en: For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .
kha: Kim lah ap ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew . Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki kjat jong ki ki iaid sha ka jingsniew , bad ki pynlong kyrkieh ban pynmih snam .

kha: Ko paid Israel , ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ki long ki bymmyntoi kum ki myrsiang kiba shong hapdeng ki jingjot jong ka nongbah .

en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God .
kha: Ka jingbitar u briew kam lah ban jop ïa ka jingthmu bahok jong U Blei .

en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .
kha: Ka jingkhublei ïa u Ruphos , ba u la jied ia U Trai , bad ïa ka kmie jong u , bad jongnga .

en: And they laughed him to scorn , knowing that she was dead .

kha: Ha kane , ka briew ka la wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u .  To ïarap ïa nga , ko Kynrad !  ka la ong .

translated_en_to_kha: Ngin sa leit sha kano kano ka jingjrong ban phah ia u khun jong ngi sha ka skulbah kaba bha.

en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .
kha: Phi baroh ar ngut phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phi katba kot la ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi tip ba da ka bor jong nga baroh nga la shakri ia u kpa jong phi .

en: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.
kha: Nga artatien ba u Tom un nang ba un kren bha ia ka French lano lano ruh.
translated_en_to_kha: Nga artatien ba u Tom un sa nang kumno ban kren bha ia ka ktien Phareng.

en: And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .
kha: To ai ha ki ïa kine ki jinghikai , khnang ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine kiei kiei ki ai jingmut , ba kin long ki bym don jingbakla .

en: This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa une hi U Jisu na ka jingïap , bad ngi baroh ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u Jisu u la pynmih ia U Blei , na kaba ngi baroh ngi long ki sakhi .

en: Unfortunately , India couldnt become member of NSG , he said .
kha: Sngewsih ba ka India kam lah ban long dkhot jong ka NSG , u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba sngewsih ka long ba ka India kam lah ban long dkhot jong ka NSG , u la ong .

en: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,
kha: u Simeon u la shim ïa u khunlung ha ki ksang ti jong u bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ia u ha la ki kti bad u la kyrkhu ia U Blei bad u la ong:

en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :
kha: U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Dei lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Na uba la ong , Ba ha u Isaak yn khot ia u symbai jong me:

en: Continue in prayer , and watch in the same with thanksgiving ;
kha: To ïaineh skhem ha ka jingduwai , bad to sharai haba phi duwai , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bteng ha ka jingduwai , bad peit ha kajuh ka rukom da kaba ainguh ;

en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled .
kha: ki rnga barhem ki sei ding na ka leilieh ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingshai ha khmat jong u la pynmeh ia ki dewiong ding .

en: But if a man be just , and do that which is lawful and right ,
kha: Tharai don u briew uba bha shisha , uba hok bad uba beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u briew u long uba hok , bad leh ia kata kaba long katkum ka ain bad kaba dei .

en: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .
kha: hynrei ngam shym la shah kynnoh pop ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pynmynsaw , bad ka jingduwai jong nga sha U Blei ka long kaba beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbymhok ha ki kti jong nga: ruh ka jingduwai jong nga ka long kaba khuid .

en: But were mingled among the heathen , and learned their works .
kha: hynrei ki la ïashongkha khleh bad ki bad bud ïa ki rukom leh blei thala jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la ia tyngkhuh hapdeng ki nongwei , bad ki la nang ia ki kam jong ki .

en: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you ?
kha: Kumno ? Hato nga la shim kabu ïa phi lyngba uno uno na ki nonglamktien kiba nga la phah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la ioh jingmyntoi na phi da uno uno na ki uba nga la phah sha phi ?

en: Even so faith , if it hath not works , is dead , being alone .
kha: Kumta ka long bad ka jingngeit : Lada ka long tang ma ka hi bad kam kynthup ïa ki kam , te ka long kaba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka jingngeit, lada kam don kam, ka long kaba iap, kaba don marwei .

en: It appears they want the same thing and will take it by force.
kha: I kumba ki iakwah ïa kajuh kumba iaknieh.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka paw ba ki kwah ia kajuh ka jinglong bad kin shim ia ka da ka bor.

en: Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingkmen da ka khubor ka jingpynshlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba haba ki la pule , ki la sngewbha na ka bynta ka jingpyntngen .

en: Children , obey your parents in the Lord : for this is right .
kha: Phi ki khun , ka long ka kamram kum kiba ngeit ban kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , namar kane ka long kaba phi dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun , kohnguh ia ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ha U Trai : namar kane ka long kaba dei .

en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )
kha: Nga la bitar bad nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait !’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga sngap jar ha ka jingbitar jong nga , Kin ym rung ha ka jingjahthait jong nga . )

en: Treasurer -Mr.Damekit Pynkhlong Dkhot Executive Committee (1).
kha: U nongbuh pisa -Bah.Damekit Pynkhlong Dkhot Executive Committee (1).
translated_en_to_kha: Treasurer -Mr.Damekit Pynkhlong Dkhot Executive Committee (1).

en: He promised to finish the task by the eleventh hour on Friday.
kha: U la kular ban pyndep ia ka kam ha ka por kaba shiphew baje ha ka sngi Palei.
translated_en_to_kha: U la kular ban pyndep ia ka kam ha ka shiphew kynta ha ka sngi Palei.

en: The road blockade caused a lot of inconvenience to commuters .
kha: Ka jingkhang surok ka la wanrah ia ka jingeh kaba khraw ia ki nongleit nongwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhang lynti ka la wanrah shibun ka jingbymsuk ia ki nongleit nongwan .

en: Then said they unto him , Where is he ? He said , I know not .
kha: Hangno u don ?  ki la kylli .  Ngam tip ,  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ia u, Hangno u don ? U la ong , Ngam tip .

en: Does this item come with accessories or is it sold separately?
kha: Hato kane ka mar ka wan ryngkat bad ki tiar pyndonkam ne la die lakajong ia ki?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane ka mar ka wan ryngkat bad ki tiar ne la die kyrpang?

en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka rupa , lane ka pisa tama ha ki pla jong phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ka ksiar , ne rupa , ne nar ha ki pla jong phi , .

en: Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem jong ki Amorites: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?
kha: Bad phim pat shemphang ?  u la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kumno phim sngewthuh ?

en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume .
kha: Ki khñiang kin bam duh ïa ki dieng bad ki jingthung jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng bad ki soh jong ka ri jong me baroh kin bam .

en: But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .
kha: Kat kumba U Blei u kren ïa ka jingshisha , ka jingkular jong nga ïa phi kam long kaba  Ho-oid  bad kaba  Em .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba U Blei U long uba shisha, ka ktien jong ngi shaphang jong phi kam shym la long kaba thikna bad kaba thikna .

en: The sons of Mushi  ; Mahli , and Eder , and Jeremoth , three .
kha: U Mushi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli , u Eder , bad u Jeremoth .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Mushi ; Mahli, bad u Eder, bad u Jeremaiah, lai ngut .

en: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .
kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ki la ong ïa u ,  to ai ha ngi ïa une u kpu borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u, ko Trai, to ai shuh shuh ia une u kpu .

en: And Remeth , and En–gannim , and En–haddah , and Beth–pazez  ;
kha: ka Remeth , ka Engannim , ka Enhaddah , bad ka Bethpasses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Remet , bad u En maamim , bad u Enhaddah bad u Bethpazez ; .

en: Mountains , and all hills  ; fruitful trees , and all cedars :
kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lumrit bad ki lumbah , ki diengsoh bad ki khlaw ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum , bad ki lum baroh; ki dieng soh , bad ki dieng soh baroh:

en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :
kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhreh ïa la ka kali thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhreh ia ka kali jong u, bad u la shim ia ki briew jong u bad u:

en: God promised that Jesus would become the King of His Kingdom .
kha: U Blei u kular ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Hima jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kular ba U Jisu un long u Syiem jong ka Hima jong U .

en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and saw , and behold four horns .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi saw tylli ki reng masi dab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la iohi, bad ha khmih saw tylli ki reng .

en: And the second row , an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
kha: ïa u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lain kaba ar, ka rong saw, ka rong saw bad u mawkordor .

en: And he , casting away his garment , rose , and came to Jesus .
kha: U la bret noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u la rynsied , bad u la wan sha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret noh ia ka jain jong u, u la ieng bad u la wan sha U Jisu .

en: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .
kha: To ngin ïit ïa la ki lynti bad phai pat sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin wad bad pyrshang ia ki lynti jong ngi , bad phai biang sha U Trai .

en: If you really do not do , you have to pull yourself together .
kha: Lada shisha phim leh , phi hap ban pynkhih ia lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim leh shisha , phi hap ban tan ia lade lang .

en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .
kha: Kan ym da donkam ïa phi ban da ong , namar kin ïohi katno phi long kiba sngur bad ba donburom ha ka jinglong jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki dang iohi ia ka jingiakren kaba khuid jong phi ryngkat bad ka jingtieng .

en: Alert! therefore, when you send me to speak to the people now.
kha: Husiar! namarkata, haba phi phah kren paidbah mynta.
translated_en_to_kha: Ailad! namarkata, haba phi phah ia nga ban kren bad ki briew mynta.

en: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .
kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u kynmaw ia ka jingkular bakhuid jong u , bad u Abraham u shakri jong u .

en: And Leah said , A troop cometh : and she called his name Gad .
kha: Ka Leah ka ong ,  Nga la long kaba donbok  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Gad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Leah u la ong, Ka kynhun shipai ka wan: bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Gad .

en: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .
kha: Phim ju kwah ïa ka jingai jingmut lem jong nga lane shahshkor haba nga pynbeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kim shym la leh ei ei na ka jingai jingmut jong nga: ki la leh bein ia ka jingshah lehbein jong nga baroh .

en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .
kha: Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u briew ban ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki ieit ia ka jingiaroh ia ki briew kham palat ban ia ka jingiaroh ia U Blei .

en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?
kha: Mynta nga la leh aïu keiñ ?  u Dabid u kylli .  Hato ngam lah seh ban kylli jingkylli ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong , Nga la leh aiu mynta ? Hato kam don daw ?

en: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar .
kha: Un thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ jong u mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shini jong ka jingknia pop un thang ha ka almari .

en: Who really are we , and why do we publicly share our beliefs ?
kha: Ngi dei kiei bad balei ngi ïalap paidbah ïa ki jingngeit jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long shisha mano , bad balei ngi iasam paidbah ia ki jingngeit jong ngi ?

en: And one tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
kha: bad sa shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka shi bynta na ka bynta uwei u langbrot, ha baroh hynriew tylli ki langbrot:

en: Have you started studying the Bible with Jehovah’s Witnesses ?
kha: Hato phi la sdang pule ïa ka Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la sdang ban pule ia ka Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi jong U Jehobah ?

en: If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .
kha: Namarkata , lada me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u para ba-ïatrei lem jong me , to pdiang sngewbha pat ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me khein ia nga namarkata u paralok , pdiang ia u kum ma nga hi .

en: He gave a huge amount of gold which is usually given to Kings.
kha: U la ai ïa ka ksiar kaba dei eh ban ai kum ïa u syiem.
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai ia ka ksiar kaba heh bha kaba ju ai sha ki Syiem.

en: The Lawyers' Paradise is also located in the District Council.
kha: Ka “Lawyers’s Paradise"ka don ha District Council ruh.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Lawyers' Paradise ruh ka don ha District Council.

en: And again he saith , Rejoice , ye Gentiles , with his people .
kha: Ka ong biang ,  Shadkmen , ko ki Jentil , ryngkat bad ki briew jong U Blei!
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u ong , To sngewbha , phi ki Jutang , bad ki briew jong u .

en: I have planted , Apollos watered ; but God gave the increase .
kha: Nga la bet , u Apollos u ai um , hynrei dei U Blei uba pynsan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la thung , u Apollos u la ai um ; hynrei U Blei u la ai ia ka jingkiew .

en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years .
kha: U Solomon u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem ïa ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la synshar ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh sawphew snem .

en: Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .
kha: Wat ju pynkynriah ïa u mawpud ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la thung naduh mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat weng noh ia ka dak hyndai , kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la buh .

en: As the lily among thorns , so is my love among the daughters .
kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki tap ïa nga da ki jingdoh ; ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka long kaba rit hapdeng ki khniang , kumjuh ruh ka jingieit jong nga hapdeng ki khun kynthei .

en: And he said , Art thou my very son Esau ? And he said , I am .
kha: Hynrei hamar ba un sa ai artat ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , u la kylli biang ,  Phi dei shisha u Iso ?  U ruh u jubab ,  Nga dei !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Hato me long u khun jong nga hi ? Bad u la ong , Nga long .

en: Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :
kha: baroh ki mrad ba la pynjuh bad kiba ha khlaw , ki mrad bapar bad ki sim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki mrad , bad ki masi baroh;

en: Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :
kha: Te U  Trai  u la kren ha nga , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki rangbah kiba la phah sha nga ban ïathuh ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la ong ha ki: Kumta phin ong ha u Sedekaiah:

en: The event is scheduled between November 5th and December 20th.
kha: Ia kane ka jingialang la buh ban pynlong hapdeng ka 5 tarik u Naiwieng haduh ka 20 tarik u Nohprah.
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kane ka jingjia la buh por hapdeng ka 5 tarik u Nailur bad ka 20 tarik u Nailur.

en: And others , tempting him , sought of him a sign from heaven .
kha: Kiwei ki la kwah ban riam ïa U Jisu , kumta ki la ong ha u ban leh ka kambah ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat, da kaba pynshoi ia u, ki la wad na u ia ka dak na bneng .

en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom ban kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ia kiba hok , hynrei ki nongpop sha ka jingkylla kaba mut .

en: He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .
kha: U pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud bad u sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkoit ia kiba la tyrkhong ha ka dohnud , bad u teh ia ki jingmynsaw jong ki .

en: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy .
kha: La don palat sawphew ngut kiba la thmu lang ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la don palat sawphew ngut kiba la leh ia kane ka jingthmu .

en: How can we benefit ourselves by attending Christian meetings ?
kha: Ka jingwan sha ki jingïalang kan ai jingmyntoi aïu ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ngin ioh jingmyntoi ia lade da kaba leit sha ki jingialang Khristan ?

en: Sing unto him a new song  ; play skilfully with a loud noise .
kha: To rwai ha u ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai , to tem da ka jingtbit ïa ka duitara , bad to risa jam da ka jingkmen !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrwai ia u ia ka jingrwai thymmai ; ialehkai da ka jingstad da ka jingsawa kaba jam .

en: I thank my God , making mention of thee always in my prayers ,
kha: Ko Philemon u para jong nga , man ka por ba nga duwai , nga kynmaw ïa me bad ainguh ïa U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ainguh ia U Blei jong nga , da kaba kdew ia me man ka por ha ki jingduwai jong nga , .

en: And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .
kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa uta u mraw , ki la shoh ïa u , bad phah kylla ïa u khlem ai ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kem ia u, bad ki la shoh ia u, bad ki la phah noh ia u thylli .

en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .
kha: Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine ki hukum harum :
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki jingbishar kiba me buh ha khmat jong ki .

en: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi te , un hap ban ai jingkheiñ shaphang ïa lade ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai jingkhein ia lade ha U Blei .

en: Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November.
kha: Ia ka jingainguh la rakhe ha ka sngi Palei kaba saw jong u bnai Naiwieng.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewnguh ka long ha ka sngi Thohdieng kaba saw jong u bnai Nohprah.

en: there is a lack of medicines, doctors, nurses in the villages.
kha: Ha nongkyndong duna dawai, doctors, nurses.
translated_en_to_kha: ka don ka jingduna dawai, ki doktor, ki nurse ha ki shnong ki thaw.

en: And Jacob kissed Rachel , and lifted up his voice , and wept .
kha: Te u la doh ïa ka bad u la sdang ïam namar ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la kdup ia ka Rakhel , bad u la pynkiew ia ka sur jong u bad u la iam .

en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me .
kha: Lymne ba ki lah ban ai ki jingpynshisha jong ki jingkynnoh jong ki kaba ki wallam mynta pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim lah ruh ban pynshisha ia kiei kiei kiba ki kynnoh mynta ia nga .

en: After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
kha: Nangta u la paw ha u Jakob , bad hadien ha baroh ki Apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata , la iohi ia u Jakob ; nangta na ki apostol baroh .

en: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea ;
kha: Ha uta u lyoh bad ha kata ka duriaw la pynbaptis ïa ki baroh kum ki nongbud u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki la shah pynbaptis ha u Moses ha u lyoh bad ha ka duriaw ; .

en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
kha: haba nga ong katno ka jingsngewsih jong nga , katno ka jingpang ba khlem kut jong ka dohnud jong nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!
translated_en_to_kha: Ba nga don ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw bad ka jingsngewsih kaba iai bteng ha ka dohnud jong nga .

en: Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .
kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Wat tieng ïa kita ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ha phi , Wat nym tieng ia ki .

en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?
kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangno mynta ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? kumjuh ruh ia ka jingkyrmen jong nga , mano ban iohi ia ka ?

en: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .

kha: Ha ka jingim jong nga kaba lyngkot ha ka pyrthei , nga thaw ki jingrwai shaphang ki hukum jong me .

kha: Kane ka dei ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu Khrist , U Khun U Blei .

en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .
kha: Ko khun jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kren , bad wat ju klet ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi ban leh .

translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng jong ngi ka kylla sha ki nongwei , ki iing jong ngi sha ki nongwei .

en: My friends scorn me : but mine eye poureth out tears unto God .
kha: Ki paralok jong nga ki krenbeiñ ïa nga ; ki khmat jong nga ki pynmih ïa ki ummat sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paralok jong nga ki sngewsih ia nga: hynrei ka jong nga ka theh ia ki ummat sha U Blei .

en: And if the man be poor , thou shalt not sleep with his pledge :

kha: Donbok ba u Tom un nym dei u ban ñiah ia ka kali.

en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots .
kha: Ki jingpyrta jong ki maji ba ngam jyllop ki sawa ha ka rud duriaw .

kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei la pynïadait skhem bad kawei pat , ba wat ka lyer ruh kam lah ban rung hapdeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka long kaba jan bha bad kawei pat , ba ym don ka Iyer kaba lah ban wan hapdeng jong ki .

en: Persecuted , but not forsaken ; cast down , but not destroyed ;
kha: La pynjynjar ïa ngi bunsien , hynrei ym shym la pynlwet noh ; teng teng hapdeng ka jingartatien , hynrei da lei lei ym ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ; don bun ki nongshun , hynrei ngim ju duh paralok ; bad wat la ngi jur ka jingmong hateng hateng , ym shym la pynjot noh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynshitom bein , hynrei ym shym la iehnoh ia u ; ba la bret noh , hynrei ym shym la pynjot ia u ; .

kha: U  Trai  u tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat ; u tip katno ki long ki bymshemphang ha kaba pynshong nongrim .

kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la mihpat , ngan leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi .

en: Hear diligently my speech , and let this be your consolations .
kha: Sngap ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ka dei tang kata ka jingpyntngen ba nga pan na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngap jar ia ka jingkren jong nga , bad ai ba kane kan long ka jingpyntngen jong phi .

en: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,
kha: Hato ka jingim jong me ka lyngkot kum ka jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki sngi jong me ki long kum ki sngi u briew ? ki snem jong me kum ki sngi u briew .

kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kwah ia ki jingbam ba bang jong u: namar ki long ka doh kaba thok .

kha: Wat pynmynsaw ïa ki shakri ba la jied jong nga ; wat ktah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

kha: Lada phi long uba tlot ha ka por shipa , phi dei uba tlot shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me lyngngoh ha ka sngi jong ka jingeh , ka bor jong me ka long kaba rit .

en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , pynkyntang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynkhuid ia ka sniehdoh bad ka kjat jong u , bad pynkyntang ia ka .

en: And the king of Ai they took alive , and brought him to Joshua .
kha: La kem ïa u bad la ïalam ïa u sha u Joshua .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ai ki la shim im ia u bad ki la wanrah ia u sha u Joshua .

translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsam ia ka jingdonkam jong ki riewkhuid ; ba la ai sha ka jingpdiang sngewbha .

kha: Ki ong ba ngin long ki bieit ban kli ïa ki kti jong ngi bad ai ïa lade ban shahjingit haduh ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U bieit u pynkhih ia la ki kti bad u bam ia la ka jong ka doh .

en: And Noah began to be an husbandman , and he planted a vineyard :
kha: U Noah , uba long u nongrep , u long u briew uba nyngkong eh ban thung ka bri sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Noah u la sdang ban long u nongrep , bad u la thung ia ka kper sohjew:

en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God .
kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ban hap ha ki kti jong U Blei uba im !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba shyrkhei ban hap ha ki kti U Blei uba im .

en: Discretion shall preserve thee , understanding shall keep thee :
kha: Ka jingsian bad ka jingshemphang jong phi kin ïada ïa phi
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbym iahap kan pynneh ia me:

en: But after I am risen again , I will go before you into Galilee .
kha: Hynrei hadien ba la pynmihpat ïa nga , ngan leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la mihpat pat , ngan leit shuwa jong phi sha Galilaia .

en: For none of us liveth to himself , and no man dieth to himself .
kha: Ym don uno uno na ngi uba im tang na ka bynta ïa lade , ym don uno uno na ngi uba ïap tang na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don uwei ruh na ngi uba im ha lade , bad ym don uwei ruh uba iap ha lade .

en: The life is more than meat , and the body is more than raiment .
kha: Ka jingim ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ka jingbam , bad ka met ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ki jaiñphong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingim ka kham palat ia ka doh , bad ka met ka kham palat ia ka jain .

en: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
kha: Nga long uta uba tip kaba kumno ka long ban shah pynshitom ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u briew uba la iohi ia ka jingshah pynshitom da u dieng jong ka jingbitar jong u .

en: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
kha: Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine kiei kiei ngi thoh ha phi , ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap .

en: And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
kha: hynrei kim shym shem ïa ka met jong U Trai Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rung shapoh bad kim lap ia ka met U Trai Jisu .

en: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators :
kha: Ha ka shithi kaba nga la thoh sha phi nga la ong ba phim dei ban ïakhleh bad ki briew kiba awria .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la thoh sha phi ha ka epistle ban ym iasyllok bad ki nongleh kam sniew:

en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp .

translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh bad ka sniehdoh u la thang da ka ding shabar ka camp .

en: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :

en: Have ye suffered so many things in vain ? if it be yet in vain .
kha: Hato baroh kaba phi la mad kam don jingmut ei ei ? Da shisha ka don katto katne ka jingmut!
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la shah shitom shibun kiei kiei kiba la jah rngai ? lada ka dang long kaba jah rngai .

en: Tom told his dentist that he brushes his teeth after every meal.
kha: U Tom u ïathuh ia u dentist jong u ba u shutbniat man ka ba u dep bam.
translated_en_to_kha: U Tom u la iathuh ha u doktor bniat jong u ba u sait ia ki bniat jong u hadien man la ka jingbam.

en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him .
kha: Nangta U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kiew na u ha ka jaka ba u la iakren bad u .

en: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you .
kha: Ho-oid , me long ka sur jong u paidbah . Ynda men ïap , ka jingstad jong me kan ïap lang bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem artatien hynrei phi long ki briew , bad ka jingstad kan iap bad phi .

en: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .
kha: Ngam lah ap shuh , nga kwah ban kren . Ngam lah shuh ban kun ïa ki ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga dap da ka jinglong , ka mynsiem hapoh jong nga ka khanglad ia nga .

en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days .
kha: Ha kine ki por baroh , u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam baroh ki sngi jong ki .

en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .
kha: Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , bad ka khyndew ka nguid ïa ki nongshun jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynkhih ia ka kti kadiang jong me, ka khyndew ka la rong noh ia ki .

en: And upon Kiriathaim , and upon Beth–gamul , and upon Beth–meon ,

translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor Kiriathaim, bad halor ka Bethgamul, bad halor ka Bethmeon .

kha: U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Korah ,  Da sngap bha , phi ki Lebi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Korah: To sngap, nga kyrpad ia phi, phi ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi:

en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;
kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba u la pynhap ha ngi da U Jisu Khrist u nongpynim jong ngi;

en: Get cashback benefits by using your preferred bank’s credit card.
kha: Ïoh ïa ki jingmyntoi jong ka jingïoh bïang pisa da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka card jong ka bank kaba phi kwah.
translated_en_to_kha: Ioh ia ki jingmyntoi ba shadien da kaba pyndonkam ia ka card ba kham kwah jong phi.

en: Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .
kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jong me ha nga , u shakri jong me — ka jingkular kaba me pynlong ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka ktien jong me ha u shakri jong me uba aiti lut ha ka jingtieng jong me .

en: Watch therefore : for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come .
kha: To sumar , te , namar ba phim tip ha kano ka sngi ba U Trai jong phi un wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit namarkata: namar phim tip ia ka por ba U Trai jong phi u wan .

en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !
kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kaba la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba jakhlia bad kaba la pynjakhlia ia ka , ha ka nongbah kaba pynshitom bein !

en: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u sngewkhia tang ïa la ki jong ki kam , ym ïa kiei kiei ki jong U Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar baroh ki wad ia la ka jong ka jong ka jaka , ym ia kiei kiei kiba long U Jisu Khrist .

en: And he said unto them ,  What would ye that I should do for you ?
kha: Kaei kata ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Phi kwah ba ngan leh aiu na ka bynta jong phi ?

en: Thou shalt increase my greatness , and comfort me on every side .
kha: Men pynlong ïa nga uba kham khraw ban ïa kaba ju long ; bad men pyntngen biang ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me pynroi ia ka jingkhraw jong nga , bad pyntngen ia nga na man la ki liang .

en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious ?
kha: Lada kata ka Hukum , kaba wallam ïa ka jingïap haba la pyntreikam ïa ka , ka la wan ha kat kata ka burom , kaba katno tam ka burom kaba kham khraw ka long kata ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem!
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ka jingpynkhuid ia u mynsiem kan kham long kaba donburom ?

en: And there came a voice to him ,  Rise , Peter  ; kill , and eat .
kha: Ka sur ka la ong ha u ,  Ïeng joit , ko Petros ; to pynïap bad to bam !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan ka sur ha u, To kiew, u Petros ; pyniap bad bam .

en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Isaak ban kular ïa u Jakob bad u Iso da ki jingkyrkhu ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Isaak u la kyrkhu ia u Jakob bad u Iso shaphang kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .

en: But he said unto them ,  I have meat to eat that ye know not of .
kha: Hynrei u la jubab ,  Nga don ka jingbam ban bam ïa kaba phi phim tip ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki , Nga don ka jingbam kaba phim tip .

en: So far , at least 1 . 25 lakh Rohingyas have fled to Bangladesh .
kha: Haduh mynta , ym duna ia ka 1 . 25 lak ngut ki Rohingya ki la phet sha Bangladesh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh mynta, la kumno kumno 1 . 25 lak Rohingya ki la phet sha Bangladesh .

en: For the  Lord  thy God is a consuming fire , even a jealous God .
kha: namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long kum ka ding kaba bam duh ; um lah shah ba ki Israel kin mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u long ka ding kaba bam , wat U Blei uba sngewsih .

en: And he erected there an altar , and called it El–elohe–Israel .
kha: U pynïeng ïa ka duwan hangta , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ka da ka kyrteng El , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynieng hangta ia kawei ka almari, bad u la khot ia ka Elelohe Israel .

en: And he left off talking with him , and God went up from Abraham .
kha: Ynda U Blei u la dep ïakren bad u Abraham , u iehnoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iehnoh ia ka jingiakren bad u , bad U Blei u la leit noh na u Abraham .

en: To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la thaw ïa ka sngi bad ïa u bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la pynlong ia ki jingshai kiba khraw: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .
kha: Naba uno uno uba ai khublei da ka jingsuk , u kylla long uba ïatreilang ha ki kam sniew ba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba la pynkhih ia u U Blei u long u nongiashim bynta ha ki kam bymman jong u .

en: And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?
kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ,  Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la ong: Shaei ngan ianujor ia ka hima U Blei ?

en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand .
kha: hynrei kata ka la lah pynïap arphew saw hajar ngut ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la iap ha ka khlam ki long arphew saw hajar .

en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .
kha: U Dabid u dei u khun khatduh , bad katba ki lai ngut shi para kiba nyngkong ki sah bad u Saul ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u long uba rit tam: bad ki lai ngut kiba kham heh ki la bud ia u Saul .

en: Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .
kha: To pynpaw ïa ka jinglong jemnud sha uwei pa uwei baroh . U Trai u la jan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka jinglong ryntih jong phi kan long kaba la tip ha ki briew baroh . U Trai u don ha kti .

en: Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .
kha: Shahshkor katba nga dang ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngap mynta ia ka jingmut jong nga , bad sngap ia ki jingkyrpad jong ki rmiang shyntur jong nga .

en: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
kha: Hato nga la kylla long mynta u nongshun jong phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga long namarkata u nongshun jong phi , namar nga iathuh ia phi ia ka jingshisha ?

en: Then came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet , saying ,
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki briew lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan ka ktien U Trai da u Haggai u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: And entered into the house of Zacharias , and saluted Elisabeth .
kha: Ka la leit sha ka ïing jong u Sekharaïah bad ka la khublei ïa ka Elisabeth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung ha iing u Sakhiaiah bad u la ai khublei ia u Elisabeth .

en: You can schedule the deliveries for Tuesday, Thursday, or Friday.
kha: Phi lah ban buh por ia ki jingpynpoi ha ka sngi Ba-ar, sngi Palei, ne sngi Thohdieng.
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban buh por ia ki jingpynpoi ha ka sngi Balang, sngi Thohdieng, ne sngi Palei.

en: There salute thee Epaphras , my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus  ;
kha: U Epaphras , uba don lang bad nga ha ka byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong u ïa me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta u Epaphraas , u paralok jong nga ha U Khrist Jisu ; .

en: Nigel has stood in 123 ODIs , 32 T20Is and 56 Tests in his career
kha: U Nigel u la ieng ha ki 123 tylli ki ODI 32 tylli ki T20I bad 56 tylli ki Test ha ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nigel u la ieng ha ki 123 tylli ki ODI , 32 tylli ki T20I bad 56 tylli ki Test ha ka jingim jong u .

en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .
kha: Ka jingstad kan pynsngewtynnat ïa ka jingim jong phi bad ka ai jingsuk lynter ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lynti jong ka ki long ki lynti jong ka jingsngewbha , bad ki lynti jong ka baroh ki long ka jingsuk .

en: But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .
kha: Ka Mari ka la kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei baroh bad ka la pyrkhat jylliew shaphang kita .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Maria ka la buh ia kine kiei kiei baroh , bad ka la pyrkhat ia ki ha ka dohnud jong ka .

en: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel :
kha: Ynda u Moses u la dep ai ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ha u paidbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynkut noh da kaba kren ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ki Israel baroh:

en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .
kha: Ïa ka liang kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna hynriew tylli ki jingker ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ki liang jong ka Tabernakl shaphang sepngi u la shna hynriew tylli ki board .

en: Having damnation , because they have cast off their first faith .
kha: Hynrei to wat kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla ha ka thup ; namar haba ki jingkwah ka doh jong ki ban shongkurim , ki phai noh na U Khrist , bad kumta ki don ka jingpynrem ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingtehkular bad u kaba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka jingtim , namar ki la bret noh ia ka jingngeit ba nyngkong jong ki .

en: My beloved is mine , and I am his : he feedeth among the lilies .
kha: Haduh katno phi long uba bhabriew , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; katno phi pynkmen ïa nga ! U phlang bajyrngam un long ka jingthiah jong ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: U baieit jong nga u long u jong nga: u bam hapdeng ki syntiew .

en: Set your affection on things above , not on things on the earth .
kha: To pynneh ïa ki jingmut jong phi ha kiei kiei kiba hangta , ym ha kiei kiei kiba hangne ha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka jingieit jong phi ha kiei kiei kiba la kdew haneng , ym ha kiei kiei kiba don ha ka pyrthei .

en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .
kha: Kynmaw ïa U  Trai  ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki lynti jong me baroh to ithuh ia u , bad un pynbeit ia ki lynti jong me .

en: Unto you , O men , I call  ; and my voice is to the sons of man .
kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , u khunbynriew ; nga khot ïa uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha phi ko shynrang , nga khot ; bad ka sur jong nga ka long ha ki khun shynrang .

en: Then he openeth the ears of men , and sealeth their instruction ,
kha: U pynlong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa kaei ba u ong , bad ki sheptieng ïa ki jingmaham jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u plie ia ki shkor jong ki briew , bad u pynskhem ia ka jinghikai jong ki , .

en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy , and scall ,
kha: Kine ki long kita ki aiñ shaphang ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka ain na ka bynta ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh baroh .

en: His eyes shall be red with wine , and his teeth white with milk .
kha: Ki khmat jong u ki saw triej na kaba dih waiñ , Bad ki bniat jong u ki lieh shaid na kaba dih dud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong u kin long kiba saw bad ka wain , bad ki bniat jong u kin lieh da ka dud .

en: Then thou shalt cut off her hand , thine eye shall not pity her .
kha: wat isynei ïa ka ; ot noh ïa ka kti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me dei ban ot noh ia ka kti jong ka, ka khmat jong me kan ym sngewsynei ia ka .

en: Mark me , and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .
kha: Khmih ïa nga . Hato kata kam la biang ba phin khmih ïa nga ha ka jingkyndit bad ban sngap noh jar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mark ia nga , bad to sngew lyngngoh , bad to buh ia ka kti jong phi ha ka shyntur jong phi .

en: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .
kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la lum thup ïa ki shi jaka jaka haduh ba la iwtung lut ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lum lang ia ki ha ki lum: bad ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong .

en: ( For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast . )
kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u Pilat u la dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uwei na ki koidi na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta ka jingdonkam u dei ban pyllait ia kawei ha ki ha ka jingkhawai . )

en: And in the morning came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep ka la wan ka ktien U Trai ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Bear ye one another s burdens , and so fulfil the law of Christ .
kha: Ïakit markylliang ïa ki jingkit , bad ha kane ka rukom phin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: To ia kit iwei ia iwei pat bad kumta to pyndep ia ka hukum U Khrist .

en: He taketh it with his eyes : his nose pierceth through snares .
kha: Mano ba lah ban pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong u bad kem ïa u ? lane mano ba lah ban kem ïa ka khmut jong u ha ka jingriam ?
translated_en_to_kha: U shim ia ka da ki khmat jong u: ka shyntur jong u ka bthei lyngba ki jingeh .

en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .
kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai shkor ia nga, bad iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga;

en: And to this agree the words of the prophets  ; as it is written ,
kha: Ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïamynjur tylli bad kane . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kane ka mynjur ia ki ktien ki nongiathuhlypa ; kumba la thoh , .

en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .
kha: Katno nga kmen ba nga lah ban shaniah ha phi nadong shadong !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewkmen namarkata ba nga don ka jingshaniah ha phi ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :
kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ngi im ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngim ïaleh na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la ngi iaid ha ka doh , ngim ialeh thma hadien ka doh:

en: For he must reign , till he hath put all enemies under his feet .
kha: Naba U dei ban synshar haduh ba Un da pyndem ïa ki nongshun baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u dei ban synshar , haduh ba un da buh ia ki nongshun baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .

en: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;
kha: To trei shitom bad wat long kiba alhia . To shakri ïa U Trai da ka dohnud kaba aiti lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba sniew ha ka kam;

en: So Jacob went down into Egypt , and died , he , and our fathers ,
kha: Nangta u Jakob u la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jakob u la leit hiar sha Ijipt bad u la iap , ma u bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: Please review our terms and conditions before placing your order.
kha: Sngewbha peit bnïah ïa ki kyndon bad ki jingpynbeit jong ngi shwa ban buh ïa ka ordar jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha bishar bniah ia ki kyndon bad ki jinglong jong ngi shwa ban buh ia ka order jong phi.

en: Is my strength the strength of stones ? or is my flesh of brass ?
kha: Hato la thaw ïa nga na u maw ? Hato ka met jong nga ka dei ka rnong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka bor jong nga ka long ka bor jong ki maw ? lane ka doh jong nga ka long ka nar ?

en: And the whole multitude of them arose , and led him unto Pilate .
kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la ïeng joit bad ka la ïalam ïa U Jisu ha khmat u Pilat , ha kaba ki la sdang ban mudui ïa u :
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah baroh kawei u la ieng bad u la ialam ia u sha u Pilat .

en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens .
kha: To ngin plie ïa la ki dohnud sha U Blei ha bneng bad duwai ,
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin rah ia ka dohnud jong ngi da ki kti jong ngi sha U Blei ha bneng .

en: From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .
kha: Na kata ka jaka u peit shane bad shatai ban ïoh ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh kata ka wad ia u mrad , bad ki khmat jong ka ki peit sha jngai .

en: And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .
kha: bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkha u nongthaw khiew , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia ki na ka bynta ka lyngkha jong u khiew kumba U Trai u la thung ia nga .

en: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .
kha: Ka jingieit jong phi ka pynkmen ïa nga , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka jingsleh jong phi ka kham iwbih ban ïa uno uno u musla .
translated_en_to_kha: U baieit jong nga u long uba lieh bad uba sniew , uba kongsan tam napdeng shi hajar .

en: And Chesed , and Hazo , and Pildash , and Jidlaph , and Bethuel .
kha: u Khesed , u Haso , u Pildash , u Jidlaph , bad u Bethuel , u kpa jong ka Rebekka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Chesed, bad u Hasol, bad u Pildash, bad u Jidlaph, bad u Bethuel .

en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba shah haduh kaba kut , uta hi un ioh jingpynim .

en: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard .
kha: Naba ngim lah ban sangeh ban kren ïa kaei kaba ma ngi hi ngi la ïohi bad ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim lah khlem da kren ia kiei kiei kiba ngi la iohi bad iohsngew .

en: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .
kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin nym ong lano lano ïa kaba sniew , u thylliej jong nga un ym kren ïa kaba shukor lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin ym kren sniew , lymne ka shyntur jong nga kan ym kren thok .

en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles .
kha: Ngam tharai ba nga long uba khampoh khyndiat ban ïa kito ki riewkyrpang ïa kiba la khot ki  apostol  jong phi!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tharai ba ngam shym la long uba rit tam hadien ki apostol kiba kongsan tam .

en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell , to the sides of the pit .
kha: Hynrei pynban , la pynhiar ïa me sha ka bynta kaba jylliew tam jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia me yn pynhiar sha dujok , sha ki liang jong ka thliew .

en: Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , lada kane ka long kumno U Blei u la ieit ïa ngi , te ma ngi , ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit , lada U Blei U ieit ia ngi kumta , ngi ruh ngi dei ban ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  my God  ; Feed the flock of the slaughter  ;
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ong ha nga ,  To leh ïa ka bynta jong u nongaplangbrot jong ka kynhun langbrot kaba dei ban shah shohdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong nga ; Ai ia ka kynhun jong ka jingpyniap ; .

en: Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to address your concern.
kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la ailad ïa ngi ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la ailad ia ngi ban pynbeit ia ka jingsngewkhia jong phi.

en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;
kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ka jingai sngewbha ia uwei u langbrot, ha baroh hynriew tylli ki langbrot ; .

en: His scales are his pride , shut up together as with a close seal .
kha: Ïa ka met jong u la shna da ki stieh ha ki laiñ , kiba la pynïadait lang bad kiba eh kum u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkren jong u ki long ka jingsarong jong u, ki la khang lang kum ka muhor kaba jan .

en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .
kha: Ka jingkynnoh ka long ym ia baroh ki jaitniam , hynrei tang ia kito ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kam bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbakla ka shong , ym bad ka niam baroh , hynrei bad ka niam kaba bakla .

en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead .
kha: ha ka jingkyrmen ba ïa nga hi yn sa pynmihpat na kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada da kano kano ka lad nga lah ban poi sha ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap .

en: Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me ?
kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha kaba ap ïa ka jingkular jong me ; katba nga kylli ,  Lano keiñ men ïarap ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki jah noh na ka bynta ka ktien jong me , da kaba ong , Lano me pyntngen ia nga ?

en: We support a wide variety of payment options for your convenience.
kha: Ngi kyrshan ïa ki rukom siew bapher bapher na ka bynta ka jingsuk jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi kyrshan ia ki lad jingsiew kiba bun jait na ka bynta ka jingsuk jong phi.

en: The  Lord  repented for this : It shall not be , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u kylla noh la ka jingmut bad u ong ,  Kaei kaba phi la ïohi kan ym jia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kylla bamut na ka bynta kane : Kan ym long kumta , ong U Trai .

en: I gave thee a king in mine anger , and took him away in my wrath .
kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la ai ha phi ïa ki syiem , bad ha ka jingbitar shla jong nga , nga la shim noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ai ia me ia u syiem ha ka jingbitar jong nga , bad nga la shim noh ia u ha ka jingbitar jong nga .

en: Yea , they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils ,
kha: Ki la ai ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei kum ki jingkñia ha ki bleithaw jong ka Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki la knia ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki ha ki ksuid , .

en: And the disciples were filled with joy , and with the Holy Ghost .
kha: Ki riewngeit ha Antiokh ki la dap da ka jingkmen bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la dap da ka jingkmen bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: At least once a year , a day is set aside to do a major cleaning .
kha: Shisien shisnem , la buh ïa kawei ka sngi ban pynkhuid bha nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: La kumno kumno shisien shi snem , la buh kyrpang ia ka sngi ban leh ia ka jingpynkhuid kaba khraw .

en: The sons of Kohath  ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .
kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kohath ; Amram, Izhar, Hebron bad Uziel, saw ngut.

en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :
kha: Ngam slem shuh ban im ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U  Trai  ka la duh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong , Ka bor bad ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka la jah noh na U Trai:

en: For this our heart is faint  ; for these things our eyes are dim .
kha: Ngi pang ha ka dohnud jong ngi hi bad ngim lah ban ïohi bha lyngba ki ummat jong ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka dohnud jong ngi ka la tyrkhong namar kine kiei kiei ki khmat jong ngi ki la tyrkhong .

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Kaei kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Kaei kaba u Moses u la hukum ia phi ?

en: And Jeremiah said , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la ong , Ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .
kha: Wat la ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah poi lypa ha ki nongbah ka Ijipt , ka Soan bad ka Hanes ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki syiem jong u ki la don ha Soan , bad ki nonglam khubor jong u ki la wan sha Hanes .

en: So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , bad uwei pa uwei u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jong ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la leit noh ia ki briew , uwei pa uwei sha ka pateng jong u .

en: youth  P.Warjri , PresidentSamla C.kharmawphlangGeneral Secretary.
kha: Samla P.Warjri , PresidentSamla C.kharmawphlangGeneral Secretary.
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla P. Warjri , President u Samla C.Kharmawphlang General Secretary.

en: O earth , cover not thou my blood , and let my cry have no place .
kha: Ko Pyrthei , wat buhrieh ïa ki jingbakla ba la leh ïa nga ! Wat ai ba ka jingkhot jong nga ïa ka jingshisha , yn pynsngap jar !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khyndew , wat tap ia ka snam jong nga , bad to ai ba ka jingud jong nga kan ym don jaka .

en: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me .
kha: Nga don hangne ha ka pyrthei tang shipor ; wat buhrieh ïa ki hukum jong me na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u nongwei ha ka khyndew: wat buhrieh ia ki hukum jong me na nga .

en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga , bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga ha ka sien kaba ar da kaba ong:

en: For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
kha: Lada phi leit sha ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban leit shata ka long ban tur sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka iing jong ka ka sdang ban iap , bad ki lynti jong ka haduh kiba iap .

en: Open thy doors , O Lebanon , that the fire may devour thy cedars .
kha: To plie ïa ki jingkhang jong pha , ko Lebanon , khnang ba ka ding kan thang duh ïa ki dieng Kedar jong pha !
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia ki jingkhang jong me, ko Lebanon, ba ka ding kan bam ia ki diengsoh jong me .

en: The BJP had staged a  " drama " " to save the funds , he said . "
kha: Ka BJP ka la pynlong ia ka  " drama " " ban pynim ia ka pisa , u la ong . "
translated_en_to_kha: Ka BJP ka la pynlong ia ka " drama" " " ban pynduna ia ka pisa , u la ong ."

en: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep .
kha: U briew uba rung shapoh lyngba ka jingkhang u long u nongap jong ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba rung na ka jingkhang u long u nongap langbrot .

en: But the CAA was the worst decision railroaded through Parliament .
kha: Hynrei ka CAA ka dei ka rai kaba sniew tam kaba la pynlong lyngba ka Parliament .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka CAA ka dei ka rai kaba sniew tam kaba la iaid lyngba ka Parliament .

en: And Laban called it Jegar–sahadutha : but Jacob called it Galeed .
kha: U Laban u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Jegar Sahadutha , katba u Jakob pat u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Galeed .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la khot ia ka Jagarsahadutha: hynrei u Jakob u la khot ia ka Galeed .

en: Upgrade your account to a premium membership for additional perks.
kha: Pynkylla ïa ka account jong phi sha ka jinglong dkhot ba rem dor na ka bynta ki jingmyntoi ba kham bun.
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbha ia ka account jong phi sha ka jinglong dkhot kaba heh na ka bynta ki jingmyntoi ba kham bun.

en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days , and full of trouble .
kha: La kha ïa ngi baroh ki briew kiba tlot bad bymdonbor . Baroh ka ïalam sha kajuh ka jingim balyngkot , bajynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: U shynrang uba la kha na ka kynthei u long tang khyndiat sngi , bad uba dap da ka jingeh .

en: And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
kha: U thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki dieng shittim , bad u la tap ia ki da ka ksiar .

en: I've been expecting something like this to happen for a long time.
kha: Nga lah ap ia kum kane ba kan jia la slem.
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la khmih lynti ia kaei kaei kaba kum kane ban jia la slem bah.

en: And the sons of Shamer  ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .
kha: U Shomer u para jong u , u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Rohgah , u Jehubbah , bad u Aram .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shamer ; Ahi, bad u Rohgah, u Jehubbah bad u Aram .

en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .
kha: To long kiba stad ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa kiwei ki bym pat ngeit , da kaba pyndonkam ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kawei pa kawei ka kabu kaba phi ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaid ha ka jingstad sha ki kiba don shabar , da kaba siew kylliang ia ka por .

en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver .
kha: Ka jingmut kaba la pynshai bha ka long kum ka dur oh-shrong ksiar ba la pyndait ha ka rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la kren bha ka long kum ki apple ksiar ha ki dur rupa .

en: And they made signs to his father , how he would have him called .
kha: Nangta , ki la ai dak ïa u kpa jong u , da kaba kyrpad ïa u kaei ka kyrteng u mon ba u khynnah un don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leh ia ki dak ha u kpa jong u , kumno un khot ia u .

en: They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .
kha: Ki pynbna ïa ka sngi shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah , bad ai ha u Naboth ka jaka shong badonburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynbna ia ka jingstet , bad ki la buh ia u Naboth ha jrong hapdeng ki briew .

en: Verizon partners with Apple and Google for superfast 5G TV service
kha: Ka Verizon ka iatreilang bad ka Apple bad ka Google na ka bynta ka jingshakri 5G TV kaba stet bha
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paralok jong ka Verizon bad ka Apple bad ka Google na ka bynta ka jingshakri 5G TV kaba stet bha .

en: All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .
kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin tlot , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki kti kin long kiba tlot , bad ki kjat baroh kin long kiba tlot kum ka um .

en: It tells us the truth about God—who he is and what he stands for .
kha: Ka ïathuh ïa ngi ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei—U dei u ei bad u long u ba kumno .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iathuh ia ngi ia ka jingshisha shaphang U Bleiu ba u long bad kaei kaba u ieng na ka bynta jong u .

en: Giving no offence in any thing , that the ministry be not blamed :
kha: Ngim kwah ïano ïano ban wad daw ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi , kumta ngi pyrshang ban ym buh ïa ki jingjynthut ha ka lynti jongno jongno .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai jingmut ei ei ha kano kano ka kam , ba ka jingshakri kan ym shah kynnoh:

en: Hide them in the dust together  ; and bind their faces in secret .
kha: Tep ïa ki baroh hapoh ka khyndew ; teh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia ki ha ka dewbilat ; bad teh ia ki khmat jong ki ha kaba rieh .

en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .
kha: U tip kumno ban trei ïa ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei jong u um hikai ia u ban sngewthuh , bad um hikai ia u .

en: To him which smote great kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba donbor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la pynkhih ia ki syiem kiba khraw: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: During the past week Delhi is experiencing a pollution emergency .
kha: Ha kane ka taiew ba la dep ka Delhi ka mad ia ka jingeh jong ka jingjaboh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew ba la dep ka Delhi ka mad ia ka jingeh ha ka jingjaboh .

en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .
kha: U la ieh ïa ka doh jong nga ha ka jing-lhieh bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh jong nga bad ka sniehdoh jong nga ka la tymmen ; u la pynpra ia ki shyieng jong nga .

en: This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
kha: To kynmaw ba kin sa wan ki por kiba jynjar ha ki sngi kiba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka tip ruh , ba ha ki sngi ba khatduh kin sa wan ki por kiba shyrkhei .

en: The glasses , and the fine linen , and the hoods , and the veils .
kha: ïa ki jaiñ bastang jong ki , ki rumal linen jong ki , bad ïa ki jaiñ teh ryndang bad ki jaiñtapkhmat kiba jrong kiba ki tap ha ki khlieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki glass , bad ki jain kiba rit , bad ki hood bad ki jingtap .

en: And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?
kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Kane ka dur bad ka kyrteng ki dei ki jongno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Ka dur bad ka jingthoh lyngkot jongno ?

en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war  ;
kha: Nangta u Joab u la phah khubor sha u Dabid da kaba ïathuh ïa u shaphang ka thma ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joab u la phah bad u la iathuh ha u Dabid ia kiei kiei baroh kiba iadei bad ka thma ; .

en: The king of Kedesh , one  ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one  ;
kha: ka Kedesh , ka Jokneam ( ha Karmel ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u Kedesh , uwei u syiem u Jokneam u Karmel , uwei;

en: It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step .
kha: Kam long ha u briew uba iaid ban pynbeit ia la ki jingjam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam dei ka jong u briew uba iaid wat ban pynbeit ia ka step jong u .

en: He then lying on Jesus  breast saith unto him , Lord , who is it ?
kha: Kumta uta u synran u la tur kham sha jan U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , u dei uno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la thiah ha ka kpoh U Jisu u la ong ha u, ko Trai, mano ?

en: Who can say , I have made my heart clean , I am pure from my sin ?
kha: Hato don uba lah ban ong da shisha ba ka jingïatiplem jong u ka khuid , ba u la lah ban iehnoh ïa ka pop jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban ong , nga la pynkhuid ia ka dohnud jong nga , nga long uba khuid na ka pop jong nga ?

en: Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .
kha: Sumar bha bad peitngor , namar phim tip lano kata ka por kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bha, to peit bad duwai: namar phim tip lano ka por .

en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ? answer me .
kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , nangno u Ïoannis u la ïoh ïa ka hok ban pynbaptis : Ka la long na U Blei ne na u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbaptis u loannis , hato ka dei na bneng ne ki briew ? jubab ia nga .

en: These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane katba nga dang don bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la kren ha phi , nga dang don ryngkat bad phi .

en: He maketh the storm a calm , so that the waves thereof are still .
kha: U pynjai jai ïa ka  erïong kaba jur , bad ki jingat phyllung ki long jai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ka eriong kaba jem , kumta ki um jong ka ki dang sah .

en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .
kha: Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh mynta ka jingkhmih lynti haduh ba ki nongshun jong u kin long ki kjat jong u .

en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice , and weep with them that weep .
kha: Kmen bad kiba kmen , ïa-ïam bad kito kiba ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha bad ki kiba leh kmen , bad to iam bad ki kiba iam .

en: See then that ye walk circumspectly , not as fools , but as wise ,
kha: Kumta da sumar kumno phi im . Wat im kum ki briew kiba bieit , hynrei , kum ki briew kiba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit te ba phi iaid da kaba pyrkhat bha, ym kum ki bieit hynrei kum kiba stad .

en: So then faith cometh by hearing , and hearing by the word of God .
kha: Kumta te , ka jingngeit ka wan lyngba kaba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ka khubor ka wan lyngba kaba ïalap ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta te ka jingngeit ka wan da kaba iohsngew , bad ka jingsngap da ka ktien U Blei .

en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .
kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la rung ha ka lieng , ki synran jong u ki la bud ia u .

en: The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .
kha: Ki briew ki kyang jam ,  Ka lyiur ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut , hynrei ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingot ka la dep , ka por lyiur ka la kut noh , bad ngim shym la lait im .

en: And Cush begat Nimrod : he began to be a mighty one in the earth .
kha: U Kush u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Nimrod ; uba la long u nongjop pyrthei uba khraw banyngkong eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Cush u la kha ia u Nimrod: u la sdang ban long uba khlain bor ha ka khyndew .

en: I know it is so of a truth : but how should man be just with God ?
kha: Ho-oid , nga la ïohsngew ïa kata baroh mynshuwa . Hynrei da kumno u briew u lah ban jop ïa ka kam jong u pyrshah ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ba ka long kumta jong ka jingshisha: hynrei kumno u briew u dei ban long tang bad U Blei ?

en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep .
kha: bad u Dabid , uba don ha ka ri khlaw , u ïohsngew shaphang kane ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iohsngew ha ka ri khlaw ba u Nabal u la ot ia ki langbrot jong u .

en: Simon the Canaanite , and Judas Iscariot , who also betrayed him .
kha: u Simon u Riew-ieit ri , bad u Judas Iskariot uba la die noh ïa u Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon u nong Kanaan bad u Judas Isarot ruh u la shet kylla ia u .

en: Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?
kha: U Blei um ju pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok , um ju pep ban leh ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Blei U pynkylla ia ka jingbishar ? lane hato ka hok kaba bakla ?

en: And there are differences of administrations , but the same Lord .
kha: Don bun jait ki rukom shakri , hynrei ïa ujuh U Trai la shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ki jingiapher jong ki jingsynshar , hynrei u juh u Trai .

en: Jehovah is so great and powerful , yet he listens to our prayers !
kha: U Jehobah u long uba khraw bad badonbor tam , hynrei u sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehobah u long uba khraw bad uba donbor haduh katta katta , hynrei u sngap ia ki jingduwai jong ngi !

en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .
kha: Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh nam kum u nongthaw kulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba thmu ban leh ia kaba sniew yn khot u briew uba sniew .

en: Then answered Esther , and said , My petition and my request is  ;
kha: Ka Esther ka jubab ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia ka Esther , bad u la ong , Ka jingujor jong nga bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga ka long;

en: The police is also suspecting the involvement of hotel employees .
kha: Ki pulit ki suba ruh ia ka jingdonkti jong ki nongtrei hotel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ruh ki suba ba ki nongtrei hotel ki donkti .

en: So I went , and hid it by Euphrates , as the  Lord  commanded me .
kha: Kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ki hajan ka Ïuphratis .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad nga la buhrieh ia ka da ka Euphrates kumba U Trai u la hukum ia nga .

en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight , and carry out thereby .
kha: Katba ki dang khmih , to pynpei thliew lyngba ka kynroh ka ïing jong me bad to shim ïa ka song jong me shabar lyngba jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To tih ia me lyngba ka kynroh ha khmat jong ki , bad to pynlong ia kata .

en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief .
kha: Namar ba kim don ka jingngeit , um shym la leh shibun ki kambah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la leh bun ki kam kiba khlain hangta namar ka jingbymngeit jong ki .

en: And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u shakri uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tylli ki sbai u la ïohnong sa ar hajar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh uta uba la ioh arngut , u la ioh ruh sa arngut .

en: My son , attend to my words  ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .
kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; sngap ïa ki ktien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun jong nga, to sngap ia ki ktien jong nga; to sngap ia ka shkor jong me ha ki ktien jong nga .

en: The other day I ran out of gas in the middle of a busy Interstate.
kha: Kato ka sngi nga lut umphniang ha pdeng kawei ka khap jylla.
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei pat ka sngi nga la phet noh na ka gas hapdeng ka jaka kaba bun briew.

en: But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .
kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngewthuh aïu kane ka jinghikai ka kit jingmut , bad ki la sngewsheptieng ban kylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim sngewthuh ia kata ka jingong , bad ki la tieng ban kylli ia u .

en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .

en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One , and ye know all things .
kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi la lah don ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ba la theh ha phi da U Khrist , bad kumta phi baroh phi tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi don ka jingpynkhuid na Uba khuid , bad phi tip ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And herein is that saying true , One soweth , and another reapeth .
kha: Ka jingong ka long kaba shisha , ‘ Uwei u bet , uwei pat u ot .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne ka long kaba shisha , Uwei u bet bad uwei pat u kheit .

en: O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei uba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Israel, me la pynjot ia lade ; hynrei ha nga ka long ka jingiarap jong me .

en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .
kha: La otsher ïa ki baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi la ot ia u Abraham bad u Ishmael u khun jong u .

en: And their border was toward Jezreel , and Chesulloth , and Shunem ,
kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Jesreel , ka Khesulloth , ka Shunem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam jong ki u long sha Jesel bad u Ksulloth bad u Shunem .

en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .
kha: Ïa u Er , u khun nyngkong jong u , u Judah u la pynïoh ka tnga kaba kyrteng ka Tamar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la shim ia ka tnga na ka bynta u khun nyngkong jong u, uba kyrteng u Tamar .

en: Let the house of Aaron now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Ai ba ki lyngdoh jong U Blei kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka iing u Aaron mynta kan ong , ba ka jingisynei jong u kan sah junom .

en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u, bad wanrah ia ki sha u lum Hor:

en: Upon this I awaked , and beheld  ; and my sleep was sweet unto me .
kha: Kumta te , ki briew kin ong , ‘ Nga la leit thiah bad nga la kyndit ha ka jingthymmai bor .’
translated_en_to_kha: Halor kane nga la kyndit , bad nga la iohi ia ka met bad ka jingthiah jong nga ka la thiang ia nga .

en: For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
kha: Phin don borabor ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiba duk phi don beit bad phi ; hynrei ia nga phim don beit .

en: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,
kha: Baroh ki la ïa-ïam haba ki la kdup ïa u bad ki la doh khublei ïakhlad bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la iam bad ki la hap ha ka ryndang jong u Paul bad ki la kdup ia u .

en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
kha: U la poi kham jan sha ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïam na ka bynta jong ka , u da ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan hajan kata ka shnong bad u la iam halor jong ka .

en: And as ye go , preach , saying , The kingdom of heaven is at hand .
kha: Khie leit bad ïalap , ‘ Ka Hima ki bneng ka la jan !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba phi nang iaid, to ialap da kaba ong , Ka hima bneng ka don hajan .

en: Pilate therefore , willing to release Jesus , spake again to them .
kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pyllait noh ïa U Jisu , kumta u la kyrpad biang ïa u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat namarkata, da kaba mon ban pyllait ia U Jisu , u la kren biang ia ki .

en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
kha: Mynta , nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba phi la ïohi ïa nga hynrei phin ym ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong ha phi , Ba phi ruh phi la iohi ia nga bad phim ngeit .

en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you .
kha: Bad kumta la khanglad ïa nga bunsien na kaba wan sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw kata ruh nga la shah khanglad shibun ban wan sha phi .

en: But ( which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works .
kha: Nga kwah ruh ba ki kynthei kin long kiba biang bad kiba sngewthuh ïa ki jaiñ ba ki riam bad ban riam da kaba dei ; ym da ki jingkhyllong shñiuh bakhyllah ne da ki jingdeng ksiar ne ki paila ne da ki jaiñkup riam kiba remdor , hynrei da ki kam babha , kumba ka dei ïa ki kynthei kiba kam ba ki long kiba riewblei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei (ka kaba long ki kynthei kiba pynpaw ia ka jinglong blei ) da ki kam kiba bha .

en: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kiba nga lah ban ñiew kum ka jingmyntoi ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiei kiei kiba nga la ioh ha nga , kito kiba nga la khein ia ka jingduhnong na ka bynta U Khrist .

en: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called ?
kha: Dei ma ki kiba kren sniew ïa kata ka kyrteng babha ïa kaba la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kim kren bein ia kata ka kyrteng kaba dei da kaba la khot ia phi ?

en: And he said unto them ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut da kaba ong ,  To shahshkor te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Uta uba don ki shkor ban iohsngew , to ai ba un iohsngew .

en: At the last it biteth like a serpent , and stingeth like an adder .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud phin sngew kumba phi la shah puh da u  seiñïong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba khatduh ka bam kum u bsein , bad ka sting kum u bsein .

en: Who can find a virtuous woman ? for her price is far above rubies .
kha: A katno ka long kaba eh ban shem ïa ka tnga kaba lah ! ka dor jong ka , ka kham kor shibun ban ïa ki mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban shem ia ka kynthei kaba bha ? namar ka dor jong ka ka long kaba kham heh ban ia ki ruby .

en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .
kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um nang ang wat tang shikyntien ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um lah ban jubab ia u Abner sa shisien , namar u la tieng ia u .

en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out  ; and they could not .
kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u , hynrei kim lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la kyrpad ia ki synran jong me ban bret noh ia u ; bad kim lah .

en: For he spake , and it was done  ; he commanded , and it stood fast .
kha: Haba u la kren , ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong ; ha ka hukum jong u baroh ka la paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la kren, bad la leh ia ka; u la hukum, bad ka la ieng skhem .

en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .
kha: Kumta khot ïa ki para Israel  Ki briew jong U Blei  bad  kiba ieit da U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ia ki hynmen jong phi, Ammi ; bad ia ki para kynthei jong phi, Ruhamah .

en: Gather up thy wares out of the land , O inhabitant of the fortress .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , phi don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ! To lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynmih ia ki mar jong me na ka ri , ko nongshong shnong jong ka kut .

en: Share your shopping experience with us to help improve our platform.
kha: Sam ïa ka jingshem jong phi ha ka por thied jingthied bad ngi ban ïarap ban pynbha ïa ka rynsan jong ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Share ia ka jingshem jong phi bad ngi ban iarap ban pynbha ia ka rynsan jong ngi.

en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?
kha: U Blei u wan ha u Balaam , bad u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba sahmiet bad me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la wan sha u Balaam bad u la ong: Kiei kine ki briew kiba don bad me ?

en: WhatsApp tricks : How to read deleted WhatsApp messages on Android ?
kha: WhatsApp tricks : Kumno ban pule ia ki message WhatsApp ba la delete ha Android ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki buit WhatsApp: Kumno ban pule ia ki khubor WhatsApp ba la pyndam noh ha ka Android ?

en: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
kha: U hi da lade um dei ka jingshai ; u la wan ban ïathuh shaphang ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la long uta u Jingshai , hynrei la phah ia u ban sakhi ia kata ka Jingshai .

en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him .
kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shah ïa u ban tip ba phi ieit ïa u da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga kyrpad ia phi ba phin pynskhem ia ka jingieit jong phi ia u .

en: What daily practice is good for anyone wanting to learn God’s will ?
kha: Ban tip ïa ka mon jong U Blei , aïu dei ban leh man la ka sngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingleh kaba man ka sngi kaba bha na ka bynta uno uno uba kwah ban nang ia U Blei ].

en: For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .
kha: Ki nuti bad ki kynthei lyngkar ki long ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kawei ka khlaw ka long ka thliew kaba jylliew ; bad ka kynthei kaba phylla ka long ka thliew kaba rit .

en: Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .
kha: un pynshlur ïa phi bad pynshaitbor ïa phi ban ïai leh bad kren ïa kaei kaba bha .
