translated_en_to_kha: Pynsngewbha ia ki dohnud jong phi , bad pynskhem ia phi ha man la ka ktien bad ka kam kaba bha .

en: For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
kha: Naba kumba ki briew baroh ki ïap namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ha u Adam baroh ki iap, kumta ha U Khrist baroh kin sa im .

en: An FIR was lodged against the accused at the Vakola police station .
kha: La ujor da ka FIR pyrshah ia une u nongshah kynnoh ha thanat pulit jong ka Vakola .
translated_en_to_kha: La ujor FIR pyrshah ia utei u nongshah kynnoh ha thanat Vakola .

en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .
kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan ban wad bad ban pynim ïa kiba la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Khun u briew u wan ban wad bad ban pynim ia kata kaba la jah .

en: And how hear we every man in our own tongue , wherein we were born ?
kha: Kumno , te , ba baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ka ktien tynrai jong ngi hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumno ngi iohsngew ia uwei pa uwei ha la ka jong ka shyntur , ha kaba la kha ia ngi ?

en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .
kha: Ka nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ianujor ia ka khun jong u Seion bad ka kynthei kaba sngewrit bad kaba jem .

en: Of the sons of Uzziel  ; Michah the first , and Isshiah the second .
kha: U Ussiel , u khun uba saw jong u Kohath , u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mikah bad u Isshaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki khun shynrang jong u Ussiel ; Mihiah uba nyngkong bad u Isiah uba ar .

en: Was returning , and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet .
kha: Kumta u Philip u la khreh bad u la leit . Mynta , u ïunukh na Ithiopia , uba dei u rangbah synshar ba ha khmat eh uba dei khmih ïa ka jaka kynshew jong ka syiem jong ka Ithiopia , u dang don ha ka lynti sha ïing . U la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U Blei bad ba u dang leit phai pat sha la ïing ha ka kali kulai jong u . Katba u dang leit phai , u la pule na ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: U dang wan phai , bad u la shong ha ka kali jong u u la pule ia u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa .

en: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?
kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kaei kaba u la thoh , kumno phi lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba nga ong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phim ngeit ia ki jingthoh jong u , kumno phin ngeit ia ki ktien jong nga ?

en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long uba khraw ha Zion bad u long uba ha khlieh duh halor ki briew baroh .

en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .
kha: Ki khun shynrang u Eli ki dei ki riewbymman . Kim ju shahshkor ïa U  Trai
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khun shynrang jong u Eli ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Belial ; kim ithuh ia U Trai .

en: And as they departed from Jericho , a great multitude followed him .
kha: Katba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki dang mihnoh na Jerikho , u paidbah babun u la bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang mih na Jerikoh , u paidbah uba bun u la bud ia u .

en: The accused have remained absconding since the incident took place .
kha: Ki nongshah kynnoh ki dang phet krad naduh ba la jia katei ka jingjia .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshah kynnoh u la sah khlem jingmut naduh ba la jia katei ka jingjia .

en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .
kha: Namar kane balei bun na phi , phi pang bad phi swai , bad bun bah ki la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka daw bun ki long kiba tlot bad kiba pang hapdeng jong phi , bad bun ki thiah .

en: The same day went Jesus out of the house , and sat by the sea side .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi U Jisu u la mihnoh na ïing bad u la leit sharud ka duriaw , ha kaba u la shong ban hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi u Jisu u la mih na iing , bad u la shong ha rud duriaw .

en: And they said , We will call the damsel , and enquire at her mouth .
kha: Ki jubab ,  To ngin khot ïa ka bad tip aïu ka don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong , Ngin khot ia ka damel bad kylli ha ka shyntur jong ka .

en: I will delight myself in thy statutes : I will not forget thy word .
kha: Ngan sngewbha eh ha ki aiñ jong me ; ïa ki hukum jong me ngan ym klet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan sngewbha ia lade ha ki ain jong me: Ngan ym klet ia ka ktien jong me .

en: Alert! because of that, when you send me to speak to the people now.
kha: Husiar! namar-kata, haba phi phah kren paidbah mynta.
translated_en_to_kha: Ailad! namar kata, haba phi phah ia nga ban kren bad ki briew mynta.

en: Lo , let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein .
kha: Pynlong ïa ka kaba khlem seisoh , ka miet khlem ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , to ai ba kata ka miet kan long marwei , wat ai ba ka sur kaba kmen kan wan rung shapoh .

en: Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :
kha: Nangta ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namar ba kim ngeit ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki la leh bein ia ka ri kaba sngewtynnad , kim ngeit ia ka ktien jong u:

en: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .
kha: U la don saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u juh u briew u don saw ngut ki khun kynthei kiba dang kha khun .

en: The injured have been admitted to Siddharth Hospital for treatment .
kha: Kitei kiba mynsaw ki la shah sumar ha Siddharth Hospital .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba mynsaw ki la shah sumar ha Siddharth Hospital .

en: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .
kha: Haba nga ai jingmut , ki briew ki sngap jar bad ki shahshkor bha ïa kaei kaba nga ong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha nga ki briew ki la ai shkor, bad ki la ap, bad ki la sngap jar ha ka jingai jingmut jong nga .

en: And for fear of him the keepers did shake , and became as dead men .
kha: Ki nongap phira ki la sheptieng katta katta haduh ba ki la kyiuh bad ki la long kum ki briew kiba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ka jingtieng ia u ki nongsumar ki la khih , bad ki la kylla long kum ki briew kiba la iap .

en: I robbed other churches , taking wages of them , to do you service .
kha: Mynba nga dang trei hapdeng jong phi , la siew ïa nga da kiwei pat ki balang . Kum ban shu ong noh , nga la lute na ki khnang ban ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la lute ia kiwei pat ki balang , nga shim ia ka bainong jong ki , ban leh ia phi ka jingshakri .

en: So , you should understand that what happens if the length changes .
kha: Kumta , phi dei ban sngewthuh ba kaei kaba jia lada ka jingjrong ka kylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta , phi dei ban sngewthuh ba kaei kaba jia lada ka jingjrong ka kylla .

en: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .
kha: Lada phi dei uba khlaiñ bam , da synshar bha ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad buh ia ka wait ha ka shyntur jong me lada me long u briew uba la ai jingkwah bam .

en: And Mizraim begat Ludim , and Anamim , and Lehabim , and Naphtuhim ,
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ijipt ki long ki briew jong ka Lydia , ka Anam , ka Lehab , ka Naphtuh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Mizraim u la kha ia u Ludim, bad u Anamim, bad u Lehabim bad u Naphtuhim .

en: Your account has been temporarily locked due to suspicious activity.
kha: Ka account jong phi ka la shah khang shipor namar ki kam kiba bymman.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka account jong u ka la shah khang shipor namar ka jingtreikam kaba suba.

en: The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong u paidbah kin sangeh noh na kaba kren ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ki la kiar na kaba kren , bad ki la buh ia la ka kti ha ka shyntur jong ki .

en: Strive not with a man without cause , if he have done thee no harm .
kha: Wat ïakynroi badno badno khlem daw haba um ju leh kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ialeh bad u briew khlem daw , lada um shym la leh ei ei ia me .

en: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .
kha: Ki briew kiba bieit kim suidñiew lada ki leh pop , hynrei ki briew kiba beit ki kwah ban ïohmap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bieit ki pynlong ia ka jingleh bein ha ka pop: hynrei hapdeng kiba hok ka don ka jingsngewbha .

en: PM ' s address at Birth Centenary celebrations of Acharya Mahapragya
kha: Ka jingkren u PM ha ka jingrakhe dap shispah snem kha jong u Acharya Mahapragya
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkren jong u PM ha ka jingrakhe ia ka jingkha khun jong u Acharya Mahapragya .

en: We understand your concern and are here to help resolve it promptly.
kha: Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka jingsngewkhïa jong phi bad ngi don hangne ​​ban ïarap ban pynbeit kloi ïa ka.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewthuh ia ka jingsngewkhia jong phi bad ngi don hangne ban iarap ban pynbeit kloi ia ka.

en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?
kha: Hato u pukni u ap hukum na me ban shna ïa la ka skum halor ki lumbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u blang u kiew ha ka hukum jong me , bad u pynlong ia ka bniat jong ka ha jrong ?

en: He was trained by Sistla Somayajulu in weightlifting for some time .
kha: La pyntbit ia u da ka Sistla Somayajulu ha ka kam rah khia katto katne por .
translated_en_to_kha: La hikai ia u da u Sistla Somayajulu ha kaba rah ia ka jingkhia katto katne por .

en: Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
kha: To ñiewburom ïa baroh , to ieit ïa la ki parabangeit , to tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad ñiewburom ïa u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Burom ia ki briew baroh . Ieit ia ka jinglong paralok . To tieng ia U Blei . Burom ia u syiem .

en: Because of that, I am writing, that we should keep our spirits high.
kha: Namarkata, nga thoh te, ba ngin pyneh rngiew.
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata, nga thoh, ba ngi dei ban buh ia ki mynsiem jong ngi kiba jrong.

en: By me princes rule , and nobles , even all the judges of the earth .
kha: Man la u nongsynshar ha pyrthei u synshar da ka jingïarap jong nga , ki nongsaiñ hima bad ki riewdonburom kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da nga ki syiem ki synshar , bad ki riew rangbah , wat ki nongbishar baroh jong ka pyrthei .

en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
kha: U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u thom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Hazael u syiem Syria u la pynshitom bein ia ki Israel baroh ki sngi jong u Jehoaaz .

en: Compare this product with similar ones to see which fits your needs.
kha: Pynïanujor ïa kane ka mar bad kiwei pat kiba ïadei kumjuh ban ïohi kano ba ïadei bad ki jingdonkam jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Pynianujor ia kane ka jingmih bad kiba kum kita ban iohi kiba iadei bad ki jingdonkam jong phi.

en: Then will the  Lord  be jealous for his land , and pity his people .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta la ka ri ; u la don ka jingisynei ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai un sngewsih ia ka ri jong u , bad un sngewsynei ia ki briew jong u .

en: A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .
kha: Ki paralok borabor ki pynpaw ïa ka jingieit jong ki . Ki hynmen ki para ki dei na ka bynta kaei lada kim ïarap lem ha por jingjynjar ?
translated_en_to_kha: U paralok u ieit ha man la ka por , bad u hynmen u kha na ka bynta ka jingeh .

en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy ,
kha: bad man la ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong phi baroh , nga duwai da ka jingkmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh shi katta ha man la ka jingduwai jong nga na ka bynta jong phi baroh da kaba kyrpad da ka jingkmen ,

en: He hath led me , and brought me into darkness , but not into light .
kha: U la beh ïa nga jylliew bad kham jylliew sha ka jingdum ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ialam ia nga sha ka jingdum , hynrei ym sha ka jingshai .

en: He appointed the moon for seasons : the sun knoweth his going down .
kha: Me la thaw ïa u bnai ban pynlong jingkheiñ bnai ; ka sngi ka tip ïa ka por ban sep .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thung ia u bnai na ka bynta ki aiom: ka sngi ka tip ia ka jingleit jong u shapoh .

en: We are committed to ensuring that such incidents don’t happen again.
kha: Ngi shimkhïa ban pynthikna ba kum kine ki jingjïa kin ym jïa bïang.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long kiba thrang ban pynthikna ba kum kine ki jingjia kin ym jia shuh.

en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .
kha: U la ïathuh ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abiathar u la pyni ia u Dabid ba u Saul u la pyniap ia ki lyngdoh jong U Trai .

en: Declare his glory among the heathen , his wonders among all people .
kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u sha ki hima , ïa ki kam radbah jong u sha ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia ka burom jong u hapdeng ki nongwei , ki jingphylla jong u hapdeng ki briew baroh .

en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies : O  Lord  , put me not to shame .
kha: Nga la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me , A  Trai  ; wat shah ba yn buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la sahkut ha ki jingphla jong me: Ko Trai , wat pynjah burom ia nga .

en: So Samuel turned again after Saul  ; and Saul worshipped the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u Samuel u leit phai ryngkat bad u , bad u Saul u la mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Samuel u la phai biang hadien ba u Saul bad u Saul ki la mane ia U Trai .

en: Therefore, the more you learn, the more messed up are your thoughts.
kha: Kumta, kat nang stad, nang khongpong ka jingpyrkhat.
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta katba nang nang nang nang nang nang nang kham jynjar ki jingpyrkhat jong phi.

en: And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam jong ki u long u Helkat, bad u Hali, bad u Beten bad u Achsah .

en: He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .
kha: U la shim noh ïa ka spah jong nga baroh bad pynjot ïa ka burom jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la weng noh ia nga na ka burom jong nga , bad u la shim ia ka khlieh na ka khlieh jong nga .

en: And he answered them , saying ,  Who is my mother , or my brethren ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga ? Kiei ki para jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Ka kmie jong nga ne ki hynmen jong nga ?

en: Moreover it is required in stewards , that a man be found faithful .
kha: Kawei kaba donkam ïa kum uta u shakri ka long ba un long uba ïaineh ha u kynrad jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka long kaba donkam ha ki nongsumar , ba u briew un shah shem ba u long uba iaineh .

en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him , saying , Master , eat .
kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki synran ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to bam ei ei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba ki synran jong u ki duwai ia u, ki ong, Ko Nonghikai, bam .

en: Is the toy appropriate for my childs physical and mental abilities ?
kha: Hato ka jinglehkai ka iadei bad ka jinglah met bad jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki khun jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jinglehkai ka iadei bad ki khun jong nga ha ka met bad ka jingmut jingpyrkhat ?

en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing , and thy lips with rejoicing .
kha: Un shah ïa phi ban rkhie bad ban kyang jam pat ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba un da pyndap ia ka shyntur jong me da kaba rkhie , bad ki rmiang shyntur jong me da ka jingkmen .

en: Leah was tender eyed  ; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured .
kha: Ka Leah ka don ki khmat kiba i-ieit , katba ka Rakhel pat ka long i-lub bad kaba bhabriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Leah ka la long kaba jem bad kaba jem hynrei ka Rakhel ka la itynnad bad kaba la sngewtynnad bha .

en: But wilt thou know , O vain man , that faith without works is dead ?
kha: Phi kiba bieit ! Hato phi kwah ban da pyn-i ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long ka bymmyntoi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me tip , ko briew uba lehnohei, ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka la iap ?

en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingstad briew , ka jingproh jabieng , ka jingsngewthuh — kim lah ïarap ei ei lada U  Trai  u long pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingstad ne jingsngewthuh ne jingai jingmut pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: The locusts have no king , yet go they forth all of them by bands  ;
kha: Ki puit : kim don syiem , hynrei ki mih ryntih kynhun kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai kim don syiem , hynrei ki leit noh baroh da ki band ; .

en: Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :
kha: Te ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai :  Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jong phi , Da ka jingrwai ngin pdiang sngewbha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Israel ki rwai ia kane ka jingrwai , To kiew sha jrong, ko well ; to rwai ia ka:

en: Watch ye , stand fast in the faith , quit you like men , be strong .
kha: To sharai , to ïeng skhem ha ka jingngeit , to long shlur , to long kiba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia phi, ieng skhem ha ka jingngeit, iehnoh ia phi kum ki briew, to long kiba skhem .

en: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .
kha: Kine ki long ki ktien shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lemuel ka kren ha u :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u syiem Lemel , ka jingiathuhlypa kaba ka kmie jong u ka la hikai ia u .

en: He fashioneth their hearts alike  ; he considereth all their works .
kha: U saiñdur ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki baroh , bad u tip ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynwan dur ia ki dohnud jong ki kumjuh; u pyrkhat ia ki kam jong ki baroh .

en: Corruption further reinforces poverty and brings about backwardness.
kha: Ka jingbamsap ka nang pynkhlaiñ shuh shuh ia ka jingduk bad wanrah ïa ka jingsahdien.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbamsap ka pynskhem shuh shuh ia ka jingduk bad ka wanrah ia ka jingkylla.

en: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .
kha: Kine ki shalyntem ki long kumjuh kum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ki tyrpeng , la pyrta ia ki ha ka jingsngap jong nga , ko tyrpeng .

en: As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .
kha: U la kynmaw ban pyn-i jingisynei ha u Abraham bad ha baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u la kren ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, ha u Abraham bad ha u symbai jong u junom .

en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba hangamei , uba sarong bad u bym ju kheiñ briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkren bein kaba sngewsih bad kaba sngewsih ka dei ka kyrteng jong u , uba iadei bad ka jingbitar kaba sngew sarong .

en: Who is weak , and I am not weak ? who is offended , and I burn not ?
kha: Haba uno uno u tlot , te nga ruh nga tlot ; haba uno uno u hap ha ka pop , la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkthang mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba tlot , bad ngam long uba tlot ? uba sngewsih , bad ngam thang ?

en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .
kha: U  Trai  u khmih sha tbian na bneng , bad u ïohi ïa u khunbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u peit na bneng; u iohi ia ki khun shynrang baroh .

en: The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .
kha: U  Trai  u la kloi ban kren ïa ka kam jong u , u long uba la kloi ban bishar ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u ieng ban kyrpad , bad u ieng ban bishar ia ki briew .

en: And the trees said to the fig tree , Come thou , and reign over us .
kha: Nangta ki dieng ki ong ïa u dieng Dumbur , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng ki la ong ha u dieng sohjew , Me wan bad me synshar halor jong ngi .

en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingtyrkhong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha Jeremaiah shaphang ka jingduna .

en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?
kha: Kaei nga lah ban ai ïa U  Trai namar ka jinglehbha jong u baroh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba ngan ai ha U Trai na ka bynta ki jingmyntoi jong u baroh ha nga ?

en: But Jesus answered them ,  My Father worketh hitherto , and I work .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  U Kpa jong nga u ïai trei , bad ka dei ïa nga ruh ban trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ia ki, U Kpa jong nga u trei haduh mynta, bad nga trei .

en: Chat with our customer service representatives for quick assistance.
kha: ïa kren bad ki nongmihkhmat jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingïarap kaba kloi.
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkylla bad ki nongmihkhmat jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingiarap kaba kloi.

en: As a dog returneth to his vomit , so a fool returneth to his folly .
kha: U bieit uba leh ïa kaei kaei kaba mutlop ha kaba ar sien u long kum u ksew uba leit phai sha la ka prie .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u kulai u phai sha ka jingsma jong u, kumta u bieit u phai biang sha ka jingsma jong u .

en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Consider your ways .
kha: Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid ; Pyrkhat ia ki lynti jong phi .

en: And they worshipped him , and returned to Jerusalem with great joy :
kha: Ki la mane ïa u bad ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem , kiba la pyndap da ka jingkmen bakhraw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mane ia u bad ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen kaba khraw:

en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .
kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba ngan leit ïathuh ïa u ba phi don hangne ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta me ong, Leit, to iathuh ia u kynrad jong me, Ha khmih, u Elijah u don hangne .

en: But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up  ; and he arose .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u khynnah na ka kti bad u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u , bad u la ïeng joit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ia u da ka kti bad u la rah ia u ; bad u la ieng .

en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la jam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la ieng bad ki la kynnoh jur ia u .

en: A foolish woman is clamorous : she is simple , and knoweth nothing .
kha: Ka jingmutlop ka long kum ka kynthei kaba kaw kaw , kaba bieit bad kaba khlemrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei kaba bieit ka long kaba sngewsih: ka long kaba suk , bad kam tip ei ei .

en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour  ; but shalt fear thy God .
kha: Wat pynshitom beiñ ïa ki , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat synshar ia u da ka jingsngewsih ; hynrei to sheptieng ia U Blei jong me .

en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .
kha: Nga shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar nga ieit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan sngewbha ia lade ha ki hukum jong me kiba nga la ieit .

en: She seeketh wool , and flax , and worketh willingly with her hands .
kha: Ka trei smat ïa lade ban thir  saiwul bad thain jaiñ linen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wad ia ka snieh langbrot bad ka sniehdoh bad ka trei mon sngewbha da ki kti jong ka .

en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it , with all these vessels .
kha: Pyndonkam laiphew san kilo ka ksiar nylla ban thaw ïa uta u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar baroh kiba ïadei bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka talent ksiar kaba khuid un pynlong ia ka, da kine ki tiar baroh .

en: Evil pursueth sinners : but to the righteous good shall be repayed .
kha: Ka jingjynjar ka buddien ïa ki nongpop kylleng , hynrei ki briew kiba hok kin ïoh bainong da kiei kiei kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew ka bud ia ki nongpop: hynrei ia ka jingbha kaba hok yn siew kylliang .

en: The troops of Tema looked , the companies of Sheba waited for them .
kha: Ki paid nongkhaïi na Sheba bad Tema ki ïawad ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai jong ka Tema ki peit , ki kompeni jong ka Sheba ki ap ia ki .

en: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .
kha: Lada me leit sha ka ïing jong ka , me don ha ka lynti sha ka ri kiba ïap . Ka dei ka lynti kaba jan tam sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing jong ka ka long ka lynti sha dujok , ka leit sha ki kamra iap .

en: His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :
kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka leilieh , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki lieh kum ka ïor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong u ka long kum ka jingshai, bad ka rong jong u ka long kum u slap:

en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jong u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko symbai jong u Abraham u shakri jong u, phi ki khun u Jakob jong u .

en: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall .
kha: Kito kiba pyrkhat ba ki ïeng skhem , kan kham bha ba ki sumar ba ïoh ki kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ai ba uta uba pyrkhat un ieng un sumar na ka bynta ba un hap .

en: And Moses and Aaron did as the  Lord  commanded them , so did they .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia ki , kumjuh ruh ki la leh .

en: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .
kha: U la ong ïa kane , bad nangta u la sah noh ha Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la ong ia kine ki ktien ha ki , u dang sah ha Galilaia .

en: And if a house be divided against itself , that house cannot stand .
kha: Lada ka longïing ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka longïing kan kyllon noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada la phiah ia ka iing pyrshah ia lade , kata ka iing kam lah ban ieng .

en: Several times , the bus has reached the village well past midnight .
kha: Katto katne sien , ka bus ka la poi sha shnong palat shiteng miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne sien , ka bus ka la poi sha shnong bha mynta ka miet .

en: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years , and begat a son :
kha: Haba u Lamekh u la dap shispah phraphew ar snem ka rta , u ïoh khun shynrang ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Lamech u la im shispah hynriewphew ar snem , bad u la kha khun shynrang:

en: A loving father provides for his family materially and spiritually .
kha: U Blei u khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa uba ieit u pynbiang ia ka iing ka sem jong u ha ka liang ka met bad ka mynsiem .

en: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh , nga la kren ha phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hukum ia phi ha kata ka por ia kiei kiei baroh kiba phi dei ban leh .

en: Moab is destroyed  ; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard .
kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynjot ; ha sngap ïa ki khynnah ba ki ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Moab ka la shah pynjot ; ki khun rit jong ka ki la pynmih ia ka jingpyrta ban iohsngew .

en: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits .
kha: U nongrep uba la trei shitom u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bynta kaba nyngkong na ka jingot .
translated_en_to_kha: U tnga uba trei u dei ban long u nongshim bynta nyngkong eh jong ki soh .

en: And Moses built an altar , and called the name of it Jehovah–nissi :
kha: U Moses u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u ai kyrteng ïa ka  U  Trai  u long ka Lama jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la tei ia ka almari bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Jehobah ].

en: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
kha: namar phi ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim ïa ki mynsiem jong phi , kaba long ka jingthmu jong ka jingngeit jong phi ha U .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpdiang ia ka jingkut jong ka jingngeit jong phi , wat ia ka jingpynim ia ki mynsiem jong phi .

en: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .
kha: To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom , kum u shipai baïaineh jong U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Me namarkata to shah ia ka jingkhlain , kum u shipai uba bha jong U Jisu Khrist .

en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit bad ïeng ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la wan ha khmat ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And the saying pleased Absalom well , and all the elders of Israel .
kha: Kane ka la i kum ka jingai jingmut kaba bha ïa u Absalom bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingong ka la sngewbha shibun ia u Absalom bad ki rangbah Israel baroh .

en: In other words , you have the decisive say in what happens at home .
kha: Ha kiwei pat ki kyntien , phi don ka jingkren kaba rai ha kaei kaba jia ha iing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiwei pat ki kyntien , ngi don ka jingong kaba rai ha kaei kaba jia ha iing .

en: A loving husband treats his wife with tenderness and understanding .
kha: U tnga uba ieit u sumar bha ïa la ka tnga , da ka jingieit bad da ka jingsngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U tnga uba ieit u leh ia ka tnga jong u da ka jingsngewrit bad jingsngewthuh .

en: And God was displeased with this thing  ; therefore he smote Israel .
kha: La pynsngewsih ïa U Blei da kaei kaba la dep leh , kumta u la pynshitom ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la sngewsih ia kane ka kam ; namarkata u la shoh ia ki Israel .

en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
kha: Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje bad ruh ha ka por lai baje u la leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien u la mih kumba hynriew bad hynniew kynta , bad u la leh kumjuh .

en: And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .
kha: Kumta u la peit sha ki , da ka jingkhmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sngap ia ki, da kaba khmih lynti ban ioh ei ei na ki .

en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?
kha: Nangta u la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar bad u la kylli ,  Ko rangbah , kaei nga dei ban leh ba yn pynim ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia ki shabar , bad u la ong , Ko Sir , nga dei ban leh aiu ban ioh jingpynim ?

en: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .
kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; hynrei mynta nga kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ba ngan shah pynshitom nga la iaid bakla: hynrei mynta nga la bat ia ka ktien jong me .

en: And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother s fury turn away  ;
kha: Khie leit noh kumne hi sha u Laban u hynmen jong nga ha Haran , bad sah bad u shipor , tad haduh ba ka jingbitar u hynmen jong me kan pjah , bad ba u klet noh ïa kata kaba me la leh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to sah bad u katto katne sngi, haduh ba u hynmen jong me un da phet noh;

en: And I heard a voice saying unto me ,  Arise , Peter  ; slay and eat .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit , ko Petros , to pynïap bad to bam !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba ong ha nga, To khie, u Petros ; u la sdang bad bam .

en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty , and kill him .
kha: bad ki la ïapynlong ki jingthmu ban kem ïa U Jisu ha kaba rieh bad ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iamir jingmut ba kin shim ia U Jisu da ka jinglong rit paid, bad pyniap ia u .

en: Be ye angry , and sin not : let not the sun go down upon your wrath :
kha: Lada phi bitar , wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong phi kan ïalam ïa phi ban leh pop , wat bitar sah baroh shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba bitar , bad wat leh pop: wat ai ba ka sngi kan hiar halor ka jingbitar jong phi:

en: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
kha: khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat jong u baroh ki sngi ka jingim jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingkhuid bad ka hok ha khmat jong u , baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong ngi .

en: And because iniquity shall abound , the love of many shall wax cold .
kha: Haduh katta kan long ka jingsaphriang jong ka jingsniew ba ka jingieit jong ki briew kiba bun kan man khriat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba ka jingbymhok kan nang bun, ka jingieit jong kiba bun kan nang khriat .

en: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .
kha: Pynthikna , te , ba ka jingshai hapoh jong phi kam dei ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar namarkata ba ka jingshai kaba don ha me kan ym long ka jingdum .

en: And the speech pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .
kha: U  Trai  u la sngewbha ba u Solomon u la pan ïa kane ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkren ka la pynsngewbha ia U Trai , ba u Solomon u la kylli ia kane ka jingjia .

en: Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?
kha: Hangno , namarkata , ka don ka thymmei jong ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Naei te ka wan ka jingstad ? bad shano ka jaka jong ka jingsngewthuh ?

en: For further information, please check the FAQ section on our website.
kha: Na ka bynta ki jingtip ba kham bnïah, sngewbha peit ïa ka bynta FAQ ha ka website jong ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki jingtip ba kham bniah, sngewbha peit ia ka bynta FAQ ha ka website jong ngi.

en: Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :
kha: Ka jingstad ka la tei ïa la ka ïing , bad ka la pynïeng hynñiew tylli ki rishot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka la tei ia ka iing jong ka, ka la pynmih ia ki hynriew tylli ki tnum jong ka:

en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , I perceive that thou art a prophet .
kha: Nga ïohi ba me long u nongïathuhlypa , ko kynrad ,  kata ka kynthei ka la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka ong ha u, ko sahep, nga sngewthuh ba me long u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
kha: U Jakob u la nang ïaid noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang jong u mot Eder .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la iaid , bad ki la pynphriang ia ka ïingjahthait jong u sha lyndet ka tower jong u Edar .

en: Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :
kha: Nga pan na me , A Blei , ban shah ïa nga ban don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :
translated_en_to_kha: Ar tylli kiei kiei kiba nga la dawa na me;

en: And when he had thus spoken , he shewed them his hands and his feet .
kha: U la ong ïa kane bad u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ki kti jong u bad ïa ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kumta, u la pyni ia ki kti bad ki kjat jong u .

en: What ye know , the same do I know also : I am not inferior unto you .
kha: Baroh kiba me ong , nga la ïohsngew mynshuwa . Nga sngewthuh ïa kata baroh ; nga tip lut kat kaba me , me tip . Ngam long uba hapoh jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi tip , kumjuh ruh nga tip: Ngam kham poh ia phi .

en: The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .
kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa la U Khun bad u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kpa u ieit ia u Khun , bad u la aiti lut ia kiei kiei baroh ha ka kti jong u .

en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,
kha: Te ki Israel ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Sihon u syiem Amor ban ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u syiem Amorites ki da ong:

en: But as for you , your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .
kha: Phi , phin ïap ha kane ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia phi, ki metiap jong phi, kin hap ha kane ka ri khlaw .

en: All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .
kha: Baroh ki parabangeit hangne ki phah ka jingkhublei . To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki para ki ai khublei ia phi . Khublei iwei ia iwei pat da ka jingkyndit bakhuid .

en: One of the major towns of Arunachal Pradesh is the township of Namsai
kha: Kawei na ki shnong ba kongsan jong ka Arunachal Pradesh ka dei ka shnong Namsai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei na ki shnong ba kongsan jong ka Arunachal Pradesh ka dei ka shnong Namsai .

en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .
kha: Ki shna ïa ki jingker ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki board na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ jong u dieng shittim , da kaba ieng .

en: Now where remission of these is , there is no more offering for sin .
kha: Kumta haba la map ïa kine , ym donkam shuh ka jingainguh ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kaba ka jingmap ia kine ka long , ym don shuh ka jingtyrwa na ka bynta ka pop .

en: Thou hast despised mine holy things , and hast profaned my sabbaths .
kha: Phim don jingburom ïa ki jaka bakhuid , bad phim sumar ïa ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la lehbein ia kiei kiei kiba khuid jong nga , bad me la pynjah burom ia ki Sabha jong nga .

en: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :
kha: Kita kiba bieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynrei kim shym la rah tam ïa ka umphniang bad ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba bieit ki la shim ia ki sharak jong ki bad kim shym la shim umphniang bad ki:

en: And Moses took the rod from before the  Lord  , as he commanded him .
kha: U Moses u la leit shim ïa uta diengduh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia u diengduh na khmat U Trai kumba u la hukum ia u .

en: But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa nga ; U Blei jong nga u ïada ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u long ka jingiada jong nga ; bad U Blei jong nga u long u maw jong ka jaka rieh jong nga .

en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .
kha: To shahshkor , ko khun jong nga , long uba stad bad pynleit jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia me ko khun jong nga, bad to long uba stad, bad to ialam ia ka dohnud jong me ha ka lynti .

en: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables , and said ,
kha: U Jisu u pyndonkam biang ïa ki pharshi ha kaba kren ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la kren biang ha ki da ki pharshi bad u la ong:

en: But Peter took him up , saying , Stand up  ; I myself also am a man .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la pynïeng ïa u .  To ïeng ,  u la ong ,  nga hi nga long tang u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la shim ia u, u da ong: To ieng; nga ruh nga long u briew .

en: And Laban said , Behold , I would it might be according to thy word .
kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Nga mynjur . Ngin leh kumba phi ai jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong , Ha khmih , nga lah ban long kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: The depths have covered them : they sank into the bottom as a stone .
kha: Ka duriaw kaba jylliew ka la tap ïa ki ; ki la ngam sha trai duriaw kum u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingjylliew ki la tap ia ki: ki la ngam shapoh kum u maw .

en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .
kha: Ale , bam na ka jingbam jong nga , bad dih na ka waiñ ba nga la khleh .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan bam ia u kpu jong nga bad dih ia ka wain kaba nga la khleh lang .

en: They that tarry long at the wine  ; they that go to seek mixed wine .
kha: Ki khmat jong u kiba saw snam , bad u don ki jingmong khlem daw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kiba sah slem ha ka wain ; ki leit wad ia ka wain ba la khleh lang .

en: He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .
kha: U ai ïa ki jingri ïa ka jingbam jong ki bad u bsa ïa ki khun tyngab haba ki pah .
translated_en_to_kha: U ai ia u mrad ia ka jingbam jong u, bad ia ki khun masi kiba iam .

en: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel .
kha: Ka la don ka jingsuk hapdeng ki Israel bad Syria ha ki ar snem kiba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bteng lai snem khlem ka thma hapdeng ka Syria bad ka Israel .

en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother  ;
kha: u la lait na kaba ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim shah shuh ia u ban leh ia kaba dei na ka bynta u kpa ne ka kmie jong u ; .

en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
kha: Me pynlong ïa ki umpohliew ban tuid sha ki them , bad ïa ki wah ba kin tuid hapdeng ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U phah ia ki tyllong um sha ki them kiba tuid hapdeng ki lum .

en: For security reasons, your session has timed out. Please log back in.
kha: Na ka bynta ki daw jong ka jingshngain, ka session jong phi ka la kut por. Sngewbha rung bïang.
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw jong ka jingshngain, ka jingialang jong phi ka la kut noh. Sngewbha log biang shapoh.

en: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;
kha: Hadien kane , u Paul u la mihnoh na Athens bad u la leit sha Korinth .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei u Paul u la leit noh na Athen bad u la poi ha Korinth ;

en: It is expected to be priced between Rs 5 . 5 lakh and Rs 8 . 5 lakh .
kha: La khmih lynti ba kan long hapdeng Rs 5 . 5 lak bad Rs 8 . 5 lak .
translated_en_to_kha: La khmih lynti ba kan long hapdeng 5 . 5 lak bad Rs 8 . 5 lak .

en: ( James 1 :17 ) You will come to know how to approach him in prayer .
kha: ( U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin ioh tip kumno ban wan shajan jong u lyngba ka jingduwai .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin sa nang kumno ban leit shajan jong u ha ka jingduwai .

en: The earth , O  Lord  , is full of thy mercy : teach me thy statutes .
kha: A  Trai  , ka pyrthei ka dap da ka jingieit baneh jong me ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ko Trai ka dap da ka jingisynei jong me: hikai ia nga ia ki ain jong me .

en: " I have said earlier that I have faith in the state government . "
kha: " Nga la ong mynshuwa ba nga don ka jingngeit ha ka sorkar jylla . "
translated_en_to_kha: " Nga la ong kham mynshuwa ba nga don ka jingngeit ha ka sorkar jylla ."

en: Saying , Prophesy unto us , thou Christ , Who is he that smote thee ?
kha: ki la ong ,  To ïathuh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi , ko Messaïah ! To antad mano ba shoh ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , To iathuhlypa ia ngi , me Khrist , Uei uta uba sngap jar ia me ?

en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :
kha: Pynban U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki haba ki kyang , bad u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u la pyrkhat ia ka jingjynjar jong ki , haba u la iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki:

en: My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me .
kha: ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok jong nga kim don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong nga ki la rem , bad ki paralok ba la tip bha jong nga ki la klet noh ia nga .

en: What ? came the word of God out from you ? or came it unto you only ?
kha: Kaei ? Lane ka lah mo ban long ba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan na phi ? Lane hato dei tang ha phi ba ka la wan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ? ka la mih ka ktien U Blei na phi ? lane ka la wan ha phi tang ?

en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering : it is most holy .
kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingkñia namar ki jingleh palat , kiba khuid bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh kane ka long ka ain jong ka jingaiti kaba sniew: ka long kaba khuid tam .

en: I am the  Lord  , your Holy One , the creator of Israel , your King .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid jong phi , nga la thaw ïa phi , ko Israel , bad nga long u Syiem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai , U Bakhuid jong phi , u nongthaw jong ki Israel , u Syiem jong phi .

en: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day , saying ,
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka Deborah bad u Barak u khun jong u Abinoam ki la rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Deborah bad u Barak u khun u Abinoam ha kata ka sngi da kaba ong:

en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me .
kha: Ki la bret im ïa nga shapoh ka thliew bad ki la khang ïa ka da u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ot noh ia ka jingim jong nga ha ka thliew , bad ki la bret ia u maw halor jong nga .

en: Dominion and fear are with him , he maketh peace in his high places .
kha: U Blei u long uba donbor ; baroh ki dei ban ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa u ; U pynïeng ïa ka hima ba kynja bneng ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsynshar bad ka jingtieng ka don bad u , u pynlong ia ka jingsuk ha ki jaka ba jrong jong u .

en: In Bombay , a BJP lady corporator was arrested while taking a bribe .
kha: Ha Bombay la kem ia kawei ka longkmie ka BJP ha ka por ba ka dang shim ia ka pisa bamsap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Bombay , la kem ia uwei u kynthei jong ka BJP katba u dang shim pisa .

en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,
kha: Hynrei me leh shitrhem bad peit shin ïa ngi da ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ka dohnud jong me ka rah noh ia me ? bad ki khmat jong me ki lyngngoh aiu ,

en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .
kha: U Blei u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba leh pop bad ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un weng noh ia u briew na ka jingthmu jong u , bad ban buhrieh ia ka jingsarong na u briew .

en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man , and he seeth all his goings .
kha: U peit-thuh ïa ki sien jam ba ki briew ki jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khmat jong u ki long ha ki lynti jong u briew , bad u iohi ia ki jingleit jong u baroh .

en: And this woman s child died in the night  ; because she overlaid it .
kha: Te ha kawei ka miet ka la kum ban ïa la i khun bad i la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka kynthei ka la iap ha ka por miet ; namar ba ka la pynkhih palat ia ka .

en: If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit  ;
kha: Nga smai ba ngam shym la leh kaba bymman ; bad ngam ju pyrshang ban shukor ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la iaid da ka jinglong ba sniew , lane lada ka kjat jong nga ka la kyrkieh ban thok ; .

en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water .
kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa ka snam kum ka jingbam ; pynban , theh noh ïa ka ha ka khyndew kumba theh ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam ia ka ; me dei ban theh ia ka ha ka khyndew kum ka um .

en: Then I answered them , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Kumta nga la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la kren ha nga bad u la ong
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la jubab ia ki , Ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Gracious is the  Lord  , and righteous  ; yea , our God is merciful .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba bha ; U Blei jong ngi u long uba sngewlem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei ka long U Trai , bad ka hok ; yea , U Blei jong ngi u long uba isynei .

en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave , and shall remain in the tomb .
kha: Haba la rah ïa u sha ka jingtep , sha ka jingtep ba la ap phira bha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei yn wanrah ia u sha ka jingtep bad un sah ha ka jingtep .

en: Thou fool , that which thou sowest is not quickened , except it die :
kha: A me u bieit! Haba me bet ïa u symbai ha ka khyndew , um lah ban shylluit lymda u ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me bieit , ia kaba me bet ym shym la pynsted , lait noh tang ba ka iap:

en: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .
kha: Haduh lai sngi um shym lah ban ïohi , bad ha kata ka por um shym la bam ne dih ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don lai sngi khlem iohi , bad um shym la bam ne dih .

en: But cleave unto the  Lord  your God , as ye have done unto this day .
kha: Pynban , to ïaineh ha U  Trai  , kumba phi la leh haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to bat skhem ia U Trai U Blei jong phi kumba phi la leh haduh kane ka sngi .

en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit . Grace be with you . Amen .
kha: U Trai un long lem bad ka mynsiem jong phi . Ka jingaiei jong U Blei kan long bad phi baroh . Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Jisu Khrist un long bad ka mynsiem jong me . Ka jingaiei kan long bad phi . Amen .

en: The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .
kha: To U  Trai  un ai ki khun ha phi — ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un nang pynbun shuh shuh ia phi bad ki khun jong phi .

en: The product is eligible for a 7-day no-questions-asked return policy.
kha: Ka mar ka long kaba lah ban ïoh ïa ka polisi ban pynphai bïang khlem jingkylli kaba 7 sngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingmih ka long kaba biang na ka bynta ka polisi pynphai kaba 7 sngi khlem jingkylli.

en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: bad u thang ïa ka jingiwbih suhsieng halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thang ia ka jingiwbih kaba thiang ha kata ka por; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: When the Almighty was yet with me , when my children were about me  ;
kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la long bad nga ha kata ka por , bad ïa nga la ker sawdong da baroh ki khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Blei baroh u dang don bad nga, haba ki khun jong nga ki dang don shaphang jong nga ; .

en: In the First Division, Khliehingriang will play against Moosalyngkat.
kha: Haka First Division ka Khliehiongriang pyrshah iaka Moosalyngkat.
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka Division ba nyngkong, u Khliehingriang un ialehkai pyrshah ia u Moosalyngkat.

en: Ye have condemned and killed the just  ; and he doth not resist you .
kha: Phi la pynrem bad phi la pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui , bad kim shym pyneh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la pynrem bad pyniap ia u ; bad um pyrshah ia phi .

en: So that my soul chooseth strangling , and death rather than my life .
kha: haduh ba nga sngew ba ka kham bha ban shah ksih ïap ban ïa kaba dang im ha kane ka met bajynjar sat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba ka mynsiem jong nga ka jied ia ka jingkhihwin , bad ka jingiap ban ia ka jingim jong nga .

en: Neither be ye called masters : for one is your Master , even Christ .
kha: Lymne ba yn khot ïa phi ‘ u Nongïalam ,’ namar ba u nongïalam jong phi uba tang ma u hi u long u Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym dei ruh ban khot ia phi ki kynrad: namar uwei u long u Nonghikai jong phi, wat U Khrist ruh .

en: Then they sent to Jezebel , saying , Naboth is stoned , and is dead .
kha: Ïa ka khubor la phah sha ka Jesebel ,  Ïa u Naboth la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la phah sha Jesbel, ki da ong, u Naboth u la shah pyniap bad u la iap .

en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
kha: Na u ruh men kiar , namar u la kren pyrshah ïa ka jingïalap jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kiba me long ruh; namar u la pyrshah shibun ia ki ktien jong ngi .

en: And he came and found them asleep again : for their eyes were heavy .
kha: U wan phai biang sa shisien bad u la shem ba ki synran ki ïohthiah ; kim lah ban khyllie ïa ki khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan bad u la lap biang ia ki ba ki la iohthiah: namar ki khmat jong ki ki la khia .

en: Rise , let us be going : behold , he is at hand that doth betray me .
kha: To ïeng joit , ïa ngin leit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: To kiew, to ngin ia leit: ha khmih , u don ha kti uba shet kylla ia nga .

en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , He is sick .
kha: Haba ki briew u Saul ki wan ban kem ïa u Dabid , ka Mikhal ka ïathuh ïa ki ba u pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Saul u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ban shim ia u Dabid , ka la ong , U pang .

en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !
kha: Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki Israel ki long kiba itynnat , Kum ki dieng Tlai kiba ïeng laiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ki long kiba bha jong me ko Jakob bad ki iing jong me ko Israel !

en: I remember specifically the Confederations Cup opener against Japan .
kha: Nga kynmaw kyrpang ia ka jingialehkai ba sdang jong ka Confederations Cup pyrshah ia ka Japan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kynmaw kyrpang ia ka jingplie ia ki jingpynkylla pyrshah ia ka Japan .

en: But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .
kha: Pynban , ïa ka waiñ bathymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei dei ban buh ia ka wain thymmai ha ki bilor thymmai ; bad baroh ar la pynneh pynsah .

en: He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .
kha: U la set ïa nga ha ka ïingbyndi jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jinglyng-a .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei pyrshah ia nga , bad u la ker sawdong ia nga da ka gall bad ka jingtrei shitom .

en: These things said Esaias , when he saw his glory , and spake of him .
kha: U Isaïah u la ong ïa kane namar u la ïohi ïa ka burom U Jisu bad u la kren shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei ki la ong u Isaiah , haba u la iohi ia ka burom jong u bad u la kren ia u .

en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
kha: Te U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha u Sedekaïah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .
kha: U synshar halor ka duriaw , kaba u la thaw ; ka khyndew ruh , kaba u hi u la pynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka duriaw ka long ka jong u , bad u la thaw ia ka: bad ki kti jong u ki la pynlong ia ka ri kaba rkhiang .

en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .
kha: Ki la phut ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap bad bam ïa ki , wat ïa ki thied bym don jingmad jong u diengsynshar !
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba ot ia ki khlaw da ki khlaw , bad ki tynrai junper na ka bynta ka doh jong ki .

en: With him is wisdom and strength , he hath counsel and understanding .
kha: Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingstad , hynrei U Blei u don ka jingstad bad ka bor . Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingïohi jngai ; U Blei u don ka jingïohi jngai bad ka bor ban pyntreikam .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u ka long ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlain , u don ka jingai jingmut bad ka jingsngewthuh .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Bring of the fish which ye have now caught .
kha: Te U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wallam katto katne tylli ki dohkha kiba phi dang shu ngat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , To wanrah ia ki dohkha kiba phi la kem mynta .

en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .
kha: U la pyntwa ruh ïa u mot ha Penuel bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynliem ia ka tower jong u Penuel bad u la pyniap ia ki briew jong ka shnong .

en: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .
kha: Em , ngan ai ïa ka jubab jong nga hi mynta bad ngan ïathuh ïa phi kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , ngan jubab ruh ia ka bynta jong nga , nga ruh ngan pyni ia ka jingmut jong nga .

en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
kha: Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la sngewthuh balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ym don briew ha ka miej uba tip na ka bynta kaei ka jingthmu kaba u kren ia kane ha u .

en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter ?
kha: Ym don ka umpohliew kaba pynmih ïa ka um kaba thiang bad ïa ka um kaba kthang na kajuh ka tyllong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka pung um ka phah shabar ha kajuh ka jaka ka um kaba thiang bad kaba thiang ?

en: To deliver their soul from death , and to keep them alive in famine .
kha: U pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingïap ; u ri pynim ïa ki ha ki por ka  nemsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong ki na ka jingiap , bad ban pynim ia ki ha ka jingkyrduh bam .

en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the second time , saying ,
kha: Sa shisien pat U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jonah ha ka sien kaba ar da kaba ong:

en: Let him take his rod away from me , and let not his fear terrify me :
kha: To sangeh na kaba pynshitom ïa nga A Blei . Buh sha jngai ïa ki jingpynsheptieng jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba un shim noh ia u diengduh jong u na nga , bad wat ai ba ka jingtieng jong u kan pyntieng ia nga:

en: A man s heart deviseth his way : but the  Lord  directeth his steps .
kha: Phi lah ban don la ki jingthmu , hynrei dei U Blei uba ïalam ïa ki jingpyntreikam jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u pyrkhat ia la ka lynti: hynrei U Trai u bthah ia ki step jong u .

en: Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .
kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng bad ka khyndew kin jah noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym jah noh .

en: And he shall send Jesus Christ , which before was preached unto you :
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ki por jong ka jingkhlaiñ ba kynja mynsiem kin wan na U Trai , bad un phah ïa U Jisu , uba long U Messaïah ïa uba u la lah jied na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un phah ia U Jisu Khrist, uba la ialap ha phi mynshuwa:

en: For he taught them as one having authority , and not as the scribes .
kha: Um shym la long kum ki nonghikai Aiñ ; pynban , u la hikai da ka iktiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la hikai ia ki kum kiba don ka bor , bad ym kum ki nongthoh .

en: And all the elders of Israel came , and the priests took up the ark .
kha: Haba baroh ki nongïalam ki la ïalumlang , ki lyngdoh ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki bah ïa ka sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah Israel baroh ki la wan , bad ki lyngdoh ki la rah ia ka synduk .

en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?
kha: Balei ba ma phi ruh phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato phim shym la pynshitom la biang ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei phi pynshitom ia nga kum U Blei bad phim sngewhun ia ka doh jong nga ?

en: Please return the defective item, and we will replace it immediately.
kha: Sngewbha pynphai bïang ïa ka tïar kaba la jot, bad ngin sa bujli noh mardor.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha pynphai biang ia ka mar kaba duna, bad ngin sa bujli noh mardor.

en: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years , and he begat Enoch :
kha: Haba u Jared u la dap shispah hynriewphew ar snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enokh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jared u la im shispah hynriewphew ar snem , bad u la kha ia u Enokh:

en: People from every continent , including Antarctica , are benefiting .
kha: Ki briew na baroh ki jaka , ba kynthup ruh ïa ka Antarctica ki ïoh jingmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew na man la ka dewbah , kynthup ia ka Antarctica , ki ioh jingmyntoi .

en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .
kha: Mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki mrad kum ka jingainguh thang halor ka duwan lane ïa ki jingkñia ban shim noh ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia na ka bynta ka pop me la don ka jingsngewbha .

en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
kha: U la bret ïa nga ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïapher shuh na ka jaboh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret ia nga ha ka dewbilat , bad nga la kylla long kum ka dewmet bad ka dewbilat .

en: And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?
kha: Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa lade ha ka jaka jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki: Wat tieng: namar nga don ha ka jaka U Blei ?

en: Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
kha: Ïa ka jingphyrnai ksiar la ïohi ha ka phang bashatei , bad ka burom jong U Blei ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingtiengburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ka suinbneng kaba shai ka wan na shaphang shathie : bad U Blei ka long ka jingkhraw kaba shyrkhei .

en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng bad ka khyndew kin jah noh: hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym jah noh .

en: For who is God , save the  Lord  ? and who is a rock , save our God ?
kha: U  Trai  tang ma u hi u long U Blei ; U Blei tang ma u hi uba long ka jingïada jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba long U Blei , pynim ia U Trai ? bad mano ba long u maw , pynim ia U Blei jong ngi ?

en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,
kha: Ka la jan dei artat ka por na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , kumta U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la don hajan bad U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .

en: The joy of our heart is ceased  ; our dance is turned into mourning .
kha: Ka jingkmen ka la duh noh na ki jingim jong ngi ; ka jingsngewsih ka la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki jingshad jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud jong ngi ka la sangeh noh; ka shad jong ngi ka kylla long kaba sngewsih .

en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis ba ki rung shapoh , u la kyrpad ïa ki ban ai ei ei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba iohi ia u Petros bad u Ioannis kiba la jan leit shapoh ka tempi u la kylli ia u alm .

en: His left hand is under my head , and his right hand doth embrace me .
kha: Wat khmih beiñ ïa nga namar ka rong sniehdoh jong nga , namar ba ka sngi ka la pynkylla rong ïa nga . Ki shynrang kiba shi para bad nga ki bitar ïa nga bad ki pyntrei ïa nga ha ka bri sohwaiñ . Ngam don por ban sumar ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti kadiang jong u ka don hapoh ka khlieh jong nga , bad ka kti kadiang jong u ka pdiang ia nga .

en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
kha: u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lain kaba ar kan long kaba jyrngam, ka sapphire bad u mawkordor .

en: Your shopping cart is empty. Add some products to start your journey.
kha: Ka shang thied jingthied jong phi ka thylli. Pyndap katto katne ki mar ban sdang ïa ka jingthied jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kali thied jingthied jong phi ka long kaba thylli. Pyndap katto katne ki mar ban sdang ia ka jingleit jong phi.

en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling ;
kha: Don ki briew kiba la phai dien noh na kine bad ki la jah lynti ha ki jingïatainia ba-bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaba don kiba la kylla sha shiliang sha ka Jangking ; .

en: Hear ye , and give ear  ; be not proud : for the  Lord  hath spoken .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u la kren ! To pynrit bad shahshkor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia phi , bad to ai shkor wat sngew sarong: namar U Trai u la kren .

en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
kha: Da kumta u Saul bad lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap lang bad ym don uba na ki khun ki ksiew jong u kiba ïoh ban synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Saul u la iap , bad ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei ka la iap lang .

en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish , and upon all pleasant pictures .
kha: Un pynngam wat ïa ki liengbah kiba khraw bad kiba itynnat tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ki lieng jong u Tarshish baroh , bad halor ki dur kiba sngewtynnad .

en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .
kha: Ko ki kynthei , to pyndem ha la ki tnga , kumba ha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tnga , to pyndem ia lade ha la ki jong ki tnga kumba ha U Trai .

en: So Joab arose and went to Geshur , and brought Absalom to Jerusalem .
kha: Nangta u la ïeng joit bad u leit sha Geshur , bad u wan ïalam pat ïa u Absalom sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joab u la ieng bad u la leit sha Geshur bad u la wanrah ia u Absalom sha Jerusalem .

en: Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :
kha: To put ïa ka turoi halor u lum Seïon ; to ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingshah jingit bad khot ïa ka jingïaseng bah !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ka turoi ha ka Seion , pynkyntang ia ka jingstet , khot ia ka jingiaseng kaba jem:

en: And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,
kha: Haba ki la hiar na ka lieng , mar kumta hi , ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la mih na ka lieng , mardor ki la ithuh ia u , .

en: We can learn even more about God’s personality by reading the Bible .
kha: Ngi lah ban ïoh jingtip shuh shuh shaphang ki jinglong jong U Blei da kaba pule ïa ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi lah ban nang kham bun shaphang ka jinglong jong U Blei s da kaba pule ia ka Baibl .

en: Now when she had weaned Lo–ruhamah , she conceived , and bare a son .
kha: Hadien ba ka Gomer ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa la ka khun , ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei u khun ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka la kha ia u Loruhamah, ka la pun khun bad ka la kha khun shynrang .

en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng bad ka khyndew kin jah noh: hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym jah noh .

en: You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .
kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi kan kham skhem da kaba ïohi ïa ka jaka ba khot ka Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin sa ioh jingmyntoi ha ka mynsiem da kaba iohi ia ka jaka kaba la khot ka Bethel .

en: And he shall take all his fat from him , and burn it upon the altar .
kha: Nangta un shim ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh bad thang halor ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ka shini jong u baroh na u , bad un thang ia ka ha ka almari .

en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down , and the feeble knees  ;
kha: Te to rah ïa ki kti ba la thait jong phi , bad pynkhlaiñ ïa ki khohsiew kiba la kyiuh jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata rah ia ki kti kiba sahkut shapoh, bad ki kjat kiba tlot ;

en: Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki briew ba-mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang sha jngai bah .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga, phi la sngap jar, kiba jngai na ka hok:

en: Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
kha: Ki khah kim lah ban mih haba ym don um ; yn ym lah ban shem shabar ka jaka sngem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jingkynran dien ka lah ban kiew khlem ka dewbilat ? hato ka lama ka lah ban kiew khlem um ?

en: And he gave them their request  ; but sent leanness into their soul .
kha: kumta u la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki la pan kwah , bad u la phah ruh ïa ka jingpang bashyrkhei hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia ki ia ka jingkyrpad jong ki ; hynrei u la phah ia ka jinglong rit paid ha ka mynsiem jong ki .

en: Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .
kha: Ngam sheptieng , ngan ïai kren beit namar nga tip ïa la ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan kren , bad ngan ym tieng ia u ; hynrei kam long kumta bad nga .

en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .
kha: Uno uno u shynrang uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingainguh ; ka dei kaba khuid bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki shynrang napdeng ki lyngdoh kin bam ia ka: ka long kaba khuid tam .

en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
kha: Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kum ki masi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la khein ia ngi kum ki mrad , bad la pynpaw pyrthei ia ngi ha ka jingpeit jong phi ?

en: His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .
kha: Ka leilieh jong u ka pynshai ïa ka pyrthei ; ka khyndew ka ïohi ïa ka bad ka khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingshai jong u ki la pynshai ia ka pyrthei: ka khyndew ka la iohi , bad ka la khih .

en: When I said , My foot slippeth  ; thy mercy , O  Lord  , held me up .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la kyllon noh  ; hynrei ka jingieit baneh jong me , A  Trai  , ka batskhem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la ong , Ka kjat jong nga ka sngap jar jar ia ka jingisynei jong me , ko Trai , ka la bat ia nga .

en: A soft answer turneth away wrath : but grievous words stir up anger .
kha: Ka jubab kaba jem ka tem ïa ka jingbitar , hynrei kaba khor ka pynkhih bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jubab kaba jem ka pynphai noh ia ka jingbitar: hynrei ki kyntien kiba sngewsih ki pynkhih ia ka jingbitar .

en: Her wise ladies answered her , yea , she returned answer to herself ,
kha: Ki paralok bastad ki phai ktien ïa ka , Bad ka ïai-ong shi ong kumta ha lade ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei kiba stad jong ka ki la jubab ia ka , hooid , ka la jubab biang ia lade , .

en: Tennis is difficult. I never know which way the ball is going to fly.
kha: Ka tennis ka jynjar. Ngam lah tip shaei ka ball kan her.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Tenni ka long kaba eh. Ngam ju tip kumno ka bol kan her.

en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
kha: bad lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long nyngkong , u dei ban long u mraw jong baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno na phi un long uba khraw tam , un long u shakri jong baroh .

en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .
kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , bad phi phin long ki mraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Un shim ia ka shi bynta na ki langbrot jong phi: bad phin long ki shakri jong u .

en: This is the fourth case of conviction under the PMLA in the country .
kha: Kane ka dei ka mukotduma kaba saw jong ka jingshah rai pynrem hapoh ka PMLA ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka jingjia kaba saw jong ka jingshah pynrem hapoh ka PMLA ha ka ri .

en: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus , Lord , and what shall this man do ?
kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa u , u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , kumno shaphang une u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la iohi ia u ha U Jisu , ko Trai bad une u briew un leh aiu ?

en: If ye walk in my statutes , and keep my commandments , and do them  ;
kha: Lada phi im kat kum ki aiñ jong nga , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi iaid ha ki ain jong nga bad phi sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad leh ia ki ;

en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace , his goods are in peace :
kha: Haba u briew uba khlaiñ , uba la khreh ïa la ki tiar ïaleh baroh , u ap phira ïa la ka jong ka ïing , baroh ki jingdon jingem jong u ki don ha ka jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew uba khlain u bat ia ka iing jong u, ki mar jong u ki don ha ka jingsuk:

en: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .
kha: Hadien ba u Terah u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran .
translated_en_to_kha: U Terah u la im hynriewphew snem, bad u la kha ia u Abram, u Nahor bad u Haran .

en: Our technician will contact you within 24 hours to resolve the issue.
kha: Ki nongtrei jong ngi kin sa phone ïa phi hapoh 24 kynta ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh.
translated_en_to_kha: U technician jong ngi un iakynduh ia phi hapoh 24 kynta ban pynbeit ia ka jingeh.

en: Tom couldn't go to Boston with us because he didn't have enough money.
kha: U Tom um shem lah ban leit sha Boston bad ngi namar ba um shem dap pisa.
translated_en_to_kha: U Tom um lah ban leit sha Boston bad ngi namar ba um don pisa kaba biang.

en: God understandeth the way thereof , and he knoweth the place thereof .
kha: Tang U Blei u tip ïa ka lynti , u tip ïa ka jaka hangno la shem ïa ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u sngewthuh ia ka lynti jong ka , bad u tip ia ka jaka jong ka .

en: Gad , a troop shall overcome him : but he shall overcome at the last .
kha: Ka kynhun ki nonglute kin sa wan ïaleh ïa u Gad , Hynrei un phai kylla ban beh ïa ki nadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Gad , ka kynhun shipai kan jop ia u: hynrei un jop ha kaba kut .

en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Declare unto us this parable .
kha: U Petros u la kren ,  To batai ïa kane ka jingong ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia u Petros bad u la ong ha u , To pynpaw ha ngi ia kane ka pharshi .

en: The city of Dhule is the administrative headquarters of the district .
kha: Ka nongbah Dhule ka dei ka jaka synshar jong ka distrik .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka nongbah Dhule ka dei ka jaka synshar jong ka distrik .

en: I would order my cause before him , and fill my mouth with arguments .
kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka daw ha khmat jong u bad ngan ai baroh ki jingïatainia na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan hukum ia ka daw jong nga ha khmat jong u , bad ngan pyndap ia ka shyntur jong nga da ki jingiakren .

en: Thank you, Mr. Shemborlang Rynniaw, President HANM, Mawshynrut Circle.
kha: Khublei shibun,Bah Shemborlang Rynniaw,President HANM, Mawshynrut Circle.
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun, u Mr. Shemborlang Rynniaw, President HANM, Mawshynrut Circle.

en: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Helkath , bad ka Rehob , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Rehob bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: My son , if thine heart be wise , my heart shall rejoice , even mine .
kha: Ko khun , lada phi long uba stad , ngan sngewkmen shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, lada ka dohnud jong me ka long kaba stad, ka dohnud jong nga kan sngewbha, wat jong nga ruh .

en: We value your opinion. Don’t forget to leave a review for the product.
kha: Ngi khein kor ïa ka jingmut jong phi. Wat klet ban ai ïa ka jingkynthoh na ka bynta ka tïar.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi khein kor ia ka jingmut jong phi. Wat klet ban iehnoh ia ka jingbishar bniah na ka bynta ka jingmih.

en: And said , O sir , we came indeed down at the first time to buy food :
kha: Kynrad ngi la wan shane shisien ban thied jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , ko sahep , ngi la wan hiar shisha ha ka sien kaba nyngkong ban thied jingbam:

en: I have yet many things to say unto you , but ye cannot bear them now .
kha: Nga dang don shibun kiei kiei ban ong ha phi , hynrei mynta kan long palat eh ïa phi ban shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga dang don shibun kiei kiei ban ong ha phi , hynrei phim lah ban shah ia ki mynta .

en: And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .
kha: Hadien ba u la khublei ïakhlad ïa ki briew , u la leit noh sha u lum ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la phah noh ia ki , u la leit noh sha u lum ban duwai .

en: If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .
kha: Da kumno uno uno u lah ban ïasaid bad u ? U lah ban kylli shihajar tylli ki jingkylli , ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada un ialeh pyrshah ia u , um lah ban jubab ia u uwei na ki hajar .

en: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba la khot  Ka Lyngkha Ka Snam  haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata la khot ia kata ka lyngkha , Ka lyngkha snam haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Suk kito kiba tip ba ki long kiba duk ha kaba kynja mynsiem ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kiba duk ha ka mynsiem: namar ka jong ki ka long ka hima bneng .

en: This shows that the “Paradoh-Parasnam” is not enough to unite mankind.
kha: Kane ka pyni ba ka Jinglong “Paradoh-Parasnam" kam pat biang ban pynïatylli ïa u bynriew.
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka pyni ba ka Paradoh-Parasnam  kam pat biang ban pyniasoh lang ia u khun bynriew.

en: Until the time that his word came : the word of the  Lord  tried him .
kha: haduh ka por ba ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh lypa , ka la urlong shisha . Ka ktien U  Trai  ka la pynshisha ba um shym bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ka por ba ka ktien jong u ka la wan: ka ktien U Trai ka la pyrshang ia u .

en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand ,  Stand forth .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Wan shane sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha uta u briew uba don ka kti kaba la tyrkhong , To ieng shabar .

en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .
kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi shaphang kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la thoh ha phi shaphang jong ki kiba pynshoi ia phi .

en: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification .
kha: Pynban , ma ngi baroh , ngi dei ban pynsngewbha ïa ki parabangeit jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki , khnang ban tei ïa ki ha ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba uwei pa uwei na ngi un pynsngewbha ia u paramarjan jong u na ka bynta ka jingbha jong u .

en: These things have I spoken unto you , that ye should not be offended .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , khnang ba phin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la kren ha phi , ba phin ym sngewsih .

en: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people .
kha: Ha kiba bun rukom u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki briew bad u la kyntu jur ïa ki ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun kiwei pat kiei kiei ha ka jingkyntu jong u u la ialap ia u ha ki briew .

en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .
kha: Ka jingshai ban pynpaw ïa ka mon jong me ha ki Jentil bad ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai ban pynshai ia ki Jutang , bad ka burom jong ki briew jong me Israel .

en: And there they left their images , and David and his men burned them .
kha: Haba ki Philistia ki la phet , ki la iehnoh shadien ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la rah noh ïa ki .
