translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ki la iehnoh ia ki dur jong ki , bad u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la thang ia ki .

en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?
kha: Balei ba me la iehnoh ïa ngi slem katta katta ? Hato men dang kynmaw biang ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me klet noh ia ngi junom , bad to iehnoh ia ngi haduh katne por ?

en: Why did the knees prevent me ? or why the breasts that I should suck ?
kha: Balei te ka kmie jong nga ka thum ïa nga ha la pneh ? Balei ka ai buiñ ïa nga ha ka shadem jong ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ki kjat ki khanglad ia nga ? lane balei ki bniat kiba nga dei ban dih ?

en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God , and to heal the sick .
kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki ban ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia ki ban ialap ia ka hima U Blei bad ban pynkoit ia kiba pang .

en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last shall be first .
kha: Hynrei bun kiba mynta ki long kiba ha shuwa kin long kiba khatduh , bad bun kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long kiba ha shuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bun kiba nyngkong kin long kiba khatduh; bad kiba khatduh kin long kiba nyngkong .

en: And he said , Behold now , I am old , I know not the day of my death :
kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Me ïohi ba nga la tymmen bad shen ngan sa ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ha khmih mynta, nga la tymmen, ngam tip ia ka sngi iap jong nga:

en: Suffer me that I may speak  ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
kha: Ai ïa nga ka lad ba ngan kren bad nangta , haba nga la dep kren , krenbeiñ lada phi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia nga ba ngan kren ; bad hadien kata nga la kren , nga la rkhie bein .

en: And when we were come to Jerusalem , the brethren received us gladly .
kha: Haba ngi la poi ha Jerusalem , ki parabangeit ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la poi ha Jerusalem , ki para ki la pdiang sngewbha ia ngi .

en: Then a spirit passed before my face  ; the hair of my flesh stood up :
kha: Ka lyer ka beh jai jai ïa ka khmat jong nga , bad u shñiuh u ïeng treng da kaba khaw-eit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei u mynsiem u la iaid ha khmat jong nga; u shniuh ka doh jong nga u la ieng:

en: One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
kha: Ka jingkordit kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka don sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka jingjynjar ka la leit noh bad , ha khmih , ki wan ar tylli ki jingjynjar hadien .

en: A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
kha: Haba uba bieit u phoi , u pynpaw kumne kumne ba yn tip . Ki briew kiba sian kim patiaw ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar kaba bieit ka long mynta: hynrei u briew uba stad u tap ia ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: Pride goeth before destruction , and an haughty spirit before a fall .
kha: Ka jingsarong ka ïalam sha ka jingjot , bad ka jingsngewmeng sha ka jingkyllon noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrmen ka leit shuwa ban shah pynjot , bad ka mynsiem kaba sngewsih shuwa ban hap .

en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa uba khlaiñbor tam na ki kynrad baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai jong ki kynrad: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .
kha: Haba ïa u Lebi ym pat shym la kha , hynrei u la long , kum ban shu ong , ha ka met u kpa tymmen jong u , u Abraham haba u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u dang don ha ki tyrpeng jong u kpa jong u, haba u Melchisedec u la iakynduh ia u .

en: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord s brother .
kha: Ngam shym la ïakynduh ïa kiwei pat ki Apostol lait noh tang ïa u Jakob , u para jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki apostol kim shym la iohi ia nga, lait noh tang u Jakob u hynmen jong U Trai .

en: Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .
kha: Ïa u , u dieng tangon u long u lyngkhot phlangïap bad u rkhie haba ki briew ki kawang sum ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: La khein ia ki dar kum ki dieng: u rkhie bein ia ka jingkhih jong u khnam .

en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .
kha: ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa u bad ban ïoh jingkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki . Kito kiba la shah pynjynjar da ki mynsiem bymman ruh ki la wan bad la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba la shah pynmong ha ki mynsiem bymkhuid: bad ki la koit .

en: He shall build me an house , and I will stablish his throne for ever .
kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïai bteng junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Un tei ia nga ka iing , bad ngan pynskhem ia ka khet jong u junom .

en: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Blei jong ki blei: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
kha: Te balei ba me wad bniah ïa baroh ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me kylli hadien ka jingbymhok jong nga , bad wad hadien ka pop jong nga ?

en: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .
kha: ( U la ong ïa kane ban tynjuh ïa u Philip ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un leh . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane u la ong ban pynshisha ia u: namar ma u hi u tip ia kaei kaba un leh .

en: And this I say , lest any man should beguile you with enticing words .
kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi da ki jingïatainia kiba bakla , kam pher haduh katno ki i kumba ki long kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane nga ong , ioh ba uno uno u briew un pynkhih ia phi da ki ktien kiba sngewtynnad .

en: The young lions roar after their prey , and seek their meat from God .
kha: Ki sing samla ki kyrhuh haba ki behmrad , ki wad ïa ka jingbam kaba U Blei u pynbiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sing samla ki rkhie bein hadien ka jingbam jong ki , bad ki wad ia ka doh jong ki na U Blei .

en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .
kha: Iehnoh ïa ka kynhun ki briew kiba bieit , bad men ïoh im . Ïaid ruh ha ka lynti ka jingtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia kiba bieit , bad im ; bad leit ha ka lynti jong ka jingsngewthuh .

en: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me  ; so that my feet did not slip .
kha: Me la da ïa nga na kaba shah kem , bad ngam pat ju kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynheh ia ki step jong nga hapoh jong nga ; kumta ki kjat jong nga kim shym la khih .

en: Ye shall not tempt the  Lord  your God , as ye tempted him in Massah .
kha: Wat tynjuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kumba phi la leh ha Massah .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban tynjuh ia U Trai U Blei jong phi kumba phi la tynjuh ia u ha Massah .

en: Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor mynta , ko Israel , u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta to iohsngew , ko Jakob u shakri jong nga ; bad ki Israel kiba nga la jied:

en: Choose between online payment or pay-on-delivery for your convenience.
kha: Jied hapdeng ka jingsiew onlaiñ ne ka jingsiew ha ka por ba pynpoi na ka bynta ka jingsuk jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Jied hapdeng ka jingsiew online ne ka jingsiew na ka bynta ka jingsuk jong phi.

en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts , known and read of all men :
kha: Ma phi hi phi long kata ka shithi ba ngi don , ïa kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ngi khnang ba baroh kin tip bad kin pule .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ka epistle jong ngi kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ngi , la tip bad pule ia ki briew baroh:

en: Shah Rukh Khan has become the first Indian to own 2020 Hyundai Creta .
kha: U Shah Rukh Khan u la long u nong India uba nyngkong eh ban ioh ia ka 2020 Hyundai Creta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shah Rukh Khan u la long u nong India ba nyngkong eh ban don ia u 2020 Hyundai Creta .

en: He looseth the bond of kings , and girdeth their loins with a girdle .
kha: U pynhiar khet ïa ki syiem bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki koidi ;
translated_en_to_kha: U pyllait ia ka jingiadei jong ki syiem , bad u pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong ki da ka tyrpeng .

en: Would you like to include a personalized gift message with your order?
kha: Hato phi kwah ban buh lem bad i jingthoh sngewbha ba kyrpang ryngkat bad ka ordar jong phi?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi kwah ban kynthup ia ka khubor jingai sngewbha kaba kyrpang bad ka order jong phi?

en: ( Isaiah 2 :4 ) God will bring an end to all injustice and suffering .
kha: ( Isaia 2 :4 ) U Blei un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingleh bymhok bad ki jingjynjar baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Isaiah 2 :4 ) U Blei un pynkut noh ia ka jingbymhok bad ka jingjynjar baroh .

en: And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?
kha: Balei ba phi khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ,’ bad pynban phim leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei phi khot ia nga , ko Trai , ko Trai bad phim ia kiei kiei kiba nga ong ?

en: My foot hath held his steps , his way have I kept , and not declined .
kha: Nga bud beit ïa ka lynti ba u jied , bad ngam ju sakma sha kadiang ne kamon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kjat jong nga ka la bat ia ki step jong u, ka lynti jong u nga la bat , bad ngam shym la kyntait .

en: And David went up from thence , and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi .
kha: U Dabid u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka thain jong ka Engedi , ha kaba u la sah ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kiew nangta, bad u la shong ha ki jaka ba skhem ha Engedi .

en: I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
kha: Nga la jied ban kohnguh ; nga la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la jied ia ka lynti jong ka jingshisha: ki jingbishar jong me nga la buh ha khmat jong nga .

en: And the answer to these questions will be given by the people in 2023.
kha: Bad ka jubab ia kine ki jingkylli kan long da u paidbah ha u 2023.
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia ka jubab ia kine ki jingkylli yn ai da ki briew ha u snem 2023.

en: Behold their sitting down , and their rising up  ; I am their musick .
kha: Naduh mynstep haduh mynmiet ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka jingshong jong ki, bad ka jingkiew jong ki ; nga long u khniang jong ki .

en: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,
kha: ïa ka miej , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad baroh ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka miej bad ki dieng jong u bad ki tiar jong u baroh bad ka jingbam ba la pyni .

en: She layeth her hands to the spindle , and her hands hold the distaff .
kha: Ka thir hi ïa la u ksai , bad ka thain hi ïa la ka jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka buh ia ki kti jong ka ha ka spindle , bad ki kti jong ka ki bat ia ka jingduna .

en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
kha: Phi te phi nud ban kynting sbai ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paralok bajan tam eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, phi pynkhih ia ki bym don kpa, bad phi tih ia ka thliew na ka bynta u paralok jong phi .

en: And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew ,  Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynim ïa pha ; khie leit ha kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha kata ka kynthei, Ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynim ia me; to leit suk .

en: Our customer service team is available around the clock to assist you.
kha: Ka kynhun ïarap ïa ki nongthied ka don baroh shilynter ban ïarap ïa phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun jong ngi ka don baroh shilynter ban iarap ia phi.

en: There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :
kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ktah jur ïa ka jingmut haba peit ba ki ïaid :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don lai tylli kiei kiei kiba iaid bha, hooid, saw tylli ki wan ha kaba leit:

en: And on the morrow , when they were come from Bethany , he was hungry :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , katba ki dang wan phai pat na Bethania , U Jisu u la sngew thngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba bud, haba ki la wan na Bethania, u la thngan:

en: Ever learning , and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth .
kha: Katto katne na ki leit rung sha ki ïingbriew bad pynshohbieit ïa ki kynthei kiba tlot ba la bankhia da ka jingpynrem jong ki pop jong ki bad kiba la shah ringmraw ha ki jingkwah ba har rukom , ki kynthei kiba pyrshang borabor ban shah hikai hynrei ki bym lah ban tip da lei lei ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: La ju nang , bad ym ju lah ban poi sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .

en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways , go not astray in her paths .
kha: Wat ai ba kum kata ka briew kan ïoh jop ïa ka dohnud jong phi ; wat leit shang kylleng shaba ïaid ma ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan hiar sha ki lynti jong ka , wat leit bakla ha ki lynti jong ka .

en: Theocratic education has long been a hallmark of Jehovah’s Witnesses .
kha: Ka jinghikai bakynja Blei ka long ka dak ba la slem bha jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinghikai ha ka rukom synshar paidbah ka la long ka dak jong ki Nongsakhi jong U Jehobah.

en: Bezer , and Hod , and Shamma , and Shilshah , and Ithran , and Beera .
kha: u Beser , u Hod , u Shamma , u Shilshah , u Ithran , bad u Beera .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bezer, bad u Hod, bad u Shamma, bad u Shilsh, bad u Ithran, bad u Beera .

en: Who will make up  " the armies " " that follow Christ into battle ? "
kha: Mano ba pynlong  " ia ki kynhun shipai " " kiba bud ia U Khrist sha ka thma ? "
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ban pynlong " ki shipai" " kiba bud ia U Khrist sha ka thma ? "

en: All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .
kha: te uwei pa uwei uba im un ïap bad un kylla long dewmet sa shisien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh baroh kan jah noh lang bad u briew un phai biang sha ka dewmet .

en: I can already see people cooperating much more than they were before .
kha: Nga lah ban iohi ba ki briew ki iatreilang kham bun ban ia kaba ki ju leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga lah ban iohi ia ki briew kiba iatreilang kham bun ban ia kaba ki la long mynshuwa .

en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :
kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin sait ia ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki hangta:

en: And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,
kha: U Lot u mih shabar , u da khang tdam ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lot u la mih shabar ha ka jingkhang sha ki , bad u la khang ia ka jingkhang hadien jong u .

en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .
kha: U angel na bneng u la paw ha u bad u la pynshaitbor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u angel u la paw ha u na bneng , u la pynskhem ia u .

en: If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he cannot deny himself .
kha: Lada ngim long kiba ïaineh , u ïaisah hi uba ïaineh , namar um lah ban shukor ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngim ngeit , hynrei u kohnguh ia lade: um lah ban kyntait ia lade .

en: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
kha: U la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! U Khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyrta, u da ong, ko Jisu, ko Khun u Dabid, to isynei ia nga .

en: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :
kha: Hynrei me — me pyntriem ïa nga da ki jingphohsniew ; me phah ha nga da ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingphohsniew kynsha
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me sngewsih ia nga da ki jingphohsniew , bad me pyntieng ia nga lyngba ki jingphohsniew:

en: When pride cometh , then cometh shame : but with the lowly is wisdom .
kha: Ki briew kiba sarong kin shah pynjahburom . Ka long kaba kham stad ban long kiba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka jingsarong ka wan, nangta ka wan ka jingsngewlehrain: hynrei bad kiba rit ka long ka jingstad .

en: And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .
kha: Ki la ïaleit sha shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh sha ka ri Genesaret .

en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .
kha: Kiba bun na kiba ngeit ki la ïawan , ki da phla ha kaba paw bad ki da pynpaw ïa kaei kaba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun kiba ngeit ki la wan, bad ki la phla bad ki la pyni ia ki kam jong ki .

en: And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .
kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to sah ha kajuh ka ïing tad haduh ba phin da mihnoh na kata ka shnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kano kano ka iing kaba phi rung shapoh, hangta ka sah, bad nangta ka leit noh .

en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew baroh sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga lada nga shah pynkiew na ka khyndew , ngan khring ia ki briew baroh sha nga .

en: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .
kha: Ngan ïai buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me , ngan ïaroh ïa me shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan kyrmen beit , bad ngan dang iaroh ia me kham bun .

en: Fear came upon me , and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .
kha: Nga kyiuh bad sngew syier ; ka met jong nga baroh kawei ka khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ka la wan ha nga , bad ka la khih , kaba la pynlong ia ki shyieng jong nga baroh ban khih .

en: To bind his princes at his pleasure  ; and teach his senators wisdom .
kha: bad ka bor halor ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem bad ka iktiar ban ai jingbthah ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban teh ia ki syiem jong u ha ka jingsngewbha jong u ; bad hikai ia ki nongshong shnong jong u .

en: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .
kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ba kynja bneng ka long kaba laitluid , bad ka dei ka kmie jong ngi keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem kaba don haneng ka long kaba laitluid , kaba long ka kmie jong ngi baroh .

en: He sent a man before them , even Joseph , who was sold for a servant :
kha: Hynrei u la phah ïa u briew ha shuwa jong ki , u Joseph , ïa uba la die kum u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u briew ha khmat jong ki , wat ia u Joseph ruh uba la die na ka bynta u shakri:

en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female .
kha: Hynrei ha kaba nyngkong , ha ka por ka jingpynlong , ‘ U Blei u la thaw ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei ,’ kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei naduh kaba sdang jong ka jingthaw U Blei u la pynlong ia ki shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Mine eye trickleth down , and ceaseth not , without any intermission ,
kha: Ki ummat jong nga kin mih kum ki wahduid ba ïai tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki tuid shapoh , bad kim sangeh , khlem kano kano ka jingpynsangeh , .

en: Thus did Noah  ; according to all that God commanded him , so did he .
kha: U Noah u la leh ïa kata baroh kat kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Noah ; kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba U Blei u la hukum ia u , kumjuh ruh u la leh .

en: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .
kha: U ïam rangbah rangsan hangta haduh ba kita ki nong Ijipt ki ïohsngew , bad la leit rah ïa ka khubor sha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iam jam: bad ki nong Ijipt bad ka iing u Pharaoh ki la iohsngew .

en: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Jarmuth , bad ka Engannim , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Jarmuth bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka , ka En maamim bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka ; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,
kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la shaniah ïa lade ha ki , namar ba u la tip ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la aiti ia lade ha ki , namar u tip ia ki briew baroh .

en: Let us break their bands asunder , and cast away their cords from us .
kha: To ngin pyllait ïa lade na ka jingsynshar jong ki ,  ki ong ;  to ngin bret noh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin pynpra ia ki band jong ki shapoh , bad ngin bret noh ia ki lynti jong ki na ngi .

en: Humans who do not seek Gods guidance will never attain lasting peace .
kha: Ki briew ki bym wad ia ka jingpyniaid jong U Blei kin ym ioh satia ia ka jingsuk kaba neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki bym wad ia ka jingpyniaid jong U Blei kin ym ioh ia ka jingsuk kaba neh .

en: Oil for the light , spices for anointing oil , and for sweet incense ,
kha: ka umphniang ïa ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingthang iwbih ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai , ki jingbam ba bang na ka bynta ka umphniang ba thiang , .

en: And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joktan ki dei ki briew jong ka Almodad , ka Sheleph , ka Hasarmabeth , ka Jerah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joktan u la kha ia u Almadad, bad u Sheleph, bad u Hazarmaveth, bad u Jerah .

en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Khrist hi da lade u la kular ban ai ha ngi — ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingkular kaba u la kular ia ngi , wat ia ka jingim bymjukut ruh .

en: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad rieh hapoh ka krem ha Makkedah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la phet noh , bad ki la buhrieh ia lade ha ka krem ha Makkedah .

en: Wisdom is too high for a fool : he openeth not his mouth in the gate .
kha: Ki jingkren kiba stad ki long kiba jylliew katta katta ïa u briew uba bieit ban sngewthuh . Um don ei ei ban kren haba ïa ki kam badonkam la ïatainia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka long kaba heh palat na ka bynta u bieit: um plie ia ka shyntur jong u ha ka khyrdop .

en: But he denied before them all , saying , I know not what thou sayest .
kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata ha khmat jong ki baroh .  Ngam tip ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kyntait ha khmat jong ki baroh, u da ong, Ngam tip ia kaei kaba me ong .

en: And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
kha: Wat la phi kam ba phi mane ïa U  Trai  , phim shym mut kumba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la ki ong , U Trai u im ; shisha ki smai lamler .

en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
kha: Hato phi kwah ban ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai jong u briew ka pynlong jaka ia u , bad ka wanrah ia u ha khmat ki briew kiba khraw .

en: His roots are wrapped about the heap , and seeth the place of stones .
kha: Ki thied jong ki , ki kyllaiñ sawdong ïa ki maw , bad ki batskhem ha man la u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tynrai jong u ki la tyrkhong sawdong ka thliew , bad u iohi ia ka jaka jong ki maw .

en: And the people said unto Joshua , Nay  ; but we will serve the  Lord .
kha: U paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Em ! Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ong ha u Joshua , Em; hynrei ngin shakri ia U Trai .

en: For their redeemer is mighty  ; he shall plead their cause with thee .
kha: U  Trai  u long u nongkyrshan uba donbor jong ki , bad un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u nongsiewspah jong ki u long uba khlain bor; un kyrpad ia ka daw jong ki bad me .

en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra dei ban otsher ïa uta u khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra yn sa ot ia ka doh jong u .

en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .
kha: Kam da jngai nangta la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang kiba dang ïabam jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka lynti kaba bha na ki ka kynhun jong ki sniang kiba bun .

en: This is my comfort in my affliction : for thy word hath quickened me .
kha: Wat ha ka jingshitom jong nga , la pyntngen ïa nga namar ka jingkular jong me ka ai jingim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingpyntngen jong nga ha ka jingjynjar jong nga: namar ka ktien jong me ka la pynkloi ia nga .

en: And as Jesus passed by , he saw a man which was blind from his birth .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid artat , u la ïohi ïa u briew ïa uba la kha matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la iaid lyngba , u la iohi ia u briew uba matlah naduh ba la kha ia u .

en: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .
kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka la shun ïa nga nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ia phi , phi tip ba ka la shun ia nga shuwa ba kan shun ia phi .

en: Let thy mercy , O  Lord  , be upon us , according as we hope in thee .
kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan long ha ngi , A  Trai  , kumba ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka jingisynei jong me, ko Trai, kan long halor jong ngi, kumba ngi kyrmen ha me .

en: Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
kha: Ki synran ki la ïa-peit uwei ïa uwei pat da ka jinglyngngoh kaba jur , shaphang jongno u mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran ki peit iwei ia iwei pat, ki artatien ia uba u kren .

en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
kha: Ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh , ka khyndew ka pynmih shikatdei eh ki jingthung , ïa kiba u Joseph u lum bad kynshew ha ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki hynriew snem kiba bun ka khyndew ka la mih da ki kti .

en: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;
kha: Ym don sabon kaba lah ban sait ïa ki pop jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga sait ia lade da ka um slap , bad nga pynlong ia ki kti jong nga kim ju long kiba khuid kumta ;

en: However , the police is maintaining a studied silence over the issue .
kha: Hynrei ki pulit ki dang pynlong ia ka jingsngap jar kaba la pule bha halor katei ka mat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki pulit ki dang pynneh ia ka jingsngap jar kaba la pule bniah halor kane ka mat .

en: Complete your profile to receive personalized product recommendations.
kha: Pyndep ïa ka profile jong phi ban ïoh ïa ki jingai jingmut ba kyrpang jong ki mar.
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndep ia ka profile jong phi ban ioh ia ki jingai jingmut jong ki mar ba la shna kyrpang.

en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki dieng shittim , bad u la tap ia ki da ka ksiar .

en: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .
kha: Mynta ba ka por ka jingngeit ka la poi , ka Hukum kam donbor shuh halor jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ba kata ka jingngeit ka la wan , ngim don shuh hapoh u nonghikai skul .

en: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven .
kha: Hynrei u shñiuh u sdang ban san biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki shniuh jong ka khlieh jong u ki la sdang ban san biang hadien ba u la shah ot .

en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept .
kha: ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingsynshar u Josiah la buh ia kane ka jingkhawai .

en: Let thy fountain be blessed : and rejoice with the wife of thy youth .
kha: Kumta shongsuk bad ka tnga jong phi bad shem ïa ka jingkmen bad ka kynthei kaba phi shongkurim —
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka pung jong me kan long kaba la kyrkhu: bad to sngewbha bad ka tnga jong ka jinglong samla jong me .

en: A wise man is strong  ; yea , a man of knowledge increaseth strength .
kha: Ban long stad ka kham bha ban ïa kaba long khlaiñ ; ho-oid , ka jingtip ka kham donkam ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u long uba khlain ; yea , u briew uba stad u nang pynroi ia ka bor .

en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .
kha: na kawei ka pateng bynriew sha kawei pat u pyn-i ka jingisynei ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingisynei jong u ka long ha kito kiba tieng ia u naduh ka pateng haduh ka pateng .

en: He shall suck the poison of asps : the viper s tongue shall slay him .
kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba sniew u nguid ka long kum ka bih ; ka pynïap ïa u kum ka jingpuh jong u bseiñ bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Un dih ia ka bih jong ki asp: ka shyntur jong u bsein kan pyniap ia u .

en: Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .
kha: Um donkam ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u lehsbun ïa kito kiba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid u sngewsih ia ki nonglehbein: hynrei u ai ka jingaiei ia kiba rit .

en: Erastus abode at Corinth : but Trophimus have I left at Miletus sick .
kha: U Erastos u la sah ha Korinth , bad nga la iehnoh ïa u Trophimos ha Miletos , namar ba u pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshong ha Korinth: hynrei u Trophimus u la leit noh ha Miletus uba pang .

en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .
kha: Lada phi siew kylliang ïa kaba bha da kaba sniew , da lei lei phin ym lah ban beh ïa kaba sniew na ka ïing jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba siew kylliang ia ka jingsniew na ka bynta ka jingbha , ka jingsniew kan ym mih na ka iing jong u .

en: And the people murmured against Moses , saying , What shall we drink ?
kha: Kita ki paidbah ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses , bad ki la kylli ,  Ngin ïadih da-ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ia ud pyrshah ia u Moses da kaba ong: Ngi ngin dih aiu ?

en: And it was told Saul , saying , Behold , David is at Naioth in Ramah .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u don ha Naïoth kaba ha Ramah , kumta u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban kem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha u Saul, da kaba ong: Ha khmih u Dabid u don ha Naiot ha Ramah .

en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever !
kha: Lane da u shniah ban shniah ïa ki ktien jong nga ha u maw bad ban thoh ïa ki khnang ba kin sah junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba la ker ia ki da ka pen nar bad ka lead ha u maw junom !

en: And hereby we do know that we know him , if we keep his commandments .
kha: Lada ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei , te ngi sngewskhem ba ngi ithuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kane ngi tip ba ngi ithuh ia u , lada ngi sumar ia ki hukum jong u .

en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .
kha: Phi ïohi katno ki dak heh nga pynlong haba nga thoh sha phi mynta da la ka jong ka kti!
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi katno ka shithi kaba heh nga la thoh sha phi da ka kti jong nga hi .

en: When I would comfort myself against sorrow , my heart is faint in me .
kha: Ïa ka jingsngewsih jong nga ym lah ban pynkhiah ; nga pang ha ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga sngewtynnad ia lade pyrshah ia ka jingsngewsih , ka dohnud jong nga ka la tyrkhong ha nga .

en: For he was numbered with us , and had obtained part of this ministry .
kha: U Judas u la long u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong ngi , namar la lah jied ïa u ban ïadon bynta lem ha ka kam jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la shah khein bad ngi , bad u la ioh ia ka bynta jong kane ka jingshakri .

en: A wise king scattereth the wicked , and bringeth the wheel over them .
kha: U syiem uba stad un shem uno uba leh ïa ka bymdei , bad un pynshitom ïa u khlem isynei .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem uba stad u pynphriang ia kiba sniew bad u wanrah ia ka kali halor jong ki .

en: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men ,
kha: Naba U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka jingaiei jong U na ka bynta ka jingpynim jong ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingaiei U Blei kaba wanrah ia ka jingpynim ka la paw ha ki briew baroh .

en: Wherefore do the wicked live , become old , yea , are mighty in power ?
kha: Balei ba U Blei u shah ïa ki briew basniew ban im , u shah ïa ki ban im slem bad roi kyrhai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba ki bymman ki im , ki kylla tymmen , ki long kiba khlain bor ha ka bor ?

en: Their houses are safe from fear , neither is the rod of God upon them .
kha: U Blei um wallam satia ka jingpynjot ha ki longïing jong ki ; kim ju im ha ka jingshyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iing jong ki ki long kiba lait na ka jingtieng , bad u diengduh U Blei um don ha ki .

en: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .
kha: Ki la khang ïa ka lynti phet jong nga bad pyrshang ban pynjot ïa nga ; bad ym don mano mano ban pynsangeh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynsniew ia ka lynti jong nga, ki buh ia ka jingeh jong nga, kim don jingiarap .

en: Stay me with flagons , comfort me with apples : for I am sick of love .
kha: Ko kynthei Jerusalem , nga long uba ïong hynrei uba bhabriew , ka jingïong kum ki ïingjaiñ ha ka ri shyiap Kedar , hynrei ka jingbhabriew kum ki pyrda ba la wah ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: To sah ia nga da ki sohjew, pynsngewbha ia nga da ki apple: namar nga pang ia ka jingieit .

en: He sealeth up the hand of every man  ; that all men may know his work .
kha: U pynsangeh ïa ka jingtrei jong ki briew ; u pyn-i ha ki ïa kaei kaba u lah ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynskhem ia ka kti jong uwei pa uwei u briew khnang ba baroh ki briew kin tip ia ka kam jong u .

en: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings .
kha: Ka la don ka jingïapait biang hapdeng ki briew namar kine ki ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la don ka jingphiah namarkata sa shisien pat hapdeng ki Jiw na ka bynta kine ki jingkren .

en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?
kha: U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym don uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phah !
translated_en_to_kha: U bret noh ia u ice jong u kum ki jingbam ba bang: mano ba lah ban ieng ha khmat ka jingkhriat jong u ?

en: Israel also came into Egypt  ; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha Ijipt bad u shongduh ha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ruh ki la wan sha Ijipt ; bad u Jakob u la sah ha ka ri Ham .

en: The lot causeth contentions to cease , and parteth between the mighty .
kha: Lada ar ngut ki briew kiba donbor ki ïa-pyrshah uwei ïa uwei ha ka ïingbishar , kaba kynting sbai kan lah ban ai ïa ka rai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lot ka pynlong ia ki jingiakren ban sangeh noh , bad ka iakhlad hapdeng kiba khlain bor .

en: And gave their land for an heritage : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki ha ki briew jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia ka ri jong ki na ka bynta ka pateng: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .
kha: sumar ïa ki jinghikai jong nga ha ki por baroh ; thoh ïa ka ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia ki ha ki kti jong me , thoh ia ki ha ka miej jong ka dohnud jong me .

en: Whose hope shall be cut off , and whose trust shall be a spider s web .
kha: Ki shaniah ha u ksai — ka snur thapbawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrmen jongno kan shah ot noh , bad ka jingshaniah jongno kan long ka web jong u khnai .

en: Anathoth with her suburbs , and Almon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Anathoth , bad ka Almon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Anathoth bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad u Almon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: Please review the return policy to understand the terms and conditions.
kha: Sngewbha peit bnïah ïa ka polisi ban pynphai ban sngewthuh ïa ki kyndon bad ki jingpynbeit.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha bishar bniah ia ka polisi pynphai biang ban sngewthuh ia ki kyndon bad ki jingpynbeit.

en: The silver is mine , and the gold is mine , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh ha ka pyrthei ka long ka jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rupa ka long ka jong nga , bad ka ksiar ka long ka jong nga , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .
kha: Haba u la shem ïa ka , u kmen haduh katta katta ba u buh ïa ka halor ki tyrpeng jong u bad bah pat ïa ka sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la shem ia ka , u la buh ia ka ha ki tyrpeng jong u, da kaba kmen .

en: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .
kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa uta u khun bad ki la pynïap ïa u bad bret ïa ka met jong u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u bad ki la pyniap ia u bad ki la bret noh ia u na ka kper sohjew .

en: He spoke of the measures taken for investor facilitation in the State .
kha: U la kren shaphang ki lad ki lynti ba la shim na ka bynta ban pynsuk ia ki nongbei tyngka ha ka Jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren shaphang ki lad ba la shim na ka bynta ka jingpynsuk ia ki nongbei tyngka ha ka Jylla .

en: The moon and stars to rule by night : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban synshar halor ka miet ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: U bnai bad ki khlur ban synshar miet: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations , saith the  Lord .
kha: Pha dei ban shahshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba jakhlia bad kiba ijli kiba pha la leh .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la kha ia ka jinglehrain bad ki jinglehrain jong me , ong U Trai .

en: I ' m seeking a true alchemist who will help me to decipher the codes .
kha: Nga wad ia u alchemist uba shisha uba iarap ia nga ban sngewthuh ia ki code .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga wad ia u alchemist uba shisha uba iarap ia nga ban sngewthuh ia ki code .

en: Who are these that fly as a cloud , and as the doves to their windows ?
kha: Kiei kine ki liengbah kiba per kum u lyoh , kum ki paro ki wan phai sha la ki sem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kine kiba her kum u lyoh , bad kum ki paro ha ki jingkhang jong ki ?

en: Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .
kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewsniew , bad wat pyrshang ban ïalang paralok bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewsih ia ki briew kiba sniew , lymne wat kwah ban don ryngkat bad ki .

en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .
kha: Bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei uba kum une u khynnah , u pdiang ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba pdiang ia uwei u khynnah rit ha ka kyrteng jong nga u pdiang ia nga .

en: Thus did Uriah the priest , according to all that king Ahaz commanded .
kha: U Uriah u leh kumba u syiem u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Ulia u lyngdoh kat kum kata ka jingbthah jong u syiem Ahasa .

en: And when Zacharias saw him , he was troubled , and fear fell upon him .
kha: Haba u Sekharaïah u la ïohi ïa u , u la kyndit bad u la sngewsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sakhia u la iohi ia u, u la sngewsih bad ka jingtieng ka la hap halor jong u .

en: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?
kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  To ïathuh ïa nga u dei uei , ko Kynrad , khnang ba ngan lah ban ngeit ha u !
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong , Uei u Trai ba ngan ngeit ia u ?

en: The rich and poor meet together : the  Lord  is the maker of them all .
kha: Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk ki don ïa kane kajuh , U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki baroh ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki riewspah bad kiba duk ki iakynduh lang: U Trai u long u nongthaw jong ki baroh .

en: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
kha: Haba phi leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khmat jong phi bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, haba me stet tam, to pynsleh ia ka khlieh jong me, bad sait ia ka khmat jong me ; .

en: The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .
kha: Kane ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Ninebeh , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kaba la ïohi da u Nahum , uba dei na Elkosh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong u Nineveh . Ka kot jong ka jingphohsniew jong u Nahum u Elkoshite .

en: Remove thy way far from her , and come not nigh the door of her house :
kha: Pynjngai ïa lade na kum kata ka briew , wat ju leit tur sha jan ka jingkhang ka ïing jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka lynti jong me na ka , bad wat wan hajan ka jingkhang jong ka iing jong ka:

en: My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?
kha: Kynrad , phi la kylli ïa ngi , ‘ Phi dang don kpa ne phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong nga u la kylli ia ki shakri jong u, u da ong: Hato phi don u kpa ne u hynmen ?

en: And four great beasts came up from the sea , diverse one from another .
kha: Saw tylli ki mradkhlaw bakhraw eh ki la mih shajrong na ka duriaw-bah , uwei uwei u ïapher na kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad saw tylli ki mrad kiba khraw ki la mih na ka duriaw , kiba pher kawei na kawei pat .

en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul , so is good news from a far country .
kha: Khatduh eh kaba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor babha na ka ri ba sha jngai ka long kum ka jingdih ïa ka umkhriat haba phi tyrkhong bad phi sliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ki um kiba khriat sha ka mynsiem kaba sliang , kumjuh ruh ka khubor babha na ka ri kaba jngai .

en: How long shall I see the standard , and hear the sound of the trumpet ?
kha: Sa katno nga dei ban ïohi ïa ka thma kaba nang jur bad ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa jong ki turoi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por ngan iohi ia ka standard , bad nga iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi ?

en: And when he heard this , he was very sorrowful : for he was very rich .
kha: Hynrei haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh , namar u la long uba riewspah shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohsngew ia kane , u la sngewsih shibun: namar u la riewspah shibun .

en: Discover our wide range of products by browsing through the categories.
kha: Lap ïa ki mar bapher bapher jong ngi da kaba peit lyngba ki jait.
translated_en_to_kha: Pyni ia ki mar kiba bun jait jong ngi da kaba peit lyngba ki jait.

en: Righteousness exalteth a nation : but sin is a reproach to any people .
kha: Ka hok ka kyntiew ïa ka jaitbynriew ; ka pop ka long ka jingjahburom jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok ka pynkiew ia ka jaitbynriew: hynrei ka pop ka long ka jingkren bein ia uno uno u briew .

en: And Peter , fastening his eyes upon him with John , said , Look on us .
kha: Ki la khmih shlip ha u , bad u Petros u la ong ,  Peit sha ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros, da kaba pynkhih ia ki khmat jong u bad u Ioannis, u la ong, Peit ia ngi .

en: Thy word have I hid in mine heart , that I might not sin against thee .
kha: Nga ri khop ïa ka hukum jong me ha la ka dohnud , khnang ba ngan ym leh pop pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien jong me nga la buhrieh ha ka dohnud jong nga , ba ngan ym leh pop pyrshah ia me .

en: I will heap mischiefs upon them  ; I will spend mine arrows upon them .
kha: ‘ Ha ki ngan pynngat ïa ki jingpynjot bymkut shuh , ngan siat lut la ki khnam ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan lum ia ki khniang jong nga ha ki ; ngan pynlut ia ki khnam jong nga ha ki .

en: And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .
kha: Kumta u la khot ïa uwei na ki shakri bad u la kylli ïa u , ‘ Ka jia aïu ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia uwei na ki shakri bad u la kylli kaei kata ka jingmut .

en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham s sight because of his son .
kha: Kane ka la pyndiaw shibun eh ïa u Abraham , naba u Ishmael ruh u dei u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka long kaba sngewsih shibun ha ka khmat u Abraham namar u khun jong u .

en: And there arose certain , and bare false witness against him , saying ,
kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ïeng bad ki la ïathuh ïa kane ka jinglamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka sakhi kaba thikna bad kaba thylli pyrshah ia u, da kaba ong:

en: The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :
kha: Ki nongshun jong u ki tur ïaleh tyngeh ïa u , Bad ki beh ïa u da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongsiat khnam ki la sngewsih shibun ia u, bad ki la siat ia u, bad ki la shun ia u:

en: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa U Jisu ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wan hajan jong u baroh ki nongleh kam sniew bad ki nongpop na ka bynta ban iohsngew ia u .

en: The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?
kha: U  Trai  u don bad nga , ngan ym sheptieng ; u briew un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u don ha ka liang jong nga ; ngan ym tieng: kaei kaba u briew u lah ban leh ia nga ?

en: For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .
kha: A  Trai  U Nongsynshar , nga buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me ; nga la shaniah ha me naduh ba nga dang samla .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta me me long ka jingkyrmen jong nga, ko Trai Blei: me long ka jingshaniah jong nga naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: Sania Mirza is one of the most popular Indian players for lawn Tennis .
kha: Ka Sania Mirza ka dei kawei na ki nongialehkai ba pawnam bha ha India na ka bynta ka lawn tennis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sania Mirza ka dei kawei na ki nongialehkai India kaba pawnam tam na ka bynta ka lawn Tenni .

en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before ?
kha: Shu tharai , te , ba phi dei ban ïohi ïa U Khun U briew ba u leit kiew pat sha ka jaka ha kaba u la don mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei bad lada phin iohi ia u Khun u briew ba u kiew shaneng ha ka jaka ba u la don mynshuwa ?

en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .
kha: Nga sngewsih bad nga phong da ki jaiñ khain , bad nga shong hangne ha u pui pui , ba la shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la shna ia ka sniehdoh jong nga, bad nga la pynsniew ia ka sniehdoh jong nga ha ka dewbilat .

en: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock ,
kha: Kumta u Jakob u phah ktien sha ka Rakhel bad ka Leah ba kin ïakynduh ïa u ha lyngkha ha kaba ki jingri jong u ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la phah bad u la khot ia ka Rakhel bad ka Leah sha lyngkha sha ka kynhun jong u .

en: And some of them would have taken him  ; but no man laid hands on him .
kha: Don kiba la kwah ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba ktah kti ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don napdeng jong ki kiba la shim ia u ; hynrei ym don mano mano ruh kiba la buh kti ia u .

en: And the waters covered their enemies : there was not one of them left .
kha: Hynrei ka um ka la pynngam jyllop ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki um ki la tap ia ki nongshun jong ki: ym don uwei ruh na ki uba sah .

en: Iron is taken out of the earth , and brass is molten out of the stone .
kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ka nar na ka khyndew ; bad ki pynum ïa ka rnong na ki maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka Iron la shim na ka khyndew , bad la pynkhyllem ia u nar na u maw .

en: The elder women as mothers ; the younger as sisters , with all purity .
kha: To wat sneng ïa uba la kham rangbah , hynrei to kyrpad ha u kum la u kpa . To ñiew ïa kiba kham samla kum la ki para , ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham ïaw kum ki kmie , bad ïa ki kynthei kiba kham samla kum ki para , da ka jingsngur mynsiem baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tymmen kum ki kmie ki kham rit kum ki para kynthei , da ka jingkhuid baroh .

en: And he said unto them ,  I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Soitan uba hap kum ka leilieh na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , nga la iohi ia u Soitan kum u jingshai ba u hap na bneng .

en: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia , they came to Pamphylia .
kha: Hadien ba ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka thain jong ka Pisidia , ki la wan poi ha Pamphylia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba ki la iaid lyngba ka ri Pisaia baroh kawei, ki la poi ha Pamphylia .

en: Deliver thyself , O Zion , that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha la ki briew ,  Nga la pynsakma ïa phi ha ki liang baroh . Hynrei mynta , ma phi kiba shah ringmraw , phet noh na Babilonia bad leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia lade , ko Seion , kaba shong bad ka khun jong ka Babilon .

en: PERES  ; Thy kingdom is divided , and given to the Medes and Persians .
kha: Ki jingbynta  , Ïa ka hima jong phi la pynbynta bad la ai ha ki Mid bad ki Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: PERES ; Ka hima jong Me ka la phiah , bad la ai ha ki Media bad ki Persia .

en: And thou mourn at the last , when thy flesh and thy body are consumed ,
kha: Phin thiah ryngkat bad ka jingud shuwa ba phin ïap , ka doh bad ki dohksah jong phi kin ringswai , bad phin ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me sngewsih khatduh , haba ka doh bad ka met jong me ka la bam , .

en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
kha: Hato u briew u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Uba bishar wat ïa kito kiba heh kyrdan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don mano mano ba hikai ia U Blei ? haba u bishar ia kito kiba jrong .

en: Howbeit they did not hearken , but they did after their former manner .
kha: Hynrei kito ki briew kim shahshkor , bad ki ïai bteng ban bud ïa ki rukom kiba rim jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kim shym la sngap , hynrei ki la leh katkum ka rukom kaba mynshuwa jong ki .

en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke , as out of a seething pot or caldron .
kha: Ka tdem ka wan mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , kum ka tdem ki ñiut kiba la thang sha trai jong u khiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki thliew shyntur jong u ki leit dih duma, kum na ka umphniang ne ka umphniang .

en: Singh, he confirmed, by posting on his Twitter account, this afternoon.
kha: U Singh, ula pynthikna, da kaba thoh ha ka twitter jongu, mynta ka noh sngi.
translated_en_to_kha: U Singh, u la pynthikna, da kaba buh ha ka Twitter jong u, mynta ka janmiet.

en: And they say unto him , We have here but five loaves , and two fishes .
kha: Baroh kaba ngi don hangne ki long san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Ngi don hangne tang san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha .

en: For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .
kha: Ka jingleh bymman bad ka jingleh jubor ki long kum ka bam ka dih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki bam ia u kpu jong ka jingsniew , bad ki dih ia ka wain jong ka jingleh donbor .

en: For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .
kha: U long tang ma u marwei , uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingsngew jong nga , bad uba sngewlem shisha shaphang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam don briew uba sngewtynnad, uba sumar ia ka jylla jong phi da ka jinglong tynrai .

en: Seeing then that we have such hope , we use great plainness of speech :
kha: Namar ba ngi don ïa kane ka jingkyrmen , ngi long kiba shlur bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ngi iohi nangta ba ngi don kum kata ka jingkyrmen , ngi pyndonkam ia ka jingkren kaba jem kaba khraw:

en: The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us , that we have sinned !
kha: Ym don shuh kano kano kaba dang sah na baroh kaba ngi la ju sngewsarong . Ngi la leh pop bad mynta ngi long kiba la tim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh ka la hap na ka khlieh jong ngi: sngewsih ia ngi , ba ngi la leh pop !

en: And Beth–lebaoth , and Sharuhen  ; thirteen cities and their villages :
kha: ka Beth Lebaoth , bad ka Sharuhen : khatlai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Bethlebaoth , bad ka Sharan ; shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .
kha: Lada phi kwah ban lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba bat ia ka shyntur bad ka shyntur jong u u iada ia ka mynsiem jong u na ki jingeh .

en: He that smiteth a man , so that he die , shall be surely put to death .
kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u parabriew kat haduh ba un da ïap u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pyniap ia u briew, haduh ba un da iap , un shah pyniap shisha .

en: The quiver rattleth against him , the glittering spear and the shield .
kha: Ki atiar kiba ki nongshong jong ki , ki rah ; ki sawa bad ki thaba ha ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa kaba jem pyrshah ia u, ka khnam kaba rben bad ka jingda .

en: And I said unto my master , Peradventure the woman will not follow me .
kha: Bad nga la kylli ha u kynrad jong nga , ‘ Kumno lada jia ba kata ka briew kam treh ban wan ryngkat bad nga ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha u kynrad jong nga , Hooid ka kynthei kan ym bud ia nga .

en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .
kha: Ki briew ki bym ñiewkor ïa kiwei pat , ki lah ban pynkhih kulmar ïa ki nongbah baroh . Kito kiba stad ki pynjai jai ïa kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba sngewsih ki wanrah ia ka nongbah sha ka jingma: hynrei ki briew kiba stad ki phai noh ia ka jingbitar .

en: And the sons of Reuben  ; Hanoch , and Pallu , and Hezron , and Carmi .
kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Reuben : u Hanokh , u Pallu , u Hesron , bad u Karmi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Reuben ; Hanoch, bad u Pallu, bad u Hesron, bad u Carmi .

en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord , and he shall lift you up .
kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un pynkhraw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduna ia lade ha khmat U Trai , bad un rah ia phi .

en: For this is my covenant unto them , when I shall take away their sins .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad ki haba ngan weng noh ïa ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka jutang jong nga ha ki , haba ngan weng noh ia ki pop jong ki .

en: And they caught him , and cast him out of the vineyard , and slew him .
kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa u , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ , bad ki la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kem ia u bad ki la bret noh ia u na ka kper sohjew bad ki la pyniap ia u .

en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused. How can we assist you today?
kha: Ngi panmap na ka bynta kino kino ki jingeh kiba lah ban mih. Kumno ngi lah ban ïarap ïa phi mynta ka sngi?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi panmap na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbymsuk kaba la mih. Kumno ngi lah ban iarap ia phi mynta ka sngi?

en: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the  Lord  which he did .
kha: Ho-oid , phi dei kito kiba la ïohi ïa kine ki kambah baroh kiba U  Trai  u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khmat jong phi ki la iohi ia ki kam kiba khraw jong U Trai kiba u la leh .

en: Neither was the man created for the woman ; but the woman for the man .
kha: Lymne ym shym la thaw ïa u briew na ka bynta ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na ka bynta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shynrang ruh um shym la thaw na ka bynta ka kynthei ; hynrei ka kynthei na ka bynta u shynrang .

en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .
kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Silpah ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban shakri ïa ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ai ha ka khun jong u ka Leah Zilpah ia ka nongtrei jong u na ka bynta ka nongtrei kti .

en: O ye Corinthians , our mouth is open unto you , our heart is enlarged .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit ha Korinth! Ngi la kren da kaba shai kdar ha phi ; ngi la plie ïar ïa la ki dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Korinth , ka shyntur jong ngi ka plie ia phi , ka dohnud jong ngi ka nang heh .

en: Then laid they their hands on them , and they received the Holy Ghost .
kha: Te u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la buh ïa la ki kti ha ki , bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ki , bad ki la pdiang ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit ?
kha: Hato uno uno na phi u lah ban im kham slem da kaba khuslai shaphang jong ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mano na phi da kaba pyrkhat u lah ban pyndap ia ka jinglong jong u shi cuit ?

en: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la iai bteng ha ka tempi, ki iaroh bad kyrkhu ia U Blei . Amen .

en: If thou canst answer me , set thy words in order before me , stand up .
kha: Jubab ïa nga lada phi lah . Pynkhreh ïa ki nia jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me lah ban jubab ia nga, to buh ia ki ktien jong me ha khmat jong nga, to ieng .

en: Let thy garments be always white  ; and let thy head lack no ointment .
kha: Borabor pynpaw ïa ka jingkmen bad ba-dap da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki jain jong me kin long kiba lieh man ka por bad to ai ba ka khlieh jong me kan duna ka umphniang .

en: I have procured a licence for food processing and making fruit juices .
kha: Nga la ioh ia ka laisen ban pynkhreh ia ki jingbam bad ban shna ia ki umsoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ioh laisen na ka bynta ka jingpynkhreh ia ki jingbam bad ban shna ia ki umsoh soh .

en: And they had in their inheritance Beer–sheba , or Sheba , and Moladah ,
kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Beersheba , ka Sheba , ka Moladah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la don ha ka pateng jong ki u Beersheba ne u Sheba bad u Moladah .

en: He lieth under the shady trees , in the covert of the reed , and fens .
kha: U dem hapoh ki bniap shiah , bad u rieh hapdeng ki khah ha ki jaka sngem .
translated_en_to_kha: U shong hapoh ki dieng kiba jyrngam, ha ka jingtap jong u phlang bad ki thliew .

en: If thou prepare thine heart , and stretch out thine hands toward him  ;
kha: Pynlong ïa la ka dohnud kaba beit , ko Job . Phai sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong me bad pynkhih ia ki kti jong me sha u ; .

en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel , a Pirathonite , judged Israel .
kha: Hadien u Elon , u Abdon u khun jong u Hillel uba na Pirathon u ïalam ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u u Abdon u khun u Hillel, u Piratoni u la bishar ia ki Israel .

en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;
kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingim hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba iehnoh ia ki lynti jong ka jinglong beit , ban iaid ha ki lynti jong ka jingdum ; .

en: For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , nga duwai ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw kane nga Paul , u koidi U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi ki Jutang , .

en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me , and sat before me .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan ban kylli na nga shaphang ka mon U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan katto katne na ki rangbah Israel sha nga , bad ki la shong ha khmat jong nga .

en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .
kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U Trai ban ia kaba shaniah ha ki syiem .

en: And he asked them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven .
kha: Katno tylli u kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia ki, Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ? Ki la ong, Hynriew .

en: But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .
kha: Lane hato me la kyntait ïa ngi junom ? Hato ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la kyntait shisha ia ngi; me la bitar shibun ia ngi .

en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus , whom I have begotten in my bonds :
kha: Kumta nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad na ka bynta u Onesimos , uba long u khun jong nga hi ha U Khrist ; ba mynba ngi la don ha ka byndi nga la long u kpa jong u ha ka mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia me na ka bynta u khun jong nga Onesimus , uba nga la kha ha ki jingteh jong nga:

en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .
kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap ki long ki bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam haduh hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ktah ia ka met iap jong uno uno u briew un long u bymkhuid hynriew sngi .

en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished : there make ready .
kha: Un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng , kaba heh , kaba la pynbit pynbiang , ha kaba phin pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pyni ia phi ia ka kamra kaba heh kaba la pyndap: hangta pynkhreh .

en: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :
kha: Ki parabangeit baroh kiba don hangne ki ïasnohkti lang bad nga ha kaba phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha ki balang ha Galatia :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki parabangeit baroh kiba don ryngkat bad nga, ha ki balang Kalatia:

en: The horn of Moab is cut off , and his arm is broken , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ka Moab la khñiot noh ; ïa ka bor jong ka la pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka horn jong u Moab ka la tyrkhong , bad ka kti jong u ka la tyrkhong , ong U Trai .

en: Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;
kha: ki bakla shaphang kaei kaba dei , namar ba ngan leit sha U Kpa bad phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka hok , namar nga leit sha U Kpa jong nga bad phim iohi shuh ia nga ; .

en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?
kha: Hynrei lada ka long kumta , da kumno ki Jingthoh Bakhuid kiba ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba dei ban jia , kin jia long shisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumno te yn pyndep ia ki jingthoh , ba kumta ka dei ban long ?

en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery , the wormwood and the gall .
kha: Ka jingpyrkhat ïa ka jingpang jong nga , ka jingbymdon ïing jong nga , ka long ka bih bakthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba kynmaw ia ka jingjynjar jong nga bad ka jingjynjar jong nga, ka sniehdoh bad ka gall .

en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .
kha: Ha ka jingïadei bad ka Hukum , la kumno kumno nga la ïap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga lah ban im na ka bynta U Blei . La pynïap ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la iap ha ka hukum , ba ngan im ha U Blei .

en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .
kha: Ki proberb jong me kim don jingmyntoi shuh kum ki dpei ; ki jingïasaid jong me ki long kiba tlot kum ka dewbyrtha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkynmaw jong u ki long kum ka dewbilat , ki met jong u sha ki met jong ka dewbilat .

en: The disciple is not above his master , nor the servant above his lord .
kha: Ym don uba shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nonghikai jong u ; ym don u mraw uba kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U synran um long halor u kynrad jong u , lymne u shakri halor u kynrad jong u .

en: The Biram tribe called the Jyrwa after the name of their father, Biram.
kha: Jait Biram pat, ki ong ia ki Jyrwa na ka kyrteng u kpa, u Biram.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaitbynriew Biram ka la khot ia ka Jyrwa hadien ka kyrteng u kpa jong ki, u Biram.

en: Only by pride cometh contention : but with the well advised is wisdom .
kha: Kiba leh meng kim leh ei ei hynrei tang ban pynmih jingkulmar . Ka long kaba kham stad ban da pan ïa ka jingai jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang da ka jingsarong ka wan ka jingiakren: hynrei da ka jingstad kaba la ai jingmut bha .

en: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .
kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap ki la pihuiñ ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki shakri bakhuid jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngewsih ia u Moses ruh ha ka shnong , bad u Aaron u riewkhuid jong U Trai .

en: And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .
kha: La don ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri ka la shongthait sawphew snem . Bad u Othniel u khun u Kenaz u la iap .

en: And the damsel ran , and told them of her mother s house these things .
kha: Kata ka samla ka la mareh sha ka ïing ka kmie jong ka bad ka ïathuh ïa kaba la jia baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U dam u la mareh , bad u la iathuh ha ki ia kine kiei kiei jong ka kmie jong ka .

en: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject ;
kha: La kumno kumno to ai ïa ka jingmaham ar sien ïa u briew uba pynmih ki jingïapait , bad hadien kata to kiar noh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba long u nongwei hadien ka jingshah kyntait kaba nyngkong bad kaba ar;

en: Surely God will not hear vanity , neither will the Almighty regard it .
kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban kyang jam ; U Blei Badonbor Baroh um shym ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid U Blei un ym iohsngew ia ka jinglong bieit , lymne u Blei baroh un ym pyrkhat ia ka .

en: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;
kha: Ki la klet ïa U Blei uba la pyllait im ïa ki da ki kam badonbor jong u ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la klet noh ia U Blei u nongpynim jong ki, uba la leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw ha Ijipt ; .

en: Declare this in the house of Jacob , and publish it in Judah , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah :
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia kane ha ka iing u Jakob , bad pynmih ia ka ha Judah da kaba ong:

en: As many as 150 unidentified people have also been booked in this case .
kha: Ki don haduh 150 ngut ki briew ki bym lah ban ithuh ruh kiba la shah pynngat ha kane ka mukotduma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba 150 ngut ki briew ki bym ithuh ruh ki la shah book ha kane ka khep .

en: If I forget thee , O Jerusalem , let my right hand forget her cunning .
kha: To ai ba ngan nym lah shuh ban tem biang ïa ka duitara lada nga klet ïa pha , ko Jerusalem !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga klet ia me, ko Jerusalem, to ai ba ka kti kadiang jong nga kan klet noh ia ka jingleh thok jong ka .

en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban leit shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ruh u bym don ha lyngkha un wan phai biang ban shim ia ki jain jong u .

en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :
kha: Ki wahduid kiba la khleh lang bad ka ïor lem bad u thah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba lieh namar u ice , bad ha kaba u slap u buhrieh:

en: Let men of understanding tell me , and let a wise man hearken unto me .
kha: Uno uno uba don ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kaba biang un mynjur da shisha ; bad uba stad haba u ïohsngew ïa nga un ong
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki briew kiba sngewthuh kin iathuh ia nga , bad ai ba u briew uba stad un sngap ia nga .

en: So David slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David .
kha: U Dabid u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u , bad la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid .

en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la sngewsih haba nga ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki kynthei jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong nga ka ktah ia ka dohnud jong nga namar ki khun kynthei jong nga baroh .

en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
kha: Nga la thoh laiphew tylli ki jingkren na ka bynta jong phi . Ki kynthup ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingkyntu babha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngam shym la thoh ia kiei kiei kiba bha ha ki jingai jingmut bad ka jingtip , .

en: Lord  , how long shall the wicked , how long shall the wicked triumph ?
kha: Slem haduh katno ki bymman kin ïalehkmen ? Slem haduh katno , A  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Trai , haduh katno u bymman , haduh katno u bymman un jop ?

en: And be it indeed that I have erred , mine error remaineth with myself .
kha: Wat la nga la leh bymdei , kumno kata ka pynmong ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ka long shisha ba nga la bakla, ka jingbakla jong nga ka sah bad nga hi .

en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kiba sian la ainong da ka jingtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng kaba suk: hynrei kiba stad ki shah pynkup burom da ka jingtip .

en: Congress leaders raise question over the development model of Gujarat .
kha: Ki nongialam ka Congress ki buh jingkylli halor ka rukom pynroi jong ka Gujarat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongialam ka Congress ki buh jingkylli halor ka rukom pynroi jong ka Gujarat .

en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee .
kha: Nangta thep hapoh ka synduk ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba ngan ai ha me , ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ha ka synduk ia ka jingphla kaba ngan ai ha me .

en: Job hath spoken without knowledge , and his words were without wisdom .
kha: ba u Job u kren da ka jingbymtip bad kano kano kaba u ong kam don jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Job u la kren khlem jingtip , bad ki ktien jong u ki long khlem jingstad .

en: Bharathi ' s song adds to the grandeur of the central character .  " "
kha: Ka jingrwai u Bharathi ka pyndap ia ka jingkhraw jong u tyngshop pdeng .  " "
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingrwai jong u Bharathi ka pyndap ia ka jingkhraw jong u nongthoh pdeng . "

en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka pyrthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bam lut ia kiei kiei baroh na ka ri , ong U Trai .

en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .
kha: U sakhi uba lah ban shaniah , borabor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei u bym lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sakhi kaba iaineh kan ym thok: hynrei ka sakhi kaba bakla kan kren bein .

en: This formula generalizes Heron ' s formula for the area of a triangle .
kha: Kane ka formula ka pynlong kyllum ia ka formula jong u Heron na ka bynta ka area jong ka triangle .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka formula ka pynlong kyllum ia ka formula jong u Heron na ka bynta ka jaka jong ka triangle .

en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia .
kha: Kumta phi la kylla long ka nuksa ïa kiba ngeit baroh ha Makedonia bad ha Akhaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba phi la long ki nuksa ia baroh kiba ngeit ha Makedonia bad Akhaia .

en: And I will dwell among the children of Israel , and will be their God .
kha: Te ngan shongduh hapdeng ki Israel bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shong hapdeng ki khun Israel bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

en: The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .
kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kaba ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan sa wan shen !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjynjar kaba ar ka la leit noh bad , ha khmih , ka jingjynjar kaba lai ka wan kloi .

en: And the sons of Issachar  ; Tola , and Phuvah , and Job , and Shimron .
kha: U Issakhar bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Issakhar ; Tola, bad u Phuvah, bad u Job, bad u Shimron .

en: Who remembered us in our low estate : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: Um shym la klet ïa ngi mynba ngi la shahjop ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba kynmaw ia ngi ha ka jaka kaba rit jong ngi: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: And he did evil , because he prepared not his heart to seek the  Lord .
kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , namar ba um shym pyrshang ban wad ïa ka mon U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew , namar um shym la pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong u ban wad ia U Trai .

en: Tell me , ye that desire to be under the law , do ye not hear the law ?
kha: Shah ïa nga ban kylli ïa kito na phi kiba kwah ban im hapoh ka Hukum : Hato phim ïohsngew aïu ka Hukum ka ong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia nga , phi kiba kwah ban don hapoh ka hukum , phim iohsngew ia ka hukum ?

en: The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,
kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi , bad ki dieng jong ka , bad ka jaka shong jingisynei , .

en: The lips of the righteous feed many : but fools die for want of wisdom .
kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki pynmyntoi ïa kiba bun ki briew , hynrei phin pynïap ïa lade da ka jingmutlop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong kiba hok ki ai bam bun: hynrei ki bieit ki iap namar ka jingkyrduh ia ka jingstad .

en: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God , they are the sons of God .
kha: Kito ïa kiba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei , ki long ki khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba la ialam da U Mynsiem U Blei , ki long ki khun U Blei .

en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for his word was with power .
kha: Baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai , namar u la kren da ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai jong u: namar ka ktien jong u ka la long da ka bor .

en: For their heart studieth destruction , and their lips talk of mischief .
kha: Ka jingthaw kulmar ka long baroh ba ki ju pyrkhat ; man la ka por ba ki ang la ki shyntur don mano re mano ban shah pynmong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dohnud jong ki ka pule ia ka jingpynjot, bad ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ki kren ia ka jingbymman .

en: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .
kha: ki ieit ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew bad ban shah khot ha ki briew ‘ ko Nonghikai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingai khublei ha ki iew ki hat, bad ban shah khot ki briew, Rabbi, Rabbi .

en: Son of man , set thy face against mount Seir , and prophesy against it ,
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia u lum Seir , bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ka , .

en: His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .
kha: Katto katne ki briew ki koit ki khiah haduh ka sngi ka jingïap ; ki ïap suk bad khlem shitom , ki met jong ki kiba la ïoh jingbsa bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bniat jong u ki dap da ka dud , bad ki shyieng jong u ki la tyrkhong da ka sniehdoh .

en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,
kha: ka linen kaba ni ; u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la suh da u shñiuh blang ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw, bad ka sniehdoh kaba jem, bad ki blang kiba jem .

en: And till Moses had done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .
kha: Ynda u Moses u la lah ïakren bad ki , u tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haduh ba u Moses u la dep ban kren bad ki , u la buh ia ka jingtap ha ka khmat jong u .

en: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
kha: Kum ki wah kiba la sangeh noh ban tuid , bad ki pung-um kiba la rngad noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki um ki nang duna na ka duriaw , bad ka jingshlei um ka nang pyut bad nang tyrkhong:

en: In Bihar , the BJP was defeated as all its opponents had come together .
kha: Ha Bihar ka BJP ka la shah rem namar baroh ki nongialeh pyrshah jong ka ki la iawan lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Bihar , ka BJP ka la shah rem namar baroh ki nongpyrshah jong ka ki la iawan lang .

en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Lydda bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba shong ha Lydda bad u Saron ki la iohi ia u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .

en: And he said unto them , Exact no more than that which is appointed you .
kha: Wat lum palat ïa kaba shong aiñ ,  u la ong ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Ym palat ia kata kaba la buh ia phi .

en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,
kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Ebal ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joshua u la tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ha u lum Ebal , .

en: I said ,  " Please call me Kitkat in all further correspondence . " " "
kha: Nga la ong,  "Sngewbha khot ia nga Kitkat ha baroh ki jingthoh kiba kham sha khmat . " " "
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong, "Sngewbha khot ia nga Kitkat ha baroh ki jingiadei kiba kham bniah ."

en: But woe unto you that are rich ! for ye have received your consolation .
kha: Hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba riewspah mynta ; phi la lah ïoh ïa ka jingim suk !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei sngewsih ia phi kiba riewspah ! namar phi la ioh ia ka jingpyntngen jong phi .

en: And they brought the young man alive , and were not a little comforted .
kha: Ki la ïalam sha ïing ïa uta u samla uba dang im , bad la pyntngen ïa ki shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia uta u samla uba im , bad kim shym la shah pyntngen khyndiat .

en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid ? and his dread fall upon you ?
kha: bad ka bor jong u kan pyndap ïa me da ka jingtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jingbha jong u kan ym pyntieng ia phi ? bad ka jingtieng jong u kan hap halor jong phi ?

en: Remember ye not the former things , neither consider the things of old .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat snoh ha ki jingjia jong ka mynnor ne shongsah ha kaei kaba la jia slem mynshuwa .
