translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa , wat pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba rim .

en: Be not wise in thine own eyes : fear the  Lord  , and depart from evil .
kha: Wat buh ka jingpyrkhat ha lade ba phi kham stad ban ïa kaba phi long ; shu kohnguh beit ïa U  Trai  , bad kiar ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long uba stad ha la ki jong ki khmat: to tieng ia U Trai , bad to phet noh na kaba sniew .

en: I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
kha: Nga tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki dang don , hynrei ki pynsamthiah ia nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tharai ka long kaba bha ba ki kot ki dang don , hynrei ki pynlong ia nga ban thiah .

en: We appreciate your patience and understanding as we resolve this matter.
kha: Ngi sngewnguh ïa ka jingïaishah bad jingsngewthuh jong phi katba ngi dang pynbeit ïa kane ka kam.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewnguh ia ka jingshaniah bad jingsngewthuh jong phi katba ngi dang pynbeit ia kane ka kam.

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Pray not for this people for their good .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Wat kyrpad ïa nga ban ïarap ïa kine ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga , Wat duwai na ka bynta kane ka jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki .

en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .
kha: Ka ding ka dei ban ïai meh lynter halor ka duwan bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ding kan long kaba thang ha ka almari ; kan ym mih satia .

en: And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
kha: Ynda u Saul u la dep kata ka jingïashad shongshit bad ka jingrisa , u leit kiew sha ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la pyndep ia ka jingiathuhlypa , u la poi ha ka jaka kaba jrong .

en: That it may be well with thee , and thou mayest live long on the earth .
kha: Khnang ba baroh kan long bha bad phi , bad ba phi lah ban im slem ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan long kaba bha bad me , bad me lah ban im slem ha ka khyndew .

en: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We value your trust in us.
kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la wanrah ïa kane ha ka jingtip jong ngi. Ngi khein kor ïa ka jingshanïah jong phi ha ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun ba phi wanrah ia kane ha ka jingpyrkhat jong ngi. Ngi khein kor ia ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ngi.

en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases , Abram drove them away .
kha: Ki pukni ki wan hiar ha kita ki metïap , hynrei u Abram u beh noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki sim ki la wan hiar sha ki met iap , u Abram u la beh noh ia ki .

en: A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;
kha: Ki sing , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh bad ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;
translated_en_to_kha: U sing uba khlain tam napdeng ki mrad , bad um phai noh na ka bynta uno uno u ; .

en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .
kha: Hynrei baroh kumjuh ki ïap bad la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki baroh la tap da ki kruiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin thiah kumjuh ha ka dewbilat bad ki khniang kin tap ia ki .

en: As the president of the Green club, he organized environmental programs.
kha: Kum u nongpynïaid ïa ka Green club, u la pynlong ïa ki prokram ïada mariang.
translated_en_to_kha: Kum u president jong ka Green club, u la pynlong ia ki prokram kiba iadei bad ka mariang.

en: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up ,
kha: Haba u Gideon u la wan phai na ka thma na ka lynti ka Khim Heres ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u khun u Joash u la wan phai na ka thma shuwa ba ka sngi kan mih , .

en: Now it was not written for his sake alone , that it was imputed to him ;
kha: Ïa ki ktien  La pdiang kum uba hok  ym shym la thoh tang na ka bynta jong u marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ym shym la thoh na ka bynta jong u marwei , ba la pynngat ha u ; .

en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty , and I desire to reason with God .
kha: Hynrei ka jingïasaid jong nga ka long bad U Blei , ym bad me ; Nga kwah ban pyn-i nia ïa ka kam jong nga bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ngan kren bad Uba donbor baroh , bad nga kwah ban iasaid bad U Blei .

en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .
kha: Ki Israel ki la hap hapoh u Eglon haduh khatphra snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khun Israel ki la shakri ia u Eglon u syiem u Eglon u syiem u Eglon u syiem u Eglon u Eglon u syiem u Eglon u Eglon u la shakri ia u Eglon u syiem u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon u Eglon

en: I don't think that Tom would be stupid enough to do something like that.
kha: Ngam tharai re ba u Tom un bieij haduh katta katta ba un leh kumto.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam tharai ba u Tom un long uba bieit ban leh ia kaei kaei kaba kum kata.

en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .
kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor long U  Trai  jong ngi ; ïa ka jingstad jong u ym lah ban thew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba khraw ia U Trai jong ngi , bad ka bor kaba khraw: ka jingsngewthuh jong u ka long kaba khlem kut .

en: And they spit upon him , and took the reed , and smote him on the head .
kha: Ki la bynthiew ïa u , bad ki la shim ïa u dieng bad ki la tied ïa U ha ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngap jar ia u, bad ki la shim ia u sohjew bad ki la sdang ia u ha ka khlieh .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .
kha: Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kawei ka jingjynjar hadien kawei pat kan wan ha pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Ka jingsniew, tang kawei ka jingsniew, ha khmih ka wan .

en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left : remove thy foot from evil .
kha: Kiar na kaba sniew bad ïaid beit sha khmat . Wat jam palat na ka lynti kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang: weng noh ia ka kjat jong me na kaba sniew .

en: My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, wat klet ia ka hukum jong nga ; hynrei to ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan sumar ia ki hukum jong nga:

en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .
kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban tuh, lymne ban leh thok, lymne ban thok iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me , and now hear to be in me .
kha: Mynta phi lah ban ïashim bynta lem bad nga ha ka thma . Ka dei kajuh ka thma kaba phi la ïohi ïa nga ba nga la ïaleh ha ki por kiba mynshuwa , bad kumba phi ïohsngew , ïa kata kaba nga dang ïaleh haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia kajuh ka jingialeh kaba phi la iohi ha nga , bad mynta phi iohsngew ba ka don ha nga .

en: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .
kha: bad shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa ka lieng bad ïa la u kpa bad ki la ïaleit bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh mardor na ka lieng bad u kpa jong ki bad ki la bud ia u .

en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,
kha: Kumta te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ;  Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata (kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong , Ha ka sngi lada phin iohsngew ia ka sur jong u , .

en: After my words they spake not again  ; and my speech dropped upon them .
kha: kim don ei ei shuh ban ai jingmut haba nga la dep kren . Ki ktien jong nga ki ngam kum ki jingjaw jong u slap ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ki ktien jong nga kim ju kren shuh ; bad ka jingkren jong nga ka la hap halor jong ki .

en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa U Blei jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Blei jong ka bneng: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .
kha: Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga ; kita kiba wad ïa nga kin shem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ieit ia ki kiba ieit ia nga ; bad kito kiba wad ia nga kloi kin shem ia nga .

en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , and he would not let them go .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad um shym la shah ïa ki ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u Pharaoh bad un ym pyllait ia ki .

en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .
kha: Lada ka ri ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka ri kan kyllon noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada la phiah ia ka hima pyrshah ia lade , kata ka hima kam lah ban ieng .

en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .
kha: Baroh shi sngi nga ïaroh ïa me bad pynbna ïa ka burom jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka shyntur jong nga kan dap da ka jingiaroh jong me bad da ka burom jong me baroh shisngi .

en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
kha: Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , ngi ainguh ïa me , bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata ko Blei jong ngi ngi ainguh ia me bad ngi iaroh ia ka kyrteng ba donburom jong me .

en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .
kha: Nga la klet noh kaba kumno ka jingkhiah bad ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen ki long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la weng noh ia ka mynsiem jong nga na ka jingsuk: Nga klet ia ka jingroi jingpar .

en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?
kha: Kin jin da la dei ban kwah ïa ka jingkmen ba u ai ; kin jin da la dei ban duwai borabor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un sngewbha ia lade ha Uba donbor baroh ? hato un khot beit ia U Blei ?

en: And the sons of Javan  ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jaban ki long ki briew jong ka Elishah , ka Spain , ka Sypros , bad ka Rhodes ; ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba shong ha ki rud duriaw bad ha ki dewlynnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Javan ; Elisah, bad u Tarshish, u Kittim bad u Dodanim .

en: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me : teach me thy statutes .
kha: Nga phla ïa baroh kaba nga la leh , bad me la jubab ïa nga ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynbna ia ki lynti jong nga , bad me la iohsngew ia nga: hikai ia nga ia ki ain jong me .

en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , kiwei pat kin ïoh ïa ka burom kaba phi la ïoh shisien , bad phin ïap samla ha ki kti ki briew ki bym don jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ia ka burom jong me ha kiwei pat bad ki snem jong me ha kiba shyrkhei:

en: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly .
kha: Kynsan kynsan nga shem ïa lade ha ka jingjahburom ha khmat u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la don ha ka jingsniew baroh hapdeng ka balang bad ka jingiaseng .

en: And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .
kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga dang shu shongkurim , bad na kata ka daw ngam lah ban wan .’
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u la ong , Nga la shongkurim ia ka tnga bad namarkata ngam lah ban wan .

en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba baroh kaba don ka mynsiem kan iaroh ia U Trai . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: They ravished the women in Zion , and the maids in the cities of Judah .
kha: Ïa ki tnga jong ngi la batbor ha u lum Seïon hi ; ha man ki nongrit ka Judia ïa ki khun kynthei jong ngi la pynbor ban pyndem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia ki kynthei ha Seion , bad ki shakri ha ki nongbah Judah .

en: Let him eschew evil , and do good  ; let him seek peace , and ensue it .
kha: U dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew bad ban leh ïa kaba bha ; u dei ban ïaleh shitom na ka bynta ka jingsuk da ka dohnud jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba un sngap jar ia kaba sniew, bad leh bha; to ai ba un wad ia ka jingsuk, bad pynbud ia ka .

en: I will take the cup of salvation , and call upon the name of the  Lord .
kha: Ngan wallam ka jingainguh waiñ sha U  Trai  , ban ainguh ïa u namar ka jingpynim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shim ia ka khuri jong ka jingpynim , bad ngan khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust : quicken thou me according to thy word .
kha: Nga thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha ka khyndew ; to pynkhie im biang ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong nga ka rung sha ka dewmet: me pynkloi ia nga kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :
kha: La don ruh ka Ain , ka Rimmon , ka Ether , bad ka Ashan : saw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ain , Rimmon , bad Ether , bad Ashan ; saw tylli ki nongbah bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Make this valley full of ditches .
kha: bad u ong ,  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Tih nur-um ha kylleng kane ka phud um baryngkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kumta u Trai u ong , Pynlong ia kane ka them kaba dap da ki thliew .

en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .
kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ngut ki tnga na ka bynta u syiem Joash , bad ki kha ïa u , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiada u la shim na ka bynta jong u arngut ki tnga ; bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Minister of State for Child Development in the Raj Panchayat Department.
kha: Myntri Khynnah ha ka Tnat Panchayati Raj.
translated_en_to_kha: U Myntri ka sorkar jylla na ka bynta ka jingroi jingpar jong ki khynnah ha ka tnad Raj Panchayat.

en: And Bilhah Rachel s maid conceived again , and bare Jacob a second son .
kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun biang , bad ka la kha khun shynrang uba ar ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bilhah u la pun khun biang, bad u la kha ia u Jakob u khun shynrang uba ar .

en: My son , attend unto my wisdom , and bow thine ear to my understanding :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , to sngap bad shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, to leit sha ka jingstad jong nga, bad to dem ia ka shkor jong me ha ka jingsngewthuh jong nga:

en: Aijalon with her suburbs , Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Aijalon , bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Aijalon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, Gathrimmon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka ; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: The elders have ceased from the gate , the young men from their musick .
kha: Ki tymmen kim shong shuh ha ka khyrdop nongbah , bad ki samla kim tem jingtem shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah ki la sangeh noh na ka khyrdop , ki samla na ka jingsawa jong ki .

en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .
kha: Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh ha ka Duriaw Basaw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kam kiba shyrkhei ha ka ri Ham , bad kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei da ka duriaw Basaw .

en: For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass s colt .
kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop kin sdang ban long kiba stad haba kha ïa ki kada khlaw ban long kum kiba la pynjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u briew uba la shah pynbiej un long uba stad, wat la u briew un kha kum u blang khlaw.

en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .
kha: Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki briew ban mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Une u paralok u pynsngewthuh ia ki briew ban mane ia U Blei pyrshah ia ka ain .

en: Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .
kha: A  Trai  , to pynshitom ïa kito ki riewbymman ! To kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, ko Trai; ko Blei, to rah ia la ka kti: wat klet ia kiba pynrit mynsiem .

en: Actress Alia Bhatt has a white Persian cat , whom she has named Edward .
kha: Ka actress Alia Bhatt ka don kawei ka miaw Persian kaba lieh , ia kaba ka la ai kyrteng Edward .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Alia Bhatt ka don ka masi Persian kaba lieh, kaba ka la jer kyrteng Edward .

en: And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
kha: Uwei u briew uba ki kjat bad ki kti jong u ki la sieb u la wan sha U Jisu ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la don uwei u briew ha khmat jong u uba don ka jingduna .

en: Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,
kha: Haba u Saul u la synshar ar snem ha Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la synshar shi snem bad haba u la synshar ar snem halor ki Israel .

en: ( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures , )
kha: Ïa ka Khubor Babha la kular la slem bah da U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Kaba u la kular lypa da ki nongiathuhlypa jong u ha ki jingthoh bakhuid , )

en: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga dem khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kane ka daw nga dem khrup ha U Kpa jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , .

en: And now she is planted in the wilderness , in a dry and thirsty ground .
kha: Mynta la thung ïa u ha ka ri shyiap , ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym don um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta la thung ia ka ha ka ri khlaw , ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang bad kaba sliang .

en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?
kha: Phi la lehbha katta katta! Uei uba la pynlong ïa phi ban sangeh ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la mareh bha ; mano ba khanglad ia phi ba phin ym kohnguh ia ka jingshisha ?

en: And Beth–nimrah , and Beth–haran , fenced cities : and folds for sheep .
kha: Beth Nimrah , bad Beth Haran .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Bethnimrah, bad ka Bethharan, ki nongbah ba la ker: bad ki jingpynkylla na ka bynta ki langbrot .

en: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un buh ia u bad ki syiem , wat bad ki syiem jong ki briew jong u .

en: Now the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the son of Amittai , saying ,
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah u khun jong u Amittai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jonah u khun u Amittai da kaba ong:

en: They shall roar together like lions : they shall yell as lions  whelps .
kha: Ki nong Babilonia baroh ki kyrhuh kum ki sing bad jlew kum ki khun sing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ia rkhie lang kum ki sing: kin pyrta kum ki sing baroh .

en: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation , and offerings .
kha: Hadien ba nga la don bun snem shabar na Jerusalem , nga la leit shata ban rah katto katne ka pisa sha ki briew jong nga bad ban ai ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien bun snem nga la wan wanrah ia ki soh sha ka jaitbynriew jong nga , bad ki jingainguh .

en: Cease not to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ;
kha: ngam shym la sangeh ban ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Sangeh noh ban ainguh ia phi , da kaba kdew ia phi ha ki jingduwai jong nga ;

en: " Paddy is sown on 13 lakh hectares across 10 districts of Haryana . "
kha: " Ia u khaw la bet ha ka jaka kaba 13 lak hectare ha kylleng ki 10 tylli ki District jong ka Haryana . "
translated_en_to_kha: " Ia u Paddy la bet ha ki 13 lak hectare ha kylleng ki 10 tylli ki distrik jong ka Haryana ."

en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the  Lord .
kha: Da kumta u Moses u ai ha ki Israel ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingrakhe ïa ka jinglehniam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynbna ha ki khun Israel ia ki jingkhawai jong U Trai .

en: A froward man soweth strife : and a whisperer separateth chief friends .
kha: Ki riewbymman ki pynphriang ïa ki ktien lorni ; ki pynjynjar bad pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sngewsih u bet ia ka jingialeh: bad u paralok rangbah uba kham sngap jar .

en: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name s sake .
kha: Bad nga hi ngan pyn-i ha u ïa baroh kaba u dei ban shah na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pyni ia u katno kiei kiei kiba khraw u dei ban shah shitom na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: Who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the frowardness of the wicked  ;
kha: ki briew kiba sngewtynnat ha kaba leh kam sniew bad kiba lehkmen ha ki kam bymman ki bym don jingmut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba sngewbha ban leh ia kaba sniew , bad uba sngewbha ia ka jingsngewsih jong ki bymman ; .

en: Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her .
kha: te to ai ba ka tnga jong nga kan shet ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta uwei pat u briew bad ban thiah ha ka jingthiah jong uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ai ba ka tnga jong nga kan khih ha kawei pat , bad ai ba kiwei kin dem khrup halor jong ka .

en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me .
kha: ngan sdien ïa kita ha la ka tyrpeng da kaba sngewsarong bad ngan buh ïa ki ha ka khlieh kum ka pansngiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ngan shim ia ka ha ka tyrpeng jong nga , bad ngan teh ia ka kum ka khlieh ha nga .

en: But we were gentle among you , even as a nurse cherisheth her children :
kha: wat la kum ki apostol jong U Khrist ngi lah ban dawa na phi . Hynrei ngi la long kiba jai jai mynba ngi la don bad phi , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa ki khun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi la long kiba jemnud hapdeng jong phi, kumba ka nurse ka sumar ia ki khun jong ka:

en: Your order has been placed successfully. Thank you for shopping with us.
kha: Ka ordar jong phi ka la long. Khublei shibun ïa phi ba phi la thied jingthied bad ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka order jong u ka la long kaba jop. Khublei shibun ba phi la leit thied bad ngi.

en: Then came the first , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained ten pounds .
kha: Uba nyngkong u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar da kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan uba nyngkong, u da ong, ko Trai, ka pound jong me ka la nang kiew shiphew pound .

en: One of his disciples , Andrew , Simon Peter s brother , saith unto him ,
kha: Uwei pat na ki synran jong u , u Andriw , uba long u para jong u Simon Petros , u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki synran jong u , u Andrei , u hynmen u Simon Peter u ong ha u .

en: Also to punish the just is not good , nor to strike princes for equity .
kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynlong ïa u briew balui lui ban siew ïa ka kuna ; ka pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar bahok haba ki briew kiba bha ki shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ban pynshitom ia kiba hok kam long kaba bha, lane ban shoh ia ki syiem na ka bynta ka jinglong mar ryngkat .

en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
kha: U Asa u syiem ka Judah bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Asa bad u syiem Israel baroh ki sngi jong ki .

en: Ye are not straitened in us , but ye are straitened in your own bowels .
kha: Ym dei ma ngi kiba la khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha phi ; dei ma phi kiba khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la shah pynkhih ha ngi , hynrei phi la shah pynkhih ha la ki jong ki bniat .

en: And of Dan he said , Dan is a lion s whelp : he shall leap from Bashan .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Dan u ong ,  U Dan u dei u sing samla ; Na Bashan u mih kynsan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Dan u la ong, u Dan u long u sing: un leit noh na Basan .

en: The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .
kha: Ïa U  Trai  yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïap , da kino kino kiba leit hiar sha ka ri ka jingsngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba iap kim iaroh ia U Trai , lymne ia uno uno uba leit shapoh ka jingsngap jar .

en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat , and let her fall off .
kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la ot noh ïa ki tyllai kiba bat ïa ka lieng rit bad ki la pyllait ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shipai ki la ot ia ki lynti jong ka lieng , bad ki la ai ba kan hap noh .

en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew la shna da ka rupa bad ka ksiar ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bleithaw jong ki nongwei ki long ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong ki briew .

en: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .
kha: bad ki shad katba nang tem ïa ki duitara bad put ïa ki tangmuri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim ia ka timbrel bad ka harp , bad ki sngewbha ia ka sur jong ka organ .

en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Phi ki paid Israel , phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad ïeng ïaleh ïa nga . Hynrei mynta , to phai pat sha nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai sha u na uba ki khun Israel ki la kylla long kiba jylliew .

en: Later , in Jerusalem , supporters of circumcision contended with Peter .
kha: Hadien ha Jerusalem ki nongkyrshan jong ka jingotsher ki la ialeh pyrshah bad u Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien , ha Jerusalem , ki nongkyrshan jong ka jingotsher ki la ialeh pyrshah bad u Petros .

en: And blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair ,
kha: ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; ka jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw, bad ka sniehdoh kaba jem, bad ki blang kiba jem .

en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki ong shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kito kiba ong kum kine kiei kiei ki pynbna shai ba ki wad ia ka ri .

en: And the  Lord  said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do  ;
kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ha lade ,  Ngan nym buhrieh na u Abraham ïa kaei kaba ngan sa leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Ngan buhrieh na u Abraham ia kata kaba nga leh;

en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .
kha: Ki maw jong ka khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , bad ki pui pui jong u ki don ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki maw jong ka ki long ka jaka jong ki sapphir: bad ka don ka dewmet ksiar .

en: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .
kha: Ki im ka jingim ha ka jingsuk bad ki ïap suk khlem ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynlut ia ki sngi jong ki ha ka spah , bad ha ka khyllipmat ki hiar sha ka jingtep .

en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .
kha: bad un wallam pat ïa ki briew babun sha U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki khun Israel kin phai sha U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: Also now , behold , my witness is in heaven , and my record is on high .
kha: Don mano mano ha bneng u ban ïeng na ka bynta jong nga bad u ban don ha ka liang jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh mynta, ha khmih, ka sakhi jong nga ka don ha bneng, bad ka rekod jong nga ka don ha jrong .

en: For when ye were the servants of sin , ye were free from righteousness .
kha: Mynba phi la long ki mraw jong ka pop , phi la lait noh na ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba phi long ki shakri jong ka pop , phi la lait na ka hok .

en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time .
kha: Pynban don kaei kaei kaba khang ïa kane ban jia mynta , bad phi tip ka dei kaei . Ha ka por kaba biang , te , Uta Uba Sniew un mihpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta phi tip ia kaei kaba khanglad ba un shah pynpaw ha ka por jong u .

en: O house of Jacob , come ye , and let us walk in the light of the  Lord .
kha: Mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , to ngin ïaid ha ka jingshai kaba U  Trai  u ai ha ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko iing u Jakob , to wan , bad to ngin iaid ha ka jingshai U Trai .

en: ( And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria . )
kha: Haba kane ka jingkheiñbriew kaba nyngkong ka la jia , u Kyrinios u long u lyngskor jong ka Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: (Bad ia kane ka jingsiew khajna la leh nyngkong eh ha ka por ba u Cyrenius u long u Lat jong ka Syria . )

en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?
kha: haba ki rieh ha la ki krem ne haba ki dem ban ap ha la ki krem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki shong ha ki thliew jong ki , bad ki kohnguh ha ka jaka rieh ban thiah ?

en: To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Tang ma u hi u leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba marwei u leh ia ki jingphylla kiba khraw: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Withdraw thine hand far from me : and let not thy dread make me afraid .
kha: Shah ba ngan pan ar tylli kiei kiei ; to mynjur ïa ki , bad ngan nym pyrshang ban buhrieh na me : to sangeh noh ban pynshitom ïa nga , bad wat khñiot ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka kti jong me na nga: bad wat ai ba ka jingtieng jong me kan pyntieng ia nga .

en: The  Lord  is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .
kha: U  Trai  u synshar halor ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka burom jong u ka don halor ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long uba ha khlieh duh halor ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad ka burom jong u halor ki bneng .

en: And it was known throughout all Joppa  ; and many believed in the Lord .
kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la par kylleng ka Joppa , bad bun ki briew ki la ngeit ha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la tip ia ka ha baroh kawei ka Joppa ; bad bun ki la ngeit ha U Trai .

en: The  Lord  thundered from heaven , and the most High uttered his voice .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kyrhuh na suiñbneng , bad ïa ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh la ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pyrta na bneng , bad uba ha khlieh duh u la pynmih ia ka sur jong u .

en: Open thou mine eyes , that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law .
kha: To pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïohi ïa ki jingshisha baphylla hapoh ka aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia ki khmat jong nga , ba ngan iohi ia kiei kiei kiba phylla na ka hukum jong me .

en: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives .
kha: U la pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbanbeiñ jong ki ban sngewsynei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ruh ia ki ban sngewsynei ia kito baroh kiba rah ia ki mraw .

en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
kha: Me la pynduhbor ïa nga , A Blei ; me la shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta u la pynlong ia nga ban sngewsih: me la pynlong ia ka kynhun jong nga baroh .

en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
kha: Ngam pat ju leh pop da kaba duwai ba kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam shym la shah shitom ha ka shyntur jong nga ban leh pop da kaba kwah ia ka jingtim ia ka mynsiem jong u .

en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
kha: Kumta phin sumar bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad leh ia ki: Nga long U Trai .

en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
kha: U Asa u syiem Judah bad u Baasha u syiem Israel ki don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma hapdeng jong ki katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Asa bad u syiem Israel baroh ki sngi jong ki .

en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul .
kha: Haba nga lyng-a bad khuslai , me pyntngen bad pynkmen ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingbun ki jingpyrkhat jong nga hapoh jong nga ki jingsuk jong me ki pynsngewbha ia ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .
kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la kynthoh ia u, u da ong: To bat ia ka jingsuk jong me bad to mih noh na u .

en: And his servants conspired against him , and slew him in his own house .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la thmu pyrshah ia u , bad ki la pyniap ia u ha la iing .

en: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .
kha: Ka don ka jingmaïan kaba la pynpaw ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , kaba nga sngewthuh kaba thew ïa U Khrist bad ïa ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingmaham kaba khraw: hynrei nga kren shaphang U Khrist bad ka balang .

en: But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ba ka don kaei kaei hangne kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba ha kane ka jaka ka long kaba kham khraw ban ia ka tempi .

en: Women entrepreneurs from 16 different states across India participated .
kha: Ki kynthei nongseng kam seng jam na ki 16 tylli ki jylla bapher bapher ha kylleng ka ri India ki la iashim bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei nongseng kam seng jam na ki 16 tylli ki jylla bapher bapher ha kylleng ka ri India ki la iashim bynta .

en: The calamity of Moab is near to come , and his affliction hasteth fast .
kha: Ka jingshahjop jong ka Moab ka la jan ; ka jingjot jong ka , ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjynjar jong u Moab ka la jan wan , bad ka jingjynjar jong u ka la nang stet .

en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :
kha: To ngin pyrkhat khia uwei ïa uwei pat , ban ïarap uwei ïa uwei pat , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingïa-ieit bad ban lehbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ngin ia pyrkhat iwei ia iwei pat ban pynkhih ia ka jingieit bad ia ki kam kiba bha:

en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .
kha: Wat tieng ïa ki , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka bynta jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban tieng ia ki: namar U Trai U Blei jong phi un ialeh na ka bynta jong phi .

en: Lala Hardayal was building up his revolutionary Gaddar Party in America .
kha: U Lala Hardayal u dang tei ia ka seng Gaddar kaba la pynlong ia ka jingkhihwin ha ri America .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lala Hardayal u dang tei ia ka kynhun Gaddar jong u ha America .

en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .
kha: Lada hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap ban siew na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa u Kain , Hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap lada uno uno u pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u Kain un shah pynshitom hynriew shah, shisha u Lamech hynriewphew hynriew .

en: This is my commandment , That ye love one another , as I have loved you .
kha: Ka hukum jong nga ka long kane : To ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba nga ieit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong nga , Ba phi ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat kumba nga la ieit ia phi .

en: The snare is laid for him in the ground , and a trap for him in the way .
kha: Ha ka khyndew ïa ka jingriam la buhrieh ; ïa ka jingriam la pynap ha ka lynti ïaid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka snare ka long na ka bynta jong u ha ka khyndew , bad ka jingma na ka bynta jong u ha ka lynti .

en: They took the young men to grind , and the children fell under the wood .
kha: Ïa ki samla shynrang jong ngi la pynbor ban tylliat kew kum ki mraw ; ki khynnah shynrang ki ïaid sheng sheng hapoh ka jingkit dieng bakhia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki samla ban khih , bad ki khynnah ki la hap hapoh u dieng .

en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .
kha: La pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka pop bad phi la long pat ki mraw jong ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba lait na ka pop , phi la kylla long ki shakri jong ka hok .

en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki ruh da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki dieng kiba shittim , bad to tap ia ki da ka ksiar .

en: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .
kha: U Soitan u la kwah ban wallam jingjynjar ha ki paid Israel , kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban rai ban shim ka jingkheiñbriew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Soitan u la ieng pyrshah ia ki Israel , bad u la pynkhih ia u Dabid ban khein ia ki Israel .

en: And Goshen , and Holon , and Giloh  ; eleven cities with their villages :
kha: ka Goshen , ka Holon , bad ka Giloh : khatwei tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Goshen bad u Holon bad u Giloh ; shiphew tylli ki shnong jong ki:

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron ha Ijipt :
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron ha ka ri Ijipt da kaba ong:

en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .
kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ki jingjubab bastad jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba la iohsngew ia u ki la lyngngoh ia ka jingsngewthuh bad ki jubab jong u .

en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask .
kha: U Herod u la sngewbha eh haduh ba u la kular ïa ka ,  Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha ïa kano kano kaba pha pan !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u la kular da ka jingsmai ban ai ia ka ia kaei kaei kaba ka pan .

en: And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .
kha: ka Ophir , ka Habilah , bad ka Jobab . Kine baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Ophir bad u Habil bad u Jobb: kine baroh ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Joktan .

en: Riches and honour are with me  ; yea , durable riches and righteousness .
kha: Nga don ka spah bad ka burom ban ai , ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki spah bad ka burom ki don bad nga ; yea , ki spah bad ka hok kiba neh slem .

en: Every purpose is established by counsel : and with good advice make war .
kha: Pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bha bad phin ïoh jingjop ; wat leit tur thma khlem da don ka dur pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kawei pa kawei ka jingthmu la pynskhem da ka jingai jingmut: bad da ka jingai jingmut kaba bha ka long ka thma .

en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
kha: U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem ; u kynrup ïa nga kum u sing .
translated_en_to_kha: U la long ha nga kum u bear uba thiah ha ka jaka ap , bad kum u sing ha ki jaka ba rieh .

en: Which rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?
kha: Kim shym long kiba kmen haduh ka jingïap bad la tep ïa ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba sngewbha palat , bad ki sngewbha , haba ki lah ban shem ia ka jingtep ?

en: And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .
kha: Ki la wan phai bad ki la ïathuh ha kiwei pat , hynrei kim shym la ngeit ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit bad ki la iathuh ia kata ha ki jingsahkut: kim ngeit ia ki .

en: Huz his firstborn , and Buz his brother , and Kemuel the father of Aram ,
kha: u Us uba nyngkong , u Bus u para jong u , u Kemuel u kpa jong u Aram ,
translated_en_to_kha: Huz u khun nyngkong jong u , bad u Buz u hynmen jong u , bad u Kemuel u kpa jong u Aram .

en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Isaïah u khun jong u Amos shaphang ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien ba u Isaiah u khun u Amoz u la iohi shaphang ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

en: For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
kha: Ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba rem bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka umphniang ka lah ban long kaba la die shibun , bad la ai ha kiba duk .

en: Therefore whether it were I or they , so we preach , and so ye believed .
kha: Kumta te , kam pher lada ka la wan na nga ne na ki , kane ka long kaei kaba ngi baroh ngi ïalap , bad kane ka long kaei kaba phi ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la ka long ma nga ne ma ki , kumta ngi ialap , bad kumta phi la ngeit .

en: Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .
kha: Ai ba ki briew jong U Blei kin shadkmen ha ka jingjop jong ki bad rwai da kaba kmen baroh shi miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki riewkhuid kin sngewbha ha ka burom: ai ba kin rwai jam halor ki jingthiah jong ki .

en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
kha: Nangta ki la rwai ïa ka jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la rwai ia ka jingrwai , ki la leit shabar sha u lum jong ki Olive .

en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .
kha: Kumta u Laban u pynlong ka jingkhawai shongkurim bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la lum lang ia ki briew baroh jong kata ka jaka bad u la leh ia ka jingkhawai .

en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .
kha: Ngi la ïadon baroh arspah hynñiewphew hynriew ngut ha ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la don ha ka lieng baroh arspah sanphew ngut ki mynsiem .

en: Rather , he told his disciples to memorialize , or remember , his death .
kha: Hynrei , u ong ïa la ki synran ban iai-kynmaw , lane ban kynmaw ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ia ki synran jong u ban kynmaw ia ka jingiap jong u .

en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ban nym khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la leh ia ka jutang bad ki khmat jong nga ; balei te nga dei ban pyrkhat ia ka nongtrei ?

en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
kha: Men shu peit bad men ïohi kumno ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang da ki khmat jong me me peit bad peit ia ka bainong jong kiba sniew .

en: Let us choose to us judgment : let us know among ourselves what is good .
kha: Ka shong ha ngi ban rai ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin jied ia ngi: to ngin tip hapdeng jong ngi ia kaei kaba bha .

en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;
kha: Hynrei kim phai sha U Blei , u Nongthaw jong ki , uba ai jingkyrmen ïa ki ha ki kynta kiba dum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym don ba ong , Hangno U Blei u nongthaw jong nga uba ai jingrwai ha ka miet ; .

en: When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iohsngew ia kane , la pynbaptis ia ki ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .

en: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah kiba bun ki la bud ia u .

en: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord , so walk ye in him :
kha: Naduh ba phi la pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu kum U Trai , to im ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba phi la pdiang ia U Khrist Jisu U Trai, kumta to iaid ha u:

en: And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .
kha: Khatduh eh u la paw ruh ha nga — wat la nga long kum uta uba la kha khlem biang por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad khatduh eh la iohi ia u ruh na nga ruh, kum uwei uba la kha na ka por kaba biang .

en: I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .
kha: Nga ong ha lade ba nga dei ban kren , ba ma phi kiba la kham rangbah phi dei ban ïasam lem ïa la ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , Ki sngi ki dei ban kren , bad bun snem ki dei ban hikai ia ka jingstad .

en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king , live for ever .
kha: Ki la ong ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren bad ki la ong ha u syiem Nebuchadnezzar , ko syiem, to im junom .

en: Your feedback is important to us. We will ensure your issue is addressed.
kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong phi ka long kaba kongsan ïa ngi. Ngin pynthikna ba ka jingeh jong phi kan shah pynbeit.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong phi ka long kaba kongsan ia ngi. Ngin sa pynthikna ba ia ka jingeh jong phi la pynbeit.

en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?
kha: Nga long uba kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei nga shim ia ka doh jong nga ha ki bniat jong nga bad nga buh ia ka jingim jong nga ha ka kti jong nga ?

en: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay  ;
kha: Ki bymman ki lah ban don shibun bha ka rupa ban ñiew bad shibun ki jingriam ban ïa kaba ki donkam ;
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u lum ia ka rupa kum ka dewbilat , bad u pynkhreh ia ka dewbilat kum ka dewbilat ; .

en: Mercy and truth preserve the king : and his throne is upholden by mercy .
kha: U syiem un ïai don ha ka bor katba ka jingsynshar jong u ka dang long kaba khuid , kaba hok , bad kaba biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewrit bad ka jingshisha ka pynneh ia u syiem: bad ka khet jong u ka la pynskhem da ka jingisynei .

en: We regret to hear about your experience. Let us investigate this for you.
kha: Ngi sngewsih ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingjïa jong phi. To ngin wad bnïah ïa kane na ka bynta jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewsih ban iohsngew ia ka jingshem jong phi. To ngin wad bniah ia kane na ka bynta jong phi.

en: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  To ap , to ngin peit lada u Elijah un wan bad pyllait im ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba sah ki la ong , To ngin ia peit la u Elias un wan ban pynim ia u .

en: And into whatsoever house ye enter , first say , Peace be to this house .
kha: Ha man ba phi rung ha kano kano ka ïing , to ong nyngkong , ‘ Ka jingsuk kan long ha kane ka ïing .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kano kano ka iing kaba phi rung, to ong nyngkong eh: Ka jingsuk kan long ha kane ka iing .

en: Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .
kha: Kaei kaba nga thoh ka long kaba shisha . U Blei hi u tip ba ngam shym lamler!
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiei kiei kiba nga thoh ha phi, ha khmat U Blei, ngam ju thok .

en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
kha: U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng: u la leh ia kaei kaei kaba u la mon .

en: Please allow [X] days for our team to review and respond to your concern.
kha: Sngewbha ailad [X] sngi ïa ka kynhun jong ngi ban bishar bnïah bad jubab ïa ka jingeh jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha ailad [X] sngi na ka bynta ka kynhun jong ngi ban bishar bniah bad jubab ia ka jingsngewkhia jong phi.

en: As the door turneth upon his hinges , so doth the slothful upon his bed .
kha: U briew uba jaipdeh u kylla thiah ha jingthiah , um leit jngai ban ïa ka jingkhang kaba padai ha la ki kopja .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka jingkhang ka phai sha ki tyrpeng jong u, kumta ka long kaba jem ha ka jingthiah jong u .

en: And they shall see his face  ; and his name shall be in their foreheads .
kha: Kin ïohi ïa ka durkhmat jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong u yn thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin iohi ia ka khmat jong u ; bad ka kyrteng jong u kan long ha ki khlieh jong ki .

en: The MLAs elect only those whom they like...Here in Khasiland, it is true.
kha: Ki MLA ngi jied tang uba ngi sngew ieid…Hangne ha ri khasi lah eh shisha.
translated_en_to_kha: Ki MLA ki jied tang ia kiba ki sngewtynnad...Hangne ha Khasiland, ka long kaba shisha.

en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?
kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la leh ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam shym la buh ha ka jaka buh bad nga , bad la khang hapdeng ki spah jong nga ?

en: The  Lord  preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me .
kha: U  Trai  u ïada ïa ki bym don jingïarap ; haba nga la don ha ka jingma , u la pyllait im ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u pynneh ia kaba suk: Nga la shah pynhiar dor , bad u la iarap ia nga .

en: When on earth Jesus cured the sick , fed the hungry , and calmed storms .
kha: Mynba u Jisu u don ha pyrthei u pynkoit ïa kiba pang , u pynkdang ïa kiba thngan bad u pynjaijai ïa ki eriong .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ha ka khyndew U Jisu u la pynkoit ia kiba pang, u la ai bam ia kiba thngan bad u la pynjem ia ki eriong .

en: Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .
kha: To pyllaitluid ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me ;
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh na nga ia ka jingshah lehbein bad ka jinglehbein ; namar nga la bat ia ki jingphla jong me .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against them  ; and he departed .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ; bad kumta katba u dang leit noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki ; bad u la leit noh .

en: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .
kha: kaba pynkylla maw ïa ka um , bad kaba pynkhriat ïa ka sla duriaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki buhrieh kum u maw , bad ka khmat jong ka jingjylliew ka la tyrkhong .

en: He then having received the sop went immediately out : and it was night .
kha: U Judas u la pdiang ïa u kpu bad mar kumta u la mihnoh shabar . Ka la long ka por mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ioh ia ka sop u la mih noh mardor: bad ka la dei ka miet .

en: Did I say , Bring unto me ? or , Give a reward for me of your substance ?
kha: Hato nga la pan na phi ban ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha lane ban tyrwa ei ei ïano ïano na ka bynta jong nga
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la ong , To wanrah ia nga ? lane , Ai ia ka bainong na ka bynta jong nga ?

en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang ki synran jong u bad shaphang ka jinghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah lyngdoh u la kylli ia U Jisu na ki synran jong u bad na ka jinghikai jong u .

en: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .
kha: Ki bymman ki tei ki ïing kum ka snur thapbawa lane kum ka ïingtrep u mraw uba ap phira ïa ki lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: U tei ia ka iing jong u kum u khnai bad kum ka thliew kaba u nongsumar u shna .

en: My bowels boiled , and rested not : the days of affliction prevented me .
kha: Ïa nga la tar arliang da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingpang ; nga la ïoh ïa ka jingjynjar na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bniat jong nga ki la rkhiang , bad kim shym la shongthait: ki sngi jong ka jingjynjar ki la khanglad ia nga .

en: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .
kha: To ai ba U Blei un thew ïa nga ha ki tarajur bahok , bad un ïohi katno uba lui lui nga long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ngan shah khia ha ka jinglong kaba iadei , ba U Blei un tip ia ka jinglong ba janai jong nga .

en: And as ye would that men should do to you , do ye also to them likewise .
kha: Leh ïa kiwei kumba phi kwah ïa ki ban leh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba phi kwah ba ki briew kin leh ia phi, to leh ia ki kumjuh .

en: Hast thou an arm like God ? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him ?
kha: Hato me long uba khlaiñ kum ma nga ? Hato ka sur jong me ka kyrhuh jam kum ka jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me long ka kti kum U Blei ? lane phi lah ban khih da ka sur kum ma u ?

en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication , and it was winter .
kha: Ka la long ka por tlang , bad ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam jong ka Jingpynkyntang ïa ka Templ dang rakhe ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long ha Jerusalem ka jingkhawai jong ka jingpynkyntang , bad ka la long ka por lyiur .

en: You must apply on the application form, filling in your name and surname.
kha: Un hab ban apply ha ka application form, pyndap ia ka kyrteng bad ka jait.
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban apply ha ka phorm jong ka aplikeshon, da kaba pyndap ia ka kyrteng bad ka kyrteng jong phi.

en: And the servants of Saul told him , saying , On this manner spake David .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki ïathuh ha u Saul ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri u Saul ki la iathuh ha u, ki da ong: Ha kane ka rukom u Dabid u la kren .

en: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .
kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad khatduh ïa kata baroh kawei la tan pat sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane la leh lai sien: bad baroh la ring biang sha bneng .

en: Glory to God in the highest , and on earth peace , good will toward men .
kha: Ka burom ïa U Blei ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam , bad ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ha kito kiba u sngewbha !
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia U Blei ha kaba ha khlieh duh , bad ha ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei , ka mon babha ia ki briew .

en: Verily I say unto you , That he shall make him ruler over all his goods .
kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ba un pynlong ia u ban synshar halor ki mar ki mata jong u baroh .

en: Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .
kha: Ki khun ki peitbeiñ ïa nga bad ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki khynnah rit ki la leh bein ia nga ; nga la ieng , bad ki la kren pyrshah ia nga .

en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .
kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ban ïathiah shongkha para shynrang . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju thiah bad u khun bynriew kumba long bad ki kynthei: ka long kaba sngewsih .

en: Cast thy bread upon the waters : for thou shalt find it after many days .
kha: Thep ïa ka pisa jong phi ha ka jingkhaïi bar ri bad ha kawei na kine ki sngi phin ïohnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh ia u kpu jong me halor ki um: namar men shem ia u hadien bun sngi .

en: They break in pieces thy people , O  Lord  , and afflict thine heritage .
kha: Ki pynlwet ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; ki banbeiñ ïa kito kiba long ki jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynpra ia ki briew jong me, ko Trai, bad ki pynshitom ia ka pateng jong me .

en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .
kha: Ha ka jingtep , ki riewbymman ki sangeh noh ban leh ki kam bymman , bad ki nongtrei ba la thait , khatduh ki ïoh jingjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki bymman ki sangeh noh na kaba pynkhuslai ; bad hangta ki la thait ki la shongthait .

en: This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .
kha: Ki long ki briew ba nga la pynlong na ka bynta ïa lade , bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Une u briew u la thaw na ka bynta lade ; kin pyni ia ka jingiaroh jong nga .

en: Great men are not always wise : neither do the aged understand judgment .
kha: Kam dei ka rta kaba pynstad ïa ngi lane kaba ïarap ïa ngi ban tip kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba khraw kim ju long kiba stad: bad ki tymmen kim sngewthuh ia ka jingbishar .

en: A fool s lips enter into contention , and his mouth calleth for strokes .
kha: Haba uno uno uba bieit u sdang ïa ka jingïania , u pan kwah ïa ka jingshah sympat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur kiba bieit ki rung ha ka jingiakren , bad ka shyntur jong u ka pyrta ia ki stroke .

en: A long time ago when Pluto was still a planet, there was a boy named Tom.
kha: Mynshuwa haka por ba u Pluto u dang dei u planet, don u khynnah ba kyrteng Tom.
translated_en_to_kha: La slem bah mynshuwa haba u Pluto u dang long u planet, don uwei u khynnah uba kyrteng u Tom.

en: Hear ye the word which the  Lord  speaketh unto you , O house of Israel :
kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba U  Trai  u don na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien kaba U Trai u kren ha phi ko iing Israel:

en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .
kha: Baroh ki la ïawan hadien jong u bad ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u paidbah u la bud hadien, u la iam , Shaphang jong u .

en: I love the  Lord  , because he hath heard my voice and my supplications .
kha: Nga ieit ïa U  Trai  , namar u sngew ïa nga , u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ieit ia U Trai , namar u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga bad ki jingkyrpad jong nga .

en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .
kha: U shakri uba ar u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai san tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uba ar u la wan, u da ong, ko Trai, ka pound jong me ka la kiew san pound .

en: And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
kha: Kumta u ïalam noh ïa ki briew ba la jied jong u , bad ki rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia ki briew jong u da ka jingkmen, bad u la jied ia u da ka jingkmen:

en: Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :
kha: phi ka leilieh bad u phria , ka ïor bad ki lyoh , ki lyer bakhlaiñ kiba kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ding , bad ka lyer kaba jur bha, bad ka lyer kaba jur bha kaba pyndep ia ka ktien jong u:

en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .
kha: U Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem u la leit ban ïakren bad u Jakob , hamar ba ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la wan phai na ki pyntha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hamor u kpa jong u Shechem u la leit sha u Jakob ban iakynduh bad u .

en: Men shall clap their hands at him , and shall hiss him out of his place .
kha: Ka lyer ka kyrhuh ha ki katba ki dang ïaphet , da kaba pynsheptieng ïa ki da ka bor pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang kin ktah ia ki kti jong ki ha u , bad kin pynkhih ia u na ka jaka jong u .

en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .
kha: Ka pyrda kaba wah ha ka Templ ka la kad arliang , naduh khlieh haduh tbian .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtap jong ka tempi ka la tyrkhong arsien naduh jrong haduh trai .

en: I was also upright before him , and have kept myself from mine iniquity .
kha: U tip ba ngam don jingpalat , ba nga la sumar ïa lade na kaba leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh nga la long uba beit ha khmat jong u , bad nga la iada ia lade na ka jingbymhok jong nga .

en: These be they who separate themselves , sensual , having not the Spirit .
kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba pynlong ki jingïapait , kiba shah ïalam ha ki jingkwah ba kynja doh jong ki , ki bym don U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba pyniakhlad ia lade, kiba sngewthuh bakla, ki bym don ia U Mynsiem .

en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
kha: U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngat hangta ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la shah bret ha ka net da ki kjat jong u hi , bad u iaid halor ka jingma .

en: At thy rebuke they fled  ; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away .
kha: Haba me sneng ïa ki um , ki phet ; ki phet noh haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jingpyrta jong ka hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingshah pynrem jong me ki la phet noh ha ka sur jong ka jingsawa jong me ki la kyrkieh noh .

en: He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .
kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba lehhok ïa kiwei pat , bad u ïada ïa kito kiba aiti ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U bat ia ki lynti jong ka jingbishar , bad u pynneh ia ka lynti jong ki riewkhuid jong u .

en: Judge in yourselves : is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered ?
kha: To bishar hi da lade la ka long kaba dei ïa ka briew ban duwai ha U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: To bishar ha lade: hato ka long kaba sngewtynnad ba ka kynthei ka duwai ha U Blei kaba la lap ?

en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified .
kha: Te da kawei ka jingkñia , u la pynjanai ha la ka rta ïa kito kiba la pynkhuid na ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da kawei ka jingainguh u la pynjanai junom ia kito kiba la pynkyntang .

en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
kha: Ka Templ jong ngi ka long kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ïeng halor jong u lumbah bajrong naduh kaba sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khet kaba donburom naduh kaba sdang ka long ka jaka jong ka jaka kyntang jong ngi .

en: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .
kha: Ka jingshai ka tyngshaiñ ha kiba hok , bad ka jingkmen ha kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: La bet ia ka jingshai na ka bynta kiba hok , bad ka jingkmen na ka bynta kiba hok ha ka dohnud .

en: Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
kha: To long uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To leh sngewbha bad u shakri jong me, ba ngan im bad ban bat ia ka ktien jong me .

en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way , who walk in the law of the  Lord .
kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingim jong ki ka long ka bym don jingbakla , kiba im kat kum ka aiñ jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ki bym pat shah pynjakhlia ha ka lynti , kiba iaid ha ka hukum U Trai .

en: When your fathers tempted me , proved me , and saw my works forty years .
kha: Hangta ki la tynjuh bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , ong U Blei , wat la ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ha ki sawphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki kpa jong phi ki la pynshoi ia nga, ki la pynshisha ia nga, bad ki la iohi ia ki kam jong nga sawphew snem .

en: But Jesus said unto them ,  They need not depart  ; give ye them to eat .
kha: Kim donkam ban leit ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ban bam !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Kim donkam ban leit noh ; ai ia ki ban bam .

en: Bharti said she had come here as Prime Minister Narendra Modis emissary .
kha: Ka Bharti ka la ong ba ka la wan hangne ​​kum ka nongmihkhmat jong u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Bharti ka la ong ba ka la wan shane kum u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi .

en: We have forwarded your issue to the concerned team for faster resolution.
kha: Ngi la phah ïa ka jingeh jong phi sha ka kynhun ba dei peit ban pynbeit kloi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la pynpoi ia ka jingeh jong phi sha ka kynhun kaba iadei na ka bynta ban pynbeit kham stet.

en: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem , and fought with Abimelech .
kha: U Gaal u ïalam ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad u ïaleh ïa u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gaal u la mih ha khmat ki briew jong ka Shechem bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Abimelech .

en: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them .
kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la sheptieng ïa ki bad ki la kmen haba ki la mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ijipt ka la sngewbha haba ki la leit noh: namar ka jingtieng ia ki ka la hap halor jong ki .

en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat , and he shall yield royal dainties .
kha: Ka khyndew u Asher kan seisoh shibun , Bad un pynmih ki jait jingbam kiba biang wat ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Na u Asher u kpu jong u un long uba heh , bad un ai ia ki jingbam ba bang jong ka syiem .

en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .
kha: Ym don nongwei ha ka ri jong ki ; ym don u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba la ai ia ka khyndew marwei , bad ym don nongwei uba la iaid hapdeng jong ki .

en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked , he saith , Behold the Lamb of God !
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Ïoannis u dang ïeng biang hangta bad ar ngut na ki synran jong u , mynba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u dang ïaid nangta .  Ha khmih U Khunlangbrot U Blei !  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u peit ia U Jisu katba u dang iaid , u ong , Ha khmih U Khunlangbrot U Blei !

en: King Agrippa , believest thou the prophets ? I know that thou believest .
kha: Ko syiem Agrippa , hato me ngeit ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ? Nga tip ba me ngeit !
translated_en_to_kha: U Syiem Agrippa , ngeit ia ki nongiathuhlypa ? Nga tip ba me ngeit .

en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,
kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bniap shiah . Kine ki long kita kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long kiba la bet hapdeng ki tnat ; kum kiba iohsngew ia ka ktien .

en: Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .
kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ; kata ka long baroh kaba ngi donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u ong ha u, ko Trai, to pyni ia ngi ia U Kpa, bad ka biang ia ngi .

en: And he said , Lord  God  , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?
kha: Hynrei U Abram u ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , kumno keiñ nga lah ban tip ba kan long ka jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , ko Trai Blei , da kaba ngan tip ba ngan hiar pateng ia ka ?

en: Behold , he findeth occasions against me , he counteth me for his enemy ,
kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem daw ban pyrshah ïa nga bad ban ñiew ïa nga kum u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u shem ia ki por pyrshah ia nga , u khein ia nga na ka bynta u nongshun jong u .

en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace .
kha: Bad ka jingbha ka long ka jingmih ba la pynmih na ki symbai kiba ki nongpynïasuk ki la bet ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u soh jong ka hok la bet ha ka jingsuk jong ki kiba pynlong ia ka jingsuk .

en: And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Jakob u dang shet syrwa jhur , u Iso u la wan na kaba behmrad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la wan na lyngkha: bad u Iso u la wan na lyngkha: bad u la lyngngoh:

en: And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they .
kha: Nangta u Balak u la phah kham bun ki nongïalam kiba kham pawkhmat ban ïa kito kiba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Balak u la phah biang ia ki syiem, kham bun bad kham donburom ban ia ki .

en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban shoh ia u da u diengduh bad me dei ban pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong u na dujok .

en: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .
kha: U bieit uba sngewmeng u thikna ban ïoh ïa ka jingshah sympat .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkhreh ia ki jingbishar na ka bynta ki nonglehkai , bad ki stripe na ka bynta ka tyrpeng jong ki bieit .

en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths , and reverence my sanctuary : I am the  Lord .
kha: Sumar ïa ka Sabbaton , bad burom ïa ka jaka ha kaba ïa nga la mane . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin sumar ia ki sngi saitjain jong nga, bad to burom ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga: Nga long U Trai .

en: And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof  ;
kha: Balei keiñ ba ngam peiphang ? Balei keiñ ba ngam shah ba kiwei kin pynbeit ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumno nga la shun ia ka jinghikai, bad ka dohnud jong nga ka la lehbein ia ka jingshah pynrem ; .

en: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .
kha: Me la long u nongshong basa ha ka ïing jong ki Jentil kiba khlem otsher , bad me da ïabam lem bad ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Me la leit sha ki briew ki bym pat shah ot , bad me la bam bad ki .

en: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .
kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan ai ïa phi ka jingim kaba jlan bad kaba manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingjrong jong ki sngi , bad ka jingim kaba jrong bad ka jingsuk , kin pyndap ia me .

en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,
kha: Ka jait Reuben ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Elealeh , ka Kiriathaim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki ksiew ki la tei ia u Hesbon bad u Elealeh bad u Kiriathaim .

en: This was done thrice : and the vessel was received up again into heaven .
kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad nangta ïa kata kaei kaei la shim noh pat sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kane la leh da kaba sngap jar: bad la pdiang biang ia ka lieng sha bneng .

en: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
kha: Me kam ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long uba sngur ha ki khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la ong , Ka jinghikai jong nga ka long kaba khuid bad nga long uba khuid ha ki khmat jong me .

en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards .
kha: Na ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka phang sepngi , shna hynriew tylli ki jingker
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ki liang jong ka Tabernakl shaphang sepngi me dei ban shna hynriew tylli ki board .

en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
kha: Ko Job , phi la pynbitar ïa nga . Mynta ngam lah ap shuh ban jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pynlong ia ki jingpyrkhat jong nga ban jubab , bad na ka bynta kane nga pynkloi .

en: He maketh my feet like hinds  feet : and setteth me upon my high places .
kha: U pynstet ïa ki kjat jong nga kum ka skei ; u sumar ïa nga ha ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ki kjat jong nga kum ki kjat ba jrong: bad u pynshong ia nga ha ki jaka ba jrong jong nga .

en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth , and broader than the sea .
kha: Ka jingkhraw jong U Blei ka kham ïar ban ïa ka pyrthei , ka kham ïar ban ïa ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthew jong ka ka kham jrong ban ia ka khyndew , bad kham heh ban ia ka duriaw .

en: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka thain hajan ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shata bad u la leit noh sha ki rud duriaw jong ka Tyros bad ka Sidon .

en: But brother goeth to law with brother , and that before the unbelievers .
kha: Pynban , uwei u parabangeit u leit sha ka ïingbishar pyrshah ïa uwei pat bad u ailad ïa u bymngeit ban bishar ïa ka kam!
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u hynmen u leit sha ka ain bad u hynmen , bad kata ha khmat ki bym ngeit .

en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
kha: Phi lah ban ïaid da kaba suk ha ki lynti jong phi bad phin ym jynthut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to iaid ha ka lynti jong me da kaba suk bad ka kjat jong me kan ym kylla .

en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest .
kha: Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang : ‘ Phin ym ïohrung da lei lei ha ka ri sha ka jaka ha kaba ngan ai ka jingjahthait ïa phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiba nga sngap jar ha ka jingbitar jong nga ba kin ym rung sha ka jingjahthait jong nga .

en: Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .
kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki mareh stet , ym don kawei na ki kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki sngi jong nga ki kham stet ban ia ka post: ki phet noh , kim iohi ia ka jingbha .

en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la wan phai, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, sha ka shnong Gilgal .

en: And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .
kha: U Jisu u la kiew sha u lum bad hangta u la shong bad la ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la kiew sha u lum bad hangta u la shong bad ki synran jong u .

en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John , whose surname was Mark .
kha: U Barnabas u la kwah ban ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lem bad ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Barnabas u la kut jingmut ban shim bad ki ia u loannis uba la jer kyrteng u Mark .

en: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord  God .
kha: Man ka snem ha kine ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam , ki shynrang baroh ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lai sien ha ka snem baroh ki shynrang jong me kin paw ha khmat U Trai Blei .

en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,
kha: U ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Dei U Blei uba pynsngewsih ia nga , bad uba pynhiar ia ki briew hapoh jong nga , .

en: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting .
kha: U Klaudius Lusias , sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor Badonburom : Khublei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Claudius Lysias u Lat uba bha tam u Felix u phah khublei .

en: Good understanding giveth favour : but the way of transgressors is hard .
kha: Ka jingshemphang ka pynïoh ïa ka jingñiewburom , hynrei kito ki bym lah ban shaniah ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewthuh kaba bha ka ai jingmyntoi: hynrei ka lynti jong ki nongleh kam sniew ka long kaba eh .

en: Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .
kha: Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khun , ïoh ba kin noh mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa , wat pynkhih ia ki khun jong phi ban bitar , ioh ba kin duh mynsiem .

en: He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
kha: U Blei u buh ïa u lyoh halor ki briew jong u bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban ai jingshai ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphriang ia u lyoh na ka bynta ka jingtap ; bad ka ding ban ai jingshai ha ka por miet .

en: If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness  ;
kha: Ngam pat ju mane ïa ka sngi ha ka jingthaba jong ka ne ïa u bnai ha ka itynnat jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga iohi ia ka sngi haba ka la shai , ne u bnai uba iaid ha ka jingshai ; .

en: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .
kha: Mynta , ko Job , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; long jar jar bad shah ba ngan kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Mark bha, ko Job, to sngap ia nga: to sngap jar ia me bad ngan kren .

en: And he said ,  That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka long kaei kaba mih na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Kata kaba mih na u briew , kata ka pynjakhlia ia u briew .

en: A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .
kha: U sakhi u pyllait im ïa ki briew haba u ong ïa kaba shisha ; haba u ong ïa kaba shukor , u shetkylla ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sakhi kaba shisha ka pynpoi ia ki mynsiem: hynrei u nongsakhi uba thok u kren thok .

en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .
kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la iaid lait ia ki syiem baroh jong ka khyndew ha ka spah bad ka jingstad .

en: They change the night into day : the light is short because of darkness .
kha: Hynrei ki paralok jong nga ki ong ba ka por mynmiet ka dei ka por mynsngi ; ki ong ba ka jingshai ka don hajan , hynrei nga tip nga don ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynkylla ia ka miet sha ka sngi: ka jingshai ka long kaba lyngkot namar ka jingdum .

en: Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs  ; four cities in all .
kha: ka Heshbon , bad ka Jaser , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Heshbon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, ka Jazer bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; saw tylli ki nongbah baroh .

en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka bor ban bishar lane ban pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phi ar ngut ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: Ko briew uba la pynlong ia nga u nongbishar ne u nongphiah halor jong phi ?

en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .
kha: Nga kloi ban ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta nga la plie ia ka shyntur jong nga , ka shyntur jong nga ka la kren ha ka shyntur jong nga .

en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool : much less do lying lips a prince .
kha: Ki briew kiba donburom kim ju kren ïa kaba lamler , bad kiba bieit kim don ei ei kaba dondor ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkren kaba bha kam long kaba bieit: kham duna ki rmiang shyntur kiba thok .

en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .
kha: Ka kham bha ban don khyndiat , kaba la kamai da ka hok , ban ïa kaba ïoh shibun , ba la lum da ka jingbymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long khyndiat bad ka hok ban ia ki jingmih kiba khraw khlem ka hok .

en: The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .
kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libni bad u Shimei , bad ki ruh ki don bun ki khun ki ksiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon ; Libni , bad u Shimei , kat kum ka iing ka sem jong ki .

en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land , ye shall not vex him .
kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa ki nongwei kiba shong ha ka ri jong phi .
