translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u nongwei u sah bad me ha ka ri jong phi , phin ym pynsngewsih ia u .

en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature :
kha: U Khrist u long ka dur bapaw jong U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi . U long U Khun ba la kha nyngkong , uba hakhlieh duh jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long ka dur jong U Blei bym lah ban iohi , u khun nyngkong jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw:

en: And no marvel ; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light .
kha: Ngin lyngngoh lei ïa kata ? Wat u Soitan hi u lah ban thawdur ïa lade ban paw kum u angel ka jingshai !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ba phylla na ka bynta u Soitan hi u kylla long u angel jong ka jingshai .

en: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .
kha: Ha U Khrist bad da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha u ngi don ka jingshlur ban leit sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei da ka jingsngewskhem baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ngi don ka jingshlur bad ka jingrung da ka jingshaniah da ka jingngeit jong u .

en: There is none that understandeth , there is none that seeketh after God .
kha: ym don uno uno uba stad lane uba mane ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba sngewthuh , ym don mano mano ruh kiba wad ia U Blei .

en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked : but giveth right to the poor .
kha: Um shah ïa ki bymman ba kin ïai im , bad u ïai leh ïa kiba duk da ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Um pynneh ia ka jingim jong kiba sniew: hynrei u ai hok ia kiba duk .

en: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar s household .
kha: Baroh ki briew U Blei hangne ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei , khamtam kito kiba na ka ïingsyiem jong u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki riewkhuid ki ai khublei ia phi, khamtam eh ia kito kiba long na ka iing jong u Kaisar .

en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .
kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba U Blei u long bymhok ? Ym kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ong aiu te ? Hato ka don ka jingbymhok bad U Blei ? U Blei u la khang .

en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .
kha: To beh kthong ïa ki bad ñiad noh ïa ki na ka khyndew !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynshitom bad pynjot ia ki ha ka jingbitar na shapoh ki bneng U Trai .

en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths , and reverence my sanctuary : I am the  Lord .
kha: Rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam bad burom ïa ka jaka ha kaba ïa nga la mane . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin sumar ia ki sngi saitjain jong nga, bad to burom ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga: Nga long U Trai .

en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .
kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynsngewsih ia u Amalek bad ki briew jong u da ka tduh jong ka waitlam .

en: Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .
kha: Uei uba lah ban pynlong ïa u ban plie ïa ki tyngam jong u , kiba la ker da kito ki bniat kiba itriem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban plie ia ki jingkhang jong ka khmat jong u ? ki bniat jong u ki long kiba shyrkhei sawdong .

en: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
kha: Ngan ym leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym klet ia ki jingbthah jong me: namar bad ki me la pynsted ia nga .

en: Therefore snares are round about thee , and sudden fear troubleth thee  ;
kha: Kumta mynta ki don ki jingriam baroh sawdong jong phi , bad kynsan kynsan phi dap da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki snar ki long sawdong jong me , bad kynsan kynsan ka jingtieng ia me;

en: And many of them said , He hath a devil , and is mad  ; why hear ye him ?
kha: Bun na ki , ki la ïa-ong ,  U shongksuid ! U la lamwir ! Balei phi ïa-shahskhor ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki ki la ong , U don u ksuid bad u la mad ; balei phi iohsngew ia u ?

en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten : for they were not grown up .
kha: U kew te um shym julor , namar ba u ih kham hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u kew bad u rie kim shym la shah pynpra: namar kim shym la san .

en: Keep my commandments , and live  ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .
kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin ïoh im . Da sumar bha ban bud ïa ki jinghikai jong nga kumba phi sumar ïa la ki khmat ;
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia ki hukum jong nga , bad to im ia ka ain jong nga kum ka apple jong ka khmat jong me .

en: He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .
kha: To shim ïa nga bad phi , bad ngin ïaphet noh ; to long u syiem jong nga bad shim ïa nga sha ka kamra jong phi . Ngin ïakmen lang , ngin ïadih bun bad pyllaitluid war ïa lade ha ka jingieit . Kam long kaba phylla ba baroh ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga sha ka iing kaba bam , bad ka banner jong u halor jong nga ka long ka jingieit .

en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .
kha: Ki jingmih ba phi lum kin long kiba bun , bad kin biang na ka bynta shisnem ; wat la katta ruh , phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kaba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ia ka dukan kaba rim , bad phin pynmih ia kaba rim namar kaba thymmai .

en: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !
kha: Katno nga da kwah ban don ki ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthoh ïa ki ha ka kitab !
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba la thoh ia ki ktien jong nga mynta ! oh ba la shon ia ki ha ka kot !

en: Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .
kha: Naduh ba nga la ithuh ïa phi , phi shait ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ia U Trai naduh ka sngi ba nga ithuh ia phi .

en: Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .
kha: To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u mynta bad sha bymjukut !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ka kyrteng U Trai naduh kane ka por bad junom .

en: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
kha: Naba ki ba bun na phi , ba la pynbaptis ha U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa phi da U Khrist hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba phi la shah pynbaptis ha U Khrist phi la phong ia U Khrist .

en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
kha: Nangta ki la ïarwai jingrwai bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la rwai ia ka jingrwai , ki la leit shabar sha u lum jong ki Olive .

en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;
kha: bad kumba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka bor ban synshar , kumta ngan ai ha phi ïa kajuh ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga thung ha phi ia ka hima kumba U Kpa jong nga u la thung ha nga ; .

en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki paid Israel . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Israel , to shaniah ha U Trai: u long ka jingiarap jong ki bad ka stieh jong ki .

en: And whence is this to me , that the mother of my Lord should come to me ?
kha: Balei kane ka jingjia bakhraw ka wan jia ha nga , ba ka kmie jong U Trai jong nga ka wan ban jngoh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangno kane ka long ha nga , ba ka kmie U Trai jong nga kan wan sha nga ?

en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
kha: Phi la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga baroh , bad phim mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la buh ia ka jingmut jong nga baroh, bad phin ym don kawei ruh na ka jingshah kyntait jong nga:

en: I will speak , that I may be refreshed : I will open my lips and answer .
kha: Ngam lah shah shuh , nga dei ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kren , ba ngan sngewbha: Ngan plie ia ki rmiang shyntur jong nga bad jubab .

en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la siewspah ia ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah san snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi jong u Enos baroh ki long hynniew spah san snem: bad u la iap .

en: And if they be bound in fetters , and be holden in cords of affliction  ;
kha: Hynrei lada la teh ïa ki briew ha ki kynjri , da kaba shahshitom na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki shah teh ha ki bniat , bad ki shah bat ha ki lynti jong ka jingshah pynshitom ; .

en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand :
kha: Uta u lyngdoh un theh khyndiat ka umphniang ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un theh ia ka umphniang ha ka kti kadiang jong u hi:

en: And Jesus came and touched them , and said ,  Arise , and be not afraid .
kha: U Jisu u la wan sha ki bad u la ktah ïa ki .  To ïeng joit ,  u la ong .  To wat sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la wan bad u la ktah ia ki, bad u la ong: To khie bad wat tieng .

en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua lem bad ka kynhun shipai , u leit phai pat sha ka jaka sher dara ha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la wan phai, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, sha ka shnong Gilgal .

en: With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .
kha: U Blei u long uba khlaiñ bad uba ïai jop ; baroh ar ngut — uba shah shukor bad u nongshukor ki don hapoh ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u ka long ka bor bad ka jingstad: u nongshah thok bad u nongleh thok ki long ki jong u .

en: Till I come , give attendance to reading , to exhortation , to doctrine .
kha: Tad ynda nga wan , to ai ïa ka por jong me bad ka jingpyrshang ban pule paidbah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ban ïalap bad hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba ngan da wan, ai jingmut ban pule, ban pynshlur, ban hikai .

en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .
kha: Ym don sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti bakynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: U sing u la iaid lyngba ia ka, lymne u sing uba shyrkhei u la iaid lyngba jong ka .

en: Men do therefore fear him : he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .
kha: Kam long kaba phylla , te , ba uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa u , bad ba um ñiew ïa kito kiba kam ba ki long kiba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki tieng ia u: um burom ia uno uno uba stad ha ka dohnud .

en: For the great day of his wrath is come  ; and who shall be able to stand ?
kha: Ka sngi batriem jong ka jingbitar jong ki ka la poi , bad uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka sngi kaba khraw jong ka jingbitar jong u ka la wan ; bad mano ba lah ban ieng ?

en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .
kha: Wat shukor haba phi thew jingthew da u mawser ne da u diengthew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat don ha ka iing jong phi ki jingthew , kiba heh bad kiba rit .

en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say .
kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid un hikai ïa phi ha kata ka por ïa kaei ba phin ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Mynsiem Bakhuid un hikai ia phi ha kajuh ka kynta ia kaei kaba phi dei ban ong .

en: I will pay my vows unto the  Lord  now in the presence of all his people .
kha: Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong u baroh ngan ai ha u ïa kaei kaba nga la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan siew ia ki jingkular jong nga ha U Trai mynta ha khmat ki briew jong u baroh .

en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him , talk ye of all his wondrous works .
kha: Rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; ïathuh ïa ki jingphylla kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ia u, to rwai ia u, to kren ia ki kam phylla jong u baroh .

en: And gave their land for an heritage , an heritage unto Israel his people .
kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki sha ki briew jong u ; u la ai ïa ki ha ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia ka ri jong ki na ka bynta ka pateng , ka pateng ha ki Israel jong u .

en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city , and cursed shalt thou be in the field .
kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa ki shnong bad ki lyngkha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia me ha ka shnong , bad la tim ia me ha lyngkha .

en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
kha: Ki Philistia ki la poi ha ka Them Rephaim bad ki ïohknieh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ruh ki la wan bad ki la pynphriang ia lade ha ka them Rephaim .

en: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei ha kata kajuh kumba phi la long mynba la khot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit , to ai ba uwei pa uwei u briew, ha kaba la khot ia u, ha kata ka por un kohnguh ia U Blei .

en: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid .
kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Bilhah ïa ka Rakhel ka khun jong u kum ka shakri jong ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ai ha ka Rakhel ia ka khun jong u ka Bilhah ka nongtrei jong u ban long ka nongtrei jong ka .

en: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies , as much as in all riches .
kha: Nga sngewkmen ha kaba bud ïa ki hukum jong me palat ban ïa kaba don ka spah kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la sngewbha ha ka lynti jong ki jingphla jong me , kumba ha ki spah baroh .

en: And when the multitude heard this , they were astonished at his doctrine .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u paidbah u la iohsngew ia kane , ki la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai jong u .

en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .
kha: Hynrei naduh mynta U Khun U Briew un shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u Khun u briew un shong ha ka liang kadiang jong ka bor U Blei .

en: How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?
kha: Em , me lah ban shah tang ïa ka jingshit haba ka lyer na shaphang shathie ka lynshop ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ki jain jong me ki rkhiang , haba u pynsngap jar ia ka khyndew da ka Iyer kaba shathie ?

en: Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;
kha: Phi ong ba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la ong , U Trai u la pynmih ia ngi ki nongiathuhlypa ha Babilon ; .

en: Unless the  Lord  had been my help , my soul had almost dwelt in silence .
kha: Lada U  Trai  um shym la ïarap ïa nga , ngan jin da la leit kloi sha ka ri kaba jar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada U Trai um shym la long ka jingiarap jong nga , ka mynsiem jong nga ka la jan shong ha ka jingsngap jar .

en: They prevented me in the day of my calamity : but the  Lord  was my stay .
kha: Haba nga don ha ka jynjar , ki la tur ïaleh ïa nga , hynrei U  Trai  u la ïada ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khanglad ia nga ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar jong nga: hynrei U Trai u la long ka jingsah jong nga .

en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ha phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia phi, Em: hynrei, lymda phi kylla bamut, phi baroh kumjuh phin sa jah noh .

en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and stood before the angel .
kha: U Joshua u la ïeng hangta , u da phong ki jaiñ bajakhlia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la phong da ki jain kiba jakhlia bad u la ieng ha khmat u angel .

en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand , but the goats on the left .
kha: Un buh ïa ki briew kiba hok sha ka liang kamon jong u bad ïa kiwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ia ki langbrot ha ka liang kadiang jong u , hynrei ia ki blang ha ka liang kadiang .

en: And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .
kha: Haba u la ïashem ïa ngi ha Assos , ngi la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng bad ngi la leit sha Mitylene .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iakynduh bad ngi ha Asos , ngi la ialam ia u shapoh bad ngi la poi ha Mytlene .

en: And said , Hail , King of the Jews ! and they smote him with their hands .
kha: Im slem ko Syiem ki Jiw !  Bad ki la leit bad thab ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Hail, Syiem ki Jiw ! bad ki la shoh ia u da ki kti jong ki .

en: For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .
kha: Lada ka long kumta , phi don ka lawei kaba phyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha ka don ka jingkut bad ka jingkhmih lynti jong me kan ym shah ot noh .

en: He holdeth back the face of his throne , and spreadeth his cloud upon it .
kha: U buhrieh ïa u bnai bapyllun hadien ki lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U bat ia ka khmat jong ka khet jong u , bad u pynphriang ia u lyoh jong u halor jong ka .

en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .
kha: Hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum ka bih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh jong u ha ka kpoh jong u ka kylla , ka long ka gall jong ki jingbam hapoh jong u .

en: Then came the day of unleavened bread , when the passover must be killed .
kha: Ka sngi ka la poi ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ha kaba ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait la dei ban pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan ka sngi jong u kpu bym don thied , haba la dei ban pyniap ia ka jingkhawai .

en: And they that did eat were four thousand men , beside women and children .
kha: Ka jingkheiñ ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long saw hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba bam ki long saw hajar ngut ki shynrang , nalor ki kynthei bad ki khun .

en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .
kha: Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba u ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew un ym shim ia ka tnga jong u kpa jong u, lane un ym lap ia u kpa jong u.

en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
kha: Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pyiar la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka hawk ka her da ka jingstad jong me , bad ka pynjrong ia ki bniat jong ka shaphang shathie ?

en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .
kha: Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Solomon la wan kit na Musri bad na kiwei pat ki ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ki kulai na Ijipt bad na ki ri baroh .

en: And all the people were amazed , and said , Is not this the son of David ?
kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewkyndit ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .  Hato une un dei U Khun jong u Dabid ?  ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la lyngngoh bad ki la ong: Hato une u dei u khun u Dabid ?

en: Doth our law judge any man , before it hear him , and know what he doeth ?
kha: U la ong ha kiwei ,  Kat kum ka Hukum jong ngi ngim lah ban pynrem ïa u briew ha shuwa ban ïohsngew na u bad ban shem kaei ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka ain jong ngi kam bishar ia uno uno u briew, shuwa ba kan iohsngew ia u bad tip ia kaei kaba u leh ?

en: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun , and it seemed great unto me :
kha: Don sa kaei kaei kawei pat kaba nga la ïohi , ka nuksa kaba bha shaphang kumno ïa ka jingstad la ñiew ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingstad nga la iohi ruh hapoh ka sngi , bad ka la long kumba khraw ha nga:

en: And again they said , Alleluia . And her smoke rose up for ever and ever .
kha: Sa shisien ki la pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba la bam duh ïa ka nongbah bakhraw ka la kiew shajrong junom la junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien ki la ong , Aleluia . Bad ka tdem jong ka ka la kiew junom .

en: My days are swifter than a weaver s shuttle , and are spent without hope .
kha: Ki sngi ki ïaid khlem don jingkyrmen , ki ïaid kham stet ban ïa ka latai jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki kham stet ban ia ka jingsma kaba jem , bad la pynlut khlem jingkyrmen .

en: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .
kha: ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki maw Onyx , bad ki maw ban buh ha ka ephod , bad ha ka sniehdoh .

en: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .
kha: Shah kin dih bad kin klet ïa la ka jingduk , bad ïa ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba un dih , bad un klet ia ka jingduk jong u , bad un kynmaw shuh ia ka jingjynjar jong u .

en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .
kha: U briew uba jaipdeh uba kyntait ban trei u shu pynïap ei ïa lade ; baroh kaba u leh ka long ban pyrkhat shaphang kaei ba u kwah ban don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah jong u briew uba sniew ka pyniap ia u ; namar ki kti jong u ki kyntait ban trei .

en: For where envying and strife is , there is confusion and every evil work .
kha: Ha kaba ka don ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingkhwan myntoi , hangta ka don ruh ka jingbymïaid ryntih bad ki jait jingsniew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kaba ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingialeh ka don, ka don ka jingkulmar bad kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba sniew .

en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them , he consented not  ;
kha: Ki paidbah ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah kham slem , hynrei u kyrngah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki kwah ia u ban sah kham slem bad ki , um shym la mynjur shuh;

en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia phi, Em: hynrei, lymda phi kylla bamut, phi baroh kumjuh phin sa jah noh .

en: For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .
kha: Ngi tip ba ka Hukum ka long kaba kynja mynsiem ; hynrei nga long u briew uba kynja doh , ba la die kum u mraw ha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi tip ba ka hukum ka long kaba kynja mynsiem: hynrei nga long uba kynja doh, uba la die hapoh ka pop .

en: And he called the porters  ; and they told it to the king s house within .
kha: Ki nongap khyrdop ki pynbna ïa kata ka khubor , bad la leit rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ki nongap bar ri bad ki la iathuh ia kata ha ka iing syiem hapoh .

en: And when he had thus spoken , he went before , ascending up to Jerusalem .
kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane bad nangta u la nang leit sha Jerusalem ha shuwa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kumta, u la leit sha khmat, u la kiew sha Jerusalem .

en: But , behold , the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table .
kha: Hynrei , ha khmih ! Uta uba shetkylla ïa nga u don hangne ha ka miej lem bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei , ha khmih , ka kti jong uta uba shet kylla ia nga ka don ryngkat bad nga ha ka miej .

en: Something went wrong with your payment. Try again with a different method.
kha: Ka don ka jing bakla ha ka jingsiew jong phi. Pyrshang bïang da ka rukom kaba pher.
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaei kaba la bakla bad ka jingsiew jong phi. Pyrshang biang da ka rukom kaba pher.

en: And to godliness brotherly kindness  ; and to brotherly kindness charity .
kha: ha ka jinglong riewblei pynlang ïa ka jingïadei parabangeit ; bad ha ka jingïadei parabangeit pynlang ïa ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jinglong ba kynja Blei bad ha ka jinglong ba kynja Blei .

en: When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
kha: u slap uba pyneh ïa u pui pui sha ki  dew tylli ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka dewbilat ka san sha ka jingkhlain , bad ki lum ki ia tyngkhuh stet ?

en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;
kha: bad ka Esther ka ai ïa kane ka khubor ban leit rah pat sha u Mordekai :
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien u Esther u la kren ha u Hatach bad u la ai hukum ia u ha u Mordecai;

en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .
kha: Bud ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad ai kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha u, To bud ia nga ; bad ai ba kiba iap kin tep ia kiba iap jong ki .

en: They had almost consumed me upon earth  ; but I forsook not thy precepts .
kha: Sa khyndiat , ki la jan ban ïoh pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym leh lyndet ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jan bam ia nga ha ka khyndew ; hynrei ngam shym la iehnoh ia ki jingbthah jong me .

en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .
kha: Ka thma kaba la sdang hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ka neh katba u Abijah u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u .

en: And he said unto them ,  That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Ba U Khun u briew ruh u long U Trai jong ka Sabha .

en: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats  hair .
kha: Ki thir ruh ïa u shñiuh blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ka dohnud jong ki ka la pynkhih ia ki da ka jingstad ki la tyrkhong ia ki shniuh blang .

en: I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;
kha: Kumta ynda phi shah jynjar , ngan sa ïoh rkhie ïa phi . Ngan sa rkhiebeiñ ïa phi ynda phi hap ha ka jingsheptieng —
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh ngan rkhie bein ia ka jingjynjar jong phi ; Ngan rkhie bein haba ka jingtieng jong phi ka wan ; .

en: Behold now behemoth , which I made with thee  ; he eateth grass as an ox .
kha: Khmih ïa u Behemoth u mrad kynsha ; nga la thaw ïa u bad nga la thaw ïa me . U bam phlang kum ka masi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta u la leh bad me ; u bam ia u phlang kum u masi .

en: Many people think that Jehovah’s Witnesses is the name of a new religion .
kha: Bun ki briew ki tharai ba ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ka dei ka kyrteng jong ka niam bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun ki briew ki pyrkhat ba ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki dei ka kyrteng jong ka niam kaba thymmai .

en: And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .
kha: Ki la kem ïa ki apostol bad ki la set ha ka phatok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ki apostol , bad ki la buh ia ki ha ka phatok kaba iadei .

en: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
kha: Haba nga pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlah pyrkhat shuh , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrngah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat haba nga kynmaw nga tieng , bad nga khih nga bat ia ka doh jong nga .

en: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not  ; and sealeth up the stars .
kha: U lah ban khang ïa ka sngi ba kan mih , bad ïa ki khlur ban tyngshaiñ mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba hukum ia ka sngi , bad kam mih ; bad ka pynshai ia ki khlur .

en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam ha ban da kdang — la don kumba saw hajar ngut ki briew . Nangta ki synran ki la ïalum hynñiew tukri kiba la dap da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . U Jisu u la phah noh ïa ki briew
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la bam ki long kumba saw hajar: bad u la phah noh ia ki .

en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity , and is polluted with blood .
kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah kaba dap da ki riewbymman bad ki nongpynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah jong ki kaba trei ia ka jingbymhok , bad ka long kaba la pynjakhlia da ka snam .

en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach , he runneth upon me like a giant .
kha: U ïai pynmynsaw ïa nga ; u tur ïaleh kum u shipai ba la lamwir da ka jingisih .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynpra ia nga da kaba pynkhein ia nga, u mareh halor jong nga kum u rangbah .

en: So the  Lord  alone did lead him , and there was no strange god with him .
kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u ïalam ïa la ki briew , ym don u blei nongwei uba ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta tang U Trai u la ialam ia u , bad ym don blei phylla bad u .

en: If I wait , the grave is mine house : I have made my bed in the darkness .
kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka dei ka pyrthei kiba ïap , sha kaba ngan sa dem ban thiah ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga ap, ka jingtep ka long ka iing jong nga: Nga la shna ia ka jingthiah jong nga ha ka jingdum .

en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people  ;
kha: ban jop ïa ki hima bad ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyndep ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein ha ki nongwei , bad ki jingpynshitom ha ki briew ;

en: Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Doth Job fear God for nought ?
kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  Hato u Job un mane ïa me lada um ïoh ei ei na ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Soitan u la jubab ia U Trai , bad u la ong , Hato u Job u tieng ia U Blei khlem da don ei ei ?

en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .
kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka por ba la buh man ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei namarkata ban bat ia kane ka hukum ha ka aiom jong u man la u snem .

en: And brought out Israel from among them : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la ïalam noh ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmih ia ki Israel napdeng jong ki: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: Bless them that curse you , and pray for them which despitefully use you .
kha: kyrkhu ïa kito kiba tim ïa phi , bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba lehbeiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kyrkhu ia ki kiba tim ia phi , bad duwai na ka bynta jong ki kiba pynlut ia phi .

en: And the sons of Naphtali  ; Jahzeel , and Guni , and Jezer , and Shillem .
kha: U Naphtali bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Jahsil , u Guni , u Jeser , bad u Shillem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Naphtali ; u Jahel, bad u Guni, bad u Jeser bad u Shillem .

en: But blessed are your eyes , for they see : and your ears , for they hear .
kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , katno kiba donbok phi long ! Ki khmat jong phi ki ïohi bad ki shkor jong phi ki ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la kyrkhu ia ki khmat jong phi: bad ki shkor jong phi: namar ki iohsngew .

en: To bind their kings with chains , and their nobles with fetters of iron  ;
kha: ban khum ïa ki syiem jong ki da ki kynjri , ïa ki nongïalam jong ki da ki kynjri nar ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ban teh ia ki syiem jong ki da ki kynjri , bad ki rangbah jong ki da ki jingteh nar ; .

en: Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
kha: Kyrpad na U  Trai  ban kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phin ïoh jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ki kam jong me ha U Trai , bad ki jingpyrkhat jong me kin long kiba skhem .

en: Lift up thyself , thou judge of the earth : render a reward to the proud .
kha: Me long u nongbishar ïa ki briew baroh ; A to ïeng bad ai ha kiba sarong ïa kaei kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia lade, me bishar ia ka khyndew: ai ia ka bainong ia kiba sngew sarong .

en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .
kha: Bad ka jingïathuh shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka nam jong u ka la mih sha man la ki jaka jong ka ri sawdong .

en: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :
kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki lumbah , ha shuwa ban pynïeng ïa ki lumrit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ba ki lum kin shongthait , shuwa ba ki lum kin mih:

en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .
kha: Haba u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ki Israel ki la leh ïa ki Amor , bad ïa ka jingbun paid ki Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u khun jong u Zippor u la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Israel ki la leh ia ki Amorit .

en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .
kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai ! To rwai ha U  Trai  , ko phi ka pyrthei baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: O rwai ia U Trai ka jingrwai kaba thymmai: rwai ia U Trai , ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .
kha: Lada phim shahshkor ïa nga , te U Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei kiba kren da kawei pat ka sur ktien ba sngew khyllah ban hikai ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ki rmiang shyntur bad kawei pat ka shyntur un kren ia une u briew .

en: For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .
kha: Lada ngim shym la pyntud katne katne , ngin jin da la wan phai kylla ar sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lait noh tang ba ngi la sahkut, thikna mynta ngi la wan phai biang ha kane ka sien kaba ar .

en: I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
kha: Shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki khohwah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haduh katno u long uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym buhrieh ia ki bynta jong u, ne ia ka bor jong u, ne ia ka jinglong jong u kaba wan .

en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall : but the  Lord  helped me .
kha: La tur ïaleh jur ïa nga bad nga la shahjop , hynrei U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynkhih ia nga ba nga lah ban hap: hynrei U Trai u la iarap ia nga .

en: To put plainly the objective is 3E . Enterprises , Earning , Empowerment .
kha: Ban kren shai ia ka jingthmu ka long 3E . Ki kam , Ka jingkamai , Ka jingpynkupbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban buh shai ia ka jingthmu ka long 3E . Ki jingeh , Ka Jingpynroi .

en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .
kha: Ma phi kiba hiarpateng na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa uba U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko symbai jong u Israel jong u, ko khun u Jakob jong u .

en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice , that it might depart from me .
kha: Lai sien nga la duwai ha U Trai shaphang kane bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ban weng noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingjia nga la kyrpad ia U Trai, ba kan phet noh na nga .

en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him .
kha: Haba ngi shahshitom , ngi dei ban shong marwei ha ka jingïaishah bajar jar ;
translated_en_to_kha: U shong marwei bad u sngap jar , namar u la kit ia ka ha u .

en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wan bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , To bud ia nga , bad ngan pynlong ia phi ki nongtong dohkha jong ki briew .

en: Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin ong mynta ia U Trai , ba ka jingisynei jong u kan neh junom .

en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka jingkylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki apostol bad ki rangbah ki la iawan lang ban pyrkhat ia kane ka kam .

en: And they said unto her , Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
kha: Em ! Ngin leit bad phi sha ki briew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ka , Hooid ngin sa wan phai bad me sha ki briew jong me .

en: I am the good shepherd : the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep .
kha: Nga , nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha , uba kloi ban ïap na ka bynta ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha: u nongaplangbrot uba bha u ai ia la ka jingim na ka bynta ki langbrot .

en: To devise cunning works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
kha: ban pruid dur ba-itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ban thaw ia ki kam kiba rit , ban trei ha ka ksiar bad ha ka rupa bad ha ka nar .

en: You should avoid traveling on Tuesday and Friday because of heavy traffic.
kha: Dei ban kiar na kaba leit jingleit ha ka sngi Ba-ar bad sngi Thohdieng namar ka jingbun ki kali.
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban kiar na kaba leit jingleit ha ka sngi Balang bad sngi Palei namar ka jingdheng kali kaba jur.

en: And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .
kha: Haba u Paul u la dep kren , u la dem khohsiew bad ki bad u la duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kumta, u la dem khrup bad u la duwai bad ki baroh .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Te , to peit ! Ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, To pdiang ia ka jingpeit jong me: ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynim ia me .

en: The pins of the tabernacle , and the pins of the court , and their cords ,
kha: ïa ki snar bad ki tyllai jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad ka phyllaw jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pin jong ka Tabernakle , bad ki pin jong ka iingbishar bad ki string jong ki .

en: And he said , My presence shall go with thee , and I will give thee rest .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Nga hi ngan leit ryngkat bad me , bad ngan ai ha me ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ka jingdon jong nga kan leit bad me , bad ngan ai jingjahthait ia me .

en: There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :
kha: La don u nongïalam jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Nikodemos , uba dei na ka kynhun ki Pharisi .
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u briew na ki Pharisi uba kyrteng u Nikodemous u nongsynshar jong ki Jiw:

en: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good : the enemy shall pursue him .
kha: ki la kyntait ïa kata kaba bha . Namar kane , ki nongshun jong ki kin buddien ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la bret noh ia kaei kaba bha: u nongshun un bud ia u .

en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me .
kha: Me tip kumno ki nongshun jong nga ki la isih ïa nga bad kumno ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohi ia ka jingsngewsih jong ki baroh bad ki jingmutdur jong ki baroh pyrshah ia nga .

en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprung up , and choked them :
kha: Khyndiat na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki bniap dieng shiah , kiba la san bad kjap noh ïa ki jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don kiba hap hapdeng ki tnat ; bad ki tnat ki la mih , bad ki la pynkhih ia ki:

en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Da ka jingstad jong u , u la thaw ïa ki bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba da ka jingstad u la thaw ia ki bneng: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: But it could have recruited professionals , such as bankers , economists .
kha: Hynrei ka lah ban shim ia ki riew shemphang , kum ki nongtrei bank , ki riew shemphang ka ioh ka kot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka lah ban long ki riew shemphang kiba la shim kam, kum ki bank , ki nongtrei ka ioh ka kot .

en: But the lad knew not any thing : only Jonathan and David knew the matter .
kha: khlem da peiphang ei ei ka mut aïu kane baroh ; tang u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u khynnah um tip ei ei: tang u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki tip ia kata ka kam .

en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .
kha: Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymdei ha ka ri shyiap bad tynjuh ïa U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la kwah palat ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka la pynshoi ia U Blei ha ka ri khlaw .

en: Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai noh sha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta hadien kata u la ong ha ki synran jong u , To ngin leit biang sha Judaea .

en: The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .
kha: Ïa ki briew kiba bha yn ïai kynmaw kum ka jingkyrkhu ; hynrei ïa ki riewbymman yn klet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkynmaw jong kiba hok ka long kaba la kyrkhu: hynrei ka kyrteng jong kiba sniew kan pyut .

en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner :  Balei u Abner u dei ban ïap kum u bieit ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la iam halor u Abner , bad u la ong: U Abner u la iap kum u briew uba bieit ?

en: But ye believe not , because ye are not of my sheep , as I said unto you .
kha: hynrei phin ym ngeit , naba phim dei ki langbrot jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phim ngeit , namar phim long na ki langbrot jong nga kumba nga la ong ha phi .

en: We are all one man s sons  ; we are true men , thy servants are no spies .
kha: Ngi baroh ngi ïalong shi para . Kynrad , ngim dei ki nongsyntiat , ngi dei ki briew ba shida .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long baroh ki khun shynrang beg ngi long ki briew kiba shisha, ki shakri jong me kim dei ki nongsyntiat .

en: Mohan Bhagwat defies govt rule , unfurls national flag at school in Kerala
kha: Pyrshah ia ka jingsynshar ka sorkar u Mohan Bhagwat , pynher ia ka lama ri ha skul ha Kerala .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mohan Bhagwat u pyrshah ia ka jingsynshar govt, khlem da pynkhih ia ka lama jong ka ri ha skul ha Kerala .

en: Oh that I were as in months past , as in the days when God preserved me  ;
kha: Lada ka jingim jong nga kan jin da la long biang kum ha ka por ba U Blei u dang peit halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba nga la long kumba ha ki bnai ba la leit noh, kumba ha ki sngi ba U Blei u la pynneh pynsah ia nga ; .

en: The small and great are there  ; and the servant is free from his master .
kha: Baroh ki don hangta , kiba pawnam bad ki bym don ba ithuh , bad ki mraw , khatduh ki la laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba rit bad kiba khraw ki don hangta ; bad u shakri u lait na u kynrad jong u .

en: And his mother answered and said , Not so  ; but he shall be called John .
kha: Hynrei ka kmie ka la ong ,  Em ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei ban long u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kmie jong u ka la jubab bad ka la ong: Ym kumta; hynrei yn khot ia u u Ioannis .

en: Behold now , I have ordered my cause  ; I know that I shall be justified .
kha: Nga la kloi ban ïasaid ïa ka kam ka jong nga . Namar nga tip ba ngam shym bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta , nga la hukum ia ka daw jong nga ; Nga tip ba ngan long uba hok .

en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap noh ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi u Noah baroh ki long hynniew spah sanphew snem: bad u la iap .

en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ :
kha: Ha kata ka por , ki dkhot jong ki balang ha Judia kim pat ithuh ïa nga markhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym shym la tip da ka khmat sha ki balang Judaea kiba la don ha U Khrist:

en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .
kha: Phim bit wat tang ban sliew ding ruh ha la ïing ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban thang ding ha baroh ki jaka shong jaka sah jong phi ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: My face is foul with weeping , and on my eyelids is the shadow of death  ;
kha: Nga la ïam haduh ba ka durkhmat jong nga ka la sawkyr-ang , bad ki khmat jong nga ki la sieb bad la paw syrngiew sawdong jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong nga ka long kaba sniew bad ka iam , bad ha ki khmat jong nga ka don ka jingdum jong ka jingiap ; .

en: He will not suffer me to take my breath , but filleth me with bitterness .
kha: Um shah ïa nga ban ïoh pynhiar mynsiem ; u la pyndap ïa ka jingim jong nga da ka jingkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym shah ia nga ban ring mynsiem ia nga , hynrei un pynkhih ia nga da ka jingsngewsih .

en: And , behold , there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him .
kha: Nangta ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Moses bad u Elijah ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u Moses bad u Elias ki la paw ha ki ba ki ia kren bad u .

en: And the  Lord s  anger was kindled the same time , and he sware , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ha kata ka sngi , bad u la kular ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar jong U Trai ka la bthei ha kajuh ka por , bad u la sngap jar , u da ong , .

en: Brethren , the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .
kha: To ka jingaiei ka jong U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist kan long ryngkat bad phi baroh , ki parabangeit jong nga . Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko para bangeit , ka jingaiei U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist kan long bad ka mynsiem jong phi . Amen .

en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi jong u Kain baroh ki long hynniew spah shi snem: bad u la iap .

en: A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish man despiseth his mother .
kha: Ki khun kiba stad ki pynlong ïa ki kpa jong ki ban kmen . Tang kiba bieit ki ñiewbeiñ ïa la ki kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun uba stad u pynlong ia u kpa uba kmen: hynrei u briew uba bieit u niewbein ia la ka kmie .

en: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;
kha: ka Ebron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Hebron, bad u Rehob, bad u Hammon, bad u Kanah, wat haduh u Sidon uba khraw .

en: The heavens declare his righteousness , and all the people see his glory .
kha: Ki bneng ki pynbna ïa ka hok jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh ki ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bneng ki pynbna ia ka hok jong u , bad ki briew baroh ki iohi ia ka burom jong u .

en: And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .
kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongshimwai ki la pynmynsaw ïa u ruh , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la phah ia u: bad ki la pynmynsaw ia u ruh, bad ki la bret noh ia u .

en: Your fathers , where are they ? and the prophets , do they live for ever ?
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kito ki nongïathuhlypa kim don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa jong phi ki don shano ? bad ki nongiathuhlypa , hato ki im junom ?

en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .
kha: Kumta te ki dieng baroh ki ong ha u dieng shiah , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ia ki dieng baroh ha ka jingkhihwin , To wan bad to synshar halor jong ngi .

en: Then he questioned with him in many words  ; but he answered him nothing .
kha: Kumta u Herod u la kylli ïa U Jisu shibun ki jingkylli , hynrei U Jisu um shym jubab ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kylli ia u da ki kyntien kiba bun ; hynrei um jubab ei ei ia u .

en: Whereby the world that then was , being overflowed with water , perished :
kha: Ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong na ka um bad da ka um , bad ka la long ruh da ka um ; ka um jong ka jingshlei um , ba ïa ka pyrthei barim la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ka pyrthei kaba ha kata ka por ka la long, ka la tuid da ka um, ka la jah noh:

en: Consider what I say ; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things .
kha: To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba nga ong , namar U Trai un pynlah ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia kaei kaba nga ong ; bad U Trai u ai ia me ka jingsngewthuh ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house , and on thy gates .
kha: Thoh ruh ïa ki ha ki shawkad jong ki ïing bad ha ki khyrdop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban thoh ia ki ha ki post jong ka iing jong me bad ha ki khyrdop jong me .

en: When Pilate heard of Galilee , he asked whether the man were a Galilaean .
kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la kylli ,  Hato une u briew u dei u nong Galilaïa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Pilat u la iohsngew ia ka Galilaia , u la kylli la uta u briew u dei u Galilaia .

en: To whom then will ye liken me , or shall I be equal ? saith the Holy One .
kha: Badno lah ban ïanujor ïa U Blei bakhuid ? Don uno uno ba kum ma u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha mano te phin ianujor ia nga , ne ngan iaryngkat ? ong U Bakhuid .

en: Verily I say unto you , All these things shall come upon this generation .
kha: Nga ong shisha ha phi : Ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kine ki jingpynïap baroh kan hap halor ki briew jong kane ka juk !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kine kiei kiei baroh kin sa wan ha kane ka pateng .

en: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
kha: Wat ka jingïap bad ka jingpynjot ki ong ba ki la ïohsngew tang ki hamsaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynjot bad ka jingiap ka ong , Ngi la iohsngew ia ka nam jong ka da ki shkor jong ngi .

en: And he , as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .
kha: Kaba mih nangta ka long ba nga khyllem kum ka dieng pyut , kum ka jaiñphong ba la bam khñiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u, kum ka jingbam kaba pyut, u bam, kum ka jain kaba la bam da u khnai .

en: Kedemoth with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Kedemoth , bad ka Mephaath , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Kdemoth bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Mephath bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .
kha: Ngi tip ba ngi long ki jong U Blei , wat la ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u Basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi tip ba ngi long na U Blei , bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka shong ha ka jingsniew .

en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
kha: U briew uba shem ïa nga u shem ïa ka jingim , bad U  Trai  un sngewbha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno uba shem ia nga u shem ia ka jingim , bad un ioh ia ka jingsngewbha jong U Trai .

en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: kiba ka kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingshakri ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la buh jingma ia ka jingim jong ki na ka bynta ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: And after those days we took up our carriages , and went up to Jerusalem .
kha: Hadien ba ngi la pynlut katto katne por hangta , ngi la khreh ïa la ki tiar ki tar bad ngi la leit noh sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kita ki sngi ngi la shim ia ki kali jong ngi bad ngi la leit sha Jerusalem .

en: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei ha phi , bad ka jingsuk , na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: to see that the certificate that you gave it actually consist of k nodes .
kha: ban iohi ba ka certificate kaba phi la ai ha ka jingshisha ka don k node .
translated_en_to_kha: ban iohi ba ka kot ba phi la ai ha ka jingshisha ka kynthup ia ki k node .

en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone , he hath made my paths crooked .
kha: nga thap kyllon katba nga ïaid ; ki kynroh maw ki khang ïa nga kat shaba nga phai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khang ia ki lynti jong nga da u maw ba la ot , u la pynlong ia ki lynti jong nga kiba la tyrkhong .

en: And all the people shall hear , and fear , and do no more presumptuously .
kha: Te uwei pa uwei un sa ïohsngew ïa kata bad un sngewsheptieng , bad yn ym don shuh uba nud ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew baroh kin iohsngew , bad kin tieng , bad kin ym leh shuh da kaba sngewthuh bakla .

en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .
kha: Bad u Kain u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Kane ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban shah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kain u la ong ha U Trai , Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka kham khraw ban ia kaba nga lah ban shah .

en: And he confessed , and denied not  ; but confessed , I am not the Christ .
kha: U Ïoannis um shym la kyntait ban jubab , hynrei , u la kren ha kaba paw bad da kaba shai , u da ong ,  Ngam dei u Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phla , bad um shym la kyntait ; hynrei u la phla , ngam dei U Khrist .

en: And the children of Israel did so , and gathered , some more , some less .
kha: Ki Israel ki ïaleh kumta , don kiba lum kham bun , kiwei pat ki lum kham khyndiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh kumta, bad ki la ialum lang, katto katne kham duna .

en: And when they had found him , they said unto him , All men seek for thee .
kha: bad haba ki la shem ïa u , ki la ong ,  Baroh ki ïawad ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lap ia u bad ki la ong ha u: Baroh ki briew ki wad ia me .

en: Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .
kha: Ngan ïai lehkmen bad shadkmen , namar U  Trai  U Blei u long u nongpynim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan sngewbha ha U Trai , ngan sngewbha ha U Blei jong ka jingpynim jong nga .

en: When I say , My bed shall comfort me , my couch shall ease my complaint  ;
kha: Nga thiah bad pyrshang ban pynjahthait ; nga khmih ban ïohlait na ka jingpang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga ong , ka jingthiah jong nga kan pyntngen ia nga , ka shuki jong nga kan pynjem ia ka jingujor jong nga ;

en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .
kha: Ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; ki pyrkhat ki kham bha palat ma ki ban ïa nga , bad ki wan wat ban bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngewsih ia nga, ki phet noh na nga, bad ki lait na kaba sngap jar ha ka khmat jong nga .

en: Thou art my portion , O  Lord  : I have said that I would keep thy words .
kha: Me long baroh uba nga kwah , A  Trai  ; nga kular ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long ka bynta jong nga ko Trai: Nga la ong ba ngan bat ia ki ktien jong me .

en: So he went with them . And when they came to Jordan , they cut down wood .
kha: Ynda ki poi ha Jordan , ki la sdang ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit bad ki . Bad haba ki la poi ha Jordan , ki la ot dieng .

en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .
kha: Katba u dang khynnah , don ki briew ki ban sumar ïa u bad pynïaid ïa ki kam jong u tad haduh ban da poi ka por ba la buh da u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka don hapoh ki nonghikai bad ki Lat haduh ka por ba la thung ia u kpa .

en: He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .
kha: Ki riewbymman ki khie lung kum ki ñiut ha ka sngi , kum ki ñiut kiba saphriang kylleng ka kper .
translated_en_to_kha: U long uba jyrngam ha khmat ka sngi , bad ka tnat jong u ka mih ha ka kper jong u .

en: He telleth the number of the stars  ; he calleth them all by their names .
kha: U rai ïa ka jingdon jong ki khlur bad u khot ïa uwei pa uwei da ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ia ka jingbun ki khlur ; u khot ia ki baroh da ki kyrteng jong ki .

en: Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko khun jong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei kaba dei ka jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Me namarkata ko khun jong nga to long uba skhem ha ka jingaiei kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .
kha: Wat ju kren ïa kano kano ka bymshisha . Kiar na kaba kren lamler bad na ki ktien kiba ïalam bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh na me ia ka shyntur kaba jem , bad ki rmiang shyntur kiba kylla ki la buh jngai na me .

en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver .
kha: Ka aiñ kaba me la ai ka kham kordor ïa nga ban ïa ka pisa baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hukum jong ka shyntur jong me ka kham bha ia nga ban ia ki hajar tylli ki ksiar bad rupa .

en: And I will set my tabernacle among you : and my soul shall not abhor you .
kha: Ngan shong hapdeng jong phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym phai noh na phi da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ka iing jong nga hapdeng jong phi: bad ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym shun ia phi .

en: The  Lord  is my portion , saith my soul  ; therefore will I hope in him .
kha: U  Trai  u long baroh kaba nga don , bad kumta nga buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long ka bynta jong nga , ong ka mynsiem jong nga ; namarkata ngan kyrmen ha u .

en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsngewbha iwei ia iwei pat da ka jingkyndit bakhuid . Ki balang U Khrist ki ai khublei ia phi .

en: I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;
kha: Mynta to shahshkor , ko Job , ïa kaei kaba nga tip ngan ïathuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pyni ia me , sngap ia nga ; bad ia kaba nga la iohi ngan pynbna ; .

en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .
kha: Ka Mari ka nong Magdala bad ka Mari ka kmie u Josis ki la khmih bad ïohi hangno ba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria Magdala bad ka Maria ka kmie u Joses ki la iohi ia ka jaka ba la buh ia u .

en: My breath is corrupt , my days are extinct , the graves are ready for me .
kha: Ka jingkut jong ka jingim jong nga ka la jan . Ngam sngewlah ring mynsiem bha shuh ; ym don ei ei shuh kaba sah na ka bynta jong nga , sa tang ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong nga ka long kaba bamsap, ki sngi jong nga ki la jah noh , ki jingtep ki long kiba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong nga .

en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .
kha: Phi ïohi , namarkata , ka dei da ki kam jong u ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha U Blei , ym tang da ka jingngeit jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi nangta kumno da ki kam u briew u long uba hok, bad ym da ka jingngeit tang .

en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and she called his name Onan .
kha: Ka punkhun biang bad ka la kha ïa uwei pat u khun shynrang , la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Onan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pun khun biang, bad ka la kha ia u khun shynrang ; bad ka la khot kyrteng ia u Onan .

en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him : talk ye of all his wondrous works .
kha: To rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; ïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ia u, to rwai ia u: kren ia ki kam phylla jong u baroh .

en: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .
kha: ‘ Ngam sngewkwah ,’ u la jubab , hynrei hadien , u la kylla ka jingmut bad u la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong: hynrei hadien u la kylla bamut bad u la leit noh .

en: Jesus , when he had cried again with a loud voice , yielded up the ghost .
kha: U Jisu u la lynñiar biang bad u la ring pynhiar mynsiem khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu haba u la iam biang da ka sur kaba jam , u la aiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :
kha: Haba u Methuselah u la dap shispah phraphew hynñiew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Lamekh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Methuselah u la im shispah hynriewphew hynriew snem:

en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .
kha: Thaw ïa ki jingker kiba pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki board na ka bynta ka iing jong ki dieng shittim kiba ieng .

en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end .
kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar shiteng kita ki jingker , u dei ban kot na kawei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bar pdeng hapdeng ki board kan poi naduh kaba kut haduh kaba kut .

en: His mother saith unto the servants , Whatsoever he saith unto you , do it .
kha: Ka kmie jong u Jisu te ka la ong ïa ki shakri ,  To leh kat kaba u ong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kmie jong u ka ong ha ki shakri , Kaei kaei kaba u ong ha phi , to leh ia kata .

en: They send forth their little ones like a flock , and their children dance .
kha: Ki khun jong ki , ki mareh bad ki ïalehkai kum ki khunlangbrot
translated_en_to_kha: Ki phah ia ki khun rit jong ki kum ka kynhun , bad ki khun jong ki ki shad .

en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
kha: Ïa u briew uba trei , la siew bainong ïa u , hynrei ym shym la ñiew ïa ka kum ka jingai sngewbha ; ka long kaei kaei kaba u la kamai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha uta uba trei kam la khein ia ka jingaiei hynrei ka ram .

en: And the chief seats in the synagogues , and the uppermost rooms at feasts :
kha: kiba jied ban buh jaka lypa ha ki synagog bad jied ïa ki jaka babha tam ha ki jingkhawai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jaka shong ba kongsan ha ki synagog bad ki kamra kiba shalor tam ha ki jingkhawai:

en: The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .
kha: Phi lah ban thain jaiñ na u  saiwul jong ki langbrot jong phi bad thied jaka da ka pisa kaba phi ïoh na kaba die na ki katto katne ki blang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki langbrot ki long na ka bynta ki jain jong me , bad ki blang ki long ka dor jong ka lyngkha .

en: ( Proverbs 1 :8 ) Jehovah requires a wife to care for her family lovingly .
kha: ( Proberb 1 :8 ) U Jehobah u kwah ïa ka tnga ban sumar sukher ïa la ka ïing ka sem da ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Proberb 1 :8 ) U Jehobah u donkam ia ka tnga ban sumar ia ka iing ka sem jong ka da ka jingieit .

en: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near , and accused the Jews .
kha: Ka dei ha kata ba katto katne ki nong Babilonia ki la shim kabu ban kren pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha kata ka por katto katne ki Chalded ki la wan hajan , bad ki la kynnoh ia ki Jiw .

en: I Nebuchadnezzar was at rest in mine house , and flourishing in my palace :
kha: Nga la shongsuk ha la ka ïing syiem , da kaba lehkmen ïa ka jingmanbha bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga Nebuchadnezzar nga la shongthait ha iing jong nga, bad nga la roi ha ka iing jong nga:

en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha kaba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  dei ban pynlong ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai kaba nyngkong ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait jong U Trai .

en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
kha: Un kren ki kyntien ha phi da kaba ma phi bad baroh ka longïing phin ïohlait im .’
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba iathuh ia me ia ki ktien , ha kaba ma me bad ka iing jong me baroh .

en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki pynlong mraw ïa ki khunswet ba dang rit bad ki shim ïa ki khun jong u briew uba duk kum ka jingsiew ïa ki ram .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim ia ki bym don kpa na ka sniehdoh , bad ki shim ia ka jingkular jong kiba duk .

en: Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .
kha: Da phikir kumno phi pyrkhat ; naba ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ki saiñdur ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia ka dohnud jong me da ka jingminot baroh namar na ka ki long ki mat jong ka jingim .

en: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding .
kha: La don hangta hajan , ka kynhun jong ki sniang kiba bun , kiba ïabam jingbam ha ka sharing lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la don hajan ki lum ka kynhun sniang kaba heh .

en: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
kha: U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngba u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ki la wan lyngba U Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hukum la ai da u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ka la wan da U Jisu Khrist .

en: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself , O God of Israel , the Saviour .
kha: U Blei ki Israel , uba pynim ïa la ki briew , u long U Blei uba buhrieh ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me long U Blei uba buhrieh ia lade , ko Blei jong ki Israel , U Nongpynim .

en: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?
kha: Te kumta kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khñiang ? u briew u long aïu ha ki khmat U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno u briew u long u khniang ? bad u khun u briew uba long u khniang ?

en: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession .
kha: Ha kane ka snem , ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem jong kane ka jubile phin pynphai biang ia uwei pa uwei sha ka jaka jong u .

en: And if the man have none to redeem it , and himself be able to redeem it  ;
kha: U briew u bym don ba-ha-ïing ban thied pat ïa ka , hadien habud haba u la manbha bad dap biang u lah ban thied pat ïa ka da lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uta u briew um don shuh ban siewspah ia ka, bad ma u hi u lah ban siewspah ia ka ; .

en: And every open vessel , which hath no covering bound upon it , is unclean .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u khra bad u khiew hapoh ka ïingjaiñ u bym don jingtap u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pa kawei ka lieng kaba plie, kaba khlem tap ia ka, ka long kaba khlem khuid .

en: For a servant when he reigneth  ; and a fool when he is filled with meat  ;
kha: u mraw uba kylla long syiem , u bieit uba u ïoh ban bam ïa baroh kat kaba u kwah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u shakri haba u synshar ; bad u bieit haba u dap da ka doh ; .

en: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .
kha: bad sa ar tylli ki jingker ïa ki dong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki board u la shna ia ki tduh jong ka Tabernak ha ki arliang .

en: For I know that the  Lord  is great , and that our Lord is above all gods .
kha: Nga tip ba U  Trai  u long uba khraw , kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba U Trai u long uba khraw , bad ba U Trai jong ngi u long halor ki blei baroh .

en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales , and they believed them not .
kha: Hynrei ki apostol ki la pyrkhat ba kaei kaba kita ki kynthei ki la ong ka long ka bym don jingmut , bad kim shym la ngeit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ktien jong ki ki long kumba ki long ki khanatang kiba khlem akor , bad kim ngeit ia ki .

en: For thou art my lamp , O  Lord  : and the  Lord  will lighten my darkness .
kha: Ma me , ko  Trai  , me long ka jingshai jong nga , me beh noh ïa ka jingdum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta me me long ka sharak jong nga , ko Trai: bad U Trai un pynshai ia ka jingdum jong nga .

en: And a fire was kindled in their company  ; the flame burned up the wicked .
kha: ka ding ka la hap halor ki nongbud jong ki bad thang duh ïa kito ki briew kiba bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la thang ia ka ding ha ka kynhun jong ki ; ka ding ka la thang ia kiba sniew .

en: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty , or the lawful captive delivered ?
kha: Hato pha lah ban shim noh ïa ka jinglute na u shipai ? Hato pha lah ban pyllait ïa ki koidi na u nongsynshar uba leh jubor ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato yn shim noh ia ka mrad na kiba khlain bor , ne ia u mraw ba la shah pynpoi katkum ka ain ?

en: If it be possible , as much as lieth in you , live peaceably with all men .
kha: To leh katbalah ïa kiei kiei baroh katba phi lah ban im ha ka jingïasuk bad ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kaba lah, katba ka don ha phi, to im suk im saiñ bad ki briew baroh .

en: If not , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .
kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to long jar jar bad shahshkor ïa nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi kumno ba phi long uba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ym dei, to sngap ia nga: to bat ia ka jingsuk jong me, bad ngan hikai ia me ia ka jingstad .

en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah khat-ar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi jong u Seth baroh ki long hynniew spah shiphew snem: bad u la iap .

en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .
kha: Te ka jingpynmihpat ka batai ïa ngi shaphang ka jingieit bad jingaiei jong U Jehobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka jingmihpat ka iathuh ia ngi shaphang ka jingieit bad ka jingbhabriew bym dei hok jong U Jehobah .

en: And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .
kha: U Heber u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Japhlet , u Shomer , bad u Hotham , bad kawei ka khun , ka Shua .
translated_en_to_kha: U Heber u la kha ia u Japhet, bad u Shomer, bad u Hotham, bad u Shua ka para jong ki.

en: To make the weight for the winds  ; and he weigheth the waters by measure .
kha: Haba U Blei u ai ha ka lyer ïa ka bor jong ka , bad ba u kheiñ ïa ka jingheh jong ka duriaw ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynlong ia ka jingkhia na ka bynta ki Iyer ; bad u thew ia ki um da kaba thew .

en: Then went Samson to Gaza , and saw there an harlot , and went in unto her .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Samson u leit sha Gasa , ka shnong ki Philistia , hangta u ïakynduh ïa ka nuti bad u leit ïathiah bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samson u la leit sha Gaza , bad u la iohi hangta ia kawei ka jaka bad u la leit shapoh jong ka .

en: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;
kha: To ai ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkmen ha ka jingkyrmen;

en: By humility and the fear of the  Lord  are riches , and honour , and life .
kha: To kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , da kaba pynrit , bad phin ïoh ïa ka spah , ka burom , bad ka jingim kaba jlan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jinglong rit mynsiem bad ka jingtieng ia U Trai ki long ki spah , bad ka burom bad ka jingim .

en: Before him went the pestilence , and burning coals went forth at his feet .
kha: U phah ïa ka jingpang ha shuwa jong u bad hukum ba ka jingïap kan bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat jong u la leit sha ka jingpang khlam , bad ki dewiong kiba thang ki la leit sha khmat ha ki kjat jong u .

en: The depth saith , It is not in me : and the sea saith , It is not with me .
kha: Ki jingjylliew jong ki duriaw-bah bad ki duriaw-rit , ki ong ba ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjylliew ka ong , Kam don ha nga: bad ka duriaw ka ong , Kam don bad nga .

en: And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .
kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khlam bad u la shu ïeng hapdeng kiba im bad kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ieng hapdeng kiba iap bad kiba im ; bad ka khlam ka la sah .

en: An high look , and a proud heart , and the plowing of the wicked , is sin .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki shah synshar ha la ka hangamei bad ka jingsngewmeng , bad kane ka long pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpeit kaba jrong , bad ka dohnud kaba sngew sarong , bad ka jingtuid jong kiba sniew , ka long ka pop .

en: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga don ka jingtip bad ka bor pyrkhat kaba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga shong ha ka jingstad kaba stad , bad nga lap ia ka jingtip shaphang ki jingpynmih kiba stad .

en: And Lot also , which went with Abram , had flocks , and herds , and tents .
kha: U Lot ruh u la don ki langbrot , ki blang , ki masi , bad kumjuh ruh la ka jong ka longïing longsem bad ki shakri shakor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lot ruh uba la leit bad u Abram, u don ki langbrot bad ki kynhun bad ki ïingjaiñ .

en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :
kha: ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad Keilah bad u Achzib bad u Maresh ; hynniew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart .
kha: Ngan kohnguh da kaba angnud eh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar men ai shuh shuh ka jingshemphang ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iaid ia ka lynti jong ki hukum jong me , haba me pynheh ia ka dohnud jong nga .

en: I will praise thee : for thou hast heard me , and art become my salvation .
kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A  Trai  , namar me la ïohsngew ïa nga , bad me la ai ka jingjop ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iaroh ia me: namar me la iohsngew ia nga, bad me la kylla long ka jingpynim jong nga .

en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .
kha: Haba nga ïohi ïa ki bymman ba ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong me , nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ka la bat ia nga namar ki bymman kiba iehnoh ia ka hukum jong me .

en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
kha: Hadien la wan poi kita kiwei pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki la pyrta jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata la wan ruh kiwei pat ki nongleh kam sniew, ki da ong, ko Trai, ko Trai, to plie ia ngi .

en: In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .
kha: Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyllait im ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , bad kin ai ka jingïaroh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha U Trai baroh u symbai Israel un long uba hok bad un don ka burom .

en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .
kha: U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñ eh ba baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka ryndang jong u ka sah ka jingkhlain , bad ka jingsngewsih ka kylla long ka jingkmen ha khmat jong u .

en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the  Lord s  passover .
kha: Ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ïa kaba ju rakhe ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , ka sdang ha ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba nyngkong ha ka por mynstep ka long ka jingkhawai Niam U Trai .

en: But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
kha: Hynrei ka jingisynei U Blei ka shlei katta katta , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei uba riewspah ha ka jingisynei , na ka bynta ka jingieit kaba khraw jong u ha kaba u la ieit ia ngi .

en: And thou sayest , How doth God know ? can he judge through the dark cloud ?
kha: Bad pynban phi kylli ,  Aïu U Blei u tip ? la buhrieh ïa u ha ki lyoh — kumno u lah ban bishar ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me ong , Kumno U Blei U tip ? u lah ban bishar lyngba ka lyoh kaba dum ?

en: Answer a fool according to his folly , lest he be wise in his own conceit .
kha: Ai ka jubab bieit ïa ka jingkylli bieit , bad uta uba kylli ïa ka un sngewthuh ba um long uba stad kumba u pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Jubab ia u briew uba bieit kat kum ka jinglong bieit jong u , ioh ba un long uba stad ha la ka jong ka jingmut .

en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .
kha: Lada uno uno u bitar ïa phi , ka jingai sngewbha kaba ai ha kaba rieh ka pynjem jai ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai ha ka jingbitar kaba rieh: bad ka bainong ha ka kpoh kaba khlain .

en: In thee , O  Lord  , do I put my trust : let me never be put to confusion .
kha: A  Trai  , nga la wan ha me ban ïoh jingïada ; wat shah da lei lei ba ngan shahjop !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha me, ko Trai, nga buh ia ka jingshaniah jong nga: wat ai ba ngan ym shah pynkulmar .

en: The  Lord  lifteth up the meek : he casteth the wicked down to the ground .
kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba sngewrit , hynrei u pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u pynkiew ia ka jingjem: u bret ia kiba sniew shapoh khyndew .

en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes , and the deaf that have ears .
kha: U Blei u ong ,  Khot hajir ïa ki briew jong nga sha ïingbishar . Ki don ki khmat hynrei ki long kiba matlah ; ki don ki shkor hynrei ki long kiba kyllut !
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah ia ki briew kiba matlah kiba don ki khmat , bad kiba sngap jar kiba don ki shkor .

en: Therefore, it said it looks forward to the full implementation of the Bill.
kha: Kumta, ka ong ba ka khmih lynti ban pyntreikam pura noh ïa katei ka Bill.
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la ong ba ka khmih lynti ia ka jingpyntreikam pura ia ka Bill.

en: And Elimelech Naomi s husband died  ; and she was left , and her two sons .
kha: u Elimelekh u la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh marwei bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: U lok jong ka Elimech u la iap ; bad ka la sah noh bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong ka .

en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?
kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin ïai im ha ka pop ba ka jingaiei U Blei kan nang khraw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ong aiu te ? Hato ngin iai bteng ha ka pop , ba ka jingaiei kan nang bun ?

en: And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,
kha: Kumta u Joseph u la shim ïa ka , u la spaiñ da ka jaiñ linen kaba thymmai ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la shim ia ka met bad u la tap ia ka da ka jain lin kaba khuid .

en: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist .
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba u la kren ha ki shaphang u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran ki sngewthuh ba u la kren ha ki shaphang u loannis u Nongpynbaptis .

en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .
kha: Ka nongbah ka long hapdeng ka jingjot , bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pyntwa noh .
