translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka nongbah la iehnoh ia ka jingpynjot , bad ka khyrdop ka la shah pynjot .

en: A wise man s heart is at his right hand  ; but a fool s heart at his left .
kha: Ka long kaba ju long ba u briew uba stad u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad uba bieit u leh ïa ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u don ha ka liang kadiang jong u ; hynrei ka dohnud kaba bieit ha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :
kha: Kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ki la ïakren bad u . Ki la long u Moses bad u Elijah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki la ia kren bad u arngut ki briew kiba long u Moses bad u Elias:

en: I write not these things to shame you , but as my beloved sons I warn you .
kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi , ym namar ba nga kwah ban pynlehrain ïa phi , hynrei ban sneng ïa phi kum ki khun ba-ieit jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam thoh ia kine kiei kiei ban pynjah burom ia phi , hynrei kum ki khun baieit jong nga nga maham ia phi .

en: If the scourge slay suddenly , he will laugh at the trial of the innocent .
kha: Haba uba lui lui u ïap kynsan , U Blei u rkhie .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka jingsma ka sdang kynsan kynsan , un rkhie bein ia ka jingbishar ia ki bym don pop .

en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .
kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u leit sha Ramoth ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta uta u samla, wat u samla u nongiathuhlypa ruh u la leit sha Ramothgilead .

en: But first must he suffer many things , and be rejected of this generation .
kha: Hynrei , nyngkong u dei ban shahshitom shikatdei eh bad ban shah kyntait da ki briew jong kane ka pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nyngkong eh u dei ban shah shitom bun kiei kiei , bad shah kyntait na kane ka pateng .

en: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: U Hesekaïah u phai ïa la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la phai ia la ka khmat sha ka jingkhang bad u la duwai ha U Trai da kaba ong:

en: And he shall say , Where are their gods , their rock in whom they trusted ,
kha: Te U  Trai  un ong ha la ki briew , ‘ Shaei kito ki blei khrawbor ha kiba phi shaniah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ong , Hangno ki blei jong ki , u maw jong ki ha uba ki shaniah , .

en: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel , Give counsel among you what we shall do .
kha: Nangta u Absalom u phai sha u Ahithophel bad u ong ,  Mynta ba ngi don hangne , kaei ka jingai jingmut jong phi ïa ngi ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Absalom ha u Ahitophel , Ai jingmut hapdeng jong phi ia kaei kaba ngin leh .

en: We should not say our prayers from memory or read them from a prayer book .
kha: Ngim dei ban duwai da kaba spel lyndet lane pule na ka kot jingduwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngim dei ban ong ia ki jingduwai jong ngi na ka jingkynmaw ne pule ia ki na ka kot jingduwai .

en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment , which was inflicted of many .
kha: Ka la biang ba ïa une u briew la pynshitom ha kane ka rukom da kiba bun na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka biang ia kum une u briew ka long kane ka jingpynshitom , kaba la pynshitom ia kiba bun .

en: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father , and given them to me .
kha: U Blei u la shim noh ïa ki kynhun jingri na i pa jong phi bad u la ai ïa ki ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Blei u la shim noh ia ki masi jong u kpa jong phi bad u la ai ia ki ha nga .

en: And he answered him , I am : go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .
kha: Ho-oid , nga dei u Elijah ,  u jubab .  Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem , u kynrad jong phi ba nga don hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia u, nga long: leit, to iathuh ia u kynrad jong me, Ha khmih, u Elijah u don hangne .

en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him , Beth–el .
kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka jaka ba U Blei u la kren bad u, u Bethel .

en: Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?
kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba me dei u briew uba nyngkong ba la kha napdeng u khunbynriew ? Hato me don hangta mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa ki lumbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me long u briew uba nyngkong uba la kha ? lane me la thaw ha khmat ki lum ?

en: Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .
kha: Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei phin ym shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynjot ka wan ; bad kin wad ia ka jingsuk , bad kan ym don .

en: If you are not satisfied with the resolution, we can escalate this further.
kha: Lada phim sngewhun ïa ka jingpynbeit, ngi lah ban pynjur shuh shuh ïa kane.
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim sngewhun ia ka jingpynbeit, ngi lah ban pynjur shuh shuh ia kane.

en: The word “devil” means someone who tells wicked lies about another person .
kha: Ka Ktien “ksuid” kamut uno uno uba kren lamler shaphang kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyntien devil ka mut u briew uba iathuh ia ki jinglamler kiba sniew shaphang uwei pat u briew .

en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .
kha: Na Miletos u Paul u la phah khubor sha Ephesos , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki nongsharai balang    , ban ïakynduh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na Mileos u la phah sha Ephesos bad u la khot ia ki rangbah jong ka balang .

en: And this is the writing that was written , MENE , MENE , TEKEL , UPHARSIN .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : ‘ Ka dak jingkheiñ , ka dak jingkheiñ , ka jingthew , ki jingbynta .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka dei ka jingthoh kaba la thoh , MENE , MENE , TEKEL , UPHARSIN .

en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
kha: U Jephthah u phah nonglamktien biang sha u syiem Ammon
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la phah pat sha u syiem ki khun Ammon:

en: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me , wat la baroh kiwei pat kin leh kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u, Wat la baroh kin sngewsih hynrei ngan ym sngewsih .

en: An estimated Rs 1 , 500 crore of investment would be mobilised through this
kha: La antad ba T.1, 500 klur ka jingbei tyngka yn pynmih lyngba kane .
translated_en_to_kha: La antad ba 1 , 500 klur tyngka yn sa pynkhih lyngba kane .

en: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ?
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi lut ïa ka buit jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la sngewthuh ia ka jingstad jong ki bad u la ong ha ki: Balei phi pynshoi ia nga ?

en: We’re investigating the delay in your delivery and will update you shortly.
kha: Ngi dang tohkit ïa ka jingpynslem ïa ka jingpynpoi jong phi bad ngin sa pyntip ïa phi shen.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi dang wad bniah ia ka jingpynslem ha ka jingpynpoi jong phi bad ngin sa pynthymmai ia phi tang khyndiat por.

en: I remembered thy judgments of old , O  Lord   ; and have comforted myself .
kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ki jingbishar jong me kiba mynbarim , bad ki wallam jingpyntngen ïa nga , A  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kynmaw ia ki jingbishar jong me kiba rim , ko Trai ; bad nga la pyntngen ia lade .

en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash .
kha: Ki Philistia ki la phah kawei ka kynhun shipai ban ïada ïa ka khim Mikhmash .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la leit sha ka lynti jong u Michmash .

en: Therefore let us not sleep , as do others ; but let us watch and be sober .
kha: Kumta te , ngim dei ban ïohthiah kum kiwei pat ; ngi dei ban peitmat bad pyngngad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to ngin ym thiah kumba leh kiwei pat; hynrei to ngin peit bad ngin long kiba jem .

en: The bands of the wicked have robbed me : but I have not forgotten thy law .
kha: Ki bymman ki la buh ka jingriam ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym klet ïa ka aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynhun jong ki bymman ki la lute ia nga: hynrei ngam shym la klet ia ka hukum jong me .

en: And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;
kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada jong nga , u long ka kut baskhem jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , U Trai u long u maw jong nga, bad ka kut jong nga, bad u nongpyllait im jong nga;

en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! they say of me , Doth he not speak parables ?
kha: Hynrei nga la pyrshah ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynlong ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! Uwei uwei baroh u la lah khñium ba nga ju kren borabor ha ki jingkyntip .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , Ah Trai Blei ! ki ong shaphang jong nga , Hato um kren pharshi ?

en: And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .
kha: Une u long uta U Jisu u nongïathuhlypa , uba na Nasareth ha Galilaïa ,  ki paidbah ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah u la ong: Une u long U Jisu u nongiathuhlypa jong ka Nazareth jong ka Galilaia .

en: That thou mayest regard discretion , and that thy lips may keep knowledge .
kha: Te phin sa nang kumno ban leh donakor , bad ki ktien jong phi kin pynpaw ba phi don ka jingtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban pyrkhat ia ka jingstad, bad ba ki rmiang shyntur jong me kin bat ia ka jingtip .

en: They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :
kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; bad ki khmut , hynrei kim lah ban iw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim iohsngew: ki nos ki don ia ki , hynrei kim sngap jar:

en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity , what is man the better ?
kha: Katba phi dang ïania slem , katta ka dang long ka bymmyntoi , bad phim shym long uba kham bit kham biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba iohi ba ki don bun kiei kiei kiba pynkiew ia ka jinglong bieit , kaei kaba kham bha ia u briew ?

en: And these words , which I command thee this day , shall be in thine heart :
kha: Wat klet lano lano ïa kine ki hukum ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki ktien kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi kin long ha ka dohnud jong me:

en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .
kha: Kumba u Moses u la kyntiew ïa u  seiñ rnong ha u dieng ha ka ri shyiap , ha kajuh ka rukom ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn kyntiew shajrong , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym jah noh , hynrei un ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die , but after this the judgment :
kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ïap tang shisien , bad hadien kata yn bishar da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba la buh ia ki briew shisien ban iap , hynrei hadien kane ka jingbishar:

en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom  ; I have led thee in right paths .
kha: Nga la hikai ha phi ïa ka jingstad bad ka rukom im kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la hikai ia me ha ka lynti jong ka jingstad ; nga la ialam ia me ha ki lynti kiba dei .

en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .
kha: Baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong me , bad baroh kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom jong nga la pynpaw lyngba jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jong nga baroh ki long ki jong me, bad me long ki jong nga ; bad nga la pyndonburom ha ki .

en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kane ka long kumno kan jia ha kito kiba kynton ka spah na ka bynta ïa lade hynrei ki bym riewspah ha ka jingkhmih jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh uta uba buh ia ka spah na ka bynta lade , bad um long uba riewspah ha U Blei .

en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
kha: Nangta u Moses u buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong sha mihngi na wah Jordan
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la ot lai tylli ki nongbah ha kane ka liang Jordan sha ka liang ka sngi kaba mih;

en: Please refer to our terms and conditions for more details about warranties.
kha: Sngewbha peit ïa ki kyndon bad ki jingpynbeit jong ngi na ka bynta ki jingtip ba kham bnïah shaphang ki waranti.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha peit ia ki kyndon bad ki jinglong jong ngi na ka bynta ki jingtip ba kham bniah shaphang ki jingkular.

en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .
kha: Wat ong ei ei , bad don ki ban pyrkhat ba me long uba stad !
translated_en_to_kha: O ba phin bat pura ia ka jingsuk jong phi ! bad ka dei ban long ka jingstad jong phi .

en: Even the life of an unborn child inside its mother is precious to Jehovah .
kha: Wat ka jingim jong i khyllung i bym pat kha i ba don hakpoh jong ka kmie ruh i long iba kordor hakhmat U Jehobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka jingim jong u khunlung ba dang kha hapoh ka kmie jong u ka long kaba kordor ha U Jehobah .

en: They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters  ;
kha: Katto katne ki leit da ka liengbah halor ka duriaw-bah , ki trei na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki ha ki duriaw-rit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba leit sha duriaw ha ki lieng , kiba leh ia ka kam ha ki um kiba heh ; .

en: Then went Abimelech to Thebez , and encamped against Thebez , and took it .
kha: Nangta u Abimelekh u leit sha Thebes , u kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , bad u kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abimelech u la leit sha Thebes , bad u la shong ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka Thebes bad u la shim ia ka .

en: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , ka jait Ephraim bad ka jait Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , ki la ïohpdiang ïa kane ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khun u Joseph , u Manasseh bad u Ephram ki la shim ia ka pateng jong ki .

en: If thou wilt send our brother with us , we will go down and buy thee food :
kha: Lada phi kloi ban phah ïa u para jong ngi bad ngi , ngin leit thied bam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me phah ia u hynmen jong ngi bad ngi , ngin leit hiar bad thied jingbam ia me:

en: And I will make all my mountains a way , and my highways shall be exalted .
kha: Ngan shna ïa ka surok bah halor ki lumbah bad pynkhreh ïa ka lynti ba ki briew jong nga kin ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ki lum jong nga baroh, bad ki surok bah jong nga kin nang kiew .

en: Then call thou , and I will answer : or let me speak , and answer thou me .
kha: To kren nyngkong , A Blei , bad ngan jubab . Lane to shah ngan kren , bad to jubab ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to khot ia me , bad ngan jubab: lane to ai ba ngan kren , bad to jubab ia nga .

en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?
kha: Hato me lah ban pyndap ïa ka snieh jong u da ki sum pynïap dohkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban pyndap ia ka sniehdoh jong u da ki nar ba la shet ? lane ka khlieh jong u da ki khnam dohkha ?

en: And he called the multitude , and said unto them ,  Hear , and understand :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa ki paidbah sha u bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor bad to shemphang !
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia u paidbah bad u la ong ha ki: To sngap bad sngewthuh:

en: If he hath wronged thee , or oweth thee ought , put that on mine account  ;
kha: Lada u la leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa me lane u dang don ka ram ban siew ïa me , shim ïa kata na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u la leh bakla ia me, ne u la leh ia kata na ka bynta jong nga;

en: I feel very privileged and honoured to have worked with him in many films .
kha: Nga sngew ba nga long uba kyrpang bad uba donburom ban iatreilang bad u ha kiba bun ki phlim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngew ba nga long uba donbok bad uba sngew sarong shibun ban iatreilang bad u ha kiba bun ki phlim .

en: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim , spoiling and great destruction .
kha: Ki paid ka Horonaim ki kyang , ‘ Ka Jinglehbor ! Ka Jingpynjot !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka jingpyrta kan long na Horonaim , ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw .

en: I find then a law , that , when I would do good , evil is present with me .
kha: Kumta nga shem ba kane ka hukum ka treikam ; haba nga kwah ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , kaei kaba sniew ka long tang ma ka , ka jingjied kaba nga don .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga shem ha kata ka por ia ka ain, kata, haba nga leh bha, kaba sniew ka don ryngkat bad nga .

en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
kha: Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka long kum katei : ‘ Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ïa lade .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba ar ka long kum ma ka , Me dei ban ieit ia la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ia lade .

en: For I have given you an example , that ye should do as I have done to you .
kha: Nga la pyn-i ka nuksa ïa phi , ba phin leh kumba nga la leh ma nga ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la ai nuksa ia phi , ba phi dei ban leh kumba nga la leh ia phi .

en: Iron sharpeneth iron  ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .
kha: Ki briew ki ïoh jinghikai uwei na uwei pat , kumba u nar u pynnep ïa u nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Iron u pynkhih ia ka nar kumta u briew u pynkhih ia ka khmat jong u paralok jong u .

en: The equity shares are proposed to be listed on the Emerge platform of NSE .
kha: Ia ki bynta jong ka equity la tyrwa ban buh kyrteng ha ka rynsan Emerge jong ka NSE .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ki bhah jong ka equity la tyrwa ban buh kyrteng ha ka rynsan jong ka NSE .

en: And it was told Joab , Behold , the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Joab ba u Syiem Dabid u jaw ummat bad u ïambriew na ka bynta u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ia ka Joab , Ha khmih u syiem u iam bad u iam na ka bynta u Absalom .

en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  Ha kane ka por balyngkot , hato me pyrkhat ba men pynlong Khristan ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul , La jan me pynsngewbha ia nga ban long u Khristan .

en: And delivered just Lot , vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked :
kha: U la pyllait im ïa u Lot , u briew uba bha , uba la pisa jingmut da ka jinglong bajakhlia jong ki briew bymkheiñ ïa ka aiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynpoi tang ia u Lot, u la sngewsih ia ka jingiakren kaba jakhlia jong kiba sniew:

en: And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;
kha: Ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynsiem , kumba phi trei na ka bynta U Trai bad ym na ka bynta ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba phi leh, to leh da ka dohnud, kumba long ha U Trai, bad ym ha ki briew;

en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife : and Jacob went in unto her .
kha: Kumta ka ai ïa ka Bilhah ha u tnga jong ka , bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ai ia u ia u Bilhah ka nongtrei jong ka ha ka tnga: bad u Jakob u la rung shapoh jong ka .

en: See , I have set before thee this day life and good , and death and evil  ;
kha: Mynta ka sngi nga ai ba phin jied napdeng kaba bha bad kaba sniew , napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit , nga la buh ha khmat jong me ha kane ka sngi ka jingim bad ka jingbha , bad ka jingiap bad ka jingsniew ; .

en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night , the manna fell upon it .
kha: Ka hap ha ka jaka shong dara mynmiet ryngkat bad ka umjer . Ha ka step kaba bud ki briew ki leit kylleng kylleng ban khar ïa ka , ki tylliat ïa ka lane dung pynni ïa ka , bad nangta ki shet bad pynlong kpu stang ïa ka . Ka jingmad ka long kum u kpu ba la shet ha ka umphniang Olib . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka dew ka la hap ha ka shnong ha ka por miet , ka manna ka la hap halor jong ka .

en: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .
kha: Un ym im ban ïohi ïa ki wah ka umphniang Olib lane ïa ki wahduid kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym iohi ia ki wah , ki wahduid , ki wah umsoh bad ka umsoh .

en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
kha: U Philip u la leit bad u la ïathuh ha u Andriw , bad baroh ar ngut ki la leit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u wan bad u Androd: bad sa shisien u Androd bad u Philip ki iathuh ia U Jisu .

en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :
kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi kam dei kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingbakla lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingkyntu jong ngi kam shym la long kaba thok, ne kaba khlem khuid:

en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord ? or who hath been his counsellor ?
kha: Uei uba tip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Uei uba lah ban ai jingmut ïa U ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba tip ia ka jingmut U Trai ? lane mano ba la long u nongai jingmut jong u ?

en: For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ngat ha ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingthoh ka ong , Uno uno uba ngeit ia u un ym sngewlehrain .

en: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .
kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingsuk , bad uwei pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew baroh kawei ka don ha ka jingjahthait , bad ka sngap jar: ki bthei sha ka jingrwai .

en: And Moses laid up the rods before the  Lord  in the tabernacle of witness .
kha: Nangta u Moses u buh ïa kita ki diengduh baroh hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la buh ia ki dieng ha khmat U Trai ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka

en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba pdiang ïa ka khubor jong u , u pynskhem da kane ba U Blei u long uba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la ioh ia ka jingphla jong u u la buh ha ka muhor jong u ba U Blei U long uba shisha .

en: Know now that God hath overthrown me , and hath compassed me with his net .
kha: Hato phim lah ban ïohi ba dei U Blei uba la leh ïa kane ? U la buh ïa ka jingriam ban kem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip mynta ba U Blei u la pynhap ia nga , bad u la ker sawdong ia nga da ka net jong u .

en: They have mouths , but they speak not : eyes have they , but they see not :
kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban kren ; bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim kren: ki khmat ki don: hynrei kim iohi:

en: And Saul s uncle said , Tell me , I pray thee , what Samuel said unto you .
kha: Bad kaei u ïathuh ïa phi ?  u kñi u Saul u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong, Iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, kaei kaba u Samuel u la ong ha phi .

en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
kha: Ki neh slem ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ieng skhem junom bad junom , bad la leh ia ki ha ka jingshisha bad ka jinglong beit .

en: To know wisdom and instruction  ; to perceive the words of understanding  ;
kha: Kine ki long ki proberb ki ban ïarap ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingstad bad ka jinghikai kaba bha , bad ban shemphang ïa ki jingong kiba jylliew jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban tip ia ka jingstad bad jinghikai ; ban sngewthuh ia ki kyntien jong ka jingsngewthuh ; .

en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ , let him be Anathema Maranatha .
kha: Uno uno u bym ieit ïa U Trai — to long ka jingtim ïa u ! Marana tha  — U Trai jong ngi , u wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew um ieit ia U Trai Jisu Khrist , to ai ba un long u Anathema Maranatha .

en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end , the first and the last .
kha: Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u Alpha bad u Omega , ka jingsdang bad ka jingkut , kaba nyngkong bad kaba khatduh .

en: And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .
kha: Nangta u kpa jong u , u ong ha u ,  Ale kham hajan ko khun bad to doh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u u Isaak u la ong ha u, To wan hajan mynta, bad to kdup ia nga ko khun jong nga .

en: He shall be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .
kha: Yn sa beh noh ïa u na ka ri jong kiba im , yn sa beh noh na ka jingshai sha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Un shah beh noh na ka jingshai sha ka jingdum , bad un shah beh noh na ka pyrthei .

en: Police have registered a case of murder and started further investigation .
kha: Ki pulit ki la register ia ka case pyniap briew bad ki la sdang ia ka jingtohkit kaba bniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ki la register ia ka kam pyniap briew bad sdang ban tohkit shuh shuh .

en: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?
kha: Hynrei hangno lah ban shem ïa ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shano yn shem ia ka jingstad ? bad shano ka jaka jong ka jingsngewthuh ?

en: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ong ,  Ka jubab kaba dei , ko Nonghikai !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta katto katne na ki nongthoh ki la jubab: Ko Nonghikai, me la ong bha .

en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .
kha: Man ka snem ki kmie ki kpa jong U Jisu ki leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki leit sha Jerusalem man la u snem ha ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait .

en: Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .
kha: Bad haba nga la kyrpad ïa me ban shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga , me la ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga: wat buhrieh ia ka shkor jong me ha ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga .

en: For that they hated knowledge , and did not choose the fear of the  Lord  :
kha: Phim ju sngew donkam ïa ka jingtip bad borabor phi kyntait ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ki la shun ia ka jingtip , bad kim shym la jied ia ka jingtieng ia U Trai:

en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments , and of the fishes .
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la ïalum khat-ar tukri kiba dap da kaei kaba la sah tam na u kpu bad ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim shiphew tylli ki basket kiba dap da ki bniat bad ki dohkha .

en: He hath filled me with bitterness , he hath made me drunken with wormwood .
kha: Ka jingshah shitom bakthang ka long baroh kaba u la ai ïa nga kum ka jingbam bad jingdih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyndap ia nga da ka jingsngewsih , u la pynlong ia nga ban dih kyiad da ka sniehdoh .

en: If God will not withdraw his anger , the proud helpers do stoop under him .
kha: Ka jingbitar U Blei ka ïaineh . U pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong u kiba ïarap ïa u Rahab , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw , uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada U Blei un ym weng noh ia ka jingbitar jong u , ki nongiarap kiba sngew sarong ki dem hapoh jong u .

en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .
kha: Khie leit suk leit saiñ ,  u Elisha u ong . Bad u Naaman u leit noh . U la leit dang khyndiat ka jingjngai ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, To leit suk . Kumta u la leit noh na u khyndiat .

en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long ki mraw jong u briew bariewspah , pan kylliang pisa bad phin long u mraw jong u nongai ram .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsynshar kaba riewspah halor kiba duk , bad u nongshim ram u long u shakri ia u nongai ram .

en: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments  ; for therein do I delight .
kha: Pynlong ïa nga ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar ha ki nga shem ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia nga ban iaid ha ka lynti jong ki hukum jong me ; namar ha kata nga sngewbha .

en: All go unto one place  ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .
kha: Baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka — ka khyndew . Baroh ar ki la wan na ka bad baroh ar kin leit phai pat sha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki leit sha kawei ka jaka ; baroh ki long na ka dewmet , bad baroh ki kylla dewbilat biang .

en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship .
kha: bad ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la bret noh katto katne ki bynta jong ki tiar ki tar jong ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba lai ngi bret noh da la ki jong ki kti ia ka jingkhang ia ka lieng .

en: And Abraham stretched forth his hand , and took the knife to slay his son .
kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka tari ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la shim ia ka wait ban pyniap ia la u khun .

en: Enter not into the path of the wicked , and go not in the way of evil men .
kha: Wat leit sha kaba ki riewsniew ki leit . Wat pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki riewbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat rung ha ka lynti jong kiba sniew , bad wat leit ha ka lynti jong ki briew kiba sniew .

en: The batsman opted for DRS , but the decision stayed in England ' s favour .
kha: Utei u nongtied u la jied ia ka DRS , hynrei ka rai ka sah ha ka liang jong ka England .
translated_en_to_kha: U batsman u la jied ia ka DRS , hynrei ka rai ka la sah ha ka jingsngewtynnat jong ka England .

en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :
kha: Ym pat la ïalam bakla ïa nga ban burom ïa ki da kaba doh ïa la ki kti kum ka jingnguh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah pynkhih rieh , ne ka shyntur jong nga ka la kdup ia ka kti jong nga:

en: Now concerning spiritual gifts , brethren , I would not have you ignorant .
kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki jingai na U Mynsiem Bakhuid . Nga kwah ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong ki , ko parabangeit jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kaba iadei bad ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem, ko para bangeit, ngan ym don ia phi ki bym tip .

en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
kha: Hynrei lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kaba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ngi kyrmen ba ngin ym iohi , te hato ngi ap ia ka da ka jingshaniah .

en: And the light shineth in darkness  ; and the darkness comprehended it not .
kha: Ka jingshai ka shai ha kaba dum , bad ka jingdum kam lah ban pynlip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingshai ka shai ha ka jingdum ; bad ka jingdum kam sngewthuh ia ka .

en: I clothe the heavens with blackness , and I make sackcloth their covering .
kha: Nga lah ban pyndum ïa ka suiñbneng , ban ïohi kumba ka ïambriew namar kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga phong ia ki bneng da ka jingdum , bad nga pynlong ia ka jingtap jong ki .

en: Matthew and Thomas , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon called Zelotes ,
kha: u Matthaïos bad u Thomas , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , bad u Simon ( ïa uba la khot , u Riew-ieit ri ) .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mathaios bad u Thomas , u Jakob u khun u Alphaeus bad u Simon u ba la khot u Selotes .

en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag , and thou sewest up mine iniquity .
kha: Men map ïa ki bad men weng noh sharud ïa ki ; men ñiad noh ïa ki jingbakla baroh ba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleh bymman jong nga ka la sahkut ha ka pla , bad me shna ia ka jingbymhok jong nga .

en: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .
kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw sha la ka jong shnong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung ha ka lieng bad u la iaid lait noh bad u la wan sha la ka jong ka shnong .

en: He added : My Congress brothers and sisters , you have made me very proud .
kha: U la bynrap : Ko para Congress jong nga phi la pynsarong shibun ia nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bynrap: Ki hynmen ki para jong nga ka Congress , phi la pynlong ia nga ban sngew sarong shibun .

en: Wealth maketh many friends  ; but the poor is separated from his neighbour .
kha: Borabor kiba riewspah ki ïakynduh ïa ki paralok kiba thymmai , hynrei kiba duk kim lah ban bat ïa kiba khyndiat ngut kiba ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah ka pynlong bun ki paralok ; hynrei u baduk u la iakhlad noh na u para marjan jong u .

en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the  Lord  than sacrifice .
kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba beit ; kaba kham pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ban ïa kaba wallam sha u ïa ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban leh ia ka hok bad ka jingbishar ka kham pdiang ia U Trai ban ia ka jingknia .

en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .
kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la wan poi na Galilaïa bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u wan na Galilaia sha Jordan sha u Ioannis , ban shah pynbaptis na u .

en: There they cry , but none giveth answer , because of the pride of evil men .
kha: Ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , hynrei U Blei um jubab , naba ki long kiba sarong bad ba-bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki iam , hynrei ym don ba ai jubab , namar ka jingsarong jong ki briew kiba sniew .

en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  ,
kha: U Hesekaïah u phai la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hesekaiah u la phai sha ka kynroh bad u la duwai ha U Trai .

en: Even to day is my complaint bitter : my stroke is heavier than my groaning .
kha: Nga dang ïaleh pyrshah bad khñium pyrshah ïa U Blei ; ngam lah ban kun ïa ka jingud jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat haduh mynta ka sngi ruh ka jingujor jong nga ka kham jur: ka stroke jong nga ka kham heh ban ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done .
kha: Ki la ïalumlang ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma me da ka bor bad ka mon jong me , me la lah thmu ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ban leh ia kaei kaei kaba ka kti bad ka jingmut jong me ka la kut jingmut shuwa ban leh .

en: And God remembered Rachel , and God hearkened to her , and opened her womb .
kha: Nangta U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Rakhel ; u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka bad u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kynmaw ia ka Rakhel , bad U Blei u la sngap ia ka bad u la plie ia ka kpoh jong ka .

en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka la don ka jingkhawai jong ki Jiw ; bad U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .

en: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the  Lord  exceedingly .
kha: bad u la sher dara hajan ka Sodom , kaba ki briew jong ka , ki la long kiba bymman bad kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Sodom ki long kiba sniew bad ki nongpop ha khmat U Trai palat .

en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad  ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .
kha: Phi lah ban long uba stad , hynrei lada phi shukor ïano ïano , phi leh la kum u bieit . Lada phi shim klop , phi pynjot ïa la ka jinglong jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka jingshah lehbein ka pynlong ia u briew uba stad ban mad ; bad ka jingai ka pynjot ia ka dohnud .

en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favour with God and man .
kha: U Jisu u la nang san ha ka met bad ha ka jingstad , da kaba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei lem bad ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la nang kiew ha ka jingstad bad ka jinglong , bad ha ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei bad u briew .

en: Jesus then cometh , and taketh bread , and giveth them , and fish likewise .
kha: Te U Jisu u la leit sha khmat , u la shim ïa u kpu , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki ; u leh kumjuh ruh bad kita ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu nangta u wan, bad u shim ia u kpu, bad u ai ia ki, bad ki dohkha kumjuh .

en: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .
kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingkhang rnong bad pynpra ïa ki nar kiba ker .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynpra ia ki khyrdop nar , bad u la ot ia ki nar nar ha ka dewbilat .

en: Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !
kha: Haduh katno nga kwah ba ngan tip hangno ngan shem ïa u , ban tip kumno ngan leit shano ba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba nga tip shano nga lah ban shem ia u ! ba nga lah ban wan wat sha ka jaka shong jong u !

en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan long kaba la kren da u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Wat nym don hapdeng jong phi .

en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .
kha: Te , to ngin leit sha u shabar ka jaka shong dara ban ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingshah lehrain jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin leit sha u shabar ka shnong , da kaba kit ia ka jingshah lehbein jong u .

en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .
kha: Lym kumta baroh kin tip ba phi long u bym lah ban set ïa kiei kiei kiba rieh bad phin ym lah ban lait na kane ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ba uta uba iohsngew ia ka un pynjah burom ia me, bad ka jingsngewsih jong me kan ym phai noh .

en: And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .
kha: Nga thmu ban tei ka Templ kaba khraw , namar U Blei jong ngi u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka iing kaba nga tei ka long kaba khraw: namar U Blei jong ngi u long uba khraw halor ki blei baroh .

en: The sons of Laadan  ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .
kha: U Ladan u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jehiel , u Setham , bad u Joel ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Laadan ; u rangbah ki long u Jehiel, bad u Setham bad u Joel, lai ngut .

en: We will become perfect humans just as Adam and Eve were before they sinned .
kha: Ngin sa long ki briew kiba janai kum u Adam bad ka Im shuwa ba kin leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin sa long ki briew kiba janai kumba u Adam bad ka Im ki long shuwa ba kin leh pop .

en: So Hazael king of Syria died  ; and Ben–hadad his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u khun jong u , u Benhadad u long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hazael syiem Syria u la iap; bad u Benhadad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Will he esteem thy riches ? no , not gold , nor all the forces of strength .
kha: Kan ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban kyang jam ban ïoh ka jingïarap ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi baroh kam lah ban ïarap ïa phi mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un burom ia ka spah jong me ? em, ym ka ksiar , ne ki bor jong ka jingkhlain baroh .

en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
kha: A katno uba kmen long u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta u shakri , uba u kynrad jong u ynda u wan un shem ba u leh kumta .

en: Then said he unto him ,  A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la khreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kaba u la khot sngewbha bun ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u, Uwei u briew u la leh ia ka jingkhawai kaba khraw, bad u la bthah ia kiba bun:

en: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever .
kha: Katba phi dang long kawei ka jaitbynriew , wat leh ïa kano kano ka ban ïarap ïa kine ki jaitbynriew ne pynmyntoi ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat wad ia ka jingsuk jong ki ne ka jingroi jingpar jong ki baroh ki sngi jong me junom .

en: In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,
kha: Kum ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jingpyrkhat na ki jingphohsniew jong ka miet , haba ka jingthiah kaba jylliew ka hap ha ki briew , .

en: Bless the  Lord  , O house of Israel : bless the  Lord  , O house of Aaron :
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki paid Israel ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Kyrkhu ia U Trai , ko iing Israel: to kyrkhu ia U Trai , ko iing Aaron:

en: And Kiriathaim , and Sibmah , and Zereth–shahar in the mount of the valley ,
kha: ka Kiriathaim , ka Sibmah , ka Serethshahar halor u lum uba don ha ka them ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Kiriathaim bad u Sibmah bad u Zerethshahar ha u lum jong ka them .

en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
kha: Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki Amramite , bad ki Izharite , ki Hebronite bad ki Uzilete:

en: Then Sihon came out against us , he and all his people , to fight at Jahaz .
kha: U syiem Sihon u wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi ha Jahas ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sihon u la mih pyrshah ia ngi, ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh, ban ialeh ha Jahaz .

en: Neither shall any priest drink wine , when they enter into the inner court .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ shuwa ban leit rung hapoh ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u lyngdoh un ym dih wain ruh haba ki rung shapoh ka phyllaw kaba shapoh .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Take heed that no man deceive you .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  To sumar , bad wat shah ïano ïano ruh ban shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: To sumar ba ym don mano mano ba shukor ia phi .

en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken , because they were elder than he .
kha: Namar ba u Elihu u dei uba khynnah tam na kiba don hangta , u la hap ban ap haduh ba baroh kiwei ki la dep kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Elihu u la ap haduh ba u Job un da kren , namar ki la kham rangbah ban ia u .

en: To whom then will ye liken God ? or what likeness will ye compare unto him ?
kha: Badno lah ban nujor ïa U Blei ? Kumno phi lah ban batai kaei ba u long ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha mano te phin ianujor ia U Blei ? lane kaei ka jingiasyriem kaba phin ianujor bad u ?

en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat :
kha: U Moses , u Aaron , bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki sait ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ki kjat
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la sait ia ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki hangta:

en: The desire of a man is his kindness : and a poor man is better than a liar .
kha: Ka long ka jingjahburom ban long uba khwan myntoi ; ki briew kiba duk ki kham bha ban ïa ki nongshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah jong u briew ka long ka jingbhabriew jong u: bad u briew uba duk u kham bha ban ia u nonglamler .

en: O house of Aaron , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko iing u Aaron , shaniah ha U Trai: u long ka jingiarap jong ki bad ka jingda jong ki .

en: If my land cry against me , or that the furrows likewise thereof complain  ;
kha: Lada nga la tuh ïa ka jaka kaba nga rep bad knieh ïa ka na ki trai kiba dei hok —
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka ri jong nga ka iam pyrshah ia nga , ne ba ki bniat kumjuh ki ujor ; .

en: Carry neither purse , nor scrip , nor shoes : and salute no man by the way .
kha: Wat rah ïa ka pla pisa lane ïa ka pla khrong lane ïa ki juti ; wat sangeh ban khublei ïano ïano ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat rah ia ka pla tyngka, ne ka scrip, ne ki juti: bad ym ai khublei ia uno uno u briew da kaba ong .

en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?
kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki bad ker ïa ki na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba la ai jingshai ia u briew uba la buhrieh ia ka lynti jong u bad uba U Blei u la rung shapoh ?

en: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
kha: bad beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban beh noh ia ki nongshun jong me baroh na khmat jong me kumba U Trai u la kren .

en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .
kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ha Lystra bad Ikoniom ki ïakren babha shaphang u Timothi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la iathuh bha da ki para kiba don ha Lystra bad Iconum .

en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .
kha: Bad u la siew ïa u Araunah hynriewspah ki sbai ksiar na ka bynta ka jaka shoh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ai ha u Ornan na ka bynta kata ka jaka hynriew spah Shekel ksiar da ka jingkhia .

en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee ,
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban pynpait ïa u khra ha khmat jong ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit bad nga
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to pynpra ia ka bilor ha khmat ki briew kiba leit ryngkat bad me , .

en: Therefore they sought again to take him : but he escaped out of their hand ,
kha: Sa shisien ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu , hynrei u la lait noh na ki kti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la wad biang ban shim ia u: hynrei u la lait na ka kti jong ki .

en: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple  ; and he healed them .
kha: Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki la wan sha u ha ka Templ , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U ba matlah bad uba lyngngoh u la wan sha u ha ka tempi ; bad u la pynkoit ia ki .

en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee .
kha: Te ngan long uba nyngkong ban ïaroh ïa me bad pdiang ba me la ïoh ka jingjop da lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan phla ruh ha me ba ka kti kadiang jong me hi ka lah ban pynim ia me .

en: And when they had lifted up their eyes , they saw no man , save Jesus only .
kha: Te haba ki la khmied bad kim shym la ïohi ïano ïano ruh hangta hynrei tang ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong ki, kim shym la iohi iano iano ruh, lait noh tang ia U Jisu .

en: For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth .
kha: naba ka dei ka jingshai kaba pynmih ïa ka jingot kaba kyrhai ha baroh ki jinglong babha , bahok , bad bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u soh jong U Mynsiem u don ha ka jingbha bad ka hok bad ka jingshisha baroh .

en: Blessed are the peacemakers : for they shall be called the children of God .
kha: Suk kito kiba trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk ; U Blei un khot ïa ki , ki khun jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ki nongshna jingsuk: namar yn khot ia ki ki khun U Blei .

en: He beholdeth all high things : he is a king over all the children of pride .
kha: U peit ibeiñ wat ïa ki mrad kiba iphieng tam ; u long u syiem jong ki mradkhlaw baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U peit ia kiei kiei baroh kiba jrong: u long u syiem halor ki khun jong ka jingsarong baroh .

en: And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,
kha: ki la tip naba ki la ïohmad ba ka Ktien U Blei ka long kaba bha , bad ki la ïohmad ruh ïa ki bor jong ka por ka ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la mad ia ka ktien babha jong U Blei bad ki bor jong ka pyrthei ban sa wan , .

en: Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
kha: Hato phim kynmaw ? Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane baroh mynba nga dang don lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw phim don , kata , haba nga dang don bad phi , nga la iathuh ia kine kiei kiei ?

en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal .
kha: La pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Mynsiem ha kano kano ka rukom ha uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingbha ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingpynpaw jong U Mynsiem la ai ha uwei pa uwei u briew ban ioh jingmyntoi .

en: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .
kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mynta nga la pynkhreh ban shah tyrwa , bad ka por jong ka jingleit jong nga ka la jan .

en: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
kha: Kine ki jingshah shitom kiba phi ïohi da la ki khmat kin pynlamwir ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba me sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingpeit jong ki khmat jong me kiba me iohi .

en: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant , O  Lord  , according unto thy word .
kha: Me la bat ïa la ka kular , A  Trai  , bad me long uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la leh bha ia u shakri jong me, ko Trai, kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: A fool s mouth is his destruction , and his lips are the snare of his soul .
kha: Haba uba bieit u kren , u pynjot ïa lade ; u ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki ktien jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur kaba bieit ka long ka jingpynjot jong u , bad ki rmiang shyntur jong u ki long ka jingma jong ka mynsiem jong u .

en: Because they turned back from him , and would not consider any of his ways :
kha: namar ki la sangeh na kaba bud ïa u bad leh bymsalia ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la phai noh na u , bad kin ym pyrkhat ia kano kano ka lynti jong u:

en: And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleit lang bad U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki liang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit bad u ; bad bun ki briew ki la bud ia u, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u .

en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , Come ye up out of Jordan .
kha: U Joshua u la leh kumta ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la hukum ia ki lyngdoh da kaba ong: To wan kiew na Jordan .

en: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number , and bind them in thy skirts .
kha: Pynsah katto katne ki shñiuh bad song ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ki jaiñkup jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men shim katto katne na ki ha ka jingbun briew jong me .

en: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
kha: U bieit u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka proberb tang kumba u briew uba dkoh u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat jong ki blang kim iaryngkat: kumjuh ruh ka long ka pharshi ha ka shyntur jong ki bieit .

en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ïa ki balang !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka shkor , to ai ba un iohsngew ia kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang .

en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .
kha: U buh ka por ban ieit bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma bad ka por ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban ieit , bad ka por ban shun ; ka por thma , bad ka por jingsuk .

en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
kha: U Blei u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew ; u kynjrat ïa ki païa kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pynkhih ia ka khyndew na ka jaka jong ka , bad ki maw jong ka ki khih .

en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ïa ki lyngkha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia me ha ka shnong , bad la kyrkhu ia me ha lyngkha .

en: Therefore hear now this , thou afflicted , and drunken , but not with wine :
kha: Phi ki briew kiba jynjar jong ka Jerusalem , phi kiba ïaid sheng sheng kumba phi la buaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew mynta ia kane, me la shah pynshitom bad nga la dih kyiad, hynrei ym da ka wain:

en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded : and they let them go .
kha: Ki la jubab kumba U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki , bad kita ki briew ki la shah ïa ki ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ki kumba U Jisu u la hukum: bad ki la pyllait noh ia ki .

en: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem , and saw not the king s face .
kha: U Absalom u la shong ar snem ha Jerusalem khlem ïohi ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Absalom u la shong ar snem pura ha Jerusalem , bad um shym la iohi ia ka khmat syiem .

en: The “ sheep ” are those who will have proved themselves his loyal subjects .
kha: Ki “ langbrot ” ki dei kito kiba pyni ba ki long kiba kohnguh sneng ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki langbrot   ki long kito ki ban sa pynshisha ia lade ia ki sobjek ba iaineh jong u .

en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .
kha: U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , hadien ba phi la lah pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la pynmih ia U Jisu , ia uba phi la pyniap bad u la sahkut ha u dieng .

en: As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .
kha: Nga ieit ïa phi kumba U Kpa u ieit ïa nga ; to ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Kpa u la ieit ia nga, kumta nga la ieit ia phi: to iai bteng ha ka jingieit jong nga .

en: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .
kha: Ïa nga la thaw ha kaba sdang eh , ha kaba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: La buh ia nga naduh bymjukut, naduh kaba sdang, ne la ju don ka khyndew .

en: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab , and told him : and Ahab went to meet Elijah .
kha: Kumta u Obadaïah u leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ïathuh ha u , bad u Ahab u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Elijah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Obadaiah u la leit iakynduh ia u Ahab, bad u la iathuh ha u: bad u Ahab u la leit iakynduh ia u Elijah .

en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: u la ai ïa ki ha u Israel , u shakri jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka pateng ha ki Israel jong u: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , U Khun U Briew ruh un kyntait ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba kyntait ia nga ha khmat ki briew un shah kyntait ha khmat ki angel U Blei .

en: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him .
kha: Ki khun ki long kiba bha kupar lada ki don u kpa uba beit bad uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba hok u iaid ha ka jinglong ba janai jong u: ki khun jong u ki long kiba la kyrkhu hadien jong u .

en: We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :
kha: Ngin ïoh kurup ïa ki markordor kiba har rukom bad pyndap ïa la ki ïing da ki mar lute !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin sa shem ia kiei kiei baroh kiba kordor , ngin pyndap ia ki iing jong ngi da ka jingsniew:

en: I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .
kha: Nga la long kum u kpa ïa kiba duk bad nga la long ha ka liang ki nongwei haba ki shem jingeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la long u kpa ia kiba duk: bad ka daw kaba ngam tip nga la wad bniah .

en: To give subtilty to the simple , to the young man knowledge and discretion .
kha: Ki lah ban pynlong ïa u briew uba shida ban long sian bad hikai ïa ki samla kumno ban dap ban biang ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ai jingmut ia kiba suk , ia u samla .

en: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada ka jingïatiplem kam pynrem ïa ngi , ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit , lada ka dohnud jong ngi kam pynrem ia ngi , te ngi don ka jingshaniah ha U Blei .

en: He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .
kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingshlur jong nga kan pyllait im ïa nga , namar yn ym don u riewsniew u ban nud ban ïakynduh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U ruh un long ka jingpynim jong nga: namar u nongleh arsap un ym wan ha khmat jong u .

en: The righteous see it , and are glad : and the innocent laugh them to scorn .
kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki kmen bad ki briew kiba lui lui ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ba la pynshitom ïa ki bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba hok ki iohi ia ka , bad ki sngewbha: bad ki bym don pop ki rkhie bein ia ki ban sngewsih .

en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .
kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba ïaineh , bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba iaineh , uba pynskhem ia phi bad un iada ia phi na kaba sniew .

en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kren lyngba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan long kaba la kren da u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?
kha: Me wan jngoh ïa ki man ka step , bad me tynjuh ïa ki man la ka minit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba me dei ban leit jngoh ia u man ka step , bad pyrshang ia u man la ka khyllipmat ?

en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?
kha: U briew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangta u kam ba u shu biria u long kum u briew uba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiar kaba pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u briew uba thok ia u paramarjan jong u, bad u ong , Hato ngam don ha ka jingialehkai ?

en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the  Lord  hath wrought this ?
kha: Baroh na ki , ki tip ba ka kti U  Trai  ka la thaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba tip ha kine baroh ba ka kti U Trai ka la leh ia kane ?

en: And if Christ be not raised , your faith is vain ; ye are yet in your sins .
kha: Bad lada ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat , te ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba shisha bad phi dang don hi ha ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada U Khrist um shym la pynmihpat ia U Khrist, ka jingngeit jong phi ka long kaba lehnohei ; phi dang don ha ki pop jong phi .

en: But let judgment run down as waters , and righteousness as a mighty stream .
kha: Pynban , ai ba ka jingbishar hok kan tuid kum ka wahduid , bad ka jinglehhok kum ka wah ka bym ju rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba ka jingbishar kan tuid kum ki um , bad ka hok kum ka wah kaba khlain .

en: And the sons of Shemida were , Ahian , and Shechem , and Likhi , and Aniam .
kha: ( U Shemida u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ahian , u Shekhem , u Likhi , bad u Aniam . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shemida ki long, u Ahian, bad u Shechem, bad u Likhi, bad u Aniam .

en: The wise shall inherit glory : but shame shall be the promotion of fools .
kha: Ki briew kiba stad kin nang ïoh ka nam ka burom , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kin nang mad ka jingjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: U riewstad un hiar pateng: ka burom hynrei ka jinglehrain kan long ka jingkyntiew ia ki bieit .

en: And he brought the burnt offering , and offered it according to the manner .
kha: U wanlam ruh ïa u mrad na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang , bad u kñia ïa u katba kum ka jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka jingainguh thang bad u la tyrwa ia ka katkum ka rukom .

en: My soul melteth for heaviness : strengthen thou me according unto thy word .
kha: La ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewsih ; to pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong nga ka rkhiang na ka bynta ka jingkhia: me pynskhem ia nga kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: A real hope of being reunited with your dead loved ones . —John 5 :28 , 29 .
kha: Ka jingkyrmen bashisha ban ïashem biang bad kiba ieid ba thoin kiba la ïap .—Ioannis 5 :28 , 29 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrmen kaba shisha ban iakynduh biang bad kiba ieit jong phi kiba la iap . oannis 5 :28 , 29 .

en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
kha: A katno nga long u briew u bym don jingsuk! Uei u ban pyllait noh ïa nga na kane ka met kaba ïalam ïa nga sha ka jingïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko briew uba sngewsih ba nga long! mano ban pyllait ia nga na ka met jong kane ka jingiap ?

en: Is there any number of his armies ? and upon whom doth not his light arise ?
kha: Hato don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki angel kiba shakri ïa u ? Hato don kano kano ka jaka kaba ka jingshai U Blei kam lah ban tyngshaiñ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don katto katne ki shipai jong u ? bad halor jongno ka jingshai jong u kam mih ?

en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering , to make an atonement for you :
kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u khun blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong phi:

en: And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la kylla noh ïa la ka jingmut bad um shym wallam ha ki briew jong u ïa ka jingpynjot kaba u la byrngem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la kylla bamut na ka jingsniew kaba u la pyrkhat ban leh ia ki briew jong u .

en: Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: ka jingaiei kan don ha phi , bad jingsuk , na U Blei jong ngi U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei ha phi bad ka jingsuk na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .
kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka rnong , bad ki khohwah jong u ki long kum ki shalyngka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki long kum ki nar kiba khlain ; ki shyieng jong u ki long kum ki nar nar .

en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh , which is called the Passover .
kha: Ka por ka la jan na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ïa kaba la khot ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingkhawai jong u kpu bym don thied ka la nang jan , ia kaba la khot ka Passover .

en: He saith unto them ,  How then doth David in spirit call him Lord , saying ,
kha: Balei , te ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  ba U Mynsiem u pynshlur ïa Dabid ban khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai’ ? U Dabid u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha ki , Kumno u Dabid ha ka mynsiem u khot ia u Trai , da kaba ong:

en: That we should be to the praise of his glory , who first trusted in Christ .
kha: Te ma ngi , kiba long kiba nyngkong ban kyrmen ha U Khrist , ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngi dei ban long ha ka jingiaroh ia ka burom jong u , uba la shaniah nyngkong eh ha U Khrist .

en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .
kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba leh ïa kaba bha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don u briew uba hok ha ka pyrthei , uba leh bha bad u bym leh pop .

en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka shkor , to ai ba un iohsngew ia kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang .

en: Gather yourselves together , yea , gather together , O nation not desired  ;
kha: Ko jaitbynriew bym don jinglehrain , to tipbriew
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniasoh lang ia lade , yea , to ialum lang , ko jaitbynriew kaba ym kwah;

en: Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof .
kha: Ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap ki khynñiuh ha ki um hapoh ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei kiba la iap ki mih na shapoh ki um , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka .

en: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :
kha: Hangta ki la ïalap ïa ka khubor ha Perga bad nangta ki la leit sha Attalia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la ialap ia ka ktien ha Perga , ki la leit hiar sha Atlia:

en: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth , and addeth learning to his lips .
kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki da pyrkhat ha shuwa ban kren ; ki lah ban pynkohnguh da kaei kaba ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u riewstad ka hikai ia ka shyntur jong u , bad ka pyndap ia ka jingpule ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

en: And Moses said , Thou hast spoken well , I will see thy face again no more .
kha: Ka dei kaba phi ong ,  U Moses u jubab .  Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga lano lano .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , Me la kren bha, ngan ym iohi shuh ia ka khmat jong me .

en: Others cast spells on their enemies to make them sick or even to kill them .
kha: Kiwei pat ki ai ksuid ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki pynlong ia ki nongshun jong ki ban pynpang ia ki ne wat ban pyniap ia ki .

en: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .
kha: Ka Mari ka la sah bad ka Elisabeth kumba lai bnai bad nangta ka la leit pat sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria ka la sah bad ka kumba lai bnai , bad ka la leit phai noh sha la iing .

en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Ahab u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u ; bad u Ahasaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: God forbid . How shall we , that are dead to sin , live any longer therein ?
kha: Kam long kumta! Ngi la ïap ïa ka pop — kumno te ngi lah ban ïai im ha ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la khang . Kumno ngin im shuh ha ka pop ?

en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , I cannot speak : for I am a child .
kha: Nga jubab ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam tip kumno ban kren ; nga dang khynnah eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , Ah Trai Blei ! ha khmih , ngam lah ban kren: namar nga long u khynnah .

en: For had ye believed Moses , ye would have believed me : for he wrote of me .
kha: Lada phi la ngeit da shisha ha u Moses , phin jin da la ngeit ha nga , namar u la thoh shaphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi ngeit ia u Moses, phi la ngeit ia nga: namar u la thoh shaphang jong nga .

en: If he cut off , and shut up , or gather together , then who can hinder him ?
kha: Lada U Blei u kem ïa me bad u wallam ïa me sha ka jingbishar , uei uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u ot noh , bad u khang , ne u ialum lang , te mano ba lah ban khanglad ia u ?

en: Counsel is mine , and sound wisdom : I am understanding  ; I have strength .
kha: Nga don ki jingthmu bad nga pyntreikam ïa ki ; nga don ka jingshemphang , bad nga don ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Counsel ka long ka jong nga, bad ka jingstad: Nga sngewthuh ; nga don ka bor .

en: Not in the lust of concupiscence , even as the Gentiles which know not God :
kha: ym ha ka jingkwah brai thala , kum kiba mane blei thala ki bymtip ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingkwah brai jong ka jinglong rit paid, wat kum ki Jutang ki bym tip ia U Blei:

en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .
kha: Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long syriem kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrop ha ka sngi ba slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinghiar kaba bteng ha ka sngi kaba slap bha bad ka kynthei kaba ialeh pyrshah ka long kumjuh .

en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ngi ka kynton jakhlia jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynlong ia ngi kum ki khun bad ki kyntait hapdeng ki briew .

en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;
kha: Kumta u Iso u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u Isaak um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la iohi ba ki khun kynthei u Kanaan kim sngewbha ia u Isaak u kpa jong u;

en: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynlong katto katne na ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan shim ruh na ki na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ki Lebi , ong U Trai .

en: It also contains essential amino acids required to repair the body tissues .
kha: Ka don ruh ia ki amino acid kiba donkam ban pynbha ia ki shyieng jong ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ruh ia ki acid kiba donkam ban pynbha ia ki shyieng met .

en: Check the reviews and ratings to ensure the product meets your expectations.
kha: Peit ïa ki jingthoh bad ki jingniew ban pynthikna ba ka mar ka ïadei bad ka jingkhmih lynti jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia ki jingbishar bad ki jingthew ban pynthikna ba ka jingmih ka iadei bad ki jingkhmih lynti jong phi.

en: In India , the Australian Open will telecast live on the Sony SIX channels .
kha: Ha India , ka Australian Open kan pyni live ha ki channel jong ka Sony SIX .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha India , ka Australian Open kan sa telecast live ha ki lad Sony SIX .

en: The paths of their way are turned aside  ; they go to nothing , and perish .
kha: Ki paid nongkhaïi ki jah lynti ha kaba wad um ; ki ïaid ruma bad ki ïap ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lynti jong ka lynti jong ki ki kylla shawei ; kim leit ei ei , bad ki jah noh .

en: And again , The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise , that they are vain .
kha: bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Trai u tip ba ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba stad ki long ki bymdondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien , U Trai u tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba stad , ba ki long kiba lehnohei .

en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?
kha: Hynrei phi tharai ba nga shukor — bad phi tharai ba ngam lah ban ïathuh ïa ka badei na ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka don ka jingbymhok ha ka shyntur jong nga ? hato ka jingsngewtynnat jong nga kam lah ban ithuh ia kiei kiei kiba bakla ?

en: I lead in the way of righteousness , in the midst of the paths of judgment :
kha: Nga ïaid ha ka lynti ka hok , nga bud ïa ki lynti ka jinglehhok ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ialam ha ka lynti jong ka hok, hapdeng ki lynti bishar:

en: Wherefore the law is holy , and the commandment holy , and just , and good .
kha: Te kumta , ka Hukum hi ka long kaba khuid , bad ka jinghukum ka long kaba khuid , kaba dei bad kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka hukum ka long kaba khuid , bad ka hukum ka long kaba khuid bad kaba hok .

en: Her young ones also suck up blood : and where the slain are , there is she .
kha: Sawdong ki metïap ki pukni ki ïaboi , bad ki khun pukni ki dih ïa ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ka ruh ki dih snam: bad ha kaba ki la shah pyniap ki don , hangta ka don ma ka .

en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .
kha: Shim ïa une u diengduh bad me , namar da u men sa leh ïa ki kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ia une u dieng ha ka kti jong me , da kaba me leh ia ki dak .

en: For the word of the  Lord  is right  ; and all his works are done in truth .
kha: Ki ktien U  Trai  ki long kiba shisha ; bad baroh ki kam jong u ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ktien U Trai ka long kaba dei; bad ki kam jong u baroh ki long ha ka jingshisha .

en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat ïa ka pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingainguh kaba sniew: u la leh pyrshah shisha ia U Trai .

en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .
kha: Katno uba kmen u long uta u shakri lada u kynrad jong u , u shem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta u shakri , uba u kynrad jong u ynda u wan un shem ba u leh kumta .

en: What advantage then hath the Jew ? or what profit is there of circumcision ?
kha: Hato ki Jiw te ki don ha kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban ïa ki Jentil ? Lane hato don kano kano ka dor ha ka jingotsher ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingmyntoi te kaba u Jiw u don ? lane kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba don ha ka jingotsher ?

en: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity . Amen .
kha: To ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad kito baroh kiba ieit ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi da ka jingieit baneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long bad kito baroh kiba ieit ia U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist ha ka jinglong bashisha . Amen .

en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka shkor , to ai ba un iohsngew ia kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang .

en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :
kha: Ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la bam lut plain ïa kita kiba sngaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sniang kiba rit bad kiba sniew ki la bam ia ki hynriew tylli ki sniang kiba heh ba nyngkong:

en: But even unto this day , when Moses is read , the veil is upon their heart .
kha: Wat mynta ruh , man ba pule ïa ka Hukum u Moses , kata ka jingkah ka dang tap hi ïa ki jingmut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat haduh kine ki sngi, haba la pule ia u Moses, ka jingtap ka don ha ka dohnud jong ki .

en: For all the gods of the people are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
kha: Ki blei jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw , hynrei U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki blei baroh ki long ki bleithaw: hynrei U Trai u la thaw ia ki bneng .

en: And when all Jabesh–gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul ,
kha: Haba ki briew jong ka Jabesh ki ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ki Philistia ki la leh ïa u Saul ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Jabesh ષlead u la iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Philistia ki la leh ia u Saul .

en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord , the veil shall be taken away .
kha: Hynrei lah ban weng noh ïa ka , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang u Moses :  Ïa ka jingkah jong u la weng noh mynba u la phai sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ynda ka la phai sha U Trai , yn sa weng noh ia ka jingtap .

en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself  ; for his mouth craveth it of him .
kha: Ka jingkwah bam jong u nongbylla sngi ka pynlong ïa u ban kham trei shitom , namar u kwah ban pynhun ïa la ka jingthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba trei na ka bynta lade ; namar ka shyntur jong u ka kwah eh ia ka na u .

en: Then there arose a reasoning among them , which of them should be greatest .
kha: Ka jingïania ka la mih hapdeng ki synran ha kaba ïadei badno napdeng jong ki , uba long uba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la mih ka jingmut hapdeng jong ki , kaba na ki ka dei ban long kaba khraw tam .

en: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .
kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la wan , u la shahjingit bad um shym dih waiñ , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Une uba shongksuid !’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u loannis um shym la wan bam ne dih, bad ki ong , U don u ksuid .

en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .
kha: Lada phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kum u briew uba bieit uba kylli ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat jubab ia u briew uba bieit kat kum ka jinglong bieit jong u , ioh ma me ruh to long kum ma u .

en: In Chokpot Civil Sub-Division, Sengchim N Sangma raised the tri-colour flag.
kha: Ha Chokpot Civil Sub-Division u Sengchim N Sangma u la pynher ia ka lama lairong.
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka Chokpot Civil Sub-Division, u Seng Nchim Sangma u la pynkiew ia ka lama kaba don tri-color.

en: And the seven had her , and left no seed : last of all the woman died also .
kha: bad nangta ïa baroh ki para shynrang : Baroh hynñiew ngut shi para ki la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew bad ki la ïap noh khlem don khun . Khatduh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew ngut ki don ia ka, bad kim shym la iehnoh symbai: khatduh eh na ka kynthei baroh ka la iap ruh .

en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things  ; and holy is his name .
kha: namar jong kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la leh na ka bynta jong nga . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uta uba donbor u la leh ia nga ia kiei kiei kiba khraw ; bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid .

en: He recalls : I approached Jehovah and earnestly prayed for his forgiveness .
kha: U kynmaw : Nga la leit sha U Jehobah bad nga la duwai jur na ka bynta ka jingmap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynmaw: Nga la leit sha U Jehobah bad nga la duwai shitrhem na ka bynta ka jingmap jong u .

en: But his wife looked back from behind him , and she became a pillar of salt .
kha: Hynrei ka tnga u Lot ka la phai dien bad ka la kylla long u païa mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u ka peit shadien jong u , bad ka la kylla long ka maw mluh .

en: Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .
kha: Nga la ai ha ki ka ri shyiap ban long ka ïing jong ki , bad nga shah ba kin shong ha ki pyntha mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing jong u nga la pynlong ia ka ri khlaw bad ka ri kaba khlem khun jong u .

en: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .
kha: bad u Judas Iskariot , uba la shetkylla ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas Isarikos ruh u la shet kylla ia u: bad ki la leit shapoh kawei ka iing .

en: The project completion time is 54 months from date of signing the contract .
kha: Ka por ban pyndep ia ka projek ka long 54 bnai naduh ka tarik ba la soi ia ka jingiateh .
