translated_en_to_kha: Ka por pyndep ia ka projek ka long 54 bnai naduh ka tarik ba la soi ia ka jingiateh .

en: Wisdom is better than weapons of war : but one sinner destroyeth much good .
kha: Ka jingstad ka kham lehbha shibun ban ïa ki atiar ïaleh , hynrei uwei u nongpop u lah ban pynduh shibun ka jingbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ia ki tiar thma: hynrei uwei u nongpop u pynjot shibun kiei kiei kiba bha .

en: I am afraid of all my sorrows , I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent .
kha: Lada nga phuh samrkhie bad pyrshang ban klet ïa la ka jingpang , baroh ka jingshitom jong nga ka wan biang ban pynkhuslai ïa nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u rai pynrem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tieng ia ki jingsngewsih jong nga baroh , nga tip ba men ym bat ia nga khlem pop .

en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
kha: Nangta katto katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wan sha U Jisu na Jerusalem bad ki la kylli ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki Pharisi kiba long na Jerusalem ki da ong:

en: Land transfer activities are in progress for the remaining 3 Sub Treasuries .
kha: Ki kam pynkylla jaka ki dang iaid shakhmat na ka bynta ki 3 tylli ki Sub Treasury kiba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kam pynkylla jaka ki dang iaid shakhmat na ka bynta ki 3 tylli ki Sub Treasury kiba dang sah .

en: And the king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon bad ki paidbah baroh hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u ki la knia ha khmat U Trai .

en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wad ïa ki lynti ban pynmynsaw ïa kiwei ; wat ki ktien jong ki , ki long kiba thang da ka jingsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba khlem akor u tih ia ka jingsniew: bad ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u ka don kum ka ding kaba thang .

en: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .
kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba la wah hapoh ka Templ la pynkad arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi ka la dum bad ka jingtap jong ka tempi ka la tyrkhong hapdeng .

en: It should be noted that the impulse of these two protests is very different .
kha: Dei ban kdew ba ka jingpynbor jong kine ki ar tylli ki jingiakhih ka iapher bak-ly-bak .
translated_en_to_kha: Dei ban kdew ba ka jingkhih jong kine ki ar tylli ki jingiakhih ka long kaba pher bha .

en: Go , stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life .
kha: Khie leit bad ïeng ha ka Templ , bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh shaphang kane ka jingim bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit , ieng bad kren ha ka tempi ha ki briew baroh ki ktien jong kane ka jingim .

en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God , save this stranger .
kha: Balei une u nongwei u long tang ma u uba la wan phai pat ban ainguh ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ym lap ia kiba wan phai ban ai burom ia U Blei , pynim ia une u nongwei .

en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
kha: Shna ïa kine ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki dieng shittim , bad to tap ia ki da ka ksiar .

en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
kha: U la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia bad u la phah noh ïa ki sha Joppa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pynbna ia kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki , u la phah ia ki sha Joppa .

en: Jesus answered them ,  Is it not written in your law , I said , Ye are gods ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  La thoh ha ka hukum jong phi hi ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Phi long ki blei .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki , Hato ym shym la thoh ha ka hukum jong phi , nga la ong , Phi long ki blei ?

en: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain .
kha: Ki briew kiba kular ïa kiei kiei kiba kim ju lah ban ai satia ki long kum ki lyoh bad ka lyer ki bym ai slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sngew sarong ia lade da ka jingai kaba bakla ka long kum ki lyoh bad ka Iyer khlem slap .

en: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death .
kha: Naduh kata ka sngi hi ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïasylla ïa ka ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta naduh kata ka sngi ki la ia kren lang na ka bynta ban pyniap ia u .

en: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .
kha: U Kylli ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shukor bad ong ba nga la bakla ? Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga long uba khlem pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga dei ban thiah pyrshah ia ka hok jong nga ? ka jingmynsaw jong nga ka long kaba ym lah ban pynkoit khlem ka jingpynkhein .

en: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .
kha: Haba ka kynta ka la poi , U Jisu u la shong ha la ka jaka ha ka miej lem bad ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la poi ka por , u la shong bad ki shiphew ngut ki apostol bad u .

en: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
kha: Bad ka hukum kaba dei ban wallam jingim , ha nga , ka la wallam ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka hukum kaba la buh ha ka jingim , nga la shem ba ka long haduh ka jingiap .

en: Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .
kha: Ar ngut ki kham bha ban ïa kaba marwei , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei kham bha shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Arngut ki kham bha ban ia kawei ka ; namar ki don ka bainong kaba bha na ka bynta ka jingtrei shitom jong ki .

en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge : but a fool layeth open his folly .
kha: Ki briew kiba sian , borabor ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki thad ïa la ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew uba stad u iadei bad ka jingtip: hynrei u bieit u plie ia ka jinglong bieit jong u .

en: And put no difference between us and them , purifying their hearts by faith .
kha: Um shym la pynïapher ei ei hapdeng jong ngi bad ki ; u la map ïa ki pop jong ki namar ba ki la ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat buh jingpher hapdeng jong ngi bad ki , da kaba pynkhuid ia ki dohnud jong ki da ka jingngeit .

en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;
kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki wah ban rngad lut bad pynsangeh ïa ki umpohliew ban mih .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkylla ia ki wah sha ka ri khlaw , bad ki wah ki tuid sha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang ; .

en: He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .
kha: U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha ki briew jong u , ki jingbthah bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U pyni ia ka ktien jong u ha u Jakob , ki ain bad ki jingbishar jong u ha ki Israel .

en: For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .
kha: Naba kumba ka jingïap ka la wan da uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ka wan da uwei u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar namar da u briew u la wan ka jingiap , da u briew ruh ka la wan ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap .

en: Shall vain words have an end ? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest ?
kha: Hato phin shu kren junom ? Hato borabor phin don ka kyntien khatduh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki ktien kiba lehnohei kin don ka jingkut ? lane kaei kaba pynskhem ia me ba me jubab ?

en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .
kha: Uno uno uba len ïa ka jingshisha u thaw jingkulmar , hynrei uta uba pyn-i markhmat u trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynkhih ia ka khmat u pynmih ia ka jingsngewsih: hynrei u bieit uba sngap jar un hap .

en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood , and leave off righteousness in the earth ,
kha: Phi long kiba la tim , phi kiba pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok bad kiba shukor ïa ki briew ban pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba pynphai ia ka jingbishar sha ka khlaw , bad iehnoh ia ka hok ha ka khyndew .

en: And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
kha: Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U  Trai  un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia u ha ka ward , ba ka jingmut jong U Trai kan paw ha ki .

en: Sir , The legacy of Kerala is the intervention with the awareness of rights .
kha: Sir , Ka pateng jong ka Kerala ka dei ka jingwan rung ryngkat bad ka jingsngewthuh ia ki hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Sir , Ka pateng jong ka Kerala ka long ka jingiarap bad ka jingsngewthuh ia ki hok .

en: Then said Mary unto the angel , How shall this be , seeing I know not a man ?
kha: Ka Mari ka la ong ha u angel ,  Nga long kaba dang sotti . Kumno , te , kane ka lah ban long ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka Maria ka la ong ha u angel: Kumno kane kan long haba ngam ithuh ia u briew ?

en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
kha: Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw ; hynrei U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long ki bleithaw: hynrei U Trai u la thaw ia ki bneng .

en: And now send men to Joppa , and call for one Simon , whose surname is Peter :
kha: Bad mynta to phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah sha Joppa ban leit shem ïa uwei u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta phah ia ki briew sha Joppa , bad khot ia uwei u Simon uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Petros:

en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kiba kut jong ka pyrthei , u ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u peit sha ki kut jong ka khyndew bad u iohi hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei;

en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me .
kha: U Blei u bret ïa nga sha ka thliew kaba jaboh , bad wat ki jaiñphong jong nga ki sngewlehrain ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban pynngam ia nga ha ka thliew, bad ki jain jong nga hi kin pynjah burom ia nga .

en: And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .
kha: U Abram u la shaniah ha U  Trai  ; bad namar kane , U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa u bad u la pdiang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ngeit ha U Trai ; bad u la khein ia ka ha u na ka bynta ka hok .

en: And he spake to them a parable  ;  Behold the fig tree , and all the trees  ;
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Pyrkhat ïa u diengsoh Dumbur bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha ki da ka pharshi ; Ha khmih u dieng sohjew bad ki dieng baroh ; .

en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose ? or bore his jaw through with a thorn ?
kha: Hato me lah ban bsuh ïa u tyllai lyngba ka khmut jong u lane buh u khwai lyngba ki tyngam jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban buh ia ka hook ha ka shyntur jong u ? lane u la rah ia ka shyntur jong u lyngba da ka thorn ?

en: And who is he that will harm you , if ye be followers of that which is good ?
kha: Uei u ban pynsniew ïa phi lada phi shitrhem ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mano ba pynmynsaw ia phi lada phi long ki nongbud ia kata kaba bha ?

en: And the king said unto him , Go in peace . So he arose , and went to Hebron .
kha: Khie leit suk ,  u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u la leit noh sha Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u, To leit suk . Kumta u la ieng bad u la leit sha Hebron .

en: Elbows and arms stained with blood , but it ' s older than his own injuries .
kha: Ki tyrpeng bad ki kti ki la rong snam , hynrei ka kham rim ban ia ki jingmynsaw jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat bad ki kti ki la tyrkhong da ka snam , hynrei ka kham heh ban ia ki jingmynsaw jong u hi .

en: He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .
kha: bad nangta u bynrap ,  Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi .   Kaei kata ?  ka kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong shuh shuh , nga don ei ei ban ong ia me . Bad ka la ong , To ong .

en: And forthwith he came to Jesus , and said , Hail , master  ; and kissed him .
kha: U Judas u la leit beit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad me , ko Nonghikai ,  bad u la doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan sha U Jisu, bad u la ong, Hail, ko kynrad; bad u la kdup ia u .

en: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity  ; and quicken thou me in thy way .
kha: To sumar ïa nga na kaba pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ka bymdondor ; to long uba bha ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai noh ia ki khmat jong nga na kaba iohi ia ka jinglong ba sniew ; bad pynkloi ia nga ha ka lynti jong me .

en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord .
kha: uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ba ngan ïoh long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka la pynmih ia phi na ka ri Ijipt , ban long U Blei jong phi: Nga long U Trai .

en: For he is not a God of the dead , but of the living : for all live unto him .
kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong kiba ïap , namar ha u baroh ki im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar um long U Blei jong kiba iap , hynrei jong kiba im: namar baroh ki im ha u .

en: For they are life unto those that find them , and health to all their flesh .
kha: Ki long ka jingim bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ïa uno uno uba sngewthuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ka jingim ia kito kiba shem ia ki , bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ia ka doh jong ki baroh .

en: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?
kha: namar ka spah kam neh junom . Ym don wat ki hima ruh ki ban neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka spah kam long junom: bad hato ka khlieh ka neh ha man la ka pateng ?

en: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool .
kha: U briew uba shemphang u ïoh jinghikai kham bun na kawei ka jingsneng ban kaba uba bieit u ïoh jinghikai na kaba shah sympat shispah sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshah kyntait ka rung kham bun ha u briew uba stad ban ia kaba shispah tylli ki lain ha u bieit .

en: And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,
kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa u : Ki la wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka waiñ bym bha , bad ki la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la rkhie bein ia u, ki wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ia u sohjew .

en: Though thy beginning was small , yet thy latter end should greatly increase .
kha: Baroh ka spah kaba me la duh , kam long ei ei ban ïapyrshang bad kaei kaba U Blei un sa ai pat ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka jingsdang jong me ka long kaba rit hynrei ka jingkut kaba hadien jong me ka dei ban nang kiew shibun .

en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
kha: To ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingtip , namar nga shaniah ha ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hikai ia nga ia ka jingmut kaba bha bad ka jingtip: namar nga la ngeit ia ki hukum jong me .

en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :
kha: Mynta , A Trai , me la bat ïa la ka kular , bad men shah ïa u shakri jong me ban leit noh ha kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai, mynta to ai ba u shakri jong me un leit noh ha ka jingsuk, kat kum ka ktien jong me:

en: The ransom of a man s life are his riches : but the poor heareth not rebuke .
kha: Kiba riewspah ki hap ban pyndonkam ïa la ka pisa ban pyllait ïa la ka jingim , hynrei ym don ba byrngem ïa uba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsiew bai lutksan jong u briew ka long ka spah jong u: hynrei kiba duk kim iohsngew ia ka jingshah pynrem .

en: A false witness shall perish : but the man that heareth speaketh constantly .
kha: Ym lah ban ngeit ïa ka jingphla shem mynsiem jong uba lamler , hynrei ka ktien jong uno uno uba da pyrkhat bha yn pdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sakhi kaba bakla kan jah noh: hynrei u briew uba iohsngew u kren beit .

en: Whereupon , O king Agrippa , I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision :
kha: Bad kumta , ko syiem Agrippa , ngam shym la long u bymkohnguh ïa ka jingïohipaw kaba nga la ïoh na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u syiem Agrippa , ngam shym la kohnguh ia ka jingphohsniew bneng:

en: And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, To khie, to leit noh: ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynlong ia me uba pura .

en: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?
kha: Balei ngin shu ïai khñium haba la pynshitom ïa ngi na ka bynta ka pop jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei u briew uba im u ud , u briew na ka bynta ka jingpynshitom ia ki pop jong u ?

en: And thou shalt have joy and gladness  ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .
kha: A katno men long uba shadkmen bad uba kmen , bad katno kiwei ruh kin kmen haba yn kha ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me phin ioh ia ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen ; bad bun kin sngewbha ha ka jingkha ia u .

en: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .
kha: Lada nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa nga ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Te ngan ym sngewlehrain haba nga burom ia ki hukum jong me baroh .

en: And he said unto them , Hear , I pray you , this dream which I have dreamed :
kha: U ong ,  Shahshkor ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki: To sngap, nga kyrpad ia phi, kane ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la phohsniew:

en: Princes are hanged up by their hand : the faces of elders were not honoured .
kha: Ïa ki nongïalam jong ngi la shim noh bad phasi ; ïa ki tymmen shynrang jong ngi ym shym la ñiewburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki shah pynsangeh da ka kti jong ki: ki khmat jong ki rangbah kim shym la shah burom .

en: Behold , I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness .
kha: Nga kwah ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ; to ai ha nga ka jingim bathymmai , namar me long uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la thrang ia ki jingbthah jong me: pynkloi ia nga ha ka hok jong me .

en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .
kha: U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem haduh khyndew bad u la mane .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynkhih ia la ka khlieh sha ka khyndew bad u la mane ia ka khyndew .

en: And he lighted the lamps before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: bad hangta ha ka jingdon U  Trai  u thang ïa kita ki sharak , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmeh ia ki sharak ha khmat U Trai ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And after that many days were fulfilled , the Jews took counsel to kill him :
kha: Hadien bun sngi , ki Jiw ki la ïashem lang bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynïap ïa u Saul , hynrei la ïathuh ha u shaphang ka jingthmu jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata bun sngi la pyndep , ki Jiw ki la iamir jingmut ban pyniap ia u:

en: To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity  ;
kha: Ki lah ban hikai ïa phi kumno ban im kum kiba stad bad kumno ban long uba hok , uba lehhok , bad uba ïaid beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pdiang ia ka jinghikai jong ka jingstad, ka hok bad ka jingbishar , bad ka jinglong marryngkat;

en: The crown of pride , the drunkards of Ephraim , shall be trodden under feet :
kha: Ïa ka jingsarong jong kito ki nongïalam buaid yn ïuhroit hapoh ki kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong ka jingsarong , ki nongdih buaid jong ka Ephraim , kin sa iaid hapoh ki kjat:

en: All the labour of man is for his mouth , and yet the appetite is not filled .
kha: Ngi trei ïa ki kam jong ngi baroh tang ban ïoh ei ei ban bam , hynrei ngim ju dap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtrei baroh jong u briew ka long na ka bynta ka shyntur jong u , bad wat la katta ruh ka jingkwah bam kam pat dap .

en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .
kha: U pynjahburom ïa kito kiba don ha ka bor bad pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: U theh ia ka jingleh bein ia ki syiem , bad u pyntlot ia ka bor jong kiba khlain .

en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .
kha: Phi donkam ban sympat ïa u kulai , phi dei ban teh lakam ïa u kada , bad phi dei ban sympat ïa uba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka whip na ka bynta u kulai , ka ryndang na ka bynta ka tdong , bad u dieng na ka bynta ka tyrpeng kaba bieit .

en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
kha: U Moses u leh ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Moses: kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u , kumta u la leh .

en: This wisdom descendeth not from above , but is earthly , sensual , devilish .
kha: Kaba kum kata ka jingstad kam long kaba wan hiar na bneng ; ka long jong ka pyrthei , kam long kaba kynja mynsiem bad ka long kaba kynja ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingstad kam hiar na jrong , hynrei ka long kaba pyrthei, kaba sngewthuh bakla .

en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .
kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit hadien ba U  Trai  U la shoh ïa ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew sngi la pyndep , hadien ba U Trai u la pynkhih ia ka wah .

en: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah , and Eshtaol , and Ir–shemesh ,
kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Sorah , ka Eshtaol , ka Irshemesh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw jong ka pateng jong ki ka long ka Sorah bad ka Eshetol bad ka Irshesh .

en: And a certain man was there , which had an infirmity thirty and eight years .
kha: Hangta la don u briew uba la pang haduh laiphew phra snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u la don hangta , uba don ka jingbym lah kha khun laiphew san snem .

en: The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .
kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki ïaid ha ka lynti kaba ïalam artet sha ka jingim , ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong ka jingim ka long halor jong kiba stad , ba un leit noh na dujok shapoh .

en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;
kha: Wad ïa ka kumba phi wad ïa ka rupa lane ïa kano kano ka spah ba la buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me wad ia ka kum ka rupa, bad wad ia ka kum ki spah ba la buhrieh ; .

en: But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .
kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la klet ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Seion u la ong , U Trai u la iehnoh ia nga , bad U Trai jong nga u la klet noh ia nga .

en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .
kha: Naba men long u sakhi na ka bynta jong u ban ïathuh ha uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi bad ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong u ha ki briew baroh jong kaei kaba me la iohi bad iohsngew .

en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .
kha: Hamar kaba shiteng na ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la jan kut U Jisu u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la sdang ban hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha pdeng ka jingkhawai U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka tempi bad u la hikai .

en: Why did God not destroy Adam and Eve and start over with another human pair ?

en: For the truth s sake , which dwelleth in us , and shall be with us for ever .
kha: namar ka jingshisha ka ïaisah ha ngi bad kan long lem bad ngi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingshisha kaba shong ha ngi bad kan long bad ngi junom .

en: Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .
kha: Hynrei phim bit ban bam ïa ka snam jong ki ; phi dei ban theh ïa ka ha ka khyndew kumba theh ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ma phi phin ym bam ia ka snam ; phin theh ia ka ha ka khyndew kum ka um .

en: And Saul said , Blessed be ye of the  Lord   ; for ye have compassion on me .
kha: U Saul u jubab ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ba lehsbun ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , To long kiba la kyrkhu na U Trai ; namar phi sngewsynei ia nga .

en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour , seeing he dwelleth securely by thee .
kha: Wat thmu sniew ei ei ban pynmong ïa la u paramarjan , uba sah hajan jong phi , uba shaniah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym sngewsih ia u paramarjan jong me, haba u shong shngain ha me .

en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire .
kha: Kumta u Hiram u la pynbiang ïa u Solomon da ki dieng Kedar tylli bad ki dieng Kseh tylli baroh kiba u kwah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hiram u la ai ia u Solomon u dieng bad u dieng ding kat kum ka jingkwah jong u baroh .

en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner .
kha: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la jia long uba donkam eh na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait u kylla long u maw khlieh jong ka kut .

en: The new wine mourneth , the vine languisheth , all the merryhearted do sigh .
kha: Ki bri sohwaiñ ki la ïapstai bad ka um sohwaiñ ka la nang duna . Baroh kiba la long shisien kiba kmen , mynta ki sngewsih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wain thymmai ka iam, u sohjew u sngap jar, baroh kiba sngewbha ki sngap jar .

en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;
kha: U riewarsap u buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktien pynkhyllew .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shun ia ka jingkren bein bad ki rmiang shyntur jong u, bad u buh ia ka jingthok hapoh jong u ; .

en: Love ye therefore the stranger : for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
kha: Namar kata , ieit ïa kita ki nongwei , namar phi ruh phi la long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: To ieit ia u nongwei: namar phi la long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: He takes the lead in helping his family to learn about God and His purposes .
kha: Kum u khlieh jong ka ïing u dei ban long u banyngkong ha ka ban ïarap ban hikai ïa ki shaphang U Blei bad ki jingthmu jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: U shim ia ka jingialam ha kaba iarap ia ka iing ka sem jong u ban nang shaphang U Blei bad ki jingthmu jong U .

en: The sorrows of hell compassed me about  ; the snares of death prevented me  ;
kha: Ka jingma jong ka jingïap ka don sawdong jong nga , bad ka jingtep ka pynap la ka jingriam ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingsngewsih jong ka dujok ki la ker sawdong ia nga shaphang ; ki jingeh jong ka jingiap ki la khanglad ia nga ; .

en: Thus did your fathers , when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land .
kha: Kata ka dei kaei ba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh haba nga la phah ïa ki na Kadesh Barnea ban leit swar ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki kpa jong phi ki la leh kumta haba nga la phah ia ki na Kadeshbarnea ban iohi ia ka ri .

en: So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .
kha: Haba kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , ngim dei ki khun jong kata ka kynthei mraw , hynrei jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta te, ko para bangeit, ngim dei ki khun jong ka kynthei bond, hynrei jong ka jinglaitluid .

en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened , and the palace shall be dissolved .
kha: Ki khyrdop hapoh ka wah ki bthei ; ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ka jingsngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khyrdop jong ki wah kin plie , bad ka iing syiem kan jah noh .

en: Be ye therefore perfect , even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect .
kha: Phi dei ban long kiba janai — kumba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u long uba janai !
translated_en_to_kha: To long namarkata kiba janai , kumba U Kpa jong phi uba don ha bneng u long uba janai .

en: Ye are the light of the world . A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid .
kha: Phi , phi long kum ka jingshai ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ïa ka nongbah ba la tei halor u lum ym lah ban buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ka jingshai jong ka pyrthei . Ka nongbah kaba la buh ha u lum ym lah ban buhrieh .

en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared ,
kha: Hynrei haba la pynpaw ïa ka jingsbun bad ka jingieit U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi , u la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien kata ka jingbha bad jingieit U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ia u briew ka la paw , .

en: And they put the fat upon the breasts , and he burnt the fat upon the altar :
kha: halor ki shadem jong ki bad u rah ïa ki baroh sha ka duwan . U thang ïa ka khleiñ halor ka duwan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka shini ha ki bniat bad u la thang ia ka shini ha ka almari:

en: And Jesus answering them began to say ,  Take heed lest any man deceive you :
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Sumar bha , bad wat ai ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la sdang ban ong ia ki: To sumar bha ioh ba uno uno un shukor ia phi:

en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .
kha: Mynmiet ki shyieng jong nga baroh ki pang ; ka jingpang kaba bam ïa nga kam kut shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyieng jong nga ki la tyrkhong ha nga ha ka aiom miet: bad ki shyieng jong nga kim shongthait .

en: For if they do these things in a green tree , what shall be done in the dry ?
kha: Naba lada ïa kiba kum kine kiei kiei la leh haba u dieng u dang jyrngam , kaei ka ban jia haba u la tyrkhong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ki leh ia kine kiei kiei ha u dieng uba jyrngam , kaei kaba dei ban leh ha ka jaka ba rkhiang ?

en: They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;
kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban kren , bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim ju kren ; ki khmat ki don ki , hynrei kim iohi ; .

en: Remember the word unto thy servant , upon which thou hast caused me to hope .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ka jingkular jong me ïa nga , u shakri jong me , ka la ai jingkyrmen ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ka ktien ha u shakri jong me , ha kaba me la pynlong ia nga ban kyrmen .

en: But the other of love , knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel .
kha: Kiwei pat , kim ïalap ïa U Khrist da kaba sngur , hynrei na ka mynsiem ka jingkwah rhah ; ba ki da pyrkhat ba kin nang pynjynjar shuh shuh ïa nga katba nga dang don ha byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei pat ka jingieit , da kaba tip ba nga la buh na ka bynta ka jingiada ia ka gospel .

en: Let them give glory unto the  Lord  , and declare his praise in the islands .
kha: Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ki ri bajngai kin ai ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin ai burom ia U Trai , bad kin pynbna ia ka jingiaroh jong u ha ki dulir .

en: But murmured in their tents , and hearkened not unto the voice of the  Lord .
kha: Ki ïashong ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïakhñium bad kim sngap ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la ia sngap jar ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki , bad kim shym la sngap ïa ka sur U Trai .

en: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
kha: Wat long kiba bieit , hynrei , pyrshang ban wad ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat long kiba khlem akor , hynrei to sngewthuh ia kaei ka mon U Trai .

en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry  ; her clothing is silk and purple .
kha: Ka thain ïa ki jaiñ siang thiah bad ka phong da ki jaiñ linen bani bad basawbthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pynlong ia lade da ki jingtap tapestry ; ki jain jong ka ki long kiba jem bad kiba jyrngam .

en: Or darkness , that thou canst not see  ; and abundance of waters cover thee .
kha: Ka wan ka jingdum ba phim lah shuh ban ïohi , bad ka jingshlei ka tyllep ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane ka jingdum , ba me lah ban iohi ia me; bad ka jingbun ki um ka tap ia me .

en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .
kha: U lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia ainguh ha nga , ïa ka jingkñia ainguh bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Un bam ia u kpu U Blei jong u , na kiba khuid tam .

en: A fool uttereth all his mind : but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards .
kha: Ki briew kiba bieit ki pynpaw ïa la ka jingbitar ha kaba paw , hynrei ki briew kiba shemphang ki ïaishah bad ki set khop ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bieit u kren ia ka jingmut jong u baroh: hynrei u briew uba stad u buh ia ka haduh hadien .

en: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly .
kha: Ha kita ki maw ba phi la ñiad astor , thoh shai ïa ki ktien baroh jong ki hukum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban thoh ha ki maw ia ki ktien jong kane ka hukum da kaba shai bha .

en: But this man , because he continueth ever , hath an unchangeable priesthood .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u im junom , bad ka kam jong u kum u lyngdoh kam shym la hiarpateng sha uno uno uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei une u briew, namar u dang iai bteng, ka jinglong lyngdoh kaba ym lah ban pynkylla .

en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad , and rivers of waters in the streets .
kha: Ki khun kiba phi la ïoh na kiwei pat ki kynthei kin ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki pung um jong me kin saphriang shabar ri , bad ki wah um ha ki lynti .

en: Our fathers have sinned , and are not  ; and we have borne their iniquities .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh pop , hynrei mynta kim don shuh , bad ngi shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa jong ngi ki la leh pop , bad kim long shuh bad ngi la kha ia ki jingbymhok jong ki .

en: And Jesus called a little child unto him , and set him in the midst of them ,
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot ïa u khynnah , u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la khot ia u khynnah rit ha u bad u la buh ia u hapdeng jong ki .

en: For wheresoever the carcase is , there will the eagles be gathered together .
kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hangno hangno ba ka met ka don , hangta ki blang kin ialum lang .

en: magazine , one young woman wrote :  " The articles were my life story . " " "
kha: magazine , kawei ka samla ka la thoh :  " Ki jingthoh ki la long ka jingiathuhkhana jong ka jingim jong nga . " " "
translated_en_to_kha: ka kot khubor , kawei ka samla ka la thoh: "Ki jingthoh ki long ka jingiathuhkhana jong nga ."

en: And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
kha: Kaba kum kata ka jinghikai ka long kum ka prum kaba bam noh ïa ka doh . Ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la hikai kum ïa kita kiei kiei ki dei u Hymenaïos bad u Philetos .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ktien jong ki kan bam kum ka jingpang: na kiba u Hymnaos bad u Philetos;

en: I am not able to bear all this people alone , because it is too heavy for me .
kha: Da lade hi ngam lah shuh ban kitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ; ka la khia than ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam lah ban shah ia kine ki briew baroh marwei , namar ka long kaba khia palat ia nga .

en: And again , Praise the Lord , all ye Gentiles ; and laud him , all ye people .
kha: Shuh shuh ka ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko ki Jentil baroh ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jaitbynriew baroh!
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien , Iaroh ia U Trai , phi baroh ki Jutang ; bad to iaroh ia u , phi baroh ki briew .

en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .
kha: Kane baroh ka la jia ha Bethania kaba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ha kaba u Ïoannis u la pynbaptis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kine kiei kiei la leh ha Bethabara sha lyndet ka Jordan , ha kaba u loannis u dang pynbaptis .

en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple .
kha: bad um shah ïano ïano ruh ban rah ei ei lyngba ki phyllaw jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym shah ba uno uno u briew un kit ia kano kano ka lieng lyngba ka tempi .

en: Behold , this is the joy of his way , and out of the earth shall others grow .
kha: Ho-oid , kata ka long baroh ka jingkmen ba ki riewbymman ki ïoh , kiwei pat mynta ki wan bad ki shim ïa ki jaka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih kane ka long ka jingkmen jong ka lynti jong u, bad na ka khyndew kiwei pat kin roi .

en: Then said they to him again , What did he to thee ? how opened he thine eyes ?
kha: U la leh aïu ïa me ?  ki la kylli .  Kumno u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong biang ia u , Kaei kaba u la leh ia me ? kumno u la plie ia ki khmat jong me ?

en: I don't remember if Tom lent me the book or if I borrowed it from the library.
kha: Ngam kynmaw ba dei u Tom uba aikylliang ha nga ia ka kot ne dei ba nga shimkylliang na library.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam kynmaw lada u Tom u la ai ram ia nga ia ka kot ne lada nga la shim ram na ka library.

en: The incident took place at a government hospital in Chamarajanagar, Karnataka.
kha: Katei ka jingjia, ka dei ha ka hospital sorkar ha Chamarajanagar jong ka jylla Karnataka.
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingjia ka la jia ha kawei ka hospital sorkar ha Chamarajanagar, Karnataka.

en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria , and preached Christ unto them .
kha: U Philip u la leit sha ka nongbah ha Samaria bad u la ïalap ïa U Messaïah ha ki briew hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Philip u la leit sha ka shnong Samaria bad u la ialap ia U Khrist ha ki .

en: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .
kha: Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahpanhes ki la pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki khun jong u Memphis bad u Tahpan ki la pynpra ia ka khlieh jong me .

en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass .
kha: ki la ïakylliang noh ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ka dur jong u mrad uba bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la pynkylla ia ka burom jong ki sha ka jingiasyriem jong u masi uba bam ia u phlang .

en: Our team is working on resolving the payment discrepancy. Please bear with us.
kha: Ka kynhun jong ngi ka dang trei ban pynbeit ïa ka jingbym ïahap ha ka jingsiew. Sngewbha ïaishah bad ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun jong ngi ka dang trei ban pynbeit ia ka jingbym iahap jong ka jingsiew. Sngewbha shah ia ngi.

en: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?
kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me long u nongwei , bad ba ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa me ha ki ïing jong ngi , lane ba me lyngkhuit bad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ngi la iohi ia me u nongwei , bad ngi la shim ia me ? lane lyngkhuid bad ngi la phong ia me ?

en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?
kha: Kine ki dei ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa U Blei bad kiba ngeit ba um lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la ong ha U Blei , To leit noh na ngi : bad kaei kaba U Blei uba donbor u lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ki ?

en: Your satisfaction is our priority, and we’ll do everything to make this right.
kha: Ka jingsngewhun jong phi ka long ka jingthmu ba kongsan jong ngi, bad ngin sa leh ïa kaba donkam baroh ban pynbeit ïa kane.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewhun jong phi ka long kaba kongsan jong ngi, bad ngin leh ia kiei kiei baroh ban pynlong ia kane ka hok.

en: Even as Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him for righteousness .
kha: To pyrkhat ïa ka jingïashem u Abraham , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u Abraham u ngeit ia U Blei , bad la khein ia ka ha u na ka bynta ka hok .

en: The thought of foolishness is sin : and the scorner is an abomination to men .
kha: Kano kano ka jingthmu ba u bieit u pyrkhat ka long pop . Ki briew ki isih ïa u briew u bym don ei ei hynrei uba rkhiebeiñ ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpyrkhat jong ka jingbieit ka long ka pop: bad u nonglehkai u long uba sngewsih ia ki briew .

en: We understand how frustrating this must be and truly regret the inconvenience.
kha: Ngi sngewthuh haduh katno kane ka dei ban long kaba pynsngewsih bad ngi sngewsih shisha ïa ka jingbymsuk jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewthuh haduh katno kane ka dei ban long bad ngi sngewsih shisha ia ka jingbymsuk.

en: Hast thou given the horse strength ? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder ?
kha: Hato dei ma me , ko Job , uba pynkhlaiñ haduh katta katta ïa ki kulai bad ai ha ki ïa ki treng kiba noh rymphum ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la ai ia ka bor kulai ? hato me la phong ia ka ryndang jong u da ka jingsma ?

en: The place was worshipped and a lamp lighted there daily at the onset of dusk .
kha: La mane ia kata ka jaka bad la pynmeh ia ka sharak hangta man ka sngi ha ka por ba sdang ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: La mane ia ka jaka bad ka lamp ka la shai hangta man ka sngi ha ka por ba sdang ka jingdum .

en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , bad u theh ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia ka ; bad u Moses u la theh ia ka snam halor ka almari sawdong .

en: We’ve escalated your concern to the higher management for immediate attention.
kha: Ngi la pynkiew ïa ka jingsngewkhïa jong phi sha ki bor pynïaid kiba kham halor ban shimkhïa mardor.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la nang kiew ka jingsngewkhia jong phi sha ka jingpyniaid kaba kham halor na ka bynta ka jingpyrkhat kaba kloi.

en: Actor Anil Kapoor has shared a new picture with Prime Minister Narendra Modi .
kha: U actor Anil Kapoor u la iasam ia ka dur kaba thymmai bad u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Actor Anil Kapoor u la iasam ia ka dur kaba thymmai bad u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi .

en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man .
kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , phin pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad ïa u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to shem ia ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingsngewthuh kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad u briew .

en: But if ye will not hearken unto me , and will not do all these commandments  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym sngap ia nga bad phin ym leh ia kine ki hukum baroh ; .

en: Check the full product description and specifications before placing an order.
kha: Peit bha ïa ka jingbatai ba pura jong ki mar bad ki jingtip ba bnïah shwa ban buh ïa ka ordar.
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia ka jingbatai bad ki jingbatai ba pura shwa ban buh ia ka order.

en: Which maketh Arcturus , Orion , and Pleiades , and the chambers of the south .
kha: U Blei u sdien ïa ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng — ka Dngiem Heh    , u Orion    bad ki Pleïades    , bad ki khlur shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pynlong ia u Arcturus , u Orion bad ki Pleiades bad ki kamra jong ka thain shatei lam mihngi .

en: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ksang ti , u la buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki , bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki ha ki kti jong u, u la buh ia ki kti jong u halor jong ki bad u la kyrkhu ia ki .

en: Saying , This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you .
kha: U la ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba la shonshab ïa ka jutang ba U Blei u la hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Kane ka long ka snam jong ka jutang kaba U Blei u la hukum ha phi .

en: Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :
kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki syiem bad phi ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki khun syiem shynrang bad baroh kiwei ki nongsynshar ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Syiem jong ka khyndew , bad ki rangbah baroh , bad ki nongbishar baroh jong ka khyndew:

en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .
kha: Kumba ka long , namarkata , ki jingkñia ainguh ki don na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew shaphang ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kita ki jingknia ka don ka jingkynmaw biang ia ki pop man la u snem .

en: Who hath believed our report ? and to whom is the arm of the  Lord  revealed ?
kha: Ki briew ki jubab ,  Uei uba lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba ngi ïathuh mynta ? Uei uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka kti U  Trai  ha kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba ngeit ia ka kaiphod jong ngi ? bad hano la pynpaw ia ka kti U Trai ?

en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son :
kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsynei ïa u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewsih ia kane ka jingsngewsih halor u Saul bad halor u Jonathan u khun jong u:

en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .
kha: Ka kham bha ban ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem kaba la duh noh ïa la ki khun ban ïa kaba ïakynduh ïa uno uno uba bieit uba bunkam ha ka kam mutlop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba u bear u la shah lute ha ki bniat jong ka un iakynduh ia u briew , ban ia u briew uba bieit ha ka jinglong bieit jong u .

en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart , and be no more stiffnecked .
kha: Kumta , naduh mynta , kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad wat long shuh kiba mutlop .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhluit namarkata ia ka sniehdoh jong ka dohnud jong phi , bad wat nym sngur shuh .

en: These have one mind , and shall give their power and strength unto the beast .
kha: Kine baroh shiphew ngut ki don kajuh ka jingthmu , bad ki ai ïa ka bor bad ka iktiar jong ki ha u mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki don kawei ka jingmut , bad kin ai ia ka bor bad ka bor jong ki ha u mrad .

en: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me , but walk contrary unto me  ;
kha: Lada hadien kat kane phim treh ban shahshkor ïa nga bad phi dang ïai pyrshah hi ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phin ym sngap ia nga baroh, hynrei to iaid pyrshah ia nga;

en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .
kha: ki sei shabar ïa u rishot bakyntang uba don hangta bad ki thang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ki dur na ka iing u Baal bad ki la thang ia ki .

en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .
kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun shipai ha ka Them Siddim , kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh ki la iasoh lang ha ka wah Siddim kaba long ka duriaw mluh .

en: The evil bow before the good  ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin hap ban pyndem ha kiba hok bad kyrpad rit ïa ka jinglehisynei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew ka dem ha khmat kiba bha bad kiba sniew ha ki khyrdop jong kiba hok .

en: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
kha: Naba kaei kaba nga leh , ka dei kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka Hukum ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga leh ia kata kaba ngam kwah , nga mynjur ia ka hukum ba ka long kaba bha .

en: Because of the mountain of Zion , which is desolate , the foxes walk upon it .
kha: namar u lum Seïon u long kynjah bad u la shah iehnoh , bad ki myrsiang khlaw ki shang kylleng lyngba ki jingpra jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u lum Seion uba la jot , ki blang ki iaid halor jong ka .

en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .
kha: Ka bainong ban lehbha ka lam sha ka jingim ; hynrei ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pop shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtrei shitom jong kiba hok ka long kaba rit: u soh jong kiba sniew ban leh pop .

en: Thy first father hath sinned , and thy teachers have transgressed against me .
kha: U kpa tymmen banyngkong eh jong phi u la leh pop ; ki nongïalam jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa ba nyngkong jong me u la leh pop , bad ki nonghikai jong me ki la iaid lait ia nga .

en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up , and the clouds drop down the dew .
kha: Ka jingstad jong u , ka pynlah ïa ki wah ban tuid bad ïa ki lyoh ba kin pynhap slap ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingtip jong u la pynpra ia ki jingjylliew , bad ki lyoh ki pynhap ia ka dewbilat .

en: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city .
kha: Ka jingstad ka lehbha bun shah ïa u briew ban ïa kaba ki shiphew ngut ki nongsynshar ki lah ban leh ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka pynskhem ia kiba stad palat ia ki shiphew ngut ki briew kiba don ha ka nongbah .

en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass ? or loweth the ox over his fodder ?
kha: U Kada u sngewhun haba u bam phlang , bad ka masi ka sngap jar haba ka bam skum kba ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u blang khlaw u rkhie haba u don u phlang ? lane u pynhiar ia u masi halor ka jingbam jong u ?

en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .
kha: Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri jong ki ka la pynmih ia ki khnai ha ka jingbun , ha ki kamra jong ki syiem jong ki .

en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .
kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah shen un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingjynjar jong iwei pa iwei i briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah un pynkut noh shen ia ka jingjynjar jong uwei pa uwei .

en: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
kha: U don borabor ïa ka jinglong U Blei ; hynrei um shym pyrkhat ïa kata da ka bor ba u dei ban pyrshang ban pynlong mar ryngkat bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba long ha ka dur U Blei , u la pyrkhat ba kam long kaba iaryngkat bad U Blei:

en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time , and numbered all Israel .
kha: Mar kumta hi , u syiem Joram u mihnoh na Samaria bad u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Jehoram u la mih na Samaria ha kajuh ka por , bad u la khein ia ki Israel baroh .

en: Let them not depart from thine eyes  ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
kha: Wat shah ba kin phet noh na phi ; kynmaw bad ri kyndong ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba kin leit noh na ki khmat jong me ; to buh ia ki hapdeng ka dohnud jong me .

en: Have all the gifts of healing ? do all speak with tongues ? do all interpret ?
kha: Baroh kim long ki Apostol ne ki nongïathuhlypa ne ki nonghikai . Ym baroh ki don ïa ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah lane ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher lane ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki jingai sngewbha baroh jong ka jingpynkhiah ? hato baroh ki kren da ki thylliej ? hato baroh ki batai ?

en: From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .
kha: Namar kane , kiba bun na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki la phai dien noh bad kim leit shuh bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh kata ka por bun na ki synran jong u ki la leit phai noh bad kim ju iaid shuh bad u .

en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .
kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong . To ïaroh ïa u da ki wiang rnong bajam .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia u halor ki cymbal kiba jam: iaroh ia u halor ki cymbal kiba sawa bha .

en: He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .
kha: U tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan hiar ; bad u lyoh uba dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem ia ki bneng ruh , bad u la wan hiar ; bad ka jingdum ka la don hapoh ki kjat jong u .

en: My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee  ;
kha: Ko khun , to sngewthuh ïa kaei ba nga hikai ïa phi , bad wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga lada me pdiang ia ki ktien jong nga bad buhrieh ia ki hukum jong nga bad me ; .

en: Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .
kha: Ki snep ha ka kpoh jong u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kiba nep ; ki tar ïa ka madan ktieh kumba long ka lyntang shoh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki maw kiba jem ki don hapoh jong u: u pynphriang ia kiei kiei kiba la kdew bha ha ka dewbilat .

en: For by thee I have run through a troop : by my God have I leaped over a wall .
kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad ka bor ba ngan jop ïa ki jingïada jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da me nga la mareh lyngba ka kynhun shipai: da U Blei jong nga nga la jngi halor ka kynroh .

en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house  ; and the man stood by me .
kha: Uta u briew u ïeng ha syndah jong nga hangta , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga shabar ka Templ bad ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia u ba u kren ha nga na iing ; bad uta u briew u la ieng hajan jong nga .

en: And above all these things put on charity , which is the bond of perfectness .
kha: Bad nalor kine ki jinglong baroh , to bynrap ïa ka jingieit , kaba tehsong lang ïa kiei kiei baroh lang ha ka jingïatylli kaba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor kiei kiei baroh ki la buh ha ka jingai sngewbha , kaba long ka jingiadei jong ka jinglong janai .

en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Jeroboan u la sdang ban synshar halor ka Judah .

en: And he straitly charged them , and commanded them to tell no man that thing  ;
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ai ha ki , ki hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh ïa kane hano hano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh jur ia ki , bad u la hukum ia ki ban iathuh ia kata ka kam ; .

en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .
kha: Nangta u Samuel u leit sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïing ha Gibeah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la leit sha Ramah ; bad u Saul u la leit sha iing jong u ha Gibeah u Saul .

en: And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :
kha: U long uba hakhlieh tam halor kawei pa kawei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi long kiba janai ha u, uba long u khlieh jong ka hima bad ka bor baroh:

en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .
kha: U Jisu te u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ba baroh ki briew kin phiah ha ki kynhun kynhun bad shong halor u phlang bajyrngam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki ban pynlong ia ki ban shong baroh da ki kompeni halor u phlang uba jyrngam .

en: We resolved this conflict by sitting down and really listening to each other .
kha: Ngi la pynbeit ia kane ka jingialeh da kaba shong bad sngap shisha iwei ia iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la pynbeit ia kane ka jingialeh da kaba shong bad sngap shisha iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?
kha: Kumno u nud ban kren kumne ? Kane ka dei ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! Dei tang U Blei hi marwei uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !
translated_en_to_kha: Balei une u briew u kren kumta ? uba lah ban map ia ki pop hynrei tang U Blei ?

en: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
kha: Hynrei la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , uba , lem bad ka tnga jong u ka Sapphira , ki la die katto katne na ka jaka kaba dei ka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , bad ka tnga jong u ka Saphira ka la die ia ka jaka .

en: Behold , he spreadeth his light upon it , and covereth the bottom of the sea .
kha: U phah ïa ka leilieh kylleng ka suiñbneng hynrei ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ka ïailong kaba dum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u pynphriang ia ka jingshai jong u halor jong ka , bad u tap ia ka tduh jong ka duriaw .

en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .
kha: Ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , kam shym la ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka Michal ka khun u Saul kam don khun haduh ka sngi ba ka iap .

en: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .
kha: U khun uba bieit u pynsngewsih ïa la u kpa bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun uba bieit u long ka jingsngewsih ia u kpa jong u , bad ka jingsngewsih ia ka kaba kha ia u .

en: For three things the earth is disquieted , and for four which it cannot bear :
kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei ba ka pyrthei da lade kam lah shah :
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta lai tylli kiei kiei ka khyndew ka la jah rngai noh , bad na ka bynta saw tylli kiei kiei kiba kam lah ban shah:

en: He spake , and the locusts came , and caterpillers , and that without number ,
kha: U la hukum , bad ki puit ki ïawan da ki million bad ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren , bad ki khnai ki la wan , bad ki khnai , bad kata khlem jingkhein , .

en: And David , according to the saying of Gad , went up as the  Lord  commanded .
kha: U Dabid u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit kumba u Gad u la ïathuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid kat kum ka jingong u Gad u la leit shaneng kumba U Trai u la hukum .

en: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
kha: Lymne U Kpa da lade hi um bishar ïano ïano . U la ai ha la U Khun ïa ka hok baroh ban bishar , ba baroh kin burom ïa U Khun kumba ki burom ïa U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Kpa um bishar iano iano ruh hynrei u la leh ia ka jingbishar baroh ha U Khun:

en: For their rock is not as our Rock , even our enemies themselves being judges .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ki , ki tip ba ki blei jong ki , ki tlot , kim long kiba donbor kum U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u maw jong ki um long kum u Rock jong ngi , wat ki nongshun jong ngi hi ki long ki nongbishar .

en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïakren para ma ki :  U ong ïa kane namar ngim don kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia pyrkhat hapdeng jong ki da kaba ong: Ka long namar ba ngim don kpu .

en: And God looked upon the children of Israel , and God had respect unto them .
kha: U ïohi ïa ka jinglongmraw jong ki Israel , bad u la sngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la peit ia ki khun Israel bad U Blei u la burom ia ki .

en: He said that whenever he visits India , it gives him the sense of homecoming .
kha: U la ong ba man la ka por ba u leit sha India , ka ai ia u ia ka jingsngew ba u wan phai sha la iing .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ba man ka por ba u leit jngoh ia ka ri India , ka ai ia u ia ka jingsngew ba u wan phai sha la iing .

en: And these are the generations of Isaac , Abraham s son : Abraham begat Isaac :
kha: Kane ka dei ka khana shaphang u Isaak u khun jong u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki pateng u Isaak , u khun u Abraham: U Abraham u la kha ia u Isaak:

en: The  Lord  hath chastened me sore : but he hath not given me over unto death .
kha: U la pynshitom jur ïa nga , hynrei um shym la shah ïa nga ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynshitom ia nga: hynrei um shym la aiti ia nga haduh ka jingiap .

en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .
kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u khunlung ki la sngewlyngngoh ha kiei kiei kiba u Simeon u la kren shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph bad ka kmie jong u ki la lyngngoh ia kita kiei kiei kiba la kren shaphang jong u .

en: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim , and came unto the house of Micah .
kha: Ki leit sha khmat nangta bad ki wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba don ha ri lum Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid noh nangta sha u lum Ephraim bad ki la poi ha iing u Micah .

en: He teacheth my hands to war  ; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms .
kha: U hikai ïa nga ban ïaleh thma , ba kumta nga lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ryntieh kaba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U hikai ia ki kti jong nga ban ialeh ; kumta ka bow jong ka nar ka la tyrkhong da ki kti jong nga .

en: And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .
kha: U Abram u la don phraphew hynriew snem ha kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la don saw snem bad hynriew snem, haba u Hagar u la kha ia u Ishmael ha u Abram .

en: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :
kha: Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka jingshemphang kum ka paralok ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha ka jingstad , Me long ka para jong nga ; bad khot ia ka jingsngewthuh ia ka kynthei jong me:

en: For it is written , He shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee :
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un hukum ïa ki angel jong u ban sumar bha ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh , Un ai ia ki angel jong u ban bat ia me:

en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Uba Khuid long ma u !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi, bad to mane ha ka jaka shong kjat jong u ; namar u long uba khuid .

en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  lymda kumta ki paidbah ki lah ban khih kulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la ong , Ym ha ka sngi bam , ioh ba kan don ka jingkhihwin jong ki briew .

en: So he went another way , and returned not by the way that he came to Beth–el .
kha: Kumta um shym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba u la wan , hynrei na kawei pat ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit noh da kumwei pat ka lynti, bad um shym la wan phai shuh da ka lynti kaba u la poi sha Bethesel .

en: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites , and prophesy against them  ;
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia ki Ammonite bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ki ; .

en: In 1985 he receives India ' s highest award for films , ' Dadasaheb Phalke ' .
kha: Ha ka snem 1985 u la ioh ia ka khusnam kaba heh tam jong ka ri India na ka bynta ki phlim , ‘ Dadasaheb Phalke ’ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u snem 1985 u ioh ia ka khusnam kaba heh tam na ka bynta ki phlim , ' Dadasaheb Phalke ' .

en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee .
kha: Mynshuwa nga la tip tang ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa nga , da kaba nga ïohsngew pateng na kiwei ; hynrei mynta nga la ïohi ïa me da la ki jong ki khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia me da ka jingsngap jong ka shkor: hynrei mynta ka khmat jong nga ka iohi ia me .

en: It shall be accomplished before his time , and his branch shall not be green .
kha: Ha shuwa ba ka por jong u kan kut , un ïapstai noh , un ïapstai noh kum ki tnat bad kin ym jyrngam biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn pyndep ia ka ha khmat ka por jong u , bad ka tnat jong u kan ym long kaba jyrngam .

en: So Gad came to David , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Choose thee
kha: U Gad u la leit sha U Dabid , u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano men jied ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Gad u la wan sha u Dabid bad u la ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai .

en: A righteous government that can benefit you personally . —Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
kha: Ka sorkar kaba hok kaba lah ban pynmyntoi ïa phi shimet shimet .—Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sorkar kaba hok kaba lah ban pynmyntoi ia phi shimet .  Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .

en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor , that looketh toward Jeshimon .
kha: Kumta u la ïalam ïa u Balaam sha khlieh u Lum Peor uba phai shaphang ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la wanrah ia u Balaam sha jrong jong u Peor , uba peit sha Jeshimon .

en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .
kha: U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih halor jong me ban ïada ïa me shano shano ba me leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un ai ia ki angel jong u halor jong me , ban sumar ia me ha ki lynti jong me baroh .

en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang nyngkong jong ki nong Ijipt ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la pynkhih ia ka Ijipt ha u khun nyngkong jong ki: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes .
kha: To bat ha ka kti jong me ïa kito ki lyngkhot dieng ar tylli bad ai ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki dieng kiba me thoh kin don ha ka kti jong me ha khmat ki khmat jong ki .

en: And they asked him , saying , Why say the scribes that Elias must first come ?
kha: Bad ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ong ba u Elijah u hap ban wan nyngkong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u da kaba ong: Balei ki nongthoh ba u Elias u dei ban wan nyngkong ?

en: And Jehu said , Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal . And they proclaimed it .
kha: Nangta u Jehu u hukum ,  Pynbna ïa ka sngi jong ka jingmane ban lehburom ïa u Baal !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la ong , Pynkhlain ia ka jingialang kaba skhem na ka bynta u Baal . Bad ki la pynbna ia ka .

en: Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself ?
kha: Hato me ïohsngew pateng ïa ki jingthmu U Blei ïa kiba u la thaw ? Hato ka jingstad briew ka dei ka jong me marwei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la iohsngew ia ka jingmaham jong U Blei ? bad me khang ia ka jingstad ha lade ?

en: As many as I love , I rebuke and chasten : be zealous therefore , and repent .
kha: Nga sneng bad sympat ïa baroh kiba nga ieit . Long kaba thrang eh , te , bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang ieit , nga pynrem bad nga la sngewsih: to long kiba sngewrit namarkata , bad to kylla bamut .

en: They did not destroy the nations , concerning whom the  Lord  commanded them :
kha: Kim shym la pynïap ïa ki nongmane bleithaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kim shym la pynjot ia ki jaitbynriew , shaphang kiba U Trai u la hukum ia ki:

en: Seek ye the  Lord  while he may be found , call ye upon him while he is near :
kha: To phai sha U  Trai  bad duwai ha u , mynta ba u don hajan .
translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia U Trai katba u dang don, to khot ia u katba u dang jan:

en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
kha: Baroh shi miet , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïaid na Gilgal sha Gibeon bad ki la tur kyndit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la wan sha ki kynsan kynsan bad u la leit kiew na Gilgal baroh shi miet .

en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country .
kha: Bad u la ïai kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid na kata ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyrpad shibun ia u ba un ym phah noh ia ki na ka ri .

en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake .
kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u la ai ha u Stephan ïa ka jingstad kum kane ba haba u la kren , kim shym lah ban pynrem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim lah ban pyrshah ia ka jingstad bad ka mynsiem da kaba u kren .

en: Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
kha: Ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Arngut ki briew kin don ha lyngkha; ia uwei pat yn shim noh .

en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning Moab since that time .
kha: Kata ka dei ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai mynshuwa shaphang ka Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka ktien kaba U Trai u la kren shaphang kata ka por .

en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain , and his soul within him shall mourn .
kha: U sngew tang ïa ka jingpang ha ka met jong u hi bad ki jingkhuslai ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh jong u halor jong u kan don ka jingpang, bad ka mynsiem jong u hapoh jong u kan iam .

en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .
kha: Ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah ïa ki sha ka  liewlong khlem trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kyrpad ia u ba un ym hukum ia ki ban leit shapoh .

en: But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
kha: Ka jingwan U Khun U Briew kan long kum kaei kaba la jia ha ka por u Noah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba ki sngi u Noah ki long kumta ruh ka jingwan jong u Khun u briew kan long .

en: And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth–lehem .
kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la ïap , la tep ïa ka harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rakhel u la iap bad la tep ia u ha ka lynti sha Ephrath kaba long ka Bethlehem .

en: Wise men lay up knowledge : but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction .
kha: Kiba stad ki ïoh ïa ka jingtip baroh kaba ki lah ; hynrei haba kiba bieit ki kren , ka jingkulmar ka mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki buh ia ka jingtip: hynrei ka shyntur jong kiba bieit ka la jan shah pynjot .

en: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things , and to enter into his glory ?
kha: Hato kam long kaba donkam ïa U Messaïah ban shahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei baroh bad nangta ban rung sha ka burom jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Khrist um dei ban shah shitom ia kine kiei kiei bad ban rung sha ka burom jong u ?

en: Moses commanded us a law , even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob .
kha: Ngi kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ ba u Moses u ai ha ngi , ka spah kordor tam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la hukum ia ngi ia ka ain , wat ia ka pateng jong ka jingiaseng u Jakob .

en: And again another scripture saith , They shall look on him whom they pierced .
kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  Ki briew kin ïakhmih ïa uta ïa uba ki la sum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa kawei pat ka jingthoh ka ong , Kin peit ia uta uba ki la pynkhih .

en: So speak ye , and so do , as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty .
kha: To kren bad to leh kum ki briew ïa kiba yn sa bishar da ka hukum kaba pyllaitluid ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to kren ia phi , bad kumta to leh , kumba kin shah bishar da ka ain jong ka jinglaitluid .

en: Surely against me is he turned  ; he turneth his hand against me all the day .
kha: Bad u la ïai sympat ïa nga da ki jingtied bym don jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid pyrshah ia nga u phai u phai ia la ka kti pyrshah ia nga baroh shisngi .

en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .
kha: Ym don kiba sngewtynnat ïa kiba duk , wat ki paramarjan jong ki , hynrei kiba riewspah ki don shibun ki paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba duk la shun wat na la u jong u para marjan : hynrei u riewspah u don bun ki paralok .

en: For the upright shall dwell in the land , and the perfect shall remain in it .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok — ki briew kiba ïaid beit — kin ïoh shongsah ha kane ka ri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiba hok kin shong ha ka ri , bad kiba janai kin sah ha ka .

en: Who is this that cometh up as a flood , whose waters are moved as the rivers ?
kha: Kaei kane kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah kaba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba wan shaneng kum ka jingshlei um , kiba ki um jong u ki khih kum ki wah ?

en: Honour and majesty are before him : strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .
kha: Ka burom bad ka main longsyiem ki ker sawdong ïa u ; ka bor bad ka jingitynnat ki pyndap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom bad ka jingkhraw ka don ha khmat jong u: ka jingkhlain bad ka jingitynnad ki don ha ka jaka kyntang jong u .

en: And the ark of the  Lord  was in the country of the Philistines seven months .
kha: Hadien ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la don ha ka ri ki Philistia hynñiew bnai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka synduk U Trai ka la don ha ka ri Philistia hynriew bnai .

en: And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .
kha: Ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ngan long U Blei jong phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iaid hapdeng jong phi , bad ngan long U Blei jong phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .

en: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha nongbah Teman , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Bosrah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding ia ka Teman , ka ban bam ia ki iing jong u Bosrah .

en: At some time in your life , you have likely asked , ‘ Why all the suffering ?’
kha: Teng teng ha ka jingim jong phi , phi la ju kylli , ‘ Balei kein katne katne ki jingjynjar ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei ka por ha ka jingim jong phi , phi la kylli ,  Balei ka jingjynjar baroh ?

en: Then one of the twelve , called Judas Iscariot , went unto the chief priests ,
kha: Nangta uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran — uta uba kyrteng u Judas Iskariot — u la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah lyngdoh .

en: So she caught him , and kissed him , and with an impudent face said unto him ,
kha: Ka kynrup trait ïa uta u samla , ka doh ïa u , ka peit shlip ha ki khmat jong u , bad ka ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la kem ia u , bad ka la kdup ia u , bad da ka khmat kaba khlem akor ka la ong ha u , .

en: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron , and for his sons ,
kha: Ki suh ïa ki sopti-poh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ia ki jain kiba bha na ka bynta u Aaron bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A  Trai  , bad nga pyrkhat shaphang ka aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kynmaw ia ka kyrteng jong me ko Trai, ha ka por miet bad nga la sumar ia ka hukum jong me .

en: And he spake to his sons , saying , Saddle me the ass . And they saddled him .
kha: Nangta u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Teh jin lem ïa ka kada jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia ki khun shynrang jong u, u da ong, To sngap jar ia nga . Bad ki la sngap jar ia u .

en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .
kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki reng u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: U langbrot uba la iohi ba u don ar tylli ki bniat ki long ki syiem Media bad Persia .

en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .
kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa u Dathan bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka la plie bad ka la rong noh ia u Datan , bad ka la tap ia ka kynhun jong u Abiram .

en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Judas , hato dei da ka jingdoh ba me la shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha u, Ko Judas, me shet kylla ia U Khun u briew da ka jingkyndit ?

en: Our team is already looking into your concern and will provide an update soon.
kha: Ka kynhun jong ngi ka dang peit bnïah ïa ka jingeh jong phi bad kan sa ai ïa ka jingpynbna shen.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun jong ngi ka la dep ban peit bniah ia ka jingsngewkhia jong phi bad kan ai ia ka jingpynkylla shen.

en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :
kha: Kiwei ki pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop , hynrei ïa la ki jong ngam ju buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga tap ia ki jingpynkhein jong nga kum u Adam , da kaba buhrieh ia ka jingbymhok jong nga ha ka kpoh jong nga:

en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :
kha: Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingstad la tei ia ka iing;

en: And Maarath , and Beth–anoth , and Eltekon  ; six cities with their villages :
kha: ka Maarath , ka Bethanoth , bad ka Eltekon : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Maarath bad ka Bethanoth bad ka Eltekon ; hynriew tylli ki shnong jong ki:

en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .
kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa pha ban nang tlot , bad yn ym don baburom ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan pynlong ia me uba rit hapdeng ki nongwei, bad uba la shah lehbein hapdeng ki briew .

en: Also regard not your stuff  ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours .
kha: Kim dei ban khuslai ei ei shaphang la ki jingdon jingem ba ki hap ieh , namar kiba bha tam ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei kin long ki jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju pyrkhat ruh ia kiei kiei jong phi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ka ri Ijipt baroh ka long ka jong phi .

en: Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .
kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia u , phi ki bneng jong ki bneng , bad phi ki um kiba don halor ki bneng .

en: Examine some of the material that will be discussed at the next few meetings .
kha: Pynkhreh lypa katto katne ki kot ba ngin sa ïasyllok ha ki jingïalang ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit bniah katto katne na ki jingthoh ki ban sa iakren ha ki khyndiat tylli ki jingialang ban wan .

en: Ye mountains , that ye skipped like rams  ; and ye little hills , like lambs ?
kha: Phi ki lumbah , balei phi ryngkoh kum ki blang ? Phi ki lumrit , balei phi kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki lum , ba phi la lyngngoh kum ki langbrot ; bad phi ki lum rit , kum ki langbrot ?

en: And said unto him , Art thou he that should come , or do we look for another ?
kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la kylli ïa u Jisu ,  phi long ma phi uta uba dei ban wan , ne ngin ïakhmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Hato me uba dei ban wan, ne ngi wad ia uwei pat ?

en: captured my attention . Please continue to publish such good articles for us !
