kha: ka la shim ia ka jingpyrkhat jong nga . Sngewbha iai bteng ban pynmih kum kine ki jingthoh kiba bha na ka bynta jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: la kem ia ka jingpyrkhat jong nga . Sngewbha bteng ban pynmih ia kum kine ki jingthoh kiba bha na ka bynta jong ngi !

en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with he goats .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki ban shah pynïap , kum ki khunblang , ki blang , bad ki langbrot shynrang . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynhiar ia ki kum ki langbrot sha ka jingpyniap , kum ki langbrot kiba don ki blang .

en: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
kha: ban pyrkhat ïa ki dur kiba itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban thaw ia ki kam kiba sngewtynnad, ban trei ha ka ksiar bad ha ka rupa bad ha ka nar .

en: The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem jong kine ki nongbah : ka Jerikho , ka Ai ( hajan Bethel ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Jerikho , uwei u syiem Ai uba don hajan ka Bethel .

en: Therefore hear , ye nations , and know , O congregation , what is among them .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor phi ki jaitbynriew , bad to tip kaei ka ban jia ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew, phi ki jaitbynriew, bad to tip, ko ka jingiaseng , kaei kaba don hapdeng jong ki .

en: The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .
kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei shitom kan ym lah ban kham pynriewspah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrkhu U Trai , ka pynlong riewspah , bad um pyndap ia ka jingsngewsih bad ka .

en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark : they shall not be taken from it .
kha: Ki dieng jingbah ki dei ban sah hapoh kita ki kyrwoh , bad ym bit ban sei ïa ki nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng kin don ha ki ryntieh jong ka lieng: ym dei ban shim noh ia ki na ka .

en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Abraham u la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka na jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ha ka sngi kaba lai u Abraham u la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la iohi ia kata ka jaka kaba jngai .

en: Because they provoked his spirit , so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips .
kha: Ki la pynkthang ïa u haduh katta katta haduh ba u la kren khlem da ap ban pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynkhih ia ka mynsiem jong u , haduh ba u la kren khlem da pyrkhat bad ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
kha: Ka kren da ka jingstad kaba jai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka plie ia ka shyntur jong ka da ka jingstad ; bad ha ka shyntur jong ka ka long ka ain jong ka jingbhabriew .

en: And I will give children to be their princes , and babes shall rule over them .
kha: U  Trai  un shah ïa ki briew ban shah synshar ha ki khynnah shynrang ki bym pat ïaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ia ki khun ban long ki syiem jong ki , bad ki babes kin synshar halor jong ki .

en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: U la kad arliang ïa ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la phiah ia ka duriaw Basaw ha ki bynta: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , and it is common among men :
kha: Nga la ïohi ba ha kane ka pyrthei la leh ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingsniew kaba nga la iohi hapoh ka sngi , bad ka long kaba ju jia hapdeng ki briew:

en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
kha: Kita ki riewngeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ki la leit kylleng , ki da ïalap ïa ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kita kiba la shah pynpra shabar ri ki la leit shano shano ruh ban ialap ia ka ktien .

en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .
kha: U  Trai  u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la don ia nga ha kaba sdang jong ka lynti jong u , ha khmat ki kam barim jong u .

en: The ants are a people not strong , yet they prepare their meat in the summer  ;
kha: ki dkhiew : ki dei kiba tlot , hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai ki long ki briew ki bym khlain , hynrei ki pynkhreh ia ka doh jong ki ha ka por lyiur ; .

en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , O ye righteous : for praise is comely for the upright .
kha: Phi baroh kiba hok , to risa jam da ka jingkmen ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To kmen ha U Trai , ko hok: namar ka jingiaroh ka wan na ka bynta kiba hok .

en: Terrors take hold on him as waters , a tempest stealeth him away in the night .
kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kan sa shoh kum ka jingshlei bakynsan ; ka lyer mynmiet kan beh ïa ki baroh nangta ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingtieng ki bat ia u kum ki um, ka eriong ka tuh noh ia u ha ka por miet .

en: For every house is builded by some man  ; but he that built all things is God .
kha: Man la ka ïing , ha ka jingshisha , la tei da uno uno — Bad uta uba la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh long U Blei keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka iing la tei da u briew ; hynrei uta uba tei ia kiei kiei baroh u long U Blei .

en: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders , he answered nothing .
kha: Hynrei um shym ong ei ei ha kaba jubab ïa ki jingmudui jong ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la kynnoh ia u da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah rangbah , um shym la jubab ei ei .

en: A sound heart is the life of the flesh : but envy the rottenness of the bones .
kha: Ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kaba suk ka pynlong ïa ka met ka bakoit bakhiah , hynrei ka jingpihuiñ ka long kum ka jingpang bampong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud kaba jem ka long ka jingim jong ka doh: hynrei ka sngewsih ia ka jingsniew jong ki shyieng .

en: Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid foundation of new Parliament building today .
kha: U Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi u la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka iing dorbar thymmai mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi u la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka iing dorbar thymmai mynta ka sngi .

en: And there went great multitudes with him : and he turned , and said unto them ,
kha: Shisien mynba ki paidbah babun ki la ïaleit lem bad U Jisu , u la phai sha ki bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah kiba bun ki la leit bad u: bad u la phai bad u la ong ha ki:

en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath : they cry not when he bindeth them .
kha: Kito ki bym don blei ki ïai bitar , bad wat haba la pynshitom ïa ki , kim ju duwai ban ïoh ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nongleh arsap ha ka dohnud ki lum ia ka jingbitar: kim iam haba u teh ia ki .

en: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid , which is Jesus Christ .
kha: Naba U Blei u la lah buh lypa ïa U Jisu Khrist ba tang ma u hi u nongrim , bad ym don kano kano kawei pat ka nongrim ba lah ban seng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiwei pat ki nongrim ym lah ban buh briew ban ia kata kaba la buh, kaba long U Jisu Khrist .

en: My days are past , my purposes are broken off , even the thoughts of my heart .
kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki la nang ïaid ; ki jingthmu jong nga kim shym urlong ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka la duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki la leit noh, ki jingthmu jong nga ki la jah noh , wat ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud jong nga ruh .

en: These are the three sons of Noah : and of them was the whole earth overspread .
kha: Kine lai ngut ki khun u Noah ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Noah: bad na ki la saphriang ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes , and take away thy fair jewels .
kha: Kin pynkad ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad kin shim ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa weng noh ruh ia me na ki jain jong me bad kin weng noh ia ki mawkordor ba itynnad jong me .

en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .
kha: U Issakhar u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khun shynrang jong u Issakhar ki long, u Tola, bad u Puah, u Jashub bad u Shimron, saw ngut.

en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the  Lord .
kha: Haba shem ïa ka tnga , phi shem ïa kaei kaba bha ; ka pynpaw ba U  Trai  u lehbha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba shem ia ka tnga u shem ia kaei kaei kaba bha , bad u ioh ia ka jingsngewbha jong U Trai .

en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh , and reckoneth with them .
kha: Hadien ka por kaba jlan u kynrad jong kito ki shakri u la wan pat bad u la pan jingkheiñ na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ka por kaba jrong u kynrad jong kita ki shakri u wan , bad u khein ia ki .

en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes ,
kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban banbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u la maham ïa ki syiem ;
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la shah ia uno uno u briew ban leh bakla ia ki: hooid , u la pynrem ia ki syiem na ka bynta jong ki , .

en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds  ; I will be like the most High .
kha: Me la ong ba men kiew ïa ki kliar jong ki lyoh bad ban long kum U Badonbor Tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kiew sha jrong jong ki lyoh ; ngan long kum uba ha khlieh duh tam .

en: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee .
kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me , bad mynta ki tip ba kaei kaei baroh kaba me la ai ha nga ka wan na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki la tip ba kiei kiei baroh kiba me la ai ha nga ki long na me .

en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .
kha: U la pynhiar ïa ki syiem bakhrawbor na ki khet jong ki , bad u la kyntiew shajrong ïa kiba rangli .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynhiar ia kiba khlain bor na ki jaka shong jong ki , bad u la pynkhraw ia ki da kaba rit .

en: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .
kha: Don kiba la ong ,  U dei ma u ,  hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  Em , um dei ma u , u shu ïasyriem ïa u .  Kumta uta u briew hi u la ong ,  Dei ma nga uta u briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba ong , Une u long ma u: kiwei pat ki la ong: U long kum ma u: hynrei u la ong , nga long ma u .

en: The incorrect item was shipped. We will arrange for the correct one to be sent.
kha: La bakla phah da ka mar ba bakla. Ngin sa pynbeit ïa kaba dei ban phah.
translated_en_to_kha: La phah ia ka mar kaba bakla. Ngin sa pynbeit ia kaba dei ban phah.

en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .
kha: Hato me don jingtip haduh katno ka heh ka pyrthei ? To jubab ïa nga lada me tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la sngewthuh ia ka jingjylliew jong ka khyndew ? pynbna lada me tip lut .

en: India are set to tour New Zealand for a full series starting later this month .
kha: Ka India ka thmu ban leit sha New Zealand na ka bynta ka series kaba pura kaban sdang ha kaba kut jong une u bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka India ka la thmu ban leit jngoh ia ka New Zealand na ka bynta ka series kaba pura kaba sdang ha kaba kut jong une u bnai .

en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .
kha: To ai khublei ïa uwei pa uwei na ki briew jong U Blei kiba ha U Khrist Jisu . Ki parabangeit hangne lem bad nga ki phah sha phi ki jingkhublei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia uwei pa uwei u riewkhuid ha U Khrist Jisu . Ki para kiba don ryngkat bad nga ki khublei ia phi .

en: And Rephah was his son , also Resheph , and Telah his son , and Tahan his son ,
kha: U Ephraim u don ruh uwei u khun uba kyrteng u Rephah , uba ki khun ki ksiew jong u ki long kumne harum : u Resheph , u Telah , u Tahan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Rephas u long u khun jong u, u Resheph, bad u Telah u khun jong u, bad u Tahan u khun jong u, .

en: For our heart shall rejoice in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .
kha: Ngi la kmen namar jong u , ngi shaniah ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dohnud jong ngi kan sngewbha ha u , namar ngi la shaniah ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u .

en: And he that curseth his father , or his mother , shall surely be put to death .
kha: Uta uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba tim ia la u kpa ne ia ka kmie jong u , un shah pyniap shisha .

en: How much less shall I answer him , and choose out my words to reason with him ?
kha: Kumta da kumno ngan shem ki kyntien ban jubab ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ngan jubab ia u , bad ngan jied ia ki ktien jong nga ban ia kren bad u ?

en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved , but whom the Lord commendeth .
kha: Naba ka long haba U Trai u pyrkhat bha ïa u briew , ba u briew u long uba la pdiang hun , bad ym haba u briew u pyrkhat bha shaphang ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym ia uta uba iaroh ia lade la mynjur , hynrei ia uba U Trai u iaroh .

en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels , and have not kept it .
kha: Phi long kita kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , kata kaba la wan ai da ki angel — pynban phim shym la kohnguh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la ioh ia ka hukum da ka jinglong jong ki angel , bad kim shym la bat ia ka .

en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .
kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba sawphew snem u la shah shitom ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And there were also two other , malefactors , led with him to be put to death .
kha: Ïa kiwei pat ki ar ngut ki rangbah , baroh ar ngut ki dei kiba leh kam runar , la ïalam ruh shabar ba yn pynïap ryngkat bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ruh arngut kiwei pat ki nongleh bymman, ki la ialam bad u ban shah pyniap .

en: Hindi , Bengali , Marwari and Bihari language speakers also found in the town .
kha: Ki nongkren Hindi , Bengali , Marwari bad Bihari ruh la lap ha kane ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkren ktien Hindi , Bengali , Marwari bad Bihari ruh ki la lap ha ka shnong .

en: Which were cut down out of time , whose foundation was overflown with a flood :
kha: Wat ha shuwa ba ka por jong ki kan wan , ki la shah rong noh da ka jingshlei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la ot noh na ka por , kaba ka nongrim jong u ka la tuid da ka jingshlei um:

en: Also a screenwriter , the actor has written dialogues for over 250 movies too .
kha: Kumjuh ruh u nongthoh phlim , une u aktor u la thoh ia ki jingiakren na ka bynta palat 250 tylli ki phlim ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u nongthoh screen , u aktor u la thoh ia ki jingiakren na ka bynta palat 250 tylli ki phlim ruh .

en: That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .
kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin pynkynmaw ïa phi ban sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad phin long ki jong nga nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin kynmaw bad leh ia ki hukum jong nga baroh bad to long kiba khuid ha U Blei jong phi .

en: Then stood up Phinehas , and executed judgment : and so the plague was stayed .
kha: Hynrei u Phinehas u la ïeng bad pynshitom ïa kiba leh pop bad ïa ka khlam la pynsangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ieng u Phinehas, bad u la pyndep ia ka jingbishar: bad kumta ka khlam ka la sah .

en: Apply thine heart unto instruction , and thine ears to the words of knowledge .
kha: To shahshkor bha ïa u nonghikai jong phi bad pynleit jingmut ïa baroh katba phi lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndonkam ia ka dohnud jong me ha ka jinghikai , bad ki shkor jong me ha ki ktien jingtip .

en: The police said a case of murder had been registered against the four persons .
kha: Ki pulit ki la iathuh ba la register case pyniap briew pyrshah ia kitei ki saw ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ki la iathuh ba la register ia ka kam pyniap briew pyrshah ia kitei ki saw ngut ki briew .

en: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .
kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba pyniap ia la u kpa ne ia ka kmie jong u , un shah pyniap shisha .

en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .
kha: U briew uba jaipdeh u long uba sniew kum uno uno uba pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: U ruh uba sngap jar ha ka kam jong u u long u hynmen jong u uba long u nongpynjot uba khraw .

en: The sons of Zophah  ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Sophah ki long u Suah , u Harnepher , u Shual , u Beri , u Imrah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Sopah ; Suah, bad u Haner, bad u Shual, bad u Beri, bad u Imrah .

en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin shadkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia phi ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u: to ai ba ka dohnud jong ki kan kmen ia kiba wad ia U Trai .

en: And the graves were opened  ; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose ,
kha: ki jingtep ki la ang , bad ïa shibun ki briew jong U Blei kiba la ïap la pynmihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingtep ki la plie ; bad bun ki met jong ki riewkhuid kiba la thiah ki la mih , .

en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon .
kha: Tang khat-ar bnai hadien , katba u dang ïaid halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Babilon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ka hima Babilon .

en: He turned their heart to hate his people , to deal subtilly with his servants .
kha: U la pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ban isih ïa ki briew jong u bad leh shukor ïa ki shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphai ia ka dohnud jong u ban shun ia ki briew jong u , ban iadei bad ki shakri jong u .

en: And Kibzaim with her suburbs , and Beth–horon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
kha: ka Kibsaim , bad ka Beth Horon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Kibzaim bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Bethhoron bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; saw tylli ki nongbah .

en: He sent darkness , and made it dark  ; and they rebelled not against his word .
kha: U Blei u la phah ïa ka jingdum ha ka ri , hynrei ki nong Ijipt kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ka jingdum , bad u la pynlong dum ia ka ; bad kim shym la leh pyrshah ia ka ktien jong u .

en: These woes exploded first in the year 1914 and have escalated since that time .
kha: Kine ki jingjynjar ki la bthei nyngkong eh ha ka snem 1914 bad ki la nang jur naduh kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki jingeh ki la bthei nyngkong ha ka snem 1914 bad ki la nang kiew naduh kata ka por .

en: What will ye do in the solemn day , and in the day of the feast of the  Lord  ?
kha: Bad haba ka por kan poi na ka bynta ki Jingkhawai Niam ba la jied na ka bynta ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , kin ïaleh kumno hangta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phin leh ha ka sngi kaba suk bad ha ka sngi jong ka jingkhawai U Trai ?

en: His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
kha: Baroh kaba u leh ki dap da ka jingpyndonburom bad kaba iphieng ; ka hok jong u ka neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kam jong u ka long kaba donburom bad kaba donburom: bad ka hok jong u ka sah junom .

en: For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .
kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dan bad na ki lum Ephraim ki pynbna ïa ka khubor basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka sur kaba pynbna na u Dan , bad ka pynmih ia ka jingjynjar na u lum Ephram .

en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .
kha: To ïeng beit ha la ki kjat jong me !  Uta u briew u la kynthih bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: La ong da ka sur kaba jam , To ieng beit ha ki kjat jong me . Bad u la jngi bad u la iaid .

en: Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .
kha: Ha kaba pynkut noh , to long kiba khlaiñ ha U Trai bad ha ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, ko para jong nga, to long kiba skhem ha U Trai bad ha ka bor jong ka bor jong u .

en: But Samson s wife was given to his companion , whom he had used as his friend .
kha: bad ïa ka tnga jong u la ai sha u briew uba la shong synran ïa u ha ka jingkyntiew kurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka tnga jong u Samson ka la long ha u paralok jong u , uba u la pyndonkam kum u paralok jong u .

en: The children of Shem  ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shem — u Elam , u Asshur , u Arpakhshad , u Lud , bad u Aram — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shem ; Elam, bad u Asshur, bad u Arphaxed, bad u Lud, bad u Aram .

en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
kha: Ka leilieh ka thaba na ki lyoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh da kaba ai um u phong ia u lyoh uba jylliew: u pynphriang ia u lyoh uba shai jong u:

en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Solomon u la palat ia ki syiem baroh jong ka khyndew na ka bynta ka spah bad na ka bynta ka jingstad .

en: They eat up the sin of my people , and they set their heart on their iniquity .
kha: Phi kylla riewspah na ki pop ki briew jong nga , bad kumta phi kwah ïa ki ban nang leh pop shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bam ia ka pop jong ki briew jong nga , bad ki buh ia ka dohnud jong ki ha ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I have done one work , and ye all marvel .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la leh ïa kawei ka kambah , bad baroh phi ïa-sngewlyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, Nga la leh ia kawei ka kam, bad phi baroh phi lyngngoh .

en: Which doeth great things past finding out  ; yea , and wonders without number .
kha: Ngim lah ban sngewthuh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw ba u leh bad ïa ki kambah jong u ym don jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba la leit noh da kaba wad ia ka yea, bad ki jingphylla khlem jingkhein .

en: Most congregations of Jehovah’s Witnesses have meetings three times each week .
kha: Bun na ki balang jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki ju pynlong jingïaseng arsien shitaiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba bun ki jingiaseng jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki don ki jingialang lai sien man la ka taiew .

en: And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka bym lah ha u briew ka long kaba lah ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kiei kiei kiba ym lah ban long bad ki briew ki long kiba lah bad U Blei .

en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart : I know that this is with thee .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga tip ba baroh kata ka por me ïai thmu ha kaba rieh ban pynmynsaw ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kine kiei kiei me la buhrieh ha ka dohnud jong me: Nga tip ba kane ka don bad me .

en: And David went on , and grew great , and the  Lord  God of hosts was with him .
kha: U la nang khlaiñ ha ki por baroh , namar U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Tam u la don ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iaid shakhmat bad u la nang khraw bad U Trai Blei jong ki paid u la don ryngkat bad u .

en: And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
kha: Bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  To kynmaw ïa nga , ko Jisu , haba me wan kum u Syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha U Jisu, ko Trai, to kynmaw ia nga haba me wan sha ka hima jong me .

en: For he testifieth , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Men long u lyngdoh shi junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la sakhi , Me long u lyngdoh junom hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u Melchisedec .

en: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .
kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jingshisha nga ong ha phi , ba un pynlong ia u ban synshar halor kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

en: The hearing ear , and the seeing eye , the  Lord  hath made even both of them .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa ngi ki khmat ban peit da ki bad ïa ki shkor ban sngap da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shkor kaba iohsngew bad ka khmat kaba iohi, U Trai u la pynlong wat ia ki baroh arngut ruh .

en: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet .
kha: U Sephanaïah u pule ïa ka shithi ha nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Sephiah u lyngdoh u la pule ia kane ka shithi ha ki shkor jong u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa .

en: But Simon s wife s mother lay sick of a fever , and anon they tell him of her .
kha: Ka kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka thiah pang ha jingthiah na ka jingpang shit , bad mar ïapoi u Jisu , la ïathuh shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka kmie jong u Simon ka la pang shit, bad u anon ki iathuh ia u shaphang jong ka .

en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .
kha: To khmih bha ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki masi jong phi katba phi lah ,
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba minot ban tip ia ka jinglong jong ki kynhun jong me , bad peit bha ia ki kynhun jong me .

en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?
kha: Kam dei namar ba phi ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei ba u sneng ïa phi bad wanrah ïa phi sha ka jingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un pynrem ia me namar ka jingtieng ia me ? hato un rung bad me ha ka jingbishar ?

en: There the prisoners rest together  ; they hear not the voice of the oppressor .
kha: Wat ki koidi ki ïoh jingsuk , ba ki la laitluid na ki jingshah hylla bad jingshah hukum tyngeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki koidi ki shongthait lang kim iohsngew ia ka sur jong u nongpynshitom bein .

en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet : for his God gave him rest round about .
kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u synshar ha ka jingsuk , bad U Blei u ai ha u ka jingshongshngain ha ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka hima Jehoshaphat ka la sngap jar: namar U Blei jong u u la ai jingjahthait ia u sawdong .

en: How did their glasses get swapped ? Even they themselves didn't understand it !
kha: Kumno ki iitkhmat jongki ki shah kylliang ? Maki ruh kim sngewthuh iakata .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ki khmat jong ki ki la kylla ? Wat ma ki hi kim sngewthuh ia ka !

en: Declare his glory among the heathen  ; his marvellous works among all nations .
kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u ha ki jaitbynriew , ïa ki kam bakhrawbor ha ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia ka burom jong u hapdeng ki nongwei ; ki kam ba phylla jong u hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: Add thou not unto his words , lest he reprove thee , and thou be found a liar .
kha: Lada phi kam ba u ong ei ei ïa kaba um shym la ong , un sneng tyngeh ïa phi , bad yn pynpaw ba phi dei uba lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyndap ia ki ktien jong u , ioh un pynrem ia me , bad me la shem ba me long u nonglamler .

en: Then asked he them again ,  Whom seek ye ?  And they said , Jesus of Nazareth .
kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?   U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kylli biang ia ki, Iano phi wad ? Ki la ong, U Jisu na Nazareth .

en: The dead are not able to see or hear or do anything . —Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .
kha: Kiba ïap kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew ne leh ei ei .—Eklesiastis 9 :5 , 10 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba iap kim lah ban iohi ne iohsngew ne leh ei ei . Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .

en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u wan phai khlem shah pynïap sha ka ïingsyiem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la leit phai noh sha la iing ha Jerusalem .

en: Persia , Ethiopia , and Libya with them  ; all of them with shield and helmet :
kha: Ki rangbah na Persia , Sudan bad na Libya ki don bad u , bad baroh ki don ki stieh bad ki jingda khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Persia , Ethiopia , bad ka Libya bad ki ; baroh ki don ka jingda bad ka helmet:

en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death : but a wise man will pacify it .
kha: U briew uba stad un pyrshang ban ïai pynkmen ïa u syiem ; lada u syiem u bitar , don uba lah ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar jong u syiem ka long kum ki nonglam khubor jong ka jingiap: hynrei u briew uba stad un pynsngewbha ia ka .

en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice according to that which I command thee .
kha: Mynta , ko khun ,  la bteng ka Rebekka ,  shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei ba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata ko khun jong nga to kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga kat kum kata kaba nga hukum ia me .

en: The young men saw me , and hid themselves : and the aged arose , and stood up .
kha: ki samla ki kynriah harud tang shu ïohi ïa nga , bad ki riewtymmen ki ïeng ban pyn-i ka jingburom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla ki la iohi ia nga, bad ki la buhrieh ia lade: bad u tymmen u la ieng , bad u la ieng .

en: And when they were escaped , then they knew that the island was called Melita .
kha: a Jinglamphrang Ïa  Ka Shithi U Paul Sha Ki Nong Rom  la thoh ban pynkhreh lynti ïa ka jingthmu u Paul ban leit khmih ïa ka Balang ha Rom . Ka jingthmu jong u ka long ban trei hapdeng ki Khristan kiba don hangta katto katne por bad nangta , da ka jingkyrshan jong ki , ban leit sha Spain . U la thoh ban batai ïa ka jingsngewthuh jong u ïa ka jingngeit Khristan bad ka jingpyntreikam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingim Khristan . Ka shithi ka don ha ka ïa ka jingïathuh ba-dap pura shaphang ka khubor jong u Paul . Hadien ba u la ai khublei ïa kiba ha ka balang ha Rom bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa ka jingduwai jong u na ka bynta jong ki , u Paul u ïathuh ïa ka phangpdeng jong ka shithi :  Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut  (
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ki la lait im , nangta ki la tip ba la khot ia kata ka dulir Melita .

en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side , and shall drive him to his feet .
kha: Baroh sawdong jong u ka jingshyrkhei ka ap ; ka bud ïa u ha man ka sien jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingtieng kin pynlong ia u ban tieng na man la ki liang , bad kin pynkhih ia u sha ki kjat jong u .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u khot ïa u Abraham ha kaba ar sien na bneng ,
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la khot ia u Abraham na bneng ha ka sien kaba ar .

en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh  ; and he dwelt therein .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa ka Gilead ha ka kur jong u Makhir , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai ia u Machir u khun u Manasseh ; bad u la shong hangta .

en: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling , so is he that giveth honour to a fool .
kha: Kaba ïaroh ïa uno uno uba long mutlop ka long kumba teh ïa u maw ha ka jri siat sim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba uta uba teh ia u maw ha ka sniehdoh , kumta u ai burom ia u bieit .

en: Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .
kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka pyrthei kiba ïap — Ka don borabor ka jingkwah shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dujok bad ka jingpynjot kim ju dap shuh shuh kumta ki khmat u briew kim ju sngewhun .

en: Fret not thyself because of evil men , neither be thou envious at the wicked  ;
kha: Wat ai ba ki briew basniew kin pynkhuslai ïa phi ; wat bishni ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym sngewsih ia lade namar ki briew kiba sniew, lymne wat sngewsih ia kiba sniew ; .

en: And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .
kha: U la thoh lai hajar tylli ki proberb bad palat hajar tylli ki jingrwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren lai hajar tylli ki proberb: bad ki jingrwai jong u ki long shihajar san .

en: For the  Lord s  portion is his people  ; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance .
kha: hynrei ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob u la jied na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai ka long ka bynta jong u ; u Jakob u long ka bynta jong ka pateng jong u .

en: But because I have said these things unto you , sorrow hath filled your heart .
kha: Bad mynta ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi , ki dohnud jong phi ki la dap da ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la kren ia kine kiei kiei ha phi , ka jingsngewsih ka la pyndap ia ka dohnud jong phi .

en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings , which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia :
kha: Sha lyndet ki wah jong ka Sudan don ka ri ha kaba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki thapniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew ia ka ri kaba shai bad ki bniat , kaba don sha lyndet ki wah jong ka Ethiopia:

en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .
kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Lada me hi men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Lada ka jingdon jong me kam leit bad nga, wat rah ia ngi kumta .

en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me ?
kha: Haba la pynkhih ïa u , u long uba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba nud bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba shyrkhei kiba nud ban pynkhih ia u: mano nangta uba lah ban ieng ha khmat jong nga ?

en: And ye shall chase your enemies , and they shall fall before you by the sword .
kha: Phin long ki nongjop pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin beh ia ki nongshun jong phi , bad kin hap ha khmat jong phi da ka waitlam .

en: Then let me sow , and let another eat  ; yea , let my offspring be rooted out .
kha: te ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong nga , lane to ai ba kiwei kin bam ïa ka jingbam ba nga pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ngan bet , bad to ai ba uwei pat un bam yes yes , to ai ba ki khun jong nga kin shah tynrai noh .

en: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins ,
kha: ban ïathuh ha ki briew jong u ba yn pynim ïa ki da kaba ki ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ai jingtip ia ka jingpynim ia ki briew jong u da kaba map ia ki pop jong ki , .

en: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah , and carried away captives .
kha: Ki Edom ki la sdang wan hiarthma biang ïa ka Judah bad ki la ïoh kurup shibun ki koidi . Kumta u syiem Ahas u la ong ïa u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha jong ka Assyria ban phah jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar sa shisien ki nong Edome ki la wan bad ki la pyniap ia u Judah , bad ki la rah noh ia ki mraw .

en: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !
kha: Ko ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , ïa ki jingkynshew bakordor jong phi la lute .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno kiei kiei jong u Iso ki la wad bniah ! kumno kiei kiei kiba buhrieh jong u ki la wad !

en: Wherefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt separate three cities for thee .
kha: Namar kata nga hukum ïa phi ban buh kyrpang lai tylli ki shnong jakarieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga hukum ia me da kaba ong , Me dei ban pyniakhlad lai tylli ki nongbah na ka bynta jong me .

en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days , according unto the days that ye abode there .
kha: Kumta , hadien ba ngi la sah slem ha Kadesh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phi shong ha Kadesh bun sngi katkum ki sngi ba phi shong hangta .

en: The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ïa uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long uba bha ia kito kiba ap ia u , ia ka mynsiem kaba wad ia u .

en: Behold , I have made thee small among the heathen : thou art greatly despised .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Edom ,  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba tlot bor ; baroh kin ibeiñ ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la pynlong ia me uba rit hapdeng ki nongwei: me la shah niewbein shibun .

en: Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner . )
kha: lane ka ïeng apthap ha kyndong , teng teng ha ki surok bah , bad teng teng ha ka jaka ïew .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka don shabar, mynta ha ki surok, bad ka sah ha man la ki thliew . )

en: And Noah was five hundred years old : and Noah begat Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
kha: Ynda u Noah u la dap sanspah snem ka rta , u ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Noah u la dap san spah snem: bad u Noah u la kha ia u Shem, u Ham bad u Japhet .

en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi jong u Jared baroh ki long hynniew spah hynriewphew ar snem: bad u la iap .

en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
kha: Wat pynïeng ruh ïa uno uno u païa maw na ka bynta ka jingmane bleithaw ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kita .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat buh ia me ha ka dur ; kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u shun .

en: Length of days is in her right hand  ; and in her left hand riches and honour .
kha: Ka jingstad ka pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi kumjuh ruh ka pynïoh ïa ka spah bad ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong ki sngi ka don ha ka kti kadiang jong ka ; bad ha ka kti kadiang jong ka ka spah bad ka burom .

en: Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .
kha: Ki briew ki ong ha nga ,  Hangno kito ki jingbyrngem kiba U  Trai  u la pynlong pyrshah ïa ngi ? To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki ong ha nga , Hangno ka ktien U Trai ? to ai ba kan wan mynta .

en: Among the bushes they brayed  ; under the nettles they were gathered together .
kha: Shabar ha ki khlaw ki pah kum ki mrad bad ki ïa-thngian lang hapoh ki  lawlynnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng ki khlaw ki la ia tyngkhuh ; hapoh ki bniat ki la ialum lang .

en: Jehovah tells us to avoid sinful practices because he knows they will harm us .
kha: U Jehobah u ong ïa ngi ban kiar na ka jingmlien ba long pop namar ba u tip ba kin pynsniew ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehobah u ong ia ngi ban kiar na ki kam pop namar u tip ba kin pynmynsaw ia ngi .

en: The crown of the wise is their riches : but the foolishness of fools is folly .
kha: Ïa ki briew kiba stad la ainong da ka spah , hynrei ïa kiba bieit la tip da ki jingleh bieit jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong kiba stad ka long ka spah jong ki: hynrei ka jingbieit jong ki bieit ka long kaba sniew .

en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow , and all my members are as a shadow .
kha: Ka jingsngewsih jong nga ka la jan pynmatlah ïa nga ; ki kti bad ki kjat jong nga ki la rit kum ki syrngiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong nga ruh ka long kaba dum namar ka jingsngewsih , bad ki dkhot jong nga baroh ki long kum ka jingdum .

en: Will he make a covenant with thee ? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever ?
kha: Hato un ïateh kular bad me bad kular ban shakri ïa me junom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un leh ia ka jutang bad me ? phin shim ia u kum u shakri junom ?

en: What , my son ? and what , the son of my womb ? and what , the son of my vows ?
kha: Phi long u khun ba-ieit jong nga , ka jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga . Kaei ngan ïathuh ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ko khun jong nga ? bad kaei , u khun jong nga ? bad kaei , u khun jong ki jingkular jong nga ?

en: And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .
kha: Ki rep lyngkha bad ki thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki lum ka jingot kaba dap kyrhai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bet ia ki lyngkha , bad thung ia ki kper sohjew , kiba lah ban ai soh ia ka jingroi .

en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin lehkmen !
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia phi ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u: to ai ba ka dohnud jong ki kan kmen ia kiba wad ia U Trai .

en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .
kha: Kumta u Hushai , u paralok jong u Dabid , u la leit phai sha ka nongbah hamar ba u Absalom u dang wan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u paralok jong u Hushai u la wan shapoh shnong bad u Absalom u la wan sha Jerusalem .

en: And he looked up , and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury .
kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ki briew bariewspah ba ki thep ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki ha ka jingkynshew ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit sha jrong , bad u la iohi ia ki riewspah kiba bret ia ki jingai sngewbha jong ki shapoh ka jaka buh jingbam .

en: The Empowered Group will be headed by Rajasthan Transport Minister Yunus Khan .
kha: Ia kane ka Empowered Group yn ialam da u myntri ka tnad kit ka bah jong ka Rajasthan u Yunus Khan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kane ka kynhun ba la pynkup bor yn ialam da u Myntri ka tnad ka leit ka wan u Yunus Khan .

en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast :
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Grik hapdeng jong kito kiba la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don katto katne ki Grik napdeng jong ki kiba la wan shaneng ban mane ha ka jingkhawai:

en: Neither as being lords over God s heritage , but being ensamples to the flock .
kha: Wat pyrshang ban leh trai khlieh halor kito ha kiba la ai ïa phi ban sumar , hynrei to long ka nuksa ïa ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kum ki kynrad halor ka pateng jong U Blei, hynrei ban long ki nuksa ia ka kynhun .

en: Strength and honour are her clothing  ; and she shall rejoice in time to come .
kha: Ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ïoh burom , bad kam sheptieng ïa ka lawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhlain bad ka burom ki long ki jain jong ka ; bad kan sngewbha ha ka por ban wan .

en: The arrow cannot make him flee : slingstones are turned with him into stubble .
kha: Ym don uno uno u khnam uba lah ban pynher krad ïa u ; ki mawbah kiba la kawang ïa u ki long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U khnam um lah ban pynlong ia u ban phet: ki maw ki kylla bad u sha ka sniehdoh .

en: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire . This is the second death .
kha: Nangta ïa ka jingïap bad ïa ka Hades la bret ha ka pung ka ding . ( Kane ka pung ka ding ka long ka jingïap kaba ar . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiap bad ka dujok la bret ha ka pung ding . Kane ka long ka jingiap kaba ar .

en: Then shall two be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
kha: Ha kata ka por ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta arngut kin don ha lyngkha; ia uwei pat yn shim noh .

en: That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .
kha: Kane ka la long ka jingshai kaba shisha — ka jingshai kaba wan sha ka pyrthei bad pynshai ha u bynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka la long ka Jingshai kaba shisha , kaba pynshai ia uwei pa uwei u briew uba wan sha ka pyrthei .

en: Then said some of them of Jerusalem , Is not this he , whom they seek to kill ?
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  Hato um dei une u briew ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki ïawad ban pynïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la ong katto katne na ki na Jerusalem , Hato kane kam dei ma u uba ki wad ban pyniap ?

en: Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be ye holy : for I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Pynkyntang khuid ïa lade , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia lade namarkata , bad to long kiba khuid: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la ong ,  Ai ba kan jia long , te , kumba phi ngeit !  —
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ktah ia ki khmat jong ki, u da ong: Kat kum ka jingngeit jong phi to long ha phi .

en: For I was my father s son , tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother .
kha: Mynba nga dang long tang u khynnah rit , u khun marwei ki kmie ki kpa jong nga , i pa i ju hikai ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la long u khun jong u kpa jong nga, uba jem bad uba ieit tang ha khmat ka kmie jong nga .

en: That the man of God may be perfect , thoroughly furnished unto all good works .
kha: khnang ba u briew uba shakri ïa U Blei un lah ban long uba bit pura bad uba la biang bha ban leh ïa baroh ki jait kam kiba bha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u briew jong U Blei un long uba janai, uba la pynkhreh bha ha ki kam babha baroh .

en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor , saying , Get me this damsel to wife .
kha: U la ïathuh ha u kpa jong u ,  Nga kwah ba phin pynïoh ïa ka Dinah kum ka tnga ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shehem u la kren ha u kpa jong u u Hamor, u da ong: To ai ia nga ia kane ka dam sha ka tnga .

en: If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee ?
kha: Lada phim lah ban siew , kin knieh noh wat ïa ka jingthiah jong phi ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim don ei ei ban siew , balei un shim noh ia ka jingthiah jong me na shapoh jong me ?

en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .
kha: ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jat jong u bad bat khak ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U gin un shim ia u da ka kjat , bad u nongtuh un jop ia u .

en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .
kha: Kin san kin plung kum u phlang ba la ai um bha , kum ki dieng Jamynrei harud ki wahduid jong ka um batuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin mih kum ki phlang , kum ki khlaw da ki wah um .

en: When Jesus was on earth , he always prayed to his Father , not to anyone else .
kha: Por ba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , manla ka-por u duwai ha la u Kpa , ym ha kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la don ha ka pyrthei , u ju duwai ha U Kpa jong u ym ha uno uno u briew .

en: If now thou hast understanding , hear this : hearken to the voice of my words .
kha: Mynta to shahshkor ïa nga , lada phi long kiba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada mynta me don ka jingsngewthuh , sngap ia kane: sngap ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong nga .

en: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee : thou saidst , Fear not .
kha: Me la jubab ïa nga bad ong ïa nga ban ym sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la jan ha ka sngi ba nga khot ia me: me la ong , Wat tieng .

en: For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .
kha: Kat kaba nga kren ka dei ka jingshisha , ha nga ki ktien lamler ki long kiba ijli .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka shyntur jong nga kan kren ia ka jingshisha bad ka jingsniew ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki rmiang shyntur jong nga .

en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the  Lord  , and whose hope the  Lord  is .
kha: Hynrei ngan kyrkhu ïa u briew uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia u briew uba shaniah ha U Trai , bad uba U Trai u long ka jingkyrmen jong u .

en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple , and went about to kill me .
kha: Dei na kane ka daw ba ki Jiw ki la kem ïa nga katba nga dang don hapoh ka Templ , bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kine ki daw ki Jiw ki la kem ia nga ha ka tempi , bad ki la leit ban pyniap ia nga .

en: You have earned reward points on this purchase. Redeem them on your next order.
kha: Phi la ïoh ïa ki point khusnam ha kane ka jingthied. Pyndonkam ïa ki ha ka ordar kaba hadien.
translated_en_to_kha: U la kamai ia ki jaka siew bai lutksan ha kane ka jingthied. Pynbeit ia ki ha ka order kaba hadien jong phi.

en: I have seen an end of all perfection : but thy commandment is exceeding broad .
kha: Nga la tip ba kiei kiei baroh ki don u pud ; hynrei ka hukum jong me ka long kaba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ka jingkut jong ka jinglong janai baroh: hynrei ka hukum jong me ka long kaba palat .

en: From Ekron even unto the sea , all that lay near Ashdod , with their villages :
kha: bad baroh ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba hajan ka Ashdod , naduh Ekron haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh Ekron haduh ka duriaw, baroh kiba don hajan ka Ashdod, bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him : he is filled full with reproach .
kha: La ngi la shah tied bad shah ibeiñ , ngi dei ban pdiang ïa ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U ai ia ka rmiang shyntur jong u ha uta uba pynkhih ia u: u dap da ka jingshah lehbein .

en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .
kha: Suk uta u briew uba long stad — uba ïoh ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba suk ia u briew uba shem ia ka jingstad bad u briew uba ioh ia ka jingsngewthuh .

en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham , and of his oath unto Isaac  ;
kha: ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad u Abraham , ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong bad u Isaak .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat na ka jutang kaba u la leh bad u Abraham bad ka jingsmai jong u ha u Isaak ; .

en: And the thing which he did displeased the  Lord  : wherefore he slew him also .
kha: Kata kaba u leh ka la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u la pynïap noh ïa u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata kaba u la leh ka la pynsngewsih ia U Trai: namar kata u la pyniap ia u ruh .

en: And the young men arose , wound him up , and carried him out , and buried him .
kha: Ki samla shynrang ki la wan shapoh , ki la sop ïa ka met jong u , ki la bah ïa u shabar , bad tep ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla ki la ieng, ki la pynmynsaw ia u, bad ki la rah ia u shabar bad ki la tep ia u .

en: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka pang da ka jingangnud nga kwah ban tip ïa ki jingbishar jong me ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong nga ka bthei na ka bynta ka jingkwah kaba ka don ha ki jingbishar jong me man ka por .

en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and behold a basket of summer fruit .
kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi shi shang ki soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai U Blei u la pyni ha nga: bad ha khmih ka lyngkhot soh jong ka por lyiur .

en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi da ka iktiar jong U Trai ban pule ïa kane ka shithi ha ki parabangeit baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyntu ia phi da U Trai ba ia kane ka shithi dei ban pule ha ki para bakhuid baroh .

en: He hath hedged me about , that I cannot get out : he hath made my chain heavy .
kha: U la khum ïa nga ha ki kynjri ; nga long u koidi u bym don kano kano ka jingkyrmen ban lait phet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia nga shaphang jong nga: u la pynlong ia ka kynjri jong nga kaba khia .

en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :
kha: U bang bha ban leh ïa ka jingsniew bad u buh katto katne ha ka shyntur jong u ban sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u pyllait im ia ka , bad u iehnoh ia ka ym ; hynrei u dang buh ia ka hapoh ka shyntur jong u:

en: Because she takes after her younger sister , I cannot tell one from the other .
kha: Namar ka bit iaka ka para jong ka , ngam nang pyniapher ia ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ka shim ia ka para kaba kham rit jong ka , ngam lah ban iathuh ia kawei na kawei pat .

en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
kha: Uwei na ki synran , uta ïa uba U Jisu u ieit , u da shong shaniah ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la don ka jingshaniah ha U Jisu uwei na ki synran jong u , uba U Jisu u ieit .

en: The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .
kha: Wat ki nonglute kiba la shah sahnarphna bad u ki la ïakren beiñ ïa u ha kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongtuh ruh kiba la sahnarphna bad u ki bret ia kajuh ha ki bniat jong u .

en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .
kha: Wat pyrshang ban kren tipbriew ha uba bieit ; um lah ban ïaroh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kren ha ki shkor jong u bieit: namar un pynjah burom ia ka jingstad jong ki ktien jong me .

en: However , one managed to escape from the scene , taking advantage of the dark .
kha: Hynrei uwei u la lah ban phet krad na katei ka jaka , da kaba shim kabu ia ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei u la lah ban phet krad na ka jaka , da kaba shim kabu ia ka jingdum .

en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha u Philip ,  Khie leit sha jan ka kali kulai bad bud mar jan ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Mynsiem u la ong ha u Philip, To leit shajan bad to iasoh bad kane ka kali .

en: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion  ; and the Amorites call it Senir  ; )
kha: ( Ïa u lum Hermon la khot Sirion da ki nong Sidon , bad Senir da ki Amor )
translated_en_to_kha: (Kaei kaba ki Sidonian ki khot ia ka Sirion ; bad ki Amorit ki khot ia ka Senir ; )

en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross .
kha: Ka jingkren bymshisha kaba buhrieh ïa kaei ba phi pyrkhat shisha ka long kum ka jingsop ïit ha u khiew khyndew uba tat-dor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur kiba thang bad ka dohnud kaba sniew ki long kum ka khiew kaba la tap da ka dewbilat rupa .

en: Sinha has been critical of the BJP since its Bihar election campaign took off .
kha: U Sinha u la kynthoh jur ia ka BJP naduh ba ka jingialap elekshon jong ka ha Bihar ka la sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sinha ka la long kaba kongsan ia ka BJP naduh ba ka jingialap elekshon jong ka ha Bihar ka la kiew noh .

en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;
kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba kyrduh , uba duk palat ban ïoh thied jaiñ thied nep ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la iohi ia kano kano ka jingduh jain , ne uno uno u baduk khlem da tap ; .

en: Yea , the Almighty shall be thy defence , and thou shalt have plenty of silver .
kha: Ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un long ka ksiar jong phi , ai ba un long ka rupa , ba la kynton jrong na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , U Blei un long ka jingiada jong me , bad me men don shibun ka rupa .

en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim kin hikai ïa me , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ki don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kin ym hikai ia me , bad kin iathuh ia me , bad kin kren ia ki ktien na ka dohnud jong ki ?

en: He shall not cry , nor lift up , nor cause his voice to be heard in the street .
kha: Un ym pyrta lane pynjam ïa ka sur jong u lane un ym pynmih ki ktien kren bajam ha ki lynti bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Um dei ban iam , ne ban rah shaneng , ne ban pynlong ia ka sur jong u ban iohsngew ha surok .

en: David was thirty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years .
kha: U Dabid u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u la long syiem , bad u la synshar sawphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la don laiphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar sawphew snem .

en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u phah khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la phah bad u la lum lang ia ki rangbah Judah bad Jerusalem .

en: Fear not , O land  ; be glad and rejoice : for the  Lord  will do great things .
kha: Ko ki lyngkha , wat sheptieng , hynrei to risa bad lehkmen namar baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng, ko ri to sngewbha bad sngewbha: namar U Trai un leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw .

en: For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .
kha: Naba ma u hi u la ong ,  Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju ñiewkor ha la ka jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Jisu hi u la sakhi , ba u nongiathuhlypa um don burom ha la ka jong ka ri .

en: The hireling fleeth , because he is an hireling , and careth not for the sheep .
kha: U nongbylla sngi u phet noh namar ba u long tang u nongbylla sngi bad um salia ei ei ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongtrei u phet noh , namar u long u nongtrei kam , bad um sumar ia ki langbrot .

en: And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .
kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki , u la kiew pat halor ka lieng bad u la sdang ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iehnoh ia ki , bad u la rung biang shapoh lieng u la leit noh sha kawei pat ka liang .

en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes  ;
kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban lehbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u maham ïa ki syiem :
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la shah ia u briew ban leh bakla ia ki: hooid , u la pynrem ia ki syiem na ka bynta jong ki ; .

en: She standeth in the top of high places , by the way in the places of the paths .
kha: Hajrong ki lum harud lynti bad ha ka jaka ïashem ki lad , ka ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ieng ha jrong jong ki jaka ba jrong , da kaba ong ha ki jaka jong ki lynti .

en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes , and prudent in their own sight !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi pyrkhat phi long uba stad , kumta kiba shalak shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia kito kiba stad ha la ki jong ki khmat bad kiba stad ha la ka jong ka khmat !

en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array , army against army .
kha: Ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia bad jong ki Israel ki ïa-ïeng riang marpyrshah ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki Philistia ki la buh ia ka thma ha ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ia ki shipai .

en: Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .
kha: Hato don napdeng jong phi ba shem jynjar ? U dei ban duwai . Hato don uba kmen ? U dei ban rwai ïaroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don mano mano ruh napdeng jong phi ? to ai ba un duwai . Hato don mano mano ruh ? to ai ba un rwai ia ki salm .

en: Many seek the ruler s favour  ; but every man s judgment cometh from the  Lord .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u kwah ïa ka jingsngewtynnat na u nongsynshar ; hynrei tang na U  Trai  phi lah ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun ki wad ia u nongsynshar u ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u briew u wan na U Trai .

en: And they said unto him , Nay , my lord , but to buy food are thy servants come .
kha: Em , kynrad ,  ki jubab .  Ngi la ïawan kum ki mraw jong phi ban thied jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Em, ko kynrad jong nga, hynrei ban thied jingbam ki wan ki shakri jong me .

en: ( Ephesians 6 :1-3 ) He expects parents to instruct and correct their children .
kha: ( Ephesos 6 :1-3 ) U khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Ephesos 6 :1-3 ) U khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin hikai bad pynbeit ia ki khun jong ki .

en: Understand , ye brutish among the people : and ye fools , when will ye be wise ?
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , kumno phi lah ban long kiba bieit mutlop sat ? Lano phin nang ïa kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewthuh , phi sngewsih hapdeng ki briew: bad phi bieit , mynno phin long kiba stad ?

en: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke  ; yet do I not forget thy statutes .
kha: Nga long u bymmyntoi kum ka lwa snieh waiñ ba la bret ; pynban ngam shym la klet ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la kylla long kum ka bilor ha ka tdem ; hynrei ngam klet ia ki ain jong me .

en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?
kha: Hato me lah ban teh lang ïa ki Pleïades    , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba teh ïa u Orion    ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban teh ia ki jingktah kiba thiang jong ki Jingkyrpad , ne pyllait ia ki band jong ka Orion ?

en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .
kha: U Jonathan u ïateh jutang jingïadei paralok bad u Dabid namar ka jingieit bajylliew ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki la leh ia ka jutang , namar u ieit ia u kum la ka jong ka mynsiem .

en: Bless the  Lord  , O house of Levi : ye that fear the  Lord  , bless the  Lord .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki Lebi ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi baroh kiba mane ïa U !
translated_en_to_kha: Kyrkhu ia U Trai , ko iing u Lebi: phi kiba sheptieng ia U Trai , to kyrkhu ia U Trai .

en: Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .
kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , namar ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kyntait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la shah kyntait kin khot ia ki , namar U Trai u la kyntait ia ki .

en: Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
kha: U Shuppim bad u Huppim ruh ki long na kane ka jait . U Dan u don uwei u khun , u Hushim .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuppim ruh , bad u Huppim , ki khun jong u Ir bad u Hushim , ki khun shynrang jong u Aher .

en: For he knoweth not that which shall be : for who can tell him when it shall be ?
kha: Ym don mano mano na ngi batip ïa kaei ka ban jia , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban ïathuh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar um tip ia kata kaban long: namar mano ba lah ban iathuh ia u lano kan long ?

en: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .
kha: Me la buh ïa ka pyrthei ha ki nongrim baskhem , bad yn ym pynkhih shuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba buh ia ki nongrim jong ka khyndew , ba ym dei ban weng noh ia ka junom .

en: And the woman conceived , and sent and told David , and said , I am with child .
kha: Hadien kata , ka la shem ba ka la punkhun bad ka phah ktien sha u Dabid ban ïathuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la pun khun bad ka la phah bad iathuh ha u Dabid bad ka la ong, Nga don khun .

en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men , much elder than thy father .
kha: Ngi ïoh ïa ka jingstad na ki briew ba la phuh ñiuhlieh — kito ïa kiba la kha ha shuwa u kpa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ngi baroh arngut ki briew kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tymmen bha, kiba kham rangbah shibun ban ia u kpa jong me .

en: For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .
kha: ( Kim pat sngewthuh hi ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba la ong ba u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haduh mynta kim tip ia ka jingthoh , ba u dei ban mihpat na kiba iap .

en: The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .
kha: U la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei , hynrei baroh kiwei pat , ki la long kiba sniew ha khmat U Blei , bad ka jingleh jubor ka la saphriang kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ruh ka la bamsap ha khmat U Blei , bad ka khyndew ka la dap da ka jingleh donbor .

en: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , la kynthup lang hapdeng ki Lebi . )
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shaphang u Moses u briew jong U Blei , la jer kyrteng ia ki khun shynrang jong u na ka jait Lebi .

en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kur u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shebuel u khun u Gershom u khun u Moses u la long u nongsynshar ia ki spah .

en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird ? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens ?
kha: Hato men teh ïa u kum ïa ka sim ba ri ha ïing , kum kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa ki shakri kynthei jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ialehkai bad u kum bad ka sim ? lane phin teh ia u na ka bynta ki shakri jong me ?

en: Give not thy strength unto women , nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings .
kha: Wat pynlut ïa la ka bor ha ka jingïathiah shongkha , bad ïa baroh ka pisa jong phi ha ki kynthei ; ki la pynjot ïa ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ia ka bor jong me ha ki kynthei , lane ia ki lynti jong me ha kata kaba pynjot ia ki syiem .

en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
kha: U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïapom jong u Hadadeser .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u syiem u To u la iohsngew ba u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki shipai baroh .

en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence : when I consider , I am afraid of him .
kha: nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga sngewsih ha khmat jong u: haba nga pyrkhat , nga tieng ia u .

en: And onyx stones , and stones to be set for the ephod , and for the breastplate .
kha: ki mawkordor Karnelian bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki maw onyx , bad ki maw ban buh na ka bynta ka ephod , bad na ka bynta ka sniehdoh .

en: They that make them are like unto them : so is every one that trusteth in them .
kha: To ai ba baroh kiba la thaw ïa ki bad kiba shaniah ha ki kin kylla long kum ki bleithaw ba ki la shna !
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba pynlong ia ki ki long kum ma ki: kumjuh ruh uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha ki .

en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .
kha: Kumta te , u briew u bym leh ïa kaba bha kaba u tip ba u dei ban leh u long uba shah pynrem namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha uta uba tip ban leh ia kaba bha bad u bym leh ia kata, ha u ka long ka pop .

en: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die . Believest thou this ?
kha: Hato pha ngeit ïa kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba im bad uba ngeit ha nga un ym iap satia . Ngeit ia kane ?

en: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man s hand under their wings .
kha: Nga la ïohi ba uwei pa uwei na kita ki kherub u don kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh ki thapniang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la paw ha ki cherub ka dur jong u briew hapoh ki bniat jong ki .

en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .
kha: Khmih ïa ka durkhmat jong nga . Ngam shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sngewhun, to peit ia nga ; namar ka paw ha phi lada nga thok .

en: When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .
kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat ha ka jingbun briew , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki long tang katto katne ngut ki briew ha ka met jong u, tang khyndiat eh bad ki nongwei ha ka .

en: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face , that thy shame may appear .
kha: U  Trai  hi un sloit ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad un pynpaw ïa pha ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan lap ia ki bniat jong me ha ka khmat jong me, ba ka jingsngewlehrain jong me kan paw .

en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .
kha: Ki la ïeng kham pajih bad ki la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad ! To isynei ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkiew ia la ka sur bad ki la ong, Jisu, ko Nonghikai, to isynei ia ngi .

en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , are upon thee , O inhabitant of the earth .
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi baroh ! Ki don ki jingshyrkhei , ki  liewlep , bad ki jingriam kiba ap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng bad ka thliew bad ka snare ki don halor jong me ko nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew .

en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,
kha: Hato me wad jingbam na ka bynta ki sing ban bam , bad pynhun ïa ki sing samla kiba thngan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me leit khwai ia u sing ? lane pyndap ia ka jingkwah bam jong ki sing samla , .

en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps .
kha: U syiem u kren ha ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shaphang kine ki jingai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hesekaiah u la kylli ia ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shaphang ki lum .

en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngi ; nga ïeng ha khmat ki briew bad nga kyrpad jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la leit sngewsih khlem ka sngi : Nga la ieng , bad nga la iam ha ka balang .

en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts , and the chief seats in the synagogues ,
kha: Ki ieit ïa ki jaka bakor tam ha ki jingkhawai bad ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ieit ia ki kamra kiba shalor tam ha ki jingkhawai , bad ki jaka shong ba kongsan ha ki synagog , .

en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
kha: Ka jingïaishah ba pynkohnguh ka lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka lah ban pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba slem ka long kaba la pynbor ia u syiem, bad ka shyntur kaba jem ka pynpra ia ka shyieng .

en: And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Em ! Phi la ïawan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Em, hynrei ban iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka ri kaba phi wan .

en: And the saying pleased me well : and I took twelve men of you , one of a tribe :
kha: Nga la sngewdei ïa kata ka jingai jingmut ; kumta nga la jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingong ka la pynsngewbha ia nga bha: bad nga la shim shiphew ngut ki briew na phi, uwei na ka jaitbynriew:

en: His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .
kha: Ka jingmad ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; u thylliej jong phi u long ka dud bad ka ngap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong u ka long kum ka ksiar kaba bha tam, ki locks jong u ki long kiba khlaw , bad kiba lieh kum u blang .

en: Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .
kha: Nangta u Solomon u duwai :  Me , A  Trai  , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bneng , pynban me la jied ban shong ha ki lyoh bad ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ong ba un shong ha ka jingdum kaba jylliew .

en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , U  Trai  u shahshkor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u jngai na kiba sniew: hynrei u iohsngew ia ka jingduwai jong kiba hok .

en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kaba sah na ka doh bad na u kpu phin thang da ka ding .

en: Thank you for reaching out. Could you please share more details about the issue?
kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la wan sha ngi. Phi lah ban ïasam shuh shuh shaphang kane ka mat?
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la poi shabar. Hato phi lah ban iasam kham bniah shaphang ka mat?

en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Neither curse them at all , nor bless them at all .
kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Phi kyntait ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei to shu keiñ noh na kaba kyrkhu ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la ong ha u Balaam, Wat tim ia ki satia, lymne wat kyrkhu ia ki satia .

en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :
kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym hap ban phet noh ha ka por tlang lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei duwai ba ka jingleit jong phi kan ym long ha ka por lyiur, lymne ha ka sngi Sabha:

en: Passing through the street near her corner  ; and he went the way to her house ,
kha: U dang ïaid ha lynti najan ka dong ha kaba shong kawei ka kynthei . U dang ïaid lyngba najan ïing jong ka
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba iaid lyngba ka lynti hajan ka kut jong ka ; bad u la leit sha iing jong ka , .

en: Kindly provide additional details to help us resolve your complaint effectively.
kha: Sngewbha ai ïa ki jingtip ba bnïah ban ïarap ïa ngi ban pynbeit ïa ka jingujor jong phi da kaba suk.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha ai ia ki jingtip ba kham bniah ban iarap ia ngi ban pynbeit bha ia ka jingujor jong phi.

en: Then said I to the angel that talked with me , Whither do these bear the ephah ?
kha: Nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Shaei ki rah ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ha u angel uba la kren bad nga , Hato kine ki kit ia ka ephah ?

en: When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil  ;
kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong nga ki la ai shibun ka dud , bad ki dieng Olib ki la san ha ki khyndew jong ki jaka maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la sait ia ki step jong nga da ka butter , bad u maw u la theh ia nga shabar ki wah umphniang ; .

en: But the tongue can no man tame  ; it is an unruly evil , full of deadly poison .
kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ba la lah ban pynjuh ïa u thylliej . U long uba sniew bad bym lah ban synshar , uba dap da ka bih ba pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka shyntur kam lah ban shah ktah ha ka met u long u bym don akor , uba dap da ka bih kaba pyniap briew .

en: We’ve updated you via email. Please check and confirm if everything is resolved.
kha: Ngi’n pynbna ïa phi lyngba ka email. Sngewbha peit bad pynthikna lada baroh ki la biang.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la pynthymmai ia phi lyngba ka email. Sngewbha peit bad pynskhem lada baroh la pynbeit.

en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .
kha: bad nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki dieng ha ki ryntieh da ki liang jong ka synduk , ban kit ia ka synduk .

en: For he knew who should betray him  ; therefore said he ,  Ye are not all clean .
kha: ( U Jisu u la lah tip lypa uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa u ; na kata ka daw balei u la ong ,  Baroh na phi , lait noh uwei , phi long kiba khuid .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u tip mano ba dei ban pyndem ia u ; namarkata u la ong ia u , Phi baroh phim long kiba khuid .

en: Therefore said he , Take it up to thee . And he put out his hand , and took it .
kha: Shim ïa u ,  u hukum bad uta u briew u dem bad u la shim ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong , To shim ia ka sha me . Bad u la pynmih ia la ka kti bad u la shim ia ka .

en: But woe to them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
kha: Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha kita ki sngi na ka bynta ki kynthei kiba armet bad ki kmie kiba don ki khun rit !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kordit ia kito kiba don khun bad ia kito kiba ai dud ha kita ki sngi !

en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .
kha: namar U Blei u trei borabor hapoh jong phi , ban pynlong ïa phi kiba don ka mon bad kiba lah ban kohnguh ïa ka jingthmu jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar dei U Blei uba trei ha phi baroh ar ban mon bad ban leh ia ka jingsngewbha jong u .

en: And Chephar–ammoni , and Ophni , and Geba  ; twelve cities with their villages :
kha: ka Shepharammoni , ka Ophni , bad ka Geba : khat-ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Khepharammoni, bad u Ophni, bad u Gba ; shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: And Moses  father in law said unto him , The thing that thou doest is not good .
kha: Nangta u Jethro u ong ,  Phim shym leh satia ïa kane ha ka rukom kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u Moses u la ong ha u , Kaei kaba me leh kam long kaba bha .

en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iohsngew ia kata , u la phah ia u Joab bad ki shipai kiba khlain bor baroh .

en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us , that might lay his hand upon us both .
kha: Hynrei ym don uno uno uba wan hapdeng jong ngi — ym don u ban bishar ïa U Blei bad ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ruh u briew uba sngi ha ngi, uba lah ban buh ia la ka kti halor jong ngi baroh arngut .

en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .
kha: Me long U Blei jong nga , bad nga ainguh ïa me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long U Blei jong nga bad ngan iaroh ia me: me long U Blei jong nga , ngan pynkhraw ia me .

en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came unto Iconium .
kha: Ki apostol ki la kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong ki ha ka jingpyrshah ïa ki bad ki la leit noh sha Ikoniom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la pynkhih ia ka dewmet jong ki kjat jong ki pyrshah ia ki bad ki la poi ha Iconum .

en: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father , and ye in me , and I in you .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin sa tip ba nga long ha U Kpa jong nga bad ba ma phi ha nga , kumba nga long ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi phin sa tip ba nga don ha U Kpa jong nga bad phi ha nga bad nga ha phi .

en: For yet a little while , and he that shall come will come , and will not tarry .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Namar sa tang shibit eh , bad uta uba wan un wan ; un ym slem shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar tang khyndiat por , bad uta u ban wan un wan , bad un ym sahkut .

en: Behold , I am pressed under you , as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves .
kha: Bad mynta , ngan ïuh ïa phi ha madan bad phin ud kum ka kali ba la pynkit khia da u kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la shah pynkhih hapoh jong phi , kumba la pynkhih ia ka kali kaba dap da ki shniuh .

en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
