kha: U Dabid u la tip ïa kata bad u phah ïa u Joab pyrshah ïa ki lem bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iohsngew ia kata , u la phah ia u Joab bad ki shipai kiba khlain bor baroh .

en: If in this life only we have hope in Christ , we are of all men most miserable .
kha: Lada ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Khrist ka long tang ha kane ka jingim hi , te ngi dei ban ïoh kham bun ka jinglehisynei ban ïano ïano ruh ha ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ha kane ka jingim tang ngi don ka jingkyrmen ha U Khrist , ngi long kiba duk tam na ki briew baroh .

en: Rajnath Singh launches portal for ' Opportunities for Make In India in Defence '
kha: U Rajnath Singh u la pyllait ia ka portal na ka bynta ' ki lad ban pynlong ia ka ri India ha ka kam iada ' .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rajnath Singh u pynmih ia ka por na ka bynta ' Ki lad ki lynti na ka bynta ban pynlong ha India ha ka ri India ' .

en: A time to weep , and a time to laugh  ; a time to mourn , and a time to dance  ;
kha: U buh ka por ban sngewsih bad ka por ban kmen , ka por ban ïam sngewsih bad ka por ban shad ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban iam , bad ka por ban rkhie ; ka por ban iam , bad ka por ban shad ; .

en: Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .
kha: Peit beit sha khmat da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka khlieh ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki khmat jong me kin peit beit sha khmat , bad to ai ba ki khmat jong me kin peit beit ha khmat jong me .

en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba ïoh burom lymda u long uba sngewrit ; ki briew kiba meng ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ban pynjot ka dohnud u briew ka long kaba sngewrit , bad shuwa ka burom ka long ka jinglong rit mynsiem .

en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :
kha: Da shisha katto katne ngut na ki , ki ïalap ïa U Khrist namar ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingïakajia , hynrei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba ialap shisha ia U Khrist wat na ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingialeh ; bad don ruh na ka mon babha:

en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels .
kha: Na ka bynta ki angel , te , ka briew ka dei ban don ka jingda halor la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ba ka long hapoh ka bor u tnga jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka daw ka kynthei ka dei ban don ka bor ha ka khlieh jong ka namar ki angel .

en: And Joseph said unto them the third day , This do , and live  ; for I fear God :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Nga long u briew uba sheptieng Blei , kumta ngan pyllait im ïa phi ha kane ka kyndon :
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki ha ka sngi kaba lai: Kane ka leh, bad im ; namar nga tieng ia U Blei:

en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
kha: Ki jinghikai jong kiba stad ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim ; kin ïarap ïa phi ban lait im haba ka jingim jong phi ka don ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hukum jong kiba stad ka long ka pung jong ka jingim , ban phet noh na ki jingeh jong ka jingiap .

en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle : but safety is of the  Lord .
kha: Phi lah ban pynkhreh ïa ki kulai na ka bynta ka thma , hynrei dei U  Trai  uba ai ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: U kulai u la pynkhreh pyrshah ia ka sngi thma: hynrei ka jingshngain ka long jong U Trai .

en: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother , and was gone to Paddan–aram  ;
kha: U la shem ba u Jakob u la kohnguh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba u Jakob u la kohnguh ia la u kpa bad ia la ka kmie bad u la leit sha Paddanaram ; .

en: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .
kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki lumbah bajrong , bad ki phyllad ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum kiba jrong ki long ka jaka rieh na ka bynta ki blang khlaw ; bad ki maw na ka bynta ki lum .

en: For her sins have reached unto heaven , and God hath remembered her iniquities .
kha: Naba ïa ki pop jong ka la kynton shajrong kat shaduh bneng , bad U Blei u kynmaw ïa ki kam bymman jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki pop jong ka ki la poi sha bneng , bad U Blei u la kynmaw ia ki jingbymhok jong ka .

en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .
kha: Hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep U Jisu u la wan sha ki synran , da kaba ïaid halor ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingpahara kaba saw jong ka miet U Jisu u la leit sha ki , u iaid ha duriaw .

en: And the law is not of faith : but , The man that doeth them shall live in them .
kha: Hynrei ka Hukum kam don ei ei ban leh bad ka jingngeit . Pynban kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Jar uba leh ïa baroh ïa kaba ka hukum ka dawa un ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka hukum kam dei ka jingngeit: hynrei , U briew uba leh ia ki un im ha ki .

en: Tom had no idea that Mary was planning to stay in Australia for three more days.
kha: U Tom um bna eiei ba ka Mary ka mut sah sha Australia sa lai sngi.
translated_en_to_kha: U Tom um don jingmut ei ei ba ka Mary ka thmu ban sah ha Australia sa lai sngi.

en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ , and hath anointed us , is God ;
kha: U dei U Blei hi uba pynlong ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist ; u dei U Blei hi da lade uba la pynkyrpang ïa ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uta uba pynskhem ia ngi bad phi ha U Khrist bad uba la pynsleh ia ngi, u long U Blei ; .

en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .
kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist U long ka jingkut jong ka hukum na ka bynta ka hok ha uwei pa uwei uba ngeit .

en: The righteous is delivered out of trouble , and the wicked cometh in his stead .
kha: Uba hok u lait na ka jingjynjar ; pynban u bymman u hap ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: La pyllait noh ia uba hok na ka jingjynjar , bad u bymman u wan ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .
kha: Sa shisien pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel , kiba long baroh laiphew hajar ngut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , u Dabid u la lum lang ia ki briew Israel baroh kiba la jied, laiphew hajar .

en: He spake , and there came divers sorts of flies , and lice in all their coasts .
kha: U Blei u la hukum , bad ki skain bad ki mait ki la dap kylleng ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren , bad ki la wan ki jait khnai , bad ki khniang ha ki rud duriaw jong ki baroh .

en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .
kha: Wat shukor ïa lade tang da kaba sngap ïa ka ktien jong u ; pynban , to pyntreikam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to long ki nongleh ia ka ktien , bad ym tang ki nongsngap , da kaba shukor ia la ka jong ka jong ka jinglong .

en: And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .
kha: U Manoah u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba ngi la ïohi ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: U Manoah u la ong ha ka tnga jong u, "Ngin sa iap shisha, namar ngi la iohi ia U Blei .

en: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places : how are the mighty fallen !
kha: Halor ki lum ka Israel ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ïap ! Kiba shlur tam na ki shipai jong ngi , ki la kyllon !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingitynnad jong ki Israel ka la shah pyniap ha ki jaka ba jrong jong me: kumno ki riew khlain ki la hap !

en: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish , for whom Christ died ?
kha: Bad kumta une u briew uba tlot , u parabangeit ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap , un jot noh namar kata  ka jingtip  jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lyngba ka jingtip jong me u hynmen uba tlot un jah noh , na ka bynta jong u U Khrist u la iap ?

en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .
kha: Nangta kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba don kita ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ban put ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew ngut ki angel kiba don ki hynriew tylli ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ia lade ban sawa .

en: Will he make many supplications unto thee ? will he speak soft words unto thee ?
kha: Hato un kyrpad ïa me ban pyllait ïa u ? Hato un ïasaid bad me ban ïoh jingisynei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un leh bun ki jingkyrpad ha me ? hato un kren ia ki kyntien kiba jem ha me ?

en: O Lord , thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul  ; thou hast redeemed my life .
kha: Me la wan ban pyllait ïa nga , A Trai , bad me la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, me la kyrpad ia ki daw jong ka mynsiem jong nga ; me la siewspah ia ka jingim jong nga .

en: Remove not the old landmark  ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :
kha: Wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud uba rim lane knieh ïa ka khyndew ba long trai da ki khunswet .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat weng noh ia ka dak barim ; bad wat rung sha ki lyngkha jong ki bym don kpa:

en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
kha: Ynda u Noah u la pyngngad , bad u la tip aïu u khun khatduh jong u , u la leh ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Noah u la kyndit na ka wain jong u, bad u la tip ia kaei kaba u khun rit jong u u la leh ia u .

en: And they lay wait for their own blood  ; they lurk privily for their own lives .
kha: hynrei ki briew kiba kum kita ki riam ïa lade hi , ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki thiah ia la ka jong ka snam ; ki ia tyngkhuh bad la ka jong ka jingim .

en: He hath made me also a byword of the people  ; and aforetime I was as a tabret .
kha: Bad mynta ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa kane ka proberb pyrshah ïa nga ; ki wan bad ki bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ruh ia nga kum u briew ; bad mynshuwa nga la long kum u tabret .

en: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .
kha: U pynlong ïa ki pud jong phi ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ka jingsuk ha ki pud jong me , bad u pynkhih ia me da u kew uba bha tam .

en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .
kha: Kaba tip kumno ban pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymdonkam lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid u bsein un bam khlem da sngewtynnad ; bad u khunlung um kham bha .

en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the  Lord  , and put it on my loins .
kha: Kumta nga la thied ïa ki bad phong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la ioh ia ka jingkhang kat kum ka ktien U Trai , bad nga la buh ia ka ha ki tyrpeng jong nga .

en: I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
kha: Nga la ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka jingïamareh , nga la pyndep ïa ka jingïaphet , nga la ri ïa ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ialeh ia ka jingialeh kaba bha, nga la pyndep ia ka lynti jong nga, nga la bat ia ka jingngeit:

en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father s sheep at Beth–lehem .
kha: u Dabid u ju iehnoh ïa ki bad u leit phai sha Bethlehem na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ban sharai ïa ki langbrot u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Dabid u la leit phai noh na u Saul ban ai bam ia ki langbrot jong u kpa jong u ha Bethlehem .

en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
kha: U la pynhun ïa kito kiba sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u pynhun ia ka mynsiem kaba thrang, bad u pyndap ia ka mynsiem kaba thngan da ka jingbha .

en: And after the second veil , the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all  ;
kha: Ha lyndet ka jingkah kaba ar la don ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaba la khot ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ka jingtap kaba ar , ka Tabernak kaba la khot ka Holiest na baroh ; .

en: Notwithstanding ye have well done , that ye did communicate with my affliction .
kha: Hynrei ka long kaba bha shibun ïa phi ban ïarap ïa nga ha ki jingjynjar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la phi la leh bha, ba phi la iakynduh bad ka jingjynjar jong nga .

en: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof , as though I shot at a mark .
kha: Ngan sa siat lai tylli ki khnam shata , la kum ba siat ha ka skum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan siat lai tylli ki khnam ha ka liang jong ka , kumba nga siat ia ka dak .

en: The issue with your payment is under review, and we’ll notify you once resolved.
kha: Ka jingeh ha ka jingsiew jong phi ka dang don hapoh ka jingbishar bnïah, bad ngin sa pyntip ïa phi ynda la pynbeit.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mat bad ka jingsiew jong phi ka dang bishar bniah, bad ngin sa pyntip ia phi shisien ba la pynbeit.

en: And all they of the land came to a wood  ; and there was honey upon the ground .
kha: Ma ki baroh ki la wan sha ka jaka khlaw bad ki la shem ïa ka ngap kat shaba phai .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki briew jong ka ri ki la poi sha u dieng ; bad ka don ka ngap ha ka khyndew .

en: An end is come , the end is come : it watcheth for thee  ; behold , it is come .
kha: Kan wan halor jong pha baroh . Kane ka long kaba kut . Phan sa jot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkut ka la wan, ka jingkut ka la wan: ka peit ia me ; ha khmih , ka la wan .

en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance , and your burden , and your strife ?
kha: Hynrei kumno tang ma nga marwei nga lah ban kit ïa ka jingkitkhlieh kaba khia ha kaba bishar bad rai ïa ki kam ïakajia hapdeng jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno nga hi nga lah ban shah ia ka jingeh jong phi, bad ka jingkit jong phi bad ka jingialeh jong phi ?

en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .
kha: Katba nang bun ki duwan ba ki paid Israel ki thaw ban pynkhuid ïa ki pop , katta nang bun ki jaka ba ki ïoh ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u Ephraim u la leh bun ki nongleh pop , ki nongleh kam sniew kin long ha u ban leh pop .

en: aided professors/lecturers/teachers, etc) in public affairs(active politicians).
kha: aided proffessors/lecturers/teachers,etc)ha ki kam paidbah( active politics).
translated_en_to_kha: ki nongkyrshan/jinghikai ba la iarap, bad kiwei kiwei) ha ki kam paidbah).

en: But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :
kha: Hynrei lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sher dara lem bad u Purah u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me tieng ban hiar, me leit bad u shakri jong me shapoh sha ka kynhun shipai:

en: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go  ;
kha: Hynrei kim shym ong ei ei . U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew , U la pynkhiah ïa u , bad U la phah noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki . U la shim ia u, bad u la pynkoit ia u, bad u la pyllait noh ia u;

en: For faster resolution, we recommend visiting our Help Centre for detailed steps.
kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit kaba kham kloi, ngi ai jingmut ban leit sha ka Help Center jong ngi na ka bynta ki jingbatai ba bnïah.
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit kaba kham stet, ngi ai jingmut ban leit jngoh ia ka Help Centre jong ngi na ka bynta ki sienjam kiba bniah.

en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .
kha: Hynrei nga pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha ki hajar ki pateng kiba ieit ïa nga , bad kiba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba pyni ia ka jingisynei ha ki hajar ngut kiba ieit ia nga bad kiba sumar ia ki hukum jong nga .

en: " " " " " Equality under the law is an important point of view . " " " " " " "
kha: " " " " Ka jingiaryngkat hapoh ka ain ka long ka jingmut kaba kongsan. " " " " " " "
translated_en_to_kha: " " " " " "Ka jingiaryngkat hapoh ka ain ka long ka jingmut kaba kongsan ." " " ."

en: Is it fit to say to a king , Thou art wicked ? and to princes , Ye are ungodly ?
kha: U Blei u pynrem ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongsynshar haba kim long jingmyntoi ne ki long kiba bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long kaba dei ban ong ia u syiem , Me long uba sniew ? bad ha ki syiem , Phi long ki bym don Blei ?

en: Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .
kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ap paralok hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko para jong nga haba phi iawan lang ban bam , to ia sah iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence , and given to the poor ?
kha: Balei bym die noh ïa kane ka jingiwbih ha ka dor laispah ki sbai rupa bad ïa ka pisa ban ai sha kiba duk ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ym shym la die ia kane ka umphniang da ki lai spah pen , bad la ai ha kiba duk ?

en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .
kha: Ka burom U Blei ka la phet na Israel ,  ka ong ,  namar ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Ka burom ka la jah noh na Israel: namar la shim ia ka synduk U Blei .

en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .
kha: Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki leh ïa ki kam bieit ; ki briew kiba stad ki long jai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba bitar u la sngewsih lyngngoh: bad u briew uba sniew u la shah shun .

en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves , and are become judges of evil thoughts ?
kha: te phi long ba la rem da kaba pynïapher hapdeng jong phi hi bad phi bishar ha ka nongrim jong ki jingthmu basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim long kiba shi bynta ha lade , bad phi kylla long ki nongbishar jong ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew ?

en: I loathe it  ; I would not live alway : let me alone  ; for my days are vanity .
kha: Ngan keiñ noh , nga la thait ban im Ieh ïa nga marwei . Ka jingim jong nga kam don jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewsih ia ka ; ngan ym im beit: to ngan sah marwei ; namar ki sngi jong nga ki long kiba sniew .

en: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years .
kha: U la long syiem sawphew snem ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ba u Solomon u la synshar ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel baroh kawei ka long sawphew snem .

en: Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .
kha: Phi ki rangbah phi long kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to shahshkor mynta ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ki ktien jong nga , ko phi ki briew kiba stad ; bad to ai shkor ia nga , phi kiba don ka jingtip .

en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .
kha: Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bha ïa nga ïa baroh kaba nga don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, Job, nga kyrpad ia me, to sngap ia ki jingkren jong nga baroh .

en: Honour thy father and mother ; ( which is the first commandment with promise ; )
kha: To burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,  kaba long ka hukum kaba nyngkong kaba don ka jingkular ha ka :
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me ; (ka long ka hukum kaba nyngkong eh da ka jingkular ; )

en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?
kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai lang , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ki risa da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki khlur mynstep ki rwai lang , bad ki khun U Blei baroh ki la pyrta da ka jingkmen ?

en: But every man is tempted , when he is drawn away of his own lust , and enticed .
kha: Hynrei u briew u shah pynshoi haba u shah ring pah bad shah riam ha ki jingkwah brai jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei u shah pynshoi , haba u shah rong noh na la ka jong ka jingkwah brai bad u la shah pynngop .

en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother ,
kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u apostol U Jisu Khrist da ka mon U Blei bad u Timothi u para jong ngi .

en: God brought them out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn .
kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki la kum u masi prut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la wanrah ia ki na Ijipt; u don kumba ka long ka bor jong u unicorn .

en: Glory and honour are in his presence  ; strength and gladness are in his place .
kha: Ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem ki ker sawdong ïa u , ka bor bad ka jingkmen ki dap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom bad ka burom ki don ha ka jingdon jong u; ka jingkhlain bad ka jingkmen ki don ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
kha: Wat buaid da ka waiñ , ha kaba kan pynjot ïa phi ; pynban , to long kiba la pyndap da U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat dih ia ka wain , ha kaba ka long kaba palat ; hynrei to pyndap da U Mynsiem ; .

en: Mani C Kappan , the LDF candidate , has won the Pala assembly bypoll in Kerala .
kha: U Mani C Kappan uba dei u kyrtong jong ka LDF u la jop ha ka bypoll jong ka dorbar Pala ha Kerala .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mani C Kappan u kyrtong ka LDF u la jop ia ka dorbar Pala ha Kerala .

en: For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,
kha: Naba ki la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien kiba pher bad ki da ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei . U Petros u la kren :
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la iohsngew ba ki kren da ki thylliej bad ki pynkhraw ia U Blei . Nangta u la jubab ia u Petros .

en: And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
kha: U la ong shai bha ïa kane ha ki . Kumta u Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa u bad u la sdang ban sneng ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia kata da kaba kren shai . U Petros u la shim ia u bad u la sdang ban pynrem ia u .

en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him : neither will he go unto the wise .
kha: Ki briew kiba meng kim sngewtynnat ban shah sneng ; kim ju pan ïa ki jingai jingmut na kito kiba kham stad .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongleh bein um ieit ia uta uba pynrem ia u: lymne un leit sha kiba stad .

en: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,
kha: Ki la shim la ka bainong bad ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u nongaikam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la ioh ia ka , ki la ia ud pyrshah ia u briew uba bha jong ka iing .

en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi bad ka jingsuk na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad na U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: Then opened he their understanding , that they might understand the scriptures ,
kha: Nangta u la plie ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki ban shemphang ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la plie ia ka jingsngewthuh jong ki , ba kin sngewthuh ia ki jingthoh , .

en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land , and shalt gather in the fruits thereof :
kha: Ha ki hynriew snem to thung to tep ha la ka lyngkha , bad lumlang ïa ki jingmih jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew snem me dei ban bet ia ka ri jong me, bad men lum ia ki soh jong ka:

en: Extinct or nearly extinct traditional transport Palanquin , dulki , bazra boat .
kha: La duh jait ne la jan duh jait ki lieng kit mar tynrai ki Palanquin , ki dulki , ki lieng bazra .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lieng kit mar tynrai kaba la jah rngai ne kaba la jan duh jait.

en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , It shall not stand , neither shall it come to pass .
kha: Hynrei nga , U  Trai  , nga pynbna ba kane kan ym jia da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei , Kan ym ieng , lymne kan ym jia .

en: Yet a little sleep , a little slumber , a little folding of the hands to sleep :
kha: Dem kai shipor bad thiah lada phi sngewkwah . Kli ïa la ki kti ban jahthait shiphang ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khyndiat ka jingthiah, khyndiat ka jingthiah, khyndiat ka jingpynkylla ia ki kti ban thiah:

en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father , and from our Lord Jesus Christ ,
kha: Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi bad ka jingsuk na U Blei U Kpa bad na U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: An angry man stirreth up strife , and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .
kha: Ki briew kiba kloi ban bitar ki pynlong shibun ki jingïakajia bad ki jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bitar u pynkhih ia ka jingialeh , bad u briew uba bitar u nang bun ha ka jingpynkhein .

en: I will feed my flock , and I will cause them to lie down , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Nga hi da lade ngan long u nongaplangbrot ïa ki langbrot jong nga , bad ngan wad ka jaka shongthait ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai bam ia ki langbrot jong nga , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban thiah , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water :
kha: Un pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pyniap ia uta uwei na ki sim ha ka umphniang khyndew halor ka um kaba tuid:

en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .
kha: Ka jingkhuslai kan lute ïa ka jingkmen na phi , hynrei ki ktien sbun kin pynkmen ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhia ha ka dohnud u briew ka pynlong ia ka ban dem khrup: hynrei ka ktien kaba bha ka pynsngewbha ia ka .

en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
kha: Hangno phi la tep ïa u ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  To wan bad peit Ko Trai ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Hangno phi la buh ia u ? Ki la ong ha u: Ko Trai to wan peit .

en: And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ynda ki la dep bam dep dih ha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngew jynjar sat bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang duwai ha khmat U  Trai . Ha kata ka por , u lyngdoh Eli u shong ha ka jaka jong u ha syndah jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la don ha ka jingsngewsih mynsiem, bad ka la duwai ha U Trai bad ka la iam sngewsih .

en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .
kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba la san ryngkat bad ki jingthung bad ki la kjap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don kiba hap hapdeng ki tnat ; bad ki tnat ki la mih bad ka , bad ki la pynkhih ia ka .

en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .
kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pilat kumba long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi uba ki briew ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kata ka jingkhawai u la pyllait ha ki ia uwei u koidi , ia uba ki kwah .

en: Who is he that saith , and it cometh to pass , when the Lord commandeth it not ?
kha: Tang ïa ka mon ka jong U Trai hi la ju ïai pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba ong , bad ka wan ban jia , haba U Trai um hukum ia ka ?

en: He thinks that the Soul is capable of being inclined and attracted towards God .
kha: U pyrkhat ba ka Mynsiem ka lah ban shah pynngop bad shah khring sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U pyrkhat ba ka Mynsiem ka lah ban shah pynkhih bad shah khring sha U Blei .

en: And these were the princes which he had  ; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest ,
kha: bad kine ki long ki rangbah synshar jong u : U lyngdoh : U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Sadok
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki rangbah kiba u don u Azariah u khun u Sadok u lyngdoh .

en: And Esau said , I have enough , my brother  ; keep that thou hast unto thyself .
kha: Hynrei u Iso u ong ,  Ko hep , nga dap biang kyrhai ; buh ïa kaei kaba phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la ong, Nga la biang, ko hynmen jong nga; to sumar ia kata ba me don ha lade .

en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
kha: U Blei u jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka Leah , bad ka la punkhun bad ka kha ïa u khun uba san ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la sngap ia ka Leah , bad ka la pun khun bad ka la kha ia u Jakob u khun uba phra .

en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?
kha: Ki ktien ba-thylli , ko Job ! Ki ktien ba-thylli !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u briew uba stad u dei ban pynpaw ia ka jingtip kaba sniew , bad pyndap ia ka kpoh jong u da ka Iyer mihngi ?

en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah , and came to Jerusalem .
kha: U knieh ïa ki nongbah ba la kerkut jong ka Judah bad u tur shaphrang shaduh Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki shnong ba la ker sawdong kiba dei jong u Judah bad u la poi ha Jerusalem .

en: For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .
kha: Ka pop ka la ïoh ïa ka lad , bad da ka lad jong ka hukum , ka la shukor ïa nga bad ka la pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka pop, kaba shim por da ka hukum, ka la shukor ia nga, bad da ka ka la pyniap ia nga .

en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad , and she that bare thee shall rejoice .
kha: Pynlong ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ban sarong na ka bynta jong phi ; ai ïa ka kmie jong phi ïa kata ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong me bad ka kmie jong me kin sngewbha , bad kata ka ban kha ia me kan sngewbha .

en: For which things  sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience :
kha: Namar kiba kum kine kiei kiei , ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka wan ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiei kiei ka jingbitar U Blei ka wan ha ki khun jong ka jingbym kohnguh:

en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep  ; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger .
kha: Leh jaipdeh lada phi kwah ; ïai thiah sah , hynrei phin shahthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong kaba jem ka la rung ha ka jingthiah kaba jylliew ; bad ka mynsiem kaba khlem akor kan shah thngan .

en: A wise son heareth his father s instruction : but a scorner heareth not rebuke .
kha: Ki khun kiba stad ki shahshkor haba ki kmie ki kpa ki pynbeit ïa ki , hynrei ki briew kiba sarong da lei lei kin ym phla ba ki la bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun uba stad u iohsngew ia ka jinghikai jong u kpa: hynrei u nongleh bein um iohsngew ia ka jingshah pynrem .

en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba marwei ka pynphriang ia ki bneng , bad ka iaid halor ki um duriaw .

en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa .
kha: Ym shym don thma shuh haduh ka snem kaba laiphew san jong ka jingsynshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym shym la don shuh ka thma ha ka sanphew snem jong ka jingsynshar u Asa .

en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .
kha: Hynrei phin ong ,  Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ong te , Ki tnat ki la tyrkhong noh , ba nga lah ban shah rong noh .

en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king s heart was toward Absalom .
kha: U Joab u tip ba u Syiem Dabid u kynmaw ieit haduh katta katta ïa u Absalom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Joab u khun u Seruiah u la sngewthuh ba ka dohnud jong u syiem ka long sha ka ri Absolon .

en: And thy servant my father said unto us , Ye know that my wife bare me two sons :
kha: Nangta i pa i ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi tip ba ka Rakhel ka tnga jong nga ka ïoh tang ar ngut ki khun shynrang na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri jong me u kpa jong nga u la ong ha ngi: Phi tip ba ka tnga jong nga ka kha ia nga arngut ki khun shynrang:

en: Strangers shall fade away , and they shall be afraid out of their close places .
kha: Ki la duh ka jingshlur jong ki bad ki wan da kaba kyiuh na la ki jong ki kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongwei kin jah noh , bad kin tieng na ki jaka ba jan jong ki .

en: After the completion of her degree she became an advocate entitled to practice .
kha: Hadien ba ka la pyndep ia ka kyrdan pule jong ka ka la kylla long ka nongiasaid ain kaba don hok ban treikam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba la dep ia ka kyrdan jong ka ka la kylla long ka nongiasaid ain kaba don hok ban leh .

en: Against an elder receive not an accusation , but before two or three witnesses .
kha: To wat pynshahshkor ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u nongsharai balang lymda la wanrah da ki ar ngut ne bun ngut ki sakhi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia u rangbah um ioh ia ka jingkynnoh , hynrei ha khmat ar ne lai ngut ki sakhi .

en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia ka shyntur jong me, bishar hok bad kyrpad ia ka daw jong kiba duk bad kiba duk .

en: Behold , thou hast instructed many , and thou hast strengthened the weak hands .
kha: Me la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew bad me pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me la hikai ia kiba bun bad me la pynskhem ia ki kti kiba tlot .

en: Ummah also , and Aphek , and Rehob : twenty and two cities with their villages .
kha: ka Ummah , ka Aphek , bad ka Rehob : arphew ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Umah ruh , bad u Aphek bad u Rehob: arphew ar tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: The Bible answers that question at ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 and 2 TIMOTHY 3 :16 , 17 .
kha: Ka Baibl ka jubab ïa kata ka jingkylli ha ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 bad 2 TIMOTHI 3 :16 , 17 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Baibl ka jubab ia kata ka jingkylli ha Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 bad 2 TIMOTHY 3 :16 , 17 .

en: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief : but a faithful ambassador is health .
kha: Ki nonglamktien ki bym lah ban shaniah ki thaw jingkulmar , hynrei kito kiba lah ban shaniah ki wallam ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor uba sniew u hap ha ka jingsniew: hynrei u nongwan ba iaineh u long ka koit ka khiah .

en: As for our redeemer , the  Lord  of hosts is his name , the Holy One of Israel .
kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa ngi — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia u nongsiewspah jong ngi , U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: Families are wise to seek Jehovah’s advice , which he provides through his Word .
kha: Ki longïing longsem kiba stad ki wad ïa ki jinghikai jong U Jehobah kiba u la ai lyngba ka Ktien jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki longïing ki long kiba stad ban wad ïa ki jingai jingmut jong U Jehobah, kiba u pynbiang lyngba ka Ktien jong u .

en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor .
kha: Haba u Sisera u tip ba u Barak u la leit kiew sha u Lum Tabor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyni ia u Sisera ba u Barak u khun u Abinoam u la leit kiew sha u lum Tabor .

en: Who was delivered for our offences , and was raised again for our justification .
kha: Na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , la aiti ïa u ban ïap , bad ïa u la pynmihpat khnang ban pynlong ka hok ïa ngi bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la pynpoi na ka bynta ki jingleh bymman jong ngi , bad la pynmih biang ia ngi na ka bynta ka jingpynshisha jong ngi .

en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted  ; that I might learn thy statutes .
kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka la long kaba bha ïa nga , namar ka pynlong ïa nga ban nang ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba bha ia nga ba nga la shah pynshitom ; ba ngan nang ia ki ain jong me .

en: These wait all upon thee  ; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season .
kha: Baroh na ki , ki shaniah ha me ban ai ïa ki ka jingbam haba ki donkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh ki ap ia me; ba me lah ban ai ia ki ia ka doh jong ki ha ka por kaba biang .

en: A wicked man hardeneth his face : but as for the upright , he directeth his way .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki skhem ha lade ; ki bymman ki shu leh mynleh katba ki lah .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew u pynkhlain ia ka khmat jong u: hynrei katba ia kiba beit , u pynbeit ia la ka lynti .

en: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning , and encamped against Gibeah .
kha: Kumta ki Israel ki mih ha ka step kaba bud bad ki sher dara hajan ka nongbah Gibeah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ieng mynstep bad ki la ia shong shnong pyrshah ia ka Gibeah .

en: Ebed–melech went forth out of the king s house , and spake to the king , saying ,
kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit shata bad ong ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ebedmech u la mih noh na ka iing syiem bad u la kren ha u syiem da kaba ong:

en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel  ; and they were also both of them his wives .
kha: U Dabid u la shongkurim ïa ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad mynta ka Abigail ruh ka la long ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid ruh u la shim ia u Ahinoam na Jesel ; bad ki long ruh baroh arngut ki tnga jong u .

en: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
kha: Ka la ong ha lade ,  Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la ong hapoh jong ka , Lada nga lah ban ktah ia ka jain jong u , ngan sa long uba pura .

en: The first man is of the earth , earthy : the second man is the Lord from heaven .
kha: Ïa u Adam uba nyngkong , la thaw na ka dewmet , ba la wan na ka khyndew ; u Adam uba ar u la wan na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba nyngkong u long na ka khyndew , uba khyndew: u briew uba ar u long U Trai na bneng .

en: His strength shall be hungerbitten , and destruction shall be ready at his side .
kha: U la ju long uba riewspah , hynrei mynta u ïaid ha ka jingthngan ; ka jingjot ka ïeng bad ka ap ha syndah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bor jong u kan long kaba thngan , bad ka jingpynjot kan long kaba la pynkhreh ha ka liang jong u .

en: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven , and in the earth !
kha: hynrei u dem shapoh ban peit ïa ki bneng bad ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba pynrit ia lade ban iohi ia kiei kiei kiba don ha bneng bad ha ka khyndew !

en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself , even as he is pure .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba don ïa kane ka jingkyrmen ha U Khrist , u ri khuid ïa lade , kumba U Khrist u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei uba don ia kane ka jingkyrmen ha u u pynkhuid ia lade kumba u long uba khuid .

en: Lie not one to another , seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds ;
kha: Wat ïa-lamler iwei ïa iwei pat , naba phi la loit noh ïa ka jinglong barim lem bad ki jingmlien jong ka bad ba phi la kup ïa ka jinglong bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju ia kren iwei ia iwei pat , haba phi iohi ba phi la weng noh ia u tymmen bad ki kam jong u ; .

en: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .
kha: Nangta ha Peor , ki briew jong U Blei ki la ïasnohlang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , bad bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki blei bym don jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iasoh ruh bad u Baalpeor bad ki la bam ia ki jingknia jong kiba iap .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Thy bruise is incurable , and thy wound is grievous .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ki jingmong jong phi ki long ki bym lah ban koit , ïa ki jingmynsaw jong phi ym lah ban pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Ka jingsma jong me ka long kaba ym lah ban pynkoit , bad ka jingmynsaw jong me ka long kaba sngewsih .

en: I called my servant , and he gave me no answer  ; I entreated him with my mouth .
kha: Haba nga khot ïa u shakri , um jubab — wat la nga kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la khot ia u shakri jong nga , bad um shym la jubab ia nga ; nga la kyrpad ia u da ka shyntur jong nga .

en: Ye serpents , ye generation of vipers , how can ye escape the damnation of hell ?
kha: Phi ki bseiñ bad ki khun ki bseiñ ! Kumno phi khmih lynti ban lait na ka jingshah pynrem sha ka dujok ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki bsein , phi ki khun ki bsein , kumno phi lah ban lait na ka jingtim jong ka dujok ?

en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land , the chief of all their strength .
kha: U pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang kiba nyngkong jong baroh ki longïing jong ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ruh ia ki khun nyngkong baroh ha ka ri jong ki , u rangbah jong ka bor jong ki baroh .

en: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass  ; and as thy days , so shall thy strength be .
kha: To ki shnong jong u kin long kiba la ker da ki khyrdop nar , Bad to un shongsuk shongsaiñ borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki juti jong me kin long ki nar bad ki nar bad kumba long ki sngi jong me , kumta ka bor jong me kan long .

en: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment .
kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha , um dei ban leit phai pat sha ïing na ka bynta ka jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba uta uba don ha lyngkha un phaidien shuh shuh na ka bynta ban shim ia ka jain jong u .

en: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .
kha: Bun ki nongsakhi ki la shu sakhi lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu , hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki kim ïahap satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiba bun ki sakhi lamler pyrshah ia u , hynrei ka jingphla jong ki kam iahap lang .

en: Who will have all men to be saved , and to come unto the knowledge of the truth .
kha: Kane ka long kaba bha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi , namar u kwah ba uwei pa uwei un ïohlait im bad ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba don ki briew baroh ban ioh jingpynim , bad ban wan sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .

en: Abraham saith unto him , They have Moses and the prophets  ; let them hear them .
kha: U Abraham u la ong , ‘ Ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki don u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ; ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki dei ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ki ong .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u ong ha u , Ki don u Moses bad ki nongiathuhlypa ; ai ba kin iohsngew ia ki .

en: Lo , their good is not in their hand : the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
kha: Ki ong ba ki ïoh jingjop da ka bor jong ki hi , hynrei ïa ka rukom jingpyrkhat jong ki , ngam lah ban pdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , ka jingbha jong ki kam don ha ka kti jong ki: ka jingai jingmut jong kiba sniew ka long kaba jngai na nga .

en: And Moses let his father in law depart  ; and he went his way into his own land .
kha: Nangta u Moses u khublei ïakhlad bad u Jethro , bad u Jethro u leit phai pat sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iehnoh ia u kpa jong u ha ka ain bad u la leit sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: The  Lord  is King for ever and ever : the heathen are perished out of his land .
kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom la junom . Kito kiba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei kin jah noh na ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long u Syiem junom: ki nongwei ki jah noh na ka ri jong u .

en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .
kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shong ha ka jingstad briew , hynrei , ha ka bor U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingngeit jong phi kan ym ieng ha ka jingstad jong ki briew , hynrei ha ka bor U Blei .

en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .
kha: Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei ban pyndonkam da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim ia ka ksiar, bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw bad ka rong saw bad ka rong saw .

en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the  Lord  ? who can shew forth all his praise ?
kha: Mano ba lah ban ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh ? Mano ba lah ban ïaroh ïa u kumba dei biang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban pynpaw ia ki kam kiba khraw jong U Trai ? mano ba lah ban pyni ia ka jingiaroh jong u baroh ?

en: We give thanks to God always for you all , making mention of you in our prayers ;
kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi baroh bad ngi ïai kynmaw ïa phi borabor ha ki jingduwai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ainguh ia U Blei man ka por na ka bynta jong phi baroh , da kaba kdew ia phi ha ki jingduwai jong ngi ;

en: He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .
kha: U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ka ktien jong u , bad u la pynkoit ia ki , bad u la pyllait im ia ki na ki jingpynjot jong ki .

en: And he said , Thy brother came with subtilty , and hath taken away thy blessing .
kha: U Isaak u jubab ,  U para jong me u la wan bad shukor ïa nga . U la shim noh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , U hynmen jong me u la wan ryngkat bad ka jinglong rit paid , bad u la shim noh ia ka jingkyrkhu jong me .

en: My son , let not them depart from thine eyes : keep sound wisdom and discretion :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , batskhem ïa la ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh . Wat shah lano lano ba kin lait noh na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat ai ba kin leit noh na ki khmat jong me: to buh ia ka jingstad bad ka jingstad:

en: How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
kha: Bad ngi dih ïa ka jingbymman la kum ba ka dei ka um ; ho-oid , ngi long kiba bamsap ; ngim dondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka kham sngewsih bad kham jakhlia u briew uba dih ia ka jingbymhok kum ka um ?

en: We have an altar , whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ki jaka mane blei jong ki Jiw kim don hok ban bam na kano kano ka jingkñia ïa kaba la buh halor ka duwan jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi don ka almari , na kaba kim don hok ban bam kaba shakri ia ka Tabernak .

en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers : and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Hesekaïah u la ïap , bad u khun jong u , u Manasseh u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u: bad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son , saying ,
kha: U Dabid u la hukum ïa baroh ki nongïalam Israel ban ïarap ïa u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid ruh u la hukum ia ki rangbah Israel baroh ban iarap ia u Solomon u khun jong u da kaba ong:

en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,
kha: Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki long ka Siddim , ka Ser , ka Hammath , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong ki long u Ziddim, u Zer, bad u Hammath, u Rakath bad u Khrist , .

en: Whom I have sent again : thou therefore receive him , that is , mine own bowels :
kha: Nga phah pat sha me ïa u mynta , lem bad u ka long lem ka dohnud jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba nga la phah biang: me namarkata to pdiang ia u, kata ka long, ka kpoh jong nga hi:

en: We do not inherit the earth from our ancestors , we borrow it from our children .
kha: Ngi khlem iohpateng iakane ka pyrthei na ki mynbarim jongngi , ngi pankylliang na ki khun jongngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngim hiar pateng ia ka khyndew na ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ngi shim ram na ki khun jong ngi .

en: When they went from one nation to another , from one kingdom to another people  ;
kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki leit na kawei ka jaitbynriew sha kawei pat, na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ; .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u dohkha ban prie noh ïa u Jonah harud duriaw , bad u la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha ki dohkha , bad u la pynmih ia u Jonah ha ka ri kaba rkhiang .

en: But in vain they do worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
kha: Kam myntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ba ki hikai ïa ki rukom ki briew kumba ki dei ki hukum jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khlem da don ei ei ki mane ia nga, ki hikai ia ki jinghikai ia ki hukum jong ki briew .

en: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :
kha: Haba U Blei u rai hangno ba u slap un hap , bad ïa ka lynti ki lyoh ba pynlong pyrthat ;
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la leh ia ka hukum na ka bynta u slap , bad ka lynti na ka bynta ka jingshai jong u lyoh:

en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .
kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki neh haduh kane ka sngi namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bteng ia kane ka sngi katkum ki jingpynbeit jong me: namar baroh ki long ki shakri jong me .

en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land , and throw down all thy strong holds :
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ka ri jong phi bad pynpra ïa ki jingïada jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ot noh ia ki shnong jong ka ri jong me, bad ngan pynhap noh ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong me baroh:

en: By what way is the light parted , which scattereth the east wind upon the earth ?
kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ka jaka ha kaba ka sngi ka wan mih , lane sha ka jaka na kaba ka lyer mihngi ka beh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Da kumno ka jingshai ka la iakhlad noh , kaba pynphriang ia ka Iyer mihngi halor ka khyndew ?

en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .
kha: Lada phi bet ïa ki symbai ka jingbymhok , ka jingpynjot kan mih , bad ka jingbanbeiñ jong phi ïa kiwei kan kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba bet ia ka jingbymhok un kheit ia ka jingbymhok: bad u diengduh jong ka jingbitar jong u un jah noh .

en: The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
kha: Me don u ksuid hapoh jong me !  u paidbah u la jubab .  Mano ba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la jubab bad ki la ong: Me don u ksuid: uba leit ban pyniap ia me ?

en: But he , willing to justify himself , said unto Jesus , And who is my neighbour ?
kha: Hynrei u nonghikai ka Hukum u la kwah ban pynksan ïa lade , kumta u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Uei u paramarjan jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la mon ban pynshisha ia lade, u la ong ha U Jisu , Bad uei u paramarjan jong nga ?

en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .
kha: ( Hynrei u Dabid u la ïohknieh ïa ka kut Seïon jong ki , bad la tip kyrteng ïa ka kum ka  Nongbah u Dabid .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Dabid u la bat skhem ia ka Seion: kajuh ka long ka nongbah u Dabid .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , They have well spoken that which they have spoken .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Ki la kyrpad ïa kaba dei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ki la kren bha ia kata kaba ki la kren .

en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend  ; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful .
kha: U paralok u thmu ïa kaba bha , wat haba u pynmong ïa phi . Hynrei haba u nongshun u buh ïa ka ksang ti jong u halor ka tyrpeng jong phi — da husiar !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingmynsaw jong u paralok ; hynrei ki jingkyndit jong u nongshun ki long kiba thok .

en: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance :
kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ha me ngan ai ia ka ri Kanaan , ka bynta jong ka pateng jong phi:

en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .
kha: U syiem u phah shna ruh ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta jong ka la sop da ka bniat hati , bad ïa kaba sah jong ka la sop da ka ksiar kaba nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u syiem u la shna ia ka khet kaba khraw jong ka sniehdoh , bad u la tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
kha: Ha kata ka por , uwei u briew na ka jait Lebi u shongkurim ïa ka khun jong uwei u Lebi bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew uba na ka iing u Lebi u la leit shongkurim ia ka khun kynthei jong u Lebi .

en: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land .
kha: Haba la die ïa kano kano ka khyndew , ïa ka hok jong u trai khyndew ban thied pat ïa ka dei ban ithuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka ri baroh kawei jong phi phin ai ka jingpynim ia ka ri .

en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .
kha: Hynrei u briew uba donburom u lehhok bad u ïeng skhem na ka bynta kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u bym laitluid un ieng ia kiei kiei kiba laitluid bad da kiei kiei kiba laitluid un ieng .

en: When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .
kha: Ka pop bad ka jinglehrain ki ïaid lang . Pynjah noh ïa ka burom jong phi , bad phin ïoh ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ ha ka jaka jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u bymman u wan , te u wan ruh da ka jingleh bein , bad da ka jingshah lehbein .

en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
kha: Nga kwah ban don u ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong nga , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paralok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: O ba u briew u lah ban kyrpad ia u briew bad U Blei kumba u briew u kyrpad ia u paramarjan jong u !

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .
kha: Mynta , nga thung ïa me u lat halor ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph: Peit nga la buh ia me ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: In the first chariot were red horses  ; and in the second chariot black horses  ;
kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom kaba nyngkong la tan da ki kulai rong saw , ïa kaba ar da ki kulai rong ïong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kali kaba nyngkong ki don ki kulai kiba saw ; bad ha ka kali kaba ar ki kulai kiba lieh ; .

en: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways  ; and the  Lord  was with him .
kha: U Dabid u ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka thma bad u jop ha kat kaba u leh , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leh da ka jingstad ha ki lynti jong u baroh; bad U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u .

en: The word of the  Lord  which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ki hima , da kaba sdang na ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa pyrshah ia ki Jutang ; .

en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
kha: Shibun ki briew , ki ban kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad kin shukor ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar bun kin wan ha ka kyrteng jong nga, ki da ong, Nga long U Khrist ; bad ngan shukor ia kiba bun .

en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary , and the young men shall utterly fall :
kha: Wat kito kiba dang samla ki sngewtlot ; ki rangsamla ki lah ban kyllon ha ka jingthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ki samla ruh kin sa lyngngoh bad kin sa thait , bad ki samla kin hap noh shibun:

en: My son , walk not thou in the way with them  ; refrain thy foot from their path :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat ïashang bad ki briew kiba kum kita . Kiar na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, wat iaid ha ka lynti bad ki ; kiar na ka lynti jong ki:

en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jong u ; da ka jingthaba ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia ki khnam shabar, bad u la pynphriang ia ki ; u la pynsngewsih ia ki .

en: And he left them , and went out of the city into Bethany  ; and he lodged there .
kha: U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la mihnoh na ka nongbah sha Bethania , ha kaba u la pynlut ïa ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iehnoh ia ki bad u la mih na ka shnong sha Bethania bad u la sah hangta .

en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :
kha: Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew uba kyrduh , leh ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jong phi un ym tip shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba me leh ia ki alm , wat ai ba ka kti kadiang jong me kan tip ia kaei kaba ka kti kadiang jong me ka leh:

en: They are as stubble before the wind , and as chaff that the storm carrieth away .
kha: bad ban pyrsad noh ïa ki kum ïa ki phlangïap ha ka lyer , lane kum ïa u pui pui ba la rah noh ha ka  erïong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kum ki dieng ha khmat ka Iyer , bad kum ki bniat ba ka eriong ka rah noh .

en: They that make them are like unto them  ; so is every one that trusteth in them .
kha: Ai ba kito baroh kiba thaw ïa ki bad kiba shaniah ha ki kin long kum ki bleithaw kiba ki la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba pynlong ia ki ki long kum ma ki ; kumjuh ruh uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha ki .

en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
kha: Ka spah kan ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïashem ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki spah kim ioh jingmyntoi ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar: hynrei ka hok ka pyllait na ka jingiap .

en: Let them curse it that curse the day , who are ready to raise up their mourning .
kha: Ong ïa ki nongkren byrtong ban tim ïa kata ka sngi , Kito kiba tip kumno ban bat ïa u Lebiathan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin tim ia ka kaba tim ia ka sngi , kiba kloi ban pynmih ia ka jingsngewsih jong ki .

en: Behold , all ye yourselves have seen it  ; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?
kha: Hynrei em , ha ka jingshisha , phi la ïohi hi da lade ; te kumta balei ba phi kren ïa kum kata ka jingkren bieit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , baroh phi hi phi la iohi ia ka ; balei te phi long kumta baroh kawei ?

en: Then the disciples took him by night , and let him down by the wall in a basket .
kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka miet ki nongbud jong u Saul ki la ïalam ïa u bad ki la pynhiar sha tbian ïa u lyngba ka thliew ha ka kynroh , da kaba pynhiar ïa u ha ka shang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shim ia u ha ka por miet , bad ki la pynhap ia u da ka jingkhang ha ka basket .

en: In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .
kha: To trei minot bad phin pahuh ha ka jingim ; lada phi shu bunktien phin ïoh long kiba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingtrei baroh ka don ka jingmyntoi: hynrei ka jingiakren jong ki rmiang shyntur ka long tang ka jingpynbeit .

en: And , lo , while she yet talked with the king , Nathan the prophet also came in .
kha: Katba ka dang kren kumta bad u syiem , u Nathan u wan poi ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha ka por ba ka dang iakren bad u syiem, u Nathan u nongiathuhlypa ruh u la wan rung .

en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
kha: Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , ngan iap ha ka bniat jong nga , bad ngan pynbun ia ki sngi jong nga kum ka dewbilat .

en: Canst thou send lightnings , that they may go , and say unto thee , Here we are ?
kha: Bad lada me hukum ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ; hato kan wan sha me bad ong ,  Nga kloi ban leh ei ei  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban phah ia ki jingshai, ba kin leit bad kin ong ha me , Hangne ngi don ?

en: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
kha: U tdong jong u , u ïeng kum u dieng Kedar ; ki ksah ha ki khohwah jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkhih ia ka tdong jong u kum u sohjew: ki shyieng jong ki maw jong u ki ia tyngkhuh lang .

en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar bad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia uta uba tei ia ka shnong da ka snam , bad u pynskhem ia ka shnong da ka jingbymhok !

en: Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .
kha: To kynmaw , ko  Trai  , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To khmih ïa ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjahburom jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ko Trai, kaei kaba wan ha ngi: pyrkhat , bad ha khmih ka jingshah lehbein jong ngi .

en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?
kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh mynta me pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia ki briew jong nga , ba men ym pyllait ia ki ?

en: When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .
kha: Ki snem jong nga ki la nang ïaid mynta , bad nga ïaid ha ka lynti bym lah phai dien shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la poi katto katne snem , te ngan leit noh sha ka lynti na kaba ngan ym wan phai shuh .

en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :
kha: Nangta baroh ki jingjynjar jong me kin shu jah noh na ki jingkynmaw jong me , kum ki jingshlei um kiba la ïaid lait noh bad ym don jingkynmaw shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me klet noh ia ka jingjynjar jong me, bad kynmaw ia ka kum ki um kiba iaid noh:

en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .
kha: U Beraïah u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Heber bad u Malkhiel . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa ka nongbah Birsaith . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Beriah ; Heber bad u Malchiel uba long u kpa jong u Birzavith .

en: This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingjop jong U  Trai  ; to ngin ïakmen , to ngin ïalehkmen !
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi kaba U Trai u la pynlong; ngin ia kmen bad sngewbha ha ka .

en: He hath taken a bag of money with him , and will come home at the day appointed .
kha: U la rah shi pla ka tyngka bad u bad un ym wan phai kumba ar taïew ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pla pisa bad u , bad un wan phai noh sha la iing ha ka sngi ba la buh .

en: And he taught them many things by parables , and said unto them in his doctrine ,
kha: U la pyndonkam da ki pharshi ban hikai shibun kiei kiei ïa ki , da kaba ong ha ki :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hikai ia ki shibun kiei kiei da ki pharshi bad u la ong ha ki ha ka jinghikai jong u .

en: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart , and the year of my redeemed is come .
kha: Nga la kut jingmut ba ka por ban pynim ïa ki briew jong nga ka la wan ; ka la dei ka por ban pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sngi jong ka jingsiew kylliang ka don ha ka dohnud jong nga , bad ka snem jong ka jingsiew kylliang jong nga ka la wan .

en: Then the devil leaveth him , and , behold , angels came and ministered unto him .
kha: Nangta u Soitan u la iehnoh ïa U Jisu ; bad ki angel ki la ïawan bad ki la ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ksuid u la iehnoh ia u, bad, ha khmih, ki angel ki la wan bad ki la shakri ia u .

en: But to the land whereunto they desire to return , thither shall they not return .
kha: Men thrang ban ïohi ïa kane ka ri sa shisien pat , hynrei men ym ïoh wan phai shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei sha ka ri kaba ki kwah ban leit phai noh , ha kata ka jaka kin ym wan phai shuh .

en: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time  ; for it is an evil time .
kha: Bad kumta , kaba sngap jar ha kum kita ki por kiba sniew ka long kaba sian ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u riewstad un sngap jar ha kata ka por ; namar ka long ka por kaba sniew .

en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?
kha: Kam don jingbha ban thaw ïa ka dur nar ban mane kum u blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la thaw ia u blei , ne ban pynkhih ia ka dur ba la ker sawdong kaba myntoi na ka bynta kaei kaei ?

en: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said ,  Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ,  Balei phi ïa-pyrkhat ïa kine kiei kiei kiba sniew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ki u la ong , Balei phi pyrkhat sniew ha ki dohnud jong phi ?

en: But flesh with the life thereof , which is the blood thereof , shall ye not eat .
kha: Kawei kaba phim dei ban bam ka long ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka ; nga khang pyrshah ïa kane namar ba ka jingim ka don ha ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh bad ka jingim jong ka , kaba long ka snam jong ka , phin ym bam .

en: A false balance is abomination to the  Lord  : but a just weight is his delight .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur thok . U sngewbha ha ki jingthew kiba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingïahap kaba bakla ka long kaba sngewsih ïa U Trai: hynrei ka jingkhia kaba hok ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u .

en: The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .
kha: Ki briew kiba pop ki ïaid ka lynti kyllaiñ ; hynrei kiba lui lui ki ïaid ha kaba beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong u briew ka long kaba jylliew bad kaba phylla: hynrei katba ia kaba khuid, ka kam jong u ka long kaba dei .

en: What time she lifteth up herself on high , she scorneth the horse and his rider .
kha: Hynrei haba ka sdang ban mareh , ka lah ban rkhiebeiñ ïa uno uno u kulai bad u nongshong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka por ba ka kiew ia lade sha jrong , ka sngewsih ia u kulai bad u nongshong kulai jong u .

en: But the Pharisees said , He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils .
kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi ki la ong ,  U dei u rangbah jong ki ksuid uba ai ha u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi ki la ong , U beh noh ia ki ksuid lyngba u syiem jong ki ksuid .

en: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .
kha: U Blei u phah ïa u slap ban ai um ïa ka khyndew ; u lah ban phah ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , lane ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ka ban wan , la ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit , ne na ka bynta ka ri jong u , ne na ka bynta ka jingisynei .

en: I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .
kha: Nga ong ïa me , to ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to leit noh sha ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ha me, To khie bad shim ia ka jingthiah jong me bad leit shapoh iing jong me .

en: And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .
kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u la shem bun ki briew kiba la ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ia kren bad u, u la rung shapoh bad u la shem ia kiba bun kiba la iawan lang .

en: But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .
kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïai ban haduh ba u Dabid ha kaba khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Absalom u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba ïabiang ïa u syiem
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Absalom u la pynbor ia u , ba u la pyllait noh ia u Amnon bad ki khun syiem baroh ban leit ryngkat bad u .

en: For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .
kha: Ngam leh ïa kaba bha kaba nga kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingbha kaba nga kwah: hynrei ka jingsniew kaba ngam kwah , ba nga leh .

en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .
kha: Phin hap prie noh ïa kaba phi la bam , bad baroh ki ktien pynroh jong phi kin sep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam kaba me la bam kan sa sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban bam

en: And Menahem slept with his fathers  ; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap bad la tep , bad u Pekahaïah u khun shynrang jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Menahem u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u ; bad u Pekaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha khyndew bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong nga ha ki mawria .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynpra ruh ia ki bniat jong nga da ki maw maw , u la tap ia nga da ka dewbilat .

en: Does not your heart yearn for the peace , happiness , and prosperity seen there ?
kha: Hato ka mynsiem jong phi ka kwah ne em ïa ka jingsuk lane ka jingkmen bad ka jingpahuh pahai kumba phi ïohi hangtei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka dohnud jong phi kam kwah eh ia ka jingsuk , jingkmen bad ka jingroi jingpar kaba la iohi hangta ?

en: And the sons of his brother Helem  ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .
kha: U Hotham u para jong u , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Sophah , u Imna , u Shelesh , bad u Amal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u hynmen jong u u Helem ; u Sopah, bad u Imna, bad u Shelesh bad u Amal .

en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
kha: Shibun ki briew , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long u Messaïah !’ bad kin shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar bun kin wan ha ka kyrteng jong nga, ki da ong, Nga long U Khrist ; bad ngan shukor ia kiba bun .

en: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .
kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban kylla ri khlaw mluh namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri kaba seisoh ha ka jingbym lah kha khun , namar ka jingsniew jong kita kiba shong hangta .

en: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee .
kha: ‘ Kynmaw ban rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton , kumba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To buh ia ka sngi Sabha ban pynkyntang ia ka , kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me .

en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phoenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .
kha: Hangta ngi la shem ïa ka lieng kaba thmu ban leit sha Phoenisia , kumta ngi la ïakiew ha ka bad ngi la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la shem ia ka lieng kaba iaid sha Phoenisia , ngi la leit sha ka lieng bad ngi la leit noh .

en: The simple believeth every word : but the prudent man looketh well to his going .
kha: Uba bieit un ngeit ïa kaei kaei baroh ; ki briew kiba sian ki da khmih ïa la ka jingjam .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba suk u ngeit ia kawei pa kawei ka ktien: hynrei u briew uba stad u peit bha ia ka jingleit jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Aïu me bat ha la ka kti ?   U diengduh ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Kaei kata ha ka kti jong me ? Bad u la ong: U dieng .

en: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :
kha: Nangta khie leit bad shim ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha bad pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wanrah ia u khun masi ba la tyrkhong, bad pyniap ia u ; bad to ngin ia bam, bad to ia sngewbha:

en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi , u la shem ba la lah tep ïa u Lasaros saw sngi mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta haba U Jisu u la wan , u la shem ba u la thiah ha ka jingtep saw sngi mynta .

en: They make the king glad with their wickedness , and the princes with their lies .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ki shukor ïa u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u da ki buit bymman jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynsngewbha ia u syiem da ka jingsniew jong ki , bad ki syiem da ki jinglamler jong ki .

en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks  ; and his eye seeth every precious thing .
kha: Katba ki sam thliew lyngba ïa ki mawsiang , Ki shem ïa ki mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: U ot ia ki wah hapdeng ki maw ; bad ka khmat jong u ka iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba kordor .

en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree , and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .
kha: Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jinglong jong me ka long kum u dieng sohjew , bad ki bniat jong me ha ki kynhun sohjew .

en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .
kha: Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Jason bad ïa kiwei pat ban siew ïa ka pisa kaba donkam ban ïohlait , bad nangta ki la pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la shim ia ka jingshngain jong u Jason bad na kiwei pat ki la pyllait noh ia ki .

en: Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?
kha: U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi baroh khat-ar ngut ? Pynban uwei na phi u long u ksuid !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki: Hato ngam shym la jied ia phi shiphew ngut bad uwei na phi u long u ksuid ?

en: He croucheth , and humbleth himself , that the poor may fall by his strong ones .
kha: Ki lanot ki bym ïoh jingïarap ki dem ha ka jinglwet ; ka jingkhlaiñ ba thombor ka la jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U sngap jar bad u pynrit mynsiem ia lade, ba kiba duk kin hap da kiba khlain jong u .

en: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :
kha: Baroh kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei ka jia ha ka por kaba U Blei u jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka don ka aiom , bad ka por ha kawei pa kawei ka jingthmu hapoh ka bneng:

en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine : but a broken spirit drieth the bones .
kha: Kaba dap da ka jingkmen ka pynlong ïa phi ban shait ban khlaiñ . Ban sngewdiaw man ka por ka long ka jingïap suki pa suki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud kaba sngewbha ka leh bha kum ka dawai: hynrei ka mynsiem kaba la tyrkhong ka tyrkhong ia ki shyieng .

en: But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .
kha: U ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah uba shi para bad u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u la pyrshah ia ki Israel , u Jonathan u hynmen u Shimea u la pyniap ia u .

en: Surely there is a vein for the silver , and a place for gold where they fine it .
kha: Ki don ki par ha kaba la tih ïa ka rupa ; Ki don ki jaka ha kiba la saiñ ïa ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka don ka snam na ka bynta ka rupa , bad ka jaka na ka bynta ka ksiar ha kaba ki dain kuna ia ka .

en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth , and forgetteth the covenant of her God .
kha: kaba iehnoh ïa la u jong u tnga bad klet ïa la ka jutang kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba iehnoh ia ka jingpyniaid ia ka jinglong samla jong ka , bad ka klet noh ia ka jutang U Blei jong ka .

en: But last of all he sent unto them his son , saying , They will reverence my son .
kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki . ‘ Da shisha kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khatduh eh u la phah ia la u khun ha ki, u da ong: Kin burom ia u khun jong nga .

en: Some remove the landmarks  ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .
kha: Ki briew ki pynkynriah ïa ki mawpud ban kurup jaka shuh ; ki tuh ïa ki langbrot bad buh ïa ki ha la ki jong ki kynhun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba weng noh ia ki dak ki shin ki shim noh da kaba shyrkhei ia ki kynhun , bad ki ai bam ia ki .

en: Son of man , put forth a riddle , and speak a parable unto the house of Israel  ;
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ka pharshi ha ki Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , u la buh ia ka jingkylli bad u kren ia ka jingiasyriem ha ka iing Israel ; .

en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali  ; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
kha: U Ahimaas , uba shongkurim ïa ka Basemath , kawei pat na ki khun kynthei jong u Solomon : ka ri Naphtali
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahimaaz u la don ha Naphtali ; u la shim ruh ia ka khun jong u Solomon sha ka tnga:

en: Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’
kha: Jarkatta don kiba ong : ‘ Ym u briew u don ka mynsiem ka ba iaid lait na ka jingiap ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don kiba lah ban kylli:  Hato ki briew kim don ka mynsiem bym lah iap kaba im na ka jingiap ?

en: A time to get , and a time to lose  ; a time to keep , and a time to cast away  ;
kha: U buh ka por ban shem bad ka por ban jah , ka por ban kynshew bad ka por ban bret noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban ioh , bad ka por ban duh ia ka por ban buh , bad ka por ban bret noh ia ka ; .

en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .
kha: Balei ba u briew uba jaipdeh um ju mih na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u sheptieng ? Ïa ki sing ?
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew u ong , Ka don u sing ha ka lynti ; u sing u don ha ki surok .

en: And after him arose Jair , a Gileadite , and judged Israel twenty and two years .
kha: Hadien u Tola , la wan u Jair uba na Gilead . U la ïalam ïa ki Israel haduh arphew ar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u la mih u Jair, u Gilead bad u la bishar ia ki Israel arphew ar snem .

en: But that time the authorities didnt pay any heed to the issue , the locals said .
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka por ki bor synshar kim shym la shimkhia ia katei ka mat , la ong ki nongshong shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kata ka por ki bor synshar kim shym la pyrkhat ei ei ia ka mat , la ong ki nongshong shnong .

en: And after all this the  Lord  smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease .
