kha: Nangta hadien kane baroh , U  Trai  u pynngat ha u syiem da ka jingpang kaba jur ha ki snier .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kine baroh U Trai u la sdang ia u ha ki bniat jong u da ka jingpang kaba ym lah ban pynkoit .

en: O come , let us worship and bow down : let us kneel before the  Lord  our maker .
kha: Ale , to ngin ïadem ngon bad mane ïa u ; to ngin ïadem khohsiew ha khmat U  Trai  , U Nongthaw jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: O to wan, to ngin mane bad dem khrup: to ngin dem khrup ha khmat U Trai nongthaw jong ngi .

en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .
kha: Ka bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka pop jong une u briew , bad ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng kan pynpaw ia ka jingbymhok jong u ; bad ka khyndew kan kiew pyrshah ia u .

en: More cameras would be set up than had filmed the last presidential inauguration .
kha: Yn buh kham bun ki camera ban ia kaba la ring dur ia ka jingpynskhem president kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn buh kham bun ki camera ban ia kaba la ring dur ia ka jingplie kaba khatduh .

en: However , Indrani never gave him Sheena ' s contact details , he told the court .
kha: Hynrei u Indrani um shym la ai satia ïa ki jingtip ba ïadei bad ka Sheena , u la ïathuh ha ka ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Indrani um ju ai ia u ia ki jingtip ba bniah jong ka Sheena , u la iathuh ha ka iingbishar .

en: Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .
kha: Em , ha kine baroh ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop baroh lyngba jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!
translated_en_to_kha: Em, ha kine kiei kiei baroh ngi long kham palat ban ia ki nongjop lyngba jong u uba la ieit ia ngi .

en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro ? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble ?
kha: Hato me pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga ? Ngam long ei ei hynrei tang ka sla dieng ; me wan tur ïaleh ïa i shi lyngkhot u phlang ba-tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me pynpra ia ka sla kaba la pynkhih sha ka kpoh ? bad me bud ia u sboh uba rkhiang ?

en: I spent most of my time on the streets , stealing and then selling what I stole .
kha: Nga pynlut ia ka por kaba bun ha ki surok , nga tuh bad nangta nga die ia kaei kaba nga tuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlut bun ka por jong nga ha ki surok , nga tuh bad nangta nga die ia kaei kaba nga la tuh .

en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh , ki la pynphriang ia ka nam jong u ha kata ka ri baroh kawei .

en: Surely I am more brutish than any man , and have not the understanding of a man .
kha: Nga kham long kum u mrad ban kum u briew ; ngam don ka jingshemphang kumba u briew u dei ban don .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga kham sniew ban ia uno uno u briew , bad ngam don ka jingsngewthuh ia u briew .

en: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka ïaid kum ka lieng kaba stet tam , kum ka jingstet u pukni uba suh kynsan shapoh ban kynrup ïa ka rabbit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jah noh kum ki lieng kiba stet: kum u blang uba kyrkieh sha ka jingbam .

en: Some of them , such as Joseph and Moses , are referred to in Hebrews chapter 11 .
kha: Katto katne na ki kum u Joseph bad u Moses la kdew ha ki Hebru lynnong 11 .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne na ki kum u Joseph bad u Moses la kdew ha ki Hebru lynnong 11 .

en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .
kha: don tang uwei U Blei uba long U Kpa jong u bynriew baroh , uba long U Trai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei kiei baroh , bad u long ha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei U Blei bad U Kpa jong baroh , uba don halor jong phi baroh .

en: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
kha: Bad kumno shaphang ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki hynriew tylli ki kpu jong ki saw hajar ngut bad katno tylli ki basket phi la shim ?

en: Simeon and Levi are brethren  ; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations .
kha: U Simeon bad u Lebi ki ïalong shi para . Ki pyndonkam ïa la ki atiar ban thombor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simeon bad u Lebi ki long ki tiar kiba sniew ki don ha ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ki .

en: He that eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , dwelleth in me , and I in him .
kha: Kito kiba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad ba dih ïa ka snam jong nga ki ïaisah ha nga , bad ma nga ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba bam ia ka doh jong nga bad uba dih ia ka snam jong nga , u shong ha nga bad nga ha u .

en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .
kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki jingïatainia ba-bieit bad ba khlem jingmut ; me tip ba ki kut ha ka jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jingkylli kiba bieit bad ki bym nang kiar na ka jingtip ba ki leh ia ki jingialeh pyrshah ia ki shynrang bad kynthei .

en: And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .
kha: Ïa kane baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , ba ngan long u nongiashim bynta bad phi .

en: The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei , hynrei U Blei da lade hi u ai ïa ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka lot la bret ha ka tyrpeng ; hynrei ka jingpynkylla ia ka baroh kawei ka long jong U Trai .

en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee :
kha: Haba phi shong bam bad u briew uba donburom , da buh jingmut ba u long uei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me shong bad u nongsynshar , pyrkhat da kaba pyrkhat ia kaei kaba don ha khmat jong me:

en: And said unto me , Thou art my servant , O Israel , in whom I will be glorified .
kha: U la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Israel , me long u shakri jong nga ; namar jong me , ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Me long u shakri jong nga ko Israel ha uba ngan shah pyndonburom .

en: So , addressing the corpse , he commanded : “Young man , I say to you , Get up !”
kha: U la ong ia u ta u ba la iap , “Ko samla nga ong ha me , to ïeng joit !”
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta , da kaba pynbeit ia ka met iap, u la hukum:  Samla , nga ong ia phi , Khie !

en: And he that taketh not his cross , and followeth after me , is not worthy of me .
kha: Uno uno u bym shim ïa la ka diengphna bad bud ha dien jat jong nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u bym shim ia ka diengphna jong u bad uba bud ia nga , um long uba bit ia nga .

en: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul was come in very deed .
kha: u phah ïa ki nongsyntiat , bad u shem ba u Saul u la wan shisha hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah ia ki nongleit jingleit , bad u la sngewthuh ba u Saul u la wan ha ka kam kaba shisha .

en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years : and Terah died in Haran .
kha: U Terah u la ïap hangta ha ka rta kaba arspah san snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi u Tarah ki long arspah san snem: bad u Tarah u la iap ha Haran .

en: Because the law worketh wrath : for where no law is , there is no transgression .
kha: Ka Hukum ka pynjem ïa ka jingbitar U Blei ; hynrei hangno hangno ka ha bym don ka Hukum , ym don ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka hukum ka trei: namar ha kaba ym don ain , ym don ka jingpynkhein .

en: If you’re unable to access the refund, let us know, and we’ll assist you further.
kha: Lada phim lah ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynphai pisa, pyntip ïa ngi, bad ngin ïarap ïa phi shuh shuh.
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim lah ban ioh ia ka jingpynphai pisa, to pyntip ia ngi, bad ngin iarap shuh shuh ia phi.

en: Sarah Joseph ' s literary career began very early , when she was in high school .
kha: Ka kam thoh ka tar jong ka Sarah Joseph ka la sdang naduh mynnyngkong bha , ha ka por ba ka dang pule ha skul heh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kam thoh kot jong u Sarah Joseph ka la sdang kloi bha , haba ka dang pule ha ka skul heh .

en: Render unto them a recompence , O  Lord  , according to the work of their hands .
kha: To pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh , A  Trai  ;
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ki ia ka jingsiew kylliang , ko Trai , kat kum ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong ki .

en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord , I die daily .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , nga ïakynduh ïa ka jingïap man la ka sngi! Ka jingsngew sarong kaba nga don ha phi , ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , ka pynlong ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pyrshah da ka jingkmen jong phi kaba nga don ha U Khrist Jisu U Trai jong ngi , nga iap man ka sngi .

en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me , and mine ear received a little thereof .
kha: Shisien ka khubor ka wan jar jar , kaba jar jar eh ba ngam da ïohsngew bha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la wanrah ia kaei kaei ha nga , bad ka shkor jong nga ka la ioh khyndiat na ka .

en: There is the occasional dispute between a couple as pecking order is reaffirmed .
kha: Ka don ka jingïakynad teng teng hapdeng ki arngut katba la pynskhem biang ïa ka jingpynbeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingialeh teng teng hapdeng ka tnga bad ka tnga namar la pynskhem biang ia ka order .

en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good : her candle goeth not out by night .
kha: Ka tip ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei kiba ka thaw , bad ka trei haduh ynda miet bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngewthuh ba ki mar jong ka ki long kiba bha: ka sharak jong ka kam ju mih miet .

en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief , that he might have mercy upon all .
kha: Naba U Blei u la pynlong ïa baroh ki briew , ki koidi jong ka jingbymkohnguh , khnang ba un lah ban pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u la pynkut noh ia ki baroh ha ka jingbymngeit , ba un sngewsynei ia baroh .

en: So the  Lord  saved Israel that day : and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven .
kha: ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti shaduh palat ka Bethaben . U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la pynim ia ki Israel ha kata ka sngi: bad ka thma ka la iaid sha Betheshan .

en: We’ve processed your refund, and the amount will reflect in your account shortly.
kha: Ngi la pyndep ïa ka jingpynphai pisa jong phi, bad ka pisa kan sa paw ha ka account jong phi shen.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la pyntreikam ia ka jingpynphai biang jong phi, bad ka pisa kan paw ha ka account jong phi tang khyndiat por.

en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .
kha: Haba phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kren ia ka jingshisha u pynpaw ia ka hok: hynrei ka jingleh thok kaba bakla .

en: Further , the GST rates on such vehicles have been lowered from 12 to 5 percent .
kha: Shuh shuh la pynhiar ia ka dor GST ha kum kine ki kali na ka 12 sha ka 5 percent .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh , la pynduna ia ka dor GST ha kum kine ki kali na ka 12 haduh 5 percent .

en: All ye beasts of the field , come to devour , yea , all ye beasts in the forest .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa ki ri nongwei ban wan kum ki mradkhlaw bad bam duh ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki mrad khlaw , to wan bam ja miet , hooid , phi ki mrad khlaw baroh .

en: Even us , whom he hath called , not of the Jews only , but also of the Gentiles ?
kha: Naba ngi long ki briew kiba u la khot , ym tang napdeng ki Jiw hynrei napdeng ki Jentil ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia ngi ruh kiba u la khot ym tang na ki Jiw hynrei na ki Jutang ruh ?

en: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .
kha: Ban im slem ka long ka bainong jong kiba hok ; u ñiuhlieh u long ka pansngiat badonburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh kaba jrong ka long ka khlieh jong ka burom , lada la shem ia ka ha ka lynti jong ka hok .

en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïaineh bad uba hok ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kam jong ki kti jong u ki long kiba shisha bad ka jingbishar ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long kiba thikna .

en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction , and openeth their ears in oppression .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew lyngba ki jingshah shitom , bad u pyndonkam ïa ka jingjynjar ban plie ïa ki khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U pyllait im ia kiba duk ha ka jingjynjar jong u , bad u plie ia ki shkor jong ki ha ka jingshah pynshitom bein .

en: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .
kha: To wat duh noh ïa la ka jingshlur , te , namar ka wallam bad ka , ïa ka bainong kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynduh noh namarkata ia ka jingshaniah jong phi kaba don ka jingsiew kylliang kaba khraw .

en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing , and the breath of all mankind .
kha: Dei U Blei uba pynïaid ïa ka jingim jong ki jingthaw jong u ; ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei ka don hapoh ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kti jong u ka don ka mynsiem jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba im , bad ka jingsawa jong u khun bynriew baroh .

en: Suspicious activity detected. Your account is temporarily locked for your safety.
kha: La lap ïa ka jingleh kaba suba. Ka account jong ngi la khang shipor na ka bynta ka jingshngain jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtreikam kaba suba ba la lap. Ka account jong u ka la khang shipor na ka bynta ka jingshngain jong u.

en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .
kha: Pynbeit ïa la ki khun katba ki dang lung ban shah hikai . Lada phim leh kumta , phi ïarap ïa ki ban pynjot da ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia u khun jong me katba dang don ka jingkyrmen , bad wat ai ba ka mynsiem jong me kan lait na ka jingud jong u .

en: And the king said , Bring me a sword . And they brought a sword before the king .
kha: U la phah shim ka waitlam , bad haba la wanrah ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , To wanrah ia nga ia ka waitlam . Ki la wanrah ia ka waitlam ha khmat u syiem .

en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret .
kha: U briew uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher , te , u dei ban duwai khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingai ban batai ïa kaei kaba u kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ai ba uta uba kren da ka shyntur bym tip un duwai ba un lah ban batai .

en: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body , she did it for my burial .
kha: Kaei kaba ka la leh ka long ban theh ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih ha ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh ïa nga na ka bynta ban tep .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ka la theh ia kane ka umphniang ha ka met jong nga , ka la leh ia kata na ka bynta ka jingtep jong nga .

en: For when we were yet without strength , in due time Christ died for the ungodly .
kha: Namar mynba ngi dang long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta kiba bymman , ha ka por kaba U Blei u la jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ngi dang duna ka bor, ha ka por kaba biang U Khrist u la iap na ka bynta ki bym riewblei .

en: And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .
kha: ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Amorites bad ki nong Kanaan bad ki Girgash bad ki Jeruis .

en: Then I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a flying roll .
kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad ha kane ka por nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli kaba her ha ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la phai , bad nga la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong nga , bad nga la peit , bad ha khmih ka jingkylla kaba her .

en: We assure you that your issue is being handled as per our customer care policies.
kha: Ngi pynthikna ïa phi ba ïa ka jingeh jong phi la pynbeit katkum ki kyndon jong ngi ban sumar ïa ki nongthied.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi pynthikna ia phi ba ia ka jingeh jong phi la pyniaid katkum ki polisi sumar jong ngi.

en: Wherefore , brethren , covet to prophesy , and forbid not to speak with tongues .
kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , to ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan kwah hir hir ïa ka ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , hynrei wat adong ïa ka jingkren ha ki thylliej bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko para bangeit, to thrang ban iathuhlypa bad khang ban ym kren da ki thylliej .

en: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
kha: Ka jingïaroh ïa uba bieit kam long kaba dei , kum ka ïor ha ka por lyiur lane u slap ha ka aïom ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u slap ha ka por lyiur , bad kum u slap ha ka por tlang , kumta ka burom kam long kumba ka long kaba bieit .

en: And if this come to the governor s ears , we will persuade him , and secure you .
kha: Bad lada u lyngskor un ïohsngew ïa kane , ngin pynngeit ïa u ba phi long ki bymtip ei ei , bad phin ym don ei ei ban khuslai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada kane ka wan ha ki shkor jong u Lat , ngin pynsngewthuh ia u , bad ngin pynskhem ia phi .

en: And it came to pass after three days , that the officers went through the host  ;
kha: Hadien lai sngi , ki nongïalam ki leit kylleng ka jaka shong dara ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien lai sngi , ba ki ophisar ki la iaid lyngba ka host ; .

en: Chandrababu Naidu didn ' t utter a single word on bifurcation in state assembly .
kha: U Chandrababu Naidu um shym la kren wat tang kawei ruh ka ktien halor ka jingïapher ha ka dorbar jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: U Chandrababu Naidu um shym la kren tang kawei ka kyntien shaphang ka jingpynkylla ha ka dorbar jylla .

en: And when they found him not , they turned back again to Jerusalem , seeking him .
kha: Ki shym la shem ïa u , kumta ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem ban wad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kim lap ia u, ki la phai biang sha Jerusalem , ki wad ia u .

en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people .
kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa ka ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  ïoh ba u paidbah un khihwin .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la ong , Ym ha ka sngi bam , ioh ba kan don ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki briew .

en: All my inward friends abhorred me : and they whom I loved are turned against me .
kha: Ki paralok bajan tam jong nga ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; kito kiba nga ieit eh ki pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki paralok ba shapoh jong nga ki la sngewsih ia nga: bad kito kiba nga ieit ki kylla pyrshah ia nga .

en: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
kha: Nga la long kum u dieng uba ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki umjer .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tynrai jong nga ka la saphriang da ki um , bad ka dewbilat ka la thiah baroh shi miet ha ka tnat jong nga .

en: The first machine operator , Adam , did not treasure the life he had been given .
kha: U nongpyniaid mashin ba nyngkong eh u Adam um shym la khein kor ia ka jingim ba la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpyniaid mashin ba nyngkong eh , u Adam , um shym la buh kor ia ka jingim kaba la ai ia u .

en: He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
kha: Un ai burom ïa nga , namar un shim ïa kaei ba nga ong bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pyndonburom ia nga: namar un pdiang ia ka jong nga bad un pyni ia ka ha phi .

en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly  ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?
kha: kum kita ki briew kin shah pynjot ha ka shikhyllipmat . Hato phi sngewthuh ba ka jingjot kaba kumno kan lah ban jia na U Blei ne na u syiem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong ki kan kiew kynsan bad mano ba tip ia ka jingjot jong ki baroh arngut ?

en: Afterward he brought me to the gate , even the gate that looketh toward the east :
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba phai shaphang mihngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la wanrah ia nga sha ka khyrdop , wat ia ka khyrdop kaba peit shaphang mihngi:

en: Sing unto the  Lord  with thanksgiving  ; sing praise upon the harp unto our God :
kha: To rwai ki jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; tem ïa ki sur ha ka duitara ha U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ha U Trai da kaba ainguh ia ka jingrwai ha ka harp ha U Blei jong ngi:

en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away , and believed on Jesus .
kha: Kumta ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïasylla ban pynïap ïa u Lasaros ruh , namar na kaei kaba la jia ha u , bun ki Jiw ki la kyntait ïa ki bad ki la ngeit ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata namar jong u bun na ki Jiw ki la leit noh bad ki la ngeit ha U Jisu .

en: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .
kha: Ha shuwa ban thaw ïa ka pyrthei , u Ktien u la lah don lypa ; u la don bad U Blei , bad u long kumjuh kum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba sdang la don ka Ktien , bad ka Ktien ka la don bad U Blei , bad ka Ktien ka long U Blei .

en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered , lest they die .
kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew kyrteng ki long hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kin ym leit shapoh ban peit haba kiei kiei kiba khuid ki la tap , ioh kin iap .

en: When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .
kha: Lada phi ïakynduh ïa ki dkhot ka balang jong ngi , pyrshang ban tip kham bha ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi iakynduh ia ki dkhot jong ka balang jong ngi ha ka thain , pyrshang ban ithuh kham bha ia ki .

en: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face , and were sore afraid .
kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur , ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta ba ki la dem khrup la ki durkhmat sha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la dem khrup bad ki la tieng shibun .

en: Whereby , when ye read , ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ )
kha: ( Nga la thoh khyndiat shaphang kane , bad lada phi pule ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh , phi lah ban tip shaphang ka jingsngewthuh jong nga ïa ka jingmaïan U Khrist . )
translated_en_to_kha: Da kata, haba phi pule, phi lah ban sngewthuh ia ka jingtip jong nga ha ka jingmaham jong U Khrist )

en: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .
kha: Kum u lyoh uba mih bad u jah noh , u briew u ïap bad um wan phai shuh ; la klet noh da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym leit phai shuh sha la iing , lymne ka jaka jong u kan ym ithuh shuh ia u .

en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
kha: Kumta ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U Blei u la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga da kaba ai khun shynrang ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pun khun bad ka la kha khun shynrang ; bad ka la ong: U Blei u la weng noh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong nga:

en: But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
kha: Haba me khreh ka jingkhawai , khot sngewbha ïa kiba duk , kiba khrew , kiba dkoh , bad kiba matlah ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba me pynlong ia ka jingkhawai, khot ia kiba duk, kiba la tyrkhong, kiba lyngkhuid:

en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
kha: Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok un iohi ia ka, bad un sngewbha: bad ka jingbymhok baroh kan khang ia ka shyntur jong ka .

en: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
kha: Te u Petros bad uta uwei pat u synran ki la leit sha ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la leit noh bad uta uwei pat u synran bad u la poi sha ka jingtep .

en: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the  Lord .
kha: U Dabid u kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U  Trai  bad u leit , kumba u Gad u la ong ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit sha ka ktien u Gad , kaba u la kren ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights , he was afterward an hungred .
kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet khlem jingbam , U Jisu u la thngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la shah jingit sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , u la shah thngan hadien kata .

en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the  Lord  continually .
kha: U Aaron un sumar bad buh ryntih ïa kita ki sharak ha u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , bad un khmih ba kin meh man ka por ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynbeit ia ki sharak ha ka sharak kaba khuid ha khmat U Trai man ka por .

en: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones .
kha: kiba shim ïa ki khunlung jong pha bad lynthaw ïa ki ha u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha un long , uba shim bad u dait ia ki khun rit jong me pyrshah ia ki maw .

en: For as the body without the spirit is dead , so faith without works is dead also .
kha: Te kumta , kumba ka met khlem ka mynsiem ka long kaba ïap , kumta ruh ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long kaba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka met khlem ka mynsiem ka la iap, kumta ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ruh ka la iap .

en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
kha: U briew uba alhia u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynñiew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U sluggard u kham stad ha la ka jong ka jingmut ban ia hynriew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai daw .

en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac , Go from us  ; for thou art much mightier than we .
kha: Te u Abimelekh u ong ha u Isaak ,  To mihnoh na ka ri jong ngi . Me la kylla long uba kham khrawbor ban ïa kaba ngi long .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong ha u Isaak, To leit noh na ngi ; namar me kham khlain shibun ban ia ngi .

en: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys , in caves of the earth , and in the rocks .
kha: Ki la dei ban im ha ki krem , ha ki thliew ba la tih ha ki sharing jong ki riat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban shong ha ki kliar jong ki them , ha ki krem jong ka khyndew bad ha ki maw .

en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .
kha: Ka long kaba bieit ban sngewtynnat haba leh bymdei . Ki briew kiba stad ki sngewbha ha ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kum ka jingialehkai ia u bieit ban leh bakla: hynrei u briew uba sngewthuh u don ka jingstad .

en: So Michal let David down through a window : and he went , and fled , and escaped .
kha: Ka pynhiar ïa u na ka jingkhangïit , bad u phet ïap bad u lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Michal u la pynhap ia u Dabid lyngba ka jingkhang : bad u la leit noh bad u la phet noh .

en: And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .
kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phin kren shaphang jong nga , namar ba phi la don lem bad nga naduh kaba sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi ruh phin sa sakhi , namar phi la don ryngkat bad nga naduh kaba sdang .

en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .
kha: U la leit beit sha ki synagog u la sdang ban ïalap ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u la ialap ia U Khrist ha ki synagog , ba u long U Khun U Blei .

en: And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .
kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To da khmih bha ba men ym phah noh ïa u khun jong nga shata !
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong ha u: To sumar ba me wanrah biang ia u khun jong nga hangta .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba ngeit u don ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi , Uta uba ngeit ha nga u don ka jingim bymjukut .

en: Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance  ;
kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ha me ngan ai ia ka ri Kanaan , ka bhah jong phi ; .

en: A man s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .
kha: Ka jingsngewmeng kan wanrah ïa ka jinghap jong phi , hynrei lada phi long kiba sngewrit , yn burom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u sngew sarong un pynhiar dor ia u: hynrei ka burom kan pynskhem ia kiba pynrit mynsiem .

en: Lest ye should say , We have found out wisdom : God thrusteth him down , not man .
kha: Kumno phi lah ban kubur ba phi la shem ïa ka jingstad ? U Blei u dei u ban jubab ïa u Job , naba phim shym lah leh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin ong , Ngi la shem ia ka jingstad: U Blei u pynkhih ia u, ym u briew .

en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
kha: Phin sa long uba stad , bad ka jingtip jong phi kan ai jingkmen ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka jingstad ka rung ha ka dohnud jong me, bad ka jingtip ka long kaba sngewtynnad ia ka mynsiem jong me;

en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .
kha: Kata ka jia namar u la lehbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei bad um ju pyn-i jingsbun ïa ki kynthei ki bym don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynsniew ia ka sniehdoh kaba ym kha: bad um leh ei ei ia ka riewkynthei .

en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders , said ,
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki rangbah lyngdoh ki rkhie bein ia u , bad ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah ki la ong .

en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )
kha: Ki traishnong jong ka ki la phet sha Gittaim , ha kaba ki la shong la sah naduh kata ka por . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Beeroth ki la phet noh sha Gittaim , bad ki la long ki nongwan sah hangta haduh kane ka sngi . )

en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do , that we might work the works of God ?
kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ngi lah ban leh khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u: Ngi leh aiu ba ngin leh ia ki kam U Blei ?

en: And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .
kha: Lada um pyndep ïa kine ki kamram ha ka , u dei ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ka khlem da siew ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada um leh ia kine lai ngut ha ka , te kan leit noh khlem pisa .

en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and cleave to his wife  ;
kha: ‘ Bad na kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie bad ïaineh bad la ka tnga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ia la u kpa bad ka kmie bad un iasoh bad ka tnga jong u ; .

en: And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,
kha: ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai , bad ki jingbam ba bang na ka bynta ka umphniang ba thiang , .

en: And Pharaoh said , Go up , and bury thy father , according as he made thee swear .
kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Khie leit , tep ïa la u kpa , kumba phi la kular ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong, To kiew bad tep ia u kpa jong me kumba u la pynlong ia me ban smai .

en: He coveteth greedily all the day long : but the righteous giveth and spareth not .
kha: U briew uba hok , pat , u lah ban ai , bad ban ai kylluid .
translated_en_to_kha: U kwah sngewbha baroh shisngi: hynrei u hok u ai bad um pyllait .

en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness , Zion is a wilderness , Jerusalem a desolation .
kha: Ki nongbah bakyntang jong me ki long kum ka ri shyiap ; ka Jerusalem ka long ka jaka kynjah ba la pynjot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongbah bakhuid jong me ki long ka ri khlaw , ka ri khlaw ka long ka ri khlaw , ka Jerusalem ka long ka ri khlaw .

en: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him , and rent it in twelve pieces :
kha: U Ahijah u loit noh ïa ka jaiñkup thymmai kaba u phong , u kad ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahijah u la kem ia ka jain thymmai kaba don ha u, bad u la pynkhih ia ka ha ki shiphew tylli ki jain:

en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour .
kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum kaba la neh lai kynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta naduh ka kynta kaba hynriew ka la don ka jingdum ha ka ri baroh kawei haduh ka kynta kaba hynniew .

en: But if thou refuse to go forth , this is the word that the  Lord  hath shewed me :
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga ha ka jingïohipaw ïa kaei ka ban jia lada phi kyntait ban pyndem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me kyntait ban leit sha khmat, kane ka long ka ktien kaba U Trai u la pyni ia nga:

en: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El–paran , which is by the wilderness .
kha: bad ïa ki Hor ha ki lumbah jong ka Edom , bad ki thwet ïa ki haduh Elparan kaba harud ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Horite ha u lum jong ki, haduh Elparan, kaba don ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
kha: Namar ba kita ki nongpynkha khun ki sheptieng ïa U Blei , u ruh u pynmanbha ïa ki , bad u ai ha ki ba kin don la ki khun ki kti . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi bad ki nang khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia namar ba ki nongkha khun ki la tieng ia U Blei , ba u la shna ia ki iing .

en: They give drink to every beast of the field : the wild asses quench their thirst .
kha: Ki pynbiang um ïa ki mradkhlaw ; hangta ki kada khlaw ki pynjah ïa ka jingsliang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ai um ia uwei pa uwei u mrad lyngkha: ki blang khlaw ki pynsangeh ia ka jingthngan jong ki .

en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Israel bad u syiem Judah ki la leit sha Ramotgilead .

en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel  ; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,
kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel ! U la wan ïa ka ban ïarap ïa ki briew jong u bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai Blei jong ki Israel ; namar u la leit jngoh bad u la siewspah ia ki briew jong u , .

en: They shall bear thee up in their hands , lest thou dash thy foot against a stone .
kha: Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki , ban ri ïa me na ka jingjynthut jong ki kjat jong me ha ki maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin rah ia me ha ki kti jong ki , ioh ba me pynkhih ia ka kjat jong me ha u maw .

en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .
kha: da u lyoh jong ka jingbitar shla jong me uba rben katta katta ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi ban ksam lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la tap ia lade da u lyoh , ba ka jingduwai jong ngi kan ym iaid lyngba .

en: Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .
kha: To wan ha nga , phi baroh kiba thait na kaba kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia , bad ngan ai ha phi ka jingjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan sha nga, phi baroh kiba trei shitom bad kiba khia, bad ngan ai jingjahthait ia phi .

en: But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .
kha: Lada um leh kumta , un kit hi ïa la ka jingpynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada um sait ia ki, lymne um sait ia ka doh jong u ; te un kit ia ka jingbymhok jong u .

en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :
kha: u Adoniram u peit ïa kiba shah pyntrei jubor ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Adoram u la long halor ka jingsiew: bad u Jehoshaphat u khun u Ahlid u la long u nongthoh:

en: For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .
kha: Ngan pynkut mynta ïa ka bor jong ka Assyria halor jong phi bad ngan pyndkut ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mynta ngan pynpra ia ka lyngkhot jong u na me , bad ngan pynpra ia ki jingteh jong me ha ka dewbilat .

en: O Lord , what shall I say , when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies !
kha: Aïu nga lah ban ong , A  Trai  , mynta ba ki Israel ki la kynran dien na u nongshun ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , ngan ong aiu haba ki Israel ki phai noh ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki !

en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .
kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long :  U Syiem jong ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la thoh ia ka jingthoh lyngkot jong ka jingkynnoh jong u , KA JINGPYNBNA .

en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men  ; all these were men of valour .
kha: Khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai Benjamin kiba shlur ki la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la hap na u Benjamin shiphew hajar ngut ki briew baroh kine ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingshlur .

en: A fool hath no delight in understanding , but that his heart may discover itself .
kha: Uba bieit um suidñiew la u sngewthuh ne em ïa kano kano ; baroh kaba u kwah ban leh ka long ban pynpaw katno u long uba sian .
translated_en_to_kha: U bieit um don jingsngewbha ha ka jingsngewthuh , hynrei ba ka dohnud jong u kan lap ia lade .

en: Jayaprakash Sardar is son of Arunpal Sardar and Amrit Lal is son of Shiv Narayan .
kha: U Jayaprakash Sardar u dei u khun jong u Arunpal Sardar bad u Amrit Lal u dei u khun jong u Shiv Narayan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jayaprakash Sardar u dei u khun u Arunpal Sardar bad u Amrit Lal u dei u khun u Shiv Narayan .

en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife : but every fool will be meddling .
kha: Uno uno uba bieit u lah ban sdang ïa ki jingïania ; kaba donburom ka long ban kiar na kine .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka burom ia u briew ban sangeh noh na ka jingialeh: hynrei uwei pa uwei u bieit un sa ia tyngkhuh .

en: Praise him for his mighty acts : praise him according to his excellent greatness .
kha: To ïaroh ïa u namar ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh . To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw ba-halor tam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia u na ka bynta ki kam ba khraw jong u: iaroh ia u kat kum ka jingkhraw kaba khraw jong u .

en: So the messenger went , and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for .
kha: Kumta uta u nonglamktien u la leit sha u Dabid bad u la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la hukum ïa u ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u nonglam khubor u la leit , bad u la wan bad u la pyni ia u Dabid baroh kaba u Joab u la phah ia u .

en: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .
kha: Bad kum ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , u Lebi ( kiba hiarpateng na u ki lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ) ruh u la siew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba nga lah ban ong kumta , u Lebi ruh uba ioh ia ka shiphew snem u la siew ia ka shiphew ha u Abraham .

en: Make no friendship with an angry man  ; and with a furious man thou shalt not go :
kha: Wat ïalong paralok bad ki briew kiba domriang , kiba khong khong .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ialong paralok bad u briew uba bitar ; bad bad u briew uba bitar me wat leit:

en: Thou shalt fear the  Lord  thy God , and serve him , and shalt swear by his name .
kha: Tiengburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , mane tang ïa u , bad kular ruh tang ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad to shakri ia u, bad to smai da ka kyrteng jong u .

en: If thou be righteous , what givest thou him ? or what receiveth he of thine hand ?
kha: Hato me ïarap ïa U Blei da kaba me long uba hok ? Kam don kano kano kaba U Blei u donkam na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me long uba hok , kaei kaba me ai ia u ? lane kaei kaba u pdiang na ka kti jong me ?

en: Sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth  ; shew forth from day to day his salvation .
kha: Rwai ha U  Trai  , baroh ka pyrthei ! Pynbna man ka sngi ïa ka khubor babha ba u la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ha U Trai, ka khyndew baroh kawei ka pyni na ka sngi sha ka sngi .

en: As a result , wells in the nearby areas were contaminated turning the water dark .
kha: Kumta ki tyllong um ha ki jaka ba marjan ki la shah pynjakhlia kaba la pynlong dum ia ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka jingmih , ki thliew ha ki jaka ba marjan ki la shah pynjakhlia bad ka um ka la dum .

en: Since no such book existed , I have tried to write one for use in my own courses .
kha: Namar ba ym don kum kata ka kot , nga la pyrshang ban thoh kawei ban pyndonkam ha la ki jong ki course .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ym don kum kata ka kot , nga la pyrshang ban thoh kawei na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha la ki jong ki jinghikai .

en: And he went from thence to mount Carmel , and from thence he returned to Samaria .
kha: U Elisha u la nang leit sha u Lum Karmel , bad hadien u la leit phai sha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit noh nangta sha u lum Karmel, bad nangta u la leit phai biang sha Samaria .

en: The police believe the boy has done this with the intention of making easy money .
kha: Ki pulit ki ngeit ba une u khynnah u la leh ia kane da ka jingthmu ban kamai pisa da kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ki ngeit ba u khynnah u la leh ia kane da ka jingthmu ban kamai pisa kaba suk .

en: But if ye shall still do wickedly , ye shall be consumed , both ye and your king .
kha: Hynrei lada phi dang ïai leh pop , ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi yn pynjot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi dang leh sniew, phin sa shah pynjot noh, ma phi bad u syiem jong phi .

en: Two hundred she goats , and twenty he goats , two hundred ewes , and twenty rams ,
kha: arspah tylli ki blang kynthei bad arphew tylli ki  langsohmoh , arspah tylli ki langbrot kynthei bad arphew tylli ki langbrot shynrang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ar spah tylli ki blang bad arphew tylli ki blang bad arphew tylli ki langbrot .

en: And he said unto me ,  Depart : for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles .
kha: ‘ Khie leit ,’ U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ naba ngan phah ïa me sha jngai sha ki Jentil .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, To leit noh: namar ngan phah ia me sha ki Jutang .

en: On 15.09.2023, the match will be held Maitchaphrang Mootyrchiah against Chutwakhu.
kha: Haka 15.09.2023 ka Maitchaphrang Mootyrchiah pyrshah ïaka Chutwakhu.
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka 15.09.2023, ka jingïakhun kan long ka Maitchuphrang Mootyrchiah pyrshah ïa u Chutwakhu.

en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .
kha: Nangta ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Trai ha u bad ha baroh kiwei pat kiba ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ha u ia ka ktien U Trai bad ha baroh kiba don ha iing jong u .

en: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts , as of woollen and linen together .
kha: Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ ba la thain lang da u  saiwul bad u  sai linen .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat phong da ka jain jong ki nongleit jingleit, kum ka snieh bad ka snieh langbrot .

en: And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .
kha: bad lada ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ka la mih noh na iing jong u , ka lah ban leit long ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew .

en: And from the wicked their light is withholden , and the high arm shall be broken .
kha: Ka jingshai ka sngi ka phyrnai eh ïa ki nongleh bymman , bad ka khanglad ïa ki na ki kam leh jubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na kiba sniew ka jingshai jong ki ka la sahkut , bad ka kti kaba jrong kan sa tyrkhong .

en: Such as family law, village law, religious law or church law...and government law.
kha: Kum ka aiñ kur, ka aiñ shnong, ka aiñ niam ne balang…bad ka aiñ sorkar.
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka ain jong ka longiing, ka ain shnong, ka ain niam ne ka ain balang...bad ka ain sorkar.

en: (H.S.Shylla) (Boldness L.Nongum) (Egentstar Kurkalang) (Rasting L.Thabah)Chairman.
kha: (H.S.Shylla) (Boldness L.Nongum) (Egentstar Kurkalang) (Rasting L.Thabah)Chairman.
translated_en_to_kha: (H.S.Shylla) (Ka Jingshlur L.Nongum) (Egentstar Kurkalang) (Raning L.Thabah)Chairman.

en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for , the evidence of things not seen .
kha: Ban ngeit ka long ban sngewskhem ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kyrmen , ban sngewthikna ïa kiei kiei kiba ngim lah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingngeit ka long ka jinglong jong kiei kiei kiba la kyrmen , ki sakhi jong kiei kiei ki bym lah ban iohi .

en: Hold your peace , let me alone , that I may speak , and let come on me what will .
kha: Sngap jar bad ailad ïa nga ban kren , bad to ai ba ki jingmih nangta kin long kumba ki long .
translated_en_to_kha: To bat ia ka jingsuk jong phi, to ai ba ngan kren marwei, bad to ai ba ngan wan ha nga kaei kaba mon .

en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee , and cast out devils .
kha: Kumta u la leit sha baroh ki jaka ha Galilaïa , da kaba ïalap ha ki synagog bad beh noh ïa ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ialap ha ki synagog jong ki ha kylleng ka Galilaia baroh kawei .

en: And the man waxed great , and went forward , and grew until he became very great :
kha: U la nang manbha , bad u la kylla long uba riewspah eh .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u la nang heh nang heh nang heh nang heh nang heh nang heh haduh ba un da long uba khraw shibun:

en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .
kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa kata ; ngan pdiang da kaba sngewbha lada kaba phi ong ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me don ei ei ban ong , jubab ia nga: kren , namar nga kwah ban pynshisha ia me .

en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .
kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ïa ka shkor kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki u la pynkhih ia u shakri jong u rangbah lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ia ka shkor kadiang jong u .

en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei ba phi sheptieng ? Hato phim pat don jingngeit satia ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Balei phi tieng ? kumno ka long ba phim don jingngeit ?

en: And ye shall keep my statutes , and do them : I am the  Lord  which sanctify you .
kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , namar nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang khuid ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sumar ia ki ain jong nga , bad leh ia ki: Nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ia phi .

en: Beware therefore , lest that come upon you , which is spoken of in the prophets  ;
kha: To sumar bha , te , ba kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong kan ym jia ha phi :
translated_en_to_kha: To husiar namarkata , ioh ba kata kan wan ha phi , kaba la kren ha ki nongiathuhlypa ; .

en: Thou shalt fall upon the open field : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Kin kyllon ïap sha lum sha wah . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban hap ha ka lyngkha kaba plie: namar nga la kren ia kata , ong U Trai Blei .

en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .
kha: Nga long u paralok jong kito baroh kiba shakri ïa me , jong baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u paralok jong kita baroh kiba sheptieng ia me , bad na kita kiba sumar ia ki hukum jong me .

en: He is a merchant , the balances of deceit are in his hand : he loveth to oppress .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long bymhok kum ki nong Kanaan ; ki sngewtynnat ban shukor ïa ki nongthied da ki tarajur bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: U long u nongkhaii , ki jinglong thok ki don ha ka kti jong u: u ieit ban pynshitom bein .

en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .
kha: Ki lah don hapoh ka jingsynshar u Khedorlaomer haduh khat-ar snem , hynrei ha ka snem kaba khatlai ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Shiphew snem ki la shakri ia u Chedorlaomer , bad ha ka snem kaba shiphew ki la leh pyrshah .

en: And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
kha: A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don ki khun rit !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kordit ia kito kiba pun khun bad ia kito kiba ai dud ha kita ki sngi !

en: What matters did Paul initially deal with in his first letter to the Corinthians ?
kha: Kiei ki mat kiba u Paul u la kren nyngkong ha ka shithi kaba nyngkong jong u sha ki nong Korinth ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei kiba kongsan kiba u Paul u la iadei ha kaba sdang ha ka shithi ba nyngkong jong u sha ki nong Korinth ?

en: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .
kha: Ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , kumta ka la wan ryngkat bad u paidbah nadien jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ka la iohsngew ia U Jisu , ka la wan rung shapoh ka press hadien , bad ka la ktah ia ka jain jong u .

en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Haba nga pynshitom ïa ka Ijipt ha kane ka rukom , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pyndep ia ki jingbishar ha Ijipt : bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane , ko Job: to ieng beit, bad to pyrkhat ia ki kam ba phylla jong U Blei .

en: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the  Lord  his God .
kha: U Jotham u la nang khlaiñbor , namar u kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jotham u la long uba khlain bor , namar u la pynkhreh ia ki lynti jong u ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong u .

en: And he increased his people greatly  ; and made them stronger than their enemies .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai shibun ki khun ïa ki briew jong u bad pynlong ïa ki kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynbun shibun ia ki briew jong u bad u la pynlong ia ki ban kham khlain ban ia ki nongshun jong ki .

en: Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous  ; but who is able to stand before envy ?
kha: Ka jingbitar ka long kaba shyrkhei bad kaba pynjot , hynrei kam long ei ei haba ïanujor bad ka jingpihuiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar ka long kaba sniew , bad ka jingbitar ka long kaba sngewsih ; hynrei mano ba lah ban ieng ha khmat ka jingsngewsih ?

en: And they that were sent went their way , and found even as he had said unto them .
kha: Ki la nang leit ha la ka lynti bad ki la shem ïa kaei kaei baroh thik kumba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh bad ki la shem kumba u la ong ha ki .

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord  , for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut !
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai , namar u long uba bha: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Or ministry , let us wait on our ministering : or he that teacheth , on teaching ;
kha: lada ka long ban shakri , ngi dei ban shakri ; lada ka long ban hikai , ngi dei ban hikai ;
translated_en_to_kha: Lane ka jingshakri , to ngin ap ia ka jingshakri jong ngi: ne uta uba hikai, ha kaba hikai;

en: And Jesus answering said ,  Were there not ten cleansed ? but where are the nine ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  La don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ïa kiba la pynkhiah ; shano kiwei pat ki khyndai ngut ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab u la ong, Hato ym shym la pynkhuid shiphew ngut ? hynrei shano kita ki hynniew ngut ?

en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind , called Euroclydon .
kha: Hynrei shen ka lyer kaba jur — kata kaba la khot ka lyer  Shatei-lam-mihngi  — ka la beh na ka dewlynnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym slem hadien ba la mih pyrshah ia ka ka Iyer kaba jur bha, kaba la khot ka Euroclydon .

en: Jesus answered them , and said ,  My doctrine is not mine , but his that sent me .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba nga hikai kam dei na ka jinghikai jong nga hi , hynrei ka wan na U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki bad u la ong: Ka jinghikai jong nga kam dei ka jong nga hynrei ka jong uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: And great fear came upon all the church , and upon as many as heard these things .
kha: Ka balang baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la sngewshyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtieng kaba khraw ka la wan ha ka balang baroh kawei bad ha kiba la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei .

en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud , and bring forth boughs like a plant .
kha: da ka um un khie lung kum u jingthung ba dang lung .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lyngba ka jingsma jong ka um kan sa tuid , bad kan pynmih ia ki tnat kum u jingthung .

en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
kha: Ki la lynñiar , ki da khaweh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang pyrta , bad ki dang bret noh ia ki jain jong ki bad ki la bret ia ka dewbilat sha ka Iyer .

en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the  Lord .
kha: Ngan bat ïa ka kular jong nga bad nga pynlong ïa pha ka jong nga , bad phan sa pdiang ïa nga kum U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan sa pynsngewsih wat ia me ha nga ha ka jinglong ba iaineh: bad me men ithuh ia U Trai .

en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .
kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki turoi . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki jingtem ksai .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia u da ka sur jong ka turoi: iaroh ia u da ka jingsawa bad ka harp .

en: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed , which do err from thy commandments .
kha: Me sneng ïa kiba sarong ; kito ki bymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ki long kiba la tim .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynrem ia kiba sngew sarong kiba la shah tim , kiba bakla na ki hukum jong me .

en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
kha: Hynrei lada u ïaid ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um don ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u briew u iaid miet , u ia tyngkhuh , namar ym don jingshai ha u .

en: But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding ia ka Judah bad kan bam ia ki iing jong ka Jerusalem .

en: For if I build again the things which I destroyed , I make myself a transgressor .
kha: Lada nga sdang ban tei pat ïa ka rukom ka Hukum ïa kaba nga la jynrat noh , te nga pynpaw noh ïa lade kum uwei uba pynkheiñ Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga tei pat ia kiei kiei kiba nga la pynjot , nga pynlong ia lade u nongleh bymman .

en: Though he were a Son , yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered  ;
kha: Hynrei wat la u la long U Khun U Blei , u la nang ban kohnguh da kaba u la shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u long u Khun hynrei u la nang ia ka jingsngap jar da kiei kiei kiba u la shah shitom ; .

en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
kha: Ki briew kiba khlem Blei ki long kum kito ki khah ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki lynti jong baroh kiba klet ia U Blei ; bad ka jingkyrmen kaba arsap kan jah noh:

en: The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .
kha: Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym phai noh na ka aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba sngew sarong ki la pynjah burom shibun ia nga: hynrei ngam shym la kyntait na ka hukum jong me .

en: Ephraim , he hath mixed himself among the people  ; Ephraim is a cake not turned .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long kum u kpu bym pat ih bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim , u la khleh lang hapdeng ki briew ; Ephraim ka long ka cake kaba ym shym la kylla .

en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus .
kha: Kumta nga mareh beit sha pyrshah ka thong khnang ban ïoh ïa ka prais , kaba long ka jingkhot U Blei da U Khrist Jisu sha ka jingim kaba shaneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pynkhih sha ka dak na ka bynta ka khusnam jong ka jingkhot kaba khraw jong U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul , and never eateth with pleasure .
kha: Kiwei pat kim don jingkmen satia ; ki im bad ki ïap ryngkat bad ka jingkthang ha ki dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u iap ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong u , bad um ju bam da ka jingsngewbha .

en: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret .
kha: ( Ka long da shisha kaba lehrain eh wat ban ïakren ïa kita kiei kiei ïa kiba ki leh ha kaba rieh ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long kaba sngewlehrain wat ban kren shaphang kita kiei kiei kiba la leh na ki ha kaba rieh .

en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God s elect ? It is God that justifieth .
kha: Uei u ban mudui ïa kiba la jied jong U Blei ? U Blei hi da lade u la pynbna ba ki long khlem pop!
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba buh ia kaei kaei ha ka jingkynnoh jong U Blei ? Ka long U Blei uba pynshisha .

en: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him , and returned to the castle :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki shipai ïaid kjat ki la leit phai sha ka kut shipai bad ki la iehnoh ha ki shipai shong kulai ban leit bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ki la iehnoh ia ki kulai ban leit bad u , bad ki la leit phai biang sha ka iing syiem:

en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .
kha: Ka jingtip jong nga ka long kaba ïar ; ngan pyndonkam ïa kaba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong nga , u long uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shim ia ka jingtip jong nga na jngai , bad ngan ai ia ka hok ha u Nongthaw jong nga .

en: Thou , O  Lord  , remainest for ever  ; thy throne from generation to generation .
kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long u syiem junom , bad men synshar sha kaba kut ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko Trai, me sah junom ha ka khet jong me naduh ki pateng haduh ki pateng .

en: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .
kha: U Ktien u la don ha ka pyrthei , bad wat la U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da u , pynban , ka pyrthei kam shym la ithuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don ha ka pyrthei , bad la thaw ia ka pyrthei da u , bad ka pyrthei kam ithuh ia u .

en: And Moses cried unto the  Lord  , saying , Heal her now , O God , I beseech thee .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la kyang ha U  Trai  ,  A Blei , to pynkhiah ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pyrta ha U Trai, u da ong: To pynkhiah ia ka mynta ko Blei, nga kyrpad ia me .

en: Settle it therefore in your hearts , not to meditate before what ye shall answer :
kha: Buh jingmut lypa ban ym khuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka namarkata ha ki dohnud jong phi , ban ym pyrkhat shuwa kaei kaba phin jubab:

en: All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .
kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynshitom beiñ ïa nga da ki jinglamler — A ïarap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hukum jong me baroh ki long kiba iaineh: ki pynshitom bein ia nga da kaba bakla; to iarap ia nga .

en: None that go unto her return again , neither take they hold of the paths of life .
kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka uba lah ban wan phai . Un ym lah shuh ban wan phai pat sha ka lynti ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba leit phai biang sha ka , lymne ki bat ia ki lynti jong ka jingim .

en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab jong ki Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Israel bad u syiem Judah ki la leit sha Ramotgilead .

en: Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,
kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jong U  Trai  , ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba ieng ha iing U Trai , ha ki phyllaw jong ka iing U Blei jong ngi .

en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit , and his life from perishing by the sword .
kha: Un ym shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki ; u pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingïap hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U bat ia ka mynsiem jong u na ka thliew , bad ka jingim jong u na ka jingduh noh da ka waitlam .

en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .
kha: Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlieh ; ka long ka jingbieit ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym kyrkieh ha ka mynsiem jong me ban bitar: namar ka jingbitar ka shong ha ka kpoh jong ki bieit .

en: Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :
kha: Yn don ka jingseisoh kaba khraw ha ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ki wan hynriew snem ka jingbun kaba khraw ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt:

en: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .
kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bitar ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki shiphew ngut ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la sdang ban sngewsih shibun ia u Jakob bad u loannis .

en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot : he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment .
kha: U king ïa ka duriaw kum ka um kaba thnam bad u pynlong ïa ka ba kan tyrtho kum u khiew umphniang .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ka jingjylliew ban rkhiang kum ka umphniang: u pynlong ia ka duriaw kum ka umphniang .

en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men , beside women and children .
kha: Ka jingkheiñ ïa ki rangbah kiba la bam ka la long san hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la bam ki long kumba san hajar ngut ki shynrang , nalor ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .

en: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing : but righteousness delivereth from death .
kha: Ka spah kaba phi ïoh da ka bymhok kam pynmyntoi ei ei , hynrei ka jinglonghok ka pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingma jong ka jingsniew kim ioh ei ei: hynrei ka hok ka pyllait na ka jingiap .

en: And Judas the brother of James , and Judas Iscariot , which also was the traitor .
kha: U Judas u khun jong u Jakob bad u Judas Iskariot uba la kylla long u nongshetkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas u hynmen u Jakob bad u Judas Isarot ruh u la long u nongshet kylla .

en: Behold , he put no trust in his servants  ; and his angels he charged with folly :
kha: U Blei um shaniah ïa ki shakri jong u ha bneng ; u shem ka jingduna wat bad ki angel jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , um shym la shaniah ha ki shakri jong u ; bad ki angel jong u u la kynnoh da kaba sngewsih:

en: We held a meeting of all the parties of Jammu and Kashmir to hear their concerns .
kha: Ngi la pynlong ia ka jingialang jong baroh ki party jong ka Jammu bad Kashmir ban sngap ia ki jingeh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la pynlong ia ka jingialang jong baroh ki liang jong ka Jammu bad Kashmir ban iohsngew ia ki jingeh jong ki .

en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it , and too much .
kha: Kaei kaba la lah wallam ka la biang ban trei pyndep ïa ka kam baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ki don ka la biang na ka bynta ki kam baroh ban pynlong ia ka , bad palat .

en: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
kha: Hato don uno uno uba hok ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sngur ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u briew uba iap un kham hok ban ia U Blei ? hato u briew un kham khuid ban ia u nongthaw jong u ?

en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head , and chains about thy neck .
kha: Ki jinghikai jong ki kin pynbha ïa ka jinglong jong phi kum ka jaiñspong kaba ishongkhia ha ka khlieh jong phi , lane kum u jingdeng uba pyniphuh ïa ka dur jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kin long ka jingpynitynnad ia ka jingaiei ha ka khlieh jong me , bad ki kynjri sawdong ka ryndang jong me .

en: Her husband is known in the gates , when he sitteth among the elders of the land .
kha: U tnga jong ka u long uba la ithuh bha , bad u long uwei na ki nongshong shnong uba pawkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: La tip ia u tnga jong ka ha ki khyrdop , haba u shong hapdeng ki rangbah jong ka ri .

en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him .
kha: Da sngap ha shuwa ba phin jubab . Lada phim leh kumta , phi long uba bieit bad shah rkhiebeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba jubab ia ka kam shuwa ba un iohsngew ia ka , ka long kaba sngewsih bad kaba sngewlehrain ia u .

en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .
kha: Naba u Abraham u la ap khmih ïa ka nongbah kaba U Blei u la pynwandur bad u la tei , ka nongbah kaba don ki nongrim baneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la wad ia ka nongbah kaba don ki nongrim, kaba u nongtei bad u nongshna jong ka u long U Blei .

en: If I sin , then thou markest me , and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity .
kha: me ïai jngoh ban ïohi lada nga leh pop , khnang ba men kyntait ban map ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga leh pop , te me pynpaw ia nga , bad men ym pyllait ia nga na ka jingbymhok jong nga .

en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .
kha: Ym don uba kren lamler ha ka ïingbishar u ban ïohlait na ka jingpynshitom ; u la shah pynrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sakhi kaba bakla kan ym long kaba khlem jingpynshitom , bad uta uba kren thok un jah noh .

en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .
kha: To ïaineh bad ka tnga jong phi bad ai ka jingieit tang ïa ka hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Doh ia ki um na la ka jong ka thliew , bad ki um kiba tuid na la ka jong ka thliew .

en: Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .
kha: Mynta , to shim noh ïa ka pisa na u bad ai ïa ka ha uta uba la don shiphew hajar tylli ki sbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim namarkata ia ka sap na u , bad ai ia ka ha uta uba don shiphew tylli ki talent .

en: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: khnang ba ki briew jong u kin kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u bad ban bat ïa ki hukum jong u baroh . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin peit ia ki ain jong u, bad kin sumar ia ki ain jong u . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: Every word of God is pure : he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him .
kha: U Blei u bat man la ka kular ba u pynlong . U long kum ka stieh ïa baroh kiba wad ïa ka jingïada jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba khuid: u long ka jingda ia kito kiba buh ia ka jingshaniah jong ki ha u .

en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .
kha: Ki ktien sbun ki long kum ka ngap — kaba thiang ïa ka jingmad bad kaba bha ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kyntien kiba sngewtynnad ki long kum ka umsoh , kaba thiang ia ka mynsiem bad ka koit ka khiah ia ki shyieng .

en: For God shall cast upon him , and not spare : he would fain flee out of his hand .
kha: kan beh halor jong ki khlem jingisynei katba ki pyrshang katba don la ka bor ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei un bret ia u, bad un ym lait: un phet noh na ka kti jong u .

en: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .
kha: Hadien ba u la lah ong ïa kane , u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Lasaros , to mihnoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kumta, u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u Lasaros u la wan shabar .

en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins  ; and in him is no sin .
kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u la paw ban bah noh ïa ki pop , bad kam don kano kano ka pop ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi tip ba la pynpaw ia u ban weng noh ia ki pop jong ngi bad ha u ym don pop .

en: And he said unto him ,  Thou hast answered right : this do , and thou shalt live .
kha: Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  to leh ïa kane bad men im .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Me la jubab hok: kane leh , bad me phin im .

en: That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .
kha: Hato me la pan na U Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong me , bad hato me la kohnguh ban ym leh pop shuh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba ngam iohi: lada nga la leh ia ka jingbymhok , ngan ym leh shuh .

en: When the waves of death compassed me , the floods of ungodly men made me afraid  ;
kha: Ki jingat phyllung ka jingïap ki don sawdong jong nga , ki jingat phyllung ka jingpynjot ki tyllun halor jong nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki um iap ki la ker sawdong ia nga , ki jingshlei um jong ki briew ki bym riewblei ki la pyntieng ia nga;

en: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes , which is over against Galilee .
kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la leit da ka lieng sha ka thain Gadara , kaba don sha shiliang jong ka duriaw Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha ka ri Gadare kaba don ha Galilaia .

en: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,
kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki shakri kynthei ban pyrta na ka jaka kaba jrong tam ha kata ka nongbah :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la phah ia ki nongtrei jong ka: ka pyrta ha ki jaka ba jrong tam jong ka nongbah .

en: As soon as the morning was light , the men were sent away , they and their asses .
kha: Dang step phyrngab la phah noh ïa kita shi para bad ïa ki kada jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang shu shai ka step , la phah noh ia ki shynrang , ma ki bad ki tdong jong ki .

en: Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .
kha: ki bat ïa kaba paw shabar jong ka niam jong ki , hynrei kin kyntait ïa ka bor bashisha jong ka . To kiar noh na kiba kum kita ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka rukom riewblei , hynrei ka kyntait ia ka bor jong ka: na kum kata ka jingkylla .

en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
kha: namar kim pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la pyrkhat ia ka kambah jong ki kpu: namar ka dohnud jong ki ka la tyrkhong .

en: And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons  wives with him :
kha: Kumta u Noah lem bad la ka tnga , bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki tnga jong ki , ki la ïamih shabar na kata ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Noah u la leit noh bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ka tnga jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad u:

en: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him , and to every seed his own body .
kha: U Blei u pyndap ïa uta u symbai da ka met kat kumba u sngewbha ; ha uwei pa uwei u symbai ïa la ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u ai ia ka met kumba ka la mon ia u, bad ha uwei pa uwei u symbai la ka jong ka met .

en: Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .
kha: Jied ïa ka jingbthah jong nga , ban ïa ka rupa ; jied ïa ka jingtip , ban ïa ka ksiar nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Pdiang ia ka jinghikai jong nga , bad ym ia ka rupa bad ka jingtip ban ia ka ksiar ba la jied .

en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .
kha: Nangta , ki lai ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Moses ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Elias u la paw ha ki bad u Moses: bad ki la ia kren bad U Jisu .

en: And so terrible was the sight , that Moses said , I exceedingly fear and quake : )
kha: Kaei kaba la ïohi ka long kaba sngewtriem katta katta ba u Moses u la ong ,  Nga la khynñiuh bad nga la sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kaba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba u Moses u la ong , Nga tieng palat bad nga khih: )

en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment , than for you .
kha: U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ha ka Sngi Bishar ïa ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ban ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan kham lah ban shah ia ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ha ka jingbishar , ban ia phi .

en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Hynrei to long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiaw lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ainguh ia U Blei uba ai ia ngi ia ka jingjop lyngba U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .
kha: Pynban uno uno uba don U Mynsiem , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei baroh , hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba long mynsiem u bishar ia kiei kiei baroh, hynrei ma u hi ym shah bishar na uno uno u briew .

en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me , and keep my commandments .
kha: Hynrei nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong nga ha ki hajar ki pateng bynriew jong kito kiba ieit ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba pyni ia ka jingisynei ha ki hajar ngut kiba ieit ia nga , bad kiba sumar ia ki hukum jong nga .

en: For I have satiated the weary soul , and I have replenished every sorrowful soul .
kha: Ngan pynthymmai bor ïa kito kiba la thait bad pynhun da ka jingbam ïa baroh kiba la tlot na ka jingthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la pynhun ia ka mynsiem kaba la tyrkhong , bad nga la pyndap ia kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kaba sngewsih .

en: O worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness : fear before him , all the earth .
kha: Dem ngon ha khmat uta Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ; to khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , phi ka pyrthei baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: O mane ia U Trai ha ka jingitynnad jong ka jingkhuid: to tieng ha khmat jong u , ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .
kha: Ym namar ba nga kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ; pynban , nga kwah ban ïohi ba la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong ha ka jingbuh jingkheiñ jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym namar ba nga kwah ia ka jingai: hynrei nga kwah ia u soh uba lah ban pyndap ia ka account jong phi .

en: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .
kha: Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew ; ym don u briew uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat buh ia ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ki syiem , ne ha u khun u briew , ha kiba ym don jingiarap .

en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .
kha: U syiem u kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha bad u sngewbha ïa kito kiba kren ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur kiba hok ki long ka jingsngewbha jong ki syiem ; bad ki ieit ia uta uba kren hok .

en: And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
kha: U Petros u la ïaisah bun sngi ha Joppa lem bad u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , ba u la sah bun sngi ha Joppa bad uwei u Simon u nonglehkai .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki , Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And he said ,  Verily I say unto you , No prophet is accepted in his own country .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju pdiang sngewbha ha la ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ym shym la pdiang ia u nongiathuhlypa ha la ka jong ka ri .

en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
kha: Ha u , ïa phi ruh la tei lang lem bad kiwei pat da U Mynsiem jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba phi ruh la tei lang na ka bynta ka jaka shong jong U Blei lyngba U Mynsiem .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that their rulers , and elders , and scribes ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , ki tymmen ki san , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba ki nongsynshar jong ki bad ki rangbah bad ki nongthoh .

en: Ye that put far away the evil day , and cause the seat of violence to come near  ;
kha: Phi kyntait ban pdiang ba ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka wan , hynrei kaei ba phi leh ka long tang ban pynjan ïa kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba buh jngai ia ka sngi kaba sniew , bad pynlong ia ka jaka shong jong ka jingleh donbor ban wan hajan ; .

en: That , according as it is written , He that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .
kha: Te kumta , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban sngewsarong , u dei ban sngewsarong ha kaei kaba U Trai u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kumba la thoh , Uta uba pyndonburom , to ai ba un pyndonburom ha U Trai .

en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty .
kha: Suh ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron u hynmen jong me khnang ba un ishongkun shongkhia bad idonburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki jain kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u hynmen jong me na ka bynta ka burom bad na ka bynta ka jingitynnad .

en: This is the dream  ; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king .
kha: Kane ka la long ka jingphohsniew . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha u Syiem Kynrad aïu ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka jingphohsniew ; bad ngin sa iathuh ia ka jingbatai jong ka ha khmat u syiem .

en: And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;
