kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ka jutang bad phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ha khmih, nga pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga bad phi, bad bad u symbai jong phi hadien jong phi;

en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab : and Eglon was a very fat man .
kha: Nangta u leit rah ïa ki jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon , uba long u briew uba sngaid shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka jingai sngewbha sha u Eglon syiem u Eglon: bad u Eglon u long u briew uba heh bha .

en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
kha: Kumta ïa ki balang la nang pynkhlaiñ ha ka jingngeit bad ki la nang roi ha ka jingbun briew man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh ki balang ki la nang skhem ha ka jingngeit , bad ki la nang kiew man ka sngi .

en: The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki ïoh ka jingsngewskhem borabor , hynrei ki bymman kin ym lah ban im ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba hok kin ym shah weng noh: hynrei ki bymman kin ym shong ha ka khyndew .

en: Saying , Surely blessing I will bless thee , and multiplying I will multiply thee .
kha: U la ong ,  Nga kular ba ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pynroi ïa me pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Hooid ngan kyrkhu ia me , bad da kaba pynbun ngan pynbun ia me .

en: And the remnant took his servants , and entreated them spitefully , and slew them .
kha: katba kiwei pat ki bat trait ïa ki shakri , ki shoh ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiba sah ki la shim ia ki shakri jong u, bad ki la sngewsih ia ki da kaba sngewsih, bad ki la pyniap ia ki .

en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of your words , and was wroth , and sware , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong phi bad u la bitar lep , bad kumta da kaba sngewkhia u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong phi, bad u la bitar bad u la sngap jar, u da ong:

en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey , and increaseth the transgressors among men .
kha: Ki ap ïa phi kum ki nonglute bad ki long ka daw ïa kiba bun ki rangbah ban ym long ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ruh ka sah kum ka mrad , bad ka pynbun ia ki nongleh kam sniew hapdeng ki briew .

en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb , throughout the seven lambs :
kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiateh kaba shiphew na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u langbrot, ha baroh hynriew tylli ki langbrot:

en: But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .
kha: Ki la sngewshyrkhei , da kaba pyrkhat ba ki ïohi ïa ka rngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la tieng bad ki la sngew lyngngoh , bad ki la shim ba ki la iohi ia u mynsiem .

en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath , and vex them in his sore displeasure .
kha: Nangta u maham ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad u pyntriem ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un kren ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong u, bad un pynsngewsih ia ki ha ka jingbym sngewtynnad kaba jur jong u .

en: But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
kha: Baroh la pyndonkam ban siew ïa ki nongtrei bad ban thied ïa ki tiar ha kaba shna pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la ai ia kata ha ki nongtrei , bad ki la pynbha ia kata ka iing U Trai .

en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
kha: Kata ka dei ka rukom haba wanrah ïa uwei u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot , ne u  langsohmoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta yn leh ia ka na ka bynta uwei u masi, ne na ka bynta uwei u langbrot ne na ka bynta u khun masi .

en: In picture : A candid collage of Mahesh Babu with his children Gautham and Sitara .
kha: Ha ka dur : Ka collage kaba shai jong u Mahesh Babu bad ki khun jong u u Gautham bad ka Sitara .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka dur: Ka jingpyniasoh lang jong u Mahesh Babu bad ki khun jong u u Gautham bad u Sitara .

en: The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .
kha: wat ki rangbah kiba kham paw eh ki sngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki riew rangbah ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki , bad ka shyntur jong ki ka la rung sha ka tnum jong ka shyntur jong ki .

en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ïohi ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha u: Lada phi iohi ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla , phin ym ngeit .

en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Moab , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyndep ia ki jingbishar halor ka Moab ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?
kha: Lada ka khriat , ki ar ngut ki lah ban ïathiah lang bad ban neh ha ka jingsyiad , hynrei kumno phin pynneh jingsyiad tang ma phi da lade hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien, lada arngut ki thiah lang, te ki don ka jingshit: hynrei kumno uwei u lah ban shit marwei ?

en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .
kha: Namar ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang kan ym lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kam long kaba lah ba ka snam jong ki masi bad ki blang kan weng noh ia ki pop .

en: To overthrow their seed also among the nations , and to scatter them in the lands .
kha: bad pynsakma ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki hapdeng ki nongmane bleithaw , ban iehnoh ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ki ri nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynhap ia u symbai jong ki ruh hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ban pynphriang ia ki ha ki ri .

en: So when David was old and full of days , he made Solomon his son king over Israel .
kha: Haba u Dabid u la tymmen bha , u thung ïa u Solomon u khun jong u kum u syiem halor ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba u Dabid u la tymmen bad u la dap da ki sngi , u la pynlong ia u khun jong u u Solomon u syiem halor ki Israel .

en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone , and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof  ;
kha: lane ïa ki khunswet ban shahthngan katba ïa lade nga dang bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane ki la bam ia ka morsel jong nga hi marwei, bad u bym don kpa um shym la bam ia ka ; .

en: Fear not , daughter of Sion : behold , thy King cometh , sitting on an ass s colt .
kha: Wat ym sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Hangne u syiem jong pha u wan , u da shong halor u khun kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng, ko khun jong u Sion: ha khmih, u Syiem jong me u wan, u shong ha ka tdong jong u.

en: By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
kha: Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong U Blei ka pyndait thah ïa ki um , bad ka pynkylla thah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingsawa jong U Blei la ai: bad ka jingjyllei jong ki um ka long kaba jem .

en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life  ; and he that winneth souls is wise .
kha: Ka hok ka ai jingim , hynrei ka jinglehbor ka shim noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U soh jong kiba hok u long u dieng jong ka jingim ; bad uta uba jop ia ki mynsiem u long uba stad .

en: Cast me not off in the time of old age  ; forsake me not when my strength faileth .
kha: Wat kyntait ïa nga mynta ba nga la tymmen ; wat iehnoh ïa nga mynta ba nga la tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynsangeh ia nga ha ka por ba nga la tymmen ; wat iehnoh ia nga ym haba ka bor jong nga ka duna .

en: There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
kha: bad kumta ka jingpynjot kan ym shoh ïa me , ka jingleh jubor kan ym wan hajan ka ïing jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingsniew kaba sniew ia me, lymne kano kano ka khlam kan wan hajan ka jaka shong jong me .

en: And they said unto her , There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name .
kha: Ki la ong ha ka ,  Hynrei pham don uwei ruh na ki ba-ha-ïing uba kyrteng kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ka , Ym don uwei ruh na ki kur jong me uba la khot da kane ka kyrteng .

en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .
kha: Kaba shit khlieh ka thaw ki jingïania , hynrei ka jingïaishah ka wallam ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bitar u sngap jar: hynrei uta uba slem ban bitar u pynjem ia ka jingialeh .

en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been  ; as infants which never saw light .
kha: Te ngan jin da la ïohthiah kum ki khun syiem kiba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , lane ïohthiah kum u khunlung ba dang shu kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane kum ka jingkha khlem por kaba buhrieh ngam shym la long kum ki khunlung ki bym ju iohi ia ka jingshai .

en: * Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .
kha: * Ka kam kaba nyngkong eh kaba u Jisu u la leh ka long ban shop ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki ksuid jong u sha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: * Ka jingleh kaba nyngkong eh kum u Syiem ka long ban bret ia u Soitan bad ki ksuid jong u shapoh khyndew .

en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .
kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit noh ; ngan nang ïaid ma nga sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , To ngin ia shim ia ka jingleit jong ngi bad to ngin ia leit noh bad ngan leit ha khmat jong me .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Ask now the priests concerning the law , saying ,
kha: U la ong ,  Kylli ïa ki lyngdoh ban ai ka rai halor kane ka jingkylli :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong ia U Trai jong ki paid To kylli mynta ia ki lyngdoh shaphang ka hukum da kaba ong:

en: And Hamath also shall border thereby  ; Tyre , and Zidon , though it be very wise .
kha: Ka Hamath , kaba ïakhap pud bad ka Hadrakh , ka long ruh ka jong u , bad kumta ruh ki long ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon , lem bad ki jingtbit jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Hamath ruh kan long kaba stad bha.

en: And their dwelling was from Mesha , as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east .
kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shong ki sah ka ïar naduh Mesha haduh Sephar , kaba don ha ka ri lum kaba shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka shong jong ki ka long na Mesa, katba me leit sha u Sephar u lum shaphang mihngi .

en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jehoïakim u la ïap bad u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jehoiakim u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u: bad u Jehoichin u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ , the Son of the living God .
kha: Bad mynta ngi ngeit bad ngi tip ba me long uta U Bakhuid uba la wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi ngeit bad ngi sngewskhem ba me long uta U Khrist U Khun U Blei uba im .

en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , to Debir  ; and fought against it :
kha: Nangta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la phai noh pat sha Debir bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la wan phai bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, sha Debir ; bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka:

en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .
kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mahli bad u Mushi . U Mahli ruh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Eleasar bad u Kish ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Merari ; Mahli, bad u Mushi . Ki khun shynrang jong u Mahli ; Eleazar bad u Kish .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
kha: Hato phi kwah ban lait na ka jingïap ? Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka umpohliew ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka pung jong ka jingim , ban phet noh na ki jingeh jong ka jingiap .

en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .
kha: Lada um don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada um don khun kynthei , te phin ai ia ka pateng jong u ha ki hynmen jong u .

en: There shall none of his meat be left  ; therefore shall no man look for his goods .
kha: Haba u bam , ym ju don jingpynsah tam , hynrei mynta um don shuh ka jingpahuh pahai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym dei ban iehnoh ia ka doh jong u; namarkata ym don mano mano ruh ban wad ia ki mar jong u .

en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful  ; and the end of that mirth is heaviness .
kha: Ka jingrkhie ka lah ban buhrieh ïa ka jingkhuslai . Haba ka jingkmen ka la jah , ka jingsngewsih ka dang ïai don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ha ka jingrkhie ka dohnud ka sngewsih ; bad ka jingkut jong kata ka jingkmen ka long ka jingkhia .

en: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever .
kha: Ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , phin bud pyrkhing junom ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sumar ia kane kaei kaei na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit ia me bad ia ki khun jong me junom .

en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
kha: Ka longïing jong u kan long kaba don ba em bad kaba riewspah ; bad un roi kyrhai junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah bad ka spah kan long ha iing jong u: bad ka hok jong u ka sah junom .

en: They shall lament for the teats , for the pleasant fields , for the fruitful vine .
kha: To tied ïa la ki shadem ha ka jingsngewsih namar ki lyngkha baseisoh bad ki bri sohwaiñ ki la shah pynjot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kin iam na ka bynta ki bniat , na ka bynta ki lyngkha kiba itynnad , na ka bynta u sohjew uba jyrngam .

en: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .
kha: Naba ki ktien kiba phin kren kim dei ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem jong U Kpa jong phi uba kren lyngba jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym ma phi uba kren hynrei U Mynsiem jong phi uba kren ha phi .

en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,
kha: Hangta halor u lum , U  Trai  u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren bad phi markhmat ha ka jaka ba la lum na pdeng ka ding , .

en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house , and upon thy gates :
kha: Thoh ïa ki ha ki shawkad ki ïing jong phi bad ha ki khyrdop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban thoh ia ki ha ki jingkhang jong ka iing jong me bad ha ki khyrdop jong me:

en: As many as 32 panchayats in the district have been declared as surveillance zones .
kha: Haduh 32 tylli ki panchayat ha ka District la pynbna kum ki jaka peitngor .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh 32 tylli ki panchayat ha ka District la pynbna kum ki zone zone .

en: And they that are Christ s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts .
kha: Bad kita kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu ki la pynïap ïa ka jinglong ba kynja briew lem ïa ki jingthrew bad ki jingkwah brai jong ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba long U Khrist ki la sahnarphna ia ka doh bad ki jingieit bad ki jingkwah brai .

en: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost , and prophesied , saying ,
kha: Ïa U Sekharaïah , u kpa jong u Ïoannis la pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad u la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei :
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u u la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad u la iathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: Because I will publish the name of the  Lord  : ascribe ye greatness unto our God .
kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  , bad ki briew jong u kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pynmih ia ka kyrteng U Trai: to ai ia ka jingkhraw ha U Blei jong ngi .

en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas , thy builders have perfected thy beauty .
kha: Ka ïing jong pha ka long ka duriaw . Ki nongtei jong pha ki la shna ïa pha kum ka liengbah kaba itynnat ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pud jong me ki don hapdeng ki duriaw , ki nongtei jong me ki la pynjanai ia ka jingitynnad jong me .

en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds , until the day and night come to an end .
kha: U pynïakhlad ïa ka jingshai na ka jingdum da ka syrwiang ba la pruid dak ha khmat ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ker sawdong ia ki um da ki pud , haduh ba ka sngi bad ka miet kan kut noh .

en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .
kha: ( Ka don ka shnong hajan hangta ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynhun shipai . ) Bad kumta yn pynlong khuid biang ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ka kyrteng jong ka shnong kan long ka Hamonah . Kumta kin pynkhuid ia ka ri .

en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .
kha: U sngewtynnat ha ka kynhun paralok bad ki briew kiba bymman bad u ïaid sawdong bad ki nongpop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba iaid ryngkat bad ki nongtrei bymman , bad ka iaid bad ki briew kiba sniew .

en: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .
kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira ,  u Pilat u la ong ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi lah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki: Phi don ka jingpeit: leit noh ia ka katba phi lah .

en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .
kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki bun sngi , bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngen ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u la iam bun sngi , bad ki hynmen jong u ki la wan pyntngen ia u .

en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .
kha: Kino kino kiba ieit ïa ka jingtip ki kwah ban don ba pynong haba ki bakla . Ka long ka jingbieit ban isih haba don ba pynbeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba ieit ia ka jinghikai u ieit ia ka jingtip: hynrei uta uba shun ia ka jingshah pynrem u long uba sniew .

en: For the  Lord  shall be thy confidence , and shall keep thy foot from being taken .
kha: U  Trai  un ri sumar ïa phi . Un ym shah ba phin hap ha ka jingriam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un long ka jingshaniah jong me , bad un sumar ia ka kjat jong me na kaba shah shim .

en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes : but the  Lord  pondereth the hearts .
kha: Phi lah ban tharai ba baroh kat kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei kynmaw ba U  Trai  u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka lynti jong u briew ka long kaba dei ha la ki jong ki khmat: hynrei U Trai u pyrkhat ia ki dohnud .

en: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .
kha: Ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh kiba ka ri Ijipt ka la ïoh lehkmen ki la kut , bad ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki la sdang , kumba u Joseph u la lah ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki hynriew snem ka jingbun briew kiba la don ha ka ri Ijipt ki la kut noh .

en: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house :
kha: U briew uba don ha tnum ka ïing jong u , um dei shuh ban pynlut por ban hiar shapoh bad shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u na ka ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba uta uba don ha ka iing un ym wan hiar ban shim ei ei na iing jong u:

en: And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .
kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa ngi da ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la pynmih ia U Trai , bad un pynmih ruh ia ngi da ka bor jong u hi .

en: Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
kha: u la die ïa ka lyngkha ba u long trai , u la wallam ïa ka pisa , bad u la ai ha ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don jaka, u la die ia ka, bad u la wanrah ia ka pisa, bad u la buh ia ka ha ki kjat jong ki apostol .

en: And Balak did as Balaam had said , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
kha: U Balaam u leh kumta , bad u kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la leh kumba u Balaam u la ong, bad u la tyrwa ia u masi bad u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka jaka bam .

en: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore .
kha: Ïa kane la kynmaw kum ka kam babha jong u naduh kata ka por bad yn ïai kynmaw ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kata la khein ha u na ka bynta ka hok haduh ki pateng baroh junom .

en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :
kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u wad ïa ki mawlynnai kiba kordor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , ka hima bneng ka long kum u briew uba khaii , uba wad bha ia ki mawkordor:

en: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .
kha: U Jakob u la bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jakob u la leit sha ka ri jong ki briew kiba mihngi .

en: Jesus answered and said ,  This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kam dei na ka bynta jong nga ba kane ka sur ka la kren , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong , Kane ka sur kam shym la wan na ka bynta jong nga hynrei na ka bynta jong phi .

en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit  ; and he cried out ,
kha: Hamar kata ka por uwei u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid u la wan rung hapoh ka synagog bad u la lynñiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la don ha ka synagog jong ki u briew uba don ka mynsiem bymkhuid ; bad u la pyrta .

en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for he commanded , and they were created .
kha: Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! U shu hukum , bad ïa ki la pynlong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin iaroh ia ka kyrteng U Trai : namar u la hukum , bad la thaw ia ki .

en: As I was in the days of my youth , when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle  ;
kha: Kito ki long ki sngi mynba nga dang dap kyrhai bad ka jinglong paralok U Blei ka ïada ïa ka ïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga la don ha ki sngi samla jong nga, haba ka jingmaham U Blei ka la don ha ka iingjahthait jong nga;

en: Boast not thyself of to morrow  ; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth .
kha: Wat sarong shaphang kaba lashai . Phim tip aïu kan jia hapdeng mynta bad hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewsih ia lade ban sngewsih ; namar ngam tip ia kaei kaba ka sngi ka lah ban wanrah .

en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David  ;
kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa U Nongpynim bakhrawbor , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmih ia ka jingpynim na ka bynta jong ngi ha iing u Dabid u shakri jong u;

en: The stranger did not lodge in the street : but I opened my doors to the traveller .
kha: Nga khot sngewbha sha ïing jong nga ïa ki nongleit jingleit bad ngam ju shah ba kin thiah miet ha ki surok bah .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongwei um shym la sah ha surok : hynrei nga la plie ia ki jingkhang jong nga ha u nongleit jingleit .

en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
kha: Katba ki rangbah ki dang ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang kren namar ba u shongksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki dang mih shabar , ha khmih ki la wanrah ha u ia u briew uba dum uba don u ksuid .

en: Sing unto the  Lord  , bless his name  ; shew forth his salvation from day to day .
kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  , bad to ïaroh ïa u ! Pynbna man ka sngi ïa khubor babha ba u la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ia U Trai , to kyrkhu ia ka kyrteng jong u ; to pyni ia ka jingpynim jong u man ka sngi .

en: Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?
kha: Phi don ki khmat — hato phim lah ban ïohi ? Phi don ki shkor — hato phim lah ban ïohsngew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ki khmat , phim iohi ? bad ki shkor , phim iohsngew ? bad phim kynmaw ?

en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth , and which the vulture s eye hath not seen :
kha: Ym don u kbeit uba ïohi ïa ki lynti sha ki par , bad ym don u pukni ba ju her halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka lynti kaba ym don khnai kaba tip, bad kaba ka khmat jong u blang kam shym la iohi:

en: And the  Lord  plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingpang ha kita ki briew , namar ba ki la pynlong ïa u Aaron ban thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynshitom ia ki briew namar ki la shna ia u khun masi , uba u Aaron u la shna .

en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels , and the laver and his foot .
kha: ïa ka duwan na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang lem bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , bad ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingknia thang bad ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ka jaka bam bad ka kjat jong u .

en: And when the thousand years are expired , Satan shall be loosed out of his prison ,
kha: Hadien ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut , yn pyllait ïa u Soitan na ka byndi jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la kut ka hajar snem , u Soitan un sa jah noh na ka phatok jong u .

en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .
kha: Nangta ki mynsiem ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka jaka kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Ka Armageddon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la lum lang ia ki ha ka jaka kaba la khot ha ka ktien Hebru .

en: And he said unto him , Son , thou art ever with me , and all that I have is thine .
kha: ‘ Ko khun jong nga ,’ u kpa u la jubab , ‘ phi ïai don borabor hangne lem bad nga , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Ko khun, me don beit bad nga bad baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong me .

en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry , as we have received mercy , we faint not ;
kha: Kumta ngi iohi ia ka jongisynei jingblei , ba u la ai ha ngi ka jingisynei , te ngim dei ban kyllon
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba ngi iohi ia kane ka jingshakri kumba ngi la ioh ia ka jingisynei , ngim sngewsih;

en: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us  ;
kha: ba un pynim ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , na ka bor jong kito baroh kiba isih ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngi dei ban lait na ki nongshun jong ngi bad na ka kti jong baroh kiba shun ia ngi ; .

en: Teach me , O  Lord  , the way of thy statutes  ; and I shall keep it unto the end .
kha: Hikai ïa nga , A  Trai  , ïa ka jingmut jong ki aiñ jong me , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ki ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hikai ia nga ko Trai, ka lynti jong ki ain jong me ; bad ngan buh ia ka haduh kaba kut .

en: Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
kha: Ka jingieit kaba khraw tam kaba u briew u lah ban don na ka bynta ki paralok jong u ka long ban aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingieit kaba kham khraw kam don briew ban ia kane , ba u briew u buh ia la ka jingim na ka bynta ki paralok jong u .

en: They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .
kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah ban ïohsngew ; kim lah wat ban pynhiar mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim iohsngew shuh shuh bad ym don mynsiem ha ka shyntur jong ki .

en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .
kha: Bad ym dei u Adam uba la shah shukor ; dei ka kynthei kaba la shah shukor bad pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Adam um shym la shah thok , hynrei ka kynthei ka la shah thok ka la long ha ka jingpynkhein .

en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us : for we are not ignorant of his devices .
kha: Haba phi map ïano ïano ïa kaei kaba u la leh , nga ruh nga map ïa u kumjuh . Naba haba nga map — lada , shisha , ka dei ïa nga ban map ïa kano kano — nga leh ïa kata ha khmat U Khrist namar jong phi , khnang ban ym shah ïa u Soitan ban leh donbor halor jong ngi ; naba ngi tip kiei ki jingthmu jong u ki long .
translated_en_to_kha: U Soitan u dei ban ioh jingmyntoi ia ngi: namar ngim long kiba khlem jingtip ia ki tiar jong u .

en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah shipai jong ki bad ki nongap phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka kynhun bad u kapten bad ki ophisar jong ki Jiw ki la shim ia U Jisu bad ki la teh ia u .

en: Honour thy father and thy mother : and , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
kha: burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ; bad to ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia la u kpa bad ia la ka kmie : bad , Me dei ban ieit ia la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ia lade .

en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .
kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u ïaisah ha U Blei u dei ban im kumba U Jisu Khrist u la im .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ong u la sah ha u ruh kumta ban iaid, kumba u la iaid .

en: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me , and there are many adversaries .
kha: Ka don ka kabu da shisha hangne na ka bynta ka jingtrei kaba khraw bad kaba myntoi , wat lada don bun ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingkhang kaba khraw bad kaba treikam ha nga , bad ki don bun ki nongshun .

en: Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .
kha: To ïa-pdiang iwei ïa iwei te , na ka bynta ka burom jong U Blei , kumba U Khrist u la pdiang ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pdiang iwei ia iwei pat kumba U Khrist ruh u la pdiang ia ngi sha ka burom U Blei .

en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
kha: Na ka khet jong u ha bneng U Trai u rkhie u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki jingthmu batlot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shong ha ki bneng un rkhie: U Trai un don ia ki ha ka jingshah lehbein .

en: That ye would walk worthy of God , who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory .
kha: Ngi la pynshlur ïa phi , ngi la pyntngen ïa phi , bad ngi ïai kyrpad ïa phi ban im ka jingim kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba khot ïa phi ban ïa-ïoh bynta lem ha ka Hima bad ka burom jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin iaid hok ia U Blei uba la khot ia phi sha ka hima bad ka burom jong u .

en: Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it , and received instruction .
kha: Nga peit ïa kane , nga la pyrkhat shaphang jong ka , bad nga ïoh ka jinghikai na ka :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iohi , bad nga la pyrkhat bha: Nga la peit ia ka , bad nga la ioh jinghikai .

en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .
kha: Kito kiba lait im kin ïap ha ka jingpang , bad wat ki tnga jong ki kin ym ïam na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba sah na u kin shah tep ha ka jingiap: bad ki riewkynthei jong u kin ym iam .

en: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works , and by works was faith made perfect ?
kha: Hato phim ïohi ? Ka jingngeit jong u bad ki kam jong u ki ïatreilang ; ïa ka jingngeit jong u la pynlong janai da ki kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi ia ka jingngeit kaba la leh da ki kam jong u , bad da ki kam la pynlong ia ka jingngeit kaba janai ?

en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it , the cattle also concerning the vapour .
kha: U pyrthat u pynbna ïa ka jingwan ka  erïong bad ki jingri ki tip ba kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong ka ka paw shaphang jong ka , ki masi ruh shaphang ka lyer .

en: I am come to send fire on the earth  ; and what will I , if it be already kindled ?
kha: Nga la wan ban pynmeh ding ïa ka pyrthei , bad katno nga kwah ba ïa ka , la lah pynmeh lypa !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga wan ban phah ding ha ka khyndew ; bad ngan leh aiu lada ka la dep ban thang ?

en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .
kha: U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah laiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi baroh kiba u Adam u la im ki long hynniew spah laiphew snem: bad u la iap .

en: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart , and said , Why could not we cast him out ?
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu ha kaba jar jar bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u ksuid shabar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu shabar bad ki la ong: Balei ngim lah ban beh noh ia u ?

en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness  ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth .
kha: Namar ka jingieit baneh jong me , to long uba bha ïa nga , khnang ba ngan lah ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia nga hadien ka jingieit jong me ; kumta ngan bat ia ka jingphla jong ka shyntur jong me .

en: From above the horse gate repaired the priests , every one over against his house .
kha: Ka kynhun ki lyngdoh , ka tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba kiew shaphang shatei na ka Khyrdop Kulai , uwei uwei u tei ha khmat ka ïing jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na jrong ka khyrdop kulai ka la pynbha ia ki lyngdoh , uwei pa uwei u la leit sha ka iing jong u .

en: Then Eli called Samuel , and said , Samuel , my son . And he answered , Here am I .
kha: U Eli u la khot ïa u ,  Ko Samuel , ko khun jong nga !   Oi , kynrad ,  u Samuel u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eli u la khot ia u Samuel bad u la ong, u Samuel, u khun jong nga . Bad u la jubab , Hangne nga don .

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai ; namar u long uba bha: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki mraw ba ki shong da ki kulai katba ki riewdonburom ki ïaid da ka kjat kum ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ki shakri halor ki kulai , bad ki syiem kiba iaid kum ki shakri halor ka khyndew .

en: Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?
kha: Kata ka briew ka ong ha u ,  Kynrad , hato nga pan khun shynrang na phi ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi ban ym kyntiew ïa ki jingkyrmen jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ong: Hato nga kwah ia u khun jong u kynrad jong nga ? hato ngam shym la ong , Wat pynbiej ia nga ?

en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .
kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel haduh arphew lai snem . Nangta u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Shamir .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bishar ia ki Israel arphew lai snem, bad u la iap, bad la tep ia u ha Shamir .

en: And the  Lord  spake to Manasseh , and to his people : but they would not hearken .
kha: Wat la U  Trai  u la maham ïa u Manasseh bad ïa ki briew jong u , ki kyntait ban shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Manasseh bad ha ki briew jong u: hynrei kim shym la sngap .

en: Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .
kha: Bad to khmih ïa ki jingdonkam jong iwei ïa iwei pat , ym tang ïa la ka jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat peit ia uwei pa uwei ha la ka jong ka jong ka kam , hynrei uwei pa uwei ruh ha ki kam jong kiwei pat .

en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .
kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei ngan puson ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bymman ki la ap ia nga ban pynjot ia nga: hynrei ngan pyrkhat ia ki jingphla jong me .

en: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith . Grace be with thee . Amen .
kha: Don kiba kam ba ki don ïa ka , bad kaba mih ka long ba ki jah noh na ka lynti jong ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei jong U Blei to kan long bad phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba don kiba la kam bakla shaphang ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei kan long bad me . Amen .

en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .
kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ,  To rai hapdeng jong nga bad u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  La kdew ïa u Jonathan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong, To buh ia nga bad u Jonathan jong nga . Bad u Jonathan u la shah shim .

en: A greyhound  ; an he goat also  ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .
kha: ki  langsohmoh , ki  iar-ryngkuh kiba ïaid pyn-at shadem , bad u syiem ha khmat ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U blang uba heh; u blang ruh u blang bad u syiem , pyrshah ia uba ym don ba kiew shaneng .

en: He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  U briew uba la bet ïa u symbai babha u long U Khun U Briew ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Uta uba bet ia u symbai uba bha u long U Khun u briew ; .

en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it : for his mercy endureth for ever :
kha: u la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba jong ka , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban iaid lyngba pdeng jong ka: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom:

en: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshai yn leh kumno ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia u ha ka ward , namar ym shym la pynbna ia kaei kaba dei ban leh ia u .

en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty ? go down , and be thou laid with the uncircumcised .
kha: Ong ha ki :  Hato me tharai ba me kham bhabriew ban ïano ïano ruh ? Men leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad thiah hangta hapdeng ki bymriewblei .
translated_en_to_kha: Iano me iaid ha ka jingitynnad ? leit shapoh bad to shah set bad ki bym pat shah ot .

en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth ? or who hath disposed the whole world ?
kha: Hato U Blei u ïoh ka bor na uwei pat ? Hato don uno uno uba buh ïa u ban peit halor ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la ai ia u ia ka jingsynshar halor ka khyndew ? lane mano ba la pynbeit ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei ?

en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly : and indeed bear with me .
kha: Nga da kwah ba phin ïaishah bad nga , wat haba nga leh bieit khyndiat . Sngewbha leh kumta!
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ha U Blei phi lah ban shah ia nga khyndiat ha ka jinglong ba sniew jong nga: bad shisha shah ia nga .

en: He hath turned aside my ways , and pulled me in pieces : he hath made me desolate .
kha: U beh krad ïa nga sharud surok , u tar lyngkhot ïa nga , bad u iehnoh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphai noh ia ki lynti jong nga, bad u la tan ia nga ha ki bynta: u la pynlong ia nga ban jah rngai noh .

en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land : he brake the whole staff of bread .
kha: U  Trai  u la phah  nemsniew sha ka ri jong ki bad u la shim noh ïa baroh ka jingbam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la khot ia ka jingkyrduh ha ka ri: u la pynkhih ia u dieng kpu baroh kawei .

en: If I must needs glory , I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities .
kha: Lada nga dei ban sngewsarong , ngan sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba pyn-i haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga dei ban donkam ia ka burom , ngan sngew sarong ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad ki jingduna jong nga .

en: If we say that we have no sin , we deceive ourselves , and the truth is not in us .
kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim don pop , ngi shukor ïa lade , bad ka jingshisha kam don ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim don pop , ngi shukor ia lade bad ka jingshisha kam don ha ngi .

en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness , so that there is no place clean .
kha: Ïa ki miej ha kiba ki shong la tap da ka prie bad ym don shuh ka bynta kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki miej baroh ki dap da ka jingsma bad ka jingjakhlia , kumta ym don jaka kaba khuid .

en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense .
kha: katba u paidbah habar u la duwai ha ka kynta ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah baroh kawei u la duwai shabar ha ka por ba mih ka jingiwbih .

en: And am no more worthy to be called thy son : make me as one of thy hired servants .
kha: Ngam long uba dei ba yn khot u khun jong phi ; to ñiew ïa nga tang kum uwei na ki nongtrei wai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam long shuh uba bit ban shah khot u khun jong me: pynlong ia nga kum uwei na ki shakri ba la thung kam jong me .

en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;
kha: U la ong ba un pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad kynmaw ïa ka jutang bakyntang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban leh ia ka jingisynei kaba la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad ban kynmaw ia ka jutang bakhuid jong u ; .

en: When they heard that , they were cut to the heart , and took counsel to slay them .
kha: Haba ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la bitar shla haduh katta katta ba ki la kwah ban phah pynïap ïa ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la shah pynmong ha ka dohnud , bad ki la shim jingmut ban pyniap ia ki .

en: If any man s work abide which he hath built thereupon , he shall receive a reward .
kha: Lada kaei kaba la tei ha ka nongrim kam ing ha ka ding , u nongtei un ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u kohnguh ia kaba u la tei hangta , un ioh ia ka bainong .

en: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
kha: Halor kane baroh , kaei kaba ngi lah ban ong ? Lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi lah ban ong aiu ia kine kiei kiei ? Lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba lah ban long pyrshah ia ngi ?

en: The flesh also , in which , even in the skin thereof , was a boil , and is healed ,
kha: Haba uno uno u briew u mih tohjaw bad u la jem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh ruh ha kaba, wat ha ka sniehdoh jong ka, ka la rkhiang bad ka la koit .

en: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and took the royal city .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Joab u nang bteng ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ki Ammon , bad u la jan ïohknieh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Rabbah na ki khun Ammon bad u la shim ia ka shnong syiem .

en: For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  , bad ngam ju kylla . Bad kumta ma phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , phim pat shym la jah noh khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga long U Trai , ngam kylla ; namarkata phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob phim shah pynjot .

en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .
kha: Ym don mano mano nabar ka kynhun kiba la nud ban ïasoh bad ki , wat la ki paidbah ki la kren ïaroh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na kiwei pat ym don mano mano ruh kiba iasoh bad ki: hynrei ki briew ki la pynkhraw ia ki .

en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness ; and hold such in reputation :
kha: To pdiang ïa u , te , da ka jingkmen , kum u para ha U Trai . To phin ñiewburom ïa kiba kum kita ki briew kum ma u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pdiang ia u namarkata ha U Trai da ka jingkmen baroh ; bad bat ia u ha ka nam:

en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .
kha: Na ka jaka ba u synshar , u khmih shapoh halor baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jaka shong jong u u peit ia ki nongshong shnong baroh jong ka khyndew .

en: But they are altogether brutish and foolish : the stock is a doctrine of vanities .
kha: Ma ki baroh ki long kiba mutlop bad kiba bieit . Aïu ki lah ban nang na ki bleithaw dieng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki long kiba sniew bad kiba bieit: ka stock ka long ka jinghikai jong ki jinglong ba sniew .

en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”
kha: Ka Baibl ka ong : “U Blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei baroh ba u la thaw , ha khmih ruh , ka la bha eh .”
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Baibl ka ong: U Blei u la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la thaw bad , peit ! ka la long kaba bha shibun .

en: Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .
kha: Ai ba kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin wan sha nga — kito baroh kiba tip ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba kito kiba tieng ia me kin phai sha nga , bad kito kiba la ithuh ia ki jingphla jong me .

en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .
kha: Lada u bieit katta katta ban shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka jingsniew kan long ka bainong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uta uba la shah thok ha ka jinglong ba sniew: namar ka jinglong ba sniew kan long ka jingsiew kylliang jong u .

en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u tei ia ka Jerusalem: u lum lang ia ki nong Israel .

en: And now I ask one petition of thee , deny me not . And she said unto him , Say on .
kha: Bad mynta nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata ?  ka Bathsheba ka kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga kylli ia kawei ka jingkyrpad jong me, wat kyntait ia nga . Bad ka la ong ha u , To ong .

en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt , he sent out our fathers first .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym shem jingbam ei ei , bad haba u Jakob u la ïohsngew ba don kew ha Ijipt , u la phah ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ha ka jingleit banyngkong jong ki shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Jakob u la iohsngew ba don u kew ha Ijipt , u la phah shwa ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: Then did he see it , and declare it  ; he prepared it , yea , and searched it out .
kha: Ka long hangta ba u ïohi ïa ka jingstad bad u tynjuh ïa ka dor jong ka — U ai ïa ka , ka jingmynjur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la iohi ia ka, bad u la pynbna ia ka ; u la pynkhreh ia ka, hooid, bad u la wad ia ka .

en: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :
kha: Wat shim kabu ïa kiba duk tang namar ba phi lah ; wat shim kabu ïa kito kiba ïeng khlem jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Rob ym ia kiba duk , namar u long uba duk: ym pynshitom bein ia kiba shah shitom ha ka khyrdop:

en: Who shall declare his way to his face ? and who shall repay him what he hath done ?
kha: Ym don mano mano u ban pharep ïa u briew uba sniew lane ban siew kylliang ïa u na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba pynbna ia ka lynti jong u sha ka khmat jong u ? bad mano ba siew kylliang ia u ia kaei kaba u la leh ?

en: And whether it be cow or ewe , ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day .
kha: Wat kñia ha kajuh ka sngi ïa ka masi bad u khun jong ka , ïa ka langbrot bad u khun jong ka , lane ïa ka blang bad u khun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ka long ka masi ne ka langbrot , phin ym pyniap ia ka bad ia ki khun jong ka baroh arngut ha kawei ka sngi .

en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food .
kha: U briew uba don ha ka bor uba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk u long kum u  lapbah  lapsan uba pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba duk uba pynshitom bein ia kiba duk u long kum u slap uba tuid um uba iehnoh ia ka jingbam .

en: Which also they did , and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul .
kha: Te ki la leh ïa kane , bad ki la phah ïa ka pisa sha ki tymmen basan jong ka balang lyngba u Barnabas bad u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ki ruh ki la leh , bad ki la phah sha ki rangbah da ki kti u Barnabas bad u Saul .

en: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :
kha: To long kum ki khunlung kiba dang shu kha , kiba kwah hir hir borabor ïa ka dud bakhuid ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ba da kaba dih ïa ka phin san bad yn pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ki babes ba dang kha thymmai, kwah ia ka dud ba shisha jong ka ktien , ba phin nangroi da kata:

en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
kha: Bad haba nga la sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long halor jong ngi ha kaba sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba nga dang sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la hap halor jong ki kumba ha ngi ha kaba sdang .

en: To teach when it is unclean , and when it is clean : this is the law of leprosy .
kha: Kine ki aiñ ki batai shai kumno yn leh haba kaei kaei ka long ka bymkhuid bad haba ka la long khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban hikai haba ka long kaba khlem khuid , bad haba ka long kaba khuid: kane ka long ka ain jong ka jingpang sniehdoh .

en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :
kha: U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari , kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong kita ki kur kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki . U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Libni bad u Shimei ; u Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel ; bad u Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki ïing kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka jaitbynriew jong ki Kohathi na ki Lebi:

en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit , when our rest together is in the dust .
kha: Ka jingkyrmen kan ym ïaid lang bad nga haba ngan hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin hiar sha ki bar jong ka thliew , haba ka jingjahthait jong ngi ka don ha ka dewbilat .

en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;
kha: Bad ban ïaroh bad pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  man ka step bad man ka janmiet ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban ieng man ka step ban ainguh bad iaroh ia U Trai , bad kumjuh ruh ha ka por mynstep ; .

en: And if it bear fruit , well : and if not , then after that thou shalt cut it down .
kha: Te lada u dieng u pynmih soh Dumbur ha ka snem kaba bud , katta kan kham bha ; lymda kumta , te phi lah ban phah khet noh ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka sei soh, bha: bad lada ym dei, te hadien kata to ot noh ia ka .

en: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him , and he halted upon his thigh .
kha: Ka sngi ka la mih haba u Jakob u mihnoh na Peniel , u da ïaid dkoh namar kata ka skhep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang iaid lyngba ia u Penuel ka sngi ka la kiew halor jong u , bad u la sangeh ha ka tyrpeng jong u .

en: Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .
kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang sha ki pung-um , bad ïa ki synrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew kiba tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la pynkylla ia u maw sha ka um kaba ieng , ka um ka la kylla long ka pung um .

en: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this !
kha: U Balaam u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Kiei kine ki briew kiba ïalumlang shaphang shatei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pharshi jong u bad u la ong: Alas, mano ba im ynda U Blei un leh ia kane !

en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
kha: Te uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la iathuh ha ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la pynlong ia u uba koit ba khiah .

en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Blei u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Blei u la pyndem ha kata ka sngi u Jabin u syiem Kana ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
kha: bad ki la ong ,  Phi dei ban ong ba ki synran jong u ki la wan mynmiet bad ki la tuh ïa ka met jong u katba phi dang ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , To ong ia phi , ki synran jong U ki la wan miet , bad ki la tuh noh ia u katba ngi dang thiah .

en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble ? was not my soul grieved for the poor ?
kha: Hato ngam shym la ïam bad ki briew ba shem jingeh bad sngewsih ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingkyrduh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngam shym la iam na ka bynta uta uba la don ha ka jingeh ? hato ka mynsiem jong nga kam shym la sngewsih na ka bynta kiba duk ?

en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .
kha: Bad ïa pha , ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade shaduh sha bneng ? Yn bret ïa pha sha tbian sha dujok !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, Kapernam, uba la shah pynkiew sha bneng, yn sa pynhap shapoh dujok .

en: Let thy tender mercies come unto me , that I may live : for thy law is my delight .
kha: To isynei ïa nga , bad ngan im ; namar nga shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ki jingsngewrit jong me kin wan ha nga, ba ngan im: namar ka hukum jong me ka long ka jingsngewbha jong nga .

en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .
kha: bad sa ar tylli ki jingker ïa ki dong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki board men pynlong ia ki tduh jong ka ïingjaiñ ha ki arliang .

en: Trikuta , the triple peak , is where the holy shrine of Vaishno Devi can be found .
kha: Ka Trikuta , ka tduh kaba lai , ka dei ka jaka ba lah ban shem ia ka jaka mane blei kyntang jong ka Vaishno Devi .
translated_en_to_kha: Trikuta , ka jaka mane blei kaba khuid jong ka Vaishno Devi lah ban shem .

en: Submit yourselves therefore to God . Resist the devil , and he will flee from you .
kha: Kumta te , to pyndem ha U Blei . To ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Bymman , bad un phet ïap noh na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduna ia lade namarkata ha U Blei . Pynbeit ia u ksuid , bad un phet noh na phi .

en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
kha: U jop ruh ïa ki Moab kiba kylla long ki raïot jong u bad siew khajna sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia u Moab bad ki nongshong shnong ki la kylla long ki shakri jong u Dabid bad u la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha .

en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , phin sa tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad phin sa lah ban sngewthuh shaphang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngewthuh ia ka jingtieng ia U Trai , bad to shem ia ka jingtip U Blei .

en: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .
kha: Lada phi ngeit , phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiei kiei baroh, kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai, da kaba ngeit, phin sa ioh .

en: A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him .
kha: Ki jingsawa ba-sngewtriem kin pah ha ki shkor jong ki , bad ki nonglute kin wan kurup ïa ki haba ki dang pyrkhat ba ki shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur kaba shyrkhei ka don ha ki shkor jong u: ha ka jingroi jingpar u nongpynjot un wan ha u .

en: And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .
kha: haba saw ngut ki rangbah ki la poi , ki da rah ïa u briew uba pang ïapshiliang sha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan sha u, ki wanrah ia uwei uba pang na ka jingpang sniehdoh, uba la kha saw ngut .

en: There is a generation that curseth their father , and doth not bless their mother .
kha: Don ki briew kiba tim ïa la ki kpa bad ki bym ju pyn-i ïa la ka jingïaroh ïa la ki kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka pateng kaba tim ia la u kpa , bad kam kyrkhu ia la ka kmie .

en: Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .
kha: Kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba phi la nang . Ka jingnang jingtip jong phi ka dei ka jingim jong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim stet ia ka jinghikai ; wat ai ba kan leit: to buh ia ka ; namar ka long ka jingim jong me .

en: We follow strict guidelines to ensure all complaints are addressed within 48 hours.
kha: Ngi bud ïa ki kyndon kiba pyrkhing ban pynthikna ba baroh ki jingujor kin shah pynbeit hapoh 48 kynta.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi bud ia ki kyndon kiba pyrkhing ban pynthikna ba baroh ki jingujor ki shah pynbeit hapoh 48 kynta.

en: Where the birds make their nests : as for the stork , the fir trees are her house .
kha: Hangta ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ; ki thring ki shna skum ha ki dieng Kseh
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki sim ki shna ia ki bniat jong ki: kumba long u khnai , ki dieng ki long ka iing jong ka .

en: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests : and we shall reign on the earth .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki , ka hima ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei jong ngi , bad kin synshar ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la pynlong ia ngi ha U Blei jong ngi: bad ngin synshar ha ka khyndew .

en: Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?
kha: U Blei u tyrwa ha me ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me dang kyntait ïa ka ? Ngi la ïakren bad u ha ki ktien bajai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki jingpyntngen jong U Blei ki long kiba rit bad me ? hato don kaei kaei kaba rieh bad me ?

en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
kha: Namar mynhynne ka miet u angel jong U Blei ha uba nga long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hangta u angel U Blei uba nga long bad uba nga shakri .

en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Blei u ong ha u Nathan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kajuh ka miet , ba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan ha u Nathan da kaba ong:

en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .
kha: Uno uno u bym bah ïa la ka diengphna bad wan nadien jong nga , um lah ban long u synran jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym kit ia ka diengphna jong u bad u wan hadien jong nga, um lah ban long u synran jong nga .

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai ; namar u long uba bha: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga bad wat klet ïa ki ktien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga mynta , ko khun , bad wat leit noh na ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong nga .

en: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .
kha: Nangta U Petros u la kren ,  Khmih , ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la sdang ban ong ha u, Lo, ngi la iehnoh ia baroh, bad ngi la bud ia me .

en: Behold , a king shall reign in righteousness , and princes shall rule in judgment .
kha: Kan don ka sngi ha kaba yn don u syiem u ban synshar ha ka jinglong ba-beit , bad ki nongïalam ka ri ki ban synshar ha ka jinglehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u syiem un synshar ha ka hok , bad ki syiem kin synshar ha ka jingbishar .

en: Ye that fear the  Lord  , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi baroh kiba mane ïa u . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba sheptieng ia U Trai , to shaniah ha U Trai: u long ka jingiarap jong ki bad ka jingda jong ki .

en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .
kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah , pynban , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kum ki kynroh bajrong bakhlaiñ sawdong ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah jong u briew uba riewspah ka long ka nongbah kaba skhem jong u, bad kum ka kynroh kaba jrong ha la ka jong ka jaka .

en: And the man did as Joseph bade  ; and the man brought the men into Joseph s house .
kha: Uta u shakri u leh kumba la hukum ïa u , bad u leit ïalam ïa kita shi para sha ka ïing u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u la leh kumba u Joseph u la ong bad uta u briew u la wanrah ia kita ki briew shapoh iing u Joseph .

en: But covet earnestly the best gifts : and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way .
kha: Namarkata , to puson ha ki dohnud jong phi , halor ki jingai kiba kham donkam . Pynban , kaba bha tam ka long ka rukom kaba bud nangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to kwah eh ia ki jingai kiba bha tam: bad pynban nga pyni ha phi ia ka lynti kaba kham bha .

en: In 1939 aged 15 , she made her first broadcast on BBC Radio for Children ' s Hour .
kha: Ha ka snem 1939 ha ka rta kaba 15 snem , ka la pynmih nyngkong eh ia ka ha ka BBC Radio na ka bynta ka por jong ki khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem 1939 ha ka rta kaba 15 snem , ka la pynlong ia ka jingpynbna ba nyngkong jong ka ha ka BBC Radio na ka bynta ki Khynnah Khynnah .

en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless , they take the widow s ox for a pledge .
kha: Ki shim ïa ki kada kiba dei jong ki khunswet , bad bat ïa u masi kyrtong jong ka riewkynthei haduh ba kan da dep siew ïa ka ram jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki beh noh ia ka tdong jong ki bym don kpa , ki shim ia u masi masi ba la tyrkhong na ka bynta ka jingkular .

en: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .
kha: U paidbah baroh u la jubab ,  Ai ba ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u kan hap halor jong ngi bad halor ki khun jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia ki briew baroh, bad u la ong , Ka snam jong u kan long halor jong ngi bad halor ki khun jong ngi .

en: Every man praying or prophesying , having his head covered , dishonoureth his head .
kha: Kumta u briew uba duwai lane pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang da kaba tap ïa la ka khlieh u pynjahburom ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew uba duwai ne uba iathuhlypa, uba la tap ia ka khlieh jong u , u pynjah burom ia ka khlieh jong u .

en: The constituency of Tilak Nagar is a part of the West Delhi Lok Sabha constituency .
kha: Ka Constituency ka Tilak Nagar ka dei ka bynta jong ka West Delhi Lok Sabha Constituency .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Constituency jong ka Tilak Nagar ka dei ka bynta jong ka West Delhi Lok Sabha constituency .

en: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea , man giveth up the ghost , and where is he ?
kha: Hynrei u briew u ïap noh , bad kata ka long kaba kut jong u ; u ïap bad hangno keiñ u don ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u briew u iap, bad u jah noh: Hooid, u briew u ai ia u ksuid bad shano u don ?

en: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy , and whom he will he hardeneth .
kha: Kumta te , U Blei u isynei ïa uno uno uba u kwah , bad u pyneh dohnud ïa uno uno uba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la isynei ia uba un isynei bad uba u kwah .

en: So went the present over before him : and himself lodged that night in the company .
kha: U phah ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha shuwa jong u bad u la sahmiet ha kata ka miet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit sha khmat jong u: bad ma u hi u la sah ha kata ka miet ha ka kompeni .

en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought unto the priest  ;
kha: Lada uno uno u briew u ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban ïalam ïa u ha u lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh ka don ha u briew , nangta yn wanrah ia u sha u lyngdoh ; .

en: And he would not : but went and cast him into prison , till he should pay the debt .
kha: Hynrei u kyntait ; pynban , u la phah thep byndi ïa u tad haduh ba u dei ban siew ïa ka ram .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym: hynrei u la leit bret ia u ha phatok , haduh ba un da siew ia ka ram .

en: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .
kha: Bad nga da kyrpad jur ïa phi ban duwai ba U Blei un phah pat ïa nga sha phi kham kloi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga kyrpad ia phi ban leh ia kane, ba ngan sa wan phai noh kloi sha phi .

en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .
kha: ka kynhun shipai Judia ka la shahjop , bad ki shipai ki la phet sha la ki ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la kham sniew ha khmat ki Israel , bad ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka ïingjaiñ .

en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngi don ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jingkwah jong ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko para bangeit , ngi long ki nongkit ram , ym ia ka doh , ban im katkum ka doh .

en: Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .
kha: Pynban , palat ban ïa kaei kaei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la ngi don ha kane ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi trei shitom, kata , la ka long kaba don ne kaba khlem don , ngi lah ban shah pdiang na u .

en: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us : for after that he had said before ,
kha: Bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh u ai ha ngi ïa ka sakhi jong u . Nyngkong u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh u long u sakhi ia ngi: namar hadien kata u la ong mynshuwa .

en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
kha: Pynphong ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u bad teh halor jong ka ïa ka dak bakyntang jong ka jingpynkyntang ba la thoh ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ka khlieh jong u, bad buh ia ka khlieh bakhuid halor ka khlieh .

en: During the same period of the last UDF government , 4 , 791 appointments were made .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por jong ka sorkar UDF ba la dep , la thung 4, 791 ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por jong ka sorkar UDF kaba khatduh , 4 , 791 tylli ki jingthung la leh .

en: And I said , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest .
kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . Bad U Trai u la jubab , ‘ Nga long U Jisu , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong, Me long mano ko Trai ? Bad u la ong , Nga long U Jisu uba me pynshitom bein .

en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass , and he hath set darkness in my paths .
kha: U Blei u la khang ïa ka lynti , bad ngam lah ban ïaid lyngba ; u la buhrieh ïa ka lynti jong nga ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyntait ia ka lynti jong nga ba ngam lah ban iaid , bad u la buh ia ka jingdum ha ki lynti jong nga .

en: And he said unto me , Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here .
kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Rung shapoh , bad peit ïa kaba sniew , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki ïaleh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha nga, To leit rung, bad peit ia ki jingleh bymman kiba ki leh hangne .

en: Nicodemus saith unto them , ( he that came to Jesus by night , being one of them , )
kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi hangta u dei u Nikodemos , u briew uba la leit mynshuwa ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nikodemus u ong ha ki , (u uba wan sha U Jisu ha ka por miet, u long uwei na ki , )

en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .
kha: Ka jingieid kam julam jingsniew ia ki marjan , namarkata , ka jinieid ka jingpyndap pynkmen jong ka kyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingieit kam don jingma ia u paramarjan jong u: namarkata ka jingieit ka long ka jingpyndep ia ka ain .

en: But as for thee and thy servants , I know that ye will not yet fear the  Lord  God .
kha: Hynrei nga tip ba ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phim pat sheptieng ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia me bad ki shakri jong me , nga tip ba phin ym tieng ia U Trai Blei .

en: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth  ; and the honourable man dwelt in it .
kha: Phi pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi bad ïa ka kyrdan jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka jaka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u briew uba donbor u don ka khyndew ; bad u briew uba donburom u shong ha ka .

en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food , where all the beasts of the field play .
kha: U phlang ban bsa ïa u , u mih ha ki lum ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki ïalehkai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ki lum ki wanrah ia u jingbam , ha kaba ki mrad baroh ki ialehkai .

en: And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew ,  La map ïa ki pop jong me , ko paralok jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohi ia ka jingngeit jong ki, u la ong ha u, ko briew, la map ia ki pop jong me .

en: Servants have ruled over us : there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand .
kha: Ïa ngi la synshar da ki rangbah kiba long kum ki mraw hi , bad ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka bor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri ki la synshar ia ngi: ym don mano mano ruh kiba pyllait ia ngi na ka kti jong ki .

en: And , behold , seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .
kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad ba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kiba met .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba rit bad ki la bthei da ka Iyer mihngi ka la mih hadien jong ki .

en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me , yea , four which I know not :
kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba phylla eh ïa nga ba ngan shemphang :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don lai tylli kiei kiei kiba phylla palat ia nga , hooid , saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ngam tip:

en: For as we have many members in one body , and all members have not the same office :
kha: Ngi don bun ki dkhot ha kawei ka met bad baroh kine ki dkhot ki don ki jingtreikam bapher bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ngi don bun ki dkhot ha kawei ka met , bad baroh ki dkhot kim don kajuh ka ophis:

en: Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .
kha: Lada uno uno u la leh bymdei ïa phi , to wat siew kylliang ïa u da ka bymdei . To pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba baroh ki ñiew ba ka long kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia u briew uba sniew na ka bynta ka jingsniew . Ai ia kiei kiei kiba hok ha khmat ki briew baroh .

en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .
kha: Wat kular ban kitkhlieh na ka bynta ki ram jong kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long ma me uwei na kita uba ktah kti , ne na kita kiba thikna na ka bynta ki ram .

en: The government recently shifted IDBI Banks MD and CEO Kishor Kharat to Indian Bank .
kha: Dang shen ka sorkar ka la pynkynriah ia u MD bad u CEO jong ka IDBI u Kishor Kharat sha ka Indian Bank .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sorkar dang shen ka la pynkylla ia ka IDBI Bank MD bad CEO u Kishor Kharat sha ka Indian Bank .

en: You can contact our grievance cell directly at [phone/email] for escalated concerns.
kha: Phi lah ban ïakynduh beit ïa ka cell jingujor jong ngi ha [phone/email] na ka bynta ki jingeh kiba la nang kiew.
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban iakynduh beit ia ka cell jong ngi ha [ka phone/ka email] na ka bynta ki jingeh kiba nang jur.

en: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .
kha: Haba un pyrshang ban phet ïap na ka waitlam nar , ka ryntieh rnong kan siat ban pynkyllon ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Un phet noh na ka tiar nar , bad ka bow nar kan shoh ia u lyngba .

en: Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .
kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel um ithuh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki ong , U Trai un ym iohi , lymne U Blei u Jakob un ym khein ia ka .

en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :
kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka hok bad u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ba la pynksan da ka jingaiei jong u lyngba ka jingpynim kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu:

en: Dost thou know when God disposed them , and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?
kha: Hato me tip kumno U Blei u ai hukum bad u pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba na ki lyoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me tip haba U Blei u la pynkylla ia ki , bad u la pynlong ia ka jingshai jong u lyoh jong u ban shai ?

en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
kha: Ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah borabor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong u bymman ka kwah ia kaba sniew: u para marjan jong u um shem jingsngewbha ha ki khmat jong u .

en: For there is one God , and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ;
kha: Naba don tang uwei U Blei , bad don uwei uba pynwan lang ïa U Blei bad ïa u khunbynriew , U Khrist Jisu uba long ruh u briew , uba la aiti ïa lade ban siewspah ïa ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar don uwei u Blei bad uwei u nongpyniasuk hapdeng U Blei bad ki briew, u briew U Khrist Jisu ; .

en: Scuffle between CBI and Kolkata policemen at commissioner Rajeev Kumar ' s residence
kha: Ka jingiakajia hapdeng ki pulit ka CBI bad ka Kolkata ha iing sah jong u commissioner Rajeev Kumar
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingïakynad hapdeng ki pulit jong ka CBI bad Kolkata ha ka jaka sah jong u commissioner u Rajev Kumar .

en: Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?
kha: Me mane ïa U Blei , bad ka jingim jong me ka long ka bym shah kynnoh pop ; bad kumta me dei ban don ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam dei ka jingtieng jong me, ka jingshaniah jong me, ka jingkyrmen jong me bad ka jinglong hok jong ki lynti jong me ?

en: It is a faithful saying : For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :
kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha :  Lada ngi la ïap bad u , ngin sa ïoh im ruh lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingong kaba iaineh: Namar lada ngi la iap bad u , ngin im ruh bad u:

en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :
kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sdang ban shakri ïa ki Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad ki la shakri ia u Baalim:

en: But a lover of hospitality , a lover of good men , sober , just , holy , temperate ;
kha: U dei ban long uba lehsbun bad uba ieit ïa kaei kaba bha . U dei ban long uba synshar ïa lade , uba beit , u bakhuid , bad uba leh ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u nongieit ia ka jingpdiang sngewbha, u nongieit ia ki briew kiba bha, uba jem, uba hok, uba khuid, uba jem;

en: He said the CCTV footage of the area was being analysed to identify the miscreants .
kha: U la ong ba dang bishar bniah ia ki dur CCTV jong katei ka jaka ban ithuh ia ki nongleh kam sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ba la bishar bniah ia ki dur CCTV jong katei ka jaka ban ithuh ia ki nongleh bymman .

en: And they twain shall be one flesh : so then they are no more twain , but one flesh .
kha: bad baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’ Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki arngut kin long kawei ka doh: kumta kim long shuh arngut hynrei kawei ka doh .

en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab . And there was a sore famine in Samaria .
kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit . Ka  nemsniew ha Samaria ka la don ha ka por kaba jur bha ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la leit pyni ia lade ha u Ahab . Bad ka la don ka jingkyrduh kaba jur ha Samaria .

en: We are disappointed , but it is better to have better feeling in the way we played .
kha: Ngi la sngewsih , hynrei ka bha ban don ka jingsngew kaba kham bha ha ka rukom ialehkai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la sngewsih , hynrei ka kham bha ban don ka jingsngew kaba kham bha ha ka rukom ialehkai jong ngi .

en: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city , knit together as one man .
kha: Kumta baroh ki rangbah ha Israel ki ïalumlang na ka bynta kawei ka jingthmu — ban tur ïaleh ïa kata ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta baroh ki briew Israel ki la ialum lang pyrshah ia ka shnong , ki ia tyngkhuh lang kum uwei u briew .

en: Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?
kha: Hato uno uno na phi uba long u kpa un ai ïa la u khun da u maw haba u pan ïa u kpu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane uei u briew uba don na phi uba lada u khun jong u u pan kpu , un ai maw ia u ?

en: With my whole heart have I sought thee : O let me not wander from thy commandments .
kha: Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga pyrshang ban shakri ïa me ; to sumar ïa nga na ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka dohnud baroh nga la wad ia me: O wat ai ba ngan iaid na ki hukum jong me .

en: For if God spared not the natural branches , take heed lest he also spare not thee .
kha: U Blei um shym la pyllait ïa ki Jiw , kiba long kum ki tnat tynrai ; hato phi pyrkhat un pyllait ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada U Blei um shym la pyllait ia ki tnat ba kynja met , to sumar bha ioh ba un ym pyllait ia me ruh .

en: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule : but the slothful shall be under tribute .
kha: Ka jingtrei shitom kan ai bor ïa phi ; kaba leh jaipdeh kan pynlong mraw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti jong u nongtrei shitom kan long kaba synshar: hynrei ka sniehdoh kan long hapoh ka jingsiew .

en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body , yet in my flesh shall I see God :
kha: Wat lada hadien ba la bam noh ïa ka doh jong nga da ka jingpang , wat ha kane hi ka met ngan ïohi ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la hadien ki khniang sniehdoh jong nga kin pynjot ia kane ka met , hynrei ha ka doh jong nga ngan iohi ia U Blei:

en: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp , whither thou shalt go forth abroad :
kha: Phi dei ban buh ka jaka ha kaba phi lah ban leit shabar    kham jngai ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban don ka jaka ruh shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah, ha kaba me leit shabar ri:

en: This is one thing , therefore I said it , He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked .
