kha: Nga long uba lui lui , hynrei ngam salia shuh , Nga la thait ban im . Jia katba jia ; kiba lui lui ne kiba rem ; U Blei un pynjot ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kawei ka jingjia , namarkata nga la ong ia kata , U pynjot ia kiba janai bad kiba sniew .

en: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .
kha: Ngam don jingsuk , jingjahthait , bad ki jingjynjar jong nga kim don jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la don ha ka jingshngain, bad ngam shym la shongthait, bad ngam shym la sngap jar shuh shuh hynrei ka jingeh ka la wan.

en: The Spirit of God hath made me , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .
kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga bad uba ai jingim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Blei u la thaw ia nga , bad ka jingsawa jong Uba donbor baroh ka la ai jingim ia nga .

en: Take heed , regard not iniquity : for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction .
kha: Da sumar ban ym phai sha ka jingbymman ; ïa ka jingshah shitom jong phi la phah ban pyllait ïa phi na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bha, wat ia ka jingbymhok: namar ia kane me la jied ban ia ka jingjynjar .

en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he was afraid of him .
kha: U Saul u ïohi ïa ka jingjop u Dabid bad u nang sheptieng shuh shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba u Saul u la iohi ba u la leh stad shibun , u la tieng ia u .

en: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
kha: Ïa kata baroh kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka jinglong jong ngi kam shym la shah ot , hynrei ka ding kaba sah jong ki ka bam .

en: There will be strict laws to be implemented according to the will of those in power.
kha: Hangta kin mih ki ain kynsha ban pyntreikam katkum ka jingsngew mon jong kiba donbor.
translated_en_to_kha: Kin don ki ain kiba pyrkhing ban pyntreikam katkum ka mon jong kito kiba don ha ka bor.

en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory , provoking one another , envying one another .
kha: Ngim dei ban sngewsarong lane kiba pynbitar iwei ïa iwei pat lane bishni iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin ym kwah ia ka burom kaba khlem akor , da kaba pynkhih iwei ia iwei pat .

en: For ye may all prophesy one by one , that all may learn , and all may be comforted .
kha: Phi baroh phi lah ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , uwei hadien uwei , khnang ba uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh jinghikai bad jingpynshlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi baroh phi lah ban iathuhlypa kawei hadien kawei pat, ba baroh kin nang, bad baroh kin ioh jingpyntngen .

en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .
kha: Bad kumta to pyntngen iwei ïa iwei pat bad to ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba phi leh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pyntngen ia lade lang, bad to pynroi iwei ia iwei pat kumba phi leh .

en: For she hath cast down many wounded : yea , many strong men have been slain by her .
kha: Naba ka la pynjot shibun ki rangbah bad ka la long ka daw jong ka jingïap kiba bun kiba ym lah ñiew shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la pynhap bun ki briew kiba la mynsaw: hooid , bun ki briew kiba khlain ki la shah pyniap ha ka .

en: Two , I ' ve actually done research on the strategic benefits of asking for advice .
kha: Ar , nga la leh shisha ia ka jingwad bniah shaphang ki jingmyntoi ba kongsan jong ka jingpan jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ar , nga la leh shisha ia ka jingwad bniah shaphang ki jingmyntoi ba thymmai jong ka jingpan jingmut .

en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance , and joined affinity with Ahab .
kha: Haba u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u la riewspah bad pawnam , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingshongkurim hapdeng u dkhot ka longïing jong u bad ka longïing u Ahab u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Jehoshaphat u don ka spah bad ka burom ha ka jingbun, bad u la iasoh bad u Ahab .

en: After a rift with party leadership , Khushbu Sundar switched to the Congress in 2014
kha: Hadien ka jingiapher jingmut bad ki nongialam ka party u Khushbu Sundar u la kylla sha ka Congress ha u snem 2014 .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ka jingma kaba khraw bad ka jingialam jong ka seng , u Khushbu Sundar u la kylla sha ka Congress ha u snem 2014 .

en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .
kha: Phin pynlong ïa u ba la thang da ka jinglehrain bad U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong u to lum ia ki dewiong ba la thang ha ka khlieh jong u , bad U Trai un siew kylliang ia me .

en: But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .
kha: To kiar noh na ki jingïakren ba-thala bad ba-bieit , tang ban ïalam ïa ki briew kham jngai na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shun ia ki jingkren bein bad ki jingkren bein: namar kin nang kiew sha ka jingbymhok kaba kham bun .

en: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?
kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohnud briew ? Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba shukor katta katta ; ka pang jur eh ban ïa kaba ïoh jingkoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud ka long kaba thok halor kiei kiei baroh , bad kaba sniew shibun: mano ba lah ban tip ia ka ?

en: The minutes of understanding may form base for working out details of the contract .
kha: Ki minit jong ka jingsngewthuh ki lah ban long ka nongrim ban trei ia ki jingtip ba bniah jong ka jingiateh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki minit jong ka jingsngewthuh ki lah ban long ka nongrim na ka bynta ban trei ia ki jingtip ba bniah jong ka jingiateh .

en: And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :
kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U la kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan shah ïa u ban leit sha Bethlehem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la jubab , u Dabid u la pan shuti na nga ban leit sha Bethlehem:

en: Prime Minister Nehru led the Congress to major election victories in 1957 and 1962 .
kha: U Myntri Rangbah Nehru u la ialam ia ka Congress sha ki jingjop kiba khraw ha ka elekshon ha u snem 1957 bad 1962 .
translated_en_to_kha: U Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Nehru u la ialam ia ka Congress sha ki jingjop elekshon kiba khraw ha u snem 1957 bad 1962 .

en: And said unto them ,  Why sleep ye ? rise and pray , lest ye enter into temptation .
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi thiah ? Khie joit bad duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, Balei phi thiah ? khie bad duwai , ioh ba phin rung ha ka jingpynshoi .

en: Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
kha: hynrei katno ka jingkhlaiñ kaba khraw ka don ha ka met jong u , bad katno ka bor kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Lo mynta, ka bor jong u ka don ha ki tyrpeng jong u, bad ka bor jong u ka don ha ka kpoh jong u .

en: O ye simple , understand wisdom : and , ye fools , be ye of an understanding heart .
kha: Hato phi dang long kiba lung jingmut ? Hikai ban long kiba rangbah jingmut . Hato phi long kiba dang bieit ? Hikai ban long kiba shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko phi kiba suk, sngewthuh ia ka jingstad: bad, phi kiba bieit, to long kiba sngewthuh ia ka dohnud .

en: So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .
kha: Kumta ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khrist , bad la pynïasoh iwei bad iwei pat kum ki dkhot bapher jong kawei ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi, haba ngi long kiba bun, ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khrist , bad uwei pa uwei u dkhot iwei ia iwei pat .

en: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth .
kha: Naba kan wan halor ki briew baroh ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kum ka snare kan wan ha kito baroh kiba shong ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .
kha: Ai ba ki khmat jong ki kin matlah khnang ba kin ym ïohi ; bad ai ba kin dem hapoh ki jingjynjar jong ki ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki khmat jong ki kin dum , ba kin ym iohi , bad kin dem khrup ia ka tyrpeng jong ki baroh kawei .

en: The light of the righteous rejoiceth : but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out .
kha: Kiba hok ki long kum ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ; ki bymman ki long kum ka sharak ka ban lip noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai jong kiba hok ka kmen: hynrei ka sharak jong kiba sniew kan sa jah noh .

en: And now ,  Lord  , thou art God , and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
kha: Ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad me pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular baphylla ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Trai, me long U Blei, bad me la kular ia kane ka jingbha ha u shakri jong me:

en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years .
kha: U Jehu u la synshar arphew phra snem ha Samaria kum u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ba u Jehu u la synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria ka long arphew san snem .

en: Grace be to you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ïa phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi, bad na U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves .
kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri , bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki masi baroh bad ki nongbah , ngi la shim ia ka jingbam ha lade .

en: Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .
kha: Me la ai ha nga ïa ka jingim bad ka jingieit baïaineh , bad ka jingsumar sukher jong me ka ri pynim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ai ia nga ia ka jingim bad ka jingsngewbha, bad ka jingleit jngoh jong me ka la pynneh pynsah ia ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .
kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Nga smai ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam tip shaphang uta u briew uba phi kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la sdang ban tim bad ban smai da kaba ong: Ngam ithuh ia une u briew uba phi kren .

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Ai ka jingnguh sha U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka long bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai ; namar u long uba bha ; namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field  ; let us lodge in the villages .
kha: Nga la wan hiar napdeng ki dieng Almond ban ïohi ïa ki jingthung balung ha ka them , ban ïohi ïa ki sla bathymmai halor ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki syntiew halor ki diengsoh Pomkranet .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, ko baieit jong nga, to ngin leit sha lyngkha ; to ngin ia sah ha ki shnong .

en: Blessed are they that keep judgment , and he that doeth righteousness at all times .
kha: Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba leh borabor ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kito kiba bat ia ka jingbishar , bad uta uba leh hok ha man la ka por .

en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer , and to the ministry of the word .
kha: Ma ngi hi , te , ngin ai ïa ka por jong ngi baroh ha ka jingduwai bad ha ka kam ka jingïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngin ai ia lade beit ha ka jingduwai , bad ha ka jingshakri jong ka ktien .

en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :
kha: Ha kawei ka por u la long bymmyntoi shuh ïa me , hynrei mynta u long uba myntoi ïa me bad ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ha ka por ba la leit noh ka long kaba khlem jingmyntoi ia me, hynrei mynta ka long kaba myntoi ia me bad ia nga:

en: Give heed to me , O  Lord  , and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me .
kha: Kumta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  , to sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong bad to shahshkor ïa kaei ba ki nongshun jong nga ki ong shaphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga ko Trai bad sngap ia ka sur jong kita kiba ialeh pyrshah ia nga .

en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me , and plead against me my reproach :
kha: Phi pyrkhat ba phi kham bha ban ïa nga bad phi ñiew ïa ki jingeh jong nga kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada shisha phin pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia nga , bad to kyrpad pyrshah ia nga:

en: And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .
kha: Haba ka waiñ ka la lut noh , ka kmie U Jisu ka la ong ïa u ,  Kim don waiñ shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki kwah wain , ka kmie U Jisu ka ong ha u , Ki don wain .

en: Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .
kha: U Blei u pyn-i ha ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïa ka jingsarong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u pyni ia ki ia ka kam jong ki bad ki jingpynkhein jong ki ba ki la palat .

en: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by , let the first hold his peace .
kha: Hynrei lada don uba shong lang ha ka jingïaseng u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U Blei , uta uba kren u dei ban sangeh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don kaei kaei kaba la pynpaw ha uwei pat uba shong hajan , to ai ba uba nyngkong un bat ia ka jingsuk jong u .

en: We accept it always , and in all places , most noble Felix , with all thankfulness .
kha: Ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kane ha kylleng kylleng bad ha ki por baroh , bad ngi da sngewnguh eh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi pdiang ia ka man ka por, bad ha ki jaka baroh, kham bunsien u Felix uba donburom, da ka jingsngewnguh baroh .

en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka khmat namar ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohsngew ba la ong , Ka khmat na ka bynta ka khmat bad ka bniat na ka bynta ka bniat:

en: And Saul answered , God do so and more also : for thou shalt surely die , Jonathan .
kha: U Saul u ong ha u ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada yn ym pynïap ïa me !
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la jubab, U Blei un leh kumta bad kham bun ruh: namar me thikna ba me iap noh, Jonathan .

en: And Elon the Zebulunite died , and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun .
kha: Hadien kata u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Aijalon kaba ha ri Sebulun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elon u Zebulun u la iap , bad la tep ia u ha Aijalon ha ka ri Zebulun .

en: My harp also is turned to mourning , and my organ into the voice of them that weep .
kha: Haba shisien mynshuwa nga la ïohsngew ïa ki sur bakmen , mynta nga ïohsngew tang ka jingïambriew bad ka jingïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka harp jong nga ruh ka kylla long kaba sngewsih , bad ka dkhot met jong nga ha ka sur jong ki kiba iam .

en: The king sent and loosed him  ; even the ruler of the people , and let him go free .
kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah pyllait ïa u ; u nongsynshar ki jaitbynriew u la pyllait ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phah bad u la pyllait ia u ; wat ia u nongsynshar jong ki briew , bad u la pyllait noh ia u .

en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .
kha: Ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hapdeng ki briew ; ym don batip ïa ka dor bashisha jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew um tip ia ka dor jong ka; ym don ruh ha ka ri jong kiba im .

en: And believers were the more added to the Lord , multitudes both of men and women . )
kha: Hynrei la nang pynïasoh kham bun ki briew sha ka kynhun — u paid ki rangbah bad ki kynthei kiba la ngeit ha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki bangeit ki la nang kham bun ha U Trai , ki paidbah shynrang bad kynthei . )

en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?
kha: lane ban pyllait im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshun ne u nongbanbor ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane , Pynduh noh ia nga na ka kti jong u nongshun ? lane , Pynduh noh ia nga na ka kti jong kiba khlain ?

en: Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God s behalf .
kha: To ïaishah bad shahshkor sa katto katne ïa kaei ba nga ong na ka liang jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia nga khyndiat , bad ngan pyni ia me ba nga dang hap ban kren na ka bynta U Blei .

en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart : and a good report maketh the bones fat .
kha: Ki khmat kiba phuh samrkhie ki pynlong ïa phi ban kmen , bad ki khubor ki babha ki pynsngewtynnat shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai jong ki khmat ka pynkmen ia ka dohnud: bad ka khubor kaba bha ka pynlong ia ki shyieng ban heh .

en: Now is the judgment of this world : now shall the prince of this world be cast out .
kha: Mynta ka dei ka por ba ïa kane ka pyrthei yn bishar ; mynta ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei yn pynhiar khet .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka long ka jingbishar jong kane ka pyrthei: mynta yn bret noh ia u syiem jong kane ka pyrthei .

en: And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .
kha: Ym dei u briew uba kren , hynrei u blei !  ki la pyrta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la pyrta, ki da ong: Ka dei ka sur jong u blei , ym jong u briew .

en: Thou hast sent widows away empty , and the arms of the fatherless have been broken .
kha: Phi la kyntait noh ym tang na kaba ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei , hynrei phi la lute ïa ki khunswet ba la shah lehbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la phah noh ia ki riewkynthei kiba thylli , bad ki kti jong ki bym don kpa ki la tyrkhong .

en: She maketh fine linen , and selleth it  ; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .
kha: Ka thain ki jaiñkup bad ki jingpanpoh bad ka die ïa ki ha ki nongkhaïi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shna ia ka jain kaba bha, bad ka pynkhih ia ka ; bad ka pynpoi ia ki belt sha u nongkhaii .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , he is in thine hand  ; but save his life .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha u Soitan ,  Kam pher , ai un long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym shim ïa ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Ha khmih u don ha ka kti jong me ; hynrei u pynim ia ka jingim jong u .

en: Though I speak , my grief is not assuaged : and though I forbear , what am I eased ?
kha: Hynrei ym don kaba nga ong ka ïarap , bad kaba shu sngap jar kam pynjai jai ïa ka jingpang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la nga kren hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong nga kam shym la sngewsih: bad wat la nga sngewsih , kaei kaba nga la sngewsuk ?

en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah bariewblei kiba la tep ïa u Stephan , ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïam kaba jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba riewblei ki la rah ia u Stephan sha ka jingtep jong u, bad ki la sngewsih shibun ia u .

en: And fell down on his face at his feet , giving him thanks : and he was a Samaritan .
kha: U la dem khrup ïa lade ha khyndew ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la ainguh ïa u . Uta u briew u dei u nong Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hap ha ka khmat jong u ha ki kjat jong u, u la ainguh ia u: bad u la long u nong Samaria .

en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .
kha: Ngan ai ruh shibun ki khun ki kti ïa u khun jong kata ka mraw ba kin long kawei ka jaitbynriew . U ruh u dei u khun jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh na u khun jong u mraw ngan pynlong jaitbynriew , namar u long u symbai jong me .

en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .
kha: U briew uba buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun u dei uba lamler . Uno uno uba pynphriang ïa ka jinglorni u dei uba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba buhrieh ia ka jingshun da ki rmiang shyntur kiba thok , bad uta uba kren bein , u long uba bieit .

en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Jehu u Nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Hanani bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jehu u khun u Hanani pyrshah ia u Baasha da kaba ong:

en: The  Lord  taketh pleasure in them that fear him , in those that hope in his mercy .
kha: hynrei u sngewbha ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u , ha kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u shim ia ka jingsngewbha ha kito kiba tieng ia u , ha kito kiba kyrmen ha ka jingisynei jong u .

en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .
kha: Hadien ba u la dih khyndiat ka waiñ , u la buaid , u law ïa la ki jaiñ bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh la ka ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dih ia ka wain, bad u la dih kyiad ; bad u la shah tap hapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u .

en: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .
kha: Ha ka jaka rung sha ka nongbah , harud ki khyrdop , ka pyrta :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pyrta ha ki khyrdop , ha ka jingkhang jong ka nongbah , ha ka jingwan rung ha ki jingkhang .

en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest , so is a man that wandereth from his place .
kha: U briew sha jngai na la ïing u long kum ka sim kaba jngai na la ka skum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka sim kaba iaid na ka bniat jong ka , kumjuh ruh u briew uba iaid na ka jaka jong u .

en: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki lur ïa ki lyngkha jong ka jingsniew bad ki bet ïa ka jingbymman kum u symbai ; mynta ki ot da ka jingbymman bad ka jingsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga la iohi , kita kiba bet ia ka jingbymhok , bad kiba bet ia ka jingsniew , ki kheit ia kajuh .

en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free ? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass ?
kha: Mano ba ai ha ki kada khlaw ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ki ? Mano ba pyllait lan ïa ki bad shah ïa ki ban shang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la phah ia ka tdong khlaw kaba laitluid ? lane mano ba la pyllait ia ki band jong ka tdong khlaw ?

en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :
kha: Don saw jait ki mrad kiba rit ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kiba sian shikatdei eh :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don saw tylli kiei kiei kiba rit ha ka khyndew , hynrei ki long kiba stad palat:

en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .
kha: Kumta u Paul u la sah hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bteng hangta shi snem hynriew bnai , u la hikai ia ka ktien U Blei hapdeng jong ki .

en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .
kha: Um da donkam ïa ka jingwad bniah ban weng noh ïa ki nongïalam bad ban bujli ïa ki da kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynpra ia ki briew kiba khlain bor khlem da khein , bad un buh ia kiwei pat ha ka jaka jong ki .

en: Open ye the gates , that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in .
kha: To plie ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad to ai ba ka jaitbynriew baïaineh kan rung , ka jaitbynriew kaba ki briew jong ka , ki leh ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia ki khyrdop , ba ka jaitbynriew kaba hok kaba bat ia ka jingshisha kan rung shapoh .

en: And he took some of his brethren , even five men , and presented them unto Pharaoh .
kha: Nangta u pynithuh ïa kita ki hynmen jong u ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim katto katne na ki hynmen jong u, wat san ngut ki briew, bad u la pyni ia ki ha u Pharaoh .

en: Wherefore he called that place Beer–sheba  ; because there they sware both of them .
kha: Bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Beersheba , namar dei hangta ba baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingsmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la khot ia kata ka jaka Beersheba ; namar hangta ki la sngap jar ia ki baroh arngut .

en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men , and keep the paths of the righteous .
kha: Kumta phi dei ban bud nuksa ïa ki briew kiba bha bad im ka jingim kaba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban iaid ha ka lynti jong ki briew kiba bha bad ban bat ia ki lynti jong kiba hok .

en: Why dost thou strive against him ? for he giveth not account of any of his matters .
kha: Balei ba phi kynnoh ïa U Blei ba um ju jubab ïa ki jingkhñium u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me ialeh pyrshah ia u ? namar um ai jingkhein ia kano kano na ki kam jong u .

en: Follow peace with all men , and holiness , without which no man shall see the Lord :
kha: Ïaleh ban ïashongsuk bad ki briew baroh , bad pyrshang ban im ka jingim kaba khuid , namar khlem kata uno uno un ym lah ban ïohi ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To bud ia ka jingsuk bad ki briew baroh , bad ka jingkhuid , khlem kata ym don mano mano ruh ban iohi ia U Trai:

en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great , and because mine hand had gotten much  ;
kha: ne sngewsarong ha ka jingdon jingem jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la sngewbha namar ba ka spah jong nga ka long kaba khraw , bad namar ba ka kti jong nga ka la ioh bun ; .

en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth  ; and thy want as an armed man .
kha: hynrei katba phi dang ïohthiah , ka jingduk kan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u nongtuh uba la kieng atiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka jingduk jong me kan wan kum uta uba leit jingleit ; bad ka jingkwah jong me kum u briew uba don tiar .

en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
kha: U Isaak u kham jied ïa u Iso , namar u bang bha ban bam ïa ki mrad kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei ka Rebekka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u ieit ia u Iso, namar u la bam ia ka jingsma jong u: hynrei u Rebekka u ieit ia u Jakob .

en: Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .
kha: Wat iehnoh ïa ka jingstad , bad kan ïada ïa phi ; ieit ïa ka , te kan sumar bha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iehnoh ia ka, bad kan pynneh ia me: ieit ia ka, bad kan sumar ia me .

en: For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also  ; will he not then consider it ?
kha: U Blei u tip kino ki briew ki bymlarkam ; u ïohi ïa ki kam sniew jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u tip ia ki briew kiba lehnohei: u iohi ia ka jingsniew ruh ; hato un ym pyrkhat ia ka ?

en: Now there were seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and dying left no seed .
kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong eh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki don hynriew ngut ki hynmen: bad uba nyngkong u la shim ia ka tnga, bad u la iap khlem symbai .

en: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  will I destroy them .
kha: Shibun ki nongshun ki la don sawdong jong nga ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la ker sawdong ia nga: hynrei ha ka kyrteng U Trai ngan pynjot ia ki .

en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains , and fill the valleys with thy height .
kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah bad ïa ki them da ka metïap bapyut jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka doh jong me halor ki lum , bad ngan pyndap ia ki them da ka jingjrong jong me .

en: For the  Lord  giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .
kha: Dei U  Trai  uba ai ïa ka jingstad ; na u ka wan ka jingtip bad ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u ai jingstad: na ka shyntur jong u ka mih ka jingtip bad ka jingsngewthuh .

en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , and made thereunto a crown of gold round about .
kha: U suit ïa ka da ka ksiar kaba nylla , bad u buh u jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong ka rmiang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid , bad u la shna ia ka da ka khlieh ksiar sawdong .

en: And Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth , she judged Israel at that time .
kha: Mynta ka Deborah , ka tnga jong u Lappidoth , ka long ka nongïathuhlypa , bad ka shakri kum ka nongbishar ïa ki Israel ha kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Deborah, ka jingiathuhlypa, ka tnga jong u Lapidoth, ka la bishar ia ki Israel ha kata ka por .

en: If we say that we have not sinned , we make him a liar , and his word is not in us .
kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim shym la leh pop , ngi pynlong ïa U Blei ba u lamler bad ka ktien jong u kam don ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngim shym la leh pop , ngi pynlong ia u u nonglamler , bad ka ktien jong u kam don ha ngi .

en: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ;
kha: Hynrei lada u long u shakri uba sniew , un ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong nga un wan slem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad lada uta u shakri uba sniew un ong ha ka dohnud jong u , u kynrad jong nga u pynslem ia ka jingwan jong u;

en: But as truly as I live , all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei nga kular skhem ba kumba nga long uba im bad kumba ka jingdon jong nga ka dap ïa ka pyrthei baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba nga im shisha , ka khyndew baroh kan dap da ka burom U Trai .

en: I go the way of all the earth : be thou strong therefore , and shew thyself a man  ;
kha: Ka por jong nga ban ïap ka la wan . To long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut skhem , bad leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u hukum ïa me ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga iaid ha ka lynti jong ka khyndew baroh: to long uba khlain namarkata , bad to pyni ia lade u briew ; .

en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them  ; because they refuse to do judgment .
kha: Ïa ki bymman la pynrem da ka jingleh jubor jong ki hi ; ki kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshah lute jong ki bymman kan pynjot ia ki ; namar ki kyntait ban leh ia ka jingbishar .

en: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .
kha: Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u dei ban jot noh , ngam don ka jingkitkhlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga shim ia phi ban thoh ia kane ka sngi , ba nga long uba khuid na ka snam jong ki briew baroh .

en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .
kha: Namar U Trai u sneng ïa baroh kiba u ieit , bad u sympat ïa uno uno ïa uba u pdiang kum la u khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uba U Trai u ieit u pynshitom , bad u sngap jar ia uwei pa uwei u khun uba u pdiang .

en: I will declare thy righteousness , and thy works  ; for they shall not profit thee .
kha: Phi pyrkhat ba kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei ngan pynpaw ïa ki jingleh jong phi , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin ym lah ban ïarap ei ei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbna ia ka hok jong me, bad ki kam jong me ; namar kin ym pynmyntoi ia me .

en: But the  Lord  is in his holy temple : let all the earth keep silence before him .
kha: U  Trai  u don ha ka Templ bakhuid jong u ; to ai ba uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un sngap jar ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u don ha ka tempi bakhuid jong u: to ai ba ka khyndew baroh kan sngap jar ha khmat jong u .

en: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil .
kha: Nangta U Mynsiem u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha ka ri shyiap ba yn pynshoi u da u Soitan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la ialam ia U Jisu sha ka ri khlaw ban shah pynshoi ha u ksuid .

en: And he brought me to the north gate , and measured it according to these measures  ;
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop bashatei . U la thew ïa ka , bad ka la long katjuh ka jingheh kum kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga sha ka khyrdop shaphang shathie , bad u la thew ia ka katkum kine ki jingthew ; .

en: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people  ;
kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit na kawei ka jaitbynriew sha kawei pat ka hima;

en: Go to now , ye rich men , weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you .
kha: Bad mynta , phi ki briew kiba riewspah , to shahshkor ïa nga ! to ïam bad to lynñiar ïa ki jinglanot ki ban wan hap ha phi !
translated_en_to_kha: To leit mynta, phi ki riewspah, to iam bad to iam na ka bynta ki jingjynjar jong phi ki ban wan ha phi .

en: A righteous man hateth lying : but a wicked man is loathsome , and cometh to shame .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki isih ïa kaba lamler , hynrei ki ktien jong ki briew kiba bymman ki long ka jinglehrain bad jingjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba hok u shun ia ka jinglamler: hynrei u briew uba sniew u long uba sngewsih , bad u wan sha ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .
kha: U la pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha , bad u la phah noh thylli ïa kiba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyndap ia kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha ; bad ia kiba riewspah u la phah thylli noh .

en: And the Levites shall speak , and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice ,
kha: Ki Lebi kin kren ïa kine ki ktien ha ka sur kaba jam :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Lebi kin kren bad kin ong ha ki briew Israel baroh da ka sur kaba jam .

en: But ye shall destroy their altars , break their images , and cut down their groves :
kha: Pynban , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki , bad pom pynduh ïa ki shab jong ka Asherah , ka blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin pynjot ia ki nonglehkai jong ki, phin pynpra ia ki dur jong ki bad phin ot ia ki khlaw jong ki:

en: And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En–gedi  ; six cities with their villages .
kha: ka Nibshan , ka nongbah Mluh , bad ka Engedi : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong Salt bad ka shnong Engedi ; hynriew tylli ki shnong jong ki .

en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Benjamin la ai saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jaitbynriew Benjamin , Gibeon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka , ka Geba bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka .

en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .
kha: Ki Israel ki long ka jaitbynriew ka bym don ka bor sngewthuh ; kim don satia ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem jingmut , bad ym don jingmut ei ei ruh em ha ki .

en: Yea , if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding  ;
kha: ho-oid , kyrpad ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , bad kyrpad jur ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , lada me pyrta hadien ka jingtip , bad pynkiew ia ka sur jong me na ka bynta ka jingsngewthuh ; .

en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Shem  ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
kha: Ai ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Shem ! U Kanaan un long u mraw jong u Shem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: La kyrkhu ia U Trai Blei u Shem ; bad u Kanaan un long u shakri jong u .

en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .
kha: Namar ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong u hi , kita ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kine ki lai ngut ki briew ki la sangeh ban jubab ia u Job , namar u la long uba hok ha la ki jong ki khmat .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  It is written again , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ruh , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , La thoh biang ia u , Wat ju tynjuh ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: But though he had done so many miracles before them , yet they believed not on him :
kha: Wat la U Jisu u la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat jong ki , kim shym la ngeit ha u , ba yn pyndep ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la ong ba kan long shisha :
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat la u la leh bun ki kambah ha khmat jong ki, hynrei kim ngeit ia u:

en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass , than one tittle of the law to fail .
kha: Hynrei ka kham jem ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ban jah noh ban ïa kaba iehnoh ïa ka bynta kaba rit tam jong ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kham suk ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew ban iaid , ban ia kawei ka tdong jong ka hukum ban rem .

en: Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .
kha: Ka thain Goshen , ha kaba ki Israel ki shong ki sah , ka long tang ma ka , ka jaka ha kaba u phria um shym hap .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ha ka ri Goshen , ha kaba ki khun Israel ki don , ym don hail .

en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is , than a stalled ox and hatred therewith .
kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa ki jhur bad ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ban ïa kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba bha tam ha kaba don ka jingpihuiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long ka jingbam janmiet jong ki jingthung ha kaba ka jingieit ka don , ban ia u masi bad ka jingshun kaba sahkut bad ka jingshun bad ka .

en: And she said , Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Shah ba u Adonijah , u hynmen jong me un ïoh ïa ka Abishag kum ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Ai ba u Abishag u Shunam un long u Adonijah u hynmen jong me .

en: But I say unto you which hear , Love your enemies , do good to them which hate you ,
kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi kiba shahshkor ïa nga : Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi , lehbha ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi kiba iohsngew , To ieit ia ki nongshun jong phi , to leh bha ia kito kiba shun ia phi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Peace be unto thee  ; fear not : thou shalt not die .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Long ka jingsuk . Wat sheptieng . Men ym ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Ka jingsuk ha me; wat tieng: men ym iap .

en: But all Israel and Judah loved David , because he went out and came in before them .
kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei ha Israel bad Judah ki ieit ïa u Dabid ba u long u nongïalam uba jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Israel baroh bad u Judah ki ieit ia u Dabid , namar u la mih bad u la wan rung ha khmat jong ki .

en: Thou hast heard their reproach , O  Lord  , and all their imaginations against me  ;
kha: Me la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki krenbeiñ ïa nga , A  Trai  ; me tip ïa baroh ki jingïasylla jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohsngew ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ki, ko Trai, bad ki jingmutdur jong ki baroh pyrshah ia nga ; .

en: Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .
kha: Mynta to ïeng joit kum u rangbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli kiba nga kylli ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih mynta ia ki tyrpeng jong me kum u briew ; namar ngan dawa na me , bad to jubab ia nga .

en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .
kha: Ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki hi ,  U ong ïa kane namar ngim shym la wanrah jingbam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia pyrkhat hapdeng jong ki da kaba ong: Ka long namar ba ngim shym la shim kpu .

en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them , to overthrow them in the wilderness :
kha: Kumta u la ai ïa ka jingmaham kaba eh ba un pynlong ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ka ri shyiap
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la rah ia la ka kti pyrshah ia ki , ban pynhap ia ki ha ka ri khlaw:

en: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .
kha: Phin ïawad ïa nga , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga , namar phim lah ban leit sha kaba ngan don .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin wad ia nga, bad phin ym shem ia nga: bad hangno nga don, hangta phim lah ban wan .

en: There go the ships : there is that leviathan , whom thou hast made to play therein .
kha: Ki liengbah ki ïaid halor jong ka , bad ha ka u Lebiathan u lehkai , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw uba me la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki leit ki lieng: don uta u Lebiathan, uba me la pynlong ban ialehkai hangta .

en: Yea , surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh un ym leh ïa kaba sniew ; um ju leh bymdei ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , shisha U Blei un ym leh sniew , lymne u Blei uba donbor baroh un ym pynkylla ia ka jingbishar .

en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
kha: U pynkylla ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyiap bad pynmih umpohliew ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkylla ia ka ri khlaw sha ka um kaba ieng , bad ka khyndew kaba rkhiang sha ki wah um .

en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?
kha: U Jisu pat , u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingthmu basniew jong ki , bad kumta u la ong ,  Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngewthuh ia ka jingsniew jong ki bad u la ong: Balei phi pynshoi ia nga, phi ki nongleh arsap ?

en: As thou hast sent me into the world , even so have I also sent them into the world .
kha: Nga la phah ïa ki sha ka pyrthei , kumba me la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba me la phah ia nga sha ka pyrthei , kumta ruh nga la phah ia ki sha ka pyrthei .

en: For the man was above forty years old , on whom this miracle of healing was shewed .
kha: U briew ha kaba la leh ïa kane ka kambah ka jingpynkhiah u la palat sawphew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta u briew u la don palat sawphew snem ka rta, ha uba la pyni ia kane ka kambah jong ka jingpynkhiah .

en: They reel to and fro , and stagger like a drunken man , and are at their wits  end .
kha: ki jynthut bad ki ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba briew kiba buaid — baroh ka jingtbit jong ki ka la lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iaid sha ka kpoh bad ki rkhie bein kum u briew uba la buaid, bad ki don ha ka jingkut jong ki.

en: And he began to say unto them ,  This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .
kha: katba u ong ha ki  Kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la wan urlong shisha mynta ka sngi , haba phi ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sdang ban ong ha ki , Mynta ka sngi kane ka jingthoh ka la pyndep ha ki shkor jong phi .

en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity , and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty .
kha: Ka jingbymman jong me ka paw da kaei kaba me kren ; me pyrshang ban buhrieh ha lyndet ki ktien sian jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka shyntur jong me ka pynpaw ia ka jingbymhok jong me, bad me jied ia ka shyntur jong ki riewstad .

en: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .
kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la pynlong ka jingthmu ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit sha ki Pharisi , bad u la shim jingmut kumno ki lah ban pynthut ia u ha ka jingiakren jong u .

en: Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh . Ki don saw ngut ki rangbah hangne kiba la shim jingsmai .
translated_en_to_kha: To leh namarkata ia kane ba ngi ong ha me: Ngi don saw ngut ki briew kiba don ka jingkular ha ki ; .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Lymne nga ruh ngan ïathuh ha phi , te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Wat iathuh ia phi da ka bor aiu nga leh ia kine kiei kiei .

en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
kha: U briew uba alhia u shong hapoh ïing ; u ong ba u sing u lah ban ïoh ïa u lada u mih shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew u ong , Ka don ka sing shabar , ngan shah pyniap ha ki surok .

en: Nevertheless in those days , saith the  Lord  , I will not make a full end with you .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat ha kito ki sngi ngan ym pynjot khoit ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ha kita ki sngi , ong U Trai , ngan ym pynkut noh ia phi .

en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness .
kha: Ki nongpynïap briew ki ïaid kylleng lyngba ki rudnong ; ngi kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim haba ngi wad jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi buh ia u kpu jong ngi bad ka jingma jong ka jingim jong ngi namar ka waitlam jong ka ri khlaw .

en: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
kha: Ki briew kiba beit kin lehbha ïa phi ; ki bymman ki kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba hok ki long kiba dei: hynrei ki jingai jingmut jong kiba sniew ki long kiba thok .

en: If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;
kha: Lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka jingim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u buh ia ka dohnud jong u ha u briew , lada u lum ha lade ia ka mynsiem bad ka mynsiem jong u ; .

en: Saying ,  There was in a city a judge , which feared not God , neither regarded man :
kha: Ha kawei ka shnong la don u nongbishar u bymsheptieng ïa U Blei lymne burom ïa u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ka don ha kawei ka nongbah u nongbishar , u bym tieng ia U Blei , lymne u briew:

en: They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .
kha: Ki khanglad ïa kiba duk ba kin ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki bad pynbor ïa kiba kyrduh ban phet rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynphai noh ia kiba duk na ka lynti: ki baduk jong ka khyndew ki buhrieh lang .

en: So the  Lord  was with Joshua  ; and his fame was noised throughout all the country .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joshua , bad ka nam jong u ka saphriang kylleng kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la don bad u Joshua bad ka nam jong u ka la sawa ha kylleng ka ri .

en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ki hikai ïa ki aiñ ba la thaw da ki briew kumba ki dei ki aiñ U Blei !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khlem da don ei ei ki mane ia nga, ki hikai ia ki jinghikai ia ki hukum jong ki briew .

en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
kha: U phah shna ruh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta na ka la tap da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah pat la tap da ka ksiar nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u syiem u la shna ia ka khet kaba khraw jong ka sniehdoh , bad u la tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba bha tam .

en: Look unto the heavens , and see  ; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou .
kha: To khmied sha ka suiñbneng ! Peit katno ka jingjngai jong ki lyoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Peit sha bneng , bad peit ia ki lyoh kiba kham jrong ban ia me .

en: But if this thing be true , and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel :
kha: Hynrei lada kata ka jingkynnoh ka long kaba shisha bad ym don sabut ban pyn-i ba kata ka briew ka long kaba dang sotti ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kane ka long kaba shisha , bad ki dak jong ka jinglong kynthei kim shym la lap na ka bynta ka dam:

en: And I will drive thee from thy station , and from thy state shall he pull thee down .
kha: U  Trai  un weng noh ïa me na ka jaka treikam bad pynhiar ïa me na ka kyrdan kaba halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan beh noh ia me na ka jaka jong me, bad na ka jylla jong me un tan ia me shapoh .

en: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone s cast , and kneeled down , and prayed ,
kha: Nangta u la leit noh na ki kumba shi pda maw bad u la dem khohsiew bad u la duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shah kyntait na ki shaphang ka jingthep maw, bad u la dem khrup bad u la duwai .

en: Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
kha: Don kiba la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Kynrad , hato tang khyndiat ngut ki briew ki ban lait im ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei u la ong ha u: Ko Trai, hato ki don tang khyndiat kiba shah pynim ? Bad u la ong ha ki .

en: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass away , till all be fulfilled .
kha: Kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia ha shuwa ba ki briew kiba im mynta kin ïap baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kane ka pateng kan ym jah noh , haduh ba baroh kin da pyndep .

en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ka por kaba biang na ka bynta jong nga kam pat poi . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Ka por jong nga kam pat poi: hynrei ka por jong phi ka long kaba la pynkhreh beit .

en: I beheld the mountains , and , lo , they trembled , and all the hills moved lightly .
kha: Nga la khmih ha ki lumbah — ki la khynñiuh , bad ki lumrit ki khih shadien bad sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ki lum, bad, ha khmih, ki la khih, bad ki lum baroh ki iaid jem .

en: He asked water , and she gave him milk  ; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish .
kha: U Sisera u pan um , hynrei ka ai ha u da ka dud ; Ka wanrah malai ïa u ha ka pliang kaba itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pan um , bad ka la ai dud ia u ; ka la wanrah ia ka butter ha ka jingbam kaba don ka jingbam .

en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong kan long ka jingpynkut kaba khuid: phin ym leh ei ei ha kata ka jaka .

en: So am I made to possess months of vanity , and wearisome nights are appointed to me .
kha: Na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat ngam don ei ei ïa ka ban im , kawei ka miet hadien kawei pat ka wanrah jingkordit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la shah pynlong ban don ki bnai jong ka jinglong ba sniew, bad ki miet kiba sngewsih ki long kiba la buh ha nga .

en: The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .
kha: Baroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong nga bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong kito kiba la ieng pyrshah ia nga , bad ka jingthmu jong ki pyrshah ia nga baroh shisngi .

en: But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .
kha: Ha kata ka por u khynnah Samuel u ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  , u da phong da ka sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Samuel u la shakri ha khmat U Trai, u long u khynnah , u la pyniasoh bad ka jain lyngkhuid .

en: Sihon king of the Amorites , and Og king of Bashan , and all the kingdoms of Canaan :
kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor , ïa u Og , u syiem ka Bashan , bad ïa baroh ki syiem ha Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Syiem Sihon u syiem ki Amorites bad u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan bad ki hima Kana:

en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .
kha: U shñiuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kynthei , ki bniat jong ki , ki long kum ki bniat sing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki shniuh kum ki shniuh kynthei bad ki bniat jong ki ki long kum ki bniat jong ki sing .

en: Your issue has been resolved successfully. We hope to serve you better in the future.
kha: Ka jingeh jong phi ka la shah pynbeit. Ngi kyrmen ban shakri kham bha ïa phi ha ki por ban wan.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mat jong phi ka la long kaba jop. Ngi kyrmen ban shakri kham bha ia phi ha ki por ban wan.

en: That bringeth the princes to nothing  ; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity .
kha: U pynhiar shapoh ïa ki nongsynshar badonbor um pynlong ei ei shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka wanrah ia ki syiem sha ka jingbym don shuh; u pynlong ia ki nongbishar jong ka khyndew kum ka jinglong ba sniew .

en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
kha: Ki dur khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia ki kynthei kiba phylla, bad ka dohnud jong me kan kren ia kiei kiei kiba bakla .

en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .
kha: Haba ka Rebekka ka ïohi ïa u Isaak , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebeka u la rah ia ki khmat jong u, bad haba ka la iohi ia u Isaak , ka la pynkhih ia ka kulai .

en: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,
kha: Ko ki khun ba-ieit jong nga ! Sa shisien , kum ka kmie kaba suh kha , nga sngew ïa kajuh ka jait jingsuh na ka bynta jong phi tad haduh ka jinglong U Khrist kan da thawdur ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit jong nga kiba nga kha pat haduh ba U Khrist un sa mih ha phi .

en: These profound differences even affected fundamental teachings about God and Christ .
kha: Kine ki jingiapher kiba jylliew ki la ktah wat ia ki jinghikai ba kongsan shaphang U Blei bad U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki jingiapher kiba jylliew ki la ktah wat ia ki jinghikai ba kongsan shaphang U Blei bad U Khrist .

en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,
kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingknia ba la thang bad ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ka jaka bam bad ka kjat jong u .

en: He looketh on the earth , and it trembleth : he toucheth the hills , and they smoke .
kha: U khmih ha ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh ; u ktah ïa ki lumbah , bad ki pynmih ïa ka tdem .
translated_en_to_kha: U peit ia ka khyndew , bad ka khih: u ktah ia ki lum , bad ki dih duma .

en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
kha: U syiem Serksis u la pynlong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki rud duriaw jong ka hima jong u kumjuh ruh ïa kito ki briew kiba shong shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ahasaerus u la buh khajna ha ka ri bad ha ki dulir duriaw .

en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes , and make thy supplication to the Almighty  ;
kha: Hynrei to phai mynta bad to ïasaid bad U Blei Badonbor Baroh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me kwah ban wad ia U Blei ha ki por ba la buh, bad leh ia ka jingkyrpad jong me ha Uba donbor baroh;

en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth , and a twoedged sword in their hand  ;
kha: Ai ba kin pyrta jam katba ki ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad ki waitlam banep ha ki kti jong ki
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki jingiaroh ba jrong jong U Blei kin long ha ka shyntur jong ki , bad ka waitlam kaba arliang ha ka kti jong ki ; .

en: For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .
kha: Kaei kaba phi dei ban ong ka long kane :  Lada U Trai u mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kane lane ïa katai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba phi dei ban ong , Lada U Trai un mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ia kane ne ia kata .

en: Who found favour before God , and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
kha: U la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei , bad u la kyrpad ïa U Blei ban shah ïa u ban pynkhreh ka ïing na ka bynta U Blei jong u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat U Blei , bad u kwah ban shem ia ka jaka sah na ka bynta U Blei jong u Jakob .

en: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .
kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phi dei ban long kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta haba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba la pynkhreh ruh: namar U Khun u briew u wan ha ka kynta kaba phim pyrkhat .

en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Amon ki la thmu pyrshah ia u bad ki la pyniap ia u syiem ha la iing .

en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Wat klim .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohsngew ba la ong da ki ha ka por barim: Wat leh ia ka kam sniew:

en: Thou art become cruel to me : with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me .
kha: Me la lehbeiñ ïa nga ; me la pynshitom ïa nga da ka bor jong me baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la kylla long uba sniew ia nga: da ka kti kaba khlain jong me me pyrshah ia lade pyrshah ia nga .

en: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil , and pour it upon his head , and anoint him .
kha: Nangta , shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , theh ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u , bad pynsleh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to shim ia ka umphniang pynsleh bad theh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u bad pynsleh ia u .

en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: hynrei u la pynngam jyllop ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Pharaoh bad u kynhun jong u ha ka duriaw Basaw: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .
kha: Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jong ki ha Ashdod ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la shim ia ka synduk U Blei bad ki la wanrah ia ka na Ebenaseser haduh Ashdod .

en: And Eli said unto her , How long wilt thou be drunken ? put away thy wine from thee .
kha: bad u ong ha ka ,  Keiñ noh kane ka jingleh buaid jong pha ! Wat dih shuh bad pynpyngngad noh !
translated_en_to_kha: U Eli u la ong ia ka, Haduh katno phin sa dih kyiad ? bret noh ia ka wain jong me na me .

en: And if she vowed in her husband s house , or bound her soul by a bond with an oath  ;
kha: Lada ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim ka kular ban kiar na kano kano ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka la kular ha iing u tnga jong ka, ne ka la teh ia ka mynsiem jong ka da ka jingiadei bad ka jingsmai ; .

en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .
kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria bad ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien katto katne sngi u syiem u Agrippa bad u Bernice ki la wan sha Kaisaria ban ai khublei ia u Festo .

en: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?
kha: Kumta ki synran ki la sdang ban ïakylli para ma ki hi ,  Hato la don mano mano ba la wanrah jingbam ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki synran ki la ong iwei ia iwei pat: Hato don mano mano ba wanrah ia u ban bam ?

en: Trust ye in the  Lord  for ever : for in the  Lord Jehovah  is everlasting strength :
kha: To ngin shaniah ha U  Trai  junom ; un ïada ïa ngi borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaniah ha U Trai junom: namar ha U Trai U Trai U Trai u long ka bor bymjukut:

en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ka met jong nga da ki shyieng , bad ki thied bad me la tap ïa ki shyieng da ki ksah bad ka sniehdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la phong ia nga da ka sniehdoh bad ka doh , bad me la ker sawdong ia nga da ki shyieng bad ki shyieng .

en: And the waters shall fail from the sea , and the river shall be wasted and dried up .
kha: Ka um kan rit ha ka Nile , bad ka wah kan sdang ban rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um kin jah noh na ka duriaw , bad ka wah kan sa jah rngai bad kan sa tyrkhong .

en: And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .
kha: Ïa ka ïing jong u yn tip ha Israel kum ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah loit juti .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong u kan long ha Israel , Ka iing jong uta uba la pyllait ia ka juti jong u .

en: I hate , I despise your feast days , and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga isih ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi ; ngam lah shah ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga shun , nga sngewsih ia ki sngi bam jong phi , bad ngan ym sngap jar ha ki jingiaseng ba pura jong phi .

en: And they said one to another , Let us make a captain , and let us return into Egypt .
kha: Kumta ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  To ngin jied uwei u nongïalam , bad ngin ïaleit phai pat sha Ijipt !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat , To ngin ia leh ia u kapten bad to ngin leit phai noh sha Ijipt .

en: They were driven forth from among men , ( they cried after them as after a thief  ; )
kha: Baroh ki la beh ïa ki ryngkat bad ki jingkynha , kumba ki kynha ïa ki nongtuh .
translated_en_to_kha: La beh noh ia ki na ki briew , (ki la iam hadien jong ki kumba hadien u nongtuh ; )

en: Delivering thee from the people , and from the Gentiles , unto whom now I send thee ,
kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ki paid Israel bad na ki Jentil sha kiba ngan phah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpyllait ia me na ki briew bad na ki Jutang , ha kiba nga phah mynta ia me .

en: God is a Spirit : and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth .
kha: U Blei u long U Mynsiem , bad tang ha ka bor U Mynsiem jong u ba ki briew ki lah ban mane ïa u kumba u long hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u long U Mynsiem: bad kita kiba mane ia u ki dei ban mane ia u ha ka mynsiem bad ha ka jingshisha .

en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Tyros , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding ha ka kynroh jong ka Tyros , ka ban bam ia ki iing jong ka .

en: All things were made by him  ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .
kha: Da u , la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ka jingpynlong baroh kaba la thaw khlem ma u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei la thaw da u ; bad khlem ma u ym shym la leh ei ei kaba la thaw .

en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew khyndai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi jong u Methuselah baroh ki long hynniew spah hynriewphew hynniew snem: bad u la iap .

en: In the way of righteousness is life  ; and in the pathway thereof there is no death .
kha: Ka hok ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim ; ka jingbymman ka long ka lynti sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka lynti jong ka hok ka long ka jingim ; bad ha ka lynti jong ka ym don jingiap .

en: And , behold , certain of the scribes said within themselves , This man blasphemeth .
kha: Nangta katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Une u briew u krenbeiñ Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, katto katne na ki nongthoh ki la ong hapoh jong ki, Une u briew u kren bein .

en: For to be carnally minded is death ; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace .
kha: Kaba shah synshar ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh , ka ïalam sha ka jingïap ; kaba shah synshar ha U Mynsiem , ka ïalam sha ka jingim bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ban long kiba don ka jingmut kaba kynja doh ka long ka jingiap ; hynrei ban long kiba don ka jingmut mynsiem ka long ka jingim bad ka jingsuk .

en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them , or that the wild beast may break them .
kha: Kam tip ei ei lada ka kjat ka lah ban pynlwet ïa ki ne lada u mradkhlaw u pynpait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad klet ba ka kjat ka lah ban pynkhih ia ki , ne ba u mrad khlaw u lah ban pynpra ia ki .

en: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long , and five cubits broad .
kha: Ki kamra ap phira jong ka , ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ki kynroh bashapoh jong ka ki la long katjuh ka jingheh kat kito kiba ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . La don ruh jingkhangïit baroh sawdong bad ha ka jaka rung . Baroh shi lynter ka la long arphew san mitar ka jingjrong bad khat-ar mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ar tylli ki arch sawdong ki long sanphew cubit ka jingjrong, bad san cubit ka jingheh .

en: For we brought nothing into this world , and it is certain we can carry nothing out .
kha: Ngi wallam aïu sha ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei ! Ngi lah ban rah aïu pat na ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim shym la wanrah ei ei ha kane ka pyrthei , bad ka long kaba thikna ba ngim lah ban pyndep ei ei .

en: But Thomas , one of the twelve , called Didymus , was not with them when Jesus came .
kha: Uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u Thomas ( ba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) , um shym don bad ki haba U Jisu u la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Thomas uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki briew kiba la khot u Didymus um shym la don ryngkat bad ki haba U Jisu u la wan .

en: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you , as it is written .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Na ka daw jong phi ki Jiw , ki Jentil ki kren sniew ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kyrteng U Blei ka long kaba la kren bein hapdeng ki Jutang lyngba jong phi , kumba la thoh .

en: Return unto thy rest , O my soul  ; for the  Lord  hath dealt bountifully with thee .
kha: To sngewskhem , ko mynsiem jong nga , namar U  Trai  u la lehbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To phai sha ka jingjahthait jong me , ko mynsiem jong nga ; namar U Trai u la leh sngewbha ia me .

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .
kha: Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ,  Ko khun u briew ïeng joit . Nga kwah ban ïakren bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, to ieng ha ki kjat jong me bad ngan kren ha me .

en: And I spake unto you at that time , saying , I am not able to bear you myself alone :
kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Mynba ngi dang don ha u Lum Sinai , nga la ïathuh ha phi , ‘ Ka jingkitkhlieh ban ïalam ïa phi ka khia than ïa nga , ngam lah shuh ban kit ïa ka tang marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la kren ha phi ha kata ka por, da kaba ong , ngam lah ban shah ia phi marwei:

en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .
kha: Naba ngi pynkut ba u briew u don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei tang lyngba ka jingngeit , bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi pynkut ba u briew u long uba hok da ka jingngeit khlem ki kam jong ka ain .

en: Then the Philistines went up , and pitched in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .
kha: Ki Philistia ki wan bad sher dara ha Judah , bad ki hiarthma ïa ka shnong Lehi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Philistia ki la kiew shaneng bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad Judah bad ki la pynphriang ia lade ha Lehi .

en: Much every way : chiefly , because that unto them were committed the oracles of God .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha , don shibun , ha kiba bun ki liang! Ha kaba nyngkong , U Blei u la aiti ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun ha man la ki rukom: khamtam eh, namar ba ha ki la aiti ia ki jingkren bein jong U Blei .

en: Today’s realities are war , crime , hunger , sickness , aging—to mention just a few .
kha: Namar ka jingshisha ka long ka thma , jingsniew , jingïapthngan , jingpang ban kdew tang katto kattne .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki jingshisha ki long ka thma, ki kam runar, ka jingkyrduh, ka jingpang, ka jinglong tymmen to kdew tang katto katne .

en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .
kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un paw , u da wan ha ki lyoh lem bad ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta kin iohi ia U Khun u briew uba wan ha u lyoh ryngkat bad ka bor bad ka burom kaba khraw .

en: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
kha: Bad ïa uno uno u dieng u bym pynmih u soh uba bha la ju khet noh bad bret hapoh ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym pynmih soh uba bha la ot noh bad la bret ha ka ding .

en: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off , and to them that were nigh .
kha: Bad U wan bad u la ïalap ïa ka khubor babha jong ka jingsuk sha phi kiba la jngai bad ha kiba long hajan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan bad u la ialap ia ka jingsuk ha phi kiba la jngai , bad ha kito kiba la jan .

en: And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u kyntait ban jubab wat tang shikyntien , kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa u lyngskor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la jubab ia u ban ym don ka ktien kaba shu sngap jar ba u Lat u la lyngngoh shibun .

en: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law , and did all that he had said .
kha: U Moses u pdiang ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Jethro
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Moses u la sngap ia ka sur jong u kpa jong u ha ka ain , bad u la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong .

en: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name .
kha: Bad u la wan poi sha Damaskos lem bad ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh ban kem ïa baroh kiba mane ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne u don ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh ban teh ia baroh kiba khot ia ka kyrteng jong me .

en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace , and in all other places ;
kha: Kaba mih nangta ka long , ba ka kynhun nongap phira jong ka ïingsyiem baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat hangne , ki tip ba nga don ha ka byndi namar nga long u shakri jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba ki jingiadei jong nga ha U Khrist ki paw ha ka iing syiem baroh , bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka baroh;

en: For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .
kha: ïa u briew u ba jingngeit u ban bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam : U wei pat u briew uba tlot ,  u bam da ki jhur .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei u ngeit ba u lah ban bam ia kiei kiei baroh: uwei pat uba tlot u bam ia ki jingthung jingtep .

en: For I have kept the ways of the  Lord  , and have not wickedly departed from my God .
kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  ; Ngam shym la phai noh na U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la bat ia ki lynti U Trai , bad ngam shym la phet noh na U Blei jong nga .

en: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
kha: Ki la pyrta bad kylli ,  Don mo u nongshong basa hangne uba kyrteng u Simon Petros ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot bad u la kylli la u Simon uba la jer kyrteng u Petros u la sah hangta .

en: And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me , and live .
kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ba men ïohi ïa ka khmat jong nga , namar uno uno uba ïohi ïa ka un ym im shuh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Phi lah ban iohi ia ka khmat jong nga: namar ym don mano mano ruh ban iohi ia nga bad ban im .

en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself  ; and discover not a secret to another :
kha: Lada ma phi bad la u paramarjan phi don ka jingïapher jingmut , ïakren pynbeit para ma phi bad wat pynpaw ïa kino kino ki kam barieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh ia ka daw jong me bad u para marjan jong me hi ; bad wat lap ia ka jingmaham ia uwei pat:

en: To redeem them that were under the law , that we might receive the adoption of sons .
kha: U la wan kum u Khun na ka briew bad u la im hapoh ka Hukum ki Jiw , ban siewspah ïa kito kiba hapoh ka Hukum , ba ngi lah ban long ki khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban siew kylliang ia ki kiba don hapoh ka hukum , ba ngin ioh ia ka jingpdiang ia ki khun shynrang .

en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .
kha: Mynta , ko Job , ïasuk noh bad U Blei bad sangeh noh na kaba pynlong ïa u kum u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewthuh mynta ia lade bad u, bad to long ha ka jingsuk: da kata ka jingbha kan wan ha me .

en: Why standest thou afar off , O  Lord  ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?
kha: Balei me don jngai palat , A  Trai  ? Balei me buhrieh ïa lade haba ngi don ha ka jynjar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me ieng jngai, ko Trai ? balei me buhrieh ia lade ha ki por ba jynjar ?

en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .
kha: Ïa baroh kaba u don la shim noh ; u ïap , khlem pat dap pura ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jingbha jong ki kaba don ha ki kam leit noh ? ki iap , wat khlem ka jingstad .

en: Salute Apelles approved in Christ . Salute them which are of Aristobulus  household .
kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Apelles , uba ïa ka jingïaineh ha U Khrist la pynshisha . Ki jingkhublei ïa kito kiba na ka longïing jong u Aristobulos .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Jingpule ba la mynjur ha U Khrist . Pynbeit ia ki kiba long na ka iing jong u Aristotle .

en: For yourselves , brethren , know our entrance in unto you , that it was not in vain :
kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi hi phi tip ba ka jingwan jngoh jong ngi ïa phi kam shym la long kaba sep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong phi, ko para bangeit, to tip ia ka jingrung jong ngi shapoh jong phi, ba kam shym la long lehnohei:

en: What knowest thou , that we know not ? what understandest thou , which is not in us ?
kha: Kam don ei ei kaba me tip ïa kaba ngim tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba me tip , ba ngim tip ? kaei kaba me sngewthuh ia ka , kaba ym don ha ngi ?

en: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way  ; they found no city to dwell in .
kha: Katto katne ki la sakma ha ka ri shyiap bym don lynti bad kim shym la shem ïa ka lynti jong ki sha ka nongbah ban shong ban sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid kai ha ka ri khlaw ha ka rukom kaba marwei ; kim lap ia ka shnong ban shong .

en: Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , to shahshkor ïa kaei ba u kpa jong phi u hikai ïa phi . Shahshkor bha , bad phin ïoh ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap, phi ki khun, ia ka jinghikai jong u kpa , bad to leit ban tip ia ka jingsngewthuh .

en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
kha: U briew uba bieit mutlop tam u kham bha ban ïa uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba stad haba um long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi ia u briew uba stad ha la ka jong ka jingmut ? ka don ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bun ia u briew uba bieit ban ia u .

en: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: da ka kti bakhlaiñ jong u , ka ksang ti badonbor jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka kti kaba khlain , bad da ka kti kaba la pynjrong: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall , and escaped his hands .
kha: Hynrei la pynhiar ïa nga ha ka shang na ka jingkhangïit kaba ha ka kynroh bad la pyllait im ïa nga na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lyngba ka jingkhang ha ka basket la pynhap ia nga da ka jingkhang , bad nga la lait na ki kti jong u .

en: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot , being of the number of the twelve .
kha: Nangta u Soitan u la rung hapoh u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Iskariot , uba long uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Soitan u la rung ha u Judas u Isarot , u long na ka jingdon jong ki shiphew ngut .

en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .
kha: Uno uno uba don U Khun , u don ïa kane ka jingim ; uno uno u bym don U Khun U Blei , um don ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ia u Khun u don ka jingim; bad uta u bym don ia U Khun U Blei um don jingim .

en: Then Jesus saith unto them ,  Children , have ye any meat ?  They answered him , No .
kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ko samla , phi la ïangat ei ei ?   Ei ei ruh em ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u ong ha ki, Ko khun, phi don jingbam ? Ki la jubab ia u , Em .

en: A year later , Japanese authorities said her death was linked to excessive overtime .
kha: Hadien shisnem , ki bor synshar jong ka Japan ki la ong ba ka jingiap jong ka ka dei kaba iadei bad ka jingtrei palat por .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien shisnem , ki bor synshar Japan ki la ong ba ka jingiap jong ka ka iadei bad ka jingtrei palat .

en: And being fully persuaded that , what he had promised , he was able also to perform .
kha: U la thikna bha ba U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la sngewskhem pura ia kata , ia kaei kaba u la kular , u la lah ruh ban pyndep .

en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them , What do ye , loosing the colt ?
kha: katto katne ngut na kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïaleh aïu ba phi ïalaw ïa u khun kada ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na kita kiba ieng hangta ki la ong ha ki, Phi leh aiu ia ka khun masi ?

en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .
kha: Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kum ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jingpah jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban pyntieng ia u kum u khnai ? ka burom jong ki shyntur jong u ka long kaba shyrkhei .

en: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .
kha: Ki la tan ïa ki lieng sharud duriaw , ki la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ki la bud ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la wanrah ia ki lieng jong ki sha ka ri , ki la iehnoh lut ia u bad ki la bud ia u .

en: And what can David say more unto thee ? for thou , Lord  God  , knowest thy servant .
kha: Sa kaei shuh nga lah ban ong ha me ! Me ithuh ïa nga u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid u lah ban ong kham bun ia me ? namar me, ko Trai Blei, me tip ia u shakri jong me .

en: His heart is as firm as a stone  ; yea , as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .
kha: Ka dohnud maw jong u kam ju don jingsheptieng , kaba eh tasam kum u mawtylliat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u ka long kaba skhem kum u maw ; yea, kumba ka long kaba eh kum u maw ba la khleh lang .

en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
kha: Baroh ki kren shaphang katno u long uba kohnguh bad baïaineh , hynrei shu pyrshang ban wad ïa uno uno uba long kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba bun ki briew kin pynbna ia la ka jong ka jingbha: hynrei u briew uba iaineh uba lah ban shem ?

en: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him .
kha: U don ruh u Obed Edom , uba U Blei u la kyrkhu da kaba ai ha u phra ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba la jer ter ter kat kum ka rta : u Shemaïah , u Jehosabad , u Joah , u Sakhar , u Nethanel , u Ammiel , u Issakhar , bad u Peullethai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ammiel uba hynriew , u Issakhar uba hynriew: namar U Blei u la kyrkhu ia u .
