en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings : his heart is fixed , trusting in the  Lord .
kha: Um sheptieng haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor kaba sniew ; ka jingngeit jong u ka long kaba khlaiñ , bad u shaniah ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Um dei ban tieng ia ki khubor kiba sniew: ka dohnud jong u ka long kaba skhem , da kaba shaniah ha U Trai .

en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ba ïa u Ïoannis la thep ha ka ïingbyndi , u la leit noh sha Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ba u Ioannis u la shah set phatok, u la leit noh sha Galilaia ;

en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bad u ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka long kaba bha ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki shakri jong u baroh .

en: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there , and reasoning in their hearts ,
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dang shong hangta ki la pyrkhat ha lade ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki don katto katne na ki nongthoh kiba shong hangta , bad kiba pyrkhat ha ki dohnud jong ki .

en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
kha: Ha ka por shiteng synñia nga khie ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por shiteng miet ngan ieng ban ainguh ia me namar ki jingbishar hok jong me .

en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge : but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .
kha: Ki briew kiba sian ki sngap jar ïa kaei kaba ki tip , hynrei kiba mutlop ki thad ïa la ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u buhrieh ia ka jingtip: hynrei ka dohnud jong ki bieit ka pynbna ia ka jingbieit .

en: Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Hato phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Ngan wallam ïa ki briew ryngkat bad ki waitlam ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la tieng ia ka waitlam ; bad ngan wanrah ia ka waitlam halor jong phi , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Two women shall be grinding together  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin ïatylliat lang ïa u kew : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Arngut ki kynthei kin ia rkhie bein ia kawei pat .

en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .
kha: Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dei ban ïabeh . To ai ba dohnud kan kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , khamtam ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbud hadien ka jingai sngewbha , bad kwah ia ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , hynrei kham bha ba phin iathuhlypa .

en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba hynñiewspah hynñiewphew hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi jong u Lamech baroh ki long hynriew spah hynriewphew hynriew snem: bad u la iap .

en: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .
kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmut bad phi kloi ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngi phin long uba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngap ia ka jingai jingmut , bad pdiang ia ka jinghikai , ba me long uba stad ha kaba kut jong me .

en: And the angel said unto her , Fear not , Mary : for thou hast found favour with God .
kha: U angel u la ong ha ka ,  To wat sheptieng , ko Mari ; U Blei u la sngewbha ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la ong ha ka, Wat tieng, ko Maria: namar me la shem ia ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei .

en: But I determined this with myself , that I would not come again to you in heaviness .
kha: Kumta nga la kut jingmut ban ym wan shuh sha phi ïoh ka pynsngewsih ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la kut jingmut ia kane bad lade , ba ngan ym wan phai biang sha phi ha ka jingbun briew .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Forbid him not : for he that is not against us is for us .
kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa u bad ïa kiwei pat ki synran ,  namar uno uno u bym pyrshah ïa phi u long ha ka liang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Wat khang ia u: namar uta u bym pyrshah ia ngi u long na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
kha: To ïeng joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong me mynta kum u briew: Ngan dawa na me , bad ngan pynbna ia me ha nga .

en: If you do not have a proper sewage disposal system , toilet wastes should be buried .
kha: Lada phim don ki jaka leit shabar kiba paka , dei ban shu tep ïa ka jakhlia .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim don ka rukom bret jaboh kaba biang , dei ban tep ia ki jaboh jabaiñ .

en: O Israel , return unto the  Lord  thy God  ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity .
kha: To wan phai noh sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ko paid Israel . Ka pop jong phi ka la pynlong ïa phi ban jynthut bad kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Israel , to wan phai sha U Trai U Blei jong me ; namar me la hap da ka jingbymhok jong me .

en: Yea , brother , let me have joy of thee in the Lord : refresh my bowels in the Lord .
kha: Kumta , ko para jong nga , sngewbha ban leh ïa kane na ka bynta U Trai ; kum u para ha u Khrist , to pynkmen ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ko para, to ngan ioh ia ka jingkmen jong me ha U Trai: pynthymmai ia ki bniat jong nga ha U Trai .

en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she ? for seven had her to wife .
kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba kiba ïap ki mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Baroh hynñiew ngut ki la shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha ka jingmihpat jongno ka long ma ka ? namar hynriew ngut ki la don ia ka bad ka tnga .

en: During the election campaign , Narendra Modi had called for a debate on Article 370 .
kha: Ha ka jingialap elekshon u Narendra Modi u la khot iatai halor ka Article 370 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba ialap elekshon , u Narendra Modi u la khot ia ka jingiatai halor ka Article 370 .

en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king .
kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki paidbah baroh na ka Israel bashatei ki la ïawanlang ban pynlong syiem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shehem: namar ki Israel baroh ki la wan sha Shehem ban pynlong syiem ia u .

en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds  ;
kha: U lah ban man khraw , ban jrong shaduh suiñbneng , u khraw haduh ba ka khlieh jong u ka kot sha ki lyoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka jingbha jong u ka kiew sha bneng , bad ka khlieh jong u ka poi sha ki lyoh ; .

en: And when he was come into Jerusalem , all the city was moved , saying , Who is this ?
kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la khynwin jlang .  Uei une ?  ki briew ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan sha Jerusalem, ka shnong baroh kawei ka la khih, ka la ong: Mano kane ?

en: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
kha: Ka shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing jong ka lane ha ki jaka shong kiba jrong tam ha ka shnong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing jong ka , ha ka jaka shong ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka nongbah .

en: They were confounded because they had hoped  ; they came thither , and were ashamed .
kha: hynrei ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka ïap harud ki wahduid ba-tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngewsih namar ki la kyrmen ; ki la wan shata , bad ki la sngewlehrain .

en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .
kha: U Goliath u kob ïa ki Israel man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet haduh sawphew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philistia u la wan hajan mynstep bad janmiet , bad u la pyni ia lade sawphew sngi .

en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
kha: Lada nga la kum shukor ïa u khunswet , da kaba tip ba ngan ksan ha khmat ka ïingbishar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la rah ia la ka kti pyrshah ia ki bym don kpa , haba nga la iohi ia ka jingiarap jong nga ha ka khyrdop:

en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the house of Israel , Seek ye me , and ye shall live :
kha: U  Trai  u ong kumne ha ki paid Israel ,  Wan sha nga , bad phin ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai ha ka iing Israel: To wad ia nga bad phin im:

en: For John had said unto Herod , It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother s wife .
kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la ïai-ong ïa u Herod ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa me ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga u para jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Ioannis u la ong ha u Herod , Kam long kaba dei ia me ban don ka tnga jong u hynmen jong me .

en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches .
kha: Hangno ba ka don ka jingtip , ïa ki kamra la pyndap pynbiang da ki jingbuh jingsat kiba kordor bad kiba itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jingtip ki kamra kin dap da ki spah kiba kordor bad kiba sngewtynnad baroh .

en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?
kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im kan kyrshan ïa phi haba phi pang , hynrei lada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingkyrmen jong phi kaba sah ka la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong u briew kan pynneh ia ka jingbym lah kha khun jong u ; hynrei ka mynsiem kaba la mynsaw kaba lah ban shah ?

en: My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi ki ong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga to sngap ia ka jinghikai jong u kpa jong me bad wat iehnoh ia ka hukum jong ka kmie jong me:

en: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day , and taught it the children of Israel .
kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Moses u thoh ïa kata ka jingrwai bad u hikai ïa ka ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses namarkata u la thoh ia kane ka jingrwai ha kajuh ka sngi , bad u la hikai ia ka ha ki khun Israel .

en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U Blei u long ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid , To leh ia kaba don ha ka dohnud jong me ; namar U Blei U don ryngkat bad me .

en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .
kha: Kita ki jingthaw hi ki phet shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingthaw ba im ki la mareh bad ki la wan phai kum ka dur jong ka jingshai jong ka jingshai .

en: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .
kha: La pynïadait skhem haduh katta katta ïa ki baroh ba ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iasoh iwei ia iwei pat , ki ia tyngkhuh , ba kim lah ban shah rong noh .

en: Most of the others are from Punjab , with their families having farming backgrounds .
kha: Kiba bun na kiwei pat ki dei na Punjab , ha kaba ki longïing jong ki ki don ka jinglong rep .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba bun na kiwei pat ki dei na Punjab , bad ki longiing jong ki ki don ki jinglong nongrep .

en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .
kha: Kam myntoi ïa me ban shu ïai kren ; ka long kaba shai kdar ba mem sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Job u plie ia ka shyntur jong u ha ka por ba u pynbun ia ki kyntien khlem jingtip .

en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
kha: Dang step phyrngab man ka step baroh ki briew ki la leit sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la wan mynstep sha u ha ka tempi , na ka bynta ban iohsngew ia u .

en: Which make oil within their walls , and tread their winepresses , and suffer thirst .
kha: Ki khem ïa ki soh Olib na ka bynta ka umphniang , bad ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bynta ka um sohwaiñ , hynrei ma ki ïa lade pat ki thynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pynlong ia ka umphniang hapoh ki kynroh jong ki , bad ki iaid lyngba ia ki thliew wain jong ki , bad ki shah thngan .

en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies , and that seek him with the whole heart .
kha: Suk kito kiba bud ïa ki hukum jong u , kiba kohnguh ïa u da la ka dohnud baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kito kiba sumar ia ki jingphla jong u , bad kiba wad ia u da ka dohnud baroh kawei .

en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit , that we are the children of God :
kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u pynïasoh lang ïa lade bad ki mynsiem jong ngi ban pynbna ba ngi long ki khun jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem hi u sakhi da ka mynsiem jong ngi , ba ngi long ki khun U Blei:

en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .
kha: ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba long jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bam ia ki jingthung baroh ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki la bam ia ki soh jong ka khyndew jong ki .

en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
kha: Badno phin nujor ïa nga ?  ong U  Trai .  Hato don uno uno uba kum ma nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha nga phin ianujor ia nga bad phin pynlong ia nga uba iaryngkat bad nga, ba ngin long kumta ?

en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What sawest thou , that thou hast done this thing ?
kha: Balei me leit leh ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong ha u Abraham: Me la iohi ia kane ka kam ?

en: Other common languages include Gojri , Pahadi , Kashmiri , Hindi , Punjabi and Urdu .
kha: Kiwei pat ki ktien kiba pawnam ki kynthup ia ka Gojri , ka Pahadi , Kashmiri , ka Hindi , ka Punjabi bad ka Urdu .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki ktien ba ju don ki kynthup ia ka Gojri , Pahadi , Kashmiri , Hindi , Punjabi bad Urdu .

en: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .
kha: U shna hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta uta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad u thaw ruh ïa ki nap bad ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki hynriew tylli ki sharak jong u, bad ki sniang jong u, bad ki sniang jong u, da ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: India vs Ireland , ICC Womens World T20 , as it happened : IND win , through to semis
kha: India vs Ireland , ICC Womens World T20 , kumba la jia : Jop ka IND , lyngba sha ka semis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka India vs Ireland , ICC Womens World T20 , kumba ka la jia: IND jop , lyngba ki semi .

en: Give her of the fruit of her hands  ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .
kha: Ai burom ïa ka ïa baroh kaba ka leh . Ka dei hok ban burom da baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ka na ki soh jong ki kti jong ka ; bad ai ba ki kam jong ka kin iaroh ia ka ha ki khyrdop .

en: Lying lips are abomination to the  Lord  : but they that deal truly are his delight .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa kiba lamler , hynrei u sngewbha ïa kito kiba bat ïa la ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur kiba sah ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei kita kiba leh shisha ki long ka jingsngewbha jong u .

en: And after him Elon , a Zebulunite , judged Israel  ; and he judged Israel ten years .
kha: Hadien u Ibsan , u Elon uba na Sebulun u ïalam ïa ki Israel shiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u u Elon , u nong Zebulun u la bishar ia ki Israel ; bad u la bishar ia ki Israel shi snem .

en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .
kha: U la bat ïa nga na ka ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , bad mynta nga dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong u na kaba leit shapoh ka thliew , bad ka jingim jong u kan iohi ia ka jingshai .

en: And Kish was the father of Saul  ; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel .
kha: U Kish , u kpa jong u Saul bad u Ner , u kpa jong u Abner ki dei ki khun shynrang jong u Abiel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kish u long u kpa jong u Saul bad u Ner u kpa jong u Abner u long u khun u Abiel .

en: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .
kha: Ha ka jaka ban bam , nga ïam sngewsih , bad ngam shym sangeh ban ud .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingsma jong nga ka wan shuwa ba ngan bam , bad ki jingsawa jong nga ki tuid kum ki um .

en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
kha: Borabor nga la lehhok bad lehbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phong ia ka hok , bad ka la phong ia nga: ka jingbishar jong nga ka long kum ka jainkup bad ka khlieh .

en: Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .
kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins    jong ka Asia ki la don hangta ; ki hi ki dei ban wan ha khmat jong me bad buh ïa ki jingmudui jong ki lada ki don ei ei pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la dei ban don hangne ha khmat jong me, bad pyrshah, lada ki don ka jingdonkam pyrshah ia nga .

en: You can recognize them by the way they take no part in politics or social conflicts .
kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ïa ki namar kim ju shim bynta ha ki kam saiñ pyrthei ne ha kam ïaleh pyrshah ha ka imlang sahlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ia ki da ka rukom ba kim shim bynta ha ka sain pyrthei ne ki jingialeh ha ka imlang sahlang .

en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased , and came to Samaria .
kha: U syiem u leit phai noh sha la ïing ha Samaria da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la leit sha la iing bad u la sngewsih bad u la poi ha Samaria .

en: Hearken unto me now therefore , O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , sngap ïa nga . Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga mynta , ko khun , bad to sngap ia ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong nga .

en: The son of Hesed , in Aruboth  ; to him pertained Soco , and all the land of Hepher :
kha: U Benhesed : ki nongbah Arubboth bad Sokoh bad baroh ka ri Hepher
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Hesed , ha Aruboth ; ha u u la ioh ia ka Soco , bad ka ri Hepher baroh:

en: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace  ; thou shalt be buried in a good old age .
kha: Me pat , men im tymmen , men ïap ha kaba suk , bad yn sa tep ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me leit sha ki kpa tymmen jong me ha ka jingsuk ; me la shah tep ha ka jinglong tymmen kaba bha .

en: And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .
kha: U la ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba beit sha ka nongbah ha kaba ki lah ban shong ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ialam ia ki shabar da ka lynti kaba dei , ba kin leit sha ka shnong shong jaka sah .

en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :
kha: Namar lada phi map ïa kiwei ïa ki jingpalat kiba ki la leh ïa phi , U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ruh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi map ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki, U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng ruh un map ia phi:

en: If we suffer , we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us :
kha: Lada ngi ïai bteng ban ïaishah , ngin sa synshar ruh lem bad u . Lada ngin len ïa u , u ruh un len ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi shah shitom ruh ngin synshar bad u: lada ngi kyntait ia u , ma u ruh un kyntait ia ngi:

en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .
kha: Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim tyngshaiñ shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi bad u bnai kin dum , bad ki khlur kin weng noh ia ka jingshai jong ki .

en: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow , than that thou shouldest vow and not pay .
kha: Kham bha ban ym kular ei ei ban ïa kaba pynlong ka jingkular hynrei khlem bat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ba me dei ban kular , ban ia kaba me dei ban kular bad ban ym siew .

en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .
kha: Haba u Soitan u la dep ban pynshoi ïa U Jisu ha ki rukom bapher bapher , u la iehnoh ïa u shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u ksuid u la pynkut noh ia ka jingpynshoi baroh , u la leit noh na u shi aiom .

en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends , even the eyes of his children shall fail .
kha: Ha ka proberb ba-mynshuwa , u briew u die ïa la ki paralok na ka bynta ka pisa , bad ki khun jong u ki shahshitom na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kren sngewbha ia ki paralok jong u , wat ki khmat jong ki khun jong u kin jah noh .

en: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .
kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long khlem jingïarap ha khmat u nongsynshar uba sniew ; u long uba shyrkhei kum u sing uba kyrhuh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum u sing uba rkhie bein , bad u bear uba rkhie bein; kumjuh ruh u nongsynshar uba sniew halor ki briew kiba duk .

en: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .
kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit noh bad u leh ïa baroh kaba ka Esther ka la ong ïa u ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Mordecai u la leit noh bad u la leh katba kum ka Esther ka la hukum ia u .

en: The sun ariseth , they gather themselves together , and lay them down in their dens .
kha: Haba ka sngi ka mih , ki leit phai noh bad ki thiah ha ki krem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi ka mih , ki ialum lang bad ki thiah ia ki ha ki thliew jong ki .

en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .
kha: Ïa ki kyntien jong phi yn sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — ban pynbna ïa phi la phi long uba lui lui ne uba shah pynrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ki ktien jong me men shah pynrem , bad da ki ktien jong me men shah pynrem .

en: Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :
kha: Hynrei U Blei un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha u ne um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki riewbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Blei un ym bret noh ia u briew uba janai , lymne un ym iarap ia ki nongleh bymman:

en: Are there not mockers with me ? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?
kha: Nga khmih kumno baroh ki krenbeiñ ïa nga da ka jingkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym don ki nongleh thok bad nga ? bad hato ka khmat jong nga kam iai bteng ha ka jingpynkhih jong ki ?

en: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
kha: Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u bad kyrsiew ïa u .  Pyllait im ïa ngi , A Trai !  ki la ong .  Ngin sa ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u, bad ki la pynkynjah ia u, ki da ong: ko Trai, to pynim ia ngi: ngi la jah noh .

en: And the water ran round about the altar  ; and he filled the trench also with water .
kha: Ka um ka la tuid sawdong ïa ka duwan bad la pyndap ïa ka kharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka um ka la iaid sawdong ka almari ; bad u la pyndap ia ka thliew ruh da ka um .

en: Be not afraid of their faces : for I am with thee to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ki khmat jong ki: namar nga don ryngkat bad me ban pyllait im ia me , ong U Trai .

en: Beareth all things , believeth all things , hopeth all things , endureth all things .
kha: Ka jingieit kam sangeh noh shiteng ; bad ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingïaishah jong ka kim duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shah ia kiei kiei baroh, ka ngeit ia kiei kiei baroh, ka kyrmen ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha kaba ki la ïalang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don bun ki jingshai ha ka kamra kaba shalor , ha kaba ki la ialum lang .

en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne .
kha: U Khunlangbrot u la leit bad u la shim ïa ka kot kli na ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan bad u la shim ia ka kot na ka liang kadiang jong uta uba shong halor ka khet .

en: The India vs England match will be aired live on Star Sports 1 HD and Star Sports 1 .
kha: Ïa ka jingïakhun jong ka India pyrshah ïa ka England yn pyni live ha Star Sports 1 HD bad Star Sports 1 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingialehkai jong ka India vs England kan long ha ka por ba im ha ka Star Sports 1 HD bad Star Sports 1 .

en: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it , then proclaim peace unto it .
kha: Haba phi leit ïaleh ïa kano kano ka shnong , ailad ïa ki briew jong ka ban pan ïasuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me wan hajan ka shnong ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka , te pynbna ia ka jingsuk ha ka .

en: He that is not with me is against me : and he that gathereth not with me scattereth .
kha: Uno uno u bym long ha ka liang jong nga u pyrshah da shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum u pynsaphriang da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u bym don bad nga u long pyrshah ia nga: bad uta u bym ialum lang bad nga u la jah noh .

en: And she called his name Joseph  ; and said , The  Lord  shall add to me another son .
kha: To U  Trai  un ai ïa nga sa uwei u khun  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Joseph bad ka la ong: U Trai un pyndap ia nga sa uwei pat u khun shynrang .

en: And he made boards for the tabernacle  ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
kha: Ki shna arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki board na ka bynta ka Tabernakple ; arphew tylli ki board na ka liang sepngi shaphang shathie:

en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .
kha: namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba hok u ïarap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u nongleh bymman u long uba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei ka jingmaham jong u ka long bad kiba hok .

en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .
kha: Phin ym ïohi ïa ki dur , ki diengphna , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka Kingdom Hall .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi nym iohi ia kino kino ki dur , ki jingpynkylla , ne kiei kiei kiba kum kine ha ka Hima Hall .

en: I beheld , and the same horn made war with the saints , and prevailed against them  ;
kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , kata ka reng ka pynlong thma bad ki briew jong U Blei bad ka la jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi , bad kata kajuh ka horn ka la ialeh thma bad ki riewkhuid , bad ka la jop pyrshah ia ki ; .

en: And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .
kha: Ka jingjubab jong ki ka long ,  U Moses u la shah ïa u briew ban pyntip da ka jingthoh ïa ka jingpyllait tnga bad iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong , U Moses u la shah shitom ban thoh ia ka bill jong ka jingpyniakhlad , bad ban weng noh ia ka .

en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .
kha: Hadien ar snem u ïap noh
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad u la iap ha ka snem kaba sawphew snem jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .
kha: U Rehoboam u leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba baroh ki briew na shaphang shatei ka Israel ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u la leit sha Shehem: namar ha Shehem baroh ki Israel ki la wan ban pynlong syiem ia u .

en: Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .
kha: Nga la kren kum u bieit , ko  Trai . Aïu ngan jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang ban ong ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long uba sniew; ngan buh ia ka kti jong nga ha ka shyntur jong nga .

en: As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”
kha: Kumba ka Baibl ka ong , phin nym sngew sih kum kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ong ka Baibl , phin ym sngewsih kumba kiwei pat ruh ki leh ki bym don jingkyrmen .

en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ïa ka Sabbaton la thaw na ka bynta ka jingbha u briew ; ïa u briew ym shym la thaw na ka bynta ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Ka Sabha ka la long na ka bynta u briew bad ym u briew na ka bynta ka Sabha:

en: She was shifted to the hospital immediately where doctors declared her brought dead .
kha: La pynkynriah ia ka sha hospital mardor ha kaba ki doktor ki la pynbna ba la wanrah ia ka ba ka la iap .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkynriah noh ia ka sha hospital mardor ha kaba ki doktor ki la pynbna ba ka la wanrah ia ka ba ka la iap .

en: And Pathrusim , and Casluhim , ( out of whom came the Philistines , ) and Caphtorim .
kha: ka Pathrus , ka Kasluh bad ka Krit na kiba la hiarpateng ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Pathırım , bad u Ksuhim (na ki la wan ki Philistia , ) bad u Kaphtorim .

en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee , thou shalt not let him go away empty :
kha: Haba phi pyllait ïa ki , wat phah noh thylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me phah noh ia u na me, wat pyllait ia u thylli:

en: Students alleged that attackers entered hostels and assaulted students and teachers .
kha: Ki samla pule ki la kynnoh ba ki nongthombor ki rung ha ki hostel bad thombor ia ki khynnah skul bad ki nonghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah skul ki la kynnoh ba ki nongthombor ki la rung ha ki hostel bad ki la thombor ia ki khynnah skul bad ki nonghikai .

en: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten : for he had many wives .
kha: U la don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang , namar u don shibun ki tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u don shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u: namar u don bun ki tnga .

en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge : but the heart of the foolish doeth not so .
kha: Ïa ka jingtip la pynphriang da ki briew kiba stad , ym da kiba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong kiba stad ki pynphriang ia ka jingtip: hynrei ka dohnud jong kiba bieit kam long kumta .

en: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .
kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga , shim khia ïa kaei kaba nga hikai ïa phi , bad phin im slem .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ko khun jong nga, bad pdiang ia ki ktien jong nga ; bad ki snem jong ka jingim jong me kin long kiba bun .

en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :
kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw kaba long baroh sawdong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ka duwan , bad ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingshakri jong ki longiing jong ki nong Gerson , ban shakri bad na ka bynta ki jingkit:

en: But of the times and the seasons , brethren , ye have no need that I write unto you .
kha: Ym donkam ban thoh ha phi , ko parabangeit , shaphang ki por bad ki khep haba kine kiei kiei kin jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ki por bad ki aiom , ko para bangeit , phim donkam ba ngan thoh sha phi .

en: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
kha: Suk uta u briew uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid hok ïa ka kam khaïi jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha u pyni ia ka jingsngewbha, bad u ai ram: un ialam ia ki kam jong u da ka jingsngewthuh .

en: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .
kha: Ka jinglorni ka wanrah ïa ka jingbitar kumba da shisha ka lyer na shatei ka wanrah slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Iyer kaba mihngi ka pynmih ia u slap: kumta ka don ka khmat kaba bitar ka shyntur kaba kylla .

en: But ye that did cleave unto the  Lord  your God are alive every one of you this day .
kha: hynrei kito na phi kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ki dang im haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi kiba la iaineh ha U Trai U Blei jong phi phi im iwei pa iwei ha kane ka sngi .

en: And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
kha: U ong ha u Abraham ,  Kane baroh ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah kat ha kaba me kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong , Ha khmih ka ri jong nga ka don ha khmat jong me: shong ha ka jaka ba ka sngewbha ia me .

en: And out of the tribe of Dan , Eltekeh with her suburbs , Gibbethon with her suburbs ,
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Dan la ai ha ki saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Eltekeh , ka Gibbethon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jaitbynriew Dan , ka Eltekeh bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka , ka Gibbethon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka .

en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
kha: To shahshkor , ma phi baroh , ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap da kaba sngap jar ia ka jingsawa jong ka sur jong u , bad ka sur kaba mih na ka shyntur jong u .

en: Speak , ye that ride on white asses , ye that sit in judgment , and walk by the way .
kha: Ïathuh ïa kata , phi kiba shong halor ki kada balieh , Kiba shong ha ki jin , Bad phi kiba hap ïaid kjat kat shaba phi leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren , phi kiba shong ha ki kada lieh , phi kiba shong ha ka jingbishar bad kiba iaid ha ka lynti .

en: How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
kha: Kiei ki pop jong nga ? Kiei ki bym dei kiba nga la leh ? Ki kam sniew aïu ba la ujor ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno tylli ki jingbymhok bad ki pop jong nga ? pynlong ia nga ban tip ia ka jingleh bymman jong nga bad ka pop jong nga .

en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .
kha: U  Trai  u tip lada phi long uba rkhiebeiñ . Bad um sngewbha ïa kata ; bad nangta u lah ban ym pynshitom ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un iohi ia ka, bad ka pynsngewsih ia u, bad u pynphai noh ia ka jingbitar jong u na u .

en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill  ;
kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka khyndew ; u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingsangsot jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U pynmih ia kiba duk na ka dewbilat , bad u pynmih ia kiba duk na ka dewbilat ; .

en: I am clean without transgression , I am innocent  ; neither is there iniquity in me .
kha: Ngam shym long uba la pynrem ; ngam shym la leh bakla ei ei . Nga long uba lui lui bad lait na ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long uba khuid khlem ka jingpynkhein, nga long uba khlem pop ; bad ym don ka jingbymhok ha nga .

en: A time to rend , and a time to sew  ; a time to keep silence , and a time to speak  ;
kha: ka por ban tar bad ka por ban syrdep , ka por ban sngap jar bad ka por ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban pynkylla , bad ka por ban sew ; ka por ban sngap jar , bad ka por ban kren ; .

en: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?
kha: Bad ma phi ! Phi pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga ha ka jingbieit ! Baroh ka jubab ba phi ai ka long ka jingshukor !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno te phi pyntngen ia nga khlem jingmyntoi , haba phi iohi ha ki jubab jong phi ba ka sah ka jinglamler ?

en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza , which shall devour the palaces thereof :
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbah ka Gasa , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding ha ka kynroh jong ka Gaza , ka ban bam ia ki iing jong ka:

en: I tell thee , thou shalt not depart thence , till thou hast paid the very last mite .
kha: Hangta phin sah , nga ong ha phi , tad ynda phi siew ïa pisa bakhatduh jong ka kuna jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia me, wat leit noh nangta, haduh ba phin da siew ia ka mite kaba khatduh eh .

en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :
kha: Ka khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba phim shym duh noh ban pdiang wat tang ïa kawei ka jingkyrkhu , katba phi dang ap khmih lynti ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba phi wan shadien ha ka jingai;

en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?
kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U dei U Messaïah !  Hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  U Messaïah un ym wan na Galilaïa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong , Une u long U Khrist . Hynrei don kiba ong: Hato U Khrist un mih na Galilaia ?

en: I beheld , and , lo , there was no man , and all the birds of the heavens were fled .
kha: Nga la ïohi ba ym don briew ; wat ki sim ki la lah her noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi, bad, ha khmih, ym don briew, bad ki sim bneng baroh ki la phet noh .

en: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah .
kha: U Ahasaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah ha ka snem kaba khatwei ha kaba u Joram u khun jong u Ahab , u la long u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Joram u khun u Ahab u la sdang ban synshar halor ka Judah .

en: Then said Jesus ,  Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka ! To ai ba kan buh ïa kaei kaba ka don na ka bynta ka sngi ban tep jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong: To ai ia ka marwei: pyrshah ia ka sngi tep jong nga ka la buh ia kane .

en: It cannot be gotten for gold , neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof .
kha: Ym lah ban thied da ka rupa lane ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym lah ban ioh ia ka ksiar , bad ym dei ban thew ia ka rupa na ka bynta ka dor jong ka .

en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down , after they were compassed about seven days .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa ki kynroh ka Jerikho ban kyllon , hadien ba ki khun Israel ki la ïaid tawiar sawdong ïa ki , hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit ki kynroh jong u Jerikoh ki la hap noh , hadien ba la ker sawdong ia ki kumba hynriew sngi .

en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .
kha: Bad kumta ka khubor shaphang u Jisu ka la phriang stet kylleng ka probins jong ka Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi ka nam jong u ka la saphriang kylleng ka thain sawdong ka Galilaia .

en: And Saul took him that day , and would let him go no more home to his father s house .
kha: U Saul u bat ïa u Dabid ban ïaisah bad u naduh kata ka sngi bad um shym shah ïa u ban leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la shim ia u ha kata ka sngi , bad un ym pyllait shuh ia u sha iing u kpa jong u .

en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes .
kha: U syiem u shong ban bishar bad u tip ïa kaba sniew haba u ïohi ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem uba shong ha ka khet bishar u pynphriang ia ka jingsniew baroh da ki khmat jong u .

en: On this side Jordan , in the land of Moab , began Moses to declare this law , saying ,
kha: Dei ha ka por ba ki Israel ki don ha Moab sha mihngi na Jordan ba u Moses u sdang ban batai bad hikai ïa ki hukum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka liang ka Jordan , ha ka ri Moab , u Moses u la sdang ban pynbna ia kane ka hukum da kaba ong:

en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .
kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ka jutang jong nga hapdeng jong nga bad me , bad ngan pynbun palat ia me .

en: And those twelve stones , which they took out of Jordan , did Joshua pitch in Gilgal .
kha: Hangta u Joshua u pynïeng ïa ki khat-ar tylli ki maw ba la shim na ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki maw kiba ki la shim na Jordan ki la iaid ha Gilgal .

en: To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: U la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la ialam ia ki briew jong u lyngba ka ri khlaw: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
kha: Kumba ka ïor ka jah noh ha ka jingshit bad ka jingryngkhiang , kumjuh ruh u nongpop u jah noh na ka ri jong kiba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit ka bam ia ki um slap: kumta ka jingtep ia kito kiba la leh pop .

en: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew u la ong ,  naduh ba nga dang khynnah , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, kine baroh nga la iohi naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: But some man will say , How are the dead raised up ? and with what body do they come ?
kha: Don u ban kylli ,  Kumno lah ban pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap ? Ka met kaba kumno kin don ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don u briew uba ong , Kumno la pynmihpat ia kiba iap ? bad bad kaei ka met kaba ki wan ?

en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .
kha: Phi ruh phi dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: To long ruh kiba iaishah bad pynskhem ia ki dohnud jong phi: namar ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .

en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it , neither shall it be valued with pure gold .
kha: U mawkordor Topas babha tam bad ka ksiar banylla kim lah ïanujor bad ka dor jong ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka topz jong ka Ethiopia kan ym iaryngkat bad ka , bad kan ym long kaba kordor da ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: Now God himself and our Father , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way unto you .
kha: To U Blei hi uba U Kpa jong ngi da lade hi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong ngi ban wan sha phi!
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Blei hi bad U Kpa jong ngi bad U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist, u pynbeit ia ka lynti jong ngi sha phi .

en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .
kha: Kren na ka bynta ki briew ki bym lah ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade . Ïada ïa ki hok jong baroh ki bym don jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia ka shyntur jong me na ka bynta kiba dum ha ka daw jong baroh kiba la buh ban pynjot .

en: The actor played a superstar who motivates Zairas character to believe in her dreams .
kha: Ka aktor ka la ak kum ka khlur ba pawnam kaba pynshlur ia ka Zairas ban ngeit ha ki jingangnud jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U aktor u la leh ia ka jinglong ba pawnam kaba pynshlur ia ka jinglong jong ka Zaira ban ngeit ha ki jingphohsniew jong ka .

en: And Joseph said unto them , That is it that I spake unto you , saying , Ye are spies :
kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ong , phi dei ki nongsyntiat ,  u Joseph u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki, Kata ka long ba nga kren ha phi, da kaba ong: Phi long ki nongleit jingleit:

en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
kha: Bad kumta ngan wan sha phi da ka jingkmen kaba dap , lada ka long ka mon jong U Blei , bad ngan dap da ka jinghun ba pynpyngngad haba ngan wan khmih ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan wan sha phi da ka jingkmen da ka mon U Blei , bad nga lah ban pynthymmai ia phi .

en: Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests ,
kha: Ka dei namar kane ka jingthmu ba nga la leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka hukum na ki rangbah lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba nga leit sha Damaskos da ka bor bad ka jingpynrung na ki rangbah lyngdoh .

en: This I say then , Walk in the Spirit , and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba nga ong : Shah ïa U Mynsiem ba un pynïaid ïa ki jingim jong phi , bad phin ym pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane nga ong te , To iaid ha U Mynsiem bad phin ym pyndep ia ka jingkwah brai jong ka doh .

en: And Joshua burnt Ai , and made it an heap for ever , even a desolation unto this day .
kha: U Joshua u la thang ïa ka Ai bad u iehnoh ïa ka ha ka jingjot . Ka dang sah kumta mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la thang ia ka Ai, bad u la pynlong ia ka kum ka thliew junom, wat ka jingjot haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And Moses told it unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel .
kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata kaba u Moses u la ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang u Aaron , bad ha ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iathuh ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki khun Israel baroh .

en: It is this post that was known as Surgeon General till the formation of Kerala State .
kha: Dei kane ka post kaba la tip kum ka Surgeon General haduh ban da thaw ia ka Jylla Kerala .
translated_en_to_kha: Dei kane ka post kaba la tip kum u Surgeon General haduh ka jingmih jong ka Jylla Kerala .

en: Then came there two women , that were harlots , unto the king , and stood before him .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , ar ngut ki nuti ki la wan bad pynpaw ïa lade ha khmat u Syiem Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan hangta arngut ki kynthei kiba long ki nongkhaïi , ha u syiem bad ki la ieng ha khmat jong u .

en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way : and his heart fretteth against the  Lord .
kha: Don ki briew kiba pynjot ïa lade da ki kam ba-mutlop jong ki hi bad nangta ki kynnoh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbieit jong u briew ka pynkylla ia ka lynti jong u: bad ka dohnud jong u ka khih pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And these are the words that the  Lord  spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki ktien kiba U Trai u kren shaphang ki Israel bad shaphang u Judah .

en: The salutation by the hand of me Paul . Remember my bonds . Grace be with you . Amen .
kha: Da ka kti jong nga hi nga thoh ïa kane :  Ki jingai khublei na u Paul .  Wat klet ïa ki kynjri jong nga ! To ai ba ka jingaiei jong U Blei kan long lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Jingkyrkhu da ka kti jong nga u Paul . Kynmaw ia ki jingiadei jong nga . Ka jingaiei kan long bad phi . Amen .

en: Even so we , when we were children , were in bondage under the elements of the world :
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ngi ruh ngi la ju long ki mraw ha kiwei pat ki bor mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka pyrthei shuwa ba ngin poi ka jinglong rangbah ba kynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ngi , haba ngi dang rit , ngi la don ha ka jinglong mraw hapoh ki element jong ka pyrthei:

en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .
kha: bad ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da kaba shukor ïa kiwei bad shah shukor ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew bad ki nongleh thok kin nang kham sniew nang kham sniew, ki nang kham sniew bad shah thok .

en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
kha: Ka met jong u kan khie lung kumba dang samla bad ban khlaiñ pat ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh jong u kan kham thymmai ban ia u khynnah s: un leit phai biang sha ki sngi samla jong u:

en: And when it was day , the magistrates sent the serjeants , saying , Let those men go .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud ki bor synshar ka Hima Rom ki la phah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad ka hukum ,  Pyllait noh ïa kito ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la dei ka sngi, ki majistor ki la phah ia ki sergent ki da ong , Ai ba kita ki briew kin leit noh .

en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules .
kha: Pha la die ïa ki tiar jong pha na ka bynta ki kulai tan , ki kulai thma , bad ki kada na Beth Togarmah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jong ka iing u Togarmah ki la khaii ha ki fair jong me da ki kulai bad ki kulai bad ki kulai .

en: In stripes , in imprisonments , in tumults , in labours , in watchings , in fastings ;
kha: La sympat ïa ngi , la set byndi , bad la shah ktah kti ha u paidbhur ; ngi la trei palat bad ngi la duh thiah ne duh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki stripe, ha ki jingshah set phatok, ha ki jingeh, ha ki jingtrei shitom, ha ki jingpeitkai, ha ki jingleh niam ; .

en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .
kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long kum ka rupa kaba kynsai ; ka jingai jingmut jong u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong kiba hok ka long kum ka rupa ba la jied: ka dohnud jong kiba sniew ka long kaba kordor khyndiat .

en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall not escape .
kha: Lada phi lamler ha ka ïingbishar , phin shah pynshitom — yn ym don jingpyllait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sakhi kaba bakla kan ym long kaba khlem jingpynshitom , bad uta uba kren thok un ym lait .

en: And Elisha said unto him , Take bow and arrows . And he took unto him bow and arrows .
kha: Pynïoh ïa ka ryntieh bad katto katne tylli ki khnam ,  u Elisha u hukum ïa u . U Jehoash u pynïoh ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong ha u, To shim ia ka bow bad ki khnam . Bad u la shim ia u da ka bow bad ki khnam .

en: And Samuel told all the words of the  Lord  unto the people that asked of him a king .
kha: U Samuel u ïathuh ha kita ki briew kiba pan syiem na u ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la iathuh ia ki ktien U Trai baroh ha ki briew kiba la pan na u syiem .

en: I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .
kha: Nga sngewbha ban kyrpad ïa ka Ïuodia bad ka Suntukhi , ban pyrshang ban ïamynjur kum shi para ha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia ka Eodias, bad nga kyrpad ia u Syntyche, ba kin long kumjuh ha U Trai .

en: And the sixth , Ithream , by Eglah David s wife . These were born to David in Hebron .
kha: u Ithream , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Eglah . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang baroh la kha ha Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba hynriew, ka Isram, da ka tnga jong u Eglah Dabid . Ia kine la kha ia u Dabid ha Hebron .

en: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .
kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ym bakla da lei lei ; da lei lei ngan ym poi ha ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka dohnud jong u , Ngan ym khih: namar ngan ym don ha ka jingeh .

en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkhia bapher bapher ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai ; bad ka jinglong kaba bakla kam long kaba bha .

en: And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u Joshua , da kaba ong , Ia ki san ngut ki syiem la lap ba ki la buhrieh ha ka krem ha Maksa .

en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kam bha ïa phi ; bad kumta ruh ka long kaba pyrshang ban ïoh palat ka jingïaroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam long kaba bha ban bam bun ka ngap: kumta na ka bynta ki briew ban wad ia la ka jong ka burom kam long ka burom .

en: Who among you will give ear to this ? who will hearken and hear for the time to come ?
kha: Hato uno uno na phi un sngap ïa kane ? Naduh mynta hato phin shahshkor bha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano napdeng jong phi ban ai shkor ia kane ? mano ban sngap bad iohsngew ia ka por ban wan ?

en: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God , but not according to knowledge .
kha: Nga lah ban ong skhem ïa phi ba ki long kiba ieit ïa U Blei naduh ka dohnud ; hynrei ïa ka jingieit jong ki ïa U Blei , ym shym la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingtip bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kit ia ki ba ki don ka jingkmen U Blei , hynrei ym kat kum ka jingtip .

en: Now therefore go , and I will be with thy mouth , and teach thee what thou shalt say .
kha: Mynta , khie leit ! Ngan ïarap ïa me ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ïa me aïu men ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to leit noh bad ngan long bad ka shyntur jong me bad ngan hikai ia me ia kaei kaba me ong .

en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people , the disciples suffered him not .
kha: U Paul hi u la kwah ban leit ha khmat u paidbah , hynrei ki parabangeit kim shah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Paul u la rung shapoh ki briew , ki synran kim shym la shah shitom ia u .

en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .
kha: Ha kine ki sawphew snem ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim bad ki kjat jong phi ruh kim shym at .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jain jong me kam shym la tymmen ha me, bad ka kjat jong me kam shym la tyrkhong, kine ki sawphew snem .

en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt : it shall not be eaten .
kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka jingainguh bam ba u lyngdoh u wanrah , ïa baroh dei ban thang lut khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka jingknia doh na ka bynta u lyngdoh yn thang lut: ym dei ban bam ia ka .

en: He shall not strive , nor cry  ; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets .
kha: Un ym ïakajia lane pyrta , lane kren ki jingkren bajam ha ki lynti bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym ialeh , lymne un ym iam ; bad uno uno u briew un ym iohsngew ia ka sur jong u ha ki surok .

en: His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .
kha: Ai ba ki nongpop kin kit hi ïa ka jingpynshitom ; ai ba kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong u kin iohi ia ka jingjot jong u , bad un dih ia ka jingbitar jong Uba donbor baroh .

en: But if they cannot contain , let them marry : for it is better to marry than to burn .
kha: Hynrei lada phim lah ban synshar ïa la ki jingkwah , kan bha ban ïaid shaphrang bad ban shongkurim — ka kham bha ban shongkurim ban ïa kaba ing da ka jingkwah brai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kim lah ban teh lakam , to ai ba kin shongkurim: namar ka kham bha ban shongkurim ban ia kaba thang .

en: Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
kha: To wan bad khmih ïa u briew uba la ïathuh ïa nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . Hato une u lah ban long U Messaïah ?
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, peit ia u briew uba la iathuh ia nga ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ju leh: hato kane kam dei ka Khrist ?

en: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , and whose sins are covered .
kha: Suk kita ïa kiba la map noh ïa ki jingleh bymdei , kiba ïa ki pop la map noh!
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , La kyrkhu ia kito kiba la map ia ki jingbymhok jong ki , bad kiba la tap ia ki pop jong ki .

en: Receive , I pray thee , the law from his mouth , and lay up his words in thine heart .
kha: Pdiang ïa ki jinghikai ba u ai ; buh ïa ki ktien jong u ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pdiang ia me, nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka hukum na ka shyntur jong u, bad buh ia ki ktien jong u ha ka dohnud jong me .

en: And he sent away the multitude , and took ship , and came into the coasts of Magdala .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u paidbah , u la kiew ha ka lieng , bad u la leit sha ka thain Magadan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah noh ia u paidbah bad u la leit sha ki rud duriaw Magdala .

en: For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .
kha: Kaba kum kata kaba da sang eh ka dei ban shah pynshitom da ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka kam runar kaba shyrkhei ; yea , ka long ka jingbymhok ban shah pynshitom ha ki nongbishar .

en: And he called it Shebah : therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day .
kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri  Ka Jingsmai .  Dei kumta ba ka shnong Beersheba ka la ïoh ïa la ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la khot ia ka Sheba: namarkata ka kyrteng jong ka shnong ka long Beersheba haduh kine ki sngi .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .
kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei ban long kiba sngewrit ha shuwa ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka jinghikai ia ka jingstad ; bad ha khmat ka burom ka long ka jinglong rit mynsiem .

en: And I will not have mercy upon her children  ; for they be the children of whoredoms .
kha: Ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki khun jong ka ; ki long ki khun jong ka nuti bym don jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ym isynei ia ki khun jong ka ; namar ki long ki khun jong ki nongkhaii met .

en: As the fining pot for silver , and the furnace for gold  ; so is a man to his praise .
kha: Ka ding ka phrang ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa ; ïa ka nam u briew lah ruh ban phrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka umphniang kaba jem na ka bynta ka rupa , bad ka ding na ka bynta ka ksiar ; kumjuh ruh u briew ha ka jingiaroh jong u .

en: For truly my words shall not be false : he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee .
kha: Ym don kaei kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi kaba long kaba bakla ; phi ïohi ha khmat jong phi ïa u briew uba stad shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha ki ktien jong nga kin ym long kiba bakla: uta uba janai ha ka jingtip u don bad me .

en: For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
kha: La don ka pop ha ka pyrthei shuwa ba yn ai ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei hangno ha bym don ka hukum , ym don jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haduh ba ka hukum ka la don ha ka pyrthei: hynrei ka pop kam shym la shah kyntait haba ym don ka hukum .

en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .
kha: Ka long kaba ibieit ban ym suidñiew ïa kaei kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka long kaba jingstad ban pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U bieit u pynjah burom ia ka jinghikai jong u kpa: hynrei uta uba pyrkhat ia ka jingshah pynrem u long uba stad .

en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .
kha: Ka kham bha bashong ha ka ri shyiap ban ïa kaba bad ka tnga kaba bunktien bad ïai thnum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban shong ha ka ri khlaw , ban ia kaba don ka kynthei kaba ialeh pyrshah bad kaba bitar .

en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .
kha: U Omri bad ki shipai jong u ki mihnoh na Gibbethon bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tirsah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Omri u la kiew na Gibbethon, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Tirsah .

en: Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
kha: Sa shisien uta u briew u la phah biang ïa kiwei pat ki mraw , kham bun ïa kaba nyngkong , bad ki nongshimwai ki la leh ïa ki ha kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , u la phah ia kiwei pat ki shakri kham palat ban ia kiba nyngkong: bad ki la leh ia ki kumjuh .

en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the  Lord  , or being his counsellor hath taught him ?
kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban ïathuh kaei ba U  Trai  u leh ? Mano ba lah ban hikai ïa u lane ban ai jingmut ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la bthah ia U Mynsiem U Trai , ne u nongai jingmut jong u u la hikai ia u ?

en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .
kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! To sait ruh ïa ki kti bad ïa ka khlieh jong nga ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u ong ha u, ko Trai, ym tang ki kjat jong nga hynrei ki kti bad ka khlieh jong nga ruh .

en: And their eyes were opened , and they knew him  ; and he vanished out of their sight .
kha: Te ïa ki khmat jong ki la plie bad ki la ithuh ïa u , hynrei u la jah noh na khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong ki ki la plie , bad ki la ithuh ia u ; bad u la jah noh na ka jingpeit jong ki .

en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , even what my God saith , that will I speak .
kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan ong ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga ban ong !
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Kumba U Trai u im, wat ia kaei kaba U Blei jong nga u ong, kata ngan kren .

en: Children , obey your parents in all things : for this is well pleasing unto the Lord .
kha: Ki khun , ïai kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , naba kata ka long kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun , to kohnguh ia ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh: namar kane ka long kaba sngewbha shibun ia U Trai .

en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees  ; and brake the trees of their coasts .
kha: u la pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ jong ki bad ïa ki dieng Dumbur bad u la pynkheiñ ïa baroh ki dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkhih ia ki diengsoh jong ki ruh bad ki dieng sohjew jong ki ; bad u pynkhih ia ki dieng jong ki rud duriaw jong ki .

en: The wicked are overthrown , and are not : but the house of the righteous shall stand .
kha: Ki bymman ki ïakynduh ïa la ka jingkyllon noh bad ym don ba mih pateng na ki , hynrei ki longïing jong kiba hok ki ïai im pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bymman ki shah pynhap , bad kim long: hynrei ka iing jong kiba hok kan ieng .

en: I cry unto thee , and thou dost not hear me : I stand up , and thou regardest me not .
kha: Nga khot ïa me , A Blei , hynrei mem ju jubab ; bad haba nga duwai , mem sngap shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pyrta ha me , bad me wat iohsngew ia nga: Nga ieng , bad me wat khein ia nga .

en: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light , and kings to the brightness of thy rising .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin wan bud ïa ka jingshai jong pha , bad ki syiem sha ka jingshai jong ka step phyrngab jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Jutang kin wan sha ka jingshai jong me bad ki syiem sha ka jingshai jong ka jingmih jong me .

en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee , and despise not thy mother when she is old .
kha: To shahshkor ïa la u kpa ; khlem ma u phin ym ïoh jingim . Haba ka kmie ka la tymmen , pyn-i ha ka ïa ka jingïaroh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia u kpa jong me uba kha ia me, bad wat ju lehbein ia ka kmie jong me haba ka la tymmen .

en: So the king died , and was brought to Samaria  ; and they buried the king in Samaria .
kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u la ïap . Ïa ka met jong u la kit bad la tep ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem u la iap , bad la wanrah ia u ha Samaria ; bad ki la tep ia u syiem ha Samaria .

en: And set up over his head his accusation written , THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
kha: Haneng ka khlieh jong u ki la buh ka jingthoh pynbna ïa ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u :  Une u long U Jisu , U Syiem ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh halor ka khlieh jong u ia ka jingkynnoh jong u ba la thoh , KANE KA JINGPYNBNA IA KI JINGPYNBNA .

en: They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .
kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba thmu ban pynjynjar bad ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; ki dohnud jong ki , ki dap borabor da ka jingshet shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kha ia ka jingsniew, bad ki pynmih ia ka jinglong ba sniew, bad ka kpoh jong ki ka pynkhreh ia ka jingleh thok .

en: Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
kha: lane ban leh myntor , lane ban ïakren bad ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane u nongleh jadu , ne u nongleit jingleit uba don ki mynsiem kiba la tip bha , ne u nongleh jadu , ne u nongleh jadu .

en: For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .
kha: U la jied ïa u Jakob na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la jied ia u Jakob ha lade, bad ki Israel na ka bynta ka spah ba kyrpang jong u .

en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
kha: U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai kumba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: Shabana Azmi , Sonu Nigam , Ronit Roy and Juhi Chawla were also present at the event .
kha: Ha kane ka sngi la don lang ruh ka Shabana Azmi , u Sonu Nigam , u Ronit Roy bad u Juhi Chawla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kani ka sngi da emlang u Shabana Azmi , u Sonu Nigam , u Ronit Roy wa u Juhi Chawla da emlang u .

en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka hok ban bishar , namar u long U Khun U Briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai bor ia u ban pyndep ia ka jingbishar ruh , namar u long U Khun u briew .

en: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
kha: Mynta to shim ïa ka bainong jong phi bad khie leit sha ïing . Nga kwah ban ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh kumba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia kata ka long jong me, bad leit noh ia ka lynti jong me: Ngan ai ia kane kaba khatduh, kumba ha me .

en: But he said ,  Yea rather , blessed are they that hear the word of God , and keep it .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynban , katno kaba kmen long kito kiba shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong , Hooid kham bha, la kyrkhu ia kito kiba iohsngew ia ka ktien U Blei bad kiba sumar ia ka .

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask you one thing  ; and answer me :
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Mynta shah ïa nga ban kylli kawei ka jingkylli ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, nga ruh ngan kylli ia phi kawei kaei kaei bad jubab ia nga:

en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
kha: Ko khun u briew  u la ong ,  phai khmat sha ki lum ka Israel , bad to ai ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me sha ki lum Israel bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ki .

en: Truly the light is sweet , and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun :
kha: Ka long kaba bha ba yn lah ban lehkmen ïa ka jingshai itynnat jong ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka jingshai ka long kaba thiang , bad ka long kaba sngewtynnad ia ki khmat ban iohi ia ka sngi:

en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .
kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar shiteng kita ki jingker , u kot naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka bar pdeng ban siat lyngba ki board naduh kawei ka tduh haduh kawei pat .

en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom , and apply thine heart to understanding  ;
kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad pyrshang ban shemphang ïa ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba me pynkhih ia ka shkor jong me sha ka jingstad, bad pyntreikam ia ka dohnud jong me ha ka jingsngewthuh ; .

en: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .
kha: Ki nongïalam Israel baroh ki shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki rangbah Israel ki la don ha me ha ka bor jong ki ban pynmih snam .

en: But the end of all things is at hand : be ye therefore sober , and watch unto prayer .
kha: Kaba kut jong kiei kiei baroh ka la jan . Phi dei ban long kiba lah ban synshar ïa lade bad kiba sharai , ban lah ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh ka don hajan: to long namarkata kiba jemnud bad to peit sha ka jingduwai .

en: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynskhem ïa ka jingtep da kaba buh ïa ka muhor halor u maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ban ap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la leit , bad ki la pynlong ia ka jingtep kaba thikna, da kaba khang ia u maw bad buh ia ka watch .

en: Vipers were 91 all out in 18 . 1 overs , a target West Storm raced to in 9 . 3 overs .
kha: Ki Vipers ki la jop 91 ha ka 18 . 1 over , ka thong ka West Storm ka la ïakhun ha ka 9 . 3 tylli ki over .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Vipers ki long 91 ngut baroh 18 . 1 over, ka thong jong ka West Storm ka la mareh sha ka 9 . 3 tylli ki over .

en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .
kha: Phi ki briew phi isih ïa uta uba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bad kren ïa ka jingshisha baroh ha ka ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shun ia uta uba kren bein ha ka khyrdop , bad ki shun ia uta uba kren beit .

en: Ye fools , did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also ?
kha: A ki bieit ! Hato ym dei U Blei uba la thaw ïa kaba shabar , uba la thaw ruh ïa kaba shapoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki bieit , hato uta u la thaw ia kata kaba long khlem da pynlong ia kata kaba don hapoh ruh ?

en: Behold , God is mighty , and despiseth not any : he is mighty in strength and wisdom .
kha: Katno U Blei u long uba khlaiñ ! um ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano ; ym don kano kano kaba um lah ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Blei u long uba donbor , bad um ju khein ia uno uno: u long uba donbor ha ka bor bad ka jingstad .

en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .
kha: Naba nga ïohi ba me dap da ka jingbishni bajur bad me long u koidi jong ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga sngewthuh ba me don ha ka jinglong ba sniew bad ha ka jingteh jong ka jingbymhok .

en: And if it be not so now , who will make me a liar , and make my speech nothing worth ?
kha: Hato don mano mano ba lah ban len ba kane ka long kumta ? Hato don mano mano ba lah ban pynshisha ba ki ktien jong nga ki long ki bymshisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada kam long kumta mynta , mano ban pynlong ia nga u nonglamler , bad ban pynlong ia ka jingkren jong nga kaba kordor ?

en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants , and to eat and drink with the drunken  ;
kha: bad un sdang ban shoh ïa la ki para shakri bad ban ïabam ïadih bad ki nongbuaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un sdang ban shoh ia ki para shakri jong u, bad ban bam bad dih bad u nongdih kyiad ; .

en: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pan ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalumlang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la kyrkhu ia ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei da ka sur kaba jam , u da ong:

en: Ye worship ye know not what : we know what we worship : for salvation is of the Jews .
kha: Phi ki nong Samaria phim da tip shai ïano phi mane ; hynrei ma ngi ki Jiw ngi tip ïano ngi mane , namar ka long na ki Jiw ba ka jingpynim ka wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi mane ia kaei: ngi tip ia kaei kaba ngi mane: namar ka jingpynim ka long jong ki Jiw .

en: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee , which is the sea of Tiberias .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa ( ïa kaba ju la khot ruh , ka duriaw Tiberias ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei U Jisu u la leit sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaia kaba long ka duriaw Tibet .

en: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :
kha: Lada me kyntait , ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndap ïa ka da ki jakoid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me kyntait ban pyllait ia ki, ha khmih , ngan sa pynkhih ia ki pud jong me baroh:

en: And when he had opened the second seal , I heard the second beast say , Come and see .
kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba ar ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba ar uba ong ,  To wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba ar , nga la iohsngew ia u mrad uba ar ba u ong , To wan bad peit .

en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ba-eh tam , ki tih ha trai jong ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U buh ia la ka kti halor u maw ; u pynkhih ia ki lum da ki tynrai .

en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this ?
kha: U Boas u kylli ïa u briew uba pynïaidkam ,  Katai ka theisamla ka dei mano ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Boaz u la ong ha u shakri jong u uba la buh halor ki nongot , Ka dam jongno ka long kane ?

en: Accuse not a servant unto his master , lest he curse thee , and thou be found guilty .
kha: Wat ju kren pyrshah ïa u shakri ha u kynrad jong u . Phin long uba la tim bad jynjar na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pdiang ia u shakri ha u kynrad jong u , ioh un tim ia me bad me la shem ba me long uba don pop .

en: But Paul cried with a loud voice , saying , Do thyself no harm : for we are all here .
kha: Hynrei u Paul u la pyrta da ka ktien kaba jam ,  Wat pynmynsaw ïa lade . Ngi baroh ngi don hangne !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Paul u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u da ong: Wat leh ei ei: namar ngi baroh ngi don hangne .

en: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .
kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem bad ki khun jong ki , bad ki nguh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongtrei kti ki la wan hajan , ma ki bad ki khun jong ki bad ki la dem khrup ia lade .

en: And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .
kha: U her stet halor ki Kherub u ïaid halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shong halor ka cherub , bad u la her: bad la iohi ia u halor ki bniat jong ka Iyer .

en: Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !
kha: Ka ri ka don ha ka jingjynjar haba u syiem jong ka u dei u samla bad ki nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh shi miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia me ko ri haba u syiem jong me u dang rit bad ki syiem jong me ki bam mynstep !

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :
kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ka jingshai kan ym shai ne dum:

en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .
kha: Ki briew kiba leh jubor ki shukor ïa la ki paralok bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba shyrkhei u pynsngewsih ia u paramarjan jong u , bad u ialam ia u sha ka lynti kaba ym bha .

en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew kin shah pynïap kylleng , bad kito kiba lait im kin sa sngewthuh ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiba la shah pyniap kin hap hapdeng jong phi , bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai ,
kha: Hynrei ki paidbah jong ka Gibeon , kiba dei ki Hib , ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Joshua u la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad ïa ka Ai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongshong shnong jong ka Gibeon ki la iohsngew ia kaei kaba u Joshua u la leh ha Jerikos bad ha Ai .

en: In a coming new world , life in perfect health and happiness . —Revelation 21 :3 , 4 .
kha: Ha ka pyrthei ba thymmai , ka jingim kaba suk lem bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ba janai .—Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka pyrthei kaba thymmai kaban sa wan, ka jingim ha ka koit ka khiah bad ka jingkmen kaba janai . Ka Jingpynkylla 21:3 , 4 .

en: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .
kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba ki long kiba bha palat — oh , katno ka jingbha ki pyrkhat ba ki long !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka pateng , O katno ki khmat jong ki ! bad ki khmat jong ki ki kiew shaneng .

en: Behold , I am the  Lord  , the God of all flesh : is there any thing too hard for me ?
kha: Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ym don kaei kaei kaba eh than ïa nga ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long U Trai , U Blei jong ka doh baroh: hato don kaei kaei kaba eh palat ia nga ?

en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?
kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha , hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym don lynti shuh da kumno kumno ban pynbang pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umsoh ka long kaba bha: hynrei lada ka umsoh ka la duh noh ia ka jingsma jong ka , da kaba ka long kaba la pynsngem ?

en: Manufacturers certify at the time of FLC that all components in the EVM are original .
kha: Ki nongshna ki pynshisha ha ka por jong ka FLC ba baroh ki bynta ha ka EVM ki dei kiba tynrai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshna ki pynshisha ha ka por jong ka FLC ba baroh ki bynta ha ka EVM ki long kiba tynrai .

en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .
kha: Kumta hadien ba ki la mihnoh na u Lum Sinai , ki Israel kim deng jingdeng shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la weng noh ia lade na ki jingpynitynnad jong ki da u lum Horeb .

en: He mocketh at fear , and is not affrighted  ; neither turneth he back from the sword .
kha: Kim tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingsheptieng , bad ym don waitlam kaba lah ban pynphai dien ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U rkhie bein ia ka jingtieng, bad um shym la sngewsih ; bad um phai shuh na ka waitlam .

en: When I had waited , ( for they spake not , but stood still , and answered no more  ; )
kha: Hato ngan ïai ap haduh ba kin da sngap jar ? Ki shu ïeng hangto khlem don ei ei shuh ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda nga la ap , (namar kim shym la kren , hynrei ki la ieng slem , bad kim jubab shuh; )

en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade , and mine arm be broken from the bone .
kha: te to ai ba yn kdiah ïa ki kti jong nga ; to ai ba yn sloit ïa ki na ki tyrpeng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ai ba ka kti jong nga kan hap na ka tyrpeng jong nga, bad ka kti jong nga kan tyrkhong na ka shyieng .

en: And fear came upon every soul : and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles .
kha: Shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla la leh lyngba ki apostol , bad ïa uwei pa uwei baroh la pyndap da ka jingsheptieng ïa U Blei .
