translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtieng ka la wan ha kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem: bad bun ki jingphylla bad ki dak la leh da ki apostol .

en: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go , no , not by a mighty hand .
kha: Nga tip ba u Pharaoh un ym shah ïa phi ban leit lymda la pynbor ïa u ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga thikna ba u syiem Ijipt un ym pyllait ia phi, em, ym da ka kti kaba khlain .

en: Unless thy law had been my delights , I should then have perished in mine affliction .
kha: Lada ka aiñ jong me kam shym la long ka tyllong jong ka jingkmen jong nga , ngan jin da la ïap na ki jingshitom jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka hukum jong me kam shym la long ka jingsngewbha jong nga , nga la dei ban jah noh ha ka jingjynjar jong nga .

en: But if we shall say , Of men  ; we fear the people  ; for all hold John as a prophet .
kha: Hynrei lada ngi ong , ‘ Na u briew ,’ ngi sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki lah ban leh , namar ki baroh ki la pdiang ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ngin ong , Na ki briew ngi tieng ia ki briew ; namar baroh ki bat ia u loannis kum u nongiathuhlypa .

en: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?
kha: Hato phi rai pynrem ïa U Blei uba hok ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba  U  isih ïa ka jingbishar hok ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato uta ruh uba shun ia ka hok ? bad phi pynrem ia uta uba long uba hok tam ?

en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them , and the new wine shall fail in her .
kha: Hynrei shen phin ym ïoh ïa u kew bad ka umphniang Olib kat ban dap biang bad yn ym don waiñ shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mala bad ka jingpynkhluit wain kan ym ai bam ia ki , bad ka wain thymmai kan duna ha ka .

en: And the patriarchs , moved with envy , sold Joseph into Egypt : but God was with him ,
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la bishni ïa u Joseph u para jong ki bad ki la die ïa u ban long u mraw ha Ijipt . Hynrei U Blei u la don lem bad u bad u la pyllait ïa u na ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kpa tymmen ki la iaid ryngkat bad ka jingsngewsih, ki la die ia u Joseph sha Ijipt : hynrei U Blei u la don ryngkat bad u .

en: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth , and hid his lord s money .
kha: Hynrei u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la leit noh , u la tih ka thliew ha ka khyndew , bad u la buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong u kynrad jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba la ioh ia kawei u la leit bad u la tih ha ka khyndew , bad u la buhrieh ia ka pisa jong u kynrad jong u .

en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To U Blei uba long U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi, bad na U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: Liverpool and Chelsea are meeting in the semifinals for the third time in four seasons
kha: Ka Liverpool bad ka Chelsea ki iakhun ha ka semifinal ha ka sien kaba lai ha ki saw samoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Liverpool bad ka Chelsea ki iakynduh ha ka semifinal ha ka sien kaba lai ha ki saw tylli ki aiom .

en: And now I have sent a cunning man , endued with understanding , of Huram my father s ,
kha: Nga phah sha phi u nongshna jingshna uba stad bad uba tbit bha , uba kyrteng u Huram .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga la phah ia u briew uba stad, uba la shah pynngop da ka jingsngewthuh, na u kpa jong nga u s , .

en: Shall they therefore empty their net , and not spare continually to slay the nations ?
kha: Hato kin pyndonkam ïa la ki waitlam junom bad ïai pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew khlem jingisynei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kin thylli namarkata ia ka net jong ki , bad kin ym lait beit ban pyniap ia ki jaitbynriew ?

en: And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .
kha: Ki Israel ki la pdiang katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hynrei kim shym kynjoh ktien na U  Trai  shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang ki la shim na ki jingbam jong ki , bad kim shym la pan jingmut ha ka shyntur U Trai .

en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :
kha: Hadien ba la die ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ban shah thied biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata la die noh ia u u lah ban shah siew kylliang biang ; uwei na ki hynmen jong u u lah ban siew kylliang ia u:

en: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .
kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la leit sha Kapernam , ka shnong ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la hikai ïa u paidbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan hiar sha Kapernam , ka shnong Galilaia bad u la hikai ia ki ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .
kha: Ki tur pyrshah ïa ki Benjamin ha ka sien kaba ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la wan hajan ki khun shynrang ha ka sngi kaba ar .

en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee  ; but with great mercies will I gather thee .
kha: Tang shipor nga la iehnoh ïa pha ; da ka jingieit kaba jylliew ngan shim pat ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka khyllipmat kaba rit nga la iehnoh ia me ; hynrei da ki jingsngewrit kiba khraw ngan lum ia me .

en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the  Lord  lighteneth both their eyes .
kha: U briew baduk bad u nongbanbeiñ jong u ki ïadon ïa kane kumjuh — U  Trai  u ai ïa ki khmat ha baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba duk bad uba thok u iakynduh lang: U Trai u pynshai ia ki khmat jong ki baroh arngut .

en: And it came to pass on the day when the  Lord  spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,
kha: Mynba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong ,  Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi ba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .
kha: U  Trai  u kwah ba ki tarajur bad ki mawthew ki dei ban long kiba beit bad baroh ka jingïadie ïathied kan long kaba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhia bad ka jingïahap kaba hok ki long ki Trai s: ki jingkhia baroh jong ka pla ki long ki kam jong u .

en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi, bad na U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment , in meteyard , in weight , or in measure .
kha: Wat shukor ïano ïano da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingthew thok , ha ka pruh , ha u mawthew , ne ha ka jingbun .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leh ia ka jingbymhok ha ka jingbishar, ha ka jaka ri jingri, ha ka jingkhia ne ha ka jingthew .

en: The Ministry provides funds for conducting training programmes under MPLAD Programme .
kha: Ka tnad ka ai pisa na ka bynta ban pynlong ia ki prokram ai jinghikai hapoh ka MPLAD Programme .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ministry ka ai pisa na ka bynta ban pynlong ia ki prokram ai jinghikai hapoh ka MPLAD Programme .

en: She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .
kha: Ka long borabor kaba smat kaba sting bad ka khmih ïa ki jingdonkam ha ka longïing jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka peit bha ia ki lynti jong ka iing jong ka , bad kam bam ia u kpu jong ka jingbym shimkhia .

en: After the video went viral , Dr KK Aggarwal issued a statement on his Twitter handle .
kha: Hadien ba katei ka video ka la saphriang bha , u Dr KK Aggarwal u la pynmih ia ka kyrwoh ha ka twitter handle jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba ka video ka la iaid lyngba, u Dr KK Aggarwal u la pynmih ia ka jingkren ha ka Twitter jong u .

en: Fans were left wanting more of the intense rivalry between Lesnar and Braun Strowman .
kha: Ki nongkyrshan ki la sahkut ha ka jingkwah shuh shuh ïa ka jingïakhun kaba jur hapdeng u Lesnar bad u Braun Strowman .
translated_en_to_kha: La iehnoh ia ki nongkyrshan kiba kwah kham bun ka jingialeh pyrshah kaba jur hapdeng u Lesnar bad u Braun Strowman .

en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .
kha: Wat pynrem ïa nga , A Blei , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ong ha U Blei , Wat pynrem ia nga ; to pyni ia nga namar kata me ialeh pyrshah ia nga .

en: Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?
kha: Hato don u briew , wat la u long uba stad tam , uba la ju long uba larkam na ka bynta U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u briew u lah ban long uba myntoi ha U Blei , kumba uta uba stad u lah ban long uba myntoi ha lade ?

en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .
kha: Lada phi don ka jingieit iwei ïa iwei , te baroh kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga . Kumba nga la ieit ïa phi , kumta phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane baroh ki briew kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga lada phi iaieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: But while doing like this , the quality of portability of Java programs will be lost .
kha: Hynrei katba dang leh kumne , ka jingbha jong ka jinglah ban rah ia ki prokram Java kan jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba dang leh kumne , ka jinglong jong ki prokram Java kan jah noh .

en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder , and upon thy seed for ever .
kha: Kin long ka dak kaba sakhi ïa ka jingbishar U Blei ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin long halor jong me na ka bynta ka dak bad ka jingphylla , bad halor u symbai jong me junom .

en: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her ,  Weep not .
kha: Haba U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingisynei ïa ka , bad u la ong ha ka ,  Wat ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la iohi ia ka, u la sngewsynei ia ka bad u la ong ha ka, Wat iam .

en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted , until Asshur shall carry thee away captive .
kha: Hynrei phi ki Ken phin sa shah pynjot thiaw Ynda u Assyria u ringmraw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Kenite un jah rngai noh, haduh ba u Ashur un rah noh ia me sha jngai .

en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
kha: Me tip ba kum uta ki briew u long uba bamsap bad ki pop jong u ki pynshisha ba u bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ba uta uba long kum uta u la kylla long uba sniew bad uba pop , uba la shah pynrem na lade .

en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor , his throne shall be established for ever .
kha: Lada u syiem u ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , un synshar slem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem uba bishar hok ia kiba duk , ka khet jong u kan long kaba skhem junom .

en: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .
kha: Phim pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u lane phim pat ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jong u , bad phim ju sumar ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi , naba phim ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim don ka ktien jong u kaba sah ha phi: namar ia uba u la phah , ia u phim ngeit .

en: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la wan bad ki la ong ha u: Balei me kren ia ki da ki pharshi ?

en: And Gideon said unto God , If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand , as thou hast said ,
kha: Nangta u Gideon u ong ha U Blei ,  Me ong ba me la kut jingmut ban pyndonkam ïa nga ban pyllait ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong ha U Blei , Lada me pynim ia ki Israel da ka kti jong nga kumba me la ong .

en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham s brother .
kha: Ka Milkah ka ïoh ïa kine ki phra ngut ki khun na u Nahor , u para u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bethuel u la kha ia u Rebekka: kine ki 8 ngut ki Milkah ki la kha ia u Nahor , u hynmen u Abraham .

en: Shall it be told him that I speak ? if a man speak , surely he shall be swallowed up .
kha: Ngan ym pan ban ïakren bad U Blei ; balei ngan ai ïa u ka lad ban pynjot ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato yn iathuh ia u ba nga kren ? lada u briew u kren , thikna ba un shah rong noh .

en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together , that it might be one .
kha: Ki thaw sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rnong ban pyndait lang ïa kita ki ar tylli ki sut ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna sanphew tylli ki nar ban pyniasoh lang ia ka ïingjaiñ , ba kan long kawei .

en: Who died for us , that , whether we wake or sleep , we should live together with him .
kha: uba la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi khnang ba ngi lah ban ïa-im lem bad u , la ngi im lane ngi ïap haba u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la iap na ka bynta jong ngi , kata , la ngi khie ne thiah , ngi dei ban im lang bad u .

en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle , and his candle shall be put out with him .
kha: Ïa ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u yn pyndum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai kan dum ha ka iing jong u , bad ka sharak jong u kan sa mih noh bad u .

en: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .
kha: Kin phai noh na kaba shahshkor ïa ka jingshisha bad kin pynleit jingmut ha ki puriskam kai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynphai noh ia ki shkor jong ki na ka jingshisha , bad kin kylla sha ki khanatang .

en: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba la bsa ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa kano kano kaba jyrngam ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong ki lum ka long ka jaka ri jingri jong u, bad u wad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba jyrngam .

en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynbaptis shisha ia phi da ka um: hynrei un pynbaptis ia phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .
kha: U kylli ,  Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ?   Ho-oid , ngi ithuh ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Phi tip ia u Laban u khun u Nahor ? Ki la ong , Ngi ithuh ia u .

en: When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakynduh lang nga long uwei napdeng jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la leit sha ka khyrdop lyngba ka nongbah , haba nga la pynkhreh ia ka jaka shong jong nga ha surok !

en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .
kha: U synshar halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew tam sha kliar ki lum bajrong tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kti jong u ki don ki jaka ba jylliew jong ka khyndew: ka jingkhlain jong ki lum ka long ruh jong u .

en: To bring back his soul from the pit , to be enlightened with the light of the living .
kha: u pyllait im ïa ka jingim u briew , bad ai ha u ïa ka jingkmen jong ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban wanrah biang ia ka mynsiem jong u na ka thliew , ban shah pynshai da ka jingshai jong kiba im .

en: All this have I proved by wisdom : I said , I will be wise  ; but it was far from me .
kha: Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingstad ban tynjuh ïa kane baroh . Nga la kut jingmut ban long uba stad , hynrei ka la long palat pud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh nga la pynshisha da ka jingstad: Nga la ong , ngan long uba stad ; hynrei ka la long kaba jngai na nga .

en: Seeing many things , but thou observest not  ; opening the ears , but he heareth not .
kha: Ko Israel , phi la ïohi shibun bha , hynrei ka don jingmut aïu ïa phi ? Phi don ki shkor ban sngew , hynrei phi ïohsngew aïu da shisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba iohi ia kiei kiei kiba bun , hynrei me peit ia ki shkor kim ju plie ia ki shkor , hynrei um ju iohsngew .

en: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la lyngngoh ; bad ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien, ki la lyngngoh bad ki la iehnoh ia u bad ki la leit noh .

en: And it came to pass , when Samuel was old , that he made his sons judges over Israel .
kha: Haba u Samuel u la tymmen , u thung nongbishar ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Samuel u la tymmen, ba u la pynlong ia ki khun shynrang jong u ki nongbishar halor ki Israel .

en: But I say unto you , Swear not at all  ; neither by heaven  ; for it is God s throne :
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng , naba ka long ka khet jong U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Wat nym leh ei ei ruh em da ka bneng ; namar ka long ka khet U Blei:

en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth , and to the house of Judah as rottenness .
kha: Ngan wallam jingjot halor ki Israel bad ka jingduh halor ki paid Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan long ha Ephraim kum u khnai bad ha ka iing Judah kum ka jingsniew .

en: Now the Lord is that Spirit : and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty .
kha: Mynta ,  U Trai  ha kane ka jingthoh u long U Mynsiem ; bad hangno haba U Mynsiem jong U Trai u don , hangta ka don ka jinglaitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai u long uta u Mynsiem: bad ha kaba U Mynsiem U Trai u don ka jinglaitluid .

en: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .
kha: Haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka jingidiaw ka la tap ïa ka khmat jong u baroh kawei , bad u la leit noh da ka jingsngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sngewsih ia kata ka jingong, bad u la leit noh da ka jingsngewsih: namar u don ki jingdon jingem kiba khraw .

en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?
kha: Hato me lah ban pyrta hukum ïa ki lyoh bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban pynkiew ia ka sur jong me sha ki lyoh , ba ka jingbun ki um kan tap ia me ?

en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurim .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shong bad ka kmie jong u ha ka ain . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .
kha: Lada ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynrem ïa ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi bad ba u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka dohnud jong ngi ka pynrem ia ngi , U Blei u kham khraw ban ia ka dohnud jong ngi bad u tip ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .
kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sngi Sabha kaba bud ka la wan la jan baroh kawei ka shnong ban iohsngew ia ka ktien U Blei .

en: He went in therefore , and shut the door upon them twain , and prayed unto the  Lord .
kha: U la khang ïa ka jingkhang bad u duwai ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung namarkata, bad u la khang ia ka jingkhang halor jong ki arngut bad u la duwai ha U Trai .

en: We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .
kha: Ngi la leh pop kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh ; ngi la long bymman bad sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la leh pop bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ngi la leh khlem akor , ngi la leh sniew .

en: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh    , ka long kaba donkam ban pynshisha ba u briew uba ai ïa ka u la ïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kaba ka test ka long , ka dei ruh ban don ka jingiap jong u nongleh kam sniew .

en: They are all plain to him that understandeth , and right to them that find knowledge .
kha: Ha u briew uba shemphang , ki long kiba shai ; ha uta uba tip bha , ki long kiba beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki long kiba shai ha uta uba sngewthuh , bad kiba dei ha ki kiba shem ia ka jingtip .

en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki leh ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum da ka kti u Moses .

en: And this commandment have we from him , That he who loveth God love his brother also .
kha: Ka hukum kaba U Khrist u la ai ha ngi ka long kane : Uno uno uba ieit ïa U Blei u dei ban ieit ïa la u parabriew ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka hukum ngi don na u , Ba uta uba ieit ia U Blei u ieit ia la u hynmen ruh .

en: But I know , that even now , whatsoever thou wilt ask of God , God will give it thee .
kha: Hynrei nga tip ba wat mynta ruh U Blei un ai ha me ïa kaei kaei kaba me pan na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga tip , ba wat mynta ruh , kaei kaei kaba phi pan na U Blei , U Blei un ai ia ka ha me .

en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him : he will ever be mindful of his covenant .
kha: U pynbiang jingbam ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u ; um ju klet ïa ka jutang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai doh ia ki kiba tieng ia u: un iai kynmaw ia ka jutang jong u .

en: Buy the truth , and sell it not  ; also wisdom , and instruction , and understanding .
kha: Ka jingshisha , ka jingstad , ka jingtip bad ka jingshemphang — kine ki long kiba kordor ba phin siew , hynrei kiba shongdor rem ïa phi ban die .
translated_en_to_kha: Thied ia ka jingshisha , bad die ia ka wat shuh shuh ia ka jingstad , bad ka jinghikai , bad ka jingsngewthuh .

en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound , who shall prepare himself to the battle ?
kha: Bad lada u briew u put ïa ka ronsing ka bym ai ka jingsawa kaba shai , uei u ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka turoi ka ai ia ka sur kaba khlem thikna , mano ban pynkhreh ia lade sha ka thma ?

en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal , nor the churl said to be bountiful .
kha: Yn ym don u ban pyrkhat ba uba bieit u long uba donburom lane ban ong ba u riewshukor u long uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia u briew uba sniew yn ym khot shuh ia u liberal , lane u briew uba la shah kyntait u la ong ba u long uba bun briew .

en: Do we then make void the law through faith ? God forbid : yea , we establish the law .
kha: Hato kane ka mut ba da kane ka jingngeit ngi kyntait noh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , ym kumta ; pynban , ngi pynskhem ïa ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngi pynlong ia ka hukum lyngba ka jingngeit ? U Blei u khang: hooid , ngi pynskhem ia ka ain .

en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him , in all utterance , and in all knowledge ;
kha: Naba ha U Khrist la pynlong ïa phi kiba man kyrhai ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingkren bad ka jingtip baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha kiei kiei baroh phi la riewspah da u, ha ka jingkren baroh, bad ha ka jingtip baroh;

en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .
kha: U Blei u la thung ïa nga kum u apostol bad u nonghikai ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dei na kane ka daw ba nga shahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba la thung ia nga u nongialap , bad u apostol , bad u nonghikai jong ki Jutang .

en: Responsible brothers at the branch office approve the formation of new congregations .
kha: Ki para bangeit kiba shim ka jingkitkhlieh ha ka tnad treikam ki mynjur ïa ki jingpynkha balang thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen kiba don ka jingkitkhlieh ha ka ophis tnat ki mynjur ia ka jingmih jong ki jingiaseng thymmai .

en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him ? shall they part him among the merchants ?
kha: Hato ki nongtong dohkha kin ïadait dor halor jong u ? Hato ki nongkhaïi kin ot doh ïa u ban die ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki paralok kin leh ia ka jingkhawai jong u ? kin iakhlad noh ia u hapdeng ki nongkhaii ?

en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth , and shall assure our hearts before him .
kha: Kane , te , ka long kumno ngin tip ba ngi long ki jong ka jingshisha ; kane ka long kumno ngin sngewskhem ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kane ngi tip ba ngi long na ka jingshisha , bad ngin pynthikna ia ki dohnud jong ngi ha khmat jong u .

en: And ye shall seek me , and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart .
kha: Phin wad ïa nga , bad phin shem ïa nga namar ba phin wad ïa nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin wad ia nga, bad phin shem ia nga, haba phin wad ia nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .
kha: Ki khun jong u briew uba bha kin long kiba donbor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: U symbai jong u un long uba khlain ha ka khyndew: ka pateng jong kiba hok kan long kaba la kyrkhu .

en: So it would be this distance right over here , which is exactly half of the diameter .
kha: Kumta kan long kane ka jingjngai hangne ​​, kaba long thik shiteng na ka diameter .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kan long kane ka jingjngai hangne hi, kaba long thik shiteng na ka jingheh .

en: His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .
kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin ai noh pat ïa kaei kaba u la tuh na kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong u kin wad ban pynsngewbha ia kiba duk , bad ki kti jong u kin pynphai biang ia ki mar ki mata jong ki .

en: Remember that the Constitution cannot issue certificates of citizenship to foreigners.
kha: Bad kynmaw ka Constitution kam lah ban ai certificate trai shnong ia ki poiwir poiei.
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ba ka Riti Synshar kam lah ban ai ia ki kot ki sla jong ka jinglong nongshong shnong sha ki nongwei.

en: And all flesh shall see that I the  Lord  have kindled it : it shall not be quenched .
kha: Baroh kin ïohi ba ma Nga , U  Trai  , nga la thang ïa ka bad ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh baroh kan iohi ba nga U Trai nga la pynmeh ia ka: kan ym shah pynlip .

en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with madness , and blindness , and astonishment of heart :
kha: U  Trai  un pynlamwir ïa phi , un pynmatlah ïa phi , bad un pynshaïong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynkhih ia me da ka jingsngewsih, bad ka jingmatlah bad ka jinglyngngoh jong ka dohnud:

en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :
kha: Nangta u nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga dei ban phla mynta ba nga la leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kren ia u rangbah ha u Pharaoh, u da ong: Nga kynmaw ia ki jingbakla jong nga ha kane ka sngi:

en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki sngap ïa ki jingmut kiba sniew , bad ki nongshukor ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongleh bymman u ai jingmut ia ki rmiang shyntur lamler bad u nonglamler u ai shkor ia ka shyntur kaba sniew .

en: Rev.H.ChyneSecretaryMeghalaya Prayer Church Transformation Initiative (MPCTI)Shillong.
kha: Rev.H.ChyneSecretaryMeghalaya Prayer Church Transformation Initiative (MPCTI)Shillong.
translated_en_to_kha: Rev.H.ChyneSecretary Meghalaya Prayer Church Transition Initiative (MPCTI)Shillong.

en: For he commandeth , and raiseth the stormy wind , which lifteth up the waves thereof .
kha: U hukum , bad ka lyer bah ka sdang ban beh bad pynmih ki jingat phyllung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u hukum , bad u pynmih ia ka Iyer kaba jur , kaba pynkiew ia ki um jong ka .

en: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the  Lord  had shewed me .
kha: bad nga la ïathuh ïa kiba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la lah pyn-i ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la kren ha ki shaphang ka jingshah set phatok baroh kaba U Trai u la pyni ha nga .

en: And there came a voice out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
kha: Ka sur ka la kren na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun jong nga , uba nga la jied — shahshkor ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka sur na u lyoh kaba ong: Une u long U Khun baieit jong nga: to iohsngew ia u .

en: Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
kha: Katba ki dang wan , uwei pa uwei u sngewshyrkhei ; kawei pa kawei ka durkhmat ka kylla blad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat jong ki ki briew kin sngewsih shibun: ki khmat baroh kin lum ia ka jingdum .

en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother s womb , nor hid sorrow from mine eyes .
kha: To tim ïa kata ka miet ba ka shah ba yn kha ïa nga , da kaba pynshah ïa nga ha ki jingjynjar bad ki jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kam khang ia ki jingkhang jong ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga, lymne ka buhrieh ia ka jingsngewsih na ki khmat jong nga .

en: Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .
kha: U buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh hajan ka rmiang ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah haba rah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u pud u sam ki don ki ryntieh , ki jaka na ka bynta ki dieng ban kit ia ka miej .

en: And Abraham stood up from before his dead , and spake unto the sons of Heth , saying ,
kha: U la mihnoh na ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ka metïap jong ka tnga jong u , u la leit sha ki Hit , bad u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ieng na khmat ka jingiap jong u, bad u la kren ha ki khun shynrang jong u Heth da kaba ong:

en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds  ; and the cloud is not rent under them .
kha: U dei U Blei uba pyndap ïa ki lyoh da ka um bad u pynlong ïa ki ban ym bthei noh na ka jingkhia .
translated_en_to_kha: U teh ia ki um ha ki lyoh kiba jylliew jong u ; bad u lyoh um shym la tyrkhong hapoh jong ki .

en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .
kha: Me ïuh halor ka duriaw da ki kulai jong me , bad ki umbah ki thnam shaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iaid lyngba ka duriaw bad ki kulai jong me , lyngba ka um kaba heh .

en: And they went , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
kha: Ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha ki , bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh bad ki la shem kumba u la ong ha ki: bad ki la pynkhreh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait .

en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds , or the noise of his tabernacle ?
kha: Ym don batip kumno ki lyoh ki ïaid lane kumno u pyrthat u kyrhuh lyngba ka suiñbneng , ha kaba U Blei u shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh hato don mano mano ba lah ban sngewthuh ia ki lyoh , ne ka jingsawa jong ka iing jong u ?

en: Honour the  Lord  with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :
kha: To burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ai ha u ka jingainguh da kiei kiei kiba bha tam ba ka lyngkha jong phi ka pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia U Trai da ka jinglong jong me, bad da ki soh ba nyngkong jong me baroh:

en: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me  ; because I have hoped in thy word .
kha: Kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin kmen haba ki ïohi ïa nga , namar nga la shaniah ha ka jingkular jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba tieng ia me kin sngewbha haba ki iohi ia nga ; namar nga la kyrmen ha ka ktien jong me .

en: They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .
kha: Ki hap ban ot ha ki lyngkha ki bym dei la ki jong , bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kheit ia u kew jong u ha lyngkha : bad ki lum ia ka spah jong kiba sniew .

en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .
kha: Te ngan lah ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan don ka lad ban jubab ia uta uba kren bein ia nga: namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .

en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also , neither would he let the people go .
kha: Hynrei wat ha kane ka kynti ruh , u Pharaoh u la kylla long mutlop , bad um shym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u ha kane ka por ruh , bad un ym pyllait ia ki briew .

en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .
kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki husiar ban kiar na kaba sniew , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kim suidñiew bad ki tur ruma kat shaba lap .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u tieng , bad u phet noh na kaba sniew: hynrei u bieit u la rkhie bein bad u la sngewskhem .

en: He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .
kha: Ki shong jngai bah na ki nongbah kiba khynwin ; bad ym don ba lah ban pynjuh bad pyntreikam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U sngewsih ia u paidbah jong ka shnong , um sngewthuh ia ka jingud jong u nongniah kali .

en: They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .
kha: Ki la long kum ki kulai ba la bsa bha , ki bym lah synshar ha ki jingkwah , uwei pa uwei u da kwah brai ïa ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la long kum ki kulai ba la ai bam ha ka por mynstep: uwei pa uwei u la sngap jar hadien ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u .

en: A time to kill , and a time to heal  ; a time to break down , and a time to build up  ;
kha: ka por ban pynïap bad ka por ban pynkhiah , ka por ban pynkhyllem bad ka por ban tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban pyniap , bad ka por ban pynkoit ; ka por ban bthei , bad ka por ban tei ; .

en: Are ye so foolish ? having begun in the Spirit , are ye now made perfect by the flesh ?
kha: Kumno phi dang sah bieit haduh katta katta! Haba phi la sdang da U Mynsiem U Blei , mynta phi kwah pat ban pynkut da la ka bor hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi long kiba bieit ? haba phi la sdang ha U Mynsiem , hato mynta phi la pynlong janai da ka doh ?

en: And saying , Lord , my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy , grievously tormented .
kha: Ko Kynrad , u shakri jong nga u thiah pang ha ïing , um lah ban khih bad u da shitom jur eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba ong, ko Trai, u shakri jong nga u sah ha iing u pang pang ba pang, u la shah pynshitom bein shibun .

en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble , against the day of battle and war ?
kha: Nga la buh pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ki por jingjynjar , bad na ka bynta ki sngi ka jingïaleh thma bad ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nga la buh kyrpang pyrshah ia ka por jong ka jingjynjar , pyrshah ia ka sngi thma bad thma ?

en: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym noh mynsiem namar nga shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga kwah ba phin ym sngap jar ia ki jingjynjar jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , kaba long ka burom jong phi .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha Seïon , ha Jerusalem , ka ïingshong jong u . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai na Seion , uba shong ha Jerusalem . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta U Khrist u la mihpat na kiba iap , bad u la kylla long u soh nyngkong eh jong kita kiba la iohthiah .

en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir , with the precious onyx , or the sapphire .
kha: Ka ksiar babha tam bad ki mawkordor , kim lah ban ïaryngkat bad ka dor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym lah ban khein kor ia ka da ka ksiar jong u Ophir , da ka onyx kaba kordor , ne ka sapphire .

en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .
kha: Bad haba uno uno u shakri ïa U Khrist ha kane ka rukom , u pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad la pdiang da kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba ha kine kiei kiei u shakri ia U Khrist u long uba pdiang sngewbha ha U Blei bad uba la mynjur da ki briew .

en: We are thine : thou never barest rule over them  ; they were not called by thy name .
kha: Me ñiew ïa ngi kumba mem ju long u nongsynshar jong ngi , kumba ngim pat la ju long ki briew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long ki jong me: wat ju synshar ia ki ; kim shym la khot da ka kyrteng jong me .

en: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people , I find no fault in this man .
kha: Nangta u Pilat u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki paidbah ,  Ngam shem kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa une u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pilat u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki briew , ngam shem jingbakla ha une u briew .

en: Delight is not seemly for a fool  ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
kha: Kiba bieit kim dei ban im ha ka pahuh pahai , bad ki mraw kim dei ban synshar halor ki briew badonburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai kam long kumba u bieit ; kham duna na ka bynta u shakri ban don ka jingsynshar halor ki syiem .

en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .
kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh kat kaba me ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ri baroh kaba me iohi , ha me ngan ai ia ka bad ha u symbai jong me junom .

en: Shri.Daiapherbha Lamare, Secretary, Narpuh Border Area Joint Action Committee (NBAJAC).
kha: Shri.Daiapherbha Lamare,Secretary,Narpuh Border Area Joint Action Committee (NBAJAC).
translated_en_to_kha: Shri.Dafarbha Lamare, Secretary, Narpuh Border Area Joint Action Committee (NBAJAC).

en: And when his disciples were come to the other side , they had forgotten to take bread .
kha: Haba ki synran ki la jam sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , ki la klet ban rah jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki synran jong u ki la wan sha kawei pat ka liang , ki la klet ban shim kpu .

en: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old , as God had commanded him .
kha: bad haba u Isaak u la dap phra sngi ka rta , u Abraham u la otsher ïa u kumba U Blei u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ot ia u khun jong u u Isaak uba dang 8 sngi kumba U Blei u la hukum ia u .

en: For God is my record , how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ .
kha: U Blei u long u sakhi jong nga , ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , haba nga ong ba ka jingsngew bajylliew na ka bynta jong phi baroh , ka wan na ka dohnud U Khrist Jisu hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u long ka rekod jong nga , katno nga kwah eh ia phi baroh ha ka kpoh U Jisu Khrist .

en: The government plans to inject Rs 2 lakh crore as fresh capital over two to three years
kha: Ka sorkar ka thmu ban pynrung 2 lak klur tyngka kum ka pisa thymmai ha ki ar ne lai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sorkar ka thmu ban injek 2 lak klur tyngka kum ka pisa thymmai ha ki ar haduh lai snem .

en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God , which was committed to my trust .
kha: Ïa kata ka jinghikai la shem ha ka Gospel ïa kaba la pynkhamti ha nga ban pynbna , ka Khubor Babha na U Blei uba khrawburom bad ba la kyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka gospel ba donburom jong U Blei uba la kyrkhu , kaba la aiti ha ka jingshaniah jong nga .

en: Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , and Rabbah  ; two cities with their villages :
kha: Don ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) bad ka Rabbah : ar tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kirjathbaal , kaba long Kirjathjarim , bad Rabha ; ar tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: By his neesings a light doth shine , and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning .
kha: Ka jingshai ka thaba haba u synriah , bad ki khmat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki jingpynkhih jong u ka jingshai ka shai bha, bad ki khmat jong u ki long kum ki khmat jong ka step .

en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Serug u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Nahor arspah snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: When they went , they went upon their four sides : and they turned not when they went .
kha: kumta ba ki shalyntem ki lah ban tyllun sha kano kano na ki saw tylli ki dong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la leit noh , ki la iaid ha ki saw liang jong ki : bad kim shym la phai haba ki la leit .

en: And if Christ be not risen , then is our preaching vain , and your faith is also vain .
kha: Lada kata ka long kaba shisha , ka mut ba ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat ; bad lada ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , te ngim don ei ei ban ïalap bad phim don ei ei ha ka ban ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada U Khrist um shym la mihpat, te ka jingialap jong ngi ka long kaba lehnohei, bad ka jingngeit jong phi ruh ka long kaba lehnohei .

en: With kings and counsellors of the earth , which built desolate places for themselves  ;
kha: ban ïohthiah kum ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar kiba la tei pat ïa ki ïingsyiem mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki syiem bad ki nongai jingmut jong ka khyndew , kiba la tei ia ki jaka ba la jot na ka bynta lade ; .

en: The movie will be the third collaboration between Yash Raj films and Dibakar Banerjee .
kha: Kane ka phlim kan dei ka jingiatreilang kaba lai hapdeng ki phlim Yash Raj bad u Dibakar Banerjee .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka phlim kan long ka jingiatreilang kaba lai hapdeng ki phlim Yash Raj bad ka Dibakar Banerjee .

en: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way , when ye were come forth out of Egypt  ;
kha: Kynmaw aïu ki Amalek ki la leh ïa phi katba phi dang wan na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kaei kaba u Amalek u la leh ha me ha ka lynti , haba phi la mih na Ijipt ; .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
kha: ban shna ïa lade ka lyngkor da ki tyllai snieh bad ki dieng jingphna bad ban buh ïa ka ha u ryndang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ha nga; To leh ia me ki jingteh bad ki jingteh , bad buh ia ki ha ka ryndang jong me .

en: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town , but was in that place where Martha met him .
kha: ( U Jisu um pat shym la poi ha kata ka shnong , hynrei u dang don ha ka jaka ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïakynduh ïa u . )
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Jisu um pat wan shapoh shnong , hynrei u la don ha kata ka jaka ha kaba ka Martha ka la iakynduh ia u .

en: The desire of the righteous is only good : but the expectation of the wicked is wrath .
kha: Kaei kaba ki briew kiba bha ki kwah ka mih ha ka jingbha ; haba ki bymman ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , baroh ki bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah jong kiba hok ka long tang kaba bha: hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti jong kiba sniew ka long ka jingbitar .

en: If I have made gold my hope , or have said to the fine gold , Thou art my confidence  ;
kha: Ngam pat ju shaniah ha ka spah
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la pynlong ksiar ia ka jingkyrmen jong nga, ne nga la ong ia ka ksiar kaba bha, Me long ka jingshaniah jong nga;

en: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
kha: Uta u briew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la sdang ban kren , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u pat sha ha ka kmie jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Utei uba la iap u la ieng bad u la sdang ban kren . Bad u la aiti ia u ha ka kmie jong u .

en: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .
kha: Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u baroh pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa nga katba nga dang kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un kyrpad ia nga da ka bor kaba khraw jong u ? Em ; hynrei un buh bor ha nga .

en: I am taking this step to serve 125 crore citizens of India , he said in another tweet .
kha: Nga shim ia kane ka sienjam ban shakri ia ki 125 klur ki nongshong shnong ka ri India , u la ong ha kawei pat ka tweet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga shim ia kane ka sienjam ban shakri 125 klur ngut ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri India , u la ong ha kawei pat ka tweet .

en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor , one  ; the king of the nations of Gilgal , one  ;
kha: ka Dor ( harud duriaw ) , Goiim ( ha Galilaïa ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u Dor ha rud duriaw u Dor , uwei u syiem ki jaitbynriew Gilgal , uwei u ; .

en: My son , be wise , and make my heart glad , that I may answer him that reproacheth me .
kha: Ko khun jong nga , to long uba stad , bad ngan long uba kmen ; ngan don ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kem daw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, to long uba stad bad pynsngewbha ia ka dohnud jong nga, ba ngan jubab ia uta uba kren bein ia nga .

en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .
kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dano dano .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ko Trai jong nga, to phah, nga kyrpad ia me, da ka kti jong uta uba me phah .

en: Again troops had to be sent to Buldana to reinforce the police and crush the uprising .
kha: Sa shisien pat la hap ban phah shipai sha Buldana ban pynkhlain ia ki pulit bad ban pynduh pyndam ia ka jingkhihwin .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien la hap ban phah ia ki shipai sha Buldana ban pynskhem ia ki pulit bad ban pynkhih ia ka jingkhihwin .

en: But neither Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised :
kha: Ïa u Titos u paralok jong nga , wat la u dei u Grik , ym shym la pynbor ïa u ban otsher ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym shym la pynbor ia u Titus uba don bad nga, uba long u Grik:

en: Chan is a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador , and has championed charitable works and causes .
kha: U Chan u dei u Nongmihkhmat jong ka UNICEF , bad u la kyrshan ia ki kam bad ki jingthmu babha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Chan u dei u UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador , bad u la kyrshan ia ki kam ai jingiarap bad ki daw .

en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum lang ia ki rangbah Israel baroh , bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

en: And he said , Cursed be Canaan  ; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren .
kha: u ong ,  Ka jingtim halor u Kanaan ! Un long u mraw ïa ki hynmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: La pynsniew ia u Kana; u shakri jong ki shakri un long ha ki hynmen jong u .

en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
kha: Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la jubab ia nga , bad phi la ong , Kaei kaba me la kren ka long kaba bha ia ngi ban leh .

en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs .
kha: bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ashkenas ban pyrkhat sngewlem ïa u Daniel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Blei u la wanrah ia u Daniel ha ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingieit kaba jem bad u syiem jong ki nongshong shnong .

en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children : he rewardeth him , and he shall know it .
kha: Phi ong ba U Blei u pynshitom ïa u khun namar ki pop jong u kpa . Em ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ki nongpop hi ; ai ba un pyn-i ba u leh ïa ka , namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u buh ia ka jingbymhok jong u na ka bynta ki khun jong u: u ai khusnam ia u , bad un sa tip ia ka .

en: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it ?
kha: Kaei ka kmie jong u thah bad jong u thah stang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka kpoh jongno ka la mih ka ice ? bad ka jingkhriat kaba jur jong ka bneng , mano ba la shynrang ne kynthei ?

en: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber , and to Eloth , at the sea side in the land of Edom .
kha: Nangta u Solomon u leit sha Esiongeber bad sha Elath , ki kadlieng harud ka Khmut Duriaw Akaba , ha ri ki Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la leit sha Ezionbir bad sha Eoth, ha rud duriaw ha ka ri Edom .

en: So we can be confident that God’s Kingdom will soon bring an end to all such problems .
kha: Te ngi lah ban shaniah skhem ba shen ka Hima jong U Blei kan pynkut ïa kum kita ki jingeh baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba U Blei s Hima un sa pynkut noh shen ia ki jingeh baroh .

en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .
kha: U Jakob u ïaishong ïaisah ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba u kpa jong u , u la shong la sah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la shong ha ka ri ha kaba u kpa jong u u long u nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .
kha: U ong ba kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha haba u pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la ong , Kam myntoi ei ei ia u briew ba un sngewbha ia lade bad U Blei .

en: And out of the tribe of Reuben , Bezer with her suburbs , and Jahzah with her suburbs ,
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Reuben ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Beser , ka Jahas
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jait Reuben , u Bezer bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka , bad ka Jahrah bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka .

en: For the  Lord  will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .
kha: U  Trai  un ym iehnoh ïa la ki briew ; bad un ym iehnoh ïa kito kiba long ki jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un ym bret noh ia ki briew jong u , lymne un ym iehnoh ia ka pateng jong u .

en: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .
kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u nongïarap jong u ki la khreh , bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha uta u lum uba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ieng , bad u myntri jong u u Joshua: bad u Moses u la kiew sha u lum U Blei .

en: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .
kha: Kum ka  erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingbthei jong U Blei ki jah noh , bad da ka jingsawa jong ki shyntur jong u ki shah bam .

en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat  ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
kha: kim lah ban peit ïa ka jingbam bad ki la jan ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong ki ka sngewsih ia ki jait doh baroh; bad ki wan hajan ki khyrdop jong ka jingiap .

en: And the floors shall be full of wheat , and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil .
kha: Ki jaka pynkhuid kew kin dap da u kew ; ki thliew harud ki jaka pynmih umsoh bad umphniang kin shlei da ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki mala kin dap da u kew bad ki shini kin tuid da ka wain bad ka umphniang .

en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God , and lettest such words go out of thy mouth ?
kha: Me leh bitar ïa U Blei bad me kyntait ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me pynphai ia ka mynsiem jong me pyrshah ia U Blei bad to ai ba kum kine ki ktien kin mih na ka shyntur jong me ?

en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .
kha: Khie leit bad rep ïa kata ka ri , phi ki briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Spain ! Ym don shuh mano mano ban ïada ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To iaid lyngba ka ri jong me kum ka wah , ko khun jong u Tarshish: ym don bor shuh .

en: And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .
kha: U Saul u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Shahshkor , Ahimelekh !   Nga hangne , ko kynrad ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong, To sngap mynta, ko khun Ahitub . Bad u la jubab, Hangne nga don, ko kynrad jong nga .

en: Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .
kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , ki Rephaim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la khein ruh ia ki rangbah, kumba ki Anahim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ia ki Emim .

en: The foot shall tread it down , even the feet of the poor , and the steps of the needy .
kha: Kito kiba la shah banbeiñ , ki ïaid halor jong ka mynta bad ki ïuh ïa ka hapoh ki kjat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kjat kan pynkhih ia ka shapoh , wat ki kjat jong kiba duk bad ki step jong kiba duk .

en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U ieit ia ka hok bad ka jingbishar: ka khyndew ka dap da ka jingbha jong U Trai .

en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
kha: Ki bymman ki wallam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang ban pynjia ha ki briew kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman un long u nongsiewspah na ka bynta kiba hok , bad u nongleh kam sniew na ka bynta kiba hok .

en: Then if any man shall say unto you , Lo , here is Christ , or there  ; believe it not .
kha: Nangta , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangne U don U Messaïah !’ lane ‘ U don hangtai !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta lada uno uno u briew un ong ha phi, Lo, hangne u don U Khrist, ne hangta; wat ngeit ia kata .

en: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts : so shall I talk of thy wondrous works .
kha: Ïarap ïa nga ban shemphang ïa ki aiñ jong me , bad ngan puson halor ki jinghikai kiba phylla jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia nga ban sngewthuh ia ka lynti jong ki jingbthah jong me: kumta ngan kren shaphang ki kam phylla jong me .

en: And he said unto them , Come again unto me after three days . And the people departed .
kha: U Rehoboam u jubab ,  Ai ïa nga lai sngi ba ngan pyrkhat ïa kane ka kam . Nangta sa wan pat .  Kumta kita ki briew ki leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , To wan biang sha nga hadien lai sngi . Ki briew ki la leit noh .

en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table .
kha: Ki kyrwoh ban bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ïa ka miej ki dei ban don hajan ka rmiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u pud u sam ki ring kin long na ka bynta ki jaka jong ki dieng ban kit ia ka miej .

en: The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .
kha: Ngi itynnat ïa ka jingkhlaiñ ka jinglong samla bad ngi burom ïa u ñiuhlieh ka jinglong tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom jong ki samla ka long ka bor jong ki: bad ka jingitynnad jong ki tymmen ka long ka khlieh kaba rong saw .

en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery , and life unto the bitter in soul  ;
kha: Balei ban shah ïa ki briew ban ïai im ha ki jingjynjar ? Balei ban ai jingshai ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingsngewsih ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la ai jingshai ia uta uba don ha ka jingjynjar, bad ka jingim haduh kiba sngewsih ha ka mynsiem ; .

en: As for me , behold , I am in your hand : do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad nga , nga don ha ka bor jong phi ! To leh ïa nga ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba biang bad kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga, ha khmih, nga don ha ka kti jong phi: leh bad nga kumba nga long uba bha bad iakynduh ia phi .

en: Yea , the hind also calved in the field , and forsook it , because there was no grass .
kha: Ka skei kmie hapoh ka lyngkha ka iehnoh ïa la i khun ba dang kha namar bym don phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , u blang ruh u la iam ha lyngkha , bad u la iehnoh ia ka , namar ym don phlang .

en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .
kha: U Petros u la tied ïa ka jingkhang kaba shabar , bad ka shakri kaba kyrteng ka Rhoda ka la wan ban peit uei uba tied .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Petros u dang tied ia ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop, uwei u dam u la wan ban sngap, uba kyrteng u Rhoda .

en: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
kha: Haba ki dang mihnoh , ki ïakynduh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba ap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iakynduh ia u Moses bad u Aaron kiba ieng ha lynti, katba ki dang mih na u Pharaoh:

en: And the multitude cometh together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ïing . U paidbah babun u la ïalum biang kat haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah u wan biang , haduh ba kim lah ban bam ia u kpu .

en: And so it fell out unto him : for the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died .
kha: Te ka la jia kumta ïa u ; u la ïap , da kaba shah ïuh ha ban da ïap ha u paidbah ha kata ka khyrdop shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ka la hap shabar jong u: namar ki briew ki la iaid halor jong u ha ka khyrdop , bad u la iap .

en: Build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them  ;
kha: ‘ Tei ïa ki ïing bad shongduh . Thaw ki kper bad bam ïa kaei kaba phi thung hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: To tei ia ki iing , bad to shong ha ki ; bad thung ia ki kper , bad bam ia ki soh jong ki ; .

en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .
kha: bad ha kane ka rukom , un pyllait ïa kita baroh kiba la long ki mraw shi lynter ka jingim jong ki , namar ka jingsheptieng jong ki ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to pynpoi ia ki kiba lyngba ka jingtieng ia ka jingiap ki la shah teh ha ka jinglong mraw jong ki baroh kawei .

en: And when the ship was caught , and could not bear up into the wind , we let her drive .
kha: Ka la lynshop ïa ka lieng , bad namar ka long ka bym lah ban king ïa ka lieng sha khmat pyrshah ïa ka lyer , ngi la sangeh ban pyrshang bad ngi la shah ïa ka ban shah kit katba shaba beh ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka lieng ka la shah kem , bad kam lah ban shah sha ka Iyer , ngi la ailad ia ka ban niah kali .

en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
kha: To shahshkor mynta , bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia phi , bad to sakhi ha ka iing u Jakob , ong U Trai Blei , U Blei jong ki paid .

en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them  ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
kha: Kine ki long ki jingainguh : ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba phi shim na ki; ka ksiar bad ka rupa bad ka nar .

en: And Jesus , perceiving the thought of their heart , took a child , and set him by him ,
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la shim ïa u khynnah , u la pynïeng hajan jong u bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu haba u sngewthuh ia ka jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud jong ki, u la shim ia u khynnah bad u la buh ia u hajan jong u .

en: Behold , I am according to thy wish in God s stead : I also am formed out of the clay .
kha: Ma phi bad ma nga ngi long kumjuh ha khmat U Blei , ïa baroh ar ngut na ngi la thaw na ka dewmet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long kat kum ka jingkwah jong me ha ka jaka jong U Blei: Nga ruh nga la mih na ka dewbilat .

en: Thy testimonies are very sure : holiness becometh thine house , O  Lord  , for ever .
kha: Ki aiñ jong me ki neh bymjukut , A  Trai  , bad ka Templ jong me ka long kaba khuid da shisha , junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingphla jong me ki long kiba thikna bha: ka jingkhuid ka kylla long ka iing jong me, ko Trai, junom .

en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men .
kha: Pyrkhat halor kiei kiei kiba u Job u ong ; phin ïohi ba u kren kum u riewbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah jong nga ka long ba u Job un shah tynjuh haduh kaba kut namar ki jubab jong u na ka bynta ki briew kiba sniew .

en: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,
kha: Haba ki briew ha ka synagog ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ha ka synagog haba ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei ki la dap da ka jingbitar .

en: And ye shall perish among the heathen , and the land of your enemies shall eat you up .
kha: Phin ïap ha ka jinglongmraw , phin shah nguid ha ka khyndew ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa jah noh hapdeng ki nongwei bad ka ri jong ki nongshun jong phi kan bam ia phi .

en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury , nor lend him thy victuals for increase .
kha: Wat kheiñ sut ei ei halor ka ram kaba phi ai ïa u , bad wat die ïohnong ha u ïa kano kano ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ia u ia ka pisa jong me ha ka kam khaii , lane wat ai ram ia u ia ki jingbam jong me na ka bynta ka jingkiew .

en: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way : but the folly of fools is deceit .
kha: Balei ba u briew uba sian u stad ? Namar u tip ïa kaei ban leh . Balei ba u briew ba-mutlop u bieit ? Namar ba u shu pyrkhat ba u tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad jong u briew uba stad ka long ban sngewthuh ia ka lynti jong u: hynrei ka jinglong bieit jong ki bieit ka long kaba thok .

en: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you , that God should raise the dead ?
kha: Balei ma phi kiba don hangne phi shem ba ka long ka bym lah ban ngeit ba U Blei u pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei dei ban pyrkhat ia kaei kaei kaba ym lah ban ngeit bad phi , ba U Blei un pynmihpat ia kiba iap ?

en: And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .
kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Mari , kaba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Maria kaba shong ha ki kjat U Jisu bad ka la iohsngew ia ka ktien jong u .

en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,
kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha jong ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa shibun ki hima , ki pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki ban sah kynjah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jingshisha , ko Trai , ki syiem Assyria ki la pynjot ia ki jaitbynriew bad ki ri jong ki , .

en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , Had Zimri peace , who slew his master ?
kha: Katba u Jehu u dang rung lyngba ka khyrdop , ka la pyrta ,  Me u Simri ! Me u nongpynïap briew ! Balei me wan hangne ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Jehu u dang rung ha ka khyrdop, ka la ong, Hato ka jingsuk ka la pyniap ia u kynrad jong u ?

en: A feast is made for laughter , and wine maketh merry : but money answereth all things .
kha: Ka jingbam khawai ka pynkmen ïa phi bad ka waiñ ka pyndap jingkmen ïa phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh ïa kano kano na kine khlem ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhawai ka long na ka bynta ka jingrkhie, bad ka wain ka pynlong ia ka jingkmen: hynrei ka pisa ka jubab ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: These are the sons of Rachel , which were born to Jacob : all the souls were fourteen .
kha: Kine khatsaw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Rakhel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong ka Rakhel kiba la kha ia u Jakob: baroh ki mynsiem ki long shiphew ngut .

en: I know thy works , that thou art neither cold nor hot : I would thou wert cold or hot .
kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha la leh ; nga tip ba pham long kaba khriat ne kaba shit . Katno nga kwah ba phan jin da la long kawei na kita !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia ki kam jong me, ba me long uba khriat ne uba shit: nga la thiah ne uba shit .

en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangta , bad u Jethro ruh u pynshongkurim ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kaba la kha khun shynrang ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la sngewhun ban shong bad uta u briew : bad u la ai ia u Moses u Zipporah ia ka khun jong u .

en: And gave them the lands of the heathen : and they inherited the labour of the people  ;
kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ki ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad u la shah ïa ki ban shim noh ïa ki pyntha jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ha ki ia ki ri jong ki nongwei : bad ki la hiar pateng ia ka jingtrei shitom jong ki briew ; .

en: But with the precious blood of Christ , as of a lamb without blemish and without spot :
kha: ka la long ka jingkñia kaba remdor jong U Khrist , uba la long kum u khunlangbrot uba khlem don jingthohbria lane jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da ka snam ba kordor jong U Khrist, kum u langbrot khlem jingduna bad khlem jingduna:

en: Every wise woman buildeth her house : but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands .
kha: Ïa ki rympei ïing la pynlong da ka jingstad jong ki kynthei , hynrei la pynjot da ka jingleh bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kaba stad ka tei ia ka iing jong ka: hynrei kaba bieit ka pynkhih ia ka da ki kti jong ka .

en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof , and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it ,
kha: Dei ma nga uba la tap ïa ka duriaw da ki lyoh bad uba la sop ïa ka da ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la pynlong ia u lyoh ia ka jain jong u, bad ka jingdum kaba jylliew na ka bynta jong ka , .

en: So the last shall be first , and the first last : for many be called , but few chosen .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kumta kiba khatduh kin long ha shuwa , bad kito kiba ha shuwa kin long khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kaba khatduh kan long nyngkong, bad kaba khatduh: namar bun ki shah khot, hynrei tang khyndiat eh kiba la jied .

en: The works of the  Lord  are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein .
kha: A katno kiba phylla long kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la leh ! Baroh kiba la kmen bad ki , ki kwah ban shemphang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kam U Trai ki long kiba khraw , la wad na kita baroh kiba sngewbha ha ka .

en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
kha: Pynban , to pyrkhat ïa ka Hima jong u , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kham bha ban wad ia ka hima U Blei ; bad ia kine kiei kiei baroh yn pyndap ha phi .

en: Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
kha: Shaniah ha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . Wat shaniah ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaniah ha U Trai da ka dohnud baroh bad wat shaniah ha la ka jong ka jingsngewthuh .

en: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me , My father , thou art the guide of my youth ?
kha: Bad mynta pha ong ha nga , ‘ Me long u kpa jong nga , bad me la ieit ïa nga naduh ba nga dang khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me na kane ka por wat iam ha nga , ko kpa jong nga ?

en: And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .
kha: Nangta ki ïakylli ïa u ,  Ha-ei ka Sarah ka tnga jong me ?  U jubab ,  Ka don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Hangno ka Sarah ka tnga jong me ? Bad u la ong: Ha ka tent .

en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment : and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity .
kha: Kam don jingbishar hok ha kaba u sakhi u thmu ban pynmong ïano ïano . Ki riewbymman ki ieit ïa ka jingmad kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbishar kaba khlem akor ka pynjah burom: bad ka shyntur jong ki bymman ka bam ia ka jingbymhok .

en: The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .
kha: To ka burom jong U  Trai  kan neh junom ! To U  Trai  un kmen ïa kaei kaba u la thaw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom U Trai kan neh junom: U Trai un sngewbha ha ki kam jong u .

en: For the  Lord  will plead their cause , and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them .
kha: U  Trai  un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki na ka bynta jong ki , bad un byrngem ïa ka jingim jong uno uno uba byrngem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un kyrpad ia ka daw jong ki , bad un pynsniew ia ka mynsiem jong kito kiba la pynsniew ia ki .

en: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of strange language  ;
kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , mynba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ki la mihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt , ka iing u Jakob na ka jaitbynriew kaba phylla ; .

en: Remember this , and shew yourselves men : bring it again to mind , O ye transgressors .
kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , phi ki nongpop ; pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kane , bad pyni ia lade ki briew: to wanrah biang ia ka ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat , ko phi ki nongleh bymman .

en: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la pynskhem ia ki lyoh haneng : haba u la pynskhem ia ki pung um jong ka jingjylliew :

en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart  ; they are revolted and gone .
kha: Hynrei ma phi ki briew ! Phi long kiba eh ryndang bad kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ; phi la phai noh sharud bad iehnoh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane ka jaitbynriew ka don ka dohnud kaba kylla bad kaba leh pyrshah ; ki kylla bad ki la jah noh .

en: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .
kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la bitar ïa kita ar ngut shi para .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki shiphew ngut ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la khih da ka jingbitar pyrshah ia ki arngut ki hynmen .

en: And when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him .
kha: U la beiñ ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pyrshah ia ki Israel , u Jonathan u khun u Shimeah u hynmen u Dabid u la pyniap ia u .

en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony , to be kept .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , u Aaron u buh ïa uta u khiew ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ba yn ïoh sumar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses , kumta u Aaron u la buh ia ka ha khmat ka Jingsakhi , ban shah sumar .

en: And Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place : and Balak also went his way .
kha: Nangta u Balaam u la ïeng joit bad leit phai noh sha la ïing , bad u Balak ruh u la leit phai ha la ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ieng, bad u la leit phai noh sha la ka jaka: bad u Balak ruh u la leit noh .

en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
kha: bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha ki hukum briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ym pyrkhat ia ki khanatang jong ki Jiw, bad ki hukum jong ki briew , kiba phai noh na ka jingshisha .

en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .
kha: To ai ba baroh kiba pyrshah ïa nga bad kiba ïaleh ïa nga yn pynshitom kum ïa ki briew bymman bad ki briew bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba u nongshun jong nga un long kum uba sniew , bad uta uba ieng pyrshah ia nga kum u bym hok .

en: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
kha: Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khyndew . Hynrei hapoh jong kajuh ka khyndew , baroh ka long ba la pra bad ba la phret .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka khyndew , na ka ka mih u kpu: bad hapoh jong ka la pynkylla kum ka ding .

en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause  ; and deceive not with thy lips .
kha: Wat ïeng sakhi pyrshah ïano ïano khlem ka daw kaba dei , ne wat ong ïa kaei kaei ka ban ïalam bakla shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long u nongsakhi pyrshah ia u paramarjan jong me khlem daw ; bad wat ju thok da ki rmiang shyntur jong me .

en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ki shim katto katne na ki jinglute ba ki ïohknieh ha ka thma bad pynkyntang ïa ki ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki jinglute ba la jop ha ki thma ki la aiti ban pynneh ia ka iing U Trai .

en: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle , that thou mayest eat and be full .
kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingbam baroh kaba phi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ia ki phlang jong me na ka bynta ki masi jong me, ba me lah ban bam bad dap .

en: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people : for I the  Lord  do sanctify him .
kha: ïoh u pyntngit ïa la ki khun hapdeng ki briew jong u . Nga long U  Trai  , uba pynkyntang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym pynjah burom ia u symbai jong u hapdeng ki briew jong u: namar nga U Trai nga pynkyntang ia u .

en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :
kha: U la kular lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u na mynbarim
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u la kren da ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid jong u , kiba la long naduh ba la sdang ka pyrthei:

en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ong ,  Kumno une u briew u tip katne katne haba um pat ju ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh, ki da ong, Kumno une u briew u tip ia ki shithi, namar ba um pat ju nang ?

en: Think upon me , my God , for good , according to all that I have done for this people .
kha: Nga duwai ha me , A Blei , to kynmaw ban kyrkhu na ka bynta kaei kaei baroh ba nga la leh na ka bynta kane ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia nga, ko Blei jong nga, na ka bynta ka jingbha, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh na ka bynta une u briew .

en: Pilate then went out unto them , and said , What accusation bring ye against this man ?
kha: Kumta u Pilat u la leit shabar sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïamudui aïu ïa une u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la mih shabar sha ki bad u la ong: Kaei ka jingkynnoh kaba phi wanrah pyrshah ia une u briew ?

en: For by me thy days shall be multiplied , and the years of thy life shall be increased .
kha: Ka jingstad kan nang pynjrong ïa ki snem ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da nga ki sngi jong me kin nang bun bad ki snem jong ka jingim jong me kin nang bun .

en: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them  ; and they made ready the passover .
kha: Ki synran ki la leh kumba U Jisu u la bthah ïa ki bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la leh kumba U Jisu u la thung ia ki ; bad ki la pynkhreh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait .

en: Reprove not a scorner , lest he hate thee : rebuke a wise man , and he will love thee .
kha: Wat ju pynbeit ïa u briew uba hangamei ; un isih ïa phi na ka bynta kata . Hynrei lada phi pynbeit ïa u briew uba stad , un burom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynrem ia u nongleh bein , ioh un shun ia me: pynrem ia u briew uba stad , bad un ieit ia me .

en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :
kha: Ki Lebi mynta ki long ki jong nga . Mynba nga la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh jong ki nong Ijipt , nga la pynkyntang kum la u jong ïa u khun nyngkong na kawei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel ; ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin weng noh ia ka dewbilat na ka almari bad kin saphriang ia ka jain kaba lieh halor kata:

en: Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .
kha: Kita shi para ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , ki la buh biang ïa la ki jingkit halor ki kada jong ki bad ki la leit phai sha kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pynkhih ia ki jain jong ki, bad uwei pa uwei u la leit phai noh sha ka shyntur jong u, bad ki la leit phai noh sha ka nongbah .

en: They bow themselves , they bring forth their young ones , they cast out their sorrows .
kha: Hato me tip lano kin dem ban wallam ïa ki khun rit sha ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dem khrup ia lade , ki wanrah ia ki khun shynrang jong ki , ki bret noh ia ki jingsngewsih jong ki .

en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place , and hangeth the earth upon nothing .
kha: U Blei u pyiar ha ka sahit bneng bashatei bad u sdien ïa ka pyrthei ha ka haw haw ba-thylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynjrong shaphang shathie halor ka jaka kaba thylli , bad u pynsangeh ia ka khyndew halor kaei kaei .

en: Is it time for you , O ye , to dwell in your ceiled houses , and this house lie waste ?
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , balei ba ma phi phin shong ha ki ïing ba la shna bha katba ka Templ jong nga ka dang sah ha ki jingjot ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka dei ka por ia phi , ko phi , ban shong ha ki iing ba la khang jong phi bad kane ka iing ka thiah ?

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai ; namar u long uba bha: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all : the king himself is served by the field .
kha: Wat u syiem u shaniah ha ka jingot .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka jingmyntoi jong ka khyndew ka long na ka bynta baroh: u syiem hi u shah shakri da ka lyngkha .

en: He draweth also the mighty with his power : he riseth up , and no man is sure of life .
kha: U Blei , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u pynjot ïa kiba khrawbor ; U Blei u trei — bad u briew uba sniew u ïap .
