translated_en_to_kha: U ring ruh ia kiba khlain bor da ka bor jong u: u kiew shaneng , bad ym don briew uba thikna ia ka jingim .

en: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest , O  Lord  , and teachest him out of thy law  ;
kha: A  Trai  , katno suk long u briew uba me hikai , uta ha uba me hikai ïa ka aiñ jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta u briew uba me pynshitom bein, ko Trai, bad hikai ia u na ka hukum jong me ; .

en: But we will bless the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore . Praise the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ma ngi , kiba im , ngin ainguh ïa u mynta bad sha bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngin kyrkhu ia U Trai naduh kane ka por bad junom . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: He giveth power to the faint  ; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength .
kha: U pynshaitbor ïa kito kiba tlot bad kiba thait .
translated_en_to_kha: U ai bor ia kiba jem bad ha kito ki bym don bor u pynkiew ia ka bor .

en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith , the same are the children of Abraham .
kha: Phi dei ban sngewthuh te , ba ki khun ki ksiew bashisha jong u Abraham ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip namarkata ba kita kiba don ka jingngeit ki long kumjuh ki khun u Abraham .

en: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .
kha: Bad mynta , ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga tip ba kaei kaba ma phi bad ki nongïalam jong phi , phi la leh ïa U Jisu ka long namar ka jingbymtip jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ko para bangeit, nga ong ba lyngba ka jingbymtip phi la leh ia kata, kumba la leh ruh ia ki nongsynshar jong phi .

en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .
kha: Ki shna ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la shna halor ki kynjri ba la shna da ka sniehdoh ha ki tduh jong ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him .
kha: U ryndang jong phi u long kum u mot jong u Dabid , uba pyllun bad jlih , lem bad u jingdeng ryndang uba kum shihajar tylli ki stieh kiba pynsdien sawdong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U baieit jong nga u la buh ha ka kti jong u da ka thliew jong ka jingkhang , bad ki bniat jong nga ki la khih na ka bynta jong u .

en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .
kha: Kumta te , haba u briew u smai da ka duwan , u smai da ka bad da baroh ki jingai sngewbha halor jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno u la smai da ka almari , u la smai da ka bad da kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka .

en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
kha: Ka nam jong u ka la kut ha ïing bad shabar ; ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkynmaw jong u kan jah noh na ka khyndew , bad un ym don kyrteng ha lynti .

en: And Isaac s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .
kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la tih ïa ka pukri ha kata ka them bad ki lap ba ka don um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la tih ha ka them , bad ki la shem hangta ia ka um kaba tuid .

en: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the  Lord  :
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u leit bran bran sha kata ka jaka ha kaba u la ïeng ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la khie dang step ha ka jaka ba u ieng ha khmat U Trai:

en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
kha: Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ka por jong ka jingtep ïa ka met jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la leh ia kaba ka lah: ka la wan shwa ban pynsleh ia ka met jong nga sha ka jingtep .

en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la poi sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa , ha ka ri Gerasa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi sha shiliang duriaw sha ka ri Gadare .

en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony , and cover the ark with the veil .
kha: Buh hangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki Shiphew Hukum , bad kah ïa ka da ka pyrda .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh hangta ia ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi , bad tap ia ka synduk da ka jingtap .

en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king , which made a marriage for his son ,
kha: Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Shisien la don u syiem uba la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai shongkurim na ka bynta u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hima bneng ka long kum uwei u syiem uba la shongkurim ia u khun jong u .

en: But refuse profane and old wives  fables , and exercise thyself rather unto godliness .
kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki khanatang bym don nongrim , ki bymmyntoi ban ïathuh . To men pynmlien ïa lade ïa ka jingim riewblei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kyntait ia ki tnga kiba sniew bad kiba la tymmen, bad leh ia lade kham bha ha ka jinglong blei .

en: Behold , I come quickly : hold that fast which thou hast , that no man take thy crown .
kha: Ngan wan kloi . Sumar kyndong ïa kaei kaba pha don , khnang ba yn ym don uno uno u ban lute na pha ïa ka bainong jong ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga wan kloi: bat ia kata ka jingstet kaba me don, ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba shim ia ka khlieh jong me .

en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow ? doth he open and break the clods of his ground ?
kha: Ym don u nongrep uba lur sah ïa ki lyngkha jong u bad uba pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbet .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u nongrep u tuid baroh shisngi ban bet ? hato u plie bad pynpra ia ki bniat jong ka khyndew jong u ?

en: And God appeared unto Jacob again , when he came out of Paddan–aram , and blessed him .
kha: Haba u Jakob u la wan phai na Mesopotamia , U Blei u la mihpaw biang ha u , bad u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la paw biang ha u Jakob, haba u la mih na Paddanaram bad u la kyrkhu ia u .

en: And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
kha: Kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Noah kumta kan long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ka la long ha ki sngi u Noah , kumta kan long ruh ha ki sngi U Khun u briew .

en: And he forsook the  Lord  God of his fathers , and walked not in the way of the  Lord .
kha: U kyntait ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la iaid ha ka lynti U Trai .

en: With all lowliness and meekness , with longsuffering , forbearing one another in love ;
kha: To long borabor kiba sngewrit , kiba jemnud , bad kiba ïaishah . To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi da kaba ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jinglong rit paid bad ka jinglong jemnud baroh, da kaba slem , da kaba ialeh pyrshah iwei ia iwei pat ha ka jingieit ; .

en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .
kha: Kumba hadien shiphew sngi , U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Nabal bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba shi sngi hadien , ba U Trai u la shoh ia u Nabal , ba u la iap .

en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki kren ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ïa u thylliej uba kren sniew yn pynsangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u nongleh hok ka wanrah ia ka jingstad: hynrei ka shyntur kaba jem kan shah ot noh .

en: Your glorying is not good . Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump ?
kha: Kam long kaba dei ïa phi ba phin sngewsarong ! Phi tip ïa ka jingong ,  Tang khyndiat u thiat , u pynsieb ïa u kpu im ba la khleh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpyndonburom jong u kam long kaba bha . Hato phim tip ba ka jingkhleh kaba rit ka pynkhih ia ka lum baroh kawei ?

en: So that I come again to my father s house in peace  ; then shall the  Lord  be my God :
kha: bad lada ngan wan phai pat da kaba suk sha ïing u kpa jong nga , te men long U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba ngan wan phai biang sha ka iing u kpa jong nga ha ka jingsuk ; te U Trai un long U Blei jong nga:

en: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me .
kha: Ka Sarah ka ong ,  U Blei u la wanrah ka jingkmen bad ka jingrkhie ïa nga . Kat kiba ïohsngew ïa kane kin ïa-rkhie bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sarah ka la ong , U Blei u la pynlong ia nga ban rkhie , kumta baroh kiba iohsngew kin rkhie bad nga .

en: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years : and he died .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba phraspah khyndaiphew san snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi jong u Mahalael baroh ki long hynriew spah hynniewphew san snem: bad u la iap .

en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .
kha: Kan long kum ka jingpynjot , ka ding bashyrkhei , ka ban bam duh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga don .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka ding kaba bam ia ka jingpynjot , bad kan sa pynduh noh ia ka jingroi jong nga baroh .

en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him ? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?
kha: Ujuh U Blei uba la thaw ïa nga u la thaw ruh ïa ki shakri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato uta uba la thaw ia nga ha ka kpoh um shym la thaw ia u ? bad ym don ba thaw ia ngi ha ka kpoh ?

en: My beloved spake , and said unto me , Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .
kha: U shñiuh jong phi u itynnat halor ki ngab jong phi , bad u noh rymphum ha ka ryndang jong phi kum ki mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkren baieit jong nga, bad ka la ong ha nga, To kiew, ko jingieit jong nga, bad to wan noh .

en: There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .
kha: Ym don kaba sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka jynjar suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingsniew kaba jia ia kiba hok: hynrei ki bymman kin dap da ka jingsniew .

en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .
kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang kum ka kynhun , kam dei ka Jingkhawai U Trai ba phi ïabam .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi iawan lang namarkata ha kawei ka jaka , kane kam dei ban bam ia ka jingbam janmiet jong U Trai .

en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ; as saith the prophet ,
kha: Hynrei U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh um shong ha ki ïing ba la tei da ki briew , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Katba kiba ha khlieh duh kim shong ha ki temple ba la shna da ki kti ; kumba ong u nongiathuhlypa , .

en: Lo , he goeth by me , and I see him not : he passeth on also , but I perceive him not .
kha: U Blei u ïaid najan , hynrei ngam ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , u iaid lyngba jong nga, bad ngam iohi ia u: u iaid shakhmat ruh, hynrei ngam sngewthuh ia u .

en: Then Peter said unto him , Lord , speakest thou this parable unto us , or even to all ?
kha: U Petros u la ong ,  Ko Trai hato kane ka pharshi ka dei na ka bynta jong ngi , ne me mut ïa ka na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ha u, ko Trai, me kren ia kane ka pharshi ha ngi ne wat ha ngi baroh ?

en: Your loyalty is important to us, and we’ll ensure this experience doesn’t happen again.
kha: Ka jinglong ïaineh jong phi ka long kaba kongsan ïa ngi, bad ngin pynthikna ba kane ka jingjïa kan ym jïa bïang.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ba iaineh jong phi ka long kaba kongsan ia ngi, bad ngin pynthikna ba kane ka jingshem kan ym jia shuh.

en: Behold , thou art called a Jew , and restest in the law , and makest thy boast of God ,
kha: Kumno shaphang jong phi ? Phi khot ïa lade u Jiw ; phi shaniah ha ka Hukum bad sngewsarong shaphang U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ia me, la khot ia me u Jiw, bad to shongthait ha ka hukum , bad to pynlong ia ka jingsarong jong U Blei jong me .

en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom , being about threescore and two years old .
kha: bad u Darius u nong Mid , uba ha kata ka por u don hynriewphew ar snem ka rta , u la knieh ïa ka bor syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Darius u Media u la shim ia ka hima, u la don kumba sanphew snem bad ar snem .

en: I counsel thee to keep the king s commandment , and that in regard of the oath of God .
kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba u syiem u ong , bad wat pynlong kano kano ka jingkular ha U Blei khlem da pyrkhat bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ai jingmut ia me ban sumar ia ka hukum jong u syiem bad kata ha kaba iadei bad ka jingsmai U Blei .

en: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod , and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines .
kha: Ki briew ba ïakhleh jaitbynriew kin shong kin sah ha Ashdod . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pyndem lut ïa kine ki Philistia kiba sarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u bastard un shong ha Ashdod , bad ngan ot noh ia ka jingsarong jong ki Philistia .

en: He directeth it under the whole heaven , and his lightning unto the ends of the earth .
kha: U phah ïa ka leilieh na shiliang sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynbeit ia ka hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei , bad ka jingshai jong u haduh ki kut jong ka khyndew .

en: And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .
kha: Kumta ki sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad u Moses u ong ha ki ,  La shi sngi , phi dei ban long kiba la pynkhreh bad ha kajuh ka por phim dei ban ïathiah shongkha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki briew , To long kiba la pynkhreh ha ka sngi kaba lai: wat wan sha ki tnga jong phi .

en: The ark , and the staves thereof , with the mercy seat , and the veil of the covering ,
kha: ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki jingbah ïa ka , ka jingtap jong ka , bad ka jingkah kaba kah ïa ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka synduk bad ki dieng jong ka, ryngkat bad ka jaka shong jingisynei bad ka jingtap jong ka jingtap .

en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .
kha: Ki Israel ki phet ïap na ki Judia , bad U Blei u shah ïa ki Judia ban thombor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la phet noh ha khmat u Judah : bad U Blei u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki .

en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :
kha: Kumta ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u sing . Kum u  labasa ngan apthap ha ki lynti ïaid jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan long ha ki kum u sing: kum u blang da kaba nga peit ia ki:

en: Therefore the king said unto Shimei , Thou shalt not die . And the king sware unto him .
kha: Bad u ong ha u Shimei ,  Nga khlei la ka jubanlak ha phi ba phin ym shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u syiem u la ong ha u Shimei , Wat iap . Bad u syiem u la sngap jar ia u .

en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito kiba lute ïa ka kin shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kwah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Kaldea kan long ka jingjot: baroh kiba pynsniew ia ka kin sa sngewhun , ong U Trai .

en: For if Abraham were justified by works , he hath whereof to glory ; but not before God .
kha: Lada ïa u la ñiew ka hok bad U Blei da kiei kiba u la leh , un don ei ei ban sngewsarong shaphang kata — hynrei ym ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada u Abraham u la shah pynksan da ki kam , u don ka burom ; hynrei ym ha khmat U Blei .

en: A servant will not be corrected by words : for though he understand he will not answer .
kha: Phim lah ban pynbeit ïa u shakri tang da kaba kren ïa u . U lah ban sngewthuh ïa phi , hynrei un ym pynleit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri un ym shah pynbeit da ki kyntien: namar wat la u sngewthuh un ym jubab .

en: And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :
kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang jong nga bad pha , bad phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga bad me ; bad me phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai:

en: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
kha: Katto katne ki la long kiba bieit , ki shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki bad namar ka jingsniew jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bieit namar ka jingpynkhein jong ki , bad namar ki jingbymhok jong ki , ki shah pynshitom .

en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
kha: Phi long kiba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba die ha ka ïew die doh , khlem da kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaei kaba la die ha ki jingbam ba la shet, kata ka bam, khlem da kylli ei ei na ka bynta ka jingsngewthuh:

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Sa shisien pat to leh ïa ka bynta u nongaplangbrot , ha kane ka sien u bymmyntoi ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , To shim ha me hynrei ia ki tiar jong u nongaplangbrot uba bieit .

en: Better is little with the fear of the  Lord  than great treasure and trouble therewith .
kha: Ka kham bha ban long kiba duk bad ba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ban ïa kaba long kiba riewspah bad shah jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long tang khyndiat bad ka jingtieng ia U Trai ban ia ka spah bad ka jingeh kaba khraw bad kata .

en: And in all vineyards shall be wailing : for I will pass through thee , saith the  Lord .
kha: Yn don ka jinglynñiar ha ki bri sohwaiñ baroh . Baroh kane kan jia namar ba nga wan ban pynshitom ïa phi .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki kper sohjew baroh kin iaid: namar ngan iaid lyngba jong me , ong U Trai .

en: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .
kha: Kine ki briew kim shym buaid , kumba phi tharai ; ka dang khyndai baje mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kine kim shym la dih kyiad kumba phi tharai , haba phi iohi ba ka long tang ka kynta kaba lai jong ka sngi .

en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .
kha: Namar kane ka daw phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar — ym tang namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei , hynrei na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phi dei ban long kiba kohnguh, ym tang na ka bynta ka jingbitar hynrei na ka bynta ka jingsngewthuh .

en: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .
kha: Namar haba ka jinglong lyngdoh ka la kylla , ka dei ban don ruh ka jingkylla ha ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jinglong lyngdoh kaba la kylla , la pynlong ia ka jingkylla ruh jong ka ain .

en: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
kha: Kumta te , phi dei ban long kiba ïai pynkhreh , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta kaba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to long kiba la pynkhreh ruh: namar ha ka kynta kaba kum kata kumba phim pyrkhat ba U Khun u briew un wan .

en: Which removeth the mountains , and they know not : which overturneth them in his anger .
kha: Khlem jingmaham u pynkynriah ïa ki lum , bad da ka jingbitar u pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba weng noh ia ki lum , bad kim tip: kaba pynkylla ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong u .

en: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house , neither did he set his heart to this also .
kha: Pynban , u la phai wak bad u leit noh sha la ka ïingsyiem khlem da pynleit jingmut ei ei ruh em shaphang kane .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la phai bad u la leit sha la iing , bad um shym la buh ia ka dohnud jong u ha kane ruh .

en: And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter s field , to bury strangers in .
kha: Hadien ba ki la poi ha ka jingïamynjur lang shaphang kata , ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka Lyngkha u Nongthaw khiew , kum ka jaka tep ïa ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim jingmut bad ki la thied bad ki ia ka lyngkha khiew , ban tep ia ki nongwei shapoh .

en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: u la tei ïa ka pyrthei halor ki um bajylliew ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la pynjrong ia ka khyndew halor ki um: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im la bret sha ka pung ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym shym la lap ba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka jingim la bret ha ka pung ding .

en: And Ahishar was over the household : and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute .
kha: Uba khmih ïa ki shakri ïingsyiem : U Ahishar Uba khmih ïa ka jingtrei kaba shu pynbor : u Adoniram , u khun jong u Abda .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahishar u la long halor ka iing: bad u Adoniram u khun u Abda u la long halor ka khajna .

en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
kha: U Jesse nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Shammah .  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh  u Samuel u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jesse u la pynlong ia u Shammah ban iaid lyngba . Bad u la ong , Bad U Trai um shym la jied ia kane .

en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof  ;
kha: Mano ba bat ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa ka khyndew ? Mano ba buh ïa u mawdong jong ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki nongrim jong ka ki la sahkut ? lane mano ba buh ia u maw ba kongsan jong ka;

en: And join them one to another into one stick  ; and they shall become one in thine hand .
kha: Nangta bat ïa kine ki ar tylli ki dieng na tduh ha tduh ha ka kti jong me ba kin i kum uwei u dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to pyniasoh ia ki iwei ia iwei pat ha kawei ka dieng ; bad kin long kawei ha ka kti jong me .

en: Again , they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .
kha: Haba ki briew jong U Blei ki shahjop bad shah ibeiñ da ki jingbanbeiñ bad jingjynjar bashyrkhei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , ki shah pynduh bad shah pynhiar dor lyngba ka jingshah pynshitom bein , ka jingshah pynshitom bad ka jingsngewsih .

en: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .
kha: Nga ong ha phi baroh ba ym don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki ban ïohmad ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , Ba ym don uwei ruh na kita ki briew kiba la shah jied un sngewtynnad ia ka jingbam janmiet jong nga .

en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
kha: Kam mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin ïohlait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngam pdiang ia ka jingphla na u briew: hynrei ia kine kiei kiei nga ong , ba phin ioh jingpynim .

en: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David  ; and Saul became David s enemy continually .
kha: Kumta u nang kham tieng shuh shuh ïa u Dabid bad u kylla long u nongshun jong u katba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u dang kham tieng ia u Dabid ; bad u Saul u la kylla long u nongshun jong u Dabid man ka por .

en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city , when they heard these things .
kha: Da kine ki ktien ki la pynkhihwin ïa u paidbah bad ïa ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhuslai ia ki briew bad ki nongsynshar jong ka shnong haba ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel  ; and they fled every man to their tents .
kha: Ki shipai u Amasaïah ki shahjop , bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki phet krad sha la ki ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la kham sniew ha khmat ki Israel ; bad ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha la ki ïingjaiñ .

en: And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad u la ïap noh ruh khlem don khun . Ka la jia kumjuh ïa u para uba lai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba ar ka la shim ia ka, bad ka la iap, ym shym la iehnoh ia u symbai: bad kaba lai kumjuh .

en: Hear this , O ye that swallow up the needy , even to make the poor of the land to fail ,
kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi kiba ïuhroit ïa kiba kyrduh bad kiba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa kiba duk ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane , ko phi kiba sngap jar ia kiba duk , wat ban pynlong ia kiba duk jong ka ri ban duh noh , .

en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
kha: Phi sngewsarong ba phi don ka Hukum U Blei — hynrei hato phi wallam ka jinglehrain ïa U Blei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me uba pynlong ia ka jingsarong jong me ia ka hukum , da kaba pynkhein ia ka hukum me khlem burom ia U Blei ?

en: As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka mawkordor ksiar ha ka sniehdoh kaba sniew , kumjuh ruh ka kynthei kaba bhabriew kaba khlem ka jingsngewthuh .

en: And it shall come to pass , if there remain ten men in one house , that they shall die .
kha: Lada shiphew ngut ki dang sah ha kawei ka ïing , kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan jia lada ki sah shiphew ngut ki briew ha kawei ka iing .

en: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .
kha: Nangta ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u ,  Mynta te me kren shai kdar , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u, Lo, mynta me kren shai bad me kren ia ka proberb .

en: The length of a board was ten cubits , and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half .
kha: Kawei kawei ka jingker ka long saw mitar ka jingjrong bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong ka lieng ka long shi cubit , bad ka jingjrong jong ka lieng ka long shi cubit shiteng .

en: And the foolish said unto the wise , Give us of your oil  ; for our lamps are gone out .
kha: Nangta kita kiba bieit ki la ong ha kiba stad , ‘ Ai lem ha ngi ïa ka umphniang jong phi , namar ki sharak jong ngi ki la jan lip .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u bieit u la ong ha kiba stad: Ai ia ngi na ka umphniang jong phi ; namar ki sharak jong ngi ki la jah noh .

en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath : and behold every one that is proud , and abase him .
kha: To khmih sha kito kiba sarong ; theh ïa ka jingbitar jong me bad pynpoh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka jingbitar jong me: bad ha khmih uwei pa uwei uba sngew sarong , bad pynjah burom ia u .

en: And they dwelt therein , and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name , saying ,
kha: Ki la shong la sah hangne bad tei ïa ka templ ban burom ïa me , da kaba tip
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shong hangta bad ki la tei ia me ka jaka kyntang hangta na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong me, ki da ong:

en: Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,
kha: A  Trai  uba U Blei , uba long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh , nga kyrpad ïa me to thung ïa u briew uba lah ban ïalam ïa u paidbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki mynsiem baroh , un buh ia u briew halor ka balang , .

en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .
kha: Bad da baroh ka spah bakyrhai jong u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , U Blei jong nga un pyndap ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei jong nga un pyndap ia ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh kat kum ka spah jong u ha ka burom da U Khrist Jisu .

en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things , but will walk contrary unto me  ;
kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane ka jingpynshitom phim pat shahshkor ïa nga , hynrei phi ïai pyrshah ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phin ym shah pynkylla ha nga da kine kiei kiei , hynrei phin iaid pyrshah ia nga ; .

en: And he prayed again , and the heaven gave rain , and the earth brought forth her fruit .
kha: Sa shisien u la duwai , bad ka suiñbneng ka la theh noh ïa la u slap bad ka khyndew ka la pynmih ïa ki jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: U la duwai biang bad ka bneng ka la ai slap bad ka khyndew ka la pynmih ia u soh jong ka .

en: Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Wat lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu saiñ na ka sisa bad ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat phai sha ki bleithaw , lymne ban pynlong ia lade ki blei kiba la tyrkhong: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
kha: Nangta u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u kylla dien bad phai noh sha Ninebeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Sennakherib u syiem Assyria u la leit noh bad u la leit phai noh bad u la shong ha Nineveh .

en: Now therefore hearken unto me , O ye children : for blessed are they that keep my ways .
kha: Te mynta , ko samla , shahshkor ïa nga . Leh kumba nga ong , bad phin long suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sngap ia nga, ko khun: namar la kyrkhu ia kita kiba sumar ia ki lynti jong nga .

en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath : and he sought no more again for him .
kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la phet ïap sha Gath , u sangeh noh ban wad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la phet noh sha Gath : bad um wad shuh ia u .

en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ka long kaba bha tam ïa ngi ban ap ha ka jingïaishah — ban ap ïa u ban pynim ïa ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba bha ba u briew un kyrmen bad da kaba sngap jar ia ka jingpynim U Trai .

en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .
kha: Kumta ngan sngewsarong shaphang une u briew — hynrei ngan ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa kiei kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kum uta ngan burom: hynrei na nga hi ngan ym burom , hynrei ha ki jingduna jong nga .

en: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner .
kha: U Pharisi u la kyndit haba u ïohi ba U Jisu um shym la thet ha shuwa ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Pharisi u la iohi ia ka , u la lyngngoh ba um shym la sait nyngkong shuwa ban bam ja miet .

en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill , and under every green tree :
kha: Ha baroh ki lumrit bad ha syrngiew jong uwei pa uwei u dieng ki pynïeng ïa ki païa maw bad ki dur jong ka blei Asherah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki buh ia ki dur bad ki lum kiba jrong , bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam:

en: For thou ,  Lord  , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .
kha: A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongsynshar ha ka pyrthei baroh ; me kham khraw palat ban ïa ki blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong me, ko Trai, me long uba jrong halor ka khyndew baroh: me la pynkiew sha jngai halor ki blei baroh .

en: Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .
kha: To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko  Trai  ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa ka burom ba-mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: To phai noh sha me ko Trai bad ngin sa kylla thymmai ia ki sngi jong ngi kumba ju long mynshuwa .

en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :
kha: Ka ktang jong uta u diengpynïeng sharak ka don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ka dur ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sharak ki don saw tylli ki khiew ba la shna kum ki almond, ki knop jong u bad ki syntiew jong u:

en: But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !
kha: Pha long kum ka kynthei kaba ïaleh awria bad ki nongwei ha ka jaka ban ieit ïa la u tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga kaba leh be-ijot ia ka jingkha khun , kaba shim ia ki nongwei ha ka jaka jong u tnga jong ka !

en: But when that which is perfect is come , then that which is in part shall be done away .
kha: hynrei haba kata kaba janai kan wan , te kata kaba tang katto katne kan jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda kata ka la wan , te kata ka long ha kawei ka bynta kan sa jah noh .

en: Her children arise up , and call her blessed  ; her husband also , and he praiseth her .
kha: Ki khun jong ka , ki pynpaw ïa ka jingsngew burom ïa ka , u tnga jong ka u ïaroh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ka ki ieng , bad ki khot ia ka; u tnga jong ka ruh u iaroh ia ka .

en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .
kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki kumne kumne .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniakhlad ia lade napdeng kane ka balang , ba ngan bam ia ki tang shiphang .

en: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not  ; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
kha: Ho-oid , baroh ki jingri jong ki , ki pun bad ki kha khlem don ka jingeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong shynrang jong ki, bad ka jingbym lah ban leh kumta, bad ka khun masi jong ka .

en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynïap briew ha kaba rieh .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba pynkhih ia u paramarjan jong u da kaba rieh . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .
kha: Katno ngi ainguh ïa U Blei ba u la pynlong ïa u Titos ban thrang kum ma ngi ban ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ainguh ia U Blei uba la buh ia kajuh ka jingsumar ha ka dohnud jong u Titus na ka bynta jong phi .

en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano ba me leit . Nga tip kumno me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga tip ia ka jaka sah jong me, bad ka jingleit jong me, bad ka jingwan jong me shapoh bad ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ia nga .

en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .
kha: Men ai ïa ngi ka jingroi jingpar , A  Trai  ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndep ha ka jingjop ka long ka jingmih na kaei kaba me leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai, me ruh phin pynbeit ia ka jingsuk na ka bynta jong ngi: namar me ruh me la leh ia ki kam jong ngi baroh ha ngi .

en: Evil men understand not judgment : but they that seek the  Lord  understand all things .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kim sngewthuh kaei ka jinglehhok , hynrei kito kiba mane ïa U  Trai  ki sngewthuh bha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kim sngewthuh ia ka jingbishar: hynrei kito kiba wad ia U Trai ki sngewthuh ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad ka mrad .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shong bad uno uno u mrad . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: I entreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me da la ka dohnud baroh ; ban isynei ïa nga , kumba me la kular !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kyrpad ia ka jingsngewbha jong me da ka dohnud baroh: to long kiba isynei ia nga kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,
kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , haba ngi duwai na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ainguh ia U Blei bad ia U Kpa jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , da kaba duwai beit na ka bynta jong phi , .

en: And when they looked , they saw that the stone was rolled away : for it was very great .
kha: Ha lynti ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei u ban pyntyllun na ka bynta jong ngi ïa u maw na ka jingkhang ban rung sha ka jingtep ?  ( U la long u maw uba heh shibun . ) Te ki la khmih bad ki la ïohi ba ïa u maw la lah pyntyllun noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki peit , ki la iohi ba u maw u la kylla noh: namar u la long uba khraw shibun .

en: Yet ye have forsaken me , and served other gods : wherefore I will deliver you no more .
kha: Pynban phi dang iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; kumta ngan ym pyllait ïa phi sa shisien pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la iehnoh ia nga, bad phi la shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei: namar kata ngan ym pyllait shuh ia phi .

en: Behold , thou art wiser than Daniel  ; there is no secret that they can hide from thee :
kha: Me pyrkhat ba me kham stad ban ïa u Daniel , ba ym don ka barieh ba lah ban buhrieh na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me, me kham stad ban ia u Daniel ; ym don jingmaham ba ki lah ban buhrieh na me:

en: And the water was spent in the bottle , and she cast the child under one of the shrubs .
kha: Haba ka um ka la lut , ka ieh ïa u khunlung hapoh kawei ka bniap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynlut ia ka um ha ka bilor , bad ka la bret ia u khynnah hapoh uwei na ki shyieng .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Why art thou wroth ? and why is thy countenance fallen ?
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ïa u Kain ,  Balei me bitar , bad balei ka durkhmat jong me ka kylla dur ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Kain , Balei me bitar ? bad balei ba ka khmat jong me ka la hap ?

en: The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .
kha: Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai ïa ki ka jingbam na bneng ban pynhun ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la kylli , bad u la wanrah ia ki quail , bad u la pynhun ia ki da u kpu bneng .

en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering , he shall bring it a female without blemish .
kha: Lada u briew u wallam ïa ka langbrot kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop , ka dei ban long ka langbrot ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u wanrah ia u khun langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , un wanrah ia ka kynthei khlem jingduna .

en: By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;
kha: Ïa ngi la pyndonburom bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroh . La ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongshukor , pynban ngi kren ïa ka jingshisha ;
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka burom bad ka jingbym burom, da ka kaiphod kaba sniew bad kaba bha: kum ki nongleh thok , bad wat la katta ruh;

en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king : his mouth transgresseth not in judgment .
kha: U syiem u kren da ka iktiar blei ; ki rai jong u borabor ki long kiba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sentens ba kynja Blei ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u syiem: ka shyntur jong u kam iaid lait ha ka jingbishar .

en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened  ; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread .
kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym dei ban lap ïa u thiat ha ki ïing jong phi ; namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu uba la khleh thiat la u dei u nongwei ne u traishnong , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin ym bam ei ei kaba la khleh lang ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh .

en: And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .
kha: Dang step bha ha ka step kaba bud , katba ki dang ïaid ha kata ka lynti , ki la ïohi ïa uta u dieng Dumbur . U la ïap baroh shi rynïeng haduh ki thied .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep , katba ki dang iaid lyngba , ki la iohi ia u dieng sohjew ba u la tyrkhong na ki tynrai .

en: Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .
kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ko Job , phi la bakla . U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka long tang: Ngan jubab ia me, ba U Blei u kham khraw ban ia u briew .

en: Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?
kha: U phah ïa ka jingjynjar bad jingpynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam dei ka jingpynjot ia kiba sniew ? bad ka jingpynshitom kaba phylla ia ki nongtrei bymman ?

en: And he said , Bring me a new cruse , and put salt therein . And they brought it to him .
kha: Buh khyndiat ka mluh ha ka pliang thymmai , bad wanrah ïa ka ha nga ,  u la hukum . Ki la wanrah ïa ka ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , To wanrah ia nga ia ka umsoh kaba thymmai, bad buh ia ka umsoh ha ka . Ki la wanrah ia ka ha u .

en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .
kha: Khnang ba U Blei un sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , phi dei ban ïaleh ban im katkum ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ba ki jingduwai jong phi kin shah sngap ha U Blei , phi dei ban pyrshang katba lah ban im katkum ki ain jong u .

en: Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?
kha: Kine baroh ki kdew ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la dep pyndonkam ; ki long tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei baroh kiba dei ban jah noh da kaba pyndonkam ; ) hadien ki hukum bad ki jinghikai jong ki briew ?

en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun u Nebat u la synshar ia u Abijam halor ka Judah .

en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñkup bad u la ong ,  Ngim donkam shuh kino kino ki sakhi !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh rangbah u pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u ong , Ngi donkam shuh shuh ia ki sakhi ?

en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these parables , he departed thence .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ïathuh ïa kine ki pharshi , u la iehnoh ïa kata ka jaka
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba U Jisu u la pyndep ia kine ki pharshi , u la leit noh nangta .

en: Woe to the bloody city ! it is all full of lies and robbery  ; the prey departeth not  ;
kha: Long kaba la tim ka nongbah kaba pynïap bad kaba lamler , kaba dap da ka spah ban shah lute bad shah kurup !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ka nongbah kaba snam ! ka dap da ki jinglamler bad ki jinglute ; u mrad u leit noh;

en: If the replacement doesn’t meet your expectations, we can explore alternative solutions.
kha: Lada ka jingpynkylla kam ïahap bad ka jingkhmih lynti jong phi, ngi lah ban wad ki lad ki lynti da kiwei.
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka jingpynkylla kam iadei bad ki jingkhmih lynti jong phi, ngi lah ban wad ia ki lad ki lynti kiba pher.

en: Wilt thou believe him , that he will bring home thy seed , and gather it into thy barn ?
kha: Hato me khmih lynti ïa u ba un wanrah ïa ka jingot jong me , bad ban lum ïa u kew na ka jaka shoh kew jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ngeit ia u , ba un wanrah ia u symbai jong me sha iing bad un lum ia u ha ka phyllaw jong me ?

en: The requested adjustment has been processed. Please check your account for confirmation.
kha: Ka jingpynbeit ba la pan ka la dep pyndep. Sngewbha peit ïa ka account jong phi ban pynthikna.
translated_en_to_kha: La pyntreikam ia ka jingpynkylla ba la pan. Sngewbha peit ia ka account jong phi na ka bynta ka jingpynskhem.

en: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .
kha: U syiem jong ki bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem jong ki un leit sha ka jingshah set phatok, ma u bad ki syiem jong u ryngkat , ong U Trai .

en: The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth–shemesh , and Elon–beth–hanan :
kha: U Bendeker : ki nongbah Makas , Shaalbim , Beth Shemesh , Elon , bad Beth Hanan
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Dekar, ha Makaz, bad ha Shaalbim, bad u Bethshesh, bad u Elonhamshan:

en: And Samuel said , Gather all Israel to Mizpah , and I will pray for you unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Samuel u phah khot ïa ki Israel baroh ban ïashem lang ha Mispah , da kaba ong ,  Ngan duwai hangta ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong: To leit noh ia ki Israel baroh sha Mizpa , bad ngan duwai na ka bynta jong phi ha U Trai .

en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark  ;
kha: U la ap sa hynñiew sngi , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sah sa hynriew sngi; bad sa shisien u la phah ia ka paro na ka lieng;

en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .
kha: U la ïaphylliew jingmut hapoh synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , da kaba pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki Jiw bad ki Grik .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iasaid ha ka synagog man la ka sngi Sabha bad u la pynsngewthuh ia ki Jiw bad ki Grik .

en: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers : but the sheep did not hear them .
kha: Baroh kita kiwei kiba la wan ha shuwa jong nga ki long ki nongtuh bad nonglute , hynrei ki langbrot kim shym la shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kaba la wan ha khmat jong nga ki long ki nongtuh bad ki nongtuh: hynrei ki langbrot kim shym la iohsngew ia ki .

en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .
kha: Ho-oid , u phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei jong ngi ka neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: U phlang u tyrkhong , u syntiew u tyrkhong: hynrei ka ktien U Blei jong ngi kan ieng junom .

en: And it came to pass that night , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Nathan , saying ,
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u ong ha u Nathan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kata ka miet , ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Nathan da kaba ong:

en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .
kha: Ka kham bha ban don ki briew kiba stad kiba sneng ïa phi ban ïa kaba don ki briew kiba tasngeng kiba rwai ki jingïaroh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban iohsngew ia ka jingkynthoh jong kiba stad , ban ia u briew ban iohsngew ia ka jingrwai jong ki bieit .

en: Behold , I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me .
kha: Nga tip ki jingmut pyrshah aïu phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong phi bad ki buit kiba phi pyrkhat bakla pyrshah ia nga .

en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :
kha: U long ma u , uta uba bat ïa ka jingtei baroh kawei , bad uba pynlong ïa ka ba kan san ha ka Templ kaba kyntang ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ka jingtei baroh ka la iaid beit ka san sha ka tempi bakhuid ha U Trai:

en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .
kha: U Blei u la ai noh ïa nga ha ki briew kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la aiti ia nga ha ki bymman , bad u la pynphai noh ia nga ha ki kti jong kiba sniew .

en: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,
kha: U la leit biang sha ka jaka ïew ha ka por khyndai baje , bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba ïa-ïeng hangta khlem kam ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih kumba ka kynta kaba lai , bad u la iohi ia kiwei pat kiba ieng khlem sangeh ha iew .

en: Then said Pilate unto him , Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee ?
kha: Kumta u Pilat u la ong ïa u ,  Mem ïohsngew ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ki mudui ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Pilat ha u , Hato phim sngap katno kiei kiei kiba ki sakhi pyrshah ia me ?

en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
kha: Hynrei u pyllait ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u pynshong ia kiba duk na ka jingjynjar , bad u pynlong ia u kum ka kynhun .

en: And they did not receive him , because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem .
kha: Hynrei ki briew hangta kim kwah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ka la paw shai ba u la don ha ka lynti sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la pdiang ia u , namar ka khmat jong u ka long kumba un leit sha Jerusalem .

en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
kha: Don katto katne ka jingkyrmen ïa u bieit uba mutlop ban ïa uno uno uba kren khlem pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi ia u briew uba kyrkieh ha ki ktien jong u ? ka don ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bun ia u briew uba bieit ban ia u .

en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
kha: Phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad ki kam bym don jingmyntoi kiba ki briew ki leh , kiba long ki kam ka jingdum . Pynban wallam ïa ki sha ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim don jingiadei bad ki kam bym don soh jong ka jingdum , hynrei ki kham pynrem ia ki .

en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh , what will he do unto those husbandmen ?
kha: Mynta , haba u trai ka bri sohwaiñ u wan , kaei kaba un leh ïa kito ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u kynrad jong ka kper sohjew u wan , un leh aiu ia kita ki nongrep ?

en: And when he would not be persuaded , we ceased , saying , The will of the Lord be done .
kha: Ngim shym lah ban pynkohnguh ïa u , kumta ngi la sangeh noh bad ngi la ong ,  Ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ym shym la pynsngewthuh ia u, ngi la sangeh noh da kaba ong , Ka mon U Trai kan long .

en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .
kha: Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la wan sha u , hynrei kim lah ban ïadon bad u namar u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la wan sha u bad ki hynmen jong u , bad kam lah ban wan sha u na ka bynta ka kot khubor .

en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?
kha: Ym don uba stad u ban kren kumba kren ma me lane ïada ïa lade da kum kita ki ktien bym don jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u dei ban pyrkhat da ka jingiakren kaba khlem jingmyntoi ? lane da ki jingkren kiba u lah ban leh ei ei ?

en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
kha: U briew u lah ban ïohpateng ïa ka ïing bad ka spah na la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei tang U  Trai  uba lah ban ai ha u ïa ka tnga kaba shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing bad ka spah ki long ka pateng jong ki kpa: bad ka tnga kaba stad ka long na U Trai .

en: Cretans and Arabians , we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God .
kha: ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam Jiw , bad katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Krit bad na Arabia — pynban baroh na ngi , ngi ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien jong ngi shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei u la leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Kreta bad ki nong Arab , ngi iohsngew ba ki kren ha ki thylliej jong ngi ia ki kam ba phylla jong U Blei .

en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come , whereof we speak .
kha: U Blei um shym la buh ïa ki angel kum ki nongsynshar halor ka pyrthei kaba thymmai ka ban sa wan — ka pyrthei ïa kaba ngi ïakren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ki angel um shym la buh ha ka jingsynshar ia ka pyrthei kaban sa wan , na kaba ngi kren .

en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi , u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kat kum ka jingthew ïa kaei kaba U Khrist u la ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ngi baroh la ai ia ka jingaiei kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jingai U Khrist .

en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .
kha: U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton ñiut bad u shim da ki saraw khiew ba la pait ban trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shim ia u da ka khiew ban scrap ia lade da ka met bad u la shong hapdeng ka dewbilat .

en: Herein is my Father glorified , that ye bear much fruit  ; so shall ye be my disciples .
kha: Ka burom U Kpa jong nga ka paw da ka jingseisoh ba bun jong phi ; bad ha kane ka rukom phi long ki synran jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne la pyndonburom ia U Kpa jong nga, ba phi sei soh shibun ; kumta phin long ki synran jong nga .

en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
kha: Ym don ei ei ïa u kpa hynrei ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki kam bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kha ia u bieit u leh ia kata ha ka jingsngewsih jong u: bad u kpa jong u bieit um don jingkmen .

en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness : but the righteous hath hope in his death .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wallam ïa la ka jong ka jingkyllon noh da ki kam basniew jong ki , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba bha la ïada da ka jinglonghok jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La beh noh ia u bymman ha ka jingsniew jong u: hynrei u hok u don ka jingkyrmen ha ka jingiap jong u .

en: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon : of shittim wood shalt thou make it .
kha: Thaw ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ka jingbam ban thang ia ka jingiwbih halor: na u dieng shittim me dei ban shna ia ka .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .
kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa u syiem Ijipt ,  Men mad ïa ka waitlam u syiem Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; Ka waitlam jong u syiem Babilon kan wan ha me .

en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses .
kha: Ki paid Israel baroh ki ïaleit noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki Israel ka la leit noh na ka jingdon jong u Moses .

en: And I saw in my dream , and , behold , seven ears came up in one stalk , full and good :
kha: Nga la phohsniew ruh ba nga ïohi hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga, bad, ha khmih, hynriew tylli ki shkor ki la wan shaneng ha kawei ka tnat kaba dap bad kaba bha:

en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me , What are these , my lord ?
kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Ko rangbah , kaei ka jingmut jong kine ki kali ïapom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la jubab bad nga la ong ha u angel uba la kren bad nga: Kiei kine, ko kynrad jong nga ?

en: Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?
kha: Pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . Kumno keiñ uno uno un pynbeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkdor .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia ka kam U Blei: namar mano ba lah ban pynlong ia kata kaba beit , kaba u la pynlong lyngngoh ?

en: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds , and folds for flocks .
kha: Ka ri jong phi harud duriaw kan kylla long ki pyntha bym don jingkah lem bad ki trep jong ki nongap langbrot bad ki sem langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw kan long ki jaka sah bad ki ïing rit na ka bynta ki nongap langbrot , bad ki jingpynkylla na ka bynta ki kynhun .

en: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , ki kren shaphang kiei kiei ki jong ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , namar ki long ki jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long na ka pyrthei: namarkata ki kren ia ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka iohsngew ia ki .

en: Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .
kha: Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah bad khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew katba phi lah ban ïashem .’
translated_en_to_kha: To leit namarkata sha ki surok bah bad katba phi lah ban shem, to leit sha ka jingshongkha .

en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .
kha: Phi kynmaw balei nga la ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha phi ha kaba nyngkong ; ka long namar ba nga la pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip kumno lyngba ka jingbym lah jong ka doh nga la ialap ia ka gospel ha phi ha kaba nyngkong .

en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the  Lord  withal .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw , ïa u soh baroh dei ban pynkyntang kum ka jingainguh ïaroh ïa nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba saw baroh ki soh jong ka kin long kiba khuid ban iaroh ia U Trai .

en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding : therefore shalt thou not exalt them .
kha: Me la khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki ban pyrkhat beit ; wat shah ïa ki ban jop halor jong nga mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la buhrieh ia ka dohnud jong ki na ka jingsngewthuh: namarkata wat pynkhraw ia ki .

en: When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;
kha: U Blei u long borabor bad nga ha kata ka por bad u ai jingshai ïa nga katba nga ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka sharak jong u ka la shai ha ka khlieh jong nga , bad haba da ka jingshai jong u nga la iaid lyngba ka jingdum ; .

en: And the Philistines came up yet again , and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .
kha: Nangta ki Philistia ki leit phai pat sha ka Them Rephaim bad ki knieh biang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la wan shaneng sa shisien pat bad ki la pynphriang ia lade ha ka them Rephaim .

en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
kha: Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis    lano ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lane mano ba ïathuh ïa u syiar ba u slap un sa hap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la buh ia ka jingstad ha ki bynta ba shapoh ? lane mano ba la ai jingmut ia ka dohnud ?

en: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :
kha: Ïa kine baroh la buh jingthoh naba ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine baroh, haba ki la ioh ia ka kaiphod kaba bha lyngba ka jingngeit, kim shym la ioh ia ka jingkular:

en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
kha: Te u Sennakherib u patsha ka Assyria u iehnoh bad leit phai sha Ninebeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Sennakherib u syiem Assyria u la leit noh bad u la leit phai noh bad u la shong ha Nineveh .

en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi  ; for he dwelt in the south country .
kha: U Isaak u la wan sha ka ri khlaw jong  Ka Pukri jong uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga  bad ba u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shathie jong ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la wan na ka lynti jong ka thliew Lahairoi ; namar u la shong ha ka ri Sepngi .

en: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong  ;
kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pyrshang ban pynsniew ïa uwei pat u briew da kaba mudui lamler ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u nongsakhi lamler u kiew pyrshah ia uno uno u briew ban sakhi pyrshah ia u ia kaba bakla ; .

en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
kha: Hynrei jar uba shahshkor ïa nga un shongsuk kynjai . Un lait na ki jingma khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba sngap ia nga un shong suk im saiñ bad un sngap jar na ka jingtieng ia ka jingsniew .

en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons , and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat .
kha: Namar ba la palat ka jingthngan , phin hap bam sa ïa la ki jong ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ia ka doh jong ki khun shynrang jong phi bad ka doh jong ki khun kynthei jong phi phin bam .

en: Are not my days few ? cease then , and let me alone , that I may take comfort a little ,
kha: Hato ka jingim jong nga ka la jan kut ? Ieh ïa nga marwei ! Shah ba ngan lehkmen ïa ka por kaba dang sah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki sngi jong nga kim long kiba rit ? sangeh noh nangta , bad iehnoh ia nga marwei , ba ngan ioh jingpyntngen khyndiat ,

en: And there was Mary Magdalene , and the other Mary , sitting over against the sepulchre .
kha: Ka Mari ka nong Magdala , bad kawei pat ka Mari , ki la shong hangta marpyrshah ïa ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria Magdalene bad kawei pat ka Maria kaba shong ha ka jingtep .

en: The name of the  Lord  is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it , and is safe .
kha: U  Trai  u long kum ka kut baskhem , sha kaba kiba hok ki lah ban leit bad sngewshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng U Trai ka long ka tower kaba skhem: u hok u mareh shapoh jong ka , bad u long uba shngain .

en: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes  ; but the  Lord  weigheth the spirits .
kha: Phi lah ban pyrkhat ba baroh kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei dei U  Trai  uba bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki lynti jong u briew ki long kiba khuid ha la ki jong ki khmat ; hynrei U Trai u khia ia ki mynsiem .

en: Thank you for pointing out this issue. We’ll use your feedback to improve our processes.
kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la kdew ïa kane ka mat. Ngi’n pyndonkam ïa ka jingai jingmut jong phi ban pynbha ïa ki rukom treikam jong ngi.
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la kdew ia kane ka mat. Ngi pyndonkam ia ka jingai jingmut jong phi ban pynbha ia ki rukom treikam jong ngi.

en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano me leit , bad nga tip kumno ba me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga tip ia ka jaka sah jong me, bad ka jingleit jong me, bad ka jingwan jong me shapoh bad ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ia nga .

en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im ; aïu te , kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlem Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki hok ki duna bha ka jingpynim , shano ki bym riewblei bad u nongpop kin paw ?

en: Whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Rise up and walk ?
kha: Hato ka kham suk ban ong , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong phi ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ to ïeng joit bad ïaid ?’
translated_en_to_kha: La ka kham suk ne em, ban ong , Ki pop jong me kin map ia me ; ne ban ong , To kiew bad iaid ?

en: The right hand of the  Lord  is exalted : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
kha: Ka bor jong u ka la wanrah jingjop ïa ngi — ka borbah jong u ha ka thma !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti kadiang jong U Trai ka long kaba la pynkiew: ka kti kadiang jong U Trai ka leh da ka jingshlur .

en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .
kha: Ka met jong u ka ju long kaba samla bad kaba khlaiñ , hynrei shen kan sa kylla pui pui .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki dap da ka pop jong u samla jong u , ki ban thiah bad u ha ka dewbilat .

en: But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation  ;
kha: Pynban , to long kiba khuid ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , kumba U Blei uba la khot ïa phi u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba uta uba la khot ia phi u long uba khuid, kumta to long kiba khuid ha ka jingiakren baroh;

en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :
kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga ieng bad la bishar ia nga na ka bynta ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingkular ba la leh da U Blei ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi:

en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .
kha: Lada phi pynshitom ïa la ki khun , phim ieit ïa ki . Lada phi ieit ïa ki , phin sneng pynbeit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynim ia u khun jong u: hynrei uta uba ieit ia u u pynshitom ia u ha ki por .

en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
kha: Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jong nga . Ngan sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hikai ia nga , bad ngan bat ia ka shyntur jong nga : bad pynlong ia nga ban sngewthuh shano nga la bakla .

en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother , his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness .
kha: Lada phi tim ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ka jingim jong phi kan kut kum ka sharak kaba lip noh ha kaba dum .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba tim ia la u kpa ne ia ka kmie jong u , ka sharak jong u kan shah pynmih ha ka jingdum kaba dum .

en: So the altar shall be four cubits  ; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns .
kha: Kane ka bynta ba-halor , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia la thang , ka long ruh ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki long kham jrong ban ïa kiwei ha ka bynta ba-halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka altar kan long saw phut bad na ka altar shaneng kan long saw tylli ki bniat .

en: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad mawthew bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkhia jong ki nongleit jingleit , bad ki jingthew jong ki nongleit jingleit , baroh arngut ki long kumjuh ki jingpynjah burom ia U Trai .

en: He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .
kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei ia ka Elat , bad u la pynphai biang ia ka ha Judah , hadien kata u syiem u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u .

en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iathuh ha ki khun Israel katba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .
kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka rupa ne da ka ksiar ban mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban thaw bad nga ia ki blei rupa , bad phin ym thaw ia phi ia ki blei ksiar .

en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them , as they were able to hear it .
kha: U Jisu u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki briew , u da pyndonkam shibun kiwei pat ki pharshi kum kine ; u la ïathuh shibun ïa ki kat kaba ki lah ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kiba bun ki pharshi u kren ia ka ktien ha ki , kumba ki la lah ban iohsngew ia ka .

en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah , city by city ,
kha: U thung ki nongbishar ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ba la tei kut jong ka Judah bad u bthah ïa ki :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki nongbishar ha ka ri baroh ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong jong ka Judah , ka shnong hadien ka shnong .

en: Where no oxen are , the crib is clean : but much increase is by the strength of the ox .
kha: Khlem ki masi kyrtong ban tan ïa ka lyngkor , ka lyngkha jong phi kan ym don ei ei , hynrei da ki yn pyndap shoiñ ïa ki thiar da u kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ym don masi , ka crib ka long kaba khuid: hynrei ka jingkiew kaba bun ka long da ka jingkhlain jong u masi .

en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory .
kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un mihpaw , da kaba wan ha ki lyoh ha ka bor bakhraw bad ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta kin iohi ia U Khun u briew uba wan ha ki lyoh da ka bor bad ka burom kaba khraw .

en: And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :
kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki lehbeiñ ïa ngi bad pyntrei jubor ïa ngi kum ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nong Ijipt ki la pynshitom bein ia ngi, bad ki la pynshitom ia ngi, bad ki la buh ia ngi ha ka jinglong mraw kaba jur:

en: Please rest assured that our priority is to address your concern as quickly as possible.
kha: Sngewbha sngewskhem ba ka jingthmu ba kongsan jong ngi ka long ban pynbeit kloi katba lah ïa ka jingeh jong phi.
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewbha sngewskhem ba ka jingthmu jong ngi ka long ban pynbeit kloi katba lah ia ka jingsngewkhia jong phi.

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his father Manasseh did .
kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Manasseh , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai kumba u kpa jong u u Manasseh u la leh .

en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place .
kha: Buh ïa ka jingtap halor ka Synduk Ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ka jaka shong jingisynei halor ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi ha ka jaka kaba khuid tam .

en: For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .
kha: Lada uno uno u mut ba u long ei ei haba da shisha um long ei ei , u long tang u nongshukor ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada u briew u pyrkhat ia lade ba u long kaei kaei, haba um long ei ei , u shukor ia lade .

en: Him therefore I hope to send presently , so soon as I shall see how it will go with me .
kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ban phah shen ïa u sha phi tang mar shu tip kumno kiei kiei kin long na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U namarkata nga kyrmen ban phah mynta, tang shu iohi kumno kan iaid bad nga .

en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .
kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop , A  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: To im mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, ko Trai: Ko Trai, nga kyrpad ia me, phah mynta ia ka jingroi jingpar .

en: And the stars of heaven shall fall , and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken .
kha: ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ïa ki bor ha ka haw haw yn pynkynriah noh na ki lynti ïaid jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khlur bneng kin hap , bad ki bor kiba don ha bneng kin khih .

en: For while one saith , I am of Paul ; and another , I am of Apollos ; are ye not carnal ?
kha: Haba uwei na phi u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ,  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos  — hato phim dang leh kum ki riewpyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba uwei u ong , nga long na u Paul ; bad uwei pat, nga long na u Apollos phim long uba don doh ?

en: Then said Martha unto Jesus , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
kha: Ka Martha ka la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men jin da la don hangne , ko Trai , u para jong nga un ym jin da la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka Martha ka la ong ha U Jisu, ko Trai, lada me la don hangne , u hynmen jong nga um shym la iap .

en: They think in terms of a democracy , which is not possible in a monetary based economy .
kha: Ki pyrkhat ha ka liang ka synshar paidbah , kaba ym lah ban long ha ka ioh ka kot kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pyrkhat ha ka liang ka synshar paidbah , kaba ym lah ban long ha ka ioh ka kot kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka pisa .

en: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?
kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei bad ba U Mynsiem U Blei u shong hapoh jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba phi long ka tempi U Blei bad ba U Mynsiem U Blei U shong ha phi ?

en: He built Eloth , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .
kha: ( Dei hadien ka jingïap jong u Amasaïah , ba u Ussaïah u la ïohknieh biang ïa ka Elath bad tei thymmai pat ïa ka nongbah . )
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei ia ka Eloth , bad u la pynphai biang ia ka ha Judah , hadien kata u syiem u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u .

en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Ngam shym phah ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki iathuhlypa bakla ia phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga: Ngam shym la phah ia ki , ong U Trai .

en: Having therefore , brethren , boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus ,
kha: Ngi don , namar kata , ko parabangeit jong nga ïa ka jinglaitluid ba-pura ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam da kata ka jingïap U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don namarkata, ko para bangeit , ka jingshlur ban rung sha ka jaka bakhuid tam da ka snam U Jisu .

en: But ye , brethren , are not in darkness , that that day should overtake you as a thief .
kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko parabangeit , phim long ha ka jingdum , bad ba ka Sngi kan lap kyndit ïa phi kum u nongtuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi ko para bangeit, phim don ha ka jingdum, ba kata ka sngi kan sa palat ia phi kum u nongtuh .

en: The wicked desireth the net of evil men : but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit .
kha: Baroh kaba ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah ka long ban wad ban leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew , hynrei kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bymman ki kwah ia ka net jong ki briew kiba sniew: hynrei ka tynrai jong kiba hok ka ai soh .

en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
kha: Harud ki wah ka Babilon ngi la shong ; hangta ngi ïam haba ngi kynmaw ïa ka Seïon .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki wah Babilon , hangta ngi la shong , hooid , ngi iam , haba ngi kynmaw ia ka Seion .

en: For we are labourers together with God : ye are God s husbandry , ye are Gods building .
kha: Naba ngi long ki nongïatrei lem bad U Blei , phi long ka lyngkha jong U Blei , phi long ruh ka jingtei jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ki nongtrei ryngkat bad U Blei: phi long ki nongrep jong U Blei, phi long ki Blei kiba tei .

en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi la iohsngew ia ka jingpynkylla ia ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la ai ha nga ha phi:

en: Upon observing the peace of wicked people , at first the psalmist felt bitter at heart .
kha: Haba u la peit ia ka jingsuk jong ki briew kiba sniew , ha kaba nyngkong u nongrwai salm u la sngewsih ha ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la iohi ia ka jingsuk jong ki briew kiba sniew, ha kaba nyngkong u nonglehkai u la sngewsih ha ka dohnud .

en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest , the next day they lightened the ship  ;
kha: Ka  erïong kaba jur ka la neh , kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la sdang ban bret noh katto katne ki jingkit kiba don ha ka lieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la shah pynkhih palat bad ka eriong , ha ka sngi kaba bud ki la pynshai ia ka lieng ; .

en: Singh claimed that Muslims who went to Ajmer prayed for return of BSP government in UP .
kha: U Singh u la kynnoh ba ki Muslim kiba leit sha Ajmer ki duwai ban wanphai biang ka sorkar BSP ha UP .
translated_en_to_kha: U Singh u la kam ba ki Muslim kiba leit sha Ajmer ki la duwai ban wan phai biang ka sorkar BSP ha UP .

en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead , and strengthened himself against Israel .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u long syiem hadien u Asa u kpa jong u , bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u , bad u la pynskhem ia lade pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: The state tourism department has already issued two notifications for land acquisition .
kha: Ka tnad jngohkai pyrthei jong ka jylla ka la dep pynmih ar tylli ki jingpynbna na ka bynta ban shim jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnad jngohkai pyrthei jong ka jylla ka la dep pynmih ar tylli ki jingpynbna na ka bynta ban shim jaka .

en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .
kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular U Blei la pynlong ha kine ki ktien :  Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pat , bad ka Sarah kan ïoh khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka ktien jong ka jingkular , Ha kane ka por ngan wan , bad ka Sara kan ioh khun shynrang .

en: We know that God spake unto Moses : as for this fellow , we know not from whence he is .
kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei u la kren ha u Moses ; katba ïa une u briew , te , ngim tip wat nangno u wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei u la kren ha u Moses: kumba long ia une u paralok , ngim tip naei u don .

en: All of them are being treated at the interim treatment centre at Dharga Town , he said .
kha: Kine baroh ki dang shah sumar ha ka jaka sumar shipor kaba don ha Dharga Town , u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki dang shah sumar ha ka jaka sumar ba shipor ha Dharga Town , u la ong .

en: I am the  Lord  your God  ; walk in my statutes , and keep my judgments , and do them  ;
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . To kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi; nga iaid ha ki ain jong nga, bad nga sumar ia ki jingbishar jong nga, bad nga leh ia ki;

en: And the manna was as coriander seed , and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium .
kha: ( Ka manna ka long kum ki symbai kiba rit bad kaba lam byrlieh stem ha ka rong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka manna ka long kum u symbai ba la khleh lang bad ka rong jong ka kum ka rong jong ka bdellium .

en: ' They started to pull my cupboard doors off and empty all my possessions on the floor .
kha: ’ Ki la sdang ban tan ia ki jingkhang jong ka almari jong nga bad pynthylli ia ki jingdon jingem jong nga baroh ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: ' Ki la sdang ban tan ia ki jingkhang jong ka almari jong nga bad ki la thylli lut ia ki jingdon jingem jong nga ha madan .

en: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :
kha: Dei namar kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei namar kata balei ba nga long kum nongïakura u bym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingkura jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga namarkata nga mareh kumta, ym kumba ym thikna;
