en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;
kha: U shah ïa ki briew kiba thngan ban shongduh hangta , bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta u pynlong ia kiba thngan ban shong , ba kin pynkhreh ia ka shnong na ka bynta ka jaka shong jaka sah ; .

en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth .
kha: U Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u la hukum ïa kita kiba ïeng hajan jong u Paul ban thab ïa u na ka shyntur .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah lyngdoh u la hukum ia kita kiba ieng hajan jong u ban shoh ia u ha ka shyntur .

en: There is one body , and one Spirit , even as ye are called in one hope of your calling ;
kha: Don tang kawei ka met bad uwei U Mynsiem , kumba don tang kawei ka jingkyrmen sha kaba U Blei u la khot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don kawei ka met bad uwei u Mynsiem , kumba la khot ia phi ha kawei ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingkhot jong phi .

en: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee : so will I destroy thy cities .
kha: Ngan pynpra phom ïa ki dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah ha ka ri jong phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kheit noh ia ki khlaw jong me na pdeng jong me: kumta ngan pynjot ia ki shnong jong me .

en: Behold , he taketh away , who can hinder him ? who will say unto him , What doest thou ?
kha: U shim kaei kaba u kwah , bad ym don ba lah ban khang ïa u . Ym don uba nud ban kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u shim noh ia u ? mano ba ong ia u , Me leh aiu ?

en: Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .
kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , ha kaba bam ne ha kaba dih , to leh phi ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: La phi bam ne dih ne leh ei ei ruh em ia ka burom U Blei .

en: RBI had restricted all the banks and financial institutions from using crypto currency .
kha: Ka RBI ka la khanglad ia baroh ki bank bad ki jaka ai pisa ban pyndonkam ia ka pisa crypto .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka RBI ka la khang ia baroh ki bank bad ki jaka ai pisa na kaba pyndonkam ia ka pisa crypto .

en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .
kha: Naba ngi tip ba haduh ka por ba mynta , ki jingthaw baroh ki ud da ka jingpang , kum ka jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi tip ba ka jingthaw baroh kawei ka iam bad ka iaid kai ha ka jingpang haduh mynta .

en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin don ha ka jaka tylliat kpu : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Arngut ki kynthei kin ia rkhie bein ha ka mill ; ia kawei yn shim , bad ia kawei pat sha kadiang .

en: And some of them that stood by , when they heard it , said , Behold , he calleth Elias .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  To sngap , u khot ïa u Elijah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na ki kiba ieng hajan, haba ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la ong: Ha khmih u khot ia u Elias .

en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities , and against the high towers .
kha: ka sngi kaba dap da ka jingsawa ki turoi thma bad ka jingpyrta-thma jong ki shipai kiba tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ïa ki kut bajrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi jong ka turoi bad ka alarm pyrshah ia ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong , bad pyrshah ia ki tower kiba jrong .

en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .
kha: To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka jingrwai leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane ka ktien kaba nga shim pyrshah ia phi, wat ka jingsngewsih ruh, ko iing Israel .

en: All this was done , that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying ,
kha: Kane ka la jia ban pynshisha ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kine baroh la leh , ba kan long kaba la kren da u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong:

en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
kha: U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka ong kumne . U briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Kumjuh ruh ka hima U Blei, kumba u briew u dei ban bret symbai ha ka khyndew ; .

en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang jong ka Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her kum ka thring .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ai ia ki bniat kiba bha ia ki blang ? lane ki bniat bad ki bniat sha ka bniat ?

en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Jared u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Enokh hynriew spah snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .
kha: Ki lah ban sawa sngewtynnat , hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang da ka jingisih .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u kren hok, wat ngeit ia u: namar ki don hynriew tylli ki jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant :
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynskhem ia kajuh ha u Jakob na ka bynta ka hukum , bad ha ki Israel na ka bynta ka jutang bymjukut:

en: And there was also a strife among them , which of them should be accounted the greatest .
kha: Ka jingïasaid nia ka la jia hapdeng ki synran ba ïa uno na ki yn ñiew ba u long uba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ruh ka jingialeh hapdeng jong ki , kaba na ki dei ban khein ia kaba khraw tam .

en: He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .
kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong kiba ïap . Phi la bakla shikatdei eh !
translated_en_to_kha: Um dei u Blei jong kiba iap , hynrei U Blei jong kiba im: phi namarkata phi bakla shibun .

en: He that planted the ear , shall he not hear ? he that formed the eye , shall he not see ?
kha: U Blei u la thaw ïa ki shkor jong ngi — hato un ym ïohsngew ? U la thaw ïa ki khmat jong ngi — hato un ym ïohi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la thung ia ka shkor , un ym iohsngew ? uta uba la thaw ia ka khmat , un ym iohi ?

en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye troubled ? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts ?
kha: Hynrei , u la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi ïasheptieng ? Balei ba kine ki jingartatien ki wan ha ki jingpyrkhat jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Balei phi sngewsih ? bad balei ki jingpyrkhat ki mih ha ki dohnud jong phi ?

en: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it .
kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingkit bakhia kiba U Blei u la buh halor jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ka jingtrei shitom kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki khun shynrang ban shah pyntreikam ha ka .

en: And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
kha: Bad hangta ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la iakynduh ia u ia ka kynthei kaba don ka jain kaba rit bad kaba rit mynsiem .

en: And he made the ephod of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
kha: Ki suh ki thain ïa ka ephod da ka jaiñ linen kaba ni ; da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; bad da u  sai ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka sniehdoh ksiar, rong saw bad rong saw bad rong saw bad rong saw .

en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .
kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synran ïa u ; kumta ka kynhun ka long kaba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta la leit shaneng bad u baroh arngut ki kali bad ki kulai: bad ka la long ka kynhun kaba khraw shibun .

en: Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;
kha: Ki ap ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kam wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jingtep ban ïa ka spah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba slem na ka bynta ka jingiap , hynrei kam wan shuh shuh bad ka tih na ka bynta jong ka kham palat ban ia ki spah ba la buhrieh shuh shuh .

en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city : the destruction of the poor is their poverty .
kha: Ka spah ka ïada ïa uba riewspah , ka jingduk ka pynjot ïa uba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah jong u briew uba riewspah ka long ka nongbah kaba skhem jong u: ka jingpynjot ia kiba duk ka long ka jingduk jong ki .

en: And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ynda u la long syiem katto katne por , u Joash u la kut jingmut ban shna pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kane , ba u Joash u la pyrkhat ban pynbha ia ka iing U Trai .

en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba im u dei ban long uba stad ; ka long kaba bha kum ka jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingïohpateng
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka long kaba bha bad ka pateng: bad da ka ka don ka jingmyntoi ia ki kiba iohi ia ka sngi .

en: Then they reviled him , and said , Thou art his disciple  ; but we are Moses  disciples .
kha: Ki la tim ïa u bad ki da ong ,  Me long u synran jong une u briew : Hynrei , ngi long ki synran u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la kren bein ia u, bad ki la ong, Me long u synran jong u ; hynrei ngi long ki synran jong u Moses .

en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
kha: Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthied ia ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta ka long na ki khun Heth .

en: And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .
kha: bad haba u smai da ka Templ , u smai da ka bad da U Blei , uba don hangta ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u la smai da ka tempi , u la smai da ka bad da uta uba shong hangta .

en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky , which is strong , and as a molten looking glass ?
kha: Hato me lah ban ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynpyiar ïa ka sahit bneng bad pynlong ïa ka kaba eh kum ka nar ba la pynphyrnai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me bad u me la pynphriang ia ka bneng kaba khlain bad kum ka glass kaba la tyrkhong ?

en: But thou hast not called upon me , O Jacob  ; but thou hast been weary of me , O Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hynrei phi la thait ïa nga , ko Israel ; phim shym la mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me khlem khot ia nga ko Jakob ; hynrei me la sngewsih ia nga ko Israel .

en: Unto whom David said , If thou passest on with me , then thou shalt be a burden unto me :
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Lada phi wan bad nga , kan ym ïarap ei ei ïa nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba u Dabid u la ong: Lada me iaid shakhmat bad nga, te me long ka jingkit ia nga:

en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth , and pitched in the wilderness of Paran .
kha: Nangta ki mihnoh na Haseroth bad ki pynïeng dara ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ki briew ki la leit noh na Haseroth bad ki la iaid ha ka ri khlaw Paran .

en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth , and the stock thereof die in the ground  ;
kha: Wat la ki thied jong u ki man tymmen noh , bad u dyngkhong jong u , u ïap ha ka khyndew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka tynrai jong ka ka la rim ha ka khyndew bad u dieng jong ka u iap ha ka khyndew;

en: " Let us not create a fear psychosis among people , " " the minister told the House . "
kha: " To ngin ym thaw ia ka jingsngew tieng hapdeng ki briew , " " u myntri u la ong ha ka iing dorbar . "
translated_en_to_kha: "Wat ai ba ngin thaw ia ka jingtieng hapdeng ki briew," u myntri u la ong ha ka iing dorbar ."

en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Ishmael ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isaak , u khun jong ka Sarah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sarah ka la iohi ia u khun jong u Hagar u nong Ijipt, uba ka la kha ha u Abraham, u da rkhie bein .

en: Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .
kha: To khie joit , ko Jerusalem bad tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ; ka burom ka jong U  Trai  ka tyngshaiñ ha phi !
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , to shai namar ka jingshai jong me ka wan , bad ka burom U Trai ka la kiew halor jong me .

en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :
kha: Bad kumta U Blei u phah ïa ka bor ka jingbakla ban trei ha ki khnang ba kin ngeit ïa kaei ka bymshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka daw kane U Blei un phah ia ki da ka jingpynbyrngia kaba khlain, ba kin ngeit ia ka jinglamler:

en: In the fifth day of the month , which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin s captivity ,
kha: ( Ka la long ka snem kaba san naduh ba la ringmraw ïa u syiem Jehoïakhin . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra jong u bnai , kaba long ka snem kaba phra jong u syiem Jehoichin .

en: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel :
kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha Ijipt bad ki ïalumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit bad ki la ialum lang ia ki rangbah Israel baroh:

en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock , upon the crag of the rock , and the strong place .
kha: U thaw ïa ka skum halor ki mawsiang kiba kynjang eh bad pynlong ka kut jong ka ïa ki kliar lum kiba nep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shong bad ka shong ha u mawsiang , halor u mawsiang bad ka jaka kaba skhem .

en: The preparations of the heart in man , and the answer of the tongue , is from the  Lord .
kha: Ngi lah ban don ki jingthmu , hynrei khatduh ka rai ka dei jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynkhreh ia ka dohnud ha u briew , bad ka jubab jong ka shyntur , ka long na U Trai .

en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .
kha: to long kiba sngewnguh ha kiei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh to ainguh: namar kane ka long ka mon U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu shaphang jong phi .

en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia me haba me wan rung , bad la tim ia me haba me mih noh .

en: One law and one manner shall be for you , and for the stranger that sojourneth with you .
kha: Kijuh ki aiñ bad kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ki long ïa phi bad ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka ain bad kawei ka rukom kan long na ka bynta jong phi , bad na ka bynta u nongwei uba sah bad phi .

en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen , the signs , and those great miracles :
kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki khlam kiba ishyrkhei , ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba khraw ba U  Trai  u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingpynshoi kiba khraw kiba ki khmat jong me ki la iohi, ki dak bad kita ki kambah kiba khraw:

en: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , ka por ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah ka la poi . Ha kata ka por ïa ka ri jong phi yn pynïar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi ba la tei ia ki kynroh jong me , ha kata ka sngi ka hukum kan long kaba jngai .

en: But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?
kha: Kumno ngin pynshitom ïa u ?  Phi ap khmih ïa ka kabu ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi dei ban ong , Balei ngi pynshitom ia u , haba ngi iohi ia ka tynrai jong ka kam la shem ha nga ?

en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil : the Lord reward him according to his works :
kha: U Aleksandar , u kamar-tama u la pyndik eh ïa nga ; U Trai un sa ainong ïa u kat kum ki kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Alexander u la leh ia nga kaba sniew shibun: U Trai u ai khusnam ia u kat kum ki kam jong u:

en: And to knowledge temperance  ; and to temperance patience  ; and to patience godliness  ;
kha: ha ka jingtip jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingsynshar ïa lade ; ha ka jingsynshar ïa lade pynlang ïa ka jingïaishah ; ha ka jingïaishah pynlang ïa ka jinglong riewblei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban tip ia ka jingsngewrit ; bad ban pynbeit ia ka jingshaniah ; bad ban iaishah ia ka jinglong blei;

en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju long kiba skhem , hynrei mynta u jynthut ; u kyllon — u shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingmut jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki step jong ka bor jong u kin long kiba jem , bad ka jingmut jong u hi kan pynhap ia u shapoh .

en: The lip of truth shall be established for ever : but a lying tongue is but for a moment .
kha: Ka jinglamler ka neh tang shipor , hynrei ka jingshisha ka neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lip jong ka jingshisha kan long kaba skhem junom: hynrei ka shyntur kaba thok ka long tang shiphang .

en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb , and by his strength he had power with God :
kha: U kpa tymmen jong ki u Jakob u la ïaleh ïa u hynmen synrap jong u , u Iso , katba baroh ar ngut ki dang don hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong ki ; haba u Jakob u la nang san , u ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei —
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia la u hynmen da ka kjat ha ka kpoh , bad da ka bor jong u u don ka bor bad U Blei :

en: Then the king arose very early in the morning , and went in haste unto the den of lions .
kha: Dang step phyrngab u syiem u la khie bad u la pynkloi sha ka thliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ieng dang step bha , bad u la leit rung kyrkieh sha ka thliew jong ki sing .

en: Why are thy valiant men swept away ? they stood not , because the  Lord  did drive them .
kha: Balei ba u Apis u blei bakhrawbor jong phi u kyllon ? U  Trai  u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ki briew kiba shlur jong me ki la shah rong noh ? kim shym la ieng , namar U Trai u la beh ia ki .

en: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;
kha: kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkyrmen ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei , u bym ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh mynnyngkong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingim bymjukut, kaba U Blei, uba ym lah ban thok, u la kular shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang;

en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , and make thereto a crown of gold round about .
kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla , bad pynpur da ka ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid , bad pynlong ia ka da ka khlieh ksiar sawdong .

en: And a maid saw him again , and began to say to them that stood by , This is one of them .
kha: Kata ka khynnah shakri ka la ïohi ïa u hangta bad ka la sdang ban ong biang kumjuh ha kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ,  U long uwei na ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u nongtrei u la iohi biang ia u, bad u la sdang ban ong ha ki kiba ieng hajan , Une u long uwei na ki .

en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?
kha: Hato phim tip ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki angel ? Katno tam , te , ïa kiei kiei ki jong kane ka jingim !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba ngin bishar ia ki angel ? katno kiei kiei kiba iadei bad kane ka jingim ?

en: The  Lord  hath made all things for himself : yea , even the wicked for the day of evil .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la thaw ki don la ki jingkut ; bad ka jingkut jong u bymman ka long ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leh ia kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta lade: hooid , wat ia kiba sniew na ka bynta ka sngi kaba sniew .

en: And it came to pass in the time of her travail , that , behold , twins were in her womb .
kha: Haba ka la dei por ïa ka ban kha , la shem ba kan sa kha khun synrap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por jong ka jingkha khun jong ka, ba, ha khmih, ki khun marwei ki la don ha ka kpoh jong ka .

en: But while men slept , his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat , and went his way .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet , haba baroh ki la ïohthiah , u nongshun u la wan bad u la bet ïa ki ñiut hapdeng u kew , bad u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba ki briew ki dang thiah , u nongshun jong u u la wan bad u la bet ia ki jaboh hapdeng u kew bad u la leit noh .

en: John answered and said , A man can receive nothing , except it be given him from heaven .
kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab ,  Ym don uno uno uba lah ban ïohpdiang ei ei lymda U Blei u ai ïa ka ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la jubab bad u la ong: U briew um lah ban ioh ei ei , lymda la ai ia u na bneng .

en: That thy trust may be in the  Lord  , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee .
kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ba phin buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha U  Trai  ; kata ka long balei ba nga ïai ïathuh ïa ki ha phi mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingshaniah jong me kan long ha U Trai , nga la pyntip ha me ha kane ka sngi , wat ha me ruh .

en: And she bare him Zimran , and Jokshan , and Medan , and Midian , and Ishbak , and Shuah .
kha: Ka la kha na u ïa u Simran , u Jokshan , u Medan , u Midian , u Ishbak , bad u Shuah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kha ia u Zimran, bad u Joksan, bad u Medan, bad u Midian, bad u Isbak, bad u Shuah .

en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .
kha: Weng noh ïa ki jingbymkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynmih ïa kaei kaei kaba itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka dewbilat na ka rupa , bad kan mih ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingsiew kaba kham bha .

en: Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
kha: Ngi la leh ïa kane , ym namar ba ngim don ka hok ban dawa jingkyrshan ïa ngi ; ngi la leh ïa ka , ban long ka nuksa na ka bynta jong phi ban bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym namar ba ngim don bor , hynrei ban pynlong ia lade kum ka nuksa ha phi ban bud ia ngi .

en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .
kha: Shisien ne ar sien ki nongkhaïi kiba die bun jait ki tiar ki pynlut ïa ka miet shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton shabar ki kynroh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki nongkhaii bad ki nongdie ia ki mar bapher bapher ki la sah khlem Jerusalem shisien ne arsien .

en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them .
kha: Ki nongbishar kiba pynshitom ïa uba shah pynrem , kin manbha bad kin ïoh ka nam babha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kito kiba pynrem ia u kin sngewbha , bad ka jingkyrkhu kaba bha kan wan ha ki .

en: For the  Lord  taketh pleasure in his people : he will beautify the meek with salvation .
kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingsngewbha ha ki briew jong u ; u pyndonburom ïa kiba sngewrit da ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u shim ia ka jingsngewbha ha ki briew jong u: un pynitynnad ia kiba jemnud da ka jingpynim .

en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
kha: Uta u briew u long uba sarong bad uba ïaleh pyrshah ; u bat ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u tap ia ka khmat jong u da ka jingkhluit jong u , bad u pynlong ia ki jingbam ba jem ha ki tyrpeng jong u .

en: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .
kha: Phin ym donkam ban khuslai ïa ka jingpynjot kaba wan kynsan , kum kaba wan ha ki riewbymman kum ka  erïong .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ka jingtieng kynsan , lymne ia ka jingpynjot ia kiba sniew haba ka wan .

en: And he said , I seek my brethren : tell me , I pray thee , where they feed their flocks .
kha: Nga wad ïa la ki hynmen shynrang , kiba ap sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri jong ki ,  u jubab .  Phi lah ban ïathuh hangno ki ïadon ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Nga wad ia ki hynmen jong nga: to iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, shano ki ai bam ia ki langbrot jong ki .

en: And he washed his face , and went out , and refrained himself , and said , Set on bread .
kha: Ynda u la dep bta khmat , u wan mih biang ; nangta da kaba pynjai jai ïa lade , u hukum ban sam ïa ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sait ia la ka khmat bad u la mih noh bad u la kyntait ia lade bad u la ong: To buh ia u kpu .

en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .
kha: Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa me da kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ba me kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong me hi ka pynrem ia me, bad ym ia nga: hooid, ki rmiang shyntur jong me hi ki sakhi pyrshah ia me .

en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps  ; as a prince would I go near unto him .
kha: Ngan ïathuh ha U Blei ïa baroh kaba nga la leh , bad ngan ïeng da kaba sngew shlur ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbna ha u ia ka jingbun ki step jong nga ; kum u syiem ngan leit shajan jong u .

en: For an odious woman when she is married  ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .
kha: ka kynthei kaba ijli kaba ïoh ban shongkurim , bad ka shakri haba ka ïoh ban shim ïa ka jaka ka kynrad jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kynthei kaba sngewsih haba ka la shongkurim bad ka nongtrei kti kaba long ka nongioh pateng ia ka jinglong kynthei jong ka .

en: Her granddaughter married a fine brother , and they too are serving as special pioneers .
kha: Ka khun ksiew jong ka ka la shongkurim ïa u hynmen uba bha , bad ma ki ruh ki shakri kum ki nongsdang ba kyrpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun ksiew jong ka ka la shongkurim ia u hynmen uba bha , bad ma ki ruh ki shakri kum ki nongsdang ba kyrpang .

en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phah bad ki la lum lang ha u ia ki rangbah Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

en: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod , of Ammon , and of Moab :
kha: Ha kata ka por , nga shem ruh ba bun na ki rangbah Jiw ki la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei na Ashdod , Ammon , bad Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi ruh nga la iohi ia ki Jiw kiba la shongkurim ia ki tnga jong u Ashdod , jong u Ammon bad jong u Moab:

en: Canst thou by searching find out God ? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection ?
kha: Hato me lah ban shem ïa ki pud ki sam jong ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban wad ia U Blei ? phi lah ban shem ia U Blei uba donbor haduh ka jinglong janai ?

en: Blessings are upon the head of the just : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
kha: U briew uba bha un ïoh jingkyrkhu . Ki ktien u riewbymman ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkyrkhu ki don ha ka khlieh jong kiba hok: hynrei ka jingleh donbor ka tap ia ka shyntur jong kiba sniew .

en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .
kha: Dei ma nga uba pynlong ïa ka , kaba bieit bad ngam shym ai ha ka ïa ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynduh ia ka jingstad jong ka , bad um shym la pynpaw ia ka jingsngewthuh jong ka .

en: The CBI in its affidavit said that probe into benami transactions was still in progress .
kha: Ka CBI ha ka jingpynbna jong ka ka la ong ba ka jingtohkit halor ki jingpyniaid benami ka dang iaid shakhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka CBI ha ka affidavit jong ka ka la ong ba ka probe sha ki jingpyniaid benami ka dang iaid shakhmat .

en: While on earth , Jesus fed the hungry , healed the sick , and restored life to the dead !
kha: Mynba u don ha ka pyrthei , u Jisu u la pynkdang ïa kiba thngan , pynkhiah ïa kiba pang bad pynmihpat ïa kiba la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang don ha ka pyrthei , U Jisu u la ai bam ia kiba thngan , u la pynkoit ia kiba pang bad u la pynphai biang ia ka jingim sha kiba iap !

en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .
kha: Mynmiet ki thiah khlem don ei ei ban tap nalor jong ki , kim don ei ei ban ïada na ka jingkhriat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynlong ia kiba lyngkhuid ban sah khlem jain , ba kim don jingtap ha ka jingkhriat .

en: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
kha: U bieit uba pyndonkam ïa ka jingong kaba stad u pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang u nongbuaid uba pyrshang ban phut ïa u shiah ha ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u thorn u leit sha ka kti jong u nongdih buaid , kumjuh ruh ka long ka pharshi ha ka shyntur jong ki bieit .

en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .
kha: Ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah kin plie baroh shi sngi ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lei , namar yn ym don ka miet hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki khyrdop jong ka kin ym khang satia ha ka sngi: namar kan ym don miet hangta .

en: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius , and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian .
kha: U Daniel u la manbha ha ka por ba u Darius u synshar bad ha ka jingsynshar jong u Syros u nong Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta une u Daniel u la roi ha ka jingsynshar u Darius bad ha ka jingsynshar u Seiros u Persia .

en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .
kha: Ym don jingthaw ba-im ba lah ban ïohi ïa ka , ym don , wat ka sim kaba her .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpeit ia ka ka la buhrieh na ki khmat jong ki jingim baroh , bad la buh hajan na ki sim jong ka Iyer .

en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed  ; for he giveth of his bread to the poor .
kha: To long sbun bad ïasam ïa ka jingbam jong phi bad kiba duk , phin long kiba la kyrkhu na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka khmat kaba jem un long uba la kyrkhu ; namar u ai ia u kpu jong u ha kiba duk .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When the whole earth rejoiceth , I will make thee desolate .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan sa pynlong ïa me ka ri kaba kynjah katta katta ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan shadkmen namar ka jingkyllon jong me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei ; Haba ka khyndew baroh kawei kan kmen , ngan pynlong ia me ban jah rngai noh .

en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , U Blei u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta U Blei u la buh ia ki dkhot uwei pa uwei ha ka met kumba ka la pynsngewbha ia u .

en: Mika , Richa and Navraj Hans sang for their good friend Kapil while he played the drums .
kha: U Mika , u Richa bad u Navraj Hans ki rwai na ka bynta u paralok babha jong ki u Kapil katba u dang tem tyndong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mika , u Richa bad u Navraj Hans ki rwai na ka bynta u paralok babha jong ki u Kapil katba u dang ialehkai ia ki drum .

en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .
kha: U tei ka templ ïa u Baal ha Samaria , u shna ka duwan na ka bynta jong u bad u buh ïa ka ha ka templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynmih ia ka jingknia na ka bynta u Baal ha ka iing u Baal kaba u la tei ha Samaria .

en: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour , which is Christ the Lord .
kha: Ha kane ka sngi ha ka shnong u Dabid la kha ïa U Nongpynim jong phi — U Khrist U Trai !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha phi la kha ia u Khrist U Trai .

en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .
kha: Haba shah khñiot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khñiot , hynrei ka jingurlong jong ka jingkhmih lynti ka pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrmen ka pynsngewsih ia ka dohnud: hynrei haba ka jingkwah ka wan , ka long u dieng jong ka jingim .

en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra phin don ka jingiaseng kaba pura: phin ym leh ei ei ha kata:

en: And Michal Saul s daughter loved David : and they told Saul , and the thing pleased him .
kha: Ka Mikhal ka khun u Saul pynban ka ïapmat ïa u Dabid , bad haba u Saul u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun jong u Michal ka la ieit ia u Dabid : bad ki la iathuh ha u Saul bad kata ka la pynsngewbha ia u .

en: My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :
kha: Ko khun jong nga , haba U  Trai  u pynbeit ïa phi , da shahshkor bha , bad shim ïa ka kum ka jingmaham .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun jong nga, wat nym sngewthuh ia ka jingpynbeit ia U Trai ; wat nym sngewsih ia ka jingpynbeit jong u:

en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )
kha: ( Ïa u Barabbas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin kaba lah jia ha ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )
translated_en_to_kha: ( Uba na ka bynta kawei ka jingpynkylla kaba la leh ha ka nongbah , bad na ka bynta ka jingpyniap briew , la bret ha phatok . )

en: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Kishion , ka Daberath ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jait Issakhar , u Kishon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka , ka Dabera bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka .

en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the  Lord  , and he pondereth all his goings .
kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa baroh kaba phi leh , kat shaba phi leit , u peit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki lynti jong u briew ki don ha khmat U Trai , bad u pyrkhat ia ki jingleit jong u baroh .

en: Lest they drink , and forget the law , and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted .
kha: haba ki dih , ki klet noh ïa ki aiñ bad ki lyndet noh ïa ki hok jong ki briew kiba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ba kin dih , bad kin klet ia ka hukum , bad kin pynkylla ia ka jingbishar jong uno uno na kiba shah pynshitom .

en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad phin im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïap shuwa ka por jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka pynjlan ia ki sngi: hynrei ki snem jong kiba sniew kin sa lyngkot .

en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .
kha: U briew u bym shem ïa nga u pynmong ïa lade ; kat uba isih ïa nga u ieit ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba leh pop pyrshah ia nga u pynsniew ia la ka jong ka mynsiem: baroh kiba shun ia nga ki ieit ia ka jingiap .

en: Ye shall not go after other gods , of the gods of the people which are round about you  ;
kha: Wat mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ïa kino kino ki blei jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leit bud ia kiwei pat ki blei , na ki blei jong ki briew kiba don sawdong sawdong jong phi;

en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .
kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki kulmar lut — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia ka kynjri: namar ka ri ka dap da ki kam runar kiba snam , bad ka nongbah ka dap da ka jingleh donbor .

en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens  ; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent .
kha: Ka dei ka jingpyrsad jong u kaba pynkhuid ïa ka suiñbneng , bad dei ka kti jong u kaba pynïap ïa u mrad kynsha uba ïaleh ban phet .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka mynsiem jong u u la pynkhih ia ki bneng ; ka kti jong u ka la pynlong ia u bsein uba la tyrkhong .

en: Thousands of years of human history tell us that there has been more and more suffering .
kha: Da ki hajar snem , ka Histori u bynriew ka iathuh ia ngi ba ka la don khambun shuhshuh ki jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki hajar snem jong ka histori jong u briew ki iathuh ia ngi ba ka la nang bun ka jingjynjar .

en: And his disciples came , and took up the body , and buried it , and went and told Jesus .
kha: Ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïawan , ki la bah ïa ka met jong u , bad ki la tep ïa ka ; nangta ki la leit bad ïathuh ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la wan, bad ki la shim ia ka met bad ki la tep ia ka bad ki la leit iathuh ha U Jisu .

en: And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .
kha: Mynta nga long kum u ban sa ïap noh ; ym don jinglait na ka jingjynjar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka la tuid halor jong nga ; ki sngi jong ka jingjynjar ki la bat ia nga .

en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki ksing bad ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia u da ka timbrel bad ka shad: iaroh ia u da ki tiar bad ki dkhot met kiba jrong .

en: He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again .
kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U kwah eh ban wanrah biang ia kito kiba don ha ka jingkynmaw jong u bad ban iohi ia ki ba kin im biang ha ka pyrthei .

en: But some of them said , He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils .
kha: hynrei katto katne ngut na u paidbah ki la ong ,  U dei u Beelsebul , u rangbah jong ki ksuid , uba la ai ha U ïa ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don napdeng jong ki kiba ong: U beh noh ia ki ksuid lyngba u Belzebul u rangbah jong ki ksuid .

en: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .
kha: Ïa baroh yn pynkhuid da ka ding kumba ïa ka jingkñia la pynkhuid da ka mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei un shah pynsngem da ka ding , bad kawei pa kawei ka jingknia kan sa shah pynsngem da ka umsoh .

en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
kha: Ki briew kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbeit kin ïoh im , hynrei kito ki bym pdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: U don ha ka lynti jong ka jingim uba bat ia ka jinghikai: hynrei uta uba kyntait u bakla .

en: The Governor also explained to MPs the impact of Brexit on India and the global economy .
kha: U Lat u la batai ruh sha ki MP ia ka jingktah jong ka Brexit ia ka India bad ia ka ioh ka kot jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lat ka jylla u la batai ruh sha ki MP ia ka jingktah jong ka Brexit ha India bad ka ioh ka kot jong ka pyrthei .

en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer , but destruction cometh  ; it cometh out of the north .
kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kum ka masi baphylla , ba la tur ïaleh da u skain ba kynthah na shatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kum ka masi kaba itynnad bha, hynrei ka jingpynjot ka wan ; ka wan na shaphang shathie .

en: And he said unto them ,  This is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la pynmih na ka bynta kiba bun , ka snam jong nga kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kane ka long ka snam jong nga jong ka jutang bathymmai kaba la pynmih na ka bynta kiba bun .

en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .
kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . To sngap ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to iohsngew ha bneng ia ka jingduwai jong ki bad ka jingkyrpad jong ki , bad pynneh ia ka daw jong ki .

en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption , and this mortal must put on immortality .
kha: Na kane u ba lalot rahah hab ban buh ha ka jing bymlalot , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap ka dei ban kylla sha kaei ka bym dei ban ïap shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingbam ka dei ban buh ha ka jingbym lah ban pyut , bad une u briew uba iap u dei ban buh ha ka jingbym lah iap .

en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathuh hano hano ba u long U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kynnoh ia ki synran jong u ba kim dei ban iathuh iano iano ruh ba u long U Jisu U Khrist .

en: Then went out to him Jerusalem , and all Judaea , and all the region round about Jordan ,
kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha u na Jerusalem , na ka probins    baroh kawei jong ka Judia bad na kylleng ka ri kaba hajan ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit sha u Jerusalem bad ka Judaea baroh kawei bad ka thain baroh sawdong ka Jordan .

en: He is not here : for he is risen , as he said . Come , see the place where the Lord lay .
kha: Um don hangne ; la pynmihpat ïa u , kumba u la ong . Ale hangne bad peit ïa ka jaka ha kaba u la thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Um don hangne : namar u la mihpat kumba u la ong . To wan, peit ia ka jaka ba U Trai u thiah .

en: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee .
kha: Nga tip , A  Trai  , ba me long uba khrawbor tam ; ba me lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ba me lah ban leh ia kiei kiei baroh, bad ba ym lah ban bat ia ka jingpyrkhat na me .

en: And the servant said , Lord , it is done as thou hast commanded , and yet there is room .
kha: Shen shen u shakri u la ong , ‘ La pyndep ïa ka hukum jong me , ko kynrad , hynrei dang don jaka na ka bynta kiba bun .’
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la ong, ko Trai, la leh kumba me la hukum, bad wat la katta ruh ka don ka jaka .

en: The liberal soul shall be made fat : and he that watereth shall be watered also himself .
kha: Long kiba sbun , bad phin manbha . Ïarap ïa kiwei , bad yn ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem kaba laitluid kan long kaba heh: bad uta uba ai um ruh un shah pynsleh um hi .

en: And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .
kha: Pynïeng ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka khyrdop jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ka iingbishar sawdong , bad pynsangeh ia ka jingsahkut ha ka khyrdop jong ka iingbishar .

en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge  ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .
kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki long borabor kiba thrang bad ba kloi ban shah hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u riewstad ka ioh ia ka jingtip ; bad ka shkor jong u riewstad ka wad ia ka jingtip .

en: A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha ïa ki briew kiba bha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kiba thmu sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha u ioh ia ka jingsngewbha jong U Trai: hynrei u briew uba sniew un pynrem .

en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .
kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la sop da ka rnong , bad u kieng ïa u sum rnong ba tawah ha ka tyrpeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u don ki jingbam nar ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka thong nar hapdeng ki tyrpeng jong u .

en: The king s wrath is as the roaring of a lion  ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .
kha: Ka jingbitar u syiem ka long kum ka jingkyrhuh u sing , hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum u slap ba pdiang hun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar jong u syiem ka long kum ka jingsawa jong u sing ; hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum ka dew ha u phlang .

en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again :
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Uno uno uba dih na kane ka um un sliang pat , hynrei uno uno uba dih na ka um kaba ngan ai ha u un ym sliang shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka: Uno uno uba dih ia kane ka um un sliang biang:

en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency  ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .
kha: Lada ka long kumta , to ïeng ha la ka burom bad ka jingsarong ; kup ïa lade da ka jingitynnat bad ka burom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia lade mynta da ka jinglong rangbah bad ka jingbhabriew ; bad pynbeit ia lade da ka burom bad ka jingitynnad .

en: He openeth also their ear to discipline , and commandeth that they return from iniquity .
kha: U pynlong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka jingmaham jong u , ban phai noh na ka jingbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: U plie ruh ia ka shkor jong ki ban shah hikai , bad u hukum ba kin leit phai noh na ka jingbymhok .

en: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .
kha: Haba u Judah u ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la kah ïa la ka durkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Judah u la iohi ia ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka long ka nongkhaii met ; namar ba ka la tap ia ka khmat jong ka .

en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean  ;
kha: Me dei ban pynïapher ïa kata kaba long ka jong U  Trai  na kata kaba lah ban pyndonkam paidbah , ïa kata kaba khuid na kata ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba phin buh ia ka jingiapher hapdeng kaba khuid bad kaba khlem khuid, bad hapdeng kaba khlem khuid bad kaba khuid;

en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .
kha: Nga tip me la rah ïa nga sha ka jingïap , sha ka kupar ba la buh ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba men pyniap ia nga, bad ha ka iing kaba la buh na ka bynta baroh kiba im .

en: These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
kha: Hangne ki don shuh ki proberb u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki briew ha ka ïingbishar u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ruh ki long ki proberb jong u Solomon , kiba ki briew jong u Hesekaiah syiem Judah ki la copy .

en: The  Lord  killeth , and maketh alive : he bringeth down to the grave , and bringeth up .
kha: U  Trai  u pynïap bad u pynim pat ; u pynhiar ïa ki briew sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , bad u pynkiew pat ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u pyniap , bad u pynim: u pynhiar sha ka jingtep , bad u pynmih .

en: And a certain centurion s servant , who was dear unto him , was sick , and ready to die .
kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam ka hima Rom uba hangta , u la don u shakri uba u ieit eh ; uta u briew u la pang bad u la jan ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u shakri uba la shah shitom ha u, u la pang bad u la kloi ban iap .

en: How then can man be justified with God ? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman ?
kha: Hato don mano mano uba lah ban long uba hok bad uba khuid ha khmat U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno te u briew u lah ban long uba hok bad U Blei ? lane kumno u lah ban long uba khuid uba la kha na ka kynthei ?

en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki jingmut jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kim long kum ki jong phi , bad ki lynti jong nga ki ïapher na ki jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki jingpyrkhat jong nga kim long ki jingpyrkhat jong phi, lymne ki lynti jong phi kim long ki lynti jong nga , ong U Trai .

en: We looked for peace , but no good came  ; and for a time of health , and behold trouble !
kha: Ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka por ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ; ka jingtriem ka wan pynban .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi wad ia ka jingsuk , hynrei ym shym la wan ei ei bad na ka bynta ka por jong ka koit ka khiah , bad ha khmih ka jingeh !

en: Our system shows the item has been delivered. Could you confirm or provide clarification?
kha: Ka system jong ngi ka pyni ba la dep pynpoi ïa ka mar. Hato phi lah ban pynthikna ne ai jingshai?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka system jong ngi ka pyni ia ka mar. Hato phi lah ban pynskhem ne ai jingshai?

en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust , and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks .
kha: Bret noh ïa ka ksiar jong phi , tep ïa ka ksiar babha tam jong phi ha ka phud jong ka wahduid ba la rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to buh ia ka ksiar kum ka dewbilat bad ka ksiar jong u Ophir kum ki maw jong ki wah .

en: And look that thou make them after their pattern , which was shewed thee in the mount .
kha: Da kitkhia ba men thaw ïa ki kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me ha une u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad peit ba me pynlong ia ki katkum ka dur jong ki, kaba la pyni ia me ha u lum .

en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .
kha: U angel U Blei u la kren ïa nga ha ka jingphohsniew bad u ong , ‘ Jakob !’ ‘ Oi’ nga la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Blei u la kren ha nga ha ka jingphohsniew, u da ong: U Jakob: Bad nga la ong: Hangne nga don .

en: For these be the days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .
kha: Naba kito kin long ‘ Ki Sngi ka Jingpynshitom ,’ ban pynlong ïa baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ban urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kine ki long ki sngi jong ka jingsiew kylliang , ba kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh kin long kiba la pyndep .

en: How long wilt thou not depart from me , nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?
kha: Balei mem shu phai noh shawei tang shipor , ba ngan ïoh nguid ïa la ka umbiah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por phin ym leit noh na nga , lymne wat iehnoh ia nga marwei haduh ba ngan da sngap jar ia nga ?

en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee :
kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  I pa jong phi bad ki hynmen ki para jong phi ki la wan sha phi , ka ri Ijipt ka long ka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la kren ha u Joseph, u da ong: U kpa jong me bad ki hynmen jong me ki wan sha me:

en: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
kha: Lada nga leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka mut ba ngam long shuh uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada nga leh ia kata ngam shym la leh shuh ia kata, hynrei ka pop kaba shong ha nga .

en: For the  Lord  is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba dei eh ban ïaroh ; u long uba dei ban shah pyndonburom kham palat ïa ki blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u long uba khraw , bad uba dei ban iaroh shibun: u dei ban tieng halor ki blei baroh .

en: But he knoweth the way that I take : when he hath tried me , I shall come forth as gold .
kha: Pynban U Blei u tip ïa ka jingjam baroh kaba nga shim ; lada u tynjuh ïa nga , un shem ba nga long khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u tip ia ka lynti kaba nga shim: haba u la tynjuh ia nga , ngan sa wan mih kum ka ksiar .

en: And Jacob said unto them , My brethren , whence be ye ? And they said , Of Haran are we .
kha: U Jakob u kylli ïa ki nongap langbrot ,  Ko paralok , phi dei kiba na-ei ?   Na Haran ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha ki, ko para jong nga, naei phi long ? Ki la ong: Na Haran ngi long .

en: Brethren , my heart s desire and prayer to God for Israel is , that they might be saved .
kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga , katno nga kwah da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ba ki briew jong nga hi kin long ïa kiba la pynim ! Katno nga duwai ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit, ka jingkwah bad jingduwai jong nga ha U Blei na ka bynta ki Israel ka long , ba kin ioh jingpynim .

en: Then came also publicans to be baptized , and said unto him , Master , what shall we do ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonglum khajna ki la wan ban shah pynbaptis , bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko nonghikai , kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan ruh ban shah pynbaptis, bad ki la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, ngi dei ban leh aiu ?

en: Wherefore will ye plead with me ? ye all have transgressed against me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Kaei ka jingujor jong pha ? Balei pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei phin kyrpad ia nga ? phi baroh phi la iaid lait ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .
kha: Kumta ki la leit kloi bad ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan ryngkat bad ka Maria bad u Joseph bad u khunlung ba la thiah ha ka jaka ri jingri .

en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .
kha: Kumta nga la leit hangta bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw khiew ba u trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la leit sha ka iing jong u nongthaw khiew, bad, ha khmih, u la leh ia ka kam ha ki tyrpeng .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .
kha: Phim dei ban ong ïa nga ïa kaei ba ngan leh ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Ka por jong nga kam pat poi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ka, Ko kynthei, nga don jingiadei bad me ? ka por jong nga kam pat poi .

en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat treikam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew phin don ka jingiaseng kaba khuid ; phin ym leh ei ei kaba rit .

en: Behold , I go forward , but he is not there  ; and backward , but I cannot perceive him :
kha: Nga la wad shaphang mihngi , hynrei U Blei um don hangta ; ngam shym la shem ïa u haba nga wad shaphang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga leit sha khmat , hynrei um don hangta ; bad shadien , hynrei ngam lah ban sngewthuh ia u:

en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds , and with every leader .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ïamir jingmut bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam baroh jong ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid u la iamir jingmut bad ki rangbah shihajar bad spah ngut ki rangbah .

en: And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .
kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ngi ban ïabam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u Petros bad u Ioannis, u da ong: To leit pynkhreh ia ngi ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait im .

en: Knowing this first , that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation .
kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , namarkata , to kynmaw ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai da lade ïa ka jingïathuhlypa ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ia kane nyngkong , ba ym don ka jingiathuhlypa jong ka jingthoh ka long jong kano kano ka jingbatai shimet .

en: A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty  ; but a fool s wrath is heavier than them both .
kha: Ka jingkhia u maw bad u shyiap kam long ei ei ban haba ïanujor bad ka jingjynjar kaba uba mutlop u lah ban pynjia .
translated_en_to_kha: U maw u long uba heh , bad ka dewbilat ka kham heh; hynrei ka jingbitar kaba bieit ka kham heh ban ia ki baroh arngut .

en: Wherefore the well was called Beer–lahai–roi  ; behold , it is between Kadesh and Bered .
kha: Dei namar kata ba ki briew ki khot kyrteng ïa ka pukri hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Bered  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata la khot ia ka thliew Beerlahairoi ; ha khmih, ka don hapdeng u Kadesh bad u Bered .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord  from the heavens : praise him in the heights .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na bneng , phi kiba im ha ki jaka bakynjang shajrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . Iaroh ia U Trai na bneng: iaroh ia u ha ki jingjrong .

en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :
kha: Nga la thngan , hynrei phim shym bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang , hynrei phim shym ai jingdih ïa nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la thngan, bad phim shym la ai jingbam ia nga: Nga la sliang, bad phim shym la ai jingdih ia nga:

en: Neither murmur ye , as some of them also murmured , and were destroyed of the destroyer .
kha: Ngim dei ban khñium , kumba don na ki , kiba la khñium — bad la pynjot ïa ki da u Angel ka Jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim ju sngap jar ia phi, kumba don napdeng jong ki ruh kiba la sngap jar bad ki la shah pynjot noh na u nongpynjot .

en: The city of confusion is broken down : every house is shut up , that no man may come in .
kha: Ha ka nongbah , baroh kiei kiei ki long ha ka jingkulmar , bad ki briew ki la setkut ïa lade ha ki ïing jong ki ban shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shnong jong ka jingkulmar ka la jot: kawei pa kawei ka iing ka la khang , ba ym don briew uba lah ban wan rung .

en: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old  ; and his eyes were dim , that he could not see .
kha: ( Ha kata ka por u Eli u la dap khyndaiphew phra snem bad u la jan matlah ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Eli u la dap hynniewphew snem bad ki khmat jong u ki la tyrkhong , ba um lah ban iohi .

en: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?
kha: Nga long hok , A Blei . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jong nga . Ym don mano mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To thiah mynta, to buh ia nga ha ka jingshisha bad me ; mano ba un ia tyngkhuh bad nga ?

en: That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .
kha: Me ai ïa ka ha ki , bad ki bam ïa ka , me pynbiang jingbam , bad ki sngewhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me ai ia ki ba ki lum: me plie ia ka kti jong me, ki dap da ka jingbha .

en: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?
kha: Hato ki para kynthei jong u baroh kim shong kim sah hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki para kynthei jong u , hato kim don baroh bad ngi ? Naei une u briew u don ia kine kiei kiei baroh ?

en: So , as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .
kha: Kumta te , nga kwah hir hir ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi ruh kiba shong ha Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumba nga long ha nga , nga long uba kloi ban ialap ia ka gospel ha phi kiba don ha Rome ruh .

en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai U Blei jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u , La ong ia u , Wat ju tynjuh ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .
kha: Ka Bethania ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad shibun ki nong Judia ki la wan ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ban pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u para jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki Jiw ki la wan sha Martha bad ka Maria , ban pyntngen ia ki shaphang u hynmen jong ki .

en: Fear before him , all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .
kha: to kyiuh ha khmat jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah pynkhih shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ha khmat jong u, ka pyrthei baroh kawei: ka pyrthei ruh kan long kaba skhem , ba kan ym khih .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno shuh phi ki briew phin dang kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Katno por phi kyntait ban sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad ki ain jong nga ?

en: And Saul s servants said unto him , Behold now , an evil spirit from God troubleth thee .
kha: Ki shakri jong u ki ong ha u ,  Ngi tip ba u mynsiem bymman ba la phah U Blei u pynjynjar ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Saul ki la ong ha u, Ha khmih mynta, ka mynsiem kaba sniew na U Blei ka pynshitom ia me .

en: Hezekiah also had said , What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the  Lord  ?
kha: Te u syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba nga lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah ruh u la ong , Kaei ka dak ba ngan leit sha ka iing U Trai ?

en: The bows of the mighty men are broken , and they that stumbled are girded with strength .
kha: Ïa ki ryntieh jong ki shipai kiba khlaiñ la pynkheiñ , hynrei kiba tlot ki ïohbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tyrpeng jong ki briew kiba khlain bor ki la tyrkhong , bad kita kiba la tyrkhong ki la tyrkhong da ka bor .

en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .
kha: Lada phi dei ki jong U Khrist , te , phi long ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi long U Khrist, te phi long u symbai jong u Abraham, bad ki nongioh pateng kat kum ka jingkular .

en: And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?
kha: U Abraham u wan hajan U  Trai  , bad u kylli ,  Hato men shu pynjot noh ïa kiba hok ruh ryngkat bad ki bymman ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la wan hajan bad u la ong: Hato me ruh phin pynjot ia kiba hok bad kiba sniew ?

en: Thinkest thou this to be right , that thou saidst , My righteousness is more than God s ?
kha: Kam long kaba dei , ko Job , na ka bynta jong me ban ong ba me long uba lui lui ha khmat U Blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phi pyrkhat ia kane ban long kaba dei , ba phi ong , Ka hok jong nga ka kham palat ia U Blei ?

en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .
kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki khun synrap shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ka ban kha khun , ha khmih , ki don ki khun marwei ha ka kpoh jong ka .

en: They shall perish  ; but thou remainest  ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment  ;
kha: Kita kin jah noh , hynrei me men ïaisah ; baroh kin sa jot noh kum ki jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa jah noh ; hynrei me sah ; bad baroh kin sa tymmen kumba ka jain ; .

en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;
kha: U la long uba khuid bad uba bha , hynrei phi la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la kyntait ia Uba khuid bad Uba hok , bad phi kwah ia u nongpyniap briew ban shah ai ha phi ; .

en: Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
kha: Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Templ ban duwai : Uwei u la long u Pharisi , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .
translated_en_to_kha: Arngut ki briew ki la leit shapoh ka tempi ban duwai; uwei pat u Pharisi .

en: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ , he sent two of his disciples ,
kha: Haba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la ïohsngew hapoh ïingbyndi shaphang kiei kiei kiba U Khrist u la leh , u la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Ioannis u la iohsngew ha phatok ia ki kam U Khrist , u la phah arngut ki synran jong u .

en: Go forth of the ark , thou , and thy wife , and thy sons , and thy sons  wives with thee .
kha: Khie ïamihnoh na kato ka lieng bad la ka tnga , ki khun shynrang jong me lem bad ki tnga jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To mih noh na ka lieng, ma me bad ka tnga jong me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me .

en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ïa ki thiar jong phi yn pyndap da u kew , bad phin ïoh ruh shibun bha ka waiñ haduh ba phim lah shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki phyllaw jong me kin dap da ka jingbun, bad ki jingkhluit jong me kin bthei da ka wain thymmai .

en: And they called the name of that place Bochim : and they sacrificed there unto the  Lord .
kha: bad dei namar kata keiñ ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Bokhim . Hangta ki la ai jingkñia ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka u Bochim : bad ki la knia hangta ha U Trai .

en: Give none offence , neither to the Jews , nor to the Gentiles , nor to the church of God .
kha: To im ha kata ka rukom ban ym thaw jingeh ïa ki Jiw ne ïa ki Jentil ne ïa ka balang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai jingmut ei ei ia ki Jiw ne ia ki Jutang ne ia ka balang U Blei .

en: As at the report concerning Egypt , so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre .
kha: Wat ki nong Ijipt kin kyndit bad khuslai haba ki tip ba ïa ka Tyros la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba long ha ka kaiphod kaba iadei bad ka ri Ijipt , kumta kin sa sngewsih shibun eh ia ka kaiphod jong u Tyros .

en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .
kha: Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shong bad ki ban bam bad dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leit ruh shapoh iing bam , ban shong bad ki ban bam bad ban dih .

en: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .
kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah bad jingñiewkor na kiwei lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba bha ; lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba sniew , phi leh ïa kaba bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kim ju bakla kiba thmu ia ka jingsniew ? hynrei ka jingisynei bad ka jingshisha kan long ha kito kiba thmu ia ka jingbha .

en: And when the  Lord  saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba ka jingieit ka kham duna ïa ka Leah ban ïa ka Rakhel , u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun , hynrei ka Rakhel ka ïailong kaba khlem khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai u la iohi ba ka Leah ka la shah shun , u la plie ia ka kpoh jong ka: hynrei ka Rakhel ka la kha khun .

en: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .
kha: kiba la paw ha ka burom ba kynja bneng bad ki la ïakren bad U Jisu shaphang ka rukom ha kaba shen un sa pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei da kaba ïap ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la paw ha ka burom , bad u la kren shaphang ka jingiap jong u kaba u dei ban pyndep ha Jerusalem .

en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony , that they come up out of Jordan .
kha: ban hukum ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ban wan kiew noh na ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi , ba kin mih na Jordan .

en: Behold , my belly is as wine which hath no vent  ; it is ready to burst like new bottles .
kha: Lada ngam ïoh ïa ka lad ban kren , ngan sa bthei kum ka lwa snieh kaba dap da ka waiñ bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka kpoh jong nga ka long kum ka wain kaba khlem vent ; ka long kaba la pynkhreh ban bthei kum ki bilor thymmai .

en: For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .
kha: Ngam nang kumno ban pynroh , bad U Blei shen un pynshitom ïa nga lada nga leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ban ym ai ia ki kyrteng kiba sngewtynnad ; ha kaba leh kumta u nongshna jong nga un sa shim noh shen ia nga .

en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night .
kha: Naba phi hi da lade phi tip bha ba ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi tip pura ba ka sngi U Trai ka wan kum u nongtuh ha ka miet .

en: Where is the way where light dwelleth ? and as for darkness , where is the place thereof ,
kha: Hato me tip na-ei ka jingshai ka wan lane kaei ka tyllong jong ka jingdum ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ka lynti ha kaba ka jingshai ka shong ? bad katba ia ka jingdum , shano ka jaka jong ka , .

en: And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .
kha: Nangta phan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh . Phan ym tap ïa la ki khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin leh kumba nga la leh: phin ym tap ia ki rmiang shyntur jong phi , lymne bam ia u kpu jong ki briew .

en: Even a child is known by his doings , whether his work be pure , and whether it be right .
kha: Wat u khynnah u pynpaw ïa kaei kaba u long da kaei kaba u leh ; phi lah ban ong lada u long uba hok bad uba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia u khynnah ruh la tip da ki jingleh jong u, ka kam jong u ka long kaba khuid , bad la ka long kaba dei ne em .

en: Today , Jehovah is preparing millions of people for life in the future Paradise on earth .
kha: Mynta ruh U Jehobah u dang ïai pynkhreh da ki phew lak ngut ki briew ban ïoh im ha paradais .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka sngi , U Jehobah u pynkhreh da ki million ngut ki briew na ka bynta ka jingim ha ka lawei ka Paradais ha ka pyrthei .

en: Give to him that asketh thee , and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away .
kha: Haba uno uno u pan ei ei na phi , to ai ïa kata ha u ; haba uno uno u kwah ban pan kylliang ei ei na phi , to ai kylliang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha uta uba kylli ia me bad na uta uba kwah ban shim ram na me wat phai noh ia me .

en: And the evil spirit answered and said , Jesus I know , and Paul I know  ; but who are ye ?
kha: Hynrei u mynsiem bymman u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ithuh ïa U Jisu , bad nga tip shaphang u Paul ; hynrei ma phi — phi dei kiei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U mynsiem bymman u la jubab bad u la ong, Jisu nga tip, bad u Paul nga tip ; hynrei phi long mano ?

en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth : I came not to send peace , but a sword .
kha: Wat mut ba nga la wan ban wanrah ka jingsuk sha ka pyrthei . Em , ngam shym la wanrah ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ka waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga wan ban phah ia ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei : Ngam shym la wan ban phah ia ka jingsuk , hynrei ka waitlam .

en: Rishabh Pant was set but threw away his wicket when he attacked spinner Mitchell Santner .
kha: U Rishabh Pant u la set hynrei u la bret noh ia ka wiket haba u la thombor ia u spinner u Mitchell Santner .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rishabh Pant u la shah set hynrei u la bret noh ia ka wiket jong u haba u la hiar thma ia u Mitchell Santner .

en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
kha: Kim dondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba sniew, ka kam jong ki jingbakla: ha ka por jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki kin sa jah noh .

en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva , a Jew , and chief of the priests , which did so .
kha: Ki hynñiew ngut ki shynrang kiba shi para , kiba long ki khun jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Skeba , ki la leh ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang jong uwei u Sceva , u Jiw bad u rangbah lyngdoh kiba la leh kumta .

en: When a man s ways please the  Lord  , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him .
kha: Haba phi pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , phi lah ban pynkylla paralok ïa ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew u pynsngewbha ia U Trai , u pynlong wat ia ki nongshun jong u ban iasuk bad u .

en: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,
kha: Hynrei haba ki rangbah synshar ki la poi , kim shym shem ïa ki apostol ha byndi , kumta ki la wan phai noh sha ka Dorbar bad ki la ïathuh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki ophisar ki la wan , bad kim lap ia ki ha phatok , ki la wan phai bad ki la iathuh .

en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?
kha: Hato men ym khmih ïa nga , A Blei , lane buh ïa nga ha ka jingbishar bad jingtian bishar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me plie ia ki khmat jong me ha uba kum uta , bad me wanrah ia nga ha ka jingbishar bad me ?

en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .
kha: Hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpyntngen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba iathuhlypa u kren ha ki briew sha ka jingpynroi bad jingpynshlur bad jingpyntngen .

en: And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
kha: Da kaba lyngngoh bad shaïong , ki la ïai kylli uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Aïu kane ka kit jingmut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la lyngngoh bad ki la artatien, ki ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, Kaei ka jingmut jong kane ?

en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself , but he that is called of God , as was Aaron .
kha: Ym don uno uno ruh uba shim ha lade ïa ka burom ka jinglong rangbah lyngdoh . Ka dei tang lyngba ka jingkhot U Blei , ba u briew u lah ban long u rangbah lyngdoh — kumba u Aaron u la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba shim ia kane ka burom ha lade , hynrei uta uba la khot na U Blei kumba la khot ia u Aaron .

en: And all the elders and all the people said unto him , Hearken not unto him , nor consent .
kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki la jubab ,  Wat shahshkor ïa u ; wat pyndem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah baroh bad ki briew baroh ki la ong ha u, Wat sngap ia u, lymne wat mynjur ia u .

en: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem ,
kha: Te nga la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u syiem Sedekaïah ha Jerusalem katba ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la kren ia kine ki ktien baroh ha u syiem Judah ha Jerusalem .

en: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .
kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wan bad ka la noh ar tylli ki sbai tama , kiba shongdor kumba shi pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan kawei ka riewkynthei kaba duk, bad ka la bret ha ki ar tylli ki khniang kiba pynlong ia ka jingjngai .

en: Who can discover the face of his garment ? or who can come to him with his double bridle ?
kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban tar noh ïa ka jingsop bashabar jong u lane pynpei ïa ka atiar jingïada kaba u phong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban lap ia ka khmat jong ka jain jong u ? lane mano ba lah ban wan sha u da ka ryndang kaba arsien jong u ?

en: For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .
kha: Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka dei ban long kaba lah ban synshar da uba kren , namar U Blei um kwah ïa ngi ban long ha ka jingkynrum kynram hynrei ha ka jingryntih bad ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar U Blei um dei u nongthoh jong ka jingkulmar , hynrei ka jingsuk kumba long ha ki balang baroh jong ki riewkhuid .

en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards :
kha: Thaw ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka liang kaba ar jong ka Tabernakl ha ka liang mihngi kin don arphew tylli ki board:

en: But let a man examine himself , and so let him eat of that bread , and drink of that cup .
kha: Kumta te , uwei uwei baroh u dei ban ïit nyngkong ïa lade , bad nangta un bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba u briew un bishar ia lade , bad kumta to ai ba un bam ia uta u kpu bad un dih ia uta u khuri .

en: The nakedness of thy father s wife shalt thou not uncover : it is thy father s nakedness .
kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano na ki tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong me wat plie: ka long ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong me .

en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian , in that he told him not that he fled .
kha: U Jakob u la shukor ïa u Laban da kaba um shym la ïathuh ei ei ba u thmu ban phet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la phet noh khlem da tip sha u Laban u Syria, ha kaba um shym la iathuh ia u ba u la phet noh .

en: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .
kha: Nga la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong me ha ka pyrthei ; nga la pyndep ïa ka kam kaba me la ai ha nga ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyndonburom ia me ha ka khyndew: Nga la pyndep ia ka kam kaba me la ai ha nga ban leh .

en: Then ye shall let your children know , saying , Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .
kha: phin ïathuh ha ki shaphang ka por mynba ki Israel ki la jam ïa ka Jordan halor ka dewryngkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin sa pyntip ia ki khun jong phi da kaba ong: Ki Israel ki la wan halor kane ka Jordan ha ka ri kaba rkhiang .

en: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month , in the second year of Darius the king .
kha: ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba hynriew ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jinglong Patsha u Darius .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sawphew snem jong u bnai kaba hynriew , ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Darius u syiem .

en: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman : howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I .
kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba nga dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan bad ba nga don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei don u briew uba dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan ban ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ka long kaba shisha ba nga long u paralok jong me uba jan: wat la u don u paralok uba kham jan ban ia nga .

en: He shall die without instruction  ; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray .
kha: U ïap namar ba um lah synshar ïa lade ; ka jingïailong mutlop jong u kan ïalam ïa u sha ka jingtep jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Un iap khlem jinghikai ; bad ha ka jingkhraw jong ka jinglong jong u un iaid bakla .

en: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God , then the kingdom of God is come unto you .
kha: Em , ym dei u Beelsebul , hynrei U Mynsiem U Blei , uba ai ha nga ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid , kaba pynshisha ba ka Hima U Blei ka la da wan lypa ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada nga beh noh ia ki ksuid da U Mynsiem U Blei , te ka hima U Blei ka wan ha phi .

en: Watch therefore , for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  To sumar bha , te , namar ba phim tip ïa ka sngi lane ïa ka kynta .
