translated_en_to_kha: To peit namarkata , namar phim tip ia ka sngi ne ka kynta ha kaba u Khun u briew u wan .

en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
kha: Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan hikai ia phi da ka kti U Blei: ia kaba don bad Uba donbor baroh ngan ym buhrieh .

en: And this voice which came from heaven we heard , when we were with him in the holy mount .
kha: Ngi hi da lade ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane ka sur kaba wan na bneng , haba ngi la ïadon lem bad u ha u lum bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka sur kaba la wan na bneng ngi la iohsngew , haba ngi la don ryngkat bad u ha u lum bakhuid .

en: Then went up Moses , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel :
kha: U Moses , u Aaron , u Nadab , u Abihu , bad hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , ki ïaleit kiew ïa uta u lum ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron, u Nadab bad u Abihu bad hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah Israel:

en: Give ear , O ye heavens , and I will speak  ; and hear , O earth , the words of my mouth .
kha: Ko ka bneng , shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong nga , bad ko ka pyrthei , sngap bha ïa kaei ba ngan kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai shkor ko bneng , bad ngan kren ; bad ngan iohsngew ko khyndew ia ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong nga .

en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .
kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki dieng shittim , bad u la tap ia ki da ka ksiar , ban kit ia ka miej .

en: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .
kha: Ki kulai thma kim lah ban ai jingjop ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki kam lah ban pyllait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U kulai u long uba lehnohei na ka bynta ka jingshngain: lymne un ym pynpoi ei ei da ka bor kaba khraw jong u .

en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment : the waters stood above the mountains .
kha: Me buh ïa ka duriaw-bah halor jong ka kum ka barandi , bad ka um ka tap ïa ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la tap ia ka da ka jain: ki um ki ieng halor ki lum .

en: Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .
kha: Kata ka kynthei ka kylli ,  Ïano ngan khot na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Samuel ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka kynthei ka la ong: Iano ngan wanrah sha me ? Bad u la ong: To wanrah ia nga u Samuel .

en: And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .
kha: Bad phim dei ban khot ïano ïano ha kane ka pyrthei ‘ u Kpa ,’ namar ba phi don tang uwei u Kpa ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat khot ia u kpa jong phi ha ka khyndew: namar uwei u long U Kpa jong phi uba don ha bneng .

en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;
kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga ha ka rukom kaba khuid bad kaba donburom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban tip kumno ban don ia ka lieng jong u ha ka jingpynkhuid bad burom ; .

en: Then are they glad because they be quiet  ; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven .
kha: Ki la kmen namar kata ka jingjai jai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingma bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka kadlieng kaba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki sngewbha namar ki sngap jar jar kumta u wanrah ia ki sha ka jaka ri jingri kaba ki kwah .

en: And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .
kha: Ki briew kin leh ïa kine kiei kiei ïa phi namar ba kim pat ithuh ïa U Kpa lymne ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine kiei kiei kin leh ia phi , namar kim ithuh ia U Kpa ne ia nga .

en: And lo a voice from heaven , saying , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
kha: Nangta ka sur ktien ka la ong na bneng ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit eh jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ioh ia ka sur na bneng, kaba ong: Une u long U Khun baieit jong nga, ha uba nga sngewbha shibun .

en: But I certify you , brethren , that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man .
kha: Shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba ka Gospel ba nga ïalap ha phi kam long kaba na ka tynrai u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga pynshisha ia phi ko para bangeit ba ka gospel kaba la ialap shaphang jong nga kam long hadien u briew .

en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .
kha: U long uba shaniah ha U Blei , uba la jied ïa u ban leh ïa kane ka kam , kumba u Moses u la long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong u ha ka ïing U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la long uba iaineh ha uta uba la thung ia u , kumba u Moses u la long uba iaineh ha ka iing jong u baroh kawei .

en: While Peter yet spake these words , the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word .
kha: Katba u Petros u dang kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor kita baroh kiba shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u Petros u dang kren ia kine ki ktien , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la hap ha kita baroh kiba la iohsngew ia ka ktien .

en: Raj Darbhanga was a main patron of Dhrupad , a vocal style in Hindustani classical music .
kha: U Raj Darbhanga u la long u nongkyrshan ba kongsan jong ka Dhrupad , ka rukom rwai ha ka jingrwai classical Hindustan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Raj Darbhanga u la long u nongkyrshan ba kongsan jong ka Dhrupad , ka rukom rwai ba pawnam ha ka Hindustani .

en: As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .
kha: Uno uno uba kut jingmut ban leh ïa kaba dei un im , hynrei uno uno uba ïai beh ban leh ïa kaba sniew un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka hok ka long ha ka jingim: kumta uta uba bud ia ka jingsniew u bud ia ka haduh ka jingiap jong u hi .

en: Then an herald cried aloud , To you it is commanded , O people , nations , and languages ,
kha: u sangot u la pynbna ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko ki briew jong ki ri baroh , ki jaitbynriew bad ki jait ktien !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kawei ka herald ka la pyrta jam , Ha phi la hukum ia ka , ko ki briew , ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien , .

en: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , being bound in affliction and iron  ;
kha: Katto katne ki la im ha ka jingshaïong bad ka jingdum , ki koidi kiba shahshitom ha ki kynjri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ban shong ha ka jingdum bad ha ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , ban shah teh ha ka jingjynjar bad ka nar ; .

en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shlur bad ki bym tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba eh ia kito kiba donbor ban dih wain , bad ki briew kiba donbor ban ia khleh lang ia ka jingdih kaba khlain:

en: Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .
kha: Bad haba phi pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingsngewbha jong phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi pan , bad phim pdiang , namar phi pan ia ka , ba phin bam ia ka ha ki jingkwah brai jong phi .

en: And all the men of Israel , when they saw the man , fled from him , and were sore afraid .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa u Goliath , ki her krad na u da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel baroh ki la phet noh na u bad ki la tieng shibun .

en: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things .
kha: U briew uba la shah hikai ha ka jinghikai khristan u dei ban ïasam ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u don bad u nonghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba uta uba la shah hikai ha ka ktien un iakynduh bad uta uba hikai ha kiei kiei baroh kiba bha .

en: Now will I rise , saith the  Lord   ; now will I be exalted  ; now will I lift up myself .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki jaitbynriew ,  Mynta ngan leh ïa la ka kam . Ngan pyn-i katno nga long uba donbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngan kiew , ong u Trai ; mynta ngan sa shah pynkhraw ; mynta ngan pynkiew ia lade .

en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her ,  Give me to drink .
kha: Ka nong Samaria ka la wan ban tong um , bad U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ai um ba ngan dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wan kawei ka kynthei na Samaria ban tan um: U Jisu u ong ha ka , Ai ia nga ban dih .

en: And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
kha: U la kylli ïa nga ,  Hato mem tip ?   Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia nga bad u la ong, Hato phim tip kaei kine ? Bad nga la ong , Em ko kynrad jong nga .

en: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynta ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Hato phi kwah ba ngan pyllait noh ha phi ia u Syiem ki Jiw ?

en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: Hadien kata , u la im sa sanspah snem bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shem u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Arphaxed san spah snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: And as they did eat , he said ,  Verily I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi , uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang ia bam , u la ong , Hooid nga ong ha phi , ba uwei na phi un die noh ia nga .

en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James  ; and all the elders were present .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Paul u la leit bad ngi ban ïakynduh ïa u Jakob ; bad baroh ki nongsharai balang jong ka balang ki la ïadon lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Paul u la leit rung bad ngi sha u Jakob ; bad ki rangbah baroh ki la don lang .

en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things : moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass .
kha: Husiar na ki briew kiba shri bad khapbrip khmat ïa phi ; ki don ka jingpyrkhat kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U khang ia ki khmat jong u ban pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba sniew: da kaba pynkhih ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u u wanrah ia ka jingsniew ban jia .

en: Give thanks unto the  Lord  , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .
kha: Ai ki jingnguh sha U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; Ïathuh ha ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To ainguh ia U Trai , to khot ia ka kyrteng jong u , to pynpaw ia ki kam jong u hapdeng ki briew .

en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience , when your obedience is fulfilled .
kha: Bad hadien ba phi la pynshisha ïa ka jinglong baïaineh ba-pura jong phi , ngin kloi ban pynshitom ïa kano kano ka jingleh ka bymïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingdon ha ka jinglong ba kloi ban pynphai kylla ia ka jingbym kohnguh baroh , haba la pyndep ia ka jingsngap jar jong phi .

en: In the 1870’s a small group of Bible students began rediscovering long-lost Bible truths .
kha: Ha ki snem 1870 , kawei ka kynhun barit ka la sdang ban pule ïa ka Baibl bad ki la shem biang ïa ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki snem 1870 ].

en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,
kha: U Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki synran jong u — uta u ban sa shetkylla ïa u — u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei na ki synran jong u u Judas Isarot u khun u Simon uba dei ban shet kylla ia u .

en: Then the king promoted Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , in the province of Babylon .
kha: Bad u syiem u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego sha ki kyrdan ba kham halor ha ka probins jong ka Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la pynroi ia u Shadrak, u Meshach bad u Abednego, ha ka ri Babilon .

en: Ye know that ye were Gentiles , carried away unto these dumb idols , even as ye were led .
kha: Phi tip ba mynba phi dang long kiba mane bleithaw , la ïalam sakma ïa phi ha ki rukom kiba bun sha ki jingmane ïa ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip ba phi la long ki Jutang , la rah noh sha kine ki bleithaw kiba dum , kumba la ialam ia phi .

en: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka lynti kaba i kumba ka long kaba dei ia u briew , hynrei ka jingkut jong ka ki long ki lynti jong ka jingiap .

en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :
kha: Ym don shuh uba lah ban teh kynjri ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba don ka jaka sah jong u hapdeng ki jingtep ; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban teh ia u, em, ym da ki kynjri:

en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
kha: Tang da ka jingduwai lah ban beh noh kum ïa une ,  u Jisu u la jubab ;  ym don kawei pat kaba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Une u jait um lah ban wan ei ei hynrei tang da ka jingduwai bad ka jingleh niam .

en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter : and Peter saith unto him , Lord , dost thou wash my feet ?
kha: U la wan ha u Simon Petros , uba la ong ha u ,  Hato men sait ïa ki kjat jong nga , ko Trai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u wan ha u Simon Petros: bad u Petros u ong ha u: Ko Trai, me sait ia ki kjat jong nga ?

en: It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?
kha: Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka don palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U Blei u tip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïap , hynrei me mem tip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba jrong kum ka bneng ; kaei kaba me lah ban leh ? kham jylliew ban ia ka dujok ; kaei kaba me lah ban tip ?

en: And Pilate , when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people ,
kha: U Pilat u la khot lang ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh , ïa ki nongïalam , bad ïa u paidbah , bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat haba u la khot lang ia ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongsynshar bad ki paidbah .

en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee , which frameth mischief by a law ?
kha: Mem don ei ei ban leh ïa ki nongsynshar bymhok , kiba pynlong ïa ka jingbymhok ban ksan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka khet jong ka jingbymhok kan don ka jingiadei bad me , kaba pynlong ia ka jingbymhok da ka ain ?

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Me la lah ïohi ïa u , bad u dei uta uba ïakren bad me mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Me la iohi ia u, bad dei ma me uba kren bad me .

en: Then said he unto them ,  Nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom :
kha: U la ïai bteng ban ong ,  Ki ri kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat ; ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki , Ka jaitbynriew kan kiew pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew bad ka hima pyrshah ia ka hima:

en: But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa nga la phah tang sha ki langbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong: Ngam shym la phah hynrei sha ki langbrot Israel kiba la jah .

en: Timothy my workfellow , and Lucius , and Jason , and Sosipater , my kinsmen , salute you .
kha: U Timothi , u para nongtrei jong nga , u phah ïa phi ki jingkhublei ; bad kumjuh ruh u Lukios , u Jason , bad u Sosipater kiba long ki para Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Timothi u paralok jong nga, bad u Lucius, bad u Jason, bad u Soospater, ki kur jong nga, ki ai khublei ia phi.

en: Say not thou , I will recompense evil  ; but wait on the  Lord  , and he shall save thee .
kha: Wat shim ha lade ban siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew . Shaniah ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ïa ka kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ong ma me, ngan siew kylliang ia ka jingsniew ; hynrei to ap ia U Trai , bad un pynim ia me .

en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
kha: Hato me tip ïa ki aiñ kiba synshar ïa ki suiñbneng , bad hato me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip ia ki jingpynbeit jong ka bneng ? phi lah ban buh ia ka jingsynshar jong ka ha ka khyndew ?

en: Fear not , little flock  ; for it is your Father s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .
kha: Wat sheptieng , ko kynhun barit , naba U Kpa jong phi u la sngewbha ban ai ha phi ïa ka Hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng, khyndiat ka kynhun masi ; namar ka long ka jingsngewbha jong U Kpa jong phi ban ai ia phi ia ka hima .

en: Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?
kha: Uei uba lah ban jop ïa ka pyrthei ? Tang u briew uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba jop ia ka pyrthei , hynrei uta uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei ?

en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me : and many such things are with him .
kha: Un pyndep ïa kata kaba u la thmu na ka bynta jong nga ; kata ka jingthmu ka long tang kawei na kiba bun kiba u don ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u leh ia kata kaba la buh na ka bynta jong nga: bad bun kiei kiei kiba kum kita ki don bad u .

en: My fruit is better than gold , yea , than fine gold  ; and my revenue than choice silver .
kha: Kaei kaba me ïoh na nga ka kham bha ban ïa ka ksiar banylla , ka kham bha ban ïa ka rupa kaba kynsai .
translated_en_to_kha: U soh jong nga u kham bha ban ia ka ksiar, u yea, ban ia ka ksiar kaba bha ; bad ka jingmih jong nga ban ia ka rupa ba la jied.

en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .
kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa ki shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethania , ha kaba u la rah ïa la ki kti bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ialam ia ki haduh Bethania , bad u la rah ia la ki kti bad u la kyrkhu ia ki .

en: For I determined not to know any thing among you , save Jesus Christ , and him crucified .
kha: Naba katba nga dang don bad phi , nga la kut jingmut ban klet ïa kiei kiei baroh lait tang ïa U Jisu Khrist bad khamtam ïa ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la kut jingmut ban tip ei ei hapdeng jong phi, lait noh tang U Jisu Khrist bad u la sahnarphna ia u .

en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
kha: Kumta ki ïamihnoh na Ijipt bad ki wan phai sha la u kpa ha Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit kiew na Ijipt bad ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki .

en: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful , and hast forgotten God that formed thee .
kha: Ki la klet ïa la U Blei , u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki , uta uba la ai ha ki ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Na u Rock uba la kha ia me me u long uba khlem jingmut, bad u la klet ia U Blei uba la thaw ia me .

en: For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :
kha: Ïa une u khunlung nga la pan na u , bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la pan .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta une u khynnah nga la duwai ; bad U Trai u la ai ia nga ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga kaba nga la kylli na u:

en: And when even was come , the ship was in the midst of the sea , and he alone on the land .
kha: Haba la janmiet , ka lieng ka la don hapdeng ka duriaw , katba U Jisu u dang don marwei ha ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la poi ka lieng ka la don hapdeng ka duriaw bad ma u marwei ha ka ri .

en: I thought it good to shew the signs and wonders that the high God hath wrought toward me .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh jong nga ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah kiba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pyn-i ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha ban pyni ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla kiba U Blei uba ha khlieh duh u la leh ia nga .

en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?
kha: Te ïa U Khrist la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïap halor ka diengphna namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Khrist u la phiah ? hato u Paul u la sahnarphna na ka bynta jong phi ? lane phi la shah pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng u Paul ?

en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .
kha: Bad kumta da ka jingsngewieit bajylliew kin duwai na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei kaba kor tam kaba U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jingduwai jong ki na ka bynta jong phi , kaba sngewtynnad ia phi na ka bynta ka jingaiei kaba palat jong U Blei ha phi .

en: And the people journeyed from Kibroth–hattaavah unto Hazeroth  ; and abode at Hazeroth .
kha: Na kata ka jaka ki paidbah ki la kynriah noh sha Haseroth , ha kaba ki la sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la leit noh na Kibrothhattaavah haduh Hazeroth ; bad ki la shong ha Hazeroth .

en: He hath put my brethren far from me , and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me .
kha: U Blei u pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para jong nga ban iehnoh ïa nga ; nga kylla long u nongwei ha kito kiba ithuh ïa nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki hynmen jong nga sha jngai na nga, bad ka jingiadei jong nga ka long shisha kaba jngai na nga .

en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .
kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum , U Blei un shem ïa ki jingduwai jong phi kiba ijli eh ban sngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynphai noh ia ka shkor jong u na kaba iohsngew ia ka hukum , wat ka jingduwai jong u ruh kan long kaba sngewsih .

en: Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .
kha: Te nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,  Nga kyrpad ïa me , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai ; Ko Trai , nga kyrpad ia me , to pynpoi ia ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khyndew jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn thung hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar , ha khmih , nga long na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngan phai sha phi , bad phin sa shah pynkhih bad bet:

en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me , and I have nothing to set before him ?
kha: U paralok jong nga uba don ha ka jingleit u la dang shu wan poi ha ka ïing jong nga , bad ngam shym don jingbam ei ei na ka bynta jong u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u paralok jong nga ha ka jingleit jong u u wan sha nga , bad ngam don ei ei ban buh ha khmat jong u ?

en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
kha: Wat ki maw ha ki kynroh ki kyang pyrshah ïa phi , bad ki shankhung ki pynsawa ïa ka jingkyang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u maw un pyrta na ka jingkhang , bad u beam na u dieng un jubab ia ka .

en: What then shall I do when God riseth up ? and when he visiteth , what shall I answer him ?
kha: Lada ngam leh kumta , kumno te ngan wan ha khmat U Blei ? Kaei nga lah ban ong haba U Blei u wan ban bishar ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Te ngan leh aiu haba U Blei un khie ? bad haba u leit jngoh ia u , ngan jubab aiu ia u ?

en: He that receiveth you receiveth me , and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me .
kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ïa phi u pdiang ïa nga , bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa nga , u pdiang ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pdiang ia nga u pdiang ia nga, bad uta uba pdiang ia nga u pdiang ia uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: And now , behold , Adonijah reigneth  ; and now , my lord the king , thou knowest it not :
kha: Hynrei u Adonijah u lah da long syiem , bad phim tip ei ei shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, u Adonijah u la synshar ; bad mynta, ko kynrad jong nga, me tip ia ka:

en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , there is a place by me , and thou shalt stand upon a rock :
kha: hynrei don kawei ka jaka hangne hajan jong nga , ha kaba me lah ban ïeng halor u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Ha khmih , ka don ka jaka hajan jong nga , bad me men ieng halor u maw:

en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?
kha: Hynrei uwei na phi un ong ha nga ,  Lada kane ka long kumta , kumno U Blei un shem jingbakla badno badno ? Uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me ong ha nga , Balei u dang lap ia ka jingbakla ? Namar mano ba pyrshah ia ka mon jong u ?

en: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
kha: Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ai ha nga un wan sha nga . Ngan ym kyntait ïa uno uno uba wan sha nga , namar nga la wan hiar na bneng ban leh ym ïa ka mon ka jong nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la wan hiar na bneng, ym ban leh ia ka mon jong nga hi hynrei ia ka mon jong uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: But they set their abominations in the house , which is called by my name , to defile it .
kha: Ki buh wat ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong ki ha ka Templ ba la tei na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki buh ia ki jinglehrain jong ki ha ka iing kaba la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga , ban pynjakhlia ia ka .

en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house  ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .
kha: Kaba pyrshang ban ïohnong da ka bymhok , ka pynngat ïa la ka longïing ha ka jingjynjar . Wat bamsap bad phin ïoh im slem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba thrang ban ioh ia la ka jong ka iing ; hynrei uta uba shun ia ki jingai sngewbha un im .

en: Peter saith unto him , Of strangers . Jesus saith unto him ,  Then are the children free .
kha: Ki nongwei ,  la jubab u Petros .  Kumta , te ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  kata ka mut ba ki traishnong kim donkam ban siew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u ong ha u , Na ki nongwei . U Jisu u ong ha u , Te ki khynnah ki laitluid .

en: But when they came to Jesus , and saw that he was dead already , they brake not his legs :
kha: Hynrei haba ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ba u la lah ïap lypa , kumta kim shym la pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la poi ha U Jisu bad ki la iohi ba u la iap lypa, kim shym la pynkhih ia ki kjat jong u:

en: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof  ; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water .
kha: Hynrei wat pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki kum ka jingbam ; pynban , theh noh ïa ka ha khyndew kumba theh um .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ma me wat bam ia ka snam jong ka; me dei ban theh ia ka ha ka khyndew kum ka um .

en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel , out of every tribe a man .
kha: Mynta to jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to shim ia phi shiphew ngut ki jait Israel , na kawei pa kawei ka jait .

en: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,
kha: Nangta kata ka briew ka la iehnoh ïa la u khiew um , ka la leit phai sha shnong , bad ka la ong ïa ki briew hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka kynthei ka la iehnoh ia ka um jong ka bad ka la leit shapoh shnong bad ka la leit sha ki shynrang .

en: The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .
kha: Phim ju tip kaei u syiem u pyrkhat ; ki jingmut jong u ki long sha lyndet ka jingtip jong ngi , kumba jrong ka sahit bneng ne kumba jylliew ka duriaw-bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng na ka bynta ka jingjrong , bad ka khyndew na ka bynta ka jingjylliew , bad ka dohnud ki syiem ka long kaba ym lah ban wad bniah .

en: Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .
kha: Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh lang bad ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga , hynrei ngan pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ruh ki la shong bad kren pyrshah ia nga: hynrei u shakri jong me u la pyrkhat ha ki ain jong me .

en: Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .
kha: Ko khun , haba phi sangeh ban shah hikai , shen phin iehnoh noh ïa kaei kaba phi la tip mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: To sangeh noh ko khun jong nga, ban iohsngew ia ka jinghikai kaba pynlong ia ka jingbakla na ki ktien jingtip .

en: ( 1 Thessalonians 2 :13 ) If you apply what the Bible teaches , you will benefit greatly .
kha: ( 1 Thessaloni 2 :13 ) Lada phi pyndonkam kaei ka jinghikai ka Baibl phin ioh shibun ka jingmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: (I Thessaloni 2 :13 ) Lada phi pyndonkam ia kaei kaba ka Baibl ka hikai , phin sa ioh jingmyntoi shibun .

en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .
kha: Naba lada la don ka burom ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka burom ka don ha kata kaba neh junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada kata kaba la weng noh ka long kaba donburom , kham bun kaba sah ka long kaba donburom .

en: Now therefore stand and see this great thing , which the  Lord  will do before your eyes .
kha: Mynta , namar kata , ïeng thik hangto , bad phin ïohi ïa ka kam kaba khraw ïa kaba U  Trai  un leh ha khmat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ieng bad peit ia kane ka kam kaba khraw kaba U Trai un leh ha khmat ki khmat jong phi .

en: Arise , and go down to the potter s house , and there I will cause thee to hear my words .
kha: Khie leit sha ka ïing jong u nongthaw khiew , ha kaba ngan ai ha me ka khubor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , bad leit sha ka iing jong u khnai , bad hangta ngan pynlong ia me ban iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga .

en: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .
kha: Kumta ki la tyrwa ar ngut ki rangbah : U Joseph ïa uba la khot u Barsabbas ( ïa uba la tip ruh kum u Justos ) , bad u Matthias .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thung arngut, u Joseph uba la khot u Barsabas, uba la jer kyrteng u Justus bad u Mathaios .

en: Where there is no vision , the people perish : but he that keepeth the law , happy is he .
kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem ka jingïalam U Blei ka long ka jaitbynriew ka bym ïaid beit . A suk uta u briew uba sumar ïa ka hukum U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ym don jingphohsniew , ki briew ki jah noh: hynrei uta uba sumar ia ka hukum , u long uba kmen .

en: The king by judgment establisheth the land : but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it .
kha: Haba u syiem u pyrkhat khia ïa ka jingbishar hok , ka ri kan long kaba khlaiñ , hynrei haba u pyrkhat khia tang ïa ka pisa , un pynjot ïa ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem da ka jingbishar u pynskhem ia ka ri: hynrei uta uba pdiang ia ki jingai sngewbha u pynhap ia ka .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Get thee up  ; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ïeng joit ! Balei me dem sah kumne ha khyndew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua , To khie noh ia me ; balei me sah kumta ha ka khmat jong me ?

en: Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?
kha: Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kiba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ha kaba ka jingkhlain jong ki kti jong ki ka lah ban pynmyntoi ia nga , ha kiba ka jinglong tymmen ka la jah noh ?

en: Son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Howl ye , Woe worth the day !
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ïathuhlypa bad pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Men pyrta ïa kine ki ktien :  Ka sngi kaba sngewtriem kan wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , to iathuhlypa bad ong , Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Kumno phi , Ka long kaba kordor ia ka sngi !

en: The sea is come up upon Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof .
kha: Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka Babilon bad tap da ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka duriaw ka wan shaneng ha Babilon: ka la tap da ka jingbun ki um jong ka .

en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened , and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped .
kha: Kiba matlah kin lah ban ïohi , bad kiba kyllut kin ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khmat jong kiba matlah kin plie , bad ki shkor jong kiba sngap jar kin sa plie .

en: But if ye bite and devour one another , take heed that ye be not consumed one of another .
kha: Hynrei lada phi leh kum ki mradkhlaw , phi pynmong bad pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat , te sumar bha , ïoh phin ïa-pynjot noh khoit iwei ïa iwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi bam bad bam iwei ia iwei pat , to sumar ba phin ym shah bam iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration , and seethe his flesh in the holy place .
kha: Shim ïa ka doh jong uta u langbrot ba la pyndonkam ha ka por ba pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad phon ïa ka ha kata ka jaka kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ia u langbrot jong ka jingpynkyntang , bad to buh ia ka doh jong u ha ka jaka bakhuid .

en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth , and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth :
kha: Wat sngewkmen haba u nongshun jong phi u ïakynduh ïa ka jingjot , bad wat lehkmen haba u jynthut .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewbha haba u nongshun jong me u la hap , bad wat ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan sngewbha haba u la lyngngoh:

en: For as touching the ministering to the saints , it is superfluous for me to write to you :
kha: Kam da donkam shisha ïa nga ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïarap ïa kaba dang ïai phah sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba nga dang ktah ia ka jingshakri ia ki riewkhuid , ka long kaba palat ia nga ban thoh sha phi:

en: And they stoned Stephen , calling upon God , and saying , Lord Jesus , receive my spirit .
kha: Ki la ïai lynthem maw ïa u Stephan katba u dang khot kyrpad ïa U Trai ,  A Trai Jisu , to pdiang ïa ka mynsiem jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Stephan, da kaba khot ia U Blei bad ki da ong, ko Trai Jisu, to pdiang ia ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes : but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise .
kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop borabor ki pyrkhat ba ki leh ïa kaba dei . Ki briew kiba stad ki shahshkor ïa ki jingpyn-i lem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong u bieit ka long kaba dei ha la ki jong ki khmat: hynrei uta uba sngap ia ka jingai jingmut u long uba stad .

en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
kha: Ka jingkmen jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi . Ym don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud ka tip ia la ka jong ka jingsngewsih ; bad u nongwei um ju ia tyngkhuh bad ka jingkmen jong u .

en: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .
kha: Ki la shahjingit bad ki la duwai , ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad ki la phah noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia leh niam bad ki la duwai bad ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ki , ki la phah noh ia ki .

en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .
kha: U Syiem Solomon u la jied laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kum ki nongtrei ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la pynmih ia ka Levy na ki Israel baroh; bad ka Levy ka long laiphew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: For those who wish to make a donation , there is a contribution box .—2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
kha: Kito kiba kwah ban ai sngewbha ki lah thep ha i synduk ba la buh lypa .—2 Korinth 9 :7 .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kito kiba kwah ban ai jingiarap , ka don ka synduk jingnoh synniang .2 9 Korinth :7.

en: Nearly 11 million people attended the 2 , 981 district conventions held in a recent year !
kha: Haduh 11 million ngut ki briew ki la wan sha ki 2 , 981 tylli ki district convention ba la pynlong ha ka shisnem ba la dep !
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh 11 million ngut ki briew ki la leit sha ki 2 , 981 tylli ki jingialang distrik ba la pynlong ha une u snem ba dang shen !

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , which maketh a way in the sea , and a path in the mighty waters  ;
kha: La slem mynshuwa U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka lynti lyngba ka duriaw , ka lynti lyngba ki um kiba phaloh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai uba pynlong ia ka lynti ha duriaw bad ka lynti ha ki um kiba khlain ; .

en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ong te , ba u Abraham u kpa , jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ong aiu te ba u Abraham u kpa jong ngi, kumba u long ha ka doh u la shem ?

en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kiba bat ïa ka ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba iehnoh ia ka hukum ki iaroh ia kiba sniew: hynrei kum kiba bat ia ka hukum ki ialeh pyrshah ia ki .

en: And he laid his hands on her : and immediately she was made straight , and glorified God .
kha: U la buh ïa la ka kti halor jong ka , bad kumta hi ka la pynbeit ïa la ka met bad ka la ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha ka : bad mar kumta hi ka la long kaba beit , bad u la pyndonburom ia U Blei .

en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .
kha: Te phim don daw ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan ym leh jubor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka jingtieng jong nga kan ym pyntieng ia me , lymne ka kti jong nga kan ym long kaba khia halor jong me .

en: So they went near , and carried them in their coats out of the camp  ; as Moses had said .
kha: Kumta ki la ïawan , ki bat na ki jaiñkup jong ki metïap bad ki ïarah noh ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara , kumba u Moses u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la leit shajan , bad ki la rah ia ki ha ki jainkup jong ki na ka shnong ; kumba u Moses u la ong .

en: For in that he died , he died unto sin once : but in that he liveth , he liveth unto God .
kha: Bad kumta , namar ba u la ïap , ka pop kan ym donbor shuh halor jong u ; bad mynta u im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata u la iap, u la iap sha ka pop shisien: hynrei ha kata u im , u im ha U Blei .

en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and was come again .
kha: Haba u Solomon u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Shimei u la leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha u Solomon ba u Shimei u la leit noh na Jerusalem sha Gath bad u la wan phai biang .

en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
kha: Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhreh bad pynbiang , ha kaba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pyni ia phi ia ka kamra kaba heh kaba la pynkhreh bad kaba la pynkhreh: hangta pynkhreh ia ngi .

en: Then one of them , which was a lawyer , asked him a question , tempting him , and saying ,
kha: bad uwei na ki , u nonghikai ka Hukum , u la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da ka jingkylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei na ki uba long u nongiasaid ain u la kylli ia u ia ka jingkylli, da kaba pynshoi ia u bad da kaba ong:

en: And he put them all out , and took her by the hand , and called , saying ,  Maid , arise .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la khot ,  Khie joit , ko khun jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki baroh shabar, bad u la shim ia ka da ka kti, bad u la pyrta, u da ong, Mei, to khie noh .

en: Then said he ,  Unto what is the kingdom of God like ? and whereunto shall I resemble it ?
kha: U Jisu u la kylli ,  Ka Hima U Blei ka long kum kaei ? Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong: Ha ka hima U Blei ka long kumno ? bad shano ngan iasyriem ia ka ?

en: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived , and hid herself five months , saying ,
kha: Katto katne por hadien , ka Elisabeth ka tnga jong u , ka la punkhun bad kam shym mih na ïing san bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kita ki sngi ka tnga jong u ka la pun khun bad ka la buhrieh ia lade san bnai da kaba ong:

en: If so be that ye have heard him , and have been taught by him , as the truth is in Jesus :
kha: Phi la ïohsngew shisha shaphang jong u , bad kum ki nongbud jong u , la hikai ha phi ïa kata ka jingshisha kaba don ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kumta ba phi la iohsngew ia u, bad la hikai ia phi da u, kumba ka jingshisha ka long ha U Jisu:

en: Then I said , I am cast out of thy sight  ; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba ïa nga la beh noh na ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ba ngan ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , nga la shah beh noh na ka khmat jong me ; hynrei ngan peit biang sha ka tempi bakhuid jong me .

en: Oh that my grief were thoroughly weighed , and my calamity laid in the balances together !
kha: Lada ïa ki jingjynjar bad ki jingkthang mynsiem jong nga la thew ha ki tarajur ,
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ka jingsngewsih jong nga ka la nang jur bha, bad ka jingjynjar jong nga ka la buh ha ki jingïahap lang !

en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .
kha: Ha ka por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Edom ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ka la kylla long ka hima kaba laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u u Edom u la kylla na hapoh ka kti u Judah , bad u la pynlong syiem halor jong ki hi .

en: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .
kha: U Jisu u la leit lyngba ki nongbah bad ki nongrit , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad u da thew ïa la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid lyngba ki shnong bad ki shnong , u la hikai bad u la leit sha Jerusalem .

en: Nay , much more those members of the body , which seem to be more feeble , are necessary :
kha: Hynrei da khongpong , ngim lah ban leh ei ei khlem ki dkhot jong ka met kiba i kham tlot ;
translated_en_to_kha: Em, kham bun kita ki dkhot jong ka met, kiba i kumba ki kham tlot , ki long kiba donkam:

en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?
kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bashukor ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan khein ia ki da ki jinglong kiba sniew , bad da ka pla jong ki jingkhia kiba thok ?

en: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall : but the righteous shall flourish as a branch .
kha: Kito kiba shaniah ha ka spah jong ki , kin hap kum ki sla jong ka synrai , hynrei kiba hok kin roi kyrhai kum ki sla jong ka lyiur .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shaniah ha ka spah jong u un hap: hynrei u hok un roi kum u tnat .

en: Some of them that stood there , when they heard that , said , This man calleth for Elias .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  U khot ïa u Elijah !
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne na ki kiba ieng hangta haba ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la ong, Une u briew u khot ia u Elias .

en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .
kha: Ka sniehdoh jong nga kam ïadait bha shuh bad ki shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka said .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyieng jong nga ka rung ha ka sniehdoh jong nga bad ha ka doh jong nga , bad nga la lait im da ka sniehdoh jong ki bniat jong nga .

en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei , phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong phin don ka jingpynkut kaba khuid: phin ym leh ei ei ha kata ka jaka .

en: To another faith by the same Spirit ; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit ;
kha: Uwei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka jingngeit ha uwei , katba ha uwei pat , u ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingngeit da u juh u Mynsiem ; ha uwei pat ki jingai sngewbha jong ka jingpynkhiah da u juh u Mynsiem .

en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies , then keep thee from every wicked thing .
kha: Haba phi don ha ka jaka shong dara ha ka por thma , kiar na kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u nongshun u leit sha khmat ki nongshun jong me , te to sumar ia me na kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew .

en: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God , whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption .
kha: Bad to wat pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong U Blei ; naba U Mynsiem u long ka dak jong ka jinglong trai jong U Blei ïa phi , ka jingbahkhlieh ba ka Sngi kan poi haba U Blei un pyllaitluid ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat sngewsih ia U Mynsiem bakhuid jong U Blei , da kaba phi shah set haduh ka sngi jong ka jingpynim .

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold , I stood upon the bank of the river :
kha: U syiem u ong ,  Nga la phohsniew ba nga ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph: Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga, ha khmih nga la ieng ha rud wah:

en: Oh that I might have my request  ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !
kha: Balei U Blei um ai ha nga ïa kaba nga pan ? Balei um jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ngan ioh ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga bad ba U Blei un ai ia nga ia kaei kaei kaba nga kwah eh !

en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :
kha: Kat kum ki jingbthah kiba khatduh jong u Dabid , ïa baroh ki Lebi la buh jingthoh ba kin shakri haba ki la dap arphew snem ka rta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ki ktien ba khatduh jong u Dabid la khein ia ki Lebi naduh arphew snem shaneng:

en: And thou shalt set them in two rows , six on a row , upon the pure table before the  Lord .
kha: Buh ïa ki kpu ha ki ar laiñ , hynriew tylli ha kawei kawei ka laiñ , halor ka miej ba la suit ksiar kaba don ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ki ha ki ar lain, hynriew tylli ha ka lain , halor ka miej kaba khuid ha khmat U Trai .

en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days  ; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths :
kha: Ki Israel baroh ki dei ban shong hynñiew sngi ha ki ïingtrep ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban shong ha ki ïingjaiñ hynriew sngi; baroh kiba la kha ki Israel kin shong ha ki ïingjaiñ:

en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .
kha: Te , ïa kine , yn phah noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok kin leit sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine kin leit noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut: hynrei kiba hok sha ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron s head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .
kha: U pynkyntang ïa u Aaron da kaba theh khyndiat ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la theh ia ka umphniang pynsleh ha ka khlieh jong u Aaron bad u la pynsleh ia u, ban pynkyntang ia u .

en: They were children of fools , yea , children of base men : they were viler than the earth .
kha: Ki long ka kynhun bymdondor , ki briew bym don ba ñiew ! Ïa ki la beh noh na ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la long ki khun jong ki bieit , yea , ki khun jong ki shynrang ba rit: ki la kham sniew ban ia ka khyndew .

en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingmut u wanrah ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa uba bieit , uba bieit u shu rkhie bad u hylla bad u tim .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew uba stad u ialeh pyrshah bad u briew uba bieit , la u bitar ne u rkhie , ym don jingjahthait .

en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .
kha: Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingbymhok phi lah ban lehkmen kum ka jingbam babha tam , hynrei shen kan long kum u shyiap ba-dap ha ka shyntur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam thok ka long kaba thiang ia u briew ; hynrei hadien kata ka shyntur jong u kan dap da u maw .

en: And Hagar bare Abram a son : and Abram called his son s name , which Hagar bare , Ishmael .
kha: Bad ka Hagar ka la ïoh khun shynrang na u Abram , bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hagar u la kha ia u Abram u khun shynrang: bad u Abram u la khot ia u khun jong u, uba u Hagar u la kha, u Ismael .

en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .
kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid hok ki shongshngain bad sngewskhem , hynrei uta u bym lehhok un shah kem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid beit beit u iaid beit: hynrei uta uba pynkylla ia ki lynti jong u yn sa tip .

en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
kha: Ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U  Trai  ka ïaineh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long na ki jingisynei U Trai ba ngim shah pynjot , namar ki jingmap jong u kim ju pep .

en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la bynta ïa ka ri kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses , kumta ki khun Israel ki la leh , bad ki la phiah ia ka ri .

en: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows , It is good for them if they abide even as I .
kha: Mynta , ha kiba khlem shongkurim bad ha ki riewkynthei nga ong ba ka kan kham bha ïa phi ban shong marwei kum ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong namarkata ha ki bym pat shongkurim bad ki riewkynthei , Ka long kaba bha ia ki lada ki kohnguh wat ia nga ruh .

en: The sons of Naphtali  ; Jahziel , and Guni , and Jezer , and Shallum , the sons of Bilhah .
kha: U Naphtali u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jahsiel , u Guni , u Jeser , bad u Shallum . ( Ki dei ki khun ki ksiew na ka Bilhah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Naphtali ; Jahziel, bad u Guni, bad u Jeser, bad u Shallum, ki khun shynrang jong u Bilhah .

en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .
kha: U briew uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hynrei ki briew basniew kim lah sngewthuh kum ïa kita kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok u pyrkhat ia ka daw jong kiba duk: hynrei ki bymman kim tip ia ka .

en: Go not up , for the  Lord  is not among you  ; that ye be not smitten before your enemies .
kha: Wat leit . U  Trai  um don lem bad phi , bad ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kiew shaneng , namar U Trai um don hapdeng jong phi ; ba phin ym shah pynmong ha khmat ki nongshun jong phi .

en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;
kha: Men ym sheptieng na ki jingma mynmiet ne na ki jingtur ïaleh ha ka por mynsngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ka jingtieng ha ka por miet ; lane na ka bynta u khnam uba her ha ka sngi ; .

en: Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee ,  Take up thy bed , and walk ?
kha: Ki la kylli ïa u ,  Uei uta u briew uba la ong ïa me ban leh kumne ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la kylli ia u, Uei uta u briew uba la ong ha me: To shim ia ka jingthiah jong me bad to iaid ?

en: And I will put a division between my people and thy people : to morrow shall this sign be .
kha: Ngan pynïapher hapdeng ki briew jong nga bad ki briew jong me . Kane ka kambah kan jia lashai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ka jingphiah hapdeng ki briew jong nga bad ki briew jong me: ban sa wan ka dak kan long lashai .

en: And Jesus said ,  Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Don mano mano ba la ktah ïa nga , naba nga tip ïa ka mynba ka bor ka la mihnoh na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong , Uwei u la ktah ia nga: namar nga sngewthuh ba kata ka jingbha ka la jah noh na nga .

en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life : but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit .
kha: Ki kyntien kiba sbun ki pynkhie im , hynrei ki kyntien kiba khor ki pynlwet ïa ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur kaba koit ba khiah ka long u dieng jong ka jingim: hynrei ka jinglong ba jylliew ha ka ka long ka jingpynkhein ha ka mynsiem .

en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia me haba me wan rung, bad la kyrkhu ia me haba me mih noh .

en: He is not here , but is risen : remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee ,
kha: Um don hangne ; la pynmihpat ïa u . Kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u la ong ha phi mynba u dang don ha Galilaïa :
translated_en_to_kha: Um don hangne , hynrei u la mihpat: kynmaw kumno u la kren ha phi haba u dang don ha Galilaia .

en: The Lord  God  hath opened mine ear , and I was not rebellious , neither turned away back .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingshemphang , bad nga shym la ïaleh pyrshah lane phai noh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei u la plie ia ka shkor jong nga , bad ngam shym la leh pyrshah , lymne ngam shym la phaidien .

en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .
kha: Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap , kane ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist un bishar ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei un bishar ia ki jingmaham jong ki briew da U Jisu Khrist kat kum ka gospel jong nga .

en: Give them , O  Lord  : what wilt thou give ? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts .
kha: Kaei kaba ngan kylli na phi ban leh ïa kine ki briew ? Pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei jong ki ! Pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym lah ban sumar ïa ki khunlung jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ki, ko Trai: kaei kaba me ai ? ai ia ki ia ka kpoh kaba khlem kha bad ki bniat kiba rkhiang .

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , but not with a perfect heart .
kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , hynrei u leh ïa kata da ka jingbymmon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ym da ka dohnud kaba janai .

en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil : but to the counsellors of peace is joy .
kha: Kito kiba thmu sniew kin don ha ka jingkyndit thret , hynrei kito kiba trei na ka bynta kaba bha kin shem ïa ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduna ka don ha ka dohnud jong ki kiba pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew: hynrei ha ki nongai jingmut jong ka jingsuk ka long ka jingkmen .

en: ( Ephesians 5 :18 , 19 ) Admission is free , and no collections are taken .—Matthew 10 :8 .
kha: ( Ephesos 5 :18 , 19 ) Ym ju shim bai rung lane jingkynshew .—Mathaios 10 :8 .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Ephesos 5 :18 , 19 ) Ka jingrung ka long kaba laitluid, bad ym shym la shim ia ki jinglum jingtip .  macahew 10 :8 .

en: Exalt the  Lord  our God , and worship at his holy hill  ; for the  Lord  our God is holy .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , bad to mane ha u lum bakyntang jong u ! U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: To pynpaw ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi , bad to mane ha u lum bakhuid jong u ; namar U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long uba khuid .

en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .
kha: Ka Israel ka her kum ka paro kaba bieit ; nyngkong ki briew jong ka ki wad jingïarap na Ijipt , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim ruh ka long kum ka paro kaba bieit khlem dohnud: ki khot ia ka ri Ijipt , ki leit sha Assyria .

en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .
kha: Haba ka sngi Pentekost ka la poi , baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïalumlang ha kawei ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi Pentecost ka la poi pura , baroh ki la ia don ryngkat ha kawei ka jaka .

en: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga dei ban leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u kpa jong u ha ka ain: Namar ki briew ki wan sha nga ban kylli ia U Blei:

en: And the priest said unto them , Go in peace : before the  Lord  is your way wherein ye go .
kha: U lyngdoh u jubab ,  Phim donkam ban khuslai ei ei . U  Trai  un sumar ïa phi ha ka jingleit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh u la ong ha ki: To leit suk: ha khmat U Trai ka long ka lynti jong phi ha kaba phi leit .

en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee , diligently to seek thy face , and I have found thee .
kha: Kumta mynta nga la wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi . Nga la kwah eh ban wan wad ïa phi , bad nga la lap ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la wan sha khmat jong me, da ka jingkmen ban wad ia ka khmat jong me, bad nga la shem ia me .

en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
kha: Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phin im slem ; kiwei kin burom ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba bud ia ka hok bad ka jingisynei u shem ia ka jingim , ka hok bad ka burom .

en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .
kha: Mynba U Jisu u don marwei , katto katne ngut na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la wan sha u ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad ki la kylli ïa u ban batai ïa ki pharshi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la don marwei , kito kiba don shaphang jong u bad ki shiphew ngut ki la kylli ia u ia ka pharshi .

en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .
kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban shahshkor ïa ki ktien kiba jar jar jong uno uno uba stad ban ïa ki jingpyrta jong u nongsynshar ha ka dorbar jong ki bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ki ktien jong ki riewstad la iohsngew kham sngap jar ban ia ka jingpyrta jong uta uba synshar hapdeng ki bieit .

en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
kha: Me tip ba ngam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me tip ba ngam long uba sniew ; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pyllait na ka kti jong me .

en: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .
kha: ki tare ha ka jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iaid ha ka jingdum khlem jingshai , bad u pynlong ia ki ban lyngngoh kum u briew uba la buaid .

en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , when Ehud was dead .
kha: Hadien ba u Ehud u la ïap , ki paid Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh biang ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , haba u Ehud u la iap .

en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .
kha: Me la thwet ïa ngi bad pynïap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jong me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Me la tap da ka jingbitar, bad me la pynshitom bein ia ngi: me la pyniap , me la sngewsih .

en: An offence has been registered under the Indian Penal Code and the Maharashtra Police Act .
kha: La register ia ka kam runar hapoh ka Indian Penal Code bad ka Maharashtra Police Act .
translated_en_to_kha: La register ia ka kam runar hapoh ka Indian Penal Code bad ka Maharashtra Police Act .

en: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others .
kha: bad phi tip ïa lade ba phi la ibeiñ ïa kiwei ki briew bun bunsien .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar bunsien ruh ka dohnud jong me hi ka tip ba me hi kumjuh me la tim ia kiwei pat .

en: Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .
kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kane ka jingleh jubor jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga pyrta na kaba bakla , hynrei ngam shym la iohsngew: Nga iam jam , hynrei ym don jingbishar .

en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .
kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la pynlong ia u ban bitar da ki jingpynmih jong ki: bad ka khlam ka la bthei ha ki .

en: Greatly desiring to see thee , being mindful of thy tears , that I may be filled with joy ;
kha: Da thrang ba kwah eh ban ïohi ïa me , nga kynmaw ïa ki ummat jong me , khnang ba yn ïoh pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah shibun ban iohi ia me, da kaba pyrkhat ia ki ummat jong me, ba ngan dap da ka jingkmen ;

en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
kha: Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ïa ki nongsngap jong me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ki ban ibeiñ ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei ki kren , bad ki kyntu bad ki pynrem da ka bor baroh . Wat ai ba uno uno un leh bein ia me .

en: And in the third chariot white horses  ; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses .
kha: ïa kaba lai da ki kulai rong lieh , bad ïa kaba saw da ki kulai thohbroin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka kali lieh kaba lai; bad ha ka kali kaba saw ki kulai kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong .

en: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the  Lord  all the day long .
kha: Wat sngewbishni ïa ki briew kiba leh pop , ai ba ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  kan long ha khmat ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan sngewsih ia ki nongpop: hynrei to long ma me ha ka jingtieng ia U Trai baroh shisngi .

en: To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Blei namar ka jingaiei ba-dap da ka burom jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha ngi ha U Khun uba ieit jong u!
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingiaroh ia ka burom jong ka jingaiei jong u , ha kaba u la pdiang ia ngi ha uba ieit .

en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth  ; and my delights were with the sons of men .
kha: nga lehkmen ha ka pyrthei , bad leh sngewbha bad ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkmen ha ka bynta kaba shong jong ka khyndew jong u ; bad ki jingsngewbha jong nga ki la don bad ki khun shynrang .

en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .
kha: U la thaw ki durblei nar jong u Baal ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la iaid ha ki lynti jong ki syiem Israel , bad u la shna ruh ia ki dur ba la shna na ka bynta u Baal .

en: But when the blade was sprung up , and brought forth fruit , then appeared the tares also .
kha: Haba ki jingthung ki la san bad ki kop sohkew ki la sdang mih , te ki ñiut ruh ki la paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u bniat u la mih bad u la pynmih soh , nangta la paw ki tar ruh .

en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .
kha: U briew uba bha un ym bakla da lei lei ; yn ïai kynmaw borabor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid un ym shah pynkhih junom: ki hok kin long ha ka jingkynmaw bymjukut .

en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
kha: Ïalang paralok bad uba stad bad phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok bad ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid bad ki briew kiba stad un long uba stad: hynrei u paralok jong ki bieit un shah pynjot .

en: If his loins have not blessed me , and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep  ;
kha: Nga ju ai ïa u ki jaiñkup ba la thain da u  saiwul uba la ïoh na ka kynhun langbrot jong nga hi . Nangta te u ïaroh ïa nga naduh ka dohnud jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki tyrpeng jong u kim shym la kyrkhu ia nga , bad lada um shym la shah pynshit da ka snieh langbrot jong nga ; .

en: And Joseph said , Give your cattle  ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .
kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Lada phim don pisa shuh , wallam ïa ki jingri jong phi ; te ngan ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad kita ki jingri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong: Ai ia ki masi jong phi ; bad ngan ai ia phi na ka bynta ki masi jong phi lada ka pisa ka duna .

en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .
kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka lynti kaba i kumba ka long kaba dei ia u briew , hynrei ka jingkut jong ka ki long ki lynti jong ka jingiap .

en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
kha: Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba stad phin sngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingbun ki kyntien ym kwah pop: hynrei uta uba kyntait ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u u long uba stad .

en: And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .
kha: Don bun ki jinglah ban shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ki jingpher bapher bapher jong ki jingtreikam , hynrei ka long kajuh ka Blei kaba trei baroh ha baroh .

en: The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .
kha: Ki briew kiba sarong ki la ïathuh lamler shaphang jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohnud baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba sngew sarong ki la thaw ia ka jinglamler pyrshah ia nga: hynrei ngan sumar ia ki jingbthah jong me da ka dohnud baroh .

en: And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God :
kha: Bad to pdiang ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingïada khlieh , bad ka ktien U Blei kum ka waitlam kaba U Mynsiem u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shim ia ka helmet jong ka jingpynim bad ka waitlam U Mynsiem kaba long ka ktien U Blei:

en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit bad buh u nongap phira , bad ong ïa u ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta U Trai u la ong ha nga, To leit, to buh ia u nongap , to ai ba un pynbna ia kaei kaba u iohi .

en: Wherefore , though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient ,
kha: Kum u hynmen jong me ha U Khrist na ka bynta kane ka daw ba nga lah ban sngew shlur katne , ban hukum ïa me ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , wat la nga lah ban long uba shlur shibun ha U Khrist ban hukum ia me ia kata kaba suk .

en: And her spirit came again , and she arose straightway : and he commanded to give her meat .
kha: Ka la im pat , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon , bad U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ai ei ei ha ka ba kan bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mynsiem jong ka ka la wan biang, bad ka la ieng beit: bad u la hukum ban ai ia ka doh jong ka .

en: So it came to pass , when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people ,
kha: Hadien ba ki la ïap lut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la jia , haba ki briew baroh ki la shah bam bad ki la iap na ki briew .

en: Through the tender mercy of our God  ; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us ,
kha: U Blei jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba jemnud . Un pynlong ïa ka step baphyrnai jong ka jingpynim ban mih ha ngi
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingisynei kaba jem jong U Blei jong ngi ; ha kaba ki sngi naduh jrong ki la leit jngoh ia ngi , .

en: But he shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .
kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka jingïap jong kito kiba ïalong ba-ha-ïing bad u na ka jingshongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un ym pynjakhlia ia lade, u long u rangbah hapdeng ki briew jong u, ban pynjah burom ia lade .

en: For the  Lord  will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrshan ïa la ki briew ; un sngewsynei ïa la ki shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un bishar ia ki briew jong u , bad un kylla bamut ia lade shaphang ki shakri jong u .

en: But the chief priests moved the people , that he should rather release Barabbas unto them .
kha: Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah ban pan ba u Pilat un pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pynkhih ia ki briew, ba u kham dei ban pyllait noh ia u Barabbas ha ki .

en: The sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . U don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah , bad kawei ka khun , ka Serah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Asher ; Imnah, bad u Ishii, bad u Ishii, bad u Beriah, bad u Serah ka para jong ki .

en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .
kha: Kane ka long ka ri ba ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Judah kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .
kha: Thaw ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki kynjri ha ki tduh jong ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
kha: Naba u kpu ba U Blei u ai u long uta uba wan hiar na bneng bad uba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u kpu U Blei u long uta uba wan hiar na bneng bad u ai jingim ia ka pyrthei .

en: For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .
kha: Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ki ïawanlang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hangta lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kaba ar ne lai ngut ki ialum lang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hapdeng jong ki .

en: Thou shalt not take thee a wife , neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place .
kha: Wat shongkurim lane don khun ha ka jaka kaba kum kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shim ia me ka tnga , bad wat don khun shynrang ne kynthei ha kane ka jaka .

en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki khun Ammon , ong U Trai .

en: And his servants spake yet more against the  Lord  God , and against his servant Hezekiah .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba kham sniew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei bad ïa u Hesekaïah , u shakri U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la kren kham bun pyrshah ia U Trai Blei bad pyrshah ia u shakri jong u u Hesekaiah .

en: Then there arose a question between some of John s disciples and the Jews about purifying .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la sdang ban ïatainia bad u Jiw shaphang ki bynta ba ïadei bad ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la mih ka jingkylli hapdeng katto katne ki synran u loannis bad ki Jiw shaphang ka jingpynkhuid .

en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :
kha: Ki rmiang shyntur ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ki lah ban thiang kum ka ngap , bad ki jingdoh jong ka ki long jlih kum ka umphniang Olib ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki rmiang shyntur jong ka kynthei kaba phylla ki hap kum ka umsoh , bad ka shyntur jong ka ka kham jem ban ia ka umphniang:

en: Ye shall know them by their fruits . Do men gather grapes of thorns , or figs of thistles ?
kha: Phin ithuh ïa ki da kaei kaba ki leh . Ki bniap shiah kim ju pynmih ki sohwaiñ , bad ki shiah buid kim ju pynmih ki soh Dumbur .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin ithuh ia ki da ki soh jong ki . Hato ki briew ki lum ia ki soh , ne ki soh jong ki thliew ?

en: For sin shall not have dominion over you : for ye are not under the law , but under grace .
kha: Ka pop kam dei ban long ka kynrad jong phi ; namar phim im hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka pop kan ym don ka jingsynshar halor jong phi: namar phim don hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei .

en: Therefore being justified by faith , we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ :
kha: Mynta ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit , ngi don ka jingïasuk bad U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba la pynksan da ka jingngeit , ngi don ka jingsuk bad U Blei lyngba U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist:

en: What was the last requirement Thomas had to meet before receiving his salary and back pay ?
kha: Kaei ka jingdawa kaba khatduh eh kaba u Thomas u dei ban pyndep shwa ban ioh ia ka tulop bad ka back pay ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam kaba khatduh kaba u Thomas u la dei ban iakynduh shwa ban ioh ia ka tulop bad ka jingsiew kaba shadien jong u ?

en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim  ; which conceived , and bare him a son .
kha: Kumta u Hosia u la shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Gomer , ka khun jong u Diblaim . Hadien ba la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit bad u la shim ia u Gomer ka khun jong u Diblaim kaba la pun khun, bad u la kha ia u khun shynrang .

en: For they are gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself : Ephraim hath hired lovers .
kha: Ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kada khlaw , ki paid Israel kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki la leit ban wad jingïarap na ki Assyria , bad ki la siew ruh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban ïada ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leit sha Assyria, ka tdong khlaw marwei: U Ephraham u la thung ia ki nongieit .

en: Moreover he put out Zedekiah s eyes , and bound him with chains , to carry him to Babylon .
kha: Hadien kata , la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat u Sedekaïah bad la teh ïa u da ki kynjri ban rah ïa u sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la pynmih ia ki khmat jong u Sedekaiah bad u la teh ia u da ki kynjri, ban rah ia u sha Babilon .

en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .
kha: Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba im hapoh jong ngi , to sumar ïa kiei kiei kiba bha ïa kiba la pynkhamti ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba bha kaba la aiti ha me to sumar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba shong ha ngi .

en: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?
kha: Ha kane ki synran ki la sngewphylla haduh katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Mano keiñ uba lah ban lait im ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lyngngoh namar ka jingthew, ki da ong hapdeng jong ki , Mano ba lah ban pynim ?

en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least , why take ye thought for the rest ?
kha: Lada phim lah ban leh wat ïa kum kane kaei kaei kaba rit , balei ban khuslai shaphang kiwei pat kiei kiei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim lah ban leh ia kata kaba kham duna eh , balei phi pyrkhat ia kaba sah ?

en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .
kha: Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia ka doh jong ka jingknia ha ka sngi kaba lai yn thang da ka ding .

en: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours : therefore acknowledge ye them that are such .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba kum kine ki dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingithuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynthymmai ia ka mynsiem jong nga bad jong phi: namarkata to pdiang ia kita kiba long kum kita .

en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
kha: Ha kata ka por ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga wat ha ki shakri , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh halor ki shakri bad halor ki nongtrei kti ha kita ki sngi ngan theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
kha: bad kin bret ïa ki shapoh ka lawar ding baklang , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat bniat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un bret ia ki ha ka ding: kan don ka jingsawa bad ka jingsawa jong ki bniat .

en: These great beasts , which are four , are four kings , which shall arise out of the earth .
kha: U la ong ,  Kine ki saw tylli ki mradkhlaw kiba khraw eh ki long ki saw tylli ki hima ki ban sa mih ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki mrad kiba khraw kiba don saw ngut ki long saw ngut ki syiem ki ban mih na ka khyndew .

en: Wine is a mocker , strong drink is raging : and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise .
kha: Kaba dih kyiad palat ka pynlong ïa phi uba bunktien bad uba bieit . Ka long ka jingijli ban buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wain ka long ka jingdih kaba jem: bad uno uno uba shah thok da kata um long uba stad .

en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel , nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel .
kha: Ym dei ïa u Israel , shynrang lane kynthei , ban leit long nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym dei ban don kawei ruh na ki khun kynthei Israel , lane ka jingleh be-ijot jong ki khun shynrang Israel .

en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .
kha: U pynsngap jar ïa kito ki lah ban shaniah , bad u shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki riewtymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U weng noh ia ka jingkren jong kiba shaniah , bad u shim noh ia ka jingsngewthuh jong kiba la tymmen .

en: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day .
kha: kynmaw ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
