translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sumar ban leh ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar baroh kiba nga buh ha khmat jong phi ha kane ka sngi .

en: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death , and brake their bands in sunder .
kha: U wallam ïa ki na ka jingshaïong bad ka jingdum jong ki bad bthat lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki kynjri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynmih ia ki na ka jingdum bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , bad u la pynkhih ia ki band jong ki ha ka dewbilat .

en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen  ; and they that hated them ruled over them .
kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki ha ka bor jong ki nongmane bleithaw , bad ki nongshun jong ki , ki synshar halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki nongwei ; bad kita kiba shun ia ki ki la synshar ia ki .

en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous : he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly .
kha: U ai jingïarap bad jingïada ïa kiba hok , ki briew kiba im hok .
translated_en_to_kha: U buh ia ka jingstad kaba skhem na ka bynta kiba hok: u long u nongkren bein ia ki kiba iaid beit .

en: But thou shalt go unto my country , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son Isaac .
kha: Me dei ban leit pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa nga , bad men pynïoh ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga u Isaak napdeng ki kur ki jait jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me leit sha ka ri jong nga bad ha ka ri jong nga bad to shim ia ka tnga ha u khun jong nga u Isaak .

en: And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
kha: Ki shna ruh khatsan tylli ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki dieng kiba heh ; san tylli na ka bynta ki board jong kawei ka liang jong ka Tabernakle .

en: And that he was buried , and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures :
kha: ba la tep ïa u bad ba la pynmihpat ïa u hadien lai sngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba la tep ia u bad ba u la mihpat ha ka sngi kaba lai kat kum ki jingthoh:

en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .
kha: La don ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , ki riew niam kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka ri ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki Jiw kiba shong ha Jerusalem, ki briew kiba riewblei, na kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew hapoh bneng .

en: Now among these were of the children of Judah , Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah :
kha: Napdeng kito kiba la shah jied ki long u Daniel , u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah ; baroh na ki , ki dei na ka jait Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta napdeng kine ki long na ki khun Judah, u Daniel, u Hananiah, u Mishael bad u Asariah:

en: Then said Jonathan unto David , Whatsoever thy soul desireth , I will even do it for thee .
kha: U Jonathan u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba phi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid , Kaei kaei kaba ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah , ngan leh wat ia kata na ka bynta jong me .

en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;
kha: bad khang ïa phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei . Kin sumar ïa phi na ki briew kiba pynkhih jingkulmar da kaei kaba ki kren —
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyllait ia me na ka lynti jong u briew uba sniew, na u briew uba kren ia kiei kiei kiba sniew;

en: Where the word of a king is , there is power : and who may say unto him , What doest thou ?
kha: U syiem u trei bad ka iktiar , bad ym don uba lah ban pyrshah ïa kaei ba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ka ktien jong u syiem ka don ka bor: bad mano ba lah ban ong ia u: Me leh aiu ?

en: And they brought him upon horses , and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah .
kha: Ïa ka met jong u la wan kit sha Jerusalem halor u kulai , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia u halor ki kulai bad ki la tep ia u bad ki kpa jong u ha ka shnong Judah .

en: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people : for they had not put him into prison .
kha: Ïa nga ym pat shym la set ha ka byndi bad nga dang ïaid laitluid hapdeng ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la wan rung bad u la mih noh hapdeng ki briew: namar kim shym la set ia u ha phatok .

en: And spice , and oil for the light , and for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .
kha: bad ïa ki musla bad ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh , bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsma bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai , bad na ka bynta ka umphniang ba thiang .

en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :
kha: Wat pynleit jingmut ha kaei kaei baroh kaba ki briew ki ong — phi lah ban ïohsngew ba u shakri jong phi u ibeiñ ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju pyrkhat ruh ia ki ktien baroh kiba la kren ; ioh ba me iohsngew ia u shakri jong me ba u tim ia me:

en: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .
kha: Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mih noh bad ki la bat ia ka dorbar pyrshah ia u , kumno ki lah ban pynjot ia u .

en: For if Jesus had given them rest , then would he not afterward have spoken of another day .
kha: Lada u Joshua u la ai ha ki briew ïa ka jingjahthait kaba U Blei u la kular , U Blei un ym kren hadien shaphang kata kawei pat ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada U Jisu u la ai jingjahthait ia ki , te hadien kata un ym shym la kren sa kawei ka sngi .

en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds .
kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba la iohsngew ia ka ki la lyngngoh ia kita kiei kiei kiba la iathuh ha ki da ki nongaplangbrot .

en: Behold , the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him ?
kha: Mano mano ba ïohi ïa u Lebiathan u duh ka jingshlur bad u kyllon ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka jingkyrmen jong u ka long kaba lehnohei: ym don mano mano ruh ban shah pynhap wat ha khmat jong u ?

en: But draw near hither , ye sons of the sorceress , the seed of the adulterer and the whore .
kha: Ale hangne ban shah bishar , a phi ki nongpop ! Phim long kham bha ban ïa ki nongleh byrtong , kiba klim bad ki nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to wan hajan jong ka , phi ki khun shynrang jong ka jinglong tynrai , u symbai jong u nongleh kam sniew bad ka nongkhaii met .

en: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .
kha: Kumta lada ka hima u Soitan ka phiah ha ki kynhun , kan ym lah ban neh , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi sha ka jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u Soitan u kiew pyrshah ia lade bad la phiah ia u, um lah ban ieng , hynrei u don ka jingkut .

en: And I saw no temple therein : for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it .
kha: Ngam shym ïohi ïa ka templ ha ka nongbah , namar ka templ jong ka , u long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad U Khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam shym la iohi ia ka tempi hangta: namar U Trai Blei Uba donbor baroh bad U Khunlangbrot ki long ka tempi jong ka .

en: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , the concubine of Saul , had done .
kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ka Rispah ka la leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u Dabid ia kaei kaba u Rizpah u khun jong u Aiah u la leh .

en: So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people .
kha: U Dabid u synshar ha baroh ka Israel bad u pynthikna ba ïa ki briew jong u yn lehbha bad lehhok borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la synshar halor ki Israel baroh , bad u la pyndep ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok hapdeng ki briew jong u baroh .

en: ( There are eleven days  journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh–barnea . )
kha: ( Ka shim por khatwei sngi ban ïaid na u Lum Sinai sha Kadesh Barnea na shaphang ka ri lum Edom . )
translated_en_to_kha: (Ki don shiphew sngi ka jingleit na Horeb da ka lynti jong u lum Seir haduh Kadeshbarnea . )

en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him ? I trow not .
kha: U shakri um dei hok ban ïoh ka jingkhublei na ka bynta ka jingkohnguh hukum jong u , hato kam long kumta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u ainguh ia uta u shakri namar ba u la leh ia kiei kiei kiba la hukum ia u ? Ngam shym la leh .

en: If he destroy him from his place , then it shall deny him , saying , I have not seen thee .
kha: Hynrei phut noh ïa ki — ym don mano mano batip ba ki ju don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u pynjot ia u na ka jaka jong u , te kan kyntait ia u da kaba ong , Ngam shym la iohi ia me .

en: And he stooping down , and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying  ; yet went he not in .
kha: U la dem bad u la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen , hynrei um shym la rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem khrup shapoh bad u la peit shapoh, u la iohi ia ki jain lin kiba la thiah ; hynrei um shym la rung shapoh .

en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syiem un long u paralok jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia ka jinglong khuid jong ka dohnud , namar ka jingaiei jong ki rmiang shyntur jong u u syiem un long u paralok jong u .

en: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
kha: bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kwah ban wan bad sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khyndew baroh ka la wad ia u Solomon, ban iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong u, kaba U Blei u la buh ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: Avoiding this , that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us :
kha: Ngi da sumar ba yn ym shah kynnoh ha ki jingmudui ïa ka rukom pynïaid ïa kane ka jingai sbun mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkiar na kane , ba ym don briew uba dei ban kynnoh ia ngi ha kane ka jingbun kaba la pyniaid da ngi:

en: Receive us ; we have wronged no man , we have corrupted no man , we have defrauded no man .
kha: To pdiang ïa ngi ha ki dohnud jong phi . Ngim shym la leh bymdei ïano ïano ; ngim shym la pynjot ïano ïano , lymne ngim shym la pyrshang ban shim kabu ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Pdiang ia ngi ; ngim shym la leh ei ei, ngim shym la pynsniew iano iano ruh .

en: He pursued them , and passed safely  ; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet .
kha: U bud ha ka jingbeh bad u ïaid ryntih ha ka jingshngain stet katta katta ba um shym la dei satia ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bud ia ki , bad u la iaid suk shuh da kaba um shym la leit bad ki kjat jong u .

en: Behold even to the moon , and it shineth not  ; yea , the stars are not pure in his sight .
kha: Ha khmat jong u wat u bnai um long uba phyrnai , ne ki khlur kim long kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih wat ia u bnai ruh um ju shai ; hooid , ki khlur kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .

en: Within a short period , 255 buses Procurement of will be added to existing BRTC bus fleet .
kha: Hapoh ka por kaba lyngkot , yn pynrung 255 tylli ki bus ha ka kynhun bus ba la don lypa jong ka BRTC .
translated_en_to_kha: Hapoh ka por kaba lyngkot , 255 tylli ki bus yn sa pyndap ha ka lieng bus BRTC kaba la don lypa .

en: Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob  ;
kha: To khynñiuh , ko khyndew , ha ka jingwan jong U  Trai  , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei jong u Jakob ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia me, ko khyndew, ha khmat U Trai, ha khmat U Blei u Jakob;

en: He that saith he is in the light , and hateth his brother , is in darkness even until now .
kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u don ha ka jingshai , pynban u isih ïa la u hynmen u para , u don ha ka jingdum haduh kane hi ka kynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ong ba u don ha ka jingshai bad u shun ia la u hynmen , u don ha ka jingdum wat haduh mynta .

en: For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?
kha: Hato u briew u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei ka jingmyntoi ia u briew lada u ioh ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad u duh noh ia la ka jong ka mynsiem ?

en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .
kha: Ki die noh ïa ka jaka ka puta bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pisa hapdeng jong ki baroh , kat kum kaei kaba uwei uwei u donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la die ia ki mar ki mata bad ki mar ki mata jong ki, bad u la iakhlad ia ki ha ki briew baroh kumba uwei pa uwei u donkam .

en: Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .
kha: Ha ka por ba u la rangbah bha ban pynlong ïa la ki jingkut jingmut , ki briew kin dih dud bad bam ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: U butter bad ka ngap un bam , ba un nang ban kyntait ia kaba sniew bad ban jied ia kaba bha .

en: Also take your flocks and your herds , as ye have said , and be gone  ; and bless me also .
kha: Ïalam ïa la ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi , bad khie mihnoh . Duwai ruh na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ruh ia ki langbrot bad ki kynhun jong phi kumba phi la ong , bad to leit noh ; bad to kyrkhu ia nga ruh .

en: Moreover they that work in fine flax , and they that weave networks , shall be confounded .
kha: Kito kiba thain ïa ka jaiñ linen kin don ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata kito kiba trei ha ka flax kaba bha, bad kito kiba shna ia ki jain , kin shah pynjah burom .

en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .
kha: khnang ba haba nga don pat bad phi , phin don wat kham bun ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa nga ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan kham bun ha U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong nga da kaba wan biang sha phi .

en: Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
kha: Pyni ïa nga haduh katno me ieit ïa nga , A  Trai  , bad pynim ïa nga kat kum ka kular jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ki jingisynei jong me kin wan ruh ha nga, ko Trai, wat ka jingpynim jong me ruh kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: And as Peter was beneath in the palace , there cometh one of the maids of the high priest :
kha: U Petros u dang don shapoh ha ka phyllaw haba kawei na ki khynnah shakri jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh ka la ïaid nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Petros u dang don hapoh ka iing syiem , ka wan kawei na ki shakri jong u rangbah lyngdoh:

en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .
kha: Haba phi la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngap ruh ; hynrei haba phi thngan , wat ka jingbam kaba kthang ruh ka thiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem kaba pura ka long kaba thiang; hynrei ha ka mynsiem kaba thngan ka long kaba thiang .

en: And the people waited for Zacharias , and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por ki paidbah ki la ïa-ap ïa u Sekharaïah bad ki da sngewlyngngoh balei ba u pynlut bun por hapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ap ia u Sakhia, bad ki la lyngngoh ba u la sah slem ha ka tempi .

en: You can even print out a few pages to share with an interested person in his own language !
kha: Phi lah ruh ban print katto katne sla ban sam  ïa ki briew kiba kwah ban tip ha ka ktien jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah wat ban shon katto katne sla ban iasam bad u briew uba sngewtynnad ha la ka jong ka ktien !

en: It has also been inscribed in UNESCOs representative list of intangible cultural heritage .
kha: La thoh ruh ia ka ha ka thup jong ki nongmihkhmat jong ka UNESCO jong ki pateng kolshor bym lah ban iohi .
translated_en_to_kha: La thoh ruh ia ka ha ka thup jong ki UNESCO jong ka pateng kolshor kaba ym lah ban iohi .

en: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus , which was laid at his gate , full of sores ,
kha: La don ruh u briew uba duk uba kyrteng , u Lasaros , uba la dap da ki prum , ïa uba la ju wallam sha ka jingkhang jong u briew uba riewspah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u nongkyrpad uba kyrteng u Lasaros, uba la buh ha ka khyrdop jong u, uba dap da ki shyieng .

en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .
kha: Kim shym tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh aïu ki ong , namar ki ïakren bad u da ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh ia ki ; namar u la kren ha ki da u nongpynkylla ktien .

en: Not that any man hath seen the Father , save he which is of God , he hath seen the Father .
kha: Kane kam mut ba uno uno u la ïohi ïa U Kpa ; uta uba na U Blei u long tang ma u uba la ïohi ïa U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym ba uno uno u briew u la iohi ia U Kpa, lait noh tang ma u uba long na U Blei , u la iohi ia U Kpa .

en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the  Lord  his God :
kha: Suk uta u briew uba don U Blei jong u Jakob ban ïarap ïa u bad uba shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba suk ia uta uba don ia U Blei jong u Jakob na ka bynta ka jingiarap jong u, uba ka jingkyrmen jong u ka long ha U Trai U Blei jong u:

en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man  ; the candle of the wicked shall be put out .
kha: U riewsniew um don ïa ka lawei — ym don ei ei ba un peit sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan ym don ka bainong ia u briew uba sniew ; ka sharak jong kiba sniew kan shah pynlip .

en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow  ; the willows of the brook compass him about .
kha: Ki bniap shiah bad ki dieng Jamynrei    harud ka wahduid ki ai jakarieh ïa u ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng kiba jylliew ki tap ia u da ka jingdum jong ki ; ki mon jong ka wah ki ker sawdong ia u .

en: But John forbad him , saying , I have need to be baptized of thee , and comest thou to me ?
kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pyrshang ban pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u .  Nga dei ban shah pynbaptis ha me ,  u Ïoannis u la ong ,  bad me la wan pynban sha nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u loannis u la ong ia u, nga donkam ban shah pynbaptis na me bad me wan sha nga ?

en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness , and he is waited for of the sword .
kha: Um don jingkyrmen ban lait na ka jingdum , namar hangno re hangno ka waitlam ka ap ban pynïap ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Um ngeit ba un mih na ka jingdum , bad la ap ia u na ka waitlam .

en: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew , and the earth is stayed from her fruit .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw ym shym don slap bad ym shym mih ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka bneng halor jong phi ka sah na ka dewbilat , bad ka khyndew ka sah na u soh jong ka .

en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear , we thought it good to be left at Athens alone ;
kha: Ha kaba kut ngim lah shah shuh . Kumta ngi la rai ban sah tang ma ngi ha Athens
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba ngim lah shuh ban iaid lait, ngi la pyrkhat bha ban sah ha Athen marwei;

en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise , O ye servants of the  Lord  , praise the name of the  Lord .
kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Phi ki shakri jong U  Trai  ; to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . Iaroh , ko ki shakri U Trai , iaroh ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: Woe unto you ! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets , and your fathers killed them .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi thaw ki mot jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa — kita ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia phi ! namar phi tei ia ki jingtep jong ki nongiathuhlypa , bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pyniap ia ki .

en: Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
kha: U la dei U Jisu , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u la lah kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Na une u symbai u briew u don U Blei kat kum ka jingkular jong u u la pynmih ha ki Israel ia u Nongpynim , U Jisu:

en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .
kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ha kaba kiba ïap kin mihpat , kan long ka tnga jongno ? Ma ki baroh ki la shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha ka jingmihpat jongno ka tnga jongno kan long na ki hynriew ngut ? namar baroh ki la don ia ka .

en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day , it is abominable  ; it shall not be accepted .
kha: namar ka long ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad lada uno uno u bam ïa ka , ngan ym pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada la bam satia ha ka sngi kaba lai , ka long kaba sngewsih ; ym lah ban pdiang ia ka .

en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .
kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jingsngewbha na U  Trai  bad na ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah Samuel u la nang san bad u la don ha ka jingsngewbha bad U Trai bad ruh bad ki briew .

en: Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak : for your work shall be rewarded .
kha: Hynrei phi dei ban long kiba khlaiñ bad phim dei ban noh mynsiem . Ka kam kaba phi leh yn sa ai bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba khlain namarkata , bad wat ai ba ki kti jong phi kin tlot: namar ka jingtrei jong phi kan long kaba la siew kylliang .

en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha ba-pura shaphang kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la hikai ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban tip ia ka jingshisha jong kita kiei kiei , ha kaba la hikai ia me .

en: And not only this ; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one , even by our father Isaac ;
kha: Bad kam dei tang katne . Naba ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang ka Rebekka ki la don ujuh u kpa , u Isaak , u kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym tang kane ka ; hynrei haba u Rebeka ruh u la pun khun da uwei, wat da u kpa jong ngi u Isaak ; .

en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation , thou didst thresh the heathen in anger .
kha: Me thom sawdong ka pyrthei ha ka jingbitar ; ha ka jingbitar shla me ïuh halor ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iaid lyngba ka ri ha ka jingbitar , me la pynkhih ia ki jaitbynriew ha ka jingbitar .

en: He opened the rock , and the waters gushed out  ; they ran in the dry places like a river .
kha: U plie ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka mih shabar , ka tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap kum ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la plie ia u maw , bad ki um ki la tuid ; ki la mareh ha ki jaka ba rkhiang kum ka wah .

en: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church .
kha: Hamar kane ka por u Syiem Herod u la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kata ka por u Herod u syiem u la pynkhih ia ki kti jong u ban pynsngewsih ia ka balang .

en: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .
kha: Ban pynkut : Wat ai ba uno uno un buh jingeh shuh ïa nga , namar ki dak mong kiba nga don ha ka met jong nga ki pyn-i ba nga long u mraw jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh mynta wat ai ba uno uno un pynshitom ia nga: namar nga kit ha ka met jong nga ia ki dak U Trai Jisu .

en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba weng noh ia ka dak jong u para marjan jong u . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: So the  Lord  sent pestilence upon Israel : and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha ki paid Israel , bad hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki , ki la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la phah ia ka jingpang ha Israel: bad la hap na Israel hynriew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: And Isaac departed thence , and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar , and dwelt there .
kha: Kumta u Isaak u mihnoh nangta bad u sher dara ha ka Them Gerar , ha kaba u la shong la sah katto katne por .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la leit noh nangta, bad u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka them Gerar bad u la shong hangta .

en: The trees of the  Lord  are full of sap  ; the cedars of Lebanon , which he hath planted  ;
kha: Ki dieng Kedar jong ka Lebanon ki ïoh shibun u slap — ki dieng jong U  Trai  hi , kiba u la thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng U Trai ki dap da ka sap ; ki dieng Lebanon , kiba u la thung ; .

en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .
kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki dang ïeng hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moses uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ieng jngai , bad u Moses u la wan hajan ka jingdum kaba jylliew ha kaba U Blei U la don .

en: Sec . 7 applies to judges of all courts , except those courts to which judges are elected .
kha: Sec . 7 ka treikam ia ki nongbishar jong baroh ki iingbishar lait noh tang kito ki iingbishar ha kaba la jied ia ki nongbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbeit . 7 ka iadei bad ki nongbishar jong baroh ki iingbishar , lait noh tang kito ki iingbishar kiba la jied ia ki nongbishar .

en: For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .
kha: Ïa kiba hok la ïalam lynti bad ïada da U  Trai  , hynrei kiba sniew ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u tip ia ka lynti jong kiba hok: hynrei ka lynti jong ki bymman kan jah noh .

en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who shall also tell you the same things by mouth .
kha: Ngi phah ha phi , te , ïa u Judas bad u Silas , ki ban ïathuh ïa phi markhmat ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ngi thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la phah namarkata ia u Judas bad u Silas , kiba ruh kin iathuh ia phi ia kiei kiei da ka shyntur .

en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms , yet do they imagine mischief against me .
kha: Wat la dei ma nga uba pynheh pynsan bad pynlong ïa ki kiba khlaiñ , ki ïasuhbuit sniew pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la nga la teh bad pynskhem ia ki kti jong ki hynrei ki pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew pyrshah ia nga .

en: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains , Fall on us  ; and to the hills , Cover us .
kha: Kata kan long ka por ha kaba ki briew kin ong ha ki lumbah , ‘ To hap halor jong ngi !’ bad ha ki lumrit , ‘ To buhrieh ïa ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin sdang ban ong ha ki lum , To hap ha ngi ; bad ha ki lum , To tap ia ngi .

en: And the king said , Thou shalt surely die , Ahimelech , thou , and all thy father s house .
kha: U syiem u ong ,  Ahimelekh , ma me bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me baroh phi dei ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong: Me dei ban iap shisha, Ahimech, me bad ka iing u kpa jong me baroh .

en: But now I go my way to him that sent me  ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?
kha: Hynrei mynta ngan leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban ym don uwei ruh na phi uba kylli ïa nga shaei ba ngan leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta nga leit sha uta uba la phah ia nga ; bad ym don uwei ruh na phi uba kylli ia nga , Me leit ?

en: And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .
kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Khie leit .  Kumta kata ka khynnah ka leit bad ka wan ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun jong u Pharaoh ka la ong ia ka, Leit noh . Bad ka nongtrei ka la leit khot ia ka kmie jong u khynnah .

en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,
kha: U Blei um shym jied ïa ngi ban shah ïa ka jingbitar jong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynim lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei um shym la thung ia ngi ban bitar , hynrei ban ioh ia ka jingpynim da U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here : and he shall slay me .
kha: Te kumno phin hukum ïa nga ban leit ban ong ïa u syiem ba phi don hangne ? Un sa pynïap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta me ong, To leit, to iathuh ia u kynrad jong me, Ha khmih, u Elijah u don hangne : bad un pyniap ia nga .

en: Who , when they were come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Ghost :
kha: Haba ki la poi , ki la duwai na ka bynta ki riewngeit ba kin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba, haba ki la wan hiar, u la duwai na ka bynta jong ki, ba kin ioh ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
kha: Kumta to ai ba ngin ym man thait ha kaba lehbha ; namar lada ngim duh bor noh , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngin lum ïa ka jingot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ngin ym sngewsih ha kaba leh bha: namar ha ka por kaba biang ngin kheit lada ngim sngap jar .

en: The isles saw it , and feared  ; the ends of the earth were afraid , drew near , and came .
kha: Ki briew na ki ri bajngai ki la ïohi kaei ba nga la leh ; ki da sheptieng bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Kumta ki la ïalumlang baroh bad ki ïawan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dulir ki la iohi ia ka, bad ki la tieng ia ki tduh jong ka khyndew ki la tieng, ki la wan hajan bad ki la wan .

en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness , and not cut down , it withereth before any other herb .
kha: Lada ka um ka tyrkhong noh , dei ma ki kiba ïapstai nyngkong , katba ki dang rit eh ïa ka ban ot bad pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka dang don ha ka jinglong jyrngam jong u, bad ym shym la ot ia ka, ka tyrkhong ha khmat uno uno u jingthung .

en: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom , and shall return into his own land .
kha: u syiem ka Syria un hiarthma ïa ka Ijipt , hynrei un shah pynbor ban kynran .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un wan sha ka hima jong u bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: Let the redeemed of the  Lord  say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy  ;
kha: To ïai-ong ïa kine ki ktien ha ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ma phi baroh ïa kiba u la pynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba u nongsiewspah jong U Trai un ong kumta, ia uba u la siewspah na ka kti jong u nongshun ; .

en: ' Baahubali 2 ' sets a new benchmark , becomes first Indian film to cross Rs 1000 crore mark
kha: Ka phlim ' Baahubali 2 ' ka buh ia ka nongrim kaba thymmai , ka long ka phlim India kaba nyngkong eh ban jam ia ka thong jong ka Rs 1000 klur .
translated_en_to_kha: ' Baahubli 2 ' ka buh ia ka nongrim kaba thymmai, ka kylla long ka phlim India kaba nyngkong eh ban iaid lait ia ka 1000 klur tyngka .

en: And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .
kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa U Jisu , namar ba ki ieit ïa ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ruh kiba kwah eh ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei baroh: bad ki la rkhie bein ia u .

en: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .
kha: To ïeng joit bad khie leit shim ïa u , bad khroh ïa u . Ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, to rah ia u khynnah, bad to bat ia u ha ka kti jong me ; namar ngan pynlong ia u ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

en: And they , when they had heard that he was alive , and had been seen of her , believed not .
kha: Ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki nongbud jong u . Ki dang ïasngewsih bad ïam ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , ba ka ong ba U Jisu u im bad ba ka la lah ïohi ïa u , kim shym la ngeit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ruh haba ki la iohsngew ba u dang im bad la iohi ia ka , kim shym la ngeit .

en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
kha: Te phin shaniah ha U Blei borabor bad shem ba u long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar te men sngewbha ia U Blei uba donbor baroh .

en: Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .
kha: Kumta mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , shaniah ha U Blei jong phi bad wan phai pat sha u . Long kiba ïaineh bad kiba lehhok , bad ap da kaba ïaishah ïa U Blei jong phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to phai sha U Blei jong me: to sumar ia ka jingisynei bad ka jingbishar , bad to ap ia U Blei jong me man ka por .

en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,
kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la poi ha ka jaka kaba la khot ka Golgotha , kata ka mut ka jaka jong ka khlieh .

en: Whereunto I also labour , striving according to his working , which worketh in me mightily .
kha: Ban pyndep ïa kane nga ïaleh tyngeh bad nga ïaksaid , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingkhlaiñ badonbor kaba U Khrist u ai bad kaba treikam hapoh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba nga ruh nga trei shitom, nga ialeh kat kum ka jingtrei jong u, kaba trei shitom ha nga .

en: Though he slay me , yet will I trust in him : but I will maintain mine own ways before him .
kha: Nga la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen , te yn lei lada U Blei u pynïap noh ïa nga ? Ngan leit ban ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u pyniap ia nga, hynrei ngan shaniah ha u: hynrei ngan pynneh ia la ki jong ki lynti ha khmat jong u .

en: Jesus answered him ,  Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato kane ka jingkylli ka wan na me ne kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa me shaphang jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, Me ong ia kane ka jingkren jong me hi, ne kiwei pat ki la iathuh ia kata na nga ?

en: For they that sleep sleep in the night ; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night .
kha: Ka long ha ka por miet ba ki briew ki thiah ; ka dei ha ka por miet ba ki buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kito kiba thiah miet ; bad kito kiba la dih kyiad ki dih kyiad ha ka miet .

en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
kha: U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha kito kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpeit ia ka ka long kaba hok bad U Blei ban siew kylliang ia ki kiba pynshitom ia phi;

en: And when ye see the south wind blow , ye say , There will be heat  ; and it cometh to pass .
kha: Bad haba phi sngew ba ka lyer bashathie ka beh , phi ong ba kan shit — bad ka long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi iohi ia ka Iyer kaba shathie kaba beh , phi ong , Kan don ka jingshit ; bad ka wan ban iaid .

en: For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?
kha: Lada nga ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam jong nga , balei ba uno uno un wohnia ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingbam ïa kaba nga da ainguh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga long u nongshim bynta da ka jingaiei , balei ba nga kren bein ia kata kaba nga ainguh ?

en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof .
kha: Bad ki lynti bah kin dap pat da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ïalehkai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki surok jong ka shnong kin dap da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ialehkai ha ki surok jong ka .

en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars , and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .
kha: U thang ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh ba-thala ha ki duwan ba ki la mane . Da kaba leh ïa kane baroh , u pynlong ïa ka Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ba la pynkhuid pat kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thang ia ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh halor ki jingkhang jong ki , bad u la pynkhuid ia ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .
kha: lane bad la ka hynmen kynsi ne ka para kynsi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u hynmen jong me: ka long ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u hynmen jong me .

en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .
kha: U Saul u ïathuh ha u Jonathan u khun jong u bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . Hynrei u Jonathan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la kren ha u Jonathan u khun jong u bad ha ki shakri jong u baroh ba kin pyniap ia u Dabid .

en: And the frogs shall come up both on thee , and upon thy people , and upon all thy servants .
kha: Kin rynsied ha me , ha ki briew jong me , bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong me baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai kin wan shaneng ha me bad ha ki briew jong me bad ha ki shakri jong me baroh .

en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .
kha: Um don ki nonghiarpateng , ym don kiba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym don khun shynrang ne khun ksiew hapdeng ki briew jong u , lane uno uno uba sah ha ki jaka sah jong u .

en: Now rise up , said I , and get you over the brook Zered . And we went over the brook Zered .
kha: Nangta ngi jam sha shiliang ka wah Sered kumba U  Trai  u la ong ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to kiew shaneng, la ong nga, bad to ioh ia phi halor ka wah Zered . Bad ngi la leit sha ka wah Zered .

en: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .
kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynskhem ia ki bar jong ki khyrdop jong me ; u la kyrkhu ia ki khun jong me hapoh jong me .

en: For whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Arise , and walk ?
kha: Hato ka kham suk ban ong , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong me ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ To ïeng joit bad to ïaid ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hato ka kham suk ban ong , Ki pop jong me kin map ia me ; ne ban ong , To khie bad iaid ?

en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the  Lord  men depart from evil .
kha: Long kiba kohnguh bad kiba ïaineh , bad U Blei un map ïa ka pop jong phi . To kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad kaba sniew kan ym jia ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingisynei bad ka jingshisha la pynkhuid: bad da ka jingtieng ia U Trai ki briew ki mih na ka jingsniew .

en: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .
kha: Ka jingsneng bad ka jingpynbeit ki long kiba bha ïa ki khynnah . Lada u khynnah u ïoh leh katba u mon , u pynlehrain ïa la ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: U dieng bad ka jingshah pynrem ka ai jingstad: hynrei u khynnah uba la iehnoh ha lade u wanrah ia ka kmie jong u ban pynjah burom .

en: They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .
kha: Ha u patsha Darius , to synshar ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah ia ka shithi sha u, ha kaba la thoh kumta ; Ha u Darius u syiem, baroh ka jingsuk .

en: And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ieh ïa ka marwei ! Balei ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha bad ba-itynnat na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong, To ai ia ka marwei balei phi pynshitom ia ka ? ka la leh ia ka kam kaba bha ha nga .

en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short , and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment ?
kha: ym don u briew uba sniew uba kmen slem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingjop jong kiba sniew ka long kaba lyngkot , bad ka jingkmen jong u nongleh arsap hynrei shiphang ?

en: Come , let us take our fill of love until the morning : let us solace ourselves with loves .
kha: Ale keiñ , ngin ïaleh ieit baroh shi miet . Ngin ïalehkmen katba ngi dang ïakdup .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, to ngin shim ia ka jingpyndap jong ngi haduh ka por mynstep: to ngin pyntngen ia lade da ki jingieit .

en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come ?
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki nonghikai Aiñ ki ong ba u Elijah u la dei ban wan shuwa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ia u, ki da ong, Balei te ki nongthoh ba u Elias u dei ban wan nyngkong ?

en: But when the sun was up , it was scorched  ; and because it had no root , it withered away .
kha: Te haba ka sngi ka la shit , ka la thang noh ïa ki jingthung ba dang lung ; bad namar ba ki thied kim da ngam jylliew bha , ki jingthung shen ki tyrkhong noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka sngi ka la kiew, ka la tyrkhong ; bad namar ba kam don tynrai , ka la tyrkhong noh .

en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh  ; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .
kha: Ïa u briew la kha ha ka doh na ki kmie ki kpa kiba long ki briew , hynrei la kha ha kaba kynja mynsiem na U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba la kha na ka doh ka long ka doh ; bad kata kaba la kha na U Mynsiem ka long ka mynsiem .

en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .
kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei , u im ha U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba phla ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei , U Blei U shong ha u , bad ma u ha U Blei .

en: And all the people departed every man to his house : and David returned to bless his house .
kha: Hadien kata baroh ki leit noh sha la ïing , bad u Dabid u la leit sha la ïing ban pynlut katto katne por bad ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la leit noh sha la iing : bad u Dabid u la leit phai biang ban kyrkhu ia la iing .

en: For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba u paidbah u la ïakynduh ïa U — namar ba ki la ïohsngew ba U la leh ïa kane ka kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka daw ki briew ruh ki la iakynduh ia u , namar ki la iohsngew ba u la leh ia kane ka kambah .

en: He brought me forth also into a large place : he delivered me , because he delighted in me .
kha: U la ïarap ïa nga ban lait na ka jingma ; u la pyllait im ïa nga namar u la sngewbha eh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga ruh sha ka jaka kaba heh: u la pynpoi ia nga , namar u la sngewbha ia nga .

en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood : and his name is called The Word of God .
kha: Ïa ka jaiñkup kaba u phong la tap da ka snam . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long  U Ktien jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la phong ia u da ka jainkup kaba la pynngam ha ka snam: bad la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Ka Ktien U Blei .

en: For all the promises of God in him are yea , and in him Amen , unto the glory of God by us .
kha: Dei namar kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist ba ngi ïa-ong  Amen  na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki jingkular U Blei baroh ha u ki long Yes, bad ha u Amen, ha ka burom U Blei da ngi .

en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .
kha: Nangta ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum ki thylliej ding kiba pur kylleng bad ktah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la paw ha ki ki thylliej kiba la tyrkhong kum ka ding , bad ka la shong halor uwei pa uwei na ki .

en: For they served idols , whereof the  Lord  had said unto them , Ye shall not do this thing .
kha: bad kim kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban ym mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la shakri ia ki bleithaw , na kiba U Trai u la ong ha ki , Phin ym leh ia kane ka kam .

en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .
kha: Ym don kano kano ka waitlam kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khnam ne waitsum kaba lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam jong uta uba thiah ha u kam lah ban bat: ka khnam, ka dar , ne ka khnam .

en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?
kha: Nga thikna ba me lah , namar me la tymmen bha bad me la don hangta mynba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip ia ka , namar ba la kha ia me ha kata ka por ? lane namar ba ka jingbun ki sngi jong me ka long kaba khraw ?

en: Howbeit then , when ye knew not God , ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods .
kha: Ha ka por ba la leit phim shym la ithuh ïa U Blei , kumta phi long ki mraw jong ki jingthaw ki bym dei ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phim ithuh ia U Blei, phi la shakri ia ki kiba da ka jinglong kim long blei .

en: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .
kha: Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhia ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi long shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia u briew ka wanrah ia ka jingma: hynrei uno uno uba buh ia ka jingshaniah jong u ha U Trai un long uba lait im .

en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy , and after vows to make enquiry .
kha: Pyrkhat sani bha ha shuwa ba phin kular ïa ka jingainguh sha U Blei . Phi lah ban babe ïa ka hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingma ia u briew uba bam ia kata kaba khuid , bad hadien ki jingkular ban wad bniah .

en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies , that I might destroy them that hate me .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban phet krad na nga ; nga pynjot ïa kito kiba shun ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ai ruh ia nga ia ki ryndang jong ki nongshun jong nga , ba ngan pynjot ia ki kiba shun ia nga .

en: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
kha: Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar hok , ki briew kiba bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingkmen ia kiba hok ban leh ia ka jingbishar: hynrei ka jingpynjot kan long ia ki nongtrei bymman .

en: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtoreth , and served the  Lord  only .
kha: Kumta ki Israel ki bret noh ïa ki bleithaw u Baal bad ka Astarte , bad ki la mane tang ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Israel ki la weng noh ia u Baalim bad u Ashtoreth bad ki la shakri ia U Trai tang .

en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynskhem ia kajuh ha u Jakob na ka bynta ka hukum , bad ha ki Israel na ka bynta ka jutang bymjukut , .

en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .
kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit jong nga bad ma nga da ka jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka mut , ba ngan ioh jingpyntngen lang bad phi da ka jingngeit lang jong phi bad nga .

en: Therefore his sisters sent unto him , saying , Lord , behold , he whom thou lovest is sick .
kha: Kita ki kynthei shi para ki la phah khubor sha U Jisu :  Ko Trai , u paralok uba me ieit u pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki para jong u ki la phah sha u, ki da ong: Ko Trai, ha khmih uta uba me ieit u pang .

en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel s grave unto this day .
kha: U Jakob u la pynïeng u maw sahkynmaw hangta , bad u dang pynsah dak ïa ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la buh ia u maw halor ka jingtep jong ka: kata ka long ka maw jong ka jingtep jong u Rakhel haduh kine ki sngi .

en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;
kha: Haba u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan poi , u put ïa ka turoi ban maham ïa uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u iohi ia ka waitlam ba ka wan ha ka ri , u beh ia ka turoi bad u maham ia ki briew ; .

en: And could not find what they might do : for all the people were very attentive to hear him .
kha: hynrei kim shym shem ka lad ban leh ïa kata , namar baroh ki briew ki la ïai shahshkor ïa u , kim kwah ban duh noh wat kawei ka kyntien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym lah ban shem ia kaei kaba ki lah ban leh: namar ki briew baroh ki la pyrkhat bha ban iohsngew ia u .

en: And every wise hearted among you shall come , and make all that the  Lord  hath commanded  ;
kha: Baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit napdeng jong phi ki dei ban ïawan shna ïa kita baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  u la hukum :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba stad hapdeng jong phi un wan , bad un leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum;

en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .
kha: Kaba ñiewshiliang ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei don katto katne ki nongbishar ki ban leh bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka jingbamsap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban don ka jingburom ia ki briew kam long kaba bha: namar na ka bynta u kpu uba u briew un iaid lait .

en: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together , and came to Samuel unto Ramah ,
kha: Te ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel ki la ïakynduh lang , ki leit sha u Samuel ha Ramah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah Israel ki la ialum lang bad ki la poi ha u Samuel ha Ramah .

en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon , and said unto him , Ask what I shall give thee .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la mihpaw ha u Solomon bad u kylli ,  Kaei me kwah ba ngan ai ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la paw ha u Solomon bad u la ong ha u , Kylli ia kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .

en: And goeth out from Beth–el to Luz , and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth ,
kha: Na Bethel u suh sha Lus , da kaba ïaid ter ter sha Ataroth Addar , ha kaba shong ki Arkhit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mih na Bethesel sha Luz , bad ka iaid lyngba sha ki pud jong ka Archi haduh Ataroth .

en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us , so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ .
kha: Kumba ngi ïoh bynta na ki jingshah shitom babun jong U Khrist , kumta ruh , lyngba U Khrist , ngi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingïarap bakhraw jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ki jingjynjar U Khrist ki nang bun ha ngi , kumta ka jingpyntngen jong ngi ruh ka nang bun da U Khrist .

en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .
kha: Bad pynban u dei U Blei uba la pynriewspah ïa ki — ngam lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la pyndap ia ki iing jong ki da kiei kiei kiba bha: hynrei ka jingmut jong kiba sniew ka long kaba jngai na nga .

en: Now Elisabeth s full time came that she should be delivered  ; and she brought forth a son .
kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka Elisabeth ban kha , bad ka la kha khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka por ba pura jong ka Elisabeth ka la poi ba ka dei ban kha ; bad ka la kha khun shynrang .

en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him , and he shall hear thee , and thou shalt pay thy vows .
kha: Haba phi duwai , un jubab ïa phi , bad phin bat ïa ki kular ba phi la pynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban leh ia ka jingduwai jong me ha u , bad un iohsngew ia me , bad me dei ban siew ia ki jingkular jong me .

en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .
kha: Hynrei u kpu uba wan hiar na bneng u long uta ïa uba uno uno uba bam ïa u un ym ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u long u kpu uba wan hiar na bneng , ba u briew un bam ia u bad un ym iap .

en: The way of the just is uprightness : thou , most upright , dost weigh the path of the just .
kha: A  Trai  , me pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha ; ka surok kaba ki ïaid ka long kaba madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong kiba hok ka long kaba beit: me, kaba beit tam, to thew ia ka lynti jong kiba hok .

en: They are destroyed from morning to evening : they perish for ever without any regarding it .
kha: Uno uno u lah ban dang im mynstep , hynrei u ïap khlem da tip ha shuwa ba ka janmiet kan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shah pynjot naduh mynstep haduh janmiet: ki jah noh junom khlem kano kano ka jinglong ha kaba iadei bad ka .

en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him , and reigned in his stead .
kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah . Bad kumta u Baasha u long u syiem ka Israel ha ka jaka u Nadab .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ha ka snem kaba lai jong u syiem Judah u la pyniap ia u, bad u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .
kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phi ruh phin mihpaw lem bad u bad ïoh bynta ïa ka burom jong u!
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Khrist uba long ka jingim jong ngi un paw , te phin sa paw ruh bad u ha ka burom .

en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehkmen ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ha ki duriaw !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u synshar ; to ai ba ka khyndew kan kmen ; to ai ba ka jingbun ki dulir kan sngewbha ia ka .

en: And ten young men that bare Joab s armour compassed about and smote Absalom , and slew him .
kha: Nangta shiphew ngut na ki shipai jong u Joab ki ker sawdong ïa u Absalom bad pyndep ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shiphew ngut ki samla kiba phong ia ka jainkup Joab ki la ker sawdong bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Absalom , bad ki la pyniap ia u .

en: And the king answered them roughly  ; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men ,
kha: U syiem um ñiewkor ïa ki jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab ia ki da kaba jem bad u syiem Rehoboam u la iehnoh ia ka jingmut jong ki rangbah .

en: But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
kha: Kito kiba mane ïa u bad kiba leh ïa kaba dei ki long kiba la pdiang sngewbha da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ia uta uba sheptieng ia u bad uba trei ia ka hok , la pdiang ia u bad u .

en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .
kha: U phah ïa ka jingshai sha ki jaka ba-dum tliw kum ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U lap ia kiei kiei kiba jylliew na ka jingdum , bad u pynmih shabar ban pynshai ia ka jingdum jong ka jingiap .

en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;
kha: Wat ynda phi la ïoh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ban shong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lest haba me la bam bad me la dap, bad me la tei ia ki iing kiba bha, bad me shong ha ki ;

en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
kha: Wat buh jingshaniah shuh ha ki briew ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor haduh katno ?
translated_en_to_kha: To sangeh noh na u briew uba ka jingsawa jong u ka don ha ki thliew shyntur jong u: namar ha kaba u dei ban shah khein ?

en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .
kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa ka khmat jong u haduh ba u Hasael u la kem pang . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat brup .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynbeit ia ka khmat jong u da kaba stet, haduh ba u la sngewlehrain: bad u briew U Blei u la iam .

en: So the waters were healed unto this day , according to the saying of Elisha which he spake .
kha: Bad kata ka um ka la khuid naduh kata ka sngi , kumba u Elisha u la ong ba kan long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki um ki la koit haduh kane ka sngi , kat kum ka jingong jong u Elisha kaba u la kren .

en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .
kha: U Petros bad kiwei pat ki apostol ki la phai ktien ,  Ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros bad kiwei pat ki apostol ki la jubab bad ki la ong: Ngi dei ban kohnguh ia U Blei ban ia ki briew .

en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .
kha: Ka jingïap kan wan kum u nonglamktien barunar ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynkhih jingkulmar borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew u wad tang ia ka jingleh pyrshah: namarkata yn phah ia u nonglam khubor uba sniew pyrshah ia u .

en: And while he yet spake with them , Rachel came with her father s sheep : for she kept them .
kha: Katba u Jakob u dang ïakren bad ki , ka Rakhel ka la poi bad la ka kynhun langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren bad ki, ka Rakhel ka la wan ryngkat bad ki langbrot jong u kpa jong ka: namar ka la sumar ia ki .

en: And the priest shall look upon the plague , and shut up it that hath the plague seven days :
kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bha ïa ka , bad un buh kyrpang ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh haduh hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit ia ka khlam bad un khang ia kata kaba don ka khlam hynriew sngi:

en: For whom the  Lord  loveth he correcteth  ; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth .
kha: U  Trai  u pynbeit ïa kito kiba u ieit , kumba u kpa u pynbeit ïa u khun ïa uba u sngewsarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uba U Trai u ieit u pynbeit ; wat kum u kpa ia u khun ha uba u sngewbha .

en: And he said unto him , Lord , I am ready to go with thee , both into prison , and to death .
kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , nga kloi ban leit sha ka ïingbyndi bad me bad ban ïap lem bad me !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: Ko Trai, nga kloi ban leit bad me, ha phatok bad ha ka jingiap .

en: And they took their bones , and buried them under a tree at Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
kha: Nangta ki khar ïa ki shyieng bad ki tep ïa ki hapoh uwei u dieng Tamarisk uba ha kata ka shnong , bad ki ïashahjingit hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki shyieng jong ki bad ki la tep ia ki hapoh u dieng ha Jabesh bad ki la shah jingit hynriew sngi .

en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men : for all men have not faith .
kha: To duwai ruh ba U Blei un pyllait im ïa ngi na ki briew kiba bymman bad kiba sniew ; naba ym uwei pa uwei baroh u ngeit ïa ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ngin shah pyllait na ki briew ki bym don nongrim bad kiba sniew: namar ki briew baroh kim don jingngeit .

en: Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .
kha: Nga la kren palat ïa kaba nga dei ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Shisien nga la kren ; hynrei ngan ym jubab: yea, arsien; hynrei ngan ym iaid shakhmat shuh .

en: Open to me the gates of righteousness : I will go into them , and I will praise the  Lord  :
kha: To plie ïa nga ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ; ngan leit rung shapoh bad ainguh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Plie ia nga ia ki khyrdop jong ka hok: Ngan leit shapoh jong ki , bad ngan iaroh ia U Trai:

en: But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .
kha: Pynban , men leit sha ki briew u kpa jong nga , bad sha ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad jied ka tnga na ka bynta jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me leit sha ka iing u kpa jong nga bad ha ka iing jong nga bad to shim ia ka tnga ha u khun jong nga .

en: And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up : behold , I have delivered the land into his hand .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah kan leit nyngkong . Nga ai ha ki ban bat synshar ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong: U Judah un leit shaneng: ha khmih nga la aiti ia ka ri ha ka kti jong u .

en: What then ? shall we sin , because we are not under the law , but under grace ? God forbid .
kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin leh pop , namar ngim long hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei ? Ym kumta!
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata ? hato ngin leh pop, namar ngim don hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei ? U Blei u la khang .

en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , bun na ki briew , kynthup ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki sdang ban ujor pyrshah ïa ki para Jiw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingpyrta kaba khraw jong ki briew bad ki tnga jong ki pyrshah ia ki hynmen jong ki ki Jiw .

en: Then these men assembled , and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God .
kha: Haba ki nongshun jong u Daniel ki la khmih ïa u ba u duwai sha U Blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kine ki briew ki la ialum lang , bad ki la shem ia u Daniel ba u duwai bad u dang kyrpad ha khmat U Blei jong u .

en: And the ark of God was taken  ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .
kha: La knieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ki khun shynrang jong u Eli baroh ar ngut , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: La shim ia ka synduk U Blei bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Eli, u Hophni bad u Phinehas ki la shah pyniap .

en: Give unto the  Lord  , ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei , ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha U Trai, phi ki paralok jong ki briew , ai ha U Trai ia ka burom bad ka bor .

en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .
kha: Haba u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la ong ha ki ,  Duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don ha kata ka jaka , u la ong ha ki , Duwai ba phin ym rung ha ka jingpynshoi .

en: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head , because thou canst not make one hair white or black .
kha: Wat ym smai da ka khlieh jong phi , naba phim lah ban pynlieh lane pynïong ïa iwei i shñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat sngap jar da ka khlieh jong me, namar ngam lah ban pynlong ia uwei u shniuh uba lieh ne uba lieh .

en: Then said his wife unto him , Dost thou still retain thine integrity ? curse God , and die .
kha: Ka tnga jong u ka ong ha u ,  Me dang long hi uba ïaishah kumba ju long , hato kam dei kumta ? Balei mem tim ïa U Blei bad ïap noh artat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ia ka tnga jong u ha u, Hato me dang bat ia ka jinglong ba janai jong me ? tim ia U Blei bad iap .

en: And the scripture was fulfilled , which saith , And he was numbered with the transgressors .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom la pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  U la don bynta ha ka kupar ki nongpalat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pyndep ia ka jingthoh kaba ong , Bad la khein ia u bad ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .
kha: U nongmareh thong uba mareh ïa ka thong un ym lah ban ïoh ïa ka prais lymda u kohnguh ïa ki rukom pynïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew ruh u ialeh na ka bynta ki kam runar, hynrei um shym la shah pynkup burom , lait noh tang ba u ialeh katkum ka ain .

en: Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
kha: shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel ka rupa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kito kiba la shah khein na ki, ki long 8 hajar san spah sawphew snem .

en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave , though they cry in his destruction .
kha: Balei ba me tur ïaleh ïa u briew ba la jot , uta u bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh hynrei uba kyrpad ïa ka jingisynei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la un ym pynkhih ia la ka kti sha ka jingtep , wat la ki iam ha ka jingjot jong u .

en: This witness is true . Wherefore rebuke them sharply , that they may be sound in the faith ;
kha: Na kane ka daw me dei ban sneng tyngeh ïa ki , khnang ba kin don ka jingngeit kaba shisha
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka sakhi ka long kaba shisha . Namarkata to pynrem jur ia ki, ba kin long kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit ; .

en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth ? I tell you , Nay  ; but rather division :
kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la wan ban wallam ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Em , ym ka jingsuk , hynrei ka jingïapait .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi ong ba nga wan ban ai jingsuk ha ka pyrthei ? Nga ong ia phi , Em ; hynrei kham bha ban phiah:

en: I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .
kha: u lah ban ong ha u ,  Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong nga , me long U Blei jong nga ; ha me nga shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ong na U Trai , U long ka jaka rieh bad ka kut jong nga: U Blei jong nga ; ha u ngan shaniah .

en: With your Bible teacher’s help , prepare a comment that you might make at the next meeting .
kha: Lyngba ka jingïarap jong i nonghikai Baibl jong phi , pynkhreh ïa ka jubab kaba phi lah ban ai ha ka jingïalang ka ban bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingiarap jong u nonghikai Baibl jong phi, pynkhreh ia ka jingkynthoh kaba phi lah ban leh ha ka jingialang kaba hadien .

en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle , and all the vessels of the ministry .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Moses ruh u la synreit ïa ka snam halor kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang bad halor kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la theh snam ia ka Tabernak bad ki tiar jong ka jingshakri baroh .

en: Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .
kha: Balei , U Blei um shaniah wat ïa ki angel jong u ; wat ma ki kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , um shaniah ei ei ha ki riewkhuid jong u ; hooid , ki bneng kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .

en: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .
kha: Hikai ïa kiba la kham rangbah ba kin long kiba adkar , kiba tipbriew bad kiba synshar ïa lade ; kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit , ka jingieit bad ka jingïaishah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki rangbah ki long kiba jem, kiba jem, kiba jem, kiba jem, kiba sawa ha ka jingngeit, ha ka jingai sngewbha, ha ka jingshaniah .

en: Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .
kha: To wat leh kyrkieh ha kaba buh ïa ki kti halor jongno jongno ban pynkyntang ïa u sha ka kam U Trai . To wat ïadon bynta ha ki pop jong kiwei ; to ri ïa lade uba sngur .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit kynsan ia u briew, wat long u nongshim bynta na ki pop jong kiwei pat: to sumar ia lade uba khuid .

en: And David arose , and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u mihnoh , u da phet krad na u Saul , bad u la leit sha u Akhish u syiem ka Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ieng bad u la phet noh ha kata ka sngi namar ka jingtieng ia u Saul bad u la leit sha u syiem Gath .

en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .
kha: Ki khun kynthei jong phi kin hap shna ki jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongshet jingshet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ki khun kynthei jong phi ban long ki nongbam dohkha , bad ban long ki nongshet jingshet , bad ban long ki nongshet kpu .

en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .
kha: Ki Israel kin tip naduh kata ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka iing Israel kan tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki naduh kata ka sngi .

en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .
kha: To kmen , ko Israel , namar u Nongthaw jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki Israel kin sngewbha ha uta uba la pynlong ia u: to ai ba ki khun Seion kin sngewbha ha u Syiem jong ki .

en: And he said unto them ,  Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?
kha: Te U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phim sngewthuh ïa kane ka pharshi ? Kumno , te phi lah ban sngewthuh ïa kiwei pat ki pharshi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Hato phim tip ia kane ka pharshi ? bad kumno te phin ithuh ia ki pharshi baroh ?

en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .
kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban aiti ïa la ka jingim , khnang ba nga lah ban ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Kpa jong nga u ieit ia nga , namar nga aiti noh ia ka jingim jong nga , ba ngan shim biang ia ka .

en: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the  Lord  trieth the hearts .
kha: Ïa ka ksiar bad ïa ka rupa la phrang ha ka ding , bad ïa ka dohnud jong u briew la phrang da U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umphniang kaba jem ka long na ka bynta ka rupa , bad ka ding na ka bynta ka ksiar : hynrei U Trai u pyrshang ia ki dohnud .

en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery ; ( as I wrote afore in few words ,
kha: U Blei u la pynpaw shai ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u bad u la pyntip ïa ka ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno kata da ka jingpynpaw u la pynpaw ha nga ia ka jingmaham ; (kumba nga la thoh mynshuwa da ki kyntien kiba rit , .

en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .
kha: Ki kti jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynta kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong me ki la pynlong ia nga bad ki la pynlong ia nga sawdong baroh sawdong .

en: And they brought the colt to Jesus , and cast their garments on him  ; and he sat upon him .
kha: Ki la wallam ïa uta u kada ha U Jisu , ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor uta u khun kada , bad U Jisu u la shong halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia u khun masi ha U Jisu bad ki la bret ia ki jain jong ki ha u ; bad u la shong halor jong u .

en: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin s neck , and wept  ; and Benjamin wept upon his neck .
kha: U piam ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , bad u ïam . U Benjamin ruh u ïa-ïam lang katba u dang piam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hap ha ka ryndang jong u hynmen jong u, bad u la iam ; bad u Benjamin u la iam ha ka ryndang jong u .

en: And what he hath seen and heard , that he testifieth  ; and no man receiveth his testimony .
kha: U ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi bad la ïohsngew , pynban ym don ba pdiang ïa ka khubor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaba u la iohi bad iohsngew , ba u la sakhi ; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba pdiang ia ka jingsakhi jong u .

en: And he answered , Fear not : for they that be with us are more than they that be with them .
kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Elisha u jubab .  Ngi don kham bun ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba ki don ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la jubab: Wat tieng: namar kito kiba don ryngkat bad ngi ki kham bun ban ia kita kiba don ryngkat bad ki .

en: Yea , the light of the wicked shall be put out , and the spark of his fire shall not shine .
kha: Ïa ka jingshai jong u briew basniew yn pynlip sah ; ki thylliej ding jong ka kin ym meh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ka jingshai jong u bymman kan sa jah noh , bad ka jingshai jong ka ding jong u kan ym shai .

en: When it shall hail , coming down on the forest  ; and the city shall be low in a low place .
kha: ( Hynrei u phria un hap ha ki khlaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn pynjot . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ka la hiar ha ka khlaw ; bad ka shnong kan long kaba rit ha ka jaka kaba rit .

en: There is gold , and a multitude of rubies : but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel .
kha: Lada phi tip shaphang kaei kaba phi kren , phi don ei ei kaba kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar ne ki mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka ksiar , bad ka jingbun ki mawkordor: hynrei ki rmiang shyntur jong ka jingtip ki long ka mawkordor kaba kordor .

en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment ? wilt thou condemn me , that thou mayest be righteous ?
kha: Hato me pyrshang ban pynshisha ba nga long u bymhok — ban buh ïa nga ha ka bymdei bad ïa lade ha kaba dei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ruh phin pynrem ia ka jingbishar jong nga ? phin pynrem ia nga , ba me long uba hok ?

en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! saith the  Lord .
kha: Katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ka jingbishar U  Trai  ïa kita ki nongsynshar kiba pynjot bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: To long ha ki nongaplangbrot kiba pynjot bad pynphriang ia ki langbrot jong nga ! ong U Trai .

en: He said unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  Peter answering said , The Christ of God .
kha: Kumno pat ma phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ong ba nga long uei ?  U Petros u la jubab ,  Me long U Messaïah jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Hynrei phi ong ba nga long mano ? U Petros u la jubab u la ong , U Khrist U Blei .

en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
kha: Ngan ïada ïa kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan iada ia kane ka shnong ban pynim ia ka na ka bynta jong nga hi , bad na ka bynta u Dabid jong nga .

en: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin long kum ma nga . La shisha , nga long hi kum ma phi . Phim shym la leh sniew ei ei ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko para bangeit, nga kyrpad ia phi, to long kumba nga long; namar nga long kumba phi long: phim shym la pynmynsaw ia nga satia .

en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul : he that keepeth understanding shall find good .
kha: Lehbha ïa lade bad wad jinghikai kat kaba phi lah ; nangta kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi ïoh jinghikai bad phin manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ioh ia ka jingstad u ieit ia la ka jong ka mynsiem: uta uba bat ia ka jingsngewthuh un shem ia kaba bha .

en: The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
kha: Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh junom , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong U Trai ka ieng junom , ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud jong u ha ki pateng baroh .

en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram  ; and the elders of Israel followed him .
kha: Nangta u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , ki la leit sha u Dathan bad u Abiram .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ieng bad u la leit sha u Datan bad u Abiram ; bad ki rangbah Israel ki la bud ia u .

en: And if he have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father s brethren .
kha: Lada um don hynmen ne para shynrang , ki hynmen ki para shynrang u kpa jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada um don hynmen , te phin ai ia ka pateng jong u ha ki hynmen kpa jong u .

en: Their enemies also oppressed them , and they were brought into subjection under their hand .
kha: Ki la shah banbeiñ ha ki nongshun jong ki bad ki la long nadong shadong hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshun jong ki ruh ki la pynshitom bein ia ki , bad la wanrah ia ki hapoh ka kti jong ki .

en: Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?
kha: Hato me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw jong u bad khmih lynti ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me shaniah ha u , namar ka bor jong u ka long kaba khraw ? lane phin iehnoh ia ka jingtrei shitom jong me ha u ?

en: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .
kha: Uba lorni u thad ïa kaba la buhrieh , hynrei phi lah ban buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha uba lah ban buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongrah khana u pynpaw ia ki jingmaham: hynrei uta uba long na ka mynsiem kaba iaineh u buhrieh ia ka kam .

en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .
kha: Pha bud ha ki dien jat ka hynmen jong pha , bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iaid ha ka lynti jong ka para jong me ; namarkata ngan ai ia ka khuri jong ka ha ka kti jong me .

en: And the  Lord  came down to see the city and the tower , which the children of men builded .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la wan hiar ban khmih ïa kata ka nongbah bad ïa uta u mot uba ki la lah tei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wan hiar ban peit ia ka shnong bad ka tower kaba ki khun shynrang ki la tei .

en: And Ish–bosheth sent , and took her from her husband , even from Phaltiel the son of Laish .
kha: Kumta u Ishbosheth u phah shim noh ïa ka na u tnga jong ka , u Paltiel u khun jong u Laish .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishbosheth u la phah, bad u la shim ia ka na u tnga jong ka, wat na u Phaltiel u khun u Laish .

en: Be not over much wicked , neither be thou foolish : why shouldest thou die before thy time ?
kha: Hynrei wat long kiba sniew palat ne kiba bieit palat , ym kawei ruh na ki — balei phin ïap haba phim pat dei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long uba sniew palat, lymne me uba bieit: balei me dei ban iap shuwa ka por jong me ?

en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand : but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .
kha: Ka jinglong jaipdeh kan pynlong ïa phi ban kyrduh , hynrei ka jingtrei shitom kan pynriewspah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U long uba duk uba iadei bad ka kti kaba jem: hynrei ka kti jong uba minot ka pynlong ia u uba riewspah .

en: But he turned , and rebuked them , and said ,  Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of .
kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la dumok ïa ki bad u la ong ,  Phim tip phi dei na u jait Mynsiem aïu ; naba U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jong ki briew , hynrei ban pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la phai bad u la kren bein ia ki bad u la ong: Phim tip ia ka mynsiem kaba phi long .

en: Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
kha: Baroh kaba ki kyntu ka long ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrduh ha ka kynhun jong ki , kaba nga hi ruh nga da kwah eh ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki kwah ba ngin kynmaw ia kiba duk ; kajuh kaba nga ruh nga la thrang ban leh .
