en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning , that we should love one another .
kha: Ka khubor kaba phi la ïohsngew naduh kaba mynnyngkong hi ka long kane : Ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka khubor kaba phi la iohsngew naduh kaba sdang , ba ngi dei ban iaieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And Joseph dreamed a dream , and he told it his brethren : and they hated him yet the more .
kha: Shisien u Joseph u la phohsniew , bad haba u la ïathuh ïa ka ha la ki hynmen shynrang , ki la kham isih shuh shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la phohsniew ia ka jingphohsniew, bad u la iathuh ia ka ha ki hynmen jong u: bad ki la shun ia u kham bun .

en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lada phi shah ban otsher ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei lei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga Paul nga ong ha phi , ba lada phi shah ot , U Khrist un ym pynmyntoi ei ei ia phi .

en: Then Saul , ( who also is called Paul , ) filled with the Holy Ghost , set his eyes on him ,
kha: Te ïa u Saul — ïa uba la khot ruh u Paul — la pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ; u la khmih shlip ïa uta u nongleh myntor bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul (u ba la khot ruh u Paul) u la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la buh ia ki khmat jong u ha u .

en: My brethren , be not many masters , knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ym dei shibun na phi ban long ki nonghikai . Kumba phi tip , ma ngi ki nonghikai ngin sa shah bishar kham pyrkhing ban ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong nga , wat long kiba bun ki kynrad , da kaba tip ba ngin sa ioh ia ka jingpynrem kaba kham khraw .

en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit , they are created : and thou renewest the face of the earth .
kha: Hynrei haba me ai pat ha ki ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , la thaw ïa ki ; me ai ka jingim bathymmai ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me phah ia ka mynsiem jong me, la thaw ia ki: bad me pynthymmai ia ka khmat jong ka khyndew .

en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor  ; yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .
kha: Ka long kaba sbun ïa kiba duk , bad kiba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pynkhih ia la ka kti sha kiba duk ; yea , ka kner ia ki kti jong ka sha kiba duk .

en: This is the land that yet remaineth : all the borders of the Philistines , and all Geshuri ,
kha: Baroh ka ri jong ka Philistia bad ka Geshur ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka ri kaba dang sah: ki pud ki sam jong ki Philistia baroh bad ki Geshuri baroh .

en: Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it .
kha: Hikai ïa u khynnah kumno u dei ban im , bad un kynmaw ïa ka baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia u khynnah ha ka rukom kaba u dei ban leit: bad ynda u la tymmen , un ym phet noh na ka .

en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling , and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees .
kha: Haba uno uno u jynthut , u tlot bad u lwait , ki ktien jong me ki kyrshan ïa u ban ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong me ki la pynskhem ia uta uba la hap , bad me la pynskhem ia ki kjat kiba tlot .

en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .
kha: Lada phi kwah ban long kiba kmen , to lehsbun ïa kiba duk ; ka long ka pop ban ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba lehbein ia u paramarjan jong u u leh pop: hynrei uta uba isynei ia kiba duk , u long uba suk .

en: And David sent to Joab , saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite . And Joab sent Uriah to David .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u la phah ktien sha u Joab :  Phah sha nga ïa u Uriah u nong Hit .  Kumta u Joab u phah ïa u sha u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah sha u Joab, u da ong, To phah ia nga ia u Hiti . Bad u Joab u la phah ia u Uri ha u Dabid .

en: The officer said the couple apparently did not have a happy marriage and had frequent fights
kha: U ophisar u la ong ba kine ki arngut kumba ka paw kim shym la don ka jingshongkha kaba suk bad ki ju ialeh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: U ophisar u la ong ba ki arngut kumba ka paw kim don ka jingshongkha kaba suk bad ki ju ialeh .

en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .
kha: Lada phi shah ba uba bieit un sam ïa ka khubor , ka long kumba ot ïa la ki jong ki kjat ; phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba phah khubor da ka kti jong u bieit u ot noh ia ki kjat bad u dih ia ka jingpynjot .

en: And they said , Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ , and thou shalt be saved , and thy house .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  To ngeit ha U Trai Jisu , bad yn sa pynim ïa me — ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ngeit ha U Trai Jisu Khrist bad me long uba la pynim bad ka iing jong me .

en: DR Shullai, Principal Synod Higher Secondary School, along with the parents of the children.
kha: D.R.Shullai, Principal Synod Higher Secondary School, lem bad ki kmie ki kpa jong ki khynnah.
translated_en_to_kha: DR Shullai, Principal Synod Higher Secondary School, ryngkat bad ki kmie ki kpa jong ki khynnah.

en: One law shall be to him that is homeborn , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you .
kha: Kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kin teh kumjuh ïa ki traishnong bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka hukum kan long ha uta uba la kha ha iing bad ha u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong phi .

en: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah , Let no man know of these words , and thou shalt not die .
kha: U Sedekaïah u la jubab ,  Wat ai ba uno uno ruh un tip ïa kane ka jingïakren , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym don ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u la ong ha u Jeremaiah, Wat ai ba uno uno un tip ia kine ki ktien bad me wat iap .

en: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?
kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , te , kaei kaba me pyrkhat ? Hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ban siew khajna sha u Patsha ka hima Rom , ne kam long ?
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia ngi namarkata , Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ? Hato ka long kaba dei ban ai khajna ia u Kaisar ne em ?

en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness : for they shall be filled .
kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingangnud bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; U Blei un pynhun jrut ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kito kiba thngan bad sliang hadien ka hok: namar kin sa dap .

en: And he was angry , and would not go in : therefore came his father out , and entreated him .
kha: U hynmen u la bitar haduh katta katta ba um shym leit shapoh ïing ; kumta u kpa jong u , u la mih shabar bad kyrpad ïa u ban rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bitar , bad um shym la leit shapoh: namar kata u kpa jong u u la mih noh , bad u la kyrpad ia u .

en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka Templ , u tei ïa ki duwan na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa ki khlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tei ia ki nongleh kam sniew baroh ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward , and went down unto Arabah :
kha: bad u ïaid lyngba na shatei jong ka sharing lum na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta u hiar arsut sha ka them ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid sha shiliang shaphang ka liang mihngi shaphang shathie, bad u la leit hiar sha ka liang mihngi:

en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?
kha: Hato ym dei ba ïa ki san tylli ki sim ïing la die tang ar pisa ? Pynban ym don kawei ruh ka sim ïing ïa kaba la klet noh da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym don san tylli ki sim ba la die na ka bynta ar tylli ki jaka jngai , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la klet ha khmat U Blei ?

en: And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta , ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la dap shiphew snem ka rta, ki la leit sha Jerusalem hadien ka rukom lehkmen .

en: And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the  Lord  yonder .
kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga nang leit ïakynduh ïa U Blei hangtai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Balak , To ieng hangne da ka jingainguh thang jong me, katba nga dang iakynduh ia U Trai hangta .

en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :
kha: Wat ïabam ha ka miej u briew uba khapnap lane uba kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam ia u kpu jong uta uba don ka khmat kaba sniew, lymne me kwah ia ki doh ba bang jong u:

en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked , to overthrow the righteous in judgment .
kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynksan ïa uba la rem bad ban khang ïa uba lui lui na kaba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam long kaba bha ban pdiang ia ka briew jong kiba sniew , ban pynhap ia kiba hok ha ka jingbishar .

en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,
kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba nga ïohsngew ïa kaba phi la ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me la kren ha ka jingsngap jong nga , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong me da kaba ong:

en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .
kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun bad phi lah ban sngewsarong borabor ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shah lehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia u khun jong me, bad un ai ia me ia ka jingjahthait ; hooid , un ai jingsngewbha ia ka mynsiem jong me .

en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .
kha: Uno uno uba dang dih dud u dang long u khynnah , khlem pat don kano kano ka jingshemphang ïa kaei kaba dei bad ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei uba pyndonkam ia ka dud u long u bym tbit ha ka ktien ka hok: namar u long u babe .

en: He divideth the sea with his power , and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud .
kha: Ka dei ka jingkhlaiñ jong u kaba jop ïa ka duriaw ; da ka jingtbit jong u , u pynjot ïa u Rahab u mrad kynsha .
translated_en_to_kha: U phiah ia ka duriaw da ka bor jong u , bad da ka jingsngewthuh jong u u iaid lyngba ia kiba sngew sarong .

en: For whosoever shall keep the whole law , and yet offend in one point , he is guilty of all .
kha: Uno uno uba pynkheiñ ïa kawei ka hukum u long uba shah pynrem ha kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno u briew un sumar ia ka hukum baroh kawei , bad wat la katta ruh ha kawei ka por , u long uba don pop na baroh .

en: I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would say unto me .
kha: Nga kwah ban tip kaei ba un ong bad kumno un jubab ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan tip ia ki kyntien kiba un jubab ia nga , bad ngan sngewthuh ia kaei kaba un ong ha nga .

en: When the wicked rise , men hide themselves : but when they perish , the righteous increase .
kha: Ki briew kin buhrieh ïa lade haba ki briew kiba sniew ki wan ha ka bor . Hynrei ynda ki hap na ka bor , kiba hok kin synshar biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki bymman ki kiew, ki briew ki buhrieh ia lade: hynrei haba ki jah noh , ki hok ki nang kiew .

en: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city , and his servants did besiege it .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingkerkut u Nebukhadnessar da lade hi u la wan sha Jerusalem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon u la wan pyrshah ia ka shnong bad ki shakri jong u ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka .

en: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth  ; and the earth was reaped .
kha: Te uta uba shong halor u lyoh u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , bad la ïohlum ïa ka jingot jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba shong ha u lyoh u la rung ha ka lyngkhot jong u ha ka khyndew ; bad ka khyndew ka la ot .

en: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .
kha: Haba kin ïap , kin leit phai pat sha ka khyndew ; ha kata ka sngi baroh ki jingthmu jong ki kin sa kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong u ka leit sha khmat, u leit phai biang sha ka khyndew jong u ; ha kata hi ka sngi ki jingpyrkhat jong u ki jah noh .

en: In a tweet Mr Naidu hoped that Goddess Durga will bless people with her choicest blessings .
kha: Ha ka tweet jong u Mr Naidu u la kyrmen ba ka Blei Durga kan kyrkhu ia ki briew da ki jingkyrkhu kiba bha tam jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka tweet u Mr Naidu u la kyrmen ba ka Durga kan kyrkhu ia ki briew da ki jingkyrkhu ba la jied jong ka .

en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ .
kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Khrist Jisu , ïa phi kiba la ju long jngai la wallam hajan da ka jingïap kaba long ka jingkñia U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ha U Khrist Jisu phi kiba la jngai teng teng la pynlong ia phi da ka snam U Khrist .

en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .
kha: U nongaikam uba khot bylla ïa uno uno uba bieit uba u ïakynduh , u long tang ban pynmynsaw kat ïa kiba ïatreilang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei uba khraw uba la thaw ia kiei kiei baroh arngut u ai khusnam ia kiba bieit bad u ai khusnam ia ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .
kha: Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew bad kin kyang , bad ka nongbah hi kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shong ha madan kaba la shah sloit lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khyrdop jong ka kin iam bad iam bad ka la jah rngai noh bad ka la shong ha ka khyndew .

en: Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?
kha: Hato ym don u ban jubab ïa kane ka jingkren bieit baroh ? Hato kaba kren bunktien ka pynksan ïa u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym dei ban jubab ia ka jingbun ki kyntien ? bad hato u briew uba dap da ka jingiakren u dei ban long uba hok ?

en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her , so that he shall have no need of spoil .
kha: U tnga jong ka u buh ka jingshaniah jong u ha ka , bad un ym kyrduh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u tnga jong ka ka shaniah ha ka da kaba suk , kumta un ym donkam ia ka jingsniew .

en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .
kha: Dei u Jotham uba tei ïa ka Khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la tei pynheh shuh shuh ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Ophel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei ia ka khyrdop kaba jrong jong ka iing U Trai , bad ha ka kynroh jong ka Ophel u la tei shibun .

en: God forbid that I should justify you : till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me .
kha: Ngan nym ong ruh ba ma phi ki briew phim shym bakla ; ngan ïai ban ïa ka jinglui lui jong nga haduh ka sngi ba ngan sa ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la khang ba ngan pynshisha ia phi: haduh ba ngan da iap ngan ym weng noh ia ka jinglong ba janai jong nga na nga .

en: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .
kha: Ki la pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki jingleh jong ki bad ki la long bymïaineh ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shah pynsniew ha la ki jong ki kam, bad ki la leit sha ka jaka ri jingri da ki jingpynmih jong ki hi .

en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever  ;
kha: Ka lah ban long ba u Onesimos u la don jngai na me katto katne por khnang ba men ïoh pat ïa u ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lehse u la leit noh na ka bynta ka aiom , ba me dei ban pdiang ia u junom ; .

en: So he let him go : then she said , A bloody husband thou art , because of the circumcision .
kha: Te ka Sipporah ka tnga jong u , ka la shim ïa u maw uba nep , ka otsher ïa u khun jong ka , nangta ka pyndei tiak da ka doh otsher ïa ki kjat    u Moses . Namar ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher ka la ong ha u Moses ,  Me long u tnga da ka snam ïa nga .     Kumta U  Trai  u la pynsah ïa ka jingim u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la pyllait noh ia u: nangta ka la ong, U tnga uba snam me long , namar ka jingotsher .

en: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth  ; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger  ;
kha: Ho-oid , ki nongwei kin ïohknieh ïa ka spah jong phi baroh , bad kaei kaba phi la trei shitom kan long ka jong kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki nongwei kin pyndap ia ka spah jong me ; bad ki jingtrei shitom jong me kin long ha iing u nongwei ; .

en: As for me , behold , my covenant is with thee , and thou shalt be a father of many nations .
kha: Nga pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad me : Nga kular ba men long u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga, ha khmih, ka jutang jong nga ka long bad me, bad me phin long u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew .

en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
kha: Phi myntoi ïa lade haba phi bha sbun . Haba phi leh ki kam runar , phi pynmynsaw hi ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sngewrit u leh bha ia la ka jong ka mynsiem: hynrei uta uba sniew u pynshitom ia la ka jong ka doh .

en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah :  Nga la jan ban pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia u Serubabel u Lat ka Judah da kaba ong , Ngan pynkhih ia ki bneng bad ka khyndew ; .

en: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel .
kha: Kumjuh ruh , U Trai u la hukum ba kito kiba ïalap ïa ka gospel kin dei ban ïoh ïa la bam na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh U Trai u la buh ba kito kiba ialap ia ka gospel kin im na ka gospel .

en: No mention shall be made of coral , or of pearls : for the price of wisdom is above rubies .
kha: Ka dor jong ka jingstad ka long palat ban ïa ki paila lane ki mawleiñ lane ki mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym dei ban kdew ia u mawkordor , ne ki mawkordor: namar ka dor jong ka jingstad ka long halor ki ruby .

en: Their seed is established in their sight with them , and their offspring before their eyes .
kha: Ki don ki khun bad ki khun ksiew , bad ki im ban khmih ïa ki baroh ba ki heh ki san ;
translated_en_to_kha: U symbai jong ki u la skhem ha ka jingpeit jong ki bad ki , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ha khmat ki khmat jong ki .

en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iehnoh ia ki, bad u la leit noh biang, bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai da kaba ong ia kijuh ki kyntien .

en: I desire to be present with you now , and to change my voice ; for I stand in doubt of you .
kha: Katno nga da kwah eh ban ïadon bad phi mynta , khnang ba nga lah ban sngew da kumwei pat shaphang jong phi . Nga sngewkhuslai shikatdei eh shaphang jong phi!
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kwah ban don ryngkat bad phi mynta , bad ban pynkylla ia ka sur jong nga ; namar nga ieng ha ka jingartatien ia phi .

en: The Government shall act in accordance with the rules of law in the appointment of teachers.
kha: Ka sorkar kan leh katkum ki kyndon ka ain ha kaba thung ia ki nonghikai.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sorkar kan leh katkum ki kyndon ain ha kaba thung ia ki nonghikai.

en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea : therefore my words are swallowed up .
kha: yn shem ba kin kham khia ban ïa u shyiap ka duriaw , kumta ki ktien khlem da pyrkhat jong nga kim dei ban pynlyngngoh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta mynta kan kham heh ban ia ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw: namarkata ki ktien jong nga ki la shah rong noh .

en: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .
kha: U la ïohi ruh ba u Laban um da leh jan shuh ïa u kumba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la iohi ia ka khmat u Laban bad, ha khmih, kam shym la long ha u kumba ju long mynshuwa .

en: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God  ; and to them were given seven trumpets .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba ïeng ha khmat U Blei , bad la ai ha ki , hynñiew tylli ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia ki hynriew ngut ki angel kiba ieng ha khmat U Blei ; bad la ai ha ki hynriew tylli ki turoi .

en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion s whelps are scattered abroad .
kha: Kum ki sing ki bym don ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam , ki ïap , bad ki khun jong ki baroh ki sakma .
translated_en_to_kha: U sing uba la rim u jah noh namar ka jingbym don u mrad , bad ki bniat jong u sing kiba heh ki la bthei shabar ri .

en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation , which sing among the branches .
kha: Halor ki dieng ba don hajan , ki sim ki thaw ïa ki skum jong ki bad ki rwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki ki sim bneng kin don ka jaka shong jong ki , kiba rwai hapdeng ki tnat .

en: And the  Lord  answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words .
kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u angel da ki kyntien pyntngen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la jubab ia u angel uba la kren bad nga da ki ktien kiba bha bad kiba suk .

en: Then said David to Jonathan , Who shall tell me ? or what if thy father answer thee roughly ?
kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ,  Mano ban pyntip ïa nga lada i pa jong phi i kren dom ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u Jonathan , Mano ba iathuh ia nga ? lane kumno lada u kpa jong me u jubab ia me da kaba lyngkot ?

en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .
kha: ( Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .
translated_en_to_kha: (Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh shibun ban iehnoh ia kine ki jinglong .

en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .
kha: U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot kyrpad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong u ha nga , namarkata ngan khot ia u katba nga dang im .

en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;
kha: Me long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba map , wat la ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi ki long ki jingsngewsih bad ki jingmap , wat la ngi la leh pyrshah ia u ; .

en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .
kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew . Hynrei ban bam khlem da thet ïa ki kti jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban leh kumta — Kane kam pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynjakhlia ia u briew: hynrei ban bam da ki kti bym pat tyrkhong ym da u briew .

en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
kha: Hynrei lada baroh kin wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong nga , ngan ym shem wat tang uwei ruh na ki ba u long uba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi baroh, to wan phai, bad to wan mynta: namar ngam lah ban shem ia uwei u briew uba stad hapdeng jong phi .

en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .
kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki pyrta ha U Trai ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , bad u pynim ia ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki .

en: The Bible alone tells us what we must do to please God .—Psalm 1 :1-3  ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
kha: Dei tang ka Baibl kaba ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .—Salm 1 :1-3 ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Baibl marwei ka iathuh ia ngi ia kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ban pynsngewbha ia U Blei . ‡ Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .

en: Behold , the day of the  Lord  cometh , and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee .
kha: Ka sngi ha kaba U  Trai  un shong ha ka khet bishar ka la jan . Te ïa ka Jerusalem yn sa lute , bad ïa ka jinglute yn sa pynïabynta ha ka jingïohi jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka sngi U Trai ka wan bad ka jingjot jong me kan sa phiah hapdeng jong me .

en: For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .
kha: Namar don uwei u kpu , baroh na ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met , naba ngi baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long kiba bun ki long uwei u kpu, bad kawei ka met: namar ngi long baroh ki nongiashim bynta ha uta u kpu .

en: Therefore they say unto God , Depart from us  ; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways .
kha: Ki bymman ki ong ïa U Blei ba un ieh ïa ki ha la ka mon jong ki ; kim kwah ban tip ïa ka mon jong u ha ka jingim jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki ong ha U Blei , To leit noh na ngi ; namar ngim kwah ia ka jingtip ia ki lynti jong me .

en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .
kha: Un ri sumar ïa me na ki jingma barieh baroh bad na ki jingpang bashyrkhei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid un pyllait ia me na ka jingma kaba khraw .

en: For he will not lay upon man more than right  ; that he should enter into judgment with God .
kha: Ym da donkam ba U Blei un buh por ïa ki briew ban leit bad ba yn bishar ïa ki da u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un ym thiah ha u briew kham palat ia ka hok ; ba un rung ha ka jingbishar bad U Blei .

en: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the  Lord  above all that were before him .
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  palat ban ïa uno uno na kiba ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u khun jong u Omri u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai halor kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha khmat jong u .

en: But he said unto them ,  All men cannot receive this saying , save they to whom it is given .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kane ka jinghikai kam treikam ïa baroh , hynrei tang ha kito kiba U Blei u la ai ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki , Baroh ki briew kim lah ban pdiang ia kane ka jingong , lait noh tang kito kiba la ai ia ka .

en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .
kha: Nangta ki la sdang ban kylli para ma ki uno napdeng jong ki uba lah ban long u ban sa leh ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sdang ban kylli hapdeng jong ki , mano na ki ba dei ban leh ia kane ka kam .

en: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God , and of Jesus our Lord ,
kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ba-dap pura kin long ki jong phi lyngba ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei bad ïa U Jisu U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kan nang bun ha phi lyngba ka jingtip ia U Blei bad ia U Jisu U Trai jong ngi .

en: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name s sake .
kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar ïa ki pop jong phi la map na ka bynta U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga thoh sha phi ko khun rit , namar la map ia ki pop jong phi na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .

en: I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .
kha: Nga la thoh ki jinghikai bym lah ñiew shuh na ka bynta ki briew , hynrei ki kyntait ïa ki kum kaei kaei kaba khyllah bad long nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la thoh ha u ia kiei kiei kiba khraw jong ka ain jong nga , hynrei la khein ia ki kum kaei kaei kaba phylla .

en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and saddled his ass , and went with the princes of Moab .
kha: Kumta ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u teh jin ïa la ka kada , bad u leit bad kita ki nongïalam jong ki Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la khie dang step, bad u la sngap jar ia ka tdong jong u bad u la leit bad ki syiem jong ka ri Moab .

en: Children : “Children , be obedient to your parents in union with the Lord .”—Ephesians 6 :1 .
kha: Ki khun : “Phi ki khun to kohnguh ia la ki kmie ki kpa ha U Trai .” —Ephesos 6 :1 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah: Ki khynnah , to long kiba kohnguh ia ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ha ka jingiadei bad U Trai .  Ephesos 6:1 .

en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means . The Lord be with you all .
kha: To ai ba U Trai hi , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , un ai ha phi ka jingsuk ha ki por baroh bad ha ka jingim jong phi baroh . U Trai un long lem bad phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai jong ka jingsuk hi u ai jingsuk ia phi man ka por da ki lad baroh . U Trai un long bad phi baroh .

en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .
kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: O ainguh ia U Trai ; khot ia ka kyrteng jong u: pynpaw ia ki kam jong u hapdeng ki briew .

en: The spirit of man is the candle of the  Lord  , searching all the inward parts of the belly .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingpyrkhat bad ka jingïatiplem ; ngim lah ban rieh na lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong u briew ka long ka sharak jong U Trai , ka wad ia ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka kpoh baroh .

en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the children of Ammon made war against Israel .
kha: Ka long hadien katto katne por ba ki Ammon ki leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por ba ki khun Ammon ki la ialeh thma pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: Verily I say unto you , that this generation shall not pass , till all these things be done .
kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei kin jia shuwa ba ki briew kiba dang im mynta , ki la ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi ba kane ka pateng kan ym iaid , haduh ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin da jia .

en: Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !
kha: Hato U Blei um shong ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam bad jngoh shapoh ïa ki khlur , wat la ki don hajrong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Blei um don ha ka jingjrong jong ka bneng ? bad ha khmih ka jingjrong jong ki khlur , katno ki long kiba jrong !

en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow  ; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap .
kha: Lada phi ap haduh ba ka lyer bad ka jinglong ka suiñbneng kin bit kin biang , da lei lei phin ym thung ei ei bad phin ym ïoh ot ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba peit ia ka Iyer un ym bet ; bad uta uba peit ia ki lyoh un ym kheit .

en: Later he was admitted to the Bengali language and literature department of Dhaka University .
kha: Hadien la pynrung ia u sha ka tnad jong ka ktien Bengali bad ka thoh ka tar jong ka Dhaka University .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien la pdiang ia u ha ka tnad thoh ka tar bad ka thoh ka tar jong ka Dhaka University .

en: And Joshua blessed him , and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .
kha: U Joshua u la kyrkhu ïa u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh bad u la ai ha u ïa ka nongbah Hebron kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la kyrkhu ia u bad u la ai ha u Caleb ia u khun u Jephunneh Hebron na ka bynta ka pateng .

en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .
kha: To ai ki jingkhublei jong ngi sha baroh ki nongïalam jong phi bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh . Ki parabangeit jong ngi na Italy ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kita baroh kiba don ka jingsynshar halor jong phi , bad ki riewkhuid baroh . Ki jong ka Italy ki ai khublei ia phi .

en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue , my spirit prayeth , but my understanding is unfruitful .
kha: Naba lada nga duwai ha kane ka rukom , ka mynsiem jong nga ka duwai da shisha , hynrei ka jingmut jong nga kam don bynta ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga duwai da ka shyntur bym tip , ka mynsiem jong nga ka duwai , hynrei ka jingsngewthuh jong nga ka long kaba khlem soh .

en: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven , he also having a sharp sickle .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel ba u wan mihnoh na ka Templ ha bneng , bad u ruh u la don ka rashi kaba nep .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u angel u la mih na ka tempi kaba don ha bneng , ma u ruh u don ka waitlam kaba jem .

en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain , and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand .
kha: Uba ar ha ka kyrdan u dei u Jehohanan uba don ar lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki shipai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hajan jong u la don u rangbah shipai , bad bad u arspah saw hajar .

en: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth .
kha: Kynmaw ruh ban ym leh klet ïa ki Lebi katba phi dang shong ha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: To shim ia lade ba me ym iehnoh ia u Lebi katba me dang im ha ka khyndew .

en: And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .
kha: Shibun kin iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ha kata ka por ; kin ïashetkylla iwei ïa iwei pat bad kin isih iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta bun kin sngewsih iwei ia iwei pat bad kin ia tyngkhuh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And Saul was afraid of David , because the  Lord  was with him , and was departed from Saul .
kha: U Saul u sheptieng ïa u Dabid namar ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid hynrei U la kynriah noh na u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la tieng ia u Dabid namar U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u bad u la leit noh na u Saul .

en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers : for thereby some have entertained angels unawares .
kha: Da kynmaw ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei ha ki ïing jong phi . Don kiba la leh kumta bad pdiang sngewbha ïa ki angel khlem da tip ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat klet ban pynbyrngia ia ki nongwei: namar da kata don kiba la pynbyrngia ia ki angel khlem da tip .

en: And as some spake of the temple , how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts , he said ,
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran ki dang ïakren shaphang ka Templ , ba katno ka long kaba itynnat lem bad ki maw bajlih jong ka bad ki jingai ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba la pynitynnad ia ka tempi , kumno la pynitynnad ia ka da ki maw bad ki jingai sngewbha kiba bha , u la ong , .

en: Saying ,  What think ye of Christ ? whose son is he ?  They say unto him , The Son of David .
kha: Phi pyrkhat kumno shaphang u Messaïah ? U dei u nonghiarpateng jongno ?   U dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Phi pyrkhat aiu ia U Khrist ? u khun jongno ? Ki ong ha u , U Khun u Dabid .

en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword : but the tongue of the wise is health .
kha: Ki ktien ba khlem da pyrkhat ki lah ban pynmong jylliew kum kano kano ka waitlam , hynrei ki ktien ba kren ha ka jingstad ki lah ban pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba kren kum ki jingpynbthei jong ka waitlam: hynrei ka shyntur jong kiba stad ka long ka jingkoit jingkhiah .

en: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .
kha: Nangta u Petros u la jubab .  Ko Trai , lada dei shisha ma me , hukum ïa nga ban wan sha me halor ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la jubab ia u bad u la ong, ko Trai, lada me long ma me, to khot ia nga ban wan sha me ha ka um .

en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong pha !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka , Na ka bynta kane ka jingong to leit noh na ka khun jong me .

en: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing , he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u tip ei ei , ha ka jingshisha um tip kumba u dei ban tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u pyrkhat ba u tip ei ei , um tip ei ei haduh mynta kumba u dei ban tip .

en: My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .
kha: Mem shym la ai ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta ka khlieh jong nga , hynrei ka la tap ïa ka khlieh jong nga da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong nga da ka umphniang me khlem pynsleh: hynrei kane ka kynthei ka la pynsleh ia ki kjat jong nga da ka umphniang .

en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him , and given him a name which is above every name :
kha: Na kane ka daw U Blei u la kyntiew eh ïa u sha ka jaka kaba hajrong tam eh , bad ai ha u ïa ka kyrteng kaba kham khraw ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata U Blei ruh u la pynkhraw shibun ia u, bad u la ai ia u ia ka kyrteng kaba kham halor ka kyrteng baroh:

en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it  ; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin .
kha: Phi dei ban isih ïa uno uno uba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa u da ka jinglamler . Ka jingkren bymshisha kam wanrah ei ei hynrei ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur kaba thok ka shun ia kito kiba shah pynshitom ha ka ; bad ka shyntur kaba sngewtynnad ka pynjot .

en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .
kha: Kiba hok ki don kyrhai ban bam , hynrei ki bymman ki shahthngan borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok u bam ia ka jingpynhun ia ka mynsiem jong u: hynrei ka kpoh jong kiba sniew kan kwah .

en: And the south , and the plain of the valley of Jericho , the city of palm trees , unto Zoar .
kha: ka bynta bashathie jong ka ri Judah ; bad ka ri thor kaba ïar naduh Soar haduh Jerikho , ka shnong ki dieng Tlai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang shathie bad ka madan Jerikoh , ka shnong ki dieng sohjew haduh Zoar .

en: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .
kha: Ka jingieit ka dei ban long kaba sngur . To isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , to batskhem ïa kaei kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka jingieit kan long khlem ka jingpynkylla dur . Pynbeit ia kata kaba sniew ; ban bat ia kata kaba bha .

en: And Gederoth , Beth–dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah  ; sixteen cities with their villages :
kha: ka Gederoth , ka Bethdagon , ka Naamah , bad ka Makkedah : khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Gederoth, u Bethdagan, bad u Naamah, bad u Nadaah ; ki shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God , and the heritage appointed unto him by God .
kha: Kane ka dei ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar ba U Blei u la buh bynta ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka bynta jong u briew uba sniew na U Blei , bad ka pateng ba la buh ha u da U Blei .

en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love ; in honour preferring one another ;
kha: To ieit iwei ïa iwei ha ka jingrhem mynsiem kum ki parabangeit , bad to long kiba da kwah hir hir ban pyn-i ka jingburom iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba sngewbha iwei ia iwei pat da ka jingieit para briew ; da ka burom kaba kham kwah iwei ia iwei pat ; .

en: As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .
kha: Ki jingtim kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi lait tang haba phi dei hok ban ïoh ïa ki . Ki long kum ki sim kiba her bad ki bym ju shongneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka sim da kaba iaid kai, kumba ka sngap jar da kaba her , kumta ka jingtim kan ym wan .

en: O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .
kha: Me la hikai ïa nga naduh ba nga dang samla , bad nga dang ïai ïathuh ïa ki kam kiba phylla jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Blei me, me la hikai ia nga naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga: bad haduh mynta nga la pynbna ia ki kam phylla jong me .

en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki .  To dih ïa ka , phi baroh ,  u la ong ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka khuri bad u la ainguh bad u la ai ha ki da kaba ong: To dih ia ka baroh;

en: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth  ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .
kha: Pynlah ïa nga ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ki por baroh , namar ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ha ki jingbishar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat shim ia ka ktien jong ka jingshisha na ka shyntur jong nga ; namar nga la kyrmen ha ki jingbishar jong me .

en: While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .
kha: U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shemphang aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba U Mynsiem u la ong ,  Ha sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïawad ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u Petros u dang pyrkhat ia ka jingphohsniew, U Mynsiem u la ong ha u: Ha khmih lai ngut ki briew ki wad ia me .

en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity , and sin as it were with a cart rope :
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phim shym lah ban pyllaitluid na la ki jong ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki kiba ring ia ka jingbymhok da ki lynti jong ka jinglong ba sniew, bad ka pop kumba ka long da ka lynti kit mar:

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Come ye after me , and I will make you to become fishers of men .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Wan bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , To wan hadien jong nga bad ngan pynlong ia phi ban long ki nongtong dohkha ia ki briew .

en: Go ye , get you straw where ye can find it : yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .
kha: Phi hap ban leit ïawad hi kat naba phi lap , hynrei phi dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit ia phi, to ioh ia ka sboh ha kaba phi lah ban shem ia ka: hynrei ym dei ban pynduna ia ka kam jong phi .

en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .
kha: U la tei biang ïa ki nongbah baroh ha Hamath kiba long ki jaka buh jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tei ia ka Tadmor ha ka ri khlaw bad ki nongbah dukan baroh kiba u la tei ha Hamath .

en: And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :
kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u ! Pyllait ïa u Barabbas ha ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta baroh shisien, ki da ong: To leit noh bad une u briew, bad pyllait noh ia ngi u Barabbas:

en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people .
kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki tuid da ki ummat kum ki wah ha ka jingshah pynjot jong ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong nga ka tuid shapoh ki wah um na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ia ka khun jong ki briew jong nga .

en: All the kings of the nations , even all of them , lie in glory , every one in his own house .
kha: Baroh ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki thiah ha ki jingtep kiba itynnat ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh, wat ia ki baroh, ki thiah ha ka burom, uwei pa uwei ha la ka jong ka iing .

en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever : he hath made a decree which shall not pass .
kha: da ki hukum jong u ïa ki la pynneh ha ki jaka jong ki junom , bad kim lah khlem kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynskhem ruh ia ki junom: u la leh ia ka hukum kaba ym iaid .

en: ( Luke 23 :43 ) Also , millions of dead ones will be resurrected to human life on the earth .
kha: ( Loukas 23 :43 ) Shuh shuh yn sa pynmihpat ïa ki milian ngut ki briew kiba la ïap sha ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Loukas 23 :43 ) Kumjuh ruh da ki million ngut kiba iap kin sa mihpat sha ka jingim briew ha ka pyrthei .

en: Saying , God hath forsaken him : persecute and take him  ; for there is none to deliver him .
kha: Ki ong ,  U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u ; ïa ngin ïabeh bad kem ïa u ; ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , U Blei u la iehnoh ia u: pynshitom bad shim ia u ; namar ym don mano mano ruh ban pynpoi ia u .

en: Or , Who shall descend into the deep ? ( that is , to bring up Christ again from the dead . )
kha: Lymne ba phin kylli , Uei u ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei shapoh ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane , Mano ba hiar shapoh ? (ka mut ban pynmih biang ia U Khrist na kiba iap . )

en: There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .
kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don namarkata hynriew ngut ki hynmen: bad uba nyngkong u la shim ia ka tnga bad u la iap khlem khun .

en: And in their mouth was found no guile : for they are without fault before the throne of God .
kha: Ym ju lap ïa ki ba ki ïathuh lamler ; ki long kiba khlem thohbria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka shyntur jong ki ym shym la lap ia ka jinglehrain: namar ki long khlem jingbakla ha khmat ka khet U Blei .

en: But be it so , I did not burden you : nevertheless , being crafty , I caught you with guile .
kha: Phin mynjur , namarkata , ba ngam shym la long ka jingbankhia ïa phi . Hynrei don ki ban ong ba nga la long uba sianti , bad riam ïa phi da ki jingshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to long kumta, ngam shym la pynkhia ia phi: wat la katta ruh, namar ba nga long uba stad, nga la kem ia phi da ka jingsngewrit.

en: But to do good and to communicate forget not : for with such sacrifices God is well pleased .
kha: Wat klet ban lehbha bad ïarap uwei ïa uwei pat , namar kine ki long ki jingkñia kiba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ban leh bha bad ban iakynduh ym klet: namar da kum kine ki jingknia U Blei U sngewbha shibun .

en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with  ; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished !
kha: Nga don ka jingpynbaptis ban ïohpdiang , bad katno nga sngewkhia mynsiem tad haduh ba kan da kut noh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingpynbaptis ban shah pynbaptis bad ka ; bad kumno nga la shah pynkhih haduh ba kan da pyndep !

en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud : under his tongue is mischief and vanity .
kha: Ka jingkren jong u , ka dap da ki jingtim , ki jinglamler , bad ki jingbyrngem ; u kloi ban kren ki kyntien kiba dap da ka jingisih bad ka jingsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u ka dap da ka jingtim bad ka jingleh thok bad ka jingleh thok: hapoh ka shyntur jong u ka long kaba sniew bad kaba sniew .

en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest :
kha: Phim dei ban leit rah ïa la ki jingainguh kat shaba phi ibit ;
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade ba men ym ai ia ki jingknia thang jong me ha man la ka jaka ba me iohi:

en: He that is not with me is against me  ; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad .
kha: Uno uno u bym long na ka bynta jong nga , u ïaleh pyrshah shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum ban lang u long shisha uba pynsaphred .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u bym don bad nga u long pyrshah ia nga; bad uta u bym ialum lang bad nga u la jah noh shabar ri .

en: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom  ; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth .
kha: Katto katne ki briew ki alhia palat wat ban buh jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sniehdoh ka buhrieh ia ka kti jong u ha ka shyntur jong u ; ka pynsngewsih ia u ban wanrah biang ia ka ha ka shyntur jong u .

en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth , and it abideth .
kha: Ka jingïaineh jong me ka ïaisah sha ki pateng bynriew baroh ; me la buh pynskhem ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong bashisha jong me ka long ha ki pateng baroh: me la pynskhem ia ka khyndew bad ka iaineh .

en: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it  ; and they shall consecrate themselves .
kha: Hynñiew sngi ki lyngdoh kin pynkyntang ïa ka duwan bad pynbiang ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi kin pynkhuid ia ka almari bad kin pynkhuid ia ka ; bad kin pynkyntang ia lade .

en: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .
kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka dung kew bad ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka kiaw kurim jong ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la hiar sha madan bad ka la leh katba kum ka kmie tymmen jong ka ka la bthah ia ka .

en: And as we have borne the image of the earthy , we shall also bear the image of the heavenly .
kha: Kumba ngi kup ïa ka dur u briew ïa uba la thaw na ka dewmet , kumta ngin kup ïa ka dur u Briew uba na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ngi la kha ia ka dur jong ka khyndew , ngin sa kit ruh ia ka dur jong ka bneng .

en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .
kha: Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawsiang baskhem ki kynriah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shisha u lum uba hap u wan sha ka jaka kaba rit , bad u maw u la jah noh na ka jaka jong u .

en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith ; that ye , being rooted and grounded in love ,
kha: Ba U Khrist un pynsuhthied ha mynsiem jongphi da jingngeit , ba phin , pynshong nongrim ha ka jingieit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Khrist un shong ha ki dohnud jong phi da ka jingngeit ; ba phi , da kaba sdang bad sdang ha ka jingieit .

en: After receiving the information the hospital authorities got in touch with the local police .
kha: Hadien ba la ioh jingtip ki bor pyniaid ka hospital ki la iakynduh ia ki pulit jong ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba la ioh ia ki jingtip ki bor hospital ki la iakynduh bad ki pulit jong ka thain .

en: That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ban bud ïa ka jingïalam jong kiba kum kita ki briew , bad uno uno de uba trei bad shakri lang bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phi aiti ia lade ha kiba kum kita, bad ha uwei pa uwei uba iarap bad ngi bad uba trei shitom .

en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki paralok jong phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohsngew ba la ong , Me dei ban ieit ia u paramarjan jong me bad to shun ia u nongshun jong me .

en: And David laid up these words in his heart , and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath .
kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki la shon jur ha u Dabid , bad u sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa u syiem Akhish .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la buh ia kine ki ktien ha ka dohnud jong u bad u la tieng shibun ia u Achish u syiem Gath .

en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him , and cried with a loud voice , he came out of him .
kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa u briew , u la lynñiar jam , bad u la mihnoh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynkhih ia u bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam , u la mih na u .

en: He hath said in his heart , God hath forgotten : he hideth his face  ; he will never see it .
kha: U riewbymman u ong ha lade ,  U Blei um sngew ei ei ! u la khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad un ym ïohi ïa nga da lei lei !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka dohnud jong u: U la klet: u buhrieh ia ka khmat jong u ; un ym iohi ia ka satia .

en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?
kha: Hato me lah ban kdew lynti ïa ki khlur na kawei ka aïom sha kawei pat bad me pynïaid ïa ka thup khlur baheh bad barit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban wanrah ia u Mazzaroth ha ka aiom jong u ? lane phi lah ban ialam ia u Arcturus bad ki khun shynrang jong u ?

en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there  ; and that her guests are in the depths of hell .
kha: Kito kiba ngat ha ka jingriam jong ka kim tip ba ki briew kiba leit ha ïing jong ka ki ïap , bad kito kiba la rung mynshuwa ki don mynta ha kaba jylliew bha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei um tip ba kiba iap ki don hangta ; bad ba ki nongwan jong ka ki don ha ka jingjylliew jong ka dujok .

en: They cause him to go naked without clothing , and they take away the sheaf from the hungry  ;
kha: Hynrei kiba duk kin hap ban ïaid shabar khlem ki jaiñ ban ïada ïa ki ; ki hap ban shahthngan katba dang lum kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynlong ia u ban leit lyngkhuid khlem jain , bad ki weng noh ia ka sniehdoh na kiba thngan ; .

en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it : and he that hateth suretiship is sure .
kha: Lada phi kular ban siew ïa ka ram u nongwei , phin babe ïa kata . Kan kham bha lada phi kiar na kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba thikna na ka bynta u nongwei un long uba stad na ka bynta jong ka: bad uta uba shun u long uba thikna .

en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon s wisdom , and the house that he had built ,
kha: Ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingstad u Solomon bad ïohi ïa ka ïingsyiem kaba u la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka mahadei ka Sheba ka la iohi ia ka jingstad baroh jong u Solomon bad ka iing kaba u la tei .

en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .
kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan wan biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok kin kyrshan ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingbishar kan wan phai sha ka hok: bad baroh kiba hok ha ka dohnud kin bud ia ka .

en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,
kha: Ha ka sngi U Trai , U Mynsiem u la shim ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur bajam , kaba sawa kum ka turoi , kaba kren na shadien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la don ha U Mynsiem ha ka sngi U Trai , bad nga la iohsngew hadien jong nga ia ka sur kaba khraw kum ka turoi .

en: As the Father knoweth me , even so know I the Father : and I lay down my life for the sheep .
kha: Nga , nga long u nongaplangbrot uba bha . Kumba U Kpa u ithuh ïa nga bad nga , nga ithuh ïa U Kpa , ha kajuh ka rukom nga ithuh ïa la ki langbrot bad ki ithuh ïa nga . Bad nga kloi ban ïap na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Kpa u ithuh ia nga, wat nga ruh nga ithuh ia U Kpa: bad nga aiti ia la ka jingim na ka bynta ki langbrot .

en: Children s children are the crown of old men  ; and the glory of children are their fathers .
kha: Ki riewtymmen ki sngewsarong ïa la ki jong ki ksiew , kumba ki khynnah ki sngewsarong ïa la ki jong ki kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah ki long ka khlieh jong ki tymmen ; bad ka burom jong ki khun ki long ki kpa jong ki .

en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .
kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba arphew hynñiew jong u bnai uba ar , ka khyndew ka la rkhiang nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew kaba ar, ha ka sngi kaba hynriewphew jong u bnai, ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong .

en: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .
kha: Kane keiñ , ka long kumno phi dei ban duwai :   ‘ Ko Kpa jong ngi uba ha bneng : Ai ba ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka rukom namarkata to duwai: Ko Kpa jong ngi uba don ha bneng , to long ka kyrteng jong me .

en: And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .
kha: Nangta u phai sawdong , u la ïohi ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga . Nga jubab , ‘ Ho-oid , Kynrad !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u peit shadien jong u, u la iohi ia nga, bad u la khot ia nga . Bad nga la jubab , Hangne nga don .

en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;
kha: Hynrei haba kata ka prum ka la jem bad ka la kylla lieh biang , uta u briew u dei ban leit sha u lyngdoh , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada ka doh kaba thymmai ka kylla biang bad la pynkylla lieh , un wan sha u lyngdoh ; .

en: And they cast out many devils , and anointed with oil many that were sick , and healed them .
kha: Ki la beh noh bun ki ksuid , bad ki la tah umphniang Olib ha kiba bun ki briew kiba pang bad ki la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la beh noh ia ki ksuid kiba bun bad ki la pynsleh da ka umphniang ia kiba pang bad ki la pynkoit ia ki .

en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation : and thy gentleness hath made me great .
kha: A Trai , Me ïada bad me pynim ïa nga , ka jingïarap jong me ka la pynkhraw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh me la ai ia nga ia ka jingda jong ka jingpynim jong me: bad ka jinglong jemnud jong me ka la pynlong ia nga uba khraw .

en: I called upon the  Lord  in distress : the  Lord  answered me , and set me in a large place .
kha: Ha ka jingkordit jong nga , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ; u la jubab ïa nga bad u la pyllait ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la khot ia U Trai ha ka jingjynjar: U Trai u la jubab ia nga , bad u la buh ia nga ha ka jaka kaba heh .

en: Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .
kha: Ka jaitbynriew kan kyllon lada ym don ka jingïalam . Ha ka jingbun ki nongaibuit don ka jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ym don ka jingai jingmut , ki briew ki hap: hynrei ha ka jingbun ki nongai jingmut ka don ka jingshngain .

en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;
kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi shukor ïa nga kum ki wahduid kiba ju rngad noh ha bym don slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong nga ki la leh thok kum ka wah , bad kum ka wah ki wah ki jah noh ; .

en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .
kha: Nga la ud da ka jingsngewsih namar ka Moab , da ka jingpangnud namar ka Kir Heres .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki bniat jong nga kin sawa kum ka harp na ka bynta u Moab , bad ki bynta ba shapoh jong nga na ka bynta u Kirher .

en: Cast out the scorner , and contention shall go out  ; yea , strife and reproach shall cease .
kha: Phet noh na u briew uba shukor , bad nangta yn ym don shuh ki jingïakajia , ka jingïamai lane ka jingsin kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia u nongleh bein, bad ka jingiakren kan mih ; yea , ka jingialeh bad ka jingshah lehbein kan sangeh noh .

en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .
kha: Ban ïoh jingbam kaba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt bad Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la ai kti ia ki nong Ijipt bad ia ki nong Assyria ban sngewhun ia u kpu .

en: And they said , Lord , behold , here are two swords . And he said unto them ,  It is enough .
kha: Ki synran ki la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Kine hangne ar tylli ki waitlam , ko Kynrad !   Kata ka la biang !  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong, ko Trai, ha khmih, hangne ki don ar tylli ki waitlam . Bad u la ong ha ki , Ka la biang .

en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .
kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pynshitom kumba phi dei ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la pyndep ia ka jingbishar jong kiba sniew: ka jingbishar bad ka hok ka bat ia me .

en: Harden not your hearts , as in the provocation , in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
kha: wat pyneh ïa la ka dohnud , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la long haba ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kumba ki la long ha kata ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap haba ki la tynjuh ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynkhih ia ki dohnud jong phi, kumba ha ka jingpynkhih , ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynshoi ha ka ri khlaw:

en: That the  Lord  appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon .
kha: U  Trai  u paw biang ha u kumba u la paw ha Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Trai u la paw ha u Solomon ha ka sien kaba ar kumba u la paw ha u ha Gibeon .

en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .
kha: bad kin bret ïa ki shapoh ka lawar ding baklang , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un bret ia ki ha ka ding: kan don ka jingsawa bad ka jingsawa jong ki bniat .

en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born : let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed .
kha: Long ba la tim kata ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga ! To klet noh ïa ka sngi ba i mei jong nga i kha ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia ka sngi ha kaba la kha ia nga: wat ai ba ka sngi ha kaba ka kmie jong nga kan kha ia nga kan long kaba la kyrkhu .

en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the  Lord  dwelleth in Zion .
kha: Ngan pynhiarkput na ka bynta kito kiba la shah pynïap ; ngan ym map ïa kiba leh kam sniew . Hynrei ha Judah bad Jerusalem yn don ki nongshong shnong junom , bad ma nga U  Trai  , ngan shong ha u lum Seïon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pynkhuid ia ka snam jong ki kaba ngam shym la pynkhuid: namar U Trai u shong ha Seion .

en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .
kha: ka kharai kaba jylliew ha ka nongbah Akasia ; bad ngan pynshitom ïa phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongleh pyrshah ki long kiba jylliew ban pyniap briew , wat la nga la long u nongpynrem ia ki baroh .

en: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country  ; and his disciples follow him .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit phai pat sha la shnong ; ki synran ki bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih noh nangta, bad u la wan sha la ka jong ka ri ; bad ki synran jong u ki bud ia u .

en: They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
kha: Ym don shuh ka jingrwai bakmen ha ka por ba dih waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat shuh ïa ka jingmad jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym dih wain da ka jingrwai ; ka jingdih kaba khlain kan long kaba sngewsih ia ki kiba dih ia ka .

en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink , neither be ye of doubtful mind .
kha: Kumta baroh wat sngewdiaw , da kaba pyrkhat ïa kaei phin bam bad dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat wad ia kaei kaba phin bam ne kaei kaba phin dih , lymne to long kiba artatien .

en: And David was afraid of God that day , saying , How shall I bring the ark of God home to me ?
kha: Te u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U Blei bad u ong ,  Kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad nga mynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la tieng ia U Blei ha kata ka sngi , u da ong: Kumno ngan wanrah ia ka synduk U Blei sha iing ha nga ?

en: And now abideth faith , hope , charity , these three ; but the greatest of these is charity .
kha: Kine lai tylli kin ïaisah : Ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingieit ; bad kaba khraw tam na kine ka long ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ka long ka jingngeit, ka jingkyrmen, ka jingai sngewbha, kine ki lai tylli ki ; hynrei kaba khraw tam na kine ka long ka jingai sngewbha .

en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years : and Athaliah reigned over the land .
kha: Hynriew snem u la don hangta ha kaba rieh , katba ka Athalaïah ka synshar kum ka syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don bad ki ha iing U Blei hynriew snem: bad u Athaliah u la synshar halor ka ri .

en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king , and stand not in the place of great men :
kha: Haba phi ïeng ha khmat u syiem , wat pyrshang ban shon jur ïa u bad leh mynleh kum uba pawkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat buh ia lade ha khmat u syiem , bad wat ieng ha ka jaka jong ki briew kiba khraw:

en: He may prepare it , but the just shall put it on , and the innocent shall divide the silver .
kha: hynrei kin don ki briew kiba bha ki ban phong ïa kita ki jingriam , bad kin don ki briew kiba hok ki ban ïoh ïa kata ka rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: U lah ban pynkhreh ia ka , hynrei kiba hok kin buh ia ka , bad ki bym don pop kin phiah ia ka rupa .

en: Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the church , and gave himself for it ;
kha: Ko ki shynrang , to ieit ïa la ki tnga kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ka balang bad u la ai ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tnga , to ieit ia ki tnga jong phi , kumba U Khrist ruh u ieit ia ka balang , bad u la aiti ia lade na ka bynta jong ka ; .

en: He paweth in the valley , and rejoiceth in his strength : he goeth on to meet the armed men .
kha: Ki thrang ban trud ïa ka khyndew ha ka jaka them ; ki mareh stet sha ka thma da la ka bor baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U paw ha ka them, bad u sngewbha ha ka bor jong u: u leit sha khmat ia ki briew kiba don tiar .

en: When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kyndit thret .  Uei te uba lah ban lait im ?  ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki synran jong u ki la iohsngew ia ka , ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta, ki da ong: Mano ba lah ban pynim ?

en: But with many of them God was not well pleased : for they were overthrown in the wilderness .
kha: Hynrei bad kiba bun U Blei um shym la sngewbha , kumta ki metïap jong ki la pynsaphriang ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad kiba bun na ki U Blei um shym la sngewbha shibun: namar ki la shah pynhap ha ka ri khlaw .

en: Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
kha: namar ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad ki la kyntait ïa ki jingbthah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leh pyrshah ia ki ktien U Blei , bad ki la pynrem ia ka jingai jingmut jong Uba ha khlieh duh:

en: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless , hearing a voice , but seeing no man .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit ryngkat bad u Saul ki la sangeh , khlem kren wat shikyntien ruh ; ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur hynrei kim lah ban ïohi ïano ïano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba iaid bad u ki la ieng khlem kren, ki iohsngew ia ka sur hynrei kim iohi ia u briew .

en: The disciple is not above his master : but every one that is perfect shall be as his master .
kha: Ym don u shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nonghikai jong u ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u shah hikai , haba u la pyndep ïa ka jingshah hikai , un long kum u nonghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U synran um long halor u kynrad jong u: hynrei uwei pa uwei uba janai un long kum u kynrad jong u .

en: For all his judgments were before me : and as for his statutes , I did not depart from them .
kha: Nga la leh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ; Ngam shym la lyndet ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki jingbishar jong u baroh ki la long ha khmat jong nga: bad katba ia ki ain jong u , ngam shym la phet noh na ki .

en: And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
kha: Phi la pynbitar ruh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi mynba phi don ha Taberah , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Tabarah, bad ha Massah, bad ha Kibrothhattaavah, phi la pynkhih ia U Trai ban bitar .

en: The changeable suits of apparel , and the mantles , and the wimples , and the crisping pins ,
kha: ïa ki jaiñ babha jong ki , ki jaiñ jynsur , ki jaiñkup bad ki pla kynsit ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jain kiba kylla , bad ki shyieng , bad ki shyieng , bad ki pin kiba tyrkhong , .

en: Then will I also walk contrary unto you , and will punish you yet seven times for your sins .
kha: te nga ruh ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi bad ngan pynshitom ïa phi kham jur sa hynñiew shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan iaid pyrshah ia phi , bad ngan pynshitom ia phi sa hynriew sien na ka bynta ki pop jong phi .

en: And he said unto him , Thou knowest how I have served thee , and how thy cattle was with me .
kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Phi tip kumno nga la shakri ïa phi bad kumno ki kynhun jingri jong phi ki la roi ha ka jingsumar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u , Me tip kumno nga la shakri ia me bad kumno ki masi jong me ki la don ryngkat bad nga .

en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .
kha: Ki jhieh ha u slap uba hap halor ki lumbah , bad ki ïa-thngian harud ki mawsiang ban rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngem bad ki um jong ki lum , bad ki pdiang ia u maw namar ka jingkwah ia ka jaka rieh .

en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour s house  ; lest he be weary of thee , and so hate thee .
kha: Wat leit jngoh bunsien eh ïa u paramarjan jong phi , u lah ban sngewngiah ïa phi bad isih pynban ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka kjat jong me na ka iing jong u para marjan jong me; ioh ba un sngewsih ia me, bad kumta un shun ia me .

en: And his disciples remembered that it was written , The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up .
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kynmaw ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ka jingsngew shitrhem jong nga ïa ka ïing jong me , a Blei , ka ing hapoh jong nga kum ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki kynmaw ba la thoh ia nga , Ka jingkmen jong ka iing jong me ka la bam ia nga .

en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
kha: U rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai : U Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada Ki lyngdoh : U Sadok bad u Abiathar
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la long halor ka kynhun shipai: bad u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh:

en: And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .
kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt bad ban sumar ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da u nongiathuhlypa U Trai u la wanrah ia ki Israel na Ijipt , bad da u nongiathuhlypa la pynneh pynsah ia u .

en: And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .
kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tad ynda u dep tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , bad pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïaroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat ai ia u ia ka jingsuk, haduh ba un da pynskhem ia ka Jerusalem ha ka khyndew .

en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; naba kata kan pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata wat ju thiah ha ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong me, ban pynjakhlia ia lade bad ka .

en: Perhaps, there will be those who say, now, this year I won't be using a mobile phone anymore.
kha: Lehse, ki don don ki ban ong, mynta, ka snem ngan ym pyndonkam mobile shuh.
translated_en_to_kha: Lehse, kin don kiba ong, mynta, mynta u snem ngan ym pyndonkam shuh ia ka mobile phone.

en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :
kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ar tylli ki maw onyx , bad tep ha ki ia ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel:

en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Babilon , jong ka jingïam pangnud namar ka jingpynjot ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka jingpyrta ka wan na Babilon , bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw na ka ri jong ki Khaldi:

en: And many among them shall stumble , and fall , and be broken , and be snared , and be taken .
kha: Kiba bun kin jynthut ; kin kyllon bad kin shah pynlwet . Yn pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingriam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun napdeng jong ki kin sa lyngngoh bad kin hap bad kin shah pynpra bad kin shah rong noh bad shah shim noh .

en: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .
kha: Don shibun kiei kiei ba ngi hap ban ong shaphang kane ka bynta , hynrei ka long kaba eh ban batai ïa phi , namar phi long kiba suki katta katta ïa ka ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kiba ngi don shibun kiei kiei ban ong , bad kaba eh ban kren , haba phi iohi ba phi long kiba dum .

en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;
kha: Nga ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ jong u briew uba alhia , uba mutlop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la leit sha lyngkha jong u sohjew bad da ka kper sohjew jong u briew uba khlem jingmut ; .

en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil : so do stripes the inward parts of the belly .
kha: Teng teng ka donkam ban mad ïa ka jingshem kaba kthang ha ka jingim ban pynlong ïa ngi ban kylla ïa ki lynti jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsma jong ka jingmynsaw ka pynkhuid ia ka jingsniew: kumta to pynkhih ia ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka kpoh .

en: Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .
kha: Ngim dei ban tynjuh ïa U Trai , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad la pynïap ïa ki da ki bseiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat pynshoi ia U Khrist kumba don napdeng jong ki ruh kiba la shah pynshoi bad ki la shah pynjot ha ki bsein .

en: Through desire a man , having separated himself , seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .
kha: Ki briew ki bym ïadei bad kiwei ki pyrkhat tang ïa lade ; kin ym ïahap bad kaei kaba baroh ki tip ba ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingkwah u briew, uba la pyniakhlad ia lade, u wad bad u iakynduh bad ka jingstad baroh .

en: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand  ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jingleh myntor kiba phi pyndonkam bad ngan iehnoh ïa phi khlem ki nongkren byrtong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ot noh ia ki nongleh jadu na ka kti jong me ; bad me phin ym don shuh ki nongleh jadu:

en: If the men of my tabernacle said not , Oh that we had of his flesh ! we cannot be satisfied .
kha: Baroh kito kiba trei bad nga ki tip ba nga la ju pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki briew jong ka Tabernak jong nga kim ong , Oh ba ngi don ia ka doh jong u ! ngim lah ban sngewhun .

en: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?
kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don shuh ka jingma ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar mynta ba phim lah ban leh ia kane: balei ba ka jingpynjot ka dei ban nangroi sha ka jingshah pynmong jong ki syiem ?

en: And by reason hereof he ought , as for the people , so also for himself , to offer for sins .
kha: Bad namar ma u hi u long uba tlot , u dei ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ym tang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew hynrei namar ki pop jong u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka daw jong kane u la dei ban aiti ia ki pop .

en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity , in Ur of the Chaldeans .
kha: bad u Haran u la ïap ha la ka jong ka shnong , ka Ur ha ka ri Babilonia , mynba u kpa jong u , u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haran u la iap ha khmat u kpa jong u u Terah ha ka ri jong ka jingkha jong u, ha Ur jong ki Khaldi .

en: And he hardened Pharaoh s heart , that he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
kha: U Pharaoh , pynban , u la ïai mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud u Pharaoh, ba um shym la sngap ia ki ; kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister , which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea .
kha: Nga phah sha phi , da kaba sngewburom ïa ka parabangeit jong ngi , ka Phibi , kaba shakri ïa ka balang ha Kenkhria .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ai khublei ia phi ia ka para jong ngi kaba long ka shakri jong ka balang kaba don ha Cenchrea .

en: And it was told Abimelech , that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Abimelekh ba ki la ïalum hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha u Abimelech , ba ki briew baroh jong ka tower Shechem ki la ialum lang .

en: She said moreover unto him , We have both straw and provender enough , and room to lodge in .
kha: Don shibun u phlangïap bad ka jingbam ïa ki jingri ha ïing jong ngi , bad don ruh ka jaka na ka bynta jong phi ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ong shuh shuh ha u , Ngi don ka jaka bad ka jaka kaba biang, bad ka jaka ban sah shapoh .

en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .
kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  Leit sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad ïalap ïa ka Gospel sha ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , To leit sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad to ialap ia ka gospel ha ki jingthaw baroh .

en: Be not deceived ; God is not mocked : for whatsoever a man soweth , that shall he also reap .
kha: Wat ym shukor phi ïa lade hi , ym don mano mano uba ñiew bieit ïa U Blei . U briew un ot ïa kaei kaba u bet .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shah thok ; U Blei um shah lehbein: namar kaei kaei kaba u briew u bet , kata ruh un kheit .

en: Teach us what we shall say unto him  ; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .
kha: To hikai ïa ngi aïu ngin ong ha U Blei ; ki jingmut jong ngi ki thylli ; ngim don ei ei ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hikai ia ngi ia kaei kaba ngin ong ha u ; namar ngim lah ban hukum ia ka jingkren jong ngi namar ka jingdum .

en: Verily I say unto you , This generation shall not pass , till all these things be fulfilled .
kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia ha shuwa ba ki briew kiba im mynta kin ïap baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kane ka pateng kan ym iaid , haduh ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin da pyndep .

en: We understand your frustration and assure you that we’re doing our best to resolve the issue.
kha: Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka jingsngewsih jong phi bad ngi pynthikna ïa phi ba ngi dang leh katba lah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewthuh ia ka jingsngewsih jong phi bad pynthikna ia phi ba ngi leh katba lah ban pynbeit ia ka jingeh.

en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .
kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Katba im U  Trai  , nga kular ban ong ïa kaei kaba u ïathuh ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Kumba U Trai u im, kaei kaba U Trai u ong ha nga, kata ngan kren .

en: Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?
