kha: A ba ngan da la ïap noh hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga lane ïap noh ha ka khyllipmat ba la kha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ngam shym la iap na ka kpoh ? balei ngam shym la iehnoh ia u ksuid haba nga la mih na ka kpoh ?

en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God , and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty .
kha: Kata ka long ka kupar jong u briew uba pynkhih ïa la ki ksang ti sha U Blei bad uba beiñ pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u pynkhih ia la ka kti pyrshah ia U Blei , bad u pynskhem ia lade pyrshah ia Uba donbor baroh .

en: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .
kha: Baroh kiba don hangta ki la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khynnah . U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat ïam ; ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki iam bad ki iam ia ka: hynrei u la ong: Wat iam; kam shym la iap, hynrei ka thiah .

en: And Laban went to shear his sheep : and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father s .
kha: U Laban u la leit ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad ha ka por ba um don ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing kiba long ki jong u kpa jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la leit ban ot ia ki langbrot jong u: bad ka Rakhel ka la tuh ia ki dur kiba long u kpa jong ka .

en: So the  Lord  smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah  ; and the Ethiopians fled .
kha: U  Trai  u jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Sudan mynba u Asa bad ki kynhun shipai jong ka Judia ki tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la shoh ia ki nong Ithiopia ha khmat u Asa , bad ha khmat u Judah ; bad ki nong Ithiopia ki la phet noh .

en: And Jacob was left alone  ; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day .
kha: hynrei u la sah shadien marwei . Nangta uwei u briew u wan bad u la ïalympat bad u haduh ban da jan kynjat shai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la sah marwei bad hangta u la ia tyngkhuh bad u haduh ban da mih ka sngi .

en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .
kha: Haba u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongrah tiar jong u u la iohi ba u Saul u la iap , u la hap kumjuh ha ka waitlam bad u la iap .

en: They looked , but there was none to save  ; even unto the  Lord  , but he answered them not .
kha: Ki wad jingïarap , hynrei ym don uba pyllait im ïa ki ; ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki peit , hynrei ym don mano mano ruh ban pynim ; wat ha U Trai ruh , hynrei um shym la jubab ia ki .

en: We’ve documented your complaint and will keep you informed throughout the resolution process.
kha: Ngi la thoh ïa ka jingujor jong phi bad ngin pyntip ïa phi ha baroh kawei ka jingpynbeit.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la thoh ia ka jingujor jong phi bad ngin pyntip ia phi ha baroh kawei ka rukom pynbeit.

en: Then shall ye call upon me , and ye shall go and pray unto me , and I will hearken unto you .
kha: Nangta phin khot kyrpad ïa nga . Phin wan bad duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin khot ia nga , bad phin leit duwai ha nga , bad ngan sngap ia phi .

en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave  ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
kha: Ki lah ban shait ban khlaiñ haba ngi lap ïa ki , hynrei kin ïap haba ngi ïoh leh dusmon ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin sngap jar ia ki kum ka jingtep ; bad baroh kawei, kum kito kiba leit shapoh ka thliew:

en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world .
kha: Bad ngi la ïohi bad ïathuh ha kiwei ba U Kpa u la phah ïa la U Khun ban long U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la iohi bad ngi la sakhi ba U Kpa u la phah ia u Khun ban long U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .

en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .
kha: Men ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong kiba shah banbeiñ bad jong ki khunswet ; men bishar da kaba sngewlem ïa ki ; ba kumta ki briew kin ym pynjia jingshyrkhei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban bishar ia ki bym don kpa bad kiba shah pynshitom bein , ba u briew jong ka khyndew un ym shah pynshitom shuh .

en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance  ; and I will fill their treasures .
kha: nga pynriewspah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , da kaba pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ki jingkynshew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan pynlong ia kito kiba ieit ia nga ban hiar pateng ia nga ; bad ngan pyndap ia ki spah jong ki .

en: And to him they had regard , because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries .
kha: Ki la pynshahshkor kumne ïa u namar la kham slem u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki da ka jingleh myntor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u ki la don ka jingburom , namar kata ka por kaba jrong u la pynshoi ia ki da ki jingleh jadu .

en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
kha: Kaba byrngia ha ki jingim pahuh , ka waiñ bad ka jingbam lutphut kin ym pynlong ïa phi uba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia ka jingsngewbha un long u briew uba duk: uta uba ieit ia ka wain bad ka umphniang un ym riewspah .

en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof , all that make sluices and ponds for fish .
kha: Ki nongthain jaiñ bad ki nongtrei kiba tbit kin diaw bad kin noh mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sa shah pynpra ha ki jingthmu jong ka , baroh kiba shna ia ki sluice bad ki pung dohkha .

en: And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .
kha: U la ktah ïa ka kti jong ka , ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ktah ia ka kti jong ka, bad ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ia ka: bad ka la ieng bad ka la shakri ia ki .

en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning , and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even  ;
kha: Ainguh ïa uwei mynstep bad uwei pat janmiet ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u langbrot men ainguh mynstep bad uwei pat u langbrot men ainguh ha ka por janmiet ; .

en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah s neck , and brake it .
kha: Nangta u Hananaïah u la loit ïa ka lyngkor na u ryndang jong nga , u la pynkheiñ lyngkhot ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Haniah u nongiathuhlypa u la shim ia ka lyngkhot na ka ryndang jong u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah, bad u la bret ia ka .

en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him , and he in us , because he hath given us of his Spirit .
kha: Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi im ha U Blei bad ba u im hapoh jong ngi , namar ba u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane ngi tip ba ngi shong ha u bad ma u ha ngi namar u la ai ia ngi ia U Mynsiem jong u .

en: Hear , I beseech thee , and I will speak : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
kha: Me ong ïa nga ban shahshkor katba me dang kren bad ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap , nga kyrpad ia me , bad ngan kren: Ngan dawa na me , bad ngan pynbna ia me ha nga .

en: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .
kha: Nga tip ,  ka la jubab ,  ba un sa mihpat ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Martha ka ong ha u , Nga tip ba un sa mihpat ha ka jingmihpat ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

en: And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u angel ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jong u , bad u angel u kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la hukum ia u angel ; bad u la buh biang ia ka waitlam jong u ha ka sniehdoh jong ka .

en: And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said ,  What will ye that I shall do unto you ?
kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la khot ïa ki .  Kaei phi kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ieng shuh shuh bad u la khot ia ki bad u la ong: Phi kwah aiu ba ngan leh ia phi ?

en: And he brought me to the door of the court  ; and when I looked , behold a hole in the wall .
kha: U la ïalam ïa nga sha ka jaka rung sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar bad pyn-i ïa nga ïa ka thliew ha ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingbishar ; bad haba nga peit , ha khmih kawei ka thliew ha ka jingkhang .

en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :
kha: Kñia uwei u khunlangbrot mynstep bad uwei pat ynda janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u langbrot men ainguh mynstep ; bad uwei pat u langbrot men ainguh ha ka por janmiet:

en: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written , KING OF KINGS , AND   OF LORDS .
kha: Ha ka jaiñkup jong u bad ha ka lbong jong u la thoh ïa ka kyrteng :  U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u don ha ka jainkup jong u bad ha ka tyrpeng jong u ka kyrteng kaba la thoh , U SHAH KI SHAH , BAD KI JINGPYNBNA .

en: And this thing became a sin : for the people went to worship before the one , even unto Dan .
kha: Bad kumta ki briew ki la leh pop , naba ki leit mane ha Bethel bad ha Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kaei kaei ka la kylla long ka pop: namar ki briew ki la leit mane ha khmat uta, wat ha u Dan ruh .

en: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram , Give me the persons , and take the goods to thyself .
kha: U syiem jong ka Sodom u ong ha u Abram ,  Bat ïa kaba la ïoh lute , hynrei pynphai noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u Sodom u la ong ha u Abram , Ai ia nga ia ki briew bad shim ia ki mar sha lade .

en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,
kha: ha kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah jong ki Jiw ki la pyntip ia u pyrshah ia u Paul bad ki la kyrpad ia u .

en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .
kha: Kumta u la ïeng na ka miej bam , u la law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , bad u la teh ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka syngkai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khie na ka por bam ja miet, bad u la buh shawei ia ki jain jong u ; bad u la shim ia ka jainkup bad u la pynkhih ia lade .

en: For the greatest benefit , it is good to do the same before attending a congregation meeting .
kha: Ban kham ïoh jingmyntoi , ka long kaba donkam ban leh kumjuh shuwa ban wan sha ki jingïalang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi kaba khraw tam , ka long kaba bha ban leh kumjuh shwa ban leit sha ka jingialang balang .

en: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the  Lord  , that I die not :
kha: Bad lada nga dang im , sngewbha bat ïa la ka kular bakyntang bad ïaineh skhem bad nga ; hynrei lada jia ba nga ïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei tang katba nga dang im to pyni ia nga ia ka jingbha jong U Trai, ba ngan ym iap:

en: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .
kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ki ar tylli ki kynjri ksiar ha ki ar tylli ki ryntieh ha ki tduh jong ka sniehdoh .

en: What ailed thee , O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?
kha: Kaei kaba la jia , ko Duriaw , ban pynlong ïa pha ban phet noh ? Bad ma pha , ko Jordan , balei ba pha sangeh ban tuid ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba la pynlong ia me, ko duriaw, ba me la leit phai noh ? me Jordan , ba me la beh noh ?

en: Why , seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty , do they that know him not see his days ?
kha: Balei ba U Blei um buh ka por na ka bynta ka jingbishar , ka sngi jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba ki por kim shah buhrieh na Uba donbor baroh , hato kita ki bym ithuh ia u kim iohi ia ki sngi jong u ?

en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth , that the wicked might be shaken out of it ?
kha: Hato me la hukum ïa ka step ban kurup ïa ka pyrthei bad ban kynther ïa ki bymman na ki jakarieh jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan bat ia ki tduh jong ka khyndew , ba ki bymman kin shah pynkhih noh na ka ?

en: He was an economist with the World Bank and a consultant to the Planning Commission of India .
kha: U la long u stad ka ioh ka kot ha ka World Bank bad u nongai jingmut ha ka Planning Commission jong ka ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: U la long u nongshong shnong bad ka World Bank bad u nongai jingmut ha ka Planning Commission of India .

en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice , and cried  ; and the people wept that night .
kha: Baroh shi miet ki paidbah ki la kyang ha ka jingnoh mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, bad ki la iam ; bad ki briew ki iam ha kata ka miet .

en: But Peter said , Not so , Lord  ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ,  Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! ngam pat ju bam mynno mynno ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid lane kaba sang kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong , Em, ko Trai ; namar ngam pat ju bam ia kaei kaei kaba ju jia ne kaba khlem khuid .

en: For thou didst it secretly : but I will do this thing before all Israel , and before the sun .
kha: Me la leh pop ha kaba rieh , hynrei ngan pynjia ïa kane haba shai ka sngi ba ki Israel baroh kin ïohi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la leh ia kata da kaba rieh: hynrei ngan leh ia kane ha khmat ki Israel baroh , bad ha khmat ka sngi .

en: But let patience have her perfect work , that ye may be perfect and entire , wanting nothing .
kha: Pynthikna ba ka jingïaishah jong phi ka rah ïa phi artet ka lynti khlem da hap noh , khnang ba phin long kiba janai bad kiba dap pura , khlem jingduna ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba ka jingshaniah kan don ka kam kaba janai jong ka, ba phin long kiba janai bad kiba pura, khlem da kwah ei ei .

en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .
kha: Um khuslai lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u ki shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u ka la skhem , un ym tieng , haduh ba un da iohi ia ka jingkwah jong u ha ki nongshun jong u .

en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs  ; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols .
kha: Keiñ noh kaba rwai da ka sur bajam ; ngam kwah ban sngap ïa ki duitara jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia nga ia ka jingsawa jong ki jingrwai jong me ; namar ngan ym iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki jingleh be-ijot jong me .

en: And Joram turned his hands , and fled , and said to Ahaziah , There is treachery , O Ahaziah .
kha: Ka dei ka jingshetkylla , ko Ahasaïah !  U Joram u kyang jam , katba u dang pynphai sawdong ïa ka kali ïapom jong u bad u phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joram u la phai noh ia la ki kti bad u la phet noh bad u la ong ha u Ahasaiah, Ka don ka jingleh thok, ko Ahasaiah .

en: Now , as I recall , weren ' t you the one tasked to dole out the beatings , not receive them ?
kha: Mynta kumba nga kynmaw , hato ym dei ma phi uba la ai kam ban sam ia ki jingshah shoh , ym ban pdiang ia ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta , kumba nga kynmaw , hato phim dei ma phi uba la shah shoh , ym pdiang ia ki ?

en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name ' s sake , that he might make his mighty power known .
kha: Hynrei u la pynim ia ki na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u khnang ba un pynpaw ia ka bor bakhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u la pynim ia ki na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u , ba un pynpaw ia ka bor ba khraw jong u .

en: Saravanan then moved to Chennai and completed a course in acting at the Adyar Film Institute .
kha: Nangta u Saravanan u la leit sha Chennai bad u la pyndep ïa ka jingpule ha ka kam ak phlim ha Adyar Film Institute .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saravanan u la leit sha Chennai bad u la pyndep ia ka jinghikai ha ka kam ak phlim ha ka Adyar Film Institute .

en: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them : thus were all these cities .
kha: Na ka ri ba ki Israel ki la ïoh , la ai ha ki Lebi sawphew phra tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki nongbah ki long kawei pa kawei bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ki sawdong jong ki: kumta kine ki nongbah baroh .

en: Leave thy fatherless children , I will preserve them alive  ; and let thy widows trust in me .
kha: Ieh ïa ki khunswet bad nga , bad ngan sumar ïa ki . Ki riewkynthei ki lah ban shaniah ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Iehnoh ia ki khun bym don kpa jong me , ngan pynim ia ki ; bad to ai ba ki riewkynthei jong me kin shaniah ha nga .

en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .
kha: Im ïohi da lei lei ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi lane tip kumno ka jingim ka long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata um shym la iohi ia ka sngi , lymne um tip ei ei: kane ka don ka jingjahthait kaba kham bun ban ia kawei pat .

en: This whole town is drying up , and the Mayor is the only one who don ' t seem to be affected .
kha: Kane ka shnong baroh kawei ka la tyrkhong , bad tang u Mayor uba i kumba um shah ktah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka shnong baroh kawei ka nang tyrkhong , bad u Mayor u dei tang ma u uba i kumba um shah ktah .

en: The  Lord  our God spake unto us in Horeb , saying , Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount :
kha: U ong ,  Mynba ngi don ha u Lum Sinai , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi la ïashong slem eh ha une u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la kren ha ngi ha Horeb, u da ong: Phi la shong slem bha ha kane ka lum:

en: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it , they returned to Ekron the same day .
kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki peit ïa ki ba ki leh ïa kane bad hangta ki leit phai pat sha Ekron ha kata hi ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki san ngut ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la iohi ia ka , ki la leit phai noh sha Ekron ha kajuh ka sngi .

en: Sanctify the  Lord  of hosts himself  ; and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread .
kha: To kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long uba khuid , nga long uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia U Trai jong ki paid hi; bad to ai ba un long ka jingtieng jong phi .

en: Gradually they would have made the entire earth into a paradise .—Genesis 1 :28  ; 2 :8 , 15 .
kha: Suki suki kin pynkylla ïa ka sha ka paradais .—Jenesis 1 :28 ; 2 :8 , 15 .
translated_en_to_kha: Suki suki kin sa pynlong ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei sha ka paradais .  Genesis 1 :28 ; 2 :8 , 15 .

en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .
kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap uba la beh noh da ka lyer ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan pynphriang ia ki kum u shyieng uba iaid noh da ka Iyer jong ka ri khlaw .

en: Verma said Eisenhower wanted to recognise and support India for its own right as a democracy .
kha: U Verma u la ong ba u Eisenhower u kwah ban ithuh bad kyrshan ia ka India na ka bynta ka hok jong ka kum ka synshar paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Verma u la ong ba u Eisenhower u kwah ban ithuh bad kyrshan ia ka India na ka bynta la ka jong ka hok kum ka synshar paidbah .

en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi ïa uba kham palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba phi la leit shabar ban iohi ? U nongiathuhlypa ? Hooid , nga ong ha phi , bad kham palat ia u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him , dark waters , and thick clouds of the skies .
kha: U kah ïa lade da ka jingdum ; ki lyoh barben , kiba dap da ka um , ki ker sawdong ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ka jingdum sawdong jong u, ki um kiba dum bad ki lyoh kiba jylliew jong ki bneng .

en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman , or if I have laid wait at my neighbour s door  ;
kha: Lada nga la ikwah ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong nga , bad ïai ap , ïai rieh , shabar ka jingkhang jong ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah thok ha ka kynthei , lane lada nga la thiah ha ka jingkhang jong u para marjan jong nga ;

en: And he called them unto him , and said unto them in parables ,  How can Satan cast out Satan ?
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot ïa ki ha u bad u la kren ïa ki ha ki pharshi :  Kumno u Soitan u lah ban beh noh ïa u Soitan ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ki ha u bad u la ong ha ki ha ki pharshi , Kumno u Soitan u lah ban beh noh ia u Soitan ?

en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .
kha: Ka tynrai jong ka jingim ba riew Blei kaba don ha ka Baibl ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ban sah ha ka rukom ka ban wanrah ka jingmyntoi shimet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongrim ba kynja Blei ha ka Baibl ki pyni ia ngi kumno ban im ha ka rukom kaba wanrah ia ki jingmyntoi ha ka met .

en: And another of his disciples said unto him , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
kha: Uwei pat u briew , uba la long u synran , u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , shah shuwa ïa nga ba ngan leit phai bad tep ïa i pa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat na ki synran jong u u la ong ha u, ko Trai, to shah ia nga ban leit tep nyngkong ia u kpa jong nga .

en: Satan questioned whether God rules in a worthy way and in the best interests of His subjects .
kha: U Soitan u la woh nia la U Blei u donhok ne em ban synshar bad la ka jingsynshar jong u ka pynmyntoi ne em ïa la ki khun ki hajar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Soitan u la kylli la U Blei u synshar ha ka rukom kaba dei bad ha ka jingmyntoi kaba bha tam jong ki nongsynshar jong U .

en: And Jacob did so , and fulfilled her week : and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also .
kha: U Jakob u la mynjur , bad haba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim ka la kut , u Laban u la ai ha u ïa ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ba kan long ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la leh kumta, bad u la pyndep ia ka taiew jong ka: bad u la ai ia u ia ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ruh .

en: They returned to the top flight at the first opportunity by winning the First Division title .
kha: Ki la wanphai biang sha ka kyrdan ba ha khlieh duh ha ka kabu kaba nyngkong da kaba jop ïa ka nam lahduh jong ka First Division .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan phai biang sha ka liengsuin kaba ha khlieh duh ha ka kabu kaba nyngkong da kaba jop ia ka nam lahduh jong ka Division .

en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .
kha: Ko phi kiba hok baroh to lehkmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba khuid u la leh , bad to ainguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To kmen ha U Trai , phi hok bad ainguh ia ka jingkynmaw ia ka jingkhuid jong u .

en: And hath raised us up together , and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus :
kha: Ha U Khrist Jisu , la pynmihpat ïa ngi lem bad u , ba ngin ïoh synshar lem bad u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmih ia ngi ryngkat bad u la pynlong ia ngi ban shong lang ha ki jaka bneng ha U Khrist Jisu:

en: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me , saying , What are these , my lord ?
kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u angel ,  Kine kiei kiei ki ïeng na ka bynta kaei , ko rangbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la jubab bad nga la kren ha u angel uba la kren bad nga, da kaba ong, Kiei kine, ko kynrad jong nga ?

en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .
kha: U la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei , namar ki briew kim shym don jingngeit . Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ki nongrit kiba don sawdong ha kata ka thain , u da hikai ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la lyngngoh namar ka jingbymngeit jong ki . Bad u la leit kylleng kylleng ki shnong , u da hikai .

en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  had commanded Moses .
kha: bad u buh halor jong ka ïa u kpu ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia u kpu ha khmat U Trai ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved .
kha: Bad nangta , ïa uno uno uba khot kyrpad sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap yn pynim .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia , ba uno uno uba khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai un ioh jingpynim .

en: And to our beloved Apphia , and Archippus our fellowsoldier , and to the church in thy house :
kha: bad ha ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong me , bad ka Apphia ka para jong ngi , bad u Arkhippos u para shipai jong ngi :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka Appia baieit jong ngi, bad u Archipos u paralok jong ngi, bad ha ka balang ha iing jong me:

en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .
kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ki nga pynkyntang ïa lade sha me , khnang ba ma ki ruh , ki lah ban long kiba la ïoh pynkyntang da shisha sha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ki nga pynkyntang ia lade , ba kin long ruh kiba la pynkyntang lyngba ka jingshisha .

en: For great is the  Lord  , and greatly to be praised : he also is to be feared above all gods .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba eh dei ban ïaroh ; ïa u dei ban ai ka burom palat ban ïa kiwei ki blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u long uba khraw ia U Trai , bad uba dei ban iaroh shibun: u ruh u dei ban shah tieng halor ki blei baroh .

en: Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .
kha: Kumta u rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , hato me dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?   Ho-oid ,  la jubab u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah shipai u la wan bad u la ong ha u, Iathuh ia nga, me dei u Roman ? U la ong, Hooid .

en: Jesus’ ministry included teaching , performing miracles , and even offering up his life for us
kha: Ki Kam u Jisu ki kynthup ïa ka ban hikai , ban leh ïa ki kambah , wat haduh ban aiti noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshakri jong U Jisu ka kynthup ia ka jinghikai , ka jingleh ia ki kambah , bad wat ban aiti ia ka jingim jong u na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: Art thou the Christ ? tell us . And he said unto them ,  If I tell you , ye will not believe :
kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la ong ,  hato me dei U Messaïah ?  U la jubab ,  Lada nga ïathuh ha phi , phin ym ngeit ïa nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hato Me long U Khrist ? iathuh ia ngi . Bad u la ong ha ki: Lada nga ong ia phi , phin ym ngeit:

en: For this is my blood of the new testament , which is shed for many for the remission of sins .
kha: kane ka long ka snam jong nga , kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang jong U Blei , ka snam jong nga ïa kaba la theh noh na ka bynta kiba bun ïa ka ban map ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka snam jong nga jong ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba la pynkhuid na ka bynta kiba bun na ka bynta ka jingmap ia ki pop .

en: As he hath done this day , so the  Lord  hath commanded to do , to make an atonement for you .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ngi la leh mynta ka sngi , khnang ban map ïa ka pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u la leh ha kane ka sngi , kumta U Trai u la hukum ban leh , ban leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong phi .

en: There is one come out of thee , that imagineth evil against the  Lord  , a wicked counsellor .
kha: Na pha , ko Ninebeh , la wan u briew uba dap da ki jingpyrkhat bymman , uba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Don uba mih na me , uba pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew pyrshah ia U Trai , u nongai jingmut uba sniew .

en: These things also belong to the wise . It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment .
kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki don ruh ban ong ïa kine kiei kiei : Ka long ka bymdei ïa u nongbishar ban leh shiliang khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei ruh ki long ki jong kiba stad . Kam long kaba bha ban don ka jingburom ia ki briew ha ka jingbishar .

en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth : and a word spoken in due season , how good is it !
kha: Katno ka pynkmen haba ïoh ïa ka kyntien kaba dei kaba ïahap bad ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u don ka jingkmen da ka jubab jong ka shyntur jong u: bad ka ktien ba la kren ha ka por kaba biang , katno ka long kaba bha !

en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .
kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap , u la pynsangeh ïa ki ummat jong nga , bad u la sumar ïa nga na ka jingshahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la pyllait im ia ka mynsiem jong nga na ka jingiap, ki khmat jong nga na ki ummat bad ki kjat jong nga na ka jinghap .

en: Wherefore we would have come unto you , even I Paul , once and again ; but Satan hindered us .
kha: Ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat sha phi . Nga hi nga la pyrshang ban leit phai pat palat ïa ka shisien , hynrei u Soitan um ailad ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi la wan sha phi, wat ma nga ruh, shisien bad shisien hynrei u Soitan u la khanglad ia ngi .

en: Rohit has scored 2422 runs in 88 innings while Kohli has accumulated 2369 runs in 65 outings .
kha: U Rohit u la kamai 2422 ron ha ki 88 inning katba u Kohli u la lum 2369 ron ha ki 65 tylli ki outing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Rohit ka la kamai 2422 ron ha ki 88 tylli ki inning katba u Kohli u la lum 2369 ron ha ki 65 tylli ki outing .

en: And they shall say to you , See here  ; or , see there : go not after them , nor follow them .
kha: Kin don kito ki ban ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , hangtai !’ lane ‘ Ha khmih hangne !’ Hynrei wat mih shabar ban wad ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ong ia phi, Peit hangne ; ne, peit hangta : wat leit bud ia ki, ne bud ia ki .

en: And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .
kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta katta haduh ba ka la jan pynlwet ïa nga . Ïashong hangne bad to ïai ap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Ka mynsiem jong nga ka long kaba sngewsih palat haduh ka jingiap: to sah hangne , bad to peit .

en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just  ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him .
kha: U briew uba nyngkong ban kren ha ka ïingbishar borabor u sngewdei tad haduh ba uba ïaleh pyrshah u sdang ban buh jingkylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba nyngkong eh ha la ka jong ka daw u i kumba u shu ; hynrei u para marjan jong u u wan bad u wad ia u .

en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace .
kha: Ka long kumjuh mynta : Don khyndiat ngut kiba dang sah na kito kiba U Blei u la jied namar ka jingaiei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ha kane ka por ruh ka don ka jingsah katkum ka elekshon jong ka jingaiei .

en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Suffer ye thus far .  And he touched his ear , and healed him .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Keiñ noh kane !  U la ktah ïa ka shkor jong uta u briew bad u la pynkhiah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong, To sngewbha ia phi haduh mynta . U la ktah ia ka shkor jong u bad u la pynkoit ia u .

en: But if any man seem to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither the churches of God .
kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kwah ban ïasaidnia shaphang kata , baroh kaba nga don ban ong ka long ba ma ngi lymne ki balang U Blei ngi don da kawei pat ka rukom ha ka jingmane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u briew u i kumba u long uba ialeh pyrshah , ngim don kum kata ka dustur , lymne ki balang U Blei .

en: And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .
kha: Nangta kito kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long nyngkong , bad kito kiba mynta ki long nyngkong kin long khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki don kiba khatduh ki ban long nyngkong , bad ki don kiba khatduh .

en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad kumta um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud u Pharaoh , haduh ba un ym pyllait ia ki khun Israel .

en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .
kha: Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kum u dieng Olib uba hap noh ki shylluit .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynkhih ia u sohjew jong u uba khlem san kum u sohjew , bad un bret noh ia u syntiew jong u kum u olive .

en: They are vanity , and the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
kha: Ki long ki bymdondor bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ; yn sa pynjot ïa ki haba U  Trai  u wan ban leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba sniew , bad ka kam jong ki jingbakla: ha ka por jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki kin sa jah noh .

en: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them : for the king s word was abominable to Joab .
kha: Namar u Joab um pdiang ïa ka hukum jong u syiem , um shym la shim jingkheiñ ïa ki jait Lebi bad Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Lebi bad u Benjamin kim shym la khein ia u: namar ka ktien jong u syiem ka long kaba sngewsih ia u Joab .

en: And there came forth a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will persuade him .
kha: Katto katne na ki angel ki ong ïa kawei bad kiwei ki ong da kumwei pat , haduh ba u mynsiem u jam sha khmat , u wan sha U  Trai  bad u ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan mih uwei u mynsiem bad u la ieng ha khmat U Trai bad u la ong , Ngan pynsngewthuh ia u .

en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah khyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Peleg u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Reu arspah hynniew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour , they received every man a penny .
kha: Ïa ki rangbah kiba la sdang ban trei ha ka por san baje la ai mar shi sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi kumba shiphew kynta , ki la pdiang ia uwei pa uwei u pisa .

en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels  ; but he took on him the seed of Abraham .
kha: Namar ka shai kdar , ba ym dei ïa ki angel ba u ïarap . Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U ïarap ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha um shym la shim ia u ia ka jinglong jong ki angel ; hynrei u la shim ia u ia u symbai u Abraham .

en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .
kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade ,  Un ym pynshitom ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba u bymman u la ong ha ka dohnud jong u , Men ym dawa ia ka .

en: Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ; ïaroh ïa ka burom bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha U Trai , ko ki paralok jong ki briew , ai ha U Trai ia ka burom bad ka bor .

en: Their knops and their branches were of the same : all of it was one beaten work of pure gold .
kha: Ki shata , ki tnat , bad ka ktang u diengpynïeng sharak ki long kiba ïadait lang kawei da ka ksiar nylla ba la shoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki knop jong ki bad ki tnat jong ki ki long kumjuh: baroh ka long kawei ka kam ksiar kaba khuid .

en: To speak evil of no man , to be no brawlers , but gentle , shewing all meekness unto all men .
kha: Ong ïa ki ban ym kren sniew ïano ïano , hynrei ban long kiba shongsuk bad ïadei paralok , bad ban pyn-i borabor da ka jinglong bajemnud sha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban kren sniew ia uno uno u briew, ban ym long ki nonglehkai , hynrei kiba jemnud , kiba pyni ia ka jinglong jemnud baroh ha ki briew baroh .

en: Get wisdom , get understanding : forget it not  ; neither decline from the words of my mouth .
kha: A to ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ! Wat klet lane leh bymsuidñiew ïa ki ktien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ioh ia ka jingstad, ioh ia ka jingsngewthuh: wat klet ia ka;

en: The lion hath roared , who will not fear ? the Lord  God  hath spoken , who can but prophesy ?
kha: Haba u sing u kyrhuh , uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingtieng ? Haba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kren , uei uba lah ban lait khlem pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: U sing u la rkhie bein , mano ba nym tieng ? U Trai Blei u la kren , mano ba lah ban iathuhlypa ?

en: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
kha: Husiar ïoh phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynriewspah katne ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me ong ha ka dohnud jong me , Ka bor bad ka bor jong ka kti jong nga ka la ioh ia nga ia kane ka spah .

en: But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .
kha: ‘ Em ,’ u la jubab , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi lah ban kum jynrat katto katne u kew lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong: Em lada phi lum ia ki sohjew , phi lum ruh ia u kew bad ki .

en: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem , and to hinder it .
kha: Kumta ki ïasylla lang ban wan bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad thaw jingkulmar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la ia thmu lang baroh ban wan bad ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem bad ban khanglad ia ka .

en: And God was with the lad  ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .
kha: U Blei u la long ryngkat bad uta u khynnah katba u nang heh nang san ; u la im ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran bad u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la don bad ka lad ; bad u la san bad u la shong ha ka ri khlaw bad u la kylla long u nongsiat khnam .

en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :
kha: To phin pynrit ïa lade , namarkata , hapoh ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi shajrong ha ka por kaba biang jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduna ia lade namarkata hapoh ka kti ba donbor jong U Blei , ba un pynkhraw ia phi ha ka por kaba biang:

en: Thus did all the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
kha: Baroh ki Israel ki la kohnguh bad leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khun Israel baroh ki la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses bad u Aaron .

en: Then said he , These are the two anointed ones , that stand by the Lord of the whole earth .
kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Kine ki long ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba U Blei u la jied bad pynsleh ba kin shakri ïa u , U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong , Kine ki long ki arngut kiba la pynsleh , kiba ieng hajan U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And it came to pass , when they saw him , that they brought thirty companions to be with him .
kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ïa u , ki phah laiphew ngut ki samla shynrang ban sah bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki la iohi ia u , ba ki la wanrah laiphew ngut ki paralok ban don ryngkat bad u .

en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .
kha: Katba u dang don ha lynti sha ïing , ki shakri jong u ki la wan shem ïa u bad ka khubor ,  U khun jong me un im !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang hiar mynta, ki shakri jong u ki la iakynduh ia u, bad ki la iathuh ha u, ki da ong: U khun jong me u im .

en: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .
kha: Hynrei dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba wan sha ki briew bad uba ai ha ki ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka don ka mynsiem ha u briew: bad ka jingpynshlur jong Uba donbor baroh ka ai ia ki ia ka jingsngewthuh .

en: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride : but the lips of the wise shall preserve them .
kha: Ha ka jingsarong , kiba bieit ki kren shaba palat ; ki ktien jong kiba stad ki ïada ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka shyntur jong kiba bieit ka don ka jinglehrain: hynrei ki rmiang shyntur jong kiba stad kin pynneh ia ki .

en: But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
kha: Pynban , ki shem jingkmen ha kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long ha ka hukum U Trai ; bad ha ka hukum jong u u pyrkhat miet bad sngi .

en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart : and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly .
kha: Baroh ki ktien jong nga ki long kiba beit bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong nga kin long kiba beit jong ka dohnud jong nga: bad ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin pynpaw shai ia ka jingtip .

en: They shall have like portions to eat , beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony .
kha: U dei ban ïoh bynta mar katjuh ka jingbam kumba long kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , bad u lah ban buh ïa kano kano kaba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki phah sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin don kum ki bynta ban bam , nalor kata kaba wan na ka jingdie ia ka jinglong jong u .

en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly , he shall not save of that which he desired .
kha: Ïa ka jinglalot jong u ym lah ban pynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid un ym sngew ia ka jingsngap jar ha ka kpoh jong u , un ym pynim ia kata kaba u kwah .

en: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,
kha: Ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh ha U Jisu , ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah , bad pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phong ia u da ka rong saw bad ki la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven ,
kha: Te u angel ïa uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew u la rah ïa la ka kti kamon sha bneng
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u angel uba nga iohi u ieng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew u la rah ia la ka kti sha bneng .

en: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .
kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u Jonah bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw , bad ka la long jai jai ha ka shikhyllipmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shim ia u Jonah, bad ki la bret noh ia u sha duriaw: bad ka duriaw ka la sangeh noh na ka jingbitar jong ka .

en: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving , and declare his works with rejoicing .
kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa u da ki jingkñia , bad da ki jingrwai jong ka jingkmen ki dei ban ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kin knia ia ki jingknia jong ka jingsngewnguh , bad pynbna ia ki kam jong u da ka jingkmen .

en: And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .
kha: U Gad bad ki khun shynrang jong u : U Sephon , u Haggi , u Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod , bad u Areli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gad ; Zphion, bad u Haggi, u Shuni, bad u Esbon, u Eri, bad u Arodi, bad u Areli .

en: The same material is studied in every one of our more than 110 ,000 congregations earth wide .
kha: Baroh ki balang kiba don palat 1 ,10 ,000 tylli ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki ïa pule ïa kajuh ka bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kajuh ka jingthoh la pule ha kawei pa kawei na ki jingpyniasoh jong ngi palat 110 000 tylli ki pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate , and thy neck is an iron sinew , and thy brow brass  ;
kha: Nga la tip ba phin pynshisha ba phi long kiba mutlop , kiba pyneh kum ka nar bad ka rnong bym lah ban pynkdor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba me long uba sting, bad ka ryndang jong me ka long ka sniehdoh nar, bad ka nar kaba jem jong me;

en: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .
kha: Kumta ki la khot biang ïa ki shapoh bad ki la ong ïa ki ba kim dei da lei lei ban kren lane hikai ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia ki bad ki la hukum ia ki ba kim dei ban kren satia ne hikai ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .

en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is : but when Christ cometh , no man knoweth whence he is .
kha: Hynrei haba U Messaïah un wan , ym don ba tip na-ei ba u wan . Bad baroh ngi tip nangno une u briew u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ngi tip ia une u briew naei u don: hynrei haba U Khrist u wan, ym don ba tip shano u don .

en: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand , which is the token in every epistle : so I write .
kha: Da ki kti jong nga hi , nga thoh ïa kane : Ki jingkhublei na u Paul . Kane ka dei ka rukom ba nga soi ïa kawei pa kawei ka shithi ; kane ka long kumno nga thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynkylla ia u Paul da ka kti jong nga hi, kaba long ka token ha man la ka epistle: kumta nga thoh .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou canst believe , all things are possible to him that believeth .
kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  lada ma me hi me lah . Kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ïa u briew uba don ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Lada me lah ban ngeit , kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ban long ha uta uba ngeit .

en: And it came to pass , as she continued praying before the  Lord  , that Eli marked her mouth .
kha: Ka Hannah ka la ïai duwai slem ha U  Trai  bad u Eli u nang khmih ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ka dang iai duwai ha khmat U Trai , ba u Eli u la buh dak ia ka shyntur jong ka .

en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
kha: Da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , mynta la pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng jong ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin long kiba lait im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham palat ha kata ka por, haba la pynksan mynta da ka snam jong u , ngin sa shah pynim na ka jingbitar lyngba jong u .

en: That Moses commanded the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Ynda u la dep , u ong ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u Moses u la hukum ia ki Lebi kiba kit ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai da kaba ong:

en: Thou makest darkness , and it is night : wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .
kha: Me la thaw ïa ka miet , bad ha ka jingdum baroh ki mradkhlaw ki mih shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Me pynlong ia ka jingdum, bad ka long ka miet: ha kaba ki mrad khlaw baroh ki iaid shabar .

en: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof :
kha: U dei U Blei uba shim ïa ka um na ka khyndew bad pynkylla ïa ka sha ki jingjaw jong u slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u pynlong rit ia ki tdem um: ki theh ia u slap kat kum ka lyer jong ka:

en: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam bad u nongai hukum ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyngba jong u nga la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la ai ia u kum u sakhi ia ki briew , u nongialam bad u nongialam ia ki briew .

en: The NSO group has said that it has given Pegasus licenses only to governments across the world
kha: Ka kynhun NSO ka la ong ba ka la ai license Pegasus tang ia ki sorkar ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun NSO ka la ong ba ka la ai laisen ia ki Pegasus tang sha ki sorkar ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

en: She hath killed her beasts  ; she hath mingled her wine  ; she hath also furnished her table .
kha: Ka la shah ba kin pynïap ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ka jingkhawai , ka la khleh jingiwbih ha ka waiñ , bad ka la pynkhreh ïa ka miej .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pyniap ia ki mrad jong ka ; ka la khleh lang ia ka wain jong ka ; ka la pynbiang ruh ia ka miej jong ka .

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; We have heard a voice of trembling , of fear , and not of peace .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ka jinglynñiar ka jingsngewtriem , ka jinglynñiar ka jingtieng bad ym ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai ; Ngi la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka jingtieng , bad ym jong ka jingsuk .

en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?
kha: U Thomas u la ong ha u ,  Ko Kynrad , ngim tip shano ba men leit ; te kumno ngin tip ïa ka lynti ban poi hangta ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Thomas u ong ha u, ko Trai, ngim tip shano me leit ; bad kumno ngin tip ia ka lynti ?

en: And the  Lord  visited Sarah as he had said , and the  Lord  did unto Sarah as he had spoken .
kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka Sarah kumba u la kular , bad ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang ïa u Abraham haba u la tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leit jngoh ia ka Sarah kumba u la ong , bad U Trai u la leh ia ka Sarah kumba u la kren .

en: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God .
kha: Ki jingthaw baroh ki ap da ka jingthrang hir hir ba U Blei un pynpaw ïa ki khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingkhmih lynti kaba jur jong u jingthaw ka ap ia ka jingpynpaw jong ki khun U Blei .

en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el . ( Now the name of the city before was Luz . )
kha: Ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Bethel , kaba ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Lus . U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki . Ki la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha ka nongbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka iing u Joseph ka la phah ban kyntait ia u Bethel . (Mynta ka kyrteng jong ka shnong shuwa ka long ka Luz . )

en: The king s favour is toward a wise servant : but his wrath is against him that causeth shame .
kha: Ki syiem ki sngewtynnat ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba lah , hynrei ki pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynlehrain ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u long uba stad: hynrei ka jingbitar jong u ka long pyrshah ia u kaba pynlong ia ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore , and among the sons of Merari .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingbate kam ïa ki nongap phira kiba na ka kur u Korah bad na ka kur u Merari .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki jingphiah jong ki nongrah khmat hapdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Kore , bad hapdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Meri .

en: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength , and it was infinite  ; Put and Libya were thy helpers .
kha: Ka la synshar ïa ka Sudan bad ïa ka Ijipt , ym don pud ïa ka bor jong ka ; ka Libya ka la long ka paralok jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ethiopia bad ka Ijipt ki long ka bor jong ka, bad ka la long kaba khlem kut; U Put bad ka Libya ki long ki nongiarap jong me .

en: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation .
kha: Kumta ki shipai ki aiti noh ïa kita ki koidi bad ïa ki mar lute ha ki paidbah bad ki nongïalam jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la iehnoh ia ki mraw bad ka jingjot ha khmat ki syiem bad ka balang baroh .

en: Ask thee a sign of the  Lord  thy God  ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above .
kha: To pan na U  Trai  U Blei jong me ban ai ka dak ha me . Ka lah ban long na kaba jylliew ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap lane nang tei najrong eh jong ka bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli ia me ia ka dak jong U Trai U Blei jong me;

en: To the extent that each family member applies the Bible’s counsel , family life will benefit .
kha: Kat ba lah u wei pa u wei u dkhot jong ka ïng ka sem u dei ban pyndonkam ia ki jinghikai jong ka Baibl , khnang ba ka longing longsem kan bit kan biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh katta katta ba uwei pa uwei u dkhot jong ka longïing u pyndonkam ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ka Baibl, ka jingim ha ka longïing kan ïoh jingmyntoi .

en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
kha: Ban pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , un shim ar tylli ki sim , khyndiat u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ban pynkhuid ia ka iing ar tylli ki sim, bad u dieng cedar, bad u dieng cedar:

en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
kha: Ka ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka long ka kper barieh , ka kper ba la ker kynroh , ka umpohliew bym dei paidbah ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong u ki long kum ki khmat jong ki paro da ki wah um , la sait da ka dud bad la set bha .

en: Is he the God of the Jews only ? is he not also of the Gentiles ? Yes , of the Gentiles also :
kha: Lane ba U Blei u long U Blei tang jong ki Jiw ? Hato um dei U Blei jong ki Jentil ruh ? Da shisha u dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u dei u Blei jong ki Jiw tang ? hato um dei ruh na ki Jutang ? Hooid , na ki Jutang ruh:

en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust  ; my skin is broken , and become loathsome .
kha: La sop ïa ka met jong nga da ki ksaiñ , bad la tap ïa ka da ki prum ; ka ksuit ka mih na ki prum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh jong nga ka la tyrkhong da ki khniang bad ki dewbilat ; ka sniehdoh jong nga ka la tyrkhong , bad ka la kylla long kaba sniew .

en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .
kha: U maham ïa phi ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong u syiem , Wat ai ba u Hesekaiah un shukor ia phi: namar un ym lah ban pyllait im ia phi .

en: And it fell on a day , that he came thither , and he turned into the chamber , and lay there .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u la wan phai sha Shunem bad u la leit kiew sha la ka kamra ban pynjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hap ha kawei ka sngi , ba u la wan shata , bad u la phai shapoh ka kamra bad u la thiah hangta .

en: But now it is come upon thee , and thou faintest  ; it toucheth thee , and thou art troubled .
kha: Mynta ka wan jia sa ha me ban don ha ka jynjar , bad me dum ka buit ka stad ban ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka la wan ha me, bad me sngewsih ba ka ktah ia me, bad me la sngewsih .

en: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :
kha: Nga la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Peit , nga la khot da ka kyrteng u Bezaleel u khun u Uri , u khun u Hur , na ka jait Judah:

en: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness , and righteousness remain in the fruitful field .
kha: Ha kylleng ka ri , ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok , yn pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka jingbishar kan shong ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka hok kan sah ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh .

en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
kha: To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thap basniew jong u Soitan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndait ia ka jainkup baroh kawei jong U Blei , ba phin lah ban ieng pyrshah ia ki tyrpeng jong u ksuid .

en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .
kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïingbishar ; wallam ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ! Buh ïa ka kam jong phi ban pynshisha ba phi long ha kaba dei !
translated_en_to_kha: Buh ia nga ha ka jingkynmaw: to ngin ia kyrpad lang: pynbna ia me , ba me long uba hok .

en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,
kha: Na kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assyria , bad u tei hangta ïa ki nongbah ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kata ka ri u la leit noh u Asshur bad u la tei ia ka shnong Ninebe, bad ka shnong Rehoboth bad u Calah .

en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .
kha: Nga bishni ïa kito kiba la ïap bad kiba la leit noh ; ki long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la iaroh ia kiba iap kiba la iap kham palat ban ia kiba dang im .

en: Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
kha: Ka kynhun ka la aiti ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la duwai bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kiba ki buh ha khmat ki apostol : bad haba ki la duwai ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ki .

en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter , and abode with him fifteen days .
kha: Ka la long lai snem hadien ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïoh jingtip na u Petros , bad nga la sah bad u ar taïew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta hadien lai snem nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban iohi ia u Petros bad nga la sah bad u shiphew sngi .

en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the  Lord  met him , and sought to kill him .
kha: Ha ka jaka sahmiet ha lynti , U  Trai  u ïashem bad u Moses , bad u mut ban pynïap noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka lynti ha ka iing sah , ba U Trai u la iakynduh ia u bad u la wad ban pyniap ia u .

en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pyrta ha U Trai ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , bad u la pynim ia ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki .

en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,
kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh Kapernam , u rangbah pynïaidkam ka Hima Rom u la wan ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrpad jingïarap :
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la rung ha Kapernam, u la wan ha u uwei u rangbah shipai uba la kyrpad ia u .

en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep hikai ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , u la ong ha la ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba U Jisu u la dep ia kine ki ktien baroh, u la ong ha ki synran jong u:

en: And there went out fire from the  Lord  , and devoured them , and they died before the  Lord .
kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad kata ka thang ïa ki hangta ha khmat jong U  Trai  haduh ba kin da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka ding na U Trai , bad ka la bam ia ki , bad ki la iap ha khmat U Trai .

en: Behold , their valiant ones shall cry without : the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba shlur ki pan jingïarap . Ki nongkit  tiensyiem kiba pyrshang ban wallam ka jingsuk ki ïam sngewsih kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , kiba shlur jong ki kin iam shabar: ki nonglam khubor jong ka jingsuk kin iam sngewsih .

en: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .
kha: Haba ka Naomi ka ïohi ba ka Ruth ka la kut jingmut skhem ban leit bad ka , kam shym ong ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ka la iohi ba ka la thrang ban leit bad ka , nangta ka la leit noh da kaba kren ia ka .

en: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour : but the way of the wicked seduceth them .
kha: U briew uba hok u long ka jingkdew lynti ïa la u paralok , hynrei ka lynti jong u bymman ka ïalam bakla ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok u kham bha ban ia u paramarjan jong u: hynrei ka lynti jong ki bymman ka pynshoi ia ki .

en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
kha: Pynban , ym don uno uno ruh uba tip lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta kan wan — ym ki angel ha bneng lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa hi uba tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na kata ka sngi bad ka por ym don ba tip, em, ym ki angel bneng , hynrei tang U Kpa jong nga .

en: I know that there is no good in them , but for a man to rejoice , and to do good in his life .
kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh ba baroh kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban kmen bad leh ïa kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah katba ngi dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ba ym don jingbha ha ki , hynrei na ka bynta u briew ban kmen bad ban leh ia kaba bha ha ka jingim jong u .

en: Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .
kha: Te u Philip u la sdang ban kren ; da kaba sdang na kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , u la ïathuh ïa u ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Philip u la plie ia ka shyntur jong u bad u la sdang ha kajuh ka jingthoh bad u la ialap ha u Jisu .

en: And if thou say in thine heart , How shall we know the word which the  Lord  hath not spoken ?
kha: Phi lah ban lyngngoh kumno phi lah ban ong haba ka khubor u nongïathuhlypa kam shym wan na U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me ong ha ka dohnud jong me , Kumno ngin ithuh ia ka ktien kaba U Trai um shym la kren ?

en: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .
kha: Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lum , bad ïa ka pyrthei la pyndap da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U ai um ia ki lum na ki kamra jong u: ka khyndew ka sngewhun ia u soh jong ki kam jong me .

en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .
kha: Ki jingkyrmen jong ki briew kiba bha ki lam sha ka jingkmen , hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti ki riewbymman kam lam shano shano .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong kiba hok kan long ka jingkmen: hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti jong kiba sniew kan jah noh .

en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .
kha: U la mynjur ban siew ïa ki ka bainong sngi , shi sbai rupa shi sngi , bad u la phah ïa ki ban trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ia mynjur bad ki nongtrei na ka bynta ka pisa shisngi , u la phah ia ki sha ka kper sohjew jong u .

en: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?
kha: Lada U Blei u khmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long kaba bha ba un wad ia phi ? lane kumba uwei u briew u rkhie bein ia u ?

en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .
kha: Ka jingïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , ka jinglut noh jong ka ruh ka long kaba kloi eh . Kaba kham eh ban ïoh ïa ka , kaba kham roi ruh ka jingïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka spah kaba la ioh da ka jinglong ba sniew kan nang duna: hynrei uta uba lum da ka jingtrei shitom un nang kiew .

en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .
kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh kum ki kulai thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dur jong ki ka long kum ka dur jong ki kulai ; bad kum ki kulai , kumta kin mareh .

en: Let all the earth fear the  Lord  : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .
kha: To mane ïa U  Trai  , phi baroh ka pyrthei ! To pyndonburom ïa u , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka khyndew baroh kan sheptieng ia U Trai: ai ba ki nongshong shnong jong ka pyrthei kin ieng ha ka jingsheptieng ia u .

en: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .
kha: Ïa phi ym dei ban khot ‘ ko Nonghikai ,’ namar ba phi baroh phi ïalong mar ryngkat bad don tang uwei U Nonghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat shah khot Rabbi: namar uwei u long u Nonghikai jong phi, wat U Khrist ; bad phi baroh phi long ki para .

en: Arise , go unto Nineveh , that great city , and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee .
kha: U ong ,  Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah bakhraw , bad to pynbna ha ki briew ïa ka khubor kaba nga la ai ha me
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, leit sha Nineveh, kata ka shnong kaba khraw, bad to ialap ha ka ia ka jingialap ba nga hukum ia me .

en: Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane mynta , khnang ba haba kata kan jia , phin ngeit ba ‘ Nga long uba nga long .’
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga ong ia phi shuwa ba kan wan, ba ynda ka la jia , phi lah ban ngeit ba nga long ma nga .

en: Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .
kha: Ki la jubab ïa u da kaba pyrta jam ,  Em , ym dei ïa u ! Ngi kwah ïa u Barabbas !  ( u Barabbas u la long u nongkamsniew . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pyrta biang baroh, ki da ong, Ym ia une u briew, hynrei u Barabbas . Mynta u Barabbas u la long u nongtuh .

en: But if they obey not , they shall perish by the sword , and they shall die without knowledge .
kha: Hynrei lymda kumta , kin ïap ha ka jingbymtip bad ryngkang ïa ka wah sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kim kohnguh , kin sa jah noh da ka waitlam bad kin sa iap khlem jingtip .

en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , and the house that he had built ,
kha: Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ïohi ïa ka jingstad u Solomon , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka ïingsyiem ba u la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka mahadei ka Sheba ka la iohi ia ka jingstad u Solomon bad ka iing kaba u la tei .

en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .
kha: U Simon Petros u la pyn-i dak ïa u bad u la ong ,  Kylli ïa u ba u kren shaphang jongno .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u la sngewsih ia u , ba u dei ban kylli mano ba u kren .

en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt , which the head or tail , branch or rush , may do .
kha: Ym don mano mano ha Ijipt , uba riewspah ne uba duk , uba donnam ne u bym donnam , uba lah ban tyrwa ban ïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym don kano kano ka kam na ka bynta ka ri Ijipt, kaba ka khlieh ne ka tnat ne ka tnat ne ka tnat ka lah ban leh .

en: For what if some did not believe ? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect ?
kha: Hynrei kumno lada katto katne na ki kim long kiba ïaineh ? Hato kane ka mut ba U Blei un ym long uba ïaineh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumno lada don kiba ngeit ? hato ka jingbymngeit jong ki kan pynlong ia ka jingngeit U Blei khlem jingktah ?

en: What will ye ? shall I come unto you with a rod , or in love , and in the spirit of meekness ?
kha: Kaei kaba phi kham jied ? Hato ngan wan sha phi da u dieng sympat , ne ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit bad ka jingjemnud ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi kwah ? ngan wan sha phi da u diengduh ne ha ka jingieit bad ha ka mynsiem jong ka jingjemnud ?

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Thou hast well seen : for I will hasten my word to perform it .
kha: Me ong kaba dei  U  Trai  u la ong ,  bad nga dang khmih ban ïohi ba ki kyntien jong nga ki wan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga, Me la iohi bha: namar ngan pynkloi ia ka ktien jong nga ban pyndep ia ka .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , To day shalt thou be with me in paradise .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Nga kular ïa me ba ha kane ka sngi men don ha ka Paradais bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u: Hooid nga ong ha me: Ha ka sngi me long bad nga ha ka paradais .

en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction : and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ka Kushan ba ki sheptieng bad ki briew ka Midian ki khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ki ïingjaiñ jong u Cushan ha ka jingshah pynshitom: bad ki jingtap jong ka ri Midian ki la khih .

en: Let another man praise thee , and not thine own mouth  ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .
kha: Ai ba kiwei pat ki briew kin ïaroh ïa phi — wat ki nongwei ; ym dei ban leh ïa ka na lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba uwei pat un iaroh ia me, bad ym ia la ka jong ka shyntur beg u nongwei, bad ym ia la ki rmiang shyntur .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise God in his sanctuary : praise him in the firmament of his power .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Templ jong u ! To ïaroh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u ha bneng !
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . Iaroh ia U Blei ha ka jaka kyntang jong u: iaroh ia u ha ka bynta jong ka bor jong u .

en: As coals are to burning coals , and wood to fire  ; so is a contentious man to kindle strife .
kha: U rnga u pynrhem ïa ka ding , ka diengïap ka pynmeh ïa ka , u nongthaw jingkulmar u pynshit ïa ki jingïamai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki dewiong ki dei ban thang ia ki dewiong , bad ki dieng ban thang ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba ialeh pyrshah ban pynmih ia ka jingialeh .

en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
kha: Da kumno u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingim ? Da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba u samla un pynkhuid ia la ka lynti ? da kaba sumar ia ka kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: For whosoever shall do the will of God , the same is my brother , and my sister , and mother .
kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , u long u para jong nga , ka para jong nga , ka kmie jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno u briew uba leh ia ka mon U Blei, kumjuh ruh u hynmen jong nga bad ka para jong nga bad ka kmie jong nga .

en: Now he hath not directed his words against me : neither will I answer him with your speeches .
kha: U Job u la kren ha phi , ym ha nga , hynrei ngan ym jubab ha ka rukom ba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta um shym la bthah ia ki ktien jong u pyrshah ia nga: lymne ngan jubab ia u da ki jingkren jong phi .

en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .
kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ka jingieit jong ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien bad ka jingkren ; ka dei ban long ka jingieit kaba shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit jong nga, to ngin ym ieit ha ka ktien, ym ha ka shyntur ; hynrei ha ka kam bad ha ka jingshisha .

en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art  ; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .
kha: U dei u parabriew jong me uba shahshitom na ki pop jong me , bad kaba bha kaba me leh ka ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew jong me ka lah ban pynmong ia u briew kumba me long; bad ka hok jong me ka lah ban pynmyntoi ia u khun u briew .

en: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .
kha: Ka jingsngewbha jong u kam long ha ki kulai bakhlaiñ ; lymne ka jingkmen jong u ha ki shipai bashlur ;
translated_en_to_kha: Um sngewbha ia ka jingkhlain jong u kulai: um shim jingsngewbha ia ki kjat jong u briew .

en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .
kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , U Jisu u la don hangta marwei ; bad hamar kane ka por ka lieng ka la don jngai ha ka duriaw , ba la kynting shane shatai da ki jingat phyllung , namar ba ka lyer ka la beh pyrshah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka lieng mynta ka la don hapdeng ka duriaw , ka la tyrkhong da ki um: namar ka Iyer ka la long pyrshah .

en: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .
kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Un tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ngan pynskhem ia ka khet jong ka hima jong u junom .

en: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment  ; and they called his name Esau .
kha: Uba nyngkong u long uba saw doh , bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka long kum ka jaiñkup shñiuh ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba nyngkong ka la mih saw, baroh sawdong kum ka jain kaba jyrngam ; bad ki la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Iso .

en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .
kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na ki , ki la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don napdeng jong ki kiba la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la iathuh ha ki ia kiei kiei kiba U Jisu u la leh .

en: Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,
kha: Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Moses , kaba u khlem ïalam lang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jethro u kpa jong u Moses u la shim ia ka Zipporah ka tnga jong u Moses hadien ba u la phah biang ia ka .

en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . And the land had rest fourscore years .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel ki la jop ïa ki Moab , bad ka jingsuk ka la don ha ka ri haduh phraphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Moab u la shah pynrem ha kata ka sngi hapoh ka kti jong ki Israel . Bad ka ri ka la shongthait saw snem .

en: Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death  ;
kha: Ngan sa leit noh shen bad ngan ym wan phai shuh — ban leit sha ka ri kaba dum bad kaba bym don jingkyrmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ba ngan leit shano ngan ym wan phai shuh, wat sha ka ri jong ka jingdum bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap ; .

en: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families .
kha: Ka jingsam kaba hynñiew la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lot kaba hynriew ka la mih na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Dan kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: And as they were loosing the colt , the owners thereof said unto them , Why loose ye the colt ?
kha: Katba ki dang loit ïa u khun kada , u trai jong u , u la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi ïalaw ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang pyllait ia u khun masi , ki trai jong ka ki la ong ha ki , Balei phi pyllait ia u khun masi ?

en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort  ; and I answered them after the same manner .
kha: Ki phah ïa nga ïa kajuh ka khubor saw sien , bad ha man la ki sien , nga phah ïa kijuh ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la phah sha nga saw sien hadien kane ka jait ; bad nga la jubab ia ki ha kajuh ka rukom .

en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi ïa u briew uba don u ksai thew ha ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la rah biang ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la peit, bad ha khmih u briew uba don u lain thew ha ka kti jong u .

en: For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .
kha: Naba ïa baroh kiei kiei la thaw da u , bad baroh kiei kiei ki long lyngba jong u bad na ka bynta jong u . Ha U Blei , to long ka burom junom ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong u, bad lyngba jong u, bad ha u, kiei kiei baroh: ha kiba ka long ka burom junom . Amen .

en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
kha: Ngi ïoh ban im ka jingim jong ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , ngi khuslai , bitar bad ïohpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki sngi jong u ruh u bam ha ka jingdum , bad u don ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingbitar kaba khraw bad ka jingpang jong u .

en: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I  ; how can I dispossess them ?
kha: Wat leit ong ha la ka dohnud , kine ki jaitbynriew ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi , kumno ngi lah ban beh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me ong ha ka dohnud jong me , Kine ki jaitbynriew ki kham palat ia nga ; kumno ngan pynduh noh ia ki ?

en: But if they will not obey , I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh , te ngan rat lut khoit bad pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kin ym kohnguh , ngan sa ktah bad pynjot lut ia kata ka jaitbynriew , ong U Trai .

en: Behold , ye are of nothing , and your work of nought : an abomination is he that chooseth you .
kha: Phi bad baroh kaba phi leh kim long ei ei ; kito kiba mane ïa phi ki long kiba isaitmet !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, phim long ei ei, bad ka kam jong phi kaba khlem jingmyntoi: ka long kaba sngewsih ia phi .

en: And he returned unto his brethren , and said , The child is not  ; and I , whither shall I go ?
kha: U leit phai pat sha la ki para , bad u ong ,  U para um don shuh hangta ! Ngam tip shuh ngan leh kumno .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit phai sha ki hynmen jong u bad u la ong: U khynnah um dei u ; bad nga , shano ngan leit ?

en: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain , The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy ?
kha: Wat pyrkhat ba kam don ka jingshisha ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  Ka mynsiem kaba U Blei u la buh hapoh jong ngi ka dap da ki jingkwah kiba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka jingthoh ka ong lehnohei , Ka mynsiem kaba shong ha ngi ka kwah ban sngewsih ?

en: And when they had this done , they inclosed a great multitude of fishes : and their net brake .
kha: Nangta , ki la pynhiar ïa ki bad ki la ngat shibun tylli ki dohkha bad ki jar ki la jan kad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leh ia kane, ki la khang ia ki dohkha kiba bun: bad ka jingkhang jong ki kaba pura .

en: When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :
kha: Nga la lah don hangta mynba u thaw ïa ka sahit bneng , mynba u pynïar ïa ka jylli halor ka duriaw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la pynkhreh ia ki bneng , nga la don hangta : haba u la buh ia ka kompas ha ka khmat jong ka jingjylliew:

en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba kwah ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hadien ba u la dih ïa ka waiñ barim . ‘ Kaba rim ka kham bha ,’ u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba dih ia ka wain kaba rim uba kwah beit: namar u ong , Kaba rim ka kham bha .

en: Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Ha ka jingsngew jong me , uei na kine lai ngut uba la leh kum u paramarjan ïa u briew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei mynta na kine lai ngut, phi pyrkhat ba phi long para marjan bad uta uba la hap hapdeng ki nongtuh ?

en: Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;
kha: U  Trai  u khmih sumar ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa u , ïa kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u ,
