translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka khmat U Trai ka don ha kito kiba sheptieng ia u, ha kito kiba kyrmen ha ka jingisynei jong u;

en: That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
kha: Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba da ka bor jong u , u la leh ki kam bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da kad arliang ïa ki um ka duriaw bad ïalam ïa ki briew jong u lyngba ki um kiba jylliew , ban ïoh ïa ka nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade ?  Ha ka jingïalam U  Trai  , ki kjat jong ki , ki long skhem kum ki kulai khlaw , bad kim ju jynthut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka la ialam ia ki lyngba ka jingjylliew , kum u kulai ha ka ri khlaw , ba kim dei ban shah pynthut ?

en: In Poland , it was once common to boil a can of condensed milk in water for about three hours .
kha: Ha Poland , shisien ka ju long ban pynkhluit ia ka tin dud ba la khleh lang ha ka um kumba lai kynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Poland , ka la ju long shisien ban pynkhluit ia ka tin jong ka dud ba la khleh lang ha ka um kumba lai kynta .

en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :
kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa nga lane ïohsngew shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka shkor ka la iohsngew ia nga , te ka la kyrkhu ia nga ; bad haba ka khmat ka la iohi ia nga , ka la sakhi ia nga:

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .
kha: Balei me khot uba bha ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ym don uno uno uba bha lait tang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Balei me khot ia nga uba bha? ym don ba bha, lait noh tang uwei, kata ka long U Blei .

en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .
kha: U Blei u pynshitom ïa ki , namar ïa kaei kaba lah ban tip shaphang U Blei ka long kaba shai ha ki , naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynshai ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata kaba lah ban tip na U Blei ka paw ha ki ; namar U Blei u la pyni ia ka ha ki .

en: And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :
kha: Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , khyndiat na u symbai u la hap ha lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la bet, katto katne ki symbai ki la hap ha rud lynti, bad ki sim ki la wan bad ki la bam ia ki:

en: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty : they shall behold the land that is very far off .
kha: Sa shisien pat phin ïohi ïa u syiem ba u synshar ha ka burom bakhraw ha ka hima kaba pyiar ha baroh ki liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia u syiem ha ka jingitynnad jong u: kin iohi ia ka ri kaba jngai bha .

en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano kaba ki lah ban ong , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah uba ïeng hangta lem bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohi ia uta u briew uba la koit bad ki , kim lah ban ong ei ei pyrshah ia kata .

en: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families .
kha: Ka jingsam kaba san la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Asher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lot kaba phra ka la mih na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Asher kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .
kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi A to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ka jingmih jong ka sngi haduh ka jinghiar jong u Trai ka long ban iaroh .

en: And some fell among thorns , and the thorns grew up , and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .
kha: Katto katne na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , kiba mih bad kiba la kjap noh ïa ki jingthung , bad kim shym la pynmih kew ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la hap hapdeng ki thliew bad ki thliew ki la san bad ki la tyrkhong ia ka bad kam shym la ai soh ei ei .

en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .
kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong u briew ki long kum ka um ha ka pukri kaba jylliew , hynrei uba don ka jingïohi jngai u lah ban tong noh ïa ki shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpang ha ka dohnud u briew ka long kum ka um kaba jylliew ; hynrei u briew uba sngewthuh un sei ia ka .

en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him .
kha: ha kaba u Balak u la pynïap ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad u phah rah de katto katne ka doh sha u Balaam bad kita ki nongïalam kiba ïadon lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la tyrwa ia ki masi bad ki langbrot bad u la phah sha u Balaam bad sha ki rangbah kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned two years in Jerusalem .
kha: U Amon u la don arphew ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amon u la don arphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem .

en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
kha: Naba don shibun , khamtam kiba la kylla na ka niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiwei da ka jingleh bym don jingmut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki don bun ki nongkren bad ki nongleh thok kiba khlem akor bad kiba lehnohei, khamtam eh ia ki jong ka jingotsher:

en: Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .
kha: Ngan khmih halor kane ka Templ bad ngan kloi ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai baroh ba yn pynlong hangne ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khmat jong nga kin plie bad ki shkor jong nga kin sngap ia ka jingduwai kaba la leh ha kane ka jaka .

en: And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .
kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat u Sekharaïah u la lah pat ban kren , bad u la sdang ban ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u ka la plie mardor, bad ka shyntur jong u ka la jah noh, bad u la kren bad u la iaroh ia U Blei .

en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .
kha: U briew uba stad , uba rangbah jingmut u long uba paw ha ka jingshemphang jong u . Katba nang sngewtynnat ki ktien ba u kren , katta u nang lah ban pynkohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba stad ha ka dohnud yn khot uba stad: bad ka jingsma jong ki rmiang shyntur ka nang kiew ka jingnang jingstad .

en: God is faithful , by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord .
kha: U Blei u long uba dei ban shaniah , U Blei uba la khot ïa phi sha ka jingïasyllok bad U Jisu Khrist u khun jong u , uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u long uba iaineh, da uba la khot ia phi sha ka jingiasyllok jong u Khun jong u U Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: Creating the sense of inferiority in Bharatiya social mind was the main objective behind that .
kha: Ka jingthaw ia ka jingsngew ba rit paid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka imlang sahlang jong ka Bharatiya ka long ka jingthmu ba kongsan ha lyndet jong kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthaw ia ka jingsngew ba duna ha ka imlang sahlang jong ka ri India ka long ka jingthmu ba kongsan hadien kata .

en: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .
kha: Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa uwei , ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongrep ki la shim ia ki shakri jong u, bad ki la shoh ia uwei pat bad ki la pyniap ia uwei pat bad ki la ther maw ia uwei pat .

en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?
kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi ieit ia kiba ieit ia phi , kaei ka bainong kaba phi don ? wat ki nongpynbna ruh kumjuh ?

en: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way : but wickedness overthroweth the sinner .
kha: Kiba hok ki ïada ïa kiba lui lui ; ka pop ka long ka jingkyllon noh ki bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok ka bat ia uta uba beit ha ka lynti: hynrei ka jingsniew ka pynhap ia u nongpop .

en: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .
kha: Ka bynta kaba halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei pa kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka almari kan long shiphew phut ka jingjrong, shiphew phut ka jingheh ha ki saw tylli ki square jong ka .

en: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt , and heardest their cry by the Red sea  ;
kha: Me ïohi kumno ki kpa tymmen ki la shahshitom ha Ijipt ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhot jong ki na ka bynta ka jingïarap ha ka Duriaw Basaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ia ka jingjynjar jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt , bad u la iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki da ka duriaw Basaw ; .

en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
kha: Haba u Moses u la ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kren , ki ïamkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iathuh ia kine ki jingkren ha ki khun Israel baroh: bad ki briew ki la iam shibun .

en: From Aroer , which is by the bank of the river Arnon , even unto mount Sion , which is Hermon ,
kha: Kane ka ri ka ïar naduh ka shnong Aroer harud ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Seïon ( Sirion ) shaphang shatei , ( kaba mut , u lum Hermon . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na Aroer kaba don harud ka wah Arnon, haduh u lum Sion uba long u Hermon .

en: And they took Lot , Abram s brother s son , who dwelt in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .
kha: U Lot , u pyrsa jong u Abram , u la shong la sah ha Sodom , kumta ki la shim ïa u lem bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u Lot u khun u Abram uba shong ha Sodom bad ki mar ki mata jong u bad ki la leit noh .

en: For I desired mercy , and not sacrifice  ; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings .
kha: Nga kwah ïa ka jingieit baneh jong phi , ym ka jingkñia da ki mrad . Nga kham kwah ba ki briew jong nga kin ithuh ïa nga ban ïa ki jingainguh thang sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kwah ia ka jingisynei , bad ym ia ka jingknia ; bad ka jingtip ia U Blei kham palat ban ia ki jingknia ba la thang .

en: The level of historical separation between these groups is estimated at about eight centuries .
kha: Ka kyrdan jong ka jingpyniakhlad ha ka histori hapdeng kine ki kynhun la antad ba ka long kumba 8 spah snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrdan jong ka jingpyniakhlad histori hapdeng kine ki kynhun la antad kumba 8 spah snem .

en: Also the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , saying , Thou also shalt not go in thither .
kha: Dei namar jong phi keiñ ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga ruh , bad u ong , ‘ Wat me ruh , Moses , men ym ïohrung ha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh U Trai u la bitar ia nga na ka bynta jong phi, u da ong , Me ruh wat leit shapoh hangta .

en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the  Lord .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka nongbah , ki ïaid sha ka Templ , ryngkat bad ki jingtem jingput ki duitara bad ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Jerusalem da ki jingsawa bad ki turoi bad ki turoi sha ka iing U Trai .

en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not .
kha: U para nongtuh u long u nongshun uba sniew tam jong u hi . Un shah pynshitom lada u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ha ka ïingbishar , U Blei un tim ïa u lada um leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba iadei bad u nongtuh u shun ia la ka jong ka mynsiem: u iohsngew ia ka jingtim , bad um ju kren ia ka .

en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the  Lord  , and did worse than all that were before him .
kha: U Omri u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  kham palat ban ïa kino kino kiba ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Omri u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad u la leh kham sniew ban ia baroh kiba don ha khmat jong u .

en: And the king said unto the woman , Go to thine house , and I will give charge concerning thee .
kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  u syiem u la jubab ,  bad ngan sa khmih ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha kata ka kynthei: Leit sha iing jong me bad ngan ai jingmut shaphang jong me .

en: Because thou hast made the  Lord  , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation  ;
kha: Me la pynlong ïa U  Trai  u nongkyrshan jong me , ïa U Bahakhlieh Tam u nongïada jong me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la pynlong ia U Trai, uba long ka jaka rieh tngen jong nga, wat kaba ha khlieh duh eh, ka jaka shong jaka sah jong me;

en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
kha: Ki lyngkha ba sah shrah ki lah ban pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , hynrei ki bymhok kin shu ieh ïa kine khlem rep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam kaba bun ka don ha ka jingpynkhih ia kiba duk: hynrei ka don kata kaba la pynjot namar ka jingbym don ka jingbishar .

en: And come to the king , and speak on this manner unto him . So Joab put the words in her mouth .
kha: Nangta leit sha u syiem bad ong ha u ïa kaei kaba nga bthah ïa phi ban ong .  Nangta u Joab u la ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to wan sha u syiem bad kren ia kane ka rukom ha u . Kumta u Joab u la buh ia ki kyntien ha ka shyntur jong ka .

en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .
kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaei ka bymdei , yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; phin ïap lada phim ailad ban pynbeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbeit ka long kaba sngewsih ia uta uba iehnoh ia ka lynti: bad uta uba shun ia ka jingshah pynrem un iap .

en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :
kha: Lada ki mraw kiba phet na la u kynrad ki wan wad jingïada na phi , wat phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat aiti ha u kynrad jong u ia u shakri uba la lait na u kynrad jong u ha me:

en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki sumar ïa ka spah jong ki , hynrei ki bymman ki duh ei ïa la ka jong haba ki por kiba eh ki wan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka iing jong kiba hok ka don ka spah kaba bun: hynrei ha ka jingmih jong kiba sniew ka don ka jingeh .

en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .
kha: Bad ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jong nga , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyndep ia ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar halor ki nongwei , kumba kim pat iohsngew .

en: And Humtah , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , and Zior  ; nine cities with their villages :
kha: ka Humtah , ka Hebron , bad ka Sior : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Hamatah , bad ka Kirjatharba , kaba long u Hebron , bad u Zior ; hynniew tylli ki shnong jong ki:

en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people , and he rehearsed them in the ears of the  Lord .
kha: U Samuel u shahshkor ïa baroh kaba ki ong , bad nangta u leit bad ïathuh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la iohsngew ia ki ktien baroh jong ki briew , bad u la pynkhreh ia ki ha ki shkor U Trai .

en: Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it brake forth , as if it had issued out of the womb ?
kha: Mano ba khang ïa ki khyrdop ban bat ïa ka duriaw haba ka bthei na ka kpoh jong ka khyndew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane mano ba khang ia ka duriaw da ki jingkhang , haba ka mih noh , kumba ka la mih na ka kpoh ?

en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;
kha: Ngam pat ju kyrngah ban ïarap ïa kiba duk ; ngam pat ju shah ïa ki riewkynthei ban im jynjar
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la bat ia kiba duk na ka jingkwah jong ki , ne nga la pynlong ia ki khmat jong u riewkynthei ban duh;

en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jong kito ki bym pat ngeit , bad phim donkam ban shaniah hano hano na ka bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin iaid hok sha ki kiba shabar , bad ba phin ym don ei ei .

en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .
kha: Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnga jong ki kumba ki ieit ïa la ki jong ki met . U shynrang uba ieit ïa la ka tnga u ieit ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ia ki tnga jong ki kum ki met jong ki hi . Uta uba ieit ia ka tnga jong u u ieit ia lade .

en: And then will I profess unto them , I never knew you : depart from me , ye that work iniquity .
kha: Nangta ngan ong ha ki , ‘ Ngam ju la ithuh ïa phi . Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew bymman !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta ngan sa phla ha ki, ngam ju ithuh ia phi: leit noh na nga, phi kiba leh ia ka jingbymhok .

en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .
kha: U pyndeng ha u ïa ka jingdeng shadem , bad u buh ha ka ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka sniehdoh halor jong u: ruh u la buh ha ka sniehdoh ia ka Urim bad ka Thummim .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;
kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : namar me mut ba me stad kum U Blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong ia U Trai Blei ; Namar me la buh ia ka dohnud jong me kum ka dohnud U Blei ; .

en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
kha: U dieng uba plung bha um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba sniew , bad u dieng uba swai um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U dieng uba bha um lah ban pynmih ia ki soh kiba sniew , bad u dieng uba sniew um lah ban pynmih ia ki soh kiba bha .

en: Behold , I come quickly : blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book .
kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Suk kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien ïathuhlypa kiba hapoh kane ka kitab !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga wan kloi: la kyrkhu ia uta uba bat ia ki ktien jong ka jingiathuhlypa jong kane ka kot .

en: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , namar ka jingisynei kaba phi la ïohpdiang , ki Jiw mynta kim kohnguh ïa U Blei , khnang ba ma ki ruh mynta kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh kine ruh mynta kim shym la ngeit , ba lyngba ka jingisynei jong phi ruh kin ioh ia ka jingisynei .

en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger : and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
kha: Uno uno uba mutlop palat kat ban kular ban bahkhlieh ïa ki ram jong u nongwei u dei ban don la ki jingdon jingem ban buh bynda .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jain jong u kaba thikna na ka bynta u nongwei : bad shim ia ka jingkular jong u na ka bynta ka kynthei kaba phylla .

en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :
kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ïa ka met jong u da ka jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shah pynngop ruh da ka jingpang ha ka jingthiah jong u, bad ka jingbun ki shyieng jong u da ka jingpang kaba jur:

en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .
kha: Te namarkata , haba ka por ka poi ba ïa ka ri yn ai pat sha ki briew jong U  Trai  , yn ym don shuh ka bynta ïano ïano na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban don uwei ruh u ban bret ia ka lynti da ka lot ha ka jingiaseng U Trai .

en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
kha: Kumta ki pynhiar kloi kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pynhiar stet ia uwei pa uwei u tdong jong u shapoh khyndew , bad uwei pa uwei u la plie ia ka tdong jong u .

en: The former treatise have I made , O Theophilus , of all that Jesus began both to do and teach ,
kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Ha ka kitab banyngkong jong nga , nga la thoh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh bad hikai naduh ka por ba u la sdang ïa ka jingtrei jong u tad haduh ka sngi ha kaba la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthoh kaba mynshuwa nga la leh , ko Theophilus , na kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la sdang ban leh bad hikai , .

en: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to them that send him .
kha: Wat ju ailad ïa u briew uba jaipdeh ban leh ei ei na ka bynta jong phi ; un long kum ka sirka kaba pynshyrkhei ïa ki bniat , lane kumba pynsat ka tdem ïa ki khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u sohjew ha ki bniat , bad kumba u dih duma ha ki khmat , kumjuh ruh u slap ha kito kiba phah ia u .

en: For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa nga ; ki ïakren bad sylla pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga ki kren pyrshah ia nga ; bad kita kiba thiah ki ap ia ka mynsiem jong nga ki ia kren lang , .

en: ( Now the man Moses was very meek , above all the men which were upon the face of the earth . )
kha: ( U Moses u long u briew uba sngewrit ; uba kham sngewrit ban ïa uno uno u briew ha ka pyrthei . )
translated_en_to_kha: (Mynta u briew Moses u la long uba jemnud bha, halor ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka khmat ka khyndew . )

en: For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :
kha: Phi hi phi la ju long mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong U Trai , phi long ha ka jingshai . Kumta phi dei ban im kum ki briew kiba don ha ka jingshai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la long teng teng ka jingdum , hynrei mynta phi long ka jingshai ha U Trai: iaid kum ki khun jong ka jingshai:

en: And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .
kha: La sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh lai bnai , bad haba la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka la ting khun ïa u bad ka la pynheh pynsan ïa u kum la u jong u khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la beh noh ia u, ka khun jong u Pharaoh ka la shim ia u, bad ka la pyndap ia u na ka bynta la u jong u khun .

en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede , even I , stood to confirm and to strengthen him .
kha: Mynta u kitkhlieh ban ïarap bad ïada ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Darius u Mede, wat nga ruh nga la ieng ban pynskhem bad ban pynskhem ia u .

en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .
kha: Ki wallam ïa ka jingtieng bad jingpyntriem , bad ha ka jingsarong jong ki , ki shim ïa ka aiñ ha lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba shyrkhei bad kiba shyrkhei: ka jingbishar jong ki bad ka burom jong ki kan iaid shakhmat na lade .

en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things  ; and I will be his God , and he shall be my son .
kha: Uno uno uba ïoh ïa ka jingjop un ïohpdiang ïa kane na nga : Ngan long U Blei jong u , bad un long u khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba jop un hiar pateng ia kiei kiei baroh ; bad ngan long U Blei jong u , bad un long u khun jong nga .

en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .
kha: U Rephaïah , u khun jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong ki u la pynbha ia u Rephaiah u khun u Hur , u nongsynshar shiteng na Jerusalem .

en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he shall offer unto the  Lord .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok ïa kiba wanrah sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka hukum jong ka jingknia jingsuk kaba un aiti ha U Trai .

en: As God liveth , who hath taken away my judgment  ; and the Almighty , who hath vexed my soul  ;
kha: Nga smai da U Blei Ba-im Badonbor Baroh , Uba kyntait ïa ka hok ïa nga bad uba pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang —
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Blei U im, uba la weng noh ia ka jingbishar jong nga ; bad Uba donbor baroh, uba la pynsngewsih ia ka mynsiem jong nga ; .

en: Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .
kha: Bad u Samuel u ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa shisien ngin pynbna ïa u Saul kum u syiem jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la ong ha ki briew , To wan, bad to ngin leit sha Gilgal bad pynthymmai ia ka hima hangta .

en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .
kha: Na ka bynta kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit  tiensyiem wat la mynta nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga lah ban long uba shlur ha ka jingkren shaphang ka gospel kumba nga dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaba nga long u nongwan ha ki jingteh: ba ha kata ngan kren shlur kumba nga dei ban kren .

en: When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .
kha: Haba ki bymman ki ïap , ka jingkyrmen jong ki ruh ka ïap bad ki . Ka jingsngewskhem halor ka spah kam ïalam shano shano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew uba sniew u iap , ka jingkhmih lynti jong u kan jah noh: bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew ki bym hok ka jah noh .

en: And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,
kha: Ki briew kiba na ka jait bashaphang shatei ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah bad ki la khot ia u . Kumta u Jeroboan bad ki Israel baroh ki la wan bad ki la ia kren bad u Rehoboam da kaba ong:

en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .
kha: Uta uba da mutlop u kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ka ram u nongwei u dei hok ban buh ïa la ka jong ka jingdon jingem ban pynshisha ïa ka jingsiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jain jong u kaba thikna na ka bynta u nongwei , bad shim ia ka jingkular jong u na ka bynta ka kynthei nongwei .

en: Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Lo-ammi ,’ namar ki briew ka Israel kim dei ki briew jong nga , bad ngam long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Blei , Khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Loammi: namar phim dei ki briew jong nga , bad ngan ym long U Blei jong phi .

en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body , that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof .
kha: Ka pop kam dei shuh ban synshar ïa ki met ki jong phi , da kaba pynkohnguh sha ki jingkwah jong ka jinglong tynrai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju leh pop namarkata ha ka met iap jong phi, ba phin kohnguh ia ka ha ki jingkwah brai jong ka .

en: Behold , the  Lord  will carry thee away with a mighty captivity , and will surely cover thee .
kha: Me lah ban long uba donkam , hynrei U  Trai  un shim ïa me bad bret noh ïa me sharud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Trai un rah noh ia me da ka jinglong mraw kaba khraw , bad un tap shisha ia me .

en: Then said Absalom , Call now Hushai the Archite also , and let us hear likewise what he saith .
kha: U Absalom u ong ,  Mynta khot ïa u Hushai , bad to ngin sngap aïu u don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Absalom , Khot mynta ia u Arkit ruh , bad to ngin iohsngew kumjuh ia kaei kaba u ong .

en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;
kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngi ne ar sngi , ne san sngi , ne shiphew sngi , ne wat arphew sngi ruh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban bam shi sngi, ne ar sngi, ne san sngi, ne shi sngi, ne arphew sngi;

en: The one preach Christ of contention , not sincerely , supposing to add affliction to my bonds :
kha: Kine ki leh kumta na ka jingieit , namar ki tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ban ïada ïa ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ialap ia U Khrist jong ka jingiakren, ym da kaba shisha, da kaba shim ba un pyndap ia ka jingjynjar ha ki jingteh jong nga:

en: And Er , Judah s firstborn , was wicked in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  slew him .
kha: Ka rukom im jong u Er ka long bymman , bad kata ka la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  , kumta U  Trai  u la pynïap noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Er , u khun nyngkong jong u Judah u la long uba sniew ha khmat U Trai ; bad U Trai u la pyniap ia u .

en: Also , O Judah , he hath set an harvest for thee , when I returned the captivity of my people .
kha: Bad na ka bynta jong phi , ki paid Judah , nga la buh ka por ban pynshitom ïa phi ruh na ka bynta kaei kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ko Judah , u la buh ia ka jingot na ka bynta jong me , haba nga la pynphai biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki briew jong nga .

en: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die  ; and he charged Solomon his son , saying ,
kha: Haba u Dabid u la jan ïap , u la khot ïa u Solomon , u khun jong u bad u la ai ha u ïa ki jingbthah bakhatduh :
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki sngi u Dabid ki la jan ba un iap ; bad u la kynnoh ia u Solomon u khun jong u da kaba ong:

en: And when they had passed over , they came into the land of Gennesaret , and drew to the shore .
kha: Ki la leit sha shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki la teh ïa ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid lait noh sha ka ri Genesaret bad ki la leit sha rud duriaw .

en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves , or of the young pigeons , such as he can get  ;
kha: Nangta un kñia ïa kawei na kita ki paro lane ki lyngdkhur
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti ia uta uba don ki turtle , ne na ki khun sniang kumba u lah ban ioh;

en: And Moses said , Thus saith the  Lord  , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt :
kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Pharaoh ,  U  Trai  U ong , ‘ Ha ka por shiteng synñia ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka Ijipt ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , Kumta u ong U Trai , Kumba shiteng miet ngan leit shabar hapdeng ka ri Ijipt:

en: And when we had taken our leave one of another , we took ship  ; and they returned home again .
kha: Nangta ngi la khublei ïakhlad iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ngi la leit kiew ha ka lieng katba ma ki , ki la leit phai sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ngi la ia shongthait iwei ia iwei pat, ngi la ia shim lieng ; bad ki la leit phai noh sha la iing .

en: Let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof : let the fields rejoice , and all that is therein .
kha: Kyrhuh , ko duriaw , bad baroh ki jingthaw ha phi ; to kmen , ko ki madan , bad baroh kiba don ha phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka duriaw kan khih , bad ka jingdap jong ka: ai ba ki lyngkha kin kmen , bad baroh kaba don ha ka .

en: And the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith  ; and the fifth , Shephatiah the son of Abital  ;
kha: u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith ; u Shephataïah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abital ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uba saw , u Adonijah u khun u Haggith ; bad uba phra u Shephiah u khun u Abital ; .

en: And this is the record , that God hath given to us eternal life , and this life is in his Son .
kha: Ka jingphla ka long kane : U Blei u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kane ka jingim ka don ka tyllong jong ka ha U Khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka rekod , ba U Blei u la ai ha ngi ia ka jingim bymjukut , bad kane ka jingim ka don ha U Khun jong u .

en: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed .
kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kumno la pynkhiah ïa uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ruh kiba la iohi ia ka ki la iathuh ha ki da kaei ka lad ba uta uba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid u la koit .

en: And he called the name of the place Taberah : because the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them .
kha: Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Taberah , namar dei hangta ba ka ding U  Trai  ka la klang hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Tabrah: namar ka ding U Trai ka la thang hapdeng jong ki .

en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
kha: Me ïohi ïa nga mynta , hynrei mem ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la jah noh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong uta uba la iohi ia nga kan ym iohi shuh ia nga: ki khmat jong me ki don ha nga , bad ngam long kumta .

en: Behold , I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands  ; thy walls are continually before me .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , ngam lah ban klet ïa pha ! Nga la thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong pha ha ki lynghoh kti jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la ker ia me ha ki kti jong nga ; ki kynroh jong me ki iai bteng ha khmat jong nga .

en: These are the two olive trees , and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth .
kha: Ki ar ngut ki sakhi ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib bad ki ar tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak kiba ïeng ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng olive , bad ki ar tylli ki sharak kiba ieng ha khmat U Blei jong ka khyndew .

en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me , and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .
kha: U Blei u bitar bad tur pyrshah ïa nga ; u leh ïa nga kum ïa u nongshun basniew tam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ruh ia ka jingbitar jong u pyrshah ia nga , bad u khein ia nga ha u kum uwei na ki nongshun jong u .

en: He has obstinately refused to understand that old assumptions and arrangements no longer work .
kha: U la kyntait da kaba tyngeh ban sngewthuh ba ki jingmut bad ki jingpynbeit barim kim treikam shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyntait khlem da pyrkhat ia kata ka jingmutdur bad ki jingpynbeit barim kim treikam shuh .

en: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
kha: kito kiba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ba ki ïoh , kumba kim shym lap miet ha kita . Naba kane ka pyrthei , kumba ka long mynta , kan ym neh slem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba pyndonkam ia kane ka pyrthei , kumba kim ju lehbein ia ka: namar ka rukom jong kane ka pyrthei ka jah noh .

en: Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .
kha: Baroh ki la ong ,  Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U Blei ?  U la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi ong ba nga long .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong baroh: Me long u Khun U Blei ? Bad u la ong ha ki , Phi ong ba nga long .

en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance : but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken .
kha: Haba ki briew ki kmen , ki phuh samrkhie , hynrei haba ki sngewsih , ki pyn-i jingsngewdiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud kaba sngewbha ka pynlong ia ka khmat kaba sngewbha: hynrei da ka jingsngewsih jong ka dohnud ka mynsiem ka la tyrkhong .

en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves , and the spoil of the cities which we took .
kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri jong ki bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki masi kiba ngi la shim na ka bynta ka jingbam ha lade , bad ka jingjot jong ki nongbah kiba ngi la shim .

en: And the flesh of them shall be thine , as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine .
kha: Ka doh na ki , kum ka shadem bad ka kjat-dien kamon kiba long ki jingainguh bakyrpang , ki long ka bynta jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh jong ki kan long ka jong me, kumba ka sniehdoh kaba jrong bad kumba ka tyrpeng kaba sha kadiang ka long ka jong me .

en: He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .
kha: Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! Tang u Nongthaw jong u , uba lah ban jop ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U long u rangbah jong ki lynti U Blei: uta uba la pynlong ia u u lah ban pynlong ia ka waitlam jong u ban wan shajan jong u .

en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .
kha: bad ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa u kew , bad ki sohwaiñ , bad ki soh Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khyndew kan iohsngew ia u kew bad ka wain bad ka umphniang ; bad kin iohsngew ia u Jesel .

en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host  ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , recorder .
kha: U Joab , uba shi para bad u Abishai u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhun shipai ; u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Ahilud u khmih halor ki jingbuh jingthoh ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u khun u Seruiah u la long halor ka kynhun shipai ; bad u Jehoshaphat u khun u Ahild .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Fill the waterpots with water .  And they filled them up to the brim .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki shakri ,  Pyndap ïa kine ki khra da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Pyndap ia ki thliew um da ka um . Bad ki la pyndap ia ki haduh ka tduh .

en: For I know that my redeemer liveth , and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth :
kha: Hynrei nga tip ba don ha bneng u ban wan ha kaba khatduh ban pynksan ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba u nongsiewspah jong nga u im, bad ba un ieng ha ka sngi kaba khatduh halor ka khyndew:

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a man shall nourish a young cow , and two sheep  ;
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , wat lada u nongrep u lah ban pynsah im tang iwei i khun masi bad ar tylli ki blang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba u briew un ai bam ia ka masi kaba dang rit bad ar tylli ki langbrot ; .

en: ( For we are but of yesterday , and know nothing , because our days upon earth are a shadow : )
kha: Ka jingim jong ngi ka long kaba lyngkot , ngim tip ei ei ; ngi iehnoh kum ka syrngiew ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta ngi long tang hynnin ka sngi, bad ngim tip ei ei, namar ki sngi jong ngi ha ka pyrthei ki long ka jingdum: )

en: Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .
kha: Kumta khie leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba suk , bad wat leh ei ei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to wan phai noh bad leit suk , ba me ym sngewbha ia ki kynrad jong ki Philistia .

en: There the righteous might dispute with him  ; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
kha: Nga long uba hok ; nga lah ban ïasaidnia bad U Blei ; un pynbna shisien pynbna , ba nga long uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ka lah ban long kaba hok bad u ; kumta nga dei ban shah pyllait junom na u nongbishar jong nga .

en: If he called them gods , unto whom the word of God came , and the scripture cannot be broken  ;
kha: Ngi tip ba ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ka long kaba shisha junom ; bad U Blei u la khot ïa kito ki briew ki blei , ki briew ha kiba U Blei u la ai ïa ka khubor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u khot ia ki blei , ha kiba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan , bad ka jingthoh ym lah ban pynpra ; .

en: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim , and the ears of them that hear shall hearken .
kha: Ki khmat bad ki shkor jong ki kin ïohi bad kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki khmat jong kito kiba iohi kin ym dum , bad ki shkor jong kito kiba iohsngew kin sngap .

en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him , and would have killed him  ; but she could not :
kha: Kumta ka Herodias ka buhnud pyrshah ïa u Ïoannis bad ka la kwah ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kam shym la lah namar u Herod .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka Herodias ka la don ka jingialeh pyrshah ia u , bad kan jin da la pyniap ia u ; hynrei kam lah:

en: And they that were sent , returning to the house , found the servant whole that had been sick .
kha: Ki nonglamktien ki la leit phai pat sha ka ïing jong u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki la shem ba u shakri jong u , u la khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit phai noh sha iing bad ki la lap ia uta u shakri baroh kawei uba la pang .

en: And , behold , an hand touched me , which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands .
kha: Nangta ka kti ka la shim ïa nga bad ka la pynkhie joit ïa nga ; nga dang khynñiuh hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka kti ka la ktah ia nga, kaba la buh ia nga ha ki kjat jong nga bad ha ki tyrpeng jong nga .

en: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab , and said , Behold , I saw Absalom hanged in an oak .
kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Dabid u la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïathuh ha u Joab ,  Kynrad , nga la ïohi ïa u Absalom ba u sdien ha u dieng Sning !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u la iohi ia ka, bad u la iathuh ha u Joab, bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga la iohi ia u Absalom ba u la sahkut ha u dieng oak .

en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;
kha: Mynta , ko khun , leh kumba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata ko khun jong nga, to kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga ; bad to khie, to phet noh sha u Laban hynmen jong nga sha Haran ; .

en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
kha: Me la dei ban don jingisynei ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ruh ngam shym la sngewsynei ia u para mraw jong me, kumba nga la sngewsynei ia me ?

en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
kha: Namar kata , phin ïoh ïa kaba phi pan kwah , bad ki kam jong phi hi kin pynshitom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kin bam ia u soh jong ka lynti jong ki hi , bad kin pyndap da ki tiar jong ki hi .

en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest , but to them that believed not ?
kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ,  Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ïa ki ïa ka jingjahthait  — ïano u kren ? Ïa kita kiba la ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha mano ba u sngap jar ba kim dei ban rung sha ka jingjahthait jong u , hynrei ha kito ki bym ngeit ?

en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter  ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .
kha: Ki la khot ïa u Barnabas da ka kyrteng Seus , bad ïa u Paul da ka kyrteng Hermes , namar ba u long u nongkren uba kham ha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia u Barnabas , u Jupiter bad u Paul , u Mercurius , namar u long u nongkren rangbah .

en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee  ; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .
kha: Ngan pyrta da kaba kmen katba nga dang tem na ka bynta jong me ; da ka longrynïeng jong nga baroh kawei ngan rwai namar ba me la pynim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin sngewbha shibun haba nga rwai ha me bad ha ka mynsiem jong nga kaba me la siewspah .

en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city , and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple ,
kha: Nangta u Soitan u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha Jerusalem , ka Nongbah Bakhuid , bad u la buh ïa U ha ka kliar kaba jrong tam jong ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ksuid u rah ia u sha ka nongbah bakhuid , bad u shong ia u ha ka tduh jong ka tempi .

en: My breath is strange to my wife , though I entreated for the children s sake of mine own body .
kha: Ka tnga jong nga kam lah ban shah ïa ka jingsma ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga , ki hynmen ki para jong nga kim wan hajan jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong nga ka long kaba phylla ia ka tnga jong nga , wat la nga la sngewsih na ka bynta ki khun na ka bynta ka met jong nga hi .

en: And he suffered no man to follow him , save Peter , and James , and John the brother of James .
kha: Te um shym la shah ïano ïano ruh ban leit bad u , hynrei tang ïa u Petros bad u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shah ia uno uno u briew ban bud ia u, lait noh tang u Petros bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis u hynmen u Jakob .

en: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing : but the honour of kings is to search out a matter .
kha: Ngi burom ïa U Blei namar kaei kaba u la buhrieh ; ngi burom ïa ki syiem ïa kaei kaba ki batai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka burom U Blei ban buhrieh ia kaei kaei: hynrei ka burom jong ki syiem ka long ban wad ia kaei kaei .

en: Then the king of Israel called an officer , and said , Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah .
kha: Nangta u Ahab u khot ïa uwei u rangbah ha ka ïingbishar , bad u ong ïa u ban leit bad wan ïalam mar mar ïa u Mikaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Israel u la khot ia u ophisar bad u la ong: To leh kloi ia u Micaiah u khun jong u Imlah .

en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .
kha: Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban dih waiñ , bad phi la hukum ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la ai wain ia ki Nazareth ban dih ; bad phi la hukum ia ki nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong: Wat iathuhlypa .

en: If thy children have sinned against him , and he have cast them away for their transgression  ;
kha: Ki khun jong me ïoh ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei , bad kumta u pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki khun jong me ki la leh pop pyrshah ia u , bad u la bret noh ia ki namar ka jingleh bymman jong ki ; .

en: And Moses said , I will now turn aside , and see this great sight , why the bush is not burnt .
kha: Kane te kaba iphylla ,  u la pyrkhat .  Balei ba ka  lawlynnong kam shym ing duh ? Ngan da leit kham hajan bad peit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , mynta ngan phai noh shawei pat bad ngan iohi ia kane ka jingpeit kaba khraw , balei ba ka khlaw kam shym la shah thang .

en: And he goeth up into a mountain , and calleth unto him whom he would : and they came unto him .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha u lum bad u la khot bad u ïa ki rangbah kiba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u leit sha u lum, bad u khot ia uta uba u kwah: bad ki la wan sha u .

en: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .
kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la wan bad shim noh ïa ka met jong u bad tep noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la wan bad ki la shim ia ka met jong u bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka jingtep .

en: On both the sides , male worshippers are represented first followed by the female worshippers .
kha: Ha baroh arliang la pyni nyngkong ia ki nongmane shynrang bud sa ki nongmane kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha baroh arliang , la pyni nyngkong eh ia ki nongmane shynrang .

en: As he saith also in another place , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
kha: U la ong ruh ha kawei pat ka jaka ,  Men long u lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh jong u Melkhisedek .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u ong ruh ha kawei pat ka jaka , Me long u lyngdoh junom hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u Melchisedec .

en: Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .
kha: To ïai duwai namar jong ngi . Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi don ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid , namar ngi kwah ban leh ïa kaba dei ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Duwai na ka bynta jong ngi: namar ngi shaniah ba ngi don ka jingsngewthuh kaba bha, ha kiei kiei baroh kiba kloi ban im hok .

en: One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .
kha: Kawei na ki lad ka long da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kaba ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka rukom ka long da kaba peit ia kiei kiei kiba u la thaw bad pyrkhat jylliew ia kaei kaba ki iathuh ia ngi .

en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days  ; and caused the dayspring to know his place  ;
kha: Ko Job , ha baroh ka jingim jong me , hato me la hukum ïa ka sngi haduh ka step ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la hukum ia ka step naduh ki sngi jong me ; bad u la pynlong ia ki sngi ban tip ia ka jaka jong u ; .

en: And the  Lord  plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram s wife .
kha: Hynrei namar ba u syiem u la shim ïa ka Sarai , U  Trai  u la phah ki jingpang bashyrkhei halor jong u bad halor ki briew ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynshitom ia u Pharaoh bad ka iing jong u da ki khniang kiba khraw namar ka tnga jong u Sarai Abram .

en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
kha: Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bynta jong me ba men shong junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la tei shisha ia me ka iing ban shong ha ka jaka shong jaka sah jong me ban sah junom .

en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah hynñiew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reu u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Serug arspah hynriew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .
kha: Kiar na ki briew kiba bieit ; kim don ei ei ban hikai ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit noh na ka jingdon jong u briew uba bieit , haba me sngewthuh ha u ia ki rmiang shyntur jong ka jingtip .

en: And beside this , giving all diligence , add to your faith virtue  ; and to virtue knowledge  ;
kha: Te namar kane hi ka daw phi dei ban leh ïa kaba bha tam jong phi ban pynlang ïa ka jingbha ha ka jingngeit jong phi ; ha ka jingbha jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingtip ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nalor kane , da kaba ai ia ka jingminot baroh , pyndap ia ka jinglong babha jong phi;

en: And when the messengers turned back unto him , he said unto them , Why are ye now turned back ?
kha: bad ki nonglamktien ki la leit phai sha u syiem .  Balei phi wan phai noh ?  u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nonglam khubor ki la phai biang sha u , u la ong ha ki , Balei mynta phi phai noh ?

en: And his brother s name was Jubal : he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ .
kha: U para jong u , u dei u Jubal , u kpa tymmen jong ki nongtem jingtem baroh kiba tem ïa ka duitara bad put tangmuri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong u hynmen jong u ka long u Jubal: u la long u kpa jong baroh kum ka jingpyniaid ia ka harp bad ka organ .

en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?
kha: Don jingkyrmen aïu na ka bynta ki briew kiba khlem blei ha ka kynta ba U Blei un dawa ïa ka jingim jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei ka jingkyrmen jong u nongleh arsap wat la u la ioh , haba U Blei u shim noh ia ka mynsiem jong u ?

en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity  ; yea , every good path .
kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa nga , phin sa tip kaei kaba dei , kaba hok , bad kaba ïaid beit . Phin sa tip ïa kaei kaba phi dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngewthuh ia ka hok, bad ka jingbishar, bad ka jinglong marryngkat ; yea, kawei pa kawei ka lynti kaba bha .

en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .
kha: Ki nongshna da ki kti ki ïarap bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iarap ia uwei pa uwei u para marjan bad uwei pa uwei u la ong ha u hynmen jong u , To long kiba shlur bha .

en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries , and all thine enemies shall be cut off .
kha: Ka Israel kan jop ïa ki nongshun jong ka bad pynjot ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti jong me kan kiew halor ki nongshun jong me, bad ki nongshun jong me baroh kin shah ot noh .

en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi u la theh noh buk ïa ka jingaiei ba-dap kyrhai ha nga bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kiba long ki jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingaiei U Trai jong ngi ka la long kaba palat bad ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: And yet I say unto you , That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon lem bad ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kum uwei na kine ki syntiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh nga ong ha phi , Ba wat u Solomon ha ka burom jong u baroh um shym la long kum uwei na kine .

en: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them : they sank as lead in the mighty waters .
kha: Pynban tang shisien pyrsad na me , ko  Trai  , ka la pynïap jyllop ïa ki nong Ijipt ; ki ngam kum ka sisa ha ka umbah bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynbthei da ka Iyer jong me, ka duriaw ka la tap ia ki: ki la ngam kum ka lead ha ki um kiba khlain .

en: Bow down thine ear , and hear the words of the wise , and apply thine heart unto my knowledge .
kha: To shahshkor , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei ba ki riewstad ki la ong . Pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: To pynkhih ia ka shkor jong me, bad to iohsngew ia ki ktien kiba stad, bad to pyntreikam ia ka dohnud jong me ha ka jingtip jong nga .

en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries .
kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki sdang wanrah biang sha ki kamra buh tiar ïa kiba shiphew na u kew jong ki , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Judah baroh u la wanrah ia ka shiphew jong u kew bad ka wain thymmai bad ka umphniang sha ki jaka buh jingbam .

en: The eyes of the  Lord  preserve knowledge , and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor .
kha: U  Trai  u khmih ba ïa ka jingshisha la ri kyndong da kaba pynpulom ïa ki ktien jong ki nonglamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat U Trai ki pynneh ia ka jingtip , bad u pynkhih ia ki ktien jong u nongleh bymman .

en: But ye , beloved , building up yourselves on your most holy faith , praying in the Holy Ghost ,
kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , to ïai tei ïa lade halor ka jingngeit bakyntang tam . To duwai ha ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi baieit, phi tei ia lade ha ka jingngeit bakhuid tam jong phi, da kaba duwai ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: As for me , is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?
kha: Ka jingïania jong nga kam dei bad ki briew ki bym im junom ; nga don ka daw kaba biang ba ngam lah ban ïaishah .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga pat hato ka jingujor jong nga ha u briew ? bad lada ka long kumta , balei ba ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym shah pynshitom ?

en: Paul , a servant of Jesus Christ , called to be an apostle , separated unto the gospel of God ,
kha: U Paul , u shakri jong U Jisu Khrist , u ba la shah khot u apostol bad ba la jied da U Blei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u shakri U Jisu Khrist u la khot ia u ban long u apostol , u la pyniakhlad bad ka gospel U Blei .

en: She considereth a field , and buyeth it : with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .
kha: Ka peit bniah ïa ka lyngkha bad ka thied ïa ka , bad da ka kamai ba ka ïoh ka thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ka brisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pyrkhat ia ka lyngkha , bad ka thied ia ka: da u soh jong ki kti jong ka ka thung ia ka kper sohjew .

en: ( John 17 :3 ) However , others also need to hear the good news so that they too can be saved .
kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hynrei , kiwei ruh ki donkam ban ïohsngew ïa ka khubor babha , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïoh lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Ioannis 17:3, ) Hynrei kiwei ruh ki donkam ban iohsngew ia ka khubor babha khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ioh jingpynim .

en: Only those of us who fit in with changing conditions can find a suitable place in that future .
kha: Tang na ngi kiba iadei bad ki jinglong kiba kylla ngi lah ban shem ia ka jaka kaba biang ha kata ka lawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang kito na ngi kiba iadei bad ki jinglong kiba kylla ki lah ban shem ia ka jaka kaba biang ha kata ka lawei .

en: Because I have called , and ye refused  ; I have stretched out my hand , and no man regarded  ;
kha: Nga ïai pyrta ïa phi , nga da khot sngewbha ba phin wan , hynrei phim sngap . Phim shahshkor satia ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la khot ia nga bad phi la kyntait ; nga la pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba pyrkhat ; .

en: But when it pleased God , who separated me from my mother s womb , and called me by his grace ,
kha: Hynrei U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la jied ïa nga wat shuwa ban kha ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga ban shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka la pynsngewbha ia U Blei uba la pyniakhlad ia nga na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga bad u la khot ia nga da ka jingaiei jong u .

en: And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .
kha: Haba u Elisha u la poi , u la leit marwei shapoh ka kamra bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap halor ka jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la wan shapoh iing, ha khmih uta u khynnah u la iap bad u la thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u .

en: The Maharashtra government , for instance , has announced sale of imported pulses at Rs 55 a kg
kha: Kum ka nuksa ka sorkar Maharashtra ka la pynbna ban die ia ki soh ba wan nabar ha ka dor Rs 55 shi kilo .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sorkar Maharashtra , kum ka nuksa , ka la pynbna ia ka jingdie ia ki soh ba la wanrah nabar ha ka 55 a kg .

en: For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
kha: Naba kumba ïa ka briew la thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha na ka briew ; bad dei U Blei uba pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka kynthei ka long na u shynrang , kumjuh ruh u shynrang ruh da ka kynthei ; hynrei kiei kiei baroh jong U Blei .

en: But he answered and said unto him that told him ,  Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga , bad kiei ki para shynrang jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong ha uta uba la iathuh ha u: Ka kmie jong nga ? bad ki hynmen jong nga ki long mano ?

en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .
kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u riewspah ha kata u la shah pynrit: namar kum u syntiew u phlang un jah noh .

en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call upon the name of the  Lord .
kha: Ngan ai ha me ka jingkñia ainguh bad ai ka jingduwai sha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan aiti ha me ia ka jingknia ainguh , bad ngan khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved  ; but he that believeth not shall be damned .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba ngeit bad uba shah pynbaptis , yn pynim ; ïa uno uno u bymngeit , yn pynrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ngeit bad uba shah pynbaptis un ioh jingpynim ; hynrei uta u bym ngeit un shah tim .

en: And brought the ass , and the colt , and put on them their clothes , and they set him thereon .
kha: ki la wallam ïa ka kada bad ïa u khun kada , ki la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup halor jong ki , bad U Jisu u la kiew ban shong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka tdong bad ka khun masi bad u la phong ia ki jain jong ki bad ki la buh ia u ha kata ka jaka .

en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war : and in multitude of counsellors there is safety .
kha: Nalor baroh , phi dei ban thaw ki buit kiba biang shuwa ba phin ïaleh ïa ka thma , bad katba nang bun ki jingkyntu babha ba phi ïoh , katta phin nang long kiba jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ka jingai jingmut kaba stad men pynlong ia ka thma jong me: bad ha ka jingbun ki nongai jingmut ka don ka jingshngain .

en: Ibrahim Khan fell in an awkward situation , as it was a fight between the emperor and his son .
kha: U Ibrahim Khan u la hap ha ka jingeh kaba shyrkhei namar ba ka dei ka jingialeh hapdeng u syiem bad u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ibrahim Khan u la hap ha ka jinglong kaba awria , namar ka la long ka jingialeh hapdeng u syiem bad u khun jong u .

en: And they digged another well , and strove for that also : and he called the name of it Sitnah .
kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la ïatih ïa kawei pat ka pukri , bad hangta ruh la don ka jingïakajia shaphang jong ka , kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jingïashun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tih sa kawei pat ka thliew, bad ki la ialeh na ka bynta kata ruh: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka u Sitnah .

en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .
kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka mrad , ma u bad kata ka mrad ki dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u thiah bad u mrad , un shah pyniap: bad phin pyniap ia u mrad .

en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did , when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee .
kha: Kane ka la long ka kambah kaba ar kaba U Jisu u la leh hadien ba u la wan na Judia sha Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long biang ka kambah kaba ar kaba U Jisu u la leh, haba u la mih na Judaea sha Galilaia .

en: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .
kha: hynrei ha ka jingshit ki jah noh , bad ki phud wahduid ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kano ka por ba ki rkhiang , ki jah noh: haba ka shit , ki shah bam noh na ka jaka jong ki .

en: O that they were wise , that they understood this , that they would consider their latter end !
kha: Kim lah sngewthuh balei ba ki la shahjop ; kim lah shemphang ïa kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: O ba ki long kiba stad , ba ki sngewthuh ia kane , ba kin pyrkhat ia ka jingkut kaba hadien jong ki !

en: I am debtor both to the Greeks , and to the Barbarians ; both to the wise , and to the unwise .
kha: Namar nga don ka kamram ba nga dei ban pyndep sha ki jaitbynriew baroh , ha ki briew baroh kiba la shai bad kiba dang sah dien , ha kiba don ka jingnang jingstad bad ki bym don ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long uba don ram ha ki Grik bad ha ki Barbar baroh arngut ha kiba stad bad ha ki bym stad .

en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .
kha: Da kumta , te , kaba kumno ka jingpynbaptis phi la ïohpdiang ?   Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Ha kaei te phi la shah pynbaptis ? Ki la ong: Ha u Ioannis .

en: And they had a few small fishes : and he blessed , and commanded to set them also before them .
kha: Ki la don ruh katto katne tylli ki dohkha rit . U Jisu u la ainguh na ka bynta kine bad u la ong ïa ki synran ban sam ïa ki ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don katto katne ki dohkha rit: bad u la kyrkhu , bad u la hukum ban buh ia ki ruh ha khmat jong ki .

en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham s servant , and his men .
kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rebekka bad ïa ka shakri ïing batymmen jong ka ba kin leit ryngkat bad u shakri jong u Abraham lem bad ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah noh ia ka Rebeka jong ki, bad ka kmie jong ka, bad u shakri jong u Abraham bad ki briew jong u .

en: And the land shall yield her fruit , and ye shall eat your fill , and dwell therein in safety .
kha: Ka ri kan seisoh bha , bad phin ïoh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh shongshngain hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri kan ai ia ki soh jong ka, bad phin bam ia ka jingpyndap jong phi, bad phin shong hangta ha ka jingshngain .

en: But thou , Israel , art my servant , Jacob whom I have chosen , the seed of Abraham my friend .
kha: Hynrei me , ko Israel u shakri jong nga , me long u paidlang ba nga la jied , ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, ko Israel, me long u shakri jong nga, u Jakob uba nga la jied, u symbai u Abraham u paralok jong nga .

en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .
kha: Thaw arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki board na ka bynta ka Tabernakl , arphew tylli ki board shaphang shathie .

en: And he that regarded not the word of the  Lord  left his servants and his cattle in the field .
kha: Kiwei pat kim suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham U  Trai  bad ki ieh ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri ha lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u bym sngewthuh ia ka ktien U Trai u la iehnoh ia ki shakri bad ki masi jong u ha lyngkha .

en: But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?
kha: Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la bitar .  Balei ba shu pynsep-ei ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki synran jong u ki la iohi ia ka, ki la sngewsih, ki la ong: Ha kano ka jingthmu kane ka jaboh ?

en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he bringeth them out of their distresses .
kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki pyrta ha U Trai ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , bad u pynmih ia ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki .

en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .
kha: Kito kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha ka Sudan bad kiba la kob sarong shaphang ka Ijipt kin shaïong jingmut ; la pynkhih ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin tieng bad sngewlehrain ia ka jingkhmih lynti jong ki, bad ia ka burom jong ki ha Ijipt .

en: Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .
kha: Hato me wan ban kynnoh ïa nga , A Blei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi ban shu sngap jar bad ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba kyrpad ia nga ? namar mynta lada nga bat ia ka shyntur jong nga , ngan aiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee : thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .
kha: Te men khot , bad ngan jubab , bad men shem sngewbha ïa nga , u jingthaw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban khot ia me bad ngan jubab ia me: men kwah ia ka kam jong ki kti jong me .

en: This is an international , nonprofit religious organization of people who willingly serve God .
kha: Kane ka dei ka seng jong ki briew kiba shakri ïa U Blei da la ka mon sngewbha , ka bym don jingïohnong eiei bad ka don ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka seng niam kaba don ha ka pyrthei , kaba khlem kamai jong ki briew kiba mon sngewbha ki shakri ia U Blei .

en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the law , that he rent his clothes .
kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingpule na kata ka kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka hukum , ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u .

en: And Paul chose Silas , and departed , being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God .
kha: katba u Paul u la jied ïa u Silas bad u la leit noh , la aiti ïa ki da ki riewngeit ha ka jingïada jong ka jingaiei jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la jied ia u Silas bad u la leit noh da ki parabangeit sha ka jingaiei U Blei .

en: And ye my flock , the flock of my pasture , are men , and I am your God , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ma phi , ki langbrot jong nga , ka kynhun kaba nga bsa , phi long ki briew jong nga , bad nga long U Blei jong phi ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi ki langbrot jong nga, ki langbrot jong nga, ki long ki briew bad nga long U Blei jong phi , ong U Trai Blei .

en: One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him , was Andrew , Simon Peter s brother .
kha: Uwei na ki u la long u Andriw , uba shi para bad u Simon Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki arngut uba la iohsngew ia u Ioannis ba u kren, bad u la bud ia u, u long u Andrei, u hynmen u Simon Peter .

en: Who hath laid the measures thereof , if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it ?
kha: Mano ba la rai haduh katno kan heh ? Mano ba ring ksai halor jong ka ? Hato me tip ïa ki jubab baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la buh ia ki jingthew jong ka , lada me tip ? lane mano ba la pynjrong ia u lain halor jong ka ?

en: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses , neither will your Father forgive your trespasses .
kha: Hynrei lada phim map ïa kiwei , te U Kpa jong phi un ym map ïa ki jingpalat kiba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phim map ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki briew , lymne U Kpa jong phi un ym map ia ki jingleh bymman jong phi .

en: Shew me a penny . Whose image and superscription hath it ?  They answered and said , Caesar s .
kha: To pyn-i hangne ïa ka sbai rupa . Ka durkhmat bad ka kyrteng jongno long kine kiba don ha ka ?   Jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyni ia nga ia ka pisa . Ka dur bad ka jingthoh lyngkot jongno ka don ? Ki la jubab bad ki la ong , Kaisar s .

en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad .
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ka ïingsyiem ba la tei da u syiem Hasael , bad ngan thang duh ïa ki kut jong u syiem Benhadad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding sha ka iing u Hazael , ka ban bam ia ki iing jong u Benhadad .

en: And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit pat sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïohi ïa uba ïapshiliang ka kti .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung biang shapoh ka synagog ; bad don uwei u briew hangta uba don ka kti kaba la tyrkhong .

en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom , and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace .
kha: Me tip kaei ban leh ; mem dei ban shah ïa u ban ïap da kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: To leh namarkata kat kum ka jingstad jong me , bad wat ai ba ka khlieh jong u kan hiar shapoh ka jingtep ha ka jingsuk .

en: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages , world without end . Amen .
kha: ha U Blei to long ka burom ha ka balang bad ha U Khrist Jisu na ka bynta ki por baroh , junom la junom ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u to long ka burom ha ka balang da U Khrist Jisu ha ki rta baroh, ka pyrthei khlem kut . Amen .

en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry , with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .
kha: Nga la siang pynitynnat ïa ka jingthiah jong nga da ka jaiñ linen bun rong na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynitynnad ia ka jingthiah jong nga da ki jingtap jong ka tapestry , da ki kam ba la ker , da ka jain kaba bha jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .
kha: Hynrei ai ïa kaei kaba hapoh ki khuri bad ki pliang jong phi ha kiba duk , bad kiei kiei baroh kin long kiba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kham bha ban ai ia ki jingaiei kiba phi don ; bad , ha khmih , kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba khuid ha phi .

en: His parents answered them and said , We know that this is our son , and that he was born blind :
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la jubab ,  Ngi tip ba u dei u khun jong ngi , bad ngi tip ba la kha matlah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la jubab ia ki bad ki la ong , Ngi tip ba une u dei u khun jong ngi , bad ba la kha matlah ia u:

en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .
kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi bad nang khrawbor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la nang heh palat bad u la tei ha ki iing syiem Judah bad ki nongbah jong ki dukan .

en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook ? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down ?
kha: Hato me lah ban khwai ïa u Lebiathan da u khwai dohkha ? ne teh ïa u thylliej jong u da u tyllai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban sei ia u Lebiathan da ka hook ? lane ka shyntur jong u da ka lynti kaba me pynhap ?

en: For through the voice of the  Lord  shall the Assyrian be beaten down , which smote with a rod .
kha: Ki Assyria kin khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur U  Trai  bad sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingpynshitom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lyngba ka sur U Trai un shoh ia u Assyria uba la shah shoh da u diengduh .

en: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life : but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked .
kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim , hynrei ki ktien u briew uba bymman ki buhrieh ïa ka jinglong ba leh jubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u briew uba hok ka long ka thliew jingim: hynrei ka jingleh donbor ka tap ia ka shyntur jong kiba sniew .

en: He loveth transgression that loveth strife : and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction .
kha: Ban sngewtynnat ïa ka pop ka long ban sngewtynnat ban thaw jingkulmar . Lada phi kob man ka por , phi pan kwah ïa ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: U ieit ia ka jingleh bymman kaba ieit ia ka jingialeh: bad uta uba pynkiew ia ka khyrdop jong u u wad ia ka jingpynjot .

en: For he said , Surely they are my people , children that will not lie : so he was their Saviour .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki long ki briew jong nga kin ym shukor ïa nga .  Bad kumta u la pyllait im ïa ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la ong , Hooid ki long ki briew jong nga, ki khun ki bym thok: kumta u la long u Nongpynim jong ki .

en: God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .
kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynkhreh lypa ïa kaei kaei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong ngi . Ka jingthmu jong u ka la long ba tang ha ka jingïadon ryngkat bad ngi ba yn pynjanai ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la pynbiang ia kaei kaei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong ngi , ba ki khlem ma ngi kim dei ban long kiba janai .

en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .
kha: Te u Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh khnang ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas Isarikos, uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah lyngdoh, u la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ban aiti noh ia u ha ki .

en: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul , in fifty and two days .
kha: Hadien sanphew ar sngi jong ka jingtrei , ïa ka kynroh baroh kawei la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba arphew san jong u bnai Elul .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la pyndep ia ka kynroh ha ka sngi kaba arphew san sngi jong u bnai Elul , ha ka sanphew ar sngi .

en: And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .
kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka kynta kaba hynriew ka la poi , ka la don ka jingdum ha ka ri baroh kawei haduh ka kynta kaba hynniew .

en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .
kha: U Jisu u la kren ha ki shisyndon .  To long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . To wat sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mardor U Jisu u la kren ha ki, u da ong: To long kiba sngewbha; ka long kaba bha;

en: They did cry there , Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise  ; he hath passed the time appointed .
kha: To ai da ka kyrteng bathymmai ïa u syiem ka Ijipt — ‘ U riew kob-pia uba la duh ei ïa la ka kabu’ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iam hangta , u syiem Ijipt u long tang ka jingsawa ; u la iaid lait ia ka por ba la buh .

en: So likewise ye , when ye shall see all these things , know that it is near , even at the doors .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , phin tip ba ka por ka la jan ban sdang artat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumjuh ruh phi, haba phi iohi ia kine kiei kiei baroh, to tip ba ka la jan, wat ha ki jingkhang ruh .

en: ( 2 Peter 2 :4 ) Jehovah forbids trying to inquire of the dead . —Read Deuteronomy 18 :10 , 11 .
kha: ( 2 Petros 2 :4 ) U Jehobah u khang pyrshah ïa ngi ban ïa kren bad kiba ïap .—Pule Deuteronomi 18 :10 , 11 .
translated_en_to_kha: ( 2 Petros 2 :4 ) U Jehobah u khang ban pyrshang ban kylli ia kiba iap .  Pule Deuteronomy 18 :10 , 11 .

en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads , neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard .
kha: Wat khap ïa u shñiuh ha ki kynriang ka khlieh jong phi lane khih ïa ki tmain
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban pyllun ia ki tduh jong ki khlieh jong phi , bad wat pynkhih ia ki tduh jong ka ryndang jong me .

en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
kha: Ki briew basniew ki ngat ha la ki jong ki pop , katba ki briew bahok ki kmen bad ki laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingpynkhein ia u briew uba sniew ka don ka jingma: hynrei ki hok ki rwai bad ki kmen .

en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong kan long ka jingpynkut kaba khuid ; phin ym leh ei ei ha kata ka sngi:

en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .
kha: U long u bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u lane pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u don ha kawei ka jingmut , bad mano ba lah ban pynphai ia u ? bad kaei kaba ka mynsiem jong u ka kwah , wat ba u leh .

en: As free , and not using your liberty for a cloak of maliciousness , but as the servants of God .
kha: To im kum ki briew kiba laitluid ; hynrei wat pyndonkam ïa ka jinglaitluid ban buhrieh ïa kano kano kaba sniew , hynrei to im kum ki mraw jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka jinglaitluid , bad ym da kaba pyndonkam ia ka jinglaitluid jong phi na ka bynta ka jainkup jong ka jingsniew , hynrei kum ki shakri U Blei .

en: Be silent , O all flesh , before the  Lord  : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation .
kha: To pynjar jar , uwei pa uwei baroh , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  , namar u wan na ka jaka shong kaba khuid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap jar , ko doh baroh, ha khmat U Trai: namar la pynmih ia u na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong u .

en: There is one lawgiver , who is able to save and to destroy : who art thou that judgest another ?
