kha: Dei tang U Blei uba long u nongai hukum bad u nongbishar . Dei tang ma u hi uba lah ban pynim bad ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phi dei uei , ban bishar ïa la u parabriew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Don uwei u nongthaw ain uba lah ban pynim bad pynjot: me uba bishar ia uwei pat ?

en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness  ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them .
kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba nga kren ki long kiba shisha ; ym don ei ei ha ki kaba lamler lane ïalam bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong nga ki long ha ka hok ; ym don ei ei kaba sniew ne kaba sniew ha ki .

en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .
kha: Kan long ka pansngiat ka burom ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan ai ha ka khlieh jong me ia ka jingpynitynnad: ka khlieh jong ka burom kan aiti ha me .

en: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines : and the Philistines went to their own place .
kha: Hadien kata , u Saul u la sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , bad ki la leit phai noh sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la kiew na kaba bud ia ki Philistia : bad ki Philistia ki la leit sha la ka jong ka jaka .

en: Idolatry , witchcraft , hatred , variance , emulations , wrath , strife , seditions , heresies ,
kha: ha ka jingmane bleithaw bad ka jingai ksuid . Ki briew ki kylla long nongshun bad ki ïashoh ; ki ïa-bishni , bitar , bad ki kwah eh . Ki ïa-pait ha ki seng bad ki kynhun ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleh jadu, ka jingleh jadu, ka jingshun, ka jingpher, ki jingpynkylla dur, ka jingbitar, ka jingialeh, ki jingpynkylla dur , ki jingkren bein , ki jingkren bein , .

en: And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
kha: Ka Adah ka la kha ïa u Jabal , uba dei u kpa tymmen jong kito kiba ri jingri bad kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Adah u la long u kpa jong kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ bad jong kiba don masi .

en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness , ( woe , woe unto thee ! saith the Lord  God   ; )
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Pha long kaba la tim ! Kaba la tim ! Pha la leh ïa kata kaba sniew baroh , bad nangta
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ka jingsniew jong me baroh, (sngewsih, sngewsih ia me ! ong U Blei Trai;).

en: And that ye put on the new man , which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness .
kha: bad phi dei ban kup ïa u briew uba thymmai ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei kaba pynpaw ïa lade ha ka jingim kaba shisha kaba long kaba beit bad kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba phi phong ia u briew uba thymmai, uba hadien U Blei la thaw ha ka hok bad ka jingkhuid kaba shisha .

en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
kha: Ka ïing jong u briew uba bha kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing jong kiba sniew kan sa kylla: hynrei ka iing jong kiba hok kan roi .

en: And it repented the  Lord  that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .
kha: u la sngewsih ba u lah thaw bad buh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la kylla bamut ia U Trai ba u la thaw briew ha ka khyndew , bad ka la pynsngewsih ia u ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?
kha: Phi tharai ngam shym kren ei ei hynrei tang ka lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktien ka jingkutlad jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi mutdur ban pynrem ia ki kyntien , bad ki jingkren jong uta uba la duh jingkyrmen , kiba long kum ka Iyer ?

en: Notwithstanding , if he continue a day or two , he shall not be punished : for he is his money .
kha: Hynrei lada uta u mraw u im shi sngi lane ar sngi , uta u briew um dei ban shah pynshitom . Ka jingduh jong u ïa la u mraw uba long ka spah jong u ka la long hi ka jingpynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh lada u bteng shi sngi ne ar sngi , un ym shah pynshitom: namar u long ka pisa jong u .

en: Hear , ye that are far off , what I have done  ; and , ye that are near , acknowledge my might .
kha: Ai ba uwei pa uwei uba hajan bad uba hajngai un ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba nga la leh bad pyndem ha ka bor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap, phi kiba jngai, ia kaei kaba nga la leh ; bad phi kiba jan , pdiang ia ka bor jong nga .

en: Whosoever shall make like unto that , to smell thereto , shall even be cut off from his people .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba shna ïa kaba kum kane ka jingiwbih yn ym kheiñ shuh kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba leh kumta, ban sngap jar ia kata, un shah ot noh wat na ki briew jong u .

en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;
kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh : ngin ïakynting sbai bad ngin jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta kane kan long kaei kaei kaba ngin leh ha Gibeah ; ngin leit sha jrong pyrshah ia ka ; .

en: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
kha: Kaba nga tip ka long ba ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la maham ïa nga ba ka byndi bad ki jingjynjar ki ap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To pynim ba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u sakhi ha man la ka nongbah , da kaba ong ba ki jingiadei bad ki jingjynjar ki kohnguh ia nga .

en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .
kha: Nangta u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ïa ki kjat-dien bad u thang lang ïa ki ha ka duwan halor kita kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sait ia ki bynta ba shapoh bad ki kjat , bad u la thang ia ki halor ka jingainguh thang ha ka almari .

en: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah , Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king .
kha: Nga sheptieng , kam dei kumta ,  u Jonathan u jubab .  U Syiem Kynrad , u Dabid u la pynlong syiem ïa u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Adonijah, Hooid u syiem jong ngi u la pynlong syiem ia u Solomon .

en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .
kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba phi ïoh ka kabu , leh ïa kaba bha ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym leh bha na ki ha kiba ka dei ban long , haba ka don ha ka bor jong ka kti jong me ban leh ia kata .

en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments , and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt .
kha: Hynrei kita ki nongleh myntor ki ïaleh kumjuh da ki buit myntor jong ki , bad ki ruh ki pynmih ïa ki jakoid ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleh jadu ki la leh kumta da ki jingleh jadu jong ki, bad ki la wanrah ia ki khnai ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .
kha: Ka long ka jingbieit ban bud ïa la ki jong ki jingsngewthuh . To long shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shaniah ha la ka jong ka dohnud u long uba bieit: hynrei uba iaid da ka jingstad , un shah pyllait im .

en: My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :
kha: Ko khun , tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad burom ïa u syiem . Wat leh ei ei bad ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, to sheptieng ia U Trai bad ia u syiem : bad wat nym ialeh pyrshah bad ki kiba la ai ban kylla:

en: Peace be to the brethren , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha ki parabangeit baroh ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingieit da ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsuk kan long ha ki para bangeit bad ka jingieit da ka jingngeit, na U Blei U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu ha kaba jar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la wad kumno kin pyniap ia u ; namar ki la tieng ia ki briew .

en: And looking up to heaven , he sighed , and saith unto him ,  Ephphatha ,  that is ,  Be opened .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khmied sha bneng , U la ud jylliew , bad u la ong ha uta u briew ,   Ephphatha .   Kaba mut ,  To plie !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u peit sha bneng, u la ud, bad u la ong ha u, Ephphatha, kata ka mut, To plie .

en: Happy is the man that feareth alway : but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief .
kha: Kohnguh borabor ïa U  Trai  bad phin long kiba suk . Lada phi long kiba eh dohnud , phin hap ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba suk ia u briew uba tieng: hynrei uta uba pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u un hap ha ka jingsniew .

en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said ,  Take this , and divide it among yourselves :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ong ,  Shim ïa kane bad sam ïa ka hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka khuri bad u la ainguh bad u la ong: Shim ia kane bad phiah ia ka hapdeng jong phi:

en: But if the cloud were not taken up , then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up .
kha: Katba u lyoh u dang neh sah hajuh , ki ruh kim kynriah na ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ym shym la shim ia u lyoh , te kim shym la leit jingleit haduh ka sngi ba la shim ia u .

en: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?
kha: Ynda ki leit phai sha la u kpa , u kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi ïawan kloi mynta ka sngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la poi ha u kpa jong ki, u la ong , Kumno phi wan kloi haduh mynta ka sngi ?

en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .
kha: Haba ka Bathsheba ka la ïohsngew ba u tnga jong ka u la shah pynïap , ka ïambriew na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka tnga jong u Uri ka la iohsngew ba u tnga jong ka u la iap , ka la iam na ka bynta u tnga jong ka .

en: Whereunto he called you by our gospel , to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: U Blei u la khot ïa phi sha kane lyngba ka Khubor Babha kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi ; u la khot ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa la ka bynta jong ka burom jong U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u la khot ia phi da ka gospel jong ngi , ha kaba ioh ia ka burom U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .
kha: Phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jong phi ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit !
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ngi ki blang rit kiba pynsniew ia ki sohjew: namar ki sohjew jong ngi ki don ki sohjew kiba jem .

en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .
kha: Ai ba U Trai un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshemphang ba kham khraw jong ka jingieit U Blei bad sha ka jingïaishah kaba la ai da U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u pynbeit ia ki dohnud jong phi sha ka jingieit U Blei , bad sha u nongpang uba ap ia U Khrist .

en: And of Zebulun he said , Rejoice , Zebulun , in thy going out  ; and , Issachar , in thy tents .
kha: Shaphang ki jait Sebulun bad Issakhar u ong ,  Kiba na ka jait Sebulun to kin manbha ha ki jingkhaïi pateng ha duriaw ; Bad to ka spah jong ka jait Issakhar kan nang roi ha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Zebulun u la ong, To sngewbha, ko Sebulun, ha ka jingleit shabar jong me; bad u Issakhar, ha ki ïingjaiñ jong me .

en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .
kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop ki kmen ha la ka jingbieit , hynrei kiba stad kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba suk ia uta uba duna ka jingstad: hynrei u briew uba sngewthuh u iaid beit .

en: He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynïoh myntoi ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un ïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shem ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka: bad uta uba duh noh ia la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ia ka .

en: And at midnight there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh  ; go ye out to meet him .
kha: Ka la da shiteng synñia haba ka jingpyrta ka la sawa jam , ‘ U nongleitkurim u la don hangne ! To wan bad ïashem ïa u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por shiteng miet la pyrta , Ha khmih u nongleit kurim u wan ; phi leit shabar ban iakynduh ia u .

en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein : and he that rolleth a stone , it will return upon him .
kha: Ki briew kiba thaw jingriam ïa kiwei pat kin ngat ïa lade . Ki briew kiba sdang pynhap khyndew ki shah ban ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba tih ia ka thliew un hap ha ka: bad uta uba pynkhih ia u maw , un wan phai biang ha u .

en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief .
kha: Nga lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ki jingai jingmut bad ngan ïai kren ban pyntngen ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynskhem ia phi da ka shyntur jong nga , bad ka jingkhih jong ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka dei ban pynjem ia ka jingsngewsih jong phi .

en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .
kha: Dang step phyrngab u nongpynïap briew u khie bad u mih ban leit pynïap ïa uba duk , bad mynmiet u tuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpyniap briew uba kiew da ka jingshai u pyniap ia kiba duk bad kiba duk , bad ha ka por miet u long kum u nongtuh .

en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow ? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail ,
kha: Hato me la ju leit jngoh ïa ki kamra buh tiar , ha kaba nga la buh ïa ka ïor bad ïa u phria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la rung ha ki spah jong u slap ? lane me la iohi ia ki spah jong u hail .

en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me .
kha: Ka hukum jong me ka don bad nga ha ka por baroh bad ka pynlong ïa nga uba kham stad ban ïa ki nongshun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me lyngba ki hukum jong me me la pynlong ia nga uba kham stad ban ia ki nongshun jong nga: namar ki don beit bad nga .

en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy  ; and he put us therein .
kha: Hangta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la shem ïa ka lieng na Aleksandria kaba thmu ban leit sha Italy , kumta u la kyntiew ïa ngi ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta u centurion u la lap ia ka lieng Alexandria kaba leit sha Italy ; bad u la buh ia ngi hangta .

en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
kha: Ki tih shaduh ki tyllong jong ki wah , bad ki wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U teh ia ki wah na ka jingtuid um ; bad kaei kaei kaba la buhrieh u wanrah sha ka jingshai .

en: For some , when they had heard , did provoke : howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses .
kha: Kiei kita ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ? Baroh kito ïa kiba la ïalam noh na Ijipt da u Moses ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki katto katne, haba ki la iohsngew, ki la pynmih: wat la ym baroh kiba la mih na Ijipt da u Moses .

en: The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .
kha: Ka pyrthei kan ka pra bad kan jot . U  Trai  u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri kan sa thylli lut, bad kan sa shah pynjot lut: namar U Trai u la kren ia kane ka ktien .

en: And Balaam said unto God , Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , hath sent unto me , saying ,
kha: U la jubab ,  U syiem Balak ka ri Moab u la phah ïa ki ban ïathuh ha nga
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha U Blei, u Balak u khun u Zippor u syiem u Moab u la phah sha nga da kaba ong:

en: The young man saith unto him , All these things have I kept from my youth up : what lack I yet ?
kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh ,  u samla u la jubab .  Sa kaei pat ba nga donkam ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: U samla u ong ha u , Kine kiei kiei baroh nga la buh naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga: kaei kaba nga duna haduh mynta ?

en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei uba long ha U Khrist , um ïai leh pop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïai leh pop , um pat shym la ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sah ha u um ju leh pop: uno uno u bym shym la iohi ia u , lymne u la ithuh ia u .

en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :
kha: ïa ka jingkyrkhu , lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrkhu , lada phi kohnguh ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi , kiba nga hukum ia phi ha kane ka sngi:

en: Behold , I have received commandment to bless : and he hath blessed  ; and I cannot reverse it .
kha: Ïa nga la bthah ban kyrkhu , Bad haba U Blei u kyrkhu , ngam lah ban pynkylla da kumwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la ioh ia ka hukum ban kyrkhu: bad u la kyrkhu ; bad ngam lah ban pynphai kylla ia ka .

en: And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ka kynta ka la poi mynta ïa U Khun U Briew ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Ka por ka la poi, ba u Khun u briew un shah pyndonburom .

en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .
kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hushai u la ong ha u Absalom , Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahitophel u la ai kam long kaba bha ha kane ka por .

en: And upon Kerioth , and upon Bozrah , and upon all the cities of the land of Moab , far or near .
kha: Kerioth , bad Bosrah . Ka jingbishar ka la wan ha ki nongbah baroh jong ka Moab , hajan bad hajngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha Keriot bad ha Bosrah bad ha ki shnong baroh jong ka ri Moab , kiba jngai ne kiba jan .

en: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines , he was afraid , and his heart greatly trembled .
kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Philistia , u la sngewsheptieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la iohi ia ka kynhun jong ki Philistia , u la tieng bad ka dohnud jong u ka la khih shibun .

en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee  ; and the mother of Jesus was there :
kha: Ar sngi hadien , la don ka jingkyntiew kurim ha ka shnong Kana kaba ha Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai ka la don ka jingkhawai shongkurim ha Cana jong ka Galilaia ; bad ka kmie U Jisu ka la don hangta :

en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus , and of the love which ye have to all the saints ,
kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu bad ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki briew baroh ki jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi la iohsngew ia ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu bad ia ka jingieit kaba phi don ha ki riewkhuid baroh .

en: And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying ,  Behold , a sower went forth to sow  ;
kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa ki shibun kiei kiei .  Shisien la don u briew uba la mihnoh ban bet symbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren bun kiei kiei ha ki ha ki pharshi, u da ong: Ha khmih uwei u nongbet u la leit shabar ban bet ; .

en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past , a people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ;
kha: ( Ki jaitbynriew Emim kiba ju shong ha Ar ki dei ki ramhah kiba khrawbor . Ki long kiba jrong kat ki Anakim , kawei pat ka jait ki ramhah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Em ki shong hangta ha ki por ba la leit noh, ki briew kiba khraw, bad kiba bun, bad kiba jrong, kum ki Anackim ; .

en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;
kha: Wat klet ïa ka jutang U Blei , kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom ,
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba pyrkhat beit ia ka jutang jong u ; ka ktien kaba u la hukum ha ki hajar pateng ; .

en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them , that they may cleanse the land .
kha: Kan shim por ïa ki Israel hynñiew bnai ban tep ïa ki metïap baroh bad ban pynlong khuid pat ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew bnai ki Israel kin tep ia ki , ba kin pynkhuid ia ka ri .

en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .
kha: Phi long ki paralok jong nga ! To isynei ïa nga ! Ka kti U Blei ka la ïaleh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewsynei ia nga, to sngewsynei ia nga, ko paralok jong nga ; namar ka kti U Blei ka la ktah ia nga .

en: For I will defend this city , to save it , for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
kha: Ngan ïeng namar kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan iada ia kane ka shnong , ban pynim ia ka, na ka bynta jong nga hi bad na ka bynta u Dabid jong nga .

en: For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?
kha: Hato u briew un ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u hi u duh noh lane u shahjop ? Em da shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei kaba u briew u la myntoi lada u ioh ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad u duh noh ia lade ne shah bret noh ?

en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u long uba bha sbun .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai ; namar U Trai u long uba bha: rwai ia ka kyrteng jong u ; namar ka long kaba sngewtynnad .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Have ye understood all these things ?  They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
kha: Hato phi shemphang ïa kine kiei kiei ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .  Ho-oid ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Hato phi la sngewthuh ia kine kiei kiei baroh ? Ki ong ha u , Hooid ko Trai .

en: Blessed is he that waiteth , and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days .
kha: Suk kito kiba ïaineh tad haduh ba ki shihajar laispah laiphew san sngi ki kut noh !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta uba ap, bad u wan sha ka hajar san spah san sngi .

en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service , and a worldly sanctuary .
kha: Ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka la don ki rukom pynïaid ïa ka jingmane Blei bad kumjuh ruh ka jaka ba la shna da u briew ban mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta shisha ka jutang kaba nyngkong ruh ka don ki jingpynbeit jong ka jingshakri ba kynja Blei, bad ka jaka kyntang pyrthei .

en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
kha: Te me dei ban ong ha u ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong , ‘ U Israel u long u khun nyngkong jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong ha u Pharaoh , Kumta u ong U Trai , U Israel u long u khun jong nga:

en: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .
kha: Ïa ka spah jong u baroh yn pynjot ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkiew jong ka iing jong u kan leit noh , bad ki mar jong u kin tuid noh ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar jong u .

en: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .
kha: Ma phi to nang ïaleit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit sha kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar ba ka por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit sha kane ka jingkhawai: Ngam pat leit sha kane ka jingkhawai ; namar ka por jong nga kam pat dap .

en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial ? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel ?
kha: Kumno U Khrist bad u Ksuid kin ïahap jingmut ? Kumno uba ngeit u don bynta bad u bymngeit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jingiap kaba U Khrist u don bad ka jinglong rit paid ? lane kaei ka bynta kaba u ngeit bad u bym ngeit ?

en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho . And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri .
kha: Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sakkur , u khun jong u Imri u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u la tei ia ki briew jong ka Jerikho . Bad hajan jong ki la tei ia u Zacur u khun jong u Imri .

en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbymlehhok kaba jia ha ka pyrthei — ka jingbymlehhok kaba la pynlong da ki nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingsniew kaba nga la iohi hapoh ka sngi , kum ka jingbakla kaba mih na u nongsynshar:

en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .
kha: U Dabid u la pyllait im ïa baroh bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnga jong u ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la koit lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la rah noh: bad u Dabid u la pyllait im ia ki arngut ki tnga jong u .

en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils , no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you .
kha: Em , ka long pynban da ka bor ka jong U Blei ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid , bad kane ka pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei ka la da wan ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada nga da ka kti U Blei nga beh ia ki ksuid , khlem artatien ka hima U Blei ka wan ha phi .

en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u shakri jong nga un leh da ka jingstad , un sa shah pynkhraw bad shah pynkhraw shibun .

en: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
kha: Haba phi ïohi ba ki sla jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba mynta ki la siat shabar , phi iohi bad tip hi dalade ia kata ka por lyiur mynta ka la jan .

en: And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;
kha: Bad kane nga duwai , ba ka jingieit jong phi kan nang ïoh roi kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbishar bajanai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane nga duwai , ba ka jingieit jong phi kan nang bun shuh shuh ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingbishar baroh;

en: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein : then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
kha: to lehkmen ko ki lyngkha bad baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha pha ! Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin risa da ka jingkmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka lyngkha kan long kaba kmen bad baroh kaba don hangta: nangta ki dieng baroh kin ia kmen .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Shebna ,  Haba kata ka jia , ngan phah khot ïa u shakri jong nga u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi , ba ngan khot ia u shakri jong nga u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah:

en: But the word is very nigh unto thee , in thy mouth , and in thy heart , that thou mayest do it .
kha: Em , ka don hangne bad phi . Phi tip ïa ka bad phi lah ban sot ïa ka ; kumta mynta , kohnguh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka ktien ka long kaba jan bha ha me, ha ka shyntur jong me bad ha ka dohnud jong me, ba me lah ban leh ia kata .

en: Ye have heard the blasphemy : what think ye ? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death .
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei . Kaei ka jingrai jong phi ?  Baroh ki la rai pyrshah ïa u : U long ba la rem bad dei ban pynïap noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohsngew ia ka jingkren bein: kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ? Bad baroh ki la pynrem ia u ba u long uba don pop .

en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom , seeing he hath no heart to it ?
kha: Kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha lada pynlut pisa ha ka jingpynnang pynstad ïa uba bieit , namar um don jingshemphang satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka don ka dor ha ka kti jong u bieit ban ioh ia ka jingstad , haba um don dohnud ia ka ?

en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,
kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi , u Pharaoh u la hukum ïa ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw bad ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam :
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la hukum ha kajuh ka sngi ia ki nongtrei jong ki briew bad ki ophisar jong ki da kaba ong:

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .
kha: U Elijah shisha u wan shuwa ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  bad un pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, U Elias shisha un wan nyngkong eh, bad un pynphai biang ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .
kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba ngan sa leh ka long ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ka jingiaseng , Kane ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum ban leh .

en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .
kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw , ki la rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai banyngkong jong ka snem kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ka jingshah set ki la bat ia ka jingkhawai Niam ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba nyngkong .

en: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .
kha: Hadien ba uwei uwei baroh u la bam kdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh sha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ki la bam bha, ki la pynshai ia ka lieng bad ki la bret noh ia u kew sha duriaw .

en: I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;
kha: Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phi da U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ainguh ia U Blei jong nga man ka por na ka bynta jong phi , na ka bynta ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la ai ha phi da U Jisu Khrist ; .

en: He made also posts of threescore cubits , even unto the post of the court round about the gate .
kha: Ka kamra kaba ha tduh eh ka lam sha kawei ka phyllaw . U la thew ïa kata ka kamra bad u la shem ba ka long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shna ruh ia ki post kiba don laiphew cubit, wat haduh ka post jong ka iingbishar sawdong ka khyrdop .

en: And Samson went down to Timnah , and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah , ha kaba u ïohi ïa kawei ka kynthei Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la leit hiar sha Timna bad u la iohi ia kawei ka kynthei ha Timna na ki khun kynthei jong ki Philistia .

en: And the mean man boweth down , and the great man humbleth himself : therefore forgive them not .
kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynlehrain bad yn pynjahburom . Wat map ïa ki , A  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew uba rit u dem khrup, bad u briew uba khraw u pynrit mynsiem ia lade: namarkata wat map ia ki .

en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the  Lord  an heave offering in your generations .
kha: Pateng la pateng , ïa kane ka jingai kaba kyrpang dei ban ai sha U  Trai  na u kpu ba phi shet .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka doh kaba nyngkong jong phi phin ai ha U Trai ka jingainguh kaba khraw ha ki pateng jong phi .

en: And with him they crucify two thieves  ; the one on his right hand , and the other on his left .
kha: Ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki dakaid lem bad U Jisu , ïa uwei sha kamon bad ïa uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad u ki sahnarphna arngut ki nongtuh ; uwei ha ka liang kadiang jong u , bad uwei pat ha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: How hast thou helped him that is without power ? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength ?
kha: Katno phi la long ka jingïarap babha ïa nga — u briew uba duk , uba tlot kum ma nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno me la iarap ia uta uba khlem bor ? kumno me pynim ia ka kti kaba khlem bor ?

en: And of the angels he saith , Who maketh his angels spirits , and his ministers a flame of fire .
kha: Hynrei shaphang kita ki angel U Blei u la ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa la ki angel kum ki lyer , bad ïa ki shakri jong u kum ki thylliej ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki angel u ong , Uba pynlong ia ki angel jong u ki mynsiem , bad ki shakri jong u ki long ka ding ding .

en: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .
kha: Tang u briew u bym don jingsngewthuh un kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ki ram jong uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba khlem jingsngewthuh u ktah ia ki kti , bad u kylla long uba thikna ha khmat u paralok jong u .

en: O come , let us sing unto the  Lord  : let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation .
kha: Ale , to ngin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ; to ngin ïarwai da ka jingkmen ha U Blei , uba ïada ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: O to wan, to ngin rwai ha U Trai: to ngin pynmih ia ka jingsawa kaba kmen ia u maw jong ka jingpynim jong ngi .

en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :
kha: Ko Job , hato me la phla ïa ki pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop shuh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka long kaba iadei bad ka jingkren ha U Blei, nga la kha ia ka jingpynshitom bein, ngan ym pynsngewsih shuh:

en: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind .
kha: Naduh myn dang long ka pyrthei ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ba uno uno u ai jingïoh imat pat ïa u briew uba la kha matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ba la sdang ka pyrthei ym shym la iohsngew ba uno uno u briew u la plie ia ki khmat jong uta uba la kha matlah .

en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Bring him down unto me , that I may set mine eyes upon him .
kha: Nangta phi ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u shane , khnang ba phin ïoh peit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ong ha ki shakri jong me, To wanrah ia u sha nga, ba ngan buh ia ki khmat jong nga ha u .

en: There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .
kha: Ym don jingdum ka ban dum tliw palat ban buhrieh ïa u nongpop na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingdum , ne ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , ha kaba ki nongtrei bymman ki lah ban buhrieh ia lade .

en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil ? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth ?
kha: Hato me tip haduh katno ki kit ïa la ki khun rit ? Hato me tip ïa ka por ba yn kha ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban khein ia ki bnai kiba ki pyndep ? lane phi tip ia ka por ba ki pynmih ?

en: But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .
kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Antiokh , nga la pyrshah ïa u ha kaba paw , namar ba u la bakla shai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Antiok , nga la pyrshah ia u ha khmat , namar ba u la dei ban shah kynnoh .

en: But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .
kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba kin hikai lane leh donbor halor ki shynrang ; ki dei ban long kiba jar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngam shah ia ka kynthei ban hikai , ne ban pynduh ia ka bor halor u shynrang , hynrei ban long ha ka jingsngap jar .

en: But if ye do not forgive , neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses .
kha: Lada phim map ïa kiwei , U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ym map ïa ki jingbakla kiba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phim map , lymne U Kpa jong phi uba don ha bneng un ym map ia ki jingleh bymman jong phi .

en: While I live will I praise the  Lord  : I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being .
kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa u katba nga dang im ; ngan rwai ha U Blei jong nga baroh shi lynter ka jingim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang im ngan iaroh ia U Trai : Ngan rwai iaroh ia U Blei jong nga katba nga dang don ka jinglong .

en: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
kha: Nga la wan sha ka pyrthei kum ka jingshai , ba baroh kiba ngeit ha nga kin ym sah ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga wan ka jingshai ha ka pyrthei , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un ym kohnguh ha ka jingdum .

en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter : for thy heart is not right in the sight of God .
kha: Mem don bynta lane ïoh bynta ha ka kam jong ngi , namar ka dohnud jong me kam long kaba beit ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me don ka bynta ne ka bynta ha kane ka kam: namar ka dohnud jong me kam long kaba dei ha khmat U Blei .

en: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
kha: Hynrei kiba la shah khot sngewbha kim suidñiew bad ki la leit sha la ki kam ki jam : Uwei sha ka lyngkha jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la pynshai ia ka, bad ki la leit noh ia la ka lynti, kawei sha ka kper jong u, kawei pat sha ki mar jong u:

en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ki umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ? Hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong ka duriaw-bah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la rung ha ki tyllong um jong ka duriaw ? lane me la iaid ha ka jingwad ia ka jingjylliew ?

en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .
kha: Kaba mih ka long , ba ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ngeit ïa ka jingshisha hynrei kiba la sngewbha ha ka pop , yn pynrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba baroh kin shah tim ki bym ngeit ia ka jingshisha , hynrei ki la sngewbha ha ka jingbymhok .

en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: khnang ba ma phi baroh lang , phi lah ban ïaroh da kawei ka sur ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phi lah da kawei ka jingmut bad kawei ka shyntur ban pyndonburom ia U Blei , wat ia U Kpa jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: And as soon as he had spoken , immediately the leprosy departed from him , and he was cleansed .
kha: Mar kumta hi ka jingpang ka iehnoh ïa uta u briew , bad u la long khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu kren ia u, mar kumta hi u la leit noh na u , bad u la shah pynkhuid .

en: They can provide comfort and guidance in times of trouble .—James 5 :14-16  ; 1 Peter 5 :2 , 3 .
kha: Ki lah ban ai jingtngen bad kdew lynti ha ki por bajynjar .—Jakob 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lah ban ai jingpyntngen bad jingpyniaid ha ki por ba jynjar .  James 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .

en: In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
kha: Ym shym la don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi ym don syiem ha Israel: uwei pa uwei u la leh ia kaba dei ha la ki jong ki khmat .

en: It is naught , it is naught , saith the buyer : but when he is gone his way , then he boasteth .
kha: U nongthied borabor u khñium ba ka dor ka rem eh , hynrei nangta u leit noh bad u kren sarong ba u la ïoh da kaba ïadait dor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew, kaba sniew, u nongthied: hynrei haba u la leit noh ia la ka lynti , nangta u sngew sarong .

en: He hath destroyed me on every side , and I am gone : and mine hope hath he removed like a tree .
kha: U la shoh ïa nga na baroh sawdong . U la jynrat noh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga bad u iehnoh ïa nga ban tyrkhong bad ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynjot ia nga na man la ki liang, bad nga la jah noh: bad ka jingkyrmen jong nga u la weng noh kum u dieng .

en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .
kha: Baroh ki mrad ha ki khlaw jong ka Lebanon kim pat biang na ka bynta ka jingkñia sha U Blei jong ngi , bad ki dieng jong ka ki khyndiat eh ban pynmeh ïa ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Lebanon kam biang ban thang , lymne ki mrad jong ka ki biang na ka bynta ka jingknia thang .

en: Besides Bangladesh , Italy , Franch , Japan , Korea , and India have developed silk industries .
kha: Nalor ka Bangladesh , ka Italy , ka Franch , ka Japan , ka Korea bad ka India ki la pynroi ia ki karkhana silk .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ka ri Bangladesh , Italy , Franch , Japan , Korea , bad ka India ki la pynmih ia ki karkhana silk .

en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ki longïing jong ki briew kiba sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewkynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynjot ia ka iing jong kiba sngew sarong: hynrei un pynskhem ia u pud u sam jong u riewkynthei .

en: And they were filled with madness  ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .
kha: La pyndap ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla bad ki la sdang ban ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki ïa kaei ba ki lah ban leh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la dap da ka jingsngewsih ; bad ki la iakynduh iwei ia iwei pat ia kaei kaba ki lah ban leh ia U Jisu .

en: Nevertheless , there might be times that you may need to receive support from the congregation .
kha: Wat la katta ruh , ki lah ban don ki por ba phi lah ban donkam ban ïoh jingkyrshan na ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh , ki lah ban don ki por ba phi donkam ban ioh jingkyrshan na ka balang .

en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .
kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tiar ïaleh u ha uta u khynnah , bad u ong ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la ai ia ka jainkup jong u ha u khun jong u, bad u la ong ha u, Leit rah ia ki sha ka shnong .

en: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips : but the just shall come out of trouble .
kha: Ki bymman ki shah riam ha ki ktien jong ki hi , hynrei ki briew kiba beit ki pyllait ïa lade na ka jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman u la shah rong noh ha ka jingpynkhein ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u: hynrei kiba hok kin mih na ka jingjynjar .

en: And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .
kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa ki bad ki la buh ïa ki ha phatok haduh ka sngi kaba bud , namar ba ka la dier eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh kti ia ki, bad ki la buh ia ki ha ka sngi kaba bud: namar mynta ka la jia .

en: Behold , the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth : much more the wicked and the sinner .
kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïoh bainong hangne ha pyrthei , te phi lah ban thikna ba ki bymman bad ki briew kiba pop kin shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ia kiba hok yn sa siew kylliang ha ka khyndew: kham bun ki bymman bad ki nongpop .

en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .
kha: Sa shisien pat nga maham ba uno uno u briew uba shah ïa lade ban otsher u pynbor ban kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga pynshisha biang ia uwei pa uwei u briew uba la shah ot , ba u long u nongkit ram ban leh ia ka hukum baroh kawei .

en: And thou his son , O Belshazzar , hast not humbled thine heart , though thou knewest all this  ;
kha: Hynrei ma phi , u khun jong u , phim shym la pynrit ïa lade , wat la phi la tip ïa kane baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me u khun jong u, ko Belshasar, phim shym la pynrit ia ka dohnud jong me, wat la me tip ia kine baroh;

en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .
kha: Aïu ngan ong shuh ha me ! Me tip bha ïa nga , bad pynban me pyndonburom ïa nga , u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba u Dabid u lah ban kren kham bun ia me na ka bynta ka burom jong u shakri jong me ? namar me tip ia u shakri jong me .

en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger .
kha: Ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki ka pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban ym lah shah , ki kam bymman jong ki , ki la pynlong ïa u ban bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia u ban sngewsih ia ki blei kiba phylla , da ki jingsngewsih ki la pynlong ia u ban bitar .

en: Over the next two years , he was able to disrupt their supply routes , forcing them to retreat .
kha: Ha ki ar snem kiba hadien , u la lah ban pynthut ia ki lynti pynpoi jong ki , kaba la pynbor ia ki ban kynriah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki ar snem kiba hadien , u la lah ban pynthut ia ki lynti pynbiang jong ki , kaba pynbor ia ki ban kynriah noh .

en: And a mixed multitude went up also with them  ; and flocks , and herds , even very much cattle .
kha: Kiwei ki briew ruh kiba bun lem bad ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi , ki leit ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah uba la khleh lang ruh u la leit shaneng bad ki ; bad ki kynhun masi bad ki kynhun masi , wat ki masi kiba bun bha .

en: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead  ; whereof we are witnesses .
kha: Phi la pynïap ïa uta uba ïalam sha ka jingim , hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap — bad ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyniap ia u Syiem jong ka jingim , ia uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na kiba iap ; na kiba ngi long ki sakhi .

en: In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: Ha ka jingïaseng lang jong ki briew jong me baroh , ha ka jaka kyntang jong ka Templ jong me ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki iing jong U Trai, hapdeng jong me, ko Jerusalem . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .
kha: Haba ki briew kiba stad ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong kiba stad ka pyndonkam hok: hynrei ka shyntur jong ki bieit ka theh ia ka jingbieit .

en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man , and he strengthened me ,
kha: Sa shisien pat u la bat ïa nga , bad nga la kham sngew ïohbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wan biang bad u la ktah ia nga kum u briew , bad u la pynskhem ia nga .

en: But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .
kha: Hynrei mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shuh . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thylli lait sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka mynsiem jong ngi ka la tyrkhong: ym don ei ei ruh em, nalor kane ka manna, ha khmat ki khmat jong ngi .

en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .
kha: U lumlang ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u khang ïa ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah ha ki ïing jingkynshew .
translated_en_to_kha: U lum lang ia ki um duriaw kum ka thliew: u buh ia ka jingjylliew ha ki iing buh jingbam .

en: That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .
kha: Bad kumta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang U  Trai  hi u long U Blei — ym don uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew kin tip ba U Trai u long U Blei bad ba ym don shuh .

en: The words of a wise man s mouth are gracious  ; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself .
kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba stad u kren ka wanrah ha u ïa ka burom , hynrei ïa u bieit la pynjot da ki ktien jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u briew uba stad ki long kiba sngewrit ; hynrei ki rmiang shyntur jong u bieit kin sngap jar ia lade .

en: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
kha: kim don ka jingïatiplem ; kim bat ïa la ki kular , bad kim pyn-i jingsbun lane jingisynei ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem ka jingsngewthuh, ki nongpynkylla ia ka jutang, khlem ka jingieit ba kynja met, ka bym lah ban pynkylla, ka bym don jingisynei:

en: Providing for honest things , not only in the sight of the Lord , but also in the sight of men .
kha: Ka jingthmu jong ngi ka long ban leh ïa kaba dei , ym tang ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ha khmat u briew ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbiang ia kiei kiei kiba hok , ym tang ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ha khmat ki briew ruh .

en: In the fear of the  Lord  is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka wanrah ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingshngain ïa u briew bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka don ka jingshaniah kaba skhem: bad ki khun jong u kin don ka jaka rieh tngen .

en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me long u nonghikai uba khraw ha Israel , bad mem tip ïa kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u: Me long u kynrad jong ki Israel bad phim tip ia kine kiei kiei ?

en: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew , bad ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ïa ki Philistia la kynrup da ka jingsngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kin iohsngew bad kin tieng: ka jingsngewsih kan bat ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Philistia .

en: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .
kha: U la jubab ,  U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa nga u la ong ha nga ba ngan rah ïa ka jingthiah bad ban ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia ki , Uta uba la pynlong ia nga uba pura, uta u la ong ha nga, To shim ia ka jingthiah jong me bad to iaid .

en: Who hath prevented me , that I should repay him ? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine .
kha: Uei uba lah ban tur ïaleh ïa u , bad u ban dang lait im ? Ym don mano mano ha ka pyrthei baroh uba lah ban leh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la khanglad ia nga , ba ngan siew kylliang ia u ? kaei kaei kaba don hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei ka long ka jong nga .

en: The selection will be done on the basis of a computer based examination and a personality test .
kha: Ia ka jingjied yn leh katkum ka jingpeit bniah da ka kompiwtor bad ka jingthew ia ka jinglong briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka jingjied yn leh katkum ka jingpeit bniah kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka kompiwtor bad ka jingtest ia ka jinglong .

en: And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
kha: U nongïalam jong ki Jiw u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u nongsynshar u la kylli ia u, u da ong, Ko Nonghikai babha, ngan leh aiu ban hiar pateng ia ka jingim bymjukut ?

en: And saith unto him , All these things will I give thee , if thou wilt fall down and worship me .
kha: Ïa kine baroh ngan ai ha me ,  u Soitan u la ong ,  lada men dem khohsiew bad mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u , Kine kiei kiei baroh ngan ai ha me lada me hap bad mane ia nga .

en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;
kha: Lada uno uno u pynmynsaw ïa uwei pat u briew , kumba u la leh ïa uta , kumta ruh yn leh kylliang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u pynmih ia ka jingduna ha u paramarjan jong u ; kumba u la leh , kumta yn leh ia u ; .

en: And teach customs , which are not lawful for us to receive , neither to observe , being Romans .
kha: Ki hikai ïa ki dustur kiba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ jong ngi ; ngi long ki traishnong jong ka Hima Rom , bad ngim lah ban pdiang ne pyndonkam ïa kine ki dustur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hikai ia ki riti dustur , ki bym long katkum ka ain ia ngi ban pdiang , lymne ban peit bniah , da kaba long ki nong Rom .

en: Return , I pray you , let it not be iniquity  ; yea , return again , my righteousness is in it .
kha: Phi la leit jngai palat . Sangeh na kaba long bymhok . Wat pynrem ïa nga . Ngam shym bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan phai, nga duwai ia phi, wat ai ba kan long ka jingbymhok ; yea, to wan phai biang, ka hok jong nga ka don ha ka .

en: But put forth thine hand now , and touch all that he hath , and he will curse thee to thy face .
kha: Hynrei tharai mynta me shim noh na u baroh kiba u don — un tim ïa me markhmat !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to buh ia ka kti jong me mynta, bad to ktah ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don, bad un tim ia me ha ka khmat jong me .

en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .
kha: Shatei na Sela , u pud ka Edom u ïaid lyngba ka Khim Akrabbim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw jong ki Amorit ka long naduh ka jingleit sha Akrabbim, naduh u maw bad shaneng .

en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God .
kha: Nga lah ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingshakri jong nga ïa U Blei , lyngba U Khrist Jisu
translated_en_to_kha: Nga don namarkata ia kaba nga lah ban pyndonburom lyngba U Jisu Khrist ha kita kiei kiei kiba iadei bad U Blei .

en: Praise the  Lord  with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .
kha: To ai ki jingainguh ïa U  Trai  ha ki duitara , to rwai ha u da ki jingtem ksai .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai da ka harp: rwai ia u da ka jingrwai bad ka tiar kaba shiphew tylli ki string .

en: He sendeth out his word , and melteth them : he causeth his wind to blow , and the waters flow .
kha: Hadien pat u ai ka hukum , bad u thah u um ; u phah ïa ka lyer , bad ka um ka tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U phah ia ka ktien jong u, bad u pynkhluit ia ki: u pynlong ia ka Iyer jong u ban beh , bad ki um ki tuid .

en: And they took him , and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it .
kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u bad bret ïa u sha ka pukri , kaba la tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u, bad ki la bret ia u ha ka thliew: bad ka thliew ka la thylli , ym don um ha ka .

en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he will send forth labourers into his harvest .
kha: To kyrpad ïa U Trai ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban ïalumlang ha ka jingot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To duwai namarkata ia U Trai jong ka jingot , ba un phah ia ki nongtrei sha ka jingot jong u .

en: Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
kha: Naba nga ïohsngew shaphang ka jingieit jong me ïa ki briew U Blei baroh bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngap ia ka jingieit bad ka jingngeit jong me, kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu bad ha ki riewkhuid baroh;

en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka byndi , u la ïalam shabar ïa ki apostol , bad u la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u angel U Trai ha ka por miet u la plie ia ki jingkhang jong ka phatok bad u la wanrah ia ki shabar bad u la ong:

en: They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :
kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa U  Trai bad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bitar ia u ruh ha ki um jong ka jingialeh , haduh ba ka la leit pang bad u Moses na ka bynta jong ki:

en: For as the Father hath life in himself  ; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself  ;
kha: Kumba U Kpa da lade hi u long u tyllong jong ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom u la pynlong ïa U Khun jong u ban long u tyllong jong ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba U Kpa u don ka jingim ha lade ; kumta u la ai ha U Khun ban don ka jingim ha lade ; .

en: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me : It is good for a man not to touch a woman .
kha: Mynta , to ngin ïa-peit ïa ki bynta kiba phi la thoh . Ka bha ïa u briew ba un ym shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shaphang kiei kiei kiba phi la thoh ha nga: Ka long kaba bha ia u shynrang ban ym ktah ia ka kynthei .

en: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him , whom Sarah bare to him , Isaac .
kha: U Abraham u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u khun jong u uba la kha ha u, uba ka Sarah ka la kha ha u, u Isaak .

en: According to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .
kha: Ki Israel ki trei ïa kane ka kam baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses , kumta ki khun Israel ki la leh ia ki kam baroh .

en: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .
kha: Lada uno uno u ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar ban mudui ïa phi na ka bynta ka sopti-poh jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew un mudui ia me ha ka ain bad un shim noh ia ka jainkup jong me ruh .

en: For destruction from God was a terror to me , and by reason of his highness I could not endure .
kha: Namar ba nga sheptieng ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei , ngam shym lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynjot na U Blei ka la long ka jingtieng ia nga , bad namar ka jingjrong jong u ngam lah ban shah .

en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .
kha: Ka kham bha kaba sah ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang bad ka tnga kaba bunktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban shong ha kawei ka kut jong ka iing , ban ia kaba don ka kynthei kaba shlur ha ka iing kaba heh .

en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the  Lord  , offer it at your own will .
kha: Haba phi pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sngewbha sha U  Trai  , bud beit ïa ki rukom lehniam khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phin aiti ia ka jingknia ainguh ia U Trai , to aiti ia ka katba phi mon hi .

en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea , and Nymphas , and the church which is in his house .
kha: To ai ïa ka jingkhublei bakyrpang jong ngi ïa ki parabangeit ha Laodikaïa , bad ïa ka Nympha bad ïa ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai khublei ia ki para bangeit kiba don ha Laodicea bad u Nymphas bad ka balang kaba don ha iing jong u .

en: Praise ye the  Lord  for the avenging of Israel , when the people willingly offered themselves .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ki Israel ki la kut jingmut ban ïaleh ; U paidbah da kaba kmen u tyrwa mon sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai na ka bynta ka jingpynshitom bein ia ki Israel , haba ki briew ki la tyrwa mon sngewbha ia lade .

en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing , she took Zilpah her maid , and gave her Jacob to wife .
kha: Haba ka Leah ka sngewthuh ba ka la wai ban ïoh khun , ka la ai ïa ka mraw jong ka , ka Silpah ha u Jakob kum ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka Leah ka la iohi ba ka la iehnoh ia ka jingkha khun, ka la shim ia ka nongtrei jong ka, bad ka la ai ia u Jakob ha ka tnga jong ka .

en: And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .
kha: U riewspah u la jubab , ‘ Kata kam pat biang , ko kpa Abraham ! Hynrei lada uno uno u mihpat na ka jingïap bad leit sha ki , te kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, Em, ko kpa Abraham: hynrei lada uwei u leit sha ki na kiba iap , kin kylla bamut .

en: I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
kha: Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga long u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh ka kren skhem ba ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia ka jingshisha ha U Khrist , ngam thok , ka jingsngew jong nga ruh ka pynlong ia nga ban sakhi ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , .

en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain , and a corrupt spring .
kha: U briew babha uba ai ha uwei pat uba sniew ka pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ka umpohliew kaba la pynjngut ne ka pukri kaba la ai bih .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba hok uba hap ha khmat kiba sniew u long kum ka pung kaba jynjar , bad ka tyllong um kaba bamsap .

en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .
kha: Hynrei u briew uba la shongkurim u pyrkhat kiei kiei kiba kynja pyrthei , kumno ba un pynsngewbha ïa la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba la shongkurim u sumar ia kiei kiei kiba long jong ka pyrthei , kumno u lah ban pynsngewbha ia ka tnga jong u .

en: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .
kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet ki la ap ha ki khyrdop shnong khnang ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la tip ia ka jingsah jong ki ha u Saul . Bad ki la peit ia ki khyrdop miet bad sngi ban pyniap ia u .

en: For ye say , Where is the house of the prince ? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked ?
kha: Phi kylli ,  Hangno ka don ka ïing jong u briew bakhraw mynta , u briew uba leh ïa kaba sniew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi ong , Hangno ka iing jong u syiem ? bad shano ki jaka shong jong ki bymman ?

en: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Salah u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Eber saw spah lai snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea , from the bay that looketh southward :
kha: Kane ka pud bashaphang shathie ka sdang na ka tduh kaba shathie jong ka Duriaw Baïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud jong ki shaphang shathie u long na rud duriaw mluh, na ka duriaw kaba peit shaphang shathie:

en: O my people , what have I done unto thee ? and wherein have I wearied thee ? testify against me .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la leh aïu ïa phi ? Kumno nga la long ka jingkit ïa phi ? To jubab ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la leh aiu ia me ? bad ha kaba nga la phong ia me ? sakhi pyrshah ia nga .

en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried , and passed beyond the quarries , and escaped unto Seirath .
kha: U Ehud u la ïohphet katba ki dang ïa-ap . U la leit narud ki maw ba la ohdur bad u leit poi sha Seirah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ehud u la lait im katba ki dang sahkut, bad u la iaid shabar ki maw bad u la lait sha Seirath .

en: He shall enter into peace : they shall rest in their beds , each one walking in his uprightness .
kha: Kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ki ïoh jingsuk bad jingjahthait ha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Un rung ha ka jingsuk: kin shongthait ha ki jingthiah jong ki , uwei pa uwei un iaid ha ka jinglong beit jong u .

en: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul  ;
kha: Haba ki briew ka Jabesh kiba ha Gilead ki ïohsngew aïu ki Philistia ki la leh ïa u Saul ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongshong shnong jong u Jabeshgilead ki la iohsngew ia kata kaba ki Philistia ki la leh ia u Saul ; .

en: But we understand from Luke 13 : 24 that Gods requirements are such as to exclude unworthy ones .
kha: Hynrei ngi sngewthuh na u Loukas 13 : 24 ba ki jingdawa jong U Blei ki long kumne ban kyntait ia ki bym bit dor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi sngewthuh na u Loukas 13 : 24 ba ki jingdonkam jong U Blei ki long kum ban kyntait ia kiba khlem akor .

en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah , and made themselves a king .
kha: Ha ki sngi ba u Jehoram u synshar , ki Edom ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ki la long ka hima kaba laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u ki nong Edome ki la kylla na hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u Judah , bad ki la pynlong syiem ia lade .

en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me , or lifted up myself when evil found him :
kha: Ngam pat ju kmen haba ki nongshun jong nga ki shah jynjar , ne sngewbha haba ki ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot ;
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la sngewbha ia ka jingpynjot ia uta uba shun ia nga , ne nga la pynkiew ia lade haba ka jingsniew ka la lap ia u:

en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .
kha: Nangta ngin leit bad shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , ïa kaba la leh bymsuidñiew mynba u Saul u long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ngin wanrah biang ia ka synduk U Blei jong ngi ha ngi: namar ngim shym la kylli ia ka ha ki sngi u Saul .

en: He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .
kha: U Ïoannis u la long kum ka sharak , kaba meh bad kaba tyngshaiñ , bad phi la mon shipor ban lehkmen ha ka jingshai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la long u jingshai uba thang bad uba shai: bad phi la mon ia ka aiom ban sngewbha ha ka jingshai jong u .

en: And they departed , and went through the towns , preaching the gospel , and healing every where .
kha: Ki synran ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit lyngba ki nongrit baroh , ki da ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha bad ki da pynkhiah ïa ki briew ha kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh bad ki la iaid lyngba ki shnong ki thaw, ki da pynkhiah ia ka gospel bad ki pynkoit ia ki jaka baroh .

en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way , and said unto them ,
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew sha Jerusalem , u la shim kyrpang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la kren jar jar ha ki , katba ki dang ïa-ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem u la shim ia ki shiphew ngut ki synran shawei ha lynti bad u la ong ha ki:

en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet , I should have slept : then had I been at rest ,
kha: Lada ngan jin da la ïap ha kata ka por , ngan jin da la don ha ka jingjahthait mynta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta mynta nga la dei ban thiah dang sah bad sngap jar, nga la dei ban thiah: nangta nga la shongthait , .

en: For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
kha: Ma nga , shisien nga la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad nga la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la im khlem ka hukum shisien: hynrei haba ka hukum ka la wan , ka pop ka la im biang bad nga la iap .

en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,
kha: Haba u Petros u la leit sha Jerusalem , kito kiba ïashah ba dei ban otsher ïa ki Jentil ki la wohnia ïa u , da kaba ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la wan shaneng ha Jerusalem , kita kiba la shah ot ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u .

en: Though it be given him to be in safety , whereon he resteth  ; yet his eyes are upon their ways .
kha: U Blei u lah ban shah ïa u ban im khlem jingpynthut , hynrei u peit-thuh pat ïa u man la ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la la ai ia u ban long ha ka jingshngain, ha kaba u shongthait ; hynrei ki khmat jong u ki don ha ki lynti jong ki .

en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
kha: Kane ka la pynmih ïa ka jingïatainia kaba tyngeh hapdeng jong ki .  Kumno une u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ?  ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw namarkata ki iaid hapdeng jong ki da kaba ong: Kumno une u briew un ai ia ngi ia ka doh jong u ban bam ?

en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .
kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt bad u la long u briew uba khraw ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shah hikai ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nong Ijipt , bad u la long uba khlain bor ha ki ktien bad ha ki kam .

en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .
kha: Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua ,  Ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ong ha u Joshua , U Trai U Blei jong ngi ngin shakri bad ka sur jong u ngin kohnguh .

en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb , as Moses said : and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak .
kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , la ai ïa ka Hebron ha u Kaleb , uba la beh noh na ka nongbah ïa ki lai tylli ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Anak .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia u Hebron ha u Caleb kumba u Moses u la ong: bad u la beh noh nangta ia ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Anaak .

en: My tabernacle also shall be with them : yea , I will be their God , and they shall be my people .
kha: Ngan shong hangta bad ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Tabernak ruh kan long bad ki: Hooid , ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel .
kha: Hapdeng ki paid Israel yn ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ba bakla lane ki jingïathuhlypa kiba ïalam bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan ym don shuh ka jingphohsniew ne ka jingpynpaw pyrthei hapoh ka iing Israel .

en: Behold Israel after the flesh : are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar ?
kha: To pyrkhat ïa ki paid Israel ; kito kiba bam ïa kaei kaba la kñia ki ïoh bynta ha ka jingshakri ha ka duwan sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki Israel hadien ka doh: hato kim bam ia kano na ki jingknia jong ka almari ?

en: And Jonadab said unto the king , Behold , the king s sons come : as thy servant said , so it is .
kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Dabid ,  Kito kiba wan ki dei ki khun shynrang jong phi , kumba nga la ong ba kin sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonadab u la ong ha u syiem: Ha khmih ki khun syiem ki wan: kumba u shakri jong me u la ong .

en: And Mary arose in those days , and went into the hill country with haste , into a city of Juda  ;
kha: Shen hadien , ka Mari ka la khreh bad ka la leit bran bran sha ka shnong ha ka ri lum ha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria ka la ieng ha kita ki sngi bad ka la leit sha ka ri lum da kaba kyrkieh, sha ka shnong Judah ; .

en: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites , so shall also the Son of man be to this generation .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa u la long ka dak ïa ki briew jong ka Ninebeh , kumta U Khun U Briew un long ka dak ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba u Jonah u long ka dak ha ki nong Ninebe , kumta ruh u Khun u briew un long ha kane ka pateng .

en: That they gathered themselves together , to fight with Joshua and with Israel , with one accord .
kha: Ki la ïakynduh lang baroh bad ki la ïasnohkti lang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Joshua bad ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki la ialum lang , ban ialeh bad u Joshua bad bad ki Israel , da kawei ka jingmut .

en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?
kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jong ka pisa ? Ne phi ïa-bishni namar ba nga long uba sbun ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam long kaba dei ia nga ban leh ia kaba nga mon bad ka jong nga hi ? Hato ka khmat jong me ka long kaba sniew namar nga long uba bha ?

en: All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .
kha: Ka jingim jong kiba duk ka don ha ka jingïaleh borabor , hynrei ki briew kiba kmen ki suk mynsiem ha ka jingim borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki sngi jong kiba shah shitom ki long kiba sniew: hynrei uta uba don ka dohnud kaba sngewbha u don ka jingkhawai kaba bteng .

en: In time , you may qualify to begin preaching with the local congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses .
kha: Shen phin sa lah ban leit ïalap ryngkat bad kiwei pat ki para bangeit jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka shnong jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por , phi lah ban sdang ban ialap bad ka balang jong ki nongsakhi jong ka ri .

en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .
kha: Naba U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi um pynlong ïa ngi kiba khawpud ; pynban , U Mynsiem jong u , u pyndap ïa ngi da ka bor , ka jingieit , bad ka bor halor lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ai ha ngi ia ka mynsiem jong ka jingtieng ; hynrei ka bor bad ka jingieit bad ka jingmut kaba skhem .

en: Meditate on how Jehovah has worked out his will in the past and how he will do so in the future .
kha: Pyrkhat kumno U Jehobah u la pyndep ïa ka mon jong u ha ki por ba la leit noh bad kumno un leh ïa kata ha ki por ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat kumno U Jehobah u la leh ia ka mon jong u ha ki por ba la leit noh bad kumno un leh kumta ha ki por ban wan .

en: Wherefore I also , after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus , and love unto all the saints ,
kha: Na kane ka daw , naduh ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Trai Jisu bad ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata nga ruh hadien ba nga la iohsngew ia ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Trai Jisu bad ka jingieit ia ki riewkhuid baroh .

en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
kha: Lada phi long uba shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba uno uno u leh bakla ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban leh klet ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewthuh jong u briew ka pynslem ia ka jingbitar jong u ; bad ka long ka burom jong u ban iaid lait ia ka jingpynkhein .

en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them ?
kha: Kumno me lah ban pynlong ïa ki briew kum ka dohkha lane kum ka kynhun ki khñiang ki bym don nongsynshar ban ïalam ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew kum ki dohkha duriaw , kum kiei kiei kiba iaid kai , ki bym don nongsynshar halor jong ki ?

en: Look on every one that is proud , and bring him low  ; and tread down the wicked in their place .
kha: Ho-oid , to khmih ïa ki bad to pynhiar ïa ki ; pynlwet ïa ki bymman ha ka jaka kaba ki ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia uwei pa uwei uba sngew sarong , bad pynhiar ia u ; bad pynhiar ia kiba sniew ha ka jaka jong ki .

en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .
kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong U  Trai  ; to wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha U Trai ia ka burom kaba dei ia ka kyrteng jong u: wanrah ia ka jingainguh , bad wan sha ki iingbishar jong u .

en: And when he had spoken such words unto me , I set my face toward the ground , and I became dumb .
kha: Haba u la kren ïa kane , nga la peit sha khyndew , khlem lait kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kum kine ki ktien ha nga , nga la buh ia ka khmat jong nga sha khyndew bad nga la lyngngoh .

en: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem : and they tarried there .
kha: Kumta u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki bah biang ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha Jerusalem bad ki sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zadok namarkata bad u Abiathar ki la rah biang ia ka synduk U Blei sha Jerusalem : bad ki la sah hangta .

en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .
kha: Mynta phi dei ban jied ïa u briew uba stad bad uba shemphang bad thung ïa u ba un peit ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba u Pharaoh un peit ia u briew uba stad bad uba stad , bad un buh ia u halor ka ri Ijipt .

en: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands  ; and said , Let us not kill him .
kha: Haba u Reuben u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa u Joseph .  To ngin ym pynïap ïa u ,  u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la iohsngew ia kata , bad u la pyllait noh ia u na ki kti jong ki ; bad u la ong: To ngin ym pyniap ia u .

en: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
kha: Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade , yn pynrit ; bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa lade , yn pynkhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba pynkhraw ia lade un shah pynjah burom ; bad uta uba pynrit mynsiem ia lade un shah pynkhraw .

en: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .
kha: Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaba synshar halor ki syiem jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei kaba me la iohi ka long kata ka nongbah kaba khraw kaba synshar halor ki syiem jong ka khyndew .

en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :
kha: Nangta u Moses u phah khot ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , hynrei ki ong ,  Ngim wan !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la phah ban khot ia u Datan bad u Abiram, ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab: kiba la ong: Ngin ym wan shaneng:

en: Then the king said unto me , For what dost thou make request ? So I prayed to the God of heaven .
kha: U patsha u kylli ,  Kaei kaba me kwah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha nga , Na ka bynta kaei kaba me kyrpad ? Kumta nga la duwai ha U Blei jong ka bneng .

en: For thou shalt worship no other god : for the  Lord  , whose name is Jealous , is a jealous God :
kha: Wat mane ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei , namar ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngam lah shah ïa kino kino ki ban ïakob ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong me wat mane ia uwei pat u blei: namar U Trai uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba sngewsih:

en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings , and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices .
kha: Yn sa rong noh ïa ki kumba kit da ka lyer , bad kin sa shah ka jinglehrain namar ba ki kñia ha ki blei thala .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Iyer ka la teh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka , bad kin sngewlehrain namar ki jingknia jong ki .
