en: Salute Asyncritus , Phlegon , Hermas , Patrobas , Hermes , and the brethren which are with them .
kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa u Asynkritos , u Phlegon , u Hermes , u Patrobas , u Hermas , bad baroh ki parabangeit kiba don bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Asynritus , u Phlegon , u Herma , u Hermes bad ki para kiba don ryngkat bad ki .

en: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
kha: Te ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba la ktah kti ïa u , namar ba ka kynta jong u kam pat poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wad ban shim ia u: hynrei ym don ba buh kti ia u , namar ka por jong u kam pat poi .

en: But the men put forth their hand , and pulled Lot into the house to them , and shut to the door .
kha: Hynrei kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba don hapoh ki la mih shabar , ki la ring ïa u Lot shapoh ïing , bad ki khang ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shynrang ki la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad ki la tan ia u Lot shapoh iing sha ki bad ki la khang ia ka jingkhang .

en: And Joseph said unto him , This is the interpretation of it : The three branches are three days :
kha: U Joseph u ong ,  Kane ka mut kumne : kita ki tnat lai tylli ki long lai tylli ki sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha u: Kane ka long ka jingbatai jong ka: Ki lai tylli ki tnat ki long lai sngi:

en: Meditate upon these things ; give thyself wholly to them ; that thy profiting may appear to all .
kha: To leh minot ha kine kiei kiei bad to aiti ïa lade ha ki , ba baroh kin ïohi ïa ka jingroi jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia kine kiei kiei; to ai ia lade baroh kawei ha ki; ba ka jingmyntoi jong me kan paw ha baroh .

en: Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !
kha: Hynrei tang namar ka jingïoh pisa bymdei phi shah ïa kiba shah pynrem ban lait bad phi khang ïa kiba lui lui na kaba ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pynshisha ia kiba sniew na ka bynta ka bainong , bad weng noh ia ka hok jong kiba hok na u !

en: And as Samuel turned about to go away , he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle , and it rent .
kha: Nangta u Samuel u phai ban leit noh , hynrei u Saul u ïohbat ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka la kad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Samuel u dang phai sha jngai, u la bat ia ka tduh jong ka jainkup jong u, bad ka la tyrkhong .

en: And said , Hitherto shalt thou come , but no further : and here shall thy proud waves be stayed ?
kha: Nga ong ïa ka ,  Haduh hangne phan ïoh poi , bad ym palat ! Hangne ki jingat phyllung bakhlaiñ jong pha ki dei ban sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Haduh mynta phin wan shuh shuh: bad hangne ki um kiba sngew sarong jong me kin sah ?

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .
kha: U angel u jubab ,  Ka tnga jong phi ka dei ban sumar ban leh ïa kita baroh ïa kaba nga la bthah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha u Manoah , Na kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong ha kata ka kynthei to ai ba kan husiar .

en: I will call on the  Lord  , who is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies .
kha: Nga khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan khot ia U Trai uba dei ban shah iaroh: kumta ngan sa lait na ki nongshun jong nga .

en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .
kha: Un jah noh na ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sah ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat ruh kaba la iohi ia u kan ym iohi shuh ia u ; bad ka jaka jong u kan ym iohi shuh ia u .

en: 00 am : Prime Minister Narendra Modi to address a conference on Legal Services Day today at 10 am
kha: 00 am : U Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi un kren ha ka jingialang ha ka sngi shakri ain mynta ka sngi ha ka por 10 baje mynstep
translated_en_to_kha: 00 am: U Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi ban kren ia ka jingialang ha ka sngi Legal Services Day mynta ka sngi ha ka por 10 baje mynstep .

en: This minimum balance could be as low as Rs 500 or as high as Rs 2 lakh , depending on your bank .
kha: Kane ka pisa kaba duna tam ka lah ban long haduh 500 tyngka ne haduh 2 lak tyngka , katkum ka bank jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingïahap kaba rit tam ka lah ban long haduh 500 ne haduh 2 lak, katkum ka bank jong phi .

en: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen .
kha: U Solomon u don sawphew hajar tylli ki sem ïa ki kulai ring kali , bad khat-ar hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u don sawphew hajar tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki kali jong u, bad shiphew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai .

en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me !
kha: Ngam shym sngap ïa ki nonghikai jong nga , ngam shym la shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong ki nonghikai jong nga , lymne kim shym la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong nga ha ki kiba la hikai ia nga !

en: All the cities of the children of Aaron , the priests , were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
kha: Baroh ki long khatlai tylli lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki , la ai ha ki lyngdoh , kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong Aaron baroh ki long shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ki .

en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead , they departed every man unto his place .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ba u Abimelekh u la ïap , baroh ki leit phai noh sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew Israel ki la iohi ba u Abimelech u la iap , ki la leit noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka jaka .

en: Yet all this availeth me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king s gate .
kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim long ei ei ïa nga katba nga dang ïohi ïa uto u Jiw , u Mordekai ba u shong ha ka khyrdop sha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim don ei ei ia nga, katba nga dang iohi ia u Mordecai u Jiw uba shong ha ka khyrdop syiem .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Destroy this temple , and in three days I will raise it up .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Pynpra ïa kane ka Templ , bad ha ki lai sngi ngan tei pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Pynduh noh ia kane ka tempi bad hadien lai sngi ngan pynmih ia ka .

en: Do You Recall ? What did you learn from Hezekiah , Hannah , and Jonah about trusting in Jehovah ?
kha: Hato Phi Kynmaw ? Kaei kaba phi la ïoh jinghikai na u Hesekaiah , ka Hannah bad u Jonah shaphang ka jingshaniah ha U Jehobah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato Phi Kynmaw ? Kaei kaba phi la nang na u Hesekaiah , u Hannah bad u Jonah shaphang ka jingshaniah ha U Jehobah ?

en: And when he is come , he will reprove the world of sin , and of righteousness , and of judgment :
kha: Bad haba un wan , un pynshisha ïa briew jong ka pyrthei ba ki bakla shaphang ka pop bad shaphang kaei kaba dei bad shaphang ka jingbishar jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la wan , un pynrem ia ka pyrthei pop bad ka hok bad ka jingbishar:

en: And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
kha: Kumta , hangta ha khmat jong phi nga bret ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia ki ar tylli ki miej , bad nga la bret noh ia ki na ki ar tylli ki kti jong nga , bad nga la bret ia ki ha khmat ki khmat jong phi .

en: I have heard the check of my reproach , and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer .
kha: Kaei kaba phi la ong ka long ka jingñiewbeiñ , hynrei nga tip kumno ngan jubab ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia ka jingpeit bniah jong nga , bad ka mynsiem jong ka jingsngewthuh jong nga ka pynlong ia nga ban jubab .

en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .
kha: Ka jingklim ka long ka jingriam — ka pynngat ïa kito kiba U  Trai  u bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong ki kynthei kiba phylla ka long ka thliew kaba jylliew: uta uba la sngewsih ia U Trai un hap ha ka .

en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .
kha: Ma ngi kiba long kiba khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit , ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot ba kin bah ïa ki jingkit jong ki . Ngim dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi nangta kiba khlain ngi dei ban shah ia ki jingduna jong kiba tlot , bad ban ym pynsngewbha ia lade .

en: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
kha: Pynban dei ma nga uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rah ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynrei kim shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la hikai ia u Ephraim ruh ban leit , da kaba shim ia ki da ki kti jong ki ; hynrei kim tip ba nga la pynkoit ia ki .

en: And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .
kha: Bad man ka sngi hapoh ka Templ bad ha ki ïing jong ki briew ki ïai bteng ban hikai bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad man ka sngi ha ka tempi bad ha man la ka iing , kim sangeh ban hikai bad ialap ia U Jisu Khrist .

en: And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .
kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh ban leit ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh bad u la iathuh ha u Moses bad u la ong, U Eldad bad u Medad ki iathuhlypa ha ka shnong .

en: O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .
kha: Pynbeit ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; hynrei wat leh tyngeh halor jong ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka lah ban long ka jingkut jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, to pynbeit ia nga, hynrei da ka jingbishar ; ym ha ka jingbitar jong me, ioh ba me wanrah ia nga sha ka jingbym don ei ei .

en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .
kha: Kata ka long ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar jong kito ki bymsalia ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid kum kine ki jaka sah jong kiba sniew , bad kane ka long ka jaka jong uta u bym ithuh ia U Blei .

en: For he found her in the field , and the betrothed damsel cried , and there was none to save her .
kha: Uta u briew u la batbor ïa kata ka briew kaba la ïatehktien , bad wat la ka la lynñiar ruh , ym don mano mano ba wan ïarap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la shem ia ka ha lyngkha, bad ka dam kaba la tyrkhong ka la iam , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynim ia ka .

en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .
kha: Naba kaei kaba i kum ka jingibieit U Blei ka long kaba kham stad ban ïa ka jingstad briew , bad kaei kaba i kumba ka long ka jingtlot U Blei ka long kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka bor briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbieit U Blei ka kham stad ban ia ki briew ; bad ka jingtlot U Blei ka kham khlain ban ia ki briew .

en: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah , u la leit sha Kapernam .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u la pynkut lut ia ki jingkren jong u ha ki nongpeitkai jong ki briew , u la rung ha Capernaum .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh u long uba mutlop eh bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ki paidbah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ka dohnud jong u Pharaoh ka la tyrkhong , u kyntait ban pyllait ia ki briew .

en: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved , even as they .
kha: Em ! Ngi ngeit bad la pynim ïa ngi da ka jingaiei jong U Trai Jisu , kumba long ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi ngeit ba lyngba ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu Khrist ngin sa ioh jingpynim kumba ki long .

en: But when the people were put forth , he went in , and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .
kha: Hynrei mar ïa pynmih ïa ki briew shabar , U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka kamra jong ka khynnah bad u la bat ïa ka kti jong ka , bad ka la khie joit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda la buh ia ki briew shabar , u la rung shapoh bad u la shim ia ka da ka kti bad ka nongtrei ka la ieng .

en: Jesus cried and said ,  He that believeth on me , believeth not on me , but on him that sent me .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga u ngeit ym tang ha nga hynrei ruh ha uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la pyrta bad u la ong , Uta uba ngeit ha nga, um ngeit ia nga hynrei ha uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip ba ngi ieit ïa ki khun U Blei : Ka long da kaba ieit ïa U Blei bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane ngi tip ba ngi ieit ia ki khun U Blei , haba ngi ieit ia U Blei bad ngi sumar ia ki hukum jong u .

en: And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart  ; for the  Lord  is with thee .
kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat , namar U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathan u la ong ha u syiem, To leit leh ia kaba don ha ka dohnud jong me ; namar U Trai u don ryngkat bad me .

en: And she said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell the man that sent you to me ,
kha: bad ka ïathuh ïa ki ban leit pat sha u syiem bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , Iathuh ia uta u briew uba la phah ia phi sha nga .

en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .
kha: Ki briew jong ngi ki dei ban nang ban pynlut ïa la ka por ha kaba leh babha , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam bashisha ; kim dei ban im ka jingim ka bymlarkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba ki jong ngi ruh kin nang ban pynneh ia ki kam kiba bha na ka bynta ki jingpyndonkam kiba donkam , ba kin ym long ki bym don jingmyntoi .

en: As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Dei ma nga uta ,  ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllon ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang shu ong ha ki, Nga long ma nga, ki la leit phai shadien bad ki la hap ha khyndew .

en: And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .
kha: Ngan long U Kpa jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin long u Kpa ha phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Baroh .

en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .
kha: Namar kata , kohnguh hok ïa ki ktien baroh ba la thoh ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia ki ktien jong kane ka jutang bad leh ia ki , ba phin roi ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh .

en: For what portion of God is there from above ? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high ?
kha: Kaei U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa ngi ? Kumno u siew kylliang ïa ki kam u bynriew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong U Blei ka don hangta naduh jrong ? bad kaei ka pateng jong U Blei baroh na jrong ?

en: Woe unto the wicked ! it shall be ill with him : for the reward of his hands shall be given him .
kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki long kiba la tim ; kaei kaba ki la leh ïa kiwei mynta yn leh ïa ka ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew ia u bymman ! kan long kaba pang bad u: namar ka bainong jong ki kti jong u yn ai ia u .

en: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;
kha: Haba la pynlong janai ïa u , u la jia long ka tynrai jong ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la pynlong ia u uba janai, u la long u nongthoh jong ka jingpynim bymjukut ha kito baroh kiba kohnguh ia u;

en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city , which was before the king s gate .
kha: U Hathakh u leit sha u Mordekai ha ka phyllaw ka nongbah ha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Hatach u la leit sha u Mordecai sha ka lynti jong ka shnong kaba don ha khmat ka khyrdop syiem .

en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing , and because he had no pity .
kha: Namar ka jingleh ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh barunar , u dei ban buria saw shah ïa kaba u la shim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynphai biang ia u khun langbrot saw shah, namar ba u la leh ia kane ka kam bad namar ba um don jingsngewrit .

en: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families .
kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai ha ka jaitbynriew Reuben kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ , in them that are saved , and in them that perish :
kha: Naba ngi long kum ka jingiwbih ba la ai da U Khrist sha U Blei , kaba saphriang hapdeng kito kiba la pynim bad kito kiba la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ha U Blei ka jingsma kaba thiang jong U Khrist, ha kito kiba la pynim bad ha kito kiba jah:

en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .
kha: Don uba la ïathuh ha ka Tamar ba u kthaw kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha u Tamar, da kaba ong: Ha khmih u kpa jong me u leit sha Timna ban ot ia ki langbrot jong u .

en: I have not sent these prophets , yet they ran : I have not spoken to them , yet they prophesied .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngam shym la phah ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei wat la katta ki leit la ka leit . Ngam shym la ai kano kano ka khubor ha ki , hynrei pynban ki kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la phah ia kine ki nongiathuhlypa , hynrei ki la mareh: Ngam shym la kren ia ki , hynrei ki la iathuhlypa .

en: Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :
kha: To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  , phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi ki jait jong ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai , ko iing u Jakob bad ki iing Israel baroh:

en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner , whom they would .
kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u lyngskor ka hima Rom u la ju don ka rukom ban pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi ïa uba u paidbah u pan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kata ka jingkhawai u Lat u la ju pyllait ha ki briew ia u koidi uba ki kwah .

en: And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me long u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab ;  kiwei pat ki ong ba me long u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab , u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis: hynrei don kiba ong: Elias bad kiwei pat , Uwei na ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Throughout the week , the public were invited to vote for their favourite wild card contestants .
kha: Ha baroh kawei ka taiew la khot sngewbha ia ki paidbah ban thep vote ia ki nongiashim bynta wild card ba ki sngewtynnad eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew baroh kawei , la khot ia ki paidbah ban jied ia ki nongiashim bynta khlaw ba ki ieit eh .

en: But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
kha: Hynrei ma phi te , phi dei ban leit phai biang sha ka ri shyiap sha ka phang jong ka Duriaw Basaw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia phi pat , pynphai ia phi, bad shim ia ka jingleit jong phi sha ka ri khlaw da ka lynti jong ka duriaw Basaw .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .
kha: Ka jingbam jong nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  ka long ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga bad ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba u la ai ha nga ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Ka jingbam jong nga ka long ban leh ia ka mon jong uta uba la phah ia nga bad ban pyndep ia ka kam jong u .

en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
kha: Me la shah ïa ka lyer ban beh noh ïa nga ; me la kynting ïa nga ha ka  erïong bajur .
translated_en_to_kha: Me pynkiew ia nga sha ka Iyer me pynlong ia nga ban shong halor jong ka, bad pynpra ia ka jinglong jong nga .

en: Where they crucified him , and two other with him , on either side one , and Jesus in the midst .
kha: Hangta ki la sahnarphna ïa u ; bad ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang bad U Jisu hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ki la sahnarphna ia u, bad arngut kiwei pat bad u, na kawei ka liang bad U Jisu hapdeng .

en: And they took Joseph s coat , and killed a kid of the goats , and dipped the coat in the blood  ;
kha: Nangta ki la pynïap uwei  langsohmoh bad ki wieh ïa kata ka sopti jong u Joseph ha ka snam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka jainkup jong u Joseph bad ki la pyniap ia u khun blang bad ki la pynngam ia ka jainkup ha ka snam ; .

en: ( 2 Peter 3 :13  ; Revelation 21 :3 , 4 ) So make it a family habit to study the Bible together !
kha: ( 2 U Petros 3 :13 ; Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 ) Kumta ia leh ban pynmlien ba ka ïng ka sem kan pule lang ia ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: ( 2 Petros 3 :13 ; Jingpynpaw 21:3), 4 ) Kumta pynlong ia ka kum ka jinglong jong ka longiing ban pule lang ia ka Baibl !

en: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work s sake . And be at peace among yourselves .
kha: To ñiewburom shikatdei eh ïa ki bad to ieit ïa ki namar ka kam kaba ki trei . To phin ïalong kiba ïasuk para ma phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban burom ia ki shibun eh ha ka jingieit ia ka kam jong ki . Bad to long kiba suk hapdeng jong phi .

en: And when the child was grown , it fell on a day , that he went out to his father to the reapers .
kha: Katto katne snem hadien , ha ka aïom ot , u khynnah u la mih shabar ha kawei ka step ban leit sha la u kpa jong u , uba don ha lyngkha lem bad ki nongot kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u khynnah u la san , u la hap ha ka sngi , ba u la leit shabar sha u kpa jong u sha ki nongot .

en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .
kha: Ka kham bha ban long uba sngewrit bad sah duk ban ïa kaba long uba meng bad ïoh bynta na ka jinglute jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long ban long ka mynsiem kaba rit mynsiem bad kiba rit mynsiem , ban ia kaba phiah ia ka jingsniew bad kiba sngew sarong .

en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
kha: Lada phim lah ban synshar ïa ka jingbitar jong phi , phin long khlem ka jingïarap kum ka nongbah bym don kynroh , kaba lait rynghang ban shah tur ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka jingsynshar halor la ka jong ka mynsiem u long kum ka nongbah kaba la jot , bad khlem ki kynroh .

en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever  ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
kha: bad un long u syiem jong ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob junom ; ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh da lei lei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un synshar ia ka iing u Jakob junom bad na ka hima jong u kan ym kut .

en: You could talk about a problem that your children encountered at school and how to deal with it .
kha: Balei phim peit ïa ka prokram ba la pyni ha JW Broadcasting ( tv .jw .org ) bad ïasyllok lang hadien ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban kren shaphang ka jingeh kaba ki khun jong phi ki iakynduh ha skul bad kumno ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka .

en: Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .
kha: Hato phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Blei ? Kata ka bha ! Ki ksuid ruh ki ngeit — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Me ngeit ba don uwei u Blei uba me leh bha: ki ksuid ruh ki ngeit , bad ki khih .

en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
kha: Ka jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka durkhmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynnep ïa ka jingshemphang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ia ka jingrkhie: namar da ka jingsngewsih jong ka khmat la pynbha ia ka dohnud .

en: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .
kha: Bad ki la ong ,  Ngim da donkam ïa kino kino ki sakhi ! Ma ngi hi ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u la ong !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ngi donkam shuh ia ka sakhi ? namar ngi hi ngi la iohsngew na la ka jong ka shyntur .

en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .
kha: U la shim ruh shibun ka rnong na Betah bad na Berothai , ki nongbah kiba la synshar da u Hadadeser .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na Betah, bad na Berothai, ki shnong Hadadeser, u syiem Dabid u la shim palat ia ka nar .

en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man : seek out his wickedness till thou find none .
kha: Pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ki riewbymman bad ki riewsniew ; pynshitom ïa ki namar ka jingbakla kaba ki la leh tad haduh ba kin ym leh shuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh ia ka kti jong u briew uba sniew bad uba sniew: wad ia ka jingsniew jong u haduh ba men da shem .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  Let the dead bury their dead : but go thou and preach the kingdom of God .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ai ba kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki . Khie leit ma me bad pynbna ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u: Ai ba kiba iap kin tep ia kiba iap jong ki: hynrei me leit bad ialap ia ka hima U Blei .

en: Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .
kha: Baroh ki pyrshang ban shem sngewbha bad ki briew kiba khraw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad kito kiba lah ban pynsngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun kin sngewbha ia u syiem: bad uwei pa uwei u long u paralok jong u uba ai jingai sngewbha .

en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada phi long bymhok phin kyllon kynsan .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba iaid beit un ioh jingpynim: hynrei uta uba bakla ha ki lynti jong u un hap noh shisien .

en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
kha: Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar ngi tip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym tang kumta , hynrei ngi sngew sarong ha ki jingjynjar ruh: da kaba tip ba ka jingjynjar ka trei ia ka jingshaniah ; .

en: And judgment is come upon the plain country  ; upon Holon , and upon Jahzah , and upon Mephaath ,
kha: Ka jingbishar ka la wan ha ki nongbah jong ki sharing lum : ha ka Holon , Jahsah , Mephath ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbishar ka wan ha ka ri kaba jylliew ; ha Holon , bad ha Jahiah , bad ha Mephath .

en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah hynñiew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: U Seth u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Enos hynriew spah hynriew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: So then because thou art lukewarm , and neither cold nor hot , I will spue thee out of my mouth .
kha: Hynrei namar ba pha long kaba blem blem , ka bym shit lymne khriat , ngan prie noh ïa pha na ka shyntur jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta te namar ba me long uba jem bad uba khriat ne uba shit , ngan sa sngap ia me na ka shyntur jong nga .

en: And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .
kha: Kumta kita ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Phah ïa ngi ha kitei ki sniang , bad shah ïa ngi ban rung hapoh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ksuid baroh ki la kyrpad ia u, ki da ong: Phah ia ngi shapoh ka sniang, ba ngin rung shapoh jong ki .

en: A substantial portion of sabarimala pilgrims are from Tamil Nadu , Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka .
kha: Ka bynta kaba khraw jong ki nongleit nongwan shabarimala ki dei na Tamil Nadu , Andhra Pradesh bad Karnataka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta kaba khraw jong ki khynnah rit ka dei na Tamil Nadu , Andhra Pradesh bad Karnataka .

en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .
kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïaid na ka lynti kaba lait na kaba sniew ; te khmih shano ba phi leit — ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti kaba heh jong kaba beit ka long ban phet noh na kaba sniew: uta uba bat ia la ka lynti u pynneh ia la ka mynsiem .

en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father  ; and his kingdom was established greatly .
kha: U Solomon u la kiew khet kum u syiem hadien u Dabid , u kpa jong u , bad ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong u la pynskhem bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la shong ha ka khet u kpa jong u ; bad ka hima jong u ka la skhem shibun .

en: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
kha: Ka jingleh bymman kam wanrah ïa ka jingshngain , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew un ym shah pynskhem da ka jingsniew: hynrei ka tynrai jong kiba hok kan ym khih .

en: But if a woman have long hair , it is a glory to her : for her hair is given her for a covering .
kha: Balei , ka jinglong tynrai hi ka hikai ïa phi ba u shñiuh uba jrong ha u briew u long ka jingjahburom , hynrei ha ka briew u long ka burom ba-itynnat . Ïa u shñiuh uba jrong la ai ha ka ban long kum ka jingtap ïa ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka kynthei ka don ki shniuh kiba jrong , ka long ka burom ia ka: namar la ai ia ka ia ki shniuh jong ka na ka bynta ka jingtap .

en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar : but the breast shall be Aaron s and his sons .
kha: U lyngdoh un thang ïa kata ka khleiñ ha ka duwan , hynrei kata ka shadem kan dei jong ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un thang ia ka shini halor ka almari: hynrei ka sniehdoh kan long u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: Then saith he unto his disciples ,  The harvest truly is plenteous , but the labourers are few  ;
kha: Kumta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Ka jingot ka khraw eh , hynrei don khyndiat ki nongtrei ban lumlang ïa ka shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ha ki synran jong u , Ka jingot shisha ka long kaba bun, hynrei ki nongtrei ki long tang khyndiat;

en: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
kha: To kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba la mihpat na ka jingïap , uba la hiarpateng na u Dabid , kumba la hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ba U Jisu Khrist na u symbai u Dabid u la mihpat na kiba iap kat kum ka gospel jong nga:

en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
kha: Ki ktien jong u briew ki lah ban long ka umpohliew ka jingstad , kaba jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba sngur kum ki wahduid batuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u briew ki long kum ki um kiba jylliew , bad ka tyllong um jong ka jingstad kum ka wah kaba tuid .

en: I will therefore that men pray every where , lifting up holy hands , without wrath and doubting .
kha: Ha man la ka jingshakri ha ka balang , nga kwah ba ki rangbah kin duwai , ki briew kiba la pynkyntang sha U Blei bad kiba lah ban rah ïa la ki kti ha ka jingduwai khlem jingbitar lane ka jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leh namarkata ba ki briew kin duwai ha man la ki jaka, ki da rah ia ki kti bakhuid khlem jingbitar bad artatien .

en: The  Lord  by wisdom hath founded the earth  ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .
kha: U Trai u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u ; da ka jingshemphang jong u , u la buh beit ïa ka sahit bneng ha la ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai da ka jingstad u la seng ia ka khyndew ; da ka jingsngewthuh u la pynskhem ia ki bneng .

en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me  ;
kha: Haba uno uno na ki shakri jong nga u mudui pyrshah ïa nga , ngan shahshkor bad leh da kaba hok ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la leh bein ia ka daw jong u shakri jong nga ne jong u shakri jong nga , haba ki ialeh pyrshah ia nga ; .

en: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob  ; and hearken unto Israel your father .
kha: Ale lang bad sngap , phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , Shahshkor ïa u Israel u kpa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ia lum lang ia lade , bad to sngap ia phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ; bad sngap ia u Israel u kpa jong phi .

en: But I say unto you , that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom , than for that city .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi Bishar , U Blei un pyn-i shibun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa kata ka shnong !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ba kan kham shah ha kata ka sngi na ka bynta ka shnong .

en: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph , saying , Thy father did command before he died , saying ,
kha: Kumta ki phah khubor sha u Joseph da kaba ong ,  Shuwa ba i pa in ïap , i la bthah ïa ngi ban kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka jingleh kam sniew jong ngi ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah ia u nonglam khubor sha u Joseph, ki da ong: U kpa jong me u la hukum shuwa ba un iap da kaba ong:

en: For thou writest bitter things against me , and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .
kha: Me wanrah ïa ki jingujor bakthang pyrshah ïa nga , wat ïa kaba nga la leh mynba nga dang khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me thoh ia kiei kiei kiba sngewsih pyrshah ia nga , bad pynlong ia nga ban don ia ki jingbymhok jong ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth ? declare , if thou hast understanding .
kha: Hato me don hangta mynba nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ? Lada me tip haduh katta katta , to ïathuh ïa nga shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno me la don haba nga la buh ia ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ? pynbna lada me don ka jingsngewthuh .

en: We regret the inconvenience caused and are offering a compensation voucher as a goodwill gesture.
kha: Ngi sngewsih ïa ka jingbymsuk kaba la jia bad ngi ai snewgbha da ka voucher bai lutksan kum ka jingleh bha.
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewsih ia ka jingbymsuk kaba la wanrah bad ngi ai ia ka jingsiew bai lutksan kum ka jingleh kaba bha.

en: A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .
kha: U shakri kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam , kata ka long , ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba shisha ïa kaba U Trai u la pynïeng , ym da u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U myntri jong ka jaka kyntang , bad jong ka iingmane kaba shisha , kaba U Trai u la pynkhih , bad ym u briew .

en: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands , and upon the smooth of his neck :
kha: Ka buh ïa ki snieh jong kita ki blang ha ki kti bad ha ki bynta bym don shñiuh ha ka ryndang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la buh ia ki sniehdoh jong ki khun blang ha ki kti jong u , bad ha ka ryndang jong u:

en: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord  God  , the God of Israel .
kha: Lai sien shisnem , baroh ki shynrang ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem baroh ki khun shynrang jong phi kin paw ha khmat U Trai Blei , U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment , because he willingly walked after the commandment .
kha: Ki Israel kin shah ka jingshah banbeiñ ; ka la duh noh ïa ka khyndew kaba dei hok jong ka , namar ka ïai kwah ban wad jingïarap na kito ki bym don ei ei ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u la shah pynshitom bad shah pynpra ha ka jingbishar , namar u la iaid mon sngewbha hadien ka hukum .

en: My son , eat thou honey , because it is good  ; and the honeycomb , which is sweet to thy taste :
kha: Ko khun , bam ïa ka ngap , ka long kaba bha . Bad kumba ka ngap na ka rewngap ka long kaba thiang ha u thylliej jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong nga, to bam ia ka ngap, namar ka long kaba bha ; bad ka umsoh kaba thiang ha ka jingsngewtynnat jong me:

en: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?
kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kaba nga don ba ngan ïai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam don ka jingkyrmen ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka bor jong nga , ba nga dei ban kyrmen ? bad kaei ka jingkut jong nga , ba nga dei ban pynjlan ia ka jingim jong nga ?

en: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gift , or the altar that sanctifieth the gift ?
kha: A katno phi long kiba matlah ! Kaei kaba kham donkam , ka jingai sngewbha ne ka duwan kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka jingai sngewbha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi bieit bad matlah: namar la ka kham khraw ne ka jingaiei ne ka almari kaba pynkyntang ia ka jingaiei ?

en: And I will make Pathros desolate , and will set fire in Zoan , and will execute judgments in No .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt bashathie ban sah kynjah bad ngan tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah Soan ha ka phang shatei . Ngan pynshitom ïa ka nongbah Thebes .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ki Pathro ban jah rngai noh, bad ngan thang ding ha Zoan , bad ngan pyntreikam ia ki jingbishar ha No .

en: And Saul said unto his servants , Provide me now a man that can play well , and bring him to me .
kha: U Saul u hukum ïa ki ,  Pynïoh ïa nga u briew uba nang bha ban tem bad wan ïalam ïa u sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, To ai mynta ia nga ia u briew uba lah ban ialehkai bha bad wanrah ia u ha nga .

en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words : and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit .
kha: Uba sngewskhem ha lade um kren ha ki por baroh . Ki briew kiba long jai jai ki don ka jingïohi jngai da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka jingtip u pynim ia ki ktien jong u: bad u briew uba sngewthuh u long uba don ka mynsiem kaba bha tam .

en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .
kha: U Dabid u sah ha ri Philistia khathynriew bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka por ba u Dabid u la shong ha ka ri Philistia ka long shisnem bad saw bnai .

en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .
kha: Lada u briew u die mraw ïa la ka khun , kam lah ban ïoh laitluid kumba ki mraw shynrang ki ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u die ia ka khun jong u ban long ka shakri kynthei , kan ym leit shabar kumba ki shakri shynrang ki leit shabar .

en: And Bath–sheba bowed , and did obeisance unto the king . And the king said , What wouldest thou ?
kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon ha khmat u syiem , bad u ong ,  Pha kwah aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Bathsheba u la dem khrup bad u la kohnguh ia u syiem . Bad u syiem u la ong , Phi kwah aiu ?

en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .
kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la long lem bad ki , bad kiba bun ki briew ki la ngeit bad ki la phai sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kti U Trai ka la don ryngkat bad ki: bad u nombar uba bun u la ngeit bad u la phai sha U Trai .

en: Which when the brethren knew , they brought him down to Caesarea , and sent him forth to Tarsus .
kha: Haba ki parabangeit ki la tip shaphang kata , ki la ïalam ïa u Saul sha Kaisaria bad ki la phah noh ïa u sha Tarsos .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba haba ki para ki la tip, ki la wanrah ia u sha Kaisaria bad ki la phah ia u sha Tarsos .

en: And if Satan cast out Satan , he is divided against himself  ; how shall then his kingdom stand ?
kha: Kumta lada kawei ka kynhun ka ïaleh ïa kawei pat ka kynhun hapoh ka hima jong u Soitan , kane ka mut ba ka la da ïaphiah ha ki kynhun bad shen kan sa khyllem ha ka jingpra !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u Soitan u la bret noh ia u Soitan , u la shah phiah pyrshah ia lade ; kumno te ka hima jong u kan ieng ?

en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :
kha: Ho-oid , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat , nga la shem ïa kane khyndiat pa khyndiat katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , kane nga la shem , ong u nongialap , da kaba khein kawei hadien kawei pat:

en: And when we had launched from thence , we sailed under Cyprus , because the winds were contrary .
kha: Ngi la nang leit nangta , bad namar ba ka lyer ka beh pyrshah ïa ngi , ngi la ïaid sha ka liang ba kah lyer jong ka dewlynnong Sypros .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la sdang naduh hangta, ngi la leit shapoh Cyprus , namar ki Iyer ki long kiba pyrshah .

en: Some men s sins are open beforehand , going before to judgment ; and some men they follow after .
kha: Don ki briew kiba ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba paw tyngkreiñ , bad ki pop jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa jong ki sha ka jingbishar ; hynrei ki pop jong kiwei pat ki paw kham hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ki pop ki plie lypa, ki leit sha ka jingbishar ; bad katto katne ki briew ki bud hadien .

en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u wan ïalam ïa u Jakob u kpa jong u bad u pynithuh ïa u ha u syiem . U Jakob u kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la wanrah ia u kpa jong u, bad u la buh ia u ha khmat u Pharaoh: bad u Jakob u la kyrkhu ia u Pharaoh .

en: And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city : for God did vex them with all adversity .
kha: Kawei ka jaitbynriew ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , bad kawei ka nongbah ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka nongbah , namar U Blei u wanrah ka jingjynjar bad jingshitom ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jaitbynriew ka la shah pynjot ha ka jaitbynriew, bad ka shnong jong ka nongbah: namar U Blei u la pynsngewsih ia ki da ka jingeh baroh .

en: But if I live in the flesh , this is the fruit of my labour : yet what I shall choose I wot not .
kha: Hynrei , lada , da kaba nga lah ban leh shuh shuh ka kam kaba myntoi , te ngam thikna ïa kano nga dei ban jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada nga im ha ka doh , kane ka long ka soh jong ka jingtrei shitom jong nga: hynrei kaei kaba ngan jied ngam ju leh kumta .

en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .
kha: Kita ki saw ngut ki syiem ki la shim lut khoit kat kaba don ha Sodom bad Gomorrah , kaba kynthup ruh ïa ka jingbam bad ki la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki mar ki mata jong ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah bad ki jingbam jong ki baroh bad ki la leit noh .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .
kha: Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ki briew kiba mutlop kim don ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingstad bad ki kyntait ban shah hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka jingsdang jong ka jingtip: hynrei ki bieit ki pynjah burom ia ka jingstad bad jinghikai .

en: Wherein I suffer trouble , as an evil doer , even unto bonds ; but the word of God is not bound .
kha: Namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , nga shahshitom bad nga shah teh kynjri ruh kum u riewrunar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba nga shah shitom, kum u nongleh bymman, wat haduh ki jingteh ; hynrei ka ktien U Blei kam shah teh .

en: Better is a dry morsel , and quietness therewith , than an house full of sacrifices with strife .
kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ïa u kpu ba la tyrkhong lem bad ka jingsuk mynsiem ban ïa kaba bam khawai ha ka ïing kaba dap da ki jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ka jingbam kaba rkhiang, bad ka jingsngap jar bad kata, ban ia ka iing kaba dap da ki jingknia bad ka jingialeh .

en: So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .
kha: Kumta te , kiei kiei baroh ki shong , ym ha kaei kaba u briew u kwah ne u leh , hynrei tang ha ka jingisynei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta te kam dei na uta uba mon, ne na uta uba mareh, hynrei na U Blei uba pyni ia ka jingisynei .

en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea , they supposed it had been a spirit , and cried out :
kha: hynrei ki la ïohi ïa u ba u ïaid halor ka um .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la pyrkhat , bad ki la lynñiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la iohi ia u ba u iaid halor ka duriaw, ki la pyrkhat ba ka la long ka mynsiem, bad ki la pyrta:

en: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .
kha: Katba u Petros u dang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynduh ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la nguh dem ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u dang wan rung, u Kornellius u la iakynduh ia u bad u la dem ha ki kjat jong u bad u la mane ia u .

en: And he said ,  Of a truth I say unto you , that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all :
kha: U la ong ,  Nga ong ha phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk ka la thep kham bun shah ban ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Na ka jingshisha nga ong ha phi , ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk ka la bret kham bun ban ia ki baroh:

en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
kha: bad baroh kin pynbna shynna ba U Jisu Khrist u long U Trai , ïa ka burom U Blei uba U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba kawei pa kawei ka thylliej kan phla ba U Jisu Khrist U long U Trai , ha ka burom U Blei U Kpa .

en: Where is boasting then ? It is excluded . By what law ? of works ? Nay : but by the law of faith .
kha: Ïa kaei te , ngi lah ban sngewsarong ? Yn don ei ei! Bad kaei ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Hato ka dei ba ngi kohnguh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , hynrei ka dei ïa kata kaba ngi ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ka long kaba sngew sarong te ? La kyntait ia ka . Da kano ka ain ? jong ki kam ? Em: hynrei da ka ain jong ka jingngeit .

en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations , and their countries ,
kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A  Trai  , ba ki patsha ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , bad pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki , ki bym don briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jingshisha , ko Trai , ki syiem Assyria ki la pynjot ia ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad ki ri jong ki , .

en: A good name is better than precious ointment  ; and the day of death than the day of one s birth .
kha: Ka nam kaba bha ka kham kor ban ïa ka jingiwbih baremdor , bad ka sngi kaba phi ïap ka kham bha ban ïa ka sngi ha kaba la kha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng kaba bha ka kham bha ban ia ka umphniang kaba kordor ; bad ka sngi iap ban ia ka sngi kha jong uwei .

en: Thou gavest me no kiss : but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet .
kha: Mem shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga da ka jingdoh , hynrei kam shym la sangeh ban doh ïa ki kjat jong nga naduh ba nga la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ai ia nga ia ka jingkyndit: hynrei kane ka kynthei naduh ka por ba nga wan rung kam shym la sangeh ban kdup ia ki kjat jong nga .

en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :
kha: U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban long kiba khuid bad kiba lait phar na ka jingjakhlia ka jingawria .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka mon U Blei, wat ka jingpynkhuid jong phi, ba phin kiar na ka jingleh be-ijot:

en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
kha: U Nathan u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kat kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum kine ki ktien baroh , bad kat kum kane ka jingphohsniew baroh , kumta u Nathan u la kren ha u Dabid .

en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name s sake , that he might make his mighty power to be known .
kha: Hynrei u la pynim ïa ki , kumba u la kular , khnang ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u la pynim ia ki na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u , ba un pynlong ia ka bor ba khraw jong u ban tip .

en: Withhold not correction from the child : for if thou beatest him with the rod , he shall not die .
kha: Wat pyntud ban sneng pynbeit ïa u khynnah . Ka jingsympat kaba dei kan ym pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym pynbeit ia u khynnah: namar lada me shoh ia u da u diengduh , un ym iap .

en: Then Simon Peter answered him , Lord , to whom shall we go ? thou hast the words of eternal life .
kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ko Trai , sha uno pat ngin leit ? Me don ki ktien kiba ai ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Simon Petros u la jubab ia u, ko Trai, shano ngin leit ? me don ki ktien jong ka jingim bymjukut .

en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .
kha: U Jotham u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don sanphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem .

en: And as we tarried there many days , there came down from Judaea a certain prophet , named Agabus .
kha: Ngi la don hangta bun sngi mynba u nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Agabos u la wan poi na Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ngi dang sah hangta bun sngi, la wan hiar na Judaea uwei u nongiathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Agabus .

en: The rich man shall lie down , but he shall not be gathered : he openeth his eyes , and he is not .
kha: Tang shisien khatduh ïawai , kin thiah kum kiba riewspah , hynrei ynda ki kyndit na kaba ïohthiah , kin shem ba baroh ka spah jong ki kam don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U riewspah un thiah , hynrei un ym shah lum: u plie ia ki khmat jong u bad um long kumta .

en: And Isaiah said , Take a lump of figs . And they took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .
kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ha kiba synran ïa u syiem ban tah ha u tohjaw da i symboh ba la shna na ki soh Dumbur , bad un ïohkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah u la ong, Shim ia ka lum ki sohjew . Ki la shim bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka um kaba rkhiang bad u la koit .

en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .
kha: Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Damaskos da ka ding bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan thang ia ka ding ha ka kynroh jong ka Damaskos bad kan bam ia ki iing jong u Benhadad .

en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .
kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah , u jop ïa ki Edom ha ka Them Mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajar ngut na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Abisai u khun u Seruiah u la pyniap ia ki nong Edome ha ka them ka umsoh shiphew hajar .

en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
kha: Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewieit ban nguid tylli ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u nongrah khana ki long kum ki jingmynsaw , bad ki hiar shapoh ki bynta ba shapoh tam jong ka kpoh .

en: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u long uba hok ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi tip ba u long uba hok , phi tip ba uwei pa uwei uba leh ia ka hok u la kha na u .

en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat , and cockle instead of barley . The words of Job are ended .
kha: nangta ha ka jaka u kew bad u barli , to ai ba ki ñiut bad ki shiah kin mih . Ki ktien u Job ki kut hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki thliew kin san ha ka jaka u kew , bad ki khnai ha ka jaka u kew . Ki ktien u Job ki la kut noh .

en: And if ye salute your brethren only , what do ye more than others ? do not even the publicans so ?
kha: Bad lada phi kren tang ïa ki paralok jong phi , hato phi lah leh ïa kaei kaei kaba kham pher ? Wat kiba mane blei thala ki leh ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi kren ia ki hynmen jong phi tang , kaei kaba phi kham bun ban ia kiwei pat ? wat ki nongpynbna ruh kumta ?

en: And the king went forth , and all the people after him , and tarried in a place that was far off .
kha: Katba u syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , ki la sangeh ha ka ïing kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit noh bad ki briew baroh hadien jong u bad u la sah ha ka jaka kaba jngai .

en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .
kha: Bad mynta , u lah ban ïarap ïa kita kiba shah pynshoi , namar ma u hi u la shah pynshoi bad shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ma u hi u la shah pynshoi , u lah ban iarap ia kito kiba shah pynshoi .

en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
kha: da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun Israel kiba shong ha ki shnong Judah , u Rehoboam u la synshar halor jong ki .

en: I will heal their backsliding , I will love them freely : for mine anger is turned away from him .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ngan wanlam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha lade . Ngan ieit ïa ki da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ; ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkoit ia ka jingkylla jong ki, ngan ieit ia ki da kaba laitluid: namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka la kylla noh na u .

en: Now therefore up by night , thou and the people that is with thee , and lie in wait in the field :
kha: Mynta te , ma phi lem bad ki rangbah jong phi phin ïaid da miet bad rieh ha ki lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta mynta mynta mynmiet, ma me bad ki briew kiba don bad me, bad to thiah ha lyngkha:

en: The earth is utterly broken down , the earth is clean dissolved , the earth is moved exceedingly .
kha: Ka pyrthei kan orpait bad kan kad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong lut , ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong , ka khyndew ka la khih palat .

en: To deliver thee from the strange woman , even from the stranger which flattereth with her words  ;
kha: Phi lah ban pyllait ïa lade na kano kano ka kynthei awria kaba pyrshang ban pynngop ïa phi da ki ktien jali ja-um jong ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyllait ia me na ka kynthei nongwei, wat na u nongwei uba sngewtynnad ia ki ktien jong ka;

en: And they asked Baruch , saying , Tell us now , How didst thou write all these words at his mouth ?
kha: Nangta ki la ong ïa u ,  Ïathuh ha ngi , mynta , kumno phi la poi thoh ïa kane baroh ? Hato u Jeremaïah u la ong ïa ka ha phi ban thoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u Baruk da kaba ong: Iathuh ia ngi mynta , Kumno me la thoh ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ka shyntur jong u ?

en: Jesus and the 144 ,000 form a righteous heavenly government —God’s Kingdom . —Revelation 14 :1-3 .
kha: U Jisu lem bad ki 1 ,44 ,000 ngut kin seng ïa ka hima ha bneng . Kata ka dei ka Hima jong U Blei .—Jingpynpaw 14 :1-3 .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu bad ka 144 ,000 ki pynlong ia ka sorkar bneng kaba hok God ]. Ka Jingpynpaw 14 :1-3 .

en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God :
kha: Hynrei phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phim treh ban leit rung sha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la phin ym kiew shaneng , hynrei phi la leh pyrshah ia ka hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi:

en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul  ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .
kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum U Blei bad phin im slem ; lada phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , phin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba sumar ia ka hukum u sumar ia la ka jong ka mynsiem ; hynrei uta uba lehbein ia ki lynti jong u un iap .

en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
kha: Ngan sa wan sha phi hadien ba nga la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — naba nga dei ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngan wan sha phi haba ngan iaid lyngba ka Makedonia: namar nga iaid lyngba ka Makedonia .

en: Joseph is a fruitful bough , even a fruitful bough by a well  ; whose branches run over the wall :
kha: U Joseph u long kum u kada khlaw harud ka umpohliew u khun kada khlaw ha sharing lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u long u tnat uba jyrngam , wat u tnat uba jyrngam da ka thliew ; ki tnat jong u ki iaid halor ka jingkhang:

en: And the people cried unto Moses  ; and when Moses prayed unto the  Lord  , the fire was quenched .
kha: Kita ki paidbah ki la kyang ha u Moses ban ïarap ; u la duwai ha U  Trai  , bad ka ding ka la lip noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la pyrta ha u Moses bad haba u Moses u la duwai ha U Trai , ka ding ka la jah noh .

en: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .
kha: U Judas u la mynjur ïa kata bad u la sdang ban khmih ïa ka kabu kaba biang ban aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki khlem ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kular , bad u la wad lad ban pyndem ia u ha ki ha ka jingbym don u paidbah .

en: Which made heaven , and earth , the sea , and all that therein is : which keepeth truth for ever :
kha: U Nongthaw jong ka bneng , ka pyrthei bad ka duriaw , bad baroh kiba don ha ki . U bat ïa ki jingkular jong u borabor ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew, ka duriaw bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka: kaba bat ia ka jingshisha junom:

en: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .
kha: Iehnoh ïa kaba sniew bad ka bymdei na ka ïing jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka jingbymhok ka don ha ka kti jong me, to buh ia ka sha jngai, bad wat ai ba ka jingsniew kan shong ha ki iing jong me .

en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh , and might save some of them .
kha: Lehse , nga lah ban pynlong ïa ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong nga hi ban sngewbishni , ba kumta yn lah ban pynim katto katne na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada da kano kano ka lad nga lah ban pynmih ia ki kiba long ka doh jong nga , bad nga lah ban pynim katto katne na ki .

en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel , and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat ?
kha: Balei ka jaiñkup jong u ka saw palat , kum ka jong u briew uba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ban shna waiñ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata me rong saw ha ka jain jong me bad ki jain jong me kum uta uba iaid ha ka jaka dih wain ?

en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour  ; they fell down , and there was none to help .
kha: Ki la duh bor noh na ka jingtrei shitom ; kumba kin kyllon noh , bad ym don ba ïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la pynhiar ia ka dohnud jong ki da ka jingtrei shitom; ki la hap noh , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban iarap .

en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .
kha: Ha ka hukum jong U Blei kiei kiei kiba khraw ki jia , kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba ngim lah ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u rkhie bein da ka sur jong u; kiei kiei kiba khraw ki leh ia u , kiba ngim lah ban sngewthuh .

en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .
kha: Nangta katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la kren ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  hukum ïa ki synran jong me ban sngap jar !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, to pynrem ia ki synran jong me .

en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you , and ye shall afflict your souls , by a statute for ever .
kha: Kata ka sngi ka dei ban long ka sngi kaba khuid bha , ka sngi ha kaba ki shahjingit bad kim trei ïa kano kano ka kam . Kine ki dei ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ban rakhe pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan long ka Sabha jong ka jingjahthait ha phi , bad phin pynshitom ia ki mynsiem jong phi da ka ain junom .

en: And when Jesus was come into Peter s house , he saw his wife s mother laid , and sick of a fever .
kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Petros bad hangta u la ïohi ïa ka kiaw kurim u Petros ba ka thiah pang lem bad ka jingshit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la wan shapoh iing u Petros, u la iohi ia ka kmie jong u kaba la thiah bad kaba pang shit .

en: The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool ?
kha: ‘ U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga : To shong hangne ha ka liang ka mon jong nga tad haduh ba ngan buh ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga , To shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga , haduh ba ngan da pynlong ia ki nongshun jong me ha ka kjat jong me ?

en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :
kha: Ïa ki katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sympat , bad ïa kiwei pat la teh ha ki kynjri bad la set phatok ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki la shah tynjuh ha ki jingleh bein bad ki jingkren bein kiba shyrkhei, hooid, nalor ki jingiadei bad ka jingshah set phatok:

en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?
kha: Hynrei ym baroh ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Babha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong ,  A Trai , uei uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh baroh ia ka gospel . Na ka bynta u Isaiah u ong , ko Trai , uba la ngeit ia ka khubor jong ngi ?

en: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the  Lord   ; and they prepared them ,
kha: Ha ki hukum ki jong u syiem ki pynkhreh ha ka jaka jong ka Templ ïa ki kamra buh jingbuh
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hesekaiah u la hukum ban pynkhreh ia ki kamra ha iing U Trai ; bad ki la pynkhreh ia ki .

en: Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,
kha: Uta u Basniew un wan ha ka bor u Soitan bad un leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bakla ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ma u ruh uba wan hadien ka jingtrei jong u Soitan da ka bor bad ki dak bad ki jingphylla kiba thok baroh .

en: It is sown in dishonour ; it is raised in glory : it is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power :
kha: Haba la tep , ka long kaba ijli bad kaba tlot ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long kaba itynnat bad kaba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: La bet ia ka ha ka jingbym don burom ; la pynkiew ia ka ha ka burom : la bet ia ka ha ka jingtlot ; la pynkiew ia ka ha ka bor:

en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
kha: Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki don arngut ki nongtuh kiba la sahnarphna bad u, uwei ha ka liang kadiang bad uwei pat ha ka liang kadiang .

en: Hear  ; for I will speak of excellent things  ; and the opening of my lips shall be right things .
kha: Shahshkor ïa ki ktien donburom tam jong nga , baroh kaba nga kren ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngap jar namar ngan kren ia kiei kiei kiba bha ; bad ka jingplie ia ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kan long kiei kiei kiba dei .

en: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gold , or the temple that sanctifieth the gold ?
kha: Ko ki bieit bamatlah ! Kano kaba kham donkam , ka ksiar lane ka Templ kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka ksiar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi bieit bad matlah: namar hato ka kham khraw, ka ksiar ne ka tempi kaba pynkyntang ia ka ksiar ?

en: Neither shall he go in to any dead body , nor defile himself for his father , or for his mother  ;
kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba leit sha jan ka metïap , wat la ka dei ka jong u kpa ne ka kmie jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym leit sha kano kano ka met iap, lymne un ym pynjakhlia ia lade na ka bynta u kpa jong u, ne na ka bynta ka kmie jong u ; .

en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth , and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven ?
kha: Kim phai sha U Blei , uba pynlong ïa ngi kiba stad , kham stad ban ïa u mrad ne ka sim .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba hikai ia ngi kham bun ban ia ki mrad jong ka khyndew , bad u pynlong ia ngi kham stad ban ia ki sim bneng ?

en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .
kha: Namar ba ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel ki tam arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut ïa ki Lebi , phi dei ban pyllait pat ïa kine ki khun shynrang kiba tam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kito kiba la khein ia ki hadien ki longiing jong ki ruh ki long lai hajar arspah .

en: Moreover , brethren , we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia ;
kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong ngi , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa kaei kaba ka jingaiei U Blei ka la pynpaw ha ki balang ha Makedonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, ko para bangeit , ngi leh ia phi ban sngewthuh ia ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la ai ha ki balang Makedonia ; .

en: And Absalom , and all the people the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .
kha: U Absalom bad baroh ki Israel baroh lem bad u ki rung sha Jerusalem , bad u Ahithophel u la don ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom bad ki briew baroh ki Israel ki la wan sha Jerusalem bad u Ahitoh bad u .

en: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .
kha: Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , nga ïarap ïa ki ; nga ai jingïarap ïa ki khunswet ki bym don lad shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la pynpoi ia kiba duk kiba iam, bad ki bym don kpa bad ia uta u bym don jingiarap ia u .

en: Peter said unto him , Lord , why cannot I follow thee now ? I will lay down my life for thy sake .
kha: Ko Trai , balei ngam lah ban bud ïa me mynta ?  u Petros u la kylli .  Nga kloi ban ïap na ka bynta jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la ong ha u, ko Trai, balei ngam lah ban bud ia me mynta ? Ngan aiti ia ka jingim jong nga na ka bynta jong me .

en: And the king said unto him , Turn aside , and stand here . And he turned aside , and stood still .
kha: Ïeng hangto ,  u syiem u ong ha u ; bad u la leit shajrong bad ïeng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u, To phai noh shawei bad ieng hangne . U la phai noh bad u la ieng sahkut .

en: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
kha: Kumba shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai bad rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Blei bad kiwei pat ki koidi ki dang shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por shiteng miet u Paul bad u Silas ki la duwai bad ki la rwai iaroh ia U Blei : bad ki koidi ki la iohsngew ia ki .

en: The water from this stream was used for agriculture and all other domestic uses by the villagers .
kha: Ia ka um na kane ka wah la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka rep ka riang bad kiwei kiwei ki jingpyndonkam ha iing da ki nongshong shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka um na kane ka wah la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka rep ka riang bad kiwei kiwei ki jingpyndonkam ha iing da ki nongshong shnong .

en: Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong biang ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Nga long ka jingkhang jong ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong biang ha ki: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, nga long ka jingkhang jong ki langbrot .

en: I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .
kha: Nga buh ki mawlynnai ha pha — ki khadu bad ki kpieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynitynnad ia me ruh da ki jingpynitynnad, bad nga la buh ia ki brace ha ki kti jong me, bad ka kynjri ha ka ryndang jong me .

en: I am here to offer my thanks for the President ' s address in the joint sitting of both the Houses
kha: Nga wan hangne ​​ban ai ka jingkhublei ia ka jingkren jong u President ha ka jingiashong dorbar lang jong baroh ar tylli ki iing dorbar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga don hangne ban ai khublei ia ka jingkren jong u President ha ka jingialang lang jong baroh ar tylli ki iing .

en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries : and the land of Egypt shall not escape .
kha: Haba u hiarthma ïa kito ki ri baroh , wat ïa ka Ijipt ruh yn ym ieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynkhih ia la ka kti ruh halor ki ri: bad ka ri Ijipt kan ym lait .

en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
kha: Ka jinglorni ka long kaba bang bha ; a katno ngi ieit ban nguid ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u nongrah khana ki long kum ki jingmynsaw , bad ki hiar shapoh ki bynta ba shapoh tam jong ka kpoh .

en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh , and Betonim  ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir  ;
kha: ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Heshbon haduh Ramath Mispeh bad Betonim , naduh Mahanaim haduh ka khappud jong ka Lodebar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh Heshbon haduh Ramathmizpeh, bad u Betonim ; bad na Mahanaim haduh u pud u sam jong ka Debir ; .

en: Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .
kha: Wat ïathuh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ha Gath shaphang ka jingshahjop jong ngi ; wat ai ba kin ïohi ba phi ïam . Ko ki briew ka Beth Leaphrah , pyn-i ïa ka jinglyng-a jong phi da kaba kyrsum ha u pui pui !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia ka ha Gath , wat iam satia: ha ka iing u Aphrah u pynkhih ia lade ha ka dewbilat .

en: The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection , and asked him ,
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi don na ki Saddusi ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kam ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi ki Sadusi ki la wan sha u ki Sadusi kiba ong ba ym don jingmihpat bad ki la kylli ia u .

en: Drink no longer water , but use a little wine for thy stomach s sake and thine often infirmities .
kha: Wat dih tang ïa ka um , hynrei shim khyndiat ka waiñ ban ïarap ïa ka  nierbah jong me , naba me long uba pang khah khah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat dih shuh ia ka um , hynrei pyndonkam khyndiat ka wain na ka bynta ka kpoh jong me bad bunsien ka jingduna ha ka kpoh jong me .

en: For it is written , that Abraham had two sons , the one by a bondmaid , the other by a freewoman .
kha: Ka ong ba u Abraham u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , uwei na ka kynthei mraw bad uwei pat na ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh ba u Abraham u don arngut ki khun shynrang, uwei pat da u nongtrei ba laitluid .

en: The east wind carrieth him away , and he departeth : and as a storm hurleth him out of his place .
kha: ka lyer mihngi kan sar ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Iyer mihngi ka rah noh ia u: bad kum ka eriong ka pynkhih ia u na ka jaka jong u .

en: Who is made , not after the law of a carnal commandment , but after the power of an endless life .
kha: U la long u lyngdoh , ym da ki jingbuhbeit ryntih bad jingpynïaid ba kynja briew , hynrei lyngba ka bor jong ka jingim kaba ym don jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la pynlong , ym hadien ka ain jong ka hukum kaba kynja doh , hynrei hadien ka bor jong ka jingim kaba khlem kut .

en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
kha: Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , hynrei U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kmie ki kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh: hynrei u la kynnoh ia ki ba kim dei ban iathuh iano iano ruh ia kaei kaba la leh .

en: Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .
kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u da ka jingshad ; to tem ki ksing bad ki duitara ha ka jingïaroh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin iaroh ia ka kyrteng jong u ha ka shad: ai ba kin rwai iaroh ia u da ka timbrel bad ka harp .

en: For decades , Jehovah’s Witnesses used , printed , and distributed various versions of the Bible .
kha: Da ki phew snem , ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki la pyndonkam , ki la shon bad ki la sam ïa ki Baibl bapher bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki phew snem, ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki la pyndonkam , la shon bad la sam ia ki version bapher bapher jong ka Baibl .

en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
kha: Lada u tang shu mon bad pynïap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ba kan pynsngewbha ia U Blei ban pynjot ia nga ; ba un pyllait noh ia ka kti jong u , bad ot noh ia nga !

en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban leh ia ki jingbishar jong nga, bad to sumar ia ki jinglong jong nga, ban iaid ha ka: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba la lah kren ha nga ba u jam sha khmat bad ba uwei pat u angel u la wan ban ïashem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uta u angel uba la kren bad nga u la leit noh bad uwei pat u angel u la mih ban iakynduh ia u .

en: Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word  ;
kha: Nga duwai ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei na ka bynta kito ruh kiba ngeit ha nga namar ka khubor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam duwai na ka bynta kine marwei , hynrei na ka bynta jong ki ruh kiba ngeit ha nga lyngba ka ktien jong ki;

en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .
kha: Ngi la jam ïa ka duriaw da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Kilikia bad Pamphylia , bad ngi la poi sha Mura , ha Lukia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la iaid lyngba ia ka duriaw Cilicia bad ka Pamphylia , ngi la poi ha Myra , ka shnong Lycia .

en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning , and expounded it by order unto them , saying ,
kha: Kumta u Petros u la ai ha ki ka jingïathuh bniah ïa kaei kaba la jia naduh kaba sdang hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la pynkhreh ia kata naduh kaba sdang, bad u la batai ia ka da kaba pynbeit ha ki da kaba ong:

en: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha , which is , being interpreted , The place of a skull .
kha: Ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi Khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wanrah ia u ha ka jaka Golgotha, kaba la pynkylla ktien , Ka jaka jong ka khlieh .

en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
kha: hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . Bynrap sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka cassia san spah Shekel, hadien ka Shekel jong ka jaka kyntang, bad ka umphniang olive ka hin:

en: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men , and went to the Ammonites .
kha: Hynrei u Ishmael bad phra ngut na ki briew jong u ki la kynriah na u Johanan bad phet sha ka ri ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah u la lait na u Johanan ryngkat bad ki 8 ngut ki briew bad u la leit sha ki Ammon .

en: Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .
kha: Weng noh ïa ki nongai jingmut bymman na khmat u syiem , bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u yn tip na ka bynta ka ïingbishar hok jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia kiba sniew na khmat u syiem , bad ka khet jong u kan long kaba skhem ha ka hok .

en: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi wat ki shipai bashlur tam kin pynhap ïa la ki tiar ïapom bad kin mareh .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba shlur napdeng kiba khlain bor un phet noh lyngkhuid ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai .

en: Give me understanding , and I shall keep thy law  ; yea , I shall observe it with my whole heart .
kha: To batai ïa ka aiñ jong me ha nga , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ka ; ngan sumar ïa ka da ka dohnud jong nga baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia nga ka jingsngewthuh, bad ngan sumar ia ka hukum jong me ; yea , ngan sumar ia ka da ka dohnud baroh .

en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son s hand , and will give it unto thee , even ten tribes .
kha: Ngan knieh ïa ka hima na u khun jong u Solomon bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan shim ia ka hima na ka kti jong u khun jong u, bad ngan ai ia ka ha me, wat shiphew jait .

en: His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .
kha: Kin khie im da ka jingsan bathymmai , bad kin itynnat kum ki dieng Olib . Kin iwbih kum ki dieng Kedar ka Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tnat jong u kin saphriang bad ka jingitynnad jong u kan long kum u dieng olive bad ka jingsma jong u kum u Lebanon .

en: And it came to pass at the end of seven days , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Hadien ba la kut kita ki hynñiew sngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kaba kut jong ki hynriew sngi , ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: ( Psalm 122 :1 ) This also creates a favorable impression in the community . —2 Corinthians 6 :3 .
kha: ( Salm 122 :1 ) Ka shnong ka thaw ka ïaroh ïa kane . —2 Korinth 6 :3 .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Salm 122:1 ) Kane ka pynmih ruh ia ka jingsngew kaba bha ha ka imlang sahlang . 2 Korinth 6:3, .

en: How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me ?
kha: Slem sa katno nga dei ban ap ? Lano men pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno tylli ki sngi jong u shakri jong me ? haba me pyndep ia ka jingbishar halor jong ki kiba pynshitom bein ia nga ?

en: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .
