kha: Nga la sheptieng , kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! Kane hangne ka long kaba dei ka jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la tieng, bad nga la leit buhrieh ia ka sap jong me ha ka khyndew: ha kata ka jaka me don ia kata ka jong me .

en: For this is thankworthy , if a man for conscience toward God endure grief , suffering wrongfully .
kha: U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi na ka bynta kane , lada phi ïaishah ïa ka jingpang na ka jingshahshitom bymdei hok namar phi tip ïa ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long kaba donkam , lada u briew uba don ka jingsngewthuh sha U Blei u shah ia ka jingsngewsih , u shah shitom bakla .

en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .
kha: Me buh ïa u pud ba kim lah ban jam palat , ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym tap biang ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la buh pud ba kin ym iaid lait ia ka ; ba kin ym phai shuh ban tap ia ka khyndew .

en: So David s young men turned their way , and went again , and came and told him all those sayings .
kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki leit phai noh bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Nabal u la lah ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki samla u Dabid ki la phai biang, bad ki la leit phai biang, bad ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ia u ia kita ki jingkren baroh .

en: For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .
kha: Ngam shemphang kaei kaba nga leh ; namar ngam leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ban leh , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa kaei kaba nga isih .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kata kaba nga leh ngam shah: na ka bynta kaei kaba nga kwah, kata ngam ju leh; hynrei ia kaba nga shun, kata nga leh .

en: But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad bret ïa ka sha ki ksew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong , Kam long kaba iadei bad ka jingshim ia u kpu jong ki khynnah bad ban bret ia u ha ki kulai .

en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ngan ap ha ka jaka jam ïa ka wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba ngan da ïoh khubor na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit , ngan sah ha ka madan jong ka ri khlaw , haduh ba kan da wan ka ktien na phi ban pynshisha ia nga .

en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , shall be upon thee , O inhabitant of Moab , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingshyrkhei , ki liewlep , bad ki jingriam ki ap ïa ki briew ka Moab . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng, bad ka thliew, bad ka snare, kan long halor jong me, ko nongshong shnong jong ka Moab , ong U Trai .

en: And Saul saw and knew that the  Lord  was with David , and that Michal Saul s daughter loved him .
kha: U Saul u sngewthuh shai ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid bad ba ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ka ieit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la iohi bad u la tip ba U Trai u don bad u Dabid bad ba ka khun jong u Michal ka ieit ia u .

en: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities : but fear thou God .
kha: Kam pher haduh katno phi phohsniew , haduh katno phi trei ïa ka kam bymmyntoi , lane haduh katno phi kren , phi dei ban ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka jingbun ki jingphohsniew bad bun ki kyntien ki don ruh ki jingpher: hynrei to sheptieng ia U Blei .

en: Ye shall do no servile work therein : but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leh ia ka kam kaba rit ha ka: hynrei phin ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: He , however , said a final decision would be taken only after getting views of all stakeholders .
kha: Hynrei u la ong ba ia ka rai kaba khatduh yn shim tang hadien ba la ioh ia ka jingai jingmut na baroh ki nongshim bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ba yn shim ia ka rai kaba khatduh tang hadien ba la ioh ia ki jingmut jong baroh ki nongshim bynta .

en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
kha: Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bynta ki hajar ki pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kynmaw ia ka jutang jong u junom , ka ktien kaba u la hukum ha ki hajar pateng .

en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
kha: U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum kine ki ktien baroh , bad kat kum kane ka jingphohsniew baroh , kumta u Nathan u la kren ha u Dabid .

en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin sumar ia ki ain jong nga baroh bad ki jingbishar jong nga baroh: Nga long U Trai .

en: But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .
kha: hynrei lada ka wan na U Blei , phim lah ban jop ïa ki . Phi lah ban shem ïa lade kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !  Ka Dorbar ka la kohnguh ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Gamaliel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka long na U Blei , phim lah ban pynhap ia ka ; ioh lehse la shem wat ia phi wat ban ialeh pyrshah ia U Blei .

en: His mother Bibi Khadija was said to be a descendant of the Turkic Sufi saint Khwaja Ahmed Yasawi .
kha: La ong ba ka kmie jong u ka Bibi Khadija ka dei ka khun jong u riewkhuid Turki Sufi u Khwaja Ahmed Yasawi .
translated_en_to_kha: La ong ba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka khun jong u riewkhuid jong ka Turkic Sufi u Khwaja Ahmed Yasawi .

en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast : seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan , ka sngi ha kaba ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba neh hynñiew sngi ka sdang ; ha kata ka por dei ban bam tang ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai ka long ka jingkhawai: hynriew sngi yn bam ia u kpu khlem thied .

en: Now a certain man was sick , named Lazarus , of Bethany , the town of Mary and her sister Martha .
kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Lasaros , uba sah ha Bethania , u la pang . Ka Bethania ka dei ka shnong ha kaba ka Mari bad ka Martha ka para jong ka , ki shong ki sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uwei u briew uba pang, uba kyrteng u Lasaros, na Bethania, ka shnong ka Maria bad ka para jong ka ka Martha .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God .
kha: Balei me khot babha ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ym don uba bha lait noh tang U Blei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Balei me khot ia nga uba bha ? ym don ba bha hynrei tang uwei, kata ka long U Blei .

en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple , and departed , and went and hanged himself .
kha: U Judas u la bret ïa ki sbai rupa ha madan hapoh ka Templ bad u la mihnoh ; nangta u la leit bad u la sdien phasi ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret ia ki rupa ha ka tempi bad u la leit noh bad u la sahkut ha lade .

en: Next Abraham  " made his way from encampment to encampment out of the Negeb and to Bethel . " " "
kha: Hadien kata U Abraham  " u la iaid na kawei ka jaka sah sha kawei pat na ka Negeb bad sha Bethel . " " "
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u Abraham u la iaid lynti na ka jaka sah sha ka jaka sah na Negeb bad sha Bethel . "

en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul , that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth .
kha: Nalorkata Nga ñiew ïa U Blei kum u sakhi jong nga — u tip ïa ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka long na ka bynta ban ïada ïa phi ba nga la rai ban ym leit sha Korinth .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata nga khot ia U Blei na ka bynta ka jingthoh ha ka mynsiem jong nga , ba ban pyllait im ia phi ngam pat poi haduh mynta sha Korinth .

en: Know ye not , that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death ?
kha: Naba phi tip shai ba haba la pynbaptis ïa ngi ha U Khrist Jisu , la pynbaptis ïa ngi ha ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip , ba bun na ngi kumba la pynbaptis ha U Jisu Khrist la pynbaptis ia ngi ha ka jingiap jong u ?

en: And his concubine that was in Shechem , she also bare him a son , whose name he called Abimelech .
kha: U don ruh kawei ka tnga kliar ha Shekhem ; ka la kha uwei u khun na u bad u ai kyrteng ïa u , u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynthei jong u kaba don ha Shehem, ka la kha ruh ia u khun shynrang, uba u la khot u Abimelech .

en: As the truth of Christ is in me , no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia .
kha: Da ka jingshisha U Khrist kaba don ha nga , nga kular ba ïa kane ka jingsngew sarong jong nga yn ym pynsngap jar hangno hangno ha Akhaïa baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka jingshisha U Khrist ka don ha nga , ym don mano mano ruh ban khang ia nga na kane ka jingsarong ha ki thain Akhaia .

en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;
kha: Don ki ban pyndonkam da ka ksiar ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka nongrim ; kiwei pat kin pyndonkam da ka dieng ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada uno uno u briew u tei halor kane ka nongrim ksiar, rupa, ki maw ba kordor, ki dieng, ki sboh, ki sboh ; .

en: And they truly were many priests , because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death :
kha: Ka don sa kawei pat ka jingïapher : ki la don bun na kito kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , namar ki la ïap bad kim shym lah shuh ban bteng ïa la ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la long shisha kiba bun ki lyngdoh , namar kim shym la shah shitom ban bteng namar ka jingiap:

en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish , and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts .
kha: Ka kyiad ka long ïa ki briew kiba la jan ïap , ïa kito kiba shem jynjar sat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ka jingdih kaba khlain ha uta uba la pynkhreh ban jah noh , bad ka wain ha kito kiba don ki dohnud kiba khia .

en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban shong dara ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ shaphang mihngi . Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam niam baroh kiba dei ban pyndep ha ka Jaka Kyntang na ka bynta ki Israel . Uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la khein ia ki da ki longiing jong ki ki long ar hajar hynriew spah sanphew .

en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots , even white bright spots  ;
kha: Haba u briew ne ka briew ki don ki dak thohlieh ha ka sniehdoh jong ki , u lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u shynrang ruh ne ka kynthei ki don ha ka sniehdoh jong ki shyieng kiba shai bha, wat ki shyieng kiba lieh kiba shai bha;

en: Israel is swallowed up : now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure .
kha: Ki Israel kin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad kin long ki bymlarkam kum u khra ba la pait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Israel ka la shah rong noh: mynta kin long hapdeng ki Jutang kum ka lieng ha kaba ym don jingsngewbha .

en: And when he had begun to reckon , one was brought unto him , which owed him ten thousand talents .
kha: U la dang shu sdang ban leh kumta haba la wallam ïa uwei uba la kit ram bun tyngka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la sdang ban khein , la wanrah ia uwei ha u , uba donkam ia u shi hajar talent .

en: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
kha: U Abraham u la dap khyndaiphew khyndai snem mynba la otsher ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la dap hynniewphew snem ka rta bad hynniew snem ka rta, haba u la shah ot ha ka doh jong u .

en: The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la smai ,  Ngan ym klet lano lano ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la smai da ka jingbha jong u Jakob , Hooid ngan ym klet ia ki kam jong ki .

en: It shall devour the strength of his skin : even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength .
kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka par baroh kawei ka met jong u bad ka pynlong ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ban pyut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan bam ia ka bor jong ka sniehdoh jong u: wat u khun nyngkong jong u un bam ia ka bor jong u .

en: In contrast , consider how just two Bible proverbs help us to see what is important to happiness .
kha: Ha ba ia nujor bad pyrkhat kumno artylli na ki kitab jong ka Proberb ka iarap ia ngi , kaei kaba donkam ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingïapher , pyrkhat kumno tang ar tylli ki proberb jong ka Baibl ki iarap ïa ngi ban iohi ïa kaei kaba kongsan ha ka jingkmen .

en: And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain .
kha: Bad wat la kim shym la shem kano kano ka daw ban rai pynïap ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban phah pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la kim lap ia ka daw jong ka jingiap ha u , hynrei ki kwah ia u Pilat ba un shah pyniap .

en: And he said unto his father , My head , my head . And he said to a lad , Carry him to his mother .
kha: Kynsan kynsan u pyrta jam sha la u kpa ,  Ka khlieh jong nga ka pang ! Ka khlieh jong nga ka pang !   Bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u ,  u kpa u ong ha u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha la u kpa, Ka khlieh jong nga, ka khlieh jong nga . Bad u la ong ha uwei u khynnah shynrang , To rah ia u sha ka kmie jong u .

en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .
kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki sumar ïa ki jingri jong ki , hynrei ki riew ba-bymman ki lehbeiñ ïa la ki jong .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba hok u pyrkhat ia ka jingim jong u mrad jong u: hynrei ki jingsngewrit kiba jem jong kiba sniew ki long kiba sniew .

en: If there arise among you a prophet , or a dreamer of dreams , and giveth thee a sign or a wonder ,
kha: U nongïathuhlypa ne u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew u lah ban kular ïa ka kambah ne ka kamphylla ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don hapdeng jong phi u nongiathuhlypa ne u nongphohsniew jong ki jingphohsniew bad u ai ia me ia ka dak ne ka jingphylla .

en: And Edom said unto him , Thou shalt not pass by me , lest I come out against thee with the sword .
kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ong ,  Ngim shah ïa phi ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong ngi ! Lada phi pyrshang , ngin mih bad tur ïaleh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Edom u la ong ha u, Wat iaid lyngba jong nga , ioh ngan mih pyrshah ia me da ka waitlam .

en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,
kha: Kynsan ka kynhun bah jong ki angel ka bneng , ka la mihpaw lem bad u angel , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kynsan kynsan la don bad u angel u paidbah jong u kynhun bneng uba iaroh ia U Blei bad u ong:

en: There is none to plead thy cause , that thou mayest be bound up : thou hast no healing medicines .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba sumar ïa phi , ym don jingïarap na ka bynta ki prum jong phi , ym don jingkyrmen ban koit na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh ban kyrpad ia ka daw jong me, ba me lah ban shah teh: me don ki dawai pynkoit .

en: And it came to pass , when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and was fled forth ,
kha: Haba ka la ïohi ba u la iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup bad ba u la mareh shabar ïing ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ka la iohi ba u la iehnoh ia ka jain jong u ha ka kti jong ka bad u la phet noh .

en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .
kha: Kumba nga la ïoh jinghikai ïa ki jingbishar bahok jong me , ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka dohnud kaba sngur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iaroh ia me da ka jinglong hok jong ka dohnud , ynda nga la nang ia ki jingbishar hok jong me .

en: By faith Moses , when he was come to years , refused to be called the son of Pharaoh s daughter  ;
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses , haba u la rangbah , ban kyntait ba yn khot ïa u , u khun jong ka khun u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Moses haba u la dap snem u la kyntait ban shah khot u khun u Pharaoh u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ban shah khot u Pharaoh u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ia u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ia u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ia u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ia u khun u Pharaoh u la kyntait ia u khun u Moses .

en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son , he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters .
kha: Lada u briew u thied mraw ïa ka kynthei ban ai ïa ka ha la u khun , u dei ban ñiew ïa ka kum la ka khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u la iapoikha bad ka ha u khun jong u , un leh ia ka katkum ka rukom jong ki khun kynthei .

en: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .
kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Paul ban shong bad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u sha u Pheliks u Lyngskor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynbiang ia ki mrad , ba kin buh ia u Paul ha u Lat ka jylla .

en: And into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you , eat such things as are set before you :
kha: Ha man ba phi leit shapoh ka nongrit bad la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kano kano ka shnong kaba phi rung, bad ki pdiang ia phi, bam ia kiei kiei kiba la buh ha khmat jong phi:

en: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .
kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la shong dara ha ka Them Akasia , ki rangbah ki la sdang ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei Moab kiba don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la shong ha Shittim , bad ki briew ki la sdang ban leh ia ka kam runar bad ki khun kynthei jong u Moab .

en: O  Lord  God , to whom vengeance belongeth  ; O God , to whom vengeance belongeth , shew thyself .
kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei uba pynshitom ; to pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai Blei, ha uba ka jingpynshitom bein ka long; ko Blei, ha uba ka jingpynshitom bein ka long ka jong u, to pyni ia lade .

en: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pdiang pisa ban pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shim ia ka bainong ban pyniap ia u briew uba khlem pop . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih waiñ , bad phi ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis um shym la wan bam kpu ne dih wain ; bad phi ong , U don u ksuid .

en: And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .
kha: U Dabid , uba shu pien tang da ka jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka bor jong u baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shad ha khmat U Trai da ka bor baroh; bad u Dabid u la shah rong noh da ka jain lin .

en: There is a crying for wine in the streets  ; all joy is darkened , the mirth of the land is gone .
kha: Ki briew ki pyrta ha ki lynti bah namar ym don waiñ shuh . Ka jingkmen ka la duh noh junom ; la beh noh ïa ka na ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingud wain ha ki surok ; ka jingkmen baroh ka la dum , ka jingkmen jong ka ri ka la jah noh .

en: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :
kha: Uta u riewspah u la ong , ‘ Kumta nga kyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jong nga , ha kaba nga don san ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong , nga kyrpad ia me namarkata ko kpa, ba me phah ia u sha iing u kpa jong nga:

en: And when the disciples saw it , they marvelled , saying , How soon is the fig tree withered away !
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la lyngngoh ,  Kumno u dieng Dumbur u tyrkhong stet katta katta ?  Ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki synran ki la iohi ia ka , ki la lyngngoh, ki la ong , Katno u dieng sohjew u la tyrkhong noh !

en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .
kha: U lah ban buhrieh arsap ïa la ka jingisih , hynrei baroh kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bymman ba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshun jong u ka la tap da ka jingleh thok , ka jingsniew jong u kan paw ha khmat ka balang baroh kawei .

en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
kha: U Jair uba na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh katto katne ki shnong bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ki  Ki shnong u Jair .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jair u khun u Manasseh u la leit shim ia ki shnong rit jong ka, bad u la khot ia ki u Habothjair .

en: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .
kha: Haba u samla u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba uta u samla u la iohsngew ia kata ka jingong, u la leit noh da ka jingsngewsih: namar u don ki jingdon jingem kiba khraw .

en: As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :
kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat shah ba ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynwandur da kito ki jingkwah brai kiba phi la ju don mynba phi dang don ha ka jingbymtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ki khynnah kiba kohnguh , ban ym pynwan dur ia lade katkum ki jingkwah brai ba mynshuwa ha ka jingbymtip jong phi:

en: And thou , profane wicked prince of Israel , whose day is come , when iniquity shall have an end ,
kha: Me u nongsynshar uba bymman bad bymkhuid jong ki Israel , ka sngi jong me , ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom ba kut , ka wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, u syiem Israel uba sniew uba sniew, uba ka sngi jong u ka wan , haba ka jingbymhok kan kut noh .

en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
kha: Ka long bieit ban krenbeiñ ïa kiwei . Lada phi long uba sngewthuh , phin shu sngap jar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba khlem jingstad u pynjah burom ia u paramarjan jong u: hynrei u briew uba sngewthuh u bat ia ka jingsuk jong u .

en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer , being the ninth hour .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit sha ka Templ ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi , kaba long ka kynta jingduwai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros bad u Ioannis ki la leit sha ka tempi ha ka por duwai, ka long ka por kaba hynniew .

en: I know his wrath , saith the  Lord   ; but it shall not be so  ; his lies shall not so effect it .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga tip ïa ka jinglehmeng jong ki . Ki jingkob jong ki kim long ei ei ruh , bad kiei kiei kiba ki leh kin ym neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia ka jingbitar jong u, ong u Trai ; hynrei kan ym long kumta; ki jinglamler jong u kin ym ktah kumta .

en: Investigating officers has to prepare the report after consulting with the police superintendent .
kha: Ki ophisar tohkit ki hap ban pynkhreh ia ka kaiphod hadien ba ki la iamir jingmut bad u nongpeit jong ki pulit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ophisar kiba wad bniah ki hap ban pynkhreh ia ka kaiphod hadien ba la iamir jingmut bad ki pulit .

en: And David reigned over all Israel  ; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people .
kha: U Dabid u la synshar halor ka ri Israel baroh , bad u da pynthikna ba ki briew jong u kin ïohmad ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingbymshah shiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la synshar halor ki Israel baroh; bad u Dabid u la pyndep ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok ha ki briew jong u baroh .

en: And Samuel grew , and the  Lord  was with him , and did let none of his words fall to the ground .
kha: Katba u Samuel u nang san , U  Trai  u la don ryngkat bad u , bad u pynurlong ïa baroh kaba u Samuel u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la san bad U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u bad um shym la ailad ia kawei ruh na ki ktien jong u ban hap ha khyndew .

en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink , and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .
kha: Phi kyntait ban ai um ïa kito kiba la thait , bad phi kyntait ban bsa ïa kito kiba thngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ai um ia kiba la thait ban dih , bad me la bat ia u kpu na kiba thngan .

en: Go in , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , that he let the children of Israel go out of his land .
kha: Khie leit bad ong ha u Pharaoh ba u dei ban shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit shapoh, kren ha u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt , ba un pyllait noh ia ki khun Israel na ka ri jong u .

en: Wherefore , my beloved brethren , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , slow to wrath :
kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban long uba kloi ban shahshkor , hynrei uba suki ban kren bad uba suki ban bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko para baieit jong nga, to ai ba uwei pa uwei un sngap jar, un slem ban kren, un slem ban bitar:

en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la u hynmen u para u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia la u hynmen u sah ha ka jingshai , bad ym don ka lad ban ia tyngkhuh bad u .

en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?
kha: Kumno u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la long uba la pynksan da U Blei ? Ka la long namar ki kam ki jong u , mynba u la aiti ïa u Isaak u khun jong u ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u Abraham u kpa jong ngi um shym la long uba hok da ki kam , haba u la tyrwa ia u Isaak khun jong u halor ka almari ?

en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa uno uno , bad hadien un ïaroh ïa ka kham bun ban ïa kaba pynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynrem ia u briew hadien un shem kham bun ka jingsngewbha ban ia uta uba sngap jar bad ka shyntur .

en: What is man , that thou shouldest magnify him ? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him ?
kha: Balei ki briew ki long kiba donkam ha me ? Balei me da peit bniah ïa kaei ba ki leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka briew kaba me dei ban pynkhraw ia u ? bad ba me dei ban buh ia ka dohnud jong me ha u ?

en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon .
kha: Wat shna ïa ka duwan kaba don ki kyrdon kiba kiew sha ka ; lada phi leh kumta , phi pynpaw khlem akor ïa lade haba phi kiew ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat leit shaneng da ki step sha ka almari jong nga, ba ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me kan ym lap ha kata ka jaka .

en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :
kha: Ngi la ïoh katto katne ka jakarieh lieng haba ngi la ïaid shaphang shathie jong ka dewlynnong kaba rit jong ka Kauda . Hangta da kaba eh , ngi la lah ban pynskhem ïa ka lieng rit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban mareh hapoh kawei ka ïew kaba la khot Clauda , ngi la don shibun ka kam ban wan da ka lieng:

en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
kha: Ka ong ruh , ‘ Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki kti jong ki kin rah ia me shaneng, ioh ha kano kano ka por ba me pynkhih ia ka kjat jong me pyrshah ia u maw .

en: But God commendeth his love toward us , in that , while we were yet sinners , Christ died for us .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pyn-i ha ngi haduh katno ba u ieit ïa ngi — ka la long mynba ngi dang long ki nongpop ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u iaroh ia ka jingieit jong u ia ngi, ha kata, katba ngi dang long ki nongpop, U Khrist u la iap na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it  ; every male shall eat it : it shall be holy unto thee .
kha: Me dei ban bam ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka jaka kyntang , bad tang ki shynrang kiba lah ban bam ïa ki ; ñiew ïa ki , kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jaka kaba khuid tam men bam ia ka ; uwei pa uwei u shynrang un bam ia ka: kan long kaba khuid ha me .

en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt ? or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?
kha: Hynrei uei uba lah bam ïa ka jingbam ka bym don jingmad bad kaba khlem mluh ? Don jingmad aïu ha ka bynta kaba lieh jong ka pylleng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ia kata kaba khlem sngewbha lah ban bam khlem ka umsoh ? lane hato don ka jingsma ha ka rong lieh jong ka sniehdoh ?

en: And Joab answered and said , Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .
kha: Ym kumta !  u Joab u jubab .  Ngan ym pynsniew lane pynjot ïa ka nongbah jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la jubab bad u la ong: To long kiba jngai na nga, ba nga dei ban dih ne pynjot .

en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing , thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge .
kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïa uno uno u briew , wat leit rung sha ïing jong u ban shim ïa ka jaiñkup ban buh bynda ha phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me ai ram ia u hynmen jong me, wat leit shapoh iing jong u ban shim ia ka jingkular jong u .

en: There is not much of a difference between fighting an Assembly election and a Lok Sabha election .
kha: Kam don ka jingiapher kaba khraw hapdeng ka jingiakhun ia ka elekshon Assembly bad ka elekshon Lok Sabha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don jingiapher than hapdeng ka jingialeh elekshon bad ka elekshon Lok Sabha .

en: Traffic jams proof no slowdown in auto sector , those making such claims defaming country : BJP MP
kha: Ka jingdheng kali ka pynshisha ba ym don jinghiar ha ka kam kali , kito kiba kren kum kine ki pynjah burom ia ka ri : MP jong ka BJP
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jam kiba iaid kali kim pynshisha ia ka jingslem ha ka kam shna kali, kito kiba leh ia kum kine ki jingdawa ki pynjah burom ia ka ri: U MP ka BJP .

en: And the sons of Japhlet  ; Pasach , and Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .
kha: U Japhlet ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Pasakh , u Bimhal , bad u Ashbath .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Japhlet ; Pasach, bad u Bimal bad u Ashvath . Kine ki long ki khun jong u Japhlet .

en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians , to catch him in his words .
kha: Ïa ki katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot na ka kynhun u Herod , la phah sha U Jisu ban riam ïa u da ki jingkylli :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki phah sha u katto katne na ki Pharisi bad na ki nong Herodian ban kem ia u ha ki ktien jong u .

en: And when he had made an end to offer the present , he sent away the people that bare the present .
kha: Haba u Ehud u la dep ai ha u ïa ki jingai sngewbha , u la ong ha ki rangbah kiba la kit ïa kita ban leit phai noh pat sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la kut noh ban aiti ia ka jingai sngewbha , u la phah noh ia ki briew kiba kit ia ka jingai sngewbha .

en: And there came a messenger to David , saying , The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom .
kha: U nonglamktien u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  Ki Israel ki la ïakular ban ai jingkyrshan noh ïa u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor u la wan ha u Dabid, u da ong: Ki dohnud ki Israel ki long hadien u Absalom .

en: And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .
kha: ( Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw kiba nga ïohi harud ka wah Khebar ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynkiew ia ki cherubim . Kane ka long ka jingthaw ba im kaba nga la iohi da ka wah Chebar .

en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .
kha: Uwei na ki u pynbor ïa u ban ïaleit lang bad ki ; u la mynjur , bad u ïaleit ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u la ong, To sngewhun, nga kyrpad ia me, bad leit bad ki shakri jong me . Bad u la jubab , Ngan leit .

en: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah laiphew snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eber u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Peleg saw spah laiphew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ ;
kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to ïai ainguh borabor na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh sha U Blei uba U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingainguh beit ia kiei kiei baroh ha U Blei bad ia U Kpa ha ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi Jisu Khrist;

en: And when Jesus came into the ruler s house , and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise ,
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka ïing jong u rangbah synshar . Haba u la ïohi ïa ki nongput nongtem na ka bynta ka jingontep bad ba ki briew baroh ki la khihwin ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la wan shapoh iing u nongsynshar bad u la iohi ia ki nongtrei bad ki briew kiba ia pyrta jam .

en: But whatsoever hath a blemish , that shall ye not offer : for it shall not be acceptable for you .
kha: Lada phi ainguh da u jingri uba don kano kano ka jingduna , U  Trai  un ym pdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaei kaba don ka jingduna, kata phin ym ai: namar kan ym long kaba pdiang ia phi .

en: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .
kha: Na ka bynta jong ki u kynmaw ïa ka jutang jong u , bad namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong u , u la kylla jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynmaw na ka bynta jong ki ia ka jutang jong u , bad u la kylla bamut kat kum ka jingbun ki jingsngewsih jong u .

en: Yea , ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath , and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah .
kha: Ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba mih ha ka jaka kaba shiphew hektar kin pynmih tang san gallon ka waiñ . Shiphew shang u symbai un pynmih tang shi shang u symbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , shi akar ka kper sohjew kan ai kawei ka bath , bad u symbai jong u homer un ai ia ka ephah .

en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .
kha: Ka spah ba phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ym ha shuwa ba kan ïalam ïa phi sha ki tyngam jong ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingioh ia ki spah da ka shyntur kaba thok ka long ka jinglong kaba sniew kaba la pynkhih sha ki kiba wad ia ka jingiap .

en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood : neither shall ye use enchantment , nor observe times .
kha: Wat bam ïa kano kano ka doh ba dang don snam ha ka . Wat leh ïa kano kano ka kam byrtong .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban bam ei ei bad ka snam: lymne phin ym pyndonkam ia ka jingleh jadu , lymne ban peit ia ki por .

en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .
kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pyrta ha U Trai ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , bad u la pyllait im ia ki na ki jingjynjar jong ki .

en: Then said we unto them after this manner , What are the names of the men that make this building ?
kha: Ki pan ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong baroh ki rangbah kiba ïarap ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngi la ong ha ki hadien kane ka rukom , Kiei ki kyrteng jong ki shynrang kiba shna ia kane ka jingtei ?

en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof  ; the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards ,
kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh dei ban weng bad ainguh halor kata ka duwan : ka dongnai , ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki doh jem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti na ka ia ka shini baroh;

en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host  ; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder  ;
kha: U Joab , u khun ka Seruïah , u long u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u long uba khmih sumar ïa ki dulir ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u khun u Seruiah u la long halor ka host ; bad u Jehoshaphat u khun u Ahild u la long u nongthoh ; .

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Un long uwei na phi ki khat-ar ngut , uta u ban wieh ïa u kpu jong u ha ka pliang bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, Ka long kawei na ki shiphew ngut kiba dih bad nga ha ka pliang .

en: Arise therefore , and get thee down , and go with them , doubting nothing : for I have sent them .
kha: Kumta to khreh bad leit hiar , bad wat sngewlehrain ban leit bad ki , naba nga la phah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie namarkata, bad to hiar shapoh, bad leit bad ki, khlem artatien ei ei: namar nga la phah ia ki .

en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
kha: Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na Sukkoth bad ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka jingleit jong ki na Sucoth bad ki la shong shnong ha Etham, ha ka tduh jong ka ri khlaw .

en: And he ran before , and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him : for he was to pass that way .
kha: Kumta u la mareh ha shuwa jong ki paidbah bad u la kiew ïa u dieng Sykomore    ban ïohi ïa U Jisu , uba dei ban ïaid lyngba kata ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mareh shuwa , bad u la kiew sha u dieng sycomore ban iohi ia u: namar u la dei ban iaid kumta .

en: And it shall come to pass , when your children shall say unto you , What mean ye by this service ?
kha: Haba ki khun jong phi ki kylli ïa phi , ‘ Ka mut aïu kane ka jinglehniam ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia haba ki khun jong phi kin ong ha phi , Kaei kaba phi mut da kane ka jingshakri ?

en: And Jesus came and spake unto them , saying ,  All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth .
kha: U Jisu u la wan hajan bad u la ong ha ki ,  La ai ha nga baroh ka bor ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la wan bad u la kren ha ki, u da ong: Ka bor baroh ka long ha nga ha bneng bad ha ka khyndew .

en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah  ;
kha: U Toi u syiem ka Hamath u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la jop ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei jong u Hadadeser .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u syiem u Hamat u la iohsngew kumno u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki shipai baroh jong u Hadareer syiem u Sobah ; .

en: The statue is the dream project of Gujarat Chief Minister and the BJP PM candidate Narendra Modi .
kha: Une u mot u dei u project thrang jong u Myntri Rangbah ka jylla Gujarat bad u kyrtong PM jong ka BJP u Narendra Modi .
translated_en_to_kha: Utei u mot u dei u projek ba la thrang jong u Myntri Rangbah ka jylla Gujarat bad u kyrtong ka BJP u Narendra Modi .

en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving , and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms .
kha: To ngin ïawan ha khmat jong u da ka jingainguh bad rwai kmen da ki jingrwai ïaroh !
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin wan ha khmat jong u da kaba ainguh , bad ngin pynmih ia ka jingsawa kaba kmen ha u da ki salm .

en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace , whose mind is stayed on thee : because he trusteth in thee .
kha: Ma me , A  Trai  , me ai ka jingsuk bajanai ïa kito kiba batskhem ïa ka jingthmu jong ki bad kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me buh ia u ha ka jingsuk kaba janai, uba ka jingmut jong u ka sah ha me: namar u shaniah ha me .

en: Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .
kha: bad haba u la shem ïa uwei uba ikordor tam , u leit bad die lut ïa kaei kaei kaba u la don , bad u thied ïa uta u mawlynnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba, haba u la shem ia kawei ka mawkordor kaba heh dor, u la leit bad u la die lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don, bad u la thied ia ka .

en: And they were exceeding sorrowful , and began every one of them to say unto him , Lord , is it I ?
kha: Ki synran ki la sngewdiaw shikatdei eh , bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien uwei pat ,  Da shisha , A Trai , mem mut ba dei ma nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngewsih palat bad uwei pa uwei na ki u la sdang ban ong ha u: Ko Trai, em ?

en: And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,
kha: U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Jaka Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la leit noh sha Samaria . Bad katba u dang don ha ka iing kaba ot ha lynti .

en: And the king answered the people roughly , and forsook the old men s counsel that they gave him  ;
kha: U syiem u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u kren tohmet ïa kita ki briew , kumba la ai jingmut kita ki samla .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab ia ki briew da kaba sngewsih , bad u la iehnoh ia ki rangbah ba ki la ai ia u ; .

en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synran ïa ka pharshi ban hikai ïa ki ba ki dei ban duwai borabor ban ym noh mynsiem da lei lei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia ka jingiasyriem ha ki haduh kane ka jingkut, ba ki briew ki dei ban duwai beit, bad ban ym lyngngoh ; .

en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .
kha: Na kawei ka por sha kawei pat phi pynjahburom ïa nga bad phim don ka jinglehrain haba phi krenbeiñ ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki shi sien ki la kren bein ia nga: phim sngewlehrain ba phi pynlong ia lade kiba phylla ia nga .

en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household : for all her household are clothed with scarlet .
kha: Haba hap ka ïor , kam khuslai namar kiba ha ka ïing jong ka ki biang ki jaiñ syaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam tieng ia u slap na ka bynta ka iing jong ka: namar baroh ka iing jong ka ka la phong da ka rong saw .

en: The  Lord  liveth  ; and blessed be my rock  ; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation .
kha: U  Trai  u im ! To ïaroh ïa u nongïada jong nga ! To pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei uba khlaiñ uba pynim ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u im ; bad la kyrkhu ia u maw jong nga ; bad la pynkhraw ia u Blei jong u maw jong ka jingpynim jong nga .

en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur , that is over against Egypt .
kha: U Saul u jop ïa ki Amalek , da kaba ïaleh shi lynter lynti naduh Habilah haduh Shur , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Ijipt ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la pynkhih ia ki nong Amlek na Habla haduh ba phin da poi sha Shur kaba la kut noh pyrshah ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .
kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki wan ha ka bor , baroh ki lehkmen , hynrei haba ki briew kiba sniew ki synshar , ki briew ki buhrieh ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew kiba hok ki sngewbha , ka don ka burom kaba khraw: hynrei haba ki bymman ki kiew , u briew u la buhrieh .

en: And he said unto them ,  With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer :
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïabam bad phi ïa kane ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha shuwa ba ngan shahshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Da ka jingkwah nga la kwah ban bam ia kane ka jingkhawai Niam bad phi shuwa ba ngan shah shitom:

en: And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .
kha: To ngin pynlong ka jingïateh kular ba kan don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi bad ki jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi shongkurim bad ngi , bad ai ia ki khun kynthei jong phi ha ngi , bad shim ia ki khun kynthei jong ngi ha phi .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the name of the  Lord   ; praise him , O ye servants of the  Lord .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , phi ki shakri jong U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . Iaroh ia ka kyrteng U Trai ; iaroh ia u , ko ki shakri U Trai .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I say not unto thee , Until seven times : but , Until seventy times seven .
kha: Em , ym tang hynñiew sien ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  hynrei haduh hynñiewphew sien hynñiew ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u , Ngam ong ha me, Haduh hynriew sien: hynrei , Haduh hynriewphew sien hynriew .

en: To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew kumba U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jong ki briew jong U Blei . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyndep ia ki ia ka jingbishar ba la thoh: kane ka burom ka don ki riewkhuid jong u baroh . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .
kha: Ngan ai ki jingmaham shaphang kata ka sngi ha ka suiñbneng bad ha ka khyndew ; kan don ka jingumsnam , ka ding bad ki lyoh tdem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyni ia ki jingphylla ha ki bneng bad ha ka khyndew , ka snam bad ka ding bad ki lum tdem .

en: Let a man so account of us , as of the ministers of Christ , and stewards of the mysteries of God .
kha: Phi dei ban pyrkhat ïa ngi kum ki shakri U Khrist , ïa kiba la buh ban sumar ïa ki jingshisha barieh jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba u briew un iathuh ia ngi kum ki nongshakri jong U Khrist bad ki nongshong shnong jong ki jingmaham jong U Blei .

en: And there came a voice from heaven , saying , Thou art my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
kha: Bad ka sur ka la wan na bneng ,  Me long U Khun ba-ieit jong nga hi . Nga sngewbha ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka sur na bneng, ka ong: Me long U Khun baieit jong nga, ha uba nga sngewbha shibun .

en: And the servant of the Lord must not strive ; but be gentle unto all men , apt to teach , patient ,
kha: Bad kum u shakri jong U Trai , mem dei ban ïakajia . Bad to long jaijai ha ki briew baroh , bato hikai , jingiashah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shakri U Trai um dei ban ialeh ; hynrei u long uba jemnud ia ki briew baroh, uba tbit ban hikai , uba iaishah .

en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered : the  Lord  is gracious and full of compassion .
kha: U  Trai  um shah ïa ngi ban klet noh ïa ki jingleh baphylla jong u ; u long uba bha sbun bad uba isynei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ia ki kam ba phylla jong u ban kynmaw: U Trai u long uba sngewrit bad uba dap da ka jingsngewrit .

en: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive , and shall see this land no more .
kha: Un ïap ha ka ri sha kaba ki la rah ïa u , bad un ym ïohi shuh ïa kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un iap ha kata ka jaka ba ki la ialam ia u sha ka jinglong mraw , bad un ym iohi shuh ia kane ka ri .

en: For I know nothing by myself ; yet am I not hereby justified : but he that judgeth me is the Lord .
kha: Ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka shai , hynrei kata kam pynshisha ba nga long da shisha uba lui lui . U Trai u dei uta uba bishar ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam tip ei ei da lade hynrei ngam long uba hok: hynrei uta uba bishar ia nga u long U Trai .

en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
kha: Thaw ruh ïa ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki dieng kiba heh ; san tylli na ka bynta ki board jong kawei ka liang jong ka Tabernakle .

en: And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .
kha: U Jakob u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad u kup da ka jaiñ khain . U la ïam sngewsih bun sngi na ka bynta u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la buh ia ka jainkup ha ki tyrpeng jong u, bad u la iam na ka bynta u khun jong u bun sngi .

en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .
kha: Don ki briew kiba da jaipdeh wat ban tian jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew u buhrieh ia la ka kti ha ka shyntur jong u , bad un ym wanrah biang ia ka ha ka shyntur jong u .

en: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïalam lynti bakla ïa u briew uba matlah .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba pynlong ia kiba matlah ban iaid kai na ka lynti . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! Ym don kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam lane kaba sang kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong , Em, ko Trai: namar ym don ei ei kaba ju jia ne kaba khlem khuid ha kano kano ka por kaba rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .

en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .
kha: Te u Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u la ong ,  Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha U Blei jong phi hangne ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la khot ia u Moses bad u Aaron bad u la ong: To leit sha U Blei jong phi ha ka ri .

en: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?
kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ïa ka Hukum , hato ym dei kumta ? Hynrei ym don uwei na phi uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum . Balei ba phi pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u Moses um shym la ai ia phi ia ka hukum , bad wat la katta ruh ym don uwei ruh na phi uba bat ia ka hukum ? Balei phi leit ban pyniap ia nga ?

en: It can also cause you to give in very quickly to other temptations .—Proverbs 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .
kha: Ka lah ruh ban pynliat ïa phi sha kiwei pat ki jingpynshoi .—Proberb 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lah ruh ban pynlong ia phi ban aiti kloi bha sha kiwei pat ki jingpynshoi .  Proverb 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35.

en: Some had been dead for a short while , but one had been in a tomb for four days ! —John 11 :39-44 .
kha: Katto katne ki la ïap tang shiphang , hynrei uwei na ki u la don ha jingtep la saw sngi .—Ioannis 11 :39-44 .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba la iap tang khyndiat por , hynrei uwei u la don ha ka jingtep haduh saw sngi !  macau 11:39-44 .

en: Hell and destruction are before the  Lord  : how much more then the hearts of the children of men ?
kha: Wat ka pyrthei kiba ïap kam lah ban buhrieh na U  Trai  ba un ym tip kaei kaba don hangta ; kumno te ngi lah ban buhrieh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi na U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dujok bad ka jingpynjot ki don ha khmat U Trai: katno tam ki dohnud ki khun ki briew ?

en: And she wrote in the letters , saying , Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people :
kha: Ki shithi ki ong :  Pynbna ïa ka sngi ban shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah baroh bad ai ïa u Naboth ka jaka kaba donburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la thoh ha ki shithi, ka da ong: Pynkhih ia ka jingstet, bad buh ia u Naboth ha jrong hapdeng ki briew:

en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
kha: bad u Ishmael u khun jong u pat u la dap khatlai snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishmael u khun jong u u la dap shiphew snem ka rta, haba u la shah ot ha ka doh jong u .

en: This is the interpretation of the thing : MENE  ; God hath numbered thy kingdom , and finished it .
kha: Bad kane ka dei ka jingmut jong ka :  Ka dak jingkheiñ  , U Blei u la kheiñ ïa ki sngi jong ka hima jong phi bad u la wallam ïa ka sha ka jingkut ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingbatai ia kaei kaei: U Blei MENE ; u la khein ia ka hima jong me, bad u la pyndep ia ka .

en: Now as soon as it was day , there was no small stir among the soldiers , what was become of Peter .
kha: Haba ka step ka la poi , ka la don ka jingkulmar jingmut kaba jur hapdeng ki nongap phira — kaei kaba la jia ha u Petros ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta tang shu sdang ka sngi , ym shym la don ka jingkhih kaba rit hapdeng ki shipai , kaei kaba la jia ia u Petros .

en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,
kha: Da ka jingpyrta bajam ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la set ïa la ki shkor da la ki kti . Nangta baroh ki la tur sha u hangta hi , ki la bret ïa u shabar ka nongbah , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam , bad ki la pynsangeh ia ki shkor jong ki bad ki la mareh halor jong u da kawei ka sur .

en: Whoso sheddeth man s blood , by man shall his blood be shed : for in the image of God made he man .
kha: Ïa ki briew la thaw ha ka dur jong U Blei hi , kumta uno uno uba pynïap ïa uwei na ki , u ruh un shah pynïap ha uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pynmih ia ka snam briew, da u briew yn pynmih ia ka snam jong u: namar ha ka dur U Blei u la thaw ia u briew .

en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples , and came into the parts of Dalmanutha .
kha: bad mar kumta hi u la kiew halor ka lieng ryngkat bad ki synran jong u bad u la leit sha ka distrik Dalmanutha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung beit ha ka lieng bad ki synran jong u bad u la wan sha ki bynta jong ka Dalmanutha .

en: For to their power , I bear record , yea , and beyond their power they were willing of themselves ;
kha: Nga lah ban pynthikna ïa phi ba ki la ai katba ki lah , bad wat palat ban ïa kaba ki lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka bor jong ki , nga kit ia ka rekod , yea , bad palat ia ka bor jong ki ki la mon ia lade;

en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain  ;
kha: Wat pynslem ban pyllait ïa uno uno uba la jan shah rai pynrem bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me sngewbha ban pynpoi ia kito kiba shah rong noh haduh ka jingiap, bad kito kiba la pynkhreh ban shah pyniap ; .

en: That they may teach the young women to be sober , to love their husbands , to love their children ,
kha: Ki dei ban hikai ïa kaei kaba bha , khnang ba ki lah ban hikai ïa ki kynthei ba dang kham samla ban ieit ïa la ki tnga bad ki khun ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin hikai ia ki samla ban long kiba jemnud , ban ieit ia ki tnga jong ki , ban ieit ia ki khun jong ki , .

en: And when the sun was up , they were scorched  ; and because they had no root , they withered away .
kha: Hynrei haba ka sngi ka la mih , ka thang ïa ki jingthung ba dang lung ; bad namar ba ki thied kim da ngam jylliew bha , shen ki jingthung ki la ïap tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi ka la kiew , ki la shah rong noh ; bad namar ba kim don tynrai , ki la tyrkhong noh .

en: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
kha: Nangta u la khot ïa la ki shakri bad u la ong ha ki , ‘ La dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong nga , hynrei ki briew kiba nga la khot sngewbha kim don hok ban ïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki shakri jong u , Ka jingkhawai shongkurim ka la pynkhreh , hynrei kito kiba la shah jied kim shym la long kiba bit dor .

en: I do set my bow in the cloud , and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth .
kha: Kata kan long ka dak jong kata ka jutang jong nga bad ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga buh ia ka bow jong nga ha u lyoh , bad kan long ka dak jong ka jutang hapdeng jong nga bad ka khyndew .

en: Nay , my sons  ; for it is no good report that I hear : ye make the  Lord s  people to transgress .
kha: Sangeh noh ko khun jong nga ! Kane ka long kaba sngewshyrkhei kaba ki briew jong U  Trai  ki ïakren shaphang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Em, ki khun shynrang jong nga kim long ka khubor kaba bha kaba nga iohsngew: phi pynlong ia ki briew jong U Trai ban iaid lait .

en: After Shahidullah Kaiser , among journalists whose names spring to the mind is Sirajuddin Hossain .
kha: Hadien u Shahidullah Kaiser napdeng ki nongthohkhubor kiba ka kyrteng jong ki ka mih ha ka jingmut u dei u Sirajuddin Hossain .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien u Shahdullah Kaiser , napdeng ki nongthoh khubor kiba ki kyrteng jong ki ki mih ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat u dei u Sirajuddin Hossain .

en: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin , saying , Go and lie in wait in the vineyards  ;
kha: Ki ong ha ki Benjamin ,  Khie leit rieh ha ki bri sohwaiñ bad ap khmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la hukum ia ki khun shynrang u Benjamin da kaba ong: To leit thiah ha ki kper sohjew ; .

en: And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;
kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa uba la ñiewburom bha ha baroh ki balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei jong u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la phah bad u ia uta u hynmen uba ka jingiaroh jong u ka long ha ka gospel baroh ki balang baroh;

en: Jesus answered ,  I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :
kha: Nga la lah ïathuh ha phi ba dei ma nga uta ,  U Jisu u la ong .  Te , lada phi ïawad ïa nga , shah ba kine kiwei kin leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Nga la ong ia phi ba nga long ma nga: lada namarkata phi wad ia nga, to ai ba kine kin leit noh:

en: And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .
kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewbha ïa u slap ha ka por pyrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ap ia nga kum u slap ; bad ki la plie ia ka shyntur jong ki kum u slap uba hadien .

en: And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .
kha: U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jubab ,  Uta uba la lehbha ïa u .  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Te , ma me khie leit bad leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Uta uba la leh isynei ia u . Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha u, To leit bad to leh kumjuh .

en: And when he had opened the fourth seal , I heard the voice of the fourth beast say , Come and see .
kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba saw ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba saw uba ong ,  To wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba saw , nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u mrad uba saw ba u ong: To wan bad peit .

en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , uno uno uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uta uba lait ha kata ka sngi un wan sha me , ban pynlong ia me ban iohsngew ia ka da ki shkor jong me ?

en: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father , we told him the words of my lord .
kha: Ynda ngi leit phai pat sha i pa , ngi ïathuh lut ha i kat ïa kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ngi la wan shaneng ha u shakri jong me u kpa jong nga , ngi la iathuh ha u ia ki ktien jong u kynrad jong nga .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit phai bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew bad ïohi :
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Leit bad pyni biang ia u Ioannis ia kiei kiei kiba phi iohsngew bad iohi:

en: Then began he to curse and to swear , saying , I know not the man . And immediately the cock crew .
kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Nga smai ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam ithuh ïa uta u briew !  Kumta hi u syiar u la kyn-ih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la sdang ban tim bad ban sngap jar, da kaba ong, Ngam ithuh ia uta u briew . Bad mardor u la sdang ban sngap jar .

en: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah , when he had been sick , and was recovered of his sickness :
kha: Hadien u Hesekaïah u koit pat na ka jingpang jong u , u thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai ïaroh :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthoh jong u Hesekaiah syiem Judah haba u la pang bad u la koit na ka jingpang jong u:

en: Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have taken evil counsel against thee , saying ,
kha: Ka Syria , lem bad ka Israel bad u syiem jong ka , ki la pynlong ka jingïasylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka Syria , Ephraim bad u khun u Remaliah ki la shim ia ka jingmut kaba sniew pyrshah ia me da kaba ong:

en: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch , saying , I am shut up  ; I cannot go into the house of the  Lord  :
kha: Nangta nga la ai ha u Barukh ïa kine ki jingbthah harum :  Ym shah shuh ïa nga ban rung hapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la hukum ia u Baruk, u da ong, nga la shah set ; ngam lah ban leit shapoh iing U Trai:

en: But though he cause grief , yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies .
kha: U lah ban wallam ka jingsngewsih ha ngi , hynrei ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba thikna bad kaba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat la u pynmih ia ka jingsngewsih hynrei un sngewsynei kat kum ka jingbun ki jingsngewsih jong u .

en: And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .
kha: U Abraham u la tymmen bha , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la tymmen bha, bad u la tyrkhong bha ha ka rta: bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia u Abraham ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and went every man his way .
kha: Nangta ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u Adonijah ki la sheptieng , bad baroh ki la ïeng joit bad leit noh , uwei uwei ha la ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongwan baroh kiba don bad u Adonijah ki la tieng, bad ki la ieng bad ki la iaid uwei pa uwei .

en: And he said , Come with me , and see my zeal for the  Lord . So they made him ride in his chariot .
kha: da kaba ong ,  Wan bad nga bad khmih da lade haduh katno nga long uba la aiti ha U  Trai .  Bad ki la ïashong lang haduh Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To wan ryngkat bad nga bad to iohi ia ka jingkmen jong nga na ka bynta U Trai . Kumta ki la pynlong ia u ban shong ha ka kali jong u .

en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .
kha: Ai ha kiba duk bad phin ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lano ruh . Lada phi khapbrip la ki khmat sha kiba duk , ki briew kiba bun kin tim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ai ia kiba duk un ym duna: hynrei uta uba buhrieh ia ki khmat jong u un don shibun ka jingtim .

en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
kha: Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha kawei na ki templ jong ki bad wah ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka templ jong u Dagon u blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ki tiar ialeh jong u ha iing jong ki blei jong ki, bad ki la pynskhem ia ka khlieh jong u ha ka tempi jong u Dagon .

en: If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :
kha: Lada , namarkata , ngi ong ba ngi don ka jingïasyllok bad u , pynban , ha kajuh ka por ngi ïaid ha ka jingdum , ngi lamler da ki ktien jong ngi bad ha ki kam jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ong ba ngi don ka jingiasyllok bad u , bad ngi iaid ha ka jingdum , ngi thok , bad ngim leh ia ka jingshisha:

en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .
kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  um pat ju la kren bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Samuel um pat ithuh ia U Trai , bad ym pat paw ia ka ktien U Trai ha u .

en: Behold , his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him : but the just shall live by his faith .
kha: Bad kane ka dei ka khubor : ‘ Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im , hynrei kito kiba hok kin im namar ki long kiba ïaineh ha U Blei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka mynsiem jong u kaba la pynkiew kam long kaba beit ha u: hynrei uba hok un im da ka jingngeit jong u .

en: And I persecuted this way unto the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women .
kha: Nga la pynshitom beiñ haduh kaba pynïap ïa ki briew kiba la bud ïa kane ka Lynti . Nga la kem ïa ki rangbah bad ki kynthei bad nga la thep ïa ki ha ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynshitom bein ia kane ka rukom haduh ka jingiap , da kaba teh bad pynpoi sha ki phatok shynrang bad kynthei .

en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together : they are firm in themselves  ; they cannot be moved .
kha: Ym don kano kano ka bynta kaba jem ha ka snieh jong u ; ka long kaba eh bad kaba jwat kum ka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki flak jong ka doh jong u ki iasoh lang: ki long kiba skhem ha lade ; kim lah ban khih .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , namar ba ka long kaba eh ban hikai ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Na ka bynta ka jingkhlain jong ka dohnud jong phi u la thoh ia kane ka hukum .

en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
kha: Phi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh . Ngim shym la long kiba jaipdeh mynba ngi la don bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong phi hi phi tip kumno phi dei ban bud ia ngi: namar ngim shym la leh khlem akor hapdeng jong phi ; .

en: His disciples say unto him , If the case of the man be so with his wife , it is not good to marry .
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ,  Lada ka long kumne hapdeng u briew bad la ka tnga , ka kham bha ban ym shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki ong ha u , Lada ka long kumta bad ka tnga jong u , kam long kaba bha ban shongkurim .

en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
kha: To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa kaba dei kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit , to long ki nongbud lang jong nga , bad to buh dak ia kita kiba iaid kumba phi don ia ngi kum ka nuksa .

en: That being justified by his grace , we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life .
kha: khnang ba ngi lah ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut kaba ngi ap kyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba la pynshisha da ka jingaiei jong u , ngi dei ban long ki nongioh pateng kat kum ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingim bymjukut .

en: But they shall serve the  Lord  their God , and David their king , whom I will raise up unto them .
kha: Pynban , kin shakri ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , uba ngan pynshong ha ka khet kum u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kin shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong ki bad u syiem jong ki, ia uba ngan pynmih sha ki .

en: Remember , I pray thee , who ever perished , being innocent ? or where were the righteous cut off ?
kha: Pyrkhat pat mynta . Jer ïa kawei ka sien mynba u riewhok u ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw , nga duwai ia me , uba la jah noh , uba khlem pop ? lane shano la ot noh ia kiba hok ?

en: And Israel said , It is enough  ; Joseph my son is yet alive : I will go and see him before I die .
kha: U Joseph u khun jong nga u dang im !  u ong ,  Ngan pan aïu shuh nalor kane ! Nga dei ban leit ïakynduh ïa u shuwa ba ngan ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la ong: Ka la biang ia u Joseph u khun jong nga u dang im: Ngan leit peit ia u shuwa ba ngan iap .

en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?
kha: hynrei un shah pyrsad noh kum u pui pui . Kito kiba ju ithuh ïa u kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un jah noh junom kum ka sboh jong u hi: kita kiba la iohi ia u kin ong , Hangno u don ?

en: A scorner seeketh wisdom , and findeth it not : but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth .
kha: Ki briew kiba meng da lei lei kin ym long kiba stad , hynrei ki briew kiba shemphang ki ïoh hikai kloi .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglehkai u wad ia ka jingstad, bad um shem ia ka: hynrei ka jingtip ka long kaba suk ia uta uba sngewthuh .

en: Harden not your heart , as in the provocation , and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
kha: Wat long uba mutlop , kumba ki kpa tymmen ki la long ha Meribah , kumba ki la long ha kato ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap ha Massah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong phi, kumba ha ka jingpynkhih , bad kumba ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynshoi ha ka ri khlaw:

en: No , nor yet Herod : for I sent you to him  ; and , lo , nothing worthy of death is done unto him .
kha: Lymne ba u Herod u shem ïa u , uba la rem , naba u la phah biang ïa u sha ngi . Kam shym don kano kano kaba une u briew u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Em, lymne u Herod: namar nga la phah ia phi sha u ; bad, ha ka jingiap ym shym la leh ei ei ia u .

en: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynjahburom ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shong jem da u kpa ne ka kmie jong u . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: And it came to pass , when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  because of the Midianites ,
kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki la kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap pyrshah ïa ki Midian ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai namar ki Midan .

en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning  ; but the end thereof shall not be blessed .
kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , tang khyndiat eh kan pynbha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng ka lah ban ioh kyrkieh ha kaba sdang ; hynrei ka jingkut jong ka kan ym long kaba la kyrkhu .

en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpisa lyng-a ka la tyllep ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim bad u Petros bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedei bad u la sdang ban sngewsih bad khia shibun .

en: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without , and made a crown of gold to it round about .
kha: U suit ïa ka da ka ksiar kaba nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid hapoh bad shabar , bad u la shna ia ka da ka khlieh ksiar sawdong jong ka .

en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee , the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee .
kha: Ki briew jong ki hima badonbor kin ïaroh ïa me bad yn sheptieng ïa me ha ki nongbah jong ki hima bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki briew kiba khlain kin pyndonburom ia me , ka shnong jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shyrkhei kan tieng ia me .

en: So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :
kha: Kane ka long kumno kan jia haba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka met la tep , ka long kaba ïap ; haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap . La bet ia ka ha ka jingbamsap ; la pynkiew ia ka ha ka jingbym lah ban pyut:

en: And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .
kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha , ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ;  hynrei wat ki ksew ki ïabam ïa kiba sah tam kiba hap na ka miej u kynrad jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong, Hooid, ko Trai: hynrei ki kulai ki bam ia ki jingbam kiba hap na ka miej jong ki kynrad jong ki .

en: He cometh forth like a flower , and is cut down : he fleeth also as a shadow , and continueth not .
kha: Ngi san bad ngi ïapstai kloi kloi kum ki syntiew ki skud ; lane ngi jah noh kum ki syrngiew .
translated_en_to_kha: U wan kum u syntiew, bad la ot noh: u phet ruh kum ka jingdum , bad um bteng .

en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
kha: ha ka rta kaba laiphew ar snem , bad u la synshar haduh phra snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Laiphew ar snem ka rta u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar 8 snem ha Jerusalem .

en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil , and pour it into the palm of his own left hand :
kha: U lyngdoh un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang Olib bad un theh ïa ka ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un shim katto katne na ka umphniang bad un theh ia ka ha ka kti kadiang jong u hi:

en: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence , then was Haman full of wrath .
kha: U Haman u la bitar haba u la sngewthuh ba u Mordekai un ym dem khohsiew ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Haman u la iohi ba u Mordecai um shym la dem khrup, bad um shym la burom ia u, te u Haman u la dap da ka jingbitar .

en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .
kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid , da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi kham bun shah ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba phi la leit shabar ban iohi ? U nongiathuhlypa ? Hooid , nga ong ha phi , bad kham palat ban ia u nongiathuhlypa .

en: Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , Go now to thy brother Amnon s house , and dress him meat .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u phah ktien sha ka Tamar ha ka ïingsyiem :  Khie leit sha ka ïing u Amnon bad khreh katto katne ka jingbam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la phah sha iing sha u Tamar, u da ong, To leit noh mynta sha ka iing u hynmen jong me, bad to phong ia u da ka doh .

en: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .
kha: Ka jingmaham ba ai da u briew uba shemphang bha ha uno uno uba mon ban sngap ka long kaba kham kordor ban ïa ki sati ksiar ne ki jingdeng mawlynnai ba la saiñ na ka ksiar banylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka shkor ksiar , bad ka jingpynitynnad ksiar kaba bha , kumjuh ruh ka long ka jingpynrem kaba stad halor ka shkor kaba kohnguh .

en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit  ; let no man stay him .
kha: U briew uba shah pynrem ba u pynïap briew u tih ïa la ka jong ka jingtep kloi katba lah . Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba leh donbor ia ka snam jong uno uno u briew un phet sha ka thliew ; wat ai ba uno uno un sah ia u .

en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .
kha: bad u la ong ,  To ai ïa kane ka bor ha nga ruh , khnang ba uno uno ha uba nga buh ïa la ki kti un ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ai ia nga ruh ia kane ka bor , ba ha uno uno uba nga buh kti , un pdiang ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,
kha: Ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad ka ong ïa ki ban leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ban ai ha u ïa kane harum ka khubor na U  Trai  :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jubab ia ki , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , To iathuh ia uta u briew uba la phah ia phi sha nga .

en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith , and the ark of the testimony ,
kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka , ban pynsleh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynsleh ia ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng da kata , bad ka synduk ka jingsakhi .

en: And Abraham stood up , and bowed himself to the people of the land , even to the children of Heth .
kha: Te u Abraham u la nguh ha khmat jong ki bad u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ieng bad u la dem khrup ha ki briew jong ka ri , wat ha ki khun Heth .

en: Ye yourselves bear me witness , that I said , I am not the Christ , but that I am sent before him .
kha: Phi hi phi long ki sakhi jong nga ba nga la ong , ‘ Ngam dei u Messaïah , hynrei , ïa nga la phah ha shuwa jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi hi phi sakhi ia nga , ba nga la ong , ngam dei U Khrist , hynrei ba nga la phah ha khmat jong u .

en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
kha: U Joshua u shakri U  Trai  , u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u khun u Nun u shakri U Trai u la iap , u la dap shispah shiphew snem .

en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .
kha: Bad shaphang ka Jesebel , U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jesreel hi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Jesbel ruh u la kren ia U Trai, u da ong: Ki kulai kin bam ia u Jesbel da ka kynroh jong u Jesel .

en: But so shall it not be among you : but whosoever will be great among you , shall be your minister :
kha: Kane pat , kam dei ka rukom kaba long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumta kan ym long hapdeng jong phi: hynrei uno uno uba long uba khraw hapdeng jong phi un long u shakri jong phi:

en: But whosoever shall deny me before men , him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven .
kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , ngan kyntait ïa u ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ia nga ha khmat ki briew , ia u ruh ngan kyntait ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng .
