en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka kamra ka Dorbar , bad nangta ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la hukum ia ki ban leit noh na ka dorbar , ki la ia kren para ma ki .

en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit  ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .
kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah ki ju pyrkhat borabor ba ki long kiba stad , hynrei u briew uba duk , uba don ka jingsngewthuh shaphang ka jinglongbriew u tip kham bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U riewspah u long uba stad ha la ka jong ka jaka sah ; hynrei u baduk uba don ka jingsngewthuh u wad ia u .

en: And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .
kha: Ki la wan sha Bethsaida , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha U Jisu ïa u briew uba matlah , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ktah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U wan sha Betsaida ; bad ki wanrah ia u briew uba matlah ha u, bad ki la kyrpad ia u ban ktah ia u .

en: His flesh is consumed away , that it cannot be seen  ; and his bones that were not seen stick out .
kha: Ka met jong u ka nang ringswai ; phi lah ban ïohi ïa ki shyieng jong u baroh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh jong u ka la jah noh , ba ym lah ban iohi ia ka ; bad ki shyieng jong u ki bym shym la iohi ki la mih noh .

en: For whether we be beside ourselves , it is to God : or whether we be sober , it is for your cause .
kha: Hato ngi da lamwir shisha ? Ka long na ka bynta U Blei . Lane hato ngi long kiba tipbriew ? Te ka long na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la ngi don hajan jong ngi, ka long ha U Blei : ne la ngi long kiba jemnud , ka long na ka bynta ka daw jong phi .

en: Thick clouds are a covering to him , that he seeth not  ; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven .
kha: Phi pyrkhat ki lyoh barben kin pynlong ba un ym lah ban ïohi , katba u ïaid halor ka sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyoh kiba jylliew ki long ka jingtap ia u , ba um iohi ia u ; bad u iaid ha ka lynti jong ka bneng .

en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns : but the way of the righteous is made plain .
kha: Lada phi jaipdeh , phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingeh kylleng , hynrei haba phi long uba trei minot , phin ym shem jingeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong u briew uba sniew ka long kum ka jingkhang jong ki tnat: hynrei ka lynti jong kiba hok ka long kaba shai .

en: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good : and whoso trusteth in the  Lord  , happy is he .
kha: Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , bad phin ïoh manbha ; shaniah ha U  Trai  bad phin long uba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pyniaid ia ka kam da ka jingstad un shem ia ka jingbha: bad uba shaniah ha U Trai , u long uba suk .

en: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit  ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
kha: U dieng uba plung bha u pynmih ki soh kiba bha , hynrei u dieng uba swai u pynmih ki soh kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba bha u pynmih ia ki soh kiba bha ; hynrei u dieng uba sniew u pynmih ia ki soh kiba sniew .

en: And he said , Which way shall we go up ? And he answered , The way through the wilderness of Edom .
kha: Na kano ka lynti ngin ïaid na ka bynta ka jingtur ïaleh ?   Ngin ïaid ïa ka lynti kaba jlan , lyngba ka ri khlaw Edom ,  u Joram u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kumno ngin leit shaneng ? Bad u la jubab , Ka lynti lyngba ka ri khlaw jong u Edom .

en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :
kha: me tap ïa lade da ka jingshai . Me pyiar ïa ki bneng kum ka ïingjaiñ
translated_en_to_kha: Uba tap ia lade da ka jingshai kum ka jain: uba pynjrong ia ki bneng kum ka jingtap:

en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , longsuffering , gentleness , goodness , faith ,
kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u pynmih ïa ka jingieit , ka jingkmen , ka jingsuk , ka jingïaishah , ka jinglehsbun , ka jingbha , ka jingïaineh , ka jingsngewrit , bad ka bor halor lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u soh jong U Mynsiem u long ka jingieit, ka jingkmen, ka jingsuk, ka jingsngewrit, ka jingbha, ka jingngeit .

en: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death .
kha: Namar ka hukum jong U Mynsiem kaba wallam ka jingim ïa ngi ha U Khrist Jisu , ka la pyllait ïa nga na ka hukum jong ka pop bad ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hukum U Mynsiem jong ka jingim ha U Khrist Jisu u la pyllait ia nga na ka hukum ka pop bad ka jingiap .

en: Chitrakoot is not just a place , but is a place that depicts life of the ancient society of India .
kha: Ka Chitrakoot kam dei tang ka jaka hynrei ka dei ka jaka kaba pyni ia ka jingim jong ka imlang sahlang hyndai jong ka Ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Chitrakoot kam dei tang ka jaka , hynrei ka dei ka jaka kaba pyni ia ka jingim jong ka imlang sahlang hyndai jong ka ri India .

en: And they said unto him , Sit down now , and read it in our ears . So Baruch read it in their ears .
kha: To shong ,  ki la ong ,  bad to pule na ka kot kli ha ngi .  Te u Barukh u la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, To shong mynta, bad to pule ia ka ha ki shkor jong ngi . Kumta u Baruk u la pule ia ka ha ki shkor jong ki .

en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Ka kmie jong u ka pynbuh briew ïa u bad ka nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shong ha ka ri khlaw Paran : bad ka kmie jong u ka la shim ia u ka tnga na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa shispah khatkhyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nahor u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Terah shispah shiphew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Bolsonaro , 63 , has outraged many with his overtly misogynistic , homophobic and racist rhetoric .
kha: U Bolsonaro , 63 snem ka rta u la pynbitar ia kiba bun da ki jingkren bein kynthei , kiba bein ia ki para kynthei bad kiba iapher jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bolsonaro, 63 snem ka rta, u la bitar ia kiba bun bad ka jingkren bein kaba jur bha jong u.

en: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .
kha: Naba ka pop ka siew ïa la ka bainong — ka jingïap ; hynrei ka jingaiei jong U Blei ka long ka jingim bymjukut ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka bainong jong ka pop ka long ka jingiap ; hynrei ka jingai U Blei ka long ka jingim bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
kha: Ai ha uno uno uba pan na phi ïa kano kano , bad haba uno uno u shim ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong phi , wat pan shuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha uwei pa uwei uba pan na me; bad na uta uba shim noh ia ki mar jong me wat kylli shuh ia ki .

en: But when Herod heard thereof , he said , It is John , whom I beheaded : he is risen from the dead .
kha: Haba u Herod u la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la ong ,  U dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ! Nga la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u , hynrei u la im pat !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Herod u la iohsngew ia kata, u la ong, U long u loannis uba nga la khlieh: u la mihpat na kiba iap .

en: And it shall come to pass , when Pharaoh shall call you , and shall say , What is your occupation ?
kha: Haba u syiem u khot ïa phi bad u kylli phi ïatrei ïaktah aïu ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia haba u Pharaoh un khot ia phi bad un ong , Kaei ka kam jong phi ?

en: And returned from the sepulchre , and told all these things unto the eleven , and to all the rest .
kha: ki la leit phai noh na ka jingtep , bad ki la ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran bad ha baroh kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan phai na ka jingtep bad u la iathuh ia kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki shiphew ngut bad ha kiwei pat .

en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
kha: ‘ Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait im ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong me uba la wanrah ia me na ka ri Ijipt , na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw .

en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days  ; and it was noised that he was in the house .
kha: Hadien katto katne sngi U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha Kapernam , bad ka khubor ka la phriang ba u la don ha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la rung ha Kaparnaum hadien katto katne sngi ; bad la iohsngew ba u don ha iing .

en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .
kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Kam ju dei ka dustur hangne ban ai shuwa ïa ka khun khatduh ban shongkurim ha shuwa ka hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong , Kam dei ban long kumta ha ka ri jong ngi , ban ai ia uba kham rit shuwa u khun nyngkong .

en: The seven good kine are seven years  ; and the seven good ears are seven years : the dream is one .
kha: Ki hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki snem , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met ruh ki long ruh ki hynñiew tylli ki snem ; ki don kajuh ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew tylli ki sniang kiba bha ki long hynriew snem ; bad ki hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba bha ki long hynriew snem: ka jingphohsniew ka long kawei .

en: And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .
kha: U  Trai  u la pyntip ha nga ïa ki jingthmu sniew kiba ki nongshun jong nga ki la thaw pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ai jingtip ia nga shaphang kata, bad nga tip ia ka: nangta me la pyni ia nga ia ki jingleh jong ki .

en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .
kha: Yn tep ïa u kumba tep ïa u kada , un sa shah ring bad bret ïa u shabar ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn tep ia u da ka jingtep ia u kada , la ring bad bret noh shabar ki khyrdop Jerusalem .

en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him , and he heareth the cry of the afflicted .
kha: Ki pynbor ïa kiba duk ban kyrpad jam sha U Blei , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki pynlong ia ka jingpyrta jong kiba duk ban wan sha u , bad u iohsngew ia ka jingpyrta jong kiba shah shitom .

en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .
kha: Haba u bieit u rkhie , ka long kum ka jingsawa ki dieng shiah ha ka ding . Kam don jingmut ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka jingkhih jong ki tnat hapoh ka umphniang, kumjuh ruh ka jingrkhie jong u bieit: kane ruh ka long kaba sniew .

en: For when God made promise to Abraham , because he could swear by no greater , he sware by himself ,
kha: Haba U Blei u la pynlong ka jingkular ha u Abraham , u la smai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular . Namar ym don uwei ruh u ban kham khraw ban ïa u , u la pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka kyrteng haba u la pynlong ïa la ka jingsmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba U Blei u la kular ia u Abraham , namar ba um lah ban smai da kaba kham khraw , u la sngap jar da lade , .

en: Nevertheless God , that comforteth those that are cast down , comforted us by the coming of Titus ;
kha: Hynrei U Blei , uba pynshlur ïa kita kiba la duh jingkyrmen , u la pynshlur ïa ngi da ka jingwan u Titos .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh U Blei uba pyntngen ia kito kiba shah pynhap , u la pyntngen ia ngi da ka jingwan jong u Titus ; .

en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .
kha: Wat shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad shah ïa uta u para Israel jong phi ban shong marjan bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shim ia ka jingmyntoi jong u, ne pynbun: hynrei to sheptieng ia U Blei jong me ; ba u hynmen jong me un im bad me .

en: Then will I make their waters deep , and cause their rivers to run like oil , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan shah ïa ki um jong me ban long jai jai bad ngan pynlong sngur bad ngan shah ïa ki wah jong me ba kin tuid jai jai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan pynlong ia ki um jong ki kiba jylliew , bad ngan pynlong ia ki wah jong ki ban tuid kum ka umphniang , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And they watched him , whether he would heal him on the sabbath day  ; that they might accuse him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew kiba don hangta ki kwah ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u leh bymdei ; kumta ki la peit bha ïa u bad khmih lada un pynkhiah ïa uta u briew ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la peit ia u , la un pynkoit ia u ha ka sngi Sabha ; ba kin kynnoh ia u .

en: For it is better , if the will of God be so , that ye suffer for well doing , than for evil doing .
kha: Naba ka kham bha ban shahshitom haba leh ïa kaba bha , lada kane shisha ka long ka mon U Blei , ban ïa kaba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kham bha lada ka mon U Blei ka long kumta, ba phin shah shitom na ka bynta ka jingleh bha, ban ia kaba leh sniew .

en: But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .
kha: Bad ha kane ka rukom phin leh pop pyrshah ïa U Khrist keiñ da kaba leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki parabangeit bad pynmong ïa ka jingïatiplem batlot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phi leh kumta pyrshah ia ki para bangeit bad pynmynsaw ia ka jingsngew ba tlot jong ki, phi leh pop pyrshah ia U Khrist .

en: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months .
kha: bad u la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah hynñiew snem shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ba u Dabid u long syiem ha Hebron halor ka iing Judah ka long hynriew snem hynriew bnai .

en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant : there have they dealt treacherously against me .
kha: Hynrei ki tang mar ïarung ïa ka ri ha Adam , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki long kum ki briew kiba la pynkhein ia ka jutang: hangta ki la leh bein ia nga .

en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses , whom the  Lord  knew face to face ,
kha: Ym pat ju don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel uba kum u Moses ; U  Trai  u ïakren bad u markhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym shym la mih u nongiathuhlypa naduh ha Israel kum u Moses , ia uba U Trai u la ithuh markhmat , .

en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the  Lord .
kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ïabam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi men bam ia u kpu khlem thied bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kan long ka jingkhawai niam ia U Trai .

en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him , he gave commandment to depart unto the other side .
kha: Haba u Jisu u la ïohi ïa u paidbah sawdong jong u , u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba U Jisu u la iohi ia ki paidbah kiba bun shaphang jong u , u la ai hukum ban leit noh sha kawei pat ka liang .

en: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me , they have also let loose the bridle before me .
kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga uba tlot bad u bym lah leh ei ei , ki phai pyrshah ïa nga da ka jingbitar jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u la pyllait ia ka lynti jong nga, bad u la pynshitom ia nga, ki la pyllait ruh ia ka sniehdoh ha khmat jong nga .

en: But the voice answered me again from heaven ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
kha: Ka sur ka la kren biang na bneng , ‘ Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka sur ka la jubab biang ia nga na bneng , Kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhuid , kata wat khot ia me .

en: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .
kha: U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit bad u la thoh ,  Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ïoannis .  A katno baroh ki la ïasngew kyndit !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pan ia ka miej thoh, bad u la thoh, u da ong, Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u loannis . Bad ki la lyngngoh baroh .

en: In the light of the king s countenance is life  ; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain .
kha: Ka jingshem sngewbha u syiem ka long kum ki lyoh kiba wanrah slap ha ka por pyrem — don ka jingim hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingshai jong u syiem ka long ka jingim ; bad ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum u lyoh jong u slap uba hadien .

en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .
kha: Namar ba U Jisu Khrist u la leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , ïa ngi baroh la pynkhuid na ka pop da ka jingainguh kaba u la aiti ïa la ka jong ka met tang shisien hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kata ka long kaba la pynkyntang lyngba ka jingaiti ia ka met U Jisu Khrist shisien na ka bynta baroh .

en: So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
kha: Ka kynhun shipai jong u Dabid ka la leit sha rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la leit sha lyngkha pyrshah ia ki Israel : bad ka thma ka la don ha u dieng Ephraim ; .

en: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved , and the cry is heard among the nations .
kha: Haba ka Babilon ka kyllon , kan don ka jingsawa ka ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , bad ïa ki jingïam pynkyndit yn ïohsngew da kiwei ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ka jingshim ia ka Babilon ka pyrthei ka khih , bad la iohsngew ia ka jingpyrta hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

en: Deputy Leader of Congress in Rajya Sabha Shri Anand Sharma was also on the dais at the book release
kha: U Deputy Leader ka Congress ha Rajya Sabha u Shri Anand Sharma ruh u la don ha ka madan ha kane ka jingpyllait kot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Deputy Leader ka Congress ha Rajya Sabha u Shri Annd Sharma ruh u la don ha madan ha ka por ba pyllait ia ka kot .

en: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul : but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil .
kha: Katno ka long kaba sngewtynnat ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ! Ki briew kiba mutlop ki kyntait ban phai noh na kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah kaba la pyndep ka long kaba sngewtynnad ia ka mynsiem: hynrei ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki bieit ban phet noh na kaba sniew .

en: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,
kha: U la leit lyngba kito ki thain bad u la pynshlur ïa ki briew da ki khubor kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la leit sha ki bynta , bad u la ai jingkyrpad shibun ia ki , u la wan sha Greece , .

en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee , into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them .
kha: Ki khatwei ngut ki synran ki la leit sha u lumrit ha Galilaïa ha kaba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la leit noh sha Galilaia, sha u lum ha kaba U Jisu u la thung ia ki .

en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .
kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïakhih pyrshah , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang jong ki briew kiba shong shnong ha ka ri Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun Israel kiba shong ha ki shnong Judah , u Rehoboam u la synshar halor jong ki .

en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por haba ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei mynta u hukum ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phai noh ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki por jong kane ka jingbymtip U Blei u la lyngngoh ha ka ; hynrei mynta u hukum ia ki briew baroh hangno hangno ba kin kylla bamut:

en: Wherefore , sirs , be of good cheer : for I believe God , that it shall be even as it was told me .
kha: Kumta , ko ki rangbah , to sngew shlur ! Naba nga shaniah ha U Blei ba kan long thik kumba la ïathuh ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko sahep, to long kiba sngewbha: namar nga ngeit ia U Blei, ba kan long kumba la iathuh ia nga .

en: If I laughed on them , they believed it not  ; and the light of my countenance they cast not down .
kha: Nga phuh samrkhie ha ki haba kim don jingshaniah ; ka khmat ba-ikmen jong nga ka pynshlur ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga rkhie bein ia ki , kim ngeit ia kata; bad ka jingshai jong ka khmat jong nga kim ju pynhap .

en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .
kha: To ngin long shlur , te , bad ong ,  U Trai u long u nongïarap jong nga , ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah ban leh ei ei ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba ngin ong da ka jingshlur , U Trai u long u nongiarap jong nga , bad ngan ym tieng ia kaei kaba u briew un leh ia nga .

en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .
kha: Phi tip thikna kumno ban ïabeh nadien ki nongleh-ieit . Wat ki kynthei kiba sniew eh ki lah ban ïoh jinghikai na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me pyrkhat ia ka lynti jong me ban wad ia ka jingieit ? namar kata me ruh me la hikai ia ki bymman jong me .

en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue : and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof .
kha: Kaei kaba phi ong ka lah ban ri ïa ka jingim lane pynjot ïa ka ; te phi dei ban pdiang ïa ki soh kiba mih na ki ktien jong hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiap bad ka jingim ki don ha ka bor jong ka shyntur: bad kito kiba ieit ia ka kin bam ia u soh jong ka .

en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad u la pan ïa ka met U Jisu . U Pilat u la hukum ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad u la kyrpad ia ka met U Jisu . Nangta u Pilat u la hukum ia ka met ban shah pynpoi .

en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki nong Ijipt kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia ki nong Ijipt hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan pynphriang ia ki lyngba ki ri .

en: And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .
kha: Nangta ngan sa weng noh ïa ka kti jong nga , bad men sa ïohi ïa ka ingdong jong nga ym ïa ka khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan weng noh ia ka kti jong nga, bad me phin iohi ia ki bynta ba shadien jong nga: hynrei ka khmat jong nga kan ym paw .

en: I have said to corruption , Thou art my father : to the worm , Thou art my mother , and my sister .
kha: Ngan sa khot ïa ka jingtep , u kpa jong nga , bad baroh ki ksaiñ kiba bam ïa nga ngan khot ïa ki ba ki dei ka kmie bad ki para kynthei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong ia ka jingbamsap , Me long u kpa jong nga: ha u khniang , Me long ka kmie jong nga bad ka para jong nga .

en: And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .
kha: U  saihon bad u barli ki la duh khoit , namar u barli u la ih bad u  saihon pat u dang shylluit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka flax bad u barli ka la tyrkhong: namar u barli u la don ha ka shkor , bad u flax u la tyrkhong .

en: And David sware unto Saul . And Saul went home  ; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold .
kha: U Dabid u la kular ba un leh kumta . Nangta u Saul u leit phai sha ïing , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai biang sha la ka jakarieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit phai sha u Saul . U Saul u la leit phai noh sha la iing hynrei u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la leit sha ka jaka ba la bat .

en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .
kha: U Jisu u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la U Jisu u la kren shaphang ka jingiap jong u: hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u la kren shaphang ka jingjahthait ha ka jingthiah .

en: Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .
kha: Ki shipai ki la leh ïa kaba la hukum ïa ki . Ki la shim ïa u Paul bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha kata ka miet haduh Antipatris .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shipai kumba la hukum ia ki, ki la ialam ia u Paul bad ki la wanrah ia u ha ka por miet sha Antipatris .

en: Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan .
kha: Phin tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jong phi haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  jong ka pyrthei baroh kan jam ïa ka Jordan ha shuwa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka synduk jong ka jutang jong U Trai jong ka khyndew baroh ka iaid ha khmat jong phi sha Jordan .

en: It hath been said , Whosoever shall put away his wife , let him give her a writing of divorcement :
kha: La ong ruh , ‘ Uno uno uba pyllait ïa la ka tnga u dei ban ai ïa ka , ka jingthoh pynbna ïa ka jingpyllait tnga .’
translated_en_to_kha: La ong , Uno uno uba weng noh ia ka tnga jong u , to un ai ia ka ia ka jingthoh jong ka jingpyniakhlad:

en: The voice of my beloved ! behold , he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .
kha: Phim tip seh ïa ka jaka , ko kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynthei ? Khie leit bad bud ïa ka kynhun langbrot ; to wad ïa ki pyntha phlang na ka bynta ki blang jong phi hajan ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongap langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong u baieit jong nga ! ha khmih , u wan jngi halor ki lum , u wan jngi halor ki lum .

en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .
kha: Haba u Joseph u la wan ha ki mynstep , u la ïohi ba ki leh diaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la wan rung sha ki mynstep bad u la peit ia ki bad, ha khmih, ki la sngewsih .

en: Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
kha: Nangta nga ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to keiñ noh ! Kumno ki briew jong me ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong, ko Trai Blei, to sangeh noh, nga kyrpad ia me: da mano u Jakob un mih ? namar u long uba rit .

en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all the days of Jehoiada the priest .
kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  katba u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai baroh ki sngi jong u Jehoiada u lyngdoh .

en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me : as soon as they hear , they shall be obedient unto me .
kha: Ki nongwei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong nga ; haba ki ïohsngew ïa nga , ki kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongwei kin aiti ia lade ha nga: tang shu iohsngew , kin kohnguh ia nga .

en: And when I looked , behold , an hand was sent unto me  ; and , lo , a roll of a book was therein  ;
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kti ba la kner sha nga bad ka bat ïa ka kot kli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga peit, ha khmih, la phah ia ka kti sha nga ; bad, ha khmih, ka roll jong ka kot ka la don hangta ; .

en: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .
kha: Ki phai bad ki leit noh , bad ki khynnah , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la phai bad ki la leit noh , bad ki la buh ia ki khynnah rit bad ki masi bad ka kali ha khmat jong ki .

en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
kha: Uno uno u lah ban kiew na ka jingduk ban long u syiem jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban leit na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long uba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka jingaibuit , um long uba kham bha kum u samla uba duk hynrei uba shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta na ka phatok u wan ban synshar ; katba uta ruh uba la kha ha ka hima jong u u kylla duk .

en: The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :
kha: u khun jong u Abishua , u khun jong u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar , u khun jong u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Abisha u khun u Phinehas u khun u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u rangbah lyngdoh:

en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingshlur jong nga . Dei U Blei , ym ka jingdum , kata kaba pynlong ïa nga ban sheptieng — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ngam shym la shah ot ha khmat ka jingdum , bad um shym la tap ia ka jingdum na ka khmat jong nga .

en: And their eyes were opened  ; and Jesus straitly charged them , saying ,  See that no man know it .
kha: bad ïa ka jingïohi jong ki la pynïoh pat . U Jisu u la maham jur ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh ïa kane hano hano ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong ki ki la plie ; bad U Jisu u la kynnoh jur ia ki, u da ong: Peit ba ym don ba tip ia kata .

en: The hay appeareth , and the tender grass sheweth itself , and herbs of the mountains are gathered .
kha: Phi ot ïa u jyntang bad nangta ot ïa u phlang ha ki sharing lum katba u jyntang ba dang lung u dang san .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sboh ki paw , bad ki phlang kiba jem ki paw hi , bad ki jingthung jong ki lum ki lum .

en: He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Men dang ïohi ïa ki ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ruh ha nga , To phai biang sha Me , bad men sa iohi ia ki jingleh bymman kiba kham khraw kiba ki leh .

en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself : but the simple pass on , and are punished .
kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad ki kynriah na ka , hynrei u briew u bym pyrkhat un ïaid beit ha ka bad un babe kylla hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u iohi lypa ia ka jingsniew, bad u buhrieh ia lade: hynrei kiba suk ki iaid shakhmat , bad ki shah pynshitom .

en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka burom kaba me la ai ha nga , khnang ba kin long kawei , kumba ma me bad nga ngi long kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka burom kaba me la ai ha nga nga nga la ai ha ki ; ba kin long kawei, kumba ngi long kawei:

en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness , which causeth through us thanksgiving to God .
kha: Un pynriewspah ïa phi borabor kat ban biang ban lehsbun ha ki por baroh , khnang kiba bun kin ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ki jingai jong phi ïa kiba ki la ïohpdiang na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong riewspah ha kiei kiei baroh ha ka jingaiei baroh , kaba pynlong lyngba jong ngi ban ainguh ia U Blei .

en: The  Lord  is good , a strong hold in the day of trouble  ; and he knoweth them that trust in him .
kha: U  Trai  u long uba bha ; u ïada ïa ki briew jong u ha ki por ka jingjynjar ; u ri sumar ïa kito kiba phai sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long uba bha , uba skhem ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar ; bad u tip ia kito kiba shaniah ha u .

en: And all Judah stood before the  Lord  , with their little ones , their wives , and their children .
kha: Baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , ryngkat bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah baroh u la ieng ha khmat U Trai, bad ki khun rit jong ki, ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki .

en: However , water level in most of the rivers in the district also swelled up following heavy rains .
kha: Hynrei ka um ha kiba bun ki wah ha ka distrik ruh ka la kiew hadien ka jingjur jong u slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka um ha kiba bun ki wah ha ka distrik ruh ka la kiew hadien u slap uba jur .

en: Doth not behave itself unseemly , seeketh not her own , is not easily provoked , thinketh no evil ;
kha: ka jingieit kam leh khlem akor lane wad ïa la ka jingmyntoi lane khapnap ; ka jingieit kam ju buh jingkynmaw ïa ki jingbakla ;
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leh khlem akor ia lade, wat wad ia la ka jong ka jong ka jaka, ym da kaba suk ban pynkhih, wat pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew ;

en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san , ai khyndai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba phra hynniew tylli ki masi, ar tylli ki langbrot bad shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem da don jaka:

en: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel , they gathered themselves together .
kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , bad kumta ki lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki Syria ki la iohi ba ki la shah pynshitom ha khmat ki Israel , ki la ialum lang .

en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon : and the people were very faint .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki Israel ki jop ïa ki Philistia , ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti naduh Mikhmash haduh Aijalon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia ki Philistia ha kata ka sngi naduh Michmash haduh Aijalon : bad ki briew ki la lyngngoh shibun .

en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
kha: Kumba da shisha u ong ha kawei pat ka bynta :   ‘ Men ym shah ïa u shakri baneh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u ong ruh ha kawei pat ka Salm , Me dei ban shah ia U Bakhuid jong me ban iohi ia ka jingbamsap .

en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .
kha: Ki briew kiba bymman da shisha kim ïohnong ei ei , hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ka pynthikna ba phin ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman u trei ia ka kam kaba thok: hynrei ha uta uba bet ia ka hok kan long ka bainong kaba thikna .

en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron  ; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter s vessel .
kha: Men pynkheiñ ïa ki da u diengduh nar ; men pynpra ïa ki lyngkhot lyngkhai kum ïa u khiew khyndew .’
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pynpra ia ki da u dieng nar ; me dei ban pynpra ia ki kum ka umphniang .

en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .
kha: To lehkmen , ko ka khyndew bad ka sahit bneng ! To kyrhuh , ko ka duriaw bad baroh ki jingthaw ba don ha pha ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki bneng kin kmen, bad ai ba ka khyndew kan sngewbha ; ai ba ka duriaw kan khih, bad ka jingdap jong ka .

en: Behold , God is great , and we know him not , neither can the number of his years be searched out .
kha: Ngim lah ban tip lut ïa ka jingkhraw jong u lane ñiew ïa jingbun ki snem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih U Blei U long uba khraw bad ngim ithuh ia u , bad ym lah ban wad ia ka jingbun ki snem jong u .

en: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh ; but he of the freewoman was by promise .
kha: Hynrei U  khun jong u , uba na ka kynthei mraw la kha katba kum ka rukom briew ; hynrei ïa u khun jong u na ka kynthei kaba laitluid la kha ha ka jingkular U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba long na ka kynthei ba la kha hadien ka doh ; hynrei ma u na ka kynthei laitluid u la long da ka jingkular .

en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .
kha: Bad ynda U Nongaplangbrot Rangbah un paw , phin ïohpdiang ïa ka pansngiat badonburom kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u Nongaplangbrot uba ha khlieh duh un paw , phin pdiang ia ka khlieh jong ka burom kaba ym jah noh .

en: For as often as ye eat this bread , and drink this cup , ye do shew the Lord s death till he come .
kha: Kane ka mut ba man ba phi bam ïa une u kpu bad phi dih na kane ka khuri phi pynbna ïa ka jingïap U Trai tad ynda un wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba phi dang bam ia une u kpu bad dih ia kane ka khuri , phi pyni ia ka jingiap jong U Trai haduh ba un da wan .

en: And heal the sick that are therein , and say unto them , The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
kha: pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ha kata ka shnong , bad ong ha ki briew hangta , ‘ Ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynkoit ia kiba pang kiba don hangta, bad ong ha ki , Ka hima U Blei ka wan hajan jong phi .

en: Be not righteous over much  ; neither make thyself over wise : why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
kha: Kumta te wat long uba bha palat ne uba stad palat — balei yn pynïap ïa lade hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long uba hok palat ia lade bad wat pynlong ia lade uba stad palat: balei phi dei ban pynjot ia lade ?

en: But if ye have respect to persons , ye commit sin , and are convinced of the law as transgressors .
kha: Hynrei lada phi ñiew ïa ki briew kat kum ba ki paw shabar , phi long ba la rem ha ka pop , bad ka hukum ka pynrem ïa phi kum u nongpynkheiñ hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi don ka jingburom ia ki briew , phi leh pop bad phi sngewskhem ia ka hukum kum ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .
kha: Phi pynlong ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jong nga u long kum ka ding ka ban pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin kha ia u sohjew, phin pynmih ia u sohjew: ka jingsawa jong phi kum ka ding kan bam ia phi .

en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  departed from Saul , and an evil spirit from the  Lord  troubled him .
kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u Saul , bad u mynsiem bymman ba la phah da U  Trai  u pynjynjar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem U Trai u la leit noh na u Saul , bad ka mynsiem kaba sniew na U Trai ka la pynkhuslai ia u .

en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to lum lang ia ka jingiaseng baroh sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: But Abimelech had not come near her : and he said , Lord , wilt thou slay also a righteous nation ?
kha: Hynrei u Abimelekh um pat shym la leit hajan jong ka bad u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , ngam shym tip ! Hato men shu pynïap ïa nga bad ïa ki briew jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abimelech um shym la wan hajan jong ka : bad u la ong: Ko Trai , me pyniap ruh ia ka jaitbynriew kaba hok ?

en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before , that ye might have a second benefit ;
kha: Nga la sngewthikna bha shaphang kane baroh kumta nga la buh ki jingthmu nyngkong eh ban wan jngoh ïa phi , khnang ba phin ïoh jingkyrkhu ar shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kane ka jingshaniah nga la thmu ban wan sha phi mynshuwa , ba phin ioh ia ka jingmyntoi kaba ar ; .

en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel .
kha: Te U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la iasoh bad u Baalpeor: bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;
kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban thaw ïa ki jingrwai , kumba u Dabid u la thaw , bad tem ïa ki ha ki duitara .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pyrta ia ka sur jong ka viol , bad ka thaw ia lade ia ki tiar jong ka jingrwai , kum u Dabid ; .

en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .
kha: Ki shylluit , ki tnat , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban long kiba ïadait lang kawei bad kiba la shu shoh da ka ksiar nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki knop jong ki bad ki tnat jong ki kin long kumjuh: baroh kan long kawei ka kam ksiar kaba khuid .

en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .
kha: Nangta ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da ki poh jat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la pynpra ia ki kulai kiba la tyrkhong da ki jingpynbthei , ki jingpynbthei jong ki kiba khlain bor jong ki .

en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning , saying , What city is like unto this great city !
kha: bad ki la lynñiar jam haba ki la ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej dieng kiba la bam duh ïa ka :  Ym pat ju don kawei pat ka nongbah kum kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la iam haba ki la iohi ia ka tdem jong ka ba ka thang ia ka, ki da ong: Kaei ka nongbah kaba kum kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !

en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .
kha: Ki nongbah ka Haran , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Asshur bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng bad pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haran, bad u Kanneh, bad u Eden, ki nongkhaii jong u Sheba, u Asshur bad u Chilmad ki long ki nongkhaii jong me .

en: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body , and the visions of my head troubled me .
kha: Ki jingïohipaw ki la pynsheptieng ïa nga , bad la pynwit shikatdei eh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga Daniel nga la sngewsih ha ka mynsiem jong nga hapdeng ka met jong nga , bad ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong nga ki la pynkhuslai ia nga .

en: Hearken unto me , O Jacob and Israel , my called  ; I am he  ; I am the first , I also am the last .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa nga , ko Israel , ka jaitbynriew kaba nga la khot ! Nga long U Blei , Uba nyngkong , Uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga, ko Jakob bad ki Israel, nga la khot ia nga; nga long uba nyngkong, nga ruh nga long uba khatduh .

en: Then David took hold on his clothes , and rent them  ; and likewise all the men that were with him :
kha: U Dabid u kad ïa la ki jaiñkup ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ki briew jong u baroh ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la bat ia ki jain jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ki ; bad kumjuh ruh ia ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u:

en: It is not for kings , O Lemuel , it is not for kings to drink wine  ; nor for princes strong drink :
kha: To shahshkor , ko Lemuel . Ki syiem kim dei ban dih waiñ , lane kim dei ban thrang kyiad ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kam dei na ka bynta ki syiem , ko Lemel , kam dei na ka bynta ki syiem ban dih wain ; ne na ka bynta ki syiem kiba khlain:

en: For he is not a man , as I am , that I should answer him , and we should come together in judgment .
kha: Lada U Blei u dei u briew , ngan jin da la jubab ïa u , Ngi lah ban leit sha ka ïingbishar ban rai ïa ka jingïakajia jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar um dei u briew kumba nga long , ba ngan jubab ia u bad ngi dei ban iawan lang ha ka jingbishar .

en: And now I have told you before it come to pass , that , when it is come to pass , ye might believe .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane mynta ha shuwa ba baroh kan jia , ba kumta haba kata kan jia , phin ïoh ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga la iathuh ia phi shuwa ba kan jia, ba ynda ka la jia , phi lah ban ngeit .

en: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life  ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .
kha: Me la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba ïalam sha ka jingim , bad ka jingdon ryngkat jong me kan pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .’
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pyntip ha nga ia ki lynti jong ka jingim ; me pynlong ia nga ban dap da ka jingkmen da ka khmat jong me .

en: And the one went out from me , and I said , Surely he is torn in pieces  ; and I saw him not since :
kha: Uwei na ki u la iehnoh ïa nga . Khlem pep u la shah patar lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki mradkhlaw , namar ngam shym la ïohi shuh ïa u naduh ba u mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u la mih noh na nga , bad nga la ong , Hooid u la shah pynpra bad ngam shym la iohi ia u naduh kata ka por:

en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
kha: Lada don uno uno uba bitar shen , to ai ba un shim ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . Lada phi pyllait ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap leh biang .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bitar shibun un shah pynshitom: namar lada me pyllait im ia u , hynrei me dei ban leh biang ia kata .

en: At that day ye shall ask in my name : and I say not unto you , that I will pray the Father for you :
kha: Haba kata ka sngi kan poi , phin pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ngam ong ba ngan pan na u na ka bynta jong phi , naba U Kpa da lade hi u ieit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi phin kylli ha ka kyrteng jong nga : bad ngam ong ha phi ba ngan duwai ia U Kpa na ka bynta jong phi:

en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him .
kha: Ki briew kiba pyrkhat tang ïa lade ki kyrkieh ban ïoh spah ha kaba kim tip lano ka jingduk kan lap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kyrkieh ban riewspah u don ka khmat kaba sniew bad um pyrkhat ba ka jingduk kan wan ha u .

en: Heshbon , and all her cities that are in the plain  ; Dibon , and Bamoth–baal , and Beth–baal–meon ,
kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Heshbon bad ki nongbah baroh ha ka jaka padun : ka Dibon , ka Bamoth Baal , ka Beth Baalmeon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Heshbon bad ki shnong jong ka baroh kiba don ha ka madan ; Dibon bad u Bamothbaal bad u Bethbaalmeon .

en: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .
kha: U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khor ïa ngi , bad u la kynnoh ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew uba long u kynrad jong ka ri u la kren lyngkot ia ngi bad u la shim ia ngi kum ki nongsyntiat jong ka ri .

en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
kha: Me ai ha u ïa ka jingjahthait na ki sngi ka jingjynjar haduh ban da tih ïa ka tliew ban ngat u bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban ai jingjahthait ia u na ki sngi jong ka jingjynjar , haduh ba ka thliew kan da tih na ka bynta kiba sniew .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  A katno phi long kiba bakla ! Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki jingthoh bakhuid lane ïa ka bor U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Phi bakla, khlem da tip ia ki jingthoh ne ia ka bor U Blei .

en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory . I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .
kha: Nga dei ban sngewsarong , wat la kam wanrah jingbha ei ei . Hynrei ngan kren mynta shaphang ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingpynpaw ba la ai ha nga da U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam long kaba donkam ia nga khlem artatien ia ka burom . Ngan sa wan sha ki jingphohsniew bad ki jingpynpaw jong U Trai .

en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the  Lord  : it was the priests .
kha: Ïa ka pisa ba la ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh ba hap siew pat    bad na ka bynta ki jingkñia pop ym shym thep ha ka synduk ; ka dei ka jong ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pisa kaba palat bad ka pisa pop kam shym la wanrah ha iing U Trai: ka la long ki lyngdoh .

en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .
kha: Haduh mynta phim ju pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; to pan bad phin ïohpdiang , khnang ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh mynta phim shym la pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jong nga: kylli , bad phin sa pdiang , ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap .

en: The home minister said the governments decisions in Jammu and Kashmir would help the state develop .
kha: U myntri kam poh iing u la ong ba ki rai jong ka sorkar ha Jammu bad Kashmir kin iarap ia ka jylla ban kiew shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U myntri kam poh iing u la ong ba ki rai jong ki sorkar ha Jammu bad Kashmir kin iarap ia ka jylla ban kiew .

en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .
kha: U briew u dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum u tnga , bad ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tnga , bad ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba u tnga un ai ia ka tnga kaba dei: bad kumjuh ruh ia ka tnga ha u tnga .

en: Where no wood is , there the fire goeth out : so where there is no talebearer , the strife ceaseth .
kha: Khlem ka diengïap , ka ding ka lip noh ; khlem ka jinglorni , ka jingïakajia ka kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ym don dieng , hangta ka ding ka mih: kumta hangno ym don u nongrah jingiathuhkhana , ka jingialeh ka sangeh noh .

en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u :  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , namar ka hima ki bneng ka la jan !
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ialap bad ban ong: To kylla: namar ka hima bneng ka la jan .

en: The city police today claimed to have arrested the key accused among two in the double murder case .
kha: Ki pulit jong ka sor mynta ka sngi ki la kam ba ki la kem ia u nongshah kynnoh ba kongsan napdeng arngut ha ka mukotduma pyniap briew arsien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit jong ka nongbah mynta ka sngi ki la kam ba ki la kem ia u nongshah kynnoh ba kongsan napdeng arngut ha ka kam pyniap briew kaba arsien .

en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
kha: U syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa U  Trai  , bad ruh ban tei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la kut jingmut ban tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng U Trai bad ka iing na ka bynta ka hima jong u .

en: Look unto me , and be ye saved , all the ends of the earth : for I am God , and there is none else .
kha: To phai sha nga mynta bad ban im , ko ki briew baroh kylleng ka pyrthei ! Nga long tang ma nga U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit sha nga bad to long kiba la pynim ia phi, baroh ki kut jong ka khyndew: namar nga long U Blei bad ym don shuh .

en: And the desolate land shall be tilled , whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by .
kha: Baroh kiba ju ïaid narud ki lyngkha jong phi ki la ïohi ba kumno ba la san jrong bad ba la iehnoh khlaw ïa ki , hynrei ngan shah ba phin rep biang ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri kaba la jot kan sa kylla long kaba la jot ha khmat jong baroh kiba iaid lyngba .

en: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him : but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .
kha: Kiba hok ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki thrang , hynrei ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa kata kaba ki sheptieng eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia kiba sniew , kan wan ha u: hynrei ka jingkwah jong kiba hok kan long .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Whosoever hath sinned against me , him will I blot out of my book .
kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Dei ïa kito kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga kiba ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Uno uno uba la leh pop pyrshah ia nga , ia u ngan sa bret noh na ka kot jong nga .

en: When he raiseth up himself , the mighty are afraid : by reason of breakings they purify themselves .
kha: Haba u ïeng joit , wat kiba khlaiñ tam ki sheptieng ; kim lah leh ei ei namar ka jingtieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u pynkiew ia lade, kiba khlain bor ki tieng: namar ki jingtwa ki pynkhuid ia lade .

en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth , the noise of them that rejoice endeth , the joy of the harp ceaseth .
kha: bad ka sur bakmen jong ki duitara bad ki ksing jong ki ka la duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkmen jong ki taber ka sangeh noh, ka jingsawa jong kito kiba kmen ka kut noh, ka jingkmen jong ka harp ka sangeh noh .

en: And Moses said unto them , If ye will do this thing , if ye will go armed before the  Lord  to war ,
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada phi da mut shisha kumba phi ong , te hangne ha khmat U  Trai  to khreh ban leit sha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki , Lada phi leh ia kane ka kam , lada phi leit ialehkai ha khmat U Trai ban ialeh thma .

en: And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .
kha: Slem katno u la long kumne ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u .  Naduh ba u dang rit ,  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia la u kpa , Katno snem mynshuwa naduh ba kane ka la wan ha u ? Bad u la ong: Na u khynnah .

en: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .
kha: Men ym sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong me ; kiba bun ki briew kin kyrpad jingïarap na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh me ruh men thiah, bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pyntieng ia me;

en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee ? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?
kha: Don mano mano ba la pyn-i ha me ïa ki khyrdop kiba ap phira ïa ka pyrthei ba-dum jong kiba ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato la plie ia ki khyrdop jong ka jingiap ha me ? lane me la iohi ia ki jingkhang jong ka jingdum jong ka jingiap ?

en: Let that day be darkness  ; let not God regard it from above , neither let the light shine upon it .
kha: Pynkylla ïa kata ka sngi sha ka jingdum , A Blei . Wat kynmaw shuh ïa kata ka sngi ; Wat ai ba ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ pat halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kata ka sngi kan long ka jingdum ; wat ai ba U Blei un pyrkhat ia ka na jrong , lymne ai ba ka jingshai kan shai halor jong ka .

en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters , it shall be determined in a lawful assembly .
kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei shuh shuh kaba phi kwah , dei ban ïapynbeit ïa ka ha ka dorbar aiñ jong ki traishnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi kylli ia kano kano ka kam kaba iadei bad kiwei pat ki kam , yn sa pynbeit ha ka jingialang kaba long katkum ka ain .

en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,
kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u rangbah shipai u la tuklar bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai u Lysias u la wan ha ngi bad da ka jingleh donbor kaba khraw u la weng noh ia u na ki kti jong ngi .

en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :
kha: U Petros u la sdang ban kren :  Mynta nga sngewthuh ba ka long kaba shisha ba U Blei u ñiew kumjuh ïa uno uno baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la plie ia ka shyntur jong u , bad u la ong , Na ka jingshisha nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um don burom ia ki briew:

en: And when they had brought them , they set them before the council : and the high priest asked them ,
kha: Ki la wallam shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la pynïeng ïa ki ha ka Dorbar , bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ki, ki la buh ia ki ha khmat ka dorbar: bad u rangbah lyngdoh u la kylli ia ki .

en: And it came to pass , while he blessed them , he was parted from them , and carried up into heaven .
kha: Katba u dang kyrkhu ïa ki , u la leit noh na ki bad la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u dang kyrkhu ia ki, u la iakhlad noh na ki bad u la rah sha bneng .

en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .
kha: ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba dum , ne ïa ki jingsniew kiba pynïap haba shai ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka jingpang kaba iaid ha ka jingdum ; lane na ka bynta ka jingpynjot kaba la jah rngai noh ha ka por shiteng sngi .

en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la lah wan na Jerusalem ki la ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Pharisi bad katto katne na ki nongthoh kiba wan na Jerusalem .

en: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
kha: Haba u briew u smai , u pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong uno uno uba kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ka jingsmai ka pynbeit ïa baroh ki jingïatainia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew shisha ki sngap jar da kaba kham khraw: bad ka jingsmai na ka bynta ka jingpynskhem ka long ha ki ka jingkut jong ki jingialeh baroh .

en: And hath put all things under his feet , and gave him to be the head over all things to the church ,
kha: U Blei u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat U Khrist bad u la ai ïa u ha ka Balang kum U Trai uba ha khlieh duh halor kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u , bad u la ai ia u ban long u khlieh halor kiei kiei baroh ha ka balang .

en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .
kha: Kumta ka la pynshoi ïa u da ki jinglehieit jong ka , bad u la ngat ha ki ktien jali ja-um jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingkren kaba sngewtynnad jong ka ka la pynlong ia u ban aiti noh , da ka jingkyrhuh jong ki rmiang shyntur jong ka ka la pynbor ia u .

en: And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
kha: Nangta u shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; bad baroh ki la dih na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka khuri bad haba u la ainguh u la ai ia ka ha ki : bad baroh ki la dih na ka .

en: For there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; neither hid , that shall not be known .
kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la tap yn plied , bad ïa kano kano kaba rieh yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don ei ei kaba la tap , kaba ym lah ban pynpaw ; lymne ban buhrieh , kaba ym lah ban tip .

en: Surely the Lord  God  will do nothing , but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar um ju leh ei ei khlem da pynpaw ïa ka jingthmu jong u ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid U Trai Blei un ym leh ei ei , hynrei u pynpaw ia ka jingmaham jong u ha ki shakri jong u ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .
kha: Phi la pynïap bun bah ki briew hangne hapoh ka nongbah ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la pynbun ia ka jingpyniap jong phi ha kane ka nongbah , bad phi la pyndap ia ki lynti jong ka da kaba pyniap .

en: There came then his brethren and his mother , and , standing without , sent unto him , calling him .
kha: Nangta ka kmie U Jisu bad ki para jong u ki la wan poi . Ki la ïeng shabar jong ka ïing bad ki phah khubor shapoh , ban kylli shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki hynmen jong u bad ka kmie jong u, bad ki la ieng shabar, ki la phah sha u, ki khot ia u .

en: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .
kha: Ainong ïa uwei pa uwei baroh katba kum ki kam jong u , khnang ba ki briew jong me kin kohnguh ïa me ha ki por baroh katba ki dang im ha kane ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin sheptieng ia me baroh ki sngi ba ki im ha ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow ? or will he harrow the valleys after thee ?
kha: Hato me lah ban teh ïa u da u tyllai bad pynlur ïa u ? lane pynlong ïa u ban ring lyngkor ha ki lyngkha jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban teh ia u unicorn bad ka band jong u ha ka sniehdoh ? lane un pynkhih ia ki them hadien jong me ?

en: Thy silver and thy gold is mine  ; thy wives also and thy children , even the goodliest , are mine .
kha: U syiem Benhadad u dawa ba men aiti noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me , ïa ki kynthei bad ïa kiba khlaiñ tam na ki khun jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me ka long ka jong nga; ki tnga jong me ruh bad ki khun jong me, wat kiba bha tam, ki long ki jong nga .

en: ( For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel , until he had cut off every male in Edom : )
kha: Slem bah ha shuwa jong kane , mynba u Dabid u pynjot ïa ka Edom , u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , u la leit shata ban tep ïa kiba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: (Haduh hynriew bnai u Joab u la sah hangta bad ki Israel baroh, haduh ba un da ot noh ia uwei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom: )

en: And it came to pass afterward , that David s heart smote him , because he had cut off Saul s skirt .
kha: Hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong u Dabid ka sdang ban pynjynjar ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ka la jia ba ka dohnud u Dabid ka la khih ia u, namar u la ot noh ia u sohjew jong u Soul .

en: For I speak to you Gentiles , inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles , I magnify mine office :
kha: Nga kren mynta ha phi ki Jentil : Katba nga dang long u apostol sha ki Jentil , ngan sngewsarong ha ka kam jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kren ha phi ki Jutang , kumba nga long u apostol jong ki Jutang , nga pynkhraw ia ka kam jong nga:

en: Better is an handful with quietness , than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit .
kha: Ka lah ban long kumta , hynrei ka long kaba kham bha ban don tang khyndiat , bad ka jingpalei jingmut , ban ïa kaba bunkam shi lynter da ki kti baroh ar tylli , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long ka kti kaba jem bad kaba jem , ban ia baroh ar ki kti kiba dap da ka jingtrei shitom bad ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem .

en: And he said , Swear unto me . And he sware unto him . And Israel bowed himself upon the bed s head .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ,  Pynlong ka jingsmai ba phin leh kumta .  U Joseph u la pynlong ka jingsmai , bad u Jakob ruh u ainguh hangta ha jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To sngap jar ia nga . Bad u la sngap jar ia u . U Israel u la dem khrup ha ka khlieh jong ka jingthiah .

en: Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .
kha: U briew uba shahshkor ïa nga un suk — u briew uba ap man ka sngi ha jingkhang jong nga , uba ap ha jaka rung ka ïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta u briew uba iohsngew ia nga, uba peit man ka sngi ha ki khyrdop jong nga, uba ap ha ki post jong ki jingkhang jong nga .

en: If I speak of strength , lo , he is strong : and if of judgment , who shall set me a time to plead ?
kha: Hato ngan pyrshang da ka bor ? Hato ngan pyrshang da ka bor ïa U Blei ? Hato ngan rah ïa u sha ïingbishar ? Don uba lah ban pynlong ïa u ban leit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga kren shaphang ka jingkhlain , lo , u long uba khlain: bad lada ka long ka jingbishar , mano ba buh por ia nga ban kyrpad ?

en: The  Lord  our God be with us , as he was with our fathers : let him not leave us , nor forsake us :
kha: To U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un don ryngkat bad ngi , kumba u la don ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ; to un ym iehnoh ïa ngi lane lyndet ïa ngi ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong ngi un long bad ngi kumba u la long bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi: wat ai ba un iehnoh ia ngi:

en: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure  ; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury .
kha: Me long uba khuid ha kito kiba khuid , hynrei uba pyrshah ha kito kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba khuid men pyni ia lade uba khuid ; bad da kaba khuid men pyni ia lade uba khlem akor .

en: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .
kha: Kynsan kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh , bad ki jingat phyllung ki la sdang ban phaloh shapoh ka lieng , haduh ba ka la jan dap da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka eriong kaba jur bha bad ki um ki la beh shapoh ka lieng , haduh ba mynta ka la dap .

en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .
kha: U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki leh bad u leh ha ki kat kum kaba ki dei hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kam jong u briew un ai ha u , bad un pynlong ia uwei pa uwei ban shem kat kum ki lynti jong u .

en: Which say , It is not near  ; let us build houses : this city is the caldron , and we be the flesh .
kha: Ki ong , ‘ Shen ngin tei pat ïa ki ïing . Ka nongbah ka long kum u khiew shet , bad ngi long kum ka doh hapoh jong u , hynrei la kumno kumno u la ïada ïa ngi na ka ding .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ong , Kam don hajan shuh to ngin tei ia ki iing: kane ka shnong ka dei ka jaka ri jingri , bad ngi long ka doh .

en: And the king , and all the people that were with him , came weary , and refreshed themselves there .
kha: U syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la thait hi ïan haba ki la poi ha Jordan , bad ki la shong pynjahthait hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la wan lyngngoh bad ki la pynkmen ia lade hangta .

en: Then said Micah , Now know I that the  Lord  will do me good , seeing I have a Levite to my priest .
kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Mynta ba nga la don u Lebi kum u lyngdoh jong nga , nga tip ba U  Trai  un sa pynmanbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Mica u la ong , Mynta nga tip ba U Trai un leh bha ia nga , haba nga don u Lebi ha u lyngdoh jong nga .

en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
kha: Khmih shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ban kylli , nga kyrpad ia me, na ka rta kaba mynshuwa, bad pynkhreh ia lade ha ka jingwad ia ki kpa jong ki:

en: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam shapoh ha ka pliang bad la ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rah ïa ka sha la ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: La wanrah ia ka khlieh jong u ha ka jaka kaba heh , bad la ai ha ka dam: bad ka la wanrah ia ka ha ka kmie jong ka .

en: And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .
kha: Ki la teh ïa u ha ki kynjri , ki la ïalam ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u ha u Pilat , u lyngskor ka hima Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la teh ia u, ki la ialam noh ia u, bad ki la aiti ia u ha u Pontius u Lat .

en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .
kha: Nangta u Abraham u la ai katto katne tylli ki langbrot bad ki masi ha u Abimelekh , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki ïateh kular .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la shim ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad u la ai ia ki ha u Abimelech ; bad baroh arngut ki la leh ia ka jutang .

en: ( 1 Corinthians 15 :24 ) Why not tell your friends and loved ones about what God’s Kingdom will do ?
kha: ( 1 Korinth 15 :24 ) Te balei phim ïathuh lem ha la ki paralok bad kiba ieit ba thoiñ shaphang aiu ka Hima U Blei kan leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: (Corinth 15 :24 ) Balei phim iathuh ia ki paralok bad kiba ieit jong phi shaphang kaei kaba U Blei s Hima un leh ?

en: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me : now also will I give sentence against them .
kha: ka lyer kaba wan ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  kan long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa kata ! U dei U  Trai  hi uba pynbna ïa ka jingbishar halor ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka Iyer kaba pura na kita ki jaka kan wan sha nga: mynta ruh ngan ai jingpynshitom pyrshah ia ki .

en: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .
kha: Hato phi don ka tnga ? Te wat pyrshang ban iehnoh ïa ka . Hato phim pat shongkurim ? Te wat ym wad tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la shah teh ha ka tnga ? wad ban shah pyllait . Hato me la pyllait na ka tnga ? wat wad ia ka tnga .

en: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria : and Ahab his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Omri u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u Ahab u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Omri u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad la tep ia u ha Samaria : bad u Ahab u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him , and distressed him , but strengthened him not .
kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria , ha ka jaka ban ïarap ïa u Ahas , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad thaw jingeh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Tilgath pynkhlain ia u syiem Assyria u la wan sha u, bad u la pynsngewsih ia u, hynrei um shym la pynskhem ia u .

en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
kha: Uno uno uba leit sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïada , uno uno uba ïaisah hapoh ka jingkah jong U Badonbor Baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shong ha ka jaka rieh jong Uba ha khlieh duh un sah hapoh ka jingdum jong Uba donbor tam .

en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .
kha: Hynrei kawei ka kynthei ka pynhap najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka kynthei ka la bret ia u maw ha ka khlieh jong u Abimelech, bad baroh ban pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u .

en: And when he had said this , he breathed on them , and saith unto them ,  Receive ye the Holy Ghost :
kha: Nangta u la pyrsad halor jong ki bad u la ong ,  To pdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ong ia kane, u la ring mynsiem ia ki, bad u la ong ha ki: Pdiang ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: And he went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold therein , and them that bought  ;
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh ïa ki nongkhaïi da kaba ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit shapoh ka tempi bad u la sdang ban beh noh ia kita kiba die hangta bad ia kiba thied ; .

en: And Eleazar died , and had no sons , but daughters : and their brethren the sons of Kish took them .
kha: hynrei u Eleasar u la ïap khlem don khun shynrang ; u don tang ki khun kynthei . Ki khun kynthei jong u ki shongkurim ïa ki bakha jong ki , ki khun u Kish .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eleasar u la iap, bad um don khun shynrang hynrei ki khun kynthei: bad ki hynmen jong ki ki khun shynrang jong u Kish ki la shim ia ki .

en: And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Peit , ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ba ki synran jong me kin leh ïa kata ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ong ha u: Ha khmih, balei ki leh ha ka sngi Sabha ia kata kaba ym long katkum ka ain ?

en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon , that are high and lifted up , and upon all the oaks of Bashan ,
kha: Un pynjot ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba jrong jong ka Lebanon bad ïa ki dieng Sning baroh ha ka ri Bashan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki dieng Lebanon baroh kiba jrong bad kiba la pynkiew shaneng bad ha ki dieng Basan baroh .

en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .
kha: Nga tip ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba hok , A  Trai  , bad ba me la pynshitom ïa nga namar me long uba ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ko Trai, ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba dei, bad ba me ha ka jingngeit me la pynshitom ia nga .

en: If thine enemy be hungry , give him bread to eat  ; and if he be thirsty , give him water to drink :
kha: Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , bsa ïa u ; lada u sliang , ai um ba un dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u nongshun jong me u thngan, ai kpu ia u ban bam ; bad lada u sliang, ai um ia u ban dih:

en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .
kha: Ki la ïada ïa ngi mynsngi bad mynmiet ha ka por baroh ba ngi don bad ki haba ngi sharai ïa la ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la long ka kynroh ia ngi baroh arngut miet bad sngi , katba ngi dang don bad ki da kaba sumar ia ki langbrot .

en: And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
kha: Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha kata kajuh ka shnong kaba ïai wan sha u bad kyrpad na ka bynta ki hok jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïarap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïaleh pyrshah jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don kawei ka riewkynthei ha kata ka shnong ; bad ka la wan sha u, ka da ong: To pynbeit ia nga na u nongshun jong nga .

en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .
kha: Kin pyllait ïa phi na ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki briew , na ki kynthei kiba nang ban kren ïa ki ktien kiba pynshohbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin iada ia me na ka kynthei nongwei , na u nongwei uba sngewtynnad ia ki ktien jong ka .

en: I will lay thy cities waste , and thou shalt be desolate , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki nongbah jong me ha ki jingjot , bad ïa ka ri jong me kaba kynjah ; te men sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynjot ia ki nongbah jong me, bad me phin sa shah pynjot , bad me tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: To understand a proverb , and the interpretation  ; the words of the wise , and their dark sayings .
kha: kumta ba kin shemphang ïa ki jingmut kiba rieh kiba don ha ki proberb bad ki jingeh ba ki riewstad ki kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban sngewthuh ia ka proberb , bad ka jingbatai ; ki ktien kiba stad bad ki jingkren ba dum jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .
kha: Ngan phah sha jngai bah ïa ki briew bad ngan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la weng noh ia ki briew sha jngai , bad ka don ka jingkyntait kaba khraw hapdeng ka ri .

en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  The children of this world marry , and are given in marriage :
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ki shynrang bad ki kynthei jong kane ka juk ki ïashongkurim ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki: Ki khun jong kane ka pyrthei ki shongkurim bad la ai ha ka jingshongkurim:

en: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near , the tribe of Benjamin was taken .
kha: Te u Samuel u pynwan sha khmat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jait , bad U Trai u la jied ïa ka jait Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Samuel u la pynlong ia ki jait Israel baroh ban wan hajan , la shim ia ka jaitbynriew Benjamin .

en: Produce your cause , saith the  Lord   ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob .
kha: U  Trai  , u Syiem ki Israel , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Phi ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew , to buh ïa ka kam jong phi . Wallam ïa ki jingïasaid nia babha tam ba phi don !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynmih ia ka daw jong phi , ong u Trai ; u wanrah ia ki daw kiba khlain jong phi , ong u Syiem u Jakob .

en: And he saith unto me , Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book : for the time is at hand .
kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat bat kum kaba rieh ïa ki ktien ka jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka kitab , namar ka por ka la jan haba kane baroh kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha nga , Wat nym pynkhuid ia ki ktien jong kane ka kot: namar ka por ka la jan .

en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ; because thou hast obeyed my voice .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrkhu ïa ki kumba nga la kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me — baroh namar ba me la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u symbai jong me baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu ; namar me la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga .

en: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled , which he spake , signifying what death he should die .
kha: ( Kane ka la jia , khnang ba ki ktien jong U Jisu kin urlong da shisha , ki ktien kiba u pyndonkam mynba u la pynpaw ïa ka jingïap kaba kumno u dei ban ïap . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingong U Jisu kan long kaba la pyndep , kaba u la kren , kaba pynpaw ia kaei ka jingiap kaba u dei ban iap .

en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget  ; neither shall ye fear other gods .
kha: bad phim dei ban klet ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jutang kaba nga la leh bad phi phin ym klet; lymne phin ym tieng ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: Lay not wait , O wicked man , against the dwelling of the righteous  ; spoil not his resting place :
kha: Wat long kum ki riewsniew kiba thmu ban lute ïa u briew uba hok ne ban knieh noh ïa ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ap , ko briew uba sniew, pyrshah ia ka jaka shong jong u ; ba hok ba u la pynsniew ia ka jaka shongthait jong u:

en: Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka jingstad ka long kaei kaei kaba donkam tam ba phi dei ban leh . Nalor kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïoh , to ïoh ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka long kaba kongsan shuh shuh: bad da ka jingstad jong me baroh .

en: For I say unto you , I will not any more eat thereof , until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God .
kha: Naba nga ong ha phi , ngan ym bam shuh na ka tad ynda la ai ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka ha ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , ngan ym bam shuh ia ka , haduh ba kan da pyndep ha ka hima U Blei .

en: I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?
kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki long kum u ribon basawbthuh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba phi kren . Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la weng noh ia ka jainkup jong nga ; kumno ngan buh ia ka ? Nga la sait ia ki kjat jong nga ; kumno ngan pynjakhlia ia ki ?

en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .
kha: U tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kaba ki tnga nongwei jong u baroh kin ïoh thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh u la leh na ka bynta ki tnga bar ri jong u baroh , kiba thang ia ka jingiwbih bad ki la knia ha ki blei jong ki .

en: ( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
