kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ba ki briew ki don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar ym ki nongsngap ia ka hukum ki long tang ha khmat U Blei , hynrei ki nongleh ia ka hukum kin long kiba hok .

en: But the path of the just is as the shining light , that shineth more and more unto the perfect day .
kha: Ka lynti kaba kiba hok ki ïaid ka long kum ka jingmih ka sngi ; ka nang phyrnai nang phyrnai haduh ba kan da shai bha kum mynsngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka lynti jong kiba hok ka long kum ka jingshai kaba shai , kaba nang shai shuh shuh haduh ka sngi kaba janai .

en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son : but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father .
kha: U samla uba kohnguh ïa ka aiñ u dei uba stad . Uta uba ïalong paralok bad ki bymlarkam ei ei u pynjahburom ïa la u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sumar ia ka hukum u long u khun uba stad: hynrei uta uba long u paralok jong ki briew kiba shyrkhei u pynjah burom ia la u kpa .

en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .
kha: Lada phi long jai jai , phi long kiba stad , hynrei lada phi long kiba shit khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong mutlop phi long .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba slem ban bitar u long uba sngewthuh shibun: hynrei uta uba kyrkieh mynsiem u pynkiew stet ia ka mynsiem .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will break the bow of Elam , the chief of their might .
kha: U ong ,  Ngan pynïap ïa ki nongsiatkhnam kiba la pynlong ïa ka Elam ban long kaba khrawbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid; Ha khmih , ngan pynpra ia ka bow jong u Elam , u rangbah jong ka bor jong ki .

en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha khmat U  Trai  jong u Lum Sinai , Ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum ki la rkhiang na khmat U Trai , wat kata ka Sinai na khmat U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders , which is become the head of the corner .
kha: U Jisu u long uta ïa uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,   ‘ U maw uba ma phi ki nongtei phi la kyntait u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Une u dei u maw uba la buh ha ka jaka jong phi ki nongtei , uba kylla long u khlieh jong ka kut .

en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .
kha: Nga da lade ngan hikai ïa ki briew jong pha , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingmanbha bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki khun jong me kin shah hikai na U Trai ; bad ka long kaba khraw ia ka jingsuk jong ki khun jong me .

en: When Jesus saw their faith , he said unto the sick of the palsy ,  Son , thy sins be forgiven thee .
kha: Haba U la ïohi haduh katno ba ki don ka jingngeit , U Jisu u ong ha uta uba pang ïapshiliang ,  Ko khun jong nga , ïa ki pop jong me la map .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohi ia ka jingngeit jong ki , u la ong ha kiba pang ba pang , Ko Khun , ki pop jong me kin map ia me .

en: Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me , and save me .
kha: Namar me long uba hok , to ïarap ïa nga bad to pyllait ïa nga . To shahshkor ïa nga , bad to pynim ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh ia nga ha ka hok jong me, bad pynlong ia nga ban lait im: pynkhih ia ka shkor jong me ha nga, bad pynim ia nga .

en: Unto carpenters , and builders , and masons , and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house .
kha: Ki dei ban siew ïa ki misteri , ki nongtei , bad ki misteri maw , bad thied ïa ki dieng bad ki maw kiba pyndonkam ha kaba shna pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki nongshna dieng , bad ki nongtei , bad ki maw , bad ban thied dieng bad u maw ba la ot ban pynbha ia ka iing .

en: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew ha uta u paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Une u briew u dei da shisha u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun na ki briew namarkata haba ki la iohsngew ia kane ka jingong ki la ong , Na ka jingshisha une u long u Nongiathuhlypa .

en: And it was about the sixth hour , and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .
kha: Ka la long kumba khat-ar baje haba ka sngi ka la sangeh ban tyngshaiñ bad ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka ri baroh kawei haduh lai baje ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long kumba hynriew kynta , bad ka la don ka jingdum ha ka khyndew baroh kawei haduh ka por hynniew kynta .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,
kha: uba ha khappud ka hima Edom . Hangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron ha u lum Hor, ha rud duriaw jong ka ri Edom, u da ong:

en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?
kha: Ko Job , hato me pyrkhat ba ngim lah ban jubab ïa me ? Ba ki kyntien beiñ jong me kin ieh ïa ngi ban nym nang kren shuh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki jinglamler jong me ki dei ban pynlong ia ki briew ban bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki ? bad haba me sngap jar , hato ym don mano mano ruh kiba pynjah burom ia me ?

en: Then he said unto them ,  O fools , and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Katno kiba bieit phi long , katno phi long kiba suki ban ngeit ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki: Ko kiba bieit bad kiba slem ban ngeit ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki nongiathuhlypa ki la kren:

en: For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .
kha: Nga kwah ban ïohi ïa phi kham palat ban ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid lynti ; nga kyrmen ban pynlut shibun ka por bad phi , lada U Trai u shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ym iohi ia phi mynta da ka lynti ; hynrei nga shaniah ban sah katto katne por bad phi lada U Trai u shah .

en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave  ; and they mourned over him , saying , Alas , my brother !
kha: U tep ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep jong ka longïing jong u hi , bad ma u bad la ki khun shynrang ki ïam sngewsih ïa ka , ki da ong ,  O u para jong nga , u para jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka met jong u ha la ka jong ka jingtep ; bad ki la iam halor jong u, ki da ong: Alas, ko hynmen jong nga !

en: Therefore , brethren , we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith :
kha: Kumta , ha ki jingjynjar bad jingshahshitom jong ngi baroh , la pynshlur ïa ngi da ma phi , ko parabangeit . Ka dei ka jingngeit jong phi kaba la pynshlur ïa ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko para bangeit , ngi la shah pyntngen halor jong phi ha ka jingjynjar bad jingjynjar jong ngi baroh:

en: And she said unto him , I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah , which she bare unto Nahor .
kha: U kpa jong nga u dei u Bethuel u khun jong u Nahor bad ka Milkah ,  ka la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ong ha u, Nga long ka khun jong u Bethuel u khun u Milkah, kaba ka la kha ha u Nahor .

en: Desiring to be teachers of the law ; understanding neither what they say , nor whereof they affirm .
kha: Ki kwah ban long ki nonghikai ïa ka hukum U Blei , hynrei kim sngewthuh ïa la ki jong ki ktien lane shaphang kiei kiei ïa kaba ki kren da ka jingsngewskhem kaba haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah ban long ki nonghikai jong ka ain ; ka jingsngewthuh ym ia kaei kaba ki ong , ne ia kaba ki pynskhem .

en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses , saying , Behold , we die , we perish , we all perish .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ha u Moses ,  Te kata ka dei kaba kut ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la kren ha u Moses, ki da ong: Ha khmih ngi iap, ngi jah noh baroh .

en: Elihoreph and Ahiah , the sons of Shisha , scribes  ; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud , the recorder .
kha: Ki sekretari ka ïingbishar : U Elihoreph bad u Ahijah , ki khun jong u Shisha Uba khmih ïa ki dulir : U Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud
translated_en_to_kha: U Eihoreph bad u Ahiah, ki khun shynrang jong u Shisha, ki nongthoh ; Jehoshaphat u khun u Ahild .

en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?
kha: Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shaphang ki kam runar jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh katno por kin kren bad kren ia kiei kiei kiba eh ? bad ki nongtrei bymman baroh ki sngew sarong ia lade ?

en: I will be as the dew unto Israel : he shall grow as the lily , and cast forth his roots as Lebanon .
kha: Ngan long ïa ki paid Israel kum u slap ha ka dewryngkhiang . Kin phuh kum ki syntiew ; kin suhthied skhem kum ki dieng ha Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan long kum ka dewbilat ha Israel: un roi kum u lily , bad un bret noh ia ki tynrai jong u kum u Lebanon .

en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .
kha: Katno kan long kaba kmen haba uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung bad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha kylleng na ka bynta ki kada bad ki masi .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia phi kiba bet hajan ki um baroh , kiba phah shabar ia ki kjat jong u masi bad ka tdong .

en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .
kha: Ha kata ka por u syiem u la thung ïa u Mordekai ha ka kam synshar khadar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la lum lang ia ki khun masi ha ka sien kaba ar, nangta u Mordecai u la shong ha ka khyrdop syiem .

en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee , in making thee desolate because of thy sins .
kha: Te nga la dep sdang ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingpynpra ïa phi namar ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh ngan pynpang ia me ha kaba pynsniew ia me, ha kaba pynlong ia me ban jah noh namar ki pop jong me .

en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .
kha: Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka jingstad , bad lada phi kyntait ïa ka , phi hi phin shem jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me long uba stad, men long uba stad na ka bynta lade: hynrei lada me sngewsih , tang ma me hi men shah ia ka .

en: That they do good , that they be rich in good works , ready to distribute , willing to communicate ;
kha: To hukum ïa ki ba kin leh ïa kaba bha , ban man kyrhai ha ki kam babha , ban long kiba sbun bad kiba kloi ban ïasam bad kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki leh bha , ba ki long kiba riewspah ha ki kam kiba bha , kiba kloi ban sam , kiba kloi ban iakynduh ; .

en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin , the strength of Egypt  ; and I will cut off the multitude of No .
kha: Ngan shah ïa ka nongbah Pelusium , ka kut bakhraw jong ka Ijipt , ban mad ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Ngan pynjot ïa ka spah jong ka Thebes .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor ka pop, ka bor jong ka ri Ijipt ; bad ngan ot noh ia u paidbah jong u No .

en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently , that nothing be wanting unto them .
kha: To leh kaba bha tam ban ïarap ïa u Senas u riewsaid bad ïa u Apollos ba kin sdang ïa ki jingleit jong ki , bad khmih ba kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wanrah ia u nongiasaid ain bad u Apollos ha ka jingleit jong ki da kaba minot, ba ym don ei ei kaba kwah ia ki .

en: And I will make the land desolate , because they have committed a trespass , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ki la long ki bymïaineh ha nga , bad kumta ngan pynlong ka ri khlaw ïa ka ri .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ka ri kaba la jot , namar ki la leh ia ka jingleh bymman , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind , and the ointment of his right hand , which bewrayeth itself .
kha: Kumno phi lah ban pynsngap jar ïa ka ? Hato phi la ju pyrshang ban khang ïa ka lyer lane phi la ju pyrshang ban kham ha ka kti ïa ka umphniang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba buhrieh ia ka u buhrieh ia ka Iyer bad ka umphniang jong ka kti kadiang jong u kaba pynkhih ia lade .

en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .
kha: Ka jingsakhi lamler ka long kaba ma kum ka waitlam , u dieng tangon ne u khnam banep .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba kit ia ka sakhi kaba bakla pyrshah ia u paramarjan jong u u long u maul , bad ka waitlam bad u khnam uba jem .

en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
kha: kiba ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba bha bad rai pynrem ïa kiba lui lui sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum lang ia lade pyrshah ia ka mynsiem jong kiba hok , bad ki pynrem ia ka snam kaba khlem pop .

en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
kha: Pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kin dup long kiba khuid janai bad ïa uno uno ne kaei kaei kaba pyndei ïa ki yn pynmynsaw da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynkyntang ia ki, ba kin long kiba khuid tam: kaei kaei kaba ktah ia ki kan long kaba khuid tam .

en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,
kha: Ha u bnai bahynriew jong ka jingpunkhun jong ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la phah ïa u angel Gabriel sha ka shong ha Galilaïa kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew kaba hynriew la phah ia u angel Gabriel na U Blei sha kawei ka shnong Galilaia kaba kyrteng ka Nazareth .

en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab : for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly .
kha: U Ahasaïah u la long syiem haba u la don arphew ar snem ka rta , bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . U Ahasaïah ruh u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ka longïing jong u Syiem Ahab , naduh ba ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u — ka khun jong u syiem Ahab bad ka ksiew jong u Omri , u syiem ka Israel — ka la ai jingmut ïa u , kaba la ïalam sha ka jingsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid ruh ha ki lynti jong ka iing u Ahab: namar ka kmie jong u ka long ka nongai jingmut jong u ban leh sniew .

en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .
kha: Ka mut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren shaphang kaei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong namarkata , Kaei kane kaba u ong ? ngim lah ban iathuh ia kaei kaba u ong .

en: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .
kha: Haba ki briew basniew ki don ha ka bor synshar , ka kam sniew ka nang roi . Hynrei kiba hok kin im ban ïohi ïa ka jingkyllon jong kiba kum kita ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki bymman ki nang bun, ka jingpynkhein ka nang kiew: hynrei kiba hok kin iohi ia ka jinghap jong ki .

en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .
kha: U la phah ïa ki shakri jong u ban ïathuh ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ban wan sha ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim kwah ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia ki shakri jong u ban khot ia ki kiba la shah khot sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim: bad kin ym wan .

en: Let me not , I pray you , accept any man s person , neither let me give flattering titles unto man .
kha: Ngan ym shah liang ha kane ka jingïatainia ; ngan nym pynroh ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ngan pdiang ia uno uno u briew, lymne wat ai ba ngan ai ia ki kyrteng kiba sngewtynnad ia u briew .

en: And Jacob loved Rachel  ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .
kha: U Jakob u ïapmat ïa ka Rakhel , kumta u ong ,  Ngan trei hynñiew snem na ka bynta jong phi , lada phi shah ba ngan shongkurim ïa ka Rakhel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ieit ia ka Rakhel bad u la ong , Ngan shakri ia me hynriew snem na ka bynta ka Rakhel khun kaba kham rit jong me .

en: And Shaaraim , and Adithaim , and Gederah , and Gederothaim  ; fourteen cities with their villages :
kha: ka Shaaraim , ka Adithaim , ka Gederah , bad ka Gederothaim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Shaaraim , bad u Adithaim , bad u Gederaham bad u Gederothaim ; ki shiphew tylli ki shnong jong ki:

en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .
kha: U Aaron un kñia ïa u  langsohmoh uba hap ha U  Trai  da ka jingkynting sbai , bad un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un wanrah ia uta u blang ha uba U Trai u la hap , bad un aiti ia u na ka bynta ka jingknia pop .

en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot , and stood at the door of the house of Elisha .
kha: Kumta u Naaman u la leit lem bad la ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u la sangeh ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Elisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Naaman u la wan ryngkat bad ki kulai jong u bad bad ka kali jong u bad u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing u Elisha .

en: I will sing unto the  Lord  as long as I live : I will sing praise to my God while I have my being .
kha: Ngan rwai ha U  Trai  baroh shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; katba nga dang im ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan rwai ia U Trai katba nga dang im: Ngan rwai iaroh ia U Blei jong nga katba nga dang don ia ka jinglong jong nga .

en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .
kha: Te u Pilat u la aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki ïa ka ban sahnarphna . Kumta ki la shimti noh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la aiti noh ia u ha ki ban shah sahnarphna . Ki la shim ia U Jisu bad ki la ialam noh ia u .

en: I have pursued mine enemies , and destroyed them  ; and turned not again until I had consumed them .
kha: Nga beh kthong ïa ki nongshun jong nga , bad nga jop ïa ki ; ngam shym sangeh tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la bud ia ki nongshun jong nga, bad nga la pynjot ia ki ; bad ngam shym la phai shuh haduh ba ngan da bam ia ki .

en: For a just man falleth seven times , and riseth up again : but the wicked shall fall into mischief .
kha: Kam pher katno sien uba hok u kyllon , borabor un khie pat ; hynrei ka jingjot ka pynjot ïa ki bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u briew uba hok u hap hynriew sien, bad u kiew biang: hynrei ki bymman kin hap ha ka jingsniew .

en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .
kha: U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynshlur ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jong U Blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u khun u la ieng bad u la leit sha u Dabid shapoh khlaw bad u la pynskhem ia la ka kti ha U Blei .

en: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you .
kha: Pynban , ki pop jong phi ki la bat noh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingbymhok jong phi ki la pynphai noh ia kine kiei kiei , bad ki pop jong phi ki la bat ia kiei kiei kiba bha na phi .

en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , It is not in me : God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace .
kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , ngam lah ; hynrei U Blei un ai ka jingbatai kaba ai jinghun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la jubab ia u Pharaoh, u da ong: Kam don ha nga: U Blei un ai ia u Pharaoh ia ka jubab jong ka jingsuk .

en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .
kha: Un pyllait ïa phi lada phi long lui lui , lada kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynpoi ia ka ïew jong ki bym don pop: bad la pynpoi da ka jingkhuid jong ki kti jong me .

en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .
kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha baroh hynñiew ngut — ki la ïap khlem don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba lai ka la shim ia ka ; bad kumjuh ruh ia ki hynriew ngut: bad kim shym la iehnoh khun, bad ki la iap .

en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .
kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih ki pynlong ïa phi ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umphniang bad ka jingiwbih ka pynkmen ia ka dohnud: kumta ka long ka jingsngewtynnat jong u paralok jong u briew da ka jingai jingmut kaba sngewsih .

en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself  ; but the simple pass on , and are punished .
kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang kin ïohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad kin kiar na ka , hynrei ki briew ki bym pyrkhat kin ïaid beit ha ka bad kin babe kylla hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad u iohi lypa ia ka jingsniew, bad u buhrieh ia lade ; hynrei kiba suk ki iaid shakhmat , bad ki shah pynshitom .

en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .
kha: hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad lehkmen ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men ai ia ki jingknia jingsuk , bad men bam hangta , bad to sngewbha ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Ahab u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u khun u Asa u la sdang ban synshar halor ka Judah ha ka snem kaba saw jong u Ahab u syiem Israel .

en: And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .
kha: U Lebi u ïeng joit ban leit noh , hynrei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ban sah shuwa , kumta u sah sa shi miet hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba uta u briew u la ieng ban leit noh , u kpa jong u u la kyntu ia u: namarkata u la sah hangta pat .

en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .
kha: Te ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka jingïohipaw , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bneng :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la pynpaw ia ka jingmaham ha u Daniel ha ka jingphohsniew miet . Nangta u Daniel u la kyrkhu ia U Blei jong ka bneng .

en: The curse of the  Lord  is in the house of the wicked : but he blesseth the habitation of the just .
kha: U  Trai  u buh ka jingtim ha ki longïing jong ki riewbymman , hynrei u kyrkhu ïa ki longïing jong kiba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtim U Trai ka don ha ka iing jong kiba sniew: hynrei u kyrkhu ia ka jaka shong jong kiba hok .

en: For as ye in times past have not believed God , yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief :
kha: Na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil , phim shym kohnguh ïa U Blei mynshuwa ; hynrei mynta phi la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei U Blei namar ki Jiw ki la long ki bymkohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba phi ha ki por ba la leit noh phim shym la ngeit ia U Blei , hynrei mynta phi la ioh ia ka jingisynei lyngba ka jingbymngeit jong ki:

en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease .
kha: Mem don jingjynjar , bad wat la katta me rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; me tied beiñ ïa uta uba la jan hap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kloi ban slip bad ki kjat jong u u long kum ka sharak kaba la shah pynjah burom ha ka jingpyrkhat jong uta uba suk .

en: Boast not against the branches . But if thou boast , thou bearest not the root , but the root thee .
kha: Kumta te , phim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa kito kiba la pynkheiñ noh kum ki tnat . Kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong ? Phi long tang ka tnat ; phim kyrshan ïa ki thied — ki thied ki kyrshan ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha ia ki tnat . Hynrei lada me sngew sarong , me shah ia u tynrai , hynrei u tynrai jong me .

en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow , and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work :
kha: kum u mraw uba kwah hir hir ïa ka jakarieh tngen ; kum u nongtrei uba ap ïa la ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum u shakri u kwah eh ia ka jingdum, bad kum u nongtrei u wad ia ka bainong jong ka kam jong u:

en: For thus hath the  Lord  said , The whole land shall be desolate  ; yet will I not make a full end .
kha: ( U  Trai  u la ong ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan kylla long ka ri khlaw , hynrei ba un ym pynjot khoit ïa ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai u la ong , Ka ri baroh kawei kan sa jah rngai noh; hynrei ngan ym pyndep pura .

en: Neither shall they say , Lo here ! or , lo there ! for , behold , the kingdom of God is within you .
kha: Ym don u ban ong , ‘ Ha khmih , ka don hangne !’ lane ‘ Ka don hangtai !’ ; namar ka Hima U Blei ka don hapoh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym ong ruh hangne ! lane, hangta ! namar, ha khmih, ka hima U Blei ka don hapoh jong phi .

en: And Alammelech , and Amad , and Mishal  ; and reacheth to Carmel westward , and to Shihor–libnath  ;
kha: ka Allam Melekh , ka Amad , bad ka Mishal . Ha ka phang sepngi ka kynjoh ïa ka Karmel bad Shihor Libnath .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Alammech bad u Amad bad u Mishal ; bad u poi sha Karmel shaphang sepngi, bad sha Shihorlibnath ; .

en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him , as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before thee .
kha: Hynrei ngan ym weng noh na u ïa la ka jingkyrshan kumba nga la weng noh na u Saul , ïa uba nga la pynkynriah noh khnang ba men long syiem ma me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingisynei jong nga kan ym phet noh na u kumba nga la shim noh na u Saul uba nga la bret noh ha khmat jong me .

en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
kha: nangta khatsaw snemhadien  nga la leit pat sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u Barnabas , nga da ïalam lang ruh ïa u Titos .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta shiphew snem hadien nga la leit phai biang sha Jerusalem bad u Barnabas , bad nga la shim ia u Titus bad nga ruh .

en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .
kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ngam shym lamwir , ko Kynrad badonburom ! Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka jingtipbriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong , Ngam sngewsih, u Festo uba donburom tam; hynrei nga kren ia ki ktien jong ka jingshisha bad ka jinglong ba jem .

en: Son of man , eat thy bread with quaking , and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness  ;
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kyiuh haba me bam , bad to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba me dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, bam ia u kpu jong me da kaba dih kyiad, bad dih ia ka um jong me da kaba khih bad da kaba sumar bha;

en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word , even in this ; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei la kyllum lang ha kawei ka hukum kaba ong ,  Phin ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hukum baroh ka long kaba la pyndep ha kawei ka ktien, wat ha kane ka ; Me dei ban ieit ia u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ia lade .

en: And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .
kha: U Soitan u la ong ïa u ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa une u maw ban kylla kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: U ksuid u la ong ha u: Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ia une u maw ba un long u kpu .

en: Laying wait for him , and seeking to catch something out of his mouth , that they might accuse him .
kha: da kaba pyrshang ban buh ki jingriam ïa u bad ban kem daw ïa u lada u kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingap ia u , bad ka wad ban kem ia kaei kaei na ka shyntur jong u , ba kin kynnoh ia u .

en: And Esau said , Behold , I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me ?
kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ka biang hi ! Nga sngew kum ban sa ïap noh ; kita ki hok jong nga kin myntoi aïu pat ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la ong: Ha khmih nga la jan iap: bad kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba kane ka hok nyngkong kan leh ia nga ?

en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas : besides , I know not whether I baptized any other .
kha: ( O ho-oid , nga la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Stephanas bad ïa ka longïing jong u ; hynrei ngam kynmaw la nga la pynbaptis sa ïano ïano pat . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynbaptis ruh ia ka iing u Stephanas: nalor kata , ngam tip la nga la pynbaptis ia uwei pat .

en: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .
kha: Ngam shym la ïohpdiang ïa ka na uno uno u briew , lane ym shym la don mano mano ruh ba la hikai ïa ka ha nga . U dei U Jisu Khrist hi uba la pynpaw ïa ka ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam shym la ioh ia ka na u briew, lymne ngam shym la hikai ia ka, hynrei da ka jingpynpaw U Jisu Khrist .

en: And the table and all his vessels , and the candlestick and his vessels , and the altar of incense ,
kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar ki tar jong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka miej bad ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ka sharak bad ki tiar jong u bad ka jaka bam jingiwbih , .

en: And after they had held their peace , James answered , saying , Men and brethren , hearken unto me :
kha: Haba ki la dep kren , u Jakob u la ong :  To shahshkor ïa nga , ko hynmen ko para jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki, u Jakob u la jubab, u da ong, ko para bangeit, to sngap ia nga:

en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years , O house of Israel ?
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , ngam shym la dawa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ha kito ki sawphew snem ha kaba nga la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la tyrwa ia nga ia ki jingknia bad ki jingainguh ha ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , ko iing Israel ?

en: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .
kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u don . Nangta ka  nemsniew kaba jur ka la saphriang kylleng jong kata ka ri , bad um don ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la pynlut lut, ka la mih ka jingkyrduh kaba jur ha kata ka ri ; bad u la sdang ban duna .

en: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar , for the children of Issachar according to their families .
kha: Ka jingsam kaba saw la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lot kaba saw ka la mih sha Issakhar , na ka bynta ki khun Issakhar kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: Paul , called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , and Sosthenes our brother ,
kha: Na u Paul , ïa uba la khot ban long u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Sosthenes u parabangeit jong ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u la khot ia u apostol U Jisu Khrist lyngba ka mon U Blei , bad u Syiem u para jong ngi , .

en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it  ; and whoso breaketh an hedge , a serpent shall bite him .
kha: Lada phi tih ïa ka thliew , phin hap hapoh jong ka , lada phi phrung lyngba ka kynroh , u bseiñ un puh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba tih ia ka thliew un hap ha ka ; bad uno uno uba pynpra ia ka jingkhang , u bsein un bam ia u .

en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth , and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it .
kha: Hynrei U Blei un beh noh ïa ki riewbymman na ka ri , bad rat dyngkhong ïa ki nongpop na ka kum ïa ki jingthung na ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kiba sniew yn pynduh noh na ka khyndew bad ki nongleh kam sniew kin shah rong noh na ka .

en: And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
kha: Sa shisien pat ka Judah kan long ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U  Trai  ha ka ri bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah kaba u ieit tam na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un hiar pateng ia ka bynta jong u ha ka ri bakhuid , bad un jied biang ia ka Jerusalem .

en: Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .
kha: nga la lyngkhuit bad phi la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad phi la shim ban sumar ïa nga , nga la don ha ïingbyndi bad phi la wan jngoh ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Naked , bad phi la phong ia nga: Nga la pang , bad phi la leit jngoh ia nga: Nga la don ha phatok , bad phi la wan sha nga .

en: Owe no man any thing , but to love one another : for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law .
kha: To long kiba laitluid na ka jingshah teh na uno uno — ka jingteh kaba phi dei ban shah , ka long tang ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei . Uno uno uba leh ïa kane , u la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia u briew ei ei hynrei ban iaieit iwei ia iwei pat: namar uta uba ieit ia uwei pat u la pyndep ia ka hukum .

en: To cause it to rain on the earth , where no man is  ; on the wilderness , wherein there is no man  ;
kha: Mano ba pynhap ïa u slap ha ka jaka bym don bashong basah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynlong ia u slap ha ka khyndew , ha kaba ym don briew ; ha ka ri khlaw , ha kaba ym don briew ; .

en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .
kha: I ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongwei . I la die ïa ngi , bad mynta i la pynlut ïa ka pisa baroh kaba long ka dor jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngim khein ia u nongwei ? namar u la die ia ngi , bad u la bam lut ruh ia ka pisa jong ngi .

en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .
kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh arliang , khnang ba lah ban teh skhem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ia ki tyrpeng na ka bynta jong ka, ban pyniasoh lang ia ka: da ki ar tylli ki tduh la pyniasoh lang ia ka .

en: How much then is a man better than a sheep ? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days .
kha: Bad u briew u kham kor bun shah ban ïa ka langbrot ! Kumta te , ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban ïarap ïano ïano ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno te u briew u kham bha ban ia u langbrot ? Namarkata ka long kaba dei ban leh bha ha ki sngi Sabha .

en: Over 200 candidates and leaders of various political parties had visited the dera in the past week .
kha: Palat 200 ngut ki kyrtong bad ki nongialam jong ki seng sain pyrthei bapher bapher ki la leit jngoh ia katei ka dera ha ka taiew ba la dep .
translated_en_to_kha: Palat 200 ngut ki kyrtong bad ki nongialam jong ki seng sain pyrthei bapher bapher ki la leit jngoh ia ka dera ha ka taiew ba la dep .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : and the knowledge of the holy is understanding .
kha: Ban long kiba stad , nyngkong phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai . Lada phi tip ïa uta Uba Khuid , phi don ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka jingsdang jong ka jingstad : bad ka jingtip ia kiba khuid ka long ka jingsngewthuh .

en: And they told what things were done in the way , and how he was known of them in breaking of bread .
kha: Ki ar ngut te ki la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kata ka lynti , bad ba kumno ki la ithuh ïa U Trai mynba u la kdiah ïa u kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iathuh ia kiei kiei kiba la leh ha lynti , bad kumno la ithuh ia u ha kaba ot kpu .

en: And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .
kha: bad kin phla , ‘ Ym dei ma ngi kiba pynïap ïa uto u briew , bad ngim shym ïohi ruh mano ba la leh ïa kata ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin jubab bad kin ong , Ki kti jong ngi kim shym la pynmih ia kane ka snam , bad ki khmat jong ngi kim shym la iohi ia ka .

en: They that come after him shall be astonished at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
kha: Na mihngi sha sepngi , baroh kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kupar jong u ki suhjer ka met bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba wan hadien jong u kin sngew lyngngoh ia ka sngi jong u , kumba kita kiba la leit noh ki la sngew lyngngoh .

en: In those days there was no king in Israel , but every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
kha: Ym pat don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por ; uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi ym don syiem ha Israel , hynrei uwei pa uwei u leh ia kaba dei ha la ki jong ki khmat .

en: The Prime Minister ' s Office tweeted pictures of the two leaders at the official residence of Modi .
kha: Ka ophis jong u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri ka la pynmih ha ka twitter ia ki dur jong kitei ki arngut ki nongialam ha ka iing sah jong u Modi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ophis jong u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri ka la tweet ia ki dur jong ki arngut ki nongialam ha ka jaka sah ba pura jong u Modi .

en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not ?
kha: Lehse U Blei un kylla ka jingmut jong u ; lehse un sangeh noh na kaba bitar , bad ngin ym ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban iathuh lada U Blei un phai bad kylla bamut , bad phai noh na ka jingbitar kaba jur jong u , ba ngin ym jah noh ?

en: And David was afraid of the  Lord  that day , and said , How shall the ark of the  Lord  come to me ?
kha: Nangta u Dabid u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Mynta kumno ngan lah ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la tieng ia U Trai ha kata ka sngi bad u la ong: Kumno ka synduk U Trai kan wan ha nga ?

en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth , and a foot out of joint .
kha: Kaba shaniah ha u briew u bym lah ban shaniah ha ka por ka jingjynjar ka long kumba pyrshang ban ktha jingbam da ka bniat kaba la khih ne ïaid da ka kjat kaba dkoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshaniah ha u briew u bym iaineh ha ka por jong ka jingeh ka long kum ka bniat kaba la tyrkhong , bad ka kjat kaba mih na ka shyieng .

en: God , who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets ,
kha: Ha ki por mynbarim , U Blei u la kren ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bunsien bad ha ki rukom kiba bun lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei uba ha ki por ba la buh bad ha ki por ba la leit noh ha ki por ba la leit noh sha ki kpa tymmen da ki nongiathuhlypa , .

en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .
kha: Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Ka por ka la kut noh ; to shah ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha u Laban, Ai ia nga ia ka tnga jong nga, namar ki sngi jong nga ki la pyndep, ba ngan leit sha ka .

en: Son of man , hath not the house of Israel , the rebellious house , said unto thee , What doest thou ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  mynta ba kito ki Israel ba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ki kylli ïa me ïa kaei kaba me leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew, hato ka iing Israel, ka iing kaba leh pyrshah, kam shym la ong ha me , Me leh aiu ?

en: And his raiment became shining , exceeding white as snow  ; so as no fuller on earth can white them .
kha: bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla phyrnai lieh — kham lieh ban ïa kaba uno uno ha ka pyrthei u lah ban sait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jain jong u ka la kylla rong saw, kaba la nang lieh kum u slap ; haduh ba ym don ba kham pura ha ka khyndew kaba lah ban lieh ia ki .

en: He said he hopes the All India Muslim Personal Law Board challenges the ordinance in a court of law .
kha: U la ong ba u kyrmen ba ka All India Muslim Personal Law Board kan tuklar ia kane ka ain ha ka iing bishar .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ba u kyrmen ba ka All India Muslim Personal Law Board ka tuklar ia ka hukum ha ka iingbishar .

en: So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u shakri u buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jong ki , bad , kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , baroh ki la bam bad dang don bun kaba sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la buh ia ka ha khmat jong ki , bad ki la bam , bad ki la iehnoh ia ka kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Yet a little while am I with you , and then I go unto him that sent me .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ngan don bad phi tang shipor , bad nangta ngan sa leit noh sha uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha ki: Sa khyndiat por nga don bad phi, bad nangta nga leit sha uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: And Esau ran to meet him , and embraced him , and fell on his neck , and kissed him : and they wept .
kha: Hynrei u Iso u mareh ban ïakynduh ïa u , u kdup ïa u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïa-ïam baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la mareh ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la pdiang ia u, bad u la dem ha ka ryndang jong u, bad u la kdup ia u: bad ki la iam .

en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
kha: Tang uta uba mutlop shaba palat ban lap ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtrei shitom jong ki briew kiba bieit ka phong ia uwei pa uwei na ki , namar um tip kumno ban leit sha ka nongbah .

en: And he ordained twelve , that they should be with him , and that he might send them forth to preach ,
kha: Ki la wan sha u , bad u la jied khat-ar ngut , ïa kiba u la khot apostol .  Nga la jied ïa phi ban long lem bad nga ,  u la ong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki shiphew ngut ki briew kiba dei ban don ryngkat bad u bad ba un phah ia ki ban ialap .

en: And beheld among the simple ones , I discerned among the youths , a young man void of understanding ,
kha: bad nga la ïohi shibun ki samla shynrang kiba shida jingmut , hynrei nga la ïohi kyrpang ïa uwei u samla uba duna ka jingsngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la iohi hapdeng kiba suk , nga la ithuh hapdeng ki samla , u samla uba khlem jingmut , .

en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .
kha: Bad da kumta u Saul , ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut , bad uta u samla , ki la ïap ; baroh ki briew jong u Saul ki ïap ryngkat ha kajuh ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Saul u la iap, bad ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u, bad u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u, bad ki briew jong u baroh, ha kata kajuh ka sngi .

en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
kha: Me la thaw ïa nga , bad me sumar ïa nga ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong me ki la thaw ia nga bad ki la pynwan dur ia nga: to ai ia nga ka jingsngewthuh , ba ngan nang ia ki hukum jong me .

en: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .
kha: Ka Rebekka ka don u hynmen uba kyrteng u Laban ; bad u Laban u la mareh bran bran shabar ban leit sha kata ka pukri ha kaba u shakri jong u Abraham u don .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebekka u don u hynmen bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Laban : bad u Laban u la mareh sha uta u briew, sha ka thliew .

en: And the king said unto them , I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit was troubled to know the dream .
kha: u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la khuslai shaphang ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la ïoh . Nga kwah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki , Nga la phohsniew ia ka jingphohsniew bad ka mynsiem jong nga ka la sngewsih ban tip ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea , when it cannot rest , whose waters cast up mire and dirt .
kha: Hynrei ki riewbymman ki long kum ka duriaw kaba khih phaloh , kiba ki jingat phyllung jong ka kim ju sangeh , ki wanrah ïa ka jakhlia bad ka ktieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki bymman ki long kum ka duriaw kaba jynjar, haba kam lah ban shongthait, kaba ki um jong ka ki tuid sha jrong bad ka jakhlia .

en: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old : these were the years of the life of Sarah .
kha: Ka Sarah ka la im shispah arphew hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sarah ka la don shispah arphew snem: kine ki long ki snem jong ka jingim jong ka Sarah .

en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .
kha: Bad kumta nga la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la pynlong ia ki ban mih noh na ka ri Ijipt , bad nga la wanrah ia ki sha ka ri khlaw .

en: And he made curtains of goats  hair for the tent over the tabernacle : eleven curtains he made them .
kha: Nangta ki shna ïa ka jingtap jong ka Ïingjaiñ na ki khatwei tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki jingtap jong ki blang na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ: shiphew tylli ki jingtap u la shna ïa ki .

en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .
kha: ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u pdiang sngewbha ïa kiba shah kyntait bad u da ïabam lem bad ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi bad ki nongthoh ki la ud, ki da ong: Une u briew u pdiang ia ki nongpop bad u bam bad ki .

en: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time .
kha: Ki long na ka bynta jong phi , kiba da ka jingngeit la ri kyndong da ka bor U Blei ïa ka jingpynim kaba la pynkhreh ban sa pynpaw ha kaba kut jong ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la shah sumar da ka bor U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit haduh ka jingpynim kiba la pynkhreh ban shah pynpaw ha ka sien kaba khatduh .

en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed : but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded .
kha: Lada phi kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar ; bud ïa ka bad phin lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba lehbein ia ka ktien un shah pynjot: hynrei uta uba tieng ia ka hukum un ioh ia ka bainong .

en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kito kiba shah pynshitom na ka bynta ka hok: namar ka jong ki ka long ka hima bneng .

en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .
kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew uba kyrteng u Ïoannis , uba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingshai , ba baroh ki dei ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor bad ban ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kajuh ka la wan na ka bynta ka jingsakhi , ban sakhi ia ka Jingshai , ba ki briew baroh lyngba jong u kin ngeit .

en: So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Baasha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , bad u khun jong u , u Elah u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Baasha u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad la tep ia u ha Tirzah : bad u Elah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And why wilt thou , my son , be ravished with a strange woman , and embrace the bosom of a stranger ?
kha: Ko khun jong nga , balei phin shu ai ïa la ka jingieit sha kawei pat ka briew ? Balei phin kham jied ïa ka jingpynshohbieit ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei ba me, ko khun jong nga, phin shah rong noh bad ka kynthei kaba phylla bad pdiang ia ka kpoh jong u nongwei ?

en: The church that is at Babylon , elected together with you , saluteth you  ; and so doth Mark my son .
kha: Ka Balang kaba ha Babilon , ïa kaba la jied ruh da U Blei , ka phah ïa ki jingai khublei sha phi , bad kumjuh ruh u Markos u khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka balang kaba don ha Babilon , kaba la jied ryngkat bad phi , ka ai khublei ia phi ; bad kumta u Mark u khun jong nga .

en: They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .
kha: Kiba pyn-i ka jingsngewtynnat kaba katta katta ïa phi , hynrei kam bha . Hooid , kin kyntait ia phi , lah kumba phin pynsniew iaki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktah jur ia phi, hynrei ym bha shuh shuh, kin kyntait ia phi, ba phin ktah ia ki.

en: But them that are without God judgeth . Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person .
kha: Wat la katta , kam dei ka kamram jong nga ban bishar ïa kiba nabar . U Blei un sa bishar ïa ki . Hynrei hato kam dei ban bishar ïa ki dkhot na la ka jong ka kynhun hi ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Pynmih noh ïa u briew uba sniew na ka kynhun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kito ki bym don U Blei ki bishar . Namarkata to weng noh na pdeng jong phi ia uta u briew uba sniew .

en: Yea , and certain women also of our company made us astonished , which were early at the sepulchre  ;
kha: Katto katne ngut ki kynthei jong ka kynhun jong ngi , ki la pynkyndit ïa ngi ; ki la leit dang kynjat shai sha ka jingtep , hynrei kim shym la lah ban shem ïa ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bad katto katne ki kynthei ruh jong ngi ki la pynlong ia ngi ban lyngngoh , kiba dang sdang ha ka jingtep ;

en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .
kha: Lada ïa phi ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jong u baroh , ka mut ba phim dei ki khun bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi long khlem ka jingpynshitom, ha kaba baroh phi long ki nongiashim bynta, te phi long ki khun shynrang, bad ym ki khun shynrang .

en: Zion heard , and was glad  ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O  Lord .
kha: Ki briew ka Seïon ki lehkmen , bad ki nongbah ka Judah ki shadkmen namar ki jingbishar jong me , A  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Seion u la iohsngew , bad u la sngewbha bad ki khun kynthei jong u Judah ki la sngewbha namar ki jingbishar jong me , ko Trai .

en: Mental Cleanness : If we fill our minds with clean , pure thoughts , our conduct will also be clean .
kha: Ka jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat : Lada ngi pyndap ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi da kiei kiei kiba khuid , ka jinglong jong ngi ruh kan long kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat: Lada ngi pyndap ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi da ki jingpyrkhat kiba khuid bad kiba khuid , ka jinglong jong ngi ruh kan long kaba khuid .

en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
kha: Nangta u la kdew sha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Hangne ki long ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia la ka kti sha ki synran jong u bad u la ong: Ha khmih ka kmie jong nga bad ki hynmen jong nga !

en: Yet because this widow troubleth me , I will avenge her , lest by her continual coming she weary me .
kha: pynban na ka bynta ka jingpynjynjar baroh ba kane ka riewkynthei ka ai ha nga , ngan khmih ïa kata ba kan ïoh ïa ki hok jong ka . Lada ngam leh kumta , kan ïai wan bad khatduh kan pynlwait ïa nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba kane ka riewkynthei ka pynkhuslai ia nga, ngan pynshitom ia ka, ioh ba da ka jingwan jong ka kaba iai bteng kan pynsngewsih ia nga .

en: Thou also shalt be drunken : thou shalt be hid , thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy .
kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha ruh phan hap ha ka jingbuaid bymtip briew ! Pha ruh phan pyrshang ban lait phet na ki nongshun jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men sa dih kyiad: me ruh men sa shah buhrieh , me ruh men wad ia ka bor namar u nongshun .

en: These waited on the king , beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah .
kha: Kine ki rangbah ki shakri ïa u syiem ha Jerusalem , bad nalor kata , u buh ruh kiwei pat ki shipai ha kiwei ki nongbah ba la tei kut jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki la ap ia u syiem , nalor kito kiba u syiem u la buh ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong ha kylleng ka Judah .

en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
kha: U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong u Solomon : ka thain Dor baroh kawei ;
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Abinadab , ha ka thain baroh kawei ka Dor ; kaba don ka Taphath ka khun u Solomon ha ka tnga:

en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap .  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah pynbaptis ,  u la ong ïa ki briew ,  bad U Blei un map noh ïa ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la pynbaptis ha ka ri khlaw , bad u la ialap ia ka jingpynbaptis jong ka jingkylla kaba mut na ka bynta ka jingmap ia ki pop .

en: And when he had landed at Caesarea , and gone up , and saluted the church , he went down to Antioch .
kha: Haba u la poi ha Kaisaria , u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la ai khublei ïa ka balang , bad nangta u la leit sha Antiokh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hiar ha Kaisaria, bad u la leit shaneng bad u la ai khublei ia ka balang, u la leit hiar sha Antiok .

en: Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .
kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la phet noh na Ijipt bad u la leit noh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la phet noh na kane ka jingong , bad u la long u nongwei ha ka ri Madian , ha kaba u la kha arngut ki khun shynrang .

en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .
kha: Namar ba ki Edom kim shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka hima jong ki , ki Israel ki la phai noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Edom u la kyntait ban ai ia ki Israel ia ka lynti lyngba u pud jong u: namar kata ki Israel ki la phai noh na u .

en: For what saith the scripture ? Abraham believed God , and it was counted unto him for righteousness .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaei kaba ong ka jingthoh ? U Abraham u la ngeit ia U Blei bad la khein ia ka ha u na ka bynta ka hok .

en: And he said , What hast thou done ? the voice of thy brother s blood crieth unto me from the ground .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Balei me leh ïa kane ka kam kaba shyrkhei ? Ka snam u para jong me ka ud ha nga na khyndew kum ka sur kaba khot ïa ka jingpynhiarkput .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Kaei kaba me la leh ? ka sur jong u hynmen jong me ka pyrta ia nga na ka khyndew .

en: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
kha: U jubab ,  Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong: Hato ngam dei ban sumar ban kren ia kata kaba U Trai u la buh ha ka shyntur jong nga ?

en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination : how much more , when he bringeth it with a wicked mind ?
kha: U  Trai  u ijli ïa kata , haba ki briew ba-bymman ki ai ki jingkñia ha u , khamtam lada ki leh ïa kata na ki jingthmu bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingknia jong kiba sniew ka long kaba sniew: katno ka long kaba kham bun haba u wanrah ia ka da ka jingmut kaba sniew ?

en: For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong me ; nga pynkhlaiñ ïa me bad nga ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga U Trai U Blei jong me ngan bat ia ka kti kadiang jong me, da kaba ong ha me: Wat tieng; ngan iarap ia me .

en: And after the sop Satan entered into him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  That thou doest , do quickly .
kha: U Judas tang mar ïashim ïa uta u kpu , u Soitan u la rung hapoh jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Leh noh kloi ïa kaei kaba men sa leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba u so u Soitan u la rung ha u . Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha u, Ba me leh kloi .

en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .
kha: bad phin long kiba kmen lada phin kynmaw ïa ki bad phi lah ban kren ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long kaba sngewtynnad lada me buh ia ki hapoh jong me ; kin sa iahap ha ki rmiang shyntur jong me .

en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .
kha: To leh ïa ki kambah na ka bynta jong nga , A  Trai  , kumba me la leh ha ki sngi mynba me la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ki sngi jong ka jingmih jong me na ka ri Ijipt ngan pyni ha u ia kiei kiei kiba phylla .

en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah khatsan snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Enos u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Kain hynriew spah sanphew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: And on the third day eleven bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ai khatwei tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba lai shiphew tylli ki masi , ar tylli ki langbrot , shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem da don ka jingduna ; .

en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes , and yet is not washed from their filthiness .
kha: Don ki briew kiba tharai ba ki long kiba khuid hynrei kiba dap da ka tngit suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka pateng kaba khuid ha la ki jong ki khmat , bad wat la katta ruh ym shym la sait na ka jingjakhlia jong ki .

en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .
kha: Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh ; hato men sangeh noh mynta , ne men jubab ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato uta uba ialeh pyrshah ia u Uba donbor baroh un hikai ia u ? uta uba pynrem ia U Blei , to un jubab ia ka .

en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
kha: Ka jingleh jong me ka la long kaba janai naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la long uba janai ha ki lynti jong me naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ia me, haduh ba la lap ia ka jingbymhok ha me .

en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert  ; as it is written , He gave them bread from heaven to eat .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la bam ïa ka mana ha ri shyiap , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U la ai ha ki ïa u kpu na bneng ba kin bam .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la bam ia ka manna ha ka ri khlaw ; kumba la thoh , U la ai ia ki kpu na bneng ban bam .

en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized  ; and there he abode .
kha: U Jisu u la leit phai biang sha shiliang ka wah Jordan sha ka jaka ha kaba u Ïoannis u la ju pynbaptis , bad u la sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh biang sha lyndet ka Jordan sha ka jaka ba u Ioannis ha kaba nyngkong u la pynbaptis ; bad hangta u la sah .

en: And when he rose up from prayer , and was come to his disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow ,
kha: Haba u la ïeng joit na ka jingduwai jong u , u la leit pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah , kiba la shoh lwait da ka jingsngewsih jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng na ka jingduwai bad u la wan sha ki synran jong u , u la shem ba ki thiah namar ka jingsngewsih .

en: And , behold , seven ears , withered , thin , and blasted with the east wind , sprung up after them :
kha: Nangta sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad kiba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kita kiba met .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, hynriew tylli ki shkor, kiba la tyrkhong, kiba rit bad kiba la bthei da ka Iyer mihngi, ki la mih hadien jong ki:

en: During the course of the series , he became the fastest Indian to reach 150 wickets in Test cricket .
kha: Ha ka jingiaid jong kane ka series u la long u nong India uba sted tam ban kamai 150 wiket ha ka Test Cricket .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por jong ka series , u la kylla long u nong India uba stet tam ban poi sha ka 150 wiket ha ka kriket Test .

en: And he said unto them , Depart yet for three days , then come again to me . And the people departed .
kha: Sa wan biang hadien lai sngi bad ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jubab jong nga ,  u phai ktien . Kumta ki leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To leit noh sa lai sngi, nangta to wan phai biang sha nga . Ki briew ki la leit noh .

en: And Joshua went up from Eglon , and all Israel with him , unto Hebron  ; and they fought against it :
kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit kiew na Eglon sha ki lum ka Hebron , ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad ki la kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la kiew na Eglon, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, haduh Hebron ; bad ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ka:

en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
kha: U angel jong U Trai u la paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la paw ha u u angel jong U Trai uba ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong ka jingbam ba thiang .

en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;
kha: khnang ba ma phi lem bad ki briew jong U Blei baroh , phin lah ban ïoh ka bor ban sngewthuh katno ka jingïar bad ka lynter , katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingjylliew , ka long ka jingieit U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: To lah ban sngewthuh bad ki riewkhuid baroh kaei ka jingjylliew bad ka jingjrong bad ka jingjrong;

en: Behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that use their tongues , and say , He saith .
kha: Nga pyrshah ruh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba kren ïa la ki jong ki ktien bad kiba kam ba ki wan na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia ki nongiathuhlypa , U Trai , kiba pyndonkam ia ki shyntur jong ki bad ki ong , U ong .

en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .
kha: Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba la rung ha ka jingjahthait jong u, u ruh u la sangeh noh na la ki jong ki kam kumba U Blei u la sangeh noh na ki jong u .

en: His troops come together , and raise up their way against me , and encamp round about my tabernacle .
kha: U phah ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ; ki tih ïa ki kharai ban rieh bad ki kerkut ïa ka ïingjaiñ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai jong u ki iawan lang , bad ki iaid pyrshah ia nga , bad ki iaid kylleng kylleng sawdong ka iing jong nga .

en: Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .
kha: U pynbeit ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban wanlam sha u shibun ki dieng Kedar tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki dieng cedar ha ka jingbun: namar ki Sidonian bad ki jong ka Tyros ki la wanrah bun ki dieng cedar ha u Dabid .

en: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
kha: U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong u ; u la ïap noh haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la shong ha Ijipt, ma u bad ka iing u kpa jong u: bad u Joseph u la im shispah shiphew snem .

en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .
kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur bha , bad u la shah siat da u khnam ha u nongshun bad u la mynsaw jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka thma ka la iaid pyrshah ia u Saul , bad ki nongsiat khnam ki la shoh ia u , bad u la mynsaw na ki nongsiat khnam .

en: Now therefore , I pray thee , pardon my sin , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga kyrpad ïa phi , map ïa ka pop jong nga , bad leit phai bad nga , ba kumta ngan lah ban mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata, nga kyrpad ia me, to map ia ka pop jong nga bad to phai biang bad nga, ba ngan mane ia U Trai .

en: But Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah , and the mighty men , and Solomon his brother , he called not .
kha: hynrei um shym la khot ïa u Solomon , u para jong u na ujuh u kpa lane ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , lane ïa u Benaïah , lane ïa ki nongïada jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Nathan u nongiathuhlypa bad u Benaiah bad ki riewshlur bad u Solomon u hynmen jong u, um shym la khot .

en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .
kha: Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la thang ban pynlong mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew kin long kum ki jingthang ia ka lime: kum ki thliew ba la ot kin shah thang ha ka ding .

en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .
kha: U Saul u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; ka duwan kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai: kajuh ka long ka jingknia kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei ha U Trai .

en: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
kha: Ki shna ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na kawei pat ka liang jong ka ïingjaiñ kaba don shaphang shathie , u la shna arphew tylli ki board .

en: Then he called for Solomon his son , and charged him to build an house for the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: U la phah ïa u Solomon u khun jong u bad hukum ïa u ban tei ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot ia u Solomon u khun jong u , bad u la kyntu ia u ban tei ia ka iing na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;
kha: kumba ym don ba la ithuh , pynban la ithuh ïa ngi da baroh ; la kum kiba la ïap , hynrei , kumba phi ïohi , ngi dang ïai im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ym tip , bad wat la katta ruh ngi la tip bha kum kiba iap , bad , ha khmih , ngi im kum kiba la shah pynshitom bein , bad ym shym la pyniap ; .

en: Thy name , O  Lord  , endureth for ever  ; and thy memorial , O  Lord  , throughout all generations .
kha: A  Trai  , ïa me yn pynbna borabor kum U Blei ; ki pateng bynriew baroh kin kynmaw ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng jong me, ko Trai, ka sah junom bad ka jingkynmaw jong me, ko Trai, ha ki pateng baroh .

en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity . Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus . Amen .
kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei pat da ka jingïadoh jong ka jingieit Khristan . To ka jingsuk kan long ïa phi baroh kiba dei ki jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei iwei ia iwei pat da ka jingkyndit jong ka jingai sngewbha . Ka jingsuk kan long bad phi baroh kiba don ha U Khrist Jisu . Amen .

en: For this is the love of God , that we keep his commandments : and his commandments are not grievous .
kha: Naba ka jingieit jong ngi ïa U Blei , ka mut ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . Bad ki hukum jong u kim long kiba eh katta katta ïa ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ka jingieit U Blei , ba ngi sumar ia ki hukum jong u: bad ki hukum jong u kim long kiba sngewsih .

en: And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?
kha: U Judah u ong ha la ki hynmen ki para shynrang ,  Kan myntoi aïu ïa ngi ba ngin pynïap noh ïa la u para bad buhrieh ïa ka kam pynïap briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, Kaei ka jingmyntoi lada ngi pyniap ia u hynmen jong ngi bad ngi buhrieh ia ka snam jong u ?

en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .
kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: Lai snem u la synshar ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long Maah , ka khun jong u Abishalon .

en: When I looked for good , then evil came unto me : and when I waited for light , there came darkness .
kha: Nga la kyrmen ban ïoh jingkmen bad jingshai , hynrei ka jingeh bad ka jingdum pynban ki wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga wad ia kaba bha, nangta ka jingsniew ka la wan ha nga: bad haba nga la ap ia ka jingshai , ka la wan ka jingdum .

en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mano batip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Mano ba lah ban ai jingmut ïa u ?  Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka jingmut U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba tip ia ka jingmut U Trai , ba un hikai ia u ? Hynrei ngi don ka jingmut U Khrist .

en: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .
kha: Kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  U dei u Elijah .  Kiwei ki ong ,  U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum uwei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jong ki por ba-mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong , Ba u dei u Elias . Bad kiwei pat ki la ong , Ba u long u nongiathuhlypa , ne kum uwei na ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Behold , I waited for your words  ; I gave ear to your reasons , whilst ye searched out what to say .
kha: Nga la shahshkor bha katba phi dang kren bad nga ap katba phi dang sei ïa la ki jingkren bastad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga la ap ia ki ktien jong phi ; nga la sngap ia ki daw jong phi , katba phi dang wad ia kaei kaba phi dei ban ong .

en: And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kum ka por ha kaba ngan leh ïa kane .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la buh ia ka por kaba la buh, da kaba ong: Ban sngewbha U Trai un leh ia kane ka kam ha ka ri .

en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding  ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
kha: U briew uba shemphang u thew ban leh ïa ka kam bastad , hynrei uba bieit u sdang shisien sdang na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha khmat jong uta uba don ka jingsngewthuh ; hynrei ki khmat jong u bieit ki don ha ki kut jong ka khyndew .

en: As they were increased , so they sinned against me : therefore will I change their glory into shame .
kha: Katba phi ki lyngdoh phi nang ïabun , katta phi nang leh pop pyrshah ïa nga ; bad kumta ngan pynkylla ïa ka burom jong phi sha ka jingjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki la nang kiew , kumta ki la leh pop pyrshah ia nga: namarkata ngan pynkylla ia ka burom jong ki sha ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: I ' m anxious to win this debate , and I ' ll deeply appreciate whatever help you can give me .  " "
kha: Nga thrang ban jop ia kane ka jingiatai , bad ngan sngewnguh shibun ia kano kano ka jingiarap kaba phi lah ban ai ia nga .  " "
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewkhia ban jop ia kane ka jingiatai, bad ngan sngewnguh shibun ia kano kano ka jingiarap kaba phi lah ban ai ia nga ."

en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house  ; and she shall shave her head , and pare her nails  ;
kha: ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi , bad hangta kan khi ïa la ka khlieh , kan ot ïa la ki tyrsim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to wanrah ia ka sha iing jong me ; bad kan sa ot ia ka khlieh jong ka, bad ka par ia ki bniat jong ka ; .

en: And they came and besought them , and brought them out , and desired them to depart out of the city .
kha: Kumta ki la leit bad pan map na ki ; nangta ki la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar jong ka byndi bad ki la kyrpad ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan bad ki la kyrpad ia ki, bad ki la wanrah ia ki shabar bad ki la kwah ia ki ban mih noh na ka shnong .

en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar , and slew the calf of the sin offering , which was for himself .
kha: U Aaron u leit sha ka duwan bad u pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la leit sha ka jaka bam bad u la pyniap ia u khun masi jong ka jingknia pop kaba long na ka bynta jong u hi .

en: The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,
kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar kiba ïadei bad u ; ïa ki sharak bad ka umphniang jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sharak ruh na ka bynta ka jingshai , bad ki tiar jong u , bad ki sharak jong u , ryngkat bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai , .

en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
kha: U Syiem u la sngewsynei ïa u , kumta u la map ïa ka ram jong u bad u la pyllait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u kynrad jong uta u shakri u la khih da ka jingsngewrit , bad u la pyllait noh ia u bad u la map ia u ia ka ram .

en: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah , and in the forests he built castles and towers .
kha: Ha ki lum jong ka Judah u tei ïa ki nongbah bad ha ki khlaw u tei ki kut bad ki jaka ap phira .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la tei ia ki nongbah ha ki lum Judah , bad ha ki khlaw u la tei ia ki iing bad ki tower .

en: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .
kha: Kim shym la long ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaba kha kum ki khun u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei hi u la long U Kpa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la kha ym na ka snam, ne na ka mon ka doh, ne na ka mon u briew hynrei na U Blei .

en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?
kha: Mano ba ai um ïa ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , ba kumta u phlang u mih ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynhun ia ka khyndew kaba la tyrkhong bad kaba la tyrkhong ; bad ban pynlong ia u bud jong u jingthung ba jem ban mih ?

en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
kha: Ale wan rung , phi ki briew kiba duna ka bor sngewthuh !  Bad ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba suk , to ai ba un phai shapoh hangne: kumba u kwah ia ka jingsngewthuh , ka ong ha u , .

en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .
kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Arphaxed u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Salah saw spah lai snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .

en: But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .
kha: bad nangta ki duh lut ïa ka ha ki katto katne ki jingïakhaïi basniew bad ki kut ha ka jingbymdon ei ei shuh ban ai pateng ha la ki khun ki kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kita ki spah ki jah noh da ka jingtrei shitom kaba sniew: bad u kha khun shynrang , bad ym don ei ei ha ka kti jong u .

en: And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .
kha: U hukum ïa ki paid ka Judah ban leh ïa ka mon jong U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia u Judah ban wad ia U Trai Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki bad ban leh ia ka hukum bad ka hukum .

en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought , and stripped the naked of their clothing .
kha: Ban pynlong ïa u para jong phi ban siew pat ïa ka pisa kaba u dei ban siew , phi shim noh ïa ki jaiñ ki nep jong u bad ieh ïa u khlem don ei ei shuh ban phong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la shim ia ka jingkular na u hynmen jong me na ka bynta ka jingbym don ei ei , bad me la weng noh ia ki jain jong ki .

en: And he that shall swear by heaven , sweareth by the throne of God , and by him that sitteth thereon .
kha: bad haba uno uno u smai da ka bneng , u smai da ka khet U Blei bad da uta uba shong halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba smai da ka bneng , u smai da ka khet U Blei bad da uta uba shong ha ka .

en: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
kha: Ha khmih !  u la ong .  Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U Khun U Briew ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ha khmih , nga iohi ia ki bneng ba ki plie bad U Khun u briew u ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei .

en: As always , the faithful and discreet slave has the primary responsibility of feeding the domestics .
kha: Kumba ju long , u shakri uba iaineh bad uba stad u don ka jingkitkhlieh kaba kongsan eh ban ai bam ia ki nongtrei iing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ju long , u mraw uba iaineh bad uba rieh u don ka jingkitkhlieh kaba kongsan ban ai bam ia ki iing .

en: After him repaired their brethren , Bavai the son of Henadad , the ruler of the half part of Keilah .
kha: U Babbai , u khun jong u Henadad , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat ka shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba u la pynbha ia ki hynmen jong ki, u Bavai u khun u Hennadad , u nongsynshar shiteng na Keilah .

en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves ?
kha: bad u Abimelekh u kylli ïa u ,  Phi leh lei kumne ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong ha u Abraham , Kaei kata ka jingmut jong kine ki hynriew tylli ki langbrot kiba me la buh hi ?

en: And he said unto them , Why do ye such things ? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people .
kha: Kumta u ong ha ki ,  Balei keiñ ba phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ? Man la u briew u ïathuh ha nga ïa ki kam bymman jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Balei phi leh kumta ? namar nga iohsngew ia ki jingleh bymman jong phi baroh .

en: Fulfil ye my joy , that ye be likeminded , having the same love , being of one accord , of one mind .
kha: Te , nga kyrpad ïa phi , ban pynshlei ïa ka jingkmen jong nga da kaba don kijuh ki jingpyrkhat , kiba ïasam ïa kajuh ka jingieit , bad kiba don kawei ka mynsiem bad ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndap ia ka jingkmen jong nga, ba phin long kumjuh, da kaba don kajuh ka jingieit, da kaba long kawei ka jingmut .
