en: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la wan sha u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  Nga la kloi ban leit bad me kat shaba me leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u nongthoh u la wan bad u la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, ngan bud ia me shano shano ruh ba me leit .

en: For if they which are of the law be heirs , faith is made void , and the promise made of none effect :
kha: Naba lada kaei kaba U Blei u kular ban ai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , te ka jingngeit u briew kam don jingmut bad ka jingkular U Blei kam dondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada kita kiba long na ka hukum ki long ki nongioh pateng, ka jingngeit ka long kaba khlem jingmyntoi:

en: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .
kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khyndew kan kylla eh kum u nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bneng jong me kaba don halor ka khlieh jong me kan long ka nar , bad ka khyndew kaba don hapoh jong me kan long ka nar .

en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .
kha: Lum ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi lah , bad phin jop ; khlem kata phin shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem u nongai jingmut ki long kiba la duh jingkyrmen: hynrei ha ka jingbun ki nongai jingmut ki long kiba la pynskhem .

en: And it shall come to pass at that day , that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel .
kha: Bad ha kata ka por ha ka them Jesreel ngan pynjot noh thiaw ïa ka bor jong ka kynhun shipai ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi , ba ngan pynpra ia ka bow jong ki Israel ha ka them Jesel .

en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them , as they walked , and went into the country .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha kawei pat ka rukom ha ki ar ngut na ki katba ki dang ïa-ïaid lynti sha la shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la paw ha kawei pat ka dur ha ki arngut na ki, katba ki dang iaid , bad u la leit shapoh ri .

en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger was kindled .
kha: U Sebul , u nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , u bitar lep haba u ïohsngew aïu u Gaal u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zebul u nongsynshar jong ka shnong u la iohsngew ia ki ktien u Gaal u khun u Ebed , ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei .

en: But ye have despised the poor . Do not rich men oppress you , and draw you before the judgment seats ?
kha: Hynrei phim ñiewburom ïa kiba duk ! Kiei kita kiba khñiot beiñ ïa phi bad ba ïalam ïa phi ha khmat ki nongbishar ? Kiba riewspah keiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la lehbein ia kiba duk . Hato ki briew kiba riewspah kim pynshitom bein ia phi , bad ki ring ia phi ha khmat ki jaka bishar ?

en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;
kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad phi !  Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha sepngi bajngai tam , ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng: namar nga don ryngkat bad me: Ngan wanrah ia u symbai jong me na mihngi, bad ngan lum ia me na sepngi ;

en: Knowing this first , that there shall come in the last days scoffers , walking after their own lusts ,
kha: Nyngkong eh , phi dei ban sngewthuh ba ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh yn don ki briew kaba ïa ka jingim jong ki la tyllep da ki jingkwah brai jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ia kane nyngkong , ba kan wan ha ki sngi ba khatduh , ka iaid katkum la ka jong ka jingkwah brai .

en: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .
kha: Lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi ieit ia kiba ieit ia phi, kaei ka jingsngewnguh kaba phi don ? namar ki nongpop ruh ki ieit ia kito kiba ieit ia ki .

en: But it shall not be so among you : but whosoever will be great among you , let him be your minister  ;
kha: Kane , la kumno kumno , kam dei ka rukom ban long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uwei na phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei pat ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan ym long kumta hapdeng jong phi: hynrei uno uno uba long uba khraw hapdeng jong phi , to un long u shakri jong phi ; .

en: Therefore he knoweth their works , and he overturneth them in the night , so that they are destroyed .
kha: Namar ba u tip kaei kaba u leh ; u weng noh ïa ki bad u pynlwet ïa ki mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u tip ia ki kam jong ki , bad u pynkylla ia ki ha ka por miet , haduh ba kin da shah pynjot .

en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
kha: Hynrei u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem jong ki khun Ammon um shym la sngap ia ki ktien u Jephthah kiba u la phah ia u .

en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;
kha: Kine harum ki hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang , ha ka jingbuh ryntih kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha na ka bynta u Dabid ha Hebron : u Amnon , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , kaba na Jesreel ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Dabid la kha ia ki khun shynrang ha Hebron : bad u khun nyngkong jong u u long u Amnon , na Ahonoam ka Jesrilletess ; .

en: If thou meet thine enemy s ox or his ass going astray , thou shalt surely bring it back to him again .
kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi ne ïa ka kada u nongshun jong phi ba ka ïaid sakma , leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me iakynduh ia u nongshun jong me ne ka tdong jong u kaba iaid bakla, men sa wanrah biang ia ka ha u .

en: Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,
kha: Te katto katne ngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Sadusi ki wan sha u ki Sadusi kiba ong ba ym don ka jingmihpat ; bad ki la kylli ia u da kaba ong:

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .
kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba u syiem Jehoïakim u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u Jehoiakim u la leh .

en: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,
kha: Bad phi thikna ba phi long daladie  u nongïalam ïa uba matlah , ka jingshai ïa kito kiba ha ka jingdum ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to sngewskhem ba me hi me long u nongpyniaid ia kiba matlah , ka jingshai jong kita kiba don ha ka jingdum , .

en: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls , and with his axes he shall break down thy towers .
kha: Kin tied ha ki kynroh jong pha da ki dieng pynpra kynroh bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha da ki nar rod .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ia ki engine thma pyrshah ia ki kynroh jong me , bad da ki ax jong u un pynpra ia ki tower jong me .

en: Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them , which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :
kha: Ka long ka jingpyrkhat jong nga ,  u Jakob u la ong ,  ba ngim dei ban pynjynjar ïa ki Jentil kiba la phai sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka long , ba ngim pynkhuslai ia ki , kiba na ki Jutang ki phai sha U Blei:

en: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people , and there will I plead with you face to face .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa phi sha ‘ Ka ri shyiap jong ki jaitbynriew’ , bad hangta ngan pynrem ïa phi sha ka jinglehrain jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia phi sha ka ri khlaw jong ki briew , bad hangta ngan kyrpad ia phi markhmat .

en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u paidbah u la sngewphylla ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , haba U Jisu u la pyndep ia kine ki jingkren , ki briew ki la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai jong u:

en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
kha: Kumba ïa ki ñiut la lumlang bad la thang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta kajuh hi kan jia ha kaba kut ka Ïa :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la lum bad thang ia ki tar ha ka ding ; kumta kan long ha kaba kut jong kane ka pyrthei .

en: But Peter continued knocking : and when they had opened the door , and saw him , they were astonished .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Petros u ïai tied . Khatduh ki la plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la sngewlyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la bteng ban tied: bad haba ki la plie ia ka jingkhang , bad ki la iohi ia u , ki la lyngngoh .

en: And he came unto his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I  ; who art thou , my son ?
kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha la u kpa bad u ong ,  Ko Pa !   Oi ,  u jubab .  Phi dei uei na ki khun shynrang jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan sha la u kpa bad u la ong, ko kpa jong nga: bad u la ong, Hangne nga don; me long u khun jong nga ?

en: Thou shalt not raise a false report : put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness .
kha: Wat ju pynphriang ïa ki khubor lamler , bad wat ïarap ïa u nongleh bymman da kaba sakhi lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynmih ia ka khubor kaba bakla: wat buh ia ka kti jong me bad ki bymman ban long u nongsakhi bym hok .

en: At the noise of the tumult the people fled  ; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered .
kha: Haba me ïaleh na ka bynta jong ngi , ki jaitbynriew kin phet ïap na ka jingsawa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa ki briew ki la phet krad ; ha ka jingkiew jong me ki jaitbynriew ki la jah rngai noh .

en: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la hukum ban wallam sha u ïa u briew uba matlah . Haba u la wan hajan , U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ieng bad u la hukum ia u ban wanrah sha u : bad haba u la wan hajan u la kylli ia u .

en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh , as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence .
kha: Nangta ki nong Moab kin ym sngewbha ïa u blei Khemosh jong ki , kumba ki Israel kim sngewbha ïa u blei Bethel ha uba ki shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Moab un sngewlehrain ia u Chemosh, kumba ka iing Israel ka la sngewlehrain ia ka Bethel jong ki .

en: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .
kha: Kumta u syiem Dabid u phah shaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Dabid u la phah ia u na ka iing u Machir u khun u Ammiel na Lodebar .

en: Wherefore hear the word of the  Lord  , ye scornful men , that rule this people which is in Jerusalem .
kha: Mynta , phi ki briew ba leh meng kiba synshar hangne ha Jerusalem halor kane ka jaitbynriew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai , phi ki briew kiba sngewsih , kiba synshar ia une u briew uba don ha Jerusalem .

en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken  ; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram .
kha: U Balak u leh kumba la bthah , te ma u bad u Balaam ki la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la leh kumba u Balak u la kren bad u Balak bad u Balak ki la tyrwa ha kawei pa kawei ka jaka bam masi bad u langbrot .

en: And of some , that Elias had appeared  ; and of others , that one of the old prophets was risen again .
kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ba u Elijah u la mihpaw , bad sa kiwei pat ki ong ba uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim u la mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki katto katne , uta u Elias u la paw ; bad na kiwei pat , ba uwei na ki nongiathuhlypa barim u la mihpat biang .

en: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .
kha: ki ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .  Ki synran ki la sngewsih eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pyniap ia u, bad ha ka sngi kaba lai un sa mihpat biang . Bad ki la sngewsih palat .

en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days :
kha: un mihnoh na kata ka ïing bad un khang ïa ka hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un mih na iing sha ka jingkhang jong ka iing bad un khang ia ka iing hynriew sngi:

en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,
kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei lymda ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ka tnga kan shah shim ha ka jingkhein hapoh hynriew snem ka rta , namar ba ka la long ka tnga jong uwei u briew .

en: And you , be ye fruitful , and multiply  ; bring forth abundantly in the earth , and multiply therein .
kha: To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi, to long kiba seisoh, bad to pynmih bun ha ka khyndew , bad to pynbun ha ka .

en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge ?
kha: Hato me tip kumno ki lyoh ki per ha ka sahit bneng , ka jingtrei jong ka jingtbit bakhraw jong U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me tip ia ki jinglong ba phylla jong u uba janai ha ka jingtip ?

en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit  ; through deceit they refuse to know me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ma ki baroh ki ïalam bakla ïa la ki paralok , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ; ki la hikai ïa la ki thylliej ban lamler bad kin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingleh pop jong ki . Ki leh ïa kawei ka jingleh jubor hadien kawei pat , bad kawei ka jingleh shukor ka bud ïa kawei pat . U  Trai  u ong ba ki briew jong u ki kyntait ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka shong jong me ka don hapdeng ka jingleh thok ; lyngba ka jingleh thok ki kyntait ban ithuh ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: And the tables were the work of God , and the writing was the writing of God , graven upon the tables .
kha: U Blei hi u la thaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad u la thoh ruh ïa kita ki hukum ha kita ki maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki miej ki long ka kam U Blei , bad ka jingthoh ka long ka jingthoh U Blei , la ker ha ki miej .

en: And the king sware , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress ,
kha: Nangta u ong ha ka ,  Nga kular ïa pha da U  Trai  uba im , uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki jingjynjar baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la sngap jar bad u la ong: Kumba U Trai u im, uba la siewspah ia ka mynsiem jong nga na ka jingjynjar baroh .

en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther . So Esther arose , and stood before the king ,
kha: U syiem u la pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ha ka , kumta ka ïeng bad ka ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la bat ia ka dieng ksiar sha Esther . Kumta u Esther u la ieng bad u la ieng ha khmat u syiem .

en: The soul of the sluggard desireth , and hath nothing : but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat .
kha: Kam pher katno u briew uba jaipdeh u thrang ban ïoh ïa kaei kaei , da lei lei un ym ïoh ïa ka . Uba trei shitom un ïoh ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong u nonglehkai ka kwah, bad kam don ei ei: hynrei ka mynsiem jong u nongtrei shitom kan sa kylla long kaba heh .

en: He which testifieth these things saith ,  Surely I come quickly .  Amen . Even so , come , Lord Jesus .
kha: Uta uba ai ïa ka jingphla jong u ha kane baroh , u ong ,  Ho-oid da shisha ! Nga wan kloi !  Ai kan long kumta . To wan , Trai Jisu !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynshisha ia kine kiei kiei u ong, Hooid nga wan kloi . Amen . Wat la katta ruh, to wan, ko Trai Jisu .

en: Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .
kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha ia ka, me bneng, bad phi ki apostol bad ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid; namar U Blei u la pynshitom bein ia phi ha ka .

en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .
kha: Bad khlem da pynpaw ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei , man ka sngi la ban ïa nga da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kiei kiei kiba don shabar , kata kaba wan ha nga man ka sngi , ka jingsumar ia ki balang baroh .

en: And he laid his hands upon him , and gave him a charge , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
kha: Kumba u Trai u la hukum , u Moses u buh ïa la ki kti halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , bad u la pynbna ba une un long u nongmih bujli jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki kti jong u halor jong u bad u la ai ia u ia ka jingkitkhlieh kumba U Trai u la hukum da ka kti u Moses .

en: Heal me , O  Lord  , and I shall be healed  ; save me , and I shall be saved : for thou art my praise .
kha: A  Trai  , pynkhiah ïa nga bad ngan ïohkhiah krat ; pyllait im ïa nga bad ngan long uba shngain janai . Me long uta uba nga ïaroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhiah ia nga ko Trai, bad ngan sa koit ; pynim ia nga, bad ngan sa shah pynim: namar me long ka jingiaroh jong nga .

en: Being grieved that they taught the people , and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead .
kha: Ki la sngewbitar namar ba ki ar ngut ki apostol ki la hikai ïa ki briew ba U Jisu u lah mihpat na ka jingïap , kaba pynshisha ba kiba ïap kin mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewsih ba ki la hikai ia ki briew , bad ki la ialap lyngba U Jisu ia ka jingmihpat na kiba iap .

en: Ye shall fear every man his mother , and his father , and keep my sabbaths : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban burom ïa la ka kmie bad ïa la u kpa , bad u dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton , kumba nga la hukum . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban sheptieng ia ka kmie jong u bad ia u kpa jong u bad to sumar ia ki Sabha jong nga: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .
kha: bad to ri ïa lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ha ka jingisynei jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: To buh ia lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba wad ia ka jingisynei U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist haduh ka jingim bymjukut .

en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;
kha: Mano ba tih nur na ka bynta u slap uba hap bad ba pynkhuid ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka  erïong bad u pyrthat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la phiah ia ka wah na ka bynta ka jingtuid um palat, ne ka lynti na ka bynta ka jingshai jong u lyoh ; .

en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth : there was Abraham buried , and Sarah his wife .
kha: Kata ka dei ka lyngkha kaba u Abraham u la thied na ki Hit , dei hangta ba la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka tnga jong u ka Sarah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lyngkha kaba u Abraham u la thied na ki khun shynrang jong u Heth: hangta la tep ia u Abraham bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong u .

en: But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .
kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ngan pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai U Blei jong phi phin tieng bad un pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong ki nongshun jong phi baroh .

en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong , hynrei kito kiba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh jubor .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew un bam bha da u soh jong ka shyntur jong u: hynrei ka mynsiem jong ki nongleh kam sniew kan bam ia ka jingleh donbor .

en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh , despise dominion , and speak evil of dignities .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh , kine ki briew ki ïoh ïa ki jingïohipaw kiba pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki jong ki met ; ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingsynshar jong U Blei bad ki ïakren beiñ ïa ki jingthaw badonburom ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh kine ki nongphohsniew kiba jakhlia ki pynjakhlia ia ka doh , ki pynjah burom ia ka jingsynshar , bad ki kren sniew ia ki burom .

en: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle , even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me .
kha: Nga tip ba shen ngan sa iehnoh ïa kane ka met bapyut kumba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi u la ïathuh shai ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ba tang khyndiat por nga dei ban weng noh ia kane ka iing jong nga, kumba U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist u la pyni ia nga .

en: And he fell to the earth , and heard a voice saying unto him ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
kha: U la hap sha madan bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha u ,  Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la hap ha ka khyndew bad u la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba ong ha u, Ko Saw, ko Saw, balei me pynshitom ia nga ?

en: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come , and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem ,
kha: Haba u Hesekaïah u la ïohi ïa u Sennakherib ba u thmu ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem ruh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Hesekaiah u la iohi ba u Senakherib u la wan bad ba u la thmu ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem .

en: And Laban had two daughters : the name of the elder was Leah , and the name of the younger was Rachel .
kha: U Laban u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei ; kaba heh ka kyrteng ka Leah , bad kaba rit pat ka Rakhel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u don arngut ki khun kynthei: ka kyrteng jong u rangbah ka long ka Leah bad ka kyrteng jong u ba kham rit ka long ka Rakhel .

en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land , and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,
kha: Hadien kata , katto katne ngut na ki tymmen ki san ki la ïeng joit bad ki ong ha ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la ieng katto katne na ki rangbah jong ka ri bad u la kren ha ka jingiaseng paidbah baroh kawei da kaba ong:

en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
kha: U Jehoram u la long syiem haba u don laiphew ar snem ka rta , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoram u la don laiphew ar snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar 8 snem ha Jerusalem .

en: And on the sixth day eight bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ai phra tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew 8 tylli ki masi , ar tylli ki langbrot bad shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem da don jingduna:

en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?
kha: Balei phim shym leh ïa kane ha u Jeremaïah jong ka Anathoth , uba la kren kum u nongïathuhlypa sha ki briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata balei phim shym la pynrem ia u Jeremaiah jong u Anathoth uba pynlong ia lade u nongiathuhlypa ha phi ?

en: The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .
kha: Ka bneng ka long ka jong U  Trai  hi , hynrei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng , wat ki bneng ruh ki long ki Trai s: hynrei ka khyndew u la ai ha ki khun ki briew .

en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you , as a father doth his children ,
kha: Kumba phi tip kumno ba ngi ioh jingkyrmen bad jingaimynsiem bad jingsiew ïa baroh na phi , kumba u kpa u leh ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba phi tip kumno ngi la kyntu bad pyntngen bad kynnoh ia phi iwei ia iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah , and troubled them in building ,
kha: Nangta ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri ki pyrshang ban pynduh mynsiem bad pyntieng ïa ki Jiw bad ban khanglad ïa ka jingtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka ri ki la tlot ia ki kti jong ki briew Judah bad ki la pynshitom ia ki ha kaba tei , .

en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver .
kha: Shuh shuh u la wai shi lakh ngut ki shipai na Israel ha ka dor kaba lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thung ruh shispah hajar ngut ki briew kiba donbor na Israel na ka bynta shispah talent rupa .

en: But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .
kha: Bad phi hi phi tip , kumno u la pynshisha ïa ka jingkordor jong u , kumno ma u bad ma nga , kum u khun bad u kpa jong u , ngi la ïatreilang na ka bynta ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi tip ia ka jingpynshisha jong u, ba kum u khun bad u kpa , u la shakri bad nga ha ka gospel .

en: Wherefore he saith , When he ascended up on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts unto men .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mynba u la kiew shajrong eh , u la ïalam bad u ïa shibun kiba shah ringmraw ; u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u ong , Haba u la kiew sha jrong , u la ialam ia ka jinglong mraw bad u la ai jingai sngewbha ia ki briew .

en: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall , at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea .
kha: Haba ka Edom kan kyllon , kan don ka jingsawa kaba jur kat haduh ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan khynñiuh , bad ïa ki jingkyang tieng yn ïohsngew jngai shaduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka khih ha ka jingsawa jong ka jinghap jong ki, ha ka jingpyrta la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka ha ka duriaw kaba saw .

en: Clouds and darkness are round about him : righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .
kha: Ki lyoh bad ka jingdum ki ker sawdong ïa u ; u synshar da ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum bad ka jingdum ki long sawdong jong u: ka hok bad ka jingbishar ki long ka jaka shong jong ka khet jong u .

en: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper : and the city was pure gold , like unto clear glass .
kha: Ïa ka kynroh la thaw da u maw Jasper , bad ïa ka nongbah hi la thaw da ka ksiar nylla , kaba sngur kum ka ïit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtei ia ka kynroh jong ka ka long ka Jasper: bad ka shnong ka long ka ksiar kaba khuid, kum ka rong kaba shai .

en: And thou shalt take fine flour , and bake twelve cakes thereof : two tenth deals shall be in one cake .
kha: Shim khat-ar kilo u  purew bad shet khat-ar tylli ki kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ia ka shini kaba bha, bad shet ia ka shiphew tylli ki cake jong ka: ar tylli ki jingai shiphew tylli ki jingai kin long ha kawei ka cake .

en: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .
kha: Kito kiba la ju long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïing jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki shakri kynthei ki leh ïa nga kum ïa uba kim ithuh bad u nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba shong ha iing jong nga, bad ki shakri jong nga, ki khein ia nga kum u nongwei: Nga long u nongwei ha ka jingpeit jong ki .

en: And they departed thence , and passed through Galilee  ; and he would not that any man should know it .
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad ki la ïaleit lyngba ka Galilaïa . U Jisu um shym la kwah mano mano ruh ban tip hangno u don , namar u dang hikai ïa ki synran jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh nangta, bad ki la iaid lyngba ka Galilaia bad um kwah ba uno uno un tip ia kata .

en: When Ephraim spake trembling , he exalted himself in Israel  ; but when he offended in Baal , he died .
kha: Ha ki por mynshuwa , haba ka jait Ephraim ka la kren , kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki la sheptieng ; ki peit sha u Ephraim . Hynrei ki briew ki la leh pop da kaba mane ïa u Baal , bad na ka bynta kane kin sa ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Ephraim u la khih, u la pynkhraw ia lade ha Israel ; hynrei haba u la sngewsih ha Baal , u la iap .

en: And again he sent another  ; and him they killed , and many others  ; beating some , and killing some .
kha: U trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw , ki la pynïap ïa u ; bad ki la leh ïa kiwei pat kiba bun ha kajuh ka rukom , da kaba shoh ïa ki katto katne ngut bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la phah sa kawei pat ka ; bad ia u ki la pyniap, bad bun kiwei pat ki la shoh katto katne, bad pyniap katto katne .

en: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .
kha: Bad u la ong ïa ki ,  To sumar bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka kwah hynrei ka doh ka tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia phi bad duwai , ioh ba phin rung ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka long shisha kaba la pynkhreh , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

en: This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .
kha: Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren mynba nga la ong , ‘ U briew uba wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Une u dei ma nga uba nga la ong: Hadien jong nga u wan u briew uba kham sngewtynnad ha khmat jong nga: namar u la don ha khmat jong nga .

en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :
kha: Ki long borabor kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kiba ïai shukor , kiba ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ki jinghikai U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kane ka dei ka briew kaba leh pyrshah, kaba thok ia ki khun ki kti ki bym iohsngew ia ka hukum U Trai:

en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
kha: Ki longïing babun jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki shnong jong ki nong Gerson kat kum ki longiing jong ki ki long shiphew tylli ki nongbah kiba don ki jaka ba marjan jong ki .

en: And he blessed him , and said , Blessed be Abram of the most high God , possessor of heaven and earth :
kha: u la kyrkhu ïa u , bad u ong ,  To U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , un kyrkhu ïa u Abram !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyrkhu ia u , bad u la ong , La kyrkhu ia u Abram jong U Blei uba ha khlieh duh:

en: The mighty man , and the man of war , the judge , and the prophet , and the prudent , and the ancient ,
kha: ïa ki riewshlur bad ki shipai jong ki , ïa ki nongbishar bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , ïa ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongsaiñ hima jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba khlain bor bad u briew uba don ka thma, u nongbishar bad u nongiathuhlypa bad u riewstad bad u hyndai .

en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; and he fell upon him that he died .
kha: Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la leit bad pynïap ïa u Adonijah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la phah da ka kti u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada ; bad u la hap halor jong u ba u la iap .

en: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen  ; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation .
kha: Khie leit kyang jam sha ki blei kiba phi la jied . Ai ba kita kin pyllait ïa phi ha ka por ba phi jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad iam ha ki blei kiba phi la jied ; ai ba kin pyllait im ia phi ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong phi .

en: Then the earth shook and trembled  ; the foundations of heaven moved and shook , because he was wroth .
kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad khynñiuh ; ki nongrim jong ka suiñbneng ki khih bad ki kyiuh , namar ba U Blei u la bitar !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka khyndew ka la khih bad ka la khih; ki nongrim jong ka bneng ki la khih bad ki la khih , namar u la bitar .

en: For if I make you sorry , who is he then that maketh me glad , but the same which is made sorry by me ?
kha: Naba lada ka long ba nga pynsngewsih ïa phi , mano pat ban pyntngen ïa nga ? Lait tang da kita hi ïa kiba nga la pynsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga sngewsih ia phi , mano ba pynsngewbha ia nga , hynrei uta uba sngewsih ia nga ?

en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself , or torn , whether it be fowl or beast .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kaba la shah pynïap ha uwei pat u mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban bam ia kaei kaei kaba la iap hi , ne kaba la tyrkhong , la ka long ka khnai ne ka mrad .

en: For if the firstfruit be holy , the lump is also holy : and if the root be holy , so are the branches .
kha: Lada ïa u kpu banyngkong la ai sha U Blei , te u kpu baroh uwei ruh u long u jong u ; bad lada ïa ki thied jong u dieng la ai ha U Blei , ki tnat ruh ki long ki jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada u soh ba nyngkong u long uba khuid, ka lum ruh ka long kaba khuid: bad lada u tynrai u long uba khuid , kumjuh ruh ki tnat .

en: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me , which to you-ward is not weak , but is mighty in you .
kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingpynshisha baroh kaba phi kwah ba U Khrist u kren ha nga . Haba u pynbeit ïa phi , um long uba tlot , pynban , u pynpaw ïa la ka bor hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi wad ia ka jingpynshisha jong U Khrist uba kren ha nga, kaba ha phi kam long kaba tlot , hynrei ka long kaba donbor ha phi .

en: But speaking the truth in love , may grow up into him in all things , which is the head , even Christ :
kha: Pynban , da kaba kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit , ngi dei ban san ha ki rukom baroh ha U Khrist uba long u khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba kren ia ka jingshisha ha ka jingieit , ka lah ban san ha u ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba long ka khlieh , wat U Khrist ruh:

en: And God did so that night : for it was dry upon the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u leh ïa kata . Ha ka step kaba bud u shñiuh langbrot u rkhiang , hynrei ka khyndew ka la jhieh da ka umjer .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la leh kumta ha kata ka miet: namar ka la tyrkhong tang ha ka snieh , bad ka la don ka dewbilat ha ka khyndew baroh kawei .

en: When thou goest , thy steps shall not be straitened  ; and when thou runnest , thou shalt not stumble .
kha: Yn ym don u ban pynwit ïa ka lynti jong phi lada phi ïaid kum uba stad , bad phin ym jynthut haba phi mareh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me leit, ki step jong me kin ym tyrkhong ; bad haba me iaid kai , me dei ban ym ia tyngkhuh .

en: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .
kha: Haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingainguh bynrap dei ban pynbun kat ban ïabiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingkhein kaba phi pynkhreh , kumta phin leh ia uwei pa uwei katkum ka jingkhein jong ki .

en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child  ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him .
kha: Ki khynnah na la ka tynrai ki leh kiei kiei kiba ibieit , khlem sumar , hynrei ka jingsneng sympat kaba bha ka hikai ïa ki kumno ban long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong bieit ka la teh ha ka dohnud jong u khynnah ; hynrei u dieng pynbeit un beh noh ia ka na u .

en: And now , I beseech thee , let the power of my Lord be great , according as thou hast spoken , saying ,
kha: Kumta mynta , ko  Trai  , nga kyrpad ïa me , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa la ka bor bad leh kumba me la kular haba me ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta , nga kyrpad ia me , to ai ba ka bor U Trai jong nga kan long kaba khraw kumba me la kren da kaba ong:

en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .
kha: Lada ki kohnguh ïa U Blei bad shakri ïa u , kin pynleit ïa ka jingim jong ki ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingmanbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki kohnguh bad shakri ia u , kin pynlut ia ki sngi jong ki ha ka jingroi jingpar bad ki snem jong ki ha ki jingsngewbha .

en: We look forward to more investments and increased trade opportunities between the two countries .  " "
kha: Ngi khmih lynti ia ki jingbei tyngka kiba kham bun bad ki lad khaii pateng kiba kham bun hapdeng kine ki ar tylli ki ri .  " "
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi khmih lynti shuh shuh ia ki jingbei tyngka bad ki lad khaii pateng hapdeng ki ar tylli ki ri . .

en: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing . My brethren , these things ought not so to be .
kha: Ki kyntien jong ka jingsngewnguh bad ka jingtim ki mihnoh na kajuh ka shyntur . Ko parabangeit jong nga , kane kam dei ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kajuh ka shyntur ka mih ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim . Ki hynmen jong nga, kine kiei kiei kim dei ban long kumta .

en: And David said to Abigail , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which sent thee this day to meet me :
kha: U Dabid u ong ha ka ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la phah ïa phi ha kane ka sngi ban ïashem bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abigail , La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel uba la phah ia me ha kane ka sngi ban iakynduh ia nga:

en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .
kha: Phi lah ban leit rah ïa ka sha i pa jong phi ba in bam bad in sa ai ïa phi ka jingkyrkhu jong i shuwa ba in ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban wanrah ia ka ha u kpa jong me, ba un bam bad ba un kyrkhu ia me shuwa ba un iap .

en: Give a portion to seven , and also to eight  ; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth .
kha: Buh ïa ki jingthep pisa jong phi ha ki jaka babun — wat ha kiba bun ki jaka — namar ba phim tip da lei lei ka jait jingsniewbok aïu kaba phin ïoh ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ka bhah haduh hynriew ngut bad ruh haduh 8 ; namar me tip ia kaei kaba sniew kan long ha ka khyndew .

en: Then Ehud went forth through the porch , and shut the doors of the parlour upon him , and locked them .
kha: Nangta u Ehud u la mihnoh shabar , u khang ïa ki jingkhang hadien jong u , u khang tala ïa ki , bad u leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ehud u la leit shabar lyngba ka phyllaw, bad u la khang ia ki jingkhang jong ka paralok halor jong u, bad u la khang ia ki .

en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .
kha: Katto katne kiei kiei kiba ngi ïohsngew ba me kren ki long kiba sngewphylla ïa ngi , bad ngi kwah ban tip aïu ki kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me wanrah katto katne kiei kiei kiba phylla ha ki shkor jong ngi: ngi la tip namarkata kaei kaba kine kiei kiei ki mut .

en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they spoiled their tents .
kha: Ynda ki Israel ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , ki lute ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la wan phai na kaba beh ia ki Philistia , bad ki la pynsniew ia ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .

en: The car had Congress worker Sharda Tyagi and three others in it , instead of Rahul Gandhi , Shah said .
kha: Katei ka kali ka don ka nongtrei Congress ka Sharda Tyagi bad lai ngut kiwei pat ha ka jaka jong u Rahul Gandhi , ong u Shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kali ka don ia u nongtrei ka Congress u Sharda Tyagi bad lai ngut kiwei pat ha ka jaka jong u Rahul Gandhi, la ong u Shah .

en: Then he called for a light , and sprang in , and came trembling , and fell down before Paul and Silas ,
kha: U nongpeit phatok u la pan ïa ka jingshai , u la rung shapoh , bad u la dem da kaba khynñiuh ha ki kjat jong u Paul bad u Silas .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la pyrta ia ka jingshai bad u la rung shapoh bad u la wan khih bad u la hap ha khmat u Paul bad u Silas .

en: In dealing with this sensitive issue , Paul did not make a rule that would tell Christians what to do .
kha: Ha kaba iadei bad kane ka mat kaba khia , u Paul um shym la buh ia ka kyndon kaban iathuh ia ki Khristan ia kaei kaba ki dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba iadei bad kane ka mat kaba jylliew , u Paul um shym la thaw ia ka kyndon kaba lah ban iathuh ia ki Khristan kaei kaba ki dei ban leh .

en: Salute Herodion my kinsman . Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus , which are in the Lord .
kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Herodion , u para Jiw , bad ïa ki parabangeit kiba ha ka longïing jong u Narkissos .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam jong nga kaba la shna da u Herodion . Khublei ia ki kiba long na ka iing u Narcisos kiba don ha U Trai .

en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy  ;
kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis . Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bad ka jingsngewkhuslai ki la wan ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim bad u Petros bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis bad u la sdang ban sngew lyngngoh shibun eh;

en: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life : but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction .
kha: Husiar ïa kaei kaba phi ong bad ri ïa la ka jingim . Uba kren thurmur u pynjot ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba bat ia ka shyntur jong u u bat ia ka jingim jong u: hynrei uta uba plie ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u un ioh ia ka jingjot .

en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .
kha: Nga sngewthikna , katba nga dang thoh ïa kane , ba men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat kham palat ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba shaniah ha ka jingsngap jar jong me nga la thoh sha me , da kaba tip ba me ruh phin leh kham palat ia kaba nga ong .

en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pyniap ia u masi ha khmat U Trai , da ka jingkhang jong ka iingjahthait jong ka jingiaseng .

en: At that day shall a man look to his Maker , and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ki briew kin phai sha U Nongthaw jong ki ban ïoh ïarap , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi u briew un peit sha u Nongthaw jong u bad ki khmat jong u kin don ka jingburom ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .
kha: Kito ki briew kim long ki apostol kiba shisha — ki long ki apostol lamler , kiba shukor shaphang ka jingtrei jong ki bad thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki apostol bashisha jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kiba kum kita ki long ki apostol lamler , ki nongtrei kiba thok , ki pynkylla ia lade sha ki apostol U Khrist .

en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .
kha: ïa u saphron , u kalamus , ïa ka siasia , lane ka jingiwbih kaba bun jait . Ka mirr bad ka alos ki mih hangta lem bad ki jingsleh kiba iwbih tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong u ki long kum ki ryntieh ksiar ba la buh da ka beryl: ka kpoh jong u ka long kum ka sniehdoh kaba shai bha kaba la tap da ki sohjew .

en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
kha: Haba phi ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phin iohi ia ka Jerusalem kaba la ker sawdong da ki shipai , te to tip ba ka jingpynjot ia ka ka la jan .

en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread , which she had prepared , into the hand of her son Jacob .
kha: Ka la ai ha u ïa kata ka jingbam ba-bang , lem bad ïa u kpu ba ka la pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ai ia ka doh kaba thiang bad u kpu uba ka la pynkhreh, ha ka kti u khun jong ka u Jakob .

en: All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars  ; beside unwalled towns a great many .
kha: Kine ki shnong baroh ki long kiba la kerkut skhem da ki kynroh kiba jrong , ki khyrdop , bad ki nar-khang khyrdop , bad don ruh bun ki shnong ki bym don kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki nongbah baroh ki la shah ker sawdong bad ki kynroh kiba heh , ki khyrdop bad ki bar ; nalor ki shnong ki bym don kynroh kiba bun .

en: And David gathered all the people together , and went to Rabbah , and fought against it , and took it .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki shipai jong u , u leit sha Rabbah , u tur ïaleh ïa ka , bad u la jop ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la lum lang ia ki briew baroh, bad u la leit sha Rabbah bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka bad u la shim ia ka .

en: And they brought him on horses : and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David .
kha: Ïa ka metïap jong u la rah biang sha Jerusalem halor u kulai bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia u ha ki kulai: bad la tep ia u ha Jerusalem bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid .

en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , Come hither , and hear the words of the  Lord  your God .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Ale hangne bad sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki khun Israel: To wan shane bad to iohsngew ia ki ktien U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: For we are glad , when we are weak , and ye are strong : and this also we wish , even your perfection .
kha: Ngi sngewkmen haba ngi long kiba tlot hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ . Bad kumta ngi duwai ruh ba phin long kiba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi sngewbha, haba ngi tlot, bad phi long kiba khlain: bad kane ruh ngi kwah, wat ia ka jinglong janai jong phi ruh .

en: And it came to pass afterward , that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .
kha: Hadien kane , u Samson u ibha ïa kawei ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Delilah , kaba shong basah ha ka Them Sorek .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ka la jia ba u ieit ia kawei ka kynthei ha ka them Sorek kaba kyrteng ka Delilah .

en: Came behind him , and touched the border of his garment : and immediately her issue of blood stanched .
kha: Ka la wan ha u paidbah na shadien jong U Jisu bad ka la ktah ïa ka tduh ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wan shadien jong u, bad ka la ktah ia u pud jong ka jain jong u: bad mardor ka jingmih snam jong ka ka la sdang ban khih .

en: So they ran both together : and the other disciple did outrun Peter , and came first to the sepulchre .
kha: Baroh ar ngut ki la shu mareh , hynrei uta uwei pat u synran u la kham mareh stet ban ïa u Petros bad u la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la mareh lang baroh arngut: bad uwei pat u synran u la mareh shabar u Petros , bad u la poi nyngkong eh sha ka jingtep .

en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion  ; for he loved Hannah : but the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
kha: Bad wat la u ieit eh ïa ka Hannah , u ai ïa ka tang shi bynta namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha Hannah u la ai ia ka bynta kaba bit paid namar u la ieit ia ka Hannah: hynrei U Trai u la khang ia ka kpoh jong ka .

en: I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .
kha: Katba ka dang don ka sngi , ngi dei ban trei ïa ka kam jong uta uba la phah ïa nga ; ka miet ka wan haba ym don uba lah ban trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga dei ban trei ia ki kam jong uta uba la phah ia nga, katba ka dang sngi: ka miet ka wan , haba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban trei .

en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
kha: Shim uwei na kita ki langbrot shynrang , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men shim ia uwei u langbrot ; bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u langbrot .

en: Whosoever cometh to me , and heareth my sayings , and doeth them , I will shew you to whom he is like :
kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga bad uba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki — ngan pyn-i ha phi u ïasyriem ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga bad uba iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga bad uba leh ia ki , ngan pyni ia phi ha uba u long kum:

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , he shall fly as an eagle , and shall spread his wings over Moab .
kha: U  Trai  u la kular ba ka hima kan hiar halor ka Moab kum u pukni lem bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih , un her kum u blang , bad un pynphriang ia ki bniat jong u halor ka Moab .

en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
kha: Nangta ki synran hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu .  Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei !  ki la pynbna .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kita kiba don ha ka lieng ki la wan bad ki la mane ia u, ki da ong: Na ka jingshisha me long U Khun U Blei .

en: The  Lord  on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea , than the mighty waves of the sea .
kha: U  Trai  u synshar hakhlieh eh ha bneng , kham khraw ban ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-bah , kham donbor ban ïa ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai ha jrong u kham khlain ban ia ka jingsawa jong ki um kiba bun , hooid , ban ia ki um kiba khlain bor jong ka duriaw .

en: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .
kha: Te uta uwei pat u synran , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , u ruh u la rung shapoh ; u la ïohi bad u la ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la rung ruh uta uwei pat u synran uba la wan nyngkong sha ka jingtep , bad u la iohi bad u la ngeit .

en: When the time approached for the meeting to begin , people started coming , each one carrying a chair .
kha: Ynda la jan ka por ban sdang ka jingialang ki briew ki la sdang ban wan , uwei pa uwei u rah ia ka shuki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la jan ka por ban sdang ia ka jingialang , ki briew ki la sdang ban wan , uwei pa uwei u rah ia ka shuki .

en: For they know not to do right , saith the  Lord  , who store up violence and robbery in their palaces .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kine ki briew ki pyndap ïa la ki ïing paki dulan da kiei kiei kiba la shim da ki kam runar bad ki kam lehbor . Kim tip satia wat kumno ban lehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim tip ban leh hok , ong U Trai , kiba buh ia ka jingleh donbor bad ka jinglute ha ki iing jong ki .

en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel , who dwelt in Egypt , was four hundred and thirty years .
kha: Ki Israel ki sah ha Ijipt sawspah laiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingleit jngoh ia ki khun Israel kiba shong ha Ijipt ka long saw spah laiphew snem .

en: The brasen altar , and his grate of brass , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
kha: ïa ka duwan rnong bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ïa ki jingbah jong ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam ba la shet bad ka kjat jong u, bad ki dieng jong u, bad ki dieng jong u baroh .

en: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months : it shall be the first month of the year to you .
kha: Une un long ha phi u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u bnai un long ha phi ha kaba sdang jong ki bnai: kan long ka bnai kaba nyngkong jong u snem ha phi .

en: The web series should be immediately banned and action should be taken against those who have made it .
kha: Dei ban khang mardor ia ka web series bad dei ban shim khia ia kito kiba la shna ia ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Dei ban khang noh mardor ia ka web series bad dei ban leh pyrshah ia kito kiba la pynlong ia ka .

en: Then the deputy , when he saw what was done , believed , being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord .
kha: Haba uta u lyngskor u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , u la ngeit ; naba u la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u nongshong shnong haba u la iohi ia kaei kaba la leh , u la ngeit , u la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai U Trai .

en: Terrors are turned upon me : they pursue my soul as the wind : and my welfare passeth away as a cloud .
kha: Nga la shahjop ha ka jingshyrkhei ; ka burom jong nga ka la mihnoh kum ka lyer , bad ka spah jong nga kum u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingtieng ki kylla ha nga: ki beh ia ka mynsiem jong nga kum ka Iyer: bad ka jingbha jingmiat jong nga ka jah noh kum u lyoh .

en: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel : none went out , and none came in .
kha: Ïa ki khyrdop Jerikho la khang khop bad la ap phira ban ym ïohrung ki Israel . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban rung shapoh lane mih shabar ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Jerikoh u la shah khang namar ki khun Israel: ym don ba mih shabar bad ym don ba wan rung .

en: And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .
kha: Haba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynñiew , ka la don ka jingsngap jar ha bneng kumba shiteng kynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba hynriew , ka la don ka jingsngap jar ha bneng kumba shiteng kynta .

en: And again the word of the  Lord  came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month , saying ,
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , kaba arphew saw jong u bnai , U  Trai  u la ai ha u Haggai ïa ka khubor kaba ar
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Haggai ha ka sngi kaba sawphew snem .

en: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
kha: Nangta u lyoh u tap ïa ka Ïingjaiñ baroh kawei , bad ka burom batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka pyndap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyoh u la tap ia ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang , bad ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And it was about the space of three hours after , when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .
kha: Kumba hadien lai kynta , ka tnga jong u , ka bymtip ïa kaba lah jia , ka la wan rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumba lai kynta hadien, haba ka tnga jong u, khlem da tip ia kaei kaba la leh, ka la wan rung .

en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .
kha: Pynban haba u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba u Lasaros u la pang , U la nang sah sa ar sngi ha ka jaka kaba U la don .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la iohsngew namarkata ba u pang , u sah ar sngi ha kajuh ka jaka ba u don .

en: Behold , I have refined thee , but not with silver  ; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction .
kha: Nga la tynjuh ïa phi ha ka ding jong ka jingshah shitom , kum ka rupa ba saiñ ha ka lawar ding . Hynrei nga la shem ïa phi ba phi long ki bymdondor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la pynkhuid ia me, hynrei ym da ka rupa ; nga la jied ia me ha ka ding jong ka jingjynjar .

en: Following the method just outlined , prepare for the Watchtower Study or the Congregation Bible Study .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa kaei kaba la pyni haneng , pynkhreh ban pule ïa ka Kut Ap Phira ne ka Jingpule Baibl jong ka Balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ka rukom kaba la shu batai , pynkhreh ia ka Jingpule jong ka Jingpule ne ka Jingpule Baibl .

en: What is it therefore ? the multitude must needs come together : for they will hear that thou art come .
kha: Khlem pep kin ïohsngew ba me la poi . Te , yn ïaleh kumno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata namarkata ? u paidbah u dei ban ialum lang: namar kin iohsngew ba me wan .

en: Favour is deceitful , and beauty is vain : but a woman that feareth the  Lord  , she shall be praised .
kha: Ka jingbhabriew ka long ka jingshukor bad ka jingitynnat ka jah noh , hynrei ka kynthei kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka dei ban ïoh ïaroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbha ka long kaba thok, bad ka jingitynnad ka long kaba lehnohei: hynrei ka kynthei kaba sheptieng ia U Trai , kan shah iaroh .

en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?
kha: Ka jingim briew ka long kum ka jingshakri u shipai ba shu pynbor , kum ka jingim u nongbylla sngi uba hap ban trei shitom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym don ka por ba la buh ia u briew ha ka pyrthei ? hato ki sngi jong u ruh kim long kum ki sngi jong ka jingpynrung kam ?

en: And he said unto them , Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me , and hath hired me , and I am his priest .
kha: U jubab ,  Nga don ka jingïakut bad u Mikah , u da siewdor ïa nga ba ngan shakri kum u lyngdoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Kumta bad kumta u Mica u la iadei bad nga, bad u la thung ia nga, bad nga long u lyngdoh jong u .

en: Now these are the generations of Terah : Terah begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran  ; and Haran begat Lot .
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Terah , uba long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran . U Haran u dei u kpa jong u Lot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki pateng jong u Terah: U Terah u la kha ia u Abram, u Nahor bad u Haran; bad u Haran u la kha ia u Lot .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh jong u kpa jong u , u Jehoïakhin u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: What is man , that he should be clean ? and he which is born of a woman , that he should be righteous ?
kha: Hato don mo napdeng u briew uba da sngur shisha ? Hato don mo u ban lah ban long khuid ha khmat U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka briew kaba u dei ban long uba khuid ? bad uta uba la kha na ka kynthei , ba u dei ban long uba hok ?

en: Beat your plowshares into swords , and your pruninghooks into spears : let the weak say , I am strong .
kha: Shoh tyrnem ïa kiba nep jong ki lyngkor jong phi ban pynlong waitlam bad ïa ki wait ngor tnat dieng ban pynlong sum . Wat kiba tlot ki dei ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Beat ia ki khnam jong phi ha ki waitlam, bad ki khnam jong phi ha ki khnam: to ai ba kiba tlot kin ong , nga long uba khlain .

en: And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .
kha: U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la iathuh ia ki jingkylli jong ka baroh: bad ym don ei ei kaba buhrieh na u Solomon kaba um shym la iathuh ia ka .

en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name , that will I do , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .
kha: Bad ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pan ha ka kyrteng jong nga , khnang ba ïa ka burom U Kpa yn ïoh pynpaw lyngba U Khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba phin pan ha ka kyrteng jong nga , kata ngan leh , ba U Kpa un shah pyndonburom ha U Khun .

en: And when the people heard these evil tidings , they mourned : and no man did put on him his ornaments .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sdang ban ïambriew bad kim shym deng jingdeng shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew ki la iohsngew ia kine ki khubor kiba sniew , ki la iam: bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba la phong ia ki jingdeng jong u .

en: And another came , saying , Lord , behold , here is thy pound , which I have kept laid up in a napkin :
kha: Uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , kane ka long ka sbai ksiar jong me ; nga la buhrieh ïa ka hapoh ka jaiñ rumal .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u la wan, u da ong, ko Trai, ha kane ka jaka jong me, kaba nga la buh ha ka napkin:

en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement .
kha: Kane ka phyllaw kaba habar ka long kham hapoh ban ïa ka phyllaw kaba hapoh . Ka la don ka khyrdop kham hajrong kaba lam sha ka phyllaw kaba hapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lynti iaid kjat kaba don sha shiliang jong ki khyrdop ka long kaba kham poh .

en: ( And his daughter was Sherah , who built Beth–horon the nether , and the upper , and Uzzen–sheerah . )
kha: U Ephraim u don kawei ka khun kaba kyrteng ka Sheerah . Ka tei ïa ki shnong jong ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , bad ïa ka Ussen Sheerah .
translated_en_to_kha: (Bad ka khun jong u ka long ka Sherah kaba la tei ia ka Bethhoron kaba shapoh, bad kaba shalor bad ka Uerah . )

en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To sumar ; to phikir ïa lade pyrshah ïa u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki: To sumar bad to husiar na ka jingkhleh jong ki Pharisi bad ki Sadusi .

en: Helen Puweiñ, President of Bellefonte Community College and Head of PHE Department Lumshyiap, Shillong.
kha: Helen Puweiñ, President ka Bellefonte Community College bad ki heh ka tnat PHE Lumshyiap, Shillong.
translated_en_to_kha: U Helen Puweiñ, President ka PHE Community College bad u Khliehduh ka PHE Department Lumshyiap, Shillong.

en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,
kha: To wan sha U Trai , u maw uba im uba la kyntait da u briew kum u bymmyntoi hynrei uba la jied da U Blei ba u long uba kordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba wan, kum u maw uba im, la kyntait shisha na ki briew, hynrei la jied da U Blei bad uba kordor .

en: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God .
kha: bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh , u Benaïah bad u Jahasiel kin put ïa ki turoi borabor ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah ruh bad u Jahaziel ki lyngdoh kiba don ki turoi ki iai bteng ha khmat ka synduk ka jutang U Blei .

en: For we preach not ourselves , but Christ Jesus the Lord ; and ourselves your servants for Jesus  sake .
kha: Naba ym dei ïa lade ba ngi ïalap ; ngi ïalap ïa U Jisu Khrist kum U Trai , bad ma ngi kum ki shakri jong phi na ka bynta U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim ialap ia lade , hynrei ia U Khrist Jisu U Trai ; bad ia lade ki shakri jong phi na ka bynta U Jisu .

en: For it is the day of the  Lord s  vengeance , and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion .
kha: Kane ka dei ka por ha kaba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Seïon bad pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Trai, bad ka snem jong ka jingsiew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingiakren jong ka Seion .

en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people , that they had not done sacrifice unto them .
kha: Wat da kine ki kyntien , ki apostol da kaba jwat ki la lah ban khang ïa u paidbah na kaba ai jingkñia ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kine ki jingkren ki la khanglad ia ki briew , ba kim shym la leh ia ka jingknia ha ki .

en: That thou hast slain my children , and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them ?
kha: khlem da shim ïa ki khun jong nga bad kñia ïa ki ha ki bleithaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me la pyniap ia ki khun jong nga , bad me la pynpoi ia ki ban pynlong ia ki ban iaid lyngba ka ding na ka bynta jong ki ?

en: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Bad u Solomon u bteng ,  U Dabid u kpa jong nga u la thmu ban tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long ha ka dohnud u kpa jong nga ban tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty  ; with whom , if he come shortly , I will see you .
kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ïa u para jong ngi , u Timothi la pyllait na ka ïingbyndi . Lada u wan kloi , ngan wan ryngkat bad u haba nga wan jngoh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip ba u hynmen jong ngi u Timothi u la shah set ha ka jinglaitluid ; bad uba lada u wan tang khyndiat por , ngan sa iohi ia phi .

en: Then cometh Simon Peter following him , and went into the sepulchre , and seeth the linen clothes lie ,
kha: Nadien jong u la wan u Simon Petros , bad u la leit beit shapoh ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Simon Petros u la wan bud ia u, bad u la leit shapoh ka jingtep bad u la iohi ia ki jain lin ba ki thiah .

en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall .
kha: Phi la shem ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ki donkam ïa ka jingshna pynbha . Phi la leit khmih ïa ki ïing baroh ha Jerusalem bad phi la pynkhyllem katto katne na ki ban ïoh ki maw ban shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la khein ia ki iing Jerusalem bad ki iing phi la pynpra ban pynskhem ia ka kynroh .

en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .
kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tim bad kyntait ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u bymman u sngew sarong ia ka jingkwah jong u, bad u kyrkhu ia kiba thrang , ia uba U Trai u sngewsih .

en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ka, Ko khun, to long ka jingpyntngen kaba bha: ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynlong ia me baroh kawei ban leit suk .

en: And the king said , Divide the living child in two , and give half to the one , and half to the other .
kha: u ong ,  Phiah arliang ïa u khunlung uba dang im , bad ai shiliang ha kawei , bad shiliang ha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , Pyniakhlad ia u khynnah uba im arngut bad ai shiteng ia uta uba im bad shiteng ia uwei pat .

en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people , because he hath magnified himself against the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka Moab yn pynjot bad kan ym long shuh ka hima , namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Moab un shah pynjot na ka jinglong briew , namar u la pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me , as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?
kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Balei keiñ phi pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ba phi da ïathuh ha uta u briew ba phi don sa uwei u para ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la ong: Balei phi la leh bein ia nga haduh katta katta, haduh ban da iathuh ia uta u briew la phi dang don ne em u hynmen ?

en: They say unto him , Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement , and to put her away ?
kha: Ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei , te , ba u Moses u ai ka hukum ïa u briew ban ai ïa ka jingpynbna pyllait tnga ha ka tnga jong u bad phah noh ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong ha u , Balei u Moses u la hukum ban ai ia ka jingthoh jong ka jingpyniakhlad bad ban weng noh ia ka ?

en: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man  ; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons .
kha: U samla Lebi u mynjur ban shong bad u Mikah bad u la long hi kum u khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lebi u la sngewhun ban shong bad uta u briew ; bad uta u samla u la long ha u kum uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: So is this great and wide sea , wherein are things creeping innumerable , both small and great beasts .
kha: Ka don ka duriaw-bah , kaba heh bad kaba ïar , ha kaba ki jingthaw bym lah ñiew shuh ki im , kiba rit bad kiba heh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh kane ka duriaw kaba khraw bad kaba heh , ha kaba kiei kiei ki nang kiew khlem da khein , baroh ar ki mrad kiba rit bad kiba heh .

en: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease  ; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard .
kha: Ngan pynkut noh ïa ki jingrwai jong pha baroh , bad ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki sur tem na ki duitara jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ka jingsawa jong ki jingrwai jong me ban sangeh noh ; bad ka sur jong ki harp jong me kan ym iohsngew shuh .

en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .
kha: U pynim ïa ki na kito kiba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynim ia ki na ka kti jong uta uba shun ia ki , bad u la pyllait im ia ki na ka kti jong u nongshun .

en: They may think that as long as they live a good life according to their standards , that will suffice .
kha: Ki lah ban pyrkhat ba katba ki dang im ka jingim kaba bha katkum ka jinglong jong ki , kata kan biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lah ban pyrkhat ba katba ki dang im ka jingim kaba bha katkum ka jinglong jong ki , kata kan biang .

en: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .
kha: Wat ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka mane Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat iathuhlypa shuh ha Bethel: namar ka long ka iing syiem jong u syiem, bad ka long ka iing syiem jong u syiem .

en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .
kha: U Blei bakhraw jong ki Israel um ju lamler lane kylla la ka jingmut . Um dei u briew — um ju kylla la ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ka Jingkhlain jong ki Israel kan ym thok ne kylla bamut: namar um dei u briew , ba un kylla bamut .

en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .
kha: Nangta u syiem bashlur un mihpaw . Un synshar halor ka hima bakhraw bad un leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem uba khlain bor un ieng , uta un synshar da ka jingsynshar kaba khraw bad un leh kat kum ka mon jong u .

en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;
kha: Mar kumta hi , U  Trai  u pynhap ïa u kyndok ding ha ki nongbah Sodom bad Gomorrah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la slap ha u Sodom bad ha u maw Gomorrah bad ka ding na U Trai na bneng ; .

en: And the king said unto Barzillai , Come thou over with me , and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem .
kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Ale bad nga ha Jerusalem , bad ngan khmih sumar ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Barzillai, Me wan ryngkat bad nga bad ngan ai bam ia me bad nga ha Jerusalem .

en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .
kha: Lada u briew u lah ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ka hukum , nga long uba khlem jingrem .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang ka jingkmen , ka jingpynshitom bein ia ka balang ; kaba ktah ia ka hok kaba don ha ka ain , khlem jingbakla .

en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , give me this water , that I thirst not , neither come hither to draw .
kha: Ko Kynrad ,  kata ka briew ka la ong ,  to ai ha nga ïa kata ka um ! Te ngan ym sliang shuh , lymne ngan hap wan shane ban tong um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka ong ha u, ko Sir, to ai ia nga ia kane ka um, ba ngam sliang, lymne nga wan hangne ban tan .

en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again  ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand :
kha: U la buh biang ïa u nongrah khuri rangbah ha ka kyrdan kaba u bat mynshuwa , hynrei u la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynphai biang ia u nongkhaii ba ha khlieh duh jong u.

en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision , but a new creature .
kha: Kam pher ei ei satia la otsher ne ym shym la otsher , kaei kaba donkam ka long ban long u jingthaw uba thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha U Khrist Jisu ym don ka jingkren bein ia kaei kaei, ne ka jingbymkren bein, hynrei ka jingthaw kaba thymmai .

en: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought , which say , Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength ?
kha: Phi kob shaphang kaba ïoh kurup ïa ka shnong Lodebar . Phi kob ,  Ngi la long kiba khlaiñ bha ban ïohknieh ïa ka Karnaim .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba sngewbha ia kaei kaei kaba khlem jingmyntoi , kiba ong , Hato ngim shym la shim ia ngi da ka bor jong ngi hi ?

en: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families , the cities , and their villages .
kha: Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit ïa kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Gad hadien ki longiing jong ki , ki nongbah bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me , and that which I was afraid of is come unto me .
kha: Baroh kaba nga sheptieng bad sngewtriem ka wan jia shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata kaba nga la tieng shibun ka la wan ha nga , bad kata kaba nga la tieng ka la wan ha nga .

en: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord , which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh ;
kha: Ka dei shaphang U Khun jong u , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi : Shaphang ka jinglongbriew jong u , ïa u la kha uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang U Khun jong u U Jisu Khrist jong ngi , uba la pynlong na u symbai u Dabid kat kum ka doh ; .

en: And Cain went out from the presence of the  Lord  , and dwelt in the land of Nod , on the east of Eden .
kha: Bad u Kain u leit noh na ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la shong la sah ha ka ri ba la kyrteng  Ka Nod     kaba don shaphang mihngi na ka Kper Eden .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kain u la mih noh na khmat U Trai bad u la shong ha ka ri Nod shaphang mihngi jong ka Eden .

en: And when she was come to her house , she found the devil gone out , and her daughter laid upon the bed .
kha: Ka la leit sha ïing bad ka la shem ïa ka khun jong ka ba ka thiah ha ka jingthiah ; u ksuid u la lah mihnoh shisha na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la poi ha iing jong ka , ka la lap ia u ksuid ba u la mih noh , bad ka khun jong ka ka la thiah halor ka jingthiah .

en: Mike Brearley , the captain Botham had replaced , resumed the reins for the third Test , at Headingley .
kha: U Mike Brearley uba dei u kapten uba la bujli da u Botham u la shimti biang ïa ka jingsynshar na ka bynta ka Test kaba lai , ha Headingley .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mike Brearley, u kapten u Botham u la bujli, u la sdang biang ia ki kyndon na ka bynta ka Test kaba lai, ha ka Headingley .

en: And they were haughty , and committed abomination before me : therefore I took them away as I saw good .
kha: Ki la sngewsarong bad mutlop bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba nga isih , kumta nga la pynjot ïa ki , kumba pha tip bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngewsih bad ki la leh ia kaba sngewsih ha khmat jong nga: namarkata nga la shim noh ia ki kumba nga iohi ia kaba bha .

en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness  ; but of every one that is hasty only to want .
kha: Da thmu bha bad phin ïoh kyrhai ; lada phi leh kyrkieh palat phin nym dap biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba minot ki kham sngewtynnad tang ia ka jinglong ba bun paid hynrei jong uwei pa uwei uba kyrkieh tang ban kwah .

en: And so it was , that , while they were there , the days were accomplished that she should be delivered .
kha: Ka la punkhun , bad katba ki dang don ha Bethlehem , ka por ka la dei ïa ka ba kan kha khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ka la long , kata , katba ki dang don hangta , la pyndep ia ki sngi ba dei ban pynpoi ia ka .

en: “Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble .”
kha: “Lah kaba shikyntien ka ja suda ha ba bad ka jingsuk , ban ia ka ing kaba dap da ka jingkhawai lem bad ka jingialeh .”
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban bam ia u kpu uba rkhiang da ka jingsuk jingmut ban ia kaba don ka jingkhawai ha ka iing kaba dap da ka jingeh .

en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms , The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
kha: Naba u Dabid hi u ong ha ka kitab Ki Salm ,   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : to shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid hi u ong ha ka Kitab Salm , U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga , To shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga .

en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them : and after that his brethren talked with him .
kha: Nangta katba u dang ïam kumta , u piam u doh sa ïa ki hynmen jong u baroh ; hadien kata , ki hynmen jong u ki sa ïakren ïakhana bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la kdup ia ki hynmen jong u baroh, bad u la iam halor jong ki: bad hadien kata ki hynmen jong u ki la iakren bad u .

en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot  ; yea , thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :
kha: Nangta sa khmied biang ïa ka pyrthei , kum uba skhem bad uba shlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar te men rah ia ka khmat jong me khlem da sniew ; hooid , me long uba stet bad wat tieng:

en: For he was astonished , and all that were with him , at the draught of the fishes which they had taken :
kha: Ma u bad kiwei pat kiba don lem bad u ki la sngewphylla ïa ka jingbun palat ki dohkha kiba ki la ïoh tong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la lyngngoh bad baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, ha ka jingkhluit jong ki dohkha kiba ki la shim:

en: And again , I will put my trust in him . And again , Behold I and the children which God hath given me .
kha: U ong ruh ,  Ngan buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U Blei .  Bad u ong ruh ,  Hangne nga don bad ki khun ïa kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien , ngan buh ia ka jingshaniah jong nga ha u . Bad sa shisien pat , Ha khmih ma nga bad ki khun kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga .

en: Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .
kha: U Syiem Dabid mynta u la tymmen bha , bad wat la ki shakri jong u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um shym syaid satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u syiem Dabid u la tymmen bad u la tyrkhong ha ki snem ; bad ki la tap ia u da ki jain , hynrei um shym la shit .

en: Yet I will distress Ariel , and there shall be heaviness and sorrow : and it shall be unto me as Ariel .
