kha: bad nangta U Blei un wallam ka jingjot ïa ka nongbah ïa kaba la khot  ka duwan U Blei .  Kan don ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew , bad ka nongbah baroh kawei kan long kum ka duwan ba la tap da ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ia u Ariel, bad kan don ka jingkhia bad ka jingsngewsih: bad kan long ha nga kum u Ariel .

en: He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
kha: U la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong lem bad ki jingthmu jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyni ia ka bor da ka kti jong u ; u la pynphriang ia kiba sngew sarong ha ka jingmutdur jong ki dohnud jong ki .

en: And Absalom said to Hushai , Is this thy kindness to thy friend ? why wentest thou not with thy friend ?
kha: La jia aïu ïa ka jingkyrshan jong me ïa u Dabid , u paralok jong me ?  u Absalom u la kylli ïa u .  Balei mem leit ryngkat bad u ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la ong ha u Hushai , Hato kane ka long ka jingbhabriew jong me ia u paralok jong me ? balei ba me leit bad u paralok jong me ?

en: Therefore I will look unto the  Lord   ; I will wait for the God of my salvation : my God will hear me .
kha: Hynrei ngan ap khmih ïa U  Trai  ; ngan ap skhem ïa U Blei , u ban pyllait im ïa nga . U Blei jong nga un sngew ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan peit sha U Trai ; ngan ap ia U Blei jong ka jingpynim jong nga: U Blei jong nga un iohsngew ia nga .

en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .
kha: Me pynshitom ïa la ki briew , A  Trai bad ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai, ha ka jingeh ki la leit jngoh ia me, ki la theh ia ka jingduwai haba ka jingpynshitom jong me ka la long halor jong ki .

en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .
kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam don Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba hok kin sngew lyngngoh ia kane , bad ki bym don pop kin pynkhih ia lade pyrshah ia u nongleh arsap .

en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .
kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U Blei un pyn-i ka jingisynei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba tap ia ki pop jong u un ym roi: hynrei uno uno uba phla bad iehnoh ia ki un ioh jingisynei .

en: Also of your own selves shall men arise , speaking perverse things , to draw away disciples after them .
kha: Ka por kan wan ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka kynhun jong phi kin ïathuh ki jinglamler ban ïalam noh ïa ki parabangeit ban bud ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh na ki briew jong phi hi kin mih, ki kren ia kiei kiei kiba bakla, ban tan noh ia ki synran hadien jong ki .

en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria , Whereon do ye trust , that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem ?
kha: Ma nga , u Sennakherib , u Patsha ka Assyria , nga kylli uei uba ai ha phi ba phin don ïa ka jingsngewskhem katba ka Jerusalem ka dang don ha ka jingshah kerkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Sennakherib u syiem Assyria , Phi shaniah ha ka jingshah set ha Jerusalem ?

en: Daniel answered and said , Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever : for wisdom and might are his :
kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor ! to ïaroh ïa u junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Daniel u la jubab bad u la ong , La kyrkhu ia ka kyrteng U Blei junom: namar ka jingstad bad ka bor jong u:

en: And next him was Jehozabad , and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war .
kha: Uba hapoh jong u ha ka jingïalam ïa ki shipai u dei u Jehosabad uba long halor ki shi lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , kiba la kieng atiar bha na ka bynta ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u la long u Jehosbad bad bad u la pynkhreh ia ka thma .

en: By the word of the  Lord  were the heavens made  ; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth .
kha: U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng da ka hukum jong u , ïa ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur da ka sur kren jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka ktien U Trai la thaw ia ki bneng; bad ki kynhun jong ki baroh da ka jingsawa jong ka shyntur jong u .

en: Children and parents worship together and learn how to benefit from the good news . —Read Micah 4 :1-4 .
kha: Ki khun bad ki kmie ki kpa ki ïa mane lang bad ki ïoh jinghikai kumno ban myntoi na ka khubor babha .—Pule Mikah 4 :1-4 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah bad ki kmie ki kpa ki mane lang bad ki nang kumno ban ioh jingmyntoi na ka khubor babha .  Pule Micah 4 :1-4.

en: What thing soever I command you , observe to do it : thou shalt not add thereto , nor diminish from it .
kha: Leh ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa phi ; wat pyntam ha ka ne pynduna ei ei na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba nga hukum ia phi, to peit ban leh ia kata: me dei ban pyndap ia ka, ne pynduna na ka .

en: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts , he answering said unto them ,  What reason ye in your hearts ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Balei phi pyrkhat kum ïa kita kiei kiei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba U Jisu u la sngewthuh ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , u la jubab ia ki , Kaei ka daw ha ki dohnud jong phi ?

en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord s bondmen .
kha: Bah , lada yn shem ïa ka ha uno uno na ngi , uta u dei ban ïap , bad kiba sah na ngi kin long noh ki mraw jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uno uno na ki shakri jong me ba la lap, to ai ba un iap, bad ngi ruh ngin long ki mraw jong nga.

en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .
kha: Uno uno u shynrang na ka longïing lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa ka , hynrei dei ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid , naba ka long kaba khuid bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u shynrang napdeng ki lyngdoh un bam ia ka: yn bam ia ka ha ka jaka bakhuid: ka long kaba khuid tam .

en: But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
kha: Hynrei la bishar bad la pynshitom ïa ngi da U Trai , khnang ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba la bishar ia ngi , ngi shah pynrem ha U Trai , ba ngin ym shah pynrem bad ka pyrthei .

en: Call unto me , and I will answer thee , and shew thee great and mighty things , which thou knowest not .
kha: To khot kyrpad ïa nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi ; ngan ïathuh ïa phi kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba sngewphylla kiba phim shym la tip ei ei shaphang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Khot ia nga , bad ngan jubab ia me , bad ngan pyni ia me ia kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba khlain bor kiba me tip .

en: Are they not all ministering spirits , sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation ?
kha: Ki angel ki dei kiei , te ? Ki dei ki mynsiem kiba shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ki la phah da u ban ïarap ïa kito kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kim dei baroh ki mynsiem kiba shakri , kiba la phah shabar ban shakri na ka bynta jong ki ki ban long ki nongioh pateng ia ka jingpynim ?

en: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .
kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala , ha ki lum , bad hapoh ka syrngiew jong ki dieng baroh , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong bad ha ki lum bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam .

en: It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
kha: Ka long kumne . Ka kynthei ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u  purew tad haduh ba ka lyngngun kpu baroh kawei ka sieb .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kum ka jingkhleh , kaba ka kynthei ka la shim bad buhrieh ha ki lai tylli ki jingthew jingbam , haduh ba baroh kawei ka la long kaba la khleh lang .

en: ( Now that he ascended , what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth ?
kha: Mynta , ka mut aïu  u la kiew shajrong  ? Ka mut ba nyngkong u la leit hiar sha kiba jylliew tam shapoh ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Mynta ba u la kiew , kaei kata hynrei ba u ruh u la hiar nyngkong sha ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka khyndew ?

en: Who shall also confirm you unto the end , that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: U ruh un batskhem ïa phi haduh kaba kut , khnang ba phin long kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ruh ban pynskhem ia phi haduh kaba kut, ba phin long kiba khlem jingbakla ha ka sngi U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: The way of the  Lord  is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
kha: U  Trai  u ïada ïa ki briew kiba ïaid hok ; hynrei u pynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti U Trai ka long ka bor ia kiba hok: hynrei ka jingpynjot kan long ia ki nongtrei bymman .

en: And they said unto Jephthah , Come , and be our captain , that we may fight with the children of Ammon .
kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Wan bad ïalam ïa ngi , ba ngin lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u Jephthah, To wan, bad to long u rangbah jong ngi, ba ngin ialeh bad ki khun Ammon .

en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee , and thou shalt be cut off for ever .
kha: Namar ba pha lute bad pynïap ïa la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa pha yn pynjot bad pynjahburom junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingleh donbor jong me pyrshah ia u hynmen jong me u Jakob kan tap ia me , bad me yn ot noh ia me junom .

en: To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
kha: Nga ai ïa ki ha phi mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban sumar ia ki hukum U Trai bad ki ain jong u kiba nga hukum ia me mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong me ?

en: Apart from giving inner satisfaction , can attention to our spiritual needs help us in a practical way ?
kha: Lait na kaba ai ka jingsngewhun kaba hapoh , hato ka jingpyrkhat ia ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi kan iarap ia ngi ha ka rukom kaba treikam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lait na kaba ai ia ka jingsngewhun kaba hapoh , hato ka jingpyrkhat ia ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi ka lah ban iarap ia ngi ha ka rukom kaba treikam ?

en: Of course , there are requirements to be met if we are to live forever in the coming Paradise on earth .
kha: Hooid , ki don ki jingdawa kiba ngi hap ban pynbiang lada ngi kwah ban im junom la junom ha ka Paradais ban sa wan ha ka Pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki don ki jingdonkam ban iakynduh lada ngi kwah ban im junom ha ka Paradais kaban sa wan ha ka pyrthei .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people went out into the field  ; and they told Abimelech .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Abimelekh u lap ba ki paid Shekhem ki la pynkhreh ban leit sha lyngkha ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, ki briew ki la leit sha lyngkha ; bad ki la iathuh ha u Abimelech .

en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me . And being turned , I saw seven golden candlesticks  ;
kha: Nga la phai sawdong ban peit uei uba la kren ïa nga , bad nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la phai ban iohi ia ka sur kaba kren bad nga . Bad haba nga la phai , nga la iohi hynriew tylli ki sharak ksiar ;

en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
kha: Mano ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba thngan , haba ki khun rit jong ki , ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingbam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba pynbiang ia ka jingbam jong u ? haba ki khun jong u ki iam ha U Blei , ki iaid kai namar ka jingbym don doh .

en: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jong nga , namar nga kyrmen ba U Blei un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi baroh bad ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da kaba pynkhreh ia nga ruh: namar nga shaniah ba lyngba ki jingduwai jong phi yn ai ha phi .

en: Else , if thou refuse to let my people go , behold , to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast :
kha: Lada me dang ïai kyntait , te ngan wallam ïa ki puit ha ka ri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta lada me kyntait ban pyllait ia ki briew jong nga, ha khmih, lashai ngan wanrah ia ki khnai sha rud duriaw jong me:

en: God shall enlarge Japheth , and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem  ; and Canaan shall be his servant .
kha: To U Blei un pynkhraw ïa u Japheth , Ai ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin shong kin sah bad ki briew jong u Shem ! U Kanaan un long u mraw jong u Japheth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei un pynheh ia u Japhet , bad un shong ha ki ïingjaiñ u Shem ; bad u Kanaan un long u shakri jong u .

en: For rest of the crops , return to farmers over their cost of production is estimated to be at least 50 .
kha: Na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthung , ka jingwanphai sha ki nongrep halor ka jinglut jingsep jong ki la antad ba kan long ym duna ia ka 50 .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthung , ka jingwanphai biang sha ki nongrep halor ka jinglut jong ki la antad ba ka long ym duna ia ka 50 .

en: We then , as workers together with him , beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain .
kha: Ha ka jingtrei jong ngi lem bad U Blei , namarkata , ngi kyrpad ïa phi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingaiei U Blei ban ym pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi nangta, kum ki nongtrei ryngkat bad u, ngi kyrpad ia phi ruh ba phin ym pdiang ia ka jingaiei U Blei khlem da don ei ei .

en: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .
kha: Na ka bynta kita kiba bud ïa kane ka rukom ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingsuk bad ka jingisynei kan long lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki briew jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki iaid katkum kane ka kyndon , ka jingsuk kan long ha ki , bad ka jingisynei , bad ha ki Israel U Blei .

en: The burden upon Arabia . In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge , O ye travelling companies of Dedanim .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Arabia . Phi ki briew jong ka Dedan , kiba ki kynhun leit jingleit jong phi ki shong dara ha ka rudnong bashrah jong ka Arabia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit ha Arabia . Ha ka khlaw ha Arabia phin sah , ko phi ki kompeni kiba leit jingleit jong ka Dedanim .

en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it : and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .
kha: Ka kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar , ban ïa u khiew ksiar lane ïa ka ïit babha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ksiar bad ka kristal kam lah ban iaryngkat bad ka: bad ka jingkylla jong ka kan ym long na ka bynta ki mawkordor ksiar kiba bha .

en: ( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )
kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar hano hano ruh na ki ; la pynbaptis ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar haduh mynta um pat hap ha uwei ruh na ki: tang la pynbaptis ia ki ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu . )

en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
kha: Ha ka met jong u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don saw tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sharak kin don saw tylli ki khiew ba la shna kum ki almond , bad ki knop jong ki bad ki syntiew jong ki .

en: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our cattle , shall be there in the cities of Gilead :
kha: Ki tnga bad ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ki jingri lem bad ki langbrot jong ngi , kin sah hangne ha ki shnong ka Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit jong ngi, ki tnga jong ngi, ki kynhun jong ngi bad ki masi jong ngi baroh kin don hangta ha ki nongbah Gilead:

en: Go and tell my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  , Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in ?
kha: Khie leit ïathuh ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dei ma me u ban tei ka templ ïa nga ba ngan shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad iathuh ia u shakri jong nga u Dabid , Kumta u ong U Trai , Hato me tei ia nga ia ka iing na ka bynta jong nga ban shong ?

en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering  ; ( for he is faithful that promised  ; )
kha: To ngin batskhem da ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba ngi ïaphla , namar ngi lah ban shaniah ba U Blei u bat ïa la ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin bat skhem ia ka kam jong ka jingngeit jong ngi khlem da khih ; (na u long uba iaineh uba la kular ; )

en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .
kha: Kumta phi phla shisha ba phi long ki khun ki ksiew jong kito kiba la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phi long ki sakhi ia lade , ba phi long ki khun jong ki kiba la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Prepare the table , watch in the watchtower , eat , drink : arise , ye princes , and anoint the shield .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw la dep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai ; ïa ki jaiñ rben la siang na ka bynta kiba shah khot sngewbha ba kin shong . Ki da ïabam bad ïadih . Kynsan la sawa ka hukum :  Ko rangbah shipai ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh ia ka miej, peit ha ka jaka peitkai, bam, dih: to khie, phi ki syiem, bad to pynsleh ia ka jingda .

en: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable : but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki tip ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban kren , hynrei kiba bymman borabor ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba pynmong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong kiba hok ki tip ia kaei kaba lah ban pdiang: hynrei ka shyntur jong kiba sniew ka kren lyngngoh .

en: And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
kha: Hato une u dei u khun jong phi ? Phi ong ba la kha matlah ïa u ; te kumno pat mynta u la imat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia ki da kaba ong: Hato une u khun jong phi uba phi ong ba la kha matlah ? kumno te mynta u iohi ?

en: Shall not the day of the  Lord  be darkness , and not light ? even very dark , and no brightness in it ?
kha: Ka sngi U  Trai  kan wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ym ïa ka jingshai ; kan long ka sngi ka jingdum tliw tliw , khlem kano kano ka jingphyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka sngi U Trai kan ym long ka jingdum , bad ym ka jingshai ? wat ka jingdum kaba dum bha , bad ym don jingshai ha ka ?

en: And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jubab ,  Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Haduh ar hajar lai spah sngi; nangta yn pynkhuid ia ka jaka kyntang .

en: Marriage is honourable in all , and the bed undefiled : but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge .
kha: Ïa ka jingshongkurim dei ban ri burom da baroh , bad kiba long shi tnga ki dei ban shaniah iwei ïa iwei pat . U Blei un sa bishar ïa kito kiba awria bad ïa kito kiba klim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshongkha ka long kaba donburom ha baroh , bad ka jingthiah khlem da pynkhuid: hynrei ki nongkhaii bad ki nongkhaii met U Blei un bishar .

en: And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?
kha: Bad haba ki la bam bad dih , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynhun ïa ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi la bam bad haba phi la dih , hato phim shym la bam na ka bynta lade bad phim shym la dih na ka bynta lade ?

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehoïakim u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la leh .

en: But in this will we consent unto you : If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised  ;
kha: Ngin mynjur tang ha kane : ba phin long kum ma ngi da kaba ki shynrang jong phi baroh kin shah otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kane ngin mynjur ia phi: Lada phi long kumba ngi long, ba uwei pa uwei u shynrang na phi un shah ot ; .

en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .
kha: Bun na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Grik kiba ha ka kyrdan ba-halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang bad bun ki rangbah Grik ruh ki la ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata bun na ki ki ngeit; ruh ia ki kynthei kiba donburom kiba long ki Grik , bad ki shynrang , ym tang khyndiat .

en: And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
kha: lem bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingker .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sawphew tylli ki sok rupa jong ki; ar tylli ki soket hapoh kawei ka lieng .

en: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith  ; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby .
kha: Lada phi trei ha ka par maw , phi ïoh jingmynsaw na ki maw . Lada phi thlieh dieng , phi ïoh jingmynsaw haba phi leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba weng noh ia ki maw un shah pynmong da kata ka met bad uta uba pynkhih ia u dieng un sa jah noh da kata .

en: And it came to pass , that while he executed the priest s office before God in the order of his course ,
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Sekharaïah u dang pyndep ïa ka kam kum u lyngdoh ha ka Templ , da kaba shim ïa la ka bynta ha ka jingshakri ba man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , ba katba u dang pyndep ia ka kam lyngdoh ha khmat U Blei ha ka rukom jong u .

en: And the same day , when the even was come , he saith unto them ,  Let us pass over unto the other side .
kha: Ha ka janmiet jong kata kajuh ka sngi , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  To ngin ïaleit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kajuh ka sngi haba la poi ka janmiet , u ong ha ki , To ngin iaid sha shiliang .

en: And the  Lord  put a word in Balaam s mouth , and said , Return unto Balak , and thus thou shalt speak .
kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Balaam kumno ban kren bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Balak , ban ai ha u ïa ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la buh ia ka ktien ha ka shyntur jong u Balaam, bad u la ong, To leit phai noh sha Balak, bad kumta me dei ban kren .

en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus , saying , Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven ?
kha: Ha kata ka por ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu , da kaba kylli ,  Uei uba khraw tam ha ka Hima ki bneng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu da kaba ong: Mano ba khraw tam ha ka hima bneng ?

en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall : and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink .
kha: Hangta ki la tyrwa ïa U Jisu ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka kynja bakthang ; hynrei hadien ba u la mad ïa ka , um treh dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia u sohjew ban dih da ka gall: bad ynda u la mad ia ka , un ym dih .

en: Saying ,  What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee ?  And he said , Lord , that I may receive my sight .
kha: Kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?   Ko Kynrad ,  u la jubab ,  nga kwah ban imat pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Kaei kaba nga leh ia me ? Bad u la ong , ko Trai , ba ngan ioh ia ka jingpeit jong nga .

en: That no man should be moved by these afflictions : for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto .
kha: khnang ba yn ym don mano mano na phi ban phai dien noh namar kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ . Phi hi phi ïatip ba kiba kum kine ki jingpynshitom beiñ ki long ka bynta jong ka mon U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ym don briew uba dei ban shah pynkhih ha kine ki jingjynjar: namar phi tip ba la thung ia ngi ha kata ka por .

en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit  ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
kha: U dieng uba plung um pynmih u soh uba sniew , lymne u dieng uba swai ïa u soh uba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u dieng uba bha um ju pynmih soh ba sniew ; bad u dieng uba sniew um ju pynmih soh uba bha .

en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords , and drank wine before the thousand .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet u syiem Belshassar u la khot sngewbha shihajar ngut ki rangbah donburom sha ka jingkhawai kaba khraw , bad ki la ïadih waiñ lang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Belshasar u syiem u la leh ia ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha ki hajar ngut ki kynrad jong u , bad u la dih wain ha khmat ki hajar ngut .

en: For John truly baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence .
kha: U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei ha ki khyndiat sngi yn sa pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Ioannis u la shah pynbaptis shisha da ka um ; hynrei phin sa shah pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ym bun sngi kumta .

en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead , and earrings in thine ears , and a beautiful crown upon thine head .
kha: Nga la ai ha pha ïa ka sati khmut bad ki sohshkor bad ka pansngiat ba-itynnat ban phong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga buh ia ka mawkordor ha ka khlieh jong me, bad ki shkor ha ki shkor jong me, bad ka khlieh kaba itynnad halor ka khlieh jong me .

en: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
kha: ‘ Ko Kynrad ,’ nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïatip bha ba nga la leit sha ki synagog bad nga la kem bad shoh ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong, ko Trai, ki tip ba nga la shah set phatok bad nga la shoh ha man la ka synagog ia kito kiba ngeit ha me:

en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead , and quickeneth them  ; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will .
kha: Kumba U Kpa u pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingim , ha kajuh ka rukom U Khun u ai jingim ïa kito kiba u mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba U Kpa u pynmih ia kiba iap, bad u pynkloi ia ki ; kumta u Khun u pynkloi ia uba u mon .

en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .
kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka sher dara jong U Blei  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Mahanaim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la iohi ia ki, u la ong, Une u long u nongshong shnong jong U Blei: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Mahanaim .

en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .
kha: Bad ka bor U  Trai  ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don hapdeng Sorah bad Eshtaol ha ka jaka sher dara jong ki Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Mynsiem U Trai u la sdang ban pynkhih ia u ha ki por ha ka jaka shong jong u Dan hapdeng ka Zorah bad ka Eshool .

en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon , throughout the houses of their fathers , by their families  ;
kha: lem bad u Eliasaph u khun jong u Lael kum u rangbah kur .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ruh ia ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon, ha baroh ki iing ki sem jong ki;

en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Dinah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngoh ïa ki katto katne ki kynthei Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dinah ka khun jong u Leah kaba ka la kha ha u Jakob u la leit shabar ban peit ia ki khun kynthei jong kata ka ri .

en: For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
kha: Kam wanrah jingbha ïa ita i khunlung i ban sa kha , i jah noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba la klet noh ïa i .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u wan rung bad ka jingdum , bad ka kyrteng jong u kan sa tap da ka jingdum .

en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: Hadien kata , u Enokh u la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei haduh laispah snem bad u la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Enokh u la iaid bad U Blei hadien ba u la kha ia u Methuselah lai spah snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance : for ye serve the Lord Christ .
kha: Kynmaw ba U Trai un ai ha phi kum ka bainong ïa kaei kaba u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . Naba U Khrist u dei U Kynrad bashisha uba phi shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ia kata na U Trai phin pdiang ia ka bainong jong ka pateng: namar phi shakri ia U Trai Khrist .

en: And then if any man shall say to you , Lo , here is Christ  ; or , lo , he is there  ; believe him not :
kha: Te , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Khmih , hangne u don U Messaïah !’ lane , ‘ Khmih , hangtai u don !’ — wat ngeit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta lada uno uno u briew un ong ha phi, Lo, hangne u Khrist ; ne, lo, u don hangta ; wat ngeit ia u:

en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder : the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet .
kha: Men ïuhroit halor ki sing bad ki bseiñ , ïa ki sing ba-itriem bad ïa ki  seiñpuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban iaid halor u sing bad u khnai: u sing bad u bsein u dei ban iaid hapoh ki kjat .

en: And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;
kha: U paidbah u jubab ,  Da lei lei ngin ym iehnoh ïa U  Trai  ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la jubab bad ki la ong , U Blei un khang ba ngin iehnoh ia U Trai , ban shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei ; .

en: For example , employers often prefer workers who live by the Bible principles of honesty and diligence .
kha: Kum ka nuksa , ki nongaikam ki kham jied ïa ki nongtrei kiba trei hok , kiba minot bad kiba bud ïa ki aiñ jong ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka nuksa , ki nongpyntreikam bunsien ki kham kwah ia ki nongtrei kiba im katkum ki nongrim jong ka Baibl jong ka jinglong hok bad ka jingminot .

en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city , and said unto him , Thus saith Ben–hadad ,
kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka nongbah sha u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Ahab u syiem Israel shapoh ka nongbah bad u la ong ha u, Kumta u ong u Benhadad .

en: What is the Almighty , that we should serve him ? and what profit should we have , if we pray unto him ?
kha: Ki pyrkhat bymdonkam ban shakri ïa U Blei lane ban don kano kano ka jingmyntoi ban duwai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba donbor tam , ba ngi dei ban shakri ia u ? bad kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba ngi dei ban ioh lada ngi duwai ha u ?

en: And he asked him ,  What is thy name ?  And he answered , saying , My name is Legion : for we are many .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?  Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Paidbah’ — ngi ïadon shibun !
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia u, Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ? Bad u la jubab da kaba ong: Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ka Legion: namar ngi long kiba bun .

en: He trusted in God  ; let him deliver him now , if he will have him : for he said , I am the Son of God .
kha: U shaniah ha U Blei bad u kam ba u long U Khun U Blei . Kumta , te , to ngin peit lada U Blei u kwah ban pynim ïa u mynta !
translated_en_to_kha: U la shaniah ha U Blei ; to ai ba un pyllait im ia u mynta, lada u don ia u: namar u la ong , Nga long U Khun U Blei .

en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam ,  Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa ngi ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ma nga na ka bynta ka jingsngewsih jong nga ! ka jingmynsaw jong nga ka long kaba sngewsih: hynrei nga la ong , Hooid kane ka long ka jingsngewsih , bad nga dei ban shah ia ka .

en: All that are with me salute thee . Greet them that love us in the faith . Grace be with you all . Amen .
kha: Baroh kiba ïadon ryngkat bad nga ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei ïa me . To ai khublei ïa ki paralok jong ngi kiba ha ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba don bad nga ki ai khublei ia me . Khublei ia kito kiba ieit ia ngi ha ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei kan long bad phi baroh . Amen .

en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood : but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them .
kha: Ki ktien jong ki bymman ki long kum ban pynïap , hynrei ki ktien jong kiba hok ki pyllait im ïa kito kiba shah byrngem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong kiba sniew ki long ban thiah ha ka snam: hynrei ka shyntur jong kiba hok kan pynpoi ia ki .

en: So David hid himself in the field : and when the new moon was come , the king sat him down to eat meat .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit rieh ïa lade ha ki bri . Ha ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , u syiem Saul u wan shong bam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la buhrieh ia lade ha lyngkha : bad ynda u bnai thymmai u la wan , u syiem u la shong ia u ban bam doh .

en: Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .
kha: Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad sumar bha ïa u . Wat pynmynsaw ïa u , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia u , bad peit bha ia u, bad wat leh ei ei ia u; hynrei leh ia u kumba un ong ha me .

en: Thou shalt drink also water by measure , the sixth part of an hin : from time to time shalt thou drink .
kha: Me dei ruh ban dih khyndiat ka um , ar khuri shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men dih ia ka um da ka jingthew, ka bynta kaba hynriew jong ka hin: na ka por sha ka por me dei ban dih .

en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even .
kha: Uno uno u briew uba leit rung ha kata ka ïing kaba dang khang un long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata uta uba leit shapoh iing baroh shi katta ba la khang ia ka un long u bymkhuid haduh ka por janmiet .

en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .
kha: Phi leit sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u lum uba jrong bad uba jrong me la buh ia ka jingthiah jong me: wat ha kata ka por me la leit shaneng ban knia .

en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Mynta nga la kloi lada ïap noh ruh , namar ba nga la ïohi ïa me bad tip ba me dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la ong ha u Joseph, Mynta to ai ba ngan iap noh namar nga la iohi ia ka khmat jong me namar me dang im .

en: And the  Lord  our God delivered him before us  ; and we smote him , and his sons , and all his people .
kha: hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la aiti ïa u ha ngi , bad ngi la pynïap ïa u , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la aiti ia u ha khmat jong ngi; bad ngi la shoh ia u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki briew jong u baroh .

en: So Moses the servant of the  Lord  died there in the land of Moab , according to the word of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ïap hangta ha ri Moab , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Moses u shakri U Trai u la iap hangta ha ka ri Moab kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: And in her was found the blood of prophets , and of saints , and of all that were slain upon the earth .
kha: Ïa ka Babilon la pynshitom namar ïa ka snam jong ki nongïathuhlypa bad jong ki briew jong U Blei la shem hapoh ka nongbah ; ho-oid , ka snam jong kito baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka la shem ia ka snam jong ki nongiathuhlypa bad jong ki riewkhuid bad jong baroh kiba la shah pyniap ha ka khyndew .

en: And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .
kha: U paidbah babun u la bud ïa u ; hapdeng jong ki , la don katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la bud ia u ka kynhun kaba khraw jong ki briew bad ki kynthei ruh kiba la iam bad sngewsih ia u .

en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
kha: Ki briew kiba lehhok kin ïoh ka jingim kaba kyrhai bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba iaineh un dap da ki jingkyrkhu: hynrei uta uba kyrkieh ban riewspah un ym long uba khlem pop .

en: The  Lord  is exalted  ; for he dwelleth on high : he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness .
kha: Katno uba khraw u long U  Trai  ! U synshar halor kiei kiei baroh . Un pyndap ïa ka Jerusalem da ka jinglehhok bad ka jinglong ba-beit bad pynlong ka jingskhem ha ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhraw ; namar u shong ha jrong: u la pyndap ia ka Seion da ka jingbishar bad ka hok .

en: And he said unto another ,  Follow me .  But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
kha: U la ong ha uwei pat u briew ,  Bud ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u briew u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , nyngkong to shah ïa nga ban leit phai pat bad ban tep ïa u kpa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha uwei pat, To bud ia nga . Hynrei u la ong, ko Trai, to shah ia nga ban leit tep nyngkong ia u kpa jong nga .

en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased  ; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa lade yn pynkhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba pynkhraw ia lade un shah pynjah burom ; bad uta uba pynrit mynsiem ia lade un shah pynkhraw .

en: At our meetings , we gather together , not with mere acquaintances , but with a group of close friends .
kha: Ha ki jingïalang jong ngi , ngi ïalumlang , ym bad ki briew kiba ngi shu ithuh hynrei bad ki paralok ba ïajan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jingialang jong ngi , ngi ialum lang , ym tang bad ki paralok ba jan , hynrei bad ka kynhun ki paralok ba jan .

en: And they began to be sorrowful , and to say unto him one by one , Is it I ? and another said , Is it I ?
kha: Ki synran ki la khih jingmut bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien uwei pat ,  Da shisha , mem shym mut ïa nga , hato ym dei kumta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sdang ban sngewsih bad ban ong ia u kawei hadien kawei pat, Hato dei ma nga? bad uwei pat u la ong: Hato dei ma nga ?

en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .
kha: Lada phi pynlut ïa ka por ha kaba thiah , phin long uba duk . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh kyrhai ka bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat thiah , ioh ba phin wan sha ka jingduk ; plie ia ki khmat jong me bad me sngewhun ia u kpu .

en: And Mizpah  ; for he said , The  Lord  watch between me and thee , when we are absent one from another .
kha: U Laban u ong ruh ,  To U  Trai  un khmih halor jong ngi haba ngi la ïakhlad iwei na iwei pat .  Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ruh ka Mispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Mizpah ; namar u la ong , U Trai u peit hapdeng jong nga bad me, haba ngi khlem don iwei na iwei pat .

en: The sons of Japheth  ; Gomer , and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Tubal , and Meshech , and Tiras .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Japheth — u Gomer , u Magog , u Madai , u Jaban , u Tubal , u Meshek , bad u Tiras — ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Japhet ; u Gomer, bad u Magog, bad u Madai, bad u Javan, bad u Tubal, bad u Meshesh, bad u Tir .

en: If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .
kha: U nongsharai balang u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei ban long ki bangeit bad ki bym don jingbudnam ba ki long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don mano mano ruh ki bym don pop , u tnga jong kawei ka tnga , u bym don ki khun kiba iaineh ki bym shah kynnoh ba ki long kiba sniew ne ki bym don akor .

en: Members of public coming across such offers should immediately lodge a complaint with the State Police .
kha: Ki paidbah kiba iakynduh ia kum kine ki jingtyrwa ki dei ban ujor mardor sha ki pulit jong ka jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dkhot jong ki paidbah kiba wan shaphang kum kine ki jingtyrwa ki dei ban ujor mardor sha ki Pulit ka Jylla .

en: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .
kha: Bad lada ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei un pynpaw ïa ka burom jong U Khun U Briew ha lade , bad un leh kumta kumne kumne .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada U Blei un shah pyndonburom ha u , U Blei ruh un pyndonburom ia u ha lade , bad un pyndonburom beit ia u .

en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria , and Israel served for a wife , and for a wife he kept sheep .
kha: U Jakob u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la dei ban phet ïap sha Mesopotamia , ha kaba , ban ïoh ïa ka tnga , u trei na ka bynta ïa uwei u briew bad sumar ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la phet noh sha ka ri Syria , bad ki Israel ki la shakri ia ka tnga bad na ka bynta ka tnga u la ri langbrot .

en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole  ;
kha: Lada yn kylli ïa ngi mynta shaphang ka kam babha ïa kaba la leh ha u briew uba dkoh bad kumno la pynkhiah ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ha kane ka sngi la bishar bniah ia ka kam babha kaba la leh ha u briew uba khlem akor , da kano ka rukom la pynlong ia u baroh kawei;

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,
kha: ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ban bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki , Haba phi wan sha ka ri kaba nga wanrah ia phi .

en: And there I will meet with the children of Israel , and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory .
kha: Hangta keiñ ngan ïakynduh bad ki Israel , bad ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan pynlong ïa kata ka jaka kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ngan iakynduh bad ki khun Israel , bad ka iing ka sem kan long kaba la pynkyntang da ka burom jong nga .

en: Let a little water , I pray you , be fetched , and wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree :
kha: Shah ngan wanrah khyndiat ka um ba phin ïoh sait ïa ki kjat jong phi ; phi lah ban shong jahthait ha trai jong une u dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba khyndiat ka um, nga kyrpad ia phi, to shah rong noh, bad sait ia ki kjat jong phi, bad pynjahthait ia lade hapoh u dieng:

en: And Abram said , Behold , to me thou hast given no seed : and , lo , one born in my house is mine heir .
kha: Mem shym la ai khun ïa nga , bad uwei na ki mraw jong nga un ïohpateng ïa ka spah ka phew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la ong: Ha nga, me la ai symbai ei ei: bad, ha ka iing jong nga u long u nongioh pateng jong nga .

en: Also he sent forth a dove from him , to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground  ;
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Noah u la pyllait ïa ka paro ban tip la kata ka um ka la rngad ne em , hynrei namar ba ka um ka dang tap ïa ka khyndew , kata ka paro kam shym lap jaka ban dem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la phah ia ka paro na u , ban peit la ki um ki la jah noh na ka khyndew ; .

en: And she , being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist s head in a charger .
kha: Ha ka jingaibuit ka kmie jong ka , ka la pan na u ,  To ai ïa nga mynta hangne ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ha ka pliang !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ma ka, shuwa ban shah hikai ha ka kmie jong ka, ka la ong, Ai ia nga hangne u Ioannis u la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u Ioannis .

en: Woe to Ariel , to Ariel , the city where David dwelt ! add ye year to year  ; let them kill sacrifices .
kha: Ka duwan U Blei , kaba long ka Jerusalem hi , kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ka nongbah ha kaba u Dabid u la sher dara kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ai ba sa kawei ne ar ki snem kin wan bad leit , ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai bad ki Jingkhawai Niam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia u Ariel , ia u Ariel , ka shnong ha kaba u Dabid u shong ! pyndap ia phi snem snem ai ba kin pyniap ia ki jingknia .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khun jong u Amos , u buh jingthoh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki kam ba u syiem Ussaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Usiah, nyngkong bad khatduh, u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u khun u Amoz u la thoh .

en: Is not my word like as a fire ? saith the  Lord   ; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces ?
kha: Ka khubor jong nga ka long kum ka ding , bad kum u tyrnem uba pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka ktien jong nga kam long kum ka ding ? ong u Trai ; bad kum u hammer uba pynpra ia u maw ?

en: Jaddu took the key wickets of Shakib Al Hasan , Mushfiqur Rahim , Mohammad Mithun and Mosaddek Hossain .
kha: U Jaddu u la ïoh ban khur ïa ki wiket ba kongsan jong u Shakib Al Hasan , u Mushfiqur Rahim , u Mohammad Mithun bad u Mosaddek Hossain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jaddu u la shim ia ki wiket ba kongsan jong u Shakib Al Hasan, u Mushfiqur Rahim, u Mohammad Mithun bad u Mosaddek Hossain .

en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .
kha: Ki bania bad ki nongkhaïi , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba kut eh , na ka kamra ha ka dong haduh ka Khyrdop Langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapdeng ka jingleit sha ka kut sha ka khyrdop langbrot ka la pynbha ia ki nongshna ksiar bad ki nongkhaii .

en: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: U Lamekh u la im sa sanspah khyndaiphew san snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: U Lamech u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Noah san spah hynniewphew san snem, bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand  ;
kha: Kumta u Sanballat u phah ïa uwei na ki shakri jong u sha nga ryngkat bad ka khubor kaba san , kane kawei ha ka rukom jong ka shithi ka bym shym la shon muhor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sanballat u shakri jong u ha nga ha kajuh ka rukom ka sien kaba phra da ka shithi kaba plie ha ka kti jong u ; .

en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest , lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief .
kha: Te , to ngin ïaleh shitom ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban duh noh kum ma ki namar ba kim don ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin ialeh namarkata ban rung sha kata ka jingjahthait , ioh ba uno uno u briew un hap hadien kajuh ka nuksa jong ka jingbymngeit .

en: But all these things will they do unto you for my name s sake , because they know not him that sent me .
kha: Hynrei kin leh ïa kane baroh ïa phi namar ba phi long ki jong nga ; naba kim ithuh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine kiei kiei baroh kin leh ia phi na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga , namar kim ithuh ia uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: And the world passeth away , and the lust thereof : but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever .
kha: Ka pyrthei bad kaei kaei baroh kaba don ha ka , kaba ki briew ki kwah kan sa jah noh ; hynrei kito kiba leh ïa ka mon U Blei kin im junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka pyrthei ka jah noh, bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka: hynrei uta uba leh ia ka mon U Blei u sah junom .

en: An elder or a ministerial servant coordinates the work , usually following a checklist of things to do .
kha: U rangbah balang ne u nongïarap balang u pynïaid ïa ki kam , bad u peit ïa kiei ba ki dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah ne u shakri ba shakri u pynbeit ia ka kam , bunsien u bud ia ka jingpeit bniah ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban leh .

en: You can download dramatic Bible readings , Bible dramas , and beautiful music to enjoy at your leisure .
kha: Phi lah ruh ban download ïa ki jingpule Baibl ba la pynwandur ha ki rukom drama , ki drama na Baibl bad ki jingrwai ba sngewtynnad ban sngap ha ki por ba phi shongkai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban download ia ki jingpule Baibl kiba sngewtynnad , ki drama Baibl , bad ki jingrwai kiba itynnad ban sngewtynnad ha ka por ba phi lait .

en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , even holy convocations , which ye shall proclaim in their seasons .
kha: Pynbna paidbah ïa kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ha ki por ba la buh ban pynlong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki jingkhawai jong U Trai , wat ki jingpynbna bakhuid , kiba phin pynbna ha ki aiom jong ki .

en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise upon his sword , and died with him .
kha: Haba uta u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap lem bad u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongrah tiar jong u u la iohi ba u Saul u la iap , u la hap kumjuh ha ka waitlam jong u bad u la iap bad u .

en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .
kha: Ka tnga kaba bha ka long ka jingsarong bad jingkmen jong u tnga jong ka ; hynrei ka tnga kaba pynlehrain ïa la u tnga ka long kum ka jingpang bampong ïa ki shyieng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei kaba bha ka long ka khlieh ha u tnga jong ka: hynrei kata kaba pynlong ia ka ban sngewlehrain ka long kum ka jingsniew ha ki shyieng jong u .

en: Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :
kha: To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli , bad yn ai ia phi; to wad, bad phin sa shem; bad yn plie ia ka ha phi:

en: And , behold , thou shalt conceive in thy womb , and bring forth a son , and shalt call his name JESUS .
kha: Phan sa punkhun bad phan kha ïa u khun , bad phan kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, men pun khun ha ka kpoh jong me, bad men kha khun shynrang, bad men khot ia ka kyrteng jong u U Jisu .

en: And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
kha: Nga la hap sha madan bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha nga , ‘ Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hap ha khyndew bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba ong ha nga, ko Sawul, balei me pynshitom ia nga ?

en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ha kaba shabar phi i kumba phi bha ïa baroh , hynrei shapoh phi dap da ka jingarsap bad ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh phi paw ba phi long uba hok ha ki briew , hynrei hapoh jong phi phi dap da ka jingleh arsap bad ka jingbymhok .

en: A branch of the organisation called the School of Practical Philosophy opened in 1964 in New York City .
kha: Kawei ka tnat jong ka seng kaba la khot ka School of Practical Philosophy ka la plie ha ka snem 1964 ha New York City .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnat jong ka seng kaba la khot ka Skul Pyntreikam ka la plie ha ka snem 1964 ha ka Nongbah New York .

en: And if the son of peace be there , your peace shall rest upon it : if not , it shall turn to you again .
kha: Lada u briew uba ieit ïa ka jingsuk u shong hangta , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ha u ; lymda kumta , shim noh ïa ka jingkhublei jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u khun jingsuk u don hangta , ka jingsuk jong phi kan shong ha ka: lada ym dei , kan phai biang sha phi .

en: And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city , and take it , and burn it with fire .
kha: Te ki nong Babilonia kin wan biang , kin tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kin kurup ïa ka , bad kin thang duh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Khaldes kin wan biang bad kin ialeh pyrshah ia kane ka shnong bad kin shim ia ka bad kin thang ia ka da ka ding .

en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion , and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city .
kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel kan ïuhroit ïa ki , Bad pynduh jait ïa kiba dang im baroh kiba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na u Jakob un wan uta uba don ka jingsynshar , bad un pynjot ia uta uba sah na ka shnong .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la leh .

en: And David said to Saul , Wherefore hearest thou men s words , saying , Behold , David seeketh thy hurt ?
kha: bad u ong ,  Balei phi sngap ïa ki briew kiba ong ba nga pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Saul , Balei me iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u briew, u da ong: Ha khmih u Dabid u wad ia ka jingsngewsih jong me ?

en: And he said unto them , What manner of man was he which came up to meet you , and told you these words ?
kha: U long kumno uta u briew ?  u syiem u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , U briew uba kumno u la wan shaneng ban iakynduh ia phi bad u la iathuh ia kine ki ktien ?

en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius , a centurion of the band called the Italian band ,
kha: La don u briew ha Kaisaria uba kyrteng u Kornelios , uba long u rangbah shipai ha ka kynhun shipai ka Hima Rom ba la khot  Ka Kynhun shipai Italian .
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u briew ha Caesarea uba kyrteng u Kornilio , u rangbah jong ka kynhun ba la khot ka Italy , .

en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God  ; thou art the King of Israel .
kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  la jubab u Nathanael ,  me long U Khun U Blei ! Me long u Syiem ki Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathanael u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, Rabbi, me long u Khun U Blei ; me long u Syiem Israel .

en: And to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to half the tribe of Manasseh , spake Joshua , saying ,
kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Reuben bad jait Gad , bad ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki Rubeni bad ha ki Gad bad ha ka shnong Manasseh, u Joshua u la kren:

en: The righteous also shall hold on his way , and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger .
kha: Kito kiba dawa ba ki long kiba donburom ki la nang sngewdei shuh shuh ba kim shym la bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok ruh un bat ia la ka lynti , bad uta uba don ki kti kiba khuid un kham khlain bad kham khlain .

en: And if one prevail against him , two shall withstand him  ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .
kha: Ar ngut ki briew ki lah ban ïada na ka jingtur ïaleh kaba lah ban jop ïa u briew ba tang marwei . U tyllai uba la jyrthiaw da ki lai tylli ki tyllai u long uba jwat ban dkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uwei u jop ia u , arngut kin ialeh pyrshah ia u ; bad ka lynti kaba lai tylli kam ju bthei kloi .

en: Then said Joshua , Open the mouth of the cave , and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ,  Plie ïa ka jaka rung sha ka krem bad wallam ïa kito ki san ngut ki syiem sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joshua u la ong , Plie ia ka shyntur jong ka krem bad pynmih ia kita ki san ngut ki syiem sha nga na ka krem .

en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .
kha: Haba u Saul bad ki briew jong u ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewsheptieng her .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Saul bad ki Israel baroh ki la iohsngew ia kita ki ktien jong u Philistia , ki la sngewsih shibun bad ki la tieng shibun .

en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :
kha: Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli noh ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad leh ia kane ka kam , Pynduh noh ia ki syiem, uwei pa uwei na ka jaka jong u, bad buh ia ki kapten ha ki kamra jong ki:

en: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem , Fear thou not : and to Zion , Let not thine hands be slack .
kha: Ka por ka poi haba kin ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Wat sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Wat ai ba ki kti jong pha kin noh kyrwep !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi yn ong ha Jerusalem , Wat tieng: bad ha ka Seion , Wat ai ba ki kti jong me kin long kiba jem .

en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !
kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla .  U briew uba kumno une u long ?  ki la ong .  Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la lyngngoh, ki da ong, Kaei ka rukom briew kane, ba wat ki Iyer bad ka duriaw ruh ki kohnguh ia u !

en: And Jacob said , Swear to me this day  ; and he sware unto him : and he sold his birthright unto Jacob .
kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nyngkong to smai ba phin ai noh ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi .  U Iso u smai bad u ai noh ïa la ki hok ha u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong: To sngap ia nga ha kane ka sngi ; bad u la sngap jar ha u: bad u la die ia ka hok ba nyngkong jong u ha u Jakob .

en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,
kha: bad ka jaiñspong , ki tupia , ki patlun ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jain kaba jem bha, bad ki bniat kiba bha jong ka jain kaba bha, bad ki bniat kiba jem bha .

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , can these bones live ? And I answered , O Lord  God  , thou knowest .
kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , hato kine ki shyieng ki lah ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingim ?  Nga la jubab ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , tang ma me uba lah ban jubab ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, hato kine ki shyieng ki lah ban im ? Bad nga la jubab, ko Trai Blei, me tip .

en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him  ; and they pleased him not .
kha: Haba u Hiram u leit jngoh ïa kita ki shnong , um mon ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u la mih na Tyros ban iohi ia ki shnong kiba u Solomon u la ai ha u ; bad kim shym la sngewbha ia u .

en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse , and said , Send me David thy son , which is with the sheep .
kha: Kumta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jesse ban ong ,  Phah ïa u khun jong me u Dabid , uto uba sharai ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Saul u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Jesse, bad u la ong, To phah ia nga u Dabid u khun jong me uba don bad ki langbrot .

en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym sngewsih ia ki: namar U Trai U Blei jong me u don hapdeng jong phi , U Blei uba donbor bad uba shyrkhei .

en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , Behold , Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man :
kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ïa la ka kmie ,  Phi tip ba Iso u long u briew uba bun shñiuh , katba nga pat nga long uba jlih ka sniehdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha ka Rebeka ka kmie jong u, Ha khmih, u Iso u hynmen jong nga u long u briew uba sniew bad nga long u briew uba jem:

en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .
kha: U  Trai  un iehnoh ïa ki Israel namar ba u Jeroboam u la leh pop bad u la ïalam ïa ki paid Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti noh ia ki Israel namar ki pop jong u Jeroboan uba la leh pop bad uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki pharshi jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren shaphang jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la iohsngew ia ki pharshi jong u , ki la sngewthuh ba u kren shaphang jong ki .

en: And Jokshan begat Sheba , and Dedan . And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim , and Letushim , and Leummim .
kha: U Jokshan u dei u kpa jong u Sheba bad u Dedan , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dedan ki long ki Asshurim , Ki Letushim , bad ki Leummim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joksan u la kha ia u Sheba, bad u Dedan . Ki khun shynrang ki long u Ashim bad u Letushim bad u Lemim .

en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .
kha: ‘ Ko Kornelios ! U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad u la kynmaw ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Ko Kornelius, la iohsngew ia ka jingduwai jong me, bad ki alms jong me ki la don ha ka jingkynmaw ha khmat U Blei .

en: Whenever she tries to talk to him , he denies his relationship with her and says he doesn ' t know her .
kha: Man la ka por ba ka pyrshang ban iakren bad u u kyntait ia ka jingiadei jong u bad ka bad u ong ba um ithuh ia ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lano lano ruh haba ka pyrshang ban iakren bad u , u kyntait ia ka jingiadei jong u bad ka bad u ong ba um ithuh ia ka .

en: He that saith , I know him , and keepeth not his commandments , is a liar , and the truth is not in him .
kha: Lada uno uno u ong ba u ithuh ïa u , hynrei um kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , kum uta u briew u long u nongshukor bad ym don ka jingshisha ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ong , nga ithuh ia u bad ngam sumar ia ki hukum jong u, u long u nonglamler bad ka jingshisha kam don ha u .

en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams .
kha: U ong ha u Balak ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan , bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u Balak, To tei ia nga hangne hynriew tylli ki almari, bad pynkhreh ia nga hangne hynriew tylli ki masi bad hynriew tylli ki langbrot .

en: And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .
kha: Te namar ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynmen jong u , u Jotham u la phet ïap bad u leit shong ha Beer .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jotham u la phet noh bad u la phet noh bad u la leit sha Beer bad u la shong hangta namar ka jingtieng ia u Abimelech u hynmen jong u .

en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood  ; and without shedding of blood is no remission .
kha: Da shisha , kat kum ka Hukum , la jan baroh kiei kiei la pynkhuid da ka snam , bad ïa ki pop la map noh tang lada la theh ïa ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la jan baroh kiei kiei ki long da ka ain ba la pynkhuid da ka snam ; bad khlem da pynmih snam ym don jingmap .

en: For these things were done , that the scripture should be fulfilled , A bone of him shall not be broken .
kha: Ïa kane la leh ban pynurlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid :  Yn ym pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki shyieng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine kiei kiei la leh , ba ka jingthoh kan long kaba la pyndep , Ka shyieng jong u kan ym shah pynpra .

en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah laiphew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Mahalaleel u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Jared hynriew spah laiphew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: For we are made partakers of Christ , if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end  ;
kha: Naba ngi long baroh ki nongïoh bynta bad U Khrist lada ngi batskhem haduh kaba kut ïa kata ka jingsngewskhem kaba ngi la don naduh kaba sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ki nongiashim bynta jong U Khrist lada ngi bat skhem ia ka jingshaniah jong ngi haduh kaba kut;

en: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah  ; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah , a land of rivers of waters .
kha: Nangta ki leit sha Gudgodah bad nangta pat sha Jotbathah , ka jaka kaba pahuh um .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la leit sha Gudgdah ; bad na Gudgdah haduh Jotbathah , ka ri jong ki wah um .

en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
kha: Uta uba pynkheiñ ïa kane ka aiñ yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kano kano ka mynsiem kaba bam ia kano kano ka snam , wat ia kata ka mynsiem ruh yn ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee , O Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his servants .
kha: Hangta u la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ban pynshitom ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la phah ia ki token bad ki jingphylla hapdeng jong me, ko Ijipt, halor u Pharaoh bad halor ki shakri jong u baroh .

en: And Solomon s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour , and threescore measures of meal ,
kha: Ki jingbam ba U Solomon u donkam man ka sngi ki long san hajar kilo u  purew bad shiphew hajar kilo ka jingbam ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpynbeit jong u Solomon na ka bynta kawei ka sngi ka long laiphew tylli ki jingthew ba bha, bad lai tylli ki jingthew jingbam , .

en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the  Lord  , we will not hearken unto thee .
kha: Ngi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi la ïathuh ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka ktien kaba me la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng U Trai , ngin ym sngap ia me .

en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
kha: U aiti ha ki lyngdoh ïa ki kamram kiba ki dei ban trei ha ka Templ bad u pynshlur ïa ki ban da lehbha ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki lyngdoh ha ki kam jong ki , bad u la pynshlur ia ki ha ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Trai .

en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .
kha: Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u bitar bad u pynshitom , dei u briew uba sniew uba ju lait borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ia kiba sniew la buh kyrpang ha ka sngi jong ka jingjot ? kin sa wanrah ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar .

en: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah sawphew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Kain u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Mahalael hynriew spah sawphew snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: And he said unto them that stood by , Take from him the pound , and give it to him that hath ten pounds .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha kito kiba ïa-ïeng hangta , ‘ To shim noh ïa ka sbai ksiar na u bad ai ïa ka ha u shakri uba don shiphew tylli ki sbai .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki kiba ieng hajan, To shim na u ia ka pound bad ai ia ka ha uta uba don shiphew pound .

en: In those days the  Lord  began to cut Israel short : and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel  ;
kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  u la sdang ban pynrit ïa ka jingheh jong ka ri Israel . U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u la hiarthma ïa baroh ka ri Israel kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi U Trai u la sdang ban ot lyngkot ia ki Israel: bad u Hazael u la pynkhih ia ki ha ki pud jong ki Israel baroh;

en: And the angel that talked with me came again , and waked me , as a man that is wakened out of his sleep ,
kha: U angel uba la lah kren ha nga u la wan biang bad u la kyrsiew ïa nga la kumba nga dang thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba la kren bad nga u la wan phai biang bad u la pynkynjah ia nga kum u briew uba la shah pynkynjah na ka jingthiah jong u .

en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
kha: Ale wan shane , phi ki briew kiba duna ka jingsngewthuh !  Ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba suk , to ai ba un phai shapoh hangne : bad ia uta uba kwah ia ka jingsngewthuh , ka kren ia u , .

en: Others said , These are not the words of him that hath a devil . Can a devil open the eyes of the blind ?
kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ïa-ong ,  U briew uba shongksuid um lah ban kren kumne ! Kumno u ksuid u lah ban ai jingïoh imat pat ïa ki briew kiba matlah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong , Kine kim dei ki ktien jong uta uba don u ksuid . Hato u ksuid u lah ban plie ia ki khmat jong kiba matlah ?

en: And when he was entered into the house from the people , his disciples asked him concerning the parable .
kha: Haba u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad leit sha la ïing , ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ban batai ïa kane ka jingong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la rung shapoh iing na ki briew , ki synran jong u ki la kylli ia u shaphang kata ka pharshi .

en: For it is the jubilee  ; it shall be holy unto you : ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field .
kha: Kata ka snem baroh kawei ka long kaba kyntang ïa phi ; phin bam tang ïa kita kiba mih hi ha ki lyngkha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka jubilee ; kan long kaba khuid ha phi: phin bam ia ka jingmih jong ka na ka lyngkha .

en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .
kha: Haba la ktah jur sa shisien , U Jisu u la leit sha ka jingtep , kaba long ka krem ba la khang da u mawkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu namarkata u wan biang ha lade sha ka jingtep . Ka la long ka krem bad u maw uba la thiah halor jong ka .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong ka long bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . O ainguh ia U Trai ; namar u long uba bha: namar ka jingisynei jong u ka sah junom .

en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian , let him not be ashamed  ; but let him glorify God on this behalf .
kha: Pynban , lada phi shahshitom namar ba phi long u Khristan , wat sngewlehrain ïa kata , hynrei ainguh ïa U Blei ba phi kup ïa ka kyrteng U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u briew u shah shitom kum u Khristan , wat ai ba un sngewlehrain ; hynrei un pyndonburom ia U Blei na ka bynta kane .

en: Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .
kha: Haoid , u Blei un sa khot ia ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki kam niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , U Blei un khot ia ka niam kaba bakla ban ai jingkhein ia ki kam kiba sngewsih baroh kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng jong u .

en: I have no doubt that when the time comes , our people will recognise the hand that made it all possible .
kha: Ngam artatien ba ynda la dei ka por , ki briew jong ngi kin ithuh ia ka kti kaba la pynlong ia kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam artatien ba ynda la poi ka por , ki briew jong ngi kin ithuh ia ka kti kaba la pynlong ia ka baroh .

en: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .
kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga . Lymda kumta , to ngeit namar kiei kiei kiba nga leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngeit ia nga ba nga don ha U Kpa, bad U Kpa ha nga: lane lym kumta ngeit ia nga na ka bynta ki kam hi .

en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
kha: Ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi kin nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongwei uba don hapoh jong me un kiew halor jong me; bad me un hiar shapoh shibun .

en: Get thee hence , and turn thee eastward , and hide thyself by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
kha: Mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit shaphang mihngi , bad leit rieh ïa lade hajan ka wahduid Kherith , kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: To shim ia me kumta, bad to phai shaphang mihngi, bad to buhrieh ia lade da ka wah Cherith kaba don ha khmat u Jordan .

en: if the certificates are useless , torn , paper why did Ahmadinejad ' s Minister pretend to have one . . .
kha: lada ki certificate ki long ki bym myntoi , kiba la tyrkhong , ki kot balei u Myntri u Ahmadinejad u leh mynleh ba u don kawei . . .
translated_en_to_kha: lada ki certificate ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi, ki la tyrkhong, ki kot balei u Myntri u Ahmadinejad u la leh kum uba don kawei . .

en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
kha: Hynrei ai ngin ïasyllok shuwa bad U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ong ha u syiem Israel: To kylli, nga kyrpad ia me, ha ka ktien U Trai ha ka sngi .

en: Be astonished , O ye heavens , at this , and be horribly afraid , be ye very desolate , saith the  Lord .
kha: Bad kumta nga hukum ïa ka sahit bneng ba kan khih da ka jingingiew , ban long kaba iphylla bad kaba i lyngngoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: To sngew lyngngoh, ko bneng, ia kane, bad to tieng shibun, to long kiba la jot shibun, ong U Trai .

en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .
kha: Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki ïalaw noh ïa la ki sohshkor ksiar bad ki wallam ïa ki ha u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la bret noh ia ki shkor ksiar kiba don ha ki shkor jong ki , bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha u Aaron .

en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed  ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .
kha: Hynrei bun kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ki la ngeit ; bad ka jingbun ki briew ka la roi sha kumba san hajar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bun na ki kiba la iohsngew ia ka ktien ki la ngeit ; bad ka jingdon jong ki shynrang ka long kumba san hajar ngut .

en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .
kha: U wallam jingjot ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa ki Kut baskhem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pynskhem ia kiba la shah pynjot pyrshah ia kiba khlain , khnang ba kiba la shah pynjot kin wan pyrshah ia ka kut .

en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh ka long ban ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Kane ka long ka kam U Blei ba phi ngeit ha uta uba u la phah .

en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise  ; but a foolish man spendeth it up .
kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki shong ha ka spah bad ka jingim pahuh hynrei ki briew kiba bieit ki pynlut noh ïa ka pisa tang shu ïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka spah ban kwah bad ka umphniang ha ka jaka sah jong kiba stad ; hynrei u briew uba bieit u pynlut ia ka .

en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief ; but was strong in faith , giving glory to God ;
kha: Ka jingngeit jong u kam shym la mihnoh na u , bad um shym la artatien ïa ka jingkular U Blei ; ka jingngeit jong u ka la pyndap ïa u da ka bor , bad u ai ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la lyngngoh ia ka jingkular U Blei lyngba ka jingbymngeit ; hynrei u la skhem ha ka jingngeit , da kaba ai burom ia U Blei ; .

en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt  ; I am black  ; astonishment hath taken hold on me .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la shah pynlwet namar ki briew jong nga ki la shah pynlwet ; nga ïam sngewsih ; nga la shaïong jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingsngewsih jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga nga la pynmong ; nga la sngew lyngngoh ; ka la bat ia nga .

en: And Micah consecrated the Levite  ; and the young man became his priest , and was in the house of Micah .
kha: U Mikah u thung ïa u kum u lyngdoh jong u , bad u sah ha ïing u Mikah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Migah u la pynkyntang ia u Lebi; bad uta u samla u la long u lyngdoh jong u, bad u la don ha iing u Migah .

en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,
kha: Mynta te , pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng kiwei pat ki khyndai jait bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , na ka bynta jong ki ba kin ïohkynti kum la ka jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to phiah ia kane ka ri na ka bynta ka pateng sha ki hynniew tylli ki jaitbynriew bad ka jaitbynriew Manasseh .

en: For if the inheritance be of the law , it is no more of promise : but God gave it to Abraham by promise .
kha: Naba lada ka jingai U Blei ka shong ha ka Hukum , te ka jingaiei kam shong shuh ha ka jingkular jong u . Pynban ka long namar ka jingkular jong u ba U Blei u la ai ïa kata ka jingai sngewbha ha u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka pateng ka long ka hukum , kam long shuh ka jingkular: hynrei U Blei u la ai ia ka ha u Abraham da ka jingkular .

en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet  ; and he called his name Jedidiah , because of the  Lord .
kha: bad u la hukum ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ban jer kyrteng ïa u khynnah , u Jedidaïah , namar ba U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah da ka kti u Nathan u nongiathuhlypa ; bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Jedidaiah namar U Trai .

en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee , O  Lord   ; thou art great , and thy name is great in might .
kha: A  Trai  , ym don uno uno uba kum ma me ; me long uba khrawbor , bad ka kyrteng jong me ka long kaba khraw bad kaba donbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ym don mano mano ruh kiba kum ma me, ko Trai me long uba khraw bad ka kyrteng jong me ka long kaba khraw ha ka bor .

en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :
