kha: lada nga la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mih hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la bam ia ki soh jong ka khlem pisa , ne nga la pynlong ia ki trai jong ka ban duh noh ia ka jingim jong ki:

en: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .
kha: Kumta la buh ïa u Petros ha ka phatok , hynrei ki briew jong ka balang ki la duwai jur ha U Blei na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros namarkata u la shah set phatok: hynrei ka jingduwai ka la long khlem sangeh ia ka balang ha U Blei na ka bynta jong u .

en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .
kha: Lada kata ka dak ka pur , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid ; u la bit jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka saphriang shibun ha ka sniehdoh , te u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka khlam .

en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper : and one is hungry , and another is drunken .
kha: Naba katba phi dang ïabam , phi ïabam shuwa ïa la ka jong ka jingbam miet , te don kiba la thngan katba kiwei ki lah da buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kaba bam uwei pa uwei u shim ia la ka jong ka jingbam: bad uwei u thngan , bad uwei pat u la dih kyiad .

en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .
kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shah hikai , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . Lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba kham stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kyntait ia ka jinghikai u pynjah burom ia la ka jong ka mynsiem: hynrei uta uba iohsngew u ioh ia ka jingsngewthuh .

en: For ye have need of patience , that , after ye have done the will of God , ye might receive the promise .
kha: Phi donkam ban long kiba ïaishah , khnang ba phi lah ban leh ïa ka mon U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa kata kaba u kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi donkam ia ka jingshaniah, ba hadien ba phi la leh ia ka mon U Blei , phin ioh ia ka jingkular .

en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge : for I should have denied the God that is above .
kha: Ïa kaba kum kata ka pop dei ban pynshitom da ka jingïap ; ka len ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ruh ka la long ka jingbymhok ban shah pynshitom ha u nongbishar: namar nga la dei ban kyntait ia U Blei uba don haneng .

en: And Ahab called Obadiah , which was the governor of his house . ( Now Obadiah feared the  Lord  greatly :
kha: kumta u Ahab u la khot ïa u Obadaïah , uba peit halor ki kam ha ïingsyiem . ( U Obadaïah u long uba mane hok ïa U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la khot ia u Obadaiah uba long u Lat jong ka iing jong u . (Mynta u Obadaiah u la tieng shibun ia U Trai:

en: And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
kha: Katba U Jisu u don ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem , u la leit na ka pud hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u dang leit sha Jerusalem , ba u la iaid lyngba ka ri Samaria bad Galilaia .

en: And his concubine , whose name was Reumah , she bare also Tebah , and Gaham , and Thahash , and Maachah .
kha: Ka Reuma , ka tnga kliar jong u Nahor , ka la kha ïa u Tebah , u Gaham , u Tahash , bad u Maakah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynthei jong u, kaba kyrteng u Reuh, ka la kha ruh ia u Tebah, bad u Gaham, bad u Tahash, bad u Maahah .

en: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words , and said unto him , Are we blind also ?
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi kiba ïadon hangta lem bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Da shisha mem mut ba ngi ruh ngi matlah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien bad ki la ong ha u: Hato ngi ruh ngi matlah ?

en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la ïeng bad u hangta , bad u la pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la hiar ha u lyoh , bad u la ieng bad u hangta , bad u la pynbna ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David  ; and the man that bare the shield went before him .
kha: Uta u Philistia u sdang ban ïaid sha khmat sha u Dabid lem bad u nongrah atiar uba ïaid ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philistia u la wan shajan u Dabid ; bad uta u briew uba rah ia ka stieh u la leit sha khmat jong u .

en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .
kha: Bad mynta ka jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai eh , ka phyrnai haduh katta katta ïa ngi ban khmih ïa ka ; bad ïa ka sahit bneng la sar pynkhuid da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ki briew kim iohi ia ka jingshai kaba shai kaba don ha ki lyoh: hynrei ka Iyer ka iaid , bad ka pynkhuid ia ki .

en: Or let him take hold of my strength , that he may make peace with me  ; and he shall make peace with me .
kha: Hynrei lada ki nongshun jong ki briew jong nga ki kwah ïa ka jingïada jong nga , ai ba kin ïasuk bad nga . Ho-oid , ai kin ïasuk bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane to ai ba un bat ia ka bor jong nga, ba un iasuk bad nga ; bad un iasuk bad nga .

en: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .
kha: u Mahlon bad u Khilion ruh ki la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh sa tang marwei , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mahlon bad u Chilon ruh ki la iap baroh arngut; bad kata ka kynthei ka la sah na ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong ka bad u tnga jong ka .

en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
kha: namar men ym iehnoh ïa nga ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; men ym shah ïa u shakri baïaineh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar men ym iehnoh ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha dujok , lymne men ym shah ia U Bakhuid jong me ban iohi ia ka jingbamsap .

en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .
kha: Haneng ka Synduk la don ki kherub kiba long ka dak ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar halor ka jaka ha kaba la ju map ïa ki pop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor jong ka ki cherub jong ka burom ki pynshai ia ka jaka leh pop ; kaba ngim lah mynta ban kren kyrpang .

en: Say ye to the righteous , that it shall be well with him : for they shall eat the fruit of their doings .
kha: Ki briew kiba hok kin kmen , bad kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ïa ki . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ki la trei .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ia kiba hok, ba kan long kaba bha bad u: namar kin bam ia u soh jong ki jingleh jong ki .

en: If I had called , and he had answered me  ; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice .
kha: Pynban wat la katta , lada u shah ïa nga ban kren , Ngam lah ngeit ba un shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la khot ia nga; hynrei ngan ym ngeit ba u la sngap ia ka sur jong nga .

en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and causeth them to wander in the wilderness , where there is no way .
kha: u pynpaw ka jingibeiñ ïa ki nongbanbeiñ bad u pynlong ïa ki ban sakma ha ki ri shyiap bym don lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U theh ia ki syiem , bad u pynlong ia ki ban iaid kai ha ka ri khlaw , ha kaba ym don lad .

en: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga leh ha ka rukom ba kham pher ïa kiba lait im jong kane ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ngan ym long ha ka jingsah jong une u briew kumba ha ki sngi kiba mynshuwa , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: I was daily with you in the temple teaching , and ye took me not : but the scriptures must be fulfilled .
kha: Man ka sngi nga la don bad phi ban hikai ha ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga . Hynrei ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki dei ban urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la don man ka sngi bad phi ha ka jinghikai jong ka tempi, bad phim shym la shim ia nga: hynrei ki jingthoh ki dei ban pyndep .

en: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice , and kept my charge , my commandments , my statutes , and my laws .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , namar ba u Abraham u la kohnguh ïa nga , bad u la sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u Abraham u la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga, bad u la bat ia ka jingbthah jong nga, ki hukum jong nga, ki ain jong nga bad ki ain jong nga .

en: And she went up , and laid him on the bed of the man of God , and shut the door upon him , and went out .
kha: Ka bah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra u Elisha , ka buh ïa u ha ka jingthiah bad ka mihnoh , da kaba khang ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kiew shaneng bad ka la buh ia u ha ka jingthiah jong u briew U Blei bad ka la khang ia ka jingkhang halor jong u bad ka la mih noh .

en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ai hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew hynriew tylli ki masi, ar tylli ki langbrot bad shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem jingduna:

en: And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
kha: Haba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba u angel u la ïathuh shaphang u khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohi ia ka , ki la pynpaw shabar ia ka jingong kaba la iathuh ha ki shaphang une u khynnah .

en: His head and his hairs were white like wool , as white as snow  ; and his eyes were as a flame of fire  ;
kha: U shñiuh jong u , u la long uba lieh kum u  saiwul lane kum ka ïor , bad ki khmat jong u kiba klang kum ka ding ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong u bad ki shniuh jong u ki long kiba lieh kum ka snieh langbrot, kum u slap ; bad ki khmat jong u ki long kum ka ding;

en: But unto them which are called , both Jews and Greeks , Christ the power of God , and the wisdom of God .
kha: Katba ma ngi , ngi pynbna ïa U Khrist ba la sahnarphna , ka khubor kaba long ka jingpynwit ha ki Jiw bad kaba ibieit ha ki Jentil ; hynrei ha kito ïa kiba U Blei u la khot , ki Jiw bad ki Grik ruh , kane ka khubor ka long U Khrist , uba long ka bor U Blei bad ka jingstad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kito kiba la khot, ki Jiw bad ki Grik , U Khrist ka bor U Blei bad ka jingstad U Blei .

en: For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leit ryngkat bad phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong phi u long uba iaid ryngkat bad phi , ban ialeh na ka bynta jong phi pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong phi , ban pynim ia phi .

en: But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .
kha: Kan kham suk pynban , lada ka shong marwei . Kata ka long ka jingai jingmut jong nga bad nga pyrkhat ba ïa nga ruh la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka kham suk lada ka kohnguh kumta, hadien ka jingbishar jong nga: bad nga pyrkhat ruh ba nga don U Mynsiem U Blei .

en: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters , but thou shalt not enjoy them  ; for they shall go into captivity .
kha: Phin ïoh ki khun shynrang bad kynthei , hynrei phin duh ïa ki , naba yn rong noh ïa ki kum ki koidi thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban kha khun shynrang bad kynthei , hynrei wat sngewbha ia ki namar kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: Prepare thy work without , and make it fit for thyself in the field  ; and afterwards build thine house .
kha: Wat tei ïa ka ïing jong phi bad pynskhem ïa ka longïing tad haduh ban pynbiang ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad phin thikna ba phi lah ban kamai ha ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh ia ka kam jong me shabar , bad pynlong ia ka ban iahap bad lade ha lyngkha ; bad hadien kata to tei ia ka iing jong me .

en: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .
kha: shuwa ba U Blei un thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne wat shi kham ka khyndew kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba haduh mynta um pat thaw ia ka khyndew , ne ki lyngkha , ne ka bynta kaba ha khlieh duh jong ka pyrthei .

en: And Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Don ne em hangta sa uwei u nongïathuhlypa ha uba ngi lah ban ïasyllok bad U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ong: Hato ym don hangne u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai nalor kata ba ngin kylli ia u ?

en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .
kha: Bad lada phi lehbha tang ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki leh kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi leh bha ia kito kiba leh bha ia phi, kaei ka jingsngewnguh kaba phi don ? namar ki nongpop ruh ki leh kumjuh .

en: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .
kha: Nangta ki her noh kum ka lyer bad ki jah syndon , kine ki briew kiba ka bor ka long u blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka jingmut jong u kan kylla, bad un iaid noh, bad un sngewsih, da kaba pynpaw ia kane ka bor jong u ha u blei jong u .

en: For want and famine they were solitary  ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
kha: Ki la long kiba duk haduh katta katta bad kiba thngan haduh ba ki bam ïa ki thied tyrkhong — mynmiet , ha khlaw , ha ki jaka kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingkwah bad ka jingkyrduh ki la long marwei; ki la phet noh sha ka ri khlaw ha ki por mynshuwa .

en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .
kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Na ka Templ jong U  Trai  ngi kyrkhu ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai: ngi la kyrkhu ia phi na ka iing U Trai .

en: She is more precious than rubies : and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her .
kha: Ka jingstad ka kham kordor shibun ban ïa ki mawlynnai ; ym don kano kano ruh na ka jingkwah jong phi ba lah ban ïanujor bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham kordor ban ia ki ruby: bad kiei kiei baroh kiba me kwah kim long kiba lah ban ianujor bad ka .

en: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falleth upon men , in slumberings upon the bed  ;
kha: Mynmiet haba ki briew ki dang ïohthiah , U Blei u kren ha ki jingphohsniew bad jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingphohsniew , ha ka jingphohsniew jong ka miet , haba ka jingthiah kaba jylliew ka hap ha ki shynrang , ha ki jingthiah ha ka jingthiah ; .

en: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day , and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem .
kha: Kumta u Joshua u pynlong ka jutang na ka bynta u paidbah ha kata ka sngi , bad hangta ha Shekhem u la ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba kin bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la leh ia ka jutang bad ki briew ha kata ka sngi , bad u la buh ia ki ia ka ain bad ka hukum ha Shehem .

en: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .
kha: Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Lada men beh noh ïa ngi shabar , to phah ïa ngi sha katai ka kynhun ki sniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ia u, ki da ong: Lada me beh noh ia ngi shabar , to ai ba ngin leit noh sha ka kynhun sniang .

en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U long , uba wan hadien jong nga u kham sngewtynnad ha khmat jong nga , uba ka juti jong u kam long kaba bit ban pyllait .

en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon , and bound him in fetters , to carry him to Babylon .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah , u kem ïa u Jehoïakim , bad u ïalam ïa u sha Babilonia da kaba khum ha ki kynjri .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia u u la wan shaneng u syiem Babilon bad u la teh ia u da ki kynjri, ban rah ia u sha Babilon .

en: The chargesheet has been filed under UAPA and various sections of the Indian Penal Codes and the Arms Act
kha: Ia kane ka mukotduma la ujor hapoh ka UAPA bad ki bynta bapher bapher jong ka Indian Penal Codes bad ka Arms Act 2019.
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kane ka jingkynnoh la mudui hapoh ka UAPA bad ki bynta bapher bapher jong ka Indian Penal Code bad ka ain Arms Act .

en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .
kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala halor ki lum , bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba kah syrngiew , u Ahas u ai jingkñia bad u thang jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la knia ruh bad u la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong , bad ha ki lum , bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam .

en: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phi long kiba mutlop , ki briew kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn iaroh ia u briew kat kum ka jingstad jong u: hynrei ia uta uba don ka dohnud kaba bakla yn niewbein .

en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la kylli jar jar ïa u ,  Balei ba ngim lah ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan shapoh iing, ki synran jong u ki la kylli ia u marwei , Balei ngim lah ban beh noh ia u ?

en: And he spake a parable unto them , saying ,  The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien u briew uba riewspah uba don ka jaka kaba la pynmih kyrhai ki jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia ka jingiathuhkhana ha ki, u da ong: Ka nongrim jong uwei u briew uba riewspah u la wanrah bun:

en: My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kum kiba ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Trai ka burom , phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki rukom kiba pher na kaei kaba ïohi ïa ki na shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para jong nga , kim don ka jingngeit U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , U Trai jong ka burom , ha kaba iadei bad ki briew .

en: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong nga kan ïoh long ha phi bad ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la kren ha phi, ba ka jingkmen jong nga kan sah ha phi bad ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan long kaba dap .

en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way : but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .
kha: Ka jingbeit ka pynsuk ïa ka jingim u briew uba bha , hynrei u bymman u kyllon da la ki jong ki kam bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok jong uba janai kan pynbeit ia ka lynti jong u: hynrei u bymman un hap da ka jingsniew jong u hi .

en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the  Lord  , and with your children s children will I plead .
kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  ngan buh biang ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan wanrah ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan dang kyrpad ia phi , ko Trai , bad bad ki khun jong phi ngan kyrpad .

en: For he had healed many  ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .
kha: U la lah pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew , bad baroh kito kiba pang ki la ïai kyntur sha u khnang ba ïohktah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynkoit ia kiba bun ki bym don shuh ba ki la pynkhih ia u ban ktah ia u, kumba ki don ki khniang jingpang .

en: Rise up , ye women that are at ease  ; hear my voice , ye careless daughters  ; give ear unto my speech .
kha: Ko phi ki kynthei kiba im suk , ki bym don ki jingkhuslai , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To kiew shaneng, phi ki kynthei kiba suk ; to iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga, phi ki khun kynthei ki bym sumar ; to sngap ia ka jingkren jong nga .

en: Wherefore Jesus also , that he might sanctify the people with his own blood , suffered without the gate .
kha: Namar kane ka daw U Jisu ruh u la ïap shabar ka nongbah , khnang ban pynkhuid ïa u paidlang na ka pop da ka snam jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Jisu ruh , ba un pynkyntang ia ki briew da ka snam jong u hi , u la shah shitom khlem ka khyrdop .

en: Recently , in connection with the 50 years , our Honourable President paid a visit to the Rock Memorial .
kha: Dang shen ha kaba iadei bad ka jingdap 50 snem , u President ba donburom jong ngi u la leit jngoh ia ka Rock Memorial .
translated_en_to_kha: Dang shen , ha kaba iadei bad ki 50 snem , u President ba donburom jong ngi u la leit jngoh ia ka Rock Memorial .

en: And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him ,  Thou sayest it .
kha: U Pilat u la kylli jingkylli ïa u ,  Me long u syiem jong ki Jiw ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumba me ong hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la kylli ia u, Hato me long u Syiem jong ki Jiw ? U la jubab ia u .

en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
kha: Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab ,  bad khyndiat ki dohkha rit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ? Ki la ong, Hynriew bad katto katne ki dohkha .

en: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah : fear ye not .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga pynkhreh ban kyrkhu ïa ki paid ka Jerusalem bad Judah . Kumta wat sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta sa shisien nga la pyrkhat ha kine ki sngi ban leh bha ia ka Jerusalem bad ia ka iing Judah: wat tieng .

en: And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan sha nga mynta , haba phi la isih ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la pynlong ïa nga ban mihnoh na ka ri jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la ong ha ki: Balei phi wan sha nga haba phi iohi ba phi shun ia nga bad phi la phah noh ia nga na phi ?

en: And came even before the king s gate : for none might enter into the king s gate clothed with sackcloth .
kha: Um shym la rung shapoh namar ym don uba lah ban rung shapoh ha ki jaiñ khain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan wat ha khmat ka khyrdop syiem: namar ym don ba lah ban rung shapoh ka khyrdop syiem kaba la phong da ka jain lyngkhuid .

en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
kha: Ha kaba sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , kiba don baroh ha ka ri Babilonia   .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsdang jong ka hima jong u ka long u Babel, bad u Erech, bad u Akad bad u Kalneh ha ka ri Shinar .

en: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face  ; and they said , Behold , we be thy servants .
kha: Nangta ki hynmen jong u hi ki ïawan bad ki ïadem ngon ha khmat jong u .  Ngi long ki mraw jong phi ,  ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong u ruh ki la leit bad ki la dem khrup ha khmat jong u ; bad ki la ong: Ha khmih ngi long ki shakri jong me .

en: And the  Lord  met Balaam , and put a word in his mouth , and said , Go again unto Balak , and say thus .
kha: U  Trai  u ïakynduh ïa u Balaam , u la ïathuh ha u kumno ban kren , bad u la phah ïa u pat sha u Balak ban ai ïa ka khubor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la iakynduh ia u Balaam, bad u la buh ia ka ktien ha ka shyntur jong u, bad u la ong: Leit biang sha Balak bad to ong kumta .

en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
kha: U briew uba sngewthuh u lum ïa ki soh ha ka aïom kaba biang ; ka long kaba jahburom ban thiah thai ha ka por ka aïom ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba lum ha ka por lyiur u long u khun uba stad: hynrei uta uba thiah ha ka por ot u long u khun uba pynlong ia ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: For what hath the wise more than the fool ? what hath the poor , that knoweth to walk before the living ?
kha: Kumno kiba stad ki kham bit kham biang ban ïa ki bieit ? Kaba bha aïu ïa uba duk ban tip kumno ban ïaksaid ha ka jingim ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei kaba kham stad ban ia uba bieit ? kaei kaba duk kaba tip ban iaid ha khmat kiba im ?

en: All they shall speak and say unto thee , Art thou also become weak as we ? art thou become like unto us ?
kha: Ki baroh ki khot ïa u , ‘ Mynta me la tlot kumba long ma ngi ! Me long uwei na ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kin kren bad kin ong ha me , Me ruh me kylla tlot kum ma ngi ? me kylla long kum ma ngi ?

en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .
kha: Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kum leh bakla ïa phi . To kynmaw ba ki jingbakla ki lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba tap ia ka jingpynkhein u wad ia ka jingieit ; hynrei uta uba pynkylla ia ka kam u pyniakhlad ia ki paralok kiba bun .

en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish : and they made the ships in Ezion–geber .
kha: Ha ka kadlieng Esiongeber ki thaw ïa ki liengbah ïaid duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iasoh bad u ban shna lieng ban leit sha Tarshish : bad ki la shna ia ki lieng ha Eziongeber .

en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth : and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan .
kha: Nangta ki buh ïa ki tiar ïapom jong u ha ka ïing mane jong ka blei Astarte , bad ki sahnar ïa ka met jong u ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah Beth Shan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ki tiar ialeh jong u ha ka iing u Ashtoret: bad ki la pynskhem ia ka met jong u ha ka kynroh jong ka Bethshan .

en: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns , and put it on his head , and they put on him a purple robe ,
kha: Ki shipai ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat da ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la pynphong halor ka khlieh jong u ; nangta ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh ha u bad ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai ki la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong ki khniang bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u bad ki la buh ia u da ka jainkup kaba lieh .

en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and their sockets , and the hanging for the door of the court ,
kha: ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka phyllaw , ki rishot bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka phyllaw ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingdeng jong ka iingbishar , ki maw jong u bad ki socket jong ki bad ka jingdeng na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka iingbishar , .

en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness :
kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap baroh ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki la ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh kawei jong ki khun Israel ka la ia tyngkhuh bad u Moses bad u Aaron ha ka ri khlaw:

en: And Reuben returned unto the pit  ; and , behold , Joseph was not in the pit  ; and he rent his clothes .
kha: Haba u Reuben u leit phai pat sha kata ka pukri bad shem ba u Joseph um don shuh hangta , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la leit phai biang sha ka thliew ; bad, ha khmih, u Joseph um shym la don ha ka thliew ; bad u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u .

en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .
kha: U thiah mynmiet , u khie bad ha ka por mynsngi , bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai ki speh bad ki nang san . Pynban um tip kumno kane ka jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u dei ban thiah miet bad sngi, bad u symbai u dei ban mih bad san , um tip kumno .

en: " Many , many times I felt that Jehovah did not love me and that my prayers were not being answered . "
kha: " Bunsien bunsien nga la sngew ba U Jehobah um ieit ia nga bad ba ki jingduwai jong nga kim shym la jubab . "
translated_en_to_kha: " Bunsien nga sngew ba U Jehobah um ieit ia nga bad ba ki jingduwai jong nga kim shym la shah jubab ."

en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .
kha: Kam pher la hangno hangno ki Israel ki shong ki sah , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki mrad kum ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata phin ym bam ia ka snam , la ka long ka dohkha ne ka mrad , ha kano kano ka jaka shong jong phi .

en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .
kha: U sdang da ka jingkren bieit bad u kut ha ka jinglamwir .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsdang jong ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong u ka long ka jingbieit: bad ka jingkut jong ka jingkren jong u ka long ka jinglong bieit kaba sniew .

en: And many women were there beholding afar off , which followed Jesus from Galilee , ministering unto him :
kha: La don katto katne ngut ki kynthei hangta , kiba la ïakhmih na pajih , kiba la ïabud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa bad kiba la ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei kiba bun ki la don hangta ki la leit jngai, kiba la bud ia U Jisu na Galilaia, ki shakri ia u:

en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him , yet judgment is before him  ; therefore trust thou in him .
kha: Ko Job , me ong ba mem lah ban ïohi ïa U Blei ; hynrei to ïaishah ban ap — ka kam jong me ka don ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la me ong ba men ym iohi ia u, hynrei ka jingbishar ka long ha khmat jong u ; namarkata to shaniah ha u .

en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .
kha: U la pyrshang ban ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u long uba kumno , hynrei u long u briew uba rit bad um lah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu namar ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wad ban iohi ia U Jisu uba u long ; bad um lah na ka bynta ka kot khubor , namar u la long uba rit ka jinglong .

en: And he went forth again by the sea side  ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .
kha: U Jisu u la leit phai pat sharud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah u la wan sha u bad u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh biang sha shiliang duriaw bad u paidbah baroh u la leit sha u , bad u la hikai ia ki .

en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .
kha: Kum ka dak ka jingpynkynmaw , teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban teh ia ki kum ka dak ha ka kti jong me , bad kin long kum ki khmat hapdeng ki khmat jong me .

en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner , and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat .
kha: Ha ki jaka bapra jong ki nongbah , ki khunlangbrot kin bam phlang bad ki blang samla kin shem ka jaka bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki langbrot kin bam katkum ka rukom jong ki, bad ki jaka ba la jot jong ki nongwei kin bam .

en: Then Asa went out against him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .
kha: U Asa u leit ban ïaleh ïa u , bad baroh arliang ki ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Them Sephathah hajan Mareshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asa u la mih pyrshah ia u , bad ki la buh ia ka thma ha ka them u Sephiah ha Marsah .

en: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine : and he was the priest of the most high God .
kha: Bad u Melkhisedek , uba long u syiem jong ka Salem bad uba long ruh u lyngdoh jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u la wallam ïa u kpu bad ka waiñ ha u Abram ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Melchizedek u syiem Salem u la wanrah ia u kpu bad ka wain : bad u la long u lyngdoh jong U Blei uba ha khlieh duh tam .

en: So by his miracles Jesus showed on a small scale what will take place on earth under the Kingdom of God .
kha: Kumta da ki kam bha U Jisu u pyni khyndiat , ia ka nuksa kaei ka ban sa long pat hapoh ka hima u Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta da ki kambah jong u U Jisu u la pyni ha ka rukom kaba rit kaei kaban jia ha ka pyrthei hapoh ka Hima U Blei .

en: Then released he Barabbas unto them : and when he had scourged Jesus , he delivered him to be crucified .
kha: Nangta u Pilat u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki ; bad hadien kata , u la phah sympat ïa U Jisu , u la aiti ïa u ban sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la pyllait ia u Barabbas ha ki: bad haba u la pynkhih ia U Jisu , u la aiti ia u ban shah sahnarphna .

en: For the people were numbered , and , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there .
kha: ha ka jingkhot kyrteng ïa ki shipai ym shym la don uwei ruh na Jabesh uba jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew ki la shah khein bad, ha khmih, ym don uwei ruh na ki nongshong shnong jong u Jabeshgilead hangta .

en: And his deeds , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Josaïah u la leh — ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  , ka jingkohnguh jong u ïa ka Hukum , bad ïa ka histori jong u naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut — la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kam jong u, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha khmih la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Israel bad Judah .

en: To an inheritance incorruptible , and undefiled , and that fadeth not away , reserved in heaven for you ,
kha: Kane ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingkyrmen ba-im , bad kumta ngi peit sha khmat ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu kyrhai kiba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . U buh ïa ki ha bneng na ka bynta jong phi , ha kaba kim lah ban pyut lane duh noh lane sep noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka pateng kaba ym lah ban pyut bad kaba khlem pynjakhlia bad kaba khlem jah noh, kaba la buh ha bneng na ka bynta jong phi .

en: For there must be also heresies among you , that they which are approved may be made manifest among you .
kha: (Khlem artatien ka don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong phi khnang ba yn ithuh shai ïa kita kiba leh ïa kaba dei .)
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki dei ruh ban don ki jingkren bein hapdeng jong phi , ba ia kiba la mynjur yn pynpaw hapdeng jong phi .

en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .
kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki leit wad phlangïap kylleng ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la bthei shabar ri ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt ban lum ia ki sboh ha ka jaka jong u sboh .

en: But one thing is needful : and Mary hath chosen that good part , which shall not be taken away from her .
kha: hynrei , tang kawei kaba donkam . Ka Mari ka la jied ïa kaei kaba dei , bad yn ym shim noh ïa kata na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei ka long kaba donkam: bad ka Maria ka la jied ia kata ka bynta kaba bha, kaba ym lah ban shim noh na ka .

en: And he sent him away to his house , saying ,  Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .
kha: U Jisu te u la phah ïa u sha ïing ryngkat bad ka hukum ,  Wat leit phai pat sha ka nongrit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah noh ia u sha la iing da kaba ong: Wat leit shapoh shnong ne iathuh ia kata ha uno uno u briew ha sor .

en: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .
kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban long u riewmadan uba trei ban ïoh bam ban kaba leh mynleh kum uba khraw hynrei bad ka shahthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la shah lehbein bad uba don u shakri , u kham bha ban ia uta uba burom ia lade bad uba duna u kpu .

en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
kha: U Manasseh u la don khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem sanphew san snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Manasseh u la don shiphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem :

en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba im ha ka pyrthei kiba im u don katto katne ka jingkyrmen ; u ksew uba im u kham bha ban ïa u sing ba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha uta uba la shah pyniasoh bad kiba im baroh ka don ka jingkyrmen: namar u kulai uba im u kham bha ban ia u sing uba la iap .

en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ksuid , bad u la mihnoh shabar jong u khynnah , bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la pynrem ia u ksuid ; bad u la leit noh na u: bad uta u khynnah u la koit naduh kata hi ka kynta .

en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato ym don sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ngin kylli ïa U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la ong , Hato ym don hangne u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai nalor kata ba ngin kylli ia u ?

en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .
kha: Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei uta u bym shongkurim u leh ïa kaba kham bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta uta uba ai ia ka ha ka jingshongkha u leh bha ; hynrei uta u bym ai ia ka ha ka jingshongkha u leh kham bha .

en: She riseth also while it is yet night , and giveth meat to her household , and a portion to her maidens .
kha: Ka khie dang step phyrngab bad ka pynkhreh jingbam ïa kiba ha ka ïing jong ka , bad ban ong ïa la ki shakri kynthei ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khie ruh katba dang miet, bad ka ai doh ia ka iing jong ka, bad ka bynta ia ki nongtrei jong ka .

en: Now consider how great this man was , unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils .
kha: Te , phi ïohi , katno u la long uba khraw . U Abraham u kpa tymmen ba-donnam jong ngi , u la ai ha u kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na baroh kaba u la ïoh ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta pyrkhat katno une u briew u long uba khraw , ha uba wat u kpa tymmen u Abraham u la ai shi bynta na ka shi bynta na ki jinglute .

en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .
kha: Ainguh ïa kine nalor ki jingainguh thang kiba man ka step .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban ai ia kine nalor ka jingknia thang kaba neh slem .

en: And the servant ran to meet her , and said , Let me , I pray thee , drink a little water of thy pitcher .
kha: Uta u shakri u leit bran bran ban ïashem ïa ka bad u ong ,  To ai um ba ngan dih na uto u khiew um jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la mareh ban iakynduh ia ka bad u la ong, To ngan dih khyndiat ka um na ka khiew jong me .

en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .
kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh , ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah , la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Josiah , ha kaba kane ka jingkhawai ka la long ha U Trai ha Jerusalem .

en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
kha: Ki la ïalam ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom bad ki la ong ,  Kine ki briew ki dei ki Jiw , bad ki la thaw jingkulmar ha ka nongbah jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia ki ha ki majistor, u da ong, Kine ki briew, ki long ki Jiw, ki pynshitom palat ia ka shnong jong ngi .

en: And they brought him to Jesus : and they cast their garments upon the colt , and they set Jesus thereon .
kha: Nangta ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor u khun kada bad ki la ïarap ïa U Jisu ban kiew halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia u sha U Jisu: bad ki la bret ia ki jain jong ki halor ka khun masi , bad ki la buh ia U Jisu hangta .

en: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .
kha: U briew uba sniew u prie noh ïa ka spah ba u la tuh ; U Blei u shim pat ïa ka , wat na ka kpoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sngap jar ia ki spah, bad un sa pynkhih biang ia ki: U Blei un bret noh ia ki na ka kpoh jong u .

en: But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .
kha: Mynta , lada don mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ïano ïano , um shym la leh ïa kata ha nga hynrei ha phi baroh — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (Nga ong ïa kane namar ngam kwah ban da leh tyngeh halor jong u .)
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada don mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ia nga, um shym la pynsngewsih ia nga, hynrei ha kawei ka bynta: ba ngan ym pynbor palat ia phi baroh .

en: Simon , ( whom he also named Peter , ) and Andrew his brother , James and John , Philip and Bartholomew ,
kha: U Simon ( ïa uba u la ai kyrteng , u Petros ) bad u Andriw u para jong u , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , u Philip bad u Bartholomai ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon (u uba u la jer kyrteng ruh ia u Petros ) bad u Androd u hynmen jong u, u Jakob bad u Ioannis , u Philip bad u Bartholomew .

en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , he shall even die thereby .
kha: Haba u briew uba hok u keiñ noh na kaba leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew , un ïap na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u hok u phai noh na ka hok jong u bad u pynbeit ia ka jingbymhok , un iap wat da kata .

en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .
kha: Nga hi nga la pyrkhat ba nga dei ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga lah pyrshah ïa ka jingthmu U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyrkhat shisha bad lade , ba nga dei ban leh shibun kiei kiei kiba pyrshah ia ka kyrteng U Jisu na Nazareth .

en: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .
kha: Kumta ki la leit phai sha u Balak bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh ban wan bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka ri Moab ki la ieng bad ki la leit sha Balak bad ki la ong: U Balaam u la kyntait ban wan ryngkat bad ngi .

en: And the fourth row a beryl , and an onyx , and a jasper : they shall be set in gold in their inclosings .
kha: bad u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon kaba saw . Pyndait ïa ki baroh ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lain kaba saw ka long ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw: kin buh ksiar ha ki jingkhang jong ki .

en: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?
kha: Hato me la dep ka jingkren jong me kaba kum ka lyer ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por men kren ia kine kiei kiei ? bad katno ka ktien jong ka shyntur jong me kan long kum ka Iyer kaba khlain ?

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that David his father did .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid , u la leh ïa kaei kaba sngewbha ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: Let her not be as one dead , of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother s womb .
kha: Wat ai ba kan long kum u khunlung ba la kha ïap , uba la shah bam noh shiteng ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba kan long kum kawei kaba la iap, na kaba ka doh ka la bam shiteng haba u mih na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u .

en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .
kha: Kata ka briew ka kha ïa u khun shynrang bad ka ai kyrteng ïa u , u Samson . Uta u khunlung u la nang san bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la kha khun shynrang , bad ka la khot ia u u Samson : bad uta u khun u la san , bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia u .

en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
kha: Kumta ïa une u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to bret ia u shakri bym don jingmyntoi sha ka jingdum kaba kham shabar: kan don ka jingiam bad ka jingkyrhuh jong ki bniat .

en: He shall lean upon his house , but it shall not stand : he shall hold it fast , but it shall not endure .
kha: Lada ki shaniah ha ka snur thapbawa , hato ka lah ban shan ïa ki ? Lada ki kynrup ïa u ksai , hato u lah ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïeng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Un shaniah ha ka iing jong u , hynrei kan ym ieng: un bat skhem ia ka , hynrei kan ym neh .

en: And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Te ki briew jong ki hima baroh kin khot ïa phi kiba suk , namar ka ri jong phi kan long ka jaka kaba bha ban shong ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin khot ia phi kiba la kyrkhu: namar phin long ka ri kaba sngewbha , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .
kha: Ka hukum ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi kam dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh lane kaba sha palat ka bor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka hukum kaba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi , kam shym la buhrieh na me , bad kam long kaba jngai .

en: And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .
kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba sngewtriem kum kiba u Moses u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka kti kaba khlain bor baroh bad ha ka jingtieng kaba khraw kaba u Moses u la pyni ha khmat ki Israel baroh .

en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain  ; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof .
kha: Ka jinglute borabor ka shim noh ïa ka jingim jong u nonglute — kane ka dei kaba ju jia ha uno uno uba im da ka jingleh jubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki lynti jong uwei pa uwei uba thrang ban ioh ; kaba shim noh ia ka jingim jong ki trai jong ka .

en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .
kha: Ki briew kin behmrad hangta da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam . Ho-oid , ka ri baroh kawei kan dap da ki shynraiñ bad ki bniap shiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki khnam bad da ki bow ki briew kin wan shapoh ; namar ka ri baroh kan kylla long ki bniat bad ki bniat .

en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him .
kha: Ha ka jingkiew rasong ka jingjop jong u , pynban ka jingkhia jong ka jingjynjar kan ban halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingdap jong ka jingjyllei jong u un don ha ka jingeh: kawei pa kawei ka kti jong kiba sniew kan wan ha u .

en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth , the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air ,
kha: u mrad lane ka sim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiasyriem jong uno uno u mrad uba don ha ka khyndew , ka jingiasyriem jong uno uno u sim uba don ki bniat kiba her ha ka Iyer , .

en: Then did they spit in his face , and buffeted him  ; and others smote him with the palms of their hands ,
kha: Nangta ki la bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u bad ki la shoh ïa u ; bad kito kiba la thab ïa u
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la sngap jar ha ka khmat jong u , bad ki la shoh ia u ; bad kiwei pat ki la shoh ia u da ki kti jong ki .

en: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .
kha: ha U Blei , uba tang ma u hi U Nongpynim jong ngi , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to long ka burom , ka jingkhraw bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka jingsynshar , na ki rta ba la leit noh baroh , bad mynta , bad sha ki bymjukut bad bymjukut ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha U Blei uba stad tang ma U U Nongpynim jong ngi, to long ka burom bad ka jingkhraw, ka jingsynshar bad ka bor, mynta bad junom . Amen .

en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :
kha: ngan ym beh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jaitbynriew kiba dang don ha ka ri haba u Joshua u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh ngan ym beh noh ia uno uno na khmat jong ki jaitbynriew kiba u Joshua u la leit noh haba u la iap:

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ba wat la ka Israel ka la phai noh na u , ka la lah pynshisha ba ka long kaba kham bha ban ïa ka Judah ka bymïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ka Israel kaba phaidien ka la pynshisha ia lade kham palat ban ia u Judah uba thok .

en: And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .
kha: Kin ym bud ïa uwei pat ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , namar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongwei un ym bud ia u , hynrei un phet noh na u: namar kim tip ia ka sur jong ki nongwei .

en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place , and hast made thee an high place in every street .
kha: harud jong kawei pa kawei ka surok pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me ruh me la tei ia me ia ka jaka kaba pawnam , bad me la pynlong ia me ka jaka kaba jrong ha man la ka lynti .

en: And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Saul , bad u phah khot ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la iohsngew ia ki ktien kiba u Dabid u la kren , ki la pynkhreh ia ki ha khmat u Saul : bad u la phah ia u .

en: And the child grew , and was weaned : and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned .
kha: U khunlung u la nang san , bad ha ka sngi ba la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , u Abraham u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah u la san bad u la shah pynkha khun: bad u Abraham u la leh ia ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kajuh ka sngi ba u Isaak u la shah pynkha khun .

en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God : for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .
kha: Uta ïa uba U Blei u la phah , u kren ïa ki ktien jong U Blei , namar ba U Blei u ai ha u ïa ka jingdap jong U Mynsiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba U Blei u la phah u kren ia ki ktien U Blei: namar U Blei um ai ia U Mynsiem da kaba thew ia u .

en: And the sons of Ulam  ; Bedan . These were the sons of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh .
kha: bad u Ulam u don uwei u khun uba kyrteng u Bedan . Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , bad u ksiew jong u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Ulam Bedan . Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Gilead u khun shynrang jong u Machir u khun shynrang jong u Manasseh .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .
kha: U ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai pat sha la ka kynrad , bad long ka mraw jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha ka , To leit phai noh sha ka jinglong kynthei jong me bad to pyndem ia lade hapoh ki kti jong ka .

en: He therefore that despiseth , despiseth not man , but God , who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit .
kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba kyntait ïa kane ka jinghikai , um kyntait ïa u briew , hynrei ïa U Blei , uba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U uba lehbein, um ju lehbein ia u briew hynrei ia U Blei uba la ai ruh ha ngi ia U Mynsiem bakhuid jong u .

en: Then said the king to Amasa , Assemble me the men of Judah within three days , and be thou here present .
kha: U syiem u ong ha u Amasa ,  Khot lang ïa ki rangbah Judah bad wan biang shane la shi sngi lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha u Amasa , To lum lang ia nga ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh lai sngi , bad to long hangne .

en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity , than he that is perverse in his lips , and is a fool .
kha: Ka kham bha ban long uba duk hynrei uba beit ban ïa kaba long u bieit uba shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ia uba duk uba iaid ha ka jinglong ba janai jong u, ban ia uta uba kylla ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u bad uba bieit .

en: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish , of the beeves , of the sheep , or of the goats .
kha: khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka , ka dei ban long da u masi , ne da u langbrot , ne da u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban aiti katba mon u shynrang khlem jingduna, na ki khnai, na ki langbrot ne na ki blang .

en: The sorrows of death compassed me , and the pains of hell gat hold upon me : I found trouble and sorrow .
kha: Ka jingma jong ka jingïap ka la ker sawdong jong nga ; ki jingngiew jong ka jingtep ki la hajan ïa nga ; la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingtieng bad ka jingkhuslai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingsngewsih jong ka jingiap ki la ker sawdong ia nga, bad ki jingpang jong ka khlaw dujok ki bat ia nga: Nga la shem ia ka jingeh bad jingsngewsih .

en: For from within , out of the heart of men , proceed evil thoughts , adulteries , fornications , murders ,
kha: Naba na shapoh , na ka dohnud u briew , ki wan ki jingmut basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban leh ki kam awria , ban lute , ban pynïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na shapoh, na ka dohnud ki briew, ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew, ki jingleh be-ijot, ki jingleh be-ijot , ki jingpyniap briew .

en: For wisdom is better than rubies  ; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it .
kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , nga kham kordor ban ïa ki mawlynnai ; baroh kaba phi angnud kam lah ban ïanujor bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ia ki ruby bad kiei kiei baroh kiba lah ban kwah kim dei ban ianujor bad ka .

en: They deck it with silver and with gold  ; they fasten it with nails and with hammers , that it move not .
kha: bad la pynitynnat da ka rupa bad ka ksiar . La pynskhem ïa ka da ki preg ban pyllait ïa ka na ka jingkyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pyndait ia ka da ka rupa bad da ka ksiar ; ki pynskhem ia ka da ki nail bad da ki hammer , ba kan ym khih .

en: Holding faith , and a good conscience ; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck :
kha: To pyndonkam ïa kito ki ktien kum ki jingkieng atiar khnang ba me lah ban ïaleh shlur , bad sumar ïa la ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingïatiplem bakhuid . Don ki briew ki bymshahskhor ïa la ka jingïatiplem bad ki la pyntroiñ ïa la ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbat ia ka jingngeit , bad ka jingsngewthuh kaba bha ; kaba don kiba la weng noh shaphang ka jingngeit:

en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
kha: Nangta u ong shuh ,  Hynrei nyngkong , to ngin ïakylli ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ong ha u syiem Israel: To kylli, nga kyrpad ia me, ha ka ktien U Trai ha ka sngi .

en: But they shall proceed no further : for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was .
kha: Hynrei kin ym lah ban leit kham jngai , namar baroh kin ïohi ba katno ki long kiba mutlop . Kata ka long kaei kaba dang dep jia ïa u Jannes bad u Jambres .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kin ym iaid shakhmat shuh: namar ka jinglong bieit jong ki kan paw ha ki briew baroh kumba ka jong ki ruh ka la long .

en: Seeing it is one God , which shall justify the circumcision by faith , and uncircumcision through faith .
kha: U Blei u long tang uwei , bad un pynlong ha lade hi ka hok bad ki Jiw halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit jong ki , bad un pynlong ka hok bad ki Jentil lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpeit ia ka ka long kawei ka Blei , kaba pynshisha ia ka jingkren bein da ka jingngeit , bad ka jingbymkren bein da ka jingngeit .

en: This is what was intended , since God provided a wife to be “a helper for him , as a complement of him .”
kha: Kane ka long khia jingthmu na duh ba sdang , ba u Blei u la pynkhreh , ka tnga kan long “Ka nongiarap jong u kum ka jing sumar ka ba biang .”
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kaba la thmu , namar U Blei u la pynbiang ia ka tnga ban long a u nongiarap na ka bynta jong u , kum ka jingpyndap ia u .

en: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .
kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la pynsngap jar ïa ki Saddusi , ki la ïawanlang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Pharisi ki la iohsngew ba u la buh ia ki Sadusi ban sngap jar , ki la ialum lang .

en: Also , that the soul be without knowledge , it is not good  ; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth .
kha: Ka jingshitrhem khlem ka jingtip kam long kaba bha ; ka jingbymïaishah kan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ba ka mynsiem ka long khlem jingtip, kam long kaba bha ; bad uta uba kyrkieh bad ki kjat jong u u leh pop .

en: My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .
kha: Ka khlieh jong nga ka king , bad nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Nga la khmih lynti ïa ka janmiet ban wan , hynrei kam shym wallam ei ei hynrei tang ka jingtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la sngewsih, ka jingtieng ka la pynkhih ia nga: ka miet jong ka jingsngewbha jong nga u la kylla long ka jingtieng ia nga .

en: He increaseth the nations , and destroyeth them : he enlargeth the nations , and straiteneth them again .
kha: U pynlong ïa ki hima kiba khlaiñ bad kiba khraw , hynrei nangta u jop thiaw bad pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynbun ia ki jaitbynriew , bad u pynjot ia ki: u pynheh ia ki jaitbynriew , bad u pynkhlain biang ia ki .

en: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah , of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin :
kha: Kane ka kitab ka dei ka jingïathuh ïa kaei kaba la kren da u Jeremaïah , u khun jong u Hilkaïah , uwei na ki lyngdoh jong ka shnong Anathoth ha ka thain Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien u Jeremaiah u khun u Hilkiah , na ki lyngdoh kiba don ha Anathoth ha ka ri u Benjamin:

en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days , that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made :
kha: Hadien sawphew sngi u Noah u plie ïa ka jingkhangïit , bad u pyllait ïa ka tyngab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki sawphew sngi, u Noah u la plie ia ka jingkhang jong ka lieng kaba u la shna:

en: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good : and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat bad kren ïa kaba sniew u lah ban khmih lynti ban ym shem ei ei kaba bha — tang ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka dohnud kaba jem um shem ei ei: bad uta uba don ka shyntur kaba bakla u hap ha ka jingsniew .

en: ( Psalm 119 :97-100 ) Yet , true Christians do not respect God’s standards merely to benefit themselves .
kha: ( Salm 119 :97-100 ) Ki Khristan bashisha ki burom ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei ym namarba ki ïoh jingmyntoi ïalade .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Salm 119 :97-100 ) Hynrei ki Khristan bashisha kim burom ia ki kyndon jong U Blei tang ban pynmyntoi ia lade .

en: Take a few minutes each week to examine one of the following lessons and to answer the review questions .
kha: Man la ka taïew , peitbniah katto katne minit ïa kawei na kine ki lynnong bad jubab biang ïa ki jingkylli harum .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndonkam katto katne minit man la ka taiew ban bishar bniah ia kawei na kine ki jinghikai harum bad ban jubab ia ki jingkylli bishar bniah .

en: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day : wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day .
kha: Kumta u Akhish u ai ha u ïa ka shnong Siklag , bad na kane ka daw ka Siklag ka long noh ka jong ki syiem Judah naduh kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Achish u la ai ia u Ziklag ha kata ka sngi: namar kata u Ziklag u long ha ki syiem Judah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And it came to pass after a while , that the brook dried up , because there had been no rain in the land .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , kata ka wahduid ka rngad noh namar ba ym shym la don slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien katto katne por, ba ka wah ka la tyrkhong namar ba ym shym la don slap ha kata ka ri .

en: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .
kha: Te ki Israel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri haduh kawei pat ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u long shisha u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Israel baroh naduh Dan haduh Beersheba ki tip ba u Samuel u la long u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai .

en: Lo , this only have I found , that God hath made man upright  ; but they have sought out many inventions .
kha: Kane ka long baroh kaba nga la tip : U Blei u la thaw ïa ngi kiba synlar , hynrei ngi la pynjyrthiaw shibun eh ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , kane tang nga la shem , ba U Blei u la thaw ia u briew uba beit ; hynrei ki la wad bun ki jingpynmih .

en: Asshur is there and all her company : his graves are about him : all of them slain , fallen by the sword :
kha: Ka Assyria ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Asshur ka don hangta bad ka kynhun jong ka baroh: ki jingtep jong u ki long shaphang jong u: baroh ki la shah pyniap, ki la hap da ka waitlam:

en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .
kha: Lada phi rkhiebeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki . Phin shah pynshitom lada phi leh sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba rkhie bein ia u Nongthaw jong u: bad uta uba sngewbha ia ki jingeh un ym shah pynshitom .

en: Remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Miriam by the way , after that ye were come forth out of Egypt .
kha: Kynmaw aïu U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa ka Miriam mynba phi wan na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la leh ha Miriam ha ka lynti , hadien ba phi la mih na Ijipt .

en: Beware of false prophets , which come to you in sheep s clothing , but inwardly they are ravening wolves .
kha: To sumar ïa lade na ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ; ki wan sha phi ki da i kum ki langbrot ha kaba shabar , hynrei ha kaba shapoh ki long shisha kum ki suri barunar .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ia ki nongiathuhlypa lamler kiba wan sha phi da ki jain langbrot , hynrei hapoh ki long ki blang kiba bam dohkha .

en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .
kha: Pynban , kaei kaba dang sah ka long ban ap da ka jingsheptieng ïa ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan bad ïa ka ding kaba klang ka ban sa bam duh ïa kita kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katto katne ka jingwad ia ka jingbishar bad ka jingbitar kaba shyrkhei , kaba kan bam ia ki nongshun .

en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters : the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas .
kha: Haba ki maji jong pha ki ïalam ïa pha sha duriaw , ka lyer na sha mihngi ka pynjot ïa pha jngai na ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleit jingleit jong me ki la wanrah ia me sha ki um kiba khraw: ka Iyer mihngi ka la pynpra ia me hapdeng ki duriaw .

en: And the children of Israel went away , and did as the  Lord  had commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
kha: Nangta ki la leit bad leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit noh bad ki la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses bad u Aaron .

en: And thou shalt slay the ram , and thou shalt take his blood , and sprinkle it round about upon the altar .
kha: Pynïap ïa u , shim ïa ka snam jong u , bad synreit ïa ka sawdong kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pyniap ia u langbrot bad men shim ia ka snam jong u bad men theh ia ka sawdong ha ka almari .

en: But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Kan kham shah ia ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ha ka sngi bishar ban ia phi .

en: At the same time , he said ,  " However , I will accept whatever the party decides in this regard . " " "
kha: Ha ka juh ka por u la ong  " Hynrei ngan pdiang ia kano kano kaba ka party kan rai ha kane ka bynta . " " " .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por u la ong , "Hynrei ngan pdiang ia kaei kaei kaba ka party ka rai ha kane ka bynta ."

en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .
kha: Phi lah ban jot noh da ka jingkren ki briew kiba khlem blei , hynrei ka jingstad jong kiba hok ka lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongleh arsap bad ka shyntur jong u u pynjot ia u paramarjan jong u: hynrei lyngba ka jingtip yn pynpoi ia kiba hok .

en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha la ka jaka sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun baroh ki phet ïap da kaba lynñiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng uwei pa uwei ha ka jaka jong u sawdong ka shnong : bad ki shipai baroh ki la mareh , bad ki la iam bad ki la phet noh .

en: And the people answered him after this manner , saying , So shall it be done to the man that killeth him .
kha: Ki ïathuh ïa kaei ba yn leh ïa uta u briew uba pynïap ïa u Goliath .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la jubab ia u hadien kane ka rukom, ki da ong: Kumta yn leh ia uta u briew uba pyniap ia u .

en: And I wept much , because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book , neither to look thereon .
kha: Nga la ïamkthang namar ym shym lah ban shem ïa uno uno uba dei hok ban plied ïa ka kot kli lane ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iam shibun , namar ym shym la lap ia u briew uba bit ban plie bad ban pule ia ka kot , lymne ban peit ia kata .

en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria  ; and Hoshea became his servant , and gave him presents .
kha: U Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u ; u Hoshea u pyndem wait ha u Shalmaneser bad u siew jingnguh syiem man la ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia u u la wan shaneng u Shalmaner u syiem Assyria ; bad u Hoshea u la long u shakri jong u, bad u la ai ia u ia ki jingai sngewbha .

en: And in cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of timber , to work in all manner of workmanship .
kha: ban ot ïa ki mawlynnai bad ban pyndait ïa ki , ban oh-shrong ïa ki dieng , bad ban trei ïa kano kano ka jait jingtrei kaba da ki dur pynitynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba ot ia ki maw, ban buh ia ki, bad ha kaba ker dieng, ban trei ha ki kam baroh .

en: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall , so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth .
kha: Ka Babilonia ka la long ka daw ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew ha baroh kawei ka pyrthei , bad mynta ka Babilonia kan kyllon namar ka la long ka daw ïa ka jingïap jong kiba bun ki Israel . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka Babilon ka la pynlong ia ka jingpyniap jong ki Israel ban hap , kumta ha Babilon kan hap ka jingpyniap ia ka khyndew baroh kawei .

en: In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew bad u kylli ïa u ,  Kaei me mon ïa nga ban ai ha me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Gibeon U Trai u la paw ha u Solomon ha ka jingphohsniew miet : bad U Blei u la ong: To kylli ia kaei kaba ngan ai ia me .

en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
kha: katba ngi dang ap ïa ka jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi kan paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingwad ia kata ka jingkyrmen ba la kyrkhu, bad ka jingmih kaba donburom jong U Blei uba khraw bad U Nongpynim jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt : and thou shalt observe and do these statutes .
kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum ; wat klet ruh ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kynmaw ba me la long u mraw ha Ijipt: bad me dei ban peit bad leh ia kine ki ain .

en: My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .
kha: Ngan ym randien lano lano ruh na ka jingdawa ba ngam shym bakla ; ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka beit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok jong nga ngan bat skhem , bad ngan ym pyllait noh ia ka: ka dohnud jong nga kan ym kynthoh ia nga katba nga dang im .

en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand ; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki kam babha ki paw shai kdar , bad wat ïa kito ki bym da paw shai ym lah ban buhrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki kam babha jong ki katto katne ki paw lypa ; bad kita ki bym lah ban buhrieh .

en: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters  ; and they became blood .
kha: U angel uba lai u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ki wah bad ha ki umpohliew , bad ki la kylla snam .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba lai u la theh ia ka um jong u ha ki wah bad ki pung um ; bad ki la kylla snam .

en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month  ; and my soul lothed them , and their soul also abhorred me .
kha: Ngam lah shah shuh ïa ki lai ngut kiwei pat ki nongaplangbrot , kiba la isih ïa nga , bad nga la beh noh ïa ki baroh hapoh shi bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Lai ngut ki nongaplangbrot ruh nga la ot noh ha ka shibnai ; bad ka mynsiem jong nga ka la sngewsih ia ki, bad ka mynsiem jong ki ruh ka la sngewsih ia nga .

en: Remember , I beseech thee , that thou hast made me as the clay  ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?
kha: Kynmaw ba me thaw ïa nga na ka dewbyrtha ; Hato men pynlwet pat ïa nga sha u pui pui ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw , nga kyrpad ia me , ba me la thaw ia nga kum ka dewbilat ; bad me wanrah biang ia nga sha ka dewbilat ?

en: Their drink is sour : they have committed whoredom continually : her rulers with shame do love , Give ye .
kha: Hadien ba ki la dih shibun ka waiñ , ki ïaleh sngewbha ha ki kam nuti jong ki , ki jied ïa ka jingjahburom ban ïa ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdih jong ki ka long kaba thiang: ki la leh be-ijot beit: ki nongsynshar jong ka da ka jingsngewlehrain ki ieit , Ai ia phi .

en: Whatsoever the  Lord  pleased , that did he in heaven , and in earth , in the seas , and all deep places .
kha: U leh ïa kat kaba u mon ha bneng bad ha pyrthei , ha ki duriaw bad ha ki jingjylliew bashapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba U Trai u la sngewbha, kata ka la long ha bneng bad ha khyndew, ha ki duriaw bad ha ki jaka ba jylliew baroh .

en: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest  ; it crieth out against me : therefore have I hated it .
kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga ki la phai pyrshah ïa nga ; kum u sing hapoh ka khlaw ki la kyrhuh ïa nga , bad kumta nga isih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng jong nga ka long ha nga kum u sing ha khlaw ; ka pyrta pyrshah ia nga: namarkata nga la shun ia ka .

en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
kha: U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka por kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .
translated_en_to_kha: U slap un ym tuid namar ka jingkhriat ; namarkata un kyrpad ia u da kaba ot, bad un ym don ei ei .

en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the  Lord  , at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth .
kha: Ki lum ki um noh kum ka bthing ha khmat U  Trai  , ha khmat U  Trai  jong ka khyndew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum ki la rkhiang kum ka wax ha khmat U Trai , ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .
kha: Ha shuwa ba un mih , u la khot ïa ki shiphew ngut ki shakri jong u bad u la ai ha ki kawei kawei ka sbai ksiar bad u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Khmih aïu phi lah ban kamai da kane katba nga dang leit jingleit .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ki shiphew ngut ki shakri jong u, bad u la aiti ia ki shiphew pound, bad u la ong ha ki , To iaid haduh ba ngan da wan .

en: There are , it may be , so many kinds of voices in the world , and none of them is without signification .
kha: Don shibun ki jait ktien kiba pher ha ka pyrthei , pynban ym don na ki , kiba khlem jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don , ka lah ban long , kumta bun jait ki sur ha ka pyrthei , bad ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba khlem jingmut .

en: After two days will he revive us : in the third day he will raise us up , and we shall live in his sight .
kha: Ha ki ar ne lai sngi un pynim ïa ngi , bad ngin ïoh im ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ar sngi un pynim biang ia ngi: ha ka sngi kaba lai un pynmih ia ngi , bad ngin im ha khmat jong u .

en: Six days ye shall gather it  ; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none .
kha: Hynriew sngi phin ïalum jingbam , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka sngi shongthait , yn ym don ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi phin lum ia ka ; hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kaba long ka Sabha , ha ka kan ym don shuh .

en: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , filled with wisdom : and the grace of God was upon him .
kha: U khynnah u la san bad u la nang khlaiñ ; u la dap da ka jingstad , bad ki jingkyrkhu U Blei ki la long halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah u la san bad u la nang khlain ha ka mynsiem, u la dap da ka jingstad: bad ka jingaiei U Blei ka la don halor jong u .

en: And your father hath deceived me , and changed my wages ten times  ; but God suffered him not to hurt me .
kha: Pynban i la shukor ïa nga bad pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong nga la shiphew sien . Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ba in pynmynsaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kpa jong phi u la shukor ia nga, bad u la pynkylla ia ka bainong jong nga shi sien ; hynrei U Blei u la shah ia u ban ym pynmong ia nga .

en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .
kha: Kin mynsaw bad kin ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u nongshah pyniap un hap ha ka ri jong ki Khaldian , bad kito kiba la shah pynkhih ha ki lynti jong ka .

en: So likewise ye , when ye see these things come to pass , know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ba ki jia , phin tip ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumjuh ruh phi haba phi iohi ia kine kiei kiei kiba jia , phi tip ba ka hima U Blei ka la jan .

en: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it : whithersoever it turneth , it prospereth .
kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba kaba pynbam sap ka treikam kum ka myntor ; ki ngeit ba ka lah ban leh lut ïa kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai ka long kum u maw ba kordor ha ki khmat jong uta uba don ia ka: katba ka kylla , ka roi .

en: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .
kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la leit bad pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong uta uba nyngkong bad nangta sa ïa ki jong uwei pat kiba la shah sahnarphna lem bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shipai ki la wan , bad ki la pynkhih ia ki kjat jong uba nyngkong bad jong uwei pat uba la sahnarphna bad u .

en: And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .
kha: Katba ki dang ïamih shabar , ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew na Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang mih shabar, ki la lap ia u briew uba na Cyrene, u Simon da ka kyrteng: ia u ki la pynbor ban kit ia ka diengphna jong u .

en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la wan ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong me uba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt , na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw .

en: Hearken not unto them  ; serve the king of Babylon , and live : wherefore should this city be laid waste ?
kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki ! Pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad phin im ! Balei ba kane ka nongbah kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngap ia ki ban shakri ia u syiem Babilon bad ban im: balei ba kane ka shnong kan shah pynjot ?

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have sold yourselves for nought  ; and ye shall be redeemed without money .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew ,  Mynba phi la long ki mraw , ym shym la siew pisa na ka bynta jong phi ; ha kajuh ka rukom yn ym siew ei ei ban pyllaitluid ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Phi la die ia lade na ka bynta ka ; bad phin sa shah siewspah khlem pisa .

en: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves , Who is this that forgiveth sins also ?
kha: Kiwei pat kiba ïashong bam ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki ,  Uei une , uba map wat ïa ki pop ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba shong ha ka doh bad u ki la sdang ban ong hapoh jong ki , Mano une uba map ia ki pop ruh ?

en: Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .
