kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum u Moses bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa . Ngam shym la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ki , hynrei ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga wan ban pynjot ia ka hukum , ne ia ki nongiathuhlypa : Ngam wan ban pynjot , hynrei ban pyndep .

en: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ , and make not provision for the flesh , to fulfil the lusts thereof .
kha: Hynrei to kieng ïa ki atiar jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , bad to sangeh na kaba pynleit jingmut sha ki jinglong jong ka pop kiba pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to buh ha U Trai Jisu Khrist , bad wat pynkhreh ia ka doh , ban pyndep ia ki jingkwah brai jong ka .

en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?
kha: Hynrei uta uba la lehbeiñ ïa uta uwei pat u la khynñiat sharud ïa u Moses . ‘ Mano ba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba la leh bakla ia u para marjan jong u u la pynkynriah noh ia u da kaba ong: Mano ba la pynlong ia me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?

en: Deliver me , O my God , out of the hand of the wicked , out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .
kha: A Blei jong nga , to pyllait im ïa nga na ki bymman , na ka bor jong kito kiba runar bad kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia nga ko Blei jong nga, na ka kti jong u bymman bad uba sniew .

en: For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh kiba leh kum kita kiei kiei bad kiba leh khlem hok ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;
kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap biang junom , bad hadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei une u briew hadien ba u la aiti ia kawei ka jingknia na ka bynta ki pop junom, u la shong ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei ; .

en: If I had not come and spoken unto them , they had not had sin : but now they have no cloak for their sin .
kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa la ka pop lada ngam shym la wan bad ngam shym la kren ha ki ; kumba ka long , kim don nia ei ei shuh na ka bynta la ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngam shym la wan bad kren ia ki , kim shym la don pop: hynrei mynta kim don jain na ka bynta ka pop jong ki .

en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them ,  Doth this offend you ?
kha: Khlem da don ba ïathuh , U Jisu u la tip ba ki ïakhñium shaphang kane , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Hato kane ka pynlong ïa phi ba phin kwah iehnoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la tip ha lade ba ki synran jong u ki la rkhie bein ia ka , u la ong ha ki , Hato kane ka pynsngewsih ia phi ?

en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation :
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh un rah khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh uba la shah pynsleh un wanrah ia ka snam masi sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng:

en: And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .
kha: Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ban ym ïohi shuh ïa kata kaba dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong kiba lui lui .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ia ka jingai: namar ka jingai ka pynmatlah ia kiba stad bad ka pynkylla ia ki ktien jong kiba hok .

en: And if ye have erred , and not observed all these commandments , which the  Lord  hath spoken unto Moses ,
kha: Hynrei lehse don uba kum bakla khlem da mut khnang ha kaba sumar ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi la bakla bad phim shym la sumar ia kine ki hukum baroh kiba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses .

en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .
kha: Kaei kaba phi la ïoh jingmyntoi na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la sngewlehrain mynta ? Ka jingmih jong kita kiei kiei ka long ka jingïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka soh kaba phi la don ha kita kiei kiei kiba phi sngewlehrain mynta ? namar ka jingkut jong kita kiei kiei ka long ka jingiap .

en: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .
kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kyntait ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei na ka bynta jong ki hi bad ki la kyntait ban shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi bad ki nongiasaid ain ki la kyntait ia ka jingai jingmut jong U Blei pyrshah ia lade , ym shym la pynbaptis ia u .

en: And Jacob said unto Joseph , God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan , and blessed me ,
kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la wan mihpaw ha nga ha Lus ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la kyrkhu ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha u Joseph , U Blei Uba donbor baroh u la paw ha nga ha Luz ha ka ri Kanaan bad u la kyrkhu ia nga .

en: Furthermore , when I came to Troas to preach Christ s gospel , and a door was opened unto me of the Lord ,
kha: Haba nga la poi ha Troas ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist , nga la shem ba U Trai u la lah plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka kam hangto .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh , haba nga la poi ha Troas ban ialap ia U Khrist s , bad la plie ia ka jingkhang ha nga jong U Trai .

en: Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :
kha: Sumar ban ym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to husiar , nga kyrpad ia me, bad wat dih ia ka wain ne ka jingdih kaba khlain bad wat bam ia kaei kaei kaba jakhlia:

en: And one went in , and told his lord , saying , Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel .
kha: Haba u Naaman u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u syiem bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba ka khynnah ka la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la rung shapoh bad u la iathuh ha u kynrad jong u, u da ong kumta bad kumta u la ong ka nongtrei kaba dei na ka ri Israel .

en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
kha: Ïa u jingthung baroh ïa uba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng um shym la thung , yn rat noh ,  la jubab U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong: Uwei pa uwei u jingthung uba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng um shym la thung , un sa mih tynrai .

en: And they turned and went up into the mountain , and came unto the valley of Eshcol , and searched it out .
kha: Kita ki la ïaleit sha kata ka ri lum haduh Them Eshkol bad ki la syntiat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai bad ki la leit sha u lum , bad ki la poi sha ka them Escol bad ki la wad ia ka .

en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall , called Praetorium  ; and they call together the whole band .
kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu shapoh sha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingshong u lat bad ki la khot lang ïa baroh ki shipai ba dang sah jong ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai ki la ialam noh ia u shapoh ka hall , la khot ia u Praetorium ; bad ki khot lang ia ka kynhun baroh kawei .

en: They mount up to the heaven , they go down again to the depths : their soul is melted because of trouble .
kha: Ki liengbah ki shah kynting sha suiñ bad ki ngam shapoh ki jingjylliew . Hapdeng kum kata ka jingma ki briew ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kiew sha bneng , ki hiar biang shapoh: ka mynsiem jong ki ka la tyrkhong namar ka jingjynjar .

en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
kha: Haba ka jingim u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat shisha ne em ba ki khun jong u kin kmen ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaei ka jingsngewbha kaba u don ha iing jong u hadien jong u , haba la ot noh ia ka jingbun ki bnai jong u hapdeng ?

en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .
kha: Uta uba pynïap ïa uno uno u jingri u dei ban buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynïap ïa la u parabriew u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba pyniap ia u mrad, un pynphai biang ia u: bad uta uba pyniap ia u briew , un shah pyniap .

en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them : but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them .
kha: Lada phi long kiba beit , la ïalam ïa phi da ka jinglonghok . Ïa ki briew kiba ym lah ban shaniah la pynjot da ka jingbymhok jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ba janai jong kiba hok kan ialam ia ki: hynrei ka jinglong ba jylliew jong ki nongleh kam sniew kan pynjot ia ki .

en: When the Philistines took the ark of God , they brought it into the house of Dagon , and set it by Dagon .
kha: nangta ki leit rah ïa ka sha ka templ u blei jong ki , u Dagon , bad ki buh ïa ka ha syndah u mot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki Philistia ki la shim ia ka synduk U Blei , ki la wanrah ia ka ha iing u Dagon bad ki la buh ia ka da u Dagon .

en: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol : and their brethren said unto them , What say ye ?
kha: Haba kita ki rangbah san ngut ki leit phai sha Sorah bad Eshtaol , ki para ri jong ki , ki kylli , kaei kaba ki la shem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan sha ki hynmen jong ki ha Sorah bad Eshool: bad ki hynmen jong ki ki la ong ha ki: Phi ong aiu ?

en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun , and for the precious things put forth by the moon ,
kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap da u soh uba ih kat kum ka aïom , Bad kaba dap kyrhai da ki soh kiba kynsai man la ka aïom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ki soh kiba kordor ba la pynmih da ka sngi , bad na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba kordor ba la buh da u bnai , .

en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .
kha: Ka jingshai ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung shapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka burom U Trai ka la wan shapoh iing da ka lynti jong ka khyrdop kaba ka jingkyrmen jong ka ka long shaphang mihngi .

en: And the voice spake unto him again the second time ,  What God hath cleansed , that call not thou common .
kha: Kata ka sur ka la kren biang ha u ,  Wat ñiew bymkhuid ïa kano kano kaba U Blei u la pynbna ba ka long kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur ka la kren biang ia u ha ka sien kaba ar , Kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhuid , ba wat khot ia me .

en: And they will salute thee , and give thee two loaves of bread  ; which thou shalt receive of their hands .
kha: Kin khublei ïa me bad tyrwa ïa me ar tylli ki kpu , ïa kiba me dei ban pdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ai khublei ia me , bad kin ai ar tylli ki kpu ; kiba me pdiang na ki kti jong ki .

en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven : the cankerworm spoileth , and flieth away .
kha: Pha pynmih bun ki nongkhaïi ban ïa ka jingbun ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng ! Hynrei mynta ki jah noh , kum ki puit kiba pyiar la ki thapniang bad ki her noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynbun ia ki nongkhaii jong me halor ki khlur bneng: ka jingsniew jong ka khniang bad ka her noh .

en: For though I be free from all men , yet have I made myself servant unto all , that I might gain the more .
kha: Nga long u briew uba laitluid , ym u mraw jongno jongno ; hynrei nga pynlong ïa lade u mraw jong baroh khnang ba ngan jop katba lah ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga lait na ki briew baroh, hynrei nga la pynlong ia lade u shakri ha baroh, ba ngan ioh kham bun .

en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him .
kha: Lada ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba bha , yn ñiewkor ïa phi , hynrei lada phi wad ïa ka jingjynjar , kata ka long kaei kaba phin ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba wad ia ka jingsngewbha kaba bha: hynrei uta uba wad ia ka jingsniew , kan wan ha u .

en: For the perfecting of the saints , for the work of the ministry , for the edifying of the body of Christ :
kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh na ka bynta ka kam jong ka jingshakri ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ban tei ïa ka met U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynjanai ia ki riewkhuid , na ka bynta ka kam jong ka jingshakri , na ka bynta ka jingtei ia ka met U Khrist:

en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahas u khun jong u Jotham u long u syiem ka Judah ha ka rta kaba arphew snem , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem khathynriew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Pekah u khun u Realiah Ahash u khun u Jotham u syiem Judah u la sdang ban synshar .

en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .
kha: Yn ym don ki ban hiarpateng ïa ki briew kiba khlem blei , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ïing ba la tei da ka jingbamsap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingiaseng jong ki nongleh arsap kan sa jah rngai noh , bad ka ding kan bam ia ki iing rit paid .

en: He taught me also , and said unto me , Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .
kha: I ju ong ,  Kynmaw bha ïa kaba nga ong bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano ruh . Leh kumba nga ong ïa phi , bad phin im .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hikai ia nga ruh , bad u la ong ha nga , To ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan bat ia ki ktien jong nga: to sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad to im .

en: ( Luke 1 :30-33 ) When Jesus was on earth , he proved that he would be a kind , just , and perfect Ruler .
kha: ( Loukas 1 :30-33 ) Mynba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , u la pynshisha ba un long u Nongsynshar uba sbun , uba hok bad uba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: (Lyukas 1 :30-33) Haba U Jisu u la don ha ka pyrthei, u la pynshisha ba un long u Nongsynshar uba sbun, uba hok bad uba janai .

en: I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .
kha: Ngam treh ban kyntait ïa ka jingaiei U Blei . Hynrei lada la pynksan ïa u briew ha U Blei da ka Hukum , ka mut ba U Khrist u la ïap lehnoh-ei!
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam pynsngewsih ia ka jingaiei U Blei: namar lada ka hok ka wan da ka hukum , te U Khrist u la iap lehnohei .

en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  They that are whole need not a physician  ; but they that are sick .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki , Kito kiba pang baroh kawei kim donkam ia u doktor ; hynrei kito kiba pang .

en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing  ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him .
kha: U syiem u lah ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon , kumta mihnoh na khmat jong u ; wat shong ha kaba kum kane ka jaka ba ma .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym kyrkieh ban mih na ka jingpeit jong u: wat ieng ha kaei kaei kaba sniew ; namar u leh ia kaei kaei kaba u sngewbha .

en: Now the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah , while he was shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,
kha: Katba ïa nga la dang set byndi ha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha Jeremaiah katba u dang sahkut ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok da kaba ong:

en: But when the fruit is brought forth , immediately he putteth in the sickle , because the harvest is come .
kha: Haba u kew u la ih , u briew u sdang ban ot ïa u da ka rashi , namar ka aïom ot ka la poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda la pynmih ia u soh , mardor u buh ha ka lyngkhot , namar u la wan u nongot .

en: And he said ,  Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God ? or with what comparison shall we compare it ?
kha: Kaei ngin ong , ka Hima U Blei ka long kaba kumno ?  U Jisu u kylli .  Ka pharshi kaba kumno ngin pyndonkam ban batai ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , shano ngin ianujor ia ka hima U Blei ? lane da ka jingianujor aiu ngin ianujor ia ka ?

en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold : and there was not one feeble person among their tribes .
kha: Nangta u pynmih bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel ; ki rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad baroh ki la long kiba koit kiba khiah bad kiba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ki ruh da ka rupa bad ka ksiar : bad ym don uwei ruh uba tlot hapdeng ki jaitbynriew jong ki .

en: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold ! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver !
kha: Ka kham bha — nang kham bha — ban don ka jingstad bad ka jingtip ban ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka kham bha ban ioh ia ka jingstad ban ia ka ksiar ! bad ban ioh ia ka jingsngewthuh ban ia kaba shah jied ban ia ka rupa !

en: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .
kha: U Judas tang mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai !  bad u la doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu wan u la leit beit sha u, bad u la ong, Ko kynrad, ko kynrad bad u la kdup ia u .

en: Thou shalt stand abroad , and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee .
kha: ap habar bad ieh un da wallam hi ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban ieng shabar ri , bad uta u briew uba me ai ram un wanrah ia ka jingkular shabar ri sha me .

en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against , ye ought to be quiet , and to do nothing rashly .
kha: Ym don ba lah ban len ïa kine kiei kiei . Kumta te , phi dei ban long jai jai bad ban ym leh ïa kaei kaei da ka jingthurmur .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi iohi ba ia kine kiei kiei ym lah ban kren pyrshah , phi dei ban sngap jar bad ban leh ei ei da kaba stet .

en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .
kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kaba yn ym klet shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingshah lehbein kaba neh ha phi , bad ka jingshah lehbein kaba neh slem , kaba ym klet .

en: Prove thy servants , I beseech thee , ten days  ; and let them give us pulse to eat , and water to drink .
kha: To tynjuh ïa ngi shiphew sngi ,  u la ong .  Ai ha ngi ki jhur ban bam bad ka um ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynshisha ia ki shakri jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, shi sngi; bad ai ba kin ai ia ngi ia ka um ban bam bad ka um ban dih .

en: And it came to pass , when Ahab saw Elijah , that Ahab said unto him , Art thou he that troubleth Israel ?
kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u , u ong ,  Me la wan — u nongthaw jingkulmar basniew tam ha Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Ahab u la iohi ia u Elijah, ba u Ahab u la ong ha u, Hato me uba pynkhuslai ia ki Israel ?

en: And came out of the graves after his resurrection , and went into the holy city , and appeared unto many .
kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ki jingtep bad hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la leit rung sha ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ha kaba shibun ki briew ki la ïohi ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih na ki jingtep hadien ka jingmihpat jong u, bad u la leit sha ka nongbah bakhuid bad u la paw ha kiba bun .

en: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing , and not only when I am present with you .
kha: Mynta , ka long kaba bha ban don kum kata ka jingsngewtynnat kaba khraw lada ka jingthmu ka long kaba bha — kane ka long kaba shisha borabor , bad ym dei tang haba nga don ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka long kaba bha ban shah ktah da ka jingsngewbha man ka por ha ka kam kaba bha , bad ym tang haba nga don ryngkat bad phi .

en: But , beloved , remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ  ;
kha: Hynrei to kynmaw , ko ki paralok jong nga , ïa kaei ba la ïathuh ha phi mynshuwa da ki apostol jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ko baieit , kynmaw ia ki ktien kiba la kren ha khmat ki apostol U Trai jong ngi;

en: For it increaseth . Thou huntest me as a fierce lion : and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me .
kha: Lada nga ïoh ïa kano kano ka jingjop , me beh kthong ïa nga kum u sing ; ban pynmynsaw ïa nga me leh wat da ki kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka nang kiew . Me leit khwai ia nga kum u sing uba shyrkhei: bad sa shisien me la pyni ia lade ha nga .

en: Only Luke is with me . Take Mark , and bring him with thee : for he is profitable to me for the ministry .
kha: Tang u Loukas u don bad nga . Leit wad ïa u Markos bad wan ïalam ïa u ryngkat bad me , namar u lah ban ïarap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang u Loukas u don bad nga . Shim ia u Mark, bad wanrah ia u ryngkat bad me: namar u long uba myntoi ia nga na ka bynta ka jingshakri .

en: And he returned unto him , and , lo , he stood by his burnt sacrifice , he , and all the princes of Moab .
kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la shem ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan phai sha u, bad, ha khmih, u la ieng hajan ka jingknia thang jong u, ma u bad ki syiem jong u Moab baroh .

en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard it , that he left off building of Ramah , and let his work cease .
kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u sangeh na kaba tei kut ïa ka Ramah bad iehnoh ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Baasha u la iohsngew ia kata, ba u la iehnoh ia ka jingtei ia ka Ramah bad u la iehnoh ia ka kam jong u .

en: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people , and praise him in the assembly of the elders .
kha: Ki dei ban pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ha ka jingïalang u paidbah bad ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingïalang ki nongïalam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin pynkhraw ia u ruh ha ka jingiaseng jong ki briew , bad kin iaroh ia u ha ka jingiaseng jong ki rangbah .

en: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
kha: to pyllait im ïa kiwei , da kaba knieh kynthet ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pat , to isynei da ka jingsheptieng , hynrei to da isih ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki hi , kiba la bit tngit da ki jingkwah brai bapop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki pynim da ka jingtieng, ki tan ia ki na ka ding ; ki shun wat ia ka jain ba la iohi da ka doh .

en: If a man die , shall he live again ? all the days of my appointed time will I wait , till my change come .
kha: Lada u briew u ïap noh , hato u lah mo ban im pat ? Hynrei ngan ap ïa ki aïom kiba kham bha , ban ap haduh ka por jong ka jingjynjar kan wai noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u iap , hato un im pat ? baroh ki sngi jong ka por ba la buh jong nga ngan ap , haduh ba ka jingkylla jong nga kan wan .

en: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;
kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyntang , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine tiar ki tar .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ki khun shynrang jong ka Merari , me dei ban khein ia ki katkum ki longiing jong ki, da ka iing ki kpa jong ki;

en: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .
kha: Shaphang mihngi , don hynriew ngut ki nongap phira man la ka sngi ; shaphang shatei , bad shaphang shathie , saw ngut saw ngut la buh na ka bynta ka kamra buh tiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang mihngi ki don hynriew ngut ki Lebi, shaphang shathie saw ngut ha ka shisngi, shaphang shathie saw ngut ha ka sngi, bad shaphang Asuppim ar ar arngut .

en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .
kha: Kumta , leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi : im kat kum ki hukum jong u bad kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban sumar ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong me, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u bad ban sheptieng ia u .

en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Wat shukor ïa la u para Israel , hynrei kohnguh ïa U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban pynshitom iwei ia iwei pat; hynrei me dei ban sheptieng ia U Blei jong me: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him , and saith of him ,  Behold an Israelite indeed , in whom is no guile !
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u Nathanael ba u wan sha u , u la ong shaphang jong u ,  Une u dei u kynja Israel uba shisha , ym don kano kano ka bymshisha ha u !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la iohi ia u Nathanael ba u wan sha u, bad u la ong na u, Ha khmih u Israel shisha, ha uba ym don ka jingkwah brai !

en: And after they had tarried there a space , they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles .
kha: Hadien ba ki la pynlut katto katne por hangta , la phah noh ïa ki ha kaba suk da ki parabangeit bad ki la leit phai pat sha kito kiba la phah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba ki la sah hangta ka jaka , la pyllait noh ia ki da kaba suk na ki para sha ki apostol .

en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .
kha: Naduh mynta ïa ka longïing kaba don san ngut yn phiah , ki lai ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bad ki ar ngut pyrshah ïa ki lai ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar naduh mynta kin don san ngut ha kawei ka iing ba la phiah, lai ngut pyrshah arngut bad arngut pyrshah lai ngut .

en: But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .
kha: Wat la u Asa um shym la pynjot lut ïa ki jaka mane blei thala baroh , u ïaineh ha U  Trai  katba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la jah noh: wat la katta ruh ka dohnud jong u Asa ka la long kaba janai bad U Trai baroh ki sngi jong u .

en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them  ; then he shall bear her iniquity .
kha: Hynrei lada u pyndam ïa kata hadien , un hap ban shah ïa ki jingpynshitom na ka jingbymlah ban pyndep ïa ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u pynlong ia ki ban long kiba khlem akor hadien ba u la iohsngew ia ki ; te un kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka .

en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .
kha: Ka jingim jong me kan kham phyrnai ban ïa ka jingshai ka sngi ha ka por shiteng sngi , bad ki kynta ba-dum tam jong ka jingim kin phyrnai kum ka step phyrngab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rta jong me kan kham shai ban ia ka por mynstep; me phin shai shai bha, me phin long kum ka step .

en: And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .
kha: Ka kmie jong u ka jubab ,  To ai ba kano kano ka jingtim kan hap halor jong nga ; ko khun jong nga , shu leh kumba nga ong ; bad khie leit bad wanrah ïa ki blang sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong ha u, Ha nga to long ka jingtim jong me, ko khun jong nga: tang to kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga, bad leit shim ia nga .

en: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
kha: U la leit lyngba ka shnong ha kaba la ïashem ïa u da ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung ha kawei ka shnong, u la iakynduh ia u shiphew ngut ki briew kiba la shah ktah ha ka sniehdoh, kiba ieng jngai:

en: And Moses said , Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the  Lord  ? but it shall not prosper .
kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Te balei phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynta ? Phin ym jop !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Balei mynta phi pynkhein ia ka hukum U Trai ? hynrei kan ym jop .

en: And she arose , and went away , and laid by her veil from her , and put on the garments of her widowhood .
kha: Ka Tamar ka la leit phai pat sha la ïing , ka law noh ïa ka jingkah khmat , bad ka phong biang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ieng bad ka la leit noh, bad ka la buh da ka jingtap jong ka na ka , bad ka la phong da ki jain jong ka jinglong riewkynthei jong ka .

en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver , and the gain thereof than fine gold .
kha: Ka don shibun ka jingmyntoi ha ka , ban ïa kaba don ha ka rupa ; ka kham shongdor shibun ha phi ban ïa ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki mar jong ka ki kham bha ban ia ki mar rupa , bad ka jingmyntoi jong ka ban ia ka ksiar kaba bha .

en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;
kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban pyntngit ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym pynjah burom ia kiei kiei kiba kyntang jong ki khun Israel kiba ki ai ha U Trai ; .

en: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,
kha: U la shong hangta bad u la pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u Paul . U Paul u la ïohi ba u la ngeit bad ba u lah ban ïohkhiah , kumta u la khmih shlip sha u bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,
translated_en_to_kha: U juh u la iohsngew ia u Paul ba u kren: uba la iohi ia u da kaba sngap jar bad u la sngewthuh ba u don ka jingngeit ban shah pynkoit .

en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia : and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king .
kha: U  langsohmoh u ïeng na ka bynta ka hima Gris , bad ka reng kaba paw bha hapdeng ki khmat jong u ka dei u syiem banyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u blang uba jem u long u syiem jong ka ri Greece : bad ka horn kaba khraw kaba don hapdeng ki khmat jong u ka long u syiem uba nyngkong .

en: And the flocks conceived before the rods , and brought forth cattle ringstraked , speckled , and spotted .
kha: Kumta haba kita ki langbrot ki la seng khun ha khmat kita ki tnat dieng , ki kha ki khunlangbrot kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynhun ki la kha khun ha khmat ki rod , bad ki la pynmih ia ki masi kiba la tyrkhong , kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong .

en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin .
kha: Ïathuh ruh ha ki Israel ba uno uno uba tim ïa U Blei un kit hi ïa la ka pop , bad un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Uno uno uba tim ia U Blei jong u un kit ia ka pop jong u .

en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment , nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous .
kha: Ïa ki nongpop yn pynrem da U Blei bad yn pynïakhlad ïa ki na ki briew ki jong U Blei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki bym don Blei kin ym ieng ha ka jingbishar , lymne ki nongpop ha ka jingiaseng jong kiba hok .

en: Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .
kha: Te ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Templ bad ka ïaid shaphang ka jaka kaba halor kita ki jingthaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka burom U Trai ka la mih noh na ka jingkhang jong ka iing , bad ka la ieng halor ki cherubim .

en: That thine alms may be in secret : and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly .
kha: Te kan long ka kam kaba rieh . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki soh jong me kin long ha kaba rieh: bad U Kpa jong me uba iohi ha kaba rieh hi un siew kylliang ia me ha kaba paw .

en: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth , and to Naarath , and came to Jericho , and went out at Jordan .
kha: Nangta u hiar arsut na Janoah sha Ataroth bad Naarah , u poi haduh ka Jerikho bad kut ha ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la hiar na Janoah sha Ataroth, bad sha Jaroath, bad ka la poi ha Jerikoh bad ka la leit sha Jordan .

en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .
kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long ha kaba bam bad kaba dih , hynrei ka long ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingkmen kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hima U Blei kam dei ka doh bad ka jingdih ; hynrei ka hok bad ka jingsuk bad ka jingkmen ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And the Lord said ,  Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?
kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Mynta bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk ? Ki long kiba kumno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Te ngan ianujor ia ki briew jong kane ka pateng ? bad ki long kumno ?

en: Moab is confounded  ; for it is broken down : howl and cry  ; tell ye it in Arnon , that Moab is spoiled ,
kha: ‘ Ka Moab ka la kyllon ,’ kin jubab , ‘ ïam na ka bynta jong ka ; la pynjahburom ïa ka . Pynbna ha lynter ka wah Arnon ba ïa ka Moab la pynjot !’
translated_en_to_kha: U Moab u la sngewsih ; namar u la shah pynpra: u la iam bad u la iam ; phi iathuh ia ka ha Arnon , ba u Moab u la shah pynjot , .

en: ( John 14 :28 ) The holy spirit is not a person  ; it is God’s active force .—Genesis 1 :2  ; Acts 2 :18 .
kha: ( Ioannis 14 :28 ) U mynsiem bakhuid um dei u jingthaw ka dei ka bor jong U Blei .—Jenesis 1 :2 ; Kam 2 :18 .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Ioannis 14 :28 ) U mynsiem bakhuid um dei u briew ; ka dei ka bor ba trei shitom jong U Blei .

en: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak , Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai , the children of Anak .
kha: U Kaleb u beh krad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Anak na ka nongbah — ki kur Sheshai , Ahiman , bad Talmai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Caleb u la beh noh ia ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Anaak, u Shisai, bad u Ahiman, bad u Talmai, ki khun shynrang jong u Anaak .

en: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death , and have crucified him .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongsynshar jong ngi ki la aiti noh ïa u ban rai pynïap , bad ïa u la sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumno ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongsynshar jong ngi ki la pynpoi ia u ban shah pynrem haduh ka jingiap , bad ki la sahnarphna ia u .

en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
kha: kham palat ban ïa u briew u bym ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snem . Nalorkata , baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, wat la u im shihajar snem arsien la iathuh ia u, hynrei um shym la iohi ei ei: hato baroh kim leit sha kawei ka jaka ?

en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
kha: Wat klet ïa kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ha phi ! Yn sa aiti noh ïa U Khun U Briew ha ka bor jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kine ki ktien kin rung shapoh ki shkor jong phi: namar ia u Khun u briew yn aiti ha ki kti jong ki briew .

en: And I will wait upon the  Lord  , that hideth his face from the house of Jacob , and I will look for him .
kha: U  Trai  u la buhrieh ïa lade na ki briew jong u , hynrei nga shaniah ha u bad buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ap ia U Trai uba buhrieh ia ka khmat jong u na ka iing u Jakob bad ngan wad ia u .

en: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :
kha: Ngam ong ba ka kular jong U Blei kam shym la treikam ; namar ym baroh ki paid Israel ki long ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym kumba ka ktien U Blei kam shym la treikam ei ei . Namar kim dei ki Israel baroh kiba long na Israel:

en: And it came to pass on the eighth day , that Moses called Aaron and his sons , and the elders of Israel  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi hadien ba la pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang , u Moses u khot ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u Moses u la khot ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki rangbah Israel;

en: But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .
kha: Hynrei ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh ; nangta ha ka jingwan jong u , sa ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei ha la ka jong ka rukom: U Khrist u la mih shuwa; hadien kata kita kiba long U Khrist ki long ha ka jingwan jong u .

en: And Jehoshaphat feared , and set himself to seek the  Lord  , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u la sheptieng bad duwai ha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïalam . Hadien kata u ai hukum ban pynlong ka jingshah jingit ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la tieng, bad u la buh ia lade ban wad ia U Trai, bad u la pynbna ia ka jingstet ha ka Judah baroh kawei .

en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house , and to be a joyful mother of children . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: U pyndonburom ïa ka tnga ka bym don khun ha ka ïingshong jong ka ; u pynkmen ïa ka da kaba ai ki khun ha ka . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ka kynthei kaba khlem kha khun ban ri iing , bad ban long ka kmie kaba kmen jong ki khun . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .
kha: Katba u dang duwai , ka durkhmat jong u ka la kylla dur , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla lieh phyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang duwai, la pynkylla ia ka rukom jong ka khmat jong u, bad ka jainkup jong u ka la lieh bad ka la rben .

en: I pray for them : I pray not for the world , but for them which thou hast given me  ; for they are thine .
kha: Nga duwai na ka bynta jong ki . Ngam duwai na ka bynta ka pyrthei hynrei na ka bynta kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga , namar ki long ki jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga duwai na ka bynta jong ki: Ngam duwai na ka bynta ka pyrthei , hynrei na ka bynta kito kiba me la ai ha nga ; namar ki long ki jong me .

en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .
kha: U la kwah ban pynkdang ïa lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei ym don mano mano ba ai ei ei ïa u ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la dei ban pyndap ia ka kpoh jong u da ki bniat kiba u sniang u la bam: bad ym don mano mano ruh ba la ai ha u .

en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;
kha: Na kiba kum kita ki jingma bashyrkhei jong ka jingïap u la pynim ïa ngi , bad un pynim ïa ngi ; bad ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha u ba un pynim biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyngba ki jingduwai lem jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la pyllait im ia ngi na ka jingiap kaba khraw kumne, bad u la pynpoi: ha uba ngi shaniah ba un dang pynpoi ia ngi ; .

en: Behold , we put bits in the horses  mouths , that they may obey us  ; and we turn about their whole body .
kha: Ngi pyndait lakam ha ka shyntur jong u kulai lada ngi kwah ba un kohnguh ïa ngi , bad kumta ngi lah ban pynïaid ïa u kat shaba ngi mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngi buh ia ki bit ha ki shyntur kulai , ba kin kohnguh ia ngi bad ngi phai kylleng ka met jong ki baroh kawei .

en: Their young ones are in good liking , they grow up with corn  ; they go forth , and return not unto them .
kha: Ha khlaw ki khun rit jong ki , ki san ha ka jingkhlaiñ ; ki leit noh bad kim wan phai shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ki ki long kiba sngewtynnad bha, ki san bad u kew ; ki leit sha khmat , bad kim ju wan phai sha ki .

en: And in the cutting of stones , to set them , and in carving of wood , to make any manner of cunning work .
kha: ban ot ïa ki mawlynnai bad ban pyndait ïa ki ; ban oh-shrong ïa ki dieng ; bad ban trei ïa kano kano ka jingthaw dur kaba pynitynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba ot ia ki maw, ban buh ia ki, bad ha kaba ker dieng, ban leh ia kano kano ka rukom treikam kaba rit .

en: Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .
kha: Phi dih ïa ka dud , phi kup ki jaiñ ba la thain na u  saiwul , phi pynïap bad bam na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynrei phim ju sumar bha ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi bam ia ka shini, bad phi phong ia phi da ka snieh langbrot: hynrei phim ai bam ia ka kynhun .

en: For this my son was dead , and is alive again  ; he was lost , and is found . And they began to be merry .
kha: Naba une u khun jong nga u la ïap , hynrei mynta u la im pat ; u la jah noh , hynrei mynta la shem pat ïa u .’ Bad kumta ka jingkhawai ka la sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane u khun jong nga u la iap, bad u dang im shuh shuh; bad la lap ia u . Bad ki la sdang ban sngewbha .

en: I saw a dream which made me afraid , and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me .
kha: Hynrei nga la ïoh ka jingphohsniew kaba pynsheptieng bad nga la ïohi ki jingïohipaw kiba shyrkhei mynba nga dang ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew kaba la pyntieng ia nga, bad ki jingpyrkhat ha ka jingthiah jong nga bad ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong nga ki la pynkhuslai ia nga .

en: And he said unto them ,  I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also : for therefore am I sent .
kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki ,  Nga dei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei ha kiwei pat ki shnong ruh , namar kata ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la phah ïa nga ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga dei ban ialap ia ka hima U Blei sha kiwei pat ki nongbah ruh: namar namar kata la phah ia nga .

en: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .
kha: Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob lem bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawan ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka  nemsniew ha ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la wan thied ia u kew napdeng kito kiba wan: namar ka jingkyrduh ka la don ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :
kha: ( Ym ju don uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka met . Pynban , u bsa bad sumar ïa ka , kumba U Khrist ruh u leh ïa ka balang ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don briew uba la shun ia la ka jong ka doh ; hynrei u ai bam bad u sumar ia ka, kumba U Trai ka balang:

en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
kha: Lada u briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u dei ban ai ïa ka tnga banyngkong jong u katjuh ka bam bad ka jaiñkup jaiñsem , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kumba ka ju ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u shim ia u kawei pat ka tnga jong ka, ka jainkup jong ka bad ka kamram shongkurim jong ka, un ym duna .

en: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .
kha: Ha ka rmiang ba sha trai jong ka , buh ïa ki dur soh Pomkranet ba la shna da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad hapdeng hapdeng suh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bell ksiar bad ka rong ksiar, ka rong ksiar bad ka rong ksiar, halor ka tduh jong ka rob sawdong .

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel  ;
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga kular ba borabor yn don u nonghiarpateng na u Dabid ban long u syiem ki Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai ; U Dabid un ym kwah satia ia u briew ban shong ha ka khet jong ka iing Israel ; .

en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Bad balei ba phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Blei bad phi bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Balei phi ruh phi pynkhein ia ka hukum U Blei da ka dustur jong phi ?

en: A time to be born , and a time to die  ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted  ;
kha: U buh ka por ban kha bad ka por ban ïap , ka por ban thung bad ka por ban rat noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban kha , bad ka por ban iap ; ka por ban thung , bad ka por ban lum ia kata kaba la thung ; .

en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers  skins above that .
kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki jingtap , kawei kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , ban long kum ka jingtap nalor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka jingtap na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ jong ki blang ba la rong saw, bad ka jingtap jong ki sniehdoh kiba la rong saw halor kata .

en: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .
kha: U Isaak u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , bad ha kata ka snem u ïoh ot shispah shah ïa kaba u la bet , namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Isaak u la bet ha kata ka ri , bad u la ioh ha kajuh ka snem shispah: bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia u .

en: The land shall not be sold for ever : for the land is mine  ; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me .
kha: Phim dei ban die duh ïa ka khyndew , namar phim long trai ïa ka ; ka long ka jong U Blei , bad phi long kum ki nongwei ïa kiba la shah ban pyndonkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri kan ym die junom: namar ka ri ka long ka jong nga ; namar phi long ki nongwei bad ki nongwei bad nga .

en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar : they kept his testimonies , and the ordinance that he gave them .
kha: U la kren ha ki na u rishot lyoh ; ki kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba u la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ha ki ha u lum ba dum: ki la buh ia ki jingphla jong u, bad ka hukum kaba u la ai ha ki .

en: He , that being often reproved hardeneth his neck , shall suddenly be destroyed , and that without remedy .
kha: Lada phi ïai mutlop man la ka por ba phi shah pynbeit , ha kawei ka sngi phin sa shah pynlwet bad phin ym lah khie shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U , uba la shah pynrem bunsien u pynkhlain ia ka ryndang jong u , un sa shah pynjot kynsan , bad kata khlem dawai .

en: But he shall say , I am no prophet , I am an husbandman  ; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth .
kha: Pynban , un ong , ‘ Ngam dei u nongïathuhlypa . Nga long u nongrep — nga la rep ha ka khyndew baroh shi rta ka jingim jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un ong , Ngam long u nongiathuhlypa, nga long u nongrep ; namar u briew u la hikai ia nga ban ri masi naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: Then said Jonathan , Behold , we will pass over unto these men , and we will discover ourselves unto them .
kha: To ,  u Jonathan u ong .  Ngin leit shatai sha shiliang bad shah ïa ki Philistia ban ïohi ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jonathan u la ong: Ha khmih ngin iaid sha kine ki briew bad ngin sa lap ia lade ha ki .

en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword , and smote a servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .
kha: Hynrei uwei na kita kiba ïa-ïeng hangta u la sei ïa ka waitlam bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ïoh mait ïa ka shkor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki uba ieng hajan u la ring ia ka waitlam bad u la shoh ia u shakri jong u rangbah lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ia ka shkor jong u .

en: For I long to see you , that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift , to the end ye may be established ;
kha: Naba nga kwah haduh katta katta ban ïohi ïa phi , khnang ban ïasam ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem bad phi bad ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kwah eh ban iohi ia phi , ba ngan ai ha phi katto katne ka jingai ba kynja mynsiem , haduh kaba kut phi lah ban long kiba skhem ; .

en: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah ki la shetkylla la biang ïa nga , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka iing Israel bad ka iing Judah ki la leh bein shibun ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: And shall not God avenge his own elect , which cry day and night unto him , though he bear long with them ?
kha: Mynta , hato U Blei un ym bishar ha ka liang jong ki briew jong u kiba kyang sha u mynsngi bad mynmiet ban ïoh jingïarap ? Hato un long uba suki ban ïarap ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato U Blei un ym pynrem ia la ka jong ka jingjied , kaba iam miet bad sngi ha u , wat la u shah slem bad ki ?

en: And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .
kha: U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka por ha kaba u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la shim ia u bad u la wanrah ia u sha la ka kmie , u la shong ha ki kjat jong ka haduh shiteng sngi , bad nangta u la iap .

en: For ye are bought with a price : therefore glorify God in your body , and in your spirit , which are Gods .
kha: Phim long la u jong hi hynrei jong U Blei ; u la thied ïa phi da ka dor . Kumta to pyndonkam ïa ki met jong phi na ka bynta ka burom jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thied ia phi da ka dor: namarkata to pyndonburom ia U Blei ha ka met jong phi bad ha ka mynsiem jong phi kiba long ki Blei .

en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor print any marks upon you : I am the  Lord .
kha: lane pruid dak ha la ka met lane pynmong ïa la ka doh ban ïambriew ïa kiba ïap . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban shna ia ki jingbam ha ka doh jong phi na ka bynta kiba iap: Nga long U Trai .

en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city , both man and beast : they shall die of a great pestilence .
kha: Ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ha kane ka nongbah ; ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ; kin ïap da ka khlam kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shoh ia ki nongshong shnong jong kane ka shnong, u briew bad u mrad: kin iap na ka jingpang kaba khraw .

en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers , and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah .
kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u khot shapoh ïa u rangbah ka ïingsyiem bad ong ïa u ban leit bad wallam shisyndon ïa u Mikaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la khot ia uwei na ki rangbah jong u bad u la ong: Pynbeit kloi ia u Micaiah u khun jong u Imlah .

en: The  Lord  taketh my part with them that help me : therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me .
kha: U dei U  Trai  uba ïarap ïa nga ; bad ngan ïohi ba ki nongshun jong nga ki shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u shim ia ka bynta jong nga bad kito kiba iarap ia nga: namarkata ngan iohi ia ka jingkwah jong nga halor jong ki kiba shun ia nga .

en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law , that he rent his clothes .
kha: Haba u syiem u ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka Kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsheptieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka Kitab ka Hukum , ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u .

en: Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it  ; for their wickedness is come up before me .
kha: U ong ,  Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah kaba khraw , bad to kren pyrshah ïa ka ; nga tip haduh katno kiba bymman ki briew jong ka ki long .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , leit sha Nineveh, kata ka nongbah kaba khraw, bad to iam pyrshah ia ka ; namar ka jingsniew jong ki ka wan shaneng ha khmat jong nga .

en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
kha: U Dabid u kurup ïa ki ryntieh ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah synshar jong u Hadadeser bad u rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim ia ki shipai ksiar kiba don ha ki shakri jong u Hadareer bad u la wanrah ia ki sha Jerusalem .

en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .
kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U  Trai  kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka khyndew kan dap da ka jingtip ia ka burom U Trai , kumba ki um ki tap ia ka duriaw .

en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps , and finished them in the seventh month .
kha: Ki jingai ki sdang ban poi ha u bnai uba lai bad ki ïai kynton ha ki saw bnai kiba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew kaba lai ki la sdang ban buh ia ka nongrim jong ki lum , bad ki la pyndep ia ki ha ka taiew kaba hynriew .

en: If his children be multiplied , it is for the sword : and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread .
kha: Ki lah ban don shibun ki khun shynrang , hynrei baroh kin sa ïap ha ka thma ; ki khun jong ki kin ym ïoh ka jingbam kaba biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki khun jong u ki nang bun, ka long na ka bynta ka waitlam: bad ki khun jong u kin ym sngewhun ia u kpu .

en: And they came near to the steward of Joseph s house , and they communed with him at the door of the house ,
kha: Kumta ha ka jingkhang jong kata ka ïing , ki ong ha uta u shakri rangbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan hajan u nongap iing u Joseph bad ki la iakynduh bad u ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing .

en: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .
kha: Kim don khun namar ba ka Elisabeth kam shym lah ban ïoh wat iwei ruh , bad ma ka lem bad u Sekharaïah ki la tymmen bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim don khun, namar kata ka Elisabeth ka la long kaba khlem khun, bad baroh arngut mynta ki la shah pynmong bha ha ki snem .

en: When men are cast down , then thou shalt say , There is lifting up  ; and he shall save the humble person .
kha: U Blei u pynhiar ïa kiba sarong bad u pyllait im ïa uba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew ki shah pynhap , te me dei ban ong , Ka don ka jingkiew ; bad un pynim ia u briew uba pynrit mynsiem .

en: For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron s rod swallowed up their rods .
kha: Ki la bret ïa la ki diengduh , bad kita ki kylla bseiñ . Hynrei u diengduh jong u Aaron u la nguid ïa ki diengduh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynhap ia uwei pa uwei u diengduh jong u, bad ki la kylla long ki bsein: hynrei u Aaron u la bam ia ki diengduh jong ki .

en: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance .
kha: Ngan leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong nga , nangta , ban thaw ka lad na ka bynta jong phi ban kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei ha ki por baroh hadien ka jingïap jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan pyrshang ba phin lah hadien ka jingkhlad noh jong nga ban don ia kine kiei kiei man ka por ha ka jingkynmaw .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Martha , Martha , thou art careful and troubled about many things :
kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa ka ,  Martha , Martha ! Pha la khuslai bad pha la sngew jynjar halor bun kiei kiei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka, Martha, Martha, me husiar bad me khuslai shaphang kiei kiei kiba bun:

en: But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
kha: Hynrei haba ka ïa kaba biang ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ïa la U Khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka jingdap jong ka por ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ia la u Khun , ba la thaw na ka kynthei , ba la thaw hapoh ka hukum .

en: He blesseth them also , so that they are multiplied greatly  ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .
kha: U kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki don bun ki khun ki kti ; u pynlong ba ki jingri jingdup jong ki kin ym duna .
translated_en_to_kha: U kyrkhu ia ki ruh , haduh ba kin da nang bun shuh shuh bad um shah ia ki masi jong ki ban nang duna .

en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment  ;
kha: Lada don ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup la ka jaiñ  saiwul ne ka jaiñ linen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jain ruh ba ka khlam sniehdoh ka don ha ka , la ka long ka jain kaba la tyrkhong , ne ka jain lin;

en: The burden of the valley of vision . What aileth thee now , that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops ?
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Them ka Jingïohipaw . Kaei kaba jia ? Balei ki briew baroh jong ka nongbah ki rakhe lehkmen halor ki tnum ïing ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ka them jong ka jingphohsniew . Kaei kaba phi la leit noh mynta , ba me la leit sha ki iing ?

en: And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .
kha: Bad halor kata ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka bor jong ki nongsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad na ki bor synshar ; u la pynlong ka jingthadrong ïa ki da kaba ïalam ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ka jingïaid paidbah kaba jop jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pynsniew ia ki hima bad ki bor synshar, u la pynlong ia ka jingpyni ia ki ha kaba paw, da kaba jop ia ki ha ka .

en: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils , and fire out of his mouth devoured : coals were kindled by it .
kha: Ka tdem ka mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , bad ka ding ba bam duh bad ki rnga kiba rhem na ka shyntur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kiew ka tdem na ki bniat jong u, bad ka ding na ka shyntur jong u ka la bam: ki dewiong ki la shah thang da ka .

en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ki briew kin iaroh ia U Trai na ka bynta ka jingbha jong u , bad na ka bynta ki kam ba phylla jong u ia ki khun bynriew !

en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever  ; and thou ,  Lord  , becamest their God .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel ki briew jong me junom , bad me , ko  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew jong me ki Israel me la pynlong ia la ka jong ka briew junom bad me, ko Trai, me long U Blei jong ki .

en: But go thou thy way till the end be : for thou shalt rest , and stand in thy lot at the end of the days .
kha: Bad ma me , ko Daniel , to ïaineh haduh kaba kut . Nangta men sa ïap , hynrei men mihpat ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong ha kaba kut jong ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to leit noh ia la ka lynti haduh kaba kut: namar me shongthait bad ieng ha ka bhah jong me ha kaba kut jong ki sngi .

en: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house . And the child did minister unto the  Lord  before Eli the priest .
kha: Nangta u Elkanah u leit phai sha la ïing ha Ramah , hynrei u khynnah Samuel u sah ha Shiloh bad u shakri ïa U  Trai  ha ka jingïalam u Eli u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elkanah u la leit sha Ramah sha iing jong u . Bad uta u khynnah u la shakri ia U Trai ha khmat u Eli u lyngdoh .

en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .
kha: Phan long kum ka pansngiat kaba itynnat ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men long ka khlieh jong ka burom ha ka kti U Trai bad ka khlieh syiem ha ka kti U Blei jong me .

en: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?
kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor katta katta ; ym don u briew uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U long uba stad ha ka dohnud bad uba donbor ha ka bor: uba la pynkhlain ia lade pyrshah ia u , bad uba la roi ?

en: There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .
kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei ha ka ri jong phi kaba hap khun lane kaba lyngki . Ngan pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ei ei kaba bret ia ki khun jong ki, ne kaba khlem kha khun ha ka ri jong me: ka jingbun ki sngi jong me ngan pyndep .

en: Both angels and men will have demonstrated loyal love for their Creator and God . Revelation , chapter 20 .
kha: Baroh ar ki angel bad ki briew kin sa pyni ia ka jingieit kaba iaineh ia la u Nongthaw bad ia U Blei . Jingpynpaw , lynnong 20 .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh arngut ki angel bad ki briew kin sa pyni ia ka jingieit kaba iaineh ia u Nongthaw bad U Blei jong ki . Jingpynpaw , lynnong 20 .

en: Then said the princes unto Baruch , Go , hide thee , thou and Jeremiah  ; and let no man know where ye be .
kha: Te ki la ong ha u ,  Ma me bad u Jeremaïah phi dei ban leit noh bad ban rieh . Wat ai ïano ïano ban tip hangno phi ïadon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah ki la ong ha u Baruk, To leit buhrieh ia me, ma me bad u Jeremaiah ; bad wat ai ba uno uno un tip shano phi don .

en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the  Lord  is in this place  ; and I knew it not .
kha: U Jakob u la kyndit thiah , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don hangne ! U don ha kane ka jaka , bad ngam shym tip ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la kyndit na ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la ong: Hooid U Trai u don ha kane ka jaka ; bad ngam tip ia kata .

en: Dilli Haat is situated just outside the metro station , which hosts various cultural fests and programmes .
kha: Ka Dilli Haat ka don tang shabar jong ka steshon metro , kaba pynlong ia ki tamasa bad ki prokram bapher bapher jong ka kolshor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Dilli Haat ka don tang shabar jong ka steshon metro , kaba pynlong ia ki jingbam bad ki prokram bapher bapher .

en: And the children of Israel set forward , and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho .
kha: Ki Israel ki la nang ïaid bad ki sher dara ha ki pyntha jong ka Moab sha mihngi jong ka Jordan bad marpyrshah ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit sha khmat , bad ki la iaid ha ki madan Moab ha kane ka liang Jordan da u Jerikho .

en: For this cause the king was angry and very furious , and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon .
kha: Ha kata , u syiem u la bitar shla bad u la hukum ban pynïap khoit ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem ha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka daw u syiem u la bitar bad u la bitar shibun , bad u la hukum ban pynjot ia ki riewstad baroh jong ka Babilon .

en: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot , speaking evil of you :
kha: Bad mynta ki bymngeit ki sngewkyndit haba phim ïasoh lang bad ki ha kajuh ka jingim bymngeit bad bymsalia , bad kumta ki krenbeiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki pyrkhat phylla ba phim iaid bad ki haduh kajuh ka jingkulmar kaba palat ia phi:

en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
kha: U Dabid u la kurup ïa ki stieh ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah synshar jong u Hadadeser bad u la rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim ia ki shipai ksiar kiba don ha ki shakri jong u Hadadezer bad u la wanrah ia ki sha Jerusalem .

en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount .
kha: Pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ kat kum ka dur ba nga la pyn-i ha me halor u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynkhih ia ka ïingjaiñ katkum ka rukom jong ka kaba la pyni ha me ha ka lum .

en: And herein do I exercise myself , to have always a conscience void of offence toward God , and toward men .
kha: Bad kumta nga ïaleh katba lah ban ïoh ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid kdar ha khmat jong U Blei bad ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne nga leh ia lade, ban don beit ka jingsngewthuh kaba khlem jingmut sha U Blei bad sha ki briew .

en: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;
kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab ,  Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi don uwei uba ïeng uba phim ithuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Nga pynbaptis da ka um: hynrei don uwei uba ieng hapdeng jong phi, uba phim ithuh ; .

en: Now when the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man .
kha: U rangbah shipai u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Da shisha u la long u briew uba bha !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u rangbah u la iohi ia kaei kaba la leh , u la pyndonburom ia U Blei da kaba ong: Hooid une u la long u briew uba hok .

en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
kha: bad ki la tim ïa U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jong ki . Hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ki lynti basniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren bein ia U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki jingpang jong ki , bad um shym la kylla bamut na ki kam jong ki .

en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
kha: U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bakhraw ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Adonijah u la tieng namar u Solomon, bad u la ieng bad u la leit noh bad u la bat ia ki bniat jong ka almari .

en: And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;
kha: phi tip kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh , bad phi ïoh jinghikai na ka Hukum ban jied ïa kaei kaba dei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to tip ia ka mon jong u, bad to mynjur ia kiei kiei kiba kham bha, la hikai na ka hukum ; .

en: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword : and these cities shall go into captivity .
kha: Ki samla shynrang jong ki nongbah ka Heliopolis bad Bubastis kin ïap ha ka thma , bad kiwei ki briew kin shah rah kum ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla Aven bad ki nong Pibebe kin hap da ka waitlam : bad kine ki nongbah kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .
kha: Lada phi ïaineh ha nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki ïaineh ha phi , te phin pan ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi kohnguh ia nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki kohnguh ia phi , phin kylli ia kaei kaba phi mon bad kan long ha phi .

en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
kha: Namar ngi ïohsngew ba don katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jong phi kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym trei ei ei lait tang ban lushia ha ka kam jong kiwei pat ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi iohsngew ba don katto katne kiba iaid hapdeng jong phi khlem da pyrkhat satia, hynrei ki long kiba bunkam .

en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king , which would take account of his servants .
kha: namar ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Shisien la don u Syiem uba la kut jingmut ban jurip ïa ki jingkheiñ jingdiah jong u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka hima bneng ka ianujor bad uwei u syiem , u ban shim ia ka jingkhein ia ki shakri jong u .

en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ki briew kin iaroh ia U Trai na ka bynta ka jingbha jong u , bad na ka bynta ki kam ba phylla jong u ia ki khun bynriew !

en: And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?
kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ?  u Dabid u la kylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha uta u samla uba la iathuh ha u, Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ki la iap ?

en: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .
kha: Kumta uwei na ki briew hangta u la ong ha u ,  Ha khmih , ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïa-ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïakren bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei u la ong ha u: Ha khmih ka kmie jong me bad ki hynmen jong me ki ieng shabar, ki kwah ban iakren bad me .

en: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,
kha: U Petros , uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ko nongïalam jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha ki: Phi ki nongsynshar jong ki briew bad ki rangbah Israel .

en: For he was a good man , and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith : and much people was added unto the Lord .
kha: U Barnabas u la long u briew uba bha , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka jingngeit , bad bun ki briew la wallam sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la long u briew uba bha, bad uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ka jingngeit: bad bun ki briew ki la nang kiew sha U Trai .

en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover , and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified .
kha: Sa ar sngi , kumba phi tip , kan long ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti noh ïa ka ban shah sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip ba hadien ar sngi ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait im , bad u Khun u briew u shah pyndem noh ban shah sahnarphna .

en: And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .
kha: Ka long kaba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad ka la sumar ïa u , hynrei um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dam ka long kaba itynnad bha, bad ka la sumar ia u syiem, bad ka la shakri ia u: hynrei u syiem um ithuh ia ka .

en: For he mightily convinced the Jews , and that publickly , shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ .
kha: Naba da ki nia bakhlaiñ jong u , u la jop ïa ki Jiw ha ki jingïatainia ha khmat ki paidbah da kaba pynshisha na ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Jisu u dei U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynngeit shibun ia ki Jiw, bad kata da kaba sngewthuh bakla, da kaba pyni da ki jingthoh ba U Jisu u long U Khrist .

en: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .
kha: U Herod u la kwah ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei u la sheptieng ïa ki paid Jiw , namar ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kum u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pyniap ia u , u la tieng ia u paidbah namar ki la khein ia u kum u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .
kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki leh mynleh kumba phai dien , bad ki phet sha ka jaka bashrah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua bad ki Israel baroh ki la leh kum ba ki la shah shoh ha khmat jong ki , bad ki la phet noh da ka lynti jong ka ri khlaw .

en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .
kha: Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym kohnguh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah kum ka jingtim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan pynlong ia kane ka iing kum ka Shiloh , bad ngan pynlong ia kane ka nongbah ka jingtim ia ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew .

en: For he longed after you all , and was full of heaviness , because that ye had heard that he had been sick .
kha: U kwah eh ban ïohi ïa phi baroh , bad u la sngew pisa shibun namar ba phi la ïohsngew ba u la pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la thrang ia phi baroh , bad u la dap da ka jingkhia , namar ba phi la iohsngew ba u la pang .

en: And it shall come to pass , when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :
kha: Ha man ba nga tap ïa ka suiñbneng da u lyoh , bad ba u simpyllieng u paw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia haba nga wanrah ia u lyoh halor ka khyndew, ba ka bow kan sa paw ha u lyoh:

en: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying , Fulfil your works , your daily tasks , as when there was straw .
kha: Ki nongpyntrei mraw ki ïai pyrshang ban pynbor ïa ki ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la shna mynba dang ai phlangïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongtrei ki la pynkhih ia ki, ki da ong, Pyndap ia ki kam jong phi, ki kam ba man ka sngi jong phi, kumba la don u sboh .

en: And now , O inhabitants of Jerusalem , and men of Judah , judge , I pray you , betwixt me and my vineyard .
kha: Kumta mynta u paralok jong nga u ong :  Ma phi ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad Judah , to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka Judah, to bishar, nga kyrpad ia phi, to bishar ia nga bad ia ka kper sohjew jong nga .

en: And to them which were in Hormah , and to them which were in Bor–ashan , and to them which were in Athach ,
kha: bad sha ki briew ha ki nongrit ka Hormah , Borashan , Athakh , bad Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita kiba don ha Hormah bad ha kito kiba don ha Borashan bad ha kito kiba don ha Athach .

en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?
kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jong nga ; balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ki hynmen jong nga, phi long ki shyieng jong nga bad ka doh jong nga: namar kata phi long kiba khatduh ban wanrah biang ia u syiem ?

en: And he spake a parable unto them , Can the blind lead the blind ? shall they not both fall into the ditch ?
kha: Bad U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : U briew uba matlah um lah ban ïalam ïa uwei pat ; lada u leh kumta , baroh ar ngut kin hap hapoh kharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia ka jingiathuhkhana ha ki, Hato kiba matlah kin ialam ia kiba matlah ? hato baroh arngut kin ym hap ha ka thliew ?

en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose , that he might know your estate , and comfort your hearts ;
kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba nga phah ïa u sha phi , khnang ba un ai mynsiem ïa phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi kumno ngi baroh hangne ngi ïalong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba nga la phah sha phi na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu, ba un tip ia ka jaka jong phi, bad un pyntngen ia ki dohnud jong phi ;

en: A thousand shall fall at thy side , and ten thousand at thy right hand  ; but it shall not come nigh thee .
kha: Ha syndah jong me shihajar ngut ki lah ban kyllon , shiphew hajar ngut ha baroh sawdong jong me , hynrei men ym shah pynmynsaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Shi hajar kan hap ha ka liang jong me, bad shi hajar ha ka liang kadiang jong me ; hynrei kan ym wan hajan jong me .

en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :
kha: Nga la kwah ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki la mudui ïa u , kumta nga la ïalam ïa u sha ka Dorbar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la tip ia ka daw ba ki la kynnoh ia u , nga la wanrah ia u shabar ha ka dorbar jong ki:

en: To them which were in Beth–el , and to them which were in south Ramoth , and to them which were in Jattir ,
kha: U phah ïa ka sha ki briew ha Bethel , sha ki briew ha Ramah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Judah , bad sha ki briew ha ki nongrit Jattir ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki ha Bethesel, bad ha kito kiba don shaphang shathie Ramoth bad ha kito kiba don ha Jattir .

en: And her adversary also provoked her sore , for to make her fret , because the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
kha: Ka Peninnah , kaba ju pyrshah ïa ka , ka pynshitom bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongshun jong ka ruh u la pynmih ia ka jingpang jong ka, namar ban pynlong ia ka ban sngewsih, namar U Trai u la khang ia ka kpoh jong ka .

en: Yea , and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith , I joy , and rejoice with you all .
kha: Lehse ïa ka snam jong ka jingim jong nga la dei ban theh noh kum ka jingainguh halor ka jingkñia kaba long ka jingngeit jong phi ba ai sha U Blei . Lada kata ka long kumta , nga shadkmen bad nga ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga bad phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bad lada nga shah tyrwa halor ka jingknia bad ka jingshakri jong phi , nga sngewkmen bad nga sngewkmen bad phi baroh .

en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land : which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa ki khun Israel ba kin lah ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw la kum ha ka dewryngkhiang ; haba ki nong Ijipt ki la pyrshang ban leh kumta , ka um ka la tyllep noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit ki la iaid lyngba ka duriaw kaba saw kum ka ri kaba rkhiang: kaba ki nong Ijipt ki la shah rong noh .

en: Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the  Lord  :
kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U  Trai  kan wan , ngan phah ha phi ïa u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan phah ia phi ia u Elijah u nongiathuhlypa shuwa ka jingwan jong ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U Trai:

en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him  ; and he was sore wounded of the archers .
kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur , bad u hi u la shah siat da ki khnam u nongshun , bad u la mynsaw jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka thma ka la iaid pyrshah ia u Saul , bad ki nongsiat suloi ki la shoh ia u ; bad u la mynsaw jur na ki nongsiat suloi .

en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .
kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( kaba mut  ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah  ) , namar hangta ki la tep ïa ki briew kiba la kwah rhah ban bam doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Kibrothhattaavah: namar hangta ki la tep ia ki briew kiba kwah .

en: And Kattath , and Nahalal , and Shimron , and Idalah , and Beth–lehem : twelve cities with their villages .
kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Kattath , ka Nahalal , ka Shimron , ka Idalah , bad ka Bethlehem : khat-ar tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Kattath, bad u Nahalal, bad u Shimron, bad u Idalah, bad u Bethlehem: shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .
