en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ki briew kin iaroh ia U Trai na ka bynta ka jingbha jong u , bad na ka bynta ki kam ba phylla jong u ia ki khun bynriew !

en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .
kha: Long kiba beit bad phi pyn-i ba phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; long kiba kynriang bad phi pyn-i ba phim don ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid ha ka jinglong hok jong u u tieng ia U Trai: hynrei uta uba bakla ha ki lynti jong u u niewbein ia u .

en: For the Father himself loveth you , because ye have loved me , and have believed that I came out from God .
kha: U ieit ïa phi namar ba phi ieit ïa nga bad ba phi la ngeit ba nga la wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Kpa hi u ieit ia phi , namar phi la ieit ia nga bad phi la ngeit ba nga la mih na U Blei .

en: Wherefore laying aside all malice , and all guile , and hypocrisies , and envies , and all evil speakings ,
kha: To bret noh na lade , namarkata , ïa ki jingsniew baroh ; ïa ka jingshukor lane ka jingarsap lane ka jingbishni lane ka jingkren sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingbuh shawei ia ki jingsniew baroh, bad ki jingleh arsap baroh, bad ki jingsngewsih baroh .

en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .
kha: Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phong ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khet jong u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba la buh, u Herod u la shong ha ka jain syiem, u la shong ha ka khet jong u, bad u la leh ia ka jingkren bein ia ki .

en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .
kha: Kumta u la hukum ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist . Te ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki ban shah pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng U Trai . Nangta ki la duwai ia u ban sah katto katne sngi .

en: Be afflicted , and mourn , and weep : let your laughter be turned to mourning , and your joy to heaviness .
kha: To leh sngewsih , to ïam , bad to ïamkthang ; to pynlong ïa ka jingrkhie ban kylla sha ka jingïam , ka jingkmen sha ka jingsngewdiaw !
translated_en_to_kha: To shah pynshitom , bad to iam: to ai ba ka jingrkhie jong phi kan kylla long kaba sngewsih , bad ka jingkmen jong phi kan kylla long kaba khia .

en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
kha: Ka jingangnud kaba khraw tam jong ngi ka long ba uwei pa uwei na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , kumta ba kiei kiei kiba phi kyrmen kin wan urlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi kwah ba uwei pa uwei na phi un pyni ia kajuh ka jingminot haduh kaba kut:

en: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoash u khun jong u Jehoahas kum u syiem ka Israel , u Amasaïah u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Joash u khun jong u Joah u la synshar ia u Amasa u khun jong u Joash u syiem Judah .

en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .
kha: U Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh bad hynñiew kilo ka ksiar la pyndonkam ha kawei kawei ka stieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la leh arspah tylli ki thong ksiar ba la shoh: hynriew spah Shekel ksiar u la leit sha kawei ka thong .

en: And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Dabid u thoh shithi sha u Joab bad u phah rah ïa ka ha u Uriah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep , u Dabid u la thoh shithi sha u Joab bad u la phah ia ka da ka kti jong u Uriiah .

en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .
kha: bad ka sharing jong ki them kiba kot shaduh ka shnong Ar bad shaduh u pud ka ri Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka wah jong ki wah kiba hiar sha ka jaka shong jong u Ar , bad ki shong ha u pud u sam jong ka ri Moab .

en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .
kha: Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ïa phi , hynrei ka shun ïa nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki lynti jong ka ki long kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pyrthei kam lah ban shun ia phi ; hynrei ia nga ka shun, namar nga sakhi ia ka, ba ki kam jong ka ki long kiba sniew .

en: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .
kha: U la kam ba u long uba khraw , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u .  Une u briew u long kata ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaba la khot ‘ Ka Borbah’ ,  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiba baroh ki la sngap jar, naduh kaba rit haduh kaba khraw tam, ki da ong: Une u briew u long ka bor Bakhraw jong U Blei .

en: And here is the mind which hath wisdom . The seven heads are seven mountains , on which the woman sitteth .
kha: Kane ka khot ïa ka jingstad bad jingshemphang . Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ki long hynñiew tylli ki lum , ha kiba kata ka briew ka shong . Ki long ruh ki hynñiew ngut ki syiem :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne ka don ka jingmut kaba don ka jingstad . Ki hynriew tylli ki khlieh ki long hynriew tylli ki lum , ha kiba ka kynthei ka shong .

en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .
kha: bad u Ïoannis u la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba u la ïohi . Kane ka long ka jingïathuh jong u shaphang ka khubor na U Blei bad ka jingshisha ba la pynpaw da U Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba thoh ia ka ktien U Blei bad ia ka jingphla U Jisu Khrist bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la iohi .

en: He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki wahduid ka um kaba ai jingim kin tuid noh na ka dohnud jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ngeit ha nga kumba ka jingthoh ka la ong , na ka kpoh jong u kin tuid ki wah um ba im .

en: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam sngewthuh shaphang kaei phi ïakren !  Kumta hi , katba u dang kren , u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la ong, ko briew, ngam tip ia kaei kaba me ong . Bad mardor, katba u dang kren, u la kren ia ka kynhun jong ki khnai.

en: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;
kha: Hynrei mynta ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ha kine ki thain bad namar ba nga la ju kwah la bun snem ban wan khmih ïa phi , nga kyrmen ban leh kumta mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ym don jaka shuh ha kine ki bynta , bad ka jingkwah kaba khraw ia kine ki snem ban wan sha phi ; .

en: And he said unto them ,  Full well ye reject the commandment of God , that ye may keep your own tradition .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la bteng da kaba ong ,  Phi don ka rukom basian jong ka jingkyntait ïa ka hukum U Blei ban pynneh ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, To kyntait bha ia ka hukum U Blei, ba phin bat ia la ka jong ka dustur .

en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
kha: Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bha , bad wad burom , ka nam babha , bad ka jingim bymïap shuh ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kito kiba da ka jingbteng kaba iaishah ha kaba leh bha ki wad ia ka burom bad ka burom bad ka jingbymjukut , ka jingim bymjukut:

en: And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .
kha: Kata ka jingud jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki, bad U Blei u la kynmaw ia ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham bad u Isaak bad u Jakob .

en: There is none holy as the  Lord  : for there is none beside thee : neither is there any rock like our God .
kha: Ym don uba khuid kum U  Trai  ; ym don uba kum ma u , ym don nongïada uba kum U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba khuid kum U Trai: namar ym don uwei ruh nalor jong me: lymne ym don u maw kum U Blei jong ngi .

en: But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
kha: Me pyrkhat ba U Blei un ym pynshitom , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta, namar ba kam long kumta, u la leit jngoh ia ka ha ka jingbitar jong u ; hynrei um tip ia ka ha ka jinglong kaba khraw:

en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
kha: kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad kiba knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyrkhei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iing kiba bam dohkha ki leh ia ki jingduwai kiba jrong: kajuh kan ioh ia ka jingpynrem kaba kham khraw .

en: But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
kha: Shu ong ‘ Ho-oid’ lane ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pat kaba phi ong ka wan na Uta uba Sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba ka jingiakren jong phi kan long , Hooid, hooid, hooid: namar kaei kaei kaba kham palat ban ia kine ka wan ka jingsniew .

en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread , neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf .
kha: Ki synran ki la klet ban wallam kpu kat ban dap , bad ki la don tang uwei u kpu bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki synran ki la klet ban shim kpu , bad kim don ha ka lieng bad ki palat ia kawei ka kpu .

en: He reminded that in the past elections Chandrababu has given assurances which have not been fulfilled yet .
kha: U la pynkynmaw ba ha ki elekshon ba la dep u Chandrababu u la ai ki jingkular ki bym pat urlong haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkynmaw ba ha ki elekshon ba la dep u Chandrababu u la ai jingkular ia ki bym pat lah ban pyndep haduh mynta .

en: Then he is gracious unto him , and saith , Deliver him from going down to the pit : I have found a ransom .
kha: Ha ka jingsngewsynei u angel un ong ,  Pyllait noh ïa u ! Um dei ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Hangne ka don ka kuna ban pyllaitluid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u long uba sngewrit ia u, bad u ong, To pyllait ia u na kaba leit hiar shapoh ka thliew: Nga la shem ia ka jingsiew bai lutksan .

en: Behold , he drinketh up a river , and hasteth not : he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth .
kha: Um sheptieng ïa ka wah kaba tuid stet ; u long jai jai haba ka Jordan ka tynrah ïa ka durkhmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u dih ia ka wah , bad um ju kyrkieh: u shaniah ba u lah ban tan ia u Jordan sha ka shyntur jong u .

en: I the  Lord  do keep it  ; I will water it every moment : lest any hurt it , I will keep it night and day .
kha: Ngan khmih ïa ka bad ïai ai um ïa ka . Ngan ap phira ïa ka mynmiet bad mynsngi khnang ba yn ym don mano mano u ban pynsniew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga U Trai ngan sumar ia ka man la ka khyllipmat: ioh ba uno uno un pynmong ia ka , ngan sumar ia ka miet bad sngi .

en: After whom is the king of Israel come out ? after whom dost thou pursue ? after a dead dog , after a flea .
kha: Ha khmih ïa kaei u syiem Israel u pyrshang ban pynïap ? Ha khmih ïano u beh kthong ! Ïa u ksew ïap , ïa u thyllah !
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jongno u syiem Israel u mih ? hadien jongno u la bud ? hadien u kulai uba la iap .

en: And he said unto his people , Behold , the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we :
kha: Une u ong ha la ki briew ,  Kine ki Israel ki la ïaroi palat , bad ki la ïakhlaiñ eh ruh , bad ki long ka jingma ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki briew jong u: Ha khmih ki briew jong ki Israel ki kham bun bad kham khlain bor ban ia ngi:

en: And it came to pass , as I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled out .
kha: Hynrei haba nga la kyang jam , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba nga dang pynkiew ia ka sur bad nga dang iam, ba u la iehnoh ia ka jain jong u bad nga bad u la phet noh .

en: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .
kha: Wat ong ha la u paramarjan ap haduh lashai lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa u mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ong ha u paramarjan jong me, To leit phai biang, bad lashai ngan ai shuh shuh haba me don ia ka da me .

en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David , that cometh in the name of the Lord : Hosanna in the highest .
kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka jingwan ka hima jong u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong ngi ! Ïaroh ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ka hima u kpa jong ngi u Dabid, kaba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai: Hosanna ha kaba ha khlieh duh .

en: And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .
kha: Um shym la lah ban leh kino kino ki kambah hangta , lait noh tang kaba buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba pang bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um lah ban leh ei ei kaba khraw, lait noh tang ba u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha ki katto katne ngut ki briew kiba pang, bad u la pynkoit ia ki .

en: And it came to pass , that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu bad ki lai ngut ki synran ki la hiar na u lum , bad u paidbah babun u la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, haba ki la wan hiar na lum, bun ki briew ki la iakynduh ia u .

en: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
kha: Haba nga la pyndep ïa kane ka kam bad ba nga la dep aiti sha ki ïa baroh ka pisa ïa kaba la dep pynmih na ka bynta jong ki , ngan sa mih ban leit sha Spain bad wan khmih artat ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la leh ia kane bad nga la khang ia ki ia une u soh , ngan wan da phi sha Spain .

en: Then shall the  Lord  go forth , and fight against those nations , as when he fought in the day of battle .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  un mih shabar bad un ïaleh pyrshah ïa kito ki hima , kumba u la ïaleh ha ki por ba la dep .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai un leit sha khmat bad un ialeh pyrshah ia kita ki jaitbynriew kumba u la ialeh ha ka sngi thma .

en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months in Jerusalem .
kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem .

en: And Laban said to him , Surely thou art my bone and my flesh . And he abode with him the space of a month .
kha: Haba u Jakob u la ïathuh ha u Laban ïa kaba la jia baroh , u Laban u ong ,  Ho-oid , da shisha phi dei ka doh ka snam jong nga .  U Jakob u la shong la sah hangta baroh shi bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong ha u, Hooid me long ka shyieng jong nga bad ka doh jong nga . Bad u la sah bad u shibnai .

en: So his father went down unto the woman : and Samson made there a feast  ; for so used the young men to do .
kha: U kpa jong u , u leit sha ïing kata ka kynthei , bad u Samson u pynlong ka jingkhawai hangta . Kane ka long kaba ki ju leh hapdeng ki para samla shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u kpa jong u u la leit hiar sha kata ka kynthei : bad u Samson u la leh hangta ka jingkhawai ; namar kumta u la pyndonkam ia ki samla ban leh .

en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingkyrkhu , ha kaba u Moses u briew jong U Blei u la kyrkhu ia ki khun Israel shuwa ka jingiap jong u .

en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .
kha: Nga la khmih ha ka pyrthei — ka la long ka jingsep ei suda , ha ka sahit bneng — ym don kano kano ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ka khyndew bad, ha khmih, ka la long khlem dur, bad ka la thylli ; bad ki bneng , bad kim don jingshai .

en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ , so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing .
kha: Bad kumta ki kynthei ki dei ban aiti lut ha ki tnga jong ki kumba ka balang ka aiti ïa lade ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumba ka balang ka long hapoh U Khrist , kumta to ai ba ki tnga kin long ha la ki jong ki tnga ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :
kha: Wat ki sim bad ki mrad ki don shibun ban hikai ïa me ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kylli mynta ia ki mrad bad kin hikai ia me bad ki sim Iyer bad kin iathuh ia me:

en: And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :
kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jong phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong bad eh kum u nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynpra ia ka jingsarong jong ka bor jong phi ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka bneng jong phi kum ka nar, bad ia ka khyndew jong phi kum ka nar:

en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa ka duriaw bad nga pynlong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga long U Trai U Blei jong me, uba la phiah ia ka duriaw, uba ki um jong u ki la khih: U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .
kha: Hynrei don ki nongap langbrot kiba wan beh noh ïa ki . Te u Moses u leit ban ïada ïa ki bad u ïarap ai um ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap langbrot ki la wan beh noh ia ki: hynrei u Moses u la ieng bad u la iarap ia ki , bad u la ai um ia ki kynhun jong ki .

en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;
kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba ha khlieh tam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduna ia lade ha kawei pa kawei ka jinglong briew na ka bynta U Trai: la ka long ha u syiem , kumba ka long kaba khraw tam;

en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife , She is my sister : and Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .
kha: Hadien , katba u dang shong ha Gerar , u la ong ba ka tnga jong u , ka Sarah ka dei ka para jong u . Te u Abimelekh jong ka Gerar u la phah ban wallam ïalam ïa ka Sarah sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong ia ka Sarah ka tnga jong u: Ka long ka para jong nga: bad u syiem Gerar u la phah ia ka Sarah .

en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïaleh thma , bad ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la pynkhih ia nga da ka bor ban ialeh: ia kiba la ieng pyrshah ia nga me la pyndem hapoh jong nga .

en: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven , and the fatness of the earth , and plenty of corn and wine :
kha: To U Blei un ai ha me ïa ka umjer na bneng , bad un pynseisoh ïa ki lyngkha jong me ! To un ai ha me kyrhai u kew bad ka waiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Blei u ai ia me ia ka dewbilat jong ka bneng bad ka jingkhluit jong ka khyndew bad ka wain kaba bun:

en: And the sons of Merari  ; Mahli and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .
kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki jait jong ki Lebi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Merari ; Mahli bad u Mushi: kine ki long ki long ki longiing jong u Lebi kat kum ki pateng jong ki .

en: And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jur ki masi dab bad nga don ha ka lynti ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u la ong, nga la thied san tylli ki oxen , bad nga leit pynshisha ia ki: Nga duwai ia me ba nga la pynrem ia nga .

en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand , and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand .
kha: Te ngan pynhap noh ïa ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti kadiang jong u bad ki khnam jong u kin hap noh na ka kti kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ia ka bow jong me na ka kti kadiang jong me , bad ngan pynlong ia ki khnam jong me ban hap na ka kti kadiang jong me .

en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .
kha: La leit lam ïa u ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la lap ia u ba u lum ia ki dieng ki la wanrah ia u ha u Moses bad u Aaron bad ha ka jingiaseng baroh kawei .

en: And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .
kha: Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jakob namar ba ki kti jong u ki long kiba mih shñiuh kum ki jong u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um ithuh ia u, namar ki kti jong u ki long kiba sniew, kumba ki kti jong u Iso: kumta u la kyrkhu ia u .

en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .
kha: Kat phi nang bun jingkhuslai , katta phin ïoh ki jingphohsniew kynsha , bad kat phi nang bunktien katta phin liat ha kaba kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingphohsniew ka wan lyngba ka jingbun ki kam ; bad ka sur kaba bieit la tip da ki kyntien kiba bun .

en: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record , Uriah the priest , and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah .
kha: Wanlam ar ngut ki rangbah ba lah ban shaniah , u Uriah u lyngdoh bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeberekhaïah , ban long kum ki sakhi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ha nga ki sakhi kiba iaineh ban thoh , U Uiah u lyngdoh bad u Seariah u khun u Jesereiah .

en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel was there , according to the vision that I saw in the plain .
kha: Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ kaba pyn-i ïa ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka haba nga don harud ka wah Khebar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka burom U Blei jong ki Israel ka la don hangta, kat kum ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi ha ka madan .

en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly , and hardened their necks , and hearkened not to thy commandments ,
kha: Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la sarong bad eh dohnud bad kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh sngew sarong bad ki la pynkhlain ia ki ryndang jong ki bad kim shym la kohnguh ia ki hukum jong me .

en: I said , I would scatter them into corners , I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men :
kha: Ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa ki , khnang ban ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , ngan sa pynphriang ia ki ha ki thliew , ngan pynlong ia ka jingkynmaw ia ki ban sangeh noh na ki briew:

en: But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled , and glorified God , which had given such power unto men .
kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la sheptieng , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei uba la ai kum kata ka iktiar ha ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki paidbah ki la iohi ia ka, ki la lyngngoh bad ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei uba la ai bor ia ki briew .

en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .
kha: Mynta khatduh U Trai u la ïarap ïa nga ,  ka la ong .  U la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga hapdeng ki briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la leh ia nga ha ki sngi ba u peit ia nga, ban weng noh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong nga hapdeng ki briew .

en: Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .
kha: Ngim nud ban leit sha ki rudnong lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun jong ngi ki la kieng atiar bad ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha baroh sawdong jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leit sha lyngkha , lymne iaid ha ka lynti ; namar ka waitlam jong u nongshun bad ka jingtieng ka don ha man la ki liang .

en: Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .
kha: To ïa-ap bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka mon , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit bad duwai , ba phin ym rung ha ka jingpynshoi: ka mynsiem shisha ka mon , hynrei ka doh ka tlot .

en: And Saul also went home to Gibeah  ; and there went with him a band of men , whose hearts God had touched .
kha: U Saul ruh u leit phai sha la ïing ha Gibeah . Katto katne ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ ryngkat bad ki nongïapom kiba U Blei u la ktah ïa ki dohnud jong ki , ki la leit lang bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul ruh u la leit phai noh sha ka iing sha Gibeah ; bad hangta u la leit ryngkat bad u da ka kynhun ki briew kiba U Blei u la ktah ia ki dohnud jong ki .

en: And it was so from that day forward , that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day .
kha: U Dabid u la buh ïa kane kum ka aiñ bad la ju bud ha Israel hadien kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta naduh kata ka sngi, ba u la pynlong ia ka kum ka ain bad ka hukum na ka bynta ki Israel haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .
kha: Balei phi tuh ïa ka khuri rupa u kynrad jong nga ? Ka dei kaba u ju pyndonkam ban dih na ka , kaba u ju pyndonkam ha ka kheiñ ka bishar ? Phi la leh ïa ka kam kaba shyrkhei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam dei kata ha kaba u kynrad jong nga u dih, bad da kaba u long shisha uba sniew ? phi la leh ia kaba sniew ha kaba leh kumta .

en: And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .
kha: Ïa ngi , pynban , ka long kaba dei hok , namar ba ngi ïoh ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban ïoh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka bym dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi shisha tang shu shu leh ia ka bainong kaba dei jong ki kam jong ngi: hynrei une u briew um shym la leh ei ei kaba bakla .

en: And to them which were in Aroer , and to them which were in Siphmoth , and to them which were in Eshtemoa ,
kha: Aroer , Siphmoth , Eshtemoa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita kiba don ha Aroer bad ha kita kiba don ha Siphmoth bad ha kita kiba don ha Eshetemoa .

en: And the remnant of the sodomites , which remained in the days of his father Asa , he took out of the land .
kha: U la pynduh jait ïa baroh ki nuti shynrang bad kynthei kiba shakri ha ki duwan jong ki blei thala kiba dang sah naduh ki sngi u Asa u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongleh kam sniew kiba sah ha ki sngi u kpa jong u u Asa , u la shim noh na ka ri .

en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition  ; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul .
kha: Ngim long ki briew kiba phai dien bad kiba jot noh . Pynban , ngi don ka jingngeit bad la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngim dei na kita kiba phaidien sha ka jingduhnong ; hynrei na kita kiba ngeit ha ka jingpynim ia ka mynsiem .

en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance : for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great .
kha: Nga kloi ban phah ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad ïarap lem ïa ki jong phi ha kaba pynkhreh shibun ki dieng , namar kane ka Templ kaba nga mut ban tei kan long kaba khraw bad kaba ishongkun .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ban pynkhreh ia nga ha ka jingbun: namar ka iing kaba nga thmu ban tei kan long kaba phylla shibun .

en: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life : and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood .
kha: U Dabid u ïohi ba U Saul u wad ban pynïap ïa u . U Dabid u don ha Horesh , ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iohi ba u Saul u la mih ban wad ia ka jingim jong u: bad u Dabid u la don ha ka ri khlaw jong u Siph ha u dieng .

en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways  ; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of .
kha: Wat la katta , shibun kin bud ïa ki lynti bajakhlia jong ki ; bad namar kaei kaba ki leh , kiwei kin kren sniew ïa ka Lynti jong ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun kin bud ia ki lynti ba sniew jong ki ; namar jong kiba ka lynti jong ka jingshisha kan long kaba sniew .

en: And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ; kin ïamane bad kohnguh ïa nga .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynskhem ia ki ha U Trai ; bad kin iaid shaneng bad shapoh ha ka kyrteng jong u , ong U Trai .

en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :
kha: Ha ka jingïadon ryngkat ki synran jong u , U Jisu u la leh shibun kiwei pat ki kambah ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun kiwei pat ki dak ki la leh shisha ia U Jisu ha khmat ki synran jong u , ki bym shym la thoh ha kane ka kot:

en: Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the  Lord .
kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei ; to kin pyrkhat shaphang ka jingieit baneh U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba stad bad un peit ia kine kiei kiei , wat kin sngewthuh ia ka jingieit U Trai .

en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .
kha: Naba ka long da ka jingngeit jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei ; ka long da ka jingphla jong ngi ba ïa ngi la pynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ka dohnud u briew u ngeit ha ka hok ; bad da ka shyntur la pynlong ia ka jingpdiang sha ka jingpynim .

en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the  Lord  : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew , hynrei u sngewbha ha ki ktien kiba sngur jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba sniew ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei ki ktien kiba khuid ki long ki ktien kiba sngewtynnad .

en: Take you wise men , and understanding , and known among your tribes , and I will make them rulers over you .
kha: Jied na kawei kawei ka jait ïa ki briew kiba stad , kiba shemphang , bad kiba rangbah jingmut , bad ngan thung ïa ki kum ki nongbishar ki ban peit halor ïa phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia phi ki briew kiba stad bad kiba sngewthuh bad kiba la tip hapdeng ki jaitbynriew jong phi , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ki nongsynshar halor jong phi .

en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .
kha: Ki atiar kiba ngi pyndonkam ha ka jingïaleh jong ngi kim long ki atiar jong ka pyrthei hynrei ki atiar kiba donbor jong U Blei , ïa kiba ngi pyndonkam ban pynpra ïa ki kut baskhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki tiar thma jong ngi kim long kiba kynja doh , hynrei kiba khlain bor lyngba U Blei haduh ban da pynhiar ia ki jingbat kiba khlain .

en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went , and stood to view afar off : and they two stood by Jordan .
kha: bad sanphew ngut na ki nongïathuhlypa ki la bud ïa ki sha ka Jordan . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la sangeh harud wah , bad ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïeng kham pajih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa ki la leit sha jngai : bad ki arngut ki la ieng hajan u Jordan .

en: And as he spake , a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him : and he went in , and sat down to meat .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren , u Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam bad u ; kumta u la leit shapoh bad u la shong ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren, uwei u Pharisi u la kyrpad ia u ban iabam bad u: bad u la rung shapoh bad u la shong ha ka jingbam .

en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .
kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaba kham khlaiñ shuh shuh . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kiba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u ai kham bun ka jingaiei . Namarkata u ong , U Blei u pyrshah ia kiba sngew sarong , hynrei u ai ka jingaiei ia kiba pynrit mynsiem .

en: And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basins  ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .
kha: U Moses u shim shiteng na ka snam jong kita ki mrad bad u buh ïa ka ha ki dabor , bad shiteng pat na kata ka snam u synreit ha kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim shiteng na ka snam , bad u la buh ia ka ha ki thliew ; bad shiteng na ka snam u la theh ha ka almari .

en: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .
kha: Haba ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane , ma ngi bad kiwei pat kiba hangta , ngi la kyrpad ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei baroh arngut ngi bad ki jong kata ka jaka ngi la kyrpad ia u ba un ym leit sha Jerusalem .

en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah ki la pynsngewthuh ia u paidbah ba kin kylli ia u Barabbas bad pynjot ia U Jisu .

en: For I have five brethren  ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .
kha: Shah ïa u ban leit bad maham ïa ki , khnang ba ma ki , la kumno kumno , kin ym wan sha kane ka jaka ka jingshitom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga don san ngut ki hynmen ; ba un sakhi ia ki , ioh ba kin wan ruh sha kane ka jaka pynshitom .

en: I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .
kha: Bad pynban , nga long U Blei uba map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane namar uei ba nga long . Ngan ym bat ïa ki pop jong phi pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh nga long uta uba pynduh noh ia ki jingpynkhein jong me na ka bynta jong nga hi , bad ngan ym kynmaw ia ki pop jong me .

en: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors : the one owed five hundred pence , and the other fifty .
kha: La don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shahram ha u nongai ram ,  U Jisu u la sdang .  Uwei u la shahram na u , sanspah tylli ki sbai rupa , bad uwei pat u la shahram na u , sanphew .
translated_en_to_kha: La don uwei u nongshim ram uba don arngut ki nongkit ram: uta uba donkam san spah pen , bad uwei pat sanphew pen .

en: Awake to righteousness , and sin not ; for some have not the knowledge of God : I speak this to your shame .
kha: To kynditbynriew sha ka lynti jong ka jing hok bad nai leh pop . Nga pynbna ba phin lehrain ba don hapdeng jong phi ki bymtip ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie ia ka hok , bad wat leh pop shuh shuh namar don kiba khlem ka jingtip ia U Blei: Nga kren ia kane ha ka jingsngewlehrain jong phi .

en: In addition to the 105 seats , Fadnavis has claimed that the BJP enjoys the support of 15 Independent MLAs .
kha: Nalor ki 105 seat u Fadnavis u la kam ba ka BJP ka ioh ia ka jingkyrshan na ki 15 ngut ki Independent MLA .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ki 105 tylli ki seat , u Fadnavis u la kam ba ka BJP ka ioh ia ka jingkyrshan jong ki 15 ngut ki MLA shimet .

en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba jan bad u uba hajan jong u, ban pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ki: Nga long U Trai .

en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !
kha: Ka hok jong me , A Blei , ka kot ïa ki sahit bneng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ym don mano mano uba kum ma me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok jong me ruh ko Blei ka long kaba jrong shibun: Ko Blei uba long kum ma me !

en: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,
kha: Kane ka bynta ka la kham shai shuh shuh , ba uwei pat u lyngdoh uba pher u la paw , uba syriem ïa u Melkhisedek .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kham paw shuh shuh: namar kata hadien ka jingiasyriem jong u Melchisedec ka mih sa uwei pat u lyngdoh .

en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .
kha: Don ar tylli ki dieng Olib hajan u diengpynïeng sharak , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki dieng olive da ka , uwei ha ka liang kadiang jong ka khiew bad uwei pat ha ka liang kadiang jong ka .

en: And the Pharisees came to him , and asked him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife ? tempting him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan ha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la kylli ,  hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ïa u briew ban pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la kylli ia u, Hato ka long kaba dei ia u briew ban pynduh noh ia la ka tnga ? da kaba pynshoi ia u .

en: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka shang , bad wanrah ïa ki sha nga ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ki ha kawei ka lyngkhot bad wanrah ia ki ha ka lyngkhot ryngkat bad u masi bad ki ar tylli ki langbrot .

en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .
kha: U paidbah byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang .
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah uba bun u la bud ia u , namar ki la iohi ia ki kambah jong u kiba u la leh ha ki kiba pang .

en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
kha: Nga sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! Tang katto katne por phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khot ïa phi da ka jingaiei U Khrist , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pat ka Gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngew lyngngoh ba phi la shah weng noh kloi na uta uba la khot ia phi sha ka jingaiei U Khrist sha kawei pat ka gospel:

en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .
kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti da kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong ngi , bad ym tang ïa ki pop jong ngi , hynrei ruh ïa ki pop jong ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u long ka jingpynbeit ia ki pop jong ngi: bad ym tang na ka bynta jong ngi , hynrei na ka bynta ki pop jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him : and they sent him away , and his wife , and all that he had .
kha: U syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki briew jong u , kumta ki la shim ïa u Abram bad ki la leit buh ïa u shabar ka ri lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la hukum ia ki briew jong u shaphang jong u: bad ki la phah noh ia u bad ia ka tnga jong u bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

en: He said unto them ,  Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth .  And they laughed him to scorn .
kha: u la ong ,  To ïamihnoh shabar baroh ! Ka khynnah rit kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !  Te ki baroh ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Ai jaka: namar ka nongtrei kam shym la iap , hynrei ka thiah . Ki la rkhie bein ia u ban rkhie bein .

en: And I will bring the land into desolation : and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it .
kha: Ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri jong phi haduh ba ki nongshun jong phi kiba ïohknieh ïa ka kin da lyngngoh ngaiñ ïa ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan wanrah ia ka ri ha ka jingjot: bad ki nongshun jong phi kiba shong hangta kin sngew lyngngoh ia ka .

en: The Nobel Prize for Economics was today awarded to Professor Richard H Thaler of the University of Chicago .
kha: Ia ka khusnam Nobel na ka bynta ka ioh ka kot la sam mynta ka sngi sha u Professor Richard H Thaler na ka University of Chicago .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Nobel Prize na ka bynta ka ioh ka kot la ai mynta ka sngi sha u Professor Richard H Thaler jong ka University of Chicago .

en: I form the light , and create darkness : I make peace , and create evil : I the  Lord  do all these things .
kha: Nga thaw ïa ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingdum ; nga wanrah ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pynlong ia ka jingshai , bad nga thaw ia ka jingdum: Nga pynlong ia ka jingsuk , bad nga thaw ia ka jingsniew: Nga U Trai nga leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ki nongïalam kiba la pyllait im ïa ki na ki nonglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh U Trai u la pynmih ia ki nongbishar , kiba la pyllait noh ia ki na ka kti jong kito kiba la pynsniew ia ki .

en: He that saith unto the wicked , Thou art righteous  ; him shall the people curse , nations shall abhor him :
kha: Lada u rai pynrem ïa u briew uba lui lui , un long uba la tim bad isih da baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ong ha kiba sniew , Me long uba hok; ia u ki briew kin tim ia u:

en: This image s head was of fine gold , his breast and his arms of silver , his belly and his thighs of brass ,
kha: Ïa ka khlieh jong ka la shna da ka ksiar banylla tam ; ïa ka shadem bad ki kti jong ka la shna da ka rupa ; ïa ka syngkai bad ka skhep jong ka da ka rnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka khlieh jong u ka long kaba bha, ka shyntur jong u bad ki kti rupa jong u, ka kpoh bad ki tyrpeng jong u kiba la shna da ka nar , .

en: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come  ; for all things are now ready .
kha: Haba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jingkhawai , u la phah ïa u shakri jong u ban ong ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , ‘ To wan , la dep khreh ïa kaei kaei baroh !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia u shakri jong u ha ka por janmiet ban ong ha ki kiba la shah bid , To wan shuh namar kiei kiei baroh ki la long mynta kiba la pynkhreh .

en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall live thereby .
kha: Haba u briew bymman u sangeh noh na kaba leh pop bad u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha , u la pynim ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u bymman u phai noh na ka jingsniew jong u bad u leh ia kaba dei katkum ka ain bad kaba dei , un im da kata .

en: The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .
kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew jong u ki burom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u sngewbha shibun eh na ka bynta ka hok jong u ; un pynkhraw ia ka hukum , bad un pynlong ia ka kaba donburom .

en: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the  Lord  to battle , as my lord saith .
kha: Hynrei baroh na ngi , ngi la kloi ban leit sha ka thma hapoh ka hukum jong U  Trai . Ngin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ïaleh , kumba phi la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shakri jong me kin iaid lait noh, uwei pa uwei u la pynkhreh ia ka thma, ha khmat U Trai ban ialeh thma, kumba ong u kynrad jong nga .

en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect , by reason of the glory that excelleth .
kha: Ngi lah ban ong ba namar jong kata ka burom kaba kham khraw mynta , kata ka burom kaba la tyngshaiñ bha ha ka por ba la leit , ka la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat ia kata kaba la pynlong burom kam don burom ha kane ka bynta , namar ka burom kaba kham bha .

en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold ,
kha: Man ka snem u syiem Solomon u ïohpdiang kumba arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingkhia jong ka ksiar kaba la wan ha u Solomon ha ka shisnem ka long hynriew spah sanphew hynriew tylli ki talent ksiar .

en: Then sent Joseph , and called his father Jacob to him , and all his kindred , threescore and fifteen souls .
kha: Kumta u Joseph u la phah khubor sha u Jakob , u kpa jong u , da kaba ong ïa u bad ïa ka longïing baroh kawei , baroh hynñiewphew san ngut , ban wan sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la phah ia u Joseph bad u la khot ia u kpa jong u u Jakob ha u bad ki kur jong u baroh, hynriewphew ngut ki mynsiem .

en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .
kha: Ka jingïaleh u Joshua ka ïalam ïa u naduh Kadesh Barnea ha ka phang shathie haduh Gasa hajan ka rud duriaw , kaba kynthup ïa baroh ki jaka ka ri Goshen haduh Gibeon ha ka phang bashatei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynkhih ia ki naduh Kadeshbarnea haduh Gaza bad ka ri Goshen baroh kawei haduh Gibeon .

en: And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?
kha: Ki la pynlong ïa ki apostol ban ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi la leh ïa kane ? Ka bor aïu phi la ïoh lane ïa ka kyrteng jongno phi pyndonkam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la buh ia ki hapdeng , ki la kylli: Da ka bor aiu ne da ka kyrteng aiu phi la leh ia kane ?

en: And as for their appearances , they four had one likeness , as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel .
kha: Ki shalyntem ki thaba kum ki mawkordor , bad kawei pa kawei ka shalyntem ka don sa kawei pat ka shalyntem kaba ïasnohlang ha ka liang ka mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ia ka dur jong ki, ki saw ngut ki don kawei ka jingiasyriem, kumba ka kali ka la don hapdeng ka kali .

en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria : and I will defend this city .
kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ïa kane ka nongbah Jerusalem na u patsha Assyria , bad ngan ïai bteng ban ïada ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pyllait ia me bad ia kane ka shnong na ka kti jong u syiem Assyria : bad ngan iada ia kane ka shnong .

en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years : and he begat sons and daughters :
kha: Hadien kata , u Adam u la im sa phraspah snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sngi u Adam hadien ba u la kha ia u Seth ki long hynriew spah snem: bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :
kha: Ha kawei ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , hynrei ïai kren bad wat sangeh , naba nga long lem bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kren ia U Trai ha u Paul ha ka por miet da ka jingphohsniew , Wat tieng , hynrei kren , bad wat bat ia ka jingsuk jong me:

en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
kha: Ki briew ha ki shnong ha kaba U Jisu u la leh kham bun ki kambah jong u , kim shym la phai noh na ki pop jong ki , kumta u la pynrem jur ïa kito ki shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la sdang ban pynkhih ia ki nongbah ha kaba bun na ki kam ba khraw jong u ki la long , namar kim shym la kylla bamut:

en: Ye are all the children of light , and the children of the day : we are not of the night , nor of darkness .
kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ki briew jong ka jingshai , kiba long ki jong ka sngi . Ngim dei ki jong ka miet lane jong ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long baroh ki khun jong ka jingshai , bad ki khun jong ka sngi: ngim dei jong ka miet , ne jong ka jingdum .

en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  un long u syiem jong ka pyrthei baroh ; uwei pa uwei baroh un mane ïa u kum U Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un long syiem halor ka khyndew baroh kawei: ha kata ka sngi un don uwei u Trai bad ka kyrteng jong u kawei .

en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .
kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki kwah ban ïoh hikai , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewhun ha ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong uta uba don ka jingstad ka wad ia ka jingtip: hynrei ka shyntur jong ki bieit ka bam ia ka jingbieit .

en: When thou liest down , thou shalt not be afraid : yea , thou shalt lie down , and thy sleep shall be sweet .
kha: Phin ym sheptieng haba phi thiah , bad phin ïohthiah suk baroh shi miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me thiah, wat nym tieng: hooid, men thiah noh bad ka jingthiah jong me kan long kaba thiang .

en: He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again . —Job 14 :14 , 15 .
kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .—Job 14 :14 , 15 .
translated_en_to_kha: U kwah eh ban wanrah biang ia kito kiba don ha ka jingkynmaw jong u bad ban iohi ia ki ba kin im biang ha ka pyrthei .  Job 14 :14, 15 .

en: And he doeth great wonders , so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men ,
kha: Une u mradkhlaw uba ar , u la leh ki kambah kiba khraw ; u la pynlong ïa ka ding ban wan hiar na bneng sha ka pyrthei ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u leh ia ki jingphylla kiba khraw , haduh ba u pynlong ia ka ding ban hiar na bneng ha ka khyndew ha khmat ki briew .

en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam  ; therefore he blessed you still : so I delivered you out of his hand .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la shahshkor ïa u Balaam , kumta u la kyrkhu ïa phi , bad da kumta nga la pyllait ïa phi na u Balak .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan ym sngap ia u Balaam ; namarkata u la kyrkhu ia phi haduh mynta: kumta nga la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong u .

en: He also served as a managing director of the FDC , and the founder president of Directors Guild Bangladesh .
kha: U la shakri ruh kum u Managing Director jong ka FDC , bad u nongseng president jong ka Directors Guild Bangladesh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shakri ruh kum u nongpyniaid ia ka FDC , bad u president jong ki Director Guild Bangladesh .

en: That the land spue not you out also , when ye defile it , as it spued out the nations that were before you .
kha: te kata ka ri kan ym kyntait ïa phi , kumba ka la leh ïa kita ki briew ki bymngeit Blei kiba im hangta ha shuwa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka ri kam shym la pynjakhlia ia phi ruh, haba phi pynjakhlia ia ka, kumba ka la pynjakhlia ia ki jaitbynriew kiba la don ha khmat jong phi .

en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding , and they that murmured shall learn doctrine .
kha: Ki briew kiba bieit kin nang ban sngewthuh , bad kito kiba khñium borabor kin kmen ban ïoh jinghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ruh kiba la bakla ha ka mynsiem kin sa wan sha ka jingsngewthuh , bad kita kiba la sngap jar kin sa nang ia ka jinghikai .

en: But they held their peace : for by the way they had disputed among themselves , who should be the greatest .
kha: Hynrei kim shym la jubab ïa u , namar ha lynti ki la ïatainia para ma ki shaphang uei uba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki: namar da kaba ong ki la ialeh pyrshah hapdeng jong ki hi , mano ba dei ban long uba khraw tam .

en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
kha: Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtep ka don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka met U Jisu hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki la buh ia U Jisu namarkata namar ka jingpynkhreh jong ki Jiw ; namar ka jingtep ka la jan .

en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher :
kha: Nangta ki rangbah Judah ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Debir , ha kata ka por la khot kyrteng ka Kiriath Sepher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh kata ka por u la leit pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Debir : bad ka kyrteng jong u Debir shuwa ka long u Kirjathsepher:

en: We can benefit greatly from the experience of these brothers and if they are married , that of their wives .
kha: Ngi lah ban ïoh shibun ki jingmyntoi na ki bad na ki lok jong ki ruh lada ki la shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi lah ban ioh jingmyntoi shibun na ka jingshem jong kine ki hynmen bad lada ki la shongkurim , ka jong ki tnga jong ki .

en: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .
kha: Mynba kiba na ka longïing jong u ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la leit ban shimti ïa u , namar ki briew ki la ïa-ong ,  U la lamwir !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki paralok jong u ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la leit shabar ban thiah ia u: namar ki la ong , U don hajan jong u hi .

en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
kha: Sa tang shipor ka pyrthei kan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , hynrei phin ïohi ïa nga ; bad namar ba nga im , phi ruh phin ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khyndiat por, bad ka pyrthei kam iohi shuh ia nga ; hynrei phi iohi ia nga: namar nga im, phi ruh phin im .

en: But Israel , which followed after the law of righteousness , hath not attained to the law of righteousness .
kha: katba ki briew ki jong U Blei , kiba la wad ïa ka hukum ka ban pynlong jingïasuk bad U Blei , kim shym la shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Israel kiba bud ia ka ain jong ka hok kim shym la ioh ia ka ain jong ka hok .

en: And Joshua said unto the people , Sanctify yourselves : for to morrow the  Lord  will do wonders among you .
kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Pynkhuid ïa lade , namar lashai U  Trai  un leh ki kambah hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki briew: To pynkhuid ia lade: namar lashai U Trai un leh ia ki kambah hapdeng jong phi .

en: And it came to pass in the third year , that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .
kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba lai , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u leit ïakynduh ïa u Ahab u syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai u syiem Judah u la wan hiar sha u syiem Israel .

en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the people tremble : he sitteth between the cherubims  ; let the earth be moved .
kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh . U shong ha ka khet halor ki kherub , bad ka pyrthei kan khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u synshar ; to ai ba ki briew kin khih: u shong hapdeng ki cherubim to ai ba ka khyndew kan khih .

en: Minister of State Shri Jitin Prasada felt that the need of the hour is to link literacy with employability .
kha: U myntri ka jylla u Shri Jitin Prasada u sngew ba ka jingdonkam jong kane ka kynta ka long ban pyniadei ia ka jingnang jingstad bad ka jinglah ban ioh kam ioh jam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Myntri ka jylla u Shri Jitin Prasada u la sngew ba ka jingdonkam jong ka kynta ka long ban pyniasoh ia ka jingnang jingstad bad ka jinglah ban ioh kam .

en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong nga i la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi . I la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait im ïa phi na ki Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta jong u kpa jong nga u la ialeh na ka bynta jong phi, bad u la leit jngoh ia ka jingim jong u sha jngai, bad u la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong u Midian:

en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and went back , and stood by the bank of Jordan  ;
kha: Nangta u tam ïa ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u , bad u leit phai bad ïeng harud ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ruh ia ka jainkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u, bad u la leit phai biang bad u la ieng ha rud wah Jordan ; .

en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
kha: Lada phi ïaroh ïa ka jingstad , u kpa jong phi un sngewsarong ïa phi . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut pisa ha ki nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba ieit ia ka jingstad u kmen ia la u kpa: hynrei uta uba iadei bad ki nongkhaii u pynlut ia ka jingdon jingem jong u .

en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did  ; they departed not from them  ;
kha: Ki bud ïa u Jeroboam bad ki ïai bteng ban leh ïa ki pop baroh ba u la leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun Israel ki la iaid ha ki pop baroh jong u Jeroboan kiba u la leh; kim shym la leit noh na ki ; .

en: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven , that one of these little ones should perish .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng um kwah ba iwei ruh na kine kiba rit in jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh kam dei ka mon U Kpa jong phi kaba don ha bneng , ba uwei na kine ki khynnah rit un jah noh .

en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , that the ark may be borne with them .
kha: Bsuh ïa kita ki dieng jingbah lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk , ba yn ïoh bah ïa ka da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ki dieng ha ki ryntieh da ki liang jong ka synduk , khnang ba ka synduk kan kit bad ki .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarap ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kaba suk i kumba ki long tang uwei u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u: Hooid ngan don ryngkat bad me, bad me dei ban shoh ia ki nong Midian kum uwei u briew .

en: And he said unto me , Thou must prophesy again before many peoples , and nations , and tongues , and kings .
kha: Te la ïathuh ïa nga ,  Sa shisien pat ka dei ïa me ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei sha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Me dei ban iathuhlypa biang ha khmat kiba bun ki jaitbynriew bad ki jaitbynriew bad ki thylliej bad ki syiem .

en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer : now the  Lord  will feed them as a lamb in a large place .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki long mutlop kum ki khashor . Kumno ngan bsa ïa ki kum ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Israel ki sdang ban sdang ban khih: mynta U Trai un ai bam ia ki kum u langbrot ha ka jaka kaba heh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah , and the great pride of Jerusalem .
kha: Kumne kan long kumno ba ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsarong jong ka Judah bad ïa ka jingsarong bakhraw jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Hadien kane ka rukom ngan sa pynjah burom ia ka jingsarong jong u Judah bad ka jingsarong kaba khraw jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :
kha: Katba ngi dang pynlur ïa ki lyngkha da ki masi lur ,  u la ong ,  bad ki kada ki dang ïabam phlang marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor u la wan sha u Job bad u la ong: Ki masi ki la tuid bad ki kada ki bam hajan jong ki:

en: And Abner said to Joab , Let the young men now arise , and play before us . And Joab said , Let them arise .
kha: U Abner u ong ha u Joab ,  To ngin shah katto katne na ki samla shynrang na kawei kawei ka liang ban ïakhun ïa ka jingïakob da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki atiar .   Ka biang ,  u Joab u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u la ong ha u Joab , Ai ba ki samla kin mih mynta, bad kin ialehkai ha khmat jong ngi . Bad u Joab u la ong , Ai ba kin mih noh .

en: Stand therefore , having your loins girt about with truth , and having on the breastplate of righteousness ;
kha: Kumta to ïeng ba la pynkhreh , da ka jingshisha kum u panpoh ba la pyndait ha ka syngkai jong phi , da ka hok kum ka jingda shadem jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: To ieng namarkata, da kaba don ia ki tyrpeng jong phi da ka jingshisha, bad da kaba don ha ka shyntur jong ka hok ;

en: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you  ; even as the green herb have I given you all things .
kha: Mynta phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumjuh ruh ïa ki jingthung bajyrngam ; nga ai ïa ki baroh ha phi ban long jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kaba iaid kaba im kan long ka doh na ka bynta jong phi ; kumba u jingthung ba jyrngam nga la ai ia phi ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And Pharaoh said , Behold , the people of the land now are many , and ye make them rest from their burdens .
kha: Phi mynta phi la kham ïabun paid ban ïa ki nong Ijipt . Bad mynta phi kwah ban sangeh trei !
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong: Ha khmih ki briew jong ka ri mynta ki long kiba bun bad phi pynjahthait ia ki na ki jingkit jong ki .

en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
kha: Te kumta , ngi dei borabor ban thmu ban leh ïa kita kiei kiei kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin bud namarkata ia kiei kiei kiba pynlong ia ka jingsuk , bad kiei kiei kiba uwei u lah ban pynroi ia uwei pat .

en: By much slothfulness the building decayeth  ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .
kha: Haba u briew u jaipdeh shaba palat ban shna pynbha ïa ka tnum ïing jong u , kan jaw um , bad ka ïing kan khyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jinglong kaba bun ka jingtei ka pyut ; bad lyngba ka jingbym shimkhia jong ki kti ka iing ka hap lyngba .

en: And Ehud put forth his left hand , and took the dagger from his right thigh , and thrust it into his belly :
kha: U Ehud pat da la ka kti kadiang u sei ïa ka waitlam na ka liang kamon jong u bad u dung pynngam ïa ka ha ka kpoh jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ehud u la pynkhih ia ka kti kadiang jong u, bad u la shim ia ka dagger na ka tyrpeng kadiang jong u, bad u la pynrung ia ka ha ka kpoh jong u:

en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net , that was cast into the sea , and gathered of every kind :
kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . Katto katne ki nongtong dohkha ki bret ïa ka jar jong ki hapoh ka duriaw bad ki ïoh bun jait ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , ka hima bneng ka long kum ka net , kaba la bret ha duriaw bad la lum lang ia ki jait:

en: Saying unto them ,  It is written , My house is the house of prayer : but ye have made it a den of thieves .
kha: La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi la pynkylla ïa ka sha ka jakarieh na ka bynta ki nongtuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong ha ki , La thoh ia ka iing jong nga: hynrei phi la pynlong ia ka ka thliew jong ki nongtuh .

en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?
kha: Kumta u Akhish u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Ha khmih ! Une u briew u lamwir ! Balei phi wan ïalam ïa u sha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ahish u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, Lo, phi iohi ia uta u briew u la mad: balei te phi la wanrah ia u ha nga ?

en: And , behold , there was a man named Zacchaeus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
kha: La don hangta u nonglum khajna uba ha khlieh duh uba kyrteng , u Sakhaïos , uba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la don uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Sakhaios, uba long u rangbah napdeng ki nongshong shnong bad u la riewspah .

en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .
kha: To put ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramah ! Pyrta jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka thma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ka kor ha Gibeah, bad ka turoi ha Ramah: to pyrta jam ha Bethaven, hadien jong me, ko Benjamin .

en: Then shall ye begin to say , We have eaten and drunk in thy presence , and thou hast taught in our streets .
kha: Nangta phi baroh phin jubab , ‘ Ngi la ïabam bad ïadih bad me ; me la hikai ha ka shnong jong ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin sdang ban ong , Ngi la bam bad dih ha khmat jong me , bad me la hikai ha ki lynti jong ngi .

en: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple : whom we took , and would have judged according to our law .
kha: U la pyrshang wat ban pyntngit ïa ka Templ , bad ngi la kem ïa u . Ngi la kwah ban bishar ïa u kat kum ka hukum jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba ruh u la leit ban pynjah burom ia ka tempi: ia uba ngi la shim , bad un jin da la bishar kat kum ka ain jong ngi .

en: Behold , I have made thy face strong against their faces , and thy forehead strong against their foreheads .
kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ïa me uba mutlop bad eh dohnud kum ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la pynlong ia ka khmat jong me kaba skhem pyrshah ia ki khmat jong ki , bad ka khlieh jong me kaba skhem pyrshah ia ki khlieh jong ki .

en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .
kha: Uta u rishot lyoh u don borabor ha shuwa uta u paidbah ha ka por mynsngi , bad u rishot ding pat , mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la weng noh ia u lum jong u lyoh ha ka por mynstep , lane ia u lum ding ha ka por miet , na khmat ki briew .

en: Now Sarai Abram s wife bare him no children : and she had an handmaid , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .
kha: Ka tnga u Abram ka Sarai , kam shym la ïoh khun satia . Hynrei ka la don bad ka , kawei ka mraw na Ijipt kaba kyrteng ka Hagar , bad kumta ka ong ha u Abram ,  U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka tnga jong u Sarai Abram kam don khun: bad ka don ka nongtrei kti, ka nong Ijipt kaba kyrteng u Hagar .

en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long ,  ki la ong ,  bad to ïathuh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ban long .
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia ngi , mynno kine kiei kiei kin long ? bad kaei ka dak ynda kine kiei kiei baroh kin sa pyndep ?

en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation , and in sure dwellings , and in quiet resting places  ;
kha: Ki briew jong U Blei kin lait na ki jingkhuslai , bad ki ïing jong ki kin suk bad kin shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew jong nga kin shong ha ka jaka shong jaka sah kaba suk, bad ha ki jaka shong jaka sah kiba skhem, bad ha ki jaka shongthait kiba sngap jar;

en: We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jong ngi tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha ki iing jong ngi , haduh ba ki khun Israel kin da hiar pateng ia uwei pa uwei u briew .

en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .
kha: Namar U Blei u la shah ïa ngi ban kmen , ngin ym khuslai shibun shaphang katno ka jingim ka long kaba lyngkot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un ym kynmaw than ia ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u ; namar U Blei u jubab ia u ha ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud jong u .

en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me : and I caused the widow s heart to sing for joy .
kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ki jingjynjar bakhraw ki ïaroh ïa nga , bad nga la ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei ban ïoh jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrkhu jong uta uba la pynkhreh ban jah ka la wan ha nga: bad nga la pynlong ia ka dohnud jong u riewkynthei ban rwai da ka jingkmen .

en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them , Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki kylli ,  Balei phi leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum jong ngi ka ong ba phim lah ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi u la ong ha ki: Balei phi leh ia kata kaba ym dei ban leh ha ka sngi Sabha ?

en: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .
kha: U bymman u kyrhuh bad u byrngem kum ki sing , hynrei U Blei u pynsngap jar ïa ki bad u sloit ïa ki bniat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong u sing , bad ka sur jong u sing uba shyrkhei bad ki bniat jong ki sing rit ki la tyrkhong .

en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .
kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , to ïa-ieit shitrhem iwei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingieit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor kiei kiei baroh ki don ka jingai sngewbha hapdeng jong phi: namar ka jingai sngewbha kan tap ia ki pop kiba bun .

en: If the foot shall say , Because I am not the hand , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
kha: Lada ka kjat kan ong ,  Namar ba ngam dei ka kti , te ngam dei ka jong ka met ,  kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka kjat kan ong , Namar ba ngam dei ka kti , ngam dei na ka met hato kam dei na ka met ?

en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la wallam ha ka jingsuk ïa ngi sha ka hima jong U Khun ba-ieit jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la pyllait im ia ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum , bad u la pynkylla ia ngi sha ka hima U Khun baieit jong u .

en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations , and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb .
kha: Ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah la tei halor ki khat-ar tylli ki maw nongrim , kiba halor jong ki la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol jong U Khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynroh jong ka shnong ka don shiphew tylli ki nongrim , bad ha ki ki kyrteng jong ki shiphew ngut ki apostol jong u Khunlangbrot .

en: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred .
kha: Ïa ka kynhun shipai la ai hukum da ki ar hajar hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah pynïaidkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon jong ki kpa tymmen baroh kawei ka long ar hajar hynriew spah .

en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .
kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym shym la ngeit ki la pynkhih ïa ki Jentil bad ki la pynlong ïa ki ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa riewngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym ngeit ki la pynkhih ia ki Jutang , bad ki la pynlong ia ka jingmut jong ki kaba sniew pyrshah ia ki para bangeit .

en: That thou keep this commandment without spot , unrebukeable , until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ :
kha: Ha khmat U Blei , uba ai jingim ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad ha khmat U Khrist Jisu , uba phla shai ïa la ka jingngeit ha khmat u Pontios Pilat , nga hukum ïa me ba men kohnguh ïa la ki hukum bad ban sumar hok ïa ki haduh kata ka Sngi haba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me bat ia kane ka hukum khlem da don jingduna, khlem da shah pynrem, haduh ka jingmih U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist:

en: Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .
kha: Shahshkor haba nga mai tyngeh ïa phi ; ngan ai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad ngan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai ia phi ha ka jingshah kyntait jong nga: ha khmih , ngan theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha phi , ngan pynpaw ia ki ktien jong nga ha phi .

en: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .
kha: bad nangta u la ong ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko para Israel , da sumar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ïa kine ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, Phi ki briew Israel, to sumar ia lade ia kaei kaba phi thmu ban leh kum kiba ktah ia kine ki briew .

en: And he took up his parable , and said , Rise up , Balak , and hear  ; hearken unto me , thou son of Zippor :
kha: bad u Balaam u kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ale , ko Balak u khun jong u Sippor , Bad sngap aïu nga don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pharshi jong u, bad u la ong, To kiew, Balak, bad to sngap ia nga, ko khun u Siphor:

en: Wherefore he saith , Awake thou that sleepest , and arise from the dead , and Christ shall give thee light .
kha: Kata ka long balei ba la ong ,  To khie joit , me uba ïohthiah , bad to mih na kiba ïap , bad U Khrist un tyngshaiñ halor jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u ong , To khie noh ia me uba thiah bad to khie noh na kiba iap, bad U Khrist un ai jingshai ia me .

en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired  ; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord .
kha: Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , hynrei ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka shnong ki kyntait ban leh ïa ki kam trei kti ba la aiti ha ki da ki nongpynïaidkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong ki ki Teko ki la pynbha ; hynrei ki rangbah jong ki kim shym la buh ia ki ryndang jong ki ha ka kam U Trai jong ki .

en: And he was king in Jeshurun , when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together .
kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem jong ki Israel ki briew jong u , mynba ki jait bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la long syiem ha Jeshun , haba ki khlieh jong ki briew bad ki jait Israel ki la ialum lang .

en: And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .
kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang bad ban buh ïa ka ha ka khyrdop ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hukum jong u syiem ki la shna ia ka shyntur , bad ki la buh ia ka shabar ha ka khyrdop jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .
kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi kin wan phai pat sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ka jingkyrmen ha ka jingkut jong me, ong U Trai, ba ki khun jong me kin wan phai biang sha la u jong u pud u sam .

en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever . And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you .
kha: hynrei ka ktien jong U Trai ka ïaineh junom .  Kane ka ktien ka long ka Khubor Babha ïa kaba la pynbna ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka ktien U Trai ka sah junom . Bad kane ka long ka ktien kaba da ka gospel la ialap ha phi .

en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah , and dwelt in Tirzah .
kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la sangeh noh ïa ka jingtei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah bad u leit sha Tirsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Baasha u la iohsngew ia kata, ba u la iehnoh ia ka jingtei ia ka Ramah bad u la shong ha Tirsah .

en: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah bad u la kiew sha u lum , ha uba u la shong . Ki synran jong u ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohi ia ki paidbah, u la kiew sha u lum: bad haba u la shong, ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u:

en: And David came to Saul , and stood before him : and he loved him greatly  ; and he became his armourbearer .
kha: U Dabid u wan sha u Saul bad u rung kam noh bad u . U Saul u sngewbha eh ïa u bad u jied ïa u kum u nongrah atiar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan sha u Saul , bad u la ieng ha khmat jong u: bad u la ieit shibun ia u ; bad u la kylla long u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u .

en: Nor by the earth  ; for it is his footstool : neither by Jerusalem  ; for it is the city of the great King .
kha: lymne da ka khyndew , naba ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong u ; lymne da ka Jerusalem , naba ka long ka nongbah jong U Syiem uba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka khyndew ; namar ka long ka jaka shong kjat jong u: lymne da ka Jerusalem ; namar ka long ka nongbah jong u Syiem uba khraw .

en: Insomuch that we desired Titus , that as he had begun , so he would also finish in you the same grace also .
kha: Kumta ngi la kyntu ïa u Titos , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kam , ban bteng ïa ka bad ban ïarap ïa phi ban pyndep ïa kane ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ba ngi kwah ia u Titus, ba kumba u la sdang, kumta un pyndep ruh ha phi ia kajuh ka jingaiei ruh .

en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
kha: Hato nga thew , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba nga ong te ? ba u bleithaw u long kaei kaei , ne kata kaba la tyrwa ha ka jingknia sha ki bleithaw ka long kaei kaei ?

en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .
kha: Kumta ïa u Haman la sdien ha ka diengphasi kaba u la shna na ka bynta u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la long jai jai .
