translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la pyndait ia u Haman ha ki lum ba u la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Mordecai . Nangta u syiem u la sngewsih .

en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the  Lord  : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .
kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , hynrei u isih ïa ki jingkñia kiba ki bymman ki wallam ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingknia jong kiba sniew ka long kaba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei ka jingduwai jong kiba hok ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u .

en: And they drew nigh unto the village , whither they went : and he made as though he would have gone further .
kha: Haba ki la jan poi hajan ka nongrit sha kaba ki thmu ban leit , U Jisu u la leh kumba u nang leit kham jngai ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid shajan shnong, ha kaba ki la leit: bad u la leh kumba u la leit kham sha jngai .

en: Men groan from out of the city , and the soul of the wounded crieth out : yet God layeth not folly to them .
kha: Ha ki nongbah , kiba mynsaw bad kiba la jan ïap ki lynñiar , hynrei U Blei um patiaw ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki iam na ka shnong, bad ka mynsiem jong kiba mynsaw ka pyrta: hynrei U Blei um shym la thiah ha ki .

en: Why askest thou me ? ask them which heard me , what I have said unto them : behold , they know what I said .
kha: Balei , te , ba phi kylli jingkylli ïa nga ? To kylli na kita ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa nga . Kylli na ki aïu nga la ïathuh ïa ki — ki tip ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me kylli ia nga ? kylli ia kiba la iohsngew ia nga , kaei kaba nga la ong ha ki: ha khmih ki tip ia kaei kaba nga la ong .

en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves ; but our sufficiency is of God ;
kha: Ym don ei ei ha ngi kaba ngi lah ban dawa ba ngi long kiba bit ban leh ïa kane ka kam . Ka jinglah jong ngi ka wan na U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ym ba ngi biang ia lade ban pyrkhat ia kaei kaei kum ma ngi; hynrei ka jingbiang jong ngi ka long jong U Blei;

en: Son of man , set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and prophesy against him , and against all Egypt :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . To ong ha u kumno ba ma u bad baroh kiba ha ka ri Ijipt kin shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt, bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia u, bad pyrshah ia ka Ijipt baroh:

en: But and if we say , Of men  ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .
kha: Hynrei lada ngi ong ‘ Na u briew ,’ kine ki paidbah hangne kin lynthem maw ïa ngi , namar ki la sngewskhem ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad lada ngi ong , Na ki briew baroh kin ia tyngkhuh bad ngi: namar ki shah pynbor ba u loannis u long u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .
kha: Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la dem khohsiew , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia u ha ka khlieh da ka rong saw, bad ki la sngap jar ia u, bad ki la dem khrup ia ki kjat jong ki ki la mane ia u .

en: But Saul had given Michal his daughter , David s wife , to Phalti the son of Laish , which was of Gallim .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Saul u la ai ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u , kaba la long ka tnga jong u Dabid , ha u Palti , u khun jong u Laish , uba na ka nongrit Gallim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Saul u la ai ia ka khun jong u, ka tnga jong u Dabid, ha u Phalti u khun u Laish uba long na Gallim .

en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim un ïoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba wad ban pynim ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka ; bad uno uno uba duh noh ia ka jingim jong u un pynneh ia ka .

en: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?
kha: U mai ïa ki jaitbynriew — hato un ym pynshitom ïa ki ? U long u nonghikai jong ngi baroh — hato un ym don jingtip ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynshitom ia ki nongwei , hato un ym pynbeit ? uta uba hikai ia u briew ia ka jingtip , hato un ym tip ?

en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :
kha: Na ka bynta jong ki nga kwah ba ngan jin da la don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ba la pynïakhlad na U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga lah ban kwah ba ma nga hi ngan shah pynngop na U Khrist na ka bynta ki hynmen jong nga:

en: I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .
kha: Nga , nga long kata ka jingkhang . Uno uno uba rung shapoh da nga un ïoh im ; kin ïohrung shapoh bad mih shabar bad shem ïa ka jaka bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long ka jingkhang: da nga lada uno uno u briew u rung shapoh , un sa shah pynim , bad un leit shapoh bad shabar , bad un shem ia ka jaka ri jingri .

en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u hukum ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met u kpa jong u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la hukum ia ki shakri jong u ki doktor ban pynkhuid ia u kpa jong u: bad ki doktor ki la pynkhih ia ki Israel .

en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer : and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him .
kha: Uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u long u nongpynïap briew , bad phi tip ba u nongpynïap briew um pat ïoh ka jingim bymjukut ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba shun ia la u hynmen u long u nongpyniap briew: bad phi tip ba ym don u nongpyniap briew uba don ka jingim bymjukut kaba sah ha u .

en: Several Indian athletes , including Lalita Babar , Sudha Singh and OP Jaisha , have trained under Snesarev .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongïalehkai na India kiba kynthup ïa ka Lalita Babar bad u Sudha Singh bad u OP Jaisha ki la pyntbit hapoh u Snesarev .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongialehkai India kiba kynthup ia ka Lalita Babar , u Sudha Singh bad u OP Jaisha ki la shah hikai hapoh ka Snesarev .

en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I .
kha: Te U Blei u kren ha u ha ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad u ong ,  Jakob , Jakob !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi , nga hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kren ha ki Israel ha ki jingphohsniew jong ka miet, bad u la ong, u Jakob u Jakob . Bad u la ong , Hangne nga don .

en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city , and the army which followed them .
kha: Ki shipai samla kiba la ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh , ïa kiba la bud da ka kynhun shipai Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kine ki samla jong ki syiem ki la mih na ka shnong , bad ki shipai kiba la bud ia ki .

en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom ; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit ;
kha: U Mynsiem u ai ha uwei ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingstad , katba ha uwei pat , ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha uwei pat la ai da U Mynsiem ia ka ktien jong ka jingstad ; ha uwei pat ka ktien jong ka jingtip da u juh u Mynsiem ; .

en: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee , and findeth Philip , and saith unto him ,  Follow me .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jisu u la kut jingmut ban leit noh sha Galilaïa . U la shem ïa u Philip bad u la ong ha u ,  To wan bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi kaba bud ia U Jisu un leit sha Galilaia, bad u lap ia u Philip, bad u ong ha u, To bud ia nga .

en: And it shall be , that thou shalt drink of the brook  ; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there .
kha: Ka wahduid kan pynbiang um ïa me ban dih , bad nga la hukum ïa ki tyngab ban wanrah jingbam ïa me hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , ba me dih na ka wah ; bad nga la hukum ia ki raven ban ai bam ia me hangta .

en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold , and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things :
kha: Phi la shim noh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad rah noh ïa ki jingkynshew spah jong nga sha ki templ jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la shim ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga, bad phi la rah sha ki temple jong phi ia kiei kiei kiba sngewtynnad shibun jong nga:

en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .
kha: U syiem bad ki nongïalam ki phla ba ki la leh pop , bad ki ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long kaba shongnia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki syiem Israel bad u syiem ki la pynrit mynsiem ia lade bad ki la ong , U Trai u long uba hok .

en: This also cometh forth from the  Lord  of hosts , which is wonderful in counsel , and excellent in working .
kha: Kane baroh ka jingstad ka wan na U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki jingthmu U Blei ki long kiba stad bad ki long borabor kiba wallam jingjop !
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ruh ka wan na U Trai jong ki paid, kaba phylla ha ka jingai jingmut bad kaba bha ha ka jingtrei .

en: He shall lend to thee , and thou shalt not lend to him : he shall be the head , and thou shalt be the tail .
kha: Kin don ka spah ka phew kat ban ai kylliang ïa phi , hynrei phi pat phin ym don ei ei ban ai kylliang ïa ki . Ha kaba khatduh kin sa long ki nongsynshar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ai ram ia me bad me wat ai ram ia u: un long u khlieh bad me un long u tdong .

en: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .
kha: Ong ïa ki briew ban kynriah sha jngai na ki ïingjaiñ jong u Korah , u Dathan , bad u Abiram .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ka jingiaseng da kaba ong: To khie noh ia phi na ka jaka shong jong u Korah, u Datan bad u Abiram .

en: And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka khet jong nga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka khet jong nga ha Elam , bad ngan pynjot noh nangta ia u syiem bad ki rangbah , ong U Trai .

en: Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .
kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , namar phi pyrkhat ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki kren shaphang jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia ki jingthoh ; namar ha ki phi pyrkhat ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut: bad ki long kita kiba sakhi ia nga .

en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself .
kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh . Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta ki kam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshong shadien ha ka dohnud un dap da la ki jong ki lynti: bad u briew uba bha un sngewhun na lade .

en: For I am in a strait betwixt two , having a desire to depart , and to be with Christ ; which is far better :
kha: Ïa nga la tan ha ki ar bynta . Nga da kwah eh ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim bad ban don bad U Khrist , kaba long kaei kaei kaba kham bha ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga don ha ka jingeh kaba ar, nga don ka jingkwah ban leit noh, bad ban don bad U Khrist ; kaba kham bha shibun:

en: And the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , journeyed from Kadesh , and came unto mount Hor .
kha: U paid Israel baroh u la mihnoh na Kadesh bad u la wan poi ha u lum Hor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel, wat ka jingiaseng baroh kawei, ki la leit noh na Kadesh bad ki la poi sha u lum Hor .

en: Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga la kren ïa kano kano kaba bakla , to ïathuh ïa baroh hangne ka dei kaei . Hynrei lada ka long kaba dei ha kaei kaba nga la ong , balei ba me da thab ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, Lada nga la kren sniew, to sakhi ia ka jingsniew: hynrei lada bha, balei me shoh ia nga ?

en: They go up by the mountains  ; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them .
kha: Ki tuid nalor ki lumbah bad sha ki them , sha ka jaka ba me la buh na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kiew da ki lum ; ki hiar da ki them sha ka jaka kaba me la seng na ka bynta jong ki .

en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls : for Joseph was in Egypt already .
kha: Kine ki briew kiba hiarpateng beit na u Jakob ki long baroh hynñiewphew ngut .    U khun jong u , u Joseph u la don lypa ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki mynsiem baroh kiba la mih na ka tyrpeng u Jakob ki long hynriewphew mynsiem: namar u Joseph u la don ha Ijipt mynta .

en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ïa kane ka jingainguh thang dei ban ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh thang ia kawei pa kawei ka Sabha , nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: We are confident , I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body , and to be present with the Lord .
kha: Ngi dap da ka jingshlur bad ngi kham kwah ban iehnoh ïa kane ka ïing jong ngi ha ka met bad ban ïoh long ha ka ïing bad U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewskhem, nga ong, bad ngi mon kham bun ban long kiba khlem na ka met , bad ban don ryngkat bad U Trai .

en: Those that be near , and those that be far from thee , shall mock thee , which art infamous and much vexed .
kha: Ki ri ba-marjan bad ki ri ba hajngai ki krenbeiñ ïa pha namar ka jingbymdon aiñ ha pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba don hajan bad kiba jngai na me kin rkhie bein ia me, kiba sngewsih shibun bad kiba sngewsih shibun .

en: But unto none of them was Elias sent , save unto Sarepta , a city of Sidon , unto a woman that was a widow .
kha: Pynban , ïa u Elijah ym shym la phah hano hano ha Israel , hynrei , tang sha ka riewkynthei kaba shong basah ha Sarephath ha ka thain jong ka Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha uwei ruh na ki la phah ia u Elias, lait noh tang ha Sareptta, ka shnong Sidon, ha kawei ka kynthei kaba la duh noh .

en: And his disciples answered him , From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness ?
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno , ha kane ka ri shyiap ba uno uno u lah ban ïoh jingbam ka ban dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la jubab ia u: Naei u briew u lah ban pynhun ia kine ki briew da u kpu hangne ha ri khlaw ?

en: And the  Lord  was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him : and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Aaron ruh kat ban pynïap ïa u ; kumta ha kajuh ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la bitar shibun ia u Aaron ba u la pynjot ia u: bad nga la duwai na ka bynta u Aaron ruh ha kajuh ka por .

en: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place , and maintain their cause ,
kha: Na ka ïing jong me ha bneng to sngap ïa ki bad leh-isynei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngap ia ka jingduwai jong ki bad ka jingkyrpad jong ki ha bneng ka jaka shong jong me , bad pynneh ia ka daw jong ki , .

en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .
kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei bad ki khot kyrpad ïa u ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka daw kane u Hesekaiah u syiem bad u Isaiah u khun u Amoz ki la duwai bad ki la pyrta sha bneng .

en: And Solomon told her all her questions : there was not any thing hid from the king , which he told her not .
kha: U Solomon u jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong ka baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba eh kaba um lah ban pynshai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la iathuh ia ki jingkylli jong ka baroh: ym don ei ei kaba buhrieh na u syiem , kaba u la iathuh ia ka .

en: Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .
kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynti jong ngi bad wat kah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . Ngim kwah ban ïohsngew shaphang U Blei Bakhuid jong phi ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia phi na ka lynti , phai noh na ka lynti , pynlong ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel ban sangeh noh na khmat jong ngi .

en: For I know this , that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you , not sparing the flock .
kha: Nga tip ba hadien ba nga leit noh , ki suri barunar sat kin wan hapdeng jong phi , bad kin ym map ïa ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia kane , ba hadien ba nga la leit noh ki blang kiba sngewsih kin rung hapdeng jong phi , khlem da pynim ia ka kynhun .

en: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps , they blessed the  Lord  , and his people Israel .
kha: Haba u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohi katno ba la ai , ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  bad ki ïaroh ïa ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah bad ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la iohi ia ki lum , ki la kyrkhu ia U Trai bad ki briew jong u ki Israel .

en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion : whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul .
kha: To sheptieng ïa u syiem uba bitar kumba phi leh ïa u sing bakyrhuh ; kaba pynbitar ïa u ka long kaba pynïap ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia u syiem ka long kum ka jingsawa jong u sing: uba pynkhih ia u ban bitar u leh pop ia la ka jong ka mynsiem .

en: But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
kha: kumta ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u . Hynrei ki la sngewsheptieng ïa u paidbah , uba la ñiew ba U Jisu u dei u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la wad ban buh kti ia u , ki la tieng ia u paidbah namar ki la shim ia u kum u nongiathuhlypa .

en: But the high places were not taken away : the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .
kha: Pynban , ym shym la pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la shah weng noh: ki briew ki dang knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it  ; for I will give it unto thee .
kha: Mynta , khie leit bad khmih ïa ka ri baroh kawei , naba ngan ai ïa ka baroh ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , iaid lyngba ka ri ha ka jingjrong jong ka bad ha ka jingjylliew jong ka namar ngan ai ia ka ha me ; .

en: ( Hebrews 6 :1 ) As you continue , you will be better able to take in “solid food”—that is , deeper truths .
kha: ( Hebru 6 :1 ) Lada phi iaineh phin sa lah ban bam “ka jingbam kaba eh” —kata ka long ka jingshisha kaba jylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hebru 6 :1 ) Katba phi nang bteng, phin nang kham lah ban shim ia ki jingbam kiba kham jylliew  kata ka long, ki jingshisha kiba kham jylliew .

en: And when he was full forty years old , it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel .
kha: Haba u Moses u la dap sawphew snem ka rta , u la kut jingmut ban wad kumno la ju leh ïa ki para Israel jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la dap sawphew snem ka rta, ka la wan ha ka dohnud jong u ban leit jngoh ia ki hynmen jong u ki khun Israel .

en: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and twined linen .
kha: Ha ka rmiang jong ka la pynpur ïa ki dur soh Pomkranet da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad da ka linen bani .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ha ki tduh jong ka jain rong saw, bad rong saw bad rong saw bad rong saw .

en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shim ia uwei pat u langbrot; bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u langbrot .

en: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .
kha: Ki bymman ki sarong bad pynshitom beiñ ïa kiba duk ; pynngat ïa ki ha ki jingriam kiba ki la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman ha ka jingsarong jong u um pynshitom ia kiba duk: ai ba kin shah shim ha ki tiar kiba ki la pyrkhat .

en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of Elijah  ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai u Elijah ; u khynnah u sdang ban ring mynsiem biang bad u la im pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u Elijah bad ka mynsiem jong u khynnah ka la wan biang ha u , bad u la im biang .

en: And you , that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works , yet now hath he reconciled
kha: Ha kawei ka por phi la long jngai eh na U Blei bad phi la long ki nongshun jong u namar jong kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh bad pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi , kiba la shah pynkylla bad ki nongshun ha ka jingmut jong phi da ki kam bymman , hynrei mynta u la pynbeit .

en: And he went his way , and communed with the chief priests and captains , how he might betray him unto them .
kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit noh bad u la ïakren bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ shaphang kumno u lah ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah shipai , kumno u lah ban pyndem ia u ha ki .

en: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the  Lord  unto battle , to the plains of Jericho .
kha: Ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  kumba sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba la khreh ïa ka thma ki la jam sha shiliang sha ka pyntha kaba hajan ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba sawphew hajar ngut ki la iaid shakhmat ha khmat U Trai haduh ka thma, haduh ki madan Jerikho .

en: And those which remain shall hear , and fear , and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you .
kha: Te kiwei pat kin ïohsngew aïu ka la jia ; kin sngewsheptieng , bad kin ym nud shuh ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba sah kin iohsngew bad ki tieng , bad kin ym leh shuh ia kaba sniew hapdeng jong phi .

en: And Moses was fourscore years old , and Aaron fourscore and three years old , when they spake unto Pharaoh .
kha: Ha kata ka por mynba ki la kren ha u Pharaoh , u Moses u la don phraphew snem ka rta bad u Aaron u la don phraphew lai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la dap saw snem ka rta bad u Aaron u la dap saw snem ka rta, haba ki la kren ha u Pharaoh .

en: Yea , I think it meet , as long as I am in this tabernacle , to stir you up by putting you in remembrance  ;
kha: Nga pyrkhat ïa kane ba ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban pynkhih ïa ka jingkynmaw jong phi ïa kine kiei kiei katba nga dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , nga tharai ka iakynduh , katba nga dang don ha kane ka jaka ri jingri , ban pynkhih ia phi da kaba buh ia phi ha ka jingkynmaw ;

en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayers : these shall receive greater damnation .
kha: Ki shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad knieh noh na ki , ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta pat ki duwai jlan ha khmat ki briew . Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba khraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iing kiba bam dohkha ki leh ia ki jingduwai kiba jrong: kine kin ioh ia ka jingpynrem kaba kham khraw .

en: Jehovah used the prehuman Jesus as his “master worker” in creating all other things in heaven and on earth .
kha: Shuwa ba un wan long briew U Jehobah u la pyndonkam ïa u Jisu kum u “rangbah nongtrei” ha kaba thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehobah u la pyndonkam ia u Jisu uba dang kha khun kum u nongtrei ba kham bun jong u  ha kaba thaw ia kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha ka pyrthei .

en: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .
kha: Naba tang mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong pha , i khunlung hapoh jong nga i la kynthih da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha ka por ba ka sur jong ka jingkyrkhu jong me ka la sawa ha ki shkor jong nga, u babe u la rung ha ka kpoh jong nga na ka bynta ka jingkmen .

en: And the men turned their faces from thence , and went toward Sodom : but Abraham stood yet before the  Lord .
kha: Te kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah ki la mihnoh nangta , bad ki la nang leit shaphang Sodom ; hynrei U  Trai  u dang don bad u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki phai noh na kata ka jaka, bad ki la leit sha ka ri Sodom: hynrei u Abraham u dang ieng ha khmat U Trai .

en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet , What hath the  Lord  answered thee ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
kha: Ko Jeremaïah , kylli ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la jubab ïa phi ? Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to ong ha u nongiathuhlypa , Kaei kaba U Trai u la jubab ia me ? bad , Kaei kaba U Trai u la kren ?

en: ( Yea , a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also , ) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed .
kha: Bad ka jingsngewsih , kum ka waitlam banep , kan pynlwet ïa ka dohnud jong pha hi .
translated_en_to_kha: (Em, ka waitlam kan bthei lyngba ka mynsiem jong me hi ruh, ) ba ki jingpyrkhat jong kiba bun ki dohnud kin paw .

en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .
kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane phim treh satia ban shahshkor ïa nga , ngan pynshitom jur ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phim pat sngap ia kine baroh ha nga , te ngan pynshitom ia phi hynriew shah shuh na ka bynta ki pop jong phi .

en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard the law , that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka hukum ba la pule , ki la kyntait noh ïa ki nongwei na ka imlang sahlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia , haba ki la iohsngew ia ka hukum , ba ki la pyniakhlad na Israel ia u paidbah baroh .

en: Then Job arose , and rent his mantle , and shaved his head , and fell down upon the ground , and worshipped ,
kha: Te u Job u ïeng joit bad u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih . U khi ïa la ka khlieh bad u bret ïa lade da pyllup ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Job u la ieng bad u la pynkhih ia ka jainkup jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia la ka khlieh bad u la dem khrup ha ka khyndew bad u la mane ia u .

en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection  ; and they asked him ,
kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan sha u katto katne na ki Sadusi kiba kyntait ba ka don kano kano ka jingmihpat bad ki la kylli ia u;

en: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew u bymkohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai baroh jong U Blei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta u bym pynskhem ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum ban leh ia ki . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: Soon Jesus will remove all wickedness and suffering from this earth .—Psalm 37 :9-11  ; Proverbs 2 :21 , 22 .
kha: Shen , u Jisu un weng noh baroh ki jingsniew bad jingjynjar na kane ka pyrthei .—Salm 37 :9-11 ; Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kham hadien U Jisu un weng noh ia ka jingsniew baroh bad ka jingjynjar na kane ka pyrthei .  Psalm 37 :9-11 Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .

en: And they sware unto the  Lord  with a loud voice , and with shouting , and with trumpets , and with cornets .
kha: Ha ka sur kaba jam ki shim ïa ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba kin bat ïa ka jutang , bad nangta ki pyrta bad ki put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngap jar ia U Trai da ka sur kaba jam, bad da ka jingpyrta, bad da ki turoi bad da ki turoi .

en: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple , neither with multitude , nor with tumult .
kha: Ka la long mynba nga dang leh ïa kane , ba ki la lap ïa nga hapoh ka Templ hadien ba nga la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid . Ym shym don u paidbah bad nga bad kam shym don ka jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba katto katne ki Jiw na Asia ki la shem ba nga la pynkhuid ha ka tempi, ym da ka jingbun briew, ne da ka jingkhihwin .

en: For he is our peace , who hath made both one , and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us ;
kha: Namar U Khrist da lade hi u la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingsuk da kaba pynlong kawei ka jaitbynriew ïa ki Jiw bad ki Jentil . Da ka met jong u hi , u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh kaba pynïakhlad ïa ki bad kaba pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u long ka jingsuk jong ngi, uba la pynlong ia ngi baroh arngut, bad u la pynpra ia ka kynroh pdeng jong ka jingpyniakhlad hapdeng jong ngi ; .

en: And he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , of which the  Lord  said , In Jerusalem will I put my name .
kha: U tei ïa ki duwan ba-thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba dei ban mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tei ia ki nonglehkai ha ka iing U Trai , na kaba U Trai u la ong , Ha Jerusalem ngan buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .
kha: hangta ki jingthung ki plung . Ki san kum ka bri ki diengsoh Pomkranet bad ki sei ki soh bakynsai . Ym don kano kano ka jingduna ïa u henna bad ïa u nard ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong u ki long kum ka jingthiah jong ki jingbam ba thiang: ki rmiang shyntur jong u kum ki syntiew , ki pynhap ia ka jingsma kaba thiang kaba thiang .

en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables  ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :
kha: U Jisu u la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah ; um ju ong ïa kano kano ha ki khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka pharshi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki kren ia U Jisu ha u paidbah ha ki pharshi ; bad khlem ka jingiakren pharshi um ju kren ia ki:

en: But when Jesus heard it , he answered him , saying ,  Fear not : believe only , and she shall be made whole .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata bad u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng ; tang shu ngeit , bad kan sa khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata, u la jubab ia u, u da ong: Wat tieng: ngeit tang , bad kan sa long kaba pura .

en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,
kha: U Jisu u la wan phai na ka wah Jordan uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem sha ka ri shyiap ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan phai na Jordan , bad la ialam ia u da U Mynsiem sha ri khlaw .

en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlaw ; bad ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynlong ia u Seir uba kham sniew, bad ngan ot noh na ka ia uta uba leit noh bad ia uta uba wan phai .

en: And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .
kha: Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da mut khnang , phi dei ban wanrah kawei ka blang kaba shisnem ka rta kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u pop lyngba ka jingbymtip , te un wanrah ia ka blang kaba nyngkong na ka bynta ka jingknia pop .

en: And he sware unto her , Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me , I will give it thee , unto the half of my kingdom .
kha: Da ki jingsmai ba bunsien u la ong ha ka ,  Nga smai ba ngan ai ha pha kano kano kaba pha pan , wat haduh shiteng ka hima jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sngap jar ia ka , Kaei kaei kaba me pan na nga , ngan ai ia ka ha me, haduh shiteng na ka hima jong nga .

en: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :
kha: ka Lebaoth , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Lebaoth bad u Shilhim bad u Ain bad u Rimmon: ki shnong baroh ki long arphew hynniew tylli bad ki shnong jong ki:

en: For thou hast had five husbands  ; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband : in that saidst thou truly .
kha: Pha la shongkurim ïa ki san ngut ki rangbah , bad u briew uba pha ïashong mynta um dei u tnga trai jong pha . Pha la ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la don san ngut ki tnga ; bad uta uba me don mynta um dei u tnga jong me: ha kata ka jingong jong me shisha .

en: In the body of his flesh through death , to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight :
kha: Hynrei mynta , da ka jingïap jong U Khun jong u ha kane ka doh , U Blei u la pynlong ïa phi ki paralok jong u , khnang ban pynïeng ïa phi , kiba khuid , kiba sngur , bad kiba khlem jingduna ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka met jong ka doh jong u lyngba ka jingiap , ban pyni ia phi kaba khuid bad kaba khlem jingbakla bad kaba khlem jingbakla ha khmat jong u:

en: But Jezebel his wife came to him , and said unto him , Why is thy spirit so sad , that thou eatest no bread ?
kha: Ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ka leit sha u , bad ka kylli ,  Balei phi khuslai katne katne ? Balei phim treh bam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jesbel ka tnga jong u ka la wan sha u bad ka la ong ha u, Balei ba ka mynsiem jong me ka sngewsih haduh katta katta ba me bam ia u kpu ?

en: For which cause we faint not ; but though our outward man perish , yet the inward man is renewed day by day .
kha: Na kane ka daw ngim ju duh jingkyrmen . Wat la ki met ba kynja doh jong ngi ki la nang pyut noh , pynban , ïa ki met ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi la nang pynthymmai na kawei ka sngi sha kawei ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka daw ngim ju lyngngoh hynrei wat la u briew uba shabar jong ngi u jah noh hynrei u briew uba shapoh u nang thymmai man la ka sngi .

en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid  ; they shall prevail against him , as a king ready to the battle .
kha: U tip ba ka lawei jong u ka long kaba dum ; ka jingbymman , kum u syiem badonbor , ka apthap ban tur ïaleh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjyllei bad ka jingsngewsih kan pynlong ia u ban tieng ; kin jop pyrshah ia u , kum u syiem uba la pynkhreh ia ka thma .

en: I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .
kha: Wan bad nga na ki lumbah ka Lebanon , ko ka nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebanon . Wan hiar na kliar u lum Amana , na u lum Senir bad u lum Hermon , ha kaba ki sing bad ki  labasa ki shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kynnoh ia phi ko khun kynthei Jerusalem , lada phi shem ia u baieit jong nga , ba phi iathuh ia u , ba nga pang ia ka jingieit .

en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Build me here seven altars , and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams .
kha: U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Tei ïa nga hangne hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad wallam ïa nga hynñiew tylli ki masi kyrtong bad hynñiew tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u Balak, To tei ia nga hangne hynriew tylli ki almari, bad pynkhreh ia nga hangne hynriew tylli ki masi bad hynriew tylli ki langbrot .

en: And knew not until the flood came , and took them all away  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
kha: pynban kim sngewthuh kaei kaba la jia tad haduh ba ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka rong noh ïa ki baroh . Kan sa long kumta haba U Khun U Briew u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um tip haduh ba ka jingshlei um ka la wan , bad u la shim noh ia ki baroh; kumta ruh ka jingwan jong u Khun u briew kan long .

en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and sent forth the dove  ; which returned not again unto him any more .
kha: Nangta u ap sa hynñiew sngi , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro ; ha kane ka sien kam shym la wan phai shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sah sa hynriew sngi; bad u la phah ia ka dohkha; kaba khlem wan phai shuh sha u .

en: And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives  ; and his disciples also followed him .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na ka nongbah bad u la leit , kumba u la ju leh , sha u lum ki Olib ; bad ki synran ki la leit lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih noh, bad u la leit kumba u ju leh, sha u lum Olives bad ki synran jong u ruh ki la bud ia u.

en: Then I was by him , as one brought up with him : and I was daily his delight , rejoicing always before him  ;
kha: Nga don hajan jong u kum u nongring dur , man ka sngi nga la ai jingkmen ïa u , nga da shadkmen borabor ha khmat jong u —
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la don hajan jong u, kumba la pynsan ia u: bad nga la sngewbha man ka sngi, nga la sngewbha beit ha khmat jong u;

en: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .
kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Solomon ,  Kata kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad shaphang ka jingstad jong phi ka long kaba shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u syiem , Ka la long ka khubor kaba shisha ba nga la iohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang ki kam jong me bad shaphang ka jingstad jong me .

en: Let the day perish wherein I was born , and the night in which it was said , There is a man child conceived .
kha: A Blei , to buh ka jingtim halor ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga ; buh ka jingtim halor ka miet mynba la pun ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka sngi kan jah noh ha kaba la kha ia nga, bad ka miet ha kaba la ong , Don u khun shynrang uba la kha .

en: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice : but , being stronger than she , forced her , and lay with her .
kha: Hynrei um sngap ïa ka ; bad namar ba u kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka , u la jop , bad u la batbor ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la um sngap ia ka sur jong ka: hynrei, da kaba kham khlain ban ia ka, u la pynbor ia ka bad u la thiah bad ka .

en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .
kha: Ki rangbah nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U  Trai  da lade hi un long u Syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongpynim kin wan shaneng ha u lum Seion ban bishar ia ka lum Iso; bad ka hima kan long U Trai s .

en: In which time Moses was born , and was exceeding fair , and nourished up in his father s house three months :
kha: Ka la long ha kane ka por ba la kha ïa u Moses , u khunlung uba bhabriew haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por la kha ia u Moses , bad u la long uba palat ia ka hok , bad u la bam ha iing u kpa jong u lai bnai:

en: If there be a messenger with him , an interpreter , one among a thousand , to shew unto man his uprightness :
kha: Lehse u angel u lah ban wan ïarap ïa u — uwei na ki hajar ki angel jong U Blei , uba pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa ki kamram jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don u nonglam khubor bad u, u nongpynkylla ktien, uwei napdeng ka hajar, ban pyni ha u briew ia ka jinglong hok jong u:

en: Write the things which thou hast seen , and the things which are , and the things which shall be hereafter  ;
kha: Thoh te , ïa kiei kiei kiba me ïohi ; kita kiei kiei kiba long mynta bad kita kiei kiei ki ban sa jia hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Thoh ia kiei kiei kiba me la iohi bad kiei kiei kiba long bad kiei kiei kiba hadien;

en: O  Lord  , I know that the way of man is not in himself : it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps .
kha: A  Trai  , nga tip ba ym don uno uno uba long u kynrad ïa la ka lawei jong u hi ; ym don uno uno u briew uba bat synshar ïa ka jingim jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , nga tip ba ka lynti jong u briew kam don ha lade: kam don ha u briew uba iaid ban pynbeit ia ki step jong u .

en: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .
kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng ,  Hynrei kane ka long kaba jem ïa U  Trai  ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long tang kaei kaei kaba jem ha khmat U Trai: un aiti ia ki nong Moab ruh ha ka kti jong phi .

en: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God , and set a watch against them day and night , because of them .
kha: hynrei ngi duwai ha U Blei jong ngi bad ngi buh ki rangbah ban ap phira bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ngi la leh ia ka jingduwai jong ngi ha U Blei jong ngi , bad ngi la buh ia ka jingpahara pyrshah ia ki miet bad sngi , namar jong ki .

en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue , to fasten it on high upon the mitre  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Ki teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai uba jngum , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la teh ha ka da ka rong saw, ban pynskhem ia ka ha jrong ha ka met; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah : and the  Lord  struck him , and he died .
kha: U Jeroboam um shym lah khie khlieh shuh ha ka bor jong u ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Abijah . Ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Jeroboam ruh um shym la koit shuh ha ki sngi u Abiah: bad U Trai u la shoh ia u , bad u la iap .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I am the way , the truth , and the life : no man cometh unto the Father , but by me .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Nga long ka lynti , ka jingshisha , bad ka jingim , ym don uno uno u ba leit sha U Kpa lait na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u, Nga long ka lynti, ka jingshisha bad ka jingim: ym don mano mano ruh kiba wan sha U Kpa hynrei da nga .

en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done : and there is no respect of persons .
kha: Bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla yn siew na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba bakla kiba u leh , namar U Blei u bishar ïa uwei pa uwei da kajuh ka jingthew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba leh bakla un pdiang ia ka jingbakla kaba u la leh: bad ym don ka jingburom ia ki briew .

en: Saying , I will declare thy name unto my brethren , in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee .
kha: U ong ha U Blei ,  Ngan pynbna ha ki para jong nga , ïa kaei kaba me la leh ; ngan rwai ïaroh ïa me ha ki jingïamane lang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , ngan pynbna ia ka kyrteng jong me ha ki hynmen jong nga , hapdeng ka balang ngan rwai iaroh ia me .

en: Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ki ktien jong kane ka jutang bad to kren ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem;

en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year , and it shall bring forth fruit for three years .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew ha ka snem kaba hynriew khnang ba kan pynmih bam kyrhai na ka bynta ar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan hukum ia ka jingkyrkhu jong nga halor jong phi ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad kan pynmih soh lai snem .

en: There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :
kha: La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la riam ha ki jaiñ kiba remdor eh bad uba im ha ka jingpahuh bakhraw man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la phong da ka jain kaba lieh bad kaba bha, bad u la iaid lyngkot man la ka sngi:

en: As soon then as they were come to land , they saw a fire of coals there , and fish laid thereon , and bread .
kha: Haba ki la ïa jam sha ryngkew , ki la ïohi ïa u rnga ding hangta bad ïa ka dohkha ba la buh halor jong ka , bad katto katne u kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang shu poi ha ka khyndew , ki la iohi ia ka ding dewiong hangta , bad ki dohkha ba la buh hangta bad u kpu .

en: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal , he , and all the people of war with him , and all the mighty men of valour .
kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba kynsai tam , ki la mihnoh na Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la kiew na Gilgal , ma u bad ki briew baroh kiba ialeh thma bad u bad ki riewshlur baroh .

en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Lebi ruh u la wan ïaid , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa uta u briew , bad nangta u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh u Lebi, haba u la don ha kata ka jaka, u la wan bad u la peit ia u, bad u la iaid sha shiliang .

en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee : bind them about thy neck  ; write them upon the table of thine heart :
kha: Wat ai ba ka jinglong bashaniah bad baïaineh kin iehnoh ïa phi . Teh ïa ki sawdong ka ryndang jong phi ; thoh ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ka jingisynei bad ka jingshisha kan iehnoh ia me: to teh ia ki ha ka ryndang jong me; thoh ia ki ha ka miej jong ka dohnud jong me:

en: And the  Lord  stirred up an adversary unto Solomon , Hadad the Edomite : he was of the king s seed in Edom .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la pynjia ba u Hadad , na ka longïing syiem jong u Edom , ban phai pyrshah ïa u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhih ia u nongshun ha u Solomon, Hadad u nong Edome: u la long na u symbai syiem ha Edome .

en: Abraham said :  " Do you , then , worship beside Allah a thing that can neither benefit you nor hurt you ? "
kha: U Abraham u la ong :  " Hato phi phi mane nalor U Allah ia kaei kaei kaba ym lah ban pynmyntoi ne pynmynsaw ia phi ? "
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong: "Hato phi, te, phi mane hajan u Allah ia kaei kaei kaba ym lah ban pynmyntoi ia phi ne pynmong ia phi ?"

en: And king Solomon shall be blessed , and the throne of David shall be established before the  Lord  for ever .
kha: Hynrei un kyrkhu ïa nga , bad un pynskhem ïa ka hima u Dabid junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem Solomon un long uba la kyrkhu bad ka khet u Dabid kan long kaba skhem ha khmat U Trai junom .

en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend  ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .
kha: Ha ka jingjynjar kum kane nga donkam ïa ki paralok bashisha — la nga la klet ne khlem klet ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba la shah pynshitom dei ban pyni na u paralok jong u ; hynrei u iehnoh ia ka jingtieng ia Uba donbor baroh .

en: Appoint a way , that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites , and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced .
kha: Kawei ka dak kan pyn-i ïa u syiem ïa ka lynti sha Rabbah ka nongbah ki Ammon , bad kawei pat ka lynti sha Judah , sha Jerusalem ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka lynti , ba ka waitlam kan wan sha Rabbah jong ki Ammon , bad sha Judah ha Jerusalem .

en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things . )
kha: Kumta uta uba hiar shapoh u long uta ujuh uba leit kiew shaneng , shajrong bad sha lyndet ki bneng , ban pyndap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la hiar u long kumjuh ruh uba la kiew sha jngai palat ia ki bneng baroh , ba un pyndap ia kiei kiei baroh . )

en: That there should be no schism in the body ; but that the members should have the same care one for another .
kha: Bad kumta ba yn ym don ka jingïapait ïapra ha kata ka met , hynrei baroh ki dkhot met kiba ïapher kin ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba dei ban don ka jingpang sniehdoh ha ka met ; hynrei ba ki dkhot ki dei ban don kajuh ka jingsumar iwei ia iwei pat .

en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .
kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba eh ïa uno uno ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba hok . Ka lah ban long ba don uno uno uba nud ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar tang khyndiat eh na ka bynta u briew uba hok un iap: hynrei ka jingmih na ka bynta u briew uba bha don kiba nud wat ban iap .

en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .
kha: Shaphang ka jingjynjar kaba mynta , nga pyrkhat ba ka kham bha ïa u briew ban sah kumba u long .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tharai namarkata ba kane ka long kaba bha na ka bynta ka jingjynjar kaba mynta, nga ong , ba ka long kaba bha ia u briew kumta ban long .

en: But he shall say , I tell you , I know you not whence ye are  ; depart from me , all ye workers of iniquity .
kha: Hynrei un ong biang , ‘ Ngam ithuh nangno phi ïawan . Khie leit noh na nga , phi baroh ki briew kiba bymman !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un ong , Nga ong ia phi , ngam tip ia phi naei phi leit noh na nga , phi baroh ki nongtrei bymman .

en: Son of man , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , and to his multitude  ; Whom art thou like in thy greatness ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ong ha u syiem jong ka Ijipt bad ha ki briew jong u baroh :  Katno ka jingkhrawbor jong me ! Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , kren ha u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt bad ha ka jingbun briew jong u; Iano me long kum ha ka jingkhraw jong me ?

en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,
kha: ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei ; ki ri Ephraim bad Manasseh ; ka ri Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei bad ka ri Ephraim bad ka ri Judah baroh kawei haduh ka duriaw kaba kut .

en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , uba shi para bad u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah , kumta u Kaleb u ai ïa ka Akhsah ha u ban shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Othniel u khun u Kenas, u hynmen u Caleb, u la shim ia ka : bad u la ai ia u ia ka khun jong u ha ka tnga jong u .

en: Wherefore putting away lying , speak every man truth with his neighbour : for we are members one of another .
kha: Nangta , ym don shuh ka jinglamler! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha la u parabangeit , namar baroh ngi long ki dkhot ba ïalong lang ha ka met U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ban weng noh ia ka jinglamler, kren ia uwei pa uwei bad u paramarjan jong u: namar ngi long ki dkhot iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?
kha: Ngim lah ban shem u briew uba kham bit ban ïa u Joseph , u briew uba don U Mynsiem U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha ki shakri jong u: Hato ngi lah ban shem ia u briew uba kum une u long u briew ha uba U Mynsiem U Blei U don ?

en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof : so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .
kha: Sumar bha ïa u dieng Dumbur bad phin ïoh ïa ki soh ban bam . U shakri uba sumar bha ïa la u kynrad un ïoh burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sumar ia u dieng sohjew un bam ia u soh jong u: kumta uta uba ap ia u kynrad jong u un shah burom .

en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .
kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba pynim ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka: bad uno uno uba duh noh ia la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ia ka .

en: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :
kha: Haba kumta , uei uba dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la otsher shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shabar , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar um dei u Jiw uba long uwei uba paw ; bad kata kam dei ruh ka jingotsher kaba paw shabar ha ka doh:

en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;
kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A  Trai  , haba me ïarap ïa ki briew jong me ; kynthup ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia nga ko Trai, da ka jingsngewbha kaba me shah ha ki briew jong me: Ko leit jngoh ia nga da ka jingpynim jong me;

en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O  Lord  ? wilt thou hold thy peace , and afflict us very sore ?
kha: A  Trai  , hato yn ym pynkhih ïa me da kane baroh ? Hato men ym leh ei ei bad shah ba ngin shah jynjar palat ïa kaba ngi lah ban shah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me kyntait ia lade na ka bynta kine kiei kiei, ko Trai ? me bat ia ka jingsuk jong me, bad pynshitom ia ngi shibun ?

en: If they say , Come with us , let us lay wait for blood , let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause :
kha: Tharai lada ki ong ,  Ale ngin leit apthap ïano ïano ban ïoh pynïap ! Ïa ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa ki briew kiba lui lui tang ban shu ïoh leh dusmon !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki ong , To wan ryngkat bad ngi , to ngin ia thiah ha ka snam , to ngin ia lyngngoh kyrpang ia ki bym don pop khlem daw:

en: And say to Archippus , Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord , that thou fulfil it .
kha: Bad ong ïa u Arkhippos ,  Pynthikna ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba la ai ha me ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha u Archippus , To sumar ia ka jingshakri kaba me la ioh ha U Trai , ba me pyndep ia ka .

en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same , and made them other five talents .
kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la leit shisyndon bad u la khaïi ïa la ka pisa bad u la ïohnong sa san hajar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uta uba la ioh ia ki san tylli ki talent u la leit bad u la khaii bad kijuh ki mar , bad u la pynlong ia ki sa san tylli ki talent .

en: And also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy the good of all his labour , it is the gift of God .
kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi dei ban bam bad dih bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ba uwei pa uwei u dei ban bam bad dih bad ban sngewbha ia ka jingbha jong ka jingtrei shitom jong u baroh , ka long ka jingai jong U Blei .

en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .
kha: La don katto katne ngut ki nongap langbrot ha kata ka bynta jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ha kajuh ka ri ki nongap langbrot kiba sah ha lyngkha , ki ap ia ka kynhun jong ki miet .

en: And his lord was wroth , and delivered him to the tormentors , till he should pay all that was due unto him .
kha: U Syiem u la bitar lep , bad u la phah ïa uta u shakri sha byndi ba yn pynshitom ïa u tad haduh ba un da siew pat ïa ka ram baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u u la bitar , bad u la aiti ia u ha ki nongpynshitom bein haduh ba un da siew lut ia kaba dei ban siew ia u .

en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
kha: ka Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , bad ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Iron , bad u Migdalel, u Horem, bad u Bethanath, bad u Bethshesh ; shiphew tylli ki shnong jong ki .

en: As it is written , He that had gathered much had nothing over ; and he that had gathered little had no lack .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uta uba la lum shibun um shym la don tam keiñ , bad uta uba la lum khyndiat um shym ïoh duna palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh , Uta uba la lum bun um don ei ei shuh shuh bad uta uba la lum tang khyndiat um don jingduna .

en: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewbha ïa kata ka jingai jingmut bad ki la ïamynjur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka balang baroh ka la ong ba kin leh kumta : namar kata ka long kaba dei ha khmat ki briew baroh .

en: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another : and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another .
kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long shi sut , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyniasoh ia ki san tylli ki jingtap iwei ia iwei pat: bad kiwei pat ki san tylli ki jingtap u la pyniasoh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues , and greetings in the markets .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ieit ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog bad ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew .
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ko Pharisi ! namar phi ieit ia ki jaka shong ba shalor tam ha ki synagog bad ki jingai khublei ha ki iew ki hat .

en: But was rebuked for his iniquity : the dumb ass speaking with man s voice forbad the madness of the prophet .
kha: bad la sneng ïa u na ka bynta ka pop . U kada jong u , u la kren ha ka sur briew bad u la khang ïa ka kam leh bieit jong u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la pynrem ia ka jingbymhok jong u: ka tdong kaba dum kaba kren da ka sur briew ka la pynpaw ia ka jinglong bieit jong u nongiathuhlypa .

en: The Delhi Police and National Disaster Response Force are trying to identify the chemical and how it leaked .
kha: Ki pulit jong ka Delhi bad ki kynhun ba peit ia ki jingjia ba sngewsih ki dang pyrshang ban ithuh ia katei ka dawai bad kumno ka la tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ka Delhi bad ka National Disaster Response Force ki dang pyrshang ban ithuh ia u dawai bad kumno u la tuid .

en: Yet the  Lord  hath not given you an heart to perceive , and eyes to see , and ears to hear , unto this day .
kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi um pat shym la ai ha phi ban shemphang ïa kaei kaba phi la mad .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai um shym la ai ia phi ia ka dohnud ban sngewthuh, bad ki khmat ban iohi bad ki shkor ban iohsngew, haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Then Judas , which betrayed him , answered and said , Master , is it I ? He said unto him ,  Thou hast said .
kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la kren ,  Da shisha , ko Nonghikai , mem shym mut ïa nga ?  u la kylli . U Jisu u la jubab ,  Me ong kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Judas uba la shet kylla ia u, u la jubab bad u la ong: Ko Nonghikai, hato dei ma nga ? U la ong ha u , Me la ong .

en: His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?
kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki synran ki la jubab ,  dang shen ki briew hangta ki la kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me , bad hato me thmu ban leit phai shata ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, ki Jiw kiba hadien ki la wad ban maw ia me ; bad me leit biang sha kata ?

en: And immediately I was in the spirit : and , behold , a throne was set in heaven , and one sat on the throne .
kha: Mar kumta hi , U Mynsiem u la shimti ïa nga . Hangta ha bneng la don ka khet bad la don uwei uba shong halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi nga la don ha ka mynsiem: bad, ha khmih, la buh ia ka khet ha bneng, bad uwei u la shong ha ka khet .

en: And Judah said unto Onan , Go in unto thy brother s wife , and marry her , and raise up seed to thy brother .
kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha u Onan , u para jong u Er ,  Khie leit bad thiah bad ka tnga u hynmen jong me uba la ïap . Pyndep ïa ka kamram kaba me dei ban leh kum u para kynsi jong ka , khnang ba u hynmen jong me un ïoh ki nongmih pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong ha u Onan, To leit sha ka tnga jong u hynmen jong me, bad to shongkurim ia ka, bad to pynmih symbai ia u hynmen jong me .

en: And to them which were in Hebron , and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt .
kha: U la phah ïa ka sha ki jaka baroh ha kiba ma u bad ki briew jong ki la ju ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kito kiba don ha Hebron bad ha ki jaka baroh ha kaba u Dabid hi bad ki briew jong u ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki ki jaka ba ki ju leit sha ki

en: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :
kha: Haba u Saul u la wan poi hajan ka nongbah Damaskos , kynsan ka jingshai na ka sahit bneng ka la thaba lep sawdong ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang iaid, u la wan hajan u Damaskos: bad kynsan kynsan u la shai sawdong jong u ka jingshai na bneng:

en: And I will pray the Father , and he shall give you another Comforter , that he may abide with you for ever  ;
kha: Ngan pan na U Kpa , bad un ai ïa phi ïa uwei pat U Nongïarap    , u ban shongsah bad phi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan duwai ia U Kpa , bad un ai sa kawei pat ka Jingsngewsih ia phi , ba un kohnguh ia phi junom ; .

en: And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :
kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka plie , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei hapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, ka tempi jong ka jingphla ha bneng:

en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  un ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Ngan wan sha Jerusalem ban ïada ïa phi bad ban pynim ïa phi baroh kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Nongsiewspah un wan sha Seion bad ha kito kiba phai noh na ka jingpynkhein ha u Jakob , ong U Trai .

en: Ishant has not been selected in the Indian squad that are currently in England for the ICC Champions Trophy .
kha: U Ishant um shym la shah jied ha ka kynhun jong ka India kaba don mynta ha England na ka bynta ka ICC Champions Trophy .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishan um shym la shah jied ha ka kynhun jong ka ri India kaba don mynta ha England na ka bynta ka ICC Champions Trophy .

en: For the  Lord  had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham s wife .
kha: Namar kaei kaba la jia ha ka Sarah , ka tnga jong u Abraham , U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei baroh ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Abimelekh . Kumta u Abraham u duwai na ka bynta u Abimelekh , bad U Blei u la pynkhiah ïa u . U la pynkhiah ruh ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki mraw kynthei jong u , ba kumta ki ruh ki lah ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la khang stet ia ki kpoh baroh jong ka iing Abimelech , namar ka Sarah Abraham .

en: For even when we were with you , this we commanded you , that if any would not work , neither should he eat .
kha: Mynba ngi dang don bad phi , ngi ju ïathuh ïa phi ,  Ïa uno uno uba kyntait ban trei yn ym shah ba un bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat haba ngi la don bad phi, ia kane ngi la hukum ia phi, ba lada uno uno un ym trei , lymne un ym bam .

en: And Jonathan answered Saul his father , and said unto him , Wherefore shall he be slain ? what hath he done ?
kha: Balei u dei ban ïap ?  u Jonathan u jubab .  U la leh aïu eh ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la jubab ia la u kpa bad u la ong ha u: Balei un shah pyniap ? kaei kaba u la leh ?

en: Simon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles , to take out of them a people for his name .
kha: U Simon u dang shu dep batai kumno ba U Blei u la pyn-i nyngkong ïa ka jingpyrkhat na ka bynta ki Jentil da kaba shim napdeng jong ki ïa u paidlang ban long u jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon u la pynbna kumno U Blei ha kaba nyngkong u la leit jngoh ia ki Jutang , ban shim noh na ki ia ka jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
kha: U Joseph u ong ha u syiem ,  Ki jingphohsniew baroh ar tylli ki mut ïa kajuh . U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba un sa leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha u Pharaoh , Ka jingphohsniew jong u Pharaoh ka long kawei: U Blei u la pyni ia u Pharaoh ia kaei kaba u thmu ban leh .

en: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language , but to the house of Israel  ;
kha: Ngam shym la phah ïa me sha ka jaitbynriew kaba kren ïa ka ktien nongwei kaba eh ban sngewthuh , hynrei sha ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la phah sha ki briew kiba kren phylla bad kiba don ka ktien kaba eh , hynrei sha ka iing Israel ; .

en: And when the  Lord  saw it , he abhorred them , because of the provoking of his sons , and of his daughters .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kata , u bitar da shisha , bad u kyntait ïa la ki khun shynrang bad kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai u la iohi ia ka , u la sngewsih ia ki namar ka jingpynkhih ia ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki khun kynthei jong u .

en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered , saying , Master , we would see a sign from thee .
kha: Nangta katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ki Pharisi ki la kren .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa me ba me leh kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta katto katne na ki nongthoh bad na ki Pharisi ki la jubab, ki da ong: Ko Nonghikai, ngin sa iohi ia ka dak na me .

en: She is hardened against her young ones , as though they were not hers : her labour is in vain without fear  ;
kha: Ka leh kumba ki pylleng kim dei ki jong ka , bad kam salia ba ki jingpyrshang jong ka ki pulom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la shah pynkhlain pyrshah ia ki samla jong ka, kumba kim dei ki jong ka: ka jingtrei jong ka ka long lehnohei khlem jingtieng ; .

en: I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .
kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka bor jong me , A  Trai  U Nongsynshar ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingbha jong me , tang ka jong me hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit ha ka bor U Trai Blei: Ngan kdew ia ka hok jong me, wat ia me hi .

en: And if Christ be in you , the body is dead because of sin ; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness .
kha: Hynrei lada U Khrist u im hapoh jong phi , U Mynsiem u long ka jingim na ka bynta jong phi namar la pynlong ka hok hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada U Khrist U long ha phi , ka met ka la iap namar ka pop ; hynrei U Mynsiem U long ka jingim namar ka hok .

en: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as thou hast heard , and live ?
kha: Don mo ki briew kiba dang im hadien ba ki la ïohsngew ïa u blei uba kren ha ki na ka ding , kumba phi , phi la ïohsngew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki briew ki ju iohsngew ia ka sur U Blei kaba kren na pdeng ka ding kumba me la iohsngew bad im ?

en: Charity suffereth long , and is kind ; charity envieth not ; charity vaunteth not itself , is not puffed up ,
kha: Ka jingieit ka ïaishah slem bad ka lehsbun ; kam ju pihuiñ lane kam ju kob sarong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingai sngewbha ka shah shitom slem , bad ka long kaba sbun;

en: Therefore , behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her .
kha: Te ngan leit ïalam biang ïa ka sha ri shyiap ; hangta ngan khroh biang ïa ka da ki ktien ieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , ha khmih , ngan pynsngewbha ia ka bad ngan wanrah ia ka sha ri khlaw , bad ngan kren suk ia ka .

en: And he thought within himself , saying , What shall I do , because I have no room where to bestow my fruits ?
kha: U la sdang ban pyrkhat ha lade , ‘ Ngam don hangno hangno ban buh ïa ki jingthung jong nga baroh . Aïu nga lah ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrkhat hapoh jong u da kaba ong , Ngan leh aiu namar ngam don jaka ban ai ia ki soh jong nga ?

en: And David answered and said , Behold the king s spear ! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Syiem kynrad , une u sum jong phi . Ai ba uwei na ki briew jong phi un wan shim ïa u nangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la jubab bad u la ong: Ha khmih u syiem u la wan shajan bad u la leit shim ia ka .

en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .
kha: Un leit phai na kajuh ka lynti na kaba u la wan , khlem da rung sha kane ka nongbah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka lynti kaba u wan, da kajuh ka lynti un wan phai, bad un ym wan sha kane ka shnong , ong U Trai .

en: But when the morning was now come , Jesus stood on the shore : but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus .
kha: Katba nang mih ka sngi , U Jisu u la ïeng halor ryngkew , hynrei ki synran kim ithuh ba dei U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka step ka la poi, U Jisu u la ieng ha rud duriaw: hynrei ki synran kim tip ba u long U Jisu .

en: O  Lord  , how manifold are thy works ! in wisdom hast thou made them all : the earth is full of thy riches .
kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong shibun kiei kiei ! Haduh katno me la pynlong ha ka jingstad jong me ïa ki baroh ! Ka pyrthei ka dap tang da ki jingthaw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, katno tylli ki kam jong me ! ha ka jingstad me la thaw ia ki baroh: ka khyndew ka dap da ki spah jong me .

en: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
kha: Suk ma phi kiba thngan mynta ; yn pyndap ïa phi ! Suk ma phi kiba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia phi kiba thngan mynta: namar phin sa dap . Kyrkhu ia phi kiba iam mynta: namar phin sa rkhie .

en: And she answered and said unto him , Yes , Lord : yet the dogs under the table eat of the children s crumbs .
kha: Ko Kynrad ,  ka la jubab ,  wat ki ksew ha khrum ka miej ki bam ïa ki jingbam ba la sah tam na ki khun !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la jubab bad ka la ong ha u, Hooid, ko Trai: hynrei ki kulai hapoh ka miej ki bam ia ki khun ki bam ia ki jingbam .

en: Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
kha: Wat ha Lum Sinai ruh phi la pynbitar shla ïa U  Trai  kat haduh ban pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha Horeb phi la pynbitar ia U Trai ban bitar , haduh ba U Trai u la bitar ia phi ban pynjot ia phi .

en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong ka U long U  Trai  ; suk kita ki briew kiba u la jied ban long ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong u u long U Trai ; bad ki briew kiba u la jied na ka bynta la ka jong ka pateng .

en: But if they will not pass over with you armed , they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan .
kha: Hynrei lada kim jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad leit bad phi sha ka thma , kin ïoh ïa la ka bhah jong ka jingïohkynti ha ka ri Kanaan , kumba phi ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada kin ym iaid lait bad phi da ki tiar ialeh , kin don ki jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phi ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: So then neither is he that planteth any thing , neither he that watereth ; but God that giveth the increase .
kha: Uta uba bet bad uta uba ai um kim long ei ei da shisha . Dei U Blei uba kongsan , namar u pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta te ym dei ma u uba thung ei ei, lymne uta uba ai um ; hynrei U Blei uba ai ia ka jingroi .

en: But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong u , u long uta uba ïa ka jingieit ïa U Blei la pynjanai da shisha . Dei da kane ba kumno ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba ngi long ha U Blei :
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba bat ia ka ktien jong u, ha u shisha ka long ka jingieit U Blei kaba janai: da kata ngi tip ba ngi don ha u .

en: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .
kha: Bad u Ïoannis u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla :  Nga la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paro na bneng , bad u shongsah halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la thoh ia ka jingthoh, u da ong, nga la iohi ia U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar na bneng kum ka paro, bad ka la shong halor jong u .

en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing ? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father .
kha: Naba tang shi pisa phi lah ban thied ar tylli ki sim ïing , pynban ym don kawei ka sim ïing kaba hap ha ka khyndew khlem ka jingshah U Kpa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ar tylli ki sim kim shym la die na ka bynta ka jaka kaba jngai ? bad uwei na ki un ym hap ha khyndew khlem U Kpa jong phi .

en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :
kha: Dei namar kata ba ki myllung ki rwai ,  Wan sha Heshbon , sha ka nongbah u syiem Sihon ! Ngi kwah ïohi ba yn tei pat bad pynïeng biang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kita kiba kren ha ki proberb ki ong: To wan sha Heshbon , to ai ba ka shnong Sihon kan long kaba la tei bad pynkhreh:

en: Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un long uba im thala lane u bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , uba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la die noh ïa ki hok jong u kum u hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la don uwei u nongleh kam sniew, ne u briew uba sniew, kum u Iso , uba na ka bynta kawei ka jingbam doh u la die ia ka hok kha jong u .

en: This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi , hynrei kim shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka pharshi ka la kren ia U Jisu ha ki: hynrei kim sngewthuh ia kiei kiei kiba ki long kiba u la kren ha ki .

en: And I gave them my statutes , and shewed them my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them .
kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong nga bad nga la hikai ha ki ïa ki aiñ jong nga , kiba wallam ka jingim ïa uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ha ki ia ki ain jong nga, bad nga la pyni ha ki ia ki jingbishar jong nga, kiba lada u briew u leh, un im wat ha ki .

en: Dare any of you , having a matter against another , go to law before the unjust , and not before the saints ?
kha: Lada uno uno na phi u don ka jingïakajia bad uwei pat u parabangeit , kumno phi nud ban leit ha khmat ki nongbishar bymngeit ha ka jaka ban ailad ïa ki briew U Blei ban pynbeit ïa kata ka kam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato uno uno na phi uba don ka kam pyrshah ia uwei pat , u leit sha ka ain ha khmat ki bym hok , bad ym ha khmat ki riewkhuid ?

en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding kaba meh , bad ka bam duh khoit ïa kita ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wanrah ïa ki jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka ding na U Trai , bad ka la bam ia ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la ainguh jingiwbih .

en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers ? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity ?
kha: Uei uba ïeng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ïa ki bymman ? Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga pyrshah ïa ki nongleh sniew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba ieng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ia ki nongleh bymman ? lane mano ban ieng na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ia ki nongtrei bymman ?

en: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart , which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding .
kha: Ngan ai ha phi ki nongsynshar ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad kin synshar ïa phi da ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ia phi ia ki nongsharai kat kum ka dohnud jong nga , ki ban ai bam ia phi da ka jingtip bad jingsngewthuh .

en: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes , which had not yet received their inheritance .
kha: Dang don sa hynñiew jait jong ki paid Israel ki bym pat ïoh ïa la ka bhah jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don hynriew tylli ki jait Israel ki bym pat ioh ia ka pateng jong ki .

en: Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .
kha: La kumno kumno , lada kata ka lah ban long , to ngin ïa-ïaid sha khmat kat kum kijuh ki kyndon kiba ngi la bud haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh, ha kaba ngi la dep ban poi, to ngin iaid da kajuh ka kyndon, to ngin ia pyrkhat ia kajuh ka jinglong .

en: I will declare the decree : the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou art my Son  ; this day have I begotten thee .
kha: Ngan pynbna ,  ong u syiem ,  ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la pynbna . U ong ha nga : ‘ Me long u khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long u kpa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbna ia ka hukum: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Me long u Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la kha ia me .

en: Not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but as the servants of Christ , doing the will of God from the heart ;
kha: Leh ïa kane ym tang haba ki khmih ïa phi , namar ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingmynjur jong ki ; hynrei , leh naduh ka dohnud baroh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , kum ki mraw U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym da ka jingshakri khmat, kum ki briew ; hynrei kum ki shakri U Khrist , da kaba leh ia ka mon U Blei naduh ka dohnud ; .

en: These four were born to the giant in Gath , and fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
kha: Kine saw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ramhah ka Gath , bad ki la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ha ki rangbah jong u .
