translated_en_to_kha: Kine saw ngut ki la kha ia u rangbah ha Gath , bad ki la hap da ka kti u Dabid bad da ka kti jong ki shakri jong u .

en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again , because he loved him : for he loved him as he loved his own soul .
kha: Sa shisien pat u Jonathan u pynlong ïa u Dabid ban kular ban ieit ïa u , naba u Jonathan u ieit ïa u Dabid kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la pynlong ia u Dabid ban smai biang, namar u ieit ia u: namar u ieit ia u kumba u ieit ia la ka jong ka mynsiem .

en: Mr So-and-So is dead . Why would I bother going to his funeral since , I am certain , he won't come to mine ?
kha: I bah ine-ine i lah iap . Balei ngan leit sha jingontep jong i haba nga lah thikna , in nym wan sha jingontep jongnga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Mr So-bad-Kumta u la iap . Balei ngan leit sha ka jingleit ontep jong u namar , nga thikna , un ym wan sha ka jong nga ?

en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind : and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart .
kha: Kito kiba wanrah jingeh ha la ki longïing kin ym don ei ei ha kaba kut . Ki briew kiba bieit kin long borabor ki shakri jong kiba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynkhuslai ia la ka jong ka iing un ioh pateng ia ka Iyer: bad u bieit un long u shakri ia uba stad .

en: The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .
kha: Ki khmat ki long kum ka sharak ïa ka met . Lada ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei kan dap da ka jingshai ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai jong ka met ka long ka khmat: lada ka khmat jong me ka long kaba marwei , ka met jong me baroh kawei kan long kaba dap da ka jingshai .

en: Those who took to heart Jesus warning did not foolishly turn back to try to save their material possessions .
kha: Kito kiba shim khia ia ka jingmaham jong U Jisu kim shym la phai dien da kaba bieit ban pyrshang ban pynim ia ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba la shim ia ka jingmaham jong U Jisu kim shym la phai khmat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyrkhat khlem da pyr

en: Then they willingly received him into the ship : and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went .
kha: Nangta da kaba kmen ki la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng , bad kumta hi ka lieng ka la poi ha ryngkew ha ka jaka sha kaba ki thmu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pdiang sngewbha ia u shapoh lieng: bad mar kumta hi ka lieng ka la don ha ka ri ha kaba ki la leit .

en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha Israel : Ki briew jong nga ki la pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha ka iing Israel: ka don ka jingleh be-ijot jong u Ephraim , ki Israel ki la shah pynjakhlia .

en: Enter into the rock , and hide thee in the dust , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty .
kha: Kin rieh ha ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum lane tih ki thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar U  Trai  bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: To rung shapoh u maw , bad to buhrieh ia me ha ka dewbilat , namar ka jingtieng ia U Trai bad na ka bynta ka burom jong ka jingkhraw jong u .

en: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
kha: bad ha Hades , ha kaba u la don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw , u la khmih shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa u Abraham , sha jngai bah , bad ïa u Lasaros ha syndah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha dujok u rah ia ki khmat jong u, u la shah pynshitom bein, bad u la iohi ia u Abraham sha jngai, bad u Lasaros ha ka kpoh jong u .

en: And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngkhot ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ka jaka ha kiba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shyieng briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhih ia ki dur , bad u la ot ia ki khlaw , bad u la pyndap ia ki jaka jong ki da ki shyieng briew .

en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :
kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha . Ïa ki la pynkheiñ noh namar kim shym la ngeit , katba phi sah ha la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . Hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Te ; namar ka jingbymngeit ki la shah pynpra noh, bad me ieng da ka jingngeit . Wat long kiba heh mynsiem, hynrei to tieng:

en: When they that fed them saw what was done , they fled , and went and told it in the city and in the country .
kha: Ki briew kiba la ap sumar ïa ki sniang ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , kumta ki la phet noh bad ki la pynphriang ïa ka khubor hapoh ka shnong bad ha ki jaka ri jingri .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la ai bam ia ki ki la iohi ia kaei kaba la leh , ki la phet noh bad ki la leit iathuh ha sor bad ha ri .

en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom , which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist .
kha: namar ngan ai ha phi ki kyntien bad ka jingstad kiba ym don na ki nongshun jong phi kiba lah ban kyntait lane ïa-pyrshah ïa kaei kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ai ia phi ia ka shyntur bad ka jingstad , kaba ki nongshun jong phi baroh kin ym lah ban ioh ne ban pyrshah .

en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred : for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .
kha: Mynta , halor ka jingai jingmut u Mordekai , ka Esther ka bat tang ha lade khlem ïathuh hano hano ba ka long ka Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Esther kam shym la pyni ia ki briew jong ka ne ia ki kur jong ka: namar u Mordecai u la kynnoh ia ka ba kam dei ban pyni ia ka .

en: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel : for I have seen God face to face , and my life is preserved .
kha: U Jakob u la ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa U Blei markhmat , bad nga dang im hi .  Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Peniel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka: namar nga la iohi ia U Blei markhmat bad ka jingim jong nga ka la sah .

en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame , and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .
kha: Hynrei u syiem un long khlem bor ban ïarap ïa ki , bad ka jingïada ka Ijipt kan kut ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingkhlain jong u Pharaoh kan long ka jingsngewlehrain jong phi, bad ka jingshaniah ha ka jingdum jong ka ri Ijipt jong phi .

en: But I must die in this land , I must not go over Jordan : but ye shall go over , and possess that good land .
kha: Nga te ngan ïap ha kane ka ri bad lano lano ngan ym ïoh jam ïa kata ka wah , hynrei phi pat phin sa ïoh leit shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga dei ban iap ha kane ka ri, ngam dei ban leit sha Jordan: hynrei phin leit noh bad ioh ia kata ka ri kaba bha .

en: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon , that have I given unto you , as I said unto Moses .
kha: Kumba nga la ïathuh ha u Moses , nga la ai ha me bad ha ki briew jong nga baroh ïa ka ri baroh kawei kaba phin leit ïuhkjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha man la ka jaka ba ka kjat jong phi kan iaid ha ka kjat jong phi, kaba nga la ai ha phi kumba nga la ong ha u Moses .

en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , dig now in the wall : and when I had digged in the wall , behold a door .
kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , pynpra ïa ka kynroh hangne .  Nga la pynpra lyngba ïa ka bad nga la shem ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, to tih mynta ha ka jingkhang: bad haba nga la tih ha ka jingkhang , ha khmih ka jingkhang .

en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
kha: Ki Apostol bad kiwei pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ïohsngew ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki apostol bad ki para bangeit kiba don ha Judaea ki la iohsngew ba ki Jutang ruh ki la pdiang ia ka ktien U Blei .

en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .
kha: Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jong nga lada phim don jingmut ban bat ïa ka ; kata ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym smai da ka kyrteng jong nga da kaba thok , bad phin ym pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng U Blei jong me: Nga long U Trai .

en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
kha: Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki briew kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka iaid bha bad kiba hok, ka shnong ka sngewbha: bad haba ki bymman ki jah noh , ka don ka jingpyrta .

en: The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbah ; kan long tang ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong u Damasios . Ha khmih , la weng noh ia ka nongbah , bad kan long ka kynhun kaba jot .

en: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;
kha: U la plie namar jong ngi ïa ka lynti kaba thymmai , ka lynti kaba im , lyngba kata ka jingkah — kata ka long , lyngba ka met jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka rukom kaba thymmai bad kaba im, kaba u la pynkyntang na ka bynta jong ngi, lyngba ka jingtap, kata ka mut, ka doh jong u;

en: And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .
kha: Kam shym la wan phai , hynrei ka shu her kylleng kylleng haduh ba ka um kan da rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ka raven kaba la leit sha khyndew bad ka la tyrkhong haduh ba ki um ki la tyrkhong na ka khyndew .

en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .
kha: Un leit phai pat na ka lynti ha kaba u wan , khlem da rung ha kane ka nongbah . Nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka lynti kaba u wan, da kajuh ka lynti un wan phai, bad un ym wan sha kane ka shnong , ong U Trai .

en: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful , and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright .
kha: A  Trai  , me long uba ïaineh ha kito kiba ïaineh ha me ; bad uba bha nadong shadong ha kito kiba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingsngewrit men pyni ia lade ba me long uba isynei, bad da u briew uba hok men pyni ia lade uba hok .

en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .
kha: Ngam kyrpad ba men shim noh ïa ki na ka pyrthei , hynrei nga da kyrpad ba men ri kyndong ïa ki na uta u bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam duwai ba me dei ban weng noh ia ki na ka pyrthei , hynrei ba me dei ban sumar ia ki na kaba sniew .

en: Because strait is the gate , and narrow is the way , which leadeth unto life , and few there be that find it .
kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop sha ka jingim ka long kaba khim bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba eh , bad don khyndiat ki briew kiba shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long kaba jylliew ia ka khyrdop, bad kaba rit ka long ka lynti kaba ialam sha ka jingim, bad tang khyndiat eh kiba shem ia ka .

en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Nga kwah ban ïohsngew ïa une u briew da lade hi .   Phin ïohsngew ïa u lashai ka sngi ,  u Phestos u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Agrippa u la ong ha u Festo, nga ruh ngan iohsngew ia uta u briew hi . Ban sngap ia u lashai u la ong .

en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Caesar .
kha: Bad u Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Ïa une u briew la dei ban pyllait noh lymda u la lah apil sha u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Agrippa u la ong ha u Festo, Une u briew u la lah ban shah set ha ka jinglaitluid lada um shym la ujor sha u Kaisar .

en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years , and begat sons and daughters :
kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa hynñiewspah phraphew ar snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun
translated_en_to_kha: U Methuselah u la im hadien ba u la kha ia u Lamech hynriew spah hynriewphew ar snem , bad u la kha ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei:

en: Which was the son of Enos , which was the son of Seth , which was the son of Adam , which was the son of God .
kha: u khun jong u Enosh , u khun jong u Seth , u khun jong u Adam , u khun jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Enos uba long u khun u Seth uba long u khun u Adam uba long u khun U Blei .

en: And for the wood offering , at times appointed , and for the firstfruits . Remember me , O my God , for good .
kha: nga pynkhreh ïa ki diengthang na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang ban wallam ha ki por ba la buh , bad na ka bynta ki briew ban wallam ki jingainguh da u kew banyngkong bad ki soh kiba ih nyngkong . To kynmaw ïa kane baroh , A Blei , bad to kyrkhu ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka jingainguh dieng, ha ki por ba la buh, bad na ka bynta ki soh ba nyngkong . Kynmaw ia nga, ko Blei jong nga, na ka bynta ka jingbha .

en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected , and is nigh unto cursing  ; whose end is to be burned .
kha: Hynrei lada ka pynmih ïa ki shiah bad ïa ki ñiut , kam dondor ei ei ; ka don ha ka , ka jingma naba U Blei un tim bad pynjot da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kata kaba kit ia ki khniang bad ki bniat la kyntait , bad ka long kaba jan ban tim ; kaba ka jingkut jong u ka dei ban shah thang .

en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .
kha: Naduh mynta , te , phi dei ban im ïa kaba sah jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei , ka jingim ba la synshar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da ki jingkwah jong ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba um dei shuh ban im ia ka por jong u ha ka doh ha ka jingkwah brai jong ki briew , hynrei ha ka mon U Blei .

en: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u khun ba kham heh u la don ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , haba u la poi sha jan ka ïing , u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ka jingïashad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u khun rangbah jong u u la don ha lyngkha : bad katba u dang wan bad u dang wan shajan iing , u la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa bad ka jingshad .

en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them , neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness .
kha: Hynrei pynban nga la pyrkhat isynei ïa ki . Nga la rai ban ym pynïap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka khmat jong nga ka la pyllait im ia ki na kaba pynjot ia ki , bad ngam shym la pynkut noh ia ki ha ka ri khlaw .

en: Hold fast the form of sound words , which thou hast heard of me , in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .
kha: To batskhem ïa ki ktien bashisha , kiba la pyniohsngew da nga , ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit kiba long ha U Khrist Jisu
translated_en_to_kha: To bat skhem ia ka dur jong ki ktien kiba jem, kiba me la iohsngew na nga, ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God : God is not in all his thoughts .
kha: U riewbymman um salia shaphang U  Trai  ; ha ka jingsarong jong u , u pyrkhat ba U Blei um da donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman, lyngba ka jingsarong jong ka khmat jong u, un ym wad ia U Blei : U Blei um don ha ki jingpyrkhat jong u baroh .

en: For both prophet and priest are profane  ; yea , in my house have I found their wickedness , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki long ki bymriewblei ; nga la lap ïa ki ba ki leh bymman ha ka Templ hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh arngut ki long kiba sniew;

en: And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .
kha: Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki sem bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam ïa ki da kiwei pat . Kin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad leh sngewbha ha ka waiñ — yn ym dih ïa ka da kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin tei ia ki iing bad kin shong ha ki ; bad kin thung ia ki kper sohjew bad kin bam ia ki soh jong ki .

en: And for his sister a virgin , that is nigh unto him , which hath had no husband  ; for her may he be defiled .
kha: lane ka hynmen ka para ka bym pat shongkurim kaba shong basah ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka para jong u ka long kaba jan ia u, kaba khlem don tnga ; na ka bynta jong ka u lah ban shah pynjakhlia .

en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :
kha: U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong u syiem , Wat ai ba u Hesekaiah un shukor ia phi: namar un ym lah ban pyllait ia phi na ka kti jong u:

en: Or else let these same here say , if they have found any evil doing in me , while I stood before the council ,
kha: Lane shah ïa kine kiba don hangne ban ïathuh kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shem ba nga shah pynrem haba nga la ïeng ha khmat ka Dorbar —
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lym kumta to ai ba kine ki juh kin ong hangne , lada ki la shem ia kano kano ka jingleh bymman ha nga , katba nga dang ieng ha khmat ka dorbar , .

en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats  ; one lot for the  Lord  , and the other lot for the scapegoat .
kha: Hangta un kynting sbai da ki ar tylli ki maw , uwei na ka bynta U  Trai  bad uwei pat na ka bynta u Asasel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un bret ia ki ar tylli ki blang ; kawei ka lot na ka bynta U Trai , bad kawei pat ka lot na ka bynta ka scapegoat .

en: And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .
kha: Shahshkor !  ong U Jisu .  Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong jong nga , ban ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih , nga wan kloi; bad ka bainong jong nga ka don ryngkat bad nga, ban ai ia uwei pa uwei katkum ka kam jong u .

en: Woe unto you that are full ! for ye shall hunger . Woe unto you that laugh now ! for ye shall mourn and weep .
kha: Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba pahuh mynta ; phin sa thngan ! Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba rkhie mynta ; phin sngewsih bad phin ïam !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi kiba la dap ! namar phin sa thngan . To phi kiba rkhie mynta ! namar phin iam bad iam .

en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .
kha: Kan shim por saw pateng bynriew shuwa ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin wan phai pat shane ; namar ngan ym pat beh noh ïa ki Amor tad ynda ki la long bymman haduh katta katta kat haduh ba ki dei ban shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka pateng kaba saw kin wan biang: namar ka jingbymhok jong ki Amorit kam pat dap .

en: And thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy might .
kha: Phin ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad da ka bor jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh .

en: And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .
kha: Don uwei uba la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïohi ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ia u da uwei uba la ong, Ka kmie bad ki hynmen jong me ki ieng shabar, ki kwah ban iohi ia me .

en: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban ïohpdiang jingïaroh uwei na uwei pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u long U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban ngeit ha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno phi lah ban ngeit , kiba pdiang ia ka burom iwei ia iwei pat bad wat wad ia ka burom kaba wan na U Blei tang ?

en: If any man s work shall be burned , he shall suffer loss : but he himself shall be saved ; yet so as by fire .
kha: Hynrei lada ïa ka jingtrei jong uno uno la thang duh noh , uta un duh ïa ka , hynrei ma u hi un ïohlait im , kumba u la lait im lyngba ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew un shah thang, un shah rem: hynrei ma u hi un shah pynim ; hynrei kum da ka ding .

en: In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .
kha: Ka la jia ba katba u dang long syiem ba U  Trai  u phah nyngkong ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi U Trai u la sdang ban phah pyrshah ia u Judah u Rezin u syiem Syria bad u Pekah u khun u Remaliah .

en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country  ; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine .
kha: Kumta u la leit ban trei na ka bynta uwei na ki traishnong jong kata ka ri , uba la phah ïa u sha ka jaka ri jingri jong u ban sumar ïa ki sniang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bad u la iasoh bad uwei u nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri ; bad u la phah ia u sha ki lyngkha jong u ban ai bam ia ki sniang .

en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ong ba u don ka jingngeit lada da ki kam jong u , um pynshisha ïa kata ? Hato kata ka jingngeit kan pynim ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingmyntoi, ko para jong nga, wat la u briew u ong ba u don ka jingngeit bad um don ki kam ? hato ka jingngeit ka lah ban pynim ia u ?

en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes , she doted upon them , and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea .
kha: Ka tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai bad ka phah nonglamktien sha ki ha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu iohi ia ki da ki khmat jong ka, ka la sngewsih ia ki, bad ka la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha ki sha Kaldea .

en: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;
kha: U la long ma u , uba  la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew ;  u la thung katto katne ngut ban long ki apostol ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïathuhlypa ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïalap ; ïa kiwei pat , ki nongsharai balang bad ki nonghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai katto katne, ki apostol ; bad katto katne, ki nongiathuhlypa bad katto katne, ki nongialam bad ki nonghikai ; .

en: Say unto them , As truly as I live , saith the  Lord  , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you :
kha: Mynta , ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab : ‘ Nga smai ba kumba nga long uba im , ngan leh kumba phi la pan . Nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha ki , Kumba nga im , ko Trai , kumba phi la kren ha ki shkor jong nga , kumta ngan leh ia phi:

en: Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?
kha: Hato ngam long u briew uba laitluid ? Hato ngam long u Apostol ? Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi ? Hato phi phim long u soh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta U Trai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngam dei u apostol ? hato ngam long uba laitluid ? ngam shym la iohi ia U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi ? phim dei ka kam jong nga ha U Trai ?

en: A nation of fierce countenance , which shall not regard the person of the old , nor shew favour to the young :
kha: Kin ym map lane leh-isynei ïano ïano , la ki dei ki samla ne ki tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba shyrkhei , kaba ym khein ia ka briew jong kiba la tymmen , lane kaba pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia kiba dang rit:

en: Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat , and the wine that they should drink  ; and gave them pulse .
kha: Kumta naduh kata u nongap phira u la shah ïa ki ban bteng ban bam da ki jhur ha ka jaka jong kaei kaba u syiem u la pynbiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Melzar u la weng noh ia ka bynta jong ka doh jong ki, bad ka wain kaba ki dei ban dih ; bad u la ai ia ki ia ka sniehdoh .

en: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .
kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga ; ka la sdang kynjat shai .   Em , ngan ym pyllait , lymda me kyrkhu ïa nga ,  ong u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , To ai ba ngan leit noh, namar ka sngi ka la jah noh . Bad u la ong , Ngan ym pyllait ia me , lymda me kyrkhu ia nga .

en: But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
kha: Hynrei U Blei un ai ka burom , ka nam babha bad ka jingsuk ïa baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba bha , ïa ki Jiw nyngkong bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka burom, ka burom bad ka jingsuk, ha uwei pa uwei u briew uba trei bha, ha u Jiw nyngkong eh, bad ruh ha u Jutang:

en: Look to yourselves , that we lose not those things which we have wrought , but that we receive a full reward .
kha: To phin sumar ïa lade , namarkata , khnang ba phin ym duh noh ïa kaei kaba ngi , ngi la trei , hynrei phin ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong kaba pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia lade , ba ngim duh ia kiei kiei kiba ngi la leh , hynrei ba ngi ioh ia ka bainong kaba pura .

en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
kha: U pyllaitluid ïa la ki briew , bad u pynlong ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Uba khuid bad uba khrawbor u long ma u !
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ka jingpynim ia ki briew jong u: u la hukum ia ka jutang jong u junom: ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba khuid bad kaba donburom .

en: And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .
kha: Ki la phai stet sawdong hynrei kim shym la ïohi ïano ïano pat ; tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kynsan kynsan, haba ki la peit sawdong, kim shym la iohi shuh ia u briew, lait noh tang bad ki hi .

en: Then when lust hath conceived , it bringeth forth sin : and sin , when it is finished , bringeth forth death .
kha: Nangta ki jingkwah brai jong u ki pun hapoh jong u bad ka jingmih ka long ban leh ïa ka pop ; bad ka pop , haba ka la ih bha , ka pynmih ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta haba ka jingkwah brai ka la kha khun, ka pynmih ia ka pop: bad ka pop , ynda ka la dep , ka pynmih ia ka jingiap .

en: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .
kha: Kine ki long ki proberb u Solomon : U khun uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jong u kpa ; uba bieit u wallam ka jingsngewsih ïa la ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki proberb jong u Solomon . U khun uba stad u pynlong ia u kpa uba kmen: hynrei u khun uba bieit u long ka jingkhia jong ka kmie jong u .

en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u paidbah byllien uba la wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud bun ki briew kiba la wan sha ka jingkhawai , haba ki la iohsngew ba U Jisu u wan sha Jerusalem .

en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad , even unto the children of Gad according to their families .
kha: U Moses u la ai ruh shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong ka jait Gad kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai pateng ia ka jaitbynriew Gad wat ia ki khun Gad kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: Behold , while thou yet talkest there with the king , I also will come in after thee , and confirm thy words .
kha: Bad u Nathan u bynrap ,  Nangta , katba phi dang ïakren bad u Syiem Dabid , ngan wan rung shapoh bad pynskhem ïa ka khana jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih katba me dang ia kren hangta bad u syiem , nga ruh ngan wan rung hadien jong me bad ngan pynskhem ia ki ktien jong me .

en: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato phi pdiang ïa U Mynsiem U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei ba ka Hukum ka dawa ne da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kane tang ngan sa nang na phi , Hato phi la pdiang ia U Mynsiem da ki kam jong ka hukum ne da ka jingsngap ia ka jingngeit ?

en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .
kha: Naba U Blei un ym pyn-i jingsngewsynei haba u bishar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynrei ka jinglehisynei ka jop noh halor ka jingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un don ka jingbishar khlem jingsngewrit , uta u bym shym la leh ei ei bad ka jingisynei ka sngewbha pyrshah ia ka jingbishar .

en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .
kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathuh ha ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa baroh kaba u Elijah u la leh bad kumno ba u la pynïap lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la iathuh ha u Jesbel ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u Elijah u la leh, bad u la iathuh ba u la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa baroh da ka waitlam .

en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage : neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet .
kha: Da kaba kyiuh ha ka jingshongshit , ki kulai ki mareh sha khmat ; haba ka turoi ka riew , kim lah ban ïeng hajuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U dih ia ka khyndew da ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar: um ngeit ba ka long ka sur jong ka turoi .

en: And he said to Gehazi his servant , Call this Shunammite . And when he had called her , she stood before him .
kha: U ong ïa u Gehasi u shakri jong u ban leit bad khot ïa kata ka briew . Haba ka la wan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u shakri jong u, Khot ia kane ka Shunamite . Bad haba u la khot ia ka , ka la ieng ha khmat jong u .

en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
kha: Bad haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la wallam sha ka jingshai , te ïa ka jinglong bashisha jong ki la pynpaw shynna ; naba kaei kaei kaba la pynpaw shynna ka kylla long ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba la pynrem ki paw da ka jingshai: namar kaei kaei kaba pynpaw ka long ka jingshai .

en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la jubab, Me long mano ko Trai ? Bad u la ong ha nga, Nga long U Jisu na Nazareth, uba me pynshitom bein .

en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u la leit kum uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong u nongpop !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iohi ia ka, baroh ki la ia ud bad ki la ong: Ba u la leit ban long u nongwan bad u briew uba long u nongpop .

en: And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
kha: ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ïa ka jingkah pyrda ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtap jong ki sniehdoh langbrot ka la rong saw , bad ka jingtap jong ki sniehdoh bad ka jingtap jong ka jingtap , .

en: The forest was covered with snow and the evenings were quiet as animals slept through the cold winter nights .
kha: Ka khlaw la sop da u ior , bad ki janmiet ki kynjah katba ki mrad ki iohthiah ha ki miet tlang ba khriat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlaw ka la tap da u slap bad ki janmiet ki la sngap jar katba ki mrad ki dang thiah lyngba ki miet ba khriat .

en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations , but now is made manifest to his saints :
kha: kaba long ka jingmaïan kaba u la buhrieh lyngba ki rta baroh kiba mynshuwa na ki jaitbynriew baroh hynrei mynta la pynpaw ha ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia ka jingmaham kaba la buhrieh naduh ki rta bad na ki pateng , hynrei mynta la pynpaw ha ki riewkhuid jong u:

en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .
kha: U kpa jong u briew uba hok u don ka daw babiang ban kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha u khun uba stad .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong kiba hok un sngewbha shibun: bad uta uba kha ia u khun uba stad un sngewbha ia u .

en: And if the ear shall say , Because I am not the eye , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
kha: Bad lada ka shkor kan ong ,  Namar ba ngam dei ka khmat , te ngam dei ka jong ka met ,  kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka shkor kan ong , Namar ngam dei ka khmat , ngam dei na ka met;

en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .
kha: Wat ju bam ïa ka ngap palat ban ïa kaba phi donkam ; kaba bam palat ka lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la shem ia ka ngap ? bam katba phi lah ban pyndap ia ka, ioh ba phin sa pyndap ia ka bad phin sa sngap jar ia ka .

en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
kha: Me dei ban sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta leh ïa kata — bad leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar mynta; namar U Trai u la jied ia me ban tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka jaka kyntang: to long kiba skhem bad to leh ia kata .

en: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga ong ha phi , ka don ka jingkmen ha khmat ki angel U Blei halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla bamut .

en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .
kha: Uba hok u isih ïa u bymman , bad u bymman u isih ïa uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u bym hok u long uba sngewsih ia kiba hok: bad uta uba beit ha ka lynti u long uba sngewsih ia kiba sniew .

en: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .
kha: U Paul u la ïeng joit , u la ai dak da la ka kti , bad u la sdang ban kren :  Ko ki para Israel bad ko ki Jentil baroh hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : To shahshkor ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ieng , bad u la ong da ka kti jong u: Ko Israel bad phi kiba sheptieng ia U Blei , to ai ia ki nongsngap .

en: The word that the  Lord  spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha nga shaphang ka nongbah Babilon bad ki briew jong ka :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien ba U Trai u la kren pyrshah ia ka ri Babilon bad pyrshah ia ka ri jong ki Khaldi da u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And Moses said unto Aaron , What did this people unto thee , that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them ?
kha: U ong ruh ha u Aaron ,  Aïu kine ki briew ki la leh ïa phi , haduh ba phi la pynlong ïa ki ban leh ïa ka pop kaba ishyrkhei kat kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron, "Kaei kane ka briew ha me, ba me la wanrah ia ka pop kaba khraw ha ki ?

en: Brethren , be not children in understanding : howbeit in malice be ye children , but in understanding be men .
kha: Wat long kum ki khynnah ha ka rukom pyrkhat jong phi , ko parabangeit jong nga ; to long khynnah ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingbymman , hynrei to long rangbah ha ka rukom pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit , wat long ki khynnah ha ka jingsngewthuh: wat la ha ka jingsniew phi long ki khynnah , hynrei ha ka jingsngewthuh to long ki briew .

en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh , bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi baroh ki briew haba ki la iohi ia u ki la lyngngoh shibun , bad ki la mareh sha u ki la ai khublei ia u .

en: You only have I known of all the families of the earth : therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities .
kha: Na baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei , phi long tang kawei kaba nga la ithuh bad sumar . Kata ka long kaei kaba la pynlong ïa ki pop jong phi kiba shyrkhei , bad kata ka long balei ba nga dei ban pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ma phi uba nga la tip na ki longiing baroh jong ka khyndew: namarkata ngan pynshitom ia phi na ka bynta ki jingbymhok jong phi baroh .

en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye sought me ? wist ye not that I must be about my Father s business ?
kha: U la jubab ïa ki ,  Balei ba phi dei ban wad ïa nga ? Hato phim tip ba nga dei ban don ha ka ïing jong U Kpa jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kumno phi wad ia nga ? phim sngewthuh ba nga dei ban long shaphang ka kam jong u Kpa jong nga ?

en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander ; whom I have delivered unto Satan , that they may learn not to blaspheme .
kha: Napdeng kine ki long — u Hymenaïos bad u Aleksandar , ïa kiba nga la pynshitom da kaba aiti noh ïa ki sha ka bor u Soitan ; kane kan hikai ïa ki ban sangeh na kaba krenbeiñ Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kiba u Hymenaos bad u Alexander ; kiba nga la aiti ha u Soitan , ba kin nang ban ym kren bein .

en: I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
kha: Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan leit sha U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad nga wan sha ka pyrthei : sa shisien , nga mih noh na ka pyrthei bad nga leit sha U Kpa .

en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .
kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap ha ka jaka maw , bad haba ki jingthung ki la shylluit , ki la tyrkhong noh namar ka khyndew kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don kiba la hap halor u maw ; bad tang shu mih u maw, u la tyrkhong noh namar ba u duna ka jingkhluit .

en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?
kha: Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? Hato kan dei tang ban ïoh ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih , ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga ha ka jingjahburom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata nga la mih na ka kpoh ban iohi ia ka jingtrei shitom bad ka jingsngewsih , ba ki sngi jong nga kin shah pynjot da ka jingsngewlehrain ?

en: And the ark rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , upon the mountains of Ararat .
kha: Te ha ka sngi kaba khathynñiew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kata ka lieng ka wan neh den halor u lumbah ha ki lynter lum Ararat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lieng ka la shongthait ha ka hynriew bnai, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, halor ki lum Ararat .

en: And the table and his furniture , and the pure candlestick with all his furniture , and the altar of incense ,
kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar bad ki tiar ki tar jong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka miej bad ki tiar jong u , bad ka sharak kaba khuid bad ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ka jingbam ba thiang jong u , .

en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
kha: Haba u Jakob u la tip ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Balei phim ïaleh ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Jakob u la iohi ba u don u kew ha Ijipt , u Jakob u la ong ha ki khun jong u , Balei phi peit iwei ia iwei pat ?

en: And he said , What have I sinned , that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab , to slay me ?
kha: U Obadaïah u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba nga la leh ba phi kwah ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma jong ka jingshah pynïap noh ha u syiem Ahab ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Nga la leh pop aiu ba me aiti ia u shakri jong me ha ka kti u Ahab ban pyniap ia nga ?

en: For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .
kha: Nga la thoh sha phi ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la kwah eh ban tip haduh katno phi la ïeng ha kata ka jingtynjuh bad la phi la kloi borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kane ka jingkut ruh nga la thoh , ba ngan tip ia ka jingpynshisha jong phi , la phi long kiba kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: Now Saul , and they , and all the men of Israel , were in the valley of Elah , fighting with the Philistines .
kha: U syiem Saul , ki hynmen jong phi , bad baroh kiwei ki Israel ki don ha ka Them Elah , ki dang ïaleh thma ïa ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Saul bad ki bad ki Israel baroh ki la don ha ka them Elah , ki ialeh bad ki Philistia .

en: And one of the company said unto him , Master , speak to my brother , that he divide the inheritance with me .
kha: Uwei u briew na u paidbah u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to ong ïa u hynmen jong nga ban ïabynta bad nga ïa ka jingdon jingem kaba u kpa jong ngi u la iehnoh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ka kynhun u la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, to kren bad u hynmen jong nga, ba u phiah ia ka pateng bad nga .

en: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate .
kha: bad teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ki ar tylli ki kynjri ksiar ha ki ar tylli ki ryntieh kiba don ha ki tduh jong ka sniehdoh .

en: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do this thing that he hath spoken  ;
kha: U Isaïah u jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha me ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha me na U Trai , ba U Trai un leh ia kane ka kam kaba u la kren ; .

en: There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?
kha: Don uwei u khynnah hangne uba don san tylli ki kpu barli bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hynrei kine kin ym pat biang na ka bynta kine ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Don uwei u khynnah hangne , uba don san tylli ki kpu barli , bad ar tylli ki dohkha rit: hynrei kiei napdeng kiba bun ?

en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .
kha: Hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñduh la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zebulun bad u Naphtali ki long ki briew kiba la buh jingma ia ka jingim jong ki haduh ka jingiap ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka lyngkha .

en: And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .
kha: Hangne mynta nga kob ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel . Nga kob ïa phi ba phin phah da uno uno ban ïaleh bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Philistia u la ong , Nga pyrshah ia ki shipai Israel ha kane ka sngi; ai ia nga u briew, ba ngin ialeh lang .

en: He answered and said unto them ,  When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Haba ka sngi ka sep , phi ong , ‘ Ngin sa ïoh ïa ka suiñbneng kaba bha , namar ka sahit bneng ka saw .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Ynda la janmiet , phi ong , Kan long ka jinglong kaba bha: namar ka bneng ka la rong saw .

en: And they set them up Micah s graven image , which he made , all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh .
kha: Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka ïaisah hangta ha kaba ka Ïingjaiñ ba mane ïa U Blei ka dang sah ha Shiloh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ki ha ka dur ba la ker da u Micah, kaba u la shna, ha ka por ba ka iing U Blei ka don ha Shiloh .

en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .
kha: U Petros u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad ha ki bad da ki kyntien babun u la kyrpad ïa ki , da kaba ong ,  To pynim ïa lade na ka jingpynshitom kaba wan ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kiwei pat ki ktien u la sakhi bad u la kyntu da kaba ong , To pynim ia lade na kane ka pateng kaba khlem akor .

en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .
kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ki la ïaleit kiew ïa u Lum Hor haba ïohi uta u paidlang baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum: bad ki la leit sha u lum Hor ha khmat ka jingiaseng baroh .

en: Therefore loosing from Troas , we came with a straight course to Samothracia , and the next day to Neapolis  ;
kha: Ngi la mihnoh da ka lieng na Troas bad ngi la leit beit sha shiliang sha Samothraki , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud sha Neapolis .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata da kaba jah noh na Troas , ngi la wan ryngkat bad ka lynti kaba beit sha Samothracia , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud sha Neapolis ; .

en: If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?
kha: Lada ka met baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad lada ka long tang ka shkor , da kumno yn iw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka met baroh kawei ka long ka khmat , shano ka jingsngap ? Lada baroh kawei ka la iohsngew , shano ka jingsma ?

en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon : for he it was that should betray him , being one of the twelve .
kha: U la kren shaphang u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot . Naba u Judas , wat la u dei uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , un sa shetkylla ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ia u Judas Iscarioot u khun u Simon: namar ma u la long uba dei ban shet kylla ia u, uba long uwei na ki shiphew ngut .

en: Their Paradise home was the garden of Eden —a place of great beauty with a river and fruit trees and animals .
kha: Ki sah ha paradais , ha ka kper Eden . ka long ka jaka kaba itynnat kaba don ka wah , ki dieng soh bad ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing Paradais jong ki ka long ka kper Eden ka jaka kaba itynnad bha bad ki dieng soh bad ki mrad .

en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew kiba dei ban ïap ; hynrei ïa u Melkhisedek ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da uta uba im , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne ki briew kiba iap ki ioh ia ka shiphew; hynrei hangta u pdiang ia ki, na kiba la sakhi ba u im .

en: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits .
kha: Kata ka lynti ïaid baroh shi lynter naduh ka khyrdop kaba shabar shaduh ka liang ba kut jong ka kamra bakhatduh ka la long arphew san mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka khmat jong ka khyrdop ba shapoh haduh ka khmat jong ka khyrdop ba shapoh ki long sanphew cubit .

en: And laid them down at the apostles  feet : and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need .
kha: bad ai ïa ka ha ki apostol ; bad ïa ka pisa la ïasam ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingdonkam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la buh ia ki ha ki kjat jong ki apostol: bad la sam ia uwei pa uwei katba u donkam .

en: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom , and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
kha: Phin bam bad dih ha ka miej jong nga ha ka Hima jong nga , bad phin shong halor ki khet ban synshar halor ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin ioh bam bad dih ha ka miej jong nga ha ka hima jong nga , bad shong ha ki khet kiba bishar ia ki shiphew jait ki Israel .

en: Unto thee it was shewed , that thou mightest know that the  Lord  he is God  ; there is none else beside him .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha phi ïa kane , ban pynshisha ha phi ba tang ma u hi u long U Blei , bad ba ym don uwei pat lait na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha me la pyni ia ka, ba me lah ban tip ba U Trai u long U Blei ; ym don shuh nalor jong u .

en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom ? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is ?
kha: Phi ai ka jingai jingmut kaba bha shibun bad phi ïasam ïa ka jingtip bad u briew uba bieit kum ma nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno me la ai jingmut ia uta u bym don jingstad ? bad kumno me la pynbna ia kata kumba ka long ?

en: By which also ye are saved , if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you , unless ye have believed in vain .
kha: Kata ka long ka gospel , ka khubor kaba nga la ïalap ha phi . Ïa phi la pynim da ka gospel lada phi batskhem ïa ka — lymda phi la ngeit lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba phi ruh phi la shah pynim , lada phi buh jingkynmaw ia kaei kaba nga la ialap ha phi , lymda phi la ngeit lehnohei .

en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses , clothed in fine linen , white and clean .
kha: Ki kynhun shipai ka bneng ki la bud ïa u , ki da shong halor ki kulai balieh bad ki la riam da ki jaiñ linen balieh bad bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai kiba don ha bneng ki la bud ia u halor ki kulai lieh , kiba la phong da ka jain kaba lieh bad kaba khuid .

en: They are all grievous revolters , walking with slanders : they are brass and iron  ; they are all corrupters .
kha: Ma ki baroh ki long ki nongïaleh pyrshah ba-mutlop , kiba eh kum ka rnong bad u nar . Ma ki baroh ki long kiba sniew , ki da ïaid kylleng bad pynsaphriang ïa ka lorni .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki long ki nongleh bymman kiba sngewsih, kiba iaid ryngkat bad ki jingthung: ki long ki nar bad ki nar ; ki long baroh ki nongbamsap .

en: And the king said , Whosoever saith ought unto thee , bring him to me , and he shall not touch thee any more .
kha: U Syiem u jubab ,  Lada uno uno u byrngem ïa pha , wan ïalam ïa u sha nga , bad un ym pynwit shuh ïa pha lano lano .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , Uno uno uba ong ia me, to wanrah ia u ha nga bad un ym ktah shuh ia me .

en: Then Sarah denied , saying , I laughed not  ; for she was afraid . And he said , Nay  ; but thou didst laugh .
kha: Namar ba ka Sarah ka la sheptieng , ka la len ïa kata . Ka da ong ,  Ngam shym rkhie .  U phai ktien ,  Ho-oid , pha la leh kumta , pha la rkhie .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka Sarah ka la kyntait, ka da ong, ngam shym la rkhie ; namar ka la tieng . Bad u la ong: Em; hynrei me la rkhie .

en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness , which are by Jesus Christ , unto the glory and praise of God .
kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pyndap da ki jinglong babha shisha kiba tang U Jisu Khrist u lah ban pynmih , na ka bynta ka burom bad ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ba la pyndap da ki soh jong ka hok kiba long da U Jisu Khrist , haduh ka burom bad ka jingiaroh ia U Blei .

en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;
kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ka rukom ba U Blei u buh ba ki briew kin long ka hok bad u hi , la pynpaw . Kam don jingïadei ei ei bad ka Hukum , wat la ka Hukum u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ka jingsakhi ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka hok U Blei khlem ka hukum ka paw , la sakhi da ka hukum bad ki nongiathuhlypa ; .

en: And when much people were gathered together , and were come to him out of every city , he spake by a parable :
kha: Ki briew ki ïai wan sha U Jisu na kawei ka shnong hadien kawei pat ; bad haba u paidbah babun u la ïalumlang , U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba bun ki briew ki la ialum lang bad ki la wan sha u na kawei pa kawei ka shnong , u la kren da ka pharshi:

en: And one Ananias , a devout man according to the law , having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there ,
kha: Ha kata ka nongbah la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , u briew uba riewblei uba la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong ngi bad ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da ki Jiw baroh kiba shong basah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u Ananias , u briew uba riewblei katkum ka hukum , uba don ka khubor kaba bha jong ki Jiw baroh kiba shong hangta .

en: They drank wine , and praised the gods of gold , and of silver , of brass , of iron , of wood , and of stone .
kha: bad ki la ïaroh ïa ki blei kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng bad u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la dih wain bad ki la iaroh ia ki blei ksiar bad rupa, ki nar, ki nar, ki dieng bad ki maw .

en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Gideon , and he blew a trumpet  ; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him .
kha: U mynsiem jong U  Trai  u bat synshar ïa u Gideon ; bad u put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki rangbah na ka kur Abieser ban bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem U Trai u la wan ha u Gideon , bad u la pyrta ia ka turoi ; bad u Abiezer u la ialum lang hadien jong u .

en: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .
kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka doh jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jong nga u don ka jingim bymjukut , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba bam ia ka doh jong nga bad uba dih ia ka snam jong nga , u don ka jingim bymjukut ; bad ngan pynmihpat ia u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

en: If he beget a son that is a robber , a shedder of blood , and that doeth the like to any one of these things ,
kha: Te tharai une u briew u don u khun uba lute bad uba pynïap , uba leh ïa kawei na kine kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u um ju leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u kha ia u khun uba long u nongtuh , u nongtuh snam bad uba leh kumjuh ia uno uno na kine kiei kiei .

en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms , wrought righteousness , obtained promises , stopped the mouths of lions ,
kha: Da ka jingngeit ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa baroh ki hima bad ki la jop . Ki la leh ïa kaei kaba dei hok bad ki la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba lyngba ka jingngeit u la pyndem ia ki hima , u la leh ia ka hok , u la ioh ia ki jingkular , u la sangeh ia ki shyntur jong ki sing , .

en: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :
kha: Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewsynei ia u paidbah , namar mynta ki la don bad nga lai sngi , bad kim don ei ei ban bam:

en: By whom we have received grace and apostleship , for obedience to the faith among all nations , for his name :
kha: Lyngba jong u , U Blei u la ai ïa nga ka kabu ban long u apostol na ka bynta U Khrist , khnang ban ïalam ïa ki briew na ki jaitbynriew baroh ban ngeit bad ban kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da uba ngi la ioh ia ka jingaiei bad ka jinglong apostol, na ka bynta ka jingngeit hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh, na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u:

en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
kha: Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ker sawdong ia nga shaphang ka yea, ki la ker sawdong ia nga: hynrei ha ka kyrteng U Trai ngan pynjot ia ki .

en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .
kha: Ka por kaba dei ka la poi ,  u ong ,  bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingong , Ka por ka la pyndep bad ka hima U Blei ka la jan: to kylla bamut bad ngeit ia ka gospel .

en: Then said Joab to Cushi , Go tell the king what thou hast seen . And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab , and ran .
kha: Nangta u ong ïa u mraw jong u na Sudan ,  Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi .  U mraw u la nguh bad u la mareh bran .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joab u la ong ha u Cushi , Leit iathuh ha u syiem ia kaei kaba me la iohi . U Cushi u la dem khrup ha u Joab bad u la mareh .

en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword , which say , The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us .
kha: Ïa ki nongpop napdeng ki briew jong nga yn pynïap ha ka thma — ïa kito baroh kiba ong ‘ U Blei un ym shah ïa kano kano ka jingma ban wan hajan jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongpop jong nga kin iap da ka waitlam kaba ong , Ka jingsniew kan ym palat ne khanglad ia ngi .

en: Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king :
kha: Kumta katto katne ngut na ki nongai jingmut u syiem kiba ïajan bad u ki ai jingmut ,  Balei phim pynlong ka jingwad ban shem katto katne ki theisotti ba-bhabriew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shakri syiem kiba shakri ia u ki la ong: Ai ba kin don ki khun samla kiba bha kiba wad ia u syiem:

en: If the priest s daughter also be married unto a stranger , she may not eat of an offering of the holy things .
kha: Ka khun u lyngdoh kaba shongkurim bad u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh kam lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka khun lyngdoh ruh ka long kaba la shongkurim bad u nongwei , kam lah ban bam ia ka jingainguh ia kiei kiei kiba kyntang .

en: And as they thus spake , Jesus himself stood in the midst of them , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
kha: Katba ki ar ngut ki dang ïathuh ha ki ïa kane , kynsan U Trai hi u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang ia kren kumta, U Jisu hi u la ieng hapdeng jong ki, bad u ong ha ki , Ka jingsuk kan long ha phi .

en: How can love and kindness protect us from being deprived of the prize ? How can we win the prize as a family ?
kha: Kumno ka jingieit bad jingsbun kan iada ia ngi na ka jingshah pynduh ia ka khusnam ? Kumno ngin ioh ia ka khusnam kum ka iing ka sem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ka jingieit bad ka jingbhabriew kan iada ia ngi na ka jingshah pynduh ia ka khusnam ? Kumno ngin jop ia ka khusnam kum ka longiing ?

en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u la bam bad u la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri pura jong kaei kaba la sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bam baroh, bad ki la dap: bad ki la shim ia ki lyngkhot kiba sah shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot lyngkhai .

en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .
kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim ia ka khlieh jong u Philistia bad u la wanrah ia ka sha Jerusalem ; hynrei u la buh ia ki tiar ialeh jong u ha ka tnum jong u .

en: Later , she went on to take a lead role in the movie Rock On 2 where she again proved her skills as a singer .
kha: Hadien kata ka la leit ban shim ia ka bynta kaba hakhmat eh ha ka phlim Rock On 2 ha kaba ka la pynshisha biang ia ka jingtbit jong ka kum ka nongrwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien , ka la leit sha ka bynta kaba kongsan ha ka phlim Rock Ha 2 ha kaba ka la pynshisha biang ia ka jingtbit jong ka kum ka nongrwai .

en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
kha: Hangta phin shong , nga ong ïa phi , tad haduh ba phin da siew dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha me , Wat mih na kata ka jaka, haduh ba phin da siew ia ka bai lutksan kaba khraw tam .

en: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying ,  Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?
kha: bad U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa ki Pharisi ,  Hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki nongiasaid ain bad ki Pharisi da kaba ong: Hato ka long kaba dei ban pynkoit ha ka sngi Sabha ?

en: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .
kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katto katne na ki , kin long ki syiem . Men ïoh shibun ki khun ki ksiew kiba yn sa long ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia me uba seisoh palat , bad ngan pynlong ia ki jaitbynriew na me , bad ki syiem kin mih na me .

en: But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .
kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingngeit jong me kan ym duh noh . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha nga , me dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me, ba ka jingngeit jong me kan ym jah: bad haba me la kylla , pynskhem ia ki hynmen jong me .

en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .
kha: Ki paid Asher ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka naba kim shym la beh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Asher ki shong hapdeng ki nong Kanaan: namar kim shym la beh ia ki .

en: And when they saw him afar off , even before he came near unto them , they conspired against him to slay him .
kha: Na jngai ki la ïohi ïa u , bad katba un da poi hajan jong ki , ki lah da ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad rai ban pynïap noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohi ia u na jngai, wat shuwa ba un wan hajan jong ki, ki la thmu pyrshah ia u ban pyniap ia u .

en: And the men did so  ; and took two milch kine , and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home :
kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumba la ong ; ki shim ar tylli ki masi kynthei bad ki teh ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ki set ïa ki khun masi ha sem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang ki la leh kumta bad ki la shim ar tylli ki masi dud, bad ki la teh ia ki ha ka kali kit mar, bad ki la khang ia ki khun masi jong ki ha iing:

en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .
kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai baroh kawei katba ki paid Israel baroh ki shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha ki shkor jong ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei ia ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai haduh ba kin da kut noh .

en: And gathered them out of the lands , from the east , and from the west , from the north , and from the south .
kha: U la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi bad u la wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri nongwei , na mihngi bad sepngi , na shatei bad shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la lum ia ki na ki ri, na mihngi bad na sepngi, na shaphang shathie bad na shathie .

en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
kha: Hynrei , to pyrkhat nalor kiei kiei baroh ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ïa kaei kaba u dawa na phi , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to wad nyngkong ia ka hima U Blei bad ia ka hok jong u bad ia kine kiei kiei baroh yn pyndap ha phi .

en: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to build and to plant it  ;
kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , lada nga ong ba ngan seng lane tei ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kano ka por ngan kren shaphang ka jaitbynriew, bad shaphang ka hima, ban tei bad ban thung ia ka ; .

en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine . So Pharaoh awoke .
kha: bad kita ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la bam lut plain ïa kita ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid . Nangta u syiem u la kyndit thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki sniang kiba la shah rem bad kiba la tyrkhong ki la bam ia ki hynriew tylli ki sniang kiba la tyrkhong bha bad kiba heh . Kumta u Pharaoh u la kyndit .

en: Now after that John was put in prison , Jesus came into Galilee , preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God ,
kha: Hadien ba la set ïa u Ïoannis ha ka byndi , U Jisu u la leit noh sha Galilaïa bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien ba la set ia u Ioannis ha phatok , U Jisu u la wan sha Galilaia , u la ialap ia ka gospel jong ka hima U Blei .

en: And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .
kha: Ynda me la ïohi ïa ka , men sa ïap noh , kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda me la iohi ia ka , ma me ruh to ialum lang bad ki briew jong me kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ialum lang .

en: And Jehu slept with his fathers : and they buried him in Samaria . And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ha Samaria , bad u Jehoahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u: bad ki la tep ia u ha Samaria . Bad u Jehos u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: But Abijah waxed mighty , and married fourteen wives , and begat twenty and two sons , and sixteen daughters .
kha: U Abijah , pynban , u la nang kham khlaiñbor . U la don khatsaw ngut ki tnga bad u long u kpa ïa ki arphew ar ngut ki khun shynrang bad khathynriew ngut ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abijah u la nang khlain shiphew ngut ki tnga, bad u la kha arphew arngut ki khun shynrang bad shiphew ngut ki khun kynthei .

en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit sha kawei pat ka nongrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u Khun u briew um wan ban pynjot ia ki briew , hynrei ban pynim ia ki . Bad ki la leit sha kawei pat ka shnong .

en: Thou prevailest for ever against him , and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
kha: Me pynduhbor ïa u briew bad phah noh ïa u junom ; ka durkhmat jong u ka sniew dur ha ka por ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Me jop junom ia u, bad u iaid: me pynkylla ia ka khmat jong u, bad me phah noh ia u .

en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah , When thou comest to Babylon , and shalt see , and shalt read all these words  ;
kha: Nga la ong ïa u Seraïah ,  Haba men poi ha Babilon , pynthikna ban pule jam ha ki briew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la thoh hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la ong ha u Seraiah, "Haba me wan sha Babilon, bad men sa iohi, bad men pule ia kine ki ktien baroh;

en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded  ; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north .
kha: Ïa ki briew ka Ijipt la pynlehrain ; la jop ïa ki da ki briew ba na shatei . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun jong ka ri Ijipt kan shah pynjah burom ; kan shah pynpoi ha ka kti jong ki briew jong ka ri Sepngi .

en: And this shall be a sign unto you  ; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes , lying in a manger .
kha: Bad kane ka long kaei ka ban pynshisha ïa kata ha phi : Phin shem ïa u khunlung uba la sop da ki jaiñsop bad uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha phi ; Phin shem ia u babe ba la tap da ki jain kiba la tyrkhong , uba thiah ha ka jaka ri jingri .

en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities , and in houses which no man inhabiteth , which are ready to become heaps .
kha: Uta u long u briew uba knieh ïa ki nongbah bad u shim ïa ki ïing kiba ki trai ki la phet noh , hynrei ka thma kan pynjot ïa kito ki nongbah bad ïa ki ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shong ha ki nongbah kiba la jot , bad ha ki iing kiba ym don briew kiba shong ki sah , kiba la pynkhreh ban kylla long ki thliew .

en: Australia moved to the top of the Cricket World Cup standings after beating Sri Lanka by 87 runs at the Oval .
kha: Ka Australia ka la kiew sha ka kyrdan ba ha khlieh duh jong ka Cricket World Cup hadien ba ka la pynliem ia ka Sri Lanka da 87 ron ha ka Oval .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Australia ka la kiew sha ka kyrdan ba ha khlieh duh jong ka Cricket World Cup hadien ba ka la pynliem ia ka Sri Lanka da 87 ron ha ka Oval .

en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :
kha: Ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ruh kin ïam bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , namar ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thied ïa ki mar jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkhaii jong ka khyndew kin iam bad iam halor jong ka ; namar ym don mano mano ruh kiba thied shuh ia ki mar ki mata jong ki:

en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us  ; for thou hast done right , but we have done wickedly :
kha: Me leh ïa kaba dei ban pynshitom ïa ngi ; Me long uba ïaineh , wat la ngi la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba me long tang ha kiei kiei baroh kiba la wanrah ha ngi ; namar me la leh hok , hynrei ngi la leh sniew:

en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .
kha: Namar kam i shongnia ha nga ban phah ïa u koidi khlem da kdew shai ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long kumba ngam don nongrim ban phah ia u koidi , bad ym da kaba pynpaw ia ki kam runar ba la buh pyrshah ia u .

en: Thefts , covetousness , wickedness , deceit , lasciviousness , an evil eye , blasphemy , pride , foolishness :
kha: ban klim , ban lalot , bad leh baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew ; ka jingshukor , ka jingbymdon-burom , ka jingbishni , kaba kren sniew shaphang kiwei , ka jingsarong , bad ka jingbieit —
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingtuh, ka jingkwah brai, ka jingsniew, ka jingleh thok, ka jingsngewsih, ka khmat kaba sniew, ka jingkren bein , ka jingsarong , ka jingbieit:

en: And the beast that was , and is not , even he is the eighth , and is of the seven , and goeth into perdition .
kha: Bad u mradkhlaw uba la ju im shisien , hynrei u bym shym im shuh , u dei hi u syiem uba phra uba long uwei na ki hynñiew ngut bad u mihnoh ban shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u mrad uba la long , bad um long kumta , wat ma u ruh u long uba phra, bad u long na ki hynriew ngut, bad u leit sha ka jingjot .

en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .
kha: Te U Abraham u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Beersheba bad u la mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei Bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la thung ia u khlaw ha Beersheba , bad u la khot hangta ia ka kyrteng U Trai , U Blei bymjukut .

en: For neither at any time used we flattering words , as ye know , nor a cloak of covetousness ; God is witness :
kha: Phi tip bha ba ngim shym la wan ha phi da ki jingkren jali ja-um , lymne ba ngi la pyndonkam ïa ki kyntien ban da  rap-jot ïa ka jinglalot — U Blei u long u sakhi ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don por ba ngi pyndonkam ia ki kyntien kiba sngewtynnad, kumba phi tip, lane ka jainkup jong ka jingkwah brai ; U Blei u long u sakhi:

en: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .
kha: Kumta uta u shakri u buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong u Abraham , u kynrad jong u , bad u pynlong ka jingsmai ban leh ïa kaei kaba u Abraham u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la buh ia la ka kti hapoh ka tyrpeng jong u Abraham u kynrad jong u, bad u la sngap jar ia u shaphang kata ka kam .

en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jong pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdop jong pha da ki maw kiba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki jingkhang jong me da ki nar , bad ki khyrdop jong me da ki nar , bad ki pud jong me baroh .

en: There is another that beareth witness of me  ; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true .
kha: Hynrei don uwei pat uba phla na ka bynta jong nga , bad nga tip ba ïa kaei kaba u ong shaphang jong nga ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Don uwei pat uba sakhi ia nga ; bad nga tip ba ka sakhi kaba u sakhi shaphang jong nga ka long kaba shisha .

en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .
kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shynrang ba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ka jingtap na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ jong ki blang ba la rong saw, bad ka jingtap halor ki snieh bad ki blang .

en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar  ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
kha: Man la ka sngi ha ki por ban wan , kñia ha kata ka duwan ar tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kane ka long kaba me ai ha ka almari ; ar tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong man ka sngi .

en: Be not ye therefore like unto them : for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of , before ye ask him .
kha: Wat long kum ma ki . U Kpa jong phi u da tip lypa ïa kaei kaba phi donkam ha shuwa ba phin pan na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat long kum ma phi: namar U Kpa jong phi u tip ia kiei kiei kiba phi donkam, shuwa ba phin kylli ia u .

en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .
kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt sha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don , bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la mih na Ijipt, ma u bad ka tnga jong u bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u don bad u Lot bad u, shaphang shathie .

en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward , and bear fruit upward :
kha: Kito kiba lait im ha Judah kin roi kin san kum ki jingthung kiba ngam jylliew ki thied ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba sah na ka iing Judah kan sa mih biang shapoh bad kan sei soh shaneng:

en: In the multitude of people is the king s honour : but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince .
kha: Ka jingkhraw jong u syiem ka shong ha ki katno ngut ki briew kiba u synshar ; khlem kita um long ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingbun ki briew ka long ka burom jong u syiem: hynrei ha ka jingkwah jong ki briew ka long ka jingpynjot ia u syiem .

en: As it is written , For thy sake we are killed all the day long ; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Na ka bynta jong phi ngi la long ha ka jingma jong ka jingïap ha ki por baroh ; la leh ïa ngi kum ïa ki langbrot ba la ïalam sha ka jingpynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh , Na ka bynta jong me la pyniap ia ngi baroh shisngi; ngi la shah khein kum ki langbrot na ka bynta ka jingpyniap .

en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee , until thou be increased , and inherit the land .
kha: Pynban , ngan beh noh ïa ki khyndiat pa khyndiat , tad haduh ba phin da ïabun paid ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba rit bad khyndiat ngan beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me, haduh ba men da nang kiew bad ngan hiar pateng ia ka ri .

en: And the Lord said ,  Simon , Simon , behold , Satan hath desired to have you , that he may sift you as wheat :
kha: Ko Simon , Simon ! Sngap ! U Soitan u la ïoh jingbit ban tynjuh ïa phi baroh , ban pynïakhlad ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kumba u nongrep u pynïakhlad ïa u kew na u stait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong, u Simon, u Simon, ha khmih, u Soitan u la kwah ia phi, ba un sa khleh ia phi kum u kew:

en: The king s heart is in the hand of the  Lord  , as the rivers of water : he turneth it whithersoever he will .
kha: U  Trai  u pynïaid ïa ka jingmut jong u syiem kham suk kumba u pynïaid ïa ka lynti ka wahduid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u syiem ka don ha ka kti U Trai, kum ki wah um: u pynphai ia ka katba u mon .

en: And I the  Lord  will be their God , and my servant David a prince among them  ; I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad u syiem kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long u nongsynshar jong ki . Nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga U Trai ngan long U Blei jong ki, bad u shakri jong nga u Dabid u rangbah hapdeng jong ki ; nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria , even a blessing in the midst of the land :
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka Israel yn kyrdan lang bad ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria , bad kine ki lai tylli ki ri kin long ka jingkyrkhu ïa ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel kin long kiba lai bad ka ri Ijipt bad ka ri Assyria:

en: They answered and said unto him , If he were not a malefactor , we would not have delivered him up unto thee .
kha: Ka jubab jong ki ka la long ,  Ngin ym da la wallam ïa u sha phi lada um shym la leh ïa ka kam runar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u: Lada um long u nongleh bymman , ngin ym shym la aiti ia u sha me .

en: In February 2009 , there was evidence of the Thai army towing a boatload of 190 Rohingya refugees out to sea .
kha: Ha u bnai February 2009 ka la don ka jingpynshisha ba ki shipai Thailand ki la tan ïa ka lieng kaba dap da ki 190 ngut ki nongphetwir Rohingya sha duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u bnai February 2009 , la don ki sakhi ba ki shipai Thai ki la tan ia ka lieng kaba don 190 ngut ki nongphetwir Rohingya shabar duriaw .

en: For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .
kha: Ïa uta u khun la kha ha ka por ba U Blei u la buh ba yn sa kha ïa u .
