translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka Sarah ka la pun khun bad ka la kha ia u Abraham ha ka por ba u la tymmen, ha ka por ba la buh ia u .

en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;
kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba nga la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad hangne u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong ha u Jakob: Peit ia kane ka kynhun bad ha khmih ia une u maw uba nga la bret hapdeng jong nga bad me;

en: In case of a rise in the water level , the people settled on the banks of river Ganga will be sent elsewhere .
kha: Lada jia ba ka um ka kiew , ia ki briew kiba shong ha rud wah Ganga yn phah shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingkiew jong ka um , ki briew kiba la shong ha rud wah Ganga kin phah shawei pat .

en: The amount from the deal would have helped the company in reducing its high debt of around Rs 46 , 000 crore .
kha: Ka pisa na katei ka jingiateh kan jin da la iarap ia ka kompeni ban pynduna ia ka ram kaba heh jong ka kaba haduh 46, 000 klur tyngka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pisa na ka jingiateh kan jin da la iarap ia ka kompeni ha kaba pynduna ia ka ram kaba heh jong ka kaba long kumba 46 000 klur tyngka .

en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .
kha: Baroh kiba mane bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewsih ia kito baroh kiba shakri ia ki dur ba la ker sawdong, kiba sngew sarong ia lade ha ki bleithaw: to mane ia u, phi baroh ki blei .

en: The broader Nifty too gained 81 . 55 points , or 0 . 85 per cent , to hit a new lifetime high of 9 , 591 . 30 .
kha: Ka Nifty kaba kham heh ruh ka la ioh 81 . 55 point , lane 0 . 85 percent , ban poi sha ka jingkiew kaba thymmai ha ka jingim jong ka 9 591 . 30 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Nift kaba kham heh ruh ka la ioh 81 . 55 poiñ, lane 0 . 85 na ka shispah, ban hiar sha ka jingkiew kaba thymmai ha ka jingim kaba 9 , 591 . 30 .

en: Then , in chapters 10 and 11 , we read of 70 families that descended from Noahs sons Shem , Ham , and Japheth .
kha: Nangta ha ki lynnong 10 bad 11 ngi pule shaphang 70 tylli ki longiing kiba mih na ki khun u Noah u Shem , u Ham bad u Japheth .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta, ha ki lynnong 10 bad 11 , ngi pule shaphang 70 tylli ki longiing kiba la hiar na u Noah u Shem, u Ham bad u Japhet .

en: And the inhabitant shall not say , I am sick : the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity .
kha: Yn ym don uba shong ba sah ha ka ri jong ngi , u ban dang ud pang , bad ïa ki pop baroh yn map .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongshong shnong un ym ong: nga pang: ki briew kiba shong hangta kin shah map ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: Behold , he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .
kha: Haba U Blei u pyntwa , uei uba lah ban tei pat , bad uno uba lah ban pyllait ïa u briew uba U Blei u la set byndi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u bthei , bad ym lah ban tei pat: u khang ia u briew , bad ym lah ban don ka jingplie .

en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin , he clappeth his hands among us , and multiplieth his words against God .
kha: Ha ki pop jong u , u pyndap da ka jingïaleh pyrshah ; ha khmat jong ngi baroh u beiñ ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u pyndap ia ka jingleh pyrshah ia ka pop jong u , u pynkhih ia ki kti jong u hapdeng jong ngi , bad u pynbun ia ki ktien jong u pyrshah ia U Blei .

en: He turned his head to face the door into the living room so that he could watch the women when they came back .
kha: U la pynphai ia la ka khlieh ban peit sha ka jingkhang shapoh kamra shong khnang ba un ioh peit ia ki kynthei ynda ki la wan phai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphai ia la ka khlieh ban peit ia ka jingkhang shapoh kamra shong khnang ba un peit ia ki kynthei ynda ki la wan phai biang .

en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus ; for he oft refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain :
kha: To U Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ha ka longïing u Onesiphoros , namar ba u la pyntngen ïa nga bunsien .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u ai jingisynei ia ka iing u Onesiphoros ; namar u la pynkmen ia nga bunsien, bad um shym la sngewlehrain ia ka kynjri jong nga:

en: And it came to pass , when men began to multiply on the face of the earth , and daughters were born unto them ,
kha: Haba ki briew ki la saphriang ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bad haba ki la ïoh ki khun kynthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki briew ki la sdang ban mih ha ka khmat ka khyndew bad la kha ia ki khun kynthei ha ki .

en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said ,  Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .
kha: U Jisu u la khmih ha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Suk phi kiba duk ; ka Hima U Blei ka long ka jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia ki khmat jong u sha ki synran jong u bad u la ong: Kyrkhu ia phi: namar ka jong phi ka long ka hima U Blei .

en: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan : and Saul sware , As the  Lord  liveth , he shall not be slain .
kha: U Saul u la sngewïahap ïa kaba u Jonathan u ong bad u smai ha ka Kyrteng U  Trai  ba un ym pynïap ïa u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la sngap ia ka sur jong u Jonathan: bad u Saul u la sngap jar: Kumba U Trai u im, un ym shah pyniap .

en: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries , Will they now commit whoredoms with her , and she with them ?
kha: Bad nga ong ha lade ba ki pynlong ïa ki kum ka nuti ïa ka briew kaba la ngam ha ka jingklim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ia ka kaba la tymmen ha ki kam sniew , Hato mynta kin leh ia ki kam sniew bad ka , bad ma ka bad ki ?

en: And unclean spirits , when they saw him , fell down before him , and cried , saying , Thou art the Son of God .
kha: Bad man ba ki briew kiba don ki mynsiem bymkhuid ha ki , ki la ïohi ïa u , ki dem khrup ha khmat jong u bad ki lynñiar ,  Me long U Khun U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki mynsiem bymkhuid haba ki la iohi ia u ki la dem ha khmat jong u bad ki la pyrta ki da ong: Me long U Khun U Blei .

en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun  ; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire .
kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka sngi , bad la shah ïa ka ban thang ïa ki briew da jingshit tyrha bajur jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba saw u la theh ia ka umphniang jong u ha ka sngi ; bad la ai bor ia u ban thang ia ki briew da ka ding .

en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
kha: Lada phi long uba jaipdeh , phin ym ïoh da lei lei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban long hadien , hynrei lada phi trei minot , phin ïoh spah .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba sniew um ju bam ia kata kaba u la shim ha ka jingleit khwai: hynrei ka jinglong jong u briew uba minot ka long kaba kordor .

en: Here is the patience of the saints : here are they that keep the commandments of God , and the faith of Jesus .
kha: Kane ka khot ïa ka jingïaishah ha ka liang ki briew jong U Blei , kito kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei bad kiba ïaineh ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne ka don ka jingshaniah jong ki riewkhuid: hangne ki don kiba sumar ia ki hukum U Blei bad ka jingngeit U Jisu .

en: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse  ; Reuben , Gad , and Asher , and Zebulun , Dan , and Naphtali .
kha: Bad kine ki jait kin ïeng ha u lum Ebal katba dang pynbna ïa ki jingtim : ka jait Reuben , ka jait Gad , ka jait Asher , ka jait Sebulun , ka jait Dan , bad ka jait Naphtali .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kin ieng halor u lum Ebal ban tim ia u Reuben, u Gad bad u Asher, bad u Zebulun, u Dan bad u Naphtali .

en: And was transfigured before them : and his face did shine as the sun , and his raiment was white as the light .
kha: Katba ki dang ïakhmih , ka jingkylla dur ka la wan ha U Jisu : Ka durkhmat jong u ka da tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la lieh phyrnai eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynkylla dur ha khmat jong ki: bad ka khmat jong u ka la shai kum ka sngi , bad ka jainkup jong u ka la lieh kum ka jingshai .

en: And the sixth angel sounded , and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God ,
kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la put ïa la ka turoi . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba hynriew u la sawa , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur na ki saw tylli ki bniat ksiar kaba don ha khmat U Blei .

en: And said , My Lord , if now I have found favour in thy sight , pass not away , I pray thee , from thy servant :
kha: Ko rangbah , sngewbha wat ïaid lait na ka ïing jong nga khlem da wan rung ; nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ko Trai jong nga, lada mynta nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me, wat leit noh, nga kyrpad ia me, na u shakri jong me:

en: And I knew him not : but that he should be made manifest to Israel , therefore am I come baptizing with water .
kha: Ngam pat shym la tip u dei uno , hynrei nga la wan ïa ka ban pynbaptis da ka um , khnang ba yn ïoh pynithuh ïa u ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam ithuh ia u: hynrei ba un shah pynpaw ha ki Israel , namarkata nga wan pynbaptis da ka um .

en: So ye in like manner , when ye shall see these things come to pass , know that it is nigh , even at the doors .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei ba ki jia , phin tip ba ka por ka la jan , kaba la kloi ban sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phi ha kajuh ka rukom, haba phi iohi ia kine kiei kiei kiba jia, to tip ba ka la jan, wat ha ki jingkhang ruh .

en: And he bowed himself , and said , What is thy servant , that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?
kha: U Mephibosheth u dem ngon sa shisien bad u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , ngam long uba kham bha ban ïa u ksew uba la ïap ! Balei ba phin da long uba bha haduh katne ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem khrup bad u la ong, "Kaei ka jinglong jong me, ba me dei ban peit ia u kulai uba la iap kum ma nga ?

en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .
kha: Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba kumba nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi ieit eh ba ngi ïalong lang borabor , lada ngi im lane ngi ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam kren ia kane ban pynrem ia phi: namar nga la ong mynshuwa , ba phi don ha ki dohnud jong ngi ban iap bad ban im bad phi .

en: Masters , give unto your servants that which is just and equal ; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven .
kha: Ko ki kynrad , to long kiba beit bad kiba hok ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa ki mraw jong phi . Kynmaw ba ma phi ruh phi don U Kynrad ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynrad , ai ha ki shakri jong phi ia kaba hok bad kaba iaryngkat ; da kaba tip ba phi ruh phi don u Master ha bneng .

en: Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,
kha: bad beit beit sha Gilead bad sha Kadesh ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha Dan , bad na Dan ki leit shaphang sepngi sha Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la poi ha Gilead bad ha ka ri Tahtimhodshi ; bad ki la poi ha Danjaan bad shaphang u Sidon .

en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :
kha: Ïa u yn sa aiti noh ha ki Jentil , ki ban ibeiñ ïa u , krenbeiñ ïa u bad bynthiew ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un shah pynpoi ha ki Jutang, bad un shah lehbein, bad un shah pynkhih bein, bad un shah pynkhih bein:

en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .
kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sngi , namar la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhreh ia ka jingai sngewbha pyrshah ia u Joseph ha ka por shiteng sngi: namar ki la iohsngew ba ki dei ban bam kpu hangta .

en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,
kha: Hynrei ma me , me la bud ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , ka jinglong jingim jong nga , bad ka jingthmu jong nga ha ka jingim ; me la khmih ïa ka jingngeit jong nga , ka jingïaishah jong nga , ka jingieit jong nga , ka jingïaineh jong nga , ka jingshah pynshitom jong nga , bad ki jingshah shitom jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la tip pura ia ka jinghikai jong nga, ka rukom im, ka jingthmu, ka jingngeit, ka jingsngewsih, ka jingsngewrit , ka jingshaniah , ka jingshaniah .

en: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
kha: baroh ki dei ban ai katba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei un ai katba u lah, kat kum ka jingkyrkhu U Trai U Blei jong me uba u la ai ha me .

en: And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
kha: Lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei ba phi loit ïa u , ong ha u ba u Kynrad u donkam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u kylli ia phi , Balei phi pyllait ia u ? kumta phin ong ha u , Namar U Trai u donkam ia u .

en: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples , after that he was risen from the dead .
kha: Kane , te , ka la long ka sien kaba lai ba U Jisu u la paw ha ki synran hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei mynta ka sien kaba lai ba U Jisu u la pyni ia lade ha ki synran jong u , hadien kata u la mihpat na kiba iap .

en: Behold , he withholdeth the waters , and they dry up : also he sendeth them out , and they overturn the earth .
kha: Ka jingrang ryngkhiang ka wan haba U Blei u pynsangeh ïa u slap ; ki jingshlei um ki wan haba u pyllait war ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u khang ia ki um , bad ki tyrkhong: ruh u phah ia ki shabar , bad ki pynkylla ia ka khyndew .

en: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour : and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap ha ka rta kaba la tymmen bha , uba la dap kyrhai da ka spah bad ka burom ; bad u Solomon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iap ha ka rta kaba bha, kaba dap da ki sngi, ka spah bad ka burom : bad u Solomon u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And because ye are sons , God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts , crying , Abba , Father .
kha: Ban pyn-i ba phi dei ki khun jong u , U Blei u la phah ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khun jong u ha ki dohnud jong ngi , U Mynsiem uba kyang ,  Ko Pa , Pa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba phi long ki khun shynrang, U Blei u la phah ia U Mynsiem jong u Khun jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi, da kaba pyrta, Abba, ko Kpa .

en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .
kha: Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u :  Hato mem long U Messaïah ? To pynim ïa lade bad ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki nongleh bymman uba la shah rong noh ha u, u da ong: Lada me long U Khrist , to pynim ia lade bad ia ngi .

en: And Moses took the anointing oil , and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein , and sanctified them .
kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka umphniang pynsleh , bad u buh ïa ka ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad baroh kaba don ha ka , bad ha kane ka rukom u pynkyntang ïa ki baroh sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka umphniang pynsleh bad u la pynsleh ia ka iingjain bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka .

en: The watchman said , The morning cometh , and also the night : if ye will enquire , enquire ye : return , come .
kha: Nga jubab ,  Ka step ka wan , hynrei ka miet kan wan biang . Lada phi kwah ban kylli biang , sa wan pat bad kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap u la ong , Ka step ka wan, bad ruh ka miet: lada phi kwah ban kylli, kylli ia phi: to wan phai noh .

en: Save that the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ba ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la shah weng noh: ki briew ki la knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih kaba dang don ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and , lo , God hath shewed me also thy seed .
kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Ngam shym poi pyrkhat ba ngan dang ïohi biang ïa ka khmat jong me ; pynban U Blei u la shah ba ngan ïohi sa ïa ki khun jong me ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la ong ha u Joseph, Ngam shym la pyrkhat ban iohi ia ka khmat jong me: bad, ha khmih, U Blei u la pyni ia nga ruh ia u symbai jong me .

en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel , who did very wickedly :
kha: Ha kawei ka por , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel , uba la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane u syiem Judah u la iasoh bad u Ahasaiah syiem Israel uba la leh sniew shibun:

en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart , and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them :
kha: Pynban , ki la long kiba mutlop bad ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la hikai ïa ki ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la iaid katkum ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong ki hi, bad hadien u Baalim , kaba ki kpa jong ki ki la hikai ia ki:

en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself , ye do well :
kha: Phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei lada phi kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong ka hima , ïa kaba la shem ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  To ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba ieit ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi pyndep ia ka ain syiem kat kum ka jingthoh: Me ieit ia u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ia lade:

en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace , and be whole of thy plague .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk , bad to long kaba la khiah na ka jingshitom jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka, Ko khun, ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynlong ia me baroh kawei ban leit suk, bad to long baroh kawei ka khlam jong me .

en: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein , for the fruit of their doings .
kha: Hynrei ka pyrthei kan long kum ka ri shyiap namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka ri kan long kaba la jot namar jong ki kiba shong ha ka , namar u soh jong ki jingleh jong ki .

en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
kha: Yn don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jentil ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih, halor kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem briew kaba leh sniew, na u Jiw nyngkong eh, bad ruh na ki Jutang ; .

en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .
kha: Ha ka sngi ba u Lot u mih na Sodom , ka ding bad u kyndok ki la hap na bneng bad la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kajuh ka sngi ba u Lot u la mih na Sodom u la slap ia ka ding bad u mawlyngnai na bneng bad u la pynjot ia ki baroh .

en: But every man s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him , then shall he eat thereof .
kha: hynrei uno uno u mraw ba phi la thied u lah ban bam ïa ka lada phi otsher shuwa ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei u shakri uba la thied da ka pisa , haba me la ot ia u , te un bam ia ka .

en: Then shall they call upon me , but I will not answer  ; they shall seek me early , but they shall not find me :
kha: Hangta kin sa khot kyrpad ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ngan ym jubab ; phin sa wan wad ïa nga kylleng sawdong , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin khot ia nga , hynrei ngan ym jubab ; kin wad kloi ia nga , hynrei kin ym shem ia nga:

en: Christ is become of no effect unto you , whosoever of you are justified by the law ; ye are fallen from grace .
kha: Kito na phi kiba pyrshang ban pynksan ha khmat U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , phi la dkhat noh ïa lade na U Khrist . Phi long shabar ka jingaiei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Khrist u la kylla long uba khlem jingktah ei ei ia phi, uno uno na phi uba la pynshisha da ka hukum ; phi la hap na ka jingaiei .

en: Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .
kha: Te nangta , phi don jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga san tylli ki kpu ne kano kano kaba phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta te kaei kaba don hapoh ka kti jong me ? ai ia nga san tylli ki kpu ha ka kti jong nga , ne kaei kaba don .

en: What ? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body ? for two , saith he , shall be one flesh .
kha: Lane lehse phim tip ba u briew uba pynïasoh ïa la ka met bad ka nuti u long kawei ka met bad ka ? Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shai kdar ,  Baroh ar kin ïalong kawei ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ? phim tip ba uta uba la pyniasoh bad ka met ka long kawei ka met ? namar arngut, u ong u , kin long kawei ka doh .

en: He is swift as the waters  ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .
kha: Ïa u briew uba sniew la rong noh ha ka jingshlei , bad ka jaka kaba u long trai ka don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ; um leit shuh ban trei ha la ki bri sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U long uba stet kumba ki um; ka bynta jong ki ka long kaba la tim ha ka khyndew: um iohi ia ka lynti jong ki kper sohjew .

en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel  ; and the name of his second , Abiah : they were judges in Beer–sheba .
kha: U khun uba kham heh u kyrteng u Joel bad uba kham rit , u Abijah ; kine ki long ki nongbishar ha Beersheba .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka kyrteng jong u khun nyngkong jong u ka long u Joel bad ka kyrteng jong u ba ar jong u: ki long ki nongbishar ha Beersheba .

en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa u briew uba nyngkong , u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ;  hynrei u Adam uba khatduh u la long U Mynsiem uba ai jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta la thoh ia u briew uba nyngkong u Adam u la long u mynsiem uba im ; u Adam uba khatduh u la long u mynsiem uba stet .

en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .
kha: Kumta hadien khyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la iaid lyngba ia ka ri baroh kawei , ki la poi ha Jerusalem ha kaba kut jong ki hynniew bnai bad arphew sngi .

en: And she said unto them , Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me .
kha: Wat khot ïa nga , ka Naomi ,  ka jubab ;  khot noh ïa nga , ka Marah , namar U Blei Bakhrawbor u la pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha ki, Wat khot ia nga u Naomi, khot ia nga u Mara: namar ba U Blei u la leh bein shibun ia nga .

en: And his disciples said unto him , Thou seest the multitude thronging thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la jubab ,  Me ïohi kumno ki briew ki ïa-thngian ïa me ; balei ba me kylli uei uba la ktah ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la ong ha u, Me iohi ia u paidbah ba u ia tyngkhuh bad me bad me ong ba me la ktah ia nga ?

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , go , get thee unto the house of Israel , and speak with my words unto them .
kha: Nangta U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , leit sha ki paid Israel bad ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa me ba men ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, to leit sha ka iing Israel bad to kren da ki ktien jong nga ha ki .

en: And he made two cherubims of gold , beaten out of one piece made he them , on the two ends of the mercy seat  ;
kha: U thaw ruh ar tylli ki Kherub da ka ksiar tylli kaba la shoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ar tylli ki cherub ksiar, la pynkhih na kawei ka bynta u la shna ia ki, ha ki arliang jong ka jaka shong ba la leh;

en: So the prophet departed , and waited for the king by the way , and disguised himself with ashes upon his face .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa u sop spaiñ ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñ , ban buhrieh ïa ka durkhmat , bad u leit bad ïeng harud lynti , ban ap ïa u syiem Israel ban ïaid nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u nongiathuhlypa u la leit noh , bad u la ap ia u syiem hajan lynti , bad u la pynkylla ia lade da ka dewbilat ha ka khmat jong u .

en: Then he said , Go , borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours , even empty vessels  ; borrow not a few .
kha: Khie leit sha ki paramarjan jong phi bad pan kylliang bun tylli ki khra thylli kat kiba phi lah ban ïoh ,  u Elisha u la ong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong , Leit , shim ram ia me na ki para marjan jong me baroh , wat ki lieng kiba thylli; ym tang khyndiat .

en: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph , of the house of David  ; and the virgin s name was Mary .
kha: U la don ka khubor ïa ka theisotti kaba la ïatehktien bad u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph , uba long u nonghiarpateng na u syiem Dabid . Ka kyrteng jong ka , ka long ka Mari .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei ka nongleh kam sniew kaba la shah kyntait ha u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph , na ka iing u Dabid ; bad ka kyrteng kaba dang kha ka long ka Maria .

en: Then said the Jews , Forty and six years was this temple in building , and wilt thou rear it up in three days ?
kha: Hato men tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ?  ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ka la shim por sawphew hynriew snem ban tei ïa kane ka Templ !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Jiw ki la ong , Sawphew hynriew snem kane ka temple ka dang tei , bad me pynmih ia ka ha ki lai sngi ?

en: And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
kha: U la pyrkhat ,  Lada u Iso u wan ïaleh ïa kawei ka kynhun bad u pynjot ïa ka , kata kawei pat ka kynhun ka lah ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Lada u Iso u wan sha kawei ka kynhun bad u la shoh ia ka, te kawei pat ka kynhun kaba sah kan lait im .

en: But when Israel came up from Egypt , and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea , and came to Kadesh  ;
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia : mynba ki Israel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap haduh ka Khmut Duriaw Akaba , bad ki wan poi ha Kadesh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Israel ki la wan kiew na Ijipt bad ki la iaid lyngba ka ri khlaw haduh ka duriaw Basaw bad ki la poi ha Kadesh ; .

en: And the people repented them for Benjamin , because that the  Lord  had made a breach in the tribes of Israel .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewsih na ka bynta ki Benjamin namar U  Trai  u la phiah ïa ka jingtylli kawei jong ki jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la kylla bamut na ka bynta u Benjamin namar ba U Trai u la pynlong ia ka jingpynkhein ha ki jait Israel .

en: And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na ka duwan kaba ong ,  Ko Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh ! Kaba shisha bad kaba hok ki long da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia uwei pat na ka almari ba u ong , Wat la katta ruh, ko Trai Blei Uba donbor baroh, uba shisha bad uba hok ki long ki jingbishar jong me .

en: Who , when they came to Caesarea , and delivered the epistle to the governor , presented Paul also before him .
kha: Ki la ïalam ïa u sha Kaisaria , ki la ai ïa ka shithi ha u lyngskor , bad ki la aiti ïa u Paul ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba, haba ki la poi ha Kaisaria, bad u la aiti ia ka shithi sha u Lat, u la pyni ia u Paul ruh ha khmat jong u .

en: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children  ; I will not go out free :
kha: Hynrei lada u mraw u pynbna ba u ieit ïa la u kynrad , ïa la ka tnga , bad ïa la ki khun , bad um kwah ban ïoh laitluid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u shakri un ong shai: Nga ieit ia u kynrad jong nga, ia ka tnga jong nga bad ki khun jong nga; ngan ym leit shabar laitluid:

en: Saying , Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord : peace in heaven , and glory in the highest .
kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa u syiem uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Ka jingsuk ha ki bneng bad ka burom ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , La kyrkhu ia u Syiem uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai: ka jingsuk ha bneng , bad ka burom ha jrong tam .

en: Our wholesales have been very encouraging and the booking orders have also witnessed a significant rise .  " "
kha: Ki jingdie marbam jong ngi ki la long kiba ai mynsiem shibun bad ki jingbthah booking ruh ki la sakhi ia ka jingkiew kaba jur .  " "
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingdie baroh jong ngi ki la long kiba ai mynsiem shibun bad ki jingbthah book ruh ki la sakhi ia ka jingkiew kaba khraw . .

en: And he would not for a while : but afterward he said within himself , Though I fear not God , nor regard man  ;
kha: La slem bah u nongbishar u la kyntait ban leh ei ei , hynrei ha kaba khatduh u la ong ha lade , ‘ Wat la ngam sheptieng ïa U Blei lane burom ïa u briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym leh katto katne por: hynrei hadien u la ong hapoh jong u: Wat la ngam tieng ia U Blei, lymne nga burom ia u briew ; .

en: That they may want bread and water , and be astonished one with another , and consume away for their iniquity .
kha: Kin sa kyrduh ïa u kpu bad ka um ; kin long kiba duh jingkyrmen , bad kin ringsdot noh namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin kwah ia u kpu bad ka um , bad kin sngew lyngngoh iwei ia iwei pat bad kin bam noh ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .
kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi leh !  Lada u hynmen u para jong phi u leh pop , to sneng tyngeh ïa u , bad lada u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade: Lada u hynmen jong me u leh pyrshah ia me, to pynrem ia u bad lada u kylla bamut , to map ia u .

en: Here they were described as the protectors of sage Vasistha and his cow against the attack of king Viswamitra .
kha: Hangne ​​la batai ia ki kum ki nongiada ia u riewstad Vasistha bad ia ka masi jong u pyrshah ia ka jingshah thombor jong u syiem Viswamitra .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne la batai ia ki kum ki nongiada ia u sage Vasistha bad ka masi jong u pyrshah ia ka jingshah thombor jong u syiem Viswamitra .

en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam , that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem :
kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Rehoboam , u syiem Shishak jong ka Ijipt u la leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra jong u syiem Rehoboam , u Syiem Ijipt u la wan pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem:

en: And Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .
kha: U Abner bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Ishbosheth ki la leit na Mahanaim sha ka nongbah Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u khun u Ner bad ki shakri jong u Ishiioshet u khun u Saul ki la mih na Mahanaim sha Gibeon .

en: And enquired not of the  Lord  : therefore he slew him , and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  U pynïap ïa u , bad u ai synshar noh ïa ka hima sha u Dabid u khun jong u Jesse .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la kylli ia U Trai: namarkata u la pyniap ia u, bad u la pynphai ia ka hima sha u Dabid u khun u Jesse .

en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth , that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
kha: bad ba ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane dei ban bret ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym hap bad u mane ia u, ba un shah bret hapdeng ka ding kaba thang .

en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , ngan leh kumjuh ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba phla ia nga ha khmat ki briew , ia u ruh ngan phla ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng .

en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels , that the excellency of the power may be of God , and not of us .
kha: Pynban ma ngi kiba don ïa kane ka jingkynshew kaba kynja mynsiem ngi long kum ki khiew khyndew , khnang ban pyn-i ba ka bor kaba halor tam ka long ka jong U Blei , ym ka jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi don ia kane ka spah ha ki khiew khyndew , ba ka jingbha jong ka bor kan long ka jong U Blei , bad ym jong ngi .

en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the plague was stayed .
kha: Ynda ka khlam ka la sangeh , u Aaron u leit phai sha u Moses ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la leit phai biang sha u Moses sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad ka khlam ka la sah .

en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,
kha: Ngi don ïa ka hok kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleh bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka ktien ka jingshisha , da ka bor U Blei , da ka jainkup jong ka hok ha ka liang kadiang bad sha ka liang kadiang .

en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .
kha: Hynrei kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa u kpa jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha kaba kamai spah , kumta ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u kim shym la iaid ha ki lynti jong u, hynrei ki la phai noh hadien ka jingshah lehbein, bad ki la shim ia ki pisa tuh bad ki la pynkylla ia ka jingbishar .

en: And they went into Capernaum  ; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue , and taught .
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong Kapernam , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la sdang ban hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit sha Kaparnaum ; bad mardor ha ka sngi Sabha u la rung ha ka synagog bad u la hikai .

en: Not that I speak in respect of want : for I have learned , in whatsoever state I am , therewith to be content .
kha: Bad ngam shym ong ïa kane namar ba nga la shah leh klet , naba nga la nang ban sngewhun ha kaei kaba nga don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba nga kren ha kaba iadei bad ka jingkwah: namar nga la nang, ha kano kano ka jylla nga long, da kata ban sngewhun .

en: Let your speech be always with grace , seasoned with salt , that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man .
kha: Ka jingkren jong phi ka dei ban long borabor kaba sngewbang bad kaba sngewtynnat , bad phi dei ban tip kumno ban ai ka jubab kaba dei ha uwei uwei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka jingkren jong phi kan long beit bad ka jingaiei, kaba la pyndap da ka umsoh, ba phin tip kumno phi dei ban jubab ia uwei pa uwei .

en: And have ye not read this scripture  ; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner :
kha: Hato da shisha phi la pule ïa kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ?   ‘ U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi , u la kylla long uba donkam eh na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim shym la pule ia kane ka jingthoh ; U maw uba ki nongtei u la kyntait u kylla long u khlieh jong ka kut:

en: And I saw an angel come down from heaven , having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel ba u wan hiar na bneng , u da bat ha ka kti ïa u shabi jong ka  liewlong khlem trai bad u kynjri uba khia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia u angel uba wan hiar na bneng, uba don ia u shabi jong ka thliew kaba khlem shapoh bad ka kynjri kaba khraw ha ka kti jong u .

en: Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sendeth an ambassage , and desireth conditions of peace .
kha: Lada um sngewlah , un phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïashem ïa uwei pat u syiem , ban kyrpad ïa ki kyndon jingsuk katba u dang jngai bah ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lym kumta, katba uwei pat u dang long uba jngai, u phah ia ka jingkren bein, bad u kwah ia ki jinglong jong ka jingsuk .

en: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be , blessed shall she be above women in the tent .
kha: Kaba donbok tam na ki kynthei ka dei ka Jael , Ka tnga jong u Heber u jait Ken ; Kaba donbok tam na ki kynthei kiba shong ha ki dara .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia ka Jael ka tnga jong u Heber u Kenite, la kyrkhu ia ka ban long halor ki kynthei ha ka tent .

en: And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .
kha: Nga shoh pynkyllon ïa ki , bad kim lah khie shuh ki thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la bam ia ki, bad nga la pynmynsaw ia ki, ba kim lah ban khie: Hooid, ki la hap hapoh ki kjat jong nga .

en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them .
kha: U la mih lem bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ki hynriewspah tylli ki kali ïapom jong u kiba bha tam , ïa kiba la ai hukum da ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim hynriew spah tylli ki kali ba la jied, bad ki kali jong ka ri Ijipt baroh , bad u la leit sha uwei pa uwei na ki .

en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .
kha: Bad nangta kin wan sha ka jingsngewthuh bad kin lait na ka jingriam u Ksuid , uba la pynngat ïa ki bad la pynlong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba kin lah ban pynkoit ia lade na ka jingma jong u ksuid , kiba la shah kem da u katba mon jong u .

en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam uba ar u syiem ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Amasaïah u long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynriew jong u syiem Israel u la sdang ia u Asariah u khun jong u Amasaiah u syiem Judah ban synshar .

en: And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ha-ei ka don , namar bunsien U Jisu u la ïakynduh hangta bad la ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Judas ruh uba la shet kylla ia u, u tip ia kata ka jaka: namar U Jisu bunsien u la leit sha kata bad ki synran jong u .

en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver , and for an homer of barley , and an half homer of barley :
kha: Kumta nga la siew khatsan lyngkhot ka rupa bad shispah sanphew kilo u barli ban thied ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la thied ia ka ha nga shiphew tylli ki rupa, bad na ka bynta u sohjew, bad u sohjew uba shiteng:

en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .
kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum hynñiew tukri pura jong ki lyngkhot kiba sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bam baroh , bad ki la dap: bad ki la shim ia ka doh kaba la tyrkhong kaba la sah hynriew tylli ki basket kiba la dap .

en: Behold , I stand here by the well of water  ; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water :
kha: Hangne nga don harud kane ka pukri ha kaba ki samla kynthei jong ka nongbah kin sa ïawan tong um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga ieng hangne hajan ka pung um ; bad ki khun kynthei jong ka shnong ki mih ban tan um:

en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
kha: Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh kumba u Elijah u la ong ïa ka , bad baroh na ki , ki dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la leit bad ka la leh katkum ka jingong jong u Elijah: bad ma ka bad ka iing jong ka ki la bam bun sngi .

en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long uta uba pynrit ïa lade bad uba long kum une u khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pynrit mynsiem ia lade kum une u khynnah rit , uta u long uba khraw tam ha ka hima bneng .

en: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .
kha: U Philip u shem ïa lade ha Asotos ; u la nang leit sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Philip u la lap ha Azotus : bad u la iaid lyngba u la ialap ha ki shnong baroh, haduh ba u la poi ha Kaisaria .

en: Then Joshua called the twelve men , whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , out of every tribe a man :
kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kiba u la jied ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joshua u la khot ia ki shiphew ngut ki briew kiba u la pynkhreh na ki khun Israel:

en: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .
kha: Mynta , kane baroh ka long ka nuksa ïa ngi , ban maham ïa ngi ban ym kwah brai ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , kumba ki la leh , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba don na ki kiba la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine kiei kiei ki long ki nuksa jong ngi, ha ka jingthmu ngim dei ban kwah ia kiei kiei kiba sniew, kumba ki ruh ki kwah .

en: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang wan hajan ka Jerikho , la don u briew bamatlah uba shong harud ka lynti bah , u da khrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba u dang wan hajan Jerikos, uwei u briew uba matlah u la shong hajan ka lynti u la kyrpad:

en: Whether he have gored a son , or have gored a daughter , according to this judgment shall it be done unto him .
kha: Dei ban bud ïa kane kajuh ka aiñ lada uta u masi kyrtong u pynïap ïa u khynnah shynrang ne ïa ka khynnah kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: La u la kha khun shynrang ne u la kha khun kynthei kat kum kane ka jingbishar yn leh ia u .

en: Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying  ; who can hear it ?
kha: Kiba bun na ki nongbud jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kane bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka jinghikai ka long kaba eh than . Uei u ban shahshkor ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bun na ki synran jong u haba ki la iohsngew ia kane ki la ong: Kane ka long ka jingkren kaba eh ; mano ba lah ban iohsngew ia ka ?

en: Come , let us make our father drink wine , and we will lie with him , that we may preserve seed of our father .
kha: Ale ngin ïapyndih buaid ïa i pa bad ngin ïathiah lang bad i , khnang ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti na i .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, to ngin pynlong ia u kpa jong ngi ban dih wain, bad ngin thiah bad u, ba ngin pynneh ia u symbai jong u kpa jong ngi .

en: Then Daniel went to his house , and made the thing known to Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah , his companions :
kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha ïing bad u la ïathuh ïa ki paralok jong u — u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah — ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha la iing bad u la pynpaw ia kata ha u Hananiah, u Mishael bad u Asariah, ki paralok jong u:

en: But when the cattle were feeble , he put them not in : so the feebler were Laban s , and the stronger Jacob s .
kha: Hynrei um shym buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki jingri kiba kham tlot . Tang hapdeng khyndiat por u Laban u la ïoh ïa baroh ki jingri kiba tlot , bad u Jakob pat u ïoh baroh ki jingri kiba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki masi ki la tlot, um shym la buh ia ki: kumta u nonglehkai u la long u Laban s, bad u Jakob uba kham khlain u s .

en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee , O  Lord  , among the heathen , and I will sing praises unto thy name .
kha: Bad kumta ngan ïaroh ïa me , ko  Trai  , hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , nga rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan ainguh ia me ko Trai hapdeng ki nongwei bad ngan rwai iaroh ia ka kyrteng jong me .

en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all : )
kha: Phi tip ïa ka khubor kaba u la phah sha ki paid Israel , da kaba pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha jong ka jingsuk lyngba U Jisu Khrist , uba long U Trai jong baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba U Blei u la phah sha ki khun Israel, da kaba ialap ia ka jingsuk da U Jisu Khrist: (u long U Trai jong baroh: )

en: And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;
kha: Bad U Blei , uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , u la pyn-i ïa ka jingmynjur ïa ki Jentil da kaba ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki , kumba u la leh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei uba tip ia ki dohnud, u la pynpaw ia ki, u la ai ia ki ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid kumba u la leh ha ngi;

en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab : and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart .
kha: Na ka ïing u Abinadab ki wanrah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki pynkit ïa ka ha ka kali kaba thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio ki sumar ïa kata ka kali ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rah ia ka synduk U Blei ha ka kali thymmai na ka iing u Abinadab : bad u Ussa bad u Ahio ki tan ia ka kali .

en: The  Lord  your God hath multiplied you , and , behold , ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynbun ia phi, bad , ha khmih , phi long mynta ka sngi kum ki khlur bneng na ka bynta ka jingbun briew .

en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the  Lord  God of Israel , and sought him , he was found of them .
kha: Hynrei haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , ki phai sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ki la wad ïa u bad shem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la phai sha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel bad ki la wad ia u , la lap ia u na ki .

en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God , and without a teaching priest , and without law .
kha: Slem bah ki Israel ki la im khlem U Blei uba shisha , khlem ki lyngdoh ban hikai ïa ki , bad khlem ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la slem bha ki Israel ki la long khlem U Blei uba shisha, bad khlem u lyngdoh uba hikai, bad khlem ka ain .

en: But let every man prove his own work , and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone , and not in another .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban bishar ïa la ka jong ka jingleh . Lada ka long kaba bha , te u lah ban sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba ma u da lade u la leh , khlem da ïanujor ïa ka bad kaei kaba kiwei ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba uwei pa uwei un pynshisha ia la ka jong ka kam, bad nangta un don ka jingkmen ha lade marwei, ym ha uwei pat .

en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .
kha: Ngim ju tei ki ïing ki sem ban shong ban sah — ngi shong ha ki ïingjaiñ — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkha , lane u kew . Ngi la kohnguh tylli ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jonadab u la hukum ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi la shong ha ki ïingjaiñ bad ngi la kohnguh bad ngi la leh katba kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .

en: And he said ,  Come .  And when Peter was come down out of the ship , he walked on the water , to go to Jesus .
kha: To wan !  la jubab U Jisu . Kumta u Petros u la hiar na ka lieng bad u la sdang ban ïaid halor ka um sha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, To wan . Bad haba u Petros u la wan hiar na ka lieng , u la iaid halor ka um , ban leit sha U Jisu .

en: Let the heavens be glad , and let the earth rejoice : and let men say among the nations , The  Lord  reigneth .
kha: To kmen , ko pyrthei bad sahit bneng ! Ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  u long u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki bneng kin sngewbha , bad ai ba ka khyndew kan sngewbha: bad ai ba ki briew kin ong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , U Trai u synshar .

en: And went again into the judgment hall , and saith unto Jesus , Whence art thou ? But Jesus gave him no answer .
kha: U la leit pat sha ïing bad u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Nangno me wan ?  Hynrei U Jisu um shym jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit biang sha ka jaka bishar bad u la ong ha U Jisu, Phi long kumno ? Hynrei U Jisu um shym la jubab ei ei ia u .

en: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire : this is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi , ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer . Ka kham bha shibun ban sngewhun bad kaei kaba phi don ban ïa kaba ïai kwah ïa kawei pat kaei kaei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ka jingpeit jong ki khmat ban ia ka jingleit kai jong ka jingkwah: kane ruh ka long ka jinglong bieit bad ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem .

en: And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .
kha: Kita baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingïateh kular bakyntang iwei ïa iwei pat . U Dabid u sah ha Horesh , bad u Jonathan u leit noh sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arngut ki la leh ia ka jutang ha khmat U Trai : bad u Dabid u la shong ha khlaw , bad u Jonathan u la leit sha la iing .

en: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food : we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks .
kha: Ngi la wanrah ruh kham bun ki pisa ban thied jingbam shuh . Ngim tip satia mano ba la buh biang ïa ki pisa jong ngi ha ki byrni jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki pisa ngi la wanrah ha ki kti jong ngi ban thied jingbam: ngim lah ban tip mano ba buh ia ka pisa jong ngi ha ki tyrpeng jong ngi .

en: Can a maid forget her ornaments , or a bride her attire ? yet my people have forgotten me days without number .
kha: Hato ka samla kan klet ïa ki jingdeng jong ka , lane ka nongleitkurim ïa ka jaiñ kyntiew kurim jong ka ? Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la klet ïa nga bun bun sngi ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka nongtrei ka lah ban klet ia ki jingdeng jong ka , ne ka nongleitkurim jong ka ? hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la klet ia nga ki sngi khlem nombar .

en: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;
kha: Ïa nga la set ha ka kamra kaba shapoh khyndew bad la set slem ïa nga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Jeremaiah u la rung ha ka thliew bad ha ki ïing rit bad u Jeremaiah u la sah hangta bun sngi;

en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,
kha: La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei bad la pynpaw ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la buh lypa shisha ha khmat ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei , hynrei u la paw ha kine ki por ba khatduh na ka bynta jong phi , .

en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abraham harud ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre . Katba u Abraham u dang shong ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka por ba dang shit kyr-ang mynsngi , u la khmied bad u la ïohi lai ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha u ha ki madan Mamre : bad u la shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ ha ka jingshit jong ka sngi;

en: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed , and , behold , a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven  ;
kha: Katba nga dang pyrkhat shaphang ka jingïohipaw , nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba wan hiar na bneng , uba la kloi bad uba peitngor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ha ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong nga halor ka jingthiah jong nga, bad, ha khmih, u nongap bad u riewkhuid u la wan hiar na bneng ; .

en: Of the sons of Hebron  ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .
kha: U Hebron , u khun uba lai jong u Kohath , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeraïah , u Amaraïah , u Jehasiel , bad u Jekameam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki khun shynrang jong u Hebron ; Jeriah uba nyngkong, u Amariah uba ar, u Jahaziel uba lai bad u Jekameam uba saw .

en: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .
kha: Napdeng kiba hiarpateng na u Ishar , ïa u Khenanaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u la buh ban peit ïa ki kam synshar khadar : Kaba buh jingthoh bad kaba bishar ïa ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki Izharite , u Chenaiah bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki long na ka bynta ka kam kaba shabar halor ki Israel , na ka bynta ki ophisar bad ki nongbishar .

en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh s , and captain of the guard .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ha Ijipt , ki Midian ki la die noh ïa u Joseph ha u Potiphar , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , uba dei u kapten jong ki nongap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Midian ki la die ia u sha Ijipt ha u Potiphar, u ophisar jong u Pharaoh s .

en: I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .
kha: Nga pynïaidkam bad nga ai ki jingrai ; nga la ïalam ïa ki kumba u syiem u ïalam ïa la ki shipai , bad nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingshngain haba ki duh jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la jied ia ka lynti jong ki, bad nga la shong kum u syiem ha ka kynhun shipai, kum uba pyntngen ia ki nongsngewsih .

en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  shall die : shall we be consumed with dying ?
kha: Lada mano mano ban wan wat tang hajan ka Ïingjaiñ ruh un ïap , te ngi baroh ngi long hi kum kiba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba wan hajan ka iing jong U Trai un iap: hato ngin shah pynjot da kaba iap ?

en: Then took they him , and led him , and brought him into the high priest s house . And Peter followed afar off .
kha: Ki la kem ïa U Jisu bad ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh ; bad u Petros u la bud na pajih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la shim ia u, bad ki la ialam ia u, bad ki la wanrah ia u shapoh iing u rangbah lyngdoh . U Petros u la bud noh .

en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man , unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works ,
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u Dabid u la mut mynba u la kren shaphang ka jingsuk jong u briew ïa uba U Blei u pdiang kum uba hok , lait noh na kano kano kaba u briew u leh :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u Dabid ruh u batai ia ka jingkyrkhu jong u briew , ha uba U Blei u pynshitom ia ka hok khlem ki kam , .

en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness , than he that is perverse in his ways , though he be rich .
kha: Ka kham bha ba duk bad ba long hok ban ïa kaba riewspah bad ïaid kynriang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ia uba duk uba iaid ha ka jinglong hok jong u, ban ia uta uba kylla ha ki lynti jong u, wat la u long uba riewspah .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Mary .  She turned herself , and saith unto him , Rabboni  ; which is to say , Master .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Ko Mari !  Ka la phai sha u bad ka la ong ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Rabboni !  ( Kane ka mut  Ko Nonghikai ! . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ka, ka Maria . Ka la phai noh sha lade, bad ka la ong ha u, Rabbon ; kaba mut ban ong, Ko Nonghikai .

en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .
kha: U Phestos u la jubab ,  Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa leit pat shen shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Festo u la jubab , ba u Paul u dei ban sah ha Kaisaria bad ba ma u hi un leit noh tang khyndiat por .

en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .
kha: Ngim dei ban long kiba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar ngut na ki , ki la kyllon ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngin ym leh ia ka kam sniew kumba don napdeng jong ki kiba la leh , bad ki la hap ha kawei ka sngi lai arphew hajar .

en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the  Lord   ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .
kha: Haba phi ai ha kiba duk , ka long kumba phi ai kylliang sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  un sa siew pat ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba sngewsynei ia kiba duk u ai ram ia U Trai ; bad ia kaba u la ai un siew biang ia u .

en: And he said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me .
kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Lada me sngewbha ïa nga , ai ha nga katto katne ka jingpynshisha ba me dei da shisha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: Lada mynta nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me , te to pyni ia nga ia ka dak ba me kren bad nga .

en: I considered all the living which walk under the sun , with the second child that shall stand up in his stead .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat shaphang ki briew baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka pyrthei , bad nga la sngewthuh ba hangno re hangno hapdeng jong ki don u samla u ban shimti ïa ka jaka jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyrkhat ia kiba im baroh kiba iaid hapoh ka sngi , bad u khun uba ar uba ieng ha ka jaka jong u .

en: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world  ; but that the world through him might be saved .
kha: Naba U Blei um shym la phah ïa la U Khun sha ka pyrthei ba un long u nongbishar jong ka , hynrei , ba un long u nongpynim jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei um shym la phah ia la u Khun sha ka pyrthei ban pynrem ia ka pyrthei ; hynrei ba ka pyrthei lyngba jong u kan ioh jingpynim .

en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee  ; thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt be any more .
kha: Pha la jah noh , la jah noh junom , bad ki nongkhaïi na baroh kawei ka pyrthei ki la sngewtriem , ki la sheptieng ba ki ruh kin mad ïa ka kupar jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkhaii hapdeng ki briew kin sngap jar ia me; me long ka jingtieng, bad wat ju long shuh .

en: For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai  , bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; ym dei ban die mraw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ki shakri jong nga kiba nga la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt: kin ym shah die kum ki mraw .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Ye shall eat no manner of fat , of ox , or of sheep , or of goat .
kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa ka khleiñ jong ki masi , ki langbrot , ne ki blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Phin ym bam ia ka shini ne ka masi ne ka langbrot ne ka blang .

en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;
kha: Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia jong U Khrist la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ïa ki pop jong ngi la map ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ngi don ka jingpynim lyngba ka snam jong u, ka jingmap ia ki pop kat kum ka spah jong ka jingaiei jong u ; .

en: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you , that ye both do and will do the things which we command you .
kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ha ngi ka jingsngewskhem ha phi , bad ngi thikna ba phi leh bad phin ïai leh ïa kaei kaba ngi ong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi don ka jingshaniah ha U Trai kaba ktah ia phi , ba phi baroh arngut phi leh bad phin leh ia kiei kiei kiba ngi hukum ia phi .

en: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings . And he offered the burnt offering .
kha: Ki briew ki la sdang ban iehnoh noh ïa u Saul , kumta u ong ha ki ,  Wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , To wanrah ia ka jingainguh thang ha nga bad ki jingknia jingsuk . Bad u la tyrwa ia ka jingainguh thang .

en: And desired favour against him , that he would send for him to Jerusalem , laying wait in the way to kill him .
kha: Ki la kyrpad ïa u Phestos ban leh ei ei na ka bynta jong ki da kaba wallam ïa u Paul sha Jerusalem , naba ki la lah pynlong ka jingïasylla ban pynïap ïa u ha lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kwah ia u, ba un phah ia u sha Jerusalem, da kaba ap ha ka lynti ban pyniap ia u .

en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?
kha: Hynrei u Barsillai u jubab ,  Ngam don bun snem shuh ban im ; balei ngan leit bad U Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Barzillai u la ong ha u syiem: Haduh katno nga dang im, ba ngan leit sha Jerusalem bad u syiem ?

en: For ye have the poor with you always , and whensoever ye will ye may do them good : but me ye have not always .
kha: Phin don borabor ïa ki briew kiba duk bad phi , bad ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , phi lah ban ïarap ïa ki . Hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi don ia kiba duk bad phi man ka por, bad katba phi mon phi lah ban leh bha ia ki: hynrei ia nga phim don beit .

en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Abimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Shavsha was scribe  ;
kha: u Sadok u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Nadaok u khun u Ahitub bad u khun u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; bad u Shavsha u la thoh ; .

en: And she said , Drink , my lord : and she hasted , and let down her pitcher upon her hand , and gave him drink .
kha: Ka ong ,  Ko rangbah , to dih  bad ka pynhiar kloi kloi ïa uta u khiew um na ka tyrpeng jong ka , bad ka pynbat katba u dang dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong, To dih, ko kynrad jong nga: bad ka la kyrkieh, bad ka la pynhap ia ka khiew jong ka ha ka kti jong ka, bad ka la ai ia u ban dih .

en: And Peter answered unto her , Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much ? And she said , Yea , for so much .
kha: U Petros u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , hato kane ka pisa baroh ka dei kaba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , phi la ïohpdiang na kaba die ïa ka jaka jong phi ?   Ho-oid ,  ka la jubab ,  kato ka pisa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la jubab ia ka, To iathuh ia nga la phi die ia ka jaka haduh katne ? Bad ka la ong, Hooid, namar kata .

en: For to this end Christ both died , and rose , and revived , that he might be Lord both of the dead and living .
kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap bad u la mihpat sha ka jingim khnang ban long U Trai jong kiba im bad jong kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kane ka jingkut U Khrist baroh arngut u la iap, bad u la mihpat bad u la im pat, khnang ba un long U Trai jong kiba iap bad kiba im .

en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei , ngan pynhiarkput halor kane ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan ym leit jngoh ia kine kiei kiei ? ong U Trai: hato ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym shah pynshitom bein ha ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?

en: And he answering said unto him , Lord , let it alone this year also , till I shall dig about it , and dung it :
kha: Hynrei u nongsumar kper u la jubab , ‘ Iehnoh shuwa , ko kynrad , sa tang shisnem ; ngan tih sawdong jong u bad ai sboh katto katne .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia u, ko Trai, to ai ba kan long tang mynta u snem ruh, haduh ba ngan da tih ia ka, bad ngan da sngewsih ia ka:

en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
kha: Da shisha phi tip ba don shibun ki nongïamareh kiba ïashim bynta ha ka jingmareh thong , hynrei tang uwei na ki u ïoh ïa ka prais . Kumta to mareh ha kata ka rukom ban ïoh ïa ka prais .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba kito kiba mareh ha ka jingiakop ki mareh baroh , hynrei uwei u ioh ia ka khusnam ? Kumta mareh , ba phin ioh .

en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .
kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa kata ka thain baroh kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shaphang shathie , bad nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka madan baroh kawei ha kane ka liang ka Jordan shaphang mihngi, wat haduh ka duriaw jong ka madan, hapoh ki tyllong um jong ka Pisgah .

en: The  Lord  bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .
kha: U  Trai  u pyndiaw ïa ki jingthmu ki jaitbynriew ; um shah ïa ki ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u wanrah ia ka jingmut jong ki nongwei sha ka jingbym don jingktah: u pynlong ia ki tiar jong ki briew ki bym don jingktah ei ei .

en: For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .
kha: Da ka ding bad ka waitlam un pynshitom ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ka ding bad da ka waitlam jong u U Trai un kyrpad ia ka doh baroh: bad ka jingpyniap ia U Trai kan long kaba bun .

en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , u long uba hok , kumba U Khrist u long uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit , wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ia phi: uta uba leh ia ka hok u long uba hok , kumba u long uba hok .

en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein .
kha: Buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap ïa ka da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ka um hapdeng ka ïingjaiñ bad ka ïingkhang bad men theh um ha ka .

en: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .
kha: Kino kino ki bym kwah ban shah hikai kin ïailong kiba kyrduh . Hynrei uno uno uba sngap ïa ka jingpynbeit u long ba la ñiewkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduk bad ka jingsngewlehrain kan long ha uta uba kyntait ia ka jinghikai: hynrei uta uba pyrkhat ia ka jingshah pynrem un shah burom .

en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers , and none shall deliver her out of mine hand .
kha: Ngan law lyngkhuit ïa ka ha khmat kiba ieit jong ka , bad yn ym don uno uno ruh uba lah ban pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ngan sa lap ia ka jinglehrain jong ka ha khmat ki nongieit jong ka , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pyllait ia ka na ka kti jong nga .

en: Even as they delivered them unto us , which from the beginning were eyewitnesses , and ministers of the word  ;
kha: Ki la thoh ïa kaei kaba la ïathuh ha ngi da kito kiba la ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh naduh kaba sdang bad kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki la pynpoi ia ki ha ngi, kiba naduh kaba sdang ki long ki nongsakhi khmat bad ki nongshakri jong ka ktien ; .

en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the  Lord  into the hand of Asaph and his brethren .
kha: Ka long naduh kata ka por ba u Dabid u la ai nyngkong eh ha u Asaph bad ki para Lebi jong u ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u la pynpoi nyngkong ia kane ka Salm ban ainguh ia U Trai ha ka kti jong u Asaph bad ki hynmen jong u .

en: Let there more work be laid upon the men , that they may labour therein  ; and let them not regard vain words .
kha: Pyntrei shitom kham tyngeh ïa kine ki briew bad pynbunkam ïa ki , khnang ba kin ym don por ban shahshkor ïa ki nia lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin kham bun ki kam ha ki briew, ba kin trei shitom ha ka ; bad wat ai ba kin ym khein ia ki ktien kiba lehnohei .

en: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day , every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes .
kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , phim dei shuh ban leh kumba phi la ju leh . Haduh mynta , phi ïamane Blei katba phi sngewdei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi leh hangne ha kane ka sngi , uwei pa uwei u leh ia kaba dei ha la ki jong ki khmat .

en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba sha mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia nga shapoh ka phyllaw kaba shapoh shaphang mihngi : bad u la thew ia ka khyrdop kat kum kine ki jingthew .

en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .
kha: To pynkhiah ïa kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , to pynkhiah ïa kito kiba shitom na ki jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad to beh noh ïa ki ksuid . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumta to ai ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhiah ia kiba pang, pynkhuid ia kiba pang niangthohlieh, pynmih ia kiba iap: laitluid phi la ioh , laitluid phi la ai .

en: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .
kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba lui lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynshisha ia kiba sniew bad uta uba pynrem ia kiba hok , wat ma ki baroh arngut ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai .

en: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .
kha: Haba ka Martha ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan , ka la leit ban ïakynduh ïa u , hynrei ka Mari ka la sah ha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka Martha, tang shu iohsngew ba U Jisu u wan, ka la leit iakynduh ia u: hynrei ka Maria ka dang shong ha iing .

en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .
kha: Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingleh bymdei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan long uba isynei ia ka jingbymhok jong ki , bad ki pop jong ki bad ki jingbymhok jong ki ngan ym kynmaw shuh .

en: And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :
kha: Nangta u syiem , u lyngskor , bad ka Berniki , bad baroh kiwei pat ki la ïeng joit ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren kumta, u syiem u la ieng, bad u Lat bad u Bernice bad kita kiba shong bad ki:

en: And God blessed Noah and his sons , and said unto them , Be fruitful , and multiply , and replenish the earth .
kha: U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Noah bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad u ong ha ki ,  To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kyrkhu ia u Noah bad ki khun shynrang jong u, bad u la ong ha ki, To long kiba seisoh bad kiba bun bad pyndap ia ka khyndew .

en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth , that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures .
kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong u hi u la wallam ïa ngi sha ka jingim lyngba ka ktien jong ka jingshisha , khnang ba ngi dei ban ïoh ïa ka jaka kaba nyngkong hapdeng ki jingthaw baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki jingthaw jong u hi un kha ia ngi da ka ktien jong ka jingshisha , ba ngin long kum ki soh ba nyngkong jong ki jingthaw jong u .

en: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel , saying , When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower .
kha: Kumta u ong ha ki ,  Ngan sa wan pat ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ , bad haba nga wan , ngan pyntwa phum ïa une u mot !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ruh ha ki briew jong ka Penuel da kaba ong: Ynda nga la wan phai biang ha ka jingsuk , ngan pynpra noh ia kane ka tower .

en: And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
kha: Hadien katto katne por uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u la ong ,  Me ruh , me long uwei na ki !  Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam dei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien khyndiat por uwei pat u la iohi ia u, bad u la ong, Me ruh me long na ki . U Petros u la ong, ko briew, ngam long kumta .

en: And the man Elkanah , and all his house , went up to offer unto the  Lord  the yearly sacrifice , and his vow .
kha: Ka por ka la poi biang ba u Elkanah bad kiba ha ka ïing jong u ki leit biang sha Shiloh ban kñia ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem ha U  Trai  , bad ban ai ka jingainguh kyrpang ba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u Elkanah bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei ki la leit sha U Trai ia ka jingknia kaba man la u snem bad ka jingkular jong u .

en: And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
kha: Nangta u briew uba shitom na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan sha u , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong khuid ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la wan u nongpang niangthohlieh bad u la mane ia u, u da ong, ko Trai, lada me mon, me lah ban pynkhuid ia nga .

en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles  wings , and brought you unto myself .
kha: Phi la ïohi aïu ma nga , U  Trai  nga la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt bad kumno ba nga la kit ïa phi kum ka pukni kaba kit ïa la ki khun ha ki thapniang jong ka , bad nga la wan ïalam ïa phi sha nga ha kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohi ia kaei kaba nga la leh ia ki nong Ijipt bad kumno nga la kit ia phi ha ki bniat , bad nga la wanrah ia phi sha lade .

en: Who then is Paul , and who is Apollos , but ministers by whom ye believed , even as the Lord gave to every man ?
kha: Haba kumta , uei u Apollos ? Bad uei u Paul ? Ngi dei tang ki shakri jong U Blei , kiba la ïalam ïa phi ban ngeit . Uwei pa uwei na ngi u trei ïa ka kam kaba U Trai u la ai ïa u ban leh :
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba long u Paul bad u Apollos , hynrei ki nongshakri da kiba phi ngeit , kumba U Trai u la ai ha uwei pa uwei u briew ?

en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof , and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof ?
kha: Hato me lah ban pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno dei ban leit , lane ban phah noh biang ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me dei ban shim ia ka haduh u pud jong ka , bad ba me dei ban tip ia ki lynti sha ka iing jong ka ?

en: For the day is near , even the day of the  Lord  is near , a cloudy day  ; it shall be the time of the heathen .
kha: Ka sngi ka la jan , ka sngi haba U  Trai  un leh , ka sngi jong ki lyoh bad jingjynjar ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sngi ka la jan , wat ka sngi U Trai ka la jan , ka sngi kaba dum; kan long ka por jong ki nongwei .

en: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him , is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .
kha: Kaba leit tuklar ha ka jingïania ka bym dei ka kam jong phi ka long kumba leit sha lynti bah bad kem ïa u ksew na ki shkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid lyngba bad uba ialeh pyrshah ia u , u long kum uta uba shim ia u kulai da ki shkor .

en: I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .
kha: Nga tip aïu kito ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong , ki da kren lamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad kam ba nga la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor jong nga ha ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia kaei kaba ki nongiathuhlypa ki la ong , kata ka jingiathuhlypa ka don ha ka kyrteng jong nga , da kaba ong , Nga la phohsniew , nga la phohsniew .

en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be made fat .
kha: Ka jingkhapnap ka pynmih tang ka jingjynjar . Phi long kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ka dohnud kaba sngew sarong u ieng ha ka jingialeh: hynrei uta uba buh ia ka jingshaniah jong u ha U Trai un sa shah pynlong shini .

en: Go to , let us go down , and there confound their language , that they may not understand one another s speech .
kha: Ïa , ngin ïaleit hiar bad pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki , ba kumta kin ym ïasngewthuh shuh iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha , to ngin leit hiar, bad hangta pynkulmar ia ka ktien jong ki, ba kin ym sngewthuh iwei ia iwei pat ka jingkren .

en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .
kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u para jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynïap ïa u Asahel u hynmen u para jong ki ha ka thma ha Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abisai u hynmen jong u u la pyniap ia u Abner , namar u la pyniap ia u hynmen jong ki ha Gibeon ha ka thma .

en: He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea , he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .
kha: Un jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad ba yn ym ïohi shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Un her noh kum ka jingphohsniew , bad un ym lap: hooid , un shah beh noh kum ka jingphohsniew jong ka miet .

en: Grudge not one against another , brethren , lest ye be condemned : behold , the judge standeth before the door .
kha: To wat ïakren khñium paralok hi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi . U Nongbishar u la jan , u la kloi ban wanpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, ko para bangeit, ioh ba phin shah pynrem: ha khmih u nongbishar u ieng ha khmat ka jingkhang .

en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .
kha: Baroh ki paidbah jong u Dabid bad baroh ki paidbah ha Israel ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um don bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew baroh bad ki Israel baroh ki sngewthuh ha kata ka sngi ba kam dei ka jong u syiem ban pyniap ia u khun u Ner .

en: On the east three gates  ; on the north three gates  ; on the south three gates  ; and on the west three gates .
