kha: La don lai tylli ki khyrdop ha kawei kawei ka liang : Lai tylli ha ka phang mihngi , lai tylli ha ka phang shathie , lai tylli ha ka phang shatei , bad lai tylli ha ka phang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka liang mihngi lai tylli ki khyrdop ; shaphang shathie lai tylli ki khyrdop ; bad shaphang sepngi lai tylli ki khyrdop .

en: Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .
kha: Ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . Ka jingleh jubor ka nang roi . Ka jingsarong ka ïeng rasong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka sngi , ha khmih ka la wan: ka step ka la jah noh; u dieng u la phuh , ka jingsarong ka la phuh .

en: Woe unto him that saith unto his father , What begettest thou ? or to the woman , What hast thou brought forth ?
kha: Hato uno uno un nud ban ong ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ,  Balei phi pynlong ïa nga kumne ?
translated_en_to_kha: To u briew uba ong ha u kpa jong u, Kaei kaba me kha ? lane ha ka kynthei , Kaei kaba me la kha ?

en: But to Israel he saith , All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people .
kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Israel u ong ,  Baroh shi sngi nga la rah ïa la ki kti ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ki Israel u ong , Baroh shisngi nga la pynkhih ia ki kti jong nga sha ki briew ki bym kohnguh bad kiba sngewtynnad .

en: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he , and Hoshea the son of Nun .
kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ki ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai , ba ki Israel kin ïohsngew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wan bad u la kren ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka jingrwai ha ki shkor jong ki briew , ma u bad u Hoshea u khun u Nun .

en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , u para jong u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah ; kumta u Kaleb u la ai ha u ïa la ka khun kynthei ban shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Othniel u khun jong u Kenas, u hynmen barit jong u Caleb, u la shim ia ka : bad u la ai ia u ia ka khun jong u ha ka tnga jong u .

en: Go thy way , eat thy bread with joy , and drink thy wine with a merry heart  ; for God now accepteth thy works .
kha: To leh — bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi bad long uba kmen ; dih ïa ka waiñ jong phi bad to long kiba dap da ka jingkmen . Ka long kaba biang bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit ia ka lynti jong me, bam ia u kpu jong me da ka jingkmen, bad dih ia ka wain jong me da ka dohnud kaba kmen ; namar U Blei mynta u pdiang ia ki kam jong me .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . Blessed is the man that feareth the  Lord  , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Suk uta u briew uba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . La kyrkhu ia u briew uba sheptieng ia U Trai , uba sngewbha shibun eh ha ki hukum jong u .

en: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand : also they saw God , and did eat and drink .
kha: U Blei um shym pynmynsaw ïa kine ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki Israel ; ki la ïohi ïa U Blei , bad hadien kata ki la ïabam bad ïadih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ki rangbah jong ki Israel um shym la buh ia la ka kti: ruh ki la iohi ia U Blei bad ki la bam bad dih .

en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .
kha: Wat la u Asa um shym pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala ha ka ri , u ïailong uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  shi lynter ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la shah weng noh na Israel: wat la katta ruh ka dohnud u Asa ka la long kaba janai ha ki sngi jong u baroh .

en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?
kha: Hato me tip mynno la kha ïa ki blang lum ? Hato me ju ïohi ïa ka skei khlaw ba ka kha khun ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi tip ia ka por ba ki blang khlaw ki wanrah ? lane phi lah ban buh dak haba ki blang ki kha khun ?

en: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus , and shall present us with you .
kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Trai Jisu na kiba ïap , un pynmihpat ïa ngi ruh lem bad U Jisu bad un ïalam ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , sha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ba uta uba la pynmih ia U Trai Jisu un pynmih ia ngi ruh da U Jisu , bad un pyni ia ngi ryngkat bad phi .

en: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?
kha: Kumno uwei un sngewthikna ba ka mynsiem briew ka kiew artet katba ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hiar sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba tip ia ka mynsiem u briew uba leit shaneng bad ka mynsiem jong u mrad uba leit shapoh khyndew ?

en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
kha: U Kpa uba im u la phah ïa nga , bad namar jong u nga ruh nga im . Ha kajuh ka rukom uno uno uba bam ïa nga un im namar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Kpa uba im u la phah ia nga, bad nga im da U Kpa: kumta uta uba bam ia nga, wat ma u ruh un im da nga .

en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land : but he shall stumble and fall , and not be found .
kha: U syiem un wan phai pat sha ki kut ki jong ka ri jong u hi , hynrei un shahjop , bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un phai ia la ka khmat sha ka kut jong ka ri jong u hi: hynrei un sa lyngngoh bad un hap , bad ym shem .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the  Lord .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ! Ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Nangta baroh u paidbah u ong ,  Amen ,  bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel junom . Bad ki briew baroh ki la ong , Amen bad ki la iaroh ia U Trai .

en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .
kha: Ha kata ka por , u khun uba la kha ha ka rukom briew u la pynshitom beiñ ïa uta uba la kha namar U Mynsiem U Blei ; bad ka long kumjuh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba ha kata ka por uta uba la kha hadien ka doh u la pynshitom bein ia uta uba la kha hadien U Mynsiem , wat la katta ruh mynta .

en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
kha: Kine ki long ki ktien bashongkhia jong u Agur u khun jong u Jakeh :  U Blei um long bad nga , U Blei um long bad nga , bad nga long khlem jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u Agur u khun u Jakh, wat ka jingiathuhlypa: uta u briew u la kren ha Iel , wat ha Iel bad Ucal .

en: And it came to pass at the end of two full years , that Pharaoh dreamed : and , behold , he stood by the river .
kha: Hadien ar snem kynthih , u Syiem ka ri Ijipt u la phohsniew ba u ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kaba kut jong ki ar snem ba pura, ba u Pharaoh u la phohsniew: bad , ha khmih , u la ieng hajan ka wah .

en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U  Trai  un aiti noh ïa phi ha u nongshun , u ban kurup ïa ka shnong jong phi . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin leit bad rieh ha ka krem ha Adullam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan wanrah ia u nongioh pateng ha me, ko nongshong shnong jong ka Marsah: un wan sha u Adullam ka burom jong ki Israel .

en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .
kha: Haba me phai noh na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , ki ïap bad ki phai pat sha ka khyndew na kaba ki la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Me buhrieh ia ka khmat jong me, ki la shah pynshitom: me shim noh ia ka jingsawa jong ki, ki iap bad ki leit phai biang sha ka dewmet jong ki .

en: These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Shem, hadien ki longiing jong ki, hadien ki thylliej jong ki, ha ki ri jong ki, hadien ki jaitbynriew jong ki .

en: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty  ; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city .
kha: Ka long kaba kham bha ban ïaishah ban ïa kaba long uba donbor . Ka kham bha ban don ka bor halor lade ban halor ki nongbah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba slem ban bitar u kham bha ban ia u ; uba khlain bor bad uta uba synshar ia ka mynsiem jong u ban ia uta uba shim ia ka nongbah .

en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .
kha: Ha ka phyllaw kaba shabar ka la don kawei ka kamra rit ba pynïasoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kaba shaphang shatei . Kane ka lam sha ka kamra rung kaba pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw bad hangta ki sait ïa ki metïap jong ki mrad ba la thang tylli kum ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kamra bad ki jingkhang jong ka ki long hajan ki post jong ki khyrdop , ha kaba ki sait ia ka jingainguh thang .

en: The Cabinet will urge the NDA Govt to increase the states share of central taxes from 42 percent to 50 percent .
kha: Ka kynhun myntri kan kyntu ia ka sorkar NDA ban pynkiew ia ka bhah jong ki jylla na ka khajna pdeng na ka 42 percent sha ka 50 percent .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun myntri kan kyntu ia ka NDA Govt ban pynkiew ia ka bhah jong ki jylla na ka 42 percent haduh 50 percent .

en: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again : but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release  ;
kha: Phi lah ban dawa la ka ram kaba phi la ai ha u nongwei , hynrei phim dei ban leh kumta na la ki para jait .
translated_en_to_kha: Na u nongwei me lah ban shim biang ia ka: hynrei kata kaba long jong me bad ka kti jong me kan pyllait;

en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John ,
kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la nang ïoh kham bun ki synran bad u la nang pynbaptis kham bun ban ïa u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba namarkata U Trai u la tip kumno ki Pharisi ki la iohsngew ba U Jisu u la pynlong bad pynbaptis kham bun ki synran ban ia u loannis .

en: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u para jong u , uba don  saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata la mih u hynmen jong u, uba don ka thread kaba saw ha ka kti jong u: bad la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Serak .

en: Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
kha: Phin sngew kumba phi don halor ka duriaw-bah , phi ïohpang duriaw , shah pynshad kynting shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka liengbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me, to long kum uta uba shong hapdeng ka duriaw, ne kum uta uba shong halor ka tduh jong u mast .

en: ( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka ktien Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Paul u la bteng :
translated_en_to_kha: (Bad haba ki la iohsngew ba u kren ha ka shyntur Hebru ha ki , ki la nang sngap jar shuh shuh: bad u ong , )

en: And he lodged there that same night  ; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother  ;
kha: Hadien ba u la sahmiet hangta , U Jakob u jied na ki jingri jong u kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u Iso u hynmen jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: U la sah hangta ha kata kajuh ka miet ; bad u la shim na kata kaba la wan ha ka kti jong u;

en: And David called one of the young men , and said , Go near , and fall upon him . And he smote him that he died .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u khot ïa uwei na ki briew jong u , bad u ong ,  Pynïap ïa u !  U briew u la shoh ïa u nong Amalek bad u la pynmynsaw ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la khot ia uwei na ki samla bad u la ong, To leit shajan bad to hap halor jong u . Bad u la shoh ia u ba u la iap .

en: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .
kha: Ïa U Khun la pynlong uba kham khraw ban ïa ki angel , kumba ka kyrteng kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ka long kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynlong ia u kham bha shibun ban ia ki angel , kumba u la ioh da ka pateng ia ka kyrteng kaba kham bha ban ia ki .

en: And Moses cried unto the  Lord  , saying , What shall I do unto this people ? they be almost ready to stone me .
kha: U Moses u la duwai jur ha U  Trai  , bad u ong ,  Aïu nga lah ban leh bad kine ki briew ? Mynta ki khreh sa ban lynthem maw ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pyrta ha U Trai, u da ong: Ngan leh aiu ia une u briew ? ki la jan kloi ban maw ia nga .

en: The Bharatiya Janata Party has stepped up its preparations in view of the upcoming assembly elections in Bihar .
kha: Ka Bharatiya Janata Party ka la pynkhlaiñ ïa ka jingpynkhreh jong ka ha kaba ïadei bad ka elekshon dorbar ka ban wan ha Bihar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka seng Bharatiya Janata Party ka la nang kiew ha ka jingpynkhreh jong ka ha ka elekshon Assembly ban sa wan ha Bihar .

en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
kha: Sumar bha ,  U Jisu u la maham ïa ki ,  bad sumar ïa lade na u thiat jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Herod .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kynnoh ia ki, u da ong, To sumar bha ia ka jingkhleh jong ki Pharisi bad ka jingkhleh jong u Herod .

en: And after the earthquake a fire  ; but the  Lord  was not in the fire : and after the fire a still small voice .
kha: Hadien u jumai , la wan ka ding — hynrei U  Trai  um shym don ha ka ding . Bad hadien ka ding , la wan ka sur kaba sawa jem jai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ka jingkhynñiuh jumai ka ding ; hynrei U Trai um shym la don ha ka ding: bad hadien ka ding ka sur kaba dang rit .

en: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked , and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible .
kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka bor jong ki rangbah bymman bad kiba leh jubor . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pyllait ia me na ka kti jong kiba sniew , bad ngan siewspah ia me na ka kti jong kiba shyrkhei .

en: The workman melteth a graven image , and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold , and casteth silver chains .
kha: Um long kum i bleithaw ba u nongtrei u shna ba ki kamar ki sop da ka ksiar bad pynshong ha u khiew rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongtrei u pynkhluit ia ka dur ba la ker , bad u nongshna ksiar u pynphriang ia ka da ka ksiar , bad u bret ia ki kynjri rupa .

en: Then said the Lord to him , Put off thy shoes from thy feet : for the place where thou standest is holy ground .
kha: U Trai u la ong ha u , ‘ Loit noh ïa ki juti , naba ka jaka ha kaba me ïeng ka long ka khyndew kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha u: Pynduh noh ia ki juti jong me na ki kjat jong me: namar ka jaka ba me ieng ka long ka khyndew kaba khuid .

en: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee , leave not thy place  ; for yielding pacifieth great offences .
kha: Lada u nongsynshar jong phi u bitar ïa phi , wat nym ai ïa ka jingiehnoh kam jong phi ; ïa ki jingbakla kiba khia lah ban map lada phi long jai jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka mynsiem jong u nongsynshar ka kiew pyrshah ia me , wat iehnoh ia ka jaka jong me;

en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance , he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor .
kha: Lada phi ïoh spah da kaba kheiñ sut bad shim kabu ïa ki briew , ka spah jong phi kan leit sha uwei pat uba lehsbun ïa kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba da ka jingmyntoi bad ka jingmyntoi khlem hok u pynkiew ia ka jingdon jong u , un lum ia ka na ka bynta uta uba sngewsynei ia kiba duk .

en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .
kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai dak ïa u paidbah :  U briew uba ngan doh u long uta uba phi kwah . To kem ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uta uba la shet kylla ia u u la ai dak ia ki, u da ong: Uno uno uba ngan kdup, uta u long kumjuh: bat skhem ia u .

en: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them : as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people .
kha: Ki la buh jingmut ïa kane bad ki la sngewbha eh . Da shisha , kaei kaei baroh kaba u syiem u la leh ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la shim khia ia kata, bad ka la pynsngewbha ia ki: kumba u syiem u la pynsngewbha ia ki briew baroh .

en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :
kha: Ho-oid , wat ha ki shakri jong nga , baroh shynrang bad kynthei , ngan theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha kita ki sngi , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki shakri jong nga bad ha ki nongtrei jong nga ngan theh ha kita ki sngi jong u Mynsiem jong nga; bad kin iathuhlypa:

en: And the firstborn bare a son , and called his name Moab : the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day .
kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka la kha khun shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Moab . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Moab haduh kine ki sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun nyngkong u la kha khun shynrang bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u: kumjuh ruh u kpa jong ki nong Moab haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants , shipmen that had knowledge of the sea , with the servants of Solomon .
kha: U Syiem Hiram u la phah katto katne ngut ki maji kiba tbit bha na ka kynhun lieng jong u ban ïatreilang bad ki maji jong u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u la phah ha ka duriaw jong u, ki nongshong lieng kiba don ka jingtip shaphang ka duriaw, ryngkat bad ki shakri jong u Solomon .

en: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband , and a man find her in the city , and lie with her  ;
kha: Lada lap hapoh shnong ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew kaba la ïatehktien bad uwei pat u briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka dam kaba long ka nongleh kam sniew ka long kaba la shna da u tnga, bad u briew u shem ia ka ha sor, bad u thiah bad ka ; .

en: Blessed be God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies , and the God of all comfort ;
kha: To ngin ai ka jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Kpa ba-dap da jingisynei , U Blei na uba ka jingïarap baroh ka wan !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Blei , wat ia U Kpa jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , U Kpa jong ki jingsngewsih bad U Blei jong ka jingpyntngen baroh;

en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,
kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingmihpat kiba ïap : Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ? U la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba iadei bad ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap , phim shym la pule ia kata kaba la kren ha phi da U Blei da kaba ong:

en: When the righteous are in authority , the people rejoice : but when the wicked beareth rule , the people mourn .
kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa u nongsynshar uba hok bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ki briew kiba suk . To pyn-i ha nga ïa u nongsynshar basniew bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ki briew kiba shah lanot .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki hok ki don ha ka bor synshar , ki briew ki sngewbha: hynrei haba ki bymman ki synshar , ki briew ki iam .

en: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and put water there , to wash withal .
kha: U buh ïa ka dabor hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad u pyndap ïa ka da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka um hapdeng ka ïingjaiñ bad ka ïingkhang , bad u la buh um hangta , ban sait da ka um .

en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David , saying , Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may slay him .
kha: Hynrei u Saul u phah biang ïa ki ba kin da leit peit da lade ïa u Dabid . U hukum ïa ki ,  Rah lang ïa u hangne ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ngan pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la phah biang ia ki nonglam khubor ban iohi ia u Dabid, u da ong: To wanrah ia u ha nga ha ka jingthiah, ba ngan pyniap ia u .

en: And Manoah said , Now let thy words come to pass . How shall we order the child , and how shall we do unto him ?
kha: Nangta u Manoah u kylli ,  Ynda la wan urlong ki ktien jong phi , uta u khynnah u dei ban leh aïu ? Ka jingim kaba kumno u dei ban im ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Manoah u la ong, Mynta to ai ba ki ktien jong me kin jia . Kumno ngin hukum ia u khynnah bad kumno ngin leh ia u ?

en: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death , and he be to be put to death , and thou hang him on a tree :
kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa kano kano ka kam runar bad na ka bynta kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u la leh ia ka pop kaba dei ban iap , bad u dei ban shah pyniap , bad me u la sahkut ha u dieng:

en: And he brought them before the king of Moab : and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie ha u syiem Moab , bad ki la sah hangta katba u Dabid u dang rieh ha ka krem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ki ha khmat u syiem u Moab: bad ki la shong bad u ha ka por ba u Dabid u dang don ha ka jaka set .

en: And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .
kha: U Joab u la hukum ban put ïa ka turoi ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la pyrta ia ka turoi, bad ki briew ki la wan phai noh na kaba bud ia ki Israel: namar u Joab u la bat ia ki briew .

en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest , and findeth none .
kha: Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la mihnoh na u briew , u ïaid napdeng ka jaka ryngkhiang da kaba khmih ïa ka jaka ban ïoh pynjahthait . Lada um lah ban shem ïa kano kano ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la jah noh na u briew , u iaid lyngba ki jaka ba rkhiang , u wad jingjahthait bad um lap ei ei .

en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .
kha: U ong ha nga ,  Ka jingpynjot kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka ri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Na shaphang shathie ka jingsniew kan mih ha ki nongshong shnong baroh .

en: For the love of Christ constraineth us ; because we thus judge , that if one died for all , then were all dead :
kha: La synshar ïa ngi da ka jingieit U Khrist , mynta ba ngi tip ba uwei u briew u la ïap na ka bynta jong uwei pa uwei , kaba mut ba baroh ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingieit U Khrist ka khanglad ia ngi ; namar ngi bishar kumta , ba lada uwei u la iap na ka bynta baroh , te baroh ki la iap:

en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .
kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jong u baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynskhem ia u kum u nail ha ka jaka kaba skhem ; bad un long na ka bynta ka khet kaba donburom ia ka iing u kpa jong u .

en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .
kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum u Moses la pule la slem bah ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïalap ha man ki shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Moses hyndai u don ha man la ka shnong ia kito kiba ialap ia u , la pule ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabha .

en: His sons come to honour , and he knoweth it not  ; and they are brought low , but he perceiveth it not of them .
kha: Ki khun jong ngi ki ïoh burom , hynrei ngim ju tip ïa kata , lane ym don ba ïathuh haba ki jahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wan sha ka burom , bad um tip ia ka ; bad ki shah pynhiar dor , hynrei um sngewthuh ia ka na ki .

en: And to know the love of Christ , which passeth knowledge , that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God .
kha: Bad ban tip ïa ka jingieit jong U Khrist wat la kam long kaba lah ban tip pura ïa ka , bad kumta to long kiba dap pura da ka jinglong jong U Blei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban tip ia ka jingieit U Khrist kaba iaid lait ia ka jingtip , ba phin long kiba dap da ka jinglong ba pura jong U Blei baroh .

en: Therefore , behold , I will hedge up thy way with thorns , and make a wall , that she shall not find her paths .
kha: Kumta ngan kerkut ïa ka da ki bniap shiah , bad ngan tei da ka kynroh ban khang ïa ka lynti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih , ngan pynkhih ia ka lynti jong me da ki tnat bad ngan thaw ia ka kynroh , ba kan ym shem ia ki lynti jong ka .

en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
kha: To U  Trai  un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , naba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi da lei lei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un bishar hapdeng jong nga bad me, bad U Trai un pynrem ia nga na me: hynrei ka kti jong nga kan ym don halor jong me .

en: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem–melech , and their men , to pray before the  Lord  ,
kha: Ki briew ka Bethel ki la phah ïa u Shareser bad ïa u Regemmelekh bad ïa ki rangbah jong ki sha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong U  Trai
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la phah sha ka iing U Blei u Sherezer bad u Regemmadek bad ki briew jong ki ban duwai ha khmat U Trai .

en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .
kha: Hangta u la shem ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ainias , uba la pang ïapshiliang bad u bym shym la lah ban khie na ka jingthiah la phra snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta u la shem ia uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Aeneas uba la buh ia ka jingthiah jong u haduh 8 snem bad u la pang ia ka jingpang sniehdoh .

en: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ïathaw buit ; ki la ai shibun ka pisa ïa ki shipai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la ialum lang bad ki rangbah bad ki la iamir jingmut , ki la ai pisa shibun ia ki shipai .

en: And Joshua did unto them as the  Lord  bade him : he houghed their horses , and burnt their chariots with fire .
kha: U Joshua u leh ïa ki kumba U  Trai  u la hukum : u pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad u thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la leh ia ki kumba U Trai u la bthah ia u: u la pynkhih ia ki kulai jong ki, bad u la thang ia ki kali jong ki da ka ding .

en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .
kha: Uta u briew u dang ïai khmih jar jar ïa ka , ban peit la ka long ba U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u briew uba lyngngoh ia ka u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u, ban tip la U Trai u la pynlong ia ka jingleit jong u kaba roi ne em .

en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .
kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang kren ïa ka kyrteng u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan weng noh ia ki kyrteng jong u Baalim na ka shyntur jong ka , bad kin ym kynmaw shuh da ka kyrteng jong ki .

en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness , unto the mount of the daughter of Zion .
kha: Na ka nongbah jong ka Sela ha ka ri shyiap , ki briew jong ka Moab ki phah u khunlangbrot kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta uba synshar ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Phah ia u khun langbrot sha u nongsynshar jong ka ri na Sela sha ri khlaw , haduh ka lum jong ka khun jong u Seion .

en: And when she had thus said , she turned herself back , and saw Jesus standing , and knew not that it was Jesus .
kha: Te ka la phai dien bad ka la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïeng hangta ; hynrei kam shym tip ba u dei U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la ong kumta, ka la phai noh sha la ka liang kawei, bad ka la iohi ia U Jisu ba u ieng, bad kam tip ba u long U Jisu .

en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .
kha: Ka Athalaïah ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu mar ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka Athaliah ka kmie jong u Ahasaiah ka la iohi ba u khun jong ka u la iap , ka la ieng bad ka la pynjot ia u symbai syiem baroh .

en: Moreover the law entered , that the offence might abound . But where sin abounded , grace did much more abound :
kha: Ïa ka Hukum la pynmih khnang ban pynbun ïa ka jingleh bymdei ; hynrei haba ka pop ka man bun , ka jingaiei U Blei ka nang kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka hukum ka la rung , ba ka jingleh be-ijot kan nang bun . Hynrei ha kaba ka pop ka la nang bun, ka jingaiei ka la nang bun:

en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
kha: Na ka bynta jong nga phin shah tian bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki bad ha ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad yn wanrah ia phi ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem na ka bynta jong nga , na ka bynta ka jingsakhi pyrshah ia ki bad ki Jutang .

en: And Solomon s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country , and all the wisdom of Egypt .
kha: U Solomon u kham stad ban ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Mihngi lane ïa ki riewstad jong ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la nang bha ia ka jingstad jong ki khun shatei lam mihngi baroh bad ka jingstad jong ka ri Ijipt baroh .

en: Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .
kha: Namar ki khlem la niewkor ia ki jinglehsbun jong U Blei , u Adam bad ka Im ki la saitlah .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewnguh ia ka jingbhabriew jong U Blei, u Adam bad ka Im ki la leh khlem kohnguh bad la pynlong ia ki ban siew ia ka jingpynshitom ba la buh .

en: But the judgment shall sit , and they shall take away his dominion , to consume and to destroy it unto the end .
kha: Nangta ka ïingbishar ba kynja bneng kan shong bishar , kan knieh noh ïa ka bor jong u bad pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingbishar kan shong bad kin weng noh ia ka jingsynshar jong u, ban bam bad ban pynjot ia ka haduh kaba kut .

en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Nga tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin wan jia ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka jingtynjuh , bad kumno lada ka waitlam ka pynrem wat ia u dieng ? kan ym long shuh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: For we are saved by hope : but hope that is seen is not hope : for what a man seeth , why doth he yet hope for ?
kha: Naba ka long da ka jingkyrmen ba ïa ngi la pynim ; hynrei lada ngi ïohi kaei kaba ngi ap kyrmen , te kam da long shisha ka jingkyrmen . Naba uei uta uba kyrmen ïa kaei kaba u ïohi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi la shah pynim da ka jingkyrmen: hynrei ka jingkyrmen kaba la iohi kam long ka jingkyrmen: namar kaei kaba u briew u iohi , balei u dang kyrmen ?

en: But if ye will not do so , behold , ye have sinned against the  Lord  : and be sure your sin will find you out .
kha: Hynrei lada phim bat ïa la ka kular , nga maham ïa phi ba phi leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Wat bakla ïa kane ; phin shah pynshitom namar ka pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym leh kumta, ha khmih, phi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai : bad to thikna ba ka pop jong phi kan lap ia phi .

en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
kha: U la kham jied ban shahshitom bad ki briew jong U Blei ban ïa kaba lehkmen ha ka pop katto katne por .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjied ban shah shitom bad ki briew U Blei , ban ia kaba sngewbha ia ki jingsngewbha jong ka pop na ka bynta ka aiom ; .

en: And Moses said before the  Lord  , Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u la jubab ,  Me tip ba nga long uba duna ha ka ktien ka thylliej ; kumno keiñ u Pharaoh un shahshkor ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha khmat U Trai , Ha khmih nga long uba khlem ot bad kumno u Pharaoh un sngap ia nga ?

en: Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said ,  Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .
kha: Hadien ba U Judas u la mihnoh , U Jisu u la ong ,  Mynta ïa ka burom U Khun U Briew la pynpaw ; mynta ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba u la leit noh , U Jisu u la ong , Mynta la pyndonburom ia U Khun u briew bad la pyndonburom ia U Blei ha u .

en: And if we know that he hear us , whatsoever we ask , we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him .
kha: U ïohsngew ïa ngi man ba ngi kyrpad ïa u ; bad namar ba ngi tip ba kane ka long kaba shisha , ngi tip ruh ba u ai ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kyrpad na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ngi tip ba u iohsngew ia ngi , kaei kaei kaba ngi kylli , ngi tip ba ngi don ki jingujor kiba ngi kwah na u .

en: And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .
kha: Bad mynta , balei me pyntud ? To ïeng joit bad shah ba yn pynbaptis ïa me bad sait noh ïa ki pop jong me da kaba duwai sha u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta balei ba me sah ? khie , bad shah pynbaptis , bad sait noh ia ki pop jong me , da kaba khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: Salute Philologus , and Julia , Nereus , and his sister , and Olympas , and all the saints which are with them .
kha: Ki jingkhublei ïa u Philologos bad ka Julia , ïa u Nireus bad ka para jong u , ïa u Olumpas bad ïa ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ïadon bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philologus , bad u Julia , u Nereus bad ka para jong u bad u Olympas bad ki riewkhuid baroh kiba don ryngkat bad ki .

en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .
kha: La ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingdon jong ki shipai shong kulai : Ki la long arphew lakh ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingdon jong ki shipai kulai ka long arspah hajar: bad nga la iohsngew ia ka jingdon jong ki .

en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; as Moses commanded .
kha: bad u ai ïa ki shadem bad ki kjat-dien kamon kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , kumba u Moses u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bniat bad ka tyrpeng kaba sha kadiang u Aaron ki la khih na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai ; kumba u Moses u la hukum .

en: And he said unto them ,  Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba phi lah ban pynlong ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim ban leit noh khlem bam katba u nongleitkurim u dang don bad ki ? Da shisha em !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Hato phi lah ban pynlong ia ki khun jong ka kamra kaba stet katba u nongleit kurim u don bad ki ?

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Mynta ka jingpynim ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u dei uba hiarpateng jong u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Kane ka sngi ka long ka jingpynim kaba wan sha kane ka iing, namar ba u long ruh u khun u Abraham .

en: We acknowledge , O  Lord  , our wickedness , and the iniquity of our fathers : for we have sinned against thee .
kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , A  Trai  ; ngi phla ïa la ki pop bad ïa ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi pdiang , ko Trai , ia ka jingsniew jong ngi bad ia ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi: namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia me .

en: He that wasteth his father , and chaseth away his mother , is a son that causeth shame , and bringeth reproach .
kha: Tang u briew uba khlemrain bad bym donburom un lehbeiñ ïa la u kpa lane beh noh ïa la ka kmie na ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynsyrwa kai ia la u kpa bad uba pynjah burom ia la ka kmie, u long u khun uba pynlong ia ka jingsngewlehrain bad uba wanrah ia ka jingshah lehbein .

en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .
kha: Napdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis bad ka tnga u Sebedi .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng jong ki la don ka Maria Magdalene bad ka Maria ka kmie u Jakob bad u Joses bad ka kmie jong ki khun u Sebede .

en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .
kha: Ki don ki jingïadei paralok ki bymneh , hynrei ki don ki paralok kiba lah ban shaniah palat ban ïa ki hynmen ki para .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba don ki paralok u dei ban pyni ia lade uba iadei paralok: bad don u paralok uba kham jan ban ia u hynmen .

en: The sons of Jehieli  ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Ladan ; u Setham bad u Joel , ki dei peit ïa ki ïing jingkynshew bad ïing buh tiar jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jehieli ; u Setham bad u Joel u hynmen jong u kiba la long halor ki spah jong ka iing U Trai .

en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness : he is gracious , and full of compassion , and righteous .
kha: Ka jingshai ka tyngshaiñ ha kaba dum na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha , na ka bynta kito kiba dap da ka jingisynei , kiba bha sbun bad kiba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba beit ka mih ka jingshai ha ka jingdum: u long uba sngewrit bad uba dap da ka jingsngewrit bad uba hok .

en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff , even Bands , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .
kha: Nangta nga la kdiah ïa u dieng uba ar , uta uba la khot  U Jingtylli ,  bad ïa ka jingtylli jong ka Judah bad ka Israel la pynkhynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga ot noh ia kiwei pat ki nongtrei jong nga, wat ki Band, ba ngan pynpra ia ka jinglong paralok hapdeng u Judah bad ki Israel .

en: And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba khraw katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Namar ka jingud jong u Sodom bad u Gomorrah ka long kaba khraw , bad namar ka pop jong ki ka long kaba sngewsih shibun;

en: But it shall come to pass in the latter days , that I will bring again the captivity of Elam , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Elam ba kin manbha biang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan sa jia ha ki sngi kiba hadien , ba ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ka Elam , ong U Trai .

en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .
kha: Nga la ïohpateng ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kpa tymmen jong nga .  U Naboth u jubab .  U  Trai  u khang ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nabot u la ong ha u Ahab, U Trai u la khang ia nga, ba ngan ai ia ka pateng jong ki kpa jong nga ha me .

en: Remove far from me vanity and lies : give me neither poverty nor riches  ; feed me with food convenient for me :
kha: Pyllait ïa nga na ka jingshukor bad shah ïa nga ban ym riewspah lane duk . Kumta ai ïa nga ka jingbam kat ban biang ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh na nga ia ka jinglong ba sniew bad ki jinglamler: wat ai ia nga ia ka jingduk ne ka spah ; ai bam ia nga da ka jingbam kaba suk na ka bynta jong nga:

en: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
kha: Tang shu hiar na ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba wan mih na ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Une u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka tep briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih noh na ka lieng , mar kumta hi u la iakynduh ia u na ki jingtep uwei u briew uba don ka mynsiem bymkhuid .

en: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them , See that ye fall not out by the way .
kha: Nangta u phah noh ïa la ki hynmen , bad katba ki dang ïakhreh mih , u ong ,  Wat ïakajia ha lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la phah noh ia ki hynmen jong u, bad ki la leit noh: bad u la ong ha ki: Peit ba phin ym hap noh da ka lynti .

en: Then she went in , and fell at his feet , and bowed herself to the ground , and took up her son , and went out .
kha: Ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u Elisha , lem bad ka khmat kaba kynduh ha ka khyndew , nangta ka la shim ïa la u khun bad ka mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la rung shapoh bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u bad ka la dem khrup ha madan bad ka la rah ia la u khun bad ka la mih noh .

en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame  ; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought .
kha: hynrei un wanrah jingjahburom ïa kito kiba isih ïa me , bad ki ïing ki riewbymman kin jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba shun ia me kin sa shah rong noh ha ka jingsngewlehrain ; bad ka jaka shong jong ki bymman kan wan sha ka jaka ba la buh lypa .

en: And the seventy returned again with joy , saying , Lord , even the devils are subject unto us through thy name .
kha: Ki hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah ki la wan phai ha ka jingkmen kaba khraw .  Ko Trai ,  ki la ong ,  wat ki ksuid ki la kohnguh ïa ngi haba ngi hukum ha ka kyrteng jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriewphew ngut ki la wan phai biang da ka jingkmen, ki da ong: Ko Trai, wat ki ksuid ruh ki pyndem ha ngi lyngba ka kyrteng jong me .

en: If ye had known me , ye should have known my Father also : and from henceforth ye know him , and have seen him .
kha: Mynta ba phi la ithuh ïa nga ,  u la ong ha ki ,  phin ithuh ïa U Kpa jong nga ruh ; bad naduh mynta phi da ithuh ïa u bad phi la ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi la ithuh ia nga, phi la ithuh ia U Kpa jong nga ruh: bad naduh mynta phi ithuh ia u, bad phi la iohi ia u .

en: And he that stealeth a man , and selleth him , or if he be found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .
kha: Uta uba rong tuh ïa u briew da kaba mut ban die mraw ne ban ri mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba tuh ia u briew bad uba pyniap ia u, lane lada lap ia u ha ka kti jong u, un shah pyniap shisha .

en: These were born unto the giant in Gath  ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
kha: Kine ki lai ngut kiba la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , ki long kiba hiarpateng na ki ramhah ha Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kine la kha ia u rangbah ha Gath ; bad ki la hap da ka kti u Dabid bad da ka kti ki shakri jong u .

en: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the  Lord  , because he cometh to judge the earth .
kha: Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin pyrta da ka jingkmen haba U  Trai  un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki dieng ki rwai ha khmat U Trai , namar u wan ban bishar ia ka khyndew .

en: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amasaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Amasaiah , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .
kha: U pynpaw ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh ; u tip kaei kaba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , bad ïa u hi la ker sawdong da ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynpaw ia kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh: u tip ia kaei kaba don ha ka jingdum , bad ka jingshai ka shong bad u .

en: I am resolved what to do , that , when I am put out of the stewardship , they may receive me into their houses .
kha: Mynta nga tip kaei ba ngan leh ! Te haba ka kam jong nga ka duh noh , ngan don ki paralok ki ban pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kut jingmut aiu ban leh , ba ynda nga la shah weng noh na ka kam sumar , kin pdiang ia nga shapoh ki iing jong ki .

en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
kha: Ka Babilonia kynsan kynsan ka kyllon bad la pynjot noh ! To ïam namar jong ka ! Pynïoh dawai na ka bynta ki jingmong jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Babylon ka la hap kynsan bad ka la shah pynjot: ka long kaba sngewsih ia ka ; ka shim ia ka balm na ka bynta ka jingpang jong ka, lada ka long kumta ka lah ban koit .

en: And I subscribed the evidence , and sealed it , and took witnesses , and weighed him the money in the balances .
kha: Nga la soi bad shon muhor ïa ka dulir , bad la sakhi ïa ka , bad la thew ïa ka pisa ha ka tarajur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la subscribe ia ki sakhi , bad nga la khang ia ka , bad nga la shim ia ki sakhi , bad nga la thew ia u ia ka pisa ha ki jingthew .

en: And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
kha: Kita baroh kiba shong ha ka Dorbar ki la khmih shlip ha u Stephan bad ki la ïohi ba ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka durkhmat jong u angel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba shong ha ka dorbar, ki peit bniah ia u, ki la iohi ia ka khmat jong u kumba ka la long ka khmat jong u angel .

en: And she went forth , and said unto her mother , What shall I ask ? And she said , The head of John the Baptist .
kha: Kumta ka khynnah ka la leit noh bad ka la kylli ïa ka kmie jong ka ,  Kaei ngan pan ?   Ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ka la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la leit shabar bad ka la ong ha ka kmie jong ka, "Kaei kaba ngan kylli?" Bad ka la ong: Ka khlieh jong u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis .

en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingiw jong kine ki jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka jingainguh dih to ai ia ka bynta kaba lai jong ka wain , na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .
kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la dem ngon ha madan ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la hap ha khmat jong ki ha khmat jong ka jingiaseng Israel baroh .

en: So they , being sent forth by the Holy Ghost , departed unto Seleucia  ; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .
kha: Haba la phah da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u Barnabas bad u Saul ki la leit sha Seleukia bad ki la leit da ka lieng nangta sha ka dewlynnong Sypros .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la leit noh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid, ki la leit noh sha Seleucia ; bad nangta ki la leit sha Cyprus .

en: And they said unto Moses , Speak thou with us , and we will hear : but let not God speak with us , lest we die .
kha: Ki ong ha u Moses ,  Lada phi kren ha ngi , ngin shahshkor ; hynrei ngi sheptieng ba lada U Blei u kren ha ngi , ngin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses, To kren bad ngi, bad ngin sa iohsngew: hynrei wat ai ba U Blei un kren bad ngi, ioh ngin iap .

en: And saw two ships standing by the lake : but the fishermen were gone out of them , and were washing their nets .
kha: U la ïohi ar tylli ki lieng ba la tan sharud duriaw ; ki nongtong dohkha ki la ieh ïa ki bad ki la sait ïa ki jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ar tylli ki lieng kiba ieng harud ka pung: hynrei ki nongtong dohkha ki la leit noh na ki , bad ki dang sait ia ki jar jong ki .

en: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people , neither to repair the breaches of the house .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki mynjur ïa kane bad ki mynjur ruh ban nym shim ïa ka jingshna pynbha ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki la mynjur ban ioh pisa shuh na ki briew , lymne ban pynbha ia ki jingpynkhein ia ka iing .

en: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech , which he did unto his father , in slaying his seventy brethren :
kha: Bad kumta ka long ba U Blei u siew kylliang ïa u Abimelekh namar ka kam sniew kaba u la leh pyrshah ïa la u kpa ha kaba pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Blei u la pynphai ia ka jingsniew jong u Abimelech, kaba u la leh ha u kpa jong u, ha kaba pyniap ia ki hynriewphew ngut ki hynmen jong u:

en: To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .
kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun ba-ieit jong nga : To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei , bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Timothi, u khun baieit eh jong nga: Ka jingaiei, ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu U Trai jong ngi .

en: Not unto us , O  Lord  , not unto us , but unto thy name give glory , for thy mercy , and for thy truth s sake .
kha: Tang sha me hi , A  Trai  , tang sha me hi ! bad ym sha ngi , ba dei ban ai ïa ka burom namar ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingïaineh jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym ha ngi, ko Trai, ym ha ngi, hynrei ha ka kyrteng jong me to ai burom, namar ka jingisynei jong me bad na ka bynta ka jingshisha jong me .

en: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , In my dream , behold , a vine was before me  ;
kha: Kumta u nongrah khuri rangbah u ong ,  Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga , la don uwei u dieng sohwaiñ ha khmat jong nga , uba don lai tylli ki tnat .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah u la iathuh ia ka jingphohsniew jong u ha u Joseph bad u la ong ha u, Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga, ha khmih, u sohjew u la don ha khmat jong nga;

en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest  ; because it did not rest in your sabbaths , when ye dwelt upon it .
kha: Te ka ri kan ïoh lehkmen ha ki snem ka jingshongthait kaba pura ha kaba phin ym ai ei ei ïa ka ; kan long kaba la iehnoh bad kan ïoh shongthait , katba phi dang don ha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka dang sah ha ka ri kan shongthait ; namar kam shym la shongthait ha ki sngi saitjain jong phi, haba phi shong ha ka .

en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .
kha: Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me ; ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong nga ruh ngan kiew sha ki hukum jong me kiba nga la ieit ; bad ngan pyrkhat ha ki ain jong me .

en: Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ka Templ jong U  Trai  U Blei kan don . Hangne ka don ka duwan ha kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ki jingainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong , Kane ka long ka iing U Trai Blei , bad kane ka long ka jingknia thang na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ?
kha: Hangno don na ki syiem jong ki nongbah ka Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena bad Ibbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno u syiem u Hamath bad u syiem u Arpad bad u syiem ka shnong Sepharvaim , Hena bad ka Ivah ?

en: But in those days , after that tribulation , the sun shall be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light ,
kha: Ha ki sngi hadien kata ka por jong ka jingjynjar , ka sngi kan sa kylla dum , u bnai un ym shai shuh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kita ki sngi hadien kata ka jingjynjar , ka sngi kan dum bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai ia ka .

en: And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;
kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la leit kylleng ka thain baroh jong ka wah Jordan , u da ïalap ,  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei un map ïa ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wan sha ka ri baroh kawei shaphang ka Jordan , da kaba ialap ia ka jingpynbaptis ia ka jingkylla kaba mut na ka bynta ka jingmap ia ki pop ; .

en: That which I speak , I speak it not after the Lord , but as it were foolishly , in this confidence of boasting .
kha: Da shisha ïa kaei kaba nga ong mynta kam long kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa nga ban ong ; ha kane ka kam ban sngewsarong nga kren shisha kum uba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba nga kren , ngam kren ia ka hadien U Trai , hynrei kumba ka la long kaba bieit , ha kane ka jingshaniah ban sngew sarong .

en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .
kha: Baroh ar ngut ki im ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la long baroh arngut kiba hok ha khmat U Blei , ki iaid ha ki hukum bad ki jingpynbeit jong U Trai khlem jingbakla .

en: Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ban biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym shah ia ki khlieh jong ki, lymne ki lock jong ki ban san jrong ; kin ym shah shuh ia ki khlieh jong ki.

en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei kaba palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong phi , bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei kaba iaid lait ia ka jingsngewthuh baroh kan bat ia ki dohnud bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi lyngba U Khrist Jisu .

en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .
kha: ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la lah ong :  Nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel u ong , nga la pynpra ia ka jingkit jong u syiem Babilon .

en: But a certain Samaritan , as he journeyed , came where he was : and when he saw him , he had compassion on him ,
kha: Hynrei u nong Samaria uba la leit jingleit na kata ka lynti u la wan lap ïa uta u briew , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei u nong Samaria, katba u dang iaid, u la wan sha ka jaka ba u don: bad haba u la iohi ia u , u la sngewsynei ia u .

en: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah , the son of Shaphan , had heard out of the book all the words of the  Lord  ,
kha: U Mikaïah , u khun jong u Gemaraïah bad u khun ksiew jong u Shaphan , ki la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule na kot kli ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Mihaiah u khun u Gemariah u khun u Shaphan u la iohsngew na ka Kitab ia ki ktien U Trai baroh .

en: There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .
kha: Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam miet ïa u hangta , ha kaba ka Martha ka la ïarap ban sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na kito kiba la ïashong bam ha ka miej lem bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki la pynlong ia u ban bam ja miet bad ka Martha ka la shakri: hynrei u Lasaros u long uwei na ki uba shong ha ka miej bad u .

en: And when they were come to the multitude , there came to him a certain man , kneeling down to him , and saying ,
kha: Haba ki la wan phai pat sha u paidbah , uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la poi ha u paidbah, uwei u briew u la wan ha u, u la dem khrup ha u bad u la ong:

en: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee to dwell there , saying ,
kha: Ynda phi shong ha ki shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , lada phi ïohsngew
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me iohsngew ia ka jingkren ha kawei na ki shnong jong me, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai ha me ban shong hangta da kaba ong:

en: Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,
kha: Ki ïa-lorni bad kren sniew uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki long kiba shun ïa U Blei , kiba pynbitar , kiba sarong bad kiba sngewmeng ; ki pyrkhat ïa kiba bun ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshun , ki nongshun ia U Blei , wat la ki long kiba sngewsih , kiba sngew sarong , kiba sngew sarong , ki nongthaw ia kiei kiei kiba sniew , ki bym kohnguh ia ki kmie ki kpa , .

en: And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
kha: Bad mynta , da kaba kohnguh ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jerusalem , khlem da tip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, nga leit sha Jerusalem ha ka mynsiem, khlem da tip ia kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ia nga hangta:

en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban pynsah ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Soitan u la jubab ia U Trai, bad u la ong, Skin na ka bynta ka sniehdoh, hooid, baroh kaba u briew u don u la ai na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

en: The floods have lifted up , O  Lord  , the floods have lifted up their voice  ; the floods lift up their waves .
kha: Ki jingjylliew ka duriaw ki sawa jam , A  Trai  ; ki sawa jam bad ki kyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingshlei um ki la kiew shaneng , ko Trai , ki jingshlei um ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki; ki jingshlei um ki kiew ia ki um jong ki .

en: And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,
kha: ïa ka duwan ksiar , ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , ïa ka jingiwbih , ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkhang ksiar bad ka umphniang ba la pyndap bad ka jingiwbih ba thiang bad ka jingpynsangeh ia ka jingkhang jong ka iing .

en: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month : and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him .
kha: Ka la long ha ka por tlang bad u syiem u dang shong ha ka ïingsyiem tlang ha khmat ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u syiem u la shong ha ka iing lyiur ha ka taiew kaba hynniew : bad ka la don ka ding ha ka ding kaba thang ha khmat jong u .

en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the  Lord  : but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki lynti jong ki briew kiba sniew ; hynrei u ieit ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong kiba sniew ka long kaba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei u ieit ia uta uba bud ia ka hok .

en: If thou buy an Hebrew servant , six years he shall serve : and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing .
kha: Lada phi thied ïa u mraw Hebru , u dei ban shakri ïa phi hynriew snem . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew , u dei ban ïoh laitluid khlem da hap siew ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me thied ia u shakri Hebru , hynriew snem un shakri: bad ha kaba hynriew un leit noh khlem da siew ei ei .

en: But if ye will not hearken unto us , to be circumcised  ; then will we take our daughter , and we will be gone .
kha: Hynrei lada phim pdiang ïa kaba ngi ong , bad phim shah otsher , ngin shim noh ïa ka bad ngin leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym sngap ia ngi, ban shah ot ; te ngin shim ia ka khun jong ngi bad ngin sa jah noh .

en: Son of man , say unto her , Thou art the land that is not cleansed , nor rained upon in the day of indignation .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba ka ri jong ki kam long kaba khuid , bad kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ka ha ka jingbitar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to ong ia ka , Me long ka ri kaba ym shym la pynkhuid , lymne kaba la slap ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar .

en: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in Samaria : and Joash his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jehoash u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehosa u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ; bad ki la tep ia u ha Samaria : bad u Joash u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing , la ka heh ne ka rit , ka kynting sbai ban tip ïa kano ka khyrdop ka kitkhlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thep vote, kumjuh ruh ia kiba rit kum kiba khraw kat kum ka iing ki kpa jong ki .

en: Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .
kha: Mynta khie leit sha la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi , hynrei phi dei ban pynmih katjuh ki maw-it .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit mynta , bad to trei ia ka kam namar ym dei ban ai sboh ia phi , hynrei phin pynpoi ia ka jingiathuhkhana jong ki nar .

en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .
kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la leit hiar na kata ka lynti ; hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïaid lait na kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba shu jia ryngkhat u la wan hiar uwei u lyngdoh kumta : bad haba u la iohi ia u , u la iaid sha shiliang .

en: The altar of burnt offering , with his brasen grate , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbam ba la thang , bad ki dieng jong u kiba la tyrkhong , bad ki dieng jong u baroh , ka jaka bam bad ka kjat jong u .

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Amaziah had done  ;
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa u kpa jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh;

en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil  ; the harvest is the end of the world  ; and the reapers are the angels .
kha: bad u nongshun uba la bet ïa ki ñiut u long u Ksuid . Ka jingot ka long kaba kut jong ka Ïa , bad ki nongot ki long ki angel .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshun uba la bet ia ki u long u ksuid ; ka jingot ka long ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei ; bad ki nongot ki long ki angel .

en: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me . But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee ? In tithes and offerings .
kha: Nga kylli ïa phi , hato ka long kaba dei ba u briew un shukor ïa U Blei ? Ha ka jingshisha ym dei , pynban phi shukor ïa nga . ‘ Da kumno ?’ phi kylli . Ha kaba ïadei shaphang kawei-na-kaba-shiphew bad ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u briew un lute ia U Blei ? Hynrei phi la lute ia nga . Hynrei phi ong , Hangno ngi la lute ia me ? Ha ki shiphew bad ki jingainguh .

en: For now they shall say , We have no king , because we feared not the  Lord   ; what then should a king do to us ?
kha: Kine ki briew shen kin sa ong ,  Ngim don syiem , namar ngim shym la sheptieng ïa U  Trai . Hynrei kaei kaba u syiem un lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mynta kin ong , Ngim don syiem , namar ngim tieng ia U Trai ; kaei te u syiem u dei ban leh ia ngi ?

en: But Adoni–bezek fled  ; and they pursued after him , and caught him , and cut off his thumbs and his great toes .
kha: U la phet krad , hynrei ki la beh ïa u , kem ïa u bad ki ot noh ïa ki  tikmie bad ki  jatkmie jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Adoni beek u la phet noh; bad ki la bud ia u, bad ki la kem ia u, bad ki la ot noh ia ki tyrpeng bad ki tyrpeng kiba heh jong u .

en: And Joab sent messengers to David , and said , I have fought against Rabbah , and have taken the city of waters .
kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Dabid ban ïathuh :  Nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka Rabbah bad nga la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka pynbiang umdih jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Dabid bad u la ong: Nga la ialeh pyrshah ia u Rabbah bad nga la shim ia ka shnong um .

en: Yea , ye yourselves know , that these hands have ministered unto my necessities , and to them that were with me .
kha: Phi hi phi ïatip ba nga la trei da kine ki kti jong nga ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei kaba ki paralok jong nga bad ma nga ngi donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, phi hi phi tip, ba kine ki kti ki la shakri ia ki jingdonkam jong nga bad ia kita kiba don ryngkat bad nga .

en: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up , behold , two men stood by them in white apparel  ;
kha: Katba ki dang ïaï khmied la ki khmat sha sahit bneng mynba u dang kiew , kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah kiba riam lieh ki la ïeng hajan jong ki bad ki la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang peit bniah sha bneng katba u dang kiew, ha khmih arngut ki briew ki la ieng hajan jong ki da ki jain lieh ; .

en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them .
kha: Kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ki jingmaham jong nga kim shym long ki jingbyrngem lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai bad ba ngam shym la ong lehnohei ba ngan leh ia kane ka jingsniew ia ki .

en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn  ; because that the famine was so sore in all lands .
kha: Ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthei ki la ïawan sha Ijipt ban thied kew na u Joseph , namar ka  nemsniew ka la ktah jur ha kylleng ki ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ri baroh ki la wan sha Ijipt sha u Joseph ban thied ia u kew ; namar ba ka jingkyrduh ka la jur bha ha ki ri baroh .

en: Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: bad yn pynïap ïa phi ha ka thma ha ka ri jong phi hi . Te uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin hap da ka waitlam ; Ngan bishar ia phi ha u pud u sam jong ki Israel ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Honour thy father and thy mother : that thy days may be long upon the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
kha: Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , ba phi lah ban im slem ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me: ba ki sngi jong me kin long kiba jrong ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me .

en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me , and have multiplied your words against me : I have heard them .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki rukom kren kob-pia jong me ba me la kren pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta da ka shyntur jong phi phi la sngew sarong pyrshah ia nga , bad phi la pynbun ia ki ktien jong phi pyrshah ia nga: Nga la iohsngew ia ki .

en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ , not only to believe on him , but also to suffer for his sake ;
kha: Naba ïa phi la ai ka lad ban shakri ïa U Khrist , ym tang ban ngeit ha u , hynrei ban shahshitom ruh na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha phi la ai ha ka bynta U Khrist, ym tang ban ngeit ia u hynrei ban shah shitom na ka bynta jong u ; .

en: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .
kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki mawkyrdon lem bad u , bad nangta ki shipai ki la dei ban bah ïa u namar u paidbhur u la lamwir palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la poi ha ki step , kumta ka la long , ba la kha ia u da ki shipai na ka bynta ka jingleh donbor jong ki briew .

en: And he saith unto him , Friend , how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment ? And he was speechless .
kha: ‘ Ko paralok , kumno phi ïohrung hangne khlem ki jaiñ shongkurim ?’ u syiem u la kylli ïa u . Hynrei uta u briew um shym ong ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u, Paralok, kumno me wan rung ha ka jaka kaba khlem don ka jain shongkurim ? Bad u la long uba khlem kren .

en: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes  ; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes .
kha: Uno uno ruh uba thiah lane bam ha kata ka ïing u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba sah ha iing un sait ia ki jain jong u ; bad uta uba bam ha iing un sait ia ki jain jong u .

en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people , and sanctified the people  ; and they washed their clothes .
kha: Nangta u Moses u la wan hiar na u lum bad u ong ïa ki paidbah ba kin pynkhreh ïa lade na ka bynta ka jingmane .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la hiar na u lum sha ki briew , bad u la pynkhuid ia ki briew ; bad ki la sait ia ki jain jong ki .

en: The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .
kha: U paidbah u la phai ktien ,  Ngi don ka hukum kaba ong ba u dei ban ïap , namar u la kam ba u long U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la jubab ia u , Ngi don ka hukum bad da ka hukum jong ngi u dei ban iap , namar u la pynlong ia lade U Khun U Blei .

en: They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .
kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki kali ïapom lem bad ki jingbthah ban leit bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim namarkata ar tylli ki kulai kit kulai ; bad u syiem u la phah hadien ka kynhun ki nong Syria da kaba ong: Leit bad peit .

en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .
kha: Lada phi ai sngewbha sha ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ban ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynshitom ia kiba duk ban pynroi ia ka spah jong u , bad uta uba ai ia kiba riewspah , un sa wan thikna .

en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed : which giveth food to the hungry . The  Lord  looseth the prisoners :
kha: ha ka jingbishar , u don ha ka liang kiba shah banbeiñ bad u ai jingbam ïa kiba thngan . U  Trai  u pyllaitluid ïa ki koidi
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pyndep ia ka jingbishar na ka bynta kiba shah pynshitom bein: kaba ai jingbam ia kiba thngan . U Trai u pyllait ia ki koidi:

en: Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .
kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shuh ïa ki . Ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan pynim ia ki langbrot jong nga , bad kin ym long shuh ki mrad ; bad ngan bishar hapdeng ki masi bad ki masi .

en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la phah da ki bseiñ ba-dap da ka bih hapdeng kita ki briew , bad bun ki Israel ki la shah puh bad ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah ia ki bsein kiba thang ding hapdeng ki briew , bad ki la bam ia ki briew ; bad bun ki briew Israel ki la iap .

en: And the king said unto the man of God , Come home with me , and refresh thyself , and I will give thee a reward .
kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Wan ngin ïaleit bad nga sha ïing bad ngin ïabam ei ei . Ngan ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha uta u briew jong U Blei, To wan phai noh bad nga bad pynkmen ia lade bad ngan ai ia me ia ka bainong .

en: And his feet like unto fine brass , as if they burned in a furnace  ; and his voice as the sound of many waters .
kha: ki kjat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la phrang bad ba la pynphyrnai , bad ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka kshaid bakyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kjat jong u ki long kum ki nar kiba jem, kumba ki thang ha ka ding ; bad ka sur jong u kum ka jingsawa jong ki um kiba bun .

en: And God helped him against the Philistines , and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal , and the Mehunims .
kha: U Blei u ïarap ïa u ban jop ïa ki Philistia , ïa ki Arab kiba shong ha Gurbaal , bad ïa ki Meun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la iarap ia u pyrshah ia ki Philistia bad pyrshah ia ki Arab kiba shong ha Gurbaal bad ki Mehunim .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him .
kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um shym tam ïa ki syiem kiba la synshar ha Israel ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , hynrei ym kum ki syiem Israel kiba la don ha khmat jong u .

en: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Bad da ki waitlam jong ki , kin pynïap ïa kito kiba shong basah ha ki shnong jong ka ha ka ri . Nangta ka Tyros kan tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun kynthei jong ka kiba don ha lyngkha kin shah pyniap da ka waitlam ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: For they fled from the swords , from the drawn sword , and from the bent bow , and from the grievousness of war .
kha: Ki briew ki ïaphet ban ïohlait im na ki waitlam kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa ki , na ki ryntieh kiba la khreh ban siat , na baroh ki jingma jong ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la phet noh na ki waitlam, na ka waitlam ba la ring bad na ka bow ba la pynkhih bad na ka jingsngewsih jong ka thma .

en: Then answered the Jews and said unto him , What sign shewest thou unto us , seeing that thou doest these things ?
kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Ka kambah aïu ba me lah ban leh ban pyn-i ha ngi ba me don hok ban leh ïa kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia ki Jiw bad u la ong ha u, Kaei ka dak kaba me pyni ha ngi haba me iohi ba me leh ia kine kiei kiei ?

en: And when he came to his disciples , he saw a great multitude about them , and the scribes questioning with them .
kha: Haba ki la ïadon bad kiwei ki synran , ki la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun sawdong jong ki bad katto katne na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki ïania bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan sha ki synran jong u , u la iohi ia u paidbah uba bun shaphang jong ki bad ki nongthoh kiba kylli bad ki .

en: Give instruction to a wise man , and he will be yet wiser : teach a just man , and he will increase in learning .
kha: Kano kano kaba phi kren ïa u briew uba stad , kan pynlong ïa u ban nang kham stad . Kano kano kaba phi kren ha u briew uba hok kan nang pynroi ïa ka jingtip jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai jinghikai ia u briew uba stad , bad un nang kham stad: hikai ia u briew uba hok , bad un nang kiew ha ka jingnang jingstad .

en: Son of man , What is the vine tree more than any tree , or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kumno yn nujor ïa u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng ? Ka bha aïu ka tnat u dieng sohwaiñ haba nujor bad ki dieng ha khlaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , Kaei ka dieng sohjew kaba kham bun ban ia uno uno u dieng , ne ban ia ka tnat kaba don hapdeng ki dieng khlaw ?

en: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .
kha: Mynta , ki para ri jong u ki la isih ïa u , bad kumta ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien hadien jong u ban ong , ‘ Ngim kwah ïa une u briew ban long u syiem jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nongshong shnong jong u ki la shun ia u , bad ki la phah khubor hadien jong u , ki da ong , Ngin ym don ia une u briew ban synshar halor jong ngi .

en: I , even I , have spoken  ; yea , I have called him : I have brought him , and he shall make his way prosperous .
kha: Dei ma nga uba la kren bad ba la khot ïa u ; nga la ïalam ïa u shabar bad la ai ha u ïa ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh nga la kren ; yes, nga la khot ia u: Nga la wanrah ia u, bad un pynlong ia ka lynti jong u kaba roi .

en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them , he was received up into heaven , and sat on the right hand of God .
kha: Hadien ba U Trai Jisu u la lah kren bad ki , ïa u la shim noh sha bneng bad u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta hadien ba U Trai u la kren ha ki , la pdiang ia u sha bneng bad u la shong ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei .

en: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation  ; and give him a charge in their sight .
kha: Pynïeng ïa u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u paidlang baroh , bad hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh to pynbna ba ma u un long u nongmih bujli jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad buh ia u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha khmat ka jingiaseng baroh; bad ai ia u ia ka jingkitkhlieh ha khmat jong ki .

en: But he answered one of them , and said , Friend , I do thee no wrong : didst not thou agree with me for a penny ?
kha: ‘ To shahshkor , ko paralok ,’ u trai u la jubab ha uwei na ki , ‘ ngam shym la shukor ïa phi . Nalor kata baroh , phi la mynjur ban trei ïa ka jingtrei sngi na ka bynta shi sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab ia uwei na ki, bad u la ong, Paralok, ngam shym la leh bakla ia me: hato me ym ia mynjur bad nga na ka bynta ka pisa ?

en: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city , and the gates thereof , and the wall thereof .
kha: U angel uba la kren ha nga u la don u diengthew uba da ka ksiar ban thew ïa ka nongbah , ïa ki khyrdop jong ka , bad ïa ki kynroh jong ka .
