translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la iakren bad nga u don ka lyngkhot ksiar ban thew ia ka nongbah bad ki khyrdop jong ka bad ka kynroh jong ka .

en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter : and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam .
kha: U tur ïaleh ïa ki khlem riej bad u pynïap shibun na ki . Nangta u leit bad u sah ha ka krem mawsiang ha Etam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhih ia ki da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw: bad u la leit hiar bad u la shong ha trai jong u maw Etam .

en: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .
kha: Haba ngan wan sha phi , nga tip ba ngan wan ryngkat bad ka jingkyrkhu ba-dap jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga thikna ba ynda nga wan sha phi , ngan wan ha ka jingdap jong ka jingkyrkhu U Khrist .

en: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel  ; and they seemed unto him but a few days , for the love he had to her .
kha: U Jakob u la trei hynñiew snem ba u lah ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel , bad kata ka por ka i kum khyndiat tylli ki sngi ïa u , namar u la ieit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la shakri hynriew snem na ka bynta ka Rakhel; bad ki la long kumba ki long tang katto katne sngi, namar ka jingieit kaba u don ia ka .

en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business ? he shall stand before kings  ; he shall not stand before mean men .
kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba leh ïa ka kam babha , bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba kham bha ban ïa ka kynhun babun bad babit tam jong ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi ia u briew uba trei shitom ha ka kam jong u ? un ieng ha khmat ki syiem ; un ym ieng ha khmat ki briew kiba rit paid .

en: For he hath made him to be sin for us , who knew no sin ; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him .
kha: U Khrist u la long uba khlem pop , hynrei na ka bynta jong ngi U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban don bynta ha ka pop jong ngi khnang ba haba ngi don ha u ngin lah ban ïoh bynta na ka hok U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pynlong ia u ban long pop na ka bynta jong ngi, uba khlem tip ia ka pop ; ba ngin long kiba la pynlong ia ka hok U Blei ha u .

en: And , behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you .
kha: U Joseph u bteng ,  Mynta , phi baroh , bad phi ruh , Benjamin , phi ïohi ba nga dei shisha u Joseph uba kren ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki khmat jong phi ki iohi, bad ki khmat jong u hynmen jong nga u Benjamin, ba ka dei ka shyntur jong nga kaba kren ha phi .

en: For in the resurrection they neither marry , nor are given in marriage , but are as the angels of God in heaven .
kha: Naba haba kiba ïap ki mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng bad kin ym ïashongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka jingmihpat kim ju shongkurim, lymne la ai ha ka jingshongkurim, hynrei ki long kum ki angel U Blei ha bneng .

en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Maachah , the daughter of Abishalom .
kha: Ka kmierad jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Absalom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sawphew snem u la synshar ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long Maah , ka khun jong u Abishalon .

en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and went not fully after the  Lord  , as did David his father .
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym la bud hok ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad um shym la leit pura hadien U Trai kumba u kpa jong u u la leit noh .

en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
kha: Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai sha U Blei da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sniew kaba don ha ka ïing jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me phai sha U Blei Baroh , men sa shah tei pat , men sa weng noh ia ka jingbymhok na ki iing jong me .

en: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the  Lord  is near in the valley of decision .
kha: Da ki hajar hajar ki don ha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Dei hangta ba ka Sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah , ki paidbah ha ka them rai: namar ka sngi U Trai ka la jan ha ka them rai .

en: (As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  U ai sbun mynsiem sha kiba kyrduh ; ka jinglehsbun jong u ka neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kumba la thoh , U la pynphriang shabar ri ; u la ai ha kiba duk: ka hok jong u ka sah junom .

en: Nishad was a former MP from Bihars Muzaffarpur constituency and his son , Ajay Nishad , is currently a lawmaker .
kha: U Nishad u dei u MP barim na Bihars Muzaffarpur konstitwensi bad u khun jong u u Ajay Nishad u dei mynta u nongthaw ain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nishad u dei u MP barim na Bihars Muzaffarpur constituency bad u khun jong u u Ajay Nishad mynta u dei u nongthaw ain .

en: And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
kha: bad u bthah ïa u nonglamktien ,  Hadien ba phi la ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka thma ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh ia u nonglam khubor da kaba ong: Haba me la pynkut noh ban iathuh ia ki kam thma ha u syiem .

en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,
kha: Nangta nga phah ïa ki nonglamktien na ka ri shyiap Kedemoth sha u Sihon u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa ka jingïasuk , da kaba ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la phah ia ki nonglam khubor na ka ri khlaw jong u Kdemot sha u syiem Heshbon da ki ktien jingsuk da kaba ong:

en: Then said he , Lo , I come to do thy will , O God . He taketh away the first , that he may establish the second .
kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Nga hangne , A Blei , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me .  Kumta U Blei u la pynsangeh noh ïa baroh ki jait jingkñia kiba rim bad u la pynlong ba ka jingkñia U Khrist kan mih bujli ha ka jaka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong, Lo, nga wan ban leh ia ka mon jong me, ko Blei . U weng noh ia kaba nyngkong, ba un pynskhem ia kaba ar .

en: And all the people that heard him , and the publicans , justified God , being baptized with the baptism of John .
kha: Baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ïa u ; ma ki bad khamtam ki nonglum khajna ki long kita kiba la kohnguh ïa ka jingdawa bahok jong U Blei bad kiba la shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew baroh kiba la iohsngew ia u, bad ki nongpynbna paidbah, ki la pynshisha ia U Blei, ki la shah pynbaptis da ka jingpynbaptis jong u loannis .

en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .
kha: Bad kumta u briew u long u nongshun jong U Blei haba u shah pynïaid ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh ; namar um kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei , bad ha ka jingshisha um lah ban kohnguh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingmut kaba kynja doh ka long kaba sniew pyrshah ia U Blei: namar kam hap hapoh ka hukum U Blei , lymne shisha kam lah ban long kumta .

en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .
kha: Shah ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh shatai sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga duwai ia me, to ngan leit sha jngai, bad ngan iohi ia ka ri kaba bha kaba don sha lyndet ka Jordan, kata ka lum kaba bha, bad ka Lebanon .

en: For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
kha: Kawei ka briew , kaba ka khun jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad mar kumta hi ka la wan sha u bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kawei ka kynthei kaba dang rit ka don ka mynsiem bymkhuid, ka la iohsngew ia u, bad ka la wan bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u:

en: And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba don hangta ki la bitar bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingsleh iwbih ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don katto katne kiba don ka jingbitar hapoh jong ki hi , bad ki la ong , Balei la leh ia kane ka jaboh jong ka umphniang ?

en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .
kha: Nangta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Syros kum u patsha ka Babilonia , u Syros u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Syiem Babilon u Syiem u la leh ia ka hukum ban tei ia kane ka iing U Blei .

en: Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .
kha: Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kumta ruh U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew katsha ba bha tam ka rukom ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u kpa uba stad bad uba ieit u hikai ia ki khun jong u , kumta U Blei u hikai ia ki briew ha man la ki jaka ia ka rukom kaba bha tam ban im .

en: Sigh therefore , thou son of man , with the breaking of thy loins  ; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .
kha: Ko khun u briew , to ud kumba ka dohnud jong me ka la pait ha ka jingjynjar . To ud da ka jingsngewsih ha kaba baroh kin khmih ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Sigh namarkata, ko khun u briew, da kaba pynpra ia ki tyrpeng jong me ; bad da ka jingsngewsih ka sngap jar ha khmat ki khmat jong ki .

en: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , Behold , two kings stood not before him : how then shall we stand ?
kha: Ki nongsynshar ka Samaria ki la sheptieng ,  Kumno ngi lah ban pyrshah ïa u Jehu ,  ki la ong ,  naba wat u syiem Joram lymne u syiem Ahasaïah kim lah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la tieng palat bad ki la ong: Ha khmih arngut ki syiem kim shym la ieng ha khmat jong u: kumno te ngin ieng ?

en: Now these are thy servants and thy people , whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power , and by thy strong hand .
kha: Ko  Trai  , kine ki dei ki shakri jong me , ki briew jong me hi . Me la pyllait ïa ki da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki shakri jong me bad ki briew jong me kiba me la siewspah da ka bor bah jong me bad da ka kti ba skhem jong me .

en: No man can come to me , except the Father which hath sent me draw him : and I will raise him up at the last day .
kha: Ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa uba la phah ïa nga u pynwan ïa u sha nga ; bad ngan pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban wan sha nga , lait noh tang U Kpa uba la phah ia nga ban ring ia u: bad ngan pynmihpat ia u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them : but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .
kha: Ka hok ka pyllait ïa kito kiba lehhok , hynrei kito ïa kiba ym lah ban shaniah ki shah riam ha la ka jong ka jingkwah brai hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok jong kiba hok kan pynpoi ia ki: hynrei ki nongleh kam sniew kin shah shim ha la ka jong ka jingsniew .

en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
kha: U Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga , ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba ïohknieh ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .
translated_en_to_kha: U Caleb u la ong , Uta uba pynkhih ia ka Kirjathsepher bad uba shim ia ka, ha u ngan ai ia ka Ahsah ia ka khun jong nga ha ka tnga .

en: Above all , taking the shield of faith , wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked .
kha: Ha ki por baroh to bat ïa ka jingngeit kum ka stieh ; naba da ka phi lah ban pynlip ïa ki sum bameh ding baroh jong u bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Halor baroh , da kaba shim ia ka jingda jong ka jingngeit , da kaba phin lah ban pynlip ia ki nar ding baroh .

en: Police have registered a case of murder under section 302 of the Indian Penal Code against unidentified persons .
kha: Ki pulit ki la register case pyniap briew katkum ka kyndon 302 jong ka Indian Penal Code pyrshah ia ki briew ki bym lah ban ithuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pulit ki la register ia ka kam pyniap briew hapoh ka kyndon 302 jong ka Indian Penal Code pyrshah ia ki briew ki bym lah ban ithuh .

en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts , to the which also ye are called in one body ; and be ye thankful .
kha: Ka jingsuk kaba U Khrist u ai , ka long ban kdew lynti ïa phi ha ki rai kiba phi shim ; naba dei ïa kane ka jingsuk ba U Blei u la khot lang ïa phi ha kawei ka met . Bad to long kiba sngewnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba ka jingsuk U Blei kan synshar ha ki dohnud jong phi, ha kaba la khot ia phi ha kawei ka met ; bad to sngewnguh .

en: Bring me venison , and make me savoury meat , that I may eat , and bless thee before the  Lord  before my death .
kha: ‘ Wallam doh mrad ïa nga bad shet ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkyrkhu ha khmat U  Trai  shuwa ba ngan ïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah ia nga ia ka doh kaba thiang, bad pynlong ia nga ban bam ia nga, bad ngan kyrkhu ia me ha khmat U Trai shuwa ka jingiap jong nga .

en: O thou king , the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom , and majesty , and glory , and honour :
kha: U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynlong ïa u Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong me , u syiem uba khraw bad ai ha u ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko syiem, U Blei uba ha khlieh duh u la ai ia u kpa jong me ka hima, bad ka jingkhraw bad ka burom:

en: ( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;
kha: Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kumno ka la jia bad ngi haba ngi ïaid lynti na ka ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta phi tip kumno ngi la shong ha ka ri Ijipt ; bad kumno ngi la wan lyngba ki jaitbynriew kiba phi la iaid lyngba;

en: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days , after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine :
kha: Hadien ba phi la dep shoh kew bad dep khem ïa ki sohwaiñ , rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sumar ia ka jingkhawai jong ki ïingjaiñ hynriew sngi, hadien ba me la lum ha u kew bad ka wain jong me:

en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u la iehnoh ia ka ri Ijipt khlem da tieng ia ka jingbitar jong u syiem: namar u la shah shitom , kumba u iohi ia uta u bym lah ban iohi .

en: Lo , when the wall is fallen , shall it not be said unto you , Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?
kha: Ka kynroh kan khyllem , bad uwei uwei baroh un kylli ïa phi kaba bha aïu ka la long da ka jingpushara lieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , haba ka kynroh ka la hap , hato ym shym la ong ha phi , Hangno ka dawai kaba phi la dawai ?

en: So the Levites stilled all the people , saying , Hold your peace , for the day is holy  ; neither be ye grieved .
kha: Ki Lebi ki la pynjai jai ïa u paidbah bad ong ha ki ban ym sngewsih ha kum kata ka sngi kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki Lebi ki la sngap jar ia ki briew baroh, ki da ong: To sngap jar, namar ka sngi ka long kaba khuid ; lymne phi la sngewsih .

en: And David said unto him , How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the  Lord s  anointed ?
kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Kumno keiñ me nud ban pynïap ïa u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u: Kumno phim tieng ban pynkhih ia la ka kti ban pynjot ia U Trai ba la pynsleh ?

en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish  ; yea , those nations shall be utterly wasted .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki hima ki bym shakri ïa pha yn pynjot thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew bad ka hima ki bym shakri ia me kin jah noh ; yea , kita ki jaitbynriew kin sa jah rngai noh shibun .

en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .
kha: U Stad saiñpyrkhat u la pyrshang ban shem ïa ki kyntien pyntngen , hynrei ki ktien kiba u thoh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongialap u la wad ban shem ia ki kyntien kiba lah ban pdiang: bad kata kaba la thoh ka long kaba dei , wat ki kyntien jong ka jingshisha ruh .

en: Neither filthiness , nor foolish talking , nor jesting , which are not convenient : but rather giving of thanks .
kha: Lymne kam long kaba dei ïa phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka ktien kaba khlem akor , kren thala , ne krensih , pynban , phi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkhuid, ne ka jingkren bieit, ne ka jingkren bein, kaba ym long kaba suk: hynrei ka kham sngewnguh .

en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
kha: U Aaron u jubab ,  Wat bitar ïa nga . Phi tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba im sngi tang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la ong, Wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong u kynrad jong nga kan nang jur: me tip ia ki briew, ba ki la set ha ka jingsniew .

en: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;
kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bad u diengsoh Dumbur , u diengsoh Pomkranet bad u diengsoh Olib , bad ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri u kew bad u kew bad ki dieng sohjew bad ki dieng sohjew bad ki dieng sohjew bad ki dieng sohjew;

en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .
kha: U bret ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsai jong ka ki la ïap jyllop ha ka Duriaw Basaw
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh bad u shipai jong u u la bret shapoh duriaw: ki kapten ba la jied jong u ruh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw Basaw .

en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces , and grind the faces of the poor ? saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
kha: Phim don hok ban khñiot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ban shim kabu ïa kiba duk . Ma nga U Nongsynshar U  Trai  Badonbor baroh nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi mut ba phi shoh ia ki briew jong nga ha ki bynta , bad phi pynkhih ia ki khmat jong kiba duk ? ong U Trai U Blei jong ki paid .

en: Your words have been stout against me , saith the  Lord . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee ?
kha: Phi la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei shaphang jong nga ,  ong U  Trai .  Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi la ong shaphang jong me ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong phi ki la long kiba sniew pyrshah ia nga , ong U Trai . Hynrei phi ong , Ngi la kren kumta pyrshah ia me ?

en: David therefore besought God for the child  ; and David fasted , and went in , and lay all night upon the earth .
kha: U Dabid u la duwai ïa U Blei ba uta u khunlung un koit . Um treh bam ei ei , bad man ka miet u rung sha la ka kamra , bad u thiah ha madan baroh shi miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kyrpad ia U Blei na ka bynta u khynnah ; bad u Dabid u la shah jingit, bad u la leit rung , bad u la thiah baroh shi miet ha ka khyndew .

en: Can any man forbid water , that these should not be baptized , which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we ?
kha: Kine ki briew ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba ma ngi ruh ngi la ïohpdiang . Hato don uno uno , te , u ban khang ïa ki na kaba shah pynbaptis da ka um ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato uno uno u briew u lah ban khang ia ka um , ba kine kin ym shah pynbaptis , kiba la ioh ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid kumjuh ia ngi ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?
kha: Te U  Trai  u kylli ïa u Kain ,  Shano u Abel u para jong me ?  U te u jubab ,  Ngam tip . Hato dei ma nga u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Kain, Hangno u Abel u hynmen jong me ? Bad u la ong: Hato nga dei u nongsumar jong nga ?

en: The sons of Leah  ; Reuben , Jacob s firstborn , and Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Zebulun :
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Leah ki long u Reuben ( u khun nyngkong u Jakob ) , u Simeon , u Lebi , u Judah , u Issakhar , bad u Sebulun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Leah ; Reuben, u khun nyngkong jong u Jakob, bad u Simeon, bad u Lebi, bad u Judah, bad u Issakhar bad u Zebulun:

en: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to sumar ïoh ba uno uno na phi u don ka dohnud kaba sniew eh bad bymngeit kat haduh ba un da phai dien noh na U Blei uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bha ko para bangeit , ioh ba kan don ha uno uno na phi ka dohnud bymngeit kaba sniew, ha kaba leit noh na U Blei uba im .

en: And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Hynñiew ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki hynriew hajar ngut ki la shim katno tylli ki basket kiba dap da ki bniat ? Ki la ong, Hynriew .

en: But before faith came , we were kept under the law , shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed .
kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka por ba ka jingngeit kan wan , ka Hukum ka set ïa ngi baroh kum ki koidi tad haduh ban da pynpaw ïa kane ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shuwa ba ka jingngeit kan wan , la buh ia ngi hapoh ka hukum , la khang ia ngi ha ka jingngeit kaba hadien dei ban pynpaw .

en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .
kha: Hynrei lada ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai , te uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher u dei ban sngap jar noh bad kren tang ha lade bad ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ym don u nongpynkylla ktien , to ai ba un sngap jar ha ka balang ; bad to ai ba un kren ia lade bad ia U Blei .

en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :
kha: Bad to U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur , un pynlah ïa phi ban don kajuh ka jingmut hapdeng jong phi da kaba bud ïa ka nuksa U Khrist Jisu ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Blei jong ka jingshaniah bad ka jingpyntngen u ai ia phi ban long kiba iadei paralok iwei ia iwei pat kat kum U Khrist Jisu:

en: But those mine enemies , which would not that I should reign over them , bring hither , and slay them before me .
kha: Mynta , ïa kito ki nongshun jong nga ki bym kwah ïa nga ban long u syiem jong ki , to wallam ïa ki hangne bad pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kita ki nongshun jong nga, ki bym kwah ba ngan synshar halor jong ki, ki wanrah ia ki hangne bad ki pyniap ia ki ha khmat jong nga .

en: And the men rose up from thence , and looked toward Sodom : and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way .
kha: Te kita ki briew ki ïamihnoh nangta , bad ki leit sha ka jaka na kaba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka Sodom ; bad u Abraham u leit on lynti ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ieng naduh hangta, bad ki peit sha ka shnong Sodom : bad u Abraham u la leit ryngkat bad ki ban wanrah ia ki ha lynti .

en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah : and the men of war , mighty men of valour , were in Jerusalem .
kha: Ha kylleng ka Judah u tei ki kut bad ki nongbah , ha kiba la buh bun bah ki mar ki mata . Ha Jerusalem , u buh ki rangbah synshar kiba tbit bha , kat kum ki kur jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la don shibun ki kam ha ki shnong Judah: bad ki shipai kiba khlain bor ki la don ha Jerusalem .

en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his : brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
kha: Mynta uno uno u lah ban shong ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u — hadien ba la ber da u kyndok ban pynïap ïa ki khñiang jingpang !
translated_en_to_kha: Kan shong ha ka iing jong u, namar ba kam dei kawei ruh na ki: u mawsiang un sa bthei ha ka jaka shong jong u .

en: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .
kha: Ngan sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa lade ruh , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namar ba nga ieit palat ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlut bad pynlut shibun eh na ka bynta jong phi ; wat la katba nga nang ieit ia phi , katta nga nang duna ka jingieit .

en: Then saith he unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .
kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ka jingsngewsih hapoh ka dohnud jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta kata kat haduh ba ka jan pynlwet ïa nga . To sah hangne bad ïa-ap lem bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ha ki, Ka mynsiem jong nga ka long kaba sngewsih palat, wat haduh ka jingiap: to sah hangne bad to peit bad nga .

en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .
kha: Ki la duh noh ïa baroh ki jingsngew jong ka jinglehrain ; ki pynlapmiet ïa lade ha ki kam thala bad ki leh ïa baroh ki jait kam sniew khlem salia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la leit noh ki la aiti ia lade ha ka jinglong ba sniew, ban trei ia ka jingbymkhuid baroh da ka jingkwah brai .

en: And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .
kha: Man ka step , uwei pa uwei u lum katba u lah ban bam , bad ynda ka la shit ka sngi , kaba sah baroh ha madan ka la um noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lum ia ka man ka step, uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingbam jong u: bad haba ka sngi ka la rkhiang ka la rkhiang .

en: And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law  ; but Ruth clave unto her .
kha: Sa shisien pat ki sdang ban ïam . Nangta ka Orpah ka doh khublei ïa la ka kiaw kurim bad ka leit phai pat sha ïing , hynrei ka Ruth ka snoh rdin ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, bad ki la iam biang: bad ka Orpah ka la kdup ia ka kmie jong ka ha ka ain ; hynrei ka Ruth ka la sngewsih ia ka .

en: Tell your friend that if he does not do so within a reasonable period of time , you will have to do so yourself .
kha: Iathuh ia u paralok jong phi ba lada um leh kumta hapoh ka por kaba biang , phin hap ban leh hi dalade .
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia u paralok jong phi ba lada um leh kumta hapoh ka por kaba biang , phin hap ban leh hi dalade .

en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold  ;
kha: Man ka snem u syiem Solomon u ïohpdiang kumba arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingkhia jong ka ksiar kaba la wan ha u Solomon ha ka shisnem ka long hynriew spah sanphew hynriew tylli ki talent ksiar ; .

en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me : and disguiseth his face .
kha: Uba klim u ap ïa ka por janmiet ba kan wan ; u tap ïa la ka khmat khnang ban ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat ruh jong u nongleh kam sniew ka ap ia ka jingshai kaba dum, ka ong: Ym don khmat ban iohi ia nga: bad ka pynkylla ia ka khmat jong u .

en: During a chat with indianexpress . com , Sagarika opened about her relationship with Zaheer , fondly called Zak .
kha: Ha ka por ba ia kren bad ka indianexpress . com , ka Sagarika ka la plie shaphang ka jingiadei jong ka bad u Zaheer uba la khot ieit bha u Zak .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingiakren bad ki nong India . ka Sagarika ka la plie shaphang ka jingiadei jong ka bad u Zaheer, uba la khot u Zak.

en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders ? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread .
kha: Balei ba ki synran jong me kim kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ? Kim ju thet ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ha shuwa ba kin bam !
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ki synran jong me ki pynkhein ia ka rukom jong ki rangbah ? namar kim sait kti haba ki bam kpu .

en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee  ;
kha: Kumta hamar ba phin ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei ha ka duwan bad hangta phi kynmaw ba u para jong phi u don ei ei pyrshah ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada me wanrah ia ka jingai jong me sha ka almari bad hangta to kynmaw ba u hynmen jong me u don ka hok pyrshah ia me ; .

en: For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka jingroi kyrhai jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha kita ki sngi bad ha kata ka por, haba ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong u Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

en: And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .
kha: Kumta don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don 8 tylli ki board ; bad ki soket jong ki ki long shiphew tylli ki soket rupa , hapoh kawei pa kawei ka board ar tylli ki soket .

en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .
kha: Nangta u Shalmaneser u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Assyria u la wan shaneng ha ka ri baroh kawei bad u la leit sha Samaria bad u la ker sawdong ia ka lai snem .

en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .
kha: Ka long kaba la tip bha ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Judah ; bad u Moses um shym kdew ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka paw shai ba U Trai jong ngi u mih na Judah ; na kaba u Moses u la kren ei ei shaphang ka jinglong lyngdoh .

en: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,
kha: Kan long kumne ha kaba kut ka Ïa : ki angel kin mihnoh ban lumlang ïa ki briew kiba sniew napdeng kiba bha
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kan long ha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei: ki angel kin wan shabar , bad kin ot noh ia kiba sniew napdeng kiba hok .

en: According to reports , Heavy rains hit many parts of the city like Narayanguda , Himayatnagar , and Khairatabad .
kha: Katkum ka khubor , U slap uba jur u la ther ha kiba bun ki bynta jong ka nongbah kum ha Narayanguda , Himayatnagar , bad Khairatabad .
translated_en_to_kha: Katkum ka khubor ba la ioh lum la ong ba u slap ba jur u la hiar ha kiba bun ki bynta jong ka nongbah kum ka Narayanguda , ka Himayatnagar , bad ka Khairatabad .

en: Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .
kha: Kumta ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ki rangbah ban ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u da kren pyrshah ïa u Moses bad pyrshah ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la sngewsih ia ki briew kiba la ong , Ngi la iohsngew ia u ba u kren bein ia u Moses bad pyrshah ia U Blei .

en: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,
kha: Na ka khet syiem ha ka nongbah Susa jong ka Persia , u syiem Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha kita ki sngi , haba u syiem Ahasaerus u la shong ha ka khet jong ka hima jong u kaba don ha Shushan ka iing syiem .

en: Nor thieves , nor covetous , nor drunkards , nor revilers , nor extortioners , shall inherit the kingdom of God .
kha: lane kiba tuh lane kiba kwah lalot lane kiba buaid lane kiba kren thadrong ïa kiwei lane ki nongtuh — yn ym don uno uno na kine u ban ïohkynti ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongtuh, ne ki nongdih kyiad, ne ki nongdih kyiad, ne ki nongleh kam sniew, kin hiar pateng ia ka hima U Blei .

en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not , when she had received the spies with peace .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïada ïa ka Rahab ka nuti na kaba shah pynïap lem bad kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei ; naba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongsyntiat na Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit ka Rahab kaba sniew kam shym la jah noh bad ki ki bym ngeit , haba ka la pdiang ia ki nongleit jingleit da ka jingsuk .

en: So Joshua rose up early in the morning , and brought Israel by their tribes  ; and the tribe of Judah was taken :
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Joshua u wan ïalam ïa ki Israel sha khmat , shi jait shi jait , bad la kdew ïa ka jait Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la khie dang step , bad u la wanrah ia ki Israel da ki jaitbynriew jong ki ; bad la shim ia ka jaitbynriew Judah:

en: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine  ; and she doted on her lovers , on the Assyrians her neighbours ,
kha: La ka long ka jong nga , ka Oholah ka ïai bteng ban long ka nuti bad ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki nongleh-ieit jong ka na Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Aholah ka la ialehkai ia ka kam runar haba ka long ka jong nga ; bad ka la sngewsih ia ki nongieit jong ka , ha ki nong Asyria jong ka .

en: In the 2014 general election , Mahajan had defeated Dutt , the then sitting MP , by a margin of 1 . 86 lakh votes
kha: Ha ka elekshon paidbah jong u snem 2014 u Mahajan u la pynliem ia u Dutt uba dei u MP ba dang shong ha kata ka por da ka jingiapher kaba 1 . 86 lak vote
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka elekshon bah 2014 , u Mahajan u la jop ia u Dut , u MP uba shong ha kata ka por, da ka jingkhein kaba 1 . 86 lak

en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee .  And he saith , Master , say on .
kha: U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha u ,  Ko Simon , nga don ei ei ban ong ha me .   Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  to ïathuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, u Simon, nga don ei ei ban ong ha me . Bad u ong, Ko Nonghikai, to ong .

en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city : and their contentions are like the bars of a castle .
kha: Ïarap ïa la u para bad un ïada ïa phi kum ka kynroh kaba khlaiñ jong ka nongbah , hynrei lada phi ïakajia bad u , un khang khyrdep ki jingkhang jong u ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U hynmen uba la sngewsih u kham eh ban jop ban ia ka nongbah kaba khlain: bad ki jingkynthoh jong ki ki long kum ki bar jong ka iing syiem .

en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea , they said unto him , Rabbi , when camest thou hither ?
kha: Haba ki briew ki la shem ïa U Jisu sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , ki la ong ha u ,  Ko Nonghikai , mynno me la poi shane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shem ia u sha shiliang duriaw, ki la ong ha u, Rabbi, haba me wan hangne ?

en: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?
kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingbymshisha jong nga ka pynlong ïa ka burom U Blei da kaba pynlong ïa ka jingshisha jong u ban kham paw shai ? Balei yn dang ïai pynrem ïa nga kum u nongpop ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka jingshisha U Blei ka la nang kiew lyngba ka jinglamler jong nga sha ka burom jong u ; balei ba nga ruh nga shah bishar kum u nongpop ?

en: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time , who should walk after their own ungodly lusts .
kha: Ki la ong ha phi ,  Haba ki sngi bakhatduh kin wan , kin mih ki briew ki ban krenbeiñ ïa phi , ki briew kiba ïaid katba kum ki jingkwah brai bymriewblei jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ba ki la iathuh ia phi ba ki dei ban don ki nongleh thok ha ka sien kaba khatduh , kiba dei ban iaid hadien la ki jong ki jingkwah brai khlem blei .

en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day  ; for I know not the numbers thereof .
kha: Ngan ïathuh shaphang ka jingbha jong me ; baroh shi sngi ngan kren shaphang ka jingpynim jong me , wat la ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong nga kan pyni ia ka hok bad ka jingpynim jong me baroh shisngi ; namar ngam tip ia ki jingkhein jong ka .

en: For as he thinketh in his heart , so is he : Eat and drink , saith he to thee  ; but his heart is not with thee .
kha: To wan bad bam shuh sa khyndiat ,  u ong , hynrei um mut kumta . Kaei kaba u pyrkhat ka long kaei kaba u long da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba u pyrkhat ha ka dohnud jong u, kumta u long: Bam bad dih, u ong ia me ; hynrei ka dohnud jong u kam don bad me .

en: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,
kha: Ha ka synagog , la don u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u , bad u la kyang da ka sur kaba jam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka synagog la don uwei u briew uba don ka mynsiem u ksuid bymkhuid bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam .

en: And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .
kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jong me ki wan urlong — bad kin wan urlong shisha — te kin sa tip ba pleng hapdeng jong ki u don u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda kane kan jia , (oo, kan sa wan, ) te kin sa tip ba u nongiathuhlypa u la don hapdeng jong ki .

en: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Uta u lyngdoh un shim ïa kata ka shang na phi bad buh ïa ka ha khmat ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia ka basket na ka kti jong me bad un buh ia ka ha khmat ka almari U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: He wandereth abroad for bread , saying , Where is it ? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand .
kha: bad ki pukni ki ap ban ïoh puh ïa ka metïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U iaid shabar ri na ka bynta u kpu, u ong, Hangno ka don ? u tip ba ka sngi jong ka jingdum ka long kaba la pynkhreh ha ka kti jong u .

en: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim , and dwelt therein  ; and went out from thence , and built Penuel .
kha: U Jeroboam u syiem ki Israel u la tei kynroh ïa ka shnong Shekhem kaba ha ri lum Ephraim bad u la sah hangta katto katne por . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u tei kynroh sa ïa ka shnong Penuel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeroboam u la tei ia u Shehem ha u lum Ephraim , bad u la shong hangta ; bad u la mih noh nangta , bad u la tei ia u Penuel .

en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :
kha: Ma phi baroh kiba nga la phah sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong .’
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai, phi baroh na ka jinglong mraw, ia uba nga la phah na Jerusalem sha Babilon:

en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said , Why did the heathen rage , and the people imagine vain things ?
kha: Da U Mynsiem Bakhuid me la kren lyngba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong ngi , u shakri jong me , haba u la ong ,   ‘ Balei ba ki Jentil ki bitar shla ; balei ki briew ki thaw ïa ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano da ka shyntur jong u shakri jong me u Dabid u la ong , Balei ki nongwei ki la bitar , bad ki briew ki pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba lehnohei ?

en: A sword is upon the liars  ; and they shall dote : a sword is upon her mighty men  ; and they shall be dismayed .
kha: Ka Jingïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bashukor jong ka — katno ki long kiba bieit ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai jong ka — katno ki long kiba sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam ka don ha ki nonglamler ; bad kin sa leh: ka waitlam ka don ha ki briew kiba khlain bor jong ka ; bad kin sa sngewsih .

en: ( For all these abominations have the men of the land done , which were before you , and the land is defiled  ; )
kha: Ki la leh ïa kita ki kam kiba ijli bad pyntngit ïa ka ri , hynrei phi phim dei ban leh ïa ki . Baroh na phi , la ki Israel ne ki nongwei kiba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , phi dei ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta kine ki jingleh bymman baroh ki la leh ia ki briew jong ka ri kiba la don ha khmat jong phi, bad ka ri ka la jakhlia ; )

en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons  sons , even four generations .
kha: U Job u la im shispah sawphew snem hadien kane , ka jingim kaba la jlan bha kat ban ïohi ïa ki ksiew bad ïa ki ksiew tun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane u Job u la im shispah sawphew snem , bad u la iohi ia ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u wat saw pateng .

en: And they said , Thou hast not defrauded us , nor oppressed us , neither hast thou taken ought of any man s hand .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la jubab ,  Em , phim shym la shukor ïa ngi , lane banbeiñ ïa ngi , lane shim ei ei nano nano .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Me khlem pynduh ia ngi, ne pynshitom ia ngi, bad me khlem shim ia ka kti jong uno uno u briew .

en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
kha: Ha ki ïing jong ki briew kiba sniew don ki jingkynshew kiba ki la lum da kaba leh bymhok . Ki pyndonkam da ki jingthew bashukor , kaei kaei kaba nga isih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki dang don ki spah jong ka jingsniew ha iing jong kiba sniew , bad ka jingthew kaba rit kaba long kaba sngewsih ?

en: And when Paul s sister s son heard of their lying in wait , he went and entered into the castle , and told Paul .
kha: Hynrei u khun jong ka para jong u Paul u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla ; kumta u la leit shapoh ka kut shipai bad u la ïathuh ha u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun jong u Paul u la iohsngew ia ka jingthiah jong ki, u la leit rung shapoh ka iing syiem bad u la iathuh ha u Paul .

en: Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;
kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa kine ki nongbah : ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , ( ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la tei ia ka Bethhoron kaba shalor, bad ka Bethhoron ka nongbah kaba shapoh, kaba la ker sawdong, bad ki kynroh, ki khyrdop bad ki bar ;

en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens , and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains  ;
kha: U Solomon u don ruh phraphew hajar ngut ki nongshtah maw ha ri lum , bad hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki nongkit maw ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u don laiphew hajar ngut ki nongkit jingkit, bad saw hajar ngut ki nongkit ha ki lum ; .

en: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water , which Abimelech s servants had violently taken away .
kha: U Abraham u la ujor ha u Abimelekh shaphang ka pukri um ïa kaba ki shakri u Abimelekh ki la knieh bor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la pynrem ia u Abimelech namar ka pung um kaba u Abimelech u la shim noh da ka jingleh donbor .

en: Now we beseech you , brethren , by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , and by our gathering together unto him ,
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingwan pat ka jong U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi bad ka jinglum lang ïa ngi ban long lem bad u : Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit da ka jingwan U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist bad da ka jingialum lang jong ngi ha u .

en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .
kha: Dang step eh ha ka Sngi U Trai , hamar ba dang shu mih ka sngi , ki la leit sha ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad dang step bha ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka taiew , ki la poi ha ka jingtep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi .

en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
kha: Phin shem ïa kata ynda phin leit sha ka kamra ba shadien ban rieh ,  u Mikaïah u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Ha kata ka sngi haba me leit shapoh ka kamra kaba shapoh ban buhrieh ia lade .

en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy  ; and did run to bring his disciples word .
kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh na ka jingtep , da ka jingsheptieng bad pynban kiba la pyndap da ka jingkmen , bad ki la mareh ban ïathuh ha ki synran jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh kloi na ka jingtep da ka jingtieng bad ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad ki la mareh ban wanrah ia ki synran jong u ia ka ktien .

en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .
kha: Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi ban pynshahshkor ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la kyntait ban sngap , bad ki la tan noh ia ka tyrpeng bad ki la pynsangeh ia ki shkor jong ki , ba kim dei ban iohsngew .

en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .
kha: te ha ka jingbitar ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , bad sa shisien ngan pynshitom jur shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba la long mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan iaid pyrshah ia phi ruh ha ka jingbitar ; bad nga ruh ngan pynshitom ia phi hynriew sien na ka bynta ki pop jong phi .

en: And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Nga la long u traishnong da kaba siew shibun ka pisa .   Hynrei nga long traishnong naduh dang kha ,  u Paul u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah shipai u la jubab , Da ka jingpynkut kaba khraw nga la ioh ia kane ka jinglaitluid . Bad u Paul u la ong , Hynrei nga la kha laitluid .

en: Wilt thou judge them , son of man , wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers :
kha: Hato me la kloi ban ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong ki , ko khun u briew ? Te to leh kumta . Pynkynmaw ïa ki shaphang kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki kpa jong ki , ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me bishar ia ki ko khun u briew, me bishar ia ki ? pynlong ia ki ban tip ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki kpa jong ki:

en: And no man was able to answer him a word , neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban ai kano kano ka jubab ïa U Jisu , bad naduh kata ka sngi ym don mano mano ba nud ban kylli jingkylli shuh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don briew uba lah ban jubab ia u da ka ktien , lymne u briew naduh kata ka sngi u kylli shuh ia u .

en: Whose soever sins ye remit , they are remitted unto them  ; and whose soever sins ye retain , they are retained .
kha: Lada phi map ïa ki pop jong ki briew , la map ïa ki ; lada phim map ïa ki , ïa ki ym shym la map .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pop jongno jongno ruh kiba phi phah sha ki ; bad kiba phi bat ia ki, ki shah bat .

en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah : but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him .
kha: U Amasa u la leit khot ïa ki , hynrei um shym poi ha ka por ba u syiem u la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Amasa u la leit ban lum lang ia ki briew jong u Judah: hynrei u la sah kham slem ban ia ka por ba la buh ia u .

en: And Azariah the priest went in after him , and with him fourscore priests of the  Lord  , that were valiant men :
kha: U Asaraïah u lyngdoh ryngkat bad phraphew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba khlaiñ bad bashlur ki bud nadien jong u Syiem Ussaïah ban khang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asariah u lyngdoh u la rung hadien jong u, bad bad u saw ngut ki lyngdoh jong U Trai, kiba long ki briew kiba shlur:

en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wat na ka jing iap . ”
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka Baibl ka batai:  U Abraham u la khein ba U Blei u la lah ban pynmih [u khun jong u u Isaak] wat na kiba iap .

en: And immediately the man was made whole , and took up his bed , and walked : and on the same day was the sabbath .
kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la ïohkhiah , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah bad u la sdang ban ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi la pynlong ia uta u briew uba pura, bad u la shim ia ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la iaid: bad ha kata ka sngi la long ka sngi Sabha .

en: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death , to guide our feet into the way of peace .
kha: bad ban tyngshaiñ na bneng halor kito baroh kiba im ha ka syrngiew ba-dum jong ka jingïap , ban ïalam ïa ki sien jam jong ngi ha ka lynti jong ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ai jingshai ia ki kiba shong ha ka jingdum bad ha ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , ban ialam ia ki kjat jong ngi sha ka lynti jong ka jingsuk .

en: And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin s sack .
kha: U shakri jong u Joseph u la wad bniah da kaba sdang na uba nyngkong ter ter haduh uba khatduh , bad ïa ka khuri la shem ha ka byrni jong u Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wad, bad u la sdang ha kaba heh tam, bad u la leit noh ha kaba rit tam: bad la lap ia ka khuri ha ka tdong jong u Benjamin .

en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba kurup ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .
translated_en_to_kha: U Caleb u la ong , Uta uba pynkhih ia ka Kirjathsepher bad uba shim ia ka, ha u ngan ai ia ka Ahsah ia ka khun jong nga ha ka tnga .

en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .
kha: Nangta u lap kawei ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada kaba dang shu ïap shen . U dem bad u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shem ia ka shyntur kaba thymmai, bad u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la shim ia ka bad u la pyniap ia shi hajar ngut ki briew da kata .

en: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la mudui ïa U Jisu shibun kiei kiei , kumta u Pilat u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato men ym jubab ? Sngap ïa ki jingmudui jong ki baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la kylli biang ia u, u da ong: Wat jubab ei ei ? ha khmih katno kiei kiei ki sakhi pyrshah ia me .

en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .
kha: U Moses u la dap shispah arphew snem ka rta mynba u ïap ; ki khmat jong u kim pat byr-ïe , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la don shispah arphew snem ka rta haba u la iap: ka khmat jong u kam shym la dum, lymne ka bor ba kynja met jong u kam shym la jah noh .

en: The SAD has not decided to elevate Deputy Chief Minister Sukhbir Badal as the Chief Minister in the coming days .
kha: Ka SAD kam shym la rai ban kyntiew ia u Deputy Chief Minister u Sukhbir Badal kum u Myntri Rangbah ha kine ki sngi ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka SAD kam shym la rai ban kyntiew ia u Myntri Rangbah ka jylla u Sukhbir Badal kum u Myntri Rangbah ka jylla ha ki sngi ban wan .

en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .
kha: Bad ka jingim bymjukut ka mut ban ithuh ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba ithuh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa uba me la phah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingim bymjukut, ba kin ithuh ia me U Blei uba shisha bad U Jisu Khrist uba me la phah .

en: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand , and rejoice in hope of the glory of God .
kha: U la wallam ïa ngi da ka jingngeit sha kane ka jingshem mynsiem jong ka jingaiei U Blei , ha kaba mynta ngi im . Bad kumta ngi sngewsarong ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingïadon bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei!
translated_en_to_kha: Da uba ngi ioh da ka jingngeit ha kane ka jingaiei ha kaba ngi ieng , bad ngi sngewkmen ha ka jingkyrmen ia ka burom U Blei .

en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,
kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh phi dei ban long ka nuksa jong ka jinglong babha . To long kiba minot bad kiba kitkhia ha ka jinghikai jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh kaba pyni ia lade ia ka rukom treikam kaba bha: ha ka jinghikai kaba pyni ia ka jingbym bamsap , ka jinglong ba jylliew , ka jinglong ba shisha , .

en: But now ye also put off all these ; anger , wrath , malice , blasphemy , filthy communication out of your mouth .
kha: Hynrei mynta phi dei ban kiar noh na kine kiei kiei baroh : Ka jingbitar , ka jingkwah jakhlia , bad ki jingsngew kiba dap da ka jingisih . Ki jingkrenbeiñ lane ki jingkrensih kim dei da lei lei ban mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta phi ruh phi weng noh ia kine baroh ki jingbitar, ka jingbitar, ka jingsniew, ka jingkren bein Blei, ka jingiakren kaba jakhlia na ka shyntur jong phi .

en: Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .
kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ka pisa ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia . Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shaphang ka jinglum lang na ka bynta ki riewkhuid kumba nga la ai hukum ia ki balang Kalatia , wat ia phi ruh .

en: A wise man will hear , and will increase learning  ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :
kha: Kine ki proberb ki lah ban nang pynkhraw ïa ka jingtip jong ki riewstad bad kdew lynti ïa kiba la nang la tip ,
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba stad un iohsngew , bad un nang kiew ka jingnang jingstad ; bad u briew uba sngewthuh un poi sha ki jingai jingmut kiba stad:

en: Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
kha: Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa kaba biang , uba la kyrkhu bad tang ma u hi , U Nongsynshar , U Syiem jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ha ki por jong u un pyni, uba long uba la kyrkhu bad uba don tang ma u, u Syiem ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki kynrad;

en: He goeth after her straightway , as an ox goeth to the slaughter , or as a fool to the correction of the stocks  ;
kha: Mar kumta hi u bud ïa ka kum u masi dab sha ka jaka shohdoh , lane kum u  keirang uba ngat sbak ha ka jingriam
translated_en_to_kha: U iaid beit beit ia ka, kumba u masi u leit sha ka jingpyniap , lane kum u bieit sha ka jingpynbeit ia ki stock ; .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God  unto these bones  ; Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and ye shall live :
kha: To ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei ha kine ki shyieng ; Ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia ka jingsawa ban rung ha phi , bad phin im:

en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .
kha: Hynrei namar ba ngam lah leh ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad me . To ngin ïakynton ïa ki maw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïateh kular jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to wan, to ngin ia leh ia ka jutang, ma nga bad me; bad to ai ba kan long ka sakhi hapdeng jong nga bad me .

en: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ha Jerusalem ki la phah katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi sha u Ïoannis , ban kylli ïa u ,  Me dei uei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka dei ka jingthoh jong u Ioannis haba ki Jiw ki la phah ia ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na Jerusalem ban kylli ia u , Me long mano ?

en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your sons cast them out ? therefore shall they be your judges .
kha: Lada kane ka long kumno ba nga beh noh ïa ki , da kumno ki nongbud jong phi ki beh noh ïa ki ? Ki nongbud jong phi hi ki pynshisha ba phi bakla !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada nga da u Belzebul nga beh ia ki ksuid , da mano ki khun jong phi ki beh noh ia ki ? namarkata kin long ki nongbishar jong phi .

en: Likewise also the cup after supper , saying ,  This cup is the new testament in my blood , which is shed for you .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , u la ai ha ki ïa ka khuri hadien ka jingbam miet , da kaba ong ,  Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang bathymmai jong U Blei ïa kaba la pynskhem da ka snam jong nga , ïa kaba la pynmih noh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka khuri hadien ka jingbam janmiet, da kaba ong , Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang kaba thymmai ha ka snam jong nga kaba la pynkhuid na ka bynta jong phi .

en: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God , it is evident : for , The just shall live by faith .
kha: Tangba ym shym la pynksan ïano ïano ruh da ka Hukum ha U Blei  , namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Tang uta ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba ym don briew uba la pynksan da ka hukum ha khmat U Blei, ka paw shai: namar , U hok un im da ka jingngeit .

en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren  ; and Joseph s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh .
kha: Ha ka jingleit kaba ar u Joseph u la pynithuh ïa lade ha la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u syiem ka Ijipt u la ïoh jingtip shaphang ka longïing jong u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sien kaba ar la pynpaw ia u Joseph ha ki hynmen jong u ; bad la pynpaw ia u Joseph ha u Pharaoh .

en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .
kha: Lada phi la long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , sangeh bad pyrkhat !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me la leh bieit ha kaba rah ia lade, ne lada me la pyrkhat sniew, to buh ia la ka kti ha ka shyntur jong me .

en: If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
kha: Mem ngeit ïa nga haba nga ïathuh ïa me shaphang kiei kiei jong kane ka pyrthei ; kumno men lah ban ngeit ïa nga , te , haba nga ïathuh ha me shaphang kiei kiei jong ka bneng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga la iathuh ia kiei kiei kiba ha khyndew bad phim ngeit , kumno phin ngeit lada nga iathuh ia kiei kiei kiba ha bneng ?

en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .
kha: Me pyllait im ïa kito kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew kiba la shah pynshitom men pynim: hynrei ki khmat jong me ki don ha kiba sngewsih , ba me lah ban pynhiar ia ki .

en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth–benoth , and the men of Cuth made Nergal , and the men of Hamath made Ashima ,
kha: Ki briew ka Babilon ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw jong u blei Sukkoth Benoth ; ki briew ka Kuth , ki bleithaw jong u Nergal ; ki briew ka Hamath , ki bleithaw jong u Ashima ; ki briew ka Ibbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Babilon ki la leh ia u Sukothbenoth, bad ki briew jong ka Cuth ki la leh ia u Nergal bad ki briew jong ka Hamath ki la leh ia u Ashima .

en: And so did he unto them , and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel , that they slew them not .
kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaba u Joshua u la leh : u ïada ïa ki bad um shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta u la leh ia ki, bad u la pyllait noh ia ki na ka kti ki Israel , ba kim shym la pyniap ia ki .

en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Master , who did sin , this man , or his parents , that he was born blind ?
kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai , ka pop jongno kaba la pynlong ïa u ban kha matlah ? Hato ka dei ka pop jong u hi ne ka jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ia u, ki da ong, Ko Nonghikai, mano ba la leh pop, une u briew ne ki kmie ki kpa jong u, ba la kha matlah ia u ?

en: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him .
kha: Lada u dang marwei mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , um dei ban ïalam ïa ka tnga jong u haba u mihnoh ; hynrei lada u la shongkurim mynba u wan long u mraw jong phi , u lah ban ïalam ïa la ka tnga lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u wan rung hi dalade , un leit noh hi: lada u la shongkurim , te ka tnga jong u kan leit noh bad u .

en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , katno me long uba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem bad ka burom ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kyrkhu ia U Trai , ko mynsiem jong nga . Ko Trai jong nga , me long uba khraw shibun eh; me la phong da ka burom bad ka jingkhraw .

en: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .
kha: ( Kiba sah na kiba ïap kim shym la im pat tad ynda ki shihajar snem ki la kut . ) Kane ka dei ka jingpynmihpat kaba nyngkong ïa kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki bym pat im shuh haduh ba la dep ki hajar snem . Kane ka long ka jingmihpat kaba nyngkong .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto it ,  No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever .  And his disciples heard it .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha uta u dieng Dumbur ,  Yn ym don shuh lano lano u ban bam soh na me !  Bad ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka , Ym don mano mano ruh ba bam ia u soh jong me hadien jong me junom . Bad ki synran jong u ki la iohsngew ia kata .

en: Servants , be subject to your masters with all fear  ; not only to the good and gentle , but also to the froward .
kha: Phi ki shakri , to pynrit ha ki kynrad jong phi bad pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingtiengburom baroh , ym tang ha kito kiba lehbha bad kiba lehsbun , hynrei ruh ha kito kiba dukhi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri , to long kiba kohnguh ia ki kynrad jong phi da ka jingtieng baroh; ym tang ia kiba bha bad kiba jemnud , hynrei wat ia kiba sniew ruh .

en: And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .
kha: Ka shang ka la don ka jingtap ba la shna da ka sisa . Katba nga dang khmih , la plied ïa ka jingtap , bad hangta hapoh ka shang la shong ka kynthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la pynkiew ia ka talent jong ka lead: bad kane ka long ka kynthei kaba shong hapdeng ka ephah .

en: The burden of Dumah . He calleth to me out of Seir , Watchman , what of the night ? Watchman , what of the night ?
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Edom . Don uwei uba pyrta ïa nga na Edom ,  Ko nongap phira , shen sa katno ba ka miet kan kut ? Ïathuh ïa nga sa katno shen kan kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong u Dumah . U khot ia nga na u Seir , u Watchman , kaei ka miet ? Watchman , kaei ka miet ?

en: But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba leh ïa kaba dei , bad u pynpaw ïa ka jingkhuid jong u da kaba bishar ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai jong ki paid un shah pynkhraw ha ka jingbishar , bad U Blei uba khuid un shah pynkyntang ha ka hok .

en: I am the  Lord  : that is my name : and my glory will I not give to another , neither my praise to graven images .
kha: Nga hi marwei nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ym don kiwei pat ki blei kiba lah ban ïoh bynta na ka burom jong nga ; ngan ym shah ïa ki bleithaw ban ïoh bynta na ka jingïaroh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai: kata ka long ka kyrteng jong nga: bad ka burom jong nga ngan ym ai ha uwei pat , lymne ka jingiaroh jong nga ia ki dur ba la ker .

en: And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them  ; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Balaam ,  Wat leit bad ki , bad wat buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel , namar ki don ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Balaam , Wat leit bad ki ; me dei ban tim ia ki briew: namar ki long kiba la kyrkhu .

en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .
kha: U  Trai  um shah ïa ki briew kiba bha ban shahthngan , hynrei u khang ïa ki bymman ban ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un ym shah ia ka mynsiem jong kiba hok ban thngan: hynrei u bret noh ia ka jinglong jong kiba sniew .

en: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart , and put away evil from thy flesh : for childhood and youth are vanity .
kha: Wat shah ïa kano kano ban pynkhuslai ïa phi lane pynpang ïa phi . Phin ym neh sah ha ka jinglong samla .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata weng noh ia ka jingsngewsih na ka dohnud jong me, bad weng noh ia ka jingsniew na ka doh jong me: namar ka jinglong khynnah bad ka jinglong samla ka long kaba sniew .

en: Their wings were joined one to another  ; they turned not when they went  ; they went every one straight forward .
kha: Ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei uwei u jingthaw ki pyiar bad kita ki jingthaw ki pynlong ïa ka dur basawdong da ki khmut thapniang kiba ïakynduh . Haba ki khih , ki khih kum ka kynhun khlem da pynphai ïa ki met jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bniat jong ki ki la iasoh iwei ia iwei pat ; kim shym la phai haba ki la leit ; ki la leit beit beit sha khmat .

en: For my name s sake will I defer mine anger , and for my praise will I refrain for thee , that I cut thee not off .
kha: Khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , nga pyntud ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha lade ; nga bat noh ïa ka bad ban ym pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ngan pynsangeh ia ka jingbitar jong nga, bad na ka bynta ka jingiaroh jong nga ngan kiar na ka bynta jong me, ba ngan ym ot noh ia me .

en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?
kha: kata ka long , ym ka jingïatiplem jong phi , hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong uta uwei pat u briew .  Kumta , te ,  don u ban kylli ,  balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jong nga ban leh ïa kaei kaei la buh pud da ka jingïatiplem jong uwei pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewthuh , nga ong, ym ia la ka jong ka jong ka jong ka jong uwei pat: namar balei ba ka jinglaitluid jong nga ka shah bishar ha kawei pat ka jingsngew jong u briew ?

en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki briew baroh ki la iohsngew ia u Jeremaiah ba u kren ia kine ki ktien ha iing U Trai .

en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red , when it giveth his colour in the cup , when it moveth itself aright .
kha: Wat ai ba ka waiñ kan pynshoi ïa phi , wat la ka long kaba saw hain hain , wat la ka phyrnai ha ka khuri , bad ka hiar jem jai .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat peit ia ka wain haba ka la rong saw, haba ka ai ia ka rong jong u ha ka khuri , haba ka iaid beit ia lade .

en: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,
kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , te — nga uba long u nongsah byndi namar ba nga shakri ïa U Trai ; to im ka jingim kaba la thew kat kum ka rukom kaba U Blei u la buh haba u la khot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga namarkata , koidi jong U Trai , nga kyrpad ia phi ba phin iaid hok ia ka jingkhot kaba la khot ia phi .

en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .
kha: Wat ka jait ka kynja kaba rit bad ba duk tam kan sa long kaba khraw kum ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . Haba ka por kaba biang ka la wan , ngan pynjia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei kaba rit kan long shihajar , bad kaba rit ka jaitbynriew kaba khlain: Nga U Trai ngan pynkloi ia ka ha ka por jong u .

en: Now Peter sat without in the palace : and a damsel came unto him , saying , Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee .
kha: U Petros u dang shong habar ha ka phyllaw mynba kawei na ki shakri kynthei jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh ka la wan sha u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me long bad U Jisu u nong Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la shong shabar ha ka iing: bad uwei u dam u la wan sha u, u da ong: Me ruh me la don bad U Jisu na Galilaia .

en: And he will take the tenth of your seed , and of your vineyards , and give to his officers , and to his servants .
kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na u kew bad na u sohwaiñ jong phi na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar Aiñ bad kiwei ki rangbah synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ka shi bynta na u symbai jong phi bad na ki kper sohjew jong phi bad un ai ha ki ophisar jong u bad ha ki shakri jong u .

en: And they returned , and prepared spices and ointments  ; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment .
kha: Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha ïing bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ki musla bad ki jingiwbih na ka bynta ka met . Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la shongthait , kumba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan phai biang bad ki jingbam ba la pynkhreh ; bad ki la shongthait ia ka sngi Sabha katkum ka hukum .

en: And it came to pass , as he interpreted to us , so it was  ; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .
kha: Kiei kiei ki la urlong kumba u la ong : Phi la buh biang ïa nga ha kajuh ka kyrdan , hynrei phi la pynïap noh ïa u nongshet kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba u la batai ia ngi, kumta ka la long ma nga; bad ia u u la sahkut .

en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .
kha: kiba long ki khlieh jong ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Ladan . ( U Shimei u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shelomoth , u Hasiel , bad u Haran . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shimei ; Shelomith, bad u Haziel, bad u Haran, lai ngut . Kine ki long ki rangbah jong ki kpa jong u Laadan .

en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,
kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , ha uba la phah pynbna ïa ka jingim ba la kular kaba ngi don ha U Khrist Jisu —
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u apostol U Jisu Khrist da ka mon U Blei , kat kum ka jingkular jong ka jingim kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: He hath not dealt so with any nation : and as for his judgments , they have not known them . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: Um shym la leh ïa kane ha kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; kim tip ïa ki aiñ jong u . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la leh kumta bad kano kano ka jaitbynriew: bad kumba iadei bad ki jingbishar jong u , kim shym la ithuh ia ki . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb , and shall compass about to Goath .
kha: Bad u pud un bteng nangta na sepngi shaduh u lum Gareb bad nangta sawdong sha Goah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lain thew un sa leit sha khmat jong ka ha u lum Gareb , bad un sa iaid kylleng kylleng sha u Goath .

en: Is this your joyous city , whose antiquity is of ancient days ? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn .
kha: Hato kane kan long ka nongbah bakmen jong ka Tyros , ïa kaba la tei naduh mynbarim ? Hato kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba la phah ïa ki nongshong shnong sha shiliang ka duriaw ban buhai shnong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba kmen jong phi kaba la rim bha? ki kjat jong ka hi kin rah ia ka sha jngai sha ka jaka sah .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  the maker thereof , the  Lord  that formed it , to establish it  ; the  Lord  is his name  ;
kha: U  Trai  , uba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uba la pynlong ïa ka bad buh ïa ka ha la ka jaka , u la kren ha nga . Uta uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  , u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai u nongshna jong ka, U Trai uba la thaw ia ka, ban pynskhem ia ka ; U Trai u long ka kyrteng jong u ; .

en: ( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )
kha: kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ jong U Trai :  Ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ban pynkyntang sha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kumba la thoh ha ka hukum U Trai , Ia uwei pa uwei u shynrang uba plie ia ka kpoh yn khot bakhuid ha U Trai ; )

en: As they called them , so they went from them : they sacrificed unto Baalim , and burned incense to graven images .
kha: Hynrei katba nga nang khot ïa u , katta u nang phet jngai na nga . Ki briew jong nga ki kñia ainguh sha u Baal , ki thang jingiwbih ha ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki khot ia ki , kumta ki la leit noh na ki: ki la knia ha u Baal , bad ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha ki dur ba la ker .

en: Praise ye the  Lord  : for it is good to sing praises unto our God  ; for it is pleasant  ; and praise is comely .
kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ka long kaba bha ban rwai ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi ; ka long kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai: namar ka long kaba bha ban rwai iaroh ia U Blei jong ngi ; namar ka long kaba sngewtynnad ; bad ka jingiaroh ka long kaba wan .

en: And they took their daughters to be their wives , and gave their daughters to their sons , and served their gods .
kha: Ki la ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki khun kynthei jong ki ban long ki tnga jong ki , bad ki la ai ia ki khun kynthei jong ki ha ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki la shakri ia ki blei jong ki .

en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .
kha: Hangne ka don kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga la ïohi ha ka pyrthei : Ki briew ki lah ban bat tang shipor ïa la ka pisa haba ki lah ban donkam ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingsniew kaba jur kaba nga la iohi hapoh ka sngi , kata ka long ka spah kaba la buh na ka bynta ki trai jong ka ha ka jingsngewsih jong ki .

en: And say , What is thy mother ? A lioness : she lay down among lions , she nourished her whelps among young lions .
kha: A katno kmie jong phi ka la long kum ka sing ! Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun jong ka hapdeng ki sing shynrang kiba ishyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kaei ka kmie jong me ? Ka jinglong sing: ka la thiah hapdeng ki sing , ka la pyndap ia ki bniat jong ka hapdeng ki sing kiba dang rit .

en: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki leh duk , hynrei ki don ka spah bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Don uba pynlong ia lade uba riewspah, hynrei um don ei ei: don uba pynlong ia lade uba duk, hynrei u don ka spah kaba khraw .

en: All that openeth the matrix is mine  ; and every firstling among thy cattle , whether ox or sheep , that is male .
kha: Man la u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad man la uba la kha nyngkong na ki jingri , ki dei ki jong nga . Hynrei phi dei ban thied biang ïa u kada ,
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kaba plie ia ka matrix ka long ka jong nga bad uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong hapdeng ki masi jong me, la u masi ne u langbrot , uba long shynrang .

en: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father s brother king in his stead , and changed his name to Zedekiah .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynlong ïa u Mattanaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad u la pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Sedekaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Babilon u la pynlong ia u kpa jong u u kpa jong u ha ka jaka jong u, bad u la pynkylla ia ka kyrteng jong u sha u Sedekaiah .

en: Then they told David , saying , Behold , the Philistines fight against Keilah , and they rob the threshingfloors .
kha: U Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki tur ïaleh ïa ka nongrit Keilah bad lute ïa ki kew ba dang shu lah ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la iathuh ha u Dabid da kaba ong: Ha khmih ki Philistia ki ialeh pyrshah ia u Keilah bad ki lute ia ki jaka rep .

en: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha , when he saw them , My father , shall I smite them ? shall I smite them ?
kha: Haba u syiem ka Israel u ïohi ïa ki Syria , u kylli ïa u Elisha ,  Ko kynrad , hato ngan pynïap noh ïa ki ? Hato ngan pynïap noh ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Elisha haba u la iohi ia ki, ko kpa jong nga, hato ngan shoh ia ki ? hato ngan shoh ia ki ?

en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites  ; and the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord .
kha: bad ki Israel kim lah leh ei ei pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la duk shibun namar ki nong Midian ; bad ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai .

en: No man hath seen God at any time . If we love one another , God dwelleth in us , and his love is perfected in us .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba la ïohi ïa U Blei mynno mynno ruh , hynrei , lada ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat , U Blei u im hapoh jong ngi , bad ïa ka jingieit jong u la pynjanai noh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew uba la iohi ia U Blei ha kano kano ka por . Lada ngi iaieit iwei ia iwei pat , U Blei U shong ha ngi bad ka jingieit jong u ka long kaba janai ha ngi .

en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven , whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel ;
kha: Haba ka khubor bashisha , ka Khubor Babha , ka la wan nyngkong ha phi , phi la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingkyrmen ba ka tyrwa . Kumta ïa ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba phi kyrmen , ïa kaba la buh sumar na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng .
