translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingkyrmen kaba la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng , na kaba phi la iohsngew mynshuwa ha ka ktien ka jingshisha jong ka gospel ; .

en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa phi bad ngan ai ha phi shibun ki khun ; ngan pynskhem ïa ka bynta ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan burom ia phi, bad ngan pynlong ia phi kiba seisoh bad pynbun ia phi bad ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga bad phi .

en: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience , in signs , and wonders , and mighty deeds .
kha: Ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bun kiba pynshisha ba nga long u apostol la pynpaw hapdeng jong phi da ka jingïaishah bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ki dak jong u apostol ki la long hapdeng jong phi ha ka jingshaniah baroh, ha ki dak bad ki jingphylla bad ki kam kiba donbor .

en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .
kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew u isih ïa ka jingshai bad un ym wan sha ka jingshai , namar um kwah ba ïa ki kam sniew jong u yn paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei uba leh ia kaba sniew u shun ia ka jingshai , lym kumta ki kam jong u kin shah pynrem .

en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban leit lyngba ka thliew thyrnia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kham suk ia u kulai ban iaid lyngba ka khmat kaba rit , ban ia u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka hima U Blei .

en: So she gleaned in the field until even , and beat out that she had gleaned : and it was about an ephah of barley .
kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka ïai tam kew ha ka lyngkha haduh janmiet , bad haba ka la shoh ïa u , ka shem ba ka la ïohlum la jan shiphew kilo .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la rkhie bein ha lyngkha haduh ban da janmiet, bad ka la pynkhih ia kata ba ka la rkhie bein: bad ka la long shaphang ka ephah jong u barli .

en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death  ; and found none .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban wad ki sakhi pyrshah ïa U Jisu khnang ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem kano kano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar baroh ki la wad ia ka sakhi pyrshah ia U Jisu ban pyniap ia u ; bad kim lap ei ei .

en: And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
kha: Ka ong ha u syiem ,  Kaei kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad ka jingstad jong phi , ka long kaba shisha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u syiem: Ka la long ka khubor kaba shisha kaba nga la iohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang ki kam jong me bad shaphang ka jingstad jong me:

en: And the archers shot at king Josiah  ; and the king said to his servants , Have me away  ; for I am sore wounded .
kha: Hapdeng ka thma u Syiem Josaïah u la shah siat da ki khnam u nong Ijipt . U hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Rah noh ïa nga ; Nga la mynsaw jur !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongsiat khnam ki la siat ia u syiem Josiah bad u syiem u la ong ha ki shakri jong u: To leit noh ia nga; namar nga la mynsaw jur .

en: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be  ; and what shall be after him , who can tell him ?
kha: U bieit u kren bad ïai kren . Ym don mano mano batip kaei ka ban jia marbud , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh kan jia aïu hadien ba ngi ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U bieit ruh u dap da ki kyntien: u briew um lah ban iathuh kaei ka ban long ; bad kaei ka ban long hadien jong u , mano ba lah ban iathuh ia u ?

en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .
kha: Te ïa ka hukum kaba mynshuwa la buh sharud , namar ba ka long kaba tlot bad ka bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka don shisha ka jingpynkylla ia ka hukum kaba iaid shakhmat na ka bynta ka jingtlot bad ka jingbym myntoi jong ka .

en: Now also many nations are gathered against thee , that say , Let her be defiled , and let our eye look upon Zion .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun ki la ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki ong ,  Ïa ka Jerusalem dei ban pynjot ! Ngin ïohi ïa kane ka nongbah ha ki jingjot !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ruh bun ki jaitbynriew ki ialum lang pyrshah ia me, kiba ong , Ai ba kan shah pynjakhlia , bad to ai ba ka khmat jong ngi kan peit ia ka Seion .

en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba la ïap , ha ka jingïadei bad ka pop , hynrei kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh phi ruh phi la iap shisha ha ka pop , hynrei phi im ha U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
kha: Haba baroh ki la ïakdang , u la ong ha la ki synran ,  To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la dap , u la ong ha ki synran jong u , To lum ia ki bynta kiba sah , ba ym don ei ei kaba la jah .

en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land , that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness .
kha: Ha ka ri baroh kawei ngan pynsangeh ïa ka jingleh jakhlia , kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh ki kynthei ban ym leh awria kumba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynlong ia ka jingleh be-ijot ban sangeh noh na ka ri , ba baroh ki kynthei kin shah hikai ban ym leh hadien ka jingleh be-ijot jong phi .

en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .
kha: U syiem Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew kilo ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la leh arspah tylli ki thong ksiar ba la shoh: hynriew spah Shekel ksiar ba la shoh u la leit sha kawei ka thong .

en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice , rising early in the morning , it shall be counted a curse to him .
kha: Phi lah lehse ban tim ïa u paralok jong phi kat haduh ban da pynkhie ïa u dang step phyrngab da ka jingkhublei kaba jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kyrkhu ia u paralok jong u da ka sur kaba jam , uba khie dang step , yn khein ia ka kum ka jingtim ia u .

en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . O ye house of Israel , I will judge you every one after his ways .
kha: Hynrei ko Israel phi ong , ba kaei kaba Nga leh kam long kaba dei . Ngan bishar ïa phi da kaei ba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi ong , Ka lynti U Trai kam long kaba iaryngkat . Ko iing Israel , ngan bishar ia phi iwei ia iwei kat kum ki lynti jong u .

en: Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
kha: Ko Pa ,  u la ong ,  lada me mon , shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka mon jong nga , pynban , ïa ka mon jong me yn pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong, ko Kpa, lada me mon, weng noh ia kane ka khuri na nga: wat la katta ruh ym ka mon jong nga, hynrei ka mon jong me, to long .

en: Concerning the divisions of the porters : Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore , of the sons of Asaph .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingai kam ïa ki Lebi kiba shakri kum ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ . Na ka kur jong u Korah la don u Meshelemaïah u khun jong u Kore , na ka longïing jong u Asaph .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang ki jingphiah jong ki nongrah: Na ki Korhiah u khun u Kore , na ki khun shynrang jong u Asaph .

en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for he taught them as one that had authority , and not as the scribes .
kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom ba u la hikai , namar um long kum ki nonghikai ka Hukum ; hynrei u la hikai da ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai jong u: namar u la hikai ia ki kum kiba don ka bor , bad ym kum ki nongthoh .

en: Ye shall do no manner of work : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi baroh kat haba ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leh ei ei: kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi baroh ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh .

en: My people , go ye out of the midst of her , and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the  Lord .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh nangta ! Phet ban lait im na ka jingbitar shla jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong nga, phi mih na pdeng jong ka, bad phi pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong u na ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai .

en: Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
kha: Nangta u Jesse u khot ïa u Abinadab u khun jong u bad u wan ïalam ïa u sha u Samuel . Hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jesse u la khot ia u Abinadab bad u la pynlong ia u ban iaid ha khmat u Samuel . Bad u la ong , Bad U Trai um shym la jied ia kane .

en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God : Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God :
kha: Kane ka long kumno phin lah ban ithuh la u long U Mynsiem jong U Blei : Uno uno uba pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew , u don U Mynsiem uba wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane phi tip ia U Mynsiem U Blei: Uwei pa uwei u mynsiem uba phla ba U Jisu Khrist u wan ha ka doh u long na U Blei:

en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace  ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever .
kha: Namar ba uwei pa uwei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei , kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kam jong ka hok kan long ka jingsuk ; bad ka jingktah jong ka hok ka jingsngap jar bad ka jingpynthikna junom .

en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .
kha: Kito kiba ha Judah kiba lait im kin roi kum ki jingthung kiba ki thied ki sam jylliew ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba sah na ka iing Judah kan sa mih biang shapoh bad kan sei soh shaneng .

en: Wherefore glorify ye the  Lord  in the fires , even the name of the  Lord  God of Israel in the isles of the sea .
kha: bad kito kiba ha mihngi kin ïaroh ïa u . Ki briew kiba im harud ka duriaw kin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pyndonburom ia U Trai ha ki ding , wat ia ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ha ki rud duriaw .

en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .
kha: U nongshun u la kurup ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut . Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ki lynti ki la sangeh noh , bad ki thliew ki la thang da ka ding , bad ki briew kiba ialeh thma ki la shah pynmong .

en: Arise thou therefore , get thee to thine own house : and when thy feet enter into the city , the child shall die .
kha: Bad u Ahijah u ïai bteng ban ong ha ka tnga u Jeroboam ,  Mynta , khie leit phai sha la ïing . Tang mar ïarung shapoh shnong u khun jong pha un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie noh ia me namarkata, to leit sha la ka jong ka iing: bad ynda ki kjat jong me ki rung ha ka shnong , uta u khynnah un iap .

en: And they laid it up till the morning , as Moses bade : and it did not stink , neither was there any worm therein .
kha: Kumba u Moses u la hukum , kumta ruh ki buh ïa kaba tam haduh kawei pat ka sngi . Te kam shym la sniew , bad kam shym la boi ksaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka haduh mynstep, kumba u Moses u la ong: bad kam shym la sniew , bad ym shym la don u khniang ha ka .

en: That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .
kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia lane kaba lah ban jia ka la lah jia mynshuwa . U Blei u pynlong ïa kajuh ban jia bad ïai jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba la long mynta ka la long mynta bad kata ka ban long mynta bad U Blei u dawa ia kata kaba la leit noh .

en: I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me ka ri khlaw junom la junom , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia me ki jingpynjot bymjukut, bad ki shnong jong me kin ym wan phai shuh: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: My Father , which gave them me , is greater than all  ; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father s hand .
kha: Kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ka long kham khraw ban ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban knieh noh ïa ki na ka jingsumar U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kpa jong nga uba la ai ha nga u kham khraw ban ia baroh ; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban kheit ia ki na ka kti U Kpa jong nga .

en: When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?
kha: Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kaei ka ban jia , ki la kylli ,  Hato ngin pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jong ngi , ko Kynrad ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba kita kiba don shaphang jong u ki la iohi ia kaei kaban sa wan hadien , ki la ong ha u , ko Trai , hato ngin ia tyngkhuh bad ka waitlam ?

en: Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .
kha: A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui lui , bad ïasaid da ïa nga na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa nga na ki briew kiba shukor bad kiba sniew !
translated_en_to_kha: To bishar ia nga ko Blei bad to kyrpad ia ka daw jong nga pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew kaba khlem blei: O pyllait ia nga na u briew uba thok bad uba khlem hok .

en: He said therefore ,  A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom , and to return .
kha: Kumta u la ong ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba heh kyrdan uba dang leit sha ka ri kaba jngai bah ban shah thung syiem , hadien kata , u la thmu ban wan phai pat sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong namarkata , Uwei u riew donburom u la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai ban pdiang ia lade ia ka hima , bad ban wan phai .

en: Because it entereth not into his heart , but into the belly , and goeth out into the draught , purging all meats ?
kha: namar kam rung sha ka dohnud , hynrei , shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta ka mih shabar na ka met .  ( Ha kaba u ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la pynbna ba baroh ki jingbam ki long kiba bit ban bam . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kam rung ha ka dohnud jong u hynrei ha ka kpoh bad ka mih sha ka umsoh , ka pynkhuid ia ki doh baroh ?

en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained  ;
kha: Ïa ki umpohliew shapoh ka khyndew bad ïa ki khyrdop um jong ka suiñbneng la khang noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pung um ruh jong ka jingjylliew bad ki jingkhang jong ka bneng ki la sahkut , bad u slap na bneng u la shah teh lakam ; .

en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .
kha: dei ban wanrah lai kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ar litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad ar litar ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un wanrah ryngkat bad ka masi ka jingainguh doh kaba lai tylli ki shini ba la khleh lang bad shiteng hin ka umphniang .

en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka jylla Sobah jong ka Syria , kaba hajan ka ri Hamath , namar u Hadadeser u la pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri kaba shaphang shaneng ka Ïuphratis .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pynkhih ia u Hadareer syiem u Sobah haduh Hamath , katba u dang leit ban pynskhem ia ka jingsynshar jong u hajan ka wah Euphrates .

en: But if he thus say , I have no delight in thee  ; behold , here am I , let him do to me as seemeth good unto him .
kha: Hynrei lada um sngewbha ïa nga — te , ai un leh ïa nga katba u ibit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u ong kumta, ngam don jingsngewbha ha me; ha kane ka jaka nga don hangne, to ai ba un leh ia nga kumba u sngewbha ia u .

en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .
kha: Ki kyntait ban wan phai sha nga , bad kumta ki dei ban leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Assyria kin synshar halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym leit phai sha ka ri Ijipt hynrei u Assyria un long u syiem jong u namar ki la kyntait ban wan phai .

en: For they also built them high places , and images , and groves , on every high hill , and under every green tree .
kha: Ki tei ki jaka mane ïa ki blei thala , bad ki pynïeng ïa ki maw mot bad ki durblei Asherah ban mane ha ki jaka lum bad hapoh syrngiew ki dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la tei ruh ia ki jaka kiba jrong, bad ki dur bad ki khlaw ki btap, ha uwei pa uwei u lum uba jrong, bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam .

en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them , and he served them : and they continued a season in ward .
kha: Ki la don ha byndi la kham slem , bad u kapten u la buh ïa u Joseph ban peit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U kapten jong ki nongap u la kynnoh ia u Joseph bad ki: bad ki la bteng ia ka aiom ha ka ward .

en: So David dwelt in the fort , and called it the city of David . And David built round about from Millo and inward .
kha: Hadien ka jingïohknieh ïa ka kut , u Dabid u la shong hapoh jong ka bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ka  Ka Nongbah u Dabid .  U la tei ïa ka nongbah sawdong jong ka , da kaba sdang na ka jaka ha kaba la pyndap khyndew ha ka phang mihngi jong u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la shong ha ka kut , bad u la khot ia ka ka shnong u Dabid . Bad u Dabid u la tei sawdong na Millo bad shapoh .

en: My manner of life from my youth , which was at the first among mine own nation at Jerusalem , know all the Jews  ;
kha: Baroh ki Jiw ki tip kumno nga la im naduh ba nga dang samla . Ki tip kumno nga la pynlut ïa la ka jingim , nyngkong ha la ka shnong bad nangta ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rukom im jong nga naduh ka jinglong samla jong nga kaba la long ha kaba nyngkong eh hapdeng ka jaitbynriew jong nga hi ha Jerusalem , tip ia ki Jiw baroh;

en: And she bare him a son , and he called his name Gershom : for he said , I have been a stranger in a strange land .
kha: U Moses u ong ha lade ,  nga long u sohshnong ha kane ka ri , bad kumta nga kyrteng ïa u , u Gershom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la kha ia u khun shynrang , bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Gershom: namar u la ong , Nga la long u nongwei ha ka ri kaba phylla .

en: Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .
kha: Lymne kiba hiarpateng baroh na u Abraham ki long ki khun jong U Blei . U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham ,  Ka long lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa kiba hiarpateng kiba nga la kular ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba ki long u symbai u Abraham, baroh ki long ki khun: hynrei , Ha u Isaak yn khot ia u symbai jong me .

en: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee : and the light shall shine upon thy ways .
kha: Phin ïoh jingjop ha baroh kiei kiei kiba phi leh , bad ka jingshai kan shai ha ka lynti ïaid jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men hukum ia kaei kaei, bad kan long kaba skhem ha me: bad ka jingshai kan shai ha ki lynti jong me .

en: Nevertheless , to avoid fornication , let every man have his own wife , and let every woman have her own husband .
kha: Hynrei namar ba kynrei than ka jingleh awria , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban don la ka jong ka tnga , bad kawei pa kawei ka briew ka dei ban don la u jong u tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ban kiar na ka jingleh be-ijot , to ai ba uwei pa uwei un don la ka jong ka tnga bad to ai ba kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kan don la u jong u tnga .

en: But sought to the  Lord  God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not after the doings of Israel .
kha: U shakri ïa U Blei jong u kpa jong u , u kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei , bad um shym leh ha ka rukom ba ki syiem Israel ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la wad ia U Trai U Blei jong u kpa jong u, bad u la iaid ha ki hukum jong u, bad ym hadien ki jingleh jong ki Israel .

en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
kha: U Jakob u la leit ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit sha jan u hynmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid sha khmat jong ki, bad u la dem khrup hynriew sien haduh ba u la wan hajan u hynmen jong u .

en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .
kha: Ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ha u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatsan ba u Asa u long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la ialum lang ha Jerusalem ha ka taiew kaba lai, ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa .

en: And the Pharisees came forth , and began to question with him , seeking of him a sign from heaven , tempting him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la sdang ban ïania bad u . Ki la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la ong ïa u ban leh kambah ban pynshisha ba U Blei u la mynjur ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la wan shabar bad ki la sdang ban kylli ia u, ki wad ia u ia ka dak na bneng, ki la pynshoi ia u .

en: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes , and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man , in their sight .
kha: Men pynmeh ding da ka jakhlia briew kaba tyrkhong , shet ïa u kpu ha ka ding , bad bam ïa u ha kaba baroh ki lah ban ïohi ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men bam ia ka kum ki cake barli, bad men shet ia ka da ka dewbilat kaba mih na u briew, ha khmat jong ki .

en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .
kha: Nangta ki apostol ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Olib , uba jngai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem na u lum ba la khot u Olivet , kaba long na Jerusalem ka jingleit sngi Sabha .

en: Till a dart strike through his liver  ; as a bird hasteth to the snare , and knoweth not that it is for his life .
kha: ha kaba u  namsop u dung ha u klongsnam jong u . U long kum ka sim kaba tur ruma sha ka jar — um shym tip ba ka jingim jong u ka don ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ka jingsma kaba jem lyngba ka sniehdoh jong u ; kum u sim u kyrkieh ia ka snare , bad um tip ba ka long na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .

en: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :
kha: Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u la jan ba un shah aiti ha ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang sah ha Galilaia , U Jisu u la ong ha ki: U Khun u briew un shah pyndem ha ki kti ki briew:

en: And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .
kha: Katba u bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , katto katne na u , u la hap ha ka lynti ïaid , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u dang bet, don kiba la hap ha rud lynti, bad ki sim jong ka Iyer ki la wan bad ki la bam ia ka .

en: And it shall be at that day , saith the  Lord  , that thou shalt call me Ishi  ; and shalt call me no more Baali .
kha: Nangta sa shisien pat kan sa khot biang ïa nga u tnga jong ka — kan ym khot shuh ïa nga u Baal jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai , ba men khot ia nga Ishi bad wat khot shuh ia nga Baal .

en: But if we shall say , Of men  ; they feared the people : for all men counted John , that he was a prophet indeed .
kha: Hynrei lada ngi ong , ‘ Na u briew’   ( Ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , namar baroh ki la ngeit ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ngin ong: Na ki briew ki la tieng ia ki briew: namar baroh ki briew ki la khein ia u loannis , ba u la long u nongiathuhlypa shisha .

en: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
kha: kum U Khun U Briew , u bym shym la wan ba un shah shakri , hynrei ban shakri bad aiti ïa la ka jingim ban siewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u Khun u briew um shym la wan sha ka jingshakri sha u , hynrei ban shakri bad ban ai ia ka jingim jong u ka jingsiew bai lutksan na ka bynta kiba bun .

en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer  ; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them .
kha: Ki jait Ephraim kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Geser , bad kumta kita ki Kanaan ki ïaishong hangta hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Ephraim um shym la beh noh ia ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha Gzer ; hynrei ki nong Kanaan ki shong ha Gzer hapdeng jong ki .

en: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac , which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year .
kha: Hynrei ngan bat ïa la ka jutang bad u khun jong me u Isaak , ïa uba ka Sarah kan sa kha ha me kum ha kane ka aïom ha ka snem ka ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jutang jong nga ngan pynskhem bad u Isaak, kaba ka Sarah kan kha ha me ha kane ka por ba la buh ha ka snem ban wan .

en: And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .
kha: U Ahimelekh u la kylli na U  Trai  ïa kaei ba u Dabid u dei ban leh , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Dabid bad ïa ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia U Trai na ka bynta jong u, bad u la ai ia u ia ki jingbam ba la shna da u , bad u la ai ia u ia ka waitlam jong u Goliath u Philistia .

en: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee : but say in a word , and my servant shall be healed .
kha: lymne ba nga ñiew ïa lade uba bit ban wan sha me da lade . Shu ai tang ka hukum , bad u shakri jong nga un ïohkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngam shym la pyrkhat ia lade ba nga long uba bit ban wan sha me: hynrei nga ong da ka ktien , bad u shakri jong nga un sa koit .

en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .
kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kaba shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shi bynta na ka shi bynta jong ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingknia doh , la khleh lang bad ka bynta kaba saw jong ka hin jong ka umphniang ba la khleh .

en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers  ; and ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .
kha: Te phin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi; bad phin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong phi .

en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ka pop jong ki khun u Eli ka long kaba la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U  Trai  , namar ba ki la ñiew khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka pop jong ki samla ka la long kaba khraw shibun ha khmat U Trai: namar ki briew ki la sngewsih ia ka jingainguh U Trai .

en: But when his brethren were gone up , then went he also up unto the feast , not openly , but as it were in secret .
kha: Hadien ba ki para shynrang jong u ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu ruh u la leit ; pynban , um shym la leit ha kaba paw , hynrei ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki hynmen jong u ki la leit shaneng, te u ruh u la leit sha ka jingkhawai , ym da kaba paw hynrei kumba ka la long ha kaba rieh .

en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .
kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ong mynba u phah ïa u ban leit phai sha Ijipt ; u ïathuh ruh ha u shaphang ki kambah kiba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iathuh ha u Aaron ia ki ktien U Trai baroh kiba u la phah ia u bad ki dak baroh kiba u la hukum ia u .

en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .
kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pynbiang ïa lade kawei ka kali ïapom bad ki kulai lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synran ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kane, ba u Absalom u la pynkhreh ia u da ki kali bad ki kulai bad sanphew ngut ki briew ban mareh ha khmat jong u .

en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .
kha: Nangta ki la ïakynting sbai ban jied napdeng ki ar ngut ki rangbah , bad uta uba la jied u la long u Matthias , ïa uba la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ki khatwei ngut ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia ki vote jong ki ; bad ka lot ka la hap ha u Mathaios ; bad la khein ia u bad ki shiphew ngut ki apostol .

en: Though hand join in hand , the wicked shall not be unpunished : but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered .
kha: Phi lah ban tip skhem ba ki riewbymman kin shah pynshitom , hynrei kiba hok kin lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka kti kan iasoh lang, ki bymman kin ym shah pynshitom: hynrei u symbai jong kiba hok un shah pynpoi .

en: And Herod said , John have I beheaded : but who is this , of whom I hear such things ? And he desired to see him .
kha: U Herod u la ong ,  Nga la phah khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis ; hynrei uei une u briew uba nga ïohsngew shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh ?  Bad u la ïai pyrshang ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Herod u la ong: U Ioannis u la shah ot khlieh: hynrei mano une uba nga iohsngew ia kiei kiei ? Bad u la kwah ban iohi ia u .

en: Jesus therefore , knowing all things that should come upon him , went forth , and said unto them ,  Whom seek ye ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaei baroh ka ban sa jia ïa u , kumta u la tur sha khmat bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu namarkata haba u tip ia kiei kiei baroh kiba dei ban wan ha u, u la leit shabar bad u la ong ha ki: Iano phi wad ?

en: And every meat offering , mingled with oil , and dry , shall all the sons of Aaron have , one as much as another .
kha: Hynrei ki jingainguh bam baroh ki bym shym la shet , la ki long kiba la khleh ne kiba khlem khleh umphniang , ki dei jong ki lyngdoh na ka ïing u Aaron , bad ki dei ban ïasam lang mar katjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pa kawei ka jingainguh doh, kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang bad kaba rkhiang, baroh ki khun shynrang u Aaron kin don, uwei katba uwei pat .

en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
kha: Nangta , ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïakynting sbai ban khmih mano ban ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la sahnarphna ia u, ki la pyniakhlad ia ki jain jong u, ki la thep vote halor jong ki, kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u dei ban shim .

en: But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .
kha: Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuslai shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ki Israel ki pynjahburom ïa ka kat shaba ki leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la sngewsynei ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga, kaba ka iing Israel ka la pynjah burom hapdeng ki nongwei , shano ruh ki la leit noh .

en: Yet the children of thy people say , The way of the Lord is not equal : but as for them , their way is not equal .
kha: Bad ki briew jong me ki ong ba kaei kaba nga leh kam long ka badei ! Em , ka dei ka lynti jong ki ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun jong me ki ong , Ka lynti U Trai kam long kaba iaryngkat: hynrei ia ki , ka lynti jong ki kam long kaba iaryngkat .

en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon , who will commit to your trust the true riches ?
kha: Te lada ym pat lah ban shaniah ïa phi ha kaba pynïaid ïa ka spah pyrthei , kumno yn shaniah ha phi ïa ka spah bashisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phim shym la long kiba iaineh ha ka mammon bym hok , mano ba ai ha ka jingshaniah jong phi ia ki spah bashisha ?

en: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;
kha: La thoh ïa ki na ka bynta jong ngi ruh ïa kiba la pdiang kum kiba hok , kiba ngeit ha uta uba la pynmih na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong ngi ruh , ha kiba yn sa shah pynngat , lada ngi ngeit ha uta uba la pynmihpat ia U Jisu U Trai jong ngi na kiba iap;

en: Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee .
kha: Da sumar ban ym shah ïa ki jingbamsap ban shukor ïa phi , lane ka spah ban ïalam sakma ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ka don ka jingbitar , to husiar na ka bynta ba un shim noh ia me da ka stroke jong u: te ka jingsiew bai lutksan kaba khraw kam lah ban pynpoi ia me .

en: What is the role of a father ? In many families the father is seen primarily as the one who dispenses discipline .
kha: Kaei ka bynta jong u kpa ? Ha kiba bun ki longïing la ïohi nyngkong eh ïa u kpa kum uta uba ai ïa ka jingpynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka bynta jong u kpa ? Ha kiba bun ki longiing la iohi nyngkong eh ia u kpa kum uta uba pynduh ia ka jingpynbeit .

en: But he said unto them ,  Have ye not read what David did , when he was an hungred , and they that were with him  ;
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Phim pat ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka por mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki, Hato phim shym la pule ia kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh haba u la thngan, bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u;

en: The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .
kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga long uba nyngkong ban ïathuh ïa ka Seïon ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem ban ong , ‘ Ki briew jong phi ki wan ! Ki wan sha ïing !’
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nyngkong kan ong ha u Seion , Ha khmih , ha khmih: bad ngan ai ha Jerusalem ia uta uba wanrah ia ka khubor babha .

en: Consider the examples of three men who , while enjoying a close relationship with God , suffered many calamities .
kha: Pyrkhat ia ki nuksa jong ki lai ngut ki briew kiba katba ki dang ioh ia ka jingiadei kaba jan bad U Blei , ki la mad ia ki jingeh kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia ki nuksa jong ki lai ngut ki briew kiba , katba ki dang ioh ia ka jingiadei kaba jan bad U Blei , ki la mad ia kiba bun ki jingeh .

en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba shisha u wan sha ka jingshai khnang ba ka jingshai kan pynpaw ïa kaei kaba u la leh ka long da kaba kohnguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba leh ia ka jingshisha u wan sha ka jingshai, ba ki kam jong u kin paw, ba ki long kiba la leh ha U Blei .

en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
kha: Ngam don tnga ,  ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Ka long kaba dei haba pha ong ba pham don tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la jubab bad ka la ong, Ngam don tnga . U Jisu u la ong ha ka, Me la ong bha, ngam don tnga:

en: Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .
kha: Haba u nongpeit phatok u la ïoh ïa kane ka hukum , u la buh ïa ki sha ka kamra set kaba shapoh duh bad u la teh ïa ki kjat jong ki hapdeng ki dieng song kiba khia .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la ioh ia kum kata ka jingshah kynnoh, u la pynrung ia ki ha ka phatok kaba shapoh, bad u la pynlong ia ki kjat jong ki kiba skhem ha ki stock .

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga ki long kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Ka kmie jong nga bad ki hynmen jong nga ki long kine kiba iohsngew ia ka ktien U Blei bad kiba leh ia kata .

en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ïa ki jingdawa bahok jong ka Hukum yn pyndep nadong shadong ha ngi kiba im kat kum U Mynsiem , bad ym kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka hok jong ka hukum kan long kaba la pyndep ha ngi , kiba iaid ym kat kum ka doh hynrei kat kum U Mynsiem .

en: To whom our fathers would not obey , but thrust him from them , and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt ,
kha: Hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa u ; ki la ñiat ïa u sharud bad ki la kwah ban leit phai pat sha ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kin ym kohnguh , hynrei ki la pynkhih ia u na ki , bad ha ki dohnud jong ki ki la phai biang sha Ijipt , .

en: And Jesus answered him ,  The first of all the commandments is , Hear , O Israel  ; The Lord our God is one Lord :
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaba kongsan eh ka dei kane , ‘ Shahshkor , ko Israel ! U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u , U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u , Kaba nyngkong eh na ki hukum baroh ka long: To sngap ko Israel; U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long uwei u Trai:

en: And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .
kha: bad ïa u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon kaba saw . Ïa kine baroh la pyndait ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lain kaba saw, ka rong saw, ka onyx bad ka Jasper: ki la shah khang ha ki thliew ksiar ha ki jingkhang jong ki .

en: Then the king answered and said , Give her the living child , and in no wise slay it : she is the mother thereof .
kha: Nangta u Solomon u ong ,  Wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka kynthei kaba nyngkong — ka dei ka kmie bashisha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la jubab bad u la ong: Ai ia ka ia u khun uba im, bad ha ka jingbym don jingstad: ka long ka kmie jong ka .

en: ( Ezekiel 18 :4 ) Nowhere does the Bible teach that man has an immortal soul that survives the death of the body .
kha: ( Ezekiel 18 :4 ) Ym don hangno hangno ruh ba ka Baibl ka hikai ba ki briew ki don ka mynsiem kaba lait na ka jingiap jongka met .
translated_en_to_kha: (Esekiel 18 :4 ) Ym don jaka ba ka Baibl ka hikai ba u briew u don ka mynsiem bym lah iap kaba im na ka jingiap jong ka met .

en: Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :
kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u tlot palat ban pynim ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban ïoh jingïarap !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka kti U Trai kam shym la lyngkot , ba kam lah ban pynim ia ka tnga jong u kaba heh , ba kam lah ban iohsngew:

en: And he said unto Moses , I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee , and thy wife , and her two sons with her .
kha: U la phah ktien sha u Moses ba ki la ïawan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Moses, nga u kpa jong me u Jethro nga wan sha me bad ka tnga jong me bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong ka ryngkat bad ka .

en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh bam . U lyngdoh na ki khun shynrang u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  ha khmat ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka hukum jong ka jingainguh doh: ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kin ainguh ia ka ha khmat U Trai , ha khmat ka almari .

en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,
kha: Ynda ki la wan poi ha u Jakob u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lut ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan sha u kpa jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan bad ki la iathuh ha u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia ia ki;

en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came , and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha U Jisu ki la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ïa ka kambah na ka bynta jong ki , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ruh ryngkat bad ki Sadusi ki la wan , bad ki la kwah ia u ba un pyni ia ki ia ka dak na bneng .

en: As thou hast given him power over all flesh , that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him .
kha: Naba me la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor u bynriew baroh , khnang ba u lah ban ai ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha kito baroh ïa kiba me la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba me la ai bor ia u halor ka doh baroh , ba un ai ia ka jingim bymjukut ia kiba me la ai ia u .

en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .
kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Herod bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paralok ; ha shuwa jong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kajuh ka sngi u Pilat bad u Herod ki la ialong paralok lang: namar shuwa ba kin ia don ha ka jingshun hapdeng jong ki .

en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
kha: U Melkhisedek um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba ym shym la khein na ki u la ioh ia ka shiphew jong u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ia uta uba don ki jingkular .

en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
kha: Nangta pat , u Moses u wanlam ïa uta u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang: bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u langbrot .

en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
kha: Ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane yn bret kloi lan ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym hap bad u mane ia kajuh ka kynta un shah bret hapdeng ka ding kaba thang .

en: And the child grew , and waxed strong in spirit , and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel .
kha: U khynnah u la nang san bad nang khraw ha ka met bad ka mynsiem . U la shong la sah ha ka ri shyiap tad haduh ka sngi ba u la paw paidbah ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah u la san bad u la nang khlain ha ka mynsiem bad u la don ha ki ri khlaw haduh ka sngi ba u la paw ha ki Israel .

en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .
kha: Shaphang ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hapdeng jong ngi , U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ngin bat ïa ka junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba iadei bad kata kaba ma me bad nga ngi la kren shaphang jong nga , ha khmih U Trai un long hapdeng jong me bad nga junom .

en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .
kha: Ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki naduh kaba lai pateng bynriew ter ter lah ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun kiba la kha na ki kin rung ha ka jingiaseng U Trai ha ka pateng kaba lai jong ki .

en: Thus he shewed me : and , behold , the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline , with a plumbline in his hand .
kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai . Ha ka , nga ïohi ïa u ba u dang ïeng marsyndah ka kynroh ïa kaba la tei da ka jingïarap u sawar , bad la don u sawar ha ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la pyni ia nga: bad, ha khmih, U Trai u la ieng halor ka jingkhang ba la shna da ka plumline, bad ka plumline ha ka kti jong u .

en: Neither Herzl nor Savarkar advocated the dispossession of the civil and political rights of minority communities .
kha: U Herzl ne u Savarkar kim shym la kyrshan ban weng noh ia ka hok longbriew manbriew bad ka hok sain hima sima jong ki jaitbynriew rit paid .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh arngut u Herzl ne u Savarkar kim shym la kyrshan ia ka jingpynduh ia ki hok longbriew manbriew bad ka sain pyrthei jong ki jaitbynriew rit paid .

en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria  ; they prophesied in Baal , and caused my people Israel to err .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka pop jong ki nongïathuhlypa ka Samaria ki la kren ha ka kyrteng u Baal bad ki la ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi lypa ha ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka Samaria; ki la iathuhlypa ha Baal , bad ki la pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban bakla .

en: An instructor of the foolish , a teacher of babes , which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law .
kha: u nongbthah ïa kiba bieit , bad u nonghikai ïa ki bym don jingnang jingstad . Phi long thikna ba ha ka Hukum phi don ka thup ba-pura jong ka jingtip bad jong ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonghikai jong kiba bieit , u nonghikai jong ki babes , kiba don ka dur jong ka jingtip bad jong ka jingshisha ha ka ain .

en: Therefore was the wrath of the  Lord  kindled against his people , insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki briew jong u ; u la sngewngiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki briew jong u , khlem da pyrkhat ba u la sngewsih ia la ka jong ka pateng .

en: But I have understanding as well as you  ; I am not inferior to you : yea , who knoweth not such things as these ?
kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingsngewthuh katjuh kum ma me ; na kano kano ka liang ngam long khampoh ïa me ; baroh ki tip ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba me la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingsngewthuh kum ma phi; ngam kham poh ia phi: yea , mano ba tip ia kiei kiei kiba kum kine ?

en: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah , in the fourth month , the ninth day of the month , the city was broken up .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khyndai jong u bnai basaw jong ka snem kaba khatwei ka jinglong syiem u Sedekaïah , ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah la pynpra lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Sedekaiah, ha ka sngi kaba saw, ha ka sngi kaba hynniew jong u bnai .

en: What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .
kha: Aïu phi ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ? un pynjot ïa phi . Ym don mano mano uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi mutdur pyrshah ia U Trai ? un sa pynlong ia ka jingkut kaba pura: ka jingjynjar kan ym kiew ha ka sien kaba ar .

en: And Paul went down , and fell on him , and embracing him said , Trouble not yourselves  ; for his life is in him .
kha: Hynrei u Paul u la leit hiar , bad u la dem pyllup halor jong u bad u la kdup ïa u .  Wat khuslai ,  u la ong ,  u dang im !
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la hiar shapoh bad u la dem ha u bad u la kdup ia u da kaba ong: Wat nym leh ia lade; namar ka jingim jong u ka don ha u .

en: But the other answering rebuked him , saying , Dost not thou fear God , seeing thou art in the same condemnation ?
kha: Uta uwei pat , pynban , u la kynhied ïa uta , da kaba ong  Hato mem tieng ïa U Blei ? Me la ïoh kajuh ka jingpynrem kumba u la ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei pat u la kren bein ia u, u da ong: Hato me tieng ia U Blei haba me don ha kajuh ka jingpynrem ?

en: And within were hooks , an hand broad , fastened round about : and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering .
kha: Ïa ki bnoh , kiba jrong hynñiewphew san milimitar la pynskhem na khap ki miej baroh sawdong . Ïa ka doh baroh ba dei ban ai kum ka jingkñia la buh halor ki miej .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapoh ki don ki hook, ka kti kaba heh, kaba la pynskhem sawdong: bad halor ki miej la don ka doh jong ka jingainguh .

en: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son , saying , Behold , I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother , saying ,
kha: Kumta haba u Iso u la leit ban behmrad , ka la ong ha u Jakob ,  Nga ïohsngew myntan ïa i pa jong phi ba i ong ha u Iso ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebeka u la kren ha u Jakob u khun jong ka, u da ong: Ha khmih nga la iohsngew ia u kpa jong me ba u kren ha u Iso u hynmen jong me da kaba ong:

en: Therefore , do you think it would be right to use a cross in worship ?—Deuteronomy 7 :26  ; 1 Corinthians 10 :14 .
kha: Namarkata , phi tharai ka long mo kaba dei ban pyndonkam ïa ka diengphna ha ka jingmane ?—Deuteronomi 7 :26 ; 1 Korinth 10 :14 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta hato phi tharai ba kan long kaba dei ban pyndonkam ia ka diengphna ha ka jingmane ? ATAONOM 7 :26 ; 1 Korinth 10 :14 .

en: They smote also the tents of cattle , and carried away sheep and camels in abundance , and returned to Jerusalem .
kha: Ki tur ïaleh ruh ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki katto katne ki nongaplangbrot , ki kurup ïa shibun ki langbrot bad ki ut . Nangta ki leit phai sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ruh ia ki ïingjaiñ jong ki masi , bad ki la rah noh ïa ki langbrot bad ki kulai ha ka jingbun , bad ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

en: Happy are thy men , and happy are these thy servants , which stand continually before thee , and hear thy wisdom .
kha: Katno ki long kiba donbok ki rangbah kiba shakri ïa phi , kiba don borabor ha khmat jong phi bad kiba ïohlad ban ïohsngew ïa ki kyntien jingstad jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong me ki long kiba kmen bad ki long kiba kmen ia kine ki shakri jong me kiba ieng beit ha khmat jong me bad ki iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong me .

en: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .
kha: Hynrei haba u shem ba ka samla ka long kaba i-ieit kat haduh ba u la ïapmat ïa ka , bad u la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewieit na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mynsiem jong u ka la long ha ka Dinan ka khun u Jakob, bad u la ieit ia ka dam , bad u la kren sngewbha ia ka dam .

en: For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
kha: naba ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh kam don jingmut ei ei katba u briew uba ai ïa ka u dang im ; ka treikam tang hadien ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka test ka long kaba donbor hadien ba ki briew ki la iap: lym kumta kam don bor satia katba u nongleh kam sniew u dang im .

en: These are the generations of Shem : Shem was an hundred years old , and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood :
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Shem . Ar snem hadien ka jingshlei um , haba u Shem u la dap shispah snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Arpakhshad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki pateng jong u Shem: U Shem u la dap shispah snem ka rta, bad u la kha ia u Arphaxad ar snem hadien ka jingshlei um:

en: But the midwives feared God , and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them , but saved the men children alive .
kha: Hynrei kita ki nongpynkha khun ki dei kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei ; kumta kim shym kohnguh ïa u , hynrei ki shah ba ki khun shynrang kin im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nongkha khun ki la tieng ia U Blei bad kim shym la leh kumba u syiem Ijipt u la hukum ia ki , hynrei ki la pynim ia ki khun shynrang .

en: But the thing displeased Samuel , when they said , Give us a king to judge us . And Samuel prayed unto the  Lord .
kha: U Samuel u sngewsih ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki ban ïoh syiem ; kumta u duwai ha U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kata ka long kaba sngewsih ia u Samuel haba ki la ong: Ai ia ngi ia u syiem ban bishar ia ngi . U Samuel u la duwai ha U Trai .

en: And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .
kha: U Solomon u la shongkurim hynñiewspah ngut ki khun syiem kynthei bad laispah ngut ruh ki tnga kliar .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don hynriew spah ngut ki tnga, ki khun syiem bad lai spah ngut ki tnga: bad ki tnga jong u ki la pynphai noh ia ka dohnud jong u .

en: But to which of the angels said he at any time , Sit on my right hand , until I make thine enemies thy footstool ?
kha: U Blei um ju ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u :  Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga haduh ba ngan da pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong me ba kin long kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha uno na ki angel u la ong ha kano kano ka por , To shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga , haduh ba ngan da pynlong ia ki nongshun jong me ha ka kjat jong me ?

en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days : and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .
kha: Kumta ka Miriam ka shah khang shabar ka jaka sher dara hynñiew sngi , bad kita ki briew kim shym la mihnoh tad ynda la wan ïalam pat ïa ka shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Miriam ka la shah khang na ka shnong hynriew sngi: bad ki briew kim shym la leit jingleit haduh ba la wanrah biang ia ka Miriam .

en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants , even the daughter of my dispersed , shall bring mine offering .
kha: Wat na ka Sudan kaba sha jngai , ki briew jong nga kiba la sakma kin wallam ki jingainguh sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na shabar ki wah Ethiopia ki nongkyrshan jong nga, wat ka khun jong nga kaba la jah rngai, kin wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong nga .

en: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .
kha: Te u Soitan u la wan ha U bad u la ong ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa kine ki maw ban kylla kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpynshoi u la wan sha u , u la ong: Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ba kine ki maw kin long kpu .

en: Maharashtra government formation : Congress , NCP will decide together , says Sharad Pawar on supporting Shiv Sena
kha: Ka jingthaw sorkar ha Maharashtra : Ka Congress bad ka NCP kin ia rai lang ong u Sharad Pawar halor ka jingkyrshan ia u Shiv Sena .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingmih jong ka sorkar Maharashtra: Ka Congress , ka NCP kan rai lang , ong u Sharad Pawar halor ka jingkyrshan ia ka Shiv Sena .

en: Neither repented they of their murders , nor of their sorceries , nor of their fornication , nor of their thefts .
kha: Lymne kim shym la kylla-kaba-mut na ki jingpynïap briew jong ki , ki kam myntor jong ki , ki kam awria bajakhlia , ne ka kam tuh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la kylla bamut na ki jingpyniap briew jong ki, ne na ki jingleh jadu jong ki, ne na ka jingleh be-ijot jong ki, ne na ki jingtuh jong ki .

en: And when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto his disciples , Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners ?
kha: Katto katne ki Pharisi ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei u nonghikai jong phi u ïabam lem bad kiba kum kine ki briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la iohi ia ka, ki la ong ha ki synran jong u, Balei u Kynrad jong phi bad ki nongpop ?

en: Look , 18 , 000 villages of the country had been living in the 18th century even 70 years after the independence .
kha: Peit , 18 000 tylli ki shnong jong ka ri ki la im ha ka spah snem kaba 18 wat hadien 70 snem ba la ioh ia ka jinglaitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit 18 000 tylli ki shnong jong ka ri ki la im ha ka spah snem kaba 18 wat hadien ka jinglaitluid .

en: If ye endure chastening , God dealeth with you as with sons  ; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not ?
kha: To ïaishah ïa kaei kaba phi la shahshitom namar ka jingsneng sympat u kpa ; ka jingshahshitom jong phi ka pynpaw ba U Blei u ñiew ïa phi kum ki khun jong u . Hato la ju don ne em u khun u bym ju shah pynshitom ha la u kpa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi shah ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein , U Blei u iadei bad phi kum bad ki khun shynrang ; namar u khun u long uei u khun uba u kpa um shah pynshitom ?

en: Yea , I attended unto you , and , behold , there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :
kha: Nga la shahshkor bha bad shem ba phi la bakla ; phim shym lah ban pynduh nia ïa kaei kaba u Job u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , nga la leit sha phi bad, ha khmih, ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la pynngeit ia u Job ne uba la jubab ia ki ktien jong u:

en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim  ;
kha: Ka jaka sawdong jong ka Tappuah ka dei jong ka jait Manasseh , hynrei ka shnong Tappuah , ha khappud , ka dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Manasseh u don ka ri Tappuah : hynrei u Tappuah ha u pud u sam jong u Manasseh u dei u jong ki khun Ephraim ; .

en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .
kha: ( Naba ki Saddusi ki ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap bad ba ym don ki angel lane ki mynsiem ; hynrei ki Pharisi ki ngeit ïa kine baroh lai tylli . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Sadusi ki ong ba ym don ka jingmihpat, lymne u angel ne u mynsiem: hynrei ki Pharisi ki phla ia baroh ar .

en: Then Peter took him , and began to rebuke him , saying , Be it far from thee , Lord : this shall not be unto thee .
kha: U Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa U sharud bad u la sdang ban mai ïa u ,  U Blei un ym shah ïa kata , ko Trai !  u la ong .  Kata kan ym jia da lei lei ha me !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la shim ia u, bad u la sdang ban pynrem ia u, u da ong: To long kiba jngai na me, ko Trai: kane kan ym long ha me .

en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,
kha: U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit haba ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pisa ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Simon u la iohi ia kata lyngba ka jingthiah ia ki kti jong ki apostol la ai ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la tyrwa pisa ia ki .

en: One of themselves , even a prophet of their own , said , The Cretans are alway liars , evil beasts , slow bellies .
kha: Dei u nong Krit hi , uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , uba la kren ïa ka jingshisha mynba u la ong ,  Ki nong Krit ki long borabor kiba lamler , ki riewkhlaw bymman , bad ki jlawnguid bajaipdeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki hi, wat u nongiathuhlypa jong ki hi, u la ong , Ki Kreta ki long ki nonglamler baroh , ki mrad kiba sniew , ki kpoh kiba slem .

en: If any man defile the temple of God , him shall God destroy ; for the temple of God is holy , which temple ye are .
kha: Te lada uno uno u pynjot ïa ka templ jong U Blei , U Blei un pynjot ïa u . Naba ka templ jong U Blei ka long kaba khuid , bad phi hi phi long ka templ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pynjakhlia ia ka tempi U Blei , ia u U Blei un pynjot ia u; namar ka tempi U Blei ka long kaba khuid .

en: There were also that said , We have borrowed money for the king s tribute , and that upon our lands and vineyards .
kha: Sa kiwei ki ong ,  Ngi hap ban pan pisa kylliang ban siew ïa ka khajna syiem halor ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ruh kiba ong , Ngi la shim ram na ka bynta ka khajna jong u syiem , bad kata ha ki jaka bad ki kper sohjew jong ngi .

en: With three rows of great stones , and a row of new timber : and let the expenses be given out of the king s house :
kha: Ïa ki kynroh dei ban tei da shi syrtap ka dieng halor man ki lai syrtap ki maw . Ïa baroh ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban siew na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki lai tylli ki lain ki maw kiba heh , bad ka lain jong ki dieng thymmai: bad ai ba ia ki jinglut jingsep yn ai na ka iing syiem:

en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .
kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la pynlut katto katne por ha Antiokh , bad ryngkat lem bad bun kiwei pat , ki la hikai bad ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul ruh bad u Barnabas ki la bteng ha Antiok , da kaba hikai bad ialap ia ka ktien U Trai , ryngkat bad kiwei pat ruh .

en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .
kha: Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wan na Nasareth kaba ha ka probins jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi, ba U Jisu u la wan na Nazareth Galilaia bad u la shah pynbaptis ha u Ioannis ha Jordan .

en: Accounting that God was able to raise him up , even from the dead  ; from whence also he received him in a figure .
kha: U Abraham u da kheiñ ba U Blei u lah ban pynmihpat ïa u Isaak na ka jingïap — bad kum ban shu ong , u Abraham u la ïohpdiang pat ïa u Isaak na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba khein ba U Blei u la lah ban pynmih ia u , wat na kiba iap ; na kaba u la pdiang ia u ha ka dur .

en: And he gave her his hand , and lifted her up , and when he had called the saints and widows , presented her alive .
kha: U Petros u la kner ïa la ki kti , bad u la ïarap pynkhie ïa ka . Nangta u la khot ïa ki parabangeit baroh , kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei , u la aiti ïa ka ha ki , ka briew kaba la im pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai ia ka kti jong u, bad u la rah ia ka, bad haba u la khot ia ki riewkhuid bad ki riewkynthei , u la pyni ia ka ba ka dang im .

en: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .
kha: Kumta u Joseph u ïap ha Ijipt haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta . Ki kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka met jong u , bad hangta ha Ijipt ki buh ïa u ha ka synduk ïapbriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joseph u la iap, da kaba dap shispah snem: bad ki la pynkhuid ia u, bad la buh ia u ha ka synduk ha Ijipt .

en: And it came to pass , as they were much perplexed thereabout , behold , two men stood by them in shining garments :
kha: Ki la ïeng hangta , ki la shaïong shaphang kane , haba kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ha ki jaiñ kiba phyrnai eh ki la ïeng hajan jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, kumba ki la sngew lyngngoh shibun hangta, ha khmih, arngut ki briew ki la ieng hajan jong ki da ki jain kiba rben:

en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jong u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohkynti jong u , Katba ki Israel kin ïai jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Edom un long u trai , u Seir ruh un long u trai na ka bynta ki nongshun jong u bad ki Israel kin leh da ka jingshlur .

en: And Samson said unto them , Though ye have done this , yet will I be avenged of you , and after that I will cease .
kha: U Samson u ong ïa ki ,  Te haduh katne pleng phi leh ! Nga smai ba ngan ym shongthait tad haduh ba ngan ïoh pynhiarkput ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong ha ki, Wat la phi la leh ia kane, hynrei ngan sa shah pynrem na phi, bad hadien kata ngan sangeh noh .

en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :
kha: To kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ïathuh ha u ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long u nongshun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia me ko Gog , u rangbah duh jong u Meshe bad u Tubal:

en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests , the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness .
kha: bad u Annas bad u Kaïaphas ki la long ki rangbah lyngdoh . Ha kata ka por , ka ktien jong U Blei ka la wan ha u Ïoannis u khun jong u Sekharaïah , ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Anna bad u Kaiaphas ki long ki rangbah lyngdoh , ka ktien U Blei ka la wan ha u Ioannis u khun u Sakhia ha ka ri khlaw .

en: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee , and set darkness upon thy land , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan pynlip ïa baroh ki jingshai jong ka bneng , bad ngan pyndum ngaiñ ïa ka pyrthei jong me ha ka jingdum , ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki jingshai ba shai jong ka bneng ngan pyndum ia me , bad ngan buh ia ka jingdum ha ka ri jong me , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,
kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la jia la slem bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , nga long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat kum ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa: namar nga long U Blei , bad ym don shuh shuh; nga long U Blei , bad ym don kum ma nga .

en: But I say unto you , That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment , than for thee .
kha: Pha lah ban sngewthikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa pha !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba kan kham shah ia ka ri Sodom ha ka sngi bishar ban ia me .

en: And tookest thy broidered garments , and coveredst them : and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them .
kha: Pha la shim ïa ki jaiñ ba la suh syntiew kiba nga lah ai ha pha bad pha buh ïa ki halor ki durblei , bad pha ainguh ïa ki durblei da ka umphniang Olib bad ka jingiwbih kaba nga la lah ai ha pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to shim ia ki jain ba la tyrkhong jong me, bad me la tap ia ki: bad me la buh ia ka umphniang jong nga bad ka jingiwbih jong nga ha khmat jong ki .

en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .
kha: U syiem Ahab , u la hiar sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u jop thiaw ïa ki nong Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la mih noh bad u la shoh ia ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar bad u la pyniap ia ki Syria da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw .

en: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .
kha: Uno uno uba mon ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , un tip la kaei kaba nga hikai ka wan na U Blei ne la nga kren ha ka bor jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew un leh ia ka mon jong u , un tip ia ka jinghikai , la ka long na U Blei ne la nga kren shaphang lade .

en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivah ?
kha: Shano ki syiem jong ki nongbah Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena , bad Ibbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno u syiem u Hamath bad u syiem u Arpad bad u syiem ka shnong Sepharvaim u Hena bad u Ivah ?

en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
kha: Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la tymmen bha haba u la don shispah laiphew snem , u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehoiada u la tymmen , bad u la dap da ki sngi haba u la iap ; shispah laiphew snem ka rta u la iap .

en: And it came to pass , that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh s army ,
kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka la kynran dien noh na Jerusalem namar ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba ka kynhun shipai jong ki Khaldi ka la shah pynpra noh na Jerusalem namar ka jingtieng ia ka kynhun shipai jong u Pharaoh .

en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? bad pynhiarkput ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan ym leit jngoh ia kine kiei kiei ? ong U Trai : bad hato ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym shah pynshitom bein ha ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?

en: Saying , Sir , we remember that that deceiver said , while he was yet alive ,  After three days I will rise again .
kha: bad ki la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , ngi kynmaw ba katba uta u nongshukor u dang im u la ong , ‘ Yn sa pynmihpat ïa nga hadien lai sngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Sir , ngi kynmaw ba uta u nongleh thok u la ong , katba u dang im , Hadien lai sngi ngan sa kiew biang .

en: For he that hath , to him shall be given : and he that hath not , from him shall be taken even that which he hath .
kha: Ïa u briew uba don ei ei yn ai shuh , bad na u briew u bym don ei ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kata kaba khyndiat kaba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ia uta uba don , ha u yn ai: bad ia uta u bym don , na u yn shim noh wat ia kata kaba u don .

en: But without thy mind would I do nothing  ; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity , but willingly .
kha: Wat la katta , ngam kwah ban pynbor ïa me ban ïarap ïa nga ; pynban , ngan jin da la kwah ba men leh ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha jong me hi . Te ngan ym leh ïa kano kano lymda me mynjur .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khlem ka jingmut jong me ngan ym leh ei ei shuh ba ka jingmyntoi jong me kan ym long kumba ka long kaba donkam, hynrei da ka mon sngewbha .

en: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart , and of a good conscience , and of faith unfeigned :
kha: Ka jingthmu jong kane ka hukum ka long ban pynkhih ïa kata ka jingieit kaba wan na ka dohnud kaba sngur , ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , bad ka jingngeit bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingkut jong ka hukum ka long ka jingai sngewbha na ka dohnud kaba khuid, bad ka jingsngewbha kaba bha, bad ka jingngeit kaba khlem thok:

en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
kha: Phin sa shem haba phin leit shadien ka kamra ban rieh ,  U Mikaïah u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Ha kata ka sngi, haba me leit shapoh ka kamra kaba shapoh ban buhrieh ia lade .

en: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .
kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ban ktien biang ,  Ngim shah !  Bad ki la wan mih bad ka kynhun ïapom kaba khlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Wat iaid lyngba . U Edom u la mih pyrshah ia u da ki briew kiba bun bad da ka kti kaba khlain .

en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .
kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki briew ,  Ban long uba stad , phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ban shemphang , phi dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u briew u la ong: Ha khmih, ka jingtieng ia U Trai, kata ka long ka jingstad ; bad ban phet noh na kaba sniew ka long ka jingsngewthuh .

en: There failed not ought of any good thing which the  Lord  had spoken unto the house of Israel  ; all came to pass .
kha: U  Trai  u la bat ïa kawei pa kawei na ki jingkular kiba u la pynlong ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym shym la duna ei ei kaba bha kaba U Trai u la kren ha ka iing Israel baroh ki la jia .

en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God , who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit .
kha: U Blei u long uta uba la pynkhreh ïa ngi na ka bynta kane ka jingpynkylla dur , bad u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u kum ka jingbahkhlieh ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uta uba la leh ia ngi na ka bynta kajuh ka jinglong u long U Blei , uba ruh u la ai ha ngi ia ka jingkwah jong U Mynsiem .

en: And Pilate wrote a title , and put it on the cross . And the writing was , JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS .
kha: U Pilat u la thoh ïa ka jingthoh bad la phah wah halor ka diengphna .  U Jisu u nong Nasareth , U Syiem ki Jiw  , ka long kaei kaba u la thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la thoh ia ka kyrteng , bad u la buh ia ka ha ka diengphna . Bad ka jingthoh ka long , U JISU NA KA JINGPYNBNA .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe unto the foolish prophets , that follow their own spirit , and have seen nothing !
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba-bieit ki long kiba la tim ! Ki ai jaka ïa la ki jong ki jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ki thaw ïa la ki jong ki jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Ka long kaba bieit ia ki nongiathuhlypa kiba bieit , kiba bud ia la ka jong ka mynsiem bad kim shym la iohi ei ei !

en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt ban long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la wanrah ia phi na ka ri Ijipt: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf : in the morning he shall devour the prey , and at night he shall divide the spoil .
kha: U Benjamin u long kum u suri uba jlawnguid , Mynstep bad janmiet u pynïap bad u bam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benjamin un sa shah rong noh kum u blang: ha ka por mynstep un bam ia ka jingbam , bad ha ka por miet un phiah ia ka jingjot .

en: And they killed the passover , and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands , and the Levites flayed them .
kha: Hadien ba la pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , ki Lebi ki khoh snieh ïa ki , bad ki lyngdoh ki synreit snam ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyniap ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba la khleh lang bad ki lyngdoh ki la theh ia ka snam na ki kti jong ki bad ki Lebi ki la pynkhih ia ki .

en: Why not accept this invitation to attend our congregation’s next meeting and experience these things for yourself ?
kha: Ngi khot sngewbha ïa phi ban wan sha ka jingïalang jong ngi , phin sa mad hi dalade ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ym pdiang ia kane ka jingkhot ban leit sha ka jingialang jong ngi kaba hadien bad ban mad ia kine kiei kiei na ka bynta lade ?

en: They are of those that rebel against the light  ; they know not the ways thereof , nor abide in the paths thereof .
kha: Ki don ki briew kiba kyntait ïa ka jingshai ; kim sngewthuh ïa ka lane ki leit sha kaba ka ïalam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long na kito kiba leh pyrshah ia ka jingshai ; kim tip ia ki lynti jong ka , lymne ki iaineh ha ki lynti jong ka .

en: God also told Noah to build a huge boat , called an ark , and to take into it his family and every sort of animal .
kha: U Blei u la ong ruh ha u Noah ban thaw ïa ka ïinglieng kaba heh , bad ban wallam ïa la ka ïing ka sem bad ki mrad ba laiphew jait hapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei ruh u la ong ia u Noah ban tei ia ka lieng kaba heh bha, kaba la khot ka lieng , bad ban shim ha ka iing ka sem jong u bad ki mrad baroh .

en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khun jong u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen rangbah duh , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka sngi ha kaba ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong u ki dang bam bad dih wain ha iing u hynmen rangbah jong ki:

en: And if ye shall say , What shall we eat the seventh year ? behold , we shall not sow , nor gather in our increase :
kha: Hynrei lah ban don uba kylli hato yn ïoh bam da-ei ha kata ka snem kaba hynñiew , lada ym lah ban bet ban thung lane ban ot ban lum ïa ki soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi ong , Kaei kaba ngin bam ia ka snem kaba hynriew ? ha khmih ngin ym bet ne lum ha ka jingroi jong ngi:

en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing : and a wise man s heart discerneth both time and judgment .
kha: Katba phi dang kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , phi don ha ka jingshngain , bad u briew uba stad u tip kumno bad lano ban leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sumar ia ka hukum un ym sngew ei ei kaba sniew: bad u briew uba stad u sngewthuh ia ka por bad ka jingbishar .

en: Giving thanks unto the Father , which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light :
kha: Ai ba yn pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ka jingkhlaiñ baroh kaba wan na ka bor badonburom jong u , khnang ba phi lah ban shah ïa kiei kiei baroh da ka jingïaishah . Bad da ka jingkmen to ainguh ïa U Kpa , uba la pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ban ïoh ïa la ka bynta na kaei kaba U Blei u la tyngkai na ka bynta ki briew jong u ha ka hima ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewnguh ia U Kpa uba la pynlong ia ngi ban iakynduh ban long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka pateng jong ki riewkhuid ha ka jingshai:

en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;
kha: U ong ,  Namar kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa ki um bajai jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha khmat jong u syiem Resin bad u syiem Pekah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat ba une u briew u kyntait ia ki um Shiloah kiba iaid jem jai, bad ki kmen ha u Rezin bad u khun u Relia;

en: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka ,  Ko ka briew , pha la lait phar na ka jingpang jong pha !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la iohi ia ka, u la khot ia ka ha u bad u la ong ha ka, Ko kynthei, me la pyllait na ka jingbym lah kha khun jong me .

en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .
kha: Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , wat u briew u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta uba stad un nang na kata kaba la hikai ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba la pynshitom ia u nonglehkai, la pynlong stad ia uba suk: bad haba la hikai ia uba stad , u ioh ia ka jingtip .

en: And let it be , when these signs are come unto thee , that thou do as occasion serve thee  ; for God is with thee .
kha: Haba kine kiei kiei kin jia , leh ïa kaba U Blei u ïalam ïa me ban leh .
