translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kin long, haba kine ki dak kin wan ha me, ba me leh kum ka por ba me shakri ia me; namar U Blei U don ryngkat bad me .

en: For if any be a hearer of the word , and not a doer , he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass :
kha: Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa ka ktien hynrei u bym pyntreikam ïa ka u long kum u briew uba peit ha ka ïitkhmih bad ïohi ïa lade kumba u long .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada uno uno u long u nongsngap ia ka ktien , bad u nongleh , u long kum u briew uba peit ia ka khmat ba kynja met jong u ha ka glass:

en: And the damsel s father shall say unto the elders , I gave my daughter unto this man to wife , and he hateth her  ;
kha: U kpa jong kata ka briew un ong ha ki , ‘ Nga la ai ïa la ka khun ha une u briew ban long ka tnga jong u , bad mynta um mon shuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong ka dam un ong ha ki rangbah , nga la ai ia ka khun jong nga ha une u briew ha ka tnga bad u shun ia ka;

en: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers  ; yea , upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city :
kha: bad ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ ki mih ha ka ri ki briew jong nga . To ïam na ka bynta ki ïing baroh ha kaba ki briew ki la ju long kiba kmen bad ka nongbah kaba la ju dap da ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka ri jong ki briew jong nga kin wan ki thliew bad ki nar ; yea , ha ki iing jingkmen baroh ha ka nongbah kaba kmen:

en: And they did eat , and were all filled : and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets .
kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang , bad ki synran ki la lum khat-ar tukri na kaei kaba la sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bam , bad baroh ki la dap: bad la shim ia ki lyngkhot lyngkhai kiba sah ha ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot lyngkhai .

en: And Sarah my master s wife bare a son to my master when she was old : and unto him hath he given all that he hath .
kha: Ka Sarah , ka tnga u kynrad jong nga , ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u haba ka la tymmen , bad u kynrad jong nga u la ai lut ha u kat ïa kaba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong u kynrad jong nga ka la kha khun shynrang ha u kynrad jong nga haba ka la tymmen: bad ha u u la ai lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

en: And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba dei peit ïa ki nongtrei ba la pynbor ban trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingtei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki rangbah jong u syiem Solomon, wat arspah sanphew snem, kiba synshar ia ki briew .

en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun u Zebulun kat kum ki longiing jong ki , kine ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: How that he was caught up into paradise , and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .
kha: Nga ong biang , nga tip ba ïa une u briew la rong noh sha ka Paradais (sa shisien , ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne ka la long tang ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip) , bad hangta u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ym lah ban buh ha ki kyntien , kiei kiei kiba ki rmiang shyntur briew kim lah ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ba u la shah kem ha ka paradais , bad u la iohsngew ia ki ktien ki bym lah ban kren , kiba ym long katkum ka ain ia u briew ban kren .

en: If thou sinnest , what doest thou against him ? or if thy transgressions be multiplied , what doest thou unto him ?
kha: Lada me leh pop , kata kam ktah ei ei ïa U Blei . Lada bunsien me leh bakla , hato kata ka ktah ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me leh pop , kaei kaba me leh pyrshah ia u ? lane lada ki jingpynkhein jong me ki nang bun , kaei kaba me leh ia u ?

en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ki Israel . To khie , A  Trai  , bad wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ong .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap mynta ia kaei kaba U Trai u ong; To ialeh pyrshah ia me ha khmat ki lum bad ai ba ki lum kin iohsngew ia ka sur jong me .

en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
kha: Namar wat U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ba un shah shakri ; u la wan ban shakri bad ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pynim ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat u Khun u briew ruh um shym la wan sha ka jingshakri sha u, hynrei ban shakri, bad ban ai ia ka jingim jong u ka jingsiew bai lutksan na ka bynta kiba bun .

en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham suk ia u kulai ban iaid lyngba ka khmat jong ka nar , ban ia u briew uba riewspah ban rung shapoh ka hima U Blei .

en: Therefore now , O  Lord  , take , I beseech thee , my life from me  ; for it is better for me to die than to live .
kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , ai ba ngan ïap noh . Ka kham bha ïa nga ban ïap ban ïa ka ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta ko Trai , to shim, nga kyrpad ia me, ka jingim jong nga na nga ; namar ka kham bha ia nga ban iap ban ia kaba im .

en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ruh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki briew kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbha jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa baroh kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia kane ka pharshi ha ki katto katne kiba shaniah ha lade ba ki long kiba hok, bad ki la lehbein ia kiwei:

en: And I beseech you , brethren , suffer the word of exhortation : for I have written a letter unto you in few words .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban shahshkor bha ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynshlur ; naba kane ka shithi kaba nga la thoh sha phi kam da long kaba jrong eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit, to shah ia ka ktien jong ka jingkyntu: namar nga la thoh shithi sha phi tang khyndiat kyntien .

en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness , but is in danger of eternal damnation :
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ong kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map lano lano ruh , namar u la leh ïa ka pop bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba kren bein ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid um ju map , hynrei u don ha ka jingma jong ka jingpynrem bymjukut:

en: Six days thou shalt work , but on the seventh day thou shalt rest : in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest .
kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei wat trei ei ei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , wat la ka long ha ka aïom lur ne ka aïom ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi men trei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynriew men shongthait: ha ka por bam bad ha ka por ot men shongthait .

en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain  ; and ye say , that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen nong Samaria jong nga ki la ïamane ïa U Blei halor une u lum , hynrei phi ki Jiw phi ong ba ka Jerusalem ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngi dei ban mane ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la mane ha une u lum ; bad phi ong , ba ha Jerusalem ka long ka jaka ha kaba ki briew ki dei ban mane .

en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following  ; for it shall be very grievous .
kha: Ïa ka por ka jingpahuh yn klet lut baroh , namar ka  nemsniew ka ban bud kan long kaba shyrkhei katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbun kan ym paw ha ka ri namar kata ka jingkyrduh kaba bud ia ka ; namar kan long kaba sngewsih shibun .

en: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost , and to us , to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things  ;
kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ma ngi , ngi la ïamynjur ban ym buh kano kano ka jingkit halor jong phi nalor kine ki rukom kiba donkam :
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la long kumba ka long kaba bha ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ia ngi, ban buh ia phi ia ka jingkit kaba kham heh ban ia kine kiei kiei kiba donkam;

en: And this is the confidence that we have in him , that , if we ask any thing according to his will , he heareth us :
kha: Ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei , namar ngi sngewskhem ba u ïohsngew ïa ngi lada ngi kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta kano kano kaba long kat kum ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingshaniah kaba ngi don ha u, ba lada ngi kylli ei ei kat kum ka mon jong u , u iohsngew ia ngi:

en: This thou knowest , that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me ; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes .
kha: Me tip ba uwei pa uwei uba don ha ka probins    jong ka Asia , ba kynthup ïa u Phygelos bad u Hermogenes , ki la iehnoh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane me tip , ba baroh kiba don ha Asia kin shah pynphai noh na nga ; na kiba ki long u Phigellus bad u Herogen .

en: We will go three days  journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the  Lord  our God , as he shall command us .
kha: Ngi dei ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , kumba u la hukum ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin leit lai sngi sha ri khlaw , bad ngin knia ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi kumba un hukum ia ngi .

en: But when he saw the wind boisterous , he was afraid  ; and beginning to sink , he cried , saying , Lord , save me .
kha: Hynrei haba u la ïohi ïa ka lyer kaba khlaiñ , u la sheptieng bad u la sdang ban ngam shapoh um .  To pynim ïa nga , A Trai !  u la pyrta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u la iohi ia ka Iyer kaba rkhie bein, u la tieng; bad u la sdang ban ngam jyllop, u la pyrta, u da ong: Ko Trai, to pynim ia nga .

en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
kha: Namar ba phi long ki briew jong U Blei , kam long kaba dei wat ban ïakren hapdeng jong phi ïa kino kino ki kam awria ne ki kam jakhlia ne ki kam kwah lalot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingleh be-ijot , bad ka jingbymkhuid baroh , ne ka jingkwah brai , wat ai ba kan ym shah jer kyrteng tang shisien hapdeng jong phi , kumba ka long kaba la buh lypa ia ki riewkhuid ; .

en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim : For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction .
kha: U ong ruh ,  U Blei u la ai khun ïa nga ha ka ri ba nga shah jynjar  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u khun ba ar , u Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng kaba ar ka la khot u Ephraim: Namar U Blei u la pynlong ia nga ban long uba seisoh ha ka ri jong ka jingjynjar jong nga .

en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate , ten cubits  ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits .
kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la thew sa ïa ka pyngkiang jong ka lynti ïaid kaba ha ka khyrdop . Ka la long baroh hynriew mitar shiteng bad ka jaka ba lait hapdeng ki khyrdop kiba rynghang ka la long san mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thew ia ka jingjylliew jong ka khyrdop, shiphew cubit bad ka jingjrong jong ka khyrdop , shiphew cubit .

en: And them that are turned back from the  Lord   ; and those that have not sought the  Lord  , nor enquired for him .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa kito kiba la phai lyndet bad ki bym bud shuh ïa nga , kito ki bym shym wan sha nga , lane kylli na nga ban kdew lynti ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la kylla noh na U Trai ; bad kito ki bym shym la wad ia U Trai , lymne ki bym shym la kylli na ka bynta jong u .

en: And he saith unto them ,  Whosoever shall put away his wife , and marry another , committeth adultery against her .
kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  U briew uba pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew , u klim pyrshah ïa la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Uno uno uba weng noh ia ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ia kawei pat , u leh be-ijot ia ka .

en: And supper being ended , the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , to betray him  ;
kha: U Jisu bad la ki synran ki dang ïabam jingbam miet . U Ksuid u la bsuh lypa ha ka dohnud jong u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot , ka jingpyrkhat ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbam janmiet ka la kut noh, u ksuid u la buh mynta ha ka dohnud u Judas Isarot , u khun u Simon , ban pyndem ia u;

en: If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .
kha: Nga long uba lui lui , bad uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jong nga ki pynsngewrem , bad baroh kaba nga ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga pynshisha ia lade, ka shyntur jong nga hi kan pynrem ia nga: lada nga ong , nga long uba janai , kan pynshisha ruh ia nga uba bakla .

en: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers , into the hand of the Assyrians , upon whom she doted .
kha: Te nga aiti ïa ka sha ki long leh-ieit jong ka , ki Assyria ïa kiba ka thrang palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong ki nongieit jong ka, ha ka kti jong ki nong Assyria kiba ka la sngewtynnad .

en: They stoop , they bow down together  ; they could not deliver the burden , but themselves are gone into captivity .
kha: Ki bleithaw kim lah ban pynim ïa lade ; ïa ki la kurup bad la rah noh bak . Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ki blei ka Babilon !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngap jar, ki dem khrup lang; kim lah ban pynpoi ia ka jingkit , hynrei ma ki hi ki la leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: For as by one man s disobedience many were made sinners , so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous .
kha: Bad kumba ïa baroh ki briew la pynlong ki nongpop na ka daw jong ka jingbymkohnguh jong uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom yn pynïasuk ïa ki baroh bad U Blei na ka daw jong ka jingkohnguh jong uwei u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba da ka jingbym kohnguh jong uwei u briew bun ki la kylla long ki nongpop , kumta da ka jingsngap jar jong uwei yn pynlong hok ia kiba bun .

en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kiba khwan myntoi bad kiba kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ban bud ïa kaei ka bym dei ; halor jong ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kito kiba ialeh pyrshah bad kim kohnguh ia ka jingshisha , hynrei ki kohnguh ia ka jingbymhok , ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar .

en: And she said , These six measures of barley gave he me  ; for he said to me , Go not empty unto thy mother in law .
kha: Ka bynrap ,  U ong ïa nga ba ngam dei ban wan phai thylli sha phi , kumta u ai ïa nga ïa une u barli baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Kine ki hynriew tylli ki barli ki la ai ia nga; namar u la ong ia nga: Wat leit thylli ha ka kmie tymmen jong me .

en: And they made two ouches of gold , and two gold rings  ; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate .
kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki shrong ksiar bad ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar , bad ki pyndait ïa kita ki kyrwoh ar tylli ha ki dong kiba shaneng jong ka jingdeng shadem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar bad ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar; bad ki la buh ia ki ar tylli ki ryntieh ha ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka shyntur .

en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
kha: U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , bad ïa u Molekh u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Solomon u la leit bud ia ka blei jong ki Sidonian bad hadien u Milcom ka jinglehrain jong ki Ammon .

en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .
kha: Haba nga la sngew kumba ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad ha ka Templ bakhuid jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka mynsiem jong nga ka la lyngngoh hapoh jong nga nga kynmaw ia U Trai : bad ka jingduwai jong nga ka la wan rung sha me, shapoh ka tempi bakhuid jong me .

en: Whose end is destruction , whose god is their belly , and whose glory is in their shame , who mind earthly things .
kha: Ka jingkut jong ki kan long ha dujok , namar u blei jong ki u long ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong ki . Ki sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban sngewlehrain , bad ki pyrkhat tang ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki jong kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkut jong u ka long ka jingpynjot , uba u blei jong u u long ka kpoh jong ki , bad uba ka burom jong u ka don ha ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki , kiba pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba don ha ka pyrthei .

en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .
kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Phi dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng burom ïa U  Trai  , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh ia ki da kaba ong , Kumta phin leh ha ka jingtieng ia U Trai, da ka jingngeit bad da ka dohnud kaba janai .

en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .
kha: Ha shuwa ba u syiem jong ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa pyrshah ia ki Philistia , shuwa ba uta u Pharaoh un shoh ia ka Gaza .

en: And his master saw that the  Lord  was with him , and that the  Lord  made all that he did to prosper in his hand .
kha: U la shong la sah ha ka ïing jong u nong Ijipt uba long u kynrad jong u , uba la ïohi ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad ba u la pynmanbha ïa u ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u u la iohi ba U Trai u don ryngkat bad u bad ba U Trai u la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ban roi ha ka kti jong u .

en: That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?
kha: Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaba heh . Ngin shem ïa u briew uba duk u bym lah siew ïa ki ram jong u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki juti , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngin thied ia kiba duk na ka bynta ka rupa , bad kiba donkam na ka bynta ka juti ; yea , bad die ia ki jaboh jong u kew ?

en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,
kha: Nangta u kynrad jong uta u shakri un wan pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong uta u shakri un wan ha ka sngi ba um peit ia u , bad ha ka shi kynta kaba um tip , .

en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,
kha: U Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u ki la leit sha ka jaka long dorbar ha ka khyrdop shnong bad ki kren ha la ki para shnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Hamor bad u khun jong u u la wan sha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong jong ki bad ki la iakynduh bad ki briew jong ka shnong jong ki da kaba ong:

en: They helped to create the Right to Dance movementa non violent protest held in San Diego and later in Los Angeles .
kha: Ki la iarap ban thaw ia ka Hok ban Shad ka jingiakhih kaba khlem thombor kaba la pynlong ha San Diego bad hadien ha Los Angeles .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iarap ban thaw ia ka Hok ban shad khlem da leh donbor kaba la pynlong ha San Diego bad hadien ha Los Angeles .

en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .
kha: Kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wan shuwa , hynrei kaba kynja doh , bad nangta kaba kynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kata kam shym la long nyngkong kaba kynja mynsiem, hynrei kata kaba long tynrai; bad hadien kata kaba kynja mynsiem .

en: For , behold , I create new heavens and a new earth : and the former shall not be remembered , nor come into mind .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan thaw ïa ka khyndew bathymmai bad ïa ki bneng bathymmai . Kiei kiei kiba jia long mynshuwa yn ym kynmaw shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, nga thaw ia ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka khyndew kaba thymmai: bad ia kaba nyngkong yn ym kynmaw , lymne ban wan ha ka jingmut .

en: To proclaim the acceptable year of the  Lord  , and the day of vengeance of our God  ; to comfort all that mourn  ;
kha: U la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ba ka por ka wan haba U  Trai  un pynim ïa ki briew jong u bad jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki . U la phah ïa nga ban pyntngen ïa baroh kiba sngewsih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynbna ia ka snem kaba pdiang ia U Trai , bad ka sngi jong ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Blei jong ngi;

en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .
kha: Naba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pynlong janai ïa kano kano . Bad mynta la ai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bha da kaba ngi lah ban wan sha jan U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka hukum kam shym la pynlong ei ei kaba janai, hynrei ka jingwanrah ia ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bha ka la leh ; da kaba ngi wan hajan U Blei .

en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain  ; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain .
kha: Kumta la pynmih ïa ka hukum na ka bynta jong ki baroh ban shah pynïap , kynthup ïa u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka hukum ka la leit noh ba ki riewstad kin shah pyniap ; bad ki la wad ia u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u ban shah pyniap .

en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .
kha: Naba uno uno baroh uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uno uno uba wad un shem , bad ka jingkhang kan plie ïa uta uba tied .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei uba pan ia ka met bad uta uba wad u shem ia ka met bad ha uta uba tied ia ka yn plie .

en: Happy are thy men , happy are these thy servants , which stand continually before thee , and that hear thy wisdom .
kha: Ki tnga jong phi katno ki long kiba donbok ! Bad ki shakri jong phi katno ki long kiba donbok , ki don ryngkat bad phi borabor bad ban ïohlad ban ïohsngew ïa ki kyntien jingstad jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong me ki long kiba kmen, ki long kiba kmen ia kine ki shakri jong me kiba ieng beit ha khmat jong me bad kiba iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong me .

en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .
kha: U Judas bad u Silas , kiba long hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kren slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas bad u Silas, ki long ki nongiathuhlypa ruh, ki la kyntu ia ki para bangeit da ki ktien kiba bun, bad ki la pynskhem ia ki .

en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers , and they buried him in his own house : and Amon his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Manasseh u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u Amon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Manasseh u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad ki la tep ia u ha la ka jong ka iing: bad u Amon u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever : and his throne shall be established for evermore .
kha: Ngan buh ïa u ban long halor ki briew jong nga bad ka hima jong nga junom . Ka longïing syiem jong u kan ym kut noh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynshong ia u ha ka iing jong nga bad ha ka hima jong nga junom: bad ka khet jong u kan long kaba skhem junom .

en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .
kha: Naba uno uno uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uta uba wad un shem , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa uno uno uba tied .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei uba pan ia ka met bad uta uba wad u shem ia ka met bad ha uta uba tied ia ka yn plie .

en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .
kha: Ko Trai , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki duwan jong me ; nga long sa tang ma nga marwei uba sah , bad ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , ki la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong me , bad ki la tih ia ki nongleh kam sniew jong me bad nga la sah marwei , bad ki wad ia ka jingim jong nga .

en: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,
kha: Da ka jingsmai kyntang ha u Abraham u kpa tymmen jong ngi u la kular ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi bad shah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa u khlem jingsheptieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un ai ha ngi , ba ngin shah pyllait na ka kti ki nongshun jong ngi ngin shakri ia u khlem jingtieng .

en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the  Lord  , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him ,
kha: Baroh ki rangïapom jong phi kin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad hapoh ka jingïalam jong U  Trai  ki dei ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi haduh ba U  Trai  un da jop thiaw ïa ki
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin leit noh baroh na phi ha ka Jordan ha khmat U Trai , haduh ba un da beh noh ia ki nongshun jong u na khmat jong u .

en: My soul is weary of my life  ; I will leave my complaint upon myself  ; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .
kha: Nga la sngewthait ban im . To sngap ïa ki jingud kthang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem jong nga ka la thait na ka jingim jong nga ; Ngan iehnoh ia ka jingujor jong nga halor lade ; Ngan kren ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight , twenty shekels a day : from time to time shalt thou eat it .
kha: Yn shah ba men bam arspah laiphew gram u kpu shi sngi , bad ka dei ban neh haduh ka sngi kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh jong me kaba me bam kan long da ka jingkhia, arphew Shekel ha ka sngi: na ka por sha ka por .

en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .
kha: ba ki samla kynthei kin leit saw sngi man la ka snem ban ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah u nong Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki khun kynthei Israel ki leit sngewsih ia ka khun jong u Jephthah u Gilead saw sngi ha ka shisnem .

en: Be it known therefore unto you , that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles , and that they will hear it .
kha: Ka jingpynkut bad ki jingkhublei shimet
translated_en_to_kha: To tip namarkata ha phi, ba la phah ia ka jingpynim U Blei sha ki Jutang bad ba kin iohsngew ia ka .

en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat , because he eateth not of faith : for whatsoever is not of faith is sin .
kha: Hynrei haba u sngew artatien ïa kaei kaba u bam , U Blei u pynrem ïa u haba u bam ïa ka , namar kaei kaba u leh , kam shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit . Bad kaei kaei ka bym shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit ka long ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba artatien u shah tim lada u bam, namar um bam ia ka jingngeit: namar kaei kaei kaba ym dei na ka jingngeit ka long ka pop .

en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :
kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , kine ki rangbah ki thaw ki jingthmu basniew bad ki ai ïa ka jingai jingmut bym long hapoh kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, kine ki long ki briew kiba thmu ia ka jingsniew bad kiba ai jingmut kaba sniew ha kane ka shnong:

en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
kha: ha kaba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki wan mih na kata ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki la mih na ka wah hynriew tylli ki masi kiba la sngewtynnad bha bad kiba la sngur bha; bad ki la bam ha ka khlaw .

en: And Mordecai came again to the king s gate . But Haman hasted to his house mourning , and having his head covered .
kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit phai pat sha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem katba u Haman u pynstet ban leit sha la ïing , u da tap ïa la ka khmat ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mordecai u la wan phai biang sha ka khyrdop jong u syiem . Hynrei u Haman u la leit sha iing jong u da kaba iam bad u la tap ia ka khlieh jong u .

en: From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?
kha: Nangno ki mih ki thma bad ki jingïakajia hapdeng jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phi ïa ka jingsngewbha , kiba ïai ïaleh hapoh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Naei ki wan ki thma bad ki jingialeh hapdeng jong phi ? kim wan kumta , wat na ki jingkwah brai jong phi kiba ialeh ha ki dkhot jong phi ?

en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .
kha: U Jisu u la peit shlip sha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ha u briew , hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki long kaba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la iohi ia ki bad u la ong ha ki, Ha ki briew kane ka long kaba ym lah ban leh hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah .

en: And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
kha: Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa u na Galilaïa , ki la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba u ithuh bad ki kynthei kiba bud ia u na Galilaia ki la ieng jngai , ki la iohi ia kine kiei kiei .

en: O daughter of Babylon , who art to be destroyed  ; happy shall he be , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us .
kha: Ko ka Babilon , yn sa pynjot ïa pha . Suk uta u briew uba siew kylliang ïa pha na ka bynta kaei kaba pha la leh ïa ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong ka Babilon, kaba la shah pynjot;

en: And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .
kha: Kumba ka dei ban long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngam shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba nga kren ha ki briew kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jong kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ko para bangeit, ngam lah ban kren ha phi kum ha ka mynsiem ba kynja mynsiem, hynrei kum ha ka met, wat kum ha ki babes ha U Khrist .

en: And Elijah said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , I will surely shew myself unto him to day .
kha: U Elijah u jubab ,  Da u  Trai  uba im , ïa uba nga shakri , nga kular ba ngan ïeng ha khmat u syiem mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong , Kumba U Trai jong ki paid u im, ha khmat jong u nga ieng , ngan sa pyni ia lade ha u ha ka sngi .

en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .
kha: Bad U Trai jong ngi , ïa uba kine kiei kiei ki kren , u wan na kawei pat ka jait , bad ym don uno uno u dkhot na ka jait jong u , uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba la kren ia kine kiei kiei u dei na kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , na kaba ym don mano mano ruh kiba la leit sha ka jaka bam .

en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt : therefore I command thee to do this thing .
kha: Wat klet ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt ; dei namar kata ba nga la ai ha phi ïa kane ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kynmaw ba me la long u mraw ha ka ri Ijipt: namarkata nga hukum ia me ban leh ia kane ka kam .

en: ( For from my youth he was brought up with me , as with a father , and I have guided her from my mother s womb  ; )
kha: Baroh shi jingim jong nga , nga la kitkhia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka por ba u dang samla la pynsan ia u bad nga, kumba bad u kpa, bad nga la ialam ia ka na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga ; )

en: O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .
kha: Nga long u shakri jong me , ko  Trai  ; nga shakri ïa me , kumba ka kmie jong nga ka la leh . Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, shisha nga long u shakri jong me ; nga long u shakri jong me, bad u khun jong ka kti jong me: me la pyllait ia ki jingteh jong nga .

en: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom an hundred and twenty princes , which should be over the whole kingdom  ;
kha: U Darius u la rai ban thung shispah arphew ngut ki lat ban bat kam ha kylleng ka hima jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la sngewbha ia u Darius ban buh halor ka hima shispah arphew ngut ki syiem kiba dei ban long halor ka hima baroh kawei;

en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
kha: Une u sah shipor ha ka ïing u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon , uba shong basah harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U sah bad uwei u Simon u nonglehkai uba don harud duriaw: un iathuh ia me kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

en: Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .
kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki hangto hi .  Baroh ar ngut ki la dem khrup ha khyndew ,
translated_en_to_kha: To khie noh ia phi na kane ka balang , ba ngan bam ia ki kumba ha ka khyllipmat . Bad ki la hap ha ki khmat jong ki .

en: Also I set watchmen over you , saying , Hearken to the sound of the trumpet . But they said , We will not hearken .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  un thung ki rangbah nongap phira ban shahshkor ïa ka jingmaham jong ka turoi . Hynrei ki ong ,  Ngin ym shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga buh ia ki nongap halor jong phi, da kaba ong , To sngap ia ka sur jong ka turoi . Hynrei ki la ong , Ngin ym sngap .

en: God is the  Lord  , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .
kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei ; u la long uba bha ïa ngi . Lem bad ki tnat dieng ha ki kti jong phi , to sdang ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam bad ïaid sawdong ïa ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u long U Trai uba la pyni ia ngi ia ka jingshai: teh ia ka jingknia da ki nar , wat haduh ki bniat jong ka almari .

en: Behold , the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the  Lord s  thy God , the earth also , with all that therein is .
kha: Wat ka bneng kaba jrong tam ka long ka jong U  Trai  ; ka khyndew ruh ka long ka jong u , bad kiei kiei ruh kiba don ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka bneng bad ka bneng ki bneng ka long U Trai jong me, ka khyndew ruh bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka .

en: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,
kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ong ,  A katno phi long kiba bieit !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki, uba kyrteng u Kiapha, uba long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem, u la ong ha ki: Phim tip ei ei ruh em .

en: And the  Lord  went his way , as soon as he had left communing with Abraham : and Abraham returned unto his place .
kha: Hadien ba u la dep ïakren bad u Abraham , U  Trai  u la leit noh , bad u Abraham u leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leit noh ia la ka lynti, tang shu leit noh bad u Abraham: bad u Abraham u la leit phai noh sha la ka jaka .

en: ( John 17 :17  ; 2 Timothy 3 :16 , 17 ) They treat God’s Word as being more important than human ideas or customs .
kha: ( Ioannis 17 :17 ; 2 Timothi 3 :16 , 17 ) Ki shim ba ka ktien U Blei ka kham kongsan ban ïa ki dustur ne jingmut jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Ioannis 17 :17 ; 2 Timothi 3 :16 , 17 ) Ki leh ia ka ktien jong U Blei ].

en: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them ,  They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .
kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba koit bakhiah kim donkam ïa u nongsumar , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata , u la ong ha ki , Kito kiba long baroh ki donkam ia u doktor , hynrei kito kiba pang .

en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;
kha: u Sadok , u khun jong u Ahitub bad u Ahimelekh , u khun jong u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingbishar ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Nadaok u khun u Ahitub bad u Ahimeel u khun u Abiathar ki long ki lyngdoh ; bad u Seraiah u la long u nongthoh ; .

en: She hath wearied herself with lies , and her great scum went not forth out of her : her scum shall be in the fire .
kha: wat la ka sarang baroh kan ym jah ha ki thylliej ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pynsngewsih ia lade da ki jinglamler, bad ka sniehdoh kaba khraw jong ka kam shym la mih na ka: ka sniehdoh jong ka kan long ha ka ding .

en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .
kha: u la ong ha nga :  To thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u kren U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , u ong , Thoh ia me ia ki ktien baroh kiba nga la kren ha me ha ka kot .

en: Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .
kha: Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka jingshit mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat mynmiet . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la long ; ha ka sngi ka jingkhriat ka la bam ia nga, bad ka jingkhriat miet bad ka jingthiah jong nga ka la jah noh na ki khmat jong nga .

en: Yea , I will gather you , and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath , and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof .
kha: Ho-oid , ngan lumlang ïa ki ha Jerusalem , buh ïa ka ding hapoh jong ki , bad pynum ïa ki da ka jingbitar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ngan lum ia phi bad ngan beh ia phi ha ka ding jong ka jingbitar jong nga , bad phin sa shah pynkhyllem hapdeng jong ka .

en: And he said unto them ,  In what place soever ye enter into an house , there abide till ye depart from that place .
kha: U la ong ruh ,  Hangno hangno ba la khot sngewbha ïa phi , sah ha kajuh ka ïing haduh ba phin da mih na kata ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Ha kano kano ka jaka ba phi rung ha ka iing , to sah hangta haduh ba phin da leit noh na kata ka jaka .

en: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while : our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary .
kha: Ïa ngi , u paidlang uba khuid jong me , la beh noh shabar da ki nongshun jong ngi katto katne por : ki la ïuhroit ïa ka jaka kyntang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka jingkhuid jong me ki la don tang khyndiat por: ki nongshun jong ngi ki la iaid shapoh ka jaka kyntang jong me .

en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple  ; the king is held in the galleries .
kha: Pynphai ïa ki khmat jong phi shawei pat na nga ; ki pynshohbieit ïa nga . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba ïaid sha trai jong ki lum ka Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khlieh jong me halor jong me ka long kum ka Carmel, bad ki shniuh jong ka khlieh jong me kum ki rong saw la bat ha ki galler .

en: Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .
kha: To rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohnud baroh , ko Jerusalem !
translated_en_to_kha: Sing , ko khun jong u Zion to pyrta , ko Israel to sngewbha bad sngewbha da ka dohnud baroh ko khun jong ka Jerusalem .

en: The BMS has done its own research and has said 2 . 5 lakh units in the informal manufacturing sector have shut down
kha: Ka BMS ka la leh ia la ka jong ka jingwad bniah bad ka la ong 2 . 5 lak tylli ki unit ha ka kam shna tiar bym thikna ki la khang
translated_en_to_kha: Ka BMS ka la leh ia la ka jong ka jingwad bniah bad ka la ong 2 . 5 lak unit ha ka kam shna tiar ba pura ki la khang .

en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head , and honour the face of the old man , and fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
kha: Pyni burom ïa ki briew ba la tymmen bad ai burom ïa ki . Da kaba tiengburom kohnguh ïa nga ; Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban kiew ha khmat ka khlieh kaba jrong bad to burom ia ka khmat jong u tymmen bad to sheptieng ia U Blei jong me: Nga long U Trai .

en: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel  ; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jeroboam u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem , bad u khun jong u , u Sekharaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeroboan u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, wat bad ki syiem Israel; bad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Then saith he to the disciple ,  Behold thy mother !  And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha uta u synran ,  Kane ka long ka kmie jong me .  Naduh kata ka por uta u synran u la ïalam ïa ka ban sah noh ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ia u synran jong u, Ha khmih ka kmie jong me ! Bad naduh kata ka kynta uta u synran u la ialam ia ka sha la iing .

en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with her suburbs , and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; two cities .
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , la ai ar tylli ki nongbah : ka Taanakh bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jaitbynriew Manasseh, ka Taach bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Gathrimmon bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; ar tylli ki nongbah .

en: Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .
kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki , khnang ba ki balang baroh kin sngewskhem ïa kata bad kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha kaba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pyni ha ki bad ha khmat ki balang , ia ka jingpynshisha jong ka jingieit jong phi bad jong ka jingsarong jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi .

en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field , and shalt gather but little in  ; for the locust shall consume it .
kha: Shibun u symbai phin bet ha lyngkha , hynrei tang khyndiat pat phin ïoh ot , namar ki puit kin bam ïa ki jingthung jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban rah bun u symbai sha lyngkha , bad men lum tang khyndiat eh ha ka ; namar u khnai un bam ia u .

en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ahas u syiem ka Judah , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khyndai snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Ahasa u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Hosia u khun jong u Elah ban synshar ha Samaria halor ki Israel hynniew snem .

en: To whom we gave place by subjection , no , not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .
kha: Ki da kwah ban pynlong mraw ïa ngi , hynrei khnang ban pynneh ïa ka jingshisha ka Gospel na ka bynta jong phi , ngim shym la ailad ïa ki wat tang shi minit ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ngi la ai jaka da ka jingshah pyndem, em, ym tang shi kynta shuh shuh ba ka jingshisha jong ka gospel kan iai bteng bad phi .

en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth–gath : the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel .
kha: Bad mynta , ko ki paid ka Judah , to khublei khatduh ïa ka shnong Moresheth Gath . Ki syiem ka Israel kin ym ïoh jingïarap na ka shnong Akhsib .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ai sngewbha ia u Moreshethgath: ki iing Achzib kin long kiba thok ia ki syiem Israel .

en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest , which are these ; Adultery , fornication , uncleanness , lasciviousness ,
kha: Kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew ka leh ka long kaba paw shynna . Ka pynpaw ïa lade ha kaba klim , ka jingbymkhuid , bad ki jingleh khlem akor ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki kam jong ka doh ki paw , kiba long kine ki ; Ka jingleh be-ijot , ka jingbymkhuid , ka jingbymkhuid , .

en: Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :
kha: Kum ban pynkut : Phi baroh to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngew , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat kum shi para , bad to long kiba sbun mynsiem bad kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, to long baroh kawei ka jingmut, da kaba sngewrit iwei ia iwei pat, ka jingieit kum ki para, to long kiba sngewrit, to long kiba sngewrit:

en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor , the harvest of the river , is her revenue  ; and she is a mart of nations .
kha: To ïam pangnud , phi ki nongkhaïi ka Sidon ! Phi phah ïa ki rangbah sha shiliang ka duriaw ban thied bad ban die ïa u kew uba mih ha Ijipt bad ban ïakhaïi bad baroh ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ki um kiba khraw u symbai jong u Sihor , u jingot jong ka wah , ka long ka jingmih jong ka bad ka long ka mart jong ki jaitbynriew .

en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort :
kha: U Rehum ruh , u lat , bad u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins    , ki thoh ïa kane ka shithi sha u Artakserksis na Jerusalem :
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehum u nongkylla bad u Shimshai u la thoh ia ka shithi pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem sha u Artaxerxes u syiem ha kane ka rukom:

en: And if the house be worthy , let your peace come upon it : but if it be not worthy , let your peace return to you .
kha: Lada ki briew hapoh kata ka ïing ki pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ; hynrei lada kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to shim noh pat ïa ka jingkhublei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka iing ka long kaba bit dor , to ai ba ka jingsuk jong phi kan wan ha ka: hynrei lada kam long kaba bit dor , to ai ba ka jingsuk jong phi kan wan phai biang sha phi .

en: Then Pilate said unto them , Why , what evil hath he done ? And they cried out the more exceedingly , Crucify him .
kha: Hynrei kaei ka kam sniew kaba u la leh ?  U Pilat u la kylli . Ki la ïa-pyrta kham jam ,  Sahnarphna ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pilat u la ong ha ki, Balei, kaei kaba sniew kaba u la leh ? Bad ki la pyrta kham palat , Pynkhih ia u .

en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and , behold , it was a dream .
kha: U syiem u la kyndit thiah bad u sngewthuh ba u la phohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba rit ki la bam ia ki hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba jrong bad kiba dap . U Pharaoh u la kyndit bad, ha khmih, ka la long ka jingphohsniew .

en: Whereas angels , which are greater in power and might , bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord .
kha: Wat ki angel , kiba kham khlaiñ bad kham khraw ban ïa kine ki nonghikai balamler , kim pynrem ïa ki da ki jingkrenbeiñ ha khmat U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki angel kiba kham khraw ha ka bor bad ka bor kim wanrah ia ka jingkynnoh kaba jur pyrshah ia ki ha khmat U Trai .

en: And David said unto him , From whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped .
kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno me wan ?   Nga la lait phet na ka jaka sher dara ki Israel ,  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u: Naei me wan ? Bad u la ong ha u: Na ka kynhun Israel nga la lait im .

en: He is a leprous man , he is unclean : the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean  ; his plague is in his head .
kha: u lyngdoh un rai ïa u ba u long u bymkhuid , namar ba ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la don ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U long u briew uba sniew, u long uba khlem khuid: u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khlem khuid satia; ka khlam jong u ka don ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: The kings of the earth stood up , and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord , and against his Christ .
kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la pynkhreh ïa lade , bad ki nongsynshar ki la ïakynduh lang pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ïa U Messaïah jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka khyndew ki la ieng , bad ki nongsynshar ki la ialum lang pyrshah ia U Trai bad pyrshah ia U Khrist jong u .

en: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .
kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u ; bad ki synran ki la sheptieng haba u lyoh u la wan halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren kumta, la wan u lyoh, bad u la tap ia ki: bad ki la tieng katba ki dang rung shapoh u lyoh .

en: Thou shalt fear the  Lord  thy God  ; him shalt thou serve , and to him shalt thou cleave , and swear by his name .
kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad mane ruh tang ïa u . Ïaineh ha u bad kular skhem tang ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong me; ia u me dei ban shakri, bad ha u me dei ban sngap jar da ka kyrteng jong u .

en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .
kha: Ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la ïap bad u la mihpat , bad kumta ngi ngeit ba U Blei un shim pat bad U Jisu ïa kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la iap bad u la mihpat, wat ia kita ruh kiba thiah ha U Jisu U Blei un wanrah ryngkat bad u .

en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Leh ïa kaba bha tam ban rung lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim ; namar bun ki briew da kaba thikna kin pyrshang ban phrung lyngba jong ka hynrei kin ym lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshang ban rung shapoh ka khyrdop kaba jylliew: namar bun , nga ong ha phi , kin wad ban rung shapoh , bad kin ym lah .

en: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit  ;
kha: Uwei u briew hapdeng u paidbah u la jubab ,  Ko Nonghikai , nga la wallam ïa u khun jong nga sha me , namar u don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u bad um nang kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki paidbah u la jubab bad u la ong, Ko Nonghikai, nga la wanrah ha me ia u khun jong nga uba don ka mynsiem kaba dum;

en: He rebuked the Red sea also , and it was dried up : so he led them through the depths , as through the wilderness .
kha: U la ai hukum ïa ka Duriaw Basaw bad ka rkhiang ; u ïalam ïa ki briew jong u sha shiliang halor ka khyndew ba-rkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynrem ia ka duriaw kaba saw ruh, bad ka la tyrkhong: kumta u la ialam ia ki lyngba ki jingjylliew , kumba lyngba ka ri khlaw .

en: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;
kha: Te phin long kiba lait na baroh ki jingbymkhuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin mynjur ia kiei kiei kiba bha ; ba phin long kiba shisha bad khlem jinglehnohei haduh ka sngi U Khrist ; .

en: But beware of men : for they will deliver you up to the councils , and they will scourge you in their synagogues  ;
kha: To sumar , naba kin don ki briew ki ban kem ïa phi bad ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , bad kin sympat ïa phi ha ki synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to husiar na ki briew: namar kin pynpoi ia phi sha ki dorbar , bad kin pynkhih ia phi ha ki synagog jong ki ;

en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .
kha: Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingput ronsing , ïalumlang sawdong jong nga . U Blei jong ngi un ïaleh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kano ka jaka ba phi iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi, to leit sha ngi: U Blei jong ngi un ialeh na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :
kha: Naba u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad , ‘ uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie yn pynïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Moses u la ong: To burom ia u kpa jong me bad ia ka kmie jong me ; bad , Uno uno uba tim ia u kpa ne ka kmie , to un iap:

en: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :
kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa baroh kaba u don , bad u la shim ïa ka jinglong u shakri . U kylla long u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la pynlong ia lade khlem nam, bad u la shim ia ka dur jong u shakri, bad la pynlong ia u ha ka dur jong ki briew:

en: And all the wise men , that wrought all the work of the sanctuary , came every man from his work which they made  ;
kha: Te ki rangbah kiba tbit kiba trei ïa ka kam ki mih na la ka jingtrei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki riewstad baroh kiba la leh ia ka kam bakhuid baroh ki la wan uwei pa uwei na ka kam jong u kaba ki la leh;

en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la nang ïaid ha ka Galilaïa ; um shym kwah ban leit sha Judia , namar ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw hangta ki la ïakwah ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei U Jisu u la iaid ha Galilaia: namar un ym iaid ha ka ri Jiw , namar ki Jiw ki la wad ban pyniap ia u .

en: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .
kha: Nyngkong , nga ainguh ïa U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi baroh , namar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïohsngew shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nyngkong eh , nga ainguh ia U Blei jong nga lyngba U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi baroh , ba la kren ia ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .
kha: U Thomas ( ïa uba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) u la ong ha la ki para synran ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh bad u Nonghikai , ba ngin ïa-ïap ryngkat bad u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Thomas uba la khot u Didymus, ha ki para nongpule jong u, To ngin ia leit ruh, ba ngin iap bad u .

en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates : and they feared , when they heard that they were Romans .
kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien ha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul bad u Silas ki dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom , ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah ki la iathuh ia kine ki ktien ha ki majistor: bad ki la tieng haba ki la iohsngew ba ki long ki nong Rom .

en: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .
kha: U Hilkaïah , u Tebalaïah , bad u Sekharaïah . Ha baroh ki ïadon khatlai ngut ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Hosah kiba dei ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hilkiah kaba ar , u Tebaiah uba lai: ki khun shynrang bad ki hynmen jong u Hosa ki long shiphew ngut .

en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kerkut ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por ki shakri jong u syiem Babilon ki la wan pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem bad ka nongbah ka la shah set .

en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah , and his ways , and his sayings , are written in the story of the prophet Iddo .
kha: Kaba sah jong ka histori u Abijah , kaei kaba u ong bad kaei kaba u leh , la thoh ha  Ka Histori jong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Abijah bad ki lynti jong u bad ki ktien jong u la thoh ha ka jingiathuhkhana jong u nongiathuhlypa Iddo .

en: And he turned him unto his disciples , and said privately ,  Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phai sha ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ha kaba rieh ,  A katno phi long kiba donbok ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba phi ïohi !
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai sha ki synran jong u bad u la ong kyrpang: La kyrkhu ia ki khmat kiba iohi ia kiei kiei kiba phi iohi:

en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats  hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle : eleven curtains shalt thou make .
kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ na ki khatwei tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki jingtap jong ki blang ban long ka jingtap halor ka iing: shiphew tylli ki jingtap me dei ban shna .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto him out of heaven , and said , Abraham , Abraham : and he said , Here am I .
kha: Hynrei u angel U  Trai  u pyrta ïa u na bneng ,  Abraham , Abraham !  U jubab ,  Ho-oid , nga hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la pyrta ia u na bneng, bad u la ong, Abraham: bad u la ong: Hangne nga don .

en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you .
kha: Nangta rah ïa ki shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad buh ïa ki ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , ha kaba nga ïashem bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ki ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ha khmat ka jingphla , ha kaba ngan iakynduh bad phi .

en: The college is next to Sathyabama University in Sholinganallur , OMR and about 15 kilometres from Adyar in Chennai .
kha: Kane ka College ka don marjan bad ka Sathyabama University ha Sholinganallur , OMR bad ka jngai kumba 15 kilomitar na Adyar ha Chennai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kolej ka don hajan ka Sathyabama University ha Sholinganallur , OMR bad kumba 15 kilometre na Adyar ha Chennai .

en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .
kha: La pynmeh ïa ka ding hapdeng jong ka phyllaw , bad u Petros u la ïasoh lem bad kito kiba ïashong sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la thang ding hapdeng ka hall , bad ki la ia shong lang , u Petros u la shong hapdeng jong ki .

en: And unto Enoch was born Irad : and Irad begat Mehujael : and Mehujael begat Methusael : and Methusael begat Lamech .
kha: U Enokh u la ïoh khun shynrang uba kyrteng u Irad , uba dei u kpa jong u Mehujael , bad u Mehujael u la don u khun uba kyrteng u Methushael , uba dei u kpa jong u Lamekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u Enokh la kha ia u Irad: bad u Irad u la kha ia u Mehuel: bad u Mehuel u la kha ia u Methusel: bad u Methusel u la kha ia u Lamek .

en: And he said unto them ,  Let us go into the next towns , that I may preach there also : for therefore came I forth .
kha: Hynrei u Jisu u la jubab ,  Ngi dei ban leit sha kiwei nongrit ha kine ki thain . Nga dei ban ïalap ha ki ruh , namar dei na kata ka daw ba nga la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: To ngin leit sha ki shnong kiba hadien ruh: namar kata nga la wan shabar .

en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .
kha: Ka jingsam kaba hynriew la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lot kaba hynriew ka la mih sha ki khun u Naphtali , wat na ka bynta ki khun u Naphtali kat kum ka iing ka sem jong ki .

en: Peter answered and said unto him , Though all men shall be offended because of thee , yet will I never be offended .
kha: U Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me da lei lei , wat la baroh kiwei pat ki leh kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la jubab bad u la ong ha u , Wat la ki briew baroh kin sngewsih namar me , hynrei ngan ym sngewsih satia .

en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation , about the most holy things :
kha: hynrei u Nadab bad u Abihu ki la shah pynïap mynba ki ainguh da ka ding bymkhuid sha U  Trai  ha ka ri Shyiap Sinai . Kine kim don khun don kti , kumta u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ki la shakri kum ki lyngdoh katba u Aaron u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kan long ka jingshakri jong ki khun shynrang jong u Kohat ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , shaphang kiei kiei kiba khuid tam:

en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .
kha: Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Ham, hadien ki longiing jong ki, hadien ki shyntur jong ki, ha ki ri jong ki bad ha ki jaitbynriew jong ki .

en: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,
kha: Kumba u ju leh , u Paul u la leit sha ka synagog . Hangta , ha ki lai tylli ki sngi Sabbaton u la ïatainia bad ki paidbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul kumba ka rukom jong u ka long, u la leit sha ki, bad lai sngi ka sngi Sabha u la iasaid bad ki na ki jingthoh Bakhuid .

en: As a cage is full of birds , so are their houses full of deceit : therefore they are become great , and waxen rich .
kha: Kumba u nongriam sim u pyndap ïa ka ruh jong u da ki sim , ki la pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka jinglute . Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki long kiba donbor bad kiba riewspah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka cage ka dap da ki sim , kumta ki iing jong ki ki dap da ka jingleh thok: namarkata ki kylla long kiba khraw , bad ki la nang riewspah .

en: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilaeans ?
kha: Ha ka jinglyngngoh bad jingphylla ki la pynbna ,  Kine ki briew kiba kren kumne ki long ki nong Galilaïa !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la lyngngoh bad ki la lyngngoh, ki ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, Ha khmih hato kine baroh ki kren Galilaia ?

en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak , Told not I thee , saying , All that the  Lord  speaketh , that I must do ?
kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ba nga dei ban leh baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Balaam u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Balak, Ngam shym la iathuh ia me da kaba ong: Baroh kaba U Trai u kren , ba nga dei ban leh ?

en: Shall I not visit them for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? Hato ngan ym pynhiarkput halor ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ? Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan ym leit jngoh ia ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? ong U Trai: hato ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym shah pynshitom bein ha ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?

en: Located there is the Governing Body , a central group of experienced elders who oversee the worldwide congregation .
kha: Hangta la don ki dkhot ba la khot ka Governing Body , ka kynhun jong ki elders kiba tbit bha , ki ban peit ïa ki balang ha satlak ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: La buh ia ka ha ka por ba la buh lypa, ka kynhun pdeng jong ki rangbah kiba la tbit bha kiba peit ia ka balang ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

en: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God , and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ :
kha: lem bad ka ding baklang , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba kyntait ïa U Blei bad ki bymkohnguh ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka ding kaba rhem kaba pynkhih ia kito ki bym tip ia U Blei , bad kiba ym kohnguh ia ka gospel jong U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist:

en: And it shall be , when ye are come nigh unto the battle , that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people ,
kha: Shuwa ba phin sdang ïaleh , u lyngdoh un wan sha khmat bad kren ha kata ka kynhun shipai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, ynda phi la wan hajan ka thma, ba u lyngdoh un leit shajan bad kren ha ki briew .

en: And he discovered the covering of Judah , and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest .
kha: Baroh ki jingïada jong ka Judah ki la khyllem . Haba kata ka la jia , phi la wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh na ka jaka buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la lap ia ka jingtap jong u Judah , bad me la peit ha kata ka sngi sha ka jainkup jong ka iing khlaw .

en: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof  ; and so it shall be joined together .
kha: Ïa ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng , da kiba lah ban pynskhem ïa ka , dei ban pyndait na ki rmiang jong ka baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan don ki ar tylli ki tyrpeng jong ka kiba la pyniasoh lang ha ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka ; bad kumta kan iasoh lang .

en: Whom I would have retained with me , that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel :
kha: Ngan jin da la kwah ban bat ïa u hangne bad nga , katba nga dang don ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba un ïoh ïarap ïa nga ha ka jaka jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba nga la bat bad nga, ba ha ka jaka jong me u la lah ban shakri ia nga ha ki jingteh jong ka gospel:

en: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets : they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills .
kha: Ki briew kiba shisien ki la bam ïa ki jingbam kiba kynsai tam ki ïapthngan ha ki lynti bah ; kito kiba la heh la san ha ka pahuh pahai ki kraid lyngba ka jakhlia na ka bynta ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba la bam da kaba jem ki la jah rngai noh ha ki surok: kita kiba la pynsan pynrangbah ha ki lum ba la pdiang da ki rong saw .

en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .
kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kano kano ka mynsiem kaba ym shah pynshitom ha kata kajuh ka sngi , un shah ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: And cried with a loud voice , as when a lion roareth : and when he had cried , seven thunders uttered their voices .
kha: bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ki sing . Hadien ba u la pyrta jam , ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la jubab da ka jingkyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, kumba u sing u la pyrta: bad haba u la pyrta , hynriew tylli ki jingsawa jong ki ki la pynmih ia ki sur jong ki .

en: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him .
kha: La katta ruh , lada shah ïa uta u trai ban siew da ka kuna , ban pyllait im ïa u , u dei ban siew dep ïa ka dor kaba dei ban siew .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada la buh ha u ia ka pisa , te un ai na ka bynta ka jingsiew bai lutksan jong ka jingim jong u ia kaei kaei kaba la buh ha u .

en: Then said Daniel to Melzar , whom the prince of the eunuchs had set over Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah ,
kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u nongap phira uba u Ashpenas u la buh ban khmih ïa u bad ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la ong ha u Melzar, uba u rangbah jong ki nongshong shnong u la buh halor u Daniel, u Hananiah, u Mishael bad u Asariah .

en: Even so ye , forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church .
kha: Namar ba phi kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai jong U Mynsiem , phi dei ban pyrshang nalor kiei kiei baroh ban kham pyndonkam ïa kito kiba long jingïarap ban tei ïa ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh phi, kumba phi sngewtynnad ia ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem, to wad ba phin nang bha ha kaba tei ia ka balang .

en: Unto Timothy , my own son in the faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord .
kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit : To U Blei U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Timothi, u khun jong nga hi ha ka jingngeit: Ka jingaiei, ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .
kha: Nangta uta u angel u ïeng ha ka lynti kaba khim kaba don hapdeng ar tylli ki bri sohwaiñ ba la ker da ka kynroh maw baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u angel U Trai u la ieng ha ka lynti jong ki kper sohjew , ka kynroh ka don ha kane ka liang bad ka kynroh ha kata ka liang .

en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
kha: Ko Pa ! To ai ka burom ïa nga ha khmat jong me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba nga la don lem bad me ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ko Kpa, to pyndonburom ia nga da ka burom kaba nga la don bad me shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan long .

en: All farmers who cultivate oilseeds in all the districts except Kanyakumari , Chennai and The Nilgiris are eligible .
kha: Baroh ki nongrep kiba rep umphniang ha baroh ki distrik lait noh ka Kanyakumari , Chennai bad The Nilgiris ki lah ban ioh ia kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongrep kiba rep ia ki symbai umphniang ha baroh ki distrik lait noh tang ka Kanyakumari , Chennai bad ki Nilgiris ki long kiba dei hok .

en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,
kha: Ki la jop ruh ïa u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na kiba khatduh jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw jong u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan kaba la sah ha Ashtaroth bad ha Edrei .

en: And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?
kha: bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Me don hok aïu ba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha u , Da ka bor aiu me leh ia kine kiei kiei ? bad mano ba la ai ia me ia kane ka bor ban leh ia kine kiei kiei ?

en: And she said unto her servants , Go on before me  ; behold , I come after you . But she told not her husband Nabal .
kha: Nangta ka ong ha ki shakri ,  Khie nang ïaid sha khmat bad ngan sa bud nadien jong phi .  Hynrei kam shym ïathuh ei ei ha la u tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha ki shakri jong ka, To iaid shakhmat ha khmat jong nga ; ha khmih nga wan hadien jong phi . Hynrei kam shym la iathuh ia u tnga jong ka u Nabal .

en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .
kha: U shna saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret saw tylli ki ryntieh ksiar na ka bynta jong ka , bad u la buh ia ki ryntieh ha ki saw tylli ki tduh kiba don ha ki saw tylli ki kjat jong ka .

en: We asked their names also , to certify thee , that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them .
kha: Ngi kylli ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khnang ba ngi lah ban pyntip sha phi mano ki nongïalam jong kane ka kam ki dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la kylli ia ki kyrteng jong ki ruh , ban pynshisha ia me , ba ngin thoh ia ki kyrteng jong ki briew kiba long ki rangbah jong ki .

en: And David saith , Let their table be made a snare , and a trap , and a stumblingblock , and a recompence unto them :
kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ,  Ai ba kin ngat bad sahkut ha ki jingkhawai jong ki ; ai ba kin kyllon , ai ba kin shah pynshitom!
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid u ong , Ai ba ka miej jong ki kan long ka jingma, bad ka jingma, bad ka jingpynkylla ia ki:

en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .
kha: Kata ka long ruh balei ba phi dei ban siew ki khajna , namar ki bor synshar ki trei na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pyndep ïa la ki kamram .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na ka bynta kane ka daw to ai burom ruh: namar ki long ki nongshakri U Blei, kiba iai bteng ia kane hi.

en: And many resorted unto him , and said , John did no miracle : but all things that John spake of this man were true .
kha: Shibun ki briew ki la wan sha u .  U Ïoannis um leh kambah ei ei ,  ki la ong ,  hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong shaphang une u briew ka la long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki la leit sha u, bad ki la ong, U loannis um shym la leh kambah: hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba u loannis u la kren shaphang une u briew ki long kiba shisha .

en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .
kha: Ka la long palat ban ïa kaba ngi la khmih lynti! Nyngkong ki la aiti ïa lade ha U Trai ; bad nangta , da ka mon U Blei ki la aiti ïa lade ha ngi ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane ki la leh, ym kumba ngi la kyrmen, hynrei ki la aiti nyngkong ia la ka jong ka jingim ha U Trai bad ha ngi da ka mon U Blei .

en: Irani said the EC officials have assured the delegation that they will do justice after following legal procedures .
kha: U Irani u la ong ba ki heh ka EC ki la pynthikna ia ka kynhun ba kin leh hok hadien ba ki la bud ia ki rukom treikam jong ka ain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Irani u la ong ba ki heh jong ka EC ki la pynthikna ia ka kynhun ba kin leh hok hadien ba ki la bud ia ki rukom ain .

en: My God will cast them away , because they did not hearken unto him : and they shall be wanderers among the nations .
kha: U Blei uba nga shakri un kyntait ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba kim shym la shahshkor ïa u . Kin kylla long ki nongïaidwir hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong nga un bret noh ia ki namar kim shym la sngap ia u: bad kin long ki nongleit jingleit hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord , and from the glory of his power ;
kha: Kin shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingpynjot bymjukut , kiba la pynïakhlad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong U Trai bad na ka jingkhlaiñbor badonburom jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba shah pynshitom da ka jingpynjot bymjukut na khmat U Trai bad na ka burom jong ka bor jong u ; .

en: Turn you to the strong hold , ye prisoners of hope : even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee  ;
kha: To wan phai , phi kiba shah ringmraw kiba mynta phi la don ka jingkyrmen ; to wan phai sha ka jaka jong phi kaba shngain . Mynta nga ong ïa phi ba ngan siew pat ar shah ïa phi da ka jingkyrkhu na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai ia phi sha ka jingbat kaba skhem, phi ki koidi jong ka jingkyrmen: wat haduh ka sngi nga pynbna ba ngan siew ar shah ia me;

en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer , and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,
kha: Bad ngan ïailong uba kmen , namar nga tip ba da ki jingduwai jong phi bad da ka jingïarap kaba wan na U Mynsiem jong U Jisu Khrist , ïa nga yn sa pyllaitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba kane kan phai sha ka jingpynim jong nga lyngba ka jingduwai jong phi bad ka jingpynbiang ia U Mynsiem U Jisu Khrist .

en: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .
kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la koit um shym la long mano: namar U Jisu u la pynpaw ia lade sha jngai, u paidbah u la don ha kata ka jaka .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this night , before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  Nga ong ha me ba mynta ka miet , ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Hooid nga ong ha me, Ba mynta ka miet, shuwa u khnai, men kyntait ia nga shi sien .

en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .
kha: Katba dang don ka jingpynïap , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ynda kin hap , kin sa shah pynkhih da ka jingiarap khyndiat: hynrei bun kin ia tyngkhuh bad ki da ki jingbam ba jem .

en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man , which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts ;
kha: Kumta to iehnoh ïa u briew barim jong phi , uba pynlong ïa phi ban im kumba phi la ju im — u briew uba rim uba la nang pynjot da ki jingkwah brai bashukor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phi weng noh shaphang ka jingiakren kaba mynshuwa ia u tymmen uba la jot kat kum ki jingkwah brai ba thok ; .

en: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle  ; and they fled before him .
kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki tur shaphrang ban ïaleh bad ki Syria ki phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joab bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la iaid ha khmat ki Syria haduh ka thma ; bad ki la phet noh ha khmat jong u .

en: And led him away to Annas first  ; for he was father in law to Caiaphas , which was the high priest that same year .
kha: bad ki la ïalam ïa u nyngkong sha u Annas . U la long u kthaw kurim jong u Kaïaphas , uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ialam noh ia u sha u Anna nyngkong eh namar u long u kpa tymmen jong u Kaiaphas uba long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata kajuh ka snem .

en: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept , until they had no more power to weep .
kha: U Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la sdang ban ïam bad kim sangeh haduh ba ki la thait ïan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la pynkiew ia ka sur bad ki la iam haduh ba kim don bor shuh ban iam .

en: And David s two wives were taken captives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite .
kha: Wat ki tnga u Dabid ar ngut ruh , ka Ahinoam bad ka Abigail , ki la shah rong noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arngut ki tnga jong u Dabid ki la shah kem, u Ahinoam u Jesrilis bad u Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal u Karmelite .
