en: He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .
kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh ïa ka ; uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei un ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka ; bad uta uba shun ia ka jingim jong u ha kane ka pyrthei un bat ia ka haduh ka jingim bymjukut .

en: But now the  Lord  my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .
kha: Hynrei mynta U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ai ha nga ka jingshongsuk ha baroh ki pud ki sam jong nga . Ngam don nongshun , bad kam don kano kano jingma jong ka jingshah tur ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta U Trai U Blei jong nga u la ai jingjahthait ia nga na man la ki liang , kumta ym don u nongshun ne u bymman uba jia .

en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath  ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :
kha: Ngan leh ki kambah ha ka sahit bneng shajrong bad ïa ki jingphylla ha ka khyndew sha tbian . Kan don ka snam , ka ding , bad ka tdem kaba rben ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyni ia ki jingphylla ha bneng shaneng, bad ki dak ha ka khyndew hapoh ka snam ; bad ka ding bad ka lyer jong ka tdem:

en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy  ; then it was well with him : was not this to know me ? saith the  Lord .
kha: U bishar hok ïa kiba duk , bad baroh ki ïaid beit bad u . Kata ka long ka jingmut ban ithuh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bishar ia ka daw jong kiba duk bad kiba duk ; nangta kam shym la long kaba bha bad u: hato kane kam shym la ithuh ia nga ? ong U Trai .

en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father : there is one that accuseth you , even Moses , in whom ye trust .
kha: Pynban , wat pyrkhat ba dei ma nga u ban mudui ïa phi ha U Kpa jong nga . U Moses , ha uba phi la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen , dei ma u , u ban mudui ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyrkhat ba ngan kynnoh ia phi ha U Kpa: don uwei uba kynnoh ia phi, wat ia u Moses, ha uba phi shaniah .

en: And shall say , Cast ye up , cast ye up , prepare the way , take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban wan phai sha nga . Bret noh ïa ki jingpynwit baroh na ki lynti ïaid jong ki ! Shna ïa ka surok bad pynkhreh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ong , To leit shaneng, to leit shaneng, to pynkhreh ia ka lynti, to shim noh ia ka lynti kaba lyngngoh na ka lynti jong ki briew jong nga .

en: For ye have brought hither these men , which are neither robbers of churches , nor yet blasphemers of your goddess .
kha: Phi la wan ïalam ïa kine ki briew hangne , wat haba kim shym la lute ïa ki templ lane ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang ka blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la wanrah ia kine ki briew, ki bym dei ki nonglute jong ki balang , lymne ki nongkren bein ia ka blei jong phi .

en: For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples ,  Make them sit down by fifties in a company .
kha: ( La don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah hangta . ) U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  To pynshong ïa u paidbah ha ki kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long kumba san hajar ngut ki briew . Bad u la ong ha ki synran jong u , Pynlong ia ki ban shong da sanphew ngut ha ka kynhun .

en: But they hearkened not , nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness , to burn no incense unto other gods .
kha: Hynrei phim shahshkor satia lane pynleit jingmut . Phim iehnoh noh ïa ki jingmlien basniew ban kñia ha kiwei ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngap , lymne kim shym la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong ki ban phai noh na ka jingsniew jong ki , ban thang jingiwbih ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: For his merciful kindness is great toward us : and the truth of the  Lord  endureth for ever . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ka jingïaineh jong u ka long bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbhabriew jong u ka long kaba khraw ia ngi: bad ka jingshisha jong U Trai ka sah junom . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: Thou also , son of man , take thee a tile , and lay it before thee , and portray upon it the city , even Jerusalem :
kha: U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim uwei u maw-it , buh ïa u ha khmat jong me bad pruid dak ha u ban ïeng na ka bynta ka nongbah Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh, ko khun u briew, to shim ia ka tile, bad to buh ia ka ha khmat jong me, bad to pyni ia ka ha ka nongbah, wat ha Jerusalem:

en: And ye shall compass the city , all ye men of war , and go round about the city once . Thus shalt thou do six days .
kha: Ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me men ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah shisien shi sngi haduh hynriew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ker sawdong ia ka shnong , phi baroh ki briew kiba ialeh thma bad leit kylleng ka shnong shisien . Kumta to leh hynriew sngi .

en: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .
kha: Hynrei wat lada ngi kren kumne , ko paralok ba-ieit , ngi sngewskhem shaphang jong phi . Ngi tip ba phi ïoh ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba kham bha kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei, ko baieit, ngi shah pynbor ia kiei kiei kiba kham bha jong phi, bad kiei kiei kiba iadon ryngkat bad ka jingpynim, wat la ngi kren kumta .

en: And ye have seen their abominations , and their idols , wood and stone , silver and gold , which were among them : )
kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki bleithaw kiba isaitmet jong ki , kiba da u dieng , da u maw , da ka rupa , bad da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la iohi ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki, bad ki bleithaw jong ki, ki dieng bad ki maw, ki rupa bad ka ksiar, kiba la don hapdeng jong ki: )

en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk , of blind , halt , withered , waiting for the moving of the water .
kha: U paid uba bun jong ki briew kiba pang ki ïathiah ha ki baranda — kiba matlah , kiba dkoh , bad kiba ïapshiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kine ki don ka kynhun kaba khraw jong ki briew kiba khlem lah ban iohi, kiba matlah, kiba sahkut, kiba la tyrkhong, kiba ap ia ka jingkhih jong ka um .

en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kylli ka jingkylli ,  Kumno ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ki ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong , katba u dang hikai ha ka tempi , Kumno ki nongthoh ki ong ba U Khrist U long U Khun u Dabid ?

en: And Laban said , It is better that I give her to thee , than that I should give her to another man : abide with me .
kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Ka kham bha ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi ban ïa kaba nga ai ha uwei pat ; to sah hangne bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong, Ka kham bha ba ngan ai ia ka ha me, ban ia kaba nga ai ia ka ha uwei pat u briew: to kohnguh ia nga .

en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the  Lord  , and do all his commandments which I command thee this day .
kha: bad phin kohnguh biang ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban wan phai bad kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai , bad leh ia ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi .

en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof , and drove out the Amorites that were there .
kha: bad u Moses u phah ïa ki briew ban shem ka lynti babha tam kumno ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Jaser ; ki Israel ki la ïohknieh ïa ka bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la phah ban leit shabar Jazer , bad ki la shim ia ki shnong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ia ki Amorit kiba don hangta .

en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .
kha: Naba haba ngi long ha U Khrist Jisu , ka jingotsher lane ka jingbymdon jong ka kam don satia kano kano ka jingïapher ; kaei kaba kongsan ka long ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha U Jisu Khrist ym don ka jingkren bein, lymne ka jingbymkren bein ; hynrei ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingieit .

en: But without a parable spake he not unto them : and when they were alone , he expounded all things to his disciples .
kha: Um kren ha ki khlem pyndonkam da ki pharshi , hynrei haba u don tang bad ki synran , u batai ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khlem ka jingiathuhkhana um shym la kren ia ki: bad haba ki la don marwei , u la batai ia kiei kiei baroh ha ki synran jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .
kha: Katba u Moses u dang don ha Midian , U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit phai sha Ijipt , namar ba kito baroh kiba thmu ban pynïap ïa me ki la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses ha Madian, To leit phai noh sha Ijipt: namar ki briew baroh ki la iap kiba wad ia ka jingim jong me .

en: For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .
kha: Nga lah ban sakhi da lade hi ïa ka jingtrei shitom jong u na ka bynta jong phi bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba ha Laodikaïa bad ha Hierapolis .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kit ia u, ba u don ka jingkmen kaba khraw na ka bynta jong phi, bad kito kiba don ha Laodicea bad ia ki ha Jerapolit .

en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah : and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren , that they should not dwell in Shechem .
kha: U Abimelekh u shong ha Arumah , bad u Sebul u beh krad ïa u Gaal bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u na Shekhem , ba kumta kim lah shuh ban shong ban sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la shong ha Armah: bad u Zebul u la beh noh ia u Gaal bad ki hynmen jong u, ba kim dei ban shong ha Shehem .

en: Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .
kha: Hynrei mynta , to sheptieng ïa ka waitlam — ka waitlam kaba wanrah ïa ka jingbitar U Blei halor ka pop , khnang ba phin tip ba don uwei uba bishar .
translated_en_to_kha: To tieng ia ka waitlam: namar ka jingbitar ka wanrah ia ki jingpynshitom jong ka waitlam , ba phin tip ba ka don ka jingbishar .

en: Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .
kha: Ki paid Judah bad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki suk ki saiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah bad ki Israel ki la bun, kum ka dewbilat kaba don harud duriaw ha ka jingbun briew, ki bam bad ki dih bad ki ialehkai .

en: Now I say , That the heir , as long as he is a child , differeth nothing from a servant , though he be lord of all ;
kha: Hynrei mynta ban bteng biang — ïa u khun u ban sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u kpa jong u la ju ñiew tang kum u mraw katba u dang khynnah , wat la shisha u long trai ha kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga ong , Ba u nongioh pateng katba u dang long u khynnah , um iapher ei ei na u shakri wat la u long u kynrad jong baroh;

en: And Nathanael said unto him , Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth ? Philip saith unto him , Come and see .
kha: Hato kano kano kaba bha ka lah ban mih na Nasareth ?  U Nathanael u la kylli .  To wan bad khmih ,  la jubab u Philip .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathanael u la ong ha u, Hato ka lah ban mih ei ei kaba bha na Nazareth ? U Philip u ong ha u , To wan bad peit .

en: James , a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ , to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad , greeting .
kha: Na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai : Ka jingai khublei ïa baroh ki briew jong U Blei ba la pynsakma sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u shakri U Blei bad U Trai Jisu Khrist, ha ki shiphew jait kiba la saphriang shabar ri .

en: And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u khynnah rit bad pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki . U la buh ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u khynnah bad u la buh ia u hapdeng jong ki: bad haba u la shim ia u ha ki kti jong u , u la ong ha ki:

en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ki ka hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad u la ong ,  Ai ei ei ïa ka ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh jur ia ki ba ym don briew uba tip ia ka ; bad u la hukum ba dei ban ai ei ei ia ka ban bam .

en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers , to obey magistrates , to be ready to every good work ,
kha: To pynkynmaw ïa la ki briew ban pyndem ha ki nongsynshar bad ki bor synshar , ban kohnguh ïa ki , bad ban long kiba kloi ban leh ïa kaba bha da ki lad baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia ki ha ka jingmut ban long hapoh ki hima bad ki bor synshar , ban kohnguh ia ki majistor , ban long kiba la pynkhreh ha man la ka kam kaba bha , .

en: But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .
kha: Hynrei khyndiat ki symbai u la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha , bad ki jingthung ki la pynmih symboh ; katto katne ki la pynmih shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha, bad ki la pynmih soh, katto katne da ki shispah, katto katne da ki hynriewphew, katto katne da ki sanphew.

en: When the even was come , there came a rich man of Arimathaea , named Joseph , who also himself was Jesus  disciple :
kha: Haba la janmiet , u briew uba riewspah na Arimathaïa u la wan poi ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Joseph , bad u la long ruh u synran jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la poi ka janmiet , la wan uwei u briew uba riewspah na Arimathaea uba kyrteng u Joseph uba long ruh u synran U Jisu:

en: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that , they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith .
kha: Haba ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh ha ka kut ha Shekhem ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki wad jingïada hapoh ka kut baskhem jong ka templ jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew baroh jong ka tower jong u Shechem ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la rung ha ka jaka bat ia ka iing jong u blei Berit .

en: The  Lord  hath brought forth our righteousness : come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the  Lord  our God .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki pyrta , ‘ U  Trai  u la pyn-i ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei . Ïa ngin ïaleit bad ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wanrah ia ka hok jong ngi: to wan , bad to ngin pynbna ha Seion ia ka kam U Trai jong ngi .

en: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .
kha: Hynrei ma me to da sumar adkar ïa lade ha ki jingjia baroh ; to ïaishah shitom , trei ïa ka kam u nongïalap jong ka Khubor Babha , bad to pyndep ïa la ka kam baroh kum u shakri jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to peit ia me ha kiei kiei baroh, to shah ia ki jingjynjar, to leh ia ka kam jong u nongialap , to pynlong ia ka jingpynshisha kaba pura jong ka jingshakri jong me .

en: And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be grafted in : for God is able to graft them in again .
kha: Bad lada ki Jiw ki iehnoh ïa ka jingbymngeit jong ki , yn sa buh biang ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki ju don ; naba U Blei u lah ban leh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ruh lada kim kohnguh shuh shuh ha ka jingbymngeit: namar U Blei u lah ban pyndap biang ia ki .

en: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of : but the sorrow of the world worketh death .
kha: Naba ka jingsngewsih ïa kaba la pyndonkam da U Blei ka wanrah ïa ka jingkylla ha ka dohnud kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim — bad kam don ka jingbabe ha kata ! Hynrei ka jingsngewsih ba kynja briew ka ïalam sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingsngewsih kaba riewblei ka trei ia ka jingkylla kaba mut sha ka jingpynim ym ban kylla bamut: hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong ka pyrthei ka trei ia ka jingiap .

en: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven , the same is my brother , and sister , and mother .
kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa u ban leh u long u para jong nga , ka para jong nga , bad ka kmie jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno uba leh ia ka mon U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng, kumjuh ruh u hynmen bad ka para jong nga .

en: And the king s servants said unto him , Behold , Haman standeth in the court . And the king said , Let him come in .
kha: Kumta ki shakri ki ong ,  U Haman u don hangne , u dang ap ban ïakynduh bad phi .   Phah ïa u shapoh ,  ong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri syiem ki la ong ha u, Ha khmih u Haman u ieng ha ka iingbishar . Bad u syiem u la ong , To ai ba un wan rung .

en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .
kha: Kumta u Aaron u rah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki jakoid ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ki um Ijipt ; bad ki khnai ki la wan shaneng bad ki la tap ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: And satest upon a stately bed , and a table prepared before it , whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil .
kha: Ki da shong ha ki jingthiah ba-itynnat , bad ha khmat jong ki kin buh ïa ka miej ba la dap da kiei kiei kiba bha , ba kynthup ïa ki jingiwbih bad ka umphniang Olib kaba nga la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shong ha ka jingthiah kaba jem, bad ka miej ba la pynkhreh ha khmat jong ka, ha kaba me la buh ia ka jingiwbih jong nga bad ka umphniang jong nga .

en: And I give unto them eternal life  ; and they shall never perish , neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand .
kha: Nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kin ym ïap da lei lei ruh . Ym don uno uno uba lah ban knieh noh ïa ki na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ai ha ki ia ka jingim bymjukut ; bad kin ym jah noh satia, lymne uno uno un ym knieh ia ki na ka kti jong nga .

en: And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la shim ïa nga na ka kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa nga ban wan bad ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la shim ia nga katba nga dang bud ia ka kynhun langbrot, bad U Trai u la ong ha nga, To leit iathuhlypa ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel .

en: And Abimelech charged all his people , saying , He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death .
kha: U Abimelekh u la maham ïa ki briew baroh ;  Uno uno uba lehbeiñ ïa une u briew lane ïa ka tnga jong u , un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la kynnoh ia ki briew jong u baroh, u da ong: Uta uba ktah ia une u briew ne ka tnga jong u un shah pyniap shisha .

en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners : thy wise men , O Tyre , that were in thee , were thy pilots .
kha: Ki maji jong pha ki long na ki nongbah ka Sidon bad Arbad . Ki rangbah batbit jong pha hi ki la long ki maji .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshong shnong jong u Sidon bad u Arvad ki long ki nongleit jingleit jong me: ki riewstad jong me, ko Tyros, kiba la don ha me, ki long ki nongpyniaid jong me .

en: In addition , the actor also made his hotel , located in Mumbai , available for healthcare workers ' accommodation .
kha: Nalor kata u aktor u la pynlong ruh ia ka hotel jong u kaba don ha Mumbai ban pynbiang ia ki jaka sah jong ki nongtrei ka koit ka khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, u aktor u la pynlong ruh ia ka hotel jong u, kaba don ha Mumbai , kaba lah ban ioh na ka bynta ki nongtrei ka koit ka khiah .

en: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .
kha: Pynban , ki dei ban pyn-i ba ki long borabor kiba bha bad ba lah ban shaniah , khnang ban pynshisha ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ha baroh ba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba sngewsih , hynrei kaba pyni ia ka jinglong babha baroh; ba kin pynitynnad ia ka jinghikai U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .
kha: Bad ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem bad ban bat ïa ka junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki riewkhuid jong Uba ha khlieh duh kin shim ia ka hima bad kin don ia ka hima junom .

en: As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Namar ka jutang jong nga bad phi kaba la shonshab da ka snam jong ki jingkñia , ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba laitluid na ki thliew bym don um jong ka jingshah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia me ruh da ka snam jong ka jutang jong me nga la phah noh ia ki koidi jong me na ka thliew ha kaba ym don um .

en: So he called every one of his lord s debtors unto him , and said unto the first , How much owest thou unto my lord ?
kha: Kumta u la khot shapoh ïa ki briew baroh kiba shahram ha u kynrad jong u . U la ong ïa uba nyngkong , ‘ Sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ïa u kynrad jong nga ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la khot ia uwei pa uwei na ki nongkit ram jong u ha u , bad u la ong ha uba nyngkong , Katno phi donkam ia u kynrad jong nga ?

en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?
kha: Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Israel Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jied ia ki blei thymmai ; nangta ka la long ka thma ha ki khyrdop: hato ka la don ka jingda ne ka khnam kaba la iohi hapdeng sawphew hajar ha Israel ?

en: And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?
kha: U syiem u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Phim ïasngewthuh ba ha kane ka sngi uwei u nongïalam bakhraw ha Israel u la ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki shakri jong u: Hato phim tip ba don u syiem bad u briew uba khraw uba la hap ha kane ka sngi ha Israel ?

en: But they held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
kha: Ki briew ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la lah ong ha ki ; kim shym la ong shikyntien ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki, bad kim jubab ia u: namar ka hukum jong u syiem ka long, da kaba ong , Wat jubab ia u .

en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
kha: U Pharaoh un sa tharai ba ki Israel ki la phet sakma bad ba ki la shah khang kut ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Pharaoh un ong ia ki khun Israel , Ki la shah pynthut ha ka ri , ka ri khlaw ka la khang ia ki .

en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven , but he that came down from heaven , even the Son of man which is in heaven .
kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba la ju leit kiew sha bneng lait tang U Khun U Briew , uba la wan hiar na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don briew uba la kiew sha bneng , hynrei uta uba la wan hiar na bneng , wat U Khun u briew uba don ha bneng .

en: And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .
kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kin dep duwai ha nga , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia , ba shuwa ba kin khot , ngan jubab ; bad katba ki dang kren , ngan iohsngew .

en: Jesus answered them ,  Many good works have I shewed you from my Father  ; for which of those works do ye stone me ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la leh shibun ki kam babha ha khmat jong phi ïa kiba U Kpa u la ai ïa nga ban leh ; kano na kine ba phi kwah ban lynthem maw ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki , Bun ki kam babha nga la pyni ia phi na U Kpa jong nga ; na kita ki kam phi maw ia nga ?

en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
kha: Kane baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah sanphew snem .  Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la ai ha ki ia ki nongbishar kumba saw spah sanphew snem haduh u Samuel u nongiathuhlypa .

en: As for God , his way is perfect  ; the word of the  Lord  is tried : he is a buckler to all them that trust in him .
kha: Une U Blei — ki kam jong u ki long kiba janai ; ki ktien jong u kiba lah ban shaniah ! U long kum ka stieh ïa baroh kiba wad jingïada jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia U Blei, ka lynti jong u ka long kaba janai; u long u nongkyrshan ia kito baroh kiba shaniah ha u .

en: But the fields of the city , and the villages thereof , gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession .
kha: Pynban , ïa ki pyntha jong ka nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit jong ka la lah ai ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki lyngkha jong ka shnong bad ki shnong jong ka ki la ai ha u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh na ka bynta ka jingdon jong u .

en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter , enquire who in it is worthy  ; and there abide till ye go thence .
kha: Haba phi poi sha ka nongbah ne ka nongrit , leit rung shapoh bad wad ïa uno uno uba mon ban pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , bad sah bad u tad ynda phi mihnoh na kata ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kano kano ka shnong ne shnong kaba phi rung, to kylli mano ha ka ba dei hok bad hangta to sah haduh ba phin da leit shata .

en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .
kha: Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym don mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng jong phi , lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To long uba la kyrkhu halor ki briew baroh: ym dei ban don shynrang ne kynthei hapdeng jong phi , ne hapdeng ki masi jong phi .

en: Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .
kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na pha . Nga kyllan umphniang Olib halor ka sniehdoh jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la sait ia me da ka um ; yea , nga la sait bha ia ka snam jong me na me , bad nga la pynsleh ia me da ka umphniang .

en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !
kha: Ka Babilonia ka la tied tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad mynta uta u tyrnem u khynñiuh ! Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la jia ïa kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ka hammer jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la shah ot bad shah pynpra ! kumno ka Babilon ka kylla long ka jingpynjot hapdeng ki jaitbynriew !

en: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph , to direct his face unto Goshen  ; and they came into the land of Goshen .
kha: U Jakob u phah ïa u Judah ban nang leit sha khmat ban ong ïa u Joseph ban wan ïakynduh bad u ha Goshen .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u Judah ha khmat jong u ha u Joseph, ban pynbeit ia ka khmat jong u sha Goshen ; bad ki la poi ha ka ri Goshen .

en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering  ; for it was without number .
kha: La don kyrhai eh u kew kat haduh ba u Joseph um donkam shuh ban da thew ïa u — u la long kum u shyiap ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la lum ia u kew kum ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw, shibun eh, haduh ba u la iehnoh ia u ; namar ba u la long khlem jingkhein .

en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?
kha: Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi bad ban ym kohnguh ïa U Blei jong ngi da kaba shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngin sngap ia phi ban leh ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw baroh , ban iaid lait ia U Blei jong ngi ha kaba shongkurim ia ki tnga kiba phylla ?

en: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying , Haste thee , and come  ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .
kha: Hamar kata ka por u nonglamktien u wan poi bad u ong ha u Saul ,  Wan phai noh shisyndon ! Ki Philistia ki la wan hiarthma ïa ka ri !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la wan u nonglam khubor ha u Saul, u da ong: To wan noh sha me, bad to wan; namar ki Philistia ki la hiar thma ia kata ka ri .

en: And they kept that saying with themselves , questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean .
kha: Ki la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u , hynrei para ma ki , ki la sdang ban ïakren shaphang kane ,  Aïu kane ‘ kaba mihpat na ka jingïap’ ka mut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la iai bteng ia kata da kaba ong bad ki hi, da kaba kylli iwei ia iwei pat kaei kaba ka jingmih na kiba iap ka dei ban mut .

en: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him : but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .
kha: Ki briew ki tim ïa uno uno uba set ïa u kew , ban ap haba un kiew dor , hynrei ki ïaroh ïa uno uno uba sei ban die ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba khang ia u kew , ki briew kin tim ia u: hynrei ka jingkyrkhu kan long halor ka khlieh jong uta uba pynkhih ia ka .

en: For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .
kha: U Isaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki soh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , bad un sa jem .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Isaiah u la ong , Ai ba kin shim ia ka lum ki sohjew bad kin buh ia ka ha ka jaka ba la khleh lang bad un koit noh .

en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places .
kha: Um shym pyntwa noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai ki jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ym shym la weng noh ia ki jaka ba jrong: haduh mynta ki briew ki la knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: And always , night and day , he was in the mountains , and in the tombs , crying , and cutting himself with stones .
kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet u ju shang ha ki jaka tep briew bad ki jaka lum , da kaba lynñiar bad ot ïa lade da ki maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad man ka por, miet bad sngi, u la don ha ki lum, bad ha ki jingtep, u iam bad u ot ia lade da ki maw .

en: And his brightness was as the light  ; he had horns coming out of his hand : and there was the hiding of his power .
kha: U wan bad ka jingthaba ka leilieh ; ka jingshai ka phalang na ka kti jong u , dei hangta ba ka bor jong u ka rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingshai jong u ka long kum ka jingshai ; u don ki bniat kiba mih na ka kti jong u: bad ka la don ka jingbuhrieh ia ka bor jong u .

en: And he took him by the right hand , and lifted him up : and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength .
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u na ka kti kamon jong u bad u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u . Shisyndon ki kjat bad ki matsohlah jong une u briew ki la khlaiñ ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u da ka kti kadiang, bad u la pynkiew ia u: bad mar kumta hi ki kjat bad ki shyieng kjat jong u ki la ioh bor .

en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;
kha: U Laban u ong ha u Jakob ,  Kane ka kynton maw kan long ka jingpynkynmaw ïa ngi baroh ar ngut .  Namar kata , la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Galeed .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong , Kane ka kynhun ka long ka sakhi hapdeng jong nga bad me ha kane ka sngi . Namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Galeed ; .

en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .
kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la nang kham lieh blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong u kim tip shuh kumno yn leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Belshasar u la sngewsih shibun, bad ka khmat jong u ka la kylla ha u, bad ki kynrad jong u ki la lyngngoh .

en: Therefore we are always confident , knowing that , whilst we are at home in the body , we are absent from the Lord :
kha: Kumta ngi long borabor kiba dap da ka jingshlur . Ngi tip ba katba ngi dang don ha kane ka met ngi don jngai na ka ïing ka jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi ju sngewskhem , da kaba tip ia kata , katba ngi dang don ha iing ha ka met , ngi la jah na U Trai :

en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .
kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ei ei , ïathuh ha u , ‘ U Kynrad u donkam ïa ki ;’ bad nangta un sa pyllait ïa ki shisyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ia phi, phin ong , U Trai u donkam ia ki ; bad mardor un phah ia ki .

en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite , and Joshua the son of Nun : for they have wholly followed the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa uwei pa uwei baroh , lait noh u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh uba na ka jait Kenis bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ; ki la ïailong kiba kohnguh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh u Kenezite bad u Joshua u khun u Nun : namar ki la bud pura ia U Trai .

en: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki kiba la ong ba ka dei ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U angel u la kren ha u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew namarkata, kiba ieng hajan, bad kiba iohsngew ia ka, ki la ong ba ka la pyrta: kiwei pat ki la ong: U angel u la kren ia u .

en: The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .
kha: ym tang bad ki kpa jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi baroh ruh kiba dang im haduh mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai um shym la leh ia kane ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi ruh ngi baroh ngi dang im mynta ka sngi .

en: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kaba ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïashim bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ha ka jingïabam lang bad ha ki jingduwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bteng stet ha ka jinghikai bad ka jingiasyllok jong ki apostol , bad ha kaba bret ia u kpu bad ha ki jingduwai .

en: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;
kha: Lada u briew u weng ïa ka jingtap na ka thliew , ne lada u tih thliew bad um tap ïa ka , bad u masi ne u kada u hap hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew un plie ia ka thliew, lane lada u briew un tih ia ka thliew, bad um tap ia ka, bad u masi ne u kada un hap ha ka ; .

en: Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .
kha: Ki long ki shipai ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki long ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la phong da ki jain rong saw, ki kapten bad ki nongsynshar , baroh ki samla kiba kwah , ki nongshong kulai kiba shong kulai .

en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; kiba bieit kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad ka shong ha ka dohnud jong uta uba don ka jingsngewthuh: hynrei ia kata kaba don hapdeng ki bieit la pynpaw .

en: I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,
kha: Ngan ïeng joit bad leit sha i pa jong nga bad ong ,  Ko pa , nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ieng bad leit sha u kpa jong nga bad ngan ong ha u: Ko Kpa nga la leh pop pyrshah ia ka bneng bad ha khmat jong me .

en: And of Benjamin  ; Eliada a mighty man of valour , and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand .
kha: U nongïalam jong ki shipai na ka kur Benjamin u dei u Eliada , u shipai batbit , uba long halor ki ar lakh ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Benjamin ; Eliada u briew uba khlain bor, bad bad u ki briew kiba don ka bow bad ka shipai arspah hajar .

en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?
kha: Haba ki nongap phira ki la leit phai noh , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi khlem wan ïalam ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah ki la wan sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi bad ki la ong ha ki: Balei phim wanrah ia u ?

en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and bind herself by a bond , being in her father s house in her youth  ;
kha: Haba ka theisamla kaba dang sah bad la u kpa ka kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane ka kular ban kyndiah na kano kano ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka kynthei ruh ka kular ha U Trai , bad ka teh ia lade da ka jingiadei , ka jingdon ha iing u kpa jong ka ha ka por samla jong ka;

en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .
kha: Baroh ki wad jingtip na u ban sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki syiem baroh jong ka khyndew ki la wad ia ka jingdon jong u Solomon , ban iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong u , ba U Blei u la buh ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
kha: U buh ïa kata ka jingbam baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh lut ha ki kti u Aaron bad ha ki kti jong u khun shynrang jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ki na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai .

en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .
kha: Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Uwei pa uwei na phi u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u ong ,  Nga bud ïa u Paul ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Apollos ;  uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa u Petros ;  bad uwei pat ,  Nga bud ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kane nga ong , ba uwei pa uwei na phi u ong , Nga long u Paul ; bad nga u Apollos ; bad nga u Apollos ; bad nga u Khrist .

en: For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .
kha: U  Trai  u la lah kular ba ma u hi un long ka kynroh ding sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban ïada ïa ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong , U Trai , un long ha ka ka kynroh ding sawdong jong ka , bad kan long ka burom hapdeng jong ka .

en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Shen shen hadien ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba sdang ka jingsynshar u Jehoiakim u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah u la wan kane ka ktien na U Trai da kaba ong:

en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .
kha: Kam dei kata kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid kat kum ka lehniam ; pynban , dei kaba mih shabar na ka , kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym kata kaba leit shapoh ka shyntur ka pynjakhlia ia u briew ; hynrei kata kaba mih na ka shyntur , kane ka pynjakhlia ia u briew .

en: And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .
kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ,  Ka kam runar aïu u la leh ?  Nangta ki la sdang ban pyrta da ka sur kaba jam tam :  Sahnarphna ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: U Lat u la ong, Balei, kaei kaba sniew kaba u la leh ? Hynrei ki la pyrta kham bun da kaba ong: To ai ba un shah sahnarphna .

en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?
kha: Kumta ki la bret ïa u shabar jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki la pynïap ïa u .  Kaei , te , ba u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la bret noh ia u na ka kper sohjew bad ki la pyniap ia u . Kaei namarkata ka kynrad jong ka kper sohjew kan leh ia ki ?

en: While the sun , or the light , or the moon , or the stars , be not darkened , nor the clouds return after the rain :
kha: Kata ka long haba ka jingshai jong ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur kan sdang lip ïa phi , bad ki lyoh slap kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka sngi ne ka jingshai ne u bnai ne ki khlur kim shah rong saw, lymne ki lyoh ki wan phai hadien u slap:

en: Nevertheless we , according to his promise , look for new heavens and a new earth , wherein dwelleth righteousness .
kha: Hynrei ngi ap ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular : Ïa ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ïa ka khyndew kaba thymmai , ha kaba ka hok kan don .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ngi , kat kum ka jingkular jong u , ngi wad ia ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka pyrthei kaba thymmai , ha kaba ka hok ka shong .

en: For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .
kha: Kumta to kup ka jaiñ khain , bad to ïam bad ud sngewsih namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai kam shym la phai noh na ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingkren bein ia phi da ka jain lyngkhuid , bad ka howl: namar ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai kam shym la kylla na ngi .

en: This is the third time I am coming to you . In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established .
kha: Kane ka long mynta ka sien kaba lai ba nga wan jngoh ïa phi . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa kano kano ka jingmudui dei ban pynksan da ka jingpynshisha da ki ar ngut ki sakhi ne tam ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka sien kaba lai ba nga wan sha phi . Ha ka shyntur jong ki ar ne lai ngut ki sakhi yn pynskhem ia kawei pa kawei ka ktien .

en: And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .
kha: U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la don bad u Joseph , bad u la long u briew uba riewspah ; bad u la don ha iing u kynrad jong u u nong Ijipt .

en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .
kha: Wat ai phlangïap    shuh ïa kine ki briew ban shna maw-it . Ieh kin leit ïawad phlangïap hi da lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim ai shuh ia ki briew ban shna nar, kumba la ju long: pyllait noh ia ki bad lum ia ki sboh na ka bynta lade .

en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .
kha: Te phi ong , ‘ Lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan lang bad phi , yn ym shah shuh ïa phi ban wan ha khmat jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ong ha ki shakri jong me , Lait noh tang u hynmen uba rit tam jong phi un wan hiar bad phi , phin ym iohi shuh ia ka khmat jong nga .

en: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus  knees , saying , Depart from me  ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .
kha: Haba u Simon Petros u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat U Jisu bad u la ong ,  Khie leit noh na nga , ko Trai ! Nga long u briew uba pop !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Simon Petros u la iohi ia ka, u la dem khrup ha U Jisu, u da ong: To leit noh na nga; namar nga long u briew uba pop, ko Trai .

en: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he  ; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet , baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew mar la ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la phohsniew ha kawei ka miet , ma nga bad ma u; ngi la phohsniew ia uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingbatai jong u .

en: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash , and the other southward over against Gibeah .
kha: Uwei u don ha ka phang bashatei jong ka khim , u da phai sha Mikhmash , bad uwei pat ha ka phang bashathie , u da phai sha Geba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta ba shakhmat jong uta ka la don shaphang shathie shaphang mihngi pyrshah ia u Michmash, bad kawei pat shaphang shathie pyrshah ia u Gibeah .

en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph s house  ; for he was yet there : and they fell before him on the ground .
kha: Haba u Judah bad ki hynmen ki para jong u ki la wan sha ïing u Joseph , ki shem ba u dang don hi hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah bad ki hynmen jong u ki la wan sha ka iing u Joseph; namar u dang don hangta : bad ki la hap ha khmat jong u ha madan .

en: And the angel answered and said unto the women , Fear not ye : for I know that ye seek Jesus , which was crucified .
kha: U angel u la kren ha ki kynthei .  Phim dei ban sheptieng ,  u la ong .  Nga tip phi ïawad ïa U Jisu , uba la shah sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki kynthei, Wat tieng ia phi: namar nga tip ba phi wad ia U Jisu uba la sahnarphna .

en: And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother s blood from thy hand  ;
kha: La buh ïa me hapoh ka jingtim bad men ym lah shuh ban rep ha ka khyndew . Ka la kjit noh ïa ka snam u para jong me , i kumba ka la ang ïa la ka shyntur ban pdiang ïa kata mynba me la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta me la shah tim na ka khyndew kaba la plie ia ka shyntur jong ka ban pdiang ia ka snam hynmen jong me na ka kti jong me ; .

en: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom , but none shall be there , and all her princes shall be nothing .
kha: Yn ym don syiem u ban synshar ïa ka ri , bad ki nongïalam baroh kim don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin khot ia ki rangbah jong ka sha ka hima , hynrei ym don uwei ruh hangta , bad ki syiem jong ka baroh kin ym long ei ei .

en: Now therefore , I pray you , tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the  Lord  will say unto me more .
kha: Hynrei sngewbha to ïasah miet mynta ruh , ba nga lah ban ïoh tip aïu pat U  Trai  un ong ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata, nga kyrpad ia phi, to sah hangne ruh mynta ka miet, ba ngan tip ia kaei kaba U Trai un ong kham bun ha nga .

en: The owner of the pit shall make it good , and give money unto the owner of them  ; and the dead beast shall be his .
kha: u trai jong kata ka thliew u dei ban buria da ka pisa ïa u trai jong uta u jingri , bad un ïoh ïa ka metïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U trai jong ka thliew un pynbha ia ka, bad un ai pisa ia u trai jong ki ; bad u mrad uba la iap un long u jong u .

en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;
kha: Ïa phi ruh , la tei ha ka nongrim ba la buh da ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa , u mawdong uba long U Khrist Jisu hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la tei halor ka nongrim jong ki apostol bad ki nongiathuhlypa , U Jisu Khrist hi u long u maw ba kongsan;

en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa u Joahas u khun jong u Josaïah bad ki pynsleh syiem ïa u ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka ri ki la shim ia u khun u Josiah bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u ha ka jaka jong u kpa jong u ha Jerusalem .

en: They shall lift up their voice , they shall sing for the majesty of the  Lord  , they shall cry aloud from the sea .
kha: Kito kiba lait im kin rwai da ka jingkmen . Kito kiba don ha sepngi kin ïathuh katno ba U  Trai  u long uba khraw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kin rah ia ka sur jong ki, kin rwai na ka bynta ka jingkhraw jong U Trai , kin pyrta jam na duriaw .

en: And they said unto Joshua , We are thy servants . And Joshua said unto them , Who are ye ? and from whence come ye ?
kha: Ki ong ha u Joshua ,  Ngi kloi ban shakri ïa phi .  U Joshua u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi dei mano ? Nangno phi ïawan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u Joshua , Ngi long ki shakri jong me . U Joshua u la ong ha ki , Phi long mano ? bad naei phi wan ?

en: Do ye not yet understand , neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?
kha: Hato phim pat shemphang ? Phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki rangbah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pyndap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim pat sngewthuh , lymne kynmaw ia ki san tylli ki kpu jong ki san hajar , bad katno tylli ki basket phi la shim ?

en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .
kha: Hynrei u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban u la thiah ha ka khyrdop ïingsyiem lem bad ki nongap phira jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Uri u la thiah ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing syiem bad ki shakri jong u kynrad jong u baroh .

en: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,
kha: U bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana bad u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata kam leh ei ei na kita ki kam, hynrei wat ka la bam ha ki lum , bad ka la pynjakhlia ia ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u .

en: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :
kha: Ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrpad jur ïa u ,  Une u briew u dei hok shisha ban ïoh ïa ka jingïarap jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la poi ha U Jisu , ki la kyrpad ia u mardor , ki da ong: Ba u long uba bit na ka bynta jong u:

en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour : other men laboured , and ye are entered into their labours .
kha: Nga la phah ïa phi ban ot ha kata ka lyngkha kaba phim shym la trei ; kiwei ki la trei hangta , bad phi ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phah ia phi ban kheit ia kata ha kaba phim shym la trei: kiwei pat ki briew ki la trei shitom , bad phi la rung ha ki jingtrei shitom jong ki .

en: The land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephthalim , by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles  ;
kha: Ko ka ri Sebulun bad ka ri Naphtali , kaba ha lynti sha ka duriaw , ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , ka Galilaïa , ka ri ki Jentil !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri u Sebulon bad ka ri u Nephthalim, da ka lynti jong ka duriaw, sha lyndet ka Jordan , Galilaia jong ki Jutang;

en: And again he sent another servant : and they beat him also , and entreated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .
kha: Kumta u la phah sa uwei pat u mraw ; hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa une ruh , ki da leh pynjahburom ïa u , bad ki la phah noh thylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la phah ia uwei pat u shakri: bad ki la shoh ia u ruh, bad ki la pynjah burom ia u da kaba pynjah burom ia u, bad ki la phah noh ia u thylli .

en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .
kha: Katba ki dang don ha ka miej ban ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang shong bad bam , U Jisu u la ong , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Uwei na phi uba bam bad nga un die noh ia nga .

en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?
kha: Kumta , te , balei mem buh ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa ? Nangta te ngan jin da la ïohpdiang pat ïa ka lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata te wat ai ia ka pisa jong nga ha bank, ba ha ka jingwan jong nga nga lah ban dawa ia la ka jong ka pisa ?

en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep , he goeth before them , and the sheep follow him : for they know his voice .
kha: Haba u la pynmih ïa ki shabar , u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki , bad ki langbrot ki bud ïa u , namar ba ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u buh ia la ki jong ki langbrot , u leit ha khmat jong ki , bad ki langbrot ki bud ia u: namar ki tip ia ka sur jong u .

en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :
kha: Wat pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei lane ki khunswet , bad wat shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong ka riewkynthei kum ka bynda ïa kano kano ka ram .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynkylla ia ka jingbishar jong u nongwei, ne jong ki bym don kpa;

en: And I will take thee , and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .
kha: Jeroboam , ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel , bad men synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kat kaba me kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shim ia me bad me long u syiem katba ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah, bad me long syiem halor ki Israel .

en: And to you who are troubled rest with us , when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels ,
kha: bad un ai ka jingpyllait ha phi kiba shahshitom bad ha ngi ruh kumjuh . Un leh ïa kane haba U Trai Jisu u mihpaw na bneng lem bad ki angel bakhlaiñbor jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha phi kiba la shah pynshitom bad ngi , haba U Trai Jisu un sa paw na bneng ryngkat bad ki angel kiba donbor jong u .

en: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain , and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches :
kha: Ki sim kin wan bad dem ha u dieng uba la khyllem , bad ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid halor ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingjot jong u baroh ki sim bneng kin sah , bad ki mrad baroh ki ri kin don ha ki tnat jong u:

en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , that the table may be borne with them .
kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki dieng shittim , bad to tap ia ki da ka ksiar , ba ka miej kan long kaba la kit bad ki .

en: And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;
kha: Haba ka la shai , u la khot ïa la ki synran sha u bad u la jied khat-ar ngut na ki , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , ki apostol :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la dei ka sngi, u la khot ia ki synran jong u: bad na ki u la jied ia ki shiphew ngut, kiba u la jer kyrteng ruh;

en: And saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned unto you , and ye have not lamented .
kha: ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingrwai shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym la shad ! Ngi la rwai ïa ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym la ïam !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba ong , Ngi la ia tyngkhuh bad phi , bad phim shym la shad ; ngi la iam ha phi , bad phim shym la iam .

en: And it came to pass , that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather , and they found none .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , don katto kane ngut ki briew kiba leit ban lum jingbam , hynrei kim shym shem ei ei ruh em .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba don ki briew ha ka sngi kaba hynriew ban lum lang bad kim lap ei ei .

en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , saith the  Lord  , whose name is The God of hosts .
kha: haba ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha ka ri sha lyndet ka Damaskos ,  ong U  Trai  , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan pynlong ia phi ban leit sha ka jinglong mraw shabar jong ka Damaskos , ong U Trai , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Blei jong ki paid .

en: That which dieth of itself , or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith : I am the  Lord .
kha: Um bit ban bam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba shu ïap hi , lane uba la shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw ; kata kan pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba iap hi, ne kaba la tyrkhong bad ki mrad , un ym bam ban pynjakhlia ia lade da kata: Nga long U Trai .

en: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day , the same soul will I destroy from among his people .
kha: Bad lada uno uno u trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi , nga hi ngan pynjot ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kano kano ka mynsiem kaba leh ia kano kano ka kam ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ia kata kajuh ka mynsiem ngan pynjot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour , and he was the son of an harlot : and Gilead begat Jephthah .
kha: U Jephthah , u shipai bashlur na Gilead u dei u khun jong ka nuti . U kpa jong u , u Gilead
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Jephthah u Gilead u long u briew uba khlain bor bad u long u khun jong u nongkhaïi: bad u Gilead u la kha ïa u Jephthah .

en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )
kha: bad u hukum ba yn hikai ïa ka ha ki briew ka Judah . ( La buh jingkynmaw ha  Ka Kitab U Jashar . )
translated_en_to_kha: (U la bthah ruh ia ki ban hikai ia ki khun Judah ia ka jingpyndonkam ia ka bow: ha khmih , la thoh ha ka Kitab u Jasher . )

en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs : bright iron , cassia , and calamus , were in thy market .
kha: Ki briew ka Damaskos ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih jong pha , da kaba siewdor da ka waiñ na Helbon bad u  saiwul na Sahar . Ki ïakylliang da ki nar ba la shoh stang bad ki musli musla na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dan ruh bad u Javan ki leit sha ki fair jong me: ka nar kaba shai, ka Cassia bad ka calamus, ki la don ha ka iew jong me.

en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put it upon a bar .
kha: Phin thung ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban pyndep ïa ki kamram ka jinglong lyngdoh ; uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin buh ia ka bad ki tiar jong ka baroh hapoh ka jingtap jong ki sniehdoh bad kin buh ia ka ha ka bar .

en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .
kha: To kylla-kaba-mut , te , na kane ka jingthmu bymman jong me , bad duwai ha U Trai ba un map ïa me na kaba pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kane .
translated_en_to_kha: To kylla namarkata na kane ka jingsniew jong me bad duwai ia U Blei , lada lehse ka jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud jong me ka lah ban map ia me .

en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , ka jingainguh bam jong u bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , La shem ia ka jingthmu hapdeng ki briew jong ka Judah bad hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem .

en: This is the book of the generations of Adam . In the day that God created man , in the likeness of God made he him  ;
kha: Kane ka dei ka thup kyrteng jong ki khun ki ksiew u Adam . ( Mynba U Blei U la thaw ïa ki briew , u la thaw ïa ki ha ka dur jong U hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka kot jong ki pateng u Adam . Ha ka sngi ba U Blei u la thaw ia u briew , ha ka jingiasyriem U Blei u la pynlong ia u;

en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem , nga la ïeng harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba sawphew snem jong u bnai uba nyngkong, kumba nga la don ha rud ka wah bah kaba long ka Hiddekel ; .

en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered , even Jesus , made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .
kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi U Jisu u la rung hapoh hangta shuwa jong ngi , bad u la jia long U Rangbah Lyngdoh junom , ha ka rukom long lyngdoh u Melkhisedek .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u nongmihkhmat u la rung, wat U Jisu ruh u la long u lyngdoh rangbah junom hadien ka jingpynbeit jong u Melchisedec .

en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and smoking flax shall he not quench , till he send forth judgment unto victory .
kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la kdor lane pynlip ïa u  sai sharak ba dang mehding . Un ïaineh tad haduh ba un pynlong ïa ka jinglehhok ban jop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sniehdoh kaba la tyrkhong kan ym bthei, bad ka jingdih duma kan ym bthei, haduh ba un da phah ia ka jingbishar sha ka jingjop .

en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
kha: Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta kin sa shahjingit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki sngi kin sa wan , haba yn weng noh ia u nongleit kurim na ki , bad nangta kin sa shah jingit ha kita ki sngi .

en: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne , who liveth for ever and ever ,
kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki rwai ki jingrwai jong ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom bad ki jingsngewnguh ïa uta uba shong ha ka khet , bad mane ïa uta uba im junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kita ki mrad ki ai burom bad burom bad ainguh ia uta uba shong ha ka khet , uba im junom .

en: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .
kha: Hynrei kam long tang kumta ; ngi lehkmen na ka bynta kaei kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba mynta u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym tang kumta , hynrei ngi ruh ngi sngewkmen ha U Blei lyngba U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , da uba ngi la ioh mynta ia ka jingpynkhuid .

en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .
kha: U Abraham bad ka Sarah ki la tymmen bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por ban dang ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Abraham bad ka Sarah ki la tymmen bad ki la tyrkhong bha ha ka rta ; bad ka la sangeh noh ban don bad ka Sarah katkum ka rukom jong ki kynthei .

en: Now if Timothy come , see that he may be with you without fear : for he worketh the work of the Lord , as I also do .
kha: Lada u Timothi un wan poi ïaid lynti sha phi , da pynthikna ba un sngew ba phi pdiang sngewbha hapdeng jong phi , namar u trei na ka bynta U Trai , kum ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada u Timothi u wan, to peit ba un don ryngkat bad phi khlem jingtieng: namar u trei ia ka kam U Trai kumba nga ruh nga trei .

en: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .
kha: Ki la tip tang ïa kaei ba kiwei pat ki ong :  U briew uba la ju pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi mynta pat u ïalap ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba shisien u la pyrshang ban pynduh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la iohsngew tang , Ba uta uba la pynshitom bein ia ngi ha ki por ba la leit noh mynta u ialap ia ka jingngeit kaba u la pynjot shisien .

en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
kha: Balei ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat jong u para jong phi , hynrei phim pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha ka khmat jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei me iohi ia ka mote kaba don ha ka khmat jong u hynmen jong me , hynrei wat sngewthuh ia ka beam kaba don ha la ka jong ka khmat ?

en: And God looked upon the earth , and , behold , it was corrupt  ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .
kha: U Blei u la khmih ïa ka pyrthei bad u la ïohi ba ka la sniew , namar ki briew baroh ki la im ka jingim kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la peit ia ka khyndew bad, ha khmih, ka la bamsap ; namar ka doh baroh ka la pynsniew ia ka lynti jong u ha ka khyndew .

en: And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all .
kha: bad to kan long ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh uba ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong phi !  Bad u Abram u ai ha u Melkhisedek ïa kaba shiphew na ka jinglute kaba u la lah pynïoh pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la kyrkhu ia U Blei uba ha khlieh duh uba la aiti ia ki nongshun jong me ha ka kti jong me . Bad u la ai ia u shiphew na baroh .

en: They answered again and said , Let the king tell his servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation of it .
kha: Ki la jubab biang ïa u syiem ,  Lada u Syiem Kynrad un shu ïathuh ïa ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ngin batai ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab biang bad ki la ong , To ai ba u syiem un iathuh ia ki shakri jong u ia ka jingphohsniew , bad ngin pyni ia ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .
kha: Un sa long uba khuid hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep , bad nangta u lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang , kiba dei ka jingbam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la sep ka sngi , un long uba khuid bad hadien un bam ia kiei kiei kiba kyntang ; namar ka long ka jingbam jong u .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Wallam ïa u paidbhur ban pynshyrkhei ïa ki bad ban lute ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei un wanrah ia ka kynhun halor jong ki, bad ngan ai ia ki ban shah weng noh bad shah pynsniew .

en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them , in the two ends of the mercy seat .
kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kherub da ka ksiar kaba la shoh tylli ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shna ar tylli ki cherub ksiar, jong ka kam ba la shoh men shna ia ki, ha ki arliang jong ka jaka shong jingisynei .

en: And Asahel pursued after Abner  ; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner .
kha: u la sdang ban beh kthong ïa u Abner , u da mareh beit beit sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asahel u la bud ia u Abner bad ha kaba u leit um phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang na kaba bud ia u Abner .

en: Furthermore the  Lord  spake unto me , saying , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ruh ha nga , ‘ Nga tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh U Trai u la kren ha nga, u da ong, nga la iohi ia une u briew, bad, ha khmih, ka long ka briew kaba la tyrkhong:

en: Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?
kha: Nangta ki nongbud jong U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki da kylli ,  Balei ba ma ngi bad ki Pharisi ngi shahjingit bunsien , hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shahjingit da lei lei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran u loannis ki la wan sha u, ki da ong, Balei ngi bad ki Pharisi ngi ju shah jingit bunsien hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shah jingit ?

en: And he saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  And Peter answereth and saith unto him , Thou art the Christ .
kha: Ma phi pat phi ïa-ong kumno ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ïa-ong ba nga long uei ?  U Petros u la jubab ,  Me long U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Hynrei phi ong ba nga long ? U Petros u jubab bad u ong ha u: Me long U Khrist .

en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna jingiwbih , khleh ïa ki kum ka jingpyniwbih . Ber khyndiat ka mluh ban pynlong ïa ka kaba khuid bad kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynlong ia ka ka jingiwbih, ka jingpynkhuid hadien ka art jong ka apot , la pynkhih lang , kaba khuid bad kaba khuid:

en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
kha: Wat tim ïa u briew uba kyllut lane wat buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jynthut halor uta . Tiengburom ïa nga ; nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tim ia kiba sngap jar, lane ban buh ia ka jingkhang ha khmat kiba matlah: Nga long U Trai .

en: And he made the holy anointing oil , and the pure incense of sweet spices , according to the work of the apothecary .
kha: U shna ruh ïa ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang bad ïa ka jingiwbih suhsieng , ïa kaba la khleh lang kumba khleh jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka umphniang ba kyntang bad ka jingiwbih ba khuid jong ki jingbam ba thiang kat kum ka jingtrei jong ka jaka dih duma .

en: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
kha: bad ar tylli ki tnaw kiba kumjuh ba yn lah ban pyndait lang ïa ki . Baroh kita ki jingker ki don kine ki tnaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka lieng ka don ar tylli ki tenon, kaba jngai kumjuh na kawei pat: kumta u la pynlong ia ki board baroh jong ka Tabernak .

en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ban wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad ban ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynmih ia ngi nangta, ba un wanrah ia ngi shapoh , ban ai ia ngi ia ka ri kaba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :
kha: haba hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki la wan mih na ka wah bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki la mih na ka wah hynriew tylli ki kine, kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong bha; bad ki la bam ha ka khlaw:

en: For God shall bring every work into judgment , with every secret thing , whether it be good , or whether it be evil .
kha: U Blei un bishar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ngi leh , la kaba bha ne kaba sniew , wat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei un wanrah ia ka kam baroh ha ka jingbishar , bad kaei kaei kaba rieh , la ka long kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
kha: Ngi pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai bad U Kpa jong ngi bad ban tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kata to kyrkhu ia U Blei, wat ia U Kpa ; bad da kata ngi la tim ia ngi ki briew kiba la thaw hadien ka jingiasyriem jong U Blei .

en: Now I know that the  Lord  is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them .
kha: Mynta nga tip ba U  Trai  u kham khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh , namar u la leh ïa kane mynba ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ shaba palat ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga tip ba U Trai u kham khraw ban ia ki blei baroh: namar ha kaei kaei kaba ki la leh da ka jingsngew sarong u la long halor jong ki .

en: Now Caiaphas was he , which gave counsel to the Jews , that it was expedient that one man should die for the people .
kha: Dei u Kaïaphas uba la ai jingmut ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba ka kham bha ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Kaifa u la long ma u, uba la ai jingmut ia ki Jiw , ba ka long kaba donkam ba uwei u briew un iap na ka bynta ki briew .

en: And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
kha: U Aaron u ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses , bad nangta u Moses u leh ïa ki kambah baroh ha khmat ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la kren ia ki ktien baroh kiba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses bad u la leh ia ki dak ha khmat ki briew .

en: And he went up and down among the lions , he became a young lion , and learned to catch the prey , and devoured men .
kha: Haba u la san dap rynïeng , u la ïaleit thap mrad bad kiwei pat ki sing . Ma u ruh u la nang ban behmrad bad u kylla long u nongbam briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kiew bad hiar hapdeng ki sing , u la kylla long u sing samla , bad u la nang ban kem ia u mrad , bad u la bam ia ki briew .

en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .
kha: U la bitar ruh ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim shym don lynti ban jubab ïa u Job , bad ka pynpaw pynban kumba U Blei u la bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh pyrshah ia ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u ka la bthei ka jingbitar jong u, namar kim shym la lap jubab ei ei, bad wat la katta ruh ki la pynrem ia u Job .

en: Baldness is come upon Gaza  ; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley : how long wilt thou cut thyself ?
kha: Ka jingsngewsih bakhraw ka la wan ha ki briew jong ka Gasa , bad ki briew jong ka Ashkelon ki sngap jar . Katno slem kiba dang sah ha Philistia kin ïam sngewsih ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong khlem akor ka wan ha Gaza ; U Ashkelon u la shah ot noh bad ka jingsah jong ka them jong ki: katno por phin ot ia lade ?

en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her  ; and they rejoiced with her .
kha: Ki paramarjan bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka , ki la ïohsngew haduh katno U Trai u la long ka jingbha kaba phylla ïa ka , bad baroh ki la shadkmen lem bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para marjan jong ka bad ki para jong ka ki la iohsngew kumno U Trai u la pynpaw ia ka jingsngewrit kaba khraw ia ka ; bad ki la ia kmen bad ka .

en: And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .
kha: Hynrei ym shym la don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei kaba shapoh , uba lah ban plied ïa ka kot kli bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don briew ha bneng ne ha khyndew, ne hapoh khyndew, u bym lah ban plie ia ka kot , lymne ban peit ia kata .

en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .
kha: Ngan ieh hangta ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kiba duk , ki ban wan sha nga na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iehnoh ruh hapdeng jong me ia ki briew kiba shah shitom bad kiba duk , bad kin shaniah ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .
kha: U long u nongsynshar uba hakhlieh tam na ki syiem baroh ha ka thain naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh khappud ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U la synshar halor ki syiem baroh naduh ka wah haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh u pud u sam jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,
kha: U la don ïa ka kot kli barit ba la plied ha ka kti jong u . U la buh ïa ka kjat kamon jong u halor ka duriaw bad ïa ka kjat kadiang jong u halor ka khyndew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u don ha ka kti jong u ka kot kaba plie: bad u la buh ia la ka kjat kadiang halor ka duriaw bad ka kjat kadiang jong u halor ka khyndew .

en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
kha: Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la shim ia u lyoh na jrong ka ïingjahthait , ki khun Israel ki la leit sha khmat ha ki jingleit jong ki baroh:

en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh jingthoh ïa ki shynrang ba la kha nyngkong baroh jong ki Israel naduh kiba shi bnai lane kham heh , bad ñiew ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la shah khein na ki khun shynrang jong ki , ha ki longiing jong ki baroh kawei bad ha ka iing ki kpa jong ki .

en: And Moses said unto Korah , Be thou and all thy company before the  Lord  , thou , and they , and Aaron , to morrow :
kha: U Moses u ong ha u Korah ,  Lashai ka sngi , ma me bad ki nongbud jong me baroh arspah sanphew ngut phi dei ban wan sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ; u Aaron ruh un don lang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Korah , To long ma me bad ka kynhun jong me baroh ha khmat U Trai, ma me bad ki, bad u Aaron, ban leit noh lashai:

en: He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Katno phi don kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih .  Haba ki la shem , ki la ïathuh ïa u ,  San tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha ki , Katno tylli ki kpu phi don ? leit bad peit . Bad haba ki la tip , ki ong , San , bad ar tylli ki dohkha .

en: Then Jonathan said to David , To morrow is the new moon : and thou shalt be missed , because thy seat will be empty .
kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u ,  Naba lashai ka dei ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan paw shai lada phim don ha jingïabam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid: To sdang ia u bnai thymmai: bad me phin sa jah noh namar ka jaka shong jong me kan long kaba thylli .
