en: He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .
kha: Ki briew ki ngam sha ki jaka bajylliew tam ka jingdum . Ki wad ïa ki jaka bajylliew ka pyrthei ; bad ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynbeit ia ka jingdum baroh: ki maw jong ka jingdum bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap .

en: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .
kha: ( Uta uba la ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia u la kren shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ïoh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la iohi ia ka u la thoh ia ka jingthoh kaba thylli, bad ka jingthoh jong u ka long kaba shisha: bad u tip ba u ong shisha, ba phin ngeit .

en: And that ye study to be quiet , and to do your own business , and to work with your own hands , as we commanded you ;
kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka jingthmu jong phi ban im ka jingim kaba jar jar , ban pyrkhat ïa la ka kam , ban kamai na ka bynta ka jingim jong phi hi , kumba ngi la bthah ïa phi mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba phi pule ban sngap jar , bad ban leh ia la ka jong ka kam , bad ban trei da la ki jong ki kti kumba ngi la hukum ia phi ; .

en: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?
kha: Shisien uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kaei kaba bha kaba nga dei ban leh ba ngan ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei u la wan bad u la ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai babha, kaei kaba bha kaba ngan leh, ba ngan ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut ?

en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
kha: Uei te uba lamler ? U dei uno uno uba ong ba U Jisu um dei U Messaïah . Kum uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyntait ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba long u nonglamler hynrei uta uba kyntait ba U Jisu U long U Khrist ? U long uba pyrshah ia U Kpa bad U Khun .

en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me , but evil ?
kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Nga la ong ïa phi ba um juh ïathuhlypa ïa kano kano kaba bha ïa nga ; ka long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat: Hato ngam shym la iathuh ia me ba un ym iathuhlypa ia nga ia kaba bha hynrei ia kaba sniew ?

en: For it is written , As I live , saith the Lord , every knee shall bow to me , and every tongue shall confess to God .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei ba-im , ong U Trai , baroh kin dem khohsiew ha khmat jong nga , bad baroh kin phla ba nga long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh ia ka , Kumba nga im , ong U Trai , kawei pa kawei ka kjat kan dem ha nga , bad kawei pa kawei ka thylliej kan phla ha U Blei .

en: Of the doctrine of baptisms , and of laying on of hands , and of resurrection of the dead , and of eternal judgment .
kha: ha kaba hikai shaphang ki jingpynbaptis , bad kaba buh ïa ki kti ; shaphang ka jingmihpat jong kiba ïap bad shaphang ka jingbishar bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka jinghikai jong ki jingpynbaptis , bad ka jingbuh kti , bad ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap , bad ka jingbishar bymjukut .

en: Let the proud be ashamed  ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
kha: Ai ba kiba sarong kin lehrain , namar ki mudui lamler ïa nga ; hynrei ma nga , ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki briew kiba sngew sarong kin sngewlehrain ; namar ki la leh khlem akor ia nga khlem daw: hynrei ngan pyrkhat ha ki jingbthah jong me .

en: Now unto the King eternal , immortal , invisible , the only wise God , be honour and glory for ever and ever . Amen .
kha: Ha u Syiem bymjukut , u bymïap shuh bad u bym lah ban ïohi , uba tang ma u hi U Blei — ha u to long ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom junom la junom ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha U Syiem bymjukut, bym lah ban iohi, U Blei uba stad tang ma u, to long ka burom bad ka burom junom . Amen .

en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .
kha: u la kem im ïa u Agag , u syiem Amalek bad u la pynïap ïa ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u Agag u syiem jong ki Amalek uba im , bad u la pynjot lut ia ki briew baroh da ka tduh jong ka waitlam .

en: And Elisha died , and they buried him . And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year .
kha: U Elisha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u . Man la ka snem ki kynhun jong ki Moab ki ju wan tur thma ïa ka ri Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la iap , bad ki la tep ia u . Bad ki kynhun jong ki nong Moab ki la hiar thma ia ka ri ha ka por ba ki wan ha ka snem .

en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field , and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard , and gather in the fruit thereof  ;
kha: Phin bet ha la ki lyngkha , phin khyllad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad phin lum ïa ki soh jong ki hynriew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew snem men bet ia ka lyngkha jong me, bad hynriew snem men ot ia ka kper sohjew jong me, bad lum ia ki soh jong ka;

en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre  ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be .
kha: Teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai bajngum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ka ha ka sniehdoh kaba rong saw, ba kan long halor ka metrieh ha khmat jong ka metrieh kan long .

en: So I spake unto the people in the morning : and at even my wife died  ; and I did in the morning as I was commanded .
kha: Dang step phyrngab nga la kren bad ki briew . Ha kata ka janmiet ka tnga jong nga ka la ïap , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la leh kumba la bthah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la kren ha ki briew mynstep : bad wat ha ka por ba ka tnga jong nga ka la iap ; bad nga la leh mynstep kumba la hukum ia nga .

en: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes , and keep my judgments , and do them  ; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety .
kha: Kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai  , khnang ba phin ïoh shongshngain ha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin leh ia ki ain jong nga, bad phin sumar ia ki jingbishar jong nga, bad phin leh ia ki bad phin shong ha ka ri ha ka jingshngain .

en: He looketh upon men , and if any say , I have sinned , and perverted that which was right , and it profited me not  ;
kha: Uwei pa uwei un ong ha kaba ïohsngew paidbah ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym la leh kaba dei , hynrei U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U peit ia ki briew bad lada don kiba ong, nga la leh pop bad nga la pynkylla ia kata kaba dei, bad kam shym la pynmyntoi ia nga;

en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for his name alone is excellent  ; his glory is above the earth and heaven .
kha: Ai ba ma ki baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka kham khraw ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ; ka burom jong u ka long halor ka pyrthei bad ka bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin iaroh ia ka kyrteng U Trai: namar tang ka kyrteng jong u ka long kaba bha tam; ka burom jong u ka long halor ka khyndew bad ka bneng .

en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka leh kumne : ka klim , ka sum , bad ka ong ,  Hynrei ngam shym leh ei ei ka bymdei !
translated_en_to_kha: Kum kane ka long ka lynti jong ka kynthei kaba sniew ; ka bam , bad ka sait ia ka shyntur jong ka , bad ka ong , Ngam shym la leh ei ei kaba sniew .

en: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there , to the intent ye may believe  ; nevertheless let us go unto him .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïathuh shai kdar ha ki ,  U Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi nga kmen ba ngam shym la don ryngkat bad u , khnang ba phin ïoh ngeit . Ïa ngin ïaleit sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga sngewbha na ka bynta jong phi ba ngam shym la don hangta, ha ka jingthmu ba phi lah ban ngeit wat la katta ruh to ngin leit sha u.

en: And the angel of the  Lord  found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness , by the fountain in the way to Shur .
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la ïashem ïa ka Hagar harud ka umpohliew ha ka ri shyiap ha ka lynti sha Shur bad u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la shem ia ka da ka pung um ha ri khlaw , da ka pung um ha ka lynti sha Shur .

en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .
kha: Kito ki bleithaw baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israel na nga , hynrei da ka jubab jong nga , nga kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan shim ia ka iing Israel ha la ka jong ka dohnud , namar baroh ki la iehnoh na nga lyngba ki bleithaw jong ki .

en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,
kha: U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , ïa uta u  seiñ hyndai — kata , u Ksuid lane u Soitan — bad u la teh kynjri ïa u haduh shihajar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bat ia uta u bsein, uta u bsein barim, uba long u Ksuid bad u Soitan bad u la teh ia u shihajar snem .

en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he , and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha u bad ha u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ïa ka sap ban hikai ïa ki buit treikam ha kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ha ka dohnud jong u ba un hikai, ma u bad u Aholiab u khun u Ahisamach na ka jait Dan .

en: Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .
kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! u la pyllait im ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ na ka bor jong ki briew basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ia U Trai , to iaroh ia U Trai: namar u la pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong kiba duk na ka kti jong ki nongleh bymman .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;
kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri sha kiba la shim noh ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid ; Ha khmih , ngan pynim ia ki briew jong nga na ka ri mihngi, bad na ka ri sepngi ; .

en: I will hiss for them , and gather them  ; for I have redeemed them : and they shall increase as they have increased .
kha: Ngan khot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan lumlang ïa ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba bun paid kumba ki ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pyrta na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan lum ia ki ; namar nga la siewspah ia ki: bad kin nang kiew katba ki nang kiew .

en: She has been conferred the title of SHRINGAR MANI and adjudged as best dancer all over India , by SUR SINGAR SAMSAD .
kha: Ka la shah pynkup burom ia ka nam SHRINGAR MANI bad la niew ia ka kum ka nongshad ba tbit tam ha baroh kawei ka Ri India , da u SUR SINGAR SAMSAD .
translated_en_to_kha: La ai ia ka ia ka nam SHRINGAR MANI bad la bishar ia ka kum ka nongshad kaba bha tam ha kylleng ka ri India , da ka SUR SINGAR SAMSAD .

en: Or if I send a pestilence into that land , and pour out my fury upon it in blood , to cut off from it man and beast :
kha: Lada nga phah ïa ka khlam ha kata ka ri bad ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga shim noh bun ki mynsiem , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada nga phah ia ka jingpang ha kata ka ri, bad nga theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga ha ka snam, ban ot noh na ka ia u briew bad u mrad:

en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father , saying , A man child is born unto thee  ; making him very glad .
kha: Long ba la tim uta u briew uba la pynkmen ïa i pa jong nga mynba u la wallam ha i ka khubor ,  I dei u shynrang ! Phi la don khun shynrang !
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta u briew uba la wanrah khubor ha u kpa jong nga, da kaba ong , La kha ia u khun shynrang ha me; u la pynsngewbha shibun ia u .

en: Google says on Android 11 Go Edition , the apps will launch 20 per cent faster than they did on Android 10 Go Edition
kha: Ka Google ka ong ba ha ka Android 11 Go Edition ki apps kin pynmih kham kloi haduh 20 percent ban ia kaba ki la leh ha ka Android 10 Go Edition .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Google ka ong ha ka Android 11 Go Edition , ki apps kin pynmih 20 percent kham stet ban ia kaba ki la leh ha ka Android 10 Go Edition .

en: In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .
kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki nongtuh ki rung shapoh ki ïing , hynrei mynsngi ki rieh bad ki kiar ïa ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingdum ki tih lyngba ki iing , kiba ki la buh dak na ka bynta lade ha ka por mynstep: kim tip ia ka jingshai .

en: And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .
kha: bad u la hukum ïa kito kiba ïadie paro ,  Rah noh ïa ki nangne ! Wat pynlong jaka ïew ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki kiba die ia ki paro , To shim ia kine kiei kiei kumta wat pynlong ia ka iing jong u Kpa jong nga ka iing jong ki mar ki mata .

en: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .
kha: Ki la lap ïa u Adonibesek hangta bad ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shem ia u Adonibeek ha Bezek : bad ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u, bad ki la pyniap ia ki nong Kana bad ki nong Perizzite .

en: When Jesus understood it , he said unto them ,  Why trouble ye the woman ? for she hath wrought a good work upon me .
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi pynsalia ïa kane ka briew ? Ka long kaei kaei kaba biang bad kaba itynnat ba ka la leh na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la sngewthuh ia kata, u la ong ha ki, Balei phi pynshitom ia kata ka kynthei? namar ka la leh ia ka kam kaba bha halor jong nga .

en: Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will recompense , even recompense into their bosom ,
kha: Nga la kut jingmut lypa ban pynshitom ïa ki , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki la dep buh jingthoh . Ngan ym leh bym ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , hynrei ngan siew kylliang ïa ki
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , la thoh ha khmat jong nga: Ngan ym sngap jar , hynrei ngan siew kylliang , wat ban siew kylliang ha ka kpoh jong ki , .

en: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer : for there shall be no loss of any man s life among you , but of the ship .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga kyrpad ïa phi , to long shlur ! Ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban duh ïa la ka jingim , hynrei yn duh tang ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga kyntu ia phi ban long kiba sngewbha: namar kan ym don ka jingduh ei ei ia u briew hapdeng jong phi , hynrei ia ka lieng .

en: Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .
kha: U kyang ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada u Elisha um shah khrai khlieh shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong , U Blei un leh kumta bad kham bun ruh ia nga, lada ka khlieh jong u Elisa u khun u Shaphat kan ieng ha u ha kane ka sngi .

en: Take counsel together , and it shall come to nought  ; speak the word , and it shall not stand : for God is with us .
kha: To thaw ki jingpynkhreh jong phi ! Hynrei kin ym urlong . To kren ïa baroh kaba phi kwah ! Hynrei baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi , namar U Blei u long lem bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To shim jingmut lang, bad kan wan ha ka ktien kaba ym don shuh, bad kan ym ieng: namar U Blei U don ryngkat bad ngi .

en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
kha: Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , te kin sa shahjingit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki sngi kin sa wan , haba yn weng noh ia u nongleit kurim na ki , bad nangta kin sa shah jingit ha kita ki sngi .

en: Star India had made it clear that it would not seek a renewal of its sponsorship deal , which was to end this month .
kha: Ka Star India ka la kren shai ba kan nym wad ban pynthymmai ia ka jingiateh ban kyrshan ia ka , kaba dei ban kut mynta u bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Star India ka la pynpaw shai ba kan ym wad ia ka jingpynthymmai ia ka jingiateh ba kyrshan jong ka , kaba dei ban kut noh mynta u bnai .

en: And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .
kha: Haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros ba u dang syaid ding , ka la peit shaiñ ïa u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me la long bad U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka la iohi ia u Petros ba u sngem ia lade, ka la peit ia u bad ka la ong: Bad me ruh me la don bad U Jisu na Nazareth .

en: As saith the proverb of the ancients , Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingong mynbarim , ‘ Ïa ka jingbymman la leh tang da ki riewbymman .’ Bad kumta ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ong ka proberb jong ki tymmen , Ka jingsniew ka mih na kiba sniew: hynrei ka kti jong nga kan ym don halor jong me .

en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .
kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ka la long kaba donburom ; kaba katno tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka jingpynshitom ka long ka burom , kham bun ka jingpynshitom ia ka hok ka palat ha ka burom .

en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :
kha: U la ïohi ïa uwei na ki ba u la shah lehbeiñ ha u nong Ijipt , kumta u la leit ban ïarap ïa u bad u la pynhiarkput ïa u nong Ijipt da kaba pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba uwei na ki u la shah shitom bakla, u la iada ia u, bad u la pynrem ia uta uba la shah pynshitom bein, bad u la pynkhih ia u nong Ijipt:

en: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads , when they stood , and had let down their wings .
kha: hynrei ka don hi ka jingsawa najrong ka tnum kaba halor ki khlieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka sur na ka bneng kaba la don halor ki khlieh jong ki , haba ki la ieng , bad ki la pynhap ia ki bniat jong ki .

en: Then it shall be , that , when ye eat of the bread of the land , ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Haba bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam kaba mih hangta , khyndiat na ka dei ban buh sharud kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan long , ba haba phi bam ia u kpu jong ka ri , phin aiti ia ka jingainguh kaba heh ha U Trai .

en: It is sown a natural body ; it is raised a spiritual body . There is a natural body , and there is a spiritual body .
kha: Haba la tep , ka long kaba kynja doh ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long ka met kaba kynja mynsiem . Ka don shisha ka met ba kynja doh , kumta ruh ka dei ban don ka met ba kynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: La bet ia ka met ba kynja met; la pynkiew ia ka da ka met ba kynja mynsiem . Ka don ka met ba kynja mynsiem , bad ka don ka met ba kynja mynsiem .

en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew halor ka lieng , uta u briew uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit bad me !
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan shapoh lieng , uta uba la shah bat ha u ksuid u la duwai ia u ba un don ryngkat bad u .

en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .
kha: Lada nga phah ïa ki sha ïing khlem bsa ïa ki , kin ïapler katba ki dang ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki , ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada nga phah noh ia ki sha la ki jong ki iing , kin sa lyngngoh ha lynti: namar ki nongleit jingleit jong ki ki wan na jngai .

en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .
kha: la kum ba leh ïa u nongbylla uba trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kum u shakri ba la thung man la u snem un don ryngkat bad u: bad uwei pat un ym synshar da ka jingsngewsih ia u ha khmat jong me .

en: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,
kha: Na u Paul , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Ha u Philemon , u paralok jong ngi bad u para ba-ïatrei lang ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul, u koidi U Jisu Khrist, bad u Timothi u para jong ngi, ha u Philemon baieit eh jong ngi, bad u para bangeit jong ngi .

en: While he yet talked to the people , behold , his mother and his brethren stood without , desiring to speak with him .
kha: U Jisu u dang kren ha ki briew mynba ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong u ki la wan poi . Ki la ïeng shabar , ki da kyrpad ban ïoh kren ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang iakren bad ki briew, ha khmih ka kmie jong u bad ki hynmen jong u ki la ieng shabar, ki kwah ban iakren bad u .

en: Then I said unto them , What is the high place whereunto ye go ? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day .
kha: Nga la kylli ïa ki : Kine ki jaka bajrong sha kiba phi leit ki dei kiei ? Kumta la khot ïa kine ‘ Ki jaka bajrong’ naduh kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ki , Kaei ka jaka kaba jrong kaba phi leit ? Bad ka kyrteng jong ka ka long Bamah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .
kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrngem shuh da ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kin shong ha ka, bad kan ym don shuh ka jingpynjot kaba pura ; hynrei ka Jerusalem kan shong suk shong sain .

en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .
kha: U la ïohthiah biang bad u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew . Hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba met bad ba ih , ba ki san ha uwei u jyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thiah bad u la phohsniew ha ka sien kaba ar: bad, ha khmih, hynriew tylli ki shkor kew ki la wan shaneng ha kawei ka tnat kaba heh bad kaba bha .

en: It took Tom several hours to assemble a bunk bed that the instructions said would take less than an hour to assemble.
kha: Ka shim i'u Tom katto-katne kynta ban pyndait ia ka jingthiah ba ki jingbatai ki ong ba kan shim shikynta duna ban pyndait.
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la shim por katto katne kynta ban lum ia ka jingthiah kaba bun kaba ki jingbthah ki la ong ba kan shim por tang shi kynta ban lum lang.

en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .
kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin don ka spah ban ieh pateng ha ki ksiew jong ki , hynrei ka spah jong ki nongpop kan leit sha kiba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha u iehnoh ia ka pateng ha ki khun jong u: bad ka spah jong u nongpop ka long kaba la buh na ka bynta kiba hok .

en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes , and my judgments : which if a man do , he shall live in them : I am the  Lord .
kha: Bud ïa ki rukom leh bad ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi ; da kaba leh kumta , phin ïoh im . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban sumar ia ki ain jong nga bad ki jingbishar jong nga: kiba lada u briew u leh: Nga long U Trai .

en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
kha: Nangta u Saul u phah khubor sha u Jesse :  Nga sngewbha eh ïa u Dabid . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la phah sha u Jesse, u da ong, To ai ba u Dabid, nga kyrpad ia me, un ieng ha khmat jong nga ; namar u la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong nga .

en: But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .
kha: Nangta phi dei ban wan ïalam ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Kane kan pynshisha ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wanrah ia u hynmen uba rit tam jong phi ha nga ; kumta yn pynshisha ia ki ktien jong phi , bad phin ym iap . Bad ki la leh kumta .

en: Let your light so shine before men , that they may see your good works , and glorify your Father which is in heaven .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingshai jong phi ka dei ban shai ha khmat ki briew , khnang ba kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi leh bad ïaroh ïa u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka jingshai jong phi kan shai ha khmat ki briew , ba kin iohi ia ki kam babha jong phi bad kin pyndonburom ia U Kpa jong phi uba don ha bneng .

en: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations , beginning at Jerusalem .
kha: bad ha ka kyrteng jong u ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Jingkylla-kaba-mut bad ka jingmap ïa ki pop dei ban ïalap sha ki jaitbynriew baroh , da kaba sdang na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka jingkylla kaba mut bad ka jingmap ia ki pop dei ban ialap ha ka kyrteng jong u hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , sdang na Jerusalem .

en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .
kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa ka Truphina bad ka Truphosa , kiba trei ha ka kam U Trai bad ïa ka paralok ba-ieit jong nga , ka Persis , kaba la trei shibun ka kam na ka bynta U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Jingktah ia ka Trifena bad ka Trifosa kiba trei ha U Trai . Pynbeit ia u Persis baieit , uba la trei shitom shibun ha U Trai .

en: Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
kha: katba kum ka jinglong hynmen para jong ki , hynriew na ki kyrteng jong ki ha uwei u mawkordor bad hynriew ha uwei pat u mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew tylli ki kyrteng jong ki ha uwei u maw , bad kiwei pat ki hynriew tylli ki kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki maw , kat kum ka jingkha jong ki .

en: And he said , I will send thee a kid from the flock . And she said , Wilt thou give me a pledge , till thou send it ?
kha: Ngan phah ïa phi kawei ka blang lud na ka kynhun jong nga ,  u jubab .  Ñiuma , lada phin ai ei ei ha nga ban buh kum ka jingkular haduh ba phin da phah ïa ka blang ,  ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ngan phah ia me ia u khun na ka kynhun . Bad ka la ong , Hato me ai ia nga ka jingkular , haduh ba men phah ia ka ?

en: David therefore himself calleth him Lord  ; and whence is he then his son ?  And the common people heard him gladly .
kha: U Dabid hi da lade u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; te kumno U Messaïah u lah ban hiarpateng na u Dabid ?  U paidbah babun u dang shahshkor ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid namarkata u khot ia u Trai ; bad nangno u long u khun jong u ? Bad ki paidbah kiba iadei bad u ki la iohsngew ia u da ka jingkmen .

en: And he hath brought us into this place , and hath given us this land , even a land that floweth with milk and honey .
kha: U la wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad u la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia ngi ha kane ka jaka , bad u la ai ia ngi ia kane ka ri , wat ia ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour , and Lord Jesus Christ , which is our hope ;
kha: Na u Paul , u apostol jong U Khrist Jisu kat kum ka hukum U Blei u Nongpynim jong ngi bad U Khrist Jisu uba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi —
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u apostol jong U Jisu Khrist da ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist uba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi;

en: Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .
kha: U la ong ,  To ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng . Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyrkhong ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien u la ong ha nga , To iathuhlypa ia kine ki shyieng bad to ong ha ki , Ko shyieng kiba rkhiang , to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai .

en: Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .
kha: Ki briew ki ïalap ha nga bad ki ong ,  Wat ïalap ha ngi . Wat ïalap shaphang kata baroh . U Blei un ym pynjahburom ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iathuhlypa ia phi, to ong ia ki ha kito kiba iathuhlypa: kin ym iathuhlypa ha ki, ba kin ym sngewlehrain .

en: At the same time , saith the  Lord  , will I be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan wan haba ngan long U Blei jong ki jait Israel baroh , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ong U Trai , ngan long U Blei jong ki longiing Israel baroh , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

en: And said , Whose daughter art thou ? tell me , I pray thee : is there room in thy father s house for us to lodge in ?
kha: U ong ,  To ïathuh ïa nga uei u kpa jong phi ? Hato don jaka ha ka ïing u kpa jong phi ïa ki briew jong nga bad ïa nga ba ngin ïoh sahmiet ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Me long ka khun jongno ? iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me: hato ka don ka jaka ha iing u kpa jong me ba ngin sah ?

en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah , and the letters of Tobiah came unto them .
kha: Hapdeng kane ka por baroh , ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la ïadon hapdeng ka jingïathoh shithi bad u Tobiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ha kita ki sngi ki rangbah jong ka Judah ki la phah bun ki shithi sha u Tobiah bad ki shithi jong u Tobiah ki la wan sha ki .

en: Therefore will I howl for Moab , and I will cry out for all Moab  ; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir–heres .
kha: Bad kumta ngan ïam na ka bynta uwei pa uwei ha Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew jong ka Kir Heres .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan iam na ka bynta u Moab , bad ngan iam na ka bynta u Moab baroh; ka dohnud jong nga kan iam na ka bynta ki briew jong u Kirheres .

en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters , and to please them well in all things ; not answering again ;
kha: Ki mraw kin pyndem ha la ki kynrad bad ban pynsngewbha ïa ki ha kiei kiei baroh . Kim dei ban pynphai ktien kylliang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ki shakri ban long kiba kohnguh ia la ki jong ki kynrad , bad ban pynsngewbha bha ia ki ha kiei kiei baroh ; ban ym jubab biang ; .

en: Ye are witnesses , and God also , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe :
kha: Phi long ki sakhi jong ngi , bad kumta U Blei ruh , ba ka jingleh jong ngi ïa phi kiba ngeit ka long kaba sngur , kaba dei bad kaba khlem jingbakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ki sakhi , bad U Blei ruh , katno ka long kaba khuid bad kaba hok bad kaba khlem jingbakla ngi la leh ia lade hapdeng jong phi kiba ngeit:

en: Whom I shall see for myself , and mine eyes shall behold , and not another  ; though my reins be consumed within me .
kha: Ngan ïohi ïa u da ki khmat jong nga hi , bad un ym long u nongwei . Ka jingshlur jong nga ka la duh noh namar ba phi ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba ngan iohi na ka bynta lade, bad ki khmat jong nga kin iohi, bad ym uwei pat u ; wat la ki tyrpeng jong nga kin shah bam hapoh jong nga .

en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , kum ki sohshnong bad ki nongphetwir ha kane ka pyrthei ! Wat aiti noh ha ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh , kiba long borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: baieit eh , nga kyrpad ia phi kum ki nongwei bad ki khynnah rit , kiar na ki jingkwah brai ba kynja doh , kiba ialeh pyrshah ia ka mynsiem ; .

en: I speak not by commandment , but by occasion of the forwardness of others , and to prove the sincerity of your love .
kha: Ngam buh ïa kino kino ki aiñ . Hynrei da kaba pyn-i kumno kiwei ki kloi ban ïarap , nga pyrshang ban wad katno ka jingieit jong phi hi ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam kren da ka hukum , hynrei da ka jinglong ba shakhmat jong kiwei pat , bad ban pynshisha ia ka jinglong bashisha jong ka jingieit jong phi .

en: And , ye fathers , provoke not your children to wrath : but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord .
kha: Phi ruh ki kmie ki kpa , wat leh ïa la ki khun ha kata ka rukom ban pynbitar ïa ki , pynban to pynheh pynsan ïa ki ha ka jingsneng bad jinghikai ba kynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi ki kpa, wat pynkhih ia ki khun jong phi ban bitar: hynrei to pynsan ia ki ha ka jingpynroi bad jingpynbeit jong U Trai .

en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar , and Ahuzzath one of his friends , and Phichol the chief captain of his army .
kha: U Abimelekh u la wan na Gerar lem bad u Ahussath u nongaibuit jong u bad u Phikol u rangbah shipai jong u ban ïakynduh ïa u Isaak .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abimelech u la leit sha u na Gerar bad u Ahusath uwei na ki paralok jong u bad u Phichol u rangbah shipai jong u .

en: And , hardly passing it , came unto a place which is called The fair havens  ; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea .
kha: Ngi la leit marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw ngi la poi sha ka jaka ba la khot , Ka Jakarieh Lieng Bashngain , ka bym da jngai na ka shnong Lasaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, tang khyndiat eh ka la iaid lyngba ia ka, ka la poi ha ka jaka kaba la khot Ka jaka kaba la khot ka ri kaba la buh lypa ha kaba ka shnong Lasea ka la don ha ka shnong Lasea .

en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .
kha: Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun sing bad hikai ïa u kumno ban behmrad ; u la long u nongbam briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynmih ia uwei na ki khun jong ka: ka la kylla long u sing samla , bad ka la nang ban kem ia u mrad ; ka la bam ia ki briew .

en: A new commandment I give unto you , That ye love one another  ; as I have loved you , that ye also love one another .
kha: Bad mynta nga ai ha phi ka hukum kaba thymmai ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hukum kaba thymmai nga ai ha phi , Ba phi ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat ; kumba nga la ieit ia phi , ba phi ruh phi ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .
kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pyllait im ïa phi ha ka rukom kaba phylla , bad ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la phah ia nga ha khmat jong phi ban pynneh ia phi ia ka pateng ha ka khyndew , bad ban pynim ia ka jingim jong phi da ka jingpyllait im kaba khraw .

en: For what thanks can we render to God again for you , for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God ;
kha: Mynta ngi lah ban ainguh ïa U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi ainguh ïa u na ka bynta ka jingkmen kaba ngi don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u namar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaei ka jingainguh kaba ngi lah ban ai biang ia U Blei na ka bynta jong phi, na ka bynta ka jingkmen baroh kaba ngi sngewkmen na ka bynta jong phi ha khmat U Blei jong ngi;

en: And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .
kha: Nga lah ban sah katto katne por bad phi , lehse baroh shi tlang , bad nangta phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga ha ka ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kat shano sha ba ngan leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lah ban long ba ngan kohnguh ia phi, em, bad ka por lyiur bad phi, ba phin wanrah ia nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shano shano ruh ba nga leit .

en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
kha: bad pynlong ïa ngi ka hima jong ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to long ka burom bad ka bor junom la junom ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ngi ki syiem bad ki lyngdoh ha U Blei bad U Kpa jong u;

en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .
kha: Ka Jingbymman Bamaïan ka la da trei , hynrei , kaei ka ban jia , kan ym jia tad ynda ïa uta uba bat ïa ka la weng noh na ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingmaham jong ka jingbymhok ka la treikam lypa: tang uta uba mynta un shah shuh shuh .

en: For indeed the hand of the  Lord  was against them , to destroy them from among the host , until they were consumed .
kha: U  Trai  u ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba un da ïoh pynjot lut ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha ka kti U Trai ka la long pyrshah ia ki, ban pynjot ia ki napdeng ki shipai haduh ba kin da shah pynjot .

en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow , and loveth the stranger , in giving him food and raiment .
kha: U lehhok ïa ki khunswet bad ïa ki riewkynthei ; u ieit ïa ki nongwei kiba don bad ngi , bad u ai bam bad ai kup ai sem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U pyndep ia ka jingbishar jong ki bym don kpa bad kiba la duh jait, bad u ieit ia u nongwei , ha kaba ai jingbam bad u jainkup ia u .

en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
kha: U Blei , uta uba hok , u tip ïa kaei kaba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba hok da ka jingstad u pyrkhat ia ka iing jong kiba sniew: hynrei U Blei u pynhap ia kiba sniew namar ka jingsniew jong ki .

en: The sons of Manasseh  ; Asriel , whom she bare : ( but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead :
kha: Na ka tnga kliar jong u , ka nong Aram , u Manasseh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Asriel bad u Makhir . U Makhir u dei u kpa u Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Manasseh ; Asriel , ia uba ka la kha: (hynrei ka kynthei jong u ka la kha ia u Machir u kpa jong u Gilead :

en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .
kha: Ka jinglorni kam lah ban set ïa kaba buhrieh . Kiar na ki briew kiba bunktien palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaid kylleng kum u nongrah jingiathuhkhana u pynpaw ia ki jingmaham: namarkata wat nym ialeh pyrshah ia uta uba ialeh pyrshah ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

en: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not , that ye come together not for the better , but for the worse .
kha: Pynban , ha ki jingbthah harum , ngam ïaroh ïa phi , namar ki jingïaseng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingmane , da shisha ka kham pynsniew ban ïa kaba pynbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kane ba nga pynbna ha phi ngam iaroh ia phi, ba phi iawan lang ym na ka bynta kaba bha , hynrei na ka bynta kaba kham sniew .

en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid ka Jerusalem ! Nga wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai bad to sngewbha ko khun jong u Seion: namar, ha khmih, nga wan, bad ngan shong hapdeng jong me, ong U Trai .

en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound : therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Nga la bitar namar ba ki nongïalam ka Judah ki la hiarthma ïa ka Israel bad tuh jaka na ka . Kumta ngan theh noh ka jingpynshitom halor jong ki kum ka jingshlei um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem Judah ki long kum ma ki kiba weng noh ia u pud: namarkata ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki kum ka um .

en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .
kha: Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïaid hynriew jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh katba u dang ai ka jingkñia ïa U  Trai  da u masi bad u khun masi ba la pynsngaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba haba kita ki la leit hynriew tylli ki lynti , u la knia ia ki masi bad ki shyieng .

en: And David numbered the people that were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , u pynbynta ïa ki ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut , bad u buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la khein ia ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, bad u la buh ia ki rangbah shihajar bad ki rangbah jong ki spah ngut ki rangbah halor jong ki .

en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .
kha: Me don borabor katto katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong me ïa nga ka nang jur nang jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai ban ïaleh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me pynthymmai ia ki sakhi jong me pyrshah ia nga, bad pynbun ia ka jingbitar jong me ha nga; ki jingkylla bad ka thma ki long pyrshah ia nga .

en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha U Jeremaiah na U Trai ha ki sngi u Jehosiah u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah da kaba ong:

en: I have seen his ways , and will heal him : I will lead him also , and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners .
kha: Nga la ïohi kumno ki im , hynrei ngan pynkhiah pat ïa ki . Ngan ïalam ïa ki bad ïarap ïa ki , bad ngan pyntngen ïa kito kiba ïam sngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ki lynti jong u, bad ngan pynkoit ia u: Ngan ialam ia u ruh, bad ngan pynphai biang ia ki jingsuk ha u bad ha ki nongsngewsih jong u .

en: And there was no water for the congregation : and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron .
kha: Ym shym don um ha kata ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara , kumta u paidbah u ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Moses bad u Aaron ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don um na ka bynta ka jingiaseng : bad ki la ialum lang pyrshah ia u Moses bad pyrshah ia u Aaron .

en: If ye then be risen with Christ , seek those things which are above , where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God .
kha: Ïa phi la pynmihpat lem bad U Khrist , kumta pynbeit ïa ka dohnud jong phi ha kiei kiei kiba ha bneng , ha kaba U Khrist u shong ha la ka khet ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi la shah pynkiew bad U Khrist, to wad ia kiei kiei kiba don haneng, ha kaba U Khrist U shong ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei .

en: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time , because the  Lord  God of Israel fought for Israel .
kha: U Joshua u la jop ïa kine ki syiem baroh bad ïa ka ri jong ki tang shisien ïaleh namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ïaleh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki syiem baroh bad ka ri jong ki ki la shim ha kawei ka por , namar U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la ialeh na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: I am come in my Father s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .
kha: Nga la wan da ka iktiar U Kpa jong nga ; hynrei phim shym la pdiang ïa nga ; pynban , haba don uno uno uba wan ha la ka jong ka iktiar , phin pdiang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga wan ha ka kyrteng U Kpa jong nga, bad phim pdiang ia nga: lada uwei pat un wan ha la ka jong ka kyrteng , ia u phin pdiang .

en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the  Lord  their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .
kha: Hynrei wat ki paid Judah ruh kim shym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki pyrthuh bud ïa ki rukom ba dang bat da ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Judah um shym la bat ia ki hukum U Trai jong ki , hynrei u la iaid ha ki ain Israel kiba ki la leh .

en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king , and said , Amen : the  Lord  God of my lord the king say so too .
kha: Yn pyndep ïa ka ,  u Benaïah u jubab ,  bad to U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynskhem ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la jubab ia u syiem, bad u la ong: Amen: U Trai U Blei jong nga u ong kumta ruh .

en: This is the interpretation , O king , and this is the decree of the most High , which is come upon my lord the king :
kha: Kane , te , ka long kaei ba ka mut , ko Syiem Kynrad , bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynbna ba kan jia ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingbatai , ko syiem , bad kane ka long ka hukum jong uba ha khlieh duh tam , kaba wan ha u kynrad jong nga:

en: He was a mighty hunter before the  Lord  : wherefore it is said , Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the  Lord .
kha: Da ka jingïarap U  Trai  u la long u nongbeh mrad uba khraw ; ba kumta sa mih ka jingong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynlong ïa me u nongbeh mrad uba khraw kat u Nimrod .
translated_en_to_kha: U la long u nongleit khwai uba khlain bor ha khmat U Trai: namar kata la ong , Wat kum u Nimrod u nongleit khwai uba khlain bor ha khmat U Trai .

en: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation , upon the side of the tabernacle northward , without the veil .
kha: U buh ïa ka miej hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei , shabar kata ka pyrda ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka miej ha ka ïingjahthait jong ka jingïalang , ha ka liang jong ka ïingjahthait shaphang shathie , khlem ka jingtap .

en: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them  ; and they said unto the olive tree , Reign thou over us .
kha: Ha kawei ka por , ki dieng ki ïamih ban jied u syiem na ka bynta jong ki . Ki ong ha u dieng Olib , ‘ To long u syiem jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng ki la leit sha khmat ban pynsleh ia u syiem halor jong ki ; bad ki la ong ha u dieng olive , To long halor jong ngi .

en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .
kha: Hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah jong ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Trai un bret noh ia ka shabar duriaw; bad un pynkhih ia ka da ka ding .

en: And it came to pass , that , when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .
kha: Haba u la rung sha ka ri Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la ïohi ba ka tnga jong u ka la long kaba bhabriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Abram u la wan sha Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la iohi ia kata ka kynthei ba ka long kaba itynnad bha .

en: Son of man , prophesy , and say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Say , A sword , a sword is sharpened , and also furbished :
kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Ong ïa ki briew ïa kaei ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong :  Ïa ka waitlam , ïa ka waitlam la pynnep bad pynphyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew , u iathuhlypa , bad u ong , Kumta u ong u Trai ; To ong , Ka waitlam ka la tyrkhong , bad ruh ka la tyrkhong:

en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .
kha: Pynban , uno uno uba bam ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba jew kan pynlong ba ki bniat jong u hi kin shyrkhei ; bad uwei uwei baroh un ïap namar ki pop jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei pa uwei un iap na ka bynta la ka jong ka jingbymhok: uwei pa uwei u briew uba bam ia u sohjew ba la shet , ki bniat jong u kin sa sah ha ka tduh .

en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem , in the house of the  Lord  , before the new court ,
kha: bad ma ki bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki ïalumlang ha ka phyllaw bathymmai jong ka Templ . U syiem Jehoshaphat u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad duwai jam ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ieng ha ka jingiaseng Judah bad Jerusalem ha ka iing U Trai ha khmat ka iing kaba thymmai .

en: That made the world as a wilderness , and destroyed the cities thereof  ; that opened not the house of his prisoners ?
kha: Hato une u dei u briew uba la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynkylla ïa ka pyrthei sha ka ri shyiap ? Hato une u dei u briew u bym ju pyllaitluid ïa ki koidi jong u lane shah ïa ki ban leit sha ïing ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka la pynlong ia ka pyrthei kum ka ri khlaw , bad ka la pynjot ia ki shnong jong ka ; ki bym plie ia ka iing jong ki koidi jong u ?

en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .
kha: Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ha ki briew jong phi ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei kaba ki briew jong phi hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba phi bakla !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada nga da u Belzebub nga beh ia ki ksuid , da mano ki khun jong phi ki beh noh ia ki ? namarkata kin long ki nongbishar jong phi .

en: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .
kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti ka jingshisha bad pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba iadei bad ka jingshisha ki la bakla, da kaba ong ba ka jingmihpat ka la dep ban long shuh shuh bad pynhap ia ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne .

en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .
kha: U Abram u la shong la sah ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Lot u la shong la sah hapdeng ki nongbah ha ka them
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la shong ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Lot u la shong ha ki shnong jong ka madan , bad u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u sha ka ri Sodom .

en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof , and darkness shall pursue his enemies .
kha: Kum ka jingsyllad ka jingshlei um bakhraw u pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong u ; u phah sha ka jingïap jong ki ïa kito kiba pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da ka jingshlei um kaba palat un pynlong ia ka jaka jong ka , bad ka jingdum kan beh ia ki nongshun jong u .

en: It took Tom several hours to assemble a bunk bed that the instructions said would take less than an hour to assemble .
kha: Ka shim i'u Tom katto-katne kynta ban pyndait ia ka jingthiah ba ki jingbatai ki ong ba kan shim shikynta duna ban pyndait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la shim por katto katne kynta ban lum ia ka jingthiah kaba bun kaba ki jingbthah ki la ong ba kan shim por tang shi kynta ban lum lang .

en: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul , both sure and stedfast , and which entereth into that within the veil  ;
kha: Ngi don kane ka jingkyrmen kum u angkor ïa ki jingim jong ngi . Ka long kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad ka ïaid lyngba ka jingkah jong ka Templ ba kynja bneng shaduh ka kamra kaba kham shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingkyrmen kaba ngi don kum ka nongrim jong ka mynsiem, kaba skhem bad kaba skhem, bad kaba rung shapoh kata hapoh ka jingtap;

en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods : and the people did eat , and bowed down to their gods .
kha: Kine ki kynthei ki la khot sngewbha ïa ki sha ki jingkhawai jingkñia ha kaba la mane ïa u blei ki Moab . Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ki jingbam bad mane ïa u blei Baal jong ki Peor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia ki briew sha ki jingknia jong ki blei jong ki: bad ki briew ki la bam , bad ki la dem khrup ha ki blei jong ki .

en: But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
kha: U dei ban shong bad phi kum u nongtrei bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kum u shakri ba la thung bad kum u nongwan jngohkai un don ryngkat bad me bad un shakri ia me haduh ka snem jubile:

en: For thus saith the  Lord  to the men of Judah and Jerusalem , Break up your fallow ground , and sow not among thorns .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,  To lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ki bym pat ju lur ; wat bet ïa ki symbai jong phi hapdeng ki shiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem: Pynduh noh ia ka khyndew kaba jylliew jong phi, bad wat bet hapdeng ki thliew .

en: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth  ; and he had two horns like a lamb , and he spake as a dragon .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw , uba la wan kiew napoh ka khyndew . U la don ar tylli ki reng kum ki jong u khunlangbrot , bad u la kren kum u Ïakjakor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia uwei pat u mrad uba mih na ka khyndew ; bad u don ar tylli ki bniat kum u langbrot , bad u la kren kum u bsein .

en: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .
kha: Wat lada kiwei kim pdiang ïa nga kum u Apostol , da shisha ma phi , phi pdiang! Namar ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai , ma phi hi phi long ka jingpynskhem ïa ka jingshisha ba nga long u apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngam long u apostol ha kiwei pat, hynrei khlem artatien nga long ha phi: namar ka muhor jong ka jinglong apostol jong nga ka long ha U Trai .

en: And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
kha: U Petros bad u Ïoannis ki dang kren ha ki paidbah mynba katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh , u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ , bad katto katne ngut ki Saddusi ki la wan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ha ki briew, ki lyngdoh bad u rangbah jong ka tempi bad ki Sadusi ki la wan ha ki .

en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
kha: Nangta u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai kdar ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pharshi jong u, bad u la ong, u Balaam u khun u Beor u la ong, bad uta u briew uba la plie ki khmat u la ong:

en: I am the  Lord  , and there is none else , there is no God beside me : I girded thee , though thou hast not known me :
kha: Nga long U  Trai  ; ym don uwei pat U Blei , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkhlaiñ ba me donkam , wat la mem shym la ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai , bad ym don uwei pat, ym don Blei nalor jong nga: Nga la pynkhih ia me, wat la me khlem ithuh ia nga:

en: Unto the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first : and there Abram called on the name of the  Lord .
kha: U la poi ha kata ka jaka hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Ai ha kaba u la sher dara mynshuwa , bad ba u la lah tei ïa ka duwan . Hangta u la mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jaka jong ka almari kaba u la shna hangta ha kaba nyngkong: bad hangta u Abram u la khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And if a man smite his servant , or his maid , with a rod , and he die under his hand  ; he shall be surely punished .
kha: Lada u briew u shoh da u dieng ïa la u mraw , la u shynrang ne ka kynthei , bad uta u mraw u ïap ha shen , uta u kynrad u dei ban shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u shoh ia u shakri jong u, ne ka nongtrei jong u, bad u iap hapoh ka kti jong u ; un shah pynshitom shisha .

en: But as it is written , To whom he was not spoken of , they shall see : and they that have not heard shall understand .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa kito ha kiba ym pat shym la ïathuh shaphang jong u kin ïohi , bad kito ki bym pat shym la ïohsngew kin sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba la thoh , Ha uba ym shym la kren ia u , kin iohi: bad kito ki bym pat iohsngew kin sngewthuh .

en: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
kha: Kumta kim ïalong shuh ar ngut , hynrei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kim long shuh arngut hynrei kawei ka doh . Kaei kaba U Blei u la iasoh lang , wat ai ba u briew un ym shah pynpra .

en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth , and been wanton  ; ye have nourished your hearts , as in a day of slaughter .
kha: Ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka pyrthei ka la long kaba dap da ka jingpahuh bad jingsngewbha . Phi la pynsngaid ïa lade na ka bynta ka sngi ka jingshohdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la im ha ka jingsngewbha ha ka khyndew, bad phi la long uba sngewsih ; phi la pyndap ia ki dohnud jong phi kumba ha ka sngi pyniap .

en: Behold , I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves : be ye therefore wise as serpents , and harmless as doves .
kha: To shahshkor ! nga phah noh ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun ki suri . Phi dei ban phikir kum ki bseiñ bad kiba jemnud kum ki paro .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga phah ia phi kum ki langbrot hapdeng ki blang: to long namarkata kiba stad kum ki bsein bad ki bym don jingma kum ki paro .

en: And Judah said , Let her take it to her , lest we be shamed : behold , I sent this kid , and thou hast not found her .
kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Ai kan bat ïa kito ki tiar . Ngim kwah ba ki briew kin rkhie ïa ngi . Nga la pyrshang ban siew ïa ka , hynrei phim shym lap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong: To ai ba kan shim ia ka ha ka: ioh ngin sngewlehrain: ha khmih nga la phah ia une u khynnah bad me khlem lap ia ka .

en: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread : but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding .
kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don pahuh ka bam , hynrei ka long ka jingleh bieit ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka por ha ki kam bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pynkhih ia ka ri jong u un sngewhun ia u kpu: hynrei uta uba bud ia ki briew kiba lehnohei u long uba khlem jingmut .

en: And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh , and he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh bad , kumba u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud u Pharaoh bad um shym la sngap ia ki kumba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses .

en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .
kha: U Barsillai , uba na Gilead , u la wan hiar ruh na Rogelim ban synran ïa u syiem sha shiliang ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Barzillai u Gilead u la wan hiar na Rogelim bad u la leit sha Jordan ryngkat bad u syiem ban pyniaid ia u halor ka Jordan .

en: And all the people of the land rejoiced : and the city was quiet , after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword .
kha: La pyndap da ka jingkmen ïa ki briew baroh , bad ka nongbah ka la shongsuk , mynta ba la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh jong ka ri ki la ia risa: bad ka shnong ka la sngap jar , hadien kata ki la pyniap ia u Athaliah da ka waitlam .

en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .
kha: To ïam bad to kyang haba phi ïohsngew ïa kane . Phi kiba shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , namar baroh ki nongkhaïi kin ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno phi ki nongshong shnong jong ka Makesh, namar baroh ki briew kiba khaii ki shah ot; baroh kiba kit rupa ki shah ot noh .

en: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard , saying ,
kha: Hynrei u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hukum ïa u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , ban ai ïa kane ka hukum harum :
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Nebuchadrezzar u syiem Babilon u la ai ia ka jingkynnoh kaba iadei bad u Jeremaiah ha u Nebuzaradan u rangbah shipai u la ong:

en: It is drawn , and cometh out of the body  ; yea , the glittering sword cometh out of his gall : terrors are upon him .
kha: U khnam un sam lyngba ïa ka met jong u ; ka snam kan jaw na ka bynta banep jong u , bad ka jingshyrkhei kan khñiot ïa ka mynsiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: La ring ia ka, bad ka mih na ka met ; yea, ka waitlam kaba rben ka mih na ka gall jong u: ki tieng ki don halor jong u .

en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .
kha: Tang ma me marwei men wan sha jan jong nga ; kita kiwei pat kim bit ban wan sha jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ban wan kiew sha uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses marwei un wan hajan U Trai: hynrei kin ym wan hajan ; bad ki briew kin ym leit shaneng bad u .

en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .
kha: Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun , kumta ruh U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u sneng pynbeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh to pyrkhat ha ka dohnud jong me, ba kumba u briew u pynshitom ia la u khun, kumta U Trai U Blei jong me u pynshitom ia me .

en: Behold , I say , how they reward us , to come to cast us out of thy possession , which thou hast given us to inherit .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ba ki siew kylliang ïa ngi — ki wan ban beh krad ïa ngi shabar na ka ri kaba me la ai ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, nga ong, kumno ki ai ia ngi, ban wan bret noh ia ngi na ka jingdon jong me, kaba me la ai ia ngi ban hiar pateng .

en: He shall call upon me , and I will answer him : I will be with him in trouble  ; I will deliver him , and honour him .
kha: Haba ki khot ïa nga , ngan jubab ïa ki ; haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar , ngan long ryngkat bad ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad ngan pyndonburom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Un khot ia nga , bad ngan jubab ia u: Ngan don ryngkat bad u ha ka jingeh; ngan pyllait im ia u, bad ngan burom ia u .

en: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life , set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church .
kha: Lada kum kita kiei kiei ki jia , hato phin leit rah ïa ki ban pynbeit da ki briew ki bym don nongrim ha ka balang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada te phi don ki jingbishar ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad kane ka jingim , buh ia ki ban bishar ia kiba kham duna ka jingburom ha ka balang .

en: The  Lord  rewarded me according to my righteousness : according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me .
kha: U  Trai  u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei ; u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar ba nga long uba shida .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la siew kylliang ia nga kat kum ka hok jong nga: kat kum ka jingkhuid jong ki kti jong nga u la siew kylliang ia nga .

en: And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
kha: Bun ki briew ki la siang ïa ki jaiñkup ha lynti . Katba kiwei pat ki dang ïa-ot ïa ki tnat dieng ha ki lyngkha bad ki la siang ïa ki ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki pynphriang ia ki jain jong ki ha lynti: bad kiwei pat ki ot ia ki tnat na ki dieng , bad ki la sdang ia ki ha lynti .

en: And Esther said , The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman . Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .
kha: Ka Esther ka ong ,  U nongshun jong ngi , u nongpynshitom jong ngi , u dei une u briew uba sniew , u Haman !  U Haman u khmih sha u syiem bad ka mahadei da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esther u la ong , U nongshun bad u nongshun u long une u Haman uba sniew . Nangta u Haman u la tieng ha khmat u syiem bad ka mahadei .

en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
kha: Bad u la pyndap ,  Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Namar kata nga la ong ha phi, ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban wan sha nga lymda la ai ha u na U Kpa jong nga .

en: And all the men of his house , born in the house , and bought with money of the stranger , were circumcised with him .
kha: ryngkat bad ki mraw baroh jong u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shynrang baroh jong ka iing jong u kiba la kha ha iing bad kiba la thied da ka pisa jong u nongwei ki la shah ot bad u .

en: Lest haply , after he hath laid the foundation , and is not able to finish it , all that behold it begin to mock him ,
kha: Lada um don , un ym lah ban tei pyndep ïa ka jaka ap phira hadien ba u la seng nongrim ; bad baroh kiba ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia kin rkhie ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lest lehse, hadien ba u la buh ia ka nongrim , bad um lah ban pyndep ia ka , baroh kata ka sdang ban rkhie bein ia u , .

en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings .
kha: Ïa ka kjat-dien kamon jong u mrad yn ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tyrpeng kaba sha kadiang phin ai ha u lyngdoh na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba heh jong ki jingknia iasuk jong phi .

en: And he asked them of their welfare , and said , Is your father well , the old man of whom ye spake ? Is he yet alive ?
kha: U la kylli shaphang ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong ki bad u ong ,  Phi la ïathuh ha nga shaphang i pa jong phi , iba la tymmen — i long kumno ? I dang im , bad i shait i khlaiñ bha ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia ki shaphang ka jingbha jong ki bad u la ong: Hato u kpa jong phi u la bha ? Hato u dang im ?

en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .
kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi bad un pynkhuid ïa ngi na ki kam bymman baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi phla ia ki pop jong ngi , u long uba iaineh bad tang ban map ia ki pop jong ngi , bad ban pynkhuid ia ngi na ka jingbymhok baroh .

en: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah ,  Kane ka dei ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa me ban rah ïa la ka jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la ong ha uta uba la koit: Kam long kaba dei ia me ban rah ia ka jingthiah jong me .

en: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;
kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thain jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon baroh , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Salekah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Gilead bad u pud u sam jong ki Geshur bad ki Maachath bad baroh ki lum Hermon bad baroh ki Basan haduh u Basan;

en: In weariness and painfulness , in watchings often , in hunger and thirst , in fastings often , in cold and nakedness .
kha: Nga la thait na ka jingtrei shitom ; bunsien ngam ju ïohthiah ; nga la thngan bad sliang ; bunsien ngam shym la don ka jingbam kaba biang , ka jakarieh , lane khlem jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingtlot bad ka jingsngewsih, ha ki jingpeit bunsien, ha ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingthngan, ha ki jingbam bunsien, ha ka jingkhriat bad ka jingkhuid .

en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :
kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kata ha ka jingstad bad jingïohi jong u baroh ïa kaei kaba u la thmu , bad u la pynpaw shynna ha ngi ïa ka jingthmu ba la buhrieh ïa kaba u la lah thmu lypa ban pyndep da U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba pynpaw ha ngi ia ka jingmaham jong ka mon jong u, kat kum ka jingsngewbha jong u kaba u la thmu ha lade:

en: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba dei ban don hapoh ka Hima yn bret noh sha ka jingdum , ha kaba kin lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun jong ka hima kin shah bret sha ka jingdum kaba kham shabar: kin sa iam bad kin sa rkhie bein .

en: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem : for he did eat continually at the king s table  ; and was lame on both his feet .
kha: Kumta u Mephibosheth , uba la dkoh ki kjat baroh ar tylli , u la shong la sah ha Jerusalem , u da bam ïa baroh ki jingbam jong u ha ka miej bam jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Mephibosheth u la shong ha Jerusalem: namar u la bam beit ha ka miej syiem ; bad u la lyngngoh ha baroh ar tylli ki kjat jong u .

en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .
kha: Shisien , katba ki Israel ki dang don ha ka ri khlaw , la lap ïa uwei u briew uba dang lum diengïap ha ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki dang don ha ri khlaw , ki la lap ia u briew uba lum dieng ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways : they are not hid from my face , neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .
kha: Nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki leh . Ym don kano kano kaba la buhrieh na nga ; ki pop jong ki kim lait phet na ka jingïohi jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khmat jong nga ki don ha ki lynti jong ki baroh: kim shym la buhrieh na ka khmat jong nga , bad ka jingbymhok jong ki kam shym la buhrieh na ki khmat jong nga .

en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .
kha: Kumba u kpa uba bha u kwah ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u kpa uba bha u kwah ia kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun jong u , U Kpa jong ngi uba ha bneng u kwah ba ngin ioh ia ka jingkmen bymjukut .

en: To the law and to the testimony : if they speak not according to this word , it is because there is no light in them .
kha: Me dei ban jubab ïa ki ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u hikai ïa phi ! Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongkren byrtong — kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi kan ym weng ïa ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hukum bad ha ka jingphla: lada kim kren kat kum kane ka ktien , ka long namar ba ym don jingshai ha ki .

en: The nations also heard of him  ; he was taken in their pit , and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad ki la riam ïa u ha ka thliew . Da ki bnoh ki tan noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew ruh ki la iohsngew ia u ; la rah ia u ha ka thliew jong ki , bad ki la wanrah ia u da ki kynjri sha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
kha: Shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ïa ki , U la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki ,  Ki Briew . )
translated_en_to_kha: U shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ia ki bad u la kyrkhu ia ki, bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ki u Adam, ha ka sngi ba la thaw ia ki .

en: And when they had laid many stripes upon them , they cast them into prison , charging the jailor to keep them safely :
kha: Hadien ka jingsympat kaba jur , la set phatok ïa ki , bad la ai hukum ïa u nongpeit phatok ban khang skhem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la buh bun ki lain ha ki , ki la bret ia ki ha phatok , da kaba pynngat ia u koidi ban buh ia ki da kaba suk:

en: And it came to pass , when all the people were clean passed over Jordan , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la lah jam ïa ka Jordan , U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki briew baroh ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan, ba U Trai u la kren ha u Joshua, u da ong:

en: Ishwar knows that men who have assumed the responsibility of judging , most of them are themselves deserving of pity .
kha: U Ishwar u tip ba ki shynrang kiba la shim ia ka jingkitkhlieh ban bishar , kiba bun na ki ki long hi kiba dei hok ban ioh jingsngewsynei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishwar u tip ba ki shynrang kiba la shim ia ka jingkitkhlieh ban bishar , kiba bun na ki ki long hi kiba dei hok ban ioh ia ka jingsngewrit .

en: Her princes within her are roaring lions  ; her judges are evening wolves  ; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow .
kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka ki long kum ki sing bakyrhuh ; ki nongbishar jong ka ki long kum ki suri bathngan , kiba lalot eh kat ban pynsah sa tang ka shyieng haduh mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka hapoh jong ka ki long ki sing kiba rkhie bein ; ki nongbishar jong ka ki long ki blang janmiet ; kim ju bam ia ki shyieng haduh ka sngi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Jacob , Return unto the land of thy fathers , and to thy kindred  ; and I will be with thee .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit phai pat sha ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me , bad sha la ki kur ki jait . Nga ngan long lem ryngkat bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Jakob: To leit phai noh sha ka ri jong ki kpa tymmen jong me bad sha ka ri jong me; bad ngan don ryngkat bad me .

en: And Abijam slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Abijah u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abijam u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ; bad ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Asa u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons  after him , to be anointed therein , and to be consecrated in them .
kha: Ynda la ïap u Aaron , ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh jong u dei ban aiti ha ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin phong ha ka por ba pynkyntang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jain kyntang jong u Aaron kin long ki khun shynrang jong u hadien jong u, ban shah pynsleh ha ki bad ban shah pynkyntang ha ki .

en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .
kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba pynkhih ia ka kti jong me ban pynkoit ; bad ba ki dak bad ki jingphylla jong me kin long da ka kyrteng U Jisu bakhuid jong me .

en: Wherein ye greatly rejoice , though now for a season , if need be , ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations :
kha: To ïakmen shaphang kane , wat la ka lah ban long kaba donkam ïa phi mynta ban sngewsih shipor namar kiba bun jait ki jingtynjuh kiba phi shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba phi sngewbha shibun, wat la mynta na ka bynta ka aiom, lada donkam, phi don ha ka jingkhia lyngba ki jingpynshoi kiba bun:

en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
kha: Nga thoh sha phi , namarkata , ym namar ba phim tip ïa ka jingshisha ; pynban , ka long namar ba phi da tip ïa ka , bad phi tip ruh ym don ka lamler kaba ju mihnoh na ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la thoh sha phi namar ba phim tip ia ka jingshisha , hynrei namar ba phi tip ia ka , bad ba ym don jinglamler na ka jingshisha .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïohi ïa ka burom U Blei lada pha ngeit ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ka , La ong ia nga ha me, ba lada me ngeit , me dei ban iohi ia ka burom U Blei ?

en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .
kha: Katba kata ka sur ka dang kren , U Mynsiem U Blei u la rung ha nga , bad u la pynïeng ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur ba ka dang ïai kren ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u mynsiem u la rung ha nga haba u la kren ha nga, bad u la buh ia nga ha ki kjat jong nga, ba nga la iohsngew ia uta uba kren ha nga .

en: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah , who was a Levite , and he sojourned there .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka por la don uwei u samla Lebi uba ju sah ha nongrit Bethlehem kaba ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u samla na Bethlehemudah na ka longiing Judah , uba long u Lebi , bad u la sah hangta .

en: And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof .
kha: U Joseph u la pynlong mraw ïa ki briew na tduh sha tduh ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia ki briew , u la weng noh ia ki sha ki nongbah na kawei ka tduh jong u pud u sam jong ka ri Ijipt wat haduh kawei pat ka tduh jong ka .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto me , Go and get thee a linen girdle , and put it upon thy loins , and put it not in water .
kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied ïa lade katto katne tylli ki patlun linen balyngkot bad ban phong ïa ki ; hynrei u la bthah ïa nga ban ym phong ïa ki hapoh ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ha nga, To leit shim ia ka jain lin, bad buh ia ka ha ki tyrpeng jong me, bad wat buh ia ka ha ka um .

en: Be thou instructed , O Jerusalem , lest my soul depart from thee  ; lest I make thee desolate , a land not inhabited .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , ai ba kine ki jingjynjar kin long ka jingmaham ïa phi , lymda kumta ngan iehnoh ïa phi ; ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah jong phi sha ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong basah .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba la hikai, ko Jerusalem, ioh ba ka mynsiem jong nga kan leit noh na me ; ioh ba ngan pynlong ia me ban jah rngai noh, ka ri kaba ym shong shnong .

en: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ka jingknia ba la thang ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang .

en: Lord  , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :
kha: A  Trai  , men shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong kiba rit kyrdan ; me ai ha ki ka jingshlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai, me la iohsngew ia ka jingkwah jong kiba pynrit mynsiem: me pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong ki:

en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .
kha: U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Saul lem bad u khunblang , u kada uba kit shikhung u kpu bad ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .
