translated_en_to_kha: U Jesse u la shim ia u kada uba la shah rong noh bad u wain bad u khun masi bad u khun masi bad u la phah ia ki da u Dabid u khun jong u sha u Saul .

en: It is one of the Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram that were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1984 .
kha: Ka dei kawei na ki kynhun jong ki jingkynmaw ha Mahabalipuram kiba la shah jied kum ka jaka pateng pyrthei jong ka UNESCO naduh u snem 1984 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dei kawei na ki Group jong ki Monument ha Mahabalipuram kaba la buh kum ka UNESCO World Heritage Site naduh u snem 1984 .

en: And the high priest arose , and said unto him , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ïeng bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Mem don jubab ban ai ïa kane ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah lyngdoh u la ieng bad u la ong ha u, "Phim jubab ei ei ? kaei kata kaba kine ki sakhi pyrshah ia me ?

en: And he took him aside from the multitude , and put his fingers into his ears , and he spit , and touched his tongue  ;
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la shim ïa u tang marwei na u paidbah , U la buh ïa la ki shympriah kti ha ki shkor jong uta u briew , U la biah , bad U la ktah ïa u thylliej jong uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u shawei na u paidbah bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha ki shkor jong u, bad u la sngap jar bad u la ktah ia ka shyntur jong u;

en: So your good conduct may draw others to listen to the message you tell them .—Matthew 5 :16  ; 1 Peter 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
kha: Kumta ka akor babha jong phi ka lah ban khring ïa kiwei pat ban shahskhor ïa ka khubor ba phi ïathuh ha ki .—Mathaios 5 :16 ; 1 Petros 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka jinglong babha jong phi ka lah ban khring ia kiwei ban sngap ia ka khubor kaba phi iathuh ia ki . ATAU 5 :16 ; 1 Petros 3 :1, 2 , 16 .

en: Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
kha: Haduh hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pyrkhat briew , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka dohnud jong u kan kylla na u briew s, bad ai ba ka dohnud jong u mrad kan long ha u bad ai ba hynriew sien kan iaid halor jong u .

en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
kha: bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pharshi jong u, bad u la ong, u Balaam u khun u Beor u la ong, bad uta u briew uba la plie ki khmat u la ong:

en: Therefore the  Lord  hath recompensed me according to my righteousness  ; according to my cleanness in his eye sight .
kha: Bad kumta u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei , namar u tip ba nga long uba shida .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la siew kylliang ia nga kat kum ka hok jong nga ; kat kum ka jingkhuid jong nga ha ka khmat jong u .

en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the  Lord  , What he did in the Red sea , and in the brooks of Arnon ,
kha: Dei namar kata ba  Ka Kitab jong ki Thma U  Trai  ka kren shaphang  . . . ka shnong Waheb ha ka thain Suphah , bad ki them jong ka wah Arnon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la ong ha ka Kitab ki thma U Trai , Kaei kaba u la leh ha ka duriaw Basaw bad ha ki wah Arnon .

en: Actress and daughter of Anil Kapoor has Sonam Kapoor has strongly reacted to the false reports of her father ' s . . .
kha: Ka actress bad ka khun jong u Anil Kapoor ka la kynthoh jur ia ki khubor lamler jong u kpa jong ka . . .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kam bad ka khun jong u Anil Kapoor ka don ka jingkynthoh kaba jur ia ki khubor lamler jong u kpa jong ka . .

en: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place : with a young bullock for a sin offering , and a ram for a burnt offering .
kha: U lah ban rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam tang hadien ba u la wallam ïa uwei u masi lyngraw ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Aaron un wan sha ka jaka bakhuid: da u masi uba dang rit na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , bad u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang .

en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love , because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee , brother .
kha: Ka jingieit jong me , ko para ba-ieit , ka la wallam ïa ka jingkmen bakhraw bad jingaimynsiem bajur ! Me la pynkmen ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew U Blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi don ka jingkmen bad jingpyntngen kaba khraw ha ka jingieit jong me, namar ki kpoh jong ki riewkhuid ki shah pynthymmai da me, ko para .

en: Who covereth the heaven with clouds , who prepareth rain for the earth , who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains .
kha: U pynphriang ïa ki lyoh ha ka suiñbneng ; u pynbiang slap ïa ka khyndew bad u pynlong ba u phlang un mih ha ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba tap ia ka bneng da ki lyoh , uba pynkhreh ia u slap na ka bynta ka khyndew , uba pynlong ia u phlang ban san halor ki lum .

en: So Jacob came to Luz , which is in the land of Canaan , that is , Beth–el , he and all the people that were with him .
kha: U Jakob u wan poi bad la ki briew baroh ha Lus , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethel , ha ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jakob u la poi ha Luz, kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan, kata ka long, u Bethel, ma u bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: Whether it be in the warp , or woof  ; of linen , or of woollen  ; whether in a skin , or in any thing made of skin  ;
kha: lane ha kano kano ka lyngkhot jaiñ linen ne jaiñ  saiwul , lane ha ka snieh , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh ,
translated_en_to_kha: La ka long ha ka sniehdoh , ne ha ka sniehdoh kaba la shna da ka sniehdoh .

en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .
kha: Hynrei ki nongtuh bad ki briew bym don Blei ki im ha ka jingsuk , wat la u blei jong u long tang ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jainkup jong ki runar ki roi , bad kito kiba pynkhih ia U Blei ki long kiba skhem ; ha ka kti jong u U Blei u wanrah shibun .

en: Beloved , let us love one another : for love is of God  ; and every one that loveth is born of God , and knoweth God .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , to ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , namar ka jingieit ka wan na U Blei . Uno uno uba ieit , u long u khun jong U Blei bad u ithuh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit , to ngin ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat: namar ka jingieit ka long jong U Blei ; bad uwei pa uwei uba ieit u la kha na U Blei , bad u ithuh ia U Blei .

en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .
kha: Baroh kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka doh baroh kan tip ba nga U Trai nga la sei ia ka waitlam jong nga na ka sniehdoh jong u: kan ym wan phai shuh .

en: Herein is love , not that we loved God , but that he loved us , and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ka jingieit ka long : Kam dei ba ngi la ieit ïa U Blei , hynrei , ba u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la phah ïa la U Khun ban long ka lynti ha kaba map ïa ki pop jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne ka long ka jingieit , ym ba ngi ieit ia U Blei , hynrei ba u la ieit ia ngi , bad u la phah ia la u Khun ban long ka jingpyniasuk na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi .

en: I tell you , in that night there shall be two men in one bed  ; the one shall be taken , and the other shall be left .
kha: Ha kata ka miet , nga ong ha phi , yn don ar ngut ki briew kiba thiah ha kajuh ka jingthiah : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia phi, ha kata ka miet kin don arngut ki briew ha kawei ka jingthiah ; ia uwei yn shim noh bad ia uwei pat yn iehnoh .

en: And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .
kha: Te u Samson u rwai ,  Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , shihajar ngut nga pynïap ; Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong: Da ka shyntur jong u kada, nga la pyniap ia ki shyntur jong u kada .

en: And Jesus asked him , saying ,  What is thy name ?  And he said , Legion : because many devils were entered into him .
kha: U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ?   Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long ‘ U Paidbah ,’   u la jubab — naba shibun ki ksuid ki la rung hapoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la kylli ia u, u da ong, Kaei ka kyrteng jong me ? Bad u la ong, Legion: namar ba bun ki ksuid ki la rung ha u .

en: And , behold , immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was , sent from Caesarea unto me .
kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki lai ngut ki rangbah ïa kiba la phah sha nga na Kaisaria ki la wan poi ha ka ïing ha kaba nga la sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la don lai ngut ki briew kiba la wan sha ka iing ha kaba nga don, la phah na Kaisararia sha nga .

en: In 2007 , she was awarded the Padma Bhushan , India ' s third highest civilian honour , given by Government of India .
kha: Ha u snem 2007 ka la ioh ia ka khusnam Padma Bhushan kaba dei ka khusnam kaba lai tam jong ka ri India kaba la ai da ka sorkar India .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u snem 2007 , la pynkup burom ia ka Padma Bhushan , ka burom kaba lai kaba ha khlieh duh jong ka ri India .

en: And that no man might buy or sell , save he that had the mark , or the name of the beast , or the number of his name .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban thied ne die khlem don kane ka shab , kaba long , ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw lane u dak jingkheiñ uba ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban thied ne die, lait noh tang uta uba don ka dak ne ka kyrteng jong u mrad ne u nombar jong ka kyrteng jong u .

en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
kha: Hadien ba la pynkynriah ïa ka metïap na lynti , uwei pa uwei u la bud ïa u Joab ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la weng noh ia u na ka surok bah , ki briew baroh ki la iaid shakhmat hadien u Joab , ban bud ia u Sheba u khun u Bichri .

en: Making request , if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you .
kha: Nga pan ba U Blei ha ka mon babha jong u ha kaba khatduh un pynlah ïa nga ban wan jngoh ïa phi mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrpad , lada da kano kano ka lad mynta nga lah ban don ka jingleit kaba roi da ka mon U Blei ban wan sha phi .

en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Pekah u khun jong u Syiem Israel u la sdang ban synshar ia u Josiah u syiem Judah .

en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .
kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban tba , bad ki kjat , hynrei kim lah ban ïaid ; kim lah ban pynmih sur jingsawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim ju bat: ki kjat kim don: hynrei kim iaid: lymne ki kren lyngba ka shyntur jong ki .

en: And the skin of the bullock , and all his flesh , with his head , and with his legs , and his inwards , and his dung ,
kha: Hynrei un shim ïa ka snieh , ïa ka doh met , ïa ka khlieh , ïa ki kjat , bad ïa ki doh jem ba kynthup ïa ki snier ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sniehdoh jong u masi bad ka doh jong u baroh kawei, bad ka khlieh jong u bad ki kjat jong u bad ki bniat jong u hapoh .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Ka long kaba shisha kaba ki briew ki ong ba ka ri ka bam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jaitbynriew ïa ki khun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Namar ki ong ha phi, Me pynjot ia ki briew, bad me la duh noh ia ki jaitbynriew jong me ; .

en: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord ;
kha: To ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat da ki ktien ha ki salm , ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem ; da kaba rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki salm sha U Trai da ki jingïaroh ha ki dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba kren ia lade ha ki salm bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem , da kaba rwai bad pynlong ia ka jingrwai ha ka dohnud jong phi ha U Trai ; .

en: And I set my face unto the Lord God , to seek by prayer and supplications , with fasting , and sackcloth , and ashes :
kha: Bad nga la duwai jur ha U Trai U Blei , da kaba ïasaid bad u , da kaba shahjingit , da kaba phong ki jaiñ khain , bad da kaba shong ha u dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga buh ia ka khmat jong nga ha U Trai Blei, ban wad da ka jingduwai bad ki jingkyrpad, da kaba stet bad ka jainkup bad ka dewbilat:

en: The report referred to what it considered the illogical fear of the Muslims of being dominated by the Hindu majority .
kha: Ka kaiphod ka la kdew ia kaei kaba ka shim ba ka dei ka jingtieng bym don jingmut jong ki Muslim ba kin shah synshar ha ki Hindu kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kaiphod ka la kdew ia kaei kaba ka la pyrkhat ia ka jingtieng bym don jingmut jong ki Muslim ba la synshar da ka jingbun paid jong ki Hindu .

en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :
kha: Na u Paul , u Silas bad u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad ki jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai :
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul bad u Silvanus bad u Timothi ha ka balang jong ki nong Thessaloni ha U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist:

en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
kha: Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u angel uba hynriew ,  To pyllait noh ïa ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong ha u angel uba hynriew uba don ka turoi , Pynduh ia ki saw ngut ki angel kiba la shah teh ha ka wah bah Euphrates .

en: But found none : yea , though many false witnesses came , yet found they none . At the last came two false witnesses ,
kha: hynrei kim lah ban shem ei ei , wat la shisha bun ki briew ki la wan sha khmat bad kren ki jinglamler shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym shem ei ei: Hooid, wat la bun ki sakhi lamler ki la wan, hynrei kim lap ia ki . Ha kaba khatduh la wan arngut ki sakhi lamler , .

en: Now as I beheld the living creatures , behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures , with his four faces .
kha: Katba nga nang peit ïa kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw , nga la ïohi saw tylli ki shalyntem ba ki hiar ha ka khyndew , kawei kawei marsyndah bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba nga dang iohi ia ki jingthaw ba im, ha khmih kawei ka tyrpeng halor ka khyndew da ki jingthaw ba im, bad ki saw tylli ki khmat jong u .

en: My heart is toward the governors of Israel , that offered themselves willingly among the people . Bless ye the  Lord .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka long bad ki nongai hukum jong ki Israel , Lem bad u paidbah uba tyrwa mon sngewbha da kaba kmen . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka long sha ki nongsynshar Israel , kiba la tyrwa mon sngewbha hapdeng ki briew . Kyrkhu ia U Trai .

en: And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .
kha: Kumta uta u briew u la leit bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Dekapolis , da kaba ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah leh ïa u . Bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh , bad u la sdang ban pynmih ha ka Decapolis katno kiei kiei kiba khraw U Jisu u la leh na ka bynta jong u: bad ki briew baroh ki la lyngngoh .

en: And the old man said , Peace be with thee  ; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me  ; only lodge not in the street .
kha: U tymmen u ong ,  Nga pdiang sngewbha ha ïing jong nga ! Ngan pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi ; phim dei ban sahmiet hangne ha madan shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U tymmen u la ong , Ka jingsuk kan long bad me ; kumno kumno ruh to ai ba ki jingkwah jong me baroh kin thiah ha nga ; tang ba kin sah ha lynti .

en: And Joseph said unto his father , Not so , my father : for this is the firstborn  ; put thy right hand upon his head .
kha: U ong ha la u kpa ,  Pa , ym dei kumto . Une uba nyngkong ; buh ïa ka kti kamon jong phi ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha la u kpa: Ym kumta, ko kpa jong nga: namar kane ka long kaba nyngkong eh ba u la buh ia ka kti kadiang jong me ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .
kha: Khie leit ha kaba suk ,  u Eli u ong ,  bad to U Blei ki Israel un ai ha pha ïa kata kaba pha pan na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eli u la jubab bad u la ong: To leit suk: bad U Blei jong ki Israel un ai ia me ia ka jingkyrpad jong me ba me la pan na u .

en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth , as we have received a commandment from the Father .
kha: Katno nga sngewkmen ban shem ba don na ki khun jong phi kiba ïaid ha ka jingshisha , kumba U Kpa u la hukum ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la sngewkmen shibun ba nga lap ia ki khun jong me kiba iaid ha ka jingshisha , kumba ngi la ioh ia ka hukum na U Kpa .

en: And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .
kha: bad ka la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba la kyrkhu na baroh ki kynthei , bad long ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba phan sa kha !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kren da ka sur kaba jam bad ka la ong: La kyrkhu ia me napdeng ki kynthei bad la kyrkhu ia u soh jong ka kpoh jong me .

en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God  ;
kha: U Jisu u la tip ba U Kpa u la ai ha u ïa ka bor baroh ; u la tip ba u la wan na U Blei bad ba un sa leit sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u tip ba u Kpa u la aiti lut ia kiei kiei baroh ha ki kti jong u bad ba u la wan na U Blei bad u la leit sha U Blei ; .

en: But the  Lord  was with Joseph , and shewed him mercy , and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad kyrkhu ïa u , ba kumta u nongap byndi u la sngewbha eh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la don bad u Joseph , bad u la leh isynei ia u bad u la ai jingsngewbha ia u ha khmat u nongap phatok .

en: And Jesus answered him , saying ,  It is written , That man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word of God .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U briew um lah ban im tang da u kpu .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, u da ong: La thoh ia kata ka ktien: Uta u briew un ym im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien U Blei baroh .

en: Without natural affection , trucebreakers , false accusers , incontinent , fierce , despisers of those that are good ,
kha: kin long ki bym lehsbun , ki bym ïamap , kiba kren sniew , kiba thala , bad kiba runar ; kin isih ïa kaba bha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem ka jingieit ba kynja met, ki nongleh kam sniew, ki nongkynnoh lamler, ki bym don jingmut, ki bym don jingmut, ki bym don jingmut jong kito kiba bha , .

en: And they brake down the image of Baal , and brake down the house of Baal , and made it a draught house unto this day .
kha: Kumta ki la pynjot ïa u rishot bakyntang bad ïa kata ka templ , bad ki pynkylla jaka leit shabar ïa ka — kaba dang don haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynpra ia ka dur jong u Baal bad ki la pynpra ia ka iing jong u Baal bad ki la pynlong ia ka iing kaba la tyrkhong haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha , Behold now , the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ha kaba u Elisha u dei peit ïa ki , ki ud ha u ,  Ka jaka ha kaba ngi shong ka long kaba rit than eh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la ong ha u Elisha , Ha khmih mynta ka jaka ba ngi shong bad me ka long kaba jynjar palat ia ngi .

en: They answered and said unto him , Thou wast altogether born in sins , and dost thou teach us ? And they cast him out .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  La kha bad la pynsan ïa me hapoh ka pop — bad me pyrshang ban hikai ïa ngi ?  Bad kumta ki la beh noh ïa u na ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u, Me la kha pura ha ki pop bad me hikai ia ngi ? Ki la bret noh ia u .

en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled  ; a span shall be the length thereof , and a span shall be the breadth thereof .
kha: Ka dei ban long kaba sawdong , bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap , kaba jrong arphew ar sentimitar bad kaba ïar arphew ar sentimitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Saw tylli ki jaka ba la buh ar shah; ka span kan long ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .
kha: Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , shah ïa nga ban ong sa tang kawei ,  ka briew ka ong .  To ong  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka kynthei ka la ong, To ai ba me, nga kyrpad ia me, to kren ia kawei ka ktien ha u kynrad jong nga u syiem . Bad u la ong , To ong .

en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said , Go not down into Egypt  ; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of :
kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Isaak bad u ong ,  Wat leit sha ri Ijipt ; sah ha kane ka ri ha kaba nga la ong ha me ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha u bad u la ong: Wat leit sha Ijipt ; shong ha ka ri kaba ngan iathuh ia me:

en: He shall not fail nor be discouraged , till he have set judgment in the earth : and the isles shall wait for his law .
kha: Un ym duh jingkyrmen ne jingshlur ; un pynlong ka jingbishar hok ha ka pyrthei . Ki ri bajngai ki ap kmang ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym rem ne duh mynsiem, haduh ba un da buh ia ka jingbishar ha ka khyndew: bad ki dulir kin ap ia ka ain jong u .

en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered . Fear not therefore : ye are of more value than many sparrows .
kha: Wat ïa ki shñiuh jong ka khlieh jong phi la dep ñiew baroh . Kumta to wat sheptieng ; phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat ki shniuh khlieh jong phi ruh ki long kiba la khein baroh . Wat tieng namarkata: phi kham kordor ban ia kiba bun ki sim .

en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jotham u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Ahas u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death  ;
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban lap ki sabut lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la wad ia ka sakhi lamler pyrshah ia U Jisu, ban pyniap ia u ; .

en: Take my yoke upon you , and learn of me  ; for I am meek and lowly in heart : and ye shall find rest unto your souls .
kha: To shim ïa ka lyngkor jong nga bad buh ïa ka halor jong phi , bad to hikai na nga , namar nga long uba jemnud bad uba sngewrit ha ka mynsiem ; bad phin shem ka jingjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jingkit jong nga halor jong phi, bad to nang na nga ; namar nga long uba jemnud bad uba rit mynsiem: bad phin shem ia ka jingjahthait ha ki mynsiem jong phi .

en: So the  Lord  scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth : and they left off to build the city .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la pynsaphred ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ki la sangeh noh ha kaba tei ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la pynphriang ia ki shabar ri na kata ka jaka baroh kawei: bad ki la leit noh ban tei ia ka shnong .

en: Then he said unto me , Lo , I have given thee cow s dung for man s dung , and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith .
kha: Kumta U Blei u la ong ,  Ka bha shibun . Ngan shah ïa me ba men pyndonkam noh da ka eit masi pynban , bad me lah ban shet ïa la u kpu ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Lo, nga la ai ia me ia ka sboh masi na ka bynta u briew, bad me dei ban pynkhreh ia u kpu jong me da kata .

en: And also that nation , whom they shall serve , will I judge : and afterward shall they come out with great substance .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba teh mraw ïa ki , bad haba kin ïamihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei , kin da kit ruh shibun ka spah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ia kata ka jaitbynriew kaba kin shakri, ngan bishar: bad hadien kata kin mih da ka jingdon jingem kaba khraw .

en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days , saith the  Lord . Thus far is the judgment of Moab .
kha: Hynrei ha ki sngi ki ban wan U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka Moab kaba dap kyrhai sa shisien . Kane baroh ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia ïa ka Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ka Moab ha ki sngi kiba hadien , ong U Trai . Haduh mynta ka long ka jingbishar jong u Moab .

en: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
kha: Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asa naduh kaba nyngkong haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ia ki kam jong u Asa, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha ka kot ki syiem Judah bad Israel .

en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .
kha: ( Long ba la tim ïa u briew u bym leh ïa ka kam U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong u baroh ! Long ba la tim ïa uno uno u bym pom bad pynïap ! )
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba leh ia ka kam U Trai da kaba thok , bad la tim ia uta uba bat ia ka waitlam jong u na ka snam .

en: And when David s young men came , they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David , and ceased .
kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Nabal ha ka kyrteng u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki samla u Dabid ki la wan sha u Nabal kat kum kita ki ktien baroh ha ka kyrteng u Dabid bad ki la sangeh noh .

en: And the king said unto Joab , Behold now , I have done this thing : go therefore , bring the young man Absalom again .
kha: Hadien nangta u syiem u ong ha u Joab ,  Nga la rai ban leh ïa kata kaba me kwah . Khie leit bad wad ïa u samla Absalom bad wan ïalam pat ïa u hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Joab: Ha khmih mynta nga la leh ia kane: leit namarkata, wanrah biang ia u samla Absalom .

en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Men ïap kum u ksew ha ka kti jong ki nongwei bym don blei . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban iap ia ka jingiap jong ki bym pat shah ot da ka kti jong ki nongwei: namar nga la kren ia kata , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
kha: Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phi khlem pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei me peit ia ka mot kaba don ha ka khmat jong u hynmen jong me , hynrei wat pyrkhat ia ka beam kaba don ha la ka jong ka khmat ?

en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .
kha: Ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko ki para Israel jong nga , bad ka long lyngba U Jisu ba ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingmap ïa ki pop la ïalap ha phi ; bad ba ïa uwei uwei baroh uba ngeit ha u la pyllait na ki pop baroh na kiba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah ban pyllait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da u baroh kiba ngeit ki long kiba la pynksan na kiei kiei baroh , na kiba ym lah ban pynksan ia phi da ka hukum u Moses .

en: And also unto the Levites  ; they shall no more carry the tabernacle , nor any vessels of it for the service thereof .
kha: Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban kit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ki tiar baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh ha ki Lebi; kin ym kit shuh ia ka iingjain ne ki tiar jong ka na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka .

en: Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .
kha: Kumba me lah ban shem hi da lade , ym pat palat khat-ar sngi ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me lah ban sngewthuh , ba ki dang don tang shiphew sngi naduh ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane .

en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :
kha: ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam , ha shuwa Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba donburom jong U Trai ka wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi kan kylla dum, bad u bnai ha ka snam, shuwa ba kata ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba pawnam jong U Trai kan wan:

en: So they came into the land of Egypt : for they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  : thus came they even to Tahpanhes .
kha: Kim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki la leit sha Ijipt jngai shaduh ka nongbah Tahpanhes .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la wan sha ka ri Ijipt: namar kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai: kumta ki la poi wat sha Tahpanhes ruh .

en: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Men ym khot shuh ïa ka tnga jong me — ka Sarai ; naduh mynta ka kyrteng jong ka kan long noh — ka Sarah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham: Katba ia ka Sarai ka tnga jong me, wat khot ia ka Sarai ka kyrteng jong ka, hynrei ka Sarah kan long ka kyrteng jong ka .

en: And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .
kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Mem donkam ban ong ei ei shuh shuh . Nga la rai ba ma me bad u Siba men ïabynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u, Balei phi kren shuh ia ki kam jong me ? Nga la ong , Me bad u Siba to phiah ia ka ri .

en: And David did so , as the  Lord  had commanded him  ; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer .
kha: U Dabid u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad u la lah ban beh noh pat ïa ki Philistia naduh Geba shi lynter lynti haduh Geser .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leh kumta kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u ; bad u la shoh ia ki Philistia na Gba haduh ba me poi ha Gzer .

en: And this is the thing that ye shall do , Ye shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman that hath lain by man .
kha: Pynïap ïa baroh ki shynrang , bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ka bym dei shuh ka theisotti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long kaba phin leh , Phin pynjot lut ia uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim da u shynrang .

en: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall , and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers .
kha: Nangta ki shipai jong u Pilat ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu shapoh ka ïing paki dulan u lyngskor , bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shipai jong u Lat ki la ialam ia U Jisu shapoh ka hall kaba iadei bad u , bad ki la lum lang ha u ia ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .

en: Behold , with a great plague will the  Lord  smite thy people , and thy children , and thy wives , and all thy goods :
kha: Namar kata , U  Trai  un pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki briew jong me , ïa ki khun jong me , bad ïa ki tnga jong me , bad un pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingdon jingem jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , da ka khlam kaba khraw U Trai un pynkhih ia ki briew jong me bad ki khun jong me bad ki tnga jong me bad ki mar ki mata jong me baroh:

en: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;
kha: Lada ka kynthei ka bym pat shongkurim ka pynlong ka jingkular , da kaba mut khnang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kyndiah na kano kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka don satia u tnga, haba ka la kular ne kren ia kaei kaei na ki rmiang shyntur jong ka, ha kaba ka la teh ia ka mynsiem jong ka;

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa jong u , u Ussaïah , u Jotham u la leh hi ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai: u la leh katba kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: So we laboured in the work : and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared .
kha: Kumta , man ka sngi , naduh dang step phyrngab haduh ka por ba la mih ki khlur mynmiet , shiteng na ngi , ngi trei ha ka kynroh , katba shiteng kiwei pat , ki ïeng ap phira bad ki sum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi la trei shitom ha ka kam: bad shiteng na ki ki la bat ia ki khnam naduh ba ki khlur ki la paw .

en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .
kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba shim ktien uwei na uwei bad pynbna ïa ki kum ka khubor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia ki nongiathuhlypa , ong U Trai , kiba tuh ia ki ktien jong nga uwei pa uwei na u paramarjan jong u .

en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .
kha: Kumta ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki synran ba ka la ïohi ïa U Trai bad pynshai ha ki ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria Magdala ka la wan bad ka la iathuh ha ki synran ba ka la iohi ia U Trai bad ba u la kren ia kine kiei kiei ha ka .

en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .
kha: Ki la theh noh ïa ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei bad jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban dih . Ki la ïoh ïa kaba ki dei hok ban ïoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynmih ia ka snam jong ki riewkhuid bad ki nongiathuhlypa , bad me la ai snam ia ki ban dih ; namar ki long kiba bit dor .

en: And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :
kha: bad ïa u Gershom bad u Elieser ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka . ( U Moses u la ong ,  Nga long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwei  ; kumta u la jer kyrteng ïa uwei na ki  u Gershom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong ka ki long kiba kyrteng u Gershom ; namar u la ong , Nga la long u nongwei ha ka ri kaba phylla:

en: Then Zedekiah the king said , Behold , he is in your hand : for the king is not he that can do any thing against you .
kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la jubab ,  To leh te ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh ïa u ; ngam lah ban khang ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u syiem u la ong: Ha khmih, u don ha ka kti jong phi: namar u syiem um dei ma u uba lah ban leh ei ei pyrshah ia phi .

en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .
kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba mih ban leit tep ïa ka , kim shem ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh jong ka bad ki shyieng kti bad shyieng kjat jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit tep ia ka: hynrei kim lap shuh ia ka hynrei tang ka khlieh bad ki kjat bad ki kti jong ka .

en: Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba kaei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki — kin long ki nongphetwir bad kiba shah ring koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: La ong , nga long ka dak jong phi: kumba nga la leh, kumta yn leh ia ki: kin weng noh bad leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .
kha: Men ïai don ki khun ki ksiew , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban neh junom . Ka longïing syiem jong me kan ym kut .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka iing jong me bad ka hima jong me kan long kaba skhem junom ha khmat jong me: ka khet jong me kan long kaba skhem junom .

en: Many times did he deliver them  ; but they provoked him with their counsel , and were brought low for their iniquity .
kha: Bunsien U  Trai  u pyllait ïa ki briew jong u , hynrei ki jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ngam kham jylliew ha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bunsien u la pynpoi ia ki ; hynrei ki la pynkhih ia u da ka jingmut jong ki , bad la pynhiar dor ia ki namar ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost , that he should not see death , before he had seen the Lord s Christ .
kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la don bad u bad U la pynthikna ïa u ba un ym ïap ha shuwa ba un ïohi ïa U Messaïah ba la kular jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynpaw ha u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid, ba un ym iohi ia ka jingiap, shuwa ba un iohi ia U Trai u Khrist .

en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken : they shall be for flocks , which shall lie down , and none shall make them afraid .
kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Syria yn sa iehnoh junom . Kin long ka jaka pynbamphlang ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi , bad ym don mano mano ba beh noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong jong u Aroer ki shah iehnoh: kin long na ka bynta ki kynhun masi ki ban thiah , bad ym don kawei ruh kaba pyntieng ia ki .

en: For her wound is incurable  ; for it is come unto Judah  ; he is come unto the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .
kha: Ïa ki jingmong ka Samaria yn ym lah pynkhiah , bad ka Judah kan shahshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ; ka jingpynjot ka la poi haduh ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem hi , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingmynsaw jong ka ka long kaba ym lah ban pynkoit ; namar ka la wan sha Judah ; u la wan sha ka khyrdop jong ki briew jong nga, wat sha Jerusalem .

en: Yea , thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised , and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword .
kha: Kata ka long ba kumno ïa ki Ijipt yn pynlwet hapdeng kiba khlem otsher kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me , to shah pynpra hapdeng ki bym pat shah ot , bad to thiah bad ki kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam .

en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .
kha: To kdew ïa ka lynti sha Seïon ! To phet ban lait im ! Wat ym pynslem ! U  Trai  u wallam ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw na shatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia ka standard sha ka Seion: shongthait noh: wat sah: namar ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew na shaphang shathie , bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw .

en: A man s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth  ; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled .
kha: Phin hap ban im lem bad ki soh kiba mih na baroh kaba phi kren .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u sngewhun ia u soh jong ka shyntur jong u ; bad da ka jingroi jong ki rmiang shyntur jong u un sa dap .

en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness , as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , namar ka long ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh wat leit sha ka kynthei ban pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka , katba ka dang sahkut noh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid jong ka .

en: And he gathered an host , and smote the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them .
kha: U ïaleh da kaba shlur bad u jop wat ïa ki paid Amalek . U la pyllait im ïa ki Israel na baroh ki jingtur ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum ia ka kynhun shipai , bad u la pynkhih ia ki nong Amlek , bad u la pyllait noh ia ki Israel na ki kti jong ki kiba la pynsniew ia ki .

en: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .
kha: U Petros u la leit kylleng kylleng , bad ha kawei ka sien u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki briew jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u Petros u dang iaid kylleng ki jaka , u la wan hiar ruh sha ki riewkhuid kiba shong ha Lydda .

en: And ye returned and wept before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  would not hearken to your voice , nor give ear unto you .
kha: Kumta phi la lynñiar ha U  Trai  ba un ïarap ïa phi , hynrei um shym sngap ne shahshkor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la wan phai bad iam ha khmat U Trai ; hynrei U Trai un ym sngap ia ka sur jong phi , lymne un ym sngap ia phi .

en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate : and he measured the south gate according to these measures  ;
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashathie sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop , bad ka la don kajuh ka jingheh kum kito kiba ha ki kynroh kiba shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia nga sha ka phyllaw kaba shapoh da ka khyrdop ba shathie : bad u la thew ia ka khyrdop ba shathie kat kum kine ki jingthew ; .

en: In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .
kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïing U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan leit ban pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïathuh ïa phi lada kam long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha iing U Kpa jong nga ki don bun ki iing: lada kam long kumta , nga la iathuh ia phi . Nga leit ban pynkhreh ia ka jaka na ka bynta jong phi .

en: So David went up thither , and his two wives also , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail Nabal s wife the Carmelite .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u la leit sha Hebron , u da ïalam bad u ïa ki ar ngut ki tnga jong u : Ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la kiew sha jrong, bad ki arngut ki tnga jong u ruh, Ahinoam ka Jesril, bad ka tnga jong u Abigail ka Karmelite .

en: The objective in this regard has been chalked out for 10 , 000 of clusters while covering area of 2 lakh hectare land .
kha: Ka jingthmu ha kane ka bynta la buh kyrpang na ka bynta 10,000 tylli ki kynhun katba ka kynthup ia ka jaka kaba heh 2 lak hectare .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthmu ha kane ka bynta ka la long 10 000 tylli ki kynhun katba ka dang tap ia ka jaka kaba heh 2 lak hectare .

en: For his letters , say they , are weighty and powerful ; but his bodily presence is weak , and his speech contemptible .
kha: Don u ban ong ,  Ki shithi u Paul ki long kiba pyrkhing bad kiba khia , hynrei haba u don bad ngi markhmat , u long uba tlot , bad ki ktien jong u kim long ei ei!
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki shithi jong u, ong ba ki long kiba khia bad kiba donbor ; hynrei ka jingdon met jong u ka long kaba tlot, bad ka jingkren jong u ka long kaba sngewsih .

en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son : and when she saw him that he was a goodly child , she hid him three months .
kha: Haba ka ïohi ba u long u khunlung uba bhabriew , ka buhrieh ïa u lai bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei ka la pun khun bad ka la kha khun shynrang: bad haba ka la iohi ia u ba u long u khynnah uba bha, ka la buhrieh ia u lai bnai .

en: I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .
kha: Nga hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , namar phim pat shym kotbor ïa ka . Bad wat haduh mynta phim pat long kiba kotbor ïa ka , namar phi dang im kumba im ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ai dud ia phi da ka dud , bad ym da ka doh: namar haduh mynta phim lah ban shah ia ka , hynrei mynta phim lah .

en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God . For it is written , He taketh the wise in their own craftiness .
kha: Naba ka jingstad pyrthei , ka long ka jingibieit ha khmat U Blei . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u pynngat ïa kiba stad ha ki buit jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingbieit bad U Blei . Namar la thoh , U shim ia kiba stad ha la ka jong ka kam .

en: But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
kha: Katto katne pat , ki la pdiang ïa u bad ki la ngeit ha u ; kumta u la ai bor ha ki , ban long ki khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba ki la pdiang ia u, ha ki u la ai bor ban long ki khun U Blei, wat ha kito kiba ngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u:

en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wanrah biang ia nga ha ka lynti jong ka jaka kyntang kaba shabar kaba peit shaphang mihngi ; bad ka la khang .

en: And he stood over her , and rebuked the fever  ; and it left her : and immediately she arose and ministered unto them .
kha: U la leit bad ïeng harud ka jingthiah jong ka bad u la hukum ïa ka jingpang shit ban mihnoh na ka . Ka jingpang shit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng halor jong ka, bad u la pynrem ia ka jingshit ; bad ka la iehnoh ia ka: bad mar kumta hi ka la ieng bad ka la shakri ia ki .

en: Verily I say unto you , Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child , he shall not enter therein .
kha: Nga kren skhem ïa phi ba uno uno u bym pdiang ïa ka Hima U Blei kum u khynnah un ym lah lano lano ruh ban rung hapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Uno uno u bym pdiang ia ka hima U Blei kum u khynnah rit , un ym rung shapoh jong ka .

en: Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .
kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh kiba lamler , bad wat pynïap ïa uba lui lui , namar ngan pynrem ïa uno uno uba leh kum kata ka kam bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: To jngai na ka kam kaba bakla bad kaba khlem pop bad kaba hok: namar ngan ym pynshisha ia kiba sniew .

en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself  ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
kha: Ka khyndew hi ka pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san bad ban seisoh ; nyngkong u speh balung u mih , hadien ka kop , bad khatduh ka kop ba-dap da u symboh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka khyndew ka pynmih nyngkong ia u soh jong ka met, nangta ka shkor , hadien kata u kew ba pura ha ka shkor .

en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair  ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .
kha: katto katne na ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng    ki la ïohi ba kine ki samla kynthei ki long kiba bhabriew , kumta ki la shim ïa kita kiba ki la mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki khun shynrang U Blei ki la iohi ia ki khun kynthei shynrang ba ki long kiba hok ; bad ki la shim ia ki ki tnga jong baroh kaba ki la jied .

en: And we are his witnesses of these things  ; and so is also the Holy Ghost , whom God hath given to them that obey him .
kha: Ngi long ki sakhi ïa kine kiei kiei — ma ngi bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba long ka jingai jong U Blei ha kita baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi long ki sakhi jong u shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh bad kumjuh ruh U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ia uba U Blei u la ai ha ki kiba kohnguh ia u .

en: But the king covered his face , and the king cried with a loud voice , O my son Absalom , O Absalom , my son , my son !
kha: U syiem u tap ïa la ka durkhmat bad u kyang jam ,  A , ko khun jong nga ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! ko Absalom , ko khun jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem u la tap ia la ka khmat bad u syiem u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, ko khun jong nga u Absalom , ko khun jong nga !

en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken  ; but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
kha: Uno uno uba hap halor uta u maw un shah ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ; bad lada uta u maw u hap halor jongno jongno , un pynlwet phum ïa uta .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba hap halor uta u maw un shah pynpra ; hynrei ha uno uno uba un hap , un sa pynkhih ia u haduh ban da tyrkhong .

en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .
kha: U Moses u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara ban ïashem bad U Blei , bad ki la ïeng ha kjat jong u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wanrah ia ki briew na ka shnong ban iakynduh bad U Blei ; bad ki la ieng ha ka bynta ba shapoh jong u lum .

en: And she yet again conceived , and bare a son  ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him .
kha: Sa shisien pat ka la kha khun shynrang bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Shelah . U Judah u don ha Akhsib mynba la kha ïa u khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pun khun biang, bad ka la kha ia u khun shynrang bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Shelah: bad u la don ha Chezib , haba ka la kha ia u .

en: And from Bamoth in the valley , that is in the country of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looketh toward Jeshimon .
kha: bad na Bamoth sha ka them ha ka ri Moab , harum ka kliar u Lum Pisgah na uba lah ban ïohi ïa kata ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na Bamoth ha ka them, kata ha ka ri Moab, haduh ka tduh jong ka Pisgah kaba peit sha Jeshimon .

en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up  ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .
kha: Ka la ktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , bad ka jingmihsnam jong ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon ; bad ka la don ka jingsngewthuh hapoh jong ka ba ka ïohkhiah na ka jingshitom jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi ka pung snam jong ka ka la tyrkhong; bad ka la sngew ha ka met jong ka ba ka la koit na kata ka khlam .

en: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father , and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels ?
kha: Hato phim tip ba nga lah ban kyrpad jingïarap na U Kpa jong nga , bad shisyndon un da la phah palat khat-ar kynhun ki angel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi pyrkhat ba ngam lah mynta ban duwai ha U Kpa jong nga bad un ai mynta ia nga palat ia ka shiphew tylli ki kynhun ki angel ?

en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;
kha: U bteng nangta sha ka phang mihngi haduh Gath Hepher bad Ethkasin , da kaba phai ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti sha Rimmon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka iaid shaphang mihngi sha Gathhepher, sha Ethkazin, bad ka leit sha Rimmonmethoar sha Neah ; .

en: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .
kha: da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad lehkmen ha ka jingbhasbun jong ki briew baroh . Bad man ka sngi U Trai u nang pynïasoh ha ka kynhun jong ki ïa kito kiba la pynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiaroh ia U Blei , bad ka jingdon ia ka jingsngewbha bad ki briew baroh . Bad U Trai u la pyndap ia ka balang man ka sngi kumba dei ban pynim .

en: Thy right hand , O  Lord  , is become glorious in power : thy right hand , O  Lord  , hath dashed in pieces the enemy .
kha: Ka kti kamon jong me , A  Trai  , ka long kaba khraw eh ha ka bor ; ka pynlwet thiaw ïa u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti kadiang jong me, ko Trai, ka la kylla long kaba donburom ha ka bor: ka kti kadiang jong me, ko Trai, ka la pynpra ia u nongshun .

en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
kha: da kaba shah ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei hok ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynhap ïa uta u briew ha ka pop , bad un shah pynshitom . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane shah ia ki ban kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka jingleh bymman jong ki: namar nga U Trai nga pynkyntang ia ki .

en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine  ; he stretched out his hand with scorners .
kha: Ha ka sngi pyndonburom ïa u syiem , ki pynlong ïa u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ban dih buaid bad leh bieit da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi u syiem jong ngi ki syiem ki la pynpang ia u da ki bilor wain ; u la pynkhih ia la ka kti da ki scorn .

en: And Abraham said , My son , God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering : so they went both of them together .
kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  U Blei hi un sa pynbiang ïa uwei .  Bad baroh ar ngut ki nang ïa-ïaid lang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong, ko khun jong nga, U Blei un pynbiang ia lade ia u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang: kumta ki la ia leit lang baroh arngut .

en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .
kha: A  Trai  , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki khun jong ki ba ki shah beh kthong bad shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim kumba nga la iohi ia u Tyros, la thung ha ka jaka kaba sngewtynnad: hynrei u Ephraim un wanrah ia ki khun jong u ha u nongpyniap briew .

en: And Saul , yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord , went unto the high priest ,
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Saul u la byrngem ban pynïap ïa ki nongbud jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ring mynsiem ia ki jingma bad ka jingpyniap ia ki synran U Trai , u la leit sha u rangbah lyngdoh .

en: And if he shall come in the second watch , or come in the third watch , and find them so , blessed are those servants .
kha: A katno kin long kiba kmen lada u shem ïa ki ba ki long kiba kloi , wat haba un wan ha ka por shiteng synñia lane wat kham dier ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u wan ha ka jingpahara kaba ar, ne u wan ha ka jingpahara kaba lai, bad u shem ia ki kumta, la kyrkhu ia kita ki shakri .

en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir : they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .
kha: Ki pyndonkam ïa ki dieng Kseh-Phir na u lum Hermon kum ki dieng shna ïing . Bad ïa ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon na ka bynta ki dieng sieh lama .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ia ki dieng jong me baroh: ki la shim ia ki dieng na Lebanon ban shna ia ki masi na ka bynta jong me .

en: And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .
kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab ba u para um lah ban ieh ïa i pa ; namar lada u leh kumta , i pa in ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la ong ha u kynrad jong nga, U khynnah um lah ban iehnoh ia la u kpa: namar lada u iehnoh ia la u kpa , u kpa jong u un iap .

en: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy , which he had afore prepared unto glory ,
kha: Bad u la kwah ruh ban pynpaw ïa ka burom bakhraw jong u , ïa kaba la theh halor jong ngi kiba long ka jingisynei jong u , kito na ngi ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba un pynpaw ia ka spah jong ka burom jong u ha ki tiar jingisynei kiba u la pynkhreh lypa sha ka burom .

en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face , and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?
kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet ngi kyrpad ïa u da ka dohnud jong ngi baroh ban shah ïa ngi ban ïohi ïa phi markhmat bad ban pyndap ïa kaei kaba donkam ha ka jingngeit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduwai miet bad sngi palat ba ngin iohi ia ka khmat jong phi , bad ngi lah ban pynjanai ia kata kaba duna ha ka jingngeit jong phi ?

en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself , saying , After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure , my lord being old also ?
kha: Kumta ka Sarah ka rkhie sammut marwei , bad ka ong ,  Mynta ba nga la tymmen bad ngam donbor shuh , ngan dang lah mo ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha ? Nalor kata , u tnga jong nga ruh u la tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka Sarah ka la rkhie hapoh jong ka, ka da ong: Hadien ba nga la tymmen ngan sa sngewbha, ko kynrad jong nga ruh nga la tymmen ?

en: And it came to pass after this , that the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Nahash u syiem Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun , u khun jong u , u la long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka la jia ba u syiem ki khun Ammon u la iap bad u Hanun u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: I say again , Let no man think me a fool ; if otherwise , yet as a fool receive me , that I may boast myself a little .
kha: Nga ong pat : wat ai ba uno uno un ñiew ïa nga uba bieit . Hynrei lada phi pyrkhat kumta , la kumno kumno to pdiang ïa nga kum uba bieit , khnang ba ngan don ei ei ban sngewsarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong biang , Wat ai ba uno uno un pyrkhat ia nga uba bieit ; lada ym kumta, hynrei kum uba bieit un pdiang ia nga, ba ngan sngew sarong khyndiat ia lade .

en: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron , and spake , saying , Behold , we are thy bone and thy flesh .
kha: Nangta baroh ki jait Israel ki la leit sha u Dabid ha Hebron bad ki ong ha u ,  Ngi dei ki para doh para snam jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki jait Israel baroh ki la wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron bad ki la kren da kaba ong: Ha khmih ngi long ka shyieng bad ka doh jong me .

en: In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .
kha: Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh ,   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki la bam ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi kin ym ong shuh , Ki kpa ki la bam ia u sohjew uba thiang , bad ki bniat jong ki khun ki la buh ha ka tduh .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .
kha: Ban pyndonburom ïa U Blei ka long ban isih ïa kaba sniew ; nga isih ïa ka jingsarong bad ka jingsngewmeng , ïa ki lynti bymman bad ki ktien lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ban shun ia kaba sniew: ka jingsarong bad ka jingsngew sarong , bad ka lynti kaba sniew , bad ka shyntur kaba jem , nga shun .

en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the  Lord  , and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Ki briew kiba duk bad kiba rit kyrdan kin shem pat ïa ka jingsuk kaba U  Trai  , U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , un ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba jemnud ruh kin pynroi ia ka jingkmen jong ki ha U Trai , bad kiba duk napdeng ki briew kin sngewbha ha U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her .”
kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule “ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .”
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u don ka jingngeit ba ka tnga jong u kan im biang, hynrei ngi pule ba u  Abraham u la wan rung ban iam ia ka Sarah bad ban iam ia ka .

en: Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Ha ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kumjuh nga la ai ka jingmaham da ka jingsngewkhia ba ki dei ban phai sha U Blei na ki pop jong ki bad ban ngeit ha U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsakhi ia ki Jiw , bad ruh ia ki Grik , ka jingkylla kaba mut sha U Blei bad ka jingngeit ha U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: Peter said unto him , Though I should die with thee , yet will I not deny thee . Likewise also said all the disciples .
kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Da lei lei ngan ym ong ïa kata , wat lada nga dei ban ïap lem bad me !  Bad baroh kiwei pat ki synran ki la ïa-ong ïa kajuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la ong ha u, Wat la nga dei ban iap bad me, hynrei ngan ym kyntait ia me . Kumjuh ruh ki synran baroh ki la ong .

en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the  Lord  : moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah .
kha: U sngewsarong ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  bad pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mane blei thala bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dohnud jong u ka la kiew ha ki lynti U Trai: nalor kata u la weng noh ia ki jaka ba jrong bad ki lum na Judah .

en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it  ; let a cloud dwell upon it  ; let the blackness of the day terrify it .
kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka sngi jong ka jingdum tliw bad synñia ; kah ïa ka da ki lyoh , bad tap noh ïa ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka jingdum bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap kan rong noh ia ka ; ai ba u lyoh un shong halor jong ka ; ai ba ka jingdum jong ka sngi kan pyntieng ia ka .

en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards .
kha: haduh ba u patsha un da pynbeit pat ïa phi ha ka ri kaba kum ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai waiñ bad ha kaba don u kew ban shna jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba ngan da wan shim noh ia phi sha ka ri kaba kum ka ri jong phi hi, ka ri u kew bad ka wain , ka ri u kpu bad ki kper sohjew .

en: For even Christ pleased not himself ; but , as it is written , The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me .
kha: Naba U Khrist um shym la pynsngewbha ïa lade . Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa kiba la thew ha phi ki la hap halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat U Khrist ruh um shym la sngewbha ia lade; hynrei kumba la thoh: Ki jingkren bein jong kita kiba la kren bein ia me ki la hap ha nga .

en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in  ; and the cloud filled the inner court .
kha: Ki kherub ki ïeng shaphang shathie na ka Templ haba u rung hapoh , bad u lyoh u tap ïa ka phyllaw kaba shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki cherub ki la ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong ka iing , haba uta u briew u la rung ; bad u lyoh u la pyndap ia ka phyllaw kaba shapoh .

en: For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat sah lymda ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim ju thiah , lait noh tang ba ki la leh bakla ; bad la weng noh ia ka jingthiah jong ki , lymda ki pynlong ia ki ban hap .

en: And now come I to thee  ; and these things I speak in the world , that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves .
kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me , bad nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka pyrthei khnang ba kin lah ban ïoh ïa ka jingkmen jong nga ha ki dohnud jong ki ha ka jingdap pura baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga wan sha me bad ia kine kiei kiei kiba nga kren ha ka pyrthei , ba kin ioh ia ka jingkmen jong nga kaba la pyndep ha lade .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan pynlong ïa me kum U Blei ha u Pharaoh , bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un kren ha u kum u nongïathuhlypa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Peit, nga la pynlong ia me u blei ha u Pharaoh: bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un long u nongiathuhlypa jong me .

en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .
kha: Nangta ki briew jong U Blei kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong ki . To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki hok kin shai kum ka sngi ha ka hima U Kpa jong ki . Uba don ki shkor ban iohsngew , to ai ba un iohsngew .

en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !
kha: Balei , A Blei , me shah ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ban ïap ha shuwa ba uno uno un ïohi ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Balei te me la pynmih ia nga na ka kpoh ? Oh ba nga la aiti noh ia u ksuid bad ym don khmat ba iohi ia nga !

en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise , And God did rest the seventh day from all his works .
kha: Naba don ha Jingthoh Bakhuid la ong ïa kane shaphang ka sngi kaba hynñiew :  U Blei u la shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew na ka kam jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la kren ha kawei ka jaka kaba hynriew sngi ha kane ka sngi , Bad U Blei u la shongthait ia ka sngi kaba hynriew na ki kam jong u baroh .

en: As per the note , the Information and Broadcasting Ministry is amending the rules to allow MPs to head the committees .
kha: Katkum ka jingthoh , ka tnad pyntip ka dang pynkylla ia ki kyndon ban ailad ia ki MP ban khlieh ia ki komiti .
translated_en_to_kha: Katkum ka jingthoh , ka tnad pyntip bad pynphriang ka pynkylla ia ki kyndon ban ailad ia ki MP ban khlieh ia ki komiti .

en: For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many , )
kha: Wat lada don kiba la shu khot  ki blei  , la ha bneng ne ha pyrthei , bad wat lada don shibun kum kine  ki blei  bad  ki trai  ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la ki don kiba la khot blei, la ha bneng ne ha khyndew, (kumba don ki blei kiba bun, bad ki kynrad kiba bun, )

en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water : therefore leave off contention , before it be meddled with .
kha: Ka jingsdang ïa ka jingïakajia ka long kum ka jingbthei banyngkong jong ka den-um ; pynsangeh ïa ka ha shuwa ba kan ïaid sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsdang jong ka jingialeh ka long kumba u briew u pyllait ia ka um: namarkata iehnoh ia ka jingialeh pyrshah , shuwa ba kan shah pynthut .

en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :
kha: Kan sa long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpop yn pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaba shyrkhei la pynlong ia u bym don pop, bad u nonglehbein u la shah pynjot , bad baroh kiba peit ia ka jingbymhok ki shah ot noh:

en: And it came to pass , that , as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished , he departed to his own house .
kha: Haba ka por jingshakri jong u ha ka Templ ka la kut , u Sekharaïah u la leit phai sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba tang shu dep ki sngi jong ka jingshakri jong u , u la leit noh sha la iing .

en: This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .
kha: Kane ka jia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka um Meribah ; namar ki khun Israel ki la ia tyngkhuh bad U Trai , bad u la long uba la pynkyntang ha ki .

en: Thine heart shall meditate terror . Where is the scribe ? where is the receiver ? where is he that counted the towers ?
kha: Ki jingsheptieng jong phi kiba mynshuwa ïa ki nonglum khajna nongwei bad ki nongsyntiat kin shu long sa tang ka jingkynmaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong u kan pyrkhat ia ka jingtieng . Hangno u nongthoh ? hangno u nongpdiang ? hangno uta uba khein ia ki tower ?

en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )
kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha uta u briew ba la ïapshiliang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba phin tip ba u Khun u briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ia ki pop , (u ong ha kiba pang , )

en: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law , That the man which doeth those things shall live by them .
kha: U Moses u la thoh ïa kane , shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum :  Uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka Hukum un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Moses u batai ia ka hok kaba long na ka hukum , Ba uta u briew uba leh ia kita kiei kiei un im da ki .

en: And David said to Saul , Let no man s heart fail because of him  ; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Saul ,  Syiem Kynrad , mano mano ruh kim dei ban tieng ïa une u Philistia ! Ngan leit ban ïaleh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Saul , Wat ai ba u briew un ym duh noh namar jong u ; u shakri jong me un leit ialeh bad une u Philistia .

en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .
kha: Hynrei hynriewspah ngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon , bad ki sah hangta saw bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hynriew spah ngut ki briew ki la phai bad ki la phet noh sha ka ri khlaw sha u maw Rimmon , bad ki la shong ha u maw Rimmon saw bnai .

en: Moreover this they have done unto me : they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day , and have profaned my sabbaths .
kha: Bad kata kam dei kaba ki la leh baroh . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ki pynkheiñ ïa ka Sabbaton , kaba nga la pynskhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki la leh ia kane ha nga: ki la pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga ha kajuh ka sngi , bad ki la pynjah burom ia ki sngi saitjain jong nga .

en: According to the custom of the priest s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .
kha: Kat kum ka rukom ba la bud da ki lyngdoh , la jied ïa u da kaba kynting sbai ban thang jingiwbih halor ka duwan . Kumta u la leit shapoh ka Templ jong U Trai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka rukom treikam jong u lyngdoh , ka bhah jong u ka long ban thang jingiwbih haba u leit shapoh ka tempi U Trai .

en: At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
kha: Ym don ba kyrshan ïa nga haba nga ïasaid da ïa lade nyngkong eh ha khmat ki bor synshar ; baroh ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Nga duwai ba U Blei un ym thew pyrshah ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jubab kaba nyngkong jong nga ym don mano mano ruh kiba ieng bad nga: Nga duwai ia U Blei ba kan ym shah set ha ka jingsngew jong ki .

en: And the king took his ring from his hand , and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , the Jews  enemy .
kha: U syiem u law ïa la ka sati ba pyndonkam ha kaba shon muhor ban pynkupbor ïa ki jingpynbna , bad ai ïa ka ha u nongshun jong ka jaitbynriew Jiw , u Haman u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la shim ia ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti jong u bad u la ai ia ka ha u Haman u khun u Hamdaatha u Agagite , u nongshun jong ki Jiw .

en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .
kha: Hangta ha khmat jong ki paidbah , kim shym la lah ban kem daw ïa u ha kano kano , kumta ki la sngap jar , ki da lyngngoh ha ka jingjubab jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim lah ban bat ia ki ktien jong u ha khmat ki briew: bad ki la lyngngoh ia ka jubab jong u, bad ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki .

en: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull , which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha :
kha: U la mihnoh , u da bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad u la wan poi sha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka jaka Maloi Khlieh  , kumba la khot ïa ka . ( Ha ka ktien Hebru la khot  Golgotha  ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la rah ia ka diengphna jong u u la leit sha ka jaka kaba la khot ka jaka jong ka khlieh , kaba la khot ha ka Hebru Golgotha:

en: And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;
kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban ai ka burom kaba dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum kiba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit, ban tip ia kiba trei shitom hapdeng jong phi, bad ki long halor jong phi ha U Trai , bad ban pynrem ia phi;

en: And Nathan said , My lord , O king , hast thou said , Adonijah shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ?
kha: Nangta u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , Hato phi la dep pynbna ba u Adonijah un long syiem hadien jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathan u la ong, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, me la ong, u Adonijah un synshar hadien jong nga bad un shong ha ka khet jong nga ?

en: For all they did cast in of their abundance  ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .
kha: Naba kiwei ki la pynnoh ïa kaei kaba tam na ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la pynnoh ïa baroh kaba ka don — ka la ai ïa baroh kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh ki la bret noh ia ka jingbun jong ki ; hynrei ka na ka jingkwah jong ka ka la bret noh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don, wat ia ka jingim jong ka baroh kawei.

en: And Samuel said , What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears , and the lowing of the oxen which I hear ?
kha: U Samuel u kylli ,  Balei te , ba nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingpah ki masi bad ki langbrot ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong: Kaei kata ka jingsawa jong ki langbrot ha ki shkor jong nga bad ka jingsawa jong ki masi kiba nga iohsngew ?

en: For David said , The  Lord  God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :
kha: U Dabid u ong ,  U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ka jingsuk ha la ki briew , bad u hi un shong junom ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Dabid u la ong , U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la ai jingjahthait ia ki briew jong u, ba kin shong ha Jerusalem junom:

en: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs , and of the same body , and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel :
kha: Ka jingmaïan ka long kata kaba da ka lynti ka gospel , ki Jentil ki ïoh bynta lem bad ki Jiw ïa ki jingkyrkhu U Blei ; ki long ki dkhot jong kajuh ka met bad ki ïoh bynta ïa ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki Jutang kin long ki para pateng, bad jong kajuh ka met , bad ki nongiashim bynta ha ka jingkular jong u ha U Khrist da ka gospel:

en: And he said , Go , and tell this people , Hear ye indeed , but understand not  ; and see ye indeed , but perceive not .
kha: Kumta u ong ïa nga ban leit bad ai ha ki briew ïa kane ka khubor :  Kam pher haduh katno phi shahshkor , phin ym sngewthuh . Kam pher haduh katno phi khmih , phin ym tip kaei kaba jia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, To leit, bad to iathuh ia une u briew, To sngap shisha, hynrei wat sngewthuh ; bad peit shisha ia phi, hynrei wat sngewthuh .

en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .
kha: Baroh ki Israel kiba don hangta ki la phet ïap haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta ,  Phet , Ka khyndew ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel baroh kiba don sawdong jong ki ki la phet noh na ka jingpyrta jong ki: namar ki la ong: To ai ba ka khyndew kan rong noh ia ngi ruh .

en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another  ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .
kha: Bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long kawei ka jingkah , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki san tylli ki jingtap kin iasoh iwei ia iwei pat ; bad kiwei pat ki san tylli ki jingtap kin iasoh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .
kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong Kanaan uba u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la iohi hangta ia kawei ka khun kynthei jong uwei u nong Kanaan, kaba kyrteng u Shua ; bad u la shim ia ka bad u la leit shapoh jong ka .

en: Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :
kha: To bret noh ïa baroh ka jingkthang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingbitar . Keiñ noh ka jingkaw kaw , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ noh ki jingsngew isih la ha kano kano ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka jingsngewsih baroh bad ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar bad ka jingkyrhuh bad ka jingkren bein baroh kan jah noh na phi, da ka jingsniew baroh:

en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God : for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the  Lord .
kha: hynrei u Dabid um shym lah ban leit shata ban mane ïa U Blei , namar u la sheptieng ïa ka waitlam jong u angel jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Dabid um lah ban leit sha khmat jong ka ban kylli ia U Blei : namar u la tieng namar ka waitlam jong u angel U Trai .

en: And he went from year to year in circuit to Beth–el , and Gilgal , and Mizpah , and judged Israel in all those places .
kha: Man ka snem u ju leit sha Bethel , sha Gilgal , bad sha Mispah , bad ha kine ki jaka u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit na ka snem sha ka snem sha Bethel, bad u Gilgal bad u Mizpah bad u la bishar ia ki Israel ha kita ki jaka baroh .

en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
kha: Ka la long la jan shiteng sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew ,  Une u syiem jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long ka jingpynkhreh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait bad kumba hynriew kynta: bad u ong ha ki Jiw: Ha khmih U Syiem jong phi !

en: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit : for the Spirit searcheth all things , yea , the deep things of God .
kha: Hynrei , dei ha ngi ba U Blei u la pynpaw ïa kaba u la buhrieh , da U Mynsiem jong u . U Mynsiem u ïit ïa kiei kiei baroh , wat ïa ki jingjylliew ba la buhrieh jong ki jingthmu U Blei .
