translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynpaw ia ki ha ngi da U Mynsiem jong u: namar U Mynsiem u wad ia kiei kiei baroh, hooid, ia kiei kiei kiba jylliew jong U Blei .

en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
kha: Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynïeng hajan jong ka ïa uno uno u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat thung ia me hajan ka jingkhang U Trai U Blei jong me, kaba me pynlong ia me .

en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto one bullock , two tenth deals unto one ram ,
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ki kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang, lai tylli ki jingai sngewbha sha uwei u masi , ar tylli ki jingai sngewbha sha uwei u langbrot .

en: And he came to Ephesus , and left them there : but he himself entered into the synagogue , and reasoned with the Jews .
kha: Ki la poi ha Ephesos , ha kaba u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ka Priskila bad ïa u Akwila . U la leit sha ka synagog bad u la pynlong ka jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha Ephesos bad u la iehnoh ia ki hangta : hynrei ma u hi u la rung ha ka synagog bad u la iasaid bad ki Jiw .

en: The tabernacle , his tent , and his covering , his taches , and his boards , his bars , his pillars , and his sockets ,
kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ka jingsop jong ka bad ka jingsop kaba shabar jong ka , ïa ki bnoh bad ïa ki jingker jong ka ; ïa ki diengkhap , ki rishot , bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Tabernakl, ka ïingjaiñ jong u, bad ka jingtap jong u, bad ki tdong jong u, bad ki board jong u, ki bar jong u, ki maw jong u bad ki socket jong u .

en: For he saith to the snow , Be thou on the earth  ; likewise to the small rain , and to the great rain of his strength .
kha: U hukum ïa ka ïor ban hap halor ka khyndew , bad u phah ïa u slap uba theh kum u  lap praw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u ong ha u slap , To long ha ka khyndew; kumjuh ruh ha u slap uba rit bad ha u slap uba khraw jong ka bor jong u .

en: Their land also is full of idols  ; they worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made :
kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki bleithaw , bad ki mane ïa kita kiba ki la shna da ki kti jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri jong ki ruh ka dap da ki bleithaw ; ki mane ia ka kam jong ki kti jong ki hi , ia kaba ki kti jong ki hi ki la shna:

en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
kha: bad u la set ïa ki hapoh byndi ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki ha ka iing jong u rangbah shipai, ha ka phatok, ha ka jaka ba la teh ia u Joseph .

en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
kha: Baroh kin shun ïa phi na ka bynta jong nga . Hynrei uta uba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , un ïohlait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shah shun ha ki briew baroh na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga: hynrei uta uba iaishah haduh kaba kut , uta un shah pynim .

en: As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .
kha: Kito kiba dei jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta uba la wan na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba long ka khyndew, kum kita ruh kiba long khyndew: bad kumba long ki bneng , kum kita ruh kiba long bneng .

en: I have digged , and drunk water  ; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places .
kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih ïa ki pukri bad dih um ha ki ri nongwei , bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïuh ha ka wah Nile ba-rkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la tih , bad nga la dih ia ka um ; bad da ka kjat jong nga nga la tyrkhong ia ki wah baroh jong ki jaka ba la tyrkhong .

en: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son . And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison , and to bring it .
kha: Katba u Isaak u dang ïakren ha u Iso , ka Rebekka ka pynshahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebeka u la iohsngew haba u Isaak u la kren ia u Iso u khun jong u . U Iso u la leit sha lyngkha ban leit khwai ia ka bih bad ban wanrah ia ka .

en: And they brought unto him also infants , that he would touch them : but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khunlung jong ki sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki . Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa ki bad ki la kynhied ïa ki naba ki leh kumta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ha u ruh ia ki khunlung, ba un ktah ia ki: hynrei haba ki synran jong u ki la iohi ia kata , ki la pynrem ia ki .

en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the  Lord  on the altar of the  Lord  , which he had built before the porch ,
kha: U Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  ha ka duwan ba u la tei ha khmat ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai ha ka almari U Trai , kaba u la tei ha khmat ka phyllaw .

en: Abide thou with me , fear not : for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life : but with me thou shalt be in safeguard .
kha: To sah noh bad nga bad wat sheptieng . U Saul u kwah ban pynïap ïa phi bad ïa nga , hynrei phin lait na ka jingma bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To long bad nga, wat tieng: namar uta uba wad ia ka jingim jong nga u wad ia ka jingim jong me: hynrei bad nga me long ha ka jingsumar .

en: All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
kha: Baroh kaba U Kpa jong nga u don ka long ka jong nga ; na kata ka daw nga la ong ba U Mynsiem un shim ïa kaei kaba nga ai ha u bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba U Kpa u don ki long ki jong nga: namarkata nga la ong ba un shim na nga bad un pyni ia ka ha phi .

en: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree , behold , then an angel touched him , and said unto him , Arise and eat .
kha: U la thiah ha trai u dieng bad u la ïohthiah . Kynsan kynsan u angel u la ktah ïa u bad ong ,  Khie noh bad bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang thiah hapoh u dieng sohjew , ha khmih uwei u angel u la ktah ia u bad u la ong ha u: To khie bad bam .

en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh , which God had sworn to Abraham , the people grew and multiplied in Egypt ,
kha: Haba ka por ka la nang jan na ka bynta U Blei ban bat ïa ka kular kaba u la kular ha u Abraham , ka jingdon jong ki briew jong ngi ha Ijipt ka la roi bun shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka por jong ka jingkular ka la jan , kaba U Blei u la smai ha u Abraham , ki briew ki la nangroi bad nangroi ha Ijipt .

en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .
kha: U Jakob u sah ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la shong ha ka ri Ijipt shiphew snem: kumta ka rta jong u Jakob baroh kawei ka long shispah sawphew hynriew snem .

en: And God Almighty bless thee , and make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , that thou mayest be a multitude of people  ;
kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ka shongkha shongman jong me bad un ai ïa me bun ki khun ki kti , ba men ïoh long u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei Uba donbor baroh un kyrkhu ia me, bad un pynroi ia me, bad pynbun ia me, ba me long u paidbah;

en: And the multitude sat about him , and they said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee .
kha: U paidbah u dang ïashong sawdong U Jisu , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Khmih ka kmie jong me bad ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong me ki don habar , bad ki donkam ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah u la shong sawdong jong u bad ki la ong ha u: Ha khmih ka kmie jong me bad ki hynmen jong me khlem da wad ia me .

en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .
kha: Hynrei , kumba u Elisha u la lah ong , hamar kata ka por ha ka snem kaba bud ka la kha khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la pun khun bad ka la kha khun shynrang ha kata ka aiom ba u Elisha u la ong ha ka kat kum ka por jong ka jingim .

en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .
kha: Kito kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la lah jia ïa uta u briew uba don ksuid , bad ïa kita ki sniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iathuh ha ki kumno ka la jia ia uta uba la shah ktah ha u ksuid bad ruh shaphang u sniang .

en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .
kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar ki la ïohi ïa ka bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah ruh jong u Pharaoh ki la iohi ia ka, bad ki la iaroh ia ka ha khmat u Pharaoh: bad la ialam ia kata ka kynthei sha ka iing u Pharaoh .

en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .
kha: Man ka step haba u Aaron u wan ban pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u dei ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un thang ia ka jingiwbih kaba thiang man ka step: haba u la pynkhuid ia ki sharak , un thang ia ka jingiwbih halor jong ka .

en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth , the same shall he receive of the Lord , whether he be bond or free .
kha: To kynmaw ba U Trai un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei , la u mraw ne uba laitluid , namar ka kam babha ba u trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ba kano kano ka kam kaba bha kaba u briew u leh, kumjuh un ioh na U Trai , la u long uba la shah teh ne uba laitluid .

en: And when they came again to him , ( for he tarried at Jericho , ) he said unto them , Did I not say unto you , Go not ?
kha: Nangta ki la leit phai sha u Elisha , uba dang ap ïa ki ha Jerikho , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym leit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la wan phai biang sha u , (namar u la sah ha Jerikos ) u la ong ha ki: Hato ngam shym la ong ia phi: Wat leit ?

en: Ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth  ; but how is it that ye do not discern this time ?
kha: A kiba arsap ! Phi lah ban khmih ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ka suiñbneng bad ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng ; balei , te , phim tip ïa ka jingmut jong kane ka por ba mynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki nongleh arsap , phi lah ban ithuh ia ka khmat ka bneng bad ka khyndew ; hynrei kumno ba phim ithuh ia kane ka por ?

en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;
kha: Dei namar kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Gilead bad ka Bashan ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la hap shi bynta ha Manasseh, hajan ka ri Gilead bad ka ri Basan, kiba don sha shiliang ka Jordan;

en: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?
kha: ne ban kylli ïa U Blei ,  Da kumno ka pop jong nga ka ktah ïa me ? Nga ïohnong aïu na kaba khlem leh pop ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la ong , Kaei ka jingmyntoi ia me ? bad , Kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba ngan ioh lada nga shah pynkhuid na ka pop jong nga ?

en: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him , Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father s house ?
kha: Ka Rakhel bad ka Leah ki jubab ïa u Jakob ,  Ym don ei ei shuh kaba ngin ïoh bynta na la i pa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rakhel bad ka Leah ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u: Hato ka dang don ka bynta ne ka pateng na ka bynta jong ngi ha iing u kpa jong ngi ?

en: And he went in also unto Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him yet seven other years .
kha: U Jakob u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Rakhel ruh , bad u kham ieit ïa ka ban ïa ka Leah . Nangta u la trei na ka bynta u Laban sa hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit ruh sha ka Rakhel, bad u la ieit ruh ia ka Rakhel kham palat ia ka Leah, bad u la shakri bad u sa hynriew snem .

en: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .
kha: U kpa mar kumta hi u la pyrta ,  Nga don ka jingngeit , hynrei kam da biang . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don shuh shuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u kpa jong u khynnah u la pyrta, bad u la ong da ki ummat, ko Trai, nga ngeit; to iarap ia ka jingbymngeit jong nga .

en: And they said , Hath the  Lord  indeed spoken only by Moses ? hath he not spoken also by us ? And the  Lord  heard it .
kha: Ki ong ,  Hato U  Trai  u la kren tang lyngba u Moses ? Hato um shym la kren lyngba jong ngi ruh ?  U  Trai  u la ïohsngew aïu ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Hato U Trai u la kren shisha tang da u Moses ? hato um shym la kren ruh da ngi ? Bad U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka .

en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah , and with Abiathar the priest : and they following Adonijah helped him .
kha: U la ïakren bad u Joab ( uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Seruïah ) bad u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ki la ïamynjur ban kyrshan ïa ka jingthmu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai da u Joab u khun u Seruiah, bad da u Abiathar u lyngdoh : bad ki la bud ia u Adonijah ki la iarap ia u .

en: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom u Jakob u kylla long uba riewspah eh . U la don shibun ki kynhun jingri , ki mraw , ki ut , bad ki kada .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u la nang kiew palat, bad u don shibun ki masi bad ki nongtrei bad ki nongtrei bad ki kulai bad ki kada .

en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar ba nga thoh sha phi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ban pynkhih ïa ki jingpyrkhat bakhuid ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka epistle kaba ar, ko baieit, nga thoh mynta sha phi ; ha baroh ar kaba nga pynkhih ia ki jingmut ba khuid jong phi da ka jingkynmaw:

en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi , after their families , by the house of their fathers ,
kha: U Aaron u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : U Nadab uba heh duh , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ki khun shynrang jong u Kohath napdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi , kat kum ki longiing jong ki , da ka iing ki kpa jong ki .

en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee , saying , Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these ?
kha: Haba ki briew jong me kin kylli kaei kane ka jingmut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki khun jong me kin kren ha me da kaba ong: Hato phim pyni ia ngi ia kaei kaba me mut da kine ?

en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold on eternal life .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom kin kynshew ïa lade ka spah ka ban long ka nongrim kaba skhem na ka bynta ka lawei . Bad nangta kin lah ban jop ïa ka jingim kaba long ka jingim kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba buh ia lade ia ka nongrim kaba bha pyrshah ia ka por ban wan , ba kin bat ia ka jingim bymjukut .

en: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,
kha: U Moses u la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi , bad u la leit hajan ka  lawlynnong ban ïohi kham bha . Hynrei u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Trai :
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Moses u la iohi ia ka , u la lyngngoh ia ka jingpeit : bad katba u dang jan ban iohi ia ka , ka sur U Trai ka la wan ha u .

en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khot sngewbha ïa la u paramarjan ban wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain , ba la ker sawdong da ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai jong ki paid , phin khot ia u paramarjan jong u hapoh u sohjew bad hapoh u dieng sohjew .

en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the  Lord  : but such as are upright in their way are his delight .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba don jingmut sniew , hynrei u ieit ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba don ka dohnud kaba jem ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai: hynrei kiba long kiba beit ha ka lynti jong u ki long kiba jrong .

en: Whosoever denieth the Son , the same hath not the Father : ( but ) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also .
kha: Naba uno uno uba kyntait ïa U Khun u kyntait ruh ïa U Kpa ; uno uno uba pdiang ïa U Khun u don ïa U Kpa ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba kyntait ia u Khun , uta u don ia U Kpa: (hynrei ) uta uba pdiang ia U Khun ruh u don ia U Kpa ruh .

en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïaid lem bad ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba ki dang iakynduh bad ia pyrkhat lang, U Jisu hi u la wan hajan bad u la leit ryngkat bad ki .

en: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon ,  Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
kha: Haba u la dep kren , u la ong ha u Simon ,  To ñiat ïa ka lieng kham jngai sha ka um bajylliew , bad ma me lem bad ki paralok jong me to pynhap ïa ki jar ban tong dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u la leit noh da kaba kren, u la ong ha u Simon, Pynkhih shapoh ka jingjylliew, bad pynhap ia ki jar jong phi na ka bynta ka um .

en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .
kha: A katno pha long kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan urlong shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la kyrkhu ia kata kaba ngeit: namar kan don ka jingleh jong kita kiei kiei kiba la iathuh ia ka na U Trai .

en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks , they cast four anchors out of the stern , and wished for the day .
kha: Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ka lieng kan leit sha ki mawsiang , kumta ki la pynhiar saw tylli ki angkor na shadien jong ka lieng bad ki la duwai ïa ka jingshai ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta da kaba tieng ioh ba ngin hap halor ki maw , ki la bret saw tylli ki nar na ka tduh , bad ki la kwah ia ka sngi .

en: They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .
kha: Kin pynïap ïa me bad kin phah ïa me sha ka jingtep bashong um .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin pynhiar ia me shapoh ka thliew , bad me dei ban pyniap ia ki kiba la shah pyniap hapdeng ki duriaw .

en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David : and Abijah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Rehoboam u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u khun jong u , u Abijah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Abiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?
kha: Ki la phai ktien ,  Ka kambah aïu men leh ba ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka bad ngeit ha me ? Kaei ba men leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong namarkata ha u, Kaei ka dak kaba me pyni ha kata ka por, ba ngin iohi bad ngeit ia me ? kaei kaba me trei ?

en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar , kñia khat-ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar phin aiti shiphew tylli ki masi rit, ar tylli ki langbrot , shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem da don jaka:

en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return , and will build them , as at the first .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Judah bad Israel kiba roi kyrhai , bad ngan pynlong pat ïa ki kumba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ka jingshah set jong u Judah bad ka jingshah set jong ki Israel ban wan phai biang , bad ngan tei ia ki kumba ha kaba nyngkong .

en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .
kha: Hynrei ka kynthei kan ïohlait im ha ka por ba ka kha khun , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit bad ka jingkhuid , lem bad ka jingdon akor .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka long kaba la pynim ha kaba kha khun , lada ki iai bteng ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingai sngewbha bad ka jingkhuid ryngkat bad ka jinglong ba im .

en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment : and as many as touched were made perfectly whole .
kha: Ki la kyrpad ïa u ba un shah ïa kito kiba pang la kumno kumno ban ïohktah ïa ka tduh jong ka jaiñkup jong u ; bad ïa baroh kito kiba la ktah ïa ka la pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyrpad ia u ba kin ktah tang ia ka tduh jong ka jain jong u: bad katba lah ban ktah la pynlong pura .

en: Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :
kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor bashyrkhei ; ki jingthok ba-bymman ki mih na ki thylliej jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba ma , kum ka bih bseiñ , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong ki ka long ka jingtep kaba plie ; bad ki shyntur jong ki ki la pyndonkam da ka jingleh thok ; ka bih jong ki asp ka don hapoh ki rmiang shyntur jong ki:

en: And when she saw him , she was troubled at his saying , and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be .
kha: La pynkhuslai eh ïa ka Mari da ka khubor jong u angel , bad ka la lyngngoh aïu ki kyntien jong u ki kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la iohi ia u, ka la sngewsih ia ka jingkren jong u, bad ka la bret ha ka jingmut jong ka kaei ka rukom ai khublei kaba kane ka dei ban long .

en: And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kylla , bad ki Benjamin ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la phai biang, ki briew jong ka ri Benjamin ki la lyngngoh: namar ki la iohi ba ka jingsniew ka la wan ha ki .

en: And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .
kha: Phin sa shah ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom kum ki riewpaidbah ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban siew na ka bynta ka jingsniew ba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don, kum ki briew, kum u lyngdoh: bad ngan pynshitom ia ki na ka bynta ki lynti jong ki, bad ngan siew kylliang ia ki ia ki kam jong ki .

en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him , Master , behold , the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away .
kha: U Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la lah jia bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Khmih , ko Nonghikai , u dieng Dumbur uba me la tim u la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la pyrta ia u, Ko Nonghikai, ha khmih u dieng sohjew uba me la tim u la tyrkhong noh .

en: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :
kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit noh sha shiliang jong ka them bad u ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum uba kham ha pajih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la leit sha kawei pat ka liang, bad u la ieng ha jrong jong u lum uba jngai najan ka jaka kaba heh kaba don hapdeng jong ki:

en: And Samson said concerning them , Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines , though I do them a displeasure .
kha: U Samson u ong ,  Mynta ka kynti , ngan ym kitkhlieh ïa kaei ba ngan sa leh ïa ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong shaphang jong ki , Mynta ngan kham khlem jingbakla ban ia ki Philistia , wat la nga leh ia ki ka jingbym sngewtynnad .

en: And they came near unto him , and said , We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle , and cities for our little ones :
kha: Ki la wan hajan u Moses bad ki ong ,  Nyngkong eh , shah ngin shna ki jingker maw hangne ïa ki langbrot jong ngi bad tei ïa ki shnong kiba la ker da ki kut baskhem na ka bynta kiba shaniah ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan hajan jong u bad ki la ong: Ngin sa tei ia ki kynhun langbrot hangne na ka bynta ki masi jong ngi bad ki nongbah na ka bynta ki khun rit jong ngi:

en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka jinglyng-a ïa ka jingïarap , namar ba U  Trai  u la wallam ïa ka jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u nongshong shnong u Maroth u la ap bha: hynrei ka jingsniew ka la wan hiar na U Trai sha ka khyrdop Jerusalem .

en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness ; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God .
kha: Naba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna ka long ka jingibieit ha kito kiba jot noh ; hynrei ïa ngi kiba la pynim , ka long ka bor U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingialap ia ka diengphna ka long ha kito kiba jah rngai; hynrei ha ngi kiba la pynim ka long ka bor U Blei .

en: And because he was of the same craft , he abode with them , and wrought : for by their occupation they were tentmakers .
kha: U Paul u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki , namar ba u la kamai da kaba shna ïingjaiñ , kumba long ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba u long na kajuh ka kam, u shong bad ki, bad u la trei: namar da ka kam jong ki ki long ki nongshna ïingjaiñ .

en: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe , according to the working of his mighty power ,
kha: bad katno ka jingkhraw eh long kata ka bor kaba trei ha ngi kiba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jingkhraw palat jong ka bor jong u ha ngi kiba ngeit , kat kum ka jingtrei jong ka bor ba khraw jong u .

en: And it came to pass , as he sat at the table with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .
kha: U la shong bam bad ki , u la shim ïa u kpu , bad u la duwai ; nangta u la kdiah ïa u kpu bad u la ai ïa u ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jia katba u dang shong ha ka miej bad ki, u la shim ia u kpu bad u la kyrkhu ia u bad u la bthei bad u la ai ha ki .

en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynkoit khyndiat ia ka jingsngewsih jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga, ki da ong: Ka jingsuk, ka jingsuk ; haba ym don jingsuk .

en: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia , and answereth to Jerusalem which now is , and is in bondage with her children .
kha: Ka Hagar , kaba ïeng na ka bynta u lum Sinai ha Arabia , ka long ka dur jong ka nongbah Jerusalem kaba mynta , ka shong mraw ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka Agar ka long ka lum Sinai ha Arabia, bad ka jubab ia ka Jerusalem kaba long mynta, bad ka don ha ka jinglong mraw bad ki khun jong ka .

en: And Jonathan said unto David , Come , and let us go out into the field . And they went out both of them into the field .
kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ki bri ,  u Jonathan u jubab . Kumta ki ïaleit lang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la ong ha u Dabid, To wan, bad to ngin leit sha lyngkha . Ki la leit noh baroh arngut sha lyngkha .

en: And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .
kha: Wat ïabeh ïa ki blei thala ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pynim ïa phi namar kim dei kiba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat phai noh: namar te phi dei ban leit bud ia kiei kiei kiba lehnohei, ki bym lah ban ioh jingmyntoi ne pynpoi ; namar ki long kiba lehnohei .

en: Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?
kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u briew uba thaw ïa ki khiew u don ka hok ban pyndonkam ïa ka dewbyrtha katba u kwah , bad ban thaw ar tylli ki khiew na kawei ka lyngngun dewbyrtha , ïa uwei na ka bynta ki por bakyrpang bad ïa uwei pat na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka bor jong ka khiew halor ka dewbilat , jong kajuh ka lum ban pynlong ia kawei ka lieng sha ka burom bad kawei pat sha ka jingbym burom ?

en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Bad kumta , kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym burom ïa pha , hynrei phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka pateng jong me ha lade ha khmat ki nongwei , bad men tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and Aaron , This is the ordinance of the passover : There shall no stranger eat thereof :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait : U nongwei um bit ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ïadei bad ka Niam Ka Jinglait ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron: Kane ka long ka jingpynbeit ia ka jingkhawai: Ym don nongwei ban bam ia ka:

en: But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :
kha: hynrei kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung ka dei ka ri lum bad ri them , kaba ïoh um na u slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka ri kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka ka long ka ri jong ki lum bad ki them bad ka dih ia ka um slap bneng:

en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
kha: Ki briew jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan shabar ïa ki kulai na Musri bad Kilikia , bad ïa ka jingshalan shabar ïa ki kali ïapom na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la wanrah ia ki kulai na Ijipt, bad ki nongkhaii linen: ki nongkhaii linen ki la ioh ia ka linen linen ha ka dor .

en: And God stirred him up another adversary , Rezon the son of Eliadah , which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah :
kha: U Blei u pynjia ruh ïa u Reson u khun jong u Eliada ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon . U Reson , u la phet ïap na la u kynrad , u Hadadeser u syiem ka Sobah , bad u la long u nongïalam ïa kawei ka kynhun ki riewrunar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la pynkhih ia u da uwei pat u nongshun, u Rezon u khun jong u Eliadah uba la phet noh na u syiem jong u Hadadezer u syiem jong u Sobah:

en: Build you cities for your little ones , and folds for your sheep  ; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth .
kha: Kumta tei ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ki jingker ïa ki langbrot jong phi , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaba phi la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia ki nongbah na ka bynta ki khun rit jong phi , bad ki jingpynkylla ia ki langbrot jong phi ; bad leh ia kata kaba la mih na ka shyntur jong phi .

en: And when Joshua had let the people go , the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .
kha: U Joshua u la phah ïa ki paid Israel ha la ka lynti , bad uwei pa uwei u briew u la leit ban shim kynti ïa la ka bhah jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Joshua u la pyllait noh ia ki briew , ki khun Israel ki la leit noh uwei pa uwei sha ka pateng jong u ban ioh ia ka ri .

en: And Moses said , Eat that to day  ; for to day is a sabbath unto the  Lord  : to day ye shall not find it in the field .
kha: U Moses u la ong ,  Bam ïa ka mynta ka sngi , naba mynta ka dei ka Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , bad phin ym shem jingbam ei ei shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Bam ia kata ha ka sngi ; namar ha ka sngi ka long ka sngi Sabha ha U Trai: ha ka sngi phin ym shem ia ka ha lyngkha .

en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them .
kha: Haba la poi ka sngi ha kaba ki jingthaw ha bneng ki wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  , u Soitan u la don lang hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la don ka sngi ha kaba ki khun U Blei ki la wan ban pyni ia lade ha khmat U Trai , bad u Soitan ruh u la wan hapdeng jong ki .

en: And Obed–edom with their brethren , threescore and eight  ; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters :
kha: U Obed Edom u khun jong u Jeduthun bad ki hynriewphew phra ngut ki rangbah jong ka kur jong u kin ïarap ïa ki . Ïa u Hosah bad u Obed Edom la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Obededom bad ki hynmen jong ki, laiphew snem bad u Obededom ruh u khun u Jeduthun bad u Hosah ban long ki nongrah:

en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .
kha: Ym don mano mano ruh uba la ïohi ïa U Blei . U Khun ba marwei jong u , uba long kumjuh kum U Blei bad uba don ha syndah jong U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ba iohi ia U Blei ha kano kano ka por; ia u Khun ba la kha marwei uba don ha ka kpoh U Kpa .

en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things : for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you :
kha: Wat pynbyrsieh ïa lade da kano kano na kine ki kam , namar dei da kine ba ki briew ki bymngeit Blei ki la pyntngit ïa lade , kito ki jaitbynriew kiba im ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi bad ïa kiba ngan beh noh , ba phin ïoh leit rung hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynjakhlia ia lade ha kano kano na kine kiei kiei: namar ha kine baroh ki jaitbynriew ki la shah pynjakhlia ia kiba nga bret noh ha khmat jong phi:

en: As many were astonished at thee  ; his visage was so marred more than any man , and his form more than the sons of men :
kha: Bun ki briew kin kyndit haba kin ïohi ïa u ; la pynsniew briew ïa u haduh ba um i shuh kum u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba bun ki la lyngngoh ia me ; ka dur jong u ka la kham sniew ban ia uno uno u briew , bad ka dur jong u kham bun ban ia ki khun shynrang:

en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .
kha: Naba , lada um tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka met jong U Trai haba u bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri , u wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha lade hi katba u dang bam bad dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uta uba bam bad dih khlem akor, u bam bad dih ia ka jingtim ia lade, khlem da sngewthuh ia ka met U Trai .

en: In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da kaba phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw . U la shim ïa ki da ka lyer bashyrkhei na shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingthew, haba ka mih shabar, men iasaid bad ka: u sah ia ka Iyer kaba rben jong u ha ka sngi jong ka Iyer mihngi .

en: And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Lada kumta , phin hap pynbiang ïa ngi da ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , Me dei ruh ban ai ia ngi ia ki jingknia bad ki jingknia thang ding , ba ngin knia ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: Also he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , whereof the  Lord  had said , In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever .
kha: U tei ki duwan ki blei thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba yn mane ïa u junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la tei ia ki nonglehkai ha ka iing U Trai , na kiba U Trai u la ong , Ha Jerusalem ka kyrteng jong nga kan long junom .

en: But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .
kha: hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u . Namar kata U  Trai  u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la leh pyrshah bad ki la pynsngewsih ia U Mynsiem bakhuid jong u: namarkata u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki , bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki .

en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .
kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga da ki kyntien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u briew u wan hajan jong nga da ka shyntur jong ki, bad u burom ia nga da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki hynrei ka dohnud jong ki ka jngai na nga .

en: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
kha: Ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ha kaba dum phi dei ban ïathuh ha kaba shai , bad ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohsngew ha kaba rieh phi dei ban pynbna na ki tnum ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba nga ong ha phi ha ka jingdum , kaba phi kren ha ka jingshai: bad kaei kaba phi iohsngew ha ka shkor , kaba phi ialap halor ki jingkhang iing .

en: And Abraham answered and said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord , which am but dust and ashes :
kha: U Abraham u kren biang ,  To map , ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Nga long tang u briew bad ngam don hok ban ong ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la jubab bad u la ong: Ha khmih mynta nga la shim ia nga ban kren ha U Trai kaba long tang ka dewmet bad ka dewbilat:

en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el :
kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud u phai shaphang ka Hannathon , bad u kut ha ka Them Iphtahel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam u ker sawdong ia ka shaphang shathie sha Hanathon: bad ki jingleit jong ka ki long ha ka them Iphtahel:

en: Only fear the  Lord  , and serve him in truth with all your heart : for consider how great things he hath done for you .
kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad shakri hok ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tangba to sheptieng ia U Trai , bad to shakri ia u ha ka jingshisha da ka dohnud jong phi baroh: namar to pyrkhat katno kiei kiei kiba khraw u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .

en: And these three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
kha: Te u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , kiba dang shah khum , ki la hap sha ka pdeng jong ka ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lai ngut ki briew, u Shadrak, u Meshach bad u Abednego ki la hap hap hapdeng ka ding kaba thang .

en: As for Ephraim , their glory shall fly away like a bird , from the birth , and from the womb , and from the conception .
kha: Ka jingkhraw ki Israel kan her noh kum ka sim , bad yn ym don shuh ki khun ban kha na ki , yn ym don shuh ki kynthei ki ban armet , yn ym don jingpunkhun shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka Ephraim , ka burom jong ki kan her noh kum ka sim , naduh ba kha bad naduh ba kha .

en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .
kha: To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehkmen shongkurim kan kut , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ka Rakhel , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga sa hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndap ia ka taiew jong ka , bad ngin ai ia me ia kane ruh na ka bynta ka jingshakri kaba me shakri bad nga sa hynriew snem .

en: And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .
kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha jan jong nga ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade , lym kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki lyngdoh ruh kiba wan hajan U Trai kin pynkyntang ia lade , ioh ba U Trai un bthei halor jong ki .

en: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides  ; and they four had their faces and their wings .
kha: Nalor ki saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang jong ki , uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki kti briew , hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki kti jong u briew hapoh ki bniat jong ki ha ki saw liang jong ki ; bad ki saw ngut ki don ki khmat bad ki bniat jong ki .

en: Fondly called RNG , he was a matchless media personality who influenced the country both before and after Independence .
kha: La khot ia u u RNG , u dei u nongthoh khubor uba khlem da lah ban ianujor bad uba la ktah ia ka ri shwa bad hadien ka jinglaitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: La khot ia u RNG , u la long u briew uba khlem jingiadei uba la ktah ia ka ri shwa bad hadien ka jinglaitluid .

en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .
kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la lum ïa ka dorbar bad ki la ong ,  Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki kambah baroh kiba une u briew u la leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la lum lang ia ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi bad u la ong: Ngi aiu ? namar une u briew u leh bun ki kambah .

en: And Joseph said unto them , What deed is this that ye have done ? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine ?
kha: Ki la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , bad u Joseph u ong ,  Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? Phim tip ba u briew uba ha ka kyrdan jong nga u lah ban lap ïa phi da ka kheiñ ka bishar ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki, Kaei kane ka kam kaba phi la leh ? hato phim lah ban iathuh lypa ia uta u briew uba kum ma nga ?

en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .
kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Me ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga , bad mynta ba me la shah ïa nga ban long syiem hadien jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ong ha U Blei , Me la pyni ia ka jingisynei kaba khraw ia u kpa jong nga u Dabid bad me la pynlong ia nga ban synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .
kha: Namar ba u pynduh noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki duwan jingiwbih na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la weng noh na ki shnong Judah baroh ki jaka ba jrong bad ki dur: bad ka hima ka la sngap jar ha khmat jong u .

en: The young lions roared upon him , and yelled , and they made his land waste : his cities are burned without inhabitant .
kha: Ki la kyrhuh ha u kum u sing , ki la pynkylla ri shyiap ïa ka ri jong u , bad ki shnong jong u ki don ha ka jingjot jingpra , kiba la shah iehnoh khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sing samla ki la iaid halor jong u, bad ki la pyrta, bad ki la pynlong ia ka ri jong u: ki nongbah jong u ki shah thang khlem nongshong shnong .

en: Let them alone : they be blind leaders of the blind . And if the blind lead the blind , both shall fall into the ditch .
kha: Wat khuslai shaphang jong ki ! Ki long ki nongïalam bamatlah jong kiba matlah ; bad haba uwei u briew uba matlah u ïalam ïa uwei pat , baroh ar ngut ki hap sha ka kharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin long marwei: ki long ki nongialam kiba matlah jong kiba matlah . Bad lada kiba matlah ki ialam ia kiba matlah , baroh arngut kin hap ha ka thliew .

en: And they brought young children to him , that he should touch them : and his disciples rebuked those that brought them .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah ha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa kita ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ki khynnah rit sha u , ba un ktah ia ki: bad ki synran jong u ki la kynthoh ia kito kiba wanrah ia ki .

en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .
kha: U Mikaïah u la ong ïa ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule ha ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Mihaiah u la pynbna ha ki ia ki ktien baroh kiba u la iohsngew , haba u Baruk u la pule ia ka kot ha ki shkor jong ki briew .

en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him : whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David .
kha: Mar kumta , u Saul u rah ïa la u sum sha u Jonathan ban pynïap ïa u , bad u Jonathan u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u la da kut jingmut shisha ban pynïap ïa u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la bret ia u khnam ha u ban shoh ia u: ha kaba u Jonathan u la tip ba ka la kut jingmut na u kpa jong u ban pyniap ia u Dabid .

en: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God , which is in thee by the putting on of my hands .
kha: Na kane ka daw nga pynkynmaw ïa me ban ïai pynrhem ïa kata ka jingai kaba U Blei u la ai ha me mynba la buh ïa ki kti jong nga ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga buh ia me ha ka jingkynmaw ba me pynkhih ia ka jingai U Blei kaba don ha me da kaba buh ia ki kti jong nga .

en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , wherein Solomon had built the house of the  Lord  , and his own house ,
kha: Ka la shim por arphew snem ïa u Solomon ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kaba kut jong ki arphew snem ha kaba u Solomon u la tei ia ka iing U Trai bad ia la ka jong ka iing .

en: For our light affliction , which is but for a moment , worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory ;
kha: Bad kane ka jingshahshitom kaba khyndiat bad kaba tang shipor kaba ngi shah kan wallam ha ngi ïa ka burom bakhraw bad ba bymjukut , kaba kham khraw palat ban ïa kata ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingshah pynshitom kaba jem jong ngi, kaba long tang shiphang , ka trei na ka bynta jong ngi ka jingkhia kaba kham palat bad kaba bymjukut jong ka burom ; .

en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face , he is forehead bald : yet is he clean .
kha: Lada u briew u hap shñiuh na shadien ne na sha khmat ka khlieh jong u , kata kam pynlong ïa u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la hap noh na ka bynta jong u khlieh jong u sha ka khmat jong u, u long uba jem khlieh: hynrei u long uba khuid .

en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood  ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .
kha: Shna kawei ka lieng na ka bynta ïa lade da u jait dieng uba bha ; shna ki kamra ha ka bad tah ruh ïa ka da ka bsiang na shapoh bad shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia me ka synduk dieng kaba kham heh bad me dei ban shna ha ka synduk , bad me dei ban pynkhih ia ka hapoh bad shabar da ka madan .

en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .
kha: Wat lada phi shoh ïa u bieit haduh ba u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la me dei ban pynmih ia u briew uba bieit hapdeng u kew uba don ka sniehdoh , hynrei ka jingbieit jong u kan ym mih noh na u .

en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin , and of Abner s men , so that three hundred and threescore men died .
kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynïap laispah hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah jong u Abner kiba na ka jait Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shakri u Dabid ki la shah pyniap ha u Benjamin bad na u Abner ki briew kiba la iap .

en: And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ïai pynpaw ïa lade ha Shiloh , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u la kren ruh ha u . Bad haba u Samuel u kren , ki Israel baroh ki shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw biang ha Shiloh: namar U Trai u la pynpaw ia lade ha u Samuel ha Shiloh da ka ktien U Trai .

en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof : and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .
kha: Kaba kut jong kaei kaei ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsdang jong ka . Ka jingïaishah ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba kham bha ka long ka jingkut jong kaei kaei ban ia kaba sdang jong ka: bad u nongpang ha ka mynsiem u kham bha ban ia uba sngew sarong ha ka mynsiem .

en: So built we the wall  ; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof : for the people had a mind to work .
kha: Kumta ngi ïai tei ïa ka kynroh , bad shen ka la ïeng mar shiteng ka jingjrong , namar ki briew ki shitrhem ha ka jingtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi la tei ia ka kynroh ; bad ka kynroh baroh kawei ka la iasoh lang haduh shiteng na ka: namar ki briew ki don ka jingmut ban trei .

en: Because the ground is chapt , for there was no rain in the earth , the plowmen were ashamed , they covered their heads .
kha: Namar bym don slap bad ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong ki nongrep ki pang ka dohnud ; ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong , namar ym shym la don slap ha ka khyndew , ki nongrep ki la sngewlehrain , ki la tap ia la ka khlieh .

en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .
kha: kaba u la rah sha ka ri jingkhaïi bad u la buh ha ka nongbah ki nongkhaïi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ot ia ka tduh jong ki tnat kiba dang rit jong u, bad u la rah ia ka sha ka ri jong ka jingkhaii ; u la buh ia ka ha ka nongbah jong ki nongkhaii .

en: And , behold , a certain lawyer stood up , and tempted him , saying , Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
kha: U nonghikai ka Hukum u la wan bad u la pyrshang ban riam ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei u nongiasaid ain u la ieng bad u la pynshoi ia u, u da ong: Ko Nonghikai, ngan leh aiu ban hiar pateng ia ka jingim bymjukut ?

en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a trespass offering .
kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang ïa kata ka khleiñ baroh halor kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Ka dei ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un thang ia ki ha ka almari na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai: ka long ka jingainguh kaba palat .

en: But into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you not , go your ways out into the streets of the same , and say ,
kha: Hynrei ha man ba phi leit shapoh ka shnong bad ba ym shym la pdiang ïa phi , khie leit sha ki lynti bah bad ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kano kano ka shnong kaba phi rung bad kim pdiang ia phi , leit sha ki lynti jong phi sha ki lynti jong ki hi , bad ong , .

en: Is it in the early morning before starting your day’s work or later in the evening after the children have gone to bed ?
kha: Hato , ha ka por mynstep ne ynda la miet haba la thiah ki khun ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka dei ha ka por mynstep shwa ban sdang ia ka kam jong phi lane hadien ha ka por janmiet hadien ba ki khynnah ki la leit thiah ?

en: To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :
kha: Bad ynda u la kut jingmut ban pynpaw ïa la U Khun ha nga , khnang ba nga lah ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha shaphang jong u ha ki Jentil , ngam shym la leit wad buit nano nano ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynpaw ia U Khun jong u ha nga , ba ngan ialap ia u hapdeng ki nongwei mardor ngam shym la ai da ka doh bad ka snam:

en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?
kha: Ko Israel me la wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , katba nga dang ïalam ïa me ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la pynlong ia kane ha lade , ha kaba me la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong me haba u la ialam ia me ha ka lynti ?

en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynkyntang ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, bad pynkyntang ia ki, ba kin shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .
kha: Mynta , haba baroh kiba la ïap , kin sa mihpat ha kata ka sngi ka jingmihpat , ka tnga jongno kan long ? Baroh kita ki hynñiew ngut ki la lah shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingmihpat namarkata, haba kin sa mihpat, ka tnga jongno kan long na ki ? namar ki hynriew ngut ki la don ia ka bad ka tnga .

en: And when Saul s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron , his hands were feeble , and all the Israelites were troubled .
kha: Haba u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul u ïohsngew ba u Abner u la shah pynïap ha Hebron , u la sheptieng , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki la sngewsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u Saul u la iohsngew ba u Abner u la iap ha Hebron , ki kti jong u ki la tlot bad ki Israel baroh ki la jynjar .

en: The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
kha: U shakri u la dem khrup ha ki khohsiew ha khmat u Syiem . ‘ To ïaishah bad nga ,’ u la kyrpad , ‘ bad ngan siew ïa phi ïa kaei kaei baroh !’
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri namarkata u la dem khrup bad u la mane ia u, u da ong: Ko Trai, to iaishah bad nga, bad ngan siew lut ia me .

en: Preach the word ; be instant in season , out of season ; reprove , rebuke , exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine .
kha: ïalap ïa ka khubor , ban ïai kyntu ha kaba pynbna ïa ka (haba dei por ne ha bym dei por) , ban pynkynduh , ban pynbeit bad ban pynshlur , da ka jingïaishah baroh haba me hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhlain ia ka ktien ; to long kiba kloi ha ka aiom, na ka aiom ; pynrem, pynrem, pynshlur da ka jingsngewsih bad jinghikai baroh .

en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul  ;
kha: Ki pynlong ka jutang ha kaba ki mynjur ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rung ha ka jutang ban wad ia U Trai Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki da ka dohnud jong ki baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong ki baroh;

en: And he shall take the two goats , and present them before the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Nangta un shim ar tylli ki blang sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ki ar tylli ki blang bad un pyni ia ki ha khmat U Trai ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .
kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka la kynton shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Tyrre ka la tei ia lade ka jaka kaba skhem, bad ka la lum ia ka rupa kum ka dewbilat bad ka ksiar kaba bha kum ka dewbilat jong ki surok .

en: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all  ;
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , u la leit noh na kata ka jaka , bad bun ki briew ki la bud ïa u . U la pynkhiah ïa kito baroh kiba pang
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba U Jisu u la tip ia kata, u la kynriah noh ia lade naduh kata ka por: bad ki paidbah kiba bun ki la bud ia u, bad u la pynkoit ia ki baroh;

en: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people , she came to the people into the temple of the  Lord .
kha: Ka syiem Athalaïah ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba mih na ki nongap phira bad u paidbah , kumta ka pynstet ban leit sha ka Templ , ha kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka Athaliah ka la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong u nongap bad ki briew , ka la wan sha ki briew shapoh ka tempi U Trai .

en: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah , saying , There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïalumlang ha Mispah , ki la ai ka kular bakyntang sha U  Trai  :  Yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban shah ïa u Benjamin ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki shynrang Israel ki la smai ha Mizpah, ki da ong: Ym don uwei ruh na ngi uba ai ia ka khun jong u ha u Benjamin ha ka tnga .

en: And when they had nothing to pay , he frankly forgave them both . Tell me therefore , which of them will love him most ?
kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban siew pat sha u , kumta u la pyndam noh ïa ki ram jong ki baroh ar ngut . Uno na kine , te , u ban ieit kham bun ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kim don ei ei ban siew , u la map beit ia ki baroh arngut . Iathuh ia nga namarkata , mano na ki ban ieit ia u kham bun ?

en: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
kha: Ha khmih ! U ïakren ha u paidbah , bad kim ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba kim ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dei U Messaïah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei, ha khmih, u kren shlur, bad kim ong ei ei ia u . Hato ki nongsynshar ki tip shisha ba une u long U Khrist hi ?

en: For the creature was made subject to vanity , not willingly , but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope ,
kha: Naba ïa ki jingthaw la pynrem ban duh noh ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , ym na ka mon la jong hi , hynrei namar ka mon U Blei uba la mon ïa kata . Pynban ka la don ka jingkyrmen
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingthaw la pynlong hapoh ka jinglong ba la pynlong da ka mon sngewbha , hynrei namar uta uba la pynlong ia kajuh ha ka jingkyrmen .

en: For I am the least of the apostles , that am not meet to be called an apostle , because I persecuted the church of God .
kha: Naba nga long uba rit tam na baroh ki Apostol — ngam long wat uba bit ban khot u Apostol , namar nga la pynshitom beiñ ïa ka balang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga long uba rit tam na ki apostol , uba ym iakynduh ban shah khot u apostol , namar nga la pynshitom bein ia ka balang U Blei .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring a sword upon thee , and cut off man and beast out of thee .
kha: Mynta te , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa phi ba ngan pynïoh ïa ki shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi da ki waitlam , bad kin pynïap ïa ki briew bad ki jingri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka waitlam halor jong me , bad ngan ot noh ia u briew bad u mrad na me .

en: I said in the cutting off of my days , I shall go to the gates of the grave : I am deprived of the residue of my years .
kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ha ka jingdap pura ka jingim , nga la leit sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ban ym lah ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong ha kaba ot ia ki sngi jong nga: Nga la shah pynduh noh ia ka jingsah jong ki snem jong nga .

en: And when they heard these sayings , they were full of wrath , and cried out , saying , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien , ki la bitar shla bad ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iohsngew ia kine ki jingkren, ki la dap da ka jingbitar bad ki la pyrta, ki da ong: Ka long kaba khraw ia ka Diana jong ki nong Ephesos .

en: Even as I please all men in all things , not seeking mine own profit , but the profit of many , that they may be saved .
kha: To leh kumba leh ma nga ; nga pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa baroh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga leh , khlem da pyrkhat ïa ka jingbha jong nga hi , hynrei ïa ka jingbha jong kiba bun , khnang ba yn pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga pynsngewbha ia ki briew baroh ha kiei kiei baroh, ym da kaba wad ia ka jingmyntoi jong nga hi, hynrei ia ka jingmyntoi jong kiba bun, ba kin ioh jingpynim .

en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer , or as a thief , or as an evildoer , or as a busybody in other men s matters .
kha: Lada uno uno na phi u shahshitom , kam dei ban long namar ba u long u nongpynïap briew lane u nongtuh lane u nongkamsniew lane uba lushia ïa ki kam kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat ai ba uno uno na phi un shah shitom kum u nongpyniap briew, ne kum u nongtuh, ne kum u nongleh bymman, ne kum u nongleh kam sniew ha kiwei pat ki kam .

en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :
kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi bad rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh uba la shah pynsleh un shim ia ka snam masi bad un wanrah ia ka sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng:

en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof , and will slay all the princes thereof with him , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynïap ïa u nongsynshar ka Moab bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ot noh ia u nongbishar na pdeng jong ka , bad ngan pyniap ia ki syiem jong ka baroh bad u , ong U Trai .

en: For the husband is the head of the wife , even as Christ is the head of the church : and he is the saviour of the body .
kha: Naba u tnga u don ka iktiar halor la ka tnga kumba U Khrist u don ka iktiar halor ka balang ; bad U Khrist hi u long U Nongpynim jong ka balang , ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u tnga u long u khlieh jong ka tnga kumba U Khrist u long u khlieh jong ka balang : bad u long u nongpynim ia ka met .

en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea : but Silas and Timothy abode there still .
kha: Mar kumta hi , ki parabangeit ki la phah noh ïa u Paul sha ka rud duriaw ; hynrei u Silas bad u Timothi ki la sah ha Beria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta mardor ki para ki la phah noh ia u Paul ban leit sha duriaw: hynrei u Silas bad u Timothi ki sah hangta haduh mynta .

en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .
kha: Haba ka sngi ka la jan sep , u Abram u shoh samthiah eh , bad ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingsngew shyrkhei ka la wan ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi ka la nang hiar, ka jingthiah kaba jylliew ka la hap ha u Abram ; bad, ha khmih, ka jingtieng kaba khraw ka la hap halor jong u .

en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten , so thou shalt eat them : the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike .
kha: Uno uno , u lah ban bam ïa kata ka doh , uba khuid ne bymkhuid , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la bam ia u sohjew bad u sohjew: ki bymkhuid bad kiba khuid kin bam ia ki kumjuh .

en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold , and grave upon it , like the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  LORD .
kha: Thaw ruh ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla bad thoh ha ka , ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ka pliang ksiar kaba khuid, bad tep ia ka, kum ki jingthoh jong ka dak , KA JINGPYNBNA IA U Trai .

en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : but whosoever will lose his life for my sake , the same shall save it .
kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh ïa ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un pynim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba pynim ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka: hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ia la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga , uta un pynim ia ka .

en: For Herod had laid hold on John , and bound him , and put him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife .
kha: Naba u Herod u la lah hukum mynshuwa ban kem ïa u Ïoannis , bad u la phah teh kynjri bad set byndi ïa u . U la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ka tnga jong u Philip u para jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Herod u la bat ia u Ioannis bad u la teh ia u bad u la set ia u ha phatok na ka bynta u Herodias .

en: That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .
kha: ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïeng biang bad ban pynthikna ba yn sumar ïa ka jingïateh lok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka hima kan long ka nongrim, ba kan ym kiew ia lade, hynrei ba da kaba bat ia ka jutang jong u kan ieng .

en: And the eye cannot say unto the hand , I have no need of thee : nor again the head to the feet , I have no need of you .
kha: Kumta te , ka khmat kam lah ban ong ïa ka kti ,  Ngam donkam ïa phi!  Lymne ka khlieh kam lah ban ong ïa ki kjat ,  Shisha , ngam donkam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khmat kam lah ban ong ha ka kti , ngam donkam ia me: lymne ia ka khlieh sha ki kjat , ngam donkam ia phi .

en: And Ornan turned back , and saw the angel  ; and his four sons with him hid themselves . Now Ornan was threshing wheat .
kha: Hangta ha ka jaka shoh kew u Araunah bad saw ngut ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang shoh kew , bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u angel , ki khun shynrang ki la mareh bad rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ornan u la phai shadien, bad u la iohi ia u angel ; bad ki saw ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad u ki la buhrieh ia lade . Mynta u Ornan u la ot ia u kew .

en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .
kha: Nga la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman jong ki , bad nga la phai noh na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingbymkhuid jong ki bad kat kum ki jingpynkhein jong ki nga la leh ia ki , bad nga la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na ki .

en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them  ; and the desert shall rejoice , and blossom as the rose .
kha: Ka ri shyiap kan shadkmen , bad ki syntiew kin phuh ha ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri khlaw bad ka jaka marwei kan sngewbha na ka bynta jong ki ; bad ka ri khlaw kan kmen , bad kan phuh kum u rose .

en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Sakharaiah , ha khmih , la thoh ha ka Kitab ki jingthoh jong ki syiem Israel .

en: And when Saul enquired of the  Lord  , the  Lord  answered him not , neither by dreams , nor by Urim , nor by prophets .
kha: bad kumta u la kylli ïa U  Trai  kaei ba un leh . Hynrei U  Trai  um shym jubab ei ei ïa u , la ha ki jingphohsniew , lane da u Urim bad u Thummim , lane da ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Saul u la kylli ia U Trai , U Trai um shym la jubab ia u, lymne da ki jingphohsniew, lymne da ka Urim, lymne da ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years .
kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , u im khatsan snem palat ïa u Jehoash u syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasaiah u khun u Joash u syiem Judah u la im hadien ka jingiap jong u Joash u khun u Joash u syiem Israel shiphew snem .

en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .
kha: Ai ha u khyndiat ka iktiar jong me , khnang ba u paidbah un kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh katto katne na ka burom jong me halor jong u , ba ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kan long kaba kohnguh .

en: If you harmonize your life with the standards set out in the Bible , God will give you everlasting life .—Romans 6 :23 .
kha: Lada phi pyniahap ka jingim jong phi katkum ka kyrdan ba buh ha ka Baibl , u Blei un ai ïa phi ka jingimbymjukut . —Rom 6 :23 .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi pyniadei ia ka jingim jong phi bad ki kyndon ba la buh ha ka Baibl , U Blei un ai ia phi ia ka jingim bymjukut . Rom 6 :23 .

en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
kha: Te ïathuh ïa ngi me dei uei ,  ki la ong .  Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab sha kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u, Me long mano ? ba ngin ai jubab ia kita kiba la phah ia ngi . Kaei kaba phi ong ia lade ?

en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith : as it is written , The just shall live by faith .
kha: Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : Ka long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U briew uba beit bad U Blei da ka jingngeit un im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hangta la pynpaw ia ka hok U Blei na ka jingngeit sha ka jingngeit: kumba la thoh: U hok un im da ka jingngeit .

en: And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
kha: Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ba ngan dang sah . Ngan dang ïaisah bad phi baroh , ban pynsan shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba don ia kane ka jingshaniah , nga tip ba ngan kohnguh bad ngan iai bteng bad phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingkiew bad jingkmen jong phi baroh;

en: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .
kha: Uba dang sah ïa uba yn phah u long u khun ba-ieit jong u trai hi . Ha kaba khatduh , te , u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki nongshimwai . ‘ Nga ngeit skhem kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don uwei u khun shynrang, u ba ieit eh jong u, u la phah ia u ruh ha ki, u da ong: Kin burom ia u khun jong nga .

en: In thee have they discovered their fathers  nakedness : in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .
kha: Don na ki , kiba thiah bad ka tnga u kpa jong ki . Don kiba pynbor ïa ki kynthei ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki ha ka por poi bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha me ki la lap ia ki kpa jong ki: ha me ki la pynrit ia ka kaba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta ka jingjaboh .

en: And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :
kha: shaphang ka jinglong Blei bakhuid jong u , la pyn-i shynna da ka bor bakhraw ban long U Khun jong U Blei da kaba pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynbna ba u long U Khun U Blei da ka bor , kat kum ka mynsiem ka jingkhuid , da ka jingmihpat na kiba iap:

en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour , especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .
kha: Ki nongsharai balang    kiba trei bha kum ki nongïalam ki dei hok ban ïohpdiang ar shah ïa ka jingsiew , khamtam kito kiba trei jur ha ka jingïalap bad jinghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki rangbah kiba synshar bha kin long kiba bit ban ioh ia ka burom kaba arsien, khamtam kito kiba trei ha ka ktien bad ka jinghikai .

en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is , and he shall shut it up seven days more :
kha: un hukum ba dei ban sait ïa ka , bad buh kyrpang ïa ka sa hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ba kin sait ia kata ka jingpang bad un khang ia ka sa hynriew sngi:

en: And said unto them  ; Go ye also into the vineyard , and whatsoever is right I will give you . And they went their way .
kha: kumta u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Phi ruh khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ , bad ngan siew ka bainong kaba biang .’ Kumta ki la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ; To leit ruh sha ka kper sohjew bad kaei kaei kaba dei ngan ai ia phi . Ki la leit noh .

en: But if ye will not hear these words , I swear by myself , saith the  Lord  , that this house shall become a desolation .
kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , te nga smai ha phi ba kane ka ïingsyiem kan ngat ha ki jingjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym iohsngew ia kine ki ktien , nga smai da lade , ong U Trai , ba kane ka iing kan kylla long ka jingjot .

en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for , thou camest down , the mountains flowed down at thy presence .
kha: Ka la don ka por mynba me wan bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba ngim shym khmih lynti ; ki lumbah ki ïohi ïa me bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me la leh ia kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba ngim ju peit , me la wan hiar shapoh , ki lum ki la tuid shapoh ha khmat jong me .

en: And hallow my sabbaths  ; and they shall be a sign between me and you , that ye may know that I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Pynlong ïa ka Sabbaton ka sngi kaba khuid , ba kumta kan long ka dak jong ka jutang ba ngi la thaw , bad kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to pynkhuid ia ki sngi shongthait jong nga; bad kin long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi, ba phin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness  sake , happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror , neither be troubled  ;
kha: Hynrei wat lada phi hap ban shahshitom haba phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , katno kiba kmen phi long ! Wat sheptieng ïano ïano , bad wat khuslai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad lada phi shah shitom na ka bynta ka hok, to sngewbha: bad wat tieng ia ka jingtieng jong ki, lymne wat shah pynshitom ; .

en: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel  ; and they said , Nay  ; but we will have a king over us  ;
kha: Ki briew kim shahshkor ïa u Samuel , hynrei ki ong ,  Em ! Ngi kwah da u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki briew ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ia ka sur u Samuel ; bad ki la ong: Nay ; hynrei ngin sa don u syiem halor jong ngi ; .

en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .
kha: U Blei u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli , nangta leit bad kren ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, to bam ia kata ba me shem; to leit kren ha ka iing Israel .

en: Now it came to pass after this , that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died , and his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Hadien katto katne por u Nahash u syiem ka Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun u khun jong u , u long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia hadien kane , ba u Nahas u syiem ki khun Ammon u la iap , bad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .
kha: Da kumta phin leh ïa kita ki shnong kiba sha jngai na kata ka ri ha kaba phin shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to leh ia ki nongbah baroh kiba jngai bha na me , ki bym dei na ki nongbah jong kine ki jaitbynriew .

en: O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me  ; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .
kha: Phah ïa ka jingshai jong me bad ka jingshisha jong me ; to ai ba kin ïalam ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong me , bad sha ka Templ jong me , ha kaba me shong .
translated_en_to_kha: O phah ia ka jingshai bad ka jingshisha jong me: to ai ba kin ialam ia nga ; to ai ba kin wanrah ia nga sha u lum bakhuid jong me bad sha ki iing jong me .

en: Thy navel is like a round goblet , which wanteth not liquor : thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies .
kha: Uba ieit jong nga u la leit sha la ka kper , ha kaba ki dieng balsam ki mih . U dang pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u bad lum ïa ki  tiew lili .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka navel jong u ka long kum ka goblet kaba pyllun, kaba kwah ia ka kyiad: ka kpoh jong u ka long kum ka thliew kew kaba la buh kylleng kylleng bad ki syntiew .

en: For it is written , I will destroy the wisdom of the wise , and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynjot noh ïa ka jingstad jong kiba stad bad ngan kyntait sharud ïa ka jingshemphang jong ki riewshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh , ngan pynjot ia ka jingstad jong kiba stad bad ngan pynlong ei ei ia ka jingsngewthuh jong kiba stad .

en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel , saying , Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you :
kha: U Abner u leit sha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki ,  La slem bah phi la kwah ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u la iakynduh bad ki rangbah Israel, u da ong: Phi la wad ia u Dabid ha ki por ba la leit noh ban long syiem halor jong phi:

en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jong me , naba ka dei hi ka kmienah jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u hynmen jong u kpa jong me: ka long ka aunt jong me .

en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .
kha: Ki ai ka jingpynkylla da ka ktien bad ki batai ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban sngewthuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki pule ha ka kot ha ka hukum U Blei da kaba kyrpang , bad ki la ai jingmut , bad ki la pynlong ia ki ban sngewthuh ia ka jingpule .

en: And David said , Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul , that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan s sake ?
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Dabid u kylli ,  Don mano mano ba dang sah na ka longïing jong u Saul ? Lada don , nga kwah ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun ïa u na ka bynta u Jonathan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong: Hato don shuh kaba sah na ka iing u Saul ba ngan pyni ia u ia ka jingsngewbha na ka bynta u Jonathan ?

en: If there come any unto you , and bring not this doctrine , receive him not into your house , neither bid him God speed :
