kha: Te kumta , lada uno uno u wan ha phi khlem da wallam ïa kane ka jinghikai , to wat pdiang sngewbha ïa u ha ki ïing jong phi ; to wat da ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don mano mano ruh ha phi, bad wat wanrah ia kane ka jinghikai, wat pdiang ia u ha iing jong phi, wat ju khot ia u:

en: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman , and hast a desire unto her , that thou wouldest have her to thy wife  ;
kha: bad phi ïohi hapdeng jong ki ïa ka kynthei kaba bhabriew kaba phi imon ban shongkurim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to iohi hapdeng ki mraw ia ka kynthei kaba itynnad, bad phi kwah ia ka, ba phin don ia ka ha ka tnga jong me;

en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven  ; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days :
kha: U Moses u rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad kumta ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka la dum ngaiñ lai sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynkhih ia la ka kti sha bneng ; bad ka la don ka jingdum kaba jur ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei:

en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
kha: Ki nongpyntrei kam jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan kulai na Musri bad Kilikia bad ïa ka jingshalan kali ïapom na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la wanrah ia ki kulai na Ijipt, bad ki nongkhaii linen: ki nongkhaii linen ki la ioh ia ka linen linen ha ka dor .

en: Even so the tongue is a little member , and boasteth great things . Behold , how great a matter a little fire kindleth !
kha: Kumta ka long bad u thylliej : La u long uba rit , u lah ban sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw . Shu pyrkhat kat ka  lawbah lah ban pynpluh ïa ka da i thylliej ding iba rit !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka shyntur ka long ka dkhot kaba rit, bad ka sngew sarong ia kiei kiei kiba khraw . Ha khmih , katno ka long kaba khraw khyndiat ka ding !

en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .
kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Abraham bad ha u Isaak , bad ngan ai ïa ka ruh ha ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Abraham bad u Isaak ha me ngan ai ia ka bad ha u symbai jong me hadien jong me ngan ai ia ka ri .

en: And it came to pass , when the priests were come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the house of the  Lord  ,
kha: Haba ki lyngdoh ki dang mih na ka Templ , kyndit kyndit la pyndap ïa ka da u lyoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki lyngdoh ki la mih na ka jaka bakhuid , ba u lyoh u la pyndap ia ka iing U Trai .

en: The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .
kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah ,  Uno na kine ar ngut ba phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Barabbas !  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lat u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, Hato na ki arngut phi kwah ba ngan pyllait noh ia phi ? Ki la ong, Barabbas .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?
kha: Te U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha ki ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan ryngkat bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Hato phi mih kum u nongtuh , da ki wait bad ki dieng ban shim ia nga ?

en: Now we know that God heareth not sinners : but if any man be a worshipper of God , and doeth his will , him he heareth .
kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei um ju shahshkor ïa ki nongpop ; u shahshkor ïa ki briew kiba burom ïa u bad ba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi tip ba U Blei um iohsngew ia ki nongpop: hynrei lada uno uno u long u nongmane ia U Blei bad u leh ia ka mon jong u , ia u u iohsngew .

en: And when she had brought them unto him to eat , he took hold of her , and said unto her , Come lie with me , my sister .
kha: Katba ka dang ai ïa ki ha u , u la bat trait ïa ka bad u ong ,  Ale thiah lang bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka la wanrah ia ki ha u ban bam, u la bat ia ka bad u la ong ha ka: To wan thiah bad nga ko para jong nga .

en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks , and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers .
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , ki nongwei kin shakri ïa phi , Kin sumar ïa ki jingri jong phi kin lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad sumar ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongwei kin ieng bad ai bam ia ki langbrot jong phi , bad ki khun shynrang jong u nongwei kin long ki nongrep sohjew bad ki nongrep sohjew jong phi .

en: ( James 1 :27  ; 4 :4 ) Can you identify a religious group in your community that has these marks of true Christianity ?
kha: ( Jakob 1 :27 ; 4 :4 ) Phi lah mo ban ithuh ïa ka kynhun ha shnong jong phi kaba don kum kine ki dak jong ka jinglong Khristan bashisha ?
translated_en_to_kha: (U Jakob 1 :27 ; 4 ) Hato phi lah ban ithuh ia ka kynhun niam ha ka imlang sahlang jong phi kaba don ia kine ki dak jong ka niam Khristan bashisha ?

en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and wash them with water .
kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka khyrdop jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ong ïa ki ban sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men wanrah ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad sait ia ki da ka um .

en: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt .
kha: U syiem Jehoïakim , pynban , u la phah ïa u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah sha Ijipt ban wallam ïa u Uriah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoilim u syiem u la phah ia ki briew sha Ijipt, kata u Elnathan u khun Achbor bad katto katne ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u sha Ijipt .

en: And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,
kha: U Moses u thoh lut ïa ka Aiñ U Blei ha ka kitab , khlem da ieh kawei ruh ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , haba u Moses u la pyndep ia ki ktien jong kane ka hukum ha ka kot haduh ba kin da dep .

en: But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it  ; for I will be no judge of such matters .
kha: Hynrei namar ba ka long ka jingïatainia shaphang ki ktien bad ki kyrteng bad shaphang ka hukum jong phi , phi hi phi dei ban ïapynbeit ïa ka . Ngan ym long u nongbishar ïa kine kiei kiei !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka long ka jingkylli jong ki kyntien bad ki kyrteng jong phi, to peit ia ka ; namar ngan ym long u nongbishar ia kum kine kiei kiei .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Friend , wherefore art thou come ?  Then came they , and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  To pynkloi shaphang jong ka , ko paralok !  Nangta ki la ïawan kiew , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , bad ki la batskhem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Paralok, balei me wan ? Nangta ki la wan bad ki la buh kti ha U Jisu bad ki la shim ia u .

en: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings : and the word which ye hear is not mine , but the Father s which sent me .
kha: Uno uno u bym ieit ïa nga um kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga . Bad ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïohsngew kam dei ka jong nga , hynrei ka wan na U Kpa , uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia nga um bat ia ki ktien jong nga: bad ka ktien kaba phi iohsngew kam dei ka jong nga , hynrei U Kpa uba la phah ia nga .

en: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken : but on whomsoever it shall fall , it will grind him to powder .
kha: Uno uno uba hap halor une u maw un shah ot lyngkhot ; bad lada u maw u hap halor uno uno , un pynlwet jin ïa uta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba hap halor une u maw un shah pynpra: hynrei ha uno uno uba un hap , un sa pynkhih ia u haduh ban da tyrkhong .

en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
kha: Ki ïaleh ban phai lyndet na nga . Kin sa lynñiar namar ka lyngkor kaba ban ïa ki , hynrei yn ym don ban weng ïa ka na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew jong nga ki la sdang ban phaidien noh na nga: wat la ki khot ia ki sha ka jaka kaba ha khlieh duh tam, ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pynkiew ia u.

en: Now I praise you , brethren , that ye remember me in all things , and keep the ordinances , as I delivered them to you .
kha: Nga ïaroh ïa phi namar ba phi kynmaw ïa nga borabor bad bud ïa ki jinghikai kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga iaroh ia phi ko para bangeit, ba phi kynmaw ia nga ha kiei kiei baroh, bad to sumar ia ki jingbthah kumba nga la aiti ia ki ha phi .

en: Which none of the princes of this world knew : for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory .
kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei , uba la tip ïa kane ka jingstad . Lada ki la tip ïa ka , kin ym da la sahnarphna ïa U Trai ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ym don uwei ruh na ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei uba tip: namar lada ki la tip ia ka , kin ym shym la sahnarphna ia U Trai ka burom .

en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight  ; her skin , and her flesh , and her blood , with her dung , shall he burn :
kha: Dei ban thang ïa kata ka masi lem bad ka snieh , ka doh , ka snam , bad ki snier jong ka ha khmat jong u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei un thang ia ka masi ha ka khmat jong u; bad ka doh jong ka bad ka snam jong ka, ryngkat bad ka snam jong ka, un thang:

en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour , or buyest ought of thy neighbour s hand , ye shall not oppress one another :
kha: Kumta , haba phi ïadie ïathied khyndew para Israel , wat ïashukor paralok hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi die ia ka mar sha u paramarjan jong phi, ne thied ia ka mar na ka kti jong u paramarjan jong phi, phin ym pynshitom iwei ia iwei pat:

en: O  Lord  , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !
kha: A  Trai  , katno slem nga dei ban pyrta jingïarap ha shuwa ba men shahshkor , ha shuwa ba men pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingleh jubor ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, haduh katno ngan iam bad me phin ym iohsngew ! wat ban pyrta sha me ia ka jingleh donbor bad me phin ym pynim !

en: And entered into a ship , and went over the sea toward Capernaum . And it was now dark , and Jesus was not come to them .
kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki synran U Jisu ki la leit hiar sha ka duriaw , ki la kiew ha ka lieng , bad ki la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw shaphang Kapernam . Ka miet ka la poi bad U Jisu um pat wan satia sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung ha ka lieng bad u la leit sha shiliang duriaw sha Kaparnaum . Bad mynta ka la dum , bad U Jisu um shym la wan sha ki .

en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers , neither shall any of them that provoked me see it :
kha: Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei ruh sha kata ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Yn ym don uwei ruh na kito kiba la kyntait ïa nga u ban ïohrung sha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid kin ym iohi ia ka ri kaba nga sngap jar ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki, lymne uno uno na ki uba la pynkhih ia nga un ym iohi ia ka:

en: And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .
kha: U Jeroboam u tei ruh ïa ki jaka mane ha kliar ki lum , bad u jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing ki bym dei na ka jait Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shna ia ka iing kaba jrong tam bad u la pynlong ia ki lyngdoh kiba rit tam na ki briew ki bym dei na ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi .

en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,
kha: ka da pyrta jam ha ki khyrdop nongbah bad kat haba ki briew ki ïalumlang :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pyrta ha ka jaka kaba kongsan tam, ha ki jingkhang jong ki khyrdop: ha ka nongbah ka pynmih ia ki ktien jong ka da kaba ong:

en: And he said , What then is to be done for her ? And Gehazi answered , Verily she hath no child , and her husband is old .
kha: U Elisha u kylli ïa u Gehasi ,  Te kaei nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ?  U jubab ,  Kam don khun shynrang , bad u tnga jong ka ruh u la tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Te kaei kaba dei ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ? Bad u Gehasi u la jubab , Hooid kam don khun bad u tnga jong ka u la tymmen .

en: In the tenth year , in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khat-ar jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , I prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Hadien ba nga la ai ïa ka dulir thied jaka ha u Barukh , nga la duwai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba nga la pynpoi ia ki sakhi jong ka jingthied sha u Baruk u khun u Neriah , nga la duwai ha U Trai da kaba ong:

en: And a certain Jew named Apollos , born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , and mighty in the scriptures , came to Ephesus .
kha: Ha kata ka por uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Apollos ïa uba la kha ha Aleksandria , u la wan poi sha Ephesos . U long u nongkren uba pnah bad uba don ka jingtip babniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Apollos, uba la kha ha Alexandria, u briew uba stad bad uba donbor ha ki jingthoh Bakhuid, u la wan sha Ephesos .

en: He smote the Philistines , even unto Gaza , and the borders thereof , from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city .
kha: U jop ïa ki Philistia , bad u thombor ïa ki jaka sah jong ki , na ki shnong kiba rit tam haduh ki nongbah kiba heh tam , kaba kynthup ïa ka Gasa bad ki ri kiba marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia ki Philistia, wat haduh Gaza, bad ki pud jong ka, naduh ka tower jong ki nongap haduh ka nongbah ba la ker sawdong .

en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem  ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,
kha: Kine harum ki long ki khun jong u ïa kiba la kha ha Jerusalem : U Shammua , u Shobab , u Nathan , u Solomon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong kito kiba la kha ha u ha Jerusalem ; Shammua bad u Shobab bad u Nathan bad u Solomon .

en: Or crookbackt , or a dwarf , or that hath a blemish in his eye , or be scurvy , or scabbed , or hath his stones broken  ;
kha: uba kdor ka ingdong lane u khyndai khup ; uba pang khmat , uba ïoh  ñiangdait , uba don prum , lane u ïunukh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane u khnai , ne u dwarf , ne uba don ka jingduna ha ka khmat jong u , ne uba sniew ne uba la tyrkhong , ne uba la tyrkhong;

en: And it came to pass at midnight , that the man was afraid , and turned himself : and , behold , a woman lay at his feet .
kha: Ha ka por mynmiet u kyndit thiah kynsan , u phai , bad u lyngngoh ban shem ïa ka kynthei kaba thiah ha ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por shiteng miet, ba uta u briew u la tieng, bad u la phai noh: bad , ha khmih kawei ka kynthei ka la thiah ha ki kjat jong u .

en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .
kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la dem un ym pynlip ïa ka sharak ba dang mehding , un wanrah ka jingbishar hok baneh ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rong kaba la tyrkhong un ym bthei, bad ka flax kaba dih duma un ym pynlip: un wanrah ia ka jingbishar sha ka jingshisha .

en: And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .
kha: U la rung shapoh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Balei katne katne ka jingkhynwin ? Balei ba phi ïa-ïam ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan rung , u ong ha ki , Balei phi pynlong ia kane ka ado bad phi iam ? ka dam kam shym la iap hynrei ka thiah .

en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary , and have given Jacob to the curse , and Israel to reproaches .
kha: bad ki nongsynshar jong phi ki la pyntngit ïa ka ïingkyntang jong nga . Kumta nga la wallam ka jingpynjot ha Israel ; nga shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban shah rkhiebeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la pynjah burom ia ki rangbah jong ka jaka kyntang , bad nga la ai ia u Jakob ha ka jingtim , bad ki Israel ha ki jingkren bein .

en: And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .
kha: u la kynthih , u la ïeng ha la ki kjat , bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng sawdong . Nangta u la leit shapoh ka Templ lem bad ki , u da ïaid bad kynthih bad ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kiew shaneng, bad u la iaid bad ki ha ka tempi, u iaid bad u la iaid bad u la iaroh ia U Blei .

en: I know Ephraim , and Israel is not hid from me : for now , O Ephraim , thou committest whoredom , and Israel is defiled .
kha: Nga tip ka Israel ka long kumno — kam lah ban rieh na nga . Ka la long ka bymïaineh , bad ki briew jong ka kim long kiba bit ban mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia u Ephraim , bad ki Israel kim shym la buhrieh na nga: namar mynta ko Ephraim , me leh ia ka kam runar bad ki Israel ki la shah pynjakhlia .

en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti . And the thing pleased the king  ; and he did so .
kha: Nangta sa shim ïa ka samla kaba phi itynnat tam bad pynlong ïa ka , ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .  U syiem u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , kumta u la pdiang ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba ka khun masi kaba sngewbha ia u syiem kan long ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong u Vashti . Bad kata ka long kaba la pynsngewbha ia u syiem ; bad u la leh kumta .

en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun , who rideth upon the heaven in thy help , and in his excellency on the sky .
kha: Ko Israel , ym don u blei uba kum U Blei jong phi , Uba ïaid ha ka burom ha sahit bneng , Uba ïaid ha ki lyoh ban wan ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kum U Blei jong u Jeshurun uba shong halor ka bneng ha ka jingiarap jong me bad ha ka jingbha jong u ha bneng .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la wanpaw ha u hangta , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashlur bad bakhlaiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la paw ha u bad u la ong ha u: U Trai u don ryngkat bad me, me uba khlain bor .

en: Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :
kha: Nga kular ba ngan pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan leh ia kane ka jaka , ong U Trai bad ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka , bad wat ban pynlong ia kane ka shnong kum ka Tophet:

en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkoit ruh ia ka jingsngewsih jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga khyndiat, ki da ong: Ka jingsuk, ka jingsuk ; haba ym don jingsuk .

en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .
kha: Ki la poi ha ka ïing jong u Jairos , ha kaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhynwin bad u la ïohsngew ïa baroh ka jingïam bad ka jingïam kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u wan sha ka iing jong u nongsynshar jong ka synagog bad u iohi ia ka jingsawa bad kito kiba iam bad iam shibun .

en: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
kha: Ha kata ka por , U Jisu u la leit kiew sha u kum ban duwai bad ban pynlut baroh shi miet hangta da kaba duwai ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kita ki sngi , ba u la leit sha u lum ban duwai , bad u la bteng baroh shi miet ha ka jingduwai ha U Blei .

en: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .
kha: U tnga jong ka u don hok ban pynskhem ne ban pyndam ïa kano kano ka jingkular ba ka la pynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jingkular , bad kawei pa kawei ka jingsmai ban pynshitom ia ka mynsiem , u tnga jong ka u lah ban pynskhem ia ka , lane u tnga jong ka u lah ban pynlong ia ka kaba thylli .

en: Then beware lest thou forget the  Lord  , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
kha: kynmaw ba phin ym klet ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to husiar na ka bynta ba phin klet ia U Trai uba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt , na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw .

en: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .
kha: Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la ïawan mih na kata ka lieng ki long u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . ( U Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la mih na ka lieng ki long u Shem bad u Ham bad u Japhet: bad u Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan .

en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife  ; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife  ; and there I buried Leah .
kha: Dei hangta ba ki la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka Sarah ka tnga jong u ; hangta ruh ki la tep ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka ka tnga jong u ; bad dei hangta ba nga la tep ïa ka Leah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ki la tep ia u Abraham bad ka Sarah jong u ; hangta ki la tep ia u Isaak bad ka Rebek ia ka tnga jong u bad hangta nga la tep ia ka Leah .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .
kha: U Joseph u long uba dap shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien khyndiat por , ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la sdang ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, ka tnga jong u ka la buh ia ki khmat jong ka ha u Joseph bad ka la ong: To leit noh bad nga .

en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty , that thou art righteous ? or is it gain to him , that thou makest thy ways perfect ?
kha: Hato ka jingleh jong phi kaba dei , ka pynmyntoi ïa U Blei , lane ka jingbha jong phi ka ïarap ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long ka jingsngewbha ia Uba donbor baroh, ba me long uba hok ? lane ka long kaba myntoi ia u , ba me pynlong ia ki lynti jong me kiba janai ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Abraham , Wherefore did Sarah laugh , saying , Shall I of a surety bear a child , which am old ?
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Balei ka Sarah ka rkhie bad ong , ‘ Hato ngan dang ïoh khun shisha haba nga la tymmen ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Abraham , Balei ka Sarah ka la rkhie, ka da ong: Hato nga lah ban kha khun shisha uba la tymmen ?

en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .
kha: U Jephthah u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynriew snem . Hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha shnong jong u kaba ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la bishar ia ki Israel hynriew snem . Nangta u Jephthah u Gilead u la iap bad la tep ia u ha kawei na ki shnong Gilead .

en: And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
kha: U Jisu u tang shu mih na ka um , u la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad U Mynsiem ba u wan hiar halor jong u kum ka paro .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mardor u la mih na ka um, u la iohi ia ki bneng ba ki plie, bad U Mynsiem kum ka paro u la hiar halor jong u:

en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snem ka rta , ka la jan ïap . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u don tang kawei ka khun kynthei kaba dang shiphew snem ka rta, bad ka la thiah ha ka jingiap . Hynrei katba u nang iaid ki briew ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u .

en: Whom God hath raised up , having loosed the pains of death : because it was not possible that he should be holden of it .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , da kaba pyllaitluid ïa u na ka bor jong ka , namar ka long ka bym lah long ba ka jingïap kan bat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba U Blei u la pynmih, da kaba pyllait ia ki jingpang jong ka jingiap: namar kam shym la long kaba lah ba un bat ia ka .

en: And the sons of Ephraim  ; Shuthelah , and Bered his son , and Tahath his son , and Eladah his son , and Tahath his son ,
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew u Ephraim na ka pateng sha ka pateng : u Shuthelah , u Bered , u Tahath , u Eleadah , u Tahath , u Sabad , u Shuthelah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Ephraim Shuthelah bad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u,

en: Then he called his twelve disciples together , and gave them power and authority over all devils , and to cure diseases .
kha: U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ai ha ki ka bor bad ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid baroh bad ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot ia ki shiphew ngut ki synran jong u ryngkat bad u la ai bor bad ka bor halor ki ksuid baroh .

en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures , thine end is come , and the measure of thy covetousness .
kha: Kata ka ri ka don shibun ki wah bad ka spah kyrhai , hynrei ka por jong ka , ka la kut , bad ïa u ksai jingim jong ka , la pyndkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko me uba shong ha ki um kiba bun, uba bun ha ki spah, ka jingkut jong me ka la wan, bad ka jingthew jong ka jingkwah brai jong me .

en: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews , that rode on threescore and ten ass colts : and he judged Israel eight years .
kha: U don sawphew ngut ki shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki ksiew shynrang , bad baroh hynñiewphew ngut ki don la ki jong ki kada . U Abdon u ïalam ïa ki Israel phra snem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U don sawphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki laiphew ngut ki khun ksiew kiba shong ha ki laiphew snem bad shiphew snem: bad u la bishar ia ki Israel hynriew snem .

en: And said unto him , Thus saith Jephthah , Israel took not away the land of Moab , nor the land of the children of Ammon :
kha: lem bad kane ka jubab ,  Kam long kaba shisha ba ki Israel ki la knieh ïa ka ri ki Moab ne ïa ka ri ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u , Kumta u Jephthah , ki Israel kim shym la shim noh ia ka ri u Moab ne ia ka ri jong ki khun Ammon:

en: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bad nga , ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham: Me dei ban sumar ia ka jutang jong nga namarkata, me bad u symbai jong me hadien jong me ha ki pateng jong ki .

en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .
kha: U long u synran uba la kren kine kiei kiei , uta uba la thoh ruh ïa kine ; bad ngi tip ba kaei kaba u ong ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u long u synran uba sakhi ia kine kiei kiei: bad ngi tip ba ka jingphla jong u ka long kaba shisha .

en: And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field  ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .
kha: Kita ki khynnah shynrang ki la nang san nang rangbah , bad u Iso u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit , u briew uba ieit ban shang lum shang wah , katba u Jakob pat u long u briew uba jar jar , uba shong tang ha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah shynrang ki la san: bad u Iso u long u nongleit lyngkha uba stad , u briew uba na lyngkha ; bad u Jakob u long u briew uba jem , uba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .

en: Now the next day , that followed the day of the preparation , the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , kaba dei ka sngi Sabbaton , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïakynduh ïa U Pilat
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka sngi kaba bud ia ka sngi jong ka jingpynkhreh , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la iawan lang ha u Pilat .

en: And if ye take this also from me , and mischief befall him , ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
kha: Lada phin shim noh na nga mynta sa ïa une , bad lada ka jia ei ei ïa u , ngan sa shu ïap sngewsih artat ba nga la tymmen .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi shim ia kane ruh na nga, bad ka jingsniew ka la jia ia u, phin pynhap ia ki shniuh kiba rong saw jong nga da ka jingsngewsih sha ka jingtep .

en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king , and said thus unto him , King Darius , live for ever .
kha: Kumta ki la leit ban jngoh ïa u syiem bad ki la ong ,  Ko syiem Darius , ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kine ki rangbah bad ki syiem ki la ialum lang bad u syiem bad ki la ong kumta ha u , U Syiem Darius u im junom .

en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
kha: Lah ban jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tangba u dei ban long u shynrang uba shisnem bad u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: U langbrot jong phi un long uba khlem jingduna, u shynrang uba nyngkong: phin shim noh ia ka na ki langbrot ne na ki blang:

en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :
kha: Namar na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew kiba ïalam ïa u ban pynïap briew , ban klim , bad ban leh ïa kiwei kiwei ki kam bajakhlia ; ban lute , ban lamler , bad ban kren sniew ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na ka dohnud ki mih ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew, ki jingpyniap briew, ki jingleh be-ijot, ki jingleh be-ijot, ki jingtuh, ki sakhi lamler , ki jingkren bein:

en: He said unto them , An enemy hath done this . The servants said unto him , Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up ?
kha: ‘ La dei katto katne ngut ki nongshun kiba la leh ïa kane ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Phi kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad phut noh ïa ki ñiut ?’ ki la kylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , U nongshun u la leh ia kane . Ki shakri ki la ong ha u , Hato me te ba ngin leit lum ia ki ?

en: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?
kha: U Philip u la mareh sha u bad u la ïohsngew ba u dang pule na ka Kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me pule ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u la mareh sha u , bad u la iohsngew ia u ba u pule ia u nongiathuhlypa Isaiah bad u la ong: Phi sngewthuh ia kaei kaba phi pule ?

en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :
kha: Lane nga lah ban wallam ka thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tiar pynjot ban pynduh lut ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada nga wanrah ia ka waitlam ha kata ka ri, bad nga ong, Sword , leit lyngba ka ri ; kumta nga ot noh ia u briew bad u mrad na ka:

en: And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them ,  Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand :
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa u paidbah sha u sa shisien bad ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ïa nga , baroh na phi , bad to long kiba shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la khot ia ki briew baroh sha u, u la ong ha ki: To sngap ia nga iwei ia iwei:

en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Jehoram u long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Joram u khun u Ahab u syiem Israel u Ahasaiah u khun u Jehoram u syiem Judah u la sdang ban synshar .

en: ( Of whom the world was not worthy : ) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .
kha: Ka pyrthei kam shym long kaba bha na ka bynta jong ki ! Kum ki nongphetwir ki shang kylleng ha ki ri shyiap bad sha ki lum , ki da shong ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew kiba don ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na kiba ka pyrthei kam long kaba bit dor: ) ki la iaid kai ha ki ri khlaw bad ha ki lum bad ha ki thliew bad ki krem jong ka khyndew .

en: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city , as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle .
kha: Ki leit phai noh jar jar shapoh ka nongbah , kum ki shipai kiba lehrain haba ki phet noh na ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew ki la leit tuh ia ki ha kata ka sngi shapoh sor , katba ki briew ki nang sngewlehrain ki nang tuh noh haba ki phet noh ha ka thma .

en: For he said , Because the  Lord  hath sworn that the  Lord  will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .
kha: U ong ruh ,  Rah shajrong ïa ka lama U  Trai  ! U  Trai  un ïai ïaleh ïa ki Amalek junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la ong , Namar U Trai u la smai ba U Trai un ialeh thma bad u Amalek naduh ka pateng haduh ka pateng .

en: And the Pharisees went forth , and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him , how they might destroy him .
kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh na ka synagog bad mar kumta hi ki la ïakynduh bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot ka kynhun u Herod , bad ki la thaw ki jingthmu ban pynïap noh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la ia kren beit bad ki nong Herodian pyrshah ia u , kumno ki lah ban pynjot ia u .

en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood : for the blood is the life  ; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh .
kha: Tangba wat bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka , namar ka jingim ka don ha ka snam , bad phim dei ban bam ïa kata ka jingim lem bad ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Tangba to thikna ba me bam ia ka snam: namar ka snam ka long ka jingim ; bad me ym lah ban bam ia ka jingim bad ka doh .

en: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband s , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech  ; and his name was Boaz .
kha: Ka Naomi ka don u ba-ha-ïing uba kyrteng u Boas , u briew uba riewspah bad ïa uba la ñiewkor shibun uba na ka longïing jong u tnga jong ka , u Elimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Naomi ka don u khun shynrang jong ka, u briew uba donbor ha ka spah, na ka longiing jong u Elimelek ; bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Boaz .

en: And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Solomon , Ko khun jong nga, ha ka jingmut jong nga ban tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong nga:

en: To him give all the prophets witness , that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins .
kha: Baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren shaphang jong u , da kaba ong ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop lyngba ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u to ai sakhi ia ki nongiathuhlypa baroh, ba da ka kyrteng jong u uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ioh ia ka jingmap ia ki pop .

en: Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?
kha: U Pilat u la phai ktien ,  Me tharai nga dei u Jiw ? Dei ki briew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh kiba la aiti ïa me sha nga . Kaei kaba me la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la jubab , Hato nga dei u Jiw ? Ka jaitbynriew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la aiti ia me ha nga: me la leh aiu ?

en: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth , before all that went in at the gate of his city .
kha: Ki Hit baroh kiba la ïadon ha kata ka jingïalang ki pynthikna ïa ka kum ka jingïohkynti jong u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Abraham na ka bynta ka jingdon ha khmat ki khun Heth , ha khmat jong baroh kiba la leit rung ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong jong u .

en: And again , when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world , he saith , And let all the angels of God worship him .
kha: Hynrei haba U Blei u la dei ban phah ïa U Khun ba la kha nyngkong sha ka pyrthei , u la ong ,  Baroh ki angel U Blei ki dei ban mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien, haba u wanrah ia u ba nyngkong ha ka pyrthei , u ong , Bad to ai ba ki angel U Blei baroh kin mane ia u .

en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat pat !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ban peit pat , bad nga la khmih ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan sha nga, bad ieng, bad u la ong ha nga, Ko para shynrang, to pdiang ia ka jingpeit jong me . Bad ha kajuh ka kynta nga la peit sha jrong ia u .

en: And they made a calf in those days , and offered sacrifice unto the idol , and rejoiced in the works of their own hands .
kha: Ka la long hangta ba ki la thaw ïa ka bleithaw ha ka dur jong u masi , ki la ai jingkñia ha ka , bad ki la ïakhawai ha kaba ai burom ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki la lah thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thaw ia u khun masi ha kita ki sngi , bad ki la ainguh ia u bleithaw bad ki la ia kmen ha ki kam jong ki kti jong ki hi .

en: And of the Levites , Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God , and over the treasures of the dedicated things .
kha: Kiwei pat ki para Lebi jong ki , ki peit ïa ka ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ki kamra buh tiar na ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha kiba la pynkyntang sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki Lebi , u Ahiah u la long halor ki spah jong ka iing U Blei bad halor ki spah jong kiei kiei kiba la aiti .

en: The king answered and said , I know of certainty that ye would gain the time , because ye see the thing is gone from me .
kha: Ha kata , u syiem u la kren jam ,  Kumba nga la pyrkhat ! Phi pyrshang ban ïoh por , namar phi ïohi ba nga la kut jingmut
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab bad u la ong , Nga tip thikna ba phin sa ioh ia ka por , namar phi iohi ia kata ka jingjia ka la jah noh na nga .

en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus , and disputed against the Grecians : but they went about to slay him .
kha: U la kren ruh bad u la ïatainia bad ki Jiw kiba kren Grik , hynrei ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren shlur ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu, bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Grik: hynrei ki la leit ban pyniap ia u .

en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat .
kha: Uno uno uba na ki ba-ha-ïing jong me uba ïap hapoh ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iap na u Ahab ha ka shnong ki kulai kin bam ; bad uta uba iap ha lyngkha un bam ia ki sim jong ka Iyer .

en: I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .
kha: nga la long u nongwei , hynrei phim shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong phi , nga la lyngkhuit , hynrei phim shym la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad nga la don ha ïingbyndi , hynrei phim shym la sumar ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la long u nongwei, bad phim shym la shim ia nga: lyngkhuid, bad phim shym la phong ia nga: pang, bad ha phatok, bad phim shym la leit jngoh ia nga .

en: And Joab drew nigh , and the people that were with him , unto the battle against the Syrians : and they fled before him .
kha: U Joab bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid shaphrang ban tur ïaleh , bad ki Syria ki phet krad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la iaid shajan bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, sha ka thma pyrshah ia ki Syria: bad ki la phet noh ha khmat jong u .

en: But with whom was he grieved forty years ? was it not with them that had sinned , whose carcases fell in the wilderness ?
kha: Bad kiei pat kiba U Blei u la bitar haduh sawphew snem ? Bad kita ki briew kiba la leh pop , kiba la kyllon ïap ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad mano u la sngewsih sawphew snem ? hato kam dei bad kito kiba la leh pop , kiba ki met iap jong ki ki la hap ha ka ri khlaw ?

en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and his meat offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , bad ka jingainguh bam jong u , bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .
kha: Nga ong ha phi , ki paralok jong nga , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym lah hadien ban leh ïa kano kano kaba kham sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha phi ki paralok jong nga , Wat tieng ia ki kiba pyniap ia ka met bad hadien kata kim don shuh kaba ki lah ban leh .

en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead , how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead ?
kha: Mynta , namar ka khubor jong ngi ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kumno ba katto katne ngut na phi ki ong ba yn ym don ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada la ialap ia U Khrist ba u la mihpat na kiba iap , kumno don napdeng jong phi ba ym don ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap ?

en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , The  Lord  be witness between us , if we do not so according to thy words .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngi mynjur ïa kata . U  Trai  un long u sakhi hapdeng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah Gilead ki la ong ha u Jephthah , U Trai un long u sakhi hapdeng jong ngi lada ngim leh kumta kat kum ka ktien jong me .

en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .
kha: Kiwei pat ki parabangeit Jiw ki la sdang leh kum ki khawpud ryngkat bad u Petros ; bad wat u Barnabas hi ruh u la liat lang ha ka jingleh khawpud jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki Jiw ki la ia tyngkhuh kumjuh bad u ; ki la iathuh ba u Barnabas ruh u la shah rah noh da ka jingpynkylla dur jong ki .

en: And being found in fashion as a man , he humbled himself , and became obedient unto death , even the death of the cross .
kha: U la long uba sngewrit bad u la ïaid ha ka lynti jong ka jingkohnguh baroh shi lynter lynti sha ka jingïap — ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la lap ia u ha ka rukom kum u briew, u la pynrit mynsiem ia lade, bad u la long uba kohnguh haduh ka jingiap, wat ia ka jingiap jong ka diengphna .

en: And said unto him , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and come into the land which I shall shew thee .
kha: ‘ Iehnoh ïa la ka longïing bad ïa ka ri bad leit sha ka jaka kaba ngan pyn-i ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u: To mih noh na ka ri jong me bad na ka jait jong me bad to wan sha ka ri kaba ngan pyni ia me .

en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .
kha: U dang duwai bad ha ka jingïohipaw u la ïohi ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias ba u wan rung bad buh ïa la ki kti ha u , khnang ba un ïoh imat pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew ia u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias uba wan rung, bad u la buh ia la ka kti ha u, ba un ioh ia ka jingpeit jong u .

en: And be ye kind one to another , tenderhearted , forgiving one another , even as God for Christ s sake hath forgiven you .
kha: Pynban , to lehsbun bad long jemnud iwei ïa wei pat , bad to ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba U Blei u la map ïa phi ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to long kiba sbun iwei ia iwei pat, kiba sngewrit, kiba map iwei ia iwei pat, kumba U Blei na ka bynta U Khrist u la map ia phi .

en: But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law , They hated me without a cause .
kha: Kane , pynban , kaba la dei ban jia , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Hukum jong ki kan urlong shisha : ‘ Ki la shun ïa nga khlem daw ei ei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane ka wan jia, ba ka ktien kan long kaba la thoh ha ka ain jong ki: Ki la shun ia nga khlem daw .

en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .
kha: namar man u khun U Blei u lah ban jop noh thiaw ïa ka pyrthei . Bad ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop halor ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingngeit jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei kaei kaba la kha na U Blei ka jop ia ka pyrthei: bad kane ka long ka jingjop kaba jop ia ka pyrthei , wat ia ka jingngeit jong ngi ruh .

en: Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .
kha: Kine ar ngut ki rangbah , ki la shim ïa ka met U Jisu bad ki la sop ïa ka da ki jaiñ linen lem bad ki musla kat kum ka rukom ki Jiw haba pynkhreh ïa ka met shuwa ban tep .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la shim ia ka met U Jisu bad ki la pynmynsaw ia ka da ki jain lin bad ki jingbam ba bang , kumba ka rukom jong ki Jiw ka long ban tep .

en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself : and when he came home , he sent and called for his friends , and Zeresh his wife .
kha: Hynrei u la shu tyngkan ïa lade bad u leit sha ïing . Nangta u khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong u sha ka ïing jong u bad ong ïa ka tnga jong u ka Seresh ban wan ban ïadon ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Haman u la kyntait ia lade: bad haba u la wan phai sha la iing , u la phah bad khot ia ki paralok jong u , bad u Zeresh ka tnga jong u .

en: For she doted upon their paramours , whose flesh is as the flesh of asses , and whose issue is like the issue of horses .
kha: Ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rangbah ba-dap da ka jingbrai kiba don ka jingthrew jakhlia la kum ki kada bad ki khashor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la sngewsih ia ki paralok jong ki, kiba ka doh jong ki ka long kum ka doh jong ki kada , bad kiba ka jingmih jong ki ka long kum ka jingmih jong ki kulai .

en: And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .
kha: Nga la ïaid kylleng hapdeng jong phi baroh , da kaba ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei . Bad mynta nga tip ba ym don mano mano na phi ki ban dang ïohi shuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, nga tip ba phi baroh, napdeng jong phi nga la leit ialap ia ka hima U Blei , phin ym iohi shuh ia ka khmat jong nga .

en: Who hate the good , and love the evil  ; who pluck off their skin from off them , and their flesh from off their bones  ;
kha: pynban phi isih ïa kaei kaba bha bad phi ieit ïa kaei kaba sniew . Phi khoh snieh im ïa ki briew jong nga bad phi tar ïa ka doh na ki shyieng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba shun ia kaba bha , bad kiba ieit ia kaba sniew ; kiba ot noh ia ka sniehdoh jong ki na ki , bad ka doh jong ki na ki shyieng jong ki ; .

en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand , and look how thy brethren fare , and take their pledge .
kha: Bad shim kine ki ktung dud    shiphew tylli sha u nongïalam rangbah . Wad jingtip kumno ki hynmen jong phi ki long bad wanrah dak ei ei ban pyn-i ba phi la ïohi ïa ki bad ba ki koit ki khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad rah ia kine ki shiphew tylli ki chees sha u rangbah shihajar jong ki, bad peit kumno ki hynmen jong me ki leit noh bad shim ia ka jingkular jong ki .

en: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again , and called Jesus , and said unto him , Art thou the King of the Jews ?
kha: U Pilat u la rung pat sha ka ïing bad u la khot ïa U Jisu .  Hato me long u syiem jong ki Jiw ?  u la kylli ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pilat u la rung biang shapoh ka jaka bishar bad u la khot ia U Jisu bad u la ong ha u: Me long u Syiem ki Jiw ?

en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother , and saith , It is no transgression  ; the same is the companion of a destroyer .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrkhat ba kam long kaba bakla ban tuh na la ki kmie ki kpa um long kham bha ban ïa u nongtuh uba la ju mlien .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba lute ia u kpa ne ka kmie jong u, bad u ong , Kam dei ka jingpynkhein ; kumjuh ruh u paralok jong u nongpynjot .

en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?
kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei ngin pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad phi ? Ka lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi sah hajan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la ong ha ki Hebit: "Hato phi shong hapdeng jong ngi ; bad kumno ngin ialeh bad phi ?

en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .
kha: U angel u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaba shat phyrnai sngur bha , bad kaba wan mih na ka khet jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyni ia nga ia ka wah kaba khuid jong ka um ka jingim, kaba shai kum ka kristal, kaba mih na ka khet U Blei bad na u Khunlangbrot .

en: And the napkin , that was about his head , not lying with the linen clothes , but wrapped together in a place by itself .
kha: U la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen kiba la don hangta , bad ïa ka jaiñ kaba spaiñ ïa ka khlieh U Jisu . Kane kam shym don lang bad ki jaiñsop linen hynrei kaba la kli ïa ka jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka napkin kaba don ha ka khlieh jong u, kam shym la thiah bad ki jain lin, hynrei ka la ia tyngkhuh lang ha ka jaka hi .

en: And Peter said unto him , Aeneas , Jesus Christ maketh thee whole : arise , and make thy bed . And he arose immediately .
kha: Ko Ainias ,  u Petros u la ong ha u ,  U Jisu Khrist u pynkhiah ïa me . To ïeng joit bad pynbeit ïa la ka jingthiah .  Mar kumta hi u Ainias u la ïeng joit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la ong ha u, "Aeneas, U Jisu Khrist u pynlong ia me baroh kawei: khie, bad pynlong ia ka jingthiah jong me . Bad u la ieng noh mardor .

en: And the devil , taking him up into an high mountain , shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .
kha: Nangta , u Soitan u la ïalam ïa u shajrong bad u la pyn-i ha u ha ka shikhyllipmat ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ksuid u la rah ia u sha u lum uba jrong , u la pyni ha u ia ki hima pyrthei baroh ha ka khyllipmat .

en: And it came to pass in the evening , that he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to him  ; and he went in unto her .
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet , ha ka jaka jong ka Rakhel , u shim ïa ka Leah bad leit ïalam ïa ka sha u Jakob , bad u Jakob u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por janmiet u la shim ia ka khun jong u Leah bad u la wanrah ia ka ha u ; bad u la leit shapoh jong ka .

en: Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
kha: Kiei kiei kiba nga ïathuhlypa mynta ki la jia shisha . Mynta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin sdang ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa ki wan jia, bad kiei kiei kiba thymmai nga pynbna: shuwa ba kin mih nga iathuh ia phi na ki .

en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the  Lord  : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .
kha: U Laban bad u Bethuel ki jubab ,  Namar ba kane ka kam ka wan hi na U  Trai  , kam dei ïa ngi ban shim rai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Laban bad u Bethuel ki la jubab bad ki la ong: Kaei kaei ka mih na U Trai: ngim lah ban kren ia me kaba sniew ne kaba bha .

en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , I am indeed a widow woman , and mine husband is dead .
kha: Kaei pha kwah ?  u la kylli ïa ka .  Kynrad , nga dei ka riewkynthei kaba duk ,  ka la jubab .  U tnga jong nga u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ia ka, Kaei kaba phi la leh ? Bad ka la jubab , Nga long shisha ka kynthei kaba la duh noh bad u tnga jong nga u la iap .

en: To him the porter openeth  ; and the sheep hear his voice : and he calleth his own sheep by name , and leadeth them out .
kha: U nongap jingkhang u plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong u ; ki langbrot ki ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u katba u dang khot ïa la ki langbrot da ka kyrteng , bad u ïalam ïa ki shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u u nongrah u plie ia ka met bad ki langbrot ki iohsngew ia ka sur jong u: bad u khot ia la ki jong ki langbrot da ka kyrteng , bad u ialam ia ki shabar .

en: Will a lion roar in the forest , when he hath no prey ? will a young lion cry out of his den , if he have taken nothing ?
kha: Hato u sing u ju kyrhuh ha khlaw lymda u la lap ei ei ban kynrup ? Hato u sing samla u ju byrngem ha la krem lymda u la ïohkem ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u sing un iaid ha khlaw , haba um don mrad ? hato u sing samla un pyrta na ka thliew jong u lada um shym la shim ei ei ?

en: Yea , many people and strong nations shall come to seek the  Lord  of hosts in Jerusalem , and to pray before the  Lord .
kha: Bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bakhlaiñbor kin wan sha Jerusalem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bun ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew kiba khlain kin wan wad ia U Trai jong ki paid ha Jerusalem , bad ban duwai ha khmat U Trai .

en: And make straight paths for your feet , lest that which is lame be turned out of the way  ; but let it rather be healed .
kha: Da ïaid ha ki lynti kiba beit , khnang ba ïa kata ka kjat kaba dkoh yn ym pynduhbor noh , hynrei pynban , yn pynkoit keiñ ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to pynlong ia ki lynti kiba beit na ka bynta ki kjat jong phi , ioh ba kata kaba lyngngoh kan kylla noh na ka lynti ; hynrei to ai ba kan kham koit noh .

en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after : and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things .
kha: ( Naba kiba mane blei thala jong kane ka pyrthei ki ïai pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh . ) U Kpa jong phi u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei ki wad: bad U Kpa jong phi u tip ba phi donkam ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane : and he saith to his disciples ,  Sit ye here , while I shall pray .
kha: Ki la wan sha ka jaka ba la khot Gethsemane , bad U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Shong hangne katba nga dang duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka kaba la jer kyrteng Gethsemane : bad u ong ha ki synran jong u: To shong hangne katba nga dang duwai .

en: Ye have not eaten bread , neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink : that ye might know that I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Phim shym ïoh kpu ban bam , bad phim shym ïoh waiñ lane kyiad ban dih , hynrei U  Trai  u pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi khnang ba phin tip ba u long U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim shym la bam ia u kpu , lymne phim shym la dih wain ne dih kyiad: ba phin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: That they sent and called him . And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
kha: Ki paidbah na ki jait ba na shatei ki phah khot ïa u , bad nangta ma ki baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam bad ki ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki la phah bad ki la khot ia u . U Jeroboan bad ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei ki la wan bad ki la kren ha u Rehoboam da kaba ong:

en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark  ; for the oxen stumbled .
kha: Katba ki dang wan sha ka jaka shoh kew ha Khidon , u masi u jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner ïa la ka kti bad u kyrshan ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka bam jong u Chidon , u Ussa u la pynkhih ia la ka kti ban bat ia ka synduk ; namar ki masi ki la lyngngoh .

en: As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .
kha: Kumta , katba ngi dang ïohlad bunsien , ngi dei ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei , bad khamtam ïa kito kiba na ka longïing ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ngi don ka lad namarkata , to ngin leh bha ia ki briew baroh khamtam ia kito kiba long na ka iing ka sem jong ka jingngeit .

en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .
kha: Wat leh ei ei na ka jingkhwan myntoi lane na ka jingkwah bymmyntoi ban sngewsarong , hynrei , to long kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat , kiba ñiew borabor ïa kiwei kiba kham bha ban ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ym dei ban leh ei ei lyngba ka jingialeh ne ka jinglehrain ; hynrei ha ka jinglong rit mynsiem to ai ba uwei pa uwei un kham sngewbha ia uwei pat ban ia lade .

en: And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .
kha: Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kynton ñiut ha kaba ki mradkhlaw ki im . Kan long kaba shyrkhei ban peit ; yn ym don mano mano ban sah hangta , bad baroh kiba ïohi ïa ka kin sngewshyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Babilon kan kylla long ka jaka sah jong ki bsein, ka jinglyngngoh bad ka jingsawa khlem u nongshong shnong .

en: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
kha: ( Na ka bynta ki Pharisi , kumjuh ruh na ka bynta ki Jiw baroh , ki bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa tymmen jong ki : Kim ju bam lymda ki sait ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Pharisi bad ki Jiw baroh , lait noh tang ba ki sait ia ki kti jong ki bunsien , kim bam , ki bat ia ka dustur jong ki rangbah .

en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : because the spirit of the  Lord  bloweth upon it : surely the people is grass .
kha: U phlang u ïapstai bad ki syntiew ki jlop , haba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer ban beh halor jong ki . Ki briew kim neh slem ban ïa u phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: U phlang u tyrkhong , u syntiew u tyrkhong: namar ka mynsiem U Trai ka beh halor jong ka: shisha ki briew ki long ki phlang .

en: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , unto the border of the children of Ammon  ;
kha: Ka kner shaduh ka khappud jong ka Ammon bad kynthup ïa ki nongbah baroh kiba la synshar da u Sihon u syiem ka Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shnong baroh jong u syiem Amorites kiba la synshar ha Heshbon haduh u pud u sam jong ki khun Ammon;

en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynpaw ha ki por baroh ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingkhraw tam eh ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingieit ïa kaba u la pyn-i sha ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha ki juk ban wan un pyni ia ka spah kaba palat jong ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingbhabriew jong u ia ngi lyngba U Khrist Jisu .

en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the  Lord  with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .
kha: Bad kumta ma u bad ki Israel baroh ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  shatei sha Jerusalem da ka jingrisa kmen bad ka jingpynsawa ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ka iing Israel baroh kawei ki la rah ia ka synduk U Trai da kaba pyrta , bad da ka sur jong ka turoi .

en: Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .
kha: Pynngam jylliew ïa ki nongrim jong phi ha u , to tei ïa ka jingim jong phi halor jong u , bad to nang kham khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit jong phi , kumba la hikai ïa phi . Bad to long kiba la pyndap da ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkhih bad tei ha u, bad la pynskhem ha ka jingngeit kumba la hikai ia phi, da kaba pyndap ia ka da ka jingsngewnguh .

en: Whose are the fathers , and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came , who is over all , God blessed for ever . Amen .
kha: ki hiarpateng na ki kpa tymmen Hebru bapawnam ; bad U Khrist , kum u briew , u long na ka jaitbynriew jong ki . To ai ba yn ïaroh junom ïa U Blei uba synshar halor baroh! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa jong ki, bad na kiba kum ka doh U Khrist u la wan, uba la long halor jong baroh, U Blei u la kyrkhu junom . Amen .

en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,
kha: Hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lumbah uba jrong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u shim ia u Petros , u Jakob bad u Ioannis u hynmen jong u bad u wanrah ia ki sha u lum uba jrong sha jngai .

en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
kha: Bad U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , shen un pynlwet ïa u Soitan hapoh ki kjat jong phi . To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei jong ka jingsuk un pynkhih ia u Soitan hapoh ki kjat jong phi tang khyndiat por . Ka jingaiei U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist kan long bad phi . Amen .

en: As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .
kha: Wat haba la pynshitom , ym shym la pynïap ; wat haba la pynsngewsih , ngi long borabor kiba kmen ; ngi paw kum kiba duk , hynrei ngi pynriewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun ; ngi paw kum ki bym don ei ei , pynban ngi don lut ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka jingsngewsih, hynrei baroh ki sngewbha ; kum kiba duk, hynrei ki riewspah shuh shuh kum ki bym don ei ei, bad pynban ki don ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another , and toward all men , even as we do toward you :
kha: To U Trai un pynlong ïa ka jingieit jong phi iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh ban nang ïai san bad ban man khraw ha ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u pynlong ia phi ban nang kiew bad nang bun ha ka jingieit iwei ia iwei pat bad ia ki briew baroh, kumba ngi leh ia phi:

en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , and the love of God , and the communion of the Holy Ghost , be with you all . Amen .
kha: Ka jingaiei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ka jingieit jong U Blei bad ka jingïasyllok jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kin long lem bad phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu Khrist bad ka jingieit U Blei bad ka jingiasyllok jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid, to long bad phi baroh . Amen .

en: When thou hast eaten and art full , then thou shalt bless the  Lord  thy God for the good land which he hath given thee .
kha: Phin ïoh bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah , bad phin ainguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi na ka bynta kata ka ri kaba seisoh ba u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda me la bam bad dap , te men kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong me na ka bynta ka ri kaba bha kaba u la ai ha me .

en: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not , and if he be pleased to dwell with her , let her not leave him .
kha: Bad lada ka parabangeit ka la shongkurim ïa u briew u bymngeit bad u mynjur ban ïaishong bad ka , kam dei ban pyllait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynthei kaba don u tnga u bym ngeit bad lada u sngewbha ban shong bad ka , wat ai ba kan iehnoh ia u .

en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .
kha: U Mynsiem u long ka jingbahkhlieh ba ngin sa ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ha ki briew jong u , bad kane ka pynthikna ïa ngi ba U Blei un ai ka jinglaitluid kaba pura ha kito kiba long ki jong u . To ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom jong u!
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba long kaba jur tam jong ka pateng jong ngi haduh ka jingpynim ia ka jingdon jingem ba la thied, haduh ka jingiaroh ia ka burom jong u .

en: Take the millstones , and grind meal : uncover thy locks , make bare the leg , uncover the thigh , pass over the rivers .
kha: Pynshad ïa u mawtylliat ! Pynlwet ïa u  purew ! Weng ïa ka jingkah khmat ! Law noh ïa ki jaiñ bani jong pha ! Syndong ïa la ki jaiñphong ban jam ïa ki wahduid !
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ki mawlyngnai, bad khleh ia ka jingbam: pynpaw ia ki jingkhang jong me, pynlong ia ka kjat kaba lyngkhuid, pynpaw ia ka tyrpeng, iaid lyngba ki wah .

en: But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .
kha: Phi lah ban thikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar uwei pa uwei un hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka bymmyntoi kaba u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien kaba khlem akor kaba ki briew kin kren , kin ai jingkhein ia ka ha ka sngi bishar .

en: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no , not one .
kha: Baroh ki la phai noh na U Blei ; baroh ki la leh bym dei ; ym don uno uno uba leh ïa kaba dei , ym don uwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la jah noh na ka lynti, ki long ryngkat ki bym don jingmyntoi ; ym don mano mano ruh kiba leh bha, em, ym don mano mano ruh .

en: And many of the brethren in the Lord , waxing confident by my bonds , are much more bold to speak the word without fear .
kha: Bad ka jingdon jong nga ha byndi , ka la ai ïa kiba bun eh ki parabangeit ban kham sngewskhem ha U Trai , khnang ba kin nang kham shlur ha ki por baroh ban ïalap ïa ka khubor khlem sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki para bangeit ha U Trai, da kaba sngewskhem da ki jingteh jong nga, ki kham shlur shibun ban kren ia ka ktien khlem jingtieng .

en: And he said unto them ,  What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Shaphang kaei ba phi ïakren para ma phi , katba phi nang ïa-ïaid ?  Ki la ïeng , lem bad ka durkhmat basngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kiei ki jingiakren kiba phi don iwei ia iwei pat, katba phi iaid bad phi sngewsih ?

en: And when these things begin to come to pass , then look up , and lift up your heads  ; for your redemption draweth nigh .
kha: Haba kine kiei kiei baroh ki sdang ban jia , ïeng joit bad pynïeng ïa la ki khlieh , namar ka jingpynim jong phi ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kine kiei kiei ki sdang ban jia , te peit sha jrong , bad pynkiew ia ki khlieh jong phi na ka bynta ka jingpynim jong phi ka nang jan .

en: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
kha: To wat pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh , na ka daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbam baroh ki long kiba lah ban bam , hynrei ka long ka bym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynlong ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka doh kam pynjot ia ka kam U Blei . Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba khuid ; hynrei ka long kaba sniew ia uta u briew uba bam da ka jingsngewsih .

en: But to him that worketh not , but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly , his faith is counted for righteousness .
kha: Hynrei u briew uba shaniah ha ka jingngeit jong u , ym ha ki kam jong u , bad uba ngeit ha U Blei uba pynbna ïa uba la rem , ban long uba lui lui , ka long ka jingngeit jong u ba U Blei u pdiang khnang ban pynlong hok ïa uta u briew bad u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha uta u bym trei kam , hynrei u ngeit ha uta uba pynshisha ia ka jingbymhok , la khein ia ka jingngeit jong u na ka bynta ka hok .

en: But Jesus said ,  Suffer little children , and forbid them not , to come unto me : for of such is the kingdom of heaven .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ba kin wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima ki bneng ka long ïa kiba kum kine .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong, To sngewbha ia ki khynnah rit, bad wat khang ia ki, ban wan sha nga: namar na kiba kum kita ka long ka hima bneng .

en: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
kha: Haba ki apostol ki la tip shaphang kata , ki la phet sha ki nongbah Lystra bad Derbe kiba ha Lykaonia , bad sha ka thain ba-marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid lyngba ia ka, bad ki la phet noh sha Lystra bad ka Derbe, ki nongbah Lycaonia bad sha ka thain kaba don sawdong:

en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .
kha: Shi lynter ka jingim jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , namar u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la hikai ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoash u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai baroh ki sngi jong u ha kaba u Jehoiada u lyngdoh u la hikai ia u .

en: The fear of the  Lord  tendeth to life : and he that hath it shall abide satisfied  ; he shall not be visited with evil .
kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad phin ïoh im slem , uba sngewhun bad uba shongshngain na ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long kaba sngewtynnad ia ka jingim: bad uta uba don ia ka un ym shah jngoh bad ka jingsniew .

en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof .
kha: Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna saw tylli ki ryntieh ksiar na ka bynta jong ka , bad buh ia ki ryntieh ha ki saw tylli ki tduh kiba don ha ki saw tylli ki kjat jong ka .

en: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
kha: U Judas ( ym u Judas Iskariot ) u la ong ,  Ko Trai , kumno ka lah ban long ba men pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas u ong ha u, ym ha Isarikos, ko Trai, kumno ba me pynpaw ia lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?

en: And Saul said , There shall not a man be put to death this day : for to day the  Lord  hath wrought salvation in Israel .
kha: Hynrei u Saul u ong ,  Ym dei ban pynïap ïano ïano ha kane ka sngi , naba kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong: Ym dei ban pyniap ia u briew ha kane ka sngi: namar haduh mynta ka sngi U Trai u la leh ia ka jingpynim ha Israel .

en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked  ; ( for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies : )
kha: U Moses u ïohi ba u Aaron u la pyllait lan ïa kita ki paidbah kat haduh ba ki la pynkhlemrain ïa lade ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Moses u la iohi ba ki briew ki la lyngkhuid ; (namar u Aaron u la pynlong lyngkhuid ia ki ha ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki hapdeng ki nongshun jong ki: )

en: In the last two years , four new Jails have been made functional and two Sub Jails have been upgraded as District Jails .
kha: Ha kine ki ar snem ba la lah saw tylli ki Jail thymmai la pynlong ban treikam bad ar tylli ki Sub Jail la kyntiew kum ki District Jail .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kine ki ar snem ba la dep , saw tylli ki Jail thymmai la pynlong ia ki bad ar tylli ki Sub Jail la pynbha ia ki kum ki District Jail .

en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .
kha: To leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan ba-pura ha khmat U Blei , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , uta uba hikai beit ïa ka khubor jong ka jingshisha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: To pule ban pyni ia lade ba la mynjur ha U Blei , u nongtrei uba donkam ban sngewlehrain , da kaba phiah hok ia ka ktien jong ka jingshisha .

en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced , and brought in , and cast into the chest , until they had made an end .
kha: Kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki briew bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ki la wallam ïa ka khajna jong ki bad ki pyndap ïa ka synduk da ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah baroh bad ki briew baroh ki la ia kmen , bad ki la wanrah ia ka , bad ki la bret ha ka shyntur haduh ba kin da kut noh .

en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .
kha: Ka wahduid Nimrim ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym don kano kano kaba jyrngam kaba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki um Nimrim kin sa jah noh: namar u sboh u la tyrkhong noh , u phlang u la tyrkhong , ym don kaei kaei kaba jyrngam .

en: Verily I say unto you , Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein .
kha: Kynmaw ïa kane ! Uno uno u bym pdiang ïa ka Hima U Blei kum u khynnah un ym rung shapoh jong ka da lei lei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Uno uno u bym pdiang ia ka hima U Blei kum u khynnah rit un ym rung ha ka .

en: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose , that ye might know our affairs , and that he might comfort your hearts .
kha: Dei namar kata keiñ balei ba nga phah ïa u sha phi — ban ïathuh ha phi kumno baroh ngi long , bad ban pynshlur ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba nga la phah sha phi na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu, ba phin tip ia ki kam jong ngi bad ba un pyntngen ia ki dohnud jong phi .

en: They feared the  Lord  , and served their own gods , after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence .
kha: Kumta ki mane ïa U  Trai  , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa la ki blei kat kum ki rukom jong ki hima na kiba ki wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tieng ia U Trai , bad ki la shakri ia la ki jong ki blei , hadien ka rukom jong ki jaitbynriew kiba ki la rah noh nangta .

en: David smote also Hadadezer , the son of Rehob , king of Zobah , as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates .
kha: Nangta u la jop ïa u khun jong u Rehob , u Hadadeser , u syiem ka hima Sobah jong ka Syria , katba u Hadadeser u dang don ha lynti ban pynïoh pat ïa la ka bor synshar halor ka ri harud ka wah Ïuphratis kaba shaneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sdang ruh ia u Hadader u khun u Rehob u syiem u Sobah katba u dang leit ban ioh biang ia u pud u sam jong u ha ka wah Euphrates .

en: Nor scrip for your journey , neither two coats , neither shoes , nor yet staves : for the workman is worthy of his meat .
kha: wat rah ïa ka pla khrong na ka bynta ka jingleit lane ka sopti bujli lane ka juti bujli lane u diengduh . Ïa u nongtrei dei ban ai ïa kaei kaba u donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingthoh na ka bynta ka jingleit jong phi, ym ar tylli ki jainkup, ym don juti, lymne ki dieng: namar u nongtrei u long uba bit ia ka doh jong u .

en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel ha shuwa jong phi ban ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleit bad ban ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga phah ia u Angel ha khmat jong me, ban sumar ia me ha ka lynti bad ban wanrah ia me sha ka jaka kaba nga la pynkhreh .

en: And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .
kha: U Jisu u la hiar na ka lieng , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun , ïa ka dohnud jong u la pyndap da ka jingisynei ïa ki , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la pang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit shabar bad u la iohi ia u paidbah uba bun bad u la sngewsih ia ki bad u la pynkoit ia ki nongpang jong ki .

en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la mih shabar , da kaba phong ïa ka pansngiat shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaba sawbthuh . U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Khmih ! hangne uta u briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la wan shabar, u phong ia ka khlieh jong ki khniang bad ka jainkup kaba lieh . U Pilat u ong ha ki: Ha khmih uta u briew !

en: Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .
kha: Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shaphang baroh ki kam babha kiba u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga la kren . Bad u ïai phah ïa nga ki shithi ban pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki la iathuh ia ki kam babha jong u ha khmat jong nga, bad ki la pynmih ia ki ktien jong nga ha u . Bad u Tobiah u la phah ia ki shithi ban buh ia nga ha ka jingtieng .

en: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee s children with her sons , worshipping him , and desiring a certain thing of him .
kha: Nangta ka tnga jong u Sebedi ka la wan sha U Jisu lem bad ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka , ka la nguh dem ha khmat jong u , bad ka la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la wan ha u ka kmie jong u Sebede bad ki khun shynrang jong ka, ka la mane ia u bad ka kwah ia kaei kaei na u .

en: I have digged and drunk strange waters , and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places .
kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih pukri bad dih ïa ki um ha ki ri nongwei bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïoh ïuh pyntyrkhong ïa ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la tih bad dih ia ki um kiba phylla , bad da ka kjat jong nga nga la tyrkhong ia ki wah baroh jong ki jaka ba la tyrkhong .

en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “ Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her . ”
kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “ U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule ” ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u don ka jingngeit ba ka tnga jong u kan im biang, hynrei ngi pule ba u Abraham u la wan rung ban iam ia ka Sarah bad ban iam ia ka .
