en: And it was broken in that day : and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ïa ka jutang la pyndam noh ha kata ka sngi . Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki ap khmih ïa nga , bad ki tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba kaei kaba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la bthei ha kata ka sngi: bad kumta ki baduk jong ka kynhun kiba ap ia nga ki la tip ba ka long ka ktien U Trai .

en: He teareth himself in his anger : shall the earth be forsaken for thee ? and shall the rock be removed out of his place ?
kha: Phi nang pynmynsaw ïa lade da ka jingbitar jong phi . Hato ka khyndew kan long jaka kynjah namar ba phi bitar ? Hato U Blei un pynkhih ïa ki lumbah ban pynhun ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkhih ia lade ha ka jingbitar jong u: hato ka khyndew kan shah iehnoh na ka bynta jong me ? bad u maw un shah weng noh na ka jaka jong u ?

en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :
kha: U Ananias u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , bun ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa nga shaphang une u briew bad shaphang kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew jong me ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ananias u la jubab , ko Trai , nga la iohsngew da kiba bun na une u briew , katno ka jingsniew u la leh ia ki riewkhuid jong me ha Jerusalem:

en: And thou shalt become an astonishment , a proverb , and a byword , among all nations whither the  Lord  shall lead thee .
kha: Ki briew ha ki ri sha kiba U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi , kin kyndit ïa kata kaba la jia ha phi ; kin sa krenbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me long ka jinglyngngoh, ka proberb bad ka ktien , hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha kaba U Trai un ialam ia me .

en: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father s brother , and that he was Rebekah s son : and she ran and told her father .
kha: U la ïathuh ha ka ,  Nga dei u ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong phi , u khun jong ka Rebekka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la iathuh ha ka Rakhel ba u dei u hynmen jong ka kpa jong ka, bad ba u dei u khun Rebekka: bad ka la mareh bad ka la iathuh ha u kpa jong ka .

en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki .  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga ban leit sha Galilaïa bad hangta kin ïohi ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha ki: Wat tieng: leit iathuh ha ki hynmen jong nga ba kin leit sha Galilaia bad hangta kin iohi ia nga .

en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .
kha: Bad hadien ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u , ki la pynhiar noh ïa u na ka diengphna bad ki la buh ïa u ha ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pyndep ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh shaphang jong u , ki la shim ia u na u dieng bad ki la buh ia u ha ka jingtep .

en: And they shall make the ephod of gold , of blue , and of purple , of scarlet , and fine twined linen , with cunning work .
kha: Kin suh ïa ka ephod da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shna ia ka jain ksiar, kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw, kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw, bad kaba rong saw .

en: Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
kha: Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane wat la nga long u Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Khrist Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongsah byndi na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ka bynta ka jingieit nga kham sngewbha ia me, da kaba long kum u Paul uba la tymmen, bad mynta ruh u koidi jong U Jisu Khrist .

en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins :
kha: Man la u lyngdoh Jiw , u trei ïa la ka kam man ka sngi bad ai kijuh ki jingkñia man ka por ; hynrei kine ki jingkñia kim lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u lyngdoh u ieng man ka sngi bad u ai bunsien ia kijuh ki jingknia , ki bym lah ban weng ia ki pop:

en: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ? or who shall bemoan thee ? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Mano ban isynei ïa phi , ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , bad mano ban ïam sngewsih halor jong phi ? Mano ban sangeh kham slem ban kylli phi long kumno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba sngewsynei ia me ko Jerusalem ? lane mano ba sngewsih ia me ? lane mano ba leit shawei ban kylli kumno me leh ?

en: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread , for every table  ; and likewise silver for the tables of silver :
kha: na ka bynta ki miej kiba da ka rupa bad na ka bynta kawei kawei ka miej kaba da ka ksiar ha kaba yn ïa ki kpu ban ainguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jingkhia u la ai ksiar na ka bynta ki miej jong ka jingpyni, na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka miej bad kumjuh ruh ka rupa na ka bynta ki miej rupa:

en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .
kha: Kumta u Jephthah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jephthah u la iaid sha ki khun Ammon ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki ; bad U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong u .

en: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea  ; and there he tarried with them , and baptized .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judia , ha kaba u la pynlut katto katne por bad ki bad u la pynbaptis .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei ki la wan U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ha ka ri Judaea ; bad hangta u la sah bad ki bad u la pynbaptis .

en: But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;
kha: Kaei kaba nga mut , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ka long kane : Ka por kam don shuh , bad naduh mynta ki rangbah kiba la shongkurim ki dei ban im kumba kim shym la shongkurim ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane nga ong, ko para bangeit, ka por ka long kaba lyngkot: ka sah, ba baroh arngut kiba don ki tnga kin long kumba kim don shuh;

en: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .
kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa uta u briew sa shisien ,  Me ong u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingmatlah jong me — haba kumta , me ong aïu shaphang jong u ?   U dei u nongïathuhlypa ,  uta u briew u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong biang ia uta u briew uba matlah: Kaei kaba me ong shaphang jong u ba u la plie ia ki khmat jong me ? U la ong , U long u nongiathuhlypa .

en: Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .
kha: La ñiew ïa ngi kum ka synrum jong ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kyntait beiñ haduh kane ka khyllipmat !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewsih , ngi sngewsih: la pynlong ia ngi kum ka jingjakhlia jong ka pyrthei , bad ngi long ki khun jong kiei kiei baroh haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .
kha: Ong phi kwah aïu ngan ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewbit ïa ka nongleitkurim , ngan ai ha phi kat kaba phi pan , tang lada phi shah ïa nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli ia nga wat ju don ka jingbam bad ka jingai sngewbha kaba bun, bad ngan ai katba phi ong ha nga: hynrei to ai ia nga ia ka dam ia ka tnga .

en: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it  ;
kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap ha ka jaka mawsiang ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba pdiang ïa ka khubor da kaba kmen mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba la pdiang ia u symbai ha ki jaka maw, uta u long uba iohsngew ia ka ktien bad u anon da ka jingkmen u pdiang ia u;

en: But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her .
kha: Ka riewkynthei lane ka kynthei kaba la ïapyllait tnga ka dei ban pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular ba ka la ai ban kyndiah noh na kano kano .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei pa kawei ka jingkular jong ka riewkynthei bad jong ka kaba la iakhlad noh, da kaba ki la teh ia ka mynsiem jong ki, kan ieng pyrshah ia ka .

en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,
kha: Kane ka bor kaba trei ha ngi ka long kajuh kum ka jingkhlaiñbor ba u pyndonkam haba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na kiba ïap , bad u la pynshong ïa u sha ka kti kamon jong u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba u la leh ha U Khrist , haba u la pynmih ia u na kiba iap , bad u la buh ia u ha la ka jong ka liang kadiang ha ki jaka bneng .

en: He shall cover thee with his feathers , and under his wings shalt thou trust : his truth shall be thy shield and buckler .
kha: Un tap ïa me da ki thapniang jong u ; men long shngain hapoh ka jingsumar jong u ; ka jinglong baïaineh jong u kan ïada bad kyrshan ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Un tap ia me da ki bniat jong u, bad hapoh ki bniat jong u men shaniah: ka jingshisha jong u kan long ka jingda bad ka jingkhang jong me .

en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
kha: To da pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba u la ïaid lyngba , kumno u la buh ïa lade ban shah isih ha ki nongpop ! Kumta wat ai ba phin noh mynsiem bad kynran dien .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar to pyrkhat ia uta uba la shah ia ka jingpyrshah jong ki nongpop pyrshah ia lade , ioh ba phin sngewsih bad sngewsih ha ka jingmut jong phi .

en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .
kha: Nga tharai ,  u Simon u la jubab ,  un long uta uba la ïohmap kham bun .   Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon u la jubab bad u la ong , Nga tharai ba ma u uba u la map kham bunsien . Bad u la ong ha u , Me la bishar hok .

en: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth , saith the Lord  God  : wherefore turn yourselves , and live ye .
kha: Ngam kwah ïano ïano ban ïap ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam don jingsngewbha ia ka jingiap jong uta uba iap, ong U Trai Blei: namarkata to phai noh ia lade bad to im .

en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :
kha: bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon noh ; u ieit ïa ki briew kiba hok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u plie ia ki khmat jong kiba matlah: U Trai u pynmih ia kiba la dem khrup: U Trai u ieit ia kiba hok:

en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :
kha: u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiasyriem jong kano kano ka jinglong kaba rung ha ka khyndew , ka jingiasyriem jong kano kano ka dohkha kaba don ha ki um hapoh ka khyndew:

en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ïa ka rong jong ka sniehdoh jong u , lane u  labasa u lah mo ban weng ïa ki jingthoh ïong jong u ? Lada ki lah , te ma pha ka bym leh ïa kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha lah ban tip ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u nong Ithiopia u lah ban pynkylla ia ka sniehdoh jong u, ne u blang jong u ? nangta phi ruh phi lah ban leh bha , kiba la ju leh sniew .

en: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem , he and his daughters .
kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Hallohesh , u nongsynshar ïa kawei pat kaba shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . ( Ki khun kynthei ki la ïarap ha ka jingtrei . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Sallum u khun u Hallohesh, u nongsynshar shiteng na Jerusalem , ma u bad ki khun kynthei jong u .

en: They have corrupted themselves , their spot is not the spot of his children : they are a perverse and crooked generation .
kha: Pynban phi , phi long kiba ïaid kdor , ki bym dei hok ban long ki briew jong u , ka jaitbynriew kaba pop bad kaba shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynsniew ia lade , ka jaka jong ki kam dei ka jaka jong ki khun jong u: ki long ka pateng kaba kylla bad kaba kylla .

en: Whose mouths must be stopped , who subvert whole houses , teaching things which they ought not , for filthy lucre s sake .
kha: Ka long kaba donkam ban pynsngap jar ïa ka jingïathuh jong ki , namar ki pynkylla khongpong ïa ki longïing baroh da kaba hikai ïa kaei kaba kim dei ban hikai , bad baroh ka long ïa ka jingthmu basngewlehrain ban thaw pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyntur jong ki ki dei ban sangeh noh , kiba pynkylla ia ki iing baroh kawei , ki hikai ia kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban leh , na ka bynta ka kam kaba jakhlia .

en: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger , fatherless , and widow . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba pynkylla ia ka jingbishar jong u nongwei, u bym don kpa bad u riewkynthei . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen .

en: For he is our God  ; and we are the people of his pasture , and the sheep of his hand . To day if ye will hear his voice ,
kha: U long U Blei jong ngi , ngi long ki briew kiba u sumar , ka kynhun langbrot kaba u pyndap . To sngap ha kane ka sngi ïa kaei kaba u ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u long U Blei jong ngi ; bad ngi long ki briew jong ka jaka ri jingri jong u bad ki langbrot jong ka kti jong u . Ha ka sngi lada phin iohsngew ia ka sur jong u .

en: And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
kha: Kumta u leit shim ïa ki bad u wanrah sha ka , bad ka ruh ka shet ïa ka jait jingbam kaba u kpa jong u , u ju sngewtynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit, bad u la leit, bad u la wanrah ia ki sha ka kmie jong u: bad ka kmie jong u ka la shet ia ka doh kaba thiang kumba u kpa jong u u ieit .

en: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way ? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt , as thou wast ashamed of Assyria .
kha: Phi la pyntat-dor ïa lade da kaba phai sha ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Yn pynnoh mynsiem ïa phi da ka Ijipt , kumba phi la long da ka Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me sngewsih shibun ban pynkylla ia ka lynti jong me ? me ruh phin sngewlehrain ia ka ri Ijipt kumba me sngewlehrain ia ka Assyria .

en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them : but they understood not .
kha: ( U la pyrkhat ba ki briew jong u kin shemphang ba U Blei un sa pyndonkam ïa u ban pyllaitluid ïa ki , hynrei kim shym shemphang . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la tharai ba ki hynmen jong u kin sa sngewthuh kumno ba U Blei da ka kti jong u un pyllait im ia ki: hynrei kim sngewthuh .

en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years .
kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah u im khatsan snem hadien ka jingïap u Jehoash u Syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasaiah u khun u Joash u syiem Judah u la im hadien ka jingiap jong u Jehoash u khun u Jehoah u syiem Israel shiphew snem .

en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
kha: Te ngi lah ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi bad yn ym donkam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ialap ia ka gospel ha ki thain kiba don shabar jong phi , bad ban ym sngew sarong ha uwei pat u briew u la pynkhreh ia ka kti jong ngi .

en: ( That also was accounted a land of giants : giants dwelt therein in old time  ; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims  ;
kha: ( Ïa kane ka ri la ju tip kum ka ri ki Rephaim , ka kyrteng jong kita ki briew kiba ju shong hangta . Ki Ammon ki khot ïa ki , ki Samsummim .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kata ruh la khein ia ka ri jong ki rangbah: ki rangbah ki shong hangta ha ki por barim bad ki Ammon ki khot ia ki Zamzumm ; .

en: And thou shalt write Aaron s name upon the rod of Levi : for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers .
kha: bad nangta thoh ïa ka kyrteng u Aaron ha u diengduh na ka bynta ka jait Lebi . Dei ban don uwei u diengduh ïa u nongïalam jong kawei pa kawei ka jait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men thoh ia ka kyrteng Aaron ha u dieng u Lebi: namar uwei u dieng un long na ka bynta ka khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amon u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Amon kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
kha: U briew uba la shah shohdab kum u masi , lane uba la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la mynsaw ha ki maw , ne uba la ot noh ia u dkhot shimet jong u , un ym rung sha ka jingiaseng U Trai .

en: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father s sake : but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son .
kha: Pynban , na ka bynta u Dabid u kpa jong me , ngan ym leh ïa kane katba me dang im , hynrei ha ka por jingsynshar u khun jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ha ki sngi jong me ngan ym leh ia kata na ka bynta u kpa jong me: hynrei ngan pynmih noh ia ka na ka kti u khun jong me .

en: And ye are puffed up , and have not rather mourned , that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you .
kha: Kumno , te , phi sngewsarong ïa kata ? Ha kawei ka liang , phi dei bad dap da ka jingsngewsih , bad ïa u briew uba la leh ïa kaba kum kata kaei kaei la dei ban weng noh napdeng ka kynhun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la sngewsih , bad phim shym la sngewsih kham bunsien , ba uta uba la leh ia kane ka kam un shah weng noh na pdeng jong phi .

en: Many days and years shall ye be troubled , ye careless women : for the vintage shall fail , the gathering shall not come .
kha: Phi lah ban sngewhun mynta , hynrei kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem ka ban wan , phin long ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen namar yn ym don sohwaiñ ba phin ïohlum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun sngi bad ki snem phin sa shah pynshitom, phi ki kynthei ki bym don jingkhuslai: namar ka jingbam kan ym lah ban wan , ka jingialum kan ym wan .

en: And Joshua passed from Libnah , and all Israel with him , unto Lachish , and encamped against it , and fought against it :
kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Libnah sha Lakhish , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la iaid na Libnah, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u, haduh Lachish, bad u la shong shnong pyrshah ia ka, bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka:

en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .
kha: U shakri uba sian un ïoh long khlieh halor u khun bymlarkam jong u kynrad bad ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka jingïohpateng .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri uba stad un don ka jingsynshar halor u khun uba pynjah burom , bad un don ka bynta na ka pateng hapdeng ki hynmen .

en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .
kha: U nongsynshar uba khlem ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba runar . Uta uba isih ïa ka jingbymhok un synshar slem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem uba kwah ia ka jingsngewthuh ruh u long u nongpynshitom bein uba khraw: hynrei uta uba shun ia ka jingkwah brai un pynjlan ia ki sngi jong u .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahas u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Ahasa kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .
kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ngi , to ïeng skhem bad batskhem ha kito ki jingshisha kiba ngi la hikai ïa phi , ha ka jingïalap jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko para bangeit, to ieng skhem, bad to bat ia ki jinghikai kiba la hikai ia phi, la ka long da ka ktien ne da ka shithi jong ngi .

en: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him .
kha: Namar ba u don shibun ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi , bad bun ngut ki shakri , ki Philistia ki la bishni ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u don ki langbrot bad ki kynhun masi bad ki jingbam ba bun: bad ki Philistia ki la sngewsih ia u .

en: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses , which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel .
kha: Hangta ha ka jingïohi ki Israel , u Joshua u pruid ha ki maw ïa ka jingthoh jong ka Hukum kaba u Moses u la thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thoh hangta halor ki maw ia ka kopi jong ka hukum u Moses , kaba u la thoh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .
kha: Wat shim ïa la ka para ne hynmen kynsi kum kawei na ki tnga jong me katba ka tnga jong me , ka dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat shim ia ka tnga jong ka, ban pynsngewsih ia ka, ban pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka, nalor kawei pat ha ka por ba ka dang im .

en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .
kha: u Absalom u ju ong ,  Khmih , ka aiñ ka ha ka liang jong me , hynrei ym don mano mano u ban mihkhmat ïa u syiem ban sngap ïa ka kam jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la ong ha u, Peit, ki kam jong me ki long kiba bha bad kiba dei; hynrei ym don briew uba la shah jied na u syiem ban iohsngew ia me .

en: Behold , Rebekah is before thee , take her , and go , and let her be thy master s son s wife , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
kha: Ka Rebekka ka don hangne ; to shim bad ïalam ïa ka . Ai ba kan long ka tnga jong u khun u kynrad jong phi , kumba U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka Rebeka ka don ha khmat jong me, to shim ia ka bad leit noh bad to ai ba kan long ka tnga jong u khun jong me, kumba U Trai u la kren .

en: And it came to pass , that , when I was come again to Jerusalem , even while I prayed in the temple , I was in a trance  ;
kha: Nga la leit phai sha Jerusalem , bad katba nga dang duwai ha ka Templ , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba nga la wan phai biang sha Jerusalem, wat haba nga dang duwai ha ka tempi, nga la don ha ka jingkylla ; .

en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes , and made him look up : and he was restored , and saw every man clearly .
kha: U Jisu u la buh biang ïa la ki kti ha ki khmat jong uta u briew . Ha kane ka por uta u briew u la peit shaiñ , ka jingïohi jong u ka la wan phai pat , bad u la ïohi shai ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la buh biang ia ki kti jong u ha ki khmat jong u, bad u la pynlong ia u ban peit sha jrong: bad u la shah pynphai biang , bad u la iohi shai ia uwei pa uwei u briew .

en: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall , there cried a woman unto him , saying , Help , my lord , O king .
kha: Katba u syiem Israel u dang ïaid najan ka kynroh shnong , kawei ka kynthei ka pyrta jam ,  Syiem Kynrad , ïarap lem ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u dang iaid lyngba ia ka kynroh, ka la pyrta ia u, ka la pyrta ia u, ka da ong: Iarap ko kynrad jong nga ko syiem .

en: And he said , Hear ye now , O house of David  ; Is it a small thing for you to weary men , but will ye weary my God also ?
kha: U Isaïah u jubab ïa kata ,  To shahshkor , mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka long kaba sniew eh ïa phi ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah jong ki briew — hato phi donkam ruh ban pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah ka jong U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: To sngap mynta, ko iing u Dabid Hato ka long kaba rit ia phi ban pynsniew ia ki briew hynrei hato phin pynsniew ia U Blei jong nga ruh ?

en: Therefore take no thought , saying , What shall we eat ? or , What shall we drink ? or , Wherewithal shall we be clothed ?
kha: Kumta wat khuslai : ‘ Nangno ka jingbam jong nga kan wan ? lane ka jingdih jong nga ? lane ki jaiñ jong nga ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat pyrkhat ei ei da kaba ong , Ngi bam aiu ? lane , Ngi dih aiu ? lane , Da kaba ngin sa phong ?

en: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .
kha: naba U Trai un pyndep kloi kloi ïa ka jingainong ba-pura na ka bynta ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un pyndep ia ka kam , bad un ot lyngkot ia ka ha ka hok: namar ka kam kaba lyngkot U Trai un leh halor ka khyndew .

en: They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled  ; for our end is come .
kha: U Nongshun u la ap khmih ïa ngi ; ngim lah wat ban ïaid ha ki lynti bah . Ki sngi jong ngi ki la kut ; kaba kut ka la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki leit khwai ia ki step jong ngi , ba ngim lah ban leit sha ki surok jong ngi: ka jingkut jong ngi ka la jan , ki sngi jong ngi ki la pyndep ; namar ka jingkut jong ngi ka la wan .

en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .
kha: Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito kiba trei kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingshlur ïa kito kiba ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka mynsiem bishar ia uta uba shong ha ka jingbishar , bad na ka bynta ka jingkhlain ia ki kiba pynphai ia ka thma sha ka khyrdop .

en: O  Lord  our God , other lords beside thee have had dominion over us : but by thee only will we make mention of thy name .
kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ïa ngi la synshar da kiwei pat , hynrei tang ma me , me long U  Trai  jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai jong ngi, kiwei pat ki kynrad nalor jong me ki la don ka jingsynshar halor jong ngi: hynrei tang da me ngin kdew ia ka kyrteng jong me .

en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt  ; every man and his household came with Jacob .
kha: Ki khun shynrang u Jakob kiba la leit ryngkat bad u sha Ijipt , lem bad la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , ki long
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel kiba la wan sha Ijipt; uwei pa uwei bad ka iing jong u ki la wan ryngkat bad u Jakob .

en: She saith unto him , Yea , Lord : I believe that thou art the Christ , the Son of God , which should come into the world .
kha: Ho-oid , ko Trai !  ka la jubab .  Nga ngeit ba me long U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , u ban sa wan sha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ong ha u: Hooid ko Trai: Nga ngeit ba me long U Khrist U Khun U Blei uba dei ban wan sha ka pyrthei .

en: And Zacharias said unto the angel , Whereby shall I know this ? for I am an old man , and my wife well stricken in years .
kha: U Sekharaïah u la ong ha u angel ,  Da kumno ngan tip lada kane ka long kumta ? Nga long u briew batymmen , bad ka tnga jong nga ruh ka la tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sakharaiah u la ong ha u angel , Da kaba ngan tip ia kane ? namar nga long u tymmen bad ka tnga jong nga ka la tyrkhong bha ha ki snem .

en: Upon my right hand rise the youth  ; they push away my feet , and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction .
kha: Une u paidbhur u tur pyrshah ïa nga ; ki pynher krad ïa nga ; ki pynkhreh ïa ka jingïaleh kaba kut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kti kadiang jong nga ki kiew ia ki samla ; ki pynkynriah noh ia ki kjat jong nga , bad ki pynmih pyrshah ia nga ia ki lynti jong ka jingpynjot jong ki .

en: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .
kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh katno phi long kiba ieit ïa nga bad haduh katno nga la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynkmen ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi ! Kane te , ko ki parabangeit ba-ieit , ka long kumno phi dei ban ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ki hynmen jong nga ki la ieit bad ki la kwah eh ia ka jingkmen bad ka khlieh jong nga, kumta to ieng skhem ha U Trai, ko baieit eh jong nga .

en: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .
kha: Ki la leit sha ka ri Ophir bad ki wan kit nangta haduh khatsaw hajar kilo ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Ophir bad ki la shim na kata ka ksiar, saw spah arphew talent bad ki la wanrah ia ka ha u syiem Solomon .

en: And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , bad katba u dang ïaid , ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la sdang ban bud ïa u .  To isynei ïa ngi , ko khun u Dabid !  ki la pyrta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la leit noh nangta, arngut ki briew kiba matlah ki la bud ia u, ki da iam bad ki da ong: Ko Khun u Dabid, to isynei ia ngi .

en: And a girdle of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , of needlework  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: bad ki jingpanpoh da ka linen bani bad da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ba la pynpur itynnat bha , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rong saw kaba jem bha, bad kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw, kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw, kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me drink : I was a stranger , and ye took me in :
kha: Nga la thngan bad phi la bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang bad phi la ai jingdih ïa nga ; nga la long u nongwei bad phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la thngan, bad phi la ai jingbam ia nga: Nga la sliang, bad phi la ai jingdih ia nga: Nga la long u nongwei, bad phi la shim ia nga:

en: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .
kha: Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Khyndiat por , bad phin ym iohi ia nga: bad sa shisien pat, bad phin sa iohi ia nga , namar nga leit sha U Kpa .

en: But the people held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
kha: Ki paidbah ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ong ïa ki ban leh kumta ; kim shym kren shikyntien ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki, bad kim jubab ia u: namar ka hukum jong u syiem ka long, da kaba ong , Wat jubab ia u .

en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .
kha: Da ka bor bakhraw ki apostol ki la sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong U Trai Jisu , bad U Blei u la theh ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka bor kaba khraw ka la ai sakhi ia ki apostol shaphang ka jingmihpat U Trai Jisu: bad ka jingaiei kaba khraw ka la long halor jong ki baroh .

en: And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
kha: ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba nga la hukum ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka umphniang kaba pynsleh bad ka jingiwbih kaba thiang na ka bynta ka jaka bakhuid: kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia me kin leh .

en: For I will take you from among the heathen , and gather you out of all countries , and will bring you into your own land .
kha: Ngan shim noh ïa phi na man la ka jaitbynriew bad ka ri bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan shim ia phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan lum ia phi na ki ri baroh , bad ngan wanrah ia phi sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: And he said , An hundred measures of oil . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and sit down quickly , and write fifty .
kha: ‘ Shispah pipa ka umphniang Olib ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ha u ; ‘ to shong bad thoh sanphew .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Shispah tylli ki bill jong ka umphniang . Bad u la ong ha u, Shim ia ka bill jong me, bad shong kloi, bad thoh sanphew .

en: Fear them not therefore : for there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; and hid , that shall not be known .
kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa ki briew . Ïa kaei kaba la kah mynta yn weng noh , bad ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ki: namar ym don ei ei kaba la tap , kaba ym lah ban pynpaw ; bad kaba la buhrieh , kaba ym lah ban tip .

en: If I do not remember thee , let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth  ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .
kha: To ai ba ngan nym lah shuh ban rwai biang lada ngam kynmaw ïa pha , lada ngam pyrkhat ïa pha kum ka jingkmen bakhraw tam jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngam kynmaw ia me , to ai ba ka shyntur jong nga kan rung sha ka tnum jong ka shyntur jong nga; lada ngam kham kwah ia ka Jerusalem halor ka jingkmen kaba khraw jong nga .

en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .
kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Abraham , U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , uba sah hajan  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ka jingiap u Abraham, ba U Blei u la kyrkhu ia u khun jong u u Isaak bad u Isaak u la shong hajan ka thliew Lahairoi .

en: And Saul said unto Ahiah , Bring hither the ark of God . For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel .
kha: Wallam hangne ïa ka Ephod ,  u Saul u ong ha u Ahijah u lyngdoh . ( Ha kata ka sngi u Ahijah u dang rah ïa ka ha khmat ki paid Israel . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u Ahiah, To wanrah ia ka synduk U Blei . Namar ka synduk U Blei ka la don ha kata ka por bad ki khun Israel .

en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .
kha: Nangta , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh ne phi ong , dei ban leh ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba phi ainguh da u ïa U Blei uba U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba phi leh ha ka ktien ne ka kam, to leh ia kata baroh ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu , da kaba ainguh ia U Blei bad ia U Kpa da u .

en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,
kha: U Isaïah u leit noh na u syiem , hynrei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u ong ïa u
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia shuwa ba u Isaiah u la leit sha ka iingbishar pdeng, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u da kaba ong:

en: And as the people were in expectation , and all men mused in their hearts of John , whether he were the Christ , or not  ;
kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew ka la sdang ban kiew , bad ki la sdang ban pyrkhat la u Ïoannis lehse u lah ban dei U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ki briew ki dang ap, bad ki briew baroh ki la sngewsih ha ki dohnud jong u Ioannis, la u long U Khrist ne u long u;

en: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king : and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward ?
kha: Ngam don hok ïa kaba kum kane ka bainong bakhraw . Kumta ngan shu leit on lynti ïa phi tang katto katne palat ïa ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri jong me un leit khyndiat shaphang ka Jordan bad u syiem: bad balei u syiem un siew kylliang ia nga da ka bainong kaba kum kata ?

en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee : and seek ye the priesthood also ?
kha: U la ai ïa phi bad ïa kiwei pat ki Lebi ban ïoh ïa kane ka burom — bad mynta pat phi pyrshang ban ïoh sa ïa ka kam lyngdoh ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia me hajan jong u, bad ki hynmen jong me baroh ki khun shynrang jong me: bad phi wad ia ka jinglong lyngdoh ruh ?

en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
kha: Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa me , hynrei nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Kpa hok, ka pyrthei kam ithuh ia me: hynrei nga la ithuh ia me , bad kine ki la tip ba me la phah ia nga .

en: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice , Who is worthy to open the book , and to loose the seals thereof ?
kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba khlaiñ , uba pynbna ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Mano uba dei hok ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait bad ban plied ïa ka kot kli ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia u angel uba khlain uba la pynbna da ka sur kaba jam , Mano ba dei ban plie ia ka kot bad ban pyllait ia ki muhor jong ka ?

en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of things in heaven , and things in earth , and things under the earth ;
kha: Bad kumta , kum ka burom ïa ka kyrteng U Jisu baroh ki jingthaw ha bneng , ha pyrthei bad ha ka pyrthei hapoh kin dem khrup ha ki khohsiew jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha ka kyrteng U Jisu uwei pa uwei u kjat u dei ban dem khrup, na kiei kiei kiba don ha bneng bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka khyndew bad kiei kiei kiba don hapoh ka khyndew;

en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread : but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough .
kha: U nongrep uba trei shitom u don kyrhai ban bam . Ki briew kiba pynsyrwa ïa la ka por kin duk lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba rep ia ka ri jong u un don shibun u kpu: hynrei uta uba bud ia ki briew kiba lehnohei un don ka jingduk kaba biang .

en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and David s sons were chief rulers .
kha: u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u long uba khmih ïa ki nongïada jong u Dabid ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki la long ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la long halor ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongshong shnong; bad ki khun shynrang u Dabid ki long ki nongsynshar rangbah .

en: And he said unto them ,  It is not for you to know the times or the seasons , which the Father hath put in his own power .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa ki por bad ki jingjia la buh da U Kpa ha ka bor jong u hi , bad kam dei ïa phi ban tip lano kin jia long .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kam dei ia phi ban tip ia ki por ne ki aiom kiba U Kpa u la buh ha la ka jong ka bor .

en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .
kha: Te u Saul u ong ha ki nongïalam jong u paidbah ,  Ale hangne bad wad ka pop aïu la leh ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong, To leit shajan jong u, baroh ki rangbah: bad to tip bad peit shano kane ka pop ka la long mynta ka sngi .

en: Let me pass through thy land : I will go along by the high way , I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left .
kha: ‘ Shah ngin ïaid lynti na ka ri jong phi . Ngin shu ïaid beit beit na lynti bah bad ngin ym kynriah nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngan iaid lyngba ka ri jong me: Ngan iaid ryngkat bad ka lynti kaba jrong , ngan ym phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .
kha: Ki riewsniew ki don hapdeng ki briew jong nga ; ki apthap kum ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar ban riam ïa ki sim , hynrei kiba pynap ïa ki jingriam jong ki ban riam ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hapdeng ki briew jong nga la shem ia ki briew kiba sniew: ki thiah , kumba uta uba buh ia ki jingeh ; ki buh ia ka jingma , ki kem ia ki briew .

en: Everything done at a branch contributes to the orderly accomplishment of the preaching work . —1 Corinthians 14 :33 , 40 .
kha: Kiei kiei kiba la leh ha ka tnad treikam ka wanrah ïa ka jingryntih ha ka kam ïalap . —1 Korinth 14 :33 , 40 .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kaba la leh ha ka tnat ka iarap ia ka jingpyndep ryntih ia ka kam ialap . 1 Korinth 14:33, 40.

en: And Jesus looking upon them saith ,  With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .
kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ïa u briew , hynrei ym ïa U Blei ; kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u peit ia ki u ong, Da ki briew kam lah ban long, hynrei ym bad U Blei: namar bad U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah .

en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .
kha: U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Moses ,  Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ki briew katba ki dang pyrta , u la ong ha u Moses , Ka don ka jingsawa thma ha ka shnong .

en: And the men of Beth–shemesh said , Who is able to stand before this holy  Lord  God ? and to whom shall he go up from us ?
kha: Kumta ki rangbah na Beth Shemesh ki ïa-ong ,  Uei uba lah ban ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  , une U Blei uba Khuid ? Shano ngi lah ban phah ïa u ba un lait noh na ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Bethshesh ki la ong, Mano ba lah ban ieng ha khmat une u Trai bakhuid ? bad hano un leit kiew na ngi ?

en: She obeyed not the voice  ; she received not correction  ; she trusted not in the  Lord   ; she drew not near to her God .
kha: Kam shym la pynshahshkor ïa U  Trai  lane pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong u . Kam shym la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U  Trai  lane kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam shym la kohnguh ia ka sur ; kam shym la ioh ia ka jingpynbeit ; kam shym la shaniah ha U Trai ; kam shym la wan hajan U Blei jong ka .

en: Take heed to yourselves , that your heart be not deceived , and ye turn aside , and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
kha: Da husiar ban ym shah ïalam bakla noh na U  Trai  ban mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade, ba ka dohnud jong phi kan ym shah thok, bad phi phai noh shawei pat bad phi shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei bad phi mane ia ki ; .

en: And the king of Israel answered and said , My lord , O king , according to thy saying , I am thine , and all that I have .
kha: Ïathuh ha u kynrad jong nga , u syiem Benhadad , ba nga mynjur ; u lah ban shim ïa nga bad ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga don ,  u Ahab u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la jubab bad u la ong: Ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, kat kum ka jingong jong me, nga long u jong me bad baroh kaba nga don .

en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay , whose foundation is in the dust , which are crushed before the moth ?
kha: Hato me pyrkhat un shaniah ïa u jingthaw uba da ka dewbyrtha , uba da ka dewmet ba lah ban khñiot kum ïa u khñiang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka kham duna ha ki kiba shong ha ki iing dewbilat , kiba ka nongrim jong ki ka don ha ka dewbilat , kiba la tyrkhong ha khmat u khnai ?

en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the  Lord  : though hand join in hand , he shall not be unpunished .
kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa baroh kiba leh meng ; da lei lei un ym shah ba kin lait na ka jingpynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei uba sngew sarong ha ka dohnud u long uba sngewsih ia U Trai: wat la ka kti ka iasoh lang ha ka kti , un ym long uba khlem jingpynshitom .

en: But now bring me a minstrel . And it came to pass , when the minstrel played , that the hand of the  Lord  came upon him .
kha: Mynta wallam ha nga ïa u nongtem .  Katba u nongtem u dang tem ïa la ka duitara , ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan halor u Elisha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta to wanrah ia nga ia ka jingkren lyngkot . Bad ka la jia, haba u nongkren lyngkot u la ialehkai, ba ka kti U Trai ka la wan halor jong u .

en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away , the world languisheth and fadeth away , the haughty people of the earth do languish .
kha: Ka pyrthei ka tyrkhong bad ka stai noh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kylla tlot ; ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng , baroh ar , kin pyut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka iam bad ka jah noh, ka pyrthei ka jah noh bad ka jah noh, ki briew kiba sngew sarong jong ka khyndew ki jah noh .

en: Now go , write it before them in a table , and note it in a book , that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever :
kha: U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban thoh ha ka kot ba ki briew kiba kumno ki long , khnang ba kan don ka jingthoh jingkynmaw baneh shi rta , haduh katno ki la long kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta leit , thoh ia ka ha khmat jong ki ha ka miej , bad thoh ia ka ha ka kot , ba kan long na ka bynta ka por ban wan junom:

en: And Jesus , moved with compassion , put forth his hand , and touched him , and saith unto him ,  I will  ; be thou clean .
kha: U Jisu u la dap da ka jingsngewsynei bad u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To long khuid !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu, u la khih da ka jingsngewrit, u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la ktah ia u, bad u ong ha u, Ngan sa long uba khuid;

en: And it came to pass , when she pressed him daily with her words , and urged him , so that his soul was vexed unto death  ;
kha: Ka ïai kylli ïa u kawei ka sngi hadien kawei pat . U da ngiah hi shoiñ bad thait ïa ka jingthlia jong ka ïa u shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , haba ka la pynkhih ia u man ka sngi da ki ktien jong ka , bad ka la kyntu ia u , haduh ba ka mynsiem jong u ka la sngewsih haduh ka jingiap;

en: They shall be ashamed , and also confounded , all of them : they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols .
kha: Kito kiba shna bleithaw baroh kin shah lehrain ; baroh na ki kin jahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sngewlehrain ruh, bad kin sngewlehrain ruh, baroh: kin leit sha ka jingkulmar lang kiba long ki nongshna bleithaw .

en: So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .
kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynhun ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara bad ki sahmiet hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka synduk U Trai ka la ker sawdong ia ka shnong , ka iaid kylleng kawei ka por: bad ki la wan shapoh ka shnong bad ki la sah ha ka shnong .

en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .
kha: U hap da ki khohsiew , U kyllon kram bad u thiah lyngktar ha ki kjat jong ka . Ha ki kjat jong ka u hap da ki khohsiew bad u kyllon ; U kyllon kram ha madan , uba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki kjat jong ka u la dem khrup, u la hap, u la thiah: ha ki kjat jong ka u la dem khrup: ha kaba u la dem khrup, hangta u la hap iap .

en: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee , and make thy name great  ; and thou shalt be a blessing :
kha: Ngan ai ïa me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad kin sa long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pyndonnam ïa ka kyrteng jong me , ba kumta men sa long ka jingkyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw, bad ngan kyrkhu ia me, bad ngan pynlong ia ka kyrteng jong me kaba khraw; bad me long ka jingkyrkhu:

en: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .
kha: Napdeng jong ki , kin wan ki nongsynshar , ki nongïalam , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ki ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na u la mih ka kut, na u u nail, na u u bow thma, na u u nongpynshitom bein baroh lang .

en: A devout man , and one that feared God with all his house , which gave much alms to the people , and prayed to God alway .
kha: U la long u briew uba riewblei ; ma u lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh kawei ki la mane ïa U Blei . U la leh ruh shibun ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw kiba duk bad u ïai duwai ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba riewblei , bad uta uba la sheptieng ia U Blei bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei , kaba la ai shibun ki soh sha ki briew , bad u la duwai ha U Blei baroh shi katta .

en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease , her feast days , her new moons , and her sabbaths , and all her solemn feasts .
kha: Ngan pynkut noh ïa baroh ki kam sngewbha jong ka — ki jingkhawai ba man ka snem bad man u bnai bad ki jingrakhe ïa ka Sabbaton — bad ïa ki jinglehniam jong ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ia ka jingkmen jong ka baroh, ki sngi bam jong ka, ki bnai thymmai jong ka, bad ki sngi saitjain jong ka baroh .

en: So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .
kha: Haba u Abner u wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ryngkat bad arphew ngut ki rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Abner u la wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron bad arphew ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u . U Dabid u la leh ia ka jingkhawai bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: Judah mourneth , and the gates thereof languish  ; they are black unto the ground  ; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up .
kha: Ka Judah ka don ha ka jingïambriew ; ki nongbah jong ka ki la jan ïap , ki briew jong ka ki thiah ha madan ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ka Jerusalem ka kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u iam , bad ki khyrdop jong ka ki la tyrkhong ; ki la rong saw haduh ka khyndew bad ka jingpyrta jong ka Jerusalem ka la kiew .

en: But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;
kha: U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul , u Abner u khun jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul sha Mahanaim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abner u khun u Ner u rangbah jong u Saul u la shim ia u Ishaioshet u khun u Saul bad u la wanrah ia u sha Mahanaim;

en: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .
kha: U rangbah synshar u la jubab ,  Kumno ngan lah ban sngewthuh lymda don mano mano ba batai ïa ka ha nga ?  Bad u la khot sngewbha ïa u Philip ban wan kiew bad shong ha ka kali kulai ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Kumno ngan long , lymda don mano mano ba dei ban ialam ia nga ? Bad u la kwah ia u Philip ba un wan shaneng bad shong bad u .

en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .
kha: Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong ïa kaei kaba ki mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud ruh jong u rash kan sngewthuh ia ka jingtip , bad ka shyntur jong ki nongkren bein kan long kaba kloi ban kren shai .

en: Then will I go unto the altar of God , unto God my exceeding joy : yea , upon the harp will I praise thee , O God my God .
kha: Te ngan leit sha ka duwan jong me , A Blei ; me long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong nga . Ngan tem ïa ka duitara jong nga bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , A Blei , U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan leit sha ka jingknia U Blei, ha U Blei ka jingkmen kaba palat jong nga: Hooid, halor ka harp ngan iaroh ia me, ko Blei jong nga .

en: And they asked him , What then ? Art thou Elias ? And he saith , I am not . Art thou that prophet ? And he answered , No .
kha: Te , me dei uei ?  ki la kylli ,  Hato me dei u Elijah ?   Em , ngam dei ,  u Ïoannis u la jubab .  Hato me dei u nongïathuhlypa ?  ki la kylli .  Em ,  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u, Kaei te ? Hato me dei u Elias ? Bad u ong, ngam dei . Hato me uta u nongiathuhlypa ? Bad u la jubab, Em .

en: And it came to pass , that , as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God , he stood by the lake of Gennesaret ,
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la ïeng harud jong ka duriaw Gennesaret katba ki briew ki dang ïawan kiew sha u ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba ki briew ki la pynkhih ia u ban iohsngew ia ka ktien U Blei , u la ieng hajan ka pung Genesarete .

en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno ngin ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa une u paidbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki ong ha u: Naei ngi dei ban don u kpu uba bun ha ka ri khlaw , haduh ban da pyndap ia u paidbah uba bun ?

en: And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .
kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong phi , kiba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong me un buh ia kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong me bad ha kito kiba shun ia me kiba la pynshitom bein ia me .

en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah , which was sixteen years old , and made him king instead of his father Amaziah .
kha: Ki paidbah Judah te ki pynkup syiem ïa u khun jong u , u Ussaïah uba don khathynriew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh jong ka Judah ki la shim ia u Asaria uba dang shiphew snem ka rta bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u ha ka jaka jong u kpa jong u u Amasaiah .

en: Agassi followed his 1999 French Open victory by reaching the Wimbledon final , where he lost to Sampras in straight sets .
kha: U Agassi u la bud ia ka jingjop jong u ha ka French Open ha u snem 1999 da kaba poi sha ka phainal jong ka Wimbledon , ha kaba u la shah rem ha ka Sampras ha ki set kiba beit beit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Agassi u la bud ia ka jingjop jong u ha ka snem 1999 da kaba poi sha ka Wimbledon final , ha kaba u la duh noh ia u Sampra ha ki set kiba beit .

en: The captain of fifty , and the honourable man , and the counsellor , and the cunning artificer , and the eloquent orator .
kha: ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki nongïalam paidbah jong ki , ïa ki nongmihkhmat paidbah jong ki bad ïa baroh kiba pyndonkam ïa ka myntor ban bat ïa kino kino ki jingjia .
translated_en_to_kha: U kapten jong ki sanphew snem , bad u briew uba donburom , bad u nongai jingmut , bad u nonglehkai uba stad .

en: And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .
kha: Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah lane uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Don kiba ong ba me long u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis: don kiba ong u Elias ; bad kiwei pat ki Jeremaiah ne uwei na ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .
kha: Ka lah ban long ba yn don uno uno u ban ym kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba ngi phah sha phi ha kane ka shithi . Lada ka long kumta , khmih ïa u bad wat ïadon bynta ei ei bad u , khnang ba un lehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew um kohnguh ia ka ktien jong ngi da kane ka shithi , to kynmaw ia uta u briew bad wat iasyllok bad u , ba un sngewlehrain .

en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness  ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach :
kha: Suh ki patlun lyngkot kiba da ka jaiñ linen , kiba kot naduh syngkai haduh lbong , khnang ba kin ym thad burom ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynlong ia ki da ki jain lyngkhuid jong ki;

en: " Ulpian ' s statements were known in medieval Europe , but sovereignty was an important concept in medieval times " " "
kha: " Ia ki jingkren jong u Ulpian la tip ha ki por pdeng Europe , hynrei ka jingsynshar ka long ka jingmut kaba kongsan ha ki por pdeng " " "
translated_en_to_kha: " La tip ia ki jingkren jong u Ulpian ha Europe , hynrei ka jingsynshar ka long ka jingmut kaba kongsan ha ki por pdeng."

en: And there was a very sore battle that day  ; and Abner was beaten , and the men of Israel , before the servants of David .
kha: Nangta la khie ka thma kaba shyrkhei , bad u Abner bad ki Israel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la don ka thma kaba jur bha ha kata ka sngi bad u Abner u la shah shoh bad ki briew Israel ha khmat ki shakri u Dabid .

en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .
kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba u Paul u dang ap ia ki ha Athen , ka mynsiem jong u ka la khih ha u , haba u la iohi ia ka nongbah kaba la ai lut ha ka jingmane bleithaw .

en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?
kha: Balei te ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw ? Hato ba ngin ïap hangne bad la ki jingri ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei phi la wanrah ia ka jingiaseng U Trai sha kane ka ri khlaw , ba ngi bad ki masi jong ngi ngin iap hangta ?

en: And it came to pass after this , that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host , and went up , and besieged Samaria .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Benhadad u syiem ka Syria u la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei pyrshah ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane, u Benhadad u syiem Syria u la lum ia ki shipai jong u baroh, bad u la leit kiew bad u la ker kut ia ka Samaria .

en: And he said , Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant ? for what have I done ? or what evil is in mine hand ?
kha: Nangta u ong shuh shuh ,  Balei keiñ , syiem kynrad , ba phi thwet ïa u shakri jong phi ? Nga la leh aïu keiñ ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Balei u kynrad jong nga u bud ia u shakri jong u ? namar nga la leh aiu ? lane kaei kaba sniew ha ka kti jong nga ?

en: Then Baruch answered them , He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth , and I wrote them with ink in the book .
kha: U Barukh u la jubab ,  U Jeremaïah u la ong ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ha nga , bad nga la thoh ïa ka da ka sia ha kane ka kot kli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Baruk u la jubab ia ki , U la pynpaw ia kine ki ktien baroh ha nga da ka shyntur jong u , bad nga la thoh ia ki da ka ink ha ka kot .

en: And he said , If the  Lord  do not help thee , whence shall I help thee ? out of the barnfloor , or out of the winepress ?
kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Lada U  Trai  um ïarap ïa pha , Kaei ka jingïarap nga lah ban ai ? Hato nga don kew ei ei lane ka waiñ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Lada U Trai um iarap ia me , nangno ngan iarap ia me ? na ka phyllaw ne na ka phyllaw wain ?

en: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpah , and pursued the Philistines , and smote them , until they came under Beth–car .
kha: Ki Israel ki mih na Mispah bad ki beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , bad ki pynïap ïa ki lynter lynti haduh Bethkar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la mih na Mizpah bad ki la beh ia ki Philistia bad ki la shoh ia ki haduh ba ki la poi hapoh ka Bethar .

en: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .
kha: Kine khathynriew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Silpah ïa kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Silpah, kiba u Laban u la ai ha ka khun jong u, bad kine ki la kha ha u Jakob, wat shiphew ngut ki mynsiem .

en: And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .
kha: Hadien ba nga la poi , ngan sa ai ïa ki shithi jingpynithuh sha kito kiba phi la mynjur , bad ban phah ïa ki ban leit rah ïa ka jingai jong phi sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda nga la wan , ia uno uno uba phin mynjur da ki shithi jong phi , ngan phah ia ki ban wanrah ia ka jingaiei jong phi sha Jerusalem .

en: No new powers have been conferred to any of the security or law enforcement agencies by the S . O . dated 20 . 12 . 2018 .
kha: Ym shym la ai bor thymmai ia kino kino ki bor pahara ne ki bor pynjari ain da ka S . O . ka tarik 20 . 12 . 2018 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym shym la ai bor thymmai ia kino kino ki tnad pahara ne ki tnad pynjari ain da ka S . O . ka tarik 20 . 12 . 2018 .

en: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon , from all kings of the earth , which had heard of his wisdom .
kha: Ki syiem ha kylleng ka pyrthei ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingstad jong u bad ki la phah briew ban sngap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la wan na ki briew baroh ban iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong u Solomon, na ki syiem baroh jong ka khyndew kiba la iohsngew ia ka jingstad jong u .

en: And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord  ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .
kha: Nga long ka shakri jong U Trai ,  ka Mari ka la ong ,  ai kan long ha nga kumba me la ong .  Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Maria ka la ong: Ha khmih ka kti jong U Trai; to long ha nga kat kum ka ktien jong me . Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .

en: They care for the important but often routine organizational and physical tasks that must be handled in the congregation .
kha: Ki peit ïa ki kam ba donkam ba dei ban leh man la ka por ha ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sumar ia ki kam kiba kongsan hynrei bunsien ki long kiba ju long ha ka seng bad ha ka met kiba dei ban pyniaid ha ka balang .

en: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy , ) neither wist they what to answer him .
kha: Nangta u la wan pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ba ki ïohthiah ; kim shym la lah ban khyllie ïa la ki khmat . Bad kim shym la tip ïa kaei ban ong ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan phai, u la shem ia ki ba ki la iohthiah biang, (namar ki khmat jong ki ki la khia , ) ym shym la sngewthuh ia kaei kaba ki dei ban jubab ia u .

en: For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .
kha: naba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi bishar ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ka jingbishar kaba phi bishar, phin sa shah bishar: bad da ka jingthew kaba phi thew , yn sa thew biang ia ka ha phi .

en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .
kha: Ka sngi ka jingpynshitom ka la wan , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Israel , kane kan jia da shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim kan long kaba la jot ha ka sngi ba la pynrem: hapdeng ki jait Israel nga la pyntip ia kata kaba thikna .

en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord , who hath enabled me , for that he counted me faithful , putting me into the ministry ;
kha: Nga ai ïa ka jingnguh sha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba la ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhlaiñ na ka bynta ka kam jong nga . Nga ainguh ïa u ba la ñiew ïa nga uba bit bad la thung ïa nga ban shakri ïa u , wat la ha ka por ba la leit noh nga la kren sniew ïa u bad pynshitom beiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ainguh ia U Khrist Jisu U Trai jong ngi uba la pynlah ia nga, namar ba u la khein ia nga uba iaineh, da kaba buh ia nga ha ka jingshakri ; .

en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la batai ha ki ïa kaei kaba la ong shaphang jong u hi ha baroh ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , da kaba sdang da ki kitab u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sdang na u Moses bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh , u la batai ha ki ha ki jingthoh baroh ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad lade .

en: And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
kha: Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translated_en_to_kha: U sohjew u la ong ha ki: Hato nga dei ban iehnoh ia ka wain jong nga kaba pynkmen ia U Blei bad u briew bad leit sha ki dieng ?

en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
kha: U Paul u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan ha ki ; ki la kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna ruh ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la buh ia ki kti jong u halor jong ki, u Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan ha ki ; bad ki la kren da ki thylliej bad ki la iathuhlypa .

en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , in whose sight I brought them out .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la leh na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ba kan ym shah pynjakhlia ha khmat ki nongwei, ha kiba nga la pynmih ia ki shabar .

en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka jinghikai ba phi ai pateng sha kiwei pat ka pynduh noh ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Bad don bun kiwei kiei kiei kum kane kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynlong ia ka ktien U Blei kaba ym don jingktah lyngba ka dustur jong phi, kaba phi la pynpoi: bad bun kiei kiei kiba kum kita ki leh ia phi .

en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the  Lord   ; and they shall be afraid of thee .
kha: Te ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei kin ïohi ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa phi ban long ki briew jong u , bad kin sheptieng ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew kin iohi ba la khot ia me da ka kyrteng U Trai ; bad kin tieng ia me .

en: And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .
kha: Ki buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khnai bad ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka synduk U Trai halor ka kali , bad ka synduk da ki miaw ksiar bad ki dur jong ki jingmih jong ki .

en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple , Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately ,
kha: U Jisu u dang shong halor u lum ki Olib , pyrshah ïa ka Templ , mynba u Petros , u Jakob , u Ïoannis bad u Andriw ki la wan jar jar ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang shong halor u lum jong ki Olives sha jrong pyrshah ia ka tempi , u Petros bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis bad u Andrei ki la kylli ia u marwei , .

en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean  ; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even .
kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba u briew u bymkhuid u ktah ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa kata u long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba u briew u bymkhuid u ktah kan long kaba khlem khuid; bad ka mynsiem kaba ktah ia ka kan long kaba khlem khuid haduh ka por janmiet .

en: But Amnon had a friend , whose name was Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother : and Jonadab was a very subtil man .
kha: Hynrei u Amnon u don uwei u paralok uba shalak bha , uba kyrteng u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Amnon u don u paralok uba kyrteng u Jonadab, u khun u hynmen u Dabid: bad u Jonadab u long u briew uba rit bha .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy , and I was jealous for her with great fury .
kha: Nga la angnud ban ïarap ïa ka Jerusalem namar ka jingieit bajylliew jong nga ïa ki briew jong ka , ka jingieit kaba la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar ïa ki nongshun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid; nga la sngewsih ia ka Seion da ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw , bad nga la sngewsih ia ka da ka jingbitar kaba khraw .

en: And it came to pass , as they sat at the table , that the word of the  Lord  came unto the prophet that brought him back :
kha: Katba ki dang ïashong bam ha ka miej , ka ktien U  Trai  ka wan ha u nongïathuhlypa tymmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang shong ha ka miej , ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u nongiathuhlypa uba la wanrah biang ia u:

en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .
kha: Kane ka dei kumno U Blei Badonbor Baroh u pynshitom ïa ki bymman , ki briew kiba lehbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka bynta jong u briew uba sniew bad U Blei , bad ka pateng jong ki nongpynshitom bein , kaba kin ioh na Uba donbor baroh .

en: So he fled with all that he had  ; and he rose up , and passed over the river , and set his face toward the mount Gilead .
kha: U la kit lut kat ïa kaba u don bad u phet noh kyrkieh . U la jam ïa ka wah Ïuphratis , bad u leit kiew sha ki phang ka ri lum Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la phet noh bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u don; bad u la ieng sha jrong ka wah bad u la buh ia la ka khmat sha u lum Gilead .

en: But exhort one another daily , while it is called To day  ; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin .
kha: Pynban , khnang ba ym don uwei na phi u ban shah shukor ha ka pop bad eh dohnud ; phi dei ban ïarap iwei ïa iwei pat ha la ka sngi , katba ka ktien  Mynta  ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ia kyntu iwei ia iwei pat man ka sngi , katba la khot ia ka To sngi shuwa ba uno uno na phi un shah pynkhlain lyngba ka jingleh thok jong ka pop .

en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :
kha: Naba naduh ba ngi la long kawei bad u ha ka jingïap kum ma u , ha kajuh ka rukom ngin ïalong kawei bad u ha ka jingmihpat kum ma u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ngi la shah thung lang ha ka jingiasyriem jong ka jingiap jong u:

en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears , ye do always resist the Holy Ghost : as your fathers did , so do ye .
kha: A katno phi long kiba eh ryndang !  u Stephan u bteng ban kren .  A katno ki dohnud jong phi ki long kum kiba mane blei thala , katno phi leh kyllut ïa ka khubor jong U Blei ! Phi long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi : Phi ruh phi la ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid !
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la sngewsih bad khlem da shah pynkhuid ha ka dohnud bad ki shkor , phi ju pyrshah ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid: kumba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh , kumta phi ruh phi leh .

en: Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
kha: Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine baroh ar long kito ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , u kham bha ban ia ki baroh arngut ki bym pat ju long , ki bym pat ju iohi ia ka kam kaba sniew kaba la leh hapoh ka sngi .

en: He will keep the feet of his saints , and the wicked shall be silent in darkness  ; for by strength shall no man prevail .
kha: U ïada ïa ka jingim jong kito kiba shaniah ha u , hynrei kiba bymman kin shu jah lngaid ha ka jingdum ; u briew u jop ym da ka bor la jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Un bat ia ki kjat jong ki riewkhuid jong u, bad ki bymman kin sngap jar ha ka jingdum namar da ka bor un ym don mano mano ruh ban jop .

en: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush , and seize upon the city : for the  Lord  your God will deliver it into your hand .
kha: Nangta , phin wan mih na ka jakarieh bad kurup ïa ka nongbah . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin kiew na ka jaka ri jingri bad phin shim ia ka nongbah: namar U Trai U Blei jong phi un aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong phi .

en: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and began to speak with other tongues , as the Spirit gave them utterance .
kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban kren ha kiwei pat ki ktien , kat kumba U Mynsiem u pynlah ïa ki ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban kren da kiwei pat ki thylliej kumba U Mynsiem u la ai ha ki .

en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .
kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai , haduh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shapoh ka phyllaw bad u la shong lem bad ki nongap byndi ban khmih kumno kan jia baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la bud ia u sha ka iing jong u rangbah lyngdoh, bad u la leit rung bad u la shong bad ki shakri ban iohi ia ka jingkut .

en: But now , O  Lord  , thou art our father  ; we are the clay , and thou our potter  ; and we all are the work of thy hand .
kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me long u Kpa jong ngi . Ngi long kum ka dewbyrtha , bad me long kum u nongthaw khiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ko Trai, me long u kpa jong ngi ; ngi long ka dewbilat, bad me u nongtied jong ngi ; bad ngi baroh ngi long ka kam ka kti jong me .

en: As a result of BCLs exclusive control over the university for last eight years , there is no place for dissent on campus .
kha: Kum ka jingmih na ka jingsynshar kyrpang jong ki BCL halor ka skulbah ha kine ki 8 snem ba la leit noh , ym don jaka ban ia pyrshah ha ka jaka pule .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka jingmih jong ka jingsynshar ba kyrpang jong ki BCL halor ka skulbah ha ki 8 snem ba la dep , ym don jaka na ka bynta ka jingbym iahap ha ka campus .

en: Lest ye corrupt yourselves , and make you a graven image , the similitude of any figure , the likeness of male or female ,
kha: Te , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi , sumar ba phin ym leh pop da kaba thaw na ka bynta ïa lade kano kano ka durblei — la ka long ka dur u briew lane ka briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynsniew ia lade , bad pynlong ia phi ia ka dur ba la ker , ka jingiasyriem jong kano kano ka dur , ka jingiasyriem jong u shynrang ne kynthei .

en: And if he smite out his manservant s tooth , or his maidservant s tooth  ; he shall let him go free for his tooth s sake .
kha: Lada u lop ïa ka bniat jong u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka bniat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u pynkhih ia ki bniat jong u, ne ki bniat jong u; un pyllait noh ia u na ka bynta ki bniat jong u .

en: When I am the driver , my foot is on the accelerator , and the car is moving at a certain pace but it cannot run forever .
kha: Haba nga dei u nongniah , ka kjat jong nga ka don halor ka accelerator , bad ka kali ka iaid ha ka jingstet kaba la buh hynrei kam lah ban iaid junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga long u nongniah kali , ka kjat jong nga ka don ha ka jingpynstet , bad ka kali ka iaid katkum ka jingstet hynrei kam lah ban iaid junom .

en: For as the heavens are higher than the earth , so are my ways higher than your ways , and my thoughts than your thoughts .
kha: Kumba ki bneng ki long kham shajrong ïa ka pyrthei , kumta ruh ki long ki lynti jong nga bad ki jingpyrkhat jong nga kham shajrong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ki bneng ki kham jrong ban ia ka khyndew , kumta ki lynti jong nga ki kham jrong ban ia ki lynti jong phi , bad ki jingpyrkhat jong nga ki kham jrong ban ia ki jingpyrkhat jong phi .

en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Kaei ba ngin ong ? Lada ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia pyrkhat bad ki hi da kaba ong: Lada ngin ong , Na bneng ; un ong , Balei te phim ngeit ia u ?

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Uno uno uba sdang ban lur bad nangta uba ïai kyrtiang dien um long uba myntoi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Ym don uwei ruh u briew uba la buh ia la ka kti ha ka lyngkha bad uba peit shadien .

en: For kings , and for all that are in authority ; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty .
kha: Na bynta ki Syiem , na bynta baroh ki ba don ha bor shynshar , ba ngi lah ban im ka jingim kaba jar jar bad kaba suk ha ka jingtiengburom baroh sha U Blei bad da ka jinglong jingim kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki syiem , bad na ka bynta baroh kiba don ha ka bor ; ba ngin ialam ia ka jingim kaba sngap jar bad kaba suk ha ka jinglong blei bad ka jinglong hok baroh .

en: Gomer , and all his bands  ; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters , and all his bands : and many people with thee .
kha: Baroh ki riewïaleh na ki ri jong ka Gomer bad Beth Togarmah na shaphang shatei ki don bad u , bad kumta ruh ki rangbah na shibun kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gomer , bad ki kynhun jong u baroh ki la leit sha ka iing u Togarmah jong ki bynta ba shathie , bad ki kynhun jong u baroh: bad bun ki briew bad me .
