en: And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .
kha: U la batai ,  Ko Daniel , nga la wan hangne ban ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka jingïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyntip ia nga , bad u la iakren bad nga, bad u la ong, ko Daniel, nga wan mynta ban ai ia me ia ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang .

en: Nor consider that it is expedient for us , that one man should die for the people , and that the whole nation perish not .
kha: Hato phim sngewthuh ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban shah ba uwei u briew un ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew , ban ïa kaba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka jot noh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ia ngi, ba uwei u briew un iap na ka bynta ki briew , bad ba ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei kan ym jah noh .

en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
kha: Ha ka , la don baroh ki jait mrad , ki kynja bapar bad ki sim khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki mrad ba im saw kjat jong ka khyndew bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki mrad ba her bad ki sim jong ka Iyer .

en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have set a fire in Egypt , and when all her helpers shall be destroyed .
kha: Haba nga tbeh ding ha ka Ijipt bad ïa ki nongkyrshan jong ka baroh yn pynïap , te ki tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai haba nga la thang ding ha Ijipt bad haba ki nongiarap jong ka baroh kin shah pynjot .

en: And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .
kha: Hadien ka jingong ïa kane , la shim noh ïa u sha bneng katba ki dang khmih ïa u , bad u lyoh u la buhrieh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ia kine kiei kiei katba ki dang iohi ia u, la shim ia u ; bad u lyoh u la pdiang ia u na ka jingpeit jong ki .

en: Thou , O king , art a king of kings : for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom , power , and strength , and glory .
kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long uba khraw tam na ki syiem baroh . U Blei ka bneng u la pynlong ïa phi u patsha bad u la ai ha phi ka bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko syiem, me long u syiem jong ki syiem: namar U Blei jong ka bneng u la ai ha me ia ka hima, ka bor bad ka burom .

en: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) It is good to find a quiet place away from other people to say our personal prayers .—Mark 1 :35 .
kha: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) Kan kham bha lada ngi duwai ha ki jaka ba kynjah ha kaba ym don ba pynwit ïa ngi .—Markos 1 :35 .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) Ka long kaba bha ban shem ia ka jaka kaba sngap jar na kiwei pat ki briew ban ong ia ki jingduwai shimet jong ngi . Mark 1:35.

en: Peoples perception of honesty has more to do with what they can get away with legally than with what is actually the truth
kha: Ka jingsngewthuh jong ki briew shaphang ka jinglong hok ka kham iadei bad kaei kaba ki lah ban ioh lait na ka ain ban ia kaei kaba long ha ka jingshisha ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsngewthuh jong ki briew shaphang ka jinglong hok ka kham iadei bad kaei kaba ki lah ban phet krad katkum ka ain ban ia kaei kaba ha ka jingshisha ka long ka jingshisha .

en: At the time appointed he shall return , and come toward the south  ; but it shall not be as the former , or as the latter .
kha: Hadien katto katne un hiarthma pat ïa ka Ijipt , hynrei ha kane ka por kiei kiei kin kylla long da kumwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba la buh un wan phai noh shaphang shathie ; hynrei kan ym long kum kaba nyngkong ne kum kaba hadien .

en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt : but I wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad nga , pynban , ki pynsheptieng ïa ki briew jong ngi . Hynrei nga , nga la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki hynmen jong nga kiba la leit shaneng bad nga ki la pynlong ia ka dohnud jong ki briew ban rkhiang: hynrei nga la bud pura ia U Trai U Blei jong nga .

en: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her , My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee , that it may be well with thee ?
kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Ruth ,  Nga dei ban shem u tnga na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ba phin don la ka jong ka longïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka Naomi ka kmie jong ka ka la ong ha ka, ko khun jong nga, hato ngan ym wad jingjahthait na ka bynta jong me, ba kan long kaba bha bad me ?

en: The grave  ; and the barren womb  ; the earth that is not filled with water  ; and the fire that saith not , It is enough .
kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka kynthei kaba khlem khun , ka khyndew rkhiang kaba donkam slap , bad ka ding kaba meh bym lah ban tem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtep ; bad ka kpoh kaba rkhiang ; ka khyndew kaba ym dap da ka um ; bad ka ding kaba ong ba kam pat biang .

en: And the mean man shall be brought down , and the mighty man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled :
kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynjahburom , bad ïa baroh kiba sarong yn pynrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia u briew uba rit yn pynhiar mynsiem, bad u briew uba khlain bor un shah pynrit mynsiem, bad ki khmat jong kiba jrong kin shah pynrit mynsiem:

en: So when his fellowservants saw what was done , they were very sorry , and came and told unto their lord all that was done .
kha: Haba kiwei pat ki shakri ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , ki la sngewsih shikatdei eh , bad ki la leit sha u Syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki para shakri jong u ki la iohi ia kaei kaba la leh , ki la sngewsih shibun , bad ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ha u kynrad jong ki ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh .

en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee , O Israel : and because I will do this unto thee , prepare to meet thy God , O Israel .
kha: Kumta te , ko ki paid Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa phi . Bad namar ba ngan leh ïa kane , to pynkhreh ban mad ïa ka jingbishar jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta ngan leh ia me ko Israel: bad namar ba ngan leh ia kane ha me, pynkhreh ban iakynduh ia U Blei jong me ko Israel .

en: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .
kha: Ka um ka la tap bad ka set mynsiem ïa nga ; ka duriaw ka la tap lup ïa nga , bad ki phlang duriaw ki la sop baroh sawdong ïa ka khlieh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki la ker sawdong ia nga, wat haduh ka mynsiem: ka jingjylliew ka la khang ia nga sawdong sawdong, ki khniang ki la tap ia ka khlieh jong nga .

en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .
kha: Ym don pat batip , lano kata ka sngi lane ka kynta kin wan — lymne wat ki angel ha bneng , lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa u tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na kata ka sngi bad kata ka por ym don ba tip, em, ym ki angel kiba don ha bneng, lymne U Khun hynrei U Kpa .

en: For they went and served other gods , and worshipped them , gods whom they knew not , and whom he had not given unto them :
kha: Ki la shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei ba kim ju mane mynno mynno , bad ïa kiba U  Trai  u la adong ïa ki ban mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leit bad ki la shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, bad ki la mane ia ki, ki blei kiba kim tip bad kiba um shym la ai ha ki:

en: And Barak said unto her , If thou wilt go with me , then I will go : but if thou wilt not go with me , then I will not go .
kha: U Barak u jubab ,  Ngan leit lada phin leit ryngkat bad nga ; hynrei lada phim leit bad nga , nga ruh ngan ym leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Barak u la ong ha ka, "Lada phi leit bad nga, te ngan leit: hynrei lada phim leit bad nga, te ngan ym leit .

en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .
kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha u Elijah ; u la pynskhem ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka syngkai jong u bad u mareh ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da poi ha Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti U Trai ka la don ha u Elijah ; bad u la pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong u, bad u la mareh ha khmat u Ahab haduh ka jingkhang jong u Jesel .

en: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house .
kha: U Hesekaïah u phah sha u baroh ka rupa na ka Templ bad na ka jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la ai ia u ia ka rupa baroh kaba la shem ha ka iing U Trai bad ha ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing syiem .

en: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom : for he was comforted concerning Amnon , seeing he was dead .
kha: hynrei haba u la sangeh ban pyrkhat ïa ka jingïap u Amnon , u la shlei da ka jingkynmaw ieit ïa u Absalom u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mynsiem u syiem Dabid ka la kwah eh ban leit sha u Absalom: namar u la shah pyntngen shaphang u Amnon haba u la iap .

en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .
kha: Nangta uta u briew u la thew ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei , kaba lam sha ka phyllaw bashabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw kaba shabar kaba peit shaphang shathie , u la thew ia ka jingjrong jong ka bad ka jingjylliew jong ka .

en: And I will put my spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes , and ye shall keep my judgments , and do them .
kha: Ngan buh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong phi bad ngan peit ba phi bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong phi , bad ngan pynlong ia phi ban iaid ha ki ain jong nga , bad phin sumar ia ki jingbishar jong nga bad leh ia ki .

en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?
kha: Nangta u Petros u la wan sha U Jisu bad u la kylli ,  Ko Trai , lada u hynmen u para jong nga u ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , haduh katno sien nga dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la wan sha u bad u la ong, ko Trai, katno sien u hynmen jong nga un leh pop pyrshah ia nga bad nga map ia u ? haduh hynriew sien ?

en: All things are lawful for me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but all things edify not .
kha: Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh ,  kumta ki ong . Kata ka long kaba shisha , hynrei ym kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba bha .  Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh  — hynrei ym baroh ka long kaba myntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba dei katkum ka ain na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei kiei kiei baroh kim long kiba donkam: kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba dei katkum ka ain na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei kiei kiei baroh kim long kiba donkam .

en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down , lay low , and bring to the ground , even to the dust .
kha: Un pynjot ïa ki kut jong ki Moab bad ïa ki kynroh bajrong jong ki bad pynhap ïa ki shapoh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kut kaba jrong jong ki kynroh jong me un pynhiar shapoh khyndew, wat haduh ka dewbilat .

en: And when she had done giving him drink , she said , I will draw water for thy camels also , until they have done drinking .
kha: Haba u la dep dih , ka ong ,  Ngan leit tong um sa ïa ki ut jong phi de bad to ai ba kin ïoh dih katba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ka la dep ban ai um ia u , ka la ong , Ngan sa theh um na ka bynta ki kulai jong me ruh , haduh ba kin da dep dih .

en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , being eighteen thousand men .
kha: U Dabid u la nang kham pawnam shuh shuh haba u la wan phai na kaba pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki nong Edom ha ka Them Mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ai kyrteng ia u haba u la wan phai na ka jingshah shoh jong ki Syria ha ka them ka umsoh , da kaba long shiphew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they were thy merchants : they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .
kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Gris , Tubal , bad ha Meshekh bad ïakylliang ïa ki mar na ka bynta ki mraw bad na ka bynta ki tiar rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Javan , u Tubal bad u Meshech jong me: ki la khaii ia ki briew bad ki tiar nar ha ka iew jong me .

en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light , and were afraid  ; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai , hynrei kim shym ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong uta uba kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iohi shisha ia ka jingshai, bad ki la tieng; hynrei kim shym la iohsngew ia ka sur jong uta uba kren ha nga .

en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .
kha: Ha ka jingbitar U Blei u la pyndkut ïa ki kti ki kjat jong nga ; u peit ïa nga da ka jingisih .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynsngewsih ia nga ha ka jingbitar jong u, uba shun ia nga: u sngap jar ia nga da ki bniat jong u ; u nongshun jong nga u pynkhih ia ki khmat jong u ha nga .

en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?
kha: Nga ong ha phi , un bishar ha ka liang jong ki bad un leh kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthei haba u wan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia phi ba un pynshitom kloi ia ki . Wat la katta ruh haba u Khun u briew un wan , hato un shem ia ka jingngeit ha ka khyndew ?

en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la leit lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Apollonia , bad ki la wan poi sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki la iaid lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Apollonia ki la poi ha Thessaloni ha kaba ka synagog jong ki Jiw:

en: For if he were on earth , he should not be a priest , seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law :
kha: Lada u don ha ka pyrthei , un ym long satia u lyngdoh , namar don ki lyngdoh kiba ai ïa ki jingainguh katba kum ka Hukum ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada u don ha ka khyndew , um dei ban long u lyngdoh , haba u iohi ba ki don ki lyngdoh kiba ai ia ki jingai sngewbha katkum ka hukum:

en: " If you look at the countries of the world and compare them with India , the outcome of human progress is tremendous . "
kha: " Lada phi peit ia ki ri jong ka pyrthei bad ia nujor ia ki bad ka ri India , ka jingmih jong ka jingkiew jong u briew ka long kaba khraw ."
translated_en_to_kha: " Lada phi peit ia ki ri jong ka pyrthei bad ianujor ia ki bad ka ri India , ka jingmih jong ka jingkiew jong u briew ka long kaba khraw ."

en: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly , who are of thee , to whom the reproach of it was a burden .
kha: kumba kmen ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .  U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynkut ïa ka jingbyrngem ïa ka jingtim bad weng noh ïa ka jinglehrain jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan lum ia kita kiba sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingiaseng kaba jem , kiba long na me , ha kiba ka jingshah lehbein jong ka ka la long ka jingkit .

en: But Benjamin , Joseph s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren  ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .
kha: hynrei u Jakob um shym phah ïa u Benjamin , u para trai jong u Joseph ba un leit lem bad ki , namar u sheptieng ïoh jia ei ei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Benjamin u hynmen u Joseph, u Jakob um shym la phah bad ki hynmen jong u ; namar u la ong , Ka jingleh bymman ka la jia ia u .

en: But call to remembrance the former days , in which , after ye were illuminated , ye endured a great fight of afflictions  ;
kha: To kynmaw kumno ka la long bad phi ha ka por mynshuwa . Ha kito ki sngi , hadien ba ka jingshai U Blei ka la tyngshaiñ ha phi , phi la shahshitom shibun kiei kiei , pynban phim shym la shahjop ha kata ka jingïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khot ban kynmaw ia ki sngi kiba mynshuwa, ha kaba, hadien ba la pynshai ia phi, phi la shah ia ka jingialeh kaba khraw jong ki jingjynjar ; .

en: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .
kha: Nga la leh pop da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew uba lui lui ban ïap !  u la ong .  Kan ïadei aïu kata bad ngi ?  ki la jubab .  Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , nga la leh pop ha kaba nga la pyndem ia ka snam kaba khlem pop . Bad ki la ong , Kaei kata ha ngi ? me peit ia kata .

en: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her , and said , Bring me , I pray thee , a morsel of bread in thine hand .
kha: Katba ka dang leit shim ïa ka , u la ong ,  Bad sngewbha wanrah de khyndiat u kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ka dang leit ban leit shim ia ka, u la khot ia ka bad u la ong: To wanrah ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ka jingbam ha ka kti jong me .

en: And his men that were with him did David bring up , every man with his household : and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron .
kha: U la ïalam ruh ïa la ki briew bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , bad ki la shongduh ha ki nongrit sawdong ïa ka Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong u kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la wanrah ia u Dabid, uwei pa uwei bad ka iing jong u: bad ki la shong ha ki shnong Hebron .

en: Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
kha: Ki briew kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba shukor , mynta ki dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki . U Blei un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong ki ka la phiah ; mynta kin sa shah lap ba ki long kiba bakla: un pynpra ia ki nongleh jong ki , un pynsniew ia ki dur jong ki .

en: That we also may be like all the nations  ; and that our king may judge us , and go out before us , and fight our battles .
kha: khnang ba ngin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ba u syiem jong ngi hi un synshar ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi sha ka thma , bad un ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngi ruh ngin long kum ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad ba u syiem jong ngi un bishar ia ngi, bad un leit shabar ha khmat jong ngi, bad un ialeh ia ki thma jong ngi .

en: Which , when it was full , they drew to shore , and sat down , and gathered the good into vessels , but cast the bad away .
kha: Haba ka jar ka la dap , ki la tan ïa ka sharud duriaw bad ki la ïashong ban pynbynta ïa ki dohkha : ïa kiba bha sha ki jingdiang jong ki , bad ïa ki bymmyntoi la bret noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba, haba ka la dap, ki la leit sha rud duriaw, bad ki la shong, bad ki la lum ia kaba bha ha ki lieng, hynrei ki la bret noh ia kaba sniew .

en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I am not learned .
kha: Lada phi ai ïa ka ha uno uno u bym lah ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un jubab ba um tip kumno ban pule .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynpoi ia ka kot ha uta u bym nang, da kaba ong: Pule ia kane, nga duwai ia me: bad u ong: Ngam shym la nang .

en: And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
kha: Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga thikna ba une u briew uba wan bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u tnga jong ka , Ha khmih mynta , nga sngewthuh ba une u long u briew uba khuid jong U Blei uba iaid lyngba jong ngi man ka por .

en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses , saying , Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth .
kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki ong ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba phi hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Gad bad ki khun Reuben ki la kren ha u Moses da kaba ong: Ki shakri jong me kin leh kumba u kynrad jong nga u hukum .

en: Then said Jesus ,  Father , forgive them  ; for they know not what they do .  And they parted his raiment , and cast lots .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Pa , to map ïa ki ! Kim tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .  Ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki hi da kaba kynting sbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong: Ko Kpa, map ia ki ; namar kim tip ia kaei kaba ki leh . Bad ki la iakhlad noh ia ka jainkup jong u, bad ki la thep vote .

en: Judge not , and ye shall not be judged : condemn not , and ye shall not be condemned : forgive , and ye shall be forgiven :
kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ; wat pynrem ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un ym pynrem ïa phi ; map ïa kiwei , bad U Blei un map ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bishar , bad phin ym shah bishar: wat pynrem , bad phin ym shah pynrem: map , bad phin shah map:

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which shall take it .
kha: Nga la ong ruh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan ai noh ïa ka nongbah ha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , bad kin kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ia kane ka shnong yn ai ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon u shipai , u ban shim ia ka .

en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Ïa kane baroh la kynthup ha ka dur pynkhreh kaba la thoh kat kum ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  da lade hi u la ai ha nga ban pyntrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh , u Dabid u la ong , U Trai u la pynlong ia nga ban sngewthuh da ka kti jong u halor jong nga , wat ia ki kam baroh jong kane ka rukom .

en: Still others feel that the total population will eventually level off , so there is no need to be overly excited about it .
kha: Kiwei pat ki sngew ba ka jingbun briew baroh kan sa hiar ha kaba kut , kumta ym donkam ban sngewkmen palat ia ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki sngew ba ka jingbun briew baroh kawei kan sa kiew noh ha kaba kut , kumta ym donkam ban sngewtynnad palat ia ka .

en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .
kha: U Abraham u la kynriah noh na Mamre sha ki bynta bashathie jong ka Kanaan bad u la shong la sah hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Shur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la leit noh nangta sha ka ri Sepngi, bad u la shong hapdeng u Kadesh bad u Shur bad u la sah ha Gerar .

en: So he used a serpent to tell Eve that if she ate the fruit from that tree , she would not die , but she would be like God .
kha: Te u la pyndonkam da u bsein ban kren ha ka Im ba lada ka bam ïa u soh na uta u dieng , kan ym ïap , hynrei kan long kum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la pyndonkam da u bsein ban iathuh ia ka Im ba lada ka bam ia u soh na uta u dieng , kan ym iap , hynrei kan long kum U Blei .

en: And he took the elders of the city , and thorns of the wilderness and briers , and with them he taught the men of Succoth .
kha: Nangta u shim ïa ki shiah bad ki dieng shiah na ka ri shyiap bad pyndonkam da ki ban pynshitom ïa ki nongïalam jong ka Sukkoth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki rangbah jong ka shnong bad ki khlaw bad ki khlaw , bad bad ki u la hikai ia ki briew jong ka Sucoth .

en: The sons of Shemaiah  ; Othni , and Rephael , and Obed , Elzabad , whose brethren were strong men , Elihu , and Semachiah .
kha: U Shemaïah , u khun nyngkong jong u Obed Edom , u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Othni , u Rephael , u Obed , u Elsabad , u Elihu , bad u Semakhaïah . Ki dei ki rangbah kiba donkam ha ka kur jong ki namar ka jingtbit palat jong ki ; ki ar ngut kiba khatduh , ki long kiba don ka sap bakyrpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shemaiah ; u Othni, bad u Rephael, bad u Obed, u Elzabad, kiba ki hynmen jong ki ki long kiba khlain bor, u Elihu bad u Semaya .

en: And it shall come to pass , that every soul , which will not hear that prophet , shall be destroyed from among the people .
kha: Uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa uta u nongïathuhlypa un shah pynkhlad na ki briew jong U Blei bad un shah pynjot .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kaba ym iohsngew ia uta u nongiathuhlypa kan shah pynjot na ki briew .

en: It seemed good unto us , being assembled with one accord , to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,
kha: Bad kumta ngi la ïakynduh lang bad baroh ngi la ïamynjur ban jied katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien bad phah ïa ki sha phi . Kin ïaleit bad ki paralok ba-ieit jong ngi : U Barnabas bad u Paul ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long kumba ka long kaba bha ia ngi, haba ngi la ialum lang da kawei ka jingiasngewthuh jingmut, ban phah ia ki briew kiba la jied sha phi ryngkat bad u Barnabas bad u Paul baieit jong ngi .

en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty , they prevented with their bread him that fled .
kha: to ai um ïa ki briew kiba sliang kiba wan sha phi . Phi ki briew jong ka ri Tema , to ai jingbam ïa ki nongphetwir .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Tema ki la wanrah um ha u uba sliang , ki la khanglad da u kpu jong ki ia uta uba la phet noh .

en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .
kha: Kane ka long ïa baroh , namar ym don ka jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U Blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u kyrkhu kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don jingiapher hapdeng u Jiw bad u Grik: namar u juh u Trai halor baroh u long uba riewspah ha baroh kiba khot ia u .

en: But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Dei ka jingbhasbun kaba nga kwah , ym ïa ka jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Lada phi la tip kaei ka jingmut jong kane , phin ym da la pynrem ïa ki briew ki bym shym shah pynrem ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi la tip ia kaei kaba kane ka mut , ngan sa isynei ym ban knia , phim shym la pynrem ia ki bym don pop .

en: So Joab blew a trumpet , and all the people stood still , and pursued after Israel no more , neither fought they any more .
kha: Nangta u Joab u put ïa ka turoi , kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban sangeh noh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel , bad kumta ka jingïaleh ka la sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joab u la pyrta, bad ki briew baroh ki la ieng shuh shuh, bad kim shym la bud shuh ia ki Israel, kim shym la ialeh ei ei shuh .

en: As keepers of a field , are they against her round about  ; because she hath been rebellious against me , saith the  Lord .
kha: bad yn kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem kumba ki rangbah ki ap phira ïa ka lyngkha , namar ki briew jong ka ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ki nongri ia ka lyngkha , ki long pyrshah ia ka sawdong jong ka ; namar ka la leh pyrshah ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: And they went every one straight forward : whither the spirit was to go , they went  ; and they turned not when they went .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u jingthaw u phai sha baroh saw tylli ki dong , bad kumta ka kynhun ka ïaid kat shaba ka kwah , khlem da hap phai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid beit beit: ha kaba u mynsiem u la leit noh, ki la leit ; bad kim shym la phai haba ki la leit .

en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;
kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki ; hynrei to ïai kynmaw aïu U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ki: hynrei to kynmaw bha ia kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la leh ha u Pharaoh bad ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei;

en: And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .
kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la khie joit ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la shim ïa ka jingthiah ha kaba u la thiah bad u la leit noh sha ïing , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng ha khmat jong ki, bad u la shim ia kata ha kaba u la thiah, bad u la leit noh sha la iing .

en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .
kha: Naba ym don khubor jingïathuhlypa kaba la ju wan tang na ka mon u briew , hynrei ki briew ki la long hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingiathuhlypa kam shym la wan ha ka por barim da ka mon u briew: hynrei ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei ki kren kumba ki la shah pynkhih da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: For they call themselves of the holy city , and stay themselves upon the God of Israel  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
kha: Bad pynban phi sngewsarong ban ong ba phi long ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah bakhuid bad ba phi shaniah ha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khot ia lade na ka nongbah bakhuid , bad ki sah ha U Blei jong ki Israel ; U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: He that feared the word of the  Lord  among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses :
kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la sheptieng namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren , bad ki wan ïalam noh kloi ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri shapoh ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la tieng ia ka ktien U Trai hapdeng ki shakri jong u Pharaoh u la pynlong ia ki shakri jong u bad ki masi jong u ban phet sha ki iing:

en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .
kha: To ngin sngewskhem , te , bad leit sha ka khet U Blei , ha kaba don ka jingaiei . Hangta ngin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei bad ngin shem ïa ka jingaiei ka ban ïarap ïa ngi ha ka por ba ngi donkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin wan shlur sha ka khet ka jingaiei, ba ngin ioh ia ka jingisynei bad wad ia ka jingaiei ban iarap ha ka por ba donkam .

en: Saying ,  The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men , and be crucified , and the third day rise again .
kha: ‘ Ïa U Khun U Briew dei ban aiti ha ki briew kiba pop , ba yn sahnarphna , bad hadien lai sngi un mihpat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , U Khun u briew u dei ban shah aiti ha ki kti jong ki briew kiba pop , bad shah sahnarphna , bad ka sngi kaba lai ka kiew biang .

en: Gather the pieces thereof into it , even every good piece , the thigh , and the shoulder  ; fill it with the choice bones .
kha: To thep ïa ki dkhot doh kiba kynsai tam — ki tyrpeng bad ki kjat — pyndap ïa u ruh da ki kyrkhoit shyieng ba la jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia ki bynta jong ka ha ka, wat ia kawei pa kawei ka bynta kaba bha, ka tyrpeng bad ka tyrpeng ki pyndap ia ka da ki shyieng ba la jied.

en: " We might not have got the opportunity to walk behind Bapu in freedom movement , but to walk on his path is our duty . "
kha: " Ngi lah ban nym ioh lad ban iaid hadien u Bapu ha ka jingiakhih laitluid , hynrei ban iaid ha ka lynti jong u ka dei ka kamram jong ngi . "
translated_en_to_kha: " Ngi lah ban ym ioh lad ban iaid shadien jong u Bapu ha ka jingkhih laitluid, hynrei ban iaid ha ka lynti jong u ka long ka kamram jong ngi ."

en: And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .
kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Khie mareh , bad tam ïa ki khnam kiba ngan sa siat .  Uta u mareh , bad u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u khynnah jong u, Run, wad mynta ia ki khnam kiba nga siat . Bad katba u khynnah u dang mareh , u la siat ia u khnam shadien jong u .

en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .
kha: U leh kumjuh ha ki nongbah bad ki jaka ba la ieh kynjah jong ki Manasseh , Ephraim , bad Simeon , bad jngai shaduh shatei haduh Naphtali .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh u la leh ha ki shnong Manasseh, bad Ephraim, bad u Simeon, wat haduh Naphtali, bad ki jingthiah jong ki sawdong .

en: Construction of an Alternate Disputes Resolution Centre at Pudukottai at an estimated cost of Rs . 1 . 00 Crore completed .
kha: Ka jingtei ia ka jaka pynbeit ia ki jingialeh pyrshah ha Pudukottai ha ka jinglut kaba la antad ba kan long Rs . 1 . 00 Klur la pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtei ia ka jaka pynbeit thymmai ha Pudukot ha ka jinglut kaba la antad haduh Rs. 1 . 00 Khyndew .

en: As it is written in the prophets , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
kha: Ka sdang kumba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la thoh :  U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong phi ban pynkhreh lynti na ka bynta jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh ha ki nongiathuhlypa , Ha khmih nga phah ia u nonglam khubor jong nga ha khmat jong me , u ban pynkhreh ia ka lynti jong me ha khmat jong me .

en: And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .
kha: Phi dei ban long kiba khuid ïa nga , namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga long uba khuid . Nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ba phin long ki jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin long kiba khuid ha nga: namar nga U Trai nga long uba khuid, bad nga la ot noh ia phi na kiwei pat ki briew, ba phin long ki jong nga .

en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me don hok aïu ban bitar ïa u jingthung ?  U Jonah u la jubab ,  Nga don ka hok baroh ban bitar — ban bitar eh ban ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Jonah, Hato phi dei ban bitar ia u sohjew ? Bad u la ong, Nga leh bha ban bitar, wat haduh ka jingiap .

en: And the smoke of the incense , which came with the prayers of the saints , ascended up before God out of the angel s hand .
kha: Ka tdem jong ka jingainguh thang ka la kiew shalor ryngkat lem bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei na ki kti u angel uba ïeng ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tdem jong ka jingiwbih kaba la wan ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki riewkhuid ka la kiew sha jrong ha khmat U Blei na ka kti jong u angel .

en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .
kha: namar u la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim , bad u la jan ïap na ka bynta ka kam U Khrist , khnang ba un ai ïa nga ka jingïarap , kaba ma phi da lade phim lah ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na ka bynta ka kam U Khrist u la jan iap, ym ha kaba iadei bad ka jingim jong u, ban pyndap ia ka jingbym shakri jong phi ia nga .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew bad u la pynngat ha ka ri jong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia kane ka ri , ban wanrah halor jong ka ia ki jingtim baroh kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot:

en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison , desirous to apprehend me :
kha: Haba nga la don ha Damaskos , u lyngskor hapoh u syiem Aretas u la pynap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ban kem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Damaskos u Lat hapoh u Areta u syiem u la bat ia ka nongbah jong ki nong Damasa da ka garrison , da ka jingkwah ban sngewthuh ia nga:

en: A voice of noise from the city , a voice from the temple , a voice of the  Lord  that rendereth recompence to his enemies .
kha: Ha sngap ! kata ka jingsawa kaba jam ha ka nongbah ! kata ka jingsawa ha ka Templ , ka long ka jingsawa U  Trai  uba pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka jingsawa na ka nongbah , ka sur na ka tempi , ka sur U Trai kaba pynphai biang ia ki nongshun jong u .

en: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .
kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynsah uwei ruh , bad nangta ki kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shoh ia u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki briew jong u baroh: bad ki la don ia ka ri jong u .

en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
kha: Ha kata hi ka kynta jong ka miet , u nongpeit phatok u la ïalam ïa ki bad u la sait ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lem bad ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki ha kajuh ka kynta miet, bad u la sait ia ki strip jong ki ; bad la pynbaptis ia u, ma u bad ia u baroh, beit beit .

en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .
kha: Hadien kane baroh , don tang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kane keiñ ba la thaw ïa u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin iohsngew ia ka jingpynkut jong ka kam baroh kawei: To sheptieng ia U Blei , bad to sumar ia ki hukum jong u: namar kane ka long ka kamram baroh kawei jong u briew .

en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God which raiseth the dead :
kha: Ngi la sngew kumba la rai pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap . Hynrei kane ka la jia khnang ba ngi dei ban shaniah , ym ha ngi hi , hynrei tang ha U Blei keiñ , uba pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi la don ka jingpynshitom iap ha lade, ba ngin ym shaniah ha lade, hynrei ha U Blei uba pynmih ia kiba iap:

en: And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .
kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u ksuid , u briew u la sdang ban kren , bad uwei uwei baroh u la lyngngoh ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi mynno mynno ruh kum kane ha Israel !  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la beh noh ia u ksuid, u la kren lyngngoh: bad ki paidbah ki la lyngngoh , ki da ong , Ym pat ju iohi ia ka kumta ha Israel .

en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing ? behold , the world is gone after him .
kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Phi ïohi , ngim shym lah leh ei ei ruh em ! Khmih , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ïabud ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ong hapdeng jong ki: Peit kumno phim jop ei ei ? ha khmih ka pyrthei ka la jah noh hadien jong u .

en: And the priest shall take cedar wood , and hyssop , and scarlet , and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer .
kha: Nangta , un shim katto katne ka dieng Kedar , u tnat Hissop , bad u tyllai uba rong saw bad un bret ïa ki ha ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia u dieng cedar, bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u bret ia ka hapdeng ka jingthang ia ka masi .

en: And he took about five thousand men , and set them to lie in ambush between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of the city .
kha: U shim kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah bad u buh ha kaba rieh ïa ki ha ka phang sepngi jong ka nongbah , hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim kumba san hajar ngut ki briew bad u la buh ia ki ban thiah hapdeng ka Bethel bad Ai, ha ka liang sepngi jong ka nongbah .

en: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter , Art not thou also one of this man s disciples ? He saith , I am not .
kha: Kata ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop ka la ong ha u Petros ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong utai u briew ?   Em , ngam dei ,  la jubab u Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ia ka dam kaba la buh ia ka jingkhang ha u Petros , Hato me ruh phim dei uwei na kine ki synran ? U ong , ngam dei .

en: And they set in it four rows of stones : the first row was a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this was the first row .
kha: Ki buh saw kyrdon ki mawkordor ha ka ; ïa u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la buh ha ka saw tylli ki lain maw: ka lain kaba nyngkong ka long ka sardius , ka topz bad ka carbuncle: kane ka la long ka lain kaba nyngkong .

en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .
kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u Boas u hukum ïa ki nongtrei ,  Shah ïa ka ban tam wat na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katto katne ki kew na ki song bad ieh ïa ki ba kan ïoh tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ngin hap ruh katto katne na ki kti jong ka jingthmu na ka bynta jong ka, bad iehnoh ia ki, ba kan lum ia ki, bad kan ym pynrem ia ka .

en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery , even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory :
kha: Ka jingstad kaba nga pynbna ka long ka jingstad barieh jong U Blei , ïa kaba la buhrieh na u bynriew , hynrei , ïa kaba u la jied lypa na ka bynta ka burom jong ngi wat ha shuwa ba yn pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi kren ia ka jingstad U Blei ha ka jingmaham, wat ia ka jingstad ba la buhrieh, kaba U Blei u la buh ha khmat ka pyrthei sha ka burom jong ngi:

en: And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite : and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad .
kha: ki Arbad , ki Semar , bad ki Hamath . Ki jait bapher bapher jong ki jait Kanaan ki la saphriang kylleng kylleng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Arvade , bad ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongshong shnong: bad hadien kata ki long ki longiing jong ki nongshong shnong ki la saphriang shabar ri .

en: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .
kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar ba la shah kyntait la tep shisha hangta , bad ka rupa ha trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor bad ki la mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad, ha khmih, ka la buhrieh ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u, bad ka rupa hapoh jong ka .

en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .
kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban wad dong ban pynshitom ïa U Jisu , namar ba u la leh ïa kane ka jingpynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namarkata ki Jiw ki la pynshitom bein ia U Jisu bad ki la wad ban pyniap ia u namar ba u la leh ia kine kiei kiei ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .
kha: To sharai , te , bad to kynmaw bad da ki ummat kiba bun , mynsngi bad mynmiet , nga la hikai ïa iwei pa iwei na phi haduh lai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to peit , bad kynmaw , ba ha ka por lai snem ngam shym la sangeh ban maham man la ka miet bad sngi da ki ummat .

en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up , and fought against Gath , and took it : and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem .
kha: Ha kata ka por u Hasael u syiem ka Syria u tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Gath bad u jop ïa ka ; nangta u rai ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hazael u syiem Syria u la kiew bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka Gath: bad u Hazael u la buh ia la ka khmat ban leit sha Jerusalem .

en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets , and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord .
kha: Te ïa ki samla shynrang jong ka yn pynïap ha ki surok bah jong ka nongbah , bad ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot ha kata ka sngi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki samla jong ka kin hap ha ki lynti iaid kjat , bad ki shipai jong ka baroh kin shah ot noh ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai .

en: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,
kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ko Trai , to peit ia ki jingbyrngem jong ki: bad to ai ha ki shakri jong me , ba da ka jingshlur baroh kin kren ia ka ktien jong me .

en: For , behold , the  Lord  commandeth , and he will smite the great house with breaches , and the little house with clefts .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u ai ïa ka hukum , ki ïing kiba rit bad kiba heh kin shah pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, U Trai u hukum, bad un pynkhih ia ka iing kaba khraw da ki jingpynkhein , bad ia ka iing kaba rit da ki thliew .

en: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man s table : moreover the dogs came and licked his sores .
kha: da ka jingkyrmen ban bam ïa ki lyngkhot jingbam kiba hap na ka miej jong u riewspah . Wat ki ksew ki ju wan bad jliah ïa ki prum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkwah ban shah ai bam da ki jingbam kiba la hap na ka miej jong u riewspah: nalor kata ki kulai ki la wan bad ki la lympat ia ki bniat jong u .

en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria : the planters shall plant , and shall eat them as common things .
kha: Sa shisien pat phin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ki lum ka Samaria , bad kito kiba thung ïa ki kin ïoh bam ïa kaei kaba ki bri sohwaiñ kin pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dang thung ia ki sohjew ha ki lum Samaria: ki jingthung kin thung bad kin bam ia ki kum kiei kiei kiba ju jia .

en: Phrygia , and Pamphylia , in Egypt , and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene , and strangers of Rome , Jews and proselytes ,
kha: na Phrygia bad na Pamphylia , na Ijipt bad na ki thain ka Libya hajan ka Kyrini . Katto katne ngut na ngi , ngi dei na Rom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Phrygia , bad ka Pamphylia , ha Ijipt bad ha ki bynta jong ka Libya shaphang ka Cyrene bad ki nongwei jong ka Rome , ki Jiw bad ki nongwei , .

en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the  Lord  , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in .
kha: U Jehoïada u buh ruh ki nongap phira ha ka kam ha ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ban khang ïa uno uno u bymkhuid kat kum ka niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki khyrdop ha ki khyrdop jong ka iing U Trai , ba ym don kawei ruh kaba khlem khuid ha kano kano ka kam .

en: And he made a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .
kha: Ki shna ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad la suh pynpur itynnat bha ha ka da ki dur ki Kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka jain kaba rong saw, bad kaba saw, bad kaba saw: da ki cherub u la pynlong ia ka da ka kam kaba jem .

en: Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .
kha: To bat ïa kaei kaba phi ngeit shaphang kane ka kam , hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei . Suk uta u briew u bym sngew ïa ka jingpynrem haba u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u bishar ba ka long kaba dei !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me ngeit ? to don ha lade ha khmat U Blei . Ka long kaba suk ia uta u bym pynrem ia lade ha kata kaei kaba u shah .

en: I will hear thee , said he , when thine accusers are also come . And he commanded him to be kept in Herod s judgment hall .
kha: u la ong ,  Ngan sa bishar ïa me ynda poi ki nongmudui jong me .  Nangta u la ai hukum ban buh ïa u Paul ha ka jingap phira hapoh ka jaka sah jong u lyngskor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iohsngew ia me, la ong ma u, haba ki nongmudui jong me ruh ki wan . Bad u la hukum ia u ban shah set ha ka jaka bishar jong u Herood .

en: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah , two years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Elah u khun jong u Baasha u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem ha Tirsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem arphew hynriew jong u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Elah u khun u Baasha ban synshar ia ki Israel ha Tirsah ar snem .

en: Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
kha: Ko Pharisi bamatlah ! To pynkhuid nyngkong ïa kaei kaba shapoh jong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !
translated_en_to_kha: Me Pharisi uba matlah, pynkhuid nyngkong ia kata kaba don hapoh ka khuri bad ka pliang, ba shabar jong ki ruh kin long kiba khuid .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Wherefore criest thou unto me ? speak unto the children of Israel , that they go forward :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Balei me kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap ? Ong ïa ki paidbah ba kin nang ïaid shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Balei me pyrta ia nga ? kren ia ki khun Israel ba ki iaid shakhmat:

en: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .
kha: Yn tynjuh ïa phi kumne : Nga smai ha ka kyrteng u syiem ba phin ym ïoh mihnoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan shane .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane phin sa shah pynshisha: Da ka jingim u Pharaoh phin ym leit noh kumta , lymda u hynmen barit jong phi u wan shane .

en: For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong , ‘ U Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad ki briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Amos u ong , u Jeroboan un iap da ka waitlam , bad ki Israel kin shah rah noh shisha na la ka jong ka ri .

en: When the morning was come , all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death :
kha: Dang step phyrngab , baroh ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la pynlong ki jingthmu jong ki pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la poi ka step , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ki briew ki la iamir jingmut pyrshah ia U Jisu ban pyniap ia u:

en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain : for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley :
kha: Ki Amor ki beh da ka bor ïa ki briew na ka jait Dan sha ka ri lum bad kim shah ïa ki ban wan hiar sha ri thor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Amorit ki la pynbor ia ki khun u Dan sha u lum : namar kin ym shah ia ki ban wan hiar sha ka them:

en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .
kha: Shisien ka por la don u syiem bad ka syiem , bad ki don u khun ba kyrteng u Sigurd uba khlain ba smat , bad ba bhabriew bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la don shisien u Syiem bad ka Mahadei , bad ki don u khun shynrang uba kyrteng u Sigurd , uba khlain bad uba trei shitom bha .

en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .
kha: Lehse nga long u bym da nang ban kren , hynrei da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingshem baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat la nga long uba khlem akor ha ka jingkren, hynrei ym ha ka jingtip ; hynrei ngi la paw bha hapdeng jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh .

en: And one of Joab s men stood by him , and said , He that favoureth Joab , and he that is for David , let him go after Joab .
kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Joab u la ïeng harud ka metïap jong u Amasa bad u pyrta ,  Uno uno uba ha ka liang jong u Joab bad u Dabid , to un bud ïa u Joab !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki briew jong u Joab u la ieng hajan jong u, bad u la ong, Uta uba sngewbha ia u Joab bad uta uba long na ka bynta u Dabid, to ai ba un leit bud ia u Joab .

en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet , and besought him , saying , Have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
kha: U para shakri jong u , u la dem khrup bad u la kyrpad ïa u , ‘ to ïaishah bad nga , bad ngan siew pat ïa phi !’
translated_en_to_kha: U para shakri jong u u la dem ha ki kjat jong u, bad u la kyrpad ia u, u da ong: To iaishah bad nga, bad ngan siew lut ia me .

en: Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?
kha: Nangta , ngi kylli ïa ki nongïalam jong ki ban ïathuh ïa ngi mano ba la ai bor ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngi la kylli ia kita ki rangbah , bad ngi la ong ha ki kumta , Mano ba hukum ia phi ban tei ia kane ka iing bad ban pynlong ia kine ki kynroh ?

en: And said unto them ,  Thus it is written , and thus it behoved Christ to suffer , and to rise from the dead the third day :
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap hadien lai sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki , Kumta la thoh ia U Khrist ban shah shitom bad ban mihpat na kiba iap ha ka sngi kaba lai:

en: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things : but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves .
kha: Kim shym la khmih bha ïa ki jinglehniam bakyntang ha ka Templ jong nga , hynrei pynban ki la buh da ki nongwei ban khmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim shym la bat ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong nga kaba khuid: hynrei phi la buh ia ki nongsumar jong nga ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga na ka bynta lade .

en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .
kha: Naba ym don uno uno ruh uba hok ha khmat U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ; kaei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long ban pynlong ïa u briew ban tip ba u la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata da ki kam jong ka hukum ym lah ban pynshisha ia ka doh ha khmat jong u: namar da ka hukum ka long ka jingtip ia ka pop .

en: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .
kha: U Simon u la ong ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,  Sngewbha duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba kawei ruh na kita kiei kiei kiba phi la kren kan ym jia ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Simon u la jubab bad u la ong: To duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga, ba ym don kawei ruh na kine kiei kiei kiba phi la kren ka wan ha nga .

en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead , they mourned for Aaron thirty days , even all the house of Israel .
kha: U paidlang baroh u la tip ba u Aaron u la ïap , bad ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jong u haduh u laiphew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka jingiaseng baroh ka la iohi ba u Aaron u la iap , ki la iam na ka bynta u Aaron laiphew sngi , wat ia ka iing Israel baroh kawei .

en: Through faith he kept the passover , and the sprinkling of blood , lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u ban pynskhem ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad hukum ban synreit ïa ka snam ha ki jingkhang , ba u Angel jong ka Jingïap un ym pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u la bat ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba iaid beit bad ka jingpynkhuid ia ka snam , ioh ba uta uba pynjot ia u khun nyngkong un ktah ia ki .

en: And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa u tar ïa ka jaiñ na ka khmat jong u , bad kumta hi u syiem u ithuh ïa u bad u long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyrkieh bad u la weng noh ia ka dewbilat na ka khmat jong u; bad u syiem Israel u la ithuh ia u ba u long na ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: The living , the living , he shall praise thee , as I do this day : the father to the children shall make known thy truth .
kha: Dei kiba im kiba ïaroh ïa me , kumba nga ïaroh ïa me mynta . Ki kpa ki ïathuh ïa la ki khun katno me long uba ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba im, uba im, un iaroh ia me kumba nga leh ha kane ka sngi: u kpa ha ki khun un pynpaw ia ka jingshisha jong me .

en: And they said , Thou hast saved our lives : let us find grace in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh s servants .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Phi la pyllait im ïa ngi ; phi la lehbha ïa ngi , bad ngi ruh ngin long ki mraw jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Me la pynim ia ka jingim jong ngi: to ngin shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat u kynrad jong nga , bad ngin long ki shakri jong u Pharaoh .

en: And Abimelech came unto the tower , and fought against it , and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire .
kha: Haba u Abimelekh u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa uta u mot , u la leit sha ka jingkhang bad thang ïa uta u mot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la wan sha ka tower bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka bad u la leit sha ka jingkhang jong ka tower ban thang ia ka da ka ding .

en: So he brought him into his house , and gave provender unto the asses : and they washed their feet , and did eat and drink .
kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki sha la ïing bad u ai bam ïa ki kada jong ki . Ki ruh ki ïasait ïa la ki kjat bad ki ïabam jingbam miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la wanrah ia u ha iing jong u, bad u la ai jingbam ia ki kada: bad ki la sait ia ki kjat jong ki, bad ki la bam bad dih .

en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
kha: U buh ha khmat eh ïa ki tnga kliar bad ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatduh ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki nongtrei bad ki khun jong ki ha khmat eh, bad ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka hadien kata, bad u Rakhel bad u Joseph ki la khanglad khamtam eh .

en: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of , knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;
kha: Hynrei ma me , to ïaineh ha ki jingshisha kiba me la ïoh jinghikai bad kiba me ngeit skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me iai bteng ha kiei kiei kiba me la nang bad me la sngewskhem, da kaba tip ia kiba me la nang ia ki ; .

en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
kha: Hato mem tip ?  U la kylli ïa nga .  Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel uba la kren bad nga u la jubab bad u la ong ha nga, Hato phim tip ia kine kiei kiei ? Bad nga la ong, Em, ko kynrad jong nga .

en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lada u ïohi ïa ka prum , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pyn-i ba ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un iohi ia ka doh kaba thymmai bad un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid: namar ka doh kaba thymmai ka long kaba khlem khuid: ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh .

en: Smite a scorner , and the simple will beware : and reprove one that hath understanding , and he will understand knowledge .
kha: Ïa ka jingsngewmeng dei ban pynshitom , khnang ba ki briew ki bym da sngewthuh bha kin ïoh jinghikai . Lada phi long uba stad , phin ïoh jinghikai haba pynbeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia u nonglehkai, bad uba suk un husiar: bad pynrem ia uta uba don ka jingsngewthuh , bad un sngewthuh ia ka jingtip .

en: And it came to pass , that , when Jesus was returned , the people gladly received him : for they were all waiting for him .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan phai sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar baroh ki la ïa-ap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba U Jisu u la wan phai, ki briew ki la pdiang sngewbha ia u: namar baroh ki la ap ia u .

en: So the spirit took me up , and brought me into the inner court  ; and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .
kha: U Mynsiem U  Trai  u la rah ïa nga sha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh jong ka phyllaw , ha kaba nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ la pyndap da ka burom U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u mynsiem u la shim ia nga shaneng, bad u la wanrah ia nga shapoh ka phyllaw kaba shapoh bad , ha khmih ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ia ka iing .

en: The river of Kishon swept them away , that ancient river , the river Kishon . O my soul , thou hast trodden down strength .
kha: Ka jingshlei um ha ka Kishon ka la rong noh ïa ki — Ka lat lat ka wah Kishon . Ngan nang ïaid , nang ïaid shaphrang , da ka jingkhlaiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wah Kishon ka la rong noh ia ki, kata ka wah hyndai, ka wah Kishon . Ko mynsiem jong nga, me la iaid shapoh ka bor .

en: He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .
kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab da kaba shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah :  Nga long ‘ ka sur jong uta uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïaid !’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Nga long ka sur jong uwei uba iam ha ka ri khlaw , To pynlong beit ia ka lynti U Trai kumba ong u nongiathuhlypa Isaiah .

en: And the king said unto Haman , The silver is given to thee , the people also , to do with them as it seemeth good to thee .
kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Ki briew bad ka pisa jong ki , ki long ki jong me ; leh katba me sngewkwah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Haman , Ia ka rupa la ai ha me, ki briew ruh, ban leh ia ki kumba ka paw bha ha me .

en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .
kha: Te u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang samla , u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , pynsangeh ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u khun u Nun u shakri u Moses uwei na ki samla jong u u la jubab bad u la ong: Ko kynrad jong nga u Moses, to khang ia ki .

en: And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
kha: Katba ki apostol ki mihnoh na ka Dorbar , ki la kmen , namar U Blei u la ñiew ïa ki , kiba bit ban shah ïa ka jahburom na ka bynta U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit noh na ka jingdon jong ka dorbar , da kaba kmen ba la khein ia ki ba ki long kiba bit ban shah pynjah burom na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And they journeyed from Oboth , and pitched at Iye–abarim , in the wilderness which is before Moab , toward the sunrising .
kha: Ynda ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki la sher dara ha ki nongrim ba la jot jong ka Abarim kaba ha ka ri khlaw , shaphang mihngi na ka ri Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid na Oboth, bad ki la iaid ha ka ri khlaw kaba don ha khmat u Moab, sha ka jingmih ka sngi .

en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem s house , and went out .
kha: Nangta ki la ïalam noh ruh ïa ka Dinah na ïing u Shekhem , bad ki ïaleit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyniap ia u Hamor bad u khun jong u da ka waitlam, bad ki la shim ia u Dinah na ka iing u Shehem bad ki la leit noh .

en: As for their rings , they were so high that they were dreadful  ; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four .
kha: Ïa ki rmiang jong ki shalyntem la tap da ki khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ki ryntieh jong ki , ki la long kiba jrong haduh katta katta ba ki la long kiba shyrkhei ; bad ki ryntieh jong ki ki la dap da ki khmat sawdong sawdong jong ki saw ngut .

en: And they went their way , and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met  ; and they loose him .
kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ki la shem ïa u khun kada ha ka lynti bah , ba la teh ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing . Katba ki dang law noh ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid lynti ia u khun masi ba la teh da ka jingkhang shabar ha ka jaka ba arliang ki iakynduh ; bad ki la pyllait ia u .

en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
kha: Me dei ban hikai ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba phin hikai ia ki khun Israel baroh ki ain kiba U Trai u la kren ha ki da ka kti u Moses .

en: He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .
kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit baïaineh ha uba u la jied , ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U long u tower jong ka jingpynim na ka bynta u syiem jong u: bad u pyni ia ka jingisynei ia u ba la pynsleh jong u, ha u Dabid bad ha u symbai jong u junom .

en: And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :
kha: Haba ki briew ki ïakajia , bad uwei u shoh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa uwei pat khlem da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynshitom ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki briew ki ialeh lang, bad uwei pat u shoh ia uwei pat da u maw, ne da ka kti jong u, bad um iap , hynrei u bat ia ka jingthiah jong u:

en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Kan ym khie pat lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka nongleh kam sniew jong ki Israel ka la hap shuh shuh: ka la shah iehnoh ha ka ri jong ka ; ym don mano mano ruh ban pynmih ia ka .

en: It is true that our sinful nature and the bad influence of Satans world are obstacles to our being tenderly compassionate .
kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ka jinglong pop jong ngi bad ka jingktah kaba sniew jong ka pyrthei u Soitan ki long ki jingkhanglad ia ngi ban long kiba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ka jinglong pop jong ngi bad ka jingktah kaba sniew jong u Soitan ki long ki jingkhanglad ia ka jinglong ba sngewrit jong ngi.

en: Now these are the generations of Ishmael , Abraham s son , whom Hagar the Egyptian , Sarah s handmaid , bare unto Abraham :
kha: U Ishmael , ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt kaba long ka mraw jong ka Sarah , ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki pateng jong u Ismael u khun u Abraham, uba u Hagar u nong Ijipt, u Sarah u la kha ia u Abraham:

en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Behold , we have forsaken all , and followed thee  ; what shall we have therefore ?
kha: Nangta u Petros u la kren ,  Ha khmih ,  u la ong ,  ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me . Ngin ïoh aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia u Petros bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih ngi la iehnoh lut ia me baroh bad ngi la bud ia me; kaei kaba ngin don namarkata ?

en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .
kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u kylli ïa la ki khun .  Balei phi shu ieh ïa uta u briew ? Khie leit khot ïa u ban ïabam bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki khun kynthei jong u, Bad u don shano ? balei ba phi la iehnoh ia uta u briew ? khot ia u, ba un bam kpu .

en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki , bad U Jisu u la sah hangta ar sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan sha u , ki la kyrpad ia u ba un sah bad ki: bad u la sah hangta ar sngi .

en: Then he found another man , and said , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man smote him , so that in smiting he wounded him .
kha: Nangta , une ujuh u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha uwei pat u briew bad u ong ,  Shoh ïa nga !  Une u briew u leh kumta : u shoh eh ïa u bad u pynmynsaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shem ia uwei pat u briew, bad u la ong, To sngap ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me . Bad uta u briew u la shoh ia u, haduh ba da kaba shoh u la pynmynsaw ia u .

en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .
kha: Un pynngat ha phi sa shisien ïa ki jingpang kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phi la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata un wanrah ha me ia ki jingpang baroh jong ka ri Ijipt , kiba me la tieng; bad kin sa bat ia me .

en: Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .
kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Harim bad u Hasshub , u khun jong u Pahath Moab , ki tei baroh ar tylli ki bynta kiba bud bad ïa u Mot shet kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Malhijah u khun u Harim bad u Hashub u khun u Pahathmoab u la pynbha ia kawei pat ka bynta bad ka tower jong ki thliew .

en: And the multitude rose up together against them : and the magistrates rent off their clothes , and commanded to beat them .
kha: Bad u paidbah u la ïasoh lang ha kaba tur pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Silas . Ki rangbah synshar ki la tar ïa ki jaiñ jong u Paul bad u Silas , bad ki la ai hukum ban sympat ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah u la ieng lang pyrshah ia ki: bad ki majistor ki la weng noh ia ki jain jong ki , bad ki la hukum ban shoh ia ki .

en: And being let go , they went to their own company , and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them .
kha: Mar ïapyllait , u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis ki la leit phai sha la ka kynhun bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: La pyllait noh ia ki, ki la leit sha la ka jong ka kynhun bad ki la iathuh lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah ki la iathuh ha ki .

en: Yet now , if thou wilt forgive their sin―  ; and if not , blot me , I pray thee , out of thy book which thou hast written .
kha: To map ïa ka pop jong ki ; hynrei lada men ym map , nga kyrpad ba men weng noh ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na kata ka kitab ha kaba me la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong u paidlang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta lada me map ia ka pop jong ki― ; bad lada ym dei ban pynkhih ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, na ka kot jong me kaba me la thoh .

en: So they took the money , and did as they were taught : and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day .
kha: Ki nongap phira ki la shim ïa ka pisa bad ki la leh ïa kaei kaba la bthah ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta , kata ka long ka jingïathuh kaba la pynsaphriang kylleng da ki Jiw haduh kane hi ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shim ia ka pisa , bad ki la leh kumba la hikai ia ki: bad ia kane ka jingong la ju iathuh hapdeng ki Jiw haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And he brought the other ram , the ram of consecration : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
kha: Nangta u Moses u wanlam ïa u langbrot uba ar uba long na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki lyngdoh , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia uwei pat u langbrot: bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u langbrot .

en: And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .
kha: Nga la buh ka por ïa ka ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki briew jong ka Anathoth , bad haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym don mano mano ruh na ki u ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym don shuh na ki: namar ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha ki briew jong ka Anathoth, wat ha ka snem jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki .

en: Woe be unto thee , O Moab ! the people of Chemosh perisheth : for thy sons are taken captives , and thy daughters captives .
kha: Isynei ïa ki briew ka Moab ! Ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Khemosh la pynjot , bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei la ïalam noh kum ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: To long ha me, ko Moab ! ki briew jong u Khemosh ki jah noh: namar ki khun shynrang jong me ki shah kem mraw bad ki khun kynthei jong me ki shah kem mraw .

en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .
kha: Buh ïa ki mawlyngkniap hapoh ka synduk , bad ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ia ka jaka shong jingisynei halor ka synduk ; bad ha ka synduk me dei ban buh ia ka jingphla ba ngan ai ha me .

en: That the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation  ;
kha: Kumta ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la shah pynïap naduh ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka snam jong ki nongiathuhlypa baroh , kaba la pynmih na ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei , ka lah ban long kaba donkam na kane ka pateng;

en: And when he was in affliction , he besought the  Lord  his God , and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers ,
kha: Ha ka jingshitom jong u , u la pynrit ïa lade , u phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , bad u kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la don ha ka jingjynjar , u la kyrpad ia U Trai U Blei jong u , bad u la pynrit mynsiem shibun ha khmat U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u .

en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .
kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . .  , hynrei uta uba leh ka mon jong u Blei u iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Ioannis 17:3, ) Hooid, ka pyrthei ka iaid noh . . . , hynrei uta uba leh ia ka mon U Blei u sah junom .

en: The law and the prophets were until John : since that time the kingdom of God is preached , and every man presseth into it .
kha: Ka Hukum u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki treikam haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ; naduh kata ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei la ïai ïathuh , bad uwei pa uwei u bsut jubor shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hukum bad ki nongiathuhlypa ki long haduh u loannis: naduh kata ka por la ialap ia ka hima U Blei bad uwei pa uwei u rung shapoh jong ka .

en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Canaan , and great affliction : and our fathers found no sustenance .
kha: Nangta ka la don ka  nemsniew ha baroh ka Ijipt bad ka Kanaan , kaba la pynshitom shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la wan ka jingduna ha ka ri Ijipt bad ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei: bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la shem ia ka jingbam .

en: Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .
kha: Da kumne u Jesse u wan ïalam hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u sha u Samuel . Bad u Samuel u ong ha u ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïano ïano na kine .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , u Jesse u la pynlong hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u ban iaid ha khmat u Samuel . U Samuel u la ong ha u Jesse , U Trai um shym la jied ia kine .

en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it  ; and our princes , Levites , and priests , seal unto it .
kha: Namar baroh kata kaba la jia , ma ngi , ki Israel , hangne ngi pynlong ka jingïakut bakyntang da ka jingthoh , bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki Lebi jong ngi , bad ki lyngdoh jong ngi ki buh ïa ki jingshon muhor ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar kine baroh ngi pynlong ia ka jutang kaba skhem, bad ngi thoh ia ka ; bad ki syiem jong ngi, ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh jong ngi, ki khang ia ka .

en: Ye shall have one manner of law , as well for the stranger , as for one of your own country : for I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Kane ka hukum ka teh ïa phi baroh , ïa ki Israel bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban don kawei ka rukom ain, kumjuh ruh ia u nongwei, kumba long na ka ri jong phi: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And as for me also , mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity , but I will recompense their way upon their head .
kha: Hynrei ngan ym isynei ïa ki , Ngan leh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma ki , ki la leh ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia nga ruh, ka khmat jong nga kan ym lait, lymne ngan ym sngewsynei, hynrei ngan siew kylliang ia ka lynti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong ki .

en: And seeth two angels in white sitting , the one at the head , and the other at the feet , where the body of Jesus had lain .
kha: Ka Mari ka la ïeng shabar ka jingtep ka da ïam . Katba ka dang ïam , ka la dem bad jngoh shapoh ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ar ngut ki angel hangta kiba la phong da ki jaiñ balieh , ki da ïashong ha kaba la buh ïa ka met U Jisu , uwei sha khlieh bad uwei pat sha kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ia arngut ki angel kiba shong lieh, uwei ha ka khlieh bad uwei pat ha ki kjat, ha kaba ka met U Jisu ka la thiah .

en: His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .
kha: U riewbymman u jop ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingbishar U Blei ; u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongshun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lynti jong u ki long kiba sngewsih man ka por; ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba jngai na ka jingpeit jong u: kumba long na ki nongshun jong u baroh .

en: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .
kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u , kiba la leit sha ka nongrit ha Samaria ban pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ha khmat jong u: bad ki la leit noh, bad ki la rung ha kawei ka shnong jong ki nong Samaria, ban pynkhreh ia u .

en: So she went from him , and shut the door upon her and upon her sons , who brought the vessels to her  ; and she poured out .
kha: Kumta ka kynthei ka la leit sha la ïing lem bad la ki khun shynrang , ka la khang ïa ka jingkhang , ka la shim ïa u khra umphniang Olib uba rit , bad ka la phylliew umphniang ha ki khra kiba ki khun shynrang jong ka ki la wallam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la leit noh na u, bad ka la khang ia ka jingkhang halor jong ka bad halor ki khun shynrang jong ka, kiba la wanrah ia ki khiew sha ka ; bad ka la theh ia ki.

en: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .
