kha: Ka thma kan khie ha ki nongbah jong ki , bad kan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah . Kan pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki leh ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka waitlam kan sah ha ki shnong jong u , bad kan bam ia ki tnat jong u , bad kan bam ia ki namar ki jingthmu jong ki hi .

en: And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the  Lord  !
kha: bad u ïakren khñium :  Kan jin da la kham bha lada ngi la ïap ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  lem bad kiwei pat ki para Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki ia rkhie bein bad u Moses bad ki la kren da kaba ong: Hato U Blei un iap noh haba ki hynmen jong ngi ki la iap ha khmat U Trai !

en: So man lieth down , and riseth not : till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .
kha: kumta ki briew ki ïap , khlem lah shuh ban khie . Kin ym lah ban kyndit shuh katba ka sahit bneng ka dang ïaishah ; kin ym lah ban khih shuh lano lano na ka jingïohthiah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u briew u thiah shapoh, bad um khie: haduh ba ki bneng kin ym kyndit shuh , lymne kin ym kyndit na ka jingthiah jong ki .

en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .
kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ia la ka kti halor ka khlieh jong ka jingknia pop , bad un pyniap ia ka jingknia pop ha ka jaka jong ka jingknia thang .

en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,
kha: Naba yn ym don shuh kano kano ka jingkñia kaba lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop lada ngi ïai leh pop hadien ba ngi la tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ngi leh pop da kaba thmu hadien ba ngi la ioh ia ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha , ym sah shuh ka jingknia na ka bynta ki pop .

en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and from the wilderness even unto Jordan .
kha: Ki shim ïa ka ri ki Amor baroh naduh Arnon shaphang shathie haduh Jabbok shaphang shatei , bad naduh ri shyiap shaphang mihngi haduh Jordan shaphang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la don ia ki pud ki sam jong ki Amorites, naduh u Arnon haduh Jabok bad naduh ka ri khlaw haduh Jordan .

en: Now , thou son of man , wilt thou judge , wilt thou judge the bloody city ? yea , thou shalt shew her all her abominations .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  hato phi long ba la kloi ban bishar ïa ka nongbah kaba dap da ki nongpynïap briew ? Pynpaw tyngkreiñ ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ka la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ko khun u briew, hato me bishar, hato me bishar ia ka shnong kaba snam ? Hooid, men pyni ia ki jingleh bymman jong ka baroh .

en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people ? for they weep unto me , saying , Give us flesh , that we may eat .
kha: Nangno nga lah ban pynbiang doh ïa kine ki paidbah ? Ki ud sa ud bad ki pan doh ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Naei nga dei ban don ka doh ban ai ha kine ki briew baroh ? namar ki iam ha nga da kaba ong: Ai doh ia ngi, ba ngin bam .

en: If we let him thus alone , all men will believe on him : and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation .
kha: Lada ngi shah bad ïai leh ha kane ka rukom , baroh kin ngeit ha u , bad ki nongsynshar ka Hima Rom kin leh ei ei bad kin pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi ailad ia u kumta marwei, ki briew baroh kin ngeit ia u: bad ki nong Rom kin wan bad shim noh ia ka jaka bad ka jaitbynriew jong ngi baroh ar .

en: By lot was their inheritance , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half tribe .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , ïa ki jaka jong ki khyndai jait bad kawei ka shiteng jait ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la rai da kaba kynting sbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka lot ka long ka pateng jong ki, kumba U Trai u la hukum da ka kti u Moses, na ka bynta ki hynniew jaitbynriew bad na ka bynta ka shiteng jaitbynriew .

en: And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
kha: U la ong ruh ,  Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , bad da la ki kti hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad , Me Trai , ha kaba sdang me la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka khyndew ; bad ki bneng ki long ki kam ki kti jong me:

en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before the great and the terrible day of the  Lord  come .
kha: Ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam shuwa kata ka sngi bakhraw bad bashyrkhei jong U  Trai  kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi kan kylla dum bad u bnai ha ka snam , shuwa ba ka sngi kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei jong U Trai kan wan .

en: One man of you shall chase a thousand : for the  Lord  your God , he it is that fighteth for you , as he hath promised you .
kha: Uwei uwei na phi u lah ban pynher krad shihajar ki nongïapom , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na phi un beh shihajar: namar U Trai U Blei jong phi , ma u long uba ialeh na ka bynta jong phi kumba u la kular ia phi .

en: And she said , Oh my lord , as thy soul liveth , my lord , I am the woman that stood by thee here , praying unto the  Lord .
kha: Ka Hannah ka ong ha u ,  Ko kynrad ! Phi dang kynmaw mo ïa nga ? Nga dei kato ka briew kaba phi ïohi kaba ïeng hangne kaba duwai ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong: Ko kynrad jong nga, kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ko kynrad jong nga, nga long ka kynthei kaba ieng hajan jong me hangne, kaba duwai ha U Trai .

en: Behold , I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them , and will return your recompence upon your own head :
kha: Mynta ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka na kiba ki la shah die . Ngan leh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan pynmih ia ki na ka jaka ba phi la die ia ki , bad ngan pynphai biang ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong phi ha la ka jong ka khlieh:

en: And now , O Lord  God  , thou art that God , and thy words be true , and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :
kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me long U Blei ; me ju ïai bat ïa la ki kular , bad me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kular kaba phylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Trai Blei, me long uta u Blei, bad ki ktien jong me kin long kiba shisha, bad me la kular ia kane ka jingbha ha u shakri jong me:

en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim ? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand ?
kha: Hangno ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Hangno don ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim ? Hato don uno uno uba pyllait ïa ka Samaria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ki blei jong u Hamath bad u Arpad ? hangno ki blei jong u Sepharvaim ? bad hato ki la pyllait ia ka Samaria na ka kti jong nga ?

en: And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
kha: bad hadien ba u la bam jingbam , u la ïohbor pat . U Saul u la sah katto katne sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Damaskos .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la ioh ia ka doh , u la nang khlain . Nangta u la don katto katne sngi bad ki synran kiba don ha Damasi .

en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him , and every man shall draw after him , as there are innumerable before him .
kha: bun hajar ki ïasoh lang ha ka jingleit ontep , bad wat ka khyndew ka tap suki jai halor ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng jong ka them kin long kiba thiang ia u , bad uwei pa uwei un tan hadien jong u kumba ki don ki bym lah ban khein ha khmat jong u .

en: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  Haba men shong halor ka khet jong me ha ka Hima kaba dap da ka burom jong me , ngi kwah ba men shah ïa ngi ban shong bad me , uwei sha kamon jong me bad uwei sha kadiang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u , Ai ia ngi ba ngin shong, kawei ha ka liang kadiang jong me bad kawei pat ha ka liang kadiang jong me, ha ka burom jong me .

en: As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
kha: Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ngi pat , ki khmat jong ngi haduh mynta kim pat lah ban iarap ia ngi: ha ka jingpeit jong ngi ngi la peit ia ka jaitbynriew kaba ym lah ban pynim ia ngi .

en: And hast given them this land , which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them , a land flowing with milk and honey  ;
kha: Me la ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ai ia ki ia kane ka ri kaba me la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban ai ia ki, ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ; .

en: And the  Lord  answered me , and said , Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables , that he may run that readeth it .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka jubab :  To thoh shai ha ki lyngkniap dewbyrtha ïa kaei ba ngan pynpaw ha me , khnang ban lah ban pule mar syn peit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la jubab ia nga, bad u la ong, Thoh ia ka jingphohsniew, bad pynpaw shai ia ka ha ki miej, ba un iaid ia kata kaba pule ia ka .

en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold : but they went not  ; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber .
kha: U syiem Jehoshaphat u shna ïa ki liengbah ban ïaid ha duriaw sha ka ri Ophir ban wad ksiar ; hynrei ki la paitlieng ha Esiongeber bad kim shym lah ïaid shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la shna ia ki lieng jong ka Tarshish ban leit sha Ophir na ka bynta ka ksiar: hynrei kim shym la leit ; namar ki lieng ki la shah pynpra ha Eziongeber .

en: For every tree is known by his own fruit . For of thorns men do not gather figs , nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes .
kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng la tip da u soh uba u pynmih ; phim ju kheit soh Dumbur na ki bniap shiah lane lum ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki bniap shiah buid .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u dieng la ithuh da u soh jong u hi . Namar na ki thliew ki briew kim lum ia ki soh , lane na u khlaw ba la lum lang ki lum ia ki sohjew .

en: And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .
kha: Hynrei u ong ,  Wat pynsah shuh ïa ngi . U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jong nga ; to shah ngan leit phai pat sha la u kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, Wat nym leh ia nga, haba U Trai u la pynroi ia ka lynti jong nga u la phah noh ia nga ba ngan leit sha u kynrad jong nga.

en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek , and Latin , and Hebrew , THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS .
kha: Shalor jong u la thoh ïa kine ki kyntien :  Une u long U Syiem ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la thoh ruh ia ka jingthoh lyngkot halor jong u ha ki shithi Grik , bad Latin , bad Hebru , KANE KA JINGPYNBNA IA KI JINGPYNBNA .

en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens , that thou wouldest come down , that the mountains might flow down at thy presence ,
kha: Balei ba mem kad arliang ïa ka sahit bneng bad wan hiar ? Ki lumbah kin ïohi ïa me bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba me pynkylla ia ki bneng , ba me wan hiar , ba ki lum kin tuid shapoh ha khmat jong me , .

en: Then king David answered and said , Call me Bath–sheba . And she came into the king s presence , and stood before the king .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Ong ïa ka Bathsheba ban wan biang shane shapoh  — bad ka la wan bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Dabid u la jubab bad u la ong, Khot ia nga Bathsheba . Bad ka la wan shapoh ka khmat u syiem bad ka la ieng ha khmat u syiem .

en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .
kha: Ym da donkam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba ka ktah ia ka jingieit para bangeit phim donkam ba ngan thoh sha phi: namar ia phi hi la hikai na U Blei ban iaieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Hato me tip ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngew jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba me la ong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran jong u ki la wan bad ki la ong ha u: Phi tip ba ki Pharisi ki la sngewsih hadien ba ki la iohsngew ia kane ka jingong ?

en: And it shall be , when he shall be guilty in one of these things , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing :
kha: Haba u briew u hap ha ka jingpynrem , u dei ban phla ïa kata ka pop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba u la leh pop ha kawei na kine kiei kiei, ba un phla ba u la leh pop ha kata ka kam:

en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man , then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak , saying ,
kha: Te mynta , lada me pynïap lut ïa ki briew jong me baroh , ki jaitbynriew kiba la tip ïa ka nam jong me kin ïa-ong
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada me pyniap ia kine ki briew baroh kum uwei u briew , te ki jaitbynriew kiba la iohsngew ia ka nam jong me kin kren da kaba ong:

en: Being born again , not of corruptible seed , but of incorruptible , by the word of God , which liveth and abideth for ever .
kha: Naba lyngba ka ktien ba-im bad ba bymjukut jong U Blei la pynkha pat ïa phi kum ki khun jong uta u bymïap shuh , u bym dei u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: La kha pat ia u symbai uba lah ban pyut hynrei uba ym lah ban pyut da ka ktien U Blei kaba im bad kaba sah junom .

en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?
kha: U Manoah u jubab ,  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai burom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jong phi ki la urlong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Manoah u la ong ha u angel U Trai, Kaei ka kyrteng jong me, ba haba ki ktien jong me ki wan jia ngi lah ban leh ia me ?

en: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .
kha: Ha kata ka por , u Patsha Augustus u la hukum ban shim jingkheiñ ïa ki briew baroh ha ka Hima Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kita ki sngi , ba ka la mih ka hukum na u Kaisar Augus , ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan shah khajna .

en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ha phi , ki briew ka Bethel , namar ka pop bashyrkhei kaba phi la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Bethel un leh ia phi namar ka jingsniew kaba khraw jong phi: ha ka por mynstep u syiem Israel un shah ot noh shisyndon .

en: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever , if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments , as at this day .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u ka ban neh junom lada u ïai kohnguh thikna ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh kumba u leh mynta .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan pynskhem ia ka hima jong u junom , lada u iai leh ia ki hukum bad ki jingbishar jong nga kumba ha kane ka sngi .

en: Trust ye not in a friend , put ye not confidence in a guide : keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom .
kha: Wat ngeit ïa la u paramarjan ne shaniah ha la u paralok . Da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi kren wat ha la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shaniah ha u paralok , wat shaniah ha u nongpyniaid: to buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka shyntur jong me na ka kaba shong ha ka kpoh jong me .

en: And the  Lord  said , If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city , then I will spare all the place for their sakes .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Lada nga shem sanphew ngut kiba hok ha Sodom , ngan pyllait ïa kata ka nongbah baroh kawei na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Lada nga shem ha Sodom sanphew ngut ki hok hapoh ka nongbah , te ngan pyllait ia ka jaka baroh na ka bynta jong ki .

en: Even if you cannot study for long periods , decide how much time you can set aside , and try not to let anything interfere .
kha: Wat la phim lah ban pule kham slem , peit hi katno phi lah ban pule , bad wat ailad ïa kaei kaei ruh ban pynthut ïa ka jingpule jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat lada phim lah ban pule slem, rai katno ka por phi lah ban buh shawei , bad pyrshang ban ym ailad ei ei ban pynthut .

en: Seek good , and not evil , that ye may live : and so the  Lord  , the God of hosts , shall be with you , as ye have spoken .
kha: Pynlong ïa ka jingthmu jong phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad ym ïa kaei kaba sniew , khnang ba phin ïoh im . Te U  Trai  , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , da shisha un don ryngkat bad phi , kumba phi kam ba u long .
translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia kaba bha, bad ym kaba sniew, ba phin im: bad kumta U Trai , U Blei jong ki paid un don ryngkat bad phi kumba phi la kren .

en: And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
kha: Ki shna ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad ki pynïasoh ïa kita ki jingkah ar tylli da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna sanphew tylli ki jain ksiar, bad u la pyniasoh ia ki jingtap iwei ia iwei pat: kumta ka la kylla long kawei ka jaka shong jaka sah .

en: By swearing , and lying , and killing , and stealing , and committing adultery , they break out , and blood toucheth blood .
kha: Ki ïateh kular bad ki pynkheiñ ïa ki , ki lamler , ki pynïap briew , ki tuh , bad ki klim . Ki kam sniew ki nang jyllei , bad ka don ka jingïa-pynïap briew kawei hadien kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngap jar , bad thok , bad pyniap , bad tuh , bad leh ia ka kam sniew , ki mih noh , bad ka snam ka ktah ia ka snam .

en: For the builders , every one had his sword girded by his side , and so builded . And he that sounded the trumpet was by me .
kha: bad baroh uba trei , u don ka waitlam ba la teh ha ka syngkai jong u . U briew uba pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham da ka jingput ronsing u don bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki nongtei, uwei pa uwei u don ka waitlam jong u kaba la pyndait da ka liang jong u, bad kumta u la tei . Bad uta uba la sawa ia ka turoi u la don hajan jong nga .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,   ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , da la ka mynsiem baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Me dei ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh .

en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .
kha: Pynban , kum u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat uba ha shuwa jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop , bad um shym sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u la iaid sha ki pop jong u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat , kaba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop; um shym la leit noh na kata ka por .

en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework  ;
kha: Ïa ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ha kaba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ kaba rong saw bad kaba saw bad kaba saw bad kaba saw bad kaba jem bha.

en: ( Ecclesiastes 9 :5 ) Jesus taught that the dead will be resurrected —an unnecessary action if humans had an immortal soul .
kha: ( Ekesiastis 9 :5 ) U Jisu u la hikai ba ia kiba iap yn sa pynmihpatlada ka mynsiem u briew ka im junom , yn ym donkam ban pynmihpat ia u .
translated_en_to_kha: (Eklisi 9 :5 ) U Jisu u la hikai ba ia kiba iap yn sa pynmihpat an ka jingleh bym donkam lada ki briew ki don ka mynsiem bym lah iap .

en: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,
kha: Katba ka por ka nang jan haba ïa U Jisu yn shim noh sha bneng , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingmut bad u la leit ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ka por ka la dei ban pdiang ia u, u la buh ia la ka khmat ban leit sha Jerusalem .

en: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers , against the chief of the butlers , and against the chief of the bakers .
kha: U la bitar eh ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la bitar ia arngut ki ophisar jong u , pyrshah ia u rangbah jong ki nongshet kpu .

en: The group of Tharks , led by Tars Tarkas , takes Carter to their leader Tal Hajus , guarded by Tars Tarkas ' daughter Sola .
kha: Ka kynhun jong ki Thark ba la ialam da u Tars Tarkas ka ialam ia u Carter sha u nongialam jong ki u Tal Hajus ba la pahara da ka khun jong u Tars Tarkas ka Sola .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynhun ki Tharks , kaba la ialam da u Tars Tarkas , ka rah ia u Carter sha u nongialam jong ki u Tal Hajus , ba la pahara da ka Tars Tarkas ka khun jong u Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tarkas ka Tar

en: And the women answered one another as they played , and said , Saul hath slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands .
kha: Ha ka jinglehkmen jong ki , kita ki kynthei ki ïaphawar ,  U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , bad u Dabid da ki phew hajar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat katba ki dang ialehkai, bad ki la ong, U Saul u la pyniap ia ki hajar jong u, bad u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki shi hajar .

en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .
kha: Kiwei pat ki Israel kim dei shuh ban wan sha jan ka Ïingjaiñ ïoh ki wallam ha lade ïa ka jingshah pynshitom da ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki khun Israel ki dei ban wan hajan ka ïingjahthait jong ka jingïalang , ioh kin kit ïa ka pop bad kin ïap .

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane baroh , kumta ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph , Kumba U Blei u la pyni ia me ia kine baroh , ym don mano mano ruh kiba stad bad kiba stad kum ma me:

en: Yet I am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt , and thou shalt know no god but me : for there is no saviour beside me .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt . Phim don uwei pat U Blei lait na nga . Nga dei tang ma nga u nongpynim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga long U Trai U Blei jong me na ka ri Ijipt , bad me ym ithuh blei hynrei tang ia nga: namar ym don nongpynim hajan jong nga .

en: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .
kha: Uwei uwei u don saw tylli ki durkhmat , saw tylli ki thapniang , bad kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti briew hapoh kawei kawei ka thapniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u don saw tylli ki khmat bad uwei pa uwei u don saw tylli ki bniat bad ka dur jong ki kti jong u briew ka don hapoh ki bniat jong ki .

en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Lada phi la long kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang don ha ka jingpynrem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Lada phi la matlah, phim don pop: hynrei mynta phi ong: Ngi iohi; namarkata ka pop jong phi ka sah .

en: And he said to David , Thou art more righteous than I : for thou hast rewarded me good , whereas I have rewarded thee evil .
kha: Nangta u ong ha u Dabid  Phi la leh ïa kaba dei , bad nga la leh bakla . Phi la lehbha shikatdei eh ïa nga , katba nga pat nga la leh haduh katne kaba sniew ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u Dabid , Me kham hok ban ia nga: namar me la siew kylliang ia nga bha, katba nga la siew kylliang ia me ia me .

en: Like a family , they live and work together , enjoy meals together , and study the Bible together in unity . —Psalm 133 :1 .
kha: Kum Shiïing-shisem , ki im bad ki ïatreilang , ki ïa bam lang , bad pule lang ïa ka Baibl da ka jingïatylli . —Salm 133 :1 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka longiing , ki im bad ki iatrei lang , ki sngewtynnad ia ka jingbam lang , bad ki pule ia ka Baibl ryngkat ha ka jingiatylli .  Isaiah 133:1 .

en: And thine eye shall not pity  ; but life shall go for life , eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot .
kha: Ha kum kita ki mokotduma , wat ju leh-isynei ; ka jingpynshitom kan long ka jingim namar ka jingim , ka khmat namar ka khmat , ka bniat namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , bad ka kjat namar ka kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khmat jong me kan ym sngewsynei ; hynrei ka jingim kan leit sha ka jingim, ka khmat na ka bynta ka khmat, ka bniat na ka bynta ka bniat, ka kti na ka bynta ka kti, ka kjat na ka bynta ka kjat .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;
kha: U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingïap jong ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kiba la shah pynïap mynba ki kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  da ka ding bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingiap jong ki arngut ki khun shynrang u Aaron haba ki la aiti ha khmat U Trai bad ki la iap;

en: And he said unto him , I am the  Lord  that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans , to give thee this land to inherit it .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga long U  Trai  , uba la wan ïalam ïa me na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia , ban ai ha me ïa kane ka ri kum ka jong me hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u , Nga long U Trai uba la wanrah ia me na Ur jong ki Khaldian , ban ai ia me ia kane ka ri ban hiar pateng ia ka .

en: And said unto them ,  It is written , My house shall be called the house of prayer  ; but ye have made it a den of thieves .
kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh ïa ki nongtuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki , La thoh ia ka iing jong nga yn khot ka iing duwai ; hynrei phi la pynlong ia ka ka jaka rieh .

en: And it came to pass , when the king sat in his house , and the  Lord  had given him rest round about from all his enemies  ;
kha: U Syiem Dabid u la sah ha la ka ïingsyiem , bad U  Trai  u la sumar ïa u na ki nongshun jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem u la shong ha iing jong u, bad U Trai u la ai jingjahthait ia u sawdong na ki nongshun jong u baroh;

en: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed , and that he should not die in the pit , nor that his bread should fail .
kha: Kito kiba long ki koidi shen yn sa pyllaitluid ïa ki ; kin im ka jingim kaba jlan bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingbam kat kaba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshah beh shnong ka kyrkieh ba un shah pyllait noh , bad ba un ym iap ha ka thliew , lane ba u kpu jong u un jah noh .

en: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .
kha: Nangta u la ïaid sha khmat bad u la ktah ïa ka krong , bad ki briew kiba bah ïa ka ki la sangeh . U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko samla ! To khie joit , nga ong ïa me !
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan bad u la ktah ia ka bier: bad kita kiba kit ia u ki la ieng . Bad u la ong: Ko samla, nga ong ha me, To khie noh .

en: I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ? God is not the God of the dead , but of the living .
kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’ U long U Blei jong kiba im bad ym jong kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob ? U Blei um dei u Blei jong kiba iap hynrei jong kiba im .

en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm .
kha: Nalor baroh , kine ki long ki briew kiba me la jied ban long ki jong me bad kiba me la wallam noh na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki long ki briew jong me bad ka pateng jong me, kaba me wanrah da ka bor ba khraw jong me bad da ka kti ba la pynjrong jong me .

en: Elements of culture , handicrafts and cuisine from different regions of India will also be showcased during the convention .
kha: Ha kane ka jingialang yn pyni ruh ia ki bynta jong ka kolshor , ki kam shna kti bad ki jingbam na ki thain bapher bapher jong ka ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bynta jong ka kolshor , ki jingbam bad ki jingbam bapher bapher jong ka ri India ruh yn pyni ha ka por ba pynlong ia ka jingialang .

en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun u Dan kat kum ki longiing jong ki , kine ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy land , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa phi da kaba pynduna ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , da kaba pynduna ïa ka jingseisoh ki jingthung jong phi , bad da kaba pynduna ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia u soh jong ka met jong me bad u soh jong ka ri jong me, ka jingroi jong ki masi jong me bad ki kynhun langbrot jong me .

en: Yet they were not afraid , nor rent their garments , neither the king , nor any of his servants that heard all these words .
kha: Hynrei u syiem lymne uno uno na ki rangbah synshar kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , kim shym la sheptieng ne pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la tieng, lymne ki jain jong ki, lymne u syiem ne uno uno na ki shakri jong u uba la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien baroh .

en: However , severe heatwave conditions are likely to persist over Madhya Pradesh and west Rajasthan on Monday , the IMD said .
kha: Hynrei ka jingshit kaba jur ka lah ban dang iai bteng ha Madhya Pradesh bad ka thain sepngi jong ka Rajasthan ha ka sngi Nyngkong , la ong ka IMD .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingshit kaba jur ka lah ban neh ha Madhya Pradesh bad ka thain shatei lam mihngi jong ka ri India ha ka sngi Nyngkong , la ong ka IMD .

en: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .
kha: Pha long kaba lamwir !  ki la ong ïa ka . Hynrei ka la ïai ban ba ka la long kaba shisha . Kumta ki la jubab ,  U dei u angel jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ia ka, Me la sngewsih . Hynrei ka la pynskhem beit ba ka la long wat kumta ruh . Nangta ki la ong , Ka dei ka angel jong u .

en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat , the servant of Solomon the son of David , is risen up , and hath rebelled against his lord .
kha: U Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Solomon , u syiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u khun u Nebat u shakri u Solomon u khun u Dabid u la ieng bad u la leh pyrshah ia u kynrad jong u .

en: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .
kha: Hajan ka Khyrdop Langbrot ha Jerusalem ka la don ka pungsum kaba don san tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la khot ïa ka ,  ka Bethesda .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka don ha Jerusalem da ka iew langbrot ka pung kaba la khot ha ka ktien Hebru Bethesda , kaba don san tylli ki thliew .

en: Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;
kha: bad ka da phyrnai da ka burom jong U Blei . Ka nongbah ka la phyrnai kum u mawkordor , kum u maw Jasper , kaba shai sngur bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka burom U Blei: bad ka jingshai jong ka ka la long kum u maw uba kordor tam, wat kum u maw Jasper, uba shai kum u kristal ; .

en: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem , who are his witnesses unto the people .
kha: bad bun sngi u la mihpaw ha kito kiba la ïaleit lem bad u na Galilaïa sha Jerusalem . Ki long mynta ki sakhi na ka bynta jong u sha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iohi ia u bun sngi na kita kiba la wan ryngkat bad u na Galilaia sha Jerusalem , kiba long ki sakhi jong u ha ki briew .

en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :
kha: U pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh u kpa jong u , bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iaid ha ka lynti baroh kaba u kpa jong u u la iaid shapoh , bad u la shakri ia ki bleithaw kiba u kpa jong u u la shakri , bad u la mane ia ki:

en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart : thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour , and not suffer sin upon him .
kha: Wat buhnud ïano ïano , hynrei ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïapher jingmut hapdeng jong phi , khnang ba yn ym pynleh pop ïa phi namar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shun ia u hynmen jong me ha ka dohnud jong me: me dei ban pynrem ia u paramarjan jong me uba stad bad wat shah ia ka pop halor jong u .

en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue ,  Be not afraid , only believe .
kha: U Jisu um shym la patiaw ïa kaei kaba ki la ong , hynrei u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng , shu ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang shu iohsngew ia ka ktien kaba la kren , u ong ha u nongsynshar jong ka synagog , Wat tieng , tang ban ngeit .

en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .
kha: U Sebulun un shong harud duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïar haduh Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zebulun un shong ha ka jaka ri dohkha ; bad un long na ka bynta ka jaka ri dohkha ; bad u pud jong u un long haduh u Sidon .

en: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah , and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the  Lord  his God .
kha: Ha kylleng ka Judah , u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba sngewbha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta u Hesekaiah u la leh ia kaba bha bad kaba dei bad kaba shisha ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong u .

en: For nothing is secret , that shall not be made manifest  ; neither any thing hid , that shall not be known and come abroad .
kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la buhrieh noh yn wallam shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kano kano kaba la tap yn sa lap bad yn sa pynpaw ha kaba shai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don kaei kaei kaba rieh, kaba ym lah ban pynpaw ; ym don kaei kaei kaba buhrieh, kaba ym lah ban tip bad kaba wan shabar ri .

en: And the sons of Midian  ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Midian ki long u Ephah , u Epher , u Hanokh , u Abida , bad u Eldaah . Kine baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Keturah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Midian ; Ephiah, bad u Epher, bad u Hanoch, bad u Abida, bad u Eldaah . Kine baroh ki long ki khun u Keturah .

en: It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .
kha: Lehse U  Trai  un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha nga katto katne ki jingkyrkhu ban shim bujli ïa ka jingtim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lah ban long ba U Trai un peit ia ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad ba U Trai un siew kylliang ia nga na ka bynta ka jingtim jong u ha kane ka sngi .

en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death : if one know them , they are in the terrors of the shadow of death .
kha: Ki sheptieng ïa ka jingshai ha ka por mynsngi , hynrei ka jingdum kam long kaba shyrkhei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka step ka long ha ki wat kum ka jingdum jong ka jingiap: lada uwei u tip ia ki , ki don ha ki jingma jong ka jingdum jong ka jingiap .

en: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .
kha: Mar ïakren ïa kane , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ban ïakajia , bad ka kynhun ka la ïa-pait arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ong kumta, ka la mih ka jingïapher hapdeng ki Pharisi bad ki Sadusi: bad u paidbah u la phiah .

en: For thou art the God of my strength : why dost thou cast me off ? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?
kha: Me long u nongïada jong nga ; balei ba me la iehnoh ïa nga ? Balei ba ngan ïaishah shitom na ka jingshyrkhei ki nongshun jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta me U Blei jong ka bor jong nga: balei me bret noh ia nga ? balei nga leit sngewsih namar ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong u nongshun ?

en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .
kha: Ïa ka jingbam bad ka um phi lah ban thied na ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban thied ia ka doh jong ki da ka pisa , ba phin bam ; bad phin thied ruh ia ka um na ki da ka pisa , ba phin dih .

en: And he took his brethren with him , and pursued after him seven days  journey  ; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead .
kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad u la beh nadien ïa u Jakob kumba hynñiew sngi haduh ba un da lap ïa u ha ka ri lum Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki hynmen jong u bad u, bad u la bud ia u hadien jong u hynriew sngi; bad ki la iaid lait ia u ha u lum Gilead .

en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits , neither seek after wizards , to be defiled by them : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Wat leit ban pan jingmut na ki briew kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba la ïap . Lada phi leh kumta , yn ñiew ïa phi ki bymkhuid . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat khein ia kito kiba don ki mynsiem kiba la tip bha, lymne wad ia ki nongleh jadu, ban shah pynjakhlia ha ki: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And when Uriah was come unto him , David demanded of him how Joab did , and how the people did , and how the war prospered .
kha: Haba u Uriah u la wan poi , u Dabid u kylli ïa u la u Joab bad ki kynhun shipai ki bit ki biang , bad kumno ka jingïaleh ka long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Uri u la wan sha u , u Dabid u la dawa na u kumno u Joab u la leh bad kumno ki briew ki la leh bad kumno ka thma ka la roi .

en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee  ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel .
kha: Men shu khmih ïa kata ka ri na jngai , ka ri ba nga ai ha ki Israel , hynrei men ym ïoh leit rung shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban iohi ia ka ri ha khmat jong me ; hynrei wat leit shata sha ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki khun Israel .

en: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .
kha: U paidbhur u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Paul , haba la phah ïa ka khubor sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Rom ba ka Jerusalem baroh ka la khihwin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang leit ban pyniap ia u, ka khubor ka la wan ha u rangbah shipai , ba ka Jerusalem baroh kawei ka la iaid lyngba .

en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingpyrta da kaba kmen ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki briew jong U Blei :  Ka borbah jong U  Trai  ka la leh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka jingkmen bad ka jingpynim ka long ha ki jaka sah jong kiba hok: ka kti kadiang jong U Trai ka leh da ka jingshlur .

en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u wan mih na ka jaka bakhuid jong u ; un wan hiar bad ïaid ha kliar jong ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, U Trai u mih na ka jaka jong u, bad un wan hiar, bad un iaid ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khyndew .

en: And shall cut him asunder , and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
kha: U kynrad un ot ïa u lyngkhot lyngkhai bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki riewarsap . Hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ot noh ia u, bad un buh ia ka bynta jong u bad ki nongleh arsap: kin sa iam bad kin sa rkhie bein .

en: As he saith also in Osee , I will call them my people , which were not my people ; and her beloved , which was not beloved .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ka Kitab U Hosia :  Ki briew ki bym shym la long ki jong nga ngan khot ‘Ki Briew jong nga .’ Ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam shym la ieit ngan khot ‘Kaba ieit jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u ong ruh ha Osee , ngan khot ia ki ki briew jong nga ki bym dei ki briew jong nga ; bad ka baieit jong ka kaba ym shym la ieit .

en: Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u ha Bethlehem , ka shnong ha kaba u Dabid u la im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jingthoh kam shym la ong , Ba U Khrist u wan na u symbai u Dabid bad na ka shnong Bethlehem ha kaba u Dabid u la don ?

en: Beware of him , and obey his voice , provoke him not  ; for he will not pardon your transgressions : for my name is in him .
kha: Shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa u . Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa u , naba nga la phah ïa u , bad un ym map ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah kaba kum kata .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ia u , bad to kohnguh ia ka sur jong u , wat pynkhih ia u; namar ka kyrteng jong nga ka don ha u .

en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .
kha: Uta uba thang ïa ki u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum shuwa ba un leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba thang ia ki un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un sait ia ka doh jong u ha ka um bad hadien kata un wan shapoh ka jaka shong jaka sah .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because that Moab and Seir do say , Behold , the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen  ;
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Namar ba ka Moab ka la ong ba ka Judah ka long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei; Namar kata ka Moab bad ka Seir ki ong: Ha khmih ka iing u Judah ka long kum ki nongwei baroh;

en: And ye became followers of us , and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Ghost :
kha: Phi la pyrthuh bud ïa ngi bad ïa U Trai ; wat la phi la shahshitom shikatdei eh , phi la pdiang ïa ka khubor da ka jingkmen kaba wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la kylla long ki nongbud jong ngi, bad jong U Trai, haba phi la pdiang ia ka ktien ha ka jingjynjar kaba khraw, da ka jingkmen U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;
kha: To thaw ka pansngiat na ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba ki la ai , bad buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun jong u Jehosadak .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta shim ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad shna ia ki khlieh bad buh ia ki ha ka khlieh jong u Joshua u khun u Jehozadak , u rangbah lyngdoh;

en: And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .
kha: Ki ïa-pyrta uwei ïa uwei pat :  Bakhuid , Bakhuid , Bakhuid ! U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u long uba khuid ! Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u la pyrta ia uwei pat, bad u la ong, U Trai jong ki paid: ka khyndew baroh kawei ka dap da ka burom jong u .

en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .
kha: Haba ki briew ki shah lehbeiñ , ki ud ; ki pyrta ba yn don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbun ki jingshah pynshitom ki pynlong ia kiba shah pynshitom ban iam: ki pyrta namar ka kti jong kiba khlain bor .

en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .
kha: Te u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam Israel , ki ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad ki rangbah Israel ki la hukum ia ki briew da kaba ong: To sumar ia ki hukum baroh kiba nga hukum ia phi mynta ka sngi .

en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .
kha: Kumta u Moses u leit phai sha U  Trai  , bad u ong ,  Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Ki la thaw ïa u blei uba da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wan phai sha U Trai bad u la ong: Oh, une u briew u la leh pop shibun bad u la pynlong ia ki ki blei ksiar .

en: But the fig tree said unto them , Should I forsake my sweetness , and my good fruit , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
kha: Hynrei u dieng Dumbur u ong , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap ban sangeh ban pynmih ki soh thiang babha .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u dieng sohjew u la ong ha ki , Hato nga dei ban iehnoh ia ka jingsma jong nga bad ia u soh babha jong nga bad leit sha ki dieng ?

en: Now therefore fear ye not : I will nourish you , and your little ones . And he comforted them , and spake kindly unto them .
kha: Phim donkam ban sheptieng . Ngan sumar sukher ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi .  Kumta keiñ u la pynshngain ïa ki da ki ktien kiba sbun kiba ktah ïa ka dohnud jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata wat tieng: Ngan pyndap ia phi bad ia ki khun rit jong phi . Bad u la pyntngen ia ki bad u la kren sngewbha ia ki .

en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,
kha: Uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit lem bad me .  Hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , u da ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uta u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la leit noh u la kyrpad ia u ba un don ryngkat bad u: hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ia u da kaba ong:

en: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes , He saved others  ; himself he cannot save .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la beiñ ïa U Jisu , da kaba ong para ma ki ,  U la pynim ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong hapdeng jong ki bad ki nongthoh , U la pynim ia kiwei; ma u hi um lah ban pynim .

en: For God commanded , saying , Honour thy father and mother : and , He that curseth father or mother , let him die the death .
kha: Namar U Blei u la ong , ‘ To burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad ‘ Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u la hukum da kaba ong: To burom ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me: bad , Uta uba tim ia u kpa ne ka kmie , to un iap noh .

en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images , the star of your god , which ye made to yourselves .
kha: Hynrei mynta , namar ba phi la mane ïa ki durblei jong u Sakkuth , u blei syiem jong phi , bad ïa u Kaiwan , u blei khlur jong phi , phin hap ban kit ïa kito ki durblei
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la kha ia ka ïingjahthait jong u Molok bad u Chiun jong phi, u khlur jong u blei jong phi, uba phi la thaw ha lade .

en: Who is gone into heaven , and is on the right hand of God  ; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him .
kha: uba la leit noh sha bneng bad u don ha ka kti kamon U Blei , da kaba synshar halor ki angel baroh bad ki nongsynshar bad ki bor ba kynja bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la leit sha bneng , bad u don ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei; ki angel bad ki bor bad ki bor ba la pynlong hapoh jong u .

en: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one : and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour .
kha: Ym don jingïapher hapdeng u briew uba bet bad u briew uba ai um ; U Blei un ai bainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka kam kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uta uba thung bad uta uba ai um ki long kawei: bad uwei pa uwei un ioh ia la ka jong ka bainong kat kum ka jingtrei shitom jong u hi .

en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which is in mount Ephraim , and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel  ;
kha: Ki kynhun shipai ki ïakynduh ha ri lum Ephraim . U syiem Abijah u kiew sha u lum Semaraim bad u pyrta sha u Jeroboam bad ki Israel :  Shahshkor ïa nga !  u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abijah u la ieng halor u lum Zemaram, uba don ha u lum Ephram, bad u la ong, To sngap ia nga, me Jeroboan bad ki Israel baroh;

en: And now , O God of Israel , let thy word , I pray thee , be verified , which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father .
kha: Kumta mynta , ko Blei ki Israel , to kan long shisha kumta kumba me la kular ha la u shakri , u Dabid u kpa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Blei jong ki Israel, to ai ba ka ktien jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, kan long kaba la pynshisha, kaba me kren ha u shakri jong me u Dabid u kpa jong nga .

en: To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
kha: ban long kiba synshar ïa lade bad kiba sngur mynsiem , bad ki nongsumar ïing babha kiba pyndem ha la ki tnga , ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban kren sniew ïa ka khubor kaba wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban long kiba rieh , kiba khuid ha iing, kiba bha, kiba kohnguh ia la ki jong ki tnga, ba ka ktien U Blei kan ym shah kren bein .

en: And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .
kha: Kumta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la duwai kham jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki waitsum , kat kum ki rukom lehniam jong ki , haduh ba ka snam ka la tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta jam , bad ki la ot ia lade katkum ka rukom jong ki da ki wait bad ki jingbam ba la khleh lang haduh ba ka snam ka la tuid shabar jong ki .

en: Artists from different regions are creating awareness on maternal and child health issues through songs , dances and skits .
kha: Ki nongrwai na ki thain bapher bapher ki pynsngewthuh shaphang ka koit ka khiah jong ki kmie bad ki khynnah lyngba ki jingrwai , ki jingshad bad ki skit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongdro na ki thain bapher bapher ki pynmih ia ka jingsngewthuh shaphang ki jingeh ha ka koit ka khiah jong ki kmie bad ki khun lyngba ki jingrwai , ki jingshad bad ki jingrwai .

en: Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .
kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jngai bah , na shatei bad na sepngi , bad na Aswan kaba don shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih kine kin wan na jngai : bad, ha khmih, kine na shaphang shathie bad na sepngi ; bad kine na ka ri Sinim .

en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark , and set the staves on the ark , and put the mercy seat above upon the ark :
kha: Nangta u shim ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . U bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ha ki kyrwoh jong kata ka synduk bad u buh ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim bad buh ia ka jingsakhi ha ka synduk , bad u la buh ia ki dieng ha ka synduk , bad u la buh ia ka jaka shong jingisynei halor ka synduk:

en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .
kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyni ia ka jingainguh thang ha u, bad ki bynta jong ka: bad u la thang ia ki ha ka almari .

en: Therefore sent he thither horses , and chariots , and a great host : and they came by night , and compassed the city about .
kha: u phah shata ïa ka kynhun babun ryngkat bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom . Ki la poi ha ka nongbah mynmiet bad ki kerkut ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la phah ia ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw: bad ki la wan miet bad ki la ker sawdong ia ka shnong .

en: And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .
kha: Hynrei lada ka long tang kaba shu jia ryngkhat , bad um shym da mut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah ban phet sha ka jaka kaba ngan jied na ka bynta jong phi , bad hangta un shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew um shym la thiah ha ka jaka sumar jong u ; te ngan buh ia me ka jaka ha kaba un phet noh .

en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
kha: Nga long U Blei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , shuwa ka sngi nga long ma nga; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pynpoi na ka kti jong nga: Ngan trei bad mano ba ailad ia ka ?

en: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree , slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks ?
kha: Phi mane ïa ki blei pynkharoi da kaba ïathiah shongkha hapoh ki dieng bakyntang jong phi ; phi ai ïa la ki khun kum ki jingkñia hapoh ki synrang mawsiang harud ki phud wahduid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynkhih ia lade da ki bleithaw hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam , kaba pyniap ia ki khynnah ha ki them hapoh ki kliar jong ki maw ?

en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants , and put me in ward in the captain of the guard s house , both me and the chief baker :
kha: Phi la bitar ïa nga bad ïa u rangbah ki nongshet kpu , bad phi la buh ïa ngi ha phatok ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la bitar ia ki shakri jong u, bad u la buh ia nga ha ka kamra jong u nongap, ma nga bad u nongshet kpu ba ha khlieh duh:

en: Meanwhile , the toll rose to 7 , 200 with 271 more deaths and the number of infections reached 2 , 56 , 611 in the country .
kha: Katba kiba ioh pang, ki la poi sha ka 7, 200ngut bad sa 271ngut kiba iap bad kiba ioh pang, ki la kot sha ka 2,56,611ngut ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por, ka jingiap ka la kiew sha ka 7 , 200 ngut bad ka jingdon jong kiba ioh pang ka la poi sha ka 2 , 56 , 611 ngut ha ka ri .

en: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
kha: Ki don lai ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka snam ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa kajuh ka jingphla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don lai ngut kiba sakhi ha ka khyndew, U Mynsiem bad ka um: bad kine lai ngut ki ia mynjur lang ha kawei .

en: And thence sailed to Antioch , from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled .
kha: bad na kata ka jaka ki la leit pat da ka lieng sha Antiokh , ka jaka ha kaba la aiti ha ki ha ka jingsumar jong ka jingaiei jong U Blei na ka bynta ka kam kaba mynta ki la pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta ki la leit sha Antiok, na kaba la ai jingmut ia ki ha ka jingaiei U Blei na ka bynta ka kam kaba ki la pyndep .

en: As for Saul , he made havock of the church , entering into every house , and haling men and women committed them to prison .
kha: Hynrei u Saul u la pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka balang , da kaba leit na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat , u da paring shabar ïa ki riewngeit , shynrang bad kynthei , bad u la thep ïa ki sha ka ïingbyndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia u Saul , u la pynlong ia ka balang kaba sniew , u la rung ha man la ka iing , bad u la pynlong ia ki shynrang bad kynthei ban set phatok ia ki .

en: And Jesus departed from thence , and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee  ; and went up into a mountain , and sat down there .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh nangta bad u la leit narud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U la kiew ïa u lumrit bad u la shong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit noh nangta bad u la wan hajan ka duriaw Galilaia bad u la leit sha u lum bad u la shong hangta .

en: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem .
kha: Namar ki balang ha Makedonia bad Akhaïa da ka jingsngewlaitluid ki la ïakut ban ai ka jingai ban ïarap ïa kiba duk napdeng ki briew jong U Blei ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la pynsngewbha ia ki na Makedonia bad Akhaia ban ai katto katne ka jingnoh synniang na ka bynta ki riewkhuid kiba duk kiba don ha Jerusalem .

en: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece , over against the great tower that lieth out , even unto the wall of Ophel .
kha: Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka bynta kaba ar jong ki , naduh ka bynta kaba marpyrshah ïa ka jaka ap phira ka Templ kaba heh haduh ka kynroh hajan ka Ophel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong ki ki Teko ki la pynbha sa kawei pat ka bynta, pyrshah ia ka tower kaba khraw kaba la sahkut shabar, wat haduh ka kynroh jong ka Ophel .

en: Therefore if any man be in Christ , he is a new creature : old things are passed away ; behold , all things are become new .
kha: Kumta Uno uno ïa uba la pynïasoh ha U Khrist u long u jingthaw uba thymmai ; kaba rim ka la leit noh , kaba thymmai ka la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada uno uno u briew u long ha U Khrist , u long u jingthaw thymmai: kiei kiei barim ki la jah noh; ha khmih kiei kiei baroh ki kylla long kiba thymmai .

en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the  Lord  :
kha: bad da la ka shynriah ti kamon un synreit khyndiat ïa ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un theh da ka kti kadiang jong u katto katne na ka umphniang kaba don ha ka kti kadiang jong u hynriew sien ha khmat U Trai:

en: When thou vowest a vow unto God , defer not to pay it  ; for he hath no pleasure in fools : pay that which thou hast vowed .
kha: Kumta haba phi pynlong ka jingkular ha U Blei , pyndep kloi ïa ka katba lah . Um donkam ïa u bieit . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kular ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me kular ia ka jingkular ha U Blei , wat siew ia ka ; namar um don jingsngewbha ha ki bieit: to siew ia kata kaba me la kular .

en: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man , and oil to make his face to shine , and bread which strengtheneth man s heart .
kha: bad pynmih um sohwaiñ ban pynsngewbha ïa u , ka umphniang Olib ban pynkmen ïa u , bad u kpu ban ai jingkhlaiñ ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka wain kaba pynsngewbha ia ka dohnud u briew, bad ka umphniang ban pynshai ia ka khmat jong u, bad u kpu uba pynskhem ia ka dohnud u briew .

en: And he said unto them , Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and , behold , Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .
kha: Hato u shait u khlaiñ ?  u kylli biang .  U shait u khlaiñ ,  ki jubab .  Khmih , hangne ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ka wan lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Hato u la koit ? Ki la ong, U la koit: bad, ha khmih, ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ka wan ryngkat bad ki langbrot .

en: And Gideon said unto them , I will not rule over you , neither shall my son rule over you : the  Lord  shall rule over you .
kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Ngan ym long u nongsynshar jong phi , lymne u khun jong nga . U  Trai  un long u nongsynshar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong ha ki, Ngan ym synshar ia phi, lymne u khun jong nga un ym synshar ia phi: U Trai un synshar ia phi .

en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death , and prayed unto the  Lord  : and he spake unto him , and he gave him a sign .
kha: Ha kaba kum kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U duwai , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka dak ba un sa khiah pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi u Hesekaiah u la pang haduh ka jingiap, bad u la duwai ha U Trai : bad u la kren ha u , bad u la ai ia u ia ka dak .

en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .
kha: Ki briew ka Judah baroh ki jied ïa u Ussaïah , u khun jong u Amasaïah , uba dang khathynriew snem ka rta , ban long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah baroh ki la shim ia u Usiah uba dang shiphew snem ka rta bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u ha ka kamra jong u kpa jong u Amasaiah .

en: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time , and the feast of unleavened bread seven days .
kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi baroh ki paid Israel kiba don hangta ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel kiba la don lang ki la leh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka por bad ka jingkhawai niam khlem thied hynriew sngi .

en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?
kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa nga ? Ka long borabor kaba sniew !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat: Hato ngam shym la iathuh ha me ba un ym iathuh ei ei shaphang jong nga hynrei ka jingsniew ?

en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it , or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger , shall even be cut off from his people .
kha: Uno uno uba khleh ïa kaba kum kane , ne uba pyndonkam ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh ha uno uno u briew u bym dei u lyngdoh , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pyndap ia ka kum kata, lane uno uno uba buh ia ka ha u nongwei , yn ot noh wat na ki briew jong u .

en: And another also said , Lord , I will follow thee  ; but let me first go bid them farewell , which are at home at my house .
kha: Uwei pat u briew u la ong ,  Ngan bud ïa me , ko kynrad ; hynrei nyngkong shah ïa nga ban leit bad khublei ïa ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat ruh u la ong, ko Trai, ngan bud ia me ; hynrei to ngan leit noh nyngkong eh ia ki, kiba don ha iing ha iing jong nga .

en: No foot of man shall pass through it , nor foot of beast shall pass through it , neither shall it be inhabited forty years .
kha: Yn ym don bynriew ne mrad ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Na ka bynta sawphew snem yn ym don ban im hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka kjat briew kaba iaid lyngba jong ka , lymne ka kjat mrad kan iaid lyngba jong ka , lymne kan ym shong sawphew snem .

en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it , and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it .
kha: Ka kur u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh ka la hiarthma ïa ka ri Gilead , bad ka la ïohknieh ïa ka , bad beh krad ïa ki Amor kiba don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Machir u khun u Manasseh ki la leit sha Gilead bad ki la shim ia ka bad ki la bret noh ia ka Amorit kaba don ha ka .

en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .
kha: Ki la ïohi ba katto katne ngut ki synran jong u ki dang ïabam ïa la ki jingbam da ki kti ki bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam — kata , kim pat sait ha kata ka rukom kaba ki Pharisi ki ong ba ki briew ki dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohi katto katne na ki synran jong u ba ki bam ia u kpu da kaba la pynsniew, kata ka mut, da ki kti bym pat tyrkhong, ki la shem ia ka jingbakla .

en: The Congress has accused the BJP administration of misusing official agencies ahead of the Assembly elections in the state .
kha: Ka Congress ka la kynnoh ia ka sorkar BJP ba ka la pyndonkam bakla ia ki tnad sorkar ha shuwa ka elekshon iing dorbar ha kane ka jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Congress ka la kynnoh ba ka bor synshar ka BJP ka la pyndonkam bakla ia ki tnad treikam ha khmat ka elekshon Assembly ha ka jylla .

en: As per the order , admission to 150 seats in Kannur Medical College and 30 seats in Karuna Medical Colleges were cancelled .
kha: Katkum ka hukum la weng noh ia ka admission ha ki 150 tylli ki seat ha Kannur Medical College bad 30 tylli ha ki Karuna Medical College .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka hukum , la pynsangeh noh ia ka jingrung sha ki 150 tylli ki jaka shong ha Kanur Medical College bad 30 tylli ki jaka shong ha Karuna Medical College .

en: For the grave cannot praise thee , death can not celebrate thee : they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth .
kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap uba lah ban ïaroh ïa me ; uba ïap un ym lah ban shaniah ha ka jinglonghok jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingtep kam lah ban iaroh ia me, ka jingiap kam lah ban rakhe ia me: kita kiba leit shapoh ka thliew kim lah ban kyrmen ia ka jingshisha jong me .

en: During this pandemic situation and lockdown , museums and cultural institutions cannot serve visitors and audiences as usual
kha: Ha kane ka por jong ka khlam bad ka jingkhang khyrdep , ki museum bad ki jaka ai kolshor kim lah ban shakri ia ki nongwan jngohkai bad ki nongpeitkai kumba ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka jinglong jingman jong ka khlam bad ka jingkhang dam , ki jaka buh jingthoh bad ki jaka pule kim lah ban shakri ia ki nongwan jngohkai bad ki nongpeitkai kumba ju long .

en: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar , he said ,  It is finished :  and he bowed his head , and gave up the ghost .
kha: U Jisu u la dih ïa kata ka waiñ bad u la ong ,  La pyndep !  Nangta u la noh lyngngeh la ka khlieh bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la ioh ia u sohjew, u la ong: Ka la dep: bad u la dem khrup ia la ka khlieh bad u la aiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: Then said I , O my lord , what are these ? And the angel that talked with me said unto me , I will shew thee what these be .
kha: Nga la kylli ïa u ,  Ko rangbah , kine ki kulai ki mut aïu ?  U la jubab  Ngan pyn-i ïa phi aïu ki kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , ko kynrad jong nga, kiei kine ? Bad u angel uba la kren bad nga u la ong ha nga , Ngan pyni ia me kaei kaba kine ki long .

en: And in those days shall men seek death , and shall not find it  ; and shall desire to die , and death shall flee from them .
kha: Ha kine ki san bnai kin wad ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka ; kin kwah ban ïap noh , hynrei ka jingïap kan phet na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita ki sngi ki briew kin wad ia ka jingiap, bad kin ym shem ia ka ; bad kin kwah ban iap , bad ka jingiap kan phet noh na ki .

en: For if there be first a willing mind , it is accepted according to that a man hath , and not according to that he hath not .
kha: Lada phi thrang ban ai , U Blei un pdiang ïa ka jingai jong phi ha ka nongrim jong kaei kaba phi dei ban ai , ym halor kaei kaba phim don .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada don nyngkong eh ka jingmut kaba mon sngewbha, la pdiang katkum kata kaba u briew u don , bad ym katkum kata kaba um don .

en: And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .
kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha ka ïing jong u bad u la ai ha ki katto katne ka jingbam ban bam . Ïa u bad ka longïing jong u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar mynta ki la ngeit ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wanrah ia ki ha iing jong u, u la buh doh ha khmat jong ki, bad u la sngewbha, da kaba ngeit ha U Blei bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei .

en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ia ka ri Ijipt , bad ka jingpynshitom ia ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym wan shaneng ban bat ia ka jingkhawai jong ki ïingjaiñ .

en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor  ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not  ;
kha: namar u la banbeiñ bad leh bymsuidñiew ïa kiba duk bad ba u knieh noh ïa ki ïing kiba kiwei ki la thaw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la shah pynshitom bein bad u la iehnoh ia kiba duk ; namar u la shim noh da ka jingleh donbor ia ka iing kaba um shym la tei ; .

en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people , because they were many : and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel .
kha: ma u lem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moab u la tieng shibun ia ki briew: bad u Moab u la sngewsih namar ki khun Israel .

en: Nevertheless the centurion believed the master and the owner of the ship , more than those things which were spoken by Paul .
kha: Hynrei uta u rangbah shipai u la kham kohnguh ïa kaei kaba u kapten bad ïa u trai lieng , bad ym ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u rangbah u ngeit ia u kynrad bad u trai jong ka lieng , kham palat ia kita kiei kiei kiba la kren da u Paul .

en: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .
kha: pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang ïa u kat kaba u donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban plie ia ka kti jong me sha u , bad to ai ram shisha ia u kaba biang na ka bynta ka jingdonkam jong u, ha kaba u kwah .

en: Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?
kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Balei keiñ ba me da khot ïa nga haba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa me bad u la kylla long u nongshun jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Samuel , Balei te me kylli ia nga, haba u Trai u la leit noh na me bad u la kylla long u nongshun jong me ?

en: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
kha: Bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , ar ngut na kita ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u khun u Nun bad u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh kiba la leit wad ia ka ri ki la pynkhih ia ki jain jong ki:

en: And to wait for his Son from heaven , whom he raised from the dead , even Jesus , which delivered us from the wrath to come .
kha: bad ban ap ïa U Khun jong u ban wan na bneng — U Jisu , U Khun jong u , ïa uba u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap bad uba pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban ap ia la u Khun na bneng , ia uba u la pynmihpat na kiba iap , wat ia U Jisu ruh uba la pyllait im ia ngi na ka jingbitar kaban sa wan .

en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .
kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane , u Ananias u la kyllon ïap ; bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la sngewshyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ananias haba u la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien u la hap noh , bad u la aiti noh ia u ksuid: bad ka jingtieng kaba khraw ka la wan ha kita baroh kiba la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei .

en: Even every one that is called by my name : for I have created him for my glory , I have formed him  ; yea , I have made him .
kha: Ki long ki briew jong nga hi , bad nga la thaw ïa ki ban wanrah burom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia uwei pa uwei uba la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga: namar nga la thaw ia u na ka bynta ka burom jong nga, nga la thaw ia u ; yea , nga la thaw ia u .

en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .
kha: Ka Ïoanna , uba u Khusa u tnga jong ka u long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka ïingbishar jong u Herod ; bad ka Susanna , bad bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la pyndonkam ïa la ki jong ki jingïoh ban ïarap ïa U Jisu bad ïa ki synran jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Joanna ka tnga jong u Chuza Herod, bad ka Susanna bad kiwei kiwei kiba la shakri ia u na ka jingdon jong ki .

en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .
kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki para jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kin ym don pateng hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki: U Trai u long ka pateng jong ki kumba u la ong ha ki .

en: Draw thee waters for the siege , fortify thy strong holds : go into clay , and tread the mortar , make strong the brickkiln .
kha: To tong ïa ka um ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingshah kerkut , bad to pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kut jong pha ! To ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha ban shna ïa ki maw-it , bad to pynkhreh ïa ki tiar shna maw-it !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhluit ia me ia ki um na ka bynta ka jingkhang, pynskhem ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong me: leit shapoh ka dewbilat, bad iaid ia ka dewbilat, pynskhem ia ka nar .

en: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords , and took him up out of the dungeon : and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison .
kha: Nga la leh ïa kane , bad ki la tan ïa nga shalor shabar ka pung . Hadien kata ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la tan ia u Jeremaiah da ki lynti , bad ki la shim ia u na ka thliew: bad u Jeremaiah u la sah ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok .

en: In that day shall the  Lord  of hosts be for a crown of glory , and for a diadem of beauty , unto the residue of his people ,
kha: Ka sngi kan wan haba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long kum ka pansngiat badonburom jong ki syntiew na ka bynta ki briew jong u kiba dang sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai jong ki paid un long na ka bynta ka khlieh jong ka burom bad na ka bynta ka jingitynnad , haduh ki briew jong u kiba sah .

en: Do not abhor us , for thy name s sake , do not disgrace the throne of thy glory : remember , break not thy covenant with us .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jingkular jong me bad wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ; wat wallam ka jingjahburom halor ka Jerusalem ka jaka jong ka khet badonburom jong me . Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewsih ia ngi, namar ka kyrteng jong me, wat pynjah burom ia ka khet ka burom jong me: kynmaw , wat pynkhein ia ka jutang jong me bad ngi .

en: And these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt , Jacob and his sons : Reuben , Jacob s firstborn .
kha: Ki dkhot jong ka ïing ka sem u Jakob kiba leit ryngkat bad u sha Ijipt ki long u khun nyngkong jong u , u Reuben ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel kiba la wan sha Ijipt: U Reuben u khun nyngkong jong u Jakob .

en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?
kha: U Pilat u la kren biang ha u paidbah ,  Kaei te , phi kwah ïa nga ban leh ïa uta uba phi khot u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la jubab bad u la ong biang ha ki: Phi kwah aiu ba ngan leh ia uta uba phi khot u Syiem ki Jiw ?

en: And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .
kha: Baroh ki la ïalyngngoh shikatdei eh ! Ki la dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  A katno kiei kiei kiba phylla ngi la ïohi ha kane ka sngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la lyngngoh bad ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei bad ki la dap da ka jingtieng, ki da ong: Ngi la iohi ia kiei kiei kiba phylla ha ka sngi .

en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .
kha: Ka buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïabam . Nangta ki ïeng bad leit noh ha kata hi ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wanrah ia ka ha khmat u Saul, bad ha khmat ki shakri jong u; ki la ieng noh bad ki la leit noh ha kata ka miet .

en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave , and raised him from the dead , bare record .
kha: Ki briew kiba la don ryngkat bad U Jisu mynba u la khot ïa u Lasaros na ka jingtep bad ba u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ki la pynbna ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u haba u la khot ia u Lasaros na ka jingtep jong u, bad u la pynmih ia u na kiba iap, khlem da thoh .

en: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten  ; after that she shall go .
kha: Hynrei u hynmen jong ka Rebekka bad ka kmie jong ka ki ong ,  Ai ba ka Rebekka kan sah shuwa bad ngi shi taïew ne shiphew sngi , bad hadien kata ka lah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U hynmen jong ka bad ka kmie jong ka ki la ong: Ai ba ka dam kan sah bad ngi katto katne sngi, la kumno kumno shiphew ; hadien kata kan leit noh .

en: For I say unto you , Ye shall not see me henceforth , till ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
