kha: Naduh mynta , nga ong ha pha , phan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga tad haduh ba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong u Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , Phin ym iohi ia nga naduh mynta, haduh ba phin da ong: La kyrkhu ia uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .
kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat haba kane baroh ka la jia , kim shym la wan phai sha nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsarong jong ki Israel ka pynshisha ia ka khmat jong u: bad kim ju wan phai sha U Trai U Blei jong ki , lymne wad ia u na ka bynta kine baroh .

en: Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea :
kha: Ki synran ki la kut jingmut ba uwei pa uwei na ki un phah katba lah bor ban ïarap ïa ki parabangeit kiba shong basah ha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki synran, uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jinglah jong u, ki la kut jingmut ban phah jingpyntngen sha ki para bangeit kiba shong ha Judaea:

en: The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .
kha: Ki la leit sha u Philip ( uba dei na Bethsaida kaba ha Galilaïa ) bad ki la ong ,  Ko Rangbah , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U juh u la wan ha u Philip uba long na Bethsaida jong ka Galilaia bad u la kwah ia u da kaba ong: Ko sahep, ngin sa iohi ia U Jisu .

en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
kha: Hynrei haba u Pharaoh u ïohi ba kita ki jakoid ki la ïap , u la kylla mutlop biang , bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Pharaoh u la iohi ba ka don ka jingjahthait, u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u bad um shym la sngap ia ki ; kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: The prime minister spoke about womens empowerment , equality and good governance , as preached and practised by Basaveswara .
kha: U myntri rangbah u la kren shaphang ka jingpynkup bor ia ki kynthei , ka jingiaryngkat bad ka jingsynshar kaba bha kumba la ialap bad leh da u Basaveswara .
translated_en_to_kha: U myntri rangbahduh u la kren shaphang ka jingpynkupbor ia ki kynthei , ka jingiaryngkat bad ka jingsynshar kaba bha , kumba la ialap bad leh da u Basaveswara .

en: O inhabitant of Aroer , stand by the way , and espy  ; ask him that fleeth , and her that escapeth , and say , What is done ?
kha: Phi kiba shong ha Aroer , ïeng harud lynti bad ap ; kylli na kito kiba ïaphet noh , wad jingtip na ki ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko nongshong shnong jong u Aroer, to ieng hajan lynti, bad to kylli ia uta uba phet krad, bad ia kata kaba lait im, bad to ong , Kaei kaba la leh ?

en: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .
kha: U Philip u la jubab ,  Lada uwei uwei un ïoh tang mar khyndiat , kan donkam palat ïa ka arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ban thied kpu kat ban biang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u la jubab ia u , Ar spah tyngka u kpu um pat biang ia ki , ba uwei pa uwei na ki un shim khyndiat .

en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim
translated_en_to_kha: Wat plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka khun jong me ha ka ain: ka long ka tnga jong u khun jong me; wat plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka .

en: In mine ears said the  Lord  of hosts , Of a truth many houses shall be desolate , even great and fair , without inhabitant .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Baroh kine ki ïing kiba heh bad kiba itynnat kin long kiba la pra bad thylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki shkor jong nga la ong U Trai jong ki paid: Na ka jingshisha bun ki iing kin sa jah rngai noh, wat kiba heh bad kiba hok, khlem nongshong shnong .

en: These practices are wrong because ( 1 ) they make us their slaves , ( 2 ) they harm our bodies , and ( 3 ) they are unclean .
kha: Kine ki jingmlien ki long ki bymdei namar ( 1 ) Ki pynlong ïa ngi ki mraw jong ki ( 2 ) Ki pynsniew ïa ka met jong ngi , bad ( 3 ) Ki long ki bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki rukom ki long kiba bakla namar ( 1 ) ki pynlong ia ngi ki mraw jong ki , ( 2 ) ki pynmynsaw ia ka met jong ngi , bad ( 3 ) ki long ki bymkhuid .

en: And if they will learn any thing , let them ask their husbands at home : for it is a shame for women to speak in the church .
kha: Lada ki kwah ban tip ei ei shaphang kano kano , ki dei ban kylli ha la ki tnga ha ïing . Ka long kaba i jahburom ïa ka kynthei ban kren ha ka jingïaseng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada kin nang ei ei , to ai ba kin kylli ia ki tnga jong ki ha iing : namar ka long kaba sngewlehrain ia ki kynthei ban kren ha ka balang .

en: How long , ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?
kha: A , phi ki briew kiba bieit ! Slem katno keiñ phi dang kwah ban sah bieit ? Sa katno keiñ phin dang kmen ha kaba krenbeiñ ïa ka jingtip ? Hato phim kwah ban ïoh jinghikai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por, phi kiba suk, phin ieit ia ka jinglong kaba suk ? bad ki nonglehkai ki sngewbha ia ka jingsngewsih jong ki , bad ki bieit ki shun ia ka jingtip ?

en: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .
kha: Nga la kren ha ki nongïathuhlypa bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingïohipaw , bad lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa nga ai jingmaham ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kren ruh da ki nongiathuhlypa , bad nga la pyndonkam ia ki jingphohsniew kiba bun jait , da ka jingshakri jong ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her ,
kha: Hynrei ka la jia namar ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka ki la leh pop bad ki lyngdoh jong ka ki long kiba la rem namar ka jingpynjia ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew balui lui .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki pop jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka bad ki jingbymhok jong ki lyngdoh jong ka kiba la pynmih ia ka snam jong kiba hok hapdeng jong ka .

en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , is less than all the seeds that be in the earth :
kha: Ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso , u symbai barit tam ha ka pyrthei , bad u thung ïa u ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kum u symbai ba la bet ha ka khyndew , uba haba la bet ha ka khyndew , u kham duna ban ia ki symbai baroh kiba don ha ka khyndew:

en: His legs are as pillars of marble , set upon sockets of fine gold : his countenance is as Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .
kha: Ki umpohliew ki ai um ïa ka kper , ki wah um batuid , ki wahduid kiba tuid sharum na ki lumbah ka Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat jong u ki long kum ki maw marble, la buh ha ki socket ksiar kiba bha: ka khmat jong u ka long kum ka Lebanon , kaba bha kum ki diengsoh .

en: Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :
kha: To leh adkar , to sharai ! U nongshun jong phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kum u sing bakyrhuh , da kaba wad ïa uno uno ba un nguid tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba jemnud, to long kiba husiar namar u nongshun jong phi u ksuid, kum u sing uba rkhie bein, u iaid kylleng kylleng, u wad ia uba u lah ban bam:

en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .
kha: Nga la wan ban pynsngewthuh ïa me ïa kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew jong me ha ka lawei . Kane ka dei ka jingïohipaw ïa ka lawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga wan ban pynlong ia me ban sngewthuh ia kaei kaban sa jia ia ki briew jong me ha ki sngi kiba hadien: namar ka jingphohsniew ka long na ka bynta bun sngi .

en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman .
kha: U Simeon bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul , u khun ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Simeon ; u Jemuel, bad u Jamin, bad u Ohad, bad u Machin, bad u Sohar bad u Shaul u khun jong ka kynthei Kanaan .

en: And he said , Whether they be come out for peace , take them alive  ; or whether they be come out for war , take them alive .
kha: U hukum ,  Kem im ïa ki , kam pher la ki wan ban ïaleh ne pan ïasuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , La ki mih na ka bynta ka jingsuk, shim ia ki baroh arngut ne ki mih na ka bynta ka thma, shim ia ki im .

en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches , and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :
kha: Me la pynlong ka jingkhaïi bastad bad me ïai pynïohnong . Katno uba sarong me long ïa ka spah jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingstad kaba khraw jong me bad da ka jingkhaii jong me me la pynroi ia ka spah jong me, bad ka dohnud jong me ka la kiew namar ka spah jong me:

en: And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .
kha: Ha kane ka por , u Gideon bad la ki laispah ngut ki rangbah ki la wan sha ka wah Jordan bad jam sha shiliang ïa ka . Ki la thait hi ïan , hynrei ki dang beh kthong ïa ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la poi ha Jordan bad u la iaid lait noh, ma u bad ki lai spah ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, ki la lyngngoh, hynrei ki la bud ia ki .

en: To open the blind eyes , to bring out the prisoners from the prison , and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house .
kha: Phin pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong kiba matlah bad pyllaitluid ïa kito kiba shong ha ki ïingbyndi ba-dum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban plie ia ki khmat kiba matlah , ban pynmih ia ki koidi na phatok , bad ia kito kiba shong ha ka jingdum na ka iing phatok .

en: That was also the first time when Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal met US Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer .
kha: Kata ka dei ruh ka sien kaba nyngkong ba u Myntri ka tnad khaii pateng u Piyush Goyal u la ïa kynduh ïa u nongmihkhmat jong ka kam khaii pateng jong ka US u Robert Lighthizer .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka dei ruh ka sien kaba nyngkong eh ha kaba u Myntri ka tnad khaii pateng u Piyush Goyal u la iakynduh ia u nongmihkhmat jong ka ri America .

en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .
kha: U Shem , u hynmen jong u Japheth , u la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Hebru baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Shem ruh u kpa jong ki khun u Eber baroh, u hynmen jong u Japheth u rangbah, wat ha u ruh la kha khun .

en: And the sound of the cherubims  wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .
kha: Ka jingriew ki thapniang ki kherub ka sawa shaduh ka phyllaw kaba shabar . Ka sawa kum ka sur kren U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki bniat jong ki cherubim wat haduh ka iingbishar kaba shabar , kum ka sur jong U Blei Uba donbor baroh haba u kren .

en: And he said unto them ,  Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel , or under a bed ? and not to be set on a candlestick ?
kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Hato ju don uno uno uba wallam ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang lane ha khrum jingthiah ? Hato um buh ïa ka ha u diengpynïeng sharak ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Hato la wanrah ia ka sharak ban buh hapoh ka khlaw ne hapoh ka jingthiah ? bad ban ym buh ia ka sharak ?

en: I will smite them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they .
kha: Ngan phah ka jingïapthem bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki , hynrei ïa me ngan pynlong u kpa ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ia ki da ka jingpang khlam , bad ngan pynlong ia me ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kaba kham khlain bor ban ia ki .

en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .
kha: Kynsan kynsan , U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad ki , bad men kylla long da uwei pat u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Mynsiem U Trai un wan ha me bad me men iathuhlypa bad ki , bad men kylla long uwei pat u briew .

en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt , so my spirit remaineth among you : fear ye not .
kha: Mynba phi la mihnoh na ri Ijipt , nga la kular ba ngan long lem bad phi borabor . Nga dang long lem bad phi , kumta wat sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka ktien kaba nga la iateh bad phi haba phi la mih na Ijipt , kumta ka mynsiem jong nga ka sah hapdeng jong phi: wat tieng .

en: And they answered Joshua , saying , All that thou commandest us we will do , and whithersoever thou sendest us , we will go .
kha: Ki la jubab ïa u Joshua ,  Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me la ong ïa ngi bad ngin leit kat shaba me phah ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u Joshua, ki da ong: Baroh kaba me hukum ia ngi ngin leh, bad katba me phah ia ngi ngin leit noh .

en: In the upcoming biopic Yatra , Mollywood superstar Mammootty will be playing the role of the politician YS Rajasekara Reddy .
kha: Ha ka biopic ka ban sa mih ka Yatra , u khlur ba pawnam ka Mollywood u Mammootty un ak ia ka bynta jong u politishian u YS Rajasekara Reddy .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka Yatra kaba dang wan, ka jingpang ba la shna da ka Mollywood kan long ka bynta jong u politician YS Rajasekara Reddy .

en: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel : and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites :
kha: U Joab u long u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Israel ; u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih ïa ka kynhun ïada ïa u Dabid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Joab u la long halor ki shipai Israel baroh: bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la long halor ki Kheriot bad halor ki Kheriot:

en: Even all nations shall say , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land ? what meaneth the heat of this great anger ?
kha: Te ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan sa kylli , ‘ Balei keiñ U  Trai  u la leh haduh katne ïa ka ri jong ki ? Na ka daw aïu mo ba u bitar shla haduh katne ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ong , Balei u Trai u la leh kumta ia kane ka ri ? kaei ka jingshit jong kane ka jingbitar kaba khraw ?

en: Again in the ninth year , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien ha ka snem kaba hynniew, ha ka shiphew bnai, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Go ye therefore , and teach all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father , and of the Son , and of the Holy Ghost :
kha: Kumta , khie leit , sha ki briew baroh kylleng bad pynlong ïa ki , ki synran jong nga : To pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Kpa , U Khun , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translated_en_to_kha: To leit noh namarkata bad hikai ia ki jaitbynriew baroh, da kaba pynbaptis ia ki ha ka kyrteng U Kpa bad U Khun bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house , neither enter therein , to take any thing out of his house :
kha: U briew uba don halor ka tnum jong ka ïing jong u , um dei ban pynlut por da kaba hiar shapoh ka ïing ban shim ei ei ban rah bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba uta uba don ha ka iing un leit shapoh iing, lymne un rung shapoh iing, ban shim ia kaei kaei na iing jong u:

en: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim , because there was much water there : and they came , and were baptized .
kha: U Ïoannis ruh u dang pynbaptis ha Ainon , ka bym da jngai na Salim , namar ba ka la don shibun ka um ha kata ka jaka . Ki briew ki la ïaleit sha u , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis ruh u dang pynbaptis ha Aenon hajan u Salm, namar ka don ka um kaba bun hangta : bad ki la wan, bad la pynbaptis ia ki .

en: Then the king arose , and tare his garments , and lay on the earth  ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent .
kha: U syiem u la ïeng joit , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad u lympat ïa lade ha khyndew . Ki shakri ruh kiba don hangta bad u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ieng , bad u la buh ia ki jain jong u, bad u la thiah ha ka khyndew ; bad ki shakri jong u baroh ki la ieng hajan bad ki jain jong ki ki la tyrkhong .

en: Only the people sacrificed in high places , because there was no house built unto the name of the  Lord  , until those days .
kha: Ïa ka templ ym pat shym la tei na ka bynta U  Trai  , bad kumta ki briew ki dang ai ki jingkñia ha ki duwan bapher bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki briew kiba la knia ha ki jaka ba jrong , namar ym shym la tei iing ha ka kyrteng U Trai haduh kita ki sngi .

en: And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :
kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kine ki ktien , ka khyndew ha kaba u Dathan bad u Abiram ki ïeng ka la kad arliang
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, kumba u la pynkut noh ia kine ki ktien baroh, ba ka nongrim ka la jah noh hapoh jong ki:

en: It is neither fit for the land , nor yet for the dunghill  ; but men cast it out . He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
kha: Kam long kaba bha ïa ka khyndew lane ïa ka kynton sboh ; la bret noh ïa ka . Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translated_en_to_kha: Kam long kaba iadei bad ka ri, lymne na ka bynta ka dewbilat ; hynrei ki briew ki bret noh ia ka . Uta uba don ki shkor ban iohsngew , to ai ba un iohsngew .

en: The churches of Asia salute you . Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord , with the church that is in their house .
kha: Ki ingmane jong ka Asia ki phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi ; u Akwila bad ka Priskila bad ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ki , ki phah ïa ka jingkhublei parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki balang Asia ki ai khublei ia phi . Ka Aquila bad ka Priscilla ki ai khublei shibun ia phi ha U Trai , bad ka balang kaba don ha iing jong ki .

en: If my step hath turned out of the way , and mine heart walked after mine eyes , and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands  ;
kha: Lada nga la phai noh na ka lynti kaba dei lane shah ban pynthame ïa lade da kaba sniew , lada ki kti jong nga ki bit da ka pop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka step jong nga ka la kylla na ka lynti, bad ka dohnud jong nga ka la iaid hadien ki khmat jong nga, bad lada uno uno u blang u la rung sha ki kti jong nga;

en: Behold , every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee , saying , As is the mother , so is her daughter .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa kane ka proberb shaphang jong pha , ko Jerusalem : ‘ Kumba long ka kmie , kumta ruh ka khun .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , uwei pa uwei uba pyndonkam ia ki proberb un pyndonkam ia kane ka proberb pyrshah ia me , da kaba ong , Kumba long ka kmie , kumjuh ruh ka khun jong ka .

en: But it was so , that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .
kha: Hynrei kat haduh ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash ki lyngdoh kim pat shym la shna pynbha ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la long kumta , ba ha ka snem kaba arphew snem jong u syiem Jehoash ki lyngdoh kim shym la pynbha ia ki jingtwa jong ka iing .

en: Breach for breach , eye for eye , tooth for tooth : as he hath caused a blemish in a man , so shall it be done to him again .
kha: Lada u pynkheiñ ïa ka shyieng , yn pynkheiñ kylliang ïa kawei na ki shyieng jong u ; lada u pynmatlah ïa u na kawei ka khmat , yn pynmatlah kylliang ïa kawei na ki khmat jong u ; lada u lop ïa kawei ka bniat , yn lop kylliang ïa kawei na ki bniat jong u . Kumba u la pynmynsaw ïa uno uno u briew , kumta ruh yn pynmynsaw kylliang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ka jingpynkhein, ka khmat na ka bynta ka khmat, ka bniat na ka bynta ka bniat: kumba u la pynmih ia ka jingduna ha u briew , kumta yn leh biang ia u .

en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then did ye not believe him ?
kha: Ki la sdang ïatainia para ma ki :  Kaei ngin ong ? Lada ngi jubab , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un sa ong , ‘ Balei te , phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia pyrkhat bad ki hi da kaba ong: Lada ngin ong , Na bneng ; un ong , Balei te phim ngeit ia u ?

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  Have ye not read , that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female ,
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phim pat pule ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ba ha kaba mynnyngkong U Nongthaw u la thaw ïa ki briew , shynrang bad kynthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Hato phim shym la pule ia ki ha kaba sdang u la pynlong ia ki shynrang bad kynthei .

en: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .
kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar shiteng ka umphniang Olib dei ban ai kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane na ka bynta u langbrot , me dei ban pynkhreh ia ka doh kaba ai ar tylli ki shini kiba la khleh lang bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ka hin jong ka umphniang .

en: And I say unto you , Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you .
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha phi, Kylli, bad yn ai ia phi; bad phin sa shem; bad yn plie ia ka ha phi .

en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .
kha: U long uba phi dei ban ïaroh — u long U Blei jong phi ; bad phi la ïohi da la ki khmat ïa ki kam kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U long ka jingiaroh jong me bad u long U Blei jong me uba la leh na ka bynta jong me ia kine kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba shyrkhei kiba me la iohi da ki khmat jong me .

en: And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,
kha: Nangta ki la duwai ,  A Trai , me tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , kumta pyn-i ha ngi uno na kine ar ngut uba me la jied
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la duwai bad ki la ong: Me, ko Trai, me tip ia ki dohnud jong ki briew baroh, to pyni la na kine arngut me la jied .

en: Let no man say when he is tempted , I am tempted of God : for God cannot be tempted with evil , neither tempteth he any man :
kha: Lada u briew u shah pynshoi da kum kita ki jingtynjuh , um dei ban ong ,  Kane ka jingpynshoi ka wan na U Blei .  Naba ïa U Blei ym lah ban pynshoi da kaba sniew , bad ma u hi da lade um pynshoi ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un ong haba u shah pynshoi: namar U Blei um lah ban shah pynshoi da kaba sniew, lymne u pynshoi ia uno uno u briew:

en: Lift up your eyes , and behold them that come from the north : where is the flock that was given thee , thy beautiful flock ?
kha: Ko Jerusalem , ha khmih ! Ki nongshun jong pha ki wan hiar na shatei ! Hangno ki briew kiba la buh ha ka jingsumar jong pha , ki briew jong pha kiba pha la sngewsarong haduh katta katta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong me bad ha khmih ia kita kiba wan na shaphang shathie : hangno ka kynhun kaba la ai ha me , ka kynhun kaba itynnad jong me ?

en: Daniel spake and said , I saw in my vision by night , and , behold , the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea .
kha: Ki lyer ki beh kyrthep na ki liang baroh bad ki shoh ïa ka sla ka duriaw-bah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Daniel u la kren bad u la ong , Nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga ha ka por miet , bad , ha khmih , ki saw tylli ki Iyer bneng ki la iaid halor ka duriaw bah .

en: And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .
kha: Ngan pyntieng kulmar ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ia ki khnai ha khmat jong me, ki ban beh noh ia ki Hivite , ki nong Kana bad ki Hit , na khmat jong me .

en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods , and the high places , and brake down the images , and cut down the groves :
kha: U weng noh ïa ki duwan nongwei bad ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang , bad u ot noh ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la weng noh ia ki nongleh bymman bad ki jaka ba jrong bad u la pynpra ia ki dur bad u la ot ia ki khlaw:

en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee , which was given thee by prophecy , with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery .
kha: Wat leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingai ba kynja mynsiem kaba don ha me , ïa kaba la ai ha me mynba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren bad ki nongsharai balang    ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iehnoh ia ka jingai kaba don ha me, kaba la ai ha me da ka jingiathuhlypa , da kaba buh ia ki kti jong ka presbytery .

en: And he taught daily in the temple . But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him ,
kha: Man ka sngi , U Jisu u la hikai ha ka Templ . Ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hikai man ka sngi ha ka tempi . Hynrei ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh bad u rangbah jong ki briew ki la wad ban pynjot ia u .

en: And your altars shall be desolate , and your images shall be broken : and I will cast down your slain men before your idols .
kha: Ïa ki duwan yn pynjot noh bad ki duwan jingiwbih kin pra . Baroh ki briew kiba hangta kin shah pynïap ha khmat ki bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nonglehniam jong phi kin sa shah pynjot , bad ki dur jong phi kin sa shah pynpra: bad ngan bret noh ia ki briew kiba la shah pyniap jong phi ha khmat ki bleithaw jong phi .

en: For it shall be , that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest , so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon .
kha: Ki ap ha ki rudwah jong ka wah Arnon bad ki ïaid khlem jingmut shane shatai , kum ki sim kiba la shah beh noh na ki skum jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan long kumta, kumba ka sim kaba iaid kai ka mih na ka bniat, kumta ki khun kynthei jong ka Moab kin don ha ki khlaw jong u Arnon .

en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full , and drink blood till ye be drunken , of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you .
kha: Ynda haba nga pynïap ïa kine ki briew kum ki jingkñia , ki sim bad ki mrad ki dei ban bam lut ïa ka khleiñ haduh ba kin da ngiah bad dih ïa ka snam haduh ba kin da buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ia ka shini haduh ba phin da dap , bad dih snam haduh ba phin da dih kyiad na ka jingknia jong nga kaba nga la knia na ka bynta jong phi .

en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil  ; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment :
kha: Wat ïabud lang bad kiba bun paid haba ki leh ïa ka bymdei , ne haba ki ai sakhi ban pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bud ia u paidbah ban leh ia kaba sniew bad wat kren ha ka daw ban hiar hadien ba bun ban pynkhih ia ka jingbishar:

en: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,
kha: Haba u Barnabas bad u Paul ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba kin sa leh , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñphong bad ki la mareh sha pdeng u paidbah , da kaba pyrta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba haba ki apostol u Barnabas bad u Paul ki la iohsngew ia ka, ki la pynkhih ia ki jain jong ki bad ki la mareh shapoh ki briew ki da pyrta .

en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates : the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike , as the roebuck , and as the hart .
kha: Phi lah ban bam ïa ki ha ïing . Baroh na phi , la phi long kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban bam ia ka hapoh ki khyrdop jong me: u bymkhuid bad u briew uba khuid kin bam ia ka kumjuh kum u blang bad kum u blang .

en: O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .
kha: Phi kyang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U  Trai  ! Katno slem phin ïai talain ïa ka ? Khie leit phai noh sha ka jingsop , sah hangta bad shongthait !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ko waitlam jong U Trai, katno por kan long kaba sngap jar? buh ia lade ha ka sniehdoh jong me, shongthait bad to sah .

en: And Leah said , God hath given me my hire , because I have given my maiden to my husband : and she called his name Issachar .
kha: Ka Leah ka ong ,  U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka bainong jong nga , namar nga ai ïa la ka mraw ha la u tnga ;  kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Issakhar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Leah u la ong, U Blei u la ai ia nga ia ka bainong jong nga, namar nga la ai ia ka khun masi jong nga ha u tnga jong nga: bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Issakhar .

en: But those husbandmen said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and the inheritance shall be ours .
kha: Hynrei kita ki nongshimwai ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan sa long ka jong ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kita ki nongrep ki la ong hapdeng jong ki, Une u long u nongioh pateng ; to ngin pyniap ia u bad ka pateng kan long ka jong ngi .

en: He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?
kha: Da shisha ym U Blei , u bym shym la tyngkai wat ïa la u jong U Khun hi , hynrei uba la ai sngewbha ïa u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh ! U la ai ha ngi ïa la U Khun — hato un ym ai sngewbha ïa kiei kiei baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u bym shym la pyllait ia la u jong u Khun hynrei u la aiti noh ia u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh , kumno un ym ai da kaba laitluid ia kiei kiei baroh ?

en: ( Revelation 3 :14 ) Jesus himself said that he ‘ made God’s name known’ and kept ‘ bearing witness to the truth’ about God .
kha: ( Jingpynpaw 3 :14 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la ‘ pyntip ia ka kyrteng jong U Blei’ bad u la ïai “phla skhem ia ka jingshisha” shaphang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Ka Jingpynpaw 3 :14 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la pynlong ia ka kyrteng jong U Blei s ba la tip  bad u la iai bteng  ban sakhi ia ka jingshisha  shaphang U Blei .

en: And there shall be no more curse : but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it  ; and his servants shall serve him :
kha: Yn ym don kano kano kaba hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ïa kaba yn shem hapoh ka nongbah . Ka khet ka jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot kan don hapoh ka nongbah , bad ki shakri jong u kin mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym don shuh ka jingtim: hynrei ka khet U Blei bad u Khunlangbrot kan don ha ka ; bad ki shakri jong u kin shakri ia u:

en: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .
kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad phim shym shut pynnep ïa u , phi hap ban trei kham tyngeh ban pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kaba kham don jingmut ban pynkhreh lypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka nar ka long kaba jem , bad um ju pynkhih ia ka tduh , te u dei ban buh kham bun ka jingkhlain: hynrei ka jingstad ka long kaba myntoi ban bthah .

en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  Verily I say unto you , That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi : kan long kaba eh than ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ba u briew uba riewspah un ym rung sha ka hima bneng .

en: But when the first came , they supposed that they should have received more  ; and they likewise received every man a penny .
kha: Kumta haba ki rangbah kiba la long kiba nyngkong ban shah khot bylla ki la wan ban ïoh ïa ka bainong , ki la pyrkhat ba kin ïoh kham bun ; hynrei ïa ki ruh la ai mar shi sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba kaba nyngkong ka la wan , ki la pyrkhat ba ki la dei ban ioh kham bun ; bad kumjuh ruh ki la ioh ia uwei pa uwei u pisa .

en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon , Solomon built them , and caused the children of Israel to dwell there .
kha: U thymmai ruh ïa ki nongbah ba u syiem Hiram u la ai ïa u , bad u phah ïa ki Israel ban shongduh ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki shnong kiba u Hiram u la pynphai biang ia ki ha u Solomon , u Solomon u la tei ia ki bad u la pynlong ia ki khun Israel ban shong hangta .

en: Only thy holy things which thou hast , and thy vows , thou shalt take , and go unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose :
kha: Leit rah ïa ki jingainguh jong phi bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular sha U  Trai  tang sha kata ka jaka mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang kiei kiei kiba khuid jong me kiba me don bad ki jingkular jong me, me shim bad leit sha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied:

en: Thrice was I beaten with rods , once was I stoned , thrice I suffered shipwreck , a night and a day I have been in the deep ;
kha: Lai sien nga la shah paitlieng ; bad shisien nga la pynlut arphew saw kynta ha duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: La shoh ia nga da ki rod, shisien nga la shah pynkhih maw, nga la shah pynjot shipai, shi miet bad shisngi nga la don ha ka jaka ba jylliew ; .

en: And the four beasts said , Amen . And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever .
kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki la jubab ,  Amen !  Bad ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki saw tylli ki mrad ki la ong, Amen . Ki sawphew ngut ki rangbah ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ia uta uba im junom .

en: Do not ye yet understand , that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly , and is cast out into the draught ?
kha: Hato phim shemphang ? Kano kano kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew ka leit shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nangta pat shabar na ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim pat sngewthuh , ba kaei kaei kaba rung ha ka shyntur ka leit shapoh ka kpoh bad la bret noh ia ka sha ka um ?

en: The words of the wise are as goads , and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies , which are given from one shepherd .
kha: Ki jingong jong ki briew kiba stad ki long kum ki dieng banep kiba ki nongap langbrot ki pyndonkam ha kaba ïalam lynti ïa ki langbrot , bad ki proberb kiba la lum ki neh slem kum ki preg kiba la sah pynskhem . Ki long kiba la ai da U Blei , U Nongap Langbrot jong ngi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong kiba stad ki long kum ki blang , bad kum ki nail ba la pyndait da ki kynrad jong ki jingiaseng , kiba la ai na uwei u nongaplangbrot .

en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias  ; and on this wise shewed he himself .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la paw sa shisien pat ha la ki synran hajan ka duriaw Tiberias . Kane ka long kumno ka la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei U Jisu u la pyni biang ia lade ha ki synran ha ka duriaw Tibet bad halor kane u la pyni ia lade .

en: And they had tails like unto scorpions , and there were stings in their tails : and their power was to hurt men five months .
kha: Ki don ki tdong bad ki sni kum kito ki jong ka  ñianglartham , bad ka long da ki tdong jong ki ba ki don ka bor ban pynmong ïa ki briew haduh san bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki tdong kum ki khnai bad ki don ki sting ha ki tdong jong ki: bad ka bor jong ki ka long ban pynmong ia ki briew san bnai .

en: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence , and the violent take it by force .
kha: Naduh ka por ba u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u haduh kane ka sngi hi , ka Hima ki bneng ka la shah ïa ka jingleh jubor , bad ki nongleh jubor ki pyrshang ban kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh ki sngi u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis haduh mynta ka hima bneng ka shah thombor , bad ki leh donbor ki shim ia ka da ka bor .

en: And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .
kha: Kumta katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u la phah ïa u Uriah sha ka jaka ha kaba u tip ba u nongshun u khlaiñ bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Joab u la iohi ia ka shnong , ba u la aiti ia u Uriha ha ka jaka ha kaba u tip ba ki briew kiba shlur ki don .

en: For first of all , when ye come together in the church , I hear that there be divisions among you ; and I partly believe it .
kha: Ha kaba nyngkong eh , la ïathuh ïa nga ba ha ki jingïaseng jong phi , ki don ki kynhun kiba ïa-pyrshah ; bad kane nga ngeit ka don katto katne ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nyngkong eh, haba phi iawan lang ha ka balang , nga iohsngew ba ki don ki jingiapher hapdeng jong phi ; bad nga ngeit shi bynta ia kata .

en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold , and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate .
kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki dong kiba shaneng jong ka jingdeng shadem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar ha ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka ryntieh .

en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
kha: Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki ri nongwei , kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai , haba ngan sa pynphriang ia ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan sa pynpra ia ki ha ki ri .

en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up , and they shall be changed : but thou art the same , and thy years shall not fail .
kha: Men khylliap noh ïa ki kum ka sopti-lor , bad yn bujli ïa ki kum ïa ki jaiñ , hynrei me long borabor ujuh , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym kut shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kum ka jain phin pynkhih ia ki, bad kin kylla: hynrei me long kumjuh bad ki snem jong me kin ym jah noh .

en: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :
kha: Haba nga la wan sha ka pukri mynta ka sngi , nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , sngewbha ai ka jingjop ha nga ha kaei ba nga leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la poi ha kane ka sngi ha ka thliew bad nga la ong, ko Trai Blei jong u kynrad jong nga Abraham, lada mynta me pynroi ia ka lynti jong nga kaba nga leit:

en: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire , and earnestly looked upon him , and said , This man was also with him .
kha: Haba kawei na ki shakri kynthei ka la ïohi ïa u ba u shong hangta harud ding , ka la khmih shlip sha u bad ka la ong ,  Une u briew ruh u la don bad U Jisu !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei ka nongtrei ka la iohi ia u katba u dang shong hajan ka ding, bad ka la peit bniah ia u bad ka la ong: Une u briew ruh u la don ryngkat bad u .

en: But sin , taking occasion by the commandment , wrought in me all manner of concupiscence . For without the law sin was dead .
kha: Hynrei da kata ka hukum , ka pop ka la ïoh ka lad ban pynkhih ïa baroh ki jait jingkwah khwan myntoi kiba ha nga . Ha bym don ka hukum , ka pop ka long kaei kaei kaba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka pop, kaba shim por da ka hukum, ka la leh ha nga ia ka jinglong kaba rit paid baroh . Namar khlem ka hukum ka pop ka la iap .

en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .
kha: Ki jait Gad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , Bad ki jait Dan ki ïai don ha ki lieng . Ki jait Asher ki shongduh harud ka duriaw , Ki ïai don harud ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Gilead ka sah shabar Jordan : bad balei u Dan u sah ha ki lieng ? U Asher u la bteng ha rud duriaw , bad u la sah ha ki jingpynkhein jong u .

en: And she caught him by his garment , saying , Lie with me : and he left his garment in her hand , and fled , and got him out .
kha: Ka la tan ïa u na ka jaiñkup , bad ka ong ,  Ale thiah bad nga .  Hynrei u la lait phet bad u la mareh shabar da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup ha ka kti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la kem ia u da ka jain jong u, ka da ong, To leit noh bad nga: bad u la iehnoh ia ka jain jong u ha ka kti jong ka, bad u la phet noh bad u la pynmih noh ia u .

en: And Jehu gathered all the people together , and said unto them , Ahab served Baal a little  ; but Jehu shall serve him much .
kha: U Jehu u khot lang ïa ki briew jong ka Samaria , bad u ong ,  U syiem Ahab u la shakri ïa u blei Baal khyndiat , hynrei nga ngan shakri ïa u kham bun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la lum lang ia ki briew baroh, bad u la ong ha ki, u Ahab u la shakri khyndiat ia u Baal hynrei u Jehu un shakri shibun ia u .

en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?
kha: Ki la wan sha Kapernam , bad hadien ba u la rung shapoh ïing U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shaphang kaei phi la ïatainia hapdeng jong phi ha lynti ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha Kapernum: bad haba u la don ha iing u la kylli ia ki: Kaei kata kaba phi la ialeh pyrshah hapdeng jong phi ha lynti ?

en: And Saul armed David with his armour , and he put an helmet of brass upon his head  ; also he armed him with a coat of mail .
kha: U ai ïa ka jingkieng atiar ha u Dabid ban phong ; ïa ka tupia rnong u buh ha ka khlieh jong u Dabid , bad ïa ka jingphong atiar la pynkup ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la pynkhreh ia u Dabid da ka jainkup jong u, bad u la buh ia ka helmet nar ha ka khlieh jong u ; ruh u la pynkhreh ia u da ka jainkup mail .

en: And he said unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar s , and unto God the things which be God s .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Da kumta , te , siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , To ai ha u Kaisar ia kiei kiei kiba long u Kaisar, bad ha U Blei ia kiei kiei kiba long U Blei .

en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
kha: Mynno kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la long ha shuwa ne hadien ba la otsher ïa u Abraham ? Ka la long ha shuwa ym hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno la khein ia ka ? haba u la long ha ka jingotsher , ne ha ka jingbymkhuid ? Ym ha ka jingotsher , hynrei ha ka jingbymkhuid .

en: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt , so will I plead with you , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Mynta ngan pynrem ïa phi kumba nga la pynrem ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga la kyrpad ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka ri Ijipt , kumta ngan kyrpad ia phi , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Jesus answered them ,  I told you , and ye believed not : the works that I do in my Father s name , they bear witness of me .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la lah ïathuh ïa phi , hynrei phim ngeit ïa nga . Ki kam kiba nga leh ha ka bor u Kpa jong nga ki kren na ka bynta jong nga ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki, nga la ong ia phi, bad phim shym la ngeit: ki kam kiba nga leh ha ka kyrteng U Kpa jong nga, ki sakhi ia nga .

en: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother , and his mother s sister , Mary the wife of Cleophas , and Mary Magdalene .
kha: Kiba la ïa-ïeng ha syndah ka diengphna U Jisu ki la long ka kmie jong u , ka para jong ka kmie jong u , ka Mari ka tnga u Kleopas , bad ka Mari ka nong Magdala .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la ieng hajan ka diengphna U Jisu bad ka para jong u, ka Maria ka tnga jong u Cleopha bad ka Maria Magdala .

en: Then Joab arose , and came to Absalom unto his house , and said unto him , Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire ?
kha: U Joab u leit sha ka ïing jong u Absalom bad u la dawa ,  Balei ki shakri jong phi ki wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joab u la ieng bad u la wan sha iing jong u bad u la ong ha u: Balei ki shakri jong me ki la thang ia ka lyngkha jong nga ?

en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .
kha: Kin pynrem ïa u sha ka jingïap bad kin aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil , ki ban krenbeiñ ïa u , kin sympat ïa u , bad kin sahnarphna ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti ia u ha ki Jutang ban rkhie bein bad ban pynkhih ia u: bad ha ka sngi kaba lai un sa khie biang .

en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal , saying , Let Baal plead against him , because he hath thrown down his altar .
kha: Naduh kata ïa u Gideon la tip kum u Jerubbaal , namar u Joash u ong ,  Ieh u Baal un ïasaid da hi ïa lade ; ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha kata ka sngi u la khot ia u Jerubaal da kaba ong: To ai ba u Baal un kyrpad ia u namar u la pynhap ia ka ainguh jong u .

en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .
kha: Baroh kiba la ïapkhlam ki long khatsaw hajar hynñiewspah ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa kito kiba la ïap noh ha ka jingïaleh pyrshah u Korah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kito kiba la iap ha ka khlam ki long shiphew hajar hynriew spah ngut, nalor jong ki kiba la iap shaphang ka kam jong u Korah .

en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :
kha: Nangta pat , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Lachish u Joshua u la iaid sha Eglon, bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u; bad ki la ia shong shnong pyrshah ia ka:

en: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning , and bread and flesh in the evening  ; and he drank of the brook .
kha: U la dih um na ka wahduid bad ki tyngab ki wanrah kpu bad wanrah doh ïa u man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki blang ki la wanrah ia u kpu bad ka doh ha ka por mynstep , bad u kpu bad ka doh ha ka por janmiet bad u la dih na ka wah .

en: This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Une u dei ma u uba la thoh: Ha khmih nga phah ia u nonglam khubor jong nga ha khmat jong me, uba pynkhreh ia ka lynti jong me ha khmat jong me .

en: Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak unto him : and if he stand to it , and say , I like not to take her  ;
kha: Te ki nongïalam shnong kin khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u . Lada u dang kyntait ban shongkurim ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ka shnong jong u kin khot ia u bad kin kren ia u: bad lada u ieng ha ka bad u ong , Ngam sngewtynnad ban shim ia ka ; .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia ban pyndkut noh ïa ka spah jong ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei; ngan pynlong ruh ia ka kynhun jong ka ri Ijipt ban sangeh noh da ka kti u Neuchastrozzar syiem Babilon .

en: For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .
kha: Lada phi ki briew na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad phi kyntait ban bud ïa u mynta , sa shisien un iehnoh ïa kine ki briew baroh ha ka ri khlaw , bad phin kitkhlieh ïa ka jingpynjot thiaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi phai noh na u ; , un sa iehnoh biang ia ki ha ka ri khlaw bad phin pynjot ia kine ki briew baroh .

en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka ïa ka kti jong nga la kner ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingthmu kaba la thmu ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei: bad kane ka long ka kti kaba la pynjrong halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the  Lord  , as in the days of old , and as in former years .
kha: Nangta ki jingainguh ïa kiba ki paid Judah bad Jerusalem ki wallam sha U  Trai  kin long kiba pynsngewbha ïa u , kumba ki ju long ha ki por kiba la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka jingainguh jong u Judah bad ka Jerusalem kan long kaba sngewtynnad ia U Trai kumba ha ki sngi hyndai bad kumba ha ki snem kiba mynshuwa .

en: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink  ; for they could not drink of the water of the river .
kha: Ki nong Ijipt baroh ki ïatih shi lynter ïa ka rudwah baroh ban ïoh umdih , namar kim lah shuh ban dih ïa ka um na ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Ijipt baroh ki la tih sawdong ia ka wah ban dih ; namar kim lah ban dih ia ka um jong ka wah .

en: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , ko parabangeit , lada nga dang bteng ban ïalap ba ka jingotsher ka long kaba donkam , balei te ba nga dang shah pynshitom beiñ ? Lada kata ka la long kaba shisha , te ka jingïalap jong nga ïa ka diengphna U Khrist kan ym long daw jingeh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ko para bangeit, lada nga dang ialap ia ka jingkren bein, balei nga dang shah pynshitom bein ? nangta ka jingleh be-ijot jong ka diengphna ka la sangeh noh .

en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la don bad u Jehoshaphat namar u la iaid ha ki lynti ba nyngkong jong u kpa jong u u Dabid bad um shym la wad ia u Baalim ; .

en: I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .
kha: Nga pynshah da ka met sha kito kiba shoh ïa nga . Ngam shym pynsangeh ïa ki haba ki krenbeiñ ïa nga , haba ki patrong ïa ki shñiuh na u  ñiuhtmoh jong nga bad bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ai ia ka tyrpeng jong nga sha ki nongleh kam sniew, bad ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ha ki kiba la ot ia ki shniuh: ngam shym la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na ka jingsngewlehrain bad jingsma .

en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .
kha: Ko Syiem bakhlaiñbor , me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar hok ha Israel ; me la wanrah ïa ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhlain jong u syiem ruh ka ieit ia ka jingbishar ; me pynskhem ia ka jinglong marryngkat, me pyndep ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok ha u Jakob .

en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .
kha: Shet ïa nga kum kato ka jingbam bang kaba nga ju sngewtynnat , bad wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda nga la dep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh shuwa ba ngan ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynlong ia nga ka doh kaba thiang kumba nga ieit, bad wanrah ia ka ha nga, ba ngan bam ; ba ka mynsiem jong nga kan kyrkhu ia me shuwa ba ngan iap .

en: Now she that is a widow indeed , and desolate , trusteth in God , and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day .
kha: Ka riewkynthei kaba long tang marwei , ka bym don mano mano ban sumar ïa ka , ka la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei bad ka ïai duwai bad pan na u ïa ka jingïarap mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kata ka long kaba la duh shisha, bad kaba la jah rngai noh, ka shaniah ha U Blei , bad ka iai bteng ha ki jingkyrpad bad ki jingduwai miet bad sngi .

en: And hope maketh not ashamed ; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us .
kha: Kane ka jingkyrmen ka ai ha ngi ka jingkmen , namar U Blei u la theh noh ïa ka jingieit jong u ha ki dohnud jong ngi lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba long ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkyrmen kam pynlong ia ngi ban sngewlehrain ; namar ka jingieit U Blei ka la tuid shabar ha ki dohnud jong ngi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba la ai ha ngi .

en: Say , I pray thee , thou art my sister : that it may be well with me for thy sake  ; and my soul shall live because of thee .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba pha dei ka para jong nga ; khnang ba na ka bynta jong pha kin shah ïa nga ban im bad lehbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong , nga duwai ia me, me long ka para jong nga: ba kan long kaba bha bad nga na ka bynta jong me ; bad ka mynsiem jong nga kan im namar jong me .

en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers : for they indeed killed them , and ye build their sepulchres .
kha: Phi da lade hi phi phla , te , ba phi pdiang ïa kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh ; ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad phi tei ïa ki mot jingtep jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid phi sakhi ba phi ailad ia ki kam jong ki kpa jong phi: namar ki la pyniap shisha ia ki , bad phi tei ia ki jingtep jong ki .

en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u wan sha u , bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih , U Khunlangbrot jong U Blei , uba kit noh ïa ka pop jong ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Ioannis u iohi ia U Jisu ba u wan sha u, bad u ong: Ha khmih U Khunlangbrot U Blei uba weng noh ia ka pop jong ka pyrthei .

en: And they brought it . And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?  And they said unto him , Caesar s .
kha: Ki la wallam ïa kawei ka sbai rupa , bad u la kylli ,  Ka durkhmat bad ka kyrteng jongno kine ?   Ka jong u patsha ,  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka . Bad u ong ha ki, Ka dur bad ka jingthoh lyngkot jongno ? Ki la ong ha u, u Kaisar s .

en: And Joab said to Amasa , Art thou in health , my brother ? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him .
kha: U Joab u ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi long kumno , ko paralok jong nga ?  bad u bat ïa u Amasa na u  ñiuhtmoh jong u da la ka kti kamon ban doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ong ha u Amasa, Hato me long uba koit ba khiah, ko hynmen jong nga ? Bad u Joab u la shim ia u Ama da ka ryndang da ka kti kadiang ban kdup ia u .

en: Then again called they the man that was blind , and said unto him , Give God the praise : we know that this man is a sinner .
kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la khot biang ïa uta u briew ïa uba la kha matlah , bad ki la ong ha u ,  To kular ha khmat U Blei ba men ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ngi tip ba une u briew uba la pynkoit ïa me u dei u nongpop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la khot biang ia uta u briew uba la matlah bad ki la ong ha u: Ai ia U Blei ia ka jingiaroh: ngi tip ba une u briew u long u nongpop .

en: Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw wat ha ki nongwei kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lynti ; u ailad ïa iwei pa iwei ban tip ba u dei u bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ruh haba uta uba bieit u iaid lynti, ka jingstad jong u ka pynthut ia u, bad u ong ha uwei pa uwei ba u long uba bieit .

en: And humbled not himself before the  Lord  , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself  ; but Amon trespassed more and more .
kha: Hynrei ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym long uba pynrit ïa lade bad phai sha U  Trai  ; u kham long uba pop ban ïa kaba long u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la pynrit mynsiem ia lade ha khmat U Trai, kumba u kpa jong u u la pynrit mynsiem ia lade hynrei u Amon u la nang kham palat .

en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .
kha: Nga la ïai-ong borabor ba ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba duk ba u long uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , Ka Jingstad ka kham bha ban ia ka bor: wat la katta ruh ka jingstad jong u briew uba duk ka shah niewbein , bad ki ktien jong u kim shym la iohsngew .

en: And it came to pass , when Israel was strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute , and did not utterly drive them out .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki la khlaiñbor , ki la pynbor ïa ki Kanaan ban trei na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei kim shym la beh noh ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki Israel ki la khlain , ba ki la buh ia ki nong Kanaan ban siew khajna , bad kim shym la beh noh shisyndon ia ki .

en: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him ,  If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .
kha: U Petros u la pynbna ,  Da lei lei ha kano kano ka por men ym ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong nga .   Lada ngam ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong me ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  men ym ïoh long shuh u synran jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u ong ha u, Wat ju sait ia ki kjat jong nga . U Jisu u la jubab ia u , Lada ngam sait ia me , me don bynta bad nga .

en: And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .
kha: Ynda ki la poi , u Samuel u ïohi ïa u Eliab u khun jong u Jesse bad u ong ha lade ,  Une uba ïeng hangne ha khmat U  Trai  da shisha u dei uba U la jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki la wan, ba u peit ia u Eliab, bad u la ong: Hooid U Trai u la pynsleh u don ha khmat jong u .

en: But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .
kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang . U la leit sha uba kham san bad u la ong , ‘ Ko khun , khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ mynta ka sngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi pyrkhat aiu ? Uwei u briew u don arngut ki khun shynrang ; bad u la wan sha uba nyngkong bad u la ong: Ko khun, leit trei sngi ha ka kper sohjew jong nga .

en: And he spake to his disciples , that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude , lest they should throng him .
kha: U paidbah u la bun haduh katta katta ba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ban pynkhreh da ka lieng na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba ki briew kin ym tur kyrthep ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ha ki synran jong u, ba ka lieng rit kan ap ia u namar u paidbah , ioh kin pynkhih ia u .

en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan  ; and Lot journeyed east : and they separated themselves the one from the other .
kha: Kumta u Lot u jied ïa ka them Jordan baroh na ka bynta ïa lade bad u leit noh shaphang mihngi . Da kumta keiñ kine ar ngut ki la ïakhlad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Lot u la jied ia u baroh kawei ka madan Jordan ; bad u Lot u la leit shaphang mihngi : bad ki la pyniakhlad ia lade na uwei pat .

en: We have heard the fame thereof : our hands wax feeble : anguish hath taken hold of us , and pain , as of a woman in travail .
kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,  ong ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  bad ki kti jong ngi ki noh kyrwep , la kem ïa ngi da ka jinglyng-a bad ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la iohsngew ia ka nam jong ka: ki kti jong ngi ki la nang tlot: ka jingsngewsih ka la bat ia ngi, bad ka jingpang, kum ka kynthei ha ka jingtrei shitom .

en: Then spake Haggai the  Lord s  messenger in the  Lord s  message unto the people , saying , I am with you , saith the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ai ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai  ha u paidbah :  Ngan long ryngkat bad phi — kata ka long ka jingkular jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Haggai u nonglam khubor jong U Trai ha ka khubor jong U Trai ha ki briew , da kaba ong , Nga don ryngkat bad phi , ong U Trai .

en: But I tell you of a truth , there be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the kingdom of God .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don katto katne ngut hangne ki ban ym ïap tad ynda ki la ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ia phi ia ka jingshisha , don kiba ieng hangne , ki bym sngewtynnad ia ka jingiap , haduh ba kin da iohi ia ka hima U Blei .

en: And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
kha: Balei phi hap ban leit mynta ka sngi ?  u tnga jong ka u kylli .  Kam shym dei ka Sabbaton lane ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai .   Kam lei lei ,  ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Balei phi leit sha u ha ka sngi ? kam dei u bnai thymmai ne u bnai Sabha . Bad ka la ong , Kan long kaba bha .

en: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found : but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding .
kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki kren da ka jingshemphang , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba mutlop donkam ban pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki rmiang shyntur jong uta uba don ka jingstad kaba sngewthuh: hynrei u diengduh u long na ka bynta ka tyrpeng jong uta uba khlem jingmut .

en: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,
kha: Ki la shim ïa ki kynhun jingri , ki jingri , ki kada , bad baroh katba don ha shnong bad ha lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki langbrot jong ki bad ki masi jong ki bad ki kada jong ki bad ia kaba don ha sor bad kaba don ha lyngkha .

en: Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .
kha: Hynrei u la shah ïa ka jingshitom kaba la dei hok ïa ngi , ka jingpang kaba ngi la dei ban shah . Baroh shi katta ngi la pyrkhat ba ki jingshitom jong u ki la long ki jingpynshitom ba la phah da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid u la kit ia ki jingsngewsih jong ngi, bad u la kit ia ki jingsngewsih jong ngi: hynrei ngi la sngewsih ia u ba u la shah pynmong, u la shah pynmong ha U Blei bad u la shah pynshitom .

en: And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .
kha: U la ïohknieh ruh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi baroh ; ki briew jong u ki ñiah ïa kita ki jingri ha shuwa jong ki bad ki ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jong u Dabid !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim ia ki langbrot bad ki kynhun masi baroh kiba ki tan ha khmat kita kiwei pat ki masi bad u la ong: Kane ka dei ka jingjot jong u Dabid .

en: Then said he unto the disciples ,  It is impossible but that offences will come : but woe unto him , through whom they come !
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Kiei kiei kiba pynlong ïa ki briew ban hap ha ka pop ki dei ban jia , hynrei katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa uta uba pynlong ïa ki ban jia !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran, Kam lah ban long hynrei kata ka jingleh be-ijot kan wan: hynrei kordit ia u, lyngba jong u ki wan !

en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingmatlah jong u kam don ei ei bad ki pop jong u ne ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u . U la long matlah khnang ban ïohi ba ka bor jong U Blei ka trei ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Bad une u briew um shym la leh pop, ne ki kmie ki kpa jong u: hynrei ba ki kam U Blei kin paw ha u .

en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .
kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth , ki khun shynrang jong u Noah . Kine lai ngut ki la ïoh khun shynrang hadien kata ka jingshlei um .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki pateng jong u Noah, u Shem, u Ham bad u Japhet: bad ha ki la kha ia ki khun shynrang hadien ka jingshlei um .

en: And all these blessings shall come on thee , and overtake thee , if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , te kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh kin wan ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh kin wan ha me bad kin sa wan ha me lada me sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: These are wells without water , clouds that are carried with a tempest  ; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever .
kha: Kine ki briew ki long kum ki pukri ba la tyrkhong , kum ki lyoh ba la rong noh da ka  erïong ; U Blei u la buh tyngkai ïa ka jaka na ka bynta jong ki ha ka jingdum tliw tliw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki thliew khlem um , ki lyoh kiba la rah da ka eriong ; ha kiba la buh kyrpang ia ka lyer jong ka jingdum junom .

en: Look unto Abraham your father , and unto Sarah that bare you : for I called him alone , and blessed him , and increased him .
kha: Puson halor u kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , bad ka Sarah , na kiba phi hiarpateng . Mynba nga la khot ïa u Abraham , u la long uba khlem khun , hynrei nga la kyrkhu ïa u bad nga la ai ki khun ïa u ; Nga la pynroi ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia u Abraham u kpa jong phi, bad ia ka Sarah kaba kha ia phi: namar nga la khot ia u marwei, bad nga la kyrkhu ia u, bad nga la pynroi ia u .

en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants  ; that they may know my service , and the service of the kingdoms of the countries .
kha: Ka Jerusalem kan ym mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga , hynrei u Shishak un jop ïa ki , bad kin ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng ka jingshakri ïa nga bad ka jingshakri ïa ki nongsynshar pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh kin long ki shakri jong u ; ba kin tip ia ka jingshakri jong nga bad ka jingshakri jong ki hima jong ki ri .

en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man , so the company of priests murder in the way by consent : for they commit lewdness .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki long kum ka kynhun ki nonglute kiba apthap ïa u briew . Wat ha ka lynti sha ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem ki pynïap briew . Bad ki leh ïa kane kaba sniew baroh da kaba thmu lypa !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ki shipai ki ap ia u briew, kumta ka kynhun ki lyngdoh ka pyniap briew ha ka lynti da ka jingmynjur: namar ki leh ia ka jingleh be-ijot .

en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .
kha: Ka jingsawa ka turoi ruh ka nang jam nang jam . U Moses u la kren , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sur jong ka turoi ka la sawa kham jem bad kham jem , u Moses u la kren , bad U Blei u la jubab ia u da ka sur .

en: Rather , God’s Word teaches that you are a soul , that your soul is really you , with all your physical and mental qualities .
kha: Hynrei ka ktien u Blei ka hikai ba mangi ngi long ka mynsiem , ba ka mynsiem ka dei shisha mangi , ha ka met bad ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad baroh ka jinglong jongngi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei , U Blei s Ka ktien ka hikai ba phi long ka mynsiem , ba ka mynsiem jong phi ka long shisha ma phi , da ki jinglong met bad jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi baroh .

en: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the  Lord  , where the ark of God was , and Samuel was laid down to sleep  ;
kha: u Samuel pat u thiah hapoh ka jaka kyntang ha kaba don ka Synduk ka Jutang . Shuwa ban kynjat shai katba ka sharak ka dang meh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih ha ka tempi U Trai, ha kaba ka synduk U Blei ka don, bad u Samuel u la thiah;

en: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields , came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,
kha: Hadien kane , u Johanan bad ki nongïalam jong ki shipai ki bym shym la pyndem ki la wan ha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki la ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Johanan u khun u Krea bad ki rangbah shipai baroh kiba don ha ki lyngkha ki la wan sha Gedaliah sha Mizpah .

en: Behold , I will bring it health and cure , and I will cure them , and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth .
kha: Hynrei ngan sa pynkhiah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ki briew jong ka bad ngan pynïoh pat ha ki ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah . Ngan pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingsuk kyrhai bad ka jingshongshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingpynkhiah ia ki , bad ngan pynpaw ha ki ia ka jingbun jong ka jingsuk bad ka jingshisha .

en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .
kha: Wat ki paralok jong nga ki rkhie ïa nga mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga long uba hok bad u bym shah kynnoh pop ; hynrei ka don ka por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long kum uwei uba la rkhie bein ia u paramarjan jong u, uba khot ia U Blei, bad u jubab ia u: u briew uba hok u la rkhie bein .

en: And thou shalt be blessed  ; for they cannot recompense thee : for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just .
kha: bad men long uba la kyrkhu , namar kim lah ban siew kylliang ïa me . U Blei un siew pat ïa me ha ka sngi ba ki briew kiba bha ki mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban long uba la kyrkhu ; namar kim lah ban siew kylliang ia me: namar me shah pynshitom ha ka jingmihpat jong kiba hok .

en: And if any man hear my words , and believe not , I judge him not : for I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .
kha: Lada uno uno u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga bad um kohnguh ïa ka , ngan ym bishar ïa u . Nga la wan , ym ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hynrei ban pynim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga bad um ngeit, ngam bishar ia u: namar ngam shym la wan ban bishar ia ka pyrthei hynrei ban pynim ia ka pyrthei .

en: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses : and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men .
kha: Ki Lebi ki la kohnguh , bad ki la pynïap kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Lebi ki la leh kat kum ka ktien u Moses: bad ka la hap na ki briew ha kata ka sngi kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew .

en: And when the time was that Elkanah offered , he gave to Peninnah his wife , and to all her sons and her daughters , portions :
kha: Man ka por ba u Elkanah u kñia ainguh , u ju ai shi bynta na ka doh ha ka Peninnah bad shi bynta ha uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki kti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka por ka la long ba u Elkanah u la tyrwa, u la ai ha ka Peninnah ia ka tnga jong u, bad ha ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ka baroh:

en: Because he hath set his love upon me , therefore will I deliver him : I will set him on high , because he hath known my name .
kha: U Blei u ong ,  Ngan pynim ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , bad ngan ïada ïa kito kiba ithuh ïa nga kum U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la buh ia ka jingieit jong u ha nga: Ngan buh ia u ha jrong , namar u la ithuh ia ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: Who then is a faithful and wise servant , whom his lord hath made ruler over his household , to give them meat in due season ?
kha: Uno , te , uba long u shakri uba lah ban shaniah bad uba stad ? U dei uta ïa uba u kynrad jong u , u la buh ban khmih ïa kiwei pat ki shakri ban ai jingbam ïa ki ha ka por kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano te u shakri uba iaineh bad uba stad, uba u kynrad jong u u la pynlong ia u ban synshar halor ka iing jong u , ban ai bam ia ki ha ka por kaba biang ?

en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land , which I sware to give unto your fathers ,
kha: ‘ Na kane ka pateng bymman , yn ym don uwei ruh u ban ïoh leit rung ha kata ka ri kaba seisoh ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ym don uwei ruh na kine ki briew kiba sniew uba iohi ia kata ka ri kaba bha kaba nga sngap jar ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen , and disperse thee in the countries , and will consume thy filthiness out of thee .
kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong pha sha man ki ri bad ki hima bad ngan pynkut noh ïa ki kam sniew jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia me hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan pynphriang ia me ha ki ri , bad ngan bam ia ka jingjakhlia jong me na me .

en: And when he had so said , he shewed unto them his hands and his side . Then were the disciples glad , when they saw the Lord .
kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u la pyn-i ha ki ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ka krung . Ki synran ki la dap da ka jingkmen haba ki la ïohi ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ong kumta, u la pyni ha ki kti bad ka liang jong u . Nangta ki synran ki la sngewbha haba ki la iohi ia U Trai .

en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit jingmut bha ïa kaei kaba u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shahshkor ïa u bad ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew da kawei ka jingmut ki la sngap ia kiei kiei kiba u Philip u la kren , ki la iohsngew bad iohi ia ki kambah kiba u la leh .

en: For every head shall be bald , and every beard clipped : upon all the hands shall be cuttings , and upon the loins sackcloth .
kha: Baroh na ki , ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la khapnoh ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh . Baroh ki la pynmong ïa la ki kti , bad uwei pa uwei u phong ïa ki jaiñ khain .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka khlieh kan long kaba jem, bad kawei pa kawei ka ryndang kan long kaba jem: ha ki kti baroh kin long ki jingot , bad ha ki tyrpeng kin long kiba jem .

en: Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .
kha: Man ka snem , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , phi dei ban ïabam ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban bam ia ka ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me man la u snem ha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied ma me bad ka iing jong me .

en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .
kha: Ki pyndep ïa ka Templ ha ka sngi kaba lai jong u bnai Adar ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u patsha Darius .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka iing ka la dep ha ka sngi kaba lai jong u bnai Adar kaba la long ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Darius u syiem .

en: And before this , Eliashib the priest , having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God , was allied unto Tobiah :
kha: U Eliashib lyngdoh , uba khmih halor ki kamra buh tiar ka Templ , la slem u la don hapdeng ka jingïadei jingmut bad u Tobiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shuwa kane , u Eliashib u lyngdoh uba don ka jingpeit ia ka kamra jong ka iing U Blei jong ngi:

en: Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka jingpynjot ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kan long kaba da shyrkhei haduh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Edom un long ka jingpynjot: uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba jong ka un sngew lyngngoh , bad un sngap jar ia ki khniang baroh .

en: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .
kha: To pynkloi ban wan shuwa ka tlang . U Ïubulos bad u Pudens bad u Linos bad ka Klaudia bad kumjuh ruh kiwei pat ki parabangeit baroh ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To leh ia ka jingminot jong me ban wan shuwa ka por lyiur . U Eubulus u ai khublei ia me, bad ki Pudens, bad u Linus, bad u Claudia, bad ki para baroh .

en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .
kha: Ka jinglaitluid ka long kaei kaba ngi don — dei U Khrist u la pyllait ïa ngi ! Ïeng te , kum ki briew kiba laitluid , bad wat shah ïa lade ban long pat ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: To ieng skhem namarkata ha ka jinglaitluid kaba U Khrist u la pyllait im ia ngi, bad wat shah pynthut biang bad ka jinglong mraw .

en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead , some mocked : and others said , We will hear thee again of this matter .
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul u kren shaphang ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap , katto katne na ki , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u , hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  Ngi kwah ban ïohsngew ba men kren biang ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohsngew ia ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap, don kiba rkhie bein: bad kiwei pat ki la ong: Bad ngin sa iohsngew biang ia me shaphang kane ka kam .

en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities and their villages .
kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Issakhar kat kum ki longiing jong ki , ki nongbah bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: And I took my staff , even Beauty , and cut it asunder , that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people .
kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u dieng uba la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad nga la kdiah ïa u , ban pyndam noh ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia u diengduh jong nga, wat ia ka Jingitynnad, bad nga la ot ia ka shapoh khyndew, ba ngan pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la leh bad ki briew baroh .
