en: And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter ,  Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?
kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat bad u la shem ïa ki lai ngut ki synran ba ki ïohthiah . U la ong ha u Petros ,  Ko Simon , me ïohthiah ? Hato mem lah ban ïaishah bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u wan, bad u lap ia ki ba ki dang thiah, bad u ong ha u Petros, ko Simon, me thiah ?

en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them , who departed from them from Pamphylia , and went not with them to the work .
kha: hynrei u Paul um shym pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei ban ïalam ïa u , namar um shym la sah bad ki haduh kaba kut ka kam jong ki , hynrei u la leit phai pat bad u la iehnoh ïa ki ha Pamphylia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Paul um shym la pyrkhat bha ban shim ia u bad ki, uba la leit noh na ki na Pamphylia bad um shym la leit bad ki sha ka kam .

en: By faith Jacob , when he was a dying , blessed both the sons of Joseph  ; and worshipped , leaning upon the top of his staff .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa U Jakob ha shuwa ba un ïap ban kyrkhu ïa uwei pa uwei u khun shynrang jong u Joseph . U la shan ha ka tduh u diengduh jong u bad u la mane ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Jakob haba u dang iap , u la kyrkhu ia baroh arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Joseph bad u la mane ia u;

en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .
kha: Nalor baroh , wat ïa uba bieit la pyrkhat ba u long uba stad bad shemphang lada u shu shong jar jar bad set ïa la ka shyntur .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat u briew uba bieit ruh haba u bat ia ka jingsuk jong u: bad uta uba khang ia ki rmiang shyntur jong u la khein ia u briew uba sngewthuh .

en: And it came to pass , as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her , to lie by her , or to be with her .
kha: Wat la ka kyrpad ïa u Joseph man la ka sngi , um treh ban leit thiah bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ka dang kren ha u Joseph man ka sngi, ba um shym la sngap ia ka, ban thiah hajan jong ka ne ban don ryngkat bad ka .

en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .
kha: namar ba ki khun ki ksiew kynthei jong u bad ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh jaka . Ïa ka ri Gilead la ai ha kiba sah jong ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khun kynthei jong u Manasseh ki don ka pateng hapdeng ki khun shynrang jong u: bad kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u ki don ka ri Gilead .

en: And , behold , there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue , Jairus by name  ; and when he saw him , he fell at his feet ,
kha: U Jairos , u rangbah synshar ka synagog hangta , u la wan poi , bad haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , u la dem ha ki kjat jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei na ki nongsynshar jong ka synagog , u Jairus da ka kyrteng ; bad haba u la iohi ia u , u la dem ha la ki kjat .

en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei ruh phin ym ïoh jinghun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba phi kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ieit ia ka rupa un ym sngewhun ia ka rupa ; lymne ia uta uba ieit ia ka jingbun bad ka jingbun: kane ruh ka long kaba khlem akor .

en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .
kha: Ki shympriah kjat — shi bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha — ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba khlaiñ bad shi bynta jong ka kaba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba ki tyrpeng jong ki kjat ki long shi bynta na ka nar, bad shi bynta na ka dewbilat , kumta ka hima kan long shi bynta kaba khlain bad shi bynta kaba la tyrkhong .

en: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
kha: Hynrei ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tieng palat bad ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, "Mano une u briew, ba wat ka Iyer bad ka duriaw ruh ki kohnguh ia u ?

en: And when they were gone aside , they talked between themselves , saying , This man doeth nothing worthy of death or of bonds .
kha: bad hadien ba ki la mihnoh , ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Une u briew um shym leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïap ne ban shah set phatok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit noh shawei pat, ki la ia kren hapdeng jong ki, ki da ong: Une u briew um leh ei ei kaba dei ban iap ne ban teh .

en: Now that being broken , whereas four stood up for it , four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation , but not in his power .
kha: Ki saw tylli ki reng kiba la wan mih shalor haba la pynkheiñ noh ïa ka reng kaba nyngkong ki ïeng na ka bynta ki saw tylli ki hima sha kiba kata ka hima yn pynïabynta bad kin ym long kiba khlaiñ kum ka hima kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kata ka la shah pynpra, katba saw tylli ki hima kin ieng na ka jaitbynriew , hynrei ym ha ka bor jong u .

en: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .
kha: Ngam tip la u dei u nongpop ne um dei ,  uta u briew u la phai ktien .  Tang ïa kane kawei nga tip : Nga la long uba matlah , bad mynta nga la imat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong: La u long u nongpop ne em, ngam tip: kawei kaba nga tip, kata , katba nga dang matlah , mynta nga iohi .

en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .
kha: u dei ban shah pynshitom kumba u thmu ban leh ïa la u para . Da kumta phin rat noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin leh ia u kumba u la pyrkhat ban leh ia u hynmen jong u: kumta to weng noh ia kaba sniew na pdeng jong phi .

en: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden : for , behold , from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed .
kha: naba u la kynmaw ïa nga , ka shakri barit jong u ! Naduh mynta ki briew baroh kin khot ïa nga , kaba kmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la pyrkhat ia ka jaka kaba rit jong u: namar, ha khmih, naduh mynta ki pateng baroh kin khot ia nga ba nga long uba la kyrkhu .

en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and shall be joined unto his wife , and they two shall be one flesh .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Namar kane ka daw , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïalong kawei bad la ka tnga , bad ki ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw kane u briew un iehnoh ia la u kpa bad ka kmie bad un iasoh bad ka tnga jong u bad ki arngut kin long kawei ka doh .

en: And he looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no man , he slew the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .
kha: U Moses u peit shane shatai , bad haba u ïohi ba ym don mano mano ba peit sha u , u pynïap ïa u , bad u tep ïa u hapoh u shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit kumne kumta bad kumta, bad haba u la iohi ba ym don briew, u la pyniap ia u nong Ijipt bad u la buhrieh ia u ha ka dewbilat .

en: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price , and that for all thy sins , even in all thy borders .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan phah ïa ki nongshun ban kit noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki briew jong nga , khnang ban pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta ki pop kiba ki la leh ha kylleng ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon jong me bad ki spah jong me ngan ai sha ka jingjot khlem dor , bad kata na ka bynta ki pop jong me baroh , wat ha ki pud jong me baroh .

en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai . . .    ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka shiphew snem, ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka hok ba-pura ban rung sha ka Hima bymjukut jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta ka jingrung kan long kaba la shakri ha phi shibun eh ha ka hima bymjukut jong U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .
kha: Lada kawei ka dkhot jong ka met ka shitom , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lem bad ka ; lada kawei ka dkhot met ka ïoh jingïaroh , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la uwei u dkhot u shah shitom, baroh ki dkhot ki shah shitom bad ka ; ne uwei u dkhot u shah burom , baroh ki dkhot ki ia kmen bad ka .

en: Because thou servedst not the  Lord  thy God with joyfulness , and with gladness of heart , for the abundance of all things  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa phi ha ki bynta baroh , hynrei phim shym shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kaba sngewbha bad kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka jingkmen bad da ka jingkmen ka dohnud, namar ka jingbun kiei kiei baroh;

en: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .
kha: Kine ki syiem baroh ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan lang ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Meron ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kine ki syiem baroh ki la iakynduh lang , ki la wan bad ki la ia tyngkhuh lang ha ki um Merom , ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: And upon her forehead was a name written , MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH .
kha: Ha ka shyllangmat jong ka , la thoh ïa ka kyrteng kaba don ka jingmut kaba rieh :  Ka Babilon Bakhraw , ka kmie jong ki nuti baroh bad kiba sakma baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ka khlieh jong ka la thoh ia ka kyrteng , KA JINGPYNBNA , KA JINGPYNBNA IA KI JINGPYNBNA .

en: The field is the world  ; the good seed are the children of the kingdom  ; but the tares are the children of the wicked one  ;
kha: ka lyngkha ka long ka pyrthei ; u symbai babha u long ki briew kiba long ki jong ka Hima ; ki ñiut ki long ki briew kiba long ki jong Uta u Basniew ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lyngkha ka long ka pyrthei ; u symbai uba bha ki long ki khun jong ka hima ; hynrei ki tar ki long ki khun jong kiba sniew ; .

en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
kha: Me hi men ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ka ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la don ka jingpang kaba khraw da ka jingpang sniehdoh jong me, haduh ba ki bniat jong me kin hap noh na ka jingpang man ka sngi .

en: And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
kha: Men ïoh im uba skhem bad uba dap da ka jingkyrmen ; U Blei un ïada bad un ai jingjahthait ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban long uba shngain, namar ka don ka jingkyrmen ; hooid , men tih sawdong jong me, bad men shim ia ka jingjahthait jong me ha ka jingshngain .

en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the  Lord  , because the glory of the  Lord  had filled the  Lord s  house .
kha: Namar ba ka Templ ka la dap da ka jingshai batyngshaiñ , ki lyngdoh kim shym lah ban rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh kim lah ban rung shapoh iing U Trai , namar ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ia ka iing U Trai .

en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals to a bullock , and two tenth deals to one ram ,
kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ki kan long kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang, lai tylli ki jingai sngewbha ia u masi bad ar tylli ki jingai sngewbha ia uwei u langbrot .

en: Have we not power to lead about a sister , a wife , as well as other apostles , and as the brethren of the Lord , and Cephas ?
kha: Hato ngim don hok ban bud ïa ki nuksa jong kiwei pat ki apostol bad jong ki para jong U Trai bad u Petros , da kaba ïalam ïa ka tnga kaba long ka parabangeit ha ki jingleit lynti jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngim don bor ban ialam ia ka para kynthei, ka tnga bad kumjuh ruh ia kiwei pat ki apostol bad kum ki hynmen U Trai bad u Kephas ?

en: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .
kha: U Amasaïah u pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia u Edom ha ka them ka umsoh shi hajar snem , bad u la shim ia ka Sela da ka thma , bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Joktheel haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And it came to pass , when Moses held up his hand , that Israel prevailed : and when he let down his hand , Amalek prevailed .
kha: Katba u Moses u dang rah shajrong ïa la ki kti , ki Israel ki jop , hynrei haba u pynhiar shapoh ïa la ki kti , ki Amalek ki jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Moses u la bat ia la ka kti, ba ki Israel ki la jop: bad haba u la pynhap ia la ka kti, u Amalek u la jop .

en: And the Chaldeans burned the king s house , and the houses of the people , with fire , and brake down the walls of Jerusalem .
kha: Ha kata ka por , ki nong Babilonia ki la thang duh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad ïa ki ïing jong ki briew bad pynpra ïa ki kynroh ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Khaldes ki la thang ia ka iing syiem bad ki iing jong ki briew da ka ding bad ki la pynpra ia ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air , and unto the beasts of the earth , and no man shall fray them away .
kha: Ynda phi ïap , ki sim bad ki mrad kin bam ïa ki metïap jong phi , bad yn ym don ba leit beh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka met jong me kan long ka doh ha ki sim baroh jong ka Iyer bad ha ki mrad khlaw jong ka khyndew , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynpra ia ki .

en: But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .
kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , phi dei ban ngeit bad ban ym artatien da lei lei . Uno uno uba artatien u long kum ka jingat phyllung ha ka duriaw ïa kaba la beh bad ba la pynshad kynting da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba un kylli da ka jingngeit, ym don ei ei kaba khih . Na ka bynta uta uba khih u long kum ka um duriaw kaba la beh da ka Iyer bad u la tyrkhong .

en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him ?
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba donbor , bad da u ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba iohi ba u Abraham un long shisha ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba khlain bor bad ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu ha u ?

en: Besides the cakes , he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings .
kha: Nalor kita , u dei ruh ban wanrah kum ka jingainguh ïa ki kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ki cake , un aiti na ka bynta ka jingainguh jong u ia u kpu ba la khleh lang bad ka jingknia ainguh ia ki jingainguh jingsuk jong u .

en: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried , and she bound him with them .
kha: Kumta kita ki syiem Philistia ki wanrah ha ka Delilah hynñiew tylli ki  saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , bad ka khum ïa u Samson da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la wanrah ha ka hynriew tylli ki khniang kiba jyrngam ki bym pat tyrkhong , bad ka la teh ia u bad ki .

en: What then ? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for ; but the election hath obtained it , and the rest were blinded
kha: Kaei pat te ngin ïa-ong ? Ki paid Israel kim shym la shem ïa kaei kaba ki ïawad . Ka la long tang ka kynhun kaba rit kaba U Blei u la jied , kaba la shem ïa kata ; kiba sah na kita ki la set kyllut ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata ? Ki Israel kim shym la ioh ia kaei kaba u wad na ka bynta u ; hynrei ka elekshon ka la ioh ia ka, bad kiwei pat ki la matlah .

en: For then shall be great tribulation , such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time , no , nor ever shall be .
kha: Namar ka jingjynjar ha kata ka por kan kham shyrkhei ban ïa kano kano kaba la ju jia , naduh kaba sdang jong ka pyrthei haduh kane ka sngi . Lymne ba yn don pat kano kano kum kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ka por kan long ka jingjynjar kaba khraw, kumba ym shym la long naduh ka jingsdang jong ka pyrthei haduh kane ka por , em , lymne kan ym long kumta .

en: And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :
kha: Ka long kaba shisha ,  u Akhan u jubab ,  nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Achan u la jubab ia u Joshua , bad u la ong: Hooid nga la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel bad kumta bad kumta nga la leh:

en: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother , Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye  ; and , behold , a beam is in thine own eye ?
kha: Kumno phi nud ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Sngewbha , shah ïa nga ban khlaw noh ïa u thngiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ haba phi don ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane kumno phin ong ia u hynmen jong me , To ngan sei ia ka mot na ka khmat jong me ; bad , ha khmih , ka beam ka don ha la ka jong ka khmat ?

en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .
kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon noh , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , bad ki briew jong ki , ki kyndit ha kata ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki dulir kin khih ha ka sngi ba phi hap ; hooid , ki dulir kiba don ha duriaw kin sa shah pynshitom ha ka por ba phi leit noh .

en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you , that I also may be of good comfort , when I know your state .
kha: Lada ka long ka mon U Trai , nga kyrmen ba nga lah ban phah shen sha phi ïa u Timothi , khnang ba nga lah ban ïoh ka jingpynshlur da ka khubor shaphang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga shaniah ha U Trai Jisu ban phah ia u Timothi tang khyndiat por sha phi , ba nga ruh ngan long uba pyntngen shibun , haba nga tip ia ka jinglong jong phi .

en: Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , U Khun U Briew un leh kumjuh ïa u ha khmat ki angel jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga ong ha phi , Uno uno uba phla ia nga ha khmat ki briew , ma u ruh u Khun u briew un phla ha khmat ki angel U Blei:

en: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .
kha: U Jisu u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u la khot ïa ki ; ki la iehnoh ïa la u kpa jong ki , u Sebedi ha ka lieng ryngkat bad ki rangbah kiba trei bylla , bad ki la leit bad U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta u la khot ia ki: bad ki la iehnoh ia u kpa jong ki ha ka lieng bad ki shakri ba la siew bai bylla bad ki la leit bud ia u .

en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na khmat U  Trai  bad u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met jong u Job .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Soitan u la leit noh na khmat U Trai, bad u la pynkhih ia u Job da ki jingkhluit kiba jur na ka tyrpeng jong u haduh ka khlieh jong u .

en: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off , and to destroy it from off the face of the earth .
kha: Kane ka pop kaba u la leh ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingduh jingdam noh ka longïing syiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kaei kaei ka la kylla long ka pop ha ka iing u Jeroboan , wat ban ot noh ia ka bad ban pynjot ia ka na ka khmat ka khyndew .

en: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
kha: Don ki briew kiba pynlut kai ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai riewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don kata kaba la saphriang, bad wat la katta ruh ka nang kiew; bad don kata kaba kham bun ban ia kaba iakynduh, hynrei ka kham sngewtynnad ia ka jingduk .

en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father , and departed not from it , doing that which was right in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Asa , ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid ha ka lynti jong u kpa jong u, bad um shym la leit noh na ka , da kaba leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai .

en: Then I sent unto him , saying , There are no such things done as thou sayest , but thou feignest them out of thine own heart .
kha: Nga phah ka jubab sha u :  Ym don na kaei kaba phi ong ba ka long kaba dei . Phi la shu thaw hi da lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la phah sha u, da kaba ong: Ym don kum kita kiei kiei kiba la leh kumba me ong, hynrei me pynlong ia ki na ka dohnud jong me hi .

en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them , nor be an help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach .
kha: ki briew jong ka Judah kin babe ba ki la shaniah ha kata ka hima ka bym lah ban shaniah , ka hima ka bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki haba ki khmih lynti ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la sngewlehrain ia ka jaitbynriew kaba ym lah ban pynmyntoi ia ki, lymne ban long ka jingiarap ne ka jingmyntoi, hynrei ka jinglehrain , bad ruh ka jingshah lehbein .

en: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers . For there is no power but of God : the powers that be are ordained of God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar , namar ym don ka bor khlem ka jingaibor jong U Blei , bad ïa ki bor synshar kiba don mynta la buh hangta da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kan long hapoh ki bor kiba kham halor . Namar ym don bor hynrei tang jong U Blei: ki bor kiba la buh da U Blei .

en: And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .
kha: U la leit kham ha pajih , u la dem pyllup ha khyndew , bad u la duwai ba lada don ka lad , un ym hap ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka por jong ka jingshah shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid shakhmat khyndiat bad u la dem khrup bad u la duwai ba lada lah, ka kynta kan iaid noh na u .

en: Now as he was speaking with me , I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground : but he touched me , and set me upright .
kha: Mynba u dang kren , nga la kyllon ha madan khlem tipbriew . Hynrei u la bat ïa nga , u la khyllie pynïeng ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba u dang kren bad nga, nga la iohthiah jylliew ha ka khmat jong nga shapoh khyndew : hynrei u la ktah ia nga, bad u la buh ia nga beit .

en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .
kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Naphtali kat kum ki longiing jong ki , ki nongbah bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him , and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .
kha: U Joshua u la leh kumba u Moses u la hukum ïa u , bad u la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , katba u Moses , u Aaron , bad u Hur ki la leit kiew sha kliar u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la leh kumba u Moses u la ong ha u: bad u Moses, u Aaron bad u Hur ki la kiew sha jrong jong u lum .

en: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the  Lord  , and to do it , and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments .
kha: U Esra u la aiti ïa la ka jingim ha kaba pule ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai  , ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ka , bad ha kaba hikai ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Esra u la pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong u ban wad ia ka hukum U Trai , bad ban leh ia kata , bad ban hikai ha Israel ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar .

en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .
kha: Hynrei to phin nang roi ha ka jingaiei bad ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi . Ha u , to long ka burom , mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to roi ha ka jingaiei , bad ha ka jingtip ia U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi U Jisu Khrist . Ha u to long ka burom mynta bad junom . Amen .

en: And he knew it , and said , It is my son s coat  ; an evil beast hath devoured him  ; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces .
kha: U ruh u ithuh ïa ka , bad u ong ,  Ho-oid , ka dei ka sopti jong u ! U mradkhlaw aïu re u la pynïap ïa u . Ïa u Joseph u khun jong nga la tar lyngkhot lyngkhai !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tip ia kata, bad u la ong, Ka long ka jain jong u khun jong nga; u mrad uba sniew u la bam ia u ; u Joseph u la shah rong noh khlem artatien .

en: Go up to Lebanon , and cry  ; and lift up thy voice in Bashan , and cry from the passages : for all thy lovers are destroyed .
kha: Ko phi ki briew ka Jerusalem , khie leit sha Lebanon bad pyrta jam , khie leit sha ka ri Bashan bad to kyang ; pyrta na ki lumbah ka Moab , namar baroh kiba ïateh lok bad phi ki la shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha Lebanon, bad to iam bad pynkiew ia ka sur jong me ha Basan, bad to iam na ki lynti: namar ki nongieit jong me baroh ki la shah pynjot .

en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men , all lusty , and all men of valour  ; and there escaped not a man .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki la pynïap kumba shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Moab kiba kynsai tam ; ym don uwei na ki ruh uba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyniap ia u Moab ha kata ka por kumba shi hajar ngut ki briew, baroh ki briew kiba thrang ; bad ym don briew uba lait im .

en: But ye say , Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother , It is a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ;
kha: Hynrei phi hikai ba lada u briew u don kaei kaei kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ban ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ïa la ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka jong U Blei ,’ um donkam ban burom ïa la u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi ong , Uno uno uba ong ha la u kpa ne ka kmie jong u , Ka long ka jingai sngewbha , da kaba phi lah ban ioh jingmyntoi na nga ; .

en: For David is not ascended into the heavens : but he saith himself , The  Lord  said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
kha: Naba ym shym dei u Dabid uba la leit kiew sha bneng ; pynban u la ong :   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Dabid um shym la kiew sha bneng: hynrei u ong hi: U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga: To shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga .

en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;
kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u la leh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kambah jong u bad ki kam jong u, kiba u la leh hapdeng ka ri Ijipt ha u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt bad ha ka ri jong u baroh;

en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .
kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u shabuk , ka jingriew ki shalyntem , ka jingsawa ka jingïaid ki kulai , ka jingkynthih jong ki kali ïapom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong ka whip , bad ka jingsawa jong ki tyrpeng , bad ki kulai kiba iaid , bad ki kali kiba jngi .

en: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .
kha: U Abraham u leit phai pat sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Abraham u shongneh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Abraham u la leit phai sha ki samla jong u, bad ki la ieng bad ki la leit lang sha Beersheba ; bad u Abraham u la shong ha Beersheba .

en: And when the messengers were come in , behold , there was an image in the bed , with a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster .
kha: Ki leit rung shapoh bad ki shem ïa kata ka bleithaw na ïing ha ka jingthiah bad ïa ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nonglam khubor ki la wan rung, ha khmih, ka la don ka dur ha ka jingthiah, bad ka jingthiah jong ki blang na ka bynta ka bol jong u .

en: And he called unto him the twelve , and began to send them forth by two and two  ; and gave them power over unclean spirits  ;
kha: U la khot lang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la phah ïa ki ar ngut ar ngut . U la ai ïa ki ka bor halor ki mynsiem bymkhuid
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ki shiphew ngut bad u la sdang ban phah ia ki arngut bad arngut bad u la ai bor ia ki halor ki mynsiem bymkhuid ; .

en: So Jesus had compassion on them , and touched their eyes : and immediately their eyes received sight , and they followed him .
kha: U Jisu u la isynei ïa ki bad u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki ; mar kumta hi ki la lah ban ïohi , bad ki la bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Jisu u la sngewsynei ia ki, bad u la ktah ia ki khmat jong ki: bad mar kumta hi ki khmat jong ki ki la iohi , bad ki la bud ia u .

en: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding ? they hold fast deceit , they refuse to return .
kha: Balei te , ko ki briew jong nga , ba phi phai lyndet noh na nga khlem da wan phai shuh ? Phi snoh ha la ki bleithaw bad phi kyntait ban wan phai sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei te kane ka briew jong ka Jerusalem ka la kylla lyngngoh da ka jingkylla kaba mut kaba neh ? ki bat skhem ia ka jingleh thok , ki kyntait ban wan phai .

en: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea : and a great multitude from Galilee followed him , and from Judaea ,
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la leit noh sha ka duriaw Galilaïa , bad u paidbah babun u la bud ïa u . Ki la wan na Galilaïa , na Judia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la leit noh bad ki synran jong u sha duriaw: bad u paidbah uba bun na Galilaia u la bud ia u, bad na Judaea .

en: But he answered her not a word . And his disciples came and besought him , saying , Send her away  ; for she crieth after us .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym ong shikyntien ruh ha ka . Ki synran jong u ki la wan ha u bad ki la kyrpad ïa u ,  To phah noh ïa ka ! Ka wan bud ïa ngi bad ka pynlong ïa kane ka jingkhynwin baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei um shym la jubab ia ka da ka ktien . Ki synran jong u ki la wan bad ki la kyrpad ia u, ki da ong: Phah noh ia ka; namar ka iam hadien jong ngi .

en: And the king s servants said unto the king , Behold , thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint .
kha: Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ,  ki la jubab .  Ngi la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri syiem ki la ong ha u syiem , Ha khmih ki shakri jong me ki long kiba kloi ban leh ia kaei kaei kaba u kynrad jong nga u la thung .

en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka waiñ , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka set ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki iing ruh na ka bynta ka jingkiew jong u kew , bad ka wain , bad ka umphniang ; bad ki stall na ka bynta ki mrad baroh .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahasaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Ahasaiah kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples , saying , Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun jong ki , ki la khñium ha ki synran jong U Jisu .  Balei ba phi ïabam bad ïadih bad ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ?  Ki la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi jong ki ki la ia ud pyrshah ia ki synran jong u, ki da ong: Balei phi bam bad dih bad ki nongpop bad ki nongpop ?

en: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David s spears and shields , that were in the temple of the  Lord .
kha: U la ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u syiem Dabid bad ïa kiba la buh ha ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki rangbah shipai kiba palat da ki spah ngut ki la ai ia ki khnam bad ki jingda kiba don ha ka tempi U Trai .

en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate : and they said one to another , Why sit we here until we die ?
kha: Saw ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh ki don shabar ki khyrdop jong ka Samaria , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Balei ngin shu ap hangne haduh ba ngin da ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don saw ngut ki briew kiba don ka jingpang sniehdoh ha ka jingrung jong ka khyrdop : bad ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Balei ngi shong hangne haduh ba ngin da iap ?

en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
kha: Hynrei ngam don satia ka hok ban jied mano u ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kadiang jong nga . Dei U Blei u ban ai ïa kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ban shong ha ka liang kadiang jong nga bad ha ka liang kadiang jong nga kam dei ka jong nga ban ai ; hynrei yn ai ha ki na ka bynta kiba la pynkhreh .

en: And Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the house of the  Lord . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision .
kha: U Samuel u thiah haduh ban da shai ; nangta u la khie bad plie ïa ki jingkhang ka ïing U  Trai . U la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u Eli shaphang kata ka jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la thiah haduh mynstep , bad u la plie ia ki jingkhang jong ka iing U Trai . U Samuel u la tieng ban pyni ia u Eli ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away : and who shall declare his generation ? for his life is taken from the earth .
kha: La pynjahburom ïa u , bad ym shym la bishar hok ïa u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u , namar ba ka jingim jong u ha ka pyrthei ka la kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingpynjah burom jong u la weng noh ia ka jingbishar jong u: bad mano ban pynbna ia ka pateng jong u ? namar ka jingim jong u la shim noh na ka khyndew .

en: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka por jong u soh ka la jan , u la phah ia ki shakri jong u sha ki nongrep , ba kin ioh ia ki soh jong u .

en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you , or of man s judgment : yea , I judge not mine own self .
kha: Mynta , ngam khuslai da lei lei shaphang kaba shah bishar da phi lane da kano kano ka jingthew ba la buh da u briew ; ngam bishar wat ïa lade hi ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad nga ka long kaba rit bha ba nga dei ban shah bishar na phi, ne na ka jingbishar jong u briew: Hooid, ngam bishar ia la ka jong ka jong ka jinglong .

en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .
kha: Pha la long ruh ka nuti ïa ki nong Babilonia , kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynbun shuh shuh ia ka jingleh be-ijot jong me ha ka ri Kanaan haduh Caldea bad wat la katta ruh .

en: And for me , that utterance may be given unto me , that I may open my mouth boldly , to make known the mystery of the gospel ,
kha: Bad to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong nga ba U Blei un ai ha nga ïa ka khubor haba nga la kloi ban kren , khnang ba nga lah ban kren shlur bad pynpaw shai ïa ka jingmaïan ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta jong nga , ia kata ka jingkren lah ban ai ha nga , ba ngan plie ia ka shyntur jong nga da ka jingshlur , ban pynpaw ia ka jingmaham jong ka gospel .

en: And not for that nation only , but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha , um shym la ong ïa kane na lade hi ; pynban , naba u la long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ïathuhlypa ba U Jisu u dei ban ïap na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Jiw , bad ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei ba un pynwan lang ïa baroh ha kawei ka met ïa baroh ki briew jong U Blei kiba la pynsakma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym tang na ka bynta kata ka jaitbynriew tang , hynrei kata ruh u dei ban lum lang ha kawei ka ri ia ki khun U Blei kiba la saphriang shabar ri .

en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwei ; phi tip kumno phi sngew ban long u nongwei , naba phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh wat pynshitom ia u nongwei: namar phi tip ia ka dohnud jong u nongwei , namar phi la long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: ( For after all these things do the Gentiles seek : ) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things .
kha: ( Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba ki nongmane blei thala ki ju ïai pyrkhat borabor . ) U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u tip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar hadien kine kiei kiei baroh ki Jutang ki wad: ) namar U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u tip ba phi donkam ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: And there sat a certain man at Lystra , impotent in his feet , being a cripple from his mother s womb , who never had walked :
kha: Ha Lystra , la don u briew uba dkhoh naduh ba dang kha bad u bym pat ju lah ban ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don uwei u briew uba shong ha Lystra, uba khlem lah ban leh ei ei ha ki kjat jong u, uba long u nongleh bymman na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u, uba khlem pat ju iaid:

en: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .
kha: Hynrei ka jingïalap jong u Saul ka la nang kham khrawbor , bad ki jingpynshisha jong u ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah ki long kiba skhem ba ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Damaskos kim lah ban jubab ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Saul u la nang kham khlain shuh shuh ha ka bor , bad u la pynkulmar ia ki Jiw kiba shong ha Damekhos , da kaba pynshisha ba kane ka long hi U Khrist .

en: And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?
kha: Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kum u syiem jong ngi , hynrei u la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Kumta , balei ym don mano mano ba pyrshang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Absalom, uba ngi la pynsleh ia ngi, u la iap ha ka thma . Mynta namarkata phim kren ia ka ktien ban wanrah biang ia u syiem ?

en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold , I die : but God shall be with you , and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Kumba phi ïohi , nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un don ryngkat bad me , bad un sa ïalam pat ïa me sha ka ri ki kpa tymmen jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la ong ha u Joseph: Ha khmih nga iap: hynrei U Blei un don ryngkat bad phi bad un wanrah biang ia phi sha ka ri jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: That the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying , I am the  Lord  : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee .
kha: Ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses, u da ong, Nga long U Trai: me kren ha u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt baroh kaba nga ong ha me .

en: And at even , when the sun did set , they brought unto him all that were diseased , and them that were possessed with devils .
kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep bad ba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa baroh kiba pang bad kito kiba shongksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por janmiet, haba ka sngi ka la sep, ki la wanrah ha u ia kiba pang baroh bad ia kiba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid .

en: So it was done democratically and hence it will be a matter of pride , not just for the people of Hanover but all of Germany .
kha: Kumta la leh ia ka ha ka rukom synshar paidbah bad kumta kan long ka jingsarong ym tang ia ki briew jong ka Hanover hynrei ia ka ri Germany baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la leh ia ka ha ka synshar paidbah bad kumta kan long ka kam kaba sngew sarong, ym tang na ka bynta ki briew jong ka Hanover hynrei na ka bynta ka Germany baroh kawei.

en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun Asher kat kum ki longiing jong ki , kine ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law , shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision ?
kha: Lada u Jentil , u bym shym la otsher , u kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka Hukum , hato U Blei un ym ñiew ïa u kumba u la dep otsher ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada ka jingbymkhuid ka bat ia ka hok jong ka hukum , hato ym dei ban khein ia ka jingbymkhuid jong u na ka bynta ka jingkhuid ?

en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them : so they were before Judah , and the ambushment was behind them .
kha: Ha kata ka por u Jeroboam u la dep phah katto katne na ki kynhun jong u ban apthap ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Judia na shadien , katba kiba sah ki tur ïa ki na sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jeroboan u la wanrah ia ka jingshah thombor kaba wan hadien jong ki: kumta ki la don ha khmat u Judah , bad ka jingshah thombor ka la don shadien jong ki .

en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim . Then said Abner unto him , Go , return . And he returned .
kha: U Paltiel u leit bud ïa ka haduh ka nongrit Bahurim , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Hynrei u Abner u ong ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  bad u leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U lok jong ka u la leit ryngkat bad ka da kaba iam hadien jong ka sha Bahurim . Nangta u Abner u la ong ha u, Leit phai noh . Bad u la wan phai .

en: Now as touching things offered unto idols , we know that we all have knowledge . Knowledge puffeth up , but charity edifieth .
kha: Mynta , shaphang kaei kaba phi la thoh ïa ka jingbam ba la kñia sha ki bleithaw . Ka long kaba shisha , te , ba  ma ngi baroh ngi don ka jingtip ,  kumba ki ong . Pynban , kum kata ka jingtip , ka pynmeng ïa u briew da ka jingsarong ; hynrei ka jingieit ka tei keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba ngi dang ktah ia kiei kiei kiba la tyrwa sha ki bleithaw, ngi tip ba baroh ngi don ka jingtip . Ka jingtip ka nang kiew, hynrei ka jingai sngewbha ka nang kiew .

en: Because he slew me not from the womb  ; or that my mother might have been my grave , and her womb to be always great with me .
kha: namar um shym la pynïap ïa nga ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa nga . Te ka kpoh jong i mei jong nga kan jin da la long ka jingtep jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar um shym la pyniap ia nga na ka kpoh ; ne ba ka kmie jong nga ka lah ban long ka jingtep jong nga, bad ka kpoh jong ka ban long kaba khraw beit bad nga .

en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix  room : and Felix , willing to shew the Jews a pleasure , left Paul bound .
kha: Hadien , ar snem ki la leit , u Porsius Phestos u la shim ïa ka jaka jong u Pheliks kum u lyngskor . U Pheliks u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong ki Jiw , kumta u la iehnoh ïa u Paul ha ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ar snem u Porcius Festus u la wan sha ka kamra jong u Felix: bad u Felix, uba mon ban pyni ia ki Jiw ia ka jingsngewbha, u la iehnoh ia u Paul ba la teh .

en: But meat commendeth us not to God : for neither , if we eat , are we the better ; neither , if we eat not , are we the worse .
kha: Pynban , ka jingbam , kan ym lah ban nang pynbha ïa ka jingïadei jong ngi bad U Blei ; ngin ym duh ei ei lada ngim bam , lymne ngin ym ïohnong ei ei lada ngi bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh kam iaroh ia ngi ha U Blei: namar ym don, lada ngi bam, hato ngi kham bha; lymne lada ngim bam, hato ngi kham sniew .

en: Now is my soul troubled  ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
kha: Mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka pisa — bad aïu ngan ong ? Hato ngan ong , ‘ Ko Pa , wat ai ba kane ka kynta kan wan ha nga ?’ Hynrei dei na ka bynta kata nga la wan — khnang ba ngan ïoh ïaid lyngba kane ka kynta jong ka jingshah shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka mynsiem jong nga ka la sngewsih ; bad ngan ong aiu ? Ko Kpa, to pynim ia nga na kane ka kynta: hynrei namar kane ka daw nga la wan sha kane ka kynta .

en: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u men wanrah sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad men sait ia ki da ka um .

en: Son of man , set thy face against Gog , the land of Magog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal , and prophesy against him ,
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew Meshekh bad Tubal ha ka ri Magog .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia u Gog, ka ri Magog, u syiem ba ha khlieh duh jong u Meshech bad u Tubal bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia u .

en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings  houses .
kha: Ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u briew uba la kup da ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ? Ki briew kiba riam kumta ki shong ki sah ha ki ïingsyiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba phi la leit shabar ban peit ? U briew uba la phong da ki jain kiba jem ? ha khmih , kita kiba phong da ki jain kiba jem ki don ha ki iing syiem .

en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .
kha: Ïa kane dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah ban ai ki jingkñia ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jong ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u halor jong nga bad ki khun shynrang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin ai ia ki jingknia kiba thiang ha U Blei jong ka bneng , bad kin duwai na ka bynta ka jingim jong u syiem bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: After this , Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished , that the scripture might be fulfilled , saith ,  I thirst .
kha: U Jisu u la tip ba mynta la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh ; bad khnang ban pynlong ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ban urlong shisha , u la ong ,  Nga sliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u tip ba kiei kiei baroh ki la dep mynta , ba ka jingthoh kan long kaba la pyndep , u ong , nga sliang .

en: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered , yea , thy shame shall be seen : I will take vengeance , and I will not meet thee as a man .
kha: Ki briew kin ïohi ba pha long kaba lyngkhuit ; kin ïohi ba la pynrit bad pynlehrain ïa pha . Ngan pynhiarkput , bad yn ym don ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me kan sa paw , hooid, ka jingsngewlehrain jong me kan sa paw: Ngan shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang bad ngan ym iakynduh ia me kum u briew .

en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold , and couple the curtains together with the taches : and it shall be one tabernacle .
kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad pynïasoh ïa ki jingkah da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna sanphew tylli ki jain ksiar, bad ar tylli ki jingtap ryngkat bad ki jain: bad kan long kawei ka jaka shong jaka sah .

en: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .
kha: Lada ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u bad ki khun jong u dei ban pyllait pat ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ym shym la siewspah ia u ha kine ki snem , te un leit noh ha ka snem jubilee , ma u bad ki khun jong u ryngkat bad u .

en: Go ye up upon her walls , and destroy  ; but make not a full end : take away her battlements  ; for they are not the  Lord s .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongshun ban khet ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew jong nga , hynrei ym ban pynjot khoit ïa ki . Ngan ong ïa ki ban khet noh ïa ki tnat jong ki , namar kito ki tnat kim dei ki jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit sha jrong ki kynroh jong ka, bad pynjot ia ka ; hynrei wat pynlong ia ka jingkut kaba pura: weng noh ia ki thliew jong ka ; namar kim dei ki Trai s .

en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man s wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power :
kha: Kumta haba nga la wan sha phi , nga la long uba tlot bad uba kyiuh baroh shi rynïeng da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka jinghikai bad ka khubor jong nga ym shym la pynïoh da ki ktien batbit jong ka jingstad briew , hynrei da ka jingpynshisha baskhem jong ka bor U Mynsiem U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkren jong nga bad ka jingialap jong nga kam shym la long da ki ktien kiba sngewtynnad jong ka jingstad briew, hynrei ha ka jingpyni ia U Mynsiem bad ka bor:

en: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there , Joab , and Abishai , and Asahel : and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe .
kha: Ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki la don hangta : u Joab , u Abishai , bad u Asahel . U Asahel , uba lah ban mareh stet kum ka skei khlaw ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Seruiah hangta, u Joab bad u Abisai: bad u Asahel u la long kum u khlaw khlaw .

en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .
kha: Ngi thoh sha phi tang ïa kaba phi lah ban pule bad sngewthuh . Hynrei wat lada phi sngewthuh ïa ngi mynta tang katto katne , nga kyrmen ba phin poi sha kata ka jingsngewthuh kaba pura , khnang ba ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi phin ïoh sngewsarong ïa ngi kumba ngi sngewsarong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba phi la pdiang ia ngi ha kawei ka bynta , ba ngi long ka jingkmen jong phi , kumba phi ruh phi long jong ngi ha ka sngi U Trai Jisu .

en: And he said unto the people , Pass on , and compass the city , and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa la ki briew ban sdang ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba ïaid ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki briew , To iaid shakhmat bad to iaid lait ia ka shnong bad to ai ba uta uba don tiar un iaid shakhmat ha khmat ka synduk U Trai .

en: Whereof I am made a minister , according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you , to fulfil the word of God ;
kha: Bad ïa nga la pynlong u shakri jong ka balang da U Blei , uba la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi . Ka long ka kam ban pynbna pura ïa ka khubor jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaba la pynlong ia nga u myntri, kat kum ka jingpynbeit jong U Blei kaba la ai ha nga na ka bynta jong phi, ban pyndep ia ka ktien U Blei ; .

en: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek , and went and smote Israel , and possessed the city of palm trees .
kha: U Eglon u la ïasoh lang bad ki Ammon bad ki Amalek ; kine ki la jop ïa ki Israel bad ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum lang ha u ia ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad u Amalek , bad u la leit bad u la shoh ia ki Israel bad u la don ia ka shnong jong ki dieng sohjew .

en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , sa ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ki kan long kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang , lai tylli ki jingai na ka bynta u masi , bad ar tylli ki jingai na ka bynta u langbrot .

en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew uba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ jong u ha ka por khriat lane kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba uta uba shim noh ia ka jain ha ka por khriat, bad kum u sohjew ha ka por ba khriat, kumjuh ruh uta uba rwai jingrwai ha ka dohnud kaba khia .

en: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name , because thou hast been a man of war , and hast shed blood .
kha: hynrei u la khang ïa nga ban tei ïa ka , namar nga dei u nongïaleh thma bad nga lah pynmih shibun ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha nga , Wat tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga , namar me la long u briew uba ialeh thma bad me la pynmih snam .

en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
kha: Nangta nga la buh ïa ki khuri bad ki pliang ba la dap waiñ ha khmat ki Rekhab , bad nga ong ïa ki ,  To dih waiñ khyndiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la buh ha khmat ki khun shynrang jong ki Rehabit kiba dap da ka wain bad ki khuri bad nga la ong ha ki , To dih ia ka wain .

en: And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;
kha: Te mynta ki paid Israel ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka jingkthang ki ïam sngewsih :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la wan sha iing U Blei bad ki la sah hangta haduh shuwa U Blei, bad ki la pynkiew ia ki sur jong ki, bad ki la iam;

en: So now the  Lord  God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel , and shouldest thou possess it ?
kha: Kumta dei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la beh noh ïa ki Amor na ka bynta ki briew jong U , ki Israel keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta mynta U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la pynduh noh ia ki Amorit na khmat ki briew jong u Israel , bad me dei ban don ia ka ?

en: Saying , Fear not , Paul  ; thou must be brought before Caesar : and , lo , God hath given thee all them that sail with thee .
kha: ‘ Wat sheptieng , ko Paul ! Me dei ban ïeng ha khmat u Patsha . Bad U Blei ha ka jingbha jong u ïa me u la pynsah ïa ka jingim jong kito baroh kiba ïaleit da ka lieng bad me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Wat tieng, u Paul u dei ban shah wanrah ha khmat u Kaisar: bad, ha khmih, U Blei u la ai ha me ia kita baroh kiba leit bad me .

en: But if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not , it is a burning boil  ; and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
kha: Hynrei lada ka sah kumjuh bad kam shym pur , ka long tang ka sohkhliang kaba sah dak na u tohjaw , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka jaka kaba shai ka sah ha ka jaka jong u, bad kam saphriang, ka long ka umphniang kaba rkhiang ; bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid .

en: He shall not depart out of darkness  ; the flame shall dry up his branches , and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away .
kha: Wat ka syrngiew jong u kan jah noh , bad un ym lait na ka jingdum . Un long kum u dieng ïa kiba ki tnat la thang da ka ding , uba ki shylluit la rong noh da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Um dei ban mih na ka jingdum; ka ding kan tyrkhong ia ki tnat jong u, bad da ka jingsawa jong ka shyntur jong u un leit noh .

en: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Caesar ? unto Caesar shalt thou go .
kha: Nangta u Phestos , hadien ba u la ïakren bad ki nongai jingmut jong u , u la jubab ,  Me la apil sha u Patsha , kumta sha u Patsha men leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Festo, haba u la iakynduh bad ka dorbar, u la jubab, Me la kyrpad ia u Kaisar ? sha u Kaisar me leit .

en: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
kha: Un ym ïailong slem uba riewspah ; ym don kaba dei ka jong u ka ban neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ym long uba riewspah, lymne un ym iai bteng ia ka jinglong jong u, lymne un ym pynjlan ia ka jinglong janai jong ka ha ka khyndew .

en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .
kha: Uta uba thang ïa kata ka masi ruh u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , hynrei u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba thang ia ka un sait ia ki jain jong u ha ka um bad un sait ia ka doh jong u ha ka um bad un long u bymkhuid haduh ka por janmiet .

en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .
kha: U shna ïa ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong jong ka , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la shna ia u pud u sam jong ka kti sawdong sawdong .

en: This we will do to them  ; we will even let them live , lest wrath be upon us , because of the oath which we sware unto them .
kha: Ngin hap ban shah ïa ki ba kin im namar ka jingkular jong ngi ; lada ngim leh kumta , U Blei un pynshitom ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ngin leh ia ki ; ngin ailad wat ia ki ban im , ioh ba ka jingbitar kan long halor jong ngi , namar ka jingsmai kaba ngi sngap jar ia ki .

en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .
kha: Man ka sngi u Mordekai u ju ïaid sharum shaneng ha khmat ka phyllaw ka ïing ki kynthei , khnang ban tip kumno ka long bad kaei ka ban jia ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mordecai u la iaid man la ka sngi ha khmat ka iing jong ki kynthei, ban tip kumno ka Esther ka la leh bad kaei kaba dei ban jia ia ka .

en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :
kha: La slem bah nga la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha ki briew jong nga : ‘ Phi dei ban peit ba ïa ka jinglehhok la pyndep , bad phi dei ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun bad ka jingisynei iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u kren ia U Trai jong ki paid, u ong , Pynbeit ia ka jingbishar kaba shisha, bad pyni ia ka jingisynei bad ka jingsngewrit ia u briew ha la u hynmen:

en: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David , saying , Let the  Lord  even require it at the hand of David s enemies .
kha: ai ba kata ka jingkular markylliang jong ngi kan ym dkut noh . Lada pynkheiñ ïa ka , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jonathan u la leh ia ka jutang bad ka iing u Dabid , u da ong , To ai ba U Trai un dawa wat ia ka ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong u Dabid .

en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli na nga , bad ngan ai ia me ia ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka pateng jong me , bad ki bynta ba kut jong ka khyndew na ka bynta ka jingdon jong me .

en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin  ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .
kha: Uno uno uba long u khun jong U Blei , um ïai leh pop , naba ka jinglong blei batynrai jong U Blei hi ka don ha u ; bad namar U Blei u long u Kpa jong u , um lah ban ïai bteng ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba la kha na U Blei um ju leh pop ; namar u symbai jong u u sah ha u: bad um lah ban leh pop , namar la kha ia u na U Blei .

en: And Saul sware to her by the  Lord  , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing .
kha: Mynta u Saul u pynlong ka jingsmai kaba kyntang ha ka ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , nga kular ba phin ym shah pynshitom ei ei namar ba phi leh ïa kane ,  u ong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la sngap jar ia ka da U Trai, u da ong: Kumba U Trai u im, kan ym jia ei ei ia me na ka bynta kane ka kam .

en: Thou didst say , Woe is me now ! for the  Lord  hath added grief to my sorrow  ; I fainted in my sighing , and I find no rest .
kha: Nangta u ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Barukh , me ong , ‘ Nga la ngiah ! U  Trai  u la ban ïa ka jingsngewsih halor ki jingjynjar jong nga . Nga la thait na kaba shu ud , bad ngam shem kano kano ka jingjahthait !’
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ong , Ko long ma nga mynta ! namar U Trai u la pyndap ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga ; nga la lyngngoh ha ka jingsngewsih jong nga, bad ngam shem jingjahthait .

en: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered , from twenty years old and above , shall give an offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah ñiew ha ka jingkheiñbriew , kata , naduh uba arphew snem shaneng , u dei ban siew sha nga ïa kane ka dor ba la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei uba iaid hapdeng jong ki kiba la shah khein , naduh arphew snem shaneng , un ai ka jingainguh ha U Trai .

en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad u la leit bad shong harud ka wahduid Kherith .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit bad u la leh kat kum ka ktien U Trai: namar u la leit shong hajan ka wah Cherith kaba don ha khmat u Jordan .

en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .
kha: U Isaak u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Sngewbha wan kham hajan , ba ngan da ïohktah ïa phi . Hato phi dei shisha u Iso ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la ong ha u Jakob, To wan hajan, nga kyrpad ia me, ba ngan sngew ia me, ko khun jong nga, la me long u khun jong nga hi u Iso ne em .

en: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness , and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pyndap ïa ki lyngdoh da ki jingbam kiba bang eh bad pynhun ïa baroh ki jingdonkam jong ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynhun ia ka mynsiem jong ki lyngdoh da ka jingbun snam , bad ki briew jong nga kin sngewhun ia ka jingbha jong nga , ong U Trai .

en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .
kha: Ha man ba riew ka turoi ki pah sngewshyrkhei ; ki lah ban iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poi hajan , bad ki sngew ïa ka sur hukum jong ki rangbah shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong hapdeng ki turoi , Ha, ha ; bad u sngap jar ia ka thma kaba jngai, ka jingsawa jong ki kapten bad ka jingsawa .

en: Awake , awake , Deborah : awake , awake , utter a song : arise , Barak , and lead thy captivity captive , thou son of Abinoam .
kha: Ïalam , Deborah , ïalam ! Ïalam ! Rwai ka jingrwai ! Ïalam ! Tur sha khmat , ko Barak , u khun jong u Abinoam , Ïalam noh ïa ki mraw jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Awake, khie, Deborah: khie, khie, pynmih ia ka jingrwai: to mih noh, Barak, bad ialam ia ka jinglong mraw jong me, ko khun jong u Abinoam .

en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .
kha: Ko Moab , to kynmaw kumno pha rkhiebeiñ ïa ki paid Israel ? Pha la leh ïa ki kumba ki la ngat ha ka kynhun ki nonglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hato ki Israel kim shym la shah lehbein ia me ? la lap ia u hapdeng ki nongtuh ? namar namar ba me la kren ia u , me la lyngngoh na ka bynta ka jingkmen .

en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .
kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka taiew kaba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba ar , ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai , ba la pynsan ia ka iingjain .

en: They shall not dwell in the  Lord s  land  ; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt , and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria .
kha: Ki paid Israel kin ym ïoh shongsah ha ka ri U  Trai  ; hynrei kin hap leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki hap ban bam ka jingbam ba la kheiñ sang ha Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym shong ha ka ri jong U Trai ; hynrei u Ephraim un leit phai noh sha Ijipt bad kin bam ia kiei kiei kiba khlem khuid ha Assyria .

en: For if ye live after the flesh , ye shall die : but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body , ye shall live .
kha: Naba lada phi im kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh , phin sa ïap ; hynrei lada da U Mynsiem phi pynïap noh ïa ki jingleh ka pop , phin im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi im katkum ka doh, phin sa iap: hynrei lada phi pynkylla ia ki kam jong ka met , phin sa im .

en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .
kha: Ki rangbah nongïaleh jong ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shipai ha Edom yn pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki rangbah jong me, ko Teman, kin sa sngewsih haduh ba uwei pa uwei na u lum u Iso un shah ot noh da kaba pyniap .

en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .
kha: kiba la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga . Nga dap da ka jingsngewnguh ïa ki — ym tang ma nga , hynrei baroh ki balang Jentil kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba don na ka bynta ka jingim jong nga ki la buh ia la ka jong ka ryndang: ha kiba ym tang nga ainguh , hynrei wat ia ki balang Jutang baroh .

en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard , lest at any time we should let them slip .
kha: Namar kata ngi dei ban kham batskhem ïa kita ki jingshisha ïa kiba ngi la ïohsngew , kumta ba ngin ym shah rong noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi dei ban kham pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba ngi la iohsngew , ioh ha kano kano ka por ngi dei ban ailad ia ki ban slip .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  u la lah ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa phi khnang ba nga lah ban leh kham bun ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , U Pharaoh un ym sngap ia phi ; ba ki jingphylla jong nga kin nang bun ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .
kha: Nga la shem ba um shym la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïap lane ban shah set byndi ; ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka dei bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka hukum jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba nga sngewthuh ba la kynnoh ia ki jingkylli jong ka ain jong ki , hynrei ban ym don ei ei kaba la buh ha ka jingkynnoh jong u kaba dei ban iap ne jong ki jingteh .

en: For though thou wash thee with nitre , and take thee much soap , yet thine iniquity is marked before me , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Wat lada me la sait da ka sabon kaba khlaiñ , ngan dang ïai ïohi ïa ka jingkhah jaboh jong ka jingpalat jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la me sait ia me da ka sabon kaba bun, hynrei ka jingbymhok jong me ka paw ha khmat jong nga , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .
kha: Kynsan la don ka jingsawa na sahit bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingbeh ka lyer bajur , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei ha kaba ki la ïashong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kynsan kynsan ka la mih ka sur na bneng kum ka Iyer kaba jur kaba jur bha, bad ka la pyndap ia ka iing baroh kawei ha kaba ki shong .

en: Whereof I was made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power .
kha: Ïa nga keiñ la pynlong u shakri jong kata ka gospel da ka jingai bakyrpang U Blei , kaba u la ai ha nga lyngba ka jingtrei ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaba la pynlong ia nga u nongtrei, kat kum ka jingai jong ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la ai ha nga da ka jingtreikam kaba treikam jong ka bor jong u .

en: And he said to them all ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross daily , and follow me .
kha: Bad u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , un bah ïa la ka diengphna man ka sngi , bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki baroh, Lada uno uno un wan hadien jong nga, to un kyntait ia lade bad un rah ia la ka diengphna man ka sngi bad un bud ia nga .

en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
kha: Nga sngewkmen shaphang ka jingwan u Stephanas , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewkmen ia ka jingwan jong u Stephan bad u Fortunatus bad u Akhaikos: namar kata kaba la duna na ka liang jong phi ki la pynbiang .

en: Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  To bsuh noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka jingsop jong ka ! Me tharai ba ngan ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha u Petros: To buh ia ka waitlam jong me ha ka sniehdoh: ka khuri kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga , hato ngan ym dih ia ka ?

en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body .
kha: Ha ki por baroh ngi kit halor ki met baïap jong ngi ïa ka jingïap U Jisu , khnang ba ka jingim jong u ruh kan paw ha ki met jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh shi katta ka long ha ka met jong U Trai Jisu , ba ka jingim ruh jong U Jisu kan paw ha ka met jong ngi .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God  of hosts , Go , get thee unto this treasurer , even unto Shebna , which is over the house , and say ,
kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ong ïa nga ban leit sha u Shebna , u nongpynïaidkam ha ka longïing syiem , bad ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei jong ki paid u ong: Leit sha une u nongbuh pisa, wat sha Shebna kaba don halor ka iing bad ong .

en: But thou , O man of God , flee these things ; and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , patience , meekness .
kha: Hynrei ma me , ko u briew jong U Blei , to kiar na kine kiei kiei . To ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka hok , ka jingriewblei , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , ka jingïaishah , bad ka jingjemnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, ko briew jong U Blei, phet noh ia kine kiei kiei baroh bad bud ia ka hok, ka jinglong riewblei, ka jingngeit, ka jingieit, ka jingshaniah, ka jinglong jemnud .

en: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .
kha: Ka daw ba nga pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynrei kim ïohi , bad ki shahshkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lane shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga kren ia ki ha ki pharshi: namar kim iohi ia u ; bad ki iohsngew ba kim iohsngew , bad kim sngewthuh .

en: And Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many were overthrown and wounded , even unto the entering of the gate .
kha: U Gaal u la phet ïap bad u Abimelekh u la beh kthong ïa u . Bun ngut ki la mynsaw , wat haduh khyrdop shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la beh ia u , bad u la phet noh ha khmat jong u , bad bun ki la shah pynhap bad mynsaw haduh ka jingrung jong ka khyrdop .

en: And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .
kha: Kumta u Samuel u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei shuh na u . U Eli u ong ,  U long U  Trai  ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la iathuh ia u man la ka sngi, bad um shym la buhrieh ei ei na u . Bad u la ong: Ka long U Trai: to ai ba un leh ia kaba u sngewbha .

en: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden , when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms  ; saying unto them ,
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi kumno katto katne ngut kiba shah khot sngewbha ki da jied ïa ki jaka bakyrpang tam , kumta u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi ha ki baroh :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka pharshi ha kito kiba la shah bid, haba u la buh dak kumno ki la jied ia ki kamra ba kongsan ; da kaba ong ha ki .

en: And the men of Israel , beside Benjamin , were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword : all these were men of war .
kha: Kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki ïalumlang saw lakh ngut ki shipai kiba tbit bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang Israel, nalor u Benjamin, ki long saw spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba la tan ia ka waitlam: kine baroh ki long ki briew kiba ialeh thma .

en: In the seventh month , in the one and twentieth day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by the prophet Haggai , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong u bnai uba hynñiew ha kata kajuh ka snem , U  Trai  u la kren biang lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hynriew bnai, ha ka sngi kaba arphew jong u bnai, ka la wan ka ktien U Trai da u nongiathuhlypa Haggai, da kaba ong:

en: When your fear cometh as desolation , and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind  ; when distress and anguish cometh upon you .
kha: haba ka wan ha phi kum ka  erïong , bad ka pynjynjar ïa phi kum ka  erlangthari , bad haba phi don ha ka jingpang bad ka jinglanot .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka jingtieng jong phi ka wan kum ka jingpynjot , bad ka jingpynjot jong phi ka wan kum ka lyer kaba khih ; haba ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih ka wan ha phi .

en: Come , and let us return unto the  Lord  : for he hath torn , and he will heal us  ; he hath smitten , and he will bind us up .
kha: Ki briew ki ong ,  Ale ngin ïaleit phai sha U  Trai  ! U la pynmynsaw ïa ngi , hynrei da shisha un pynkhiah ïa ngi ; kumta un pynkhiah ïa ngi ; u la pynmong ïa ngi , hynrei un sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ngi , hato un ym leh kumta ?
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, bad to ngin phai sha U Trai: namar u la tyrkhong, bad un pynkoit ia ngi; bad un teh ia ngi .

en: And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .
kha: Hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei dieng bad ki blei maw ïa kiba la thaw da ka kti briew , ki bym lah ban ïohi lane ban ïohsngew , ban bam lane ban sma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta phin shakri ia ki blei, ki kti jong ki briew, ki dieng bad u maw, ki bym iohi ne iohsngew ne bam ne sngap .

en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers , and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites , every one in his business  ;
kha: Nga pynkhuid ïa ki briew na kiei kiei kiba long nongwei : nga pynkhreh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi khnang ba uwei pa uwei un tip ïa la ka kamram ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la pynkhuid ia ki na ki nongwei baroh , bad nga la thung ia ki phyllaw jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , uwei pa uwei ha ka kam jong u;

en: Yea , so have I strived to preach the gospel , not where Christ was named , lest I should build upon another man s foundation :
kha: Ka jingangnud jong nga borabor ka long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki jaka ha kiba ïa U Khrist ym pat shym la ïohsngew , khnang ban ym tei halor ka nongrim ba la seng da kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , kumta nga la ialeh ban ialap ia ka gospel , ym ha kaba la jer kyrteng ia U Khrist , ioh ba ngan tei halor ka nongrim jong uwei pat u briew:

en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
kha: Ko  Trai  , ym don uwei pat kum ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me marwei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , ym don kum ma Me , lymne ym don Blei nalor jong Me , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la iohsngew da ki shkor jong ngi .

en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces , and spread their net over him : he was taken in their pit .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa u ; ki briew ki la ïawan na kylleng sawdong . Ki la phriang ïa la ki jar behmrad bad ki la ïohkem ïa u ha ka jingriam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki jaitbynriew ki la ieng pyrshah ia u na man la ki liang na ki ri, bad ki la pynphriang ia ka net jong ki halor jong u: la shim ia u ha ka thliew jong ki .

en: Come up unto me , and help me , that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .
