kha: Ale wan bad ïarap ïa nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeon , namar ba ki briew jong ka ki la ïasuk bad u Joshua bad ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan shaneng sha nga bad iarap ia nga, ba ngin ia tyngkhuh bad u Gibeon: namar ka la iasuk bad u Joshua bad ki khun Israel .

en: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .
kha: Wat wan sha jan ,  ong U Blei .  Loit noh ïa la ki juti , namar me ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Wat nym iaid shajan hangne: weng noh ia ki juti jong me na ki kjat jong me, namar ka jaka ba me ieng ka long ka khyndew kaba khuid .

en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out  ; and when he had found him , he said unto him ,  Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la shem ïa uta u briew bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me ngeit ha U Khun U Briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la iohsngew ba ki la beh noh ia u ; bad haba u la lap ia u , u la ong ha u: Hato me ngeit ia U Khun U Blei ?

en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria , which is called Sychar , near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph .
kha: Ha Samaria u la leit poi ha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Sikhar , ka bym jngai na ka lyngkha kaba u Jakob u la ai ha u Joseph , u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u wan ha kawei ka shnong Samaria kaba la khot ka Sychar, hajan ka jaka ba u Jakob u la ai ha u khun jong u u Joseph .

en: To whom the word of the  Lord  came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah , in the thirteenth year of his reign .
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jeremaïah ha ka snem kaba khatlai ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Amon u long u syiem ka Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha ki sngi u Josiah u khun u Amon u syiem Judah ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: But Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of the men that went to search the land , lived still .
kha: Na ki khat-ar ngut ki nongsyntiat , tang u Joshua bad u Kaleb ki la lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Joshua u khun u Nun bad u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh kiba long na ki briew kiba leit wad ia ka ri ki dang im .

en: And , behold , there arose a great tempest in the sea , insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves : but he was asleep .
kha: Kynsan kynsan ka  erïong kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la don ha ka jingma ban sa ngam . Hynrei u Jisu u la ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka la mih ka eriong kaba khraw ha duriaw, khlem da sngewthuh ba ka lieng ka la tap da ki um: hynrei u la iohthiah .

en: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee , and manifested forth his glory  ; and his disciples believed on him .
kha: U Jisu u la leh ïa kane ka kambah kaba nyngkong ha Kana ha Galilaïa ; hangta , u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingsdang jong ki kambah ka la leh ia U Jisu ha Cana jong ka Galilaia , bad ka la pynpaw ia ka burom jong u bad ki synran jong u ki la ngeit ha u ; .

en: So Jehu rode in a chariot , and went to Jezreel  ; for Joram lay there . And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram .
kha: Nangta u kiew ha la ka kali ïapom bad u leit sha Jesreel . U Joram um pat shym ïoh jingkoit , bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah u dang don hangta , u leit jngoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jehu u la shong ha ka kali, bad u la leit sha Jesel ; namar u Joram u la thiah hangta . U Ahasaiah u syiem Judah u la wan hiar ban peit ia u Joram .

en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often , as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others  ;
kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam man ka snem ryngkat bad ka snam ki mrad . Hynrei U Khrist um shym la rung shapoh ban kñia ainguh ïa lade bunsien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh ba u dei ban aiti ia lade bunsien, kumba u rangbah lyngdoh u rung ha ka jaka bakhuid man la u snem da ka snam jong kiwei pat;

en: And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent  ; and Moses fled from before it .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Bret ïa u ha madan .  Haba u Moses u bret ïa u , uta u diengduh u kylla bseiñ , bad u Moses u phet na uta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: To bret ia ka ha ka khyndew . U la bret ia ka ha ka khyndew bad ka la kylla long ka bsein ; bad u Moses u la phet noh na khmat jong ka .

en: Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?
kha: Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam jong phi ki long kiba ijli . Uwei pa uwei u klim . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ieng halor ka waitlam jong phi, phi leh ia ka kam kaba sniew, bad phi pynjakhlia ia ka tnga para marjan jong u: bad phin long trai ia ka ri ?

en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .
kha: lada me long uba hok bad uba khuid , te U Blei um wan ban ïarap ïa me bad pynïoh pat ïa ka ïing ka sem jong me kum ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me la leit khuid bad beit shuh shuh mynta un sa khie na ka bynta jong me, bad un pynlong ia ka jaka shong jaka sah jong me kaba riewspah .

en: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , slem shuwa ban shai , U Jisu u la ïeng bad mihnoh na ka ïing . U la mihnoh na ka shnong sha ka jaka bakynjah , hangta u la duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynstep, haba u la khie shipor shuwa ban sdang ka sngi, u la mih noh sha ka jaka kaba marwei bad hangta u la duwai .

en: And when they heard it , they were glad , and promised to give him money . And he sought how he might conveniently betray him .
kha: Ki la sngewkmen ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u don ban ong , bad ki la kular ban ai pisa ïa u . Kumta u Judas u la sdang ban wad ïa ka lad kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la sngewbha, bad ki la kular ban ai pisa ia u . Bad u la wad kumno u lah ban pyndem suk ia u .

en: But the angel of the  Lord  did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife . Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the  Lord .
kha: Katba ki thylliej ding ki dang kiew shajrong na ka duwan , u Manoah bad ka tnga jong u ki ïohi ïa u angel U  Trai  ba u kiew sha bneng ha ki thylliej ding . U Manoah hangta u sngewthuh ba uta u briew u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , bad ma u lem bad ka tnga jong u ki dem khrup ha khyndew . Kim shym ïohi shuh ïa u angel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u angel U Trai um shym la paw shuh ha u Manoah bad ha ka tnga jong u . Nangta u Manoah u la tip ba u long u angel U Trai .

en: And his disciples went forth , and came into the city , and found as he had said unto them : and they made ready the passover .
kha: Ki synran ki la leit , ki la rung sha ka nongbah , bad shem kiei kiei baroh kumba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa ki ; bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran jong u ki la leit shabar bad ki la wan shapoh shnong bad ki la shem kumba u la ong ha ki: bad ki la pynkhreh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait .

en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .
kha: u la khot ïa la u shakri , bad u ong ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka briew na khmat jong nga ! Pynmih ïa ka shabar bad khang ïa ka jingkhang !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot ia u shakri jong u uba la shakri ia u, bad u la ong, To buh noh mynta ia kane ka kynthei na nga, bad to khang ia ka jingkhang hadien jong ka .

en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .
kha: bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh ar ngut , un hap wan bad ong ha phi , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ Nangta phin sngewlehrain bad wan ban shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la ong ia me bad ia u u wan bad u ong ha me, Ai ia une u briew u la leit sha ka jaka kaba rit tam .

en: And Jesus went out , and departed from the temple : and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple .
kha: U Jisu u la mih bad u la leit noh na ka Templ mynba ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u ban pyn-i ïa ki jingtei jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la mih noh na ka tempi: bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u ban pyni ia u ia ki jingtei jong ka tempi .

en: Also I heard the voice of the Lord , saying , Whom shall I send , and who will go for us ? Then said I , Here am I  ; send me .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U Trai u ong ,  Ïano ngan phah ? Mano ban long u nonglamktien jong ngi ?  Nga la jubab ,  Ngan leit ! To phah ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga la iohsngew ia ka sur U Trai, da kaba ong, Iano ngan phah , bad mano ban leit na ka bynta jong ngi ? Nangta nga la ong , Hangne nga dang phah ia nga .

en: And he came and took her by the hand , and lifted her up  ; and immediately the fever left her , and she ministered unto them .
kha: U la leit sha ka , u la shim ïa ka na ka kti , bad u la khyllie ïa ka . Ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan bad u la shim ia ka da ka kti, bad u la rah ia ka; bad mar kumta hi ka jingshit ka la mih noh na ka .

en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside , sealed with seven seals .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli ha ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet ; kaba la dap da ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang bad kaba la pyndait da ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ha ka kti kadiang jong uta uba shong ha ka khet ia ka kot kaba la thoh hapoh bad ha ka tyrpeng , kaba la khang da ki hynriew tylli ki muhor .

en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :
kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un ai ka jinghikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki la jyrngam bad khie lung bad u la sdang ban sei ki sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to nang ia ka pharshi jong u dieng sohjew ; Haba ka tnat jong ka ka dang jem , bad ka pynmih ia ki sla , phi tip ba ka por lyiur ka la jan:

en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased , they ceased in Israel , until that I Deborah arose , that I arose a mother in Israel .
kha: Deborah , ki nongrit jong ka Israel ki sah kynjah , Ki ïeng thylli tad ynda pha wan , Pha wan kum ka kmie ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshong shnong ki la sangeh noh, ki la sangeh noh ha Israel, haduh ba nga Deborah nga la mih , ba nga la mih ka kmie ha Israel .

en: And these signs shall follow them that believe  ; In my name shall they cast out devils  ; they shall speak with new tongues  ;
kha: Ïa kiba ngeit yn ai ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah : Kin beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; kin kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki dak kin bud ia ki kiba ngeit ; Ha ka kyrteng jong nga kin beh ia ki ksuid ; kin kren da ki thylliej thymmai ; .

en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps : there was not the like made in any kingdom .
kha: Ka khet ka don hynriew kyrdon ban kiew shajrong ïa ka , ka don ka dur u sing uwei uwei ha ki tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyndon . Ba baroh ka long khat-ar tylli ki sing . Hadien jong ka khet la don ka dur khlieh jong u khun masi dab , bad ha syndah kawei pa kawei na ki ar tylli ki jingbat kti don ka dur jong u sing . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shiphew ngut ki sing ki la ieng hangta ha kawei ka liang bad ha kawei pat ka liang halor ki hynriew tylli ki step: ym shym la don kum kata ha kano kano ka hima .

en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
kha: Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la don u lyoh uba la tap ia ki: bad ka sur ka la mih na u lyoh , ka ong: Une u long U Khun baieit jong nga: to iohsngew ia u .

en: He shall be shaven , but the scall shall he not shave  ; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more :
kha: uta u briew un khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh , lait noh ïa ka jaka bit prum . U lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Un shah ot , hynrei u khnai un ym ot shuh shuh bad u lyngdoh un khang ia uta uba don ka sniehdoh hynriew sngi:

en: And say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant ,
kha: ba ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la buh ka jingtim halor uwei uwei baroh u bymkohnguh ïa ki kyndon jong kane ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ia ki , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ; La tim ia u briew u bym kohnguh ia ki ktien jong kane ka jutang .

en: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him ,  Follow me .
kha: ( Ha kaba ong kumne , U Jisu u la kdew kaba kumno u Petros un ïap bad pyndonburom ïa U Blei . ) Te U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To bud ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kren ia u, da kaba pynpaw da ka jingiap kaba u dei ban pyndonburom ia U Blei . Bad haba u la kren ia kane , u ong ha u , To bud ia nga .

en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .
kha: Nga la matlah namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la btin ïa nga da ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa nga sha Damaskos .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngam lah ban iohi ia ka burom jong kata ka jingshai , haba la ialam da ka kti jong kito kiba don ryngkat bad nga , nga la poi ha Damasios .

en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste  ; and he said , I have sinned against the  Lord  your God , and against you .
kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot kyrkieh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa phi ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u la khot ia u Moses bad u Aaron da kaba kyrkieh ; bad u la ong , Nga la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong phi bad pyrshah ia phi .

en: And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .
kha: Hynrei ki synran kim shemphang ïa kano kano na kine kiei kiei ; ïa ka jingmut jong ki kyntien la buhrieh na ki , bad kim tip shaphang kaei U Jisu u kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim sngewthuh ei ei na kine kiei kiei: bad kane ka jingong ka la buhrieh na ki , lymne kim tip ia kiei kiei kiba la kren .

en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O Zedekiah king of Judah  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of thee , Thou shalt not die by the sword :
kha: Ko Sedekaïah , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong shaphang jong me . Men ym shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai , ko Sedekaiah u syiem Judah ; Kumta u ong U Trai jong me: Wat iap da ka waitlam:

en: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .
kha: Men pyn-i ïa ka jingïaineh jong me bad ka jingieit baneh ha la ki briew , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham bad jong u Jakob , kumba me la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la slem bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Me leh ia ka jingshisha ha u Jakob bad ka jingisynei ia u Abraham kaba me la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi naduh ki sngi barim .

en: I am he that liveth , and was dead  ; and , behold , I am alive for evermore , Amen  ; and have the keys of hell and of death .
kha: Nga long uta uba im ! Nga la ïap , hynrei mynta nga im junom la junom . Nga don ka bor halor ka jingïap bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long uta uba im, bad nga la iap ; bad, ha khmih, nga im junom shuh shuh, Amen ; bad nga don ki shabi jong ka dujok bad ka jingiap .

en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .
kha: Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki rangbah nongïalam bad ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ialam noh ia U Jisu sha u rangbah lyngdoh: bad bad u la ialum lang ia ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah bad ki nongthoh .

en: And say , If we had been in the days of our fathers , we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets .
kha: bad phi kam ba lada phi la im ha kata ka por jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , phin ym da la leh ïa kaei kaba ki la leh bad pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong , Lada ngi la don ha ki sngi jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ngin ym shym la long ki nongiashim bynta bad ki ha ka snam ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: For I am the  Lord  thy God , the Holy One of Israel , thy Saviour : I gave Egypt for thy ransom , Ethiopia and Seba for thee .
kha: Naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , uba pynim ïa phi . Ngan kyntait ïa ka Ijipt ban pyllaitluid ïa phi ; ngan kyntait ïa ka Sudan bad ka Seba .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong me, U Blei Bakhuid jong me: Nga la ai ia ka Ijipt na ka bynta ka jingsiew bai lutksan jong me, ka Ethiopia bad ka Seba na ka bynta jong me .

en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ym shym la don ka jingkhein bad ki ia ka pisa kaba la pynpoi ha ka kti jong ki , namar ki la leh da ka jingshaniah .

en: And he shall put off his garments , and put on other garments , and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place .
kha: Nangta un leit pli ïa la ki jaiñ bad un rah ïa uta u dpei shabar ka jaka shong dara , sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un weng noh ia ki jain jong u, bad un phong da kiwei pat ki jain bad un rah ia ka dewbilat shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah sha ka jaka kaba khuid .

en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan sdang ïa ka ding ha ka ri u Magog bad ha baroh shi lynter ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki briew ki shong khlem jingpynwit bad uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ding ia u Magog bad hapdeng jong ki kiba shong khlem da pyrkhat ha ki dulir: bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pynhiarkput ïa uno uno uba leh sniew ïa phi . Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na ka ngab kamon , ai ba un thab ïa ka ngab kadiang jong phi ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba phin ym pyrshah ia kaba sniew: hynrei uno uno uba pynkhih ia me ha ka rmiang shyntur jong me, to phai sha u ruh sha uwei pat ruh .

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
kha: U syiem u ong ruh ha u ,  Nga long u syiem — bad yn ym don uwei ruh ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei u ban leh ei ei khlem ka jingai jingbit jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph, Nga long u Pharaoh, bad khlem ma me ym don mano mano ruh ban rah ia la ka kti ne ka kjat ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: And the angel said unto them , Fear not : for , behold , I bring you good tidings of great joy , which shall be to all people .
kha: hynrei u angel u la ong ha ki ,  To wat sheptieng ! Nga don hangne lem bad ka khubor babha na ka bynta jong phi , ka ban wanrah ka jingkmen kaba khraw ha ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la ong ha ki: Wat tieng: namar, ha khmih, nga wanrah ia phi ia ka khubor babha jong ka jingkmen kaba khraw, kaba long ha ki briew baroh .

en: Then she saddled an ass , and said to her servant , Drive , and go forward  ; slack not thy riding for me , except I bid thee .
kha: Nangta ka phah teh jin ïa ka kada , bad ka hukum ïa u shakri ,  Pynïaid stet ïa ka kada katba ka lah , bad wat pynsuki , lymda nga ong ïa me ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la sngap jar ia u tdong jong ka, bad ka la ong ha u shakri jong ka, To iaid shakhmat, bad to leit sha khmat ym ia ka jingleit jong me na ka bynta jong nga, lymda nga la ong ia me .

en: Talking about the Nexon EV itself , the SUV comes powered by a 95kW electric motor paired with a 30 . 2kWh lithium battery pack
kha: Haba kren shaphang ka Nexon EV hi , ka SUV ka wan da ka bording kaba 95kW kaba la pyniasoh bad ka 30 . 2kWh batri lithium
translated_en_to_kha: Haba kren shaphang ka Nexon EV hi, ka SUV ka wan da ka motor elektrik kaba 95kW kaba la pyniasoh bad ka 30 . 2kWh battery .

en: Just as the Israelites rejoiced at praising Jehovah “in assemblies ,” we too enjoy worshipping him together at special events .
kha: Kumba ki khun Israel ki ïa lehkmen ban ïaroh ïa U Jehobah “ha ki jingiaseng ,” ngi ruh ngi kmen ban ïa mane lang ïa u ha kum kine ki jingïalang bakyrpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki Israel ki la sngewbha ban iaroh ia U Jehobah in ki jingiaseng , ngi ruh ngi sngewtynnad ban mane ia u ryngkat ha ki jingjia ba kyrpang .

en: Finally , brethren , pray for us , that the word of the Lord may have free course , and be glorified , even as it is with you :
kha: Ha kaba khatduh , ko parabangeit jong ngi , to duwai na ka bynta jong ngi ba ka khubor jong U Trai ka lah ban nang ïai pur stet , bad ba yn ïohpdiang ïa ka lem bad ka jingpyndonburom , kumba ka la long hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, ko para bangeit, to duwai na ka bynta jong ngi, ba ka ktien U Trai kan long kaba laitluid, bad kan long kaba la pyndonburom, kumba ka long bad phi:

en: And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .
kha: Ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa ki la leit bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa ka jingtep bad kumno ba la buh ïa ka met ka jong U Jisu hapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei ruh kiba wan ryngkat bad u na Galilaia ki la bud hadien bad ki la iohi ia ka jingtep bad kumno la buh ia ka met jong u .

en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .
kha: Ka bainong jong phi ka shong ha kaei kaba phi ong bad kaei kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi dei hok .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew un sngewhun ia ka jingbha da u soh jong ka shyntur jong u: bad ka jingsiew kylliang jong ki kti jong u briew kan long ha u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take thee Joshua the son of Nun , a man in whom is the spirit , and lay thine hand upon him  ;
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u briew uba lah , bad buh ïa ki kti jong me halor ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: To shim ia me u Joshua u khun u Nun, u briew ha uba don ka mynsiem, bad to buh ia la ka kti halor jong u;

en: On the left hand , where he doth work , but I cannot behold him : he hideth himself on the right hand , that I cannot see him :
kha: U Blei u trei ha ka kam shaphang shatei bad shathie , hynrei pynban ngam shym ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka liang kadiang , ha kaba u trei , hynrei ngam lah ban iohi ia u: u buhrieh ia lade ha ka liang kadiang , ba ngam lah ban iohi ia u:

en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .
kha: U Abimelekh u ong ,  Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong, Ngam shym la leh ia kane: lymne me la iathuh ia nga, lymne ngam pat iohsngew ia kata, hynrei haduh mynta ka sngi .

en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .
kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da kaba ong ba don uwei pat u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba u Jason u la ioh: bad kine baroh ki long pyrshah ia ki hukum jong u Kaisar, ki da ong ba don uwei pat u syiem, uwei u Jisu .

en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki long ki bym don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kyntang , bad ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka ki long ki briew kiba jem bad kiba thok: ki lyngdoh jong ka ki la pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang , ki la leh donbor ia ka ain .

en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Katno phi la bakla ! Bad phi tip balei ? Ka long namar ba phim tip ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid lane ïa ka bor jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ha ki: Hato phim tip ia ki jingthoh ne ia ka bor U Blei ?

en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have opened your graves , O my people , and brought you up out of your graves ,
kha: Haba ngan plie ïa ki jingtep ha kiba la tep ïa ki briew jong nga bad sei noh ïa ki , kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai haba nga la plie ia ki jingtep jong phi ko ki briew jong nga bad nga la pynmih ia phi na ki jingtep jong phi .

en: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time  ; and the Egyptians vexed us , and our fathers :
kha: kumno ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ngi la shong la sah hangta bun bun snem . Ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad ïa ngi ruh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leit hiar sha Ijipt , bad ngi la shong ha Ijipt la slem bad ki nong Ijipt ki la pynsngewsih ia ngi, bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi:

en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
kha: Phi dei ban ai sngewbha sha U Blei ha Jerusalem ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ïa kiba la ai ha phi ban pyndonkam ha ki jingshakri ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tiar ruh kiba la ai ha me na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Blei jong me , kita ki pynpoi ha khmat U Blei jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .
kha: Bad la don bun ki briew kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki nongpang niangthohlieh ki la don ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisa u nongiathuhlypa ; bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la pynkhuid , da kaba pynim ia u Naaman u Syria .

en: This he said , not that he cared for the poor  ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .
kha: U la ong ïa kane , ym namar ba u da sngewkhia ïa kiba duk , hynrei namar ba u la long u nongtuh . U bat ïa ka pla pisa bad uba la ju shim na ka ban pyndonkam ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane u la ong, ym ba u sumar ia kiba duk ; hynrei namar ba u long u nongtuh, bad u don ka pla, bad u la bret ia kaei kaba la buh ha ka .

en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
kha: Haba ki Syria jong ka Damaskos ki phah ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u syiem Hadadeser , u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki Syria ki la wan iarap ia u Hadarezer u syiem ka Sobah , u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki Syria arphew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .
kha: Khmih ba uno uno un ym siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew , hynrei ha ki por baroh to kut jingmut ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ba ym don ba leh sniew ia uno uno u briew ; hynrei to bud beit ia kata kaba bha, hapdeng jong phi bad ia ki briew baroh .

en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his will ,
kha: Namar ka jingieit jong u , U Blei u la rai lypa ba da U Jisu Khrist un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u — kane ka long ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingthmu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba la buh lypa ia ngi sha ka jingpdiang ia ki khun da U Jisu Khrist ha lade , kat kum ka jingsngewbha kaba bha jong ka mon jong u , .

en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks , and for the coulters , and for the forks , and for the axes , and to sharpen the goads .
kha: ka bai shut sdie bad ka bai moramot ïa ki dieng tyndung ka long shi sbai rit , bad ka bai shut nar lyngkor lane shut mohkhiew ka long ar tylli ki sbai rit . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki don ka file na ka bynta ki bniat, bad na ka bynta ki jingthung, bad na ka bynta ki fork, bad na ka bynta ki ax, bad ban pynkhih ia ki khniang .

en: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans , and be as the he goats before the flocks .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh na Babilonia ! Iehnoh ïa ka ri ! Long kiba nyngkong ban iehnoh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh na pdeng ka Babilon , bad leit noh na ka ri jong ki Khaldian , bad to long kum ki blang ha khmat ki kynhun .

en: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin , saying , What wickedness is this that is done among you ?
kha: Ki jait Israel ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha baroh ka ri jong ka jait Benjamin , ban ong ,  Ka kam bymman aïu kane kaba phi la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jait Israel ki la phah ia ki briew lyngba ka jaitbynriew Benjamin baroh kawei, ki da ong: Kaei ka jingsniew kaba la leh hapdeng jong phi ?

en: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem , and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold .
kha: U Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u kem koidi ïa u bad u pynlong ïa ka Judah ban siew lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa bad laiphew saw kilo ka ksiar kum ka khajna .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ijipt u la buh ia u ha Jerusalem bad u la pynrem ia kata ka ri da ki shispah talent rupa bad kawei ka talent ksiar .

en: And I will camp against thee round about , and will lay siege against thee with a mount , and I will raise forts against thee .
kha: U Blei un tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , un don sawdong jong ka bad un kerkut ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shong shnong pyrshah ia me sawdong , bad ngan sa thiah pyrshah ia me da ka jingkieng , bad ngan pynmih ia ki kut pyrshah ia me .

en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth , where moth and rust doth corrupt , and where thieves break through and steal :
kha: Wat kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha ka pyrthei , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang ki pynjot , bad ki nongtuh ki prong bad ki tuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat buh ia lade ha ka khyndew, ha kaba u khniang bad u dewbilat u bamsap , bad ha kaba ki nongtuh ki iaid lyngba bad tuh:

en: But he spake the more vehemently , If I should die with thee , I will not deny thee in any wise . Likewise also said they all .
kha: U Petros u la kham ban ha kaba jubab ïa u ,  Da lei lei ngan ym ong kumta , wat lada ka dei ïa nga ban ïap bad me !  Bad baroh kiwei ki synran ki la ong kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kren kham jur , Lada nga iap bad me , ngan ym kyntait ia me da ka jingstad . Kumjuh ruh ki la ong baroh .

en: If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .
kha: Lada ki ong ïa ngi ban ap haduh ba kin da wan sha ngi , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki ong kumta ha ngi , To iaid haduh ba ngin da poi sha phi ; te ngin ieng ha ka jaka jong ngi , bad ngin ym leit shaneng sha ki .

en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .
kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki sur jingtem ki duitara , hynrei mynta hangne me don ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Me thiah ha ka jingthiah jong ki ksaiñ bad la tap nep da ki wieh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong me ka la hiar sha ka jingtep, bad ka jingsawa jong ki jingleh be-ijot jong me: ka khniang ka la saphriang hapoh jong me, bad ki khniang ki tap ia me .

en: And because he saw it pleased the Jews , he proceeded further to take Peter also . ( Then were the days of unleavened bread . )
kha: Haba u la ïohi ba kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki Jiw , u la thew ruh ban kem sa ïa u Petros . ( Kane ka la jia ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba u la iohi ia ka ba ka la pynsngewbha ia ki Jiw, u la iaid shakhmat shuh shuh ban shim ia u Petros ruh . ( Nangta ki la long ki sngi jong u kpu bym don thied . )

en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial : for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto .
kha: Wat ñiew ïa nga kum ka kynthei ka bymdondor ei ei . Nga duwai kumne namar ba nga sngew kordit sat ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat khein ia ka kti jong phi na ka bynta ka khun kynthei jong nga: namar na ka jingbun jong ka jingujor bad jingsngewsih jong nga nga la kren haduh mynta .

en: But I say unto you , That Elias is indeed come , and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed , as it is written of him .
kha: Pynban , nga ong ïa phi , pynban , ba u Elijah u la lah wan bad ba ki briew ki la leh ïa u kumba ki mon , kat kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba u Elias u la wan shisha, bad ki la leh ia u ia kaei kaei kaba ki la buh kyrteng, kumba la thoh shaphang jong u .

en: And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .
kha: U Iso u kylli ,  Kumno pat shaphang kato ka kynhun kaba nga la ïakynduh ? Ka mut aïu kato ?  U Jakob u jubab  Ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kaei kaba me mut da kane ka jingleit baroh kaba nga la iakynduh ? Bad u la ong , Kine ki long ban shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat u kynrad jong nga .

en: Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .
kha: Mynta , U Blei u la tyrwa ha ngi ïa ka jingkular ba ngi lah ban pdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba u la kren . Te , to ngin da sumar , ba yn ym shem ïa uno uno na phi u bym kot ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ba la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin tieng namarkata, ioh , ka jingkular ba la iehnoh ia ngi ban rung sha ka jingjahthait jong u , uno uno na phi u dei ban long kumba u duna na ka .

en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :
kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un hikai ïa phi . Haba ki tnat jong u ki jyrngam bad khie lung bad u sdang ban sei sla , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to nang ia ka pharshi jong u dieng sohjew ; Haba ka tnat jong u ka dang jem , bad ka pynmih ia ki sla , phi tip ba ka por lyiur ka la jan:

en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .
kha: Khat-ar tylli ki dur sing ki don ha ki mawkyrdon , uwei uwei ha ka tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum kane ha kawei pat ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shiphew ngut ki sing ki la ieng hangta ha kawei ka liang bad ha kawei pat ka liang halor ki hynriew tylli ki step . Ym shym la don kum kata ha kano kano ka hima .

en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , ki bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uno uno u bym wad ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel un shah pyniap , la u long uba rit ne uba heh , la u shynrang ne kynthei .

en: Lo , these are parts of his ways : but how little a portion is heard of him ? but the thunder of his power who can understand ?
kha: Hynrei kine ki dei tang ki dak barit ïa ka bor jong u , tang ki jingpasiaw ba ngi la ïohsngew . Uei uba lah ban tip haduh katno U Blei u long shisha uba khraw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , kine ki long ki bynta jong ki lynti jong u: hynrei katno ka bynta la iohsngew na u ? hynrei ka jingsawa jong ka bor jong u kaba lah ban sngewthuh ?

en: Go not forth hastily to strive , lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof , when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame .
kha: Wat kyrkieh eh ban leit sha ïingbishar halor kaei kaei kaba phi ïohi . Lada uwei pat u nongsakhi hadien u pynshisha ba phi la bakla , kaei nangta phin leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leit noh kyrkieh ban ialeh , ioh phim tip aiu ban leh ha kaba kut jong ka , haba u paramarjan jong me u la pynjah burom ia me .

en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .
kha: Kumta u Solomon u kiew ïa ka khet u Dabid u kpa jong u ïa kaba U Blei U  Trai  u la seng . U la long u syiem uba jop , bad ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la shong ha ka khet U Trai kum u syiem ha ka jaka u Dabid u kpa jong u, bad u la roi; bad ki Israel baroh ki la kohnguh ia u .

en: And it came to pass , as they journeyed from the east , that they found a plain in the land of Shinar  ; and they dwelt there .
kha: Te ynda ki briew ki la ïaid kylleng ha ka phang mihngi , ki la poi sha ka pyntha ha Babilonia bad ki la ïashong sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang iaid shaphang mihngi, ba ki la shem ia ka madan ha ka ri Shinar ; bad ki la shong hangta .

en: But now he is dead , wherefore should I fast ? can I bring him back again ? I shall go to him , but he shall not return to me .
kha: Hynrei mynta ba i la ïap , balei ngan shahjingit ? Nga lah mo ban pynim biang ïa i khunlung ? Ngan sa leit ha kawei ka sngi sha kaba i don , hynrei im lah da lei lei ban wan phai pat sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta u la iap , balei nga dei ban shah jingit ? nga lah ban wanrah biang ia u ? Ngan leit sha u hynrei un ym wan phai sha nga .

en: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , neither would he let the children of Israel go  ; as the  Lord  had spoken by Moses .
kha: bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren lyngba u Moses , u Pharaoh um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dohnud u Pharaoh ka la tyrkhong , lymne un ym pyllait ia ki khun Israel kumba U Trai u la kren da u Moses .

en: He hath dispersed , he hath given to the poor  ; his righteousness endureth for ever  ; his horn shall be exalted with honour .
kha: U ai kylluid ïa kiba kyrduh , bad ka jingbhasbun jong u kam ju duh ; un long uba donbor bad uba ïoh burom .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynpra noh ia u bad u la ai ha kiba duk; ka hok jong u ka sah junom; ka horn jong u kan long kaba la pynkhraw da ka burom .

en: And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing  ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .
kha: Phi hikai ruh , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka duwan , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka jingai sngewbha halor ka duwan , u long uba la shah teh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad , Uno uno uba smai da ka almari , kam long ei ei shuh hynrei uno uno uba smai da ka jingai kaba don halor jong ka , u long uba don pop .

en: For they prophesy a lie unto you , to remove you far from your land  ; and that I should drive you out , and ye should perish .
kha: Ki da shukor ïa phi bad kin pynlong ïa phi ban shah rah sha jngai na ka ri jong phi . Ngan beh noh shabar ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn pynjot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki iathuhlypa ia phi, ban pynduh noh ia phi na ka ri jong phi ; bad ba ngan beh noh ia phi , bad phi dei ban jah noh .

en: Remember them , O my God , because they have defiled the priesthood , and the covenant of the priesthood , and of the Levites .
kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , kumno kito ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa baroh ar , ka jinglong lyngdoh bad ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ki ko Blei jong nga, namar ki la pynjakhlia ia ka jinglong lyngdoh bad ka jutang jong ka jinglong lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

en: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia  ;
kha: U Lyngskor u la pule ïa ka shithi bad u la kylli ïa u Paul na kano ka probins    u la wan . Haba u la tip ba u dei na Kilikia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Lat u la pule ia ka shithi, u la kylli ia kaei ka jylla kaba u long . Bad haba u la sngewthuh ba u long na Cilicia;

en: Parents need to spend time with their children and study the Bible with them , caring for their spiritual and emotional needs .
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa ki dei ruh ban pynlut por bad la ki khun , ban pule lang ïa ka Baibl , ban phikir na ka bynta ka jingsngew bad ka jingdonkam bakynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kmie ki kpa ki donkam ban pynlut por bad ki khun bad pule ia ka Baibl bad ki , da kaba sumar ia ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem bad ba kynja mynsiem jong ki .

en: Seeing his days are determined , the number of his months are with thee , thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass  ;
kha: Ka jingjrong ka rta ka jingim jong ngi la rai lypa — Ka jingkheiñ ki bnai ba ngin im . Lah dep buh ïa u pud , bad ym lah ban pynkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi iohi ia ki sngi jong u ki long kiba la buh lypa, ka jingbun ki bnai jong u ka don bad me, me la buh ia ki pud jong u ba um lah ban iaid ; .

en: For as the lightning cometh out of the east , and shineth even unto the west  ; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
kha: Naba U Khun U Briew un wan kum ka leilieh kaba thaba na shiliang sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , na mihngi sha sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka jingshai ka mih na mihngi, bad ka shai haduh sepngi; kumta ruh ka jingwan jong u Khun u briew kan long .

en: And now we call the proud happy  ; yea , they that work wickedness are set up  ; yea , they that tempt God are even delivered .
kha: Kumba ngi ïohi ïa ka , ki briew kiba sarong ki long kita kiba kmen . Ki briew kiba sniew ym tang ba ki roi kyrhai , hynrei ki tynjuh ïa ka jingïaishah U Blei da ki kam basniew jong ki bad ki lait na kata .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ngi khot ia ka jingsngew sarong kaba sngew sarong, ia kita kiba trei ia ka jingsniew la buh lypa;

en: And ye shall dwell with us : and the land shall be before you  ; dwell and trade ye therein , and get you possessions therein .
kha: Nangta phi lah ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka ri jong ngi ; phi lah ban shong ban sah hangno hangno kat ha kaba phi kwah , phi lah ban khaïi laitluid , bad ban don la ka jong ka jaka ka puta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shong bad ngi: bad ka ri kan long ha khmat jong phi; bad phin ioh ia ki mar ki mata ha ka .

en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Phi ïakwah ban shong ban sah hangne katba kiwei pat ki Israel kin leit sha ka thma ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki khun Gad bad ha ki khun Reuben: Hato ki hynmen jong phi kin leit sha ka thma bad phi kin shong hangne ?

en: And they took him , and brought him unto Areopagus , saying , May we know what this new doctrine , whereof thou speakest , is ?
kha: Kumta ki la shim ïa u Paul , ki la wallam ïa u ha khmat ka dorbar jong ka nongbah , ka Ariopagos , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi kwah ban tip kaei kane ka jinghikai bathymmai kaba me kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u bad ki la wanrah ia u ha Areopagus, ki da ong: Hato ngi lah ban tip kaei kane ka jinghikai thymmai kaba me kren ?

en: We be twelve brethren , sons of our father  ; one is not , and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan .
kha: Ngi don khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u kpa . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u dang don ha Kanaan bad i pa .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long shiphew ngut ki hynmen , ki khun shynrang jong ngi; bad uba rit tam u don ha kane ka sngi bad u kpa jong ngi ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .
kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit phai noh sha ïing . U  Trai  u la pynngat ka jingshitom bajur ha u khunlung ba ka tnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathan u la leit noh sha la iing . Bad U Trai u la shoh ia uta u khynnah uba ka tnga jong u Uri ka la kha ha u Dabid bad ka la pang jur .

en: Now therefore take , I pray thee , thy weapons , thy quiver and thy bow , and go out to the field , and take me some venison  ;
kha: To shim ïa la ka ryntieh bad ki khnam , khie leit sha rudnong bad pynïap kawei ka mrad na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to shim, nga kyrpad ia me, ia ki tiar ialeh jong me, ia ka wait bad ka bow jong me, bad leit sha lyngkha, bad shim ia nga katto katne ka bih ; .

en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart  ; and they have not known my ways .
kha: Bad kumta nga la bitar ïa kita ki briew bad nga la ong , ‘ Ki la iehnoh ïa nga borabor bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la sngewsih ia kata ka pateng, bad nga la ong , Ki ju bakla ha ka dohnud jong ki ; bad kim shym la ithuh ia ki lynti jong nga .

en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee  ; and thou shalt fear day and night , and shalt have none assurance of thy life :
kha: Ka jingim jong phi kan don borabor ha ka jingma . Synñia sngi phin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng , bad phin sngew kum ban ïap ha kano kano ka khyllipmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingim jong me kan sah ha ka jingartatien ha khmat jong me ; bad me dei ban tieng sngi bad miet , bad men ym don jingpynthikna ia ka jingim jong me:

en: But if I say thus unto the young man , Behold , the arrows are beyond thee  ; go thy way : for the  Lord  hath sent thee away .
kha: Hynrei lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Ki khnam ki don ha kawei pat ka liang jong phi ,’ te phet noh , namar U  Trai  u la phah noh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada nga ong kumta ha u samla, Ha khmih, ki khnam ki long shabar jong me: namar U Trai u la phah noh ia me .

en: Whom resist stedfast in the faith , knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world .
kha: To long kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit jong phi bad to ïaleh pyrshah ïa u , namar phi tip ba ki parabangeit jong phi ha ka pyrthei baroh ki ïaid lyngba ïa kajuh ka rukom shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba pyrshah ia ka jingngeit ha ka jingngeit , da kaba tip ba ki juh ki jingjynjar ki long ha ki para jong phi kiba don ha ka pyrthei .

en: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him , that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .
kha: Mar ïaskhem ha ka bor , u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba la pynïap ïa u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia haba la pynskhem ia ka hima ha u , ba u la pyniap ia ki shakri jong u kiba la pyniap ia u syiem u kpa jong u .

en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti kiba la rah ïa la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka hima bneng kan long kum shiphew ngut ki nongleh kam sniew kiba la shim ia ki sharak jong ki bad ki la leit shabar ban iakynduh ia u nongleit kurim .

en: Praise ye the  Lord . I will praise the  Lord  with my whole heart , in the assembly of the upright , and in the congregation .
kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ngan ainguh ïa U  Trai ha ka jingïalang ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaroh ia U Trai . Ngan iaroh ia U Trai da ka dohnud baroh kawei, ha ka jingiaseng jong kiba hok bad ha ka jingiaseng .

en: So I took the evidence of the purchase , both that which was sealed according to the law and custom , and that which was open :
kha: Te nga la shim ïa baroh ar tylli ki kopi ka dulir thied jaka — ka kopi ba la shon muhor kaba don ka jingïakut bad ki kyndon , bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor —
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la shim ia ki sakhi jong ka jingthied, baroh ar kata kaba la khang katkum ka ain bad ka riti dustur, bad kata kaba la plie:

en: But as soon as this thy son was come , which hath devoured thy living with harlots , thou hast killed for him the fatted calf .
kha: Hynrei une u khun jong phi u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka jingdon jingem jong phi ha ki nuti , bad haba u wan phai pat sha ïing , phi pynïap na ka bynta jong u ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei tang shu wan une u khun jong me uba la bam ia ka jingim jong me bad ki nongkhaii met jong me, me la pyniap na ka bynta jong u ia u khun masi uba la tyrkhong .

en: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah , and said unto him , The  Lord  thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place .
kha: U rangbah shipai u la khot ïa nga sharud bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah shipai u la shim ia u Jeremaiah bad u la ong ha u: U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynbna ia kane ka jingsniew ha kane ka jaka .

en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently , who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you :
kha: Ka dei shaphang kane ka jingpynim ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïawad bad ïit bha biang biang , bad ki la ïathuhlypa shaphang kane ka jingai ïa kaba U Blei un ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaba ka jingpynim ki nongiathuhlypa ki la kylli bad wad bniah, kiba la iathuhlypa ia ka jingaiei kaba dei ban wan ha phi:

en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .
kha: U buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie , marpyrshah kata ka miej ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka sharak ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang , sha jrong pyrshah ïa ka miej , ha ka liang jong ka ïingjaiñ shaphang shathie .

en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation , and said , Sirs , ye know that by this craft we have our wealth .
kha: Kumta u la khot lang ïa ki baroh lem bad kiwei pat kiba ïatrei kum kajuh ka jingtrei bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ko rangbah , phi tip ba ka jingmanbha jong ngi ka wan na kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kiba u la khot ryngkat bad ki nongtrei kiba kum kata ka kam, bad u la ong, Ko Sir, phi tip ba da kane ka kam ngi don ka spah jong ngi .

en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .
kha: Nangta ïa phi yn kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban shah pynïap . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin aiti noh ia phi ban shah pynshitom bein, bad kin pyniap ia phi: bad phin shah shun na ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre , we came to Ptolemais , and saluted the brethren , and abode with them one day .
kha: Ngi la nang leit da ka lieng na Tyros sha Ptolemais , ha kaba la khublei ïa ngi da ki parabangeit bad ngi la sah bad ki shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ngi la pyndep ia ka lynti jong ngi na Tyros , ngi la poi sha Ptolemis , bad ngi la ai khublei ia ki para bangeit bad ngi la sah bad ki ha kawei ka sngi .

en: Paul , an apostle , ( not of men , neither by man , but by Jesus Christ , and God the Father , who raised him from the dead ; )
kha: Na u Paul , uba ka jingkhot ban long u Apostol kam shym la wan na u briew ne da ka rukom briew , hynrei na U Jisu Khrist bad U Blei uba U Kpa , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u apostol , (ym na ki briew, ym da u briew, hynrei da U Jisu Khrist, bad U Blei U Kpa uba la pynmih ia u na kiba iap ; )

en: The kings came and fought , then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo  ; they took no gain of money .
kha: Ha Taanakh , harud ka wahduid jong ka Megiddo , Ki syiem ki la wan bad ïaleh ; Ki syiem Kanaan ki la ïaleh , Hynrei kim shym ïoh rah ïa kano kano ka rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ki la wan bad ki la ialeh , nangta ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ki syiem Kana ha Taach da ki um Megiddo ; kim shym la shim pisa ei ei .

en: That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa U Blei na ka jingkynrei spah ka burom jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka bor da U Mynsiem jong u ba phin long kiba khlaiñ ha ki jinglong bashapoh jong phi , bad nga duwai ba U Khrist un pynlong ka ïingshong jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi da ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un ai ia phi kat kum ka spah jong ka burom jong u, ban shah pynskhem da ka bor da U Mynsiem jong u ha u briew uba shapoh;

en: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God , to blaspheme his name , and his tabernacle , and them that dwell in heaven .
kha: U la sdang ban tim ïa U Blei , ïa ka kyrteng jong u , ïa ka jaka shong jong u , bad ïa kito baroh kiba shong ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la plie ia ka shyntur jong u ha ka jingkren bein ia U Blei , ban kren bein ia ka kyrteng jong u bad ia ka iing jong u bad ia kito kiba shong ha bneng .

en: And unto Absalom there were born three sons , and one daughter , whose name was Tamar : she was a woman of a fair countenance .
kha: U Absalom u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad kawei ka khun kaba kyrteng ka Tamar , ka kynthei kaba bhabriew katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Absalom la kha lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad kawei ka khun kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Tamar: ka la long ka kynthei kaba don ka jingkhein kaba hok .

en: And Moses called unto them  ; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him : and Moses talked with them .
kha: Hynrei u Moses u khot ïa ki , bad u Aaron lem bad ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang ki ïaleit sha u , bad u Moses u ïakren bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia ki; bad u Aaron bad ki nongsynshar baroh ki la wan phai sha u: bad u Moses u la kren bad ki .

en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .
kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la wan bad ki briew baroh kiba ialeh thma bad u, pyrshah ia ki da ki um Merom kynsan .

en: Then the king s servants , which were in the king s gate , said unto Mordecai , Why transgressest thou the king s commandment ?
kha: Kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ka jingtreikam ha ïingsyiem ki la kylli ïa u balei ba um kohnguh ïa ka hukum u syiem ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shakri syiem kiba don ha ka khyrdop syiem ki la ong ha u Mordecai: Balei me pynkhein ia ka hukum syiem ?

en: How weak is thine heart , saith the Lord  God  , seeing thou doest all these things , the work of an imperious whorish woman  ;
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Pha la leh ïa kane baroh kum ka nuti ka bym don jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka dohnud jong me ka tlot , ong U Trai Blei , haba me leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh , ka kam jong ka kynthei kaba sniew;

en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki dang leit sha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , kumba khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha kata ka sngi, arngut na ki ki la leit sha kawei ka shnong kaba la khot ka Emmaus kaba long na Jerusalem kumba hynriewphew tylli ki thliew .

en: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans , whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices .
kha: Ha kata ka por , la don hangta katto katne ngut ki briew kiba la ïathuh ha U Jisu shaphang ki nong Galilaïa ïa kiba u Pilat u la phah pynïap katba ki dang ai ki jingkñia sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ha kata ka aiom katto katne kiba la iathuh ia u na ki nong Galilaia, kiba ka snam jong ki u la ia khleh lang bad ki jingknia jong ki .

en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment , and poured it on his head , as he sat at meat .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang bam , kawei ka kynthei ka la wan sha u lem bad ka dabi alabastar ba la pyndap da ka jingsleh iwbih baremdor , ïa kaba ka la theh halor ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wan ha u kawei ka kynthei kaba don ka synduk kaba kordor bha, bad ka la theh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u, katba u dang shong ha ka doh .

en: But he that lacketh these things is blind , and cannot see afar off , and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins .
kha: Hynrei uno uno u bym don ïa kine , u long u bym ïohi jngai ba um lah ban ïohi bad u la klet ba ïa u la pynkhuid na ki pop jong u kiba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba duna ia kine kiei kiei u long uba matlah bad um lah ban iohi jngai , bad u la klet ba u la shah pynkhuid na ki pop barim jong u .

en: And they said unto him , Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :
kha: Ki ruh ki jubab ïa u ,  Phi mut kumno , bah , da kaba kren ïa ngi kumne ? Ngi smai ba ngim shym leh ïa kaba kum kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u: Balei u kynrad jong nga u ong ia kine ki ktien ? U Blei u la khang ba ki shakri jong me kin leh kat kum kane:

en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .
kha: Hynrei ki bymman kin peit sawdong ha ka jinglyng-a bad kin shem ba ym don lynti ban phet ïap . Tang kawei ka jingkyrmen ïa ki ka long ba ka jingïap kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khmat jong kiba sniew kin sa jah noh bad kin ym lait im bad ka jingkyrmen jong ki kan long kum ka jingaiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .
kha: Ha ka jinglyng-a kaba khraw u la duwai kham jur shuh shuh ; ka syep jong u ka la long kum ki jingjaw ka snam kaba hap ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la don ha ka jingsngewsih u la duwai kham jur: bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka la long kumba ka long ki tdem snam kiba khraw kiba hap shapoh khyndew .

en: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .
kha: Haba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , u la phah katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw ban kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban wan bad pynkhiah ïa u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohsngew ia U Jisu, u la phah sha u ia ki rangbah jong ki Jiw, u da kyrpad ia u ba un wan pynkoit ia u shakri jong u .

en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day , and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night , and I will destroy thy mother .
kha: Mynmiet bad mynsngi phi ïaid bakla , bad ki nongïathuhlypa kim long kham bha ban ïa phi . Ngan sa pynjot ïa ka Israel , ka kmie jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata men hap ha ka sngi , bad u nongiathuhlypa ruh un hap bad me ha ka miet , bad ngan pynjot ia ka kmie jong me .

en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ban ïohi ïa ki por kiba bha , u dei ban kiar na kaba kren sniew bad ban nym kren lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba ieit ia ka jingim bad uba iohi ia ki sngi kiba bha, to un kiar na kaba sniew, bad ki rmiang shyntur jong u ba kim kren bein:

en: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u ,  Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka ong ha u , Nga tip ba u wan, uba la khot U Khrist: ynda u la wan , un sa iathuh ia ngi baroh .

en: ( The  Lord  God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you , as he hath promised you ! )
kha: Ai ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi un nang pynroi shuh shuh ïa phi bun hajar shah bad un pynmanbha ïa phi , kumba u la kular !
translated_en_to_kha: (U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u pynlong ia phi shihajar sien shuh shuh kumba phi long , bad un kyrkhu ia phi kumba u la kular ia phi ! )

en: Moreover the  Lord  said unto me , Take thee a great roll , and write in it with a man s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,  Shim ka lyngkhot tiar thoh jingthoh kaba heh bad thoh ha ka da ki dak kiba heh : ‘ Maher-shalal-hash-bas .   ’
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata U Trai u la ong ha nga, To shim ia ka roll kaba khraw, bad thoh ha ka da u briew uba don ka pen kaba iadei bad ka Mahershal 

en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane , u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai jong ki paid u la thmu , bad mano ban pynjah burom ia ka ? bad ka kti jong u ka la pynjrong , bad mano ban pynphai biang ia ka ?

en: I likewise , and my brethren , and my servants , might exact of them money and corn : I pray you , let us leave off this usury .
kha: Nga la shah ïa ki briew ban shim pisa kylliang bad u kew na nga , bad kumjuh ruh ki paralok jong nga bad ki briew kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga . To mynta ngin ym ïa-dawa shuh ïa ka jingpynphai biang ïa ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh kumjuh, bad ki hynmen jong nga, bad ki shakri jong nga, nga lah ban shim pisa bad u kew: Nga kyrpad ia phi, to ngin iehnoh ia kane ka jingmyntoi .

en: A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together  ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing  ;
kha: ka por ban phylliew jingieit bad ka por ban ym phylliew jingieit , ka por ban ïadoh bad ka por ban ym ïadoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ban bret noh ia ki maw , bad ka por ban lum lang ia ki maw ; ka por ban pdiang , bad ka por ban kiar na kaba pdiang ; .

en: And the sight of the glory of the  Lord  was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel .
kha: Ka jingshai baphyrnai jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  ka la wan hiar ha uta u lum . Ïa ki Israel , ka jingshai ka i kum ka ding kaba ing ha kliar jong u lum . U lyoh u la tap ïa u lum hynriew sngi lynter , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew U  Trai  u la khot ïa u Moses na u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpeit ia ka burom U Trai ka la long kum ka ding kaba bam ia ka ding ha jrong jong u lum ha ki khmat jong ki Israel .

en: That they should seek the Lord , if haply they might feel after him , and find him , though he be not far from every one of us :
kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ba kin wad ïa u , bad lehse kin shem ïa u haba ki tba shane shatai ïa u . Pynban U Blei da shisha um long jngai na uno uno na ngi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin wad ia U Trai , lada lehse kin sngew hadien jong u , bad kin shem ia u , wat la um don jngai na ngi iwei ia iwei:

en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .
kha: Ngi tip ba ha kiei kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot kat kum ka jingthmu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi tip ba kiei kiei baroh ki iatrei lang na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki kiba ieit ia U Blei , ha kito kiba la khot kat kum ka jingthmu jong u .

en: But I will come to you shortly , if the Lord will , and will know , not the speech of them which are puffed up , but the power .
kha: Pynban , lada U Trai u mon , ngan sa wan shen sha phi , bad nangta ngan sa shem da lade hi ïa ka bor kaba kine ki briew kiba sarong ki don , bad ym tang ïa kaei kaba ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan wan sha phi tang khyndiat por, lada U Trai un mon bad ngan tip ym ia ka jingkren jong ki kiba la shah pynkhih , hynrei ia ka bor .

en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
kha: Ym don jingpynrem shuh mynta na ka bynta kito kiba im ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mynta ka jingpynrem ia kito kiba don ha U Khrist Jisu , kiba iaid ym kat kum ka doh hynrei katkum U Mynsiem .

en: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .
kha: Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , khnang , ynda phi iohi biang ia u ,  phin shadkmen , bad ka jingsngewsih jong nga kan jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phah ia u namarkata kham bha, ba haba phi iohi biang ia u, phi lah ban sngewbha, bad ba nga lah ban kham duna ka jingsngewsih .

en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger , and thirst , and are naked , and are buffeted , and have no certain dwellingplace ;
kha: Haduh kane hi ka khyllipmat ngi shahthngan bad ngi sliang ; la pynkup ha ngi da ki jaiñjot ; la shohbeiñ ïa ngi ; ngi ïaidwir na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ; ngi la thait la jrem ïa lade na ka jingtrei shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat haduh kane ka kynta baroh arngut ngi thngan, bad ngi sliang, bad ngi lyngkhuid, bad ngi la shah rong noh, bad ngim don jaka sah kaba thikna ; .

en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle , and herb for the service of man : that he may bring forth food out of the earth  ;
kha: Me pynlong ïa u phlang ban mih na ka bynta ki jingri bad ïa ki jingthung ba u briew un pyndonkam , khnang ba un lah ban pynmih jingthung ban bam
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia u phlang ban san na ka bynta ki masi bad u jingthung na ka bynta ka jingshakri ia u briew: ba un pynmih jingbam na ka khyndew ; .

en: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?
kha: Nalor baroh , dei ma phi — ma phi keiñ , khlem duna ïa kiwei pat ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi , ka jingkmen jong ngi , bad ka daw jong ngi ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jong ngi ha khmat jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ne ka jingkmen ne ka khlieh jong ngi ? Hato wat ma phi ruh ha khmat U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist ha ka jingwan jong u ?

en: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
kha: Bad balei phi khuslai shaphang ki jaiñ ? Khmih kumno ki  tiewkhlaw ki san : kim trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei phi pyrkhat ia ka jingmih ? Pyrkhat ia ki syntiew lyngkha , kumno ki san ; kim ju trei shitom , lymne kim ju khih:

en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :
kha: Haba u Adam u la dap shispah laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang uba syriem ïa u bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Adam u la im shispah laiphew snem, bad u la kha ia u khun shynrang ha la ka jong ka dur, hadien ka dur jong u ; bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Seth:

en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people ? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred ?
kha: Kumno ngan lah ban shah ïa ka lada kane ka jingjot ka wan hap ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga ki shah pynïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumno ngan shah ban iohi ia ka jingsniew kaban sa wan ha ki briew jong nga ? lane kumno ngan shah ban iohi ia ka jingpynjot ia ka jait jong nga ?

en: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish  ; and Joshua smote him and his people , until he had left him none remaining .
kha: U Horam u syiem ka Geser u la wan ban ïarap ïa ka Lakhish , hynrei u Joshua u jop ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad um shym la pyllait im wat ïa uwei ruh na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u Hiram u la wan shaneng ban iarap ia u Lachish ; bad u Joshua u la shoh ia u bad ki briew jong u, haduh ba um shym la iehnoh ia u .

en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ha kito kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum ki la iohi ia ka jingshai kaba khraw ; bad ha ki kiba shong ha ka thain bad ka jingdum jong ka jingshai jong ka jingiap ka la mih .

en: And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,
kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u pat , ki peit ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  ha ka jaka mane kaba ha Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nadaok u lyngdoh bad ki hynmen jong u ha khmat ka iing U Trai ha ka jaka ba jrong kaba don ha Gibeon .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen  ; and ye receive not our witness .
kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ngi kren ïa kaei kaba ngi tip bad ngi ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ngi la ïohi , pynban , ym don na phi uba mon ban pdiang ïa ka khubor jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha me, Ngi kren ba ngi tip, bad ngi sakhi ba ngi la iohi ; bad phim pdiang ia ka jingsakhi jong ngi .

en: President Ramnath Kovind and Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended their greetings to the neighbouring country on the occasion .
kha: U President u Ramnath Kovind bad u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi ki la ai khublei ia ka ri ba marjan ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U President ka jylla u Ramnath Kovind bad u Myntri Rangbahduh ka ri u Narendra Modi ki la pynjlan ia ka jingai khublei jong ki sha ka ri ba marjan ha kane ka sngi .

en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .
kha: Phi lah ban ong ïa iwei na Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingmut jong ki dkhot Baibl .—Pule Loukas 24 :32 , 45 .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno na ki Nongsakhi jong U Jehobah un sngewbha ban iarap ia phi ban pyrkhat ia ka jingmut jong ki Jingthoh Bakhuid . pule Loukas 242 , 45 .

en: Now , lo , if he beget a son , that seeth all his father s sins which he hath done , and considereth , and doeth not such like ,
kha: Mynta tharai une u briew uba ar u don khun shynrang . U ïohi ïa baroh ki pop kiba u kpa jong u , u la ju leh hynrei um shym bud ïa ki jingleh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ha khmih, lada u kha khun shynrang, uba iohi ia ki pop jong u baroh kiba u la leh, bad u pyrkhat bad um leh kumta .

en: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites , Hittites , and Amorites , and Perizzites , and Hivites , and Jebusites :
kha: Bad kumta ki paid Israel ki la shongduh hapdeng ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki shong hapdeng ki nong Kanaan, ki Hit bad ki Amorit bad ki Perizi bad ki Hebus bad ki Hebus:

en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .
kha: U Dan un long kum u bseiñ harud lynti bah , Bad kum u  seiñpuh harud lynti , Uba puh na ka khongdong jat jong u kulai Khnang ba u nongshong un shah bret shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dan un long u bsein ha lynti, u bsein ha lynti, uba bam ia ki tyrpeng kulai , haduh ba u nongshong kulai jong u un hap shadien .

en: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek : and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel .
kha: Ki Philistia ki lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong ki baroh ha Aphek , katba ki Israel ki sher dara harud ka pung kaba ha ka them Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki Philistia ki la ialum lang ia ki shipai jong ki baroh ha Aphek : bad ki Israel ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka pung kaba don ha Jesel .

en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses  ; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever .
kha: Phi beh noh ïa ki kynthei jong ki briew jong nga na ki ïing ba ki ieit , bad phi lute khlem kut ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong nga na ki khun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei jong ki briew jong nga ki la beh noh na ki iing kiba sngewtynnad jong ki ; na ki khun jong ki ki la shim noh ia ka burom jong nga junom .

en: And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .
kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei bad ki la mane ïa U  Trai  ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la weng noh ia ki blei nongwei napdeng jong ki: bad ka mynsiem jong u ka la sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .

en: Then king Darius wrote unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
kha: Nangta u syiem Darius u la thoh sha ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei : Khublei !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Darius u la thoh sha ki briew baroh, ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien baroh kiwei kiba shong ha ka khyndew baroh kawei; Ka jingsuk kan nang bun ha phi .

en: ( It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment , and wiped his feet with her hair , whose brother Lazarus was sick . )
kha: ( Kane ka Mari ka dei kato kaba la pynsleh ïa ki kjat U Trai da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih bad kaba la ñiad ïa ki da u shñiuh khlieh jong ka ; u dei u Lasaros u para jong ka uba la pang . )
translated_en_to_kha: (Ka la long kata ka Maria kaba la pynsleh ia U Trai da ka umphniang, bad ka la sait ia ki kjat jong u da ki shniuh jong ka, uba u hynmen jong u u Lasaros u la pang . )

en: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .
kha: Ïa ka jingpynim dei ban shem tang lyngba jong u ; ha ka pyrthei baroh ym don uno uno ïa uba U Blei u la ai uba lah ban pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ka jingpynim ha kano kano kawei pat: namar ym don kawei pat ka kyrteng hapoh bneng kaba la ai hapdeng ki briew , ha kaba ngi dei ban ioh jingpynim .

en: And he said unto them , I am an Hebrew  ; and I fear the  Lord  , the God of heaven , which hath made the sea and the dry land .
kha: Nga dei u Hebru ,  u Jonah u la jubab .  Nga mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ka bneng , uba la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Nga long u Hebru ; bad nga tieng ia U Trai , U Blei jong ka bneng uba la thaw ia ka duriaw bad ka ri kaba rkhiang .

en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .
kha: Hato phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Khat-ar ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la bret ia ki san tylli ki kpu hapdeng san hajar , katno tylli ki basket kiba dap da ki bniat phi la shim ? Ki ong ia u , Shiphew .

en: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah  ; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land .
kha: Nga la leit ban sah bad u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad shong hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u khun u Ahikam u la leit sha Mizpah ; bad u la shong bad u hapdeng ki briew kiba la sah ha ka ri .

en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together  ; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places .
kha: Ka sahit bneng ka la jah noh kum ka kot kli ba la kli , bad ïa ki lum bad ki dewlynnong baroh la pynkynriah na ka jaka ba ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bneng ka la leit noh kum ka kot lyngkdop haba la pynkhih lang bad uwei pa uwei u lum bad u dulir la pynkynriah noh na ki jaka jong ki .

en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,
kha: Ynda haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Jisu . Katba U dang duwai , la plie ïa ka bneng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la pynbaptis ia ki briew baroh, ka la jia ba U Jisu ruh u la shah pynbaptis bad u la duwai .

en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;
kha: U Moses u long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka ïing U Blei kum u shakri , bad u kren ïa kiei kiei kiba U Blei un sa kren ha ki por ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la long shisha uba iaineh ha ka iing jong u baroh kawei, kum u shakri, na ka bynta ka jingsakhi ia kita kiei kiei kiba dei ban kren hadien;

en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying , as soon as I was sent for : I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me ?
kha: Bad kumta haba phi la phah khot ïa nga , nga la wan khlem kano kano ka jingpyrshah . Nga kylli ïa phi , te , balei ba phi phah khot ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la wan sha phi khlem da ioh jingtip, tang shu phah ia nga: Nga kylli namarkata ia kaei ka jingthmu kaba phi la phah na ka bynta jong nga ?

en: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , which is not betrothed , and lay hold on her , and lie with her , and they be found  ;
kha: Lada lap ïa u briew ba u batbor ïa ka briew ka bym pat shym ïatehktien badno badno ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u shem ia ka dam kaba long ka nongleh kam sniew, kaba ym shym la shongkurim, bad u thiah ia ka, bad u thiah bad ka, bad ki shah lap;
