en: And he went out , and followed him  ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel  ; but thought he saw a vision .
kha: U Petros u la bud ïa u shabar jong ka byndi , khlem da tip , la kaei kaba u angel u la leh ka long kaba shisha ; u la pyrkhat ba u la ïohi ka jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih noh, bad u la bud ia u ; bad u la sngewsih ba ka long kaba shisha kaba la leh da u angel ; hynrei u la pyrkhat ba u la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
kha: Hynrei ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , bad ïa ki  nierlang jong u , dei ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh ban sait ïa ki pop jong ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh masi bad ka sniehdoh jong u bad ka sniehdoh jong u, to thang da ka ding shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah: ka long ka jingainguh pop .

en: For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .
kha: Kane baroh ka long na ka bynta jong phi ; bad katba ka jingaiei U Blei ka dang kner noh sha kiba bun ki briew , kin ai sha ka burom U Blei kham bun ki jingduwai ainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh ki long na ka bynta jong phi, ba ka jingaiei kaba bun kan long lyngba ka jingainguh jong kiba bun ban pynphai biang ia ka burom U Blei .

en: All the cities of the plain , and all Gilead , and all Bashan , unto Salecah and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
kha: Ngi la ïohknieh ïa ka ri u Og u Syiem Bashan baroh kawei : ïa ki nongbah baroh ha ka madan lum , ïa ki ri Gilead bad Bashan , haduh ki shnong Salekah bad Edrei shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong baroh jong ka madan, bad ka Gilead baroh, bad ka Basan baroh, haduh ka shnong Seleah bad ka Edrei, ki shnong jong ka hima Og ha Basan .

en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
kha: Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba la pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kular bun kiei kiei kiba kham bha ban ïa ka snam u Abel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha U Jisu u nongpyniasuk ia ka jutang bathymmai, bad ha ka snam jong ka jingpynbthei , kaba kren kham bha ban ia ka jong u Abel .

en: For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .
kha: Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don ei ei kaba buhrieh, kaba ym lah ban pynpaw ; bad ym shym la buh rieh ia kaei kaei ruh, hynrei ba kan wan shabar ri .

en: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply , and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied , and all that thou hast is multiplied  ;
kha: bad wat ynda ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi , ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong phi , bad ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la nang bun kyrhai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki kynhun bad ki kynhun jong me ki nang bun, bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me ka nang bun, bad baroh kaba me don ka nang bun;

en: And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?
kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , me donhok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha u, u da ong, Iathuh ia ngi, da ka bor aiu me ia kine kiei kiei ? lane mano ba la ai ia me ia kane ka bor ?

en: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief . And Eliezer had none other sons  ; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .
kha: U Elieser u don tang uwei u khun , u Rehabaïah , hynrei u Rehabaïah u don shibun ki khun ki ksiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Elieser ki long u rangbah . Bad u Elieser um don shuh ki khun shynrang beg hynrei ki khun shynrang jong u Rehabiah ki long kiba bun bha .

en: And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .
kha: Mynba u Abiathar u khun jong u Ahimelekh u la lait phet bad leit ïasoh bad u Dabid ha Keilah , u la rah ïa ka ephod lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abhiatar u khun u Ahimeel u la phet noh sha u Dabid sha Keilah , ba u la wan hiar da ka Ephod ha ka kti jong u .

en: And they have cast lots for my people  ; and have given a boy for an harlot , and sold a girl for wine , that they might drink .
kha: Ki la kynting sbai ban rai mano ki ban ïoh ïa ki koidi . Ki la die mraw ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad khynnah kynthei ban siew na ka bynta ki nuti bad ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thep vote na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ; bad ki la ai ia u khynnah shynrang na ka bynta ka kam runar , bad ki la die ia ka khynnah kynthei na ka bynta ka wain , ba kin dih .

en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps , and a den of dragons  ; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate , without an inhabitant .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ka thup ki jingpra , ka jaka ha kaba ki myrsiang ki shong ; ki nongbah ka Judah kin kylla ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano bashong ba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ka Jerusalem kaba jylliew bad ka thliew jong ki bsein ; bad ngan pynlong ia ki nongbah Judah ban jah rngai noh khlem u nongshong shnong .

en: However , our struggle for seeking a complete loan waiver for farmers will continue , said Ajit Nawale , secretary of the AIKS .
kha: Hynrei ka jingiakhun jong ngi ban wad ia ka jingpynlait ram kaba pura na ka bynta ki nongrep kan iai bteng ong u Ajit Nawale secretary ka AIKS .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingialeh jong ngi ban wad ia ka jingpynlait ram kaba pura na ka bynta ki nongrep kan iai bteng , la ong u Ajit Nawale , secretary ka AIKS .

en: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem , and were come to Bethphage , unto the mount of Olives , then sent Jesus two disciples ,
kha: Katba U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ki la wan sha Bethphage ha u lum ki Olib . Hangta U Jisu u la nang phah sha khmat ar ngut na ki synran lem bad kine ki jingbthah :
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Jerusalem bad ki la poi ha Betphage, ha u lum Olive, nangta ki la phah ia U Jisu arngut ki synran .

en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee , and awake that shall vex thee , and thou shalt be for booties unto them ?
kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ba phin tip ïa ka , phi kiba la jop ïa kiwei phin don ha ka ram ïa lade bad shah pynbor ban siew ïa ka sut . Ki nongshun kin wan bad pynkyiuh ïa phi . Kin thombor ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kin ym kiew kynsan ia me, bad kin khie ia me kiba pynsngewsih ia me, bad me long uba sngewsih ia ki ?

en: And I will say to my soul , Soul , thou hast much goods laid up for many years  ; take thine ease , eat , drink , and be merry .
kha: Nangta ngan ong ha lade , A u briew badonbok ! Me la don kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba me donkam na ka bynta bun snem . Wat khuslai ïa la ka jingim , to bam , to dih , bad to lehkmen ïa lade !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ong ha ka mynsiem jong nga, ko mynsiem, me la buh bun ki mar ki mata kiba bun snem ki shim ia ka jingsuk jong me, bam, dih bad sngewbha .

en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar :
kha: Te uwei na ki seraph u la her sha tbian sha nga , da kaba rah ïa u rnga uba rhem uba u la khap da ka nap na ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la her ia uwei na ki seraphim sha nga, da kaba don u dewiong ba im ha ka kti jong u, uba u la shim da ki thylliej na ka almari:

en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving  ; I will pay that that I have vowed . Salvation is of the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me ; ngan ai ka jingkñia ïa me bad ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka wan na U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan knia ha me da ka sur ainguh ; Ngan siew ia kata kaba nga la kular . Ka jingpynim ka long jong U Trai .

en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which I command thee this day , to do them .
kha: Namar kata , kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la lah hikai ïa phi , sumar ban leh ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban sumar ia ki hukum bad ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi .

en: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To men long khuid !  Shisyndon la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la kner ia la ka kti bad u la ktah ia u, u da ong, Ngan sa khuid . Bad mardor la pynkhuid ia ka jingpang sniehdoh jong u .

en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands ,
kha: U Jephthah u kular ha U  Trai  :  Lada me ai ha nga ka jingjop pyrshah ïa ki Ammon ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la kular ha U Trai bad u la ong: Lada me ai khlem pep ia ki khun Ammon ha ki kti jong nga .

en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan , u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba un da poi ha u dieng kyntang jong u Moreh , ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem . ( Ha kata ka por , ki Kanaan ki dang don ha ka ri . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la iaid lyngba ka ri haduh ka jaka Shechem, haduh ka madan Mrek . Bad u Kanaani u la don ha kata ka por ha kata ka ri .

en: So the workmen wrought , and the work was perfected by them , and they set the house of God in his state , and strengthened it .
kha: Baroh na ki , ki trei shitom , bad ki pynwandur biang ïa ka Templ kumba ka ju long mynshuwa kaba ïeng skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki nongtrei ki la trei, bad la pyndep ia ka kam da ki, bad ki la buh ia ka iing U Blei ha ka jylla jong u, bad ki la pynskhem ia ka .

en: Being confident of this very thing , that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ :
kha: Bad kumta nga sngewskhem ba U Blei , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kam babha ha phi , un ïai trei ha phi haduh ba yn da pyndep ïa ka ha kata ka Sngi jong U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewskhem ia kane hi , ba uta uba la sdang ia ka kam kaba bha ha phi un pyndep ia ka haduh ka sngi U Jisu Khrist:

en: Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :
kha: ki kynthei bad ki khynnah jong phi , ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit jong phi, ki tnga jong phi bad ki nongwei jong me kiba don ha ka jaka shong jong me, naduh ka jingkhluit jong u dieng jong me haduh ka um jong me:

en: And David arose , and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish , the son of Maoch , king of Gath .
kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u hynriewspah ngut ki leit sha u Akhish u khun jong u Maokh , u syiem ka Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ieng bad u la iaid lait bad ki hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ha u Achish u khun u Maoch u syiem Gath .

en: And some fell on stony ground , where it had not much earth  ; and immediately it sprang up , because it had no depth of earth :
kha: Katto katne na u , u la hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw , ha ka jaka ba duna khyndew . Tang katto katne por ki symbai ki la shylluit , namar ka khyndew kam da jylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don kiba hap ha ka khyndew kaba jylliew, ha kaba kam don khyndew than; bad mardor ka la mih noh , namar kam don ka jingjylliew jong ka khyndew:

en: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
kha: Kaei , te , ngan leh ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?   Sahnarphna ïa u !  Baroh ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u ong ha ki , Nga leh aiu te bad U Jisu uba la khot U Khrist ? Baroh ki ong ha u , To ai ba un shah sahnarphna .

en: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root : Israel shall blossom and bud , and fill the face of the world with fruit .
kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan ki paid Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , kin suhthied kum u dieng , bad kin phuh bad shylluit . Ïa ka pyrthei yn pyndap da u soh uba ki pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynlong ia kito kiba wan na u Jakob ban shim tynrai: Ki Israel kin phuh bad kin phuh , bad kin pyndap ia ka khmat jong ka pyrthei da ki soh .

en: Therefore my people shall know my name : therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak : behold , it is I .
kha: Ha ki por ki ban wan phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei bad ba nga la kren ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki briew jong nga kin tip ia ka kyrteng jong nga: namarkata kin sa tip ha kata ka sngi ba nga long uta uba kren: ha khmih , dei ma nga .

en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem , and be glad with her , all ye that love her : rejoice for joy with her , all ye that mourn for her :
kha: To shadkmen bad ka Jerusalem ; to lehkmen na ka bynta jong ka , phi baroh kiba ieit ïa kane ka nongbah ! To shadkmen bad ka , mynta phi baroh kiba la ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong ka !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha ia ka Jerusalem bad to sngewbha ia ka: to sngewbha ia ka: to sngewbha ia ka:

en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world , what shall the receiving of them be , but life from the dead ?
kha: Naba haba ki la shah kyntait , ïa u bynriew la pynkylla na kaba long ki nongshun U Blei sha kaba long ki paralok jong u . Kaei ka ban long te , haba la pdiang ïa ki ? Kan long ka jingim ïa kiba la ïap!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka jingpynkylla ia ki ka long ka jingpyniasuk ia ka pyrthei , kaei ka jingpdiang ia ki , hynrei ka jingim na kiba iap ?

en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .
kha: Hynriew sngi shuwa ka Niam Ka Jinglait , U Jisu u la leit sha Bethania , ka shnong u Lasaros , u briew ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu hynriew sngi shuwa ka jingkhawai Niam ka la poi ha Bethania , ha kaba u Lasaros u la iap , ia uba u la pynmihpat na kiba iap .

en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .
kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na ka jinglum soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka aiom u la phah sha ki nongrep ia u shakri , ba un ioh na ki nongrep ia u soh jong u sohjew .

en: Neither be ye idolaters , as were some of them ; as it is written , The people sat down to eat and drink , and rose up to play .
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U paidbah u la shong ha ka jingkhawai kaba la kylla long ka jingïadih buaid bad ka jingleh nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim long ruh ki nongmane bleithaw, kumba la long katto katne na ki ; kumba la thoh , Ki briew ki la shong ban bam bad dih, bad ki la ieng ban ialehkai .

en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward  ;
kha: Kata ka khubor ïa kaba la pynbna da ki angel ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ka long kaba shisha , bad uno uno u bym shym bud ïa ka lane u bym shym kohnguh ïa ka u shah pynshitom kumba ka dei hok ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka ktien ba la kren da ki angel ka long kaba stet , bad kawei pa kawei ka jingpynkhein bad ka jingbym kohnguh ka la ioh ia ka jingsiew kaba hok;

en: And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .
kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew baroh ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tep ia u Abner ha Hebron : bad u syiem u la pynkiew ia ka sur jong u, bad u la iam ha ka jingtep jong u Abner ; bad ki briew baroh ki iam .

en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth , he began to cry out , and say , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba dei U Jisu uba na Nasareth , u la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! U Khun U Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U la sngap ba u long U Jisu na Nazareth, u la sdang ban pyrta bad u la ong: Ko Jisu, ko Khun u Dabid, to isynei ia nga .

en: And he said , Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him . And it was told him , saying , Behold , he is in Dothan .
kha: Khie leit wad ha-ei u don ,  u syiem u hukum ,  bad ngan sa phah kem ïa u .  Haba la ïathuh ba u Elisha u don ha Dothan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, Leit bad to peit bniah ia u ha ka jaka ba u don, ba ngan phah bad shim ia u. Bad la iathuh ia u da kaba ong: Ha khmih u don ha Dotan .

en: Remember them that are in bonds , as bound with them  ; and them which suffer adversity , as being yourselves also in the body .
kha: To kynmaw ïa kito kiba don ha ïingbyndi , la kumba phi don lang bad ki ha ïingbyndi . Kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom , la kumba phi ruh phi shahshitom kum ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kita kiba don ha ki jingiadei, kumba la teh bad ki ; bad kito kiba shah shitom, kumba phi long hi ruh ha ka met .

en: And it came to pass , that , when Abraham s servant heard their words , he worshipped the  Lord  , bowing himself to the earth .
kha: Haba u shakri jong u Abraham u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u dem ngon bad u mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u shakri Abraham u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ki, u la mane ia U Trai da kaba dem khrup ha ka khyndew .

en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim uba la mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jubab ki la ong , u Ioannis u Nonghikai ; hynrei don kiba ong , Elias ; bad kiwei pat ki ong , ba uwei na ki nongiathuhlypa barim u la mihpat biang .

en: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well s mouth , and spread ground corn thereon  ; and the thing was not known .
kha: Ka tnga jong uta u briew ka shim kawei ka jingtap , ka siang ïa ka halor kata ka pukri , bad ka la thad kew halor jong ka , khnang ba mano mano kin ym ïohi ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei ka la shim bad pynphriang ia ka jingtap halor ka shyntur jong ka thliew, bad ka la pynphriang ia u kew khyndew ha kata ka por ; bad ia kata ym shym la tip .

en: Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .
kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi da ki ktien bieit , namar dei na kine kiei kiei ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan wan ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ia phi da ki ktien kiba lehnohei: namar namar kine kiei kiei ki wan ka jingbitar U Blei halor ki khun jong ka jingbym kohnguh .

en: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God , and your sins have hid his face from you , that he will not hear .
kha: Ka dei namar ki pop jong phi ba um shym ïohsngew ïa phi . Ka dei ki pop jong phi kiba pynïakhlad ïa phi na U Blei haba phi pyrshang ban mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jingbymhok jong phi ki la iakhlad noh hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei jong phi , bad ki pop jong phi ki la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong u na phi , ba un ym iohsngew .

en: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .
kha: U angel jong U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , bad ka burom jong U Trai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki . Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u angel U Trai u la wan ha ki, bad ka burom U Trai ka la shai sawdong jong ki: bad ki la tieng shibun .

en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .
kha: U Saul u khot lang ïa ki ha Besek : ki rangbah Israel ki don lai lakh ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la khein ia ki ha Bezek, ki khun Israel ki long lai spah hajar bad ki shynrang Judah ki long laiphew hajar .

en: Again , when I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; if he turn from his sin , and do that which is lawful and right  ;
kha: Nga lah ban maham ïa u briew uba sniew ba u dei ban ïap , hynrei lada u sangeh na kaba leh pop bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha —
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien haba nga ong ha kiba sniew , Me dei ban iap shuh shuh lada u phai noh na ka pop jong u, bad leh ia kata kaba long katkum ka ain bad kaba dei;

en: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem , and besieged it .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai ba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad kerkut ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Judah u Neuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon u la wan sha Jerusalem bad u la ker ia ka .

en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre , unto the city of Arbah , which is Hebron , where Abraham and Isaac sojourned .
kha: U Jakob u la leit sha u Isaak u kpa jong u ha Mamre , hajan Hebron , ha kaba u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la ju shong ju sah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la wan sha u kpa jong u ha ka shnong Arbah kaba long u Hebron ha kaba u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la sah .

en: The  Lord  hath been mindful of us : he will bless us  ; he will bless the house of Israel  ; he will bless the house of Aaron .
kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw ïa ngi , bad un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pyrkhat ia ngi: un kyrkhu ia ngi ; un kyrkhu ia ka iing Israel ; un kyrkhu ia ka iing u Aaron .

en: And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
kha: Kane ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um lah ban kyrngah ïa ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem u la sngewsih palat ia ka jingsngewsih jong u, bad na ka bynta jong ki kiba shong bad u, un ym kyntait ia ka .

en: And thou shalt speak my words unto them , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear : for they are most rebellious .
kha: Men ong ha ki ïa kaei ba nga bthah ïa me ban ong , lada ki sngap ne kim sngap . Kynmaw ba ki long ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ia ki ktien jong nga ha ki , la kin iohsngew ne kin iehnoh: namar ki long kiba leh pyrshah tam .

en: And the land is defiled : therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it , and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants .
kha: Ki kam jong ki , ki la pyntngit ïa kata ka ri , bad kumta U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ka ri bad un pynlong ruh ïa ka , ban kyntait noh ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri ka la jakhlia: namarkata nga leit jngoh ia ka jingbymhok jong ka halor jong ka, bad ka ri hi ka pynmih ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka .

en: Although China won the war , Chinese troops withdrew north of the McMahon Line , effectively ceding Arunachal Pradesh to India .
kha: Wat la ka China ka la jop ia ka thma hynrei ki shipai China ki la kynran dien noh shaphang shatei jong u McMahon Line bad da kaba aiti noh ia ka Arunachal Pradesh sha ka India .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka China ka la jop ia ka thma hynrei ki shipai China ki la mih noh shaphang shathie jong ka McMahon Line , da kaba ai noh ia ka Arunachal Pradesh sha India .

en: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house , for all the service thereof , and for all that shall be done therein .
kha: Nga buh ïa ki ban leh ïa ka kam bapoh ïa kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynlong ia ki ki nongsumar ia ka iing , na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka baroh bad na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba dei ban leh hangta .

en: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord , A pair of turtledoves , or two young pigeons .
kha: Ki la leit ruh ban ai jingkñia da shi jur ki lyngdkhur lane ar tylli ki khun paro , kumba la dawa da ka aiñ jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban aiti ia ka jingknia kat kum kata kaba la ong ha ka hukum U Trai , Kawei ka kynhun ki turtle , ne ar tylli ki paro kiba dang rit .

en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
kha: Nangta u pyndap ,  Nga don hangne ka kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u la ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Shaphan u la iathuh ha u syiem, u da ong, U Hilkiah u lyngdoh u la ai ia nga ka kot . Bad u Shaphan u la pule ia ka ha khmat u syiem .

en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .
kha: Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïathuh ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumta ïa ka jingai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist la ai ïa kito kiba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingthoh ka la pynkut lut hapoh ka pop, ba ka jingkular da ka jingngeit U Jisu Khrist kan long kaba la ai ha kito kiba ngeit .

en: But he said , As the  Lord  liveth , before whom I stand , I will receive none . And he urged him to take it  ; but he refused .
kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , uba nga shakri , nga smai ba ngan ym pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha .  U Naaman u ïai ban ba un pdiang , hynrei um treh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong , Kumba U Trai u im, ha khmat jong u, ngan ym pdiang ei ei . Bad u la kyntu ia u ban shim ia ka ; hynrei u la kyntait .

en: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,
kha: Na u Petros , u Apostol U Jisu Khrist — Sha ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei kiba im kum ki nongphetwir kiba la pynsakma kylleng ki probins jong ka Pontos , ka Galatia , ka Kappadokia , ka Asia bad ka Bithynia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u apostol U Jisu Khrist ha ki nongwei kiba la saphriang kylleng ka ri Ponto , Kalatia , Kapadocia , Asia bad Bithynia .

en: But and if she depart , let her remain unmarried , or be reconciled to her husband : and let not the husband put away his wife .
kha: hynrei lada ka leh kumta , ka dei ban shong khynraw noh lane ka dei ban ïasuk pat bad la u tnga bad u tnga um dei ban pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad lada ka leit noh, to ai ba kan sah khlem shongkurim, ne shah pynbeit bad u tnga jong ka: bad wat ai ba u tnga un weng noh ia ka tnga jong u .

en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof  ; if not , where , and who is he ?
kha: U Blei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha ki bymman . U pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbishar kiba matlah . Bad lada ym dei U Blei uba leh ïa kata , uei uba leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka long ha ka kti jong kiba sniew: u tap ia ki khmat jong ki nongbishar jong ka ; lada ym dei , shano , bad u long mano ?

en: ( Genesis 1 :28 ) Yes , God’s purpose was for them to have children and eventually to spread their Paradise over all the earth .
kha: ( Jenesis 1 :28 ) Hooid , ka jingthmu jong u Blei ka long ïa ki ban ïoh khun bad ban pynïar ïa ka paradais satlak ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Jenesis 1 :28 ) Hooid , ka jingthmu jong U Blei ka long na ka bynta jong ki ban ioh khun bad khatduh ban pynphriang ia ka Paradais jong ki ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him . And he went into the Pharisee s house , and sat down to meat .
kha: U Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa U Jisu ban ïabam miet bad u , bad U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u bad u la shong ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi u la kwah ia u ba un iabam bad u . Bad u la leit shapoh iing u Pharisi bad u la shong ha ka jingbam .

en: Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wan jia ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit , wat pyrkhat ba kam long kaba phylla shaphang ka jingpyrshang kaba shyrkhei kaba dei ban pyrshang ia phi , kumba don kaei kaei kaba phylla kaba la jia ha phi:

en: One man esteemeth one day above another : another esteemeth every day alike . Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind .
kha: Uwei u briew u pyrkhat ba kawei ka sngi ka kham donkam ban ïa kiwei pat ki sngi , katba uwei pat u pyrkhat ba baroh ki sngi ki ïalong kumjuh . Uwei pa uwei u dei ban skhem ha la ka jong ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u burom ia kawei ka sngi halor kawei pat: uwei pat u burom man la ka sngi kumjuh . Ai ba uwei pa uwei un shah pynbor pura ha la ka jong ka jingmut .

en: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .
kha: Nalor kine , U Blei u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi bad shibun ka spah ka phew ba u ïoh ban tei shibun ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la pynbiang ia u ia ki nongbah , bad ki jingdon jong ki kynhun bad ki kynhun masi ha ka jingbun: namar U Blei u la ai ia u shibun kiei kiei .

en: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon , even all these words that are written against Babylon .
kha: Nga la thoh ha ka kot ïa ka jingthoh shaphang ka jingpynjot baroh ka ban wan hap ha Babilonia , ryngkat bad kine baroh kiei kiei kiwei pat shaphang ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jeremaiah u la thoh ha ka kot ia ki jingsniew baroh kiba dei ban wan ha Babilon , wat ia kine ki kyntien baroh kiba la thoh pyrshah ia ka Babilon .

en: But Jesus turning unto them said ,  Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .
kha: U Jisu u la phai sha ki bad u la ong ,  Ko kynthei Jerusalem ! Wat ïam na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei na ka bynta ïa lade bad ki khun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai sha ki bad u la ong: Ko khun Jerusalem, wat iam na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei to iam na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ki khun jong phi .

en: Therefore I say unto you , What things soever ye desire , when ye pray , believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .
kha: Namar kane ka daw nga ong ïa phi : Haba phi duwai bad pan ïa kaei kaei , ngeit ba phi la ïohpdiang ïa ka , bad yn ai ïa phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ong ha phi , Kaei kaba phi kwah, haba phi duwai, ngeit ba phi pdiang ia ki, bad phin sa ioh ia ki .

en: Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .
kha: Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat noh na Israel kum ïa uta u nongpynïap briew , khnang ba phin manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong me kan ym sngewsynei ia u , hynrei me dei ban weng noh ia ka pop jong ka snam bym don pop na Israel , ba kan iaid bha bad me .

en: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully , and said , because he had defiled Dinah their sister :
kha: Namar ba u Shekhem u la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka Dinah ka para jong ki , ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la phai ktien ïa u Shekhem bad u Hamor u kpa jong u da ka buit shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la jubab da kaba thok bad u kpa jong u u la ong:

en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  namar ym don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ba shen hadien un ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong: Wat ia u: namar ym don briew uba leh ia ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , uba lah ban kren bein ia nga da kaba jem .

en: And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
kha: Ha ka hukum u Solomon ki la shtah ïa ki maw kiba heh itynnat na ka bynta ka nongrim jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum , bad ki la wanrah ia ki maw kiba heh , ki maw kiba rem dor bad ki maw ba la khleh lang ban buh ia ka nongrim jong ka iing .

en: After it a voice roareth : he thundereth with the voice of his excellency  ; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard .
kha: Nangta ïa ka jingkyrhuh ka sur jong u la ïohsngew ka jingriew sngewtynnat jong u pyrthat , bad ha ki por baroh ka leilieh ka thaba .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong ka ka sur ka rkhie bein: u rkhie bein da ka sur jong ka jingbha jong u bad un ym sah ia ki haba la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u .

en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah , and made obeisance to the king . Then the king hearkened unto them .
kha: Hynrei haba u Jehoïada u la ïap , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki khroh ïa u syiem Joash ban shahshkor noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien ka jingiap jong u Jehoiada ki la wan ki rangbah Judah bad ki la kohnguh ia u syiem . Nangta u syiem u la sngap ia ki .

en: And Hamor communed with them , saying , The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter : I pray you give her him to wife .
kha: U Hamor u ong ha u ,  U khun jong nga u Shekhem u la ïapmat ïa ka khun jong phi ; sngewbha shah ïa u ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hamor u la iakynduh bad ki, u da ong, Ka mynsiem jong u khun jong nga u Shechem ka kwah eh ia ka khun jong phi: Nga duwai ba phin ai ia ka ha ka tnga .

en: So they laid hands on her  ; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king s house , they slew her there .
kha: Ki la kem ïa ka , ki ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka Khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la buh kti ia ka ; bad haba ka la poi ha ka jingkhang kulai da ka iing syiem , ki la pyniap ia ka hangta .

en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots , with mighty men , and with all men of war , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ha ka miej jong nga kin bam baroh katba lah na ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai jong ki bad na ki shipai bad ki nongïaleh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin sa dap ha ka miej jong nga da ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar, bad ki briew kiba khlain bor bad bad ki shipai baroh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh , that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus .
kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang , bad haba nga ïashem ïa phi ha ka mynsiem jong nga , da ka bor jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi uba don ryngkat bad ngi , phi aiti noh ïa une u briew sha u Soitan ban pynjot ïa ka met jong u , khnang ba ïa ka mynsiem yn ïoh pynim ha ka Sngi jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban aiti ia kum uta ha u Soitan na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ia ka doh , ba ka mynsiem kan ioh jingpynim ha ka sngi U Trai Jisu .

en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem , and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kit ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom sha Jerusalem , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la rah ia u ha ka kali sha Jerusalem , bad ki la tep ia u ha ka jingtep jong u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid .

en: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?
kha: Ngam pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kaba ki briew kin ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la tieng ia u paidbah uba bun , ne ka jingbym shimkhia jong ki longiing ka la pyntieng ia nga , ba nga la sngap jar , bad ngam shym la mih na ka jingkhang ?

en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jinghikai u Moses u shakri jong nga , ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la ai ha u ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel baroh ban kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ka hukum jong u Moses u shakri jong nga, kaba nga la hukum ha u ha Horb na ka bynta ki Israel baroh , ryngkat bad ki ain bad ki jingbishar .

en: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father s household , with bread , according to their families .
kha: U Joseph u pyndap pynbiang jingbam ïa la u kpa , ïa la ki hynmen ki para , bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing u kpa jong u baroh katba ki ïadon , haduh kiba khynnah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la pyndap ia la u kpa bad ki hynmen jong u bad ka iing jong u baroh, da u kpu kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .
kha: Pynban , ngam kwah ban shim shibun ïa ka por jong me , kumta nga kyrpad ïa me ban sngewbha ban shahshkor ïa ka jingïathuh lyngkot jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh, ba ngam long uba sngewsih shuh ia me, nga kyrpad ia me ba me sngap ia ngi katto katne ki kyntien jong me .

en: But the more they afflicted them , the more they multiplied and grew . And they were grieved because of the children of Israel .
kha: Pynban katba ki Israel ki nang shah pynshitom beiñ , katta ruh ki nang ïaroi bad ki nang saphriang kylleng ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba ki nang pynshitom ia ki, katta ki nang bun bad nangroi . Bad ki la sngewsih namar ki khun Israel .

en: And Saul knew David s voice , and said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And David said , It is my voice , my lord , O king .
kha: U Saul u sngewthuh ïa ka sur u Dabid , bad u kylli ,  Dabid , hato dei ma phi ko khun jong nga ?   Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ,  u Dabid u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ithuh ia ka sur u Dabid bad u la ong, Hato kane ka dei ka sur jong me, ko khun jong nga u Dabid? Bad u Dabid u la ong, Ka dei ka sur jong nga, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem .

en: But I say unto you , That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : uno uno uba khmih ïa ka briew bad kwah ban ïoh ïa ka u la hap ha ka jingpynrem jong ka jingklim bad ka hapoh ka dohnud jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Ba uno uno uba peit ia ka kynthei ban kwah ia ka u la leh be-ijot bad ka la leh be-ijot ia ka ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .
kha: Haba u wan phai na Damaskos , u Ahas u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka duwan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la wan na Damaskos , u syiem u la iohi ia ka jingknia: bad u syiem u la leit shajan ka jingknia bad u la tyrwa ha kata ka por .

en: But if thine heart turn away , so that thou wilt not hear , but shalt be drawn away , and worship other gods , and serve them  ;
kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh bad phi kyntait ban shahshkor , bad phi shah ïalam bakla ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka dohnud jong me ka phai noh, khnang ba men ym iohsngew, hynrei kan shah rong noh bad mane ia kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ia ki ; .

en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .
kha: U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang ba u lah ban ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la rung shapoh , bad u la kwah na u syiem ba un ai por ia u , bad ba un pyni ia u syiem ia ka jingbatai .

en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers ,
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la shah khein na ki longiing jong ki khun shynrang jong ki Merari , ha ki longiing jong ki baroh kawei .

en: The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .
kha: Ka lawar ding ka klang rhem bha , hynrei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid noh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki briew jong nga , namar ïa kito kiba sniew ym shym la weng noh .
translated_en_to_kha: La thang ia ki bniat, la bam ia ka lead; u nongseng u rkhiang khlem da pyrkhat ei ei: namar ki bymman kim shah rong noh .

en: Now when she saw that she had waited , and her hope was lost , then she took another of her whelps , and made him a young lion .
kha: Ka la ap tad haduh ba ka la ïoh ba ka jingkyrmen baroh ka la duh . Nangta ka la pynheh pynsan sa ïa uwei pat na ki khun sing , bad u la san ban long u sing uba ishyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka la iohi ba ka la ap, bad ka jingkyrmen jong ka ka la jah noh, nangta ka la shim sa kawei pat ka bniat jong ka, bad ka la pynlong ia u u sing samla .

en: And he said , What cities are these which thou hast given me , my brother ? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day .
kha: Kumta u ong ha u Solomon ,  Ko para , kine seh ki shnong ba phi la ai ïa nga !  Na kane ka daw ïa kane ka jaka la dang khot ka Kabul .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, Kiei kine ki shnong kiba me la ai ha nga, ko para jong nga ? Bad u la khot ia ki ka ri u Cabul haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .
kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha ka , Ngan pynbun palat ia u symbai jong me, ba un ym khein ia u khun masi .

en: And of Gad he said , Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad : he dwelleth as a lion , and teareth the arm with the crown of the head .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Gad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei uba pynïar ïa ka ri jong ki . U Gad u ap ktem kum u sing ban patar ïa ka kti ne ïa ka snieh khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Gad u la ong: La kyrkhu ia uta uba pynheh ia u Gad: u shong kum u sing , bad u pynkhih ia ka kti da ka khlieh .

en: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab , over against Beth–peor : but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day .
kha: U  Trai  u la tep ïa u ha kawei ka them ha Moab , marpyrshah ka shnong Bethpeor , hynrei haduh kane ka sngi ruh ym don uba tip ïa ka jaka tep jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tep ia u ha ka them ha ka ri Moab, ha khmat ka Bethpeor: hynrei ym don ba tip ia ka jingtep jong u haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go unto the people , and sanctify them to day and to morrow , and let them wash their clothes ,
kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ba kin pynkhuid ïa lade mynta ka sngi bad la shai ruh khnang ba ki lah ban mane .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Leit sha ki briew bad pynkhuid ia ki haduh ka sngi bad lashai ka sngi bad ai ba kin sait ia ki jain jong ki .

en: Draw nigh to God , and he will draw nigh to you . Cleanse your hands , ye sinners  ; and purify your hearts , ye double minded .
kha: To wan hajan U Blei , bad un wan hajan jong phi . To sait ïa la ki kti , ko phi ki nongpop ! To pynkhuid ïa la ki dohnud , phi kiba arsap !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia U Blei bad un sa ring ia phi . Pynkhuid ia ki kti jong phi, phi ki nongpop ; bad pynkhuid ia ki dohnud jong phi, phi la pyrkhat arsien .

en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the  Lord  hath given them ?
kha: Kumno phi nud ban pyrshang ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki Israel na kaba jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namarkata phi pynduh mynsiem ia ka dohnud ki Israel na kaba leit sha ka ri kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki ?

en: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga , kumba nga la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Kpa jong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi sumar ia ki hukum jong nga, phin kohnguh ha ka jingieit jong nga ; kumba nga la kohnguh ia ki hukum jong u Kpa jong nga, bad to kohnguh ha ka jingieit jong u .

en: If you are studying the Bible with one of Jehovah’s Witnesses , you likely try to review the material in advance of each study .
kha: Lada phi ïa pule Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , lehse phi ju pule lypa shuwa ban sdang ka jingïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi pule ia ka Baibl bad uwei na ki Nongsakhi jong U Jehobah, phi lah ban pyrshang ban bishar bniah ia ka jingthoh shwa kawei pa kawei ka jingpule .

en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace : but he cried the more a great deal , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
kha: Bun ki briew ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kham jam shuh shuh ,  Ko Khun U Dabid , to isynei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki la kynnoh ia u ba u dei ban bat ia ka jingsuk jong u: hynrei u la pyrta kham bun: Me Khun u Dabid, to isynei ia nga .

en: Is not this the carpenter s son ? is not his mother called Mary ? and his brethren , James , and Joses , and Simon , and Judas ?
kha: Um dei une u khun jong u misteri ? Hato ka Mari kam dei ka kmie jong u , bad hato u Jakob , u Josis , u Simon bad u Judah kim dei ki para shynrang jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato une u khun jong u nongshna nar ? hato ka kmie jong u kam dei ka Maria ? bad ki hynmen jong u u Jakob bad u Joses bad u Simon bad u Judas ?

en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches , and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :
kha: Ka jingstad bad ka jingtbit jong me ka la pynriewspah ïa me da ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingstad jong me bad da ka jingsngewthuh jong me me la ioh ia me ia ka spah, bad me la ioh ia ka ksiar bad ka rupa ha ki spah jong me:

en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .
kha: Ha kata ka miet , ïa ka doh dei ban syang , bad bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu khlem thiat bad ki jhur kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dei ban bam ia ka doh ha kata ka miet, da kaba thang da ka ding bad u kpu bym don thied; bad da ki jingthung ba thiang kin bam ia ka .

en: To make their land desolate , and a perpetual hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished , and wag his head .
kha: Ki la pynlong ïa kane ka ri ka bynta ka jingtriem , ban ñiewbeiñ junom . Baroh kiba la ïaid lyngba kin kyndit ha kaei kaba ki ïohi ; kin kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jinglyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynlong ia ka ri jong ki kaba la jot , bad ka jingsawa kaba neh ; uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba kata un sngew lyngngoh , bad un pynkhih ia la ka khlieh .

en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth , in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth .
kha: ( Ko Oholibah , pha kwah ban leh biang ïa ka jingjakhlia ïa kiba la pynrem ïa pha kum ka samla khynraw ha Ijipt , ha kaba ki rangbah ki ïalehkai bad ka shadem jong pha bad pha duh noh ïa la ka jinglong sotti . )
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta me la khot ban kynmaw ia ka jinglong samla jong me, ha kaba pynkhih ia ki bniat jong me da ki nong Ijipt na ka bynta ki pop jong ka jinglong samla jong me .

en: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , This fellow doth not cast out devils , but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .
kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la jubab ,  U la beh noh ïa ki ksuid tang namar ba u rangbah jong ki , u Beelsebul u ai bor ïa u ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Pharisi ki la iohsngew ia kata ki la ong: Une u paralok um ju beh ksuid hynrei da u Belzebul u syiem ki ksuid .

en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner , and became one troop , and stood on the top of an hill .
kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïalumlang sa shisien sawdong ïa u Abner bad ki la ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la ialum lang hadien u Abner bad ki la kylla long kawei ka kynhun shipai bad ki la ieng ha jrong jong u lum .

en: And he said unto his servant , Come , and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night , in Gibeah , or in Ramah .
kha: Hynrei u kynrad jong u , u ong ,  Ngin ym leit sah ha ka nongbah ha kaba ki briew kim dei ki Israel . Ngin ïaid shaphrang ban ïaleit sahmiet ha Gibeah lane Ramah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u shakri jong u, To wan, bad to ngin iajan bad kawei na kine ki jaka ban sah baroh shi miet, ha Gibeah ne ha Ramah .

en: I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .
kha: Kham hadien , nga la phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad nga la wallam ka jingjynjar bakhraw halor ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phah ia u Moses ruh bad u Aaron , bad nga la pynshitom ia ka ri Ijipt , kat kum kata kaba nga la leh hapdeng jong ki: bad hadien kata nga la pynmih noh ia phi .

en: And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .
kha: Haba u briew u wan hajan u Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju kner la ki kti , u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba haba uno uno u briew u la wan hajan jong u ban leh ia u da kaba kohnguh ia u , u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la shim ia u bad u la kdup ia u .

en: Thus the  Lord  saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians  ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u pyllait im ïa ki Israel na ki Ijipt , bad ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ki ba ki thiah ïap harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai u la pynim ia ki Israel ha kata ka sngi na ka kti jong ki nong Ijipt ; bad ki Israel ki la iohi ia ki nong Ijipt kiba la iap ha rud duriaw .

en: And Abraham ran unto the herd , and fetched a calf tender and good , and gave it unto a young man  ; and he hasted to dress it .
kha: Nangta u mareh sha ka kynhun jingri , u shim uwei u khun masi uba dang lung bad uba dap doh , bad u ai ha u shakri , uba pynstet ban leit shet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la mareh sha ka kynhun masi bad u la shim ia u khun masi uba jem bad uba bha, bad u la ai ia u ha u samla ; bad u la kyrkieh ban riam ia ka .

en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , when ye are gathered together , and my spirit , with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
kha: Bad wat la nga long jngai na phi ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem ; kumba nga ju don bad phi , ha ka kyrteng U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi nga la lah bishar halor uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist haba phi ialum lang bad ka mynsiem jong nga da ka bor U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .
kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi U  Trai  ! Kaei kaba bha ba kata ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka bynta jong phi kan long tang ka sngi jong ka jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia phi kiba kwah ia ka sngi U Trai ! sha kaei ka jingkut na ka bynta jong phi ? ka sngi U Trai ka long ka jingdum , bad ym ka jingshai .

en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .
kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  Nga la pyrkhat ba yn ym don hangne kiba sheptieng burom ïa U Blei , ba kumta kin pynïap ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka tnga jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong: Namar nga la pyrkhat , Hooid ka jingtieng ia U Blei kam don ha kane ka jaka bad kin pyniap ia nga na ka bynta ka tnga jong nga .

en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .
kha: U Abraham u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew san snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abraham u la iehnoh ia u ksuid, bad u la iap ha ka rta kaba bha, u tymmen bad uba dap da ki snem ; bad u la ialum lang bad ki briew jong u .

en: And John was clothed with camel s hair , and with a girdle of a skin about his loins  ; and he did eat locusts and wild honey  ;
kha: U Ïoannis u la phong da ki jaiñ ba la shna na ki shñiuh ut , bad u panpoh snieh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la phong da ki shniuh kulai bad da ka sniehdoh kaba jrong shaphang ki tyrpeng jong u ; bad u la bam ia ki khnai bad ka umsoh khlaw ; .

en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .
kha: Wan kiew sha nga ha uta u lum , bad ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kito ki ktien kiba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta men buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan thoh ha ki miej ia ki kyntien kiba don ha ki miej ba nyngkong kiba me bret , bad me buh ia ki ha ka synduk .

en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,
kha: Mynta , bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka por ? Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shano ngan ianujor ia kane ka pateng ? Ka long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki iew ki hat bad kiba khot ia ki paralok jong ki .

en: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven : behold , it shall come down upon Edom , and upon the people of my curse , to judgment .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhreh ïa ka waitlam jong u ha bneng , bad mynta kan mait ïa ki Edom , kita ki briew ïa kiba u la pynrem sha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka waitlam jong nga kan sa shah rong noh ha bneng: ha khmih kan hiar ha u Edom bad ha ki briew jong ka jingtim jong nga, ha ka jingbishar .

en: Now therefore put away , said he , the strange gods which are among you , and incline your heart unto the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Te kumta , iehnoh syndon ïa kito ki blei nongwei kiba phi don ,  u la dawa ,  bad kular skhem ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to weng noh ia ki blei nongwei kiba don hapdeng jong phi bad pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong phi sha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kita kiba la pdiang sngewbha ia ka ktien jong u ki la shah pynbaptis: bad ha kajuh ka sngi la pyndap ia ki kumba lai hajar mynsiem .

en: PM Modi met Finance Minister Arun Jaitley , RBI Governor Urjit Patel and other key officials involved in economic policymaking .
kha: U PM Modi u la ïakynduh ïa u Myntri ka tnad pla tyngka u Arun Jaitley , u Lat ka RBI u Urjit Patel bad kiwei kiwei ki heh ba kongsan kiba donkti ha ka jingthaw ïa ki polisi ha ka liang ka ioh ka kot .
translated_en_to_kha: U PM Modi u la iakynduh ia u Myntri pla pisa u Arun Jaitley , u Lat ka RBI u Urjit Patel bad kiwei kiwei ki heh ba kongsan kiba donkti ha ka kam khaii pateng .

en: A land of darkness , as darkness itself  ; and of the shadow of death , without any order , and where the light is as darkness .
kha: Ka ri ka jingdum , ki syrngiew bad jingkulmar , ha kaba ka jingshai hi ka long ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri jong ka jingdum, kum ka jingdum hi ; bad ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , khlem kano kano ka order , bad ha kaba ka jingshai ka long kum ka jingdum .

en: If it do evil in my sight , that it obey not my voice , then I will repent of the good , wherewith I said I would benefit them .
kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh ïa nga bad ka leh ïa kaba sniew , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka leh ia kaba sniew ha ka khmat jong nga , ba kam kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga , te ngan kylla bamut na kaba bha , da kaba nga ong ba ngan pynmyntoi ia ki .

en: Give wings unto Moab , that it may flee and get away : for the cities thereof shall be desolate , without any to dwell therein .
kha: To buh ïa u maw jingtep na ka bynta ka Moab ; shen yn pynjot ïa ka . Ïa ki shnong jong ka yn ieh ha ka jingjot , bad yn ym don shuh uwei ruh u ban shong ban sah pat hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia ki bniat sha u Moab , ba kan phet noh bad phet noh: namar ki shnong jong ka kin sa jah rngai noh khlem don mano mano ruh ban shong hangta .

en: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , bad u la tip ba uta u briew u la pang la slem bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u ,  Me kwah ban ïohkhiah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohi ia u ba u la thiah , bad u la tip ba u la long mynta uba slem ha kata ka khep , u ong ha u , Hato me la pynlong pura ?

en: They shall come all for violence : their faces shall sup up as the east wind , and they shall gather the captivity as the sand .
kha: Ki kynhun shipai jong ki , ki tur jubor sha khmat ban jop , bad uwei pa uwei u la sngewtriem katba ki nang tur . Kiba shah kem ki bun bah kum u shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin wan baroh na ka bynta ka jingleh donbor: ki khmat jong ki kin sa kiew kum ka Iyer mihngi , bad kin lum ia ka jingshah set kum ka dewbilat .

en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .
kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ki jong U Blei , ko ki khun jong nga , bad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , namar U Mynsiem uba don ha phi , u long uba kham donbor ban ïa u mynsiem ha kito kiba long na ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long na U Blei, ko khun rit, bad phi la jop ia ki: namar uba kham khraw ha phi, ban ia uta uba don ha ka pyrthei .

en: And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .
kha: Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka la kmen haduh katta katta ba ka la mareh pat shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ïeng shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la ithuh ia ka sur jong u Petros, kam shym la plie ia ka khyrdop namar ka jingkmen, hynrei ka la mareh shapoh bad ka la iathuh kumno u Petros u ieng ha khmat ka khyrdop .

en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :
kha: Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Ahab kumba nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel bad jong u Baasha u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ka iing u Ahab kum ka iing u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat bad kum ka iing u Basa u khun u Ahijah:

en: And the heathen shall know that I the  Lord  do sanctify Israel , when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore .
kha: Haba nga pynïeng ïa ka Templ jong nga hangta ba kan don hapdeng jong ki junom , te ki jaitbynriew kin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la jied ïa ki Israel ba kin long ki briew ki jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongwei kin tip ba nga U Trai nga pynkyntang ia ki Israel , haba ka jaka kyntang jong nga kan long hapdeng jong ki junom .

en: Parthians , and Medes , and Elamites , and the dwellers in Mesopotamia , and in Judaea , and Cappadocia , in Pontus , and Asia ,
kha: Ngi dei na Parthia , na Media , bad na Elam ; na Mesopotamia , na Judia , bad na Kappadokia ; na Pontos bad na Asia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Bynta , bad ki Media , bad ki Elamite , bad ki nongshong shnong ha Mesopotamia , bad ha Judaea , bad ha Kapadocia , ha Pontous bad Asia .

en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :
kha: Um shym la shong la sah ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Kapernam , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thain jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la mih noh na Nazareth, u la wan shong ha Kaparnaum kaba don ha rud duriaw, ha ki pud u sam jong u Zabulon bad u Nephthalim:

en: And it came to pass , when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her , Fear not  ; thou shalt have this son also .
kha: Haba ki jingsuh kha ki la thar eh , ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Rakhel ; u dei sa uwei pat u shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ka dang trei shitom, ba kata ka nongkha khun ka la ong ia ka, Wat tieng; me ruh men don ia une u khun ruh .

en: For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .
kha: Ka la long ka mon jong me bad ka jingthmu jong me , ban leh ïa kane ; me la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba khraw khnang ban hikai ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ktien jong me, bad kat kum ka dohnud jong me hi, me la leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh kiba khraw, ban pynlong ia u shakri jong me ban tip ia ki .

en: As every man hath received the gift , even so minister the same one to another , as good stewards of the manifold grace of God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei , kum u sordar babha jong ki jingai ba bun jait jong U Blei , u dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingbha jong kiwei ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kaba u la ïohpdiang na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba uwei pa uwei u la ioh ia ka jingai, wat la katta ruh u shakri ia kajuh ka jingaiei kaba bun jong U Blei .

en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .
kha: Kane ka long kata ka hukum na ka bynta uta u briew uba ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh hynrei u bym kotbor ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kumba ju long ka rukom ïa kiba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong uta ha uba ka long ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh , uba ka kti jong u kam lah ban ioh ia kata kaba iadei bad ka jingpynkhuid jong u .

en: Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :
kha: Wat lada ki tih ïa ka lynti jong ki shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan kem ïa ki . Wat lada ki kiew sha bneng , ngan patan ïa ki shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ki tih shapoh dujok, te ka kti jong nga kan shim ia ki ; wat la ki kiew sha bneng, nangta ngan pynhap ia ki:

en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , to the saints which are at Ephesus , and to the faithful in Christ Jesus :
kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu — Sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Ephesos , kiba ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong ki ha U Khrist Jisu :
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul , u apostol U Jisu Khrist da ka mon U Blei , ha ki riewkhuid kiba don ha Ephesos bad ha kiba ngeit ha U Khrist Jisu:

en: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .
kha: Ïa ka jingieit la pynjanai noh ha ngi , ba ngin don ka jingshlur ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ; bad ngin don ïa ka namar ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei ka long kumjuh kum ka jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne ka jingieit jong ngi ka long kaba janai , ba ngin ioh ia ka jingshlur ha ka sngi bishar: namar kumba u long , kumta ngi long ha kane ka pyrthei .

en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof : and they shall light the lamps thereof , that they may give light over against it .
kha: Thaw hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad buh ïa ki ba kin ai jingshai ïa ka jaka kaba ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynlong ia ki hynriew tylli ki sharak jong ka: bad kin pynmeh ia ki sharak jong ka, ba kin pynshai ia ka .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting : and let all the people say , Amen . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel ; ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ong ,  Amen !  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai Blei jong ki Israel naduh bymjukut haduh bymjukut: bad to ai ba ki briew baroh kin ong , Amen . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips  ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .
kha: Nga leh borabor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u hukum ; nga bud ïa ka mon jong u , ym ïa ki jingkwah jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam shym la leit phai noh na ka hukum jong u ; nga la burom ia ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong u kham palat ban ia ka jingbam kaba donkam jong nga .

en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .
kha: U syiem Hiram jong ka Tyros u phah ka kynhun ki nongkhaïi sha u Dabid ; u pynbiang ïa u ki dieng sawdong Kedar bad ki misteri dieng bad ki misteri maw ban tei ïing ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u syiem Tyros u la phah ia ki dieng sohjew sha u Dabid, bad ki dieng sohjew bad ki diengsoh bad ki maw: bad ki la tei ia u Dabid ia ka iing .

en: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .
kha: Kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïing jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kaba ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ialam noh ia u sha u Kiaphas u rangbah lyngdoh ha kaba ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah ki la ialum lang .

en: And he went in unto Hagar , and she conceived : and when she saw that she had conceived , her mistress was despised in her eyes .
kha: U Abram u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Hagar , bad ka la punkhun . Haba ka tip ba ka la punkhun , ka la sngewsarong bad ka la ibeiñ ïa ka Sarai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha Hagar , bad ka la pun khun: bad haba ka la iohi ba ka la pun khun , ka jinglong trai jong ka ka la shah niewbein ha ki khmat jong ka .

en: And Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite , which was of Bahurim , hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Shimei u khun jong u Gera , na ka jait Benjamin kaba na Bahurim , u la pynkloi ban leit sha ka Jordan ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shimei u khun u Gera, u Benjamin uba long na Bahurim u la kyrkieh bad u la wan hiar ryngkat bad ki briew jong ka Judah ban iakynduh ia u syiem Dabid .

en: Now when these things were thus ordained , the priests went always into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the service of God .
kha: Kane ka long kumno la buh ryntih ïa kita kiei kiei . Ki lyngdoh ki rung shapoh ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ man ka sngi ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la pynbeit kumta ia kine kiei kiei, ki lyngdoh ki ju leit sha ka iing kaba nyngkong , ki pyndep ia ka jingshakri U Blei .

en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim shym lah ban beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha kito ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki dang ïaishong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun shynrang jong u Manasseh kim lah ban beh ia ki nongshong shnong jong kita ki shnong hynrei ki nongshong shnong kin shong ha kata ka ri .

en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
kha: U syiem jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-iwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syntiew ki paw ha ka khyndew ; ka por jong ka jingrwai ki sim ka wan , bad ka sur jong u turtle la iohsngew ha ka ri jong ngi ; .

en: For the scripture saith , Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn . And ,  The labourer is worthy of his reward .
kha: Naba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong ,  Ym dei ban teh ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh kew  bad  u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa la ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingthoh ka ong , Wat nym sngap jar ia u masi uba iaid shabar u kew . Bad , U nongtrei u long uba bit dor ia ka bainong jong u .

en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin .
kha: Kum u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai bad u la iaid ha ka lynti jong u Jeroboan bad ha ka pop jong u ha kaba u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?
kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki lai ngut ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah ; bad u la ong ha u Petros ,  Kumno keiñ ma phi lai ngut phim shym lah ban ïa-ap lem bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u wan sha ki synran bad u lap ia ki ba ki la iohthiah bad u ong ha u Petros: Kaei kaba phim lah ban peit bad nga shi kynta ?

en: The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .
kha: U  Trai  un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïada ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa nga na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai namarkata to long u nongbishar, bad to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad me, bad to peit, bad to kyrpad ia ka daw jong nga, bad to pyllait noh ia nga na ka kti jong me .

en: Therefore Saul removed him from him , and made him his captain over a thousand  ; and he went out and came in before the people .
kha: Kumta u Saul u phah noh ïa u bad u thung ïa u kum u nongïalam ïa ki shihajar ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Saul u la weng noh ia u na u , bad u la pynlong ia u u rangbah jong u palat shi hajar ; bad u la mih noh bad u la wan rung ha khmat ki briew .

en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit  ; and they cried out for fear .
kha: Haba ki la ïohi ba u ïaid halor ka um , ki la sngewshyrkhei .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la ong , bad ki la lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la iohi ia u ba u iaid ha duriaw, ki la sngewsih, ki la ong: Ka long ka mynsiem ; bad ki la pyrta namar ka jingtieng .

en: For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .
kha: Lada nga la trei ïa la ka kam da ka mon sngewbha , te nga la lah ban khmih lynti ban ïoh ïa ka bainong ; hynrei nga leh ïa ka tang kum ka kamram , namar U Blei u la aiti ha nga ïa kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga leh ia kane da ka mon sngewbha, nga don ka bainong: hynrei lada pyrshah ia ka mon jong nga, la aiti ha nga ia ka jingpynkylla ia ka gospel .

en: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us : and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip kaei ka jingieit : U Khrist u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi . Ngi ruh , namarkata , ngi dei ban ai ïa la ki jingim na ka bynta ki parabriew !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kane ngi sngewthuh ia ka jingieit U Blei , namar u la aiti ia la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi: bad ngi dei ban aiti ia la ka jingim na ka bynta ki para .

en: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh ; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit .
kha: Kito kiba im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka ong ïa ki ban leh , ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki shah pynïaid da kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka kwah . Kito kiba im kat kum ka jingong U Mynsiem ïa ki , ki shah pynïaid ha kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kito kiba long katkum ka doh ki pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba long katkum ka doh ; hynrei kito kiba long katkum U Mynsiem ki long kiei kiei kiba U Mynsiem .

en: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do : for ye judge not for man , but for the  Lord  , who is with you in the judgment .
kha: Da pyrkhat bha haba phi ai jingrai ; phim pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka bor briew , hynrei ha ka bor U  Trai  , bad u long bad phi haba phi ai ïa ka jingrai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki nongbishar: To sumar ia kaei kaba phi leh: namar phim bishar ia u briew hynrei ia U Trai uba don ryngkat bad phi ha ka jingbishar .

en: And also for the innocent blood that he shed : for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood  ; which the  Lord  would not pardon .
kha: bad khamtam namar baroh ki briew balui lui kiba u la pynïap . U  Trai  um lah shuh ban map ïa u Manasseh na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh na ka bynta ka snam bym don pop kaba u la pynmih: namar u la pyndap ia ka Jerusalem da ka snam bym don pop; kaba U Trai un ym map .

en: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south : and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits .
kha: Hangne ruh la don kawei ka khyrdop kaba ïalam sha ka khyrdop bashapoh . Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai ïa kane ka khyrdop kaba ar bad ka la long sanphew mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ka khyrdop ha ka phyllaw kaba shapoh shaphang shathie : bad u la thew naduh ka khyrdop haduh ka khyrdop shaphang shathie shispah cubit .

en: And it came to pass at that time , when Eli was laid down in his place , and his eyes began to wax dim , that he could not see  ;
kha: Ha kawei ka miet u Eli , uba la kham byr-ïe ki khmat , u thiah ha la ka kamra ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kata ka por, haba u Eli u la thiah ha ka jaka jong u, bad ki khmat jong u ki la sdang ban khih, ba um lah ban iohi ; .

en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .
kha: Haba me wan , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wanrah ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jainkup kaba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Carpus, haba me wan, to wanrah bad me, bad ki kot , hynrei khamtam eh ia ki kot lyngkdop .

en: And all the people that came together to that sight , beholding the things which were done , smote their breasts , and returned .
kha: Haba ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang hangta ban khmih ïa kata baroh , ki la ïohi kaei kaba la jia , baroh ki la ïaleit phai sha ïing , ki da tied ïa la ki shadem ha ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh kiba la iawan lang ha kata ka jingpeit , haba ki iohi ia kiei kiei kiba la leh , ki la sdang ia ki bniat jong ki bad ki la wan phai biang .

en: And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
kha: To shahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel ! Phi la dei ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong: To sngap , nga kyrpad ia phi ko khlieh jong u Jakob bad phi ki rangbah jong ka iing Israel ; Hato kam dei ia phi ban tip ia ka jingbishar ?

en: And they passed on and went their way  ; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah , which belongeth to Benjamin .
kha: Kumta ki ïaid lait ïa ka Jebus bad ki ïai bteng ha ka lynti jong ki . Ka la sep sngi haba ki wan poi ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid shakhmat bad ki la iaid lynti; bad ka sngi ka la hiar halor jong ki haba ki la don hajan u Gibeah uba dei u jong u Benjamin .

en: And they said unto him , Ask counsel , we pray thee , of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous .
kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kylli na U Blei la ngin shem bha ne em ha kane ka jingleit jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, To kylli jingmut, ngi duwai ia me, na U Blei, ba ngin tip la ka lynti jong ngi kaba ngi leit kan long kaba jop ne em .

en: And he put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will : be thou clean .  And immediately the leprosy departed from him .
kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To long khuid !  Mar kumta hi ka jingpang ka la iehnoh ïa uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kner ia la ka kti bad u la ktah ia u, u da ong: Ngan long uba khuid . Bad mar kumta hi u la leit noh na u .

en: Moreover I will make thee waste , and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee , in the sight of all that pass by .
kha: Uno uno na ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong pha uba dei ïaid lynti un rkhiebeiñ ïa pha bad un kiar na pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan pynlong ia me ban jah rngai noh bad ka jingshah lehbein hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong me , ha khmat jong baroh kiba iaid lyngba .

en: Or have ye not read in the law , how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath , and are blameless ?
kha: Lane phim pat ju pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ba man la ka sngi Sabbaton ki lyngdoh hapoh ka Templ ki pynkheiñ shisha ïa ka aiñ sngi Sabbaton , pynban kim shah pynrem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane phim shym la pule ha ka hukum , kumno ha ka sngi Sabha ki lyngdoh ha ka tempi ki pynjah burom ia ka Sabha bad ki long ki bym don pop ?

en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me sha Jerusalem bad to pynhap ia ka ktien jong me sha ki jaka bakhuid bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ka ri Israel .

en: I have given them thy word  ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
