kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong me , bad ka pyrthei ka la shun ïa ki , namar ba kim dei jong kane ka pyrthei , kumba nga ruh ngam dei na kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ai ia ki ia ka ktien jong me bad ka pyrthei ka la shun ia ki , namar kim dei na ka pyrthei , kumba ngam dei na ka pyrthei .

en: And unto this people thou shalt say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I set before you the way of life , and the way of death .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ong ha u paidbah ,  To shahshkor ! Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ai ha phi ka jingjied hapdeng ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingim bad ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha une u briew me dei ban ong , Kumta ong U Trai ; Ha khmih nga buh ha khmat jong phi ia ka lynti jong ka jingim bad ka lynti jong ka jingiap .

en: But I say , Have they not heard ? Yes verily , their sound went into all the earth , and their words unto the ends of the world .
kha: Hynrei nga kylli : Hato ka long kaba shisha ba kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Da shisha ki la ïohsngew — naba kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka jingsawa jong ka sur jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh ; ki ktien jong ki , ki la poi shaduh kiba kut ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong , Hato kim shym la iohsngew ? Hooid shisha, ka sur jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad ki ktien jong ki haduh ki kut jong ka pyrthei .

en: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much : and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much .
kha: Uno uno ïa uba lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit un long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiba kham khraw ; uno uno uba leh bymhok ha kiei kiei kiba rit un long u bymhok ha kiba kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iaineh ha kata kaba rit eh ruh u long uba iaineh ha kaba bun: bad uta uba khlem hok ha kaba rit eh ruh u long uba khlem hok ha kaba bun .

en: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?
kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la kylli ïa u Philip ,  To ïathuh ïa nga , shaphang jongno u nongïathuhlypa u kren ïa kane ? Shaphang ïa lade ne shaphang uwei pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: U nongleh kam sniew u la jubab ia u Philip bad u la ong, nga kyrpad ia me, na uba u kren ia kane ? na lade ne na uwei pat u briew ?

en: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .
kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong , ‘ Lada kim shahshkor ïa u Moses bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , yn ym lah ban pynngeit ïa ki wat lada uno uno un mihpat na ka jingïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: Lada kim iohsngew ia u Moses bad ki nongiathuhlypa , lymne kin ym shah pynsngewthuh wat la uwei u la mihpat na kiba iap .

en: He that heareth you heareth me  ; and he that despiseth you despiseth me  ; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa phi u shahshkor ïa nga ; uno uno uba kyntait ïa phi u kyntait ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga u kyntait ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iohsngew ia nga u iohsngew ia nga ; bad uta uba pynjah burom ia nga ; bad uta uba pynjah burom ia nga u pynjah burom ia uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges , of a cubit length  ; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh .
kha: U Ehud u shna da lade hi kawei ka waitlam arliang syrti kaba shi phut shiteng ka jingjrong . U teh ïa ka ha ka liang kamon jong u hapoh la ki jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Ehud u la pynlong ia u da u dagger uba don ar tylli ki tduh, uba jrong shi cuit bad u la teh ia ka hapoh ka jainkup jong u ha ka tyrpeng kadiang jong u .

en: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ , that with quietness they work , and eat their own bread .
kha: Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ngi hukum ïa kine ki briew bad maham ïa ki ban im ka jingim kaba beit bad ban kamai na ka bynta ban kyrshan ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ia kita kiba long kum kita ngi hukum bad kyntu da U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist, ba da ka jingsngap jar ki trei , bad ki bam ia la u jong u kpu .

en: And I John saw the holy city , new Jerusalem , coming down from God out of heaven , prepared as a bride adorned for her husband .
kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , kaba da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei , kaba la pynkhreh bad kaba la kloi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba la riam ban ïashem ïa u tnga jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga Ioannis nga la iohi ia ka nongbah bakhuid, ka Jerusalem kaba thymmai, kaba wan hiar na U Blei na bneng, kaba la pynkhreh kum ka nongleitkurim kaba la pynitynnad na ka bynta u tnga jong ka .

en: For he clave to the  Lord  , and departed not from following him , but kept his commandments , which the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U long uba ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad um ju leh bymkohnguh ïa u , hynrei u husiar ban bat ïa ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la leit sha U Trai , bad um shym la leit noh na kaba bud ia u , hynrei u la bat ia ki hukum jong u , kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa ka balang kaba ïaseng ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u rangbah uba nyngkong ha ka probins    jong ka Asia ban ngeit ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh khublei ia ka balang kaba don ha iing jong ki . Pynbeit ia u Epaenetus ba ieit eh jong nga uba long ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka Asia ha U Khrist .

en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
kha: Kynmaw ba une u briew , u Boas , uba phi la ïatrei lem bad ki kynthei jong u , u dei u ba-ha-ïing jong ngi . Shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un leit dung ïa u barli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta hato u Boaz jong ngi u dei u nongtrei jong ngi ? Ha khmih , u jop ia u barli haduh ka miet ha ka jaka rep .

en: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift , and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints .
kha: Da ka mon sngewbha jong ki hi , ki la kyrpad ïa ngi bad ïasaid na ka bynta ka lad ban ïadon bynta ha kaba ïarap ïa ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduwai ia ngi da ka jingsngewbha kaba khraw ba ngin pdiang ia ka jingai , bad shim ha ngi ia ka jingiasyllok jong ka jingshakri ia ki riewkhuid .

en: And in that day did the Lord  God  of hosts call to weeping , and to mourning , and to baldness , and to girding with sackcloth :
kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la khot ïa phi ha kato ka por ban ïam bad ïam pangnud , ban khi ïa ki khlieh jong phi bad ban phong ki jaiñ khain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi U Trai Blei jong ki paid u la khot ia u ban iam, bad ban iam, bad ban iam, bad ban iam bad ban iam bad ka jain lyngkhuid:

en: For without are dogs , and sorcerers , and whoremongers , and murderers , and idolaters , and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie .
kha: Hynrei shabar ka nongbah ki don ki riewkhyllah bad kito kiba leh byrtong , kiba awria bad ki nongpynïap briew , kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bad kito kiba lamler ha ki ktien bad ki kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shabar ki don ki kulai, bad ki nongleh jadu, bad ki nongleh kam sniew, bad ki nongpyniap briew, bad ki nongleh bleithaw , bad uno uno uba ieit bad uba leh thok .

en: And he asked Pharaoh s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord s house , saying , Wherefore look ye so sadly to day ?
kha: Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ikhuslai palat mynta ka sngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la kylli ia ki ophisar jong u Pharaoh kiba don ryngkat bad u ha ka ward jong u kynrad jong u, u da ong: Balei phi peit sngewsih haduh mynta ka sngi ?

en: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken : and he was there when Jerusalem was taken .
kha: Bad ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingsyiem haduh ka sngi ba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jeremaiah u la sah ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok haduh ka sngi ba la shim ia ka Jerusalem: bad u la don hangta haba la shim ia ka Jerusalem .

en: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .
kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh kata ka thain ; bad shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la wallam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiah ha ki jingthiah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mareh kylleng kata ka thain baroh kawei, bad u la sdang ban rah kylleng kylleng ia kiba pang, ha kaba ki la iohsngew ba u don .

en: Yet ye say , The way of the Lord is not equal . Hear now , O house of Israel  ; Is not my way equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
kha: Hynrei phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh kam long kaba dei .’ To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki Israel . Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki lynti jong nga kiba nga leh ïa kiei kiei kim long kiba dei ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi ong , Ka lynti U Trai kam long kaba iaryngkat . To sngap mynta ko iing Israel Hato ka lynti jong nga kam long kaba iaryngkat ? hato ki lynti jong phi kim long kiba iaryngkat ?

en: Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ïa ki briew lah ban map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh , bad ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki lah ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ia ki pop baroh yn map ia ki khun shynrang bad ki jingkren bein ia ki briew ha kaba ki kren bein:

en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :
kha: bad tei ïa ka ïing jong me halor ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyoh kum ki kali ïapom bad me shong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba buh ia ki beam jong ki kamra jong u ha ki um: uba pynlong ia ki lyoh jong u: uba iaid halor ki bniat jong ka Iyer:

en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them : for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan theh buk ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki paid Israel , bad ngan ym phai dien shuh na ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ym buhrieh shuh ia ka khmat jong nga na ki: namar nga la theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga halor ka iing Israel , ong U Trai Blei .

en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .
kha: Dei tang ma ki , ki ban rung ha ka Templ jong nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan jong nga , bad ban pynïaid ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin rung shapoh ka jaka kyntang jong nga bad kin wan hajan ka miej jong nga ban shakri ia nga bad kin sumar ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong nga .

en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales : and he received sight forthwith , and arose , and was baptized .
kha: Kumta hi kaei re kaei kaba kum ki snep dohkha ki la hap na ki khmat jong u Saul , bad u la lah ban ïohi pat . U la ïeng joit bad la pynbaptis ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi ka la hap na ki khmat jong u kumba ka la long ki jingthew: bad u la iohi mardor , bad u la ieng , bad u la shah pynbaptis .

en: And he called the name of the first , Jemima  ; and the name of the second , Kezia  ; and the name of the third , Keren–happuch .
kha: U la ai kyrteng ïa ka khun nyngkong ka Jemimah , ïa kaba ar ka Kesaïah bad ïa kaba khatduh ka Keren Happukh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng kaba nyngkong , u Jemima ; bad ka kyrteng kaba ar, u Kezia ; bad ka kyrteng kaba lai, u Krenhapuch .

en: Be not wroth very sore , O  Lord  , neither remember iniquity for ever : behold , see , we beseech thee , we are all thy people .
kha: Me la thaw ïa ngi , kumta wat bitar eh ïa ngi , lane bat ïa ki pop jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi junom . Ngi long ki briew jong me ; to isynei ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym sngewsih than, ko Trai, wat kynmaw ia ka jingbymhok junom: ha khmih, ngi kyrpad ia me, ngi long ki briew jong me baroh .

en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
kha: to ieh ïa ka jingai jong phi hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie leit shisyndon bad ïasuk bad la u para , bad nangta sa wan pat bad ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Iehnoh hangta ia ka jingai jong me ha khmat ka almari, bad leit noh nyngkong eh bad u hynmen jong me, bad nangta to wan bad ai ia ka jingai jong me.

en: Therefore say I unto you , The kingdom of God shall be taken from you , and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof .
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  ïa ka Hima U Blei yn shim noh na phi bad yn ai ha ki briew ki ban pynmih ki soh kiba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ong ha phi , Ia ka hima U Blei yn shim noh na phi , bad yn ai ha ka jaitbynriew kaba wanrah ia ki soh jong ka .

en: For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen ïa u dieng uba la khet ; u lah ban im pat bad un khie lung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka don ka jingkyrmen ia u dieng lada la ot ia u, ba un mih biang bad ba ka tnat kaba jem jong u kan ym sangeh .

en: And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?
kha: Ki la teh matlah ïa u bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Mano ba tied ïa me ? To antad !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tap ia u da ki khmat, ki la shoh ia u ha ka khmat bad ki la kylli ia u da kaba ong: Iathuhlypa, mano ba shoh ia me ?

en: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .
kha: Kata ka briew ka la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka , kumta ka la wan , ka da kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng , ka la dem khohsiew ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka la ïathuh ha u ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kata ka kynthei ka la tieng bad ka la khih, ka la tip ia kaei kaba la jia ha ka, ka la wan bad ka la dem ha khmat jong u, bad ka la iathuh ia u ia ka jingshisha baroh .

en: And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :
kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ïa kata ka shnong , pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai U Blei jong me u la aiti ia ka ha ki kti jong me, me dei ban shoh ia uwei pa uwei u shynrang jong ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam:

en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid narud ka duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ar ngut ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba u dang iaid lyngba ka duriaw Galilaia , u la iohi ia u Simon bad u Andrei u hynmen jong u ba ki bret ia ka jar sha duriaw: namar ki long ki nongtong dohkha .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Come and dine .  And none of the disciples durst ask him , Who art thou ? knowing that it was the Lord .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To wan bad to ïabam .  Ym don uwei ruh na ki synran uba la nud ban kylli ïa u ,  Me dei uei ?  namar ki la tip ba u dei U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki, To wan bad to bam . Bad ym don uwei ruh na ki synran uba nud ban kylli ia u, Me long mano ? da kaba tip ba ka long U Trai .

en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , hynrei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa nga hapdeng ki Israel ; Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga ; hynrei ngan shah pynkyntang hapdeng ki khun Israel: Nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ia phi .

en: And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him  ; and straightway he will send him hither .
kha: Bad lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei phi leh ïa kata , ong ïa u ba U Kynrad u donkam ïa u bad ban pynphai mar mar pat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ia phi , Balei phi leh ia kane ? to ong ba U Trai u donkam ia u ; bad mardor un phah ia u hangne .

en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends  ; of wreathen work shalt thou make them , and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches .
kha: bad ar tylli ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla kiba la jyrthiaw kum ki tyllai bad pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki shrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki kynjri ksiar ba khuid ha ki tduh jong ka jingtrei rong saw men pynlong ia ki, bad pynskhem ia ki kynjri rong saw sha ki jingkhang .

en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , to kren ha ki lumbah ki Israel bad ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don na ka bynta jong ki :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ko khun u briew, to iathuhlypa ha ki lum Israel bad to ong: Phi ki lum Israel: to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai:

en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .
kha: Bad ïa kane ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pyrthei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kaba kut kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane ka gospel jong ka hima yn sa ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi ha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kan sa wan ka jingkut .

en: Now there was found in it a poor wise man , and he by his wisdom delivered the city  ; yet no man remembered that same poor man .
kha: La don u briew uba duk uba sah hangta , hynrei uba sian katta katta ba u jin da lah ban pyllait im ïa ka shnongrit . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la lap ha ka ia u briew uba duk uba stad bad u da ka jingstad jong u u la pynpoi ia ka shnong hynrei ym don ba kynmaw ia uta u briew uba duk .

en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
kha: U Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Sekharaïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shallum u khun u Jabesh u la thmu pyrshah ia u, bad u la shoh ia u ha khmat ki briew, bad u la pyniap ia u, bad u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba  ; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims . And the land had rest from war .
kha: Ha shuwa kane , ïa ka Hebron la khot ka nongbah jong U Arba . ( U Arba u la long uba khraw tam napdeng ki Anakim ) . Mynta ka don ka jingsuk ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng u Hebron shuwa ka long u Kirjatharba ; uba u Arba u long u briew uba khraw napdeng ki Anaim . Bad ka ri ka la shongthait na ka thma .

en: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest , even to the mountains  ; and the rivers shall be full of thee .
kha: Ngan sa pynmih ïa ka snam jong me haduh ba kan da lyngkien halor ki lumbah bad kan pyndap ïa ki wahduid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai um ruh da ka snam jong me; ka ri ha kaba me jngi, wat haduh ki lum bad ki wah kin dap da me .

en: And as they were afraid , and bowed down their faces to the earth , they said unto them , Why seek ye the living among the dead ?
kha: Ha ka jingtieng bakhraw , kita ki kynthei ki la dem khrup ha khyndew , katba ki rangbah ki la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi ïawad hapdeng kiba ïap ïa uta uba im ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang tieng bad ki dang dem khrup sha khyndew , ki la ong ha ki: Balei phi wad ia kiba im napdeng kiba iap ?

en: And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .
kha: Uwei u briew u la pyrta na u paidbah ,  Ko Nonghikai ! Nga kyrpad ïa me , ban khmih ïa u khun jong nga — u khun marwei jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei u briew jong ka kynhun u la pyrta, u la ong, Ko Nonghikai, nga kyrpad ia me, peit ia u khun jong nga: namar u long tang u khun jong nga .

en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :
kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u ong ha ki nongpynkha khun kiba na ki kynthei Hebru , kawei kaba kyrteng ka Shiphrah bad kawei pat ka Puah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ijipt u la kren bad ki nongrah khun Hebru, na kiba ka kyrteng jong uta ka long u Shiphrah bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u Puah:

en: However , Jehovah added : It is not you whom they have rejected , but it is I whom they have rejected from being king over them .
kha: Hynrei U Jehobah u la bynrap : Ym dei ia phi ia uba ki la kyntait hynrei dei ia nga uba ki la kyntait ban long syiem halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehobah u la bynrap: Kam dei ma phi uba ki la kyntait , hynrei dei ma nga uba ki la kyntait na kaba long syiem halor jong ki .

en: Can the fig tree , my brethren , bear olive berries ? either a vine , figs ? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh .
kha: U dieng Dumbur , ko parabangeit jong nga , um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Olib ; ne u dieng sohwaiñ um lah ban sei ïa ki soh Dumbur , lymne ka umpohliew mluh kam lah ban pynmih ïa ka um kaba bang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u dieng sohjew, ko para jong nga, u lah ban sei ia ki soh olive ? lane u sohjew, u sohjew ? kumta ym lah ban ai um ia ka um mluh bad ka um kaba thiang .

en: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers : and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer , and the king s friend :
kha: U khlieh jong ki lat ka distrik : U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Nathan U nongai jingmut ïa u syiem : U Sabud , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Nathan
translated_en_to_kha: U Asariah u khun u Nathan u la long halor ki ophisar: bad u Zabud u khun u Nathan u long u ophisar ba kongsan:

en: And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : ( and all the congregation of Israel stood  ; )
kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïeng hangta , u Syiem Solomon u phai khmat sha ki bad pan ka jingkyrkhu U Blei halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phai sha ka khmat jong u , bad u la kyrkhu ia ka jingiaseng Israel baroh: (bad ka jingiaseng Israel baroh ka la ieng ; )

en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .
kha: hynrei ïa ki jaka mane ba-thala ym shym la pynjot . Ki briew kim pat shym la phai da ka dohnud baroh ban shakri ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la shah weng noh: namar haduh mynta ki briew kim pat pynkhreh ia ki dohnud jong ki sha U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: Therefore the men of Jabesh said , To morrow we will come out unto you , and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you .
kha: bad ki ong ha u Nahash ,  La shai ka sngi ngin sa aiti ïa lade ha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ngi katba phi sngewbit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki briew jong u Jabesh ki la ong: Lashai ngin mih sha phi , bad phin leh ia ngi baroh kaba sngewbha ia phi .

en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob , which gave us the well , and drank thereof himself , and his children , and his cattle ?
kha: Dei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong ngi uba la ai ïa ngi ïa kane ka pukri ; ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki jingri jong u baroh ki la dih na ka . Hato me kam ba me long kham khraw ban ïa u Jakob ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me kham khraw ban ia u kpa jong ngi u Jakob uba la ai ia ngi ia ka pung bad u la dih ia ka hi bad ki khun jong u bad ki masi jong u ?

en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .
kha: Ki briew ki leit sha shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , da kaba pyrshang ban lait phet lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingbun kaba ki la ioh bad ia kaba ki la buh , kin rah noh sha ka wah jong ki mon .

en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
kha: Lada U  Trai  u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada U Trai u sngewbha ia ngi , te un wanrah ia ngi sha kane ka ri , bad un ai ia ngi ia ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair , and of wearing of gold , or of putting on of apparel  ;
kha: Wat ai ba phin pynitynnat ïa lade na kaba shabar , kum kaba kumno ba sad ïa u shñiuh , lane kaba deng ki jingdeng baremdor , lane ki jaiñ ba phi riam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynitynnad jongno kam dei ban long kaba paw shabar jong ka jingpynbeit ia ki shniuh , bad ka jingdeng ksiar , ne ka jingdeng ia ki jain ; .

en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations , even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people .
kha: Phi tip ba jar uba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam kiba ijli yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba leh ia kine ki jingleh bymman , wat ia ki mynsiem kiba leh ia ki yn ot noh na ki briew jong ki .

en: The  Lord  shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust : from heaven shall it come down upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
kha: Ha ka jaka u slap , U  Trai  un pynkhie ka  erïong pui pui bad ka  erïong shyiap haduh ba phin da jot thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynlong ia u slap jong ka ri jong me bad ka dewmet: na bneng un hiar halor jong me, haduh ba men da shah pynjot .

en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue , let it be by two , or at the most by three , and that by course ; and let one interpret .
kha: Lada uno uno u mut ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , la kumno kumno ar ne lai ngut ki dei ban kren , uwei hadien uwei pat , bad uwei pat u dei ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u kren da ka shyntur bym tip , to ai ba kan long arngut ne kham bunsien da lai ngut bad kata da kaba shu kren; bad to ai ba uwei un pynkylla .

en: And set up false witnesses , which said , This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place , and the law :
kha: Nangta ki la wallam katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban ïathuh lamler shaphang jong u .  Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u ïai kren borabor pyrshah ïa ka templ bakyntang bad ïa ka hukum u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki sakhi lamler kiba la ong , Une u briew um sangeh ban kren ia ki ktien kiba kren bein pyrshah ia kane ka jaka bakhuid bad ka hukum:

en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood , and sprinkle it seven times before the  Lord  , even before the veil .
kha: un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha kata ka snam , bad un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka jingkah jong ka Jaka Kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un theh ia ka kti jong u ha ka snam , bad un theh ia ka hynriew sien ha khmat U Trai , wat ha khmat ka jingtap .

en: And straightway one of them ran , and took a sponge , and filled it with vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink .
kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh shisyndon , u la shim ïa u spoiñ    , u la pynngam ïa u hapoh ka waiñ ka bym bha , u buh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng , bad u la pyrshang ban pyndih ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh beit, bad u la shim ia ka spong, bad u la pyndap ia ka da ka sohjew, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka lyngkhot lyngkhai bad u la ai ia u ban dih .

en: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength , Israel burned none of them , save Hazor only  ; that did Joshua burn .
kha: Pynban , ki Israel kim shym thang ïa kano kano na ki nongbah kiba la tei halor ki lumrit , lait tang ka Hasor , kaba u Joshua u la thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nongbah kiba ieng dang sah ha ka bor jong ki, ki Israel kim shym la thang ia uwei ruh na ki, lait noh tang u Hazor uba u Joshua u la thang .

en: Even the country which the  Lord  smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :
kha: Kane ka thain ba U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki Israel ban ïohkynti — ki shnong Ataroth , Dibon , Jaser , Nimrah , Heshbon , Elealeh , Sibmah , Nebo bad Beon — ka long ka jaka kaba bha na ka bynta ki jingri , bad ngi don shibun bah ki jingri .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka ri kaba U Trai u la sdang ha khmat ka jingiaseng Israel , ka long ka ri na ka bynta ki masi , bad ki shakri jong me ki don ki masi:

en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James  ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :
kha: u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa ki , Boanerjes , kaba mut  ki Khun u Pyrthat  ) ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u khun u Sebedee bad u Ioannis u hynmen u Jakob; bad u la ai kyrteng ia ki u Boanerges , kaba mut: Ki khun shynrang jong u lyoh:

en: And Joash slept with his fathers  ; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne : and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .
kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ; bad u Jeroboan u la shong ha ka khet jong u : bad u Joash u la shah tep ha Samaria bad ki syiem Israel .

en: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees , saying unto him , Get thee out , and depart hence : for Herod will kill thee .
kha: Ha kata ka por katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la ong ha u ,  Me dei ban phet noh nangne bad leit shawei pat , namar u Herod u kwah ban pynïap ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi la wan katto katne na ki Pharisi, ki da ong ha u, To mih noh nangne: namar u Herod un pyniap ia me .

en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .
kha: U ïada ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u pynneh pynsah ia ki nongwei ; u pyllait ia ki bym don kpa bad ki riewkynthei: hynrei ka lynti jong kiba sniew u phai noh shapoh .

en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .
kha: Ka kmie jong me ka la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thung hajan ka wahduid . Namar ba la don kyrhai ka um , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap da ki sla bad u soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kmie jong me ka long kum u sohjew ha ka snam jong me: ka la long kaba seisoh bad kaba dap da ki tnat namar ki um kiba bun .

en: And David said unto the young man that told him , Whence art thou ? And he answered , I am the son of a stranger , an Amalekite .
kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u samla uba la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor ,  Me dei uba na-ei ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u nong Amalek , hynrei nga shong ha ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha uta u samla uba la iathuh ha u, Naei me long ? Bad u la jubab , Nga long u khun jong u nongwei , u nongleh kam sniew .

en: And he cried , A lion : My lord , I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime , and I am set in my ward whole nights :
kha: U nongap phira u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , nga la ïeng ap phira ha ka kam jong nga mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta , U sing: ko kynrad jong nga, nga ieng beit ha ka jaka pahara ha ka por mynstep, bad nga la set ha ka ward jong nga baroh shi miet:

en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki dap da ki briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri khlaw . Nangta te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongbah kiba shong ki shah pynjot , bad ka ri kan sa jah rngai; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Say not thou , What is the cause that the former days were better than these ? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this .
kha: Wat ju ong ,  O ! balei mo kiei kiei ki kham bha shibun ha ki sngi mynbarim ?  Kam long ka jingkylli kaba shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ong ma me , Kaei ka daw ba ki sngi kiba mynshuwa ki kham bha ban ia kine ? namar me kylli da ka jingstad shaphang kane .

en: And he said unto them ,  When I sent you without purse , and scrip , and shoes , lacked ye any thing ?  And they said , Nothing .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Haba nga la phah noh ïa phi ha kato ka por khlem ka pla pisa , ka pla , lane ki juti , hato phi ïaduna ei ei ?   Ym duna wat kawei ruh ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Haba nga la phah ia phi khlem pla bad ki juti bad ki juti , phim duna ei ei ? Ki la ong, Ym don ei ei .

en: For pass over the isles of Kittim , and see  ; and send unto Kedar , and consider diligently , and see if there be such a thing .
kha: Khie leit sha sepngi sha ka dewlynnong Sypros , bad phah ïano ïano shaphang mihngi sha ka ri Kedar . Phin ïohi ba ym pat ju don kaba kum kane kaba la jia mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ban iaid lyngba ki dulir Kittim, bad peit ia ka ; bad phah sha Kdar, bad pyrkhat da kaba minot, bad peit lada don kum kata ka jingjia .

en: Wherefore , if meat make my brother to offend , I will eat no flesh while the world standeth , lest I make my brother to offend .
kha: Te namarkata , lada ka jingbam ka pynlong ïa u parabangeit jong nga ban leh pop , ngan ym bam doh shuh , khnang ba ngan ym pynlong ïa u parabangeit jong nga ban hap ha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada ka doh ka pynsngewsih ia u hynmen jong nga , ngan ym bam doh katba ka pyrthei ka ieng , ioh nga pynsngewsih ia u hynmen jong nga .

en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .
kha: Katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki ïa-ong ,  U don ïa u Beelsebul ha u ! U dei u ksuid rangbah uba ai ïa u ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongthoh kiba wan hiar na Jerusalem ki la ong: U don u Belzebul bad da u syiem ki ksuid u beh ia ki ksuid .

en: And they said , There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin , that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel .
kha: Ki Israel kim dei ban duh noh kawei na ki khat-ar jait jong ki . Ngi dei ban shem ka lynti na ka bynta ka jait Benjamin ban ym duh jait ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Dei ban don ka pateng na ka bynta kito kiba lait na u Benjamin , ba ka jaitbynriew kan ym shah pynjot na Israel .

en: And he overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .
kha: Ki suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki jingker , bad ki pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban batskhem ïa kita ki diengkhap . Ïa kita ki diengkhap ruh la suit da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tap ia ki board da ka ksiar , bad u la shna ia ki ryntieh ksiar jong ki ban long ki jaka na ka bynta ki bar , bad u la tap ia ki bar da ka ksiar .

en: Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
kha: Nalorkata , une um dei u Dabid , uta uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Hato une u Dabid u la rwai iwei ia iwei pat ha ki jingshad, u da ong: U Saul u la pyniap ia ki hajar jong u bad u Dabid ki shi hajar jong u ?

en: Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?
kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? Hato ym don doktor hangta ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong nga ym shym la pynkhiah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym don balm ha Gilead ; em don doktor hangta ? balei te ka koit ka khiah jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga kam shym la koit ?

en: For the promise is unto you , and to your children , and to all that are afar off , even as many as the Lord our God shall call .
kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular jong U Blei la pynlong ha phi bad ha ki khun jong phi , bad ha baroh kiba sha jngai — baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u khot sha lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingkular ka long ha phi bad ha ki khun jong phi bad ha baroh kiba jngai, wat la U Trai U Blei jong ngi un khot .

en: And he said ,  I tell thee , Peter , the cock shall not crow this day , before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me .
kha: Nga ong ha me , ko Petros ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  u syiar un ym kyn-ih ha kane ka miet tad ynda me la ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Nga ong ia me, ko Petros, u syiar un ym rkhie mynta ka sngi, shuwa ba phin kyntait ia nga ba me ithuh ia nga .

en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
kha: Baroh shi miet nga kyang bad ka jingpang , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la khein haduh mynstep, ba kum u sing, kumta un pynpra ia ki shyieng jong nga baroh: naduh ka sngi haduh ka miet me pynkut noh ia nga .

en: And he answered and said unto them ,  I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ba lada ki sngap jar , ki maw hi kin sa sdang ban pyrta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Nga ong ia phi ba lada kine kin sngap jar , ki maw kin sa pyrta mardor .

en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory :
kha: Haba U Khun U Briew un wan kum u Syiem bad ki angel baroh lem bad u , un shong halor ka khet syiem jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u Khun u briew un wan ha ka burom jong u bad ki angel bakhuid baroh ryngkat bad u , te un shong ha ka khet jong ka burom jong u:

en: And he lifted up his face to the window , and said , Who is on my side ? who ? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs .
kha: U Jehu u khmied shajrong bad u pyrta ,  Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga ?  Ar ne lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem ki peit sha u na ka jingkhangïit ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia la ka khmat sha ka jingkhang, bad u la ong, Mano ba don ha ka liang jong nga ? Mano ? Bad hangta u peit sha u ar ne lai ngut ki nonglehkai .

en: Ye that love the  Lord  , hate evil : he preserveth the souls of his saints  ; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked .
kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa kito kiba isih ïa kaba sniew ; u ïada ïa ka jingim jong ki briew jong u ; u pyllait im ïa ki na ka bor jong ki bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba ieit ia U Trai , to shun ia kaba sniew: u pynneh ia ki mynsiem jong ki riewkhuid jong u; u pyllait ia ki na ka kti jong kiba sniew .

en: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! corn shall make the young men cheerful , and new wine the maids .
kha: Katno kaba bha bad kaba itynnat ka ri kan long ! Ki samla kin san kin khlaiñ da u kew bad ka waiñ jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katno ka jingbha jong u, bad katno ka jingitynnad jong u ! u kew un pynlong ia ki samla kiba sngewbha, bad ka wain thymmai ia ki kynthei .

en: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence , and have been given to the poor . And they murmured against her .
kha: Yn jin da la die ïa ka palat laispah ki sbai rupa bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk !  Bad ki la kem daw tyngeh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka lah ban long kaba la die palat ia ka lai spah pen , bad la ai ia ka ha kiba duk . Bad ki la ia sngap jar pyrshah ia ka .

en: And the waters returned from off the earth continually : and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated .
kha: U slap u la sangeh , bad ka um ka la nang hiar suki suki ha ki shispah sanphew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki la kylla na ka khyndew man ka por: bad hadien ka jingkut jong ki shispah sanphew sngi ki um ki la nang duna .

en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider  ;
kha: ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai , ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad me ngan pynpra ia u kulai bad u nongshong kulai jong u bad bad me ngan pynpra ia ka kali bad u nongshong kulai jong u;

en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :
kha: Mynta to kynmaw aïu phi la long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Na ka liang kaba kynja briew tang khyndiat na phi , phi la long kiba stad ne kiba khlaiñbor ne kiba don kyrdan kaba halor ha ka imlang sahlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi iohi ia ka jingkhot jong phi, ko para bangeit, kumno ym bun ki riewstad hadien ka doh, ym bun kiba donbor, ym bun kiba donburom:

en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .
kha: Ka la long ha kawei ka sngi kumba lai baje nohphai sngi mynba u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba u la ïohi da kaba shai kdar ïa u angel jong U Blei uba wan shapoh bad ong ha u ,  Kornelios !
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew kaba paw shai shaphang ka por hynniew baje jong ka sngi u angel U Blei uba wan rung ha u , bad u la ong ha u , u Kornelius .

en: And all the princes , and the mighty men , and all the sons likewise of king David , submitted themselves unto Solomon the king .
kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar bad ki shipai , bad wat kiwei pat ki khun shynrang baroh jong u Dabid ki kular ban kohnguh ïa u Solomon kum u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah baroh bad ki riewshlur bad ki khun shynrang baroh kumjuh ki la aiti noh ia lade ha u syiem Solomon .

en: And our hope of you is stedfast , knowing , that as ye are partakers of the sufferings , so shall ye be also of the consolation .
kha: Kumta ba ka jingkyrmen jong ngi sha phi kan ym khih lano lano ; ngi tip ba kumba phi ïoh bynta na kita ki jingshahshitom jong ngi , kumjuh ruh phi ïoh bynta lem na kata ka jingïarap kaba ngi ïohpdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ia phi ka long kaba skhem, da kaba tip, ba kumba phi long ki nongiashim bynta ha ki jingjynjar , kumta phin long ruh na ka jingpyntngen .

en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :
kha: U para ba-ieit jong ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u para shakri ha ka kam jong U Trai , un sa ai ïa phi ka khubor baroh shaphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jylla jong nga baroh kan pynbna ha phi, uba long u hynmen baieit bad u myntri bad u para bangeit ha U Trai:

en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren , and went over to Shechem : and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him .
kha: Nangta u Gaal u khun jong u Ebed u wan sha Shekhem lem bad la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Baal u khun u Ebed u la wan ryngkat bad ki hynmen jong u: bad ki briew jong u Shechem ki la buh ia ka jingshaniah ha u .

en: Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?
kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , ngan pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jong ki bad pynjah noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan ym pynjot ia ki riewstad na Edom bad ka jingsngewthuh na ka lum u Iso ?

en: Jesus said unto her ,  I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Nga long ka jingmihpat bad ka jingim . Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un im , wat la u la ïap ; un ïoh im , bad uno uno uba im , bad uba ngeit ha nga un ym ïap lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka, Nga long ka jingmihpat bad ka jingim: uta uba ngeit ha nga, wat la u la iap, hynrei un im:

en: And thou shalt have goats  milk enough for thy food , for the food of thy household , and for the maintenance for thy maidens .
kha: Kiba sah na ki blang kin ai ka dud na ka bynta jong phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad ïa ki shakri kynthei jong phi kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban don ka dud blang kaba biang na ka bynta ka jingbam jong me, na ka bynta ka jingbam jong ka iing jong me bad na ka bynta ka jingsumar ia ki shakri jong me .

en: Or unto governors , as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers , and for the praise of them that do well .
kha: bad ha ki lat , ïa kiba la thung da u ban pynshitom ïa ki nongkam bymman bad ban ïaroh ïa kita kiba leh babha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane ha ki nongsynshar , kumba la phah da u na ka bynta ka jingpynshitom ia ki nongleh bymman bad na ka bynta ka jingiaroh ia kito kiba leh bha .

en: So the king returned , and came to Jordan . And Judah came to Gilgal , to go to meet the king , to conduct the king over Jordan .
kha: Ha ka jingleit phai jong u , ki rangbah ka Judah kiba la wan sha Gilgal ban synran ïa u sha shiliang ka wah , ki la ïakynduh ïa u ha ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem u la wan phai noh sha Jordan . U Judah u la wan sha Gilgal ban leit iakynduh ia u syiem ban pyniaid ia u syiem halor ka Jordan .

en: The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :
kha: U la nang san nang san tad haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U dieng u la san bad u la khlain bad ka jingjrong jong u ka la poi sha bneng bad ka jingpeit jong u haduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew baroh:

en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .
kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ba u Saul u la pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa u , u la ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Wallam hangne ïa ka ephod .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la tip ba u Saul u la leh bakla ia u ; bad u la ong ha u Abiatar u lyngdoh , To wanrah ia ka met .

en: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there  ; for the famine was grievous in the land .
kha: Hynrei la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri Kanaan , bad ka la long kaba jur shikatdei eh kat haduh ba u Abram u la leit jngai shaphang shathie sha ka ri Ijipt ban shong ban sah hangta shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingkyrduh ha ka ri: bad u Abram u la leit sha Ijipt ban sah hangta namar ka jingkyrduh ka la long kaba jur ha ka ri .

en: And he overthrew those cities , and all the plain , and all the inhabitants of the cities , and that which grew upon the ground .
kha: bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa kata ka them baroh kawei lem bad ïa ki briew baroh hangta , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba mih ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynpra ia kita ki shnong bad ki madan baroh bad ki nongshong shnong baroh .

en: And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?
kha: U Joseph u poi ha Shekhem bad katba u dang ïaid sakma kylleng ïa ka shnong ha kaba uwei u briew u ïohi ïa u bad u kylli ,  Phi wad ïano ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u la shem ia u bad, ha khmih, u la iaid kai ha lyngkha : bad uta u briew u la kylli ia u da kaba ong: Me wad aiu ?

en: O Jerusalem , wash thine heart from wickedness , that thou mayest be saved . How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee ?
kha: A Jerusalem , to sait noh ïa ka jingsniew na ka dohnud jong pha , khnang ba pha lah ban ïohlait im . Sa katno phan dang ïai pyrkhat ïa ki jingpyrkhat bashlei da ka pop ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Jerusalem, sait ia ka dohnud jong me na ka jingsniew, ba me lah ban ioh jingpynim . Katno por ki jingpyrkhat ba lehnohei jong me kin sah hapoh jong me ?

en: Hear now this , O foolish people , and without understanding  ; which have eyes , and see not  ; which have ears , and hear not :
kha: To pynshahshkor , phi ki briew kiba bieit bad ba-mutlop , kiba don ki khmat , hynrei ki bym lah ïohi , bad kiba don ki shkor , hynrei ki bym lah ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap mynta ia kane , ko ki briew kiba bieit, bad khlem ka jingsngewthuh kaba don ki khmat, bad wat iohi ia ki khmat, bad wat iohi ia ki khmat kiba don ki shkor, bad wat iohsngew:

en: And he said , I am God , the God of thy father : fear not to go down into Egypt  ; for I will there make of thee a great nation :
kha: Nga long U Blei , U Blei jong u kpa jong me ,  u ong .  Wat sheptieng ban leit hiar sha Ijipt ; hangta ngan pynlong ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Nga long U Blei, U Blei jong u kpa jong me: wat tieng ban leit hiar sha Ijipt; namar hangta ngan pynlong ia me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw:

en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ong ,  Katno ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la iohi ba u la sngewsih shibun , u la ong , Katno kito kiba don ka spah kin rung ha ka hima U Blei !

en: And he will take your fields , and your vineyards , and your oliveyards , even the best of them , and give them to his servants .
kha: Un knieh ïa ki lyngkha , ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ki brisoh Olib jong phi kiba bha tam , bad un ai ïa ki ha ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ki lyngkha jong phi, bad ki kper sohjew jong phi, bad ki kper olive jong phi, wat ia kiba bha tam na ki, bad un ai ia ki ha ki shakri jong u .

en: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled .  Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .
kha: Hynrei kane baroh ka la lah jia khnang ban pynlong ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban jia shisha .  Nangta baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kine baroh la leh , ba ki jingthoh jong ki nongiathuhlypa kin long kiba la pyndep . Nangta ki synran baroh ki la iehnoh ia u bad ki la phet noh .

en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side , much people gathered unto him : and he was nigh unto the sea .
kha: U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw . Hangta harud ka duriaw , u paidbah babun u la ïalumlang sawdong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la iaid biang da ka lieng sha kawei pat ka liang, bun ki briew ki la ialum lang ha u: bad u la jan sha duriaw .

en: Behold , my servants shall sing for joy of heart , but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart , and shall howl for vexation of spirit .
kha: Kin rwai da kaba kmen , hynrei phi phin ïam ha ka jingpait dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki shakri jong nga kin rwai da ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud , hynrei phin iam namar ka jingsngewsih jong ka dohnud , bad phin iam namar ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem .

en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ai ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Ai ïa kine nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , ka jingainguh bam jong u bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .
kha: Naba u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh-isynei ha uno uno uba nga kwah ; ngan sngewsynei ïa uno uno uba nga kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u ong ha u Moses , Ngan isynei ia uba ngan isynei , bad ngan sngewsynei ia uba ngan sngewsynei .

en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab  ; the howling thereof unto Eglaim , and the howling thereof unto Beer–elim .
kha: Ha kylleng ki pud jong ka Moab la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang . La ïohsngew ha ki shnong jong ka Eglaim bad Beerelim .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyrta ka la leit kylleng kylleng ki pud jong ka Moab; ka jingsawa jong ka haduh Eglaim, bad ka jingsawa jong ka haduh Beerelim .

en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , ka jingainguh bam jong u bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
kha: Da kaba ong ka jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad nang tymmen kan sa jah noh shen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata u ong , Ka jutang kaba thymmai , u la pynlong ia kaba rim kaba nyngkong . Mynta kata kaba pyut bad kaba la tyrkhong ka la nang kloi ban jah noh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; It shall yet come to pass , that there shall come people , and the inhabitants of many cities :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ka por ka poi haba ki briew na ki nongbah babun kin wan sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid; Kan sa jia shuh shuh, ba kin wan ki briew bad ki nongshong shnong jong kiba bun ki nongbah:

en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying , Jeremiah , what seest thou ? And I said , I see a rod of an almond tree .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , kaei me ïohi ?  Nga jubab ,  U tnat jong u diengsoh Almond .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga, ka da ong: Jeremaiah, me iohi aiu ? Bad nga la ong , nga iohi ia u dieng almond .

en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingiw jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me wanrah ia ka jingknia kaba thiang shiteng na ka wain, na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba la shna da ka ding, na ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: And their father said unto them , What way went he ? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went , which came from Judah .
kha: Na kano ka lynti u leit phai ?  u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong ki u la ong ha ki, "Kaei ka lynti kaba u la leit noh?" Na ka liang jong u ki khun shynrang jong u ki la iohi ia ka lynti kaba u briew U Blei u la leit noh, kaba la wan na Judah .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba ïa ki ïing , ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ yn sa thied biang ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel; Ki iing bad ki lyngkha bad ki kper sohjew kin long biang ha kane ka ri .

en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,
kha: Ha uta uba da ka bor jong u kaba trei ha ngi u lah ban leh kham palat ban ïa kaba ngi pan , lane wat ïa kaba ngi pyrkhat ;
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha uta uba lah ban leh palat ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi pan ne pyrkhat kat kum ka bor kaba trei ha ngi .

en: O generation of vipers , how can ye , being evil , speak good things ? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh .
kha: Phi ki bseiñ — kumno phi lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha haba phi long kiba sniew ? Namar ka shyntur ka kren ïa kaei kaba la shlei ha ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko pateng jong ki khnai , kumno phi lah ban kren ia kiei kiei kiba bha ? namar na ka jingbun jong ka dohnud ka kren .

en: Being forty days tempted of the devil . And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended , he afterward hungered .
kha: ha kaba u la shah pynshoi ha u Soitan haduh sawphew sngi . Ha baroh kata ka por u khlem bam ei ei , ba kumta u la thngan eh haba ka la kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong sawphew sngi ka la shah pynshoi ha u ksuid . Bad ha kita ki sngi um shym la bam ei ei: bad ynda ki la kut noh , hadien kata u la thngan .

en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God , I will send them prophets and apostles , and some of them they shall slay and persecute :
kha: Na kane ka daw ka Jingstad jong U Blei ka la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ha ki ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki nonglamktien ; kin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki bad kin pynshitom beiñ ïa kiwei pat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh nga la ong ia ka jingstad U Blei , ngan phah ia ki ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki apostol , bad katto katne na ki kin pyniap bad pynshitom bein:

en: And Abimelech rose up , and all the people that were with him , by night , and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies .
kha: Kumta u Abimelekh lem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la mih mynmiet bad ki rieh shabar ka Shekhem ha ki saw kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ieng , bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, ha ka por miet , bad ki la thiah ha Shechem ha ki saw tylli ki kynhun .

en: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :
kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Jied ïa ki nongbah jakarieh kiba nga la hukum ha u Moses ban ïathuh ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia ki khun Israel da kaba ong: To buh ia phi ia ki nongbah rieh tngen, na kiba nga kren ha phi da ka kti u Moses:

en: And Nebo , and Baal–meon , ( their names being changed , ) and Sibmah : and gave other names unto the cities which they builded .
kha: Ka Nebo , ka Baal Meon ( ïa kane ka kyrteng la pynkylla , ) bad ka Sibmah . Ki la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki shnong kiba ki la tei biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Nebo, bad u Baalmeon, (ki kyrteng jong ki ki kylla, ) bad u Sibmah: bad u la ai kyrteng da kiwei pat ki nongbah kiba ki la tei .

en: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him : and he was as one dead  ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la lynñiar , u la pynring kyrthat jur ïa u khynnah , bad u la mihnoh . U khynnah u la i kum uba ïap , bad baroh ki la ïa-ong ,  U la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: U mynsiem u la pyrta, bad u la pynkhih ia u, bad u la mih na u: bad u la long kum uwei uba la iap ; u la iap haduh ba bun ki la ong: U la iap .

en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .
kha: U Araunah u la ai lut ha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la long u Aragah kum u syiem . Bad u Aragah u la ong ha u syiem , U Trai U Blei jong me u pdiang ia me .

en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus , who of God is made unto us wisdom , and righteousness , and sanctification , and redemption :
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wallam ïa phi ha U Khrist Jisu , bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa U Khrist ban long ka jingstad jong ngi . Da u , la pynïasuk ïa ngi bad U Blei ; ngi long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei bad la pyllaitluid ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na u phi long ha U Khrist Jisu, uba na U Blei la pynlong ha ngi ia ka jingstad bad ka hok bad ka jingpynkhuid bad ka jingpynim:

en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim , which is the seventh month .
kha: Baroh ki ïalumlang ha ka por ba ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha u bnai uba hynñiew , u bnai Ethanim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ialum lang ha u syiem Solomon ha ka jingkhawai ha u bnai Ethanim , kaba long ka taiew kaba hynriew .

en: For this is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta ïa uba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ong . ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar une u long ma u, na uba la thoh: Ha khmih nga phah ia u nonglam khubor jong nga ha khmat jong me, u ban pynkhreh ia ka lynti jong me ha khmat jong me .

en: Who was before a blasphemer , and a persecutor , and injurious : but I obtained mercy , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga namar ngam pat shym la don ka jingngeit bad kumta ngam shym tip ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la long ha khmat u nongleh bein, bad u nongpynshitom bein: hynrei nga la ioh ia ka jingisynei , namar nga la leh khlem jingngeit .

en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?
kha: Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ? Aïu ki kyrmen ban pyndep ? Lada ka long kaba shisha , kumba don kiba kam , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , balei ïa kito ki briew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta kin leh aiu kiba shah pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba iap , lada kiba iap kim kiew satia ? balei te ki shah pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba iap ?

en: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth : for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away  ; and there was no more sea .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka bneng bathymmai bad ïa ka pyrthei bathymmai . Ka bneng banyngkong bad ka pyrthei banyngkong ki la jah noh , bad ka duriaw kam don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia ka bneng kaba thymmai bad ka khyndew kaba thymmai: namar ka bneng kaba nyngkong bad ka khyndew kaba nyngkong ki la jah noh; bad ym don duriaw shuh .

en: And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .
kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa uba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia ka jingainguh thang ; bad ki khun shynrang ki la wanrah ha u ia ka snam kaba u la theh sawdong ha ka almari .

en: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .
kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pyllaitluid na ka pop bad phi long ki mraw jong U Blei . Ka jingmyntoi ïa phi ka long ka jingim ba la aiti lut sha u , bad ka jingmih ka long ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta la pyllait na ka pop bad kylla long ki shakri U Blei , phi don ia u soh jong phi sha ka jingkhuid bad ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath , even they shall keep the watch of the house of the  Lord  about the king .
kha: Ki ar kynhun kiba lait ban wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki dei ban ïeng ap phira ha ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar bynta na phi baroh kiba leit shabar ha ka sngi Sabha , wat kin sumar ia ka jingpahara jong ka iing U Trai shaphang u syiem .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .
kha: Ma nga U  Trai  , nga maham ïa me ban ym shukor ïa lade da kaba pyrkhat ba ki nong Babilonia kin ym wan shuh , namar kin sa wan biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai; Wat nym shim ia lade, da kaba ong: Ki Khaldes kin leit noh shisha na ngi: namar kin ym leit noh .

en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
kha: Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka sha Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Edom , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid um shym la wanrah ia ka synduk sha la iing ha ka shnong u Dabid , hynrei u la rah ia ka shawei sha ka iing u Obededom u Gadit .

en: But as God hath distributed to every man , as the Lord hath called every one , so let him walk . And so ordain I in all churches .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïai im kat kum ka jingai jong U Blei ïa phi , bad kumba phi la long mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Kane ka long ka jinghikai ïa kaba nga ai ha ki balang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba U Blei u la sam ha uwei pa uwei, kumba U Trai u la khot ia uwei pa uwei, kumta to ai ba un iaid . Bad kumta to buh ia nga ha ki balang baroh .

en: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .
kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  Nga la ïakhun ka jingïaleh kaba jwat bad la ka hynmen , hynrei nga la jop  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Naphtali .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rakhel u la ong: Da ki jingialeh kiba khraw nga la ialeh pyrshah bad ka para jong nga: bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Naphtali .

en: And ye now therefore have sorrow : but I will see you again , and your heart shall rejoice , and your joy no man taketh from you .
kha: Kumta kan long bad phi : Mynta phi ïasngewsih , hynrei ngan sa wan khmih pat ïa phi , bad ki dohnud jong phi kin dap da ka jingkmen ; ka jingkmen kaba yn ym don uba lah ban shim noh na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi mynta phi sngewsih: hynrei ngan sa iohi biang ia phi, bad ka dohnud jong phi kan sngewbha, bad ka jingkmen jong phi ym don ba shim na phi .

en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .
kha: U Syiem Solomon u shna shi kynhun ki lieng ha Esiongeber , kaba hajan Elath , harud jong ka Khmut duriaw Akaba , ha ka ri Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la shna ia ka duriaw ha Eziongeber kaba don hajan ka Eloth, ha rud duriaw Basaw, ha ka ri u Edom .

en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .
kha: Thep noh ïa la ka waitlam ha ka jaka jong ka ,  U Jisu u la ong ha u .  Baroh kiba shim ïa ka waitlam kin ïap da ka waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha u, To buh biang ia ka waitlam jong me ha ka jaka jong u: namar baroh kiba shim ia ka waitlam kin jah noh da ka waitlam .

en: Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
kha: Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah ban tip kaei kaba dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha ki riewstad kiba tip ia ki por , (namar kumta ka la long ka rukom syiem shaphang baroh kiba tip ia ka ain bad ka jingbishar:

en: And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .
kha: U Samuel u la leit sha u Saul , uba la khublei ïa u , da kaba ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel ! Nga la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la wan sha u Saul : bad u Saul u la ong ha u: To long uba la kyrkhu na U Trai: Nga la leh ia ka hukum U Trai .

en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .
kha: Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka ha kaba la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha kata ka kper la don ka jingtep kaba thymmai ha kaba ym pat shym la tep ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka jaka ba la sahnarphna ia u la don ka kper ; bad ha ka kper ka jingtep thymmai , ha kaba ym pat ju don briew .

en: Be watchful , and strengthen the things which remain , that are ready to die : for I have not found thy works perfect before God .
kha: Kumta kyndit bynriew noh , bad pynkhlaiñ ïa kaei pha kaba dang don ha shuwa ba kan jah noh khoit . Naba nga shem ba kaei kaba pha la leh kam long kaba janai ha khmat jong U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba husiar bad pynskhem ia kiei kiei kiba sah , kiba la pynkhreh ban iap: namar ngam shym la shem ia ki kam jong me kiba janai ha khmat U Blei .

en: Let not the swift flee away , nor the mighty man escape  ; they shall stumble , and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates .
kha: Kito kiba mareh stet kim shym lah ban phet ; ki shipai kim shym lah ban lait . Ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis , ki jynthut bad ki kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba u nonglehkai un phet noh, lymne u briew uba khlain bor un phet krad, bad un hap shaphang shathie da ka wah Euphrates .

en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?
kha: Nangta ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki la ujor ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi leh ïa kane ha ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ki Israel ki la wan bad ki la pyrta ha u Pharaoh da kaba ong: Balei me iadei kumta bad ki shakri jong me ?

en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .
kha: Kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynrei la shah ïa ki ban im shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia kiwei pat ki mrad , ki la shah weng noh ia ka jingsynshar jong ki: hynrei ka jingim jong ki ka la slem haduh ka aiom bad ka por .

en: But as one was felling a beam , the axe head fell into the water : and he cried , and said , Alas , master ! for it was borrowed .
kha: Katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , kynsan u khlieh sdie jong u , u hap hapoh um .  Ko kynrad , ngan leh kumno ?  u pyrta ha u Elisha .  U dei u sdie ba la pan kylliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba uwei u dang hap ha ka um: bad u la pyrta, bad u la ong, Alas, kynrad ! namar la shim ram ia ka .

en: And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .
kha: U la jubab ,  Sha Babilonia , ha kaba kin tei ka templ na ka bynta jong ka . Haba la dep shna ïa ka Templ , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga: Ban tei ia ka iing ha ka ri Shinar: bad kan sa long kaba skhem, bad kan buh hangta ha la ka jong ka nongrim .

en: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Elumas ( kata ka long ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngskor na ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Elyma u nongleh jadu (namar kumjuh ruh ka kyrteng jong u da kaba batai ) u la pyrshah ia ki, u wad ban pynphai noh ia u nongshong shnong na ka jingngeit .

en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .
kha: Kumta lada ka hima jong u Soitan ka don ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , kumno kan neh ? Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u Soitan ruh u la shah phiah pyrshah ia lade , kumno ka hima jong u kan ieng ? namar phi ong ba nga beh noh ia ki ksuid lyngba u Belzebul .

en: And she said , Behold my maid Bilhah , go in unto her  ; and she shall bear upon my knees , that I may also have children by her .
kha: Ka ong ,  Hangne ka don ka mraw jong nga ka Bilhah ; thiah bad ka , ba kumta kan ïoh khun na ka bynta jong nga . Da kane ka rukom ngan ïoh long kmie lyngba jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong: Ha khmih ka nongtrei jong nga ka Bilhah, to leit sha ka ; bad kan kha ia ki kjat jong nga, ba nga ruh ngan ioh khun na ka .

en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeroboam uba ar u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar hynriew bnai ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong u Asariah u syiem Judah u la synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria hynriew bnai .

en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews  ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong ha u Pilat ,  Wat ym thoh , ‘ U Syiem ki Jiw ,’ hynrei pynban , ‘ Une u briew u la ong , nga long u Syiem ki Jiw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw ki la ong ha u Pilat, Wat thoh ia u Syiem ki Jiw hynrei ba u la ong: Nga long u Syiem ki Jiw .

en: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .
kha: Ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la sah hynriew bnai ha Edom , bad ha kata ka por ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom lait noh u Hadad bad katto katne ngut ki nong Edom kiba long ki shakri u kpa jong u , kiba la phet ïap sha Ijipt . ( Ha kata ka por u Hadad u dang long tang u khynnah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u Hadad u la phet noh, ma u bad katto katne ki nong Edome jong u kpa jong u bad u, ban leit sha Ijipt ; Hadad dang long khynnah rit .

en: But Israel shall be saved in the  Lord  with an everlasting salvation : ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel la pynim da U  Trai  , bad ka jingjop jong u ka neh junom ; ki briew jong ka kin ym jahburom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Israel kin ioh jingpynim ha U Trai da ka jingpynim bymjukut: phin ym sngewlehrain ne sngewlehrain khlem kut .

en: Who by him do believe in God , that raised him up from the dead , and gave him glory  ; that your faith and hope might be in God .
kha: Da u , phi ngeit ha U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap bad la ai ha u ïa ka burom ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit bad ka jingkyrmen jong phi la pynskhem ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba da u u ngeit ha U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ia u na kiba iap , bad u la ai burom ia u; ba ka jingngeit bad ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan long ha U Blei .

en: And now , I pray you , consider from this day and upward , from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the  Lord  :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha phi ? Ha shuwa ba phin sdang ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, nga kyrpad ia phi, to pyrkhat naduh kane ka sngi bad shaneng, naduh shuwa ba la buh ia u maw halor u maw ha ka tempi U Trai:

en: Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .
kha: Ki la tip borabor , lada ki mon ban phla , ba naduh kaba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kaba pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharisi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba tip ia nga naduh kaba sdang , lada kin saphriang , ba hadien ka kynhun kaba kham jylliew jong ka niam jong ngi nga la im u Pharisi .

en: And his armourbearer said unto him , Do all that is in thine heart : turn thee  ; behold , I am with thee according to thy heart .
kha: U samla u jubab ,  Ïa kano kano kaba phi kwah ban leh , nga don lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongrah tiar jong u u la ong ha u: To leh ia kaba don ha ka dohnud jong me: to phai noh ia me;

en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted , because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely ?
kha: Ngam shym la buh dor ei ei ïa phi haba nga la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong U Blei ha phi ; nga la pynrit ïa lade khnang ban kyntiew ïa phi . Hato nga la leh bakla ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la leh ia ka kam runar ha kaba pynjah burom ia lade ba phin shah pynkhraw , namar nga la ialap ha phi ia ka gospel U Blei khlem jingsiew ?

en: Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,
kha: Ngi la pynlut kham bun ka por hangta , tad ynda ka la long kaba ma ban bteng ïa ka jingleit da ka lieng , naba mynta ka Sngi ka Jingsiewspah ka la dep . Kumta u Paul u la ai ïa kane ka jingai jingmut ha ki :
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la pynlut por shibun , bad haba ka jingleit kai mynta ka la long kaba ma , namar ba ka jingstet mynta ka la dep , u Paul u la pynrem ia ki , .

en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day , as the king bade , saying , Come again to me on the third day .
kha: Hadien lai sngi u Jeroboam bad ki briew baroh ki leit pat sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jeroboan bad ki briew baroh ki la wan sha Rehoboam ha ka sngi kaba lai, kumba u syiem u la ong: To wan biang sha nga ha ka sngi kaba lai .

en: How would you feel if you knew that a reunion with your loved ones was possible right here on earth under the best of conditions ?
kha: Kumno phin sngew lada phi tip ba phin sa ia kynduh biang bad kiba ieit ki jongphi- ha kane ka pyrthei , hapdeng ka jinglong jingman ba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno phin sngew lada phi tip ba ka jingiakynduh biang bad kiba ieit jong phi ka long kaba lah hangne hi ha ka pyrthei hapoh ki jinglong kiba bha tam ?

en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shong bad ka tnga jong u u s ; namar u pynpaw ia u kpa jong u . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong: Amen .

en: Rejoice , and be exceeding glad : for great is your reward in heaven : for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you .
kha: To kmen , to sngewkmen , namar ïa ka bainong bakhraw la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha ki bneng . Kane ka long da kumno la pynshitom beiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im ha shuwa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha , bad to sngewbha palat: namar ka long ka bainong jong phi ha bneng: namar kumta ki la shah pynshitom bein ia ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la don ha khmat jong phi .
