en: Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .
kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa lade hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u pyrkhat ba u long uba stad da ka jingthew jong kane ka pyrthei , u dei ban long uba bieit khnang ba un long uba stad da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ia lade . Lada uno uno u briew napdeng jong phi u i kumba u long uba stad ha kane ka pyrthei , to ai ba un long uba bieit , ba un long uba stad .

en: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :
kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki nongbishar jong phi ki dei ban leit thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kata ka jaka ha kaba la lap ïa ka metïap bad ki shnong kiba marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah bad ki nongbishar jong me kin mih sha ki nongbah kiba don sawdong jong uta uba la shah pyniap:

en: But the bullock , and his hide , his flesh , and his dung , he burnt with fire without the camp  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U shim ïa kaba sah na u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , ïa ka doh bad ïa ki snier jong u , bad u thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u masi bad ka sniehdoh jong u, ka doh bad ka sniehdoh jong u, u la thang da ka ding shabar ka jaka sah ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Hath he smitten him , as he smote those that smote him ? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him ?
kha: Ïa ka Israel ym shym pat la pynshitom jur da U  Trai  kumba la leh ïa ki nongshun jong ka , lymne kam shym la duh shibun ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u la pyniap ia u kumba u la pyniap ia u ? lane u la shah pyniap kat kum ka jingpyniap ia kito kiba la shah pyniap da u ?

en: For from Israel was it also : the workman made it  ; therefore it is not God : but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces .
kha: U nongsaiñdur na Israel uba la thaw ïa u bleithaw , bad um dei satia u blei ! Ïa u khun masi ksiar ba mane ha Samaria yn sa pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Israel ruh: u nongtrei u la leh ia ka ; namarkata kam dei U Blei: hynrei u khun masi jong ka Samaria un shah pynpra noh .

en: But Pharaoh s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her : then did he build Millo .
kha: U Solomon u la pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , hadien ba ka tnga jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka ri Ijipt , ka la wan kynriah na ka Nongbah u Dabid sha ka ïingsyiem kaba u Solomon u la tei na ka bynta jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khun jong u Pharaoh ka la mih na ka shnong u Dabid sha ka iing jong ka kaba u Solomon u la tei na ka bynta jong ka: nangta u la tei ia u Millo .

en: And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Saul ki leit ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kaba u Saul u la ong , bad u Dabid u sngewbha ïa ka jingpyrkhat ba un sa long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem . Ha ka sngi shuwa ka jingkyntiew kurim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki shakri jong u ki la iathuh ia kine ki ktien , ka la sngewbha ia u Dabid ban long u khun syiem: bad ki sngi kim shym la kut noh .

en: Who is like unto thee , O  Lord  , among the gods ? who is like thee , glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?
kha: Ko  Trai  , uei uba kat ma me hapdeng ki blei ? Uei keiñ uba kum ma me , uba phylla ha ka jinglongkhuid ? Uei uba lah ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum ma me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba long kum ma Me, ko Trai, napdeng ki blei ? uba long kum ma Me, uba donburom ha ka jingkhuid , uba tieng ha ki jingiaroh , uba leh ia ki jingphylla ?

en: And a voice came out of the throne , saying , Praise our God , all ye his servants , and ye that fear him , both small and great .
kha: Nangta , ka jingsawa jong ka sur ka la wan na ka khet , ka da ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi , phi baroh ki shakri bad ki briew jong u , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ñiewburom ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur ka la mih na ka khet kaba ong: Iaroh ia U Blei jong ngi, phi baroh ki shakri jong u, bad phi kiba sheptieng ia u, baroh arngut kiba rit bad kiba khraw .

en: And after the uproar was ceased , Paul called unto him the disciples , and embraced them , and departed for to go into Macedonia .
kha: Hadien ba ka jingkhihwin ka la jem jai , u Paul u la khot lang ïa ki parabangeit bad da ki ktien pynshlur u la khublei ïakhlad bad ki . Nangta u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Makedonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba la sangeh noh ka jingsawa, u Paul u la khot ia ki synran bad u la pdiang ia ki bad u la leit noh sha Makedonia .

en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa kito kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban shisyndon nga la leit sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phai pat sha Damaskos .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem sha ki ha khmat jong nga ; hynrei nga la leit sha Arabia bad nga la leit phai biang sha Damaskos .

en: And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
kha: Nangta ka Ruth ka ong ,  Kaba kor tam na baroh , u ong ba ngan ïai tam kew bad ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ruth ka Moab u la ong ha nga ruh , Me dei ban bat skhem da ki samla jong nga haduh ba kin da pyndep lut ia ka jingot jong nga .

en: And it came to pass , when the  Lord  would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind , that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal .
kha: Ka por ka la poi ba U  Trai  u shim noh ïa u Elijah sha bneng ha ka  erlangthari . U Elijah bad u Elisha ki la mihnoh na Gilgal ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba U Trai un rah ia u Elijah sha bneng da ka lyer kaba jur, ba u Elijah u la leit bad u Elisha na Gilgal .

en: Attending meetings at the local Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses will help you to do so .—Isaiah 11 :9  ; Hebrews 10 :24 , 25 .
kha: Ka jingleit jingïaseng ha ka Kingdom Hall Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , kan ïarap ïa phi ban leh kumta .—Isaiah 11 :9 ; Hebru 10 :24 , 25 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleit sha ki jingialang ha ka Hima jong ka ri Jehovah ].

en: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .
kha: Kata ka briew ka la long ka Jentil , ba la kha ha ka thain Phoenisia ha Syria . Ka la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban beh noh ïa u ksuid na ka khun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka long ka Grik , ka Syropenician da ka jaitbynriew ; bad ka la kyrpad ia u ba un bret noh ia u ksuid na ka khun jong ka .

en: But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .
kha: Long katba ka long ,  u Ahimaas u ong biang ,  Nga kwah ban leit .   Khie leit ,  u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh bran na ka lynti kaba na ka Them Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa uta u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la kumno kumno ruh, u la ong, to ngan mareh . Bad u la ong ha u, Run . Nangta u Ahimaas u la mareh da ka lynti jong ka madan, bad u la mareh palat ia u Cushi .

en: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up , and fell upon him , and slew him : and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness .
kha: Kumta u Benaïah u la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u la pynïap ïa u Joab , bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u kaba ha rudnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la kiew bad u la hap halor jong u: bad la tep ia u ha la ka jong ka iing ha ka ri khlaw .

en: By faith Abraham , when he was tried , offered up Isaac : and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son ,
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ai kum ka jingkñia ïa u Isaak u khun jong u , mynba U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham . U Abraham u la long uta ïa uba U Blei u la ïateh kular , la katta ruh u long la kloi ban ai ïa la u khun marwei kum ka jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Abraham haba la tynjuh ia u, u la tyrwa ia u Isaak : bad uta uba la ioh ia ki jingkular u la tyrwa ia u khun ba la kha tang marwei jong u .

en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .
kha: Bad u Absalom u la isih ïa u Amnon haduh katta katta namar ka jingbatbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u kat haduh ba um mon shuh ban kren ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la kren ia u hynmen jong u u Amnon u bym bha ne uba sniew: namar u Absalom u la shun ia u Amnon namar u la pynbor ia ka para jong u ka Tamar .

en: And they turned thitherward , and came to the house of the young man the Levite , even unto the house of Micah , and saluted him .
kha: Kumta ki leit sha ïing u Mikah , ha kaba u samla Lebi u sah , bad ki kylli ïa u Lebi kumno u long u man .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai sha ka iing jong u samla Lebi, wat sha ka iing u Mihah bad ki la ai khublei ia u .

en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat , or in drink , or in respect of an holyday , or of the new moon , or of the sabbath days :
kha: Kumta wat shah ïano ïano ban shna kyndon shaphang kaei kaba phi bam lane dih lane shaphang ki sngi bakhuid lane ki Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai lane ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un bishar ia phi ha ka doh ne ha ka jingdih ne ha ka sngi bakhuid ne ha u bnai thymmai ne ha ki sngi Sabha:

en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah u la long u syiem ka Israel baroh kawei , bad u la synshar arphew saw snem ha Tirsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Baasha u khun u Ahiah ban synshar halor ki Israel baroh ha Tirsah, arphew saw snem .

en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the  Lord  our God for ever and ever .
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ka mane bad kohnguh ha ïa la u jong u blei , hynrei ngi ngin mane bad kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew baroh kin iaid ha ka kyrteng jong u blei jong u , bad ngin iaid ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ngi junom .

en: And Jeroboam s wife arose , and departed , and came to Tirzah : and when she came to the threshold of the door , the child died  ;
kha: Ka tnga u Jeroboam ka leit phai noh sha Tirsah . Hamar ba ka rung ha la ïing , u khynnah u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnga jong u Jeroboan ka la ieng bad ka la leit noh sha Tirsah: bad haba ka la poi ha ka jingkhang jong ka jingkhang, uta u khynnah u la iap ; .

en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .
kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki kherub u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Blei , uba im junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki saw tylli ki mrad u la ai ha ki hynriew tylli ki angel ksiar kiba dap da ka jingbitar U Blei uba im junom .

en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth , I did stamp them as the mire of the street , and did spread them abroad .
kha: Nga pynlwet ïa ki , bad ki kylla long kum u pui pui , nga ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa ka ktieh ha ki lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la shoh ia ki kum ka dewbilat jong ka khyndew , nga la pynkhih ia ki kum ka dewbilat jong ka lynti , bad nga la pynphriang ia ki shabar ri .

en: And she said , Behold , thy sister in law is gone back unto her people , and unto her gods : return thou after thy sister in law .
kha: Kumta ka Naomi ka ong ha ka ,  Ruth , ka para kynsi jong pha ka la leit phai sha la ki briew bad sha la u blei . Khie leit phai sha ïing bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong: Ha khmih, ka para jong me ka la leit phai biang sha ki briew jong ka bad sha ki blei jong ka: to wan phai noh hadien ka para jong me .

en: The  Lord s  voice crieth unto the city , and the man of wisdom shall see thy name : hear ye the rod , and who hath appointed it .
kha: Ka long ka jingstad ban sheptieng ïa U  Trai . U pyrta ïa ka nongbah ,  To shahshkor phi ki briew kiba ïalum ha ka nongbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong U Trai ka pyrta sha ka nongbah, bad u briew uba stad un iohi ia ka kyrteng jong me: to iohsngew ia u diengduh bad uba la buh ia ka .

en: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart , but feignedly , saith the  Lord .
kha: Bad hadien kane baroh , ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , ka la shu leh mynleh ban wan phai sha nga , kam shym da mut shisha . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh na ka bynta kine baroh ka para jong ka kaba thok kam shym la phai sha nga da ka dohnud baroh kawei jong ka, hynrei da kaba leh kumta , ong U Trai .

en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds  ;
kha: Hynrei ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh u la kren ha ngi lyngba U Khun jong u . U la long uta da uba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uta ïa uba U Blei u la jied ban long u nongïoh kynti ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hath ha kine ki sngi ba khatduh u la kren ha ngi da u Khun jong u, ia uba u la thung ia u nongioh pateng ia kiei kiei baroh, da uba ruh u la thaw ia ki pyrthei ; .

en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .
kha: Phin long kum u briew ba la thoh ha ka proberb , uba pyrshang ban thiah ha ka jingthiah kaba lyngkot palat bym lah ban jyrtieng , bad ka nep kaba rit palat ka bym lah ban tap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingthiah ka kham lyngkot ban ia kaba u briew u lah ban pynjrong ia lade ha ka : bad ka jingtap ka kham rit ban ia kaba u lah ban tap ia lade ha ka .

en: But Deborah Rebekah s nurse died , and she was buried beneath Beth–el under an oak : and the name of it was called Allon–bachuth .
kha: Ka Deborah , ka nongsumar ïa ka Rebekka , ka la ïap noh bad la tep ïa ka ha trai u dieng Sning shaphang shathie jong ka Bethel . Kumta la khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U Dieng Sning jong ka jingïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Deborah ka la iap noh, bad la tep ia ka hapoh ka Bethel hapoh u dieng oak: bad ka kyrteng jong ka la khot u Allon Bachchuth .

en: And thou saidst , I will surely do thee good , and make thy seed as the sand of the sea , which cannot be numbered for multitude .
kha: Kynmaw ba me la kular ban pynbiang ba kiei kiei kin ïaid beit bad nga bad ban ai ha nga kham bun ki khun ki ksiew , kiba bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ong , Ngan leh bha ia me bad ngan pynlong ia u symbai jong me kum ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw kaba ym lah ban khein na ka bynta ka jingbun briew .

en: And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
kha: A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , balei kane ka la jia ? Balei ba ka jait Benjamin kan sa jah noh na Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , balei kane ka wan jia ha Israel , ba ka dei ban don ha ka sngi kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba duna ha Israel ?

en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech  ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha u ïa u briew uba kyllut bad u bymnang kren , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban buh ïa ki kti jong U halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wanrah ha u ia uba sngap jar, bad ki don ka jingduna ha ka jingkren jong u ; bad ki kyrpad ia u ban buh ia la ka kti halor jong u .

en: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee : and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la wan phai sha Galilaïa , bad ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid ka la long bad u . Ka khubor shaphang jong u ka la par kylleng kata ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la wan phai ha ka bor U Mynsiem sha Galilaia : bad ka la mih ka nam jong u kylleng kylleng .

en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?
kha: Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki Pharisi , ki la kylli te ïa u Ïoannis ,  Lada mem dei u Messaïah lane u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynbaptis ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u bad ki la ong ha u, Balei me pynbaptis ia me te lada me long uta u Khrist ne u Elias ne uta u nongiathuhlypa ?

en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there was none like it , nor shall be like it any more .
kha: Kan don ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , ka bym pat ju don mynno mynno kaba kum kata lane ka ban ym don shuh lano lano .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don ka jingpyrta kaba khraw ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei, kumba ym don kum kata, lymne kan ym long kum kata shuh .

en: And he brought back all the goods , and also brought again his brother Lot , and his goods , and the women also , and the people .
kha: U wan ïalam pat ruh ïa u Lot , u pyrsa jong u lem bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u , ryngkat ruh bad ïa ki kynthei bad ïa kiwei pat ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah biang ia ki mar baroh, bad u la wanrah biang ia u hynmen jong u u Lot bad ki mar ki mata jong u bad ki kynthei ruh bad ki briew .

en: And I will bless them that bless thee , and curse him that curseth thee : and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba kyrkhu ïa me , Hynrei ngan tim ïa kito kiba tim ïa me . Bad da me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kyrkhu ia kita kiba kyrkhu ia me, bad ngan tim ia uta uba tim ia me: bad ha me baroh ki longiing jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited : and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness .
kha: Uta u  langsohmoh un kit lut noh ïa ki pop baroh sha ka ri kaba ym pat ju don ba sah briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u blang un kit ia ki jingbymhok jong ki baroh sha ka ri kaba ym shong: bad un pyllait noh ia u blang ha ka ri khlaw .

en: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :
kha: Ka dei ïa kane ba U Blei u la khot ïa phi , naba U Khrist hi u la shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi bad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nuksa , khnang ba phin bud ha ki dien jat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat hangne ruh la khot ia phi: namar U Khrist ruh u la shah shitom na ka bynta jong ngi, u la iehnoh ia ngi ka nuksa, ba phi dei ban bud ia ki dienjat jong u:

en: And Solomon loved the  Lord  , walking in the statutes of David his father : only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places .
kha: U Solomon u ieit ïa U  Trai  bad u bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , hynrei u la pynïap ruh ïa ki mrad bad u la ai ïa ki kum ki jingkñia ha ki duwan kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ieit ia U Trai, u iaid ha ki ain u Dabid u kpa jong u: tang u la knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :
kha: Namar kane ka daw , haba U Khrist u la dei ban wan sha kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei :  Mem kwah ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh , hynrei me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba u wan sha ka pyrthei , u ong , Ka jingknia bad ka jingainguh me ym shym la leh kumta, hynrei ka met me la pynkhreh ia nga:

en: And the glory of the  Lord  shall be revealed , and all flesh shall see it together : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: Te ïa ka burom jong U  Trai  yn sa pynpaw , bad baroh ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka . U  Trai  da lade u la kular ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka burom U Trai kan paw , bad ka doh baroh kan iohi ia ka: namar ka shyntur U Trai ka la kren ia ka .

en: And the people said unto Samuel , Who is he that said , Shall Saul reign over us ? bring the men , that we may put them to death .
kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki ong ha u Samuel ,  Shano kito kiba ong ba u Saul um dei ban long u syiem jong ngi ? Aiti ïa ki ha ngi , ba ngin pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ong ha u Samuel , Uei uta uba ong: Hato u Saul un synshar halor jong ngi ? wanrah ia ki briew , ba ngin pyniap ia ki .

en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us .
kha: Nga sngew ba kaei kaba ngi shahshitom ha kane ka por kaba mynta , ym lah ban ïanujor satia bad ka burom ïa kaba yn sa pynpaw ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga khein ba ki jingjynjar jong kane ka por kim long kiba bit ban ianujor bad ka burom kaba yn sa pynpaw ha ngi .

en: And did all drink the same spiritual drink : for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them : and that Rock was Christ .
kha: Baroh ki la bam ïa ujuh u kpu ba kynja mynsiem bad ki la dih ïa kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem . Ki la dih na uta u mawsiang ba kynja mynsiem ba la leit lem bad ki ; bad uta u mawsiang u la long U Khrist hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki la dih ia kajuh ka jingdih ba kynja mynsiem: namar ki la dih ia uta u Rock ba kynja mynsiem uba la bud ia ki: bad uta u Rock u long U Khrist .

en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mih na ka synagog bad ki la leit beit sha ka ïing u Simon bad u Andriw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh na ka synagog bad ki la rung shapoh ka iing u Simon bad u Andrei ryngkat bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis .

en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel : but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit , and for cruel bondage .
kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ïa kane ha ki Israel , hynrei kim shym sngap ïa u , namar ka mynsiem jong ki ka la pait la pra na kata ka jinglongmraw basohsat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren kumta ha ki khun Israel: hynrei kim shym la sngap ia u Moses namar ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem bad na ka bynta ka jinglong mraw kaba shyrkhei .

en: And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
kha: Nga long ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Badonbor Baroh bad ba u wan ha ki lyoh jong ka bneng !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong: bad phin sa iohi ia u Khun u briew uba shong ha ka liang kadiang jong ka bor bad uba wan ha ki lyoh bneng .

en: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the  Lord  our God , and also with him that is not here with us this day :
kha: U pynlong ïa ka bad ngi baroh kiba ïeng hangne ha khmat jong u mynta ka sngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi ki ban dang kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad uta uba ieng hangne bad ngi mynta ka sngi ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong ngi:

en: And it came to pass in those days , that she was sick , and died : whom when they had washed , they laid her in an upper chamber .
kha: Ha kata ka por ka la pang bad ka la ïap . Ïa ka met jong ka la pynsum bad la pynthiah ïa ka ha ka kamra kaba haneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kita ki sngi, ba ka la pang, bad ka la iap: ia kiba ki la sait jain, ki la buh ia ka ha ka kamra kaba shalor .

en: Yea , they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him , and his army shall overflow : and many shall fall down slain .
kha: Ki nongai jingmut bajan eh jong u kin pynjot ïa u . Ïa kiba bun ki shipai jong u yn pynïap , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u yn pyndam noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , kito kiba bam ia ka bynta jong ka doh jong u kin pynjot ia u , bad ka kynhun shipai jong u kan tuid: bad bun kin hap noh .

en: And there was set meat before him to eat : but he said , I will not eat , until I have told mine errand . And he said , Speak on .
kha: Haba la wanrah jingbam , uta u briew u ong ,  Ngan ym pat bam tad ynda nga la dep ïathuh ïa kaei ba nga don ban ong .  U Laban u ong ,  To ïathuh keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la buh doh ha khmat jong u ban bam: hynrei u la ong, Ngan ym bam, haduh ba ngan da iathuh ia ka jingeh jong nga . Bad u la ong , Kren .

en: Why sayest thou , O Jacob , and speakest , O Israel , My way is hid from the  Lord  , and my judgment is passed over from my God ?
kha: Ko Israel , balei te ba me mudui ba U  Trai  um tip ïa ki jingjynjar jong me lane ïa ki jingkhuslai lada me shahshitom bymdei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me ong ko Jakob bad me kren ko Israel , Ka lynti jong nga ka la buhrieh na U Trai bad ka jingbishar jong nga ka la iaid noh na U Blei jong nga ?

en: Verily I say unto you , I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine , until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God .
kha: Nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh na kane ka waiñ tad haduh kata ka sngi ba nga dih na ka waiñ bathymmai ha ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh ia u soh u sohjew haduh kata ka sngi ba ngan dih thymmai ia u ha ka hima U Blei .

en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .
kha: Kawei na ki ka ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , bad nga la kha khun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka ruh ka don lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata kawei ka kynthei ka la ong: Ko kynrad jong nga, nga bad kane ka kynthei ngi shong ha kawei ka iing bad nga la kha khun bad ka ha iing .

en: And the scribe said unto him , Well , Master , thou hast said the truth : for there is one God  ; and there is none other but he :
kha: Uta u nonghikai ka Hukum u la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Kaba dei , ko Nonghikai ! Ka long kaba shisha , kumba me la ong , ba tang U Trai u long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat u blei hynrei tang ma u .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongthoh u la ong ha u, Hooid, ko Nonghikai, me la ong ia ka jingshisha: namar don uwei u Blei ; bad ym don uwei pat hynrei tang ma u:

en: That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .
kha: Te kumta , kumba ka pop ka synshar da ka jingïap , kumta ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingim bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kumba ka pop ka la synshar haduh ka jingiap, wat la ka jingaiei ruh ka lah ban synshar lyngba ka hok haduh ka jingim bymjukut da U Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: Know ye not , brethren , (for I speak to them that know the law ) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
kha: Da shisha phin sa sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba ngan sa ong , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar phi baroh phi tip ïa ka hukum . Ka hukum ka synshar halor ki briew tang haba ki dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ko para bangeit (na nga kren ha ki kiba tip ia ka hukum ) kumno ba ka hukum ka don ka jingsynshar halor u briew katba u dang im ?

en: Now , my son , the  Lord  be with thee  ; and prosper thou , and build the house of the  Lord  thy God , as he hath said of thee .
kha: U Dabid u bteng ,  Mynta , ko khun jong nga , ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me , bad ai ba un bat ïa ka kular jong u ban pynlah ïa me ban pyndep ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ko khun jong nga, U Trai un long bad me; bad to roi bad tei ia ka iing U Trai U Blei jong me kumba u la ong shaphang jong me .

en: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them .
kha: Napdeng kito kiba ki paid Israel ki la pynïap , u dei u Balaam , u nongkren byrtong , u khun jong u Beor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam ruh u khun jong u Beor , u nonglehkai , u la pyniap ia ki khun Israel da ka waitlam hapdeng jong ki kiba la shah pyniap da ki .

en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks , of the firstfruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of ingathering at the year s end .
kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phi sdang ban ot ïa u soh nyngkong na u kew jong phi ; rakhe ruh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka synrai haba phi lum ïa la ki soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban peit ia ka jingkhawai jong ki taiew , na ki soh ba nyngkong jong u kew bad ka jingkhawai ban lum ha kaba kut jong u snem .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :
kha: Ki nongshun ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynhyndai ki long ki jong ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Namar u nongshun u la ong pyrshah ia phi , Ah , wat ki jaka ba jrong hyndai ruh ki long ki jong ngi:

en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .
kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Gad bad ki khun Reuben ki la jubab da kaba ong: Kumba U Trai u la ong ha ki shakri jong me , kumta ngin leh .

en: For the  Lord  will not forsake his people for his great name s sake : because it hath pleased the  Lord  to make you his people .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ka jingkular kaba kyntang bad un ym iehnoh ïa phi namar u la rai ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kyrteng kaba khraw jong u: namar ka la pynsngewbha ia U Trai ban pynlong ia phi ki briew jong u .

en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,
kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Bun ki briew ki la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh ka jingïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hapdeng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh kumba bun ki la shim kti ban buh ha khmat khnang ban pynbna ia kita kiei kiei kiba kham thikna hapdeng jong ngi , .

en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother  ; usury of money , usury of victuals , usury of any thing that is lent upon usury :
kha: Wat shim sut na la u para Israel haba phi ai ram , lane phi ai jingbam , lane phi ai shah ïa kaei kaei ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ram ia ka sut ha u hynmen jong me;

en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and the sons of David were chief about the king .
kha: u Benaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada u khmih halor ka kynhun ap phira jong u Dabid ; ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki bat ïa ki kyrdan ba-halor ha ka jingshakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada u la long halor ki Kheriet bad ki Pelletis ; bad ki khun shynrang u Dabid ki long ki rangbah .

en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la jia ruh ha ka snem kaba shiphew snem, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats .
kha: U Saul u ïalam lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel bad u la leit wad ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ha ka phang mihngi jong ki Mawsiang ki Blang Khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la shim lai hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied na Israel baroh , bad u la leit wad ia u Dabid bad ki briew jong u halor ki maw khlaw .

en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,
kha: Da ka bor bakhraw jong u , U  Trai  u la maham ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lynti ba ki briew ki la bud . U ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la kren kumta ha nga da ka kti kaba khlain , bad u la hikai ia nga ba ngam dei ban iaid ha ka lynti jong une u briew da kaba ong:

en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee : thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt thou be any more .
kha: Me la jah , jah junom , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba la ithuh ïa me ki la sngewma , sngewtieng ba kin ïadon bynta ha ka kupar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba tip ia me hapdeng ki briew kin sngew lyngngoh ia me: me long ka jingtieng , bad wat ju long shuh .

en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .
kha: Ki khlur ki la hap ha pyrthei , kum ki soh Dumbur bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka lyer kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khlur bneng ki la hap ha ka khyndew , kumba u dieng sohjew u bret ia ki sohjew bym pat por jong ka , haba ka la khih da ka Iyer kaba khlain .

en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
kha: U briew u la lah ban pynjuh bad u la pynjuh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki jait jingthaw — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki mrad bapar bad ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki mrad baroh bad ki sim bad ki bsein bad kiei kiei ha duriaw la pynkylla dur ia ki briew:

en: But if all prophesy , and there come in one that believeth not , or one unlearned , he is convinced of all , he is judged of all :
kha: Hynrei lada uwei pa uwei u pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei haba u bymngeit ne u riewpaidbah u rung hapoh , un ïoh jingkynduh ïa la ki pop da kaei kaba u ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada baroh ki iathuhlypa, bad u wan ha uwei u bym ngeit, ne uwei u bym nang, u sngewskhem ia baroh, la bishar ia u na baroh:

en: What manner of saying is this that he said ,  Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
kha: U ong ba ngin wad ïa u hynrei ngin ym shem ïa u , bad ba ngim lah ban leit sha kaba un don . U mut aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka rukom ong ia kane ba u la ong: Phin wad ia nga bad phin ym shem ia nga: bad hangno nga don , phim lah ban wan ?

en: And Balaam said unto the ass , Because thou hast mocked me : I would there were a sword in mine hand , for now would I kill thee .
kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Namar ba pha la pynlong u bieit ïa nga ! Ba ngan da don waitlam , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u kada: Namar me la leh bein ia nga: nga la don ka waitlam ha ka kti jong nga, namar mynta ngan pyniap ia me .

en: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre , and found it even so as the women had said : but him they saw not .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ka kynhun jong ngi ki la leit sha ka jingtep bad ki la shem thik kumba ki kynthei ki la ïathuh , hynrei kim shym la ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na kita kiba don ryngkat bad ngi ki la leit sha ka jingtep , bad ki la shem ia ka kumba ki kynthei ki la ong: hynrei ia u kim shym la iohi .

en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
kha: Nga la aiti ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohpdiang , kaba long kaba donkam tam : Ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la aiti nyngkong eh ha phi ia kata kaba nga ruh nga la ioh, kumno ba U Khrist u la iap na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi kat kum ki jingthoh;

en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .
kha: Ka kyrteng jong me kan ym long shuh u Abram , hynrei u Abraham , naba nga pynlong ïa me u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong me kan ym khot shuh u Abram, hynrei ka kyrteng jong me kan long u Abraham ; namar u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew nga la pynlong ia me .

en: And in that day it shall come to pass , that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka sngi ka wan ha kaba ka jingkhraw jong ka Israel kan poi sha kaba kut , bad ïa ka spah jong ka yn bujli da ka jingduk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi kan sa jia ba ka burom jong u Jakob kan sa tyrkhong bad ka jingkhluit jong ka doh jong u kan sa tyrkhong .

en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness  ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
kha: Hynrei ha u lum Seïon kin don ki ban lait im , bad kan long ka jaka bakyntang . Ki briew jong u Jakob kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri kaba dei hok ka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha u lum Seion kan long ka jingpyllait im, bad kan don ka jingkhuid ; bad ka iing u Jakob kan don ia ki jingdon jingem jong ki .

en: But what saith it ? The word is nigh thee , even in thy mouth , and in thy heart : that is , the word of faith , which we preach ;
kha: Kaei kaba ka ong ka long kane :  Ka khubor U Blei ka don hajan jong phi , ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi bad ha ka dohnud jong phi  — kata , ka khubor jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ong ia ka ? Ka ktien ka long hajan jong me, wat ha ka shyntur jong me bad ha ka dohnud jong me: kata ka long ka ktien jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ialap ; .

en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
kha: Haba ki Syria na Damaskos ki la phah ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Dabid u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki Syria ki la wan iarap ia u Hadadezer u syiem Soba , u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki Syria arphew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: Nor of men sought we glory , neither of you , nor yet of others , when we might have been burdensome , as the apostles of Christ .
kha: Ngim shym pyrshang ban ïoh jingïaroh nano nano , la ka long na phi lane na kiwei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki briew kim shym la wad ia ngi, ym na phi, ne na kiwei pat, haba ngi la lah ban long kiba khia, kum ki apostol U Khrist .

en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?
kha: Bad U Blei u la ong , ‘ Namar kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga , bad ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Na kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ia la u kpa bad ka kmie bad un iasoh bad ka tnga jong u: bad ki arngut kin long kawei ka doh ?

en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba sdang ka jingsynshar u Jehoiakim u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah u la wan ia kane ka ktien ha u Jeremaiah na U Trai .

en: I will overturn , overturn , overturn , it : and it shall be no more , until he come whose right it is  ; and I will give it him .
kha: Ka jingjot , ka jingjot ! Ho-oid , ngan pynlong ïa ka nongbah ka jot . Hynrei kane kan ym jia tad haduh ba uta uba nga la jied ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah u la wan . Nangta ngan sa ai ïa ka ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kylla, ngan kylla, ngan kylla, ia ka: bad kan ym long shuh, haduh ba un da wan uba ka dei ka ; bad ngan ai ia ka ha u .

en: For precept must be upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little :
kha: U pyrshang ban hikai ha ngi ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit ka dei ban long halor ka jingpynbeit, ka jingpynbeit halor ka lain ba la buh lypa, ka lain ha ka lain ; hangne khyndiat, bad hangta khyndiat:

en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .
kha: U  Trai  un aiti ha phi ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad un pynkulmar ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjot lut thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai U Blei jong me un aiti ia ki ha me bad un pynjot ia ki da ka jingpynjot kaba khraw haduh ba kin da shah pynjot .

en: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the  Lord  will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .
kha: Ki dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad ban long kiba la khreh la shi sngi . Ha kata ka sngi ngan wan hiar ha u Lum Sinai ; ha kaba ki briew baroh kin ïohi ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to long kiba la pynkhreh ha ka sngi kaba lai: namar ha ka sngi kaba lai U Trai un wan hiar ha khmat ki briew baroh ha u lum Sinai .

en: A portion of the reading could be assigned to each family member , and then all can discuss what was learned from the Scriptures .
kha: Baroh ki dkhot jong ka ïing ki lah ban pule lang mar khyndiat , nangta baroh ki lah ban ïasam ïa kaei kaba ki sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka bynta jong ka jingpule lah ban aiti ha uwei pa uwei u dkhot jong ka longiing , bad nangta baroh ki lah ban iakren ia kaei kaba la nang na ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

en: They compassed me about like bees  ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
kha: Ki la ïaboi sawdong jong nga kum ki ngap , hynrei ki la ing duh kloi kum ka ding hapdeng ki shiah ; da ka bor ka jong U  Trai  nga la pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ker sawdong ia nga kum ki khnai ; ki la shah pynlip kum ka ding jong ki thliew: namar ha ka kyrteng U Trai ngan pynjot ia ki .

en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
kha: Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im ba nga la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U Blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingthaw ba im kaba nga la iohi hapoh U Blei jong ki Israel da ka wah Chebar bad nga tip ba ki long ki cherubim .

en: And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai ,  Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut jong kaei kaba u la ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u briew hapdeng ki rud Ulai, kaba la pyrta, bad u la ong, Gabriel, pynlong ia une u briew ban sngewthuh ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
kha: To wat ieit ïa ka pyrthei , lymne ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lada phi ieit ïa ka pyrthei , kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ieit ia ka pyrthei , lymne ia kiei kiei kiba don ha ka pyrthei . Lada uno uno u ieit ia ka pyrthei , ka jingieit U Kpa kam don ha u .

en: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother , and said , There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day .
kha: U paid Israel u la sngewsih na ka bynta la ki para na ka jait Benjamin bad ki ong ,  Ha kane ka sngi ki Israel ki la duh noh ïa kawei na ki jait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la kylla bamut na ka bynta u Benjamin u hynmen jong ki, bad ki la ong: Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la ot noh na Israel ha kane ka sngi .

en: Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .
kha: Ym don kano kano kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki blei , wat la kim dei kiba shisha . Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa nga , U Blei uba la wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , da ki blei ki bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jaitbynriew ka la kylla ia ki blei jong ki , kiba ym pat long ki blei ? hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la kylla ia ka burom jong ki na ka bynta kata kaba ym ioh jingmyntoi .

en: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare  ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .
kha: bad siat ïa nga da ki khnam na baroh sawdong — ki khnam kiba sam lyngba ki pynmynsaw ïa nga : bad wat la katta ruh um pyn-i jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnam jong u ki ker sawdong ia nga sawdong, u pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong nga, bad um pyllait ; u theh ia ka gall jong nga ha ka khyndew .

en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot  ; they did eat , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they builded  ;
kha: Kan long kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Lot . Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , da kaba ïathied bad ïadie , da kaba thung bad tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh kumba ka la long ha ki sngi u Lot ; ki la bam, ki la dih, ki la thied, ki la die, ki la thung, ki la tei ; .

en: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth–gilead  ; and the Syrians wounded Joram .
kha: U Syiem Ahasaïah u ïasnohkti lang bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ban ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth kaba ha Gilead , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bad u Joram u khun u Ahab sha ka thma pyrshah ia u Hazael syiem Syria ha Ramothgile ; bad ki Syria ki la pynmynsaw ia u Joram .

en: Then Darius the king made a decree , and search was made in the house of the rolls , where the treasures were laid up in Babylon .
kha: Kumta u patsha Darius u la pynmih ïa ki hukum ban wad ha ki jingthoh syiem ba la buh ha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Darius u la leh ia ka hukum , bad la wad ha ka iing jong ki roll , ha kaba la buh ia ki spah ha Babilon .

en: But unto the Son he saith , Thy throne , O God , is for ever and ever : a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom .
kha: Hynrei ïa U Khun , U Blei u la ong :  Ka hima jong me , A Blei , kan neh junom la junom ! Me synshar halor la ki briew da ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha U Khun u ong, Ka khet jong me, ko Blei, ka long junom: ka spah jong ka hok ka long ka spah jong ka hima jong me .

en: Heaven is my throne , and earth is my footstool : what house will ye build me ? saith the Lord : or what is the place of my rest ?
kha: ‘ Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga , ong U Trai , bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Ka ïing kaba kumno te phin tei ïa nga ? Hangno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga, bad ka khyndew ka long ka jaka shong kjat jong nga: kaei ka iing kaba phin tei ia nga ? ong U Trai: ne kaei ka jaka shongthait jong nga ?

en: Father , glorify thy name .  Then came there a voice from heaven , saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again .
kha: Ko Pa , to pyndonburom ïa la ka kyrteng !  Te ka sur ka la kren na bneng ,  Nga la wallam ka burom ïa ka , bad ngan leh biang kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kpa, to pyndonburom ia ka kyrteng jong me . Nangta la wan ka sur na bneng, ka ong , nga la pyndonburom ia ka baroh arngut bad ngan pyndonburom biang ia ka .

en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
kha: Ki briew kin shong kin sah ha Judah bad ha baroh ki shnong jong ka , bad kin don ki nongrep , bad ki nongap langbrot ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha Judah hi, bad ha ki shnong jong ka baroh ryngkat, ki nongrep bad kito kiba leit shabar bad ki kynhun .

en: Millions of families earth wide have found the guidance provided in the book The Secret of Family Happiness to be a real benefit .
kha: Ha satlak ka pyrthei da ki million , ki briew ki la shem da shisha ka jinghun na ka kot kaba ha ka ktien Phareng ka ba kyrteng u shabi jong ka longïng longsem ka ba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki million ki longiing ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki la shem ia ka jingpyniaid ba la ai ha ka kot Ka Jingkmen jong ka Longïing ban long ka jingmyntoi kaba shisha .

en: And it came to pass the selfsame day , that the  Lord  did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kajuh ka sngi , ba U Trai u la wanrah ia ki khun Israel na ka ri Ijipt da ki shipai jong ki .

en: Lens in Google Photos app will also roll out for iOS users soon , says the company , but there is no clear timeline for the same .
kha: Ka Lens ha ka Google Photos app kan sa pynmih ruh shen na ka bynta ki nongpyndonkam iOS , ong ka kompeni , hynrei ym pat don ka por kaba shai na ka bynta kane kajuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki len ha ka Google Photos app ruh kin sa mih noh na ka bynta ki nongpyndonkam iOS shen , ong ka kompeni , hynrei ym don por kaba shai na ka bynta kajuh .

en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations , and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished :
kha: Bad kumta U Trai u tip kumno ban pyllait im ïa ki briew kiba riewblei na ki jingtynjuh jong ki bad kumno ban pynhap ïa ki bymman ha ka jingpynshitom ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , khamtam ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki jingkwah brai jakhlia jong ka met bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka bor synshar jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u tip kumno ban pyllait ia kiba riewblei na ki jingpynshoi , bad ban buh ia ki bym hok haduh ka sngi bishar ban shah pynshitom:

en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter : so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men .
kha: U Abijah bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki thom ïa ki Israel da ka jingjop kaba khraw — shiteng na ki shipai bakynsai ka Israel ki la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abijah bad ki briew jong u ki la pyniap ia ki da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw: kumta la pyniap ia ki Israel san spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied .

en: And immediately the king sent an executioner , and commanded his head to be brought : and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,
kha: Kumta shisyndon u la phah ïa u nongap phira ryngkat bad ki hukum ban wallam ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis . U nongap phira u la mihnoh , u leit sha ka byndi , bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u syiem u la phah ia u nongpyniap briew bad u la hukum ia ka khlieh jong u ban wanrah: bad u la leit khlieh ia u ha phatok .

en: Strangers have devoured his strength , and he knoweth it not : yea , gray hairs are here and there upon him , yet he knoweth not .
kha: Ki shaniah ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki bad kim sngewthuh ba kane ka jingshaniah ha ki nongwei ka la bam duh noh ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Ki sngi jong ki , ki la jan kut , hynrei kim shym la tip ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongwei ki la bam ia ka bor jong u, bad um tip ia ka: Hooid, ki shniuh kiba rong saw ki don hangne hangtai halor jong u, hynrei um tip .

en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the  Lord  , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .
kha: Te ki briew ka Ijipt baroh kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki Israel ki la shaniah ha phi ko ki nong Ijipt ban ïarap ïa ki , hynrei phim long kham bha ban ïa u dieng uba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongshong shnong baroh jong ka ri Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U Trai , namar ki la long u diengduh ia ka iing Israel .

en: Thou therefore which teachest another , teachest thou not thyself ? thou that preachest a man should not steal , dost thou steal ?
kha: Phi hikai ïa kiwei pat — balei phim hikai ïa lade ? Phi ïalap ,  Wat tuh  — hynrei phi hi phi tuh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me namarkata uba hikai ia uwei pat, me hikai ia lade ? me uba ialap ia u briew um dei ban tuh , me tuh ?

en: And the king of Israel said , Take Micaiah , and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ,  Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat jong kane ka nongbah , bad sha u Joash u khun syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong: Shim ia u Micaiah bad rah biang ia u sha u Lat ka shnong bad ha u Joash u khun syiem;

en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .
kha: Ki rangbah sorkar ki long kum ki suri kiba patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba ki la pynïap . Ki pynïap briew ba kin ïoh riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka hapdeng jong ka ki long kum ki blang kiba pynkhih ia ka mrad , ban pynmih snam , bad ban pynjot ia ki mynsiem , ban ioh ia ka jingmyntoi kaba khlem akor .

en: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .
kha: Na u patsha Artakserksis ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Artaxerxes u syiem ki syiem, ha u Esra u lyngdoh, u nongthoh ia ka ain U Blei jong ka bneng, ka jingsuk kaba janai, bad ha kum kata ka por .

en: And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .
kha: Haba nga la wan sha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha barieh jong U Blei , ngam shym la pyndonkam da ki kyntien kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ko para bangeit, haba nga la wan sha phi, ngam shym la wan da ka jingstad ne ka jingstad kaba bha, da kaba pynbna ha phi ia ka jingphla U Blei .

en: And one told Jacob , and said , Behold , thy son Joseph cometh unto thee : and Israel strengthened himself , and sat upon the bed .
kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Jakob ba u Joseph u khun jong u , u wan jngoh ïa u , u pyneh katba lah ban shong ha la jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la iathuh ha u Jakob bad u la ong: Ha khmih u khun jong me u Joseph u wan sha me : bad u Israel u la pynskhem ia lade bad u la shong ha ka jingthiah .

en: For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me ? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .
kha: Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leit phai sha i pa lada u para um don ryngkat bad nga ? Ngan ym lah shah ban ïohi kum ïa kata ka apot ba kan wan jia ha i pa .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumno ngan leit shaneng sha u kpa jong nga bad u khynnah um don bad nga ? Lada nga iohi ia ka jingsniew kaban sa wan ha u kpa jong nga .

en: Nebuchadnezzar the king , unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah ïa ka khubor harum sha ki briew jong baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei :  Khublei !
translated_en_to_kha: U Nebuhronezar u syiem, ha ki briew baroh, ki jaitbynriew bad ki ktien baroh, kiba shong ha ka khyndew baroh kawei; Ka jingsuk kan nang bun ha phi .

en: Holding forth the word of life ; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ , that I have not run in vain , neither laboured in vain .
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ngan don ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa phi ha ka Sngi jong U Khrist , namar kan pyn-i ba baroh ka jingpyrshang bad ka jingtrei jong nga kam shym la long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba bat ia ka ktien jong ka jingim ; ba ngan sngewbha ha ka sngi U Khrist , ba ngam shym la mareh lehnohei , lymne ngam shym la trei shitom lehnohei .

en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings , and the wheels beside them  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
kha: Ki jingthaw ba-im ki la sdang ban her bad ki shalyntem ki la leit lem bad ki . Ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel ka don halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki cherub ki la pynkiew ia ki bniat jong ki, bad ki tyrpeng hajan jong ki bad ka burom U Blei Israel ka la don halor jong ki shaneng .

en: And the sons of Cush  ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabtah , and Raamah , and Sabtecha : and the sons of Raamah  ; Sheba , and Dedan .
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kush ki long ki briew jong ka Seba , ka Habilah , ka Sabtah , ka Raamah , bad ka Sabteka . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Raamah ki long ki briew jong ka Sheba , bad ka Dedan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Cush ; Seba, bad u Habil, bad u Sabha, bad u Raamah, bad u Sabta: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Raamah ; Sheba, bad u Dedan .

en: Let the heathen be wakened , and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat : for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki dei ban long kiba la kloi bad wan sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan shong ban bishar ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki nongwei kin kyndit , bad kin wan shaneng sha ka them Jehoshaphat: namar hangta ngan shong ban bishar ia ki nongwei baroh sawdong .

en: Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob s  ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and , behold , also he is behind us .
kha: Me dei ban jubab , ‘ Ki dei ki jong u Jakob u shakri jong phi . U phah ïa ki kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u kynrad jong u , u Iso . U Jakob hi u hadien jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me dei ban ong , Ki long u shakri jong me u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u u Jakob u Jakob u Jakob u u Jakob u u u Jakob u u u Jakob u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u u

en: And the son said unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and in thy sight , and am no more worthy to be called thy son .
kha: ‘ Ko pa ,’ u khun jong u , u la ong , ‘ nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phi . Ngam long shuh uba dei ba yn khot u khun jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u la ong ha u: Ko Kpa, nga la leh pop pyrshah ia ka bneng bad ha khmat jong me bad ngam long shuh uba bit ban shah khot khun jong me .

en: And the sons of Benjamin were Bela , and Becher , and Ashbel , Gera , and Naaman , Ehi , and Rosh , Muppim , and Huppim , and Ard .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin ki long u Bela , u Bekher , u Ashbel , u Gera , u Naaman , u Ehi , u Rosh , u Muppim , u Huppim , bad u Ard .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin ki long u Bela, bad u Becher, bad u Ashbel, u Gera, bad u Naaman, u Ehi, bad u Rosh, u Muppim, bad u Huppim, bad u Ard .

en: Let us be glad and rejoice , and give honour to him : for the marriage of the Lamb is come , and his wife hath made herself ready .
kha: To ngin ïarisa bad shadkmen ; to ngin ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ! Naba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingshongkurim jong U Khunlangbrot , bad ka nongleitkurim jong u ka la pynkhreh ïa lade na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin ia sngewbha bad ia kmen ia u: namar ka jingshongkurim jong u Khunlangbrot ka la wan , bad ka tnga jong u ka la pynkhreh ia lade .

en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever : and thou ,  Lord  , art become their God .
kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong me hi junom , bad me , A  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la pynskhem ha lade ia ki briew jong me ki Israel ban long ki briew ha me junom: bad me, ko Trai, me long U Blei jong ki .

en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .
kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka wallam ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Kaei kaba nga ong , namarkata , ka long kaei kaba U Kpa u la ïathuh ïa nga ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka long ka jingim bymjukut: kaei kaei kaba nga kren namarkata, kumba U Kpa u la ong ha nga, kumta nga kren .

en: And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .
kha: U syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u Sekharaïah , bad ha ka hukum jong u syiem , ki paidbah ki la lynthem maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phyllaw ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thmu pyrshah ia u bad ki la ther maw ia u da ka hukum jong u syiem ha ka phyllaw jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .
kha: Ngi ïohpdiang na u ïa kano kano kaba ngi pan , namar ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u bad ngi leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba ngi pan na u , ngi pdiang na u , namar ngi sumar ia ki hukum jong u bad ngi leh ia kita kiei kiei kiba sngewtynnad ha khmat jong u .

en: Slay all her bullocks  ; let them go down to the slaughter : woe unto them ! for their day is come , the time of their visitation .
kha: Pynïap ïa ki shipai jong ki baroh ! Mait ïa ki ! Ki briew ka Babilonia ki la kordit ! Ka por ka la poi ïa ki ban shah pynshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: Sla ia ki masi jong ka baroh; to ai ba kin leit hiar sha ka jingpyniap: sngewsih ia ki ! namar ka sngi jong ki ka la poi, ka por jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This is Jerusalem : I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Khmih ïa ka Jerusalem . Nga buh ïa ka hapdeng ka pyrthei , bad kiwei pat ki ri sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Kane ka long ka Jerusalem: Nga la buh ia ka hapdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka .

en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God , an altar of stones : thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them .
kha: Tei ïa ka duwan hangta da ki maw ïa kiba ym pat pyndei shniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta men tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai U Blei jong me: wat rah ia kano kano ka tiar nar halor jong ki .

en: For they be thy people , and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt , from the midst of the furnace of iron :
kha: Naba ki dei ki briew jong me , kiba me la wan ïalam na Ijipt , napdeng ka lawar ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ki briew jong me, bad ka pateng jong me, kaba me wanrah na Ijipt, na pdeng ka ding nar:

en: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing : a sojourner of the priest , or an hired servant , shall not eat of the holy thing .
kha: Dei tang uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang ; uwei pat um lah ban bam ïa ki , la u long u nongwei uba shong basah bad u lyngdoh lane u nongtrei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don u nongwei uba bam ia ka jingbam bakhuid: u nongwan jngohkai jong u lyngdoh ne u shakri ba la thung kam , un ym bam ia ka jingbam bakhuid .

en: When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .
kha: Haba uta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u rangbah ai hukum bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ? Utai u briew u dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u rangbah u la iohsngew ia kata , u la leit bad u la iathuh ha u rangbah shipai: To sumar ia kaei kaba me leh: namar une u briew u dei u Roman .

en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now , I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .
kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa ,  Nga shong hangne ha ka ïing ba la tei da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei pat la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u syiem u la ong ha u Natha u nongiathuhlypa, Peit mynta, nga shong ha ka iing u sohjew, hynrei ka synduk U Blei ka shong hapoh ki jingkhang .

en: But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .
kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata .  Ngam tip . . . ngam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab , bad u la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kyntait, u da ong, Ngam tip, lymne ngam sngewthuh ia kaei kaba me ong . Bad u la leit shabar sha ka phyllaw ; bad ka kynhun syiar .

en: And certain women , which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities , Mary called Magdalene , out of whom went seven devils ,
kha: bad kumta ruh katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïohkhiah na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingpang : Ka Mari ( kaba la khot , ka nong Magdala ) , na ka ba la beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki ksuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne ki kynthei kiba la koit na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingduna ha ka met , ka Maria ka la khot ka Magdalene , na ki la leit hynriew tylli ki ksuid .

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Say unto thy brethren , This do ye  ; lade your beasts , and go , get you unto the land of Canaan  ;
kha: U la ong ha u Joseph ,  Ong ïa ki hynmen jong phi ban pyndap da ki jingkit ïa ki mrad jong ki bad ban leit phai sha ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph, To ong ha ki hynmen jong me, Kane ka long kaba phi leh;

en: I have forsaken mine house , I have left mine heritage  ; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la iehnoh ïa ka Israel ; nga la kyntait noh ïa ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong nga . Nga la ai ïa ki briew ba nga ieit ha ka bor jong ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iehnoh ia ka iing jong nga, nga la iehnoh ia ka pateng jong nga ; nga la aiti ia ka mynsiem baieit eh jong nga ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ka .

en: But they obeyed not , neither inclined their ear , but made their neck stiff , that they might not hear , nor receive instruction .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane pynleit jingmut ei ei . Pynban ki la kylla long kiba mutlop ; kin ym kohnguh ïa nga lane ïoh jinghikai na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh, lymne kim shym la pynkhih ia ka shkor jong ki, hynrei ki la pynlong ia ka ryndang jong ki kaba jem, khnang ba kin ym iohsngew ne ioh jinghikai .

en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .
kha: Ki bymman ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki bitar ; u peit bitar ha ka jingisih bad ki jah noh ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U bymman un iohi ia ka, bad un sngewsih shuh shuh: ka jingkwah jong kiba sniew kan jah noh .

en: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .
kha: Haba phi duwai , wat pyndonkam bun ki kyntien bym kit jingmut , kumba ki nongmane blei thala ki leh , kiba pyrkhat ba ki blei jong ki kin ïohsngew ïa ki namar ba ki jingduwai jong ki , ki long kiba jlan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai, wat pyndonkam ia ki jingpynkylla thylli kumba ki nongwei ki leh: namar ki pyrkhat ba kin shah sngap namar ka jingkren kaba bun jong ki .

en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uno uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iaid na ka jingiap sha ka jingim , namar ngi ieit ia ki para . Uta u bym ieit ia la u hynmen u sah ha ka jingiap .

en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth , and said unto me , Lift up now thine eyes , and see what is this that goeth forth .
kha: U angel u la mihpaw biang bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Ïa kaei re kaei kawei pat kaba wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel uba la kren bad nga u la leit sha khmat bad u la ong ha nga, To rah mynta ia ki khmat jong me bad peit kaei kaba leit sha khmat .

en: Now therefore the wheat , and the barley , the oil , and the wine , which my lord hath spoken of , let him send unto his servants :
kha: Kumta mynta to phah sha ngi ïa u kew , u barli , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba phi la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u kew bad u barli, ka umphniang bad ka wain kaba u kynrad jong nga u la kren shaphang jong u: to un phah sha ki shakri jong u:

en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba ïa me bad ka pisa jong me yn bret sha ka dujok , naba me pyrkhat ba me lah ban thied ïa ka jingai jong U Blei da ka pisa !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u: Ka pisa jong me ka jah noh bad me, namar me la pyrkhat ba ka jingai jong U Blei ka lah ban thied da ka pisa .

en: I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .
kha: Ngan leit lang bad me sha Ijipt , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . U Joseph ruh un don ryngkat bad me ynda me ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit hiar bad me sha Ijipt bad ngan sa wanrah biang ia me: bad u Joseph un buh ia la ka kti halor ki khmat jong me .

en: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .
kha: To leh ïa kane , ba ki briew kiba shida kin ym shah pynïap ei , bad kumta phin ym kit pop ba dei ma phi kiba la pynïap ïa ki ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka snam bym don pop kan ym tuid ha ka ri jong me, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me kum ka pateng, bad kumta ka snam kan long halor jong me .

en: Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gad , u nongïathuhlypa jong u Dabid ,  Khie leit bad ong ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .  Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Dabid u la khie thiah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad ong ha u Dabid , Kumta u Trai u ong ia me lai tylli kiei kiei; jied ia me uwei na ki, ba ngan leh ia kata ha me .

en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people , and the veil that is spread over all nations .
kha: Hangne un sa weng kynsan ïa u lyoh jong ka jingsngewsih uba ju tap halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynjot ha une u lum ia ka khmat jong ka jingtap kaba la bret halor ki briew baroh , bad ka jingtap kaba la saphriang halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: And the king was sorry : nevertheless for the oath s sake , and them which sat with him at meat , he commanded it to be given her .
kha: U syiem u la sngewsih , hynrei namar ka jingkular kaba u la lah pynlong ha khmat baroh ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , u la ai ki hukum ba ïa ka jingkwah jong ka yn ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem u la sngewsih: wat la katta ruh na ka bynta ka jingsmai , bad kito kiba shong bad u ha ka doh , u la hukum ban ai ia ka .

en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .
kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka song kum ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , khnang ba yn pdiang ïa phi . Uta u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynkhih ia ka sniehdoh ha khmat U Trai, ban shah pdiang na ka bynta jong phi: ha ka sngi kaba bud ia ka Sabha u lyngdoh un pynkhih ia ka .

en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel , twelve years : six years reigned he in Tirzah .
kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba laiphew wei jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar khat-ar snem . Ha ki hynriew snem kiba nyngkong u la synshar ha Tirsah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew bad kaba nyngkong jong u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Omri ban synshar halor ki Israel, shiphew snem: hynriew snem u la synshar ha Tirsah .

en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars  hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .
kha: U Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jong ka dorbar jong ka nongbah bad u la ong ,  Nga ïohi ba ha ki liang baroh ma phi ki nong Athens phi long kiba kit niam bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ieng hapdeng u lum Mars, bad u la ong, Phi ki briew jong ka Athen , nga sngewthuh ba ha kiei kiei baroh phi long kiba ngeit biej palat .

en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house :
kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki ïing kiba bit bthuh . ( Kine kin treikam hadien ba ki Israel ki la rung sha ri Kanaan , ha kaba U  Trai  un ai ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti . ) Lada uno uno u shem ba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingpang bthuh ha ka ïing jong u , te u dei ban leit ïathuh ha u lyngdoh shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba don ka iing un wan bad un iathuh ha u lyngdoh, u da ong: Ka long kumba nga don ka khlam ha iing:

en: I request you to get his viscera examined outside Madhya Pradesh , preferably at AIIMS in Delhi , for free and fair investigation .
kha: Nga kyrpad ia phi ba phin phah eksamin ia ka met jong u shabar jong ka Madhya Pradesh , kaba bha eh ha AIIMS ha Delhi , na ka bynta ka jingtohkit kaba laitluid bad kaba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia phi ban ioh ia ki jingleit jngoh jong u shabar ka Madhya Pradesh, kham bha ha AIIMS ha Delhi , na ka bynta ka jingtohkit kaba laitluid bad kaba hok .

en: For verily , when we were with you , we told you before that we should suffer tribulation ; even as it came to pass , and ye know .
kha: Naba mynba ngi dang ïadon lem bad phi , ngi la ïathuh shuwa ba ngin sa shah pynshitom beiñ ; bad kumba phi tip kham bha , dei kata hi keiñ ka long kaei kaba la jia thik .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha, haba ngi la don bad phi, ngi la iathuh ia phi shuwa ba ngi dei ban shah shitom ; kumba ka la jia , bad phi tip .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye be come into the land of your habitations , which I give unto you ,
kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ba kin bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki , Ynda phi la poi ha ka ri jong ki jaka shong jaka sah jong phi kaba nga ai ha phi .

en: And all their wealth , and all their little ones , and their wives took they captive , and spoiled even all that was in the house .
kha: Ki shim lut ïa kiba ishongdor , ki la kurup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah baroh , bad ki rah lut kat kaba don hapoh ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki spah jong ki baroh bad ki khun rit jong ki baroh bad ki tnga jong ki ki la shim ia ki mraw bad ki la pynsniew wat ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha iing .

en: Having a diversified writing staff allows us to address multicultural subjects that give our publications an international appeal .
kha: Ka jingdon jong ki nongthoh bapher bapher ka ïarap ïa ngi ban ïoh jingtip ïa ki phang bapher bapher kiba khring ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ki nongtrei kiba pher bapher ka ailad ia ngi ban pynbeit ia ki sobjek kiba bun jait kiba ai ia ki kot jong ngi ka jingkyrpad ha ka pyrthei .

en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .
kha: Ki puit ki la mih na kata ka tdem sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kaba ki  ñianglartham ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la mih na ka tdem ha ka khyndew: bad la ai bor ia ki , kumba ki khnai jong ka khyndew ki don ka bor .

en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .
kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long kiba janai , bad bahok ; U Blei jong phi u long uba ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba beit .
translated_en_to_kha: U long u Rock , ka kam jong u ka long kaba janai: namar ki lynti jong u baroh ki long ka jingbishar: U Blei jong ka jingshisha bad khlem ka jingbymhok , uba hok bad uba hok u long .

en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u ha ka shnong u kpa jong u: bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Sodom bad Gomorrah ban ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kan kham shah ia ka ri u Sodom bad u Gomorraha ha ka sngi bishar ban ia kata ka shnong .

en: And there followed him a certain young man , having a linen cloth cast about his naked body  ; and the young men laid hold on him :
kha: Uwei u samla , uba kup tang da ka jaiñ linen , u bud ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la bud ia u uwei u samla uba don ka jain lin kaba la bret shaphang ka met lyngkhuid jong u bad ki samla ki la bat ia u:

en: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life ; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier .
kha: U shipai ha ka jingtrei minot u kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa la u rangbah shipai bad kumta um ïakhleh bad ki kam ha ka jingim kaba ïadei lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew uba pynkhih ia lade bad ki kam jong kane ka jingim; ba un pynsngewbha ia uta uba la jied ia u ban long u shipai .

en: And he said , I may not return with thee , nor go in with thee : neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place :
kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u jubab ,  Ngam lah ban leit sha ïing bad phi lane pdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong phi .
