translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ngam lah ban wan phai bad me, lymne ban leit rung bad me: lymne ngan ym bam kpu ne dih um bad me ha kane ka jaka:

en: And David said to Abishai , Destroy him not : for who can stretch forth his hand against the  Lord s  anointed , and be guiltless ?
kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ,  Phim dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u . U  Trai  un pynshitom shisha ïa uta uba pynmynsaw ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abisai, Wat pynduh ia u: namar mano ba lah ban pynkhih ia la ka kti pyrshah ia U Trai ba la pynsleh bad ban long uba khlem pop ?

en: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus unto good works , which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them .
kha: U Blei u la pynlong ïa ngi kumba ngi long , bad ha U Khrist Jisu u la pynlong ïa ngi ban im na ka bynta ki kam babha , ïa kiba u la pynkhreh lypa ba ngin leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ki kam jong u, kiba la thaw ha U Khrist Jisu ha ki kam kiba bha, kiba U Blei u la buh lypa ba ngin iaid ha ki .

en: Therefore I will wail and howl , I will go stripped and naked : I will make a wailing like the dragons , and mourning as the owls .
kha: Nangta u Mikah u la ong ,  Namar kane ngan ïambriew bad ïam sngewsih . Ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewsih jong nga , ngan ïaid da ka kjat suda bad khlem jaiñkup . Ngan jlew kum u myrsiang , bad ngan ud kum ka ostrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan iaid bad nga iaid lyngkhuid: Ngan pynlong ia ka jingsawa kum ki bsein , bad ngan iam kum ki blang .

en: Whom we preach , warning every man , and teaching every man in all wisdom ; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus :
kha: Kumta ngi ïalap ïa U Khrist ha uwei pa uwei . Da ka jingstad baroh katba lah ngi maham bad hikai ïa ki khnang ban pynïeng ïa uwei pa uwei ha khmat U Blei kum u briew uba la san pura ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba ngi ialap , da kaba hikai ia uwei pa uwei bad hikai ia uwei pa uwei ha ka jingstad baroh ; ba ngin pyni ia uwei pa uwei uba janai ha U Khrist Jisu:

en: Raging waves of the sea , foaming out their own shame  ; wandering stars , to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever .
kha: Ki long kum ki jingat phyllung ba khih phaloh jong ka duriaw , da ki jingleh bakhlemrain jong ki , ki pynpaw kum ki sboh sabon . Ki long kum ki khlur ba ïaid sakma , ïa kiba U Blei u la buh lypa ïa ka jaka kaba dum tliw tliw junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um kiba rben jong ka duriaw, ki pynmih ia la ki jong ki khlur kiba iaid kai, ha kiba la buh kyrpang ia ka jingdum jong ka jingdum junom .

en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah Rabbah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia u Rabbah u kulai, bad ki Ammon ki jaka shong kulai: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age , being ( as was supposed ) the son of Joseph , which was the son of Heli ,
kha: Haba u Jisu u la sdang ïa la ka kam , u la dap kumba laiphew snem ka rta . U la long u khun , kumta ki briew ki la pyrkhat , jong u Joseph , uba long u khun jong u Heli ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu hi u la sdang ban don kumba laiphew snem ka rta, u long (kumba la shim) u khun u Joseph uba long u khun u Heli .

en: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat .
kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iap na u Baasha ha ka shnong un bam ia ki kulai ; bad uta uba iap na u ha ki lyngkha un bam ia ki sim jong ka Iyer .

en: And Enoch also , the seventh from Adam , prophesied of these , saying , Behold , the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints ,
kha: Dei u Enokh , uba hynriew na kiba hiarpateng beit na u Adam , uba la ïathuhlypa la slem bah ïa kane shaphang jong ki :  U Trai un wan lem bad ki hajar ki angel bakhuid jong u
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Enokh ruh, uba hynriew na u Adam, u la iathuhlypa ia kine, u da ong: Ha khmih U Trai u wan ryngkat bad shi hajar ngut ki riewkhuid jong u .

en: And now the  Lord  shew kindness and truth unto you : and I also will requite you this kindness , because ye have done this thing .
kha: Bad mynta pat , to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh skhem bad phi . Nga ruh ngan lehbha ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta U Trai un pyni ia ka jingbha bad ka jingshisha ha phi: bad nga ruh ngan siew kylliang ia phi ia kane ka jingbhabriew , namar phi la leh ia kane ka kam .

en: Behold , a people shall come from the north , and a great nation , and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth .
kha: Ki briew ki wan na ka ri bashatei , ka jaitbynriew bakhrawbor na jngai bah ; shibun ki syiem ki pynkhreh ïa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka jaitbynriew kan wan na shaphang shathie , bad ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw , bad bun ki syiem kin sa mih na ki pud jong ka khyndew .

en: And Rachel said , God hath judged me , and hath also heard my voice , and hath given me a son : therefore called she his name Dan .
kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  U Blei u la bishar hok ïa nga . U la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad u la ai khun shynrang ha nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rakhel u la ong: U Blei u la bishar ia nga, bad u la iohsngew ruh ia ka sur jong nga, bad u la ai khun shynrang ia nga: namarkata ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Dan .

en: Don’t you agree that any family will benefit if the husband treats his wife with concern , as he himself would want to be treated ?
kha: Phim ia mynjur mo ka ing ka sem kan bha lada u tnga u sumar ia ka tnga da ka jingsngewlem kumba u kwah ba ki wei ruh kin leh kumta ia u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim mynjur ba kano kano ka longiing kan ioh jingmyntoi lada u tnga u leh ia ka tnga jong u da ka jingsngewkhia , kumba ma u hi un kwah ban shah sumar ?

en: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you ? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom .
kha: Hato don uno uno napdeng jong phi uba stad bad shemphang ? U dei ban pynshisha ïa ka da ka jingim babha , da ki kam babha jong u kiba u la leh ha ka jingsngewrit bad jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba stad bad ba la pynkhih da ka jingtip hapdeng jong phi ? to ai ba un pyni na ka jingiakren kaba bha ia ki kam jong u da ka jinglong jemnud jong ka jingstad .

en: Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatic , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .
kha: bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , to isynei ïa u khun jong nga ! U long uba pang ring bad u la don ka jingkhie ring kaba shyrkhei eh ba bunsien u hap ha ka ding lane ha ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai , to isynei ia u khun jong nga: namar u long uba sngewsih, bad uba pang: namar bunsien u hap ha ka ding , bad bunsien ha ka um .

en: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .
kha: Kumta nga la sdang ban mihnoh na Jerusalem bad ban leit sha ka thain Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynta jong nga na ka nongkynti ka longïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la mih noh na Jerusalem ban leit sha ka ri u Benjamin , ban pyniakhlad ia lade nangta hapdeng ki briew .

en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .
kha: Ki phong da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snieh ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rah u long uba tyrkhong bad uba bthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki juti barim bad ki la tyrkhong ha ki kjat jong ki, bad ki jain kiba rim ha ki ; bad u kpu baroh jong ka jingpynbiang jong ki u la tyrkhong bad u la tyrkhong .

en: And God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water  ; and she went , and filled the bottle with water , and gave the lad drink .
kha: Te U Blei u pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ka , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka pukri um . Ka la leit ban pyndap um ïa kata ka pla snieh bad ka la ai um ïa uta khynnah ba un dih .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la plie ia ki khmat jong ka, bad ka la iohi ia ka pung um ; bad ka la leit , bad ka la pyndap ia ka bilor da ka um , bad ka la ai um ia u khynnah .

en: Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , me la jubab ïa la ki briew ; me la pyn-i ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la jubab ia ki, ko Trai jong ngi: me la long u Blei uba map ia ki, wat la me la shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang na ki jingpynmih jong ki .

en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , prince of the country , saw her , he took her , and lay with her , and defiled her .
kha: Haba u Shekhem u khun jong u Hamor u jait Hib , uba long u khlieh jong kata ka thain , u la ïohi ïa ka , u la shim ïa ka , bad u la batbor ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shehem u khun u Hamor u Hivite u la iohi ia ka , u la shim ia ka bad u la thiah bad ka bad u la pynjakhlia ia ka .

en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .
kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kata ka long kumno ba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng un leh ïa uwei pa uwei na phi lymda phi ïamap ïa la u hynmen u para naduh ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumjuh ruh U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng un leh ia phi, lada na ki dohnud jong phi phim map ia uwei pa uwei u hynmen jong u .

en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u la tip ba u patsha u la leit sha Lakhish bad u dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Libnah ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban ïasyllok bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Rabsakeh u la wan phai , bad u la shem ia u syiem Assyria uba ialeh pyrshah ia ka Libnah : namar u la iohsngew ba u la leit noh na Lachish .

en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
kha: Kim shym la im sngi ban pyrkhat ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba ki la iehnoh ; lada ki leh kumta , kin jin da la ïoh ka kabu ban leit phai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shisha, lada ki la pyrkhat ia kata ka ri na kaba ki la mih , ki lah ban ioh lad ban wan phai biang .

en: And Mephibosheth had a young son , whose name was Micha . And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth .
kha: U Mephibosheth u don uwei u khun samla uba kyrteng u Mika . Baroh ki dkhot ka longïing jong u Siba ki kylla long ki shakri jong u Mephibosheth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mephibosheth u don u khun shynrang uba dang rit uba kyrteng u Mihakhas . Bad baroh kiba shong ha ka iing u Siba ki long ki shakri ia u Mephibosheth .

en: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath ? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created , in the land of thy nativity .
kha: ‘ Buh ïa ka waitlam ! Ngan bishar ïa me ha ka jaka ba la kha ïa me , ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan pynlong ia ka ban wan phai biang sha ka sniehdoh jong u ? Ngan bishar ia me ha ka jaka ba la thaw ia me, ha ka ri jong ka jingkha jong me .

en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master s sons , and set him on his father s throne , and fight for your master s house .
kha: Kumta te , tang mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kane ka shithi phi dei ban jied ïa uba kynsai tam bad uba bit tam na ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem , pynlong syiem ïa u , bad ïaleh ban ïada ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit wat ia kiba bha tam bad kiba iakynduh ia ki khun kynrad jong phi, bad buh ia u ha ka khet jong u kpa jong u, bad ialeh na ka bynta ka iing kynrad jong phi.

en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times , and strength of salvation : the fear of the  Lord  is his treasure .
kha: U ïada borabor ïa la ki briew bad u ai ïa ki ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Ka jingkynshew spah bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kan long ka jingshong shngain jong ki por jong me, bad ka jingkhlain jong ka jingpynim: ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka spah jong u .

en: Son of man , what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel , saying , The days are prolonged , and every vision faileth ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  balei ki paid Israel ki ïai-ong ïa kane ka proberb : ‘ Ka por ka leit noh , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kim urlong ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, kaei kata ka proberb kaba phi don ha ka ri Israel , da kaba ong , Ki sngi ki slem , bad kawei pa kawei ka jingphohsniew ka jah noh ?

en: Now this I say , brethren , that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God ; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption .
kha: Kaei kaba nga mut , ko parabangeit , ka long ba kaei kaba la thaw da ka doh bad ka snam kam lah ban ïadon bynta ha ka Hima U Blei , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap kan ym ïohkynti ïa ka jingbymïap shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kane nga ong, ko para bangeit, ba ka doh bad ka snam kam lah ban hiar pateng ia ka hima U Blei ; bad ka jingbamsap kam lah ban hiar pateng ia ka jingbym lah ban pyut .

en: And the king said to him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the  Lord  ?
kha: Hynrei u Ahab u jubab ,  Haba phi ong ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , ong ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno sien ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u: Katno sien ngan pynskhem ia me ba me ong ei ei hynrei tang ka jingshisha ha nga ha ka kyrteng U Trai ?

en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .
kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ka bleithaw na ïing , ka pyndem ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata , bad ka buh jingtap halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Michal u la shim ia ka dur, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka jingthiah, bad u la buh ia ka pillow jong ki blang na ka bynta ka bol jong u, bad u la tap ia ka da ka jain .

en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .
kha: To kmen bad to shadkmen junom ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bathymmai kaba nga pynlong kan dap da ka jingkmen , bad ki briew jong ka kin shem sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to sngewbha bad sngewbha junom ha kata kaba nga thaw: namar, ha khmih, nga thaw ia ka Jerusalem ka jingkmen, bad ki briew jong ka ka jingkmen .

en: The firstfruit also of thy corn , of thy wine , and of thine oil , and the first of the fleece of thy sheep , shalt thou give him .
kha: Ki dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ki soh nyngkong na u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad u  saiwul jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka soh ba nyngkong eh jong u kew jong me, na ka wain jong me bad na ka umphniang jong me, bad kaba nyngkong eh na ka snieh langbrot jong me, men ai ia u .

en: Which in time past were not a people , but are now the people of God : which had not obtained mercy , but now have obtained mercy .
kha: Ha kawei ka por phim shym la long ki briew jong U Blei , hynrei mynta phi long ki briew jong u ; ha kawei ka por phim shym la tip ïa ka jinglehisynei U Blei , hynrei mynta phi la ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehisynei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ha ka por ba la leit noh kam dei ka jaitbynriew , hynrei mynta ki long ki briew U Blei: ki bym shym la ioh ia ka jingisynei , hynrei mynta ki la ioh ia ka jingisynei .

en: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth  ; their flocks and their herds , their sons and their daughters .
kha: Hynrei ka jingmane ïa u Baal , u blei ka jinglehrain , ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban duh ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad kynhun masi , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei — kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la trei naduh ki por mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingsngewlehrain ka la bam ia ka jingtrei shitom jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi naduh ka jinglong samla jong ngi; ki langbrot bad ki kynhun jong ki, ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki .

en: And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .
kha: Mynta nga da sngewthikna ba phin sa long u syiem ki Israel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingsynshar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih , nga tip bha ba me long shisha u syiem bad ba ka hima Israel kan long kaba skhem ha ka kti jong me .

en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
kha: bad u Ahio u ïaid na khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka na ka iing u Abinadab kaba don ha Gibeah: bad u Ahio u la leit sha khmat ka synduk U Blei .

en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia ka dei kaba la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh ngi tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kata kaba la jer kyrteng mynta, bad la tip ba ka long u briew: lymne u lah ban ialeh pyrshah ia uta uba kham khlain bor ban ia u .

en: And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .
kha: Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ong ba ki la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïathuh ha ki ba u im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kim lap ia ka met jong u , ki la wan da kaba ong , ba ki la iohi ruh ia ka jingphohsniew jong ki angel kiba la ong ba u dang im .

en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp , and stoned him with stones , and he died  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Kumta ka kynhun baroh kawei ka ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara bad la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la wanrah ia u shabar ka shnong bad ki la ther maw ia u da ki maw bad u la iap ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword  ; all these were men of valour .
kha: Baroh ki Benjamin kiba shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi ki long arphew san hajar ngut — baroh na ki , ki dei ki shipai bashlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta baroh kiba la hap ha kata ka sngi u Benjamin ki long arphew san hajar ngut ki briew kiba la sei ia ka waitlam ; kine baroh ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingshlur .

en: And I will set fire in Egypt : Sin shall have great pain , and No shall be rent asunder , and Memphis shall have distresses daily .
kha: Ngan tbeh ding ïa ka Ijipt , bad ka Pelusium kan don ha ka jingkordit . Ki kynroh jong ka Thebes kin pra , bad ka nongbah kan shlei da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan thang ding ha Ijipt: Ka pop kan don ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw, bad u No un sa shah pynpra noh, bad ki Memphis kin don ki jingeh man ka sngi .

en: Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .
kha: To ïeng joit bad mihnoh ; naba ym don shuh ka jingshngain hangne . Ki pop jong phi ki la long jingtim sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie ia phi , bad leit noh namar kane kam dei ka jingjahthait jong phi: namar ba la pynjakhlia ia ka , kan pynjot ia phi, wat da ka jingpynjot kaba jur .

en: Wherein God , willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel , confirmed it by an oath :
kha: Ha kito kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba u kular , U Blei u kwah ban pyn-i shai ba un ym pynkylla ïa ki jingthmu jong u ; kumta u wanrah de ïa ka jingsmai ha ka jingkular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba U Blei, uba kham mon ban pyni ha ki nongioh pateng ia ka jingbym lah ban pynkylla jong ka jingai jingmut jong u, u la pynskhem ia ka da ka jingsmai:

en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .
kha: La katta ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied pat ha kano kano ka por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat hapdeng ki shnong ki Lebi bad ki iing jong ki shnong jong ki , ki Lebi ki lah ban siew kylliang ha kano kano ka por .

en: And the field , and the cave that is therein , were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .
kha: Kumta kata ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong ki Hit , ryngkat bad ka krem kaba don hangta , ka la kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u Abraham kum ka jaka tep briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don ha ka la pynskhem ha u Abraham na ka bynta ka jaka tep da ki khun shynrang jong u Heth .

en: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .
kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Dei ma nga  u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u, U Jisu na Nazareth . U Jisu u ong ha ki, Nga long ma nga . Bad u Judas ruh uba la shet kylla ia u u la ieng bad ki .

en: And when Aaron saw it , he built an altar before it  ; and Aaron made proclamation , and said , To morrow is a feast to the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Aaron u tei ïa ka duwan ha khmat jong uta u khun masi ksiar , bad u la pynbna ,  Lashai kan don ka jingkhawai niam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la iohi ia ka, u la tei ia ka jingbam ha khmat jong ka ; bad u Aaron u la pynbna , bad u la ong , Lashai ka long ka jingkhawai ia U Trai .

en: This then is the message which we have heard of him , and declare unto you , that God is light , and in him is no darkness at all .
kha: Mynta ka khubor ïa kaba ngi la ïohsngew na U Khun jong u bad pynbna ha phi ka long kane : U Blei u long ka jingshai bad ha u ka jingdum kam don satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka khubor kaba ngi la iohsngew na u, bad ngi pynbna ha phi, ba U Blei U long ka jingshai bad ha u ym don jingdum satia .

en: Will he reserve his anger for ever ? will he keep it to the end ? Behold , thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest .
kha: Men ym ïai bitar ; men ym khih bitar ïa nga shi junom .’ Ko Israel kata ka dei kaei kaba pha la ong , hynrei pha la leh ïa ka jingsniew kat kaba pha lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato un buh ia ka jingbitar jong u junom ? hato un buh ia ka haduh kaba kut ? Ha khmih , me la kren bad leh ia kiei kiei kiba sniew katba me lah .

en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one : for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren ,
kha: U pynkhuid ïa ki briew na ki pop jong ki , bad ma u lem bad kita baroh ïa kiba la pynkhuid ki don ujuh U Kpa . Namarkata , U Jisu um sngewlehrain ban khot ïa ki , ki para jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh arngut kiba pynkyntang bad kiba la pynkyntang ki long baroh: namar kata um sngewlehrain ban khot ia ki para , .

en: And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Silpah , ka mraw ka Leah , ki long u Gad bad u Asher . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang la kha ha Mesopotamia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Silpah, ka kti jong u Leah bad u Asher: kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob kiba la kha ia u ha Paddanaram .

en: The nakedness of thy father s wife s daughter , begotten of thy father , she is thy sister , thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka khun ka tnga u kpa jong me , naba ka ruh ka dei ka para jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka tnga jong u kpa jong me, kaba la kha na u kpa jong me, ka long ka para jong me, wat plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka .

en: They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :
kha: Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la len ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Un ym leh ei ei da shisha . Ngin ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym mad ïa ka thma lane ka  nemsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ngeit ia U Trai , bad ki la ong , Kam dei ma u ; bad ka jingsniew kan ym wan ha ngi; lymne ngin ym iohi ia ka waitlam ne ka jingkyrduh:

en: Thou that art full of stirs , a tumultuous city , a joyous city : thy slain men are not slain with the sword , nor dead in battle .
kha: Ka nongbah baroh kawei ka don ha ka jingkhihwin , la pyndap da ka jingsawa bad ka jingshongshit . Ki rangbah jong phi kiba la ïap ha kane ka thma kim shym ïap ha ka jingïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me kaba dap da ki jingkhihwin, ka nongbah kaba jylliew, ka nongbah kaba kmen: ki briew kiba la shah pyniap jong me kim shah pyniap da ka waitlam , lymne kiba la iap ha ka thma .

en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin .
kha: Kum u kpa jong u ha shuwa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad u la iaid ha ka lynti jong u kpa jong u bad ha ka pop jong u da kaba u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers , and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury .
kha: Kumta , te , me la dei ban thep ïa ka pisa jong nga ha ka jaka kynshew pisa , bad ngan jin da la ïohpdiang ïa ka baroh lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la dei ban buh ia ka pisa jong nga ha ki nongkylla , bad nangta ha ka jingwan jong nga nga la dei ban pdiang ia la ka jong ka pisa .

en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field :
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kawei pat ka pharshi :  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u la bet ïa u symbai babha hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pat ka pharshi kaba u la buh ha ki, da kaba ong: Ka hima bneng ka long kum u briew uba la bet symbai babha ha ka lyngkha jong u:

en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass , and put the taches into the loops , and couple the tent together , that it may be one .
kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rnong , pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki kyrwoh , bad suh lang ïa kita ki jaiñ jingtap ar tylli ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna sanphew tylli ki tnat nar, bad buh ia ki tnat ha ki loop , bad arngut ia ka tent lang , ba kan long kawei .

en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .
kha: Mynta hangne u don u syiem uba phi la jied ; phi la pan ïa u , bad mynta U  Trai  u la ai ïa u ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha khmih ia u syiem uba phi la jied bad uba phi la kwah ! bad , ha khmih , U Trai u la buh syiem halor jong phi .

en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
kha: Ka jingduwai jong nga ka long ba ka jingïasyllok jong ngi bad me kum ki bangeit kan wallam ïa ka jingsngewthuh ba kham jylliew ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngi ïoh ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingiakren jong ka jingngeit jong me kan long kaba treikam da kaba pdiang ia kiei kiei baroh kiba bha kiba don ha phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi ba la thang lut , kaba la leh nyngkong ha u Lum Sinai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingknia thang kaba bteng, kaba la buh ha u lum Sinai na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang, ka jingknia kaba la pynlong da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .
kha: U Simri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elah , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u . Kane ka jia ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zimri u la rung bad u la pyniap ia u, ha ka snem arphew hynriew snem u syiem Judah bad u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
kha: U shyiap uba shit phyrnai un long ka pung , bad ka khyndew kaba thrang um kan long ki umpohliew . —Isaïah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khyndew kaba la tyrkhong kan sa kylla long kum ka pung kaba jyrngam, bad ka khyndew kaba sliang kum ki tyllong um .iah 35:15, 6 , 7.

en: And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs  ; nine cities out of those two tribes .
kha: ka Ain , ka Juttah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki : khyndai tylli ki shnong na ki jait Judah bad Simeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Ain bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Juttah bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad ka Bethshesh bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka; hynniew tylli ki shnong na kita ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew .

en: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .
kha: Hangta ngi la shem katto katne ngut ki parabangeit bad ngi la sah bad ki shi taïew . Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem ki la ïathuh ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la shem ia ki synran , ngi la sah hangta hynriew sngi: kiba la ong ha u Paul lyngba U Mynsiem ba um dei ban leit sha Jerusalem .

en: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,
kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , te , nga maham ïa phi ; wat ïai im kum kiba mane blei thala , kiba ki jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor , bad kiba ki jingmut jong ki , ki long ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane nga ong namarkata , bad nga sakhi ha U Trai , ba phi nangne shakhmat phim iaid kumba iaid kiwei pat ki Jutang , ha ka jinglong ba khlem akor jong ki .

en: To the weak became I as weak , that I might gain the weak : I am made all things to all men , that I might by all means save some .
kha: Hapdeng kiba tlot ha ka jingngeit nga long uba tlot kum uwei na ki , khnang ban jop ïa ki . Kumta nga don ka jingïadei ha baroh ïa ki briew baroh , khnang ba nga lah ban pyllait katto katne na ki da ki lad baroh kiba don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiba tlot nga la kylla long uba tlot , ba ngan ioh ia kiba tlot: Nga la pynlong ia kiei kiei baroh ha ki briew baroh , ba nga lah da ki lad baroh ban pynim ia ki katto katne .

en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .
kha: Uno uno uba wanrah ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai  u dei ban wallam lem bad kata ka jingri shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bynta kaba saw jong ka wain na ka bynta ka jingknia dih to pynkhreh da ka jingainguh ne ka jingknia ba la thang, na ka bynta uwei u langbrot .

en: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah , and said unto them , What evil thing is this that ye do , and profane the sabbath day ?
kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki nongïalam Jiw bad ong ,  Peit ïa kaba sniew kaba phi leh ! Phi pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ialeh pyrshah bad ki rangbah jong ka Judah bad nga la ong ha ki , Kaei kaba sniew kaba phi leh bad ka sngi Sabha ?

en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
kha: Ïa baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u Amasaïah u la leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut ka jingsynshar jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Amasaiah, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha khmih ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Judah bad Israel ?

en: And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .
kha: Ma ka , ka long shisha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khun jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga ; bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh ka long ka para jong nga; ka long ka khun jong u kpa jong nga, hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga; bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong nga .

en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .
kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la pynmih ia phi na ka ri Ijipt , ban ai ia phi ia ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phi .

en: Behold , they shall surely gather together , but not by me : whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake .
kha: Lada uno uno u tur ïaleh ïa pha u leh ïa ka khlem ka jingaibor jong nga ; uno uno uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha un kyllon noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , kin ia lum lang shisha , hynrei ym da nga: uno uno uba ia lum lang pyrshah ia me un hap na ka bynta jong me .

en: And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me ? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?
kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ïa u Abram , bad u kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ïa nga ? Balei mem shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la khot ia u Abram bad u la ong: Kaei kata kaba me la leh ia nga ? balei phim iathuh ia nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;
kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi , ngan iohsngew , ong U Trai , ngan iohsngew ia ki bneng bad kin iohsngew ia ka khyndew ; .

en: And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .
kha: Ki synran ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , bad U Trai u la trei lem bad pynshisha ba ka jingïalap jong ki ka la long kaba shisha da ki kambah kiba ki la leh .]
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit shabar, bad ki la ialap ha man la ki jaka, U Trai u trei bad ki, bad u pynskhem ia ka ktien da ki dak kiba bud . Amen .

en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you , do ye even so to them : for this is the law and the prophets .
kha: Leh ïa kiwei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ïa ki ba kin leh na ka bynta jong phi : Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka Hukum u Moses bad jong ki jinghikai ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kiei kiei baroh kiba phi kwah ba ki briew kin leh ia phi, to leh ia ki ruh: namar kane ka long ka hukum bad ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Also Amaziah said unto Amos , O thou seer , go , flee thee away into the land of Judah , and there eat bread , and prophesy there :
kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u ong ha u Amos ,  Kata ka la biang , ko nongïathuhlypa , khie leit noh sha Judah bad leh ïa ka kam ïalap jong me hangta , bad sa ïathuhlypa de hangta . Ai ba kin siew ïa me na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Amasaiah u la ong ha u Amos, ko nongpeit, to leit noh sha ka ri Judah, bad hangta to bam ia u kpu bad to iathuhlypa hangta:

en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day .
kha: bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la bitar namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewsih namar ba U Trai u la leh ia ka jingpynkhein ia ka Ussa: namar kata ka jaka la khot ka Perezuzza haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the second time , while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,
kha: Katba nga dang don hi ha ka ïingbyndi ha ka phyllaw , ka khubor U  Trai  ka la wan biang ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jeremaiah ha ka sien kaba ar, katba u dang sahkut ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok, u da ong:

en: My face will I turn also from them , and they shall pollute my secret place : for the robbers shall enter into it , and defile it .
kha: Ngan ym leh ei ei haba ïa ka Templ bakordor jong nga yn pyntngit , haba ki nongtuh kin rung sha ka bad kin pyntngit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat jong nga ruh ngan phai noh na ki, bad kin pynjakhlia ia ka jaka rieh jong nga: namar ki runar kin rung shapoh jong ka bad kin pynjakhlia ia ka .

en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .
kha: Hynrei u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . U ong ïa ki ba ka jingïohkynti jong ki ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka jait Lebi u Moses um shym la ai pateng ei ei: U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la long ka pateng jong ki kumba u la ong ha ki .

en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the  Lord  , and hath perceived and heard his word ? who hath marked his word , and heard it ?
kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don na kine ki Nongïathuhlypa uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong U  Trai . Ym don na ki uba la ju ïohsngew ne sngewthuh ïa ka khubor jong U ne uba la ju shahshkor ne pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba U ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba la ieng ha ka jingmut jong U Trai bad u la sngewthuh bad iohsngew ia ka ktien jong u ? uba la buh dak ia ka ktien jong u bad u la iohsngew ia ka ?

en: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body .
kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim ïa u kpu , u la duwai ainguh bad u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u ,  Shim ïa u , une u long ka met jong nga  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang bam, U Jisu u la shim ia u kpu, bad u la kyrkhu, bad u la bthei ia u, bad u la ai ha ki, bad u la ong: Shim, bam: kane ka long ka met jong nga .

en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage , and ran into the army , and came and saluted his brethren .
kha: U Dabid u ieh ïa kata ka jingbam ha u rangbah uba dei peit ïa ka bam , u mareh sha ba don ki hynmen , bad u kylli kumno ki ïalong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la iehnoh ia ka kali jong u ha ka kti jong u nongri kali , bad u la mareh shapoh ka kynhun shipai , bad u la wan bad u la ai khublei ia ki hynmen jong u .

en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people : the  Lord  made me have dominion over the mighty .
kha: Nangta kita kiba lah ban shaniah ki la wan hiar sha la ki nongïalam ; Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la wan sha u da ka jinglakloi ban ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la pynlong ia uta uba sah ban synshar ia ki riew rangbah hapdeng ki briew: U Trai u la pynlong ia nga ban synshar ia kiba khlain bor .

en: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel , unto the place over against the water gate toward the east , and the tower that lieth out .
kha: U Palal , u khun jong u Usai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba sdang na ka dong jong ka kynroh bad ka jingtei ap phira jong ka ïingsyiem kaba haneng kaba long habar ka jaka ap phira ; U Pedaïah , u khun jong u Parosh u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka bynta kaba sha mihngi hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad ka jingtei ap phira ka Templ . ( Kane ka long hajan kata ka bynta jong ka nongbah ba khot Ophel , ha kaba ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ ki shong ki sah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki Nethinim ki shong ha Ophel, haduh ka jaka kaba don ha ka khyrdop um shaphang mihngi bad ka tower kaba sah shabar .

en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .
kha: U Abraham u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka  U  Trai  U Pynbiang .  Bad haduh kane ka sngi ruh , ki briew ki dang ong ,  Ha u lum jong U  Trai  u pynbiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka: kumba la ong haduh kine ki sngi , Ha u lum U Trai yn sa iohi ia ka .

en: Be careful for nothing ; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God .
kha: Wat khuslai shaphang kaei kaei , hynrei ha ki jingduwai jong phi baroh , to pan na U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi donkam bad da pan borabor na u da ka dohnud kaba sngewnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia kaei kaei kaba don tang shuh hynrei ha kiei kiei baroh da ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad da ka jingsngewnguh to ai ba ki jingkyrpad jong phi kin long kiba la tip ha U Blei .

en: Therefore the  Lord  left those nations , without driving them out hastily  ; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la shah ïa kine ki jaitbynriew ban ïaisah ha ka ri ; um shym la ai ha u Joshua ka jingjop halor jong ki , lymne beh noh shen ïa ki hadien ka jingïap jong u Joshua .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la iehnoh ia kita ki jaitbynriew , khlem da beh noh ia ki da kaba kyrkieh ; um shym la aiti ia ki ha ka kti u Joshua .

en: (For many walk , of whom I have told you often , and now tell you even weeping , that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ :
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane bunsien mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ïathuh biang ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat ; don shibun kiba ka jingim jong ki , ka pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun jong ka jingïap U Khrist ha ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta kiba bun kiba iaid, kiba nga la iathuh bunsien ha phi, bad mynta nga iathuh ia phi wat da kaba iam ruh, ba ki long ki nongshun jong ka diengphna U Khrist:

en: For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .
kha: kumba don uba la ong ,   ‘ Ha u ngi im , ngi khih bad ngi long .’   Ka long kumba katto katne na ki myllung jong phi kiba la ong ,   ‘ Ngi ruh ngi long ki khun jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha u ngi im, bad ngi iaid, bad ngi don ia ka jinglong jong ngi; kumba la ong ruh na ki myllung jong phi hi: Namar ngi long ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much , and largeness of heart , even as the sand that is on the sea shore .
kha: U Blei u la ai ha u Solomon ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh kiba kham pher , bad ïa ka jingtip kaba khraw palat ïa ka ban thew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la ai ia u Solomon ia ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh kaba palat, bad ka jingjylliew jong ka dohnud, wat kum ka dewbilat kaba don ha rud duriaw .

en: The project is being executed with financial help of the Delhi government which has sanctioned Rs 20 crore for the same , Goel said
kha: Ïa kane ka projek la pyntrei da ka jingïarap pisa jong ka sorkar Delhi kaba la ai sanction 20 klur tyngka na ka bynta kajuh , ong u Goel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kane ka projek la pyntreikam da ka jingiarap pisa jong ka sorkar Delhi kaba la pynjari 20 klur na ka bynta kajuh , la ong u Goel .

en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .
kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lynti jong nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno lait tang ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh nga dei ban iaid haduh ka sngi, bad haduh lashai: namar kam lah ban long ba u nongiathuhlypa un jah noh na Jerusalem .

en: For we are the circumcision , which worship God in the spirit , and rejoice in Christ Jesus , and have no confidence in the flesh .
kha: Dei ma ngi , ym ma ki , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingotsher kaba shisha , naba ngi mane ïa U Blei da U Mynsiem jong u bad ngi lehkmen ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu . Ngim buh ïa kano kano ka jingshaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ka jingotsher , kaba mane ia U Blei ha U Mynsiem bad ngi sngewkmen ha U Khrist Jisu bad ngim don jingshaniah ha ka doh .

en: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully : for he shall come up , and shall become strong with a small people .
kha: Da kaba pynlong ki jingïateh lok , un shukor ïa kiwei ki hima , bad un nang khlaiñ bad nang khlaiñ , wat la u synshar tang ïa ka hima kaba rit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ka jingleit kaba la leh bad u un trei da kaba thok: namar un wan shaneng bad un long uba skhem bad ki briew kiba rit .

en: They shall walk after the  Lord  : he shall roar like a lion : when he shall roar , then the children shall tremble from the west .
kha: Ki briew jong nga kin sa wan bud ïa nga haba nga kyrhuh kum u sing ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Kin wan kyrkieh sha nga na sha sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin iaid hadien U Trai: un iaid kum u sing: haba un iaid , te ki khun kin khih na sepngi .

en: Behold , I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watcheth , and keepeth his garments , lest he walk naked , and they see his shame .
kha: To shahshkor ! Nga wan kum u nongtuh ! Suk uta uba peitmat bad uba sumar ïa la ki jaiñkup , khnang ba un ym ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad shah pynlehrain ha khmat ki briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga wan kum u nongtuh . La kyrkhu ia uta uba peit bad uba ri ia ki jain jong u, ioh ba un iaid lyngkhuid bad kin iohi ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong u .

en: His mouth is most sweet : yea , he is altogether lovely . This is my beloved , and this is my friend , O daughters of Jerusalem .
kha: To khie , ko lyer Bashatei . Ko lyer Bashathie , to beh halor ka kper jong nga ; pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiwbih . Ai ba uba ieit jong nga un wan sha ka kper jong u bad bam ïa uba bha tam na ki soh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u ka long kaba thiang tam: hooid, u long uba ieit shibun . Kane ka long ka baieit jong nga , bad kane ka dei ka paralok jong nga , ko ki khun kynthei jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month , and encamped in Gilgal , in the east border of Jericho .
kha: U paidbah u la jam ïa ka Jordan ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba nyngkong bad ki la shong dara ha Gilgal , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la mih na Jordan ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba nyngkong bad ki la shong shnong ha Gilgal ha u pud u sam jong ka Jerikho .

en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth  ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit  ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .
kha: Em ! Ngam lah ban shu sngap jar ! Nga bitar bad nga kthang mynsiem . Nga dei ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan ym kyntait ia ka shyntur jong nga ; Ngan kren ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong nga ; Ngan ud ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: If that nation , against whom I have pronounced , turn from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them .
kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew ka phai noh na ka jingsniew jong ka , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kata ka jaitbynriew kaba nga la pynpaw pyrshah ka kylla na ka jingsniew jong ki , ngan kylla bamut na ka jingsniew kaba nga la pyrkhat ban leh ia ki .

en: That drink wine in bowls , and anoint themselves with the chief ointments : but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph .
kha: Phi dih waiñ na ki khuri ba-dap , bad phi pyndonkam da ki jingsleh kiba kynsai tam , hynrei phim shym ïam sngewsih halor ka jingshah pynjot ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka dih wain ha ki khiew , bad ka pynsleh ia lade da ki umphniang ba kongsan: hynrei kim sngewsih ia ka jingjynjar jong u Joseph .

en: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still : remember the  Lord  afar off , and let Jerusalem come into your mind .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u kiba don ha Babilonia :  Phi la lait na ka jingïap ! Mynta to leit ! Wat ap ! Wat la phi don jngai na ïing , pyrkhat shaphang jong nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad kynmaw ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kiba la lait na ka waitlam, leit noh, wat ieng shuh: kynmaw ia U Trai na jngai, bad to ai ba ka Jerusalem kan wan ha ka jingmut jong phi .

en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea , and had life , died  ; and the third part of the ships were destroyed .
kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka duriaw la pynkylla snam , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka duriaw ki la ïap , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki lieng la shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ki jingthaw kiba don ha duriaw, bad kiba don ka jingim, ka la iap bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ki lieng ka la shah pynjot .

en: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth , about six hundred thousand on foot that were men , beside children .
kha: Ki Israel ki mihnoh bad ki ïaid da ka kjat na Rameses haduh Sukkoth . Ki ïadon baroh kumba hynriew lakh ngut ki rangbah , nalor ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la iaid na Rameses haduh Sucoth, kumba hynriew spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba iaid kjat .

en: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord , they returned into Galilee , to their own city Nazareth .
kha: Haba U Joseph bad ka Mari ki la pyndep ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la dawa da ka aiñ jong U Trai , ki la leit phai pat sha Nasareth , ka shnong jong ki kaba ha Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kat kum ka hukum U Trai , ki la leit phai noh sha Galilaia , sha la ka jong ka shnong Nazareth .

en: And ye shall do no work in that same day : for it is a day of atonement , to make an atonement for you before the  Lord  your God .
kha: Wat trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi , naba kata ka long ka sngi ha kaba yn pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban weng noh ïa ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym leh ei ei ha kata ka sngi: namar ka long ka sngi jong ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong phi ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?
kha: hangno don kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingibieit !
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno u riewstad ? hangno u nongthoh ? hangno u nongialeh pyrshah ia kane ka pyrthei ? hato U Blei um shym la pynbieit ia ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ?

en: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters : and they came and drew water , and filled the troughs to water their father s flock .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Moses u dang shongthait harud kawei ka pukri , hynñiew ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , ki ïawan tong um ban pyndap ïa ki shyngoid ba kin ïoh ai um ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong u kpa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh jong ka Midian u don hynriew ngut ki khun kynthei: bad ki la wan bad ki la tan um , bad ki la pyndap ia ki thliew um ban ai um ia ki kynhun jong ki kpa jong ki .

en: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet , whether he eat little or much : but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep .
kha: Ki nongtrei ki lah ne kim lah ban don kat ban biang ban bam , hynrei la kumno kumno ki ïoh ka jingïohthiah kaba bang . Pynban , kiba riewspah , ki don bun haduh katta katta ha kaba kim ïohthiah namar ka jingkhuslai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthiah jong u briew uba trei shitom ka long kaba thiang , la u bam tang khyndiat ne bun: hynrei ka jingbun jong ki riewspah kan ym shah ia u ban thiah .

en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
kha: Ym don napdeng ki Anakim kiba dang sah ha ka ri Israel ; pynban , tang katto katne , la iehnoh ha Gasa , Gath bad Ashdod .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don uwei ruh na ki Anahim uba sah ha ka ri Israel: tang ha Gaza , ha Gath bad ha Ashdod , ka la sah .

en: When he is about to fill his belly , God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him , and shall rain it upon him while he is eating .
kha: Ai un bam kat kaba u kwah ! U Blei un pynshitom ïa u ha ka jingbitar shla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la jan pyndap ia ka kpoh jong u , U Blei un bret ia ka jingbitar jong u halor jong u , bad un pynhap ia ka ha u katba u dang bam .

en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
kha: Kan ym tip ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kam tip ba nga la ai ia u kew bad ka wain bad ka umphniang jong ka bad nga la pynbun ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ka, kaba ki la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Baal .

en: His sons , and his sons  sons with him , his daughters , and his sons  daughters , and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt .
kha: Ki shim ruh ïa la ki jingri bad ki jingdon jingem baroh kiba ki la lum ha Kanaan , bad ki leit noh sha Ijipt . U Jakob u leit sha Ijipt lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u baroh , ki khun shynrang ki ksiew shynrang ki khun kynthei bad ki ksiew kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad u, ki khun kynthei jong u bad ki khun kynthei jong u, bad ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la wanrah ia u bad u sha Ijipt .

en: And I will cast thee out , and thy mother that bare thee , into another country , where ye were not born  ; and there shall ye die .
kha: Ngan sa bret ïa me bad ïa ka kmie jong me sha ka jinglongmraw . Men leit sha ka ri ha kaba ym shym la kha ïa me , bad hangta phin ïap baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bret noh ia me bad ia ka kmie jong me kaba kha ia me, sha kawei pat ka ri, ha kaba ym shym la kha ia phi ; bad hangta phin iap .

en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .
kha: Hato ym don ba shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ? Nga smai ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kaba shisha . To ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un jubab ïa nga . Lada kiba pyrshah ïa nga ki wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da kaba thoh ïa ki ngan lah ban ïohi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba uwei un iohsngew ia nga ! ha khmih, ka jingkwah jong nga ka long, ba U Blei un jubab ia nga, bad ba u nongshun jong nga u la thoh ia ka kot .

en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him , Timothy and Erastus  ; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season .
kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Timothi bad u Erastos , ar ngut ki nongïarap jong u , sha Makedonia , katba u dang pynlut sa katto katne por ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la phah sha Makedonia arngut na ki kiba la shakri ia u, u Timothi bad u Erastus hynrei ma u hi u la sah ha Asia shi aiom .

en: And they shall look unto the earth  ; and behold trouble and darkness , dimness of anguish  ; and they shall be driven to darkness .
kha: lane peit shlip ha ka khyndew , pynban kin ym ïohi ei ei hynrei ka jingjynjar bad ka jingdum , ka jingdum kaba pyntriem sha kaba la beh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin peit sha ka khyndew ; bad ha khmih ka jingjynjar bad ka jingdum, ka jingdum jong ka jingsngewsih bad kin shah beh sha ka jingdum .

en: But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .
kha: To kynmaw ba u briew uba bet tang khyndiat ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh khyndiat ; uta uba bet shibun ki symbai un ïoh ot ruh shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane nga ong , Uta uba bet tang khyndiat eh un kheit ruh tang khyndiat bad uta uba bet shibun un kheit ruh shibun .

en: But those things , which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he hath so fulfilled .
kha: U Blei u la pynbna naduh mynshuwa lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa baroh ba U Messaïah jong u , u dei ban shahshitom ; bad u la pynlong ïa ka , ban jia shisha ha kane ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei kiba U Blei u la pynpaw lypa da ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong u baroh, ba U Khrist un shah shitom , u la pyndep kumta .

en: Hath walked in my statutes , and hath kept my judgments , to deal truly  ; he is just , he shall surely live , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Uba kum une u briew u kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga bad u sumar biang biang ïa ki aiñ jong nga . U long uba hok , bad un im ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hath u la iaid ha ki ain jong nga, bad u la bat ia ki jingbishar jong nga, ban leh shisha; u long uba hok, un im shisha, ong U Blei U Trai .

en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
kha: bad u la phah ïa ki sha U Trai ban kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wan , ne hato ngin khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la khot ia u arngut ki synran jong u u la phah ia ki sha U Jisu, u da ong: Me long ma me uba dei ban wan ? lane ngi wad ia uwei pat ?

en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .
kha: Ïa ka jingbishar hok la beh noh , bad ka hok kam lah ban wan hajan . Ka jingshisha ka kyllon ha ki lynti shnong , bad ka hok kam don jaka hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbishar ka kylla shadien, bad ka hok ka ieng jngai: namar ka jingshisha ka la hap ha lynti , bad ka jinglong marryngkat kam lah ban rung .

en: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
kha: Katba ka pyrthei ka dang sah , kan don ka aïom bet bad ka aïom ot . Kan don ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit , ka lyiur bad ka tlang , ka sngi bad ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka khyndew ka dang sah, ka por symbai bad ka por ot, bad ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit, bad ka por lyiur bad ka por lyiur, bad ka sngi bad ka miet kan ym sangeh .

en: But avoid foolish questions , and genealogies , and contentions , and strivings about the law ; for they are unprofitable and vain .
kha: Hynrei kiar na ki jingkylli ba-bieit , na ka thup kyrteng ki kpa tymmen , na ki jingïania bad ki jingïaleh shaphang ka Hukum . Kine ki long ki bymmyntoi bad kiba sep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiar na ki jingkylli kiba bieit , bad ki jingkren bein , bad ki jingiakren shaphang ka ain ; namar ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi bad kiba lehnohei .

en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
kha: U Shuppim bad u Hosah ki ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang sepngi bad ka khyrdop Shallekheth ha ka surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap phira la pynbynta ha ki por ba la buh , kawei hadien kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Shuppim bad u Hosah ka lot ka la wan shaphang sepngi, bad ka khyrdop Shallekh, da ka daw jong ka jingleit shaneng, ka ward pyrshah ia ka ward .

en: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies ? yea , they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart  ;
kha: Slem haduh katno kita ki nongïathuhlypa kin ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ki jinglamler kiba ki shu thaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por kane kan long ha ka dohnud jong ki nongiathuhlypa kiba iathuhlypa ? Hooid , ki long ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka jingthok jong ka dohnud jong ki hi;

en: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem  ; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech :
kha: Nangta U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Abimelekh bad ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban ïashun iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Blei u la phah ia u mynsiem bymman hapdeng u Abimelech bad ki briew jong u Shechem ; bad ki briew jong u Shechem ki la leh thok bad u Abimelech:

en: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him , and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .
kha: Ki jingthoh ki ïathuh kumno u la synshar , haduh katno u long uba khrawbor , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia ha u , ha ki Israel , bad ha ki hima baroh kiba marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingsynshar jong u baroh bad ka bor jong u, bad ki por kiba la leit noh ia u bad halor ki Israel bad halor ki hima baroh .

en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and he was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid u kpa jong u: bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
kha: Haba ki la jan poi ha Jerusalem , hajan ki shnong Bethphage bad Bethania , ki la wan sha u lum ki Olib . U Jisu u la nang phah ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jong u bad kine ki jingbthah :
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem ha Betphage bad Bethania ha u lum Olive , u phah noh ia arngut ki synran jong u .

en: Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .
kha: U  Trai  un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Jeroboam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata U Trai un pynmih ia u syiem halor ki Israel , uba ot noh ia ka iing u Jeroboiah ha kata ka sngi: hynrei kaei ? wat mynta ruh .

en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit ki la phah noh mardor ia u Paul bad u Silas ha ka por miet sha Beria: kiba wan sha ka jaka ki la leit sha ka synagog jong ki Jiw .

en: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel , and there shall be none to bury her . And he opened the door , and fled .
kha: Ïa ka Jesebel yn ym tep ; ïa ka met jong ka yn bam da ki ksew ha ka thain jong ka Jesreel .’   Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , u nongïathuhlypa samla u la mihnoh na ka kamra bad u la phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kulai kin bam ia ka Jezebel ha ka bynta jong ka Jesel bad ym don mano mano ruh ban tep ia ka . U la plie ia ka jingkhang bad u la phet noh .

en: So Rab–shakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
kha: U rangbah synshar ka Assyria u ïoh jingtip ba u patsha u la mih na Lakhish bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Libnah kaba don marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban twad jingmut na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Rabshakeh u la wan phai, bad u la shem ia u syiem Assyria uba ialeh pyrshah ia ka Libnah : namar u la iohsngew ba u la leit noh na Lachish .

en: And Joram slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jehoram u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joram u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid: bad u Ahasaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men , to be seen of them : otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven .
kha: Da pynthikna ba phin ym leh ïa ki kam niam jong phi ha kaba paw khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh . Lada phi leh ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba paw , phin ym ïoh kano kano ka nong na U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ba phin ym leh ia ki jingaiei jong phi ha khmat ki briew: lym kumta phim don ka bainong jong U Kpa jong phi kaba don ha bneng .

en: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself ; and the wife see that she reverence her husband .
kha: Hynrei ka thew ruh ïa phi : Man u shynrang u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba ïa lade , bad man ka kynthei ka dei ban ñiewburom ïa la u tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh to ai ba uwei pa uwei na phi un ieit ia la ka tnga wat kumba ma u; bad ka tnga kan iohi ba ka burom ia u tnga jong ka .

en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke , he that ruled the nations in anger , is persecuted , and none hindereth .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki nongsynshar basniew kiba banbeiñ da ka jingbitar ïa ki briew bad ki bym ju sangeh ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba ki la jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la pynkhih ia ki briew ha ka jingbitar da ka jingshah shoh kaba bteng , uta uba la synshar ia ki jaitbynriew ha ka jingbitar , u shah pynshitom bein , bad ym don ba khanglad .

en: And he said unto her , If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied , then shall I be weak , and be as another man .
kha: U jubab ,  Lada ki khum ïa nga da ki tyllai kiba thymmai ki bym pat la ju pyndonkam , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka , Lada ki teh skhem ia nga da ki lynti thymmai ki bym pat ju shong , te ngan sa tlot bad ngan long kum uwei pat u briew .

en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
kha: Me la kem ïa nga ; me dei u nongshun jong nga . Nga la sah sa tang ka snep bad ki shyieng , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la pyndap ia nga da ki jingmong kiba long ka sakhi pyrshah ia nga: bad ka jinglong rit paid jong nga ka kiew ha nga ka sakhi ia ka khmat jong nga .

en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi la long ki mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ngi da ka borbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me dei ban ong ha u khun jong me, Ngi la long ki mraw jong u Pharaoh ha Ijipt ; bad U Trai u la pynmih ia ngi na Ijipt da ka kti kaba khlain:

en: Tell ye the daughter of Sion , Behold , thy King cometh unto thee , meek , and sitting upon an ass , and a colt the foal of an ass .
kha: To ïathuh ïa ka nongbah Seïon , ha khmih , u Syiem jong pha u wan sha pha ! U long uba sngewrit bad u shong halor ka kada bad halor u khun kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia ka khun jong u Sion , Ha khmih u Syiem jong me u wan sha me, u sngap jar bad u shong halor ka kada , bad u khun masi jong u kada .

en: Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
kha: Khyndiat pat u la hap halor ka jaka maw ha kaba don tang khyndiat ka khyndew . Shen ki symbai ki la speh , namar ka khyndew kam da jylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba la hap ha ki jaka maw , ha kaba kim don khyndew than: bad mar kumta hi ki la mih noh , namar kim don ka jingjylliew jong ka khyndew:

en: And the Philistine said unto David , Am I a dog , that thou comest to me with staves ? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods .
kha: U ong ïa u Dabid ,  Men leh aïu da uto u diengduh ? Me tharai nga dei u ksew ?  Bad u pyrta da ki jingtim ki blei jong u halor u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philistia u la ong ha u Dabid, Hato nga dei u kulai, ba me wan sha nga da ki dieng ? Bad u Philistia u la tim ia u Dabid da ki blei jong u .

en: Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth , and did reverence to the king , and said , Let my lord king David live for ever .
kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon bad ka ong ,  Ai ba u kynrad jong nga , u syiem un im junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Bathsheba u la dem khrup ha ka khyndew bad u la leh burom ia u syiem bad u la ong: To ai ba u syiem jong nga u Dabid un im junom .

en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God , in much patience , in afflictions , in necessities , in distresses ,
kha: Pynban , ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi leh ngi pyn-i ba ngi long ki shakri U Blei da kaba ïaishah slem ha ki jingjynjar , ki jingeh , bad ki jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kiei kiei baroh kiba mynjur ia lade kum ki nongshakri U Blei, ha ka jingshaniah kaba khraw, ha ki jingjynjar, ha ki jingdonkam, ha ki jingjynjar .

en: He said that we have to work as a unified railway system ensuring best coordination among all railways zones and railway divisions .
kha: U la ong ba ngi hap ban trei kum ka lynti rel kaba iatylli kaba pynthikna ia ka jingiatreilang kaba bha tam hapdeng baroh ki jaka rel bad ki bynta rel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ba ngi hap ban trei kum ka rukom treikam rel kaba iatylli kaba pynthikna ia ka jingiatreilang kaba bha tam hapdeng baroh ki zone rel bad ki jingphiah rel .

en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .
kha: Kumta phi dei ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba kim leh ïa kaei kaba ki ïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh namarkata kaei kaei kaba ki ong ba phi peit, kaba peit bad leh ; hynrei wat leh ia ki kam jong ki: namar ki ong , bad kim leh .

en: They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .
kha: Ki kren ki ktien bym don jingmut bad pynlong ki jingkular lamler bad ki jingïateh kular bymlarkam . Ka hok ka kylla long bymhok , ka nang san kum ki ñiut ba long bih ha ka lyngkha ba la dep lur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ia ki ktien, da kaba sngap jar ha kaba leh ia ka jutang: kumta ka jingbishar ka mih kum ka jingbishar ha ki thliew lyngkha .

en: And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
kha: U la wan sha u langbrot , uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng harud jong ka wah , bad u la mareh sha u da ka bor jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha uta u langbrot uba don ar tylli ki bniat kiba nga la iohi ba u ieng ha khmat ka wah bad u la mareh sha u ha ka jingbitar jong ka bor jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , See , I have given into thine hand Jericho , and the king thereof , and the mighty men of valour .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Nga buh ha ki kti jong me ïa ka Jerikho , lem bad u syiem jong ka bad ïa ki shipai bashlur jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua , Peit, nga la aiti ha ka kti jong me u Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka bad ki riewshlur jong ka .

en: What ? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you , which ye have of God , and ye are not your own ?
kha: Hato phim tip ba ka met jong phi ka long ka jaka shong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba shong hapoh jong phi bad ïa uba la ai ha phi da U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ? phim tip ba ka met jong phi ka long ka tempi jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba don ha phi , uba phi don na U Blei , bad phim long ki jong phi hi ?

en: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Gezer with her suburbs ,
kha: La ai ha ki , saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Shekhem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ha ka ri lum Ephraim ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Geser ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la ai ia ki Shehem bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka ha u lum Ephraim , ban long ka shnong rieh tngen na ka bynta u nongleh jadu ; bad u Gzer bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka .

en: Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .
kha: Ngi kyntu ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban maham ïa kiba jaipdeh , ban pynshlur ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , ban ïaishah ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi kyntu ia phi ko para bangeit, to maham ia kiba khlem akor, to pyntngen ia kiba tlot , to kyrshan ia kiba tlot , to long kiba iaishah ia ki briew baroh .

en: The cases were registered under the relevant sections of IPC , the Disaster Management Act and the Rajasthan Epidemic Diseases Act .
kha: Ïa kine ki case la register hapoh ki bynta ba ïadei jong ka IPC , ka Disaster Management Act bad ka Rajasthan Epidemic Diseases Act .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kine ki case la register hapoh ki bynta ba iadei bad ka IPC , ka ain pyniaid ia ki jingpang bad ka ain jong ka Rajasthan Epidemic Disease Act .

en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish  ; he shall let him go free for his eye s sake .
kha: Lada u briew u shoh na ka pyllew khmat ïa la u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , bad kata ka khmat ka sep-ei noh , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u shoh ia ka khmat jong u shakri jong u, ne ka khmat jong u shakri jong u, ba ka jah noh; un pyllait noh ia u na ka bynta ka khmat jong u .

en: And his return was to Ramah  ; for there was his house  ; and there he judged Israel  ; and there he built an altar unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u ju leit pat sa sha la ïing ha Ramah , hangta ruh u ju shakri kum u nongbishar . Ha Ramah u la tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingwan phai jong u ka long ha Ramah ; namar hangta u la bishar ia ki Israel bad hangta u la tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai .

en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .
kha: Sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , bad ai ïa ka ha ki briew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta kane ka jingkyrkhu kaba me la wanrah ha u kynrad jong nga , to ai ba kan long wat ha ki samla kiba bud ia u kynrad jong nga .

en: For do I now persuade men , or God ? or do I seek to please men ? for if I yet pleased men , I should not be the servant of Christ .
kha: Hato kane ka i kumba nga pyrshang ban ïoh jingpynshisha na u briew ? Em , ym kumta! Kaei kaba nga kwah ka long ban pynshisha na U Blei! Hato nga pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew ? Lada nga dang long uba pyrshang ban leh kumta , ngam pat long u shakri U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hato mynta nga pynsngewthuh ia ki briew ne ia U Blei ? ne nga wad ban pynsngewbha ia ki briew ? namar lada nga dang sngewbha ia ki briew , ngam dei ban long u shakri U Khrist .

en: And she answered him , Nay , my brother , do not force me  ; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel : do not thou this folly .
kha: Em ,  ka ong .  Wat pynbor ïa nga ban leh kum kane ka kam pohjait ! Kaba da sngewjli !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jubab ia u, Em, ko hynmen jong nga, wat pynbor ia nga; namar ym dei ban leh ia kata ha Israel: wat leh ia kane da kaba suk .

en: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God , to walk in his laws , which he set before us by his servants the prophets .
kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , mynba me la ong ïa ngi ban im kat kum ki aiñ kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai jong ngi, ban iaid ha ki ain jong u , kiba u buh ha khmat jong ngi da ki shakri jong u ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up , and to pull down , and to destroy it  ;
kha: Lada ha kano kano ka por nga ong ba ngan rat , ngan pynkheiñ , lane pynjot ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kano ka khyllipmat ngan kren shaphang ka jaitbynriew, bad shaphang ka hima, ban kiew shaneng, bad ban tan shapoh, bad ban pynjot ia ka;

en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles  ; Prepare war , wake up the mighty men , let all the men of war draw near  ; let them come up :
kha: Pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynbna hapdeng ki jaitbynriew : ‘ To Pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma ; khot ïa ki nongïaleh thma ; ïalumlang ïa ki shipai bad tur shaphrang !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbna ia kane hapdeng ki Jutang ; Pynkhreh ia ka thma, pynkynjah ia ki briew kiba khlain bor , ai ba baroh ki briew kiba ialeh thma kin wan hajan ; ai ba kin wan shaneng:

en: And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .
kha: Ka pynstet ban phylliew ïa ka um na u khiew jong ka ha ka shyngoid ai um ïa ki jingri bad ka mareh sha kata ka pukri ban leit tong um shuh , haduh ba kan da dep ban ai um ïa ki ut jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kyrkieh bad ka la pynthylli ia ka khiew jong ka shapoh ka thliew bad ka la mareh biang sha ka thliew ban tan um bad ka la tan ia ki kulai jong u baroh .

en: Then he shall minister in the name of the  Lord  his God , as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the  Lord .
kha: bad u lah ban shakri hangta kum u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kum kiwei pat ki Lebi kiba ïashakri hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un shakri ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong u, kumba ki para jong u baroh ki leh ki Lebi kiba ieng hangta ha khmat U Trai .

en: And thou , child , shalt be called the prophet of the Highest : for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways  ;
kha: Ïa me , ko khun jong nga , yn khot u nongïathuhlypa jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Men leit ha shuwa jong U Trai ban pynkhreh ka lynti na ka bynta jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia me, ko khun, yn khot ia me u nongiathuhlypa jong Uba ha khlieh duh: namar me leit ha khmat U Trai ban pynkhreh ia ki lynti jong u;

en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .
kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali sha Kedesh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la leit bad u .
