translated_en_to_kha: U Barak u la khot ia u Zebulun bad u Naphtali ha Kadesh ; bad u la leit shaneng da ki shi hajar ngut ki briew ha ki kjat jong u: bad u Deborah u la leit shaneng bad u .

en: But if the priest buy any soul with his money , he shall eat of it , and he that is born in his house : they shall eat of his meat .
kha: Hynrei ki mraw jong u lyngdoh , ïa kiba u la thied ne ïa kiba la kha ha ïing jong u , ki lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u lyngdoh u thied ia kano kano ka mynsiem da ka pisa jong u, un bam ia ka, bad uta uba la kha ha iing jong u: kin bam ia ka doh jong u .

en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks , and lookest narrowly unto all my paths  ; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet .
kha: Me khum da ki kynjri ïa ki kjat jong nga ; me khmih ïa ki jingjam ba nga shim , bad wat ban peit-thuh ïa ki dien jat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me buh ia ki kjat jong nga ruh ha ki dieng , bad me peit lyngkot ia ki lynti jong nga baroh; me buh ia ka dak ha ki tyrpeng jong nga .

en: But Herod the tetrarch , being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip s wife , and for all the evils which Herod had done ,
kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pynrem jur ïa u Herod , uba long u lyngskor , namar u la shongkurim ïa ka Herodias , ka tnga jong u para jong u , bad u la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Herod u la shah pynrem ha u na ka bynta u Herodias u hynmen jong u u Philip bad na ka bynta ki jingsniew baroh kiba u Herod u la leh .

en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .
kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumta u shah ïa ki Midian ban synshar ïa ki haduh hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai : bad U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong u Midian hynriew snem .

en: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt , and led you forty years through the wilderness , to possess the land of the Amorite .
kha: Nga la wan ïalam ruh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , nga la ïalam ïa phi sawphew snem lyngba ka ri shyiap bad nga la ai ïa phi ïa ka ri ki Amor ba phin ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga la wanrah ia phi na ka ri Ijipt , bad nga la ialam ia phi sawphew snem lyngba ka ri khlaw , ban ioh ia ka ri jong ki Amorit .

en: Arabia , and all the princes of Kedar , they occupied with thee in lambs , and rams , and goats : in these were they thy merchants .
kha: Ki Arab bad ki nongsynshar ka ri Kedar ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar khaïi jong pha da ki khunlangbrot , ki langbrot , bad ki blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Arabia bad ki syiem jong u Kedar baroh ki la shong bad me ha ki langbrot bad ki langbrot bad ki blang: ha kine ki long ki nongkhaii jong me .

en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .
kha: Kum ka um na ka jaka den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Ninebeh !  Sangeh ! Sangeh !  ka jingpyrta ka sawa — hynrei ym don mano mano ba phai dien .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Nineveh ka long kaba rim kum ka pung um: hynrei kin phet noh . Ieng, ieng, kin iam ; hynrei ym don ba peit shadien .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Judah :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan sa pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , ba ngan leh ia ka jutang kaba thymmai bad ka iing Israel bad ka iing Judah:

en: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment : so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel .
kha: U Absalom u leh kumne ïa uwei pa uwei u Israel uba wan sha u syiem ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar ; bad da kumta u ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kane ka rukom u Absalom u la wan sha u syiem baroh: kumta u Absalom u la tuh ia ki dohnud jong ki Israel .

en: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne , high and lifted up , and his train filled the temple .
kha: Ha ka snem ba u syiem Ussaïah u ïap , nga la ïohi ïa U  Trai . U da shong halor ka khet , hajrong bad kaba la pynkyntiew , bad ka jaiñkup jong u ka pyndap ïa ka Templ baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem ba u syiem Uzziah u la iap nga la iohi ruh ia U Trai ba u shong halor ka khet kaba jrong bad kaba la pynkiew shaneng, bad ka rel jong u ka la pyndap ia ka tempi .

en: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit phai pat bad ki sha Nasareth , ha kaba u la kohnguh ïa ki . Ka kmie jong u ka la kynshew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh hapoh la ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit hiar bad ki, bad u la wan sha Nazareth, bad u la kohnguh ia ki: hynrei ka kmie jong u ka la buh ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ka dohnud jong ka .

en: And the rest of the acts of Joram , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoram u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Joram bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels , and have not charity , I am become as sounding brass , or a tinkling cymbal .
kha: Nga lah ban kren ha ki ktien jong ki briew bad wat ha ka jong ki angel ruh , hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ka jingkren jong nga ka long kum ka wiang rnong ba sawa ne kum ka shakuriaw bariew shaw shaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la nga kren da ki thylliej jong ki briew bad ki angel , bad ngam don ka jingai sngewbha , nga kylla long kum u nar uba sawa , ne u cymbal uba rkhie bein .

en: The city has been witnessing heavy rainfall for the past four consecutive days which has resulted in waterlogging in several areas .
kha: Ka nongbah ka la sakhi ia ka jingjur jong u slap ha kine ki saw sngi ba la dep kaba la pynlong ia ka jingshlei um ha ki katto katne ki jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka nongbah ka la sakhi ia ka jinghap slap kaba jur ha ki saw sngi ba bud kaba la pynlong ia ka jingtuid um ha ki katto katne ki jaka .

en: The Aponjon service helped me to get accurate health messages on how to raise a child as well as how to take care of my own health .
kha: Ka jingshakri jong ka Aponjon ka la iarap ia nga ban ioh ia ki khubor kiba thikna shaphang ka koit ka khiah kumno ban pynsan ia u khun bad kumjuh ruh kumno ban sumar ia la ka jong ka koit ka khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshakri Aponjon ka la iarap ia nga ban ioh ia ki khubor kiba thikna shaphang ka koit ka khiah kumno ban pynsan ia u khun bad kumjuh ruh kumno ban sumar ia la ka jong ka koit ka khiah .

en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
kha: Ki apostol ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew ba ki nong Samaria ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei , kumta ki la phah ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki apostol kiba don ha Jerusalem ki la iohsngew ba ka Samaria ka la pdiang ia ka ktien U Blei , ki la phah sha ki ia u Petros bad u loannis:

en: And the glory of the  Lord  went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .
kha: Nangta ka jingshai batyngshaiñ ka iehnoh ïa ka nongbah bad ka la leit sha u lumbah ha ka phang mihngi jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom U Trai ka la kiew na pdeng ka nongbah bad ka la ieng halor u lum uba don shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah .

en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .
kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Templ . ( Ka dei hangta ba ki kynthei ki ju thain ïa ki barandi kiba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa ka Asherah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynpra ia ki iing jong ki shynrang kiba don hajan ka iing U Trai , ha kaba ki kynthei ki la shet ia ki jingthung na ka bynta ka khlaw .

en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )
kha: ( Ki la ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalam ïa u shapoh ka Templ . )
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar ki la iohi mynshuwa bad u ha ka nongbah u Trophimus u Ephesia, uba ki la shim ba u Paul u la wanrah shapoh ka tempi . )

en: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof , and deliver you into the hands of strangers , and will execute judgments among you .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi shabar ka nongbah bad ngan aiti ïa phi ha ki nongwei . Nga la rai ïa phi ban ïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih ia phi na pdeng jong ka , bad ngan aiti ia phi ha ki kti jong ki nongwei , bad ngan pyndep ia ki jingbishar hapdeng jong phi .

en: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;
kha: U Jisu , te , u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . U long uba khuid ; um shym don kano kano kaba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u sha ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kum une u rangbah lyngdoh u la kylla long ma ngi, uba khuid, uba khlem jingma, uba khlem jingduna, uba la pyniakhlad na ki nongpop bad uba la pynlong kham halor ban ia ki bneng ; .

en: And he laid it upon my mouth , and said , Lo , this hath touched thy lips  ; and thine iniquity is taken away , and thy sin purged .
kha: U la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga da u rnga barhem bad ong ,  Une u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong me , bad mynta ka jingkitpop jong me ka la jah noh , bad ïa ki pop jong me la map .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka ha ka shyntur jong nga, bad u la ong, Lo, kane ka la ktah ia ki rmiang shyntur jong me bad ka jingbymhok jong me ka la jah noh, bad ka pop jong me ka la pynkhuid .

en: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
kha: Bad da ka jingmynjur jong ka tnga jong u , u la buh katto katne ka pisa na ka bynta ïa lade bad u la ai ïa kaba sah baroh ha ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh biang ia ka bynta jong ka dor, ka tnga jong u ruh ka la long kaba rieh ha ka, bad u la wanrah katto katne ka bynta, bad u la buh ia ka ha ki kjat jong ki apostol .

en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Joash u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Joash bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt : for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward .
kha: U la ñiew ba ka jingshah krenbeiñ na ka bynta U Messaïah ka long kaba kham kordor bun shah ban ïa ka spah baroh jong ka ri Ijipt , naba u khmih lynti ïa ka bainong ka ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewthuh ia ka jingshah lehbein U Khrist kaba kham khraw ban ia ki spah ha Ijipt: namar u la don ka jingburom ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong ka bainong .

en: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days  ; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sanphew , ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton kaba hynñiew , wan ai shuh ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  da u kew thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ka sngi kaba hynriew hadien ka sngi saitjain kaba hynriew phad sngi bad phin aiti ia ka jingainguh bam kaba thymmai ha U Trai .

en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :
kha: Hynrei lada u paidbah u leh bymsuidñiew ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki briew jong ka ri ki leh ei ei na uta u briew haba u ai ia u symbai jong u ha u Molek bad um pyniap ia u:

en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .
kha: Kata ka briew ka leit sha u syiem , ka dem ngon haduh khyndew ha ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong ,  Ïarap ïa nga , ko Syiem Kynrad !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka kynthei Tekah ka la kren ha u syiem, ka la dem khrup ha khyndew bad ka la kohnguh bad ka la ong: Iarap ko syiem .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki thliew , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don hangno hangno ban thiah bad pynjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u: Ki khnai ki don ki thliew bad ki sim Iyer ki don ki bniat hynrei U Khun u briew um don jaka ban buh ia la ka khlieh .

en: Then saith he to the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it forth  ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang ,  To kner shabar ïa la ka kti .  U la kner shabar ïa ka bad ka la kylla bha pat , kumba long kata kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ia uta u briew, Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me . Bad u la pynkhih ia ka; bad la pynphai biang ia ka baroh kawei .

en: Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?
kha: Kumta te , balei mynta phi kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaba buh ka jingkit halor ki met jong ki parabangeit ïa kaba ym don ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lymne ma ngi hi kiba lah ban kit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata balei phi pynshoi ia U Blei , ban buh ia ka jingkit ha ka ryndang jong ki synran , kaba ym ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ne ngi kim lah ban shah ?

en: Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .
kha: Bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la don ka khubor , kynthup ïa u Samuel bad kito kiba mih hadien jong u , ki la pynbna ruh ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kine ki sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh na u Samuel bad kito kiba hadien , kumba ki la kren , ki la iathuhlypa kumjuh ia kine ki sngi .

en: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .
kha: bad U Blei u ïakynduh ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Nga la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad nga la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la iakynduh ia u Balaam : bad u la ong ha u, Nga la pynkhreh hynriew tylli ki almari bad nga la tyrwa halor kawei pa kawei ka almari ia u masi bad u langbrot .

en: And he said , This will I do : I will pull down my barns , and build greater  ; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ,’ u la ong ha lade ; ‘ ngan pynpra ïa ki thiar jong nga bad shna ïa kiba kham heh , ha kaba ngan kynshew ïa u kew jong nga bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki mar jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Kane ngan leh: Ngan pynhiar ia ki phyllaw jong nga, bad ngan tei kham heh shuh shuh bad hangta ngan ai lut ia ki soh bad ki mar jong nga baroh .

en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hadien sawphew snem ngan wallam pat ïa ki nong Ijipt na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Ha kaba kut jong ki sawphew snem ngan lum ia ki nong Ijipt na ki briew ha kaba ki la shah pynpra:

en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Haba uno uno u kyllon , hato un ym ïeng pat ? Lada uno uno u bakla lynti , hato un ym wan phai pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me dei ban ong ha ki, Kumta u Trai u ong: Hato kin hap , bad kin ym mih ? un phai noh bad un ym wan phai ?

en: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .
kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob ,  Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai khyndiat ba ngan dih ïa kato ka syrwa saw .  ( Dei namar kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la ong ha u Jakob, To ai bam ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, da kata kajuh ka khiew kaba saw namar nga la lyngngoh: namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u;

en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod , ( when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him , ) and fought against Ashdod , and took it  ;
kha: Ha ki hukum jong u Sargon , u patsha jong ka Assyria , u rangbah ai hukum bahakhlieh tam jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashdod ka nongbah Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem ba u Tartan u la wan sha Ashdod (ha ka por ba u Sargon u syiem Assyria u la phah ia u), bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Ashdod bad u la shim ia ka;

en: Then came one and told them , saying , Behold , the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple , and teaching the people .
kha: Nangta uwei u briew u la wan rung shapoh bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ! Ki briew kiba phi la buh ha byndi ki don ha ka Templ , ki da hikai ïa ki paidbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei u la wan bad u la iathuh ha ki da kaba ong: Ha khmih ki briew kiba phi la set phatok ki ieng ha ka tempi bad ki hikai ia ki briew .

en: And Ahaz slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Ahas u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Hesekaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahas u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid: bad u Hesekaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Keep ye judgment , and do justice : for my salvation is near to come , and my righteousness to be revealed .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba dei , naba shen ngan pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , To bishar ia ka jingbishar bad leh ia ka hok: namar ka jingpynim jong nga ka la jan wan , bad ka hok jong nga kan sa paw .

en: But that it spread no further among the people , let us straitly threaten them , that they speak henceforth to no man in this name .
kha: Hynrei ban khanglad ïa kane ban phriang shuh shuh hapdeng ki briew , to ngin maham ïa kine ki briew ban ym kren da lei lei shuh hano hano ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba kan ym saphriang shuh hapdeng ki briew , to ngin byrngem jur ia ki , ba kin kren nangne shakhmat ia uno uno u briew ha kane ka kyrteng .

en: Therefore Saul said unto the  Lord  God of Israel , Give a perfect lot . And Saul and Jonathan were taken : but the people escaped .
kha: U Saul u ong ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ,  A  Trai  , balei mem shym jubab ïa nga mynta ka sngi ? Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel to jubab ïa nga da ki mawkyntang   . Lada ka dei ka pop jong u Jonathan ne ka jong nga , to jubab da u Urim ; hynrei lada ka dei ka jong ki Israel ki briew jong me , jubab da u Thummim .  Ka jubab ka kdew ïa u Jonathan bad u Saul ; bad u paidbah u lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Saul u la ong ha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, To ai shibun eh . Bad u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la shah shim: hynrei ki briew ki la lait im .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Elah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Elah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;
kha: U Darius u nong Mid , uba long u khun jong u Serksis , u la synshar ïa ka hima Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Darius u khun u Ahasuerus , na u symbai jong ki Media , uba la long syiem halor ka hima jong ki Khaldes;

en: Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire  ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof .
kha: Ym dei ban bam im ne phon ïa ka , hynrei bam ïa ka da kaba shu syang tylli kynthup ïa ka khlieh , ki kjat bad ki doh jem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam ia ka kaba thymmai, lane kaba la khleh lang bad ka um, hynrei ka thang da ka ding; ka khlieh jong u bad ki kjat jong u, bad da ka jingkhuid jong ka .

en: And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .
kha: Haba ki la dep na kaba rkhiebeiñ ïa u , ki la law noh ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh bad ki la pynkup pat halor jong u da ki jaiñ jong u hi . Nangta ki ïalam noh ïa u ban sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rkhie bein ia u, ki la weng noh ia ka rong saw na u, bad ki la phong ia la ki jong ki jain ha u , bad ki la ialam ia u ban sahnarphna ia u .

en: And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  na ka jinglute kaba ki la wanrah biang : hynñiewspah tylli ki khlieh jong ki masi bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tyrwa ha U Trai ha kajuh ka por, na ka jinglute kaba ki la wanrah, hynriew spah tylli ki masi bad hynriew hajar tylli ki langbrot .

en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .
kha: Pyndonkam da ki ktien kiba shongnia ïa kiba yn ym don ba wad daw , khnang ba yn ïoh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba sniew ban ïoh kren pyrshah shaphang jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkren kaba sngewsih , kaba ym lah ban pynrem ia u; ba uta uba pyrshah u lah ban sngewlehrain , khlem da don ei ei kaba sniew ban ong shaphang jong phi .

en: And to pass by you into Macedonia , and to come again out of Macedonia unto you , and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea .
kha: Naba nga la thmu ban wan jngoh ïa phi ha ka lynti jong nga sha Makedonia bad kumjuh ynda nga wan phai , khnang ban ïoh jingïarap lem na phi na ka bynta ka jingleit jong nga sha Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban iaid lyngba jong phi sha Makedonia bad ban wan phai biang na Makedonia sha phi bad na phi ban wanrah ia nga sha Judaea .

en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ,  yn plie ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi kan don ka pung kaba plie ia ka iing u Dabid bad ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem na ka bynta ka pop bad na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid .

en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market : and thou wast replenished , and made very glorious in the midst of the seas .
kha: Ïa ki mar khaïi jong pha la pynkit ha ki kynhun liengbah kit mar baheh tam .  Pha long kum ka liengbah ha duriaw ba la pynkit da ki jingkit bakhia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lieng jong u Tarshish ki la rwai ia me ha ka iew jong me: bad me la pynkhuid ia me, bad me la pynlong ia me uba donburom shibun hapdeng ki duriaw .

en: Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Philistia bad ki Arab ki shong ki sah hajan ka jaka ha kaba katto katne ngut ki nong Sudan ki la shongduh harud ka duriaw . U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Jehoram .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata U Trai u la pynkhih pyrshah ia ka mynsiem jong ki Philistia bad jong ki Arab kiba don hajan ki nong Asia:

en: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword : she is delivered to the sword : draw her and all her multitudes .
kha: Ki briew ka Ijipt kin kyllon lang bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynïap lut ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin hap hapdeng jong ki kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam: la aiti ia ka ha ka waitlam: ring ia ka bad ki paidbah jong ka baroh .

en: With Onesimus , a faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They shall make known unto you all things which are done here .
kha: Lem bad u , u wan u Onesimos , uta u para ba-ieit bad uba lah ban shaniah , uba dei na ka kynhun jong phi . Kin ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba la jia hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u Onesimus, u hynmen uba iaineh bad uba ieit eh, uba long uwei na phi . Kin sa pyntip ha phi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh hangne .

en: But your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , them will I bring in , and they shall know the land which ye have despised .
kha: Phi ong ba ki khun ki kti jong phi kin shah kem , hynrei ngan wallam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba phi , phi la kyntait , bad kan long ka jaka shong jaka sah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun rit jong phi kiba phi ong ba kin long ki mrad ba la bam , ngan wanrah ia ki , bad kin sa tip ia ka ri kaba phi la lehbein .

en: And Saul gathered the people together , and numbered them in Telaim , two hundred thousand footmen , and ten thousand men of Judah .
kha: U Saul u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u bad u peit bniah ïa ki ha Telem : la don ar lakh ngut ki shipai na Israel bad shiphew hajar ngut na Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la lum lang ia ki briew ha Telaim, arspah hajar ngut ki nonglehkai kjat bad shi hajar ngut ki briew na Judah .

en: That I may see the good of thy chosen , that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation , that I may glory with thine inheritance .
kha: Ai ba ngan ïohi ïa ka jingroi jingpar ki briew jong me bad ïadon bynta ha ka jingkmen jong ka jaitbynriew jong me , ha ka jingsarong bakmen jong kito kiba long ki jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan iohi ia ka jingbha jong me ba la jied jong me, ba ngan sngewbha ha ka jingkmen jong ka jaitbynriew jong me, ba ngan sngew sarong da ka pateng jong me .

en: Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .
kha: Ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ki la ïawan sha khmat , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban pule ïa ka jingthoh lane ïathuh ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan rung ki riewstad jong u syiem baroh: hynrei kim lah ban pule ia ka jingthoh , lymne ban pyntip ha u syiem ia ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;
kha: Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym kren shaphang kata hano hano ruh ; hynrei katba u nang hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh , katta ki nang ïathuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh ia ki ba kim dei ban iathuh iano iano ruh: hynrei katba u nang kynnoh ia ki, katta katta ki nang pynmih ia ka;

en: And when the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , loosing thence , they sailed close by Crete .
kha: Ka lyer kaba jai jai na shathie ka la sdang ban beh , bad ki rangbah ki la pyrkhat ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , kumta ki la ïaring noh ïa u angkor bad ki la king kham jan katba lah marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw jong ka Krit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka Iyer kaba shathie ka la beh jem, da kaba shim ba ki la ioh ia ka jingthmu jong ki, da kaba jah noh nangta, ki la iaid hajan Crete .

en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne , saying , Amen  ; Alleluia .
kha: Ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang bad ki saw tylli ki kherub ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , uba la shong ha ka khet . Ki la ong ,  Amen ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arphew ngut ki rangbah bad ki saw tylli ki mrad ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ia U Blei uba shong ha ka khet, ki da ong: Amen ; Aleluia .

en: Woe unto the world because of offences ! for it must needs be that offences come  ; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh !
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ïa ka pyrthei ha kaba don kiei kiei kiba pynlong ïa ki briew ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ! Kiba kum kine kiei kiei kin ïai jia — hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba pynjia ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ka pyrthei namar ki jingleh bymman ! namar ka dei ban long ba ki jingleh bymman ki wan ; hynrei sngewsih ia uta u briew da uba ka jingleh bymman ka wan !

en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
kha: Nga la khmih ïa kiwei pat ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Nga la shem uwei u briew na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah ban burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ka mynsiem jong nga ka wad, hynrei ngam lap: uwei u briew napdeng ka hajar nga la shem ; hynrei ka kynthei napdeng kita baroh ngam shym la shem .

en: The  Lord  said moreover unto me  ; Son of man , wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah ? yea , declare unto them their abominations  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , hato me la kloi ban bishar ïa ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ? Pynrem ïa ki namar kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong shuh shuh ha nga; ko khun u briew, hato me bishar ia u Aholah bad u Aholibah ? Hooid , pynbna ha ki ia ki jingsngewsih jong ki;

en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom , and the  Lord  his God was with him , and magnified him exceedingly .
kha: U Solomon u khun jong u syiem Dabid u la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima Israel , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa u bad pynlong ïa u uba khlaiñbor shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u khun u Dabid u la nang khlain ha ka hima jong u, bad U Trai U Blei jong u u la don ryngkat bad u, bad u la pynkhraw ia u haduh katta katta .

en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .
kha: Hynrei wat la ka jinglong ka met jong nga ka la long ka jingtynjuh bakhraw ïa phi , phim shym la ibeiñ ne kyntait ïa nga . Pynban phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa u angel na bneng ; phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpynshoi jong nga kaba la don ha ka doh jong nga phim shym la lehbein, lymne phim shym la kyntait ; hynrei phi la pdiang ia nga kum u angel U Blei, wat kum U Khrist Jisu .

en: But when the Pharisees saw it , they said unto him , Behold , thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day .
kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohi ïa kane , ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ha khmih , ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Aiñ jong ngi na ka bynta ki synran jong me ban leh ïa kane ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Pharisi ki la iohi ia kata, ki la ong ha u: Ha khmih ki synran jong me ki leh ia kata kaba ym dei ban leh ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi , he asked his disciples , saying ,  Whom do men say that I the Son of man am ?
kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka thain hajan ka shnong Kaisaria Philippi , ha kaba u la kylli ïa la ki synran ,  Ki briew ki ong ba U Khun U Briew u long uei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan ha ki rud duriaw jong ka ri Asia , u la kylli ia ki synran jong u da kaba ong: Mano ba ki briew ki ong ba nga long U Khun u briew ?

en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain , and to no purpose : therefore have I cried concerning this , Their strength is to sit still .
kha: Ka jingïarap kaba ka Ijipt ka ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta nga la khot-sin ïa ka Ijipt , ‘ U Ïakjakor bym lah pynmynsaw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki nong Ijipt kin iarap khlem jingthmu: namarkata nga la pyrta shaphang kane , Ka bor jong ki ka long ban shongthait .

en: And they that went before , and they that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna  ; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord :
kha: Ki briew kiba don ha khmat bad kito kiba bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba la leit sha khmat , bad kiba bud ki la pyrta, ki la pyrta, ki da ong: Hosanna; La kyrkhu ia uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai:

en: Lest I be full , and deny thee , and say , Who is the  Lord  ? or lest I be poor , and steal , and take the name of my God in vain .
kha: Lada nga ïoh palat , nga lah ban ong ba ngam donkam ïa me . Hynrei lada nga kyrduh pat , nga lah ban tuh bad pynjahburom ïa U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la dap , bad nga la kyntait ia me bad nga la ong , Uei U Trai ? lane lym kumta nga la duk bad nga la tuh bad nga la shim ia ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga khlem da don ei ei .

en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you , and ye shall carry up my bones from hence .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ïa la ki briew ban smai .  Kular ïa nga ,  u ong ,  ba ynda U Blei u ïalam noh ïa phi sha kata ka ri , phin rah lang ïa ka met jong nga nangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la smai ia ki khun Israel, u da ong: U Blei un leit jngoh ia phi, bad phin rah ia ki shyieng jong nga naduh hangta .

en: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka ba ka ïam , bad u la ïohi kumno ba ki briew kiba la ïadon lem bad ka , ki ruh ki la ïa-ïam ; ka la ktah ïa ka dohnud jong u , bad la pynkhih jur ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohi ia ka ba ka iam bad ki Jiw ruh ki iam kiba wan ryngkat bad ka , u la ud ha ka mynsiem bad u la sngewsih .

en: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .
kha: Lada ngi kohnguh hok ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un sngewbha ïa ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka hok jong ngi lada ngi peit ban leh ia kine ki hukum baroh ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong ngi kumba u la hukum ia ngi .

en: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
kha: Hynrei haba ki la ithuh ba u dei u Jiw , ki la ïa-pyrta lang ïa kajuh haduh ar kynta :  Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la tip ba u long u Jiw, baroh da kawei ka sur shaphang ka jaka kaba ar kynta ki la pyrta , Ka long kaba khraw ka Diana jong ki nong Ephesia .

en: And it came to pass , that at even the quails came up , and covered the camp : and in the morning the dew lay round about the host .
kha: Ha ka por janmiet , shi kynhun bah ki  iar khlaw ki la wan her , kat ban dap ïa ka jaka sher dara , bad ha ka por mynstep la don ka umjer ha kylleng ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , ba ha ka por ba ki quail ki la wan shaneng, bad ki la tap ia ka shnong : bad ha ka por mynstep ka dew ka la thiah sawdong ia u nongpdiang .

en: Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?
kha: Nga isih ïa u masi ksiar ba mane da ki briew jong ka nongbah Samaria . Nga bitar lep ïa ki . Sa katno kan shim por shuwa ba kin sangeh noh na kaba mane bleithaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun masi jong me, ko Samaria, ka la bret noh ia me ; ka jingbitar jong nga ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki: katno por kan long shuwa ba kin poi sha ka jingbym don pop ?

en: And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
kha: Haba ka la poi ha ïing , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka ,  Ka long kumno , ko khun kynthei jong nga ?  Ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynta jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la wan sha ka kmie tymmen jong ka, ka la ong, Me long mano, ko khun jong nga? Bad ka la iathuh ia ka baroh kaba uta u briew u la leh ia ka .

en: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton halor jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, "To lum ia ki maw ; bad ki la shim maw bad ki la shna ia ka kynhun: bad ki la bam hangta halor ka kynhun .

en: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat , Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships . But Jehoshaphat would not .
kha: Nangta u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel u tyrwa ban shah ïa ki maji jong u ba kin leit bad ki maji u Jehoshaphat , hynrei u Jehoshaphat u la kyntait ïa ka jingtyrwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ahasaiah u khun u Ahab ha Jehoshaphat u la ong: To ai ba ki shakri jong nga kin leit bad ki shakri jong me ha ki lieng . Hynrei u Jehoshaphat un ym leh kumta .

en: That they may walk in my statutes , and keep mine ordinances , and do them : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God .
kha: Te kin sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kin kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum jong nga . Kin long ki briew jong nga bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin iaid ha ki ain jong nga, bad kin sumar ia ki jinglong jong nga: bad kin long ki briew jong nga, bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

en: They shall put you out of the synagogues : yea , the time cometh , that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service .
kha: Phin shah beh noh na ki synagog , bad ka por kan poi haba uno uno uba pynïap ïa phi un pyrkhat ba da kaba leh kumta u shakri ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin bret noh ia phi na ki synagog: Hooid, ka por ka wan, ba uno uno uba pyniap phin pyrkhat ba u leh ia ka jingshakri ia U Blei .

en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men : they make broad their phylacteries , and enlarge the borders of their garments ,
kha: Ki leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki . Peit ïa ki jingteh  sai snieh kiba don ki jingthoh bakhuid ïa kiba ki teh ha ki shyllangmat bad ki ksang ti jong ki , bad khmih haduh katno ki long kiba heh ! Khmih ruh katno kiba jrong ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki jaiñkup jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki kam jong ki baroh ki leh na ka bynta ban shah iohi ha ki briew: ki pynlong ia ki jingkren lyngkot jong ki , bad ki pynheh ia ki pud jong ki jain jong ki , .

en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin sngewkhuslai wat hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin set ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin iohi bad kin sngewlehrain ha ka bor jong ki baroh: kin buh ia la ka kti halor ka shyntur jong ki , ki shkor jong ki kin long kiba sngap jar .

en: Which stood only in meats and drinks , and divers washings , and carnal ordinances , imposed on them until the time of reformation .
kha: namar ba ki ïadei tang bad ka jingbam , ka jingdih bad ki niam ki rukom pynkhuid babun jait . Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ kiba tang shabar , kiba ïadei tang haduh ka por ba U Blei un seng nongrim da kaei kaba thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ieng tang ha ki doh bad ki jingdih, bad ki jingsait um, bad ki jingpynbeit met , kiba la pynjari ha ki haduh ka por jong ka jingpynkylla .

en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .
kha: U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong u kum u Nongïalam bad u Nongpynim , ban ai ha ki paid Israel ka kabu ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkiew ia U Blei da ka kti kadiang jong u ban long u Syiem bad u Nongpynim , namar ban ai ka jingkylla kaba mut ia ki Israel bad ka jingmap ia ki pop .

en: That thou mayest bear thine own shame , and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done , in that thou art a comfort unto them .
kha: Phan sngewlehrain ïa lade bad ka jingjahburom jong pha kan pyn-i ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha haduh katno ki long kiba bit babiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban shah ia la ka jong ka jingsngewlehrain, bad to sngewlehrain ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me la leh, ha kaba me long ka jingpyntngen ia ki .

en: Unto you first God , having raised up his Son Jesus , sent him to bless you , in turning away every one of you from his iniquities .
kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la jied ïa la u Shakri bad u la phah ïa u nyngkong ha phi , ban kyrkhu ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi ban phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha phi nyngkong eh U Blei, haba u la pynmih ia la u Khun Jisu, u la phah ia u ban kyrkhu ia phi, ha kaba pynphai noh ia phi iwei ia iwei na ki jingbymhok jong u .

en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , ban bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u, Lada uno uno un wan hadien jong nga, to un kyntait ia lade bad un rah ia la ka diengphna bad un bud ia nga .

en: Moreover , brethren , I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you , which also ye have received , and wherein ye stand ;
kha: Bad mynta nga kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba nga la ïalap ha phi , ïa kaba phi la pdiang , bad ha kaba ka jingngeit jong phi ka ïeng skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ko para bangeit, nga pynbna ha phi ia ka gospel kaba nga la ialap ha phi, kaba phi ruh phi la pdiang, bad ha kaba phi ieng;

en: And they laid hands on her  ; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king s house : and there was she slain .
kha: Ki kem ïa ka , ki rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka Khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh kti ia ka ; bad ka la iaid lynti da kaba ki kulai ki la wan shapoh iing syiem: bad hangta ka la shah pyniap .

en: And they rose up the same hour , and returned to Jerusalem , and found the eleven gathered together , and them that were with them ,
kha: Ki la ïeng joit shisyndon bad ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem , ha kaba ki la shem ïa ki khatwei ngut ki synran kiba la ïalumlang bad kiwei pat kiba ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng ha kajuh ka kynta bad ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem bad ki la shem ia ki shiphew ngut kiba la ialum lang bad kito kiba don ryngkat bad ki .

en: Alas ! for that day is great , so that none is like it : it is even the time of Jacob s trouble  ; but he shall be saved out of it .
kha: Ka sngi kaba shyrkhei ka wan ; ym don kano kano kawei pat ka sngi kaba lah ban nujor bad ka — ka por ka jingnoh mynsiem na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , hynrei kin lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Alas ! namar kata ka sngi ka long kaba khraw , kumta ym don kawei ruh kaba kum kata: ka long wat ka por jong u Jakob ka jingshah pynshitom ; hynrei un sa lait na ka .

en: For thou hast made of a city an heap  ; of a defenced city a ruin : a palace of strangers to be no city  ; it shall never be built .
kha: Me la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynpra ïa ki jingtei-kut . Ki ïingsyiem kiba ki nongshun jong ngi ki la tei ki la jah noh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la pynlong ia ka nongbah ka jaka sah jong ka nongbah kaba la iada: ka iing jong ki nongwei ban ym long ka nongbah ; kan ym long satia .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jotham u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jotham bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: And caused me to pass by them round about : and , behold , there were very many in the open valley  ; and , lo , they were very dry .
kha: U la pynïaid ïa nga sawdong ka them , bad nga la ïohi ba la don shibun bah ki shyieng bad ki long kiba la tyrkhong bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynlong ia nga ban iaid lyngba jong ki sawdong: bad, ha khmih, ki la don shibun ha ka them kaba plie ; bad, ha khmih, ki la tyrkhong bha .

en: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
kha: Pyntreikam ïa kaei kaba phi la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong nga bad ki kam jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kita kiei kiei kiba phi la nang, bad kiba phi la iohsngew bad kiba phi la iohi ha nga, to leh: bad U Blei jong ka jingsuk un long bad phi .

en: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house : and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them .
kha: Nangta u Lebi u la pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ka ïing jong u na ka bynta U Jisu , bad napdeng kiba shah khot sngewbha la don bun ngut ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei de ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lebi u la leh ia u ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha la ka jong ka iing: bad ka la don ka kynhun kaba khraw jong ki paidbah bad kiwei pat kiba la shong bad ki .

en: Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning ? I the  Lord  , the first , and with the last  ; I am he .
kha: Mano dei uta ba pynlong ïa kane ban jia ? Uba la thmu skhem ïa ka jingïaid ka histori ? Nga , U  Trai  , nga la don hangta naduh mynnyngkong , bad nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai don hangta ha kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la leh bad leh ia kata, da kaba khot ia ki pateng naduh kaba sdang ? Nga U Trai, uba nyngkong, bad bad uba khatduh; Nga long ma nga .

en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , uba itynnat , da ka jingpyiar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlong ia u uba hok da ka jingbun ki tnat jong u: kumta ki dieng Eden baroh kiba don ha ka kper U Blei ki la sngewsih ia u .

en: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .
kha: Ki la shakri kum ki nongbishar na ka bynta u paidbah ha ki por baroh , da kaba wallam ïa ki kam kiba eh sha u Moses hynrei ki bishar hi ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bishar ia ki briew ha ki aiom baroh: ki daw kiba eh kiba ki wanrah ha u Moses , hynrei kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba rit ki la bishar ia lade .

en: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus , I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar .
kha: Hynrei u Paul u la apil ; u la kyrpad ba yn buh ïa u hapoh u nongap phira bad ban shah ba u Patsha un rai ïa ka kam jong u . Kumta nga la ai ki hukum ban buh ïa u hapoh ka jingap phira tad haduh ba nga lah ban phah ïa u sha u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Paul u la kyrpad ban shah set ha ka jingbishar jong u Augus , nga la hukum ia u ban shah set haduh ba ngan da phah ia u sha Kaisar .

en: And had suffered many things of many physicians , and had spent all that she had , and was nothing bettered , but rather grew worse ,
kha: wat la ka la ïoh jingsumar na kiba bun ki nongsumar . Ka la pynlut ïa ka pisa jong ka baroh , hynrei ha ka jaka ba kan kham ïoh jingkhiah , ka la nang kham shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la shah shitom shibun kiei kiei jong kiba bun ki doktor , bad kam shym la pynlut lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don , bad kam shym la nang kham bha ei ei hynrei ka la nang kham sniew shuh shuh .

en: And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .
kha: Khreh la shai dang step , bad wan kiew ïa u Lum Sinai ban ïashem bad nga hangta ha kliar lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to long kiba la pynkhreh mynstep , bad to wan kiew mynstep sha u lum Sinai , bad to pyni ia lade hangta ha nga ha jrong jong u lum .

en: The  Lord  of hosts hath purposed it , to stain the pride of all glory , and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la thmu ïa kata . U la thmu ïa kata khnang ban pynkut noh ïa ka jingsarong jong ki ha kaei kaba ki la leh bad ban pynpoh ïa ki rangbah ïa kiba la ñiewburom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai jong ki paid u la thmu ia ka, ban pynsniew ia ka jingsarong jong ka burom baroh , bad ban wanrah ia ka burom jong ka khyndew baroh .

en: I also could speak as ye do : if your soul were in my soul s stead , I could heap up words against you , and shake mine head at you .
kha: Lada phi don ha ka jaka jong nga bad ma nga ha ka jaka jong phi , ngan lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi ong . Nga lah ban pynkhih ïa ka khlieh jong nga ha ka jingsian bad ngan pynïap jyllop ïa phi ha ka jingshlei jong ki ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh nga lah ban kren kumba phi leh: lada ka mynsiem jong phi ka don ha ka jaka jong nga, nga lah ban lum ia ki kyntien pyrshah ia phi, bad nga lah ban pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong nga ha phi .

en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon ?
kha: Ki rangbah na Siph ki wan sha u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u dang rieh ha u Lum Hakhilah ha tduh jong ka ri khlaw Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Sipai ki la wan sha u Saul ha Gibeah, ki da ong: Hato u Dabid um buhrieh ia lade ha u lum Hachilah uba don ha khmat u Jeshimon ?

en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi ai ïa kata ka song kew , kñia ruh kum ka jingainguh thang uwei u khunlangbrot u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin aiti ha kata ka sngi haba phi pynkhih ia u langbrot khlem jingduna jong ka snem kaba nyngkong na ka bynta ka jingknia thang sha U Trai .

en: Wherefore ? Because they sought it not by faith , but as it were by the works of the law . For they stumbled at that stumblingstone ;
kha: Bad balei kam shym la long kumta ? Namar kim shym la shaniah ha ka jingngeit hynrei ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Bad kumta ki la jynthut ha  U maw jong ka jingjynthut
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ? Namar kim shym la wad ia ka da ka jingngeit , hynrei kumba ka long da ki kam jong ka hukum . Namar ki la ia tyngkhuh bad uta u mawsiang;

en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .
kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong ,  Ma u da lade hi u la shim ïa ki jingshitom jong ngi bad u la bah noh ïa ki jingpang jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan long kaba la kren da u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa, da kaba ong , U hi u la shim ia ki jingduna jong ngi , bad u la kit ia ki jingpang jong ngi .

en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .
kha: U Moses u ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan paw ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Kane ka long kaba U Trai u la hukum ba phin leh: bad ka burom U Trai kan paw ha phi .

en: And what nation is there so great , that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law , which I set before you this day ?
kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don ki aiñ kiba hok kat kito kiba nga la hikai ïa phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw haduh katta katta , kaba don ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba hok kum kane ka hukum baroh kaba nga buh ha khmat jong phi mynta ka sngi ?

en: Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .
kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , bad u ïada ïa la ki jong . Kumta ngi dem ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , u la ieit ia ki briew ; ki riewkhuid jong u baroh ki don ha ka kti jong me: bad ki la shong ha ki kjat jong me ; uwei pa uwei un pdiang ia ki ktien jong me .

en: I had no rest in my spirit , because I found not Titus my brother : but taking my leave of them , I went from thence into Macedonia .
kha: Nam don jingsuk ha ka mynsiem , namar ngam shym ïashem ïa u para jong ngi , u Titos . Kumta nga la kren khatduh ïa ki briew hangto bad nga la leit noh sha Makedonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la shongthait ha ka mynsiem jong nga, namar ngam shym la shem ia u Titus u hynmen jong nga: hynrei haba nga la leit noh na ki, nga la leit noh nangta sha Makedonia .

en: And they shall call them , The holy people , The redeemed of the LORD : and thou shalt be called , Sought out , A city not forsaken .
kha: Bad kin khot ia ki ki briew bakhuid , Kiba la siewspah da U Trai : bad ia me yn khot , Ba la wad , Ka nongbah bym shym la iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin khot ia ki , Ki briew kiba khuid , kiba la shah pyllait im na U Trai: bad ia me yn khot: La khot ia me: Ka shnong kaba ym shah iehnoh .

en: Then the chief captain took him by the hand , and went with him aside privately , and asked him , What is that thou hast to tell me ?
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shim ïa u na ka kti , u la ïalam ïa u da lade hi , bad u la kylli ,  Kaei me don ban ïathuh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah u la shim ia u da ka kti bad u la leit noh bad u shawei bad u la kylli ia u: Kaei kata kaba phi dei ban iathuh ia nga ?

en: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do ? he will come and destroy the husbandmen , and will give the vineyard unto others .
kha: Kaei te , kaba uta u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ?  la kylli U Jisu .  Un sa wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki briew bad ai noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong ka kper sohjew un leh aiu ? un wan pynjot ia ki nongrep bad un ai ia ka kper sohjew sha kiwei pat .

en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?
kha: Ka la jan dap artat san baje haba u la leit sha ka jaka ïew bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba phi pynsep-ei ïa ka sngi baroh kawei hangne khlem kam ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba shiphew kynta u la mih noh, bad u la shem ia kiwei pat kiba ieng khlem sangeh, bad u la ong ha ki, Balei phi ieng hangne baroh shisngi ?

en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead : and calling unto him the centurion , he asked him whether he had been any while dead .
kha: U Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la lah ïap . U la khot ïa u rangbah shipai bad u la kylli ïa u la U Jisu u la lah ïap la slem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la lyngngoh lada u la dep iap: bad u la khot ia u ha u rangbah shipai , u la kylli ia u la u la iap katto katne por .

en: ( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )
kha: Naba da ka bor U Blei la pynlong ïa nga u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kumba ïa u Petros la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta uta uba la leh ha u Petros ha ka jinglong apostol jong ka jingotsher, kumjuh ruh u la long uba donbor ha nga sha ki Jutang: )

en: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws , and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk , and the work that they must do .
kha: Phi dei ban hikai ïa ki shaphang ki hukum jong U Blei bad batai ïa ki kumno ki dei ban im bad aïu ki dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban hikai ia ki ia ki kyndon bad ki ain , bad me dei ban pyni ia ki ia ka lynti ha kaba ki dei ban iaid bad ka kam kaba ki dei ban leh .

en: Remember , O  Lord  , the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem  ; who said , Rase it , rase it , even to the foundation thereof .
kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , kaei kaba ki Edom ki la leh ha ka sngi ba kurup ïa ka Jerusalem . To kynmaw kumno ki ïai-ong ,  To pynjot thiaw ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ko Trai , ki khun u Edom ha ka sngi Jerusalem ; kiba la ong , Pynduh ia ka , bata ia ka , wat haduh ka nongrim jong ka .

en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
kha: Naba nga ong ïa phi ba ka jingim jong ka jingshakri U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïaineh , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jong u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban urlong shisha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga ong ba U Jisu Khrist u long u nongshakri jong ka jingotsher na ka bynta ka jingshisha U Blei , ban pynskhem ia ki jingkular ba la leh ha ki kpa tymmen:

en: And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .
kha: Kumta u kynrad u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Khie leit sha ki lynti bah ha rudnong bad sha ki lynti khim bad ïawer ïa ki briew ban wan shapoh khnang ba ka ïing jong nga kan dap .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad u la ong ha uta u shakri, To leit sha ki surok bah bad ki jingkhang bad pynbor ia ki ban wan rung, ba ka iing jong nga kan dap .

en: And the  Lord  said , Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles , whither I will drive them .
kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Kane ka long kum ka dak ba ki Israel ki hap ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ka Aiñ ka khang , haba ngan pynsakma ïa ki sha ki ri nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Kumta ruh ki khun Israel kin bam ia u kpu ba la pynjakhlia jong ki hapdeng ki Jutang , ha kaba ngan beh noh ia ki .

en: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .
kha: Kum ïa ki shiah kiba la thain bad ïa u phlangïap ba-tyrkhong , ïa phi ki nongbuaid yn thang duh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba ki dang ia tyngkhuh kum ki khniang , bad katba ki dang dih kyiad kum ki nongdih kyiad , kin sa shah bam kum ki khniang kiba rkhiang pura .

en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .
kha: Ki da sngewsih kthang eh namar u la lah ong ba kin ym ïohi shuh ïa u . Bad kumta ki la ïaleit bad u sha ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba sngewsih khamtam eh na ka bynta ki ktien kiba u kren , ba kin ym iohi shuh ia ka khmat jong u . Ki la iadon ryngkat bad u haduh ka lieng .

en: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .
kha: Kine hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Bilhah, kiba u Laban u la ai ha ka Rakhel jong u, bad ka la kha ia kine ha u Jakob: baroh ki mynsiem ki long hynriew ngut .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Nadab u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Nadab bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers  sakes .
kha: Namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka Khubor Babha , ki Jiw ki long ki nongshun jong U Blei na ka bynta jong phi ki Jentil . Hynrei namar ka jingjied U Blei , ki long ki paralok jong u namar ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka gospel , ki long ki nongshun na ka bynta jong phi: hynrei katba ia ka elekshon , la ieit ia ki na ka bynta ki kpa .

en: Flee fornication . Every sin that a man doeth is without the body ; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body .
kha: To kiar na ka jingleh awria . Kano kano kawei pat ka pop kaba u briew u leh kam ktah ïa ka met jong u ; hynrei u briew uba leh awria u leh pop ïa kata ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleh be-ijot . Ka pop baroh kaba u briew u leh ka long khlem ka met ; hynrei uta uba leh be-ijot u leh pop pyrshah ia la ka jong ka met .

en: And said unto him , Behold , thou art old , and thy sons walk not in thy ways : now make us a king to judge us like all the nations .
kha: bad ki ong ha u ,  Peit , phi te mynta phi la tymmen , bad ki khun jong phi kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi . Kumta , thung noh da u syiem ban synshar halor jong ngi , ba kumta ngin don noh la u Syiem kumba kiwei pat ki ri ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih me la tymmen bad ki khun jong me kim iaid ha ki lynti jong me: mynta to pynlong ia ngi u syiem ban bishar ia ngi kum ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: Fury is not in me : who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle ? I would go through them , I would burn them together .
kha: Ngam bitar shuh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ . Tang lada ki don ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban hap ban ïakhun pyrshah , te ngan thang ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Fury kam don ha nga: mano ban buh ia ki bniat bad ki thliew pyrshah ia nga ha ka thma ? Nga la iaid lyngba ia ki , ngan thang lang ia ki .

en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath , of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span .
kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Goliath , uba na ka shnong Gath , u wan mih na ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ban kob ïa ki Israel . U jrong kumba lai mitar
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la mih u nongjop na ka kynhun jong ki Philistia , uba kyrteng u Goliath , na Gath , uba ka jingjrong jong u ka long hynriew cubit bad ka span .

en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynrang yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki samla jong ka kin hap ha ki lynti jong ka , bad ki shipai baroh kin shah ot noh ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and forgat the  Lord  their God , and served Baalim and the groves .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa u bad mane ïa ki bleithaw Baal bad Asherah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad ki la klet noh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki , bad ki la shakri ia u Baal bad ki khlaw .

en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth , and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way .
kha: U pynlong kiba bieit ïa ki nongïalam jong ki bad u shah ba kin shang kylleng ha ka jingkulmar bad jah lynti ;
translated_en_to_kha: U weng noh ia ka dohnud jong u rangbah jong ka khyndew , bad u pynlong ia ki ban iaid kai ha ka ri khlaw ha kaba ym don lad shuh .

en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
kha: Kumta to kieng mynta ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phin lah ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki bor ïaleh u nongshun ; bad hadien ba ka jingïaleh ka la kut , phin dang ïeng skhem ha ka nongrim jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to shim ha phi ia ka jainkup baroh kawei jong U Blei, ba phin lah ban ieng ha ka sngi kaba sniew, bad haba phi la leh lut, ban ieng .

en: And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .
kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh khun synrap , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , ki ïakhih ïaksaid para ma ki ha ka kpoh jong ka . Ka ong ,  Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jia ha nga ?  Kumta ka la leit kylli na U  Trai  ban ïoh jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah ki la ialeh lang hapoh jong ka ; bad ka la ong , Lada ka long kumta , balei nga long kumta ? Bad ka la leit kylli ia U Trai .

en: Have I need of mad men , that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence ? shall this fellow come into my house ?
kha: Hato ngam shym la don lypa bun bah ki lamwir ? Balei phi wan ïalam sa uwei pat ban pynwit ïa nga da ki jingleh lamwir jong u hangne ha ka ïing jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga donkam ia ki briew kiba bieit , ba phi la wanrah ia une u paralok ban ialehkai ia u briew uba bieit ha khmat jong nga ? hato une u paralok un wan shapoh iing jong nga ?

en: And except those days should be shortened , there should no flesh be saved : but for the elect s sake those days shall be shortened .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la pynduna ïa ka jingbun ki sngi ; lada um shym la leh kumta , yn ym don mano mano ruh uba lah ban lait im . Na ka bynta ki briew jong u kiba u la jied , U Blei un pynduna ïa ki sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lait noh tang kita ki sngi, ym dei ban pynim ia ka doh: hynrei na ka bynta kiba la jied ia kita ki sngi yn pynlyngkot .

en: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
kha: Bad nangta u ong ,  Nga don hangne ka Kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shaphan u nongthoh u la pyni ia u syiem, u da ong: U Hilkiah u lyngdoh u la aiti ia nga ia ka kot . Bad u Shaphan u la pule ia ka ha khmat u syiem .

en: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon , nor burnt sacrifice , nor meat offering  ; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon .
kha: Wat thang halor jong ka ïa ka jingiwbih ba lah khang , ne ïa ka jingainguh thang da ki mrad ne ïa ka jingainguh bam , bad wat theh halor jong ka ïa ka jingainguh kaba da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban ai jingiwbih nabar ri halor kata, lane ka jingknia thang, ne ka jingainguh doh bad phim dei ban theh ia ka jingainguh dihsha halor kata .

en: And the people took their dough before it was leavened , their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders .
kha: Kumta ki paidbah ki pyndap ïa ki khiew shet jong ki da u kpu bakhlem thiat , ki song ïa ki ha ki jaiñ , bad ki bah ïa ki ha la ki tyrpeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la shim ia ka doh jong ki shuwa ba kan long kaba la khleh lang, ki kjat jong ki ki la shah teh ha ki jain jong ki ha ki tyrpeng jong ki .

en: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war , which were of the children of Dan , stood by the entering of the gate .
kha: Katba ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai na Dan , ki la khreh ban ïaleh thma , ki dang ïeng ha ka khyrdop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la thung da ki tiar ialeh jong ki, kiba long na ki khun shynrang ki la ieng hajan ka jingkhang .

en: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day , and fell down at the door of the man s house where her lord was , till it was light .
kha: Ynda ka la kynjat shai kata ka briew ka wan bad ka kyllon ha jingkhang ïing jong uta u tymmen , ha kaba u tnga jong ka u don . Ka dang don hangta hi haba ka la step ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka kynthei ka la wan ha ka por mynstep jong ka sngi , bad ka la hap ha ka jingkhang jong u briew ha kaba u kynrad jong ka u la don , haduh ba ka la shai .

en: And the rest , some on boards , and some on broken pieces of the ship . And so it came to pass , that they escaped all safe to land .
kha: bad kiba sah kin bud nadien , da kaba snoh ha ki lyntang lane ha kino kino ki lyngkhot kiba la pait jong ka lieng . Bad kane ka la long kumno ngi baroh ngi la lait im sha ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiba sah, katto katne ha ki lieng, bad katto katne ha ki bynta ba la tyrkhong jong ka lieng . Bad kumta ka la jia , ba ki la lait im baroh ban hiar .

en: Then were there brought unto him little children , that he should put his hands on them , and pray : and the disciples rebuked them .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khynnah sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki bad ba un duwai na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei ki synran ki la mai ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wanrah ia ki khynnah rit ha u, ba un buh ia ki kti jong u ha ki, bad u duwai: bad ki synran ki la kynthoh ia ki .

en: Then shall the righteous answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , and fed thee ? or thirsty , and gave thee drink ?
kha: Nangta kiba hok kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me thngan bad ba ngi bsa ïa me , lane ba me sliang bad ba ngi ai jingdih ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u hok un jubab ia u, u da ong, ko Trai, haba ngi la iohi ia me ba me la thngan bad ngi la ai bam ia me ?

en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .
kha: Hynrei lada uno uno na phi u duna ïa ka jingstad , u dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ïa ka ha u ; namar U Blei u ai kylluid bad ai ei ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno na phi u duna ka jingstad, to un pan na U Blei, uba ai ha ki briew baroh da kaba laitluid, bad u bym sngewthuh; bad yn ai ia u .

en: And as Esaias said before , Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed , we had been as Sodom , and been made like unto Gomorrha .
kha: Ka long kumba u Isaïah u la lah ong mynshuwa ,  Lada U Trai Badonbor Baroh um shym la ieh ïa ngi katto katne kiba hiarpateng , ngin jin da la long kum ka Sodom , ngin jin da la long kum ka Gomorrah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba u Isaiah u la ong mynshuwa , Lait noh tang u Trai u Saboth u la iehnoh ia ngi u symbai , ngi la long kum u Sodom bad la pynlong ia ngi kum u Gomorraha .

en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king , she came to the people into the house of the  Lord  :
kha: Haba ka Athalaïah ka ïohsngew ïa ka jingrisa jong ki paidbah ïa u syiem , ka la pynkloi sha ka Templ , ha kaba ki paidbah ki la ïalumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka Athaliah ka la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ki briew kiba mareh bad iaroh ia u syiem , ka la wan sha ki briew shapoh iing U Trai:

en: And the man Micah had an house of gods , and made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .
kha: Une u Mikah u don la ka ïing mane blei . U shna katto katne ki bleithaw bad ka ephod , bad u thung ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u kum u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u Micah u don ka iing blei, bad u la shna ia ka ephod bad ka teraphim bad u la pynkyntang ia uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u uba la long u lyngdoh jong u .

en: But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .
kha: Mynta to leit bad ai ïa kane ka khubor sha ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to leit noh ia ka lynti jong phi, to iathuh ha ki synran jong u bad u Petros ba u leit sha Galilaia: hangta phin sa iohi ia u kumba u la ong ha phi .

en: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord . So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God ; but with the flesh the law of sin .
kha: Ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba leh ïa kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ! Kane te , ka long ka jinglong jong nga : Da lade hi nga lah ban leh ïa ka hukum U Blei tang da ka jingmut jong nga , katba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong nga ka leh ïa hukum jong ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ainguh ia U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist jong ngi . Kumta da ka jingmut nga hi nga shakri ia ka hukum U Blei ; hynrei da ka doh ka hukum ka pop .

en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .
kha: Ym dei ban don mano mano ba ibeiñ ïa u , hynrei phi dei ban ïarap ïa u ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang ba un ïoh wan phai pat sha nga ; naba nga khmih lynti ba un wan phai ryngkat bad ki parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un leh bein ia u: hynrei to ialam ia u ha ka jingsuk, ba un wan sha nga: namar nga wad ia u bad ki hynmen .

en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people , and laid before their faces all these words which the  Lord  commanded him .
kha: Kumta u Moses u wan hiar bad u la khot lang ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wan bad u la khot ia ki rangbah jong ki briew , bad u la buh ha khmat jong ki ia kine ki ktien baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u .

en: So we can be sure that both Jehovah and Jesus want to help us to enjoy a happy future ! —Psalm 72 :12-14  ; 145 :16  ; 2 Peter 3 :9 .
kha: Namar kata ngi lah ban sngew thikna ba baroh ar ngut u Jehobah bad u Jisu ki kwah ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïoh ïa ka lawei kaba suk ba kmen .—Salm 72 :12-14 ; 145 :16 ; 2 Petros 3 :9 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba baroh arngut u Jehobah bad U Jisu ki kwah ban iarap ia ngi ban ioh ia ka lawei kaba suk !  Isaiah 72:12-14 ; 145:126 ; 2 Petros 3:9.

en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .
kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan ; bad baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap ka long laiphew cubit, bad saw cubit ka long ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap: ki shiphew tylli ki jingtap ki long kiba heh .

en: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea ,  Peace , be still .  And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .
kha: U Jisu u la ïeng bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer ,  Long jai jai !  bad u la ong ïa ki jingat phyllung ,  Long jai jai !  Ka lyer ka la kynjah jar bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la pynrem ia ka Iyer bad u la ong ha ka duriaw, Ka jingsuk, to sah . Bad ka Iyer ka la sangeh noh bad ka la don ka jingsuk kaba khraw .

en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?
kha: Me la ïohsngew kaei ba u patsha Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato me pyrkhat ba men lait im ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me la iohsngew ia kaei kaba ki syiem Assyria ki la leh ha ki ri baroh da kaba pynjot lut ia ki ; bad me shah pyllait im ?

en: But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , but in his own country , and among his own kin , and in his own house .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang ha la ka shnong bad da ki ba-ha-ïing bad ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki, U nongiathuhlypa um long uba khlem burom, hynrei ha la ka jong ka ri bad hapdeng la ka jong ka iing .

en: Gaius mine host , and of the whole church , saluteth you . Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you , and Quartus a brother .
kha: U Gaïos , uba ai jaka sah ïa nga , uba ha ka ïing jong u ka balang ka ïaseng , u phah ïa phi ki jingai khublei ; u Erastos , u nongsumar ïa ki jingkynshew ha ka nongbah , bad u Kuartos , u parabangeit jong ngi , ki phah ïa ki jingkhublei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gious u nongpdiang sngewbha jong nga, bad jong ka balang baroh kawei, u ai khublei ia phi . Ka jingpynkylla ia ka kamra jong ka nongbah ka ai khublei ia phi, bad u Quartus u hynmen .

en: And when they were come to Capernaum , they that received tribute money came to Peter , and said , Doth not your master pay tribute ?
kha: Haba U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la wan sha Kapernam , ki nonglum ïa ka khajna Templ ki la wan ha u Petros bad ki la kylli ,  Hato u Nonghikai jong phi u siew ïa ka khajna Templ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha Kapernam , kita kiba la ioh khajna ki la wan sha u Petros bad ki la ong: Hato u kynrad jong phi um siew khajna ?

en: And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .
kha: U phai sha uwei pat u rangbah bad u kylli ïa u ïa kajuh ka jingkylli , bad man ba u kylli , u ïoh ïa kajuh ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai noh na u sha kawei pat ka rukom: bad ki briew ki la jubab biang ia u katkum ka rukom kaba mynshuwa .

en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .
kha: Kumta u Jakob u mihnoh , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , bad hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Isaak u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la leit noh bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u don, bad u la wan sha Beersheba bad u la ainguh ia U Blei jong u kpa jong u u Isaak .

en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,  A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong bad u la ong ha ki synran jong u , Katno tang kito kiba don ka spah kin rung sha ka hima U Blei !

en: So when they were dismissed , they came to Antioch : and when they had gathered the multitude together , they delivered the epistle :
kha: La phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki la leit sha Antiokh , ha kaba ki la lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh jong ki parabangeit bad ki la ai ha ki ïa ka shithi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba la beh noh ia ki , ki la poi ha Antiok : bad haba ki la lum lang ia u paidbah , ki la pynpoi ia ka epistle:

en: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning  ; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire .
