kha: Phim dei ban pynsah ei ei haduh mynstep ; lada don kaba sah , dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym iehnoh ei ei na ka haduh ka por mynstep bad ia kaba sah na ka haduh ka por mynstep phin thang da ka ding .

en: But if not , be it known unto thee , O king , that we will not serve thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
kha: Hynrei wat lada um leh , to u Syiem Kynrad un tip skhem ba ngin ym mane ïa u blei jong phi , bad ngin ym dem ngon sha ka durbriew ksiar kaba phi la phah pynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ym dei ban tip ha me ko syiem ba ngin ym shakri ia ki blei jong me , lymne ngin ym mane ia ka dur ksiar kaba me la buh .

en: And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .
kha: Baroh ki briew ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongbah ka kynjah , naba mynta la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh jong ka ri ki la ia risa , bad ka shnong ka la sngap jar: bad ki la pyniap ia u Athaliah da ka waitlam hajan ka iing syiem .

en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .
kha: Ngan pyllait ïa phi na kata baroh kaba pyntngit ïa phi . Ngan hukum ïa u kew ba un bun kyrhai , khnang ba phin ym mad shuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynim ruh ia phi na ki jingbymkhuid jong phi baroh: bad ngan khot ia u kew , bad ngan pynbun ia u , bad ngan ym buh ia ka jingkyrduh ha phi .

en: If you are able to spend more time or are limited to less time each week , the Witnesses will make themselves available to help you .
kha: Lada phi lah ban pyllut shibun ka por lane tang khyndiat por man ka taiew , ki wongsakhi ki lah ban pyllait ïalade ban ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi lah ban pynlut por kham bun ne kham duna ka por man la ka taiew , ki Nongsakhi kin pynlong ia lade ban iarap ia phi .

en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .
kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa phi , bad ong bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia phi, haba ki briew kin kren bein ia phi, bad kin pynshitom bein ia phi, bad kin kren bein ia phi baroh .

en: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent  ; for they shall march with an army , and come against her with axes , as hewers of wood .
kha: Ka Ijipt ka phet krad , ka pyrsad kum u bseiñ , katba ka kynhun shipai u nongshun ka wan tur . Ki tur ïaleh ïa ka da ki sdie , kum ki rangbah kiba pom ïa ki dieng bad kiba pynjot ïa ka khlaw barben .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong ka kan iaid kum ka waitlam kaba jem namar kin iaid ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai , bad kin wan pyrshah ia ka da ki ax , kum ki dieng .

en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , to bam khyndiat ka jingbam ; phi donkam ïa ka khnang ban im . Wat iwei i shñiuh na ka khlieh jong phi in ym hap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga kyrpad ia phi ban shim katto katne ka doh: namar kane ka long na ka bynta ka koit ka khiah jong phi: namar ym don u shniuh uba hap na ka khlieh jong uno uno na phi .

en: Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .
kha: U la thew ïa kane ka kamra bad u la lap ba ka jylliew saw mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tduh jong ka lynti rung kaba jan tam sha ka Templ bad sha bakut jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la thew ia ka phyllaw jong ka khyrdop, 8 cubit ; bad ki post jong ka, ar cubit ; bad ka phyllaw jong ka khyrdop ka la don shapoh .

en: Then shall ye return , and discern between the righteous and the wicked , between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not .
kha: Sa shisien pat ki briew jong nga kin ïohi ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba jia ïa kiba hok bad ïa ki bymman , ha u briew uba shakri ïa nga bad ha uta u bym leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin sa wan phai, bad phin sa ithuh hapdeng kiba hok bad kiba sniew, hapdeng uta uba shakri ia U Blei bad uta u bym shakri ia u .

en: So I turned and came down from the mount , and the mount burned with fire : and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands .
kha: Kumta nga la phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum , nga da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli , ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang . Ki thylliej ding ki dang meh ha uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la phai bad nga la wan hiar na u lum, bad u lum u la thang da ka ding: bad ki ar tylli ki miej jong ka jutang ki la don ha ki ar tylli ki kti jong nga .

en: Now the  Lord  had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah . And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights .
kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai ,  u dohkha uba heh u la nguid ïa u Jonah , bad u la don hapoh u dohkha lai sngi lai miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai u la pynkhreh ia ka dohkha kaba khraw ban dih ia u Jonah . Bad u Jonah u la don ha ka kpoh jong ki dohkha lai sngi bad lai miet .

en: For Joshua drew not his hand back , wherewith he stretched out the spear , until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai .
kha: U Joshua u rah ïa la u sum uba la kdew sha ka Ai bad um shym pynhiar ïa u tad haduh ba uwei pa uwei u briew hangta u la shah pynïap . Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ai kiba la shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi — khat-ar hajar ngut ki shynrang bad ki kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Joshua um shym la pynkhih ia la ka kti shadien, ha kaba u la pynkhih ia ka khnam haduh ba u la pynjot lut ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ai .

en: And the thing was known to Mordecai , who told it unto Esther the queen  ; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai s name .
kha: U Mordekai u tip shaphang kane bad u ïathuh ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ; kaba la ïathuh pat ïa u syiem ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u la shem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kata ka jingjia la tip da u Mordecai , uba la iathuh ha ka Esther ia ka mahadei ; bad ka Esther ka la pynskhem ia u syiem jong ka ha ka kyrteng jong u Mordecai .

en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel , saying , This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations .
kha: Ong ruh ha ki paid Israel , ‘ Kane ka dei ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang ïa kaba dei ban pyndonkam ha kaba shakri ïa nga ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Kane kan long ka umphniang kaba khuid ha nga ha ki pateng jong phi baroh .

en: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day s journey , and he cried , and said , Yet forty days , and Nineveh shall be overthrown .
kha: U Jonah u sdang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , bad hadien ba u la ïaid baroh shi sngi , u la pynbna ,  Hapoh sawphew sngi ïa ka Ninebeh yn sa pynjot !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonah u la sdang ban rung shapoh ka shnong shi sngi, bad u la pyrta bad u la ong: Hynrei sawphew sngi bad u Ninebe un sa shah pynhap noh .

en: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house : when I begin , I will also make an end .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba nga la kren pyrshah ïa ka ïing u Eli , naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan leh pyrshah ia u Eli ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la kren shaphang ka iing jong u: ynda nga sdang , ngan pynkut noh ruh .

en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .
kha: Kumta la wad ïa ka samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , bad ki lap ha Shunem ïa kaba kum kata ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Abishag , bad ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la wad ia ka dam kaba bha ha kylleng ki ri Israel , bad ki la shem ia ka Abishag ka Shunam , bad ki la wanrah ia ka sha u syiem .

en: Yet he sent prophets to them , to bring them again unto the  Lord   ; and they testified against them : but they would not give ear .
kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ban phai pat sha u , hynrei ki paidbah ki kyntait ban shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la phah ia ki nongiathuhlypa sha ki, ban wanrah biang ia ki sha U Trai ; bad ki la sakhi pyrshah ia ki: hynrei kim shym la ai shkor .

en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba wan hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad ka jingphyrnai jong u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kine kiei kiei nga la iohi ia uwei pat u angel uba wan hiar na bneng , uba don ka bor kaba khraw ; bad ka khyndew ka la shai da ka burom jong u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If my covenant be not with day and night , and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth  ;
kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ka sngi bad ka miet , bad nga la thaw ki aiñ kiba pynïaid ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Lada ka jutang jong nga kam long bad ka sngi bad ka miet , bad lada ngam shym la buh ia ki kyndon jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew ; .

en: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .
kha: ( Ka kynhun lieng jong u Hiram , kaba la wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ka la wan kit ruh nangta shibun ki dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawlynnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shipai duriaw ruh jong u Hiram, kiba la wanrah ksiar na Ophir, ki la wanrah na Ophir shibun ki dieng almug bad ki maw ba kordor .

en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest , fluttereth over her young , spreadeth abroad her wings , taketh them , beareth them on her wings :
kha: Kumba ka pukni ka hikai her ïa la ki khun , bad ka pyiar la ki thapniang ban kyrshan ïa ki , kumta ruh U  Trai  u kyrshan ïa ki Israel ba kin ym hap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u blang u la pynkhih ia ka bniat jong ka, u la pynkhih ia ki bniat jong ka:

en: Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
kha: Mynta nga phah ïa me sha u Pharaoh khnang ba men ïalam noh ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong nga , na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan mynta bad ngan phah ia me sha u Pharaoh, ba me lah ban wanrah ia ki briew jong nga ki khun Israel na Ijipt .

en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
kha: Ki nongaplangbrot ki la leit phai pat , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la ïohsngew bad ïohi ; ka la long thik kumba u angel u la ïathuh ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongaplangbrot ki la wan phai , ki la pyndonburom bad iaroh ia U Blei na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la iohsngew bad iohi kumba la iathuh ha ki .

en: And all things are of God , who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ , and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation ;
kha: Ïa kane baroh la leh da U Blei , uba lyngba U Khrist u la pynkylla ïa ngi na ki nongshun sha ki paralok jong u bad u la aiti ha ngi ïa ka kamram ban pynlong ïa kiwei ruh ki paralok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiei kiei baroh ki long na U Blei , uba la pynbeit ia ngi bad lade da U Jisu Khrist , bad u la ai ha ngi ia ka jingshakri jong ka jingpyniasuk ; .

en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .
kha: Bad kumta ki briew ka Israel kin ïohknieh ïa kaei kaba dang sah jong ka ri Edom bad ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba shisien ki long ki jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  , u ban pynlong ïa kane ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin ioh ia ka jingsah jong u Edom bad na ki nongwei baroh kiba la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga , ong U Trai uba leh ia kane .

en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?
kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa phi ,  u la jubab ,  bad phim shym la shahshkor . Balei ba phi kwah ban ïohsngew biang ïa ka ? Lehse ma phi , ruh , phi kwah ban long ki synran jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia ki , Nga la iathuh ia phi mynta , bad phim shym la iohsngew: balei phin iohsngew biang ia ka ? hato phi ruh phin long ki synran jong u ?

en: And the king of Israel said , Alas ! that the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab !
kha: Ngi la jan ïap !  u syiem Joram u la kyang jam .  U  Trai  u la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem Moab !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong: Alas ! ba U Trai u la khot ia kine ki lai ngut ki syiem ryngkat, ban aiti ia ki ha ka kti u Moab !

en: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka hikai ïa ngi ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei , bad ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinghikai ia ngi ia kata , da kaba kyntait ia ka jingbymngeit Blei bad ki jingkwah brai pyrthei , ngi dei ban im da kaba jem , hok bad da kaba riewblei , ha kane ka pyrthei kaba mynta;

en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark  ; let it look for light , but have none  ; neither let it see the dawning of the day :
kha: Wat ai ba u  lurstep un tyngshaiñ ; wat ai ka jingkyrmen jong ka step ïa kata ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki khlur jong ka jingshai jong ka kin dum ; ai ba kan wad ia ka jingshai , hynrei wat ai ba kan iohi ia ka jingshai jong ka sngi:

en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli ,  Hato ka Aiñ jong ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynta kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ruh ki la wan sha u, ki da pynshoi ia u bad ki la ong ha u: Hato ka long kaba dei ia u briew ban pynduh noh ia la ka tnga na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka daw ?

en: To whom he said , This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest  ; and this is the refreshing : yet they would not hear .
kha: U la ai ka jingshongthait bad ka jingjahthait ïa phi baroh , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba u la ong , Kane ka long kaba sah ha kaba phi lah ban pynlong ia ka jingsngewsih ban shongthait bad kane ka long kaba pynkmen: hynrei kin ym iohsngew .

en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .
kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba phra u la sawa , bad nga la iohi ia u khlur uba hap na bneng sha ka khyndew: bad ha u la ai ia u ia u shabi jong ka thliew kaba khlem kut .

en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .
kha: Nangta u Shekhem u ong ha u kpa jong ka Dinah bad ha ki hynmen shynrang jong ka ,  Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingkyrpad jong nga , bad kat kaba phi kwah ngan ai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shechem u la ong ha u kpa jong ka bad ha ki hynmen jong ka: To ngan shem ia ka jingaiei ha ki khmat jong phi bad kaei kaba phin ong ha nga ngan ai .

en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart , and hear with thine ears .
kha: U Blei u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u briew , sngap bha bad kynmaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga ong ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew, ki ktien jong nga baroh kiba ngan kren ha me ki pdiang ha ka dohnud jong me bad ki iohsngew da ki shkor jong me .

en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U siang ïa ka jingsiang halor ka Ïingjaiñ bad u buh sa ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynphriang shabar ia ka ïingjaiñ halor ka ïingjaiñ , bad u la buh ïa ka jingtap jong ka ïingjaiñ halor jong ka ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .

en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .
kha: Ki la pynlut hynñiew sngi ha kaba pynkyntang ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew sngi ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatduh ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra ki la pynlong ia ka jingialang kaba jur: namar ki la bat ia ka jingpynkyntang ia ka almari hynriew sngi bad ka jingkhawai hynriew sngi .

en: If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba riewblei ? Lada um synshar ïa la u thylliej , ka jinglong riewblei jong u kam myntoi bad u shukor ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew napdeng jong phi u i kumba u long uba riewblei, bad um ju kren bein ia la ka shyntur , hynrei u shukor ia la ka jong ka dohnud , kane ka niam ka long kaba lehnohei .

en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong u , bad u la ai ruh ha u ïa ka jingtbit , ka jingnang , bad ka jingshemphang ban trei ïa ki jait kam ohdur kiba har rukom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyndap ia u da ka mynsiem U Blei, ha ka jingstad, ha ka jingsngewthuh bad ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingtrei baroh;

en: The word that the  Lord  spake to Jeremiah the prophet , how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt .
kha: Mynba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt , U  Trai  U la kren ha nga . U ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien ba U Trai u la kren ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa , kumno u syiem Babilon u dei ban wan bad ban pynkhih ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .
kha: Kiwei pat ki langbrot jong nga ki hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba phi la kyrdem bad dih ïa ka um kaba phi pynjngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia ka kynhun jong nga , ki bam ia kata kaba phi la iaid da ki kjat jong phi bad ki dih ia kata kaba phi la pynsniew da ki kjat jong phi .

en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Within a year , according to the years of an hireling , and all the glory of Kedar shall fail :
kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha nga ,  Hapoh shisnem thik ka jingkhraw jong ki jait jong ka Kedar kan poi sha kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta U Trai u la ong ha nga, Hapoh shisnem, kat kum ki snem jong ka jingsiew bai bylla, bad ka burom jong u Kedar baroh kan jah noh:

en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Josaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Josiah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: But when they departed from Perga , they came to Antioch in Pisidia , and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and sat down .
kha: Ki la nang leit na Perga bad ki la poi ha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la mih na Perga, ki la poi ha Antiok ha Pisidia, bad ki la leit shapoh ka synagog ha ka sngi Sabha bad ki la shong .

en: Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .
kha: Ai ba ki nongïalam jong phi kin leit sha Kaisaria lem bad nga bad mudui ïa uta u briew lada u leh ïa kano kano ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin hiar bad nga bad kin kynnoh ia une u briew lada don kano kano ka jingsniew ha u .

en: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .
kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingkyrmen , un pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen baroh bad ka jingsuk kaba long da ka jingngeit jong phi ha u , khnang ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan ïai san da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Blei jong ka jingkyrmen u pyndap ia phi da ka jingkmen bad jingsuk baroh ha kaba ngeit, ba phin nang bun ha ka jingkyrmen, lyngba ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow , that thou mayest live , and inherit the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
kha: Leh beit bad lehhok borabor , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad ba phin ïaishong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba long tang ma me, ba me lah ban im bad ban hiar pateng ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me .

en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,
kha: Namar ba ïa kine kiei kiei baroh yn pynjot ha kane ka rukom , ki briew kiba kumno phi dei ban long ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi iohi ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin sa jah noh , kumno ki briew ki dei ban long ha ka jingiakren bakhuid bad ka jinglong riewblei baroh .

en: Who gave himself for our sins , that he might deliver us from this present evil world , according to the will of God and our Father :
kha: Khnang ban pyllait ïa ngi na kane ka juk basniew kaba mynta , U Khrist u la aiti ïa lade na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , da kaba kohnguh ïa ka mon U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la aiti ia lade na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , ba un pyllait im ia ngi na kane ka pyrthei kaba sniew kaba mynta , kat kum ka mon U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi:

en: Chief Secretary Dharmendra Sharma , DGP Dr Muktesh Chander , IGP Jaspal Singh and other officials were also present on the occasion .
kha: Ha kane ka sngi la ia don lang u Chief Secretary u Dharmendra Sharma , u DGP u Dr Muktesh Chander , u IGP u Jaspal Singh bad kiwei kiwei ki nongkitkam ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kani ka sngi da emlang u Chief Secretary ka jylla u Dharmendra Sharma , u DGP u Dr Mukesh Chander , IGP u Jaspal Singh wa kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi kiwi

en: And all the people arose as one man , saying , We will not any of us go to his tent , neither will we any of us turn into his house .
kha: U paidbah baroh u ïeng tylli lang kawei bad u ong ,  Yn ym don na ngi , la u sah ha la ka ïingjaiñ ne ha la ïing ban leit sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ieng kum uwei u briew, ki da ong: Ngin ym leit sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u , lymne ngin ym leit phai sha ka ïing jong u .

en: He is near that justifieth me  ; who will contend with me ? let us stand together : who is mine adversary ? let him come near to me .
kha: namar U Blei u don hajan , bad un pynshisha ba nga long uba lui lui . Hato don mano mano ba nud ban ujor pyrshah ïa nga ? Ïa ngin ïaleit lang sha ka ïingbishar ! To ai ba un wallam ïa ki jingmudui jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: U don hajan kata ka pynshisha ia nga ; mano ban ialeh pyrshah ia nga ? to ngin ia ieng lang: mano ba long u nongshun jong nga ? to ai ba un wan hajan jong nga .

en: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow , with the cup of astonishment and desolation , with the cup of thy sister Samaria .
kha: Kan pynjynjar ïa pha bad pynbuaid , kata ka khuri jong ka jingpynsheptieng bad jingpynjot , ka khuri jong ka Samaria ka hynmen jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la dap da ka jingdih buaid bad ka jingsngewsih, da ka khuri jong ka jinglyngngoh bad ka jingpynjot , da ka khuri jong ka para jong me ka Samaria .

en: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold , which fill their masters  houses with violence and deceit .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba mane kum ki nongmane bleithaw bad kiba tuh bad pynïap khnang ban pyndap ïa ka ïing u kynrad jong ki da ka jinglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi ruh ngan pynshitom ia kito baroh kiba jngi ha ka jingkhang , kiba pyndap ia ki iing jong ki da ka jingleh donbor bad ka jingleh thok .

en: He first findeth his own brother Simon , and saith unto him , We have found the Messias , which is , being interpreted , the Christ .
kha: Mar kumta u la shem ïa u Simon , u para jong u bad u la ong ha u ,  Ngi la shem ïa u Messaïah .  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Khrist . )
translated_en_to_kha: U shem nyngkong eh ia la u jong u hynmen u Simon, bad u ong ha u, Ngi la shem ia u Messias, uba la pynkylla ktien, U Khrist .

en: If he say thus , It is well  ; thy servant shall have peace : but if he be very wroth , then be sure that evil is determined by him .
kha: Lada i ong , ‘ Ka biang’ kan ym jia ei ei ïa nga ; hynrei lada i bitar , phin tip ba i la kut jingmut ban pynsniew ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u ong kumta , Ka long kaba bha shuh shuh u shakri jong me un ioh ia ka jingsuk: hynrei lada u bitar shibun , te to thikna ba ka jingsniew ka long kaba la kut da u .

en: Then Samuel said unto Saul , Stay , and I will tell thee what the  Lord  hath said to me this night . And he said unto him , Say on .
kha: Sangeh !  u Samuel u hukum ,  bad ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha nga hynne mynmiet .   Ïathuh ïa nga ,  ong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la ong ha u Saul , To sah bad ngan iathuh ia me ia kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ha nga mynta ka miet . Bad u la ong ha u , To ong .

en: Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .
kha: To kiar noh na ki jingkwah brai ka jinglong samla , bad ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ka hok , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , bad ka jingsuk , lem bad kito kiba da ka dohnud basngur ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh ruh ia ki jingkwah brai: hynrei bud ia ka hok, ka jingngeit, ka jingai sngewbha, bad ki kiba khot ia U Trai na ka dohnud kaba khuid .

en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,
kha: Napdeng jong ki la don ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingpang mihsnam kaba jur la khat-ar snem ; ka la pynlut ïa baroh kaba ka don ha ki nongsumar , hynrei ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka kynthei kaba don ka jingmih snam shiphew snem , kaba la pynlut lut ia ka jingim jong ka ha ki doktor , ym lah ban pynkoit ia uno uno u doktor .

en: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei pa uwei u la kular bad pynskhem da kaba shim smai . U Isaak u khublei khatduh ïa ki , bad ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng mynstep bad ki la ia sngap jar iwei ia iwei pat: bad u Isaak u la phah noh ia ki , bad ki la leit noh na u da kaba suk .

en: And , behold , the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom  ; and the earth did quake , and the rocks rent  ;
kha: Nangta ïa ka pyrda kaba la wah hapoh ka Templ la kad arliang naduh khlieh haduh tbian . Ka khyndew ka la khynñiuh , ki mawsiang ki pra la ka jong ka jong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka jingtap jong ka tempi ka la tyrkhong arsien naduh jrong haduh trai; bad ka khyndew ka la khih, bad ki maw ki la tyrkhong;

en: And if I go and prepare a place for you , I will come again , and receive you unto myself  ; that where I am , there ye may be also .
kha: Bad hadien ba nga la leit bad pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi , ngan wan pat bad ngan shim ïa phi ha lade hi , ba phi ruh phin don ha ka jaka kaba nga don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada nga leit pynkhreh ia ka jaka na ka bynta jong phi , ngan wan phai biang bad pdiang ia phi ha lade; ba hangta nga don ruh .

en: At that time when David saw that the  Lord  had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite , then he sacrificed there .
kha: U Dabid u ïohi ba da kane U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , kumta u la ai ki jingkñia halor ka duwan ha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por haba u Dabid u la iohi ba U Trai u la jubab ia u ha ka jaka bam jong u Ornan u Jibuit , nangta u la knia hangta .

en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :
kha: Tang lada phi la sngap ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jin da la tuid ha phi kum ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingjop kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung kiba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko ba me la sngap ia ki hukum jong nga ! nangta ka jingsuk jong me ka la long kum ka wah bad ka hok jong me kum ki um duriaw:

en: For the bodies of those beasts , whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin , are burned without the camp .
kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u wanrah ïa ka snam ki mrad ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam ïa ka ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia namar ki pop ; hynrei ïa ki met jong ki mrad la thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki met jong kita ki mrad kiba la wanrah ia ka snam jong ki ha ka jaka kyntang da u rangbah lyngdoh na ka bynta ka pop .

en: Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,
kha: Bad kumta U Trai u ong ,  Phi dei ban iehnoh ïa ki bad pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki . Wat ïadon bynta bad kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to mih noh na pdeng jong ki , bad to long kiba kyrpang , ong U Trai , bad wat ktah ia kaei kaei kaba jakhlia ; bad ngan pdiang ia phi .

en: Then the king of Israel said , Take ye Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;
kha: Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ,  Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad leit lam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat ka nongbah , bad sha u khun syiem Joash .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Israel u la ong: To shim biang ia u Micaiah bad rah biang ia u sha u Lat ka shnong bad ha u Joash u khun syiem;

en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God .
kha: Naba ïa ki jingthaw hi ha kawei ka sngi yn pyllaitluid na ki jinglongmraw sha ka jingpyut bad ban ïadon bynta ha ka jinglaitluid badonburom jong ki khun jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ia ka jingthaw hi ruh yn pyllait noh na ka jinglong mraw jong ka jingbamsap sha ka jinglaitluid kaba donburom jong ki khun U Blei .

en: Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?
kha: Kumno lah ban kha pat ïa u briew uba la rangbah ?  U Nikodemos u la kylli .  Kam lah ban long ba un rung shapoh ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u bad ban kha sa shisien !
translated_en_to_kha: U Nicodemus u ong ha u , Kumno u briew u lah ban kha haba u la tymmen ? hato u lah ban rung ha ka sien kaba ar ha ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u bad ban kha ia u ?

en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .
kha: Lai sngi hadien u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jeroboan bad ki briew baroh ki la wan sha Rehoboam ha ka sngi kaba lai, kumba u syiem u la buh, da kaba ong: To wan biang sha nga ha ka sngi kaba lai .

en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do unto thee , that the sea may be calm unto us ? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .
kha: Ka  erïong ka la nang jur ha kata ka por , kumta ki maji ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh ïa me ban pynsangeh ïa ka  erïong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u, Ngi leh aiu ia me, ba ka duriaw kan long kaba jem ha ngi? namar ka duriaw ka la khih bad ka la long kaba jynjar .

en: They shall also bring up a company against thee , and they shall stone thee with stones , and thrust thee through with their swords .
kha: Kin pynkhih buk ïa u paidbah ban lynthem maw ïa pha , bad kin ot lyngkhot ïa pha da ki waitlam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin wanrah ruh ia ka kynhun pyrshah ia me , bad kin pynkhih ia me da ki maw bad kin pynkhih ia me da ki waitlam jong ki .

en: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas by transgression fell , that he might go to his own place .
kha: ban shakri kum u apostol ha ka jaka jong u Judas , uba la iehnoh ban leit sha ka jaka kaba u dei ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un shim bynta ia kane ka jingshakri bad ka jinglong apostol, na kaba u Judas da ka jingpynkhein u la hap , ba un leit sha la ka jong ka jaka .

en: Nearly 70 per cent of agricultural work is done by women , yet they are excluded from the symbolism and leadership of the movements .
kha: Haduh 70 percent na ki kam rep la leh da ki kynthei , hynrei ki shah kyntait na ka jinglong dak bad ka jinglong nongialam jong ki jingiakhih .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh 70 percent na ka kam rep la leh da ki kynthei , hynrei la kyntait ia ki na ka jinglong dak bad jinglong nongialam jong ki jingkhih .

en: Then the  Lord  put forth his hand , and touched my mouth . And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ,  To shahshkor , nga ai ha me ki kyntien kiba me dei ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la kner ia la ka kti bad u la ktah ia ka shyntur jong nga . Bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ha khmih nga la buh ia ki ktien jong nga ha ka shyntur jong me .

en: And the king went forth , and all his household after him . And the king left ten women , which were concubines , to keep the house .
kha: Kumta u syiem u phet noh , da ka jingsynran lem ka longïing jong u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , lait noh ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shadien ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit noh bad ka iing jong u baroh hadien jong u . Bad u syiem u la iehnoh ia ki shiphew ngut ki kynthei kiba long ki kynthei kiba long ki kynthei kiba la shah sumar ha ka iing .

en: And I said after she had done all these things , Turn thou unto me . But she returned not . And her treacherous sister Judah saw it .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba hadien ba ka la leh ïa kane baroh , da kaba thikna kan sa wan phai pat sha nga . Hynrei kam shym wan phai , bad ka Judah ka para bymïaineh jong ka , ka la ïohi ïa kata baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong hadien ba ka la leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh, To phai noh sha nga . Hynrei kam shym la wan phai shuh . Bad ka para jong ka kaba thok ka la iohi ia ka .

en: For Gaza shall be forsaken , and Ashkelon a desolation : they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day , and Ekron shall be rooted up .
kha: Yn ym iehnoh ïano ïano ha ka nongbah Gasa . La iehnoh ïa ka Ashkelon . Ïa ki briew jong ka Ashdod yn beh noh ha ka shiteng sngi , bad ïa ki briew jong ka Ekron yn beh noh na ka nongbah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka Gaza kan shah iehnoh bein, bad u Ashkelon u la shah pynjot: kin beh noh ia u Ashdod ha ka por shiteng sngi, bad u Ekron un sa shah tynrai .

en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;
kha: Uwei u bania uba kyrteng u Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei Artemis da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Demetrius , u nongshna rupa uba la shna ia ki jaka mane rupa na ka bynta ka Diana , um shym la wanrah ei ei kaba rit ia ki nongtrei kti ; .

en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married : for he had married an Ethiopian woman .
kha: U Moses u la shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kush bad ka Miriam bad u Aaron ki wad dong ïa u na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Miriam bad u Aaron ki la kren pyrshah ia u Moses namar ka kynthei Ethiopia kaba u la shongkurim: namar u la shongkurim ia ka kynthei Ethiopia .

en: Rejoice not against me , O mine enemy : when I fall , I shall arise  ; when I sit in darkness , the  Lord  shall be a light unto me .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi kim don daw ban risa beiñ halor jong ngi . Ngi la kyllon noh , hynrei ngin khie pat . Ngi don ha ka jingdum mynta , hynrei U  Trai  un ai jingshai ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewbha pyrshah ia nga ko nongshun jong nga: haba nga hap , ngan khie ; haba nga shong ha ka jingdum , U Trai un long ka jingshai ha nga .

en: Ye lust , and have not : ye kill , and desire to have , and cannot obtain : ye fight and war , yet ye have not , because ye ask not .
kha: Phi kwah ei ei , hynrei phim ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi pynïap ; phi da kwah eh , hynrei phim lah ban ïoh ïa kita , kumta phi ïania bad phi ïaleh thma . Phim ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah , namar ba phim pan na U Blei ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi kwah, bad phim don: phi pyniap, bad phi kwah ban don: phi ialeh bad ialeh thma, hynrei phim don: namar phim pan .

en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will shew thee what thou shalt do : and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee .
kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Jesse sha kata ka jingkñia , bad ngan sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew uba ngan ïathuh ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad khot ia u Jesse sha ka jingknia , bad ngan pyni ia me ia kaei kaba me dei ban leh: bad me dei ban pynsleh ia nga ia uta uba nga khot ha me .

en: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud , and gat him up into the mount : and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights .
kha: U Moses u la kiew ïa uta u lum sha uta u lyoh . U la sah hangta sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la leit shapoh u lyoh, bad u la leit sha u lum: bad u Moses u la don ha u lum sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet .

en: Give me my wives and my children , for whom I have served thee , and let me go : for thou knowest my service which I have done thee .
kha: Ai ha nga ïa ki tnga jong nga bad ïa ki khun jong nga kiba nga la ïoh da kaba trei na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngan leit noh . Phi tip haduh katno nga la shakri hok ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ia nga ia ki tnga jong nga bad ki khun jong nga, na ka bynta jong nga nga la shakri ia me, bad pyllait noh ia nga: namar me tip ia ka jingshakri jong nga kaba nga la leh ia me .

en: Now therefore be not grieved , nor angry with yourselves , that ye sold me hither : for God did send me before you to preserve life .
kha: Mynta , wat sngewsih ne kynnoh ïa lade namar ba phi la die ïa nga shane . Dei U Blei keiñ uba la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pynim ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta wat sngewsih ne bitar ia lade, ba phi la die ia nga hangne : namar U Blei u la phah ia nga ha khmat jong phi ban pynneh pynsah ia ka jingim .

en: Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .
kha: Pynkloi ! mareh ! ngan ym lah ban leh ei ei tad haduh ba men da poi hangta .  Namar ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongrit la ai kyrteng ka Soar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la phet noh na ka jaka ba nga lah ban leh ei ei haduh ba me da wan shata . Namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka shnong u Soar .

en: DGP Abhayanand , who is camping at the spot , was heckled by local people who charged him with failure to provide security to Singh .
kha: U DGP Abhayanand uba shong camp ha katei ka jaka u la shah kynthoh ha ki briew jong ka thain kiba la kynnoh ia u ba um shym la ai jingpahara ia u Singh .
translated_en_to_kha: U DGP Abhayanand uba dang sah ha katei ka jaka u la shah pynngop ha ki briew kiba don ha katei ka jaka kiba la kynnoh ba um lah ban pynbiang ia ka jingshngain ia u Singh .

en: Not so : go now ye that are men , and serve the  Lord   ; for that ye did desire . And they were driven out from Pharaoh s presence .
kha: Em ! Tang ki shynrang ki lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  , lada kata ka long kaei kaba phi kwah .  Mar kumta , la beh noh ïa ki na khmat u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta: leit mynta phi kiba long ki briew, bad to shakri ia U Trai ; namar kata ka la long kaba phi kwah . Bad la beh noh ia ki na ka jingdon jong u Pharaoh .

en: And the princes of Succoth said , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thine army ?
kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth ki ong ,  Balei ngin ai jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong phi ? Phim pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Sucoth ki la ong: Hato ki kti u Sebah bad ka Zalmunna mynta ki don ha ka kti jong me, ba ngin ai kpu ia ka kynhun shipai jong me ?

en: And the  Lord  shewed signs and wonders , great and sore , upon Egypt , upon Pharaoh , and upon all his household , before our eyes :
kha: Ngi la ïohi da la ki khmat ba u la leh ïa ki kamphylla bad ïa kiei kiei kiba ishyrkhei pyrshah ïa ki Ijipt , ïa u syiem jong ki , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la pyni ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla, kiba khraw bad kiba phylla, ha Ijipt, ha u Pharaoh bad ha ka iing jong u baroh, ha khmat ki khmat jong ngi:

en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau , which were with her in the house , and put them upon Jacob her younger son :
kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ki jaiñ kiba bha tam jong u Iso , ïa kiba ka buh ha ïing , bad ka pynphong ïa ki ha u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Rebeka ka la shim bha ia u khun rangbah jong ka u Iso, uba don bad ka ha iing, bad ka la buh ia ki ha u Jakob khun rit jong ka:

en: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold , graven , as signets are graven , with the names of the children of Israel .
kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa ki mawkordor Karnelian bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar . Ha kita la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ia ki maw kiba la khang da ki maw ksiar, kiba la ker sawdong, kumba la ker sawdong, bad ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel .

en: And I will tread down the people in mine anger , and make them drunk in my fury , and I will bring down their strength to the earth .
kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh bad nga lynthaw ïa ki . Nga la theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynhiar ia ki briew ha ka jingbitar jong nga , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban dih kyiad ha ka jingbitar jong nga , bad ngan pynhiar ia ka bor jong ki sha ka khyndew .

en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children , because he was the son of his old age : and he made him a coat of many colours .
kha: U Jakob u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki khun shynrang jong u baroh , namar ba la kha ïa u haba u la tymmen . U la suh ïa u kawei ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Israel u ieit ia u Joseph kham palat ia ki khun jong u baroh: bad u la pynlong ia u da ka jainkup kaba bun rong .

en: And the  Lord  gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers  ; and they possessed it , and dwelt therein .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular da kaba kyntang ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba un ai ha ki . Haba ki la shimti ïa ka , ki la shongduh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ia ka ri baroh kaba u la sngap jar ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki bad ki la don ia ka, bad ki la shong ha ka .

en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him ? saith the  Lord . Do not I fill heaven and earth ? saith the  Lord .
kha: Ym don uba lah ban rieh ha kaba ngam lah ban ïohi ïa u . Hato phim tip ba nga don ha ki jaka baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don mano mano ba buhrieh ia lade ha ki jaka ba rieh ba ngan ym iohi ia u ? ong U Trai . Hato ngam pyndap ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew ? ong U Trai .

en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad shah pynduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ki kti jong ka jingshlei um kin sa tuid na khmat jong u , bad kin sa shah pynpra ; yea , kumjuh ruh u syiem ka jutang .

en: Say ye not , A confederacy , to all them to whom this people shall say , A confederacy  ; neither fear ye their fear , nor be afraid .
kha: Wat ïasoh ha ki jingïathmu basniew jong ki briew bad wat sheptieng ïa kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ong ia phi , Ka jinglong ba sniew, ha kito baroh kiba une u briew un ong , Ka jinglong ba sniew; wat tieng ia ka jingtieng jong ki , lymne to tieng .

en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works , when she had received the messengers , and had sent them out another way ?
kha: Ka la long kumjuh ruh bad ka Rahab kaba long ka nuti . La pynksan ïa ka ha U Blei lyngba ki kam jong ka , mynba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki Israel kiba la wan syntiat bad ïarap ïa ki ban lait phet na kawei pat ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh kam shym la long ka Rahab kaba la pynshisha da ki kam , haba ka la pdiang ia ki nonglam khubor , bad ka la phah ia ki da kumwei pat ?

en: Mishra had on Sunday accused Kejriwal of taking Rs 2 crore from his cabinet colleague , a charge refuted by Deputy CM Manish Sisodia .
kha: U Mishra u la kynnoh ha ka Sngi Roibar ba u Kejriwal u la shim pisa 2 klur tyngka na u paralok jong u ha ka kynhun myntri , ka jingkynnoh kaba la kyntait da u Deputy CM u Manish Sisodia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mishra u la kynnoh ha ka sngi U Blei ba u la shim 2 klur tyngka na u paralok jong u, ka jingkynnoh kaba la kyntait da u Deputy CM u Deputy CM u Deputy CM u Deputy CM u Deputy CM u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Deputy u Mish u Mish u la kynnoh ba u la kynnoh ba u la kynnoh ba u la kynnoh ia u.

en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah .
kha: Tang mar ïabna ïa ka jingshah pynïap u khun jong ka , ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka la ai hukum ban pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot jong ka longïing syiem Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka Athaliah ka kmie jong u Ahasaiah ka la iohi ba u khun jong ka u la iap , ka la ieng bad ka la pynjot ia u symbai syiem baroh jong ka iing Judah .

en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces , and wash the inwards of him , and his legs , and put them unto his pieces , and unto his head .
kha: Ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa uta u langbrot , sait ïa ki snier bad ki kjat-dien jong u , nangta sa buh lang ïa ki halor kita ki lyngkhot doh bad ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men ot ia u langbrot ha ki bynta ba shapoh jong u bad ki kjat jong u bad buh ia ki ha ki bynta jong u bad ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: Then I will give you rain in due season , and the land shall yield her increase , and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit .
kha: ngan phah ha phi ïa u slap ha ka aïom kaba biang , khnang ba ka khyndew kan pynmih kyrhai ki jingthung jingtep bad ki dieng kin seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan ai slap ia phi ha ka por kaba biang bad ka khyndew kan ai ia ka jingmih jong ka bad ki dieng lyngkha kin ai soh ia ki soh jong ki .

en: The merchants of these things , which were made rich by her , shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment , weeping and wailing ,
kha: Ki nongkhaïi , kiba la kylla riewspah na kaba ïakhaïi ha kata ka nongbah , kin ïeng sha jngai bah , namar ki sngewsheptieng ban ïoh bynta lem na ki jingshitom jong ka . Kin lynñiar bad ïambriew , bad ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkhaii jong kine kiei kiei kiba la pynlong riewspah da ka , kin ieng jngai namar ka jingtieng ia ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka , ki iam bad ki iam .

en: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .
kha: Ka long kaba dei ban ym bam doh , dih waiñ , lane ban leh kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa la u parabangeit ban kyllon noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam long kaba bha ban bam doh, ne ban dih wain, ne kaei kaei kaba u hynmen jong me u shah pynthut ne shah pynmong ne shah pyn tlot .

en: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November and December are the twelve months of the year.
kha: Kyllalyngkot, Rymphang, Lber, Iaiong, Jymmang, Jylliew, Naitung, Nailar, Nailur, Risaw, Naiwieng bad Nohprah kidei ki khat-ar tylli ki bnai jong u snem.
translated_en_to_kha: U bnai Jymmang, u February, u bnai Risaw, u bnai Risaw, u bnai May, u bnai Iaiong, u bnai Kyllalyngkot, u August, u bnai September, u bnai Lber, u bnai Nohprah bad u bnai December ki long ki shiphew bnai jong u snem.

en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king s pool : but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass .
kha: Nangta ha ka bynta kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah , nga leit shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Umpohliew bad ka Pungsum u Syiem . U kada u ba nga shong um lah ban shem kano kano ka lynti lyngba ki synrum ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la leit sha ka khyrdop jong ka pung um bad sha ka pung syiem: hynrei ym don jaka ia u mrad uba don hapoh jong nga ban iaid .

en: Say ye of him , whom the Father hath sanctified , and sent into the world , Thou blasphemest  ; because I said , I am the Son of God ?
kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , U Kpa u la jied ïa nga bad u la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei . Kumno , te , phi lah ban ong ba nga krenbeiñ blei namar ba nga la ong ba nga long U Khun U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: To ong na uta uba U Kpa u la pynkyntang bad u la phah sha ka pyrthei , Me kren bein ; namar nga la ong , Nga long U Khun U Blei ?

en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and make an atonement for himself , and for his house .
kha: Un kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia ban map ïa ki pop jong u bad jong ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un aiti ia u masi jong u na ka bynta ka jingknia pop jong u hi bad un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ka iing jong u .

en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite , to receive his pledge from the woman s hand : but he found her not .
kha: U Judah u la phah ïa u Hirah u paralok jong u , ban leit lam ïa ka blang , bad ban shim noh na ka kynthei ïa ki tiar kiba u la kular , hynrei u Hirah um shym lap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la phah ia uta u khynnah da ka kti jong u paralok jong u u Adullamite, ban pdiang ia ka jingkular jong u na ka kti jong kata ka kynthei: hynrei um shym la lap ia ka .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .
kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki langbrot kiba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei ha ki ; Ha khmih , nga ruh ngan bishar hapdeng ki masi kiba heh bad hapdeng ki masi kiba rit .

en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Ussaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Asariah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: The highways lie waste , the wayfaring man ceaseth : he hath broken the covenant , he hath despised the cities , he regardeth no man .
kha: Ki lynti bah ki long kiba ma shibun ba ym don uba ïaid ba ïeng ha ki . Ïa ki jingïateh kular la pynkheiñ bad ïa ki jingïakut ym shym burom . Ym don shuh ka jingïaburom ïano ïano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki surok bah ki thiah lypa, u briew uba iaid lynti u sangeh noh: u la pynkhein ia ka jutang , u la lehbein ia ki nongbah , um khein ia u briew .

en: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kane , ki ïadem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrta jam ,  U  Trai  u long U Blei ; U  Trai  tang ma u , u long U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew baroh ki la iohi ia ka, ki la dem khrup: bad ki la ong: U Trai, u long U Blei; U Trai, u long U Blei .

en: For wisdom is a defence , and money is a defence : but the excellency of knowledge is , that wisdom giveth life to them that have it .
kha: bad kan ai ha phi ka jingshngain kumba lah ka pisa . Ka jingstad ka ri pynim ïa phi — kane ka dei ka kabu jong ka jingtip .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingstad ka long ka jingiada, bad ka pisa ka long ka jingiada: hynrei ka jingbha jong ka jingtip ka long , ba ka jingstad ka ai jingim ia kito kiba don ia ka .

en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .
kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jong U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u panpoh snieh ha ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u juh u Ioannis u don ka jainkup jong u kulai, bad ka sniehdoh kaba rit shaphang ki tyrpeng jong u ; bad ka doh jong u ka long ki khnai bad ka umsoh khlaw .

en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
kha: Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei pat kaba phi hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kan pynlwait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad khamtam eh, da kine, ko khun jong nga, to shah pynrem: ban shna bun ki kot ym don jingkut ; bad ka jingpule kaba bun ka long ka jingtlot jong ka doh .

en: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance  ; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock , that it should not be covered .
kha: Nga la pynsah ïa ka snam hangta , ïa kaba ym lah ban buhrieh , kaba dawa ïa ka jingpynhiarkput kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan pynlong ia ka jingbitar ban wan shaneng ban shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang ; nga la buh ia ka snam jong ka halor u maw , ba kan ym shah tap .

en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .
kha: Kaei kaba ngi ïohi mynta ka long kum ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka ïitkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . Kaei kaba nga tip mynta ka long tang katto katne ; nangta kan sa long kaba dap pura — kaba dap pura kum ka jingtip jong U Blei ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta mynta ngi iohi lyngba ka glass, da kaba dum hynrei nangta nga tip ha khmat: mynta nga tip ha kawei ka bynta hynrei nangta ngan sa tip wat kumba la tip ia nga ruh .

en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
kha: Wat ainguh ha nga da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa ka mrad ha nga . Ym bit ban ieh haduh mynstep ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la kñia ha nga ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ia ka snam jong ka jingknia jong nga da u kpu ba la khleh lang bad ka shini jong ka jingknia jong nga kan sah haduh ka por mynstep .

en: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you : give me a possession of a buryingplace with you , that I may bury my dead out of my sight .
kha: Nga long u nongwei uba im hapdeng jong phi ; die ïa nga khyndiat ka jaka ba ngan ïoh ban tep ïa la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u nongwei bad u nongwan jngohkai bad phi: ai ia nga ia ka jaka tep bad phi , ba ngan tep ia kiba iap jong nga na ka jingpeit jong nga .

en: And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .
kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba pha leh ki long kiba nga ijli , ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaba ngam pat ju leh mynno mynno , bad ïa kaba ngan ym leh shuh lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan leh ha me ia kaba ngam shym la leh, bad ha kaba ngan ym leh shuh ia kaba kum kata, namar ki jingleh bymman jong me baroh .

en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , and say unto them , Ye shall be holy : for I the  Lord  your God am holy .
kha: Long kiba khuid , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki: Phi long kiba khuid: namar nga U Trai U Blei jong phi nga long uba khuid .

en: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night , and said unto him , Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad .
kha: Ha ka jingphohsniew ha kata ka miet U Blei u paw ha u Laban bad u ong ha u ,  Da husiar ban ym byrngem ïa u Jakob ha kano kano ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la wan ha u Laban u Syria ha ka jingphohsniew miet , bad u la ong ha u: To sumar ba men ym kren ia u Jakob la ka long kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

en: And of Asher he said , Let Asher be blessed with children  ; let him be acceptable to his brethren , and let him dip his foot in oil .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Asher u ong ,  U Asher u kham ïoh jingkyrkhu ban ïa la ki para jait . To ki hynmen ki para jong u kin burom eh ïa u , Bad to ka ri jong u kan dap da ki diengsoh Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Asher u la ong , Ai ba u Asher un long uba la kyrkhu da ki khun ; to ai ba un long uba pdiang sngewbha ia ki hynmen jong u, bad to ai ba un pynngam ia la ka kjat ha ka umphniang .

en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .
kha: U Blei u la pynlong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , kumba u Jotham , u khun jong u Gideon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsniew baroh jong ki briew jong ka Shehem ka la wan ha ki khlieh jong ki: bad halor jong ki la wan ka jingtim jong u Jotham u khun u Jerubbaal .

en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .
kha: U la kylli ïa ki ha ka por aïu ba u khun jong u , u la kham ïohbor , bad ki la jubab ,  Mynhynnin ha ka por shi baje nohphai sngi mynba ka jingshit na u ka la iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kylli ia ki ha ka por ba u sdang ban pynkylla . Ki la ong ha u , Hynnin ka sngi ha ka por hynriew ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ia u .

en: Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;
kha: Lymne ba u donkam ei ei kaba ngi lah ban ai da kaba trei na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long ma u hi uba ai ka jingim bad ka jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la mane ruh ia u da ki kti jong ki briew, kumba u donkam ei ei, haba u iohi ba u ai ia ka jingim baroh, bad ka jingpynhiar mynsiem baroh;

en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .
kha: Kaba ar na ki hukum bakongsan tam ka dei kane : ‘ Men ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’ Ym don kawei pat ka hukum kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba ar ka long kumne , kata ka long kane , Me dei ban ieit ia u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ia lade . Ym don kawei pat ka hukum kaba kham khraw ban ia kine .

en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .
kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah jong u Joshua ki la wan phai suk sha u ha ka jaka sher dara ha Makkedah . Ym don uwei ruh u briew ha kata ka ri uba nud ban kren pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la leit phai noh sha ka jaka sah jong u Joshua ha Maksa ha ka jingsuk: ym don ba pynkhih ia ka shyntur jong u pyrshah ia uno uno na ki khun Israel .

en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .
kha: Baroh kaba ki don ka long katto katne ki jingïania shaphang ka niam jong ki bad shaphang u briew uba kyrteng U Jisu , uba la ïap ; hynrei u Paul u kam ba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki don katto katne ki jingkylli pyrshah ia u jong ka jingngeit biej jong ki hi, bad jong uwei u Jisu uba la iap, uba u Paul u la pynskhem ba u dang im .

en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned over Israel two years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Nadab u khun jong u syiem Jeroboam u la long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nadab u khun u Jeroboan u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Asa u syiem Judah bad u la synshar ia ki Israel ar snem .

en: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings , he took Peter and John and James , and went up into a mountain to pray .
kha: Kumba shi taïew hadien ba u la kren ïa kine kiei kiei , U Jisu u la ïalam lem bad u ïa u Petros , u Ïoannis bad ïa u Jakob bad leit sha u lum ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba 8 sngi hadien kine ki jingkren , u la shim ia u Petros bad u loannis bad u Jakob bad u la leit sha u lum ban duwai .

en: For he served Baal , and worshipped him , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of Israel , according to all that his father had done .
kha: U la mane bad shakri ïa u Baal , bad kumta u kpa jong u ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la shakri ia u Baal , bad u la mane ia u , bad u la pynbitar ia U Trai Blei jong ki Israel , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: And they said , This is blood : the kings are surely slain , and they have smitten one another : now therefore , Moab , to the spoil .
kha: Ka dei ka snam !  ki la kyang jam .  Ki lai kynhun ki shipai nongshun ki la ïaleh bad pynïap iwei ïa iwei ! Ïa ngin leit bad lute ïa ki jaka shong dara jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Kane ka long ka snam: ki syiem ki la shah pyniap shisha, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh iwei ia iwei pat: mynta namarkata, u Moab, sha ka jingjot .

en: And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;
kha: Nangta u pud jong ka u suh beit shaphang sepngi shaduh Mareal , da kaba ktah ïa ka Dabbesheth bad ïa ka wahduid kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jokneam .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam jong ki u la kiew sha duriaw, bad u Marah, bad u la poi sha Dabashet bad u la poi sha ka wah kaba don ha khmat u Jokneam ; .

en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .
kha: Ki la ïamynjur ïa kano ka bynta jong ka ri uwei uwei un leit wad , bad ki ïaleit sha la ka jong ka jong ka lad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la phiah ia ka ri hapdeng jong ki ban iaid lyngba ia ka: U Ahab u la leit noh da lade , bad u Obadaiah u la leit noh da lade .

en: His eyes were as a flame of fire , and on his head were many crowns  ; and he had a name written , that no man knew , but he himself .
kha: Ki khmat jong u ki la long kum ka thylliej ding , bad u la phong shibun ki pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u . U la don ka kyrteng ïa kaba la thoh halor jong u ïa kaba ym don batip hynrei lait tang ma u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong u ki long kum ka ding ding, bad ha ka khlieh jong u ki don bun ki khlieh ; bad u don ka kyrteng ba la thoh , ba ym don ba tip , hynrei ma u hi .

en: O Lord , by these things men live , and in all these things is the life of my spirit : so wilt thou recover me , and make me to live .
kha: A Trai , ngan im na ka bynta jong me , bad tang ïa me hi ; to pynkhiah ïa nga bad ai ngan im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, da kine kiei kiei baroh ki im, bad ha kine kiei kiei baroh ka long ka jingim jong ka mynsiem jong nga: kumta men pynkoit ia nga, bad pynlong ia nga ban im .

en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood : and in thee they eat upon the mountains : in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .
kha: Don na ki briew jong phi kiba ïathuh lamler shaphang kiwei khnang ban ïoh pynïap ïa ki . Don na ki , kiba bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ai ha ki bleithaw . Don kiba sngewhun borabor ha la ki jingkwah brai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha me ki don ki briew kiba kit ia ka snam: bad ha me ki bam halor ki lum: hapdeng jong me ki leh ia ka jingleh be-ijot .

en: Then Laban overtook Jacob . Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount : and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead .
kha: U Jakob u la sher dara halor u lum , bad u Laban u la sher dara lem bad la ki kur ki jait ha ka ri lum Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Laban u la iaid lait ia u Jakob . Mynta u Jakob u la buh ia ka ïingjain jong u ha u lum: bad u Laban bad ki hynmen jong u ki la buh ha u lum Gilead .

en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .
kha: Te ngan kyntait ban ïarap ïa ki namar ba ki la leh bymman bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buhrieh shisha ia ka khmat jong nga ha kata ka sngi na ka bynta ki jingsniew baroh kiba kin sa leh, ha kaba ki phai sha kiwei pat ki blei .

en: And Saul cast the javelin  ; for he said , I will smite David even to the wall with it . And David avoided out of his presence twice .
kha: Ngan sum ïa u ha ka kynroh ,  u Saul u ong ha lade , bad u kawang ïa u sum ha u ar sien ; hynrei ha baroh ar sien u Dabid u kynriah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la bret ia ka javelin ; namar u la ong , Ngan shoh ia u Dabid wat haduh ka kynroh bad ka . Bad u Dabid u la kiar na ka jingdon jong u arsien .

en: And Paul , earnestly beholding the council , said , Men and brethren , I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day .
kha: U Paul u la peit shlip sha ka Dorbar bad u la ong ,  Ko ki para nong Israel jong nga ! Ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka sngur shaphang ka rukom ha kaba nga la im ha khmat U Blei haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul, haba u la iohi ia ka dorbar, u la ong, ko para bangeit, nga la im ha ka jingsngew babha baroh ha khmat U Blei haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents : I have not found it by secret search , but upon all these .
kha: Ki jaiñ jong phi ki la khah da ka snam jong kiba duk bad kiba lui lui , ym da ka snam jong ki nonglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ki bniat jong me la shem ia ka snam jong ki mynsiem kiba duk: Ngam shym la lap ia ka da kaba wad bniah ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .
kha: Na kawei pat kawei ka nongbah jong ka Judah ki briew ki leit kloi kloi sha Jerusalem ban pan na U  Trai  ïa ka jingïalam ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ialum lang, ban pan jingiarap na U Trai: wat na ki shnong Judah baroh ki la wan wad ia U Trai .

en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth , and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant .
kha: Hynrei ngan pyndonburom ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad pha mynba pha dang samla , bad ngan pynlong ka jutang bad pha ka ban neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ngan kynmaw ia ka jutang jong nga bad me ha ki sngi jong ka jinglong samla jong me , bad ngan pynskhem ha me ia ka jutang bymjukut .

en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga .  Bad u la phah noh ïa uta u samla .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u rangbah shipai u la pyllait noh ia uta u samla bad u la kynnoh ia u, Peit wat iathuh iano iano ruh ba me la pyni ia kine kiei kiei ha nga .

en: But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .
kha: Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , ka pyrthei ka dei ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na kata ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga .  Ale , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba ka pyrthei kan tip ba nga ieit ia U Kpa ; bad kumba U Kpa u la ai hukum ia nga, wat la katta ruh nga leh . To khie , to ngin ia leit noh kumta .

en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive , what thank have ye ? for sinners also lend to sinners , to receive as much again .
kha: Bad lada phi leh ai kylliang ïa kito na kiba phi kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ai kylliang ïa ki nongpop , ban ïoh pat katjuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi ai ram ia ki na kiba phi kyrmen ban ioh, kaei ka jingsngewnguh kaba phi don ? namar ki nongpop ruh ki ai ram ia ki nongpop , ban ioh biang katba lah .

en: Then will the  Lord  drive out all these nations from before you , and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves .
kha: Te un sa beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai un beh noh ia kine ki jaitbynriew baroh na khmat jong phi , bad phin sa don ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kiba kham khlain bor ban ia lade .

en: Save us , O  Lord  our God , and gather us from among the heathen , to give thanks unto thy holy name , and to triumph in thy praise .
kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , bad wallam pat ïa ngi napdeng ki jaitbynriew , ba ngi lah ban sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To pynim ia ngi ko Trai jong ngi, bad to lum ia ngi napdeng ki nongwei, ban ainguh ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me bad ban jop ha ka jingiaroh jong me .

en: Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Uba rit bad uba tlot kumba me long , ko Israel , wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me . Nga , U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia me, ko Jakob, bad phi ki briew Israel; ngan iarap ia me, ong U Trai bad u nongsiewspah jong me, U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And were beyond measure astonished , saying , He hath done all things well : he maketh both the deaf to hear , and the dumb to speak .
kha: Bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh .  Kumno u lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh !  ki la ïa-pyrta .  U lah wat ban pynlong ïa uba kyllut ban ïohsngew bad ïa u bymnang kren ban kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la lyngngoh palat, ki da ong, U la leh bha ia kiei kiei baroh: u pynlong ia kiba sngap jar ban iohsngew, bad kiba sngap jar ban kren .

en: As concerning the sons of Laadan  ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
kha: U Ladan , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon , u dei u kpa tymmen jong shibun ki kynhun longïing , kynthup ïa ka longïing jong u Jehiel u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba iadei bad ki khun shynrang jong u Laadan; ki khun shynrang jong u Laadan, wat na u Laadan u Gerson, ki long u Jehieli .

en: He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :
kha: Un long uba khraw , bad yn khot ïa u , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pynlong syiem ïa u , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la long ,
translated_en_to_kha: Un long uba khraw bad yn khot ia u U Khun jong Uba ha khlieh duh: bad U Trai Blei un ai ha u ia ka khet u kpa jong u u Dabid:

en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name , I will require it of him .
kha: Un kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia , ba uno uno u bym sngap ia ki ktien jong nga kiba un kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ngan dawa ia ka na u .

en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded , saying ,
kha: U Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum :
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei, u da ong: Kane ka long kaba U Trai u la hukum da kaba ong:

en: Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?
kha: haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmat , u wan ha U  Trai  , bad ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la mih ka mynsiem bad ka la ieng ha khmat U Trai bad ka la ong , Ngan pynsngewbha ia u . Bad U Trai u la ong ha u: Da kaba ?

en: And they that fed the swine fled , and told it in the city , and in the country . And they went out to see what it was that was done .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïa-ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor ha ka shnong bad ha ki jaka rep . Ki briew ki la wan ban khmih ïa kaei kaba la jia
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phet noh ia u sniang bad ki la iathuh ha ka shnong bad ha ri . Ki la leit shabar ban peit kaei kata kaba la leh .

en: Destruction upon destruction is cried  ; for the whole land is spoiled : suddenly are my tents spoiled , and my curtains in a moment .
kha: Kawei ka jingjot ka bud hadien kawei pat , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la iehnoh ha ka jingjot . Kynsan kynsan la pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi , ïa ki pyrda jong ki la tar lyngkhot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynjot ia ka jingjot ka la pyrta ; namar ka ri baroh kawei ka la jot: kynsan kynsan ki ïingjaiñ jong nga ki la jot , bad ki jingtap jong nga ha ka khyllipmat .

en: Return , ye backsliding children , and I will heal your backslidings . Behold , we come unto thee  ; for thou art the  Lord  our God .
kha: To wan phai , phi baroh kiba la phai lyndet na U  Trai  ; un pynkhiah ïa phi bad un pynlong ïa phi kiba ïaineh . Phi ong ,  Ho-oid , ngi wan sha U  Trai  , namar u dei U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan phai, phi ki khun kiba phaidien, bad ngan pynkoit ia ki tyrpeng jong phi . Ha khmih ngi wan sha me ; namar me long U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring , in goodly apparel , and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment  ;
kha: Tharai u briew uba riewspah uba deng ïa ka sati ksiar bad uba riam da ki jaiñ kiba kynsai u wan rung sha ka jingïalang jong phi , bad u briew uba duk ha ki jaiñjot ruh u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada don ha ka jingiaseng jong phi u briew uba don ka ryntieh ksiar, ha ka jain kaba bha, bad u wan rung ruh u briew uba duk ha ka jain rong stem;

en: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye , carry corn for the famine of your houses :
kha: Ban pynshisha ba phi long ki briew kiba hok , uwei na phi un sah ha ka ïingbyndi ha kaba la set ïa phi , kiwei pat ki lah ban leit kit ïa u kew uba phi la thied sha ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kiba shahthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi long ki briew kiba shisha , to ai ba uwei na ki hynmen jong phi un shah teh ha iing jong phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi: leit noh ia phi:

en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out ! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them ! God distributeth sorrows in his anger .
kha: Hato ïa ka jingshai jong u bymman la ju pynlip noh ? Hato uno uno na ki u ju ïakynduh ïa ka jingjot ? Hato U Blei u ju pynshitom ïa u bymman ha ka jingbitar
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka sharak jong ki bymman ka mih ! bad katno ka wan ka jingpynjot jong ki halor jong ki ! U Blei u sam ia ki jingsngewsih ha ka jingbitar jong u .

en: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .
kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha Elim , ha kaba la don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki dieng Tlai ; bad hangta ki la ïasher dara harud um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Elim, ha kaba ki don shiphew tylli ki pung um, bad lai tylli ki dieng sohjew: bad ki la shong hangta harud ki um .

en: ( Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread , after that the Lord had given thanks : )
kha: Kiwei pat ki lieng , kiba na Tiberias , ki la wan poi ha ka ryngkew hajan ka jaka ha kaba ki paidbah ki la bam ïa u kpu hadien ba U Trai u la ainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hynrei kiwei pat ki lieng na ka ri Tibet ki la wan ha ka jaka ba ki la bam kpu, hadien ba U Trai u la ainguh: )

en: And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .
