kha: Lada phi wan phai khlem shah pynïap ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren lyngba jong nga !  Bad u ong shuh ,  Sngap ïa nga phi baroh , ïa kaei kaba nga la ong !
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Lada me wan phai shisha ha ka jingsuk, te U Trai um shym la kren da nga . Bad u la ong , To sngap , phi baroh .

en: And he measured the wall thereof , an hundred and forty and four cubits , according to the measure of a man , that is , of the angel .
kha: U angel u la thew ruh ïa ka kynroh , bad ka la don hynriewphew mitar ka jingkynjang , kat kum ka jingthew ba la pdiang ïa kaba u la pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thew ia ka kynroh jong ka, shispah sawphew saw phut kat kum ka jingthew jong u briew , kata ka long ka jong u angel .

en: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,
kha: Ym slem hadien , u paidbah uba bun u la ïawanlang . Haba ki briew kim don ei ei shuh ban bam , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki synran sha u bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi u paidbah u long uba khraw shibun bad um don ei ei ban bam, U Jisu u la khot ia ki synran jong u ha u bad u la ong ha ki .

en: As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
kha: uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren shaphang uta :  Ha khmih , nga buh ha Seïon ïa u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ban kyllon . Hynrei uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh , Ha khmih , nga thiah ha Sion u maw bad u mawsiang jong ka jingleh bymman: bad uno uno uba ngeit ia u un ym sngewlehrain .

en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children : they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people .
kha: Ka jingpynjot kaba la wan ha ki briew jong nga ka wallam ka jingsngew shyrkhei ; ki kmie kiba ieit ki shet ïa la ki khun ban long jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong ki kynthei kiba sngewsih ki la pynkhih ia la ki jong ki khun: ki la long ka doh jong ki ha ka jingpynjot ia ka khun jong ki briew jong nga .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord  ; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u , bad u nonglamktien um long kham khraw ban ïa uta uba la phah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, U shakri um kham khraw ban ia u kynrad jong u; lymne uta uba la phah kham khraw ban ia uta uba la phah ia u .

en: And one said to the man clothed in linen , which was upon the waters of the river , How long shall it be to the end of these wonders ?
kha: Uwei na ki u la kylli ïa u angel uba ïeng kham pajih shatei shaneng wah ,  Slem katno kan long tad haduh ba kine ki jingjia kiba phylla kin poi sha kaba kut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la ong ha uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lyngkhuid kaba don halor ki um jong ka wah , Katno ka por kan long ha kaba kut jong kine ki jingphylla ?

en: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue , the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath .
kha: Katba u Paul bad u Barnabas ki dang ïamihnoh na ka synagog , ki paidbah ki la khot sngewbha ïa ki ban wan biang ha ka sngi Sabbaton kaba bud bad ban ïathuh shuh shuh ha ki shaphang kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki Jiw ki la mih noh na ka synagog , ki Jutang ki la kyrpad ba ia kine ki ktien yn lah ban ialap ha ki ha ka sngi Sabha kaba bud .

en: He shall dwell on high : his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks : bread shall be given him  ; his waters shall be sure .
kha: Te phin long shngain ; phin long skhem kum ka kut bakhlaiñ . Phin don ka jingbam ban bam bad ka um ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Un shong ha jrong: ka jaka iada jong u kan long ki tiar ialeh jong ki maw: yn ai ia u kpu; ki um jong u kin long kiba thikna .

en: For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage  ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .
kha: Naba haba kiba la ïap kin mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng ba kin ym shongkurim shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba kin mihpat na kiba iap, kim ju shongkurim, lymne kim ju shah ai ha ka jingshongkurim ; hynrei ki long kum ki angel kiba don ha bneng .

en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .
kha: Namar u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkheiñ ïa ki hok ki briew jong u bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U  Trai  u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Trai u la pynhiar ia u Judah namar u Ahash u syiem Israel ; namar u la pynlong ia u Judah uba lyngkhuid bad u la iaid lait ia U Trai .

en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .
kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlem da pud kum ka jingkñia da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingainguh da ki rmiang shyntur kiba phla ïa u kum U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u to ngin ai ia ka jingknia iaroh ia U Blei man ka por , kata ka long ka soh jong ki rmiang shyntur jong ngi da kaba ainguh ia ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And the woman said to Elijah , Now by this I know that thou art a man of God , and that the word of the  Lord  in thy mouth is truth .
kha: Ka la jubab ,  Mynta nga tip ba me long u briew jong U Blei , bad ba U  Trai  da shisha u kren lyngba jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la ong ha u Elijah: Mynta nga tip ba me long u briew jong U Blei bad ba ka ktien U Trai ha ka shyntur jong me ka long ka jingshisha .

en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Solomon u la leh , ka jingtrei jong u bad ka jingstad jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori U Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam u Solomon bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh bad ka jingstad jong u , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka Kitab ki kam u Solomon ?

en: And if the priest see that , behold , the scab spreadeth in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a leprosy .
kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u sa shisien , bad lada kata ka prum ka la pur , un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid ; ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u lyngdoh u iohi ia kata, ha khmih, ka sniehdoh ka saphriang ha ka sniehdoh, te u lyngdoh un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh .

en: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Da kumta , phin weng noh ïa ka jingshah kynnoh pop napdeng jong phi , haba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to weng noh ia ka pop jong ka snam kaba khlem pop na pdeng jong phi , haba me leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza  ; and God smote him there for his error  ; and there he died by the ark of God .
kha: Hangta hi U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Ussah bad u la pynïap ïa u namar ka jingbymburom jong u . U Ussah u la ïap hangta hajan ka Synduk ka Jutang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei ha Uzza ; bad U Blei u la pynkhih ia u hangta namar ka jingbakla jong u ; bad hangta u la iap da ka synduk U Blei .

en: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the  Lord  , and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw , U  Trai  u la pyn-i ha nga ïa u Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh uba ïeng ha khmat u angel jong U  Trai . Bad hangta hajan jong u Joshua la ïeng u Soitan , uba la khreh ban wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyni ia nga u Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh uba ieng ha khmat u angel U Trai , bad u Soitan uba ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong u ban pyrshah ia u .

en: But me , even me thy servant , and Zadok the priest , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and thy servant Solomon , hath he not called .
kha: Hynrei , kynrad , um shym khot sngewbha ïa nga , lane ïa u Sadok u lyngdoh lane ïa u Benaïah lane ïa u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma nga, wat ma nga ruh, bad u Sadok u lyngdoh bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada bad u shakri jong me u Solomon, um shym la khot ia u .

en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .
kha: Lada phi pynmong ïa la u parabangeit namar kaei kaba phi bam , te phim leh shuh na ka jingieit . To wat ai ba ka jingbam kaba phi bam kan pynsniew ïa u briew ïa uba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta jong u!
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u hynmen jong me u sngewsih ia ka doh jong me, mynta wat iaid kai . Wat pynduh ia u da ka doh jong me, na ka bynta jong u U Khrist u la iap .

en: But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .
kha: Bad u Isaïah u la long uba kham shlur haba u ong ,  Ïa nga la shem da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la paw ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Isaiah u long uba shlur bha, bad u ong, la lap ia nga na ki kiba wad ia nga ym shuh shuh .

en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe : for there is no difference :
kha: U Blei u pynlong ka hok bad ki briew lyngba ka jingngeit jong ki ha U Jisu Khrist . U Blei u leh ïa kane ïa baroh kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , namar ym don satia kano kano ka jingïapher :
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ka hok U Blei kaba long da ka jingngeit U Jisu Khrist ha baroh bad ha kito baroh kiba ngeit: namar ym don jingiapher:

en: How is Sheshach taken ! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised ! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations !
kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Babilon :  Ïa ka nongbah kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la ïaroh la kurup ïa ka ! Katno kaba itriem ban ïohi ba ka Babilon ka la long ïa ki jaitbynriew !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno la shim ia u Sheshak ! bad kumno ka jingiaroh ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la lyngngoh ! kumno ka Babilon ka kylla long ka jinglyngngoh hapdeng ki jaitbynriew !

en: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller : as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them .
kha: Ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki la knieh bad la rah noh kum ka jinglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingjot jong phi kan sa lum kum ka jinglum lang jong u khniang: kumba u mareh sha ki khnai un mareh halor jong ki .

en: And we took their land , and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to the half tribe of Manasseh .
kha: Hynrei ngi la jop ïa ki , ngi knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , bad ngi pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad , bad ha ki shiteng na ka jait Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la shim ia ka ri jong ki bad ngi la ai ia ka kum ka pateng ha ki Reuben bad ha ki Gad bad ha ka shnong Manasseh .

en: But thou shalt surely kill him  ; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterwards the hand of all the people .
kha: Pynïap ïa u ! Sdang nyngkong ma phi ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad nangta uwei pa uwei ruh un lynthem maw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban pyniap shisha ia u; ka kti jong me kan long nyngkong eh ha u ban pyniap ia u, bad hadien kata ka kti jong ki briew baroh .

en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps , neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the  Lord .
kha: Kim sumar ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki la khyllem , lymne ba ki tei pat ïa ki kynroh , bad kumta ym lah ban ïada ïa ka Israel haba wan ka thma ha ka sngi ka jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim shym la leit sha ki thliew , lymne ban pynlong ia ka jingkhang na ka bynta ka iing Israel ban ieng ha ka thma ha ka sngi U Trai .

en: He said the new hall would be spread over 30 , 000 square feet and around 5 , 000 devotees would partake langar at one point of time .
kha: U la ong ba kane ka hall thymmai kan heh haduh 30, 000 square feet bad kumba 5,000 ngut ki nongmane kin iashim langar ha kawei ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ba ia ka hall thymmai yn sa pynphriang haduh 30 000 phut square bad kumba 5 000 ngut ki nongmane kin iashim bynta lang ha kawei ka por .

en: And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben–ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
kha: Ka khun kaba ar ruh ka la kha khun shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Ben-ammi . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Ammon haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba kham rit ruh ka la kha khun shynrang bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Benammi: kumjuh ruh u kpa jong ki khun Ammon haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Then said he unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations than these .
kha: U la kylli ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katai ? Men sa ïohi shuh shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Hato me la iohi ia kane, ko khun u briew? phai biang ia me, bad men sa iohi ia ki jingleh bymman kiba kham khraw ban ia kine .

en: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes : also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah .
kha: Ha Riblah u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Sedekaïah katba u Sedekaïah u dang peit , bad u la pynïap ruh ïa ki rangbah synshar jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Babilon u la pyniap ia ki khun shynrang jong u Sedekaiah ha Riblah ha khmat jong u: kumjuh ruh u syiem Babilon u la pyniap ia ki rangbah jong u Judah baroh .

en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the  Lord  in Jerusalem : and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong ki pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Josiah u la leh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ha U Trai ha Jerusalem : bad ki la pyniap ia ka jingkhawai Niam ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ba nyngkong .

en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee , or Tychicus , be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis : for I have determined there to winter .
kha: Ynda nga phah ïa u Artemas lane ïa u Tukhikos sha me , ïaleh shitom ban wan sha nga ha Nikopolis , namar nga la rai ban pynlut ïa ka tlang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ngan phah ia u Artema sha me, ne u Tikhikos, to long kiba minot ban wan sha nga sha Nicopolis: namar nga la kut jingmut hangta ban leit sha ka por lyiur .

en: And he arose , and did eat and drink , and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God .
kha: U Elijah u la khie joit , u bam bad u dih bad ka jingbam ka la ai bor ïa u ban ïaid sawphew sngi sha Sinai , u lum bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la bam bad u la dih ia kata ka jingbam sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet haduh Horb u lum U Blei .

en: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom , and of the fields of Gomorrah : their grapes are grapes of gall , their clusters are bitter :
kha: Ki nongshun jong ki , kiba jyrsieh kum ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , ki long kum ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba sei ki soh kiba kthang bad don bih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u sohjew jong ki u long na u sohjew jong ka Sodom bad na ki lyngkha Gomorrah: ki sohjew jong ki ki long ki sohjew gall , ki kynhun jong ki ki long kiba sngewsih:

en: If the BJP is given a chance to form Government in Odisha , the State would witness quick development like Uttar Pradesh , said Yogi .
kha: Lada ailad ia ka BJP ban thaw Sorkar ha Odisha ka Jylla kan sakhi ia ka roi ka par kaba stet kum ka Uttar Pradesh , ong u Yogi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ai lad ia ka BJP ban thaw ia ka Sorkar ha Odisha , ka Jylla kan sakhi ia ka jingroi kaba stet kum ka Uttar Pradesh , la ong u Yogi .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that God did tempt Abraham , and said unto him , Abraham : and he said , Behold , here I am .
kha: Hadien khyndiat por , U Blei u la tynjuh ïa u Abraham ; u khot ïa u ,  Abraham !  Bad u Abraham u jubab ,  Oi , nga hangne !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kine kiei kiei, ba U Blei u la tynjuh ia u Abraham, bad u la ong ha u, U Abraham: bad u la ong: Ha khmih, hangne nga don .

en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , kumta ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la ong ïa u ,  To mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judia , ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba me leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki la ong ha u, To leit noh nangta, bad leit sha Judaea, ba ki synran jong me ruh kin iohi ia ki kam kiba me leh .

en: I said in mine heart , God shall judge the righteous and the wicked : for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work .
kha: Nga ong ha lade ,  U Blei un bishar kumjuh ïa uba hok bad uba sniew , namar kaei kaei baroh , kano kano ka jingleh , kan jia ha ka por ba la buh ïa ka hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong ha ka dohnud jong nga , U Blei un bishar ia kiba hok bad kiba sniew: namar ka don ka por hangta na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka jingthmu bad na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka kam .

en: And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .
kha: U Moses bad u Joshua ki la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ki hangta ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha ka ïingjaiñ ha u lum jong u lyoh: bad u lum jong u lyoh u la ieng halor ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And Leah also with her children came near , and bowed themselves : and after came Joseph near and Rachel , and they bowed themselves .
kha: nangta ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka ki la wan , bad khatduh eh , u Joseph bad ka Rakhel ki la wan bad ki nguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Leah ruh bad ki khun jong ka ki la wan hajan bad ki la dem khrup: bad hadien u Joseph u la wan hajan bad u Rakhel bad ki la dem khrup .

en: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God , and do his commandments and his statutes , which I command thee this day .
kha: kumta kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei namarkata ban kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me bad leh ia ki hukum jong u bad ki ain jong u kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi .

en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin ïohlait im ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me la iohsngew ia kaei kaba ki syiem Assyria ki la leh ha ki ri baroh: bad me shah pyllait im ?

en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day , and shall look : and , behold , if the plague be spread in the walls of the house  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un leit biang bad khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un wan biang ha ka sngi kaba hynriew bad un peit: bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam ka saphriang ha ki kynroh jong ka iing;

en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :
kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar ngan pynïap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka kyrteng bathymmai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin iehnoh ia ka kyrteng jong phi na ka bynta ka jingtim ha nga: namar U Trai Blei un pyniap ia me, bad un khot ia ki shakri jong u da kawei pat ka kyrteng:

en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it , because they wrought for me , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan ai ha u ïa ka Ijipt kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki jingtrei jong u , namar ka kynhun shipai jong u ka trei na ka bynta jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ai ia u ia ka ri Ijipt na ka bynta ka jingtrei shitom jong u ha kaba u la shakri pyrshah ia ka , namar ki la trei na ka bynta jong nga , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering , and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings .
kha: Kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop , bad ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem kum ka jingainguh pynïasuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin knia ia uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , bad arngut ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong na ka bynta ka jingknia jingsuk .

en: And he put garrisons in Edom  ; and all the Edomites became David s servants . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
kha: U pynïeng ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha baroh ka ri Edom , bad ki briew hangta ki kylla long ki raïot jong u Syiem Dabid . U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa u Dabid ha kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki shipai ha Edom ; bad ki nong Edom baroh ki la kylla long ki shakri jong u Dabid . Kumta U Trai u la pynneh pynsah ia u Dabid shano shano ruh ba u leit .

en: And , lo , it was all grown over with thorns , and nettles had covered the face thereof , and the stone wall thereof was broken down .
kha: Ki long kiba dap da ki bniap shiah bad mih da ki ñiut suda . Ka kynroh maw baroh sawdong ka la twa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la thung lut ia ka da ki tnat, bad ki bniat ki la tap ia ka khmat jong ka, bad ka jingkhang maw jong ka ka la tyrkhong .

en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;
kha: U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , lem bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop —
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba u syiem u Dabid ruh u la aiti ha U Trai, da ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la aiti na ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba u la pyndem;

en: When I was daily with you in the temple , ye stretched forth no hands against me : but this is your hour , and the power of darkness .
kha: Nga la don bad phi ha ka Templ man ka sngi , bad phim shym la pyrshang ban kem ïa nga . Hynrei kane ka dei ka kynta jong phi ban leh , haba ka bor jong ka jingdum ka synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la don bad phi man ka sngi ha ka tempi , phim shym la pynkhih kti pyrshah ia nga: hynrei kane ka dei ka por jong phi bad ka bor jong ka jingdum .

en: Kppen began a systematic study of the climate and also experimented with balloons to obtain data from upper layers of the atmosphere .
kha: U Kppen u la sdang ia ka jingpule kaba ryntih ia ka jinglong ka suinbneng bad u la leh ruh ia ki jingpyrshang da ki balloon ban ioh ia ki jingtip na ki bynta ba shalor jong ka suinbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kppen u la sdang ia ka jingpule kaba ryntih ia ka jinglong ka suinbneng bad u la pyrshang ruh da ki ballon ban ioh ia ki jingtip na ki bynta ba shalor jong ka suinbneng .

en: And Jacob s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God s stead , who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?
kha: U Jakob u la sngewbitar ïa ka Rakhel bad u ong ,  Ngam lah ban shim ïa ka jaka U Blei . Dei ma u uba khang ïa pha ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la bthei ha ka Rakhel: bad u la ong: Hato nga long ha ka jaka jong U Blei uba la buhrieh na me ia u soh jong ka kpoh ?

en: Take the girdle that thou hast got , which is upon thy loins , and arise , go to Euphrates , and hide it there in a hole of the rock .
kha: Khie leit sha ka Wah Ïuphratis bad buhrieh ïa ki patlun lyngkot hapoh ka thliew ha ki mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jingkhang kaba me la ioh, kaba don ha ki tyrpeng jong me, bad to khie, leit sha Euphrates, bad to buhrieh ia ka hangta ha ka thliew maw .

en: Then said Absalom , If not , I pray thee , let my brother Amnon go with us . And the king said unto him , Why should he go with thee ?
kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ong ,  Lada kumta te , phin shah mo la kumno kumno ïa u Amnon , u para jong nga ban wan ?   Balei un leit ?  u syiem u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Absalom, Lada ym dei, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba u hynmen jong nga un leit bad ngi . Bad u syiem u la ong ha u: Balei u dei ban leit bad me ?

en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain : for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
kha: ‘ Wat pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , naba nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ngan pynshitom ïa uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shim ia ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong me khlem da don pop: namar U Trai un ym bat ia u khlem pop uba shim ia ka kyrteng jong u khlem da don pop .

en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :
kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , lane kum ka jingainguh jingpynïasuk ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me pynkhreh ia u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia thang ne na ka bynta ka jingknia ha kaba leh ia ka jingkular ne ki jingknia jingsuk ha U Trai:

en: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal–cain , an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah .
kha: Ka Sillah ka la kha ïa u Tubal Kain , uba dei u kamar uba shna ïa ki jait tiar baroh na ka rnong bad ka nar . Ka para jong u Tubal Kain ka dei ka Naamah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Zillah ruh ka la kha ia u Tubalcain, u nonghikai jong uwei pa uwei u nongshna nar bad ka nar: bad ka para jong u Tubalcain ka long ka Naamah .

en: And the Philistine said to David , Come to me , and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air , and to the beasts of the field .
kha: Wan shane ,  u kob ïa u Dabid ,  bad ngan ai ïa ka met jong me ha ki sim bad ha ki mrad ba kin bam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philistia u la ong ha u Dabid: To wan sha nga bad ngan ai ia ka doh jong me ha ki sim Iyer bad ha ki mrad khlaw .

en: And again the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he moved David against them to say , Go , number Israel and Judah .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki Israel sa shisien , bad kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban wanrah jingjynjar halor jong ki . U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit bad ñiew ïa ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki Israel , bad u la pynkhih ia u Dabid pyrshah ia ki ban ong , Leit , u Israel bad u Judah .

en: The burden of the desert of the sea . As whirlwinds in the south pass through  ; so it cometh from the desert , from a terrible land .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Babilonia . Kum ka  erlangthari kaba sar sha shiliang ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot kan wan na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ka ri khlaw jong ka duriaw . Kumba ki lyer ha ka liang sepngi ki iaid lyngba ka ; kumta ka wan na ka ri khlaw , na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .

en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por U  Trai  u la ong ha u Aaron ,  Khie leit sha ka ri shyiap ban ïakynduh ïa u Moses .  Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhuid ; bad haba u ïashem bad u , u doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Aaron, To leit sha ka ri khlaw ban iakynduh ia u Moses . U la leit , bad u la iakynduh ia u ha u lum U Blei , bad u la kdup ia u .

en: And Jehoash slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel  ; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoash u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u ha Samaria bad ki syiem Israel bad u Jeroboam u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you  ; and the  Lord  will not hear you in that day .
kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , phin sa lynñiar kthang namar u Syiem jong phi , uba phi hi da lade phi la jied , hynrei U  Trai  un ym sngap ïa ki jingud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin pyrta ha kata ka sngi namar u syiem jong phi uba phi la jied ia phi ; bad U Trai un ym iohsngew ia phi ha kata ka sngi .

en: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof .
kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ki Amor baroh , lem bad ïa ka Heshbon bad ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jong ka , bad ki la shong la sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la shim ia kine ki shnong baroh: bad ki Israel ki shong ha ki shnong Amorit baroh , ha Heshbon bad ha ki shnong jong ka baroh .

en: Who hath woe ? who hath sorrow ? who hath contentions ? who hath babbling ? who hath wounds without cause ? who hath redness of eyes ?
kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa uno uno uba dih kyrni , uba pyrshang katto katne ka jingdih bathymmai , bad nga pyn-i ïa phi ïa uwei uba kordit bad sngewsih na ka bynta ïa lade , uba pynmih jingeh borabor , bad uba khñium borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba don ka jingjynjar ? mano ba don ka jingsngewsih ? mano ba don ki jingkynthoh ? mano ba don ki jingmynsaw khlem daw ? mano ba don ki khmat kiba saw ?

en: And he was afraid , and said , How dreadful is this place ! this is none other but the house of God , and this is the gate of heaven .
kha: U la sheptieng bad u ong ,  Kane ka jaka kaba da sngewphieng ! Kan dei ban long ka ïing jong U Blei , ka dei ban long ka khyrdop ba plie sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tieng bad u la ong: Katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ia kane ka jaka ! kane kam dei kawei pat hynrei ka iing U Blei bad kane ka dei ka khyrdop bneng .

en: Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Uno uno uba la dep sum u long uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjat . Baroh na phi , phi long kiba khuid — baroh lait noh uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u , Uta uba la sait um donkam ban sait ia ki kjat jong u , hynrei u long uba khuid man la ka sngi: bad phi long kiba khuid , hynrei ym baroh .

en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;
kha: Nangta phin lah ban im kumba U Trai u kwah bad ba phin ïai leh borabor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Ka jingim jong phi kan pynmih ïa baroh ki jingleh babha babun jait , bad phin san ha ka jingtip jong phi ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin iaid hok ia U Trai ha ka jingsngewbha baroh, da kaba long kiba seisoh ha ka kam babha baroh, bad nang kiew ha ka jingtip ia U Blei;

en: The resolution also recalled Karunanidhis role in the Dravidian movement and lauded him for his services to the Tamils and the state .
kha: Ka resolution ka la pynkynmaw ruh ia ka bynta jong u Karunanidhi ha ka jingiakhih jong ki Dravidian bad ka la iaroh ia u namar ka jingshakri jong u ia ki Tamil bad ia ka jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka resolution ka la pynkynmaw ruh ia ka bynta jong u Karnanidhi ha ka jingkhih jong ka Dravidian bad ka la iaroh ia u na ka bynta ki jingshakri jong u ia ki Tamil bad ka jylla .

en: Let us walk honestly , as in the day ; not in rioting and drunkenness , not in chambering and wantonness , not in strife and envying .
kha: To ngin leh donakor , kum ki briew kiba im ha ka jingshai jong ka sngi — khlem ki jingsngewbha thala bakhynwin ne ka jingïabuaid , khlem ka jingleh awria lane ka jingleh khlem akor , khlem ka jingïashoh ïadat lane ka jingbishni .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin iaid hok, kumba ha ka sngi ; ym ha ka jingkulmar bad ka jingdih buaid, ym ha ka kamra bad ka jingkwah brai, ym ha ka jingialeh bad ka jingsngewsih .

en: And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .
kha: Un shim ïa ki shakri jong phi , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , bad un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ki shakri shynrang jong phi, bad ki shakri kynthei jong phi, bad ki samla kiba bha tam jong phi, bad ki tdong jong phi, bad un buh ia ki ha ka kam jong u .

en: If we receive the witness of men , the witness of God is greater : for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son .
kha: Ngi ngeit ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; hynrei ka jingphla U Blei ka long kaba kham khlaiñ , bad u la ai ïa kane ka jingphla shaphang U Khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngi pdiang ia ka jingphla jong ki briew , ka jingphla U Blei ka kham khraw: namar kane ka long ka jingphla U Blei kaba u la pynshisha ia u Khun jong u .

en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way  ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .
kha: U paidbah babun u la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup ha lynti katba kiwei pat ki la khyllad da ki tnat dieng bad ki la siang ïa ki ha lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah uba bun bha u la pynphriang ia ki jain jong ki ha ka lynti ; kiwei pat ki ot ia ki tnat na ki dieng , bad ki la sdang ia ki ha lynti .

en: A drought is upon her waters  ; and they shall be dried up : for it is the land of graven images , and they are mad upon their idols .
kha: Wallam ïa ka jingrang ryngkhiang ha ka ri jong ka bad pynrngad lut ïa ki wah jong ka . Ka Babilonia ka long ka ri jong ki bleithaw ba-ishyrkhei , kiba la pynkylla bieit ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhriat ka don ha ki um jong ka ; bad kin sa tyrkhong: namar ka long ka ri jong ki dur ba la ker , bad ki la mad ia ki bleithaw jong ki .

en: And it came to pass at the return of the year , that Ben–hadad numbered the Syrians , and went up to Aphek , to fight against Israel .
kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud u la khot ïa ki rangbah bad u leit bad ki sha ka nongbah Aphek ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba la wan phai u snem, ba u Benhamad u la khein ia ki Syria bad u la leit sha Aphek ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses , inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house .
kha: U briew uba tei ïa ka ïing u ïoh kham bun ka burom ban ïa ka ïing hi . Ha kajuh ka rukom U Jisu u long uba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta une u briew la khein ba u long uba bit ban ioh ia ka burom kaba kham bun ban ia u Moses , namar ba uta uba la tei ia ka iing u kham don ka burom ban ia ka iing .

en: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud : for the glory of the  Lord  had filled the house of the  Lord .
kha: uba tyngshaiñ da ka jingshai kaba thaba na ka jingdon U  Trai  , bad kim shym lah shuh ban leit shapoh ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh kim lah ban ieng namar u lyoh: namar ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ia ka iing U Trai .

en: Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Babilon ,  To shong ha ka jingjar jar bad ha ka jingdum ; kin ym khot shuh ïa pha ka syiem jong ki jaitbynriew !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap jar, bad to rung ha ka jingdum, ko khun jong ki Khaldi: namar ia me yn ym khot shuh ia me, Ka kynthei jong ki hima .

en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God ,
kha: khnang ba ha ka por ba mynta lyngba ka Balang , ki angel nongsynshar bad ki bor ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng ki lah ban tip ïa ka jingstad jong u ha baroh ki rukom ba-ïapher jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingthmu ba mynta ha ki hima bad ki bor ha ki jaka bneng lah ban tip da ka balang ia ka jingstad ba bun jait jong U Blei , .

en: Be thou prepared , and prepare for thyself , thou , and all thy company that are assembled unto thee , and be thou a guard unto them .
kha: To ïathuh ha u ban pynkloi bad ban pynkhreh ïa la ki kynhun baroh hapoh ka jingïalam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba la pynkhreh bad pynkhreh ia lade, ma me bad ka kynhun jong me baroh kiba la ialum lang ha me, bad to long u nongap ia ki .

en: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath , and commandedst them precepts , statutes , and laws , by the hand of Moses thy servant :
kha: Me hikai ïa ki ban sumar khuid ïa ki sngi Sabbaton , bad lyngba u shakri jong me u Moses me ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la tip ia ki ha ka sngi saitjain bakhuid jong me, bad la hukum ia ki ia ki jingbthah, ki ain bad ki ain, da ka kti u Moses u shakri jong me:

en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba san phi lah ban bam ïa u soh . Lada phi leh ïa kane baroh , ki diengsoh jong phi kin seisoh kham bun . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka snem kaba phra phin bam ia u soh jong ka, ba un ai ha phi ia ka jingmih jong ka: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .
kha: U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu bad kim ñiewburom ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaiñkup ba-itynnat halor jong u bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Pilat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Herod bad ki shipai jong u ki la buh ia u ha ka por mynstep, bad u la rkhie bein ia u, bad u la pynbeit ia u da ka jainkup kaba itynnad, bad u la phah biang ia u sha u Pilat .

en: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
kha: Khmih ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga , bad peit ba dei ma nga hi . Tba ïa nga , bad phin tip , naba ka rngai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , kumba phi ïohi ba nga don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga, ba nga long ma nga hi: to bat ia nga, bad peit namar ka mynsiem kam don doh bad ki shyieng, kumba phi iohi ia nga .

en: And it came to pass the day after , that he went into a city called Nain  ; and many of his disciples went with him , and much people .
kha: Shen hadien kata , U Jisu u la leit sha ka shnong kaba la khot , ka Nain , ki synran jong u lem bad u paidbah babun ki la ïadon ryngkat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, u la leit sha kawei ka shnong kaba la khot u Nain ; bad bun na ki synran jong u ki la leit ryngkat bad u bad bun ki briew .

en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?
kha: Kine ki maw kin pynkynmaw ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh . Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kane kan long ka dak hapdeng jong phi , ba haba ki khun jong phi ki kylli ia ki kpa jong ki ha ka por ban wan , ki ong , Kaei kaba phi mut da kine ki maw ?

en: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned , and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah .
kha: Haba ki koidi jong u Ishmael ki la ïohi ïa u Johanan bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki shipai lem bad u , ki la kmen , bad phai bad mareh sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew baroh kiba u Ishmael u la rah noh na Mizpah ki la leit phai noh bad ki la leit phai noh sha u Johanan u khun u Karah .

en: And cast him out of the city , and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man s feet , whose name was Saul .
kha: Ki sakhi ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsumar u samla uba kyrteng u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret noh ia u na ka shnong , bad u la pynkhih ia u: bad ki sakhi ki la buh ia ki jain jong ki ha ki kjat jong u samla uba kyrteng u Saul .

en: Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
kha: Teh jin ha ki kulai jong phi bad shong halor jong ki ! Ïeng ryntih bad phong ïa ki jingda khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong phi ! Kieng ïa ka atiar jong phi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ki kulai ; bad khie noh, phi ki kulai , bad ieng sha khmat bad ki helmet jong phi ; ki pynkhih ia ki khnam , bad buh ia ki khnam .

en: And he said unto me , This chamber , whose prospect is toward the south , is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the house .
kha: Uta u briew u la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shathie ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba lehniam ha ka templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha nga , Kane ka kamra kaba ka jingkyrmen jong ka ka long shaphang shathie , ka long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , ki nongsumar ia ka iing .

en: And they shall turn the rivers far away  ; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up : the reeds and flags shall wither .
kha: Ki shnat jong ka wah kin iwtung katba ki dang rngad suki suki . Ki khah bad ki japung kin jlop ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynphai noh ia ki wah ; bad ki wah iada kin sa tyrkhong bad tyrkhong: ki thliew bad ki lama kin tyrkhong .

en: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .
kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa me namar ba me long u briew uba eh . Me shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong me bad ot ïa kaei kaba mem shym bet .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la tieng ia me, namar me long u briew uba rit paid: me shim ia kata ba me la thiah , bad me kheit ba me la bet .

en: And while they went to buy , the bridegroom came  ; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage : and the door was shut .
kha: Kumta ki theisotti kiba bieit ki la ïaleit ban thied khyndiat ka umphniang ; bad katba ki dang leit , la wan poi u nongleitkurim . Ki san ngut kiba la pynkhreh ki la ïaleit shapoh lem bad u sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , bad ïa ka jingkhang la khang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang leit thied, u nongleit kurim u la wan ; bad kita kiba la pynkhreh ki la leit rung bad u sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim : bad ka jingkhang ka la khang .

en: I have blotted out , as a thick cloud , thy transgressions , and , as a cloud , thy sins : return unto me  ; for I have redeemed thee .
kha: Nga la weng noh ïa ki pop jong phi kum ïa u lyoh . To wan phai pat sha nga ; nga long uta uba la pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la bthei, kum u lyoh uba jylliew, bad kum u lyoh, ki pop jong me: to wan phai sha nga ; namar nga la siewspah ia me .

en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?
kha: Hato ka turoi thma ka ju sawa ha ka nongbah khlem da pynlong ïa ki briew ban sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka ju ngat ha ka nongbah lymda U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato yn pynbthei ia ka turoi ha ka nongbah , bad ki briew kin ym tieng ? hato kan don ka jingsniew ha ka nongbah , bad U Trai um shym la leh ia kata ?

en: And he said unto them ,  Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phim ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka por mynba u la donkam ei ei ban bam ? Ma u bad ki rangbah kiba bad u ki la ïa-thngan ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Hato phim pat ju pule ia kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh haba u la donkam bad u la thngan, ma u bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u ?

en: Is any man called being circumcised ? let him not become uncircumcised . Is any called in uncircumcision ? let him not be circumcised .
kha: Lada u briew uba la lah otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban pyrshang ban weng noh ïa ki dak jong ka jingotsher ; lada u briew uba khlem otsher u la pdiang ïa ka jingkhot U Blei , um dei ban shah otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato la khot ia uno uno u briew uba la shah ot ? wat ai ba un kylla long u bym pat shah ot . Hato don mano mano ba la khot ha ka jingbymkhuid ? wat ai ba un shah ot .

en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim burom ïa nga , kumta nga phah ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ki khynnah kiba khlem akor bad kiba jemnud . Nga phah ia me sha ki bad me dei ban ong ha ki , Kumta ong U Trai Blei .

en: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
kha: Ka miet ka la jan kut , ka sngi ka la jan sdang . To ngin ïasangeh noh na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba long jong ka jingdum , bad to ngin kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh ha ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka miet ka la jah noh, ka sngi ka la jan: to ngin bret noh namarkata ia ki kam jong ka jingdum , bad to ngin buh ia ka jainkup jong ka jingshai .

en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain , or if I command the locusts to devour the land , or if I send pestilence among my people  ;
kha: Man ba nga khang ïa u slap ba un ym hap lane phah ïa ki puit ban bam ïa ki jingthung lane phah ïa ka khlam ha ki briew jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga khang ia ka bneng ba ym don slap , lane lada nga hukum ia ki khnai ban bam ia ka ri , lane lada nga phah ia ka jingpang ha ki briew jong nga ; .

en: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit ban bam ha ka ïing jong uwei na ki Pharisi kiba kham pawkhmat ; bad ki briew ki la khmih bha ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan ha ka iing jong uwei na ki rangbah Pharisi ban bam ia u kpu ha ka sngi Sabha .

en: These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .
kha: Kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl , kine ki aiñ ki ïarap ïa ngi ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew manbriew , ban burom ïa kiwei , bad ban long kiba sbun bad kiba leh hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki jinglong, kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl, ki pynroi ia ka jingbha jingmiat bad ka jingburom ia kiwei pat, ryngkat bad ki jinglong kum ka jinglong hok bad ka jingbhabriew .

en: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and disperse them among the countries  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki nong Ijipt kylleng ka pyrthei . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia ki nong Ijipt hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan pynphriang ia ki hapdeng ki ri bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And some of them said , Could not this man , which opened the eyes of the blind , have caused that even this man should not have died ?
kha: Hynrei don na ki kiba la ong ,  U la pynpeit ïa ki khmat uba matlah , ym dei ? Hato un ym lah ban ïa u Lasaros bat ym ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don napdeng jong ki kiba la ong: Hato une u briew uba la plie ia ki khmat jong kiba matlah um shym la pynlong ia kane wat ia une u briew ruh um shym la iap ?

en: And the Jews  passover was nigh at hand : and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover , to purify themselves .
kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan , bad bun ki briew ki la leit kiew na ki nongkyndong sha Jerusalem ban pyndep ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la jan poi sha ka ri: bad bun ki la leit sha Jerusalem shuwa ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba khuid ia lade .

en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
kha: Ko kynrad ,  kata ka briew ka la ong ,  mem don ïa ka jingtong , bad ka pukri ka long kaba jylliew . Nangno men ïoh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingim ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka ong ha u, ko Sir, me don ei ei ban tan bad ka thliew ka long kaba jylliew: nangno te me don kata ka um kaba im ?

en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the  Lord  : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan uta u bnai , ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ka sdang ; hynñiew sngi lynter phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u juh u bnai ka long ka jingkhawai jong u kpu khlem thied ha U Trai: hynriew sngi phi dei ban bam ia u kpu khlem thied .

en: And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .
kha: Ki briew ki la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki ban pynkloi bad rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong ngi , tad haduh ba ki khmat jong ngi kin dap da ki ummat , bad ba ki irmat jong ngi ki jhieh na kaba ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba kin pynkloi ia ngi, bad kin shim ia ka jingsawa na ka bynta jong ngi, ba ki khmat jong ngi kin tuid da ki ummat , bad ki khmat jong ngi kin tuid da ki um .

en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga dei uei keiñ bad kaei ka longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Saul, Nga long mano ? bad kaei ka jingim jong nga ne ka iing jong u kpa jong nga ha Israel , ba nga dei ban long u khun shynrang jong u syiem ?

en: The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi , bad un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba phi la ïohi ïa u ba u leh ha Ijipt
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi uba leit ha khmat jong phi, un ialeh na ka bynta jong phi, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi ha Ijipt ha khmat ki khmat jong phi;

en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face :
kha: bad kin ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh . Dei ban ïalam ïa ka shabar ka jaka sher dara bad dei ban pynïap ïa ka hangta ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ai ia ka ha u Eleasar ha u lyngdoh, ba un wanrah ia ka shabar ka shnong, bad uwei un pyniap ia ka ha khmat jong u:

en: And I will make your cities waste , and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation , and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours .
kha: Ha ka jingijli bakhraw , ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki shnong jong phi , ngan pynpra ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi , bad ngan kyntait ïa ki jingkñia ainguh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki shnong jong phi ban jah rngai noh , bad ngan wanrah ia ki jaka kyntang jong phi sha ka jingjot , bad ngan ym sngap ia ka jingsma jong ki jingsma ba thiang jong phi .

en: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law ; but desire to have you circumcised , that they may glory in your flesh .
kha: Wat kita kiba pdiang ïa ka jingotsher kim shym kohnguh ïa ka Hukum ; ki kwah ïa phi ban otsher khnang ba ki lah ban kob ba phi la pynkohnguh ha kane ka jinglehniam ha ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim dei ma ki hi kiba la shah ot lyngkot kiba sumar ia ka hukum ; hynrei ki kwah ban ioh ia phi ban shah ot , ba kin sngew sarong ha ka doh jong phi .

en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–heres , in the mount of Ephraim , on the north side of the hill Gaash .
kha: La tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath Serah ha ka ri lum Ephraim kaba shaphang shatei jong u Lum Gaash .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tep ia u ha u pud u sam jong u ha Timnathheres, ha u lum Ephraim, ha ka liang mihngi jong u lum Gaash .

en: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling , and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy ,
kha: Ha uta uba lah ban ri kyndong ïa phi na ka jinghap noh , bad ban wallam ïa phi kiba khlem jingduna bad kiba kmen ha khmat ka burom ka jingdon ryngkat jong u —
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha uta uba lah ban pynsangeh ia phi na ka jinghap , bad ban pyni ia phi khlem jingbakla ha khmat ka burom jong u da ka jingkmen kaba palat .

en: And there was found at Achmetha , in the palace that is in the province of the Medes , a roll , and therein was a record thus written :
kha: Hynrei ka la long ha ka nongbah Ekbatana ha ka probins    jong ka Media ba ïa ka kot kli la shem kaba don ïa kane ka jingbuh jingthoh :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la lap ha Achmetha, ha ka iing kaba don ha ka ri Media, ka roll, bad hangta la thoh kumta:

en: Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pyrta jam katba phi lah ! Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel shaphang ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To iam da kaba pyrta jam, wat nym pyllait, to pynkiew ia ka sur jong me kum ka turoi, bad to pyni ia ki briew jong nga ia ka jingleh bymman jong ki, bad ia ka iing u Jakob jong ki pop jong ki .

en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city , Hear , hear  ; say , I pray you , unto Joab , Come near hither , that I may speak with thee .
kha: La don kawei ka kynthei kaba stad hapoh ka nongbah kaba la pyrta na ka kynroh ,  Ha sngap ! Ha sngap ! Ong ïa u Joab ba un wan hangne ; nga kwah ban ïakren bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la pyrta ia kawei ka kynthei kaba stad na ka shnong, To sngap jar, to iohsngew; nga kyrpad ia phi, ha Joab , To wan hajan hangne, ba ngan iakren bad me .

en: And they answered Jesus , and said , We cannot tell . And he said unto them ,  Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things .
kha: Kumta ki la jubab ïa U Jisu ,  Ngim tip .  Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Lymne ma nga ruh ngan ym ïathuh , te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia U Jisu bad ki la ong, Ngim lah ban iathuh . Bad u la ong ha ki , Wat iathuh ia phi da ka bor aiu nga leh ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel , and Eder , and Jagur ,
kha: Ki nongbah kiba sha jngai eh shaphang shathie kiba dei ki jong ki , kito kiba hajan u pud jong ka Edom , ki long ka Kabseel , ka Eder , ka Jagur ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongbah kiba kham bun eh jong ka jaitbynriew Judah shaphang shathie ki long u Kabel bad u Eder bad u Jagur .

en: In that day shall there be an altar to the  Lord  in the midst of the land of Egypt , and a pillar at the border thereof to the  Lord .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , kan don ka duwan ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri Ijipt bad u rishot maw ba la pynkyntang sha U ha ka pud Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi kan don ka jingknia ha U Trai hapdeng ka ri Ijipt bad u maw ha u pud jong ka ha U Trai .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Get thee up into this mount Abarim , and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Leit kiew sha u Lum Abarim bad khmih ïa kata ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To kiew sha une u lum Abarim bad to peit ia ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki khun Israel .

en: Behold , all souls are mine  ; as the soul of the father , so also the soul of the son is mine : the soul that sinneth , it shall die .
kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u briew ka dei ka jong nga , ka jingim jong ka kmie , u kpa bad kumjuh ruh ka jong i khun . U briew uba leh pop u dei uta u ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih baroh ki mynsiem ki long ki jong nga; kumjuh ruh ka mynsiem u khun ka long ka jong nga: ka mynsiem kaba leh pop kan iap .

en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , u la mihpaw nyngkong ha ka Mari ka nong Magdala , na kaba u la pynmih noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba U Jisu u la mih ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka taiew , u la paw nyngkong eh ha ka Maria Magdalene , na kaba u la bret hynriew tylli ki ksuid .

en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
kha: Pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nyngkong baroh , namar kat uba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u long u jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia nga baroh ki khun nyngkong , kaei kaei kaba plie ia ka kpoh hapdeng ki khun Israel , na u briew bad na u mrad: ka long ka jong nga .

en: And he took it down , and wrapped it in linen , and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone , wherein never man before was laid .
kha: Nangta u la pynhiar ïa ka met U Jisu , u la sop ïa ka hapoh ka jaiñ linen , bad u la buh ïa ka hapoh ka jingtep ïa kaba la khlong na u mawsiang tylli bad ïa kaba ym pat ju pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka shapoh, bad u la tap ia ka da ka jain lin, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka jingtep kaba la ker ha u maw, ha kaba ym ju don briew mynno mynno ruh .

en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the  Lord  your God hath commanded you : ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .
kha: Ko phi ki Israel , wat pep ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi . Wat pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki aiñ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban peit ban leh kumta kumba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ia phi: phin ym phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Take heed to yourselves , and bear no burden on the sabbath day , nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem  ;
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba lada ki ieit ïa la ka jingim , kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit ha ka Sabbaton ; kim dei ban rah ïa kano kano shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; To sumar ia lade, bad wat kit ei ei ha ka sngi Sabha, lymne wanrah ia ka ha ki khyrdop Jerusalem ; .

en: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels  ; and then he shall reward every man according to his works .
kha: Naba U Khun U Briew u la jan wan ha ka burom jong U Kpa jong u lem bad la ki angel , bad nangta un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ki kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Khun u briew un wan ha ka burom U Kpa jong u bad ki angel jong u ; bad nangta un siew kylliang ia uwei pa uwei kat kum ki kam jong u .

en: Son of man , set thy face toward the south , and drop thy word toward the south , and prophesy against the forest of the south field  ;
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  khmih shaphang shathie . To kren pyrshah ïa kaba shathie bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka khlaw jong kaba shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me shaphang shathie, bad pynhap ia ka ktien jong me shaphang shathie, bad to iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ka khlaw jong ka lyngkha ba shathie;

en: And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u pule jam ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingkyrkhu bad ïa ki jingtim , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata u pule ia ki ktien jong ka hukum baroh , ki jingkyrkhu bad ki jingtim kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka hukum .

en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki Israel bad u pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u , da kaba iehnoh tang ïa ka hima Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la bitar shibun ia ki Israel , bad u la weng noh ia ki na ka jingpeit jong u: ym don shuh hynrei tang ka jait Judah .

en: And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the  Lord  hath sent me to do all these works  ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .
kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Da kane phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la phah ïa nga ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , bad ba ym dei da ka mon jong nga ba nga la leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Da kane phin sa tip ba U Trai u la phah ia nga ban leh ia kine ki kam baroh namar ngam shym la leh ia ki da ka jingmut jong nga hi .

en: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers , nor rejoiced  ; I sat alone because of thy hand : for thou hast filled me with indignation .
kha: Ngam shym pynlut ïa ka por jong nga bad kiwei pat ki briew , ha kaba ïa-rkhie bad ïasngewbha . Ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me nga la long marwei bad nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la shong ha ka jingiaseng jong ki nongleh thok , lymne nga la shong marwei namar ka kti jong me: namar me la pyndap ia nga da ka jingbitar .

en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
kha: Hynrei ngi dei ki jong ka sngi , bad ngi dei ban pyngngad . Ngi dei ban kup ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingda shadem , bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ngin long kiba jemnud, da kaba phong ia ka sniehdoh jong ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit ; bad na ka bynta ka helmet , ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingpynim .

en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears : and I told this unto the magicians  ; but there was none that could declare it to me .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ïa ki jingphohsniew ha ki nongleh myntor , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shkor kiba rit ki la bam ia ki hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba bha: bad nga la iathuh ia kane ha ki nongleh jadu ; hynrei ym don ba lah ban pynbna ia ka ha nga .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .
kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , u nongrah khuri jong u syiem Ijipt bad u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u ki la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, u nongkhaii jong u syiem Ijipt bad u nongshet kpu jong u ki la pynsngewsih ia u syiem Ijipt jong ki .

en: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane , and saith unto the disciples ,  Sit ye here , while I go and pray yonder .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad la ki synran sha ka jaka kaba la khot ka Gethsemane , bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shong hangne katba nga dang leit hangtai ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u wan ryngkat bad ki ha ka jaka kaba la khot Gethsemane bad u ong ha ki synran: To shong hangne katba nga leit duwai hangta .

en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die ? saith the Lord  God  : and not that he should return from his ways , and live ?
kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga kmen ban ïohi ba ki briew kiba sniew ki ïap ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kylli .  Em , nga kham mon ban ïohi ïa ki ba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga don jingsngewbha satia ba u bymman un iap ? ong U Blei uba sniew: bad ym ba u dei ban leit phai noh na ki lynti jong u , bad ban im ?

en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .
kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don u briew u ban sa leit jingleit ; u la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hima bneng ka long kum u briew uba leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , uba khot ia la ki jong ki shakri bad u la aiti ha ki ia ki mar jong u .

en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses , so do these also resist the truth : men of corrupt minds , reprobate concerning the faith .
kha: Kumba u Jannes bad u Jambres ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Moses , kumta ruh kine ki briew ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha — ki briew kiba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad kiba la shahjop ha ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kumba u Jan bad u Jambres ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u Moses, kumta kine ruh ki pyrshah ia ka jingshisha: ki briew kiba bamsap ki pyrshah ia ka jingngeit .

en: And as he thus spake for himself , Festus said with a loud voice , Paul , thou art beside thyself  ; much learning doth make thee mad .
kha: Katba u Paul u dang ïasaid da ïa lade ha kane ka rukom , u Phestos u la pyrta ha u ,  Me la lamwir , ko Paul ! Ka jingstad bakhraw jong me ka la pynlamwir ïa me !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren kumta na ka bynta lade, u Festo u la ong da ka sur kaba jam, ko Paul, me long nalor jong me; ka jingpule kaba bun ka pynlong ia me ban bieit .

en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war : for with thee will I break in pieces the nations , and with thee will I destroy kingdoms  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilonia , pha long u tyrnem jong nga , ka atiar jong nga ha ka thma . Nga la pyndonkam ïa pha ban ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki hima ,
translated_en_to_kha: Me long ka wait thma bad ki tiar thma jong nga: namar bad me ngan pynpra ia ki jaitbynriew, bad bad me ngan pynjot ia ki hima ; .

en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job : and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren .
kha: Ym don kino kino ki kynthei ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei kiba bhabriew kat ki khun kynthei jong u Job . U kpa jong ki u ai ka bhah jingïohpateng ha ki lem bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka ri baroh kawei ym shym la lap ia ki kynthei kiba itynnad kum ki khun kynthei jong u Job: bad u kpa jong ki u la ai pateng ia ki hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki .

en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Menahem u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Menahem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther , Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king s house , more than all the Jews .
kha: Wat pyrkhat ba phan kham lait im ban ïa kiwei pat ki Jiw tang namar ba pha don ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Mordecai u la hukum ban jubab ia ka Esther , Wat pyrkhat bad lade ba men lait im ha iing syiem, kham palat ia ki Jiw baroh .

en: Have you noticed in the pictures in this brochure how well-dressed Jehovah’s Witnesses are when attending their congregation meetings ?
kha: Haba phi peit ïa ki dur ha ine i kot lyngkdop , hato phi la ïohi kumno ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki riam ki beit haba ki leit sha ki jingïalang jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la iohi ha ki dur ha kane ka kot lyngkdop katno ki nongsakhi jong ka Jehobah ki long kiba la riam bha haba ki leit sha ki jingiaseng balang jong ki ?

en: Wherefore , as by one man sin entered into the world , and death by sin ; and so death passed upon all men , for that all have sinned :
kha: Ka pop ka la wan sha ka pyrthei lyngba uwei u briew , bad ka pop jong u ka la wallam ryngkat bad ka ïa ka jingïap . Ka jingmih ka long , ba ka jingïap ka la pur sha u bynriew baroh namar uwei pa uwei u la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, kumba da uwei u briew u la rung ha ka pyrthei, bad ka jingiap da ka pop ; bad kumta ka jingiap ka la iaid halor ki briew baroh:

en: Two tenons shall there be in one board , set in order one against another : thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
kha: bad ar tylli ki tnaw kiba ïabiang khnang ba yn lah ban pyndait lang ïa kita ki jingker . Baroh kita ki jingker ki dei ban don ïa kine ki tnaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ar tylli ki tenon kin don ha kawei ka lieng, la buh ha ka rukom kaba pyrshah iwei ia iwei pat: kumta me dei ban pynlong ia ki board baroh jong ka Tabernak .

en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .
kha: Na ka bynta jong phi pat , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban long kiba laitluid . Hynrei wat shah ba kane ka jinglaitluid kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ban synshar ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynlong ïa phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ko para bangeit, la khot ia phi sha ka jinglaitluid tang ban ym pyndonkam ia ka jinglaitluid na ka bynta ka por sha ka doh, hynrei da ka jingieit to shakri iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant , and on them that are out of the way  ; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity .
kha: Namar u hi u long uba tlot ha kiba bun rukom , u lah ban long uba jemnud bad kito ki bym don ka jingtip bad kiba leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban don ka jingsngewrit ia ki bym tip ; bad ha kito kiba don shabar na ka bynta kata ma u ruh u la shah ker sawdong ha ka jingbym lah kha khun .

en: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .
kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïada , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me sha ki briew kiba me sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ia me ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai: bad me ym shah aiti ha ka kti jong ki briew kiba me tieng .

en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ym don uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei lymda kha pat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha me: Lada ym kha pat ia u briew, um lah ban iohi ia ka hima U Blei .

en: And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u ïohi ïa ki Ken , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka jaka kaba phi shong ka long kaba skhem , Kaba shngain kum ka skum ba la shna shajrong halor ka synrang ;
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit ia ki Kenite, bad u la shim ia ka pharshi jong u, bad u la ong, Ka long kaba khlain ka jaka shong jong me, bad me buh ia ka bniat jong me ha u maw .

en: And she said unto her mistress , Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria ! for he would recover him of his leprosy .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka ong ïa la ka kynrad ,  Nga kwah ba u kynrad jong nga un lah ban leit sha u nongïathuhlypa uba shong ha Samaria ! Un pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha ka kynthei jong ka, Hato U Blei u kynrad jong nga un don bad u nongiathuhlypa uba don ha Samaria ! namar un sa pynkoit ia u na ka jingpang sniehdoh jong u .

en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the  Lord  , but didst fly upon the spoil , and didst evil in the sight of the  Lord  ?
kha: Balei te , ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u ? Balei phi pynstet ban kynrup ïa ki jinglute , bad leh kumta ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei te phim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai , hynrei phi la her halor ka jingjot , bad phi la leh sniew ha khmat U Trai ?

en: Now Hannah , she spake in her heart  ; only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard : therefore Eli thought she had been drunken .
kha: Ka la duwai jar jar : tang ki rmiang shyntur jong ka ki khih , hynrei kam shym pynmih sur ei ei . Kumta u Eli la u pyrkhat ba ka la buaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta Hannah , ka la kren ha ka dohnud jong ka ; tang ki rmiang shyntur jong ka kim shym la iohsngew: namarkata u Eli u la pyrkhat ba ka la dih kyiad .

en: And they journeyed from Beth–el  ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .
kha: U Jakob bad la ka longïing longsem ki la ïamihnoh na Bethel , bad haba ki la jan poi ha Ephrath , ka por ka la poi ba ka Rakhel kan kha khun , bad ka la don ha ka jingsuh kha kaba shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid na Bethesel ; bad ka la don tang khyndiat ka lynti ban poi sha Ephrath : bad ka Rakhel ka la khih, bad ka la trei shitom .

en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar : and they filled a sponge with vinegar , and put it upon hyssop , and put it to his mouth .
kha: La don ka pliang hangta , kaba dap da ka waiñ ka bym bha ; kumta la wieh ïa spoiñ ha ka waiñ , la teh ha ka khum Hissop , bad la kyntiew ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la buh ia ka umphniang kaba dap da u sohjew: bad ki la pyndap ia ka da ka sohjew , bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka shyntur jong u .

en: For in many things we offend all . If any man offend not in word , the same is a perfect man , and able also to bridle the whole body .
kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi bakla bunsien . Hynrei lada u briew um ju bakla ha kaei kaba u kren , u long uba janai bad u long ruh uba lah ban synshar ïa lade nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kiba bun kiei kiei ngi pynsngewsih ia baroh . Lada uno uno u briew um sngewsih ha ka ktien , kumjuh ruh u briew uba janai , bad uba lah ruh ban pynkhih ia ka met baroh kawei .

en: As we said before , so say I now again , If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received , let him be accursed .
kha: Kumba Ngi la ong mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ong biang ïa ka : Lada uno uno u ïalap ha phi ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata kaba phi la pdiang , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ngi la ong mynshuwa , kumta nga ong biang mynta , Lada uno uno u ialap ia phi ia kawei pat ka gospel kaba phi la ioh , to un shah tim .

en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile  ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .
kha: Hynrei haba u briew da kaba bitar u pynïap khnang ïa uwei pat , dei ban pynïap ïa u , wat la u wan ban rieh ha ka duwan jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u briew u wan hiar thma ia u paramarjan jong u, ban pyniap ia u da ka jingsngewsih ; me dei ban shim ia u na ka altar jong nga, ba un iap .

en: But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .
kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wat lada phim ngeit ïa nga , phi la dei ban ngeit ïa ki kam jong nga , khnang ba phi lah ban tip shi syn tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada nga leh, wat la phim ngeit ia nga, to ngeit ia ki kam: ba phin tip bad ngeit, ba U Kpa u don ha nga bad nga ha u .

en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .
kha: Nangta u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Sadok u ong ha u Joab ,  Shah ngan leit sha u syiem bad ka khubor babha ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u na ki nongshun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ahimaas u khun u Sadok u la ong: To ngan mareh mynta, bad nga shah ia ki khubor syiem, kumno ba U Trai u la pynrem ia u na ki nongshun jong u .

en: And the king of Israel answered and said , Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off .
kha: U syiem Ahab u la jubab ,  Ïathuh ïa u syiem Benhadad ba u shipai bashisha u kob  hadien  jong ka thma , ym ha shuwa jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la jubab bad u la ong: To iathuh ia u , Wat ai ba uta uba la tyrkhong ha ka sniehdoh jong u un sngew sarong ia lade kumba u la pynsangeh noh ia ka .

en: And God said unto Noah , This is the token of the covenant , which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth .
kha: Kata ka long ka dak jong ka jingkular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Noah , Kane ka long ka dak jong ka jutang kaba nga la pynskhem hapdeng jong nga bad ka doh baroh kaba don ha ka khyndew .

en: Finally , my brethren , rejoice in the Lord . To write the same things to you , to me indeed is not grievous , but for you it is safe .
kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to phin kmen ha U Trai . Ngam sngew ei ei ban ïai ban biang ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh mynshuwa , bad kan kham pynskhem ïa phi lada nga leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, ko para jong nga, to sngewbha ha U Trai . Ban thoh ia kiei kiei kiba kum kita ha phi , ha nga shisha kam long kaba sngewsih , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi ka long kaba shngain .

en: For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence  ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
kha: Lada nga la rah ïa la ka kti bad shoh ïa me bad ki briew jong me da ka jingpang , phin jin da la ïap lut khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mynta ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga, ba ngan pynkhih ia me bad ia ki briew jong me da ka jingpang ; bad me shah ot noh na ka khyndew .

en: And to Seth , to him also there was born a son  ; and he called his name Enos : then began men to call upon the name of the  Lord .
kha: U Seth u la ïoh uwei u khun , ïa uba u la kyrteng , u Enosh . Dei ha kata ka por ba ki briew ki la sdang ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong U  Trai  ha ka jingmane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u Seth ruh la kha ia u khun shynrang ; bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Enos: nangta ki briew ki la sdang ban khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel , Jezebel heard of it  ; and she painted her face , and tired her head , and looked out at a window .
kha: U Jehu u la wan poi ha Jesreel . Ka Jesebel , haba ka la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , ka kyllan rong ïa la ki khmat , ka pynbeit ïa u shñiuh jong ka , bad ka ïeng ban khmih shapoh ka surok na ka jingkhangïit ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Jehu u la wan sha Jesel , u Jesel u la iohsngew ia kata; bad ka la rong ia ka khmat jong ka, bad ka la pynthut ia ka khlieh jong ka, bad ka peit shabar sha kawei ka jingkhang .

en: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
kha: Me pynkhreh ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka leilieh jong me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bow jong me ka la long kaba lyngkhuid bha, kat kum ka jingsmai jong ki jaitbynriew, wat ka ktien jong me ruh . Selah . U la pynkhih ia ka khyndew da ki wah .
