en: And Jonathan cried after the lad , Make speed , haste , stay not . And Jonathan s lad gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .
kha: Wat shu ïeng hangto ! Leh kyrkieh !  Uta u khynnah u tam ïa uta u khnam bad u wan phai sha la u kynrad ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la pyrta hadien u khynnah, To pynsted, to sah noh . Bad u khynnah u Jonathan u la lum ia ki khnam, bad u la wan sha u kynrad jong u .

en: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ , that his soul was not left in hell , neither his flesh did see corruption .
kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Blei un leh ha ka lawei , bad kumta u la kren shaphang ka jingmihpat jong U Messaïah haba u ong ,   ‘ Ym shym la iehnoh ïa u ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; ka met jong u kam shym la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ia kane shuwa ka jingmihpat U Khrist , ba ka mynsiem jong u kam shym la iehnoh ha dujok , bad ka doh jong u kam shym la iohi ia ka jingbamsap .

en: The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?
kha: Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong phi la buh ha ka jinglehrain ; ki la shaïong bad shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki ktien jong nga ; ka jingstad kaba kumno ki la ïoh mynta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki riewstad ki sngewlehrain , ki sngewsih bad ki la shah shim: lo , ki la kyntait ia ka ktien U Trai ; bad kaei ka jingstad kaba don ha ki ?

en: Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
kha: Namar ba ïa ka snam jong u  langsohmoh ym shym la wanrah shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , phi la dei ban bam ïa ka jingkñia hangta , kumba nga la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka snam jong ka kam shym la wanrah hapoh ka jaka bakhuid: phi la dei ban bam shisha ia ka ha ka jaka bakhuid kumba nga la hukum .

en: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia , and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia ,
kha: Ki la leit lyngba ki thain ka Phrygia bad Galatia namar U Mynsiem Bakhuid um shym la shah ïa ki ban ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ka probins    jong ka Asia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki la leit kylleng ka Phrygia bad ka thain Kalatia , bad la khang ia ki da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ban ialap ia ka ktien ha Asia .

en: For as the body is one , and hath many members , and all the members of that one body , being many , are one body : so also is Christ .
kha: U Khrist u long kum kawei ka met , kaba don shibun ki dkhot ; ka long hi tang kawei ka met , wat haba la pynlong ïa ka da ki dkhot kiba ïapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka met ka long kawei, bad ka don bun ki dkhot, bad ki dkhot jong kata kawei ka met, ki long kiba bun: kumjuh ruh U Khrist .

en: And he went up unto them into the ship  ; and the wind ceased : and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure , and wondered .
kha: Nangta u la kiew halor ka lieng bad ki , bad ka lyer ka la long jai jai . Ki synran ki la sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ki shapoh ka lieng ; bad ka Iyer ka la sangeh: bad ki la lyngngoh shibun eh ha lade palat ia ka jingthew, bad ki la lyngngoh .

en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest , and my jealousy shall depart from thee , and I will be quiet , and will be no more angry .
kha: Te ka jingbitar jong nga kan kut bad ngan long jai jai . Ngan ym bitar lane bishni shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynlong ia ka jingbitar jong nga sha me ban shongthait , bad ka jingsngewsih jong nga kan leit noh na me , bad ngan sngap jar , bad ngan ym bitar shuh .

en: Madhya Pradesh came in third and fourth with Mansi Kathait and Shreya Agrawal finishing on scores of 227 . 5 and 205 . 8 respectively .
kha: Ka Madhya Pradesh ka la wan ha ka kyrdan kaba lai bad kaba saw ha kaba ka Mansi Kathait bad ka Shreya Agrawal ki la pyndep da kaba kamai 227 kol . 5 bad 205 . 8 kawei hadien kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Madhya Pradesh ka la wan ha ka kyrdan kaba lai bad kaba saw bad ka Mansi Kathait bad ka Shreya Agrawal kaba la pyndep da ki 227 . 5 bad 205 . 8 tylli .

en: My father peradventure will feel me , and I shall seem to him as a deceiver  ; and I shall bring a curse upon me , and not a blessing .
kha: Lehse i pa jong nga in ktah ïa nga bad in shem ba nga shukor ïa i ; da kumne ngan wallam ka jingtim ha lade hi ha ka jaka ka jingkyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong nga un sngew ia nga kum u nongleh thok ; bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingtim halor jong nga , bad ym ka jingkyrkhu .

en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;
kha: Kim lehrain satia ban ïai pynbitar ïa nga . Ki ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala ha ki kper bakyntang bad thang jingiwbih ha ki duwan ba-thala .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba pynkhih ia nga ban bitar beit ha ka khmat jong nga ; kaba knia ha ki kper , bad ka thang ia ka jingiwbih halor ki jaka bam nar ; .

en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u kren , Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , uba la iohsngew ia ki ktien U Blei , uba la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew jong Uba donbor baroh:

en: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .
kha: Naba haba ngi la im ka jinglong kum ki briew , ki jingkwah bapop ba la pynkhih da ka Hukum ki trei ha ki met jong ngi , bad baroh kaba ngi leh ka kut ha ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ngi la don ha ka doh , ki jingkhih jong ki pop kiba la long da ka hukum ki la trei ha ki dkhot jong ngi ban pynmih soh haduh ka jingiap .

en: For we are not as many , which corrupt the word of God : but as of sincerity , but as of God , in the sight of God speak we in Christ .
kha: Ngim long kum kita kiba bun , kiba pynlong ïa ka khubor U Blei kum ka mar khaïi kaba tad dor ; hynrei namar ba U Blei u la phah ïa ngi , ngi kren da ka jingsngur ha khmat jong u , kum ki shakri U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim long kiba bun, kiba pynsniew ia ka ktien U Blei: hynrei kum ka jinglong bashisha , hynrei kum U Blei , ha khmat U Blei ngi kren ha U Khrist .

en: And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
kha: Ki nonghiarthma kin wan da ki lieng na Sypros ; Kin jop ïa u Assyria bad u Eber , Hynrei ma ki ruh kin jah noh jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lieng kin wan na rud duriaw Kittim bad kin pynshitom ia u Asshur bad kin pynshitom ia u Eber bad un sa jah noh junom .

en: For , behold , I will send serpents , cockatrices , among you , which will not be charmed , and they shall bite you , saith the  Lord .
kha: Husiar !  U  Trai  u ong ,  nga phah ki bseiñ hapdeng jong phi , ki bseiñ don bih ki bym lah ban pynshohbieit , bad kin puh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan phah ia ki bsein, ki khnai, hapdeng jong phi, ki bym sngewtynnad, bad kin bam ia phi , ong U Trai .

en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .
kha: hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum jong ki Amalek .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abdon u khun jong u Hillel u Piratone u la iap, bad la tep ia u ha Piratone ha ka ri Ephraim, ha ka lum jong ki Amalek .

en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God : but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways , and hatred in the house of his God .
kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga kum u nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel . La katta ruh shano shano ba nga leit , phi pyrshang ban riam ïa nga kum ïa ka sim . Wat ha ka Templ U Blei , ki briew ki dei ki nongshun jong u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap Ephraim u la don bad U Blei jong nga : hynrei u nongiathuhlypa u long u nongleh kam sniew ha ki lynti jong u baroh , bad u shun ha ka iing U Blei jong u .

en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .
kha: Kane ka jingpynbna kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Persia ha ka sngi ba la buh na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ha ki ri baroh jong u syiem Ahasaerus, kata ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba arphew .

en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies , which minister questions , rather than godly edifying which is in faith : so do .
kha: Ong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa kito ki puriskam bad kito ki thup bajrong jong ka jinghiarpateng , kiba pynmih tang ïa ki jingïania ; kim ïadei ei ei bad ka jingthmu U Blei , ïa kaba lah ban tip da ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat ai jingmut ia ki khanatang bad ki jingkren lyngkot ki bym kut, kiba shakri ia ki jingkylli, ban ia kaba ai jingmut ia ka jingbam kaba long ha ka jingngeit: kumta leh .

en: Son of man , write thee the name of the day , even of this same day : the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to thoh ïa ka tarik mynta ka sngi , namar kane ka long ka sngi kaba u syiem ka Babilonia u sdang ïa ka jingkerkut ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, thoh ia ka kyrteng jong ka sngi, wat ha kane kajuh ka sngi: u syiem Babilon u la buh ia lade pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem ha kane kajuh ka sngi .

en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .
kha: To ai ba ma phi , ki briew jong u , phin ïailong kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba phi leh ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan long kaba janai bad U Trai U Blei jong ngi, ban iaid ha ki ain jong u bad ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u kumba ha kane ka sngi .

en: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind , and with many tears , and temptations , which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews :
kha: Da ka jingsngewrit baroh bad shibun ki ummat nga la trei ïa ka kam jong nga kum u shakri jong U Trai ha ki por kiba eh kiba la wan ha nga namar ki jingïasylla jong ki katto katne ngut ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshakri ia U Trai da ka jinglong rit mynsiem baroh, bad da ki ummat bad ki jingpynshoi kiba bun, kiba la jia ia nga da kaba thiah ha ki Jiw:

en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had , Put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh :
kha: U ong ha u shakri jong u , uba la rangbah bha , uba peit halor baroh kiba u don ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga bad pynlong ka jingsmai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong ha u shakri rangbah jong u, uba la synshar ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don: To buh ia ka kti jong me hapoh ka tyrpeng jong nga:

en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron .
kha: Dei ruh ma ki kiba la ong ha u Pharaoh ban pyllait noh ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba la kren ha u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt: kine ki long kita u Moses bad u Aaron .

en: And Saul said to him , Whose son art thou , thou young man ? And David answered , I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite .
kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Ko samla , me dei u khun jongno ?   Nga dei u khun jong u shakri jong phi , u Jesse , uba na Bethlehem ,  U Dabid u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u, Me long u khun jongno, ko samla ? U Dabid u la jubab, Nga long u khun jong u shakri jong me u Jesse u Bethlehemite .

en: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor , and be sold unto thee  ; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant :
kha: Lada u para Israel uba shong marjan bad phi u kylla duk kat haduh ba un da die mraw ïa lade ha phi , phim dei ban pyntrei ïa u kum ïa u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u hynmen jong me uba sah ha me u la shah pynmong bad shah die ha me;

en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang don ha Jerusalem ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , shibun ki la ngeit ha u haba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u la don ha Jerusalem ha ka por jong ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jingkhawai Niam, bun ki la ngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u haba ki la iohi ia ki kambah kiba u la leh .

en: And they shall come thither , and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence .
kha: Haba ki wan phai , ki dei ban iehnoh noh ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli kiba ki shem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin wan shata , bad kin weng noh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba sngewsih bad ki jingpynjakhlia jong ka baroh na kata ka jaka .

en: Now let them put away their whoredom , and the carcases of their kings , far from me , and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever .
kha: Mynta ki dei ban sangeh noh na kaba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei bad weng ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan shong hapdeng jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba kin weng noh ia ka jingkhaii met jong ki bad ki met iap jong ki syiem jong ki, jngai na nga, bad ngan shong hapdeng jong ki junom .

en: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh : and Moses cried unto the  Lord  because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh .
kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki ïamihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u Moses u kyrpad eh ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kita ki jakoid kiba u la wallam ha u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la mih na u Pharaoh: bad u Moses u la pyrta ha U Trai namar ki khnai kiba u la wanrah pyrshah ia u Pharaoh .

en: Men and brethren , children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you feareth God , to you is the word of this salvation sent .
kha: Ko para Israel jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , bad baroh ki Jentil hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : Ka long ha ngi , ba la phah ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynim !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang bad ki para , ki khun jong u Abraham , bad uno uno na phi uba sheptieng ia U Blei , ha phi ka long ka ktien jong kane ka jingpynim ba la phah .

en: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?
kha: Hynrei bun na uta u paidbah u la ngeit ha u bad u la ong ,  Haba U Messaïah un wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ïa kaba une u briew u la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki briew ki la ngeit ia u bad ki la ong: Ynda U Khrist un wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ia kine kiba une u briew u la leh ?

en: A close bond of unity will be blessed , for the Bible says of Jehovah : With someone loyal you will act in loyalty . 2 Samuel 22 : 26 .
kha: Ka jingïadei kaba jan jong ka jingïatylli kan long kaba la kyrkhu , namar ka Baibl ka ong shaphang U Jehobah : Ha u briew uba ïaineh phin leh ha ka jinglong baïaineh . 2 Samuel 22 : 26 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiadei kaba jan jong ka jingiatylli kan long kaba la kyrkhu, namar ka Baibl ka ong shaphang U Jehobah: Da u briew uba iaineh phin leh ha ka jinglong ba iaineh . 2 Samuel 22 : 26 .

en: They have blown the trumpet , even to make all ready  ; but none goeth to the battle : for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
kha: Ka turoi ka riew bad baroh ki la pynkhreh . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka thma , naba ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka long halor baroh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynbthei ia ka turoi, wat ban pynkhreh baroh ; hynrei ym don ba leit sha ka thma: namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long halor ka jingbun briew jong ka baroh .

en: For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them , as the  Lord  our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?
kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don u blei uba hajan kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , haba ki donkam ïa u . Man ka por ba ngi khot kyrpad ïa u , u jubab ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw haduh katta katta , kaba don U Blei uba jan bha ha ki , kumba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u don ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi khot ia u ?

en: Moreover the  Lord  thy God will send the hornet among them , until they that are left , and hide themselves from thee , be destroyed .
kha: Nalor kane U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi un phah ruh ïa u kyieng hapdeng jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa kito kiba lait im bad kiba phet rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata U Trai U Blei jong me un phah ia ka hornet hapdeng jong ki , haduh ba kito kiba sah bad kiba buhrieh ia lade na me kin shah pynjot .

en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision , whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock .
kha: Hynrei mynta , ki briew kiba kham rit rta , ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ! Ki kpa jong ki , ki long borabor ki bymdondor kiba ngan ym shah ïa ki ban ïarap ïa ki ksew jong nga ban ap ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta kita kiba kham rit ban ia nga ha ka jingshah lehbein, kiba nga la sngewsih ban shong bad ki kulai jong ka kynhun jong nga .

en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ,
kha: bad nga la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong nga . Nga la ai ha u ka jingshemphang , ka jingtbit bad ka jingnang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh —
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pyndap ia u da ka mynsiem U Blei, ha ka jingstad bad ha ka jingsngewthuh bad ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingtrei kam baroh .

en: And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .
kha: Uwei u nong Ijipt u pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongap langbrot ,  ki jubab ;  u pyntong um lem ïa ngi , bad u ïarap ai um de ïa ki jingri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong , Uwei u nong Ijipt u la pyllait ia ngi na ka kti jong ki nongap langbrot , bad u la tan um ia ngi .

en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrshah ïa ka bor kaba synshar , u pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum ; bad uno uno uba leh kumta un wallam ka jingbishar pynrem halor lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pyrshah ia ka bor , u pyrshah ia ka jingpynbeit jong U Blei: bad kita kiba pyrshah kin pdiang ia lade ia ka jingpynrem .

en: Thou shalt not take the name of the  Lord  thy God in vain  ; for the  Lord  will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain .
kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba sniew , naba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno uba pyndonkam thala ïa ka kyrteng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shim ia ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong me lehnohei; namar U Trai un ym bat ia u khlem pop uba shim ia ka kyrteng jong u lehnohei .

en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
kha: Namar ki Messaïah balamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa balamler kin mih . Kin leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , lada long kaba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Khrist kiba bakla bad ki nongiathuhlypa lamler kin kiew, bad kin pyni ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla, ban pynshoi lada lah, wat ia kiba la jied .

en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant  ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .
kha: Jngai na kaba ki briew ki shong ki sah ; lane ba ki kjat briew ki ju ïaid , ki briew ki tih ïa ki thliew ha ki par . Hangta ki trei ha ka jingkynjah marwei , da kaba sdien ïa ki tyllai ha ki thliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshlei um ka mih na u nongshong shnong ; wat ki um ba la klet noh na ka kjat: ki la tyrkhong , ki la jah noh na ki briew .

en: When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :
kha: bad pynbeit ïa ki um ka duriaw ba kin ym kiew palat ban ïa kaba u la ong . Nga la don hangta mynba u buh ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la ai ha ka duriaw ia ka hukum jong u , ba ki um kim dei ban iaid lait ia ka hukum jong u: haba u la buh ia ki nongrim jong ka khyndew:

en: The precious sons of Zion , comparable to fine gold , how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers , the work of the hands of the potter !
kha: Ki samla shynrang jong ka Seïon ki la long kiba kordor ïa ngi kum ka ksiar , hynrei mynta la ñiew ïa ki kum ïa ki khiew dewbyrtha bymdondor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ba kordor jong ka Seion , kiba lah ban ianujor bad ka ksiar kaba bha , kumno la burom ia ki kum ki khyndew khyndew , ka kam jong ki kti jong u nongthaw khyndew !

en: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Rehoboam u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Rehoboam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba kyrteng u Manoah na ka shnong Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dan . Ka tnga jong u kam pat shym la lah ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew na ka shnong Zorah, na ka longiing u Daniel, uba kyrteng u Manoah ; bad ka tnga jong u ka long kaba khlem khun bad kaba khlem khun .

en: And the  Lord  turned the captivity of Job , when he prayed for his friends : also the  Lord  gave Job twice as much as he had before .
kha: Nangta , hadien ba u Job u la duwai na ka bynta ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u , U  Trai  u la pynriewspah biang ïa u bad u la ai ha u ar shah ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la pynphai ia ka jinglong mraw jong u Job , haba u la duwai na ka bynta ki paralok jong u: ruh U Trai u la ai ia u Job ar shah kumba u la don mynshuwa .

en: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
kha: Khie leit bad ïathuh ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad iathuh ha u Dabid, da kaba ong , Kumta nga tyrwa ia me lai tylli kiei kiei: jied ia me uwei na ki, ba ngan leh ia kata ha me .

en: A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Ki buh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar hapdeng jong kita ki dur soh baroh sawdong , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bell bad ka jingsawa kaba jem , ka bell bad ka jingsawa kaba jem , sawdong sawdong ka tduh jong ka rob ban shakri ha ka ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the  Lord  , make straight in the desert a highway for our God .
kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam ,  To pynkhreh ha ka ri khlaw ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U  Trai  ! To pynkhuid ïa ka lynti ha ka ri shyiap na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong uta uba pyrta ha ka ri khlaw , Pynkhreh ia ka lynti U Trai , pynlong beit ha ka ri khlaw ia ka lynti bah na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi .

en: And they shall call them , The holy people , The redeemed of the  Lord  : and thou shalt be called , Sought out , A city not forsaken .
kha: Yn khot ïa phi ,  Ki Briew ki bakhuid jong U Blei ,   Ki briew kiba U Trai u la pyllait im ;  Ïa ka Jerusalem yn khot  Ka nongbah kaba U Blei u ieit .   Ka nongbah kaba U Blei um shym la iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin khot ia ki , Ki briew kiba khuid , kiba la shah pyllait im na U Trai: bad ia me yn khot: bad ia me yn khot: La wad ia ka shnong kaba ym shah iehnoh .

en: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half was the length thereof , and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
kha: U thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , bad hynriewphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka jaka shong kaba khuid: ar cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka , bad kawei ka cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :
kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  La shah ïa me ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade .  U Paul u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ïasaid da ïa lade kumne :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul , Me la shah ban kren hi dalade . Nangta u Paul u la pynkhih ia ka kti bad u la jubab na ka bynta lade:

en: By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Israel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Joseph haba u la iap , u la kdew ia ka jingleit noh jong ki khun Israel bad u la ai hukum shaphang ki shyieng jong u .

en: And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
kha: katba ki ïaid ha ka mon U Blei . Ki leh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u hukum , hangno hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynkylla sawdong da ki jingmut jong u: ba kin leh ia kaei kaei kaba u hukum ia ki ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei ha ka khyndew .

en: For if the woman be not covered , let her also be shorn : but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven , let her be covered .
kha: Lada ka briew kam tap ïa la ka khlieh , ka lah ban khapnoh ïa la u shñiuh . Bad namar ba ka long kaba ikhlem-akor ïa ka briew ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ne khap ïa la u shñiuh , ka dei ban tap ïa la ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka kynthei kam shah tap , to ai ba kan shah rong noh: hynrei lada ka long kaba sngewlehrain ia ka kynthei ban shah rong ne shah rong noh , to ai ba kan shah rong noh .

en: This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .
kha: U la ong ba kane kan dei ka kupar jong pha . Kane ka dei kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa pha , namar pha la klet ïa u bad pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka bhah jong me, ka bynta jong ki jingthew jong me na nga , ong U Trai ; namar me la klet ia nga, bad me la shaniah ha ka jinglamler .

en: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence , and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood , that he may die .
kha: ki rangbah shnong jong phi hi kin phah leit ring ïa u nangta , bad kin aiti ïa u ha u nongwad kput khnang ba un pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ka shnong jong u kin phah bad shim ia u nangta, bad kin aiti ia u ha ka kti jong u nongpyniap snam, ba un iap .

en: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen , clean and white : for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints .
kha: La ai ha ka ïa ka jaiñ linen baphyrnai kaba khuid ban phong .  ( Ka jaiñ linen ka long ki kam babha jong ki briew jong U Blei . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ia ka ba kan long kaba la pynbeit da ka jain kaba bha, kaba khuid bad kaba lieh: namar ka jain kaba bha ka long ka hok jong ki riewkhuid .

en: And when the day was now far spent , his disciples came unto him , and said , This is a desert place , and now the time is far passed :
kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sdang noh , ki synran ki la wan ha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka por ka dier palat , bad kane ka dei ka jaka kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta haba ka sngi ka la jah noh, ki synran jong u ki la wan shajan jong u bad ki la ong: Kane ka dei ka jaka ri khlaw bad mynta ka por ka la iaid noh:

en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others .  And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .
kha: Un wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki rangbah , bad un ai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .  Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la ong ,  Ym kumta keiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Un wan pynjot ia kine ki nongrep bad un ai ia ka kper sohjew sha kiwei pat . Bad haba ki la iohsngew ia kata ki la ong: U Blei u la khang .

en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Jingïap ïa ka Babilonia ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki briew jong ka , ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka , ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam ka long halor ki Khlieh, U Trai, bad halor ki nongshong shnong jong ka Babilon bad halor ki syiem jong ka bad halor ki riewstad jong ka .

en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands  ; yet ye turned not to me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Nga la phah ïa ki lyer ba-tyrkhong bad u phria ban pynjot ïa baroh kiba phi pyrshang ban thung , hynrei phim kylla-kaba-mut hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynkhih ia phi da kaba pynkhih bad da ka jingsma bad da ka jingsma ha ki kti jong phi baroh; hynrei phim shym la phai sha nga , ong U Trai .

en: Take the choice of the flock , and burn also the bones under it , and make it boil well , and let them seethe the bones of it therein .
kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka doh na ka langbrot bakynsai tam ; kynton ïa ka dieng na tbian u khiew . To ai ba yn shet ïa ka um ; shet ïa ki shyieng bad ïa ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jingjied jong ka kynhun , bad thang ruh ia ki shyieng hapoh jong ka , bad pynlong ia ka ban rkhiang bha , bad ai ba kin bet ia ki shyieng jong ka hangta .

en: Then I lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a certain man clothed in linen , whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz :
kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei uba kup ki jaiñ linen bad u panpoh ksiar nylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la peit, bad ha khmih uwei u briew uba la phong da ka jain lin, uba la teh ia ki tyrpeng jong u da ka ksiar kaba bha jong u Uphaz:

en: She broke the 10 , 000 metres world record , set in 1993 , while winning the gold medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro .
kha: Ka la pynpra ïa ka rekod pyrthei kaba 10, 000 meter kaba la buh ha u snem 1993 , ha ka por ba ka ïoh khur ïa ka takma ksiar ha ka Summer Olympics 2016 kaba la long ha Rio de Janeiro .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pynpra ia ka rekod pyrthei kaba 10 000 metres, kaba la buh ha u snem 1993 , katba ka dang jop ia ka takma ksiar ha u snem 2016 ha Rio de Janeiro .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done , which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa pha ha ka rukom kaba pha dei hok ban ïoh , namar pha la leh bymsalia ïa ki jingkular jong pha bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; ngan leh wat ia me kumba me la leh, kaba la leh bein ia ka jingsmai ha kaba pynkhein ia ka jutang .

en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .
kha: Phim lah ban dih na ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki ksuid ; phim lah ban ïabam na ka miej U Trai bad ruh na ka miej ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban dih ia ka khuri U Trai bad ka khuri jong ki ksuid: phim lah ban long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka miej U Trai bad ha ka miej jong ki ksuid .

en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard . My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill :
kha: To pynshahshkor katba nga rwai ha phi ïa kane ka jingrwai , ka jingrwai u paralok jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong u : U paralok jong nga u don ka bri sohwaiñ ha u lumrit uba seisoh bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngan rwai ia ka jingrwai ba la ieit eh jong nga kaba ktah ia ka kper sohjew jong u . Ka kper sohjew jong nga ka don ka kper sohjew ha u lum uba jyrngam bha:

en: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them : and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea .
kha: La pyndap ïa ki paramarjan baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ka khubor shaphang kine kiei kiei ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri lum Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtieng ka la wan ha baroh kiba shong sawdong jong ki: bad kine ki jingkren baroh ki la sawa shabar ri ha kylleng ka ri lum jong ka Judaea .

en: And they answered , We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment , and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey .
kha: Ki paidbah ki jubab ,  Ngin ai ïa ki ha phi da kaba sngewbha .  Ki siang kawei ka jaiñ , bad uwei pa uwei u buh hangta ïa ki sohshkor ba u la shim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab , Ngin ai mon sngewbha ia ki . Ki la pynphriang ia ka jain , bad ki la bret ha uwei pa uwei ia ki shkor jong u mrad jong u .

en: Yea , the fir trees rejoice at thee , and the cedars of Lebanon , saying , Since thou art laid down , no feller is come up against us .
kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bad ki dieng Kedar jong ka Lebanon ki risa da kaba kmen halor u syiem uba la kyllon , namar ym don mano mano ban khet ïa ki , mynta ba um don shuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki dieng ki ia risa ha me , bad ki dieng Lebanon ki ong , Namar ba me la buh ia me , ym don u nongleh kam sniew uba wan pyrshah ia ngi .

en: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the  Lord  had done to Israel , whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians .
kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , u la kmen bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jethro u la sngewbha na ka bynta ka jingbha baroh kaba U Trai u la leh ha ki Israel , ia kiba u la pyllait na ka kti jong ki nong Ijipt .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynrem ïa u briew uba phai noh na nga bad uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u briew u bym im junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai u la ong u briew uba shaniah ha u briew, bad uba pynlong ia ka kti jong u, bad uba ka dohnud jong u ka mih noh na U Trai .

en: The kings of the earth set themselves , and the rulers take counsel together , against the  Lord  , and against his anointed , saying ,
kha: Ki syiem jong ki , ki ïeng pyrshah , ki nongsynshar jong ki , ki ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa U  Trai bad pyrshah ïa u syiem uba u la jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka khyndew ki buh ia lade, bad ki nongsynshar ki ia kren lang, pyrshah ia U Trai bad pyrshah ia u ba la pynsleh jong u, da kaba ong:

en: Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .
kha: To lute ïa ka rupa ! To lute ïa ka ksiar ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka jingjot jong ka rupa, shim ia ka jingjot jong ka ksiar: namar ym don jingkut jong ka dukan bad ka burom na ki tiar kiba sngewtynnad baroh .

en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses ,  NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka long kaei kaba me dei ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot UBA NGA LONG u phah ïa nga sha phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Moses , NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA: bad u la ong: Kumta to ong ha ki khun Israel , NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA NGA

en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .
kha: Me bat ïa la ka kular , me la ïalam noh ïa ki briew kiba me la pyllait im ; da ka bor jong me , me la btin ïa ki sha ka ri kaba kyntang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ha ka jingisynei jong me me la ialam ia ki briew kiba me la siewspah: me la ialam ia ki ha ka bor jong me sha ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me .

en: We heard him say , I will destroy this temple that is made with hands , and within three days I will build another made without hands .
kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba u ong , ‘ Ngan pynjot ïa kane ka Templ kaba ki briew ki la tei , bad hadien lai sngi ngan tei ïa kawei pat kaba ym shym la shna da ki briew’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la iohsngew ia u ba u ong , Ngan pynjot ia kane ka tempi kaba la shna da ki kti , bad hapoh lai sngi ngan tei sa kawei pat kaba la shna khlem kti .

en: And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  I pa jong ngi , u shakri barit jong phi , i dang im bad i shait i khlaiñ .  Bad ki la dem khohsiew bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab: U shakri jong me u long uba koit ba khiah, u dang im . Ki la dem khrup bad ki la leh ia ka jingsngap jar .

en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;
kha: Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ïa u khunbynriew ym shym la ïathuh ïa kane ka jingmaïan , hynrei , U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka mynta da U Mynsiem ha ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ha kiwei pat ki juk ym shym la pynpaw ha ki khun shynrang kumba la pynpaw mynta ha ki apostol bad ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid jong u da U Mynsiem ; .

en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .
kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, ha ngi ka long ka jingkulmar khmat, ha ki syiem jong ngi, ha ki syiem jong ngi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia me .

en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .
kha: ki ban sa rkhiebeiñ ïa u , kin bynthiew halor jong u , kin sympat ïa u , bad pynïap ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi un sa mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin rkhie bein ia u, bad kin pynkhih ia u, bad kin pynkhih ia u: bad ha ka sngi kaba lai un khie pat .

en: And Samson said unto her , If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried , then shall I be weak , and be as another man .
kha: U Samson u jubab ,  Lada ki khum ïa nga da ki hynñiew tylli ki  saisiej thymmai ki bym pat ïap saw , ngan duh bor , bad ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong ha ka, Lada ki teh ia nga da ki hynriew tylli ki khniang kiba ym pat ju tyrkhong , te ngan sa tlot bad ngan long kum uwei pat u briew .

en: But ye shall not be so : but he that is greatest among you , let him be as the younger  ; and he that is chief , as he that doth serve .
kha: Hynrei kane kam dei ka rukom ka ban long bad phi ; pynban , uta uba khraw tam hapdeng jong phi u dei ban long kum uba rit tam , bad u nongïalam jong phi u dei ban long kum u shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin ym long kumta: hynrei uta uba kham khraw napdeng jong phi, to ai ba un long kum uba kham rit ; bad uta uba kham rangbah, kumba uta uba shakri .

en: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them , and discomfited them , even unto Hormah .
kha: Te ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan kiba shong hangta ki wan tur ïaleh bad ki la jop ïa ki , bad ki beh krad ïa ki haduh Hormah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nong Amake ki la wan hiar, bad ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha uta u lum, bad ki la pynkhih ia ki, bad ki la pynsngewsih ia ki, wat haduh Hormah .

en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .
kha: Tang ma nga hi nga tip ïa ki jingthmu kiba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , ki jingthmu ban wallam ha phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia ki jingpyrkhat kiba nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , ong U Trai , ki jingpyrkhat jong ka jingsuk , ym jong ka jingsniew , ban ai ia phi ia ka jingkut kaba la khmih lynti .

en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God ! how unsearchable are his judgments , and his ways past finding out !
kha: Katno ka long kaba khraw ka spah jong U Blei ! Katno ki long kiba jylliew ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong u ! Uei uba lah ban batai ïa ki jingrai jong U ? Uei uba lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki lynti jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: O ka jingjylliew jong ki spah baroh ar ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong U Blei ! katno ki jingbishar jong u ki long ki bym lah ban wad bniah , bad ki lynti jong u ki la leit noh !

en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .
kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ki la long kiba sbun shikatdei eh ha ka jingai jong ki , wat la ki long kiba duk shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno kata ha ka jingtynjuh kaba khraw jong ka jingjynjar jong ki bad ka jingduk kaba jylliew jong ki ka la nang kiew sha ki spah jong ka jinglaitluid jong ki .

en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :
kha: Wat shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa ngi ban long ki jong u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh long kiba khuid bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u la jied ia ngi ha u ha khmat ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei , ba ngin long kiba khuid bad khlem jingbakla ha khmat jong u ha ka jingieit:

en: And the king of Egypt said unto them , Wherefore do ye , Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .
kha: Hynrei u Pharaoh u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Phi mut kumno da kaba pynlong ïa ki briew ban leh klet ïa la ki kam ? Ong ïa ki ban leit sha la ki kam ki kam !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ijipt u la ong ha ki, "Balei phi, ko Moses bad u Aaron, to ai ba ki briew kin mih na ki kam jong ki? ioh ia phi sha ki jingkit jong phi .

en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear your words , when ye depart out of that house or city , shake off the dust of your feet .
kha: Bad lada kano kano ka ïing ne ka shnong kam pdiang sngewbha ïa phi lane pynshahshkor ïa phi , te mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym pdiang ia phi ne iohsngew ia ki ktien jong phi haba phi mih na kata ka iing ne ka shnong , pynkhih ia ka dewmet jong ki kjat jong phi .

en: He among the sons of Aaron , that offereth the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right shoulder for his part .
kha: ha u lyngdoh uba kñia ïa ka snam bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: U napdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron uba ai ia ka snam jong ki jingknia iasuk bad ka shini , un don ka tyrpeng kaba dei na ka bynta jong u .

en: And Jesus said ,  Make the men sit down .  Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .
kha: Pynshong ïa ki briew ha madan ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki . ( La don shibun u phlang hangta . ) Kumta ki briew baroh ki la shong ha madan ; ki la don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong, To pynlong ia ki briew ban shong . Mynta la don shibun ki phlang ha kata ka jaka . Kumta ki briew ki la shong, kumba san hajar ngut .

en: And Sarah died in Kirjath–arba  ; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan : and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her .
kha: Ka la ïap ha Hebron ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u Abraham u ïam sngewsih namar jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sarah ka la iap ha Kirjatharba ; kajuh ka long ka Hebron ha ka ri Kanaan : bad u Abraham u la wan ban iam na ka bynta ka Sarah bad ban iam na ka bynta jong ka .

en: God that made the world and all things therein , seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth , dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ;
kha: U Blei , uba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba don ha ka , u long U Trai jong ka bneng bad ka pyrthei bad um shong ha ki templ ba la thaw da ki kti jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei uba la thaw ia ka pyrthei bad kiei kiei baroh ha ka , haba u iohi ba u long U Trai jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , um shong ha ki temple ba la shna da ki kti ; .

en: Now therefore come , let me , I pray thee , give thee counsel , that thou mayest save thine own life , and the life of thy son Solomon .
kha: Lada phi kwah ban pyllait im ïa la ka jingim bad ïa ka jingim u Solomon u khun jong phi , ngan ai jingmut ïa phi ban
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to wan, to ngan ai jingmut ia me, ba me lah ban pynim ia la ka jong ka jingim bad ia ka jingim u khun jong me u Solomon .

en: This shall they have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Kata ka long kumno ki briew jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingsarong bad jingmeng jong ki bad na ka bynta ka jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kan long na ka bynta ka jingsarong jong ki , namar ki la pynjah burom bad pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia ki briew jong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: To all that be in Rome , beloved of God , called to be saints : Grace to you and peace from God our Father , and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Bad kumta nga thoh sha phi baroh kiba ha Rom kiba U Blei u ieit bad ba u la khot ban long ki briew jong u hi : To U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha baroh kiba don ha Rome, kiba ieit ia U Blei, kiba la khot ban long ki riewkhuid: Ka jingaiei ha phi bad ka jingsuk na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi, bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: What then ? are we better than they ? No , in no wise : for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles , that they are all under sin ;
kha: Haba kumta , hato ma ngi ki Jiw ngi don ha kano kano ka bynta kaba kham bha ban ïa ki Jentil ? Ym kumta! Nga la lah pyn-i ba ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki long kumjuh baroh hapoh ka bor jong ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata ? hato ngi kham bha ban ia ki ? Em, khlem da stad: namar ngi la pynshisha shuwa ia ki Jiw bad ki Jutang , ba baroh ki don hapoh ka pop ; .

en: One of the servants of the high priest , being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off , saith , Did not I see thee in the garden with him ?
kha: Uwei na ki mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba don jingïadei bad u briew ïa uba u Petros u la lah mait ïa ka shkor jong u , u la kren .  Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa me bad u ha kata ka kper ?  u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u rangbah lyngdoh uba long u khun jong u uba u Petros u la ot noh ia ka shkor jong u, u ong: Hato ngam shym la iohi ia me ha ka kper bad u ?

en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah  ; We have a strong city  ; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks .
kha: Ka sngi kan wan haba ki briew kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha ri Judah : Ka nongbah jong ngi ka long kaba skhem ! U Blei da lade hi u ïada ïa ki kynroh jong ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi yn rwai ia kane ka jingrwai ha ka ri Judah ; Ngi don ka jingpynim sor kaba khlain .

en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :
kha: Nga lah eh , da shisha , ban shaniah ha kum kito kiei kiei . Lada uno uno u pyrkhat ba u lah ban shaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar , nga don ka daw kaba kham khraw ban sngew kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la nga lah ruh ban don ka jingshaniah ha ka doh . Lada uno uno u pyrkhat ba u don ha ka doh kaba u lah ban shaniah ha ka doh , nga kham bun:

en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , Sodom thy sister hath not done , she nor her daughters , as thou hast done , thou and thy daughters .
kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ka Sodom ka para jong pha bad ki nongrit jong ka kim ju leh ïa ka jingsniew kaba ma pha bad ki nongrit jong pha phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga im , ong U Trai Blei , ka para jong me kam shym la leh ei ei , ma ka ne ki khun kynthei jong ka kumba me la leh , ma me bad ki khun kynthei jong me .

en: All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !
kha: To ïambriew na ka bynta kata ka hima , phi kiba shong marjan , phi baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingpawnam jong ka . To ong , ‘ Ka jingsynshar bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka bor jong ka kam don shuh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba don shaphang jong u, phi sngewsih ia u bad phi baroh kiba tip ia ka kyrteng jong u, phi ong , Kumno u diengduh uba khlain u la tyrkhong bad u diengduh uba itynnad !

en: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee , then thou shalt be clear from this my oath : only bring not my son thither again .
kha: Lada kata ka samla kam mon ban wan ryngkat bad me , men laitluid na kane ka jingkular . Hynrei da lei lei ruh wat leit ïalam noh ïa u khun jong nga shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada kata ka kynthei kan ym mon ban bud ia me , te me dei ban shai na kane ka jingsmai jong nga: tangba wat wanrah biang ia u khun jong nga .

en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .
kha: Nga sei ïa ka bor jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh bad ngam shym wad ban ïoh kano kano ka jingdon jingem . Baroh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga , ki ïasnoh ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ruh nga la bteng ha ka kam jong kane ka kynroh, ym ngi la thied jaka: bad ki shakri jong nga baroh ki la ialum lang ha ka kam .

en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats , and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean , sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh :
kha: Ka snam jong ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong bad u dpei jong u masi lud la synreit halor ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad kane ka pynkhuid ïa ki da kaba weng noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid katba kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ka snam jong ki masi bad ki blang bad ka dewbilat jong ka masi ka pynkhuid ia ka jingbymkhuid:

en: And the daughter of any priest , if she profane herself by playing the whore , she profaneth her father : she shall be burnt with fire .
kha: Lada ka khun jong u lyngdoh ka ïaid nuti , ka pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa ; yn thang ïa ka haduh ba kan da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khun jong uno uno u lyngdoh lada ka pynjah burom ia lade da kaba ialehkai ia ka kam runar: kan shah thang da ka ding .

en: And Joshua made peace with them , and made a league with them , to let them live : and the princes of the congregation sware unto them .
kha: U Joshua u pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki briew jong ka Gibeon bad u la shah ïa ki ba kin im . Ki nongïalam jong ka kynhun ki Israel ki ai ka jingkular skhem ba kin bat ïa kata ka jingïateh lok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la iasuk bad ki, bad u la leh ia ka jingiateh bad ki, ban ai ba kin im: bad ki rangbah jong ka jingiaseng ki la sngap jar ia ki .

en: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .
kha: U ruh u ong ,  Nga mynjur ïa kata , tangba tang uta uba shim ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga ; kiwei pat ki lah ban leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Mynta ruh to ai ba kan long katkum ka ktien jong phi: uta uba la lap ia ka un long u shakri jong nga ; bad phin long ki bym don pop .

en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth , and let the wicked be no more . Bless thou the  Lord  , O my soul . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: Ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki nongpop na ka pyrthei ; ai ba ki bymman kin duh shuh . Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki nongpop kin shah pynjot noh na ka khyndew , bad to ai ba ki bymman kin ym don shuh . Kyrkhu ia me ia U Trai ko mynsiem jong nga . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed  ; I saw , and behold a tree in the midst of the earth , and the height thereof was great .
kha: Mynba nga dang ïohthiah , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ïa u dieng bakhraw ha ka pdeng jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong nga ha ka jingthiah jong nga ; nga la iohi, bad ha khmih u dieng hapdeng ka khyndew , bad ka jingjrong jong u ka long kaba khraw .

en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , This people say , The time is not come , the time that the  Lord s  house should be built .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha u Haggai ,  Kine ki briew ki ong ba kane kam dei ka por kaba biang ban tei pat ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u kren ia U Trai jong ki paid , u ong , Une u briew um shym la poi , ka por ba dei ban tei ia ka iing U Trai .

en: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .
kha: Haba u briew u ïap hapoh ka ïingjaiñ , mano mano ba don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha ka por ba ïap lane ba rung hapoh jong ka u long u bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka hukum haba u briew u iap ha ka ïingjaiñ: baroh kiba wan shapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad baroh kiba don ha ka ïingjaiñ kin long ki bymkhuid hynriew sngi .

en: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel , all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal , and every mouth which hath not kissed him .
kha: Pynban ngan pynsah hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ha Israel — kito kiba ïaineh ha nga bad ki bym shym la dem ïa u Baal ne doh ïa u bleithaw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la iehnoh ia nga hynriew hajar ha Israel , ki kjat baroh ki bym shym la dem khrup ha u Baal bad kawei pa kawei ka shyntur kaba khlem kdup ia u .

en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the  Lord  , she came to prove him with hard questions .
kha: Ka Syiem jong ka ri Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka mahadei ka Sheba ka la iohsngew ia ka nam u Solomon shaphang ka kyrteng U Trai , ka la wan ban pynshisha ia u da ki jingkylli kiba eh .

en: The watchmen that went about the city found me , they smote me , they wounded me  ; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me .
kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno phi long kaba janai !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap kiba la leit kylleng ka nongbah ki la lap ia nga , ki la pynmong ia nga , ki la pynmynsaw ia nga ; ki nongap ia ki kynroh ki la weng noh ia ka jingtap jong nga na nga .

en: Then shall the seers be ashamed , and the diviners confounded : yea , they shall all cover their lips  ; for there is no answer of God .
kha: Kito kiba ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei kin shah pynjahburom da ka jingbymlah jong ki . Baroh kin shah pynlehrain namar U Blei um shym jubab ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongiohi kin sngewlehrain, bad ki nongleh jadu kin sngewlehrain: Hooid , baroh kin tap ia ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ; namar ym don jubab jong U Blei .

en: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews , and in Jerusalem  ; whom they slew and hanged on a tree :
kha: Ngi long ki sakhi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh ha ka ri Israel bad ha Jerusalem . Nangta ki la pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi long ki sakhi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha ka ri jong ki Jiw, bad ha Jerusalem ; kiba ki la pyniap bad ki la sahkut ha u dieng:

en: But the  Lord  sent out a great wind into the sea , and there was a mighty tempest in the sea , so that the ship was like to be broken .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka lyer kaba jur ha ka duriaw , bad ka  erïong ka la long kaba khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ka liengbah ka don ha ka jingma jong ka jingpait jingpra .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la phah ia ka Iyer kaba khraw sha duriaw , bad ka la don ka eriong kaba khlain ha duriaw , haduh ba ka lieng ka la long kumba ka la tyrkhong .

en: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder , and pushed all the diseased with your horns , till ye have scattered them abroad  ;
kha: Phi kyndat sharud ïa kiba pang bad phi ñiat ïa ki shabar na ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la pynkhih da ka liang bad da ka tyrpeng, bad phi la pynkhih ia kiba pang baroh da ki bniat jong phi, haduh ba phi la pynphriang ia ki shabar ri ; .

en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ , as though God did beseech you by us : we pray you in Christ s stead , be ye reconciled to God .
kha: Hangne ngi don , namarkata , da kaba kren na ka bynta U Khrist , la kumba U Blei hi da lade u kyrpad lyngba jong ngi . Ngi kyrpad na ka bynta U Khrist : To ai ba U Blei un pynkylla ïa phi na ki nongshun sha ki paralok jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta te ngi long ki nonglam khubor na ka bynta U Khrist, kumba U Blei u la kyrpad ia phi da ngi: ngi duwai ia phi ha U Khrist, to long kiba iapynbeit bad U Blei .

en: Because he considereth , and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
kha: U sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba u leh bad u sangeh ban leh pop , kumta un ym ïap da shisha , hynrei un ïai im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u pyrkhat bad u phai noh na ki jingpynkhein jong u baroh kiba u la leh , un im shisha , un ym iap .

en: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name , he hath done evil to this people  ; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all .
kha: Naduh ba nga la leit sha u Pharaoh ban ïakren na ka bynta jong me , u la lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ki . Bad mem shym la leh ei ei ban ïarap ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar naduh ba nga la wan sha u Pharaoh ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong me , um shym la leh ei ei ia une u briew ; bad me khlem pynpoi satia ia ki briew jong me .

en: I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .
kha: Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit bad ki lumbah ngan pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang bad ki dieng . Ngan pynkylla ïa ki them wah sha ki jaka shyiap bad pyntyrkhong ïa ki pukri um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki lum bad ki lum kiba jakhlia, bad ngan pynkhriat ia ki jingthung jong ki baroh; bad ngan pynlong ia ki wah rit , bad ngan pynkhriat ia ki pung .

en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
kha: Ki ïakren shaphang U Blei ka Jerusalem kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kti ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren pyrshah ia U Blei jong ka Jerusalem kumba ki long ki blei jong ki briew jong ka khyndew .

en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him , whether he would heal on the sabbath day  ; that they might find an accusation against him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kwah daw ban mudui ïa U Jisu ba u leh bakla , kumta ki la ïakhmih bniah ïa u ban ïohi lada un pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi ki la peit ia u, la un pynkoit ne em ha ka sngi Sabha ; ba kin shem ia ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ia u .

en: But Peter said , Ananias , why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost , and to keep back part of the price of the land ?
kha: U Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ko Ananias , balei me la shah ïa u Soitan ban bat synshar ïa me bad pynlong ïa me ban lamler ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid da kaba bat noh katto katne ka pisa kaba me la ïohpdiang na kaba die ïa ka jaka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong, Ananias , balei u Soitan u la pyndap ia ka dohnud jong me ban thok ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ban bat ia ka bynta jong ka dor jong ka ri ?

en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
kha: Naba U briew u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba leh sarong , bad kiba kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew kin long ki nongieit ia la ka jong ka jinglong, ki nonglehkai, ki nonglehkai , ki nonglehkai , ki bym kohnguh ia ki kmie ki kpa , ki bym don jingsngewnguh , ki bym don jingkhuid .

en: And he rose up that night , and took his two wives , and his two womenservants , and his eleven sons , and passed over the ford Jabbok .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Jakob u la khie , u shim ïa la ki tnga baroh ar ngut , ïa ki tnga kliar jong u ar ngut , bad ïa la ki khun baroh khatwei ngut , bad u la jam ïa ka wah Jabbok .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng ha kata ka miet, bad u la shim ia ki arngut ki tnga jong u, bad ki arngut ki kynthei jong u, bad ki shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u, bad u la iaid lait noh ia ka wah Jabok .

en: They profess that they know God ; but in works they deny him , being abominable , and disobedient , and unto every good work reprobate .
kha: Ki kam ba ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei ki jingleh jong ki , ki len ïa kata . Ki long kiba dap da ka jingisih bad bymkohnguh , ki bym biang ban leh ïa kano kano kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kam ba ki tip ia U Blei ; hynrei ha ki kam ki kyntait ia u, da kaba sngewsih bad bym kohnguh, bad ha ka kam kaba bha baroh ki pynrem .

en: To Titus , mine own son after the common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour .
kha: Nga thoh sha u Titos , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïadon lang . To U Blei uba long U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba long U Nongpynim jong ngi un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Titos, u khun jong nga hi hadien ka jingngeit lang: Ka jingaiei, ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist jong ngi .

en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .
kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad , ieh ngan sah ma nga hangne kum u mraw jong phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shah ïa u ba un leit phai bad la ki hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba u shakri jong me un iaineh ha ka jaka jong u khynnah uba shah teh ha u kynrad jong nga; bad to ai ba u khynnah un leit shaneng bad ki hynmen jong u .

en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .
kha: ‘ U para jong me u la wan phai pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , ‘ bad u kpa jong me u la phah pynïap ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha , namar u la ïoh pat ïa u ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingkoit jingkhiah .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: U hynmen jong me u la wan; bad u kpa jong me u la pyniap ia u khun masi uba la tyrkhong , namar u la pdiang ia u da kaba suk bad kaba koit ba khiah .

en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,
kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren ha nga shaphang ka ri Elam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa pyrshah ia ka Elam ha kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah da kaba ong:

en: And Moses said unto God , Who am I , that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U Blei ,  Ngam long ei ei . Kumno nga lah ban leit sha u Pharaoh bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Blei , Nga long mano ba nga leit sha u Pharaoh bad ba nga dei ban wanrah ia ki khun Israel na Ijipt ?

en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .
kha: Ki khot lang arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngi . Nalor kine , ki nongshong shnong ka Gibeah ki lumlang hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang kiba treikam da kadiang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u tbit ban kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u  ñiuhkhlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng kine ki briew baroh ki don hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la jied; uwei pa uwei u lah ban sngap jar ia ki maw ha ka sniehdoh kaba heh .

en: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel , and took counsel with his servants , saying , In such and such a place shall be my camp .
kha: U syiem Syria u ïaleh thma bad ki Israel , u ïasyllok bad la ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad jied ïa ka jaka ban pynïeng ïa ka jaka sher dara jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Syria u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel bad u la iamir jingmut bad ki shakri jong u da kaba ong: Ha kum kata ka jaka kan long ka jaka sah jong nga .

en: And he returned to Judah , and said , I cannot find her  ; and also the men of the place said , that there was no harlot in this place .
kha: Kumta u leit phai noh sha u Judah , bad u ong ,  Ngam shym lap satia ïa ka . Ki rangbah jong kata ka jaka ruh ki ong ba ym ju don nuti hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit phai sha Judah bad u la ong, ngam lah ban shem ia ka ; bad ki briew jong kata ka jaka ki la ong , ba ym don ka jaka ha kane ka jaka .

en: And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .
kha: bad nangta ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh sha phi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba wan phai sha la u jong u tnga . Phi kwah ban pynïap tang ïa uwei u briew ; kiba sah na ki paidbah kin lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki briew baroh sha me: uta u briew uba me wad u long kumba baroh ki wan phai: kumta ki briew baroh kin long ha ka jingsuk .

en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .
kha: Ki kñia ha ki blei ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ha ki blei thymmai kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim ju tip , ki blei kiba ki Israel kim ju kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la knia ha ki ksuid , ym ha U Blei; ha ki blei kiba kim tip, ha ki blei thymmai kiba la wan thymmai kiba la wan shaneng thymmai, kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim tieng .

en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book , and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity , and out of darkness .
kha: Ynda kata ka sngi kan wan , kiba kyllut kin sa lah ban ïohsngew ba la pule jam ïa ka kot , bad ba kiba matlah , kiba ju im ha ka jingdum , kin plie ïa la ki khmat bad ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi u nongsngap jar un iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka kot , bad ki khmat jong kiba matlah kin iohi na ka jingdum bad na ka jingdum .

en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .
kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sliang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; naba da kaba leh ïa kane phin pynlong ïa u ban ing da ka jingsngewlehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada u nongshun jong me u thngan, to ai bam ia u lada u sliang: namar da kaba leh kumta men lum ia ki dewiong ding ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong nga , Me long ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglong rangbah jong nga , Uba sarong tam bad uba khlaiñ tam Na ki khun jong nga baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Reuben me, me long u khun nyngkong jong nga, ka bor jong nga, bad ka jingsdang jong ka bor jong nga, ka jingbha jong ka burom bad ka jingbha jong ka bor:

en: And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .
kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . Da kaba leh kumne , me kubur ba dei ma nga uba la tih ïa kane ka pukri .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Na ka bynta kine ki hynriew tylli ki langbrot me shim na ka kti jong nga, ba kin long ki sakhi ia nga, ba nga la tih ia kane ka thliew .

en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said , Shall not Shimei be put to death for this , because he cursed the  Lord s  anointed ?
kha: U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah u la kren ,  Ïa u Shimei dei ban pynïap namar ba u la tim ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied kum u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abisai u khun u Seruiah u la jubab bad u la ong: Hato u Shimei un ym shah pyniap na ka bynta kane , namar u la tim ia U Trai u la pynsleh ?

en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snam haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ban ktah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid kai kum ki briew kiba matlah ha ki surok , ki la pynjakhlia ia lade da ka snam , haduh ba ki briew kim lah ban ktah ia ki jain jong ki .

en: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know , to teach them war , at the least such as before knew nothing thereof  ;
kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban hikai ïa kawei pa kawei ka pateng jong ki Israel shaphang ka thma , khamtam ïa kito ki bym pat ju mad ïa ka thma mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ba ki pateng Israel kin tip , ban hikai ia ki thma , la kumno kumno kumba mynshuwa kim tip ei ei na ka;

en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
kha: U Gideon u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U  Trai  u long ka Jingsuk .  ( Ka dang ïeng ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jong u Abieser . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Gideon u la tei ia ka jingknia hangta ha U Trai, bad u la khot ia ka Jehobah shalom: haduh kine ki sngi ka dang don ha Ophrah jong ki Abi eshrit .

en: He saith unto them ,  Come and see .  They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .
kha: To wan bad khmih ,  u la jubab . ( Ka la long ha kata ka por kumba saw baje janmiet . ) Kumta ki la leit bad u , bad ki la ïohi hangno u sah , bad ki la pynlut ïa kaba sah jong ka sngi bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha ki , To wan bad peit . Ki la wan bad ki la iohi ia ka jaka ba u shong bad u ha kata ka sngi: namar ka la long kumba shi kynta .

en: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers , nor the desire of women , nor regard any god : for he shall magnify himself above all .
kha: U syiem un ym suidñiew ïa u blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la shakri , bad ruh ïa u blei ba ki kynthei ki ieit . Ha ka jingshisha un ym suidñiew ïa uno uno u blei , namar un pyrkhat ba u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym khein ia U Blei jong ki kpa jong u, ne ia ka jingkwah jong ki kynthei, ne un ym khein ia uno uno u blei: namar un pynkhraw ia lade halor jong baroh .

en: It was foursquare  ; they made the breastplate double : a span was the length thereof , and a span the breadth thereof , being doubled .
kha: Ka long kaba sawdong bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap . Ka don arphew ar sentimitar ka lynter bad arphew ar sentimitar ka jingïar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long kaba saw tylli ki jaka ba la shna arsien: ka span ka long ka jingjrong jong ka, bad ka span ka jingjrong jong ka, ka la kylla ar shah .

en: Neither do men light a candle , and put it under a bushel , but on a candlestick  ; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba thang ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; hynrei u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , na kaba ka ai jingshai ïa baroh kiba hapoh ka ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew ruh kim ju pynmeh ia ka sharak, bad ki buh ia ka hapoh ka khlaw, hynrei ha ka sharak ; bad ka ai jingshai ia baroh kiba don ha iing .

en: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings , because he had done good in Israel , both toward God , and toward his house .
kha: Ki la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid kum ka dak ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingshakri kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki paid Israel , na ka bynta U Blei bad na ka bynta ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid hapdeng ki syiem , namar u la leh bha ha Israel , ha U Blei bad ha ka iing jong u .

en: And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang  purew kam shym la thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka barel jong u jingbam kam shym la jah rngai , bad ka umphniang kam shym la jah rngai , kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u la kren da u Elijah .

en: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar jong u , naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u bad ki lynti jong u baroh, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha khmih la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Judah bad Israel .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kaba u Jehoïakim u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoiakim bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ , if any comfort of love , if any fellowship of the Spirit , if any bowels and mercies ,
kha: Ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist ka pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi , bad ka jingieit jong u ka pyntngen ïa phi . Phi don ka jingïasyllok lem bad U Mynsiem , bad phi don ka jingsbun bad ka jingsngewsynei iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don namarkata kano kano ka jingpyntngen ha U Khrist , lada don kano kano ka jingpyntngen jong ka jingieit , lada don kano kano ka jingiasyllok jong U Mynsiem , lada don ki kpoh bad ki jingsngewsih , .

en: And he said , This is wickedness . And he cast it into the midst of the ephah  ; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof .
kha: U angel u la ong ,  Kane ka kynthei ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jingbymman .  Nangta u ñiat ïa ka sha tbian shapoh jong ka shang bad u tap pat shapoh ïa ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kane ka long ka jingsniew . Bad u la bret ia ka hapdeng ka ephah ; bad u la bret ia ka jingkhia jong ka lead ha ka shyntur jong ka .

en: Then said these men , We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel , except we find it against him concerning the law of his God .
kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngin ym shem kano kano da kaba ngi lah ban kynnoh ïa u Daniel lymda dei kaei kaei kaba ïasoh bad ka niam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la ong kine ki briew , Ngin ym shem ei ei pyrshah ia une u Daniel , lymda ngi shem ia ka pyrshah ia u shaphang ka hukum U Blei jong u .

en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .
kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist ngi long kiba bieit ; hynrei , phi long kiba stad ha U Khrist ! Ngi long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ ! Ngi long kiba la ibeiñ , hynrei phi long kiba la pyndonburom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long kiba bieit na ka bynta U Khrist, hynrei phi long kiba stad ha U Khrist ; ngi long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long kiba khlain ; phi long kiba donburom , hynrei ngi shah niewbein .

en: One post shall run to meet another , and one messenger to meet another , to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end ,
kha: U nonglamktien uwei hadien uwei u mareh ban ïathuh ha u syiem ka Babilonia ba ïa ka nongbah jong u la pynpra na baroh ki liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka post kan iaid ban iakynduh ia kawei pat , bad uwei u nonglam khubor ban iakynduh ia uwei pat , ban pyni ia u syiem Babilon ba la shim ia ka shnong jong u ha kawei ka tduh .

en: Because they despised my judgments , and walked not in my statutes , but polluted my sabbaths : for their heart went after their idols .
kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular namar ba ki la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton — ki la kham jied ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la lehbein ia ki jingbishar jong nga, bad kim shym la iaid ha ki ain jong nga, hynrei ki la pynjakhlia ia ki Sabha jong nga: namar ka dohnud jong ki ka la iaid bud ia ki bleithaw jong ki .

en: And the children of Dan went their way : and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back unto his house .
kha: Nangta ki leit sha khmat . U Mikah u ïohi ïa kata ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u , kumta u leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun u Dan ki la leit noh: bad haba u Mica u la iohi ba ki long kiba khlain palat ia u , u la phai bad u la leit phai noh sha la iing .

en: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses , behold , the skin of his face shone  ; and they were afraid to come nigh him .
