en: For it hath been declared unto me of you , my brethren , by them which are of the house of Chloe , that there are contentions among you .
kha: Naba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka longïing jong ka Khloi ki la ïathuh ïa nga da kaba shai kdar , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba don ki jingkajia hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la pynbna ha nga na phi, ko para jong nga, da kito kiba long na ka iing Chlois , ba ki don ki jingialeh hapdeng jong phi .

en: And as he went out of the temple , one of his disciples saith unto him , Master , see what manner of stones and what buildings are here !
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang mihnoh na ka Templ , uwei na ki synran jong u , u la ong ,  Khmih , ko Nonghikai ! Haduh katno ki maw bad ki jingtei ki long kiba iphylla !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang mih na ka tempi, uwei na ki synran jong u u ong ha u, Ko Nonghikai, peit ia ki maw bad kiei ki jingtei hangne !

en: Let the work of this house of God alone  ; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place .
kha: Wat don ha ka Templ bad wat tuklar ïa ka jingtei ïa ka . Ai ba u lat ka Judah bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw kin tei pat ïa ka Templ U Blei ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka kam jong kane ka iing U Blei marwei kan long u Lat jong ki Jiw bad ki rangbah jong ki Jiw kin tei ia kane ka iing U Blei ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And when I beheld , lo , the sinews and the flesh came up upon them , and the skin covered them above : but there was no breath in them .
kha: Katba nga dang peit , la sop ïa ki shyieng da ki thied , bad ka dohksah , bad nangta da ka sniehdoh . Hynrei ym don jingpynhiar mynsiem ha kita ki met .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la iohi, ha khmih, ki shyieng bad ka doh ki la wan shaneng halor jong ki, bad ka sniehdoh ka la tap ia ki shaneng: hynrei ym shym la don mynsiem ha ki .

en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ bad nga khem ïa ki ha kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la don ha ka kti jong nga: bad nga la shim ia ki sohjew bad nga la pynkhih ia ki ha ka khuri jong u Pharaoh .

en: And said unto them , I see your father s countenance , that it is not toward me as before  ; but the God of my father hath been with me .
kha: U ong ïa ki ,  Nga ithuh ba i pa jong phi im da leh jan shuh ïa nga kumba mynshuwa ; hynrei U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u la don lem bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki , Nga iohi ia ka khmat jong phi, ba kam long ha nga kumba shuwa u ; hynrei U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u la don ryngkat bad nga .

en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .
kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut bad kiba shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Akhish .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la iaid shakhmat da ki spah ngut bad da ki hajar ngut: hynrei u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la iaid shakhmat shadien bad u Achish .

en: Her cities are a desolation , a dry land , and a wilderness , a land wherein no man dwelleth , neither doth any son of man pass thereby .
kha: Ki shnong ki la long kiba ishyrkhei ban peit bad ki long kum ka ri shyiap bym don um , ha kaba ym don ba sah lane wat ban ïaid nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong jong ka ki long ka ri kaba rkhiang, bad ka ri khlaw, ka ri ha kaba ym don briew kaba shong , bad u khun briew um iaid lyngba kata .

en: And the hand of the  Lord  was there upon me  ; and he said unto me , Arise , go forth into the plain , and I will there talk with thee .
kha: Te nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  bad nga la ïohsngew ba u ong ha nga ,  Ïeng joit bad leit sha ka them . Ngan sa ïakren bad me hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti U Trai ka la don hangta halor jong nga ; bad u la ong ha nga: To khie leit sha ka madan , bad ngan ia kren hangta bad me .

en: And they shall fight against thee  ; but they shall not prevail against thee  ; for I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to deliver thee .
kha: To shahshkor , ko Jeremaïah ! Uwei pa uwei ha kane ka ri — ki syiem ka Judah , ki rangbah synshar , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew — kin long pyrshah ïa me . Hynrei ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki ; men long kum ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , u rishot nar , bad ka kynroh rnong . Kin ym lah ban jop ïa me , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ialeh pyrshah ia me ; hynrei kin ym jop ia me ; namar nga don ryngkat bad me , ong U Trai , ban pyllait im ia me .

en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .
kha: Kumta ki la leit nadien jong u ryngkat bad ki briew jong ki bad lap ïa u hajan ka pung kaba heh ha Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la shim ia ki briew baroh bad ki la leit ialeh bad u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah bad ki la shem ia u hajan ki um kiba khraw kiba don ha Gibeon .

en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years , when Solomon had built the two houses , the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house ,
kha: Ka shim por arphew snem ïa u Solomon ban tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki arphew snem , haba u Solomon u la tei ia ki ar tylli ki iing , ka iing U Trai bad ka iing syiem .

en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Behold , I will do a thing in Israel , at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Shisien ka sngi ngan leh ei ei kaba shyrkhei katta katta ïa ki briew ha Israel ba kita baroh kiba ïohsngew shaphang kata kin lyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Samuel , Ha khmih, ngan leh ia kaei kaei ha Israel, ha kaba baroh ar tylli ki shkor jong uwei pa uwei uba iohsngew ia ka kin khih .

en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the  Lord  : and what is Aaron , that ye murmur against him ?
kha: Haba phi ujor pyrshah ïa u Aaron , ka mut shisha pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ba ma phi bad ki nongbud jong phi , phi ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw jong kata baroh arngut me bad ka kynhun jong me baroh ki ialum lang pyrshah ia U Trai : bad kaei ka Aaron , ba phi ia ud pyrshah ia u ?

en: And he sent young men of the children of Israel , which offered burnt offerings , and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u la phah ïa ki samla shynrang bad ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  bad ki la kñia katto katne tylli ki jingri kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ki samla Israel kiba la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ki la knia ia ki jingknia jingsuk ha U Trai .

en: For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .
kha: Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei . La khet ïa u dieng ha khlaw ; la ohdur da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki riti dustur jong ki briew ki long kiba lehnohei: namar uwei u ot ia u dieng na khlaw , ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong u nongtrei , da ka ax .

en: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
kha: u ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ba ka ïing ka thylli , ka khuid , bad baroh la buh ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong , Ngan leit phai noh sha la iing na kaba nga la mih ; bad ynda u la wan u la shem ba ka long kaba thylli, kaba la tyrkhong bad kaba la tyrkhong .

en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Hesekaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha ka snem kaba lai jong u Hosia u khun jong u Elah u syiem Israel , ba u Hesekaiah u khun u Ahasa u syiem Judah u la sdang ban synshar .

en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .
kha: Lada phi ïohi ba ka kada jong u ka kyllon namar ba ban ka jingkit , ïarap ban pynïeng pat ïa ka ; wat shu ïaid lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me iohi ia ka tdong jong uta uba shun ia me uba thiah hapoh ka jingkit jong u , bad phi kwah ban iarap ia u , thikna ba phin iarap ia u .

en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons , and a desolation for ever : there shall no man abide there , nor any son of man dwell in it .
kha: Ïa ka Hasor yn pynkylla ri shyiap junom , ka jaka ha kaba tang ki myrsiang kin im . Yn ym don mano mano shuh ban shong ban sah biang hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Hazor kan long ka jaka sah jong ki bsein bad ka jingpynjot junom: ym don briew uba sah hangta, lymne uno uno u khun briew uba shong ha ka .

en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
kha: Katba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan bud ïa me kat shaba me leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba ki dang iaid ha lynti, uwei u briew u la ong ha u: Ko Trai, ngan bud ia me shano shano ruh ba me leit .

en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el , that went not out after Israel : and they left the city open , and pursued after Israel .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha Ai u la leit beh ïa ki Israel , bad ki la iehnoh rynghang ïa ka nongbah , khlem don mano mano ban ïada ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don briew uba sah ha Ai ne ha Betel, u bym shym la leit shabar hadien ki Israel : bad ki la mih noh na ka shnong kaba plie, bad ki la bud ia ki Israel .

en: And Achish believed David , saying , He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him  ; therefore he shall be my servant for ever .
kha: Hynrei u Akhish u shaniah ïa u Dabid , u da ong ha lade ,  U la long uba la isih haduh katta katta da ki briew jong u hi ki Israel ba kumta un hap long u shakri ïa nga baroh shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Achish u la ngeit ia u Dabid, u da ong , U la pynlong ia ki briew jong u Israel ban shun ia u ; namarkata un long u shakri jong nga junom .

en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh bun ki synran . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Lystra , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta sha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la ialap ia ka gospel ha kata ka shnong bad ki la hikai ia kiba bun, ki la leit phai biang sha Lystra bad sha Iconiah bad Antioch .

en: The wife hath not power of her own body , but the husband : and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body , but the wife .
kha: Ka tnga kam long kynrad halor ka met jong ka hi , hynrei u tnga jong ka u long ; kumjuh ruh u tnga um long kynrad halor ka met jong u hi , hynrei ka tnga jong u ka long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnga kam don bor ia la ka jong ka met , hynrei u tnga: bad kumjuh ruh u tnga um don bor ia la ka jong ka met .

en: All we like sheep have gone astray  ; we have turned every one to his own way  ; and the  Lord  hath laid on him the iniquity of us all .
kha: Ngi baroh ngi la long kum ki langbrot ba la sakma , uwei pa uwei na ngi u leit ha la ka jong ka lynti . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynlong ba ka jingpynshitom kan hap halor jong u , ka jingpynshitom kaba baroh ngi dei hok ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ngi kum ki langbrot ngi la iaid bakla ; ngi la phai noh iwei ia la ka jong ka lynti ; bad U Trai u la buh ha u ia ka jingbymhok jong ngi baroh .

en: And she said , Who would have said unto Abraham , that Sarah should have given children suck ? for I have born him a son in his old age .
kha: Nangta ka bynrap ,  Uei u ban leit ong ha u Abraham ba ka Sarah kan ïoh sumar khun ? Pynban nga la kha khun shynrang ïa u haba u la tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ong: Mano ba la ong ha u Abraham ba ka Sarah ka la dei ban ai khun ia u? namar nga la kha ia u khun shynrang ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u .

en: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .
kha: U Ïoannis u la kren ,  Ko Kynrad , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh , namar um shym long u jong ka kynhun jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la jubab bad u la ong, Ko Nonghikai, ngi la iohi ia uwei uba beh ia ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me bad ngi la kyntait ia u, namar ba um bud ia ngi.

en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .
kha: Bad wat sngewkhuslai haba phi ïohsngew ki jingsawa ki thma hajan jong phi bad ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa kine kiei kiei ban jia , hynrei kam mut ba ka jingkut ka la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phin iohsngew ia ki thma bad ki khubor shaphang ki thma , wat nym sngewsih: namar kum kine kiei kiei ki dei ban long; hynrei ka jingkut kan ym long haduh mynta .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I have lifted up mine hand , Surely the heathen that are about you , they shall bear their shame .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga kular kyntang ba ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong kin shah pynpoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u la pynkiew ia ka kti jong nga , Hooid ki nongwei kiba don sawdong jong phi , kin kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki .

en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la long ki lyngdoh jong u , bad u Samuel u la long uwei uba la duwai ha u ; kiba la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la jubab ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron napdeng ki lyngdoh jong u, bad u Samuel napdeng jong ki kiba khot ia ka kyrteng jong u ; ki la khot ia U Trai , bad u la jubab ia ki .

en: I was at ease , but he hath broken me asunder : he hath also taken me by my neck , and shaken me to pieces , and set me up for his mark .
kha: Nga la im ha ka jingsuk , hynrei U Blei u shim ïa nga na ryndang bad shoh bad pynlwet ïa nga . U Blei u pyndonkam ïa nga kum ka sohpdung
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la sngewsuk , hynrei u la pynpra ia nga: u la shim ruh ia nga da ka ryndang jong nga , bad u la pynkhih ia nga haduh ki bynta , bad u la pynlong ia nga ban ieng ia ka dak jong u .

en: And that which thou sowest , thou sowest not that body that shall be , but bare grain , it may chance of wheat , or of some other grain :
kha: Bad ïa uei uba me bet , u long tang u symbai , lehse u long u symbai kew ne uwei pat u symbai , ym u jingthung ba la san pura u ban san hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba me uba bet, me ym bet ia kata ka met kaba dei ban long, hynrei u kew uba thylli, u lah ban long u kew ne uwei pat u kew:

en: And when Abigail saw David , she hasted , and lighted off the ass , and fell before David on her face , and bowed herself to the ground ,
kha: Haba ka Abigail ka ïohi ïa u Dabid , ka la hiar kloi kloi bad ka dem khrup ha khyndew
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka Abigail ka la iohi ia u Dabid, ka la kyrkieh bad ka la pynjem ia ka tdong bad ka la dem ha khmat u Dabid bad ka la dem khrup ha khyndew .

en: He took also of the seed of the land , and planted it in a fruitful field  ; he placed it by great waters , and set it as a willow tree .
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u jingthung ba dang lung na ka ri Israel bad u la thung ïa u ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh , ha kaba ka ju ïai don ka um ban pynlong ïa u ban san .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ruh ia u symbai jong ka ri, bad u la thung ia u ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh u la buh ia u da ki um kiba heh , bad u la buh ia u kum u dieng uba jyrngam .

en: Our holy and our beautiful house , where our fathers praised thee , is burned up with fire : and all our pleasant things are laid waste .
kha: bad ïa ka Templ jong ngi , ka jaka kyntang bad ba-itynnat ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la ïaroh ïa me , la pynjot noh da ka ding . Baroh ki jaka kiba ngi ieit ki la don ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing bakhuid bad ka iing kaba itynnad jong ngi, ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki iaroh ia me, la thang da ka ding: bad kiei kiei baroh kiba sngewtynnad jong ngi ki la jah rngai noh .

en: And I that am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles , as in the days of the solemn feast .
kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt , ngan pynlong ïa phi ban sah biang ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumba phi la leh mynba nga wan sha phi ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga uba long U Trai U Blei jong me na ka ri Ijipt ngan dang pynlong ia me ban shong ha ki ïingjaiñ kumba ha ki sngi jong ka jingkhawai kaba jur .

en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
kha: Mar kumta hi u angel jong U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um shym ai burom ïa U Blei . La bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ , bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u angel U Trai u la sdang ia u, namar um shym la ai ia U Blei ia ka burom : bad u la shah bam da ki khniang , bad u la aiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive , and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed .
kha: Kumta phin long kiba nyngkong ban leit sha ka jinglongmraw . Ki jingkhawai bad ki jingïadih ïabam sngewbha jong phi kin kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok bad kiba nyngkong eh kiba leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel : for the Philistines said , Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears :
kha: Ym shym la don ki kamar ha Israel , namar ki Philistia ki la kut jingmut ban ym ailad ïa ki Hebru ban shna ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ym shym la lap ia ki khniang ha kylleng ka ri Israel: namar ki Philistia ki la ong: Lada ki Hebru kin pynlong ia ki da ki waitlam ne ki khnam:

en: Then she came and told the man of God . And he said , Go , sell the oil , and pay thy debt , and live thou and thy children of the rest .
kha: Ka la leit phai pat sha u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa , uba la ong ïa ka ,  Die ïa ka umphniang Olib bad siew dep ïa ki ram jong phi baroh , ban yn don bun ka tyngka kaba tam na ka bynta jong phi bad ki khun shynrang jong phi ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la wan bad ka la iathuh ha uta u briew jong U Blei . Bad u la ong, Leit, die ia ka umphniang bad siew ia ka ram jong me bad im ma me bad ki khun jong me kiba sah .

en: So he measured the court , an hundred cubits long , and an hundred cubits broad , foursquare  ; and the altar that was before the house .
kha: Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka phyllaw kaba shapoh bad ka la don sanphew mitar sawdong . Ka Templ ka don shaphang sepngi bad ha khmat jong ka , ka don ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la thew ia ka iingbishar kaba jrong shispah cubit bad shispah cubit kaba heh, kaba saw tylli; bad ka almari kaba don ha khmat ka iing .

en: The  Lord  recompense thy work , and a full reward be given thee of the  Lord  God of Israel , under whose wings thou art come to trust .
kha: To U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh . Ai ba phin ïoh ka bainong kaba pura na U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , sha uba phi la wan ban ïoh jingïada .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u siew kylliang ia ka kam jong me, bad ka bainong kaba pura jong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, hapoh jong ki ki bniat jong me me wan shaniah .

en: We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .
kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Heshbon haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la siat ia ki ; U Heshbon u la jah noh wat haduh Dibon, bad ngi la pynjot ia ki haduh u Nophah, kaba poi haduh Medeb .

en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart , so let him give ; not grudgingly , or of necessity : for God loveth a cheerful giver .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ai , namarkata , kumba phi la kut jingmut , ym da kaba bynñiaw ne da kaba sngew kum ka kamram ; naba U Blei u ieit ïa uta uba ai da kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew katba u thmu ha ka dohnud jong u, kumta to ai ba un ai shuh shuh: namar U Blei u ieit ia u nongai uba sngewbha .

en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son : and I will not take my mercy away from him , as I took it from him that was before thee :
kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khun jong nga , ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong nga na u kumba nga la leh ïa u Saul , ïa uba nga la weng khnang ba me lah ban long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khun jong nga: bad ngan ym shim noh ia ka jingisynei jong nga na u kumba nga la shim noh na uta uba la don ha khmat jong me:

en: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem : and he fled to Lachish  ; but they sent after him to Lachish , and slew him there .
kha: Ka don ka jingïasylla ha Jerusalem ban pynïap ïa u Amasaïah , kumta u phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , hynrei ki nongshun jong u ki bud ïa u shata bad pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki la leh ia ka jingthmu pyrshah ia u ha Jerusalem : bad u la phet noh sha Lachish ; hynrei ki la phah hadien jong u sha Lachish bad ki la pyniap ia u hangta .

en: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles , shalt quicken me again , and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth .
kha: Me la phah ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom halor jong nga , hynrei men pynïoh pat ka jingkhlaiñ ha nga ; men sumar ïa nga na ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Me uba la pyni ia nga ia ki jingeh kiba khraw bad kiba jur , men pynkloi biang ia nga , bad men pynmih biang ia nga na ki jingjylliew jong ka khyndew .

en: And because I doubted of such manner of questions , I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these matters .
kha: Ngam sngewlah ban rai kumno ngan lah ban ïoh jingtip halor kine kiei kiei , kumta nga la kylli ïa u Paul lada u mon ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ba yn shah bishar hangta halor kine ki jingkynnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba nga artatien ia kum kine ki jingkylli , nga la kylli ia u la un leit sha Jerusalem , bad hangta yn bishar ia kine ki kam .

en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I am God ? but thou shalt be a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .
kha: Haba kin wan ban pynïap ïa me , hato men dang kam hi ba me long U Blei ? Haba me ïakynduh ïa ki nongpynïap briew , men long uba kynja briew bad ym satia uba kynja blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me dang ong ha khmat uta uba pyniap ia me, nga long U Blei ? hynrei men long u briew bad ym U Blei ha ka kti jong uta uba pyniap ia me .

en: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon , nor any that come into Dagon s house , tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day .
kha: ( Dei namar kata ba haduh mynta ruh ki lyngdoh u Dagon bad baroh kiba mane ïa u ha Ashdod ki ryngkang noh ïa kata ka jaka bad kim ju ïaid nalor jong ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ym don ki lyngdoh jong u Dagon ne uno uno uba wan sha ka iing u Dagon ha Ashdod haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem , and thine arm shall be uncovered , and thou shalt prophesy against it .
kha: Phai beit ïa la ki khmat sha ka Jerusalem ba la shah kerkut , pynkhih ïa la ka kti ba la kham , sha ka phang ka nongbah bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban buh ia ka khmat jong me sha ka jingkhang jong ka Jerusalem , bad ka kti jong me kan sa paw , bad me dei ban iathuhlypa pyrshah ia ka .

en: Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .
kha: Te u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ u la ong , ‘ Kaei ngan leh ? ngan phah ïa u khun ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga ; da kaba thikna kin burom ïa u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u kynrad jong ka kper sohjew: Ngan leh aiu ? Ngan phah ia u khun baieit jong nga: ka lah ban long ba kin burom ia u haba ki iohi ia u .

en: And one loaf of bread , and one cake of oiled bread , and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the  Lord  :
kha: Shim ruh uwei u kpu , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , bad uwei u kpu lyngkniap na kata ka shang kpu ba la ainguh sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka kpu , bad kawei ka cake jong u kpu ba la khleh lang , bad kawei ka wafer na ka basket jong u kpu bym pat thied kaba don ha khmat U Trai:

en: Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :
kha: Nangta u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . U la phah ktien ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor bad u la ong ïa u ban buh ka jingtim halor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Balak u khun u Zippor u syiem u Moab u la ieng bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel bad u la phah bad khot ia u Balaam u khun u Beor ban tim ia phi:

en: And he built fenced cities in Judah : for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years  ; because the  Lord  had given him rest .
kha: U tei ïa ki kynroh na ka bynta ki nongbah ka Judah ha ka por jong u , bad ym shym don thma bun bun snem , namar ba U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tei ia ki shnong ba la ker ha Judah: namar ka ri ka la shongthait , bad um shym la don thma ha kita ki snem ; namar U Trai u la ai jingjahthait ia u .

en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
kha: Hukum ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa ka umphniang Olib kaba khuid bha na ka bynta kita ki sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ki khun Israel , ba kin wanrah ha me ia ka umphniang olive kaba khuid kaba la tyrkhong na ka bynta ka jingshai , ban pynlong ia ki sharak ban thang beit .

en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey , save a staff only  ; no scrip , no bread , no money in their purse :
kha: bad u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat rah ei ei bad phi ha ka jingleit jong phi lait noh tang ïa u diengduh — ym ïa u kpu , ym ïa ka pla khrong , ym ïa ka pisa ha ki pla sopti jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki ba kim dei ban shim ei ei na ka bynta ka jingleit jong ki, lait noh tang u nongtrei tang shu shu shu shu shu shu shu shu shu thoh shuh shuh:

en: There is no fear in love  ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .
kha: Ym don ka jingsheptieng ha ka jingieit ; ka jingieit kaba janai ka beh noh ïa ka jingsheptieng baroh . Kumta te , ïa ka jingieit ym shym la pynjanai ha uno uno uba sheptieng , namar ka jingsheptieng ka don jingïadei bad ka jingpynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don jingtieng ha ka jingieit ; hynrei ka jingieit kaba janai ka pynmih ia ka jingtieng: namar ka jingtieng ka don ka jingshah pynshitom . Uta uba tieng um shym la long uba janai ha ka jingieit .

en: Stay yourselves , and wonder  ; cry ye out , and cry : they are drunken , but not with wine  ; they stagger , but not with strong drink .
kha: To long uba mutlop ! To long uba matlah ! To long uba buaid khlem kano kano ka waiñ ! To ïaid sheng sheng khlem dih wat tang shi jaw !
translated_en_to_kha: To sah ia lade, bad phylla ba phi iam shabar, bad phi iam: ki la dih kyiad, hynrei ym da ka wain ; ki ia tyngkhuh, hynrei ym da ka jingdih kaba khlain .

en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .
kha: To siew te , kaei kaba phi dei ban siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dei ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom bad to ai ka burom ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit namarkata ia ki jingsiew jong ki baroh: ka burom ia kiba dei ban siew khajna ha kiba ki tieng ia kiba ki tieng;

en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance .
kha: Ha ka por jong u , ka rupa ha Jerusalem ka kynrei kum u maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jyllei kum u dieng Sykomore    ha trai ki lum Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la shna rupa ha Jerusalem kum ki maw, bad u dieng sohjew u la shna ia u kum ki dieng sohjew kiba don ha ki madan kiba rit ha ka jingbun .

en: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u Abram u kynriah noh ïa la ka dara , bad u wan shong wan sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre ha Hebron , bad hangta u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abram u la weng noh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u, bad u la wan shong ha ka madan Mamre kaba don ha Hebron bad u la tei hangta ka ïingknia ha U Trai .

en: And he took unto him all these , and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not .
kha: U Abram u la wallam ïa kine ki mrad sha U Blei , u ot ïa ki ar lyngkhot , bad u buh ïa ki lyngkhot doh marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat ha ki ar laiñ ; hynrei ïa ki sim um shym la ot lyngkhot .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia kine baroh, bad u la phiah ia ki hapdeng , bad u la buh ia kawei kawei pat: hynrei ki sim kim shym la phiah ia u .

en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .
kha: Balei ki briew ki stet haduh katta katta ban leh ïa ki kam sniew ? Namar ïa ka kam sniew ym ju kham pynshitom kloi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ka sentens pyrshah ia ka kam kaba sniew kam ju long kaba stet , namarkata ka dohnud ki khun shynrang ka long kaba la buh pura ha ki ban leh ia kaba sniew .

en: And ye shall go out at the breaches , every cow at that which is before her  ; and ye shall cast them into the palace , saith the  Lord .
kha: Phin sa shah ring sha ka jaka bapei ha ka kynroh ba hajan tam , bad yn sa bret ïa phi shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin leit shabar ha ki jingpynkhein , kawei pa kawei ka masi ha kata kaba don ha khmat jong ka ; bad phin bret ia ki shapoh ka iing syiem , ong U Trai .

en: O  Lord  , be gracious unto us  ; we have waited for thee : be thou their arm every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .
kha: A  Trai  , to isynei ïa ngi . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ha me . To ïada ïa ngi man la ka sngi bad to pynim ïa ngi ha ki por jong ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , to long kiba sngewrit ia ngi ; ngi la ap ia me: to long ka kti jong ki man ka step , ka jingpynim jong ngi ruh ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar .

en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .
kha: Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U  Trai  u la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , bad ngam shym lah ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba ngan ong ? u la kren ia nga baroh arngut bad ma u hi u la leh ia kata: Ngan iaid jem ia ki snem jong nga baroh ha ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong nga .

en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes , and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes  ; and the spirit of God came upon him .
kha: bad u ïohi ïa ki paid Israel ba ki sher dara shi jait shi jait . U mynsiem U Blei u wan rung ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la rah ia ki khmat jong u , bad u la iohi ia ki Israel ba ki shong ha ki ïingjaiñ jong u kat kum ki jaitbynriew jong ki ; bad ka mynsiem U Blei ka la wan ha u .

en: These things said he : and after that he saith unto them ,  Our friend Lazarus sleepeth  ; but I go , that I may awake him out of sleep .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane bad nangta u pynbud ,  U paralok jong ngi u Lasaros u la ïohthiah , hynrei ngan leit bad ngan kyrsiew noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei ki la ong u: bad hadien kata u la ong ha ki, U paralok jong ngi u Lasaros u thiah ; hynrei nga leit noh, ba ngan pynkynjah ia u na ka jingthiah .

en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel , Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea , a remnant shall be saved :
kha: Bad U Isaïah u la pyrta shaphang ki Israel :  Wat lada ki paid Israel ki bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw , pynban tang khyndiat na ki yn pynim ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah ruh u pyrta shaphang ki Israel , Wat la ka jingdon jong ki khun Israel kan long kum ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw , ka jingsah kan sa lait im:

en: And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :
kha: Ki ïa-ong ,  Ngim lah ban ai ïa la ka jong ka para ba kan ïashongkurim bad u briew u bym shym la otsher ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ki, Ngim lah ban leh ia kane ka kam, ban ai ia ka para jong ngi ha kawei kaba khlem ot ; namar kata ka la long ka jingkren bein ia ngi:

en: Thou shalt build the altar of the  Lord  thy God of whole stones : and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  thy God :
kha: Tei ïa ka duwan na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da ki maw tylli ; bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ;
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban tei ia ka jingknia jong U Trai U Blei jong me: bad me dei ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai U Blei jong me:

en: And I will give power unto my two witnesses , and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days , clothed in sackcloth .
kha: Ngan sa phah ïa ki sakhi jong nga ar ngut kiba kup da ki jaiñ khain , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha kita ki shihajar arspah hynriewphew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai bor ia ki arngut ki sakhi jong nga, bad kin iathuhlypa shihajar arspah hynriew sngi .

en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .
kha: Ka Sarah ka la long kumta ; ka la kohnguh ïa u Abraham bad ka khot ïa u , u kynrad jong ka . Phi long ki khun kynthei jong ka mynta lada phi leh ïa kaba dei bad phim sheptieng ïa kano kano .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka Sara ka la kohnguh ia u Abraham, ka khot ia u kynrad jong u: kiba phi long, katba phi dang leh bha, bad phim tieng ia kano kano ka jinglyngngoh .

en: Thou shalt be over my house , and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled : only in the throne will I be greater than thou .
kha: Ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ka ri jong nga , bad ki briew jong nga baroh kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me . Ka iktiar jong me hadien ka jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long halor ka iing jong nga, bad kat kum ka ktien jong me baroh: tang ha ka khet ngan kham khraw ban ia me .

en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;
kha: Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew ha ka nongbah , hynrei ka snam kam shym pashait ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kam lah ban buhrieh ïa ka ; ka la pashait ha u mawsiang basyllen .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka snam jong ka ka don hapdeng jong ka ; ka la buh ia ka ha ka tduh jong u maw ; kam shym la theh ia ka ha ka khyndew , ban tap ia ka da ka dewbilat ; .

en: And strip Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son : and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there .
kha: bad hangta law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . U Aaron un ïap hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Aaron u la weng noh ia ki jain jong u, bad u la buh ia ki ha u Eleasar u khun jong u: bad u Aaron un ialum lang bad ki briew jong u, bad un iap hangta .

en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .
kha: bad haba nga la leit sha Jerusalem , ki rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rai pynrem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang jongno, haba nga la don ha Jerusalem, ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ki Jiw ki la pyntip ia nga, ki kwah ban don ka jingbishar pyrshah ia u .

en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering , and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house , without the sanctuary .
kha: Me dei ban shim ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la ai kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop bad thang ïa u ha ka jaka ba la pynkhreh khnang shabar ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Me shim ia u masi ruh na ka jingainguh pop , bad un thang ia u ha ka jaka ba la buh jong ka iing , khlem ka jaka kyntang .

en: For all flesh is as grass , and all the glory of man as the flower of grass . The grass withereth , and the flower thereof falleth away :
kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ki briew baroh ki long kum u phlang , bad ka burom jong ki baroh kum ki  tiewkhlaw . U phlang u ïapstai noh , bad ki syntiew ki tlor noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka doh baroh ka long kum u phlang bad ka burom u briew baroh kum u syntiew phlang . U phlang u tyrkhong bad u syntiew jong u u hap noh:

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Behold , I will melt them , and try them  ; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people ?
kha: Namar kane U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan phrang ïa ki briew jong nga kum ïa ka nar bad buh ïa ki ha ka jingtynjuh . Ki briew jong nga ki la leh ïa kaba sniew — sa kaei pat kaba nga lah ban leh bad ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid: Ha khmih ngan pynkhyllem ia ki, bad ngan pyrshang ia ki ; namar kumno ngan leh ia ka khun jong ki briew jong nga ?

en: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths , to be a sign between me and them , that they might know that I am the  Lord  that sanctify them .
kha: Nga la pynlong ïa ka jingsumar ïa ka Sabbaton ka dak jong ka jingïateh kular hapdeng jong ngi , ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga pynlong ïa ki , kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ruh nga la ai ia ki Sabha jong nga, ban long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad ki, ba kin tip ba nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ia ki .

en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap jong U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade hi u ong ha nga ban tur ïaleh bad ban pynjot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato mynta nga wan shaneng khlem U Trai ban pynjot ia ka ? U Trai u la ong ha nga , To leit sha kane ka ri , bad pynjot ia ka .

en: And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .
kha: Kumta ki la pynhiar ïa u tyllai lem bad u sisa ba la teh ha u , bad ki la shem ba ka um ka don kumba sawphew mitar ka jingjylliew ; kham katto katne hadien ki la leh kumjuh bad ki la shem ba ka don laiphew mitar ka jingjylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sawa , bad u la shem ia ka arphew tylli ki bniat: bad haba ki la leit kham sha jngai khyndiat , ki la sawa biang , bad ki la shem ia ka shiphew tylli ki bniat .

en: It was meet that we should make merry , and be glad : for this thy brother was dead , and is alive again  ; and was lost , and is found .
kha: Hynrei ngi la dei ban lehkmen bad ban sngewkmen , namar u para jong phi uba la ïap , hynrei mynta u dang im ; u la jah , hynrei mynta la shem pat ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long kaba iakynduh ba ngi dei ban sngewbha, bad ban sngewbha: namar kane u hynmen jong me u la iap, bad u dang im biang ; bad u la jah noh, bad la lap ia u .

en: And this also is a sore evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go : and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind ?
kha: Hato kam dei kumta ? Ngi leit kumba ngi wan . Ngi trei , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer bad aïu ngi ïoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ruh ka long kaba sniew kaba jur, ba ha ki jaka baroh kumba u la wan: bad kaei ka jingmyntoi kaba uta uba la trei shitom na ka bynta ka Iyer ?

en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning , and numbered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .
kha: Dang step phyrngab u Joshua u la khie bad lumlang ïa ki shipai . Nangta ma u bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la ïalam ïa ki sha Ai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ieng dang step bad u la khein ia ki briew bad u la leit kiew , ma u bad ki rangbah Israel ha khmat ki briew sha Ai .

en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered ? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins .
kha: Lada ïa u paidlang uba mane ïa U Blei la pynkhuid phar na ki pop jong ki , kin ym sngewrem shuh ïa la ka pop , bad ki jingkñia ainguh baroh kin ym don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar te hato kin ym sangeh ban shah tyrwa ? namar ba ki nongmane shisien ki la pynkhuid ki la dei ban ym don shuh ka jingsngewthuh ia ki pop .

en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  ngan buh ïa me kum u nongap phira na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingmaham kiba nga ai ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, nga la pynlong ia me u nongap ia ka iing Israel: namarkata to iohsngew ia ka ktien ha ka shyntur jong nga , bad to ai jingmaham ia ki na nga .

en: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks , and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in , for my people that have sought me .
kha: Kin mane ïa nga bad ïalam ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki sha ki jaka phlang ha ka Pyntha ka Sharon ha ka phang sepngi bad ha ka Them ka Jingshitom ha ka phang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Sharon kan long ka kynhun langbrot, bad ka them Achor ka jaka na ka bynta ki kynhun ban thiah shapoh , na ka bynta ki briew jong nga kiba la wad ia nga .

en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .
kha: Lada phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim treh ban kohnguh ïa nga , ngan pynshitom shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi iaid pyrshah ia nga , bad phin ym sngap ia nga ; ngan wanrah hynriew sien shuh shuh ia ki khniang ha phi kat kum ki pop jong phi .

en: Saying , These last have wrought but one hour , and thou hast made them equal unto us , which have borne the burden and heat of the day .
kha: ‘ Kine ki briew kiba la shah khot bylla khatduh ki la trei tang shi kynta ,’ ki la ong , ‘ katba ïa ngi la buh ha ka kam baroh shi sngi ha ka jingshit ka sngi — pynban me siew ïa ki kumjuh kumba me la siew ïa ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Kine kiba khatduh ki la trei tang shi kynta , bad me la pynlong ia ki ban iaryngkat bad ngi , kiba la kit ia ka jingkit bad ka jingshit jong ka sngi .

en: And they stirred up the people , and the elders , and the scribes , and came upon him , and caught him , and brought him to the council ,
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah , ïa ki tymmen ki san , bad ïa ki nonghikai ka hukum . Ki la kem ïa u Stephan bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha khmat ka Dorbar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia ki briew bad ki rangbah bad ki nongthoh bad ki la wan sha u bad ki la kem ia u bad ki la wanrah ia u sha ka dorbar .

en: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey , and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil  ; and they shall pollute it .
kha: Ngan ailad ïa ki nongwei ban lute ïa ki ,  ong U  Trai  ,  bad ki nongpynkheiñ aiñ kin shim noh ïa ka spah jong ki bad pyntngit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan aiti ia ka ha ki kti jong ki nongwei na ka bynta ka jingbam , bad ha ki bymman jong ka khyndew na ka bynta ka jingjot ; bad kin pynjakhlia ia ka .

en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : and he called the name of the place Perez–uzzah to this day .
kha: bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la dom namar ba U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewsih namar ba U Trai u la pynkhein ia ka jaka ha Uzza: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka u Peresuziah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant  ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .
kha: Hynrei u ïohi ba ka jaka shongthait ka long kaba bha , Bad ba ka khyndew ka long kaba itynnat . Kumta u pyndem la ka met ban kit ïa ka jingkit , Bad la pynbor ban trei kum u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ba kata ka jingjahthait ka long kaba bha, bad ka ri kaba sngewtynnad; bad u la dem khrup ia ka tyrpeng jong u ban kit , bad u la kylla long u shakri ha ka khajna .

en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
kha: U Gideon u khun jong u Joash u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Joash u kpa jong u , kaba ha Ophrah , ka nongrit jong ka kur Abieser .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u khun u Joash u la iap ha ka rta kaba bha, bad la tep ia u ha ka jingtep jong u Joash u kpa jong u, ha Ophrah jong ki Abiezer .

en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord .
kha: Hadien ba u Dabid u la pyndep ban ai ïa ki jingkñia , u kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad sam jingbam ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Dabid u la pyndep ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk , u la kyrkhu ia ki briew ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .
kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist u long halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei briew , u tnga u long halor la ka tnga , bad U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga kwah ba phin tip , ba ka khlieh jong uwei pa uwei u briew ka long U Khrist ; bad ka khlieh jong ka kynthei ka long u briew ; bad ka khlieh U Khrist ka long U Blei .

en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .
kha: Kumta u syiem ka Israel u la maham ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta , bad ki la long phikir ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la phah sha kata ka jaka kaba u briew jong U Blei u la iathuh ha u bad u la maham ia u , bad u la pynim ia lade hangta , ym tang shisien ne arsien .

en: And command them to say unto their masters , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say unto your masters  ;
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ka Israel , u la bthah ïa nga ban hukum ïa ki ban ïathuh ïa ki syiem jong ki ba U  Trai  u la lah ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hukum ia ki ban ong ha ki kynrad jong ki , Kumta u Trai jong ki paidbah , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Kumta phin ong ha ki kynrad jong phi ; .

en: And he came by the Spirit into the temple : and when the parents brought in the child Jesus , to do for him after the custom of the law ,
kha: Haba la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem , u Simeon u la leit sha ka Templ . Haba ki kmie ki kpa ki la wallam ïa u khunlung Jisu hapoh ka Templ ban pyndep na ka bynta jong u ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wan da U Mynsiem ha ka tempi: bad haba ki kmie ki kpa ki la wanrah ia u khynnah Jisu , ban leh na ka bynta jong u kat kum ka rukom jong ka hukum .

en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;
kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki parabangeit baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shisha phi leh ia kata ha ki parabangeit baroh kiba don ha Makedonia baroh: hynrei ngi kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit ba phin nang kiew shuh shuh;

en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
kha: U briew uba shong hangta u jubab ,  Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa jong ki , ki dei kiei ?  Dei kumta ba la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na kata ka jaka u la jubab bad u la ong: Hynrei u kpa jong ki ? Namarkata ka la kylla long ka proberb , Hato u Saul ruh u long napdeng ki nongiathuhlypa ?

en: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about , and chased them , and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising .
kha: Ki Israel ki la kerkut ïa ki nongshun , bad khlem sangeh ki beh ïa ki nadien haduh ka jaka kaba sha mihngi na Gibeah , ki da pynïap ïa ki katba ki nang ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la khang ia ki Benjamin sawdong , bad ki la beh ia ki , bad ki la iaid kai ia ki da kaba suk pyrshah ia ka Gibeah sha ka jingmih ka sngi .

en: Of which , twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord   ; and six thousand were officers and judges :
kha: U syiem u buh arphew saw hajar ngut na ki ban pynïaid ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , hynriew hajar ngut ban buh jingthoh bad ban bishar ïa ki kam ïakajia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na kine, arphew saw hajar ki dei ban buh ia ka kam jong ka iing U Trai ; bad hynriew hajar ki long ki ophisar bad ki nongbishar:

en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :
kha: Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad men ym lah ban leit sha jaka paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, ko khun u briew, ha khmih, kin buh ia me bad kin teh ia me bad ki, bad me dei ban leit shabar hapdeng jong ki:

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Moses u dang pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng u paidbah , bad kumta u la bunkam naduh mynstep haduh ban da miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u Moses u la shong ban bishar ia ki briew: bad ki briew ki la ieng hajan u Moses naduh mynstep haduh janmiet .

en: Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .
kha: Jubab ïa nga , A  Trai  , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un tip ba me , U  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki sha lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga ko Trai, to sngap ia nga, ba une u briew un tip ba me long U Trai Blei bad ba me la pynphai biang ia ka dohnud jong ki .

en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kaba me don ïa nga kan ïoh long bad ki , bad kumta nga ruh ngan ïoh long bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynbna ha ki ia ka kyrteng jong me, bad ngan pynbna ia ka: ba ka jingieit kaba me la ieit ia nga kan long ha ki , bad nga ha ki .

en: And again , departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon , he came unto the sea of Galilee , through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis .
kha: U Jisu nangta u la mihnoh na ka thain jong ka Tyros bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Sidon sha ka duriaw Galilaïa , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka Dekapolis .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien pat, da kaba mih na ki rud duriaw jong ka Tyros bad ka Sidon , u la poi sha ka duriaw Galilaia , lyngba ki rud duriaw jong ka Decapolis .

en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine , wholly a right seed : how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me ?
kha: Nga la thung ïa me kum ïa u dieng sohwaiñ ba la jied na u symbai uba bha tam . Hynrei ha khmih me la kylla long uei ! Me la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba pyut bad u bymdondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la thung ia me u sohjew uba donburom, u symbai uba dei pura: kumno te me la kylla long u jingthung ba la tyrkhong jong u sohjew uba phylla ha nga ?

en: This city shall not be your caldron , neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof  ; but I will judge you in the border of Israel :
kha: Kane ka nongbah kan ym ïada ïa phi ha ka rukom ba u khiew u da ïa ka doh hapoh jong u . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi hangno hangno ba phi don ha ka ri Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka shnong kan ym long ka jaka ri jingri jong phi, lymne phin ym long ka doh hapdeng jong ka hynrei ngan bishar ia phi ha u pud u sam jong ki Israel:

en: Him , being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God , ye have taken , and by wicked hands have crucified and slain :
kha: Kat kum ka jingthmu jong u hi , U Blei u la lah thmu lypa ba ïa U Jisu yn aiti ha phi ; bad phi la pynïap ïa u da kaba shah ïa ki briew bapop ban sahnarphna ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U , la pynpoi da ka jingmut kaba skhem bad ka jingtip lypa jong U Blei , phi la shim , bad da ki kti kiba sniew phi la sahnarphna bad pyniap:

en: For ye shall not go out with haste , nor go by flight : for the  Lord  will go before you  ; and the God of Israel will be your rearward .
kha: Ha kane ka sien phin ym hap mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh ; phin ym pyrshang ban phet noh . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi bad un ïada ïa phi na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phin ym leit shabar da kaba kyrkieh, lymne ban leit phet noh: namar U Trai un leit shuwa jong phi ; bad U Blei jong ki Israel un long uba shadien jong phi .

en: Nay but , O man , who art thou that repliest against God ? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it , Why hast thou made me thus ?
kha: Hynrei phi , phi long uei , ko paralok jong nga , ban jubab kylla ïa U Blei ? U khiew khyndew um lah ban kylli ïa u briew uba la thaw ïa u ,  Balei ba me thaw ïa nga kumne ?
translated_en_to_kha: Em hynrei ko briew, me uba jubab pyrshah ia U Blei ? Hato kaei kaei kaba la mih kan ong ha uta uba la thaw ia ka , Balei me la pynlong ia nga kumta ?

en: And when the king entered into the house of the  Lord  , the guard came and fetched them , and brought them again into the guard chamber .
kha: Man ka por ba u syiem u leit sha ka Templ , ki nongap ki rah ïa ki stieh bad nangta ki pynphai ïa ki sha ki kamra ba buh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la rung shapoh iing U Trai , u nongap u la wan bad u la leit shim ia ki bad u la wanrah biang ia ki shapoh ka kamra pahara .

en: And afterward Joshua smote them , and slew them , and hanged them on five trees : and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u pynïap ïa ki syiem bad u sdien ïa ki ha ki san tylli ki dieng , ha kaba ki met jong ki , ki la sah haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u Joshua u la pyniap ia ki, bad u la pyniap ia ki, bad u la pyndait ia ki ha ki san tylli ki dieng: bad ki la ia shong ha ki dieng haduh ka por janmiet .

en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .
kha: Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingjop ngan ai ïa ka hok ban shong ha syndah jong nga ha ka khet jong nga , kumba nga ruh nga la jop bad mynta nga shong ha syndah U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba jop ngan ai ban shong bad nga ha ka khet jong nga, kumba nga ruh nga la jop, bad nga la shong bad U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .

en: But they , supposing him to have been in the company , went a day s journey  ; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance .
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u kim tip shaphang kane ; ki dang pyrkhat ba u la don lang bad ka kynhun , kumta ki la ïaleit lynti baroh shi sngi , bad nangta , ki la sdang ban wad ïa u hapdeng ki ba-ha-ïing bad ki paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la shim ba u la don ha ka kynhun, ki la leit sha ka jingleit kaba man ka sngi bad ki la wad ia u hapdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ki paralok jong ki .

en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :
kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga namar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad namar ki bleithaw da kiba la pyntngit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki namar ka snam kaba ki la theh halor ka ri , bad na ka bynta ki bleithaw jong ki kiba ki la pynjakhlia ia ka:

en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
kha: Ko Israel , pha long kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngew jynjar sat . Hynrei U  Trai  u khot pat ïa pha bad u ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la khot ia me kum ka kynthei kaba la iehnoh bad kaba la sngewsih ha ka mynsiem, bad ka tnga samla, haba me la kyntait, ong U Blei jong me .

en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .
kha: Naba kiwei ki la ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki na kaei kaba ki don , ban ym ktah ïa ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la ai ïa baroh kaba ka donkam ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine baroh ki don na ka jingbun jong ki ha ki jingainguh U Blei: hynrei ma ka na ka jingbun briew jong ka ka la bret ha ki jingim baroh kiba ka don .

en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
kha: U la pynbna ha ki briew ,  U briew u ban wan hadien jong nga u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki juti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ialap da kaba ong , Ka wan kawei kaba kham khlain ban ia nga hadien jong nga, ka jingkhang jong ki juti jong nga ngam long uba bit ban dem khrup bad pyllait .

en: And the king said unto her , Be not afraid : for what sawest thou ? And the woman said unto Saul , I saw gods ascending out of the earth .
kha: U syiem u ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng ! Phi ïohi aïu ?   Nga ïohi ïa ka sna-ïap ba ka mih na khyndew ,  ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ia ka: Wat tieng: namar kaei kaba me iohi ? Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong ha u Saul , nga la iohi ia ki blei kiba kiew na ka khyndew .

en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness : your clothes are not waxen old upon you , and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot .
kha: Sawphew snem U  Trai  u la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap , hynrei ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim , bad ki juti jong phi kim shym jot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ialam ia phi sawphew snem ha ka ri khlaw: ki jain jong phi kim shym la tyrkhong ha phi , bad ka juti jong me kam shym la tyrkhong ha ka kjat jong me .

en: And we utterly destroyed them , as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon , utterly destroying the men , women , and children , of every city .
kha: Ngi la pynjot ïa ki shnong baroh bad ngi la pynïap lut ruh ïa ki shynrang , ki kynthei , bad ki khynnah , kumba ngi la leh ha ki shnong jong u Sihon u Syiem Heshbon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la pynjot lut ia ki, kumba ngi la leh ia u syiem Heshbon , da kaba pynjot lut ia ki shynrang , ki kynthei bad ki khun shynrang na kawei pa kawei ka shnong .

en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it , and on the morrow : and if ought remain until the third day , it shall be burnt in the fire .
kha: Ïa ka doh kñia dei ban bam ha kajuh ka sngi ba la pynïap ïa uta u mrad lane ha ka sngi kaba bud . Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Yn bam ia ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba phi ai ia ka, bad ha ka sngi kaba bud: bad lada ka dei ban sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai , yn thang ia ka ha ka ding .

en: Saying , Master , Moses said , If a man die , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  u Moses u la ong ba lada u briew u bym don khun u ïap , u para jong u , u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga jong une uba la ïap khnang ba ki lah ban ïoh khun ïa kiba yn lah ban ñiew kum ki khun jong une u briew uba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ko Nonghikai , u Moses u la ong , Lada u briew u iap khlem khun , u hynmen jong u un shongkurim ia ka tnga jong u bad un pynmih symbai ia u hynmen jong u .

en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba seisoh ba nga la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata nga la ai ha me kawei ka bynta halor ki hynmen jong me, kaba nga la shim na ka kti jong u Amorit da ka waitlam jong nga bad da ka bow jong nga .

en: And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .
kha: Te u Abimelekh u pynphai pat ïa ka Sarah ha u Abraham , bad ha kajuh ka por u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , bad ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la shim ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki mrad bad ki kynthei bad ki kynthei bad u la ai ia ki ha u Abraham bad u la pynphai biang ia u ia ka Sarah ka tnga jong u .

en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten , and thou shalt gather it to thee  ; and it shall be for food for thee , and for them .
kha: Shim ruh ïa baroh ki jait jingbam kiba donkam na ka bynta jong me bad na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to shim ha me na ki jingbam baroh kiba la bam, bad me dei ban lum ia ka ha me; bad kan long ka jingbam na ka bynta jong me bad na ka bynta jong ki .

en: Grace be with you , mercy , and peace , from God the Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .
kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong U Kpa , un ai ha ngi ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk ; to ai ba kin long ki jong ngi ha ka jingshisha bad ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingaiei kan long bad phi, ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa, bad na U Trai Jisu Khrist, U Khun U Kpa, ha ka jingshisha bad ka jingieit .

en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .
kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shaphang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad san tylli ki bar na ka bynta ki board jong kawei pat ka liang jong ka Tabernak , bad san tylli ki bar na ka bynta ki board jong ka Tabernak na ka bynta ki liang sepngi .

en: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh s house , saying , Joseph s brethren are come : and it pleased Pharaoh well , and his servants .
kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha ka ïingsyiem ba ki hynmen u Joseph ki la poi , u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la sngewbha shibun eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka nam jong ka ka la iohsngew ha iing u Pharaoh, ka ong: Ki hynmen u Joseph ki wan: bad ka la pynsngewbha ia u Pharaoh bad ki shakri jong u .

en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king s sons are dead : for Amnon only is dead .
kha: Kumta wat ngeit ïa ka khubor ba ki khun shynrang jong me baroh ki la ïap ; tang u Amnon uba la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba u kynrad jong nga un shim ia kata ha ka dohnud jong u, ban pyrkhat ba ki khun syiem baroh ki la iap: namar u Amnon u la iap tang .

en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said unto them , Why have ye done this thing , and have saved the men children alive ?
kha: Kumta u syiem Ijipt u phah khot ïa kita ki nongpynkha khun , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi leh kumne , bad phi shah ïa ki khun shynrang ba kin im ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ijipt u la khot ia ki nongkha khun bad u la ong ha ki , Balei phi la leh ia kane ka kam bad phi la pynim ia ki khun shynrang ?

en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
kha: U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïap briew bad ki la thang duh ïa ka nongbah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u syiem u la iohsngew ia kata, u la bitar: bad u la phah ia ki shipai jong u, bad u la pynjot ia kita ki nongpyniap briew bad u la thang ia ka shnong jong ki .

en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , ( for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them  ; )
kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Me la wallam ïa kine ki briew na Ijipt da ka bor jong me . Haba ki Ijipt ki ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me la leh ïa kine ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Trai , Nangta ki nong Ijipt kin iohsngew ia ka, (namar me la pynmih ia une u briew ha ka bor jong me na ki ; )

en: Also I said , It is not good that ye do : ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies ?
kha: Nangta nga ong ,  Kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba bakla ! Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ba phin ym pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , ki Jentil , ïa kano kano ka daw ba kin krenbeiñ ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga la ong , Kam long kaba bha ba phi leh: hato phim dei ban iaid ha ka jingtieng ia U Blei jong ngi namar ka jingshah lehbein ki nongshun jong ngi ?

en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .
kha: kaba itynnat bad shongkhia kum ka skei . Ai ba ki jingitynnat jong ka kin pynkmen ïa phi ; ai ba kan ker sawdong ïa phi da ka jingieit jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kan long kum ka kynthei kaba ieit bad kaba sngewtynnad; to ai ba ki bniat jong ka kin pynhun ia me man ka por; bad to long ba me la sngewsih beit bad ka jingieit jong ka .

en: And the name of the other was Eliezer  ; for the God of my father , said he , was mine help , and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh :
kha: U la ong ruh ,  U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u la ïarap ïa nga bad u la pyllait ïa nga na kaba shah pynïap ha u Pharaoh  ; kumta u khot kyrteng ïa uwei pat u khun  u Elieser . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat ka long u Elizer na ka bynta U Blei jong u kpa jong nga, u la ong ba u long u nongiarap jong nga, bad u la pyllait im ia nga na ka waitlam u Pharaoh:

en: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .
kha: Balei me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa nga ban shim ïa ka kum ka tnga jong nga ? Kane hangne ka tnga jong me ; shim noh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me ong ia ka , Ka dei ka para jong nga ? kumta nga lah ban shim ia ka sha nga sha ka tnga: mynta te to shim ia ka bad leit noh ia ka lynti jong me .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Go unto Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit , khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses, To leit sha u Pharaoh, bad to ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai , Ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit noh, ba kin shakri ia nga .

en: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel , Because ye despise this word , and trust in oppression and perverseness , and stay thereon :
kha: Hynrei kane ka dei kaei kaba U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel u ong :  Phi kyntait ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa phi bad phi shaniah ha ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong ia uta uba khuid jong ki Israel: Namar phi sngewsih ia kane ka ktien , bad shaniah ha ka jingshah pynshitom bein bad ka jingbym iahap , bad to sah ha kata:

en: The God of Abraham , and the God of Nahor , the God of their father , judge betwixt us . And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac .
kha: U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Nahor un bishar hapdeng jong ngi .  Kumta , ha ka kyrteng U Blei ïa uba u Isaak u kpa jong u , u la mane , u Jakob u la smai da kaba sngew kyntang ban bat ïa kane ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Nahor, U Blei jong u kpa jong ki, u bishar ia ngi . Bad u Jakob u la sngap jar da ka jingtieng ia u kpa jong u u Isaak .

en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections : for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature :
kha: Namar ba ki leh ïa kane , U Blei u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingkwah brai bakhlemrain . Wat ki kynthei ki la pynbakla noh ïa ka jingpyndonkam kaba dei kat kum ka rukom ha ka jingshongkurim da ki jingleh ki bym dei kat kum ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw kane U Blei u la aiti noh ia ki ha ki jingsngewsih: namar wat ki kynthei jong ki ruh ki la pynkylla ia ka jingpyndonkam ba kynja met sha kata kaba pyrshah ia ka mariang:

en: And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .
kha: U kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam bad u shim shi kham u purew bad u thang ïa u halor ka duwan . ( Kane ka long nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi . )
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka jingainguh doh , bad u la shim katto katne na ka bad u la thang ia ka ha ka almari , nalor ka jingknia thang kaba la thang mynstep .

en: How should one chase a thousand , and two put ten thousand to flight , except their Rock had sold them , and the  Lord  had shut them up ?
kha: Balei ba shihajar kin shahjop tang ha uwei , bad shiphew hajar pat tang ha ki ar ngut ? U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la iehnoh ïa ki , bad U Blei badonbor jong ki u la kyntait noh ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno uwei u dei ban beh shihajar , bad arngut ki la buh shi hajar ban phet krad , lait noh tang u Rock jong ki u la die ia ki , bad U Trai u la khang ia ki ?

en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion .
kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka khyndew da ka bor jong u ; da ka jingstad jong u , u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad u la pyiar pynïar ïa ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thaw ia ka khyndew da ka bor jong u, u la pynskhem ia ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u, bad u la pynjrong ia ki bneng da ka jingsngewthuh jong u .

en: And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .
kha: Ka Esther ka la jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong nga mynta ka miet ha ka jingkhawai ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esther u la jubab , Lada ka long kaba bha ia u syiem , to ai ba u syiem bad u Haman kin wan mynta ka sngi sha ka jingkhawai kaba nga la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong u .

en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?
kha: Nangta u syiem Serksis u kylli ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ,  Mano ba nud ban leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei ? Uei uta u briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Ahasaerus u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka mahadei Esther, U long mano bad u don shano , uba sngew lyngngoh ha ka dohnud jong u ban leh kumta ?

en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .
kha: U Moses u la shim ïa kita ki diengduh baroh bad u la pyn-i ïa ki ha ki Israel . Ki la ïohi ïa kaba la jia , bad uwei pa uwei u nongïalam u la shim noh ïa la u jong u diengduh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynmih ia ki dieng baroh na khmat U Trai ha ki khun Israel baroh: bad ki peit bad ki la shim ia u dieng jong u .

en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign  ; Behold , a virgin shall conceive , and bear a son , and shall call his name Immanuel .
kha: Te kumta , U  Trai  un ai hi ka dak ha phi : Ka theisotti kaba punkhun kan kha u khun bad kan khot kyrteng ïa u , ‘ U Immanuel .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai hi un ai ia phi ia ka dak ; Ha khmih, ka nongleh kam sniew kan pun khun bad kan kha khun shynrang bad un khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Immanuel .

en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .
kha: Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah , u la leit kiew ïa u lumrit marwei hi ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la phah noh ia ki paidbah sha jngai, u la leit sha u lum uba jngai ban duwai: bad ynda la janmiet u la don hangta marwei .

en: The waters wear the stones : thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth  ; and thou destroyest the hope of man .
kha: Ka um ka khrud ïa ki mawsiang , bad u slap uba jur un rong noh ïa ka khyndew ; kumta me pynduh ïa ka jingkyrmen junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki phong ia ki maw: me sait ia kiei kiei kiba mih na ka dewbilat jong ka khyndew ; bad me pynjot ia ka jingkyrmen jong u briew .

en: And to the others he said in mine hearing , Go ye after him through the city , and smite : let not your eye spare , neither have ye pity :
kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U Blei ba u ong ha kita kiwei pat ki briew ,  Bud ïa u sawdong ka nongbah , bad pynïap . Wat tyngkai ïano ïano , wat sngewsynei ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kiwei pat u la ong ha ka jingsngap jong nga, To leit bud ia u lyngba ka shnong, bad to sngap jar: wat ai ba ka khmat jong phi kan lait im, lymne phim sngewsynei:

en: When he had thus spoken , he spat on the ground , and made clay of the spittle , and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay ,
kha: Hadien ba u la ong ïa kane , U Jisu u la biah ha ka khyndew bad u la khleh ktieh da ka umbiah ; u la kyllan da ita i sboh ktieh ha ki khmat uta u briew bad u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la kren kumta, u la sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang

en: Philip , and Bartholomew  ; Thomas , and Matthew the publican  ; James the son of Alphaeus , and Lebbaeus , whose surname was Thaddaeus  ;
kha: u Philip bad u Bartholomai ; u Thomas bad u Matthaïos , u nonglum khajna ; u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos bad u Thaddaïos ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip , bad u Barthomeo ; u Thomas , bad u Mathaios u Jakob u khun u Alphaeus bad u Lebayoos uba la tip kyrteng kum u Thaddeos ; .

en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel : and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel ha u Lum Gilboa . Kiba bun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiwei pat na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun jong u ki la phet krad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki Philistia ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel : bad ki briew Israel ki la phet noh na khmat ki Philistia , bad ki la hap ha u lum Gilboa .

en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ka niam ka long ka lynti ban riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingialeh pyrshah jong ki briew kiba bamsap, bad kiba duna ka jingshisha, da kaba shim ba kata ka jingmyntoi ka long ka jinglong blei: na kum kata ka jingweng noh ia lade .

en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon , and to call peaceably unto them .
kha: Nangta ka jingïalang paidbah ka phah ktien sha ki Benjamin kiba don ha u Mawsiang Rimmon bad tyrwa ban pynwai noh ïa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiaseng baroh kawei ka la phah katto katne ban kren bad ki khun shynrang jong u Benjamin kiba don ha u maw Rimmon bad ban khot ia ki da kaba suk .

en: And when he saw that , he arose , and went for his life , and came to Beer–sheba , which belongeth to Judah , and left his servant there .
kha: U Elijah u la sheptieng bad u la phet ban pyllait im ïa lade ; u shim ïa u shakri jong u bad leit noh sha Beersheba kaba ha Judah . Da kaba iehnoh ïa u shakri hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la iohi ia kata, u la ieng bad u la leit sha Beersheba kaba dei ka jong u Judah bad u la iehnoh ia u shakri jong u hangta .

en: And the evil spirit from the  Lord  was upon Saul , as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand : and David played with his hand .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u mynsiem bymman na U  Trai  u wan tyllep ïa u Saul . U dang shong ha la ïing bad u sum ha la ka kti , bad u Dabid u don hangta , u dang tem ïa la ka duitara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mynsiem bymman na U Trai ka la don ha u Saul, katba u dang shong ha iing jong u da ka javelin jong u ha ka kti jong u: bad u Dabid u la ialehkai da ka kti jong u .

en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .
kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad baroh ar ngut , u Philip bad uta u rangbah synshar ki la ïaleit hiar sha ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbaptis ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia ka kali ban ieng sah: bad ki la leit hiar shapoh um, baroh arngut u Philip bad u eunuch ; bad u la pynbaptis ia u .

en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people , and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead .
