kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki briew , bad ban sakhi ba u long uta ïa uba U Blei u la thung ban long u Nongbishar ïa kiba im bad kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ngi ban ialap ha ki briew , bad ban sakhi ba dei ma u uba la buh da U Blei ban long u Nongbishar uba kloi bad uba iap .

en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba um shym la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa lade na u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kpu , hynrei na ka jinghikai ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki sngewthuh kumno ba u la bthah ia ki ba kim tip ia ka jinghikai jong ki Pharisi bad ki Sadusi .

en: I say then , Hath God cast away his people ? God forbid . For I also am an Israelite , of the seed of Abraham , of the tribe of Benjamin .
kha: Nga kylli te : Hato U Blei u la kyntait ïa la ki jong ki briew ? Em , kam long kumta! Ma nga hi nga long u nong Israel , uba hiarpateng na u Abraham , u dkhot jong ka jait Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong te , Hato U Blei U la bret noh ia ki briew jong u ? U Blei u la khang . Na nga ruh nga long u Israel , na u symbai u Abraham , na ka jaitbynriew u Benjamin .

en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,
kha: Phi ïatip ba ngam shym la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingïarap ïa phi haba nga ïalap bad hikai ha ki paidbah bad ha ki ïing jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumno ngam shym la buh ei ei kaba myntoi ia phi , hynrei nga la pyni ia phi bad nga la hikai ia phi da kaba paw bad na iing sha iing .

en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the  Lord  , saying , The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ha ki paid Israel ïa kane ka hukum na U  Trai . U ong ,  Kaei kaba ka jait Manasseh ka ong ka long kaba dei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la hukum ia ki khun Israel kat kum ka ktien U Trai , u da ong: Ka jaitbynriew jong u Joseph ka la kren bha .

en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
kha: bad ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka khubor jong u . Ïa kane la pynkhamti ha nga , bad nga pynbna ïa ka da ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ia ka ktien jong u lyngba ka jingialap , kaba la aiti ha nga kat kum ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi;

en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .
kha: Hangta hi u la lah ban imat pat , bad u la bud ïa U Jisu , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u la ioh ia ka jingpeit jong u, bad u la bud ia u, da kaba pyndonburom ia U Blei: bad ki briew baroh haba ki la iohi ia ka, ki la iaroh ia U Blei .

en: And it came to pass at that time , that Judah went down from his brethren , and turned in to a certain Adullamite , whose name was Hirah .
kha: Ha kata ka por , u Judah u la iehnoh ïa la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u la leit sah bad uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Hirah uba na ka shnong Adullam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por, u Judah u la hiar na ki hynmen jong u, bad u la phai sha uwei u nong Adullam uba kyrteng u Hirah .

en: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul , The magistrates have sent to let you go : now therefore depart , and go in peace .
kha: Kumta u nongpeit phatok u la ïathuh ha u Paul ,  Ki rangbah synshar ki la phah ka hukum ban pyllait noh ïa me bad ïa u Silas . Te phi lah ban mihnoh , bad leit ha kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap phatok u la iathuh ia kane ha u Paul: Ki majistor ki la phah ban pyllait noh ia phi: mynta to leit noh bad leit suk .

en: Then called he them in , and lodged them . And on the morrow Peter went away with them , and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him .
kha: U Petros u la khot sngewbha ïa kita ki rangbah shapoh bad u la kyrpad jur ïa ki ban sahmiet hangta . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki ; bad katto katne ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la ïasynran lem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot ia ki shapoh bad u la sah ia ki . Bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u Petros u la leit noh bad ki , bad katto katne ki para na Joppa ki la iadon ryngkat bad u .

en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Phi pyrkhat ba ka lynti jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , hato ym dei kumta ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka long ka iing Israel , Ka lynti U Trai kam long kaba iaryngkat . Ko iing Israel , hato ki lynti jong nga kim iaryngkat ? hato ki lynti jong phi kim long kiba iaryngkat ?

en: The time is come , the day draweth near : let not the buyer rejoice , nor the seller mourn : for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
kha: Ka por ka la poi . Ka sngi ka la jan , ha kaba ka jingïadie ïathied kan ym don jingmut shuh , namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei kan hap ha baroh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por ka la poi, ka sngi ka la jan: wat ai ba u nongthied un sngewbha, lymne u nongdie un iam: namar ka jingbitar ka long halor ka jingbun briew jong ka baroh .

en: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .
kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bathsheba u la leit sha u syiem ha ka kamra: bad u syiem u la tymmen bha; bad u Abishag u Shunam u la shakri ia u syiem .

en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .
kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi kin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , kin shitom namar kata ka jingbymïaineh jong phi , tad haduh ba uba khatduh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong phi kin iaid kai ha ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , bad kin kit ia ki jingkhaii met jong phi haduh ba ki met iap jong phi kin jah rngai noh ha ka ri khlaw .

en: Therefore also now , saith the  Lord  , turn ye even to me with all your heart , and with fasting , and with weeping , and with mourning :
kha: Hynrei wat mynta ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kylla-kaba-mut da shisha bad phai sha nga da ka jingshah jingit bad ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh mynta , ong U Trai , to phai sha nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh:

en: And David sent out ten young men , and David said unto the young men , Get you up to Carmel , and go to Nabal , and greet him in my name :
kha: kumta u la phah shiphew ngut ki samla shynrang bad ka hukum ban leit sha Karmel , ban wad ïa u Nabal , bad ban ai ka jingkhublei na u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah ia ki shiphew ngut ki samla bad u Dabid u la ong ha ki samla, To kiew sha Karmel bad leit sha Nabal bad khublei ia u ha ka kyrteng jong nga:

en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .
kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban sumar ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi bad ki jingphla jong u bad ki ain jong u kiba u la hukum ia me .

en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi u Gad u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ong ha u ,  Khie leit shatei sha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah bad tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gad u la wan ha kata ka sngi ha u Dabid bad u la ong ha u, To leit shaneng, to leit sha U Trai ha ka jaka bam jong u Aragah u nong Jesus .

en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , pham shym la ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid kumba ka tnga ka leit noh na u tnga jong ka, kumta phi la leh thok ia nga, ko iing Israel , ong U Trai .

en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem . So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .
kha: Ïa ka jingpyntrei ïa ka Templ la lah pynsangeh noh bad ka la sahkut khlem pyntrei shuh haduh ka snem ba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius , u patsha ka Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la sangeh noh ia ka kam jong ka iing U Blei kaba don ha Jerusalem . Kumta ka la sangeh noh haduh ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius u syiem Persia .

en: Therefore thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God , and keep his charge , and his statutes , and his judgments , and his commandments , alway .
kha: Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïai kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad to sumar ia ka hukum jong u, bad ki ain jong u, bad ki jingbishar jong u, bad ki hukum jong u, baroh shi katta .

en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .
kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la thung ban ai ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad sha U Blei , bad kumta U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi u dei ruh ban don ei ei ban ainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u rangbah lyngdoh u long uba la buh ban ai ia ki jingai sngewbha bad ki jingknia: namar kata ka long kaba donkam ba une u briew ruh un ai katto katne ruh .

en: I speak as concerning reproach , as though we had been weak . Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold , ( I speak foolishly , ) I am bold also .
kha: Nga sngewlehrain ban phla ba phim shym la long kiba shlur ban leh ïa kito kiei kiei! Hynrei lada uno uno ud nud ban sngewsarong shaphang kaei kaei — nga kren kum uba bieit — ngan shu long uba shlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kren kum kiba iadei bad ka jingshah lehbein, kumba ngi la tlot . Wat la uno uno u long uba shlur , (nga kren bieit , ) Nga ruh nga long uba shlur .

en: For I beheld , and there was no man  ; even among them , and there was no counsellor , that , when I asked of them , could answer a word .
kha: Haba nga peit napdeng ki blei , ym don na ki uba don ei ei ban ong ; ym don uwei u ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli ba nga kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la iohi, bad ym don briew shuh shuh hapdeng jong ki, bad ym don nongai jingmut, ba haba nga la kylli ia ki, nga lah ban jubab ia ka ktien .

en: And the Egyptians pursued , and went in after them to the midst of the sea , even all Pharaoh s horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .
kha: Ki nong Ijipt ruh ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la leit nadien jong ki sha ka duriaw lem bad ki kulai , ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la bud ia ki, bad ki la leit rung hadien jong ki haduh pdeng ka duriaw, wat ki kulai jong u baroh, ki kali jong u bad ki kulai jong u .

en: And herein I give my advice : for this is expedient for you , who have begun before , not only to do , but also to be forward a year ago .
kha: Bad hangne nga ai jingmut , ka long ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban pyndep mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la sdang mynshem snem . Phi la long kiba nyngkong , ym tang ban trei ïa ka kam , hynrei ban long ruh kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangne nga ai ia ka jingai jingmut jong nga: namar kane ka long kaba donkam na ka bynta jong phi, kiba la sdang mynshuwa, ym tang ban leh, hynrei ruh ban long shakhmat shisnem mynshuwa .

en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,
kha: Bad kumta , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong pyrshah ïa u Baasha lyngba u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Baasha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Zimri u la pynjot ia ka iing u Baasha baroh kawei kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u la kren pyrshah ia u Baasha da u nongiathuhlypa Jehu .

en: And out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Mahanaim with her suburbs ,
kha: Na ka jait Gad ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Ramoth ha Gilead , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Mahanaim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jaitbynriew Gad, u Ramoth ha Gilead ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka, ban long ka shnong rieh tngen na ka bynta u nongrep ; bad Mahanaim ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka .

en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Jehoshaphat u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid . Bad u Jehoram u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And if any man hunger , let him eat at home ; that ye come not together unto condemnation . And the rest will I set in order when I come .
kha: Bad lada uno uno u thngan , u dei ban bam ha ïing , khnang ba phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei haba phi dang ïaseng lang . Ïa kiwei pat ki bynta , ngan sa pynbeit ïa ki ynda nga wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u thngan, to ai ba un bam ha iing ; ba phin ym wan lang sha ka jingpynrem . Bad kaba sah ngan sa buh ha ka rukom ynda nga wan .

en: The Union Minister of State , Health and Family Welfare , Shri Dinesh Trivedi directed the authorities to take up this issue with states .
kha: U Myntri ka tnad ka koit ka khiah jong ka sorkar pdeng u Shri Dinesh Trivedi u la bthah ia ki bor ba dei peit ban rah ia kane ka kam bad ki jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: U Myntri ka sorkar pdeng , ka koit ka khiah bad ka longïing , u Shri Dinesh Trivedi u la bthah ïa ki bor ba dei peit ban shim ïa kane ka kam bad ki jylla .

en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone , after the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three firkins apiece .
kha: Ki Jiw ki don ki aiñ shaphang ka jinglehniam haba sait pynkhuid , bad na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu la don hynriew tylli ki khra-maw buh um , uwei uwei u ngiam kumba shispah litar ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la buh hangta hynriew tylli ki thliew maw, hadien ka rukom pynkhuid ia ki Jiw, kaba don ar ne lai tylli ki thliew .

en: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy  ; I will shew them the back , and not the face , in the day of their calamity .
kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki , kum ïa u pui pui ba la beh da ka lyer mihngi . Ngan pynphai ïa la ka ingdong halor jong ki ; ngan ym ïarap ïa ki haba ka jingpynjot ka wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia ki kumba da ka Iyer mihngi ha khmat u nongshun ; ngan pyni ia ki ia ka tyrpeng , bad ym ia ka khmat , ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar jong ki .

en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :
kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong nga kin mih , kin ym mihnoh thylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ia une u briew ha khmat ki nong Ijipt: bad kan sa jia ba haba phi leit noh , phin ym leit thylli:

en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka don ka jingat kaba lieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jaka jong ka jingkhluit ka don ka jaka kaba lieh kaba mih, ne ka jaka kaba shai, kaba lieh bad katto katne kaba saw, bad la pyni ia ka ha u lyngdoh ; .

en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
kha: Ha shuwa ban poi ki snem ka  nemsniew , u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang na ka Asenath .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Joseph la kha arngut ki khun shynrang shuwa ki snem jong ka jingkyrduh bam, kiba u Asenath ka khun jong u Lyngdoh jong u On u la kha ia u .

en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .
kha: To pynkhreh ban shah kem koidi , phi ki briew ka Ijipt ! Ïa ka Memphis yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban shong ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun kynthei kaba shong ha Ijipt, to pynbiang ia lade ban leit sha ka jinglong mraw: namar ki Memphis kin long kiba la jot bad kiba la jot khlem u nongshong shnong .

en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister  ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
kha: Hynrei ka Rakhel kam shym ïoh khun na u Jakob , kumta ka la bishni ïa la ka hynmen , bad ka ong ha u Jakob ,  Ai khun ïa nga , lane ngan ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la iohi ba kam don khun ia u Jakob, ka Rakhel ka la sngewsih ia ka para jong ka; bad ka la ong ha u Jakob: Ai khun ia nga, lym kumta ngan iap noh .

en: And Hezekiah answered , It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees : nay , but let the shadow return backward ten degrees .
kha: U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ka suk ban pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam sha khmat ! Pynlong ïa ka ban leit shiphew jam shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la jubab , Ka long kaba jem ia ka jingdum ban hiar shi degree: nay , hynrei to ai ba ka jingdum kan phaidien shadien shi degree .

en: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself , that his heart turn not away : neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold .
kha: U syiem um dei ban long uba bun tnga , namar kata kan pynphai noh ïa u na U  Trai  ; bad um dei ruh ban pynriewspah ïa lade da ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym pynbun ia ki tnga ha lade, ba ka dohnud jong u kan ym kylla: bad un ym pynbun shibun ia lade ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar .

en: The  Lord  shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee , until he have consumed thee from off the land , whither thou goest to possess it .
kha: Un phah ha phi ïa ka jingpang kawei hadien kawei haduh ba yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynlong ia ka jingpang ban rung ha me, haduh ba un da bam ia me na ka ri, ha kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him : and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :
kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u . U la pynïeng ïa u Joshua ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad uta u paidlang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u: bad u la shim ia u Joshua, bad u la buh ia u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha khmat ka jingiaseng baroh:

en: If these men die the common death of all men , or if they be visited after the visitation of all men  ; then the  Lord  hath not sent me .
kha: Lada kine ki briew ki ïap kumba ïap ki parabriew khlem da hap ha kano kano ka jingpynshitom na U Blei , te shisha U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kine ki briew ki iap ia ka jingiap kaba iadei bad ki briew baroh , lane lada ki shah jngoh hadien ka jingleit jngoh ia ki briew baroh ; te U Trai um shym la phah ia nga .

en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
kha: ‘ Me la lehbha ,’ u la ong ; ‘ me long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me long uba lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba rit , ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa ki shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Hooid, ko shakri babha: namar ba me la long uba iaineh tang khyndiat eh, me don ka bor halor shiphew tylli ki nongbah .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , a people cometh from the north country , and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ki wan na ka ri ha ka phang bashatei ; ka jaitbynriew kaba khrawbor na sha jngai bah ka pynkhreh ïa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ka jaitbynriew ka wan na ka ri kaba shaphang shathie , bad ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw kan kiew na ki liang jong ka khyndew .

en: The tree that thou sawest , which grew , and was strong , whose height reached unto the heaven , and the sight thereof to all the earth  ;
kha: U dieng , uba jrong katta katta uba la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , uba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U dieng uba me iohi, uba la san bad uba khlain, uba ka jingjrong jong u ka la poi sha bneng bad ka jingpeit jong u haduh ka khyndew baroh kawei;

en: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: man kaba ki rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ne ki leit sha jan kata ka duwan , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la leit shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang bad haba ki la wan hajan ka ïingkhuid , ki la sait ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .

en: Put on therefore , as the elect of God , holy and beloved , bowels of mercies , kindness , humbleness of mind , meekness , longsuffering ;
kha: Kumta te , dei ban kup ïa lade , naba phi long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la ieit bad jied ïa phi na ka bynta jong u hi , da ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingbhasbun , ka jingsngewrit , ka jingjemnud , bad ka jingïaishah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndait namarkata, kum ki nongjied bakhuid jong U Blei, bad baieit, ki kpoh jong ki jingsngewsih, ka jingbhabriew, ka jinglong rit mynsiem, ka jinglong jemnud, ka jingshah shitom;

en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it , and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .
kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad pynpur da ka ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid, hapoh bad shabar me dei ban tap ia ka, bad men pynlong ia ka da ka khlieh ksiar sawdong .

en: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest  ; and dwelt with her mother in law .
kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka la trei bad ki bad ka la tam kew haduh ban da dep ot lut ïa u barli bad ïa u kew baroh . Bad ka la ïaishong sah bad la ka kiaw kurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la iai bteng da ki nongtrei jong u Boaz ban lum haduh kaba kut jong ka jingot barli bad u kew ; bad ka la shong bad ka kmie tymmen jong ka .

en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha ki ,  Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam !  Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Pynkhuid ia ka iing bad pyndap ia ki phyllaw da kiba la shah pyniap: to leit noh . Ki la leit noh bad ki la leit sha ka nongbah .

en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .
kha: Kumta u la ïaphylliew jingmut ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba mane ïa U Blei , bad ruh ha ki jaka paidbah man ka sngi bad ki briew kiba jia ryngkhat ki ïaid nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ialeh pyrshah ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki briew kiba riewblei bad ha iew man ka sngi bad ki kiba iakynduh bad u .

en: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah , Thou shalt not do this thing : for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael .
kha: Hynrei u Gedalaïah u la jubab ,  Wat leh ïa kata ! Kaei kaba phi ong shaphang u Ishmael kam long kaba shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam u la ong ha u Johanan u khun u Krea: Wat leh ia kane: namar me kren bakla ia u Ishmael .

en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :
kha: kiba la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la long ki bym pynsngewbha ïa U Blei! A kumno ki la long kiba shun iwei ïa iwei!
translated_en_to_kha: Uba baroh arngut ki la pyniap ia U Trai Jisu bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ki hi bad ki la pynshitom bein ia ngi bad kim sngewbha ia U Blei bad ki long kiba pyrshah ia ki briew baroh:

en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian , who passed by , coming out of the country , the father of Alexander and Rufus , to bear his cross .
kha: Ha lynti ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Simon , uba dang wan sha ka nongbah na rudnong , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna U Jisu . ( U Simon u dei na Kyrini bad u la long u kpa jong u Aleksandar bad u Ruphos . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynbor ia uwei u Simon u Cyrenian uba la iaid lyngba, u la mih na ka ri, u kpa jong u Alexander bad u Rufus, ban kit ia ka diengphna jong u .

en: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee : begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn .
kha: Ñiew hynñiew taïew naduh ba phi sdang ot ïa u kew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew taiew to khein ia me: sdang ban khein ia ki hynriew taiew naduh ba me sdang ban buh ia ka sickle ha u kew .

en: For I have not spoken of myself  ; but the Father which sent me , he gave me a commandment , what I should say , and what I should speak .
kha: Kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ngam shym la kren ha ka bor jong nga hi ; hynrei U Kpa uba la phah ïa nga u la hukum ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga dei ban ong bad kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam shym la kren shaphang lade ; hynrei U Kpa uba la phah ia nga , u la ai hukum ia nga ia kaei kaba nga dei ban ong bad kaei kaba nga dei ban kren .

en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul  ; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt .
kha: Ai ba kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa nga kin shahjop bad shah pynjot . Ai ba kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga kin shah pynlehrain bad shah pynjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin sngewlehrain bad shah bam kiba long ki nongshun ia ka mynsiem jong nga ; ai ba kin shah tap da ka jingshah lehbein bad ka jingbym burom kaba wad ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days , even an hundred and fourscore days .
kha: Hynriew bnai kynthih , u la pyn-i ïa ki spah jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha ka jingitynnat bad jingkhraw jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la pyni ia ka spah jong ka hima ba donburom jong u bad ka burom jong ka jinglong rangbah jong u kaba bha tam bun sngi, wat shispah saw sngi .

en: For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?
kha: Lada uno uno na phi u thmu ban tei ïa ka jaka ap phira , nyngkong u shong bad u kheiñ ïa ka jinglut , ban khmih la u don bun ka pisa ban pyndep ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong phi, haba phi thmu ban tei ia ka tower , wat shong nyngkong , bad khein ia ka jinglut , la u don ne em ban pyndep ia ka ?

en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,
kha: Pynban , phi la wan sha u lum Seïon bad sha ka nongbah jong U Blei uba im , ka Jerusalem kaba kynja bneng , ha kaba la don bun hajar ki angel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi wan sha u lum Sion bad sha ka shnong U Blei uba im, ka Jerusalem bneng bad sha ka kynhun ki angel ki bym lah ban khein .

en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath , to observe the sabbath throughout their generations , for a perpetual covenant .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sumar ïa kane ka sngi kum ka dak jong ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki khun Israel kin sumar ia ka Sabha , ban sumar ia ka Sabha ha ki pateng jong ki baroh kawei .

en: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews : and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon .
kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , la rahbor ïa nga na ka ri jong ki Hebru ; bad wat hangne ha Ijipt ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba nga dei hok ban shah set byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha nga la shah tuh na ka ri jong ki Hebru: bad hangne ruh ngam shym la leh ei ei ba kin buh ia nga ha ka thliew .

en: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .
kha: U Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngin ym pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shadrak , u Meshah bad u Abednego ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u syiem , Ko Neuchadnezzar , ngim da pyrkhat ban jubab ia me ha kane ka kam .

en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .
kha: Wat ai noh ïano ïano na ki khun jong me ba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa u blei Molekh , naba kata kan pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng U Blei , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat ai ba uno uno na u symbai jong me un iaid lyngba ka ding sha u Molek , bad wat pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng U Blei jong me: Nga long U Trai .

en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord , and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem .
kha: Ha kata ka kynta hi , ka la wan poi bad ka la ainguh ïa U Blei bad ka la kren shaphang u khunlung ha baroh kiba ap ïa U Blei ban pyllaitluid ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan rung ha kata ka por ka la ainguh kumjuh ia U Trai, bad ka la kren ia u ha kito baroh kiba ap ia ka jingpynim ha Jerusalem .

en: And when they came to Nachon s threshingfloor , Uzza put forth his hand to the ark of God , and took hold of it  ; for the oxen shook it .
kha: Haba ki wan poi ha jaka shoh kew jong u Nakon , ki masi dab ki la jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner bad ïohbat ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka rep jong u Nahon, u Ussa u la pynkhih ia ka kti jong u sha ka synduk U Blei bad u la bat ia ka ; namar ki masi ki la pynkhih ia ka .

en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .
kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ka jingkhang ksiar na ka bynta ka jingiwbih ha khmat ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi , bad buh ia ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain .

en: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not ; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth : for God hath received him .
kha: U briew uba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh , um dei ban peitbeiñ ïa uta u bym bam ; katba uta uba bam tang da ki jhur um dei ban bishar ïa uta uba bam ïa kaei kaei ruh ; naba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uta uba bam un leh bein ia uta u bym ju bam ; bad wat ai ba uta u bym ju bam un bishar ia uta uba bam: namar U Blei u la pdiang ia u .

en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kin hikai ïa ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad ka bymkhuid , bad hapdeng kaei kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad kaei ka bym long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin hikai ia ki briew jong nga ia ka jingiapher hapdeng kaba khuid bad kaba khuid , bad kin pynlong ia ki ban ithuh hapdeng kaba jakhlia bad kaba khuid .

en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :
kha: ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynlong bad phi bad ban pdiang ïa ki ktien ba la thoh ha ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me dei ban rung ha ka jutang bad U Trai U Blei jong me, bad ha ka jingsmai jong u, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u leh bad me ha kane ka sngi:

en: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof , to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .
kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong la pynïasoh lang naduh trai baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . La shna ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong ha kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la iasoh lang hapoh , bad ki la iasoh lang ha ka khlieh jong ka: kumta u la leh ia ki baroh arngut ha baroh ar tylli ki thliew .

en: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches , except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you ? forgive me this wrong .
kha: Kumno la ñiew ba phi kham sniew ban ïa kiwei pat ki balang , lait noh ba ngam shym pynkhuslai ïa phi ban kyrshan pisa ïa nga ? Sngewbha map ïa nga na ka bynta kane ka jingleh bymdei!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei kata ha kaba phi la kham poh ia kiwei pat ki balang , lait noh tang ba nga hi ngam shym la long uba khia ia phi ? map ia nga ia kane ka jingbakla .

en: The mountains quake at him , and the hills melt , and the earth is burned at his presence , yea , the world , and all that dwell therein .
kha: Ki lumbah ki khynñiuh ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ; ki lumrit ki um noh ha khmat jong u . Ka pyrthei ka khih haba U  Trai  u mihpaw ; ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka baroh ki kyiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum ki khih ha u , bad ki lum ki rkhiang , bad ka khyndew ka shah thang ha khmat jong u , hooid , ka pyrthei bad baroh kiba shong hangta .

en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments  ; and they shall walk with me in white : for they are worthy .
kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na pha hangto ha Sardis kim shym la pyntngit ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki . Phan ïaid ryngkat bad nga , da kaba phong da ki jaiñkup balieh , namar pha long kaba dei hok ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Me don katto katne ki kyrteng wat ha Sardis ki bym shym la pynjakhlia ia ki jain jong ki ; bad kin iaid ryngkat bad nga da ka rong lieh: namar ki long kiba bit dor .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .
kha: U Moses u leit , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit hiar bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym jam ïa u pud ban wan khmih ïa nga ; lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To hiar, to pynngat ia ki briew, ioh kin iaid lyngba sha U Trai ban peit bniah bad bun na ki kin jah noh .

en: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?
kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la kylli ,  lano kane kan jia ? Bad kaei ka ban jia khnang ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan jia ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u, ki da ong, Ko Nonghikai, hynrei mynno kine kiei kiei kin long ? bad kaei ka dak kaban sa jia ?

en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .
kha: Kham stet ban ïa ki pukni kiba suh wia na sahit bneng , ki beh kthong ïa ngi sha tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingkyndit ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongpynshitom bein jong ngi ki kham stet ban ia ki blang jong ka bneng: ki la beh ia ngi halor ki lum , ki la buh ia ngi ha ka ri khlaw .

en: So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Azariah u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u ; bad ki la tep ia u bad ki kpa jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Jotham u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal , namely , Gideon , according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel .
kha: Kim shym sngewnguh ïa ka longïing jong u Gideon na ka bynta kaba bha baroh kaba u la leh ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia ka iing u Jerubaal, kata u Gideon, kat kum ka jingbha baroh kaba u la pyni ha ki Israel .

en: For Mahlah , Tirzah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Noah , the daughters of Zelophehad , were married unto their father s brothers  sons :
kha: Kumta ka Mahlah , Tirsah , Hoglah , Milkah , bad Noah , ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , bad ki la ïashongkurim bad la ki bakha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Mahlah, u Tirsah, bad u Hoglah, bad u Milkah, bad u Noah, ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki la shongkurim bad ki khun shynrang jong ki:

en: Moreover they reckoned not with the men , into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen : for they dealt faithfully .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata kim shym la khein ia ki shynrang, ha kiba ki la aiti ia ka pisa ban shah pynkyntang ha ki nongtrei: namar ki la leh da ka jingshaniah .

en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :
kha: Ki la ïaid sha shiliang ka dewlynnong sha Paphos , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa uwei u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Bar Jisu , u Jiw uba la kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iaid lyngba ka ïew sha Paphos, ki la lap ïa uwei u nongleh jadu, u nongïathuhlypa lamler, u Jiw uba kyrteng u Barjes:

en: This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .
kha: Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ki dei ban mynjur ban otsher ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jutang jong nga kaba phin sumar hapdeng jong nga bad phi bad u symbai jong me hadien jong me; Uwei pa uwei u khun shynrang hapdeng jong phi un shah ot .

en: And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey , and go to him : he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .
kha: Rah sha u shiphew tylli ki kpu , khyndiat ki kpu stang , bad shi khiew ka um ngap . Kylli ïa u kaei ka ban jia ïa u khun jong ngi , bad un sa ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shim bad me shiphew tylli ki kpu, bad ki jingbam ba la khleh lang bad ka umsoh bad leit sha u: un iathuh ia me kaei ka ban jia ia u khynnah .

en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .
kha: u rung shapoh ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong ,  Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan rung, u la bam bad u la dih, bad u la ong, To leit peit mynta ia kane ka kynthei kaba la tim, bad to tep ia ka: namar ka long ka khun syiem .

en: Yet the  Lord  would not destroy Judah for David his servant s sake , as he promised him to give him alway a light , and to his children .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , namar ba u la kular ïa u Dabid u shakri jong u ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai un ym pynjot ia u Judah na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong u, kumba u la kular ia u ban ai ia u ia ka jingshai baroh kawei bad ia ki khun jong u .

en: And when the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth rang again .
kha: Haba ka Synduk ka Jutang ka poi , ki Israel ki risa jam da ka jingkmen haduh ba ka khyndew ka khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka synduk ka jutang U Trai ka la wan shapoh ka shnong , ki Israel baroh ki la pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba khraw , haduh ba ka khyndew ka la khih biang .

en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles  ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .
kha: Lymne ba uno uno un theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai ha ki lwa snieh ba la pyndonkam , namar ka waiñ bathymmai kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki snieh yn pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba buh ia ka wain thymmai ha ki bilor barim ; lym kumta ka wain thymmai kan bthei ia ki bilor , bad kan sa tuid noh , bad ki bilor kin sa jah noh .

en: Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .
kha: Ngan sngewbha ha kaba leh kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan buh pynskhem junom ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ngan sngewbha ia ki ban leh bha ia ki , bad ngan thung ia ki ha kane ka ri da ka dohnud jong nga baroh kawei bad da ka mynsiem jong nga baroh kawei .

en: Hear , O ye kings  ; give ear , O ye princes  ; I , even I , will sing unto the  Lord   ; I will sing praise to the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: To sngap , phi ki syiem ! Pynshahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ! Ngan rwai bad tem jingtem ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap , ko syiem; to sngap jar, ko syiem; nga ruh ngan rwai ha U Trai; ngan rwai iaroh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .
kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei une u syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la hiar noh mynta na ka diengphna , ngin ngeit ha u !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynim ia kiwei; ma u hi um lah ban pynim . Lada u long u Syiem Israel , to ai ba un wan hiar mynta na ka diengphna , bad ngin ngeit ia u .

en: And when the Philistine looked about , and saw David , he disdained him : for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and of a fair countenance .
kha: U ïai wan kham sha jan , bad haba u la ïohi shai ïa u Dabid , u la dap da ka jingbitar shla ïa u namar ba u long tang u khynnah uba saw ngab , uba phyrnai khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Philistia u la peit kylleng kylleng bad u la iohi ia u Dabid: namar u dang long tang u samla, bad u khun masi uba hok .

en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .
kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , bad kham bun ki rangbah ki la ïap ha khlaw ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka thma ka la bthei ha ka khmat jong ka ri baroh kawei: bad u dieng u la bam kham bun ki briew ha kata ka sngi ban ia kaba u waitlam u la bam .

en: For circumcision verily profiteth , if thou keep the law : but if thou be a breaker of the law , thy circumcision is made uncircumcision .
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , ka jingotsher jong phi ka don ka dor ; hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , kan jin da la bha ba phim shym la shah otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingotsher ka long kaba myntoi shisha, lada me sumar ia ka hukum: hynrei lada me long u nongpynkhein ia ka hukum , ka jingotsher jong me ka long kaba khlem ot .

en: And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .
kha: ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa U Trai , haba u la ong ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad mihnoh kyrkieh na Jerusalem , namar ki briew hangne kin ym pdiang ïa ka jingsakhi jong me shaphang jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ia u da kaba ong ha nga, To kyrkieh bad to mih noh kloi na Jerusalem: namar kin ym pdiang ia ka jingphla jong me shaphang jong nga .

en: And he kneeled down , and cried with a loud voice , Lord , lay not this sin to their charge . And when he had said this , he fell asleep .
kha: U la dem khohsiew bad u la kyang da ka ktien bajam ,  A Trai ! wat kynmaw ïa kane ka pop pyrshah ïa ki !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem khrup bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, ko Trai, wat buh ia kane ka pop ha ka jingshah kynnoh jong ki . Bad haba u la ong ia kane , u la iohthiah .

en: Again , the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain , and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world , and the glory of them  ;
kha: Nangta u Soitan u la ïalam ïa U Jisu sha u lumbah uba kynjang bad u la pyn-i ha U ïa baroh ki Hima jong ka pyrthei ha ka jingkhrawbor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , u ksuid u shim ia u sha u lum uba jrong palat , bad u pyni ia u ia ki hima pyrthei baroh , bad ka burom jong ki ; .

en: And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .
kha: U angel u la ong ruh ha nga ,  Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nuti ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kynja bynriew bad ki jait ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha nga , Ki um kiba me iohi, ha kaba ka nongkhaii ka shong, ki long ki briew bad ki paidbah bad ki jaitbynriew bad ki thylliej .

en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?
kha: Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha U  Trai  ba ngin ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ngin leh ia ki tnga na ka bynta kito kiba sah , haba ngi la smai da U Trai ba ngin ym ai ia ki na ki khun kynthei jong ngi sha ki tnga ?

en: For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ba une U Jisu uba na Nasareth un sa pynkyllon ïa ka Templ bad pynkylla ïa ki rukom kiba la wan sha ngi lyngba u Moses !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi la iohsngew ia u ba u ong , ba une u Jisu na Nazareth un pynjot ia kane ka jaka bad un pynkylla ia ki riti dustur kiba u Moses u la pynpoi ia ngi .

en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world , why , as though living in the world , are ye subject to ordinances ,
kha: Phi la ïap bad U Khrist bad la pyllaitluid ïa phi na ki mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka jingpynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada phi la iap bad U Khrist na ki rud jong ka pyrthei , balei , kumba phi im ha ka pyrthei , phi hap hapoh ki kyndon .

en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not : so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .
kha: Kita ki nongleh myntor ki pyrshang ban pyndonkam ïa ki buit myntor jong ki ban pynmih mait , hynrei kim lah . Bad kat shaba leit don tang ki mait suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleh jadu ki la leh kumta da ki jingleh jadu jong ki ban pynmih ia ki khniang , hynrei kim lah: kumta ki la don ki khniang ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .
kha: Te u ong ha kita ki shakri ,  To shong hangne bad ka kada . Ma nga bad u khun ngin leit hangtai ban mane Blei , bad hadien kata ngin sa wan pat sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la ong ha ki samla jong u, To sah hangne bad ka kada ; bad nga bad u khynnah ngin leit shata bad mane bad wan phai biang sha phi .

en: And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !
kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la kyndit bynriew bad u la ong , ‘ Baroh ki nongtrei wai jong i pa jong nga ki don kyrhai ban ïa kaba ki lah ban bam , bad nga pat hangne ngan sa ïapthngan !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan sha la ka jong ka jaka , u la ong , Katno ngut ki shakri ba la thung kam jong u kpa jong nga ki don u kpu uba biang bad ban lait im , bad nga la jah noh da ka jingkyrduh !

en: Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .
kha: Namarba U Jehobah u “mon ba ki briew baroh kin ioh lait im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” —1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka dei ka mon jong U Jehobah ba ki briew baroh ki dei ban ioh jingpynim bad wan sha ka jingtip kaba thikna jong ka jingshisha .

en: And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .
kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynsakma ïa phi kylleng kylleng ki ri nongwei . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , bad ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ngan sei ia ka waitlam hadien jong phi: bad ka ri jong phi kan sa jah rngai noh bad ki nongbah jong phi kin sa jah rngai noh .

en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Pekah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh, ha khmih la thoh ha ka Kitab ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel .

en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .
kha: Kita ki nong Ijipt ki la kyrpad jur ïa ki Israel ban pynstet bad mihnoh na kata ka ri .  Ngin sa ïap lut lada phim leit noh ,  ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la kyrkieh ia ki briew, ba kin phah noh ia ki na ka ri da kaba kyrkieh ; namar ki la ong , Ngi long baroh kiba la iap .

en: And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .
kha: ( Kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Sabad , u khun jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Shimeath , bad u Jehosabad , u khun jong ka nong Moab kaba kyrteng ka Shimrith ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba la thmu pyrshah ia u ; u khun u Shimeath u Ammon, bad u Jehosbad u khun u Shimrat u Moabit .

en: Also , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God  unto the land of Israel  ; An end , the end is come upon the four corners of the land .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga kren ïa ka ri Israel : Kane ka dei kaba kut ïa ka ri baroh kawei !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ko khun u briew, kumta u Trai Blei u ong ha ka ri Israel ; Ka jingkut ka wan ha ki saw tylli ki thliew jong ka ri .

en: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake , some to everlasting life , and some to shame and everlasting contempt .
kha: Bun na kito kiba la lah ïap kin im pat : Katto katne kin ïoh ka jingim bymjukut , bad katto katne kin shah ka jingjahburom bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun na ki kiba thiah ha ka dewmet jong ka khyndew kin kyndit , don ha ka jingim bymjukut , bad don ha ka jinglehrain bad ka jingleh bein bymjukut .

en: Paul and Timothy , the servants of Jesus Christ , to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi , with the bishops and deacons :
kha: Na u Paul bad u Timothi , ki shakri U Khrist Jisu — Sha baroh ki briew jong U Blei ha Philippi kiba ha U Khrist Jisu , kiba ki kynthup ïa ki nongïalam balang bad ki nongïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul bad u Timothi ki shakri U Jisu Khrist ha ki riewkhuid baroh ha U Khrist Jisu kiba don ha Philipi bad ki bishop bad ki diak:

en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day : for he thought , Something hath befallen him , he is not clean  ; surely he is not clean .
kha: Ka jaka shong u Dabid ka thylli , hynrei u Saul um shym ong ei ei ha kata ka sngi , namar u pyrkhat ,  Kaei re kaei ka la jia ïa u , bad um shym long uba bit kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Saul um shym la kren ei ei ha kata ka sngi: namar u la pyrkhat , Kaei kaei kaba la jia ia u, um long uba khuid ; shisha um long uba khuid .

en: Purge out therefore the old leaven , that ye may be a new lump , as ye are unleavened . For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us :
kha: Phi dei ban weng noh ïa u thiat barim jong ka pop ba kumta phin long khuid nadong shadong . Te phin long kum kawei pat ka jingkhleh jong u kpu im uba khlem don thiat , kumba da shisha nga tip phi long kumta . Naba ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait la pynkhreh , mynta ïa U Khrist , u khunlangbrot ka Jinglait jong ngi , la lah kñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid namarkata ia ka jingkhleh kaba rim, ba phin long ka lum kaba thymmai, kumba phi long ki bym don kyiad . Namar wat U Khrist ruh ia ka jingkhawai Niam jong ngi la knia na ka bynta jong ngi:

en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
kha: Ka por kan wan haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ka sngi uwei pa uwei un bret noh ia ki bleithaw rupa jong u bad ki bleithaw ksiar jong u kiba la shna da ki kti jong phi hi ha phi na ka bynta ka pop .

en: O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .
kha: Ko paid Israel jong nga , phi la shah shoh kumba shoh kew , hynrei mynta nga la pynbna ha phi ïa ka khubor babha ba nga la ïohsngew na U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko ka jingot jong nga bad u kew jong nga: kata kaba nga la iohsngew na U Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la pynbna ha phi .

en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .
kha: Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Leit kiew pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , bad phin jop ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ki la iathuhlypa kumta, ki da ong: To leit sha Ramothgilead bad to roi: namar U Trai un aiti ia ka ha ka kti u syiem .

en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U bynriew um im tang da u kpu hi , hynrei u donkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba U Blei u kren .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong: La thoh ia u briew ym da u kpu marwei hynrei da ka ktien baroh kaba mih na ka shyntur U Blei .

en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .
kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shaphang ki jingkñia ha ka por janmiet bad mynstep ïa kaba la batai ha me kan urlong shisha . Hynrei buhrieh ïa ka mynta , namar kan shim por shibun ha shuwa ban kan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingphohsniew jong ka janmiet bad ka step kaba la iathuh ka long kaba shisha: namar kata me khang ia ka jingphohsniew ; namar kan long bun sngi .

en: And their coast was Jazer , and all the cities of Gilead , and half the land of the children of Ammon , unto Aroer that is before Rabbah  ;
kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka kynthup ïa ka Jaser bad ki nongbah baroh jong ka Gilead , shiteng na ka ri ki Ammon haduh Aroer , kaba ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Rabbah ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rud duriaw jong ki ka long ka Jazer bad ki shnong Gilead baroh bad shiteng na ka ri Ammon haduh Aroer kaba don ha khmat u Rabha ; .

en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking  ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !
kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan , bad u la bam bad u la dih , bad phi la ong , ‘ Khmih ïa une u briew ! U long u lalot bad u nongbuaid , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’
translated_en_to_kha: U Khun u briew u wan bam bad dih ; bad phi ong , Ha khmih u briew uba sngewtynnad bad u nongleh pop !

en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks , and laid them on the fire , there came a viper out of the heat , and fastened on his hand .
kha: ) . Nangta u Paul u thoh kham shai shuh ïa kane ka phangpdeng . Baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ki donkam ban don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei , naba baroh ki don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop . Ka jinglonghok ki briew bad U Blei ka long lyngba ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist . Nangta u Paul u batai ïa ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist kaba mih na kane ka jingïadei bathymmai bad U Blei . Uba ngeit u don ka jingïasuk bad U Blei bad ïa u la pyllait da U Mynsiem jong U Blei na ka bor jong ka pop bad ka jingïap . Ha ki lynnong
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la lum ia ki dieng bad u la buh ia ki ha ka ding , u la mih u bsein na ka jingshit bad u la sdang ban sdang ia ka kti jong u .

en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son  ; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged .
kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad u Jonathan , bad u la lumlang ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah kiba la shah phasi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wanrah ia ki shyieng u Saul bad ki shyieng u Jonathan u khun jong u ; bad ki la lum ia ki shyieng jong kita kiba la shah pyniap .

en: Hear , O our God  ; for we are despised : and turn their reproach upon their own head , and give them for a prey in the land of captivity :
kha: Nga duwai ,  To sngap ïa ki ba ki krenbeiñ ïa ngi , A Blei ! Ai ba ka jingkrenbeiñ jong ki kan hap halor ki khlieh jong ki hi . Ai ba yn lute ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki don , bad ai ba yn ring koidi ïa ki sha ka ri nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap , ko Blei jong ngi; namar ngi la shah pynjah burom: bad pynphai ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ki ha la ka jong ka khlieh: bad ai ia ki kum ka jingbam ha ka ri jong ka jingshah set:

en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;
kha: Ki nongshun jong ki briew ka Judah bad Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba kita kiba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei pat ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki nongshun jong u Judah bad u Benjamin ki la iohsngew ba ki khun jong ka jingshah set ki la tei ia ka tempi ha U Trai U Blei Israel;

en: And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u leit sha khmat ; u ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym don jaka ban ïaid na baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la iaid kham sha jngai bad u la ieng ha ka jaka kaba rit , ha kaba ym don lad ban phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;
kha: Haba uno uno u khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , wat shong ha ki jaka bakyrpang . Ka lah ban jia ba uno uno uba kham donkam ban ïa phi u la shah khot sngewbha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba la bthah ia uno uno u briew sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , wat shong ha ka kamra kaba ha khlieh duh shuh shuh u briew uba kham donburom ban ia me u la bthah ia u;

en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea  ; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea .
kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka duriaw . Ka um ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba ïap , bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im hapoh duriaw u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba ar u la theh ia ka dohnud jong u ha ka duriaw ; bad ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba la iap: bad kawei pa kawei ka mynsiem kaba im ka la iap ha duriaw .

en: In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .
kha: Nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei kam shym wanrah kano kano ka jingbha ; phan ym da la shah ïa nga ban pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba shyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba nga la pynkhih ia ki khun jong phi ; kim shym la ioh jingpynbeit: ka waitlam jong phi hi ka la bam ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong phi, kum u sing uba pynjot .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye are all become dross , behold , therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem .
kha: Te mynta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki ba ki long bymmyntoi ei ei kum kata hi . Ngan wallam lang ïa ki baroh ha Jerusalem
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Namar phi baroh phi la kylla long u khniang , ha khmih , namarkata ngan lum ia phi hapdeng ka Jerusalem .

en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .
kha: Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban buh ïa une u kpu ha khmat U  Trai  na ka bynta ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Man la ka sngi saitjain un buh ia ka ha khmat U Trai man ka por , la shim noh na ki khun Israel da ka jutang bymjukut .

en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :
kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khot ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkloi !’ u la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah ti jong u bad pynphong juti ha ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u kpa u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, To wanrah ia ka jainkup kaba bha tam, bad buh ia ka ha u bad buh ia ka ryntieh ha ka kti jong u, bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong u:

en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries , when they had heard that the  Lord  fought against the enemies of Israel .
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la ïohsngew kumno U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki Israel , ka la sheptieng haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtieng U Blei ka la don ha ki hima baroh jong kita ki ri , haba ki la iohsngew ba U Trai u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong ki Israel .

en: They have not known nor understood : for he hath shut their eyes , that they cannot see  ; and their hearts , that they cannot understand .
kha: Kum kita ki briew ki long kiba bieit eh ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki khapbrip ïa la ki khmat bad ïa la ki jingmut na ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kim shym la tip ne sngewthuh: namar u la khang ia ki khmat jong ki, ba kim lah ban iohi ia ka ; bad ki dohnud jong ki, ba kim lah ban sngewthuh .

en: Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .
kha: Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! Ïeng joit na u pui pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! Law noh ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khum jong ka Seïon !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia lade na ka dewbilat; bad shong, ko Jerusalem: pyllait noh ia lade na ki jingteh jong ka ryndang jong me, ko khun kynthei jong u Seion .

en: The city will have wellness homes , wellness entertainment facilities , mall , hotels , multiplex , wellness treatment centres , he added .
kha: Ka nongbah kan don ki iing sumar , ki jaka pynbyrngia , ki mall , ki hotel , ki multiplex , ki jaka sumar , u la bynrap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka nongbah kan don ki iing sumar pang, ki jaka pynbyrngia ia ka koit ka khiah, ki mall, ki hotel, ki jaka sumar ba bun jait, u la bynrap.

en: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem , when they had fulfilled their ministry , and took with them John , whose surname was Mark .
kha: U Barnabas bad u Saul ki la lah pyndep ïa la ka kam bad ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Barnabas bad u Saul ki la wan phai na Jerusalem , haba ki la pyndep ia ka jingshakri jong ki bad ki la ialam bad ki ia u loannis uba la jer kyrteng u Mark .

en: And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .
kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai bad u la leit shapoh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U shong hangta bad ki nongap phira , u pynsyaid ïa lade harud ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la bud ia u sha jngai, wat sha ka iing jong u rangbah lyngdoh: bad u la shong bad ki shakri , bad u la pynshit ia lade ha ka ding .

en: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house  ; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins , he shall build the house unto my name .
kha: hynrei men ym ïoh ban tei ïa ka ; dei u khun jong me , u khun jong me hi u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh wat tei ia ka iing ; hynrei u khun jong me uba mih na ki tyrpeng jong me , un tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: And he said , Go . And he sent her away for two months : and she went with her companions , and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains .
kha: U ong ïa ka ban leit bad u phah noh ar bnai ïa ka . Ma ka bad la ki paralok ki leit kiew sha ki lum bad ki ïam sngewsih namar ba kan sa ïap kum kaba khlem shongkurim bad khlem khun khlem kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Leit noh . Bad u la phah noh ia ka haduh ar bnai: bad ka la leit bad ki paralok jong ka , bad ka la iam ia ka jinglong kynthei jong ka ha ki lum .

en: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites , out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol , six hundred men appointed with weapons of war .
kha: Kumta hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Dan ki mih na Sorah bad Eshtaol kiba la khreh ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki long ki hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la thung da ki tiar ialeh .

en: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying ,  Whom say the people that I am ?
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang duwai marwei , ki synran ki la wan ha u .  Ki paidbah ki ong ba nga long uei ?  U la kylli ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u dang duwai marwei, ki synran jong u ki la don ryngkat bad u: bad u la kylli ia ki da kaba ong: Nga long mano ?

en: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :
kha: Ha shuwa ban shim noh shajrong ïa u , u la ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki rangbah kiba u la jied kum ki apostol jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ka sngi ba la shim ia u, hadien kata u la ai hukum ia ki apostol kiba u la jied:

en: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost , The Lord said to my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool .
kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la pynkhih ïa u Dabid ban kren :   ‘ U Trai u la ong ïa U Trai jong nga ; shong hangne sha ka liang kamon jong nga haduh ba ngan da pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Dabid hi u la ong da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga , To shong ha ka kti kadiang jong nga , haduh ba ngan da pynlong ia ki nongshun jong me ha ka kjat jong me .

en: And he called Gehazi , and said , Call this Shunammite . So he called her . And when she was come in unto him , he said , Take up thy son .
kha: U Elisha u khot ïa u Gehasi , bad u ong ïa u ban khot ïa ka kmie jong u khynnah . Haba ka la wan shapoh , u ong ha ka ,  Une u khun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia u Gehasi, bad u la ong, Khot ia kane ka Shunam . Kumta u la khot ia ka . Bad haba ka la wan rung sha u , u la ong: To shim ia u khun jong me .

en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians , that ye might remove them far from their border .
kha: Phi la rah noh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem jngai na ka ri jong ki hi bad die ïa ki ha ki Grik .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Judah bad ki khun Jerusalem ki la die ha ki Grik , ba phin weng noh ia ki na u pud u sam jong ki .

en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .
kha: Haba u la tip ba U Jisu u la dei na ka thain ba la synshar da u Herod , u la phah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jerusalem ha kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu tip ba u dei u jong u Herood u la phah ia u sha u Herood uba hi ruh u la don ha Jerusalem ha kata ka por .

en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .
kha: Tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka Jaka Kyntang bad ka duwan , khnang ba ngan ym khie bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sumar ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong ka jaka kyntang bad ka jingkitkhlieh jong ka almari: ba kan ym don shuh ka jingbitar ia ki khun Israel .

en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :
kha: Kumta te , uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba stad uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata uno uno uba iohsngew ia kine ki ktien jong nga bad uba leh ia ki , ngan ianujor ia u bad u briew uba stad uba la tei ia ka iing jong u halor u maw:

en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .
kha: U Jisu u la pynlut ïa kita ki sngi da kaba hikai ha ka Templ , bad haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u ju mihnoh shabar bad pynlut ïa ka miet ha u lum ki Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por mynstep u dang hikai ha ka tempi ; bad ha ka por miet u la mih noh , bad u la sah ha ka lum kaba la khot ka lum jong ki Olives .

en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .
kha: Ha shi lynter ka jingim , ngi don ha tmier jong ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jisu , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïap jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi kiba im ngi la shah pyniap ha ka jingiap na ka bynta U Jisu, ba ka jingim U Jisu ruh kan paw ha ka doh ba iap jong ngi .

en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon . And she said , Comest thou peaceably ? And he said , Peaceably .
kha: Nangta u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith , u la leit sha ka Bathsheba , kaba dei ka kmie jong u Solomon .  Hato kane ka dei ka jingwan jngoh kaba sngewtynnat ?  Ka dei ,  u jubab ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Adonijah u khun u Haggith u la wan sha Bathsheba ka kmie u Solomon . Bad ka la ong , Me wan suk ? Bad u la ong , Da kaba suk .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham , and all his wars , and his ways , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .
kha: Ïa kiwei kiwei pat ki kam jong ka jingsynshar jong u Jotham , ki thma jong u , bad ki rukom pynïaidkam jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jotham bad ki thma jong u baroh bad ki lynti jong u, ha khmih la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Israel bad Judah .

en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
kha: Ynda nga la jop ïa ki , ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U Trai, haba nga la ioh burom ia nga ha u Pharaoh, ha ki kali jong u bad ha ki kulai jong u .

en: And she said , Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight . So the woman went her way , and did eat , and her countenance was no more sad .
kha: A ba phin da pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga kumta man ka por ,  ka jubab . Nangta ka leit noh , ka bam ka dih , bad kam shym leh sngewsih shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , To ai ba ka kti jong me kan shem ia ka jingaiei ha ka khmat jong me . Kumta kata ka kynthei ka la leit noh bad ka la bam, bad ka khmat jong ka kam shym la sngewsih shuh .

en: Then shall he answer them , saying , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these , ye did it not to me .
kha: U Syiem un jubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ha man ba phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa iwei na kine kiba rit tam , phi kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Hooid nga ong ha phi: Kumba phim shym la leh ia kata ha uwei na kine kiba rit tam .

en: Then said Elijah unto the people , I , even I only , remain a prophet of the  Lord   ; but Baal s prophets are four hundred and fifty men .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ,  Nga don sa tang ma nga u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  uba dang sah , hynrei ki don sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Elijah u la ong ha ki briew, nga, wat nga hi, nga sah u nongiathuhlypa jong U Trai Baal hynrei ki nongiathuhlypa ki long saw spah sanphew ngut ki briew .

en: He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .
kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uwei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne hadien ka por jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ; kumta hadien jong u ym don uwei ruh uba kum ma u napdeng ki syiem Judah baroh .

en: And when he came to the tower , he took them from their hand , and bestowed them in the house : and he let the men go , and they departed .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha u lum ba u Elisha u shong , u Gehasi u la shim ïa ki ar tylli ki pla bad u la kit ïa ki shapoh ïing . Nangta u la phah noh ïa ki shakri jong u Naaman .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha ka tower, u la shim ia ki na ka kti jong ki, bad u la ai ia ki ha iing: bad u la pyllait noh ia kita ki briew bad ki la leit noh .

en: And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .
kha: Nga la ong ha ki ,  Lada phi mon , to ai ïa ka bainong jong nga . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to bat noh ïa ka .  Kumta ki la siew ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka bainong jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha ki, Lada phi pyrkhat bha, to ai ia nga ia ka dor jong nga; bad lada ym dei, to ai ia ka dor jong nga laiphew tylli ki rupa .

en: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
kha: U briew uba pang na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan ha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ïarap .  Lada me mon ,  u la ong ,  me lah ban pynkhuid ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan u nongpang niangthohlieh ha u, u la kyrpad ia u, bad u la dem khrup ha u, bad u la ong ha u, Lada me mon, me lah ban pynkhuid ia nga .

en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave unto Esau mount Seir , to possess it  ; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .
kha: bad ha u Isaak nga la ai ïa u Jakob bad u Iso . Nga la ai ha u Iso ïa ka ri lum Edom kum ka jingïohkynti jong u , hynrei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong phi , bad ki khun ki kti jong u , ki leit hiar sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ha u Isaak u Jakob bad u Iso: bad nga la ai ha u Iso u Seir, ban don ia ka ; hynrei u Jakob bad ki khun jong u ki la leit hiar sha Ijipt .

en: The voice said , Cry . And he said , What shall I cry ? All flesh is grass , and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field :
kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam ,  To pynbna ïa ka khubor !   Ka khubor aïu ngan pynbna ?  nga kylli .  To pynbna ba ki briew baroh ki long kum u phlang ; kin ym neh skhem ban ïa ki syntiew khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur ka la ong , To iam . Bad u la ong , Kaei kaba ngan iam ? Ka doh baroh ka long u phlang bad ka jingbha jong ka baroh ka long kum u syntiew lyngkha:

en: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
kha: Ha Ijipt u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , na ka Asenath ka khun jong u Potiphera , u lyngdoh ha ka Heliopolis .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Joseph ha ka ri Ijipt la kha ia u Manasseh bad u Ephraham, kiba u Asenath ka khun jong u Lyngdoh jong u On u la kha ia u .

en: And as for you , O my flock , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I judge between cattle and cattle , between the rams and the he goats .
kha: Te mynta , ko ka kynhun jong nga ; ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na phi bad ngan pynkhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew , ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia phi ko kynhun jong nga, ong U Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , nga bishar hapdeng ki masi bad ki masi , hapdeng ki langbrot bad ki blang .

en: And the Spirit bade me go with them , nothing doubting . Moreover these six brethren accompanied me , and we entered into the man s house :
kha: U Mynsiem u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad ki khlem pynslem . Kine ki hynriew ngut ki parabangeit na Joppa ki la synran ïa nga sha Kaisaria , bad baroh ngi la ïaleit sha ka ïing jong u Kornelios .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Mynsiem u la bthah ia nga ban leit bad ki, khlem artatien ei ei . Nalor kata kine ki hynriew ngut ki hynmen ki la iadon ryngkat bad nga, bad ngi la rung shapoh ka iing jong uta u briew:

en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high , and the wilderness be a fruitful field , and the fruitful field be counted for a forest .
kha: Hynrei sa shisien pat U Blei un phah ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u . Ka jaka shrah kan sa kylla seisoh , bad ki lyngkha kin sa pynmih ki jingbam kyrhai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba u mynsiem un tuid halor jong ngi naduh jrong , bad ka ri khlaw kan long ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad ka lyngkha kaba seisoh kan long ka khlaw .

en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , that shall come upon thy two sons , on Hophni and Phinehas  ; in one day they shall die both of them .
kha: Haba ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong me , u Hophni bad u Phinehas kin ïap ha kajuh ka sngi , kane kan pyn-i ïa me ba baroh kaba nga la kren kan urlong .
