translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha me, kata kan wan ha ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong me, ha u Hophni bad u Phinehas ; ha kawei ka sngi kin iap baroh arngut .

en: He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .
kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kum kane ka hukum kaba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathuh ïa u Daniel ïa kaei kaba la lah jia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha u syiem u rangbah shipai u la ong: Balei ka hukum ka long kaba kyrkieh na u syiem ? Nangta u Arik u la pynpaw ia kata ha u Daniel .

en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries : which is to them an evident token of perdition , but to you of salvation , and that of God .
kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong phi ; long borabor kiba shlur , bad kane hi kan pynshisha ha ki , ba kin shah rem bad ba phin jop , namar dei U Blei uba ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaei kaei kaba la tieng da ki nongshun jong phi: kaba long ha ki ka dak kaba paw shai jong ka jingduhnong , hynrei ha phi jong ka jingpynim , bad ka jong U Blei .

en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .
kha: Ngan map noh ïa ki pop ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don kawei ruh na ki pop jong u kaba u la leh: u la leh ia kata kaba long katkum ka ain bad kaba dei; un im shisha .

en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
kha: Ïa nga ruh yn pyndap da ka jingkmen namar ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don shuh ka jingïam , yn ym don shuh ki ban khot kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan sngewbha ha Jerusalem bad ka jingkmen ha ki briew jong nga: bad ka sur jong ka jingiam kan ym iohsngew shuh ha ka , ne ka sur jong ka jingiam .

en: And king David said , Call me Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada . And they came before the king .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid phah khot ïa u Sadok , u Nathan , bad u Benaïah . Haba ki la rung shapoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Dabid u la ong: Khot ia nga u Nadaok u lyngdoh bad u Natha u nongiathuhlypa bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada . Ki la wan ha khmat u syiem .

en: And they brought him unto him : and when he saw him , straightway the spirit tare him  ; and he fell on the ground , and wallowed foaming .
kha: Ki la wallam ïa u ha U Jisu . Tang shu ïohi ïa U Jisu , u mynsiem bymkhuid u la pynring kyrthat ïa uta u khynnah , haduh ba u la kyllon ha madan bad u la tyllun , u da sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia u ha u: bad haba u la iohi ia u, u la pynlong beit ia u bad u la hap ha khyndew, bad u la khih .

en: I the  Lord  search the heart , I try the reins , even to give every man according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga wad ïa ki jingmut bad nga tynjuh ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew . Nga leh ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka lynti ba u im , kat kum kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga U Trai nga wad ia ka dohnud , nga pyrshang ia ki rein , wat ban ai ia uwei pa uwei kat kum ki lynti jong u bad kat kum ki soh jong ki jingleh jong u .

en: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
kha: Bad ngi tip ba ïa ka jinglong barim jong ngi la pynïap noh bad U Khrist halor ka diengphna , khnang ba ïa ka bor jong ka jinglong pop jong ngi , yn pynjot noh , khnang ba ngin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip ia kane , ba u tymmen jong ngi u la sahnarphna bad u , ba ka met pop kan shah pynjot , ba nangne shakhmat ngim dei ban shakri ia ka pop .

en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .
kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno u ban duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno uba pynim ia ka jingim jong u un duh noh ia ka ; hynrei uno uno u ba duh noh ia ka jingim jong u na ka bynta jong nga bad ka gospel s .

en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .
kha: ban leit bad ong ha u Hananaïah :  U  Trai  u la ong ba me lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkor nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad iathuh ha u Hananiah, da kaba ong, Kumta u la pynpra ia ki lyngkhot dieng ; hynrei men pynlong ia ki da ki lyngkhot nar .

en: They shall be turned back , they shall be greatly ashamed , that trust in graven images , that say to the molten images , Ye are our gods .
kha: Baroh kiba shaniah ha ki bleithaw , kiba khot ïa ki dur ki blei jong ki , yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa kylla shadien shibun, kin sngewlehrain shibun, kiba shaniah ha ki dur ba la ker , kiba ong ha ki dur ba la khleh lang , Phi long ki blei jong ngi .

en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :
kha: U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rit bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la buh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pynlong ia baroh, kiba rit bad kiba khraw, kiba riewspah bad kiba duk, kiba laitluid bad kiba duk, ban ioh ia ka dak ha ka kti kadiang jong ki, ne ha ka khlieh jong ki:

en: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .
kha: Te u Jakob u khot ïa la ki khun shynrang bad u ong ,  Ïalumlang baroh , ba ngan ïathuh aïu kan jia ïa phi ha ka lawei :
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la khot ia ki khun shynrang jong u bad u la ong: To ia lum lang ia lade, ba ngan iathuh ia phi ia kaei kaban sa jia ha phi ha ki sngi kiba khatduh .

en: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia , the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul , and brought him to the judgment seat ,
kha: Haba ïa u Gallio la pynlong u lyngskor jong ka Akhaïa kaba ha ka hima Rom , ki Jiw ki la ïalumlang hangta , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Gallio u long u nongshong shnong jong ka Akhaia , ki Jiw ki la leh pyrshah ia u Paul bad ki la wanrah ia u sha ka jaka bishar .

en: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment , an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary : it shall be an holy anointing oil .
kha: bad shna ïa ka umphniang pynsleh kaba kyntang ba la khleh lang kum ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynlong ia ka ka umphniang bakhuid, ka umphniang ba la pyndap da ka umphniang: kan long ka umphniang ba kyntang .

en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;
kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long kumjuh kiba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba jylliew ; kiba haba ki la iohsngew ia ka ktien , mardor ki pdiang ia ka da ka jingkmen ; .

en: Wherefore the rather , brethren , give diligence to make your calling and election sure : for if ye do these things , ye shall never fall :
kha: Naba kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , to pyrshang kham tyngeh ban pynlong ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei bad ka jingjied jong u ïa phi , ka jingshem baneh junom ; lada phi leh kumta , phin ym iehnoh da lei lei ïa ka jingngeit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki hynmen kiba kham bha, ki ai ka jingminot ban pynlong ia ka jingkhot bad ka jingjied jong phi: namar lada phi leh ia kine kiei kiei , phin ym hap satia:

en: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
kha: Hato u briew u ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em ym kumta ! Kam don kano kano kaba u lah ban ai ban ïoh pat ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kaei kaba u briew u ioh jingmyntoi lada u ioh ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad u duh noh ia la ka jong ka mynsiem ? lane u briew un ai ai aiu ha ka jingkylla ia ka mynsiem jong u ?

en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .
kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa haduh katno nga long uba donbor ha Ijipt , bad ïathuh ruh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïaleit bran bran , bad wan ïalam ïa i shane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin iathuh ia u kpa jong nga baroh ha Ijipt bad na kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la iohi bad phin pynkloi bad pynhiar ia u kpa jong nga hangne .

en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him : for he refresheth the soul of his masters .
kha: U nonglamktien uba lah ban shaniah u ai jinghun mynsiem ïa uta uba phah ïa u , kum ka umkhriat ha ka jingshit tyrha ha ka aïom ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka jingkhriat jong u slap ha ka por ot , kumjuh ruh u nonglam khubor uba iaineh ha ki kiba phah ia u: namar u pynkmen ia ka mynsiem jong ki kynrad jong u .

en: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .
kha: U Eli u la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa bad u kylli ,  Ka jingsawa aïu kata ?  Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi sha u Eli ban ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eli u la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka jingpyrta, u la ong, Kaei ka jingsawa jong kane ka jingsawa ? U uta u briew u la wan rung kyrkieh bad u la iathuh ha u Eli .

en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel halor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki Philistia ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel ; bad ki briew Israel ki la phet noh na khmat ki Philistia bad ki la hap ha u lum Gilboa .

en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year  ;
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin aiti ia ka jingainguh thang kaba thiang ha U Trai ; ar tylli ki masi rit , uwei u langbrot , hynriew ngut ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong ; .

en: And he spread it before me  ; and it was written within and without : and there was written therein lamentations , and mourning , and woe .
kha: Kata ka kti ka la plied ïa ka kot kli , bad nga la ïohi ba ka don ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang — la thoh hangta ka jingïambriew bad ka jingsngewsih kthang bad ka jingpait dohnud bad ka jingud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynphriang ia ka ha khmat jong nga; bad la thoh ia ka hapoh bad shabar: bad la thoh ha kata ki jingud, bad ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih .

en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath , which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad : and he also delivered Israel .
kha: U nongïalam uba bud u dei u Shamgar , u khun jong u Anath . Une ruh u la pyllait ïa ki Israel , bad u la leh kumta da kaba pynïap hynriewspah ngut ki Philistia da u dieng ñiah masi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u la long u Shamgar u khun u Anath, uba la pyniap ia ki Philistia hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba don u blang masi: bad u ruh u la pynpoi ia ki Israel .

en: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof : and the going up to it had eight steps .
kha: Ka kamra rung ka long marpyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La oh-shrong ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki kynroh baroh shi lynter ka lynti ïaid . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arches jong ka ki long sha ka iingbishar kaba shabar bad ki dieng sohjew ki don ha ki post jong ka: bad ka jingleit shaneng jong ka ka don 8 tylli ki step .

en: For I will not contend for ever , neither will I be always wroth : for the spirit should fail before me , and the souls which I have made .
kha: Nga ai ka jingim ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan ym mudui sah ïa ki lane bitar ïa ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ym ialeh junom, lymne ngan ym bitar beit: namar ka mynsiem kan duh noh ha khmat jong nga, bad ki mynsiem kiba nga la thaw .

en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh  ; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head .
kha: Ha ka shang kaba halor eh , don bun ki jait jingbam ba la dep shet na ka bynta u syiem , bad ki sim ki la wan bam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka basket kaba shalor tam ka don ki jait jingbam ba la shet na ka bynta u Pharaoh bad ki sim ki la bam ia ki na ka basket ha ka khlieh jong nga .

en: I speak to your shame . Is it so , that there is not a wise man among you ? no , not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren ?
kha: Ka long kaba sngewlehrain ïa phi! Da shisha yn don la kumno kumno u briew uba stad ha ka kynhun jong phi uba lah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kren ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong phi . Hato kam long kumta ba ym don u briew uba stad hapdeng jong phi ? em , ym uwei ruh u ban lah ban bishar hapdeng ki hynmen jong u ?

en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud ? is there no king in thee ? is thy counsellor perished ? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail .
kha: Balei pha kyang jam ? Balei ba pha shahshitom kum ka briew kaba suh kha ? Hato ka long namar ba pham don u syiem , bad ki nongaibuit jong pha ki la ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta balei me pyrta jam ? hato ym don syiem ha me ? hato u nongai jingmut jong me u la jah noh ? namar ki pang ki la shim ia me kum ka kynthei ha ka jingkha khun .

en: Neither shall one thrust another  ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .
kha: lane ïatyngkhuh para ma ki . Ki ïa-ïaid kynhun lyngba ïa ki jingker-ïada , bad ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei un ym pynkhih ia uwei pat: kin iaid uwei pa uwei ha ka lynti jong u: bad haba ki hap ha ka waitlam , kin ym mynsaw .

en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee .
kha: Nga la shaniah ha me shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; me la ïada ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga . Ngan ïai ïaroh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Da me nga la shah bat na ka kpoh: me long ma me uba la shim ia nga na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga: ka jingiaroh jong nga kan long beit na me .

en: It is not in heaven , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go up for us to heaven , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
kha: Kam don hangtei ha sahit bneng . Phim donkam ban da ong , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit kiew shatei bad wallam ïa ka shane sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kam dei ha bneng ba me dei ban ong , Mano ba leit sha bneng bad wanrah ia ka ha ngi ba ngin iohsngew ia ka bad leh ia kata ?

en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong nga ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga lane leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Trai u ong , Namar ki la iehnoh ia ka hukum jong nga kaba nga buh ha khmat jong ki , bad kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga , lymne kim shym la iaid ha ka ; .

en: And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .
kha: Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka por ba ki leit sha ka ïing U  Trai  , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïam bad kam treh ban bam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba u la leh kumta man la u snem, haba ka la leit sha ka iing U Trai , kumta ka la pynkhih ia ka ; namarkata ka la iam , bad kam shym la bam .

en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi ngeit ha u , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad kaba dap da ka burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba phim shym la iohi, phi ieit ia u; ha uba, wat la mynta phim iohi ia u, hynrei phi ngeit, phi sngewbha da ka jingkmen kaba ym lah ban batai bad kaba dap da ka burom:

en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .
kha: U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka bor bakhuid jong u ; un pynim ïa la ki briew , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohi ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynpaw ia ka kti bakhuid jong u ha khmat ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad ki tduh jong ka khyndew baroh kin iohi ia ka jingpynim U Blei jong ngi .

en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .
kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingim kaba jlan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me iaid ha ki lynti jong nga, ban sumar ia ki ain bad ki hukum jong nga kumba u kpa jong me u Dabid u la iaid , te ngan pynjlan ia ki sngi jong me .

en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah  ; and he reigned a full month in Samaria .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar shi bnai ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sallum u khun u Jabesh u la sdang ban synshar ha ka snem kaba hynniewphew snem jong u syiem Judah ; bad u la synshar shibnai pura ha Samaria .

en: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?
kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jong nga , leh ïa kita kiei kiei hi kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei! Hato phi pyrkhat phin lait na ka jingbishar U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me pyrkhat ia kane, ko briew, ba me bishar ia kita kiba leh ia kum kine kiei kiei bad phi leh kumjuh , ba phin lait na ka jingbishar U Blei ?

en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .
kha: Nangta pynkyntang ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki tiar jong ka baroh da kaba synreit da ka umphniang pynsleh ; te kan sa long kaba kyntang nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynkhuid ia ka jingknia ba la thang bad ki tiar jong u baroh: bad kan long ka jingknia kaba khuid tam .

en: Thou son of man , shew the house to the house of Israel , that they may be ashamed of their iniquities : and let them measure the pattern .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong shuh ,  Ko u khun u briew , to ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel shaphang ka Templ , bad ai ba kin ïitbniah ïa ka jingthmu jong ka . Pynlong ïa ki ban sngewlehrain ïa ki kam pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me khun u briew, to pyni ia ka iing ha ka iing Israel, ba kin sngewlehrain ia ki jingbymhok jong ki: bad to ai ba kin thew ia ka dur .

en: And the Father himself , which hath sent me , hath borne witness of me . Ye have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his shape .
kha: Bad U Kpa , uba la phah ïa nga , u ruh u phla na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Kpa hi uba la phah ia nga, u la pynpaw ia nga . Phim shym la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u ha kano kano ka por , lymne phim shym la iohi ia ka dur jong u .

en: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark , and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above .
kha: Ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki tap ïa ka synduk bad ïa ki dieng jingbah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki cherub ki la pynphriang ia ki ar tylli ki bniat jong ki halor ka jaka jong ka synduk , bad ki cherub ki la tap ia ka synduk bad ki dieng jong ka haneng .

en: And they answered him , He was an hairy man , and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins . And he said , It is Elijah the Tishbite .
kha: U phong ka jingkup kaba la shna na ki snieh mrad , ïa kaba la teh da u panpoh snieh ,  ki jubab .  U dei u Elijah !  u syiem u la ong jam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u, U long u briew uba don shniuh, bad u la bat ia ka sniehdoh kaba jrong sawdong jong u . Bad u la ong, Ka long ka Elijah ka Tishbite .

en: And , behold , the whole city came out to meet Jesus : and when they saw him , they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts .
kha: Kumta uwei uwei baroh na ka shnong ki la ïamih ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu ; bad haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ba un leit noh na ka thain jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka shnong baroh kawei ka la mih ban iakynduh ia U Jisu: bad haba ki la iohi ia u , ki la kyrpad ia u ba un leit noh na ki ri jong ki .

en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .
kha: Nga don hangne hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba me la jied kum la ki jong , ki briew kiba bun paid katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shakri jong me u don hapdeng ki briew jong me kiba me la jied, ki briew kiba khraw , ki bym lah ban khein ne khein ia ka jingbun briew .

en: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod , before it .
kha: bad ki teh ïa ki tduh jong ki ha kita ki ar tylli ki shrong , bad ki pynsnoh ïa ki sha khmat ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ki ar tylli ki kynjri ki la rung ha ki ar tylli ki tyrpeng , bad ki la buh ia ki ha ki tyrpeng jong ka ephod , ha khmat jong ka .

en: Thou shalt plant vineyards , and dress them , but shalt neither drink of the wine , nor gather the grapes  ; for the worms shall eat them .
kha: Phin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha bri , bad phin sumar ïa ki , hynrei phin ym ïoh kheit ïa ki sohwaiñ lane dih waiñ na ki , namar ki khñiang kin bam ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban thung ia ki kper sohjew bad phong ia ki , hynrei wat dih ia u wain , lymne wat lum ia ki sohjew ; namar ki khniang kin bam ia ki .

en: For verily I say unto you , Till heaven and earth pass , one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law , till all be fulfilled .
kha: To kynmaw ba katba ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ki dang sah , ym don iwei i dak iba rit tam lymne i bynta iba rit tam na ka Hukum ïa iba yn pyndam noh — ym haduh kaba kut jong kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha nga ong ha phi, Haduh ba ka bneng bad ka khyndew kin iaid, kawei ka jot ne kawei ka tdem kan ym iaid lait na ka hukum, haduh ba baroh kin da pyndep .

en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .
kha: Kito kiba don ki mawkordor ki la ai ïa ki sha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ , kaba la khmih da u Jehiel jong ka kur Lebi jong u Gershon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bad kiba la lap ia ki maw ba kordor ki la ai ia ki ha ka spah jong ka iing U Trai , da ka kti u Jehiel u Gerson .

en: And Ahab made a grove  ; and Ahab did more to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him .
kha: U pynïeng ruh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah . U leh shibun ban pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , kham palat ban ïa ki syiem Israel baroh ha shuwa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la leh ia ka khlaw ; bad u Ahab u la leh kham bun ban pynkhih ia U Trai Blei jong ki Israel ban bitar ban ia ki syiem Israel baroh kiba la don ha khmat jong u .

en: Therefore I endure all things for the elect s sakes , that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory .
kha: Hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei kam shah teh ha ki kynjri , bad kumta nga ïaishah ha kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim kaba wan lyngba U Khrist Jisu bad kaba wallam ïa ka burom bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga shah ia kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta kiba la jied, ba kin ioh ruh ia ka jingpynim kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu ryngkat bad ka burom bymjukut .

en: And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .
kha: Hynrei ki la ïai pyrta da ka sur kaba jam eh ba ïa U Jisu dei ban sahnarphna , bad khatduh ka jingpyrta jong ki ka la jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren stet bad ki sur kiba jam, ki la dawa ba un shah sahnarphna . Bad ki sur jong ki bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jop .

en: Because thou hast said , These two nations and these two countries shall be mine , and we will possess it  ; whereas the  Lord  was there :
kha: Me la ong ba ki jaitbynriew baroh ar , ki Judah bad ki Israel , lem bad ki ri jong ki , ki long ki jong me bad ba men sa ïohkynti ïa ki , wat la ma nga , U  Trai  nga long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la ong , Kine ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew bad kine ki ar tylli ki ri kin long ki jong nga , bad ngin sa don ia ka ; katba U Trai u la don hangta :

en: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don katto katne hangne ki ban ym ïap tad haduh ba kin da ïohi ba U Khun U Briew u wan kum u Syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Don kiba ieng hangne , ki bym sngewtynnad ia ka jingiap , haduh ba kin da iohi ia U Khun u briew uba wan ha ka hima jong u .

en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world , and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles ; how much more their fulness ?
kha: Ka pop jong ki Jiw ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ka pyrthei , bad ka jingduk ba kynja mynsiem jong ki ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ïa ki Jentil . Te , haduh katno ki jingkyrkhu ba kham khraw kin long haba ïa baroh ki Jiw yn kynthup lang!
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta lada ka jinghap jong ki ka long ka spah jong ka pyrthei , bad ka jingduna jong ki ka spah jong ki Jutang ; katno ka jinglong ba pura jong ki ?

en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .
kha: Kumta u Saul u sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid bad u leit noh ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Na kata ka daw , ïa kata ka jaka la khot U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Saul u la wan phai na kaba bud ia u Dabid, bad u la leit pyrshah ia ki Philistia: namarkata ki la khot ia kata ka jaka Selahammahlekot .

en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death ; and to the other the savour of life unto life . And who is sufficient for these things ?
kha: Ïa kito kiba jah noh , ka dei ka jingiwtung kaba pynïap ; hynrei ha kito kiba la pynim , ka long ka jingiwbih kaba wallam jingim . Uei keiñ , uba lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uta uba ngi long ka jingsma jong ka jingiap haduh ka jingiap ; bad ha uwei pat ka jingsma jong ka jingim haduh ka jingim . Bad mano ba biang na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ?

en: For the  Lord  thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes , to stand to minister in the name of the  Lord  , him and his sons for ever .
kha: Na ki jait jong phi baroh , U  Trai  u la jied ïa ka jait Lebi ban shakri ïa u kum ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u la jied ia u na ki jaitbynriew jong me baroh , ban ieng ha ka kyrteng U Trai , ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u junom .

en: That word , I say , ye know , which was published throughout all Judaea , and began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached  ;
kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingjia kaba khraw kaba la jia ha kylleng ka ri Israel , kaba sdang ha Galilaïa hadien ba u Ïoannis u la ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u shaphang ka jingpynbaptis .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka ktien , nga ong , phi tip , kaba la pynmih ha kylleng ka ri Judaea baroh kawei bad kaba la sdang na Galilaia , hadien ka jingpynbaptis kaba u loannis u la ialap;

en: But it shall not be well with the wicked , neither shall he prolong his days , which are as a shadow  ; because he feareth not before God .
kha: hynrei kan ym long bha ïa ki bymman . Ka jingim jong ki ka long kum ka syrngiew , bad kin ïap haba ki dang samla , namar ba kim kohnguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan ym long kaba bha bad kiba sniew, lymne un ym pynjlan ia ki sngi jong u kiba long kum ka jingdum ; namar ba um tieng ha khmat U Blei .

en: Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the  Lord  do so to me , and more also , if ought but death part thee and me .
kha: Hangno hangno ba phi ïap , hangta ngan ïap , bad dei hangta ba yn tep ïa nga . Ai ba ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei eh jong U  Trai  kan wan hap halor jong nga lada nga shah ïa kaei kaei lait noh ka jingïap hi ka ban pynïakhlad ïa nga na phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno me iap, ngan iap, bad hangta ngan shah tep: U Trai un leh kumta ia nga, bad kham bun ruh, lada dei ban iap tang ia me bad ia nga .

en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning , that they may follow strong drink  ; that continue until night , till wine inflame them !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi khie dang step phyrngab ban sdang dih , bad phi pynlut ki janmiet bajlan ha ka jingbuaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki kiba khie dang step , ba kin bud ia ka jingdih kaba khlain kaba iai bteng haduh ban da miet , haduh ba ka wain kan pynkhih ia ki !

en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly , that God hath made that same Jesus , whom ye have crucified , both Lord and Christ .
kha: Baroh ki paid Israel , te , ki dei ban tip da kaba thikna ba une U Jisu , uba phi la sahnarphna , u dei uta uba U Blei u la pynlong U Trai bad U Messaïah !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ai ba ka iing Israel baroh kan tip da kaba thikna, ba U Blei u la pynlong ia uta u juh u Jisu, uba phi la sahnarphna, U Trai bad U Khrist .

en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come before him : worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness .
kha: Ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom U  Trai  ; wallam ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u . To dem ha khmat Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ha U Trai ia ka burom kaba dei ia ka kyrteng jong u: wanrah ia ka jingainguh , bad wan ha khmat jong u: mane ia U Trai ha ka jingitynnad jong ka jingkhuid .

en: This means that in a personal , private prayer you tell him that you are giving yourself to him to do his will .—Matthew 16 :24  ; 22 :37 .
kha: Kane ka mut ban ïathuh ha u ha ka jingduwai ba jar jar marwei , ba phi aiti ïalade ha u ban leh ïa ka mon jong u .—Mathaios 16 :24 ; 22 :37 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka mut ba ha ka jingduwai shimet bad shimet phi iathuh ia u ba phi ai ia lade ha u ban leh ia ka mon jong u .

en: And it was so , when the king went into the house of the  Lord  , that the guard bare them , and brought them back into the guard chamber .
kha: Man ba u syiem u leit rung sha ka Templ , ki nongap khyrdop ki rah ïa kita ki stieh , bad ki pynphai pat ïa ki sha ka kamra ki nongap khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba u syiem u la leit shapoh iing U Trai, ba u nongap u la kit ia ki bad u la wanrah biang ia ki shapoh ka kamra pahara .

en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .
kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga la sheptieng , namar nga pyrkhat ïoh phin knieh jubor ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Laban: Namar nga la ong: namar nga la ong: Hooid men shim da ka bor ia ki khun kynthei jong me na nga .

en: But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .
kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Joshua u khun u Nun uba ieng ha khmat jong me, un leit shapoh: pynshlur ia u: namar un pynlong ia ki Israel ban hiar pateng ia ka .

en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .
kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad u la ai ka jingïohi pat ha kiba bun ki briew kiba matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata kajuh ka kynta u la pynkoit ia kiba bun ki jingduna bad ki jingpang jong ki, bad ki mynsiem bymman ; bad ha kiba bun kiba matlah u la ai jingpeit .

en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .
kha: Ïa ka thliew ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh la suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong khnang ba kan ym kad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ka thliew hapdeng ka rob , kum ka thliew jong u khniang , bad ka band sawdong ka thliew , ba kan ym kylla .

en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïalumlang ban shahjingit ban pynpaw ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki jaiñ khain bad sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki ïeng bad sdang ban phla ïa ki pop kiba ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U symbai Israel u la pyniakhlad ia lade na ki nongwei baroh , bad u la ieng bad u la phla ia ki pop jong ki bad ki jingbymhok jong ki kpa jong ki .

en: As if a man did flee from a lion , and a bear met him  ; or went into the house , and leaned his hand on the wall , and a serpent bit him .
kha: Kan long kum haba u briew u phet ïap na u sing bad u ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem ! lane kum haba u briew u wan sha la ïing bad buh ïa la ka kti ha ka kynroh — tang ban shah puh ha u bseiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ba u briew u la phet noh na u sing , bad u bear u la iakynduh ia u ; ne u la leit shapoh iing , bad u la pynkhih ia la ka kti ha ka jingkhang , bad u bsein u la bam ia u .

en: And the  Lord  did that thing on the morrow , and all the cattle of Egypt died : but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U  Trai  u la leh kumba u la ong bad ki jingri baroh jong ki nong Ijipt ki la ïap , hynrei kawei ruh na ki jingri jong ki Israel kam shym ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leh ia kata ha ka sngi kaba bud, bad ki masi Ijipt baroh ki la iap: hynrei na ki masi Israel ym don ba iap .

en: And Elisha said unto him , Go , say unto him , Thou mayest certainly recover : howbeit the  Lord  hath shewed me that he shall surely die .
kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba un ïap ; hynrei khie leit sha u bad ïathuh ha u ba un koit pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong ha u, To leit, to ong ha u, Me lah ban koit shisha: wat la U Trai u la pyni ia nga ba un sa iap shisha .

en: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .
kha: Ka ryntieh u Jonathan ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka waitlam u Saul ka long ka bym don jingisynei , Ka pynkhyllem ïa kiba khlaiñbor , ka da pynïap ïa ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka snam jong kiba la shah pyniap, na ka shini jong kiba khlain bor, ka bow jong u Jonathan kam shym la phaidien shuh shuh bad ka waitlam u Saul kam shym la wan phai thylli .

en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba kan long kumta ïa mynta . Naba kumne keiñ ngin pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba U Blei u dawa .  Kumta u Ïoannis u la mynjur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u: To sngewbha ia ka ban long kumta mynta: namar kumta ka long kaba bha ia ngi ban pyndep ia ka hok baroh . Nangta u la shah shitom ia u .

en: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph s son ?
kha: Baroh ki la sngewhun ïa u bad ki la sngewphylla ha ki kyntien basngewtynnat kiba u la kren . Ki la ong ,  Hato une um dei u khun jong u Joseph ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki la pynpaw ia u, bad ki la lyngngoh ia ki ktien ba sngewbha kiba mih na ka shyntur jong u . Ki la ong: Hato une u khun u Joseph ?

en: For there were that said , We , our sons , and our daughters , are many : therefore we take up corn for them , that we may eat , and live .
kha: Katto katne ki ong ,  Ngi don ki longïing baheh , ngi donkam kew ban pynim ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki don kiba ong , Ngi ki khun shynrang jong ngi bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi ngi long kiba bun: namarkata ngi shim ia u kew na ka bynta jong ki, ba ngin bam bad im .

en: For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :
kha: U Blei hi da lade u la buh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ban kham ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met kiba donkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki bynta jong ngi kim donkam: hynrei U Blei u la pynkhih ia ka met ryngkat, da kaba ai burom kham bun ia kata ka bynta kaba duna:

en: Therefore , they began searching for an understanding of the Bible’s original teachings , and Jehovah blessed them with spiritual insight .
kha: Namarkata , ki la sdang ban wad ïa ka jingsngewthuh katkum ki jinghikai tynrai jong ka Baibl bad U Jehobah u la ïarap ïa ki ban sngewthuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ki la sdang ban wad ia ka jingsngewthuh ia ki jinghikai tynrai jong ka Baibl, bad U Jehobah u la kyrkhu ia ki da ka jingshemphang ba kynja mynsiem .

en: After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
kha: Hadien ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba iap kin ioh biang ia ka jingim da ka jingmihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la rung ha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u ba ia kiba iap yn pynphai biang sha ka jingim da ka jingmihpat .

en: I will go and return to my place , till they acknowledge their offence , and seek my face : in their affliction they will seek me early .
kha: Ngan lyndet noh ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin shahshitom ha ban da biang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad wan ban wad ïa nga . Lehse ha ki jingshah shitom jong ki , kin pyrshang ban wad ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit phai noh sha ka jaka jong nga, haduh ba kin da pdiang ia ka jingleh bymman jong ki, bad kin wad ia ka khmat jong nga: ha ka jingjynjar jong ki kin wad ia nga kloi .

en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .
kha: U la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah haduh hynñiew snem shiteng , bad ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel bad Judah baroh haduh laiphew lai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha Hebron u la synshar ia ka Judah hynriew snem hynriew bnai: bad ha Jerusalem u la synshar laiphew lai snem halor ki Israel baroh bad Judah .

en: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
kha: ym ha baroh , hynrei tang ha ki sakhi kiba U Blei u la lah jied , kata , ha ngi kiba la ïabam bad ïadih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym ha ki briew baroh , hynrei ha ki sakhi ba la jied ha khmat U Blei , wat ha ngi ruh kiba la bam bad dih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na kiba iap .

en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and , behold , the camels were coming .
kha: U la mih shabar ha ka por janmiet ban ïaid kai pyngngad ha ki pyntha bad u ïohi ïa ki ut ba ki dang wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la mih ban pyrkhat ha lyngkha ha ka por ba la jia: bad u la rah ia ki khmat jong u, bad u la iohi, bad, ha khmih, ki kulai ki la wan .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , The man shall be surely put to death : all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ïa uta u briew dei ban pynïap ; ka kynhun baroh kawei kan lynthem maw ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Ia uta u briew yn pyniap: ka jingiaseng baroh kan pyniap ia u da ki maw shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah .

en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures . And this was their appearance  ; they had the likeness of a man .
kha: Hamar pdeng jong kata ka  erïong , nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba i kum ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka dur ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh na pdeng jong ka la mih ka dur jong ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba im . Bad kane ka la long ka dur jong ki; ki don ka dur jong u briew .

en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counsellor , they cast lots  ; and his lot came out northward .
kha: U Shelemaïah u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang mihngi , bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u , u briew uba ai ki jingmut kiba bha na ka por sha ka por , u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lot shaphang mihngi ka la hap ha u Sheemaiah . Nangta na ka bynta u Skharaiah u khun jong u, u nongai jingmut uba stad, ki la thep vote ; bad ka bhah jong u ka la mih shaphang shathie .

en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
kha: Ka Miriam ka la rwai na ka bynta jong ki :  To rwai ha U  Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong jong ki sha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Miriam u la jubab ia ki: To rwai ia U Trai, namar u la jop da ka burom ia u kulai bad u nongshong kulai jong u u la bret shapoh duriaw .

en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites , which dwelt in Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei :
kha: hadien ba U  Trai  u la jop ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba shong ha Heshbon , bad ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , uba synshar ha ki shnong Ashtaroth bad Edrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba u la pyniap ia u syiem ki Amorites uba shong ha Heshbon bad u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan uba shong ha Ashtaroth ha Edrei:

en: And he said , Behold , I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation : for at the time appointed the end shall be .
kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pyn-i ha me ïa kaei kaba mih na ka jingbitar U Blei kan long . Ka jingïohipaw ka kdew ïa ka por jong ka jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ha khmih , ngan pyntip ia me kaei kaba ha kaba kut jong ka jingbitar: namar ha ka por ba la buh ka jingkut kan long .

en: And he went up thence to Penuel , and spake unto them likewise : and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .
kha: U Gideon u la leit sha Penuel bad u la kyrpad kumjuh ïa ki briew kiba hangta , hynrei ki briew jong ka Penuel ki la ai kajuh ka jubab kum ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit shaneng nangta sha Penuel bad u la kren ia ki kumjuh: bad ki briew jong ka Penuel ki la jubab ia u kumba ki briew jong ka Sucot ki la jubab ia u .

en: And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u da kyrkhu shisha ïa ka Hannah , bad ka ïoh sa lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad ar ngut ki khun kynthei . Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san ha kaba shakri ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leit jngoh ia ka Hannah, haduh ba ka la pun khun, bad ka la kha lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad arngut ki khun kynthei . Bad u khynnah Samuel u la san ha khmat U Trai .

en: Pilate therefore went forth again , and saith unto them , Behold , I bring him forth to you , that ye may know that I find no fault in him .
kha: U Pilat u la mih shabar sa shisien bad u la ong ha u paidbah ,  Ha khmih , ngan wallam shabar ïa u hangne ha phi ba phin lah ban ïohi ba ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u la leit noh biang shabar bad u la ong ha ki: Ha khmih nga wanrah ia u shabar ha phi, ba phin tip ba ngam shem jingbakla ei ei ha u .

en: Make ye him drunken : for he magnified himself against the  Lord  : Moab also shall wallow in his vomit , and he also shall be in derision .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pynbuaid ïa ka Moab , namar ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ka Moab kan syntuid ha la ka prie , bad ki briew kin rkhie .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia u uba la dih kyiad: namar u la pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia U Trai: U Moab ruh un sa rkhie bein ia ka jingsma jong u, bad u ruh un sa rkhie bein ia u .

en: Arise , get thee to Zarephath , which belongeth to Zidon , and dwell there : behold , I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee .
kha: Khie leit mynta sha ka shnong Sarephath , hajan Sidon , bad sah hangta . Nga la hukum ïa kawei ka riewkynthei hangta ban bsa ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, to poi sha ka Saparphath, kaba dei ka jong u Sidon, bad to shong hangta: ha khmih nga la hukum ia ka kynthei kaba la duh noh hangta ban pynneh pynsah ia me .

en: So the people of Nineveh believed God , and proclaimed a fast , and put on sackcloth , from the greatest of them even to the least of them .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Ninebeh ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor U Blei . Kumta ki la ïa-rai ba baroh ki dei ban shahjingit , bad ba baroh ki briew , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam , ban phong jaiñ khain ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew jong u Ninebe ki la ngeit ia U Blei, bad ki la pynbna ia ka jingstet, bad ki la phong da ka jain lyngkhuid, naduh kiba khraw tam na ki wat haduh kiba rit tam na ki .

en: Unstable as water , thou shalt not excel  ; because thou wentest up to thy father s bed  ; then defiledst thou it : he went up to my couch .
kha: Me long kum ka umbah kaba shlei . Hynrei men ym ïoh ïa ka kyrdan bapawkhmat tam , Naba me la ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad me la pynjahburom ïa ka jingthiah u kpa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bym skhem kum ka um, wat nym nang bha shuh shuh namar ba me la leit sha ka jingthiah jong u kpa jong me shuh shuh: u la leit sha ka shuki jong nga .

en: They shall not dwell in thy land , lest they make thee sin against me : for if thou serve their gods , it will surely be a snare unto thee .
kha: Wat shah ba kita ki briew kin shong kin sah ha ka ri jong phi ; lada phi leh kumta , kin pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga . Lada phi mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kan long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap duh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym shong ha ka ri jong me , ioh kin pynlong ia me ban leh pop pyrshah ia nga: namar lada me shakri ia ki blei jong ki , kan long shisha ka jingma ia me .

en: And the  Lord  came , and stood , and called as at other times , Samuel , Samuel . Then Samuel answered , Speak  ; for thy servant heareth .
kha: Te U  Trai  u wan bad u ïeng hangta , bad u khot kum mynshuwa ,  Samuel ! Ko Samuel !  U Samuel u jubab ,  To kren ; u shakri jong me u shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wan, bad u la ieng, bad u la khot kumba ju long ha kiwei pat ki por, u Samuel . Nangta u Samuel u la jubab: Kren; namar u shakri jong me u iohsngew .

en: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .
kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pat , bad la thoh ïa kine kum ka jingmaham ïa ngi . Naba ngi im ha ka por ba kaba kut ka la jan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki na ka bynta ki nuksa: bad la thoh ia ki na ka bynta ka jingsneng jong ngi , ha kiba ki kut jong ka pyrthei ki wan .

en: Now the Government of India has launched the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme for all old aged persons below the poverty line .
kha: Mynta ka sorkar India ka la sdang ia ka Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme na ka bynta baroh ki tymmen kiba don hapoh u lain jong ka jingduk .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka Sorkar India ka la sdang ia ka Indira Gandhi National Old Age Scheme na ka bynta baroh ki tymmen kiba don hapoh u lain jong ka jingduk .

en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .
kha: Haba phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai ban bam haduh ba phin da ot ïa u jingthung ha kata ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bet ia u soh uba phra snem bad phin bam ia u soh uba la rim haduh ka snem kaba hynniew haduh ba ki soh jong ka kin wan rung phi bam na ka dukan kaba rim .

en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .
kha: Bad ma ngi da lade ngi tip bad ngeit ïa ka jingieit kaba U Blei u don na ka bynta jong ngi . U Blei u long ka jingieit , bad uno uno uba im ha ka jingieit , u im bad U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la ithuh bad ngeit ia ka jingieit kaba U Blei u don ha ngi . U Blei u long ka jingieit ; bad uta uba shong ha ka jingieit u shong ha U Blei , bad U Blei ha u .

en: And now I say unto you , Refrain from these men , and let them alone : for if this counsel or this work be of men , it will come to nought :
kha: Bad kumta ïa kane ka kam , nga ong ha phi , wat leh kano kano pyrshah ïa kine ki briew . Ieh ïa ki ! Lada kaei kaba ki la thmu bad leh ka long na ka jingleh briew , kan jah noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga ong ha phi , To kiar na kine ki briew , bad to ai ba kin sah marwei: namar lada kane ka jingmut ne kane ka kam ka long na ki briew , kan sa wan sha ka jingbym don:

en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth–el , and taught them how they should fear the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u lyngdoh ki Israel ïa uba la phah pat na Samaria u la leit bad shong ha Bethel , ha kaba u hikai ïa ki briew kumno ban mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uwei na ki lyngdoh uba ki la rah noh na Samaria u la wan shong ha Betel bad u la hikai ia ki kumno ki dei ban sheptieng ia U Trai .

en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children , whom I love in the truth  ; and not I only , but also all they that have known the truth  ;
kha: Na u Nongsharai Balang    — Sha ka Kynthei badonburom bad sha ki khun jong ka , ïa kiba nga ieit da shisha . Bad ym dei tang ma nga hi , hynrei baroh kiba tip ïa ka jingshisha ki ieit ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah ha ka kynthei ba la jied bad ki khun jong ka, kiba nga ieit ha ka jingshisha ; bad ym tang ma nga hi hynrei wat ia kita baroh kiba la tip ia ka jingshisha ; .

en: But though we , or an angel from heaven , preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you , let him be accursed .
kha: Hynrei wat lada ma ngi ne u angel na bneng kin ïalap ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata ïa kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok!
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat la ngi ne u angel na bneng ngi ialap ia kawei pat ka gospel ha phi ban ia kata kaba ngi la ialap ha phi , to ai ba un shah tim .

en: After that he poureth water into a basin , and began to wash the disciples  feet , and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded .
kha: Nangta u la theh khyndiat ka um ha ka dabor bad u la sdang ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki synran bad ñiad pynrkhiang ïa ki da kata ka jaiñ ñiad ba la teh ha la ka syngkai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la theh um ha ka umphniang , bad u la sdang ban sait ia ki kjat jong ki synran bad ban sait ia ki da ka jainkup kaba u la pyndonkam da ka .

en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure  ; but he for our profit , that we might be partakers of his holiness .
kha: Ki kpa jong ngi ki sneng sympat ïa ngi tang shipor , katba ki sngewbit ma ki , hynrei U Blei u leh ïa kata na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi hi , khnang ba ngin ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingkhuid jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynshitom shisha katto katne sngi ia ngi katkum ka jingsngewbha jong ki hi; hynrei ma u na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ngi, ba ngin long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka jingkhuid jong u .

en: And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .
kha: Lada u briew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jong u , baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pynkheiñ burom ïa la u hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew un shim ia ka tnga jong u hynmen jong u, ka long kaba khlem khuid: u la pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u hynmen jong u; kin long ki bym don khun .

en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .
kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka khyndew da ka bor jong u ; da la ka jingstad u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynïar ïa ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thaw ia ka khyndew da ka bor jong u, u la pynskhem ia ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u, bad u la pynjrong ia ka bneng da ka jingsngewthuh jong u .

en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head : for that is even all one as if she were shaven .
kha: Bad kano kano ka briew kaba duwai ne pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane Blei lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh ka pynjahburom ïa la u tnga ; kam don jingïapher hapdeng jong ka bad ka briew kaba la khi noh ïa la ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kaba duwai ne kaba iathuhlypa da ka khlieh jong ka ka pynjah burom ia ka khlieh jong ka: namar kata ka long wat kum ba ka la shah ot .

en: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels  ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .
kha: Kin long kum ki angel bad kim lah ban ïap . Ki long ki khun jong U Blei , naba ki la mihpat na kaba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim lah ruh ban iap shuh: namar ki long kiba iaryngkat bad ki angel ; bad ki long ki khun U Blei , ki long ki khun jong ka jingmihpat .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me  ; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me .
kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha , uno uno uba pdiang ïa uno uno uba nga phah , u pdiang ïa nga ruh ; bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa nga , u pdiang ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Uta uba pdiang ia uno uno uba nga phah u pdiang ia nga ; bad uta uba pdiang ia nga u pdiang ia uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: How can it be quiet , seeing the  Lord  hath given it a charge against Ashkelon , and against the sea shore ? there hath he appointed it .
kha: Kumno ka lah ban shongthait , haba nga la ai kam ïa ka ban leh ? Nga la hukum ïa ka ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashkelon bad ïa ki briew kiba sah ha ki rud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ka lah ban long kaba sngap jar, haba u Trai u la ai ia ka ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ia u Ashkelon bad pyrshah ia ka rud duriaw ? hangta u la buh ia ka .

en: With pollution in the city reaching alarming levels , the administration has announced the temporary closure of all schools in the capital .
kha: Da ka jingjaboh ha ka nongbah kaba la poi sha ka kyrdan kaba shyrkhei , ka bor synshar ka la pynbna ban khang shipor ia baroh ki skul ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingjaboh ha ka nongbah kaba poi sha ka kyrdan kaba shyrkhei , ka bor synshar ka la pynbna ia ka jingkhang shipor ia baroh ki skul ha ka nongbah .

en: And Pharaoh charged all his people , saying , Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river , and every daughter ye shall save alive .
kha: Khatduh eh , uta u syiem u hukum ïa ki briew jong u baroh ,  Shim ïa u khunlung Hebru baroh uba dang shu lah kha bad bret ïa u sha wah Nile , hynrei ai ba ki khun kynthei kin im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la kynnoh ia ki briew jong u baroh, u da ong: Uwei pa uwei u khun shynrang uba la kha phin bret ha ka wah bad kawei pa kawei ka khun kynthei phin pynim im .

en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land , and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .
kha: bad kam shym lehrain satia . Ka la pyntngit ïa ka ri , bad ka la leh awria da kaba mane ïa ki maw bad ki dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la iaid lyngba ka jingshai jong ka jingkhaii met jong ka, ba ka la pynjakhlia ia ka ri, bad ka la leh ia ka kam sniew da ki maw bad da ki dieng .

en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ngam don pisa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga don : Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth nga hukum ïa me ban ïeng joit bad ïaid !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong: Ka rong bad ka ksiar ngam don shuh hynrei kumba nga la ai ia me: Ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist na Nazareth to kiew bad iaid .

en: I create the fruit of the lips  ; Peace , peace to him that is far off , and to him that is near , saith the  Lord   ; and I will heal him .
kha: Nga ai jingsuk ïa baroh , ïa kiba hajan bad ïa kiba sha jngai ! Ngan pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga thaw ia u soh jong ki rmiang shyntur ; Ka jingsuk ha uta uba jngai bad ha uta uba don hajan , ong U Trai ; bad ngan pynkoit ia u .

en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .
kha: Namarkata phi dei ban pynmih ki hukum ba kito ki rangbah kin sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah haduh ba ngan da ai hukum da kumwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai mynta ia ka hukum ban pynlong ia kine ki briew ban sangeh noh bad ba kane ka shnong kan ym tei , haduh ba yn da ai sa kawei pat ka hukum na nga .

en: For David , after he had served his own generation by the will of God , fell on sleep , and was laid unto his fathers , and saw corruption :
kha: Naba u Dabid u la shakri ïa ki jingthmu jong U Blei ha ka por jong u ; bad nangta u la ïap , la tep ïa u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad ka met jong u ka la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Dabid hadien ba u la shakri ia la ka jong ka pateng da ka mon U Blei, u la iohthiah bad la buh ia u ha ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad u la iohi ia ka jingbamsap:

en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,
kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad baroh kiba synran ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki Saddusi na kata ka jaka , ki la bishni shikatdei eh ïa ki apostol ; kumta ki la kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah lyngdoh u la ieng , bad baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u , (ka long ka kynhun jong ki Sadusies , ) bad ki la dap da ka jingbitar .

en: If grapegatherers come to thee , would they not leave some gleaning grapes ? if thieves by night , they will destroy till they have enough .
kha: Haba ki briew ki kheit sohwaiñ , ki ieh de katto katne halor dieng , bad haba ki nonglute ki wan mynmiet , ki shim tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki nongrep ki wan sha me , hato kin ym iehnoh katto katne ki sohjew kiba rben ? lada ki nongtuh ha ka por miet , kin pynjot haduh ba kin da biang .

en: ▪ PRACTICES LOVE : True worshippers are “no part of the world ,” are not divided by race or culture , and display ‘ love among themselves .’
kha: ▪ KA PYNI IA KA JINGIEID : Ki nongmane bashisha kim “long na ka jong ka pyrthei ,” ym shym la phiah ia ki da ka jait ne ka dustur , bad ki pynpaw ba ki ‘ don ka jingioieit paralok hapdeng jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: ▪ KA JINGPYNBNA: Ki nongmane bashisha ki long no ka bynta jong ka pyrthei ,  ym shym la phiah da ka jaitbynriew ne ka kolshor , bad ki pyni  ka jingieit hapdeng jong ki .

en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend , and them which do iniquity  ;
kha: U Khun U Briew un phah ïa la ki angel ba lumlang napoh ka Hima jong u ïa kito baroh kiba pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ban leh pop bad ïa baroh kiwei pat kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Khun u briew un phah ia ki angel jong u, bad kin lum na ka hima jong u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba pynsngewsih, bad ia kiba leh ia ka jingbymhok ; .

en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell : and great was the fall of it .
kha: U slap u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing , bad ka la khyllem . Bad katno ka jingkhyllem bashyrkhei ka la long !
translated_en_to_kha: U slap u la hiar, bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan, bad ki Iyer ki la beh ia kata ka iing ; bad ka la hap: bad ka la long kaba khraw ia ka jinghap jong ka .

en: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister , the daughter of his father , or the daughter of his mother . And all the people shall say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka para ne bad la ka para ar kmie .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia uta uba shong bad ka para jong u, ka khun jong u kpa jong u ne ka khun jong ka kmie jong u . Bad ki briew baroh kin ong: Amen .

en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him reviled him .
kha: To ngin ïakhmih ïa U Messaïah , u syiem ki Israel , un hiar na ka diengphna mynta , bad ngin ngeit ha u !  Bad kita ki ar ngut kiba la shah sahnarphna bad U Jisu , ki la krenbeiñ ruh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba U Khrist U Syiem Israel un hiar mynta na ka diengphna , ba ngin iohi bad ngeit . Bad kita kiba la sahnarphna bad u ki la kren bein ia u .

en: My lord , hearken unto me : the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver  ; what is that betwixt me and thee ? bury therefore thy dead .
kha: Ko rangbah , ka khyndew ka shongdor tang sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa — kan long aïu kata hapdeng jong ngi ? To tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong nga, to sngap ia nga: ka ri ka long kaba kordor saw spah Shekel rupa ; kaei kata kaba la buh ia nga bad ia me ? tep namarkata ia kiba iap jong me .

en: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee  ;
kha: Ha kaba khatduh , ka Herodias ka la ïoh ïa ka kabu jong ka . Ka dei ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , mynba la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan ha ka jingsynshar jong u , ki Rangbah shipai , bad ki nongshong shnong bapawkhmat jong ka Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sngi kaba suk ka la poi , ba u Herod ha ka sngi kha jong u u la ai jingbam janmiet ia ki kynrad jong u, ki rangbah shipai bad ki jaka ba ha khlieh duh jong ka Galilaia;

en: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin  ; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah .
kha: Ki leit ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin , bad ki pynïeng ïa ki shipai marpyrshah kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la leit sha ka thma pyrshah ia u Benjamin ; bad ki briew Israel ki la buh ia lade ha ka kynhun ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki ha Gibeah .

en: The  Lord  thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee , of thy brethren , like unto me  ; unto him ye shall hearken  ;
kha: Un phah ha phi napdeng jong phi hi ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma nga , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong me un pynmih ha me ia u Nongiathuhlypa na pdeng jong me, na ki hynmen jong me, kumba ha nga; ha u phin sngap;

en: ( Proverbs 6 :27-29 , 32 ) Wisely , therefore , the Bible urges : “Be happy with your wife and find your joy with the girl you married . . .
kha: Ka jingklim bunsien ka pynjot ia ka longing longsem . —Proberb 6 :27-29 , 32 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Ki Proberb 6 :27-29 , 32 ) Da ka jingstad, namarkata, ka Baibl ka kyntu:  To sngewbha bad ka tnga jong phi bad to shem ia ka jingkmen jong phi bad ka khynnah kynthei kaba phi la shongkurim . . .

en: If ye forsake the  Lord  , and serve strange gods , then he will turn and do you hurt , and consume you , after that he hath done you good .
kha: Um lah ban shah ïa kiwei pat kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad u , bad lada phi iehnoh ïa u ban shakri ïa ki blei nongwei , un phai pyrshah ïa phi bad un pynshitom ïa phi . Un pynjot thiaw ïa phi , wat la u long uba bha ïa phi mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi iehnoh ia U Trai , bad phi shakri ia ki blei nongwei , te un phai bad un pynmong ia phi , bad un bam ia phi hadien ba u la leh bha ia phi .

en: Then answered I , and said unto him , What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof ?
kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u diengpynïeng sharak ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la jubab ia u , bad nga la ong ha u , Kiei kine ki ar tylli ki dieng olive ha ka liang kadiang jong ka sharak bad ha ka liang kadiang jong ka ?

en: And they found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he did eat  ; and they made him drink water  ;
kha: Kita ki briew kiba leit bad u Dabid ki lap ïa uwei u khynnah Ijipt ha lum , bad ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Dabid . Ki ai ha u ïa u kpu ban bam bad ka um ban dih ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shem ia u nong Ijipt ha lyngkha bad ki la wanrah ia u ha u Dabid bad ki la ai kpu ia u, bad u la bam ; bad ki la pynlong ia u ban dih um ; .

en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars , and maketh diviners mad  ; that turneth wise men backward , and maketh their knowledge foolish  ;
kha: Nga pynpaw bieit ïa ki nongpeit kti bad pynkulmar ïa ki jingïathuh lypa ki nongbatai kupar . Ki ktien jong kiba stad nga kyntait bad pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong ki ka long ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pynsngewsih ia ki dak jong ki nonglamler , bad ka pynlong ia ki nongleh jadu ban sngewsih ; kiba pynphai biang ia ki briew kiba stad shadien , bad ka pynlong ia ka jingtip jong ki kaba bieit ; .

en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïathuh ïa u syiem bad ïa ka kmie jong u ban wan hiar na ki khet jong ki , namar ba ki pansngiat ba-itynnat jong ki , ki la hap noh na ki khlieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ha u syiem bad ha ka mahadei, To pynjah burom ia lade, to shong: namar ki hima jong phi kin hiar, wat ka khlieh jong ka burom jong phi ruh .

en: Which when Jesus perceived , he said unto them ,  O ye of little faith , why reason ye among yourselves , because ye have brought no bread ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phi ïakren para ma phi shaphang ka jingbymdon jingbam ei ei ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba haba U Jisu u la sngewthuh , u la ong ha ki , Ko phi kiba duna ka jingngeit , balei phi pyrkhat hapdeng jong phi , namar ba phim shym la wanrah kpu ?

en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , Even that which they build , if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .
kha: U Tobiah uba ïeng hangta hajan jong u , u ong shuh shuh ,  Kaba kum kano ka kynroh ki lah ban tei ? Wat u myrsiang u lah ban pynpra ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: U Tobiah u Ammon u la don hajan jong u, bad u la ong, Wat ia kata kaba ki tei, lada u blang u kiew shaneng, un pynpra wat ia ka kynroh maw jong ki .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God  , My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there  ; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause .
kha: Haba phi la leit ban shong ha Ijipt kum ki nongwei , phi la leh ïa kata ha la ka jong ka mon hi ; ka Assyria , pynban , ka la shim jubor ïa phi khlem siewdor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei u la leit hiar sha Ijipt ban leit sah hangta bad ka Assyria ka la pynshitom bein ia ki khlem daw .

en: Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house  ; and I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , saith the  Lord .
kha: Mynta to leit kiew sha ki lumrit , pynïoh ïa ki dieng shna ïing , bad tei pat ïa ka Templ ; te ngan sngewbha ha ka bad ïa nga yn mane kumba ka dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha u lum , bad wanrah dieng , bad ngan tei ia ka iing ; bad ngan sngewbha ha ka , bad ngan sa shah pyndonburom , ong U Trai .

en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–serah , which is in mount Ephraim , on the north side of the hill of Gaash .
kha: Ki la tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath Serah ha ka ri lum Ephraim , ha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Gaash .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tep ia u ha u pud u sam jong ka pateng jong u ha Timnathserah kaba don ha u lum Ephram , ha ka liang mihngi jong u lum Gaash .

en: When he therefore was come up again , and had broken bread , and eaten , and talked a long while , even till break of day , so he departed .
kha: Nangta u la leit pat shajrong , u la kdiah kpu , bad u la bam . Hadien ba u la ïakren slem bad ki haduh ban da mih ka sngi , u Paul u leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la wan biang, bad u la bam bad u la kren slem, wat haduh ban da sdang ka sngi, kumta u la leit noh .

en: But who may abide the day of his coming ? and who shall stand when he appeareth ? for he is like a refiner s fire , and like fullers  soap :
kha: Hynrei uei uba lah ban ïai ap ïa ka sngi haba un wan ? Uei uba lah ban lait im haba un paw ? Un long kum ka sabon basboh bha , kum ka ding kaba phrang ïa ka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mano ba lah ban shah ia ka sngi jong ka jingwan jong u ? bad mano ba ieng haba u paw ? namar u long kum ka ding kaba kham jem bad kum ka sabon kaba kham pura:

en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :
kha: Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba lait na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan don ia phi khlem da pyrkhat . Uta u bym pat shongkurim u sumar ia kiei kiei kiba dei jong U Trai , kumno u lah ban pynsngewbha ia U Trai:

en: The petitioner , social activist ND Jaya Prakash , pleaded for a directive to the Delhi Police to ensure order at the trial courts complex .
kha: U nongmudui , u nongïakhih ha ka imlang sahlang u ND Jaya Prakash u la kyrpad ïa ka jingbthah sha ki pulit jong ka Delhi ban pynthikna ïa ka jingsuk ha ka jaka bishar jong ki ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongmudui , u nongïakhih ha ka imlang sahlang u ND Jaya Prakash , u la kyrpad ïa ka jingbthah sha ki Pulit ka Delhi ban pynthikna ïa ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki ïingbishar ba nyngkong .

en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei lah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingringdur : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khun la kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka long ka Hagar , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jutang ba la pynlong halor u lum Sinai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei kiba long ka jingiathuhkhana: namar kine ki long ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kata na u lum Sinai, kaba iadei bad ka jinglong mraw, kaba long Agar .

en: And they shall come from the east , and from the west , and from the north , and from the south , and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .
kha: Ki briew kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi , na shatei bad na shathie , bad shong ha ka jingkhawai ha ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin wan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad na shaphang shathie bad kin shong ha ka hima U Blei .

en: Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;
kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki krem bad sha ki jaka tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang bad ki dih ïa ka syrwa ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba sah hapdeng ki jingtep , bad ka shong ha ki jingtei , kaba bam ia ka doh sniang , bad ka umsoh jong kiei kiei kiba sngewsih ka don ha ki umphniang jong ki ; .

en: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah , and took them .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Hesekaïah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah bad ki jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Hesekaiah u la wan hiar thma ia ki shnong ba la ker sawdong jong ka Judah baroh .

en: They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .
kha: Ki jingkñia ainguh , ki jingkñia pop bad ki jingkñia na ka bynta ban siew pat , kin long ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh , bad ki kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin bam ia ka jingainguh doh bad ka jingainguh pop bad ka jingainguh kaba la pynkyntang ha Israel kan long ka jong ki .

en: Now when they were going , behold , some of the watch came into the city , and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done .
kha: Katba ki kynthei ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki shipai kiba ap phira ïa ka jingtep ki la leit phai pat sha ka nongbah bad ki la ïathuh ha ki rangbah lyngdoh ïa baroh kaba la lah jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki dang leit, ha khmih katto katne na ki nongap ki la wan shapoh shnong bad ki la pyni ha ki rangbah lyngdoh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh .

en: And the mother of the child said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And he arose , and followed her .
kha: Kata ka kynthei ka ong ha u Elisha ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi !  Kumta baroh ar ngut ki la ïamih lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kmie jong u khynnah ka la ong: Kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ngan ym iehnoh ia me . U la ieng bad u la bud ia ka .

en: And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan da kaba bah ha ka jingthiah ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , bad ki la pyrshang ban rah ïa u shapoh ïing bad ban buh ha khmat jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki briew ki la wanrah ha ka jingthiah ia u briew uba la shah rah da ka jingpang: bad ki la wad lad ban wanrah ia u shapoh bad ban thiah ia u ha khmat jong u .

en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him , so that he went into a ship , and sat  ; and the whole multitude stood on the shore .
kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki la bun katta katta haduh ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka , katba ki paidbah ki la ïeng harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah kiba bun ki la ialum lang ha u , haduh ba u la leit shapoh ka lieng , bad u la shong ; bad u paidbah baroh u la ieng ha rud duriaw .

en: They are all hot as an oven , and have devoured their judges  ; all their kings are fallen : there is none among them that calleth unto me .
kha: Ha ka jingkhluit ka jingbitar jong ki , ki pynïap ïa la ki nongsynshar . Ki syiem jong ki , ki shah pynïap uwei hadien uwei , hynrei ym don na ki uba khot kyrpad ïa nga ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki long kiba shit kum ka oven , bad ki la bam ia ki nongbishar jong ki baroh ki syiem jong ki ki la hap: ym don uwei ruh napdeng jong ki uba khot ia nga .

en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .
kha: Hynrei ki la ïa-ban kham jur shuh shuh ,  Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki briew ha baroh kylleng ka Judia . U la sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kham shyrkhei, ki da ong, U pynkhih ia ki briew, u hikai ha kylleng ka ri Judaea baroh kawei, naduh Galilaia haduh kane ka jaka .

en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene , which , when they were come to Antioch , spake unto the Greeks , preaching the Lord Jesus .
kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki parabangeit , kiba na Sypros bad Kyrini , ki la leit sha Antiokh bad ki la pynbna ïa ka khubor ha ki Jentil ruh , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Trai Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don napdeng jong ki ki briew kiba na Kypros bad Cyrene, kiba haba ki la poi ha Antiok ki la kren ha ki Grik ki da ialap ia U Trai Jisu .

en: For who is there of all flesh , that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire , as we have , and lived ?
kha: Ju don mo u briew uba dang im hadien ba u la ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba im ba u kren napdeng ka ding ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba don ha ka doh baroh , kiba la iohsngew ia ka sur U Blei uba im uba kren na pdeng ka ding kumba ngi la im ?
