en: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office ,
kha: ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin pyndonkam haba ki shakri kum ki lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jain jingshakri bad ki jain kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ki jain ki nep jong u ban shakri ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .
kha: Mynta , wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga bitar ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba ngan marwei, ba ka jingbitar jong nga kan nang jur pyrshah ia ki, bad ba ngan bam ia ki: bad ngan pynlong ia me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki para lem bad kita baroh kiba leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la leit phai noh sha Ijipt, ma u bad ki hynmen jong u bad baroh kiba la leit sha jrong bad u ban tep ia la u kpa hadien ba u la tep ia la u kpa .

en: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests , and an holy nation . These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel .
kha: ka jaitbynriew ba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad phin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin long ha nga ka hima lyngdoh bad ka jaitbynriew bakhuid . Kine ki long ki ktien kiba me kren ha ki khun Israel .

en: Yea , a man may say , Thou hast faith , and I have works : shew me thy faith without thy works , and I will shew thee my faith by my works .
kha: Hynrei don u ban ong ,  Uwei u briew u don ka jingngeit , uwei pat u don da ki kam .  Ka jubab jong nga ka long  To pyn-i ha nga kumno uno uno u lah ban don ka jingngeit khlem ki kam . Ngan sa pyn-i ïa phi ïa ka jingngeit jong nga da ki kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, u briew u lah ban ong, Me don ka jingngeit, bad nga don ki kam: pyni ia nga ia ka jingngeit jong me khlem ki kam jong me, bad ngan pyni ia me ia ka jingngeit jong nga da ki kam jong nga .

en: By these three was the third part of men killed , by the fire , and by the smoke , and by the brimstone , which issued out of their mouths .
kha: Shi bynta na ki lai bynta jong u bynriew la pynïap da kito ki lai tylli ki jingïapthem : Ka ding , ka tdem , bad u kyndok kiba mihnoh na ki shyntur jong ki kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kine ki lai ngut ki briew ki la shah pyniap, da ka ding bad da ka tdem, bad da u mawsiang uba la mih na ka shyntur jong ki .

en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .
kha: kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la shong slem . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ym da donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba rim ha ka sniehdoh jong u, bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long u bymkhuid: namar u long u bymkhuid .

en: And Micaiah said , If thou return at all in peace , the  Lord  hath not spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , O people , every one of you .
kha: Lada me wan phai da kaba suk ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren keiñ da nga !  bad u la bynrap ,  Shahshkor , uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba nga la kren !
translated_en_to_kha: U Mikaiah u la ong , Lada me wan phai noh satia ha ka jingsuk, U Trai um shym la kren da nga . Bad u la ong: To sngap ko briew, iwei ia iwei .

en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .
kha: Hato ki jingri jong ki bad baroh kaba ki don , kin ym long ki jong ngi ? To ngin ïamynjur ba ki lah ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki masi jong ki bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki bad ki mrad jong ki kin long ki jong ngi ? tangba to ngin ia mynjur bad ki , bad kin shong bad ngi .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy son liveth .  And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Khie leit , u khun jong me un im !  Uta u briew u la ngeit ïa ki ktien U Jisu bad u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u, To leit noh ia ka lynti jong me. Bad uta u briew u la ngeit ia ka ktien ba U Jisu u la kren ha u, bad u la leit noh .

en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .
kha: U Gideon u ïaid na ka lynti na ki tduh jong ka ri shyiap , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nobah bad ka Jogbehah , bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kaba kim shym poi pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la leit sha jrong da ka lynti jong ki kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ shaphang mihngi jong u Nobah bad u Jogbehah: namar ka kynhun ka la shngain .

en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
kha: Thaw ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong bad pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynlong ia ka ha u pud u sam jong ka kti sawdong sawdong , bad men shna ia ka khlieh ksiar sawdong .

en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David , and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .
kha: Ki Israel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid ; ka long ka jingshahjop kaba sngewshyrkhei , ha kaba la pynïap arphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki briew Israel ki la shah pyniap ha khmat ki shakri u Dabid , bad ka la don ka jingpyniap kaba khraw ha kata ka sngi kaba arphew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge , that I may go out and come in before this people : for who can judge this thy people , that is so great ?
kha: Lym kumta , kumno ngan lah ban synshar ïa une u paidlang uba khraw jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ai mynta ia nga ia ka jingstad bad ka jingtip , ba ngan mih bad wan rung ha khmat une u briew: namar mano ba lah ban bishar ia kane ka jaitbynriew jong me kaba khraw ?

en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :
kha: Nangta ki nongïalam baroh na kata ka shnong kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki rangbah baroh jong kata ka shnong kiba don hajan u briew uba la shah pyniap kin sait ia ki kti jong ki halor ka masi kaba la khlieh khlieh ha ka them:

en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , phin ym ïohrung da lei lei shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Lait noh tang ba phin kylla bad kylla long kum ki khynnah rit , phin ym rung sha ka hima bneng .

en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jia long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi iaid baroh kum ki bear, bad ngi iam kum ki paro: ngi wad ia ka jingbishar, hynrei ym don shuh shuh ka jingpynim, hynrei ka long kaba jngai na ngi .

en: Several Congress and JDS MLAs have resigned in the past weeks which have put a big question mark on the future of the Karnataka government .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki MLA ka Congress bad ka JDS ki la iehnoh kam ha kine ki taiew ba la dep kaba la buh ia ka dak jingkylli kaba khraw halor ka lawei jong ka sorkar Karnataka .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ngut ki MLA ka Congress bad ka JDS ki la hiar shuki ha ki taiew ba la dep kiba la buh ia ka dak jingkylli kaba khraw ha ka lawei jong ka sorkar Karnataka .

en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel , saying , Beware that thou pass not such a place  ; for thither the Syrians are come down .
kha: Hynrei u Elisha u phah ktien sha u syiem ka Israel , da kaba maham ïa u ban ym leit sha jan kata ka jaka , namar ba ki Syria ki ap ktem hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew jong U Blei u la phah sha u syiem Israel, u da ong: To tip ba me ym iaid lait ia kata ka jaka ; namar ba ki Syria ki wan hiar .

en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
kha: Ngi tip ba ym don uno uno napdeng ki khun U Blei uba ïai leh pop , naba U Khun U Blei u sumar ïa u , bad u Basniew um lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi tip ba uno uno uba la kha na U Blei um ju leh pop shuh shuh hynrei uta uba la kha na U Blei u sumar ia lade , bad uta uba sniew um ktah ia u .

en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta ki la ïawan sha u Petros .  Da shisha me long uwei na ki ,  ki la ong .  Nalor baroh , ka rukom kren jong me ka pynpaw ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien katto katne por ki la wan sha u, bad ki la ong ha u Petros: Hooid me ruh me long uwei na ki ; namar ka jingkren jong me ka thoh ia me .

en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .
kha: Ynda u la ong ïa kane , u Paul u la shim katto katne u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la sdang ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren kumta, u la shim ia u kpu bad u la ainguh ia U Blei ha khmat jong ki baroh: bad ynda u la bthei ia u , u la sdang ban bam .

en: The Zidonians also , and the Amalekites , and the Maonites , did oppress you  ; and ye cried to me , and I delivered you out of their hand .
kha: Ki Sidon , ki Amalek , bad ki Maon ki la banbeiñ ïa phi ha ki por ba la leit ; bad phi la kyang jam sha nga . Hato ngam shym la pyllait im ïa phi na ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Sidonian ruh, bad ki Amalek bad ki Maon ki la pynshitom bein ia phi ; bad phi la pyrta ia nga , bad nga la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong ki .

en: Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .
kha: Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka long kaba ishyrkhei ; Bad long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar shla jong ki , Naba ka long kaba shyrkhei katta katta . Kylleng ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Bad hapdeng ki briew jong ka ngan pynsakma ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia ka jingbitar jong ki, namar ka la long kaba jur ; bad ka jingbitar jong ki: Ngan phiah ia ki ha u Jakob bad ngan pynphriang ia ki ha Israel .

en: And when Joseph came home , they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house , and bowed themselves to him to the earth .
kha: Ynda u Joseph u la wan sha ïing , ki leit rah sha u hapoh ïing ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , bad ki nguh ngon ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la wan phai sha iing , ki la wanrah ia u ia ka jingai sngewbha kaba don ha ka kti jong ki shapoh iing bad ki la dem khrup ha u sha khyndew .

en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .
kha: Baroh ki long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingisih jong ki , ka ing suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u  purew u lah long ban shet .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki long ki nongleh kam sniew, kum ka oven ba la pynkhluit da u nongshet kpu , uba sangeh noh ban mih hadien ba u la pynkhih ia ka doh , haduh ba kan da long kaba la pynkhluit .

en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .
kha: Ki wah ka Edom kin kylla um bsiang , bad ka khyndew kan kylla kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ing kum ka bsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wah jong ka kin kylla long ki mawlyngnai bad ka dewbilat jong ka kan kylla long ka dewbilat .

en: And unto Eber were born two sons : the name of one was Peleg  ; for in his days was the earth divided  ; and his brother s name was Joktan .
kha: U Eber u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang : ka kyrteng jong uwei ka long u Peleg , namar dei ha ki sngi jong u ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei , bad ka kyrteng jong u para jong u pat ka long u Joktan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u Eber la kha arngut ki khun shynrang: ka kyrteng jong uwei ka long u Peleg ; namar ha ki sngi jong u la phiah ia ka khyndew ; bad ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u ka long u Joktan .

en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
kha: U Baasha u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad u tei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah khnang ban ym shah ïa ka leit ka wan sha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Baasha u syiem Israel u la leit sha Judah bad u la tei ia u Rama , khnang ba un ym shah ia uno uno u briew ban leit shabar ne wan rung sha u syiem Judah .

en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
kha: U Jethro u la wan bad ka tnga jong u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka sha ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha u lum bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jethro u kpa jong u Moses u la wan ryngkat bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ka tnga jong u ha ka ri khlaw , ha kaba u la shong ha u lum U Blei:

en: And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried  ;
kha: U briew uba duk u la ïap bad la bah da ki angel ban shong hajan u Abraham ha ka jingkhawai ha bneng . U riewspah u la ïap bad la tep ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba u nongkyrpad u la iap, bad la rah ia u da ki angel ha ka kpoh u Abraham: uta u riewspah ruh u la iap, bad la tep ia u;

en: When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .
kha: Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh kiba ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me wan sha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me , wat nang ban leh hadien ki jingleh bymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew .

en: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it : and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it .
kha: Ki briew ka pyrthei kin ïaid ha ka jingshai jong ka , bad ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kin wallam ïa ka spah jong ki shapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew jong ki kiba la shah pynim kin iaid ha ka jingshai jong ka: bad ki syiem ka khyndew ki wanrah ia ka burom bad ka burom jong ki ha ka .

en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels  ; thou crownedst him with glory and honour , and didst set him over the works of thy hands :
kha: Me la pynlong ïa u khampoh khyndiat ban ïa ki angel , me la pynphong pansngiat ïa u da ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom , bad me la pynlong ïa u ban synshar halor kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynsngewsih ia u khyndiat kham duna ban ia ki angel ; me la pynkup burom ia u da ka burom bad ka burom , bad me la buh ia u halor ki kam jong ki kti jong me:

en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .
kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong nga hi — Ngan ym shah ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong nga bad ka jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong nga hi, wat na ka bynta jong nga hi, ngan leh ia kata: namar kumno ka kyrteng jong nga kan shah pynjakhlia ? bad ngan ym ai ia ka burom jong nga ha uwei pat .

en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money  ; for , behold , it was in his sack s mouth .
kha: Ha ka jaka ba ki ïasah miet , uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni ban ai bam ïa ka kada jong u , bad u lap ïa ka pisa jong u ha khlieh eh ka byrni .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba uwei na ki u dang plie ia ka tdong jong u ban ai ia ka tdong jong u ha ka inn, u la sngap jar ia ka pisa jong u ; namar, ha khmih, ka la don ha ka shyntur jong u.

en: On the morrow , as they went on their journey , and drew nigh unto the city , Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , katba ki dang don ha lynti bad ba ki la jan poi hajan Joppa , u Petros u la leit sha ka tnum jong ka ïing ha ka por shiteng sngi ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, katba ki dang iaid sha ka nongbah, u Petros u la kiew sha jrong ka iing ban duwai kumba hynriew kynta:

en: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean , and cedar wood , and scarlet , and hyssop :
kha: Lada kata ka jingpang ka la jem , u lyngdoh un hukum ba yn wanrah ar tylli ki sim ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid ryngkat bad uwei u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u  saiwul uba saw , bad uwei u tnat Hissop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban shim na ka bynta jong u ia kiba la pynkhuid ar tylli ki sim kiba im bad kiba khuid, bad u dieng cedar bad u dieng cedar bad u dieng cedar bad u dieng cedar:

en: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment  ; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver , and five changes of raiment .
kha: U ai ruh ha uwei pa uwei na ki mar shi riam ki jaiñ , hynrei ïa u Benjamin pat u ai laispah tylli ki sbai rupa bad san riam ki jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki baroh u la ai ia uwei pa uwei u jain rong stem ; hynrei ha u Benjamin u la ai lai spah tylli ki rupa bad san tylli ki jain rong .

en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish , and a ram out of the flock without blemish .
kha: Haba me la dep ban leh ïa kata , shim ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot lud , baroh ar na ki , ki bym don kino kino ki jingduna , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda me la pyndep ia ka , men aiti ia u masi khlem jingduna , bad u langbrot na ka kynhun khlem jingduna .

en: Then sought they for Jesus , and spake among themselves , as they stood in the temple , What think ye , that he will not come to the feast ?
kha: Ki la wad ïa U Jisu , bad katba ki dang ïalum ha ka Templ , ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei phi pyrkhat ? Ka long kaba thikna ba un ym wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam , hato un wan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wad ia U Jisu bad ki la ia kren hapdeng jong ki, katba ki dang ieng ha ka tempi , Phi tharai aiu ba un ym wan sha ka jingkhawai ?

en: Tremble , ye women that are at ease  ; be troubled , ye careless ones : strip you , and make you bare , and gird sackcloth upon your loins .
kha: Phi la ju im suk , phim don ki jingkhuslai ; hynrei mynta , to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ! To loit ïa la ki jaiñ bad teh da ki jaiñjot sawdong ïa la ka syngkai .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia phi, phi ki kynthei kiba suk ; to sngewsih, phi ki bym don jingkhuslai: to pynkhih ia phi, bad pynlong ia phi ban lyngkhuid, bad to pynkhih ia phi ha ki tyrpeng jong phi .

en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father  ; and he felt him , and said , The voice is Jacob s voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau .
kha: U Jakob u tur kham sha jan u kpa jong u , uba la ktah ïa u bad u ong ,  Ka sur te kum ka sur jong u Jakob , hynrei ki kti jong me pat ki long kum ki kti jong u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la leit shajan u kpa jong u; bad u la sngew ia u, bad u la ong: Ka sur ka long ka sur jong u Jakob , hynrei ki kti ki long ki kti jong u Iso .

en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
kha: Pynkup ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynsleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh ha u Aaron ia ki jain kyntang bad pynsleh ia u, bad pynkyntang ia u; ba un shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: And he will stretch out his hand against the north , and destroy Assyria  ; and will make Nineveh a desolation , and dry like a wilderness .
kha: U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u ban pynjot ïa ka Assyria . Un pynlong ïa ka nongbah Ninebeh ka jingjot ba la shah iehnoh , ka ri shyiap bym don um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynkhih ia la ka kti shaphang shathie, bad un pynjot ia ka Assyria bad un pynlong ia ka Ninebe ka ri kaba la jot , bad kan tyrkhong kum ka ri khlaw .

en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .
kha: Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki la ïohi ba u kpa jong ki u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba kim kren bha kren miat shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki hynmen jong u ki la iohi ba u kpa jong ki u ieit ia u kham palat ban ia ki hynmen jong u baroh , ki la shun ia u bad kim lah ban kren suk ia u .

en: And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .
kha: Nga don kajuh ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei kaba kine hi ki don , kata , ba ki briew baroh , kiba bha bad kiba sniew , kin mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei , kaba ma ki ruh ki ailad , ba kan don ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap , baroh ar kiba hok bad ki bym hok .

en: And Solomon s builders and Hiram s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers : so they prepared timber and stones to build the house .
kha: Ki nongtrei jong u Solomon bad jong u Hiram lem bad ki rangbah na ka nongbah Biblos ki la pynkhreh ïa ki maw bad ïa ki dieng ban shna ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongtei jong u Solomon bad ki nongtei jong u Hiram ki la pynkhih ia ki, bad ki maw: kumta ki la pynkhreh ia ki dieng bad ki maw ban tei ia ka iing .

en: They have made it desolate , and being desolate it mourneth unto me  ; the whole land is made desolate , because no man layeth it to heart .
kha: Ki la pynkylla ri khlaw ïa ka ; ka la long thylli ha khmat jong nga . Ka ri baroh kawei ka la kylla long ka ri shyiap , bad ym don mano mano ba salia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia ka ban jah rngai noh, bad ka la jah rngai noh ha nga baroh kawei ka ri ka la jah rngai noh, namar ym don mano mano ruh kiba buh ia ka ha ka dohnud .

en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece , from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner .
kha: U Binnui , u khun jong u Henadad u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , naduh ka ïing u Asaraïah haduh ka dong jong ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Binnui u khun u Hennadad sa kawei pat ka bynta, naduh ka iing u Azariah haduh ka jingkylla jong ka kynroh, haduh ka kut .

en: But Peter and John answered and said unto them , Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God , judge ye .
kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi hi bishar kano kaba dei ha khmat U Blei — ban kohnguh ïa phi ne ban kohnguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros bad u Ioannis ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha ki, La ka long kaba dei ha khmat U Blei ban sngap ia phi kham palat ban ia U Blei .

en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved , that goeth down sweetly , causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak .
kha: Hynrei nga ieit tang ïa kawei , bad ka long kaba i-ieit kum ka lyngdkhur . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong ka kmie , ka khun ba-ieit eh jong ka kmie . Baroh ki kynthei ki khmih ïa ka bad ki ïaroh ïa ka ; ki mahadei bad ki tnga kliar ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tnum jong ka shyntur jong me kum ka wain kaba bha tam na ka bynta u baieit jong nga, kaba hiar sngewbha, kaba pynlong ia ki rmiang shyntur jong kito kiba la iohthiah ban kren .

en: For it is written in the law of Moses , Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn . Doth God take care for oxen ?
kha: Ngi pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ,  Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u kew .  Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u masi dab ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses , Wat nym sngap jar ia ka shyntur jong u masi uba iaid shabar u kew . Hato U Blei u sumar ia ki masi ?

en: And the king said unto him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the  Lord  ?
kha: Hynrei u Ahab u jubab ,  Haba phi kren ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno sien ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u: Katno sien ngan sngewsih ia me ba me iathuh ei ei ia nga hynrei ia kata kaba shisha ha ka kyrteng U Trai ?

en: Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .
kha: shiphew tylli ki masi ba la bsa pynsngaid ha sem , arphew tylli ki masi bam phlang ha lum , bad shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki skei , ki khiat , ki  keirang , bad ki syiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Shiphew tylli ki masi kiba heh , bad arphew tylli ki masi na ki jaka ri jingri , bad shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki dohkha , bad ki blang kiba heh .

en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,
kha: Ngan long shlur bad ngan kren tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jentil ban kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktien bad ki kam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ym nud ban kren ia kiei kiei kiba U Khrist um shym la leh da nga, ban pynlong ia ki Jutang kiba kohnguh , da ka ktien bad ka kam .

en: And he dealt to every one of Israel , both man and woman , to every one a loaf of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .
kha: U ai ha uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel ïa u kpu bad ka dohthang bad katto katne ki soh Khajur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia uwei pa uwei na ki Israel, u shynrang bad ka kynthei, ha uwei pa uwei u kpu bad ka doh kaba bha bad ka rong wain .

en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread , and drink this cup of the Lord , unworthily , shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord .
kha: Kaba bud ka long , lada uno uno uba bam ïa u kpu lane dih na ka khuri jong U Trai ha ka rukom kaba pynjahburom ïa U , ma u ne ma ka ki long kiba la pynrem ha ka pop pyrshah ïa ka met bad ïa ka snam jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata uno uno u briew uba bam ia une u kpu bad uba dih ia kane ka khuri U Trai khlem da donkam , un long uba don pop ia ka met bad ka snam U Trai .

en: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall , he was wroth , and took great indignation , and mocked the Jews .
kha: Haba u Sanballat u ïohsngew ba ki Jiw ki la sdang ïa ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh , u la bitar bad u sdang ban krenbeiñ ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia ba haba u Sanballat u la iohsngew ba ngi la tei ia ka kynroh , u la bitar bad u la sngewsih shibun bad u la rkhie bein ia ki Jiw .

en: After this he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , and his brethren , and his disciples : and they continued there not many days .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu bad ka kmie jong u , ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki synran ki la leit sha Kapernam bad ki la sah hangta katto katne sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane u la leit hiar sha Kaparnaum, ma u bad ka kmie jong u bad ki hynmen jong u bad ki synran jong u: bad ki la bteng hangta ym bun sngi .

en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab , every one shall howl : for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn  ; surely they are stricken .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab kin lynñiar namar ki jingjynjar ba ki shah . Baroh kin ïam haba ki kynmaw ïa ka jingbam babha kaba ki ju bam ha ka nongbah jong ka Kir Heres . Yn beh ïa ki baroh sha ka jingduh jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Moab un iam na ka bynta u Moab, uwei pa uwei un iam: namar ki nongrim jong u Kirhareseth phin iam ; shisha ki la shah pynpra .

en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the  Lord  , that it is mighty : that ye might fear the  Lord  your God for ever .
kha: Namar kane , uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un tip haduh katno ka bor jong U  Trai  ka long kaba khraw , bad ba phin burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew kin tip ia ka kti U Trai, ba ka long kaba donbor: ba phin sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong phi junom .

en: Salute Andronicus and Junia , my kinsmen , and my fellowprisoners , who are of note among the apostles , who also were in Christ before me .
kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Andronikos bad ka Junias , ki para Jiw kiba la ïadon lang bad nga ha byndi ; ki long ïa kiba la ithuh bha hapdeng ki apostol , bad ki la long Khristan shuwa ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Andronik bad ka Junia, ki para bangeit jong nga, bad ki para koidi jong nga, kiba pawnam hapdeng ki apostol kiba la don ha U Khrist ha khmat jong nga .

en: Beloved , believe not every spirit , but try the spirits whether they are of God : because many false prophets are gone out into the world .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , wat ngeit ïa baroh kiba kam ba ki don U Mynsiem , hynrei , to phin da tynjuh ïa ki ban shem lada u mynsiem ba ki don u wan ne em na U Blei . Naba shibun ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ki la leit kylleng sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit, ym ia uwei pa uwei u mynsiem, hynrei pyrshang ia ki mynsiem la ki long na U Blei: namar bun ki nongiathuhlypa lamler ki la leit shabar sha ka pyrthei .

en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .
kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , nga ong ha phi , u kham kmen ïa kane kawei ka langbrot ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bym shym la jah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u shem ia ka, shisha nga ong ha phi, u kham kmen na kata ka langbrot, ban ia ki hynniewphew hynniew ki bym shym la jah rngai .

en: And he said , Who art thou , Lord ? And the Lord said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest : it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
kha: Me long uei , A Trai ?  u la kylli .  Nga long U Jisu , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ !  ka sur ka la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Me long mano ko Trai ? Bad U Trai u la ong, Nga long U Jisu uba me pynshitom bein: ka long kaba eh ia me ban kiew pyrshah ia ki prick .

en: A widow , or a divorced woman , or profane , or an harlot , these shall he not take : but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife .
kha: ym ïa ka riewkynthei , lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , lane kaba la ïaid nuti . Un shongkurim tang bad ka theisotti kaba na ka jait jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka riewkynthei ne ka kynthei kaba la iakhlad noh, ne ka kynthei kaba la shah pynduh jait, ne ka kynthei kaba sniew, kine un ym shim: hynrei un shim ia ka nongleh kam sniew jong u hi sha ka tnga .

en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand , and caught him , and said unto him ,  O thou of little faith , wherefore didst thou doubt ?
kha: Shisyndon U Jisu u la kner bad u la batskhem ïa u bad U la ong ,  Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit me don ! Balei ba me artatien ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la kem ia u bad u la ong ha u: Ko kaba rit ka jingngeit, balei me artatien ?

en: Then went I up in the night by the brook , and viewed the wall , and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley , and so returned .
kha: kumta nga hiar noh sharum sha ka them Kidron bad ïaid shaphrang , da kaba peit ïa ka kynroh . Nangta nga wan phai pat na kajuh ka lynti ba nga wan bad leit phai sha ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la leit sha jrong ha ka por miet da ka wah, bad nga la peit ia ka kynroh, bad nga la phai shadien, bad nga la rung da ka khyrdop jong ka them, bad kumta nga la wan phai biang .

en: Then the spirit took me up , and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing , saying , Blessed be the glory of the  Lord  from his place .
kha: Te U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah joit ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew na shadien jong nga ïa ka jingsawa jam jong ka sur kaba ong ,  To ïaroh ïa ka burom U  Trai  ha bneng shajrong !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u mynsiem u la shim ia nga shaneng , bad nga la iohsngew hadien jong nga ia ka sur kaba jur bha kaba ong: La kyrkhu ia ka burom U Trai na ka jaka jong u .

en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .
kha: Nga la mihpaw ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kum U Blei Badonbor Baroh , hynrei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la paw ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob, da ka kyrteng U Blei Uba donbor baroh, hynrei da ka kyrteng jong nga U Jehobah ngam shym la tip ia ki .

en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .
kha: Nangta u ong ha u Jether , u khun nyngkong jong u ,  Khie , pynïap ïa ki !  Hynrei uta u khynnah um shym sei ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , namar ba u dang long tang u khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u khun nyngkong jong u, Up, bad u la pyniap ia ki . Hynrei u samla um shym la tan ia ka waitlam jong u: namar u la tieng , namar u dang samla .

en: I have made the earth , and created man upon it : I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens , and all their host have I commanded .
kha: Nga long uta uba thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynlong ïa ki briew ban shong hangta . Da ka bor jong nga , nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; nga pynïaid ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la thaw ia ka khyndew bad nga la thaw ia u briew halor jong ka: Nga, wat ki kti jong nga ruh nga la pynjrong ia ki bneng bad nga la hukum ia ki shipai jong ki baroh .

en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren , and dwelt in the land of Tob : and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah , and went out with him .
kha: U Jephthah u phet na la ki hynmen bad u leit shong ha ri Tob . Hangta shi kynhun ki nongkamsniew ki ïapynlong paralok bad u , bad ki leit lang kylleng lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jephthah u la phet noh na ki hynmen jong u, bad u la shong ha ka ri u Tob: bad ki la ialum lang ia ki briew kiba lehnohei sha u Jephthah .

en: Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .
kha: Ko syiem Ijipt , shano kito ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki lah ban ïathuh ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kiba u don ïa ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ki don ? hangno ki riewstad jong me ? bad to ai ba kin iathuh ia me mynta , bad to ai ba kin tip ia kaei kaba U Trai jong ki paid u la thmu ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee : by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things , whereof we accuse him .
kha: Nangta u Lusias u la ai hukum ba ki nongmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul kin wan ha khmat jong me . Lada me kylli ïa une u briew , me hi me lah ban tip na u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi mudui ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbthah ia ki nongmudui jong u ban wan sha me: da kaba bishar bniah ia uba me hi me lah ban tip ia kine kiei kiei baroh , na kiba ngi kynnoh ia u .

en: ( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing . )
kha: ( Naba baroh ki traishnong jong ka Athens bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hangta ki sngewtynnat ban pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh ha kaba ïathuh bad sngap ïa kaei kaei kaba thymmai tam . )
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta ki nong Athen bad ki nongwei baroh kiba don hangta kim shym la pynlut por ei ei shuh , hynrei ban iathuh , ne ban iohsngew ia kaei kaei kaba thymmai . )

en: And as Obadiah was in the way , behold , Elijah met him : and he knew him , and fell on his face , and said , Art thou that my lord Elijah ?
kha: Katba u Obadaïah u dang ïaid ha la ka lynti , kynsan u ïakynduh ïa u Elijah . U ithuh ïa u , u dem ngon ha khmat jong u bad u kylli ,  Dei shisha ma phi , ko kynrad ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Obadaiah u dang don ha lynti, ha khmih, u Elijah u la iakynduh ia u: bad u la ithuh ia u, bad u la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong u, bad u la ong: Me long ba u kynrad jong nga u Elijah ?

en: And it came to pass , as Jesus sat at meat in the house , behold , many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang bam ha ka ïing u Matthaïos , shibun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ki la ïawan bad shong bad U Jisu lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba U Jisu u dang shong ha iing, ha khmih bun ki nongleh kam sniew bad ki nongpop ki la wan shong bad u bad ki synran jong u .

en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .
kha: Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki hapoh shisnem , lada nga leh kumta , ka ri kan long kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bun palat ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me ha ka shisnem shuh shuh ba ka ri kan kylla long kaba la jot , bad u mrad khlaw un nang bun pyrshah ia me .

en: But ye have a custom , that I should release unto you one at the passover : will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
kha: Hynrei kat kum ka rukom kaba phi don , nga ju pyllait ïa u koidi ha phi ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Phi kwah ïa nga ba ngan pyllait ha phi ïa u syiem ki Jiw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi don ka dustur , ba ngan pyllait noh ia phi ha ka jingkhawai Niam: hato phi kwah namarkata ba ngan pyllait noh ia phi ia u Syiem ki Jiw ?

en: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?
kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew uba kren kum kane ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! U Blei u long tang ma u hi uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban pyrkhat, ki da ong: Mano ba kren bein ia ki ktien bein ? Mano ba lah ban map ia ki pop hynrei tang U Blei ?

en: And Laban said unto Jacob , Because thou art my brother , shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought ? tell me , what shall thy wages be ?
kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Tang namar ba me dei u kur u jait jong nga , mem dei ban shu trei ei na ka bynta jong nga . Katno ka bainong me kwah ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong ha u Jakob, Namar me long u hynmen jong nga, hato me dei ban shakri ia nga khlem da don ei ei? iathuh ia nga, kaei ka bainong jong me ?

en: We will pass over armed before the  Lord  into the land of Canaan , that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours .
kha: Hapoh ka hukum jong U ngin jam sha ka ri Kanaan bad leit sha ka thma , khnang ba ngi lah ban bat ïa ka jingïohkynti jong ngi hangne ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin iaid lyngba ha khmat U Trai sha ka ri Kanaan , ba ka jingdon ia ka pateng jong ngi ha kane ka liang ka Jordan kan long ka jong ngi .

en: Now it came to pass , as they went , that he entered into a certain village : and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house .
kha: Katba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki dang leit ha ka jingleit jong ki , u la wan sha ka shnong ha kaba ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Martha ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa u sha ka ïing jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, katba ki dang leit, ba u la rung ha kawei ka shnong: bad kawei ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Martha ka la pdiang ia u ha iing jong ka .

en: A study of What Does the Bible Really Teach ? or a similar book published by Jehovah’s Witnesses is recommended in preparation for baptism .
kha: Shuwa ban shim ïa ka jingpynbaptis kan kham bha lada pule sa kawei de ka kot ba la pynmih da ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpule ia kaei kaba ka Baibl ka hikai shisha ? lane ka kot kaba kum kata kaba la pynmih da ki nongsakhi jong ka Jehobah .

en: And he said unto them , Let the  Lord  be so with you , as I will let you go , and your little ones : look to it  ; for evil is before you .
kha: U Pharaoh u ong ,  Nga smai da U  Trai  ba lano lano ruh ngan ym shah ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khun jong phi ! Ka paw shai mynta ba phi don ka jingïasylla ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To ai ba U Trai un long kumta bad phi, kumba ngan pyllait noh ia phi, bad ia ki khun rit jong phi: peit ia ka ; namar ka jingsniew ka don ha khmat jong phi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Is the  Lord s  hand waxed short ? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not .
kha: Hato don u pud ïa ka bor jong nga ?  U  Trai  u jubab .  Men sa ïohi shen la kata kaba nga la ong kan urlong ne em !
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, Hato ka kti U Trai ka la lyngkot ? me peit mynta la ka ktien jong nga kan sa jia ha me ne em .

en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngan khi ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad ngan ieh lyndum ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai un pynkhih da ka sniehdoh ia ka khlieh jong ki khun kynthei jong ka Seion , bad U Trai un sa lap ia ki bynta ba rieh jong ki .

en: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , phi lah ban bam ïa kata kaba dang sah ha kano kano ka jaka , namar ka long ka bainong ïa ka jingshakri jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ia ka ha man la ka jaka, ma phi bad ki iing jong phi: namar ka long ka bainong jong phi na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong phi ha ka iing jong ka jingiaseng .

en: But it shall be , when evening cometh on , he shall wash himself with water : and when the sun is down , he shall come into the camp again .
kha: Ynda janmiet u dei ban sait ban sum ïa lade , bad ha ka por sep sngi u lah ban wan pat sha ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda la janmiet, un sait ia lade da ka um: bad ynda la sep ka sngi , un wan phai biang shapoh ka shnong .

en: Then the elders of the congregation said , How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin ?
kha: Kumta ki nongïalam jong ka jingïalumlang ki ong ,  Ym don kynthei shuh hapdeng ka jait Benjamin . Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga na ka bynta ki rangbah ba dang sah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ka jingiaseng ki la ong: Kumno ngin leh ia ki tnga na ka bynta kito kiba sah , haba ki kynthei ki shah pynjot na u Benjamin ?

en: And I knew that thou hearest me always : but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me .
kha: Nga tip ba me shahshkor ïa nga borabor , hynrei nga ong ïa kane na ka bynta u paidbah hangne , ba kumta kin ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga tip ba me ju iohsngew ia nga: hynrei namar ki briew kiba ieng hajan nga la ong ia kata , ba kin ngeit ba me la phah ia nga .

en: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it , and smote the high priest s servant , and cut off his right ear . The servant s name was Malchus .
kha: U Simon Petros , uba kieng ïa ka waitlam , u la sei ïa ka bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u da mait ïa ka shkor kamon jong u . Ka kyrteng uta u mraw ka long u Malkhos .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Simon Petros u la ring ia ka, bad u la shoh ia u shakri rangbah lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ia ka shkor kadiang jong u . Ka kyrteng jong u shakri ka long u Malchus .

en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .
kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot ïa ki riewstad bad ïa ki nongleh myntor jong u , bad ki ruh ki leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh ruh u la khot ia ki riewstad bad ki nongleh jadu: mynta ki nongleh jadu jong ka ri Ijipt ruh ki la leh kumjuh bad ki jingleh jadu jong ki .

en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the  Lord  did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .
kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , pynsngewthuh ha ki khun shynrang jong phi ba phi leh ïa kane baroh namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha phi mynba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pyni ia u khun jong me ha kata ka sngi , da kaba ong , Ia kane la leh namar kata kaba U Trai u la leh ia nga haba nga la mih na Ijipt .

en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :
kha: Haba u Iso u la dap sawphew snem ka rta , u shongkurim ïa ar ngut ki kynthei Hit , ka Judith ka khun jong u Beeri bad ka Basemath ka khun jong u Elon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la dap sawphew snem ka rta haba u la shim ia ka tnga jong u Beeri u Hitit:

en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry , Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal . And he brought them forth vestments .
kha: Nangta u Jehu u hukum ïa u lyngdoh ba dei khmih ïa ki jaiñkup bakyntang , ban sei shabar ïa ki jaiñkup bad ban ai ïa ki ha ki nongmane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u uba la don halor ka jainkup , To wanrah ia ki jainkup na ka bynta ki nongmane Baal baroh . Bad u la wanrah ia ki jainkup .

en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth  ; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee ?
kha: bad kin hikai ïa phi kaei ka jingshisha ka long . Nangta haba la phah ïa phi ban shem ïa ka , phin wanrah ïa ka jubab kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba nga lah ban pyntip ia me ia ka jingshisha jong ki ktien jong ka jingshisha ; ba me lah ban jubab ia ki ktien jong ka jingshisha ha kito kiba phah sha me ?

en: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab , saith the  Lord  , him that offereth in the high places , and him that burneth incense to his gods .
kha: Ngan pynsangeh ïa ki briew ka Moab na kaba thang jingainguh ha ki jaka mane jong ki bad ban ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ki blei jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan pynlong ia u ban sangeh noh ha Moab , ong U Trai , uta uba ainguh ha ki jaka ba jrong , bad uta uba thang jingiwbih ia ki blei jong u .

en: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .
kha: Don tang kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka jingainguh pop ka long: ka don kawei ka hukum na ka bynta jong ki: u lyngdoh uba pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid da kata un don ia ka .

en: And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .
kha: Nangta uta uba shong ha ka khet u la ong ,  Bad mynta nga thaw thymmai ïa kiei kiei baroh !  U la ong ruh ïa nga ,  Thoh ïa kane , namar kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba shong halor ka khet u la ong, Ha khmih , nga pynlong ia kiei kiei baroh kiba thymmai . Bad u la ong ha nga: Thoh: namar kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba iaineh .

en: So Samuel called unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  sent thunder and rain that day : and all the people greatly feared the  Lord  and Samuel .
kha: Kumta u Samuel u la duwai , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap ha kata ka sngi . Te uta u paidbah baroh u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Samuel ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Samuel u la khot ia U Trai ; bad U Trai u la phah ia u slap bad u slap ha kata ka sngi: bad ki briew baroh ki la tieng shibun ia U Trai bad u Samuel .

en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .
kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok jong nga , katba phi dang ap ïa kata ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ka jong phi ban long kiba khlem thohbria bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat U Blei bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko baieit, haba phi wad ia kiei kiei kiba kum kita, to long kiba minot ba phin shem ia phi ha u ha ka jingsuk, khlem da shah rong bad khlem jingbakla.

en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .
kha: Bad pynban , namar ka jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , mem shym iehnoh ne pynjot ïa ki . Me long U Blei ka jingaiei bad ka jingisynei !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh na ka bynta ki jingisynei kiba khraw jong me phim shym la bam lut ia ki, lymne wat iehnoh ia ki ; namar me long U Blei uba sngewrit bad uba isynei .

en: Let such an one think this , that , such as we are in word by letters when we are absent , such will we be also in deed when we are present .
kha: To ai ba kum uta u briew un sngewthuh ba kam don ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba ngi thoh ha ki shithi jong ngi haba ngi don sha jngai bad ïa kaei kaba ngin leh haba ngi don markhmat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kum uta un pyrkhat ia kane , ba , kumba ngi don ha ka ktien da ki shithi haba ngim don , kumta ngin sa don ruh ha ka kam haba ngi don .

en: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments , and Israel thy law : they shall put incense before thee , and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar .
kha: Kin hikai ïa ki briew jong me ban kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ jong me ; Kin ai ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin hikai ia u Jakob ia ki jingbishar jong me, bad ia ka ain jong me: kin buh ia ka jingiwbih ha khmat jong me, bad ka jingknia thang baroh kawei ha ka almari jong me .

en: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias . And when he had opened the book , he found the place where it was written ,
kha: bad la ai ha u ïa ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la plied ïa la kot kli bad u la shem ïa ka bynta ha kaba la thoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynpoi ha u ia ka Kitab u nongiathuhlypa Isaiah . Bad haba u la plie ia ka kot , u la shem ia ka jaka ba la thoh ia ka .

en: Go up into Gilead , and take balm , O virgin , the daughter of Egypt : in vain shalt thou use many medicines  ; for thou shalt not be cured .
kha: Ko ki briew jong ka Ijipt , khie leit sha Gilead bad wad ïa ka dawai ! Ki dawai jong pha baroh ki la pynshisha ba kim myntoi ei ei ; ym don ei ei ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha Gilead, bad shim ia ka balm, ko khun masi jong ka ri Ijipt: khlem da donkam shuh men pyndonkam bun ki dawai ; namar men ym shah pynkoit .

en: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .
kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kiba long ki jingbeiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban don ka bor synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ha u ia ka shyntur kaba kren ia kiei kiei kiba khraw bad ki jingkren bein ; bad la ai bor ia u ban bteng sawphew ar bnai .

en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .
kha: Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha kata ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban ñiew ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai u la pynkhraw ia u Joshua ha khmat ki Israel baroh; bad ki la tieng ia u kumba ki tieng ia u Moses, baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u .

en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me ?
kha: Nangta u Moses u la phai biang sha U  Trai  bad u la ong ,  A  Trai  , balei me lehbeiñ sat ïa la ki briew ? Balei me phah ïa nga shane ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wan phai sha U Trai bad u la ong, ko Trai, balei me la pynsniew ia une u briew ? balei ba me la phah ia nga ?

en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn , saying , Surely as I have thought , so shall it come to pass  ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai ka jingsmai :  Kaei kaba nga la thmu kan jia . Kaei kaba nga la kut jingmut ban leh yn pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai jong ki paid u la smai, u la ong: Hooid kumba nga la pyrkhat, kumta kan sa jia ; bad kumba nga la thmu, kumta kan ieng:

en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner , nor a stone for foundations  ; but thou shalt be desolate for ever , saith the  Lord .
kha: Yn ym don ki maw na ki jingjot jong pha ba yn pyndonkam pat na ka bynta ki jingtei . Phan long kum ka ri shyiap junom . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym shim na me ia u maw na ka bynta ka kut, ne u maw na ka bynta ki nongrim hynrei me dei ban shah pynjot junom , ong U Trai .

en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .
kha: Ko kynthei Israel , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ saw syn-iang , Bad u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki khun kynthei Israel , phi iam halor u Saul , uba la phong ia phi da ki jain rong saw , bad kiwei pat ki jingsngewbha , kiba phong da ki jingdeng ksiar ha ka jainkup jong phi .

en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil , and choose the good , the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings .
kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kata ka por kan wan , ïa ki ri jong kito ki ar ngut ki syiem kiba la pynshyrkhei ïa phi yn iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shuwa ba u khynnah un tip ban kyntait ia kaba sniew, bad ban jied ia kaba bha, ka ri kaba me sngewsih kan shah iehnoh noh na baroh arngut ki syiem jong ka .

en: And David sent and enquired after the woman . And one said , Is not this Bath–sheba , the daughter of Eliam , the wife of Uriah the Hittite ?
kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban lap ka dei mano , bad u la tip ba ka dei ka Bathsheba , ka khun jong u Eliam bad ka tnga jong u Uriah u nong Hit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah bad u la kylli hadien kata ka kynthei . Bad uwei u la ong, Hato kane kam dei ka Bathsheba ka khun jong u Eliam ka tnga jong u Urih u Hit ?

en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened , and have tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,
kha: Naba da kumno lah ban ïalam pat ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ba kin kylla-kaba-mut biang ? Ki la don shisien ha ka jingshai U Blei ; ki la ïohmad ïa ka jingai ba kynja bneng , bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kam long kaba lah ia kito kiba la shah pynshai shisien , bad kiba la mad ia ka jingai bneng , bad la pynlong ia ki ban iashim bynta ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid , .

en: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar , and set up the hanging of the court gate . So Moses finished the work .
kha: U Moses u pynïeng sa ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad u wah ïa ka pyrda ha khyrdop jong ka phyllaw . Kumta keiñ u Moses u pyndep ïa kata ka kam baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynsan ia ka phyllaw sawdong ka iing bad ka almari , bad u la buh ia ka jingsahkut jong ka khyrdop . Kumta u Moses u la pyndep ia ka kam .

en: All his transgressions that he hath committed , they shall not be mentioned unto him : in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live .
kha: Ïa ki pop jong u baroh yn map , bad un im , namar u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki jingpynkhein jong u kiba u la leh , kin ym shah kdew ha u: ha ka hok jong u kaba u la leh un im .

en: And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa u angel uba dei khmih ïa ki um ba u ong ,  Ki jingbishar kiba me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Uba Khuid , me uba long bad uba la long !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia u angel jong ki um ba u ong: Me long uba hok, ko Trai, uba long bad uba la jah rngai, bad uba la jah rngai, namar me la bishar kumta .

en: And he said , They were my brethren , even the sons of my mother : as the  Lord  liveth , if ye had saved them alive , I would not slay you .
kha: U Gideon u ong ,  Ki dei ki para jong nga , ki khun shynrang i mei jong nga . Nga smai da kaba kyntang ba lada phin shym la pynïap ïa ki , ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Ki long ki hynmen jong nga, wat ki khun shynrang jong nga: kumba U Trai u im, lada phi la pynim ia ki, ngan ym pyniap ia phi .

en: Blessed are they that do his commandments , that they may have right to the tree of life , and may enter in through the gates into the city .
kha: Suk kito kiba sait pynkhuid ïa la ki jaiñkup bad kumta ki don ka hok ban bam ïa u soh na u dieng ka jingim bad ban leit lyngba ki khyrdop shapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kito kiba leh ia ki hukum jong u, ba kin ioh ia ka hok sha u dieng jingim bad kin rung lyngba ki khyrdop shapoh ka nongbah .

en: And they rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone upon the water , and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood :
kha: Haba ki la khie thiah ha ka step kaba bud , ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ka um , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ba kan saw kum ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khie dang step, bad ka sngi ka la shai halor ka um, bad ki nong Moab ki la iohi ia ka um ha kawei pat ka liang kum ka snam:

en: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains , saith the Lord  God  : every man s sword shall be against his brother .
kha: Ngan pynsheptieng ïa u Gog da bun jait ki jingjia basniew . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki briew jong u kin thew ïa la ki waitlam pyrshah uwei ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan khot ia ka waitlam pyrshah ia u ha ki lum jong nga baroh: uwei pa uwei u la long pyrshah ia u hynmen jong u .

en: Hear this , I pray you , ye heads of the house of Jacob , and princes of the house of Israel , that abhor judgment , and pervert all equity .
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel , phi kiba isih ïa ka jingbishar hok bad pynkylla ïa kaba dei sha kaba bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane , nga kyrpad ia phi, phi ki khlieh jong ka iing u Jakob bad ki syiem jong ka iing Israel , kiba sngewsih ia ka jingbishar bad kiba pynkylla ia ka jinglong mar ryngkat baroh .

en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
kha: Baroh ki kut jong pha kin long kum ki diengsoh Dumbur bad ki soh Dumbur ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap beit hapoh ka shyntur jong pha !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki jingbat ba skhem jong me kin long kum ki dieng sohjew kiba don ki sohjew ba nyngkong: lada ki shah pynkhih , kin hap wat ha ka shyntur jong u nongbam .

en: And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?
kha: Nga tip ba me mihnoh namar ba me kynmaw ïing eh , hynrei balei pat me tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, wat la phi kwah ban leit noh, namar ba phi la thrang ia ka iing u kpa jong me, hynrei balei phi la tuh ia ki blei jong nga ?

en: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth  ; for he hath not another to help him up .
kha: Lada uwei na ki u kyllon , uwei pat u lah ban khyllie joit ïa u . Hynrei lada uno uno u don marwei bad u kyllon ; ka long kaba sangsot tam , namar ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ki hap , uta un rah ia u paralok jong u: hynrei sngewsih ia uta uba don marwei haba u la hap ; namar um don uwei pat ban iarap ia u .

en: So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites in their courses , according to the king s commandment .
kha: Haba la dep pynbiang ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki shim ïa la ki bynta , kumba la hukum da u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la pynkhreh ia ka jingshakri , bad ki lyngdoh ki la ieng ha ka jaka jong ki , bad ki Lebi ha ki jaka jong ki kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ki ban ym leit tur , naba ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun jong ki kin sa jop ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , To ong ha ki, Wat leit shaneng, lymne ban ialeh namar ngam don hapdeng jong phi ; ioh ba phin shah pynjot ha khmat ki nongshun jong phi .

en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .
kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khyndew bad ka la ïuh halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la nang heh, wat haduh ka kynhun jong ki bneng bad ka la pynhap katto katne na ki kynhun bad ki khlur shapoh khyndew , bad ka la rung halor jong ki .

en: But what saith the answer of God unto him ? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men , who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal .
kha: Kaei ka jubab ba U Blei u la ai ïa u ?  Nga la buh na ka bynta jong nga , hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah ki bym shym la mane ïa u blei thala , u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ong ia ka jubab U Blei ha u ? Nga la buh kyrpang ia lade hynriew hajar ngut ki briew ki bym shym la dem khrup ha ka dur jong u Baal .

en: For I would that all men were even as I myself . But every man hath his proper gift of God , one after this manner , and another after that .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin long kum ma nga ; hynrei uwei pa uwei u don ïa ka jingai kaba kyrpang na U Blei , uwei da kane ka jingai , ïa uwei pat da katai ka jingai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kwah ba ki briew baroh kin long kum ma nga hi . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u don ka jingai kaba dei jong U Blei, kawei hadien kata .

en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him :
kha: Nga kynmaw ïa phi ha ki jingduwai jong nga ; bad nga kyrpad na U Blei jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , u Kpa uba dap da ka burom , ba un ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem , u ban pynlong ïa phi kiba stad bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa U Blei , khnang ba phin ïoh tip ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Blei jong U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , U Kpa jong ka burom , un ai ha phi ia ka mynsiem jong ka jingstad bad ka jingpynpaw ha ka jingtip ia u:

en: But when they deliver you up , take no thought how or what ye shall speak : for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak .
kha: Haba ki tian bishar ïa phi , wat khuslai shaphang kaei kaba phin ong lane kumno phin ong ; haba ka por ka poi , yn sa ai ha phi ïa kaei kaba phin ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki pynpoi ia phi shaneng, wat pyrkhat kumno ne kaei kaba phin kren: namar yn ai ha phi ha kata kajuh ka kynta ia kaei kaba phin kren .

en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned , and have not charity , it profiteth me nothing .
kha: Nga lah ban ai baroh kaba nga don , bad wat ïa ka met jong nga ïa ka ban thang — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , kane kam myntoi ei ei ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la nga ai lut ia ki mar ki mata jong nga ban ai bam ia kiba duk , bad wat la nga ai ia ka met jong nga ban shah thang , bad ngam don ka jingai sngewbha ei ei ia nga .

en: ( Genesis 3 :21  ; 9 :3  ; Exodus 21 :28 ) But it is wrong to mistreat animals or to kill them just for sport or pleasure .—Proverbs 12 :10 .
kha: ( Jenesis 3 :21 ; 9 :3 ; Eksodos 21 :28 ) Hynrei ka long ka bymdei ban leh beiñ ïa ki mrad lane pynïap ïa ki tang ban shu lehkai ne lehsngewbha .—Proberb 12 :10 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Jenesis 3 :21 ; 9:3 ; Exodus 21 :28 ) Hynrei ka long kaba bakla ban leh bein ia ki mrad ne ban pyniap ia ki tang na ka bynta ka jingialehkai ne ka jingsngewbha .Ki Proberb 12 :10.

en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear ; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption , whereby we cry , Abba , Father .
kha: Namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ïa phi um pynlong ïa phi ki mraw bad pynlong ïa phi ban sheptieng ; pynban U Mynsiem u pynlong ïa phi ki khun jong U Blei , bad da ka bor U Mynsiem ngi pyrta sha U Blei jong ngi ,  Ko Kpa ! Ko Kpa jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phim shym la pdiang biang ia ka mynsiem jong ka jinglong mraw ban tieng ; hynrei phi la pdiang ia U Mynsiem jong ka jingpdiang sngewbha, ha kaba ngi pyrta , Abba , Pa .

en: ( 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) Applying God’s counsel found in the Bible also promotes happiness in marriage and self-respect .—1 Corinthians 6 :18 .
kha: ( 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingsneng ba don ha ka Baibl kan wanrah ka jingkmen ha ka jingshong kurim bad ha jingburom ïalade . —1 Korinth 6 :18 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Corinth 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka jingpyndonkam ia ki jingai jingmut jong U Blei kiba la shem ha ka Baibl ka pynroi ruh ia ka jingkmen ha ka jingshongkha bad ka jingburom ia lade . 1 Korinth 6 :18 .

en: But there are some of you that believe not .  For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not , and who should betray him .
kha: Pynban don na phi ki bymngeit .  ( U Jisu u la tip naduh kaba mynnyngkong kino ki dei kita ki ban ym ngeit bad uno na ki u ban shetkylla ïa u . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don katto katne na phi ki bym ngeit . Naba U Jisu u tip naduh kaba sdang mano ba kim ngeit , bad mano ba dei ban pyndem ia u .

en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the  Lord  shall be offered , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Nalor kane ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka , kñia ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u khun blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop sha U Trai yn aiti , nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba iai bteng bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely , every man under his vine and under his fig tree , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , all the days of Solomon .
kha: Katba u dang im , ki briew ha kylleng ka Judah bad Israel , ki im ha ka jingshngain , kawei kawei ka longïing ka don la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah bad ki Israel ki shong suk im saiñ, uwei pa uwei hapoh u sohjew bad hapoh u diengsoh jong u, naduh u Dan haduh u Beersheba, baroh ki sngi u Solomon .

en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money , that I may eat  ; and give me water for money , that I may drink : only I will pass through on my feet  ;
kha: Ngin da siewdor ïa ka jingbam ba ngi bam bad ïa ka um ba ngi dih . Kaba ngi kwah ka long tang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban die ia nga ia ka doh na ka bynta ka pisa , ba ngan bam ; bad ai um ia nga na ka bynta ka pisa: tang ngan iaid lyngba ki kjat jong nga ; .

en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .
kha: Ha ka jingbha jong me , me ong ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh ; me la bsa ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ai ruh ia ka mynsiem babha jong me ban hikai ia ki, bad wat khang ia ka manna jong me na ka shyntur jong ki, bad ai um ia ki namar ka jingthngan jong ki .

en: So we boiled my son , and did eat him : and I said unto her on the next day , Give thy son , that we may eat him : and she hath hid her son .
kha: Kumta ngi la shet ïa u khun jong nga , bad ngi la bam ïa u . Ha ka sngi kaba bud , nga ong ha ka ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong ka , hynrei ka la buhrieh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi la pynkhluit ia u khun jong nga, bad ngi la bam ia u: bad nga la ong ha ka ha ka sngi kaba bud: Ai ia u khun jong me, ba ngin bam ia u: bad ka la buhrieh ia la u khun .

en: And the high priest stood up in the midst , and asked Jesus , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ïeng ha khmat jong ki baroh bad u la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Hato mem don ka jubab ïa ka jingmudui kaba ki la wanrah pyrshah ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah lyngdoh u la ieng hapdeng bad u la kylli ia U Jisu, u da ong: Hato me jubab ei ei ? kaei kata kaba kine ki sakhi pyrshah ia me ?

en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .
kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ban shem la kine ki Israel kin bud ne em ïa ki lynti jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba lyngba jong ki ngan pynshisha ia ki Israel , la kin bat ia ka lynti U Trai ban iaid ha ka , kumba ki kpa jong ki ki la bat ia ka , ne em .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .
kha: Dang step ha ka sngi kaba bud ki paidbah ki tei ïa ka duwan hangta , ki ai ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok bad thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba ki briew ki la ieng dang step, bad ki la tei hangta ia ka jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will set my face against you for evil , and to cut off all Judah .
kha: Te nangta , ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi bad ngan pynjot ïa ka Judah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia phi na ka bynta ka jingsniew , bad ban ot noh ia ka Judah baroh kawei .

en: Until the day break , and the shadows flee away , turn , my beloved , and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether .
kha: ki dieng Kedar kin long ki bim jong ka ïing jong ngi , bad ki dieng Kseh-Sypress kin long ka sad .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ban da jah noh ka sngi, bad ki jingdum ki phet noh, ko baieit jong nga, bad me long kum u blang ne u blang uba dang rit halor ki lum jong ka Bether .

en: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .
kha: Hynrei lada phim treh ban phah ïa u , ngin ym leit , namar uta u briew u la ong ha ngi ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don ryngkat lem bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada men ym phah ia u, ngin ym leit hiar: namar uta u briew u la ong ha ngi: Phin ym iohi ia ka khmat jong nga lymda u hynmen jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi .

en: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites , and will give them in possession , that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations .
kha: Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka ri shyiap ba sha mihngi ban jop ïa ka Moab , lem bad ka Ammon , khnang ba ka Moab kan ym long shuh ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki briew jong ka ri mihngi bad ki Ammon , bad kan ai ia ki ha ka jingdon jong ki , ba ki Ammon kin ym kynmaw hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

en: And I will shake all nations , and the desire of all nations shall come : and I will fill this house with glory , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ngan pynkyllon ïa ki hima baroh , bad ïa ki jingkynshew yn wallam shane , bad ïa ka Templ yn pyndap da ka spah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ia ki jaitbynriew baroh, bad ka jingkwah jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kan wan: bad ngan pyndap ia kane ka iing da ka burom , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: Whom the  Lord  of hosts shall bless , saying , Blessed be Egypt my people , and Assyria the work of my hands , and Israel mine inheritance .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ki bad un ong ,  Ngan kyrkhu ïa pha , ko Ijipt , ki briew jong nga ; ïa pha , ko Assyria , kaba nga la thaw ; bad ïa pha , ko Israel , ki briew kiba la jied jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba U Trai jong ki paid un kyrkhu, da kaba ong: La kyrkhu ia ka ri Ijipt jong nga, bad ka ri Asyria ka kam jong ki kti jong nga, bad ki Israel jong nga .

en: He is proud , knowing nothing , but doting about questions and strifes of words , whereof cometh envy , strife , railings , evil surmisings ,
kha: U don ka jingkwah kaba sniew ban ïoh ïasaidnia bad ïakajia shaphang ki ktien , bad kane ka wanrah ïa ka jingpihuiñ , ka jingïania , ka jingkrenbeiñ , ka jingsuba sniew , bad ka jingïai-ïasaidnia na ki briew kiba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad ki bym don shuh ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U sngew sarong, um tip ei ei, hynrei u sngewtynnad ia ki jingkylli bad ki jingeh jong ki kyntien, kiba wan na ki ki kyntien kiba sngewsih, kiba ialeh pyrshah, kiba iaid beit, kiba sniew , .

en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest  ; but he that said unto him , Thou art my Son , to day have I begotten thee .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist um shym la shim ha lade ïa kane ka burom ka jinglong Rangbah Lyngdoh . Pynban , U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me , me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ruh U Khrist um shym la pyndonburom ia lade ban long u lyngdoh rangbah ; hynrei uta uba la ong ha u: Me long u Khun jong nga, haduh mynta nga la kha ia me .

en: And profited in the Jews  religion above many my equals in mine own nation , being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers .
kha: Nga la long uba ha khmat tam ïa kiba bun ki para Jiw kiba ïaryngkat rta bad nga ha kaba bud pyrkhing ïa ka niam Jiw , bad nga la kham pynleit jingmut shibun ha ki rukom pateng jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingmyntoi ha ka niam Jiw halor kiba bun ki paralok jong nga ha la ka jong ka jaitbynriew , ka jinglong kaba kham sngewtynnad palat ia ki riti dustur jong ki kpa jong nga .

en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place : I thought to promote thee unto great honour  ; but , lo , the  Lord  hath kept thee back from honour .
kha: Khie leit noh mynta sha la ïing ! Nga la kular ban ai bainong ïa me , hynrei U  Trai  u la khang ïa me ban ïoh ïa kata ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to phet noh sha ka jaka jong me: Nga la pyrkhat ban kyntiew ia me sha ka burom kaba khraw ; hynrei , ha khmih , U Trai u la pynsangeh noh ia me na ka burom .

en: Or if his sin , wherein he hath sinned , come to his knowledge  ; he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a male without blemish :
kha: kumta mar ïatip ïa kata ka pop , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada ka pop jong u, ha kaba u la leh pop, u wan sha ka jingtip jong u ; un wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong u, u khun blang, u shynrang khlem jingduna:

en: Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .
kha: Ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka bor mynbarim jong ka jaitbynriew bad pynskhem biang ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ki ruh kin long kumba ki long mynshuwa , bad ka jingiaseng jong ki kan long kaba skhem ha khmat jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ia kita baroh kiba pynshitom bein ia ki .

en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .
kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri , bad hadien kata ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha kane ka jaka .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jaitbynriew kaba kin long mraw ngan bishar , la ong U Blei: bad hadien kata kin wan shabar bad kin shakri ia nga ha kane ka jaka .

en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .
kha: Ka shem ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha ; u syiem u kwah ban tip shaphang ki kambah jong u Elisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la kren bad u shakri jong u briew U Blei, u da ong: Iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ia kiei kiei baroh kiba khraw kiba u Elisha u la leh .

en: For the rich men thereof are full of violence , and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies , and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth .
kha: Ki briew bariewspah jong phi ki kjit na kiba duk , bad baroh ki long ki nongshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki riewspah jong ka ki dap da ka jingleh donbor , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ki la kren thok , bad ka shyntur jong ki ka long kaba thok ha ka shyntur jong ki .

en: As they ministered to the Lord , and fasted , the Holy Ghost said , Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them .
kha: Katba ki dang ïashakri ïa U Trai bad shahjingit , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha ki ,  Pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul , ban trei ïa ka kam sha kaba nga la khot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki dang shakri ia U Trai , bad ki dang iaid niam , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong , Pyniakhlad ia nga u Barnabas bad u Saul na ka bynta ka kam kaba nga la khot ia ki .

en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .
