kha: Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baroh kiei kiei kiba la pyntngit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan theh ia ka um kaba khuid halor jong phi , bad phin sa long kiba khuid: na ka jingjakhlia jong phi baroh , bad na ki bleithaw jong phi baroh , ngan pynkhuid ia phi .

en: And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .
kha: Ym pat ju don mynno mynno , bad yn ym don lano lano , ba la don kum kata ka sngi , mynba U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa u bynriew . U  Trai  u ïaleh ha ka liang ki Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym shym la don ka sngi kaba kum kata shuwa jong ka ne hadien jong ka, ba U Trai u la sngap ia ka sur jong u briew: namar U Trai u la ialeh na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
kha: U briew u lah ban ïap kynsan mynmiet . U Blei u shoh-ïap ïa ki briew bad ki jot noh ; u pynïap ïa kiba khrawbor da kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka khyllipmat kin iap, bad ki briew kin sa shah pynshitom ha ka por shiteng miet, bad kin sa jah noh: bad ia kiba khlain bor yn sa shim noh khlem kti .

en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me bad ba me long uba tbit bad me don ka jingtip bad ka jingstad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew wat ia me , ba ka mynsiem jong ki blei ka don ha me , bad kata ka jingshai bad ka jingsngewthuh bad ka jingstad kaba bha tam ka don ha me .

en: And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,
kha: U hukum ïa ki ,  Man kaba kut ka hynñiew snem , ynda poi ka snem ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kane ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la hukum ia ki da kaba ong: Ha kaba kut jong kawei pa kawei ka snem , ha ka por ba la buh ha ka snem jong ka jingpyllait im .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud hadien ka thma , ki Philistia ki leit bad lute ïa ki metïap , bad ki lap ïa ki met jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki don halor u Lum Gilboa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, haba ki Philistia ki la wan ban pynduh ia kiba la shah pyniap, ba ki la lap ia u Saul bad ki khun jong u ki la hap ha u lum Gilboa .

en: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones , and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale , for abundance .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ka rupa ka don kynrei ha Jerusalem kumba don u maw , bad ïa u dieng Kedar kumba pahuh u dieng Dumbur ha ki kjat lum ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la shna rupa ban don ha Jerusalem kum ki maw, bad ki dieng ki la pynlong ia u ban long kum ki dieng kiba don ha ki them, namar ka jingbun .

en: Otherwise it shall come to pass , when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers , that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders .
kha: Lada phim leh kumta , tang mar ïa-ïap ma phi , u Solomon , u khun jong nga bad ma nga ngin shah ñiew kum ki nongshetkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta kan sa jia, haba u kynrad jong nga un thiah bad ki kpa jong u, ba ma nga bad u khun jong nga u Solomon ngin shah khein ia ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink  ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .
kha: Ki dohkha kin ïap , bad ka wah kan sa iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kin ym nud ban dih um na ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dohkha kiba don ha ka wah kin iap bad ka wah kan tyrkhong ; bad ki nong Ijipt kin dih ia ka um jong ka wah .

en: All thy rulers are fled together , they are bound by the archers : all that are found in thee are bound together , which have fled from far .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong phi baroh ki la phet krad bad ki la shah kem ha shuwa ba kin ïoh siat uwei u khnam .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongsynshar jong me ki la phet noh , ki la shah teh ha ki nongsiat khnam: baroh kiba la shem ha me ki la shah teh lang , kiba la phet noh na jngai .

en: Then contended I with the rulers , and said , Why is the house of God forsaken ? And I gathered them together , and set them in their place .
kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki rangbah synshar namar ba ki la ailad ban leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka Templ . Bad nga la wallam biang ïa ki Lebi bad ki nongtem nongput sha ka Templ bad buh biang ïa ki ha ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ialeh pyrshah bad ki nongsynshar bad nga la ong , Balei la iehnoh ia ka iing U Blei ? Bad nga la lum lang ia ki bad nga la buh ia ki ha ka jaka jong ki .

en: And Jesus said ,  For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see  ; and that they which see might be made blind .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga la wan sha kane ka pyrthei ban bishar , khnang ba kiba matlah kin ïohi bad kito kiba ïohi kin long matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong: Na ka bynta ka jingbishar nga wan sha kane ka pyrthei, ba kito ki bym iohi kin iohi; bad ba kito kiba iohi kin shah pynmatlah .

en: And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .
kha: Ki briew ka Judah ki don ka jingrwai kaba ki rwai :  Ngi long tlot ba ngi bah ki jingkit bakhia ; Don bun bah ka synrum ban pynkhuid . Kumno ngi lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh mynta ka sngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong , Ka bor jong ki nongkit jingkit ka la pyut , bad ka don shibun ki jaboh ; haduh ba ngim lah ban tei ia ka kynroh .

en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering , and one ram for a burnt offering .
kha: Ki Israel ki dei ban ai ïa u Aaron ar tylli ki  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim na ka jingiaseng jong ki khun Israel arngut ki blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , bad uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang .

en: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) From small beginnings the organization has grown to millions of Witnesses , who are busy preaching in more than 230 lands .
kha: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) Na i jingsdang i barit ka seng ka la nangroi haduh ba ka la kot sha ki milian ngut Ki Nongsakhi , kiba mynta ki bunkam ha ka ban ïalap ha palat 236 tylli ki shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Isaiah 43 :10 ) Naduh ki jingsdang kiba rit ka seng ka la nang kiew sha ki million ngut ki Nongsakhi , kiba bunkam ha palat 230 tylli ki ri .

en: Therefore also I have lent him to the  Lord   ; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the  Lord . And he worshipped the  Lord  there .
kha: Namarkata , nga aiti noh ïa u ha U  Trai . Katba u dang im , un long u jong U  Trai .  Te ki ïanguh ïadem ïa U  Trai  hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh nga la ai ram ia u ha U Trai ; katba u dang im un shah ai ram ha U Trai . Bad u la mane ia U Trai hangta .

en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .
kha: Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la pynskhem ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ïa ka hima jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewthuh ba U Trai u la pynskhem ia u ha Israel , bad ba u la pynkhraw ia ka hima jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u Israel .

en: How do ye say , We are wise , and the law of the  Lord  is with us ? Lo , certainly in vain made he it  ; the pen of the scribes is in vain .
kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi long kiba stad , bad ba phi tip ïa ki aiñ jong nga ? Ha khmih , ïa ki aiñ la pynkylla da ki nongthoh bymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno phi ong , Ngi long kiba stad bad ka hukum U Trai ka don ryngkat bad ngi ? Hooid, shisha u la leh ia ka; ka pen jong ki nongthoh ka long kaba lehnohei .

en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lai snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u u Neuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon u la wan shaneng, bad u Jehoiakim u la long u shakri jong u lai snem: nangta u la phai bad u la leh pyrshah ia u .

en: And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , bad haba kan sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ka mynsiem jong ka ka dang leit noh, (namar ka la iap ) ba ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Benoni: hynrei u kpa jong u u la khot ia u u Benjamin .

en: Be of good courage , and let us play the men for our people , and for the cities of our God : and the  Lord  do that which seemeth him good .
kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongbah jong U Blei jong ngi . Bad ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba shlur bha, bad to ngin ialehkai ia ki briew na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi, bad na ka bynta ki nongbah U Blei jong ngi: bad U Trai un leh ia kaba u sngewbha .

en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .
kha: U syiem Josaïah u hukum ïa ki briew ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum ka jinglehburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum ia ki briew baroh da kaba ong: To buh ia ka jingkhawai Niam sha U Trai U Blei jong phi kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab jong kane ka jutang .

en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .
kha: Hynrei kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u don ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la lumlang ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ba wanrah ïa u kew ban shoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim tip ia ki jingpyrkhat U Trai, lymne kim sngewthuh ia ka jingmut jong u: namar un lum ia ki kum ki shniuh shapoh khyndew .

en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
kha: Kane baroh ka pynshisha ba ka jingbishar ka jong U Blei ka long kaba hok , bad kumta phin long kiba bit na ka bynta ka Hima jong u , kaba na ka bynta jong ka phi shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba paw ha ka jingbishar hok jong U Blei , ba phin shah khein ba phi long kiba bit dor ia ka hima U Blei , na ka bynta kaba phi ruh phi shah shitom:

en: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day .
kha: lada phi kohnguh ïa u bad phi sumar biang biang ïa kata baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang lada me sngap bha ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me , ban sumar ban leh ia kine ki hukum baroh kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi .

en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering .
kha: Nangta u Moses u wanlam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop: bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop .

en: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .
kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga : To da husiar na kito kiba pynlong ki jingïapait bad kiba pynkulmar ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew bad kiba ïaid pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïoh . To kiar na ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit, to buh dak ia ki kiba pynmih ia ki jingiapher bad ki jingleh bymman kiba pyrshah ia ka jinghikai kaba phi la nang; bad kiar na ki .

en: And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her ,  Talitha cumi  ;  which is , being interpreted ,  Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .
kha: U la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la ong ïa ka ,   Talitha , koum ,   kaba mut ,  Ko Khynnah rit , nga ong ïa pha ban khie joit !
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka dam da ka kti bad u la ong ha ka, Talitha cumi kaba la pynkylla ktien, Damsel, nga ong ha me, to khie noh .

en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
kha: Pynban , mynta , phi dei ban map ïa u bad ban pynshlur ïa u , khnang ban ïada ïa u na kaba sngewsih eh kat ban da kyntait noh shisyndon ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kata ka long kaba pher phi dei ban kham map ia u, bad pyntngen ia u, ioh lehse ia uba kum uta un shah rong noh da ka jingsngewsih kaba palat .

en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .
kha: Lai ngut ki nong Judia ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u ; u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh , u Joah u khun jong u Asaph .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah uba la long halor ka iing bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad u Joah u khun u Asaph u nongthoh .

en: Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;
kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u iehnoh katto katne ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki jaitbynriew kiba U Trai u la iehnoh, ban pynshisha ia ki Israel da ki, wat la bun na ki Israel kumba kim tip ia ki thma baroh jong u Kanaan;

en: That they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is none beside me . I am the  Lord  , and there is none else .
kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei shaduh kawei pat ka tduh kan tip ba nga long U  Trai bad ym don uwei pat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin tip na ka jingmih jong ka sngi, bad na sepngi, ba ym don shuh hajan jong nga . Nga long U Trai bad ym don shuh .

en: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift , and the strong shall not strengthen his force , neither shall the mighty deliver himself :
kha: Wat ki nongmareh stet kin ym lait im , ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ kin duh ïa la ka bor , bad ki shipai kin ym lah wat ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingher kan jah noh na ka jingstet, bad u ba khlain un ym pynskhem ia ka bor jong u, lymne u ba khlain bor un ym pynpoi ia lade:

en: And Pharaoh said , Who is the  Lord  , that I should obey his voice to let Israel go ? I know not the  Lord  , neither will I let Israel go .
kha: Uei uta U  Trai  ?  u Pharaoh u kylli .  Balei ba nga dei ban shahshkor ïa u , bad shah ïa ki Israel ban leit ? Ngam ithuh ïa U  Trai  , bad ngam shah ïa ki Israel ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong, Uei U Trai, ba nga dei ban kohnguh ia ka sur jong u ban pyllait noh ia ki Israel ? Ngam ithuh ia U Trai , lymne ngan pyllait noh ia ki Israel .

en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jotham u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jotham u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid u kpa jong u: bad u Ahas u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And this is his commandment , That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ , and love one another , as he gave us commandment .
kha: Kaei kaba u hukum ka long ba ngi ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong u bad ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , kumba U Khrist u la hukum ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka hukum jong u , Ba ngin ngeit ha ka kyrteng U Khun jong u U Jisu Khrist bad ngi iaieit iwei ia iwei pat kumba u la ai hukum ia ngi .

en: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate , and at the valley gate , and at the turning of the wall , and fortified them .
kha: U Ussaïah u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingker kynroh ïa ka Jerusalem da kaba tei ïa ki kut ha Khyrdop Dong , ha Khyrdop Them , bad ha ka jaka ba khun ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Uzziah u la tei ia ki tower ha Jerusalem ha ka khyrdop , bad ha ka khyrdop them , bad ha ka jingkylla jong ka kynroh , bad u la pynskhem ia ki .

en: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh : and he gave them in commandment all that the  Lord  had spoken with him in mount Sinai .
kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel baroh ki leit hajan jong u , bad u Moses u ai ha ki ïa kita ki hukum baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Lum Sinai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata baroh ki khun Israel ki la wan hajan: bad u la ai ha ki ha ka hukum baroh kaba U Trai u la kren bad u ha u lum Sinai .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
kha: Hadien kata , u shakri U  Trai  , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, u Joshua u khun u Nun u shakri U Trai u la iap , u la dap shispah shiphew snem .

en: But there was none like unto Ahab , which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up .
kha: ( Ym shym la don mano mano uba aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai  kum u Ahab — baroh da ka jingpynbor ka tnga jong u ka Jesebel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba kum u Ahab uba la die ia lade ban leh ia ka kam sniew ha khmat U Trai , ia uba u Jesbel ka tnga jong u ka la pynkhih .

en: For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .
kha: Haduh katno sien ba u briew un kem ïa u nongshun jong u bad nangta un pyllait ïa u ban leit noh khlem mynsaw ? U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada u briew u shem ia u nongshun jong u, hato un pyllait noh ia u ? namar kata U Trai u siew kylliang ia me na ka bynta kata kaba me la leh ia nga ha kane ka sngi .

en: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
kha: Naba nga long thikna ba ym don kaba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingim , lymne ki angel , lymne kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga sngewskhem , ba ym don ka jingiap ne ka jingim ne ki angel ne ki hima ne ki bor ne kiei kiei kiba don ne kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .

en: Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .
kha: Hadien kata , ngi la ïaleit shaphang shatei sha ka thain Bashan , bad u Og u Syiem jong ka u la wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi hajan ka shnong Edrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngi la phai , bad ngi la leit sha Basan : bad u Og u syiem u la mih pyrshah ia ngi , ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh .

en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick , and the Lord shall raise him up  ; and if he have committed sins , they shall be forgiven him .
kha: Kane ka jingduwai ba la pynlong ha ka jingngeit kan pynkhiah ïa u briew uba pang ; U Trai un sa ai biang ha u ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah , bad ïa ki pop kiba u la leh yn map .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingduwai jong ka jingngeit kan pynim ia kiba pang, bad U Trai un pynmih ia u ; bad lada u la leh ia ki pop , kin shah map ia u .

en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah ban pynjot , bad ki nongtuh kim lah ban prong bad tuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to buh ia lade ha bneng, ha kaba ym don u khniang ne u khniang u ju bamsap , bad ha kaba ki nongtuh kim ju bthei ne tuh:

en: As birds flying , so will the  Lord  of hosts defend Jerusalem  ; defending also he will deliver it  ; and passing over he will preserve it .
kha: Kumba ka sim ka her tawiar halor ka skum jong ka ban ïada ïa ki khun rit jong ka , kumta ruh ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan ïada ïa ka Jerusalem bad kyrshan ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki sim ki her , kumta u Trai jong ki paid un iada ia ka Jerusalem; u ruh un pynpoi ia ka; bad haba u iaid lait un pynneh ia ka .

en: Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .
kha: Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka  erïong , ka  erlangthari ka ban khih bitar halor ki khlieh jong ki bymman ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka lyer kaba jur jong U Trai ka la jah noh ha ka jingbitar: kan hap da kaba sngewsih ha ka khlieh jong kiba sniew .

en: And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
kha: Ynda u Saul u phai ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh kiba u Samuel u la ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba haba u la phai noh na u Samuel , U Blei u la ai ia u kawei pat ka dohnud: bad kita ki dak baroh ki la jia ha kata ka sngi .

en: And the younger of them said to his father , Father , give me the portion of goods that falleth to me . And he divided unto them his living .
kha: Uba kham rit u la ong ha u , ‘ Ko pa to ai mynta ha nga ïa ka bhah jong nga na ka jingdon jingem .’ Kumta uta u briew , u la pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u hapdeng ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uba kham rit na ki u la ong ha u kpa jong u, Ko Kpa, to ai ia nga ia ka bynta jong ki mar kiba hap ha nga . Bad u la phiah ha ki ia ka jingim jong u .

en: And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the  Lord  our God .
kha: U Pharaoh u jubab ,  Duwai na ka bynta jong nga la shai .  U Moses u ong ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong , ba phin ïoh tip ba ym don mano mano ruh uba kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To sngap jar . Bad u la ong, To long kat kum ka ktien jong me: ba me lah ban tip ba ym don kum U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he  ; take him , and lead him away safely .
kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai ha u paidbah ïa ka dak :  U briew ïa uba ngan doh u dei uta ïa uba phi kwah . Kem ïa u bad ïalam ïa u da kaba ap phira bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la shet kylla ia u u la ai ia ki ia ka token, u da ong: Uno uno uba ngan kdup, uta u long kumjuh; bad u ialam noh ia u da kaba suk .

en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .
kha: Naba hadien kaei kaba la jia mynta ka sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhihwin , bad ngim lah ban ai kano kano ka daw kaba dei na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi don ha ka jingma ban shah khot ha kane ka sngi sngewsih , ym don daw ha kaba ngi lah ban ai jingkhein ia kane ka jingialang .

en: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you ; that ye , always having all sufficiency in all things , may abound to every good work :
kha: Bad U Blei u lah ban ai ïa phi palat ban ïa kaba phi donkam , khnang ba phin ïai don baroh kaba phi donkam na ka bynta ïa lade bad kham bun ban ïa kaba donkam na ka
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei U lah ban pynlong ia ka jingaiei baroh kaba bun ha phi ; ba phi, da kaba don beit ha kiei kiei baroh, phi lah ban pynbun ia ka kam babha baroh:

en: He heard the sound of the trumpet , and took not warning  ; his blood shall be upon him . But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul .
kha: Ka jingïap jong u ka long na ka jingbakla jong u hi , namar um suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham . Lada u la shahshkor un jin da la lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi , bad um shym la shah hikai; ka snam jong u kan long halor jong u . Hynrei uta uba shim jingmaham un aiti ia ka mynsiem jong u .

en: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen , a chariot of asses , and a chariot of camels  ; and he hearkened diligently with much heed :
kha: Lada u ïohi ïa ki rangbah kiba wan halor ki kulai , shi jur shi jur , bad ki rangbah kiba shong halor ki kada bad ki ut , u dei ban da khmih bniah biang biang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ia ka kali kaba don arngut ki kulai , ka kali kulai bad ka kali kulai ; bad u la sngap jar jar jar da ka jingsngewrit kaba bun:

en: He answered and said unto them ,  Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven , but to them it is not given .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa ka jingtip shaphang kiei kiei kiba rieh jong ka Hima ki Bneng la ai ha phi , hynrei ym ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Namar la ai ha phi ban tip ia ki jingmaham jong ka hima bneng , hynrei ha ki ym shym la ai ia ki .

en: And they shall take of the blood , and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses , wherein they shall eat it .
kha: Ki briew ki dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam bad tah ïa ka ha ki shawkad bad ha khlieh jingkhang jong kita ki ïing ha kiba kin ïabam ïa kita ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim ia ka snam bad kin shoh ia ka ha ki ar tylli ki liang bad ha ka jaka ba shalor jong ki iing .

en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other  ; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also .
kha: Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na kawei ka ngab , ai ba un thab sa ïa kawei ruh ; lada uno uno u shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong phi , ai ba un shim ruh ïa ka sopti-poh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha uta uba pynkhih ia me ha kawei ka rmiang shyntur ruh u ai ia uwei pat u ; bad uta uba shim noh ia ka jainkup jong me u khang ban ym shim ia ka jainkup jong me ruh .

en: When thou tillest the ground , it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength  ; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth .
kha: Lada me pyrshang ban thung jingthung , ka khyndew kan ym pynmih ei ei ; men long u nongphetwir ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me pynkhih ia ka khyndew , kan ym ai ia me ia ka bor jong ka; ka jingleit jingwan bad ka jingleit jingwan jong ka.

en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee , and another third kingdom of brass , which shall bear rule over all the earth .
kha: Hadien jong phi kan don sa kawei ka hima , ka bym da khraw kum ka jong phi , bad hadien kata sa kaba lai , ka hima kaba da ka rnong , ka ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong me kan mih kawei pat ka hima kaba kham poh ia me, bad kawei pat ka hima kaba lai jong ka nar, kaba lah ban synshar halor ka khyndew baroh kawei .

en: And the children of Israel remembered not the  Lord  their God , who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side :
kha: bad kim shym la shakri shuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la pynim ïa ki na ki nongshun baroh kiba sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel kim kynmaw ia U Trai U Blei jong ki, uba la pyllait im ia ki na ki kti jong ki nongshun jong ki baroh:

en: Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .
kha: Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka ksiar, ka rupa bad ka nar, ym don jingkhein . To khie namarkata, bad to leh, bad U Trai un long bad me .

en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekahaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Pekaiah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh, ha khmih la thoh ha ka Kitab ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel .

en: And he said , Do it the second time . And they did it the second time . And he said , Do it the third time . And they did it the third time .
kha: Ki la leh kumta , bad u ong ,  Leh biang kumta  — bad ki la leh biang kumta . U la ong ,  Leh biang sa shisien ,  bad ki la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To leh ia kata ha ka sien kaba ar . Bad u la ong , To leh ia kata ha ka sien kaba lai . Bad ki la leh ia kata ha ka sien kaba lai .

en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram , the rump , and that which covereth the inwards , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver :
kha: U Aaron u buh ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ jong u masi lyngraw bad jong u langbrot
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shini jong u masi bad u langbrot, ka tyrpeng bad kata kaba tap ia ki bynta ba shapoh bad ki snier bad ka caul halor ka sniehdoh:

en: Blessed art thou , O land , when thy king is the son of nobles , and thy princes eat in due season , for strength , and not for drunkenness !
kha: Hynrei ka ri ka long kaba donbok ban don u syiem uba pynlong ïa la ki jong ki rai bad ki nongïalam kiba bam ha ka por kaba dei , kiba bat synshar ïa lade bad ki bym buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia me, ko ri, haba u syiem jong me u long u khun jong ki riew rangbah, bad ki syiem jong me ki bam ha ka por kaba biang, na ka bynta ka jingkhlain , bad ym na ka bynta ka jingdih buaid !

en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant  ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .
kha: Lada uta u masi kyrtong u pynïap ïa u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , uta u trai masi u dei ban siew ïa u kynrad jong uta u mraw laiphew ki sbai rupa , bad ïa uta u masi dei ban lynthem maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u masi un pynkhih ia u shakri briew ne u shakri lyngkha un ai ha u kynrad jong ki laiphew Shekel rupa , bad u masi un shah pynkhih maw .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Uzza , and he smote him , because he put his hand to the ark : and there he died before God .
kha: Hangta hi U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa u Ussah bad u pynïap ïa u namar ba u ktah ïa ka synduk . U ïap hangta ha khmat U Blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia u Ussa , bad u la shoh ia u , namar u la buh ia la ka kti ha ka synduk: bad hangta u la iap ha khmat U Blei .

en: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms , in calling to remembrance the days of her youth , wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt .
kha: Ka la nang kham long ka nuti ban ïa kaba ka ju long , ka la leh kumba ka la ju leh haba ka dang khynraw , mynba ka la long ka nuti ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la pynbun ia ki kam runar jong ka, ha kaba khot ban kynmaw ia ki sngi samla jong ka, ha kaba ka la ialehkai ia ka kam runar ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass  ; but the end is not by and by .
kha: Wat sheptieng haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki thma bad ki jingïakhih pyrshah bor synshar ; kiba kum kine ki dei ban jia nyngkong , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phin iohsngew ia ki thma bad ki jingkhihwin , wat tieng: namar kine kiei kiei ki dei ban jia nyngkong eh; hynrei ka jingkut kam long da bad da .

en: But if the unbelieving depart , let him depart . A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace .
kha: Pynban , lada u bymngeit u kwah ban iehnoh ïa tnga ka bangeit , ai ba kan long kumta . Ha kiba kum kita ki khep u tnga ne ka tnga bangeit , ki la laitluid ban jied . U Blei u la khot ïa phi ïa ka ban im ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u bym ngeit u leit noh, to ai ba un leit noh . U hynmen ne ka para kam don hapoh ka jinglong mraw ha kum kine ki khep: hynrei U Blei u la khot ia ngi sha ka jingsuk .

en: And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ka jingbishar ka trei : Ka jingshai ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , hynrei ki briew ki ieit ïa ka jingdum ban ïa ka jingshai , namar ba ki kam jong ki , ki long kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingpynrem , kata ka jingshai ka wan sha ka pyrthei , bad ki briew ki ieit ia ka jingdum ban ia ka jingshai , namar ki kam jong ki ki long kiba sniew .

en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days  ; where we abode seven days .
kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng na Philippi hadien ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , bad hadien san sngi ngi la ïasoh ïa ki ha Troas , ha kaba ngi la sah shi taïew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la leit noh na Philipi hadien ki sngi jong u kpu bym don thied , bad ngi la poi ha ki ha Troas ha ki san sngi ; ha kaba ngi sah hynriew sngi .

en: But the fat , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver of the sin offering , he burnt upon the altar  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Nangta u thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ki khyllai , bad ïa ka bynta bakynsai tam jong u dohnud , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka shini bad ki snier bad ka caul halor ka sniehdoh jong ka jingknia pop, u la thang ia ka ha ka almari ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
kha: bad u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka jaka ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bad hangta la pynsah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u Joseph u la shim ia u, bad u la buh ia u ha ka phatok, ka jaka ba la teh ia ki koidi syiem: bad u la don hangta ha phatok .

en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .
kha: U dei ban long uba batskhem ïa ka khubor kaba lah ban shaniah bad kaba ïadei bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai . Ha kane ka rukom un lah ban ai mynsiem ïa kiwei da ka jinghikai bashisha bad ban pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingbakla jong kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba bat skhem ia ka ktien kaba iaineh kumba la hikai ia u , ba un lah da ka jinghikai kaba jem baroh ar ban kyntu bad ban pynngeit ia ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .
kha: Namar ba ka Rebekka kam ïoh khun , u Isaak u la duwai ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ka . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka Rebekka ka la punkhun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la kyrpad ia U Trai na ka bynta ka tnga jong u, namar ba ka la kha khun: bad U Trai u la kyrpad ia u, bad ka Rebek ka tnga jong u ka la pun khun .

en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .
kha: Ho-oid , ka por kan wan haba ki nongap kin khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan don ka sngi ba ki nongap ha u lum Ephram kin pyrta , To khie noh ia phi bad to ngin leit kiew sha Seion sha U Trai jong ngi .

en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  The foxes have holes , and the birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Ki myrsiang ki don ki krem , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don jaka hangno hangno ban dem bad ban pynjahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u , Ki blang ki don ki thliew bad ki sim Iyer ki don ki bniat ; hynrei U Khun u briew um don jaka ban buh ia la ka khlieh .

en: And they journeyed : and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them , and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob .
kha: Haba u Jakob bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki sdang ban mih , ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw ka la wan hap ha ki briew kiba don ha ki shnong ba-marjan , bad kim shym la beh satia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid: bad ka jingtieng U Blei ka la don ha ki shnong kiba don sawdong jong ki , bad kim shym la bud ia ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob .

en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
kha: Lada uno uno na phi da ka jingjia ryngkhat u pynïap ïano ïano , u lah ban leit shata bad lait na uta uba wad kput .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u nongpyniap briew u bym tip bad khlem da tip u lah ban phet noh sha kata: bad kin long ka jaka rieh jong phi na ka jingpynshitom bein ia ka snam .

en: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
kha: Kane ka long kumno ba u Moses u la pynbynta ïa ka ri shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerikho bad ka Jordan mynba u don ha ki pyntha ka Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ri kiba u Moses u la sam ha ki madan Moab , ha kawei pat ka liang ka Jordan , da u Jerikho , shaphang mihngi .

en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .
kha: U Manasseh u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hephsibah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Manasseh u la don shiphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long u Hephzibah .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit bad thied uwei u khra khyndew . U la ong ruh ïa nga ban ïalam katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh ba la tymmen ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Leit bad shim ia ka bilor khyndew, bad shim na ki rangbah jong ki briew , bad na ki rangbah jong ki lyngdoh ; .

en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .
kha: U Moses u ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha ki khlieh jong ki jaitbynriew Israel , u da ong: Kane ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum .

en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it : in the holy place shall it be eaten , in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: U lyngdoh uba kñia ïa uta u mrad un bam ïa u ha ka jaka bakhuid , ha ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh uba ai ia ka na ka bynta ka pop un bam ia ka: ha ka jaka bakhuid yn bam ia ka, ha ka phyllaw jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And the wild asses did stand in the high places , they snuffed up the wind like dragons  ; their eyes did fail , because there was no grass .
kha: Ki kada khlaw ki ïeng halor ki kliar lum bad ki thrang ban ring mynsiem kum ki myrsiang ; ka jingïohi ki khmat jong ki kam ïarap ïa ki namar kim don jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kada khlaw ki la ieng ha ki jaka ba jrong , ki la pynkhih ia ka Iyer kum ki bsein ; ki khmat jong ki ki la jah noh , namar ym don phlang .

en: That make a man an offender for a word , and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate , and turn aside the just for a thing of nought .
kha: U Blei un pynjot ïa kito kiba kren sniew ïa kiwei , kito kiba khanglad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki riewrunar , bad kito kiba kren lamler ban khang ïa ki briew kiba hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pynlong ia u briew uba leh bymman na ka bynta ka ktien , bad ka buh ia ka jingma na ka bynta uta uba pynrem ha ka khyrdop , bad pynphai noh ia kaba dei na ka bynta kaei kaei kaba khlem akor .

en: But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .
kha: hynrei ki la bat ïa u , ki da ong ,  To sah bad ngi ; ka sngi la jan kut bad ka la khreh dum .  Kumta u la leit ban sah bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la khang ia u, ki da ong: To sah bad ngi: namar ka la jan jan janmiet, bad ka sngi ka la jah noh . Bad u la leit rung shapoh ban sah bad ki .

en: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u lumlang ïa ki paid Israel na baroh kawei ka ri , naduh khappud Ijipt ha ka phang shathie sha Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei , khnang ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na Kiriath Jearim sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la lum lang ia ki Israel baroh, naduh Shihor ka ri Ijipt haduh ka jingrung jong ka Hamath, ban wanrah ia ka synduk U Blei na Kirjatjaram .

en: Break forth into joy , sing together , ye waste places of Jerusalem : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , he hath redeemed Jerusalem .
kha: To risa lang da ka jingkmen , phi ki jingpra ka Jerusalem ! U  Trai  un pyllait ïa la ka nongbah bad un pyntngen ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ka jingkmen, to rwai lang, phi pynjot ia ki jaka jong ka Jerusalem: namar U Trai u la pyntngen ia ki briew jong u, u la siewspah ia ka Jerusalem .

en: Make thee bald , and poll thee for thy delicate children  ; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle  ; for they are gone into captivity from thee .
kha: Ko ki paid Judah , to khi ïa la u shñiuh ha ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki khun kiba phi ieit . To pynlong ïa lade kiba syllen kum ki pukni , namar ïa ki khun jong phi yn shim noh na phi ban ïalam sha ka jingringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia me uba sniew, bad to pynkhih ia me na ka bynta ki khun ba jem jong me; pynheh ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me kum u blang ; namar ki la leit sha ka jingshah set na me .

en: Withal praying also for us , that God would open unto us a door of utterance , to speak the mystery of Christ , for which I am also in bonds :
kha: Ha kajuh ka por to duwai ruh na ka bynta jong ngi , ba kumta U Blei un ai ha ngi ka kabu babha ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u shaphang ka jingmaïan U Khrist . Namar kata keiñ balei ba nga don mynta ha byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba duwai ruh na ka bynta jong ngi , ba U Blei un plie ha ngi ia ka jingkhang jong ka jingkren , ban kren ia ka jingmaham jong U Khrist , na ka bynta kaba nga ruh nga don ha ki jingteh:

en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim , to the top of Pisgah , and built seven altars , and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar .
kha: U la ïalam ïa u sha ka madan Sophim kaba ha khlieh u Lum Pisgah . Hangta ruh u la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad u la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u ha ka lyngkha jong u Sophim, ha ka tduh jong ka Pisgah, bad u la tei hynriew tylli ki nongrim bad u la tyrwa ia u masi bad u langbrot ha kawei pa kawei ka nongrim .

en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .
kha: bad nga bitar shikatdei eh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sngewkmen ïa ka jingjar jar bad ka jingsuk . Namar katba nga dang bat ïa ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham pynsniew ïa ki jingshitom jong ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga sngewsih shibun eh ia ki nongwei kiba don ha ka jingsuk: namar nga la sngewsih tang khyndiat , bad ki la iarap ia ka jingjynjar .

en: Now thanks be unto God , which always causeth us to triumph in Christ , and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place .
kha: Hynrei ki jingnguh ki long sha U Blei! Naba ha U Khrist ngi long borabor kiba la ïalam da U Blei kum ki koidi ha ka jingïaid lynti ka jingjop U Khrist . U Blei u pyndonkam ïa ngi ba kata ka jingtip ïa U Khrist kan saphriang kylleng kum ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ainguh ia U Blei uba pynlong ia ngi ban jop ha U Khrist , bad u pynpaw ia ka jingsma jong ka jingtip jong u da ngi ha man la ki jaka .

en: And , behold , I send the promise of my Father upon you : but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem , until ye be endued with power from on high .
kha: Bad nga hi ngan phah halor jong phi ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular . Hynrei phi dei ban ap ha ka nongbah tad ynda ka bor ba najrong ka wan hiar halor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, nga phah ia ka jingkular jong u Kpa jong nga halor jong phi: hynrei to sah ha ka shnong Jerusalem , haduh ba phin da shah pynngop da ka bor na jrong .

en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .
kha: Hynrei ki dang nud hi ban leit kiew sha kata ka ri lum , wat la ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  lymne u Moses kim shim mih na ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la sngewtynnad ban leit sha jrong lum: wat la katta ruh ka synduk ka jutang U Trai bad u Moses , kim shym la mih na ka shnong .

en: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man , neither raising up the people , neither in the synagogues , nor in the city :
kha: Ki Jiw kim shym lap ïa nga ba nga ïasaidnia badno badno hapoh ka Templ , lymne ba ki shem ïa nga ba nga pynkhih ïa u paidbah , la ka long ha ki synagog ne hangno hangno hawei pat hapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la lap ia nga ha ka tempi ba nga ialeh pyrshah bad uno uno u briew, lymne ban pynmih ia ki briew, lymne ha ki synagog ne ha ka shnong:

en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .
kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynthei samla jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ban shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u shakri jong u Abraham , bad ki ïamih lang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebeka u la ieng bad ki dam jong ka, bad ki la shong halor ki kulai, bad ki la bud ia uta u briew: bad uta u shakri u la shim ia ka Rebeka bad u la leit noh .

en: There were also women looking on afar off : among whom was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses , and Salome  ;
kha: Katto katne ngut ki kynthei ki la don hangta , ki khmih na jngai . Napdeng jong ki , long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie jong u Jakob ba kham rit bad u Josis , bad ka Salome .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ruh ki kynthei kiba peit sha jngai: napdeng jong ki ka long ka Maria Magdalene , bad ka Maria ka kmie u Jakob kaba kham duna bad u Joses , bad u Salome ; .

en: It covers 116 districts of 6 States with a resource envelope of Rs . 50 , 000 crore to be implemented in a mission mode campaign in 125 days .
kha: Ka kynthup ia ki 116 tylli ki distrik jong ki 6 tylli ki Jylla bad ka jingdon jingem kaba Rs . 50, 000 klur ban pyntreikam ha ka mission mode campaign ha ki 125 sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthup ia 116 tylli ki District jong ki 6 tylli ki Jylla kiba don ka jingdon jingem kaba Rs . 50,000 klur ban pyntreikam ha ka rukom treikam jong ka mishon ha ki 125 sngi .

en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow , they were whiter than milk , they were more ruddy in body than rubies , their polishing was of sapphire :
kha: Ki khun syiem shynrang jong ngi ki long ki bym bit tngit bad kiba khuid kum ka ïor , kiba koit bakhiah bad kiba khlaiñ , kiba phyrnai da ka jingkoit jingkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Nazarite jong ka ki kham khuid ban ia u slap, ki kham lieh ban ia ka dud, ki kham jem ha ka met ban ia ki ruby, ka jingpynkhuid jong ki ka long kaba jem:

en: And , behold , there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the  Lord  unto Beth–el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .
kha: Ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u nongïathuhlypa na Judah u leit sha Bethel bad u la poi hangta hamar ba u Jeroboam u ïeng ha ka duwan ban kñia jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u briew jong U Blei na Judah da ka ktien U Trai u la wan sha Betel : bad u Jeroboam u la ieng hajan ka jaka bam ban thang jingiwbih .

en: Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u ,  Mem kren ei ei ha nga ? To kynmaw , nga don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phah sahnarphna ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pilat u la ong ha u, Hato me kren ia nga ? phim tip ba nga don ka bor ban sahnarphna ia me bad nga don ka bor ban pyllait ia me ?

en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego . Then they brought these men before the king .
kha: Hangta hi , u syiem u la bitar shla bad u la hukum ban wallam ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Nebuchadnezzar ha ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar jong u u la hukum ban wanrah ia u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego . Nangta ki la wanrah ia kine ki briew ha khmat u syiem .

en: Govt to foot medical bills . Mizoram Health Department instructs all doctors to be accessible any time to any person having medical problems .
kha: Ka sorkar kan siew ia ki bill sumar . Ka tnad ka koit ka khiah jong ka Mizoram ka bthah ia baroh ki doktor ba kin long kiba lah ban leit sha kino kino ki briew kiba don jingeh ha ka liang ka koit ka khiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka leit sha ki bill sumar kjat . Ka tnad ka koit ka khiah ka hikai ia baroh ki doktor ban long kiba lah ban ioh ha kano kano ka por da uno uno u briew uba don jingeh ha ka liang ka koit ka khiah .

en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him  ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïa-pasiaw ïa kine kiei kiei shaphang U Jisu , kumta ma ki bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la phah katto katne ngut ki nongap phira ban kem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Pharisi ki la iohsngew ba ki briew ki la ia kren bein ia u ; bad ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la phah ia ki ophisar ban shim ia u .

en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves ? or need we , as some others , epistles of commendation to you , or letters of commendation from you ?
kha: Hato kane ka pynpaw kumba ngi pynsarong biang shaphang ïa lade ? Hato ka lah ban long ba , kumba long lem kiwei ki briew ruh , ngi donkam ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha phi lane na phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngi sdang biang ban iaroh ia lade ? lane ngi donkam ia ki , kum kiwei pat ki shithi ai khublei ia phi , ne ki shithi ai khublei na phi ?

en: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up  ; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction .
kha: Sngap ïa ka sur jong ki jingud jong ki ha ka lynti sha Luhith , ki jingïam jong ka jingshem jynjar ha ka lynti arsut sha Horonaim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka jingleit sha jrong jong ka Luhith ka jingleit sha jrong; namar ha ka jingleit shapoh ka Horonaim ki nongshun ki la iohsngew ia ka jingpyrta jong ka jingpynjot .

en: Come against her from the utmost border , open her storehouses : cast her up as heaps , and destroy her utterly : let nothing of her be left .
kha: To tur ïaleh ïa ka na ki liang baroh bad pynpra phom ïa ki jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u kew ! Kynton ïa ki jinglute kum ki kynton kew ! Pynjot ïa ka ri ! Wat ieh ei ei ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: To wan pyrshah ia ka na u pud uba kut tam, plie ia ki iing buh jingbam jong ka: bret ia ka kum ki thliew , bad pynjot ia ka pura: wat ai ba kan sah ei ei na ka .

en: So I spake unto you  ; and ye would not hear , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  , and went presumptuously up into the hill .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kren , hynrei phim patiaw satia ; phi la ïaleh pyrshah pynban ïa u , bad da ka mynsiem kaba sngewmeng phi la leit kiew sha kata ka ri lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la kren ia phi ; bad phim shym la iohsngew , hynrei nga la leh pyrshah ia ka hukum U Trai , bad nga la leit sha jrong lum .

en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the  Lord  , of all the best thereof , even the hallowed part thereof out of it .
kha: Ai ïa ka na kaba bha tam kaba phi la ïohpdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki jingai jong phi baroh phin ai ia ka jingainguh kaba khraw jong U Trai , na ka kaba bha tam jong ka baroh .

en: Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !
kha: Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka pukri um , bad ba ki khmat jong nga ka umpohliew ki ummat , khnang ba nga lah ban ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki briew jong nga kiba la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka um , bad ki khmat jong nga ki long ka pung um , ba nga lah ban iam miet bad sngi na ka bynta ka jingpyniap ia ka khun jong ki briew jong nga !

en: All flesh is not the same flesh : but there is one kind of flesh of men , another flesh of beasts , another of fishes , and another of birds .
kha: Bad ka doh jong ki kynja ba-im kam long kajuh ka jait ; u bynriew u don kawei ka jait doh , ki mrad da kawei pat , ki sim da kawei , bad ki dohkha da kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ka doh kam dei kajuh ka doh: hynrei ka don kawei ka jait doh jong ki briew , kawei pat ka doh jong ki mrad , kawei pat ka dohkha bad kawei pat ka doh jong ki sim .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shna ki lum jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa bad phi pynitynnat ïa ki mot sahkynmaw jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi tei ia ki jingtep jong ki nongiathuhlypa bad phi pynitynnad ia ki jingtep jong kiba hok .

en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .
kha: Ka sngi kan wan ha kaba yn pynkut ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew bad yn pynjot thiaw ïa ka jinglehmeng ba kynja briew . Nangta tang ïa U  Trai  hi yn kyntiew burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat kiba jrong jong u briew kin shah pynrit mynsiem bad ka jinglong ba jrong jong ki briew kan shah pynkhih , bad tang U Trai un shah pynkhraw ha kata ka sngi .

en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him , Sir , didst not thou sow good seed in thy field ? from whence then hath it tares ?
kha: Ki shakri jong uta u briew ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , u long u symbai uba bha uba phi la bet hapoh ka lyngkha jong phi ; nangno ki ñiut ki wan mih ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki shakri jong u trai iing ki la wan bad ki la ong ha u, ko sahep, phim shym la bet symbai bha ha ka lyngkha jong me ? nangno ka la bet ia u symbai uba bha ?

en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .
kha: La pyllait noh ïa kita ki saw ngut ki angel ; na ka bynta kane hi ka kynta jong kane hi ka sngi jong une hi u bnai bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pynïap noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki saw ngut ki angel ki la shah pyllait noh shi kynta bad shi sngi bad shi bnai bad shi snem , na ka bynta ban pyniap ia ka bynta kaba lai jong ki briew .

en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .
kha: U pynim bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel na kaba shah pynïap ha ki sing .
translated_en_to_kha: U pyllait im bad u pyllait im , bad u leh ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla ha bneng bad ha khyndew , uba la pyllait im ia u Daniel na ka bor jong ki sing .

en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan , or forward  ; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward .
kha: Ngin ym shim kynti ïa kano kano ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong ki ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , namar ngi la ïohpdiang ïa la ka bhah hangne ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngin ym hiar pateng bad ki ha ka liang jong ka Jordan , ne sha khmat; namar ka pateng jong ngi ka la hap ha ngi ha kane ka liang ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .

en: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of his fathers .
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad ka shnong ha Judah , u tei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ha kaba yn thang ïa ki jingiwbih ha ki blei nongwei . Ha kane ka rukom , u la pynngat ha lade ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong Judah u la shna ia ki jaka ba jrong ban thang jingiwbih sha kiwei pat ki blei , bad u la pynkhih ia U Trai Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u .

en: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .
kha: To shad , to shad , ko  theisamla ka Shullam . Shah ïa ngi ban peit ïa phi katba phi dang shad . Balei phi kwah ban khmih ïa nga katba nga dang shad hapdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki soh ki ai ka jingsma , bad ha ki khyrdop jong ngi ki don ki soh kiba sngewtynnad baroh , kiba thymmai bad kiba rim , kiba nga la buh na ka bynta jong me , ko baieit jong nga .

en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .
kha: Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïohi ïa ka sngi lane ïa ki khlur , bad ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh ngi la duh jingkyrmen ïa ka ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ym shym la paw ka sngi ne ki khlur ha ki sngi kiba bun, bad ym don ka eriong kaba rit kaba la shong ha ngi, la weng noh ia ka jingkyrmen baroh ba ngi dei ban ioh jingpynim nangta .

en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar , Arioch king of Ellasar , Chedorlaomer king of Elam , and Tidal king of nations  ;
kha: Saw ngut ki syiem , u Amraphel jong ka Babilonia , u Ariokh jong ka Ellasar , u Khedorlaomer jong ka Elam , bad u Tidal jong ka Goiim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ki sngi u Amraphel u syiem ka Shinar, u syiem ka Elasar , u syiem ka Elam bad u syiem ba rit jong ki jaitbynriew;

en: And we went before to ship , and sailed unto Assos , there intending to take in Paul : for so had he appointed , minding himself to go afoot .
kha: Ngi la nang leit sha khmat sha ka lieng bad ngi la leit da ka lieng sha Assos , ha kaba ngi la thmu ban kyntiew u Paul ha ka lieng . U la ong ïa ngi ban leh ïa kane , namar u la mut ban leit shata na ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la leit shapoh lieng, bad ngi la leit sha Asos, hangta ngi thmu ban shim ia u Paul: namar kumta u la buh ia lade ban leit noh .

en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .
kha: Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat shongkurim bad ki ; ka khun jong me wat ai ha u khun jong u , lymne ka khun jong u wat shim ha u khun jong me .

en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles ; which is Christ in you , the hope of glory :
kha: Ka jingthmu jong U Blei ka long ban pyntip ïa ka jingmaïan jong u ha ki briew jong u , ïa kane ka jingmaïan basngewtynnat bad badonburom kaba u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh . Bad ka jingmaïan ka long , ba U Khrist u don hapoh jong phi , kaba mut , ba phin ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba U Blei un pynpaw ia kaei ka spah jong ka burom jong kane ka jingmaham hapdeng ki Jutang ; kaba long U Khrist ha phi , ka jingkyrmen jong ka burom:

en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar .
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ha ka snem kaba shiphew ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , kaba long ruh ka snem kaba khatphra jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha U Jeremaiah na U Trai ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Sedekaiah syiem Judah .

en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .
kha: La don arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad u Absalom u la leit noh da ki arspah ngut ki briew na Jerusalem , kiba la khot ; bad ki la leit noh ha ka jinglong kaba suk jong ki , bad kim tip ei ei .

en: If any man serve me , let him follow me  ; and where I am , there shall also my servant be : if any man serve me , him will my Father honour .
kha: Uno uno uba kwah ban shakri ïa nga u dei ban bud ïa nga , khnang ba u shakri jong nga un long lem bad nga hangno hangno ba nga don . Bad u Kpa jong nga un pyndonburom ïa uno uno uba shakri ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u shakri ia nga, to un bud ia nga bad hangno ba nga don, hangta ruh u shakri jong nga un don: lada uno uno u shakri ia nga, ia u u Kpa jong nga un burom .

en: Is it not yet a very little while , and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field , and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest ?
kha: Kumba ka don ka jingong , kan ym slem ba ka khlaw barben kan sa long ka jaka rep , bad ka jaka rep kan sa long pat ka khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam pat long tang khyndiat por bad ka Lebanon kan kylla long ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad ka lyngkha kaba seisoh kan long kum ka khlaw ?

en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram  ;
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba dei da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ki kan long kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang: lai tylli ki jingai na ka bynta u masi , bad ar tylli ki jingai na ka bynta u langbrot;

en: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith .
kha: U Khrist u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkyrkhu kaba U Blei u la kular ha u Abraham kan ïoh wan ha ki Jentil da U Khrist Jisu , khnang ba lyngba ka jingngeit ngin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la kular da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingkyrkhu jong u Abraham kan wan ha ki Jutang lyngba U Jisu Khrist ; ba ngin ioh ia ka jingkular U Mynsiem lyngba ka jingngeit .

en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord , how that he said ,  John indeed baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost .
kha: Te nga la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la lah ong , ‘ U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei ïa phi yn pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga kynmaw ia ka ktien U Trai , kumno u la ong , U Ioannis u la pynbaptis shisha da ka um ; hynrei phin sa shah pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And he ran unto Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou calledst me . And he said , I called not  ; lie down again . And he went and lay down .
kha: bad u la mareh sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hynrei u Eli u jubab ,  Ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang .  Kumta u Samuel u leit thiah biang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mareh sha u Eli, bad u la ong, Hangne nga don; namar me khot ia nga . Bad u la ong, ngam shym la khot shuh ia nga. Bad u la leit thiah noh .

en: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt , in the country of Goshen  ; and they had possessions therein , and grew , and multiplied exceedingly .
kha: Ki Israel ki shong ki sah ha ri Ijipt ha thain Goshen , ha kaba ki ïoh ban lum ka spah ka phew , bad ki nang ïaroi parum pareh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la shong ha ka ri Ijipt, ha ka ri Goshen ; bad ki la don ki jingdon jingem hangta, bad ki la roi bad ki la nang bun palat .

en: So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .
kha: Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u la leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh haduh katta katta ba ka la shim por lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jonah u la ieng bad u la leit sha Ninebe kat kum ka ktien U Trai . Mynta ka Ninebe ka la long ka nongbah kaba khraw palat kaba lai sngi .

en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .
kha: U syiem u la loit noh ïa ka sati ba don muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Ka Esther ka buh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la weng noh ia ka ryntieh jong u, kaba u la shim na u Haman bad u la ai ia ka ha u Mordecai . U Esther u la buh ia u Mordecai halor ka iing u Haman .

en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit , and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints ;
kha: To leh ïa kane baroh ha ka jingduwai , da kaba kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong U Blei . Duwai ha ki por baroh , katba U Mynsiem u ïalam . Namar kane ka daw , to sharai bad wat kynran dien ; duwai borabor na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingduwai beit bad ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad ha U Mynsiem , bad ka jingpeit bniah ia kata da ka jingiaishah bad ka jingkyrpad baroh na ka bynta ki riewkhuid baroh;

en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy : for I have espoused you to one husband , that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ .
kha: Nga don ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong phi , kumba U Blei u sngew ; phi long kum ka theisotti basngur ïa kaba nga la kular ha ka jingshongkurim bad tang ïa uwei u briew , U Khrist hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga sngewsih ia phi da ka jingsngewsih kaba riewblei: namar nga la pynkyntang ia phi ha uwei u tnga, ba ngan pyni ia phi kum u nongleh kam sniew uba khuid ha U Khrist .

en: But Jesus said unto her ,  Let the children first be filled : for it is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it unto the dogs .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ai ba ngin bsa nyngkong shuwa ïa ki khun . Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad ban bret ïa ka ha ki ksew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ka, Ai ba ki khynnah kin dap nyngkong: namar kam long kaba biang ban shim ia u kpu jong ki khynnah bad ban bret ia u ha ki kulai .

en: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .
kha: Hynrei haba ki parabangeit ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u , u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha shnong . Ha ka sngi kaba bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha Derbe .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba ki synran ki dang ieng sawdong jong u, u la ieng bad u la wan shapoh shnong : bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la leit noh bad u Barnabas sha Derbe .

en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack , O king , live for ever : tell thy servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation .
kha: Ki la jubab ïa u syiem ha ka ktien Aramaik ,  To u Syiem Kynrad un im junom ! To ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi , bad ngin batai ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to kren ia ki Khaldes ha u syiem ha Syriack , ko syiem, to im junom: to iathuh ia ki shakri jong me ia ka jingphohsniew , bad ngin pyni ia ka jingbatai .

en: And they arose , and went to Ziph before Saul : but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon , in the plain on the south of Jeshimon .
kha: Kumta ki mihnoh bad leit phai sha Siph ha shuwa jong u Saul . U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki don ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon , ha kawei ka them bakynjah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri khlaw Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng bad ki la leit sha ka ri Sepngi ha khmat u Saul : hynrei u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la don ha ka ri khlaw Maon, ha ka madan shaphang shathie jong u Jeshimon .

en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches  ; with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .
kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Spain bad pha la shim ïa ka rupa , ka nar , ka tin , bad ka sisa da kaba siewdor na ka bynta ki tiar ba-dap kyrhai jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Tarshish u long u nongkhaii jong me namar ka jingbun ki jait spah baroh da ka rupa, ka nar, ka tin bad ka lead , ki la khaii ha ki fair jong me .

en: Flee ye , turn back , dwell deep , O inhabitants of Dedan  ; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him , the time that I will visit him .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Dedan , to phai noh bad phet ! To rieh ! Ngan pynjot ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , namar ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia phi, phai noh, to shong jylliew, ko nongshong shnong jong u Dedan ; namar ngan wanrah ia ka jingjynjar jong u Iso halor jong u, ka por ba ngan leit jngoh ia u .

en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .
kha: Hynrei wat kmen namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng jong phi la thoh ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ha kane kam sngewbha, ba ki mynsiem ki hap ha phi ; hynrei ki kham sngewbha, namar la thoh ia ki kyrteng jong phi ha bneng .

en: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .
kha: Na ki nongbah baroh jong ka Benjamin ki wan sha Gibeah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun shynrang ki la ialum lang na ki shnong sha Gibeah , ban leit shabar ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun Israel .

en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
kha: U Joash u la don hynñiew snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sibaïah na ka nongbah Beersheba .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joash u la don hynriew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kyrteng jong ka kmie jong u ruh ka long ka Zbiah jong u Beersheba .

en: I will therefore that the younger women marry , bear children , guide the house , give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully .
kha: Te ngan kham lah ba ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla kin shongkurim , kin don ki khun ki kti , bad sumar ïa la ki ïing , khnang ban ym ailad ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ban kren sniew ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym ai lad ia ki kynthei kiba kham rit ban shongkurim , ban kha khun , ban ialam ia ka iing , ban ym ai lad ia u nongshun ban kren bein .

en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .
kha: U hukum ïa ki ban wallam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiem . Ka mahadei ka long ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiem u kwah ban pyn-i sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jong ka ha ki rangbah synshar bad ha baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban wanrah ia ka mahadei ha khmat u syiem ryngkat bad ka khlieh syiem, ban pyni ia ki briew bad ki syiem ia ka jingitynnad jong ka: namar ka la long kaba dei ban peit .

en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
kha: Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi dei ban ïoh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Hynrei lada don napdeng jong phi kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin long kiba janai: bad lada ha kano kano ka kam phi long lym kumta , U Blei un pynpaw wat ia kane ha phi .

en: And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .
kha: Bad kumta ki la kyntait ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lait noh tang hapoh ka shnong jong u bad da kiba ha ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sngewsih ia u . Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki, U nongiathuhlypa um long uba khlem burom, hynrei ha la ka jong ka ri bad ha la ka jong ka iing .

en: In the international market , both gold and silver were trading lower at USD 1 , 609 . 60 per ounce and USD 18 . 26 per ounce , respectively .
kha: Ha ka iew ka hat jong ka pyrthei , ka ksiar bad ka rupa baroh ar ki die kham duna ha ka dor USD 1, 609 . 60 shi ounce bad USD 18 . 26 shi ounce , kawei hadien kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka iew pyrthei , baroh ar ka ksiar bad ka rupa ki kham duna ha ka dor 1 , 609 . 60 shi ounce bad ka USD 18 . 26 shi ounce .

en: And when they had been there many days , Festus declared Paul s cause unto the king , saying , There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix :
kha: Hadien ba ki la don hangta bun sngi , u Phestos u la batai ïa ka jinglong jingman jong u Paul ha u syiem .  Don u briew hangne ïa uba la ieh koidi da u Pheliks ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la don hangta bun sngi, u Festo u la pynbna ia u Paul ha u syiem, u da ong: Don uwei u briew uba la shah iehnoh ha ki jingteh ha u Felix:

en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
kha: Ïa ki them kiba seisoh jong ka Judah la pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki da ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba ki them ba la jied jong me kin dap da ki kali kit kulai bad ki kulai kin buh ia lade ha ka jingkhang .

en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :
kha: Nangta ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kajuh ka khana :  Uto u mraw Hebru ba phi la wan ïalam hangne , u la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la kren ha u kat kum kine ki ktien, ka da ong: U shakri Hebru uba me la wanrah ha ngi, u la wan rung ha nga ban rkhie bein ia nga:

en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth , and built him an house , and made booths for his cattle : therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .
kha: Hynrei u Jakob u la leit sha Sukkoth , ha kaba u la shna ka ïing ïa lade bad ki sem na ka bynta ki jingri jong u . Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Sukkoth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la leit sha Sucoth bad u la tei ia u ia ka iing bad u la shna ia ki ïing masi jong u: namarkata la khot ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Sucoth .

en: And am I now come up without the  Lord  against this land to destroy it ? the  Lord  said unto me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade u la ïathuh ha nga ban tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bad pynjot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato nga wan mynta khlem U Trai pyrshah ia kane ka ri ban pynjot ia ka ? U Trai u la ong ha nga , To leit sha kane ka ri bad pynjot ia ka .

en: ( For that righteous man dwelling among them , in seeing and hearing , vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds  ; )
kha: Uta u briew uba bha u la im hapdeng jong ki , bad man la ka sngi u shah ïa ka jingkordit haba u la ïohi bad la ïohsngew ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta uta u briew uba hok uba shong hapdeng jong ki, haba u iohi bad iohsngew ia ka mynsiem hok jong u man la ka sngi da ki kam bymman jong ki ; )

en: And after this , Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre : the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan .
kha: Te u Abraham u la tep ïa ka Sarah ka tnga jong u ha kata ka krem ha ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kane , u Abraham u la tep ia ka Sarah jong u ha ka krem jong ka lyngkha Machpelah ha khmat u Mamre: kumjuh ruh u Hebron ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .
kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha ka jaka ïa kaba la khot ka Marah , hynrei ka um hangta ka long kaba kthang haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban dih ïa ka . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Marah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha Marah , kim lah ban dih ia ki um Marah: namar kata la khot ia ka Marah .

en: So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up upon their feet , an exceeding great army .
kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba u la bthah ïa nga . Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ka la rung ha kita ki met , bad ki la khie im bad ki la ïeng joit . Ki la ïabun bah na ki kat ban pynlong ka kynhun shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la iathuhlypa kumba u la hukum ia nga, bad ka mynsiem ka la wan ha ki, bad ki la im, bad ki la ieng ha ki kjat jong ki, ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw palat .
