en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever .
kha: Kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , nga kular ba u Jonadab u khun jong u Rekhab un don borabor ïa u shynrang u ban hiarpateng ban shakri ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; u khun u Rehab un ym kwah ia u briew ban ieng ha khmat jong nga junom .

en: For these two years hath the famine been in the land : and yet there are five years , in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest .
kha: Kane ka long tang ka snem kaba ar jong ka  nemsniew ha kane ka ri , bad kan dang sah sa san snem ha kiba yn ym don ba lur ne ba ot .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine ki ar snem ka jingkyrduh ka la don ha ka ri: bad wat la katta ruh ki don san snem , ha kaba ym don ka jingot ne ot .

en: Which say to the seers , See not  ; and to the prophets , Prophesy not unto us right things , speak unto us smooth things , prophesy deceits :
kha: Ki ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban sngap jar . Ki ong ,  Wat kren ha ngi shaphang kaei kaba dei . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi kwah ban ïohsngew . Ai ba ki jingïohi rngai jong ngi kin sah bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ong ha ki nongiohi , Wat iohi ia ki ktien bad ha ki nongiathuhlypa , Wat iathuhlypa ia ngi ia kiei kiei kiba dei , kren ia ngi ia kiei kiei kiba jem:

en: Nevertheless for David s sake did the  Lord  his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem , to set up his son after him , and to establish Jerusalem :
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta u Dabid , U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la ai ïa u Abijah u khun ban synshar hadien jong u ha Jerusalem bad ban sumar ïa ka Jerusalem ba kan skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh na ka bynta u Dabid u Trai U Blei jong u u la ai ia u ia ka sharak ha Jerusalem , ban pynlong ia u khun jong u hadien jong u , bad ban pynskhem ia ka Jerusalem:

en: And fields shall be bought in this land , whereof ye say , It is desolate without man or beast  ; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
kha: Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kane ka ri kan long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba ki briew lymne ki mrad kin im , bad ba ïa ka yn ai noh sha ki nong Babilonia . Hynrei ïa ki lyngkha yn sa thied pat ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki lyngkha kin long kiba la thied ha kane ka ri , na kaba phi ong , La pynjot khlem briew ne mrad ; la ai ha ka kti jong ki Khaldes .

en: And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
kha: Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um pat shym la kren ha u Shemaïah , hynrei ba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la pynbam pisa ïa u ban ai ïa nga ïa kane ka jingmaham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, nga la sngewthuh ba U Blei um shym la phah ia u ; hynrei ba u la pynpaw ia kane ka jingiathuhlypa pyrshah ia nga: namar u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la thung ia u .

en: But that we write unto them , that they abstain from pollutions of idols , and from fornication , and from things strangled , and from blood .
kha: Pynban , ngi dei ban thoh ka shithi da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ba la kñia ïa ka ha ki bleithaw ; ban kyndiah na ka jingawria ; bad ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba ngi thoh ha ki , ba ki kiar na ki jingpynjakhlia ia ki bleithaw bad na ka jingleh be-ijot bad na kiei kiei kiba la tyrkhong bad na ka snam .

en: And Delilah said to Samson , Tell me , I pray thee , wherein thy great strength lieth , and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee .
kha: Kumta ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson ,  Sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban long uba khlaiñbor bha . Lada uno uno u kwah ban khum ïa phi bad pynlong u bym lah shuh ban leh ei ei , da kumno un leh ïa kata ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Delilah u la ong ha u Samson, To iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ha kaba ka bor bah jong me ka sah, bad da kaba me lah ban shah teh ban pynshitom ia me .

en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .
kha: U Dabid u nang ïai bteng la ka lynti jong u lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah ; kita arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la thait eh , kim lah shuh ban jam sha shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Dabid u la bud ia u bad saw spah ngut ki briew: namar arspah ngut ki la sahdien , kiba la lyngngoh haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban leit sha ka wah Besor .

en: And before him shall be gathered all nations : and he shall separate them one from another , as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats :
kha: bad ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh yn lumlang ha khmat jong u . Nangta un phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun , kumba u nongaplangbrot u pynïakhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha khmat jong u yn lum lang ia ki jaitbynriew baroh: bad un pyniakhlad ia ki iwei na iwei pat, kumba u nongaplangbrot u phiah ia ki langbrot jong u na ki blang:

en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .
kha: bad hikai ïa ki ban kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad ngan ïai don ryngkat lem bad phi , haduh kaba kut ka Ïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinghikai ia ki ban sumar ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia phi: bad, ha khmih, nga don ryngkat bad phi, wat haduh kaba kut jong ka pyrthei . Amen .

en: He spake also this parable  ;  A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard  ; and he came and sought fruit thereon , and found none .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la don uwei u diengsoh Dumbur uba mih ha ka bri sohwaiñ jong u . U la leit khmih soh Dumbur ha u hynrei um shem ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren ruh ia kane ka pharshi ; Uwei u briew u don u dieng sohjew ba la thung ha ka kper sohjew jong u ; bad u la wan bad u la wad soh ha kata ka por , bad um lap ei ei .

en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard , they have trodden my portion under foot , they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness .
kha: Shibun ki nongsynshar nongwei ki la pynjot ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga ; ki la ïuhroit ïa ki lyngkha jong nga ; ki la pynkylla ïa ka ri ba-itynnat jong nga sha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun ki nongap ki la pynjot ia ka kper sohjew jong nga , ki la iaid kjat ia ka bynta jong nga hapoh ka kjat , ki la pynlong ia ka bynta kaba sngewtynnad jong nga ka ri khlaw kaba la jot .

en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .
kha: Ma phi te , kiba bam tang ki jhur — balei phi bishar ïa la u parabangeit ? Bad ma phi kiba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh — balei phi peitbeiñ ïa la u parabangeit ? Baroh na ngi , ngin hap ban ïeng ha khmat U Blei ban shah bishar da u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei balei me bishar ia u hynmen jong me ? lane balei me buh ia u hynmen jong me ? namar baroh ngin ieng ha khmat ka jaka bishar jong U Khrist .

en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka kyrteng jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na phi , bad ma phi na u , da ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi bad jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist kan long kaba donburom ha phi bad phi ha u , kat kum ka jingaiei U Blei jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
kha: Lada men dang ïoh khun shuh nalor jong ki , kita kin ym dei ki jong nga ; kano kano ka bynta kaba kin ïohpateng kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingmih jong me kaba me kha hadien jong ki, kan long ka jong me, bad yn khot ia ka kyrteng jong ki hynmen jong ki ha ka pateng jong ki .

en: This twenty years have I been with thee  ; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young , and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten .
kha: Nga la don bad phi mynta la arphew snem ; ki langbrot bad ki blang jong phi kim shym la sangeh ban kha khun , bad ngam pat ju bam doh ïa uno uno na ki langbrot shynrang na ki kynhun jingri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka arphew snem nga la don bad me; ki khun masi jong me bad ki blang jong me kim shym la bret ia ki khun masi jong me bad ki langbrot jong me ngam shym la bam .

en: Yea , all the people of the land shall bury them  ; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un ïarap lang ha kaba tep ïa ki , bad ïa ki yn ai burom na ka bynta kane , ha ka sngi jong ka jingjop thiaw jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki briew baroh jong ka ri kin tep ia ki ; bad kan long ha ki ka kyrteng ha ka sngi ba ngan shah pyndonburom , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :
kha: U la shim ïa uwei na ka longïing jong u syiem , u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u , bad u la pynlong ïa u ban smai ban long uba ïaineh skhem . U la rah koidi ïa ki rangbah badonkam
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shim ia u symbai syiem bad u la leh ia ka jutang bad u: u la shim ruh ia ka ri kaba khlain:

en: And Samuel said unto the people , It is the  Lord  that advanced Moses and Aaron , and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: U Samuel u ong shuh shuh ,  U dei U  Trai  keiñ uba la thung ïa u Moses bad u Aaron bad uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha ki briew , Dei U Trai uba la pynmih ia u Moses bad u Aaron bad uba la wanrah ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .
kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; kan kham jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia u symbai jong me kum ka dewmet jong ka khyndew: kumta lada u briew u lah ban khein ia ka dewmet jong ka khyndew , te u symbai jong me ruh un shah khein .

en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;
kha: bad u lyngdoh un ïalam ïa u shabar ka jaka shong dara , bad un khmih bha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un mih noh na ka shnong ; bad u lyngdoh un peit, bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh ka la koit ha u nongpang sniehdoh ; .

en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
kha: Wah ïa ka halor ki saw tylli ki rishot kiba da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar , ha kiba la buh ïa ki bnoh ksiar , bad ïa kiba la thep ha ki thliew tnaw rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pyndait ia ka ha ki saw tylli ki lum ba la pyndap da ka ksiar: ki hook jong ki kin long ki ksiar, ha ki saw tylli ki socket rupa .

en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :
kha: Jin haduh sawphew snem nga la ijli ïa kito ki briew . Nga la ong , ‘ Haduh katno ki long kiba shetkylla ! Ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Sawphew snem nga la sngewsih ia kane ka pateng , bad nga la ong , Ka dei ka briew kaba bakla ha ka dohnud jong ki , bad kim shym la ithuh ia ki lynti jong nga:

en: It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof : an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
kha: Nga lah ban ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba ïeng hangta ; nga peit lyngngoh , hynrei ngam lah ban ong ka dei kaei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ieng slem , hynrei ngam lah ban ithuh ia ka dur jong ka: ka dur ka la don ha khmat ki khmat jong nga , ka la don ka jingsngap jar , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba ong , .

en: These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the  Lord  said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .
kha: U Aaron bad u Moses ki la long kita ha kiba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ïalam noh ïa ki jait Israel na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kita u Aaron bad u Moses ha kiba U Trai u la ong , To wanrah ia ki khun Israel na ka ri Ijipt kat kum ki kynhun shipai jong ki .

en: We remember the fish , which we did eat in Egypt freely  ; the cucumbers , and the melons , and the leeks , and the onions , and the garlick :
kha: Ha Ijipt ngi ju ïabam ki dohkha baroh kiba ngi kwah , bad ngim siew ei ei . Kynmaw ïa ki sohkhia , ki pathaw bam-im , ki jyllang , ki piat , bad ki rynsun ba ngi ju ïoh ban bam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi kynmaw ia ki dohkha kiba ngi la bam ha Ijipt da kaba laitluid ia ki sohjew, bad ki sohjew, bad ki sohjew, bad u sohjew, bad u sohjew:

en: Or have found that which was lost , and lieth concerning it , and sweareth falsely  ; in any of all these that a man doeth , sinning therein :
kha: lane da kaba thok shaphang kano kano ba ka la jah noh bad u smai ba um shym shem pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane ki la shem ia kata kaba la jah noh, bad ka sah ha ka, bad ka smai lamler ha kano kano na kine baroh kaba u briew u leh, da kaba leh pop ha kata:

en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .
kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ia la ka kti halor ka khlieh jong ka jingknia pop , bad un pyniap ia ka na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ha ka jaka ba ki pyniap ia ka jingknia thang .

en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .
kha: Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wan sha ngi na ki Philistia ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba shahshitom kin shem ka jingshngain hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba u briew un jubab ia ki nonglam khubor jong ka jaitbynriew ? Ba U Trai u la seng ia ka Seion bad kiba duk jong ki briew jong u kin shaniah ha ka .

en: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him  ; ) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .
kha: Ki la lah bud ïa U Jisu mynba u don ha Galilaïa bad ïarap ïa u . Bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la wan sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u ki la ïadon ruh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kano ruh, haba u la don ha Galilaia, u la bud ia u, bad u la shakri ia u ) bad bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la wan ryngkat bad u sha Jerusalem .

en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .
kha: Mar kumta hi ka la khie bad ka la sdang ban ïaid shane shatai . ( Ka la don khat-ar snem ka rta . ) Haba kane ka la jia , ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi ka dam ka la mih, bad ka la iaid ; namar ka la dap shiphew snem . Bad ki la lyngngoh da ka jinglyngngoh kaba khraw .

en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .
kha: Suh ïa ka sopti u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñspong ruh da ka linen bani ; bad ïa u panpoh ruh uba la suh pynpur itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynkhuid ia ka jain kaba bha, bad men shna ia ka jain kaba bha, bad men shna ia ka jain kaba jem .

en: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof , even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof , and the oil for light ,
kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , ïa ki sharak jong u , ïa ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ïa ka umphniang ïa ki sharak jong u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sharak kaba khuid , bad ki sharak jong ka , wat bad ki sharak ban buh ryntih , bad ki jingthung jong ka baroh , bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingshai , .

en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .
kha: Ban ïoh ïa u soh uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba swai , phin ïoh u soh uba sniew . Ïa u dieng la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: La u dieng u long uba bha, bad u soh jong u u long uba bha;

en: Then said his sister to Pharaoh s daughter , Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women , that she may nurse the child for thee ?
kha: Nangta ka hynmen jong u ka ong ha ka khun u Pharaoh ,  Hato ngan leit khot ïa kawei ka kynthei Hebru ba kan ri bad sumar ïa une u khunlung na ka bynta jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ka para jong u ha ka khun jong u Pharaoh, Hato ngan leit khot ia me ia ka nongsumar jong ki kynthei Hebru , ba kan ai dud ia u khun na ka bynta jong me ?

en: Touching the Almighty , we cannot find him out : he is excellent in power , and in judgment , and in plenty of justice : he will not afflict .
kha: Ka bor U Blei ka long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ngim lah ban wan hajan jong u ; u long uba hok bad uba beit ha ka jingïadei jong u bad ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ktah ia u Blei Baroh , ngim lah ban shem ia u: u long uba tbit bha ha ka bor , bad ha ka jingbishar , bad ha ka hok kaba bun: un ym pynshitom .

en: And it was so , that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel , the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob :
kha: Haba kane ka la jia , ki nongïalam jong ka Gilead ki leit wallam biang ïa u Jephthah na ri Tob .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba ki khun shynrang jong ka Ammon ki la ialeh thma pyrshah ia ki Israel , ki rangbah Gilead ki la leit ban leit shim ia u Jephthah na ka ri u Tob:

en: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother , that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon .
kha: U la buh ïa kiba sah na ki kynhun jong u hapoh ka hukum jong u Abishai , u para jong u , uba la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki briew u la aiti ha ka kti jong u Abisai u hynmen jong u, ba un buh ia ki ha ka kynhun pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon .

en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .
kha: Lada U Blei uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar ding baklang bad na ka bor jong phi , te un leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kumta , U Blei jong ngi uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ia ngi na ka ding kaba thang , bad un pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti jong me ko syiem .

en: And they shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones  ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .
kha: Nangta un bujli da kiwei pat ki maw ha ka jaka kita kiba la weng noh , bad yn sa ñiad astor thymmai ïa kita ki kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dei ban shim ia kiwei pat ki maw bad buh ia ki ha ka jaka jong kita ki maw ; bad un shim ia kiwei pat ki maw bad un buh ia ka iing .

en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shong ha Ijipt , kumba nga pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pynshitom ia ki kiba shong ha ka ri Ijipt kumba nga la pynshitom ia ka Jerusalem da ka waitlam bad da ka jingpang:

en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .
kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade bad ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade, bad ia ka jinghikai ; to iai bteng ha ki: namar da kaba leh ia kane me pynim ia lade bad ia kita kiba iohsngew ia me .

en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers  skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof .
kha: Wan ïalam ïa kiba na ka jait Lebi bad thung ïa ki kum ki shakri ïa u Aaron u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ha ka jingtap jong ki sniehdoh bad un pynphriang halor jong ka da ka jain kaba rong saw baroh kawei .

en: Because the  Lord  was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them , therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness .
kha: ba me pynïap ïa la ki briew ha ka ri khlaw namar ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba U Trai um lah ban wanrah ia une u briew sha ka ri kaba u la sngap jar ha ki , namarkata u la pyniap ia ki ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And the elders of his house arose , and went to him , to raise him up from the earth : but he would not , neither did he eat bread with them .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar na ka ïingbishar jong u ki leit bad pyrshang ban pynkhie ïa u , hynrei um treh , bad um bam ei ei lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka iing jong u ki la ieng bad ki la leit sha u, ban pynmih ia u na ka khyndew: hynrei um shym la mon bad um shym la bam kpu bad ki .

en: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar , and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god .
kha: Ha man ka jaka mane blei ki rangbah ki thiah ha ki jaiñ ïa kaba ki la shim na kiba duk kiba la buh bynda na ka bynta ki ram . Ha ka templ U Blei jong ki , ki dih ïa ka waiñ ba ki la shim na kito kiba ki shah pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki thiah ha ki jain ba la buh da kawei pa kawei ka almari , bad ki dih ia ka wain jong kiba la shah pynrem ha iing jong u blei jong ki .

en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U long u briew uba bha , uba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U don uwei u briew ha ka ri Uz, uba la jer kyrteng u Job ; bad uta u briew u long uba janai bad uba hok , bad uta uba la sheptieng ia U Blei bad uba la sngewsih ia ka jingsniew .

en: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .
kha: Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim ki la ïamihnoh shabar na ka lieng ha la ka kynhun kynhun ka jait jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u mrad, uwei pa uwei u sim bad uwei pa uwei u sim bad kaei kaei kaba rung ha ka khyndew , hadien ki jait jong ki .

en: They shall not make baldness upon their head , neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard , nor make any cuttings in their flesh .
kha: U lyngdoh um dei ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhkhlieh , lane khap ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh , lane pynmong ïa la ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Kim dei ban leh lyngkhuid ia ka khlieh jong ki , lymne kin ym ot ia ka tduh jong ka ryndang jong ki , lymne kin ym shet ei ei ha ka doh jong ki .

en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .
kha: U Demas u la kham noh ha ki kam pyrthei bad u la iehnoh ïa nga , bad u la leit noh sha Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la leit sha Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Demas u la iehnoh ia nga, haba u la ieit ia kane ka pyrthei kaba mynta, bad u la leit noh sha Thessaloni; Ki jingbam ba la shna sha Kalatia, u Titus sha Dalmaia .

en: But if a man find a betrothed damsel in the field , and the man force her , and lie with her : then the man only that lay with her shall die :
kha: Lada u briew u ïakynduh ha lum ïa ka briew kaba la ïatehktien bad uwei pat u briew , bad u batbor ïa ka , dei ban pynïap tang ïa uta u shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u briew u shem ia ka dam kaba la tyrkhong ha lyngkha bad uta u briew u pynbor ia ka bad u thiah bad ka : te uta u briew uba thiah bad ka un iap:

en: But the children of Belial said , How shall this man save us ? And they despised him , and brought him no presents . But he held his peace .
kha: Hynrei don ki riewkai kiba ong ,  Kumno da kum une u briew u lah ban lehbha ïa ngi ?  Ki ibeiñ ïa u Saul bad kim shym wanrah ïa u kano kano ka jingai sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun jong u Belial ki la ong , Kumno une u briew un pynim ia ngi ? Ki la lehbein ia u bad kim wanrah ia u ia ki jingai sngewbha . Hynrei u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u .

en: And again I say unto you , It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
kha: Nga ban biang : ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa kaba ka ut ka rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien nga ong ha phi , Ka kham suk ia u kulai ban iaid lyngba ka khmat jong ka nar , ban ia u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka hima U Blei .

en: I Paul have written it with mine own hand , I will repay it : albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides .
kha: Hangne , ngan thoh ïa kane da ka kti jong nga hi :  Ma nga , u Paul , ngan siew pat ïa me  ( Ha ka jingshisha , ngam dei ban pynkynmaw ïa me , ba me shahram ïa lade hi ha nga . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nga Paul nga la thoh ia ka da ka kti jong nga hi: wat la ngam ong ha me kumno me dei ha nga wat ia lade nalor kata .

en: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli , that the iniquity of Eli s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever .
kha: Namar kata nga la pynbna da ka jingsngewkhia ba ha ka ïing u Eli yn ym don jingkñia lane ka jingainguh kaba lah ban weng noh ïa kane ka pop bashyrkhei ba ka ïing jong u ka la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namarkata nga la smai ha ka iing u Eli, ba ka jingbymhok jong ka iing u Eli kan ym long kaba khuid da ka jingknia ne ka jingainguh junom .

en: And when forty years were expired , there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush .
kha: Hadien ba ki sawphew snem ki la ïaid , u angel u la paw ha u Moses ha ki thylliej ding jong ka  lawlynnong kaba ing hajan u lum Sinai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la kut sawphew snem , la paw ha u ha ka ri khlaw jong u lum Sinai u angel U Trai ha ka ding kaba rkhiang ha ka khlaw .

en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul , and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah , from Dan even to Beer–sheba .
kha: U  Trai  u la kular ha u Dabid ba un shim noh ïa ka hima na u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad un thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem jong ki Israel bad ki Judah , naduh na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka ri . Mynta to U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynurlong shisha ïa kane !
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pynkylla ia ka hima na ka iing u Saul bad ban buh ia ka khet u Dabid halor ki Israel bad halor ka Judah, naduh Dan haduh Beersheba .

en: Unless otherwise indicated , Scripture quotations are from the modern-language New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures —With References .
kha: Ïa ki dkhot kotbah la sot na ka The Holy Bible Khasi - O .V . Reference .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ym shym la pyni da kumwei pat, ki jingkynthoh jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ki long na ka jingpynkylla thymmai ia ka pyrthei kaba mynta jong ki Jingthoh Bakhuid  Da ki jingpynkylla .

en: I rose up to open to my beloved  ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .
kha: Ka shadem jong phi ka long kum ki khiat , ki ar tylli ki skei synrap kiba bam jingbam hapdeng ki  tiew lili .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ieng ban plie ia u nongieit jong nga; bad ki kti jong nga ki la hap da ka jingsma kaba thiang, ha ki kti jong ka jingkhang .

en: Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .
kha: Kumta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la leit noh bad ki rangbah jong u bad wallam pat ïa ki apostol . Kim shym la pyndonkam ïa ka bor , namar ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki paidbah ki lah ban lynthem maw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit sha u kapten bad ki ophisar , bad u la wanrah ia ki khlem da leh donbor: namar ki la tieng ia ki briew , ioh ba kin shah pynkhih maw .

en: But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .
kha: Phi shisha phi la thmu sniew ïa nga , hynrei U Blei u la pynphai ïa kata sha kaba bha , khnang ba bun ki briew kiba dang im mynta kin ïoh im namar kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia phi, phi la pyrkhat sniew ia nga ; hynrei U Blei u la thmu ia ka ha ka jingbha, ban pynlong ia ka kumba ka long mynta ka sngi, ban pynim ia kiba bun ki briew kiba im .

en: And they spake unto Moses , saying , The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work , which the  Lord  commanded to make .
kha: bad ki leit ïathuh ha u Moses ,  Ki paidbah ki la wallam palat ban ïa kaba ngi donkam na ka bynta ka jingtrei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ha u Moses, ki da ong: Ki briew ki wanrah kham bun ban ia ka jingshakri jong ka kam kaba U Trai u la hukum ban leh .

en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus , when I went into Macedonia , that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine ,
kha: Nga kwah ïa me ba men sah ha Ephesos , kumba nga la bthah ïa me mynba nga la don ha ka lynti sha Makedonia . Don na ki briew hangta kiba la ai ïa ki jinghikai lamler , bad me dei ban maham ïa ki ban sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga la kyrpad ia me ban iaineh ha Ephesos, haba nga la leit sha Makedonia, ba me lah ban kynnoh ia ki katto katne ba kim hikai ia kawei pat ka jinghikai .

en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died  ; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son , which was given him in mount Ephraim .
kha: U Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron u la ïap , bad la tep ha Gibeah , ka shnong ha ka ri lum Ephraim ïa kaba la ai ha u khun jong u , u Phinehas .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eleasar u khun u Aaron u la iap; bad ki la tep ia u ha u lum uba iadei bad u Phinehas u khun jong u, uba la ai ha u ha u lum Ephraham .

en: They take up all of them with the angle , they catch them in their net , and gather them in their drag : therefore they rejoice and are glad .
kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki kem ïa ki briew da ki khwai , la kumba ki dei ki dohkha . Ki ring ïa ki na ki jar bad ki risa da ka jingkmen ïa ka jingïoh jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shim ia ki baroh da ka angle , ki kem ia ki ha ka net jong ki , bad ki lum ia ki ha ka jingkhih jong ki: namarkata ki sngewbha bad ki sngewbha .

en: And they came to Balaam , and said to him , Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor , Let nothing , I pray thee , hinder thee from coming unto me :
kha: Ki la leit sha u Balaam bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na u Balak :  Sngewbha wat shah ba kaei kaei kan khanglad ïa phi ban wan sha nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan sha u Balaam bad ki la ong ha u, Kumta u Balak u khun u Siphor, Wat ai ba ym don ei ei, nga kyrpad ia me, ba phin ym lah ban wan sha nga:

en: And he spake unto him yet again , and said , Peradventure there shall be forty found there . And he said , I will not do it for forty s sake .
kha: U Abraham u kren biang ,  Lehse yn don pat tang sawphew ngut ?  U ruh u jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka lada don sawphew ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kren biang ia u, bad u la ong, "Haduh mynta yn sa lap sawphew ngut hangta . Bad u la ong , Ngan ym leh ia kata na ka bynta sawphew ngut .

en: Not for your sakes do I this , saith the Lord  God  , be it known unto you : be ashamed and confounded for your own ways , O house of Israel .
kha: Ko Israel , nga kwah ba phin tip ba ngam shym leh ïa kane baroh namar jong phi . Nga kwah ba phin da sngewlehrain bad sngewjahburom ïa kaei kaba phi la leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym na ka bynta jong phi nga leh ia kane, ong U Trai Blei, to tip ia phi: to sngewlehrain bad sngewlehrain ia la ki jong ki lynti , ko iing Israel .

en: Now therefore perform the doing of it ; that as there was a readiness to will , so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have .
kha: To ïai trei , te , bad pyndep ïa ka kam ! To long kiba thrang ban pyndep ïa ka kumba phi la long ha kaba thmu ïa ka , bad to leh ïa ka da kaei kaba phi don mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to leh ia ka kam jong ka ; ba kumba ka la don ka jingpynkhreh ban mon , kumta ka lah ban don ka jinglehkai ruh na kata kaba phi don .

en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee , where he made the water wine . And there was a certain nobleman , whose son was sick at Capernaum .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u leit biang sha Kana ha Galilaïa , ha kaba u la pynkylla waiñ ïa ka um . Uwei u rangbah synshar ka sorkar u la don hangta uba u khun jong u , u la pang , ha Kapernam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Jisu u la wan biang sha Kana Galilaia, ha kaba u la pynlong ia ka um wain . Bad don uwei u riew donburom uba u khun jong u u la pang ha Kaparnaum .

en: But when his heart was lifted up , and his mind hardened in pride , he was deposed from his kingly throne , and they took his glory from him :
kha: Hynrei namar ba u la long uba sarong , uba eh ryndang , bad uba runar , la weng noh ïa u na ka khet syiem bad u la duh noh ïa ka jaka badonburom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka dohnud jong u ka la kiew shaneng, bad ka jingmut jong u ka la nang jur ha ka jingsarong, la pynhap noh ia u na ka khet syiem jong u, bad ki la shim noh ia ka burom jong u na u:

en: And this continued by the space of two years  ; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus , both Jews and Greeks .
kha: Kane ka la neh ar snem , ba kumta baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka probins jong ka Asia , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka la bteng da ka por kaba ar snem ; haduh ba baroh kiba shong ha Asia ki la iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai Jisu , ki Jiw bad ki Grik .

en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents , and brethren , and kinsfolks , and friends  ; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death .
kha: Yn aiti ïa phi da ki kmie ki kpa jong phi , da ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong phi , da ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad da ki paralok jong phi ; bad ïa katto katne na phi yn pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shah pyndem ha ki kmie ki kpa, bad ki para bad ki para bad ki paralok beg bad katto katne na phi kin pynlong ia phi ban shah pyniap .

en: Circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , an Hebrew of the Hebrews ; as touching the law , a Pharisee ;
kha: La otsher ïa nga haba nga la don shi taïew ka rta . Nga long u Israel naduh ba la kha ïa nga , na ka jait Benjamin , u Hebru uba nylla . Ha ka liang kaba sumar ïa ka hukum ki Jiw , nga la long u Pharisi , bad nga la long uba shitrhem katta katta haduh ba nga la pynshitom ïa ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkhuid ia ka sngi kaba phra, na ka jait Israel, na ka jaitbynriew Benjamin, u Hebru jong ki Hebru kum uba ktah ia ka ain;

en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,
kha: Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Jerikho , ka Beth Hoglah , ka Emek Kesis ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki shnong jong ki khun shynrang ki long u Jerikoh bad u Bethhlah bad ka them Kezz .

en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .
kha: U Potiphar u la sngewbha eh ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u kum u shakri ïa u shimet hi ; kumta u buh ïa u ban long u nongpeit ïa ka ïing ka sem jong u , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la shem ia ka jingaiei ha ka khmat jong u: bad u la pynlong ia u ban peit ia ka iing jong u, bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ka kti jong u .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Elijah , Go down with him : be not afraid of him . And he arose , and went down with him unto the king .
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah ,  Khie leit hiar lem bad u , bad wat sheptieng .  Kumta u Elijah u la leit bad u rangbah pynïaidkam sha u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha u Elijah: To leit hiar bad u: wat tieng ia u . U la ieng bad u la leit hiar ryngkat bad u sha u syiem .

en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .
kha: Ka Israel kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Samaria , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Samaria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Pekah .  Lada ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba ïaineh , phin ym ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khlieh jong u Ephraim ka long ka Samaria bad ka khlieh jong u Samaria ka long u khun jong u Remaliah . Lada phin ym ngeit , thikna ba phin ym shah pynskhem .

en: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination , whereas ye say , The  Lord  saith it  ; albeit I have not spoken ?
kha: Nga ong ïa ki : Kito ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi ki dei kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kiba phi thaw ki long kiba lamler . Phi ong ba ki dei ki ktien jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la kren ha phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim shym la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew kaba lehnohei bad phim shym la kren ia ka jingkren bein kaba thok , katba phi ong , U Trai u ong; wat la ngam shym la kren ?

en: And so all Israel shall be saved : as it is written , There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer , and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob :
kha: Bad baroh ki Israel yn pynim . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Nongpynim un wan na Seïon bad un weng noh ïa baroh ka jingbymman na ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta baroh ki Israel kin ioh jingpynim: kumba la thoh: Kan mih na Sion u Nongpyllait im bad kan pynphai noh ia ka jingbymngeit Blei na u Jakob:

en: Then king Solomon sware by the  Lord  , saying , God do so to me , and more also , if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life .
kha: Nangta u Solomon u la ai ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ,  To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam pynlong ïa u Adonijah ban peiñ da ka jingim jong u namar ba u pan ïa kane !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Solomon u la sngap jar da U Trai, u da ong, U Blei un leh kumta ia nga, bad kham palat ruh lada u Adonijah um shym la kren ia kane ka ktien pyrshah ia la ka jong ka jingim .

en: And after these things he went forth , and saw a publican , named Levi , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he said unto him ,  Follow me .
kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihnoh bad u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna uba kyrteng u Lebi , uba shong ha la ka jaka treikam . U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  Bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei u la leit sha khmat bad u la iohi ia uwei u paidbah uba kyrteng u Lebi, uba shong ha ka jaka pdiang ia ka riti: bad u la ong ha u: To bud ia nga .

en: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Dei u Solomon u khun jong me u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga . Nga la jied ïa u ban long u khun jong nga , bad nga ngan long u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Solomon u khun jong me, un tei ia ka iing jong nga bad ki phyllaw jong nga: namar nga la jied ia u ban long u khun jong nga bad ngan long u kpa jong u .

en: For many deceivers are entered into the world , who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh . This is a deceiver and an antichrist .
kha: Kiba bun ki nongshukor ki la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh , ki briew ki bym pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew . Kum uta u briew , u long u nongshukor bad u Nongshun jong U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar bun ki nongleh thok ki rung ha ka pyrthei , ki bym phla ba U Jisu Khrist u wan ha ka doh . Kane ka long ka nongleh thok bad ka nongleh pyrshah .

en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga kum ki nongshun . Ki rangbah ki wan phai na ka thma , da kaba pyrkhat ba kin shngain ha ïing , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka met jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ha kaba kut jong ki briew jong nga ki la kiew kum ki nongshun: phi weng noh ia ka jainkup bad ka jainkup na ki kiba iaid lyngba da kaba suk katba ki briew ki iaid lait na ka thma .

en: Now therefore hear thou the word of the  Lord  : Thou sayest , Prophesy not against Israel , and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac .
kha: Kumta mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong . Me bthah ïa nga ban sangeh kaba ïathuhlypa , ban sangeh kaba kren lamwir pyrshah ïa ki briew ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta me iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai: Me ong , Wat iathuhlypa ia ki Israel bad wat pynhap ia ka ktien jong me pyrshah ia ka iing u Isaak .

en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;
kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ngan lumlang ïa ki briew kiba nga la pynshitom , kito kiba la shahshitom ha ka jingshah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai , ngan lum lang ia ka kaba sangeh , bad ngan lum ia ka kaba la beh noh , bad ia ka kaba nga la pynshitom ; .

en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking , that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand , and called that place Ramath–lehi .
kha: Hadien kata , u bret noh ïa kata ka shyieng tyngam . Ka jaka ha kaba kane ka la jia la ai kyrteng ka Ramath Lehi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la dep kren, ba u la bret noh ia ka shyntur na ka kti jong u, bad u la khot ia kata ka jaka Ramathlehi .

en: And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
kha: Haba u la poi hajan Bethphage bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib , u la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la poi ha Betphage bad Bethania, ha u lum ba la khot u lum Olives , u la phah arngut ki synran jong u .

en: I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;
kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ïa ka shathie ban ym bat noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki briew jong nga ki wan phai na ki ri bajngai , na man la ki bynta baroh jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ong shaphang shathie , Ai shuh shuh ia ka met bad shaphang shathie: Wat leit phai biang: wanrah ia ki khun shynrang jong nga na jngai , bad ki khun kynthei jong nga na ki kut jong ka khyndew;

en: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest , who was also chief governor in the house of the  Lord  , heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things .
kha: Mynba u Pashhur u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Immer , uba long u rangbah pynïaidkam bahakhlieh duh jong ka Templ , u la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Pashur u khun jong u Immer u lyngdoh uba long ruh u Lat rangbah ha ka iing U Trai u la iohsngew ba u Jeremaiah u la iathuhlypa ia kine kiei kiei .

en: I will go before thee , and make the crooked places straight : I will break in pieces the gates of brass , and cut in sunder the bars of iron :
kha: Nga da lade ngan pynkhreh ïa ka lynti jong me , ngan pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bad ki lumrit . Ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdop rnong bad pynkheiñ ïa ki nar-khang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit ha khmat jong me , bad ngan pynlong ia ki jaka ba la tyrkhong beit: Ngan pynpra ia ki khyrdop nar , bad ngan ot ia ki nar nar:

en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even , and shall not eat of the holy things , unless he wash his flesh with water .
kha: Uta u briew uba kylla long u bymkhuid un ïaisah u bymkhuid haduh janmiet , hynrei la katta ruh um lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba u la dep sum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka mynsiem kaba la ktah ia uno uno u briew kan long kaba khlem khuid haduh ban da janmiet , bad kan ym bam ia kiei kiei kiba khuid , lymda u sait ia ka doh jong u da ka um .

en: Four tables were on this side , and four tables on that side , by the side of the gate  ; eight tables , whereupon they slew their sacrifices .
kha: Kumta la don saw tylli ki miej hapoh ka kamra bad saw tylli shabar , baroh lang ki don phra tylli ha kiba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban kñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Saw tylli ki miej ki don ha kane ka liang , bad saw tylli ki miej ha kata ka liang , hajan ka khyrdop ; 8 tylli ki miej , ha kaba ki la pyniap ia ki jingknia jong ki .

en: Now ye are full , now ye are rich , ye have reigned as kings without us : and I would to God ye did reign , that we also might reign with you .
kha: Hato phi la don lypa ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi donkam ? Hato phi la riewspah lypa ? Hato phi la long ki syiem , wat la ngi ngim long ? A , nga da kwah ba phin da long shisha ki syiem , khnang ba ngin ïoh long ki syiem lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta phi la dap, mynta phi la riewspah, phi la synshar kum ki syiem khlem ma ngi: bad nga kwah ia U Blei ba phi la synshar, ba ngi ruh ngin synshar bad phi .

en: Therefore it is come to pass , that as he cried , and they would not hear  ; so they cried , and I would not hear , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
kha: Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor mynba nga la kren , ngam shym la jubab mynba ki la duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka la jia , ba kumba u la pyrta , bad kin ym iohsngew ia u ; kumta ki la pyrta , bad ngan ym iohsngew , ong U Trai jong ki paid:

en: And he said , Hagar , Sarai s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .
kha: Ko Hagar , ka mraw jong ka Sarai , na-ei pha wan bad shano phan leit ?  Ka jubab ,  Nga phet noh na la ka kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Hagar, Sarai ka nongtrei jong nga? bad shano me leit ? Bad ka la ong , Nga phet noh na ka khmat jong ka Sarai jong nga .

en: And they which went before rebuked him , that he should hold his peace : but he cried so much the more , Thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
kha: Ki briew kiba sha khmat ki la kynhied ïa u bad ki la ong ïa u ban sngap jar . Hynrei u la pyrta kam jam shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba la leit sha khmat ki la kren bein ia u, ba un bat ia ka jingsuk jong u: hynrei u la pyrta kham bun: Ko Khun u Dabid, to isynei ia nga .

en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people : neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour : I am the  Lord .
kha: Wat pynphriang lamler shaphang jongno jongno , bad haba uno uno u dang don ha ka jingbishar namar la ka jingim , kren pynpaw lada ka jingphla jong phi kan long jingïarap ïa u . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leit shaneng bad shapoh kum u nongrah jingiathuhkhana hapdeng ki briew jong me: bad wat ieng pyrshah ia ka snam jong u paramarjan jong me: Nga long U Trai .

en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
kha: U Isaïah u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Ahas .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la pyrta ha U Trai: bad u la wanrah ia ka jingdum kaba shi degree shadien, da kaba ka la hiar ha ka dial jong u Ahas .

en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon . U Julius u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah ïa u ban leit bad ïakynduh ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat kaba u donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la ktah ia u Sidon . Bad u Julius u la kyrpad ia u Paul da ka jingsbun , bad u la ai ia u ia ka jinglaitluid ban leit sha ki paralok jong u ban pynkmen ia lade .

en: Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don hapoh ka jingïada jong u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, ko para bangeit, ngam kwah ba phin long kiba khlem jingtip, kumno ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi baroh ki la don hapoh u lyoh, bad baroh ki la iaid lyngba ka duriaw ; .

en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour , neither rob him : the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning .
kha: Wat shim kabu ïano ïano lane ban lute ïa u . Wat pynsah ïa ka bainong jong uno uno u briew uba phi la khot bylla , wat tang shi miet ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ju thok ia u paramarjan jong me, lymne wat lute ia u: ka bainong jong uta uba la shah thung kam kan ym kohnguh ia me baroh shi miet haduh ban da step .

en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .
kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka dei kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da lade u la dep rai ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta , ha khmih , U Trai u la buh ia ka mynsiem kaba thok ha ka shyntur jong kine ki nongiathuhlypa jong me , bad U Trai u la kren bein pyrshah ia me .

en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me bad wan ïalam biang ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngap ha bneng , bad map ia ka pop jong ki briew jong me Israel , bad wanrah biang ia ki sha ka ri kaba me ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And Naomi said , Turn again , my daughters : why will ye go with me ? are there yet any more sons in my womb , that they may be your husbands ?
kha: Ko ki khun kynthei jong nga , phi dei ban leit phai noh ,  ka Naomi ka jubab .  Balei phi kwah ban wan bad nga ? Hato phi mut ngan dang ïoh khun shynrang biang na ka bynta jong phi ban shongkurim ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Naomi u la ong, To phai biang, ko khun jong nga: balei phin leit bad nga ? hato ki dang don ki khun shynrang ha ka kpoh jong nga, ba kin long ki tnga jong phi ?

en: Ish–bosheth Saul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel , and reigned two years . But the house of Judah followed David .
kha: U la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba la thung ïa u kum u syiem Israel , bad u la synshar ar snem . Hynrei ka jait Judah ka ïaineh skhem ha u Dabid ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishibosheth u khun u la dap sawphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel bad u la synshar ar snem . Hynrei ka iing u Judah ka la bud ia u Dabid .

en: And Saul arose from the earth  ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .
kha: U Saul u la khie joit na madan bad u la peit , hynrei um lah ban ïohi ei ei . Kumta ki la shim ïa u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha Damaskos .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la mih na ka khyndew; bad haba ki khmat jong u ki la plie , um shym la iohi ia u briew: hynrei ki la ialam ia u da ka kti bad ki la ialam ia u sha ka ri Damasi .

en: For their power is in their mouth , and in their tails : for their tails were like unto serpents , and had heads , and with them they do hurt .
kha: Naba ka bor jong ki kulai ka don ha ki shyntur jong ki bad ruh ha ki tdong jong ki . Ki tdong jong ki , ki long kum ki bseiñ ba don ki khlieh , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynmynsaw ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka bor jong ki ka don ha ka shyntur jong ki, bad ha ki tdong jong ki: namar ki tdong jong ki ki long kum ki bsein , bad ki don ki khlieh , bad bad ki ki pynmong .

en: But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .
kha: Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shaniah kum U Khun uba dei peit ïa ka ïing U Blei . Ngi long ka ïing jong u lada ngi ïaineh ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kaba ngi kyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Khrist kum u khun halor la ka jong ka iing; kiba ngi long ki jong ngi, lada ngi bat skhem ia ka jingshaniah bad ka jingkmen jong ka jingkyrmen haduh kaba kut .

en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved them , and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks , and sent them away .
kha: U Hanun u kem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid bad u khi ïa ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , bad ot ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki ha ki syngkai , bad phah noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Hanun u la shim ia ki shakri u Dabid, bad u la ot ia ki jain jong ki hapdeng da ki tyrpeng jong ki, bad u la phah noh ia ki .

en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .
kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jong u Saul ha Gibeah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap u Saul ha Gibeah u Benjamin ki la peit ; bad ha khmih u paidbah u la jah noh bad ki la iaid shapoh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .
kha: Pynban , ngi kren borabor kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi kumta , namar u la ñiew ïa ngi kiba bit ban shaniah ïa ka Khubor Babha . Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew , hynrei , ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba tynjuh ïa ki jingthmu jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba la shah ia ngi na U Blei ban shaniah ha ka gospel , wat la katta ruh ngi kren; ym kum ki briew kiba sngewbha hynrei U Blei uba pyrshang ia ki dohnud jong ngi .

en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
kha: U pynïap lut ïa ki lyngdoh nongmane blei thala halor ki duwan ba ki shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan . Nangta u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia ki lyngdoh baroh kiba don hangta halor ki nongrim bad u la thang ia ki shyieng briew ha ki bad u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .

en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
kha: Ki lyngdoh baroh , namar kata , ki dei ban sumar ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai . Lym kumta kin kit hi ïa la ka pop bad kin ïap , namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba kyntang . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sumar namarkata ia ka hukum jong nga, ioh kin kit ia ka pop na ka bynta jong ka, bad kin iap namarkata lada ki pynjah burom ia ka: Nga U Trai nga pynkyntang ia ki .

en: I will go down now , and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it , which is come unto me  ; and if not , I will know .
kha: Ngan da leit hiar ban shem la kita ki jingkynnoh ïa kiba nga la ïohsngew ki long ne em kiba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit hiar mynta , bad ngan peit la ki la leh pura kat kum ka jingpyrta jong ka , kaba wan ha nga ; bad lada ym dei , ngan sa tip .

en: And Tamar put ashes on her head , and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her , and laid her hand on her head , and went on crying .
kha: Ka la ber dpei ha la ka khlieh , ka la kad ïa la ka sopti jynsur , bad da kaba buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat da kaba tap da ki kti ka la leit noh da kaba ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Tamar ka la buh ia ka dewbilat ha ka khlieh jong ka, bad ka la pynkhih ia ka jain jong ka kaba don ha ka khlieh jong ka, bad ka la buh ia ka kti jong ka ha ka khlieh jong ka, bad ka la iaid shakhmat .

en: And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ngi , naba ngi map ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad map ia ki pop jong ngi ; namar ngi map ruh ia uwei pa uwei uba don ram ha ngi . Bad wat ialam ia ngi sha ka jingpynshoi ; hynrei pyllait ia ngi na kaba sniew .

en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .
kha: Hadien katto katne por u Boas da lade hi u wan poi na Bethlehem bad u ai khublei ïa ki nongtrei .  To U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !  u ong .  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi !  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih u Boaz u la wan na Bethlehem, bad u la ong ha ki nongot , U Trai un don ryngkat bad phi . Ki la jubab ia u, U Trai un kyrkhu ia me .

en: The  Lord  hath also a controversy with Judah , and will punish Jacob according to his ways  ; according to his doings will he recompense him .
kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingmudui ban wanlam pyrshah ïa ki paid Judah ; un pynshitom ruh ïa ka Israel na ka bynta ka rukom leh ki briew jong ka . Un ainong ïa ki na ka bynta kaei ba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai ruh u don ka jingiakren bad u Judah , bad un pynshitom ia u Jakob kat kum ki lynti jong u ; kat kum ki kam jong u un siew kylliang ia u .

en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Behold , thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : now tell me , I pray thee , wherewith thou mightest be bound .
kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson ,  Peit , phi la pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba shisha . Sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Delilah u la ong ha u Samson, Ha khmih, me la rkhie bein ia nga, bad me la iathuh ia nga: mynta to iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, da kaba me lah ban shah teh .

en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat , u syiem Judah , u Joram u khun jong u Ahab u la long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoram u khun u Ahab u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Judah bad u la synshar shiphew snem .

en: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .
kha: Hynrei lada , kumba ngi pyrshang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi bad U Khrist , yn shem ïa ngi ba ngi long ki nongpop kumba long hi ki Jentil — hato kane ka mut ba U Khrist u pynlong ka daw ïa ka pop ? Da lei lei ruh em !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ngi wad ban shah pynksan ha U Khrist , ngi ruh ngi long ki nongpop , hato U Khrist u long namarkata u nongshakri jong ka pop ? U Blei u la khang .

en: And the man said unto Eli , I am he that came out of the army , and I fled to day out of the army . And he said , What is there done , my son ?
kha: Uta u rangbah u ong ,  Nga la lait phet na ka thma ; bad nga la shu mareh shi lynter lynti haduh hangne mynta ka sngi .  U Eli u kylli ïa u ,  Ka la jia aïu , ko khun jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la ong ha u Eli , Nga long uta uba la mih na ka kynhun shipai bad nga la phet noh sha ka sngi na ka kynhun shipai . Bad u la ong: Kaei kaba la jia ko khun jong nga ?

en: He saith unto them ,  Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives : but from the beginning it was not so .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  U Moses u la shah ïa phi ban pyllait ïa la ki tnga namar phi long kiba eh ban shah hikai . Hynrei kam shym long kumta ha ka por ba mynnyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha ki , U Moses namar ka jingkhlain jong ki dohnud jong phi u la pynshitom ia phi ban kyntait ia ki tnga jong phi: hynrei naduh kaba sdang kam shym la long kumta .

en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars : see that ye be not troubled : for all these things must come to pass , but the end is not yet .
kha: Phin sa ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki thma kiba hajan bad ïa ki khubor thma kiba sha jngai ; hynrei wat khih khuslai . Kiba kum kine kiei kiei ki dei ban jia , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa iohsngew ia ki thma bad ki khubor thma: peit ba phin ym shah pynshitom: namar kine kiei kiei baroh kin sa jia , hynrei ka jingkut kam pat long .

en: And Amaziah strengthened himself , and led forth his people , and went to the valley of salt , and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .
kha: U Amasaïah u la long shlur bad u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u sha ka Them Mluh . Hangta ki la ïaleh bad ki pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasaiah u la pynskhem ia lade, bad u la ialam ia ki briew jong u, bad u la leit sha ka them ka umsoh bad u la leit sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Seir shi hajar .

en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiar da kiba la suh ïa ka ephod , bad ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka sniehdoh kaba jem, kum ka jingtrei jong ka sniehdoh ksiar, kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw .

en: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone : the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine  ; also his heavens shall drop down dew .
kha: Kumta ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob ki shongsuk shongsaiñ , khlem jingkhuslai ha ka ri kaba dap da u kew bad da ka waiñ , ha kaba ka umjer na suiñbneng ka ai um ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel kin shong ha ka jingshngain marwei: ka pung jong u Jakob kan long ha ka ri u kew bad ka wain ; ruh ki bneng jong u kin hap noh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Learn not the way of the heathen , and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven  ; for the heathen are dismayed at them .
kha: U ong ,  Wat bud ïa ki rukom jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; wat khih jingmut da ki jingïohi bym ju kham ïohi ha ka sahit bneng , wat la kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Wat hikai ia ka lynti jong ki nongwei , bad wat sngewsih ia ki dak jong ka bneng ; namar ki nongwei ki sngewsih ia ki .

en: Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
kha: Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi bad U Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: La tep bad u ha ka jingpynbaptis , ha kaba phi ruh phi la mihpat bad u da ka jingngeit jong ka jingtreikam jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ia u na kiba iap .

en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net , and burn incense unto their drag  ; because by them their portion is fat , and their meat plenteous .
kha: Ki mane wat ïa ki jar tong dohkha jong ki bad ai jingkñia ha ki , namar ki jar jong ki , ki pyndap ïa ki da kiei kiei baroh kiba bha tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki knia ia ka net jong ki, bad ki thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ka rong jong ki ; namar da ki ka bhah jong ki ka long ka shini, bad ka doh jong ki ka long kaba bun .

en: Reward her even as she rewarded you , and double unto her double according to her works : in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double .
kha: Leh ïa ka thik kumba ka la leh ïa phi ; siew kylliang ar shah ïa ka na ka bynta baroh kaba ka la leh . Pyndap ïa ka khuri jong ka da ka jingdih kaba ar shah ka jingkhor kum ka jingdih kaba ka la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ka kumba ka la siew kylliang ia phi, bad ar shah ia ka kat kum ki kam jong ka: ha ka khuri kaba ka la pyndap ar shah ia ka .

en: And certain of the chief of Asia , which were his friends , sent unto him , desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki bor synshar ka probins , kiba long ki paralok jong u , ki la phah ruh ka khubor sha u da kaba kyrpad ïa u ban ym pyn-i khmat ïa lade ha ka jaka leh tamasa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na ki rangbah jong ka Asia, kiba long ki paralok jong u, ki la phah sha u, ki kwah ia u ba un ym leit sha ka jaka peitkai .

en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
kha: hynrei , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khynnah sha u bad u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long ïa kiba kum kine .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la khot ia ki ha u bad u la ong, To ai ia ki khynnah rit ban wan sha nga, bad wat khang ia ki: namar na kiba kum kita ka long ka hima U Blei .

en: And walk in love , as Christ also hath loved us , and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour .
kha: Ïa ka jingim jong phi dei ban synshar da ka jingieit , kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ngi bad u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih bad ka jingkñia ba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad iaid ha ka jingieit kumba U Khrist ruh u la ieit ia ngi, bad u la aiti ia lade na ka bynta jong ngi ka jingainguh bad ka jingknia ha U Blei na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang .

en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Naphtali u ong ,  U Naphtali u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkyrkhu da ka jingsngewbha U  Trai  ; Ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Naphtali u la ong, ko Naphtali, u la sngewhun ia ka jingsngewbha, bad u la dap da ka jingkyrkhu U Trai: to long ma me shaphang sepngi bad shaphang shathie .

en: This brother concludes : All the struggles I have endured will pay off in the new world . I want that ! Until then , I will continue to fight .
kha: Une u hynmen u pynkut kumne : Ki jingeh baroh kiba nga la shah kin ai jingmyntoi ha ka pyrthei thymmai . Nga kwah ia kata ! Haduh kata ka por , ngan iai bteng ban ialeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u hynmen u pynkut: Baroh ki jingeh kiba nga la shah kin sa siew ha ka pyrthei kaba thymmai . Nga kwah ia kata ! Haduh kata ka por , ngan iai bteng ban ialeh .

en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .
kha: Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm ,   ‘ Ai ba ka ïing jong u kan kylla long kaba thylli ; ai ban ym don mano mano bashong hapoh jong ka .’   La thoh ruh ,   ‘ Ai ba uwei pat un shim ïa ka jaka jong u ha ka jingshakri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh ha ka Kitab Salm , To ai ba ka jaka shong jong u kan long kaba la jot , bad wat ai ba uno uno un shong hangta : bad u bishoprick jong u un shim ia uwei pat .

en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :
kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada jong u syiem , uba la ïoh hukum ban pyndep ïa ka jingpynïap . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la jubab da ka jingai jingmut bad ka jingstad ha u sohjew u rangbah jong u syiem, uba la leit shabar ban pyniap ia ki riewstad jong ka Babilon:

en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets , rising early and sending them , saying , Oh , do not this abominable thing that I hate .
kha: Nga ïai phah sha phi ïa ki shakri jong nga kiba long ki nongïathuhlypa , kiba la ong ïa phi ban ym leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba nga isih .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la phah ha phi baroh ia ki shakri jong nga, da kaba khie dang step bad phah ia ki, da kaba ong: Oh, wat leh ia kane kaba sngewsih kaba nga shun .

en: Which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Addi , which was the son of Cosam , which was the son of Elmodam , which was the son of Er ,
kha: u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Addi , u khun jong u Kosam , u khun jong u Elmadam , u khun jong u Er ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Melchi uba long u khun u Addi uba long u khun u Cosam uba long u khun u Elmodam uba long u khun u Er .

en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought . And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon .
kha: nalor ki khajna ba la siew da ki nongkhaïi bad ki mahajon . Ki syiem Arabia bad ki lat jong ki jylla Israel ruh ki wanrah ïa u ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata kaba ki nongkhaii bad ki nongkhaii ki wanrah . Bad ki syiem Arabia bad ki nongsynshar jong ka ri ki la wanrah ia ka ksiar bad rupa ha u Solomon .

en: And the  Lord  shall scatter you among the nations , and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen , whither the  Lord  shall lead you .
kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , bad hangta tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynphriang ia phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad phin sah tang khyndiat eh hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , ha kaba U Trai un ialam ia phi .

en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .
kha: Kumta , kat kum ka hukum U  Trai  , ki paid Israel ki ai ha ki Lebi katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki jaka jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ai ha ki Lebi na ka pateng jong ki, kat kum ka hukum U Trai, kine ki shnong bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ki .

en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ishmael ki la shong la sah ha ka jaka kaba hapdeng ka Habilah bad ka Shur , sha ka phang mihngi jong ka ri Ijipt ha ka lynti sha Assyria . Kine ki la shong kyrpang na kiwei pat ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shong ha Havilah haduh Shur, kaba don ha khmat ka ri Ijipt, kumba me leit sha Assyria: bad u la iap ha khmat ki hynmen jong u baroh .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thomas , because thou hast seen me , thou hast believed : blessed are they that have not seen , and yet have believed .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Hato me ngeit namar ba me ïohi ïa nga ? Katno ki kmen kito kiba ngeit khlem da ïohi ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u, Thomas, namar ba me la iohi ia nga, me la ngeit: la kyrkhu ia kita ki bym pat iohi, bad ki la ngeit .

en: And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u la jubab .  Dang ïaid sha khmat !  Kumta u Ittai u la ïaid sha khmat bad la ki rangbah jong u lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Itai, To leit noh . Bad u Itai u la iaid lait noh bad ki briew jong u baroh bad ki khynnah rit baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood , and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the  Lord  , before the veil of the sanctuary .
kha: Un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha kata ka snam bad synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka jingkah jong ka Jaka Kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un theh ia ka kti jong u ha ka snam bad un theh ia ka snam hynriew sien ha khmat U Trai .

en: And laid it in his own new tomb , which he had hewn out in the rock : and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre , and departed .
kha: bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u hi , ïa kaba u dang phah tih shen na u mawsiang . Nangta u la pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh na khmat ka jaka rung sha ka jingtep bad u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka ha la ka jong ka jingtep thymmai kaba u la ker ha u maw: bad u la pynkhih ia u maw uba heh haduh ka jingkhang jong ka jingtep , bad u la leit noh .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto you out of the midst of the fire : ye heard the voice of the words , but saw no similitude  ; only ye heard a voice .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki kumno U  Trai  u la kren ha phi na kata ka ding , kumno phi la ïohsngew ba u kren hynrei phim shym la ïohi satia ïa ka dur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la kren ha phi na pdeng ka ding: phi la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien , hynrei phim shym la iohi ia ka jingiasyriem ; tang phi la iohsngew ia ka sur .

en: Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .
kha: Yn ym tep ïa ki metïap jong ki , hynrei kin pyut hangta bad kin iwtung ; bad ki lumbah kin saw da ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiap jong ki ruh kan mih noh na ki met iap jong ki bad ki lum kin sa tyrkhong da ka snam jong ki .

en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the  Lord  in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :
kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat u paidbah , u Solomon u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat ka duwan , u rah ïa la ki kti ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ieng ha khmat ka jingknia U Trai ha khmat ka jingiaseng Israel baroh:

en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang jong ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew ngut baroh , bad u Petros u la ïeng ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi u Petros u la ieng hapdeng ki synran bad u la ong, (ki kyrteng ryngkat ki long kumba shispah arphew , )

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Write thou these words : for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Thoh ïa kine ki ktien , namar dei ha ka nongrim jong kine ki ktien ba nga pynlong ka jutang bad me bad ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Thoh ia kine ki ktien: namar hadien ka por jong kine ki ktien nga la leh ia ka jutang bad me bad bad ki Israel .

en: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and the battle was sore : but they knew not that evil was near them .
kha: Shiphew hajar ngut ki rangdajied ïa kiba la jied kyrpang na baroh ki Israel , ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah , bad ka jingïaleh ka la long kaba jur . Ki Benjamin kim pat shym poi pyrkhat ba kin sa shah pynjot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shiphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la jied na Israel baroh: hynrei kim tip ba ka jingsniew ka la don hajan jong ki .

en: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll : but he would not hear them .
kha: Wat la u Elnathan , u Delaïah , bad u Gemaraïah ki la kyrpad ïa u syiem ban ym thang ïa ka kot kli , um patiaw satia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Elnathan bad u Delaiah bad u Gemariah ki la iakynduh ia u syiem ba un ym thang ia ka roll: hynrei un ym iohsngew ia ki .

en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store , as God hath prospered him , that there be no gatherings when I come .
kha: Man la ka Sngi U Trai , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban buh kyrpang katto katne ka pisa , kat kum ka jingïoh , bad pynlang ïa ka , khnang ba yn ym da donkam ban lum ïa ka pisa ynda nga poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taiew to ai ba uwei pa uwei na phi un thiah hajan jong u, kumba U Blei u la pynroi ia u, ba kin ym don ki jingialang haba nga wan .

en: But of the cities of these people , which the  Lord  thy God doth give thee for an inheritance , thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth :
kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong kiba hapoh kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban long ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ki shnong jong kine ki briew, kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me kum ka pateng, men ym pynim ei ei kaba ring mynsiem:

en: Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .
kha: Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka pop jong nga bad duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ban shim noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to map ia nga tang ia kane ka pop jong nga tang shisien bad to kyrpad ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, ba un weng noh na nga ia kane ka jingiap tang .

en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :
kha: Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , nga maham ïa phi ba ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan synshar halor jong phi da ka ksang ti kaba khlaiñ , da ka bor jong nga baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang im, ong U Blei Trai, shisha da ka kti kaba khlain, bad da ka kti kaba la pynjrong shabar, bad da ka jingbitar kaba la theh shabar, ngan synshar halor jong phi:

en: And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .
kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban sheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng U Trai ka la hap ha ki hima baroh kiba don sawdong ka Judah , haduh ba kim shym la leh thma ia u Jehoshaphat .

en: Behold , the  Lord  maketh the earth empty , and maketh it waste , and turneth it upside down , and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof .
