kha: U  Trai  un sa pynjot ïa ka pyrthei bad un pynlong kynjah ïa ka . Un sa khyrwait ïa ka khmat jong ka pyrthei bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Trai u pynlong ia ka khyndew kaba thylli bad u pynlong ia ka ban jah rngai noh bad u pynkylla ia ka shapoh bad u pynphriang ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka .

en: Thus will I magnify myself , and sanctify myself  ; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations , and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ngan pyn-i ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khraw bad uba khuid . Kin sa tip , te , ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynkhraw ia lade, bad ngan pynkyntang ia lade ; bad ngan sa shah ithuh ha khmat ki jaitbynriew kiba bun , bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you , Behold , he is in the desert  ; go not forth : behold , he is in the secret chambers  ; believe it not .
kha: Lane , lada ki briew kin ïathuh ïa phi , ‘ Ha khmih , u don ha ka ri shyiap !’ — wat leit shata , lane lada ki ong , ‘ Ha khmih , u rieh hangne !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada kin ong ha phi, Ha khmih, u don ha ka ri khlaw ; wat leit shabar: ha khmih, u don ha ki kamra ba rieh ; wat ngeit ia kata .

en: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .
kha: Katba ki dang leit ha ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïohthiah . Kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la sdang ban dap da ka um , ba kumta baroh ki la don ha ka jingma kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba ki dang iaid u la iohthiah: bad ka la wan hiar ka eriong ha ka pung ; bad ki la dap da ka um , bad ki la don ha ka jingma .

en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :
kha: Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U  Trai  u kren — ba ngan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la leh ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khun marwei na nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Da nga hi nga la smai, ko Trai, namar ba me la leh ia kane ka kam, bad me khlem bat ia u khun jong me, tang u khun jong me:

en: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even , he shall burn incense upon it , a perpetual incense before the  Lord  throughout your generations .
kha: Un leh kumjuh haba u wan ban pynmeh ïa kita ki sharak ha ka por janmiet . Ïa kane ka jingainguh iwbih dei ban ïai leh khlem sangeh ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Aaron u pynmeh ia ki sharak ha ka por janmiet , un thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ka , ka jingiwbih kaba neh ha khmat U Trai ha ki pateng jong phi baroh .

en: And he said unto them in his doctrine ,  Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,
kha: Katba u dang hikai ïa ki , u la ong ,  Sumar bha na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban leit kylleng ha ki jaiñkup jynsur bad ba yn khublei ïa ki da ka jinglehburom ha ka jaka ïew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ha ka jinghikai jong u , To tip ia ki nongthoh kiba sngewtynnad ban leit da ki jain kiba jrong bad ki jingkren bein ha ki iew ki hat .

en: And when ye stand praying , forgive , if ye have ought against any : that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses .
kha: Bad haba phi ïeng bad duwai , to map ïa kaei kaei kaba phi lah ban don pyrshah ïano ïano , khnang ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un map ïa ki jingleh bymdei kiba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi ieng duwai, map lada phi don ei ei: ba U Kpa jong phi ruh uba don ha bneng un map ia ki jingleh bymman jong phi .

en: And his father in law , the damsel s father , retained him  ; and he abode with him three days : so they did eat and drink , and lodged there .
kha: U kpa u ïai ban ba un sah , bad kumta u sah hangta lai sngi . Ki shi jur ki ïabam ïadih bad ki sah hangta baroh lai miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa tymmen jong u, u kpa tymmen u la bat ia u ; bad u la sah bad u lai sngi: kumta ki la bam bad dih, bad ki la sah hangta .

en: Which the children of Aaron , being of the families of the Kohathites , who were of the children of Levi , had : for theirs was the first lot .
kha: ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , kiba dei na ka kur Kohath , kiba hiarpateng na u Lebi . Ka bynta jong ki ka dei kaba nyngkong eh ban pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ki khun u Aaron, ki long na ki longiing jong ki Kohathi, kiba long na ki khun u Lebi, ki don: namar jong ki ka long kaba nyngkong .

en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face , to destroy them : he will not be slack to him that hateth him , he will repay him to his face .
kha: hynrei un ym pynslem ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u siew kylliang ia kiba shun ia u ha khmat jong ki: un ym long uba sniew ia uta uba shun ia u , un siew kylliang ia u ha khmat jong u .

en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?
kha: Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Hynrei pynthikna mano ban leit ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la wan phai biang sha u Pharaoh: bad u la ong ha ki: To leit shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong phi: hynrei mano ba leit ?

en: And afterward they desired a king : and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis , a man of the tribe of Benjamin , by the space of forty years .
kha: Bad haba ki la pan syiem , U Blei u la ai ha ki ïa u Saul u khun jong u Kish na ka jait Benjamin , ban long u syiem jong ki haduh sawphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ki la kwah ia u syiem: bad U Blei u la ai ha ki ia u khun u Kis , u briew na ka jaitbynriew Benjamin , da ka por sawphew snem .

en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent , the half curtain that remaineth , shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle .
kha: Wah ïa kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba tam shiteng shadien ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba sah na ki jingtap jong ka ïingjaiñ, ka jingtap kaba sah, kan sahkut ha ka liang ba shadien jong ka ïingjaiñ .

en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .
kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha don ha ka jingshah tur ïaleh ! Ka bor ka ban kynther ïa pha ka la wan . To buh briew ha ki jingïada ! To phira ïa ka lynti bah ! To pynkhreh ïa ka thma !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ha khmat jong me: to buh ia ki tiar siat, to peit ia ka lynti, to pynlong ia ki tyrpeng jong me kiba khlain, to pynskhem ia ka bor jong me da kaba khlain .

en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites , and built a city , and called the name thereof Luz : which is the name thereof unto this day .
kha: Kham hadien u la leit sha ri ki Hit , u la tei hangta kawei ka nongbah , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Lus , kaba dang dei hi ka kyrteng jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la leit sha ka ri jong ki Hit bad u la tei ia ka shnong bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Luz: kaba long ka kyrteng jong ka haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Then she spake , saying , They were wont to speak in old time , saying , They shall surely ask counsel at Abel : and so they ended the matter .
kha: Ka ong ,  Mynhyndai ki ju ong , ‘ Khie leit wad jubab na ka nongbah Abel’ — bad kata ka dei kaba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la kren, ka da ong , Ki la ju kren ha ka por barim, ki da ong , Kin sa kylli jingmut shisha ha u Abel: bad kumta ki la pynkut noh ia ka kam .

en: And while they were yet talking with him , came the king s chamberlains , and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared .
kha: Katba ki dang ïakren , ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem ki wan poi ha ka jingkyrkieh ban ïalam ïa u Haman sha ka jingkhawai ka Esther .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang ia kren bad u, ki la wan ki kamra jong u syiem bad ki la kyrkieh ban wanrah ia u Haman sha ka jingkhawai kaba ka Esther ka la pynkhreh .

en: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm , thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land , thou , and all thy bands , and many people with thee .
kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad bun ki jaitbynriew kiba don bad u kin tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong bad tap ïa ka ri kum u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban kiew bad wan kum ka eriong, me long kum u lyoh ban tap ia ka ri, ma me bad ki kynhun jong me baroh bad bun ki briew bad me .

en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the  Lord  your God , and none else : and my people shall never be ashamed .
kha: Te , ma phi ki Israel , phin tip ba nga don hapdeng jong phi bad ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei jong phi bad ym don uwei pat . Ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa tip ba nga don hapdeng ki Israel bad ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad ym don shuh: bad ki briew jong nga kin ym sngewlehrain satia .

en: Then saith Jesus unto him ,  Get thee hence , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
kha: Te U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit noh , ko Soitan ! Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u hi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u ong ha u, To long kumta, ko Soitan: namar la thoh: Me dei ban mane ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad tang ma u hi me dei ban shakri .

en: And they ran and fetched him thence : and when he stood among the people , he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward .
kha: Kumta ki mareh bad ki wan ïalam ïa u Saul hapdeng kita ki paidbah , bad ki ïohi ba ka khlieh jong u ka khamtam ban ïano ïano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mareh bad ki la shim ia u hangta : bad haba u la ieng hapdeng ki briew , u la kham heh ban ia uno uno na ki briew naduh ki tyrpeng jong u bad shaneng .

en: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren  ; the  Lord  is his inheritance , according as the  Lord  thy God promised him .
kha: Namar kata , ka jait Lebi kam shym ïoh bynta ïa kano kano ka jaka kum kiwei pat ki jait ; kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Lebi um don bynta ne pateng bad ki hynmen jong u; U Trai u long ka pateng jong u kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la kular ia u .

en: For your hands are defiled with blood , and your fingers with iniquity  ; your lips have spoken lies , your tongue hath muttered perverseness .
kha: Phi long kiba la rem namar ka jinglamler , ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki kti jong phi ki la tyrkhong da ka snam, bad ki kti jong phi da ka jingbymhok ; ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki la kren thok , ka shyntur jong phi ka la rkhie bein .

en: And ye shall serve the  Lord  your God , and he shall bless thy bread , and thy water  ; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee .
kha: Lada phi mane ïa nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , te ngan kyrkhu ïa phi da ka bam bad ka um , bad ngan weng noh ruh ïa ki jingpang jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad un kyrkhu ia u kpu jong me bad ia ka um jong me bad ngan weng noh ia ka jingpang na pdeng jong me .

en: The womb shall forget him  ; the worm shall feed sweetly on him  ; he shall be no more remembered  ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .
kha: Wat ka kmie jong u kam kynmaw shuh ïa u mynta ; la bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ bad la pynjot kum ïa u dieng ba la khyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kpoh kan klet noh ia u ; u khniang un bam sngewbha ia u ; un ym kynmaw shuh ia u ; bad ka jingsniew kan shah pynpra kum u dieng .

en: And the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their houses , and all the men that appertained unto Korah , and all their goods .
kha: bad ka la nguid ïa ki bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , lem bad ïa ki nongbud jong u Korah baroh bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka la plie ia ka shyntur jong ka, bad ka la rong noh ia ki bad ki iing jong ki bad ki briew baroh kiba dei ki jong u Korah bad ki mar ki mata jong ki baroh .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the city shall be built to the  Lord  from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner .
kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ïa ka Jerusalem baroh kawei yn tei pat kum ka nongbah jong nga , naduh u Mot Hananel shaphang sepngi haduh ka Khyrdop Kyndong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ka shnong kan long kaba la tei ha U Trai naduh ka tower Hanel haduh ka khyrdop jong ka kut .

en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .
kha: Ki shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki ban ai kum ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  hynrei kane kan ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa ki . Kin ym shem ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin leit bad ki langbrot jong ki bad ki kynhun jong ki ban wad ia U Trai ; hynrei kin ym shem ia u ; u la kyntait ia lade na ki .

en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk bad ki paid Israel ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Hib ki shong . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym shym la don ka shnong kaba iasuk bad ki khun Israel , lait noh tang ki Hivite ki nongshong shnong jong ka Gibeon: kiwei pat ki la ialeh thma .

en: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother , and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon .
kha: U buh ïa kiba sah na ki shipai jong u hapoh ka jingai hukum uba shi para bad u Abishai , uba pynap ïa ki shipai da kaba phai khmat sha ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki briew ki la aiti ha ka kti jong u Abisai u hynmen jong u, bad ki la buh ia lade ha ka jingialeh pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon .

en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ma ngi hi ngi sngewsarong shaphang jong phi ha ki balang jong U Blei . Ngi sngewsarong shaphang ka rukom kaba phi ïaineh ban shah bad ban ngeit lyngba baroh ki jingpynshitom beiñ bad ki jingshahshitom kiba phi ïohmad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ba ngi hi ngi burom ha phi ha ki balang U Blei na ka bynta ka jingshah shitom bad ka jingngeit jong phi ha ki jingshah pynshitom bein bad ki jingjynjar jong phi baroh kiba phi shah:

en: Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .
kha: Te kumta ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jong ngi . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jong phi , bad ngin ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngin ai ia ki khun kynthei jong ngi ha phi , bad ngin shim ia ki khun kynthei jong phi ha ngi , bad ngin shong bad phi , bad ngin long kawei ka jaitbynriew .

en: And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying , We came to thy brother Esau , and also he cometh to meet thee , and four hundred men with him .
kha: Ynda kita ki nonglamktien ki la wan phai pat sha u Jakob , ki ong ,  Ngi la leit ïashem ïa u Iso u hynmen jong phi , bad u la don ha lynti ban wan ïashem ïa phi . U don sawspah ngut ki rangbah bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nonglam khubor ki la wan phai sha u Jakob, ki da ong: Ngi la wan sha u hynmen jong me u Iso, bad ruh u wan iakynduh ia me, bad saw spah ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .
kha: ‘ Ngi long kiba riewspah’ ki ong . ‘ Ngi lah lum kyrhai ka spah . Bad ym don uwei ruh ban mudui ïa ngi ba ngi ïoh spah da ka lynti bymhok .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u la ong , Hynrei nga la riewspah, nga la shem ia nga: ha ki jingtrei jong nga baroh kin ym shem ia ka jingbymhok ha nga kiba la leh pop .

en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la phohsniew shaphang jong ki , bad u ong ,  Phi dei ki nongsyntiat ; phi ïawan ban khmih ha-ei ka ri jong ngi ka shong tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la kynmaw ia ki jingphohsniew kiba u la phohsniew shaphang jong ki, bad u la ong ha ki: Phi long ki nongleit jingleit; ban iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka ri kaba phi wan .

en: Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .
kha: Um pynsniew noh ïa u kew da kaba peh palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali dieng halor jong u khlem pynkhlur noh ïa ki symbai .
translated_en_to_kha: U kew kpu u la tyrkhong namar un ym tyrkhong ia u, lymne un ym pynpra ia u da ka tyrpeng jong ka kali jong u, lymne un ym tyrkhong ia u da ki kulai jong u .

en: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel , and reigned ten years in Samaria .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Menahem u khun jong u Gadi u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar shiphew snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynniewphew snem u Asaria u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Menahem u khun u Gadi ban synshar ia ki Israel bad u la synshar shi snem ha Samaria .

en: And he said , Speak , I pray thee , unto Solomon the king , ( for he will not say thee nay , ) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife .
kha: U jubab ,  Sngewbha kylli ïa u Syiem Solomon — nga tip un ym kyrngah ïa phi — ban shah ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka Abishag , ka theisamla na Shunem , kum ka tnga jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, To kren, nga kyrpad ia me, ha u syiem Solomon, (namar un ym ong ia me nay, ) ba un ai ia nga ia u Abishag u Shunam ha ka tnga .

en: And I will stretch out my hand , and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof : and after that he will let you go .
kha: Hynrei ngan pyn-i ïa la ka bor bad ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri Ijipt da kaba leh hangta ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei . Hadien kata un sa shah ba phin leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga, bad ngan pynkhih ia ka Ijipt da ki jingphylla jong nga baroh kiba ngan leh hapdeng jong ka: bad hadien kata un pyllait noh ia phi .

en: And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .
kha: Ngan teh ngan khum ïa me kumta ba men ym lah ban phai na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ngan buh ia ki band ha me, bad me wat phai noh ia me na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat, haduh ba me la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ka jingshah set jong me .

en: The same followed Paul and us , and cried , saying , These men are the servants of the most high God , which shew unto us the way of salvation .
kha: Ka la bud ïa u Paul bad ïa ngi , ka da pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki long ki shakri U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Ki pynbna ha phi kumno ba yn pynim ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U juh u la bud ia u Paul bad ia ngi , bad u la pyrta , u la ong , Kine ki briew ki long ki shakri jong U Blei uba ha khlieh duh tam , kiba pyni ha ngi ia ka lynti jong ka jingpynim .

en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la don ryngkat bad u Syiem Kynrad , kumta ruh ai un don ryngkat bad u Solomon , bad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar jong u kaba kham roi ban ïa ka jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Trai u la long bad u syiem jong nga, wat la u long bad u Solomon, bad u pynlong ia ka khet jong u kaba kham heh ban ia ka khet jong u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong nga u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syiem jong u syi

en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .
kha: Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohi ïa uta u rishot lyoh ba u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki dem khrup .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la iohi ia u mawlyngnai uba dum ba u ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ: bad ki briew baroh ki la ieng bad ki la mane , uwei pa uwei ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ jong u .

en: Can thine heart endure , or can thine hands be strong , in the days that I shall deal with thee ? I the  Lord  have spoken it , and will do it .
kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin dang don ka jingshlur kaba sah lane phin dang donbor kat ban rah ïa la ka kti ynda nga la pyndep bad phi ? Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren , bad nga bat ïa la ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka dohnud jong me ka lah ban shah, ne ki kti jong me kin long kiba khlain ha ki sngi ba ngan leh ia me ? Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata bad ngan leh ia kata .

en: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side , clothed in a long white garment  ; and they were affrighted .
kha: Kumta ki la rung shapoh ka jingtep , ha kaba ki la ïohi ïa u samla uba shong ha ka liang kamon uba phong da ka jaiñkup balieh — bad ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki rung shapoh ka jingtep, ki la iohi ia uwei u samla uba shong ha ka liang kadiang, uba la phong da ka jain lieh kaba jrong ; bad ki la sngew lyngngoh .

en: The declared CUF is now allowed to revise once within three year of commercial operation date , which was earlier allowed within one year only .
kha: Ia ka CUF ba la pynbna mynta la shah ban pynkylla shisien hapoh lai snem naduh ka tarik treikam jong ka kam khaii , kaba la shah mynshuwa tang hapoh shisnem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka CUF ba la pynbna mynta la shah ban pynkylla shisien hapoh lai snem jong ka tarik treikam jong ka kam khaii , kaba la shah kham mynshuwa hapoh shisnem tang .

en: Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
kha: Kumno shaphang kito ki khatphra ngut ki briew ha Siloam kiba la shah pynïap mynba ka jaka ap phira ka hap halor jong ki ? Hato phi tharai ba kane ka pynshisha ba ki long kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lane kita ki shiphew ngut kiba u tower ha Siloam u la hap bad u la pyniap ia ki , phi pyrkhat ba ki long ki nongpop halor ki briew baroh kiba shong ha Jerusalem ?

en: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .
kha: U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U Kynrad jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Kaei ba ngan leh ? Ngam long uba khlaiñ ban tih kharai , bad nga sngewlehrain ban khrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u nongap u la ong hapoh jong u, Ngan leh aiu ? namar u kynrad jong nga u shim noh na nga ia ka jinglong nongap: Ngam lah ban tih ; ban kyrpad nga sngewlehrain .

en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops  ; and them that worship and that swear by the  Lord  , and that swear by Malcham  ;
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa uno uno uba leit kiew sha tnum ïing bad mane ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur . Nga pynjot ruh ïa kito kiba mane ïa nga bad kiba smai ban ïaineh ha nga , hynrei pynban ki shim smai ha ka kyrteng jong u blei Molekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba mane ia ka kynhun ki bneng halor ki iing; bad kita kiba mane bad kiba smai da U Trai .

en: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment , that wickedness was there  ; and the place of righteousness , that iniquity was there .
kha: Shuh shuh , nga la ïohi ruh ba ha kane ka pyrthei phi shem ka jingbymman ha ka jaka kaba ka jinglehhok bad ka hok ki dei ban don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nalor kata nga la iohi hapoh ka sngi ia ka jaka bishar , ba ka jingsniew ka la don hangta ; bad ka jaka jong ka hok , ba ka jingbymhok ka la don hangta .

en: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings for the rain  ; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries .
kha: U wanrah ïa ki lyoh  erïong na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; u pynlong leilieh ïa ki  erïong , bad u wanrah shabar ïa ka lyer na la ka jaka buh .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynlong ia ki lyer ban kiew na ki tduh jong ka khyndew ; u pynmih ia ki jingshai na ka bynta u slap ; u wanrah ia ka Iyer na ki jaka buh jingbam jong u .

en: After him repaired the Levites , Rehum the son of Bani . Next unto him repaired Hashabiah , the ruler of the half part of Keilah , in his part .
kha: Kine ki Lebi ki tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : U Rehum u khun jong u Bani u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ; U Hashabaïah , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud na ka bynta ka distrik jong u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba u la pynbha ia ki Lebi, u Rehum u khun Bani . Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Hashabiah , u nongsynshar shiteng na ka Keilah , ha ka bynta jong u .

en: But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .
kha: Hynrei lada um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh lah ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai ngut ki sakhi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada un ym iohsngew ia me, te shim bad me sa kawei ne arngut ki sakhi ba ha ka shyntur jong ki ar ne lai ngut ki sakhi .

en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;
kha: To shah ngan ïathuh ïa phi haduh katno nga la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi , bad na ka bynta ki briew ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei pat baroh ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga kwah ba phin tip ia ka jingialeh kaba khraw kaba nga don na ka bynta jong phi, bad na ka bynta jong ki ha Lawodika, bad na ka bynta kiba bun ki bym pat iohi ia ka khmat jong nga ha ka doh ;

en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Tur pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth bad phin sa jop ,  ki ong ,  U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ki la iathuhlypa kumta, ki da ong: To leit sha Ramothgilead bad to roi: namar U Trai un aiti ia ka ha ka kti u syiem .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .
kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki paid Amalek namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel mynba ki wan na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid , nga kynmaw ia kata kaba u Amalek u la leh ia ki Israel , kumno u la ap ia u ha ka lynti , haba u la wan kiew na Ijipt .

en: And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .
kha: U Pilat u la kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u paidbah , kumta u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki . Nangta u la phah sympat ïa u Jisu bad aiti ïa u ban shah sahnarphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta u Pilat, uba mon ban pynhun ia ki briew, u la pyllait ia u Barabbas ha ki, bad u la aiti ia U Jisu, haba u la pynkhih ia u, ban shah sahnarphna .

en: And he said unto the disciples ,  The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ka por kan poi ha kaba phin kwah ban ïohi ïa kawei na ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew , hynrei phin ym ïohi ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki synran , Ki sngi kin sa wan , ha kaba phin kwah ban iohi ia kawei na ki sngi U Khun u briew , bad phin ym iohi ia ka .

en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam lane dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta la pynngat ia nga da ka ktien U Trai, da kaba ong: Wat bam ia u kpu, lymne dih um, lymne phai biang da kajuh ka rukom kaba me wan .

en: And the sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel .
kha: U Asher bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah lem bad ka Serah ka para jong ki . Ki khun shynrang u Beraïah ki long u Heber bad u Malkhiel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Asher ; Imna, bad u Ishii, bad u Beriah, bad ka para jong ki: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Beriah ; Heber, bad u Malchiel .

en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
kha: Suit ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban tap ia ki board da ka ksiar, bad pynlong ia ki ryntieh ksiar jong ki na ka bynta ki bar: bad me dei ban tap ia ki bar da ka ksiar .

en: ( Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley . ) To morrow turn you , and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .
kha: ha kaba ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan ki shong mynta ha ki them jong ka . Phai noh lashai ka sngi bad leit sha kata ka ri khlaw ha ki phang jong ka khmut duriaw Akaba .
translated_en_to_kha: (Mynta ki nong Amalek bad ki nong Kana ki shong ha ka them . ) Ban phai noh ia phi , bad ban poi sha ka ri khlaw da ka lynti jong ka duriaw Basaw .

en: Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :
kha: Haba la krenbeiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai ktien kylliang da kaba krenbeiñ ; haba u shahshitom , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkyrmen ha U Blei , u Nongbishar bahok .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba haba u la shah pynrem , um shym la kren bein shuh shuh haba u la shah shitom , um shym la byrngem shuh shuh hynrei u la aiti ia lade ha uta uba bishar hok:

en: He feedeth on ashes : a deceived heart hath turned him aside , that he cannot deliver his soul , nor say , Is there not a lie in my right hand ?
kha: Ka long ka jingsngewthuh kumba bam dpei . Ki jingmut ba-bieit jong u ki la ïalam bakla ïa u ha kaba u don sha lyndet ka jingïarap . Un ym pdiang ha lade ba ka bleithaw ba u bat ha ka kti jong u kam long satia ka blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U bam ia ka dewbilat: ka dohnud kaba la shah thok ka la pynphai noh ia u shawei pat , ba um lah ban pynpoi ia la ka mynsiem , ne ong , Hato ym don ka jinglamler ha ka kti kadiang jong nga ?

en: And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .
kha: U Isaak u la tei ka duwan hangta bad mane ïa U  Trai . Nangta u sher ïa la ka dara hangta , bad ki shakri jong u ki ïatih sa kawei pat ka pukri .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei ia ka jingknia hangta, bad u la pyrta ia ka kyrteng U Trai, bad u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u hangta : bad hangta ki shakri u Isaak ki la tih ia ka thliew .

en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .
kha: U nong Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai kaba don shi million ki rangbah bad laispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ki tur shaphrang haduh Mareshah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zerah u nong Ethiopia u la mih pyrshah ia ki da ka kynhun shipai kaba shi hajar hajar ngut bad lai spah tylli ki kali ; bad u la poi sha Mareshah .

en: And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .
kha: Te U  Trai  u long lem bad u , bad u long uba jop ha kiei kiei kiba u leh . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ka Assyria bad u kyntait ban pyndem ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u ; bad u la roi shano shano ruh: bad u la leh pyrshah ia u syiem Assyria , bad um shym la shakri ia u .

en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king , and brought the king word back again , saying , All that was committed to thy servants , they do it .
kha: U ai ha u Shaphan ïa ka kitab , bad u Shaphan u leit rah sha u syiem . U ïathuh ,  Ngi la leh ïa baroh kaba phi la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shaphan u la rah ia ka kot sha u syiem bad u la wanrah biang ia ka ktien syiem da kaba ong: Baroh kaba la aiti ha ki shakri jong me, ki leh ia kata .

en: For whether is greater , he that sitteth at meat , or he that serveth ? is not he that sitteth at meat ? but I am among you as he that serveth .
kha: Uei uba kham khraw , uta uba shong ban bam ne uta uba shakri ïa u ? Uta keiñ uba shong . Hynrei nga long hapdeng jong phi kum uta uba shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hato u kham khraw, uta uba shong ha ka doh ne uta uba shakri ? hato uta u shong ha ka doh ? hynrei nga long hapdeng jong phi kum uta uba shakri .

en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation , We have sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel : now therefore we may not touch them .
kha: hynrei ki jubab ,  Ngi la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang jong ngi ha ki ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel . Mynta ngim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki rangbah baroh ki la ong ha ka jingiaseng baroh: Ngi la smai ha ki da U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel: mynta ngim lah ban ktah ia ki .

en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?
kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ding . Haba ki tduh ki la ing lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la kylla rnga , hato phi lah ban shna ei ei na ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , la bret ia ka ha ka ding na ka bynta ka umphniang ; ka ding ka bam ia baroh ar tylli ki tduh jong ka , bad hapdeng jong ka la thang . Hato ka iadei bad kano kano ka kam ?

en: Behold , the days come , that I will cut off thine arm , and the arm of thy father s house , that there shall not be an old man in thine house .
kha: Ha sngap , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynïap lut ïa ki samla shynrang baroh kiba na ka longïing jong me bad na ka kur jong me , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh u briew u ban im tymmen ha ka ïing jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan ba ngan ot noh ia ka kti jong me bad ka kti jong u kpa jong me, ba ym don tymmen ha iing jong me .

en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kadiang jong u , ‘ Khie leit noh na nga , phi kiba hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei ! Khie leit noh sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un ong ruh ha ki ha ka liang kadiang, To leit noh na nga, phi la tim, sha ka ding bymjukut, kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u ksuid bad ki angel jong u:

en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;
kha: U pynbiang shibun ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad shibun ka rnong haduh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pynkhreh ia ka nar ha ka jingbun na ka bynta ki bniat na ka bynta ki jingkhang jong ki khyrdop , bad na ka bynta ki jingpyniasoh ; bad ki nar ha ka jingbun khlem da khia ; .

en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet noh bad ki la leit shapoh ka shnong , ha kaba ki la ïathuh ïa ka jingjia baroh kawei bad ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki rangbah kiba shongksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phet noh ia ki, bad ki la leit shapoh shnong, bad ki la iathuh ia kiei kiei baroh, bad kaei kaba la jia ia kiba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid .

en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice  ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
kha: Ka jingïaiban ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi ka mut ba ïa kane la pynskhem da U Blei bad ba un pynurlong shen ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba ka jingphohsniew ka la long ar shah ha u Pharaoh; ka long namar ba ia kata ka long kaba la pynskhem da U Blei, bad U Blei un sa pynlong ia ka tang khyndiat por .

en: And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .
kha: U la ong ha u Moses ,  Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam kwah shuh ban ïohi ïa me ! Ha ka sngi ba nga ïohi ïa me , men ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u, To leit noh na nga, to sumar ia lade, wat iohi shuh ia ka khmat jong nga; namar ha kata ka sngi me iohi ia ka khmat jong nga me iap .

en: And Andrew , and Philip , and Bartholomew , and Matthew , and Thomas , and James the son of Alphaeus , and Thaddaeus , and Simon the Canaanite ,
kha: u Andriw , u Philip , u Bartholomai , u Matthaïos , u Thomas , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Thaddaïos , u Simon uba shitrhem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Andreios bad u Philip bad u Bartholomew bad u Mathaios bad u Thomas bad u Jakob u khun u Alphaeus bad u Thaddeos bad u Simon u nong Kanaan .

en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .
kha: Ki shah ïa ki khunlung jong ki ban ïap ha ka jingthngan bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam kaba ym don mano mano ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong u khynnah uba dang sngap jar ka rung sha ka tnum jong ka shyntur jong u namar ka jingthngan: ki khynnah rit ki pan kpu , bad ym don ba pynpra ia ka ha ki .

en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , on whom they believed .
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka balang ki la thung ïa ki nongsharai balang , bad da ki jingduwai bad ka jingshah jingit ki la aiti ïa ki sha U Trai , ha uba ki la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pynbeit ia ki rangbah ha man la ka balang , bad ki la duwai da kaba shah jingit , ki la iaroh ia ki ha U Trai , ha uba ki ngeit .

en: Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?
kha: Hato don uno uno uba kham matlah ban ïa u shakri jong nga , uba kham kyllut ban ïa u nonglamktien ba nga phah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba matlah hynrei u shakri jong nga ? lane uba sngap jar kum u nonglam khubor jong nga uba nga la phah ? uba matlah kum uta uba janai bad uba matlah kum u shakri U Trai ?

en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus , I have determined to send him .
kha: Hynrei ngam shem ba u la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban shah rai pynïap . Bad namar ba ma u hi u la lah apil sha u Patsha , nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba nga lap ba um shym la leh ei ei kaba dei ban iap , bad ba ma u hi u la kyrpad ia u Augus , nga la kut jingmut ban phah ia u .

en: While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead  ; trouble not the Master .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , u nonglamktien u la wan na ka ïing u rangbah synshar .  Ka khun jong me ka la ïap ,  u la ong ha u Jairos ;  wat pynshitom shuh ïa u nonghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren, u wan uwei na u nongsynshar jong ka synagog, u da ong ha u, Ka khun jong me ka la iap; ym ia u Nonghikai .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjop . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua: Wat tieng ia ki: namar nga la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong me ym don uwei ruh na ki uba ieng ha khmat jong me .

en: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles  ; twelve princes according to their nations .
kha: Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki khat-ar jait , bad da ki kyrteng jong ki la jer ïa ki shnong bad ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Ishmael bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki, da ki shnong jong ki, bad da ki iing syiem jong ki; shiphew ngut ki syiem kat kum ki jaitbynriew jong ki .

en: And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .
kha: Nangta ngi la leit na ryngkew sha Philippi , ka nongbah jong ka distrik banyngkong jong ka Makedonia ; kaba long ruh ka kyntoit shnong jong ki nong Rom . Ngi la pynlut bun sngi hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh kata ka por haduh Philipi kaba long ka nongbah kaba kongsan jong kata ka bynta jong ka Makedonia: bad ngi la don ha kata ka nongbah da kaba sah katto katne sngi .

en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance : I am their inheritance : and ye shall give them no possession in Israel : I am their possession .
kha: Ki lyngdoh ki don ka jinglong lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki ïa kaei kaba nga la ai ha Israel ban hiarpateng na kawei ka pateng sha kawei pat . Kin ym don jingdon jingem ha Israel ; nga long tang ma nga uba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha ki na ka bynta ka pateng: Nga long ka pateng jong ki: bad phin ym ai ia ki ia ka jaka ha Israel: Nga long ka jaka jong ki .

en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel , No soul of you shall eat blood , neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood .
kha: Dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kam bit ïa uno uno na ki , lane ïa uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la ong ha ki khun Israel , Ym don mynsiem na phi ban bam snam , lymne uno uno u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong phi un bam snam .

en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof , and their drink offerings .
kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba bteng , bad ka jingainguh doh jong ka , bad ki jingainguh dih jong ki .

en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .
kha: Haba ki Jentil ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kmen bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , bad kito ïa kiba la jied na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ki la long ki riewngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki Jutang ki la iohsngew ia kane , ki la sngewbha bad ki la pyndonburom ia ka ktien U Trai : bad katba la buh ia ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .
kha: Nga la ong ha phi ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha phi: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi; wat tieng ia ki blei ki Amorites ha ka ri jong ki: hynrei phim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga .

en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel , that they turned back from pursuing him .
kha: ki ithuh ba um dei u syiem Israel , bad ki sangeh noh na kaba tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki rangbah jong ki kali ki la sngewthuh ba kam dei ka syiem Israel , ba ki la phai noh na kaba bud ia u .

en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved , let us have grace , whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear :
kha: Te , to ngin long kiba sngewnguh , namar ngi ïohpdiang ïa ka hima ka bymlah pynkhih . To ngin long kiba sngewnguh bad mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom ka ban pynsngewbha ïa u , da ka jingsngew burom bad ka jingtiengburom ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi pdiang ia ka hima kaba ym lah ban khih , to ngin ioh ia ka jingaiei , ha kaba ngi lah ban shakri ia U Blei da kaba pdiang sngewbha da ka jingburom bad ka jingtieng kaba riewblei:

en: And he said , Thy name shall be called no more Jacob , but Israel : for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men , and hast prevailed .
kha: Uta u briew u ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me kam long shuh u Jakob . Me la ïaleh bad U Blei bad ki briew , bad me la jop ruh ; kumta ka kyrteng jong me kan long noh u Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ka kyrteng jong me kan ym khot shuh u Jakob, hynrei u Israel: namar kum u syiem me don ka bor bad U Blei bad bad ki briew, bad me la jop .

en: And Gaal spake again and said , See there come people down by the middle of the land , and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim .
kha: U Gaal u ong biang ,  Ha khmih ! La don ki briew ki wan hiar napdeng u lum , bad kawei ka kynhun ka wan na ka lynti na u dieng Sning jong ki nongkhan !
translated_en_to_kha: U Gaal u la kren biang bad u la ong , Peit ki briew ki wan hiar hapdeng ka ri, bad kawei pat ka kynhun ka wan ryngkat bad ka madan Meonenim .

en: When Jesus heard that , he said ,  This sickness is not unto death , but for the glory of God , that the Son of God might be glorified thereby .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la ong ,  Kaba kut jong kane ka jingpang kan ym dei ka jingïap jong u Lasaros ; kane ka la jia khnang ban wallam ka burom ïa U Blei , bad kan long ka lad ha kaba U Khun U Blei un ïohpdiang ïa ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata , u la ong , Kane ka jingpang kam long kaba iap , hynrei na ka bynta ka burom U Blei , ba u Khun U Blei un shah pyndonburom da kata .

en: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God , what shall we say ? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance ? ( I speak as a man )
kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingleh bymdei jong ngi ka pyn-i kham shai ïa kaei kaba dei kaba U Blei u leh ? Hato ngi lah ban ong ba U Blei u bakla haba u pynshitom ïa ngi ? ( Kane kan long ka jingkylli kaba dei ban kylli . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka jingbymhok jong ngi ka iaroh ia ka hok U Blei , ngin ong aiu ? Hato U Blei u long uba khlem hok uba shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang ? (Nga kren kum u briew )

en: Then said Paul , I stand at Caesar s judgment seat , where I ought to be judged : to the Jews have I done no wrong , as thou very well knowest .
kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Nga ïeng ha khmat ka kamra bishar ka jong u Patsha hi , ha kaba ka dei ban bishar ïa nga . Ngam shym leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa ki Jiw , kumba me hi me tip bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ong , Nga ieng ha ka jaka bishar jong u Kaisar, ha kaba nga dei ban shah bishar: ha ki Jiw ngam shym la leh ei ei kaba bakla, kumba me tip bha .

en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre , the crowning city , whose merchants are princes , whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth ?
kha: Uei uba la thmu ban wanrah ïa kane ha Tyros , kata ka nongbah u patsha , kiba ki khun syiem kiba khaïi pateng ki la long ki briew ïa kiba la ñiewburom eh ha ka pyrthei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la shim ia kane ka jingmut pyrshah ia ka Tyros , ka nongbah kaba la pynkup burom , kaba ki nongkhaii jong ka ki long ki syiem , kiba ki nongkhaii jong ki ki long kiba donburom jong ka khyndew ?

en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house , that my name may be there for ever : and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
kha: namar nga la jied ïa ka bad nga la pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan khmih halor jong ka bad ïada ïa ka ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mynta nga la jied bad pynkyntang ia kane ka iing, ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan long hangta junom: bad ki khmat jong nga bad ka dohnud jong nga kin long hangta junom .

en: And the  Lord  said , Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia  ;
kha: Haba la kurup ïa ka Ashdod , U  Trai  u la ong ,  U Isaïah u shakri jong nga u la ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad da ka kjat suda haduh lai snem . Kane ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ijipt bad ïa ka Sudan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Kumba u shakri jong nga u Isaiah u la iaid lyngkhuid bad khlem jain lai snem na ka bynta ka dak bad ka jinglyngngoh halor ka ri Ijipt bad halor ka ri Ethiopia;

en: Yea , though they have hired among the nations , now will I gather them , and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes .
kha: Hynrei mynta ngan lumlang ïa ki bad pynshitom ïa ki . Shen shen kin sa kyrthat ha ka jingpang , haba u patsha ka Assyria u banbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid wat la ki la thung kam hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , mynta ngan lum ia ki , bad kin sngewsih khyndiat na ka bynta ka jingkit jong u syiem ki syiem .

en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering .
kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa kane ka khleiñ bad un thang ha ka duwan ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kumba u ju leh ïa ka khleiñ na u mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la weng noh ia ka na ka masi jong ki jingknia jingsuk: bad u lyngdoh un thang ia ki ha ka jingknia thang .

en: Abide in me , and I in you . As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself , except it abide in the vine  ; no more can ye , except ye abide in me .
kha: To ïaineh ha nga , bad ngan ïaineh ha phi . Ka tnat kam lah ban seisoh da lade hi ; ka lah ban seisoh tang lada ka ïaineh ha u dieng sohwaiñ . Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phim lah ban seisoh lymda phi ïaineh ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sah ha nga bad nga ha phi . Kumba ka tnat kam lah ban sei soh hi , lymda ka sah ha u sohjew; phim lah shuh , lymda phi sah ha nga .

en: If those ordinances depart from before me , saith the  Lord  , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever .
kha: U kular ba katba ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka mariang ka dang neh , kumta ruh ki Israel kin long ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kita ki jingpynbeit ki mih noh na khmat jong nga , u Trai , te u symbai Israel ruh un sangeh noh ban long ka jaitbynriew ha khmat jong nga junom .

en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds , to hear the bleatings of the flocks ? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart .
kha: Balei ki sah shadien lem bad ki langbrot ? Hato ban sngap ki nongap langbrot kiba khot ïa ki jingri ? Ho-oid , ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba me la sah hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot , ban iohsngew ia ki jingsawa jong ki kynhun ? Na ka bynta ki jingphiah jong u Reuben ki la don ki jingwad kiba khraw jong ka dohnud .

en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .
kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki noh kyrwep . U don ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Babilon u la iohsngew ia ka khubor jong ki, bad ki kti jong u ki la nang tlot: ka jingsngewsih ka la bat ia u, bad ki pang kum ka kynthei ha ka jingkha khun .

en: Again , think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you ? we speak before God in Christ : but we do all things , dearly beloved , for your edifying .
kha: Lehse phi pyrkhat ba baroh shi katta ngi la pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi . Em! Ngi kren kumba U Khrist un jin da la kwah ïa ngi ban kren ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei , bad baroh kaba ngi leh , ko paralok ba-ieit , la leh ban ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , phi pyrkhat ba ngi pynrem ia lade ha phi ? ngi kren ha khmat U Blei ha U Khrist: hynrei ngi leh ia kiei kiei baroh, ko baieit eh, na ka bynta ka jingpynroi jong phi .

en: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed , saying , Of a truth this fellow also was with him : for he is a Galilaean .
kha: Bad kumba shi kynta hadien , sa uwei pat u briew u la ban jur ,  Ym don kano kano ka jingartatien ba une u briew u la don lem bad U Jisu , naba ma u hi ruh u long u nong Galilaïa !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang ka por shi kynta hadien kawei pat ka la pynskhem da ka jingsngewskhem, da kaba ong: Na ka jingshisha une u paralok ruh u la don ryngkat bad u: namar u long u Galilaia .

en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God : and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him .
kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah , u long u khun U Blei ; bad uno uno uba ieit ïa u kpa , u ieit ïa u khun jong u ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ba U Jisu U long U Khrist u la kha na U Blei: bad uno uno uba ieit ia uta uba kha u ieit ia uta ruh uba la kha na u .

en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him  ; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .
kha: Ïa baroh kaba u la kynshew yn pynjot ; ka ding ïa kaba ym shym la pynmeh da ki kti briew ka thang ïa u bad ïa baroh ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdum baroh kan buhrieh ha ki jaka rieh jong u: ka ding kaba ym shym la pynbthei kan bam ia u ; kan sa leit pang bad uta uba sah ha ka iingjain jong u .

en: Then said the king unto her , What wilt thou , queen Esther ? and what is thy request ? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom .
kha: Kaei ka jingkwah jong pha , ko Esther , ko mahadei ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa kata — wat la ka long shiteng na ka hima jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ia ka, Kaei kaba phi kwah, ko mahadei Esther? bad kaei ka jingkyrpad jong me ? kan long wat ha me ha ka shiteng jong ka hima .

en: And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .
kha: U  Trai  u la bat la ka kular bad u la ai ka jingstad ïa u Solomon . La don ka jingïasuk hapdeng u Hiram bad u Solomon , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ai ia u Solomon ia ka jingstad kumba u la kular ia u: bad ka la don ka jingsuk hapdeng u Hiram bad u Solomon ; bad ki arngut ki la ia leit noh lang .

en: ( Romans 1 :11 , 12 ) At meetings , our regular contact with fellow believers strengthens our faith and determination to live a Christian life .
kha: ( Rom 1 :11 , 12 ) Ka jingïakynduh tista jong ngi bad la ki para bangeit ha ki jingïalang ka pynskhem ïa ka jingngeit jong ngi bad ïa ka jingraikut jong ngi ban im katkum ki jinghikai jong ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: (Rom 1 :11 , 12 ) Ha ki jingialang , ka jingiadei jong ngi man ka por bad ki parabangeit ka pynskhem ia ka jingngeit bad ka jingkut jingmut jong ngi ban im ka jingim Khristan .

en: How long wilt thou go about , O thou backsliding daughter ? for the  Lord  hath created a new thing in the earth , A woman shall compass a man .
kha: Haduh katno phin pynslem , ko ki briew bym don jingngeit ? Nga la thaw kaei kaei kaba thymmai bad kaba pher , kaba pher kum ka briew kaba ïada ïa u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno por phin leit kylleng kylleng, ko khun kynthei kaba phaidien? namar U Trai u la thaw ia kaei kaei kaba thymmai ha ka khyndew , Ka kynthei kan sa ker sawdong ia u briew .

en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .
kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynmih ia ki, hadien kata u la pyni ia ki jingphylla bad ki dak ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka duriaw Basaw bad ha ka ri khlaw sawphew snem .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .
kha: Nga , nga long u kpu ka jingim ,  U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki .  Kito kiba wan sha nga da lei lei kin ym thngan ; kito kiba ngeit ha nga da lei lei kin ym sliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Nga long u kpu ka jingim: uta uba wan sha nga un ym iap satia; bad uta uba ngeit ha nga un ym sliang satia .

en: Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
kha: Ki la thmu ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa ki briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u khun jong u Tabeel halor ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin ia kiew shaphang ka Judah, bad ngin ia pynpra ia ka, bad ngin ia pynpra ia ka ha ka jaka jong ngi, bad ngin buh ia u syiem hapdeng jong ka, wat ia u khun u Tabeal:

en: Rejoice not , O Israel , for joy , as other people : for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God , thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , sangeh noh kaba rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam kum ki riewthala . Phi la phai lyndet na la U Blei bad phi la long ki bymïaineh ha u . Ha baroh kawei ka ri phi la die ïa lade kum ki nuti ha u blei Baal bad phi la ieit ïa u kew uba phi pyrkhat ba u la siew na ka bynta jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewbha, ko Israel, namar ka jingkmen, kumba long kiwei pat ki briew: namar me la leit noh na U Blei jong me, me la ieit ia ka bainong ha kawei pa kawei ka khlaw .

en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework .
kha: Ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ , thaw ïa ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ, kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw bad kaba rong saw .

en: For in those days shall be affliction , such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time , neither shall be .
kha: Namar ka jingshitom jong kita ki sngi kan long kaba kham sniew , ban ïa kaei kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka la ju tip naduh myn nyngkong eh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei haduh ka por ba mynta . Lymne yn ym don shuh hadien kum kata kaei kaei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kita ki sngi kan long ka jingjynjar, kumba ym shym la long naduh ka jingsdang jong ka jingthaw kaba U Blei u la thaw haduh kane ka por .

en: And I said , What is it ? And he said , This is an ephah that goeth forth . He said moreover , This is their resemblance through all the earth .
kha: Ka dei kaei ?  Nga la kylli . U la jubab ,  Ka dei ka shang , bad ka ïeng na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong , Kaei kata ? Bad u la ong , Kane ka long ka ephah kaba leit shabar . U la ong shuh shuh , Kane ka long ka jingiasyriem jong ki lyngba ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .
kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Mynta ngan leit phai pat sha la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan mih , nga maham lypa ïa phi aïu ki Israel kin leh ïa ki briew jong phi hadien habud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, nga leit sha ki briew jong nga: to wan namarkata, bad ngan pynbna ia me ia kaei kaba une u briew un leh ia ki briew jong me ha ki sngi kiba hadien .

en: And now , little children , abide in him  ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
kha: Ho-oid , ko ki khun jong nga , to ïaisah ha u , khnang ba ynda u wanpaw , ngin long kiba dap da ka jingshlur bad ngim donkam ban rieh ha ka jinglehrain na u ha ka Sngi kaba u wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko khun rit, to kohnguh ia u; ba ynda un paw , ngin ioh ia ka jingshaniah bad ngin ym sngewlehrain ha khmat jong u ha ka jingwan jong u .

en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master , tell me : and if not , tell me  ; that I may turn to the right hand , or to the left .
kha: Mynta , lada phi mut ban pyndep ïa ka jingkitkhlieh kaba phi don ïa u kynrad jong nga bad ban lehhok ïa u , to sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga ; te lada kam long , to ong kumta , bad ngan sa rai aïu ngan leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta lada phin leh sbun bad shisha bad u kynrad jong nga, to iathuh ia nga: bad lada ym dei, to iathuh ia nga; to iathuh ia nga ba nga lah ban phai sha ka liang kadiang, ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .
kha: Wat la nga la pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , pynban ha ki jaka kiba jngai eh kin kynmaw ïa nga . Ma ki bad ki khun jong ki kin lait im bad kin wan phai lang sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bet ia ki hapdeng ki briew: bad kin kynmaw ia nga ha ki ri kiba jngai ; bad kin im bad ki khun jong ki , bad kin phai biang .

en: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses , the same commit thou to faithful men , who shall be able to teach others also .
kha: Shim ïa ki jinghikai kiba me la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ha khmat ki sakhi babun , bad aiti ïa ki ha ki briew kiba lah ban shaniah , kiba lah ban hikai ïa kiwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiei kiei kiba me la iohsngew na nga hapdeng ki sakhi kiba bun , kumjuh ruh me leh ia ki briew kiba iaineh , kiba lah ban hikai ia kiwei ruh .

en: But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
kha: U dieng Olib u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam ban pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u dieng olive u la ong ha ki: Hato nga dei ban iehnoh ia ka jingbun snam jong nga, ha kaba da nga ki burom ia U Blei bad ia u briew bad ki leit sha ki dieng ?

en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals , and I heard , as it were the noise of thunder , one of the four beasts saying , Come and see .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait noh ïa kawei na ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei na ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ba u ong ha ka sur kaba sawa kum u pyrthat ,  To wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi haba u Khunlangbrot u la plie ia kawei na ki muhor , bad nga la iohsngew kumba ka long ka jingsawa jong u lyoh , uwei na ki saw tylli ki mrad u la ong: To wan bad peit .

en: And Judah spake unto him , saying , The man did solemnly protest unto us , saying , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .
kha: Hynrei u Judah u ong ha u ,  Uta u briew u la maham tyngeh ïa ngi ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don ryngkat lem bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la kren ha u, u la kren bein ia ngi da kaba ong: Phin ym iohi ia ka khmat jong nga, lymda u hynmen jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi .

en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .
kha: Nangta u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi , ki la wan ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ka don kaei kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob bad u Ioannis ki khun u Sebede ki wan sha u, ki da ong: Ko Nonghikai, ngi kwah ba me dei ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi katba ngi kwah .

en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps , and strangled for his lionesses , and filled his holes with prey , and his dens with ravin .
kha: U sing u pynïap ïa ka jingbam jong u bad u tar ïa ka lyngkhot lyngkhot na ka bynta ka sing jong u bad ki khun jong ka ; u la pyndap ïa ka krem jong u da ka doh ba la patar .
translated_en_to_kha: U sing u la iam ha ki bynta jong u baroh kawei, bad u la tyrkhong na ka bynta ki sing jong u, bad u la pyndap ia ki thliew jong u da ki mrad ba bam dohkha, bad ki thliew jong u da ki thliew .

en: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row , that it may be on the bread for a memorial , even an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Buh khyndiat ka jingiwbih kaba khuid halor kawei kawei ka laiñ , kum ka dak ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ka jingiwbih kaba khuid ha kawei pa kawei ka lain, ba kan long ha u kpu na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw, wat ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: And when the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  , she fell down under Balaam : and Balaam s anger was kindled , and he smote the ass with a staff .
kha: Ha kane ka sien , haba ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel , ka la dem khop . U Balaam u la bitar lep bad u la sdang ban sympat ïa ka da la u diengduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka tdong ka la iohi ia u angel U Trai , ka la hap hapoh u Balaam : bad u Balaam u la bthei ka jingbitar , bad u la shoh ia ka tdong da u dieng .

en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree , and the increase of the field , that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen .
kha: Ngan pynroi kyrhai ïa ka jingmih na ki diengsoh bad na ki lyngkha jong phi , ba kan ym don shuh ka  nemsniew ka ban pynjahburom ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbun ia u soh jong u dieng bad ka jingroi jong ka lyngkha , ba phin ym ioh shuh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ka jingkyrduh hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

en: And afterward when David heard it , he said , I and my kingdom are guiltless before the  Lord  for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner :
kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u ong ,  U  Trai  u tip ba ma nga bad ki khun ki hajar jong nga ngim don jingrem ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kata haba u Dabid u la iohsngew ia kata , u la ong , ma nga bad ka hima jong nga ngi long kiba khlem pop ha khmat U Trai junom na ka snam u Abner u khun u Ner:

en: And were carried over into Sychem , and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem .
kha: Ïa ki met jong ki la leit rah sha Shekhem , ha kaba la tep ïa ki ha ka jingtep kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka pisa na ka jait Hamar .
translated_en_to_kha: La rah ia ki sha u Sychem bad la buh ha ka jingtep kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka pisa jong ki khun shynrang jong u Emor u kpa jong u Sychem .

en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses , every one his day  ; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Job ki ju pynlong da ka pali ïa ka jingkhawai , sha kaba baroh kiwei ki ïawan , bad borabor ki ju khot sngewbha ïa ki lai ngut ki para kynthei ban ïadon lang bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki la leit bam ha ki iing jong ki, uwei pa uwei u la phah bad u la khot ia ki lai ngut ki para kynthei jong ki ban bam bad ban dih bad ki .

en: Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye  ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother s eye .
kha: Phi u riewarsap ! Nyngkong eh weng noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na la ka khmat jong phi hi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai kdar ban khlaw ïa u thiat na ka khmat u para jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me uba arsap , to bret noh nyngkong ia ka beam na la ka jong ka khmat ; bad nangta to iohi shai ba me bret noh ia ka mote na ka khmat jong u hynmen jong me .

en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , Barbarian , Scythian , bond nor free : but Christ is all , and in all .
kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka long ba ym don shuh ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Jentil bad ki Jiw , kiba la shah otsher bad ki bym shym la shah otsher , ki riewkhlaw , ki riewdum , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid ; hynrei U Khrist u long baroh , U Khrist u long ha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ym don Grik ne Jiw, ka jingkren bein ne ka jingbymkren bein, ka Barbarian , ka Scythian , ka bond ne ka laitluid: hynrei U Khrist u long baroh, bad ha baroh .

en: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah . And it came to pass in the month Chisleu , in the twentieth year , as I was in Shushan the palace ,
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa kaei kaba u Nehemaïah u khun jong u Hakalaïah u la pyndep . Ha u bnai Kisleb jong ka snem kaba arphew ba u Artakserksis u long u patsha ka Persia , ma nga , u Nehemaïah , nga don ha ka nongbah jong ka hima , ka Susa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien u Nehemaiah u khun u Hachiah . Bad ka la jia ha u bnai Chisleu , ha ka snem kaba arphew , kumba nga la don ha Shushan ka iing syiem .

en: And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?
kha: Ka Hagar ka kylli ïa lade ,  Hato nga da ïohi shisha ïa U Blei bad ba nga dang im ban ïathuh ïa kata ?  Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba la kren ha ka ,  U Blei uba ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai uba la kren ha ka: Me U Blei me iohi ia nga: namar ka la ong: Hato nga ruh hangne nga peit ia uta uba iohi ia nga ?

en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .
kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tebeth , u bnai ba-shiphew , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la ialam ia ka Esther sha u syiem Ahasherus ha ka iing syiem jong u ha ka shiphew bnai kaba long u bnai Tebet ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :
kha: Hynrei , da kaba kylla long ka jingtim na ka bynta jong ngi , U Khrist u la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba la shah sdien ha u dieng un don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Khrist u la siewspah ia ngi na ka jingtim jong ka hukum: namar la thoh: La thoh: La thoh: La thoh: Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha u dieng:

en: But I would ye should understand , brethren , that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel ;
kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko parabangeit jong nga , ba kiei kiei kiba la jia ha nga ki la ïarap da shisha ïa ka jingpynroi ïa ka gospel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga kwah ba phin sngewthuh ko para bangeit, ba kiei kiei kiba la jia ha nga ki la hap noh kham sha ka jingpynjlan ia ka gospel ; .

en: And that he died for all , that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves , but unto him which died for them , and rose again .
kha: U la ïap na ka bynta baroh , khnang ba kito kiba im kim dei shuh ban im na ka bynta ïa lade , hynrei tang na ka bynta jong uta uba la ïap bad ba la pynmihpat na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba u la iap na ka bynta baroh, ba kita kiba im kin ym im shuh shuh ha lade, hynrei ha uta uba la iap na ka bynta jong ki, bad u la mihpat biang .

en: In the end of the sabbath , as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week , came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre .
kha: Hadien ka sngi Sabbaton katba ka step Sngi U Blei ka dang kynjat shai , ka Mari ka nong Magdala , bad kawei pat ka Mari ki la leit ban khmih ïa ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ka Sabha , katba ka dang sdang ban shai ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka taiew , ka Maria Magdalene bad kawei pat ka Maria ki la wan ban peit ia ka jingtep .

en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth , where no gin is for him ? shall one take up a snare from the earth , and have taken nothing at all ?
kha: Hato ka sim kan shu ngat ha ka jingriam lymda la pynap jingriam ïa ka ? Hato ka shangkhawiah ka ju bsiat hi lymda ngat ei ei ha ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u sim u lah ban hap ha ka jingma ha ka khyndew , ha kaba ym don gin na ka bynta jong u ? uwei un shim ia ka jingma na ka khyndew , bad kim shym la shim ei ei ruh em ?

en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .
kha: Wat pynhiarkput ïano ïano lane ban ïai isih ïa u , hynrei ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynshitom bein ia ki khun jong me: Nga long U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child  ; and they called him Zacharias , after the name of his father .
kha: Haba u khunlung u la dap shi taïew , ki la wan ban otsher ïa u , bad ki la mut ban kyrteng ïa u , u Sekharaïah , kaba bud ïa u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra ki la wan ban ot ia u khynnah bad ki la khot ia u u Zakhiah , hadien ka kyrteng u kpa jong u .

en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea ; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints ;
kha: To duwai ba ngan lait na ka jingma na ki bymngeit kiba don ha Judia bad ba ka jingshakri jong nga ha Jerusalem kan long kaba la pdiang da ki briew jong U Blei hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan shah pyllait na ki ki bym ngeit ha Judaea ; bad ba ka jingshakri jong nga kaba nga don na ka bynta ka Jerusalem kan long kaba la pdiang da ki riewkhuid ; .

en: And the child Samuel ministered unto the  Lord  before Eli . And the word of the  Lord  was precious in those days  ; there was no open vision .
kha: Ha kita ki sngi , haba uta u khynnah Samuel , u shakri ïa U  Trai  hapoh ka jingïalam u Eli , don tang khyndiat eh ki khubor na U  Trai  ; bad ñiar eh ban don ki jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah Samuel u la shakri ia U Trai ha khmat u Eli . Bad ka ktien U Trai ka la long kaba kordor ha kito ki sngi ; ym shym la don ka jingphohsniew kaba plie .

en: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sngewïahap bad ki la ïasoh bad u Paul bad u Silas ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa kiba bun ki kynthei kiba pawkhmat bad ka kynhun bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don napdeng jong ki kiba ngeit bad kiba la iasoh bad u Paul bad u Silas bad na ki Grik kiba riewblei kiba bun briew bad na ki kynthei kiba kham rangbah ym tang khyndiat ngut .

en: And when ye came unto this place , Sihon the king of Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , came out against us unto battle , and we smote them :
kha: Bad ynda ngi la poi ha kane ka jaka , U Sihon u syiem Heshbon bad u Og u Syiem Bashan ki la wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi la poi ha kane ka jaka, u Syiem Heshbon bad u Og u syiem u Basan ki la mih pyrshah ia ngi ha ka thma bad ngi la shoh ia ki:

en: And he saith unto them ,  Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days , or to do evil ? to save life , or to kill ?  But they held their peace .
kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa ki briew ,  Kaei kaba ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Ban ïarap lane ban pynsniew ? Ban pynim ïa ka jingim u briew lane ban pynjot ïa ka ?  Hynrei kim shym la ong ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Hato ka long kaba dei ban leh bha ha ka sngi Sabha ne ban leh ia kaba sniew ? ban pynim ia ka jingim ne ban pyniap ? Hynrei ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki .

en: Thus shall they know that I the  Lord  their God am with them , and that they , even the house of Israel , are my people , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Baroh kin tip ba nga ïada ïa ki Israel bad ba ki long ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kin tip ba nga U Trai U Blei jong ki nga don ryngkat bad ki, bad ba ki, wat ka iing Israel ruh ki long ki briew jong nga, ong U Trai U Blei .

en: They have dealt treacherously against the  Lord  : for they have begotten strange children : now shall a month devour them with their portions .
kha: Ki la long ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki khun jong ki kim long ki jong u . Kumta mynta , ma ki bad ki jaka jong ki kin sa shah pynjot noh shen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leh bein ia U Trai : namar ki la kha ia ki khun kiba phylla: mynta ka taiew kan bam ia ki da ki bynta jong ki .

en: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el , unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Beth–el and Ai  ;
kha: Te u la mihnoh nangta bad u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , da kaba leit sha Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ki jingleit jong u na shaphang shathie haduh Bethel, haduh ka jaka ba ka ïingjaiñ jong u ka la don ha kaba sdang, hapdeng ka Bethel bad Ai ; .

en: And he said to the king of Israel , Put thine hand upon the bow . And he put his hand upon it : and Elisha put his hands upon the king s hands .
kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha u ba un pynkhreh ban siat . U syiem u leh kumta , bad u Elisha u buh ïa la ki kti ha ki kti u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u syiem Israel, "To buh ia ka kti jong me ha ka bow . Bad u la buh ia la ka kti halor jong ka: bad u Elisha u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha ki kti jong u syiem .

en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .
kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U  Trai  ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba u la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long haduh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .
