translated_en_to_kha: Tang U Trai u la sngewbha ha ki kpa tymmen jong me ban ieit ia ki , bad u la jied ia u symbai jong ki hadien jong ki , wat ia phi halor ki briew baroh , kumba ka long mynta ka sngi .

en: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth , and smote him : I hid me , and was wroth , and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart .
kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki namar ka pop bad ka jingkwah lalot jong ki , bad kumta nga la pynshitom bad iehnoh ïa ki . Hynrei ki la long mutlop bad ki la nang ïaid ha la ki jong ki lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingbymhok jong ka jingkwah brai jong u nga la bitar , bad nga la pynsngewsih ia u: Nga la buhrieh ia nga , bad nga la bitar , bad u la iaid lyngngoh ha ka lynti jong ka dohnud jong u .

en: But I would not have you to be ignorant , brethren , concerning them which are asleep , that ye sorrow not , even as others which have no hope .
kha: Ko parabangeit , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingshisha shaphang kito kiba la ïap , khnang ba phin ym sngewsih , kumba long kito ki bym don ka jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngam kwah ba phin long kiba khlem jingtip, ko para bangeit, shaphang kito kiba la iohthiah, ba phin ym sngewsih, wat kum kiwei pat ki bym don jingkyrmen .

en: And your strength shall be spent in vain : for your land shall not yield her increase , neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits .
kha: Baroh ka jingtrei shitom jong phi kan long lehnoh-ei , namar ka khyndew jong phi kan ym pynmih jingthung jingtep bad ki dieng kin ym seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bor jong phi kan long kaba la pynlut ha ka por: namar ka ri jong phi kan ym ai ia ka jingroi jong ka , lymne ki dieng jong ka ri kin ym ai ia ki soh jong ki .

en: I will be thy king : where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities ? and thy judges of whom thou saidst , Give me a king and princes ?
kha: Phi pan ïa u syiem bad ki nongïalam , hynrei mynta kumno ki lah ban pyllait im ïa ka ri ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan long u syiem jong me : hangno uwei pat uba lah ban pynim ia me ha ki shnong jong me baroh ? bad ki nongbishar jong me kiba me ong: Ai ia nga ia u syiem bad ki syiem ?

en: There are also celestial bodies , and bodies terrestrial : but the glory of the celestial is one , and the glory of the terrestrial is another .
kha: Don ruh ki met kiba kynja bneng bad ki met kiba kynja doh ; ka jingitynnat jong kita ki met kiba kynja bneng ka ïapher na ka jingitynnat jong kita kiba kynja doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ruh ki met bneng , bad ki met ba shapoh: hynrei ka burom jong ka bneng ka long kawei , bad ka burom jong ka bneng ka long kawei pat .

en: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign  ; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehu u syiem ka Israel , u Joash u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sibiah na ka nongbah Beersheba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong u Jehu Jehoash u la sdang ban synshar ; bad sawphew snem u la synshar ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Zbiah jong u Berashab .

en: Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made , and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee .
kha: Ngan pynhap ïa ka ksang ti jong nga halor ki kam tuh bad pynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , namarkata nga la pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga ha ka jingmyntoi bym hok jong me kaba me la leh bad ha ka snam jong me kaba la don hapdeng jong me .

en: For God is my witness , whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son , that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers ;
kha: U Blei u long u sakhi jong nga ba kaei kaba nga ong ka long kaba shisha — U Blei ïa uba nga shakri da ka dohnud jong nga baroh da kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khun jong u . U Blei u tip ba nga kynmaw ïa phi man ba nga duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u long u sakhi jong nga, ia uba nga shakri da ka mynsiem jong u Khun jong u, ba khlem sangeh nga kdew ia phi man ka por ha ki jingduwai jong nga;

en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed , he said , Send . They sent therefore fifty men  ; and they sought three days , but found him not .
kha: Hynrei ki la ïai ban haduh ba u la mynjur bad shah ïa ki ban leit . Ki sanphew ngut na ki , ki la leit bad ki la wad ïa u Elijah sha lum sha them haduh lai sngi , hynrei kim shym shem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la kyntu ia u haduh ba u la sngewlehrain, u la ong, phah . Ki la phah namarkata sanphew ngut ki briew; bad ki la wad lai sngi hynrei kim lap ia u .

en: Let him know , that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death , and shall hide a multitude of sins .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada uwei na phi u ïaid sakma na ka jingshisha bad uwei pat u pynphai pat ïa u , to kynmaw ïa kane : Uno uno uba pynphai pat ïa u nongpop na ka lynti kaba bakla un pynim ïa ka mynsiem jong uta u nongpop na ka jingïap bad yn map ïa ki pop kiba bun byllien jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba un tip , ba uta uba pynkylla ia u nongpop na ka jingbakla jong ka lynti jong u un pynim ia ka mynsiem na ka jingiap , bad un buhrieh ia ki pop kiba bun .

en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ka jaka shong kaba khuid: ar cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka , bad shi cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: Therefore said I , Look away from me  ; I will weep bitterly , labour not to comfort me , because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people .
kha: Mynta to iehnoh ïa nga marwei ban ïamkthang halor kito na ki briew jong nga kiba la ïap . Wat pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la ong: Peit noh na nga ; ngan iam sngewsih, ngan ym pynsngewbha ia nga, namar ka jingsniew jong ka khun jong ki briew jong nga .

en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people : for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son .
kha: Bad kumta ha kata ka sngi , kata ka jingkmen ïa ka jingjop ka la kylla sha ka jingsngewsih ïa baroh ki shipai jong u Dabid , namar ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem u ïambriew na ka bynta la u khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingjop ha kata ka sngi ka la kylla long kaba sngewsih ia ki briew baroh: namar ki briew ki la iohsngew ba ki ong ha kata ka sngi kumno u syiem u la sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong u .

en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .
kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh dei ban leh da uwei pa uwei u Lyngdoh uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u ban shakri kum u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkñia sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh jong ki khun shynrang jong u uba la shah pynsleh ha ka jaka jong u un aiti ia ka: ka long ka ain junom ha U Trai; kan shah thang lut .

en: And when he had given thanks , he brake it , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body , which is broken for you : this do in remembrance of me .
kha: Naba nga la ïohpdiang na U Trai ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai pateng ha phi : Ba U Trai Jisu , ha kata ka miet ha kaba la shetkylla ïa u , u la shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ainguh ia ka, u la pynkhih ia ka, bad u la ong, To shim: kane ka long ka met jong nga kaba la tyrkhong na ka bynta jong phi: kane leh ha ka jingkynmaw ia nga .

en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :
kha: hynrei ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba bit ban mihpat na ka jingïap bad ban im ha ki pateng ban wan kin ym shongkurim shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kito kiba dei ban ioh ia kata ka pyrthei bad ka jingmihpat na kiba iap, kim shongkurim ne shah ai ha ka jingshongkurim:

en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .
kha: Mynta , ïa kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki briew ki bym pat shongkurim : Ngam don ka hukum na U Trai , hynrei nga ai ïa la ka jingmut kum uwei uba da ka jingisynei U Trai nga long uba lah ban shaniah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shaphang ki nongleh bymman ngam don hukum jong U Trai: hynrei nga ai ia ka jingbishar jong nga , kum uta uba la ioh ia ka jingisynei U Trai ban long uba iaineh .

en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .
kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong u kñi jong u , u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kñi , kumta ma u bad kata ka briew kin kit hi ïa la ka pop ; baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew un thiah bad ka tnga jong u kaba khlem khun: kin kit ia ka pop jong ki ; kin iap khlem khun .

en: I ate no pleasant bread , neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth , neither did I anoint myself at all , till three whole weeks were fulfilled .
kha: Ngam shym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam bang lane kano kano ka doh , lane dih ïa kano kano ka waiñ , lane sad ïa u shñiuh jong nga tad haduh ba ki lai taïew ki la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la bam ia u kpu uba sngewtynnad, ym shym la wan doh ne wain ha ka shyntur jong nga, lymne ngam shym la pynsleh ia lade satia, haduh lai taiew pura .

en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
kha: Bad U Blei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei , khnang ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane la pynpaw ia ka jingieit U Blei ia ngi , namar ba U Blei u la phah ia la u Khun ba la kha tang marwei ha ka pyrthei , ba ngin im lyngba jong u .

en: O  Lord  our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own .
kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , ngi la wallam lang ïa kane ka spah baroh ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me , hynrei kane baroh ka la wan na me bad ka long ka jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai jong ngi baroh kaba ngi la pynkhreh ban tei ia me ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me ka wan na ka kti jong me, bad ka long ka jong me hi baroh .

en: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world ? and if the world shall be judged by you , are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?
kha: Hato phim tip ba ki briew U Blei kin sa bishar ïa ka pyrthei ? Te , namarkata , lada phi long ki ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hato phim long kiba lah ban bishar ïa kiei kiei kiba rit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba ki riewkhuid kin bishar ia ka pyrthei ? bad lada ka pyrthei kan shah bishar ha phi , hato phim lah ban bishar ia kiei kiei kiba rit tam ?

en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .
kha: Un wallam ruh ar tylli ki paro ne ki lyngdkhur , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki turtle , ne ar tylli ki paro rit , kumba u lah ban ioh; bad uwei pat un long ka jingainguh pop .

en: On that night could not the king sleep , and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles  ; and they were read before the king .
kha: Ha kajuh ka miet u syiem um ïohthiah satia , kumta u hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka hima bad ban pule ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka miet u syiem um lah ban thiah , bad u la hukum ban wanrah ia ka kot ki jingthoh jong ki khanatang ; bad la pule ia ki ha khmat u syiem .

en: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall , swelling out in a high wall , whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant .
kha: Phi long kiba la shah pynrem . Phi long kum ka kynroh kaba jrong kaba don jingorpait naduh jrong haduh tbian ; kynsan kynsan phin sa kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kane ka jingbymhok kan long ha phi kum ka jingpynkhein kaba la pynkhreh ban hap , kaba la tyrkhong ha ka kynroh kaba jrong , kaba ka jingpynkylla jong ka ka wan kynsan kynsan .

en: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel!
kha: Ngam don hok ban kob tang namar ba nga ïalap ïa ka Gospel . La katta ruh , nga don hapoh ki hukum ban leh kumta . Bad katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa nga lada ngam shym la ïalap ïa ka gospel!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga ialap ia ka gospel, ngam don ei ei ban pyndonburom: namar ka jingdonkam ka la buh ha nga ; yea , kordit ia nga lada ngam ialap ia ka gospel!

en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts , but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil  ; for thine olive shall cast his fruit .
kha: Ki diengsoh Olib kin mih kyrhai ha ka ri jong phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh umphniang , naba ki soh Olib kin hap khlem por .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban don ki dieng olive ha kylleng ki jaka jong me , hynrei wat pynsleh ia lade da ka umphniang ; namar ka olive jong me kan theh ia ki soh jong u .

en: And it shall be , if he say unto thee , I will not go away from thee  ; because he loveth thee and thine house , because he is well with thee  ;
kha: Hynrei lada u mraw jong phi um kwah ban mih , bad u ieit ïa phi bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , bad u sngewhun ban sah bad phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , lada u ong ia me , ngan ym leit noh na me ; namar u ieit ia me bad ia ka iing jong me, namar u long uba bha bad me ; .

en: The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .
kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Kata te kaba da phylla ! Phim tip nangno u wan , hynrei u la pynkoit ïa nga na ka jingmatlah jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Balei hangne ka long kaba phylla , ba phim tip naei u don , bad wat la katta ruh u la plie ia ki khmat jong nga .

en: So after he had washed their feet , and had taken his garments , and was set down again , he said unto them ,  Know ye what I have done to you ?
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la sait ïa ki kjat jong ki , u la kup biang ïa ka jaiñkup bad u la leit phai sha la ka jaka ha ka miej .  Phi sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba nga dang shu dep ban leh ïa phi ?  u la kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta hadien ba u la sait ia ki kjat jong ki bad u la shim ia ki jain jong u bad u la shong biang ha ki , u la ong ha ki: Phi tip ia kaei kaba nga la leh ia phi ?

en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt , and as a dove out of the land of Assyria : and I will place them in their houses , saith the  Lord .
kha: Kin wan na Ijipt , da kaba her stet kum ki sim , bad na Assyria , kum ki paro . Ngan wanlam pat ïa ki sha ki ïing jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin khih kum ka sim na Ijipt, bad kum ka paro na ka ri Assyria: bad ngan buh ia ki ha ki iing jong ki , ong U Trai .

en: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
kha: u khun jong u Serug , u khun jong u Reu , u khun jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Shelah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Saruch uba long u khun u Ragau uba long u khun u Phalec uba long u khun u Heber uba long u khun u Sala .

en: But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;
kha: Da kumwei pat , ki la ïohi ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jentil , kumba u la ai ha u Petros ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei pyrshah ia ka jinglong ba sniew, haba ki la iohi ba la aiti ha nga ia ka gospel jong ka jingkren bein ha u Petros;

en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases , and cast out many devils  ; and suffered not the devils to speak , because they knew him .
kha: U Jisu u la pynkhiah bun kiba pang na ki jait jingpang kiba bun bad beh noh ïa kiba bun ki ksuid . Um shah ba ki ksuid kin kren ei ei , namar ki la tip u long uei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkoit ia kiba bun kiba pang jyrhoh, bad u la beh noh ia ki ksuid beg bad um shym la shah ia ki ksuid ban kren , namar ki ithuh ia u .

en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife , the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan–aram , the sister to Laban the Syrian .
kha: U Isaak u la sawphew snem ka rta mynba u shongkurim ïa ka Rebekka , ka khun jong u Bethuel ( u nong Aram na ka ri Mesopotamia ) bad ka para jong u Laban .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la dap sawphew snem ka rta haba u la shim ia ka Rebekka bad ka tnga jong u Bethuel u Syria u Paddanaram .

en: The unity that we enjoy as an organization and the experience we have gained in working together enable us to mobilize quickly in times of need .
kha: Ka jingïatyllilang bad ka jingïatreilang ka pynlah ïa ngi ban lum kloi kloi ïa ki jingïarap bad ïa ki nongtrei ha ka por ba donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiatylli kaba ngi sngewtynnad kum ka seng bad ka jingshemphang kaba ngi la ioh ha kaba iatrei lang ka pynlah ia ngi ban khih kloi ha ki por ba donkam .

en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly : therefore shall he leave his blood upon him , and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la pynbitar kthang ïa U  Trai  ; ki dei hok ban shah pynïap namar ki kam sniew jong ki . U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingpynjahburom kaba ki la wanlam ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u la pynlong ia u ban bitar kham jur: namarkata un iehnoh ia ka snam jong u halor jong u , bad ka jingshah lehbein jong u kan wan phai biang sha u .

en: And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .
kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ngan ïoh ïalam ïa kine ki briew ! ngan jin da la pynher krad ïa u Abimelekh ! Ngan ong ïa u , ‘ Pynbun shuh shuh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , ale to mih ban ïaleh !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga kwah ia U Blei ba une u briew un don hapoh ka kti jong nga ! nangta ngan weng noh ia u Abimelech . Bad u la ong ha u Abimelech , Pynroi ia ka kynhun shipai jong me bad to mih noh .

en: And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?
kha: Ki la ong para ma ki ,  Hato kam shym la long kum ka ding kaba klang hapoh jong ngi mynba u la kren ha ngi ha ka lynti bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ha ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Hato ka dohnud jong ngi kam shym la thang hapoh jong ngi katba u dang ia kren bad ngi ha lynti bad katba u dang plie ia ngi ia ki jingthoh ?

en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages : in the secret places doth he murder the innocent : his eyes are privily set against the poor .
kha: U buhrieh ïa lade ha ki shnongrit , da kaba apthap ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui . U syntiat ïa ki lanot jong u , ki bym don nongïarap ,
translated_en_to_kha: U shong ha ki jaka ba jylliew jong ki shnong: ha ki jaka ba rieh u pyniap ia ki bym don pop: ki khmat jong u ki long kiba la buh kyrpang pyrshah ia kiba duk .

en: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts , saying , What manner of child shall this be ! And the hand of the Lord was with him .
kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba la ïohsngew ïa kata , u la pyrkhat shaphang kata bad u la kylli ,  Aïu une u khunlung un long ?  Naba ka la long kaba shai ba ka bor jong U Trai ka la don halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba la iohsngew ia ki ki la buh ia ki ha ki dohnud jong ki, ki da ong: Kaei ka jait khynnah kane kan long ! Bad ka kti U Trai ka la don ryngkat bad u .

en: And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .
kha: Ieh ïa ka kumba ka long ,  u Josaïah u hukum .  Ïa ki shyieng jong u ym dei ban pynkhih .  Kumta ïa ki shyieng jong u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong kito ki jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la wan na Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , To ai ba un iaid marwei . Kumta ki la iehnoh ia ki shyieng jong u marwei, bad ki shyieng jong u nongiathuhlypa kiba la mih na Samaria .

en: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing , as unto a faithful Creator .
kha: Kumta te , kito kiba shahshitom namar ba ka long ka mon U Blei ïa ki , ki dei da la ki kam babha ban shaniah tylli ïa lade ha U Nongthaw jong ki , uba ïai bat ïa la ka jingkular .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ai ba kita kiba shah shitom kat kum ka mon U Blei kin leh ia ka jingpynsah ia ka mynsiem jong ki ha u ha kaba leh bha, kumba ha u Nongthaw uba iaineh .

en: And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .
kha: bad u Dabid u ong ha uta u nong Amalek ,  Me la wallam ïa kane halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lade haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u, Ka snam jong me ka long halor ka khlieh jong me; namar ka shyntur jong me ka la sakhi pyrshah ia me, da kaba ong: Nga la pyniap ia U Trai .

en: I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kaba kut jong pha . Ki briew ki lah ban wad ïa pha , hynrei kin ym lap ïa pha .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia me ka jingtieng, bad me nym long shuh: wat la phi wad ia me, hynrei wat ju lap shuh ia me, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .
kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki bad un pynjot ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ki ha ka jingbymhok jong ki hi, bad un ot noh ia ki ha ka jingsniew jong ki hi; hooid , U Trai U Blei jong ngi un ot noh ia ki .

en: And , behold , ye are risen up in your fathers  stead , an increase of sinful men , to augment yet the fierce anger of the  Lord  toward Israel .
kha: Bad mynta phi la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka pateng bynriew bathymmai jong ki riewbymman kaba kloi ban pynwan biang ïa ka jingbitar kaba shyrkhei jong U  Trai  halor ki Israel sa shisien pat !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, phi la kiew ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi, ka jingkiew jong ki briew kiba pop, ban pynroi ia ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai ia ki Israel .

en: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender , which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan .
kha: Ki masi kyrtong bad ki kada kiba lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi kin ïoh bam ïa u phlang bakynsai tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki masi kumjuh bad ki khun masi kiba sngap jar kin bam ia u nongbam ba khuid, uba la shah rong noh da ka shovel bad bad u nongkyrshan .

en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .
kha: Haba don kano kano ka jingïakajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan sha nga , nga hap ban bishar bad rai mano na ki uba dei , bad nga ïathuh ha ki ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ U Blei ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki don ka kam , ki wan sha nga ; bad nga bishar iwei ia iwei pat , bad nga pynlong ia ki ban tip ia ki ain U Blei bad ki ain jong u .

en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people  ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon s porch .
kha: Ki apostol ki la leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla hapdeng ki briew . Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka baranda u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ki kti jong ki apostol ki la don bun ki dak bad ki jingphylla kiba la leh hapdeng ki briew ; (bad baroh ki la don ryngkat bad kawei ka jingmut ha ka por jong u Solomon .

en: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh , all the cities with their villages .
kha: lem bad katto katne ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba don hapoh ki pud sawdong jong ka Manasseh , hynrei kiba la ai ha ki Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shnong ba kyrpang na ka bynta ki khun Ephraim ki long hapdeng ka pateng jong ki khun Manasseh , ki shnong baroh ryngkat bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?
kha: Nangta u la duwai jam ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , balei me la leh kat kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ïa kane ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehsbun shibun ban sumar ïa nga , bad mynta me pynïap ïa u khun jong ka !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyrta ha U Trai bad u la ong: Ko Trai jong nga , me ruh me la wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor kata ka riewkynthei kaba nga sah bad ka da kaba pyniap ia u khun jong ka ?

en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la pynriewspah ïa la ka longïing da kaei kaba phi la shim da kaba leh jubor , bad phi la pyrshang ban pynlong ïa la ka ïing kaba lait na ki jingpynmynsaw bad jingma !
translated_en_to_kha: To u uba kwah ia ka jingkwah brai kaba sniew ia ka iing jong u , ba un buh ia ka bniat jong u ha jrong , ba un shah pyllait na ka bor jong ka jingsniew !

en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .
kha: Phin ïatyngkhuh para ma phi , wat la ym don uba beh ïa phi , bad phin ym lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uno uno u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin hap iwei ia iwei pat kumba ka la long ha khmat ka waitlam, haba ym don ba bud: bad phin ym don bor ban ieng ha khmat ki nongshun jong phi .

en: And again , Esaias saith , There shall be a root of Jesse , and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles ; in him shall the Gentiles trust .
kha: Nangta , u Isaïah u ong ,  Uba hiarpateng na u Jesse un wanpaw ; un wan ban synshar ïa ki Jentil , bad kin buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien pat , u Isaiah u ong , Kan don ka tynrai jong u Jesse , bad uta uba wan ban synshar halor ki Jutang; ha u ki Jutang kin shaniah .

en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
kha: Lada ki don sanphew ngut kiba hok ha kata ka nongbah , hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei ? Men ym pyllait ïa ka ba ki sanphew ngut kin lait im ?
translated_en_to_kha: La ka long ba kin don sanphew ngut ki hok hapoh ka nongbah: hato me ruh phin pynjot bad ym pyllait ia ka jaka na ka bynta ki sanphew ngut ki hok kiba don hangta ?

en: And he said , Come in , thou blessed of the  Lord   ; wherefore standest thou without ? for I have prepared the house , and room for the camels .
kha: bad u ong ,  Ale sha ïing bad nga . Phi long u briew ïa uba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu . Balei phin shu ïeng hangne kumne ? Nga la pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi ha ïing jong nga , bad don ruh ka jaka ïa ki ut jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, To wan rung, me la kyrkhu ia U Trai ; namar kata me ieng shabar ? namar nga la pynkhreh ia ka iing bad ka jaka na ka bynta ki kulai .

en: And the land was not able to bear them , that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .
kha: Kumta ka jaka bam phlang kam biang ïa ki baroh ar ngut ban ïasah ryngkat , namar ba ki don shibun eh ki jingri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri kam lah ban shah ia ki, ba kin iasah lang: namar ka jingdon jong ki ka long kaba khraw , haduh ba kim lah ban iasah lang .

en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah : and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt  ; for he strengthened himself exceedingly .
kha: Ki Ammon ki siew khajna ha u Ussaïah , bad u kylla long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta kata ba ka nam jong u ka phriang wat shaduh sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Ammon ki la ai jingai sngewbha ia u Usiah : bad ka kyrteng jong u ka la saphriang haduh ka jingrung sha Ijipt ; namar u la pynskhem ia lade haduh katta katta .

en: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?
kha: Hato don uno uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju long ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba sah hapdeng jong phi uba la iohi ia kane ka iing ha ka burom kaba nyngkong jong ka ? bad kumno phi iohi ia ka mynta ? hato kam long ha ki khmat jong phi haba ianujor ia ka kum kaei kaei ?

en: And there was one named Barabbas , which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him , who had committed murder in the insurrection .
kha: Ha kata ka por u briew uba kyrteng u Barabbas u don ha ka byndi bad ki nongïaleh pyrshah kiba la pynïap briew ha ki por jingïakhih paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei uba kyrteng u Barabbas u la thiah bad ki kiba la leh ia ka jingleh pyrshah bad u, uba la leh ia ka jingpyniap briew ha ka jingleh pyrshah .

en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign : according to all that he hath done shall ye do : and when this cometh , ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
kha: Te ngan long ka dak ïa pha ; phan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . U  Trai  u ong ba haba kane kan jia , phan ïoh tip ba u long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Esekiel u long ha phi ka dak: kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh: bad ynda kane ka la wan , phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai Blei .

en: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah , and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men .
kha: Ki shipai Benjamin ki wan mih shabar na kata ka nongbah , bad shuwa ban kut kata ka sngi ki la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki shipai Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la mih na Gibeah bad ki la pynjot ia ki Israel ha kata ka sngi arphew ar hajar ngut ki Israel .

en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .
kha: Ma phi , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jong phi , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai kin leit noh na me bad na ki iing jong me bad na ki shakri jong me bad na ki briew jong me; kin sah ha ka wah tang .

en: Then said Paul , I wist not , brethren , that he was the high priest : for it is written , Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people .
kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ko para nong Israel jong nga , ngam shym tip ba u dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Mem dei ban kren sniew ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ong , Ngam shym la sngewsih, ko para bangeit, ba u long u rangbah lyngdoh: namar la thoh: Wat kren bein ia u nongsynshar jong ki briew jong me .

en: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things , he said unto him , Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God .
kha: Haba uwei na ki rangbah kiba ïashong bam u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha U Jisu ,  A katno kiba kmen long kito kiba shong ha ka jingkhawai ha ka Hima U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba uwei na ki uba shong ha ka jingbam bad u u la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei , u la ong ha u: La kyrkhu ia uta uba bam ia u kpu ha ka hima U Blei .

en: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me ? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast blessed them altogether .
kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Phi leh lei ïa nga kumne ? Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi hangne ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei phi la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la ong ha u Balaam, Me la leh aiu ia nga ? Nga la shim ia me ban tim ia ki nongshun jong nga, bad, ha khmih, me la kyrkhu lut ia ki .

en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .
kha: U la lamler shaphang jong nga ha phi ko Syiem kynrad ; hynrei phi , phi long kum u angel U Blei , kumta leh ïa kaei kaba idei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren bein ia u shakri jong me ha u syiem jong nga; hynrei u syiem jong nga u long kum u angel U Blei: to leh namarkata ia kaba bha ha ki khmat jong me .

en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled , he pursued after them , and took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and discomfited all the host .
kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem Midian , u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki her ïap , hynrei u beh kthong ïa ki bad u ïohkem ïa ki , bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sebah bad u Zalmunna ki la phet noh, u la bud ia ki, bad u la shim ia ki arngut ki syiem Maginiah, u Sebah bad u Zalmunna bad u la pynsngewsih ia ki shipai baroh .

en: O ye that dwell in Moab , leave the cities , and dwell in the rock , and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole s mouth .
kha: Phi ki briew kiba shong ha Moab , iehnoh ïa la ki shnong ! Khie bad leit sah ha ki riat bah ! Long kum ka lyngdkhur kaba thaw ïa la ka skum harud jong ka synrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko phi kiba shong ha Moab, to iehnoh ia ki shnong bad shong ha u mawsiang bad to long kum ka paro kaba pynlong ia ka bniat jong ka ha ki liang jong ka shyntur jong ka thliew .

en: And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .
kha: Haba u la poi ha ïing , um shym shah ïano ïano ban rung shapoh bad u lait noh u Petros , u Ïoannis bad u Jakob , bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan rung shapoh iing, um shah iano iano ruh ban rung shapoh, lait noh tang u Petros bad u Jakob bad u loannis bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khunlung .

en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den : he lieth in wait to catch the poor : he doth catch the poor , when he draweth him into his net .
kha: u ap ha la ka jakarieh kum u sing . U dem ban ap ïa kiba duk , u kem ïa ki ha ki jingriam jong u bad u paring ïa ki sharud .
translated_en_to_kha: U shong rieh kum u sing ha ka thliew jong u: u shong ha ka jaka ap ban kem ia kiba duk: u kem ia kiba duk , haba u ring ia u ha ka jar jong u .

en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,
kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :  Ade ! men pynjot ïa ka Templ bad tei pat ïa ka hapoh lai sngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid lyngba ia u, ki da pynkhih ia la ki khlieh bad ki da ong: Ah me uba pynjot ia ka tempi bad uba tei ia ka ha ki lai sngi .

en: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath–jearim , and the border went out on the west , and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah :
kha: U pud uba shaphang shathie u sdang na tduh jong ka Kiriath Jearim bad u suh shaduh ki Umpohliew jong ka Nephtoah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta ba shathie ka long na ka tduh jong ka Kirjathjaram bad u pud u sam u la mih shaphang sepngi bad u la leit sha ka pung um jong u Nephtoah:

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai: um shym la phet noh na ki pop jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan  ;
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u la mihnoh na Galilaïa bad u la leit sha ka thain Judia sha shiliang jong ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba U Jisu u la dep ia kine ki ktien, u la leit noh na Galilaia bad u la poi sha ki ri jong ka Judaea sha shiliang ka Jordan;

en: Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?
kha: Shano ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Shano ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim , ka Hena , bad ka Ibbah ? Hato don na ki kiba la pyllait im ïa ka Samaria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ki blei jong u Hamath bad u Arpad ? hangno ki blei jong u Sepharvaim , Hena bad ka Ivah ? ki la pynpoi ia ka Samaria na ka kti jong nga ?

en: And , behold , there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years , and was bowed together , and could in no wise lift up herself .
kha: Kawei ka briew hangta ka la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlong ïa ka ban shitom haduh khatphra snem ; ka la kdor ryngkdung bad kam lah ban pynbeit shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka don kawei ka kynthei kaba don ka mynsiem bym lah kha khun shiphew snem, bad ka la dem khrup lang, bad kam lah ban pynkiew ia lade da ka jingstad .

en: And Isaac said unto his son , How is it that thou hast found it so quickly , my son ? And he said , Because the  Lord  thy God brought it to me .
kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Kumno keiñ khun phi stet katta katta ban ïoh ïa ka ?  U Jakob u jubab ,  Namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïarap ïa nga ban lap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la ong ha u khun jong u, Kumno phi la shem kloi ia ka khun jong nga ? Bad u la ong: Namar U Trai U Blei jong me u la wanrah ia ka ha nga .

en: Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
kha: Wat pyrkhat ba ngan wallam ïa ki briew jong nga sha ka jingsuh kha bad khlem lah ban kha ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan wanrah ia ka jingkha khun ? ong U Trai: ngan pynlong ban wanrah , bad khang ia ka kpoh ? ong U Blei jong me .

en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness , that I would scatter them among the heathen , and disperse them through the countries  ;
kha: Kumta nga la pynlong sa kawei pat ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap . Nga la smai ba ngan pynsakma ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la rah ia ka kti jong nga sha ki ruh ha ka ri khlaw, ba ngan pynphriang ia ki hapdeng ki nongwei bad ngan pynphriang ia ki lyngba ki ri ; .

en: We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew katno ki briew jong ka Moab ki long kiba sarong . Ngi tip ba ki long kiba sngewmeng bad kiba sarong palat , hynrei ka jingkob jong ki ka long kaba thylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la iohsngew ia ka jingsarong jong u Moab ; u sngew sarong shibun: wat ia ka jingsarong jong u, bad ka jingsarong jong u: hynrei ki jinglamler jong u kin ym long kumta .

en: In my distress I called upon the  Lord  , and cried to my God : and he did hear my voice out of his temple , and my cry did enter into his ears .
kha: Ha ka jingjynjar nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U Blei jong nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Ha ka templ jong u , u ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong nga , u shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga nga la pyrta ia U Trai, bad nga la pyrta ha U Blei jong nga: bad u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga na ka tempi jong u, bad ka jingud jong nga ka la rung ha ki shkor jong u .

en: Who against hope believed in hope , that he might become the father of many nations ; according to that which was spoken , So shall thy seed be .
kha: U Abraham u la ngeit bad u la kyrmen , wat mynba ym shym don ka daw ban kyrmen , bad kumta u la long  U kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Kiba hiarpateng na me kin bun kat ki khlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba pyrshah ia ka jingkyrmen u la ngeit ha ka jingkyrmen, ba un long u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ; kat kum kata kaba la kren , Kumta un long u symbai jong me .

en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .
kha: Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? Kata ka ding kaba ishyrkhei kan thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pep ngin ïap lada ngi ïohsngew biang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata balei ngin iap ? namar kane ka ding kaba khraw kan bam ia ngi: lada ngi iohsngew shuh shuh ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: And the chief priests took the silver pieces , and said , It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury , because it is the price of blood .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la khar ïa ki sbai rupa bad ki la ong ,  Kane ka dei ka pisa babit snam , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban buh ïa ka hapoh ka jingkynshew ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la shim ia ki pisa rupa bad ki la ong: Kam long kaba dei ban buh ia ki ha ka jaka buh spah namar ka long ka dor jong ka snam .

en: And Noah builded an altar unto the  Lord   ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .
kha: Te u Noah u tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; u shim na kawei kawei ka jait ki mrad bad ki sim ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid , bad u thang tylli ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ainguh halor kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Noah u la tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai ; bad u la shim na ki mrad kiba khuid baroh , bad na ki sim kiba khuid baroh .

en: Watch ye therefore : for ye know not when the master of the house cometh , at even , or at midnight , or at the cockcrowing , or in the morning :
kha: To ap phira bha te , namar phim tip lano u kynrad jong ka ïing un wan — ka lah ban long ha ka por janmiet lane ha ka por shiteng synñia lane ha shuwa ka step phyrngab lane ha ka por tang shu mih sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia phi namarkata: namar phim tip haba u kynrad jong ka iing u wan, ha ka por janmiet ne ha ka por shiteng miet ne ha ka por shiteng miet ne ha ka por shiteng miet:

en: I will also vex the hearts of many people , when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations , into the countries which thou hast not known .
kha: Shibun ki jaitbynriew kin shah pynshitom haba ngan pynphriang ïa ka khubor jingpynjot ïa me lyngba ki ri kiba mem pat ju ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynsngewsih ruh ia ki dohnud jong kiba bun ki briew haba ngan wanrah ia ka jingpynjot jong me hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , sha ki ri kiba me khlem tip .

en: Take an harp , go about the city , thou harlot that hast been forgotten  ; make sweet melody , sing many songs , that thou mayest be remembered .
kha: Shim ïa ka duitara , khie leit sawdong ïa ka shnong , Pha ka bapli ka nuti ba la klet noh ! To tem bad rwai biang ïa ki jingrwai jong pha To wallam ïa ki rangbah sa shisien pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ka harp , leit kylleng ka nongbah , me uba la shah klet; to rwai bun ki jingrwai, ba me lah ban kynmaw .

en: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision  ; ( not because it is of Moses , but of the fathers  ; ) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man .
kha: U Moses u la hukum ïa phi ban otsher ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi ( wat la um shym dei u Moses hynrei ki kpa tymmen jong phi kiba la sdang ïa ka ) , bad kumta phi otsher ïa u khynnah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ia ka jingkren bein ; (ym namar ba ka dei ka jong u Moses, hynrei na ki kpa tymmen ; ) bad phi ha ka sngi Sabha phi iaid lait ia u briew .

en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ki dei ban bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu uba dang sah ha kata ka shang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin bam ia ka doh langbrot bad u kpu uba don ha ka basket , hajan ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together , and pitched by the valley of Elah , and set the battle in array against the Philistines .
kha: U Saul bad ki Israel ki ïalumlang bad ki sher dara ha ka Them Elah ; ha kaba ki khreh ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul bad ki briew Israel ki la ialum lang bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka them Elah bad ki la buh ia ka thma ha ka kynhun pyrshah ia ki Philistia .

en: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath , when thou comest to my kindred  ; and if they give not thee one , thou shalt be clear from my oath .
kha: Don tang kawei ka lad ïa me ba men lait na kaba me la smai : lada me leit sha ki kur ki jait jong nga , bad ki kyntait ïa me , te men laitluid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to long uba shai na kane ka jingsmai jong nga, haba me wan sha ka paralok jong nga bad lada kim ai ia me kawei ruh, me long uba shai na ka jingsmai jong nga.

en: After Queen director Vikas Bahl and singer Kailash Kher , in a shocking turn of events , actor Rajat Kapoor has also been accused of harassment .
kha: Hadien u director jong ka Queen u Vikas Bahl bad u nongrwai u Kailash Kher , ha ka jingkylla kaba shyrkhei jong ki jingjia , u aktor Rajat Kapoor ruh u la shah kynnoh ba u leh beijot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien u nongpyniaid jong ka Mahadei u Vika Bahl bad u nongrwai u Kailash Kher , ha ka jingkylla kaba pynkyndit ia ki jingjia , u aktor Rajat Kapoor ruh u la shah kynnoh ba u la shah pyndik .

en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long : for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .
kha: Ngan kren shaphang ka hok jong me baroh shi sngi , namar kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga ki la shahjop bad shah pynlehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong nga ruh kan kren shaphang ka hok jong me baroh shisngi: namar ki sngewlehrain , namar ki shah pynjah burom , kiba wad ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said ,  Who touched my clothes ?
kha: Mar kumta U Jisu u la tip ba ka bor ka la mihnoh na u , kumta u la phai sawdong sha u paidbah bad u la kylli ,  Mano ba la ktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu, haba u la tip mardor ha lade ba kata ka jinglong ka la mih na u, u la phai noh sha u ha ka kot khubor bad u la ong , Mano ba ktah ia ki jain jong nga ?

en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
kha: Pynban , na ka bynta jong nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shaphang ka diengphna U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ; naba da ka diengphna jong u , ka pyrthei ka la ïap ïa nga , bad nga la ïap ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la khang ba ngan burom, lait noh tang ha ka diengphna U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist, da uba la sahnarphna ia ka pyrthei ha nga bad nga ha ka pyrthei .

en: And as he said these things unto them , the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently , and to provoke him to speak of many things :
kha: Haba U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban wohnia shikatdei eh ïa u bad kylli ïa u ki jingkylli shaphang bun kiei kiei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren ia kine kiei kiei ha ki , ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban kyntu jur ia u bad ban pynkhih ia u ban kren ia kiei kiei kiba bun:

en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
kha: bad un pyndonkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ban sa jot noh . Kin jot noh namar ba kim pdiang sngewbha bad ieit ïa ka jingshisha khnang ba kin ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jinglong bymman baroh ha ki kiba jah noh ; namar kim shym la pdiang ia ka jingieit ia ka jingshisha , ba kin ioh jingpynim .

en: And when Joab was come out from David , he sent messengers after Abner , which brought him again from the well of Sirah : but David knew it not .
kha: Hadien ba u la mihnoh na u Dabid , u Joab u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit beh ïa u Abner , bad ki la wallam ïa u na ka Pukri Sirah ; hynrei u Dabid um tip ei ei shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Joab u la mih na u Dabid, u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor hadien u Abner , kiba la wanrah biang ia u na ka thliew Sirah : hynrei u Dabid um tip ia kata .

en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour , and every one to his brother , What hath the  Lord  answered ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
kha: Pynban , uwei pa uwei un kylli ïa la ki paralok bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , ‘ Kaei ka jubab kaba U  Trai  u la ai ? Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin ong iwei ia u paramarjan jong u bad iwei ia u hynmen jong u: Kaei kaba U Trai u la jubab ? bad , Kaei kaba U Trai u la kren ?

en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants  ; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand : they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony .
kha: Ki briew ka Rhodes ki khaïi pateng bad pha ; ki briew jong ki jaka ha ki rud duriaw ba bun ki la ai ha pha ïa ki bniat hati bad ka dieng Ebony ban ïakylliang na ka bynta ki mar jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang jong ka Dedan ki long ki nongkhaii jong me ; bun ki long ki mar jong ka kti jong me: ki la wanrah ia me na ka bynta ki bniat kiba mynta bad kiba jyrngam .

en: These are the things that ye shall do  ; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour  ; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates :
kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba phi dei ban leh . Kren ïa ka jingshisha iwei ïa iwei pat . Ha ki ïingbishar ai ïa ki jingbishar hok kiba shisha — kaba wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba phi dei ban leh ; Kren ia ka jingshisha ha u paramarjan jong u ban pyntreikam ia ka jingbishar jong ka jingshisha bad ka jingsuk ha ki khyrdop jong phi:

en: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .
kha: Naba U Blei u la ieit katta katta ïa ka pyrthei kat haduh ba u la aiti noh ïa U Khun ba tang marwei jong u , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ïap noh hynrei un ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u la ieit ia ka pyrthei haduh katta katta , ba u la aiti ia la u Khun ba la kha tang marwei , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym jah noh , hynrei un ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And he built there an altar , and called the place El–beth–el : because there God appeared unto him , when he fled from the face of his brother .
kha: Hangta u tei ïa ka duwan , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka kum ka kyrteng U Blei ka Bethel , namar dei hangta U Blei u la pynpaw ïa lade ha u mynba u phet ïap na la u hynmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U la tei hangta ia ka jaka bam, bad u la khot ia kata ka jaka Elbetel: namar hangta U Blei u la paw ha u haba u la phet noh na ka khmat u hynmen jong u .

en: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :
kha: La katta ruh , nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jinglong mynsiem . Hynrei , kam long ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei lane jong ki bor kiba synshar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki bor ki ban sa duh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ngi kren ia ka jingstad hapdeng jong ki kiba janai: hynrei ym ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei , ne jong ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei , kiba wan sha ka jingbym don:

en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings , which have received no kingdom as yet  ; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast .
kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki bym pat shym la sdang ban synshar , hynrei ki ban sa ïoh ka iktiar ban synshar kum ki syiem tang shi kynta bad u mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la iohi ki long shiphew ngut ki syiem ki bym pat ioh hima haduh mynta; hynrei ki ioh ia ka bor kum ki syiem shi kynta bad u mrad .

en: But I say unto you , I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine , until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father s kingdom .
kha: Nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh ïa kane ka waiñ tad haduh ka sngi ba nga dih ïa ka waiñ thymmai bad phi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ngan ym dih shuh ia une u soh sohjew haduh kata ka sngi ba ngan dih thymmai bad phi ha ka hima U Kpa jong nga .

en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,
kha: Na kawei pat ka liang jong ka Sarid , u pud u suh shaphang mihngi sha u pud jong ka Khisloth Tabor , nangta sha Daberath bad artet haduh Japhia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai noh na Sarid shaphang mihngi sha u pud u sam jong u Chislothtabor bad nangta u leit sha Dabrat bad u leit sha Japiia .

en: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,
kha: Ka por kan poi haba ki nongshun jong pha kin ker sawdong ïa pha da ki jingker , ki jingkhanglad ïa pha , bad ki nang tur jan sha pha na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki sngi kin wan ha me , ba ki nongshun jong me kin bret ia ka thliew sawdong jong me , bad kin ker sawdong ia me sawdong , bad kin buh ia me shapoh na man la ki liang .

en: And cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee : for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders .
kha: Wat map ïa kaba sniew kaba ki leh bad wat klet ïa ki pop jong ki , namar ba ki la pynlehrain ïa ngi kiba dang ïatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat tap ia ka jingbymhok jong ki , bad wat ai ba ka pop jong ki kan jah noh na khmat jong me: namar ki la pynkhih ia me ban bitar ha khmat ki nongtei .

en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .
kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me kumba ngi la ju kohnguh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me kumba u la long bad u Moses !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ngi la sngap ia u Moses ha kiei kiei baroh: tang U Trai U Blei jong me un long bad me kumba u la long bad u Moses .

en: Yet they went in unto her , as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot : so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah , the lewd women .
kha: Ki leit phai bad ïai leit sha kine ki nuti . Ki leit biang sha ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ; kito ki kynthei barunar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la leit shapoh jong ka, katba ki dang leit sha kawei ka kynthei kaba ialehkai bad ka kam: kumta ki la leit shapoh Ahollah bad sha Ahollah , ki kynthei kiba la shah rong noh .

en: For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
kha: Me tip , A Trai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh . Ki sngi jong ngi ki long kum ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi long ki nongwei ha khmat jong me, bad ki nongwei, kumba long ki kpa tymmen jong ngi baroh: ki sngi jong ngi ha ka khyndew ki long kum ka jingdum , bad ym don ba sah .

en: When I was a child , I spake as a child , I understood as a child , I thought as a child : but when I became a man , I put away childish things .
kha: Mynba nga dang khynnah , ka jingkren jong nga , ki jingsngew , bad ki jingpyrkhat ki long baroh kum ki jong u khynnah ; mynta ba nga la rangbah , nga iehnoh ïa ki rukom khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga dang rit , nga la kren kum u khynnah , nga sngewthuh kum u khynnah: hynrei ynda nga la kylla long u briew , nga la weng noh ia kiei kiei kiba rit .

en: Then his lord , after that he had called him , said unto him , O thou wicked servant , I forgave thee all that debt , because thou desiredst me :
kha: Kumta u la phah khot shapoh ïa uta u shakri . ‘ Me u shakri bymmyntoi !’ u la ong . ‘ Nga la map ïa ka ram jong me baroh kaba me shah na nga , namar ba me la kyrpad ïa nga kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u kynrad jong u, hadien ba u la khot ia u, u la ong ha u, ko shakri basniew, nga la map ia me ia kata ka ram baroh, namar me la kwah ia nga:

en: Behold , the Lord  God  will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him : behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u wan ban synshar da ka bor , u da wallam bad u ki briew ba u la pyllait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih U Trai U Blei un wan da ka kti kaba khlain, bad ka kti jong u kan synshar na ka bynta jong u: ha khmih ka bainong jong u ka don ryngkat bad u bad ka kam jong u ha khmat jong u .

en: Whom shall he teach knowledge ? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine ? them that are weaned from the milk , and drawn from the breasts .
kha: Ki mudui shaphang jong nga . Ki ong ,  U mut aïu utai u briew ba u wan hikai ? Uei uba donkam ïa ka khubor jong u ? Ka long kaba bha tang na ka bynta ki khunlung ba dang shu iehnoh buiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Iano un hikai ia ka jingtip ? bad mano ba un pynlong ban sngewthuh ia ka jinghikai ? ia kiba la shah pynkha na ka dud bad la ring na ki bniat .

en: For Jerusalem is ruined , and Judah is fallen : because their tongue and their doings are against the  Lord  , to provoke the eyes of his glory .
kha: Ho-oid , ka Jerusalem ka long ba la tim ! Ka Judah ka dang khyllem ! Kano kano kaba ki kren lane ki leh ka long pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; ki ibeiñ khlem buhrieh ïa U Blei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka Jerusalem ka la jot , bad u Judah u la hap: namar ka shyntur jong ki bad ki jingleh jong ki ki long pyrshah ia U Trai , ban pynkhih ia ki khmat jong ka burom jong u .

en: But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?
kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , ‘ A me uba bieit ! Ha kane hi ka miet men hap ban iehnoh ïa la ka jingim ; te mano ban ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba me la buh na ka bynta ïa lade ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u, Me bieit, mynta ka miet ka mynsiem jong me kan long na me: te mano kita kiei kiei kiba me la pynbiang ?

en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet , and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin , which was by the house of the  Lord .
kha: u la hukum ba yn tied ïa nga bad ban pyndait kynjri hajan ka Khyrdop Benjamin bashaneng hapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pashur u la shoh ia u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa bad u la buh ia u ha ki dieng kiba don ha ka khyrdop kaba jrong jong u Benjamin kaba don hajan ka iing U Trai .

en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp , and burn him as he burned the first bullock : it is a sin offering for the congregation .
kha: Nangta un shim ïa uta u masi lyngraw shabar ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa u kumba u thang ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la kñia ainguh namar la ka jong ka pop . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop jong uta u paidlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un rah ia u masi shabar ka shnong , bad un thang ia u kumba u la thang ia u masi ba nyngkong: ka long ka jingknia pop na ka bynta ka jingiaseng .

en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .
kha: Uta uba ot u ïoh la ka bainong bad u lum ïa ka jingmih na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ; ba uta uba bet bad uta uba ot kin ïakmen lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba kheit u ioh ia ka bainong bad u lum ia u soh haduh ka jingim bymjukut: ba uta uba bet bad uta uba kheit kin ia kmen lang .

en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .
kha: Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . U Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u syiem u la hukum , bad u ai jingbam ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh kumta: bad u Joseph u la ai ia ki kali kat kum ka hukum jong u Pharaoh , bad u la ai ia ki ia ka jingbam na ka bynta ka lynti .

en: Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .
kha: Haba ki la wan hangne , te , ngam shym la pyntud ei ei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la shong ha ka ïingbishar bad nga la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la wan shane, khlem da pynslem ei ei ha ka jaka bishar , bad nga la hukum ia uta u briew ban wanrah .

en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Phin ïohi ïa nga ba nga siew kylliang ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka na ka bynta ka jingsniew baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphai noh ia ka Babilon bad ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Kaldea baroh kiba ki la leh ha Seion ha khmat jong phi , ong U Trai .

en: And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Te sah hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad lashai ngan phah pat ïa phi .  Kumta u Uriah u la sah ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha Ulia, To leit noh hangne ha ka sngi ruh, bad lashai ngan pyllait noh ia me. Kumta u Uri u la shong ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad lashai .

en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ; bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki hynriew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha bad u la ainguh bad u la bthei ia ki bad u la ai ha ki synran jong u bad ki synran jong u ha u paidbah .

en: And there was war again : and David went out , and fought with the Philistines , and slew them with a great slaughter  ; and they fled from him .
kha: Ka thma bad ki Philistia ka la khie biang . U Dabid u leit ïaleh ïa ki bad u jop thiaw ïa ki kat haduh ba ki phet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma biang: bad u Dabid u la mih noh bad ki Philistia bad u la pyniap ia ki da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw ; bad ki la phet noh na u .

en: And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
kha: U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad phi , kata , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynbna ha phi ia ka jutang jong u, kaba u la hukum ia phi ban leh, wat shiphew tylli ki hukum ; bad u la thoh ia ki ha ki ar tylli ki miej maw .

en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .
kha: U Ussaïah u pynbiang ïa ka kynhun shipai da ki stieh , ki sum , ki jingda khlieh , ki jingphong nar , ki ryntieh bad ki khnam , bad ki maw ban kawang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Uzziah u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki ha baroh ki jaka ri khunswet, bad ki khnam, bad ki helmet, bad ki khniang bad ki khniang, bad ki khniang ban bret ia ki maw .

en: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
kha: U la jubab ,  Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kawei ha u briew u bym don , bad uno uno uba don jingbam u dei ban ïasam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U jubab bad u ong ha ki , Uta uba don ar tylli ki jainkup , to ai ba un ai ha uta u bym don shuh shuh bad uta uba don doh , to ai ba un leh kumjuh .

en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .
kha: Naba U Blei ha ka jingstad jong u , um shym la pynlah ïa ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstad jong ki hi . Pynban da kata kaba la khot ka khubor  ba-ibieit  kaba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hadien kata ha ka jingstad U Blei ka pyrthei da ka jingstad kam ithuh ia U Blei , ka la pynsngewbha ia U Blei da ka jingbieit ban ialap ia kito kiba ngeit .

en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .
kha: Hadien kata , U Jisu u la shem ïa u ha ka Templ bad u la ong ,  Peit shane , me la khiah mynta ; te sangeh na kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ka lah ban jia ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata U Jisu u lap ia u ha ka tempi, bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih, me la shah pynlong pura: wat leh pop shuh: ioh ia kaba kham sniew ha me .

en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted .
kha: Ka ri kan long kaba shah ieh kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka yn ieh kumto ha ki jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sa shah pynjot hapdeng ki ri kiba la jot , bad ki shnong jong ka kin long hapdeng ki nongbah kiba la jah rngai .

en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .
kha: Ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me , bad un ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba un shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban kren ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga hukum ia me: bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un kren ha u Pharaoh ba un phah ia ki khun Israel na ka ri jong u .

en: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,
kha: u khun jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed , u khun jong u Boas , u khun jong u Salmon , u khun jong u Nahshon ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Jesse uba long u khun u Obed uba long u khun u Bos u khun u Salmon uba long u khun u Nasson .

en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u , u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong kiba hajan hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , haba U Jisu u la pyndep ia ka jingbthah ia ki shiphew ngut ki synran jong u , u la leit noh nangta ban hikai bad ban ialap ha ki shnong jong ki .

en: Behold , is it not of the  Lord  of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire , and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity ?
kha: Ki jaitbynriew kiba phi la jop ki la pynshohthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei bymmyntoi , bad baroh kaba ki la tei la bam duh ha ka ding . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la leh ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , hato kam dei na U Trai jong ki paid ba ki briew kin trei shitom ha ka ding hi , bad ki briew kin pynlut por na ka bynta ka jinglong ba sniew ?

en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose : and thou shalt turn in the morning , and go unto thy tents .
kha: Shet ïa ka doh bad bam ïa ka ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ; bad ha ka step kaba bud , leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shet bad bam ia ka ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied: bad men phai noh mynstep bad leit sha ki ïingjaiñ jong me .

en: And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore  ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .
kha: Hynrei lada ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ka mih ha ka jaka hap shñiuh , ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada don ha ka khlieh kaba lieh, ne kaba lieh, ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba lieh kaba la mih ha ka khlieh kaba lieh jong u.

en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister , whose name was Tamar  ; and Amnon the son of David loved her .
kha: U Absalom , u khun jong u Dabid u la don kawei ka para kaba bhabriew ka bym pat shongkurim , kaba kyrteng ka Tamar . U Amnon , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid , u ibha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane, u Absalom u khun u Dabid u don ka para kaba bhabriew, kaba kyrteng u Tamar ; bad u Amnon u khun u Dabid u ieit ia ka .

en: And one of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite : therefore I chased him from me .
kha: U Joïada u dei u khun jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh , hynrei uwei na ki khun jong u Joïada u la shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u Sanballat na ka shnong Beth Horon , kumta nga la pynlong ba u Joïada un mihnoh na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Joiada, u khun jong u Eliashib u rangbah lyngdoh u la long u khun shynrang jong u Sanballat u Horonite: namarkata nga la beh noh ia u na nga .

en: And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .
kha: Nangta u trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai ki la tied ïa u na ka khlieh bad ki la leh khlem akor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien u la phah sha ki ia uwei pat u shakri ; bad ha u ki la ther maw ia u bad ki la pynmynsaw ia u ha ka khlieh , bad ki la phah noh ia u da kaba pynjah burom .

en: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .
kha: Phi dei ruh ban thung ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar bad shim ïa kawei na kaba san bynta na ki jingthung ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba u Pharaoh un leh ia kane , bad un thung ia ki ophisar halor ka ri , bad un shim ia ka bynta kaba phra jong ka ri Ijipt ha ki hynriew snem kiba bun .

en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed .
kha: Ynda haba nga pynshitom ïa ki briew namar ki pop jong ki bad pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai , haba nga la buh ia ka ri kaba la jot namar ki jingleh bymman jong ki baroh kiba ki la leh .

en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .
kha: Ha kata ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba u la ïohi ïa u nong Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u ,  Ale shane sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la iakynduh ha ka por miet ; Uwei u briew uba na Makedonia u la ieng ha u bad u la duwai ia u da kaba ong: To wan sha Makedonia bad iarap ia ngi .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri , and his treason that he wrought , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Simri u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Zimri bad ka jingleh jong u kaba u la leh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
kha: Bad U Trai un pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingmynsaw baroh bad un ri pynim bad ïalam ïa nga sha ka hima jong u ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pyllait im ia nga na ka kam kaba sniew baroh, bad un pynneh ia nga sha ka hima bneng jong u: ha uba ka burom ka long junom . Amen .

en: And he made the vessels which were upon the table , his dishes , and his spoons , and his bowls , and his covers to cover withal , of pure gold .
kha: U shna ïa ki khiew da ka ksiar nylla ban buh ha kata ka miej : ki pliang , ki khiew , ki khuri bad ki dabor rit ban pyndonkam ha ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki khiew kiba don halor ka miej, ki jingbam jong u bad ki spun jong u bad ki khiew jong u bad ki jingtap jong u ban tap da ka ksiar kaba khuid .

en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ym don uba lah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei khlem da kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha me, La u briew u la kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem , um lah ban rung sha ka hima U Blei .

en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
kha: Bad man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynphong da ka pansngiat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta kata ka ban neh junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba ialeh na ka bynta ka jinglong trai u long uba sngewrit ha kiei kiei baroh . Mynta ki leh ia kata ban ioh ia ka khlieh kaba lah ban pyut ; hynrei ngi long ki bym lah ban pyut .

en: Heavy rain is likely to occur at isolated places over Tamil Nadu , Puducherry , Kerala , Coastal and Southern parts of Karnataka , PTI reported .
kha: U slap uba jur u lah ban jia ha ki jaka ba kyrpang halor ka Tamil Nadu , Puducherry , Kerala , Coastal bad ki bynta shathie jong ka Karnataka , ong ka PTI .
translated_en_to_kha: U slap uba jur u lah ban jia ha ki jaka ba la pyniakhlad halor ka Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Kerala , ki bynta ba don ha ka thain shatei lam mihngi jong ka Karnataka , la iathuh ka PTI .

en: And Isaac gave up the ghost , and died , and was gathered unto his people , being old and full of days : and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him .
kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta ba la ih bha ka jinglong tymmen ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u , u Iso bad u Jakob ki la tep ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la aiti noh ia u ksuid bad u la iap bad u la ialum lang bad ki briew jong u: bad ki khun shynrang jong u u Iso bad u Jakob ki la tep ia u .

en: Take thee again another roll , and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll , which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ban shim da kawei pat ka kot kli bad ban thoh ha ka ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha kata kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim biang ia me sa kawei pat ka roll , bad thoh ha ka ia ki kyntien barim baroh kiba la don ha ka roll kaba nyngkong , kaba u syiem Judah u la thang .

en: Pharaoh shall see them , and shall be comforted over all his multitude , even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ka jingïohi ïa baroh kine kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma kan long ka jingtngen ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh un iohi ia ki, bad un sa shah pyntngen halor ka kynhun jong u baroh, wat u Pharaoh bad ki shipai jong u baroh ki la shah pyniap da ka waitlam , ong U Trai Blei .

en: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .
kha: Lada u bet ha ka lyngkha jong ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong u , na ka un lum ïa ka jingot ka jingïap ; lada u bet ha ka lyngkha U Mynsiem , na U Mynsiem un lum ïa ka jingot jong ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba bet ha ka doh jong u un kheit ia ka jingjot ; hynrei uta uba bet ha U Mynsiem un kheit ia ka jingim bymjukut jong U Mynsiem .

en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Haba u la dep ai ki jingkñia , u la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu dep ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk , u la kyrkhu ia ki briew ha ka kyrteng U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And he made his grave with the wicked , and with the rich in his death  ; because he had done no violence , neither was any deceit in his mouth .
kha: La buh ïa u ha ka jingtep lem bad ki bymman , la tep ïa u bad kiba riewspah , wat la um shym la leh kano kano ka kam bymman lane um shym la shukor ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia ka jingtep jong u bad kiba sniew bad kiba riewspah ha ka jingiap jong u ; namar ba um shym la leh donbor ei ei ruh em ha ka shyntur jong u .

en: For there was a tabernacle made  ; the first , wherein was the candlestick , and the table , and the shewbread  ; which is called the sanctuary .
kha: Ïa ka Ïingjaiñ la pynïeng , ka bynta kaba ha khmat , ïa kaba la khot ka Jaka Bakyntang . Ha ka la buh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ka miej lem bad u kpu ïa uba la ainguh sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka don ka jaka ri dohkha kaba nyngkong, ha kaba la don ka sharak, bad ka miej , bad ka miej ba la pyni; ia kaba la khot ka jaka kyntang .

en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof : but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .
kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew ka leh pop , kan ïoh u nongsynshar uwei hadien uwei pat . Hynrei ka jaitbynriew kan long kaba khlaiñ bad kaba ïaineh haba ka don ki nongsynshar kiba stad bad bashemphang .
