translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkhein ia ka ri bun ki long ki syiem jong ka: hynrei da u briew uba sngewthuh bad uba tip ia ka jylla jong ka yn pynjlan .

en: Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .
kha: Te u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ïathuh ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Rabsakeh u la ieng bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ha ka ktien jong ki Jiw bad u la ong: To sngap ia ki ktien jong u syiem uba khraw , u syiem Assyria .

en: And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,
kha: Ki la poi biang sa shisien ha Jerusalem . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka Templ , ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan ha u
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan phai biang sha Jerusalem : bad katba u dang iaid ha ka tempi , ki wan sha u ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah .

en: And said to the mountains and rocks , Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb :
kha: Ki la pyrta ha ki lumbah bad ha ki mawsiang ,  To tap halor jong ngi bad to buhrieh noh ïa ngi na ki khmat jong uta uba shong halor ka khet bad na ka jingbitar U Khunlangbrot !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki lum bad ki mawsiang , To hap ha ngi bad to buhrieh ia ngi na ka khmat jong uta uba shong ha ka khet bad na ka jingbitar jong u Khunlangbrot:

en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired  ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .
kha: U la pyllait noh ïa u briew uba ki la kwah , uta uba la shah set byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin bad ka jingpynïap briew , bad u la aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki ban leh kumba ki la kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyllait noh ha ki ia uta uba la shah set phatok bad pyniap briew, ia uba ki la kwah; hynrei u la aiti ia U Jisu ha ka mon jong ki .

en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid baroh ka long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Blei bad ka long kaba myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban sneng ïa kaba bakla , ban pynbeit ïa ki jingduna , bad ban ai jingkyntu ïa ka jingim kaba bha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ka jingthoh la ai da ka jingpynshlur jong U Blei , bad ka long kaba myntoi na ka bynta ka jinghikai , na ka bynta ka jingshah pynrem , na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit , na ka bynta ka jinghikai ha ka hok:

en: And Joseph saw Ephraim s children of the third generation : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph s knees .
kha: U la im haduh ba u da ïohi ïa ki khun bad ki ksiew jong u Ephraim , bad haduh ba u da ïohpdiang ïa ki khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la iohi ia ki khun jong u Ephraim jong ka pateng kaba lai: ki khun jong u Machir u khun u Manasseh ki la shah pynsan ha ki kjat jong u Joseph .

en: For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .
kha: Namar ngi tip uei uta uba la ong ,  Ngan sa pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang ;  bad uba la ong ruh ,  U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi tip ia uta uba la ong, Ka jingleh be-ijot ka long ka jong nga, ngan siew kylliang, ong U Trai . Bad sa shisien ruh , U Trai un bishar ia ki briew jong u .

en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
kha: Lada me leh kumne ïa nga , to sngewsynei ïa nga bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang ba ngan ym hap shah shuh ïa kane ka jingleh badonbor jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me leh kumta bad nga, to pyniap ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, na ka kti jong me, lada nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me ; bad wat ai ba ngan iohi ia ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .
kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u Manasseh u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh wat ïa ki pop kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba la leh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngap: bad u Manasseh u la pynshoi ia ki ban leh kham sniew ban ia ki jaitbynriew kiba U Trai u la pynjot ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness  ; even Israel , when I went to cause him to rest .
kha: Ha ka ri shyiap nga la pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa kito ki briew kiba la lait na ka jingïap . Haba ki paid Israel ki la thrang ban ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait , nga la paw ha ki na sha jngai bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Ki briew kiba la sah na ka waitlam ki la shem ia ka jingaiei ha ka ri khlaw ; wat ki Israel ruh haba nga la leit pynlong ia u ban shongthait .

en: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Nahshon , to wife  ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
kha: U Aaron u shongkurim ïa ka Elisheba , ka khun jong u Amminadab bad ka para jong u Nahshon . Ka la kha ïa u Nadab , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la shim ia u Elisheba, ka khun jong u Amminadab, ka para jong u Nahashon, bad ka la kha ia u Nadab, bad u Nadab, u Eleasar bad u Ithamar .

en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face : therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity  ; Judah also shall fall with them .
kha: Ka jingsngewmeng jong ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki . Ki pop jong ki , ki pynlong ïa ki ban jynthut bad kyllon , bad ki paid Judah ki kyllon lang bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsarong jong ki Israel ka pynshisha ia ka khmat jong u: namar kata ki Israel bad ki Ephram kin hap ha ka jingbymhok jong ki ; U Judah ruh un hap bad ki .

en: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles , and also of the Jews with their rulers , to use them despitefully , and to stone them ,
kha: Te katto katne ngut ki Jentil bad ki Jiw , ryngkat bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïakut ban lehbeiñ ïa ki apostol bad ban lynthem maw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la don ka jingshah thombor kaba la leh na ki Jutang baroh arngut bad ruh na ki Jiw bad ki nongsynshar jong ki , ban pyndonkam ia ki da kaba sngewsih bad ban maw ia ki .

en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his saltness , wherewith will ye season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and have peace one with another .
kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha ; hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingbang jong ka , kumno phi lah ban pynbang pat ïa ka ?  To don ïa ka mluh jong ka jingïalong paralok hapdeng jong phi , bad para ma phi , to im hapdeng ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umsoh ka long kaba bha: hynrei lada ka umsoh ka la duh noh ia ka umsoh jong ka ? To ai ka umsoh ha lade bad to iasuk iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .
kha: Haba u Shimei u ïohsngew ba ki don ha Gath , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Gath , ban wad ïa la ki mraw . U la lap ïa ki bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ki sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shimei u la ieng bad u la sngap jar ia ka tdong jong u, bad u la leit sha Gath sha Achish ban wad ia ki shakri jong u: bad u Shimei u la leit noh bad u la wanrah ia ki shakri jong u na Gath .

en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
kha: Ki nongïalam kiba stad kin tyngshaiñ da ka jingphyrnai baroh jong ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ kum ki khlur junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba stad kin shai kum ka jingshai jong ka bneng ; bad kita kiba phai sha ka hok kum ki khlur junom .

en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God  ; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled  ;
kha: To sumar ban ym phai dien noh na ka jingaiei U Blei . Wat ai ba uno uno un long kum u jingthung uba kthang , uba san bad uba pynjynjar da ka bih jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba peit bniah ia uno uno u briew u la duh noh ia ka jingaiei U Blei ; ioh ia kano kano ka tynrai jong ka jingsngewsih kaba mih na ka jingeh ia phi, bad da kata bun ki la shah pynjakhlia ; .

en: And not as Moses , which put a veil over his face , that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished :
kha: Bad ym kum u Moses , uba la hap ban buh da ka jingkah ha ka durkhmat jong u khnang ba ki paid Israel kin ym ïohi ba kata ka jingtyngshaiñ ka lip bad jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym kum u Moses uba la buh ia ka jingtap halor ka khmat jong u , ba ki khun Israel kim lah ban peit skhem ia ka jingkut jong kata kaba la pynduh noh:

en: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant , when , lo , he had given his hand , and hath done all these things , he shall not escape .
kha: U la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la lah pynlong . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , bad mynta un ym ïohlait ban phet .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la leh bein ia ka jingsmai da kaba pynpra ia ka jutang , haba , ha khmih , u la ai ia la ka kti bad u la leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh , un ym lait .

en: Have ye not known ? have ye not heard ? hath it not been told you from the beginning ? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth ?
kha: Hato phim tip ? Hato ym shym la ïathuh slem mynshuwa ? Hato phim shym ïohsngew kumno ka pyrthei ka sdang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ? phim shym la iohsngew ? hato ym shym la iathuh ia phi naduh kaba sdang ? phim shym la sngewthuh naduh ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ?

en: And Asa slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Asa u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid u kpa jong u: bad u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ker sawdong ïa nga da ki jinglamler bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki dang ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u ker sawdong ia nga da ki jinglamler, bad ka iing Israel da ka jingleh thok: hynrei u Judah u dang synshar bad U Blei , bad u long uba iaineh bad ki riewkhuid .

en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put in the staves thereof .
kha: Ki dei ban sumar ïa baroh ki tiar ki tar ka Ïingjaiñ bad ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sa pynphriang halor jong ki da ka jain rong saw , bad kin tap ia ka da ka jingtap ia ki sniehdoh bad kin buh ha ki dieng jong ka .

en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets  ; I have slain them by the words of my mouth : and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth .
kha: Namarkata , nga la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga sha phi ryngkat ka khubor jong ka jingbishar bad ka jingpynjot . Kaei kaba nga kwah na phi ka long kaba shisha bad kaba shai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la pyniap ia ki da ki nongiathuhlypa ; nga la pyniap ia ki da ki ktien jong ka shyntur jong nga: bad ki jingbishar jong me ki long kum ka jingshai kaba mih shabar .

en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak , and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech , the gods of Sepharvaim .
kha: Ki bleithaw jong ka Nibhas bad Tartak ; bad ki briew ka Sepharbaim ki kñia ïa la ki khun kum ki jingainguh thang ïa ki blei Adrammelekh bad Anammelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Avit ki la thang ia ki khun jong ki ha ka ding ha u Adrammech bad u Anamech, ki blei jong u Sepharvaim .

en: No man can enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man  ; and then he will spoil his house .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban prong bad rung shapoh ka ïing kaba skhem jong u briew bad rah noh ïa ki tiar ki tar lymda u teh nyngkong ïa u briew uba khlaiñ ; te un sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew uba lah ban rung ha ka iing kaba khlain bad ban pynsniew ia ki mar ki mata jong u , lait noh tang ba un teh nyngkong ia uta u briew uba khlain ; bad nangta un pynsniew ia ka iing jong u .

en: And all that handle the oar , the mariners , and all the pilots of the sea , shall come down from their ships , they shall stand upon the land  ;
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka liengbah ka la shah iehnoh mynta , bad uwei pa uwei u maji u la poi sha ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba pyniaid ia ka oar, ki nongleit jingleit bad ki nongleit jingleit baroh ki wan hiar na ki lieng jong ki , kin ieng halor ka ri;

en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath , that he entered into the synagogue and taught : and there was a man whose right hand was withered .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit sha ka synagog bad u la hikai . La don u briew hangta uba ka kti kamon jong u ka la ïapshiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ruh ha kawei pat ka sngi Sabha, ba u la rung ha ka synagog bad u la hikai: bad don uwei u briew uba ka kti kadiang jong u ka la tyrkhong .

en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven  ; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning .
kha: Wat ainguh da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa uno uno u jingri ha nga . Wat pynsah haduh mynstep ïa ka doh kñia ba la pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ia ka snam jong ka jingknia jong nga da ka jingknia kaba la khleh lang bad ka jingknia jong ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba la shet haduh mynstep .

en: And the people saw them departing , and many knew him , and ran afoot thither out of all cities , and outwent them , and came together unto him .
kha: Kumno re kumno , la don bun ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa ki ba ki leit bad ki la tip shisyndon ba ki long kiei ; kumta ki la ïaleit na baroh ki shnong bad mareh na ryngkew bad ki la poi ha ka jaka shuwa ïa U Jisu bad ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la iohi ia ki ba ki leit noh, bad bun ki la ithuh ia u, bad ki la mareh shabar na ki shnong baroh, bad ki la mih noh na ki bad ki la iawan lang sha u .

en: And there are seven kings : five are fallen , and one is , and the other is not yet come  ; and when he cometh , he must continue a short space .
kha: San ngut na ki , ki la kyllon , uwei u dang synshar , bad uwei pat um pat wan ; haba u wan , u dei ban synshar tang shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don hynriew ngut ki syiem: san ngut ki la hap, bad uwei pat um pat wan ; bad ynda u la wan , u dei ban bteng ia ka jaka kaba lyngkot .

en: And unleavened bread , and cakes unleavened tempered with oil , and wafers unleavened anointed with oil : of wheaten flour shalt thou make them .
kha: Shim ïa u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , u bym pat khleh thiat , bad shet katto katne ki kpu ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad katto katne khlem umphniang bad katto katne ki kpu lyngkniap ba la shu kyllan da ka umphniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kpu bym don thied bad ki cake ki bym don thied bad ka umphniang , bad ki wafer ki bym don thied da ka umphniang: na ka shini kew me dei ban pynlong ia ki .

en: But thou shalt in any wise let the dam go , and take the young to thee  ; that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days .
kha: Phi lah ban rah ïa ki khun sim , hynrei phi dei ban pyllait ïa ka kmie jong ki , ba phin ïoh im slem bad manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban leit noh ia ka dam, bad shim ia ki khynnah ha me ba kan long kaba bha bad me, bad ba me lah ban pynjlan ia ki sngi jong me .

en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said , These are they whom the  Lord  hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa ki ban leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba ieng hapdeng ki dieng ba la shna da u myrtle u la jubab bad u la ong: Kine ki long kita kiba U Trai u la phah ban iaid sha ka khyndew .

en: Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .
kha: To kynmaw , A Blei jong nga , ïa baroh kine kiei kiei kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia nga ko Blei jong nga, shaphang kane, bad wat pyndam noh ia ki kam babha jong nga kiba nga la leh na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong nga bad na ka bynta ki kam jong ka .

en: And the  Lord  opened the mouth of the ass , and she said unto Balaam , What have I done unto thee , that thou hast smitten me these three times ?
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ai bor ïa kata ka kada ban kren , bad ka ong ha u Balaam ,  Nga la leh aïu keiñ ïa phi ba phi da sympat ïa nga ha kine lai sien ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la plie ia ka shyntur jong u kada bad ka la ong ha u Balaam , Nga la leh aiu ia me ba me la shoh ia nga kine ki lai sien ?

en: Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .
kha: U Moses u kohnguh bad u buh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong ha Israel kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kito kiba la shah khein na ki, baroh ki longiing jong ki, da ka iing ki kpa jong ki, ki long ar hajar hynriew spah laiphew .

en: Weep ye not for the dead , neither bemoan him : but weep sore for him that goeth away : for he shall return no more , nor see his native country .
kha: Ko ki paid Judah , wat ïam na ka bynta u syiem Josaïah , wat ïam pangnud ïa ka jingïap jong u . Hynrei ïamkthang na ka bynta u Joahas , u khun jong u ; ki la rah noh ïa u bad un ym wan phai shuh , un ym ïohi shuh ïa ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iam na ka bynta kiba iap, lymne wat iam na ka bynta uta uba leit noh: hynrei to iam na ka bynta uta uba leit noh: namar un ym wan phai shuh , lymne un ym iohi ia ka ri trai jong u .

en: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in , then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .
kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki lai snem kiba la buh da u syiem , u Ashpenas u la ïalam ïa baroh ki samla shynrang sha u Nebukhadnessar .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha kaba kut jong ki sngi ba u syiem u la ong ba u dei ban wanrah ia ki shapoh , nangta u syiem jong ki eunuk u la wanrah ia ki ha khmat u Nebuchadnezzar .

en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .
kha: To duwai ha U  Trai  ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phria ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donkam ban dang sah shuh hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia U Trai (na ka la biang ) ba kin ym don shuh ki jingsawa kiba khlain bad ki hail ; bad ngan pyllait noh ia phi , bad phin ym sah shuh .

en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he could not see . And he brought them near unto him  ; and he kissed them , and embraced them .
kha: U Jakob , namar ba u la tymmen , u la byr-ïe ki khmat , bad um imat bha shuh . U Joseph u ïalam ïa ki hajan jong u ; u ruh u piam u kdup ïa ki bad u doh de ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khmat jong ki Israel ki la tyrkhong haduh ka rta, haduh ba um lah ban iohi . U la wanrah ia ki hajan jong u ; bad u la kdup ia ki, bad u la pdiang ia ki .

en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences  ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .
kha: Yn don ki jingkhynñiuh jumai kiba shyrkhei , ki  nemsniew , bad ki khlam ha kylleng kylleng ; kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba pyntriem kiba wan na sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingkhynñiuh jumai kiba khraw kin long ha ki jaka ba jylliew, bad ki jingkyrduh bam bad ki jingpang bad ki jingpeit ba shyrkhei bad ki dak kiba khraw kin don na bneng .

en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb : Ephraim shall receive shame , and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel .
kha: Ïa uta u bleithaw yn kit noh sha Assyria kum ka jingnguh syiem ïa u patsha uba khraw . Ïa ka Israel yn pynjahburom bad yn pynlehrain namar ki jingai jingmut ba ka bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn rah ruh sha Assyria na ka bynta ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Jab: U Ephram un ioh ia ka jingsngewlehrain bad ki Israel kin sngewlehrain ia la ka jong ka jingthmu .

en: Yea , when they had made them a molten calf , and said , This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt , and had wrought great provocations  ;
kha: Ki la thaw bleithaw ha ka dur jong u khun masi bad ong ba u dei u blei uba la ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ! Haduh katno ki la pynjahburom ïa me , Ko  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, haba ki la pynlong ia ki khun masi ba la khleh lang, bad ki la ong, Une u long U Blei jong me uba la wanrah ia me na Ijipt, bad u la leh ia ki jingkhih kiba khraw;

en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
kha: Suk kito kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki briew basniew ki bym bud ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia u briew u bym iaid ha ka jingmut jong ki bymman , lymne u ieng ha ka lynti jong ki nongpop , lymne u shong ha ka jaka shong jong kiba sngewsih .

en: That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .
kha: Uno uno u bym burom ïa U Khun um burom ïa U Kpa uba la phah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki briew baroh kin burom ia u Khun kumba ki burom ia U Kpa . Uta u bym burom ia u Khun um burom ia U Kpa uba la phah ia u .

en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;
kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti kaba beit bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Balaam , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la iehnoh ia ka lynti kaba dei bad ki la jah noh, da kaba bud ia ka lynti jong u Balaam u khun u Bosor uba ieit ia ka bainong jong ka jingbymhok ; .

en: But that on the good ground are they , which in an honest and good heart , having heard the word , keep it , and bring forth fruit with patience .
kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap ha ka khyndew babha ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor bad kiba bat ïa ka ha ka dohnud kaba bha bad kaba kohnguh , bad ki ïaineh tad haduh ba kin da seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kata ha ka nongrim kaba bha ki long ma ki, kiba ha ka dohnud kaba hok bad kaba bha, haba ki la iohsngew ia ka ktien , ki bat ia ka bad ki sei soh da ka jingshaniah .

en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi phin ym kylli ei ei ia nga . Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi , Kaei kaei kaba phin pan na U Kpa ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un ai ia phi .

en: A sower went out to sow his seed : and as he sowed , some fell by the way side  ; and it was trodden down , and the fowls of the air devoured it .
kha: Shisien la don u briew uba la leit ban bet symbai . Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai , katto katne na u , ki la hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , ha kaba ki la shah ïuh , bad ki sim ki la bam lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u nongthung u la mih ban bet ia u symbai jong u: bad katba u dang bet, don kiba hap ha ka liang jong u ; bad ka la shah pynkhih shapoh , bad ki sim jong ka Iyer ki la bam ia u .

en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  Verily I say unto thee , That this day , even in this night , before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u Petros ,  Nga ong ïa me ba ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien mynta ka miet , men sa ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u , Hooid nga ong ha me, Ba ha kane ka sngi, wat ha kane ka miet, shuwa ba u khnai un kyntait ia nga arsien .

en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .
kha: U dei u nongshun jong ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la long u nongshun ia ki Israel ha ki sngi jong u Solomon baroh ki sngi: bad u la sngewsih ia ki Israel bad u la synshar halor ka Syria .

en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .
kha: Ki la mihnoh na uta u briew bad ki la rung shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh ka la noh sha riat shapoh ka duriaw bad ki la ïap jyllop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki ksuid ki la mih na uta u briew, bad ki la rung shapoh ka sniang: bad ka kynhun ka la mareh stet shapoh ka pung , bad ki la shah rong noh .

en: The Holy Ghost this signifying , that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest , while as the first tabernacle was yet standing :
kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u pyn-i shai na kine ki rukom pynbeit , ba ïa ka lynti sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ym pat lah ban plie , katba kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba ha khmat ka dang ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid ia kane kaba pynpaw , ba ka lynti sha ka jaka kaba khuid tam na baroh kam pat paw , katba ka iing kaba nyngkong ka dang ieng:

en: In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .
kha: Dei ban bam ïa ka jingbam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khreh ïa ka ; phim bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; bad ym dei ban pynkheiñ wat tang kawei ruh ka shyieng jong u mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei ka iing yn bam ia ka ; wat rah ia ka doh shabar na ka iing ; bad wat pynpra ia ka shyieng jong ka .

en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , that this word came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim , u khun jong u Josaïah , u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong u Jehosiah u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah , ba kane ka ktien ka la wan ha u Jeremaiah na U Trai .

en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me , that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream .
kha: Nga la hukum ban wallam sha nga ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ha Babilon khnang ba ki lah ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la leh ia ka hukum ban wanrah ia ki riewstad baroh jong ka Babilon ha khmat jong nga , ba kin pyntip ha nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka jingphohsniew .

en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .
kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un long uwei u nongsharai jong ki , bad un sumar bha ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia uwei u nongaplangbrot halor jong ki, bad un ai bam ia ki, wat u shakri jong nga u Dabid; un ai bam ia ki, bad un long u nongaplangbrot jong ki .

en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .
kha: A  Trai  , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhreh ban pynim ia nga: namarkata ngin rwai ia ki jingrwai jong nga ha ki tiar ba la shna da ki string baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong ngi ha iing U Trai .

en: And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .
kha: U patsha u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ki bad pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, To shim ia kine ki tiar, leit rah ia ki sha ka tempi kaba don ha Jerusalem bad ai ba ka iing U Blei kan tei ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices , and drank the wine of their drink offerings ? let them rise up and help you , and be your protection .
kha: Phi la bsa ïa ki da ka khleiñ na ki jingkñia jong phi , bad phi la ai waiñ de ïa ki ban dih . Ai ba kin wan mynta bad ïarap ïa phi , ai ba kin wan kloi ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba bam ia ka shini jong ki jingknia jong ki ? ai ba kin kiew bad iarap ia phi , bad to long ka jingiada jong phi .

en: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house . After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house .
kha: U Benjamin bad u Hasshub ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ki ïing jong ki . U Asaraïah , u khun jong u Maaseïah bad u ksiew jong u Ananaïah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Benjamin bad u Hashub pyrshah ia ka iing jong ki . Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Asariah u khun u Maaseiah u khun u Aniah da ka iing jong u .

en: For the pastors are become brutish , and have not sought the  Lord  : therefore they shall not prosper , and all their flocks shall be scattered .
kha: Nga la jubab ,  Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki long kiba mutlop ; kim shym kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïalam . Dei kane keiñ balei ba ki shahjop , bad ki briew jong ngi ki la shah pynsakma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki nongap langbrot ki kylla long kiba sniew bad kim shym la wad ia U Trai: namarkata kin ym roi , bad ki kynhun jong ki baroh kin sa jah noh .

en: And he was casting out a devil , and it was dumb . And it came to pass , when the devil was gone out , the dumb spake  ; and the people wondered .
kha: U Jisu u dang beh noh ïa u ksuid u bym lah ban kren ; bad haba u ksuid u la mihnoh , uta u briew u la sdang ban kren . Ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la beh noh ia u ksuid, bad u la lyngngoh . Bad ka la jia , haba u ksuid u la mih noh , u ksuid u la lyngngoh ; bad ki briew ki la lyngngoh .

en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side , and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side : and there was a valley between them .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïeng shrak ha uwei u lum bad ki Israel ha uwei pat u lum , hapdeng jong ki don kawei ka them .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la ieng ha u lum ha kawei ka liang , bad ki Israel ki la ieng ha u lum ha kawei pat ka liang: bad ka don ka them hapdeng jong ki .

en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .
kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u ong ïa u ,  ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .  Mar kumta hi u la lah ban ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Jisu ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, To leit noh ia ka lynti jong me.

en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him , Behold , thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of heaven from above  ;
kha: Kumta u Isaak u ong ha u ,  Ym don umjer na bneng na ka bynta jong me , Ym don lyngkha baseisoh na ka bynta jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u kpa jong u u la jubab bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih, ka jaka shong jong me kan long ka jingkhluit jong ka khyndew bad ka dewbilat jong ka bneng na jrong;

en: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved , to fill up their sins alway : for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost .
kha: Ki la pyrshang wat ban pynsangeh ïa ngi na kaba ïalap ha ki Jentil ïa ka khubor ka ban wallam ka jingpynim ha ki . Ha kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ïa baroh ki pop kiba ki la ju ïai leh . Bad mynta ka jingbitar jong U Blei ha kaba kut ka la wan hiar halor jong ki!
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbeit ia ngi ban kren bad ki Jutang ba kin ioh jingpynim , ban pyndap ia ki pop jong ki baroh kawei: namar ka jingbitar ka wan ha ki haduh katta katta .

en: And the five pillars of it with their hooks : and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold : but their five sockets were of brass .
kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , ki shna san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia bad ki sah ha ki san tylli ki bnoh ; ki suit da ka ksiar ïa ki shata    bad ki shrong jong ki , bad ki shna ruh san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong na ka bynta kita ki rishot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki san tylli ki maw jong ka da ki hook jong ki: bad u la tap ia ki bniat jong ki bad ki bniat jong ki da ka ksiar: hynrei ki san tylli ki soket jong ki ki long kiba la shna da ka nar .

en: Then cried he upon me , and spake unto me , saying , Behold , these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country .
kha: Nangta u angel u la pyrta jam sha nga ,  Ki kulai kiba la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia ki la pynjai jai ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la pyrta ia nga, bad u la kren ha nga, u da ong: Ha khmih kine kiba leit sha ka ri Sepngi ki la pynsngap jar ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha ka ri Sepngi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw kaba hajan Damaskos , bad nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynsleh ïa u Hasael kum u syiem ka Syria ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, To leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw jong ka Damekhos: bad haba me wan, to pynsleh ia u Hazael ban long syiem halor ka Syria:

en: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased , he sinned yet more , and hardened his heart , he and his servants .
kha: Haba u Pharaoh u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la leh pop biang . Ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïailong kiba mutlop kum mynshuwa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Pharaoh u la iohi ba u slap bad u bsein bad ki jingsawa ki la sangeh noh , u la leh pop shuh shuh bad u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u , ma u bad ki shakri jong u .

en: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us , whether prophecy , let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith ;
kha: Kumta ngi dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingai bapher bapher kat kum ka jingaiei U Blei ba la ai ha ngi . Lada ka jingai ïa ngi ka long ban kren ïa ka khubor U Blei , ngi dei ban leh ïa kata kat kum ka jingngeit kaba ngi don ;
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don ha kata ka por ki jingai sngewbha kiba pher katkum ka jingaiei kaba la ai ha ngi , la ka long ka jingiathuhlypa , to ngin iathuhlypa katkum ka jingkhein jong ka jingngeit ; .

en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym shah ïa ki briew ban im junom , ki long kiba dei ban ïap . Nangne sha khmat kin im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Ka mynsiem jong nga kan ym ialeh beit bad u briew: hynrei ki sngi jong u kin long shispah arphew snem .

en: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things , and needest not that any man should ask thee : by this we believe that thou camest forth from God .
kha: Ngi tip mynta ba me tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ; mem da donkam ba uno uno un kylli jingkylli ïa me . Kane ka pynlong ïa ngi ban ngeit ba me la wan na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi thikna ba me tip ia kiei kiei baroh, bad ngam donkam ba uno uno un kylli ia me: da kane ngi ngeit ba me wan na U Blei .

en: But the wise answered , saying , Not so  ; lest there be not enough for us and you : but go ye rather to them that sell , and buy for yourselves .
kha: ‘ Em ,’ kiba stad ki la jubab , ‘ kam don shibun ban dap ïa phi bad ïa ngi ruh . Khie leit sha dukan bad thied khyndiat na ka bynta ïa lade .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiba stad ki la jubab, ki da ong: Ym kumta lymta ym don shuh na ka bynta jong ngi bad phi: hynrei phi leit kham bha sha kito kiba die, bad thied ia lade .

en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you , as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor , and as the fulness of the winepress .
kha: Yn ñiew ïa kane ka jingnoh synñiang kaba kyrpang ba ka ïaryngkat dor bad ka jingainguh ba u nongrep u wanrah da u kew thymmai bad ka waiñ thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane ka jingainguh kaba heh jong phi yn khein ha phi kum u kew jong ka jingthung sohjew bad kum ka jingdap jong ka jingpynkhluit wain .

en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David , if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall .
kha: To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam shym pynïap ïa uba khatduh eh na kito ki briew ha shuwa ban mih ka step !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kham bun ruh U Blei ha ki nongshun jong u Dabid , lada nga iehnoh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba iadei bad u ha ka jingshai mynstep .

en: For laying aside the commandment of God , ye hold the tradition of men , as the washing of pots and cups : and many other such like things ye do .
kha: Phi la kyntait noh ïa ka hukum U Blei bad phi kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ban buh shawei ia ka hukum U Blei , phi bat ia ka dustur jong ki briew , kum ka jingsait ia ki khiew bad ki khuri: bad bun kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba kum kita kiba phi leh .

en: And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .
kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ha ïing u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , ha Lodebar ,  u Siba u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u, Hangno u don ? Bad u Siba u la ong ha u syiem: Ha khmih u don ha iing u Machir u khun u Ammiel ha Lodebar .

en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force , to make him a king , he departed again into a mountain himself alone .
kha: U Jisu u la tip lypa ba kin sa wan bad kem ïa u khnang ban pynlong syiem ïa u da ka bor ; kumta u la leit phai biang sha ki jaka lum marwei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la sngewthuh namarkata ba kin wan shim ia u da ka bor , ban pynlong syiem ia u , u la leit noh biang sha u lum hi marwei .

en: Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .
kha: Wat bet ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phi thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lada phi leh kumta , phim lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki sohwaiñ lane ïa u soh jong uta uwei pat u jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bet ia ka kper sohjew jong me da ki symbai ba jyrngam: ioh ia u soh u symbai jong me uba me la bet bad u soh jong ka kper sohjew jong me .

en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell not : for it was founded upon a rock .
kha: U slap u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , bad ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing . Hynrei kam shym la khyllem , namar la tei ïa ka halor u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U slap u la hiar, bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan, bad ki Iyer ki la beh ia kata ka iing ; bad kam shym la hap: namar la seng ia ka halor u maw .

en: Which say , Stand by thyself , come not near to me  ; for I am holier than thou . These are a smoke in my nose , a fire that burneth all the day .
kha: Bad nangta ki ong ïa kiwei pat , ‘ To ïeng jngai na ngi , naba ngi long kiba khuid shaba palat ym bit ban ktah ïa ngi !’ Ngam lah ban shah ïa ki briew kiba kum kita — ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki ka long kum ka ding ka bym ju lip shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ong , To ieng hi dalade hajan jong nga ; namar nga kham khuid ban ia me . Kine ki long ka tdem ha ka shyntur jong nga , ka ding kaba thang baroh shisngi .

en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .
kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel , u kob ïa u ban ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Amasaiah u la phah khubor sha u Jehos u khun u Jehos u syiem Israel u da ong: To wan, to ngin ia peit iwei ia iwei pat ha khmat .

en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned twenty years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba sanphew ar jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u Syiem ka Judah , u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar arphew snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew snem jong u Asariah u syiem Judah u Pekah u khun u Remaliah u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria bad u la synshar arphew snem .

en: For if , when we were enemies , we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son , much more , being reconciled , we shall be saved by his life .
kha: Ngi la long ki nongshun jong U Blei , hynrei u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong u lyngba ka jingïap U Khun jong u . Mynta ba ngi long ki paralok jong U Blei , katno tam ba yn pynim ïa ngi da ka jingim U Khrist !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada ngi la iapynbeit bad U Blei da ka jingiap jong u Khun jong u, kham bunsien, haba la pynbeit ia ngi, ngin sa shah pynim da ka jingim jong u .

en: I am distressed for thee , my brother Jonathan : very pleasant hast thou been unto me : thy love to me was wonderful , passing the love of women .
kha: Nga pangnud namar jong me , ko Jonathan u para jong nga ; Katno me long uba nga la sngewieit ! Katno phylla long ka jingieit jong me ïa nga , Kham palat ban ïa ka jingieit ki kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga sngewsih na ka bynta jong me, ko hynmen jong nga Jonathan: me la sngewbha shibun ia nga: ka jingieit jong me ia nga ka la long kaba phylla , kaba iaid lait ia ka jingieit jong ki kynthei .

en: He rebuketh the sea , and maketh it dry , and drieth up all the rivers : Bashan languisheth , and Carmel , and the flower of Lebanon languisheth .
kha: U hukum ïa ka duriaw , bad ka rngad ! U pynlong ïa ki wah ban tyrkhong . Ki pyntha jong ka Bashan ki swai , u lumbah Karmel u kylla bthuh , bad ki syntiew jong u Lebanon ki jlop .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynrem ia ka duriaw, bad u pynlong ia ka ban tyrkhong, bad u pynkhyllem ia ki wah baroh: U Basan u la tyrkhong, bad u Karmel bad u syntiew jong u Lebanon u la tyrkhong .

en: And the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words  ; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more :
kha: ka jingriew ka turoi , bad ka jingsawa jong ka sur kaba kren . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa , ki la kyrpad ba kim kwah shuh ban ïohsngew sa ïa kawei pat ka ktien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur jong ka turoi, bad ka sur jong ki kyntien ; kiba ki sawa ki la sngap ba ka ktien kan ym kren shuh ha ki:

en: But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .
kha: Baroh kaba la shna da ka rupa , ka ksiar , ka rnong lane ka nar , la buh kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai . Dei ban buh ïa kata ha ka ïing jingkynshew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka rupa baroh bad ka ksiar bad ki tiar nar bad ka nar baroh ki long kiba la pynkyntang ha U Trai: kin wan sha ka jaka buh jingbam jong U Trai .

en: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .
kha: Balei yn ym ong te ,  To ngin leh ïa kaba sniew khnang ba kaba bha kan mih ?  Katto katne ngut ki briew , shisha , ki pynjahburom ïa nga da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba ong ïa kane kaei kaei hi ! Kin shah pynrem , kumba ki dei ban shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym kham bha, (kumba ngi la shah pynpaw lyngkot, bad kumba don kiba pynskhem ba ngi ong) To ngin leh ia kaba sniew, ba ka bha kan wan ? uba ka jingpynrem ka long tang .

en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the  Lord s  house which was toward the north  ; and , behold , there sat women weeping for Tammuz .
kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shatei ka Templ bad u la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki kynthei kiba ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka jingïap u blei Tammus .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wanrah ia nga sha ka jingkhang jong ka iing U Trai kaba don shaphang shathie bad, ha khmih, ki la shong ki kynthei kiba iam na ka bynta u Tammuz .

en: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi , the daughter of Zur  ; he was head over a people , and of a chief house in Midian .
kha: Ka kyrteng jong kata ka kynthei ka dei ka Kosbi . U Sur , u kpa jong ka u long u rangbah bahakhlieh jong kawei ka kynhun ki jait Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng jong ka kynthei Midian kaba la shah pyniap ka long u Cozbi , ka khun jong u Zur ; u la long u khliehduh halor kawei ka jaitbynriew bad na kawei ka iing kaba ha Midian .

en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .
kha: Lada u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha ka shi sngi , bad man ka por u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u iaid pyrshah ia me hynriew sien ha ka shisngi , bad hynriew sien ha ka shisngi u phai biang sha me , da kaba ong , nga kylla bamut; me dei ban map ia u .

en: Concerning Edom , thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Is wisdom no more in Teman ? is counsel perished from the prudent ? is their wisdom vanished ?
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong shaphang ka Edom :  Hato ki briew ka Edom ki la duh noh ïa la ka jingbishar babha ? Hato ki nongaibuit jong ki kim lah shuh ban ïathuh ïa ki kaei ba ki dei ban leh ? Hato ka jingstad jong ki baroh ka la jah noh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang u Edom , kumta u Trai jong ki paid ; Hato ka jingstad kam don shuh ha u Teman ? hato ka jingai jingmut ka la jah noh na kiba stad ? hato ka jingstad jong ki ka la jah noh ?

en: And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .
kha: Ka pansngiat kan long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Josaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khlieh kin long ha u Helem bad ha u Tobiiah bad ha u Jedaiah bad ha u Hen u khun u Sephaniah, na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw ha ka tempi U Trai .

en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kurup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khun Judah ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem bad ki la shim ia ka bad ki la pynkhih ia ka da ka waitlam bad ki la thang ia ka nongbah .

en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .
kha: Ka spah baroh kaba U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka dei ka jong ngi bad jong ki khun jong ngi . To leh katba U Blei u la bthah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki spah baroh kiba U Blei u la shim na u kpa jong ngi, kata ka long ka jong ngi: mynta , kaei kaei kaba U Blei u la ong ha me , to leh .

en: I said , I shall not see the  Lord  , even the  Lord  , in the land of the living : I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world .
kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ha kane ka pyrthei jong kiba im , ba ngan ym ïohi shuh ïa U  Trai lane ïa uno uno u briew uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , Ngan ym iohi ia U Trai, wat ia U Trai ruh ha ka ri jong kiba im: Ngan ym iohi shuh ia u briew bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka pyrthei .

en: For unto me the children of Israel are servants  ; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: U Israel um lah ban long u mraw baroh shi rta , namar ki Israel ki long ki mraw jong U  Trai . U wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; u long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha nga ki khun Israel ki long ki shakri ; ki long ki shakri jong nga kiba nga la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt : Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Amos , which was the son of Naum , which was the son of Esli , which was the son of Nagge ,
kha: u khun jong u Mattathias , u khun jong u Amos , u khun jong u Nahum , u khun jong u Esli , u khun jong u Naggai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Mathaias uba long u khun u Amos uba long u khun u Naum uba long u khun u Esli uba long u khun u Nagge .

en: Or ever the silver cord be loosed , or the golden bowl be broken , or the pitcher be broken at the fountain , or the wheel broken at the cistern .
kha: U kynjri rupa un dkut , bad ka sharak ksiar kan hap bad kan pait ; u tyllai ha ka pukri um un dkut ; bad ïa u khra um yn pynpait .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane la ju pynkhih ia ka lynti rupa, lane ka khiew ksiar ka la tyrkhong, lane ka khiew ka la tyrkhong ha ka pung um, lane ka tyrpeng ka la tyrkhong ha ka jaka ba la tyrkhong.

en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father , will he give him a stone ? or if he ask a fish , will he for a fish give him a serpent ?
kha: Hato uno uno na phi kiba long ki kpa phin ai ïa u khun jong phi da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u khun shynrang un pan kpu na uno uno na phi uba long u kpa , hato un ai maw ia u ? lane lada u pan dohkha , hato un ai ia u ia u ia u bsein ?

en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim : and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .
kha: Ka ju shong hapoh uwei u Dieng Tlai hapdeng ka Ramah bad ka Bethel ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ki paid Israel ki ju leit hangta na ka bynta ki jingbishar jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la shong hapoh u dieng sohjew jong ka Deborah hapdeng u Ramah bad u Bethel ha u lum Ephraim: bad ki khun Israel ki la wan shaneng sha ka ban bishar .

en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent , and leave a blessing behind him  ; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the  Lord  your God ?
kha: Lehse U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kylla ka jingmut bad un kyrkhu ïa phi da ki jingthung bakyrhai . Te phin lah ban ainguh ha u da u kew bad ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba tip lada un wan phai bad kylla bamut , bad u iehnoh ia ka jingkyrkhu hadien jong u ; wat ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingkyrkhu dih sha U Trai U Blei jong phi ?

en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .
kha: U la wan shane ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . Khlem pep , phi tip ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Me tip ia u khun u Ner, ba u la wan ban shukor ia me, bad ban tip ia ka jingleit jong me bad ka jingwan jong me, bad ban tip ia kiei kiei baroh kiba me leh .

en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone , they caught Paul and Silas , and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers ,
kha: Haba ki kynrad jong ka ki sngewthuh ba ka lad thaw pisa jong ki ka la duh noh , ki la kem ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ki la tan ïa ki sha ki bor synshar ha ka jaka ïew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki kynrad jong ka ki la iohi ba ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka la jah noh , ki la kem ia u Paul bad u Silas bad ki la tan ia ki sha ka iew sha ki nongsynshar .

en: Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi la bat noh ïa u shabi uba plie ïa ka khyrdop sha ka ïing jong ka jingtip ; phi hi phim leit rung shapoh , bad phi khang ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung shapoh !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongiasaid ain ! namar phi la weng noh ia u shabi jong ka jingtip: phim shym la rung ha lade , bad kito kiba la rung ha phi ki la khanglad .

en: And I came to Jerusalem , and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah , in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God .
kha: bad nga wan phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta nga la kyndit ban shem ba u Eliashib u shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la poi ha Jerusalem , bad nga la sngewthuh ia ka jingsniew kaba u Eliashib u la leh na ka bynta u Tobiah , ha kaba pynkhreh ia u ia ka kamra ha ki phyllaw jong ka iing U Blei .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Baasha u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha ka  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Basa bad kaei kaba u la leh bad ka bor jong u , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them : and they pursued after Joshua , and were drawn away from the city .
kha: La khot lang ïa ki rangbah baroh kiba ha ka nongbah ban leit beh ïa ki , bad katba ki nang beh ïa u Joshua , katta ruh ki nang jngai na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la khot lang ia ki briew baroh kiba don ha Ai ban bud ia ki: bad ki la beh ia u Joshua , bad la tan noh ia ki na ka shnong .

en: For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ s servant .
kha: Naba u mraw uba la khot da U Trai u long uba laitluid na ka bynta U Trai ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba laitluid ïa uba la khot da U Khrist u long u mraw jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uta uba la khot ha U Trai, uba long u shakri, u long u nongshakri jong U Trai: kumjuh ruh uta uba la khot, uba laitluid, u long u shakri jong U Khrist .

en: And they went out of the prison , and entered into the house of Lydia : and when they had seen the brethren , they comforted them , and departed .
kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la mihnoh na ka byndi bad ki la leit sha ka ïing jong ka Lydia . Hangta ki la ïakynduh ïa ki parabangeit , ki la kren ki kyntien pynshlur ïa ki , bad ki la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih na ka phatok bad ki la rung shapoh ka iing jong ka Lydia : bad haba ki la iohi ia ki hynmen ki la pyntngen ia ki bad ki la leit noh .

en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom , Thus saith thy brother Israel , Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us :
kha: U Moses u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien na Kadesh sha u syiem Edom . Ki ong ,  Kane ka khubor ka wan na ki para kur jong phi , kiba na ka jait Israel . Phi tip ïa ki jingeh kiba ngi la shah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor na Kadesh sha u syiem ka ri Edom , Kumta u hynmen jong me u Israel , Me tip ia ka jingtrei shitom baroh kaba la jia ia ngi:

en: For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the gospel : not with wisdom of words , lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect .
kha: U Khrist um shym la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis . U la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad ban ïathuh ïa ka khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka ktien ha ka jingstad briew , khnang ban pynthikna ba ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna kan ym pynduh noh ïa ka bor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist u la phah ia nga ban ym pynbaptis , hynrei ban ialap ia ka gospel: ym da ka jingstad jong ki kyntien , ioh ba ka diengphna U Khrist kan ym long kaba khlem jingktah ei ei .

en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .
kha: Ïa kaba sah jong ka yn pynsaphriang hangta kum ka jakhlia , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano uba lah ithuh ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka met jong u Jesbel kan long kum ka dewbilat ha ka khmat jong ka lyngkha ha ka bynta jong u Jesel ; khnang ba kin ym ong: Kane ka dei ka Jesbel .

en: For whom he did foreknow , he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son , that he might be the firstborn among many brethren .
kha: Kito ïa kiba U Blei u la lah jied lypa u la pynkyrpang ruh ban long kum U Khun jong u , khnang ba U Khun un long uba nyngkong hapdeng ki para .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong u uba u la tip lypa , u la buh lypa ruh ban iadei bad ka dur jong u Khun jong u , ba un long u khun nyngkong napdeng ki hynmen kiba bun .

en: For Jacob my servant s sake , and Israel mine elect , I have even called thee by thy name : I have surnamed thee , though thou hast not known me .
kha: Nga la thung ïa me ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong nga u Israel , ki briew kiba nga la jied . Nga la ai ha me ka burom bakhraw , wat la mem shym la ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u shakri jong nga u Jakob, bad ki Israel jong nga ki la jied ia me: Nga la jer kyrteng ia me wat la me khlem ithuh ia nga .

en: And he blessed Joseph , and said , God , before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk , the God which fed me all my life long unto this day ,
kha: Nangta u kyrkhu ïa u Joseph u da ong ,  To U Blei uba ki kpa jong nga , U Abraham bad u Isaak , ki la shakri , Un kyrkhu ïa kine ki khun ! To U Blei uba la ïalam ïa nga haduh kane ka sngi , un kyrkhu ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyrkhu ia u Joseph bad u la ong: U Blei, ha khmat jong u kpa jong nga u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la iaid , U Blei uba la ai bam ia nga baroh shi sngi .

en: Men s hearts failing them for fear , and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth : for the powers of heaven shall be shaken .
kha: Ki briew kin ïapler na ka jingsheptieng katba ki dang ap ïa kaei kaba wan halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei , naba ïa ki bor ha ka haw haw yn beh noh na ki lynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dohnud jong ki briew ki la jah rngai noh na ka bynta ka jingtieng, bad namar ba ki peit ia kiei kiei kiba wan ha ka pyrthei: namar ki bor bneng kin sa khih .

en: Is any sick among you ? let him call for the elders of the church  ; and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord :
kha: Hato don uno uno uba pang ? U dei ban phah khot ïa ki nongsharai balang , ki ban duwai na ka bynta jong u bad pynsleh ha u da ka umphniang Olib ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don mano mano ba pang hapdeng jong phi ? to ai ba un khot ia ki rangbah jong ka balang ; bad ai ba kin duwai halor jong u da kaba pynsleh ia u da ka umphniang ha ka kyrteng U Trai:

en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :
kha: Haba nga la ïohi ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u kum u briew ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka kti kamon jong u halor jong nga bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la iohi ia u, nga la dem ha ki kjat jong u kum uba la iap . Bad u la buh ia la ka kti kadiang halor jong nga, u da ong ha nga, Wat tieng; nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh:

en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
kha: Da shisha u la pang bad u la jan ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la isynei ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u hynrei ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha u la pang hajan ka jingiap: hynrei U Blei u la isynei ia u ; bad ym tang ia u , hynrei ia nga ruh , ioh ba ngan sngewsih ia ka jingsngewsih .

en: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
kha: u khun jong u Joshua , u khun jong u Elieser , u khun jong u Jorim , u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Jose uba long u khun u Elizer uba long u khun u Jorim uba long u khun u Mathathai uba long u khun u Lebi .

en: After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .
kha: Nangta u la paw ha palat sanspah ngut ki nongbud jong u ha kajuh ka por , kiba kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata , la iohi ia u palat san spah ngut ki para ha ka shisien ha kaba ka bynta kaba kham khraw ka sah haduh mynta , hynrei don kiba la iohthiah .

en: And had taken the women captives , that were therein : they slew not any , either great or small , but carried them away , and went on their way .
kha: bad ki la ringmraw ïa ki kynthei baroh ; kim shym la pynïap ïano ïano , hynrei ki la rah noh lem bad ki haba ki leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la shim ia ki kynthei kiba la shah set phatok, kiba don hangta: kim shym la pyniap ei ei, la ka long kaba khraw ne kaba rit, hynrei ki la rah noh ia ki, bad ki la iaid shakhmat .

en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .
kha: Ngi bud ïa ka mon jong me bad ngi buh ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me uba ngi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, ha ka lynti jong ki jingbishar jong me, ko Trai, ngi la ap ia me; ka jingkwah jong ka mynsiem jong ngi ka long ha ka kyrteng jong me bad ha ka jingkynmaw ia me .

en: But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .
kha: Hynrei ngim tip kumno pat ba mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah jong u . Kylli ïa u ; u la biang ka rta , bad u lah ban jubab da lade hi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da kaei ka lad kaba u iohi mynta, ngim tip ; ne mano ba la plie ia ki khmat jong u: u la dap ka rta ; kylli ia u: un kren na ka bynta lade .

en: Thou art the  Lord  the God , who didst choose Abram , and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldeans , and gavest him the name of Abraham  ;
kha: Ma me , A  Trai  U Blei me la jied ïa u Abram bad me ïalam ïa u na ka Ur ha Babilon ; me pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long U Trai U Blei uba la jied ia u Abram bad u la wanrah ia u na Ur jong ki Khaldian bad u la ai ia u ia ka kyrteng u Abraham ; .

en: True education , apart from providing technical skills , makes us aware of our responsibilities towards society by building an ethical character .
kha: Ka jinghikai kaba shisha , nalor ba ka ai ia ki jingtbit ha ka liang ka jingstad , ka pynlong ia ngi ban sngewthuh ia ki jingkitkhlieh jong ngi ha ka imlang sahlang da kaba tei ia ka jinglong kaba don akor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpule kaba shisha , nalor ka jingai jingtbit ha ka liang ka jingstad , ka pynlong ia ngi ban sngewthuh ia ki jingkitkhlieh jong ngi sha ka imlang sahlang da kaba tei ia ka jinglong kaba don akor .

en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .
kha: Hynrei ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la kham phriang kylleng , bad ki paid byllien ki la wan ban sngap ïa u bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katba nang kiew ka nam shabar jong u: bad ki paidbah kiba bun ki la iawan lang ban iohsngew , bad ban shah pynkoit da u na ki jingduna jong ki .

en: And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church  ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha me , ko Petros : me long u mawsiang , bad halor kane ka nongrim mawsiang ngan tei ïa ka balang jong nga , bad wat ka jingïap hi kan ym lah ban jop ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ruh ha me , Ba me long u Petros bad halor une u maw ngan tei ia ka balang jong nga ; bad ki khyrdop dujok kin ym jop ia ka .

en: And the  Lord  said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven : but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash .
kha: Hynrei kam dei ka jingthmu U  Trai  ban pynjot thiaw shi junom ïa ki Israel , kumta u pyllait im ïa ki lyngba u syiem Jeroboam uba ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai um shym la ong ba un pynduh noh ia ka kyrteng Israel na shapoh bneng : hynrei u la pynim ia ki da ka kti u Jeroboan u khun u Joash .

en: And Jesus answering them said ,  Have ye not read so much as this , what David did , when himself was an hungred , and they which were with him  ;
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Hato phim shym la pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki u la ong: Hato phim shym la pule kumne, ia kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh, haba ma u hi u la thngan, bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u;

en: For whether we live , we live unto the Lord ; and whether we die , we die unto the Lord : whether we live therefore , or die , we are the Lord s .
kha: Lada ngi im , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi im , bad lada ngi ïap , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi ïap . Kumta lada ngi im lane ngi ïap , ngi long ki jong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la ngi im ne ngi iap ha U Trai;

en: Send them away , that they may go into the country round about , and into the villages , and buy themselves bread : for they have nothing to eat .
kha: To phah noh ïa ki briew , bad ai ba kin leit sha ki lyngkha kiba hajan bad ki nongrit khnang ba kin thied ei ei ïa lade ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Phah noh ia ki , ba kin leit sha ri sawdong , bad sha ki shnong ki thaw: namar kim don ei ei ban bam .

en: And it shall be , when thou hast made an end of reading this book , that thou shalt bind a stone to it , and cast it into the midst of Euphrates :
kha: Ko Seraïah , ynda me dep ban pule ïa kane ka kot ha ki briew , nangta sa teh ïa ka ha u maw bad bret ïa ka ha ka wah Ïuphratis bad ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, ynda me la dep ban pule ia kane ka kot, ba men teh ia u maw ha ka bad bret ia u hapdeng ka Euphrates:

en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship , asleep on a pillow : and they awake him , and say unto him , Master , carest thou not that we perish ?
kha: U Jisu u don ha ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka lieng , u da ïohthiah , ka khlieh jong u ha ka syngkhlieh . Ki synran ki la kyrsiew ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , hato mem sngewlem ïa ngi ba ngin sa ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la don ha ka bynta ba shadien jong ka lieng, u la iohthiah ha ka pillow: bad ki la pynkynjah ia u, bad ki la ong ha u: Ko Nonghikai, phim sngewthuh ba ngi la jah noh ?

en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount , and called his brethren to eat bread : and they did eat bread , and tarried all night in the mount .
kha: U pynïap ïa u jingri , ïa uba u ai kum ka jingkñia halor uta u lum , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew jong u ban ïabam . Ynda ki la lah bam , ki sahmiet halor uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jakob u la tyrwa ia ka jingknia halor u lum , bad u la khot ia ki hynmen jong u ban bam kpu: bad ki la bam kpu , bad ki la sah baroh shi miet ha u lum .

en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature , if it fulfil the law , judge thee , who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law ?
kha: Bad kumta ma phi ki Jiw phin shah pynrem ha ki Jentil namar phi pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum , wat la na ka bynta jong phi ïa ka Hukum la thoh bad ïa phi la otsher ; hynrei ki kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , wat la ym shym la otsher ïa ki ha ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym long ka jingbymkren bein kaba long da ka jinglong , lada ka pyndep ia ka hukum , to bishar ia me , uba da ka shithi bad ka jingkren bein u la pynkhein ia ka hukum ?

en: And I have also established my covenant with them , to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their pilgrimage , wherein they were strangers .
kha: Nga la pynlong ruh ka jutang bad ki , da kaba kular ban ai ha ki ïa ka ri Kanaan , ka ri ha kaba ki la shong la sah kum ki sohshnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynskhem ruh ia ka jutang jong nga bad ki, ban ai ia ki ia ka ri Kanaan , ka ri jong ka jingleit jingwan jong ki , ha kaba ki long ki nongwei .

en: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;
kha: Kumjuh ruh hikai ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham san ba kin im donakor kum ki kynthei kiba dei ban leh , kiba im ka jingim bakhuid . Kim dei ban long kiba kren siar lane kiba kyrni ha ka dih waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei kiba la tymmen kumjuh , ba ki don ha ka jinglong kum ki nongmudui lamler , ym ki nongmudui lamler , ym da ka wain kaba bun , ki nonghikai ia kiei kiei kiba bha ; .

en: Again , ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time , Thou shalt not forswear thyself , but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths :
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ruh ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ki por mynbarim , ‘ Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka kular jong phi , hynrei to leh ïa kaei kaba phi la smai ha U Trai ban leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , phi la iohsngew ba la ong da ki ha ka por barim , Wat nym iehnoh ia lade , hynrei to leh ia ki jingkular jong me ha U Trai:

en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .
kha: U Hadad u ïoh ïa ka jingïadei paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para jong ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hadad u la shem ia ka jingsngewbha kaba khraw ha khmat u Pharaoh , kumta u la ai ia u ia ka tnga jong ka tnga jong u hi , ka tnga jong u Tahpenes ka mahadei .

en: For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa ka jingshitom kaba jur jong ki Israel ; ym don mano mano ruh ban ïarap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la iohi ia ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel , ba kam shym la don kano kano ka jingkhang , ne kano kano ka liang kadiang , ne uno uno u nongiarap na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
kha: U Jedaïah , u khun jong u Harumaph u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong ki u la pynbha ia u Jedaiah u khun u Hameph, wat ha ka iing jong u . Bad hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Hattush u khun u Hashabnia .

en: The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .
kha: bad baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki rudwah jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong bad yn sa rong noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kot ka la tyrkhong da ki wah, da ka shyntur jong ki wah, bad kaei kaei baroh kaba la bet da ki wah, kan tyrkhong noh, kan jah noh, bad kan ym don shuh .

en: Thus I fell down before the  Lord  forty days and forty nights , as I fell down at the first  ; because the  Lord  had said he would destroy you .
kha: Kumta nga la dem khrup ha khmat U  Trai  ha kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , namar ba u la ong ba un pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la hap ha khmat U Trai sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , kumba nga la hap ha ka ; kaba nyngkong namar U Trai u la ong ba un pynjot ia phi .

en: As for that night , let darkness seize upon it  ; let it not be joined unto the days of the year , let it not come into the number of the months .
kha: Tap noh ïa kata ka miet na ka snem , bad wat ai ba yn ñiew biang ïa ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia kata ka miet , to ai ba ka jingdum kan bat ia ka ; wat ai ba kan ym iasoh bad ki sngi jong u snem , wat ai ba kan wan ha ka jingbun ki bnai .

en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Namar ba ïa kito ki nong Galilaïa la pynïap ha kata ka rukom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nong Galilaïa ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki, "Lada phi ong ba kine ki nong Galilaia ki long ki nongpop halor jong ki nong Galilaia baroh, namar ki la shah shitom kum kita kiei kiei ?

en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?
kha: Lane lehse phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da shisha phi tip ba U Blei u long uba sbun , namar u pyrshang ban ïalam ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane me sngewsih ia ka spah jong ka jingbha bad ka jingsngewrit jong u;

en: And also thus said the king , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which hath given one to sit on my throne this day , mine eyes even seeing it .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u dem ngon ha ka jingmane ha la ka jingthiah bad u duwai , ‘ To ngin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba ha kane ka sngi u la pynlong syiem hadien jong nga ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad ba u la shah ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kata !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh kumta u syiem u la ong u syiem , La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , uba la ai ia u briew ban shong ha ka khet jong nga ha kane ka sngi .

en: We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .
kha: Ka Moab ka sarong palat ! Nga la ïohsngew katno ka jingsarong , ka jingsngewbiang ki briew ki long , katno ki pyrkhat shaphang ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la iohsngew ia ka jingsarong jong u Moab , (u long uba sngew sarong palat) ia ka jinglong ba jrong jong u, bad ka jingsarong jong u, bad ka jinglong ba jrong jong ka dohnud jong u .

en: Which was the son of Cainan , which was the son of Arphaxad , which was the son of Sem , which was the son of Noah , which was the son of Lamech ,
kha: u khun jong u Kainan , u khun jong u Arphaksad , u khun jong u Shem , u khun jong u Noah , u khun jong u Lamekh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Kain uba long u khun u Arphaxed uba long u khun u Sem uba long u khun u Noah uba long u khun u Lamech .

en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :
kha: Nga u Paul , nga pynlong ka jingkyrpad ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ong ba nga long uba jemnud bad jai jai haba nga don bad phi , hynrei uba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga hi nga kyrpad ia phi da ka jinglong jemnud bad ka jinglong jemnud jong U Khrist, uba ha khmat jong phi u long uba rit hapdeng jong phi:

en: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , U Blei ruh u la ai shuh ïa la ki sakhi ha ki , da kaba leh bun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla bad da kaba ïasam ïa ki jingai U Mynsiem Bakhuid kat kum ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei ruh u ju sakhi ia ki, baroh ar ki dak bad ki jingphylla , bad ki jingphylla kiba jylliew bad ki jingai jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kat kum ka mon jong u hi ?

en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod , and could not speak in the Jews  language , but according to the language of each people .
kha: Shiteng na ki khun jong ki , ki kren ïa ka ktien Ashdod lane ïa kiwei ki ktien bad kim tip kumno ban kren ïa ka ktien jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ki ki kren shiteng ha ka ktien Ashdod , bad kim lah ban kren ha ka ktien Jiw , hynrei kat kum ka ktien jong uwei pa uwei u briew .

en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us , which was contrary to us , and took it out of the way , nailing it to his cross ;
kha: U Blei u la map ïa ngi ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh ; u la pyndam noh ïa ka jingbuh jingthoh ka bymsngewtynnat ïa ki ram jong ngi lem bad ki kyndon jong ka kiba teh bad weng noh syndon ïa ka da kaba sah preg ïa ka ha ka diengphna .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba pynkhih ia ka jingthoh kti jong ki jingpynbeit kaba la long pyrshah ia ngi , kaba pyrshah ia ngi , bad u la weng noh ia ka na ka lynti , da kaba pynkhih ia ka ha ka diengphna jong u;

en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , uba dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u bad ki khun shynrang jong u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la shim ia u Jaasiah u khun u Jeremaiah, u khun u Habaniniah bad ki hynmen jong u baroh bad ki khun shynrang jong u baroh kawei;

en: And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water  ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?
kha: Katba ki nang ïaleit ha lynti , ki la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba la don khyndiat ka um , bad uta u rangbah synshar u la ong ,  Hangne ka don ka um . Kaei kaba khang ïa nga na kaba shah pynbaptis ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang iaid lynti, ki la poi ha kawei ka um: bad uta u nonglehkai u la ong: Peit, hangne ka don ka um; kaei kaba khanglad ia nga ban shah pynbaptis ?

en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .
kha: Haba u duwai , U Blei un jubab ïa u ; un mane ïa U Blei da kaba kmen ; U Blei un buh beit sa shisien pat ïa kiei kiei na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Un duwai ha U Blei , bad un sngewbha ia u: bad un iohi ia ka khmat jong u da ka jingkmen: namar un pynphai ia u briew ia ka hok jong u .
