en: The fruit of thy land , and all thy labours , shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up  ; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway :
kha: Ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi ha kiba phi la trei shitom , katba phi pat phim ym ïoh ei ei lait tang ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingshah lehbeiñ suda .
translated_en_to_kha: U soh jong ka ri jong me bad ki jingtrei shitom jong me baroh, un bam ia ka jaitbynriew kaba me tip; bad me shah pynshitom bein bad shah pynkhyllem beit:

en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .
kha: Shim ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh bakyrpang sha nga . Kane ka bynta jong u mrad ba la kñia ka dei ka jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka shyntur jong u langbrot Aaron, bad to pynkhih ia ka da ka jingknia kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai: bad kan long ka bynta jong me .

en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus , in the beginning of his reign , wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem .
kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar u patsha Serksis , ki nongshun jong ki briew kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da ka jingthoh pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingsynshar u Ahasaerus, ha kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar jong u, ki la thoh ha u ia ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem .

en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;
kha: Kito ki briew baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi myn haba ngi la wan jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno ba phi la phai noh na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad uba im
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki hi ki pyni ia ngi ia ka rukom rung shapoh jong ngi ha phi, bad kumno phi phai sha U Blei na ki bleithaw ban shakri ia U Blei uba im bad uba shisha ; .

en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the east gate , and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee ,
kha: bad ban leit lyngba ka Khyrdop Khra-pait shabar sha ka Them Hinnom . Hangta nga dei ban pynbna ïa ka khubor kaba un ai ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad leit sha ka them u khun Hinnom kaba don hajan ka khyrdop mihngi , bad pynbna hangta ia ki ktien kiba ngan iathuh ha me .

en: From Aroer , that is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon  ;
kha: Ka ri jong ki ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kaba kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh na Medeba shaduh Dibon .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Aroer , kata ka don ha rud wah Arnon bad ka shnong kaba don hapdeng ka wah bad ka madan Madeb baroh haduh Dbon ; .

en: Moreover four thousand were porters  ; and four thousand praised the  Lord  with the instruments which I made , said David , to praise therewith .
kha: saw hajar ngut ban ap phira , bad saw hajar ngut ban ïaroh ïa U  Trai  da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki jingtem jingput ba la pynbiang da u syiem na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata saw hajar ngut ki nongrahbor ; bad saw hajar ngut ki la iaroh ia U Trai da ki tiar kiba nga la shna, la ong u Dabid, ban iaroh da kata .

en: For , when we were come into Macedonia , our flesh had no rest , but we were troubled on every side ; without were fightings , within were fears .
kha: Wat hadien ba ngi la poi ha Makedonia , ngim shym la ïoh shongthait . Ki la don ki jingjynjar ha kylleng sawdong , ki jingïakajia bad kiwei pat , ki jingsheptieng ha ki dohnud jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, haba ngi la poi ha Makedonia, ka doh jong ngi kam don jingjahthait, hynrei ngi la shah pynshitom ha man la ki liang ; khlem ki jingialeh, hapoh ki don ki jingtieng .

en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .
kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki kam jong ki , ngan wan ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong ki hima baroh . Haba kin ïawanlang , kin sa ïohi kaei ba ka bor jong nga ka lah ban leh bad kin sa tip ba nga dei uta uba pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia ki kam bad ki jingpyrkhat jong ki: kan sa wan, ba ngan lum ia ki jaitbynriew bad ki thylliej baroh; bad kin sa wan, bad kin sa iohi ia ka burom jong nga .

en: The objective of panel discussions is to analyse the current state of unique foodproducts , Handlooms and Handicrafts from the North East region .
kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki jingiakren panel ka long ban bishar bniah ia ka jinglong mynta jong ki mar bam ba kyrpang , ki jingshna kti bad ki jingshna kti na ka thain shatei lammihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki jingiakren ha ka panel ka long ban bishar bniah ia ka jinglong kaba mynta jong ki mar bam ba kyrpang , ki kti bad ki kti na ka thain shatei lam mihngi .

en: And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist  ; he is risen from the dead  ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
kha: U dei shisha u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , uba la im pat ,  u la ïathuh ha ki rangbah synshar jong u .  Dei kata keiñ balei ba une u la don ïa kane ka bor ban leh ki kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, Une u long u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis ; u la mihpat na kiba iap bad namarkata ki kam kiba donbor ki paw ha u .

en: The earth shall quake before them  ; the heavens shall tremble : the sun and the moon shall be dark , and the stars shall withdraw their shining :
kha: Ka pyrthei ka khih katba ki nang tur ; ka sahit bneng ka khynñiuh . Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim shai shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew kan khih ha khmat jong ki; ki bneng kin khih: ka sngi bad u bnai kin dum , bad ki khlur kin weng noh ia ka jingshai jong ki:

en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .
kha: Lada uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh wat la u pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’ ngan pynshitom ïa u bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia u nongiathuhlypa bad u lyngdoh bad ki briew kiba ong , Ka jingkit jong U Trai , ngan pynshitom wat ia uta u briew bad ia ka iing jong u .

en: And he spake unto the children of Israel , saying , When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean these stones ?
kha: Bad u la ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Hadien habud , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli ïa phi aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Haba ki khun jong phi kin kylli ia ki kpa jong ki ha ki por ban wan da kaba ong: Kiei kine ki maw ?

en: And that servant , which knew his lord s will , and prepared not himself , neither did according to his will , shall be beaten with many stripes .
kha: U shakri uba tip aïu u kynrad jong u , u kwah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u bym shym la pynkloi ïa lade bad leh ïa ka , un shah pynshitom da ka jingsympat kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u shakri uba tip ia ka mon jong u kynrad jong u, bad um shym la pynkhreh ia lade, bad um shym la pynkhreh kat kum ka mon jong u, un shah shoh da ki jingshah shoh kiba bun .

en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life : and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life  ; but the wrath of God abideth on him .
kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun u don ka jingim bymjukut ; uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa U Khun un ym ïoh ïa ka jingim , hynrei un ïaisah ha ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ngeit ha U Khun u don ka jingim bymjukut: bad uta u bym ngeit ia U Khun un ym iohi ia ka jingim ; hynrei ka jingbitar U Blei ka sah ha u .

en: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee , and unto thy seed for ever . And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow .
kha: Bad mynta ka jingpang jong u Naaman kan wan halor jong me , bad ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïoh ïa ka shi junom !  Haba u Gehasi u la mihnoh , u la ïoh ïa ka jingpang — ka sniehdoh jong u ka la lieh kum ka ïor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpang sniehdoh jong u Naaman kan sa rung ha me bad ha u symbai jong me junom . Bad u la mih na khmat jong u u nongpang sniehdoh uba lieh kum u slap .

en: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things , they doubted of them whereunto this would grow .
kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewphylla ïa kaei kaba lah jia ha ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u rangbah lyngdoh bad u rangbah lyngdoh jong ka tempi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei , ki la artatien ia ki ha kaba kane kan nangroi .

en: Behold , the Lord  God  will help me  ; who is he that shall condemn me ? lo , they all shall wax old as a garment  ; the moth shall eat them up .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar da lade un kyrshan ïa nga — uno te , uba lah ban pynshisha ba nga long uba la shah pynrem ? Baroh ki nongmudui jong nga kin jah noh ; kin jah kum ka jaiñ ba la bam khñiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih U Trai U Blei un iarap ia nga ; mano ba pynrem ia nga ? ha khmih baroh kin sa tymmen kum ka jain ; u khnai un bam ia ki .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  came again the second time , and touched him , and said , Arise and eat  ; because the journey is too great for thee .
kha: U angel U  Trai  u la wan biang bad kyrsiew ïa u ha ka sien kaba ar bad u ong ,  Khie joit bad bam , lymda kumta men shitom ha ka jingïaid lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la wan biang ha ka sien kaba ar bad u la ktah ia u bad u la ong: To khie bad bam ; namar ka jingleit ka long kaba khraw palat ia me .

en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .
kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta te ko Trai jong ngi, to pynim ia ngi na ka kti jong u, ba ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew kin tip ba me long U Trai, wat tang ma me hi .

en: And I will plant them upon their land , and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them , saith the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Ngan thung ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri ba nga la ai ïa ki , bad yn ym jynrat shuh ïa ki ,  U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan thung ia ki ha ka ri jong ki , bad kin ym shah tan shuh na ka ri jong ki kaba nga la ai ha ki , ong U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :
kha: Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba nga la ju im mynba nga dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka balang U Blei bad nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynduh noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la iohsngew ia ka jingiakren jong nga ha ki por ba la leit noh ha ka niam Jiw , kumno kata ka long kaba palat ia ka jingthew nga la pynshitom bein ia ka balang U Blei , bad nga la pynsyrwa kai ia ka:

en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .
kha: Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses , ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ain bad ki jingbishar bad ki ain kiba U Trai u la leh hapdeng jong u bad ki khun Israel ha u lum Sinai da ka kti u Moses .

en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
kha: Nalor jong ka Hebron ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la ai ha ki khun u Aaron u lyngdoh u Hebron ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka, ban long ka shnong rieh tngen na ka bynta u nongrep ; bad ka Libna ryngkat bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka .

en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
kha: U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew lai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka por ba u la synshar ia ki Israel ka long sawphew snem; hynriew snem u la synshar ia u ha Jerusalem .

en: And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .
kha: Sah ha kata kajuh ka ïing , bam bad dih ïa kano kano kaba ki ai ïa phi , naba u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong jong u . Wat leit sawdong na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kajuh ka iing sah, ka bam bad dih ia kiei kiei kiba ki ai: namar u nongtrei u long uba bit ban siew ia ka bainong jong u . Wat leit na iing sha iing .

en: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron , and to his sons , according to all things which I have commanded thee : seven days shalt thou consecrate them .
kha: Leh ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u hynñiew sngi lynter kumba nga la hukum ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta to leh ia u Aaron bad ia ki khun shynrang jong u kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia me: hynriew sngi to pynkyntang ia ki .

en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up , for to shew in thee my power  ; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth .
kha: Hynrei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ka bor jong nga , nga la shah ba men dang im , khnang ba yn ïoh pynbna ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka kam kaba shisha na ka bynta kane ka daw nga la pynmih ia me, namar ban pyni ha me ia ka bor jong nga ; bad ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan shah pynbna ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .
kha: Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ; ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki bym shym la shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kim shym la iohsngew , hynrei ki la pynkhlain ia ki ryndang jong ki kum ka ryndang jong ki kpa jong ki , ki bym ngeit ha U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba duna ha kita ki jingri , lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano kano ka jingduna , phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada don kano kano ka jingduna ha ka , kumba ka long kaba lyngngoh ne kaba matlah ne kaba don kano kano ka jingduna kaba sniew , wat knia ia ka ha U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall .
kha: Mynta la pynjot ïa pha ha ka duriaw ; pha la ngam sha ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah . Ki mar jong pha bad baroh kiba la trei na ka bynta jong pha ki la jah noh ryngkat bad pha ha ka duriaw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba me shah pynpra ha ki duriaw ha ka jingjylliew jong ki um bad ka kynhun jong me baroh hapdeng jong me kan hap .

en: And over these three presidents  ; of whom Daniel was first : that the princes might give accounts unto them , and the king should have no damage .
kha: Shuh shuh u la thung ïa u Daniel bad ar ngut kiwei pat ban khmih ïa ki lat bad ban khmih halor ki jingkwah jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor kine ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba u Daniel u la long nyngkong: ba ki rangbah kin ai jingkhein ia ki, bad u syiem un ym don jingma ei ei .

en: But I keep under my body , and bring it into subjection : lest that by any means , when I have preached to others , I myself should be a castaway .
kha: Nga pyneh ïa la ka met da ki jingshahkura bad nga pyndem ïa ka hapoh ka bor synshar lade , ban sumar ïa lade na kaba shah kyntait hadien ba nga la khot ïa kiwei sha ka jingïakhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga buh hapoh ka met jong nga, bad nga wanrah ia ka ha ka jingshah pyndem: ioh ba da kano kano ka rukom, haba nga la ialap ha kiwei pat, nga hi nga dei ban long u nonglehkai .

en: And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ka ba-ha-ïing jong pha , ka Elisabeth . Ïa kaba la ong ba kam lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei mynta ka la hynriew bnai ka jingpunkhun , wat la ka la long kaba la tymmen bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka para jong me, ka la pun khun ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka: bad kane ka long ka taiew kaba hynriew bad ka , kaba la khot khlem khun .

en: Remember thy servants , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob  ; look not unto the stubbornness of this people , nor to their wickedness , nor to their sin :
kha: Kynmaw ïa la ki shakri , ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad wat thew ïa ka jingmutlop , ka jingbymman , bad ka pop jong une u paidlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ki shakri jong me, u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Jakob; wat peit ia ka jinglong sting jong une u briew, ne ia ka jingsniew jong ki, ne ia ka pop jong ki:

en: And when he was gone out into the porch , another maid saw him , and said unto them that were there , This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth .
kha: bad u la leit noh sha ka jaka rung shapoh ka phyllaw . Kawei pat ka shakri ka la ïohi ïa u bad ka la ong ha ki rangbah hangta ,  U la long lem bad U Jisu u nong Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit shabar shapoh ka phyllaw, kawei pat ka nongtrei ka la iohi ia u bad ka la ong ha ki kiba don hangta, Une u paralok ruh u la don bad U Jisu na Nazareth .

en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .
kha: Hynrei um kheiñ kor ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba ïaheh ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la iehnoh ia ka jingai jingmut kaba ki rangbah ki la ai ha u , bad u la iamir jingmut bad ki samla kiba la pynsan pynrangbah bad u , kiba ieng ha khmat jong u .

en: Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
kha: Shahshkor ! Nga la ai ha phi ka bor , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaid halor ki bseiñ bad ki  ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kano kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga ai bor ia phi ban iaid halor ki bsein bad ki khnai , bad halor ka bor jong u nongshun baroh: bad ym don ei ei kaba pynmong ia phi da kano kano ka rukom .

en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times , and anointed the altar and all his vessels , both the laver and his foot , to sanctify them .
kha: U shim ruh khyndiat na kata ka umphniang bad u synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha ka duwan bad ki tiar jong ka baroh , bad ha ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka , khnang ban pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la theh ia ka ha ka almari hynriew sien, bad u la pynsleh ia ka almari bad ki tiar jong u baroh , baroh ar ki khniang bad ka kjat jong u , ban pynkyntang ia ki .

en: Go now to the flock , and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats  ; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father , such as he loveth :
kha: Khie leit sha ka kynhun blang bad to shim ar tylli ki khunblang kiba sngaid , khnang ba ngan ïoh shet ïa ki bad khreh katto katne ïa kato ka jingbam kaba i pa jong phi i bang eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit mynta sha ka kynhun langbrot , bad to shim ia nga naduh kata ka por arngut ki khun kiba bha jong ki blang ; bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban bam doh na ka bynta u kpa jong me kumba u ieit:

en: Neither did we eat any man s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :
kha: Ngim shym la pdiang ïa ka jingkyrshan jongno jongno khlem da siewdor ïa ka . Pynban , ngi la trei bad minot thop ; ngi ïai trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ban ym long ka jingbankhia ïano ïano na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngim shym la bam ia uno uno u briew na ka bynta ka jingbam ba la shet lypa hynrei ngi la trei shitom miet bad sngi , ba ngin ym shah kynnoh ha uno uno na phi:

en: For thou , O my God , hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house : therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee .
kha: Nga don ka jingshlur ban duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai ha me , U Blei jong nga , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane ha nga , u shakri jong me , bad ba me la ong ïa nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa kiba hiarpateng na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta me, ko Blei jong nga, me la iathuh ha u shakri jong me ba men tei ia u iing: namarkata u shakri jong me u la shem ha ka dohnud jong u ban duwai ha khmat jong me .

en: The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmie , namar mem dei ban pynjahburom ïa la ka jong ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong me, ne ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka kmie jong me, wat plie: ka long ka kmie jong me ; wat plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka .

en: And it shall be , when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people , that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people .
kha: Ynda kita ki rangbah synshar ki la dep kren ha uta u paidïapom , sa jied ïa ki nongïalam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynhun shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ynda ki ophisar ki la dep ban kren ha ki briew , ba kin pynlong ia ki rangbah shipai ban ialam ia ki briew .

en: And the  Lord  commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba phi dei ban sumar bad leh ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la hukum ia nga ha kata ka por ban hikai ia phi ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar , ba phin leh ia ki ha ka ri kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: But these are written , that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ , the Son of God  ; and that believing ye might have life through his name .
kha: Hynrei ïa kine la thoh khnang ba phin ïoh ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , bad da kaba ngeit ha u phin ïoh ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kine la thoh , ba phin ngeit ba U Jisu U long U Khrist U Khun U Blei bad ba da kaba ngeit phi lah ban ioh ia ka jingim lyngba ka kyrteng jong u .

en: Which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi , which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Janna , which was the son of Joseph ,
kha: u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi , u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Jannai , u khun jong u Joseph ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Mathai, uba long u khun u Lebi, uba long u khun u Melchi, uba long u khun u Janna uba long u khun u Joseph .

en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .
kha: Bad ngi la kyrmen ba un dei ma u uta u ban sa wan ban pyllaitluid ïa ki Israel ! Nalor kata baroh , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba ka la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi la shaniah ba dei ma u uba la dei ban siewspah ia ki Israel: bad nalor kine baroh, haduh mynta ka sngi ka long ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba la leh ia kine kiei kiei .

en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .
kha: Kito kiba long ki mraw ki dei ban ñiew ba ki kynrad jong ki , ki long kiba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom baroh , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ki ban kren sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki shakri kiba bun kiba don hapoh ka yoke kin khein ia la ki jong ki kynrad kiba dei hok ban ioh ia ka burom baroh , ba ka kyrteng U Blei bad ka jinghikai jong u kan ym shah pynjah burom .

en: And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee .
kha: Une u maw buh jingkynmaw ïa uba nga la thung un long ka jaka ha kaba ïa me yn mane , bad ngan ai sha me ïa kaba shiphew na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad une u maw uba nga la buh kum u maw, un long ka iing U Blei: bad na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ha nga ngan ai shisha ia ka shiphew ha me .

en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .
kha: Hukum ïa ki ban lum ïa ka bam baroh ha kine ki snem kiba pahuh , bad ai bor ïa ki ban kynshew ïa u kew ha ki nongbah bad ban da buh nongap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ai ba kin lum ia ki jingbam baroh jong kita ki snem kiba bha ki ban wan , bad kin buh ia u kew hapoh ka kti u Pharaoh , bad ai ba kin buh jingbam ha ki nongbah .

en: And Joab said , As God liveth , unless thou hadst spoken , surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother .
kha: Nga smai da U Blei uba im ,  u Joab u jubab ,  ba lada mem shym la kren , ki rangbah jong nga kin jin da la ïai beh kthong ïa me haduh lashai mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ong , Kumba U Blei u im, lymda me la kren, shisha ha kata ka por mynstep ki briew ki la leit shaneng uwei pa uwei na kaba bud ia la u hynmen .

en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .
kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw kiba pynsaja ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Ki Israel ki tei ïa ki nongbah Pithom bad Rameses ba kin long ki jaka kynshew jingbam u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la buh halor jong ki ki nongtrei ban pynshitom ia ki da ki jingkit jong ki . Bad ki la tei ia ki nongbah spah jong u Pharaoh , u Pithom bad u Rameses .

en: For this Melchisedec , king of Salem , priest of the most high God , who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings , and blessed him  ;
kha: Une u Melkhisedek u la long u syiem jong ka Salem bad u lyngdoh jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Katba u Abraham u dang wan phai na ka thma ha kaba u la jop ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem , u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrkhu ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka Melchisedec , u syiem Salem , u lyngdoh jong U Blei uba ha khlieh duh , uba la iakynduh ia u Abraham uba wan phai na ka jingpyniap ia ki syiem , bad u la kyrkhu ia u;

en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei uba iohsngew ia kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bym leh ia ki, un ianujor bad u briew uba bieit uba la tei ia ka iing jong u halor ka dewbilat:

en: But ye , O mountains of Israel , ye shall shoot forth your branches , and yield your fruit to my people of Israel  ; for they are at hand to come .
kha: Hynrei ha ki lumbah ka Israel ki dieng kin sei biang ki sla bad pynmih soh na ka bynta jong phi , ki briew jong nga , ki Israel . Phi la jan ban wan noh sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi, ko lum Israel, phin sa mih noh ki tnat jong phi bad phin ai ia ki soh jong phi ha ki briew jong nga; namar ki la jan wan .

en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rud duriaw u kyndit ïa ka kupar jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ki dulir kin sngew lyngngoh ia me , bad ki syiem jong ki kin tieng shibun , kin sa sngewsih ha ka khmat jong ki .

en: Dearly beloved , avenge not yourselves , but rather give place unto wrath : for it is written , Vengeance is mine ; I will repay , saith the Lord .
kha: Wat ju pynhiarkput , ko ki paralok jong nga , hynrei pynban , to ai ba ka jingbitar jong U Blei kan leh ïa kata . Namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang , ong U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko baieit baieit, wat pynshitom ia lade, hynrei kham bha ban ai jaka ia ka jingbitar: namar la thoh: Ka jingleh be-ijot ka long ka jong nga; ngan siew kylliang ia ka, ong U Trai .

en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .
kha: Mynta , U Blei u la pynlong ïa ki jingkular jong u ha u Abraham bad ha u nonghiarpateng jong u . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kam shym pyndonkam da ki kyntien  ki nonghiarpateng ,  kaba thew shibun ki briew , hynrei ka pyndonkam da ka kyntien  u nonghiarpateng ,  kaba mut tang uwei u briew , kaba mut U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha u Abraham bad u symbai jong u ki long ki jingkular ba la leh . Um ong , Bad ia ki symbai , kumba bun ; hynrei kum uwei , Bad ia u symbai jong me uba long U Khrist .

en: The altar also was rent , and the ashes poured out from the altar , according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the  Lord .
kha: Ka duwan ka pra phum , bad ïa u dpei la pynsaphred ha madan , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u la kren lypa ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka altar ruh ka la tyrkhong , bad ka dewbilat ka la tuid na ka altar , kat kum ka dak kaba u briew U Blei u la ai da ka ktien U Trai .

en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .
kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki bad pynïap ïa ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul : u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la bud jur ia u Saul bad ia ki khun shynrang jong u; bad ki Philistia ki la pyniap ia u Jonathan, bad u Abinadab, bad u Malchishua, ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs , and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell . Arise , my love , my fair one , and come away .
kha: Uba ieit jong nga u don ka jingiw jong ka mirr haba u dem halor ka shadem jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U dieng sohjew u pynmih ia ki sohjew kiba jyrngam jong ka, bad ki sohjew kiba don u sohjew kiba jem ki ai ka jingsma kaba bha . To khie, ko jingieit jong nga, ko ba itynnad jong nga, bad to wan noh .

en: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him , even with Gedaliah , at Mizpah , and the Chaldeans that were found there , and the men of war .
kha: U Ishmael ruh u la pynïap ïa ki Israel baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki shipai Babilon kiba jia ryngkhat ki don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishmael ruh u la pyniap ia ki Jiw baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, wat bad u Gedaliah, ha Mizpah, bad ki Khaldi kiba la lap hangta, bad ki shipai .

en: And I have oxen , and asses , flocks , and menservants , and womenservants : and I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find grace in thy sight .
kha: Nga don ki masi , ki kada , ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki mraw . Nga phah ktien sha phi ko kynrad da ka jingkyrmen ba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga don ki masi, bad ki kada, ki langbrot bad ki nongshakri kynthei: bad nga la phah ban iathuh ha u kynrad jong nga, ba ngan shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me .

en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel :  Khie leit bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba khraw na ka tempi kaba ong ha ki hynriew ngut ki angel , To leit noh ia ki lynti jong phi bad to theh ia ki vial jong ka jingbitar U Blei halor ka khyndew .

en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew ha ka lieng bad ban nang leit sha shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la khang ia ki synran jong u ban kiew lieng bad ban leit sha kawei pat ka liang katba u dang phah noh ia ki paidbah .

en: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused  ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka jingïalang baroh kawei ka la don ha ka jingkhynwin : Katto katne ngut ki briew ki pyrta ïa kawei , kiwei ki pyrta ïa kawei pat , namar kiba bun na ki kim da tip balei ba ki la ïawan lumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Don kiba la pyrta namarkata kawei ka jingjia , bad uwei pat: namar ka jingiaseng ka la sngewthuh bakla ; bad ka bynta kaba kham bun kam tip balei ki la iawan lang .

en: And he said unto them ,  Which of you shall have a friend , and shall go unto him at midnight , and say unto him , Friend , lend me three loaves  ;
kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Tharai uwei na phi un leit sha ka ïing u paralok jong phi ha ka por shiteng synñia bad ong ha u , ‘ Ko paralok , ai kylliang ïa nga lai tylli ki lyngkhot kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Uno uno na phi un don u paralok bad un leit sha u ha ka por shiteng miet bad un ong ha u, Paralok, ai ram ia nga lai tylli ki kpu ; .

en: Which was the son of Simeon , which was the son of Juda , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Jonan , which was the son of Eliakim ,
kha: u khun jong u Simeon , u khun jong u Judah , u khun jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jonam , u khun jong u Eliakim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Simeon uba long u khun u Judah uba long u khun u Joseph uba long u khun u Jonan uba long u khun u Eliakim .

en: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
kha: Nangta u la wan sha Akhaïa , ha kaba u la sah lai bnai . U la khreh ban leit sha Syria haba u la shem ba ki la don ki Jiw kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ; kumta u la kut jingmut ban leit phai pat lyngba ka Makedonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ka sah lai bnai . Bad haba ki Jiw ki la ap ia u, katba u dang thmu ban leit sha Syria , u la thmu ban wan phai lyngba ka Makedonia .

en: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches , and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it .
kha: Teh ïa kiwei pat ki tduh jong kita ki kynjri ha ki ar tylli ki shrong , bad ha kane ka rukom pynsnoh ïa ki sha khmat ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ki ar tylli ki kynjri ba la khleh lang me dei ban pynskhem ha ki ar tylli ki tyrpeng , bad buh ia ki ha ki tyrpeng jong ka ephod ha khmat jong ka .

en: And you , being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh , hath he quickened together with him , having forgiven you all trespasses ;
kha: Phi la long ha kawei ka por kiba la ïap ha kaba kynja mynsiem namar ki pop jong phi bad namar ba phi la long ki Jentil kiba khlem ka Hukum . Hynrei U Blei mynta u la wallam ïa phi sha ka jingim bad U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi, haba phi la iap ha ki pop jong phi bad ka jingbymkhuid jong ka doh jong phi, u la nang kloi bad u, haba u la map ia phi baroh ki jingleh bymman;

en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .
kha: U Abner bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Them Jordan baroh shi miet ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan , bad hadien ba ki la ïaid baroh shi step ha ka step kaba bud , ki la wan poi biang ha Mahanaim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner bad ki briew jong u ki la iaid baroh shi miet lyngba ka madan bad ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan bad ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Bithron baroh kawei bad ki la poi ha Mahanaim .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
kha: Shi sngi hadien ka thma ki Philistia ki leit ban lute na ki metïap , ki lap ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut ba ki thiah ïap ha Lum Gilboa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, haba ki Philistia ki la wan ban pynduh ia u nongshah pyniap, ba ki la lap ia u Saul bad ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u ki la hap ha u lum Gilboa .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are as graves which appear not , and the men that walk over them are not aware of them .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi long kum ki lum jingtep ki bym don dien shuh ha kaba ki briew ki ïaid nalor khlem tip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi long kum ki jingtep ki bym paw , bad ki briew kiba iaid halor jong ki kim tip ia ki .

en: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light : they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death , upon them hath the light shined .
kha: Ki briew kiba la ïaid ha ka jingdum ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ki la shong ha ka ri jong ki syrngiew , hynrei mynta ka jingshai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba iaid ha ka jingdum ki la iohi ia ka jingshai kaba khraw: kita kiba shong ha ka ri ka jingdum jong ka jingiap, halor jong ki ka jingshai ka la shai .

en: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews : wherefore I beseech thee to hear me patiently .
kha: khamtam naduh kaba phi tip bha ïa ki dustur bad ïa ki jingïakajia baroh jong ki Jiw . Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , ban shahshkor ïa nga da ka jingïaishah .
translated_en_to_kha: Khamtam namar nga tip ia me ba me long uba stad ha ki riti dustur bad ki jingkylli baroh kiba don hapdeng ki Jiw: namar kata nga kyrpad ia me ban sngap ia nga da ka jingsbun .

en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :
kha: Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad ki la sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na kata ka jaka ki la leit shaphang shatei sha Jaser ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid lyngba ia ka wah Jordan bad ki la iaid ha Aroer, ha ka liang kadiang jong ka shnong kaba don hapdeng ka wah Gad bad sha ka wah Jazer:

en: Damascus is waxed feeble , and turneth herself to flee , and fear hath seized on her : anguish and sorrows have taken her , as a woman in travail .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki long kiba tlot bad ki la phet ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki don ha ka jingud bad jingjynjar kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Damaskos ka la kylla long kaba tlot, bad ka phai noh sha ka jingphetwir, bad ka jingtieng ka la bat ia ka: ka jingsngewsih bad ki jingsngewsih ki la shim ia ka, kum ka kynthei ha ka jingkha khun .

en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ka dei ka theisamla nongwei kaba la wan phai na Moab bad ka Naomi .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri uba la shah set halor ki nongot u la jubab bad u la ong: Ka dei ka dam kaba la wan phai bad ka Naomi na ka ri Moab:

en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .
kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei na kine ki khynnah rit , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ym tang ïa nga hynrei ïa uta ruh uba la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ia uwei na kita ki khun ha ka kyrteng jong nga: bad uno uno uba pdiang ia nga , um pdiang ia nga , hynrei uta uba la phah ia nga .

en: But he went in , and stood before his master . And Elisha said unto him , Whence comest thou , Gehazi ? And he said , Thy servant went no whither .
kha: U la leit pat shapoh ïing , bad u Elisha u kylli ïa u ,  Shano me leit ?   Ngam shym leit shano shano , kynrad ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la rung shapoh bad u la ieng ha khmat u kynrad jong u . U Elisha u la ong ha u, Naei me wan, ko Ghazi ? Bad u la ong, U shakri jong me um leit shano shano ruh .

en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: La pynsleh bad la pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh laiphew snem shaneng wat haduh sanphew snem , baroh kiba rung ha ka jaka ri jingri , ban leh ia ka kam ha ka iingjain jong ka balang .

en: Instead of retiring such ships , some countries may opt to use them as carriers for aircrafts used in small scale weather modification operations .
kha: Ha ka jaka ban pynsangeh noh ia kum kine ki lieng , don ki ri kiba lah ban jied ban pyndonkam ia ki kum ki nongkit ia ki liengsuin ba pyndonkam ha ki kam pynkylla ia ka suinbneng kiba rit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jaka ban shongthait noh ia kum kine ki lieng , katto katne ki ri ki lah ban jied ban pyndonkam ia ki kum ki nongkit liengsuin ba la pyndonkam ha ki kam pynkylla ia ka jinglong ka suinbneng kiba rit .

en: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them .
kha: Nga la ring ïa ki sha nga da ka jingsngewieit bad ka jingieit . Nga la rah ïa ki bad pyndei ïa ki ha ka ngab jong nga . Nga la dem sha ki bad nga la bsa ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ring ia ki da ki lynti jong u briew, da ki kynhun jingieit: bad nga la long ha ki kumba ki weng noh ia ka lyngkhot ha ki bniat jong ki , bad nga la buh doh ha ki .

en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .
kha: Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khraw ka jingpang jong nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khuid ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kaei kaba u hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta lada nga dang don ka jingpyntngen yes , ngan pynkhlain ia lade ha ka jingsngewsih: wat ai ba un ym lait na u ; namar ngam shym la buhrieh ia ki ktien jong Uba khuid .

en: In his days Judah shall be saved , and Israel shall dwell safely : and this is his name whereby he shall be called , THE  Lord  OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .
kha: Haba u long syiem , ki paid Judah kin shongshngain bad ki paid Israel kin im ha ka jingsuk . Yn khot ïa u , ‘ U  Trai  ka jingpynim jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u u Judah un ioh jingpynim, bad ki Israel kin shong shngain: bad kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u ha kaba yn khot ia u: U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai

en: Take counsel , execute judgment  ; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday  ; hide the outcasts  ; bewray not him that wandereth .
kha: Ki ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah ,  Ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh . To ïada ïa ngi kum u dieng uba shat syrngiew tngen ha ka jingshit jong ka shiteng sngi , bad shah ïa ngi ban pynjahthait ha ka jingda jong me . Ngi long ki phetwir ; to buhrieh ïa ngi ha ka jaka ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shem ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim jingmut, pynlong ia ka jingbishar jong me kum ka jingdum jong me kum ka miet hapdeng ka por shiteng sngi; buhrieh ia ki briew kiba la shah beh; wat ia uta uba iaid kai .

en: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki la pynïap ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki la pynlong syiem u Josaïah u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka ri ki la pyniap ia kito baroh kiba la thmu pyrshah ia u syiem Amon bad ki briew jong ka ri ki la pynlong ia u khun jong u u Josiah ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .
kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla , kaba long ka dak kaba khuid jong ka jingpynkyntang , bad ki thoh ha ka ,  La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la shna ia ka pliang jong ka khlieh ksiar kaba khuid, bad ki la thoh ha ka ka jingthoh, kum ki jingthoh jong ka dak , KA JINGPYNBNA IA U Trai .

en: Which was the son of Aminadab , which was the son of Aram , which was the son of Esrom , which was the son of Phares , which was the son of Judah ,
kha: u khun jong u Amminadab , u khun jong u Admin , u khun jong u Arni , u khun jong u Hesron , u khun jong u Peres , u khun jong u Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Aminadab uba long u khun u Aram uba long u khun u Esrom uba long u khun u Phares uba long u khun u Judah .

en: Now therefore hearken unto their voice : howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them , and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them .
kha: Kumta , sngap ïa ki , tangba me dei ban maham jur ïa ki bad pynshai kumno kita ki syiem kin leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sngap ia ka sur jong ki: wat la katta ruh to pyrshah ia ki, bad to pyni ia ki ia ka rukom jong u syiem uba synshar halor jong ki .

en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phi la lum nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .  Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nyngkong eh na ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka ri jong me men wanrah sha ka iing U Trai U Blei jong me . Wat ju iohi ia u khun ha ka dud jong ka kmie jong u .

en: O  Lord  , for thy servant s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all this greatness , in making known all these great things .
kha: Ka long ka mon bad ka jingthmu jong me ban leh ïa kane ha nga bad ban pyn-i ha nga ïa ka jingkhraw jong nga ha ki por ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, namar u shakri jong me, bad kat kum ka dohnud jong me hi, me la leh ia kane ka jingkhraw baroh, ha kaba pyntip ia kine kiei kiei baroh kiba khraw .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee : begin to possess , that thou mayest inherit his land .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khmih shane , nga la aiti ïa u syiem Sihon bad ïa ka ri jong u ha phi ; knieh ïa ka ri jong u bad kam kynti ïa ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga: Ha khmih nga la sdang ban ai ia u Sihon bad ka ri jong u ha khmat jong me: sdang ban don, ba me lah ban hiar pateng ia ka ri jong u .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .
kha: Ynda ki jaitbynriew ki ïalumlang , ngan pynngat ïa me ha ka jar jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka jar sha ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ngan pynphriang ia ka net jong nga halor jong me da ka kynhun jong ki briew kiba bun ; bad kin wanrah ia me ha ka net jong nga .

en: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
kha: U paidbah byllien u la leit sha u Ïoannis ban shah pynbaptis ha u .  Phi ki bseiñ !  u la ong ha ki .  Mano ba la ong ïa phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u paidbah uba la wan sha ka jingshah pynbaptis na u , ko pateng jong ki khnai , uba la maham ia phi ban phet noh na ka jingbitar kaban sa wan ?

en: And he said , Take the arrows . And he took them . And he said unto the king of Israel , Smite upon the ground . And he smote thrice , and stayed .
kha: Nangta u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ban shim ïa ki khnam kiba dang sah bad pduh ïa ka khyndew da ki . U syiem u pduh ïa ka khyndew lai sien , bad nangta u sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, Shim ia ki khnam . Bad u la shim ia ki . Bad u la ong ha u syiem Israel: To sngap jar ia ka khyndew . Bad u la sngap jar bad u la sah .

en: Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :
kha: Ïa nga shimet , U  Trai  um shah da lei lei ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bha bad kaba dei ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ha nga , U Blei un khang ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai ha kaba sangeh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi : hynrei ngan hikai ia phi ia ka lynti kaba bha bad kaba dei:

en: And the ark of the  Lord  continued in the house of Obed–edom the Gittite three months : and the  Lord  blessed Obed–edom , and all his household .
kha: Ka la don hangta lai bnai , bad U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa u Obed Edom bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka synduk U Trai ka la bteng ha ka iing u Obeddom ka Gittite lai bnai: bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia u Obeddom bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei .

en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not even thus , O ye children of Israel ? saith the  Lord .
kha: Nga la jied katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong phi ban long ki nongïathuhlypa , bad katto katne na ki samla shynrang jong phi ban long ki Nasir . Hato kane kam long kaba shisha , ko ki paid Israel ? Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynmih ia ki khun shynrang jong phi na ka bynta ki nongiathuhlypa, bad na ki samla jong phi na ka bynta ki Nazareth . Hato kam long wat kumta ruh ko khun Israel ? ong U Trai .

en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .
kha: Kane ka mut ba ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka rukom , kim dei ki khun jong U Blei ; hynrei , ïa ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka jingkular U Blei , la ñiew kum ki nonghiarpateng bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka mut , Kito kiba long ki khun ka doh , kine kim dei ki khun U Blei : hynrei ki khun jong ka jingkular ki shah khein na ka bynta u symbai .

en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines . And the Philistines went up to Jezreel .
kha: Kumta ha ka step kaba bud u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki mihnoh dang step phyrngab ban leit phai sha ka ri ki Philistia , hynrei ki Philistia ki leit kiew sha Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la ieng dang step ban leit phai noh sha ka ri jong ki Philistia . Ki Philistia ki la leit sha Jesel .

en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .
kha: Un jop ïa ki bad un pynïap ïa ki , bad ki metïap jong ki kin shu sah ha ka surok bah jong kata ka nongbah bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai jong ki la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng pharshi jong kata ka nongbah ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki met iap jong ki kin thiah ha ka lynti jong ka nongbah kaba khraw , kaba la khot ha ka mynsiem bad ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba la sahnarphna ia U Trai jong ngi ruh .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , believe me , the hour cometh , when ye shall neither in this mountain , nor yet at Jerusalem , worship the Father .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  To ngeit ïa nga , ko ka briew , ba ka por kan poi haba ki briew kin ym mane ïa U Kpa halor une u lum ne ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ka, Ko kynthei, to ngeit ia nga, ka por ka wan, haba phin ym mane ia U Kpa ha une u lum, ne ha Jerusalem .

en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .
kha: Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la bam ei ei na ka namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingtim ka jong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew ki la wan shapoh khlaw, ha khmih, ka umsoh ka la hap ; hynrei ym don mano mano ruh ba buh ia la ka kti ha ka shyntur jong u: namar ki briew ki la tieng ia ka jingsmai .

en: And thou saidst , I shall be a lady for ever : so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart , neither didst remember the latter end of it .
kha: Pha pyrkhat ba phan ïailong ka syiem , bad pham shym la shim khia ïa kine kiei kiei lane pyrkhat kumno ba kine baroh kin kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ong , Ngan long ka kynthei junom: kumta me khlem buh ia kine kiei kiei ha ka dohnud jong me , lymne me kynmaw ia ka jingkut kaba hadien jong ka .

en: Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul , u la kem ïa u , bad u la hukum ban teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri . Nangta u la kylli ,  Uei une u briew , bad u la leh aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah u la wan hajan bad u la shim ia u bad u la hukum ia u ban shah teh da ki ar tylli ki kynjri ; bad u la dawa mano ba u long bad kaei kaba u la leh .

en: And Philip said , If thou believest with all thine heart , thou mayest . And he answered and said , I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God .
kha: U Philip u la ong ha u ,  Lah ban pynbaptis ïa me lada me ngeit da ka dohnud baroh .   Nga ngeit ,  u la jubab ;  nga ngeit ba U Jisu Khrist u long U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u la ong , Lada me ngeit da ka dohnud jong me baroh . U la jubab bad u la ong: Nga ngeit ba U Jisu Khrist U long U Khun U Blei .

en: Then said David , O  Lord  God of Israel , thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah , to destroy the city for my sake .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga la ïohsngew ba u Saul u pynkhreh ban wan sha Keilah bad ban pynjot ïa ka namar jong nga , u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong , Ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, u shakri jong me u la iohsngew shisha ba u Saul u wad ban wan sha Keilah, ban pynjot ia ka shnong na ka bynta jong nga .

en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also , who trusted in God , adorned themselves , being in subjection unto their own husbands :
kha: Naba ki kynthei bariewblei ha ki por ba la leit noh ki la buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei , ki ju pynbhabriew ïa lade da kaba pynkohnguh ha la ki tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hadien kane ka rukom ha ka por barim ki kynthei bakhuid ruh kiba shaniah ha U Blei ki la pynitynnad ia lade, ki la long kiba kohnguh ia la ki jong ki tnga:

en: Only the  Lord  give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ai ha me ka jingtip bad ka jingstad ba kumta me lah ban synshar ïa ka Israel kat kum ki Hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang U Trai u ai ia me ia ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh, bad u ai ia me ia me ia ka hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .
kha: Wat haba phi don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jingim jong phi kum ki bangeit , phi don tang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la phi don shi hajar ngut ki nonghikai ha U Khrist: namar ha U Khrist Jisu nga la kha ia phi lyngba ka gospel .

en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .
kha: Hadien kane , ki leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , bad ha ka ri ryngkhiang kaba shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ki khun Judah ki la hiar ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha u lum bad shaphang shathie bad ha ka them .

en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khun jong u Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u khun jong u Terah , u khun jong u Nahor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Jakob uba long u khun u Isaak uba long u khun u Abraham uba long u khun u Thara uba long u khun u Nahor .

en: And Judah went up  ; and the  Lord  delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand : and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men .
kha: bad Judah ki la leit ryngkat sha ka thma . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad ki la jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Besek .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la leit shaneng bad U Trai u la aiti ia ki nong Kana bad ki nong Perizz ha ka kti jong ki: bad ki la pyniap ia ki ha u Besek shi hajar ngut ki briew .

en: And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .
kha: Hangno u hap ?  u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u briew u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa uwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , bad u pynper ïa u khlieh sdie .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew jong U Blei u la ong, Hangno ka la hap ? Bad u la pyni ia u ia kata ka jaka . Bad u la ot ia u dieng bad u la bret ia u ha ka met; bad ka nar ka la jngi .

en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
kha: U Petros bad ki paralok jong u ki la ïohthiah lyngngai , hynrei ki la kyndit thiah bad ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Jisu bad ïa kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la ïeng lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la iohthiah lyngngai: bad haba ki la kyndit ki la iohi ia ka burom jong u bad ki arngut ki briew kiba ieng ryngkat bad u .

en: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;
kha: bad da kaba pynshahshkor ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïai phah sha phi . Phim pat ju kohnguh ïa kaei kaba ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban sngap ia ki ktien jong ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa kiba nga la phah sha phi, baroh arngut ki la khie dang step bad ki la phah ia ki, hynrei phim shym la sngap ; .

en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the third month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai jong ka snem kaba khatwei ha ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka shiphew snem, ha ka sngi kaba lai, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .
kha: Nga sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh nga dang dap hi da ka jingshlur ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba khraw ia ka jingkren jong nga shaphang jong phi, kaba khraw ka long ka jingpyndonburom jong nga ia phi: Nga dap da ka jingpyntngen , nga dap da ka jingkmen palat ha ka jingjynjar jong ngi baroh .

en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city , they smote the city with the edge of the sword  ; but they let go the man and all his family .
kha: Kumta u la pyn-i ïa ki , bad ki paid Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hapoh ka nongbah , lait tang une u briew bad ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pyni ia ki ia ka jingkhang shapoh ka shnong , ki la pynkhih ia ka shnong da ka tduh jong ka waitlam ; hynrei ki la pyllait noh ia uta u briew bad ia ka iing jong u baroh .

en: Then the priest shall come and look , and , behold , if the plague be spread in the house , it is a fretting leprosy in the house : it is unclean .
kha: Lada ka la pur , kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un wan peit bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam ka saphriang ha iing, ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba jur ha iing: ka long kaba khlem khuid .

en: Until the Ancient of days came , and judgment was given to the saints of the most High  ; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom .
kha: Nangta uta uba la im junom u la wan bad u la pynbna ïa ka jingbishar ha ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei ban pdiang ïa ka bor kaba kynja syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba u hyndai jong ki sngi u la wan , bad la ai ia ka jingbishar ha ki riewkhuid jong ka Hok Bakhraw tam bad ka por ka la poi ba ki riewkhuid ki la don ia ka hima .

en: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;
kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei , ïa uba nga shakri da ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la leh . Nga ainguh ïa u haba nga kynmaw ïa me borabor ha ki jingduwai jong nga mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ainguh ia U Blei uba nga shakri na ki kpa tymmen jong nga da ka jingsngewthuh kaba khuid, ba khlem sangeh nga kynmaw ia me ha ki jingduwai jong nga miet bad sngi;

en: Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ngan pyndonkam ïa ka nuksa kaba ju long man ka sngi : Haba ar ngut ki briew ki ïamynjur halor kano kano ka kam da kaba soi ïa ka soskular , ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lane pyndap ei ei ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit , nga kren katkum ka rukom jong ki briew ; Wat la ka long tang ka jutang briew, hynrei lada la pynskhem ia ka, ym don mano mano ruh kiba khlem akor, ne kiba pyndap ia ka.

en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .
kha: Katba ka jingïaleh ka dang bteng hapdeng ki kynhun jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ka dang don ka thma hapdeng ka iing u Saul bad ka iing u Dabid , ba u Abner u la pynskhem ia lade na ka bynta ka iing u Saul .

en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .
kha: U lap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap ba ki ïaid sakma , ka ri shyiap kaba kynjah . Ïa ki u sumar bad u ker u da , kumba u ïada ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shem ia u ha ka ri kaba rkhiang, bad ha ka ri kaba rkhiang u la ialam ia u kylleng kylleng, u la hikai ia u, u la bat ia u kum ka apple jong ka khmat jong u .

en: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .
kha: Pynïap ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba isaitmet ba ki ju leh haba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kumta ba phin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki hikai ia phi ban leh ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki baroh, kiba ki la leh ha ki blei jong ki ; kumta phi dei ban leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: Is any thing too hard for the  Lord  ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee , according to the time of life , and Sarah shall have a son .
kha: Hato don kaei kaei kaba eh ïa U  Trai  ? Kumba nga la ong , ngan sa wan biang hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don kaei kaei kaba eh palat ia U Trai ? Ha ka por ba la buh ngan wan phai sha me katkum ka por jong ka jingim , bad ka Sarah kan ioh khun shynrang .

en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la jied napdeng ki parabriew , bad la thung ban shakri ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki , ban ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ka jingainguh na ka bynta ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u rangbah lyngdoh uba la shim na ki briew u long uba la buh na ka bynta ki briew ha kiei kiei kiba iadei bad U Blei , ba un ai ia ki jingai sngewbha bad ki jingknia na ka bynta ki pop:

en: And I will multiply men upon you , all the house of Israel , even all of it : and the cities shall be inhabited , and the wastes shall be builded :
kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong phi . Phin sa shong ha ki nongbah bad tei pat ïa baroh kaba sah ha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbun ia ki briew ha phi, ka iing Israel baroh: bad ki nongbah kin shong bad ki jaboh kin long:

en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .
kha: Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , u la ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la pynkhih ia ka waitlam jong u shapoh khyndew , bad u la lum ia u sohjew jong ka khyndew bad u la bret ia u ha ka thliew sohjew kaba khraw jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

en: But he , being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,
kha: Hynrei u Stephan , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ïa U Jisu uba ïeng sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma u, haba u la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid, u la peit sha bneng bad u la iohi ia ka burom U Blei bad U Jisu uba ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei .

en: Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ka jingsawa , u paidbah babun u la ïalum . Ki la ïasngewtynnat , namar ba uwei pa uwei na ki u la ïohsngew ba ki riewngeit ki kren ha ka ktien jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la pynmih ia kane shabar ri, u paidbah u la iawan lang bad u la sngew lyngngoh namar ba uwei pa uwei u la iohsngew ia ki ba ki kren ha la ka jong ka ktien .

en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
kha: U briew uba bha u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba bha ; u briew uba sniew u sei ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha na ka spah kaba bha jong ka dohnud u wanrah ia kiei kiei kiba bha: bad u briew uba sniew na ka spah kaba sniew u wanrah ia kiei kiei kiba sniew .

en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?
kha: Hato ka long kaba dei ïa me ban lehbeiñ katne katne ? Ban ñiewbeiñ ïa uta uba me hi me la thaw ? Bad nangta ban phuh samrkhie ha ki jingthmu ki riewbymman ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long kaba bha ia me ba me dei ban shah pynshitom bein , ba me dei ban lehbein ia ka kam jong ki kti jong me bad ban shai halor ka jingmut jong ki bymman ?

en: And I said , Should such a man as I flee ? and who is there , that , being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in .
kha: Nga jubab ,  Ngam dei u briew uba shait phet bad rieh . Hato phi pyrkhat ba ngan pyrshang ban pynim ïa la ka jingim da kaba rieh ha ka Templ ? Ngan ym leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong: Hato u briew uba kum ma nga u dei ban phet noh ? bad mano ba don hangta , ba nga long kum ma nga , un leit shapoh ka tempi ban pynim ia ka jingim jong u ? Ngan ym leit rung .

en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God : for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them , and they have not known the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingsniew ba ki briew ki la leh , ka khanglad ïa ki ban wan phai sha U Blei jong ki . Ka jingmane bleithaw ka don ka jingbat bakhlaiñ ïa ki bad kim pdiang ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym pynlong ia ki jingleh jong ki ban phai sha U Blei jong ki: namar ka mynsiem jong ki nongkhaii met ka don hapdeng jong ki , bad kim shym la ithuh ia U Trai .

en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .
kha: Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong nga junom .  Kumta u ong U  Trai  uba pynim ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingbitar khyndiat nga buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na me tang shiphang ; hynrei da ka jingbha bymjukut ngan isynei ia me , ong U Trai jong me .

en: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated , so that no man went through thee , I will make thee an eternal excellency , a joy of many generations .
kha: Yn ym iehnoh beiñ bad isih shuh ïa pha , ka nongbah kaba la shah iehnoh beiñ bad kynjah . Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba khraw bad kaba itynnat , ka jaka jong ka jingkmen junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba me la shah iehnoh bad shah shun, haduh ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba iaid lyngba jong me, ngan pynlong ia me ka jingbha bymjukut, ka jingkmen jong kiba bun ki pateng .

en: And the  Lord  came down upon mount Sinai , on the top of the mount : and the  Lord  called Moses up to the top of the mount  ; and Moses went up .
kha: U  Trai  u wan hiar halor u Lum Sinai , bad u la khot ïa u Moses sha kliar jong u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wan hiar halor u lum Sinai, ha jrong jong u lum: bad U Trai u la khot ia u Moses haduh jrong jong u lum ; bad u Moses u la kiew .

en: For the  Lord  thy God bringeth thee into a good land , a land of brooks of water , of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills  ;
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba seisoh — ka ri kaba don ki wah , ki pukri , bad ki umpohliew kiba tuid ha ki them bad ki lum ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u wanrah ia me sha ka ri kaba bha, ka ri jong ki wah um, ki pung um bad ki jingjylliew kiba mih na ki them bad ki lum ;

en: But he held his peace , and answered nothing . Again the high priest asked him , and said unto him , Art thou the Christ , the Son of the Blessed ?
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la sngap jar bad um ong shikyntien ruh . U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli biang ïa u ,  Hato me long U Messaïah , U Khun jong U Blei ba la kyrkhu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u, bad um shym la jubab ei ei . Sa shisien u rangbah lyngdoh u la kylli ia u bad u la ong ha u: Me long U Khrist U Khun jong Uba la kyrkhu ?

en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .
kha: U briew uba mutlop u long uba sniew bad u leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad ban khanglad ïa ki ban ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tiar ruh jong ka jingkhih ki long kiba sniew: u thmu ia ki buit kiba sniew ban pynjot ia kiba duk da ki ktien kiba thok , wat haba kiba donkam ki kren beit .

en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :
kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Eleasar , u Joshua , bad ha kiwei pat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta shaphang jong ki u Moses u la hukum ia u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad u Joshua u khun u Nun bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki Israel:

en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre  ;
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u , u Isaak bad u Ishmael , ki la tep ïa u ha ka krem Makhpelah , kaba ha ka lyngkha kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , kaba dei ka jong u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar u nong Hit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u u Isaak bad u Ishmael ki la tep ia u ha ka krem Machpelah, ha ka lyngkha u Ephron u khun u Sohar u Hitit, kaba don ha khmat u Mamre ; .

en: For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .
kha: ‘ Nga ong ha phi ,’ u la jubab , ‘ ba ha uno uno u briew uba don ei ei , yn ai kham bun shuh shuh ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba rit kaba u don yn shim noh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , Ba ha uno uno uba la shah ai ; bad na uta u bym don , wat ia uta ruh yn weng noh na u .

en: And hath gone and served other gods , and worshipped them , either the sun , or moon , or any of the host of heaven , which I have not commanded  ;
kha: da kaba mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , lane ïa ka sngi , lane ïa u bnai , lane ïa ki khlur , kaba long pyrshah ïa ka hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leit bad shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, bad u la mane ia ki, la ka sngi ne u bnai ne uno uno na ki kynhun bneng kiba ngam shym la hukum;

en: And when they had fulfilled the days , as they returned , the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem  ; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it .
kha: Haba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , ki la khreh ban leit phai noh sha ïing , hynrei u khynnah Jisu u la sah ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pyndep ia ki sngi, katba ki dang wan phai, u khynnah Jisu u la sah shadien ha Jerusalem ; bad u Joseph bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ia kata .

en: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .
kha: Ka burom jong u kan kah ïa ka nongbah na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kaba shngain , kaba la da na u slap bad ka  erïong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don ka jaka sah ha ka por mynstep na ka jingshit , bad na ka bynta ka jaka rieh tngen bad na u slap .

en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ki baroh kin wanrah ïa la ki sdie , kin pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba itynnat bad kin bret ïa ki ha ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynkhreh ia ki nongpynjot pyrshah ia me, uwei pa uwei bad ki tiar ialeh jong u: bad kin ot ia ki diengsoh ba la jied jong me, bad kin bret ia ki ha ka ding .

en: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ ? shall tribulation , or distress , or persecution , or famine , or nakedness , or peril , or sword ?
kha: Uei te , uba lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit U Khrist ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka lah , lane ka jingshitom lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ lane ka jingthngan lane ka jingduk lane ka jingma lane ka jingïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba pyniakhlad ia ngi na ka jingieit U Khrist ? ka jingjynjar ne ka jingjynjar ne ka jingshah pynshitom bein ne ka jingkyrduh ne ka jingkyrduh ne ka jingkyrduh ne ka jingma ne ka waitlam ?

en: He that cometh from above is above all : he that is of the earth is earthly , and speaketh of the earth : he that cometh from heaven is above all .
kha: Uta uba wan na bneng u kham khraw ban ïa baroh . Uta uba wan na ka pyrthei u dei u jong ka pyrthei bad u kren shaphang kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka pyrthei , hynrei uta uba wan na bneng u long halor baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba wan na jrong u long halor jong baroh: uta uba na ka khyndew u long uba na ka khyndew: uta uba wan na bneng u long halor jong baroh .

en: And they said , Is not this Jesus , the son of Joseph , whose father and mother we know ? how is it then that he saith ,  I came down from heaven ?
kha: Kumta ki la ong ,  Hato une u briew um dei U Jisu , u khun jong u Joseph ? Ngi ithuh ïa u kpa bad ïa ka kmie jong u . Kumno te , ba u ong mynta ba u la wan hiar na bneng ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Hato une u Jisu u khun u Joseph, uba ngi ithuh ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong u ? kumno te ba u ong: Nga la wan hiar na bneng ?

en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the  Lord  gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .
kha: Ho-oid , hadien kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thoh ïa kata ka jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , ba U Trai u la ai ha nga ia ki ar tylli ki miej maw , wat ia ki miej jong ka jutang .

en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me uba skhem kum u mawsiang , uba eh kum u diamond ; wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka khlieh kaba kham eh ban ia ka khlieh jong me: wat tieng ia ki, wat nym sngewsih ia ki khmat jong ki, wat la ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people  ; ( for he was above all the people  ; ) and when he opened it , all the people stood up :
kha: Katba u Esra u ïeng hangta ha ka jaka bakynjang ba kham hajrong ïa u paidbah , ki khmat jong ki , ki peit beit sha u . Tang shu plied ïa ka kitab , baroh ki ïa-ïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esra u la plie ia ka Kitab ha khmat ki briew baroh ; (namar u la don halor ki briew baroh ; ) bad haba u la plie ia ka, ki briew baroh ki la ieng:
