en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .
kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa u briew uba la matlah bad u bymnang kren namar u la shongksuid . U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa u briew , ba kumta u la lah ban kren bad ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wanrah ha u ia u ksuid uba matlah bad uba dum: bad u la pynkoit ia u, khlem da pyrkhat ba uba matlah bad uba dum baroh arngut u la kren bad u la iohi .

en: Then Samuel took a stone , and set it between Mizpah and Shen , and called the name of it Eben–ezer , saying , Hitherto hath the  Lord  helped us .
kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim uwei u maw , u pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ka Mispah bad ka Shen , bad ong ,  U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ngi baroh shi lynter lynti  — bad u la pynkyrteng ïa u ,  u maw ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la shim ia u maw, bad u la buh ia u hapdeng ka Mizpah bad u Shen, bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka u Ebenezer, u da ong: Haduh mynta U Trai u la iarap ia ngi .

en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another : the breadth was five and twenty cubits , door against door .
kha: Nangta u la thew sa ïa ka jingjngai ka kynroh kaba nadien kawei ka kamra shaduh ka kynroh kaba shadien jong kawei pat ka kamra lyngba ka lynti ïaid na ka , bad ka long khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thew nangta ia ka khyrdop naduh ka tnum jong kawei ka kamra kaba rit haduh ka tnum jong kawei pat: ka jingjrong ka long sanphew cubit, ka jingkhang pyrshah ia ka jingkhang .

en: He shall recount his worthies : they shall stumble in their walk  ; they shall make haste to the wall thereof , and the defence shall be prepared .
kha: La phah khot ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam ; ki jynthut katba ki dang tur sha khmat . Ki nongtur ïaleh ki tur sha ka kynroh bad ki pynap ïa ki stieh na ka bynta u dieng pynpra kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Un iathuh biang ia ki jingkren bein jong u: kin ia tyngkhuh ha ka jingleit jong ki ; kin pynkloi ia ka jingkhang jong ka, bad ka jingiada kan long kaba la pynkhreh .

en: They shall not labour in vain , nor bring forth for trouble  ; for they are the seed of the blessed of the  Lord  , and their offspring with them .
kha: Ki jingtrei ba kin trei kin manbha , bad ki khun jong ki kin ym mad ïa ka jingjynjar . Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ha ki por ki ban wan baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym trei khlem jingmyntoi shuh shuh, lymne kin ym wanrah ia ka jingeh ha ka por ba la kyrkhu ia ki da u Trai bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki bad ki .

en: And I say unto thee , Let my son go , that he may serve me : and if thou refuse to let him go , behold , I will slay thy son , even thy firstborn .
kha: Nga la ong ïa me ban shah ïa u khun jong nga ban leit , khnang ba un ïoh mane ïa nga , hynrei me la kyntait . Mynta te ngan pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha me, To ai ba u khun jong nga un leit noh, ba un shakri ia nga: bad lada me kyntait ban pyllait noh ia u, ha khmih ngan pyniap ia u khun nyngkong jong me .

en: And our adversaries said , They shall not know , neither see , till we come in the midst among them , and slay them , and cause the work to cease .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki pyrkhat ba ngin ym ïohi ïa ki ne tip ïa kaei kaba jia haduh ba ki la long halor jong ngi , ban pynïap ïa ngi bad ban pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongshun jong ngi ki la ong , Kin ym tip , lymne kin ym iohi , haduh ba ngin da wan hapdeng jong ki , bad ngin pyniap ia ki , bad pynlong ia ka kam ban sangeh noh .

en: Thus were their faces : and their wings were stretched upward  ; two wings of every one were joined one to another , and two covered their bodies .
kha: Ïa ki ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw la rah shajrong kumta ba ki dei ïa ki khmut thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-marsyndah , bad ki ar tylli ki thapniang ki tap ïa ki met jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khmat jong ki ki la nang kiew shaneng; bad ki bniat jong ki ki la nang kiew shaneng; ar tylli ki bniat jong ki ki la iasoh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
kha: Wallam man ka snem sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa u soh nyngkong uba phi ot .  Wat shet ïa u khunblang ne khunlangbrot ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nyngkong eh na ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka ri jong me men wanrah sha ka iing U Trai U Blei jong me . Wat ju iohi ia u khun ha ka dud jong ka kmie jong u .

en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
kha: Ki paid ka Judah ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka ri ki la pyniap ia kita baroh kiba la thmu pyrshah ia u syiem Amon bad ki briew jong ka ri ki la pynlong ia u khun jong u u Josiah ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa kawei pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ngut ki angel lem bad hynñiew tylli ki khlam , kiba long kiba khatduh , namar ki long ki jingpynpaw kiba khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi sa kawei pat ka dak ha bneng, kaba khraw bad kaba phylla, hynriew ngut ki angel kiba don ki hynriew tylli ki khlam ba khatduh ; namar ha ki la pyndap ia ka jingbitar U Blei .

en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .
kha: Lada phi tei ïa nga ka duwan kaba da u maw , wat tei ïa ka da ki maw ba la shniah , namar lada phi pyndei nar ha kita ki maw , kim long kiba bit ba ngan pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me pynlong ia nga ka jingknia maw, wat tei ia ka da u maw ba la ot: namar lada me pynkiew ia ka tiar jong me halor jong ka , me la pynjakhlia ia ka .

en: And he brought his household man by man  ; and Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , was taken .
kha: Nangta u wan ïalam sha khmat ïa ka longïing jong u Sabdi sha khmat , uwei hadien uwei , bad la kdew ïa u Akhan , u khun jong u Karmi bad u ksiew jong u Sabdi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u briew jong u da u briew bad u Achan u khun u Carmi u khun u Zabdi u khun u Zraham na ka jait Judah .

en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .
kha: Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong pha bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pui bad ngan ieh sa tang ïa u mawsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynjot ia ki kynroh jong ka Tyros , bad kin pynpra ia ki tower jong ka: Ngan sa pynkhih ruh ia ka dewbilat jong ka na ka , bad ngan pynlong ia ka kum ka tduh jong u maw .

en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ngan aiti ïa ki nong Ijipt sha u nongsynshar lehbor , sha u syiem runar u ban synshar ïa ki . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nong Ijipt ngan aiti ha ka kti jong u kynrad uba shyrkhei bad u syiem uba shyrkhei un synshar halor jong ki , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist ruh u la kñia ainguh tang shisien ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa paw ha ka sien kaba ar , ym ban weng noh ïa ka pop , hynrei ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la tyrwa shisien ia U Khrist ban kit ia ki pop jong kiba bun ; bad ha kito kiba wad ia u un paw ha ka sien kaba ar khlem pop haduh ka jingpynim .

en: There was a little city , and few men within it  ; and there came a great king against it , and besieged it , and built great bulwarks against it :
kha: La don kawei ka shnong kaba rit ka bym da don bun ngut ki briew hapoh jong ka . U syiem uba khlaiñ u la tur ïaleh ïa ka . U la kerkut ïa ka bad u la pynkhreh ban pynpra lyngba ïa ki kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka shnong kaba rit , bad tang khyndiat ngut ki briew hapoh jong ka ; bad la wan u syiem uba khraw pyrshah ia ka , bad u la ker sawdong ia ka , bad u la tei ia ki kynroh kiba khraw pyrshah ia ka:

en: And when he saw them , he said unto them ,  Go shew yourselves unto the priests .  And it came to pass , that , as they went , they were cleansed .
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki bad u la ong ha ki ,  Khie leit bad ai ba ki lyngdoh kin da khmih bniah ïa phi .  Ha lynti la pynkhuid ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ia ki, u la ong ha ki, To leit pyni ia lade ha ki lyngdoh . Bad ka la jia ba katba ki dang leit noh .

en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .
kha: Ka long da ka jingngeit ba ngi sngewthuh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba lah ban ïohi la pynlong na kaei ka bymlah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingngeit ngi sngewthuh ba la frame ia ki pyrthei da ka ktien U Blei , kumta kiei kiei kiba la iohi kim shym la long na kiei kiei kiba paw .

en: But I see another law in my members , warring against the law of my mind , and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members .
kha: Hynrei nga ïohi ïa ka hukum kaba pher kaba trei hapoh ka met jong nga — ka hukum kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum kaba ka jingmut jong nga ka mynjur . Ka pynlong ïa nga u koidi ïa ka hukum jong ka pop kaba trei ha ka met jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga iohi ia kawei pat ka ain ha ki dkhot jong nga , kaba ialeh pyrshah ia ka ain jong nga , bad kaba wanrah ia nga ha ka jingshah set ha ka ain pop kaba don ha ki dkhot jong nga .

en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .
kha: Ka la don ka jingïa-pasiaw kaba jur shaphang jong u hapdeng u paidbah .  U long u briew uba bha ,  don kiba la ong .  Em ,  kiwei ki la ong ,  u ïalam bakla ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingkyrhuh kaba jur hapdeng ki briew shaphang jong u: namar don kiba ong: U long u briew uba bha: kiwei pat ki la ong: Em; hynrei u shukor ia ki briew .

en: And the ass saw me , and turned from me these three times : unless she had turned from me , surely now also I had slain thee , and saved her alive .
kha: Hynrei ka kada jong me ka la ïohi bad kiar ïa nga lai sien . Lada kam shym la leh kumta , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa me bad pyllait im ïa ka kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tdong ka la iohi ia nga, bad ka la phai noh na nga kine ki lai sien: lymda ka la phai noh na nga, shisha mynta ruh nga la pyniap ia me, bad nga la pynim ia ka .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye have spoken vanity , and seen lies , therefore , behold , I am against you , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha ki ,  Ki ktien jong phi ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïohipaw jong phi ki long kiba lamler . Nga long pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; Namar ba phi la kren ia ki jinglamler, bad phi la iohi ia ki jinglamler, namarkata, ha khmih, nga long pyrshah ia phi, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And to them which were in Rachal , and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites , and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites ,
kha: bad Rakal ; sha ki kur u Jerahmeel , sha ki Ken ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita kiba don ha Rakhal bad ha kita kiba don ha ki shnong jong ki Jerahmeel bad ha kita kiba don ha ki shnong jong ki Kenite .

en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said , Bring this young man unto the chief captain : for he hath a certain thing to tell him .
kha: Te u Paul u la khot ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad u la ong ha u ,  Ïalam ïa une u samla sha u rangbah ai hukum , u don ei ei ban ïathuh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la khot ia uwei na ki rangbah ha u , bad u la ong: To wanrah ia une u samla ha u rangbah shipai: namar u don kaei kaei ban iathuh ia u .

en: And the contention was so sharp between them , that they departed asunder one from the other : and so Barnabas took Mark , and sailed unto Cyprus  ;
kha: La don ka jingïania kaba tyngeh , bad ki la ïakhlad paralok : U Barnabas u la ïalam ïa u Markos bad u la leit da ka lieng sha Sypros ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiakren ka la long kaba jur bha hapdeng jong ki, haduh ba ki la leit noh iwei na iwei pat: bad kumta u Barnabas u la shim ia u Mark bad u la leit sha Kypros;

en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .
kha: U patsha u la phah katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai bad nga , bad nga leit sha ka Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi . Hangta nga ai ïa ki shithi u patsha ha ki lat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la poi sha ki Lat kiba don sha shiliang wah bad nga la ai ia ki shithi jong u syiem . Mynta u syiem u la phah ia ki rangbah shipai bad ki shipai kiba don ryngkat bad nga .

en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me , even unto me Daniel , after that which appeared unto me at the first .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai ba u Belshassar u long syiem , nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw kaba ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Belshasar ka la paw ha nga, wat ha nga Daniel, hadien kata kaba la paw ha nga ha kaba nyngkong .

en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting : and the children of Israel also wept again , and said , Who shall give us flesh to eat ?
kha: Don ki nongwei kiba ïaleit lang bad ki Israel . Kine ki don ka jingkwah palat ban bam doh , bad wat ki Israel hi ki la sdang ban ud :  A , ba ma ngi ruh ngin da ïoh khyndiat ka doh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah ba la khleh lang uba don hapdeng jong ki u la hap: bad ki khun Israel ruh ki iam biang bad ki la ong: Mano ba ai doh ia ngi ban bam ?

en: And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
kha: Ki la ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong u bad ïa ka ri u Og u syiem Bashan , uwei pat u syiem Amor uba shong sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la don ha kane ka liang jong u, bad ka ri jong u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan, arngut ki syiem ki Amorit kiba don ha kane ka liang ka Jordan sha ka liang ka sngi kaba mih;

en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .
kha: Pyrkhat ïa ki sngi kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba la leit noh , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha phi aïu ka la jia , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ki sngi hyndai, pyrkhat ia ki snem kiba bun ki pateng: kylli ia u kpa jong me , bad un pyni ia me; bad kin iathuh ia me .

en: And told him , saying , Joseph is yet alive , and he is governor over all the land of Egypt . And Jacob s heart fainted , for he believed them not .
kha: Ki ïathuh ha u ,  U Joseph u dang im , bad u long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .  U Jakob u dum ka buit ka stad , ba um sngewlah ngeit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iathuh ha u, u la ong, U Joseph u dang im, bad u long u Lat halor ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei . Bad u Jakob u la lyngngoh namar um ngeit ia ki .

en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul : and when Saul saw any strong man , or any valiant man , he took him unto him .
kha: Katba u dang im , u Saul u hap ban ïaleh tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . Kumta , man ka por ba u lap ïa u briew uba khlaiñ lane uba shlur , u ju pynrung ïa u ha ka kynhun ïapom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka thma kaba jur pyrshah ia ki Philistia baroh ki sngi jong u Saul: bad haba u Saul u la iohi ia uno uno u briew uba khlain ne uno uno u briew uba shlur , u la shim ia u sha u .

en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .
kha: Ka Rakhel ka la shim ïa kita ki blei ïing bad ka la lah thep ïa ki hapoh ka jin    ut bad ka shong halor jong ki . U Laban la u wad kylleng hapoh kata ka ïingjaiñ , hynrei um lap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka Rakhel ka la shim ia ki dur, bad ka la buh ia ki ha ki tiar jong ki kulai, bad ka la shong halor jong ki . U Laban u la wad ia ka ïingjaiñ baroh kawei, hynrei um lap ia ki .

en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ox or his sheep go astray , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother .
kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi lane ïa ka langbrot u para Israel ba ka sakma , wat shu ieh ïa ka ; leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iohi ia u hynmen jong me ne ki langbrot jong u ki iaid bakla bad to buhrieh ia lade na ki: me dei ban wanrah biang ia ki sha u hynmen jong me .

en: There is one glory of the sun , and another glory of the moon , and another glory of the stars : for one star differeth from another star in glory .
kha: Ka sngi ka don la ka jong ka jingitynnat , u bnai da kawei ka jingitynnat , bad ki khlur da kawei pat ka jingitynnat ; bad wat hapdeng ki khlur don ki jingitynnat ba har rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don kawei ka burom jong ka sngi , bad kawei pat ka burom jong u bnai: namar uwei u khlur u iapher na uwei pat u khlur ha ka burom .

en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a pot , and put an omer full of manna therein , and lay it up before the  Lord  , to be kept for your generations .
kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim uwei u khiew , thep ar kilo ka manna ha u , nangta buh ïa u ha khmat U  Trai  , na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron, "To shim ia ka umphniang, bad buh ia ka um kaba dap da ka Mann ha ka, bad buh ia ka ha khmat U Trai, ban buh ia ka na ka bynta ki pateng jong phi .

en: Which was the son of Melea , which was the son of Menan , which was the son of Mattatha , which was the son of Nathan , which was the son of David ,
kha: u khun jong u Melea , u khun jong u Menna , u khun jong u Mattatha , u khun jong u Nathan , u khun jong u Dabid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Melas uba long u khun u Mennath uba long u khun u Natha uba long u khun u Dabid .

en: And they said one to another , Go to , let us make brick , and burn them thoroughly . And they had brick for stone , and slime had they for mortar .
kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ale ! ngin ïathaw maw-it bad ngin thang pyneh ïa ki .  Kumta ki la ïoh maw-it ban tei , bad ka bsiang ban pyndait lang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, To ngin ia shna nar, bad ngin thang bha ia ki . Bad ki don ki nar na ka bynta u maw, bad ki sliang ki don na ka bynta ka maw .

en: Let no man despise thy youth ; but be thou an example of the believers , in word , in conversation , in charity , in spirit , in faith , in purity .
kha: Wat ai ïano ïano ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me namar ba me long uba dang samla , hynrei to long ka nuksa ïa ki bangeit ha ka ktien , ha ka jinglong jingim , ha ka jingieit , ha ka jingngeit , bad ka jinglongkhuid jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un leh bein ia ka jinglong samla jong me ; hynrei me long ka nuksa jong ki bangeit, ha ka ktien, ha ka jingiakren, ha ka jingai sngewbha, ha ka mynsiem, ha ka jingngeit, ha ka jingkhuid .

en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .
kha: Kam ju rung ha ki jingmut jong ki ba ngan kynmaw ïa kane ka kam sniew baroh ; hynrei ki pop jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa ki , bad ngam lah khlem da ïohi ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim pyrkhat ha ki dohnud jong ki ba nga kynmaw ia ka jingsniew jong ki baroh: mynta ki jingleh jong ki hi ki la pynsngewsih ia ki shaphang ; ki don ha khmat jong nga .

en: Then they hasted , and took every man his garment , and put it under him on the top of the stairs , and blew with trumpets , saying , Jehu is king .
kha: Mar kumta ki para rangbah shipai jong u Jehu ki siang ïa ki barandi jong ki ha kliar jong ki mawkyrdon ba u Jehu un ïoh ïeng , ki la put ïa ki turoi , bad ki la pyrta ,  U Jehu u long u syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la kyrkieh bad ki la shim ia ka jain jong u, bad ki la buh ia ka hapoh jong u ha jrong jong ki step, bad ki la pyrta da ki turoi ki da ong: U Jehu u long syiem .

en: Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :
kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor bad ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don kaba eh than ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ah Trai Blei ! ha khmih , me la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew da ka bor bah jong me bad me la pynjrong ia ka kti jong me bad ym don ei ei kaba eh palat ia me:

en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;
kha: Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob kiba la leit sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun shynrang jong u , ki long hynriewphew hynriew ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki mynsiem kiba la wan bad u Jakob sha Ijipt, kiba la mih na ki tyrpeng jong u, nalor ki tnga jong u Jakob, ki mynsiem baroh ki long hynriewphew hynriew;

en: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  hath sent us to destroy it .
kha: U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkynnoh pyrshah kaba jur ïa kine ki briew bad u la phah ba ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ka Sodom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngin pynjot ia kane ka jaka , namar ka jingpyrta jong ki ka la nang jur ha khmat U Trai ; bad U Trai u la phah ia ngi ban pynjot ia ka .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once , and will distress them , that they may find it so .
kha: U  Trai  un kynting ïa phi shabar jong kane ka ri ; un pynlwet ïa phi tad haduh ba yn ym don uno uno ruh na phi uba dang sah . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan pynkhih ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri ha kane ka por , bad ngan pynshitom ia ki , ba kin shem ia ka kumta .

en: For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .
kha: Bad ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad phi hangne , namar U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam ne dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai sha ïing na kajuh ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la ong ha nga da ka ktien U Trai , Wat bam ia u kpu ne dih um hangta , lymne phai biang sha ka lynti kaba me leit .

en: And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .
kha: Ki nong Beth Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan haba ki khmied ki la ïohi ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen haba ki ïohi ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki na Betheshem ki dang kheit ia u kew jong ki ha ka them: bad ki la rah ia ki khmat jong ki bad ki la iohi ia ka synduk bad ki la sngewbha ban iohi ia ka .

en: But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .
kha: Me lah ban pyrkhat ba kin pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei uba don ka bor ban ai ka jingjop ne ka jingshahjop , bad un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me ban jop ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me leit, to leh ia kata, to long kiba khlain na ka bynta ka thma: U Blei un pynlong ia me ban hap ha khmat u nongshun: namar U Blei u don ka bor ban iarap bad ban pynhap noh .

en: And Jesus stood before the governor : and the governor asked him , saying , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou sayest .
kha: U Jisu u la ïeng ha khmat u lyngskor ka hima Rom , uba la kylli jingkylli ïa u .  Hato me long u Syiem ki Jiw ?  u la kylli .  Me ong kumta ,  la jubab U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ieng ha khmat u Lat: bad u Lat u la kylli ia u, u la ong: Me long u Syiem ki Jiw ? U Jisu u la ong ha u: Me ong .

en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .
kha: Ki long kiba bymman haduh katta katta ; ot ïa ki kum ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndait ia phi ha ka lyngkhot lyngkhai , namar ka jingot ka la san: to wan hiar noh ia phi namar ka press ka la dap , ki shini ki tuid; namar ka jingsniew jong ki ka long kaba khraw;

en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the  Lord  rest , and Moab shall be trodden down under him , even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill .
kha: U  Trai  un ïada ïa u Lum Seïon , hynrei ki briew jong ka Moab kin shah ïuhroit , kumba ïa u phlangïap la ïuh haba shna sboh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha une u lum yn pynkhih ia ka kti U Trai hapoh jong u, kumba la pynkhih ia u sboh na ka bynta u dewbilat .

en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
kha: Ym don kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynna ha ki khmat jong u . Bad ka dei sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ruh uwei ruh u jingthaw u bym paw ha ka jingpeit jong u: hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lyngkhuid bad kiba la plie ha ki khmat jong uta uba ngi hap ban leh .

en: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .
kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Haba ka sngi ka dang jlan kumne bad ka por ruh kam pat dei ban leit set ïa ki langbrot , te balei phim nang ai um ïa ki bad ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka jaka bam phlang ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Lo, ka dang long ka sngi kaba heh, bad kam dei ka por ba ki masi kin ialum lang: ai um ia ki langbrot bad leit ai bam ia ki .

en: And it was so : for he rose up early on the morrow , and thrust the fleece together , and wringed the dew out of the fleece , a bowl full of water .
kha: Ka la long thik kumta . Haba u Gideon u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , u la khem ïa u shñiuh langbrot bad u la khyrwait ïa ka umjer na u ban pyndap ïa ka pliang da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta: namar u la khie dang step, bad u la pynkhih ia ka snieh lang, bad u la pynkhih ia ka dew na ka snieh , ka khiew kaba dap da ka um .

en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves , but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place , having obtained eternal redemption for us .
kha: Haba U Khrist u la ïaid lyngba kane ka ïingjaiñ bad rung tang shisien shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam , um shym la shim ïa ka snam ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ; hynrei , u shim ïa la ka jong ka snam , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka snam jong ki blang bad ki khun masi , hynrei da ka snam jong u hi u la rung shisien shapoh ka jaka bakhuid , hadien ba u la ioh ia ka jingpynim bymjukut na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: Except it be for this one voice , that I cried standing among them , Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day .
kha: lait tang kawei kaba nga la pyrta jam haba nga ïeng ha khmat jong ki : ‘ Ïa nga la bishar da ma phi ha kane ka sngi naba nga ngeit ba kiba ïap kin sa mihpat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Lait noh tang na ka bynta kane kawei ka sur , ba nga la pyrta hapdeng jong ki , Da kaba ktah ia ka jingmihpat jong kiba iap nga shah khot ha phi ha kane ka sngi .

en: The files on renaming these government schools had been pending in the previous BJP dispensation and have been cleared by his party ' s government .
kha: Ki file halor ka jingpynkylla kyrteng ia kine ki skul sorkar ki la sahkut ha ka por ba la dep jong ka BJP bad la pynkhuid da ka sorkar jong ka party jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki file kiba pynkylla kyrteng ia kine ki skul sorkar ki la dang sahteng ha ka por ba mynshuwa jong ka BJP bad la pynkhuid da ka sorkar jong u .

en: In all the signs and the wonders , which the  Lord  sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ,
kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum kito kiba U  Trai  u la phah ïa u Moses ban leh ha u syiem ka Ijipt , ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ha ka ri hi baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki dak bad ki jingphylla baroh kiba U Trai u la phah ia u ban leh ha ka ri Ijipt ha u Pharaoh bad ha ki shakri jong u baroh bad ha ka ri jong u baroh .

en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .
kha: ha kaba u Sadok bad u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem Israel . Nangta put ïa ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Solomon !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba u Sadok u lyngdoh bad u Natha u nongiathuhlypa un pynsleh ia u hangta halor ki Israel: bad to pynsawa ia phi da ka turoi, bad to ong, U Blei un pynim ia u syiem Solomon .

en: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the  Lord  , and he heard me  ; out of the belly of hell cried I , and thou heardest my voice .
kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga , A  Trai  , nga la khot kyrpad ïa me , bad me la jubab ïa nga . Na ka jingjylliew jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap nga la khot kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Nga la pyrta namar ka jingsngewsih jong nga ha U Trai , bad u la iohsngew ia nga; na ka kpoh dujok nga la pyrta , bad me la iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga .

en: If I whet my glittering sword , and mine hand take hold on judgment  ; I will render vengeance to mine enemies , and will reward them that hate me .
kha: ba ngan shut pynnep ïa ka waitlam kaba phalang jong nga , bad ai ïa ka jingbishar bahok , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga bat ia ka waitlam kaba rben jong nga, bad ka kti jong nga kan bat ia ka jingbishar ; ngan pynphai kylla ia ki nongshun jong nga, bad ngan siew kylliang ia ki kiba shun ia nga .

en: And Moses took his wife and his sons , and set them upon an ass , and he returned to the land of Egypt : and Moses took the rod of God in his hand .
kha: Kumta u Moses u ïalam ïa la ka tnga bad ïa la ki khun shynrang , u pynshong ïa ki ha ka kada , bad u leit bad ki sha Ijipt , u da rah ïa u diengduh uba U Blei u la ong ïa u ban rah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka tnga jong u bad ki khun shynrang jong u, bad u la buh ia ki ha ka kada, bad u la leit phai noh sha ka ri Ijipt: bad u Moses u la shim ia u diengduh U Blei ha ka kti jong u .

en: For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , saith the  Lord  , so shall your seed and your name remain .
kha: Kumba ka khyndew bathymmai bad ki bneng kiba thymmai , kin ïaisah da ka bor jong nga , kumta ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kin ïaisah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ka khyndew kaba thymmai kaba ngan thaw kin sah ha khmat jong nga , ong U Trai , kumta u symbai jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kin sah .

en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous , and his ears are open unto their prayers : but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil .
kha: Naba U Trai u khmih halor kiba hok bad u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki ; hynrei u pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki khmat U Trai ki long halor kiba hok bad ki shkor jong u ki plie ia ki jingduwai jong ki: hynrei ka khmat U Trai ka long pyrshah ia kita kiba leh ia kaba sniew .

en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
kha: Hynrei kim shym beh noh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha Geser ; kumta ki Kanaan ki la shong la sah hapdeng ki Ephraim haduh kane ka sngi , hynrei la pynbor ïa ki ban trei kum ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la beh noh ia ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha Gzer: hynrei ki nong Kanaan ki shong hapdeng ki nong Ephraim haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge ? therefore have I uttered that I understood not  ; things too wonderful for me , which I knew not .
kha: Me kylli kumno nga nud ban kylli ïa ka jingstad jong me haba nga long u bym don jingtip ei ei . Nga la kren shaphang kiei kiei kiba ngam sngewthuh , shaphang ki kamphylla kiba khraw eh ïa nga ban tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba buhrieh ia ka jingai jingmut khlem jingtip ? namarkata nga la pynpaw ba ngam sngewthuh ia kiei kiei kiba phylla palat na ka bynta jong nga , kiba ngam tip .

en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters : for the children of Israel have sworn , saying , Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin .
kha: hynrei ngim lah pat ban shah ba kin shongkurim ïa ki khun kynthei jong ngi , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingtim ha uno uno na ngi uba shah ïa u Benjamin ban shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngim lah ban ai ia ki ia ki tnga jong ki khun kynthei jong ngi: namar ki khun Israel ki la smai , ki la ong: La tim ia uta uba ai tnga ia u Benjamin .

en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour , in the which Jesus said unto him ,  Thy son liveth :  and himself believed , and his whole house .
kha: Te u kpa u la kynmaw ba ha kata hi ka kynta mynba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ,  U khun jong me un im .  Kumta ma u bad ka longïing jong u baroh ki la ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u kpa u tip ba ka long ha kajuh ka kynta, ha kaba U Jisu u la ong ha u: U khun jong me u im: bad ma u hi u la ngeit, bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go , get thee down  ; for thy people , which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt , have corrupted themselves :
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie , leit hiar noh shisyndon , naba ki briew jong me kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , ki la ïaleh pop bad ki la kyntait ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To leit hiar noh na ka bynta ki briew jong me kiba me la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt ki la pynsniew ia lade:

en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :
kha: Rung shapoh lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim , namar ka khyrdop sha ka dujok ka long kaba kylluid bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba suk , bad don shibun kiba ïaid na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia phi ha ka khyrdop kaba jylliew: namar ka long kaba heh bad kaba jylliew ka long ka lynti kaba ialam sha ka jingjot, bad bun ki don kiba leit shapoh hangta:

en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar , he shall bring the live goat :
kha: Ynda u Aaron u la lah pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , ïa kaba sah jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad ïa ka duwan , un ai sha U  Trai  ïa uta u  langsohmoh uba dang im uba la jied na ka bynta u Asasel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la pynkut noh ia ka jaka bakhuid bad ka iingmane bad ka almari , un wanrah ia u blang uba im:

en: Say thou unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem , and all the house of Israel that are among them .
kha: ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki . Kane ka khubor ka dei na ka bynta u khun syiem uba synshar ha Jerusalem bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh kiba shong basah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong ia ki , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Kane ka jingkit ka iadei bad u syiem ha Jerusalem bad ka iing Israel baroh kaba don hapdeng jong ki .

en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .
kha: Ym don uba lah ban phrung jubor shapoh ka ïing jong u briew uba khlaiñ bad kit noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lymda nyngkong eh u teh u khum shuwa ïa u briew uba khlaiñ , nangta u sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lym kumta kumno u briew u lah ban rung ha ka iing jong u briew uba khlain , bad u pynsniew ia ki mar ki mata jong u , lait noh tang ba u teh nyngkong ia uta uba khlain ? bad nangta un pynsniew ia ka iing jong u .

en: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us , to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .
kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki kohnguh ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi tang ha ka kyndon ba ngin otsher ïa ki shynrang jong ngi baroh , kumba ki ruh ki la shah otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang hangne ki shynrang kin mynjur ia ngi ban shong bad ngi, ban long kawei ka jaitbynriew, lada uwei pa uwei u shynrang napdeng jong ngi un shah ot , kumba la ot ia ki .

en: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings , I will not accept them : neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts .
kha: Haba phi wallam sha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bam jong phi , ngan ym pdiang ïa ki ; ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingri ba phi la pynsngaid ban wallam sha nga kum ki jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la phi ai ia nga ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia doh jong phi: lymne ngan ym khein ia ki jingknia jingsuk jong ki mrad ba heh jong phi .

en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .
kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u ,  Hangno kito ki rangbah kiba wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar !  Ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia u Lot bad ki la ong ha u, Hangno ki briew kiba wan sha me mynta ka miet ? wanrah ia ki shabar ha ngi , ba ngin ithuh ia ki .

en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Ha ki briew jong U Blei ha Kolossai kiba long ki parabangeit baïaineh ha U Khrist : Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki riewkhuid bad ki para bangeit ha U Khrist kiba don ha Colosses: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .
kha: Baroh ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Ephesos ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ; la pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu la ai ka burom kaba kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kane la tip da ki Jiw bad ki Grik ruh kiba shong ha Ephesos ; bad ka jingtieng ka la hap ha ki baroh , bad la pynkhraw ia ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .

en: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ki rishot maw bakyntang jong phi ; phin ym mane shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dur ba la ker jong me ruh ngan ot noh ia ki dur jong me kiba ieng hapdeng jong me ; bad me ruh men ym mane shuh ia ka kam jong ki kti jong me .

en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .
kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang ïa uta u briew kumno u la ïoh imat pat . U la ïathuh ïa ki ,  U la tah khyndiat ka ktieh ha ki khmat jong nga ; nga la bta khmat , bad mynta nga la imat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta pat ki Pharisi ruh ki la kylli ia u kumno u la ioh ia ka jingpeit jong u . U la ong ha ki , U la buh ia ka dewbilat ha ki khmat jong nga bad nga la sait bad nga iohi .

en: And a stone of stumbling , and a rock of offence , even to them which stumble at the word , being disobedient : whereunto also they were appointed .
kha: Bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Une u long u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin kyllon .  Ki la jynthut namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien , katta ka la long ka mon U Blei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u maw uba ia tyngkhuh, bad u maw uba sniew, wat ha kito kiba ia tyngkhuh bad ka ktien: ha kaba la thung ia ki ruh .

en: Took branches of palm trees , and went forth to meet him , and cried , Hosanna : Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord .
kha: Kumta ki la kdiah ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai bad ki la mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , ki da pyrta ,  Ïaroh ïa U Blei ! To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u Syiem ki Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: La shim ia ki tnat jong ki dieng sohjew, bad u la leit shabar ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la pyrta: La kyrkhu ia u Syiem Israel uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year , in the twelfth month , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khat-ar jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka snem kaba shiphew snem, ha ka sngi kaba arphew snem, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Be thou my strong habitation , whereunto I may continually resort : thou hast given commandment to save me  ; for thou art my rock and my fortress .
kha: To long ka jakarieh kaba skhem jong nga , ka kut bakhlaiñ ban ïada ïa nga ; me long ka jakarieh bad ka jingkyrshan jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To long ma me ka jaka shong kaba skhem jong nga, ha kaba nga lah ban leit phai beit: me la ai hukum ban pynim ia nga ; namar me long u maw bad ka kut jong nga .

en: And when the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice : and the woman spake to Saul , saying , Why hast thou deceived me ? for thou art Saul .
kha: Haba kata ka kynthei ka ïohi ïa u Samuel , ka lynñiar kliang , bad ka ong ha u Saul ,  Balei phi shet shukor ïa nga ? Phi dei u syiem Saul du !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kata ka kynthei ka la iohi ia u Samuel , ka la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam: bad kata ka kynthei ka la kren ha u Saul, ka da ong: Balei me la shukor ia nga ? namar me long u Saul .

en: What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :
kha: Bad kane ka long kumjuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . U la kwah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong u bad ban pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u . Hynrei u la long uba ïaishah haduh katta katta ïa kito kiba long ka daw jong ka jingbitar jong u , kiba la don ha ka lynti sha ka jingshah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno lada U Blei, uba mon ban pyni ia ka jingbitar jong u, bad ban pynpaw ia ka bor jong u, u la shah ia ki khiew jong ka jingbitar kiba la pynbeit ia ka jingpynjot:

en: If one be found slain in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it , lying in the field , and it be not known who hath slain him :
kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , phi lap ha lum ha wah ïa u briew uba la shah pynïap , bad phim tip mano ba la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uwei u shah pyniap ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me ban don ia ka, haba u la thiah ha lyngkha , bad ym tip mano ba la pyniap ia u:

en: The  Lord  did not set his love upon you , nor choose you , because ye were more in number than any people  ; for ye were the fewest of all people :
kha: U  Trai  um shym la ieit bad jied ïa phi namar ba phi kham bun paid ban ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ; ha ka jingshisha phi long ka jaitbynriew kaba rit tam ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai um shym la buh ia ka jingieit jong u halor jong phi, ne jied ia phi, namar phi la kham bun ban ia uno uno u briew ; namar phi la long kiba duna tam na ki briew baroh:

en: Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?
kha: Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynjur ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathuh wat ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi mano ban long syiem hadien jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane ka long kaba la leh da u kynrad jong nga u syiem bad me khlem pyni ia ka ha u shakri jong me uba dei ban shong ha ka khet jong u kynrad jong nga hadien jong u ?

en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great : so that they wearied themselves to find the door .
kha: Nangta ki la shoh pynmatlah ïa kita ki shynrang baroh kiba don habar khnang ba kin ym shem ïa ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia ki briew kiba don ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing da ka jingmatlah, baroh arngut bad kiba heh: haduh ba ki la pynkhih ia lade ban wad ia ka jingkhang .

en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age , even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil .
kha: Ka jingbam kaba eh , ha kawei pat ka liang , ka long ïa kiba la rangbah , kiba lyngba ka jingpynmlien ki lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka doh kaba khlain ka long jong kito kiba la dap pura, wat kito kiba namar ka jingpyndonkam ki don ki jingsngew jong ki kiba la pynkhih ban ithuh ia kaba bha bad kaba sniew .

en: Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .
kha: haba U  Trai  un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un synshar ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei da ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat U Trai: namar u wan ban bishar ia ka pyrthei: un bishar ia ka pyrthei da ka hok bad ki briew da ka jingshisha jong u .

en: But thou , son of man , hear what I say unto thee  ; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house : open thy mouth , and eat that I give thee .
kha: Ko khun u briew , sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong ha me . Wat ïaleh pyrshah kum ma ki . Ang ïa la ka shyntur bad bam ïa kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me khun u briew, to sngap ia kaei kaba nga ong ha me; Wat long uba leh pyrshah kum kata ka iing kaba leh pyrshah: plie ia ka shyntur jong me bad bam ia kata kaba nga ai ha me .

en: Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato ym don khat-ar kynta ha ka shi sngi ? Kumta uno uno uba ïaid haba dang shai ka sngi un ym jynthut , naba u ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab: Hato ym don shiphew kynta ha ka sngi ? Lada uno uno u iaid ha ka sngi , um ju shah pynthut namar u iohi ia ka jingshai jong kane ka pyrthei .

en: All things are lawful unto me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but I will not be brought under the power of any .
kha: Don u ban ong ,  Nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano .  Ho-oid , hynrei ym baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa phi . Nga lah ban ong ba nga lah ban leh ïa kano kano , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa kano kano ban pynlong ïa nga u mraw jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba dei katkum ka ain jong nga: kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba dei katkum ka ain na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei ngan ym shah pynhap hapoh ka bor jong uno uno .

en: We having the same spirit of faith , according as it is written , I believed , and therefore have I spoken ; we also believe , and therefore speak ;
kha: Ka jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la kren namar nga la ngeit .  Ha kajuh ka mynsiem jong ka jingngeit ngi ruh ngi kren namar ba ngi ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi don ia kajuh ka mynsiem jong ka jingngeit kumba la thoh , nga la ngeit , bad namarkata nga la kren ; ngi ruh ngi ngeit , bad namarkata ngi kren ; .

en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Honour thy father and thy mother .
kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat mudui lamler ïano ïano ; burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie .’
translated_en_to_kha: Me tip ia ki hukum , Wat leh be-ijot , Wat pyniap , Wat tuh , Wat shah ia ka sakhi lamler , To burom ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me .

en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills , and from the multitude of mountains : truly in the  Lord  our God is the salvation of Israel .
kha: Ngim shym la ïoh jingïarap ei ei da ka jingmane jong ngi ka bym dei ïa me halor ki kliar lum . Ka jingïarap ïa ki Israel ka wan tang na U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ha ka jingshisha ka long ka jingpynim kaba la kyrmen na ki lum , bad na ki lum kiba bun: shisha ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi ka long ka jingpynim jong ki Israel .

en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew , whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite  ;
kha: Hangta ha Susa la don u Jiw uba kyrteng u Mordekai , u khun jong u Jair ; uba na ka jait Benjamin bad u long uba hiarpateng na u Kish bad u Shimei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha Shushan ka iing u don uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Mordecai u khun u Jair u khun u Shimei u khun u Kish u Benjamite;

en: For the Father loveth the Son , and sheweth him all things that himself doeth : and he will shew him greater works than these , that ye may marvel .
kha: Naba U Kpa u ieit ïa U Khun bad u pyn-i ha u ïa baroh kaba ma u hi u leh . Un pyn-i ha u wat ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw kiba un leh ban ïa kane , bad baroh phin sngewlyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Kpa u ieit ia u Khun bad u pyni ia u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ma u hi u leh: bad un pyni ia u ia ki kam kiba kham khraw ban ia kine, ba phin sngewphylla .

en: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,
kha: Haba ka la long mynsngi , ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , bad ïa U Jisu la wallam ha khmat ka dorbar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu sdang ka sngi , ki rangbah jong ki briew bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la iawan lang bad ki la ialam ia u shapoh ka dorbar jong ki da kaba ong:

en: And Miriam the prophetess , the sister of Aaron , took a timbrel in her hand  ; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances .
kha: Te ka Miriam ka nongïathuhlypa , ka para jong u Aaron , ka la shim ïa la ka kanjari , bad ki kynthei baroh ruh ki la ïabud nadien jong ka , ki da tem ïa ki kanjari , bad ki da ïashad ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Miriam ka jingiathuhlypa, ka para u Aaron, ka la shim ia ka dieng ha ka kti jong ka bad ki kynthei baroh ki la mih noh hadien jong ka da ki dieng bad da ki jingshad .

en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
kha: bad thang ïa ki blei — ki bym long da shisha ki blei , tang ki dur da ka dieng bad u maw ba la thaw da ki kti ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bret ia ki blei jong ki ha ka ding: namar kim shym la long ki blei , hynrei ka jingtrei jong ki briew , ki dieng bad u maw: namarkata ki la pynjot ia ki .

en: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity  ; and falling headlong , he burst asunder in the midst , and all his bowels gushed out .
kha: ( Da ka pisa kaba u Judas u la ïoh na ka bynta ka kam sniew jong u , u la thied ïa ka lyngkha , ha kaba u la noh ïap ïa lade ; u la pait bad ki snier jong u baroh ki la mih shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta une u briew u la thied ia ka lyngkha kaba don ka bainong jong ka jingbymhok ; bad u la hap khlieh , u la bthei hapdeng , bad ki kpoh jong u baroh ki la tuid shabar .

en: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin , which pertained to Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and twelve of the servants of David .
kha: Kumta khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , ki mihkhmat ïa u Ishbosheth , bad ïa ka jait Benjamin , ki ïakhun ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah jong u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la mih bad u la leit shajan u Benjamin uba don ha u Ishiboshet u khun u Saul bad shiphew ngut ki shakri u Dabid .

en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .
kha: Hynrei un jubab ,  Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumjuh . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi un smai da kaba ong , Ngan ym long u nongpynkhiah ; namar ha iing jong nga ym don kpu ne jain: wat pynlong ia nga u nongsynshar jong ki briew .

en: Read Acts 15 :1-35 , and see how the first-century governing body discussed and resolved a dispute with the help of the Scriptures and holy spirit .
kha: Pule ki Kam 15 :1-35 , peit kumno ba ha ka spah snem banyngkong , ka kynhun pynïaidkam ka la ïamir jingmut bad pynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia lyngba ki Jingthoh bakhuid bad u mynsiem bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Pule ia ki Kam 15 :1-35 , bad peit kumno ka kynhun synshar kaba nyngkong ka la iakren bad pynbeit ia ka jingialeh da ka jingiarap jong ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad u mynsiem bakhuid .

en: The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon , and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,
kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka , ïa ki jingpynriam baroh jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïaseng , bad ka synduk ka jingphla , bad ka jaka shong jingisynei kaba don hangta , bad ki tiar baroh jong ka ïingjaiñ .

en: Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .
kha: Pynban , ka hukum kaba nga thoh mynta sha phi ka long kaba thymmai , namar ka jingshisha jong ka , ka la paw ha U Khrist bad kumjuh ruh ha phi . Naba ka jingdum ka la jah noh , bad ka jingshai kaba shisha ka la da tyngshaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien, ka hukum kaba thymmai nga thoh ha phi, kaba shisha ha u bad ha phi: namar ka jingdum ka la leit noh, bad ka jingshai kaba shisha mynta ka shai .

en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .
kha: Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kiba long kiba khuid ha lade ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la tngit bad ki bymngeit , namar ba ki jingmut bad ki jingïatiplem jong ki , ki long ba la pyntngit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh kiba khuid ki long kiba khuid: hynrei ha kito kiba la pynjakhlia bad ki bym ngeit ym don ei ei kaba khuid ; hynrei wat ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad ka jingsngew jong ki ruh ka la jakhlia .

en: When the men were come unto him , they said , John Baptist hath sent us unto thee , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
kha: Haba ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki la ong ,  U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la phah ïa ngi ban kylli lada me long Uta Uba u la ong ba Un wan ne lada ngi dei ban khmih lynti ïa Uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew ki la wan sha u, ki la ong, u Ioannis u la phah ia ngi sha me, u da ong: Me dei ma me uba dei ban wan ? lane ngi wad ia uwei pat ?

en: As for these four children , God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom : and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams .
kha: U Blei u la ai ha ki saw ngut ki samla shynrang ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingtbit ha ka thoh ka tar bad ha ka saiñpyrkhat . Nalor kane , u la ai ha u Daniel ka jingtbit ban batai ïa ki jingïohipaw bad ïa ki jingphohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia kine ki saw ngut ki khun , U Blei u la ai jingtip bad jingtbit ha ka jingpule bad jingstad baroh: bad u Daniel u la don ka jingsngewthuh ha ki jingphohsniew bad ki jingphohsniew baroh .

en: Then the priest shall look on him : and , behold , if the scall be spread in the skin , the priest shall not seek for yellow hair  ; he is unclean .
kha: u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa u . Lada kata ka prum ka la pur shisha , um donkam ban da khmih sa ïa u shñiuh ba lam stem ; ka la paw shai hi ba u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un peit ia u: bad, ha khmih, lada ka sniehdoh ka la saphriang ha ka sniehdoh, u lyngdoh un ym wad ia ki shniuh kiba saw ; u long u bymkhuid .

en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken : and if it be sodden in a brasen pot , it shall be both scoured , and rinsed in water .
kha: Ïa u khiew khyndew ha kaba la shet ïa ka doh dei ban pynpait noh ïa u , bad lada dei u khiew shet da ka rnong , dei ban da kyrshut bha ïa u bad phler da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khyndew ha kaba la khleh lang kan sa tyrkhong: bad lada la khleh lang ha ka umphniang kaba la khleh lang , kan sa tyrkhong bad ka la tyrkhong ha ka um .

en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .
kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïano ban sheptieng : To sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba , hadien ka jingpynïap , u don ka bor ban bret sha ka dujok . To ngeit ïa nga , u long ma u uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan maham lypa ia phi ia uba phin tieng: To tieng ia u, uba hadien ba u la pyniap u don ka bor ban bret sha dujok ; yea , nga ong ha phi: To tieng ia u .

en: And the priest that offereth any man s burnt offering , even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered .
kha: Ka snieh jong u mrad ba la kñia ïa uba la wanrah kum ka jingainguh thang ruh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh uba ai ia kano kano ka jingknia thang , wat u lyngdoh ruh un don ha lade ia ka sniehdoh jong ka jingknia thang kaba u la tyrwa .

en: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth , and my right hand hath spanned the heavens : when I call unto them , they stand up together .
kha: Ki ksang ti jong nga ki la buh ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei bad kiba pyiar sha ki bneng . Haba nga phah khot ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka suiñbneng , ki wan kumne kumne bad aiti ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti jong nga ruh ka la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka khyndew, bad ka kti kadiang jong nga ka la pynkhih ia ki bneng: haba nga khot ia ki , ki ieng lang .

en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
kha: Haba u la poi bad u la ïohi kumno U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew , u la kmen bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh ban ïaineh bad ban long kiba beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba haba u la wan, bad u la iohi ia ka jingaiei U Blei, u la sngewbha bad u la kyntu ia ki baroh, ba da ka jingthmu jong ka dohnud kin ia sngap jar ha U Trai .

en: And answered them , saying ,  Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit , and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day ?
kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Lada uno uno na phi u don u khun ne u masi dab uba jia ryngkhat u hap hapoh ka pukri ha ka sngi Sabbaton , hato phin ym tan ïa u shisyndon shabar ha ka sngi Sabbaton hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Mano na phi uba don ka kada ne u masi uba la hap ha ka thliew bad un ym sei beit ia u ha ka sngi Sabha ?

en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us , who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ  ; what was I , that I could withstand God ?
kha: Ka long kaba shai ba U Blei u la ai ïa kito ki Jentil ïa kajuh ka jingai kaba u la ai ha ngi myn haba ngi la ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ; nga long uei , te , ban pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat eh kumba U Blei u la ai ha ki ia kajuh ka jingai kumba u la leh ha ngi, kiba ngeit ha U Trai Jisu Khrist; nga la long kumno ?

en: Take heed to thyself , lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest , lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee :
kha: Wat ïateh jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri sha kaba phi leit , namar kata ka lah ban long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade , ioh ba phin leh ia ka jutang bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri kaba phi leit:

en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,
kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel uba la kren da ka shyntur jong u ha u Dabid u kpa jong nga bad u la pyndep da ka kti jong u da kaba ong:

en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .
kha: Nga long u dieng sohwaiñ , bad phi long ki tnat . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha nga , bad ma nga ha u , un seisoh shibun ; naba phim lah ban leh ei ei khlem ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u sohjew, phi long ki tnat: Uta uba sah ha nga, bad nga ha u, uta hi u pynmih bun ki soh: namar khlem ma nga phim lah ban leh ei ei .

en: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver , but also of wood and of earth ; and some to honour , and some to dishonour .
kha: Ha ka ïing kaba heh don ki khiew kiba bun jait : Don na ki ïa kiba la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , kiwei pat da ka dieng bad ka dewbyrtha ; don na ki na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam kyrpang , kiwei pat ban pyndonkam man ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka iing kaba khraw ym tang ki khiew ksiar bad rupa , hynrei ruh ki dieng bad ka khyndew ; bad don kiba don burom bad don kiba khlem burom .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me la kyrpad , namar nga tip bha ïa me , bad nga sngewbha ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh ia kane ruh ba me la kren: namar me la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong nga , bad nga tip ia me da ka kyrteng .

en: They shall not take a wife that is a whore , or profane  ; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband : for he is holy unto his God .
kha: U lyngdoh namar ba u long uba khuid , um bit ban shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la ïaid nuti , lane ka bym dei ka theisotti , lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kim dei ban shim ia ka tnga kaba long ka nongkhaii met ne kaba sniew bad kim dei ban shim ia ka kynthei kaba la weng noh na u tnga jong ka: namar u long uba khuid ha U Blei jong u .

en: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God . But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did , he said unto his disciples ,
kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka bor bakhraw jong U Blei . Ki briew ki dang sngewphylla ha kaei kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , haba u ong ha ki synran jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la lyngngoh ia ka bor ba khraw jong U Blei . Hynrei katba ki dang lyngngoh iwei ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh , u la ong ha ki synran jong u .

en: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
kha: U Isaak u phah noh ïa u Jakob sha Mesopotamia , sha u Laban , uba long u khun jong u Bethuel u nong Aram , bad u hynmen jong ka Rebekka , ka kmie jong Jakob bad u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la phah noh ia u Jakob : bad u la leit sha u Laban u khun u Bethuel u Syria, u hynmen u Rebekka, u Jakob bad ka kmie u Iso .

en: And have cast their gods into the fire : for they were no gods , but the work of men s hands , wood and stone : therefore they have destroyed them .
kha: bad ki la thang lut ïa ki blei jong ki — ki bym long satia ki blei , tang ki dur jong u dieng bad u maw ba la shna da ki kti briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la bret ia ki blei jong ki ha ka ding: namar kim shym la long ki blei , hynrei ka jingtrei jong ki briew , ki dieng bad u maw: namarkata ki la pynjot ia ki .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;
kha: Hadien khyndiat por , u Abraham u la tip ba ka Milkah ka la kha phra ngut ki khun ïa u Nahor u para jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kine kiei kiei, ba la iathuh ha u Abraham, da kaba ong, Ha khmih, ko Milkah, ka la kha ruh ia ki khun ha u hynmen jong me u Nahor ; .

en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons  ; and now the  Lord  thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude .
kha: Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki leit sha Ijipt , ki ïadon baroh tang hynñiewphew ngut ; hynrei mynta U Blei u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la hiar sha Ijipt da ki shiphew ngut ki briew bad mynta U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynlong ia me kum ki khlur bneng na ka bynta ka jingbun briew .

en: Arise , get you up unto the wealthy nation , that dwelleth without care , saith the  Lord  , which have neither gates nor bars , which dwell alone .
kha: ‘ To wan , ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa kito ki briew kiba sngewshngain bad sngewskhem ! Ka nongbah jong ki , kam don ki khyrdop ne ki tala bad kam don jingïada ei ei .’
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , to kiew sha ka jaitbynriew kaba riewspah , kaba shong khlem da pyrkhat , ong U Trai , ki bym don khyrdop ne bar , kiba shong marwei .

en: For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .
kha: U  Trai  u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong phi U Trai u la beh noh ia ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad kiba khlain: hynrei ia phi , ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban ieng ha khmat jong phi haduh kane ka sngi .

en: And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .
kha: Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi , lane mano mano kiwei pat kiba kyrduh . Bad wat pyrkhat ïa ki rukom ban pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat pynshitom ia u riewkynthei , ne u bym don kpa , ne u nongwei , ne u baduk bad wat ai ba uwei ruh na phi un pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew pyrshah ia u hynmen jong u ha ka dohnud jong phi .

en: None calleth for justice , nor any pleadeth for truth : they trust in vanity , and speak lies  ; they conceive mischief , and bring forth iniquity .
kha: Phi kiew sha ka ïingbishar , hynrei phim shym ïoh ka jingbishar hok ha ka liang jong phi . Phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler ban jop ïa ka jingmudui jong phi . Phi pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong phi ban pynmong ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ba khot ia ka hok, lane uno uno u kyrpad ia ka jingshisha: ki shaniah ha ka jinglong ba sniew, bad ki kren thok ; ki kha ia ka jingbymhok .

en: Local authorities have the power to start legal proceedings for offences of harassment and illegal eviction under the Protection from Eviction Act .
kha: Ki bor synshar shnong ki don ka bor ban sdang ia ka jingbishar ain na ka bynta ki kam pynshitom bein bad ka jingshah beh beain katkum ka ain iada na ka jingshah beh shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bor synshar shnong ki don ka bor ban sdang ia ki kam ain na ka bynta ki kam runar bad ka jingshah beh shnong be-aiñ hapoh ka ain ban iada na ka ain .

en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue , and cover it with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put to the staves thereof :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ka almari ksiar kin pynphriang ia ka jain rong saw, bad kin tap ia ka da ka jingtap ia ki sniehdoh bad kin buh ha ki dieng jong ka:

en: And saying , Thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days , save thyself . If thou be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
kha: Me u ban sa pynkhyllem ïa ka Templ bad ban tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ! To pynim ïa lade lada me long U Khun U Blei ! To hiar noh na ka diengphna !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba ong , Me uba pynjot ia ka tempi bad uba tei ia ka ha ki lai sngi , to pynim ia lade . Lada me long U Khun U Blei , to wan hiar na ka diengphna .

en: And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum  ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :
kha: U pud jong ka , u suh na Heleph sha u dieng Sning ha Saanannim , nangta beit beit sha Adaminekeb bad sha Jamnia , haduh Lakkum , bad u kut ha ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rud duriaw jong ki ka long naduh u Heleph, naduh u Allon haduh u Zaim, bad u Adami Neekeb, bad u Jabneel, haduh u Lakum ; bad ki jingleit jong ka ki long ha Jordan:

en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner , in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Baroh ki traishnong Israel ki dei ban leh ïa kane haba ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba la kha na ka ri kin leh ia kine kiei kiei katkum kane ka rukom, da kaba ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding , ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?
kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki synran jong me kim bud ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , hynrei pynban ki bam da ki kti bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Pharisi bad ki nongthoh ki la kylli ia u, Balei ba phim iaid kat kum ka rukom jong ki rangbah hynrei bam ia u kpu da ki kti bym pat sait ?

en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .
kha: Phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba sah na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi bad ki para ri jong phi , phi kwah ban pyndonkam , kat kum ka mon U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba bha ha me bad ha ki hynmen jong me, ban leh ia kaba sah jong ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba leh kat kum ka mon U Blei jong phi .

en: The mountains saw thee , and they trembled : the overflowing of the water passed by : the deep uttered his voice , and lifted up his hands on high .
kha: Haba ki lumbah ki la ïohi ïa me , ki kyiuh ; ka um ka hap na ki sahit bneng . Ki um hapoh ka khyndew ki kyrhuh , bad ki jingat phyllung jong ki , ki kiew shalor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum ki la iohi ia me, bad ki la khih: ka jingtuid um kaba la iaid lyngba: ka jingjylliew ka la pynmih ia ka sur jong u, bad u la rah ia ki kti jong u sha jrong .

en: Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity  ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
kha: Me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei bad me isih ïa ka bymdei . Namarkata U Blei , U Blei jong me , u la jied ïa me bad u la ai ha me ïa ka jingkmen ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u ai ïa ki paralok jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ieit ia ka hok, bad me la shun ia ka jingbymhok; namarkata U Blei jong me, u la pynsleh ia me da ka umphniang jong ka jingkmen halor ki paralok jong me .

en: But neither he , nor his servants , nor the people of the land , did hearken unto the words of the  Lord  , which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah .
kha: Hynrei u Sedekaïah lymne ki rangbah synshar jong u lymne ki paidbah kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma u ne ki shakri jong u ne ki briew jong ka ri kim shym la sngap ia ki ktien U Trai kiba u la kren da u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Uei uba ai ha u briew ïa ka shyntur ? Uei uba pynlong ïa u uba kyllut ne u bymnang kren ? Uei uba ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa u , uba matlah ? Dei ma nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Mano ba la pynlong ia u briew uba dum ne uba sngap jar ne uba iohi ne uba matlah ? em ia nga U Trai ?

en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
kha: U ong ha kine ki rangbah ,  Ma nga , u syiem Serksis , nga la phah ïa ki shakri jong nga sha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ryngkat bad ka hukum , bad ka kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ka ! Aïu ka aiñ ka kren ba ngi dei ban leh ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi leh aiu ia ka mahadei Vashti katkum ka ain , namar ba kam shym la leh ia ka hukum jong u syiem Ahasuerus da ki kamra ?

en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;
kha: Baroh ar , u nongïathuhlypa bad uta uba kylli na u , kin ïoh ïa kajuh ka jingshah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin kit ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingbymhok jong ki: ka jingpynshitom jong u nongiathuhlypa kan long wat kum ka jingpynshitom ia uta uba wad ia u;

en: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka buit bashapoh jong ki bad u la jubab ,  Balei ba phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ? Wallam ïa ka sbai rupa , bad ai ba ngan khmih ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngin ai ne ngin ym ai ? Hynrei ma u haba u tip ia ka jingleh arsap jong ki, u la ong ha ki, Balei phi pynshoi ia nga ? wanrah ia nga ia ka pisa , ba ngan iohi ia ka .

en: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there  ; for that was the great high place : a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar .
kha: Ha kawei ka khep u la leit sha Gibeon ban ai jingkñia namar kata kaba don hangta ka long ka duwan kaba donnam tam . U la ai da ki spah tylli ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka por ba la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit sha Gibeon ban knia hangta ; namar kata ka long ka jaka kaba heh: shi hajar tylli ki jingknia thang ba u Solomon u la ainguh halor kata ka jingknia .

en: For unto every one that hath shall be given , and he shall have abundance : but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath .
kha: Naba ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ei ei , yn sa ai kham bun , bad un don kyrhai ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba khyndiat kaba u don yn shim noh na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha uno uno uba la shah ai bad un don ka jingbun: hynrei na uta u bym don yn shim noh wat ia kata kaba u don .

en: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee  ; for they will not hearken unto me : for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted .
kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ruh na ki paid Israel kiba mon ban shahshkor , naba kim shahshkor wat ïa nga ruh ; baroh na ki , ki long kiba mutlop bad kiba ehrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka iing Israel kan ym sngap ia me ; namar kin ym sngap ia nga: namar ka iing Israel baroh ka long kaba khlem akor bad kaba eh mynsiem .

en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .
kha: Ki Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad u shah ba ki Philistia kin synshar ïa ki sawphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai ; bad U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki Philistia sawphew snem .

en: But if they say thus , Come up unto us  ; then we will go up : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into our hand : and this shall be a sign unto us .
kha: Hynrei lada ki ong ba ngin leit sha ki , te ngin leit , namar kata kan long ka dak ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ki ong kumta , To wan shaneng ha ngi ; te ngin leit kiew: namar U Trai u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ngi: bad kane kan long ka dak ha ngi .

en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people , that they should be ready against that day .
kha: Ïa ki jingthoh ha ka jingpynbna dei ban pyntip paidbah ha kawei pa kawei ka probins , khnang ba baroh kin long ba la pynkhreh haba kata ka sngi kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynmih ia ka kopi jong ka jingthoh na ka bynta ka hukum ban ai ha man la ka jylla ha ki briew baroh , ba kin long kiba la pynkhreh pyrshah ia kata ka sngi .

en: And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .
kha: Nangta ki leit sha ka jaka ba la khot  Ki Pukri ,  ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lumlang ïa ki briew , bad ngan ai um ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta ki la leit sha Beer : kata ka long ka thliew kaba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses: To lum lang ia ki briew bad ngan ai um ia ki .

en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .
kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun ïapom jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ïa ka nongbah Ar ha Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki lum ka Arnon bashaneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka don ka ding kaba la mih na Heshbon, ka ding na ka shnong Sihon: ka la bam ia u Ar u Moab bad ki kynrad jong ki jaka ba jrong jong u Arnon .
