en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city , to drink water  ; but they were not satisfied : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ha ka jingtlot namar ka jingsliang , ki briew jong kiba bun ki nongbah ki la leit sha ka nongbah kaba ki kyrmen ban ïoh um , hynrei kim ïoh ka umdih ka ban biang . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ar ne lai tylli ki shnong ki la iaid sha kawei ka shnong, ban dih um ; hynrei kim shym la sngewhun: hynrei phim shym la wan phai sha nga , ong U Trai .

en: And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .
kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi wan ban kem koidi ïa u Samson bad ban leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la ong: Balei phi wan pyrshah ia ngi ? Ki la jubab: Ban teh ia u Samson ngi wan shaneng ban leh ia u kumba u la leh ia ngi .

en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
kha: Kam don ruh ha shiliang duriaw . Phim donkam ban da kylli , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit sha shiliang duriaw bad wallam ïa ka sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kam dei ruh shabar duriaw ba me dei ban ong , Mano ba leit sha shiliang duriaw na ka bynta jong ngi bad wanrah ia ka ha ngi ba ngin iohsngew ia ka bad leh ia kata ?

en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things , though ye know them , and be established in the present truth .
kha: Bad kumta ngan ïai pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang kine kiei kiei , wat la phi la tip lypa bad phi ïeng skhem ha ka jingshisha kaba phi la ïohpdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan ym sngewthuh bakla ban buh ia phi ha ka jingkynmaw ia kine kiei kiei, wat la phi tip ia ki, bad ban long kiba skhem ha ka jingshisha kaba mynta .

en: That thou appear not unto men to fast , but unto thy Father which is in secret : and thy Father , which seeth in secret , shall reward thee openly .
kha: khnang ba kiwei kin ym tip ba phi shahjingit — tang U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi , un tip . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me paw ha ki briew ban shah jingit, hynrei ha U Kpa jong me uba don ha kaba rieh: bad U Kpa jong me uba iohi ha kaba rieh un siew kylliang ia me ha kaba paw .

en: And the sons of Kohath  ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .
kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel . U Kohath u la im haduh shispah laiphew lai snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kohath ; Amram, bad u Izhar, bad u Hebron: bad ki snem jong ka jingim u Kohath ki long shispah laiphew lai snem .

en: Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .
kha: Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh sha ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jong nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ïa-im ha ka jingsuk . Bad U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Khatduh eh, ko para bangeit, ka bai kali . To long kiba janai, to long kiba suk, to long kiba don kawei ka jingmut, to im ha ka jingsuk ; bad U Blei jong ka jingieit bad ka jingsuk un don ryngkat bad phi .

en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali , and out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued after the Midianites .
kha: Nangta la khot ïa ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali , Asher , bad na ka jait Manasseh baroh ar bynta , ki beh kthong ïa ki Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la ialum lang na Naphtali bad na Asher bad na u Manasseh baroh bad ki la bud ia ki nong Midian .

en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice , he said ,  Father , into thy hands I commend my spirit :  and having said thus , he gave up the ghost .
kha: U Jisu u la pyrta ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko Pa ! Ha ki kti jong me nga aiti ïa la ka mynsiem !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u la ong, Ko Kpa, ha ki kti jong me nga iaroh ia ka mynsiem jong nga: bad haba u la ong kumta, u la aiti noh ia u ksuid .

en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :
kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ; wat bam ei ei bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai bakhuid bad phin pynshitom ia ki mynsiem jong phi: phin ym leh ei ei ha kata:

en: As former US President Abraham Lincoln had put it , Nearly all men can stand adversity , but if you want to test a mans character , give him power .
kha: Kumba u President barim jong ka US u Abraham Lincoln u la ong , La jan baroh ki briew ki lah ban shah ia ki jingeh , hynrei lada phi kwah ban tynjuh ia ka jinglong jong u briew , ai bor ia u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u President barim jong ka US u Abraham Lincoln u la buh ia ka, la jan baroh ki briew ki lah ban ieng ha ka jingeh, hynrei lada phi kwah ban tynjuh ia u briew, ai bor ia u.

en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .
kha: Kita ki nonglamktien ki poi ha Gibeah ha kaba u Saul u shong , bad haba ki la ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kata ka khubor , baroh ki ïalynñiar da ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nonglam khubor ki la wan sha Gibeah u Saul , bad ki la iathuh ia ka khubor ha ki shkor jong ki briew : bad ki briew baroh ki la pynkiew ia la ka sur bad ki la iam .

en: And he said ,  Abba , Father , all things are possible unto thee  ; take away this cup from me : nevertheless not what I will , but what thou wilt .
kha: Ko Pa ,  u duwai ,  Ko Pa jong nga ! Baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba lah ha me . Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom . Pynban ym ïa kaei kaba nga kwah , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Abba, ko Kpa, kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba lah ha me; wat la katta ruh ym ia kaei kaba nga mon hynrei ia kaei kaba me mon .

en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth  ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully  ; they have gathered themselves together against me .
kha: Ki briew ki ñiewbeiñ ïa nga ; ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga bad ki thap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia tyngkhuh bad nga da ka shyntur jong ki ; ki la pynkhih ia nga da ka jingsngewsih ; ki la ia lum lang pyrshah ia nga .

en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : a good understanding have all they that do his commandments : his praise endureth for ever .
kha: Ka lynti ban long uba stad ka long ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ; u ai ka jingbishar kaba beit ïa baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . U long uba dei ban ïaroh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng ia U Trai ka long ka jingsdang jong ka jingstad: ka jingsngewthuh kaba bha ka don baroh kiba leh ia ki hukum jong u: ka jingiaroh jong u ka neh junom .

en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;
kha: Haba u Joseph u wan ha la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki law noh ïa ka sopti jynsur jong u kaba jrong kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Joseph u la wan sha ki hynmen jong u, ba ki la weng noh ia u Joseph na ka jainkup jong u, ka jainkup jong u kaba bun rong kaba don ha u ; .

en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .
kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ki ka par baroh kawei ka met jong nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khnam jong U Blei baroh ki don hapoh jong nga: ki jingtieng jong U Blei ki buh ia lade ha ka jingpynbeit pyrshah ia nga .

en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .
kha: Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh pyrshah ia ka ia ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem jong ki Media , ki rangbah jong ka bad ki nongsynshar jong ka baroh .

en: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread : and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work therein .
kha: Nangta sa hynriew sngi phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad wat trei ei ei ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi men bam ia u kpu khlem thied: bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kan long ka jingiaseng kaba skhem ha U Trai U Blei jong me: men ym leh ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
kha: Hynrei ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la lah thung ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad kaba biang bha ka um ba kumta u lah ban sei ki sla bad pynmih ki sohwaiñ bad long u dieng sohwaiñ uba itynnat eh .
translated_en_to_kha: La thung ia ka ha ka khyndew kaba bha da ki um kiba heh , ba kan pynmih ia ki tnat bad ba kan sei soh , ba kan long u sohjew uba bha .

en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .
kha: Bad na dang khynnah , Me tip sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba lah ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba naduh u khynnah me la ithuh ia ki jingthoh bakhuid kiba lah ban pynlong ia me uba stad haduh ka jingpynim lyngba ka jingngeit kaba don ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: All who put their faith in Jesus can have their sins forgiven and receive everlasting life .—1 Timothy 2 :5 , 6  ; John 3 :16  ; Romans 5 :18 , 19 .
kha: Baroh kiba don jingngeit ha u Jisu kin ïoh map na ki pop bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :18 , 19 .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba buh ia ka jingngeit jong ki ha U Jisu ki lah ban ioh ia ki pop jong ki bad ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut .1 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :18 , 19 .

en: And all the city was moved , and the people ran together : and they took Paul , and drew him out of the temple : and forthwith the doors were shut .
kha: Ka jingkulmar ka la pur ha ka nongbah baroh kawei , bad ki briew ki la ïamareh lang , ki la kem ïa u Paul , bad ki la patan ïa u shabar jong ka Templ . Shisyndon hi la khang ïa ki jingkhang jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong baroh kawei ka la khih , bad ki briew ki la mareh lang: bad ki la shim ia u Paul bad ki la tan ia u na ka tempi: bad mar kumta hi la khang ia ki jingkhang .

en: Which was the son of Maath , which was the son of Mattathias , which was the son of Semei , which was the son of Joseph , which was the son of Juda ,
kha: u khun jong u Maath , u khun jong u Mattathias , u khun jong u Semein , u khun jong u Josekh , u khun jong u Joda ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Maath uba long u khun u Mathaiah uba long u khun u Semei uba long u khun u Joseph uba long u khun u Judah .

en: And he is the head of the body , the church : who is the beginning , the firstborn from the dead ; that in all things he might have the preeminence .
kha: U long u khlieh jong ka balang kaba long ka met jong u ; u long u tynrai jong ka jingim jong ka . U long U Khun uba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , khnang ba tang ma u hi un ïoh ïa ka bynta kaba nyngkong ha kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u long u khlieh jong ka met , ka balang: uba long ka jingsdang, u khun nyngkong na kiba iap ; ba ha kiei kiei baroh u lah ban don ka jinglong rangbah .

en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ass or his ox fall down by the way , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again .
kha: Lada ka kada ne ka masi u para Israel ka kyllon , wat shu ieh ïa ka kumta ; ïarap ïa u ban pynïeng pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iohi ia ka tdong jong u hynmen jong me ne u masi jong u ba u hap ha lynti , bad to buhrieh ia lade na ki: me dei ban iarap shisha ia u ban rah biang ia ki .

en: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
kha: ha ka rta kaba khathynriew snem , bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Shiphew snem ka rta jong u haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar arphew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Jecoliah jong ka Jerusalem .

en: So likewise ye , except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood , how shall it be known what is spoken ? for ye shall speak into the air .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , kumno uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba phi kren lada ka khubor jong phi ha ki thylliej bapher kam long kaba shai ? Ki ktien jong phi kin jah noh ha suiñ!
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumjuh ruh phi , lait noh tang da ki ktien kiba suk ban sngewthuh , kumno yn sa tip ia kaei kaba la kren ? namar phin kren ha ka Iyer .

en: This is the feeling that inspires all of us to stand up as a token of respect whenever we hear the words ' Vande Mataram ' and ' Bharat Mata Ki Jai '
kha: Kane ka long ka jingsngew kaba pynshlur ia ngi baroh ban ieng kum ka dak ka jingburom man la ka por ba ngi iohsngew ia ki kyntien ‘ Vande Mataram ’ bad ‘ Bharat Mata Ki Jai ’.
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka dei ka jingsngew kaba pynshlur ia ngi baroh ban ieng kum ka dak jong ka jingburom man ka por ba ngi iohsngew ia ki kyntien ' Vande Mataram ' bad ' Bharat Mata Ki Jai ' .

en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .
kha: La don kawei ka nongïathuhlypa kaba la tymmen bha , ka riewkynthei kaba kyrteng ka Anna , ka khun jong u Phanuel na ka jait Asher . Ka la shongkurim tang hynñiew snem bad mynta ka la dap phraphew saw snem ka rta . Kam ju mih shuh na ka Templ ; mynsngi bad mynmiet ka la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba shahjingit bad duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long ka riewkynthei kaba saw snem bad saw snem , kaba khlem mih na ka tempi , hynrei ka la shakri ia U Blei da ki jingleh niam bad ki jingduwai miet bad sngi .

en: Senior party leaders will be assigned the responsibility of supervising the campaign in the 13 Assembly constituencies where bypolls are to be held .
kha: Ki nongialam ba rangbah jong ka party kin ioh ia ka jingkitkhlieh ban peit ia ka jingialap elekshon ha ki 13 tylli ki konstitwensi jong ka Assembly ha kaba yn pynlong ia ka bypoll .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn aiti ia ki nongialam jong ka seng kiba kham rangbah ban peit ia ka jingialap ha ki 13 tylli ki Assembly constituency ha kaba yn pynlong ia ki bypoll .

en: And behold at eveningtide trouble  ; and before the morning he is not . This is the portion of them that spoil us , and the lot of them that rob us .
kha: Ha ka por janmiet ki pynlong ka jingpyntriem , hynrei kat ban da step ki la jah noh . Kata ka dei ka kupar jong uwei uwei uba lute ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por janmiet u la shah pynshitom bein bad shuwa ban step um long . Kane ka dei ka bynta jong kito kiba pynsniew ia ngi , bad ka bynta jong kito kiba lute ia ngi .

en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
kha: Uta u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong u ha U Trai, ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, wat u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba palat .

en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee  ; this is thy wickedness , because it is bitter , because it reacheth unto thine heart .
kha: Ko Judah , pha la wallam ïa kane halor lade da ka rukom kaba pha la im bad da kiei kiei kiba pha la leh . Ka pop jong pha ka la pynjia ïa kane ka jingjynjar ; ka la dung ïa pha lyngba ka dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong me bad ki jingleh jong me ki la pynmih ia kine kiei kiei ha me; kane ka long ka jingsniew jong me, namar ka poi sha ka dohnud jong me .

en: Servants , obey in all things your masters according to the flesh ; not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but in singleness of heart , fearing God :
kha: Ko ki shakri , to kohnguh ïa ki kynrad jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh , ym tang haba ki ïohi ïa phi namar ba phi kwah ban ïoh pynsngewbha ïa ki ; hynrei to leh ïa ka da ka dohnud bashisha namar ka jingsheptieng burom jong phi ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri , kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh jong phi katkum ka doh ; ym da ka jingshakri khmat, kum ki nongpynkhuid ; hynrei ha ka jinglong marwei jong ka dohnud , da kaba sheptieng ia U Blei :

en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .
kha: Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi long kiba la jop , te hynrei ba phin ïoh leh ïa kaba dei , wat la ka i kumba ngi long kiba la shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ei ei kaba sniew; ym ba ngin paw ba ngi la mynjur, hynrei ba phin leh ia kaba hok, wat la ngi long kum ki nongpynrem .

en: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered , and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan , until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan .
kha: Ki thom sa thom pyrshah ïa u haduh ba ki da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti jong ki khun Israel ka la roi bad ka la jop ia u Jabin u syiem Kanaan haduh ba ki la pynjot ia u Jabin u syiem Kanaan .

en: Then said I , Whither goest thou ? And he said unto me , To measure Jerusalem , to see what is the breadth thereof , and what is the length thereof .
kha: Shano phin leit ?  nga la kylli .  Ban thew ïa ka Jerusalem ,  u la jubab ,  ban ïohi katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingïar jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , Me leit ? Bad u la ong ha nga, Ban thew ia ka Jerusalem , ban iohi kaei ka jingjrong jong ka bad kaei ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .
kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba kamai ïa lade da kaba khwai ha ka Nile un ud khuslai bad un ïam ; ki khwai bad ki jar jong ki kin long ki bymmyntoi shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongtong dohkha ruh kin iam , bad baroh kiba bret ia ki angle sha ki wah kin iam , bad kito kiba pynphriang ia ki net ha ki um kin sa jah noh .

en: And for Aaron s sons thou shalt make coats , and thou shalt make for them girdles , and bonnets shalt thou make for them , for glory and for beauty .
kha: Suh ki sopti , ki panpoh , bad ki tupia na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ba kin ishongkun shongkhia bad itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang Aaron men shna ia ki jainkup bad men shna ia ki da ki shyieng bad ki shyieng na ka bynta jong ki, na ka bynta ka burom bad na ka bynta ka jingitynnad .

en: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
kha: Men rah bad me ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga , ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka Templ jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban kit ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u syiem bad ki nongai jingmut jong u ki la tyrwa da kaba laitluid ha U Blei jong ki Israel , uba ka jaka shong jaka sah jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .

en: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
kha: Kumta yn don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dei ban long 8 tylli ki board bad ki socket rupa jong ki, shiphew tylli ki soket hapoh kawei ka board bad ar tylli ki soket hapoh kawei pat ka board .

en: And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .
kha: U angel u hukum ïa u ,  Buh ïa ka doh bad u kpu halor une u mawsiang , bad theh ïa ka syrwa halor jong ki .  U Gideon u leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Blei u la ong ha u, To shim ia ka doh bad ki cake ki bym don thied bad to buh ia ki halor une u maw bad theh ia ka umsoh . Bad u la leh kumta .

en: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles  ; and he did eat and drink , and rose up , and went his way : thus Esau despised his birthright .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u ai kpu bad katto katne ka syrwa jhur ïa u . U ruh u la bam bad dih , bad nangta u ïeng joit bad u leit noh . Kata ka long kumno ba u Iso u sumar ïa la ki hok kum u khun nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jakob u la ai ia u Iso u kpu bad u sohjew ; bad u la bam bad u la dih, bad u la ieng bad u la leit noh: kumta u Iso u la leh bein ia ka hok ba nyngkong jong u .

en: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
kha: U khun pongka    bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U bastard un ym rung ha ka jingiaseng U Trai ; wat ha ka pateng kaba shiphew jong u un ym rung ha ka jingiaseng U Trai .

en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour , and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me : come therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people .
kha: Ngan ai ïa phi da ka jingai burom kaba khraw bad leh ïa kano kano kaba phi ong . Sngewbha wan bad tim ïa kine ki briew na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan kyntiew ia me sha ka burom kaba khraw shibun, bad ngan leh ia kaei kaei kaba me ong ha nga: to wan namarkata, nga kyrpad ia me, to tim ia nga ia une u briew .

en: When they stood , these stood  ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also : for the spirit of the living creature was in them .
kha: Haba ki kherub ki sangeh , ki shalyntem ruh ki sangeh ; bad haba ki kherub ki her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki , namar ki kherub ki pynïaid ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la ieng, kine ki la ieng ; bad haba la pynkiew ia ki ruh: namar ka mynsiem jong u jingthaw ba im ka la don ha ki .

en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves , according unto the word of the  Lord  which he commanded Joshua .
kha: Ki Israel ki shim ha lade ïa ki jingri bad ïa ki mar ki mata ba ki ïoh kurup na ka nongbah , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki masi bad ki jinglute jong kata ka shnong ki Israel ki la shim ia ka jingbam ha lade , kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u la hukum ia u Joshua .

en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .
kha: Hynrei , kine ki briew , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kito kiei kiei kiba ki tip da ka bor tipthuh kum ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine ki kren sniew ia kiei kiei kiba kim tip: hynrei ia kaei kaba ki tip da ka jinglong tynrai, kum ki mrad ba sniew, ha kita kiei kiei ki pynsniew ia lade .

en: Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .
kha: Ka Judah bad ka Israel ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha da u kew , ka ngap , ka umphniang Olib , bad ki musli musla .
translated_en_to_kha: Judah bad ka ri Israel jong me: ki la khaii ha ka iew jong me ia u kew Minth bad u Pannag bad ka umsoh bad ka umphniang bad ka umphniang .

en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .
kha: U Paul u la rung ha ka synagog bad ha ki lai bnai u la kren shlur bad ki paidbah , u da pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynngeit ïa ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit shapoh ka synagog bad u la kren shlur haduh lai bnai, da kaba ialeh pyrshah bad pynsngewthuh ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad ka hima U Blei .

en: The earth mourneth and languisheth : Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down : Sharon is like a wilderness  ; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits .
kha: Ka ri ka sah shrah bad long ri shyiap . Ki khlaw ka Lebanon ki la tyrkhong , ka them baseisoh ka Sharon ka long kum ka ri shyiap , bad ha Bashan bad ha u lum Karmel ki sla ki hap na ki dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ka iam bad ka sngewsih: Ka Lebanon ka sngewlehrain bad ka la shah pynhiar dor: U Sharon u long kum ka ri khlaw ; bad u Basan bad u Carmel ki pynkhih ia ki soh jong ki .

en: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons  ; Simri the chief , ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief  ; )
kha: Na ka kur jong u Merari la don u Hosah , uba don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shimri , ( u kpa jong u , u la pynlong nongïalam ïa u wat la um dei u khun nyngkong ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u Hosah , na ki khun shynrang jong ka Merari, u don ki khun shynrang;

en: And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?
kha: Hadien nangta , bun ki jaitbynriew nongwei kin ïaid lynti bad kin ïakylli uwei ïa uwei pat balei ba nga , U  Trai  nga la leh katne katne ïa kane ka nongbah kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki jaitbynriew kin iaid lyngba kane ka shnong bad kin ong uwei pa uwei ha la u paramarjan: Balei ba U Trai u la leh kumta ia kane ka shnong kaba khraw ?

en: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished , they brought him to Jerusalem , to present him to the Lord  ;
kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa u Joseph bad ka Mari ban pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid , kumba ka Hukum u Moses ka dawa . Kumta ki la leit rah ïa u khunlung sha Jerusalem ban aiti ïa u sha U Trai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la pyndep ia ki sngi jong ka jingpynkhuid jong ka kat kum ka hukum u Moses , ki la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem , ban pyni ia u ha U Trai;

en: John bare witness of him , and cried , saying , This was he of whom I spake , He that cometh after me is preferred before me : for he was before me .
kha: U Ïoannis u la kren shaphang jong u . U la pyrta jam ,  Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren shaphang jong u , mynba nga la ong , ‘ U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la shah pynshisha ia u, bad u la pyrta, u la ong, Une u long uta uba nga kren: Uta uba wan hadien jong nga u kham sngewtynnad ha khmat jong nga: namar u la don ha khmat jong nga .

en: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit , and worketh miracles among you , doeth he it by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
kha: Hato U Blei u ai ïa U Mynsiem bad leh ïa ki kambah hapdeng jong phi namar ba phi leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ne namar ba phi ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba shakri ia U Mynsiem bad uba leh ia ki kambah hapdeng jong phi , u leh ia kata da ki kam jong ka hukum ne da ka jingsngap ia ka jingngeit ?

en: Therefore it was not a solid national phalanx that , of itself and out of its own feeling of solidarity , rushed to the battlefields in August 1914 .
kha: Namarkata kam dei ka kynhun shipai kaba skhem kaba , na lade hi bad namar ka jingsngew iatylli jong ka hi , ka la mareh sha ki madan thma ha u bnai August 1914 .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kam shym la long ka phalanx kaba skhem kaba la pynlong hi bad na ka jingsngew jong ka hi jong ka jingiatylli , ka la mareh sha ki madan thma ha u snem 1914 .

en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid  ; and she waited on Naaman s wife .
kha: Ha kawei na ki jingleit thombor pyrshah ïa ki Israel , ki Syria ki la ringmraw ïa kawei ka khynnah rit Israel , kaba la long ka shakri jong ka tnga jong u Naaman .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Syria ki la leit noh da ki kompeni , bad ki la rah noh ia ka jinglong mraw na ka ri Israel khyndiat beg bad ka la ap ia ka tnga jong u Naaman .

en: Take therefore no thought for the morrow : for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself . Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof .
kha: Kumta wat khuslai ïa kaba lashai ; kan don bun ki jingkhuslai ki jong ka hi . Ym donkam ban kynton halor ki jingjynjar ba kawei pa kawei ka sngi ka wallam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyrkhat ia ka sngi kaba lashai: namar ka sngi kan pyrkhat ia kiei kiei hi . Ka biang ia ka sngi ka long kaba sniew jong ka .

en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .
kha: Nangta ki shong ha madan bad u haduh hynñiew sngi hynñiew miet khlem kren shikyntien ruh , namar ki la ïohi haduh katno u shah jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shong bad u ha ka khyndew hynriew sngi hynriew miet , bad ym don ba kren ia u: namar ki la iohi ba ka jingsngewsih jong u ka long kaba khraw shibun .

en: For they all saw him , and were troubled . And immediately he talked with them , and saith unto them ,  Be of good cheer : it is I  ; be not afraid .
kha: Ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta haba ki la ïohi ïa u . Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la kren ïa ki ,  Long shlur !  u la ong .  Dei ma nga . Wat sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar baroh ki la iohi ia u, bad ki la sngewsih . Bad mar kumta hi u la kren bad ki, bad u la ong ha ki, To long kiba sngewbha: ka long kaba nga shu tieng .

en: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea , the waters of the great deep  ; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over ?
kha: Dei ma me ruh uba la pynrngad ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ka lynti ïaid lyngba ki um , khnang ba kito kiba me pyllait im kin ïoh ïaid lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me dei ma me uba la tyrkhong ia ka duriaw , ki um jong ka duriaw kaba jylliew bha ?

en: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .
kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit sha kata ka kper , u da ïalam bad u ïa ka kynhun ki shipai Rom , bad katto katne ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ; ki la long kiba la kieng atiar bad ki la rah ïa ki sharak bad ki dongmusa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judas nangta, haba u la ioh ia ka kynhun ki briew bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi , u wan shata ryngkat bad ki sharak bad ki tiar ialeh .

en: We are encouraged when we hear the experiences of those who are successfully meeting the challenge of living as Christians in these difficult times .
kha: Ngi ïoh jingshlur haba ngi ïohsngew ïa ki jingjia ba la mad da kito kiba la jop ïa ki jingeh ban im kum ki Khristan ha kine ki sngi ba lanot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngewtynnad haba ngi iohsngew ia ki jingshem jong kito kiba jop ban iakynduh ia ka jingeh jong ka jingim kum ki Khristan ha kine ki por kiba eh .

en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Alas , my lord , I beseech thee , lay not the sin upon us , wherein we have done foolishly , and wherein we have sinned .
kha: u la ong ha u Moses ,  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat pynlong ïa ngi ban shah pynshitom namar ka jingleh pop ha ka jingbieit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la ong ha u Moses, Ah kynrad jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, wat buh ia ka pop halor jong ngi, ha kaba ngi la leh bieit bad ha kaba ngi la leh pop .

en: The Jews answered him , saying , For a good work we stone thee not  ; but for blasphemy  ; and because that thou , being a man , makest thyself God .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  Ngim kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me namar kano kano na ki kam babha , hynrei namar ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei jong me ! Me long tang u briew , hynrei me pyrshang ban pynlong Blei ïa lade !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la jubab ia u, ki da ong: Na ka bynta ka kam kaba bha ngim ju maw ia me; hynrei namar ba me long u briew, me pynlong ia lade U Blei .

en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .
kha: Me don bun ki nongtrei . Ki don ki rangbah ki ban trei ha ki par maw , bad ki don ki misteri maw bad misteri dieng , bad shibun ki nongtrei kti ha ki jait kam baroh ba ki lah ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki don ki nongtrei bad me ha ka jingbun , ki nongrep bad ki nongtrei maw bad ki dieng , bad ki briew kiba sniew baroh na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka kam .

en: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when ye shall be scattered through the countries .
kha: Ngan ailad ïa ki katto katne ban ïohlait na ka waitlam bad kin sakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad kin im kum kiba shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan iehnoh ia ka jingsahkut, ba phin ioh katto katne kiba lait na ka waitlam hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , haba phin sa shah pynpra noh lyngba ki ri .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kylli ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew la kaba kum kane kaei kaei ka la ju jia mynshuwa . Ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba shyrkhei !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai u la ong mynta hapdeng ki nongwei: ka theisotti jong ki Israel ka la leh ia kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei shibun .

en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
kha: U Moses u ong ha ki Israel ,  U  Trai  u la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u khun ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki khun Israel: Peit, U Trai u la khot da ka kyrteng u Bezaleel u khun Uiri u khun u Hur na ka jait Judah;

en: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .
kha: Ki paidbah byllien na Galilaïa bad Dekapolis , na Jerusalem , Judia bad na ka ri ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan ki la bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah kiba bun ki la bud ia u na Galilaia, bad na Decapolis, bad na Jerusalem, bad na Judaea, bad na sha shiliang ka Jordan .

en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .
kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad u ïathuh ha u syiem bad U syiem u ong ,  Lada u don tang marwei , u wanrah ka khubor babha .  Uta uba mareh u nang jan nang jan .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap u la pyrta bad u la iathuh ha u syiem . Bad u syiem u la ong, Lada u don marwei, ka don ka khubor ha ka shyntur jong u . U la wan stet bad u la wan hajan .

en: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned sixteen years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Joash u Syiem ka Judah , u Jehoash u khun jong u Jehoahas u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong u Joash u syiem Judah u la sdang ia u Jehoash u khun u Jehoah ban synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria , bad u la synshar shiphew snem .

en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee , and peace be to thine house , and peace be unto all that thou hast .
kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ha u Nabal :  U Dabid u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , ko paralok jong nga , lem bad ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi bad ïa baroh kiba dei ki jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta phin ong ha uta uba im ha ka jingroi jingpar, Ka jingsuk kan long ha me, bad ka jingsuk kan long ha ka iing jong me, bad ka jingsuk kan long ha baroh kaba me don .

en: And because he loved thy fathers , therefore he chose their seed after them , and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt  ;
kha: Namar ka jingieit ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la jied ïa phi , bad da ka borbah jong u , u hi da lade u la wan ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba u ieit ia ki kpa tymmen jong me , namarkata u la jied ia u symbai jong ki hadien jong ki , bad u la pynmih ia me ha khmat jong u da ka bor ba khraw jong u na Ijipt;

en: And he said unto him , See , I have accepted thee concerning this thing also , that I will not overthrow this city , for the which thou hast spoken .
kha: U jubab ,  Kata ruh ka biang hi . Ngan nym pynjot ïa kata ka nongrit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u: Peit nga la pdiang ia me shaphang kane ruh, ba ngan ym pynhap ia kane ka shnong, na ka bynta kaba me la kren .

en: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition : and , behold , if the witness be a false witness , and hath testified falsely against his brother  ;
kha: Kita ki nongbishar kin tohkit bniah ïa kata ka mokotduma ; bad lada uta u briew u la mudui lamler ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongbishar kin leh ia ka jingkylli kaba jur: bad, ha khmih, lada u sakhi u long u nongsakhi lamler, bad u la sakhi lamler pyrshah ia u hynmen jong u;

en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain , my speech shall distil as the dew , as the small rain upon the tender herb , and as the showers upon the grass :
kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan hap kum ki jingjaw slap , bad kan jreiñ ha khyndew kum ka umjer . Ki ktien jong nga kin hap kum u  lap praw ha ki jingthung ba dang lung , kum u slap ñiup ñiup ha u phlang ba dang lung .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan hap kum u slap, ka jingkren jong nga kan sa tyrkhong kum ka dewbilat, kum u slap uba rit halor u jingthung uba jem bad kum ki um ha u phlang:

en: And fear not them which kill the body , but are not able to kill the soul : but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell .
kha: Wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym lah ban pynïap ïa ka mynsiem ; hynrei to sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba lah ban pynjot ïa ka met bad ka mynsiem ha dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat tieng ia kita kiba pyniap ia ka met , hynrei kim lah ban pyniap ia ka mynsiem: hynrei kham tieng ia uta uba lah ban pynjot ia ka mynsiem bad ka met ha dujok .

en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .
kha: Ki jingbuh jingthoh ïa baroh ki longïing jong ka jait Issakhar ki don phraphew hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong ki napdeng ki longiing baroh ki long ki briew kiba shlur, kiba la khein ha baroh da ki jaitbynriew jong ki saw hajar .

en: If any man trespass against his neighbour , and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear , and the oath come before thine altar in this house :
kha: Haba u briew u shah mudui ba u leh bymdei ïa uwei pat , bad la wallam sha ka duwan jong me ha kane ka Templ ban shim ïa ka jingsmai ba u long uba lui lui ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u iaid pyrshah ia u paramarjan jong u, bad la buh ia ka jingsmai halor jong u ban pynlong ia u ban smai , bad ka jingsmai ka wan ha khmat ka ainguh jong me ha kane ka iing:

en: For thou hadst cast me into the deep , in the midst of the seas  ; and the floods compassed me about : all thy billows and thy waves passed over me .
kha: Me la bret ïa nga shapoh ki jingjylliew , sha trai duh jong ka duriaw , ha kaba ki um ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad baroh ki jingat phyllung bakhlaiñ ki tyllun halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la bret ia nga shapoh duriaw, hapdeng ki duriaw ; bad ki wah ki la ker sawdong ia nga: ki bniat jong me baroh bad ki um jong me ki la iaid halor jong nga .

en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand , then I will utterly destroy their cities .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la smai ha U  Trai  :  Lada me shah ïa ngi ban jop ïa kine ki briew , ngin pynkyntang lut khlem kyndon ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong jong ki sha me bad ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la kular ha U Trai bad ki la ong: Lada me aiti shisha ia une u briew ha ka kti jong nga , te ngan pynjot lut ia ki shnong jong ki .

en: Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , khie leit sha ka jaka bakhuid ka Bethel bad leh pop , lada phi hap ban leh kumta ! Khie leit sha Gilgal bad to leh pop da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi baroh ! Ïaid shaphrang bad wallam ïa ki mrad ban kñia na ka step sha ka step , bad wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi man la ka sngi kaba lai .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan sha Bethel , bad to iaid lait ia ka jingleh be-ijot ha Gilgal bad wanrah ia ki jingknia jong phi man ka step , bad ka shiphew jong phi hadien lai snem:

en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka shiphew snem, ha ka taiew kaba nyngkong, ha ka sngi kaba hynriew jong u bnai, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: And there will I nourish thee  ; for yet there are five years of famine  ; lest thou , and thy household , and all that thou hast , come to poverty .
kha: Lada phi don ha Goshen , nga lah ban peit ban sumar ïa phi . Ka  nemsniew kan neh sa san snem , bad ngam kwah ba ma phi , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , bad ki jingri jingdup jong phi baroh kin shahthngan .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ngan ai bam ia me ; namar ki don san snem ka jingkyrduh ; ioh ma me bad ka iing jong me bad ka jingdon jong me baroh .

en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .
kha: Hynrei haba u briew uba kham khlaiñ u tur ïaleh ïa u bad jop ïa u , u kit noh ïa baroh ki tiar ïaleh kiba u trai u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kaei kaba u la lute .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u kham khlain ban ia u un wan ha u bad un jop ia u , u shim na u ia ki tiar ialeh jong u baroh ha kaba u la shaniah , bad u phiah ia ki jinglute jong u .

en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,
kha: Haba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynjop thma ïa phi bad phi ïohkem koidi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me leit sha ki nongshun jong me bad U Trai U Blei jong me u la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong me bad me la shim ia ki mraw .

en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Ahab u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; bad u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahasaiah u khun u Ahab u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel ha Samaria ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Judah bad u la synshar ar snem halor ki Israel .

en: And he said unto them ,  The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ki syiem jong kiba mane blei thala ki don ka bor halor ki briew jong ki , bad ki nongsynshar ki kam ïa ka nam ba ki dei ‘ Ki paralok jong u Paidbah .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Ki syiem ki Jutang ki leh ia ka jingsynshar halor jong ki ; bad ia kita kiba leh ia ka bor halor jong ki la khot ki nonglehbha .

en: And David said to Abiathar the priest , Ahimelech s son , I pray thee , bring me hither the ephod . And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Abiathar , u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Ahimelekh ,  Wanrah ha nga ka ephod ,  bad u Abiathar u wanrah ïa ka ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abhiatar u lyngdoh, "Nga kyrpad ia me, to wanrah ia nga hangne ka Ephod . U Abhiatar u la wanrah ia ka Ephod ha u Dabid .

en: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he cast into the sea , than that he should offend one of these little ones .
kha: Kan kham bha ïa u lada la teh ha ka ryndang jong u ïa u mawtylliat uba heh bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw ban ïa kaba ma u , u pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la kham bha ia u ba u maw maw u la sahkut ha ka ryndang jong u , bad u la bret shapoh duriaw , ban ia kaba u dei ban pynsngewsih ia uwei na kine kiba rit .

en: But when the husbandmen saw the son , they said among themselves , This is the heir  ; come , let us kill him , and let us seize on his inheritance .
kha: Hynrei haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u khun , ki la ong ha lade , ‘ Une u long u khun jong u trai . Ale , to ngin pynïap ïa u , bad ngin ïoh ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki nongrep ki la iohi ia u khun shynrang, ki la ong hapdeng jong ki, Une u dei u nongioh pateng; to ngin pyniap ia u bad ngin shim ia ka pateng jong u .

en: Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .
kha: Ïathuh ha u syiem ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’  U Elijah u la leh kumba la hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata u ong kumta u Trai , Wat wan hiar na kata ka jingthiah ha kaba me la leit shaneng, hynrei thikna ba phin iap noh . Bad u Elijah u la leit noh .

en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn  ; and his disciples were an hungred , and began to pluck the ears of corn , and to eat .
kha: Ym slem hadien U Jisu u la ïaid lyngba ki katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la thngan , ba kumta ki la sdang ban ïakheit ïa ki rynjup kew bad bam ïa ki symboh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la leit sha ka sngi Sabha lyngba u kew ; bad ki synran jong u ki la thngan , bad ki la sdang ban ot ia ki shkor kew bad ban bam .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .
kha: Ong ha ki Israel ba kin wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh . Pdiang ïa kino kino ki jingainguh kat kiba uno uno u mon ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel ba kin wanrah ia nga ka jingainguh: na uwei pa uwei uba ai da ka mon sngewbha da ka dohnud jong u phin shim ia ka jingainguh jong nga .

en: And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .
kha: U la jubab ,  Kine ki long ki sawlyer , ki dang shu lah wan na ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la jubab bad u la ong ha nga: Kine ki long ki saw tylli ki mynsiem jong ki bneng kiba mih na kaba ieng ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .
kha: Bad tharai u paralok jong phi un jubab napoh ïing , ‘ Wat pynwit ïa nga ! Ïa ka jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban khie bad ai ei ei ha phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u na shapoh un jubab bad ong: Wat ia nga: ka jingkhang mynta ka la khang, bad ki khun jong nga ki don bad nga ha ka jingthiah ; ngam lah ban khie bad ai ia me .

en: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .
kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Te U Blei u la ai ruh ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban lait im !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei , ki la bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki bad ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei da kaba ong: Te U Blei ruh u la ai ia ka jingkylla kaba mut sha ka jingim .

en: Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ki nongap phira jong ka Templ la pynïabynta ha ki kynhun kynhun kat kum ki longïing , bad la pynkhamti ïa ki kam ha ka Templ kumba long lem kiwei pat ki Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng kine ki don ki jingphiah jong ki nongrah khmat, wat hapdeng ki rangbah kiba don ki ward iwei ia iwei pat, ban shakri ha iing U Trai .

en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness ; whose end shall be according to their works .
kha: Kumta kam long kaei kaei kaba khraw lada ki shakri jong u ki thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki shakri jong ka hok . Ha kaba khatduh kin ïoh thik kumta ïa kaei kaba ki jingleh jong ki , ki dei hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kam long kaba khraw lada ki myntri jong u ruh kin kylla long ki myntri jong ka hok ; kiba ka jingkut jong ki kan long katkum ki kam jong ki .

en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Arise , get thee down unto the host  ; for I have delivered it into thine hand .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Gideon ,  Khie joit bad tur ïaleh ïa kata ka jaka sher dara ; nga ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kajuh ka miet, ba U Trai u la ong ha u, To khie, to hiar sha ka host ; namar nga la aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong me .

en: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning , that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope .
kha: Ïa kiei kiei ba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , la thoh ban hikai ïa ngi , khnang ba ngin don ïa ka jingkyrmen lyngba ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur kiba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ai ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh mynshuwa la thoh na ka bynta ka jingpule jong ngi , ba ngi lyngba ka jingshaniah bad ka jingpyntngen jong ki jingthoh ngi lah ban don ka jingkyrmen .

en: Assemble yourselves , and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O  Lord .
kha: To pynkloi bad to wan , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong , bad ïalumlang ha ka them .’   To phah , A  Trai  , ïa ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniasoh ia lade , bad to wan, phi baroh ki nongwei , bad to lum lang ia lade sawdong: phi pynlong ia ki riewshlur jong me ban wan hiar , ko Trai .

en: When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba bud ïa u ,  Nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïano ha Israel lem bad ka jingngeit kaba kum kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata, u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki kiba bud, Hooid nga ong ha phi, ngam shym la shem ia ka jingngeit kaba khraw kum kata, em, ym ha Israel .

en: But with thee will I establish my covenant  ; and thou shalt come into the ark , thou , and thy sons , and thy wife , and thy sons  wives with thee .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynlong ka jutang bad me . Khie rung shapoh kata ka lieng bad la ka tnga jong me , ki khun shynrang jong me lem bad ki tnga jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei bad me ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga ; bad me phin wan shapoh ka synduk , ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me .

en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .
kha: Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynmaw kumno phi baroh phi la kloi ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkyiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingieit hapoh jong u ka kham bun ia phi, katba u kynmaw ia ka jingsngap jar jong phi baroh, kumno da ka jingtieng bad ka jingkhihwin phi la pdiang ia u .

en: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee thence : therefore I command thee to do this thing .
kha: Kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga la ai ha phi ïa kane ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban kynmaw ba me la long u mraw ha Ijipt, bad U Trai U Blei jong me u la siewspah ia me nangta: namarkata nga hukum ia me ban leh ia kane ka kam .

en: And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpaw ha ki kumno nga pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa ki jingrai bahok jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka burom jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin iohi ia ka jingbishar jong nga ba nga la pyndep , bad ka kti jong nga ba nga la buh halor jong ki .

en: And Amnon was so vexed , that he fell sick for his sister Tamar  ; for she was a virgin  ; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her .
kha: U shoh jingieit ïa ka haduh katta katta , haduh ba u da kem pang , naba um i don lad da kumno kumno ban ïoh ïa ka ; kum ka kynthei kaba dang sotti , ym shym shah ïa ka ban ïakynduh ïa ki shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amnon u la sngewsih haduh katta katta , haduh ba u la pang na ka bynta ka para jong u ka Tamar ; namar ka la long ka nongleh kam sniew ; bad u Amnon u la pyrkhat jur ia u ban leh ei ei ia ka .

en: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .
kha: Ko rangbah , nga ïohi ba ka jingleit jong ngi da ka lieng nangne sha khmat kan long kaba ma ; kan don ka jingjulor bakhraw ïa ka jingkit bad ïa ka lieng , bad ka jingduh ruh ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, ko Sir, nga sngewthuh ba kane ka jingleit kan long kaba pynmynsaw bad kaba pynjulor shibun, ym tang ia ka jingleit bad ka lieng , hynrei wat ia ka jingim jong ngi ruh .

en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
kha: U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , kumjuh ruh ïa ki tiar ba la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba u hi u la pynkyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ha iing U Blei ia kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u u la aiti , bad ba ma u hi u la aiti , ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki tiar .

en: Woe unto them that join house to house , that lay field to field , till there be no place , that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth !
kha: Phi long kiba la tim . Phi thied bun tylli ki ïing bad ki lyngkha ban bynrap shuh shuh ïa kito kiba phi la don lypa . Shen yn ym don jaka ïano ïano pat ban shong ban sah bad tang ma phi hi phin shong ha ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: To ki bym iasoh iing bad iing, kiba thiah ha lyngkha, haduh ba kin da don jaka , ba kin shah buh marwei hapdeng ka khyndew !

en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ , but their own belly ; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple .
kha: Naba kito kiba leh kum ïa kita kiei kiei kim shakri ïa U Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , hynrei ïa ki jingkwah jong ki hi . Da ki ktien jali ja-um bad ka jingkren pynroh , ki shukor ïa ki briew kiba lui lui .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kita ki long kiba kum kita kim shakri ia U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , hynrei ka kpoh jong ki hi; bad da ki ktien kiba bha bad ki jingkren kiba hok ki pynbiej ia ki dohnud kiba suk .

en: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem , after he was come from Hebron : and there were yet sons and daughters born to David .
kha: Hadien ba u la kynriah na Hebron sha Jerusalem , u Dabid u shim shuh shuh ki tnga kliar bad ki tnga trai , bad u ïoh bun ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim shuh shuh ia ki kynthei bad ki tnga na Jerusalem: bad ki dang don ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kiba la kha na u Dabid .

en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .
kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka dei ban long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap kan long laiphew phut bad ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap kan long saw phut: bad ki shiphew tylli ki jingtap kin long baroh kawei ka jingthew .

en: That ye may suck , and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations  ; that ye may milk out , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory .
kha: Phin ïoh leh sngewbha ha ka jingdap kyrhai jong ka , kum i khunlung ha ka shadem ka kmie jong i .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin sngap jar bad sngewhun ia ki bniat jong ka ba phin ai dud shabar, bad to sngewbha ia ka jingbun ka burom jong ka.

en: And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .
kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi haba u Joseph u leit rung shapoh ïing ban trei ïa la ka kam , uwei ruh na ki shakri ïing um don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka por , u Joseph u la leit shapoh iing ban leh ia ka kam jong u ; bad ym don uwei ruh na ki briew jong ka iing hangta shapoh .

en: For since I spake , I cried out , I cried violence and spoil  ; because the word of the  Lord  was made a reproach unto me , and a derision , daily .
kha: Man ba nga kren , nga hap ban kyang jam bad pyrta ,  Ka jingleh jubor ! Ka jingpynjot !  A  Trai  , ïa nga la rkhiebeiñ bad ibeiñ ha ki por baroh namar nga pynbna ïa ka khubor jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar namar ba nga la kren , nga la pyrta , nga la pyrta bad nga la pynsniew ; namar ka ktien U Trai ka la long ka jingkren bein ia nga, bad ka jingkren bein ia nga man ka sngi .

en: Yet it came to pass , when the children of Israel were waxen strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute  ; but did not utterly drive them out .
kha: Wat haba ki Israel ki la kham khlaiñ , kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Kanaan baroh , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia, haba ki khun Israel ki la nang khlain, ba ki la buh ia ki nong Canaan ban siew khajna ; hynrei kim shym la beh noh shisyndon ia ki .

en: I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .
kha: To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ba-ieit jong nga , shano phin ïalam pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait na ka jingshit ka shiteng sngi ? Balei nga donkam ban wad ïa phi hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong kiwei pat ki nongap langbrot ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kynnoh ia phi, ko khun kynthei jong ka Jerusalem, da ki syiem bad da ki tdong jong ka lyngkha, ba phin ym pynkhih ne pynkynjah ia ka jingieit jong nga, haduh ba un da sngewbha .

en: Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
kha: U la long u paralok jong u lyngskor jong kata ka dewlynnong , u Sergius Paulos uba la long u briew uba shemphang bha . Uta u lyngskor u la phah khot ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul ha khmat jong u namar u la kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la long bad u nongshong shnong jong ka ri, u Sergius Paulus , u briew uba stad uba la khot ia u Barnabas bad u Saul bad u kwah ban iohsngew ia ka ktien U Blei .

en: And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
kha: Nangta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk ba nga la thaw — bad ki dang don hangta naduh kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la phai noh na u lum, bad nga la buh ia ki miej ha ka synduk kaba nga la shna ; bad hangta ki don kumba U Trai u la hukum ia nga .

en: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid u kpa jong u: bad u Jehoram u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: ( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;
kha: Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u ïohsngew shaphang ka nam jong me bad ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , bad un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar kin iohsngew ia ka kyrteng kaba khraw jong me, bad ia ka kti kaba khlain jong me, bad ia ka kti ba la pynjrong jong me ; ) haba u wan bad duwai sha kane ka iing ; .

en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness , and for to shed innocent blood , and for oppression , and for violence , to do it .
kha: Hynrei me lah ban ïohi tang ïa la ki jingmyntoi shimet ; me pynïap ïa kiba lui lui , bad me banbeiñ tyngeh ïa la ki briew . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khmat bad ka dohnud jong me kim long hynrei na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong me, bad na ka bynta ban pynmih snam khlem pop, bad na ka bynta ka jingshah lehbein, ban leh ia kata .

en: And  God  saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingsniew jong uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka pyrthei bad katno ki jingmut jingpyrkhat bymman jong ki ha ki por baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la iohi ba ka jingsniew jong u briew ka long kaba khraw ha ka khyndew , bad ba kawei pa kawei ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong u ka long tang kaba sniew beit .

en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .
kha: Ko kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynthei , shano uba ieit jong phi u la leit ? To ïathuh ïa ngi na kano ka lynti uba ieit jong phi u leit , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïarap ïa phi ban shem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ki kjat jong me ki long kiba itynnad bad ki juti, ko khun syiem jong me ! ki shyieng jong ki tyrpeng jong me ki long kum ki mawkordor , ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong u nongtrei uba stad .

en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes , nor regardeth the rich more than the poor ? for they all are the work of his hands .
kha: Um ïashah liang bad ki nongsynshar ne pynpaw ba u kham lah ïa kiba riewspah ban ïa kiba duk , naba u la thaw ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka kham duna ia uta u bym pdiang ia ki briew jong ki syiem , lymne u kham sngewthuh ia kiba riewspah ban ia kiba duk ? namar baroh ki long ki kam jong ki kti jong u .

en: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul s daughter should have been given to David , that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife .
kha: Hynrei haba ka por ka poi ba yn ai ïa ka Merab ha u Dabid , la ai pynban ïa ka sha u briew uba kyrteng u Adriel uba na Meholah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia ha ka por ba la ai ia ka khun jong u Merab Saul ha u Dabid , ba la ai ia ka ha u Adriel ka Meholath .

en: Speak unto Rehoboam , the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,
kha: ban ai ka khubor ha u Rehoboam bad ha ki briew baroh jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin :
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon u syiem Judah bad ha ka iing Judah bad ka iing ka sem baroh kawei bad ha ka iing ka sem jong ki briew kiba sah .

en: And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .
kha: U Jisu u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban long nyngkong u dei ban buh khatduh eh ïa lade bad u dei ban long u shakri ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shong bad u la khot ia ki shiphew ngut bad u la ong ha ki , Lada uno uno u kwah ban long nyngkong , uta u long uba khatduh na baroh .

en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .
kha: U ngor noh ïa kano kano ka tnat kaba don ha nga ka bymseisoh , bad u khyllad ïa kano kano ka tnat kaba seisoh , khnang ba kan long khuid bad kan kham seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka tnat ha nga kaba ym sei soh u shim noh: bad uwei pa uwei u tnat uba sei soh u pynkhuid ia ka, ba kan sei soh kham bun .

en: And when Judah looked back , behold , the battle was before and behind : and they cried unto the  Lord  , and the priests sounded with the trumpets .
kha: Ki Judia ki peit sawdong bad ki ïohi ba la ker sawdong ïa ki . Ki kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , bad ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la peit shadien, ha khmih ka thma ka la long shakhmat bad shadien: bad ki la pyrta sha U Trai , bad ki lyngdoh ki la pyrta da ki turoi .

en: Hear , all ye people  ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is : and let the Lord  God  be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .
kha: To sngew ïa kane , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ; to sngap ïa kane , ko phi kiba im ha ka pyrthei ! U  Trai  Nongsynshar un sakhi pyrshah ïa phi . To shahshkor ! U kren na ka templ ba kynja bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap, phi baroh ki briew, ko khyndew, bad baroh kaba don hangta: bad to ai ba U Trai Blei un sakhi pyrshah ia phi, U Trai na ka tempi bakhuid jong u .

en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , How long are ye slack to go to possess the land , which the  Lord  God of your fathers hath given you ?
kha: Kumta u Joshua u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Sa katno phin ap ha shuwa ban phin rung bad shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la ai ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki khun Israel: Katno por phi leit bat ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ?

en: And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .
kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Katba ki synran jong u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki sdang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba u la iaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabha bad ki synran jong u ki la sdang, katba ki dang iaid, ban kheit ia ki shkor kew .

en: That they may believe that the  Lord  God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Leh ïa kane ban pynshisha ha ki Israel ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la mihpaw ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin ngeit ba U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki, U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob u la paw ha me .

en: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .
kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïah u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrdan kaba ar ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zichri u rangbah jong ka Ephram u la pyniap ia u Maaseiah u khun syiem bad u Azrikam u Lat ka iing bad u Elkanah uba don hajan u syiem .

en: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;
kha: kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka dohnud jong me kan kiew shaneng, bad me klet ia U Trai U Blei jong me, uba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt, na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw;

en: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee , between me and thee , and between my herdmen and thy herdmen  ; for we be brethren .
kha: Kumta u Abram u ong ha u Lot ,  Ki briew jong me bad ki briew jong nga kim dei ban ïakajia , namar ngi ïalong shi ïing shi sem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la ong ha u Lot, To ai ba kan ym don ka jingialeh, nga kyrpad ia me, hapdeng jong nga bad me, bad hapdeng ki nongap langbrot jong nga bad ki nongap langbrot jong me ; namar ngi long shipara .

en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .
kha: Ka jingtur ïaleh ka la sdang ha ka por shiteng sngi katba u Benhadad bad ki laiphew ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïadih buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh ha ka por shiteng sngi . Hynrei u Benhadad u la dih ia lade ha ki pavilion , ma u bad ki syiem , ki laiphew arngut ki syiem kiba la iarap ia u .

en: Partly , whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions  ; and partly , whilst ye became companions of them that were so used .
kha: Hateng hateng phi la shah krenbeiñ bad shah lehbeiñ ha kaba paw , bad ha kiwei pat ki por phi long la kloi ban don bynta bad kito kiba la shah leh ha kane kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Shi bynta , katba phi la shah pynlong da ki jingshah lehbein bad ki jingshah pynshitom bein ; bad shi bynta , katba phi la kylla long ki paralok jong ki kiba la pyndonkam kumta .

en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman . And when Naaman saw him running after him , he lighted down from the chariot to meet him , and said , Is all well ?
kha: Kumta u leit mih hadien jong u Naaman . Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh hadien jong u , u la hiar na la ka kali ïapom ban ïashem ïa u , bad kylli ,  Don ei ei kaba pher ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Gehasi u la bud hadien u Naaman . Bad haba u Naaman u la iohi ia u ba u mareh hadien jong u, u la pynshai na ka kali ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la ong, Hato baroh ki long kiba bha ?

en: Every valley shall be exalted , and every mountain and hill shall be made low : and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough places plain :
kha: To pyndap ha man la ka jaka them ; to pynmadan ïa man la u lumbah , ki lumrit ki kylla madan , bad ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram yn pynjlih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka them kan long kaba jrong , bad uwei pa uwei u lum bad u lum un shah pynlong uba rit: bad ia kiba jylliew yn pynlong beit , bad ia ki jaka kiba jylliew yn pynlong beit:

en: Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass s colt unto the choice vine  ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :
kha: U teh ïa u khun kada ha u dieng sohwaiñ Ha u dieng sohwaiñ uba bha tam ; U sait ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka um sohwaiñ , kaba saw snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba teh ia u sohjew jong u ha u sohjew, bad ka tdong jong u ha u sohjew ba la jied u la sait ia ki jain jong u ha ka wain , bad ki jain jong u ha ka snam sohjew:

en: Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?
kha: Ngan ym leit ban shim ïa la u kpu bad ka um , bad ki mrad kiba nga la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jong nga , bad ai ïa kita ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngan shim ia u kpu jong nga bad ka um jong nga bad ka doh jong nga kaba nga la pyniap na ka bynta ki nongkhuid jong nga bad ngan ai ia ka ha ki briew kiba ngam tip shano ki don ?

en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
kha: Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingsbun ba nga kwah , ym ki jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew badonburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to leit bad to nang ia kaei kata ka jingmut, ngan sngewsynei, bad ym ban knia: namar ngam wan ban khot ia kiba hok , hynrei ki nongpop sha ka jingkylla kaba mut .

en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father , and the daughter against her mother , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
kha: Nga la wan ba ki khun shynrang kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki , ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki , ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw kurim jong ki ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga wan ban buh ia u briew uba ialeh pyrshah ia u kpa jong u, bad ka khun kynthei pyrshah ia ka kmie jong ka, bad ka khun kynthei pyrshah ia ka kmie jong ka .

en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?
kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa u Titos ban leit , bad nga la phah ïa uwei pat u parabangeit bad u . Hato phi lah ban ong ba u Titos u la shim kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u bad ma nga ngim shym la leh na kijuh hi ki jingthmu bad leh ha kajuh ka rukom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kwah ia u Titus, bad bad bad u nga la phah ia u hynmen . Hato u Titus u la ioh jingmyntoi na phi ? ba iaid ngim ha kajuh ka mynsiem ? ba iaid ngim ha kijuh ki step ?

en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war : and they besieged Ahaz , but could not overcome him .
kha: U Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ki tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kerkut ïa ka , hynrei kim shym lah ban jop ïa u Ahas .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Syria bad u khun jong u Pekah u la wan sha Jerusalem ban ialeh thma: bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Ahas , hynrei kim lah ban jop ia u .

en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars  ; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory , brought out of the isles of Kittim .
kha: Ki shim ïa ki dieng Sning na Bashan ban shna boitha ; ki shna ïa ka rynsan jong pha na ki kseh ba na Sypros bad pyndait ha ka da ki bniat hati .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki oak jong u Bashan ki la shna ia ki bniat jong me; ka kynhun jong ki Ashur ka la shna ia ki ben jong me kiba sniew, ba la wanrah na ki dulir Kittim .

en: According to all that I shew thee , after the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all the instruments thereof , even so shall ye make it .
kha: Shna ïa ka bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh kat kum ka dur kaba ngan pyn-i ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga pyni ia me, kat kum ka dur jong ka ïingjahthait bad ka dur jong ki tiar jong ka baroh .

en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .
kha: U shakri um shym don shibun ban siew ïa ka ram jong u , kumta u syiem u la hukum ba ïa uta dei ban die mraw noh , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u bad baroh kiba u la don khnang ban siew ïa ka ram .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba um don ban siew , u kynrad jong u u la hukum ia u ban die noh ia u bad ia ka tnga jong u bad ki khun bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don bad ka jingsiew ban siew .

en: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes , and saw a great company come unto him , he saith unto Philip ,  Whence shall we buy bread , that these may eat ?
kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong bad u la ïohi ba u paidbah byllien u la nang wan sha u , kumta u la ong ha u Philip ,  Nangno ngi lah ban thied jingbam ka ban dap ban bsa ïa kine ki briew baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la iohi ia ka kynhun kaba khraw kaba wan sha u , u ong ha u Philip , Naei ngin thied kpu ba kine kin ioh bam ?

en: And David s men said unto him , Behold , we be afraid here in Judah : how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ?
kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki ong ha u ,  Ngi don bun bah ban sheptieng hangne ha Judah ; kan long kaba kham sniew lada ngi leit sha Keilah bad tur ïaleh ïa ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba don ha u Dabid ki la ong ha u, Ha khmih ngi tieng hangne ha Judah: katno tam lada ngi wan sha Keilah pyrshah ia ki shipai Philistia ?

en: O  Lord  , though our iniquities testify against us , do thou it for thy name s sake : for our backslidings are many  ; we have sinned against thee .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam sha nga , ‘ Wat la ki pop jong ngi ki pynrem ïa ngi , to ïarap ïa ngi , A  Trai  , kumba me la kular . Ngi la phai dien noh na me bun bunsien ; ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, wat la ki jingbymhok jong ngi ki sakhi pyrshah ia ngi, to leh ia kata na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong me: namar ki jingkylla jong ngi ki long kiba bun; ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia me .

en: For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .
