kha: Ka jingïap ka la wan shapoh lyngba ki jingkhangïit jong ngi bad ka la rung sha ki ïingsyiem jong ngi ; ka la ot ïa ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ïa ki samla shynrang ha ki jaka ïew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingiap ka wan shaneng ha ki jingkhang jong ngi, bad la rung ha ki iing jong ngi, ban ot noh ia ki khynnah na shabar , bad ki samla na ki lynti .

en: They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba phi pynlong ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynmih ia ki snier khnai, bad ki shna ia ka sniehdoh jong ki khnai: uta uba bam ia ki snier jong ki u iap , bad kata kaba la tyrkhong ka mih sha ka sniehdoh .

en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness , and receive with meekness the engrafted word , which is able to save your souls .
kha: Kumta to kiar noh na ki jingmlien bajakhlia baroh bad na ki jinglong bymman baroh . To pyndem ha U Blei bad pdiang ïa ka ktien kaba u la thung ha ki dohnud jong phi , kaba lah ban pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to buh noh ia ka jingjakhlia bad ka jinglong sniew baroh, bad pdiang da ka jingsngewrit ia ka ktien ba la pynkylla dur , kaba lah ban pynim ia ka mynsiem jong phi .

en: So David fled , and escaped , and came to Samuel to Ramah , and told him all that Saul had done to him . And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth .
kha: U Dabid u phet ïap bad u leit sha u Samuel ha Ramah bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kata baroh kaba u Saul u la leh ïa u . Nangta ma u bad u Samuel ki leit sha Naïoth bad ki sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la phet noh bad u la leit sha u Samuel ha Ramah bad u la iathuh ha u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u Saul u la leh ia u . U bad u Samuel ki la leit sah ha Naioth .

en: Therefore the showers have been withholden , and there hath been no latter rain  ; and thou hadst a whore s forehead , thou refusedst to be ashamed .
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba la bat noh ïa u slap , bad u slap pyrem um shym la wan . Pha la da i syriem hi kum ka nuti ; pham don kano kano ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la bat ia ki um slap, bad ym shym la don slap hadien bad me la don ka khlieh jong ka khnai, me la kyntait ban sngewlehrain .

en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the  Lord  hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :
kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha ki Israel baroh ,  Ha kane ka janmiet , phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha ki khun Israel baroh: Ha ka por janmiet, te phin sa tip ba U Trai u la pynmih noh ia phi na ka ri Ijipt:

en: So David stayed his servants with these words , and suffered them not to rise against Saul . But Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u pynkohnguh ïa la ki rangbah ba kim dei ban ktah kti ïa u Saul . U Saul u ïeng joit , u mihnoh na ka krem , bad u leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la sah ha ki shakri jong u da kine ki ktien, bad u la pynsngewsih ia ki ban ym kiew pyrshah ia u Saul . Hynrei u Saul u la ieng na ka krem bad u la iaid shakhmat .

en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .
kha: Nga la pynphong jaiñ ïa pha ha ki jaiñ jynsur kiba la suh syntiew bad nga la ai ha pha ki juti na ki snieh kiba bha tam , ka jingteh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la phong ia me ruh da ka sniehdoh kaba la tyrkhong, bad nga la pynkhih ia me da ka sniehdoh kaba jem, bad nga la tap ia me da ka sniehdoh kaba jem .

en: The way of an eagle in the air  ; the way of a serpent upon a rock  ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea  ; and the way of a man with a maid .
kha: u pukni u her ha suiñ , u bseiñ u par halor u mawsiang , ka liengbah kaba wad ïa la ka lynti ha ka duriaw , bad u briew bad ka briew kiba ïashoh jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong u blang ha ka Iyer ; ka lynti jong u bsein halor u maw ; ka lynti jong ka lieng hapdeng ka duriaw ; bad ka lynti jong u briew uba don ka nongtrei .

en: Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .
kha: U lyngdoh jong u blei Seus , uba ka templ jong u ka ïeng kham pajih shabar shnong , u la wallam ïa ki masi dab bad ki syntiew sha ka khyrdop , naba ma u bad ki paidbah ki la kwah ban ai ka jingkñia sha ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh jong u Jupiter uba don ha khmat ka shnong jong ki, u la wanrah ia ki masi bad ki sohjew sha ki khyrdop bad u la leh ia ka jingknia bad ki briew .

en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor bad pyllait im ïa nga na uta uba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga bad ïa u khun jong nga , bad kumta ban weng noh ïa ngi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem un iohsngew , ban pyllait ia ka kti jong u briew uba pynjot ia nga bad ia u khun jong nga ryngkat na ka pateng U Blei .

en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .
kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para jong u briew uba duk kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don paralok . Kam pher katno u pyrshang tyngeh , um lah ban ïoh paralok .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki hynmen kiba duk ki shun ia u: katno ki paralok jong u ki leit jngai na u ? u bud ia ki da ki ktien , hynrei ki kwah ia u .

en: But the hand of the  Lord  was heavy upon them of Ashdod , and he destroyed them , and smote them with emerods , even Ashdod and the coasts thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom jur ïa ki nong Ashdod bad u pyntriem ïa ki . U la pynshitom ïa ki bad ïa ki briew sawdong ka ri da kaba pynmih ha ki ïa ka jingpang thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka kti U Trai ka la khia ha ki jong u Ashdod , bad u la pynjot ia ki , bad u la pynkhih ia ki da ki khniang , wat u Ashdod bad ki rud jong ka .

en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
kha: Kumta u leit ban kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki tdong jong ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki syrdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la leit bad u la kem lai spah tylli ki blang, bad u la pynkhih ia ka tdong sha ka tdong, bad u la buh ia ka tdong ding hapdeng ar tylli ki tdong .

en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .
kha: Haba u la poi , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka pukri kaba don shabar jong ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la janmiet bha , ka por ha kaba ki kynthei ki ju wan tong um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ki kulai jong u ban dem shapoh shabar ka nongbah da ka pung um ha ka por janmiet , wat ha ka por ba ki kynthei ki leit shabar ban tan um .

en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him , and believed : among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la ïasoh bad u , napdeng jong ki , u dei u Dionysius , u dkhot jong ka dorbar ; la don ruh ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Damaris , bad kiwei pat ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katto katne ki shynrang ki la ia kren bad u, bad ki la ngeit: napdeng jong ki u Deiosos u Areopagite, bad kawei ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Damaris bad kiwei pat bad ki .

en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !
kha: Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim noh ïa ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uwei ruh . Haba ngan iehnoh noh ïa kine ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin wan jia ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ki pynsan ia ki khun jong ki hynrei ngan pynduh noh ia ki: Hooid , to sngewsih ruh ia ki haba nga leit noh na ki !

en: It was Mary Magdalene , and Joanna , and Mary the mother of James , and other women that were with them , which told these things unto the apostles .
kha: Kita ki kynthei ki la long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Ïoanna , bad ka Mari ka kmie jong u Jakob ; ma ki lem bad kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba bad ki , ki la ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka Maria Magdala bad ka Maria bad ka Maria ka kmie u Jakob bad kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba don ryngkat bad ki, kiba la iathuh ia kine kiei kiei ha ki apostol .

en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .
kha: Katba phi dang khmih ïa ka , u maw uba khraw u la lait na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad dewbyrtha jong ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohi haduh ba la ot ia u maw khlem kti, uba la pynkhih ia ka dur ha ki kjat jong u kiba long ki nar bad ki dewbilat , bad u la pynkhih ia ki .

en: And it shall come to pass , that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in  ; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki dei ban lum ar shah ban ïa kaba ki ju lum man ka sngi bad pynkhreh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kin pynkhreh ia kata kaba ki wanrah; bad kan long ar shah katba ki lum man ka sngi .

en: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder  ; so he shall open , and none shall shut  ; and he shall shut , and none shall open .
kha: Ngan ai lut ha u , ka iktiar hapoh jong u syiem , uba hiarpateng jong u Dabid . Un don ki shabi jong ka jaka treikam ; kaei kaba u plie , ym don mano mano ban khang , bad kaei kaba u khang , ym don mano mano ban plie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shabi jong ka iing u Dabid ngan buh ha ka tyrpeng jong u ; kumta un plie, bad ym don mano mano ruh ba un khang ; bad un khang; bad ym don mano mano ruh ba un plie .

en: And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .
kha: Nangta ki Amor kiba shong ha kita ki lum ki la wan tur pyrshah ïa phi kumba beh u ngap . Ki la beh ïa phi shaduh Hormah , bad ki la jop ïa phi hangta ha ri lum Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Amorit kiba shong ha uta u lum ki la mih pyrshah ia phi bad ki la beh ia phi kumba leh ki khnai bad ki la pynjot ia phi ha Seir, wat haduh Hormah .

en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone : and there was a rainbow round about the throne , in sight like unto an emerald .
kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka phyrnai kum ki mawkordor , kum u Jasper bad u Karnelian , bad baroh sawdong ka khet la don u simpyllieng uba don ka rong kum ka jong u Emerald .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba shong u la dei ban peit kum u maw Jasper bad u maw Sardine: bad ka la don ka rong saw sawdong ka khet , ha ka jingpeit kum ka rong saw .

en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :
kha: U Dabid u thung katto katne ki Lebi ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thung katto katne na ki Lebi ban shakri ha khmat ka synduk U Trai , bad ban thoh , bad ban ainguh bad iaroh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel:

en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :
kha: Phi khot ïa u , U Kpa , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kum kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa kaba sah ka jingim jong phi hangne ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi khot ia U Kpa uba khlem burom ia ki briew u bishar kat kum ka kam jong uwei pa uwei, pynlut ia ka por jong phi ban leit sah hangne ha ka jingtieng:

en: And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .
kha: Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit sah noh ha ka ïing jong u Jentil uba kyrteng u Titius Justos , uba mane ïa U Blei ; ka ïing jong u ka don ha syndah jong ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh nangta, bad u la rung ha ka iing jong uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Justus, uba mane ia U Blei, uba ka iing jong u ka la iasoh bad ka synagog .

en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .
kha: bad u phong ka jingkieng atiar da ka rnong kaba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew kilo bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U don ka helmet nar halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u la pynkhreh da ka jain mail ; bad ka jingkhia jong ka jain ka long san hajar Shekel ka nar .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong uba ha shuwa jong u , u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai: um shym la phet noh na ki pop baroh jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me long kum ka sati muhor ha ka kti kamon jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang im , ong U Trai , wat la u Coniah u khun u Jehoiakim u syiem Judah u la long u dak ha ka kti kadiang jong nga , hynrei ngan sa ktah ia me nangta;

en: For if these things be in you , and abound , they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Kine ki long ki jinglong kiba phi donkam , bad lada phi don kyrhai ïa ki , kin pynlong ïa phi kiba smat bad kiba seisoh ha ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada kine kiei kiei ki don ha phi bad ki nang bun, ki pynlong ia phi ba phin ym long kiba khlem soh ne kiba khlem soh ha ka jingtip ia U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord  ;
kha: Te , to kylla-kaba-mut , bad to phai sha U Blei , khnang ba un map ïa ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To kylla bamut namarkata , bad to kylla bamut , ba ki pop jong phi kin shah pynduh noh , haba ki por jong ka jingpynkmen kin wan na ka jingdon jong U Trai;

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , yet not like David his father : he did according to all things as Joash his father did .
kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um long kum u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba u Joash u kpa jong u , u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai, hynrei ym kum u kpa jong u: u la leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kumba u kpa jong u u la leh .

en: In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .
kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingsuk kaba ïadei bad kato kaba don ha ka Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por , ka Hima Blei kan pynphai biang wat ia ki jingiadei kiba suk kiba la don ha ka kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .

en: That hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , hath not defiled his neighbour s wife ,
kha: Um shym mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki duwan ba la mana . Um shym khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u bym shym la bam halor ki lum , bad u khlem pynkhih ia ki khmat jong u sha ki bleithaw jong ka iing Israel , um shym la pynjakhlia ia ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u .

en: Let me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they .
kha: Me wat khang ïa nga , naba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki ba kumta yn ym don shuh u ban dang kynmaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ngan pynjot ia ki, bad ngan pynduh noh ia ka kyrteng jong ki na shapoh bneng : bad ngan pynlong ia me ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khlain bad kham khraw ban ia ki .

en: And he said unto him , Oh my Lord , wherewith shall I save Israel ? behold , my family is poor in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father s house .
kha: U Gideon u jubab ,  Hynrei  Trai  , kumno ngan lah ban pyllait ïa ki Israel ? Ka kur jong nga ka long kaba tlot tam hapoh ka jait Manasseh , bad nga long uba rit tam na ki dkhot ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Ah Trai jong nga, da kaba ngan pynim ia ki Israel ? ha khmih ka iing jong nga ka long kaba duk ha Manasseh bad nga long uba rit tam ha iing u kpa jong nga .

en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .
kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . Hynrei ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ngat ha ka jingjot !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta , ha khmih , U Trai u la buh ia ka mynsiem kaba thok ha ka shyntur jong kine ki nongiathuhlypa jong me baroh , bad U Trai u la kren bein shaphang jong me .

en: And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them : and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Laban u la doh khublei ïa la ki khun ksiew bad ïa la ki khun kynthei , bad u la leit phai pat sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ieng dang step, bad u la kdup ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong u, bad u la kyrkhu ia ki: bad u Laban u la leit noh bad u la leit phai noh sha la ka jaka .

en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
kha: Bad U Blei , uba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki dohnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U Mynsiem ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta la ki briew bad kat kum ka mon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba wad ia ki dohnud u tip ia kaei ka jingmut jong U Mynsiem , namar u pynlong ia ka jingkyrpad na ka bynta ki riewkhuid kat kum ka mon U Blei .

en: And Joseph made haste  ; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother : and he sought where to weep  ; and he entered into his chamber , and wept there .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u mihnoh kynsan namar ka dohnud jong u ka shlei da ka jingsngewieit ïa la u para . Namar ba um lah kun shuh , u leit sha la ka kamra , bad u la ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la leh kyrkieh ; namar ki bniat jong u ki la sngewsih ia u hynmen jong u: bad u la wad shano ban iam ; bad u la rung shapoh ka kamra jong u, bad u la iam hangta .

en: And no man shall come up with thee , neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount  ; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount .
kha: Ym bit ïano ïano ban wan ryngkat bad me , bad wat ai ba yn ïohi ïano ïano ha kano kano ka bynta jong u lum . Wat shah ïa ki langbrot ne ïa ki masi ba kin ïabam phlang ha trai u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don mano mano ruh ban wan shaneng bad me, lymne wat ai ba uno uno un iohi ia u briew ha baroh kawei ka lum ; lymne wat ai ba ki kynhun ne ki kynhun kin bam ha khmat kata ka lum .

en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel , saying , The land , which we passed through to search it , is an exceeding good land .
kha: bad ki la ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kata ka ri kaba ngi la leit swar ka long kaba bha shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ha ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei, ki da ong: Ka ri kaba ngi iaid lyngba ban wad ia ka ka long ka ri kaba bha palat .

en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication , and compelled Judah thereto .
kha: U la tei wat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki ri lum Judia bad u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la pynlong ia ki jaka ba jrong ha ki lum Judah , bad u la pynlong ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ban leh ia ka kam sniew , bad u la pynbor ia u Judah ban leit shata .

en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
kha: Phim ïaryngkat bor wat tang bad uba don ha kyrdan ba hapoh eh jong ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria , bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki nong Ijipt kin phah kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno te phin pynphai noh ia ka khmat jong uwei u rangbah shipai jong nga uba rit tam, bad to buh ia ka jingshaniah jong me ha Ijipt na ka bynta ki kali bad na ka bynta ki kulai ?

en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face , and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him .
kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u la ai hukum na ka bynta ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh kiba dei ban ai ïa u Daniel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Nebuchadnezzar u la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong u bad u la mane ia u Daniel bad u la hukum ba kin ai ia u ia ka jingbam ba bang bad ba thiang ha u .

en: And the city had no need of the sun , neither of the moon , to shine in it : for the glory of God did lighten it , and the Lamb is the light thereof .
kha: Ka nongbah kam donkam ïa ka sngi lane ïa u bnai ban tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , namar ba ka burom jong U Trai ka tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , bad U Khunlangbrot u long ka sharak jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong kam donkam ia ka sngi, ne ia u bnai, ban shai ha ka: namar ka burom U Blei ka la pynshai ia ka, bad u Khunlangbrot u long ka jingshai jong ka .

en: And Joab returned from following Abner : and when he had gathered all the people together , there lacked of David s servants nineteen men and Asahel .
kha: Haba u Joab u la keiñ noh ïa ka jingbeh kthong , u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad u la shem ba khatkhyndai ngut na ki , ki la jah , nalor u Asahel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la wan phai na kaba bud ia u Abner : bad haba u la lum lang ia ki briew baroh , ki la duna shiphew ngut ki shakri u Dabid bad u Ashael .

en: And the  Lord  sent thee on a journey , and said , Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they be consumed .
kha: bad u la phah ïa phi lem bad ka hukum , ban pynjot ïa ki Amalek , ki briew bymman . U la ong ïa phi ban ïaleh haduh ba phin da pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah ia me ha ka jingleit , bad u la ong , Leit bad pynjot lut ia ki nongpop ki Amalek , bad ialeh pyrshah ia ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjot .

en: And he did very abominably in following idols , according to all things as did the Amorites , whom the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
kha: U la leh ïa ka pop kaba ijli eh da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba ki Amor ki la leh , ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki paid Israel ki nang ïaid sha khmat . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh da kaba sngewsih shibun eh ha kaba bud ia ki bleithaw , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la bret noh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Nangta u Moses u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , bad u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wanrah ia ki khun shynrang Aaron, bad u la buh ia ki da ki jainkup, bad u la buh ia ki da ki shyieng bad u la buh ia ki shyieng ha ki ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
kha: Don ka Ashdod bad ka Gasa , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka wahduid ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka rud jong ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ashdod bad ki shnong jong ka bad ki shnong jong ka, Gaza bad ki shnong jong ka, haduh ka wah Ijipt bad ka duriaw bah bad u pud jong ka:

en: And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .
kha: Te lada uno uno u kylli ïa u , ‘ Kiei kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phi ?’ Un jubab , ‘ Nga la ïoh ïa ki ha ka ïing u paralok .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei un ong ia u , Kiei kine ki jingmynsaw ha ki kti jong me ? Nangta un jubab , Kito kiba nga la mynsaw ha iing ki paralok jong nga .

en: Thou art worthy , O Lord , to receive glory and honour and power : for thou hast created all things , and for thy pleasure they are and were created .
kha: U Trai bad U Blei jong ngi ! Me long uba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom , ka jingpyndonburom bad ka bor . Naba me la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad da ka mon jong me , la ai ïa ki ban im bad ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long uba bit dor, ko Trai, ban pdiang ia ka burom bad ka burom bad ka bor: namar me la thaw ia kiei kiei baroh, bad na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong me ki long bad la thaw ia ki .

en: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints , and to overcome them : and power was given him over all kindreds , and tongues , and nations .
kha: La shah ïa u ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew jong U Blei bad ban jop ïa ki , bad la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka hima , ka ktien bad halor u bynriew baïapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ha u ban ialeh thma bad ki riewkhuid, bad ban jop ia ki: bad la ai bor ia u halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: So she discovered her whoredoms , and discovered her nakedness : then my mind was alienated from her , like as my mind was alienated from her sister .
kha: Ka thadrong ïa lade bad ka ailad ba baroh kin tip ba ka long ka nuti . Nga la sngewngiah ïa ka kumba nga la long ïa ka hynmen jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la lap ia ki jingkhaii met jong ka, bad ka la lap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka: nangta ka jingmut jong nga ka la jah noh na ka, kumba ka jingmut jong nga ka la jah noh na ka para jong ka .

en: When goods increase , they are increased that eat them : and what good is there to the owners thereof , saving the beholding of them with their eyes ?
kha: Kat phi nang roi ha ka spah , katta ki shyntur phin hap ban bsa . Baroh kaba phi ïohnong ka dei ka jingtip ba phi long uba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki mar ki nang kiew , ki nang kiew kiba bam ia ki: bad kaei ka jingmyntoi ia ki trai jong ka , kaba pynim ia ka jingpeit ia ki da ki khmat jong ki ?

en: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .
kha: Une te , u long u kpu uba la wan hiar na bneng ; um long kum uta u kpu uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam , hynrei hadien ki la ïap . Uta uba bam ïa une u kpu un im junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kata ka kpu kaba la wan hiar na bneng: ym kumba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam ia ka manna bad ki la iap: uta uba bam ia une u kpu un im junom .

en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication , and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication .
kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki la buaid na kaba dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka jingawria jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kiba ki syiem jong ka khyndew ki la leh ia ka kam sniew , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew ki la dih kyiad da ka wain jong ka jingleh be-ijot jong ka .

en: O Israel , thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah : there they stood : the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them .
kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel kim shym la sangeh ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga naduh ka por ba ki leh pop ha Gibeah . Kumta ha Gibeah ka thma kan lap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Israel me la leh pop naduh ki sngi u Gibeah: hangta ki la ieng: ka thma ha Gibeah pyrshah ia ki khun jong ka jingbymhok kam shym la palat ia ki .

en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet , and their cauls , and their round tires like the moon ,
kha: Ka sngi ka wan haba U  Trai  un shim noh na ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki sngewsarong — ki jingdeng itynnat ba ki deng ha ki matsohlah jong ki , halor ki khlieh jong ki , bad ha ki ryndang jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai un weng noh ia ka jingshlur jong ki jingpynitynnad jong ki shaphang ki kjat jong ki , bad ki bniat jong ki , bad ki tyrpeng kiba pyllun jong ki kum u bnai , .

en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king  ; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king s house .
kha: Haba ka leit na ka ïing ki kynthei sha ka ïingsyiem , ka lah ban riam kano kano ka jingriam kaba ka kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kumta kawei pa kawei ka la wan sha u syiem; kaei kaei kaba ka kwah la ai ia ka ban leit bad ka na ka iing jong ki kynthei sha ka iing syiem .

en: And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
kha: hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha u , ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba dei ba me kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u kpa jong nga u Dabid , Katba ka la don ha ka dohnud jong me ban tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng jong nga , me la leh bha ba ka la don ha ka dohnud jong me .

en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .
kha: Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka sngi kaba phra jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ki ha ka sngi kaba phra na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid jong u ha u lyngdoh , ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , ha khmat U Trai .

en: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people , thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen : a people which I knew not shall serve me .
kha: Me la pyllait im ïa nga na ki briew jong nga kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad me la pynneh ïa ka jingsynshar jong nga halor ki jaitbynriew ; ki briew kiba ngam ju ithuh ki la long mynta ki raïot jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh me la pyllait im ia nga na ki jingialeh jong ki briew jong nga: ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam tip kan shakri ia nga .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .
kha: ban ong ha ki Israel ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam ki Ïingtrep ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew , bad ka neh hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai kaba hynriew kan long ka jingkhawai niam jong ki iingjain haduh hynriew sngi ha U Trai .

en: And the  Lord  looked upon him , and said , Go in this thy might , and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites : have not I sent thee ?
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ,  Khie leit da la ka bor bakhraw bad pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Midian . Nga hi nga phah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u peit ia u bad u la ong: To leit ha kane ka bor jong me bad me dei ban pynim ia ki Israel na ka kti jong ki nong Midian: em nga la phah ia me ?

en: Wherefore , brethren , look ye out among you seven men of honest report , full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom , whom we may appoint over this business .
kha: Kumta te , ko hynmen ko para , to jied hynñiew ngut ki rangbah napdeng jong phi ïa kiba la ithuh ba ki long kiba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ka jingstad , bad ngin buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko para bangeit , to peit shabar hapdeng jong phi hynriew ngut ki briew kiba hok, kiba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ka jingstad , kiba ngi lah ban thung halor kane ka kam .

en: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno , ko Trai ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u, Ko Trai ? Bad u la ong ha ki , Hangno hangno ba ka met ka don , hangta ki blang kin ialum lang .

en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :
kha: hynrei tang u rangbah lyngdoh uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumta tang shisien shisnem . U rah bad u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u ainguh ha U Blei na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki pop ba ki briew ki leh khlem sngewthuh ba ki la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kaba ar u la leit sha u rangbah lyngdoh marwei shisien shisnem, ym khlem snam, kaba u la tyrwa na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ki jingbakla jong ki briew:

en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .
kha: Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kwah ban kem ïa u ; kumta to wan sha ka ri jong ngi , bad ngin pynthikna ba phi ïohkem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta te ko syiem to wan hiar katkum ka jingkwah jong ka mynsiem jong me baroh ban wan hiar bad ka bynta jong ngi kan long ban aiti ia u ha ka kti jong u syiem .

en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .
kha: Hynrei lada ngam sngewthuh ïa ka ktien kaba la kren , u briew uba pyndonkam ïa ka un long u nongwei ha nga bad ngan long u nongwei ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada ngam tip ia ka jingmut jong ka sur , ngan long ha uta uba kren u nongleh kam sniew bad uta uba kren un long u nongleh kam sniew ha nga .

en: I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?
kha: Hato la pynmynsaw ïa phi da ka pop jong nga , ko phi u nongap byndi ? Balei me pyndonkam ïa nga na ka bynta ka sohpdung-jinghikai jong me ? Hato nga long ka jingkit kaba khia eh ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la leh pop ; kaei kaba ngan leh ia me, ko nongpynsah ia ki briew ? balei me buh ia nga kum ka dak pyrshah ia me , haduh ba nga long ka jingkit ia lade ?

en: And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .
kha: Nangta ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  Ha kane ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U  Trai   ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Judah . Nangta ka la wai noh ban ïoh khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pun khun biang bad ka la kha khun shynrang: bad ka la ong: Mynta ngan iaroh ia U Trai: namarkata ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Judah ; bad ka la iehnoh ia ka jingkha khun .

en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself unto the  Lord   ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour .
kha: bad uba lai u dei u Amasaïah u khun jong u Sikhri uba don ar lakh ngut ki shipai . ( U Amasaïah u trei mon sngewbha ban shakri ïa U  Trai . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u la long u Amasiah u khun u Sichri uba la tyrwa mon sngewbha ia lade ha U Trai ; bad bad u arspah hajar ngut ki rangbah kiba donbor .

en: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings , and to kindle meat offerings , and to do sacrifice continually .
kha: bad ba borabor yn don ki lyngdoh na ka jait Lebi ban shakri ïa nga bad ban ai ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam bad ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki lyngdoh ki Lebi kin ym kwah ia u briew ha khmat jong nga ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ban pynmeh ia ki jingknia doh bad ban leh ia ka jingknia man ka por .

en: After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .
kha: Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, haba ka jingbitar jong u syiem Ahasaerus ka la sngewsih, u la kynmaw ia ka Vashti bad kaei kaba ka la leh bad kaei kaba la pynbeit pyrshah ia ka .

en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast  ; and his kingdom was full of darkness  ; and they gnawed their tongues for pain ,
kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka khet jong u mradkhlaw . Ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka hima jong u mradkhlaw , bad ki briew ki la dait ïa la ki thylliej namar ka jingpang jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba phra u la theh ia ka khiew jong u ha ka jaka shong jong u mrad ; bad ka hima jong u ka la dap da ka jingdum ; bad ki la sngap jar ia ki shyntur jong ki namar ka jingpang .

en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew bad shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka kti u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan ka la don bad u Jeremaiah , ba kim dei ban aiti ia u ha ka kti jong ki briew ban pyniap ia u .

en: Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
kha: Bad mynta um long shuh tang kum u mraw , hynrei kham palat ban ïa u mraw : u long u para ba-ieit ha U Khrist . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Bad katno khraw un long uba kordor ïa me , kum u mraw bad kum u para ha u Trai !
translated_en_to_kha: Ym mynta kum u shakri hynrei halor u shakri, u hynmen uba la ieit khamtam eh ia nga , hynrei katno ka kham bun ia me, ha ka doh bad ha U Trai ?

en: Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba biang . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad nga wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki jingïahap, tang ki jingkhia, ka ephah kaba hok, bad ka hin kaba hok, phin sa don: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la pynmih ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynjot ïa ki kali ïapom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ko Trai, ba ngan ot noh ia ki kulai jong me na pdeng jong me, bad ngan pynjot ia ki kali jong me:

en: Arise , go down to meet Ahab king of Israel , which is in Samaria : behold , he is in the vineyard of Naboth , whither he is gone down to possess it .
kha: Phin shem ïa u ha ka bri sohwaiñ u Naboth , ba u leit ban shimti ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie , leit hiar sha u Ahab u syiem Israel uba don ha Samaria: ha khmih u don ha ka kper sohjew jong u Naboth .

en: And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongwei ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia kum ka lyer kaba pynher noh ïa u phlangïap . Haba kata ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka wan , kin tur ïaleh na baroh sawdong bad kin ieh syllen ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan phah sha ki nongleh kam sniew jong ka Babilon, ki ban pynkhuid ia ka: namar ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar kin long pyrshah ia ka sawdong .

en: And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .
kha: Me lah ban ïakren bad u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba un ong . Ngan ïarap ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ha phi aïu phin leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ia u, bad buh ia ki ktien ha ka shyntur jong u: bad ngan long bad ka shyntur jong me bad bad ka shyntur jong u , bad ngan hikai ia phi ia kaei kaba phi dei ban leh .

en: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .
kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa ka pop lada ngam shym la leh hapdeng jong ki ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don uno uno uwei pat uba la ju leh ; kumba ka long , ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh , bad ki shun ïa nga bad ïa U Kpa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ngam shym la leh hapdeng jong ki ia ki kam kiba ym don briew shuh: hynrei mynta ki la iohi bad ki la shun ia nga bad ia U Kpa jong nga baroh arngut .

en: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren , and said , Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses , ye cannot be saved .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan na Judia sha Antiokh bad ki la sdang ban hikai ïa ki parabangeit ,  Phim lah ban lait im lymda la otsher ïa phi kumba ka Hukum u Moses ka dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki briew kiba wan hiar na Judaea bad ki la hikai ia ki para bangeit bad ki la ong: Lada ym shah ot noh ia phi kat kum ka rukom jong u Moses , phim lah ban pynim ia phi .

en: Be strong and of a good courage : for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give them .
kha: Kut jingmut triang bad long skhem , namar men long u nongïalam jong kine ki briew katba ki shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba khlain bad kiba don ka jingshlur kaba bha: namar ha une u briew men phiah ia ka ri kaba nga smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban ai ia ki .

en: Come ye , say they , I will fetch wine , and we will fill ourselves with strong drink  ; and to morrow shall be as this day , and much more abundant .
kha: ‘ Ïa ngin ïawad waiñ khyndiat ,’ kine ki nongdih kyiad ki ong , ‘ bad dih katba ngi lah ! Lashai kan kham palat ban ïa kaba mynta !’
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, to ong ia ki, ngan sa leit dih wain, bad ngin sa pyndap ia lade da ka jingdih kaba khlain bad lashai kan long kum kane ka sngi, bad kham bun .

en: And he said unto them ,  Take nothing for your journey , neither staves , nor scrip , neither bread , neither money  ; neither have two coats apiece .
kha: hadien ba u la ong ha ki ,  wat rah ei ei bad phi ha ka jingleit jong phi : Wat rah ïa u diengduh , ïa ka pla khrong , ïa ka jingbam , ïa ka pisa , wat ïa ka sopti bujli ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Wat shim ei ei na ka bynta ka jingleit jong phi, lymne ki dieng, lymne ki scrip, lymne u kpu, lymne ka pisa ; lymne ki don ar tylli ki jainkup .

en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
kha: Phim ïaryngkat bad wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba rit tam jong ki Assyria bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno te phin pynphai noh ia ka khmat jong uwei u rangbah shipai jong nga uba rit tam, bad to buh ia ka jingshaniah jong me ha Ijipt na ka bynta ki kali bad na ka bynta ki kulai ?

en: And all the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth rent with the sound of them .
kha: Nangta ki baroh ki la ïabud ïa u , da ka jingrisa jam bad put ïa ki sharati , da kaba pynmih ka jingsawa kaba jur kat ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la wan shaneng hadien jong u, bad ki briew ki la pipe da ki pipe bad ki la ia kmen shibun eh, haduh ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong da ka sur jong ki .

en: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city , both man and woman , young and old , and ox , and sheep , and ass , with the edge of the sword .
kha: Da ki waitlam jong ki , ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hapoh ka nongbah , ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki samla bad ki tymmen . Ki la pynïap lut ruh ïa ki jingri , ki langbrot , bad ki kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynjot lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka shnong, ki shynrang bad kynthei, ki samla bad ki tymmen bad ki masi bad ki langbrot bad ki tdong jong ka waitlam .

en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed thee out of the house of servants  ; and I sent before thee Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .
kha: Nga la wan ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ; nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ; nga la phah ïa u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Miriam ban ïalam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la wanrah ia me na ka ri Ijipt, bad nga la pyllait im ia me na ka iing ki shakri ; bad nga la phah ha khmat jong me ia u Moses, u Aaron bad u Miriam .

en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him , saying , Go and wash in Jordan seven times , and thy flesh shall come again to thee , and thou shalt be clean .
kha: U Elisha u phah ïa u shakri ban ong ha u ban leit bad sait ïa lade hynñiew sien ha ka wah Jordan , bad un ïohkhiah phar na ka jingpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la phah ia u nonglam khubor sha u, u da ong, To leit sait ha Jordan hynriew sien bad ka doh jong me kan wan biang sha me bad me phin sa khuid .

en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land , and they spoil it , so that it be desolate , that no man may pass through because of the beasts :
kha: Lane nga lah ban phah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban pynïap ïa ki briew , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ri kaba ma katta katta ba ym don uno uno uba lah ban leit lyngba ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga pynlong ia ki mrad kiba sniew ban iaid lyngba ia ka ri , bad ki pynsniew ia ka , haduh ba kan da jah rngai noh , ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba iaid lyngba namar ki mrad:

en: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .
kha: Bad kumta baroh kiba sah na u bynriew kin wan sha nga , baroh ki Jentil ïa kiba nga la khot ban long ki jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki briew kiba sah kin wad ia U Trai bad ki Jutang baroh kiba la khot ia ka kyrteng jong nga , ong U Trai uba leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: The  Lord  will smite thee with the botch of Egypt , and with the emerods , and with the scab , and with the itch , whereof thou canst not be healed .
kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ki tohjaw , kumba u la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt . Un pynlong ïa ka met jong phi ban dap da ka prum . Yn tap ïa phi da ka sarew , bad phin daitbuid , hynrei yn ym don jingpynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un shoh ia me da ka jingsma jong ka ri Ijipt, bad da ki jingmih, bad da ka sniehdoh, bad da ka sniehdoh, na kaba ngam lah ban pynkoit .

en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :
kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u lyngdoh u la khmih bniah ïa u bad u la pynbna ba u long uba khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa lade ha u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u scb u la saphriang shibun ha ka sniehdoh , hadien kata la iohi ia u na u lyngdoh na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid jong u , yn sa iohi biang ia u na u lyngdoh:

en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret , and he himself seeketh to be known openly . If thou do these things , shew thyself to the world .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba buhrieh ïa kaei kaba u leh lada u kwah ba kiwei kin tip . Naba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei , to ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip shaphang jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ym don briew uba leh ei ei ha kaba rieh bad ma u hi u wad ban shah ithuh ha kaba paw . Lada me leh ia kine kiei kiei , to pyni ia lade ha ka pyrthei .

en: Though these three men , Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah , u Noah , u Daniel bad u Job ki don hangta , ka jingbha jong ki kan pynim tang ïa ka jingim jong ki hi .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kine ki lai ngut ki briew, u Noah, u Daniel bad u Job, ki la don ha ka, ki dei ban pynpoi tang ia la ka jong ka mynsiem da ka hok jong ki, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng    jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki ha ki tyrpeng jong u Ephod , ba kin long ki maw kum ka jingkynmaw ia ki khun Israel ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And when the voice was past , Jesus was found alone . And they kept it close , and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen .
kha: Haba ka sur ka la sangeh , la don tang U Jisu hi marwei . Ki synran jong u ki la sngap jar shaphang kane baroh , bad kim shym ïathuh hano hano ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la lah ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka sur ka la iaid noh , la lap ia U Jisu marwei . Ki la buh ia ka hajan , bad kim shym la iathuh iano iano ruh ha kita ki sngi .

en: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning , and called all his servants , and told all these things in their ears : and the men were sore afraid .
kha: Dang step phyrngab , u Abimelekh u khot lang ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , bad u ïathuh ha ki ïa kaba la jia ; bad ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Abimelech u la ieng dang step, bad u la khot ia ki shakri jong u baroh, bad u la iathuh ia kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki shkor jong ki: bad ki briew ki la tieng shibun .

en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the  Lord  it came to pass , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses  minister , saying ,
kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  ; U  Trai  u la kren ha u nongïarap lem jong u Moses , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien ka jingiap jong u Moses u shakri U Trai ka la jia ba U Trai u la kren ha u Joshua u khun u Nun , u Moses u shakri da kaba ong:

en: And when he had said these things , all his adversaries were ashamed : and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him .
kha: Ka jingjubab jong u ka pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong u ban sngewlehrain ïa lade , katba ki briew ki la risa ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la kren ia kine kiei kiei baroh ki nongshun jong u ki la sngewlehrain: bad ki briew baroh ki la ia kmen na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba donburom baroh kiba la leh da u .

en: For this cause therefore have I called for you , to see you , and to speak with you : because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain .
kha: Ki Israel ha ka jingthmu U Blei
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka daw nga la khot ia phi, ban iohi ia phi bad ban iakren bad phi: namar ba na ka bynta ka jingkyrmen jong ki Israel nga la shah teh bad kane ka kynjri .

en: So Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard sent , and Nebushasban , Rab–saris , and Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , and all the king of Babylon s princes  ;
kha: Kumta u Nebusaradan , ryngkat bad ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan u Nebushasban bad u Nergal Sareser bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wallam sha nga na ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Nebuzaradan u rangbah shipai u la phah, bad u Rabushasban, u Rabushasari, bad u Nergalshareer, u Rabmag bad u syiem Babilon baroh;

en: What then ? notwithstanding , every way , whether in pretence , or in truth , Christ is preached ; and I therein do rejoice , yea , and will rejoice .
kha: Kam lei lei! Nga sngewkmen shaphang kata , katba ïa U Khrist dang ïai ïalap ha ka rukom baroh , la na ki jingthmu bymdei ne badei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata ? wat la katta ruh, la ka long ha ka jingleh thok ne ha ka jingshisha, la ialap ia U Khrist ; bad nga ha kata nga sngewkmen , hooid , bad ngan sngewbha .

en: And the king said , Let him turn to his own house , and let him not see my face . So Absalom returned to his own house , and saw not the king s face .
kha: Pynban u syiem u la ai hukum ba u Absalom um dei ban sah hapoh ïingsyiem .  Ngam kwah ban ïohi ïa u !  u syiem u ong . Kumta u Absalom u sah ha ka ïing jong u hi bad um shym leit mih ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , To ai ba un phai sha la ka jong ka iing bad wat ai ba un ym iohi ia ka khmat jong nga . Kumta u Absalom u la leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka iing bad um shym la iohi ia ka khmat syiem .

en: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth , but that which is good to the use of edifying , that it may minister grace unto the hearers .
kha: Wat kren ïa ki ktien pynmong , hynrei , tang ki ktien kiba long ka jingïarap , kita keiñ kiba tei bad kiba ïadei tang ïa kata kaba donkam , khnang ba kaei kaba phi kren kan long kaba bha ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba ka jingiakren kaba bamsap kan mih na ka shyntur jong phi , hynrei kata kaba bha ban pyndonkam ia ka jingpynroi , ba kan shakri ia ka jingaiei ha ki nongsngap .

en: Shall horses run upon the rock ? will one plow there with oxen ? for ye have turned judgment into gall , and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock :
kha: Hato ki kulai ki ju mareh halor ki mawsiang ? Hato ki briew ki ju lur ïa ka duriaw da ki masi dab ? Pynban phi la pynkylla ïa ka jingbishar hok sha ka bih , bad ïa kaba dei sha ka bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki kulai kin iaid halor u maw ? hato uwei un sa tuid hangta bad u oxen ? namar phi la pynkylla ia ka jingbishar sha ka gall , bad u soh jong ka hok sha ka hima:

en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt , and bring out the children of Israel from among them .
kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga rah ïa la ka kti pyrshah ïa ki bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U Trai haba nga pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor ka ri Ijipt bad nga pynmih noh ia ki khun Israel na pdeng jong ki .

en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased  ;
kha: Kumta ki la phah khot ïa ki briew kiba pang ha baroh ki jaka sawdong jong ka ri bad ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong kata ka jaka ki la tip ia u, ki la phah shabar sha kata ka ri baroh sawdong bad ki la wanrah ha u ia kiba pang baroh;

en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .
kha: Hynrei kito kiba kwah ban riewspah ki hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ki ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki jingkwah ba-bieit bad ki jingkwah ba-pynmynsaw , kiba tan ïa ki sha ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kita ki ban long kiba riewspah kin hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ka jingma, bad ha kiba bun ki jingkwah brai kiba bieit bad kiba pynsngewsih , kiba pynngam ia ki briew ha ka jingpynjot bad ka jingjot .

en: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?
kha: Shisyndon ki la lynñiar ,  Me kwah aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la wan ban pynshitom ïa ngi ha shuwa ka por kaba dei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki la pyrta, ki ong, Ngi don jingiadei bad me, ko Jisu, ko Khun U Blei ? me wan hangne ban pynshitom ia ngi shuwa ka por ?

en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king s meat .
kha: Haba ka por ka la kut , ki la kham i khiah krat bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa kito baroh kiba la bam ïa ka jingbam syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba kut jong ki shi sngi ki khmat jong ki ki la paw ba ki kham jem bad kham heh ha ka doh ban ia ki khun baroh kiba bam ia ka bynta jong ka doh syiem .

en: When thou beatest thine olive tree , thou shalt not go over the boughs again : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .
kha: Haba phi la dep kheit ïa ki soh Olib shisien , wat leit kheit shuh ïa kito kiba dang sah ; kita ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me shoh ia u dieng olive jong me, wat leit sha ki tnat: kan long na ka bynta u nongwei, na ka bynta u khlem kpa bad na ka bynta ka riewkynthei .

en: And this is love , that we walk after his commandments . This is the commandment , That , as ye have heard from the beginning , ye should walk in it .
kha: Kane ka jingieit kaba nga kren ka mut ba ngin ïaid ha ka jingkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei . Ka hukum , kumba phi baroh phi la ïohsngew naduh mynnyngkong , ka long ba baroh phi dei ban ïa-ïaid ha ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingieit , ba ngi iaid katkum ki hukum jong u . Kane ka long ka hukum , Ba kumba phi la iohsngew naduh kaba sdang , phi dei ban iaid ha ka .

en: Thou shalt not see a fierce people , a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive  ; of a stammering tongue , that thou canst not understand .
kha: Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa ki nongwei kiba hangamei kiba kren da ka ktien kaba phim sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iohi ia u briew uba shyrkhei, u briew uba kham jylliew ban ia kaba me lah ban sngewthuh ; jong ka shyntur kaba jem , ba me lah ban sngewthuh .

en: If any man think himself to be a prophet , or spiritual , let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord .
kha: Lada uno uno u briew pyrkhat ba u long u nonglamktien jong U Blei , u dei ban tip ba kaei kaba nga thoh sha phi ka long ka hukum U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u pyrkhat ia lade ba u long u nongiathuhlypa ne uba kynja mynsiem , to un pdiang ba kiei kiei kiba nga thoh ha phi ki long ki hukum U Trai .

en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the lad , and said , Is not the arrow beyond thee ?
kha: Haba uta u khynnah u poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khnam u la hap , u Jonathan u pyrta ïa u ,  U khnam u don kham sha jngai na phi !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la wan ha ka jaka jong u khnam uba u Jonathan u la siat , u Jonathan u la pyrta hadien u khynnah bad u la ong: Hato u khnam uba don sha lyndet jong me ?

en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong phi kin lah ban ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , ki ban ïalam ïa ki ban ym ïaineh shuh ha nga bad ban mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me shim na ki khun kynthei jong me sha ki khun shynrang jong me, bad ki khun kynthei jong ki ki leit shongkurim hadien ki blei jong ki, bad pynlong ia ki khun shynrang jong me ban leit shongkurim hadien ki blei jong ki .

en: So I prophesied as I was commanded : and as I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold a shaking , and the bones came together , bone to his bone .
kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba la bthah ïa nga . Katba nga dang kren , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingkhih shane shatai , bad ki shyieng ki la sdang ban ïadait lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la iathuhlypa kumba la hukum ia nga: bad kumba nga la iathuhlypa, ka la don ka jingsawa, bad ha khmih ka jingkhih, bad ki shyieng ki la iawan lang, ka shyieng jong u .

en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee , then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .
kha: Shuh shuh , nga la bahkhlieh ha i pa da la ka jingim na ka bynta u para . Nga ong ïa i ba lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u para sha i , ngan sa kit pop ma nga shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u shakri jong me u la long uba shisha na ka bynta u khynnah ha u kpa jong nga, da kaba ong: Lada ngam wanrah ia u ha me , te ngan kit ia ka jingkynnoh ha u kpa jong nga junom .

en: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not : for a fire is kindled in mine anger , which shall burn upon you .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ri kaba kim don jingtip ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kum ka ding , ban kan pluh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia me ban iaid bad ki nongshun jong me sha ka ri kaba me tip: namar ka ding ka la bthei ha ka jingbitar jong nga, kaba thang ia phi .

en: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years : seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
kha: U la long u syiem ka Israel sawphew snem , u da synshar hynñiew snem ha Hebron bad laiphew lai snem ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi ba u Dabid u la synshar halor ki Israel ki long sawphew snem: hynriew snem u la synshar ha Hebron , bad laiphew lai snem u la synshar ha Jerusalem .

en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .
kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .’ U Moses u la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad um shym la nud ban peit .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong, Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me, U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob . Nangta u Moses u la khih bad um shym la sngewthuh .

en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .
kha: Ka dei tang ka mynsiem kaba hapoh u briew hi , kaba tip ïa baroh shaphang jong u ; ha kajuh ka rukom , tang U Mynsiem U Blei , uba tip ïa baroh shaphang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u briew uba tip ia kiei kiei jong u briew, u pynim ia ka mynsiem u briew kaba don ha u ? wat la katta ruh ia kiei kiei jong U Blei ym tip briew hynrei U Mynsiem U Blei .

en: And base things of the world , and things which are despised , hath God chosen , yea , and things which are not , to bring to nought things that are :
kha: U la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka ñiew poh bad ibeiñ , bad ka pyrkhat ba kam long ei ei , khnang ban pynjot ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jinglong ba kongsan jong ka pyrthei, bad kiei kiei kiba la shah niewbein, U Blei u la jied, em, bad kiei kiei ki bym long, ban wanrah ia kiei kiei kiba long:

en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering : as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor , so shall ye heave it .
kha: Haba phi shet kpu , ïa uta uba phi shet nyngkong na u kew thymmai dei ban wanrah kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai . Ïa une dei ban wanrah kumjuh kumba phi wanrah jingainguh kyrpang na u kew ba phi shoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin aiti ia ka cake kaba nyngkong eh na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba heh: kumba phi leh ia ka jingainguh kaba heh jong ka tyrpeng , kumta phin pynkhih ia ka .

en: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka pyrthei — kaei kaba ka malade bapop ka brai , kaei kaba ki briew ki ïohi bad kwah , bad baroh kiei kiei kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba ki briew ki sngewsarong — ym don na kane kaba wan na U Kpa ; baroh ka wan na ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei, ka jingkwah brai jong ka doh bad ka jingkwah brai jong ki khmat bad ka jingsarong jong ka jingim kam dei na U Kpa hynrei ka long na ka pyrthei .

en: O my mountain in the field , I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil , and thy high places for sin , throughout all thy borders .
kha: bad halor ki lumbah ha ka rudnong bym don jingkah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka spah bad ïa ki jingkynshew jong phi namar ki pop baroh kiba phi la leh ha kylleng ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko lum jong nga ha lyngkha , ngan ai ia ka jingdon jong me bad ki jingdon jingem jong me baroh sha ka jingjot , bad ki jaka ba jrong jong me na ka bynta ka pop , ha kylleng ki pud jong me baroh .

en: I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me , and what I shall answer when I am reproved .
kha: Ngan kiew ïa ka jaka ap phira jong nga bad ap ban khmih ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  un ïathuh ha nga ban ong bad kaei ka jubab ba un ai halor ka jingmudui jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ieng halor ka jingpeit jong nga, bad ngan buh ia nga halor ka tower , bad ngan peit ban iohi ia kaei kaba un ong ha nga , bad kaei kaba ngan jubab haba nga la shah pynrem .

en: And there came also Nicodemus , which at the first came to Jesus by night , and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes , about an hundred pound weight .
kha: U Nikodemos , uba ha kaba nyngkong u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu mynmiet , u la leit ryngkat bad u Joseph , u da rah bad u kumba laiphew kilo ki musla , ka jingkhleh lang jong ka mirr bad ka alos .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nicodemo ruh u la wan sha U Jisu ha ka por mynstep bad u la wanrah ia ka jingkhleh lang kaba la khleh lang kumba shispah pound .

en: How great are his signs ! and how mighty are his wonders ! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and his dominion is from generation to generation .
kha: Katno kiba khraw ki long ki jingphylla jong U Blei kiba u pyn-i ha ngi ! Katno kiba khrawbor ki long ki kambah kiba u leh ! U Blei u long u syiem junom ; un synshar ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ki dak jong u ki long kiba khraw ! bad katno ki jingphylla jong u ! ka hima jong u ka long ka hima kaba bymjukut , bad ka jingsynshar jong u ka long naduh ka pateng haduh ka pateng .

en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
kha: Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw kaba ka la pyn-i ka pynshisha ba ïa ki pop jong ka kiba bun la map . Hynrei uno uno uba la ïohmap khyndiat u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ong ha me , ia ki pop jong ka kiba bun , la map ia ka; namar ka la ieit shibun: hynrei ia uba la map tang khyndiat eh, ujuh u ieit tang khyndiat .

en: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .
kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .  U nongïathuhlypa uba khraw u la mihpaw hapdeng jong ngi !  ki la ong ;  U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan ka jingtieng ha baroh: bad ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei, ki da ong: Ba u nongiathuhlypa uba khraw u la mih hapdeng jong ngi ; bad , Ba U Blei u la leit jngoh ia ki briew jong u .

en: Then Rab–shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and spake , saying , Hear the word of the great king , the king of Assyria :
kha: Nangta u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ong ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Rabshakeh u la ieng bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ha ka ktien jong ki Jiw bad u la kren da kaba ong: To sngap ia ka ktien u syiem uba khraw:

en: I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .
kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — kam long satia kaba dang sha jngai . Ïa ka jingjop jong nga yn ym pynslem . Ngan pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem bad ngan wallam ïa ka burom ka Israel hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah hajan ka hok jong nga; kan ym long kaba jngai, bad ka jingpynim jong nga kan ym sahkut: bad ngan buh ia ka jingpynim ha Seion na ka bynta ki Israel jong nga .

en: And when he had gone a little further thence , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who also were in the ship mending their nets .
kha: U la leit kham katto katne nangta bad u la ïohi ar ngut kiwei pat shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi . Ki don halor ka lieng jong ki ba ki dang ïapynbiang ïa ki jar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la leit kham sha jngai khyndiat hangta, u la iohi ia u Jakob u khun u Sebede bad u Ioannis u hynmen jong u, kiba ruh ki la don ha ka lieng ki la pynbeit ia ki jar jong ki.

en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee ,
kha: U  Trai  un wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Kanaan ïa kaba u la kular skhem ha phi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha ka por ba U Trai un wanrah ia me sha ka ri jong ki nong Kanaan kumba u la sngap jar ha me bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong me bad un ai ia ka ha me .

en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem ? come , and I will send thee unto them . And he said to him , Here am I .
kha: u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga kwah ba men leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki hynmen shynrang jong me ki ap sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Nga kloi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Israel u la ong ha u Joseph, Hato ki hynmen jong me kim ai bam ia ka kynhun langbrot ha Shehem? wan, bad ngan phah ia me sha ki . Bad u la ong ia u, Hangne nga don .

en: After these things the word of the  Lord  came unto Abram in a vision , saying , Fear not , Abram : I am thy shield , and thy exceeding great reward .
kha: Hadien kane , u Abram u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw bad ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Abram . Ngan ïada ïa me na ka jingma , bad ngan ai ha me ka bainong kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Abram ha ka jingphohsniew, ka da ong: Wat tieng, Abram: Nga long ka jingda jong me, bad ka bainong kaba khraw palat jong me .

en: And the second angel sounded , and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea : and the third part of the sea became blood  ;
kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la put ïa la ka turoi . Ïa kaei re kaei kaba i kum u lumbah uba khraw uba mehding la bret sha duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba ar u la sawa , bad kumba u lum uba heh uba la thang da ka ding u la shah bret ha duriaw: bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ka duriaw ka la kylla snam;

en: For this they willingly are ignorant of , that by the word of God the heavens were of old , and the earth standing out of the water and in the water :
kha: Ki da thmu khnang ban leh klet ïa ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum la slem bah , bad ïa ki bneng bad ka khyndew la pynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ki long kiba khlem jingtip da ka mon sngewbha, ba da ka ktien U Blei ki bneng ki la long kiba la rim, bad ka khyndew ka ieng na ka um bad ha ka um:

en: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
kha: U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dud , bad ka doh , bad u buh ïa kita ki jingbam ha khmat jong kita ki rangbah . Hangta ha trai u dieng u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka butter, bad ka dud, bad u khun masi uba u la riam, bad u la buh ia ka ha khmat jong ki ; bad u la ieng hajan jong ki hapoh u dieng , bad ki la bam .

en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .
kha: Kiba dkoh kin rynsied bad shad , bad kito ki bym lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Ki wahduid kin tuid lyngba ka ri shyiap ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u briew uba lyngkhuid un iaid kum u blang, bad ka shyntur jong u nonglehkai ba dum: namar ha ka ri khlaw ki um kin mih noh bad ki wah ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel , they spake unto her , saying , David sent us unto thee , to take thee to him to wife .
kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la leit sha ka ha Karmel bad ki ong ha ka ,  U Dabid u la phah ïa ngi ban shim ïa phi sha u ban long ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri u Dabid ki la wan sha Karmel , ki la kren ia ka da kaba ong: U Dabid u la phah ia ngi sha me ban shim ia me sha u ha ka tnga .

en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there , neither his disciples , they also took shipping , and came to Capernaum , seeking for Jesus .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba U Jisu ne ki synran jong u kim don hangta , ki la kiew ha kita ki lieng bad ki la leit sha Kapernam ban wad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew ki la iohi ba U Jisu um don hangta, lymne ki synran jong u ruh ki la leit lieng bad ki la poi sha Kapernam, ki wad ia U Jisu .

en: And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
kha: Hynrei u ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba nga lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi la leh . Wat kata kaba rit eh kaba ma phi ki paid Ephraim phi la leh ka long kaba kham kor shikatdei eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga la leh aiu mynta haba ianujor bad phi ? Hato ka jingkhleh ia ki sohjew jong u Ephraim kam kham bha ban ia ka jingbam jong u Abiezer ?

en: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us : they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , lumlang ïa la u paid ! Ngi lah shah kerkut ! Ki ïatur ïaleh ïa u nongïalam ki Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to lum ia lade ha ki shipai, ko khun shipai: u la buh ia ka jingshah thombor pyrshah ia ngi: kin shoh ia u nongbishar jong ki Israel da u dieng ha ka shyntur .

en: And he had two wives  ; the name of the one was Hannah , and the name of the other Peninnah : and Peninnah had children , but Hannah had no children .
kha: U Elkanah u don ar ngut ki tnga , ka Hannah bad ka Peninnah . Ka Peninnah ka don ki khun ki kti , hynrei ka Hannah kam shym la don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U don arngut ki tnga; ka kyrteng jong uwei ka long Hannah , bad ka kyrteng jong uwei pat u Peninnah: bad ka Peninnah ka don ki khun shynrang hynrei ka Hannah kam don khun .

en: And spared not the old world , but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness , bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly  ;
kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ka pyrthei mynbarim , hynrei u la wanrah ïa ka jingshlei um ha ka pyrthei jong ki briew bymtip Blei ; kita kiba u pyllait im ki long u Noah , uba la ïalap ïa ka hok , bad hynñiew ngut kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kam shym la pyllait ia ka pyrthei barim , hynrei ka la pynim ia u Noah ia u Noah uba phra , u nongialap ia ka hok , kaba wanrah ia ka jingshlei um ha ka pyrthei jong ki bym riewblei ; .

en: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , Behold , he is come out to fight against thee : he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah , saying ,
kha: Ka ktien ka leit poi sha ki Assyria ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u Tirhakah u syiem ka Ithiopia , u wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki . Haba u nongsynshar u ïohsngew ïa kane , u phah ïa ka shithi sha u Hesekaïah u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohsngew ia ka jingong jong u Tirhakah u syiem ka Ethiopia , Ha khmih u la mih ban ialeh pyrshah ia me: u la phah biang ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Hesekaiah .

en: And they shall come , and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys , and in the holes of the rocks , and upon all thorns , and upon all bushes .
kha: Kin ïaboi ha ki them khohruh khohram bad ha ki krem ha ki mawsiang , bad kin tap ïa kawei pa kawei ka bniap shiah bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaka pynbamphlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin wan, bad kin shongthait baroh ha ki them kiba la jot , bad ha ki thliew maw bad ha ki thliew maw baroh bad ha ki khlaw baroh .

en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;
kha: Ki mraw , to kohnguh ïa la ki kynrad da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ; bad leh ïa ka da ka dohnud basngur , kumba phi shakri ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri , to long kiba kohnguh ia ki kynrad jong phi kat kum ka doh , da ka jingtieng bad ka jingkhihwin , ha ka jinglong marwei jong ka dohnud jong phi , kumba ha U Khrist ; .

en: This charge I commit unto thee , son Timothy , according to the prophecies which went before on thee , that thou by them mightest war a good warfare ;
kha: Ko Timothi , u khun jong nga , nga pynkhamti ha me ïa kane ka hukum , kaba katba kum ki ktien jong ka jingïathuhlypa ba la kren shaphang jong me ha ka por kaba la leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka jingkynnoh nga aiti ha me, ko khun Timothi, kat kum ki jingiathuhlypa kiba la leit sha khmat jong me, ba me da ki me lah ban ialeh thma bha;

en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .
