kha: Hynrei haba ki shakri ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ka la kyntait ban wan . Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka mahadei Vashti ka la kyntait ban wan sha ka hukum jong u syiem da ki kamra jong u: namarkata u syiem u la bitar shibun, bad ka jingbitar jong u ka la thang ha u .

en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had abode two days in Ziklag  ;
kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Saul , u Dabid u wan phai na ka jingjop jong u ïa ki Amalek bad u sah ar sngi ha Siklag .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia hadien ka jingiap u Saul , haba u Dabid u la wan phai na ka jingpyniap ia ki Amalek , bad u Dabid u la shong ar sngi ha Ziklag ; .

en: Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;
kha: U ïaleh bad u angel bad u la jop . U la ïam bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jakob bad u la ïakren bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, u don ka bor halor u angel, bad u la jop: u la iam, bad u la kyrpad ia u: u la shem ia u ha Bethesel, bad hangta u la kren bad ngi;

en: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
kha: Nga long uba rit na kiba rit tam na ki briew jong U Blei baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki Jentil ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jong U Khrist , bad ban pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban ïohi kumno ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingthmu bamaïan U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha nga uba kham duna na ki riewkhuid baroh, la ai ia kane ka jingaiei, ba nga dei ban ialap hapdeng ki Jutang ia ki spah bym lah ban wad bniah jong U Khrist;

en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours , great of flesh  ; and hast increased thy whoredoms , to provoke me to anger .
kha: Pha la shah ïa ki paramarjan bakwah brai , ki nong Ijipt ban leit ïathiah bad pha , bad pha la pyndonkam ïa ka jingleh nuti jong pha ban pynbitar ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la leh ruh ia ka kam sniew bad ki para marjan jong me, kiba khraw ka doh bad me la pynbun ia ki jingkhaii met jong me, ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar .

en: And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out  ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .
kha: U mynsiem bymman u tur ïaleh ïa u da ka jinglynñiar kynsan bad bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring , ba kumta u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur ; u ïai pynshitom ïa u bad da kaba eh un pyllait ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka mynsiem ka shim ia u, bad kynsan kynsan u pyrta ia u; bad u pynkhih ia u tang khyndiat eh na u .

en: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest ; and so falling down on his face he will worship God , and report that God is in you of a truth .
kha: Yn bishar ïa u da kiei kiei baroh kiba u ïohsngew ; ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong u yn pynpaw madan , bad un dem ngon bad mane ïa U Blei , da kaba phla ,  Da shisha U Blei u don hangne hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ki jingmaham jong ka dohnud jong u ki paw ; bad kumta u hap ha ka khmat jong u un mane ia U Blei , bad un iathuh ba U Blei U don ha phi jong ka jingshisha .

en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .
kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namar ba phi long ha ka liang jong nga , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba ai ia phi ia ka khuri um ban dih ha ka kyrteng jong nga , namar phi long ki jong U Khrist , shisha nga ong ha phi , un ym duh ia ka bainong jong u .

en: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king : Solomon built Millo , and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father .
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuhkhana shaphang kata ka jingïaleh pyrshah . U Solomon u la nang pyndap khyndew ha ki jaka kiba ha mihngi jong ka Jerusalem bad u moramot ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka la long ka daw ba u la rah ia la ka kti pyrshah ia u syiem: U Solomon u la tei ia u Millo , bad u la pynbha ia ki jingtwa jong ka shnong u Dabid u kpa jong u .

en: I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
kha: Nga la leit sha uwei na kito kiba ïeng hangta bad nga la kylli na u ban batai ïa ka baroh . Te u la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la wan hajan uwei na ki uba ieng hajan bad nga la kylli ia u ia ka jingshisha jong kine baroh . Kumta u la iathuh ia nga , bad u la pynlong ia nga ban tip ia ka jingbatai ia kiei kiei baroh .

en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,
kha: Shaphang ka jait Joseph u ong ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ka ri jong ki da u slap Bad da ka um napoh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Joseph u la ong: La kyrkhu ia ka ri jong u, na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba kordor jong ka bneng, na ka bynta ka dewbilat bad na ka bynta ka jingjylliew kaba shong shapoh .

en: So David would not remove the ark of the  Lord  unto him into the city of David : but David carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
kha: Kumta u la rai ban ym leit shim ïa ka bad u sha Jerusalem ; pynban , u phai noh na lynti bad u lam ïa ka sha ka ïing jong u Obed Edom , u traishnong jong ka nongbah Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid un ym weng noh ia ka synduk U Trai ha u sha ka shnong u Dabid: hynrei u Dabid u la rah ia ka shawei sha ka iing u Obeddom u Gadit .

en: And saw heaven opened , and a certain vessel descending unto him , as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners , and let down to the earth :
kha: U la ïohi ba la plie ïa ka bneng bad kaei re kawei kaba wan hiar kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka sha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ia ka bneng kaba plie, bad kawei ka lieng kaba la hiar sha u, kumba ka la long ka jain kaba heh ha ki saw tylli ki thliew bad ka la hiar sha ka khyndew:

en: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward : and their number by their polls , man by man , was thirty and eight thousand .
kha: U shim jingkheiñ ïa baroh ki shynrang Lebi kiba la don laiphew snem lane tam . Baroh ki don laiphew phra hajar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la khein ia ki Lebi naduh ka rta kaba laiphew snem shaneng: bad ka jingkhein jong ki da ki poll jong ki, u briew da u briew, ka long laiphew san hajar .

en: And put my cup , the silver cup , in the sack s mouth of the youngest , and his corn money . And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken .
kha: Thep ïa ka khuri rupa jong nga ha khlieh ka byrni jong u para khatduh , lem bad ïa ka bai kew jong u .  U la leh kumba la bthah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka khuri jong nga, ka khuri rupa, ha ka shyntur jong u ba rit tam bad ka pisa kew jong u . Bad u la leh kat kum ka ktien kaba u Joseph u la kren .

en: So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .
kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha nga da ka borbah , bad katba U Mynsiem jong u , u rah noh ïa nga , nga la sngewkthang bad sngewbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u mynsiem u la pynkiew ia nga, bad u la shim noh ia nga, bad nga la leit sha ka jingsngewsih, ha ka jingshit jong ka mynsiem jong nga ; hynrei ka kti U Trai ka la khlain halor jong nga .

en: If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .
kha: Ïa uno uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyrkhong ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la lumlang bad la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew um kohnguh ia nga, la bret noh ia u kum u tnat, bad u la tyrkhong ; bad ki briew ki lum ia ki, bad ki bret ia ki ha ka ding , bad ki shah thang .

en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , u shong bad u duwai ,  Ngam long uba dei hok ïa kaei kaba me la lah leh na ka bynta jong nga , ko  Trai  U Blei , lane ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u syiem u la wan shong ha khmat U Trai bad u la ong: Nga long mano ko Trai Blei bad kaei ka iing jong nga ba me la wanrah ia nga haduh mynta ?

en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .
kha: Bad u la ïai kren ha ki baroh ,  To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da kiei kiei kiba u don , kam pher haduh katno u lah ban long uba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, To sumar bad to husiar na ka jingkwah brai: namar ka jingim jong u briew kam don ha ka jingbun kiei kiei kiba u don .

en: As you continue studying the Bible , you will learn how to use the Bible to explain your faith in Jehovah and the good news . —Read Romans 10 :13-15 .
kha: Katba phi dang ïaibteng ban pule ïa ka Baibl , katta phin sa nang ban pyndonkam ïa ka Baibl ban batai ïa la ka jingngeit ha U Jehobah bad ha ka khubor babha .—Pule Rom 10 :13-15 .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba phi nang pule ia ka Baibl , phin sa nang kumno ban pyndonkam ia ka Baibl ban batai ia ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Jehobah bad ka khubor babha .  Pule Rom 10:13-15 .

en: Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .
kha: Lada phan jin da la tip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! Hynrei mynta pham lah ban ïohi ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Lada me la tip, wat ma me ruh, la kumno kumno ha kane ka sngi jong me, kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka jingsuk jong me ! hynrei mynta ki la buhrieh na ki khmat jong me .

en: And they sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth : and the men marvelled one at another .
kha: Kumta kita shi para ki ïashong ha khmat jong u , ha ka miej marpyrshah ïa u Joseph kat kum ka rta jong ki naduh uba nyngkong haduh uba khatduh . Haba ki ïohi kumno ki ïashong bam , ki shu ïa-peit lyngngoh para ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shong ha khmat jong u, u khun nyngkong kat kum ka hok kha jong u, bad uba rit tam kat kum ka jinglong samla jong u: bad ki shynrang ki ia lyngngoh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;
kha: Mynta ka sngi U  Trai  u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la sngewsih ia me ha kane ka sngi ban long ki briew kiba kyrpang jong u, kumba u la kular ia me, bad ba me dei ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u baroh;

en: Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .
kha: Haba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u , nga la kyllon ha khyndew khlem tipbriew bad nga thiah pyllup hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong u: bad haba nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki ktien jong u , te nga la iohthiah jylliew ha ka khmat jong nga bad ka khmat jong nga shapoh khyndew .

en: Then the king went on to Gilgal , and Chimham went on with him : and all the people of Judah conducted the king , and also half the people of Israel .
kha: Haba u syiem u la lah jam sha shiliang , ïa kaba la synran da baroh ki rangbah ka Judah bad shiteng na ki paid Israel , u la leit beit sha Gilgal , bad u Shimham u la leit bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la leit sha Gilgal bad u Chimham u la leit sha khmat: bad ki briew baroh ki Judah ki la ialam ia u syiem bad ruh shiteng na ki Israel .

en: And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying ,  All hail .  And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .
kha: Kynsan U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .  Ki la leit sha u , bad ki la bat ïa ki kjat jong u , bad ki la mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang leit iathuh ha ki synran jong u, ha khmih, U Jisu u la iakynduh ia ki, u da ong, Baroh ki la iaid . Ki la wan bad ki la bat ia u da ki kjat bad ki la mane ia u .

en: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out  ; it speaketh deceit : one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth , but in heart he layeth his wait .
kha: Ki thylliej jong ki , ki long ki khnam kiba shyrkhei ; ki ïathuh lamler borabor . Uwei uwei u kren ki kyntien sngewieit ïa u paramarjan jong u , hynrei ha ka jingshisha u pynap ka jingriam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shyntur jong ki ka long kum u khnam ba la siat ; ka kren thok: u kren da kaba suk ia u paramarjan jong u da ka shyntur jong u , hynrei ha ka dohnud u buh ia ka jingap jong u .

en: And thou hast said unto me , O Lord  God  , Buy thee the field for money , and take witnesses  ; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
kha: Pynban , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , me long ma me uba la hukum ïa nga ban thied ïa ka lyngkha ha ka jingdon lang ki sakhi , wat la ka nongbah ka la jan shah kurup ha ki nong Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la ong ha nga, ko Trai Blei, To thied ia ka lyngkha na ka bynta ka pisa , bad shim ia ki sakhi ; namar la ai ia ka nongbah ha ka kti jong ki Khaldes .

en: And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .
kha: U la leit sha u , u la theh umphniang bad ka waiñ ha ki jingmong jong u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; nangta u la buh ïa uta u briew halor u jingri jong u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbasa    , ha kaba u la sumar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha u, bad u la teh ia ki jingmynsaw jong u, da kaba theh umphniang bad wain, bad u la buh ia u ha la ka jong ka mrad, bad u la wanrah ia u ha ka jaka ri jingri bad u la sumar ia u .

en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
kha: Lada kumta , u dei ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kiba dang sah haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat kaba bud , hadien kata un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ai ba un khein ia ki snem jong ka jingdie ia ka, bad un pynphai biang ia ka jingbun palat sha uta u briew ha uba u la die ia ka ; ba un wan phai biang sha ka jingdon jong u .

en: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul , that he might loose him : wherefore he sent for him the oftener , and communed with him .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u da kyrmen ba u Paul un ai khyndiat ka pisa ïa u ; bad na kane ka daw u ju phah khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyrmen ruh ba la ai pisa ia u na u Paul, ba un pyllait noh ia u: namar kata u la phah ia u kham bunsien bad u la iakynduh bad u .

en: Now after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them , and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , u syiem Dabid u tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia bad u jop ïa ki . U shim noh na ka jingpynïaid jong ki ïa ka nongbah Gath bad ki nongrit ba don sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien kane ka la jia , ba u Dabid u la shoh ia ki Philistia bad u la pyndem ia ki bad u la shim ia ka Gath bad ki shnong jong ka na ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por kan wan haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bad kin mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin wan shuh shuh kito kiba la leh bha, haduh ka jingmihpat jong ka jingim ; bad kito kiba la leh sniew, haduh ka jingmihpat jong ka jingpynrem .

en: Talk no more so exceeding proudly  ; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth : for the  Lord  is a God of knowledge , and by him actions are weighed .
kha: Sngap noh na kaba kren kob ; sngap jar na kaba kren meng . Naba U  Trai  u long U Blei uba tip lut , bad u bishar ïa ki jingleh ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kren ym shuh da kaba sngew sarong shuh shuh: wat ai ba ka jingsngew sarong kan mih na ka shyntur jong phi: namar U Trai u long U Blei uba tip, bad da u la khia ia ki jingleh .

en: And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise  ; he calleth thee .
kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la ong ,  Khot ïa u .  Kumta ki la khot ïa uta u briew uba matlah .  To lehkmen !  ki la ong .  Ïeng joit , u khot ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ieng sah bad u la hukum ia u ban shah khot . Ki khot ia uta uba matlah, ki da ong ha u, To long kiba suk, to khie bein ia me .

en: And I will destroy your high places , and cut down your images , and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols , and my soul shall abhor you .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi kiba ha ki lum , ngan pynpra ïa ki duwan thang jingiwbih jong phi , bad ngan bret ïa ki metïap jong phi halor ki bleithaw jong phi kiba la kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynjot ia ki jaka ba jrong jong phi, bad ngan ot ia ki dur jong phi, bad ngan bret ia ki met iap jong phi halor ki met iap jong phi , bad ka mynsiem jong nga kan shun ia phi .

en: But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .
kha: Nga kwah ba phin tep ïa nga bad la ki kpa tymmen ; rah ïa nga na Ijipt , bad tep ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la tep ïa ki .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga, bad me phin rah ia nga na Ijipt, bad phin tep ia nga ha ka jaka tep jong ki . Bad u la ong , Ngan leh kumba me la ong .

en: And his concubine played the whore against him , and went away from him unto her father s house to Beth–lehem–judah , and was there four whole months .
kha: hynrei ka la bitar ïa u , ka leit phai pat sha ïing u kpa jong ka ha Bethlehem , bad ka sah hangta saw bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u u la ialehkai ia ka met jong u, bad u la leit noh na u sha ka iing u kpa jong ka sha 

en: And I answered again , and said unto him , What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves ?
kha: Bad kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki tnat dieng Olib hajan ki ar tylli ki tyndong ksiar na kaba la phylliew ïa ka umphniang Olib ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la jubab biang bad nga la ong ha u, Kiei kine ki ar tylli ki tnat olive kiba lyngba ki ar tylli ki pipe ksiar ki pynkhuid ia ka umphniang ksiar na ki ?

en: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun , saying , Every man to his city , and every man to his own country .
kha: Haba la jan sep sngi , la wan ka hukum ha ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ,  Uwei pa uwei u briew un leit phai noh sha ka la ri bad ka nongbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la leit sha ka ri baroh kawei shaphang ka jinghiar jong ka sngi , ka la ong , Uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka shnong .

en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
kha: Kumta ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol ki la khot lang ïa ka kynhun riewngeit baroh kawei bad ki la ong ,  Kam long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh klet ïa ka jingïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei khnang ban pynïaid ïa ka kam pisa tyngka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shiphew ngut ki la khot ia u paidbah ki synran sha ki , bad ki la ong , Kam long kaba don jingmut ba ngin iehnoh ia ka ktien U Blei bad ban shakri ia ki miej .

en: Ye shall not offer unto the  Lord  that which is bruised , or crushed , or broken , or cut  ; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land .
kha: Wat kñia sha U  Trai  ïa uno uno u jingri uba la shah shohdab ne shah puid . Ym dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban aiti ha U Trai ia kaba la tyrkhong ne kaba la tyrkhong ne kaba la tyrkhong ne kaba la tyrkhong; lymne phin ym ai ei ei na ka ha ka ri jong phi .

en: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .
kha: U Araunah mar ïa-ïohi ba u Syiem Dabid u wan , u la iehnoh ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad u dem rit , bad la ka khlieh kaba kynduh ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan sha Ornan , u Ornan u la peit bad u la iohi ia u Dabid bad u la mih na ka jaka ba la khleh lang bad u la dem khrup ha u Dabid da ka khmat jong u shapoh khyndew .

en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
kha: Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi sha ka jaka jong ki Japhlet haduh ka jaka jong ka Beth Haron kaba Sharum . Nangta u suh sha Geser bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka leit shapoh sepngi sha rud duriaw jong ka Jaffleti, sha rud duriaw jong ka Bethhoron ka ri, bad sha Gzer: bad ki jingleit shabar jong ka ki don ha duriaw .

en: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
kha: Ka dei ha ka lynti ha ka por shiteng sngi , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sngi , kaba wan na sahit bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ baroh sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit lang bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ko syiem , nga la iohi ha lynti ia ka jingshai na bneng , halor ka jingshai jong ka sngi , kaba shai sawdong jong nga bad kito kiba iaid ryngkat bad nga .

en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .
kha: Man ka por , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw bad ki nongïalam jong ki , nalor ki briew kiba wan sha nga na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki don ha ka miej jong nga shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw bad ki nongsynshar , nalor kito kiba wan sha ngi na ki nongwei kiba don shaphang jong ngi .

en: And they cried unto the children of Dan . And they turned their faces , and said unto Micah , What aileth thee , that thou comest with such a company ?
kha: bad ki pyrta ïa ki . Ki rangbah na Dan ki kyrtiang dien bad ki kylli ïa u Mikah ,  Kaei kaba la jia ? Balei katne u paidbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta ia ki khun u Dan . Ki la phai ia ki khmat jong ki bad ki la ong ha u Mikah, Kaei kaba phi wan bad kum kata ka kynhun ?

en: These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :
kha: Ïa kine ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum :  Wat leit sha kano kano ka thain jong ki Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki shiphew ngut ki Jisu ki la phah shabar bad ki la hukum ia ki, ki da ong: Wat leit sha ka lynti jong ki Jutang bad sha kano kano ka shnong jong ki nong Samaria phim rung:

en: Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :
kha: Mynta khreh kloi ban leit sha i pa , bad ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jong i u ong kumne , ‘ U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; wan noh sha nga , bad wat pynslem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi la leit sha u kpa jong nga bad to ong ha u, Kumta u khun jong me u Joseph, U Blei u la pynlong ia nga u kynrad jong ka ri Ijipt baroh: to wan hiar sha nga, wat sah:

en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother : and it came to pass , when they were in the field , that Cain rose up against Abel his brother , and slew him .
kha: Nangta u Kain u ong ïa u Abel u para jong u ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha lyngkha .  Haba ki la don ha lyngkha , u Kain u la shoh ïa la u para bad u la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Kain u la kren bad u Abel u hynmen jong u: bad ka la jia, haba ki la don ha lyngkha, ba u Kain u la ieng pyrshah ia u Abel u hynmen jong u, bad u la pyniap ia u .

en: He will turn again , he will have compassion upon us  ; he will subdue our iniquities  ; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea .
kha: Men long uba leh-isynei sa shisien pat . Men ïuh ha ki kjat ïa ki pop jong ngi bad ñiat ïa ki sha trai jong ka duriaw !
translated_en_to_kha: Un phai biang sha ngi ; un sngewsynei ia ngi bad me phin bret ia ki pop jong ki baroh shapoh duriaw .

en: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah : and the Spirit of God was upon him also , and he went on , and prophesied , until he came to Naioth in Ramah .
kha: Katba u dang leit shata , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u wan hiar tyllep ha u ruh , bad u shad bad u risa baroh shi lynter lynti sha Naïoth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit shata sha Naiot ha Ramah : bad U Mynsiem U Blei u la don halor jong u ruh, bad u la iaid shakhmat bad u la iathuhlypa haduh ba u la poi ha Naiot ha Ramah .

en: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel , and set me upon a very high mountain , by which was as the frame of a city on the south .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Blei u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri Israel , bad u la pynshong ïa nga halor uwei u lumbah uba jrong . Nga la ïohi ha khmat jong nga shi kynhun ki jingtei kiba i kum ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jingphohsniew U Blei u la wanrah ia nga sha ka ri Israel , bad u la buh ia nga ha u lum uba jrong bha , ha uba ka long kum ka frame jong ka nongbah shaphang shathie .

en: Is it possible that mankind is being manipulated by an unseen but powerful and sinister force ? If so , what is it , and how can we protect ourselves ?
kha: Hato ka lah ban long ba u khun bynriew u shah pynkhih da ka bor bym lah ban iohi hynrei kaba donbor bad kaba sniew ? Lada ka long kumta kaei kata , bad kumno ngin iada ialade ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka lah ban long ba u khun bynriew u shah pyndonkam da ka bor bym lah ban iohi hynrei kaba donbor bad kaba pop ? Lada ka long kumta , kaei kata , bad kumno ngin iada ia lade ?

en: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la ong ïa kane , u la khuslai jur bad u la pynbna da kaba shai ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uwei na phi un sa shetkylla ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la ong kumta, u la sngewsih ha ka mynsiem, bad u la sakhi, bad u la ong: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, ba uwei na phi un die noh ia nga .

en: Again , I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .
kha: Nga la tip ruh balei ba ki briew ki trei shitom ban jop : Ka dei namar ba ki bishni ïa kiei kiei kiba ki paramarjan jong ki , ki don . Hynrei ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , nga la pyrkhat ia ka jingtrei shitom baroh, bad ia kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba dei, ba na ka bynta kane u briew u sngewsih ia u paramarjan jong u . Kane ka long ruh ka jinglong ba sniew bad ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem .

en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , Abner took him , and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand .
kha: Kumta ynda u Dabid u wan phai sha ka jaka sher dara na kaba pynïap ïa u Goliath , u Abner u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul . U Dabid u dang rah hi ïa ka khlieh u Goliath .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan phai na ka jingpyniap ia u Philistia , u Abner u la shim ia u bad u la wanrah ia u ha khmat u Saul bad ka khlieh jong u Philistia ha ka kti jong u .

en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
kha: phi lah ban sngewskhem ba ka jingstad ka long kaba bha ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka lawei jong phi kan long kaba phyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka jingtip ia ka jingstad kan long ha ka mynsiem jong me: haba me la shem ia ka , te kan don ka bainong bad ka jingkhmih lynti jong me kan ym shah ot noh .

en: According to their deeds , accordingly he will repay , fury to his adversaries , recompence to his enemies  ; to the islands he will repay recompence .
kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u kat kum ki jingleh jong ki , wat ïa kito kiba shong sha ki ri kiba jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ki kam jong ki, katkum kata un siew kylliang ia ki nongshun jong u, ka jingsiew kylliang ia ki nongshun jong u;

en: And she said unto Elijah , What have I to do with thee , O thou man of God ? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance , and to slay my son ?
kha: Ka ong ha u Elijah ,  A u briew jong U Blei , balei me leh ïa kane ha nga ? Hato me wan hangne ban pynkynmaw ïa U Blei ïa ki pop jong nga bad pynjia ïa ka jingïap u khun jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u Elijah, Nga don jingiadei bad me, ko briew jong U Blei ? me wan sha nga ban khot ia ka pop jong nga ban kynmaw bad ban pyniap ia u khun jong nga ?

en: But rejoice , inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ s sufferings  ; that , when his glory shall be revealed , ye may be glad also with exceeding joy .
kha: Pynban to shadkmen ba phi ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingshahshitom u Khrist , khnang ba phi lah ban long kiba dap da ka jingkmen haba ïa ka burom jong u yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to sngewbha , namar ba phi long ki nongiashim bynta ha ki jingjynjar U Khrist; kata, haba ka burom jong u kan paw, phi lah ruh ban sngewbha da ka jingkmen kaba palat .

en: We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us  ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .
kha: Hynrei ngi , ngi long ki jong U Blei . Uno uno uba ithuh ïa U Blei , u shahshkor ïa ngi ; uno uno u bym long u jong U Blei , um shahshkor ïa ngi . Kane te , ka long kumno ngi lah ban ïathuh ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng U Mynsiem ka jingshisha bad u mynsiem ka jinglamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi long na U Blei: uta uba tip ia U Blei u iohsngew ia ngi; uta u bym dei na U Blei um iohsngew ia ngi . Da kane ngi tip ia ka mynsiem jong ka jingshisha bad ka mynsiem jong ka jingbakla .

en: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .
kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim shym neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , ki iehnoh shisyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei um don tynrai ha lade, hynrei u neh shipor: namar haba ka jingjynjar ne ka jingshah pynshitom ka mih namar ka ktien , da bad da u la sngewsih .

en: And I will make this city desolate , and an hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingpynjot kaba shyrkhei kum kane ha kane ka nongbah ha kaba uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lyngba un kyndit bad lyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia kane ka nongbah kaba la jot , bad uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba kata un sngew lyngngoh bad un sngap jar namar ki jingpang jong ka baroh .

en: And five of you shall chase an hundred , and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight : and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword .
kha: san ngut na phi phin jop ïa ki shispah ngut , bad shispah ngut na phi phin jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad san ngut na phi kin beh shispah ngut bad shispah ngut na phi kin phet krad: bad ki nongshun jong phi kin hap ha khmat jong phi da ka waitlam .

en: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel , and said unto them , Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families , and kill the passover .
kha: U Moses u khot ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi baroh phin jied ïa la u khunlangbrot ne u khunblang bad pynïap ïa u , khnang ba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kin ïoh ban rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la khot ia ki rangbah Israel baroh bad u la ong ha ki: To mih noh bad shim ia phi ia u khun langbrot kat kum ki longiing jong phi bad pyniap ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait .

en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .
kha: U briew uba kren ha la ka jong ka bor u pyrshang ban ïoh burom na ka bynta ïa lade hi . Hynrei uba wad ïa ka burom jong uta uba la phah ïa u , u long uba shida , bad ym don ka bymshisha ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kren shaphang lade u wad ia la ka jong ka burom: hynrei uta uba wad ia ka burom jong u kaba la phah ia u, kumjuh ruh ka long kaba shisha, bad ym don ka jingbymhok ha u .

en: The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not , It is enough :
kha: U thliem u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei , bad baroh ar ki kyrteng  Ai ïa nga !  Don saw tylli kiei kiei ki bym ju kdang :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleit kai ka don arngut ki khun kynthei, ki iam, Ai, ai . Ki don lai tylli kiei kiei kiba ym ju sngewhun , hooid , saw tylli kiei kiei kim ju ong , Ka biang:

en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ,
kha: Me tharai ba me kham bha ban ïa u Balak , u khun jong u Sippor , u syiem Moab ? Um ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel . Hato u la ju ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta me long kaei kaei kaba kham bha ban ia u Balak u khun u Siphor u syiem u Moab ? hato u la ju ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel , ne u la ju ialeh pyrshah ia ki .

en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .
kha: Kane ka jingrakhe ka long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong ngi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa ngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long na ka bynta ka dak ha ka kti jong me, bad na ka bynta ki khmat jong me: namar da ka bor jong ka kti U Trai u la pynmih ia ngi na Ijipt .

en: And he wrote in the letter , saying , Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle , and retire ye from him , that he may be smitten , and die .
kha: U thoh :  Buh ïa u Uriah ha khmat duh , ha ka jaka kaba jur tam ka jingïaleh , nangta kynran dien noh bad ai ba un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thoh ha ka shithi, u da ong: To buh ia u Uri ha khmat jong ka thma kaba shit tam, bad to shongthait noh na u, ba un shah pynmong bad iap .

en: Ought ye not to know that the  Lord  God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?
kha: Hato phim tip ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid ka bym lah ban pynkheiñ , da kaba ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa ka jinglong syiem junom halor ki Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la ai ia ka hima halor ki Israel ha u Dabid junom , wat ha u bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u da ka jutang jong ka umsoh ?

en: And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut , ka Samaria ka kyllon ; kane ka dei ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah , bad ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki lai snem ki la shim ia ka: wat ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong u Hesekaiah , kata ka long ka snem kaba hynniew jong u syiem Israel .

en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — un phah khrai khlieh ïa phi ! Nangta un sa sdien ïa ka met jong phi ha u dieng , bad ki sim kin bam ïa ka doh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hapoh lai sngi u Pharaoh un rah ia ka khlieh jong me na me , bad un shong ia me ha u dieng ; bad ki sim kin bam ia ka doh jong me na me .

en: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .
kha: Kata ka um ruh ka la nang hiar nang hiar , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba shiphew , ki kliar lum ki la paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki um ki nang hiar beit haduh ka shi bnai: ha ka shi bnai , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai .

en: Kerioth is taken , and the strong holds are surprised , and the mighty men s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .
kha: bad ïa ki shnong bad ki kut yn kurup . Ha kata ka sngi ki shipai jong ka Moab kin sheptieng kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: La shim ia u Kerioth bad ki jingbat kiba khlain ki sngew lyngngoh, bad ki dohnud kiba khlain bor ha Moab ha kata ka sngi kin long kum ka dohnud jong ka kynthei ha ki jingpang jong ka .

en: For they shall eat , and not have enough : they shall commit whoredom , and shall not increase : because they have left off to take heed to the  Lord .
kha: Phin sa bam ïa la ka bynta na ki jingkñia hynrei phin ïai thngan . Phin sa mane ïa ki blei pynkharoi , hynrei la katta ruh phin ym ïoh khun satia , namar phi la phai lyndet na nga bad bud ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kin bam , bad kin ym biang: kin leh ia ka kam khaii met bad kin ym nang kiew: namar ki la leit noh ban sumar ia U Trai .

en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba shongsuk ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki briew kiba khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewsih ia kito kiba suk ha Seion bad kiba shaniah ha u lum Samaria , kiba la jer kyrteng u rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew , ha kiba ka iing Israel ka la wan !

en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .
kha: Lada phi king kynruh ïa ka dud , ka pynmih makhon . Lada phi tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongno , ka pynmih snam . Lada phi pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka jingkhluit jong ka dud ka pynmih ia ka sniehdoh, bad ka jingkhluit jong ka shyntur ka pynmih snam: kumta ka jingpynbor ia ka jingbitar ka pynmih ia ka jingialeh .

en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together , and went over , and pitched in the valley of Jezreel .
kha: Nangta ki Midian , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki ïalumlang baroh , ki jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan , bad ki sher dara ha ka Them Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nong Midian bad ki nong Amalek bad ki khun shatei lam mihngi ki la ialum lang bad ki la leit shajan bad ki la iaid ha ka them Jesel .

en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them , to suffice them ? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them , to suffice them ?
kha: Hato don blang don masi katta katta ban pynïap kat haduh ban da pynbiang ïa ki ? Hato ki dohkha baroh ha ka duriaw kin dap na ka bynta jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki langbrot bad ki kynhun kin shah pyniap na ka bynta jong ki ? lane baroh ki dohkha duriaw kin ialum lang na ka bynta jong ki ?

en: We are confounded , because we have heard reproach : shame hath covered our faces : for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the  Lord s  house .
kha: Phi ong , ‘ La pynjahburom ïa ngi bad la pynlehrain ïa ngi ; ngi sngew ba ngim lah leh ei ei shuh namar ki nongwei ki la shimti noh ïa ki jaka bakhuid ha ka Templ .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi sngew lyngngoh , namar ngi la iohsngew ia ka jingshah lehbein: ka jingsngewlehrain ka la tap ia ki khmat jong ngi: namar ki nongwei ki wan sha ki jaka kyntang jong ka iing U Trai .

en: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , which refuseth to be healed ? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , and as waters that fail ?
kha: Balei nga dei ban ïaishah shitom ? Balei ba ki jingmynsaw jong nga ym lah ban pynkoit ? Balei ba kim koit ? Hato me thmu ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa nga kum ka wahduid kaba ryngkhiang ha ka por lyiur ?
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ka jingpang jong nga ka long kaba neh slem, bad ka jingmynsaw jong nga kaba ym lah ban pynkoit ? me long baroh kawei ha nga kum u nonglamler bad kum ki um kiba jah ?

en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale s belly  ; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u la pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet hapoh u dohkha uba heh , kumta U Khun U Briew un pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet ha kiba jylliew jong ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba u Jonah u la don lai sngi lai miet ha ka kpoh jong u dohkha; kumta u Khun u briew un long lai sngi lai miet ha ka dohnud ka khyndew .

en: And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .
kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas ; u rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u dei u Abner , u bakha jong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u Saul ka long Ahinoam , ka khun jong u Ahimaas: bad ka kyrteng jong u kapten jong u ka long u Abner , u khun u Ner u Ner u kpa jong u Saul .

en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .
kha: Ki khat-ar ngut ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai ba la buh ïa u , ki pynbiang ka jingbam ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa lade bad ïa baroh kiba bam ha ka ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ophisar ki la pynbiang ia u syiem Solomon bad na ka bynta baroh kiba wan sha ka miej syiem Solomon, uwei pa uwei ha u bnai jong u: kim duna ei ei .

en: However , certain leaders of the ruling party are sneering at BNPs ineffective programmes , as if they would be happier with heated agitation instead .
kha: Hynrei ki katto katne ki nongialam jong ka seng synshar ki rkhie bein ia ki prokram bym treikam jong ki BNP , kumba kin kham sngewbha da ka jingkhihwin kaba jur ha ka jaka jong kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei katto katne ki nongialam jong ka seng synshar ki sngap jar ha ki prokram ki bym treikam , kumba kin kham sngewbha da ka jingkhihwin kaba jur ha ka jaka jong ki .

en: And I saw a great white throne , and him that sat on it , from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away  ; and there was found no place for them .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka khet balieh kaba khraw bad ïa uta uba shong ha ka . Ka pyrthei bad ka bneng ki la phet na khmat jong u bad ym shym la ïohi shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia ka khet lieh kaba khraw bad uta uba shong ha ka, na ka khmat jong u ka khyndew bad ka bneng ki la phet noh; bad ym shym la lap ia ka jaka na ka bynta jong ki .

en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , katba ka dang dum , ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit sha kata ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ba ïa u mawkhang la weng noh na ka jingkhang ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka taiew ka wan ka Maria Magdalene dang dum, ha ka jingtep , bad ka iohi ia u maw ba la weng noh na ka jingtep .

en: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants  ; and some of the king s servants be dead , and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
kha: Nangta ki siat ïa ngi da ki khnam na ka kynroh , bad katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem kynrad ki la shah pynïap ; u Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongsiat ki la siat na ka kynroh halor ki shakri jong me ; bad katto katne na ki shakri syiem ki la iap , bad u shakri jong me u Urih u Hit ruh u la iap .

en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan went out against them , he , and all his people , to the battle at Edrei .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki la phai bad leit na ka lynti sha Bashan , bad u syiem Og jong ka Bashan u la wan mih bad la ka kynhun ïapom ban tur ïaleh ïa ki ha Edrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai bad ki la leit sha ka lynti jong u Basan: bad u Og u syiem u Basan u la leit shabar pyrshah ia ki, ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh, sha ka thma ha Edrei .

en: And they said , We cannot , until all the flocks be gathered together , and till they roll the stone from the well s mouth  ; then we water the sheep .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Ngim lah ban leh kumta tad haduh ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh kin don hangne bad ba ym pat pyntyllun sharud ïa u maw ; nangta ngin sa ai um ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ngim lah, haduh ba ki kynhun baroh kin ialum lang, bad haduh ba kin da pynkhih ia u maw na ka shyntur jong ka thliew ; nangta ngi ai um ia ki langbrot .

en: And Jehoahaz besought the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hearkened unto him : for he saw the oppression of Israel , because the king of Syria oppressed them .
kha: Nangta u Jehoahas u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  , haba u ïohi kumno u syiem ka Syria u lehbeiñ sat ïa ki Israel , u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehosa u la kyrpad ia U Trai, bad U Trai u la sngap ia u: namar u la iohi ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong ki Israel, namar u syiem Syria u la pynshitom bein ia ki .

en: Therefore the  Lord  stablished the kingdom in his hand  ; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents  ; and he had riches and honour in abundance .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa u Jehoshaphat ka jingsynshar baskhem halor ka hima Judah , bad baroh ki briew ki wallam ki jingai sngewbha , ba kumta u long uba riewspah bad ïoh ïa ka burom bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la pynskhem ia ka hima ha ka kti jong u ; bad u Judah baroh u la wanrah ha u Jehoshaphat; bad u la don ka spah bad ka burom ha ka jingbun .

en: And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .
kha: Ainguh ïa U Blei namar ka jingtipbriew jong phi , bad namar kaei kaba phi la leh ha kane ka sngi ha kaba khang ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynïap briew bad na kaba pynhiarkput da lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la kyrkhu ia ka jingai jingmut jong me, bad la kyrkhu ia me, uba la pynsah ia nga ha kane ka sngi ban wan theh snam, bad na kaba pynshitom ia lade da ka kti jong nga hi .

en: For the day of the  Lord  is near upon all the heathen : as thou hast done , it shall be done unto thee : thy reward shall return upon thine own head .
kha: Ka sngi ka la jan ha kaba ma nga , U  Trai  ,  ngan bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ko Edom , ïa kaei kaba pha la leh yn sa leh ha pha . Phan sa ïoh pat ïa kaei kaba pha la ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sngi U Trai ka la jan ha ki jaitbynriew baroh: kumba me la leh , kan long ha me: ka bainong jong me kan wan phai ha la ka jong ka khlieh .

en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew halor ka lieng bad ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha Bethsaida , sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , katba u dang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi u la khang ia ki synran jong u ban rung shapoh lieng bad ban leit sha kawei pat ka liang shuwa sha Betsaida , katba u dang phah noh ia ki briew .

en: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :
kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga ñiew ïa lade uba donbok ba ha kane ka sngi nga dei ban ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong phi na baroh kita kiei kiei kiba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tharai ia lade ba nga sngewbha, ko syiem Agrippa, namar ngan jubab na ka bynta lade mynta ka sngi ha khmat jong me da kaba ktah ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga shah kynnoh ha ki Jiw:

en: Yea , forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness , so that they lacked nothing  ; their clothes waxed not old , and their feet swelled not .
kha: Lyngba sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap me pynbiang ïa baroh kaba ki donkam ; ki sopti ba ki phong kim shym la jot noh , bad ki kjat jong ki kim shym la sieb bad pang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, sawphew snem me la pynneh ia ki ha ka ri khlaw, haduh ba kim duna ei ei shuh shuh ki jain jong ki kim shym la tymmen, bad ki kjat jong ki kim shym la tyrkhong .

en: And they said one to another , Who hath done this thing ? And when they enquired and asked , they said , Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing .
kha: Ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Uei uba la leh ïa kane ?  Ki la tohkit bad shem ba u Gideon u khun jong u Joash u la leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Mano ba la leh ia kane ? Bad haba ki la kylli bad kylli ki la ong: U Gideon u khun u Joash u la leh ia kane ka kam .

en: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the  Lord  , not day , nor night : but it shall come to pass , that at evening time it shall be light .
kha: lane kano kano ka jingdum . Kan ïai don borabor ka jingshai sngi , wat ha ka por mynmiet . Lano kane kan jia , tang U  Trai  uba tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kan long kawei ka sngi kaba la tip da U Trai, ym sngi ne miet: hynrei kan sa jia, ba ha ka por janmiet kan long kaba jem .

en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai hapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha phi , Ba bun kin wan na mihngi bad sepngi bad kin shong bad u Abraham bad u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka hima bneng .

en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki tiar pynïeng Ïingjaiñ , ïa ki diengkhap , ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , bad ïa ki tiar pyndait jong ka baroh . Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron bad u rangbah jong ka kynhun ki la khein ia ki khun shynrang jong ki Kohathi katkum ka iing jong ki bad katkum ka iing jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And if children , then heirs ; heirs of God , and joint-heirs with Christ ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together .
kha: Naba ngi long ki khun jong U Blei , ngin ïohkynti ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba u buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u , bad ngin ïohkynti ruh lem bad U Khrist ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la lah buh na ka bynta jong u ; naba lada ngi ïadon bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom U Khrist , ngin ïoh ruh ban ïadon bynta ha ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ki khun ki long ki nongioh pateng shuh shuh jong U Blei, bad ki nongioh pateng lang bad U Khrist lada ngi shah shitom bad u, ba ngin ioh ruh ban shah pyndonburom lang .

en: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah , and said , Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal , knead it , and make cakes upon the hearth .
kha: Te u Abraham u leit rung kyrkieh sha la ka ïingjaiñ bad u ong ha ka Sarah ,  Kloi kloi , shim shi byrni u  purew uba ni , khleh bad sa shet kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la mareh shapoh ka ïingjaiñ sha ka Sarah, bad u la ong, Pynkhreh kloi lai tylli ki jingbam kiba bha, pynkhih ia ka bad shna ia ki cake halor ka ding .

en: Behold , thy people in the midst of thee are women : the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies : the fire shall devour thy bars .
kha: Ki shipai jong pha ki long kum ki kynthei , bad ka ri jong pha ka ïeng khlem ka jingïada ha khmat ki nongshun jong pha . Ka ding kan pynjot ïa ki dieng khang khyrdop jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ki briew jong me hapdeng jong me ki long ki kynthei: ki khyrdop jong ka ri jong me kin sa plie sha ki nongshun jong me: ka ding kan bam ia ki bar jong me .

en: The  Lord  hath appeared of old unto me , saying , Yea , I have loved thee with an everlasting love : therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , nga la ieit ïa phi borabor , kumta nga ïai pyn-i ïa phi ïa ka jingieit baneh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha nga mynshuwa, u da ong, Hooid, nga la ieit ia me da ka jingieit bymjukut: namarkata da ka jingieit nga la ring ia me .

en: Verily I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi baroh : ïa kaei kaba phi khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ha bneng , bad ïa kaei kaba phi shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Kaei kaei kaba phin teh ha ka khyndew kan sa shah teh ha bneng: bad kaei kaei kaba phin pyllait ha ka khyndew kan sa shah pyllait ha bneng .

en: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .
kha: kaba pynlong ïa ka pud sepngi . Hapoh kine ki pud sawdong ki shong ki sah ki briew kiba na ki longïing u Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam jong ka ri Sepngi u la long haduh ka duriaw bah bad ka rud duriaw jong ka . Kane ka dei ka rud duriaw jong ki khun Judah sawdong kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;
kha: kita kiba ïam , kumba kim shym la sngewsih ; kito kiba rkhie , kumba kim shym la don ka jingkmen ; bad kito kiba ïathied , kumba kim shym long trai ïa kaei kaba ki la thied ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba iam, kumba kim iam ; bad kita kiba kmen, kumba kim ju kmen ; bad kita kiba thied, kumba kim don ; .

en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries : but the people that do know their God shall be strong , and do exploits .
kha: Da ka buit shukor u syiem un ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka niam , hynrei kito kiba bud ïa U Blei kin ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta u la pynsniew ia ka jutang da ki jingkren bein: hynrei ki briew kiba tip ia U Blei jong ki kin long kiba khlain bad leh ia ki kam sniew .

en: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people that were present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin : but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .
kha: U Saul , u Jonathan u khun jong u , bad ki rangbah jong ki , ki sher dara ha Geba ha ka thain Benjamin ; ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka dei ha Mikhmash .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul bad u khun jong u bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad ki ki shong ha Gibeah jong u Benjamin: hynrei ki Philistia ki la shong ha Michmash .

en: And when the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  , she thrust herself unto the wall , and crushed Balaam s foot against the wall : and he smote her again .
kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel , ka la tur sha kata ka kynroh bad ka ban trait ïa ka kjat u Balaam ha ka . Sa shisien u Balaam u sympat ïa ka kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka kada ka la iohi ia u angel U Trai , ka la pynkhih ia lade sha ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynkhih ia ka kjat jong u Balaam pyrshah ia ka jingkhang: bad u la pynkhih biang ia ka .

en: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .
kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , kumba U Blei u hukum , phin ym pynthait ïa lade , bad kine ki briew baroh ki lah ban leit sha ïing hadien ba la bishar ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me leh ia kane ka kam bad U Blei un hukum ia me kumta , te me lah ban shah , bad kine ki briew baroh kin leit noh sha la ka jong ka jaka ha ka jingsuk .

en: Then thou shalt say unto them , I presented my supplication before the king , that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan s house , to die there .
kha: Shu ong ïa ki ba me kyrpad ïa nga ban ym phah pat ïa me sha byndi ban ïap hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta me dei ban ong ha ki , nga la wanrah ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga ha khmat u syiem , ba un ym pynlong ia nga ban leit phai noh sha ka iing u Jonathan, ban iap hangta .

en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .
kha: ki syiem kin sher dara hangta lem bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki . Kin pynïeng ïa la ki ïingjaiñ sawdong ka nongbah , bad uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap langbrot bad ki kynhun jong ki kin wan sha ka ; kin pynkhih ia ki ïingjaiñ jong ki pyrshah ïa ka baroh sawdong .

en: And Jacob came to Shalem , a city of Shechem , which is in the land of Canaan , when he came from Paddan–aram  ; and pitched his tent before the city .
kha: Ha ka jingwanphai na Mesopotamia , u Jakob u la poi suk poi saiñ ha ka nongbah Shekhem ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u sher ïa la ka dara ha ka madan kaba hajan kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la poi ha Shalem, ka shnong Shechem kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan, haba u la wan na Paddanaram bad u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha khmat ka shnong .

en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
kha: Kumta , ha ka liang sepngi jong ka Jordan ki buh kyrpang ïa ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , ha ka ri lum Naphtali , ïa ka Shekhem ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ïa ka Hebron ha ka ri lum Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thung ia u Kdes ha Galilaia ha u lum Naphtali, bad u Shehem ha u lum Ephraim, bad u 

en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .
kha: Kin kup da ka jaiñ khain bad kin kyiuh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn khi lyndum ïa ki khlieh jong ki , bad yn pynlehrain ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa tap ruh ia lade da ka jain lyngkhuid, bad ka jingtieng kan tap ia ki ; bad ka jingsngewlehrain kan long halor ki khmat baroh , bad ka jingsngewsih halor ki khlieh jong ki baroh .

en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren bad kata ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki uba la ong ïa ka ,  Pha kwah aïu ?  lane uba la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor kane u la wan ki synran jong u, bad u la lyngngoh ba u la iakren bad kata ka kynthei: hynrei ym don ba ong: Me wad aiu ? lane: Balei me kren bad ka ?

en: As a beast goeth down into the valley , the Spirit of the  Lord  caused him to rest : so didst thou lead thy people , to make thyself a glorious name .
kha: Kumba ïalam ïa ki jingri sha ka them baseisoh , kumta U  Trai  u ai ka jingjahthait ha ki briew jong u . U ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad pyndonburom ïa la ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u mrad u leit shapoh them, U Mynsiem U Trai u la pynlong ia u ban shongthait: kumta me la ialam ia ki briew jong me, ban pynlong ia lade ka kyrteng kaba donburom .

en: For the Son of God , Jesus Christ , who was preached among you by us , even by me and Silvanus and Timothy , was not yea and nay , but in him was yea .
kha: Naba U Jisu Khrist , u Khun U Blei , ïa uba la ïalap hapdeng jong phi da u Silas , u Timothi bad da nga hi , um long uta uba  Ho-oid  bad  Em .  Hynrei , u long ma u kaba  Ho-oid  jong U Blei ; naba dei ma u , uba long kaba  Ho-oid  ïa ki jingkular U Blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Khun U Blei , U Jisu Khrist uba la ialap hapdeng jong phi da ngi, wat da nga bad u Silvanus bad u Timothi, um shym la long uba stad bad uba stad hynrei ha u la long uba stad .

en: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge , God gave them over to a reprobate mind , to do those things which are not convenient ;
kha: Namar ba kita ki briew ki la kyntait ban bat ha ka jingmut ïa ka jingtip bashisha shaphang U Blei , u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingmut bajakhlia , ba kumta ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la kim sngewtynnad ban bat ia U Blei ha ka jingtip jong ki , U Blei u la aiti ia ki ha ka jingmut kaba la pynrem , ban leh ia kita kiei kiei ki bym suk ; .

en: Then the king went to his palace , and passed the night fasting : neither were instruments of musick brought before him : and his sleep went from him .
kha: Nangta u syiem u la leit phai pat sha ka ïingsyiem bad u la pynlut ïa ka miet khlem ïohthiah , khlem bam lane khlem kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la leit sha ka iing jong u, bad u la iaid miet: ym shym la wanrah ia ki tiar kiba sniew ha khmat jong u: bad ka jingthiah jong u ka la leit noh na u .

en: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .
kha: Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki leit tur pyrshah ïa ki kynhun shipai Benjamin bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit sha ki khun shynrang ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ki la buh ia lade ha ka jaka kaba lai pyrshah ia ka Gibeah kumba ju long ha kiwei pat ki por .

en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn , which waxed exceeding great , toward the south , and toward the east , and toward the pleasant land .
kha: Na kawei na kine ki saw tylli ki reng la mih kawei ka reng barit , kaba ka bor jong ka , ka ïar shaphang shathie bad sha mihngi bad sha ka Ri ka Jingkular .
translated_en_to_kha: Na uwei na ki u la mih khyndiat u bniat uba la nang heh palat shaphang shathie bad shaphang mihngi bad sha ka ri kaba sngewtynnad .

en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim da ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba thymmai , naba kata ka syrdep bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynlong ka thliew kaba kham heh ha ka jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba buh ia ka jain thymmai ha ka jain kaba rim , namar kata kaba la buh ban pyndap ia ka ka shim na ka jain , bad ka bai wai ka nang kham sniew .

en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .
kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum , bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia kata kaba u Moses u la hukum ha khmat ka iingmane: bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la wan hajan bad ka la ieng ha khmat U Trai .

en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern , and pools of water : and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka Babilon sha ka ahor ktieh , bad ki dkhoh kin shong hangta . Ngan sar ïa ka Babilon da u synsar u ban sar lut khoit ïa kaei kaei baroh . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ia ka da ka um kaba jyrngam bad ki pung um: bad ngan sa pynngam ia ka da ka sniehdoh jong ka jingpynjot , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And he said , Behold , I have heard that there is corn in Egypt : get you down thither , and buy for us from thence  ; that we may live , and not die .
kha: Nga ïohsngew ba don kew ha Ijipt ; khie leit thied kew nangta , ba ngin ym ïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga la iohsngew ba don u kew ha Ijipt: to hiar shapoh hangta, bad thied na ka bynta jong ngi naduh hangta; ba ngin im, bad ym iap .

en: Now therefore , behold , the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me : and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them .
kha: Da shisha nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud ki briew jong nga , bad nga la ïohi ruh kumno ki nong Ijipt ki pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ha khmih, ka jingud jong ki khun Israel ka la wan ha nga: bad nga ruh nga la iohi ia ka jingshah lehbein ha kaba ki nong Ijipt ki pynshitom bein ia ki .

en: And as they were eating , Jesus took bread , and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples , and said ,  Take , eat  ; this is my body .
kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , u la duwai ainguh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u .  To shim bad to bam ïa u ,  u la ong ;  une u long ka met jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la shim ia u kpu bad u la kyrkhu ia u bad u la bthei bad u la ai ha ki synran bad u la ong: To shim ia u kpu bad kane ka dei ka met jong nga .

en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us , that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf .
kha: Kumta kan long ba ïa ki jingduwai babun na bynta jong ngi yn sa jubab , bad U Blei un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; bad bun kin kyntiew ïa ki sur jingïaroh jong ki sha u ha ka jingainguh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ruh phi iarap lang da ka jingduwai na ka bynta jong ngi , ba na ka bynta ka jingai kaba la ai ha ngi da ki briew kiba bun ka jingsngewnguh kan long kaba la ai da kiba bun na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: For a bishop must be blameless , as the steward of God ; not selfwilled , not soon angry , not given to wine , no striker , not given to filthy lucre ;
kha: Namar ba u nongïalam balang u long uba pynïaid ïa ka kam U Blei , u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop . Um dei ban long uba leh meng ne uba bitar shen , ne uba buaid ne uba leh jubor ne uba lalot pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u bishop u dei ban long uba khlem jingbakla, kumba u nongap jong U Blei u la bitar ia lade, ym kloi ban bitar, ym da ka wain, ym da u nongleh kam sniew, ym da ka ktien kaba jakhlia;

en: As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Nga long U Blei Uba im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Karmel u ïeng hajrong tam ïa ka duriaw , kumta kan long ka jingkhlaiñ jong uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga im , ong u Syiem uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai jong ki paid , Hooid kumba u Tabor u don hapdeng ki lum bad kumba u Karmel da ka duriaw , kumta un wan .

en: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect : and make no mention of the name of other gods , neither let it be heard out of thy mouth .
kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga U  Trai  nga la kren ha phi . Wat duwai ha kiwei pat ki blei ; bad tang ïa ka kyrteng jong ki ruh wat ïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong ha phi to long kiba husiar: bad wat kdew ia ka kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki blei , lymne wat ai ba kan iohsngew na ka shyntur jong me .

en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham , Cast out this bondwoman and her son : for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son , even with Isaac .
kha: Ka Sarah ka la ïohi ïa ki , bad ka ong ha u Abraham ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka . U khun jong kane ka briew um dei ban ïoh bynta ei ei ïa ka spah ka phew jong me , kaba u khun jong nga , u Isaak u dei ban ïohpateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka la ong ha u Abraham: To weng noh ia kane ka mraw bad u khun jong ka: namar u khun jong kane ka mraw un ym long u nongioh pateng bad u khun jong nga, wat bad u Isaak ruh .

en: But what I do , that I will do , that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion ; that wherein they glory , they may be found even as we .
kha: Ngan ïai leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh mynta , khnang ban khanglad ïa kito kiwei ki  apostol  ba kin ïoh daw ban kob sarong bad ban ong ba ki trei ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ngi trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba nga leh, ba ngan leh, ba ngan ot noh ia ka por na ki kaba kwah ia ka por ; ba ha kaba ki sngew sarong , ki lah ban shem wat ia ngi ruh .

en: Seek the  Lord  , and ye shall live  ; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph , and devour it , and there be none to quench it in Beth–el .
kha: Phet sha U  Trai  , bad phin ïoh im . Lada phim leit , un bam duh kum ka ding ha ki paid Israel . Ka ding kan thang duh ïa ki briew ka Bethel , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynlip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia U Trai , bad phin im shuh shuh ha ka iing u Joseph bad un bam ia ka , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynlip ia ka ha Betel .

en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God , which thou shalt have occasion to bestow , bestow it out of the king s treasure house .
kha: Bad kano kano kaba phi dang donkam shuh ha ka Templ , phi lah ban ïoh na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba kham bun kan long kaba donkam na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong me, kaba me don ka lad ban ai, to ai ia ka na ka iing spah jong u syiem .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines , and into the hands of the children of Ammon .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa ki Philistia bad ki Ammon ban jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la shit pyrshah ia ki Israel , bad u la die ia ki ha ki kti jong ki Philistia bad ha ki kti jong ki khun Ammon .

en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven , from thence will the  Lord  thy God gather thee , and from thence will he fetch thee :
kha: Wat la phi la sakma kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei ruh , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un lumlang bad wan ïalam pat ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno na me un shah beh noh sha ki bynta ba shabar tam jong ka bneng, nangta U Trai U Blei jong me un lum ia me, bad nangta un sa shim ia me:

en: And if ye shall despise my statutes , or if your soul abhor my judgments , so that ye will not do all my commandments , but that ye break my covenant :
kha: Lada phi kyntait ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , bad phi pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad phi , ngan pynshitom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada phi sngewsih ia ki ain jong nga, ne lada ka mynsiem jong phi ka sngewsih ia ki jingbishar jong nga, kumta phin ym leh ia ki hukum jong nga baroh:

en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .
kha: Ka la long ka  erïong kaba jur tam ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha ka histori jong ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la don ka umsoh, bad ka ding ka la ia tyngkhuh bad ka umsoh, kaba sngewsih shibun, kumba ym don kum kata ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei naduh ba ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew .

en: Then Pharaoh s army was come forth out of Egypt : and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them , they departed from Jerusalem .
kha: Ka kynhun shipai Babilonia ka dang kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei haba ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la jam sha shiliang u pud ka Ijipt , ki la phai dien noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u la mih na Ijipt : bad haba ki Khaldi kiba la leit sha Jerusalem ki la iohsngew ia ka khubor jong ki , ki la leit noh na Jerusalem .

en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .
kha: U Petros u dang ïeng hangta ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Kumta kiwei pat ki la ong ha u ,  Hato me ruh mem dei uwei na ki synran jong uta u briew ?  Hynrei u Petros u la len ïa kata .  Em , ngam dei ,  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u la ieng bad u la pynshit ia lade . Ki la ong ia u namarkata ha u , Hato me ruh me long uwei na ki synran jong u ? U la kyntait ia ka bad u la ong , Ngam long kumta .

en: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
kha: Ym u briew baroh uba khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai’ u ban ïohrung shapoh Ka Hima ki bneng , hynrei tang kito kiba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym baroh kiba ong ha nga, ko Trai, ko Trai, kin rung sha ka hima bneng hynrei uta uba leh ia ka mon U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng .

en: Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal :
kha: Nga la ai palat ïa ka shispah ton ka ksiar nylla bad la jan arspah sawphew ton ka rupa nylla ban pynitynnat ïa ki kynroh jong ka Templ
translated_en_to_kha: Wat lai hajar tylli ki takma ksiar, na ka ksiar jong u Ophir, bad hynriew hajar tylli ki takma rupa ba la pynkhuid, ban tap ia ki kynroh jong ki iing kiba don ha ka met:

en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city :
kha: Lada ka la pur , un hukum ba dei ban weng noh ïa ki maw ha kiba la bit bthuh bad bret noh ïa ki sha ka jaka theh ñiut shabar shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ba kin weng noh ia ki maw ha kaba ka khlam ka don , bad kin bret ia ki ha ka jaka kaba khlem khuid shabar ka shnong:

en: But if thine eye be evil , thy whole body shall be full of darkness . If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness , how great is that darkness !
kha: hynrei lada ki khmat jong phi kim long kiba bha , ka met jong phi kan don ha ka jingdum . Kumta lada ka jingshai hapoh jong phi ka long ka jingdum , katno kan long ka jingdum kaba shyrkhei eh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka khmat jong me ka long kaba sniew, ka met jong me baroh kawei kan long kaba dap da ka jingdum . Lada ka jingshai kaba don ha me ka long ka jingdum , katno kata ka jingdum !

en: And Simon answering said unto him , Master , we have toiled all the night , and have taken nothing : nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net .
kha: Ko Kynrad ,  u Simon u la jubab ,  ngi la trei shitom baroh shi miet bad ngim shym ngat ei ei . Hynrei lada me ong kumta , ngan pynhiar ïa ki jar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon u la jubab ia u, Ko Nonghikai, ngi la trei shitom baroh shi miet, bad ngim shym la shim ei ei: wat la katta ruh ha ka ktien jong me ngan pynhap ia ka jar .

en: And Shimei said unto the king , The saying is good : as my lord the king hath said , so will thy servant do . And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days .
kha: Ho-oid , ko Syiem Kynrad ,  u Shimei u jubab .  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi ong .  Kumta u la sah slem bha ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shimei u la ong ha u syiem: Ka jingong ka long kaba bha: kumba u kynrad jong nga u la ong , kumta u shakri jong me un leh . Bad u Shimei u la shong ha Jerusalem bun sngi .

en: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets , and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour :
kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien ïa kiba la kren lah slem bah da ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ïa ka hukum na U Trai bad U Nongpynim ïa kaba la ai ha phi da ki apostol .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin kynmaw ia ki ktien kiba la kren mynshuwa da ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ia ka hukum jong ngi ki apostol jong U Trai bad U Nongpynim:

en: Confess your faults one to another , and pray one for another , that ye may be healed . The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much .
kha: Namarkata , to phla ïa la ki pop iwei ha iwei pat , khnang ba yn pynkhiah ïa phi . Ka jingduwai jong u briew uba hok ka don ka bor kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia ki jingbakla jong phi iwei ia iwei pat, bad duwai iwei ia iwei pat, ba phin koit . Ka jingduwai kaba treikam jong u briew uba hok ka long kaba bun .

en: And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle  ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have .
kha: Ngan ïathuh ha u ba phi dei ki nongri jingri , bad ba phi la wan ïalam ïa la ki kynhun langbrot , ïa kiwei de ki jingri , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang ki long ki nongap langbrot , namar ka kam jong ki ka la long ban ai bam ia ki masi ; bad ki la wanrah ia ki langbrot jong ki bad ki kynhun jong ki bad baroh kaba ki don .

en: And after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them : and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines .
kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Syiem Dabid u la tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia , u la jop ïa ki bad la pynkut noh ruh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki halor ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka la jia , ba u Dabid u la shoh ia ki Philistia bad u la pyndem ia ki: bad u Dabid u la shim ia u Methegammah na ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .
