kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ar ngut kin shah pynïap . Ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang , bad ki la pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u thiah bad ka khun jong u ha ka ain , baroh arngut kin shah pyniap: ki la leh ia ka jingkulmar ; ka snam jong ki kan long halor jong ki .

en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .
kha: Ki shipai na Persia , Lydia , bad Libya ki shakri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh bad ïa ki jingïada khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jong ka Persia bad ka Lud bad ka Put ki la don ha ka kynhun shipai jong me: ki la pyndait ia ka jingda bad ka helmet ha me ; ki la buh ia ka jingitynnad jong me .

en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day , then rejoice ye in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you :
kha: Mynta te , lada kaei kaba phi leh mynta ka sngi ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u ka long da kaba khuid mynsiem bad kaba hok , te to kmen bad u Abimelekh bad ai ba un kmen bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi la leh shisha bad shisha bad u Jerubaal bad ka iing jong u ha kane ka sngi , te to sngewbha ha Abimelech , bad to ai ba un sngewbha ruh ha phi:

en: Women received their dead raised to life again : and others were tortured , not accepting deliverance  ; that they might obtain a better resurrection :
kha: Da ka jingngeit , ki kynthei ki la ïohpdiang ïa ki ba-ha-ïing kiba la ïap ïa kiba la pynim pat . Kiwei pat , kiba kyntait ban pdiang ïa ka jinglaitluid , ki la ïap ha ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ khnang ba yn pynmihpat sha ka jingim kaba kham bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynthei ki la ioh biang ia kiba iap jong ki: bad kiwei pat ki la shah pynshitom bein , khlem da pdiang ia ka jingpynpoi ba kin ioh ia ka jingmihpat kaba kham bha:

en: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it , which was on the side of the ephod inward .
kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki na shapoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki tduh kiba sha trai jong ka , hajan ka ephod .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar bad ki la buh ia ki ha ki arliang jong ka sniehdoh, ha u pud jong ka, kaba don ha ka liang jong ka ephod shapoh .

en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed , white  ; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki khot ïa kata ka jingbam ,  ka manna . Ka long kum u symbai balieh uba rit , bad ka shngiam kum u kpu lyngkniap ba la shet bad ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka iing Israel ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Manna: bad ka la long kum u symbai ba la shet, u ; bad ka jingsma jong ka ka la long kum ki wafer ba la shna da ka umsoh .

en: And the  Lord  rooted them out of their land in anger , and in wrath , and in great indignation , and cast them into another land , as it is this day .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar shla , bad ha kata ka jingbitar , u rat dyngkhong ïa ki na ka ri jong ki bad u bret ïa ki sha ka ri nongwei , bad hangta ki dang don haduh mynta .’
translated_en_to_kha: U tynrai u la pynmih ia ki na ka ri jong ki ha ka jingbitar bad ha ka jingbitar kaba khraw bad u la bret ia ki sha kawei pat ka ri kumba ka long mynta ka sngi .

en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .
kha: bad ong ha u Samuel ,  To ïai duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ong ha u Samuel , Wat iam ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong ngi , ba un pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: Men and brethren , let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David , that he is both dead and buried , and his sepulchre is with us unto this day .
kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , nga dei ban kren shai shaphang U syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen bapawnam jong ngi . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad ka jingtep jong u ka don hangne bad ngi haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang bad ki para bangeit , to ngan kren laitluid ha phi shaphang u kpa tymmen u Dabid , ba u la iap bad la tep ia u , bad ka jingtep jong u ka don bad ngi haduh kine ki sngi .

en: They shall cut down her forest , saith the  Lord  , though it cannot be searched  ; because they are more than the grasshoppers , and are innumerable .
kha: Ki rangbah jong ki , ki bun shaba palat ban ñiew ; ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki puit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ot ia ka khlaw jong ka , ong U Trai , wat la ym lah ban wad ia ka ; namar ki kham bun ban ia ki khlaw , bad ki long ki bym lah ban khein .

en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity  ; but thou saidst , I will not hear . This hath been thy manner from thy youth , that thou obeyedst not my voice .
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha phi mynba phi dang manbha , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor . Kata ka long kaei kaba phi leh shi lynter ka jingim jong phi , phim ju treh ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kren ha me ha ka jingroi jong me ; hynrei me la ong , Ngan ym iohsngew . Kane ka la long ka rukom jong me naduh ka jinglong samla jong me, ba me khlem kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga .

en: And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .
kha: Hynrei nga la bunkam bad kiwei pat ki kam , kumta uta u briew u lait noh .  U syiem u jubab ,  Phi la pynbna hi ïa ka rai , bad phin hap siew ïa ka kuna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba u shakri jong me u la bunkam hangne hangta, u la jah noh . Bad u syiem Israel u la ong ha u: Kumta ka jingbishar jong me kan long; me hi me la rai ia kata .

en: And the woman had a fat calf in the house  ; and she hasted , and killed it , and took flour , and kneaded it , and did bake unleavened bread thereof :
kha: Kloi lan kata ka briew ka pynïap uwei u khun masi uba ka la ri pynsngaid . Nangta ka shim khyndiat u  purew , ka khleh ïa u , bad ka shet u kpu uba khlem thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei ka don u khun masi uba heh ha iing ; bad ka la kyrkieh bad ka la pyniap ia u, bad ka la shim ia ka shini bad ka la dem ia u, bad ka la shet ia u kpu khlem thied na u:

en: And it came to pass , when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .
kha: Hadien ka jingkha ïa u Joseph , u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga , ba ngan ïoh leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Rakhel u la kha ia u Joseph, ba u Jakob u la ong ha u Laban: Phah noh ia nga, ba ngan leit sha la ka jong ka jaka bad sha la ka ri .

en: And when they came thither to the hill , behold , a company of prophets met him  ; and the Spirit of God came upon him , and he prophesied among them .
kha: Haba u Saul bad u shakri jong u ki poi ha Gibeah , shi kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïakynduh ïa u . Kynsan kynsan U Mynsiem jong U Blei u wan da ka bor ha u , bad u ïasoh lang bad ki ha ka jingïashad bashongshit bad ha ka jingïarisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi sha u lum, ha khmih, ka kynhun ki nongiathuhlypa ka la iakynduh ia u ; bad U Mynsiem U Blei u la wan halor jong u , bad u la iathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children s of Israel .
kha: Ngan pynïapher ïa ki jingri jong ki Israel na ki jong ki nong Ijipt , bad kumta yn ym don wat kawei ruh ka jingri ki Israel ka ban ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pyniakhlad ia ki masi Israel bad ki masi Ijipt: bad ym don ei ei kaba iap na ki khun Israel baroh .

en: And when he humbled himself , the wrath of the  Lord  turned from him , that he would not destroy him altogether : and also in Judah things went well .
kha: Namar ba u pyndem ha U  Trai  , ka jingbitar U  Trai  kam shym pynjot thiaw ïa u , bad kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pynrit mynsiem ia lade, ka jingbitar U Trai ka la kylla na u, ba un ym pynjot lut ia u: bad ruh ha Judah kiei kiei ki la iaid bha .

en: ( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )
kha: U Solomon un ïoh kawei ka jait , na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied ban long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hynrei un don kawei ka jait na ka bynta u shakri jong nga u Dabid, bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem, ka shnong kaba nga la jied na ki jait Israel baroh: )

en: The nakedness of thy son s daughter , or of thy daughter s daughter , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover : for theirs is thine own nakedness .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ksiew ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka khun jong me, ne jong ka khun jong me, wat ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ki wat pynpaw: namar ka jong ki ka long ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me hi .

en: And the men went and passed through the land , and described it by cities into seven parts in a book , and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh .
kha: Kumta ki rangbah ki la leit kylleng ka ri bad ki la buh jingthoh kumno ki la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki hynñiew bynta , da kaba thoh ter ter ïa ki kyrteng jong ki nongrit . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha U Joshua ha ka jaka shong dara ha Shiloh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la iaid lyngba ia kata ka ri, bad ki la batai ia ka da ki shnong haduh hynriew bynta ha ka kot , bad ki la wan phai biang sha u Joshua sha u shipai ha Shiloh .

en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;
kha: Hynrei phi don ka dohnud kaba eh bad kaba kuman , bad kumta phi pynlong ka jingpynshitom ïa lade hi wat kham khraw ha ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ka jingbitar U Blei bad ki jingbishar bahok yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ka jingkhlain bad ka dohnud bym don pop jong me ka la sngewsih ia lade ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar bad ka jingpynpaw ia ka jingbishar hok jong U Blei ; .

en: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .
kha: Haba la dap hynñiew bnai , ki Israel ki la ïashongduh ha la ki shnong jong ki . Nangta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por kaba hynriew bnai bad ki khun Israel ki la don ha ki nongbah , ki briew ki la ialum lang kum uwei u briew ha Jerusalem .

en: O  Lord  , thou hast deceived me , and I was deceived : thou art stronger than I , and hast prevailed : I am in derision daily , every one mocketh me .
kha: A  Trai  me la shukor ïa nga , bad ïa nga la shukor . Me long uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa nga , bad me la jop ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei u rkhiebeiñ ïa nga ; ki krenbeiñ ïa nga baroh shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, me la shukor ia nga, bad nga la shah thok: me kham khlain ban ia nga, bad me la jop: Nga la shah lehbein man ka sngi, uwei pa uwei u rkhie bein ia nga .

en: But your wives , and your little ones , and your cattle , ( for I know that ye have much cattle , ) shall abide in your cities which I have given you  ;
kha: Tangba ïa ki tnga jong phi , ki khun ki kti jong phi , bad ki jingri jong phi — nga tip ba phi don bun ki jingri — phin iehnoh ha kita ki shnong ba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki tnga jong phi bad ki khun rit jong phi bad ki masi jong phi (namar nga tip ba phi don bun ki masi) kin sah ha ki shnong jong phi kiba nga la ai ha phi;

en: And hired counsellors against them , to frustrate their purpose , all the days of Cyrus king of Persia , even until the reign of Darius king of Persia .
kha: Ki la pynbam pisa ruh ïa ki rangbah synshar ka sorkar Persia ban trei pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la ïai leh ïa kane baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Syros haduh ka jingsynshar u Darius .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongai jingmut pyrshah ia ki, ban pynsngewsih ia ka jingthmu jong ki, ha ki sngi jong u Syiem Persia baroh kawei, wat haduh ka jingsynshar u Darius u syiem Persia .

en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .
kha: Man ka snem ka kmie jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang bad la u tnga ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka kmie jong u ka la shna ia u khyndiat ka jainkup , bad ka la wanrah ia ka ha u man la u snem , haba ka la wan shaneng bad u tnga jong ka ban aiti ia ka jingknia kaba man la u snem .

en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird , the birds round about are against her  ; come ye , assemble all the beasts of the field , come to devour .
kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga ki long kum ka sim kaba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki kbeit na baroh ki liang . To khot ïa ki mradkhlaw ban wan bad ïashim bynta ha ka jingkhawai !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng jong nga ka long ha nga kum ka sim kaba la tyrkhong , ki sim sawdong ki long pyrshah ia ka ; phi wan , to lum lang ia ki mrad baroh jong ka lyngkha , to wan bam .

en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .
kha: Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno uba hukum ïa phi lane uba shim kabu ïa phi lane uba riam pah lane uba peit poh ïa phi lane uba thab ïa phi ha ka ngab .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi shah shitom lada u briew u wanrah ia phi ha ka jinglong mraw, lada u briew u bam ia phi, lada u briew u shim na phi, lada u briew u pynkiew ia lade, lada u briew u shoh ia phi ha ka khmat .

en: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .
kha: Uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga bad u bym pdiang ïa ka khubor jong nga , u don uwei u ban bishar ïa u . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren kin long u nongbishar jong u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh !
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba kyntait ia nga bad u bym pdiang ia ki ktien jong nga: ka ktien kaba nga la kren , uta un bishar ia u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

en: Behold , he shall come up as clouds , and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind : his horses are swifter than eagles . Woe unto us ! for we are spoiled .
kha: Ha khmih , u nongshun u wan kum ki lyoh . Ki kali ïapom jong u ki long kum ka  erlangthari , bad ki kulai jong u ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni . Ngi la shahjop ! Ngim lah khie khlieh shuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, un wan shaneng kum ki lyoh, bad ki kali jong u kin long kum ka lyer kaba rkhie bein: ki kulai jong u ki kham stet ban ia ki blang . Ka long kaba sniew ia ngi ! namar ngi la shah pynjot .

en: Wherefore , said they , if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .
kha: Sngewbha ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jaka kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad to wat ai ïa ngi ban jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ban shong ban sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la ong , lada ngi la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me , to ai ba kane ka ri kan long ha ki shakri jong me na ka bynta ka jinglong trai , bad wat wanrah ia ngi sha ka Jordan .

en: I was one of the first who publicly claimed that there will be a Modi tsunami this time , not just a wave , and that is happened exactly , Paswan said .
kha: Nga dei uwei na kiba nyngkong eh uba la pynpaw paidbah ba kan don ka tsunami jong u Modi ha kane ka kynti ym tang ka umsaw , bad kata ka la jia thik thik , ong u Paswan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la long uwei na kiba nyngkong eh uba la kam paidbah ba kan don ka tsunami jong u Modi ha kane ka kynti, ym tang ka wave, bad kata ka la jia thikna, la ong u Paswan .

en: And the  Lord  came down in the pillar of the cloud , and stood in the door of the tabernacle , and called Aaron and Miriam : and they both came forth .
kha: Ki la leit , bad U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u rishot lyoh , u la ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad u pyrta  Aaron ! Miriam !  Baroh ar ngut ki wan sha khmat ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la wan hiar ha ka lynti jong u lyoh, bad u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ, bad u la khot ïa u Aaron bad ka Miriam : bad ki baroh arngut ki la mih noh .

en: And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka dei u Jakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long noh U Israel .  Kumta U Blei u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u: Ka kyrteng jong me ka long u Jakob: ka kyrteng jong me kan ym khot shuh u Jakob: hynrei u Israel un long ka kyrteng jong me: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Israel .

en: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing , whereby he may be made unclean , or a man of whom he may take uncleanness , whatsoever uncleanness he hath  ;
kha: lane lada u la ktah ïa u mrad ne ïa u briew u bymkhuid , u kylla long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane uno uno uba ktah ia kano kano ka jingbam kaba sniew , ha kaba u lah ban long u bymkhuid , ne u briew na uba u lah ban shim ia ka jingbymkhuid , kaei kaei ka jingbymkhuid kaba u don;

en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .
kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katto katne por hangta , u la mihnoh bad u la leit lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia bad Phrygia , da kaba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba u la pynlut por katto katne por hangta, u la leit noh, bad u la leit sha kylleng ka ri Kalatia bad ka Phrygia ha ka rukom kaba pynskhem ia ki synran baroh .

en: And after certain days , when Felix came with his wife Drusilla , which was a Jewess , he sent for Paul , and heard him concerning the faith in Christ .
kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u Pheliks u la wan lem bad ka tnga jong u , ka Drusilla , kaba long ka Jiw . U la phah khot ïa u Paul bad u la shahshkor ïa u katba u nang kren shaphang ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien katto katne sngi, haba u Feliks u la wan ryngkat bad ka tnga jong u ka Drusilla kaba long ka Jiw, u la phah ia u Paul bad u la iohsngew ia u shaphang ka jingngeit ha U Khrist .

en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
kha: Phi dei ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Israel kin ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to pyniap ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait , bad pynkyntang ia lade , bad pynkhreh ia ki hynmen jong phi , ba kin leh kat kum ka ktien U Trai da ka kti u Moses .

en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men , that God might manifest them , and that they might see that they themselves are beasts .
kha: Nga la rai ba U Blei u tynjuh ïa ngi , ban pyn-i ïa ngi ba ngim long kham bha ban ïa ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong ha ka dohnud jong nga shaphang ka jaka jong ki khun shynrang, ba U Blei un pynpaw ia ki, bad ba kin iohi ba ki long ki mrad .

en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams , wherewith his spirit was troubled , and his sleep brake from him .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar ba u Nebukhadnessar u long syiem , u la ïoh ka jingphohsniew . Ka la pynkhuslai shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba um shym ïohthiah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Nebuchadnezzar u Neuchadnezzar u la phohsniew ia ki jingphohsniew, ha kaba ka mynsiem jong u ka la khih bad ka jingthiah jong u na u .

en: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim , even unto Gaza , the Caphtorims , which came forth out of Caphtor , destroyed them , and dwelt in their stead . )
kha: Ka jaka harud ka Duriaw Mediterranian ka long kaba shong da ki Kaphtorim kiba wan na ka dewlynnong Krit . Kine ki la pynjot ïa ki Abbim kiba dei ki trai jaka , bad ki knieh lut ïa ka ri jong ki haduh ka shnong Gasa kaba shaphang shathie . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Avim kiba shong ha Hasrim, wat haduh Gaza, ki Kaphor kiba la mih na Kaphor ki la pynjot ia ki, bad ki la shong ha ka jaka jong ki ) .

en: PM Narendra Modi interacts with ISRO scientists after connection with the Vikram lander was lost during soft landing of Chandrayaan 2 on lunar surface .
kha: U PM Narendra Modi u ïakren bad ki stad saiantis jong ka ISRO hadien ba ka jingïadei bad ka liengsuiñ Vikram ka la duh noh ha ka por ba u Chandrayaan 2 u hiar jem ha ka sla jong u bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: U PM Narendra Modi u iakynduh bad ki stad ISRO hadien ba ka jingiadei bad ka jaka hiar jong ka Vikram ka la jah noh ha ka por ba u Chandrayaan 2 u la hiar ha ka sla jong u bnai .

en: For I will rise up against them , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and cut off from Babylon the name , and remnant , and son , and nephew , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon bad wallam ïa ka sha ka jingjot jingpra . Ngan ym pynsah ei ei — yn ym don khynnah , yn ym don mano mano ba lait im . Nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan ieng pyrshah ia ki, ong U Trai jong ki paid, bad ngan ot noh na Babilon ia ka kyrteng, bad ka jingsahkut, bad u khun shynrang bad u khun ksiew, ong U Trai .

en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .
kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u Tola u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jong u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jait Issakhar bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien u Abimelech u la mih ban iada ia ki Israel u Tola u khun u Dodo , u briew uba na Issakhar ; bad u la shong ha Shamir ha u lum Ephraim .

en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  I will ask you one thing  ; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good , or to do evil ? to save life , or to destroy it ?
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga kylli ïa phi : Aïu ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ïa ngi ban leh ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Ban ïarap ne ban pynmynsaw ? Ban pynim ïa ka mynsiem briew ne ban pynjot ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u la ong ha ki, Ngan kylli ia phi kawei kaei kaei ha ka sngi Sabha ban leh bha ne ban leh ia kaba sniew ? ban pynim ia ka jingim ne ban pynjot ia ka ?

en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys , thy flowing valley , O backsliding daughter ? that trusted in her treasures , saying , Who shall come unto me ?
kha: Balei ba ma phi ki briew bymïaineh phi kren sarong ? Ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi ka la nang hiar . Balei ba phi shaniah ha la ka bor bad phi ong ba ym don ba nud ban tur ïaleh ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata me burom ha ki them, ka them kaba tuid jong me, ko khun kynthei kaba phaidien ? kaba shaniah ha ki spah jong ka da kaba ong , Mano ba wan sha nga ?

en: The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it .
kha: Uno uno uba leh biria ïa la u kpa lane uba ñiewbeiñ ïa la ka kmie ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka u dei ban shah bam ha ki pukni ne shah khlaw ki khmat ha ki tyngab khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khmat kaba rkhie bein ia u kpa jong u bad kaba sngewsih ban kohnguh ia ka kmie jong u , ki blang jong ka them kin shim ia ka , bad ki blang kiba dang rit kin bam ia ka .

en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him , and he in him . And hereby we know that he abideth in us , by the Spirit which he hath given us .
kha: Uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U Blei , u ïaisah ha U Blei bad U Blei u ïaisah ha u . Bad dei namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ïaisah ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba sumar ia ki hukum jong u u shong ha u, bad ma u ha u . Bad da kane ngi tip ba u sah ha ngi, da U Mynsiem uba u la ai ha ngi .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu , and all that he did , and all his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehu u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kam shlur jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehu bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh bad ka bor jong u baroh , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them  ; and the people shall be gathered against them , when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .
kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa kine ki briew bymman bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang pyrshah ïa ki , bad yn pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop kiba bun ki jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ha ka jingkwah jong nga ba ngan pynshitom ia ki ; bad ki briew kin ialum lang pyrshah ia ki , haba kin teh ia lade ha ki ar tylli ki thliew jong ki .

en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .
kha: Pynmih ïa uto u briew shabar ka jaka shong dara . Uno uno u briew uba la ïohsngew ïa u ba u tim u tla un sakhi ïa kata da kaba u buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad nangta u paidbah baroh un lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah ia uta uba la tim shabar ka jaka shong jaka sah bad to ai ba baroh kiba iohsngew ia u kin buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u , bad to ai ba ka jingiaseng baroh kan buh maw ia u .

en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .
kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit khyndiat na kata ka snam ha kata ka duwan hynñiew sien . Ha kane ka rukom u dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka na ki pop jong ki paid Israel , bad un pynlong khuid ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un theh ia ka snam ha ka da ka kti jong u hynriew sien bad un pynkhuid ia ka bad un pynkhuid ia ka na ka jingbymkhuid jong ki khun Israel .

en: That saith , I will build me a wide house and large chambers , and cutteth him out windows  ; and it is ceiled with cedar , and painted with vermilion .
kha: Kordit ïa u briew uba ong ,  Ngan tei ïa lade ka ïing paki dulan bad ki kamra kiba kylluid shajrong ki mala .  Kumta u buh ki jingkhangïit ha ka ïing jong u , bad u shna biar da ki dieng Kedar , bad u airong ïa ka da ka rong saw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka ong , ngan tei ia nga ka iing kaba heh bad ki kamra kiba heh , bad nga ot ia u na ki jingkhang ; bad la tap ia ka da u sohjew , bad la rong da ka rong saw .

en: But for his kin , that is near unto him , that is , for his mother , and for his father , and for his son , and for his daughter , and for his brother ,
kha: lait noh kiba ïadei jan eh , kum ka kmie , u kpa , u khun , ka khun , u hynmen u para ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ka bynta u ba hajan jong u, kata na ka bynta ka kmie jong u bad na ka bynta u kpa jong u bad na ka bynta u khun jong u bad na ka bynta ka khun jong u bad na ka bynta u hynmen jong u .

en: The Committee examined the proposals , based on the visits of the Central Team to the States affected by severe Natural Disasters during the last year .
kha: Ka Committee ka la bishar bniah ia ki jingtyrwa , da kaba pynshong nongrim ha ki jingleit jngoh jong ka kynhun pdeng sha ki jylla kiba la shah ktah ha ki jingjia ba shyrkhei jong ka mariang ha une u snem ba la dep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Committee ka la bishar bniah ia ki jingtyrwa , katkum ka jingleit jngoh jong ka Central Team sha ki Jylla kiba shah ktah ha ki jingjia ba shyrkhei ha ka mariang ha u snem ba la dep .

en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria , and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes :
kha: U patsha ka Assyria u ïalam ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi bad u pynshong pynsah ïa ki katto katne na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah ka Media .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la rah noh ia ki Israel sha Assyria , bad u la buh ia ki ha Halah bad ha Habor hajan ka wah Gozan bad ha ki shnong ki Media:

en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :
kha: Te ngi kyang sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ïohi ba ngi shah jynjar , ngi hap trei shitom , bad ngi shah lehbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la pyrta ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi , U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ngi , bad u la peit ia ka jingjynjar jong ngi bad ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi:

en: Ye stand this day all of you before the  Lord  your God  ; your captains of your tribes , your elders , and your officers , with all the men of Israel ,
kha: Mynta ka sngi phi ïa-ïeng lang baroh ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi — ki nongïalam , ki rangbah synshar jong phi , ki shynrang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ieng ha kane ka sngi baroh ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi; ki rangbah jong phi bad ki rangbah jong phi bad ki rangbah jong phi baroh .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold , thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , la ïathuh ha u Joseph ba u kpa jong u , u pang . Kumta u ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ar ngut , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , ban ïaleit khmih ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, uwei u la iathuh ha u Joseph, Ha khmih u kpa jong me u pang: bad u la shim bad u ia ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u, u Manasseh bad u Ephram .

en: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced , O ye destroyers of mine heritage , because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki paid ka Babilonia , phi la lute ïa ka jaitbynriew jong nga . Phi kmen bad phi sngewbha , phi da leh kum ka masi ba ïaid haba shoh kba ne kum u kulai uba pah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la sngewbha , namar phi la sngewbha , ko phi pynjot ia ka pateng jong nga , namar phi la san kum ka masi ha u phlang , bad phi la pyrta kum ki masi ; .

en: For the living know that they shall die : but the dead know not any thing , neither have they any more a reward  ; for the memory of them is forgotten .
kha: Ho-oid kiba im ki tip ba kin ïap , hynrei kiba ïap kim tip ei ei . Kim don shuh kano kano ka bainong ; ki long kiba ym don shuh mano mano ba kynmaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiba im ki tip ba kin iap: hynrei kiba iap kim tip ei ei ruh em;

en: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish : and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel :
kha: Baroh kiba na ka longïing jong u Ahab bad ki khun ki ksiew ki dei ban ïap ; ngan sar lin ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong u , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka iing u Ahab baroh kawei kan jah noh: bad ngan ot noh na u Ahab ia uta uba sngap jar pyrshah ia ka kynroh , bad ia uta uba la shah khang bad uba sah ha Israel:

en: And now , my daughter , fear not  ; I will do to thee all that thou requirest : for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman .
kha: Ruth , mynta wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi pan ; kumba baroh ha shnong ki ïatip , phi dei ka kynthei kaba donburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ko khun jong nga, wat tieng ia me baroh kaba me donkam: namar ka shnong jong ki briew jong nga baroh kawei ka tip ba me long ka kynthei kaba bhabriew .

en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,
kha: Ki wallam sha u Moses ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh , ïa ki bnoh jong ka , ïa ki jingker jong ka , ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka ïingjaiñ ha u Moses, ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tiar jong u baroh, ki jain jong u, ki dieng jong u, ki dieng jong u bad ki dieng jong u .

en: And it came to pass , when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king , that the king said unto him , Wherefore wentest not thou with me , Mephibosheth ?
kha: Haba u Mephibosheth u wan poi na Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem , u syiem u ong ha u ,  Ko Mephibosheth , mem shym la leit bad nga , balei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u la wan sha Jerusalem ban iakynduh ia u syiem, ba u syiem u la ong ha u: Balei me leit bad nga Mephishet ?

en: And he saith unto them ,  Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ?  Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea  ; and there was a great calm .
kha: Balei ba phi sheptieng haduh katne ?  U Jisu u la jubab .  Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !  Nangta u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phyllung ban sangeh , bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki , Balei phi tieng, ko jong ka jingngeit kaba rit ? Nangta u la ieng bad u la pynrem ia ki Iyer bad ka duriaw ; bad ka la don ka jingsuk kaba khraw .

en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
kha: Sa shisien U Jisu u la leit noh bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ym lah ban shim noh lymda nga dih ïa ka , ïa ka mon jong me yn leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh sa shisien bad u la duwai da kaba ong: Ko Kpa jong nga, lada kane ka khuri kan ym jah noh na nga, lymda nga dih ia ka, to long ka mon jong me .

en: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the  Lord  : and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions .
kha: U Joshua u la kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki , bad u la ai ha kawei pa kawei na ki jait kiba sah jong ki Israel shi bynta jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la thep ia ki ha Shiloh ha khmat U Trai : bad hangta u Joshua u la phiah ia ka ri ha ki khun Israel kat kum ki jingphiah jong ki .

en: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will , and to agree , and give their kingdom unto the beast , until the words of God shall be fulfilled .
kha: Naba U Blei u la buh ha ki dohnud jong ki ïa ka mon ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u da kaba ïatreilang bad da kaba ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong ki ban synshar tad ynda ki ktien jong U Blei ki wan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei u la buh ha ki dohnud jong ki ban pyndep ia ka mon jong u, bad ban mynjur bad ban ai ia ka hima jong ki ha u mrad , haduh ba ki ktien U Blei kin long kiba la pyndep .

en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .
kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la phah da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi la ioh ym ia ka mynsiem jong ka pyrthei hynrei ia ka mynsiem kaba long na U Blei; ba ngin ithuh ia kiei kiei kiba la ai laitluid ha ngi na U Blei .

en: Woe unto them ! for they have gone in the way of Cain , and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward , and perished in the gainsaying of Core .
kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa ki ! Ki la bud ha ka lynti kaba u Kain u la ïaid . Na ka bynta ka tyngka , ki la aiti ïa lade sha ka jingbakla kaba u Balaam u la leh . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah kumba u Korah u la ïaleh pyrshah , bad kum ma u , la pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki ! namar ki la iaid kai ha ka lynti jong u Kain , bad ki la mareh da ka jingkwah brai hadien ka jingbakla jong u Balaam na ka bynta ka bainong , bad ki la jah noh ha ka jingmyntoi jong u Core .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Yet once , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , and the earth , and the sea , and the dry land  ;
kha: Shen ngan pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei , ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid ; Hynrei sa shisien, ka long tang khyndiat por, bad ngan pynkhih ia ki bneng bad ia ka khyndew bad ia ka duriaw bad ka ri kaba rkhiang ; .

en: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah  ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :
kha: ka ïar sha Beth Hoglah , nangta ka ïaid shaphang shatei jong ka kynjang ha kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta ka kiew artet sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la kiew sha Bethoglah bad u la iaid shaphang shathie jong ka Betharabah ; bad u pud u sam u la kiew sha u maw u Bhon u khun u Reuben:

en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , Come near before the  Lord  : for he hath heard your murmurings .
kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ong ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh ban wan bad ïeng ha khmat U  Trai  , naba u la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha u Aaron , To ong ha ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki Israel: To wan hajan ha khmat U Trai: namar u la iohsngew ia ki jingkyrhuh jong phi .

en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .
kha: Wat ïa ki rumal bad ki jaiñ-da kiba u la pyndonkam la leit lam sha kito kiba pang , bad ïa ki jingpang jong ki la beh noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihnoh na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta na ka met jong u la wanrah ia ki jingbam ba pang ne ki jingbam ba pang , bad ki jingpang ki la mih noh na ki , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki la mih noh na ki .

en: Thou sayest , ( but they are but vain words , ) I have counsel and strength for the war . Now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
kha: U dawa ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit ha ka kam shipai bad ka bor ? Mano phi pyrkhat u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Assyria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me ong , (hynrei ki long tang ki ktien kiba lehnohei , ) Nga don ka jingai jingmut bad ka jingkhlain na ka bynta ka thma . Mynta ha mano me shaniah , ba me leh pyrshah ia nga ?

en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man , and to birds , and fourfooted beasts , and creeping things .
kha: ha ka jaka ba kin mane ïa U Blei uba im , ki mane ïa ki dur ba la thaw ban i kum u briew ne ki sim ne ki mrad ne ki mrad bapar kiba ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkylla ia ka burom U Blei bym lah ban pyut sha ka dur kaba la pynlong kum u briew uba lah ban pyut, bad ki sim bad ki mrad kiba saw kjat bad kiba iaid kai .

en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .
kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba peit ïa ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki rangbah jong ki ophisar kiba la long halor ka kam u Solomon, san spah sanphew snem , kiba la synshar lypa ia ki briew kiba trei ha ka kam .

en: And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .
kha: Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew uba mih tdem bad ka dongmusa kaba mehding ki paw kynsan bad ïaid napdeng kita ki lyngkhot doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba ka sngi ka la hiar bad ka la dum, ha khmih ka ding kaba dih duma bad ka sharak kaba thang kaba la iaid hapdeng kita ki bynta .

en: And it shall come to pass , while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
kha: Haba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon jong nga ka ïaid najan nangta , ngan buh ïa me ha khmat ka krem jong uta u mawsiang bad ngan tap ïa me da la ka kti haduh ba ngan da ïaid lait nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia katba ka burom jong nga ka iaid lyngba, ba ngan buh ia me ha ka jingkhang jong u maw, bad ngan tap ia me da ka kti jong nga katba nga iaid lyngba:

en: But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?
kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don u shakri uba dang lur lyngkha lane dang sharai ïa ki langbrot . Haba u wan shapoh ïing na lyngkha hato phi ong ïa u ban pynkloi bad bam ïa la ka jingbam ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno na phi uba don u shakri uba rep ne uba ai bam ia u masi , un ong ia u da kaba wan na lyngkha , Leit bad shong ha ka doh ?

en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .
kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalumlang bad ki wan sher dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sher dara ha u Lum Gilboa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la ialum lang bad ki la wan bad ki la ia tyngkhuh ha Shunem : bad u Saul u la ialum lang ia ki Israel baroh , bad ki la ia tyngkhuh ha Gilboa .

en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab  Phi ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa uwei na ki yn sa pynkhyllem noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u: Phi iohi ia kine ki jingtei kiba khraw ? ym dei ban iehnoh ia uwei u maw halor uwei pat , u bym shah pynhap .

en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .
kha: U Shimei u la sdang ban kawang maw ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , wat haba la ker tawiar ïa u Dabid da ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongïada jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la bret maw ha u Dabid bad ha ki shakri jong u syiem u Dabid: bad ki briew baroh bad ki riewshlur baroh ki la don ha ka liang kadiang jong u bad ha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: If I be wicked , woe unto me  ; and if I be righteous , yet will I not lift up my head . I am full of confusion  ; therefore see thou mine affliction  ;
kha: Ngan tang shu leh pop , nga la don ka jingjynjar bad me , hynrei haba nga ïaid hok , ngam ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh . Nga long uba jynjar bad la tap da ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga long uba sniew, to sngewsih ia nga ; bad lada nga long uba hok, hynrei ngan ym rah ia ka khlieh jong nga . Nga dap da ka jingkulmar ; namarkata me peit ia ka jingjynjar jong nga;

en: Which was the son of Mathusala , which was the son of Enoch , which was the son of Jared , which was the son of Maleleel , which was the son of Cainan ,
kha: u khun jong u Methuselah , u khun jong u Enokh , u khun jong u Jared , u khun jong u Mahalaleel , u khun jong u Kenan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Mathuala uba long u khun u Enokh uba long u khun u Jared uba long u khun u Maleleel uba long u khun u Kain .

en: Now there were with us seven brethren : and the first , when he had married a wife , deceased , and , having no issue , left his wife unto his brother :
kha: Mynta , la don hynñiew ngut ki shynrang ba shi para kiba la ju shong ju sah hangne . Uba heh duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun , kumta u la iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u ha la u jong u para .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki don hynriew ngut ki hynmen: bad uba nyngkong, haba u la shongkurim ia ka tnga, u la iap noh bad khlem da don jingeh, u la iehnoh ia ka tnga jong u ha u hynmen jong u:

en: For they all made us afraid , saying , Their hands shall be weakened from the work , that it be not done . Now therefore , O God , strengthen my hands .
kha: Ki pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa ngi ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam . Nga la duwai ,  Hynrei mynta , A Blei , pynlong khlaiñ ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar baroh ki la pyntieng ia ngi, ki da ong , Ki kti jong ki kin tlot noh na ka kam, ba kan ym long . Mynta namarkata ko Blei, pynskhem ia ki kti jong nga .

en: And the children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and waxed exceeding mighty  ; and the land was filled with them .
kha: hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la ïaroi shikatdei eh ; ki la nang bun nang bun , bad ki la nang khlaiñ haduh ba kata ka ri ka la khapngiah da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la long kiba seisoh bad kiba la nang bun bad kiba la nang bun bad kiba la nang bun palat; bad ka ri ka la dap da ki .

en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .
kha: U Solomon u la thung khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kum ki lat ka distrik ha Israel . Ki dei ban pynbiang bam na ki distrik jong ki ïa u syiem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , uwei uwei u rangbah u kitkhlieh na ka bynta uwei u bnai ha ka shisnem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u don shiphew ngut ki ophisar halor ki Israel baroh: uwei pa uwei u bnai jong u ha ka shisnem u la pynbiang .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .
kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Ahab ha Jesreel , ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kaba long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, u Nabot u Jesreel u don ka kper sohjew kaba don ha Jesel, kaba eh da ka iing syiem u Ahab u syiem ka Samaria .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Consider ye , and call for the mourning women , that they may come  ; and send for cunning women , that they may come :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  To pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba jia ! Khot ïa ki nongïambriew ban wan , ïa ki kynthei kiba rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid: Pyrkhat ia phi, bad khot ia ki kynthei kiba sngewsih, ba kin wan ; bad phah ia ki kynthei kiba sngewsih, ba kin wan:

en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but cast them down to hell , and delivered them into chains of darkness , to be reserved unto judgment  ;
kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ki angel kiba la leh pop , hynrei u la bret ïa ki sha dujok , ha kaba la khum kynjri ïa ki ha ka jingdum , da kaba ap ïa ka Sngi ka Jingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada U Blei um shym la pyllait ia ki angel kiba la leh pop, hynrei u la bret noh ia ki sha dujok, bad u la aiti ia ki ha ki kynjri jong ka jingdum, ban shah set ha ka jingbishar ; .

en: For it came to pass , that , when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel , they turned back again from pursuing him .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki kali ïapom ki ïohi ba um dei u syiem Israel , kumta ki sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la jia ba haba ki rangbah jong ki kali ki la sngewthuh ba kam dei ka syiem Israel , ki la phai biang na kaba bud ia u .

en: And behold joy and gladness , slaying oxen , and killing sheep , eating flesh , and drinking wine : let us eat and drink  ; for to morrow we shall die .
kha: Pynban , phi ïa-rkhie bad phi ïalehkmen . Phi pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi ban bam , bad phi dih waiñ . Phi ong ,  Ngi lah ruh ban ïabam bad ïadih ! Lashai ngin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha khmih ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen, ka jingpyniap ia ki masi bad ka jingpyniap langbrot, ka jingbam doh bad ka wain: to ngin ia bam bad dih ; namar lashai ngin iap .

en: And if the priest shall look , and , behold , the plague be not spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ;
kha: Hynrei lada hadien ba u la khmih bha ïa ka , u lyngdoh u shem ba kata ka jingbthuh kam shym pur ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u lyngdoh un peit, bad, ha khmih, ka khlam kan ym saphriang ha ka jain, la ha ka jainkup ne ha ka sniehdoh ne ha kano kano ka sniehdoh;

en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even , ye shall eat unleavened bread , until the one and twentieth day of the month at even .
kha: Naduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong haduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong uta u bnai , phin ym ïabam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai ha ka por janmiet , phin bam ia u kpu khlem thied haduh ka sngi kaba arphew jong u bnai ha ka por janmiet .

en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar  ; four kings with five .
kha: ïa ki syiem jong ka Elam , ka Goiim , ka Babilonia bad ka Ellasar , ki san ngut ki syiem pyrshah ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u Syiem Elam, bad u Syiem ba la buh ha ka ri, bad u Syiem Amraphel u Syiem Shinar bad u Syiem Ariah u Syiem Elasar; saw ngut ki syiem kiba don san ngut ki syiem .

en: And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .
kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad sa ïa ka kmie jong ka , dei ban thang im ïa ki baroh lai ngut , ba kan duh kan dam ka kam sniew hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u shim ia ka tnga bad ka kmie jong ka, ka long ka jingsniew: kin shah thang da ka ding , ma u bad ki; ba kan ym don ka jingsniew hapdeng jong phi .

en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
kha: Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , ki la shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , bad ki la bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la her halor ka jingjot, bad ki la shim ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki khun masi bad ki la pyniap ia ki ha madan: bad ki briew ki la bam ia ki da ka snam .

en: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink , that puttest thy bottle to him , and makest him drunken also , that thou mayest look on their nakedness !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ha ka jingbitar shla jong phi , phi la pynpoh bad pynjahburom ïa la ki paramarjan ; phi pynlong ïa ki ban ïaid sheng sheng kum kiba la buaid .
translated_en_to_kha: To u briew uba ai ia u paramarjan jong u ban dih, uba buh ia ka bilor jong me ha u , bad uba pynlong ia u ruh ban dih kyiad ruh , ba me lah ban peit ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ki !

en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u jubab ,  Hato ka briew ka lah ban klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym ieit ïa i khun iba ka la kha ? Wat la ka kmie ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka kynthei ka lah ban klet ia u khun jong ka uba dang kha khun ? Hooid, ki lah ban klet, hynrei ngan ym klet ia me .

en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jong ka jingim jong ngi , ïa u syiem uba U  Trai  u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno uno u nonghiarthma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong ki shyntur jong ngi, ka jingpynkhuid jong U Trai, ka la shah shim ha ki thliew jong ki, na kiba ngi la ong: Hapoh ka jingdum jong u ngin im hapdeng ki nongwei .

en: Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
kha: u khun jong u Joanan , u khun jong u Rhesa , u khun jong u Serubbabel , u khun jong u Shealtiel , u khun jong u Neri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long u khun u Joanna uba long u khun u Resa uba long u khun u Serubabel uba long u khun u Salathiel uba long u khun u Neri .

en: And it came to pass , that , when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the babe leaped in her womb  ; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost :
kha: Haba ka Elisabeth ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong ka Mari , i khunlung i la khih hapoh jong ka . La pyndap ïa ka Elisabeth da U Mynsiem Bakhuid
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Elisabeth u la iohsngew ia ka jingkhublei jong ka Maria, u babe u la jngi ha ka kpoh jong ka ; bad u Elisabeth u la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .
kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , nga la pynlong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me dei ban pynpoi sha ki ïa ki jingmaham ba nga ai ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta me ko khun u briew, nga la buh ia me u nongap ha ka iing Israel namarkata me dei ban iohsngew ia ka ktien ha ka shyntur jong nga, bad to maham ia ki na nga .

en: And the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , which is by the flanks , and the caul above the liver , with the kidneys , it shall he take away ,
kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ar tylli ki snier bad ka shini kaba don ha ki , kaba don ha ki bynta ba shadien bad ka caul kaba don halor ka sniehdoh , ryngkat bad ki snier , un weng noh ia ka .

en: Thou shalt not consent unto him , nor hearken unto him  ; neither shall thine eye pity him , neither shalt thou spare , neither shalt thou conceal him :
kha: Hynrei wat shah ïa u ban pynkohnguh ïa phi ; wat shahshkor ruh ïa u . Wat isynei ïa u lane wat sngewsynei ïa ki , bad wat ïada ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewbha ia u; lymne wat sngap ia u; lymne wat sngewsynei ia u:

en: Rejoice ye in that day , and leap for joy : for , behold , your reward is great in heaven : for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets .
kha: To kmen haba kata ka jia , bad to shad da ka jingkmen , namar ïa ka bainong kaba khraw la buh na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng . Naba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh ïa kajuh ha ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha ha kata ka sngi bad to iaid kmen: namar, ha khmih, ka bainong jong phi ka long kaba khraw ha bneng: namar ha kajuh ka rukom ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .
kha: U  Trai  uba synshar bad uba ïada ïa ki Israel , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Nga long uba nyngkong , uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei ; ym don uwei pat U Blei hynrei tang ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai u Syiem Israel , bad u nongsiewspah jong u; nga long uba nyngkong, bad nga long uba khatduh; bad nalor jong nga ym don Blei .

en: Jude , the servant of Jesus Christ , and brother of James , to them that are sanctified by God the Father , and preserved in Jesus Christ , and called :
kha: Na u Judah , u shakri jong u Jisu Khrist , bad u para jong u Jakob — Sha kito kiba la khot da U Blei , kiba im hapoh ka jingieit jong U Blei U Kpa bad ha ka jingsumar U Jisu Khrist :
translated_en_to_kha: Jude , u shakri U Jisu Khrist bad u hynmen jong u Jakob , ha kito kiba la pynkyntang da U Blei U Kpa , bad la pynneh pynsah ha U Jisu Khrist , bad la khot:

en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more : but judge this rather , that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother s way .
kha: Te kumta , to ngin sangeh noh na kaba ïabishar uwei ïa uwei pat . Hynrei phi dei ban kut jingmut ban ym leh ïa kaei kaei lano lano ruh ka ban pynlong ïa u parabangeit jong phi ban jynthut lane hap ha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngin ym bishar shuh iwei ia iwei pat: hynrei to bishar ia kane kham bha, ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba buh ia ka jingkhanglad ne ka por ban hap ha ka lynti jong u hynmen jong u.

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh bad ka bor jong u , hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .
kha: Suk uta uba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suk kito kiba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jong ka jingïathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ! Naba ka por ka la jan haba baroh kine kiei kiei kin sa jia .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia uta uba pule bad kito kiba iohsngew ia ki ktien jong kane ka jingiathuhlypa bad kiba buh ia kita kiei kiei kiba la thoh ha ka: namar ka por ka la jan .

en: Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .
kha: Bud ïa U  Trai  bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin iaid bud ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad to sheptieng ia u, bad to sumar ia ki hukum jong u, bad to kohnguh ia ka sur jong u, bad phin shakri ia u, bad phin iaineh ha u .

en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .
kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong ki briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Blei ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym iaid ha ka rukom jong ka jaitbynriew kaba nga bret noh ha khmat jong phi: namar ki la leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh , bad namarkata nga la sngewsih ia ki .

en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .
kha: Nangta , ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong une u bnai , ki paid Israel baroh kin ïa-pynïap ïa kita ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin buh ia ka haduh ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u juh u bnai: bad ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei kan pyniap ia ka ha ka por janmiet .

en: And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .
kha: Ai ba kin wan ïalam shane ïa u kpa jong phi ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tam ha Ijipt , bad kin ïoh palat ïa kaba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shim ia u kpa jong phi bad ki iing jong phi bad to wan sha nga: bad ngan ai ia phi ia ka jingbha jong ka ri Ijipt , bad phin bam ia ka shini jong ka ri .

en: But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand ,  Rise up , and stand forth in the midst .  And he arose and stood forth .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Ïeng joit bad wan shane sha khmat .  Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la ïeng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ki, bad u la ong ha uta u briew uba don ka kti kaba la tyrkhong, To khie noh bad ieng sha khmat hapdeng . U la ieng bad u la ieng .

en: And when the living creatures went , the wheels went by them : and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .
kha: Haba ki jingthaw ki ïaid , ki shalyntem ki ïatyllun lang bad ki , bad haba ki jingthaw ki kiew na ka khyndew ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki jingthaw ba im ki la leit noh , ki tyrpeng ki la iaid lyngba jong ki: bad haba la pynkiew ia ki jingthaw ba im na ka khyndew , la pynkiew ia ki tyrpeng .

en: ( Acts 24 :15 ) That is why Jesus Christ could tell a repentant evildoer who expressed faith in him : “You will be with me in Paradise .” —Luke 23 :43 .
kha: ( Kam ki Apostol 24 :15 ) Na kata ka daw u Jisu Khrist u la ong ha u nongpop ba la kylla bamut uba la pynpaw ia ka jingngeit ha u : “Men long lem bad nga ha ka paradais .” —Loukas 23 :43 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Ki Kam 24 :15 ) Dei na kata ka daw ba U Jisu Khrist u lah ban iathuh ia u nongleh bymman uba kylla bamut uba la pynpaw ia ka jingngeit ha u: Phin don ryngkat bad nga ha ka Paradais .

en: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .
kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lumbah , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phi la ïohi tad haduh ba ïa U Khun U Briew la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang wan hiar na u lum , U Jisu u la kynnoh ia ki da kaba ong: To iathuh ia ka jingphohsniew ha uno uno u briew , haduh ba u Khun u briew un da mihpat na kiba iap .

en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Build thee an house in Jerusalem , and dwell there , and go not forth thence any whither .
kha: Nangta u syiem u phah khot ïa u Shimei , bad u ong ha u ,  Shna ïing noh na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha Jerusalem . Shong ha ka bad wat mihnoh na ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phah bad u la khot ia u Shimei, bad u la ong ha u, To tei ia me ha Jerusalem bad to shong hangta bad wat leit noh nangta shano shano ruh .

en: As for these things which ye behold , the days will come , in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane baroh kaba phi ïohi — ka por kan poi ha kaba yn ym iehnoh hangne ïa uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don ; ïa uwei uwei baroh yn bret sha tbian .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba long ia kine kiei kiei kiba phi iohi, ki sngi kin sa wan, ha kiba ym iehnoh ia uwei u maw halor uwei pat, u bym shah bret noh .

en: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .
kha: Phi tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khrist . Hato ngan shim noh shi lyngkhot na ka met U Khrist bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka nuti ? Kam lah ban long!
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong U Khrist ? hato ngan shim ia ki dkhot jong U Khrist bad ngan pynlong ia ki ki dkhot jong ka jaka ri jingri ? U Blei u la khang .

en: And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .
kha: U Mikah u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno phi wan ?  U jubab ,  Nga dei u Lebi na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih hangno ba ngan shong ngan sah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Micah u la ong ha u, Naei me wan ? Bad u la ong ha u, Nga long u Lebi na Bethlehemudah bad nga leit sah ha ka jaka ba nga lah ban shem jaka .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ïa nga ïa ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ïa phi da kaei ka hok ba nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Nga ruh ngan kylli ia phi kawei ka jingkylli bad jubab ia nga , bad ngan iathuh ia phi da kano ka bor nga leh ia kine kiei kiei .

en: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .
kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei na ka bynta jong ki , namar ki la khuslai bad kim lah ban leh ei ei , kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u la iohi ia ki paidbah , u la sngewsih ia ki namar ki la lyngngoh bad ki la jah rngai noh shabar ri kum ki langbrot ki bym don nongap langbrot .

en: They are created now , and not from the beginning  ; even before the day when thou heardest them not  ; lest thou shouldest say , Behold , I knew them .
kha: Dei tang mynta ba nga pynurlong ïa ki ; ym don ei ei kum kane kaba la jia mynshuwa . Lada ka la jia , phin jin da la kam ba phi la dep tip lut shaphang kane .
translated_en_to_kha: La thaw ia ki mynta , bad ym naduh kaba sdang; wat ha ka sngi ba me iohsngew ia ki wat shuwa ba me ong: Ha khmih nga la ithuh ia ki .

en: Then answered Amos , and said to Amaziah , I was no prophet , neither was I a prophet s son  ; but I was an herdman , and a gatherer of sycomore fruit :
kha: U Amos u jubab ,  Ngam dei kum uta u jait nongïathuhlypa , uba ïathuhlypa na ka bynta ban ïoh jingsiew . Nga dei u nongri jingri , bad nga sumar ïa ki dieng Dumbur .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia u Amos , bad u la ong ha u Amasaiah , ngam shym la long u khun nongiathuhlypa; hynrei nga la long u nongri langbrot bad u nonglum soh sycomore:

en: Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses , saying , If ye transgress , I will scatter you abroad among the nations :
kha: To kynmaw mynta kaei kaba me la ong ha u Moses : ‘ Lada ma phi ki briew ka Israel phin ym ïaineh ha nga , ngan pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw , nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka ktien kaba me la hukum ia u Moses u shakri jong me, da kaba ong: Lada phi iaid lait ia phi, ngan sa pynphriang ia phi shabar ri hapdeng ki jaitbynriew:

en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed what ye hear : with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you : and unto you that hear shall more be given .
kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew ! Da kijuh ki aiñ kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei , U Blei un sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — hynrei wat da kaba kham eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki: To sumar ia kaei kaba phi iohsngew: da ka jingthew kaba phi thew: bad ha phi kiba iohsngew yn sa ai kham bun .

en: And we took all his cities at that time , and utterly destroyed the men , and the women , and the little ones , of every city , we left none to remain :
kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi la ïohknieh bad pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong , bad ngi la pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , shynrang bad kynthei bad khynnah khlem pynsah ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la shim ia ki shnong jong u baroh ha kata ka por, bad ngi la pynjot lut ia ki shynrang bad ki kynthei bad ki khynnah rit na kawei pa kawei ka shnong, ngim shym la iehnoh ia kawei ruh ban sah:

en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left  ; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles , and make the desolate cities to be inhabited .
kha: Phan sa pynïar ïa ki pud sawdong na baroh ki liang ; ki briew jong pha kin ïoh pat ïa la ka ri ïa kaba kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki la shim . Ki nongbah kiba la ieh kynjah yn pyndap pat da ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong me men bret noh ha ka liang kadiang bad ha ka liang kadiang bad u symbai jong me un hiar pateng ia ki Jutang bad un pynlong ia ki nongbah kiba la jot ban shong .

en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it .
kha: La ai ha ki ïa ka nongbah Arba ( u Arba u dei u kpa jong u Anak ) , ïa kaba mynta la khot ka Hebron , ha ka ri lum Judah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ha ki ia ka shnong Arba u kpa jong u Anaak, kaba long u Hebron, ha ka ri lum Judah, bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka sawdong jong ka .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa u Gog :  Haba kata ka por ka la poi , men sa sdang pyrkhat ïa ka buit sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei ; Kan sa jia ruh, ba ha kajuh ka por kiei kiei kin wan ha ka jingmut jong me, bad me phin pyrkhat ia ka jingpyrkhat kaba sniew:

en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .
kha: Pynban , lada ki briew na Makedonia kin wan bad nga bad kin shem ba phim pat long kiba la kloi , katno kan long ka jingpynlehrain ïa ngi — khlem da kren ïa ka jinglehrain ïa phi — naba ngi la shaniah katta ïa phi!
translated_en_to_kha: Lest lehse lada ki na Makedonia ki wan ryngkat bad nga, bad ngi shem ia phi khlem da pynkhreh, ngi (ba ngim ong, phi ) ngi dei ban sngewlehrain ha kane kajuh ka jingsngewskhem .

en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka sopti barim , namar ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynkad katto katne ïa ka jaiñ barim , kan pynlong wat ïa ka jingkad kaba kham heh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba phong ia ka jain thymmai ha ka jain kaba rim: lym kumta kata ka jain thymmai kaba la pyndap ia ka ka weng noh na kaba rim , bad ka bai wai ka nang kham sniew .

en: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :
kha: Ki Jentil kim don ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei haba ki leh da ka jingsngewthuh ha lade ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , ki long ka hukum ïa lade , wat la kim don ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ki Jutang ki bym don ka hukum ki leh da ka jinglong jong kiei kiei kiba don ha ka hukum:

en: Moreover whom he did predestinate , them he also called : and whom he called , them he also justified : and whom he justified , them he also glorified .
kha: Bad kumta kito ïa kiba U Blei u la pynkyrpang , u la khot ; bad ïa kito kiba u la khot , u la pynlong ka hok ïa ki bad u hi , bad u ai bynta ïa ki ha ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ia kiba u la buh lypa, ia ki ruh u la khot: bad ia kiba u la khot: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan: bad ia kiba u la pynksan:

en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith : neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto : it is confusion .
kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ne ka briew ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki mrad ; kum kata ka kam khyllah ka pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat thiah bad uno uno u mrad ban pynjakhlia ia lade da kata: bad ka kynthei kan ym ieng ha khmat u mrad ban thiah hangta: ka long ka jingkulmar .

en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity , nor divine divinations : for I will deliver my people out of your hand : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Kumta mynta ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki jingïathuhlypa ba ïalam bakla ki la kut . Nga pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ka bor jong phi , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin ym iohi shuh ia ka jinglong bieit, ne ki jingpynpaw ba kynja Blei: namar ngan pyllait ia ki briew jong nga na ka kti jong phi: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous : but with kings are they on the throne  ; yea , he doth establish them for ever , and they are exalted .
kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba hok ; u shah ïa ki ban synshar kum ki syiem bad u shah ïa ki ba kin ïoh ka jingpyndonburom junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Um weng noh ia ki khmat jong u na kiba hok: hynrei bad ki syiem ki don ha ka khet ; yea , u pynskhem ia ki junom , bad ki la shah pynkhraw .

en: And it shall be , that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead , that his name be not put out of Israel .
kha: Yn ñiew ïa u khun shynrang ba ki ïoh nyngkong kum u khun jong uta uba la ïap khnang ba ka kyrteng jong u kan ïaineh ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , ba u khun nyngkong uba ka kha un jop ha ka kyrteng jong u hynmen jong u uba la iap , ba ka kyrteng jong u kan ym jah noh na Israel .

en: Now hear me therefore , and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren : for the fierce wrath of the  Lord  is upon you .
kha: Shahshkor , ïa nga ! Kine ki koidi ki dei ki hynmen ki para jong phi . Pyllait noh ïa ki , ne U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sngap ia nga namarkata, bad to aiti biang ia ki mraw kiba phi la shim mraw na ki hynmen jong phi: namar ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai ka don halor jong phi .

en: And he sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home : and Adoniram was over the levy .
kha: bad u buh ïa u Adoniram ban khmih ïa ki . U la pynbynta ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun kiba don shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka pynlut shi bnai ha Lebanon bad ar bnai pat ha la shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia ki sha Lebanon, shi hajar shibnai da ki jinghikai: shibnai ki la don ha Lebanon , bad ar bnai ha iing: bad u Adoniram u la palat ia ka levy .

en: Understand therefore , that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness  ; for thou art a stiffnecked people .
kha: Phi dei ban tip , namar kata , ba U  Trai  um shym ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri kaba seisoh ban ïohkynti namar ka hok jong phi . Phi dei ka jaitbynriew kaba mutlop .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngewthuh namarkata ba U Trai U Blei jong me um ai ia me ia kane ka ri kaba bha ban don ia ka na ka bynta ka hok jong me ; namar me long u briew uba la tyrkhong .

en: We have sinned , and have committed iniquity , and have done wickedly , and have rebelled , even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments :
kha: Ngi la leh pop , ngi la long kiba sniew , ngi la leh bakla . Ngi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba me la hukum ïa ngi ban leh bad ngi la phai noh na kaei kaba me la pyn-i ha ngi ba ka long kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la leh pop bad ngi la leh bymman bad ngi la leh sniew, bad ngi la leh pyrshah, wat da kaba phet noh na ki jingbthah jong me bad na ki jingbishar jong me:

en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
kha: Un phah sa ïa ki jait jingpang bad jingïapthem baroh ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai U Blei , bad phin sa jot thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka jingpang baroh bad ka khlam baroh kaba ym shym la thoh ha ka kot jong kane ka hukum , kin wanrah ia U Trai ha me haduh ba men da shah pynjot .

en: This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;
kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh . Haba ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki wan ban pyndep kam ha ka Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na ki kin ap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kaba phi dei ban leh; Ka bynta kaba lai na phi kaba rung ha ka sngi Sabha , na ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , kan long ki nongrah ia ki jingkhang ; .

en: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
kha: U la khmih sawdong jong ki baroh ; nangta U la ong ha uta u briew ,  To kner ïa ka kti jong me .  U la leh kumta , bad ka kti jong u ka la bha pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u peit kylleng kylleng ia ki baroh, u la ong ha uta u briew, Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me . Bad u la leh kumta: bad ka kti jong u ka la kylla long kaba pura kum kawei pat .

en: And the  Lord  sent Nathan unto David . And he came unto him , and said unto him , There were two men in one city  ; the one rich , and the other poor .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa sha u Dabid . U Nathan u la leit sha u bad u ong ,  Don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba shong ha kajuh ka shnong ; uwei u long uba riewspah , bad uwei pat uba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah ia u Nathan sha u Dabid . U la wan sha u bad u la ong ha u, Ki don arngut ki briew ha kawei ka shnong; uwei uba riewspah bad uwei pat uba duk .

en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?
kha: U Jisu u la khmih sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Aïu , te , kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kit jingmut ?   ‘ U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohi ia ki bad u la ong, Kaei kata kaba la thoh: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait , u long kumjuh u khlieh jong ka kut ?

en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth ? behold , the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee  ; how much less this house that I have builded ?
kha: Hynrei me lah mo , A Blei , ban shong shisha ha ka pyrthei ? Wat ka bneng baroh kam biang pura ban ngiam ïa me , kumta kumno ka lah ban long ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan heh haduh katta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hato U Blei un shong shisha ha ka khyndew ? ha khmih ka bneng bad ka bneng ki bneng kim lah ban bat ia me ; katno kane ka iing kaba nga la tei ?

en: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be famines , and pestilences , and earthquakes , in divers places .
kha: Ki ri kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat . Kin don ki  nemsniew bad ki jingkhynñiuh jumai ha kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew kan kiew pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew, bad ka hima pyrshah ia ka hima: bad kin don ki jingkyrduh bam bad ki jingpang khlam bad ki jingkhynñiuh jumai ha ki jaka ba jylliew .

en: O thou afflicted , tossed with tempest , and not comforted , behold , I will lay thy stones with fair colours , and lay thy foundations with sapphires .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ka Jerusalem , pha ka nongbah ba shah jynjar bad bymdonbor , bad ym don u ban pyntngen ïa pha , ngan tei pat ïa ki nongrim jong pha da ki mawkordor .
