translated_en_to_kha: Ko me la shah pynshitom, ba la pynkhih da ka eriong, bad ym shym la pyntngen, ha khmih, ngan buh ia ki maw jong me da ki rong kiba itynnad, bad ngan buh ia ki nongrim jong me da ki sohjew .

en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee , in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land , and hast prepared thine heart to seek God .
kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , ka dang don katto katne ka jingbha ha phi . Phi la weng baroh ki dur jong ka blei Asherah kaba ki briew ki mane , bad phi la pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki don kiei kiei kiba bha kiba la shem ha me, ha kaba me la weng noh ia ki khlaw na ka ri , bad me la pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong me ban wad ia U Blei .

en: And he hath given it to be furbished , that it may be handled : this sword is sharpened , and it is furbished , to give it into the hand of the slayer .
kha: Ïa ka waitlam la nang pynphyrnai , ba kan long kaba la pynkhreh ban pyndonkam . La pynnep bad pynphyrnai , ban buh ha ki kti u nongpynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia ka ban shah pynkhih: kane ka waitlam ka la tyrkhong bad ka la tyrkhong , ban ai ia ka ha ka kti jong u nongpyniap briew .

en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .
kha: Sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh , ba kumta phin ym shah kyntait ha ka ri Kanaan sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban sumar ia ki ain jong nga baroh bad ki jingbishar jong nga baroh: ba ka ri, ha kaba nga wanrah ia phi ban shong hangta, kan ym mih noh ia phi .

en: He did his Masters in Computer Science from the University of Wisconsin , Milwaukee and an MBA from the University Of Chicago Booth School Of Business .
kha: U la leh ia ka Masters ha ka Computer Science na ka University of Wisconsin , Milwaukee bad ia ka MBA na ka University Of Chicago Booth School Of Business .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leh ia ki Master jong u ha ka Science Science na ka University jong ka ri Wisconsin , Milwaukee bad ka MBA na ka University jong ka Chicago Booth School of Business .

en: Remember them which have the rule over you , who have spoken unto you the word of God : whose faith follow , considering the end of their conversation .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ki nongïalam jong phi kiba mynshuwa , kiba la kren ha phi ïa ka khubor U Blei . To da pyrkhat kumno ki la im bad ki la ïap , bad pyrthuh bud ïa ka jingngeit jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kito kiba don ka jingsynshar halor jong phi, kiba la kren ha phi ia ka ktien U Blei: kiba ka jingngeit jong ki ka bud, haba pyrkhat ia ka jingkut jong ka jingiakren jong ki .

en: For when they shall say , Peace and safety ; then sudden destruction cometh upon them , as travail upon a woman with child ; and they shall not escape .
kha: Haba ki briew ki ong ,  Kaei kaei baroh ka jar jar bad ka shngain ,  te kynsan ka jingpynjot kan lynshop ïa ki! Kan wan kyndit kum ki jingpang kiba wan ha ka briew kaba suh kha , bad ki briew kin ym lait phet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba kin ong , Ka jingsuk bad ka jingshngain ; nangta ka jingpynjot kynsan ka wan ha ki, kum ka jingtrei shitom ha ka kynthei kaba don khun ; bad kin ym lait .

en: Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .
kha: Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei bad buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia kane ka Kitab ka hukum , bad buh ia ka ha ka liang jong ka synduk jong U Trai U Blei jong phi , ba kan long hangta na ka bynta ka sakhi pyrshah ia me .

en: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
kha: U shipai rangbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat ka diengphna u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïap .  Une u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei !  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah uba la ieng hajan jong u, u la iohi ba u la pyrta kumta bad u la aiti noh ia u ksuid, u la ong: Hooid une u briew u long U Khun U Blei .

en: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
kha: Kumta haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Uno na kine phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Jisu Barabbas ne ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la ialum lang , u Pilat u la ong ha ki , Iano phi kwah ba ngan pyllait ha phi ? Barabbas ne U Jisu uba la khot U Khrist ?

en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive , she shall be brought up , and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves , tabering upon their breasts .
kha: Ïa ka syiem la ring koidi ; ki shakri jong ka ki ud kum ki lyngdkhur bad ki tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Huzzab kan shah rah noh sha jingshah rahbor, bad ki shakri jong ka kin ialam ia ka kumba ka long da ka sur jong ki paro , da kaba iaid ha ki bniat jong ki .

en: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul s servant , and said unto him , I have given unto thy master s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
kha: Nangta u syiem u phah khot ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga ai ha u Mephibosheth , u ksiew jong u kynrad jong me , ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ia u Siba , u shakri jong u Saul bad u la ong ha u: Nga la ai ha u khun kynrad jong me baroh kaba dei ia u Saul bad ha ka iing jong u baroh .

en: For though I be absent in the flesh , yet am I with you in the spirit , joying and beholding your order , and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ .
kha: Naba wat la ngam don ryngkat ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem , bad nga kmen haba nga ïohi ïa ka jingkut jingmut kaba skhem da kaba phi ïa-ïeng lang ha ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga long uba khlem ha ka doh, hynrei nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem, nga sngewbha bad nga peit ia ka jinglong jong phi, bad ka jinglong ba skhem jong phi ha U Khrist .

en: Behold , the noise of the bruit is come , and a great commotion out of the north country , to make the cities of Judah desolate , and a den of dragons .
kha: To shahshkor ! Ka khubor ka wan ! Ka don ka jingkhihwin bakhraw ha ka jaitbynriew bashatei ; ka kynhun shipai jong ka kan pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ka Judah sha ka ri shyiap , ka jaka ha kaba ki shong ki myrsiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka jingsawa jong u khniang ka wan, bad ka jingkhih kaba khraw na ka ri Sepngi , ban pynlong ia ki nongbah Judah ban jah rngai noh bad ka thliew jong ki bsein .

en: For the  Lord  your God is God of gods , and Lord of lords , a great God , a mighty , and a terrible , which regardeth not persons , nor taketh reward :
kha: Naba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long uba khrawbor tam halor ki blei baroh bad halor ki bor baroh . U long uba khraw bad uba donbor , bad uba dei ban sheptieng . U bym ñiewshiliang khmat bad u bym ju pdiang ïa ki jingai kiba da ka dohnud ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong phi u long U Blei jong ki blei, bad U Trai jong ki kynrad, U Blei uba khraw, uba donbor bad uba shyrkhei, uba khlem pyrkhat ia ki briew , ne uba shim ia ka bainong:

en: And , behold , the man clothed with linen , which had the inkhorn by his side , reported the matter , saying , I have done as thou hast commanded me .
kha: Te uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen u la leit phai bad wan ïathuh ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh kumba me la hukum ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lyngkhuid, uba don ka inkhorn ha ka liang jong u, u la iathuh ia kata ka kam, u la ong: Nga la leh kumba me la hukum ia nga .

en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .
kha: U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa ka kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la peit ia ka kam baroh, bad, ha khmih, ki la leh ia kata kumba U Trai u la hukum, wat la ki la leh ia kata: bad u Moses u la kyrkhu ia ki .

en: And ye shall tread down the wicked  ; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ha ka sngi haba ngan leh ïa ka kam , phin jop thiaw ïa ki bymman , bad kin long kum u pui pui hapoh ki kjat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin iaid shapoh ki kjat bymman; namar kin long ki dewbilat hapoh ki tyrpeng jong phi ha ka sngi ba ngan leh ia kane , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And men were scorched with great heat , and blasphemed the name of God , which hath power over these plagues : and they repented not to give him glory .
kha: La thang ïa ki da ka jingshit tyrha kaba jur , bad ki la tim ïa ka kyrteng jong U Blei , uba don ka bor halor kine ki khlam . Hynrei kim shym phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la shah pynshit jur bad ki la kren bein ia ka kyrteng U Blei uba don ka bor halor kine ki khlam: bad ki la kylla bamut ban ym ai burom ia u .

en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .
kha: Kumta ïa ka kur Merari la ai khat-ar tylli ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki shnong baroh na ka bynta ki khun Merari da ki longiing jong ki, kiba dang sah na ki longiing jong ki Lebi ki long da ka bhah jong ki shiphew tylli ki shnong .

en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .
kha: Namar kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano : U  Trai  u long U Blei ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . Ym don blei da uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip namarkata ia kane ka sngi , bad to pyrkhat ia ka ha ka dohnud jong me , ba U Trai u long U Blei ha bneng shaneng bad ha ka khyndew shapoh: ym don shuh .

en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering , and his meat offering , ( they shall be unto you without blemish ) and their drink offerings .
kha: Wanrah ïa kine bad ïa ka jingainguh waiñ nalor ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingainguh bam kaba man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban ai ia ki nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba iai bteng, bad ka jingainguh bam jong u, (ki long ha phi khlem jingduna ) bad ki jingainguh dih jong ki .

en: And the firstborn said unto the younger , Our father is old , and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth :
kha: Ka khun nyngkong ka ong ha la ka para ,  I pa jong ngi i la tymmen , bad ym don shynrang ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei ki ban shongkurim ïa ngi ba ngin ïoh khun ïoh kti .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun nyngkong u la ong ha uba kham rit: U kpa jong ngi u la tymmen bad ym don briew ha ka khyndew ban wan rung sha ngi kat kum ka rukom jong ka khyndew baroh:

en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei eh bad ki la ong ha u Petros bad ha kiwei pat ki apostol ,  Kaei kaba ngin leh , ko para ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki la iohsngew ia kane , ki la sngewsih ha ka dohnud jong ki bad ki la ong ha u Petros bad ha kiwei pat ki apostol: Ko para bangeit ngin leh aiu ?

en: And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .
kha: U Jisu u la kli pat ïa ka kot kli , u la ai pat ïa ka ha u shakri , bad u la shong . Baroh ki briew ha ka synagog ki la peit shlip sha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la khang ia ka kot bad u la ai biang ia ka ha u myntri bad u la shong . Bad ki khmat jong kito baroh kiba don ha ka synagog ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u .

en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .
kha: Ngi ïaleh tyngeh bad trei shitom , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ïa baroh bad khamtam ïa kito kiba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar namarkata ngi baroh arngut ngi trei shitom bad ngi shah pynjah burom , namar ngi shaniah ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ia ki briew baroh , khamtam eh ia kito kiba ngeit .

en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength , and smote Jehoram between his arms , and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .
kha: U Jehu u wiat ïa la ka ryntieh bad katba don la ka bor u siat ïa u khnam bad u dei ïa u Joram na shadien bad u ngam haduh u klongsnam jong u . U Joram u kyllon ïap ha ka kali ïapom jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la ring ia ka bow da ka bor ba pura jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia u Jehoram hapdeng ki kti jong u, bad u khnam u la mih ha ka dohnud jong u, bad u la ngam ha ka kali jong u .

en: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Set on a pot , set it on , and also pour water into it :
kha: To ïathuh ïa ki briew ba-ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ïa kane ka pharshi kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga don na ka bynta jong ki :  Buh ïa u khiew halor ka ding bad pyndap pura ïa u da ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynmih ia ka jingiasyriem sha ka iing kaba leh pyrshah, bad ong ha ki, Kumta u Trai Blei u la buh ha ka umphniang, u la buh ia ka ha ka umphniang bad u la theh um ruh ha ka:

en: Saying unto Aaron , Make us gods to go before us : for as for this Moses , which brought us out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
kha: Kumta ki la ong ha u Aaron , ‘ To thaw ïa ngi katto katne ki blei ki ban ïalam ïa ngi . Ngim tip kaei kaba la jia ïa une u Moses , uba la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong ha u Aaron , To leh ia ngi ki blei ban leit ha khmat jong ngi: namar ia une u Moses uba la wanrah ia ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ngim ju leh ia kaei kaba la jia na u .

en: And I made an ark of shittim wood , and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first , and went up into the mount , having the two tables in mine hand .
kha: Kumta nga la thaw kawei ka synduk kaba da u dieng Akasia bad nga la shtah ruh ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba nyngkong , bad nga leit rah ïa ki shalor uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shna ia ka synduk dieng shittim, bad nga la ot ar tylli ki miej maw kumba long ha kaba nyngkong, bad nga la leit sha jrong u lum, nga don ia ki ar tylli ki miej ha ka kti jong nga .

en: Who can count the dust of Jacob , and the number of the fourth part of Israel ? Let me die the death of the righteous , and let my last end be like his !
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Israel ki long kum u pui pui — Ki la ïabun palat , ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Shah ba ngan pynkut ïa la ki sngi kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei , Shah ba ngan ïap ha ka jingsuk kum u riewhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban khein ia ka dewmet u Jakob bad ka jingdon jong ka bynta kaba saw jong ki Israel ? To ngan iap ia ka jingiap jong kiba hok bad to ngan iap ia ka jingkut kaba khatduh jong nga kum ka jong u !

en: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah , nor a lawgiver from between his feet , until Shiloh come  ; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be .
kha: U Judah un bat ïa u diengsynshar syiem , Bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai synshar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wanrah ha u ïa ka bai nguh syiem , kin dem bad kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dieng kan ym mih na Judah, lane u nongthaw ain na pdeng ki kjat jong u, haduh ba u Shiloh un wan ; bad ha u ka jingiasoh lang jong ki briew kan long .

en: They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard  ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .
kha: ‘ Ym don mano mano ba khot bylla ïa ngi ,’ ki la jubab . ‘ Lada kumta , te , phi ruh khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ ,’ u la ong ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong ha u , Namar ym don mano mano ba la thung ia ngi . U ong ha ki , To leit ruh sha ka kper sohjew ; bad kaei kaei kaba dei , kaba phin pdiang .

en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .
kha: U Samuel u mihnoh na Gilgal bad u leit la ka lynti . Kiba sah na ki briew ki la bud ïa u Saul katba u dang leit ban ïasoh bad la ki shipai . Ki leit na Gilgal sha Gibeah ha ka thain Benjamin . U Saul u leit peit ïa la ka kynhun shipai , kiba don kumba hynriewspah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ieng bad u la leit sha Gilgal haduh Gibeah jong u Benjamin . U Saul u la khein ia ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, kumba hynriew spah ngut ki briew .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha nga ,  Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynkhuid kum ka bri sohwaiñ na kaba la kheit ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïano ïano katba pha lah katba dang don ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid: Kin sa lum bha ia ki Israel kiba sah kum u sohjew: pynphai biang ia ka kti jong me kum u nonglum jingtip sha ki lyngkhot lyngkhai .

en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout : and as the men of Judah shouted , it came to pass , that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah .
kha: Ki Judia ki pyrta jam , bad hapoh ka jingïalam u Abijah , ki tur ïaleh ; U Blei u pynliem ïa u Jeroboam bad ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah ki la pyrta: bad kumba ki briew jong ka Judah ki la pyrta, ka la jia ba U Blei u la shoh ia u Jeroboan bad ki Israel baroh ha khmat u Abiah bad u Judah .

en: And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :
kha: U shna ruh ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka miej jong u dieng shittim: ar tylli ki kti ka long ka jingjrong jong ka , bad shi kti ka jingjrong jong ka:

en: Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .
kha: To ïam bad to ud , ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki Kedar ki la kyllon ; ïa kito ki dieng badonburom la pynjot ! To ïam bad to ud , ko ki dieng Sning jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaw kaba rben la khet noh !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , u diengsoh u la hap ; namar ba ki riewshlur ki la shah pynsniew: howl , O phi ki oak u Basan ; namar ka khlaw jong ka vintage ka wan hiar .

en: And it was revealed in mine ears by the  Lord  of hosts , Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh da lade hi u la kren ha nga bad ong ,  Ïa kane kaba sniew jong ki yn ym map da lei lei katba ki dang im . Ma nga , U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pynpaw ha ki shkor jong nga da U Trai jong ki paid: Hooid kane ka jingbymhok kan ym long kaba khuid na phi haduh ba phin da iap , ong U Trai U Blei jong ki paid .

en: Come , and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites , and let not our hand be upon him  ; for he is our brother and our flesh . And his brethren were content .
kha: To ngin die noh ïa u ha kine ki nong Ishmael . Te ngim donkam ban pynmynsaw ïa u , naba u dei u para jong ngi , ka doh ka snam jong ngi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, bad to ngin die ia u ha ki Ishakhali, bad wat ai ba ka kti jong ngi kan long halor jong u ; namar u long u hynmen jong ngi bad ka doh jong ngi . Bad ki hynmen jong u ki la sngewhun .

en: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire  ; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land  ; thou shalt be no more remembered : for I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Yn pynjot ïa phi da ka ding . Ïa ka snam jong phi yn pynmih ha la ka ri , bad yn ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa phi .’   U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban long ka umphniang ha ka ding ; ka snam jong me kan long hapdeng ka ri ; men ym kynmaw shuh: namar nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
kha: Ki briew pat ki long kiba radbah bad kiba jrong rynïeng ; ki dei ki ramhah , bad phi la bna ba don kiba ong ba ym don mano mano uba lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba jrong , ki khun ki ksiew kiba me tip bad kiba me la iohsngew ba ki ong: Mano ba lah ban ieng ha khmat ki khun ki ksiew !

en: And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .
kha: bad ha kylleng ka ri , ar na ka lai bynta ki briew kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ka ri baroh kawei, ong U Trai, ar bynta na ka kin shah ot noh bad kin iap; hynrei kaba lai kan sah ha kata ka jaka .

en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum , and his conspiracy which he made , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Shallum u la leh , kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh ïa ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Shallum bad ka jingthmu jong u kaba u la leh , ha khmih la thoh ha ka Kitab ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel .

en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
kha: U la ai kajuh ka hukum ïa uba ar , uba lai , bad ïa kita baroh kiba khmih ïa kita ki kynhun jingri ,  Phi dei ban ong kumne ha u Iso haba phi ïakynduh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta u la hukum ia kaba ar bad kaba lai bad baroh kiba bud ia ki kynhun , da kaba ong: Ha kane ka rukom phin kren ia u Iso haba phi lap ia u .

en: O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !
kha: Phi shong sngewskhem hapdeng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na Lebanon ; hynrei katno kaba sngewsynei ynda wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phin ud haba ka jingsuh kan lap ïa phi , ki jingshitom kum kito ki jong ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko nongshong shnong jong ka Lebanon, kaba pynlong ia ka bniat jong me ha ki diengsoh , katno phin long uba sngewrit haba ki pang ki wan ha me , ka jingpang kum ka kynthei ha ka jingkha khun !

en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .
kha: bad u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha u :  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  U la mihnoh bad u la ïamkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la kynmaw ia ka ktien U Jisu kaba la ong ha u, "Ha khmat u khnai, me kyntait ia nga shibun . U la mih noh bad u la iam sngewsih .

en: And he said unto Aaron , Take thee a young calf for a sin offering , and a ram for a burnt offering , without blemish , and offer them before the  Lord .
kha: U ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim ïa uwei u masi lyngraw bad uwei u langbrot ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  , ïa u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Aaron, To shim ia u khun masi uba dang rit na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, bad u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang , khlem jingduna , bad to ai ia ki ha khmat U Trai .

en: He was also introduced to a Pakistani Sikh named Gopal Singh Chawla , former general secretary of the Pakistani Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee .
kha: La pynithuh ruh ia u bad uwei u Sikh na Pakistan uba kyrteng u Gopal Singh Chawla uba dei u General Secretary barim jong ka Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee jong ka Pakistan .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynithuh ruh ia u ha u Sikh jong ka Pakistan uba la tip kyrteng kum u Gopal Singh Chawla , u secretary barim jong ka Pakistan Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee .

en: Notice , though , that survival did not depend solely on human efforts . Noah and his family had to obey God , who had the power to preserve them alive .
kha: Hynrei peit bha ba ka jingim kam shong tang ha ka jingpyrshang jong u briew . U Noah bad ka iing ka sem jong u ki la dei ban kohnguh ia U Blei uba don ka bor ban pynim ia ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit, pynban, ba ka jingim kam shym la shong tang ha ka jingpyrshang jong u briew . U Noah bad ka iing jong u ki la dei ban kohnguh ia U Blei , uba don ka bor ban pynneh pynsah ia ki .

en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar  ; and in the night by a pillar of fire , to give them light in the way wherein they should go .
kha: Da u lyoh me ïalam ïa ki ha ka por mynsngi , bad mynmiet me pynshai ïa ka lynti jong ki da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me ialam ia ki ha ka por mynstep da u lum ba dum bad ha ka por miet da u lum ding , ban ai jingshai ia ki ha ka lynti ha kaba ki dei ban leit .

en: Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people , which prophesy out of their own heart  ; and prophesy thou against them ,
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , khmih ïa ki kynthei hapdeng ki briew jong me kiba pynlong ki jingïathuh lypa . To kren pyrshah ïa ki
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh me khun u briew, to buh ia ka khmat jong me pyrshah ia ki khun kynthei jong me kiba iathuhlypa na la ka jong ka dohnud;

en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth : and there is none that holdeth with me in these things , but Michael your prince .
kha: U la ong ,  Hato me tip balei ba nga la wan sha me ? Ka long ban pynpaw ha me ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jingshisha . Mynta nga dei ban leit noh pat bad ban ïaleh ïa u angel ïada jong ka Persia . Hadien kata , u angel ïada jong ka Gris un mihpaw . Ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga lait noh u Mikhael , u angel ïada jong ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pyni ia me ia kata kaba la kdew ha ka jingthoh jong ka jingshisha: bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba bat ia nga ha kine kiei kiei , hynrei u Michael u syiem jong phi .

en: And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .
kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkew ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha . Kim shym da don jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan rung ha ka lieng barit ; (namar kim shym la jngai na ka khyndew , hynrei kumba ka long arspah cubit , ) ki la tan ia ka jar bad ki dohkha .

en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa u hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pat ka pharshi ka la buh ha ki, ka ong: Ka hima bneng ka long kum u symbai ba la khleh lang, uba u briew u la shim bad u la bet ha ka lyngkha jong u:

en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north , and toward the east  ; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits .
kha: Sha shiliang ka khyrdop bashatei la don ka khyrdop kaba ïalam sha ka phyllaw bashapoh , katjuh kumba la don ha ka liang mihngi . Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kine ki ar tylli ki khyrdop , bad ka long sanphew mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw kaba shapoh ka la long shaphang shathie , bad shaphang mihngi bad u la thew naduh ka khyrdop haduh ka khyrdop da ki shispah cubit .

en: And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .
kha: U ïathuh ïa ngi ba la lap ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab — hynrei um shym ïathuh ha u kñi jong u ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la kren shaphang ka jingpynlong Syiem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u kpa jong u, U la iathuh shai ia ngi ba la lap ia ki kada . Hynrei shaphang ka kam jong ka hima kaba u Samuel u la kren , um shym la iathuh ia u .

en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit , after the tradition of men , after the rudiments of the world , and not after Christ .
kha: Da khmih bha , te , ba uno uno un ym teh mraw ïa phi da ki buit shukor bymmyntoi jong ka jingstad ba kynja briew , kaba wan na ki jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki briew bad na ki mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka jingpynlong , bad ym na U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: To husiar na ka bynta ba uno uno u briew un pynsniew ia phi lyngba ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad ka jingleh thok kaba lehnohei, hadien ka dustur jong ki briew, hadien ki rud jong ka pyrthei, bad ym hadien U Khrist .

en: Ye also , as lively stones , are built up a spiritual house , an holy priesthood , to offer up spiritual sacrifices , acceptable to God by Jesus Christ .
kha: To wan kum ki maw ba-im , bad to shah ïa lade ba yn pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ ba kynja mynsiem , ha kaba phin shakri kum ki lyngdoh bakhuid ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ba kynja mynsiem bad ba pdiang hun ha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ruh kum ki maw kiba im, la tei ia ka iing kaba kynja mynsiem, ka jinglong lyngdoh bakhuid, ban aiti ia ki jingknia ba kynja mynsiem, kiba pdiang sngewbha ia U Blei da U Jisu Khrist .

en: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year , in the first month , in the first day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriewphew snem, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga da kaba ong:

en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .
kha: dei ma u , uba pynlah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba khlem kynthup ïa ka hukum ba la thoh hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka hukum ba la thoh ka wallam ïa ka jingïap , hynrei U Mynsiem u ai jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba ruh u la pynlong ia ngi ki nongtrei kiba lah ban leh ia ka jutang thymmai ym na ka shithi , hynrei na ka mynsiem: namar ka shithi ka pyniap ia ka jingim .

en: They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .
kha: Da kumta ki la hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ryngkat bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki . Ka khyndew ka tap ïa ki , bad ki la jah jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki , bad baroh kiba iadei bad ki, ki la leit hiar im shapoh ka thliew, bad ka khyndew ka la khang ia ki: bad ki la jah noh na ka jingiaseng .

en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold , he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .
kha: Ma phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga , to pynskuiñ ïa ki rangbah kumba ka kulai ka pynskuiñ ïa ki kulai jong ki kali ïapom jong u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U baieit jong nga u long kum u blang ne u khun samla: ha khmih , u ieng shadien ka jingkhang jong ngi , u peit sha jrong sha ki jingkhang , u pyni ia lade lyngba ka lattice .

en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way , he shall fall himself into his own pit : but the upright shall have good things in possession .
kha: Lada phi leh buit bymman ïa u briew uba hok ban leh ïa kaba sniew , phin hap ha la ka jong ka liewlep . Uba lui lui un ïohnong shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba pynlong ia kiba hok ban iaid bakla ha ka lynti kaba sniew, un hap ha la ka jong ka thliew: hynrei kiba hok kin don ia kiei kiei kiba bha ha ka jingdon .

en: Opening and alleging , that Christ must needs have suffered , and risen again from the dead  ; and that this Jesus , whom I preach unto you , is Christ .
kha: da kaba sot bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad pynshisha na ki ba U Messaïah u la dei ban shahshitom bad ban mihpat na ka jingïap .  Une U Jisu ïa uba nga pynbna ha phi , u dei U Messaïah ,  u Paul u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingplie bad ka jingkynnoh , ba U Khrist u la shah shitom bad u la mihpat na kiba iap ; bad ba une u Jisu uba nga ialap ha phi u long U Khrist .

en: And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .
kha: Phi la ïohi ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta jong phi . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ia kine ki jaitbynriew baroh namar jong phi; namar U Trai U Blei jong phi u long ma u uba la ialeh na ka bynta jong phi .

en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;
kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh sawdong ka Medeba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rud duriaw jong ki ka long na Aroer kaba don ha rud wah Arnon bad ka shnong kaba don hapdeng ka wah bad ka madan baroh kawei da ka Medeba ; .

en: Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?
kha: Pleng da kumne mo phi siew kylliang ïa U  Trai  , a , phi ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit bad kaba anna ? Hato um dei u kpa jong phi , uba la thaw ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phi kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phi pynshitom kumta ia U Trai , ko briew uba bieit bad uba khlem akor ? hato u kpa jong me uba la thied ia me ?

en: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the  Lord  : and he made a trench about the altar , as great as would contain two measures of seed .
kha: Da kine ki maw , u thaw biang ïa ka duwan ban mane ïa U  Trai . U tih ïa ka kharai sawdong jong ka , kaba heh kat haduh ban ngiam kumba khatsaw litar ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ki maw u la tei ia ka jingbam ha ka kyrteng U Trai: bad u la shna ia ka thliew sawdong ka jingbam , katba u lah ban don ar tylli ki symbai .

en: Then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the  Lord  , before the priests and the judges , which shall be in those days  ;
kha: baroh arliang ki dei ban leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba yn bishar ïa ki da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongbishar kiba treikam ha kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta baroh arngut ki briew kiba don ka jingiakren kin ieng ha khmat U Trai, ha khmat ki lyngdoh bad ki nongbishar kiba ha kita ki sngi;

en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .
kha: Bad u la hukum ïa ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ban khum ïa ki lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia ki briew kiba khlain tam kiba don ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ban teh ia u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego bad ban bret ia ki ha ka ding kaba thang .

en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded you , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .
kha: Kynmaw kumno u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la ïathuh ha phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan kum ka ïing jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia ka ktien kaba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la hukum ia phi da kaba ong , U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai jingjahthait ia phi bad u la ai ia kane ka ri .

en: The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa kim kren ei ei hynrei tang ki jinglamler ; ki lyngdoh ki synshar tang kumba hukum ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki briew jong nga kim shym pynpaw jingpyrshah ei ei . Hynrei kin leh aïu haba baroh ka poi sha kaba kut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongiathuhlypa ki iathuhlypa bakla , bad ki lyngdoh ki bat ia ka jingsynshar da ka ktien jong ki ; bad ki briew jong nga ki ieit ban don ia ka kumta : bad phin leh aiu ha kaba kut jong ka ?

en: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .
kha: U Jakob u la tip ba la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei namar ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang don sha ki pyntha bad la ki jingri , um shym leh ei ei tad haduh ba kin da wan phai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la iohsngew ba u la pynsniew ia ka khun jong u: mynta ki khun shynrang jong u ki don bad ki masi jong u ha lyngkha : bad u Jakob u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u haduh ba kin da wan .

en: And I myself also am persuaded of you , my brethren , that ye also are full of goodness , filled with all knowledge , able also to admonish one another .
kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga : Nga hi nga sngewskhem ba phi dap da ka jingbha , ba phi don ka jingtip baroh , bad ba phi lah ban hikai iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ruh nga sngewskhem ia phi, ko para jong nga, ba phi ruh phi dap da ka jingbha, ba la pyndap da ka jingtip baroh , ba phi lah ruh ban ia kren iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Beware that thou forget not the  Lord  thy God , in not keeping his commandments , and his judgments , and his statutes , which I command thee this day :
kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; wat lyndet ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ba me klet ia U Trai U Blei jong me, ha kaba ym sumar ia ki hukum jong u bad ki jingbishar jong u bad ki ain jong u kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi:

en: Let the priests take it to them , every man of his acquaintance : and let them repair the breaches of the house , wheresoever any breach shall be found .
kha: Man u lyngdoh u dei ban kitkhlieh ïa ka pisa ba wanrah da kito kiba u shakri , bad ïa ka pisa dei ban pyndonkam ha kaba shna pynbha ïa ka Templ , katba donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki lyngdoh kin shim ia ka ha ki, uwei pa uwei u briew uba la ithuh: bad ai ba kin pynbha ia ki jingpynkhein jong ka iing , ha kano kano ka jaka ba la lap ia kano kano ka jingpynkhein .

en: While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .
kha: Ki kular ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha kano kano kaba jop halor u .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki kular ia ki ia ka jinglaitluid, ma ki hi ki long ki shakri jong ka jingbamsap: namar na kiba u briew u shah jop , na kajuh ka long uba la wanrah ha ka jinglong mraw .

en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?
kha: Kito kiba pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ki jingthmu jong ki na U  Trai  , kin jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh bad ki pyrkhat ba yn ym don ba ïohi ïa ki lane tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewsih ia kita kiba wad ban buhrieh ia ka jingmut jong ki na U Trai , bad ki kam jong ki ki don ha ka jingdum , bad ki ong , Mano ba iohi ia ngi ? bad mano ba ithuh ia ngi ?

en: So Abram departed , as the  Lord  had spoken unto him  ; and Lot went with him : and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .
kha: Haba u Abram u la dap hynñiewphew san snem ka rta , u la mihnoh na Haran , kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa u ban leh ; bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Abram u la leit noh, kumba U Trai u la kren ha u ; bad u Lot u la leit bad u: bad u Abram u la dap hynriewphew san snem ka rta haba u la leit noh na Haran .

en: And all this assembly shall know that the  Lord  saveth not with sword and spear : for the battle is the  Lord s  , and he will give you into our hands .
kha: Te ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip ba ki Israel ki don U Blei , bad ba uwei pa uwei hangne un ïohi ba U  Trai  um donkam ïa ki waitlam ne ki sum ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew . U long u nongjop ha ka thma , naba ka thma ka long ka jong U  Trai  , bad un buh ïa phi baroh hapoh ka bor jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka jingiaseng baroh kan tip ba U Trai um pynim da ka waitlam bad ka khnam: namar ka thma ka long ka Trai s , bad un aiti ia phi ha ki kti jong ngi .

en: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,
kha: Katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la leit lyngba ïa ki phang kiba shapoh jong ka probins    bad u la poi ha Ephesos . Hangta u la shem katto katne ngut kiba ngeit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la iaid lyngba ki rud duriaw ba shalor u la poi sha Ephesos: bad u la shem ia ki katto katne ki synran .

en: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses  ; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment :
kha: Ki Israel ki la leh kumba u Moses u la lah ong ; bad ki la pan na ki nong Ijipt ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa , bad ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem de .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh kat kum ka ktien u Moses ; bad ki la shim ram na ki nong Ijipt ia ki mawkordor rupa bad ki mawkordor ksiar bad ki jainkup:

en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about : all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her , spare no arrows : for she hath sinned against the  Lord .
kha: Ko nongsiatkhnam , to ïeng ryntih na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilon bad kerkut ïa ka . To siat ïa ki khnam jong phi baroh ïa ka Babilon , namar ka la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia lade ha ka jaka pyrshah ia ka Babilon sawdong: phi baroh kiba pynkhih ia ka bow, to siat ia ka, wat pyllait ia ki khnam: namar ka la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .
kha: hynrei ym don mano mano batip shaphang kata , namar ki i kumjuh kumba ki long mynshuwa . Nangta nga la kyndit thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la bam ia ki shaneng, ym lah ban tip ba ki la bam ia ki ; hynrei ki dang sngewsih, kumba ha kaba sdang . Kumta nga la kyndit .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land which I give you , then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the  Lord .
kha: Ynda phi rung ha kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  u ai ha phi , phin burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba phin ym rep ïa ka khyndew ha man la ka snem kaba hynñiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki , Ynda phi la poi ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phi , te ka ri kan long ka Sabha ha U Trai .

en: At the end of a regular pioneer’s first year of full-time service , he or she is enrolled in a six-day school that may be held at a nearby Kingdom Hall .
kha: Ynda ki pioneer batista ki la trei pura shisnem , ïa ki la ju pynrung kyrteng ha ka skul ba hynriew sngi kiba ju pynlong ha ka Ïing Hima ba jan tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ka snem ba nyngkong jong ka jingshakri kaba pura, la pynrung kyrteng ia u ne ka ha ka skul kaba hynriew sngi kaba lah ban long ha ka jaka ba marjan jong ka Hima .

en: And it shall come to pass , that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay : and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay .
kha: Uno uno uba dang lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Hasael , un shah pynïap ha u Jehu , bad uno uno uba lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Jehu un shah pynïap ha u Elisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uta uba lait na ka waitlam u Hazael un pyniap: bad uta uba lait na ka waitlam u Jehos un pyniap .

en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea  ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba ki um ki ïeng kum ki kynroh na baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun Israel ki iaid ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang hapdeng ka duriaw ; bad ki um ki long ka kynroh ia ki ha ka liang kadiang jong ki .

en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .
kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonburom : To ai ba baroh ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kane kam long ka hukum kaba thymmai kaba nga thoh sha phi ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la don naduh mynnyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga kyrpad ia me, ko kynthei, ym kumba nga la thoh ia ka hukum kaba thymmai ha me, hynrei ia kata kaba ngi la don naduh kaba sdang, ba ngi ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed , I also was standing by , and consenting unto his death , and kept the raiment of them that slew him .
kha: Bad haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , u sakhi jong me , nga hi nga la don hangta , nga da mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u bad nga da sumar ïa ki jaiñ jong ki nongpynïap ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka snam jong u Stephan jong me ka la tuid , nga ruh nga la ieng hajan bad nga la mynjur ia ka jingiap jong u, bad nga la bat ia ka jainkup jong kita kiba la pyniap ia u .

en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled  ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone  ; without the camp shall his habitation be .
kha: Un ïaisah u bymkhuid katba kata ka jingpang ka dang don , bad u dei ban sah kyrpang shabar ka jaka shong dara , jngai na kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki sngi ha kaba ka khlam kan don ha u un long uba khlem khuid: un shong marwei; khlem ka jaka shong jong u kan long .

en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty : for it was perfect through my comeliness , which I had put upon thee , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Pha la long kaba pawnam ha ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha , namar nga long uta uba la pynlong ïa pha kaba ibhabriew .  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka nam jong me ka la leit shabar hapdeng ki nongwei na ka bynta ka jingitynnad jong me: namar ka la long kaba janai lyngba ka jingitynnad jong nga, kaba nga la buh ha me, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . He said moreover , For there shall be peace and truth in my days .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la sngewthuh ïa kane kaba mut ba kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingskhem bha ha ka por ka jingim jong u , kumta u jubab ,  Ka khubor ba la ai ha nga na U  Trai  ka long kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hesekaiah u la ong ha Isaiah , Ka long kaba bha ia ka ktien U Trai kaba me la kren . U la ong shuh shuh: Namar kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshisha ha ki sngi jong nga .

en: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zebulun , twelve cities .
kha: Ki longïing jong ka kur Merari ki ïoh khat-ar tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Reuben , Gad , bad Sebulun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Merari da ki jait jong ki ki don na ka jaitbynriew Reuben bad na ka jaitbynriew Gad bad na ka jaitbynriew Sebulun , shiphew tylli ki shnong .

en: And he called him , and said unto him , How is it that I hear this of thee ? give an account of thy stewardship  ; for thou mayest be no longer steward .
kha: kumta u la khot shapoh ïa u bad u la ong , ‘ Kaei kane kaba nga ïohsngew shaphang jong me ? To ai ha nga ïa ka jingkheiñ kaba pura ïa ka jingpynïaid jong me ïa ka jingdon jingem jong nga , namar men ym lah shuh ban long u sordar jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia u bad u la ong ha u, Kumno nga iohsngew ia kane na me ? ai jingkhein ia ka jingsumar jong me; namar me lah ban long shuh u nongap .

en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .
kha: kumta u thang jingkñia da ki mrad bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u theh ïa ka jingainguh waiñ bad ka snam jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thang ia ka jingainguh thang jong u bad ka jingainguh bam jong u, bad u la theh ia ka jingainguh dih jong u, bad u la theh ia ka snam jong ki jingainguh jingsuk jong u, halor ka almari .

en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .
kha: Nangta kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki ,  To wan kiew shane !  Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang khmih , ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba khraw na bneng kaba ong ha ki, To wan shaneng hangne . Ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh ; bad ki nongshun jong ki ki la iohi ia ki .

en: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand , Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth , that I may lean upon them .
kha: U Samson u ong ïa u khynnah uba btin ïa u na ka kti ,  Ai ba ngan ktah ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa kane ka ïing . Nga kwah ban shaniah ha ki !
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la ong ha uta u samla uba bat ia u da ka kti, To ai ia nga ba ngan sngew ia ki maw ha kaba ka iing ka ieng, ba ngan shaniah ha ki .

en: BREAKING NEWS : The feature Breaking News on the jw . org website provides quick , brief updates to Jehovahs people on major events happening worldwide .
kha: BREAKING NEWS : Ka bynta jong ka Breaking News kaba don ha ka jw . org website ka ai jingtip ba stet bad ba lyngkot sha ki briew jong U Jehobah shaphang ki jingjia ba kongsan kiba jia ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: KA JINGPYNBNA: Ka jingpynkylla ia ki khubor ha ka jw . ka website ka ai ki jingpynkylla kiba stet bad kiba lyngkot sha ki briew jong ka Jehobah shaphang ki jingjia kiba kongsan kiba jia ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

en: And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .
kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ?  ki la ïakylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab ,  Ki la rah noh ïa U Trai jong nga , bad ngam tip shano ki la buh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ong ia ka, Ko kynthei, balei me iam ? Ka ong ha ki , Namar ki la shim noh ia U Trai jong nga , bad ngam tip shano ki la buh ia u .

en: But God led the people about , through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea : and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki da ka lynti kyllaiñ lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba poi sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ki Israel ki long kiba la kieng atiar ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ialam ia ki briew shaphang ka ri Ijipt: bad ki khun Israel ki la leit sha jrong na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :
kha: Ban weng ïa ka jingbymkhuid , shim khyndiat u dpei na kata ka masi rong saw ïa kaba la thang ban weng noh ïa ka pop bad buh ïa ka ha u khiew , bad theh hangta ïa ka um ba dang shu wan tong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta u briew u bymkhuid kin shim ia ka dewbilat jong ka masi ba la thang na ka bynta ka pop , bad ka um kaba tuid yn buh hangta ha ka umphniang:

en: And then shall that Wicked be revealed , whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth , and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming :
kha: Te ïa Uta u Basniew yn sa pynpaw , hynrei haba U Trai Jisu u wan , Un pynïap ïa u da ka jingpynhiar mynsiem na ka shyntur jong U bad pynjot ïa u da ka jingthaba ka jingdon ryngkat jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta yn sa pynpaw ia uta u Nongleh bymman, ia uba U Trai un bam da ka mynsiem jong ka shyntur jong u, bad un pynjot da ka jingshai jong ka jingwan jong u:

en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .
kha: kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ki ri Gad bad Gilead . U Saul u dang don ha Gilgal , bad ki briew kiba bad u ki la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Hebru ki la leit sha ka ri Gad bad Gilead . Katba u Saul u dang don ha Gilgal bad ki briew baroh ki la bud ia u da kaba khih .

en: But the  Lord  said unto me , Say not , I am a child : for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee , and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha nga ,  Wat ong ba me dang khynnah eh , hynrei khie leit sha ki briew kiba nga phah ïa me , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la ong ha nga, Wat ong, nga long u khynnah: namar me leit sha baroh kaba ngan phah ia me, bad kaei kaei kaba nga hukum ia me to kren .

en: For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynshoh samthiah ïa phi , bad phi sdang ban ngat ha ka jingïohthiah kaba jur . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki dei ban long ki khmat jong ki briew , hynrei U Blei u la pynmatlah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la theh ia ka mynsiem kaba jylliew ha phi: ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki nongsynshar jong phi , ki nongpeitkai u la tap .

en: There is nothing from without a man , that entering into him can defile him : but the things which come out of him , those are they that defile the man .
kha: Ym don kano kano kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba lah ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u kat kum ka jinglehniam . Pynban , ka long kaei kaba mih shabar na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ei ei na u briew uba rung ha u: hynrei kiei kiei kiba mih na u , kita ki long kiba pynjakhlia ia u briew .

en: Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .
kha: Ngan kyntait ïa ki ri baroh ban pynim ïa ka jingim jong phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba nga ieit ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me la long uba kordor ha ka khmat jong nga, me la long uba donburom bad nga la ieit ia me: namarkata ngan ai ia ki briew na ka bynta jong me bad ki briew na ka bynta ka jingim jong me .

en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .
kha: Judah , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Judah ma me, ma me uba ki hynmen jong me kin iaroh: ka kti jong me kan long ha ka ryndang jong ki nongshun jong me; ki khun jong me kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me .

en: Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .
kha: Ko Patsha ka Assyria , ki lat jong me ki la ïap , bad ki rangbah donburom jong me ki ïohthiah junom ! Ïa ki briew jong me la pynsakma halor ki lumbah , bad ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam pat ïa ki sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong me ki thiah , ko syiem Assyria: ki riew rangbah jong me kin shong ha ka dewbilat: ki briew jong me ki la bthei ha ki lum , bad ym don ba lum ia ki .

en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,
kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba don jingduna ha ka met ban ai ïa kata ka jingkñia : kum uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la sniew ka durkhmat , lane uba la thawsha ka met ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno u briew uba don ka jingduna, un ym leit shajan: u briew uba matlah ne uba lyngkhuid ne uba don ka shyntur kaba jem ne kaei kaei kaba palat .

en: Behold now , this city is near to flee unto , and it is a little one : Oh , let me escape thither , ( is it not a little one ? ) and my soul shall live .
kha: Phi ïohi ïa katai ka nongrit ? Katai te ka kham jan . Shah ngan leit shata — phi ïohi ïa ka ba ka long tang ka nongrit — bad ngan ïohlait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta, kane ka shnong ka la jan phet noh sha ka: Oh, to ngan lait noh nangta, (hato kam dei tang khyndiat ? ) bad ka mynsiem jong nga kan im .

en: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land , a sabbath for the  Lord  : thou shalt neither sow thy field , nor prune thy vineyard .
kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew dei ban shu ieh ïa ka khyndew khlem rep , namar ka long ka snem ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ; wat bet ha ki lyngkha jong phi ne khyllad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynriew kan long ka jaka shongthait ha ka ri, ka jaka shongthait na ka bynta U Trai: wat bet ia ka lyngkha jong me , lymne wat ot ia ka kper sohjew jong me .

en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake : and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .
kha: Namar jong ka , u syiem u la lehbha ïa u Abram bad u la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad ki blang , ki masi , ki kada , ki mraw bad ki ut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sngewbha ia u Abram na ka bynta jong ka: bad u don ki langbrot bad ki masi, bad u ju sngewthuh ia ki mrad bad ki mrad bad ki mrad ba im ha ka met bad ki kulai .

en: And David said unto Nathan , I have sinned against the  Lord . And Nathan said unto David , The  Lord  also hath put away thy sin  ; thou shalt not die .
kha: Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ,  U Dabid u la ong . U Nathan u jubab ,  U  Trai  u map ïa phi ; phin ym ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Nathan , Nga la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai . U Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid , U Trai ruh u la weng noh ia ka pop jong me; me wat iap .

en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .
kha: Man ba u lyngkhot khiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim ïa ka dewbyrtha bad pynwandur ïa ka sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lieng kaba u la shna da ka dewbilat ka la tyrkhong ha ka kti jong u nongtied: kumta u la shna biang ia ka sa kawei pat ka lieng, kumba ka long kaba bha ia u nongtied ban shna ia ka .

en: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .
kha: Bad hadien kata ki la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ! Ka long ka bym lah long ban ïalam pat ïa ki ban kylla-kaba-mut biang , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U Blei bad pynlehrain ïa u ha khmat ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kin hap noh , ban pynthymmai biang ia ki sha ka jingkylla kaba mut; haba ki iohi ba ki sahnarphna thymmai ia U Khun U Blei, bad ki buh ia u ha ka jingsngewlehrain kaba paw .

en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .
kha: Kiar ïa baroh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba bha ba me shim ia kane ka ; hooid, ruh na kane wat weng noh ia ka kti jong me: namar uta uba sheptieng ia U Blei un mih na ki baroh .

en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .
kha: ban ym shah pynshaïong jingmut da kaba suk ha ka jingpyrkhat jong phi lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka jingkam ba ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la lah wan . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa kane katba ngi dang ïathuhlypa lane ïalap , lane ba ngi la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin ym shah pynkhih kloi ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat, ne shah pynshitom, ym da ka mynsiem ne da ka ktien ne da ka shithi kumba na ngi, kumba ka sngi U Khrist ka la jan .

en: And the men of the city went out , and fought with Joab : and there fell some of the people of the servants of David  ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .
kha: Ki kynhun nongshun ki la wan mih na ka nongbah bad ki la ïaleh ïa ki kynhun jong u Joab ; katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Dabid ki la shah pynïap , bad kumta ruh ka la long ïa u Uriah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka shnong ki la mih noh bad ki la ialeh bad u Joab : bad ki la hap katto katne na ki briew jong u Dabid ; bad u Urih u Hit ruh u la iap .

en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .
kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shym shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jahas , bad u tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shaniah ha ki Israel ban iaid lyngba ka rud duriaw jong u: hynrei u Sihon u la lum lang ia ki briew jong u baroh, bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Edom ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki duk jong ka Edom kin lyngngoh ; ki riewshlur jong ka ri Moab , ki khih kin bat ia ki ; ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Kanaan baroh kin jah noh .

en: I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .
kha: Hynrei nga dang sngew shaniah ïa phi . Ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , ka pynlong ïa nga ban sngewskhem ba phin ym shim da kumwei pat bad uta u briew uba pynkulmar ïa phi , la u long uei uei , un shah pynshitom ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga don ka jingshaniah ha phi lyngba U Trai, ba phin ym long kumta: hynrei uta uba pynshitom ia phi un kit ia ka jingbishar jong u, uno uno uba long .

en: The anger of the  Lord  hath divided them  ; he will no more regard them : they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .
kha: U  Trai  um shym la don shuh ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki ; u la pynsakma ïa ki da lade hi . Um shym pyn-i jingñiewkor ei ei ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la phiah ia ki ; un ym khein shuh ia ki: kim shym la burom ia ki briew jong ki lyngdoh , kim shym la kyrshan ia ki rangbah .

en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .
kha: hynrei ki jingpynkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , bad baroh kiwei ki jait jingkwah ki tap bad kjap noh ïa ka khubor , bad kim seisoh satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka pyrthei, bad ka jingleh thok jong ki spah bad ki jingsngewtynnat jong kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba rung shapoh, ki pynkhih ia ka ktien , bad ka kylla long kaba khlem soh .

en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle , and fastened his sockets , and set up the boards thereof , and put in the bars thereof , and reared up his pillars .
kha: Ha kaba pynïeng ïa ka , u Moses u pynskhem ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka , u pynïeng ïa ki jingker jong ka , u pyndait ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , bad u pynïeng ïa ki rishot jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynsan ia ka ïingjahthait bad u la pynskhem ïa ki socks jong u bad u la buh ïa ki board jong ka bad u la buh ha ki bar jong ka bad u la pynsan ia ki maw jong u .

en: He also exalteth the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints  ; even of the children of Israel , a people near unto him . Praise ye the  Lord .
kha: U pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ , ba kumta baroh ki briew jong u ki ïaroh ïa u — ki paid Israel , kiba u ieit eh . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkhraw ruh ia ka horn jong ki briew jong u, ka jingiaroh ia ki riewkhuid jong u baroh wat na ki khun Israel , ki briew kiba hajan jong u . Iaroh ia U Trai .

en: Now therefore ye are cursed , and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen , and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God .
kha: Namar ba phi leh kumne , U Blei u la pynrem ïa phi . Ki briew jong phi kin ïailong ki mraw , kiba thoh dieng bad kiba kit um ïa ka jaka kyntang U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la tim ia phi , bad ym don uwei ruh na phi uba lait na ka jinglong mraw , bad ki dieng bad ki um na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong nga .

en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .
kha: Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong ngi , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong phi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba tip namarkata ia ka jingtieng U Trai , ngi pynsngewthuh ia ki briew ; hynrei ngi la paw ha U Blei ; bad nga shaniah ruh ba la pynpaw ha ki jingsngew jong phi .

en: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim , whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong syiem ïa u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Josaïah u syiem ka Judah , ha ka jaka u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Sedekaiah u khun u Josiah u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u Koniah u khun u Jehoiakim , ia uba u Neuchzzar u syiem Babilon u la long syiem ha ka ri Judah .

en: And even to your old age I am he  ; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you : I have made , and I will bear  ; even I will carry , and will deliver you .
kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi haduh ba phin da tymmen bad ba u shñiuh jong phi u la lieh . Nga la thaw ïa phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi ; Ngan ai jingïarap ïa phi bad ngan pyllait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat haduh ka rta kaba la tymmen jong phi nga long ma nga bad wat ban pynkhih ia phi: nga la pynlong, bad ngan shah ia phi; bad ngan pynpoi ia phi .

en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .
kha: U un long u nongpynkren lem jong me bad un kren ha u paidbah na ka bynta jong me . Nangta me pat men long kum U Blei , da kaba ïathuh ha u aïu un ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un long u nongkren jong me ha ki briew: bad un long, wat ma u ruh ha me ha ka jaka jong ka shyntur, bad me ha u ha ka jaka jong U Blei .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
kha: Kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew uba matlah u la jubab ,  Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, Kaei kaba me kwah ba ngan leh ia me ? Uta u briew uba matlah u la ong ha u , ko Trai, ba ngan ioh ia ka jingpeit jong nga .

en: And Rabshakeh said unto them , Say ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ha ki ba u Patsha u kwah tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rabsakeh u la ong ha ki, To ong mynta ha u Hesekaiah , Kumta u syiem uba khraw , u syiem Assyria , Kaei ka jingshaniah ha kaba me shaniah ?

en: Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .
kha: Ong ha u Aaron , ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha u Aaron da kaba ong , Uno uno na u symbai jong me ha ki pateng jong ki uba don kano kano ka jingduna , wat ai ba un wan shajan ban aiti ia u kpu U Blei jong u .

en: Then went king David in , and sat before the  Lord  , and he said , Who am I , O Lord  God  ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?
kha: Nangta u Syiem Dabid u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngam long uba bit ïa kaei kaba me la leh na ka bynta jong nga lymne wat ka longïing jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Dabid u la leit rung shapoh bad u la shong ha khmat U Trai bad u la ong: Nga long mano ko Trai Blei ? bad kaei ka iing jong nga kaba me la wanrah ia nga haduh mynta ?

en: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren , What is your occupation ? And they said unto Pharaoh , Thy servants are shepherds , both we , and also our fathers .
kha: U syiem u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi trei phi ktah aïu ?   Kynrad , ngi dei ki nongap langbrot , kumba ju long ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, Kaei ka kam jong phi ? Ki la ong ha u Pharaoh , Ki shakri jong me ki long ki nongap langbrot , ngi bad ruh ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
kha: uwei ha kawei ka tduh bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka jingtap , bad pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait lang bad kata ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynlong ia kawei ka cherub ha kawei ka tduh: wat na ka jaka shong pop ruh phin pynlong ia ki cherub ha ki arliang jong ka .

en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah , What shall be the sign that the  Lord  will heal me , and that I shall go up into the house of the  Lord  the third day ?
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba U  Trai  un pynkhiah ïa nga bad ba hadien lai sngi ngan sa lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la ong ha Isaiah , Kaei ka dak ba U Trai un pynkoit ia nga bad ba ngan leit sha ka iing U Trai ha ka sngi kaba lai ?

en: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city , then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold  ; within a full year may he redeem it .
kha: Lada u briew u die ïa ka ïing ha ka shnong ba la ker kynroh , u don hok ban thied pat ïa ka hapoh shisnem naduh ka sngi ba u la die ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u die ia ka iing sah ha ka shnong kaba la ker kynroh , te u lah ban siew kylliang ia ka hapoh shisnem hadien ba la die ia ka ; hapoh shisnem u lah ban siew kylliang ia ka .

en: But they that escape of them shall escape , and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys , all of them mourning , every one for his iniquity .
kha: Ki don ki ban phet ïap sha ki lumbah kumba ki lyngdkhur kiba sheptieng na ki jaka them . Baroh na ki kin ïam sngewsih namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kito kiba lait na ki kin lait im, bad kin long ha ki lum kum ki paro jong ki them, baroh ki iam , uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingbymhok jong u .

en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .
kha: U  Trai  da lade hi un ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn sa lute da ki briew kiba shisien ki la long ki shakri jong phi .  Haba kane ka jia , uwei uwei baroh un tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong ki, bad kin long ka jinglute ia ki shakri jong ki: bad phin sa tip ba U Trai jong ki paid u la phah ia nga .

en: And God said , This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you , for perpetual generations :
kha: Kum ka dak jong kata ka jutang baïaineh junom ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad phi lem bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , nga buh ïa ka ryntieh jong nga ha u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la ong , Kane ka long ka dak jong ka jutang kaba nga pynlong hapdeng jong nga bad phi bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba im uba don bad phi, na ka bynta ki pateng bymjukut:

en: But if ye turn away , and forsake my statutes and my commandments , which I have set before you , and shall go and serve other gods , and worship them  ;
kha: Hynrei lada ma me bad ki briew jong me kin ym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , bad phi mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi phai noh bad iehnoh ia ki ain bad ki hukum jong nga kiba nga la buh ha khmat jong phi, bad phin leit shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, bad phin mane ia ki ;

en: When thou comest into thy neighbour s vineyard , then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure  ; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel .
kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka bri sohwaiñ jongno jongno , phi lah ban bam sohwaiñ katba phi kwah , hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa ki ha la ka jingdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me wan sha ka kper sohjew jong u paramarjan jong me, te me lah ban bam ia ki sohjew jong me ha ka jingsngewbha jong me hi; hynrei wat buh ei ei ha ka umphniang jong me .

en: The language this text is in , as an ISO code . Pango can use this as a hint when rendering the text . If not set , an appropriate default will be used .
kha: Ka ktien kaba kane ka jingthoh ka don , kum u ISO code . Ka Pango ka lah ban pyndonkam ia kane kum ka jingai jingmut haba pynkylla ia ka jingthoh . Lada ym set , yn pyndonkam ia ka default kaba iadei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kane ka jingthoh ka don ha ka , kum ka ISO code . Ka Pango ka lah ban pyndonkam ia kane kum ka jingpynpaw haba pynmih ia ka jingthoh . Lada ym shym la buh , yn pyndonkam ia ka jingbym biang kaba biang .

en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar s , and to God the things that are God s .  And they marvelled at him .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Te kumta , siew sha u patsha ïa kaei kaba long ka jong u patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba long ka jong U Blei .  Bad ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki, To ai ha u Kaisar ia kiei kiei kiba long u Kaisar bad ha U Blei ia kiei kiei kiba long U Blei . Ki la ia lyngngoh ia u .

en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred , and evil entreated our fathers , so that they cast out their young children , to the end they might not live .
kha: U la shukor ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la long uba shyrkhei ïa ki , da kaba pynbor ïa ki ban bret ïa ki khunlung jong ki na ki longïing jong ki , khnang ba kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kajuh ka la iadei bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, bad ka jingsniew ka la pynkhih ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, haduh ba kin da bret noh ia ki khun rit jong ki, haduh kaba kut ki lah ban ym im .

en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou be kind to this people , and please them , and speak good words to them , they will be thy servants for ever .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Lada phi lehsbun ïa kine ki briew bad phi pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki , da kaba ai ka jubab kaba jem kin shakri hok ïa phi borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ia u, ki da ong: Lada me sngewbha ia une u briew bad me sngewbha ia ki bad kren ia ki da ki ktien kiba bha ha ki , kin long ki shakri jong me junom .

en: They shall take up serpents  ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them  ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .
kha: lada ki shim ïa ki bseiñ lane dih kano kano ka bih , kin ym mynsaw ; kin buh ïa la ki kti ha kiba pang , ki ban ïoh ka jingkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin shim ia ki bsein ; bad lada ki dih ia kaei kaei kaba pyniap briew, kan ym pynmong ia ki ; kin buh kti ia kiba pang bad kin koit .

en: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee , saying , This is the way , walk ye in it , when ye turn to the right hand , and when ye turn to the left .
kha: Lada phi sakma noh na ka lynti sha kamon ne sha kadiang , phin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u hadien jong phi kaba ong ,  Kane ka dei ka lynti . Bud ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shkor jong me kin iohsngew ia ka ktien hadien jong me, da kaba ong: Kane ka long ka lynti , phi iaid ha ka , haba phi phai sha ka liang kadiang bad haba phi phai sha ka liang kadiang .

en: Beginning from the baptism of John , unto that same day that he was taken up from us , must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection .
kha: Kumta te , uwei pat u dei ban ïasoh bad ngi kum u sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong u Trai Jisu . U dei ban long uwei na ki rangbah uba don hapoh ka kynhun jong ngi ha ka por baroh ba U Trai Jisu u dang leit kylleng bad ngi , da kaba sdang naduh ka por ba u Ïoannis u ïalap ïa ka khubor ka jingpynbaptis haduh ka sngi ba ïa U Jisu la shim noh sha bneng na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Sdang naduh ka jingpynbaptis u loannis, haduh kata kajuh ka sngi ba la shim noh ia u na ngi , dei ban long uwei uba la buh ban long u sakhi bad ngi shaphang ka jingmihpat jong u .

en: Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .
kha: To ong ha ki jaitbynriew baroh ,  U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: To ong hapdeng ki nongwei ba U Trai u synshar: ka pyrthei ruh kan long kaba skhem ba kan ym khih: un bishar hok ia ki briew .

en: Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .
kha: Hangta ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh ïa U  Trai . U ong  A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me junom la junom !
