translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Dabid u la kyrkhu ia U Trai ha khmat ka jingiaseng baroh: bad u Dabid u la ong: To long uba la kyrkhu ia me, ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel jong ngi, junom .

en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :
kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad ïa kata ka umphniang Olib bad un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia u khun langbrot jong ka jingainguh kaba la tyrkhong bad ka umphniang bad u lyngdoh un pynkhih ia ki na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba la tyrkhong ha khmat U Trai:

en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him : and he was perplexed , because that it was said of some , that John was risen from the dead  ;
kha: Haba u Herod , u nongsynshar ka Galilaïa , u la ïohsngew shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , u la kulmar jingmut , namar katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Herod u la iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh da u: bad u la sngew lyngngoh namar ba la ong shaphang uwei , ba u loannis u la mihpat na kiba iap;

en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .
kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym lah ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses um lah ban rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang , namar u lyoh u la shong ha kata ka jaka , bad ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ïa ka ïingjaiñ .

en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki parabangeit na Kaisaria ruh ki la ïaleit bad ngi bad ki la ïalam ïa ngi sha ka ïing jong u briew ha kaba ngin sah — u Mnason , uba na Sypros , uba la long u parabangeit naduh ki sngi kiba dang sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta la leit bad ngi ruh katto katne na ki synran jong ka ri Kaisaria, bad la wanrah bad ki ia uwei u Mnason jong ka Cyprus , u synran barim , bad uba ngi dei ban sah .

en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea , they came thither also , and stirred up the people .
kha: Hynrei haba ki Jiw ha Thessaloni ki la ïohsngew ba u Paul u la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei ha Beria ruh , ki la ïawan shata bad ki la sdang ban pynkhih bad pynkulmar ïa u paidbhur .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Jiw jong ka Thessaloni ki la tip ba la ialap ia ka ktien U Blei na u Paul ha Berea , ki la wan shata ruh bad ki la pynkhih ia ki briew .

en: And it came to pass , when I heard these words , that I sat down and wept , and mourned certain days , and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,
kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , nga shong bad nga ïam . Bun sngi nga la sngewsih bad ngam shym bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba nga la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien , ba nga la shong bad nga la iam bad nga la iam katto katne sngi bad nga la shah jingit bad nga la duwai ha khmat U Blei jong ka bneng .

en: Yea , truth faileth  ; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey : and the  Lord  saw it , and it displeased him that there was no judgment .
kha: Ka jinglonghok ka la nang duna katta katta ba uno uno uba kiar na kaba leh bymman u shem ïa lade ba u long u lanot jong ka kam runar .  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , bad ka la pynsngewsih ïa u ba ym don shuh ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ka jingshisha ka la jah noh bad uta uba phet noh na ka jingsniew u pynlong ia lade u nongshah lehbein: bad U Trai u la iohi ia ka, bad ka la pynsngewsih ia u ba ym shym la don ka jingbishar .

en: For whosoever hath , to him shall be given , and he shall have more abundance : but whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken away even that he hath .
kha: Naba ha u briew uba don ei ei yn nang ai shuh shuh , khnang ba un ïoh kham bun ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kaba rit tam kaba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba don , ha u yn ai kham bun: hynrei uno uno u bym don , na u yn weng noh wat ia kata ruh .

en: And it came to pass , when the angel of the  Lord  spake these words unto all the children of Israel , that the people lifted up their voice , and wept .
kha: Haba u angel u la kren ïa kane , ki paid Israel baroh ki la sdang ban ïam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u angel U Trai u la kren ia kine ki ktien ha ki khun Israel baroh , ba ki briew ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki bad ki la iam .

en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .
kha: Ki skain kiba ïap ki lah ban pyniwtung ïa baroh ka jingiwbih hapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingmutlop ka lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingstad kaba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai kiba la iap ki pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid ia ka sniehdoh ban phah ia ka jingsma kaba jem: kumta u leh khyndiat ia uta uba don ha ka nam na ka bynta ka jingstad bad ka burom .

en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .
kha: Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . To ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan long ka jong ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki nongrep ki la iohi ia u, ki la ia pyrkhat hapdeng jong ki, ki da ong: Une u long u nongioh pateng: to ngin pyniap ia u, ba ka pateng kan long ka jong ngi .

en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be come to the land which the  Lord  will give you , according as he hath promised , that ye shall keep this service .
kha: Haba phi rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha phi , phi dei ban leh ïa kane ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ynda phi la poi ha ka ri kaba U Trai un ai ha phi kumba u la kular , ba phin sumar ia kane ka jingshakri .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Omri u la leh bad baroh ki jingjop jong u la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Omri kiba u la leh bad ka bor jong u kaba u la pyni , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea , and they of Jerusalem , and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan , confessing their sins .
kha: Bun ki briew na ka probins    jong ka Judia bad ka nongbah Jerusalem ki la leit ban ïohsngew ïa u Ïoannis . Ki la phla ïa la ki pop , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit sha u baroh kawei ka ri Judaea bad ki jong ka Jerusalem bad baroh ki la shah pynbaptis na u ha ka wah Jordan .

en: And the residue of the number of archers , the mighty men of the children of Kedar , shall be diminished : for the  Lord  God of Israel hath spoken it .
kha: Ki  rang bahryntieh ki long ki rangbah kiba shlur tam jong ka Kedar , hynrei tang khyndiat na ki yn iehnoh , nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsah jong ki nongsiat khnam, ki riewshlur jong ki khun Kdar, kan sa duna: namar U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la kren ia kata .

en: The portion of Jacob is not like them  ; for he is the former of all things : and Israel is the rod of his inheritance : the  Lord  of hosts is his name .
kha: U Blei u Jakob um long kum ma ki ; dei tang ma u uba la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad u la jied ïa ki Israel ban long ki briew jong u hi . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta jong u Jakob kam long kum ma ki ; namar u long uba nyngkong eh na kiei kiei baroh: bad ki Israel ki long u diengduh jong ka pateng jong u: U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .
kha: Haba ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shu knieh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu shim ïa ki . Ym don ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem jongno jongno kaba shongshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki thrang ia ki lyngkha, bad ki shim ia ki da ka jingleh donbor ; bad ki iing: kumta ki pynshitom bein ia u briew bad ka iing jong u, wat ia u briew bad ka pateng jong u ruh .

en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai na ka jaitbynriew Judah bad na ka jaitbynriew u Simeon , kine ki shnong kiba la kdew hangne da ka kyrteng .

en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .
kha: Kito kiba ap phira ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka jingkmen ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan jong U  Trai  sha Seïon !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap jong me kin pynkiew ia ka sur ; da ka sur ryngkat kin rwai: namar kin sa iohi khmat ha khmat , haba U Trai un wanrah biang ia ka Seion .

en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it : for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .
kha: ( Pynban , Ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don ha Jerusalem , la buh ïa ka ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Syiem Dabid u la pynïeng mynba u wanrah ïa Ka Synduk na Kiriath Jearim . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka synduk U Blei ka la wanrah ia u Dabid na Kirjathjaram sha ka jaka kaba u Dabid u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ka: namar u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ na ka bynta jong ka ha Jerusalem .

en: Because he hath despised the word of the  Lord  , and hath broken his commandment , that soul shall utterly be cut off  ; his iniquity shall be upon him .
kha: namar ki la kyntait ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la ong bad ba ki la pynkheiñ khnang ïa kawei na ki hukum jong u . Kin kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u la leh bein ia ka ktien U Trai bad u la pynkhein ia ka hukum jong u, kata ka mynsiem kan sa shah ot noh shi syndon; ka jingbymhok jong u kan long halor jong u .

en: From the very beginning , upazila health officer Mohammad Jabed , resident medical officer Rajib Dey and other physicians in the hospital encouraged him .
kha: Naduh kaba sdang u ophisar ka tnat ka koit ka khiah jong ka upazila u Mohammad Jabed , u resident medical ophisar u Rajib Dey bad kiwei kiwei ki doktor ha katei ka hospital ki la ai mynsiem ia u .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh kaba sdang, u ophisar ka koit ka khiah jong ka Upazil u Mohammad Jabed , u ophisar ka koit ka khiah u Rajib Dey bad kiwei kiwei ki doktor ha hospital ki la pynshlur ia u .

en: And in the vine were three branches : and it was as though it budded , and her blossoms shot forth  ; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes :
kha: Mar ïasdang mih sla , ki syntiew ki la mih , bad ki sohwaiñ ki la ih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u sohjew ki don lai tylli ki tnat: bad ka la long kumba ka la bthei, bad ki syntiew jong ka ki la mih ; bad ki kynhun jong ka ki la pynmih ia ki sohjew kiba la san bha:

en: Then said Boaz unto Ruth , Hearest thou not , my daughter ? Go not to glean in another field , neither go from hence , but abide here fast by my maidens :
kha: Nangta u Boas u ong ha ka Ruth ,  Shah ngan ai jingmut katto katne ïa phi . Wat leit tam kew shawei pat lait tang ha kane ka lyngkha . Trei para kynthei hangne ;
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Boaz u la ong ha ka Ruth, Hato phim sngap, ko khun jong nga ? Wat leit lum ha kawei pat ka lyngkha, wat leit noh nangta, hynrei to sah hangne da ki shakri jong nga:

en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,
kha: Shahshkor ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi ïaleit kiew sha Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngi leit sha Jerusalem ; bad ia u Khun u briew yn die noh ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki nongthoh bad kin pynrem ia u haduh ka jingiap .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad ki paid Israel bad Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , ba ngan leh ia kata ka kam kaba bha kaba nga la kular ha ka iing Israel bad ha ka iing Judah .

en: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  seven days : in the seventh day is an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam jong phi sha U  Trai  baroh hynñiew sngi . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew phin ïalumlang biang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai hynriew sngi: ha ka sngi kaba hynriew ka long ka jingpynlong kaba khuid: phin ym leh ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba isih ïa la u hynmen u para u don ha ka jingdum ; u ïaid ha ka bad um tip shano u leit , namar ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba shun ia la u hynmen u don ha ka jingdum bad u iaid ha ka jingdum bad um tip shano u leit, namar kata ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ia ki khmat jong u .

en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months . And the  Lord  blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that he had .
kha: Ka don hangta haduh lai bnai , bad U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa ka longïing u Obed Edom bad baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka synduk U Blei ka la sah bad ka iing u Obededom ha iing jong u lai bnai . Bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ka iing u Obededom bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .

en: And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;
kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki thung jingthung , ki Midian , ki wan bad ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ka la long, haba ki Israel ki la bet, ba ki Midian ki la wan shaneng, bad ki Amalek bad ki khun shatei lam mihngi, wat ki la wan shaneng pyrshah ia ki ; .

en: And they took them wives of the women of Moab  ; the name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other Ruth : and they dwelled there about ten years .
kha: kiba la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei Moab , ka Orpah bad ka Ruth . Kumba shiphew snem hadien ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki tnga jong ki kynthei Moab; ka kyrteng jong uta ka long ka Orpah bad ka kyrteng jong kawei pat ka Ruth : bad ki la shong hangta kumba shi snem .

en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith , Abraham believed God , and it was imputed unto him for righteousness : and he was called the Friend of God .
kha: Bad ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid la pynshisha haba ka la ong ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei ; bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .  Bad kumta ïa u Abraham la khot u paralok jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pyndep ia ka jingthoh kaba ong, U Abraham u la ngeit ia U Blei, bad la pynngat ia u na ka bynta ka hok: bad la khot ia u u Paralok U Blei .

en: And they cried with a loud voice , saying , How long , O Lord , holy and true , dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth ?
kha: Ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Trai Badonbor Baroh , u bakhuid bad uba shisha ! Sa katno kan long haduh ba men da bishar ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei bad pynshitom ïa ki namar ba ki pynïap ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, ki da ong: Katno por ko Trai, ko bakhuid bad ba shisha, em ?

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .
kha: Nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha : U symboh kew u ïaisah hi tang shi symboh lymda la pynhap ïa u ha ka khyndew bad u ïap . Lada u da ïap , te u sei shibun ki sohkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Lait noh tang u kew u hap ha ka khyndew bad u iap , u im marwei: hynrei lada u iap , u pynmih bun ki soh .

en: And he knew their desolate palaces , and he laid waste their cities  ; and the land was desolate , and the fulness thereof , by the noise of his roaring .
kha: U la pynjot ïa ki kut , u la pynpra ïa ki shnong . Ki briew jong ka ri ki la sngewshyrkhei man ka por ba u kyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tip ia ki iing syiem jong ki kiba la jot , bad u la pynjot ia ki nongbah jong ki ; bad ka ri ka la jot , bad ka jingdap jong ka , da ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa jong u .

en: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house . After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah , the keeper of the east gate .
kha: U Sadok , u khun jong u Immer , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u . U Shemaïah , u khun jong u Shekanaïah , u nongpeit ïa ka Khyrdop Mihngi , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong ki ki la pynbha ia u Zadok u khun jong u Immer pyrshah ia ka iing jong u . Hadien jong u u la pynbha ruh ia u Shemaiah u khun u Shechaniah .

en: That Christ should suffer , and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead , and should shew light unto the people , and to the Gentiles .
kha: ba U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad ban long uba nyngkong ban mihpat na ka jingïap , ban pynbna ïa ka jingshai jong ka jingpynim ha ki Jiw bad ha ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Khrist un shah shitom bad ba un long uba nyngkong eh uba dei ban mihpat na kiba iap bad un pynpaw ia ka jingshai ha ki briew bad ha ki Jutang .

en: Is there iniquity in Gilead ? surely they are vanity : they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal  ; yea , their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields .
kha: La katta ruh ki dang mane ïa ki bleithaw ha Gilead , bad kito kiba mane ïa ki kin ïap . Ha Gilgal ki kñia ïa ki masi kyrtong , bad ki duwan hangta kin kylla long kum ki kynton maw ha ki pyntha bym don jingkah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka don ka jingbymhok ha Gilead ? shisha ki long kiba sniew: ki knia ia ki masi ha Gilgal ; yea , ki nongleh jong ki ki long kum ki lum ha ki thliew jong ki lyngkha .

en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang jam ha U  Trai  , ki da ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , namar ngi la iehnoh ïa me , U Blei jong ngi , bad ngi la mane ïa ki Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai, ki da ong: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia me, namar ngi la iehnoh ia U Blei jong ngi bad ngi la shakri ruh ia u Baal .

en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .
kha: Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jong ki shipai jong phi , tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , bad knieh ïa ka da lade hi . Ngam kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to lum lang ia ki briew kiba sah, bad to shim ia ka: ioh ba ngan shim ia ka shnong bad yn khot ia ka katkum ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: He shall break also the images of Beth–shemesh , that is in the land of Egypt  ; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire .
kha: Un pynjot ïa ki maw jingteinam bakyntang ha Heliopolis kaba ha Ijipt bad un thang ïa ki templ jong ki blei ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynpra ruh ia ki dur jong u Bethshesh , kiba don ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki iing jong ki blei Ijipt un thang da ka ding .

en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?
kha: Hynrei haba ki la lah khum ïa u ban sympat , u Paul u la ong ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïeng hangta ,  Hato ka shong aiñ ïa me ban sympat ïa u traishnong ka Hima Rom u bym shym la shah bishar na ka bynta kano kano ka kam runar ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang teh ia u da ki thnam , u Paul u la ong ha u rangbah shipai uba la ieng hajan , Hato ka long kaba dei ia phi ban sngap jar ia u briew uba long u Roman bad u bym shah pynrem ?

en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation , and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan , and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .
kha: Ngan pynphai pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ka ri jong ki . Kin bam ïa ka jingbam kaba mih ha u lum Karmel bad ha ki phang ka Bashan , bad kin bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah na ki jingthung kiba mih ha ki jaka jong ki Ephraim bad Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah biang ia ki Israel sha ka jaka shong jaka sah jong u, bad un bam ia u Karmel bad u Basan, bad ka mynsiem jong u kan sa sngewhun ha u lum Ephraim bad u Gilead .

en: And the priest shall take one he lamb , and offer him for a trespass offering , and the log of oil , and wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :
kha: Nangta un shim ïa uwei na ki khunlangbrot shynrang , ryngkat bad ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang , bad un ai kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingleh palat . Un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba kham kyrpang ha U  Trai  na ka bynta u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un shim ia uwei u langbrot bad un aiti ia u na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba sniew bad ka umphniang , bad un pynkhih ia ki na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai:

en: Therefore the law is slacked , and judgment doth never go forth : for the wicked doth compass about the righteous  ; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth .
kha: Ka aiñ ka tlot bad kam myntoi ei ei , bad ym ju don ka jingbishar hok . Ki briew kiba sniew ki ïoh ïa kaba kham bha ban ïa kiba hok , bad kumta ïa ka jingbishar hok la pynjngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka hukum ka la jah noh, bad ka jingbishar kam ju leit sha khmat: namar ki bymman ki iaid shaphang kiba hok ; namarkata ka jingbishar kaba bakla ka iaid shakhmat .

en: And the  Lord  said to Samuel , Hearken unto their voice , and make them a king . And Samuel said unto the men of Israel , Go ye every man unto his city .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , bad ai syiem noh ïa ki .  Nangta u Samuel u ong ïa ki rangbah Israel baroh ban leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Samuel , To sngap ia ka sur jong ki bad to pynlong syiem ia ki . U Samuel u la ong ha ki Israel: To leit noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka shnong .

en: And the liers in wait hasted , and rushed upon Gibeah  ; and the liers in wait drew themselves along , and smote all the city with the edge of the sword .
kha: Kine ki rangbah ki mareh kloi sha pyrshah ka Gibeah ; ki phet sha baroh ki liang ka nongbah bad ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei baroh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleit jingleit ki la kyrkieh, bad ki la mareh sha Gibeah; bad ki nongleit jingleit ki la iaid ryngkat bad ka shnong baroh kawei da ka tduh jong ka waitlam .

en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .
kha: U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong kaba shiteng na ka jait Manasseh kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai pateng ia ka jaitbynriew Manasseh: bad kane ka la long ka jingdon jong ka jaitbynriew Manasseh da ki longiing jong ki .

en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .
kha: haba u wan ha kata ka Sngi ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na ki briew jong u baroh bad ka jingpyndonburom na baroh kiba ngeit . Phi ruh phin long napdeng jong ki , namar ba phi la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda un wan ban shah pyndonburom ha ki riewkhuid jong u , bad ban shah sngewtynnad ha kito baroh kiba ngeit (namar la ngeit ia ka jingphla jong ngi hapdeng jong phi) ha kata ka sngi .

en: And all the people answered together , and said , All that the  Lord  hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh u la jubab lang ,  Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la kren ,  bad u Moses u la leit ïathuh ïa kane ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ia kren lang bad ki la ong , Baroh kaba U Trai u la kren ngin leh . U Moses u la pynphai biang ia ki ktien jong ki briew sha U Trai .

en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses , and to Eleazar the priest , and unto the princes of the congregation , saying ,
kha: ki la leit sha u Moses , u Eleasar , bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam jong u paidlang , bad ki ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Gad bad ki khun Reuben ki la wan bad ki la kren ha u Moses bad ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah jong ka jingiaseng da kaba ong:

en: But thou , O Daniel , shut up the words , and seal the book , even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro , and knowledge shall be increased .
kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Bad mynta , ko Daniel to khylliap noh ïa ka kitab bad shon muhor halor jong ka haduh ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba bun ki briew kin pynlehnoh-ei ïa ki jingpyrshang jong ki ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, ko Daniel, to khang ia ki ktien, bad to khang ia ka kot, wat haduh ka por kaba kut: bun kin mareh sha ka por ba kut: bad ka jingtip kan nang kiew .

en: And he brought him to Jerusalem , and set him on a pinnacle of the temple , and said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down from hence :
kha: Nangta u Soitan u la ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem bad buh ïa u ha ka jaka kaba jrong tam jong ka Templ , bad u la ong ha u ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , to pynnoh ïa lade sha tbian nangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u sha Jerusalem bad u la buh ia u ha ka tduh jong ka tempi bad u la ong ha u: Lada me long U Khun U Blei, to bret noh ia lade naduh hangta:

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Sa shisien pat ngan shah ïa ki Israel ba kin pan jingïarap na nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ba kin roi ha ka jingbun briew kum ka kynhun langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei ; ngan sa shah kylli na ka bynta kane da ka iing Israel , ban leh ia kata na ka bynta jong ki ; ngan pynbun ia ki da ki briew kum ka kynhun .

en: Wherewith shall I come before the  Lord  , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?
kha: Da-ei ngan wallam sha U  Trai  , U Blei ka bneng , haba nga wan ban mane ïa u ? Hato ngan wallam sha u da ki khun masi bakynsai tam kum ki jingainguh thang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ngan wan ha khmat U Trai bad ngan dem ha khmat U Blei uba ha khlieh duh ? ngan wan ha khmat jong u da ki jingknia thang , da ki khun masi kiba dang shisnem ?

en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah tang mar ïohsngew ïa kaba la ïathuh , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Hesekaiah u la iohsngew ia kata, ba u la pynkhih ia la ki jain bad u la tap ia lade da ka jainkup bad u la leit shapoh iing U Trai .

en: The  Lord  grant you that ye may find rest , each of you in the house of her husband . Then she kissed them  ; and they lifted up their voice , and wept .
kha: Bad to ai ba U  Trai  un pynlah ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban shongkurim biang bad ban don la ka longïing .  Kumta ka Naomi ka doh khublei ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sdang ban ïam bad ki ong ha ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un ai ia phi ba phin ioh jingjahthait, iwei pa iwei ha iing u tnga jong ka . Nangta ka la kdup ia ki ; bad ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki , bad ki la iam .

en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .
kha: Mar kumta hi ka khynnah ka la leit phai kloi kloi pat sha u syiem bad ka la dawa ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban ai mynta hangne ha ka pliang , ïa ka khlieh u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wan rung beit sha u syiem bad ka la kylli da kaba ong , Nga kwah ba me ai ia nga da kaba pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u loannis u Nongpynbaptis .

en: But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .
kha: Wat leit sha Beersheba ban mane Blei . Wat pyrshang ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Bethel kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit sha Gilgal — ïa ki briew jong ka la tim ba kin shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat wad ia ka Bethel, lane ban rung sha Gilgal, bad wat leit sha Beersheba: namar u Gilgal un leit sha ka jingshah set phatok, bad u Bethel un wan sha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka ri.

en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?
kha: Mynta hangne , kane ka briew kaba hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllait ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato kane ka kynthei, kaba long ka khun jong u Abraham, kaba u Soitan u la teh, ha kane ka shiphew snem, kam dei ban shah pyllait na kane ka jingiadei ha ka sngi Sabha ?

en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .
kha: Da shisha kiba kum kine ki kyndon ki i kumba la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymdei , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka doh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei kiba don shisha ka jingpyni ia ka jingstad ha ka mon sngewbha, bad ka jinglong rit mynsiem, bad ka jingbym shimkhia ia ka met ; ym ha kano kano ka burom ia ka jingpynhun ia ka doh .

en: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait , that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city .
kha: Ki shipai Israel kiba kham ha khmat bad ki rangbah kiba don ha ka jakarieh ki la ïapynbeit ïa ka dak .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la don ka dak kaba la buh hapdeng ki briew Israel bad ki nongleit jingleit kiba ap , ba ki dei ban pynmih ia ka ding kaba heh da ka tdem kaba kiew na ka nongbah .

en: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God , even our Father , at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhlaiñ ïa phi , bad phin long kiba janai bad kiba khuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi haba U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi u wan lem bad baroh kiba dei ki jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut u lah ban pynskhem ia ki dohnud jong phi ki bym lah ban shah ha ka jingkhuid ha khmat U Blei , wat U Kpa jong ngi ruh ha ka jingwan U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist ryngkat bad ki riewkhuid jong u baroh .

en: Then the heaven and the earth , and all that is therein , shall sing for Babylon : for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north , saith the  Lord .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei ha ka pyrthei bad ha suiñbneng kin risa da ka jingkmen ynda ka Babilonia kan kyllon ha ki briew kiba wan na shatei ban pynjot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka bneng bad ka khyndew bad kiei kiei baroh ha ka, kin rwai na ka bynta ka Babilon: namar ki nongpynjot kin wan sha ka na shaphang shathie , ong U Trai .

en: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors , and thy lovers shall go into captivity : surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness .
kha: Ïa ki nongïalam jong phi yn rong noh da ka lyer , kiba ïateh lok bad phi kin shah ring kum ki mraw ka thma ; ïa ka nongbah jong phi yn pynjahburom bad shah pynlehrain namar ki kam bymman baroh kiba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Iyer kan bam ia ki nongap langbrot jong me baroh: shisha te men sngewlehrain bad sngewlehrain na ka bynta ka jingsniew jong me baroh .

en: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation , in all the wealth which God shall give Israel : and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever .
kha: Te yn pynkordit ïa me bad men peit da ka jingsngewpihuiñ haba me ïohi ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha kiwei pat ki briew jong ka Israel , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na ka ïing jong me u ban im tymmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men iohi ia u nongshun ha ka jaka shong jong nga, ha ka spah baroh kaba U Blei un ai ha ki Israel: bad ym don tymmen ha ka iing jong me junom .

en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , Come near to me , I pray you . And they came near . And he said , I am Joseph your brother , whom ye sold into Egypt .
kha: Kumta U Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Ale kham hajan .  Ki ruh ki leit . Nangta u ong ,  Nga dei u Joseph u para jong phi , ïa uba phi la die noh sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, To wan hajan jong nga, nga kyrpad ia phi . Ki la wan hajan . Bad u la ong, Nga long u hynmen jong phi, uba phi la die sha Ijipt .

en: So the  Lord  our God delivered into our hands Og also , the king of Bashan , and all his people : and we smote him until none was left to him remaining .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u aiti ïa u Syiem Og bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh ha ka bor jong ngi , bad ngi pynïap lut ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai jong ngi u la aiti ha ki kti jong ngi ruh u Og ruh, u syiem u Basan bad ki briew jong u baroh: bad ngi la shoh ia u haduh ba ym don ba sah ha u .

en: Yea , thou shalt go forth from him , and thine hands upon thine head : for the  Lord  hath rejected thy confidences , and thou shalt not prosper in them .
kha: Phin phai noh na ka Ijipt , da kaba sdien ïa ka khlieh jong phi ha ka jinglehrain . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kyntait ïa kito kiba phi la shaniah ; phin ym ïoh kano kano ka jingmyntoi na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me, to leit noh na u, bad ki kti jong me ha ka khlieh jong me: namar U Trai u la kyntait ia ki jingshaniah jong me, bad me ym jop ha ki .

en: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold  ; three pound of gold went to one shield : and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
kha: U shna ruh laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit bad ar kilo ka ksiar ka leit ha kawei kawei ka stieh . U phah buh ïa kine ki stieh baroh ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna lai spah tylli ki jingda ksiar ba la shoh ; lai pound ka ksiar ka la leit sha kawei ka jingda: bad u syiem u la buh ia ki ha ka iing jong ka khlaw Lebanon .

en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
kha: U sdie u la khreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uno uno u dieng baroh u bym sei u soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ruh la buh ia u ax ha ka tynrai jong ki dieng: uwei pa uwei u dieng namarkata u bym pynmih soh uba bha la ot noh bad u la bret ha ka ding .

en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :
kha: Kumta u jubab ïa u syiem ,  Ai hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong . Hukum ïa ki jingdeng syiem ban pyndeng ha u kulai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba yn wanrah ia ka jain syiem kaba u syiem u ju phong, bad u kulai uba u syiem u shong halor jong u:

en: And he said unto me , What seest thou ? And I answered , I see a flying roll  ; the length thereof is twenty cubits , and the breadth thereof ten cubits .
kha: U angel u la kylli ïa nga kaei nga la ïohi . Nga la jubab ,  Ka kot kli baher ha ka lyer ; ka don khyndai mitar ka lynter bad saw mitar shiteng ka pyngkiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha nga, Kaei kaba me iohi ? Bad nga la jubab , nga iohi ia ka rong kaba her; ka jingjrong jong ka ka long arphew cubit bad ka jingjrong jong ka shiphew cubit .

en: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him , whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world .
kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin mane ïa u , lait noh ïa kito kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ha ka kitab jong kiba im kiba dei ki jong uta U Khunlangbrot ïa uba la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kiba shong ha ka khyndew kin mane ia u , kiba ym shym la thoh kyrteng ha ka kot jingim jong u Khunlangbrot ba la pyniap naduh ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei .

en: Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me , Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre  ; let them take their portion .
kha: Ngan ym shim ei ei na ka bynta ïa lade ; ngan pdiang tang ïa kata kaba ki briew jong nga ki la pyndonkam . Hynrei shah ba ki paralok jong nga , u Aner , u Eshkol , bad u Mamre ba kin shim ïa la ka bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah tang ia kata kaba ki samla ki la bam, bad ka bynta jong ki shynrang kiba la leit bad nga, u Aner, u Eshol bad u Mamre ; to ai ba kin shim ia ka bynta jong ki.

en: And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
kha: U paidbah u la kynhied ïa ki bad ong ïa ki ban sngap jar . Hynrei ki la nang pyrta kham jam ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
translated_en_to_kha: U paidbah u la kren bein ia ki, namar ki dei ban bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki: hynrei ki la pyrta kham bun, ki da ong: To isynei ia ngi ko Trai, ko Khun u Dabid .

en: Kiss the Son , lest he be angry , and ye perish from the way , when his wrath is kindled but a little . Blessed are all they that put their trust in him .
kha: to khynñiuh bad to nguh dem ïa u , lym kumta ïa ka jingbitar jong u yn pynkhie kynsan , bad phin ïap kyndit . Suk kita baroh kiba leit sha u ban ïoh ka jingïada .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiss ia u Khun , ioh ba un bitar , bad phi jah noh na ka lynti , haba ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei tang khyndiat . La kyrkhu ia kito baroh kiba buh ia ka jingshaniah jong ki ha u .

en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven , and all that is dressed in the fryingpan , and in the pan , shall be the priest s that offereth it .
kha: Ka jingainguh bam baroh ïa kaba la syang ha dpei , lane ïa kaba la sdieh ha ka karai lane ha u khiew ba la tap ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh baroh kaba la shet ha ka oven , bad baroh kaba la phong da ka pan , kan long u lyngdoh uba ai ia ka .

en: And Manoah arose , and went after his wife , and came to the man , and said unto him , Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman ? And he said , I am .
kha: U Manoah u ïeng joit bad u bud ïa la ka tnga . U leit sha uta u briew bad u kylli ,  Dei ma phi mo u briew uba la ïakren bad ka tnga jong nga ?   Ho-oid ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Manoah u la ieng bad u la leit bud ia ka tnga jong u bad u la wan sha uta u briew bad u la ong ha u: Me long u briew uba kren ia kata ka kynthei ? Bad u la ong , Nga long .

en: And he said , I will hide my face from them , I will see what their end shall be : for they are a very froward generation , children in whom is no faith .
kha: ‘ Ngan ym ïarap shuh ïa ki ,’ u ong ; ‘ bad ngan peit kai kumno kan jia ïa ki . Kine ki dei ki briew kiba mutlop , kiba ym don ka jingïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ngan buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na ki , ngan iohi kaei ka jingkut jong ki: namar ki long ka pateng kaba la tyrkhong bha, ki khun ha kiba ym don jingngeit .

en: And Jacob vowed a vow , saying , If God will be with me , and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and raiment to put on ,
kha: Nangta u Jakob u pynlong ka jingsmai ha U  Trai  :  Lada men long ryngkat bad nga bad ïada ïa nga ha kane ka jingleit jong nga , bad men ai ka bam ka dih bad ka kup ka sem ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la kular da kaba ong: Lada U Blei un don ryngkat bad nga bad un sumar ia nga ha kane ka rukom ba nga leit , bad un ai ia nga ia u kpu ban bam bad un ai ia nga ia u kpu ban phong , .

en: I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thlim ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , bad ngan pynher krad ïa ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ia ka jingtieng jong nga ha khmat jong me , bad ngan pynjot ia ki briew baroh kiba me wan sha ki , bad ngan pynlong ia ki nongshun jong me baroh ban phai noh sha me .

en: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
kha: U Ussaïah u long syiem haba u la don khathynriew snem ka rta ; bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Shiphew snem ka rta u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kyrteng jong ka kmie jong u ruh ka long ka Jecoliah jong ka Jerusalem .

en: Who knowing the judgment of God , that they which commit such things are worthy of death , not only do the same , but have pleasure in them that do them .
kha: Ki tip ba ka Hukum U Blei ka ong ba ki briew kiba im ha kane ka rukom ki dei hok ban ïap . Pynban , ym tang ba ki ïai leh ïa kine hi kiei kiei , hynrei ki mynjur wat ïa kiwei kiba leh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba tip ia ka jingbishar U Blei , ba kita kiba leh ia kum kine kiei kiei kim dei tang ban iap , hynrei ki don ka jingsngewbha ha ki kiba leh ia ki .

en: And he shall not look to the altars , the work of his hands , neither shall respect that which his fingers have made , either the groves , or the images .
kha: Kin ym shaniah shuh ha ki duwan kiba ki la thaw da ki kti jong ki , lane shaniah ha ki kam ki kti jong ki hi — ki dak jong ka bleithaw Asherah bad ki duwan ban thang jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym peit ia ki almari, ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong u, lymne un ym burom ia kata kaba ki kti jong u ki la shna, ne ia ki khlaw ne ki dur .

en: And the taskmasters of the people went out , and their officers , and they spake to the people , saying , Thus saith Pharaoh , I will not give you straw .
kha: Kumta ki nongpyntrei mraw bad ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam ki la mihnoh bad ki la ong ha ki Israel ,  U Pharaoh u ong ba un ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongtrei jong ki briew ki la mih noh, bad ki ophisar jong ki, bad ki la kren ha ki briew, ki da ong: Kumta u Pharaoh, ngan ym ai ia phi ia u sboh .

en: Yea , he magnified himself even to the prince of the host , and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away , and the place of his sanctuary was cast down .
kha: Ka la kyntait ban kohnguh wat ïa U Khun syiem jong ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng , ka la pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ba la ai sha u , bad ka la pyntngit ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , u la pynkhraw ia lade wat ha u syiem jong u nongwan jngohkai , bad da u la weng noh ia ka jingknia kaba man ka sngi , bad la pynhap noh ia ka jaka kyntang jong u .

en: The plain also , and Jordan , and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward .
kha: Shaphang sepngi , ka ri jong ki ka poi haduh wah Jordan , naduh ka pung Galilaïa shaphang shatei , arsut haduh ka Duriaw Baïap shaphang shathie , bad nangta shaduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka madan ruh bad ka Jordan bad ka rud duriaw jong ka, naduh ka duriaw jong ka madan, wat ka duriaw mluh ruh, hapoh ka Ashdoshpisgah shaphang mihngi .

en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u syiem Hesekaïah u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u la phong ki jaiñ khain , bad u la leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Hesekaiah u la iohsngew ia kata, ba u la pynkhih ia la ki jain bad u la tap ia lade da ka jainkup bad u la leit shapoh iing U Trai .

en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri jong ka jingshahshitom kaba nga dei ban dih ? Hato phi lah ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Phim tip ia kaei kaba phi kylli: phi lah ban dih na ka khuri kaba nga dih ? bad shah pynbaptis da ka jingpynbaptis kaba nga shah pynbaptis ?

en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster , and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs , and an hundred thousand rams , with the wool .
kha: U Mesha u syiem ka Moab u ri pynroi langbrot , bad man ka snem u ai ka jingnguh ïa u syiem Israel shi lakh tylli ki khunlangbrot , bad u  saiwul na ki shi lakh tylli ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mesha u syiem u la long u nongri langbrot bad u la ai ha u syiem Israel shispah hajar ngut ki langbrot bad shispah hajar ngut ki langbrot ryngkat bad ka snieh langbrot .

en: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :
kha: Kim don bynta ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u ai , naba ki long kiba bieit tasam bad kiba eh dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka jingsngewthuh ka la dum , ka la shah pynduh noh na ka jingim U Blei lyngba ka jingbymtip kaba don ha ki , namar ka jingmatlah jong ka dohnud jong ki:

en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Lada phim bam ïa ka doh jong U Khun U Briew bad dih ïa ka snam jong u , phin ym don ïa ka jingim ha lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, lymda phi bam ia ka doh U Khun u briew bad dih ia ka snam jong u, phim don jingim ha phi .

en: And ye have done worse than your fathers  ; for , behold , ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart , that they may not hearken unto me :
kha: Hynrei phi la leh wat kaba kham sniew ban ïa ka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Ma phi baroh phi long kiba mutlop bad kiba sniew , bad phim shym kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la leh kham sniew ban ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi; namar, ha khmih, phi iaid iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud kaba sniew jong u, ba kin ym sngap ia nga:

en: And the man said , They are departed hence  ; for I heard them say , Let us go to Dothan . And Joseph went after his brethren , and found them in Dothan .
kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ki la ïaleit . Nga la ïohsngew ba ki ong ba kin leit sha Dothan .  Kumta u Joseph u leit beh nadien jong ki bad u lap ïa ki ha Dothan .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew u la ong: Ki la leit noh namarkata; namar nga la iohsngew ia ki ba ki ong: To ngin leit sha Dotan . U Joseph u la leit bud ia ki hynmen jong u bad u la shem ia ki ha Dotan .

en: And while he yet spake , behold a multitude , and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve , went before them , and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him .
kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba ka kynhun ki briew ka la wan poi , ïa kaba la ïalam da u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran . U la wan sha U Jisu ban doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U dang kren, ha khmih u paidbah, bad uta uba la khot u Judas, uwei na ki shiphew ngut, u la leit ha khmat jong ki bad u la wan hajan U Jisu ban kdup ia u .

en: When I have brought them again from the people , and gathered them out of their enemies  lands , and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations  ;
kha: Khnang ban pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew babun ba nga long uba khuid , ngan wallam pat ïa ki briew jong nga na ki ri baroh kiba ki shong ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la wanrah biang ia ki na ki briew , bad nga la lum ia ki na ki ri jong ki , bad nga la pynkyntang ha ki ha khmat kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ; .

en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u kiwei pat ki dkhot jong ka longïing u syiem Ahab ki la long ki nongai jingmut ïa u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ka jingkyllon noh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai kum ka iing u Ahab: namar ki la long ki nongai jingmut jong u hadien ka jingiap u kpa jong u haduh ka jingjot jong u .

en: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed , and the needy shall lie down in safety : and I will kill thy root with famine , and he shall slay thy remnant .
kha: U  Trai  un long u nongaplangbrot ïa kiba duk jong ki briew jong u bad un shah ïa ki ban shong ha ka jingshngain . Hynrei un phah ïa ka  nemsniew kaba shyrkhei ha phi ki Philistia , bad un ym pynsah im ïa uno uno ruh na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u khun nyngkong jong kiba duk un bam, bad uba duk un thiah ha ka jingshngain: bad ngan pyniap ia u tynrai jong me da ka jingkyrduh bam , bad un pyniap ia ka jingsah jong me .

en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king s sons arose , and every man gat him up upon his mule , and fled .
kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Absalom bad ki la pynïap ïa u Amnon . Baroh kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki kiew halor ki khashor jong ki bad ki la phet krad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Absalom ki la leh ia u Amnon kumba u Absalom u la hukum . Nangta ki khun syiem baroh ki la ieng , bad uwei pa uwei u la leit sha jrong ia u kulai jong u bad u la phet noh .

en: Above it stood the seraphims : each one had six wings  ; with twain he covered his face , and with twain he covered his feet , and with twain he did fly .
kha: Sawdong jong u ki seraph ki ïeng , uwei uwei na ki u don hynriew tylli ki thapniang . Uwei uwei u seraph u tap ïa la ka durkhmat da ki ar tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa la ka met da ki ar tylli , bad la pyndonkam ïa ki ar tylli kiwei pat ban her .
translated_en_to_kha: Halor jong ka la ieng ki seraphim: uwei pa uwei u don hynriew tylli ki bniat; bad ar tylli ki bniat u la tap ia ki kjat jong u, bad da ar tylli ki bniat u la her .

en: Hearken unto me , O house of Jacob , and all the remnant of the house of Israel , which are borne by me from the belly , which are carried from the womb :
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi baroh kiba dang sah na ki briew jong nga . Nga la sumar ïa phi naduh ka por ba dang kha .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga ko iing u Jakob bad ia ki Israel baroh kiba sah ha nga naduh ka kpoh:

en: And Esau said unto his father , Hast thou but one blessing , my father ? bless me , even me also , O my father . And Esau lifted up his voice , and wept .
kha: U Iso u ïai kyrpad ha la u kpa .  Ko Pa , hato phi don tang kawei ka jingkyrkhu ? Pa , to kyrkhu ïa nga ruh !  U la sdang ban ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la ong ha la u kpa, Hato me long tang kawei ka jingkyrkhu, ko kpa jong nga? to kyrkhu ia nga ruh, ko kpa jong nga. U Iso u la pynkiew ia ka sur jong u bad u la iam .

en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt kim shym la sngewthuh ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bunsien u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit jong u , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim sngewthuh ia ki jingphylla jong me ha Ijipt ; kim kynmaw ia ka jingbun ki jingsngewsih jong me ; hynrei ki la pynkhih ia u ha duriaw , wat ha duriaw Basaw .

en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
kha: U paidbah u dei ban ñiew ba u lyngdoh u long uba khuid , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U  Trai  ; nga long uba khuid , bad nga pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pynkyntang ia u namarkata; namar u ai ia u kpu U Blei jong me: un long uba khuid ha me: namar nga U Trai uba pynkyntang ia phi, nga long uba khuid .

en: Ethiopia , and Libya , and Lydia , and all the mingled people , and Chub , and the men of the land that is in league , shall fall with them by the sword .
kha: Kata ka thma kan pynïap ruh ïa ki shipai kiba la shu wai na Sudan , Lydia , Libya , Arabia , Kub , bad wat napdeng ki briew jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ethiopia bad ka Libya bad ka Lydia bad ki briew baroh kiba la shah rong saw bad u Chub bad ki briew jong ka ri kiba don ha ka ri ki hap bad ki da ka waitlam .

en: Then went Samson down , and his father and his mother , to Timnah , and came to the vineyards of Timnah : and , behold , a young lion roared against him .
kha: Kumta u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah ryngkat bad la u kpa bad ka kmie . Katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki bri sohwaiñ hangta , u ïohsngew ïa u sing samla ba u kyrhuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samson u la leit hiar, bad u kpa jong u bad ka kmie jong u, sha Timna, bad u la wan sha ki kper sohjew jong ka Timna: bad, ha khmih, uwei u sing uba dang rit u la iaid pyrshah ia u .

en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron , nor the inhabitants of Nahalol  ; but the Canaanites dwelt among them , and became tributaries .
kha: Ki jait Sebulun kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Kitron bad Nahalal ; bad kumta ki Kanaan ki ïaishong hapdeng jong ki bad la pynbor ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Zebulun um shym la beh noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Kitrono , ne ki nongshong shnong jong ka Nahalol ; hynrei ki nongshong shnong ki la shong hapdeng jong ki , bad ki la kylla long ki nongshong shnong .

en: And he said unto Moses , Come up unto the  Lord  , thou , and Aaron , Nadab , and Abihu , and seventy of the elders of Israel  ; and worship ye afar off .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wan kiew sha nga shalor lum , ma me , u Aaron , u Nadab , u Abihu , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ; bad katba phi dang ïadon kham ha pajih , dem bad mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Moses, Me bad u Aaron, Nadab bad u Abihu bad hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah Israel; bad to mane ia phi na jngai .

en: And he said , Who art thou ? And she answered , I am Ruth thine handmaid : spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid  ; for thou art a near kinsman .
kha: Pha dei kaei ?  u kylli .  Kynrad , nga dei ka Ruth ,  ka jubab .  Namar ba phi dei u ba-ha-ïing uba ïajan eh , phi don jingkitkhlieh ban ri sumar ïa nga . Kumta sngewbha ban shongkurim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong, Me long mano ? Bad ka la jubab, Nga long ka Ruth ka nongtrei jong me: pynphriang namarkata ia ka ryndang jong me halor ka kti jong me; namar me long u khun masi uba jan .

en: I say , sayest thou , ( but they are but vain words ) I have counsel and strength for war : now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
kha: U la dawa  Hato phi tharai ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit bad ka borbah ki shipai ? Mano phi tharai u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong, me ong ma me, (hynrei ki long tang ki ktien kiba lehnohei ) Nga don ka jingai jingmut bad ka jingkhlain na ka bynta ka thma: mynta ha uba me shaniah, ba me leh pyrshah ia nga ?

en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet , and taketh not warning  ; if the sword come , and take him away , his blood shall be upon his own head .
kha: Lada uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ka hynrei um suidñiew , bad u nongshun u wan bad pynïap ïa u , te un kit pop hi ïa la ka jong ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uno uno uba iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi bad u bym shim jingmaham lada ka waitlam ka wan bad u shim noh ia u , ka snam jong u kan long halor la ka jong ka khlieh .

en: And if the  Lord  thy God enlarge thy coast , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers  ;
kha: Bad lada U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la ïathuh ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad u ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada U Trai U Blei jong me u pynheh ia ka rud duriaw jong me kumba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, bad u ai ha me ia ka ri baroh kaba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me;

en: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold , I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you , and ye shall sow the land .
kha: U Joseph u ong ha kita ki briew ,  Phi ïohi mynta ba nga la thied ïa phi bad ïa ki khyndew jong phi na ka bynta u syiem . Shim une u symbai ba phin ïabet ha ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joseph u la ong ha ki briew: Ha khmih nga la thied ia phi mynta ka sngi bad ia ka ri jong phi na ka bynta u Pharaoh: ha khmih hangne u symbai na ka bynta jong phi bad phin bet ia ka ri .

en: They have stricken me , shalt thou say , and I was not sick  ; they have beaten me , and I felt it not : when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again .
kha: Ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tied ,  phin ong ;  ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tangon , hynrei ngam kynmaw ïa ka . Balei ngam shym lah ban khie ? Nga donkam ban ïoh jingdih biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shoh ia nga, me ong, bad ngam shym la pang ; ki la shoh ia nga, bad ngam shym la sngew ia kata: mynno ngan khie ? Ngan sa wad biang ia ka .

en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls  ; every several gate was of one pearl : and the street of the city was pure gold , as it were transparent glass .
kha: Ki khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop ki la long ki khat-ar tylli ki mawlynnai ; ïa kawei kawei ka khyrdop la shna na uwei u mawlynnai . Ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah ka la long da ka ksiar nylla , kaba lah ban ïohi lyngba kum ka ïit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki khyrdop ki long shiphew tylli ki mawkordor ; kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop ka long kawei ka mawkordor: bad ka lynti jong ka shnong ka long ka ksiar kaba khuid , kumba ka long ka rong kaba shai .

en: And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
kha: Balei me kylli na nga shaphang kaei kaba bha ?  la jubab U Jisu .  Don tang Uwei uba bha . To sumar ïa ki hukum lada me kwah ban rung sha ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Balei me khot ia nga uba bha? ym don ba bha hynrei tang kawei, kata ka long: hynrei lada me rung ha ka jingim, to sumar ia ki hukum .

en: The hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and carried me out in the spirit of the  Lord  , and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones ,
kha: Nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  bad U Mynsiem jong u , u la ïalam bad pynshong ïa nga hapoh ka them ha kaba ka madan ka dap da ki shyieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti U Trai ka la don halor jong nga , bad ka la rah ia nga ha ka mynsiem U Trai , bad ka la buh ia nga hapoh ka them kaba dap da ki shyieng .

en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us ?
kha: Kaba khmih ïa ki khmat jong phi , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga , bad u jingdeng ryndang ba phi deng ka la tuh ïa ka dohnud jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi ieit kham palat ia uwei pat uba ieit , ko me uba kham itynnad hapdeng ki kynthei ? kaei kaba phi ieit kham palat ia uwei pat uba ieit , ba me leh kumta ?

en: A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :
kha: Ki long kiba jrong kat ki Anakim , kiba bun paid , bad kiba khlaiñ . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa ki baroh , kumta ki Ammon ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw , bad kaba bun , bad kaba jrong , kum ki Anaok hynrei U Trai u la pynjot ia ki ha khmat jong ki ; bad ki la jop ia ki, bad ki la shong ha ka jaka jong ki:

en: The portion of Jacob is not like them : for he is the former of all things  ; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .
kha: U Blei jong u Jakob um long kum ma ki ; u long uta uba thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad u la jied ïa ki Israel ban long ki briew jong u hi . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta jong u Jakob kam long kum ma ki: namar u long uba nyngkong eh na kiei kiei baroh beg bad ki Israel ki long u diengduh jong ka pateng jong u: U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel , saith the Lord  God  , that my fury shall come up in my face .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi haba u Gog u hiarthma ïa ka Israel , ngan sa bitar lep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kajuh ka por haba u Gog un wan pyrshah ia ka ri Israel , ong U Trai Blei , ba ka jingbitar jong nga kan wan shaneng ha khmat jong nga .

en: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah , who had understanding in the visions of God : and as long as he sought the  Lord  , God made him to prosper .
kha: Katba u Sekharaïah u nongaibuit jong u ha kaba ïadei bad ka niam u dang im ; u la shakri hok ïa U  Trai  bad U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wad ia U Blei ha ki sngi u Sekharaiah uba don ka jingsngewthuh ha ki jingphohsniew U Blei: bad katba u dang wad ia U Trai , U Blei u la pynlong ia u ban roi .

en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come , he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab , which is in the border of Arnon , which is in the utmost coast .
kha: Haba u Balak u ïohsngew ba u Balaam u la wan , u leit ïakynduh ïa u ha Ar , ka nongbah kaba harud ka wah Arnon ha ka khappud Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la iohsngew ba u Balaam u la wan iakynduh ia u ha kawei ka shnong Moab kaba don ha u pud u sam jong u Arnon kaba don ha rud duriaw kaba kut tam .

en: For the day of the  Lord  of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty , and upon every one that is lifted up  ; and he shall be brought low :
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynpoh ïa uwei pa uwei uba khrawbor , ïa uwei pa uwei uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka sngi U Trai jong ki paid kan long halor uwei pa uwei uba sngew sarong bad uba jrong , bad halor uwei pa uwei uba la shah pynkiew ; bad un shah pynhiar dor:

en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword  ; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me , and made me a polished shaft  ; in his quiver hath he hid me  ;
kha: U la pynlong ïa ki ktien jong nga kiba nep kum ka waitlam . Da la ka kti u ïada ïa nga . U la pynlong ïa nga kum u khnam , uba nep bad ba la biang ban pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ka shyntur jong nga kum ka waitlam kaba jem ; ha ka jingdum jong ka kti jong u u la buhrieh ia nga, bad u la pynlong ia nga u shaft ba la pynkhuid ; ha ka jaka ba u la buhrieh ia nga ;

en: And she arose at midnight , and took my son from beside me , while thine handmaid slept , and laid it in her bosom , and laid her dead child in my bosom .
kha: Ka la khie ha ka por mynmiet , ka shim ïa u khun jong nga na syndah jong nga katba nga dang ïohthiah , bad ka la rah ïa u sha ka jingthiah jong ka ; nangta ka buh ïa u khun ba la ïap ha ka jingthiah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la khie ha ka por shiteng miet , bad ka la shim ia u khun jong nga najan jong nga , katba ka kti jong me ka dang thiah , bad ka la buh ia ka ha ka kpoh jong ka , bad ka la buh ia u khun jong ka uba la iap ha ka kpoh jong nga .

en: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine ; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers , having itching ears ;
kha: Ka por kan sa poi haba ki briew kin ym shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai badei , hynrei kin kohnguh ïa la ki jingkwah bad kin nang pynbun ïa ki nonghikai ki ban ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki shkor ba-dait jong ki , ki kwah ban ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka por kan sa wan ha kaba kin ym shah ia ka jinghikai kaba skhem ; hynrei hadien ki jingkwah brai jong ki hi kin lum ia ki nonghikai, ki da sngap jar;

en: But Festus , willing to do the Jews a pleasure , answered Paul , and said , Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these things before me ?
kha: Hynrei u Phestos u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ki Jiw , kumta u la kylli ïa u Paul ,  Hato me mon ban leit sha Jerusalem ba yn bishar halor kine ki jingmudui ha khmat jong nga hangta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Festo, uba mon ban leh ia ki Jiw, u la jubab ia u Paul bad u la ong: Hato me leit sha Jerusalem bad hangta shah bishar ia kine kiei kiei ha khmat jong nga ?

en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field ? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken ?
kha: Hato ki kynjang mawsiang jong ka Lebanon ki ju long khlem ka ïor ? Hato ki wahduid ba dait-thah na ki lumbah ki ju rngad ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u briew un iehnoh ia u slap jong ka Lebanon uba wan na u maw lyngkha ? lane ki um kiba tuid khriat kiba wan na kawei pat ka jaka kin shah iehnoh ?

en: Who are they among all the gods of these lands , that have delivered their land out of my hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand ?
kha: Mynno na ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri uba la ju pyllait ïa la ka ri na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  u lah ban pyllait ïa ka Jerusalem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei ki blei baroh jong kine ki ri kiba la aiti ia ka ri jong ki na ka kti jong nga , ba U Trai un pyllait noh ia ka Jerusalem na ka kti jong nga ?

en: There is a generation , whose teeth are as swords , and their jaw teeth as knives , to devour the poor from off the earth , and the needy from among men .
kha: Don ki briew kiba shim kabu-runar ïa kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh ; kata ka long ka rukom ba ki kyrshan ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka pateng kaba ki bniat jong ki ki long kum ki waitlam bad ki bniat jong ki kum ki waitlam , ban bam ia kiba duk na ka khyndew bad kiba duk na ki briew .

en: And thy handmaid had two sons , and they two strove together in the field , and there was none to part them , but the one smote the other , and slew him .
kha: Kynrad , nga don ar ngut ki khun shynrang . Bad ha kawei ka sngi ki poi sha ka jingïakajia ha bri ; ha kaba ym don mano mano ban pynïakhlad ïa ki , bad uwei na ki u la pynïap ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongtrei jong me u don arngut ki khun shynrang bad ki arngut ki la ia tyngkhuh lang ha lyngkha , bad ym don ba iakhlad ia ki , hynrei uta u la shoh ia uwei pat bad u la pyniap ia u .

en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato me ngeit tang namar ba nga la ïathuh ïa me ba nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ? Men sa ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba kham khraw ban ïa kane !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u: Namar nga la ong ha me, nga la iohi ia me hapoh u dieng sohjew, me ngeit ? men sa iohi ia kiei kiei kiba kham khraw ban ia kine .

en: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .
kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud ha kti ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Simon hi u la ngeit ruh: bad haba u la shah pynbaptis, u la bteng bad u Philip, bad u la lyngngoh, haba u la iohi ia ki kambah bad ki dak kiba la leh .

en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . And he said , Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days ?
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u sngewthuh ïa kane ba ka mut ba kan don ka jingsuk bad jingshngain shi jingim jong u , kumta u jubab ,  Ka khubor ba me la ai ïa nga na U  Trai  ka long kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hesekaiah u la ong ha Isaiah , Ka long kaba bha ia ka ktien U Trai kaba me la kren . Bad u la ong: Hato kam long kaba bha lada ka jingsuk bad ka jingshisha ka long ha ki sngi jong nga ?

en: Those by the way side are they that hear  ; then cometh the devil , and taketh away the word out of their hearts , lest they should believe and be saved .
kha: Ki symbai kiba hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei u Ksuid u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka khubor na ki dohnud jong ki khnang ban khang ïa ki na kaba ngeit bad ïohlait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba don ha ka liang ki long kiba iohsngew ia u ksuid, bad ki weng noh ia ka ktien na ki dohnud jong ki , ioh ba kin ngeit bad shah pynim .

en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees : therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down , and cast into the fire .
kha: Ïa u sdie la pynkhreh ban khet ïa ki dieng na ki thied ; ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym sei ki soh babha yn khet noh bad bret ha ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ruh la buh ia u ax ha ka tynrai jong ki dieng: namarkata uwei pa uwei u dieng u bym pynmih soh uba bha la ot noh bad la bret ha ka ding .

en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki kynrei ha Jerusalem kum ki maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jyllei kum u dieng Sykomore   .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la shna ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha Jerusalem kum ki maw, bad ki dieng sohjew ki la shna ia u kum ki dieng sohjew kiba don ha ki lum na ka bynta ka jingbun .

en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
kha: Kumta u Iso u ong ,  Te kumta , shah ngan ieh katto katne ngut ki briew jong nga bad phi .  Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  Ym da donkam ban leh kumta namar nga kwah tang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la ong , To ngan leit noh bad me katto katne na ki briew kiba don bad nga . Bad u la ong , Kaei kaba donkam ia ka ? to ngan shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat u kynrad jong nga .

en: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;
kha: Ka la long ka miet kaba khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng ha ka duriaw Mediterranian da ka  erïong . Kumba shiteng synñia ki maji ki la antad ba ngi la jan poi hajan ka ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka miet kaba shiphew ka la poi, kumba ngi la shah beh shaneng bad shapoh ha Adria, kumba shiteng miet ki nongshong lieng ki la sngew ba ki la jan shajan katto katne ka ri;

en: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king  ; and half followed Omri .
kha: Ki briew ka Israel ki ïa-pait : don napdeng jong ki kiba kwah ban pynlong syiem ïa u Tibni u khun jong u Ginath , bad kiwei pat ki kwah ïa u Omri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la phiah ia ki briew Israel ha ki ar bynta: shiteng na ki briew ki la bud ia u Tibni u khun u Ginath , ban pynlong syiem ia u ; bad shiteng ki la bud ia u Omri .

en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing , which he sent to Solomon , Because the  Lord  hath loved his people , he hath made thee king over them .
kha: U syiem Hiram ha kaba jubab u phah da ka shithi sha u Solomon . U thoh ,  Namar U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hiram u syiem Tyros u la jubab da ka jingthoh, kaba u la phah sha u Solomon , Namar ba U Trai u la ieit ia ki briew jong u , u la pynlong ia me syiem halor jong ki .

en: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits  ; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled , and fell there  ; and they that remained fled to the mountain .
kha: Ka them ka la dap da ki thliew bsiang ; bad haba ki syiem jong ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah ki la pyrshang ban phet ïap na ka thma , ki la hap ha kita ki thliew ; hynrei ki lai ngut kiwei pat ki syiem ki la phet ïap sha ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka wah Sidim ka la dap da ki slimepit ; bad ki syiem u Sodom bad u Gomorrah ki la phet noh, bad ki la hap hangta ; bad kita kiba sah ki la phet noh sha u lum .

en: And he had in his right hand seven stars : and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword : and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength .
kha: U bat ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ha ka kti kamon jong u , bad ka waitlam arliang syrti ka mih na ka shyntur jong u . Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba shai ha ka por shiteng sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u don ha ka kti kadiang jong u hynriew tylli ki khlur: bad na ka shyntur jong u la mih ka waitlam kaba jem arliang: bad ka khmat jong u ka la long kumba ka sngi ka shai ha ka bor jong u .

en: And said unto him ,  Go , wash in the pool of Siloam ,  ( which is by interpretation , Sent . ) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
kha: To khie leit bad bta ïa ka khmat jong me ha ka Pung Siloam .  ( Kane ka kyrteng ka mut  Ba la phah .  ) Kumta uta u briew u la leit , u la bta ïa la ka khmat , bad u la wan phai uba imat pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Leit, sait ha ka pung Siloam, (ka kaba long da ka jingbatai, Sent . ) U la leit noh namarkata, bad u la leit peit .

en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .
kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wan sha Jerusalem , bad ki ïathuh kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta kaei kaba ki nong Babilonia ki la leh ïa ka Templ jong u . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sur jong kita kiba phet bad kiba lait na ka ri Babilon , ban pynbna ha ka Seion ia ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Trai U Blei jong ngi , ka jingpynshitom bein jong ka tempi jong u .

en: And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :
kha: Bad da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim hi ba kamet jongu mynta ka la iap , ha ka por ba u la dap shispah snem ka rta , lane ïa ka plakhun jong ka Sarah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namar ba um long uba tlot ha ka jingngeit, um shym la pyrkhat ia la ka jong ka met mynta kaba la iap, haba u la dap kumba shispah snem ka rta, lymne ka jingiap jong ka kpoh jong ka Sara:

en: Then the king said , Cause Haman to make haste , that he may do as Esther hath said . So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared .
kha: U syiem nangta u hukum ba u Haman un wan kloi , khnang ba kin lah ban leit kum ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong ka Esther . Te u syiem bad u Haman ki leit sha ka jingkhawai ka Esther .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong , To leh kloi ia u Haman ban leh kloi kumba u Esther u la ong . Kumta u syiem bad u Haman ki la wan sha ka jingkhawai kaba u Esther u la pynkhreh .

en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .
kha: Bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid ; ka long ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me na kata ka jingbam ba la kñia ainguh sha U  Trai . Kata ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ia ka ha ka jaka bakhuid , namar ka dei ka hok jong me bad ki khun shynrang jong me: namar kumta nga la hukum .

en: ( For they could not endure that which was commanded , And if so much as a beast touch the mountain , it shall be stoned , or thrust through with a dart :
kha: Namar kim lah ban shah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum kaba ong ,  Wat lada u mrad un ktah ïa uta u lum , yn lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar kim lah ban shah ia kata kaba la hukum , Bad lada u mrad u ktah ia u lum , yn sa pynkhih ia u da u dar:

en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .
kha: Me la thung ïa ki , bad ki la suhthied ; ki san bad ki pynmih soh . Ki ju kren bha shaphang jong me , pynban kim da salia eh shisha shaphang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la thung ia ki, hooid, ki la shim tynrai: ki san, hooid, ki pynmih soh: me don hajan ka shyntur jong ki, bad jngai na ki tyrpeng jong ki .

en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Nangta u buh ïa kata ka synduk hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad u wah ïa ka pyrda . Da kumne u kah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka synduk ha ka iingjain bad u la buh ia ka jingtap jong ka jingtap bad u la tap ia ka synduk jong ka jingsakhi ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .
