kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynpaw ia ka kyrteng jong me ha ki briew kiba me la ai ia nga na ka pyrthei: me ki la long, bad me la ai ia ki; bad ki la bat ia ka ktien jong me .

en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .
kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phi la lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi kheit ia ka jingot jong ka ri jong phi , wat kheit lut ia ki thliew jong ka lyngkha jong me , lymne wat lum ia ki jingot jong me .

en: It seemed good to me also , having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first , to write unto thee in order , most excellent Theophilus ,
kha: Bad kumta , ko rangbah badonburom , namar ba nga , nga pule bniah biang biang ïa kine kiei kiei baroh naduh ka jingsdang jong ki , nga la pyrkhat ba kan long kaba bha ban thoh ryntih ïa ka jingïathuh na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long kaba bha ha nga ruh, haba nga la sngewthuh pura ia kiei kiei baroh naduh kaba nyngkong eh, ban thoh sha me ha ka rukom kaba bha tam, u Theophilus uba bha tam .

en: Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .
kha: Bad u Moses u pynshisha da kaba shai ba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Ha ka bynta shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing u kren shaphang U Trai kum ‘ U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ba la pynmih ia kiba iap, wat u Moses ruh u la pyni ha khlaw , haba u khot ia U Trai U Blei jong u Abraham bad U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will plead thy cause , and take vengeance for thee  ; and I will dry up her sea , and make her springs dry .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan shimti na ka bynta jong phi bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin hap siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa phi . Ngan pynrngad ïa ki tyllong um jong ka Babilonia bad ngan pynlong ïa ki wah jong ka ban tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih , ngan kyrpad ia ka daw jong me, bad ngan shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang na ka bynta me ; bad ngan pynkhriat ia ka duriaw jong ka, bad ngan pynlong ia ki tyllong um jong ka ban tyrkhong .

en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort : yea , and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus , because his spirit was refreshed by you all .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba la pynshlur ïa ngi . Ym tang ba la pynshlur ïa ngi ; haduh katno u Titos u la pynkmen ïa ngi da ka jingkmen jong u halor ka rukom kaba phi baroh phi la ïarap ban pynkmen ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi la shah pyntngen ha ka jingpyntngen jong phi: Hooid, bad palat ia ka jingkmen jong u Titus, namar ka mynsiem jong u ka la nang pynkmen da phi baroh .

en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus , and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead , thou shalt be saved .
kha: Lada phi phla ba U Jisu u long U Trai bad ngeit ba U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , phin lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba lada me phla da ka shyntur jong me ia U Trai Jisu bad men ngeit ha ka dohnud jong me ba U Blei u la pynmihpat ia u na kiba iap .

en: The Vijnana takes up not only our parts of knowledge and will , but our parts of affection and delight and changes them into action of the divine Ananda .
kha: Ka Vijnana ka shim ym tang ia ki bynta jong ka jingtip bad ka mon jong ngi , hynrei ia ki bynta jong ka jingieit bad jingsngewbha jong ngi bad ka pynkylla ia ki sha ka jingleh jong u Ananda ba kynja blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Vijnana kam shim tang ia ki bynta jong ka jingtip bad ka mon jong ngi , hynrei ki bynta jong ngi jong ka jingieit bad ka jingsngewbha bad ka pynkylla ia ki sha ka jingtreikam jong ka Ananda ba kynja Blei .

en: Thy hands were not bound , nor thy feet put into fetters : as a man falleth before wicked men , so fellest thou . And all the people wept again over him .
kha: Ym shym la teh ïa ki kti jong u , Bad ïa ki kjat jong u ym shym la khum ; U la ïap kum uba la shah pynïap ha ki nongkamsniew !  Bad ki briew baroh ki la ïam sa shisien pat na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong me kim shym la shah teh, lymne ki kjat jong me kim shym la shah teh: kumba u briew u hap ha khmat ki briew kiba sniew, kumta me la iam biang halor jong u . Bad ki briew baroh ki iam biang halor jong u .

en: Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .
kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  Ka jingshyrkhei kaba khraw i pa jong nga i la leh ïa ki briew jong ngi ! Khmih haduh katno nga sngew ïohbor namar ba nga bam khyndiat ka ngap !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jonathan u la ong: peit, nga kyrpad ia phi, kumno ki khmat jong nga ki la shai, namar nga la mad khyndiat na kane ka umsoh .

en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith , and labour of love , and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ , in the sight of God and our Father ;
kha: Naba ngi kynmaw ha khmat U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi ba kumno phi pyntreikam ïa ka jingngeit , kumta ba ka jingieit jong phi ka pynlah ïa phi ban trei shitom , bad kumno ka jingkyrmen jong phi ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ka long kaba skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba kynmaw khlem sangeh ia ka kam jong ka jingngeit jong phi, bad ka jingtrei shitom jong ka jingieit, bad ka jingshaniah ha U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist, ha khmat U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi;

en: Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .
kha: U la kylli na ki katto katne ki rangbah ha Enaim ,  Shano kato ka nuti kaba don hangne harud lynti ?   Ym ju don nuti hangne ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la kylli ia ki briew jong kata ka jaka, u da ong, Hangno ka long kaba paw hajan ka lynti ? Ki la ong , Ym shym la don ka jaka kaba don ha kane ka jaka .

en: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law , It is good , my daughter , that thou go out with his maidens , that they meet thee not in any other field .
kha: Ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Ruth ,  Ho-oid , ko khun kynthei jong nga ; kan kham bha shibun ïa phi ban trei bad ki kynthei ha ka lyngkha jong u Boas . Phi lah ban shah leh bymdei lada phi leit sha ka lyngkha jong kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Naomi u la ong ha ka Ruth ka khun jong ka, "Ka long kaba bha, ko khun jong nga, ba me leit shabar bad ki shakri jong u, ba kim iakynduh ia me ha kano kano ka lyngkha .

en: A widely respected religious figure , Jesus Christ , indicated that false religion produces bad works , just as a “rotten tree produces worthless fruit .”
kha: U riewniam ia uba la niewkor bha da baroh , u Jisu Krist , ula kdew ba kum kita ki niam ki pynmih ki kam kiba sniew , kumba “u dieng uba pyut u pynmih ki soh ki bym dondoreiei .”
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba la shah burom bha ha ka niam , U Jisu Khrist , u la pyni ba ka niam lamler ka pynmih ia ki kam kiba sniew , kumba u dieng uba la tyrkhong u pynmih ia ki soh ki bym don dor .

en: He couched , he lay down as a lion , and as a great lion : who shall stir him up ? Blessed is he that blesseth thee , and cursed is he that curseth thee .
kha: Kane ka jaitbynriew ka long kum u sing uba khlaiñ ; Haba u thiah , ym don ba nud ban kyrsiew ïa u . Uta uba kyrkhu ïa ki Israel un ïoh jingkyrkhu , Bad uta uba tim ïa ki Israel un ïoh ka jingtim .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shong , u la thiah kum u sing uba khraw: mano ba pynkhih ia u ? La kyrkhu ia uta uba kyrkhu ia me bad la tim ia uta uba tim ia me .

en: He also that had received two talents came and said , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me two talents : behold , I have gained two other talents beside them .
kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga ar hajar tylli ki sbai . Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa ar hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’
translated_en_to_kha: U ruh uba la ioh ar tylli ki talent u la wan bad u la ong, ko Trai, me la aiti ha nga ar tylli ki talent: ha khmih nga la ioh ar tylli kiwei pat ki talent nalor jong ki .

en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .
kha: Kin ïeng jngai bah na ka , namar ba ki sheptieng ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshitom jong ka . Ki ong ,  Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ! Kane ka nongbah Babilon kaba khraw bad kaba khlaiñbor ! Tang hapoh shi kynta pha la shah pynshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ieng jngai na ka bynta ka jingtieng ia ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka, ka ong, Ah, kata ka nongbah kaba khraw Babilon, kata ka nongbah kaba khlain bor ! namar ha ka shi kynta ka jingbishar jong me ka wan .

en: And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand  ;
kha: Haba u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u ksiew jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh , u la ïohi ïa kane , u ïeng joit bad u mih na kata ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Phinehas u khun u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh u la iohi ia ka, u la ieng na pdeng ka jingiaseng bad u la shim ia ka javelin ha ka kti jong u;

en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour  ; and love no false oath : for all these are things that I hate , saith the  Lord .
kha: Wat thmu ïa ki rukom pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat . Wat ai ïa ka jingsakhi lamler ha kaba jingsmai . Nga isih ïa ka jinglamler , ka jingbymlehhok bad ka jinglehbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat ai ba uno uno na phi un pyrkhat ia ka jingsniew ha ki dohnud jong u para marjan jong u; bad wat ieit ia ka jingsmai kaba bakla: namar kine baroh ki long kiei kiei kiba nga shun , ong U Trai .

en: Then shall the father of the damsel , and her mother , take and bring forth the tokens of the damsel s virginity unto the elders of the city in the gate :
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong kata ka briew kin leit rah bad pyn-i ïa ki dak ka jinglong sotti jong kata ka briew ha ka ïingbishar jong ki nongïalam shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u kpa jong ka dam bad ka kmie jong ka kin shim bad wanrah ia ki dak jong ka jinglong kynthei ha ki rangbah jong ka shnong ha ka khyrdop:

en: But to the rest speak I , not the Lord : If any brother hath a wife that believeth not , and she be pleased to dwell with him , let him not put her away .
kha: Ha kiwei nga ong ( ma nga da lade hi , ym dei U Trai ) : Lada u parabangeit u don ka tnga ka bymngeit bad ka mynjur ban ïaishong bad u , um dei ban pyllait noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kaba sah nga kren , ym U Trai: Lada uno uno u hynmen u don ka tnga kaba ym ngeit , bad ka sngewbha ban shong bad u , wat ai ba un kyntait ia ka .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ba ka por kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israel bad Judah da ki briew bad ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , ba ngan bet ia ka iing Israel bad ka iing Judah da u symbai u briew bad da u symbai u mrad .

en: They lavish gold out of the bag , and weigh silver in the balance , and hire a goldsmith  ; and he maketh it a god : they fall down , yea , they worship .
kha: Ki briew ki plied ïa la ki pla pisa bad ki theh shabar ïa ka ksiar ; ki thew ïa ka rupa ha ki tarajur . Ki ainong ïa u bania ban shna durblei ; nangta ki dem ngon bad mane ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynmih ia ka ksiar na ka pla, bad ki khia ia ka rupa ha ka jingthew, bad ki shim ia u nongshna ksiar ; bad u pynlong ia ka u blei: ki hap noh, hooid, ki mane .

en: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .
kha: Katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , u Lebi u khun jong u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Bud ïa nga .  U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid lyngba, u la iohi ia u Lebi u khun u Alphaeus uba shong ha ka jaka pdiang ia ka rukom, bad u la ong ha u, To bud ia nga . U la ieng bad u la bud ia u .

en: Prepare ye war against her  ; arise , and let us go up at noon . Woe unto us ! for the day goeth away , for the shadows of the evening are stretched out .
kha: Kin ïa-ong ,  Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem ! To khreh ! Ngin tur ïaleh ha ka por shiteng sngi !  Hynrei nangta kin ïa-ong ,  Ka la slem palat , ka sngi ka la jan kut artat , bad ki syrngiew janmiet ki la sdang jrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh ia ka thma jong ka ; ka mih, bad to ngin ia leit sha jrong ha ka por shiteng sngi . Ka sngi ka leit noh , namar ki jingdum jong ka janmiet ki la nang jrong .

en: And let that man be as the cities which the  Lord  overthrew , and repented not : and let him hear the cry in the morning , and the shouting at noontide  ;
kha: Ai ba un long kum kito ki nongbah kiba U  Trai  u la pynjot khlem jingisynei . Ai un ïohsngew ïa ka jingud pang ha ka por mynstep bad ka jingmaham thma ha ka por shiteng sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba uta u briew un long kum ki nongbah kiba U Trai u la pynkhih , bad um shym la kylla bamut: bad to ai ba un iohsngew ia ka jingpyrta mynstep , bad ka jingpyrta ha ka por shiteng sngi;

en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .
kha: Haba u briew uba hok u sangeh ban leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad hadien kata u ïap , u ïap namar ka jingsniew kaba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew uba hok u phai noh na ka hok jong u, bad u pynbeit ia ka jingbymhok jong u, bad u iap ha ki ; namar ka jingbymhok jong u kaba u la leh un iap .

en: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .
kha: U Eser , u khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jong ka Mispah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha khmat ka jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka kynroh ka phai ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hajan jong u u la pynbha ia u Eser u khun u Jeshua, u nongsynshar jong ka Mizpah, kawei pat ka bynta pyrshah ia ka jingleit sha ka jaka ri jingri ha ka jingkylla jong ka kynroh .

en: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes , the chief ruler of the synagogue , and beat him before the judgment seat . And Gallio cared for none of those things .
kha: Ki baroh ki la kem ïa u Sosthenes , uta u nongïalam jong ka synagog , bad ki la shoh ïa u ha khmat jong ka ïingbishar . Hynrei kata kam shym pynsalia wat khyndiat ruh ïa u Gallio .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Grik baroh ki la shim ia u Soostenes, u nongsynshar ba ha khlieh duh jong ka synagog bad ki la shoh ia u ha khmat ka jaka bishar . Bad u Gallio um shym la sumar ia kata kawei ruh na kita kiei kiei .

en: For unto us was the gospel preached , as well as unto them : but the word preached did not profit them , not being mixed with faith in them that heard it .
kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka Khubor Babha , kumba ma ki ruh ki la ïohsngew . Ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ruh ïa ki , namar haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , kim shym la pdiang ïa ka da ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ngi la ialap ia ka gospel, kumjuh ruh ha ki: hynrei ka ktien ba la ialap kam shym la myntoi ia ki , ym shym la khleh lang bad ka jingngeit ha kito kiba la iohsngew ia ka .

en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .
kha: To U Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! Bad phi tip shai kdar katno ba u la leh na ka bynta jong nga ha Ephesos .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un ai ha u ba un shem ia ka jingisynei U Trai ha kata ka sngi: bad ha kiei kiei kiba u la shakri ia nga ha Ephesos , me tip bha .

en: And the men took that present , and they took double money in their hand , and Benjamin  ; and rose up , and went down to Egypt , and stood before Joseph .
kha: Kumta kita shi para ki shim ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha , ki rah pisa sa ar shah , bad ki leit noh sha Ijipt ryngkat bad u Benjamin . Hangta ki la leit ïakynduh ïa u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la shim ia kata ka jingai sngewbha, bad ki la shim ar shah ia ka pisa ha ka kti jong ki, bad u Benjamin bad u la ieng, bad u la hiar sha Ijipt bad u la ieng ha khmat u Joseph .

en: And when the dew that lay was gone up , behold , upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing , as small as the hoar frost on the ground .
kha: Ynda kata ka umjer ka la rkhiang , la don kaei re kaei kaba stang bad ni phup phup , kum u thah halor ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka dew kaba la thiah ka la kiew, ha khmih, ha ka khmat jong ka ri khlaw ka la don kaei kaei kaba rit kaba pyllun, kumba ka long kaba rit kum ka hoar kaba la tyrkhong ha ka khyndew .

en: * ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .
kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka shong kulai halor une u mrad synshar pyrthei ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad ban pyniaid ia la ka jingialam .
translated_en_to_kha: * (Ka Jingpynpaw 17 :10-13 ) Ka niam kaba bakla ka iaid lyngba ia kane ka mrad sain pyrthei , ka pyrshang ban pynkhih ia ki rai jong ka bad ban tehlakam ia ka lynti jong ka .

en: Like a crane or a swallow , so did I chatter : I did mourn as a dove : mine eyes fail with looking upward : O  Lord  , I am oppressed  ; undertake for me .
kha: Ka sur jong nga ka rit bad tlot , bad nga ud kum ka paro . Ki khmat jong nga ki la thait na kaba khmied sha bneng . A  Trai  , pyllait im ïa nga na kane ka jingjynjar baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka krem ne ka rong saw, kumta nga la rkhie bein: Nga la iam kum ka paro: ki khmat jong nga ki jah noh da kaba peit sha jrong: Ko Trai, nga la shah pynshitom bein; nga la shah pynshitom bein na ka bynta jong nga .

en: But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
kha: pynban ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei , U Kpa , uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bynta jong u ngi im ; bad don tang uwei U Trai , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad ha u ba ngi im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei, U Kpa, na uba kiei kiei baroh, bad ngi ha u ; bad uwei U Trai Jisu Khrist, da uba kiei kiei baroh ki long bad ngi da u .

en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will help thee .
kha: U Joab u ong ïa u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga , bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit ban ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Lada ki Syria ki long kiba khlain palat ia nga: hynrei lada ki khun Ammon ki long kiba khlain palat ia me , te ngan iarap ia me .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :
kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban kren ha ki lyngdoh , ki khun u Aaron , bad ong ha ki ba uno uno na ki um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka por ba lehniam haba don uba ïap napdeng ki briew jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Kren ha ki lyngdoh ki khun shynrang u Aaron bad ong ha ki: Ym don ba shah pynjakhlia na ka bynta kiba iap hapdeng ki briew jong u:

en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ai ka jingainguh thang kaba thiang ha U Trai ; uwei u masi uba dang rit, uwei u langbrot bad hynriew ngut ki langbrot kiba nyngkong snem khlem jingduna:

en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
kha: Sa shisien pat kin shong hapoh ka jingïada jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kew bad seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pawnam kum ka waiñ jong ka Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba shong hapoh ka jingdum jong u kin wan phai biang kum u kew bad kin san kum u sohjew: ka jingsma jong ka kan long kum ka wain jong ka Lebanon .

en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen , and of the traffick of the spice merchants , and of all the kings of Arabia , and of the governors of the country .
kha: nalor ki khajna ba la siew da ki nongkhaïi , ki jingïohnong na ka khaïi ka pateng , ka bai nguh syiem na ki syiem Arabia , bad na ki lat jong ki distrik ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ba u don na ki nongkhaii , bad na ka jingkhaii ia ki nongkhaii ba thiang , bad na ki syiem baroh jong ka ri Arabia .

en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many : yet they shall fall by the sword , and by flame , by captivity , and by spoil , many days .
kha: Ki nongïalam bastad jong ki briew kin ïasam ïa ka jingstad jong ki bad kiwei pat ki briew babun . Hynrei shipor katto katne na ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane shah thang ïap , bad katto katne kin shah lute bad shah pynlong koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba sngewthuh hapdeng ki briew kin hikai ia kiba bun: hynrei kin hap da ka waitlam bad da ka ding, da ka jingshah set bad da ka jingshah pynjot, bun sngi .

en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel  ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .
kha: U Dabid u ai hukum ïa baroh ki nongwei baroh kiba shong basah ha Ri Israel ban ïalumlang , bad u pyntrei ïa ki . Katto katne na ki , ki shna ïa ki mawkynroh ban tei ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la hukum ban lum lang ia ki nongwei kiba don ha ka ri Israel ; bad u la buh maw ban tih ia ki maw ba la shna da ki maw ban tei ia ka iing U Blei .

en: Nevertheless what saith the scripture ? Cast out the bondwoman and her son : for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman .
kha: Hynrei aïu ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ? Ka ïathuh ,  Beh noh ïa ka kynthei mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka ; naba u khun jong ka kynthei mraw un ym ïoh bynta na ka jingdon jingem u kpa lem bad u khun jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh kaei kaba ong ka jingthoh ? Pynduh noh ia ka kynthei bad u khun jong ka: namar u khun jong ka kynthei un ym long u nongioh pateng bad u khun jong u khun laitluid .

en: But Amaziah would not hear  ; for it came of God , that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom .
kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor . Ka dei ka mon U Blei ba U Amasaïah un shahjop , namar ba u la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki nong Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Amasaiah un ym iohsngew ia ka namar ka la wan na U Blei, ba un aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki, namar ki la wad ia ki blei jong u Edom .

en: Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea , as the  Lord  spake unto me : and we compassed mount Seir many days .
kha: ngi leit phai sha ka ri shyiap shaphang ka Duriaw Basaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad ngi la pynlut por slem ha kaba ïaid sakma ha ri lum Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngi la phai noh, bad ngi la leit sha ka ri khlaw da ka lynti jong ka duriaw Basaw, kumba U Trai u la kren ha nga: bad ngi la iaid lait ia u lum Seir bun sngi .

en: Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will do judgment upon her graven images : and through all her land the wounded shall groan .
kha: Te nangta , nga ong ba ka por ka poi ba ngan leh ei ei ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilon , bad kiba mynsaw kin ud ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, U Trai, ba ngan leh ia ka jingbishar halor ki dur ba la ker jong ka: bad lyngba ka ri jong ka baroh kawei .

en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever  ; yea , I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness , and in judgment , and in lovingkindness , and in mercies .
kha: Ko Israel , ngan pynlong ïa pha ka tnga jong nga ; ngan lehhok bad ïaineh ; ngan pyn-i ïa pha ïa ka jingieit baneh bad ïa ka jingisynei bad ngan pynlong ïa pha ka jong nga junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ialeh ia me ha nga junom;

en: And I will bless her , and give thee a son also of her : yea , I will bless her , and she shall be a mother of nations  ; kings of people shall be of her .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ka , bad ngan ai khun shynrang ïa me na ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa ka , bad kan long ka kmie jong ki jaitbynriew ; bad yn don ruh napdeng ki khun ki ksiew ki ban long ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan kyrkhu ia ka bad ngan ai ia me ruh ia u khun shynrang jong ka: hooid , ngan kyrkhu ia ka , bad kan long ka kmie jong ki jaitbynriew ; ki syiem ki briew kin long na ka .

en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .
kha: Bunsien u mynsiem bymkhuid u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u da ka bret ïa u ha ka ding bad ha ka um . To isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada me lah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bunsien ka la bret ia u ha ka ding bad ha ki um, ban pynjot ia u: hynrei lada me lah ban leh ei ei, to sngewsynei ia ngi bad iarap ia ngi .

en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
kha: bad uta u samla ruh um shym la pynslem ban leh ïa kata kaba la ai jingmut , namar ba u la ibha eh ïa ka khun jong u Jakob . U long ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u samla u la slem ban leh ia kata ka kam, namar u la sngewbha ia ka khun jong u Jakob: bad u la kham donburom ban ia ka iing u kpa jong u baroh .

en: Beside the chief of Solomon s officers which were over the work , three thousand and three hundred , which ruled over the people that wrought in the work .
kha: bad u la buh lai hajar laispah ngut ki riewkhmat kiba peit ïa ki bad kiba pynïaid ïa ki jingtrei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor u rangbah jong u Solomon uba la long halor ka kam, lai hajar bad lai spah ngut ki briew kiba la trei ha ka kam .

en: Pilate saith unto him , What is truth ? And when he had said this , he went out again unto the Jews , and saith unto them , I find in him no fault at all .
kha: Bad kaei kata ka jingshisha ?  u Pilat u la kylli . Nangta u Pilat u la mihpat shabar sha ki paidbah bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ngam lap kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pilat u ong ha u , Kaei ka jingshisha ? Bad haba u la ong ia kane , u la leit phai biang sha ki Jiw bad u la ong ha ki , Ngam shem ha u ei ei ruh em .

en: Therefore was he hired , that I should be afraid , and do so , and sin , and that they might have matter for an evil report , that they might reproach me .
kha: Ki la pyndonkam ïa u ban pyntieng ïa nga sha ka jingleh pop , khnang ba ki lah ban pynsniew ïa nam babha jong nga bad pynjahburom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la thung ia u , ba ngan tieng , bad leh kumta bad leh pop , bad ba kin don ka jingeh na ka bynta ka khubor kaba sniew , ba kin kyntait ia nga .

en: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him : I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .
kha: Ki paid Israel kim don bynta ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad sumar ïa ki ; kum u dieng ba ïai jyrngam ngan kah tngen ïa ki ; nga long u tynrai jong ki jingkyrkhu jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim un ong , Nga don ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ? Nga la iohsngew ia u, bad nga la iohi ia u: Nga long kum u dieng ding uba jyrngam . Na nga la shem ia u soh jong me .

en: And ye came near and stood under the mountain  ; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven , with darkness , clouds , and thick darkness .
kha: Ïathuh ha ki khun ki kti jong phi kumno phi leit ïeng ha trai uta u lum ha uba u lyoh tdem uba ïong synñia u tap bad na uba ka ding kaba rhem ka klang shaduh suiñbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan hajan bad u la ieng hapoh u lum ; bad u lum u la thang da ka ding haduh pdeng ka bneng , da ka jingdum , ki lyoh bad ka jingdum kaba jylliew .

en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?
kha: Ka kmie jong u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker .  Balei ka kali ïapom jong u ka slem ban wan ?  ka la ong .  Balei ki kulai jong u ki tud ban wan phai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kmie jong u Sisera ka peit shabar sha kawei ka jingkhang , bad ka la pyrta lyngba ka lattice , Balei ka kali jong u ka long kaba jrong haduh katne por ban wan ? balei ban sah ia ki tyrpeng jong ki kali jong u ?

en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .
kha: Tang hadien khyndiat por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lyer ka sdang ban beh bad u slap bajur u sdang ban hap . U Ahab u shong ha ka kali ïapom bad u sdang ban leit phai sha Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por ba ka bneng ka la dum bad ki lyoh bad ka Iyer kaba jur . U Ahab u la shong kulai bad u la leit sha Jesel .

en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .
kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Mikaïah ka khun u Uriel , na ka nongbah Gibeah . Ka thma ka la khie hapdeng u Abijah bad u Jeroboam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kyrteng jong ka kmie jong u ruh ka long ka khun jong u Uriel jong ka Gibeah . Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Abijah bad u Jerboiah .

en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .
kha: Kaei kaba ngi hikai ïa phi mynta ka long ka jinghikai jong U Trai : Ma ngi kiba dang im ha ka sngi ba U Trai u wan , ngin ym leit ha shuwa jong kito kiba la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ngi ong ha phi da ka ktien U Trai , ba ngi kiba im bad kiba sah haduh ka jingwan U Trai ngin ym khang ia kiba iohthiah .

en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed .
kha: Uwei na ki , u Sedekaïah , u khun jong u Khenaanah , u thaw ki reng nar bad u ong ha u Ahab ,  Kane ka dei kaba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Da kine phin ïaleh ïa ki Syria bad jop thiaw ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u khun u Chenaah u la pynlong ia u da ki nar , bad u la ong , Kumta ong U Trai , Da kine me pynkhih ia ka Syria haduh ba kin da shah pynjot .

en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this , she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she , and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms .
kha: Wat la ka Oholibah , ka para jong ka , ka ïohi ïa kane , ka kham shlur bad kham long nuti ban ïa kaba ka Oholah ka la ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka para jong ka ka la iohi ia kane, ka la kham bamsap ha ka jingieit kaba khlem ryntih jong ka ban ia ka, bad ha ki jaka ri jingri jong ka kham bun ban ia ka para jong ka ha ki jaka ri jingri jong ka .

en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u la leit sha ki nonglamktien jong u Balak bad u ong ,  Khie leit phai sha la ïing ; U  Trai  um shah ba ngan leit bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ieng mynstep bad u la ong ha ki rangbah Balak: To leit sha ka ri jong phi: namar U Trai u kyntait ban ailad ia nga ban leit bad phi .

en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;
kha: U Mynsiem u la ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki ban iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit ha ki Ïa kiba khatduh : Kin kohnguh ïa ki mynsiem bashukor bad kin bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Mynsiem u kren shai , ba ha ki por kiba hadien don kiba leit noh na ka jingngeit , da kaba pyrkhat ia ki mynsiem kiba pynshoi ia ki mynsiem bad ki jinghikai jong ki ksuid ; .

en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul , and to let him have liberty , and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him .
kha: U la hukum ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa u Paul ban buh ïa u hapoh ka jingap phira , hynrei ban ai ha u katto katne ka jinglaitluid bad ban shah ïa ki paralok jong u ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia u rangbah shipai ban sumar ia u Paul , bad ban ailad ia u ban ioh ia ka jinglaitluid , bad ba un khang ia u briew uba u ithuh ban shakri ne wan sha u .

en: For this cause , when I could no longer forbear , I sent to know your faith , lest by some means the tempter have tempted you , and our labour be in vain .
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la phah ïa u Timothi . Ngam lah shah shuh , kumta nga la phah ïa u ban tip shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi . Da shisha kam lah ban long ba u Ksuid u la pynshoi ïa phi bad ba ka kam jong ngi baroh ka la long kaba lehnoh-ei !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka daw , haba ngam lah shuh ban kyntait , nga la phah ban tip ia ka jingngeit jong phi , ioh da kumno kumno u nongpynshoi u la pynshoi ia phi , bad ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi ka long lehnohei .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The hour is coming , and now is , when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God : and they that hear shall live .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ba ka por kan poi — ka por ka la lah poi — haba kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Khun U Blei , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kin ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Ka por kan sa wan, bad mynta ka long, haba kiba iap kin iohsngew ia ka sur U Khun U Blei: bad kito kiba iohsngew kin im .

en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;
kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , khnang ban beh noh ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Manasseh u la leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ha ka hukum U Trai ka la wan ia kane ha Judah, ban weng noh ia ki na ka khmat jong u, namar ki pop jong u Manasseh, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh;

en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly , then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it , and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing .
kha: Lada uno uno u briew u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh khlem da poi pyrkhat u bam ïa kano kano ka jingkñia ainguh , u dei ban pynphai sha uta u lyngdoh ïa ka dor jong ka bad un ai ruh nalor kata sa shi bynta na ka san bynta jong ka dor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u briew u bam ia ka jingbam bakhuid khlem da tip , te un buh ia ka shi bynta na ka san bynta ha ka , bad un ai ia ka ha u lyngdoh ryngkat bad ka jingkhuid .

en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day , neither do ye any work , but hallow ye the sabbath day , as I commanded your fathers .
kha: lane rah ïa kano kano shabar ki ïing jong ki ha ka Sabbaton . Kim dei ban trei ha ka Sabbaton ; ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi bakyntang , kumba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat rah ia ka jingkit na ki iing jong phi ha ka sngi Sabha , lymne phim leh ei ei ruh em , hynrei to pynkhuid ia ka sngi Sabha kumba nga la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: The  Lord  shall smite thee in the knees , and in the legs , with a sore botch that cannot be healed , from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head .
kha: U  Trai  un tap ïa ki kjat jong phi baroh da ki prum ki bym lah ban pynkhiah bad kiba tyrha ; ki tohjaw kin tap ïa phi naduh khlieh haduh kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un shoh ia me ha ki kjat bad ha ki kjat jong me, da ka jingpang kaba ym lah ban pynkoit, naduh tang ka kjat jong me haduh ka tduh jong ka khlieh jong me .

en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .
kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la poi ha ka Balang ha Jerusalem , kumta ki la phah ïa u Barnabas sha Antiokh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka khubor jong kine kiei kiei ka la poi ha ki shkor jong ka balang kaba don ha Jerusalem : bad ki la phah noh ia u Barnabas , ba u dei ban leit haduh Antiok .

en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;
kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba me wan rung ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me kum ka pateng, bad me don ia ka, bad me shong hangta;

en: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
kha: ‘ Me u shakri uba sniew bad uba jaipdeh !’ u kynrad jong u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingot na kaba ngam shym bet , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngam shym bet symbai ?
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u u la jubab bad u la ong ha u: Me u shakri uba sniew bad uba sniew, me tip ba nga kheit ha ka jaka ba ngam shym la bet bad lum ha ka jaka ba ngam shym la bet:

en: But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all  ; yet let him remember the days of darkness  ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .
kha: To long uba sngewnguh ïa kawei pa kawei ka snem ba phi im . Kam pher haduh katno phi im , kynmaw ba phin ïap kham slem . Kam don kano kano ruh ïa ka ban khmih lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u briew u im bun snem, bad u kmen ha ki baroh ; hynrei to ai ba un kynmaw ia ki sngi jong ka jingdum ; namar kin long kiba bun . Baroh kaba wan ka long kaba khlem jingmut .

en: Behold , I and the children whom the  Lord  hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the  Lord  of hosts , which dwelleth in mount Zion .
kha: Nga don hangne bad ki khun kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jong u ka long halor u Lum Seïon , u la phah ïa ngi kum ki khubor ba-im sha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ma nga bad ki khun kiba U Trai u la ai ha nga ki long ki dak bad ki jingphylla ha Israel na U Trai jong ki paid kiba shong ha u lum Seion .

en: But now they desire a better country , that is , an heavenly : wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God : for he hath prepared for them a city .
kha: Pynban , ka ri kaba ki kwah hir hir ka long ka ri kaba kham bha , ka ri ba kynja bneng . Bad kumta U Blei um sngewlehrain ïa ki , ba yn khot ïa u , U Blei jong ki , namar u la pynkhreh ka nongbah na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ki kwah ia ka ri kaba kham bha, kata ka long kaba ha bneng: namar kata U Blei um sngewlehrain ban shah khot U Blei jong ki: namar u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki ia ka nongbah .

en: And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .
kha: Kumta ka jubab jong ki ïa U Jisu ka la long ,  Ngim tip .  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ruh ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha U Jisu, Ngim lah ban iathuh . U Jisu u la jubab ia ki .

en: And when he cometh home , he calleth together his friends and neighbours , saying unto them , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found my sheep which was lost .
kha: Nangta u khot lang ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u bad u ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka langbrot jong nga kaba la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u wan phai sha la iing , u khot lang ia ki paralok bad ki para marjan jong u , u da ong ha ki: To sngewbha bad nga ; namar nga la shem ia ki langbrot jong nga kiba la jah .

en: And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .
kha: Katba ki dang leit lyngba ïa ki shnong , ki la ai ha ki parabangeit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ha Jerusalem ki la rai , bad ki la bthah ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang iaid lyngba ki shnong , ki la aiti ha ki ia ki hukum ban bat , kiba la buh da ki apostol bad ki rangbah kiba don ha Jerusalem .

en: And they slew every one his man : and the Syrians fled  ; and Israel pursued them : and Ben–hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen .
kha: bad uwei pa uwei u la pynïap ïa u briew uba u ïaleh . Ki nong Syria ki phet ïap , bad ki Israel ki beh kthong , hynrei u Benhadad u la lait im da kaba u shong halor u kulai , ïa kaba la synran da katto katne ngut ki shipai shong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyniap ia uwei pa uwei u briew jong u: bad ki Syria ki la phet noh bad ki Israel ki la beh ia ki: bad u Benhadad u syiem Syria u la lait im da u kulai bad ki kulai .

en: Behold , I will take away the posterity of Baasha , and the posterity of his house  ; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
kha: Ki pop jong ki , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa nga , bad kumta ngan pyndam noh ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Jeroboam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan weng noh ia ka jaitbynriew jong u Basah bad ia ka jaitbynriew jong u ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka iing jong me kum ka iing u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat .

en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .
kha: Hynrei haba ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u Philip shaphang ka khubor babha jong ka Hima U Blei bad shaphang U Jisu Khrist , la pynbaptis ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki la ngeit ia u Philip uba ialap ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad ka hima U Blei bad ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist , la pynbaptis ia ki , shynrang bad kynthei .

en: But the hour cometh , and now is , when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth : for the Father seeketh such to worship him .
kha: Hynrei ka por ka poi bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ha ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ki briew kin mane ïa U Kpa kumba u long hi , da kaba ai ha u ïa ka jingmane kaba shisha kaba u dawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka por ka wan, bad mynta ka long, haba ki nongmane bashisha kin mane ia U Kpa ha ka mynsiem bad ha ka jingshisha: namar U Kpa u wad ia kiba kum kita ban mane ia u .

en: And Reuben spake unto his father , saying , Slay my two sons , if I bring him not to thee : deliver him into my hand , and I will bring him to thee again .
kha: U Reuben u ong ha la u kpa ,  Lada ngam wan ïalam biang sha phi ïa u Benjamin , phi lah ban pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut . Buh ïa u ha ka jingsumar jong nga , bad ngan wan ïalam biang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la kren ha u kpa jong u, u da ong: To sngap ia ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong nga, lada ngam wanrah ia u ha me: to aiti ia u ha ka kti jong nga, bad ngan wanrah biang ia u ha me .

en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
kha: Nangta u Eleasar un shim khyndiat na ka snam jong ka bad un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien da la ka shynriah ti sha ka phang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eleasar u lyngdoh un shim ia ka snam jong ka da ka kti jong u, bad un theh ia ka snam jong ka beit ha khmat ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng hynriew sien:

en: And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .
kha: Hadien ba ki la ai ïa ka jingphla jong ki bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Ha lynti ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiba bun ki shnong ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem bad ki la ialap ia ka ktien U Trai .

en: But that ye also may know my affairs , and how I do , Tychicus , a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord , shall make known to you all things :
kha: U Tukhikos u long u parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u shakri baïaineh ha ka kam U Trai , un ïathuh lut ïa ka khubor shaphang jong nga , khnang ba phin tip kumno nga ïaid shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba phi ruh phin tip ia ki kam jong nga, bad kumno nga leh, u Tikhikos, u hynmen baieit bad u shakri ba iaineh ha U Trai, un pyntip ia phi ia kiei kiei baroh:

en: And when the camp setteth forward , Aaron shall come , and his sons , and they shall take down the covering veil , and cover the ark of testimony with it :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ka camp ka la shong sha khmat , u Aaron un wan bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad kin weng noh ia ka jingtap bad kin tap ia ka synduk ka jingsakhi da ka:

en: Which things also we speak , not in the words which man s wisdom teacheth , but which the Holy Ghost teacheth ; comparing spiritual things with spiritual .
kha: Kumta te , ngim kren ha ki ktien ba la hikai da ka jingstad briew , hynrei ha ki ktien ba la hikai da U Mynsiem , kumba ngi batai ïa ki jingshisha ba kynja mynsiem ha kito kiba don U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei ruh kiba ngi kren, ym ha ki ktien kiba u briew u hikai, hynrei kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u hikai; kaba ianujor ia kiei kiei kiba kynja mynsiem bad kiba kynja mynsiem .

en: Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
kha: Hynrei nalor kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Nga long uba lui lui , da shisha U  Trai  un ym bitar sah ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi len ba phi la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me ong , Namar nga long uba khlem pop, shisha ka jingbitar jong u kan kylla na nga . Ha khmih , ngan kyrpad ia me namar me ong , ngam shym la leh pop .

en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .
kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , uba jrong bad uba khlaiñ . Phi la long khraw haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , bad ka bor jong phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ma me, ko syiem, kaba la san bad kaba khlain: namar ka jingkhraw jong me ka la san bad ka poi sha bneng bad ka jingsynshar jong me haduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew .

en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .
kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ki briew kim lah ban wan kiew shajrong , naba me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñ kyntang ïa u lum bad ban buh dak sawdong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Trai , Ki briew kim lah ban wan shaneng sha u lum Sinai: namar me la kynnoh ia ngi da kaba ong: To buh ia ki pud sawdong u lum bad pynkyntang ia ka .

en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .
kha: Nga la hikai ïa phi ïa ki hukum , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la hukum ïa nga . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la hikai ia phi ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar kumba U Trai U Blei jong nga u la hukum ia nga , ba phi dei ban leh kumta ha ka ri kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
kha: Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jong nga hi , nga ai ha phi . Ngam ai ïa ka kumba ka pyrthei ka ai . Wat sngewkhuslai bad sngewdiaw ; wat sngewsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsuk kaba nga iehnoh bad phi, ka jingsuk jong nga nga ai ha phi: ym kumba ka pyrthei ka ai ha phi . Wat ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan khih , lymne to ai ba kan tieng .

en: Nevertheless , brethren , I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort , as putting you in mind , because of the grace that is given to me of God ,
kha: Hynrei ha kane ka shithi nga la kren kham shlur shaphang katto katne ki phang kiba nga la pynkynmaw ïa phi . Nga la shlur namar ka kabu ba U Blei u la ai ïa nga ban long u shakri jong U Khrist Jisu ban trei na ka bynta ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ko para bangeit, nga la thoh kham shlur ia phi ha kano kano ka rukom, kumba nga buh ha ka jingmut jong phi, namar ka jingaiei kaba la ai ha nga na U Blei .

en: Now the  Lord  had said unto Abram , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and from thy father s house , unto a land that I will shew thee :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Abram ,  Mihnoh na la ka ri , na la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , bad na ka ïing u kpa jong me , bad leit sha ka ri kaba ngan sa pyn-i ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai u la ong ha u Abram: To mih noh na ka ri jong me bad na ka iing jong me bad na ka iing u kpa jong me sha ka ri kaba ngan pyni ia me:

en: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,
kha: Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka ïing paki dulan jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la lum lang ia ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah jong ki briew ha ka iing jong u rangbah lyngdoh uba la khot u Kaiaphas .

en: We grope for the wall like the blind , and we grope as if we had no eyes : we stumble at noonday as in the night  ; we are in desolate places as dead men .
kha: bad ngi tare ruma kum ki briew kiba matlah . Ngi jynthut ha ka por shiteng sngi , la kumba long mynmiet , la kumba ngi don ha ka pyrthei kaba dum jong kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi iaid na ka bynta ka jingkhang kum kiba matlah, bad ngi iaid kum ki khmat: ngi ia tyngkhuh ha ka por shiteng sngi kumba ha ka por miet ; ngi don ha ki jaka ba la jot kum ki briew kiba la iap .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Remove the diadem , and take off the crown : this shall not be the same : exalt him that is low , and abase him that is high .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . To law noh ïa la ka pansngiat bad ka jaiñspong jong me . Yn ym don kaei kaei ruh ka ban sah kumjuh . Kyntiew ïa kiba duk sha ka bor ! Pynhiar ïa kito kiba synshar !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Pynduh noh ia ka khlieh: kane kan ym long kumjuh: pynkiew ia uba rit bad pynjah burom ia uba heh .

en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :
kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi mihnoh na ïing bad u bad wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! Mynta u la tyrkhong bad la bthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u kpu jong ngi ngi la shim na ka bynta ka jingpynbiang jong ngi na ki iing jong ngi ha ka sngi ba ngi wan shabar ban leit sha phi ; hynrei mynta, ha khmih, ka la tyrkhong, bad ka la tyrkhong:

en: Then Jesus answered and said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him hither to me .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno ki bymngeit bad kiba bakla phi ki briew phi long ! Sa katno nga dei ban dang don bad phi ? Sa katno ngan dang ïaishah ïa phi ? To wallam ïa u khynnah shane sha nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong, Ko pateng bym ngeit bad kaba bakla, haduh katno ngan don bad phi ? haduh katno ngan shah shitom ia phi ? wanrah ia u hangne ha nga .

en: And they had breastplates , as it were breastplates of iron  ; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle .
kha: Ïa ki shadem jong ki la tap da kaei kaba i kum ki jingïada shadem da ka nar , bad ka jingsawa kaba mih na ki thapniang jong ki ka long kum ka jingriew jong ki kali kulai thma babun kiba leit tur sha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki bniat , kumba ki long ki bniat nar ; bad ka jingsawa jong ki bniat jong ki ka long kum ka jingsawa jong ki kali kit kulai kiba bun kiba mareh sha ka thma .

en: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .
kha: kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa u bad ai ha u nongsynshar nongwei . Un sa ainong ïa uta u dieng ïa kaei kaba u dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la aiti ia u ha ka kti jong u riewshlur: nga la beh noh ia u namar ka jingsniew jong u .

en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .
kha: Ha kito ki sngi ym don mano mano ba lah ban wan bad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjynjar bad jingkhihwin ha ka ri baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita ki por ym shym la don jingsuk ia uta uba la mih shabar, ne ia uta uba la wan rung , hynrei ki jingsngewsih kiba khraw ki la don ha ki nongshong shnong baroh .

en: Because they had not executed my judgments , but had despised my statutes , and had polluted my sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers  idols .
kha: Nga la leh ïa kane namar ba ki la lah kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton , bad mane ïa kijuh ki bleithaw kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la pyndep ia ki jingbishar jong nga , hynrei ki la leh bein ia ki ain jong nga , bad ki la pynjakhlia ia ki Sabha jong nga , bad ki khmat jong ki ki long hadien ki kpa jong ki ki bleithaw jong ki .

en: We certify the king that , if this city be builded again , and the walls thereof set up , by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river .
kha: Ngi sngewskhem , namarkata , ba lada ïa kane ka nongbah la tei pat bad ba ïa ki kynroh la pyndep , ko Syiem , phin ym lah shuh ban pynïaid ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi pynshisha ia u syiem ba lada la tei pat ia kane ka shnong bad ki kynroh jong ka ki kiew , da kane ka rukom men ym don bynta ei ei ha kane ka liang ka wah .

en: In those days shall Judah be saved , and Jerusalem shall dwell safely : and this is the name wherewith she shall be called , The  Lord  our righteousness .
kha: Ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem yn pyllait im bad kin im hapdeng ka jingshngain . Ïa ka nongbah yn khot ‘ U  Trai  ka Jingpynim jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi yn pynim ia ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kan shong suk: bad kane ka long ka kyrteng da kaba yn khot ia ka: U Trai jong ngi .

en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Ki khun jong phi ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khun shynrang baheh duh jong phi , haba ka  erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren , la wan ruh uwei pat bad u la ong , Ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me ki dang bam bad dih wain ha iing u hynmen rangbah jong ki:

en: For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , ngam pat shym la iehnoh ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah , wat la ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Israel kim shym la shah iehnoh, ne u Judah jong u Blei jong u, na U Trai jong ki paid ; wat la ka ri jong ki ka la dap da ka pop pyrshah ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And Jesse said unto David his son , Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn , and these ten loaves , and run to the camp to thy brethren  ;
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jesse u ong ha u Dabid ,  Shim shiphew kilo une u krai sdieh bad kine ki kpu shiphew tylli , bad leit rah kyrkieh ïa ki sha ki hynmen jong phi ha ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jesse u la ong ha u Dabid u khun jong u, To shim mynta na ka bynta ki hynmen jong me ia une u kew ba la tyrkhong bad kine ki shiphew tylli ki kpu bad mareh sha ka jaka sah jong me ha ki hynmen jong me;

en: Swear now therefore unto me by the  Lord  , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me , and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father s house .
kha: Hynrei kular ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba phin ri pynim ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , ba kumta ka kyrteng jong nga bad ka kyrteng ka jait jong nga kan ym jah junom .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap jar mynta ha nga da U Trai, ba men ym ot noh ia u symbai jong nga hadien jong nga, bad ba men ym pynjot ia ka kyrteng jong nga na ka iing u kpa jong nga .

en: And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .
kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Barsillai bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , bad u Barsillai u leit phai noh sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la leit sha Jordan . Bad haba u syiem u la wan shajan u Barzillai bad u la kyrkhu ia u ; bad u la leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka jaka .

en: And Saul asked counsel of God , Shall I go down after the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel ? But he answered him not that day .
kha: Kumta u Saul u kylli ïa U Blei ,  Hato ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato men ai ha ngi ka jingjop ?  Hynrei U Blei um shym jubab ha kata ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la kylli ia ka jingai jingmut jong U Blei, Hato ngan hiar hadien ki Philistia ? hato me ai ia ki ha ka kti jong ki Israel ? Hynrei um jubab ia u ha kata ka sngi .

en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh  ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh  ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .
kha: Ka Maakah , ka tnga u Makhir , ka kha ar ngut ki khun shynrang , kiba ka ai kyrteng ïa ki u Peresh bad u Sheresh . U Peresh u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Ulam bad u Rakem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Maachah ka tnga jong u Machir ka la kha khun shynrang, bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Peresh ; bad ka kyrteng jong u hynmen jong u ka long u Sheresh ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki long Ulam bad u Rakem .

en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .
kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi bad kin kylli ,  U la kular ban wan , hato um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u don ? Ki kpa tymmen ki la lah ïap , hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki dang ïaisah kumjuh kum mynba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u da ong: Hangno ka jingkular jong ka jingwan jong u ? namar namar namar ba ki kpa ki la iohthiah , kiei kiei baroh ki iai bteng kumba ki la long naduh ka jingsdang jong ka jingthaw .

en: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .
kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u Samuel , kumba u Samuel u la bthah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u Samuel um pat shym wan poi sha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sah hynriew sngi katkum ka por ba la buh: hynrei u Samuel um shym la wan sha Gilgal ; bad ki briew ki la jah noh na u .

en: Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .
kha: U Saul u leit mar mar ryngkat bad lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel sha ka ri khlaw Siph ban wad ïa u Dabid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la ieng bad u la leit hiar sha ka ri khlaw jong u Siph , da kaba don lai hajar ngut ki Israel kiba la jied bad u , ban wad ia u Dabid ha ka ri khlaw jong u Siph .

en: But they that have gathered it shall eat it , and praise the  Lord   ; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness .
kha: Hynrei phi kiba bet bad ot ïa u kew , phin bam ïa u kpu bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , bad phi kiba sumar bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ phin dih ïa ka waiñ ha ki phyllaw ka Templ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kito kiba la lum ia ka kin bam ia ka, bad kin iaroh ia U Trai ; bad kito kiba la wanrah lang kin dih ia ka ha ki iingbishar jong ka jingkhuid jong nga .

en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;
kha: Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jong phi kin pynkhreh ban treikam . To long adkar bad buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kaba yn sa ai ha phi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong phi, to long kiba jemnud bad kyrmen haduh kaba kut na ka bynta ka jingaiei kaba dei ban wanrah ha phi ha ka jingpynpaw U Jisu Khrist;

en: Remember these , O Jacob and Israel  ; for thou art my servant : I have formed thee  ; thou art my servant : O Israel , thou shalt not be forgotten of me .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel to kynmaw ïa kane ; kynmaw ba phi long u shakri jong nga . Nga la thaw ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , bad ngan ym klet ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw ia kine , ko Jakob bad ki Israel; namar me long u shakri jong nga: Nga la thaw ia me; me long u shakri jong nga: Ko Israel , me ym klet ia nga .

en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him : he is an unwise son  ; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children .
kha: Ki Israel ki don ka lad ban im , hynrei ka long kaba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka — kum u khunlung uba la dei ban kha , u bym treh ban mih na ka kpoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingsngewsih jong ka kynthei kaba kha khun kin wan ha u: u long u khun bym don akor namar um dei ban sah slem ha ka jaka ba kha khun .

en: And Jesus said unto the centurion ,  Go thy way  ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee .  And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing , bad ïa kaei kaba me ngeit yn sa leh na ka bynta me .  Bad ïa u shakri jong u rangbah pynïaidkam la pynkhiah ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u rangbah shispah snem, To leit noh bad kumba me la ngeit, kumta to long ha me . Bad u shakri jong u u la koit ha kajuh ka kynta .

en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death : he hath cursed his father or his mother  ; his blood shall be upon him .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .  Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie un shah pynïap ; u la kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei pa uwei uba tim ia la u kpa ne ia ka kmie jong u un shah pyniap: u la tim ia la u kpa ne ia ka kmie jong u; ka snam jong u kan long halor jong u .

en: Shalt thou reign , because thou closest thyself in cedar ? did not thy father eat and drink , and do judgment and justice , and then it was well with him ?
kha: Hato ka pynlong ïa me u syiem uba kham bha lada me tei ki ïing da ki dieng Kedar kiba kham kynsai ban ïa kito ki jong kiwei ? U kpa jong me u la im kyrhai , u long borabor uba hok bad uba leh beit , bad u manbha ha kiei kiei baroh ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me dei ban synshar , namar me khang ia lade ha u sohjew ? hato u kpa jong me um shym la bam bad dih bad leh ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok bad nangta ka la long kaba bha bad u ?

en: And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .
kha: Kumta u Jonathan u khot ïa u Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kita baroh ; nangta u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul , bad u Dabid u shakri ïa u syiem kumba u ju leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la khot ia u Dabid bad u Jonathan u la pyni ia kita kiei kiei baroh . U Jonathan u la wanrah ia u Dabid ha u Saul bad u la don ha khmat jong u kumba ha ki por ba la leit noh .

en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
kha: Nangta ki nongleh myntor jong u Pharaoh ki la leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u dang mutlop hi kumba u long . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh u la kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleh jadu jong ka ri Ijipt ki la leh kumta da ki jingleh jadu jong ki: bad ka dohnud u Pharaoh kam shym la sngap ia ki ; kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .
kha: Kynmaw ba phi ruh phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kynmaw ba me la long u mraw ha ka ri Ijipt , bad U Trai U Blei jong me u la siewspah ia me: namarkata nga hukum ia me ia kane ka jingjia ha ka sngi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la wanrah pyrshah ïa nga ? Kaei kaba pynlong ïa ki ban phai noh na nga ? Ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki hi ki la kylla long ki bymdondor .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Kaei ka jingbymhok kaba ki kpa jong phi ki la shem ha nga , ba ki la leit noh na nga , bad ki la iaid hadien ka jinglong biej , bad ki la kylla long kiba lehnohei ?

en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng ksiar , bad kito kiba don ki law ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha nga . Nga bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad wan mih da une u khun masi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha ki , Uno uno uba don ksiar, to ai ba kin pynpra ia ka . Kumta ki la ai ia ka ha nga: nangta nga la bret ia ka ha ka ding , bad la mih une u khun masi .

en: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee , and consider thee , saying , Is this the man that made the earth to tremble , that did shake kingdoms  ;
kha: Kiba ïap kin peit seh bad ang ïa me . Kin kylli , ‘ Hato une u dei u briew uba la pynkhih ïa ka pyrthei bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki hima ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba iohi ia me kin peit lyngngoh ia me, bad kin pyrkhat ia me, ki da ong: Hato une u briew uba la pynkhih ia ka khyndew, uba la pynkhih ia ki hima ; .

en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields , or a dead body , or a bone of a man , or a grave , shall be unclean seven days .
kha: Lada uno uno u ktah ïa u briew uba la shah pynïap lane uba ïap hi shabar lane lada uno uno u ktah ïa ka shyieng briew lane ïa ka jingtep , ki long ki bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba ktah ia uba la shah pyniap ha ki lyngkha ba plie, ne ka met iap ne ka shyieng jong u briew ne ka jingtep , un long u bymkhuid hynriew sngi .

en: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands , in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ :
kha: Ha U Khrist la otsher ïa phi , ym da ka jingotsher kaba la thaw da ki briew , hynrei da ka jingotsher ba la pynlong da U Khrist , kaba kynthup ïa ka jinglong ba la laitluid na ka bor jong ka pop hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba phi ruh phi la shah ot bad ka jingotsher khlem kti, ha kaba weng noh ia ka met jong ki pop jong ka doh da ka jingotsher U Khrist:

en: Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
kha: Kumta ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un pynmih ïa kane ka hukum bad soi ïa ka , bad kan treikam , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ko syiem, to pynskhem ia ka hukum, bad soi ia ka jingthoh, ba kan ym kylla kat kum ka ain jong ki Media bad ki Persia , kaba ym kylla .

en: There were together Simon Peter , and Thomas called Didymus , and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two other of his disciples .
kha: U Simon Petros , U Thomas ( ba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) , u Nathanael ( uto uba na Kana ha Galilaïa ) , ki khun u Sebedi , bad ar ngut kiwei pat ki synran U Jisu ki la don lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ryngkat bad u Simon Petros bad u Thomas uba la khot u Didymus bad u Nathanael na Kana ha Galilaia bad ki khun shynrang jong u Zebede bad arngut kiwei pat ki synran jong u .

en: Behold , I will do a new thing  ; now it shall spring forth  ; shall ye not know it ? I will even make a way in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert .
kha: To khmih ïa kaba thymmai kaba ngan leh . Ka la jia lypa — phi lah ban ïohi ïa ka mynta ! Ngan pynlong ïa ka lynti lyngba ka ri khlaw bad ïa ki wahduid ngan ai ïa phi na ka um hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan leh ia kaei kaei kaba thymmai ; mynta kan mih shuh shuh; phin ym tip ia ka ? Ngan sa pynlong wat ia ka lynti ha ka ri khlaw bad ki wah ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And they took them out of the midst of the tent , and brought them unto Joshua , and unto all the children of Israel , and laid them out before the  Lord .
kha: Ki wanrah ïa ki shabar ka ïingjaiñ , ki leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua bad sha kita ki Israel baroh , bad ki buh ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ki na pdeng ka ïingjaiñ bad ki la wanrah ïa ki sha u Joshua bad ha ki khun Israel baroh .

en: And their feet were straight feet  ; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf s foot : and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass .
kha: Ki pung kjat jong ki , ki long kiba beit , bad ki don ki khnap kum ki jong u masi dab , bad ki thaba kum ka rnong ba la shut pynphyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat jong ki ki long kiba beit bad ka tyrpeng jong ki ka long kum ka tyrpeng jong u khun masi: bad ki la rben kum ka rong jong ka nar ba la thang .

en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him , and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .
kha: Haba u syiem ka Ninebeh u la ïohsngew shaphang kata , u ïeng joit na la ka khet , u law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u shong ha u dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ktien ka la wan ha u syiem Nineveh, bad u la ieng na ka khet jong u, bad u la buh ia ka jainkup jong u na u, bad u la tap ia u da ka jainkup bad u la shong ha ka dewbilat .

en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .
kha: Ki Jiw ki la kem ïa une u briew bad sa ba kin pynïap ïa u . Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u long u traishnong ka Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bad ki shipai jong nga bad nga la pyllait im ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia une u briew la shim na ki Jiw , bad la dei ban pyniap ia u: nangta nga la wan ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai , bad nga la pyllait im ia u , haba nga la sngewthuh ba u long u Roman .

en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin , so shall thy sons marry thee : and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride , so shall thy God rejoice over thee .
kha: Kum u samla uba shim ïa ka theisotti kum ka nongleitkurim jong u , uta uba pynlong ïa pha un shongkurim ïa pha , kumba u nongleitkurim u shem sngewbha bad ka nongleitkurim jong u , kumta U Blei jong pha un shem sngewbha ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba u samla u shongkurim ia ka nongleh kam sniew, kumta ki khun shynrang jong me kin shongkurim ia me: bad kumba u nongleit kurim u kmen ia ka nongleit kurim , kumta U Blei jong me un kmen ia me .

en: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you  ; but they shall be as thorns in your sides , and their gods shall be a snare unto you .
kha: Kumta nga ong ïa phi mynta ba ngan ym beh noh ïa kine ki briew katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Kin long ki nongshun jong phi , bad phin shah riam da ka jingmane ïa ki blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata nga ruh nga la ong , Ngan ym beh noh ia ki na khmat jong phi ; hynrei kin long kum ki thliew ha ki liang jong phi , bad ki blei jong ki kin long ka jingma ia phi .

en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria , and drave the Jews from Elath : and the Syrians came to Elath , and dwelt there unto this day .
kha: ( Ha kajuh ka por , u syiem ka Edom u ïoh pat ïa ka nongbah Elath , bad u beh krad ïa ki nong Judia kiba sah hangta . Ki nong Edom ki shongsah ha Elath , bad ki dang sah hi hangta . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u syiem u Rezin u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u la koit u

en: And such were some of you : but ye are washed , but ye are sanctified , but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and by the Spirit of our God .
kha: Don na phi kiba la ju long kumta . Hynrei la pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop ; la pynkyntang ïa phi sha U Blei ; la pynksan ïa phi bad U Blei da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad da U Mynsiem U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta la sait ia phi: hynrei la pynkyntang ia phi, hynrei la pynkyntang ia phi ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu bad da U Mynsiem U Blei jong ngi .

en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
kha: Ngan pynshitom jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura halor jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyndep ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein kaba khraw halor jong ki da ki jingkren bein kiba bitar bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai , haba ngan buh ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong nga halor jong ki .

en: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised , that soul shall be cut off from his people  ; he hath broken my covenant .
kha: Ïa uno uno u shynrang u bym shym la otsher yn nym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew jong nga , namar ba um shym la bat ïa ka jutang bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u khun shynrang bym pat shah ot uba ka doh jong u kam shym la shah ot , kata ka mynsiem kan shah ot noh na ki briew jong u ; u la pynkhein ia ka jutang jong nga .

en: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
kha: Nangta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la ainguh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u kpu, bad u la ainguh ia u, bad u la ai ha ki, u da ong: Kane ka long ka met jong nga kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi: kane leh ha ka jingkynmaw ia nga .

en: And it came to pass , when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said unto them , Go again , buy us a little food .
kha: bad haba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u Jakob ki la ïabam lut ïa u kew ba la thied na Ijipt , u Jakob u la ong ha la ki khun ,  Khie leit biang bad thied jingbam biang ïa ngi khyndiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki la bam ia u kew uba ki la wanrah na Ijipt , u kpa jong ki u la ong ha ki: To leit biang, thied ia ngi khyndiat ka jingbam .

en: And his second , Chileab , of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite  ; and the third , Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur  ;
kha: u Khileab , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka tnga jong u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel ; u Absalom , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Maakah , ka khun jong u Talmai u syiem ka Geshur ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba ar jong u, u Chilib, na Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal u Karmelite ; bad kaba lai, u Absalom u khun u Maaka u khun u Talmai u syiem u Geshur;

en: And I sent the hornet before you , which drave them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites  ; but not with thy sword , nor with thy bow .
kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , nga la pynshaïong ïa ki khnang ban beh noh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor . Ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh jong phi kim ïadon bynta ei ei bad kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la phah ia ka hornet ha khmat jong phi, kaba pynmih ia ki na khmat jong phi, wat ia ki arngut ki syiem ki Amorites ; hynrei ym da ka waitlam jong me, ne da ka bow jong me .

en: And he said , Throw her down . So they threw her down : and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall , and on the horses : and he trode her under foot .
kha: bad u Jehu u la ong ïa ki ,  Bret ïa ka shapoh !  Ki la bret ïa ka shapoh bad ka snam jong ka , ka pashait ha ka kynroh bad ha ki kulai . U Jehu u ñiah ïa ki kulai ïa ka kali ïapom halor ka met jong ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Pynkhih ia ka shapoh . Kumta ki la pynhap ia ka: bad katto katne ka snam jong ka ka la tuid ha ka jingkhang , bad ha ki kulai: bad u la iaid ia ka hapoh ka kjat .
