translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , hadien ki jingleh bymman jong ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la beh noh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without , an hundred cubits eastward and northward .
kha: Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kita ki ar tylli ki khyrdop bad ka long sanphew mitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la thew ia ka kpu na khmat jong ka khyrdop kaba shapoh haduh khmat jong ka phyllaw ba shapoh shabar .

en: These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said ,  Father , the hour is come  ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la dep ong ïa kane , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ong ,  Ko Pa , ka kynta ka la poi . To ai ka burom ïa la U Khun , ba U Khun un ïoh ban ai ka burom ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki ktien ki kren ia U Jisu bad u la rah ia ki khmat jong u sha bneng bad u la ong: Ko Kpa, ka por ka la poi; to pyndonburom ia U Khun jong me ruh ba U Khun jong me ruh un pyndonburom ia me:

en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .
kha: Ïa u mrad na ka bynta kane ka jingkñia dei ban pynïap ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam kum ki jingainguh thang , bad ïa ka snam jong u dei ban synreit ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jaka ba ki pyniap ia ka jingainguh thang kin pyniap ia ka jingainguh ba la shet: bad ka snam jong ka un theh sawdong ha ka almari .

en: And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u wan phai , u la kurup ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Hasor ka long kaba khlaiñ tam na kito ki hima baroh . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua ha kata ka por u la phai shadien, bad u la shim ia u Hasor bad u la shoh ia u syiem jong ka da ka waitlam: namar u Hasor shuwa u la long u khlieh jong kita ki hima baroh .

en: Little children , yet a little while I am with you . Ye shall seek me : and as I said unto the Jews , Whither I go , ye cannot come  ; so now I say to you .
kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ngan ym don shuh bad phi slem nangne . Phin ïawad ïa nga ; hynrei nga ïathuh ïa phi mynta ïa kaei kaba ba nga la ïathuh ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , ‘ Phim lah ban leit shano sha ba nga ngan leit .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah rit, hynrei khyndiat por nga don bad phi . Phin wad ia nga: bad kumba nga la ong ha ki Jiw , Nga leit noh, phim lah ban wan ; kumta mynta nga ong ha phi .

en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .
kha: Man ka sngi na ka bynta hynñiew sngi men ai u  langsohmoh , u masi kyrtong , bad u langbrot kum ki jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Baroh ki dei ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi to pynkhreh man la ka sngi ia u blang na ka bynta ka jingknia pop: kin pynkhreh ruh ia u masi rit bad u langbrot na ka kynhun , khlem jingduna .

en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .
kha: Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pynïap ïa la ki briew , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym don mano mano na ka longïing basniew jong me ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat iasoh bad ki ha ka jingtep , namar me la pynjot ia ka ri jong me bad me la pyniap ia ki briew jong me: u symbai jong ki nongleh bymman un ym paw satia .

en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul , and after his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , the sons of Saul .
kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki , bad ki la pynïap ïa lai ngut na ki khun shynrang jong u Saul , u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la bud jur ia u Saul, bad hadien ki khun shynrang jong u ki la pyniap ia u Jonathan, bad u Abinadab bad u Malchishua, ki khun shynrang jong u u Saul .

en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold  ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .
kha: Ki shna saw tylli ki païa da ka dieng akasia ha kiba yn wah ïa kata ka pyrda , ki suit ïa ki da ka ksiar , bad ki buh ha ki ïa ki bnoh ksiar . Nangta ki shna saw tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa kiba batskhem ïa kita ki païa .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shna saw tylli ki maw kiba la shna da ka ksiar: ki hook jong ki ki long ki ksiar ; bad u la bret na ka bynta jong ki saw tylli ki socket rupa .

en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :
kha: Wat ka kynhun shipai kaba khlaiñ tam jong u syiem ka Ijipt kam lah ban ïarap ïa u ban ïaleh haba ki nong Ijipt ki tei ki jingtei khyndew bad tih ki kharai khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Pharaoh bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khlain bad kaba khraw jong u kin ym leh ia u ha ka thma, da kaba pynkhih ia ki lum, bad ban tei ia ki kut, ban ot noh ia kiba bun ki briew:

en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
kha: Hadien san sngi , u Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la leit sha Kaisaria lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . Ki la wan ha khmat jong u Pheliks bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien san sngi u rangbah lyngdoh u la hiar bad ki rangbah , bad bad uwei u nongkren uba kyrteng u Tertullus , uba la pyntip ia u Lat pyrshah ia u Paul .

en: And she brought forth her firstborn son , and wrapped him in swaddling clothes , and laid him in a manger  ; because there was no room for them in the inn .
kha: Ka la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ka bad ka la sop ïa u da ki jaiñsop , bad ka la pynthiah ïa u ha ka shyngoid — ym shym don jaka ïa ki ha ka kamra sah   .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wanrah ia u khun nyngkong jong ka, bad ka la tap ia u da ki jain kiba jem, bad ka la buh ia u ha ka jaka ri dohkha ; namar ym don jaka ia ki ha ka jaka ri dohkha .

en: Then said I unto them , Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes , and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Nga la bthah ïa ki ban bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba ki la ieit bad ban ym pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki blei ba-thala jong ka Ijipt , namar ba nga , nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ki: To weng noh ia ki jinglehrain jong u briew bad wat pynjakhlia ia lade da ki bleithaw jong ka ri Ijipt: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkhreh ka jingpynjot ïa ki bad ngam shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei nga pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid ; Kumba nga la pyrkhat ban pynshitom ia phi, haba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynkhih ia nga ban bitar , ong U Trai jong ki paid , bad ngam shym la kylla bamut:

en: Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;
kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynhun ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ban sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kam , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingthrang ban shakri .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndonkam ia ka kynhun U Blei kaba don hapdeng jong phi, da kaba shim ia ka jingpeit ia ka, ym da kaba teh lakam, hynrei da ka mon sngewbha ym da kaba jakhlia, hynrei da ka jingmut kaba la pynkhreh ; .

en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches . I am the root and the offspring of David , and the bright and morning star .
kha: Nga , U Jisu , nga la phah ïa u angel jong nga ban pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ha phi ha ki balang . Nga la hiarpateng na ka longïing jong u Dabid ; nga long u khlur step uba phyrnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga Jisu nga la phah ia u angel jong nga ban sakhi ha phi ia kine kiei kiei ha ki balang . Nga long u tynrai bad u khun u Dabid bad u khlur uba shai bad uba shai .

en: And the devil said unto him , All this power will I give thee , and the glory of them : for that is delivered unto me  ; and to whomsoever I will I give it .
kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kane ka bor baroh bad ïa kane ka spah baroh ,  u Soitan u la ong ïa u .  La ai ïa kane baroh ha nga , bad nga lah ban ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .
translated_en_to_kha: U ksuid u la ong ha u: Ia kane ka bor baroh ngan ai ha me bad ia ka burom jong ki: namar ia kata la aiti ha nga ; bad ha uno uno uba nga ai ia ka .

en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob , neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel : the  Lord  his God is with him , and the shout of a king is among them .
kha: Nga ïohi lypa ïa ka lawei jong ki Israel , Kan ym don ka jingkordit ne jinglanot ïa ki . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u don ryngkat bad ki , Ki pynbna ba ma u , u long u syiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Um shym la iohi ia ka jingbymhok ha u Jakob , bad um shym la iohi ia ka jingbymhok ha Israel: U Trai U Blei jong u u don ryngkat bad u , bad ka jingpyrta jong u syiem ka don hapdeng jong ki .

en: According to the word of the  Lord  they gave him the city which he asked , even Timnath–serah in mount Ephraim : and he built the city , and dwelt therein .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , ki ai ha u ïa ka nongbah kaba u la pan : ka Timnath Serah , kaba ha ri lum Ephraim . U la tei thymmai ïa ka nongbah , bad u shongduh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka ktien U Trai ki la ai ha u ia ka shnong kaba u la pan, wat u Timnathserah ha u lum Ephraim: bad u la tei ia ka shnong bad u la shong hangta .

en: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh na Rephidim , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai naduh ba ki mih na Ijipt ki wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai . Ki sher dara hangta ha kjat u Lum Sinai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leit noh na ka ri Refidim bad ki la poi sha ka ri khlaw Sinai bad ki la leit sah ha ka ri khlaw ; bad hangta ki Israel ki la shong shnong ha khmat u lum .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou shalt drink of thy sister s cup deep and large : thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision  ; it containeth much .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Phan dih na ka khuri jong ka hynmen jong pha ; kaba heh bad kaba jylliew . Baroh kin ñiewbeiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa pha ; ka khuri ka dap pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei ; Me dei ban dih ia ka khuri jong ka para jong me kaba jylliew bad kaba heh: me dei ban rkhie bein bad me la leh bein ia ka; ka don shibun .

en: And if one man s ox hurt another s , that he die  ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it  ; and the dead ox also they shall divide .
kha: Lada u masi kyrtong jong uwei u briew u pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong jong uwei pat , kita ki trai kin die ïa u masi kyrtong uba dang im bad kin ïasam ïa ka pisa ; kin ïasam ruh ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad uba shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uwei u briew u pynmong ia uwei pat u masi, ba u iap ; te kin die ia u masi uba im, bad kin phiah ia ka pisa jong u ; bad ia u masi uba la iap ruh kin phiah .

en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .
kha: Nangta u la phah khot ïa u Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha u syiem na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei u Joab um wan . Sa shisien u Absalom u la phah khot ïa u ; bad u Joab u kyntait biang ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Absalom u la phah ia u Joab , ban phah ia u sha u syiem ; hynrei um shym la wan sha u: bad haba u la phah biang ia u ha ka sien kaba ar .

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people , so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them .
kha: Kumba nga la wallam ïa kane ka jingjot ha kine ki briew , kumta ruh ngan ai ïa ki baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai u la wanrah ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw baroh ha une u briew , kumta ngan wanrah ha ki ia ka jingbha baroh kaba nga la kular ia ki .

en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
kha: Ym namar kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynim ïa ngi , lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba ai ïa ngi ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym da ki kam hok kiba ngi la leh, hynrei kat kum ka jingisynei jong u u la pynim ia ngi, da kaba sait ia ka jingpynthymmai bad pynthymmai ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid ; .

en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite , which was set over the servants of Saul , and said , I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .
kha: U Doeg u dang ïeng hangta bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga la ïohi ïa u Dabid mynba u leit sha u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Ahitub ha Nob .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Doeg u nong Edome uba la buh halor ki shakri u Saul bad u la ong: Nga la iohi ia u khun u Jesse uba wan sha u Nob, ha u Ahitub .

en: But the Lord said unto him ,  Go thy way : for he is a chosen vessel unto me , to bear my name before the Gentiles , and kings , and the children of Israel :
kha: U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Khie leit , namar ba nga la jied ïa u ban shakri ïa nga , ban pyntip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ki Jentil bad ha ki syiem bad ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la ong ha u: To leit noh: namar u long u nongtied ba la jied ha nga, ban kit ia ka kyrteng jong nga ha khmat ki Jutang bad ki syiem bad ki khun Israel:

en: And the  Lord  appeared unto Abram , and said , Unto thy seed will I give this land : and there builded he an altar unto the  Lord  , who appeared unto him .
kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abram bad u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ngan ai ha ki khun ki ksiew ong me .  Nangta u Abram u la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , uba lah mihpaw ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha u Abram bad u la ong: Ha u symbai jong me ngan ai ia kane ka ri: bad hangta u la tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai uba la paw ha u .

en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .
kha: Nangta u Haggai u kylli ,  Tharai ïa uno uno la pyntngit namar ba u la ktah ïa ka metïap . Te lada u ktah ïa kano kano na kine ki jingbam , hato kata kan pynlong ïa ki ruh ba la pyntngit ?  Ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Ho-oid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Haggai u la ong: Lada u bymkhuid da ka met iap u ktah ia uno uno na kine , hato kan long kaba khlem khuid ? Ki lyngdoh ki la jubab bad ki la ong: Kan long kaba khlem khuid .

en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities , and want of bread in all your places : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Dei ma nga uba la wallam ïa ka jingïapthngan ha ki nongbah jong phi baroh , pynban phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ruh nga la ai ia phi ia ka jingkhuid jong ki bniat ha ki shnong jong phi baroh: hynrei phim shym la wan phai sha nga , ong U Trai .

en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the  Lord  , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man refused to smite him .
kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai  u dkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa u hukum ïa la u para nongïathuhlypa ban shoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew na ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa u la ong ha u paramarjan jong u ha ka ktien U Trai , To sngap ia nga , nga kyrpad ia me . Bad uta u briew u la kyntait ban shoh ia u .

en: And it came to pass , when Rehoboam had established the kingdom , and had strengthened himself , he forsook the law of the  Lord  , and all Israel with him .
kha: Mar ïadep pynskhem ïa la ka bor kum u syiem , u Rehoboam bad ki briew jong u baroh ki iehnoh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Rehoboam u la pynskhem ia ka hima bad u la pynskhem ia lade , u la iehnoh ia ka hukum U Trai bad ki Israel baroh ryngkat bad u .

en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder  ; for they are hallowed .
kha: Ong ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh ban weng noh ïa ki khiew buh ding kiba da ka rnong na kiba sah jong ki briew kiba la shah thang bad ban bret ïa u rnga ding na kita ki khiew shaei shaei , namar kita ki khiew buh ding ki long kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh ba un shim ia ki shyieng na ka jingthang, bad pynphriang ia ka ding hangta; namar ki la pynkyntang .

en: Art not thou our God , who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel , and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever ?
kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi . Mynba u paid Israel jong me u wan sha kane ka ri , me beh krad ïa ki briew kiba shong hangne bad me ai ïa ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong me , ban long ka jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me U Blei jong ngi, uba la beh noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong kane ka ri ha khmat ki briew jong me ki Israel , bad me la ai ia ka ha u symbai u Abraham u paralok jong me junom ?

en: Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .
kha: U la ong ruh ha ki ,  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , U Khun u briew u dei ban shah shitom shibun kiei kiei bad shah kyntait ha ki rangbah bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh , bad shah pyniap , bad shah pynmihpat ha ka sngi kaba lai .

en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram s cattle and the herdmen of Lot s cattle : and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land .
kha: Kumta la mih ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki nongap jingri jong u Abram bad ki nongap jingri jong u Lot . ( Ha kata ka por ki Kanaan bad ki Peris ki dang shong ha kata ka ri . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingialeh hapdeng ki kynhun mrad jong u Abram bad ki kynhun masi jong u Lot: bad u Kanaan bad u Perizzite ki la shong ha kata ka por ha kata ka ri .

en: It is written in the prophets , And they shall be all taught of God . Every man therefore that hath heard , and hath learned of the Father , cometh unto me .
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh , ‘ Uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh hikai na U Blei .’ Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa U Kpa bad ïoh hikai na u , u wan sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: La thoh ha ki nongiathuhlypa , Bad baroh kin shah hikai na U Blei . Uwei pa uwei uba la iohsngew bad uba la nang na U Kpa u wan sha nga .

en: who forgives sins , who accepts repentance , whose punishment is severe , and whose bounty is universal . He is the only Lord and to Him all things proceed .
kha: uba map ia ki pop , uba pdiang ia ka jingkylla kaba mut , uba ka jingpynshitom jong u ka long kaba jur bad uba ka jingaiei jong u ka long kaba kyllum . U long tang ma U U Trai bad ha U kiei kiei baroh ki leit .
translated_en_to_kha: uba map ia ki pop , uba pdiang ia ka jingkylla kaba mut , uba ka jingpynshitom jong u ka long kaba jur bad uba ka jingaiei jong u ka long kaba kyllum . U long tang ma U bad ha U kiei kiei baroh ki iaid shakhmat .

en: ( Deuteronomy 32 :4  ; Job 12 :13  ; Isaiah 40 :26  ; 1 John 4 :8 ) The Bible tells us that he is also merciful , kind , forgiving , generous , and patient .
kha: ( Deuteronomi 32 :4 ; Job 12 :13 ; Isaiah 40 :26 ; 1 Ioannis 4 :8 ) Ka Baibl ka ïathuh ruh ïa ngi , ba U Blei u long uba isynei , uba sbun , uba map ei , uba kylluid mynsiem , bad uba ïaishah slem .
translated_en_to_kha: (Deuteronomy 32 :4; Job 12 :13 ; Isaiah 40 :26 ; 1 Ioannis 4:8 ) Ka Baibl ka iathuh ia ngi ba u long ruh uba isynei, uba sbun, uba map, uba sngewrit bad uba iaishah .

en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her : and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .
kha: Ka long ka samla kaba bhabriew eh bad kaba dang sotti . Ka leit hiar sha ka pukri , ka pyndap um ha la u khiew bad ka wan kiew biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dam ka la long kaba bha ban peit, ka nongleh kam sniew, ym don mano mano ruh kiba ithuh ia ka: bad ka la leit hiar sha ka thliew bad ka la pyndap ia ka khiew jong ka, bad ka la wan shaneng .

en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , after that the king had burned the roll , and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah , saying ,
kha: Hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakim u la lah thang ïa ka kot kli kaba nga la ong ha u Barukh ban thoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha Jeremaiah hadien ba u syiem u la thang ia ka roll bad ki ktien kiba u Baruk u la thoh ha ka shyntur jong u Jeremaiah da kaba ong:

en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .
kha: Hato kane ka jingsuk kaba U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki bym shym la otsher . Naba ngi ong na ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane ka jingkyrkhu ka wan tang ha ka jingkren bein ruh ? namar ngi ong ba la khein ia ka jingngeit ha u Abraham na ka bynta ka hok .

en: Not as Cain , who was of that wicked one , and slew his brother . And wherefore slew he him ? Because his own works were evil , and his brother s righteous .
kha: Ngim dei ban long kum u Kain ; u la long jong u Basniew bad u la pynïap ïa u Abel , u para jong u . Balei u Kain u la pynïap ïa u ? Namar kiei kiei kiba u la leh da lade hi ki la long ki bym dei , hynrei kiei kiei kiba u para jong u , u la leh ki la long kiba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kum u Kain uba long na uta uba sniew, bad u la pyniap ia u hynmen jong u . Bad balei u la pyniap ia u ? Namar ki kam jong u hi ki long kiba sniew bad u hynmen jong u u long uba hok .

en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .
kha: Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ong ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnang ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha phi , To pynlong ia lade ki paralok jong ka jingbymhok ba haba phi la rem , kin pdiang ia phi sha ki jaka shong jaka sah bymjukut .

en: And he divided himself against them , he and his servants , by night , and smote them , and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .
kha: Hangta u pynbynta kynhun kynhun ïa la ki briew , u tur pyrshah ïa ki nongshun mynmiet , bad u jop ïa ki . U beh ruh ïa ki haduh Hobah , kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Damaskos , bad u la ïoh pat ruh ïa kat kaba ki la lute .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phiah ia lade pyrshah ia ki, ma u bad ki shakri jong u, ha ka por miet, bad u la shoh ia ki, bad u la beh ia ki haduh Hobah kaba don sha ka liang kadiang jong ka Damaskos .

en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
kha: Ki shipai samla ki la tur nyngkong . Ki nongsyntiat ba la phah da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynhun ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla jong ki rangbah ki la mih nyngkong eh bad u Benhadad u la phah shabar bad ki la iathuh ha u da kaba ong: Ki don ki briew kiba mih na Samaria .

en: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ha kane ka sien nga la leh pop ; U  Trai  u leh ïa kaba dei ; ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la phah ia u Moses bad u Aaron bad u la ong ha ki: Nga la leh pop ha kane ka por: U Trai u long uba hok bad nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi long kiba sniew .

en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them ,  Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?
kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïa-pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki .  Balei ba phi ïa-pyrkhat kum ïa kita kiei kiei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi haba U Jisu u la sngewthuh ha ka mynsiem jong u ba ki la pyrkhat kumta hapoh jong ki hi , u la ong ha ki , Balei phi pyrkhat ia kine kiei kiei ha ki dohnud jong phi ?

en: And so shall be the plague of the horse , of the mule , of the camel , and of the ass , and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents , as this plague .
kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei kan hap halor ki kulai , ki khashor , ki ut , bad ki kada — halor ki mrad baroh ha ki jaka sher dara jong u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh ka khlam kulai, ka muhor, ka kulai bad ka kada bad ki mrad baroh ki ban don ha kine ki ïingjaiñ .

en: As the thief is ashamed when he is found , so is the house of Israel ashamed  ; they , their kings , their princes , and their priests , and their prophets ,
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kumba u nongtuh u shah pynjahburom haba la kem ïa u , kumta ïa phi baroh ki paid Israel yn pynjahburom — ki syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u nongtuh u sngewlehrain haba la lap ia u , kumta ka iing Israel ka sngewlehrain ia ki; ki syiem jong ki bad ki rangbah jong ki bad ki lyngdoh jong ki bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ki .

en: And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .
kha: Nga pynrem ïa ki namar ka rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , bad nga la pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ki ri nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynphriang ia ki hapdeng ki nongwei , bad ki la shah pynpra lyngba ki ri: kat kum ka lynti jong ki bad kat kum ki jingleh jong ki nga la bishar ia ki .

en: And he said unto her , Give me thy son . And he took him out of her bosom , and carried him up into a loft , where he abode , and laid him upon his own bed .
kha: Ai ïa u khynnah ha nga ,  u Elijah u la ong . U shim ïa uta u khynnah na ki kti jong ka , u rah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra kaba u sah , bad u pynthiah ïa u ha ka jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka, Ai ia nga ia u khun jong me. Bad u la shim ia u na ka kpoh jong ka, bad u la rah ia u sha jrong shapoh kawei ka loft, ha kaba u sah, bad u la buh ia u ha la ka jong ka jingthiah .

en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .
kha: Kane ka dei ka hukum jong ka Templ : Baroh ka jaka sawdong jong ka halor jong u lum ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka ain jong ka iing ; Ha ka tduh jong u lum baroh kawei ka pud jong ka sawdong kan long kaba khuid tam . Ha khmih kane ka long ka ain jong ka iing .

en: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land  ; ye shall throw down their altars : but ye have not obeyed my voice : why have ye done this ?
kha: Phim dei ban ïateh jutang bad ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Phi dei ban pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki .’ Hynrei phim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa phi . Phi la leh pynban ïa kaba pyrshah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym leh ia ka jingieit bad ki nongshong shnong jong kane ka ri; hynrei phim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga: balei phi la leh ia kane ?

en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand , and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the  Lord  :
kha: un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti kamon hangta , bad un synreit khyndiat na ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un theh ia ka kti kadiang jong u ha ka umphniang kaba don ha ka kti kadiang jong u, bad un theh ia ka umphniang da ka kti jong u hynriew sien ha khmat U Trai:

en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .
kha: Uta uba kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uta uba kren da ka shyntur bym tip um kren ha ki briew hynrei ha U Blei: namar ym don ba sngewthuh ia u ; katba ha u mynsiem u kren ia ki jingmaham .

en: Their feet run to evil , and they make haste to shed innocent blood : their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity  ; wasting and destruction are in their paths .
kha: Borabor phi thmu ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew , bad phim lah ap ban leh ïa kata . Phim ju sngew ei ei ban pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ; ka jingduh bad ka jingpynjot ki wan jia kat shaba phi leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kjat jong ki ki iaid sha ka jingsniew , bad ki pynlong kyrkieh ban pynmih snam khlem pop: ki jingpyrkhat jong ki ki long ki jingpyrkhat jong ka jingbymhok ; ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynjot ki don ha ki lynti jong ki .

en: At that time the  Lord  said unto me , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first , and come up unto me into the mount , and make thee an ark of wood .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba nyngkong bad shna ruh kawei ka synduk dieng ban buh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por U Trai u la ong ha nga, To leh ia me ar tylli ki miej maw kum ha kaba nyngkong, bad to wan shaneng sha nga sha u lum, bad to pynlong ia me ka synduk dieng .

en: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself , and God , even our Father , which hath loved us , and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace ,
kha: Ai ba U Jisu Khrist Uba U Trai jong ngi da lade hi bad U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi , uba la ieit ïa ngi , bad ha ka jingaiei jong u un ai ha ngi ka jingshlur baneh bad ka jingkyrmen baskhem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist hi bad U Blei , wat U Kpa jong ngi uba la ieit ia ngi bad uba la ai ia ngi ka jingpyntngen bymjukut bad ka jingkyrmen kaba bha lyngba ka jingaiei .

en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .
kha: Sumar bad kiar ïa la ka jingim na kaba ieit spah , bad sngewhun bad kita kiei kiei kiba phi don . Namar U Blei u la ong ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi , ngan ym kyntait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba ka jingiakren jong phi kan long khlem ka jingkwah brai ; bad to sngewhun ia kiei kiei kiba phi don: namar u la ong , Ngan ym iehnoh ia me , lymne ngan ym iehnoh ia me .

en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah , they were thy merchants : they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices , and with all precious stones , and gold .
kha: Na ka bynta ki mar jong pha ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba bad Raamah ki ai kylliang da ki mawkordor , ka ksiar , bad ki musli musla bakynsai tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkhaii Sheba bad u Raamah, ki long ki nongkhaii jong me: ki la shong ha ki jaka khaii jong me da u khliehduh jong ki jingbam baroh, bad da ki maw ba kordor baroh bad ka ksiar .

en: But if we walk in the light , as he is in the light , we have fellowship one with another , and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin .
kha: Hynrei , lada ngi ïaid ha ka jingshai — kumba ma u , u long ha ka jingshai — te ngi don ka jingïasyllok paralok hi , bad ka snam U Jisu , U Khun jong u , ka pynkhuid ïa ngi na ka pop baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ngi iaid ha ka jingshai kumba u long ha ka jingshai , ngi iasyllok iwei ia iwei pat bad ka snam U Jisu Khrist jong u ka pynkhuid ia ngi na ka pop baroh .

en: Thy sons have fainted , they lie at the head of all the streets , as a wild bull in a net : they are full of the fury of the  Lord  , the rebuke of thy God .
kha: Ha ki khongdong ha man ki surok bah ki briew jong pha ki kyllon noh na ka jingtlot ; ki long kum ka skei kaba la ngat ha ka jar jong u nongbeh mrad . Ki la mad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong me ki la lyngngoh , ki thiah ha khlieh jong ki lynti baroh: ki dap da ka jingbitar U Trai , ka jingkynthoh U Blei jong me .

en: And Joses , who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas , ( which is , being interpreted , The son of consolation , ) a Levite , and of the country of Cyprus ,
kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba u Joseph , u Lebi uba la kha ha Sypros , ïa uba ki apostol ki khot u Barnabas ( kaba mut  Uta uba pynshlur  ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Joses uba la jer kyrteng da ki apostol u Barnabas (kaba la pynkylla ktien ia u), u Lebi , bad ka ri Cyprus .

en: And it came to pass after two full years , that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor , which is beside Ephraim : and Absalom invited all the king s sons .
kha: Hadien ar snem , u Absalom u la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot ha Baal Hasor , hajan ka shnong Ephraim , bad u la khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ban ïadon hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ar snem pura, ba u Absalom u la don ki nongshong shnong ha Baalhazor kaba don hajan u Ephram: bad u Absalom u la khot ia ki khun syiem baroh .

en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king , Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? let me go over , I pray thee , and take off his head .
kha: U Abishai , uba ka kmie jong u , ka Seruïah , u ong ha u syiem ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi shah ïa une u ksew ban tim ïa phi ? Shah ngan leit hangtai bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abisai u khun jong u Seruiah u la ong ha u syiem, Balei une u kulai uba la iap u dei ban tim ia u syiem jong nga? to ngan leit noh shajan, nga duwai ia me, bad ngan weng noh ia ka khlieh jong u .

en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .
kha: To phai sha u Trai , bad ai ba kane ka jingduwai kan long ka jingainguh sha u :  To map ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh bad pdiang ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi , bad ngin ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim bad phi ia ki ktien , bad phai sha U Trai: to ong ha u: Pynduh noh ia ka jingbymhok baroh, bad pdiang sngewbha ia ngi: kumta ngin pynphai noh ia ki khun masi jong ngi .

en: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth : on the tops of their houses , and in their streets , every one shall howl , weeping abundantly .
kha: Ki briew ha ki lynti bah ki la kup da ki jaiñ khain , ha ki jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah bad halor ki tnum ïing ki briew ki ïambriew bad kyang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki lynti jong ki kin sa teh ia lade da ka jain lyngkhuid: ha ki tduh jong ki iing jong ki, bad ha ki lynti jong ki, uwei pa uwei un iam shibun .

en: And it came to pass , when all the people were clean passed over , that the ark of the  Lord  passed over , and the priests , in the presence of the people .
kha: Haba baroh ki la ïadon sha kawei pat ka liang , kita ki lyngdoh bad ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ki jam ha shuwa uta u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki briew baroh ki la iaid lyngba , ba ka synduk U Trai ka la iaid lyngba bad ki lyngdoh ha khmat ki briew .

en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .
kha: Kumta ym u Johanan lymne uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino na ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  ban ïaisah ha ka ri Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Johanan u khun u Krea, bad ki rangbah shipai baroh, bad ki briew baroh, kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai, ban shong ha ka ri Judah .

en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: Uno uno u dkhot na ka longïing jong me uba ïap ha ka nongbah un shah bam ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba iap na Jeroboan ha ka shnong un bam ia u kulai ; bad uta uba iap ha lyngkha un bam ia ki sim jong ka Iyer: namar U Trai u la kren ia kata .

en: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece , from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest .
kha: U Barukh , u khun jong u Sabbai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u Baruk u khun u Zabbai u la pynbha shibun ia kawei pat ka bynta, naduh ka jingkylla jong ka kynroh haduh ka jingkhang jong ka iing jong u Eliashib u rangbah lyngdoh .

en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai da la ka jong ka jingim ba un wallam shibun ki rangbah ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia kum shi kynhun ki puit , bad kin pyrta da ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai jong ki paid u la smai hi dalade, u da ong: Hooid ngan pyndap ia me da ki briew kumba da ki khniang ; bad kin pynkiew ia ka jingsawa pyrshah ia me .

en: The people of the land have used oppression , and exercised robbery , and have vexed the poor and needy : yea , they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully .
kha: Kiba riewspah ki shukor bad ki lute . Ki leh bymdei ïa kiba duk bad ki shim kabu ïa ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka ri ki la pyndonkam bakla ia ka jingshah lehbein , bad ki la leh ia ka kam runar , bad ki la pynsngewsih ia kiba duk bad kiba duk: hooid , ki la pynshitom bein bakla ia u nongwei da kaba bakla .

en: So Joshua arose , and all the people of war , to go up against Ai : and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour , and sent them away by night .
kha: Kumta u Joshua ryngkat bad ki shipai jong u baroh ki khreh ban leit sha Ai . U da jied laiphew hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai bad phah ba kin leit ha ka por mynmiet
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la ieng , bad ki briew baroh kiba ialeh thma, ban leit sha Ai : bad u Joshua u la jied ia ki laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah shipai , bad u la phah noh ia ki ha ka por miet .

en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it  ; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .
kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter men leh ïa kane man la ka sngi . Te ka duwan kan sa long kaba khuid phar ; bad ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka kan pynmynsaw kat ïa uba ktah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi me dei ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka almari, bad pynkyntang ia ka ; bad kan long ka almari kaba khuid tam: kaei kaei kaba ktah ia ka almari kan long kaba khuid tam .

en: And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah , Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords . And Jeremiah did so .
kha: U la ong ïa nga to buh ïa ki jaiñ rim ha ki ksang ti jong nga , khnang ba ki tyllai kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ebedmedmed u nong Ithiopia u la ong ha u Jeremaiah, "To buh mynta ia kine ki jain kiba rim bad ki jain kiba pyut hapoh ki thliew kti jong me hapoh ki lynti . Bad u Jeremaiah u la leh kumta .

en: And they shall be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and shall be shut up in the prison , and after many days shall they be visited .
kha: U Blei un buh khapngiah ïa ki syiem kum ki koidi ha ka thliew . Un set ïa ki ha ka ïingbyndi haduh ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ialum lang, kumba la lum lang ha ka thliew bad kin shah set ha phatok bad hadien bun sngi kin shah peit bniah .

en: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry , and satisfy the afflicted soul  ; then shall thy light rise in obscurity , and thy darkness be as the noonday :
kha: lada phi ai bam ïa kiba thngan , bad pynkdang ïa kito kiba kyrduh , te ka jingdum sawdong jong phi kan kylla jingtyngshaiñ kum shiteng sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me pynmih ia ka mynsiem jong me sha kiba thngan, bad pynhun ia ka mynsiem ba la shah shitom nangta ka jingshai jong me kan kiew ha ka jingdum, bad ka jingdum jong me kan long kum ka por shiteng sngi:

en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above , and cometh down from the Father of lights , with whom is no variableness , neither shadow of turning .
kha: Ka jingai kaba bha baroh bad kaba janai baroh ka wan na bneng ; ka wan hiar na U Blei , u Nongpynlong ïa ki jingshai ba kynja bneng , u bym ju kylla lane pynlong jingdum da ka jingpynphai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jingai kaba bha bad kawei pa kawei ka jingai kaba janai ka long na jrong , bad ka wan hiar na U Kpa jong ki jingshai , bad uba ym don ka jingpher , lymne ka jingdum jong ka jingkylla .

en: And he came to Nazareth , where he had been brought up : and , as his custom was , he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day , and stood up for to read .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha Nasareth , ha kaba la pynheh pynsan ïa u , bad ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la leit sha ka synagog kumba ju long . U la ïeng ban pule ïa Ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha Nazareth, ha kaba la pynsan ia u: bad kumba ka rukom jong u, u la leit shapoh ka synagog ha ka sngi Sabha , bad u la ieng ban pule .

en: And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .
kha: Kumta u kyrkhu ïa ki ha kata ka sngi , u da ong ,  Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa ki kyrteng jong phi haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’   Da kumta u la buh ïa u Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kyrkhu ia ki ha kata ka sngi, u da ong, Ha me ki Israel kin kyrkhu, da kaba ong, U Blei un pynlong ia me kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh: bad u la buh ia u Ephraim ha khmat u Manasseh .

en: Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
kha: Mynta ki thiah khlem don batip ha ki lynti bah , ïa ki durkhmat jong ki la pynïong ha ka jingïap ; ka sniehdoh jong ki , ka tyrkhong kum ka dieng , ka la sti halor ki shyieng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dur jong ki ka kham dum ban ia u dewiong ; kim tip ha ki surok: ka sniehdoh jong ki ka tyrkhong ha ki shyieng jong ki ; ka la tyrkhong , ka la kylla long kum u dieng .

en: But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .
kha: Nga sheptieng ïoh ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba phin iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist — kumba ïa ka Im la shukor da ki buit sianti uta u bseiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga tieng , ioh da kano kano ka lad, kumba u bsein u la pynshoi ia ka Im lyngba ka jinglong rit paid jong u, kumta ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi kin shah pynsniew na ka jinglong kaba suk kaba don ha U Khrist .

en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi kiba kohnguh ïa nga , ka bor jong nga kaba pynim kan kiew halor jong phi kum ka sngi bad kan wallam jingkhiah kum ki kjat sngi . Phin long kiba laitluid bad bakmen kum ki khun masi ba la pyllait na ka sem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha phi kiba tieng ia ka kyrteng jong nga kan mih ka Sngi jong ka hok da kaba pynkoit ha ki bniat jong u ; bad phin leit noh sha khmat bad phin kiew kum ki khun masi jong ka stall .

en: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Koz another piece , from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib .
kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh kaba kut ka ïing u Eliashib .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Meremoth u khun jong u Koz uwei pat u bynta, naduh ka jingkhang jong ka iing u Eliashib haduh kaba kut jong ka iing u Eliashib .

en: He shall dwell with thee , even among you , in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates , where it liketh him best : thou shalt not oppress him .
kha: Ki lah ban shong bad phi ha kano kano ka shnong ba ki mon , bad phim dei ban lehbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Un shong bad me, wat hapdeng jong phi, ha kata ka jaka kaba un jied ha kawei na ki khyrdop jong me, ha kaba u sngewtynnad eh: wat pynshitom ia u .

en: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest .
kha: Bad kumta , namar jong phi , ïa ka Seïon yn lur kum ïa ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan long kum ka kynton ñiut , bad u lum ka Templ un long kum ka khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka Seion na ka bynta jong phi kan long kum ka lyngkha , bad ka Jerusalem kan kylla long ki lum bad u lum jong ka iing kum ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khlaw .

en: Depart ye , depart ye , go ye out from thence , touch no unclean thing  ; go ye out of the midst of her  ; be ye clean , that bear the vessels of the  Lord .
kha: To pynthikna phi baroh kiba mih na Babilon , phi baroh kiba rah ïa ki tiar ka templ ! Wat ktah ïa kaba la mana ; ri khuid ïa lade bad mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynmih noh ia ka, leit noh ia phi, leit noh na kata ka jaka, wat ktah ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid; leit noh na pdeng jong ka; to long kiba khuid, kiba kit ia ki tiar U Trai .

en: And the Philistines were afraid , for they said , God is come into the camp . And they said , Woe unto us ! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore .
kha: ki la sheptieng , bad ki ong ,  U blei u la wan poi ha dara jong ki ! Ngi la shahjop ! Kum kane kam pat ju jia ha ngi mynno mynno !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la tieng namar ki la ong, U Blei u wan shapoh ka shnong . Ki la ong: Hooid ia ngi ! namar ym pat ju don kum kata ka jingjia haduh mynta .

en: He answered and said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they say unto him , Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread , and give them to eat ?
kha: Phi dei ma phi hi ban ai ei ei ïa ki ba kin bam ,  U Jisu u la jubab . Ki la kylli ,  Hato me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad pynlut arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ha u kpu khnang ban bsa ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Ai ia ki ban bam . Ki la ong ha u , Hato ngin leit thied arspah tyngka u kpu bad ai ia ki ban bam ?

en: They give gifts to all whores : but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers , and hirest them , that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom .
kha: Ïa ka nuti la siew , hynrei pha ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha bad pha pynbam tyngka ïa ki ban wan nangno nangno ban ïathiah bad pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ai jingai sngewbha ia ki nongkhaii met baroh: hynrei me ai ia ki jingai sngewbha jong me ha ki nongieit jong me baroh , bad me thung ia ki , ba kin wan sha me na ka liang baroh na ka bynta ka jingkhaii met jong me .

en: So the Philistines were subdued , and they came no more within the border of Israel . The hand of Yahweh was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .
kha: Kumta la pyndem ia ki Philistia bad kim shym la wan rung shuh hapoh u pud u sam jong ki Israel . Ka kti U Trai ka la long pyrshah ia ki Philistia ha baroh ki sngi jong u Samuel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki Philistia ki la shah pyndem , bad kim wan shuh hapoh u pud u sam jong ki Israel . Ka kti jong u Yahweh ka la long pyrshah ia ki Philistia baroh ki sngi u Samuel .

en: I have set watchmen upon thy walls , O Jerusalem , which shall never hold their peace day nor night : ye that make mention of the  Lord  , keep not silence ,
kha: Ha ki kynroh jong pha , ko Jerusalem , nga la buh ïa ki nongap phira ; mynsngi ne mynmiet kin ym sngap jar . Kin pynkynmaw ïa U  Trai  ïa ki kular jong u , bad kin ym shah ba un klet ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la buh ia ki nongap ha ki kynroh jong me, ko Jerusalem, ki bym ju bat ia ka jingsuk jong ki sngi ne miet: phi kiba kdew ia U Trai , wat sngap jar , .

en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki kti , ba ki jingthung jong phi kin seisoh shibun , bad ba ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi kin nang bun .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia u soh jong ka met jong me bad u soh jong ka khyndew jong me bad u soh jong ki masi jong me, ka jingroi jong ki masi jong me bad ki kynhun langbrot jong me .

en: And when the  Lord  saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïohi ba u Moses u wan kham hajan , u khot ïa u napdeng kata ka  lawlynnong , bad u ong ,  Moses ! Moses !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi ! Nga don hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai u la iohi ba u la phai shawei ban peit, U Blei u la khot ia u na pdeng ka khlaw, bad u la ong, Moses . Bad u la ong , Hangne nga don .

en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :
kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Mahanaim bad kynthup ïa ka Bashan baroh — baroh ka hima u Og , u syiem Bashan , bad ruh baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong jong u Jair ha Bashan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rud duriaw jong ki ka long na Mahanaim, baroh kawei ka hima u Og u syiem u Basan bad ki shnong Jair baroh kiba don ha Basan, ki long ki lai tylli ki shnong:

en: And he said unto them , Out of the eater came forth meat , and out of the strong came forth sweetness . And they could not in three days expound the riddle .
kha: U ong ,  Na u nongbam wan mih ka jingbam ; Na uba khlaiñ wan mih kaba thiang .  Hadien lai sngi ruh kim shym lah ban batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Na ka jingbam ka la mih ka doh, bad na kaba khlain ka la mih ka jingsma . Bad kim lah ha ki lai sngi ban batai ia ka jingkylli .

en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved , we have a building of God , an house not made with hands , eternal in the heavens .
kha: Naba ngi tip ba haba kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba ngi shong — ka met jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei — ka la jot noh , U Blei un buh ha bneng ïa ka ïing na ka bynta jong ngi ba ngin shong , ka ïing kaba ma u hi u la thaw , ka ban neh junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi tip ba lada la pynduh noh ia ka iing jong ngi ha ka pyrthei jong kane ka iing , ngi don ka iing U Blei , ka iing kaba ym shym la shna da ki kti , kaba bymjukut ha bneng .

en: And they sent the coat of many colours , and they brought it to their father  ; and said , This have we found : know now whether it be thy son s coat or no .
kha: Ki leit rah ïa kata ka sopti sha la u kpa , bad ki ong ,  Ngi lap ïa kane . Khmih la ka dei ne em ka sopti u khun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah ia ka jainkup kaba bun rong bad ki la wanrah ia ka ha u kpa jong ki bad ki la ong: Ia kane ngi la shem: to tip mynta la ka dei ka jainkup jong u khun jong me ne em .

en: One cherub on the end on this side , and another cherub on the other end on that side : out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
kha: Uwei ha kawei ka tduh , bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong kata ka jingtap . U pyndait lang ïa ki kumta ba ki long lang bad kata ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka cherub ha kaba kut ha kane ka liang , bad kawei pat ka cherub ha kawei pat ka liang: na ka jaka shong ba la shet u la pynlong ia ki cherub ha ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka .

en: Let us go , we pray thee , unto Jordan , and take thence every man a beam , and let us make us a place there , where we may dwell . And he answered , Go ye .
kha: Shah ba ngin leit sha Jordan ba ngin ïapom katto katne tylli ki dieng ba ngi lah ban shna ka jaka ba ngin shong .  U Elisha u jubab ,  Khie leit .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin leit, ngi duwai ia me, sha Jordan, bad ngin shim na kata uwei pa uwei u beam, bad to ngin ia shna jaka hangta, ha kaba ngi lah ban shong . Bad u la jubab, To leit noh .

en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .
kha: Shibun ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , namar ka jaka ha kaba la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu kam da jngai na ka nongbah . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktien Hebru , Latin bad Grik .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kyrteng nangta ka pule bun na ki Jiw: namar ka jaka ba la sahnarphna ia U Jisu ka la jan sha ka nongbah: bad la thoh ia ka ha ka ktien Hebru , bad Grik bad Latin .

en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .
kha: A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ïa ka kular kaba me la ong ha u kpa jong nga . Me la pynlong syiem ïa nga halor u paidlang uba bun katta katta kat haduh ba ym lah ban ñiew , kumta to ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ko Trai Blei, to ai ba ka jingkular jong me ha u kpa jong nga kan long kaba skhem: namar me la pynlong ia nga syiem halor ki briew kiba kum ka dewbilat jong ka khyndew ha ka jingbun .

en: The sons also of Jediael  ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan  ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
kha: U Jediael u don uwei u khun , u Bilhan , bad u Bilhan u don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeush , u Benjamin , u Ehud , u Khenaanah , u Sethan , u Tarshish , bad u Ahishahar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ruh jong u Jedia ;el Bilhan: bad ki khun shynrang jong u Bilhan ; Jeush, bad u Benjamin, bad u Ehd, bad u Chenaah, bad u Zeta, bad u Tharshish, bad u Ahishahar .

en: For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .
kha: U  Trai  un wan bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka  erïong , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, U Trai un wan ryngkat bad ka ding, bad ki kali jong u kum ka lyer kaba rkhie bein, ban pynlong ia ka jingbitar jong u da ka jingbitar, bad ka jingkynthoh jong u da ki thylliej ding .

en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh ïa kine ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar kata ba u la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh kiba leh ia kine kiei kiei ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai: bad namar kine ki jingleh bymman U Trai U Blei jong me u beh noh ia ki na khmat jong me .

en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall persuade Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one said on this manner , and another said on that manner .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli , ‘ Uei u ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Mano ba pynsngewthuh ia u Ahab, ba un leit sha Ramothgilead ? Bad uwei u la ong kumta bad uwei pat u la ong kumta .

en: But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :
kha: Ha shuwa ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha kin leit thiah noh , ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki la kerkut ïa ka ïing . Baroh ki shynrang jong kata ka nongbah , bad samla bad tymmen , ki la ïadon hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shuwa ba kin thiah , ki shynrang jong ka shnong , wat ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki la ker sawdong ia ka iing sawdong , baroh arngut ki rangbah bad ki samla , ki briew baroh na man la ki jaka:

en: And ye shall be left few in number , whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude  ; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Wat la phi bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , tang khyndiat eh na phi phin lait im , namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sah tang khyndiat eh ha ka jingbun briew, katba phi la long kum ki khlur bneng na ka bynta ka jingbun paid ; namar ba phin ym kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high , and the kings of the earth upon the earth .
kha: Ka por kan poi haba U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki bor ba-halor bad ïa ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi , ba U Trai un pynshitom ia ki shipai kiba jrong kiba don ha jrong , bad ki syiem jong ka khyndew ha ka khyndew .

en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array before the gate of the city : and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field .
kha: Ki Ammon ki ïaid bad ki pynskhem ïa ki jaka jong ki ha ka khyrdop sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ka ri jong ki , bad ki syiem kiba la wan ban ïarap , ki apthap ha ki rudnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la mih noh bad ki la buh ia ka thma ha khmat ka khyrdop jong ka shnong: bad ki syiem kiba la wan ki la don hi ha lyngkha .

en: Behold , all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded : they shall be as nothing  ; and they that strive with thee shall perish .
kha: Kito kiba bitar ïa me kin tip ïa ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa me kin ïap
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih baroh kiba la shah pynjah burom pyrshah ia me kin sngewlehrain bad sngewlehrain: kin long kum kaei kaei bad kito kiba ialeh bad me kin jah noh .

en: Hear this word that the  Lord  hath spoken against you , O children of Israel , against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt , saying ,
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to sngew ïa kane ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong phi , ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei kaba u la wan ïalam na ka ri Ijipt ;
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane ka ktien ba U Trai u la kren pyrshah ia phi ko khun Israel pyrshah ia ka iing baroh kawei kaba nga la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt da kaba ong:

en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king , My lord , O king , the iniquity be on me , and on my father s house : and the king and his throne be guiltless .
kha: Syiem Kynrad ,  ka ong ,  ïa kano kano kaba phi leh , ma nga bad la ka longïing ngin shim ïa ka jingshah kynnoh ; ma phi bad la ka longïing syiem phi lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei jong u Tekoah ka la ong ha u syiem, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, ka jingbymhok ka long ha nga bad ha ka iing u kpa jong nga: bad u syiem bad ka khet jong u kin long ki bym don pop .

en: For from the top of the rocks I see him , and from the hills I behold him : lo , the people shall dwell alone , and shall not be reckoned among the nations .
kha: Na kliar ki mawsiang bakynjang nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki , nga lah ban khmih ïa ki nalor ki lumrit . Ki dei ka jaitbynriew kaba im kyrpang ; ki tip ba ki long kiba la kyrkhu kyrpang ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na jrong jong ki maw nga iohi ia u, bad na ki lum nga iohi ia u: ha khmih , ki briew kin shong marwei , bad kin ym shah khein hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .

en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .
kha: Nangta u la kylli ïa uwei pat , ‘ Bad ma phi — sa katno phi dei ban pynphai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane hangne ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ to thoh phraspah .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha uwei pat, Bad katno ka long kaba donkam ? Bad u la ong, Shispah tylli ki jingthew kew . Bad u la ong ha u: Shim ia ka bill jong me bad thoh saw tylli ki jingthoh .

en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin , kaba na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don arphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew hynniew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Jehoshin jong ka Jerusalem .

en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?
kha: Kumno te ba phim shemphang ba ngam shym kren ha phi shaphang u kpu ? To sumar ïa lade na u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno phim sngewthuh ba ngam kren ia ka ha phi shaphang u kpu , ba phi dei ban husiar na ka jingkhleh jong ki Pharisi bad ki Sadusi ?

en: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day , to the right hand , or to the left , to go after other gods to serve them .
kha: Hynrei phim bit ban kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki ha kano kano ka rukom , lane mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban leit noh na kano kano ka ktien kaba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi , sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang , ban leit bud ia kiwei pat ki blei ban shakri ia ki .

en: The  Lord  shall go forth as a mighty man , he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war : he shall cry , yea , roar  ; he shall prevail against his enemies .
kha: U  Trai  u leit mih ban ïaleh kum u riewkieng atiar ; u long uba la kloi bad kwah eh ban ïaleh thma , u kyang-thma , u pyrta ban ïaleh thma ; u pyn-i ïa la ka bor pyrshah ïa la ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un leit sha khmat kum u briew uba khlain bor, un pynmih ia ka jingsngewsih kum u briew uba ialeh thma: un iam, hooid, un ialeh pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong u .

en: Unto which promise our twelve tribes , instantly serving God day and night , hope to come . For which hope s sake , king Agrippa , I am accused of the Jews .
kha: ïa kata hi kaba ki khat-ar jait jong ki briew jong ngi ki kyrmen ban ïohpdiang , haba ki mane ïa U Blei mynsngi bad mynmiet . Bad ka dei namar jong kane ka jingkyrmen , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la shah mudui da ki Jiw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ki shiphew jaitbynriew jong ngi, kiba shakri ia U Blei mynta bad mynta ka sngi, ki kyrmen ban wan . Na ka bynta kata ka jingkyrmen, ko syiem Agrippa , nga shah kynnoh ia ki Jiw .

en: And he bought a parcel of a field , where he had spread his tent , at the hand of the children of Hamor , Shechem s father , for an hundred pieces of money .
kha: U la thied ïa kata ka bynta jong ka madan na ki khun ki siew jong u Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thied ia kawei ka lyngkha, ha kaba u la pynphriang ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u, ha ka kti jong ki khun u Hamor , u kpa jong u Shechem, na ka bynta shispah tyngka .

en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  , Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the  Lord  given by Moses .
kha: Katba dang sei ïa ka pisa na ka jaka kynshew , u Hilkaïah u shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum jong U  Trai  , ka Hukum kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la wanrah ia ka pisa kaba la wanrah sha ka iing U Trai , u Hilkiah u lyngdoh u la lap ia ka kot jong ka hukum U Trai kaba la ai da u Moses .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom , neither let the mighty man glory in his might , let not the rich man glory in his riches :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki rangbah bastad kim dei ban kob sarong ïa ka jingstad jong ki , lymne ki rangbah bakhlaiñ ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , lymne ki rangbah bariewspah ïa ka spah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Wat ai ba u briew uba stad un burom ia ka jingstad jong u , lymne u briew uba khlain bor un burom ia ka bor jong u , wat ai ba u riewspah un burom ia ka spah jong u:

en: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :
kha: Kumta u Jakob u ong ha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ha kita baroh kiba don lem bad u ,  Bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baroh kiba phi don ; pynkhuid ïa lade , bad phong da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jakob u la ong ha ka iing jong u bad ha baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u: Pynduh noh ia ki blei nongwei kiba don hapdeng jong phi bad to long kiba khuid bad pynkylla ia ki jain jong phi:

en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the  Lord  , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .
kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , U  Trai  u pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem bad ka bor , bad u ai ha nga ka jingsngewthuh ïa ka jingbishar hok bad ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha ki paid Israel kiei ki long ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shisha nga dap da ka bor da ka mynsiem U Trai bad ka jingbishar bad ka bor , ban pynbna ha u Jakob ia ka jingleh bymman jong u bad ha ki Israel ia ka pop jong u .

en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him : therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy , and utterly to make away many .
kha: Te ka khubor kaba wan na mihngi bad na shatei kan pynsheptieng ïa u , bad un ïaleh da jingbitar shla , da kaba pynïap shibun ngut ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jingsawa na mihngi bad na shaphang shathie kin pynkhuslai ia u: namarkata un leit noh da ka jingbitar kaba khraw ban pynjot , bad ban pynduh noh shibun .

en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day , because that he wholly followed the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Ka Hebron ka dang dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kaleb , u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , namar ba u la kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hebron u la long u nongshong shnong jong u Jephunneh u Kenez haduh kine ki sngi , namar ba u la bud pura ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And it came to pass , when the Philistine arose , and came and drew nigh to meet David , that David hasted , and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine .
kha: U Goliath u sdang ban wan tur sha khmat sha u Dabid , bad u Dabid u mareh stet sha ka madan thma ban ïaleh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan mareh sha ka kynhun shipai ban iakynduh ia u Dabid .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand toward heaven , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong ba ka jingdum kaba rben la kumba lah ban tba ïa ka , kan tap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me sha bneng, ba kan don ka jingdum halor ka ri Ijipt, wat ka jingdum kaba lah ban sngew .

en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar : and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and he shall be clean .
kha: bad un kñia ïa u bad ka jingainguh bam halor ka duwan . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid , bad uta u briew un sa long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un ainguh ia ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingainguh doh halor ka almari: bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u , bad un long uba khuid .

en: But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .
kha: U Elisha u pan khyndiat u  purew , u ber ïa u ha uta u khiew , bad u ong ,  To theh kham bun ka syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .  Bad kam shym don kano kano kaba sniew ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong , Nangta wanrah jingbam . Bad u la bret ia ka ha ka umphniang ; bad u la ong: To theh ia ka na ka bynta ki briew, ba kin bam . Bad ym shym la don jingma ei ei ha ka umphniang .

en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .
kha: Isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , ieit ïa kaei kaba bha , bad peit ba ka jingbishar hok ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U  Trai  , un isynei ïa ki briew jong kane ka hima kiba dang pynsah ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: To shun ia kaba sniew, bad to ieit ia kaba bha, bad to pynskhem ia ka jingbishar ha ka khyrdop: ka lah ban long ba U Trai Blei jong ki paid un long uba sngewrit ia kiba sah jong u Joseph .

en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .
kha: U wan poi ha ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka set blang kiba harud lynti , bad u rung shapoh ban leit shabar   . Ka jia ryngkhat ba ka dei kajuh ka krem ha kaba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki rieh kham shapoh jong kata ka krem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha ki jaka ri langbrot ha lynti, ha kaba ka don ka krem ; bad u Saul u la rung ban tap ia ki kjat jong u : bad u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la sah ha ki liang jong ka krem .

en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain  ; yet he shall come to his end , and none shall help him .
kha: Un pynïeng ruh ïa ki ïingjaiñ syiem kiba heh hapdeng ki duriaw bad ki lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng . Hynrei un ïap , khlem don mano mano hangta ban ïarap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un thung ia ki jainkup jong ka iing jong u hapdeng ki duriaw ha u lum bakhuid uba donburom ; hynrei un poi sha ka jingkut jong u , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban iarap ia u .

en: For the Lord  God  will help me  ; therefore shall I not be confounded : therefore have I set my face like a flint , and I know that I shall not be ashamed .
kha: Hynrei ki jingkrenbeiñ jong ki kim lah ban pynmong ïa nga namar ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ai jingïarap ïa nga . Nga pyneh ïa lade ban ïaishah ïa ki . Nga tip ba ngan ym shah pynjahburom ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai Blei un iarap ia nga; namarkata ngan ym sngewlehrain: namarkata nga la buh ia ka khmat jong nga kum ka jingkhang , bad nga tip ba ngan ym sngewlehrain .

en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .
kha: Ka sngi ka la jan haba U  Trai  un shong ha ka jingbishar ; kumta to sngap jar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U  Trai  u pynkhreh ban kñia ïa ki briew jong u bad u la khot sngewbha ïa ki nongshun ban lute ïa ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: To bat ia ka jingsuk jong me ha khmat U Trai Blei: namar ka sngi U Trai ka don hajan: namar U Trai u la pynkhreh ia ka jingknia , u la bthah ia ki nongwan jong u .

en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .
kha: Ki rangbah kiba la ïalam ïa u Paul ki la ïaleit bad u haduh Athens bad nangta ki la wan phai sha Beria lem bad ki jingbthah na u Paul ba u Silas bad u Timothi ki dei ban leit sha u kloi katba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba la ialam ia u Paul ki la wanrah ia u sha Athen: bad ki la pdiang ia ka hukum ha u Silas bad u Timothi ban wan sha u da ka jingkloi baroh .

en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron , saying , Ye have killed the people of the  Lord .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka kynhun baroh ka la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ka ong ,  Phi la pynïap katto katne ngut ki briew jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud baroh ka kynhun ki Israel ki la ia ud pyrshah ia u Moses bad pyrshah ia u Aaron da kaba ong: Phi la pyniap ia ki briew jong U Trai .

en: As he came forth of his mother s womb , naked shall he return to go as he came , and shall take nothing of his labour , which he may carry away in his hand .
kha: Ngi ieh ïa kane ka pyrthei kumba ngi la wan rung sha ka — da kaba thylli . Nalor ka kam jong ngi baroh ym don kano kano kaba ngi lah ban rah bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang mih na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u, un leit phai noh kumba u wan, bad un ym shim ei ei na ka jingtrei shitom jong u, kaba u lah ban rah noh ha ka kti jong u .

en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .
kha: Kumta u leit sha u Ishmael u khun jong u Abraham , bad u shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kaba long ka para jong u Nebaïoth .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Iso u la leit sha Ishmael bad u la shim ia ki tnga kiba u don ka khun jong u khun u Abraham u khun u Abraham u khun u Abraham u khun u Abraham u khun u Nebaiot .

en: Absalom said moreover , Oh that I were made judge in the land , that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me , and I would do him justice !
kha: Bad u ju bynrap ,  Ba ngan jin da la long u nongbishar ! Te uno uno uba don ka jingïakajia lane ka jingkam ïa kano kano u lah ban wan sha nga , bad ngan ai ha u ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la ong shuh shuh , Ah ba nga la shah bishar ha ka ri , ba uwei pa uwei u briew uba don kano kano ka suit ne ka daw un wan sha nga , bad ngan leh ia u hok !

en: And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la don u shakri uba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew bariewspah ba u sordar jong u , u la pynsep-ei ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ruh ha ki synran jong u: Don uwei u briew uba riewspah uba don u nongap bad ia uta u la shah kynnoh ha u ba u la pynsyrwa kai ia ki mar ki mata jong u .

en: And this is the case of the slayer , which shall flee thither , that he may live : Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly , whom he hated not in time past  ;
kha: Lada u briew u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u bym dei u nongshun jong u , u lah ban phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban leit rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingjia jong u nongpyniap briew, uba phet noh sha kata ka jaka, ba un im: Uba pyniap ia u paramarjan jong u khlem da tip , ia uba um shym la shun ha ka por ba la leit noh;

en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
kha: Ki synran ki la king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um , u la nang wan sha jan ka lieng , bad ki la sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la iaid kumba sanphew ne laiphew tylli ki lynti iaid kjat, ki la iohi ia U Jisu ba u iaid ha duriaw, bad u la iaid hajan ka lieng: bad ki la tieng .

en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .
kha: U paidlang u ong ,  Mynta ngi tip balei U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingshai ban ïaid ryngkat , hynrei ka don tang ka jingdum ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka long kaba jngai na ngi, ym ka hok kaba palat ia ngi: ngi ap ia ka jingshai, hynrei ha khmih ka jingdum ; na ka bynta ka jingshai, hynrei ngi iaid ha ka jingdum .

en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith , having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience , and our bodies washed with pure water .
kha: Kumta to ngin wan sha jan U Blei da ka dohnud kaba sngur bad da ka jingngeit kaba skhem , da ki dohnud ïa kiba la pynkhuid na ka jingsngew rem ryngkat bad ki met ïa kiba la sait da ka um kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin iajan bad ka dohnud kaba shisha ha ka jingpynthikna kaba pura jong ka jingngeit , da kaba ki dohnud jong ngi ki la tuid na ka jingsngewthuh kaba sniew , bad ki met jong ngi ki la sait da ka um kaba khuid .

en: And when he had opened the fifth seal , I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God , and for the testimony which they held :
kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba san . Nga la ïohi ha khrum ka duwan ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka ktien U Blei bad ba ki la ïaineh ha ki jingphla jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba phra , nga la iohi hapoh ka almari ia ki mynsiem jong kita kiba la shah pyniap na ka bynta ka ktien U Blei bad na ka bynta ka jingphla kaba ki la bat:

en: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go ; whatsoever is set before you , eat , asking no question for conscience sake .
kha: Lada u bymngeit u khot bam sngewbha ïa phi bad phi mon ban leit , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi , khlem kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno na ki u ngeit ba um ju leit sha ka jingkhawai , bad phi sngewbha ban leit sha kaei kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi , bam khlem da kylli ei ei na ka bynta ka jingsngewthuh jingmut .

en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance , being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will :
