kha: Ïa kiei kiei baroh la leh kat kum ka jingthmu bad ka jingrai U Blei ; bad U Blei u la jied ïa ngi ban long ki briew jong u hi ha U Khrist namar ka jingthmu jong u hi , ba la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba u la rai naduh kaba mynnyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ruh ngi la ioh ia ka pateng, la buh lypa kat kum ka jingthmu jong uta uba trei ia kiei kiei baroh kat kum ka jingmut jong ka mon jong u hi:

en: Therefore they enquired of the  Lord  further , if the man should yet come thither . And the  Lord  answered , Behold , he hath hid himself among the stuff .
kha: ki kylli na U  Trai  ,  Dang don shuh mano mano ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  u Saul u don hangtai , u rieh ha lyndet ki jingkit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la kylli shuh shuh ia U Trai lada uta u briew u dang wan shata . Bad U Trai u la jubab , Ha khmih u la buhrieh ia lade hapdeng kiei kiei .

en: Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?
kha: U Judah u long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u leit phai sha la krem ; Hangta u dem , bad u thiah . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u long u sing uba la tymmen: na ka jingbam, ko khun jong nga: u la dem khrup: u la dem khrup kum u sing , bad kum u sing uba la tymmen; mano ba pynkynjah ia u ?

en: Israel was holiness unto the  Lord  , and the firstfruits of his increase : all that devour him shall offend  ; evil shall come upon them , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ko Israel , pha long tang ka jong nga hi ; pha long ka jingdon bakyntang jong nga . Nga la phah ka jingshitom bad ka jingpynjot ha uwei pa uwei uba pynmong ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Israel ka la long kaba khuid ha U Trai , bad ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka jingroi jong u: baroh kiba bam ia u kin sa sngewsih; ka jingsniew kan wan ha ki , ong U Trai .

en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
kha: Uwei pa uwei un shongsuk hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kin shong uwei pa uwei hapoh u diengsoh jong u bad hapoh u diengsoh jong u bad ym don uwei ruh u ban pyntieng ia ki: namar ka shyntur U Trai jong ki paid ka la kren ia kata .

en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .
kha: Kane ka la jia namar u Jeroboam u pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop kiba u la leh bad u la pynlong ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki pop jong u Jeroboam kiba u la leh pop bad kiba u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop, da ka jingpynkhih jong u ha kaba u la pynkhih ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ban bitar .

en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur  ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .
kha: Nangta u Moses u ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka Duriaw Basaw sha ka ri shyiap Shur . Lai sngi lynter ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , hynrei kim shym lap um satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Moses u la wanrah ia ki Israel na ka duriaw Basaw , bad ki la leit sha ka ri khlaw Shur ; bad ki la leit lai sngi ha ka ri khlaw , bad kim lap um .

en: Like as a woman with child , that draweth near the time of her delivery , is in pain , and crieth out in her pangs  ; so have we been in thy sight , O  Lord .
kha: Ma me A  Trai  , me la pynlong ïa ngi ban lynñiar , kum ka briew kaba lynñiar ha ka jingsuh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka kynthei kaba don khun, kaba jan ha ka por ba kha ia ka, ka don ha ka jingpang, bad ka pyrta ha ki jingpang jong ka ; kumta ngi la don ha khmat jong me, ko Trai .

en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?
kha: Lane tharai kawei ka briew kaba don shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa ka duh noh kawei na ki — kaei ba kan leh ? Ka thang ïa ka sharak , ka sar ïa la ka ïing , bad ka khmih biang biang kylleng kylleng haduh ba kan da shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: La ka long kaei ka kynthei kaba don shiphew tylli ki rupa lada ka duh ia kawei ka sharak , bad ka pynkhih ia ka iing , bad ka wad da ka jingsngewrit haduh ba kan da lap ia ka ?

en: So Joash the king of Israel went up  ; and they saw one another in the face , both he and Amaziah king of Judah , at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
kha: Kumta u Jehoash , u syiem ka Israel u leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah , u syiem ka Judah . Ki la ïakynduh ha Beth Shemesh kaba ha Judah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joash u syiem Israel u la leit shaneng; bad ki la iohi iwei ia iwei pat ha khmat, ma u bad u Amaiah u syiem Judah, ha Bethshesh, kaba dei ka jong u Judah .

en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them to present himself before the  Lord .
kha: Haba la poi ka sngi ha kaba ki jingthaw ba-im ha bneng ki wanpaw biang ha khmat U  Trai  , u Soitan u la don lang hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien la don ka sngi ha kaba ki khun U Blei ki la wan ban pyni ia lade ha khmat U Trai , bad u Soitan ruh u la wan hapdeng jong ki ban pyni ia lade ha khmat U Trai .

en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for it is written , Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God , and him only shalt thou serve .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ To mane ïa U Trai uba U Blei jong me bad shakri tang ïa u !’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, To leit shadien jong nga, ko Soitan: namar la thoh: Me dei ban mane ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad tang ma u hi me dei ban shakri .

en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities  ; but was in all points tempted like as we are , yet without sin .
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi um long uta u bym lah ban sngewlem ïa ki jingtlot jong ngi . Pynban , ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba la shah pynshoi ha kiei kiei baroh kum ma ngi , hynrei u bym shym la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim don u lyngdoh rangbah uba ym lah ban ktah da ka jingsngew jong ki jingduna jong ngi hynrei u la shah pynshoi ha ki mat baroh kumba ngi long, hynrei khlem pop .

en: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was , and her two daughters in law with her  ; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .
kha: Ki ïamih ban leit phai lang sha Judah , hynrei ha lynti ka ong ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka la mih noh na ka jaka ba ka don, bad ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong ka bad ka ; bad ki la leit phai noh sha ka ri Judah .

en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :
kha: Uba nyngkong u la kren ha uta uwei pat ,  Khie mareh bad ong ha u samla uba don u ksai thew ba yn sa don bun byllien ki briew bad shibun bah ki jingri ha Jerusalem , ba kan long kaba heh katta katta ban don ki kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Run, kren ia une u samla, da kaba ong, Ka Jerusalem kan shong kum ki shnong khlem kynroh na ka bynta ka jingbun ki briew bad ki masi hangta:

en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .
kha: Ngan teh ïa u thylliej jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ka shyntur jong me ban sngap jar ha ka tnum jong ka shyntur jong me, ba me long uba dum, bad wat long ha ki u nongpynrem: namar ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  was not yet laid .
kha: Wat la ki briew kim pat shym la sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ , ki la sdang ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai bahynñiew ban thang ki jingkñia sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai kaba hynriew ki la sdang ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang sha U Trai . Hynrei ka nongrim jong ka tempi U Trai kam pat long .

en: For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .
kha: Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi :   ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa phi ka jingshai na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrthei ka lah ban lait im .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta U Trai u la hukum ia ngi, da kaba ong, nga la buh ia me ban long ka jingshai jong ki Jutang , ba me dei ban long na ka bynta ka jingpynim haduh ki kut jong ka pyrthei .

en: And Judah acknowledged them , and said , She hath been more righteous than I  ; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son . And he knew her again no more .
kha: U Judah u la ithuh ïa kita ki tiar , bad u ong ,  Ka don ha ka hok . Ngam shym la pyndep ïa ka kamram ha ka — nga dei ban ai ha ka ïa u Shelah u khun jong nga ha ka jingshongkurim .  Bad u Judah um shym ïathiah shongkha shuh bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la pdiang ia ki bad u la ong, Ka la kham hok ban ia nga ; namar ba ngam shym la ai ia ka ha u Shelah khun jong nga . Bad um ithuh shuh ia ka .

en: I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .
kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot khoit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia ki ruh hapdeng ki nongwei kiba kim tip: bad ngan phah ia ka waitlam hadien jong ki , haduh ba ngan da bam ia ki .

en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree , that we , being dead to sins , should live unto righteousness : by whose stripes ye were healed .
kha: U Khrist da lade hi u la bah noh ïa ki pop jong ngi ha ka met jong u sha ka diengphna , khnang ba ngin ïap ïa ka pop bad ïoh im na ka bynta ka hok . Ka dei da ki jingjngem snam jong u ba la pynkhiah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la ka jong ka met jong u hi ka kit ia ki pop jong ngi ha la ka jong ka met ha u dieng, ba ngi, haba ngi la iap ha ki pop, ngi dei ban im ha ka hok: da ki strips jongno la pynkoit ia phi .

en: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country  ; and the white go forth after them  ; and the grisled go forth toward the south country .
kha: Ka kali ïapom ba la tan da ki kulai rong ïong ka la leit shaphang shatei sha Babilonia , ki kulai rong lieh ki leit shaphang sepngi , bad ki kulai thohbroin ki leit sha ka ri bashathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kulai kiba lieh kiba don hangta ki leit sha ka ri kaba shathie ; bad ki lieh ki leit shabar hadien jong ki ; bad ki la tyrkhong ki leit sha ka ri kaba shathie .

en: And he arose out of the synagogue , and entered into Simon s house . And Simon s wife s mother was taken with a great fever  ; and they besought him for her .
kha: U Jisu u la mih na ka synagog bad u la leit sha ïing jong u Simon . Ka kiaw kurim jong u Simon ka la pang bad ka jingpang shit kaba jur , bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih na ka synagog bad u la rung ha ka iing u Simon . Bad ka kmie jong u Simon ka la shah shim da ka jingshit kaba jur; bad ki la kyrpad ia u na ka bynta jong ka .

en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation : for when he is tried , he shall receive the crown of life , which the Lord hath promised to them that love him .
kha: Suk uta u briew uba ïaineh hapdeng ki jingtynjuh , namar ynda u jop haba u la ïaid lyngba ïa kaba kum kata ka jingtynjuh , un ïohpdiang kum ka bainong jong u ïa ka jingim kaba U Blei u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia u briew uba im: namar ynda la tynjuh ia u , un ioh ia ka khlieh jong ka jingim kaba U Trai u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ia u .

en: But whoso hath this world s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?
kha: Lada u briew uba riewspah u ïohi ïa la u parabriew ha ka jingkyrduh , pynban , u khang khyrdep ïa la ka dohnud pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , kumno u lah ban kam ba u ieit ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mano ba don ia kane ka pyrthei kaba bha, bad u iohi ia u hynmen jong u ba u donkam, bad u khang ia ki bniat jong u na u , katno ka shong ka jingieit U Blei ha u ?

en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kawei pat ka sur na bneng , ka da ong ,  To mihnoh , ko ki briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ban ïashim bynta ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh bynta ha ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia kawei pat ka sur na bneng kaba ong: To mih noh na ka ko ki briew jong nga ba phim long ki nongiashim bynta ha ki pop jong ka bad ba phim pdiang ia ki jingpang jong ka .

en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
kha: Da ka jingjop bakhraw me pynliem ïa ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jong me ka meh bad ka bam duh ïa ki kum ïa u phlangïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingkhraw jong ka jingbha jong me me me la pynhap ia kita kiba la ieng pyrshah ia me: me phah ia ka jingbitar jong me kaba la bam ia ki kum u dieng .

en: And they went about in Judah , and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah , and the chief of the fathers of Israel , and they came to Jerusalem .
kha: Ki la ïaleit sha baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ki wallam pat bad ki sha Jerusalem ïa ki Lebi bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit kylleng ha Judah bad ki la lum lang ia ki Lebi na ki shnong Judah baroh bad ki rangbah jong ki Israel bad ki la poi sha Jerusalem .

en: And when he came to him , behold , he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . And Balak said unto him , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la lap ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam ka Moab . U Balak u la kylli aïu U  Trai  u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan sha u, ha khmih, u la ieng hajan ka jingainguh thang jong u, bad ki rangbah jong ka ri Moab bad u . Bad u Balak u la ong ha u: Kaei kaba U Trai u la kren ?

en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you , I will put more to your yoke : my father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ I pa i la buh ha phi ïa ki jingkit kiba khia ; nga ngan nang pynkhia shuh shuh . I la sympat ïa phi da u shabuk , hynrei nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk kulai !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba u kpa jong nga u la buh ia ka jingkit kaba khia halor jong phi: u kpa jong nga u la pynshitom ia phi da ki khnam , hynrei ngan pynshitom ia phi da ki khnai .

en: For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .
kha: Ka kham bha ban shah khot sha ka jaka kaba kham shajrong ban ïa kaba shah ong ban ai noh ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba kham pawkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kham bha ba la ong ha me: To wan shaneng hangne; ban ia kata ba me dei ban shah buh kham shapoh ha khmat u syiem uba me la iohi da ki khmat jong me .

en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
kha: Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shah ïalam noh bad kin long ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki khun shynrang jong me kiba mih na me, kiba me kha, kin shim noh ia ka ; bad kin long ki nongshong shnong ha ka iing syiem jong u syiem Babilon .

en: And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees  ; but thine eat and drink ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ki synran jong U Ïoannis ki shahjingit man ka por bad ki duwai , bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki leh kumjuh , hynrei ki synran jong me ki ïabam bad ïadih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Balei ki synran u Ioannis ki ju shah jingit bunsien bad ki ju duwai bad kumjuh ruh ki synran jong ki Pharisi; hynrei me bam bad dih ?

en: And from thence he arose , and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and entered into an house , and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la mih bad leit noh sha ka jaka kaba hajan ka nongbah Tyros . U la leit sha kawei ka ïing bad um shym la kwah mano mano ban tip ba u don hangta , hynrei ba u lah ban shong ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ieng, bad u la leit sha ki pud jong ka Tyros bad ka Sidon, bad u la rung ha kawei ka iing: hynrei um lah ban buhrieh .

en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ba u patsha un ïohsngew ïa ka jingbna wer wer ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka ri , bad U  Trai  un shah ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan phah ia ka jingbthei halor jong u , bad un iohsngew ia ka khubor , bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka ri ; bad ngan pynlong ia u ban hap da ka waitlam ha la ka jong ka ri .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest , into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated :
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki briew kiba pha isih bad pha ijli .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih , ngan aiti ia me ha ka kti jong kita kiba me shun, ha ka kti jong kita na kiba ka jingmut jong me ka la jah noh:

en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , U  Trai  un sngewbha , bad ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat bam ia ka ; ba kan iaid bha bad me bad ki khun jong me hadien jong me , haba me leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai .

en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge : every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .
kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki rangbah ki sngew mutlop bad kim sngewthuh ei ei ; kito kiba shna bleithaw ki shah pynthame , namar ki blei kiba ki shna ki long kiba bakla bad kim don jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u long uba sniew ha ka jingtip jong u: uwei pa uwei u sdang u sngewlehrain ia ka dur ba la shna: namar ka dur ba la shna da u ka long kaba bakla , bad ym don mynsiem ha ki .

en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .
kha: U Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u para ,  Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, nga long u Joseph ; u kpa jong nga u dang im ? Bad ki hynmen jong u kim lah ban jubab ia u ; namar ki la sngewsih ha khmat jong u .

en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the  Lord  , shall be thine  ; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it .
kha: Baroh ki long ki jong me . Uwei pa uwei na ka ïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaei kaba la san nyngkong ha ka ri, kaba kin wanrah sha U Trai, kan long ka jong me; uwei pa uwei uba khuid ha ka iing jong me un bam ia ka .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u , u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai: um shym la leit noh na ki pop jong u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah  ; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field : but Manoah her husband was not with her .
kha: U Blei u leh kumba u Manoah u la kyrpad , bad u angel jong U , u wan biang sha kata ka briew katba ka dang shong ha lyngkha . U Manoah , u tnga jong ka um shym don lang bad ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la sngap ia ka sur jong u Manoah ; bad u angel U Blei u la wan phai biang sha kata ka kynthei katba ka dang shong ha lyngkha : hynrei u Manoah u tnga jong ka um don bad ka .

en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
kha: Ïa ki um la kad arliang , bad ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba kita ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit shapoh duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang: bad ki um ki long ka kynroh ia ki ha ka liang kadiang jong ki bad ha ka liang kadiang jong ki .

en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , Nay  ; but whom the  Lord  , and this people , and all the men of Israel , choose , his will I be , and with him will I abide .
kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Balei ngan leh kumta ? Nga dei ha ka liang jong uta uba la jied da U  Trai  , da kine ki briew , bad da ki Israel baroh . Ngan sah bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hushai u la ong ha u Absolman, u Nay ; hynrei ia uba U Trai, bad une u briew, bad ki briew baroh ki Israel, ki jied, ngan long bad u, bad bad bad u ngan iaineh .

en: Beside the sabbaths of the  Lord  , and beside your gifts , and beside all your vows , and beside all your freewill offerings , which ye give unto the  Lord .
kha: Kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ki long nalor ki Sabbaton ba ju rakhe , bad kine ki jingainguh ki long nalor ki jingai kiba phi ju ai , ki jingainguh ban pyndep ïa ka kular , bad ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ki Sabha jong U Trai , bad nalor ki jingai sngewbha jong phi baroh , bad nalor ki jingkular jong phi baroh , bad nalor ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi baroh .

en: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .
kha: Ïa ka ri yn pynbynta mar katjuh ha ki hynñiew bynta ; ka jait Judah kan sah ha la ka jaka shaphang shathie , bad ka jait Joseph ha la ka jaka shaphang shatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin phiah ia ka ha ki hynriew bynta: U Judah un shong ha ki rud duriaw jong ki shaphang shathie , bad ka iing u Joseph kan shong ha ki jaka jong ki shaphang shathie .

en: And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :
kha: U  Trai  u la leh ha me kumba u la kren da nga : u la knieh kynthet ïa ka hima na me , bad pynban u la ai ïa ka ha u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la leh ia u, kumba u la kren da nga: namar U Trai u la shim noh ia ka hima na ka kti jong me, bad u la ai ia ka ha u paramarjan jong me, wat ha u Dabid:

en: After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates : and Josiah went out against him .
kha: Hadien ba u syiem Josaïah u la leh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta ka Templ , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïaleh pyrshah ha Karkhemish ha ka wah Ïuphratis . U Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , hynrei u Neko u phah sha u Josaïah ïa kane ka khubor :
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine baroh, haba u Josiah u la pynkhreh ia ka tempi, u Neco u syiem Ijipt u la wan ban ialeh pyrshah ia u Karkhemish da ka Euphrates: bad u Josiah u la leit shabar pyrshah ia u .

en: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .
kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka sien kaba lai ,  Hynrei kaei ka kam runar kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban shem ïa kano kano kaba u la leh kaba u dei ban ïap ! Ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ha ka sien kaba lai: Balei, kaei kaba sniew kaba u la leh ? Ngam shym la lap ia ka daw jong ka jingiap ha u: Nga la pynshitom ia u bad ngan pyllait noh ia u .

en: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds  ; for their glory is spoiled : a voice of the roaring of young lions  ; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled .
kha: Ki nongsynshar ki kyang jam ha ka jingsngewsih ; ka burom jong ki ka la leit noh ! To pynshahshkor ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ki sing ; ïa ka ïing khlaw jong ki ha shi lynter jong ka Jordan la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka sur jong ka jingsawa jong ki nongaplangbrot ; namar ka burom jong ki ka la jot: ka sur jong ki sing samla ; namar ka jingsarong jong u Jordan ka la jot .

en: Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .
kha: Wat theh ïa ka ha ka met jong uno uno u riewpaidbah bad wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna ïa kawei pat ka jait umphniang kaba kum kane . Kane ka long kaba kyntang , bad phi dei ban kheiñ kyntang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka doh jong u briew ym dei ban theh ia ka, lymne phin ym pynlong ia kawei pat kaba kum kata: ka long kaba khuid bad kan long kaba khuid ha phi .

en: And the  Lord  rejected all the seed of Israel , and afflicted them , and delivered them into the hand of spoilers , until he had cast them out of his sight .
kha: U  Trai  u la kyntait ïa ki Israel baroh , u pynshitom ïa ki bad u aiti noh ïa ki sha ki nongshun barunar haduh ha kaba khatduh ban pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kyntait ia u symbai Israel baroh , bad u la pynshitom ia ki , bad u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki nongpynjot haduh ba u la bret noh ia ki na ka jingpeit jong u .

en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rit u la die ïa ka bynta jong ka jingdon jingem jong u bad u la mihnoh na ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha kaba u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka jingim ba-thurmur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym bun sngi hadien ba u khun uba kham rit u la ialum lang baroh, bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai, bad hangta u la pynlut kai ia ka jingbam jong u da kaba im .

en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
kha: Ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñ kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba riam kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingdap kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kaei kaba phi la leit shabar ban peit ? U briew uba la phong da ka jain kaba jem ? Ha khmih , kita kiba la riam itynnad bha bad kiba im da kaba jem , ki don ha ki iingbishar jong ki syiem .

en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron  ; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel .
kha: U Jabin u don khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar , bad u la synshar ïa ki Israel da kaba banbeiñ bad lehbor haduh arphew snem . Nangta ki paid Israel ki la kyang jam ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai: namar u la don hynniew spah tylli ki kali nar ; bad arphew snem u la pynshitom bein shibun ia ki khun Israel .

en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied upon the  Lord  God of their fathers .
kha: Bad kumta ki paid Judah ki la long nongjop halor ki Israel , namar ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la pynlong ia ki khun Israel ha kata ka por , bad ki khun Judah ki la jop , namar ki la shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um da sniew eh kat u kpa jong u , lane kat ka Jesebel , ka kmie jong u ; u la pynkhyllem ïa ka dur kaba u kpa jong u , u la thaw na ka bynta ban mane ïa u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai ; hynrei ym kum u kpa jong u bad kum ka kmie jong u: namar u la weng noh ia ka dur jong u Baal kaba u kpa jong u u la shna .

en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon  ; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia :
kha: U ïalam ïa baroh kiba dang lait im sha Babilonia , ha kaba ki shakri ïa u bad ïa kiba hiarpateng na u , kum ki mraw haduh ka por ka jingkhie rasong ka Hima Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba la lait na ka waitlam u la leit noh sha Babilon ; ha kaba ki la shakri ia u bad ki khun shynrang jong u haduh ka jingsynshar jong ka hima Persia:

en: Then Joab came to the king , and said , What hast thou done ? behold , Abner came unto thee  ; why is it that thou hast sent him away , and he is quite gone ?
kha: Kumta u Joab u leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? U Abner u la wan sha phi — balei phi shah ba un shu leit kumto ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joab u la wan sha u syiem bad u la ong: Me la leh aiu ? ha khmih u Abner u la wan sha me ; balei ba me la phah noh ia u bad u la jah noh shisha ?

en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
kha: Hadien kata , un phah khrud ïa ki kynroh baroh hapoh ïing , bad bret ïa kata ka khyndew shabar shnong ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynlong ia ka iing ban tyrkhong hapoh sawdong , bad kin theh ia ka dewmet kaba ki tyrkhong shabar ka nongbah sha ka jaka kaba khlem khuid:

en: That lie upon beds of ivory , and stretch themselves upon their couches , and eat the lambs out of the flock , and the calves out of the midst of the stall  ;
kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba thiah halor ki jingthiah baremdor , kiba ïakhawai da ki khun masi bad khunlangbrot !
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka thiah halor ki jingthiah ba sniew, bad ka pynjrong ia lade ha ki shuki jong ki, bad ka bam ia ki langbrot na ka kynhun , bad ki khun masi na pdeng ka stall ; .

en: Let him that stole steal no more : but rather let him labour , working with his hands the thing which is good , that he may have to give to him that needeth .
kha: U briew uba ju tuh u dei ban sangeh noh ban tuh bad to un sdang ban treikam khnang ba un kamai ïa ka jingim hok na ka bynta ïa lade bad ba u lah ban ïarap ïa kiba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba uta uba la tuh un ym tuh shuh: hynrei to ai ba un trei shitom da ki kti jong u ia kaba bha, ba un hap ban ai ha uta uba donkam .

en: And the Levite , the husband of the woman that was slain , answered and said , I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin , I and my concubine , to lodge .
kha: U Lebi , uba ka tnga kliar jong u ka la shah pynïap , u jubab ,  Ma nga bad ka tnga kliar jong nga ngi leit sahmiet ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lebi, u tnga jong kata ka kynthei kaba la shah pyniap, u la jubab bad u la ong: Nga la wan sha Gibeah kaba dei ka jong u Benjamin, ma nga bad ka tnga jong nga, ban sah .

en: And Joseph went up to bury his father : and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh , the elders of his house , and all the elders of the land of Egypt ,
kha: Kumta u Joseph u la leit ban tep ïa la u kpa . Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , ki bakhraw batri na ka ïing jong u , bad ki bakhraw batri jong ka ri Ijipt , ki ïaleit ryngkat bad u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la leit ban tep ia la u kpa: bad bad u la leit kiew ia ki shakri jong u Pharaoh baroh , ki rangbah jong ka iing jong u bad ki rangbah jong ka ri Ijipt baroh .

en: And he will be a wild man  ; his hand will be against every man , and every man s hand against him  ; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .
kha: Hynrei u khun jong pha un im kum ka kada khlaw , un ïaleh pyrshah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , bad uwei pa uwei u briew un ïaleh pyrshah ïa u . Un shong khlad na la ki kur ki jait baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un long u briew uba khlaw ; ka kti jong u kan long pyrshah ia u briew baroh, bad uwei pa uwei u kti jong u ; bad un shong ha khmat ki hynmen jong u baroh .

en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes , they were filled with envy , and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul , contradicting and blaspheming .
kha: Haba ki Jiw ki la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , ki la dap da ka jingpihuiñ ; ki la ïania ïa kaei kaba u Paul u la kren bad ki la krenbeiñ ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Jiw ki la iohi ia ki paidbah , ki la dap da ka jingsngewsih bad ki la kren pyrshah ia kita kiei kiei kiba la kren da u Paul , da kaba ialeh pyrshah bad kren bein .

en: And it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people ; there shall they be called the children of the living God .
kha: Bad ha kata hi ka jaka ha kaba ki la ong , ‘Phim dei ki briew jong nga .’ Hangta yn khot ïa ki , ki khun jong U Blei ba-im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka jaka ba la ong ha ki , Phim dei ki briew jong nga ; hangta yn khot ia ki ki ki khun U Blei uba im .

en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .
kha: U ong ha u Shaphan ,  Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hilkiah u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Shaphan u nongthoh , nga la shem ia ka Kitab ka hukum ha iing U Trai . Bad u Hilkiah u la aiti ia ka kot ha u Shaphan .

en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .
kha: U Pharaoh u ong ,  Ngan shah ba phin ïaleit ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyiap ; lada phim leit jngai than . Duwai na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong , Ngan pyllait noh ia phi, ba phin leit sha U Trai U Blei jong phi ha ka ri khlaw ; tang ba phin ym leit sha jngai than: to leit noh na ka bynta jong nga .

en: And I saw the beast , and the kings of the earth , and their armies , gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse , and against his army .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , bad ïa kita ki kynhun shipai jong ki , kiba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba la shong halor u kulai bad pyrshah ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia uta u mrad bad ki syiem jong ka khyndew bad ki shipai jong ki ki la ialum lang ban ialeh thma pyrshah ia uta uba shong halor u kulai bad pyrshah ia ka kynhun shipai jong u .

en: I will be surety for him  ; of my hand shalt thou require him : if I bring him not unto thee , and set him before thee , then let me bear the blame for ever :
kha: Ngan bahkhlieh da la ka jingim , bad ngan kitkhlieh na ka bynta jong u . Lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u sha phi bad buh ïa u ha khmat jong phi , ieh ngan kit pop ma nga shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan long uba thikna na ka bynta jong u ; na ka kti jong nga phin dawa ia u: lada ngam wanrah ia u ha me , bad nga buh ia u ha khmat jong me , te to ngan kit ia ka jingkynnoh junom:

en: And Laban said to Jacob , What hast thou done , that thou hast stolen away unawares to me , and carried away my daughters , as captives taken with the sword ?
kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Balei me shukor ïa nga bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun kynthei jong nga la kum ïa ki kynthei kiba shah kem ha ka thma ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong ha u Jakob, Me la leh aiu, ba me la tuh khlem da tip ia nga, bad me la rah noh ia ki khun kynthei jong nga kum ki mraw ba la shim da ka waitlam ?

en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .
kha: U Jakob u la khie dang step phyrngab , u shim ïa uta u maw ïa uba u la syngkhlieh , bad u thung ïa u ban sah jingkynmaw . Nangta u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u ban pynkyntang ïa u sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ieng dang step bad u la shim ia u maw uba u la buh na ka bynta ki tyrpeng jong u bad u la buh ia u kum u maw bad u la theh umphniang halor jong u .

en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .
kha: bad ban pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil ban ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingisynei jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Bad kumta ngin ïaroh ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ki Jutang kin pyndonburom ia U Blei na ka bynta ka jingisynei jong u ; kumba la thoh: Na kane ka daw ngan phla ha me hapdeng ki Jutang , bad ngan rwai ha ka kyrteng jong me .

en: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .
kha: Kine ki briew baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Noah , ha la ka jait ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkheiñ jait bapher bapher ha ka jinghiarpateng . Hadien ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ki hiarpateng na ki khun shynrang jong u Noah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki longiing jong ki khun shynrang u Noah, hadien ki pateng jong ki: bad da kine la phiah ia ki jaitbynriew ha ka khyndew hadien ka jingshlei um .

en: Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off .
kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel ki pyrkhat ba ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingïathuhlypa jong me ki dei shaphang ka lawei kaba dang slem .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew , ha khmih , ki jong ka iing Israel ki ong , Ka jingphohsniew kaba u iohi ka long na ka bynta ki sngi kiba bun ban wan , bad u iathuhlypa ia ki por kiba jngai .

en: For I know that in me ( that is , in my flesh , ) dwelleth no good thing : for to will is present with me ; but how to perform that which is good I find not .
kha: Nga tip ba kaba bha kam im hapoh jong nga — kata , ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong nga . Naba wat la ka jingkwah ban leh ïa kaba bha ka don hapoh jong nga , ngam lah ban leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ba ha nga (ka mut, ha ka doh jong nga), kam don ei ei kaba bha: namar ka mon ka don bad nga ; hynrei kumno ban leh ia kaba bha ngam shem .

en: Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .
kha: Uei keiñ uba lah ban pyllait ïa ngi na kine ki blei kiba khlaiñbor ? Kine ki dei kita ki blei kiba la shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyiap !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ngi ! mano ban pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti jong kine ki Blei kiba khlain bor ? kine ki long ki Blei kiba pynkhih ia ki nong Ijipt da ki khniang baroh ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And when he had considered the thing , he came to the house of Mary the mother of John , whose surname was Mark  ; where many were gathered together praying .
kha: Da kaba tip ïa la ka jinglong jingman , u la leit sha ka ïing jong ka Mari , ka kmie jong u Ïoannis Markos , ha kaba bun ki briew ki la ïalumlang bad ba ki dang duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pyrkhat ia kata ka kam, u la poi ha iing ka Maria ka kmie u loannis , uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Mark ; ha kaba bun ki la ialum lang bad ki duwai .

en: Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .
kha: To phah ïa u paidbhur ban lute ïa ki ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong ïa ki ban kyang ha ka jingshyrkhei . Ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ban pynngat ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba yn iohsngew ia ka jingpyrta na ki iing jong ki, haba me wanrah kynsan ia ki: namar ki la tih ia ka thliew ban shim ia nga , bad ki la buhrieh ia ki jingeh na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga .

en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses his servant , so did Moses command Joshua , and so did Joshua  ; he left nothing undone of all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki hukum jong u ha u Moses u shakri jong u , u Moses u la ai ïa kita ha u Joshua , bad u Joshua u la kohnguh ïa ki . U la leh ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses u shakri jong u, kumjuh ruh u Moses u la hukum ia u Joshua, bad kumjuh ruh u Joshua um shym la iehnoh ei ei na kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God , and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the  Lord .
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym shahshkor da kaba pynrit ïa lade ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa , uba kren ïa ka ktien U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong u, bad um shym la pynrit ia lade ha khmat u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa uba kren na ka shyntur U Trai .

en: And the mountains shall be molten under him , and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .
kha: Te ki lum kin um hapoh jong u kum ka bthing ha ka ding , kin noh sha ki jaka them kum ka um batuid arsut ïa u lumrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lum kin sa tyrkhong hapoh jong u, bad ki them kin sa tyrkhong kum ka um ha khmat ka ding bad kum ki um kiba tuid shapoh ka jaka kaba jrong .

en: My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :
kha: Nga thoh ïa kane ha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , khnang ba phin ym leh pop ; hynrei lada uno uno u leh pop , ngi don uwei uba ïasaid bad U Kpa na ka bynta jong ngi — U Jisu Khrist , uta uba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun rit jong nga, kine kiei kiei nga thoh ha phi, ba phin ym leh pop . Bad lada uno uno u briew u pop , ngi don u nongiasaid ain bad U Kpa , U Jisu Khrist uba hok:

en: And now , O  Lord  God , the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant , and concerning his house , establish it for ever , and do as thou hast said .
kha: Bad mynta , A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ha ki por baroh ïa ka kular ba me la pynlong shaphang jong nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh kumba me la kren ba men leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Trai Blei, ka ktien kaba me la kren shaphang u shakri jong me bad shaphang ka iing jong u, to pynskhem ia ka junom bad leh kumba me la ong .

en: In their heat I will make their feasts , and I will make them drunken , that they may rejoice , and sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hato ki jlawnguid ? Ngan pynkhreh ïa ki ka jingkhawai bad pynlong ïa ki ban buaid bad sngewtynnat . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingshit jong ki ngan pynlong ia ki jingkhawai jong ki, bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban dih kyiad, ba kin sngewbha, bad kin thiah ia ka jingthiah kaba neh slem, bad ban ym khie , ong U Trai .

en: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark ,
kha: Ha ki sngi shuwa ka jingshlei um , ki briew ki ïabam bad ïadih , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi hi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka ïinglieng ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba long ha ki sngi shuwa ka jingshlei um ki dang bam bad dih , ki dang shongkurim bad ki dang shongkurim haduh ka sngi ba u Noah u la rung shapoh ka lieng .

en: And say unto them , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , ye kings of Judah , and all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki syiem bad ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ba sah ha Jerusalem bad rung sha kine ki khyrdop , ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai , phi ki syiem Judah bad ki Judah baroh bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem baroh kiba rung shapoh da kine ki khyrdop:

en: Each time you go to the Kingdom Hall , become acquainted with one of the elders or ministerial servants until you get to know all of them and their families .
kha: Man ba phi leit sha ka Ïing Hima , pyrshang ban ithuh ïa iwei na ki rangbah balang ne nongïarap balang haduh ba phin da ithuh lut ïa ki bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Man la ka por ba phi leit sha ka Hima Hall , to ithuh bad uwei na ki rangbah ne ki shakri ba shakri haduh ba phin da ithuh ia ki baroh bad ki iing jong ki .

en: Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .
kha: Wat siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew lane ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynban , to siew kylliang da ka jingkyrkhu , namar ka jingkyrkhu ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa phi mynba u la khot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ym pynkylla ia ka jingsniew na ka bynta ka jingsniew, ne ban iaid lait ia ka jingma: hynrei da kaba pyrshah ia ka jingkyrkhu;

en: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way , and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase : the lion had not eaten the carcase , nor torn the ass .
kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumta , bad u leit noh bad u la lap ïa kata ka metïap u nongïathuhlypa ha lynti bah , lem bad ka kada bad u sing kiba dang ïeng hajan jong ka . U sing um shym la bam ïa kata ka metïap lymne patar ïa ka kada .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bad u la lap ia ka met jong u kaba la bret ha lynti, bad u tdong bad u sing u la ieng hajan ka met: u sing um shym la bam ia ka met iap, lymne u la pynpra ia ka tdong .

en: Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,
kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh ki paid Israel ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki khun Israel baroh bad to ong ha ki ; Kane ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum da kaba ong:

en: And thou , my lord , O king , the eyes of all Israel are upon thee , that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him .
kha: Syiem Kynrad , baroh ki paid Israel ki khmih sha phi ban ïathuh ha ki uei u ban long syiem hadien jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, ki khmat jong ki Israel baroh ki don ha me, ba me dei ban iathuh ia ki kiba shong ha ka khet jong u kynrad jong nga hadien jong u .

en: Jesus Christ himself said : “ Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out . ”
kha: U Jisu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “ Wat sngew kyndit ia kane , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jing tep kin ioh sngew ia ka jingpyrta jong u bad kin ia mih noh . ”
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu Khrist hi u la ong:  Wat sngewphylla ia kane , namar ka kynta kan sa wan ha kaba baroh kiba don ha ki jingtep jingkynmaw kin iohsngew ia ka sur jong u bad kin mih noh .

en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds , to meet the Lord in the air : and so shall we ever be with the Lord .
kha: nangta ïa ngi kiba dang im ha kata ka por yn lumlang lem bad ki ha ki ha ki lyoh ban ïashem ïa U Trai ha suiñ . Bad kumta ngin ïailong borabor bad U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngi kiba im bad kiba sah ngin sa shah kem lang bad ki ha ki lyoh , ban iakynduh ia U Trai ha ka Iyer : bad kumta ngin iai long bad U Trai .

en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son . If he commit iniquity , I will chasten him with the rod of men , and with the stripes of the children of men :
kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u , bad u , un long u khun jong nga . Haba u leh bakla , ngan sneng sympat ïa u kumba u kpa u sneng sympat ïa la u khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khun jong nga . Lada u leh khlem akor , ngan pynshitom ia u da u diengduh jong ki briew bad da ki diengduh jong ki khun ki briew:

en: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days , when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place .
kha: U khun jong u Aaron u ban mih pli ïa u kum u lyngdoh bad uba leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ban shakri ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang u dei ban phong ïa kine ki jaiñ hynñiew sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u khun uba long lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u un buh ia ki hynriew sngi , haba u wan sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ban shakri ha ka jaka bakhuid .

en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in , to give thee their land for an inheritance , as it is this day .
kha: Katba nang ïaid sha khmat , u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi , khnang ba un buh ïa phi ha ka ri jong ki , bad ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban beh noh ia ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong me kiba kham khraw bad kham khlain bor ban ia me, ban wanrah ia me, ban ai ia me ia ka ri jong ki kum ka pateng, kumba ka long ha kane ka sngi .

en: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown , and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land , neither bear the shame of the heathen any more .
kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ki jaka rep kiba seisoh bad ngan pynkut noh ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Kiwei pat ki ri kin ym rkhiebeiñ shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih na ka bynta jong ki ia u jingthung uba pawnam, bad kin ym shah bam shuh ha ka jingkyrduh ha ka ri , lymne kin ym shah shuh ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki nongwei .

en: And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
kha: Haba ki la wan kiew na kata ka um , U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la rah noh ïa u Philip . U rangbah synshar um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u , hynrei u la bteng ïa la ka jingleit , uba dap da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la mih na ka um, u Mynsiem U Trai u la kem noh ia u Philip, ba uta u nongleh kam shym la iohi shuh ia u: bad u la iaid lynti da kaba kmen .

en: And he dreamed , and behold a ladder set up on the earth , and the top of it reached to heaven : and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it .
kha: U la phohsniew ba u ïohi ïa ka lynti mawkyrdon na khyndew sha bneng , bad ki angel kiba ïakiew ïahiar ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phohsniew bad ha khmih kawei ka jingkieng ka la kiew sha bneng: bad ha khmih ki angel U Blei ki kiew bad hiar halor jong ka .

en: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains , and of the plains south of Chinneroth , and in the valley , and in the borders of Dor on the west ,
kha: bad sha ki syiem kiba ha ka ri lum ha ka phang shatei , kiba ha Them Jordan shathie na ka Duriaw Galilaïa , kiba ha trai ki lum , bad kiba harud duriaw hajan ka Dor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki syiem kiba don shaphang shathie jong ki lum bad ki madan shaphang shathie jong ka Kinneroth bad ha ki pud jong ka Dor shaphang sepngi .

en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron : and the people that were with him were about six hundred men  ;
kha: uba sher dara ha trai u soh Pomkranet ha Migron , ym da jngai na Gibeah ; u la don bad u kumba hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la sah ha ka bynta kaba kut tam jong ka Gibeah hapoh u dieng uba don ha Migron : bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u ki long kumba hynriew spah ngut ki briew;

en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father , saying , Thou hast clothing , be thou our ruler , and let this ruin be under thy hand :
kha: Ka por kan poi ha kaba ki dkhot jong ka kur kin jied uwei napdeng jong ki bad ong ha u ,  Ma phi la kumno kumno phi don ei ei ban phong , kumta to long u nongïalam jong ngi ha kane ka por ka jingjynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u briew un bat ia u hynmen jong u na ka iing u kpa jong u, da kaba ong: Me don jain, to long u nongsynshar jong ngi, bad to ai ba kane ka jingjot kan long hapoh ka kti jong me:

en: Who art thou that judgest another man s servant ? to his own master he standeth or falleth . Yea , he shall be holden up : for God is able to make him stand .
kha: Phi dei uei ban bishar ïa u shakri jong uwei pat ? U dei u Kynrad jong u hi u ban rai lada un jop ne un rem . Bad un jop , namar U Trai u lah ban pynlah ïa u ban jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long mano ba bishar ia uwei pat u shakri ? ha la u jong u kynrad u ieng ne u hap . Hooid , un sa shah bat: namar U Blei u lah ban pynlong ia u ban ieng .

en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .
kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph na Arimathaïa , ka shnong kaba ha Judia . U la long u briew uba bha bad uba donburom , uba la apkhmih ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Wat la u long u dkhot jong ka Dorbar , um shym la mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: (U juh um shym la mynjur ia ka jingmut bad ka jingleh jong ki ; ) u la long na ka shnong jong ki Jiw: uba ruh ma u hi u la ap ia ka hima U Blei .

en: And the seven years of dearth began to come , according as Joseph had said : and the dearth was in all lands  ; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .
kha: Ka la don ka  nemsniew ha kiwei ruh ki ri ; hynrei ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei , don kyrhai ka bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew snem ka jingkyrduh ki la sdang ban wan kumba u Joseph u la ong: bad ka jingkyrduh ka la don ha ki ri baroh; hynrei ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka don u kpu .

en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten  ; it shall be burnt with fire : and as for the flesh , all that be clean shall eat thereof .
kha: Lada ka doh kaba la kum dei bad kaei kaei ïa kaba la ñiew bymkhuid , ym dei ban bam , hynrei ban thang noh ïa ka . Uno uno ïa uba la ñiew ba u long uba khuid u lah ban bam ïa ka doh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh kaba ktah ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid kan ym shah thang da ka ding: bad ia ka doh baroh kaba khuid kan bam ia ka .

en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart , when they howled upon their beds : they assemble themselves for corn and wine , and they rebel against me .
kha: Kim shym la duwai ha nga naduh la ka dohnud , hynrei pynban ki bret ïa lade ha madan bad ïam pangnud kumba leh kiba mane blei thala . Haba ki duwai ban ïoh ïa u kew bad ka waiñ , ki ot pynmong ïa lade kum kiba mane blei thala . A haduh katno ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la pyrta ia nga da ka dohnud jong ki: ki ialum lang ia lade na ka bynta u kew bad ka wain , bad ki leh pyrshah ia nga .

en: But king Solomon loved many strange women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh , women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Zidonians , and Hittites  ;
kha: U Solomon u la ieit ïa kiba bun ki kynthei nongwei . Nalor ka khun u syiem ka ri Ijipt , u la shongkurim ruh ïa ki kynthei nong Hit bad ki kynthei nong Moab , Ammon , Edom bad Sidon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem Solomon u la ieit ia kiba bun ki kynthei kiba phylla, ryngkat bad ka khun jong u Pharaoh, ki kynthei jong ki nong Moab, ki nong Ammon , ki nong Edome , ki Sidonian bad ki Hit;

en: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
kha: U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim ruh wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la bitar shibun, bad u la ong ha U Trai, Wat burom ia ka jingainguh jong ki: Ngam shym la shim ia kawei ka kada na ki , bad ngam shym la pynmong ia uwei ruh na ki .

en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .
kha: Ki briew kiba pyrshang ban pynbor ïa phi ban otsher ki dei kito kiba kwah ban pynpaw bad kob ïa ki kam kiba paw shabar . Ki leh ïa ka , la kumno kumno , tang ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ na ka bynta ka diengphna U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki kwah ban leh ia ka jingpyni kaba hok ha ka doh , ki khanglad ia phi ban shah ot ; tang khnang ba kin shah pynshitom bein na ka bynta ka diengphna U Khrist .

en: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , Rechab and Baanah , went , and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish–bosheth , who lay on a bed at noon .
kha: U Rekhab bad u Baanah ki leit sha ka ïing u Ishbosheth bad ki poi hangta ha ka por shiteng sngi , katba u dang pynjahthait ïa lade ha ka por shiteng sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Rimmon u Beerothite, u Rehab bad u Baanah ki la leit sha ka iing u Ishbosheth uba la thiah ha ka jingthiah ha ka por shiteng sngi .

en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth–shemesh  ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .
kha: U pud u kynjoh ruh ïa ka Tabor , ka Shahasumah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , u da kut noh ha ka Jordan . Ka kynthup khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rud duriaw ka poi sha Tabor, bad ka Shahazimah, bad ka Bethshesh ; bad ki jingleit jingwan jong ki ki long ha Jordan: shiphew tylli ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
kha: U Krispos , uba long u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kiwei pat ki briew ha Korinth ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki la ngeit , bad la pynbaptis ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Crispus u nongsynshar rangbah jong ka synagog u la ngeit ha U Trai ryngkat bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei; bad bun na ki nong Korinth ki la ngeit bad la pynbaptis ia ki .

en: To them that are without law , as without law , ( being not without law to God , but under the law to Christ , ) that I might gain them that are without law .
kha: Kumjuh ruh , haba nga dang trei bad ki Jentil , nga im kum u Jentil , shabar ka Hukum ki Jiw , khnang ban jop ïa ki Jentil . Kane kam mut ba nga khlem kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei ; nga long shisha hapoh ka hukum U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kito ki bym don ain, kumba khlem ain, (bym long khlem ain ha U Blei , hynrei hapoh ka ain ha U Khrist , ) ba ngan ioh ia kita ki bym don ain .

en: Lest I strip her naked , and set her as in the day that she was born , and make her as a wilderness , and set her like a dry land , and slay her with thirst .
kha: Lada kam sangeh , ngan law lyngkhuit ïa ka kumba ka la long ha ka sngi ba la kha ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka , kum ka ri kaba tyrkhong bad ka bymseisoh , bad kan sa ïap namar ka jingsliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Lest nga weng noh ia ka lyngkhuid jong ka, bad nga buh ia ka kumba ha ka sngi ba la kha ia ka, bad nga pynlong ia ka kum ka ri khlaw, bad nga buh ia ka kum ka ri kaba rkhiang, bad nga pyniap ia ka da ka jingthngan .

en: And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kaba ïa U  Trai  la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Judah baroh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynbha ia ka jingknia U Trai , bad u la knia ia ki jingknia jingsuk bad ki jingknia ainguh , bad u la hukum ia u Judah ban shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan , from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon  ;
kha: Ha kata ka por , ngi la ïohknieh na kita ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor ïa ka ri kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , naduh ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Hermon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la shim ha kata ka por na ka kti jong ki arngut ki syiem ki Amorit ia ka ri kaba don ha kane ka liang ka wah Jordan, naduh ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Hermon;

en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .
kha: Ka Abigail ka dem ngon ha khyndew bad ka ong ,  Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la ieng bad ka la dem khrup ha ka khyndew bad ka la ong: Ha khmih to ai ba me long u shakri ban sait ia ki kjat jong ki shakri jong u kynrad jong nga .

en: Of these things put them in remembrance , charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit , but to the subverting of the hearers .
kha: To pynkynmaw ïa ki briew jong me ïa kane , bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingkyntu bajai jai ha khmat U Blei ba kin ym ïa-wohnia halor ki kyntien ba ki ïakren . Kam long kaba pynmyntoi , hynrei tang ban pynjot ïa ki briew kiba sngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kine kiei kiei ki la buh ia ki ha ka jingkynmaw , da kaba kynnoh ia ki ha khmat U Trai ba kim ialeh ei ei shaphang ki ktien khlem jingmyntoi ei ei , hynrei sha ka jingpynkylla ia ki nongsngap .

en: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kane baroh haba nga pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrthei , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki don ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shahshitom hapoh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh nga la iohi, bad nga la pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong nga ha kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba la leh hapoh ka sngi: ka don ka por ha kaba uwei u briew u synshar ia uwei pat ha la ka jong ka jingsngewsih .

en: Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
kha: Ong ruh ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki kali na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnga bad ki khun rit jong ki , bad ban wan ïalam ïa u kpa jong phi bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la hukum ia me, kane ka long kaba phi shim na ka ri Ijipt na ka bynta ki khun rit jong phi bad na ka bynta ki tnga jong phi bad wanrah ia u kpa jong phi bad wan .

en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki ksiew jong me hi yn sa ïalam noh bad ban pynlong ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki khun shynrang jong me kiba mih na me, kiba me kha, kin shim noh ia ka ; bad kin long ki nongshong shnong ha ka iing syiem jong u syiem Babilon .

en: And it came to pass , when Saul was returned from following the Philistines , that it was told him , saying , Behold , David is in the wilderness of En–gedi .
kha: Haba u Saul u wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki Philistia , la ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u don ha ka ri khlaw hajan Engedi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Saul u la wan phai na kaba bud ia ki Philistia, ba la iathuh ha u, da kaba ong: Ha khmih u Dabid u don ha ka ri khlaw jong u Enxed .

en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near , and smote Micaiah on the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem jong U  Trai  u iehnoh ïa nga bad u kren ha me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Sedekaiah u khun u Chenaah u la leit shajan bad u la shoh ia u Maiah ha ka rmiang shyntur bad u la ong: Kumno u Mynsiem U Trai u la leit noh na nga ban kren ha me ?

en: And Pharaoh called unto Moses , and said , Go ye , serve the  Lord   ; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed : let your little ones also go with you .
kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses , bad u la ong ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  ; wat ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh ki lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi . Hynrei ki langbrot , ki blang bad ki masi jong phi ki dei ban don hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la khot ia u Moses bad u la ong, To leit shakri ia U Trai ; tang ba ki langbrot bad ki kynhun jong phi kin sah: to ai ba ki khun rit jong phi ruh kin leit bad phi .

en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear : and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them , seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God .
kha: Nga la pynïap ïa ki sing bad ki dngiem , bad ngan leh kumjuh ïa une u Philistia ba mane blei thala , uba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong U Blei uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri jong me u la pyniap ia u sing bad u bear: bad une u Philistia u bym pat shah ot un long kum uwei na ki , namar u la pynrem ia ki shipai jong U Blei uba im .

en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein , save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .
kha: Nga la kular ba ngan shah ïa phi ban shong hangta , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ïoh ïa kata , lait tang u Kaleb bad u Joshua .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem artatien phin ym wan sha ka ri kaba nga sngap jar ban pynlong ia phi ban shong hangta, lait noh tang u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh bad u Joshua u khun u Nun .

en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :
kha: U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa u Asaph bad ïa ki para Lebi ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad ka jingmane ba pynlong ha ka jaka ba la buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki hangta man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit noh hangta ha khmat ka synduk jong u Trai Asaph bad ki hynmen jong u, ban shakri ha khmat ka synduk man ka sngi:

en: The petitioner approached the high court after the Directorate of Government Printing and Stationery rejected her application to change the name three times .
kha: Ka nongmudui ka la leit sha ka iingbishar ba ha khlieh duh hadien ba ka Directorate of Government Printing and Stationary ka la kyntait ia ka jingkyrpad jong ka ban pynkylla ia ka kyrteng lai sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka nongujor ka la leit sha ka iingbishar kaba ha khlieh duh hadien ba ka Directorate jong ka Sorkar ka la kyntait ia ka aplikeshon jong ka ban pynkylla ia ka kyrteng lai sien .

en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .
kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew ruh ka la shah pynjakhlia hapoh ki nongshong shnong jong ka ; namar ki la pynkhein ia ki ain , ki la pynkylla ia ka hukum , ki la pynpra ia ka jutang bymjukut .

en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come , ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :
kha: Nangta u Syiem un ong ha ki briew kiba ha ka liang kamon jong u , ‘ To wan , phi kiba la kyrkhu da U Kpa jong nga ! To wan bad to ïoh ïa ka hima kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi naduh kaba pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Syiem un ong ha ki ha ka liang kadiang jong u: To wan, phi la kyrkhu ia u Kpa jong nga, to hiar pateng ia ka hima ba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi naduh ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei:

en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .
kha: U Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . Kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ha u Moses , ki dei ban pdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki , ïa ka bhah jong ki jingainguh ba la thang ha ka duwan sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ha ka jait Lebi um shym la ai pateng shuh shuh; ki jingknia jong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ba la shna da ka ding ki long ka pateng jong ki kumba u la ong ha ki .

en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows , let them relieve them , and let not the church be charged ; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed .
kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka parabangeit ka don ki riewkynthei ha ka longïing jong ka , ka dei ban sumar ïa ki bad ban ym bankhia ïa ka balang , khnang ba ka lah ban sumar ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u shynrang ne kynthei uba ngeit u don ki riewkynthei , to ai ba kin pyllait ia ki , bad wat ai ba ka balang kan shah kynnoh ; ba kan pyllait ia ki kiba long ki riewkynthei shisha .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;
kha: Nga la pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka miet , khnang ba kin wan mih ha la ki por kiba biang ; bad ïa ka jutang yn ym lah ban pynkheiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Lada phi lah ban pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga ha ka sngi bad ka jutang jong nga ha ka miet bad ba kan ym don ka por bad ka miet ha ka aiom jong ki ; .

en: And he commanded them , saying , Behold , ye shall lie in wait against the city , even behind the city : go not very far from the city , but be ye all ready :
kha: lem bad kine ki hukum :  Rieh ha kawei ka liang jong ka nongbah , hynrei wat leit jngai than na ka ; long ba la khreh ban tur ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki da kaba ong: Ha khmih, phin thiah ha ka shnong, wat shadien ka shnong: wat leit jngai than na ka shnong: hynrei to long kiba la pynkhreh baroh:

en: ( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
kha: ( Loukas 21 :1-4 ) Te mano mano ruh ki lah ban “buh noh ha lade” barabor ban ai “katba u thmu ha la ka dohnud .” —1 Korinth 16 :2 ; 2 Korinth 9 :7 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Loukas 21 :1-4 ) Kumta uno uno u lah ban pynbeit man ka por ia kaei kaei kaba shawei ban ai  kumba u la kut jingmut ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I return in peace .
kha: Ong ha ki ban thep ïa u ha ka byndi bad ban ai ha u ïa u kpu bad ka um haduh ba ngan da wan phai khlem shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumta u syiem u ong ia une u paralok ha phatok , bad ai bam ia u da u kpu jong ka jingjynjar bad da ka um jong ka jingjynjar , haduh ba ngan da wan phai biang ha ka jingsuk .

en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
kha: Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki ksew — kin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa phi . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki sniang — kin shu ïuh pynban ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ia kata kaba khuid ha ki kulai , lymne wat bret ia ki mawkordor jong phi ha khmat ki sniang , ioh kin iaid kjat ia ki hapoh ki kjat jong ki , bad kin phai biang bad pynkhih ia phi .

en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .
kha: Kynsan kynsan bad khlem poi pyrkhat U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki  erïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki  erlangthari bad ka ding baklang ;
translated_en_to_kha: To shah peit ia U Trai jong ki paid da ka jingkhynñiuh jumai, bad da ka jingsawa kaba khraw, da ka eriong bad ka eriong , bad ka ding kaba bam .

en: And the two kidneys , and the fat that is on them , which is by the flanks , and the caul that is above the liver , with the kidneys , it shall he take away :
kha: ki khyllai bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ar tylli ki snier bad ka shini kaba don ha ki, kaba don hajan ki bniat bad ka caul kaba don halor ka sniehdoh, ryngkat bad ki snier, un weng noh ia ka:

en: When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .
kha: Pule ïa ka ha ki paid Israel haba ki wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki Israel baroh ki wan ban paw ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka jaka kaba un jied , men pule ia kane ka hukum ha khmat ki Israel baroh ha ka jingsngap jong ki .

en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .
kha: U Blei u ïailong ka jingïada jong phi ; Ki ksang ti uba na bymjukut ki kyrshan ïa phi . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , Bad u ong ïa phi ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei bymjukut u long ka jaka rieh jong me, bad hapoh jong me ki don ki kti bymjukut: bad un beh noh ia u nongshun na khmat me ; bad un ong , Pynduh noh ia ki .

en: Sharmila Moulik , the deputy superintendent of the hospital said that woman , Runi Khatun , is mentally unstable and she has been referred to a psychiatrist .
kha: Ka Sharmila Moulik ka deputy superintendent ka Hospital ka la ong ba katei ka longkmie kaba la tip kyrteng kum ka Runi Khatun ka don ka jingduna ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad la phah ia ka sha u psychiatrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Sharmila Moulik , ka nongpeitkai ba kyrpang jong ka hospital ka la ong ba ka kynthei , ka Runi Khatun ka long kaba khlem skhem ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad la phah ia ka sha u doktor psychiatric .

en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .
kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Me tip ia ki hukum , Wat leh be-ijot , Wat pyniap , Wat tuh , Wat shah ia ka sakhi lamler , Wat shah ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me .

en: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty , and floods upon the dry ground : I will pour my spirit upon thy seed , and my blessing upon thine offspring :
kha: Ngan ai um ïa ka ri basliang bad pynlong ïa ki wahduid ban tuid ha ka khyndew ba-tyrkhong . Ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki khun jong phi bad ka jingkyrkhu jong nga ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan theh um ia uta uba sliang, bad ngan theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga halor u symbai jong me: Ngan theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga halor u symbai jong me:

en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
kha: Ym shym la ai phlangïap shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban shna maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi shah shoh . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ kiba bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don sboh ba la ai ha ki shakri jong me, bad ki ong ia ngi, To shna nar: bad, ha khmih, ki shakri jong me ki shah shoh ; hynrei ka jingbakla ka don ha la ki jong ki briew .

en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields , and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard , which kept the door of the king s house .
kha: Ban buh bujli ïa ki , u syiem Rehoboam u thaw da ki stieh rnong bad u aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Rehoboam u la shna ha ka jaka jong ki da ki nar kiba la tyrkhong bad u la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong u rangbah shipai uba la pahara ia ka jingkhang jong ka iing syiem .

en: Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .
kha: Lashai hamar kane ka por , ngan pynhap da u phria uba jur , uba kat uta ka ri Ijipt kam pat ju tip mynno mynno ha ka histori jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ban sngewsih ia kane ka por ngan pynlong ia u slap uba sngewsih shibun , kumba um pat ju don ha Ijipt naduh ka nongrim jong ka haduh mynta .

en: The NIA will seek Bhats custody to question him in the Jammu and Kashmir terror funding case , a senior official in the security establishment told ThePrint .
kha: Ka NIA kan pan ia ka jingbat ia u Bhats ban kylli jingkylli ia u ha ka mukotduma ai pisa ia ki lehnoh ha Jammu bad Kashmir , la iathuh u heh jong ka tnad pahara ha ka ThePrint .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka NIA kan wad ia u Bhat ban buh jingkylli ia u ha ka kam ai pisa ia ki kam lehnoh ha Jammu bad Kashmir, u heh ophisar ha ka jaka pahara u la iathuh ha ka ThePrint .

en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .
kha: Mynba nga dang sah ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U  Trai  ba lada un ïalam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan mane ïa u ha Hebron .
