translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u shakri jong me u la kular katba nga dang sah ha Geshur ha Syria, da kaba ong: Lada U Trai un wanrah biang ia nga shisha sha Jerusalem , te ngan shakri ia U Trai .

en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men : in thy hills , and in thy valleys , and in all thy rivers , shall they fall that are slain with the sword .
kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah da ki metïap , bad ki met jong kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma kin tap ïa ki lumrit bad ki them .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyndap ia ki lum jong u da ki briew kiba la shah pyniap: ha ki lum jong me bad ha ki them jong me bad ha ki wah jong me baroh .

en: Behold ye among the heathen , and regard , and wonder marvellously : for I will work a work in your days , which ye will not believe , though it be told you .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha la ki briew ,  To khmih thuh ïa ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong phi , bad phin lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi . Ngan leh ei ei kaba phin ym lah ngeit haba phi ïohsngew shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih phi hapdeng ki nongwei, bad phi sngew lyngngoh shibun: namar ngan leh ia ka kam ha ki sngi jong phi, kaba phin ym ngeit, wat la la iathuh ia ka ha phi .

en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .
kha: To thoh ka jingbatai shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban batai ia ka ri haduh hynriew bynta, bad wanrah ia ka jingbatai hangne ha nga, ba ngan thep vote na ka bynta jong phi hangne ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: While he answered for himself , Neither against the law of the Jews , neither against the temple , nor yet against Caesar , have I offended any thing at all .
kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ïasaid da ïa lade :  Ngam shym leh ei ei kano kano kaba bakla pyrshah ïa ka Hukum ki Jiw , lane pyrshah ïa ka Templ , lane pyrshah ïa u Patsha ka Hima Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang jubab na ka bynta lade , Bad pyrshah ia ka ain jong ki Jiw , lymne pyrshah ia ka tempi , lymne pyrshah ia u Kaisar , nga la pynsngewsih ei ei ruh em .

en: And unto one he gave five talents , to another two , and to another one  ; to every man according to his several ability  ; and straightway took his journey .
kha: U la ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jinglah jong u : Ha uwei u la ai san hajar tylli ki sbai ksiar , ha uwei pat u la ai ar hajar tylli , bad ha uwei pat u la ai shihajar tylli . Nangta u la mih ban leit jingleit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha uwei u la ai san tylli ki talent, ha uwei pat uwei u ; ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jinglah jong u ; bad u la shim beit ia ka jingleit jong u.

en: And she say to me , Both drink thou , and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the  Lord  hath appointed out for my master s son .
kha: Lada ka mynjur bad tyrwa ruh ban wanrah um ïa ki ut jong nga , to ai ba kata kan long kaba me la jied kum ka tnga ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ong ha nga , Baroh arngut to dih ia me bad ngan ring ruh ia ki kulai jong me: to ai ba kajuh kan long ka kynthei kaba U Trai u la buh na ka bynta u khun kynrad jong nga .

en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .
kha: Bad ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynban ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jait na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la pynlong ka jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan ym weng noh ia ka hima baroh kawei hynrei ngan ai kawei ka jaitbynriew ha u khun jong me na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga, bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem kaba nga la jied .

en: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .
kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi la long kiba ngeit ?   Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Hato phi la pdiang ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid naduh ba phi ngeit ? Ki la ong ha u , Ngim pat iohsngew haduh katta katta la don ne em U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened , and be ye valiant : for your master Saul is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them .
kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! U Saul , u syiem jong phi u la ïap , bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsleh ïa nga kum u syiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to ai ba ki kti jong phi kin nang khlain, bad to long kiba shlur: namar u kynrad jong phi u la iap, bad kumjuh ruh ka iing Judah ka la pynsleh ia nga syiem halor jong ki .

en: And Benjamin came again at that time  ; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead : and yet so they sufficed them not .
kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan phai pat , bad kiwei ki Israel ki ai ha ki ïa kita ki theisotti na Jabesh ïa kiba kim shym la pynïap . Hynrei kita kim pat biang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benjamin u la wan biang ha kata ka por bad ki la ai ia ki ia ki tnga kiba ki la pynim im na ki kynthei jong u Jabeshgilead: bad wat la katta ruh kim shym la biang ia ki .

en: But Abram said unto Sarai , Behold , thy maid is in thy hand  ; do to her as it pleaseth thee . And when Sarai dealt hardly with her , she fled from her face .
kha: U Abram u ong ,  Ñiuma , ka dei ka mraw jong pha bad hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong pha ; leh ïa ka katba pha sngewbit .  Kumta ka Sarai ka lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa ka kat haduh ba ka la phet noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abram u la ong ha ka Sarai, Ha khmih, ka shakri jong me ka don ha ka kti jong me. Bad haba ka Sarai ka la leh tang khyndiat eh bad ka, ka la phet noh na ka khmat jong ka .

en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .
kha: Kin ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jong ki un kham khraw ïa u Agag , Bad ka bor synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Un theh ia ka um na ki bniat jong u, bad u symbai jong u un don ha ki um kiba bun, bad u syiem jong u un kham heh ban ia u Agag , bad ka hima jong u kan nang kiew .

en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .
kha: Hangta hajan , la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang , kiba ïabam jingbam ha ki sharing lum . Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban shah ïa ki ban rung shapoh ki sniang , bad u la shah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka kynhun sniang kaba bun kaba bam ha u lum: bad ki la kyrpad ia u ba un shah ia ki ban rung shapoh jong ki . Bad u la shah shitom ia ki .

en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went , and did according as the  Lord  commanded them : the  Lord  also accepted Job .
kha: U Eliphas , u Bildad bad u Sophar ki la leh ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa ki ban leh , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u Job .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Elipha u Teman bad u Bildad u Shuhi bad u Sophar u Namath u la leit noh bad u la leh katba U Trai u la hukum ia ki: U Trai ruh u la pdiang ia u Job .

en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn , which are written in heaven , and to God the Judge of all , and to the spirits of just men made perfect ,
kha: Phi la wan sha ka jingïalumlang kaba kmen jong ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong U Blei , kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha bneng . Phi la wan sha U Blei uba long u nongbishar ki bynriew baroh , bad sha ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba bha ïa kiba la pynjanai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingiaseng bad ka balang kaba kyllum jong ki khun nyngkong , kiba la thoh ha bneng , bad ha U Blei U Nongbishar jong baroh , bad ha ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba hok ba la pynlong janai , .

en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph , and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father .
kha: Ki la ïashongkurim hapoh ki kur kiba na ka jait u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , bad ka bri ka khyndew jong ki ka ïaisah bad ka jait u kpa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shongkurim ha ki longiing jong u Manasseh u khun u Joseph bad ka pateng jong ki ka sah ha ka jait jong u kpa jong ki .

en: A land which the  Lord  thy God careth for : the eyes of the  Lord  thy God are always upon it , from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khmih sumar ïa kane ka ri bad u ap sumar ïa ka baroh shisnem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u sumar: ki khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ki don beit ha ka , naduh kaba sdang jong u snem haduh kaba kut jong u snem .

en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter  ; it is furbished that it may glitter : should we then make mirth ? it contemneth the rod of my son , as every tree .
kha: La pynnep ïa ka ban pynïap , la pynphyrnai ba kan thaba kum ka leilieh . Kan ym don ka jinglehkmen , naba ki briew jong nga ki la leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingmaham bad jingpynshitom baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkhih ia ka ban pynlong ia ka jingpyniap briew kaba jur; la pynkhih ia ka dieng jong u khun jong nga kum uwei pa uwei u dieng .

en: And when he looked on Amalek , he took up his parable , and said , Amalek was the first of the nations  ; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever .
kha: Nangta ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u Balaam u la ïohi ïa ki Amalek , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  U Amalek u long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñbor tam na baroh , Hynrei ha kaba kut un jah noh jar .
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit ia u Amalek , u la shim ia ka pharshi jong u bad u la ong: U Amalek u long uba nyngkong eh na ki jaitbynriew ; hynrei ka jingkut kaba hadien jong u kan long ba un jah noh junom .

en: And when the seven days were almost ended , the Jews which were of Asia , when they saw him in the temple , stirred up all the people , and laid hands on him ,
kha: Hynrei hamar ba ki hynñiew sngi kin sa kut , katto katne ngut ki Jiw na ka probins    jong ka Asia ki la ïohi ïa u Paul ha ka Templ . Ki la pynkhih ïa u paidbah baroh bad ki la kem ïa u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba ki hynriew sngi ki la jan kut noh, ki Jiw kiba na Asia haba ki la iohi ia u ha ka tempi ki la pynkhih ia ki briew baroh bad ki la buh kti ha u .

en: I say unto you , that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth , more than over ninety and nine just persons , which need no repentance .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , kan don ka jingkmen kaba kham bun ha bneng halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai ki briew badonburom ki bymdonkam ban kylla-kaba-mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ha phi , ba kumjuh ruh ka jingkmen kan long ha bneng halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla bamut, palat hynniewphew hynniew ngut ki briew kiba hok, ki bym donkam ia ka jingkylla kaba mut .

en: Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi khot kaba bha ïa kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ïa kaba bha . Phi pynphai ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingshai sha ka jingdum . Phi pynlong kaba thiang ïa kaba kthang bad kaba kthang ïa kaba thiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew ia ki kiba khot ia ka jingsngewbha kaba sniew, bad kaba bha kaba buh ia ka jingdum na ka bynta ka jingshai, bad ka jingshai na ka bynta ka jingdum;

en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build , who also laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
kha: Ka kur Hassenaah ka tei ïa ka Khyrdop Dohkha . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ïa ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop dohkha ka la tei ia ki khun shynrang jong u Hasenaah, kiba la buh ruh ia ki beam jong ka, bad ki la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka, ki jingkhang jong ka bad ki bar jong ka .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
kha: Mynta kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Namar pha la klet ïa nga bad pha phai dadien ïa nga , phan sa shahshitom na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; Namar me la klet noh ia nga, bad me la bret ia nga shadien ka tyrpeng jong me, namarkata me ruh me shah ia ka jingleh be-ijot bad ki jingleh be-ijot jong me .

en: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary , unto the inner court , to minister in the sanctuary , he shall offer his sin offering , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Hadien ba u la long khuid biang , u dei ban ap hynñiew sngi bad nangta un leit sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh jong ka Templ bad ai ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid ïa u , khnang ba un lah ban shakri biang ha ka Templ . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi ba u leit sha ka jaka kyntang, sha ka phyllaw kaba shapoh, ban shakri ha ka jaka kyntang, un aiti ia ka jingknia pop jong u, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Forbidding to marry , and commanding to abstain from meats , which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth .
kha: Kiba kum kita ki briew ki hikai ba ka long ka bym dei ban shongkurim bad ban bam kyndiah ïa ki katto katne ki jait jingbam . Hynrei U Blei u la thaw ïa kito ki jingbam ban bam , hadien ka jingduwai sngewnguh , da kito kiba long kiba ngeit bad kiba la tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkwah ban shongkurim , bad ka hukum ban kiar na ki doh , kiba U Blei u la thaw ban pdiang da ka jingsngewnguh ia kito kiba ngeit bad tip ia ka jingshisha .

en: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things , which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began .
kha: U dei ban don ha bneng tad ynda ka poi ka por ha kaba yn thaw thymmai kiei kiei baroh , kumba U Blei u la pynbna lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u kiba la im slem bah mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia uba ka bneng ka dei ban pdiang haduh ki por jong ka jingsiew kylliang ia kiei kiei baroh , kiba U Blei u la kren da ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid jong u baroh naduh ba la sdang ka pyrthei .

en: And he said unto her , Up , and let us be going . But none answered . Then the man took her up upon an ass , and the man rose up , and gat him unto his place .
kha: U ong ,  Khie joit . Ngin ïaleit noh .  Hynrei kam shym phai ktien satia . Kumta u kyntiew ïa ka met jong ka halor ka kada bad u sdang ïa ka jingleit sha la shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ia ka, To ngin ia leit noh . Hynrei ym don ba jubab . Nangta uta u briew u la shim ia ka halor ka kada, bad uta u briew u la ieng, bad u la leit sha ka jaka jong u .

en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phi sha ka lyer kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong nga , nga la pynïap ïa ki khun jong phi namar phim shym sangeh ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynkhih ia ki da u nongkyrshan ha ki khyrdop jong ka ri ; ngan pynduh noh ia ki khun , ngan pynjot ia ki briew jong nga , namar ba kim phai na ki lynti jong ki .

en: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .
kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngap jar katba ki dang sngap ïa ka jingïathuh jong u Barnabas bad u Paul ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki hapdeng ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh u la sngap jar, bad u la ai ia ki nongsngap ia u Barnabas bad u Paul, da kaba pynbna ia kiei ki kambah bad ki jingphylla kiba U Blei u la leh hapdeng ki Jutang da ki .

en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,
kha: Na uta u masi un shim noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki snier ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un weng noh na ka ia ka shini baroh na ka bynta ka pop kaba ai ia ka shini kaba tap ia ki bynta ba shapoh , bad ka shini baroh kaba don ha ki bynta ba shapoh .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Put forth thine hand , and take it by the tail . And he put forth his hand , and caught it , and it became a rod in his hand :
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ,  Dem bad shim ïa u na u tdong .  Kumta u Moses u dem bad u kem ïa u , bad u kylla diengduh pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To pynkhih ia ka kti jong me bad shim ia ka da ka tdong . U la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la kem ia ka bad ka la kylla long u dieng ha ka kti jong u:

en: Persecutions , afflictions , which came unto me at Antioch , at Iconium , at Lystra ; what persecutions I endured : but out of them all the Lord delivered me .
kha: Me tip lut ïa baroh kaba la jia ha nga ha Antiokh , Ikoniom , bad Lystra , ki jingpynshitom bashyrkhei kiba nga la ïaishah! Hynrei u Trai u la pyllait ïa nga na ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingshah pynshitom bein, ki jingjynjar, kiba la wan ha nga ha Antiok, ha Iohon , ha Lystra ; kaei ka jingshah pynshitom bein kaba nga la shah: hynrei na ki baroh U Trai u la pyllait im ia nga .

en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
kha: Ki misteri liengbah na Biblos ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki dukan jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Gebal bad ki riewstad jong ka ki la don ha me: ki lieng duriaw baroh ryngkat bad ki nongleit jingleit jong ki ki la don ha me ban shong ha ki mar ki mata jong me .

en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .
kha: Um dei ruh ban pyntngit ïa ka jaka kyntang da kaba mih shabar jong ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u sha nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym mih na ka jaka kyntang jong U Blei jong u; namar ka khlieh jong ka umphniang ba pynsleh jong U Blei jong u ka don halor jong u: Nga long U Trai .

en: It is better to go to the house of mourning , than to go to the house of feasting : for that is the end of all men  ; and the living will lay it to his heart .
kha: Ka kham bha ban leit sha ka ïing ha kaba don ka jingïambriew ban ïa kata ha kaba don ka jingïaleh-sngewbha , namar kiba im ki dei ban pynkynmaw ïa lade ba ka jingïap ka ap ïa ngi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kham bha ban leit sha ka iing kaba iam , ban ia kaba leit sha ka iing kaba bam: namar kata ka long ka jingkut jong ki briew baroh; bad kiba im kin buh ia ka ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka borbah da kaba U  Trai  u jop ïa ki Ijipt , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  bad ha u Moses u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la iohi ia kata ka kam kaba khraw kaba U Trai u la leh halor ki nong Ijipt: bad ki briew ki la sheptieng ia U Trai , bad ki la ngeit ia U Trai bad u Moses u shakri jong u .

en: Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :
kha: U Khrist u synshar hangta halor baroh ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng , ki bor synshar , ki bor , bad ki kynrad ; u don ka kyrteng kaba kham hajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki kyrteng kiba don ka bor ha kane ka pyrthei mynta bad ka ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba palat ia ka jinglong rangbah baroh, bad ka bor, bad ka bor, bad ka jingsynshar, bad ka kyrteng baroh kaba la jer kyrteng, ym tang ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ha kata ruh ha kata kaban sa wan:

en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .
kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban rung sha ka jingïateh jutang bad U  Trai  ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai  ; u pynlong ruh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u syiem bad ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiada u la leh ia ka jutang hapdeng U Trai bad u syiem bad ki briew, ba kin long ki briew jong U Trai; hapdeng u syiem ruh bad ki briew .

en: And , behold , a woman in the city , which was a sinner , when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee s house , brought an alabaster box of ointment ,
kha: Ha kata ka shnong , la don ka briew kaba la im ka jingim kaba dap da ka pop . Ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan bam ha ka ïing jong u Pharisi , kumta ka la wallam ïa ka dabi alabastar kaba la dap da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, kawei ka kynthei ha kata ka shnong kaba long ka nongpop, haba ka la tip ba U Jisu u la shong ha ka iing jong u Pharisi, ka la wanrah ia ka synduk umphniang alabaster .

en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  : because he hath said , The river is mine , and I have made it .
kha: Ka Ijipt kan long kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .  Namar me la ong ba ka wah Nile ka dei ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri Ijipt kan long kaba la jot bad kaba la jot bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai: namar u la ong: Ka wah ka long ka jong nga bad nga la pynlong ia ka .

en: The  Lord  hath accomplished his fury  ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong u ; u la pynmeh ka ding ha Seïon kaba la thang duh ïa ka haduh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong u; u la theh ia ka jingbitar kaba jur jong u, bad u la pynmeh ding ha Seion , bad ka la bam ia ki nongrim jong ka .

en: He saith unto him , Which ? Jesus said ,  Thou shalt do no murder , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness ,
kha: Ki hukum kiba kumno ?  u la kylli . U Jisu u la jubab ,  Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bymdei ïano ïano ;
translated_en_to_kha: U ong ha u , Kaei ? U Jisu u la ong, Wat pyniap briew, Wat leh ia ka kam sniew , Wat tuh , Wat ju sakhi lamler , .

en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day  ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .
kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam shym la shong ha ka templ ; nga la shong borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ bad kynriah na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam shym la shong ha ka iing naduh ka sngi ba nga la wanrah ia ki Israel haduh kane ka sngi hynrei nga la leit na kawei ka ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And the woman arose , and did after the saying of the man of God : and she went with her household , and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years .
kha: Ka la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u , bad ka la leit bad la ka longïing ban shong ban sah ha Philistia haduh hynñiew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei ka la ieng bad ka la leh katkum ka jingong jong u briew jong U Blei: bad ka la leit bad ka iing jong ka , bad ka la sah ha ka ri Philistia hynriew snem .

en: And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,
kha: Lada phi shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lem ïa u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkha jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iakynduh bad ki, u da ong: Lada ka long ka jingmut jong phi ba ngan tep ia kiba iap jong nga na ka khmat jong nga;

en: And other sheep I have , which are not of this fold : them also I must bring , and they shall hear my voice  ; and there shall be one fold , and one shepherd .
kha: Don kiwei pat ki langbrot ki bym dei na kane ka sem langbrot . Nga dei ban wallam ïa ki ruh ; kin shahshkor ïa ka sur jong nga , bad kin ïalong kawei ka kynhun langbrot bad uwei u nongaplangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki langbrot kiba ngam don: ma ki ruh nga dei ban wanrah, bad kin iohsngew ia ka sur jong nga ; bad kin don kawei ka kynhun bad uwei u nongaplangbrot .

en: David therefore departed thence , and escaped to the cave Adullam : and when his brethren and all his father s house heard it , they went down thither to him .
kha: U Dabid u phet krad na ka nongbah Gath bad u leit sha ka krem hajan ka nongrit Adullam . Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u bad kiwei pat ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki tip ba u don hangta , ki la ïasoh bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit noh nangta, bad u la lait sha ka krem Adullam: bad haba ki hynmen jong u bad ka iing u kpa jong u baroh ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la leit hiar sha u .

en: Jesus answered him ,  Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake ? Verily , verily , I say unto thee , The cock shall not crow , till thou hast denied me thrice .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato me long ba la kloi shisha ban ïap na ka bynta jong nga ? Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih men len ïa nga lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, Hato me la buh ia ka jingim jong me na ka bynta jong nga ? Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha me, U khnai un ym ia tyngkhuh, haduh ba me la kyntait ia nga .

en: Son of man , behold , I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke : yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep , neither shall thy tears run down .
kha: Ko Khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  tang shi syntied ngan shim noh ïa u briew uba pha ieit eh . Pham dei ban wad daw lane ïam ne jaw ki ummat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, ha khmih nga weng noh na me ia ka jingkwah jong ki khmat jong me da ka jingsma: hynrei wat iam ne iam , lymne ki ummat jong me kin tuid shapoh .

en: The way of peace they know not  ; and there is no judgment in their goings : they have made them crooked paths : whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace .
kha: Bad ym don ba long shngain haba phi don hangta . Baroh kaba phi leh ka long ka bymhok . Phi bud ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba kyllaiñ , bad ym don uwei ruh uba ïaid na kata ka lynti u ban long shngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lynti jong ka jingsuk kim tip ; bad ym don jingbishar ha ki jingleit jong ki: ki la pynlong ia ki ban iaid lyngba: uno uno uba leit shata un ym tip ia ka jingsuk .

en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
kha: Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka kham bha ban leit hangta ban ïoh jinghikai ban ïa kaba ai jingkñia kum ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: To buh ia ka kjat jong me haba me leit sha iing U Blei , bad to kham kloi ban iohsngew , ban ia kaba ai ia ka jingknia jong ki bieit: namar kim pyrkhat ba ki leh ia kaba sniew .

en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues , and unto magistrates , and powers , take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer , or what ye shall say :
kha: Haba ki wallam ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog lane ha khmat ki lyngskor lane ki nongsynshar , wat sngewkhuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade lane ïa kaei phin kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki wanrah ia phi sha ki synagog bad ha ki majistor bad ki bor synshar , wat pyrkhat kumno ne kaei kaba phin jubab ne kaei kaba phin ong:

en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .
kha: Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la long kiba kham bit ban ïa kito kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïap suki ha ka jingthngan , khlem kano kano ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba shah pyniap da ka waitlam ki kham bha ban ia kito kiba shah pyniap da ka jingkyrduh: namar kine ki pine ki la jah noh, ki la iaid lyngba namar ka jingkwah ia ki soh jong ka lyngkha .

en: Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
kha: Nga la jubab ,  Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet noh .  Hynrei u Irijah um sngap ïa nga . Pynban , u la kem ïa nga bad ïalam ïa nga sha ki rangbah synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la ong: Ka long kaba bakla ia nga ban ym phet noh sha ki Khaldes . Hynrei um shym la sngap ia u: kumta u Irijah u la shim ia u Jeremaiah bad u la wanrah ia u sha ki rangbah .

en: And give occasions of speech against her , and bring up an evil name upon her , and say , I took this woman , and when I came to her , I found her not a maid :
kha: bad u pynbudnam ïa ka bad u kynnoh sniew ïa ka da kaba ong nga la shim ïa kane ka briew hynrei haba nga leit sha ka ngam shem ïa ki dak ka jinglong sotti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ai por ia ka jingkren pyrshah ia ka, bad wanrah ia ka kyrteng kaba sniew halor jong ka, bad ong , nga la shim ia kane ka kynthei bad haba nga la wan sha ka , ngam shym la lap ia ka ka nongtrei:

en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith , wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons , which followed him .
kha: Ki ai ïa u hynñiewphew tylli ki sbai rupa na ka templ jong u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang , bad da kata ka pisa u la wai shi kynhun ki riewdakaid ban ïasoh bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia u lai tylli ki rupa bad shiphew tylli ki rupa na ka iing u Baalberth , ha kaba u Abimelech u la thung ia ki briew kiba thylli bad kiba jem , kiba la bud ia u .

en: And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus : so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus .
kha: Kumta u Uriah u thaw ïa ka duwan thik kum kata , bad u pyndep ïa ka shuwa ba u Ahas un wan phai .
translated_en_to_kha: U U Uliah u lyngdoh u la tei ia ka jingknia katkum ka jinglong jong u syiem Ahasa: kumta u Uliah u lyngdoh u la leh ia ka pyrshah ia u syiem Ahasa u la wan na Damasios .

en: Every man is brutish by his knowledge  ; every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .
kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki briew ki long mutlop bad kumba ïap ; kito kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki lyngngoh ngaiñ namar ki blei ba ki shna ki long kiba shu thok bad khlem jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew u long uba sniew da ka jingtip jong u ; uwei pa uwei u nongseng u sngewlehrain da ka dur ba la shna: namar ka dur ba la shna da u ka long kaba bakla , bad ym don mynsiem ha ki .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of the men of Anathoth , that seek thy life , saying , Prophesy not in the name of the  Lord  , that thou die not by our hand :
kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Anathoth ki la kwah ïa nga ban shah pynïap , bad ki la ong ïa nga ba kin pynïap ïa nga lada nga dang ïai pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai jong ki briew jong ka Anathoth, kiba wad ia ka jingim jong me, da kaba ong: Wat iathuhlypa ha ka kyrteng U Trai, ba me ym iap da ka kti jong ngi:

en: In the eighth month , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
kha: Ha u bnai uba phra jong ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Iddo .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka taiew kaba phra, ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Darius, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Sekharaiah u khun u Beriah u khun u Ido u nongiathuhlypa .

en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba nga pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga shem sngewbha . Nga la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih u shakri jong nga, uba nga kyrshan ia u ; jong nga, ha uba ka mynsiem jong nga ka sngewbha ; nga la buh ia ka mynsiem jong nga halor jong u: un wanrah ia ka jingbishar sha ki Jutang .

en: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter : because that the Lord is the avenger of all such , as we also have forewarned you and testified .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom , te , uno uno u briew un ym dei ban leh bymdei ïa la u parabangeit lane shim kabu ïa u . Ngi la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kane mynshuwa , bad ngi maham jur ïa phi ba U Trai un pynshitom ïa kito kiba leh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba iaid shabar bad kiba pynbiej ia la u hynmen ha kano kano ka kam: namar ba U Trai u long u nongpynshitom bein ia kiba kum kita baroh, kumba ngi ruh ngi la pyntip lypa ia phi bad ngi la sakhi .

en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .
kha: Uno uno u Israel lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong ryngkat hapdeng jong ki , uba kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang lane ïa kano kano ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  hangno hangno lait tang ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat wanrah ia ka ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingmane jong ka jingiaseng , ban aiti ia ka ha U Trai ; wat ia uta u briew yn ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Confirming the souls of the disciples , and exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God .
kha: Ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki riewngeit bad pynshlur ïa ki ban ïaineh skhem ha ka jingngeit .  Ngi dei ban ïaid lyngba bun ki jingjynjar ban ïohrung sha ka Hima U Blei ,  ki la hikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynskhem ia ki mynsiem jong ki synran , bad ka jingkyntu ia ki ban iai bteng ha ka jingngeit , bad ba ngi dei ban rung lyngba ka jingjynjar kaba bun sha ka hima U Blei .

en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies : one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :
kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki mih ban leit ïaleh ha ki lai kynhun na ka jaka sher dara jong ki : kawei ka kynhun ka leit shaphang Ophrah ha ka ri Shual ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongpynjot ki la mih na ka shnong Philistia ha ki lai tylli ki kynhun: kawei ka kynhun ka la phai sha ka lynti kaba ialam sha Ophra , sha ka ri Shual:

en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,
kha: U Johanan bad baroh ki nongïalam ka kynhun shipai kiba don bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa ka kam runar kaba u Ishmael u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Johanan u khun u Krea bad ki rangbah shipai baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la iohsngew ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah u la leh .

en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :
kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; me kren ha ki briew bad me ai ïa ki , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Me wan hiar ruh ha u lum Sinai, bad me kren bad ki na bneng, bad me ai ia ki ki jingbishar kiba dei, bad ki ain kiba shisha, ki ain bad ki hukum kiba bha:

en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .
kha: Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong bad aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jaka jong u syiem u Rehoboam u la shna ia ki jingda nar , bad u la aiti ia ki ha ki kti jong u rangbah shipai , kiba la buh ia ka jingkhang jong ka iing syiem .

en: How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .
kha: Kim sheptieng ïa U Blei , bad kumta ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi haba phi la thait bad la duh bor , bad ki la pynïap lut ïa kito baroh kiba bud suki nadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno u la iakynduh ia me ha lynti, bad u la sngap jar ia phi, wat ia kiba tlot tam hadien jong me, haba me la lyngngoh bad uba la tyrkhong ; bad um shym la tieng ia U Blei .

en: (According as it is written , God hath given them the spirit of slumber , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear ;) unto this day .
kha: Kumba la don ha thoh ,  U Blei u la pynluin ïa ki jingmut bad ki dohnud jong ki , haduh kane hi ka sngi kim lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kat kum ka jingthoh , U Blei u la ai ha ki ia ka mynsiem jong ka jingthiah lyngngai , ki khmat ba kim dei ban iohi , bad ki shkor ba kim dei ban iohsngew ;) haduh kane ka sngi .

en: And I will send the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , among them , till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers .
kha: Ngan wanlam ïa ka thma , ïa ka  nemsniew , bad ïa ka jingïapthngan halor jong ki haduh ba yn ym don shuh wat uwei ruh na ki u ban lait ha kata ka ri ba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ia ka waitlam, ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingpang khlam hapdeng jong ki, haduh ba kin da shah pynjot na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel  ; and he cast himself down upon the earth , and put his face between his knees ,
kha: Katba u Ahab u dang leit ban bam , u Elijah u kiew sha u lum Karmel , u dem khrup ha khyndew , u da buh ïa la ka khlieh hapdeng ki khohsiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Ahab u la kiew ban bam bad ban dih . U Elijah u la kiew sha jrong jong u Carmel ; bad u la pynhap ia lade ha ka khyndew bad u la buh ia la ka khmat hapdeng ki kjat jong u .

en: Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .
kha: Lada phi donkam ïa ki mraw , phi lah ban thied na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh arngut ki mraw jong me bad ki mraw jong me, kiba me don, kin long na ki nongwei kiba don sawdong jong phi; na ki phin thied ia ki mraw bad ki mraw .

en: Hitherto is the end of the matter . As for me Daniel , my cogitations much troubled me , and my countenance changed in me : but I kept the matter in my heart .
kha: Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ka jingïathuh . Nga la sheptieng haduh katta katta ba nga la kylla lieh blaid blaid , bad ba nga la set ïa kaei kaei baroh ha lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh mynta ka long ka jingkut jong ka kam . Katba ia nga Daniel, ki jingsngewthuh jong nga ki la pynkhuslai shibun ia nga, bad ka khmat jong nga ka la kylla ha nga: hynrei nga la buh ia kata ha ka dohnud jong nga .

en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone , and smote the Philistine , and slew him  ; but there was no sword in the hand of David .
kha: Bad kumta , khlem ka waitlam , u Dabid u jop bad u pynïap ïa u Goliath da ka jingshat maw bad da u maw !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la jop ia u Philistia da ka sniehdoh bad da u maw , bad u la shoh ia u Philistia , bad u la pyniap ia u ; hynrei ym don waitlam ha ka kti u Dabid .

en: And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donkam ban im lane shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynta ka met jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki synran jong u , Namarkata nga ong ha phi , Wat pyrkhat ia ka jingim jong phi, kaei kaba phin bam ; lymne na ka bynta ka met , kaei kaba phin phong .

en: And he defiled Topheth , which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom , that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech .
kha: U syiem Josaïah ruh u la ñiewsang ïa ka Topheth , ka jaka mane thala ha Them Hinnom , khnang ba yn ym don uwei ruh u ban kñia ïa la u khun ne ka khun kum ka jingainguh thang ïa u blei Molekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynjakhlia ia u Tophet uba don ha ka them jong ki khun Hinnom , ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pynlong ia u khun shynrang ne kynthei jong u ban iaid lyngba ka ding sha u Molek .

en: Apart from traditional forces , these new forces have created massive opportunities for the consumer and service provider to interact through innovative ways .
kha: Lait na ki bor tynrai , kine ki bor thymmai ki la thaw ki lad ki lynti kiba khraw na ka bynta u nongthied bad u nongpynbiang jingshakri ban ïakynduh lyngba ki lad ki lynti kiba thymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Lait na ki bor tynrai , kine ki bor thymmai ki la thaw ia ki lad kiba khraw na ka bynta u nongthied bad u nongpynbiang jingshakri ban iakynduh lyngba ki rukom kiba thymmai .

en: But of their children , who were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel consumed not , them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day .
kha: U Solomon u pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong ki briew ka Kanaan kiba ki Israel kim shym la pynïap mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dang long ki mraw haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ki khun jong ki kiba la sah hadien jong ki ha ka ri , kiba ki khun Israel kim shym la bam , ki la pynlong ia u Solomon ban siew khajna haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said , I am young , and ye are very old  ; wherefore I was afraid , and durst not shew you mine opinion .
kha: Nga long uba dang samla , bad phi long kiba la rangbah , te nga la sngewsheptieng ban ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elihu u khun u Barachel u Buzite u la jubab bad u la ong, Nga dang samla, bad phi la tymmen bha ; namar kata nga la tieng, bad ngam shym la pyni ia phi ia ka jingmut jong nga .

en: And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Gideon , u Barak , u Jephthah , bad khatduh ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei na ngi , ngi la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi , bad phi la ïoh shongsuk shongshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phah ia u Jerubaal, bad u Bedan, bad u Jephthah bad u Samuel bad u la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti ki nongshun jong phi na man la ki liang bad phi la shong shngain .

en: And I saw heaven opened , and behold a white horse  ; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True , and in righteousness he doth judge and make war .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba plie , bad la don u kulai uba lieh . Ïa u nongshong ha u la khot Uba Ïaineh bad Uba Shisha ; ka long da ka jinglehhok ba u bishar bad u ïaleh ïa ki jingïaleh thma jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia ka bneng ba ka la plie, bad ha khmih u kulai lieh ; bad ia uta uba shong halor jong u la khot U Nongngeit bad U Nongshisha, bad ha ka hok u bishar bad u leh thma .

en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :
kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaba kjit noh ïa u slap uba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba ai jingmyntoi na ka bynta kita kiba rep ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka khyndew kaba dih ia u slap uba wan bunsien halor jong ka, bad kaba pynmih ia ki jingthung ba ki iakynduh na ka bynta jong ki da kiba la riam ia ka, ka pdiang ia ka jingkyrkhu na U Blei:

en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .
kha: Bad lada um shahshkor ïa ki , te to ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh ha ka balang . Khatduh , lada um shahshkor ïa ka balang , to ñiew ïa u kumba u long u nongmane blei thala lane u nonglum khajna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u iehnoh ban iohsngew ia ki, to iathuh ia ka ha ka balang: hynrei lada u iehnoh ban iohsngew ia ka balang , to ai ba un long ha me kum u briew uba nabar bad u paidbah .

en: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah , I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans , lest they deliver me into their hand , and they mock me .
kha: Hynrei u syiem u la jubab ,  Nga sheptieng ïa la ki para ri kiba la phet bad ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia . Ka lah ban long ba ïa nga yn aiti noh sha ki bad kin pynshitom sat ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u syiem u la ong ha u Jeremaiah , Nga tieng ia ki Jiw kiba la hap ha ki Khaldian , ioh kin aiti ia nga ha ka kti jong ki , bad ki rkhie bein ia nga .

en: That walk to go down into Egypt , and have not asked at my mouth  ; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh , and to trust in the shadow of Egypt !
kha: Ki ïaleit sha Ijipt na ka bynta ka jingïarap khlem pan ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Ki kwah ba ka Ijipt kan ïada ïa ki , ba kumta ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u syiem ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka iaid sha Ijipt , bad kim shym la pan ha ka shyntur jong nga;

en: And it came to pass , after he had eaten bread , and after he had drunk , that he saddled for him the ass , to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back .
kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam dep dih , u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u la teh jin ïa ka kada na ka bynta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah , uba leit noh ha ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ba u la bam ia u kpu bad hadien ba u la dih ia u, ba u la sngap jar ia u, ban sngap jar ia u nongiathuhlypa uba u la wanrah biang .

en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?
kha: Kumta u Petros u la leit hiar bad u la ong ha kita ki rangbah ,  Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi donkam aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la leit hiar sha ki briew kiba la phah sha u na u Kornellius; bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga long uta uba phi wad: kaei ka daw ba phi wan ?

en: And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bahok jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka sur jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la jied ia me, ba me dei ban tip ia ka mon jong u, bad me dei ban iohi ia kata kaba U long tang Uwei, bad me dei ban iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka shyntur jong u .

en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them out of the river , ill favoured and leanfleshed  ; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river .
kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ki wan mih ; ki long kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki la ki wan mih bad ki la ïeng hajan kita kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ha ka rudwah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, hynriew tylli kiwei pat ki kine ki la wan hadien jong ki na ka wah, ki la sngewsih bad ki la sngap jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar bad ki la ieng hajan kiwei pat ki kine ha rud wah .

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord  : and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein .
kha: U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u ha khmat U Trai: bad yn map ia u na ka bynta kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha kaba u la rung shapoh jong ka .

en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high  ; the lofty city , he layeth it low  ; he layeth it low , even to the ground  ; he bringeth it even to the dust .
kha: U la pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong ; u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah baskhem ha kaba ki shong , bad u pynlong ba ki kynroh jong ka kin pra bad hap sha tbian .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u pynhiar ia ki kiba shong ha ka shnong kaba jrong, u pynthiah ia ka ha ka jaka kaba jrong, wat haduh ka khyndew; u wanrah ia ka haduh ka dewbilat .

en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed , to make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
kha: Ïa kaba dang sah na kata ka umphniang un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew , bad da kumta un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia ka umphniang kaba sah ha ka kti jong u lyngdoh un buh ha ka khlieh jong uta uba dei ban pynkhuid , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u ha khmat U Trai .

en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song  ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .
kha: Kito kiba la ringmraw ïa ngi ki ong ba ngin rwai ; ki ong ïa ngi ba ngin pynsngewbha ïa ki :  To rwai ha ngi ïa ka jingrwai shaphang ka Seïon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar hangta kita kiba rah ia ngi ki la dawa na ngi ia ka jingrwai ; bad ki kiba la pynsyrwa kai ia ngi ki la dawa ia ngi da kaba ong: To rwai ia ngi kawei na ki jingrwai jong ka Seion .

en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them : and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed , neither shall they be lacking , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan thung ïa ki nongsynshar ki ban sumar ïa ki . Ki briew jong nga kin ym sheptieng ne sngewshyrkhei , bad ngan ym pynshitom shuh ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ki nongap langbrot halor jong ki ki ban ai bam ia ki: bad kin ym tieng shuh , lymne kin ym sngewsih , lymne kin ym duna , ong U Trai .

en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites , that were beyond Jordan , to Sihon king of Heshbon , and to Og king of Bashan , which was at Ashtaroth .
kha: bad kaei kaba u la leh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor kiba ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan : u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon bad u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba shong ba sah ha Ashtaroth .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh kaba u la leh ha ki arngut ki syiem ki Amorites kiba don sha shiliang ka Jordan, ha u syiem Heshbon bad ha u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan uba don ha Ashtaroth .

en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far , and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth : and , behold , they shall come with speed swiftly :
kha: U  Trai  u ai dak ban khot ïa ka jaitbynriew na jngai . U siaw ïa ki ban wan na kiba kut ka pyrthei . Bad kine ki wan ha ka jingstet bad kloi lan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un rah ia ka dak sha ki jaitbynriew na jngai, bad un pyrta ia ki naduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew: bad, ha khmih, kin wan stet stet:

en: Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki long kum u jingthung uba ki thied ki la tyrkhong bad um pynmih soh ei ei shuh . Kin ym ïoh khun shuh , hynrei wat lada ki dang ïoh , ngan pynïap ïa ki khun thep mynsiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ephraim u la tyrkhong, u tynrai jong ki u la tyrkhong, kin ym sei soh: Hooid, wat la ki pynmih ia u soh ba ieit eh jong ka kpoh jong ki .

en: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints , and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus : and when I saw her , I wondered with great admiration .
kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kata ka briew ba ka la buaid da ka snam jong ki briew jong U Blei , bad da ka snam jong kito kiba la shah pynïap namar ba ki la ïaineh skhem ha U Jisu . Haba nga la ïohi ïa ka , nga la sngewkyndit shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia kata ka kynthei kaba la dih kyiad da ka snam jong ki riewkhuid , bad da ka snam jong ki martyr jong U Jisu: bad haba nga la iohi ia ka , nga la lyngngoh da ka jingsngewnguh kaba khraw .

en: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka ïing jong u Jairos bad ki la ong ïa u ,  Ka khun jong phi ka la lah ïap . Balei phin pynshitom shuh ïa U Nonghikai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren, la wan na u nongsynshar jong ka synagog uba la ong: Ka khun jong me ka la iap: balei me pynkhuslai shuh shuh ia u Nonghikai ?

en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .
kha: Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — hynrei nga long u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei kham shitom palat , nga la don bunsien ha byndi , nga la shah sympat kham bun , bad nga la jan sha ka jingïap kham bunsien .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki long ki nongtrei jong U Khrist ? (Nga kren kum u bieit) Nga kham bun ha ki jingtrei kiba kham bun, ha ki jaka ba kham heh, ha ki phatok kiba kham bunsien, ha ki jingiap kiba kham bunsien .

en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure , as though we reached not unto you : for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ :
kha: Bad namar ba phi don hapoh kita ki pud , ngim shym la jam palat ïa ki mynba ngi la wan sha phi , da kaba wanrah ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim pynjlan ia lade shabar jong ngi, kumba ngim poi sha phi: namar ngi poi haduh phi ruh ha kaba ialap ia ka gospel U Khrist:

en: Then I commanded , and they cleansed the chambers : and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God , with the meat offering and the frankincense .
kha: Nga ai hukum ban leh ka jinglehniam jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa ki kamra bad ïa ki tiar ki tar ka Templ , jingkñia jingbam , bad ki jingiwbih ban buh pat hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la hukum , bad ki la pynkhuid ia ki kamra: bad nga la wanrah biang ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Blei , ryngkat bad ka jingainguh doh bad ka jingiwbih .

en: And they , continuing daily with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread from house to house , did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart ,
kha: Na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat ki ju ïakynduh kum ka kynhun hapoh ka Templ , bad ki ïabam jingbam lang ha ki ïing jong ki , ki da bam da ka dohnud kaba kmen bad kaba sngewrit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bteng man ka sngi da kawei ka jingiadei ha ka tempi , bad ki la bam ia ka doh jong ki da ka jingkmen bad ka jinglong marwei jong ka dohnud .

en: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him , reading in the book the words of the  Lord  in the  Lord s  house .
kha: Kumta u Barukh u la pule ïa ki ktien U  Trai  ha ka Templ thik kumba nga la ong ïa u ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Baruk u khun u Neriah u la leh katba kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u Jeremaiah u la hukum ia u, da kaba pule ha ka Kitab ia ki ktien U Trai ha ka iing U Trai .

en: Yea , behold , being planted , shall it prosper ? shall it not utterly wither , when the east wind toucheth it ? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew .
kha: Ho-oid la thung ïa ka , hynrei hato kan im bad san ? Hato kan ym ïapstai haba ka lyer mihngi ka shoh ïa ka ? Hato kan ym ïapstai hangta ha kaba ka san ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, ha khmih, hato kan roi? kan ym tyrkhong satia, haba ka Iyer mihngi ka ktah ia ka ? kan tyrkhong ha ki thliew ha kaba ka la san .

en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .
kha: Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka pyrthei . Ki briew jong ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh . Kiba im ki la nang duna bad nang duna .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingtim ka la bam ia ka khyndew , bad kito kiba shong ha ka ki la jah rngai noh: namarkata ki nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew ki shah thang , bad tang khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba sah .

en: And Jacob asked him , and said , Tell me , I pray thee , thy name . And he said , Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name ? And he blessed him there .
kha: U Jakob u la ong ,  Mynta ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka kyrteng jong me .  Hynrei u la jubab ,  Balei me kwah tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ?  Nangta u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la kylli ia u bad u la ong, To iathuh ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka kyrteng jong me . Bad u la ong: Balei ba me kylli ia ka kyrteng jong nga ? Bad u la kyrkhu ia u hangta .

en: Chidambaram was granted bail by the Supreme Court but told him to surrender his passport , make himself available for questioning and not influence witnesses .
kha: U Chidambaram u la ioh jamin da ka Supreme Court hynrei ka la ong ia u ba un aiti noh ia ka passport jong u , ban pynbiang ialade ban shah tohkit bad ban nym pynbor ia ki sakhi .
translated_en_to_kha: La ai jamin ia u Chidambaram da ka Supreme Court hynrei la ong ia u ban aiti noh ia ka passport jong u, ban pynlong ia lade ban ioh jingkylli bad ban ym pynkhih ia ki sakhi .

en: So Abijah slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead . In his days the land was quiet ten years .
kha: U syiem Abijah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid . U Asa u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u , bad hapoh ka jingsynshar u Asa ka ri ka mad ïa ka jingsuk haduh shiphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Abijah u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Asa u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u . Ha ki sngi jong u ka ri ka la sngap jar shi snem .

en: The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .
kha: Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit lyngba sha ki . Ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongbah jong ka ri Sepngi kin shah khang , bad ym don ba plie ia ki: U Judah un shah rah noh baroh kawei .

en: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .
kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ong ïa phi ban ym pyndem ha u . Ki shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat sngap ia ki ktien jong ki nongiathuhlypa kiba kren ha phi: Phin ym shakri ia u syiem Babilon: namar ki iathuhlypa ia phi .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , who redeemed Abraham , concerning the house of Jacob , Jacob shall not now be ashamed , neither shall his face now wax pale .
kha: Kumta mynta U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la pyllait ïa u Abraham na ka jingjynjar , u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , phin ym shah pynlehrain shuh , bad ki khmat jong phi kin ym i-blad shuh da ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai uba la siewspah ia u Abraham, shaphang ka iing u Jakob , u Jakob un ym sngewlehrain mynta , lymne ka khmat jong u mynta kan ym sngewlehrain .

en: Which the  Lord  commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them , by a statute for ever throughout their generations .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki paid Israel ban ai ïa kane ka bynta jong ka jingainguh . Ka dei ka aiñ ba ki paid Israel ki dei ban kohnguh pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba U Trai u la hukum ban ai ha ki khun Israel , ha ka sngi ba u la pynsleh ia ki , da ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong ki .

en: However , the transactions between the parties always start after the agreement and the period of limitation cannot be counted from the date of the agreement .
kha: Hynrei ki jingpyniaid hapdeng ki arliang mamla ki sdang beit hadien ka jingiateh bad ia ka por ba la buh por ym lah ban khein naduh ka tarik ba la iateh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jingpyniaid hapdeng ki liang ki ju sdang hadien ka jingiateh bad ka por jong ka jingpynbeit ym lah ban khein naduh ka tarik jong ka jingiateh .

en: For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .
kha: Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong U  Trai  kaba u Moses u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jingkñia ka dang don ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ U Trai kaba u Moses u la leh ha ka ri khlaw bad ka jaka thang niang ka la don ha kata ka aiom ha ka jaka ba jrong ha Gibeon .

en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .
kha: Kaei kaba me kwah na ngi , ko Jisu na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga tip me long uei — me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , To ngin ia kren marwei ia me, ko Jisu na Nazareth ? me wan ban pynjot ia ngi ? Nga tip ia me uba long U Blei Bakhuid .

en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .
kha: U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pynim ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Nongshna jong me u long u tnga jong me; U Trai jong ki paid u long u kyrteng jong u; bad u Nongsiewspah jong me u long U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel; U Blei jong ka khyndew baroh kawei un shah khot .

en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .
kha: U la leit sha u syiem Dabid bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot . Hato ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phin wan bad shim bynta ha ka jingïaleh-sngewbha ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la wan sha u syiem bad u la ong: Ha khmih mynta, u shakri jong me u la ailad ia u syiem, nga kyrpad ia me bad ki shakri jong u ki leit bad u shakri jong me .

en: And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre  ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man  ; for they were afraid .
kha: Kumta ki la leit noh bad mareh na ka jingtep , ki da sngewkhuslai bad sngewshyrkhei . Kim shym la ïathuh ei ei hano hano ruh , namar ki la sheptieng . [
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh kloi, bad ki la phet noh na ka jingtep ; namar ki la khih bad ki la lyngngoh: lymne kim shym la kren ei ei ia uno uno u briew ; namar ki la tieng .

en: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem , he assayed to join himself to the disciples : but they were all afraid of him , and believed not that he was a disciple .
kha: U Saul u la leit sha Jerusalem bad u la pyrshang ban ïasoh bad ki synran . Hynrei kim lah ban ngeit ba u la long u synran , bad baroh ki la sheptieng ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la wan sha Jerusalem , u la sngewthuh bakla ban iasoh bad ki synran: hynrei baroh ki la tieng ia u bad kim ngeit ba u long u synran .

en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .
kha: Khie leit bad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; wad biang biang ha-ei u don , bad uei uba la ïohi ïa u hangta . Nga tip ba u long uba sianti bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit, nga duwai ia phi, to pynkhreh haduh mynta, bad to tip bad peit ia ka jaka jong u ha kaba u don ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong u hangta: namar la iathuh ia nga ba u iadei bha .

en: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him , even a pillar of stone : and he poured a drink offering thereon , and he poured oil thereon .
kha: Hangta , ha kaba U Blei u la ïakren bad u , u Jakob u pynïeng ïa u maw pynsah kynmaw bad u la pynkyntang ïa u da kaba theh ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la buh ia u maw ha ka jaka ba u la iakren bad u: bad u la theh ia ka jingknia dih halor kata , bad u la theh umphniang halor kata .

en: Consider the lilies how they grow : they toil not , they spin not  ; and yet I say unto you , that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
kha: Ha khmih kumno ki syntiew khlaw ki san : Kim shym trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade . Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon ha ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kat uwei na kine ki syntiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia ki lieh kumno ki san: kim ju leh ei ei, kim ju khih ; bad pynban nga ong ha phi , ba u Solomon ha ka burom jong u baroh um shym la pynbeit kum uwei na kine .

en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
kha: Haba U Blei u la ong ban pynjot ïa ki briew jong u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u Moses , u la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Blei bad khang ïa ka jingbitar jong u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong ba un pynjot ia ki , lada u Moses u la ieng ha khmat jong u ha ka jingpynkhein , ban pynphai noh ia ka jingbitar jong u , ioh un pynjot ia ki .

en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .
kha: Ha ka shnong Dibon ka wah ka saw da ka snam , bad U Blei u don kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ba la buh na ka bynta ki briew hangta . Ho-oid , yn don ka jingpynïap ba lyngkien snam ïa uwei uwei baroh ba la iehnoh ha Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki um Dimon kin dap da ka snam: namar ngan wanrah shuh shuh ia u Dimon, ki sing halor jong u kiba lait na ka ri Moab bad halor ka ri kaba sah .

en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei kan wan . Ka jubab jong u ka long ,  Ka Hima U Blei kam wan ha ka rukom kum kaba lah ban ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la dawa ia u na ki Pharisi, haba ka hima U Blei ka dei ban wan, u la jubab ia ki bad u la ong: Ka hima U Blei kam wan da kaba peit bniah:

en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .
kha: ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia , bad ki Amalek — kumjuh ruh shi bynta na ka jinglute kaba u la kurup na u Hadadeser .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Syria , bad na ka ri Amobab bad na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad na ki Philistia bad na ka ri Amalek bad na ka jaitbynriew Hadadeser u khun u Rehob u syiem u Sobah .

en: And there was no bread in all the land  ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .
kha: Kata ka  nemsniew ka la jur katta katta ba ym don jingbam shuh hangno hangno , ki briew ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan ki la nang tlot namar ka jingthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don kpu ha ka ri baroh kawei namar ka jingkyrduh ka la nang jur bha, haduh ba ka ri Ijipt bad ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei ka la jah noh namar ka jingkyrduh .

en: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus , what advantageth it me , if the dead rise not ? let us eat and drink ; for to morrow we die .
kha: Lada nga la ïaleh bad ki  mradkhlaw  hangne ha Ephesos ha ki jingthmu briew , hato ka myntoi aïu ïa nga ? Hynrei lada ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , te , kumba don ka jingong ,  To ngin ïabam ngin ïadih , naba lashai ngin sa ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada hadien ka rukom jong ki briew nga la ialeh bad ki mrad ha Ephesos , kaei kaba pynmyntoi ia nga lada kiba iap kim kiew ? to ngin ia bam bad dih; namar lashai ngin iap .

en: And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,
kha: U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka jaka kaba kylluid ha ka khyrdop ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki rangbah shipai ha ki briew , bad u la lum lang ia ki ha ka lynti jong ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , bad u la kren suk ia ki da kaba ong:

en: Then cometh the end , when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God , even the Father ; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power .
kha: Te kaba kut kan poi ; U Khrist un jop noh thiaw ïa ki bor mynsiem , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor , bad un aiti ïa ka Hima ha U Blei uba U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka wan ka jingkut , haba u la aiti ia ka hima ha U Blei , wat ia u Kpa ; haba u la buh ia ka jingsynshar baroh bad ka bor bad ka bor baroh .

en: While ye have light , believe in the light , that ye may be the children of light .  These things spake Jesus , and departed , and did hide himself from them .
kha: To ngeit ha ka jingshai , namarkata , katba phi dang don ïa ka , ba kumta phin long ki briew jong ka jingshai .  Hadien ba U Jisu u la ong ïa kane , u la leit noh bad u la buhrieh ïa lade na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba phi dang don ka jingshai, to ngeit ha ka jingshai, ba phin long ki khun jong ka jingshai . Kine kiei kiei ki la kren ia U Jisu bad u la leit noh bad u la buhrieh ia lade na ki .

en: Again , when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed , and doeth that which is lawful and right , he shall save his soul alive .
kha: Haba uno uno uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , u pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , haba u briew uba sniew u phai noh na ka jingsniew jong u kaba u la leh , bad u leh ia kaba dei bad kaba dei , un pynim ia ka mynsiem jong u .

en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children : how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him ?
kha: Kiba sniew kumba phi long , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Katno tam , te , ba U Kpa ba ha bneng un ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha kito kiba pan na u !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi long kiba sniew, phi tip kumno ban ai ia ki jingai sngewbha ha ki khun jong phi: katno u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ai ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha kito kiba pan ia u ?

en: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods , nor serve them , nor do after their works : but thou shalt utterly overthrow them , and quite break down their images .
kha: Wat nguh wat dem ha ki blei jong ki , lane mane ïa ki , bad wat bud ïa ki rukom lehniam jong ki . Pynjot ïa ki blei jong ki , bad pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki païa mawkyntang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat dem khrup ha ki blei jong ki, lymne wat shakri ia ki, lymne wat leh ia ki kam jong ki: hynrei men pynpra lut ia ki, bad pynpra lut ia ki dur jong ki .

en: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight , and left their tents , and their horses , and their asses , even the camp as it was , and fled for their life .
kha: Kumta ha kata ka janmiet ki Syria ki la phet ban lait im , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ki ïingjaiñ , ki kulai , bad ki kada , bad ki la iehnoh ruh ïa ka jaka shong dara kumba ka long .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la ieng bad ki la phet noh ha ka por ba dum, bad ki la iehnoh ia ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki kulai jong ki bad ki tdong jong ki, wat ia ka camp kumba ka long, bad ki la phet noh na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki .

en: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the  Lord s  hand , that made all the earth drunken : the nations have drunken of her wine  ; therefore the nations are mad .
kha: Ka Babilonia ka long kum ka khuri ksiar ha ka kti jong nga , ba pynlong ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ban buaid . Ki jaitbynriew ki dih ïa ka waiñ bad ki kylla khleh bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Babilon ka la long ka khuri ksiar ha ka kti U Trai, kaba la pynlong ia ka khyndew baroh kawei: ki jaitbynriew ki la dih ia ka wain jong ka ; namarkata ki jaitbynriew ki la mad .

en: And they took Absalom , and cast him into a great pit in the wood , and laid a very great heap of stones upon him : and all Israel fled every one to his tent .
kha: Ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Absalom , ki la bret ïa ka ha ka thliew bajylliew hapoh ka khlaw , bad ki la tep ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba khraw . Baroh ki Israel ki phet krad sha la shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u Absalom bad ki la bret ia u ha ka thliew kaba heh bha ha u dieng: bad ki Israel baroh ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And David sent messengers to Ish–bosheth Saul s son , saying , Deliver me my wife Michal , which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines .
kha: Bad u Dabid ruh u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Ishbosheth ban ong ,  Ai noh ha nga ïa ka Mikhal ka tnga jong nga . Nga la siew shispah tylli ki doh otsher jong ki Philistia ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah khubor sha u khun shynrang jong nga, u da ong: To ai ia nga ia ka tnga jong nga kaba nga la ai ha nga da ki shispah tylli ki jain lyngkot jong ki Philistia .

en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow , making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly  ;
kha: U Blei u la pynrem ïa ki nongbah ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , da kaba pynjot ïa ki da ka ding , bad u la pynlong ïa ki ka nongmuna jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki bymtip Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpynkylla ia ki shnong Sodom bad Gomorra ka la pynrem ia ki da ka jingshah pynpra, kaba pynlong ia ki ban long ka nuksa ha kito kiba hadien ki dei ban im khlem blei ; .

en: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth ; but if her husband be dead , she is at liberty to be married to whom she will ; only in the Lord .
kha: Ka briew kaba la shongkurim kam long kaba laitluid katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u ïap noh , te ka long kaba laitluid ban shongkurim ïa uno uno u briew uba ka mon , hynrei tang lada u long uba ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnga ka shah teh ha ka ain katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la iap , ka don ha ka jinglaitluid ban shongkurim bad uba ka mon ; tang ha U Trai .

en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ha man kawei pa kawei ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha man kawei pa kawei ka Sabbaton , ki jaitbynriew na ki hima baroh kin wan ban mane ïa nga hangne ha Jerusalem ,  ong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, ba na uwei u bnai thymmai sha uwei pat, bad na kawei ka sngi Sabha sha kawei pat, ka doh baroh kan wan mane ha khmat jong nga , ong U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead , that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , to take possession of it .
kha: Shisyndon u Ahab u leit sha ka bri sohwaiñ ban shimti ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la iohsngew ba u Naboth u la iap, u la ieng ban leit hiar sha ka kper sohjew jong u Naboth u Jesreel , ban shim ia ka .

en: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .
kha: Haba ngi la poi ha phatok , ngi la shem ba la khang pynskhem ïa ka bad baroh ki nongap phira kiba ap ki don ha ka khyrdop ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ïa ki khyrdop , ngim shem ïano ïano ruh hapoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ka phatok ka la lap shisha ba ngi khang da ka jingshngain baroh, bad ki nongshong ki ieng shabar ha khmat ki jingkhang: hynrei ynda ngi la plie , ngim lap ia u briew hapoh .

en: And they answered the king , The man that consumed us , and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel ,
kha: Ki jubab ,  U Saul u la kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi bad ban ym pynsah iwei ruh hangno hangno ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u syiem: Uta u briew uba la bam ia ngi bad uba la thmu pyrshah ia ngi ba ngin shah pynjot na kaba sah ha kano kano ka jaka jong ki Israel .

en: Yet if thou warn the wicked , and he turn not from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .
kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew basniew , bad um shym sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , hynrei ïa ka jingim jong me yn pyllait .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me maham ia u bymman bad um phai na ka jingsniew jong u, ne na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u, un iap ha ka jingbymhok jong u ; hynrei me la pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong me .

en: And it came to pass , that , as I made my journey , and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon , suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me .
kha: Katba nga dang leit lynti bad wan poi hajan ka Damaskos , hamar shiteng sngi ka jingshai baphyrnai na sahit bneng ka la thaba kynsan sawdong jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba nga dang iaid sha ka nongbah Damarkos kumba shiteng sngi, kynsan kynsan ka la shai na bneng ka jingshai kaba khraw sawdong jong nga .

en: And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .
kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma na ka Duriaw Baïap sha ka Mediterranian bad nangta shuh shuh na shatei shaduh mihngi . Kin ïakhmih kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U  Trai  , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka .
