translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin iaid na duriaw sha duriaw, bad naduh shaphang shathie haduh shaphang mihngi, kin iaid sha ka liang mihngi ban wad ia ka ktien U Trai bad kin ym shem ia ka .

en: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .
kha: bad ki ïohi ïa U Blei ki Israel . Hapoh ki sla jat jong u , la don kaei kaba i kum ka jingsiang da u mawkordor Sapphir , kaba jngum kum ka suiñbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iohi ia U Blei jong ki Israel: bad ka la don hapoh ki kjat jong u kumba ka long ka jingtrei ba la pyndap da u maw ba la pyndap da u maw , bad kumba ka long ka met bneng ha ka jingshai jong u .

en: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth , while the evil days come not , nor the years draw nigh , when thou shalt say , I have no pleasure in them  ;
kha: Kumta to kynmaw ïa la U Nongthaw katba phi dang samla ha shuwa ka jingwan kito ki sngi bad ki snem ba-dum ha kaba phin ong ,  ngam sngewtynnat ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw mynta ia u Nongthaw jong me ha ki sngi samla jong me, katba ki sngi kiba sniew kim wan, lane ki snem ki wan hajan, haba me ong , Ngam don jingsngewbha ha ki ; .

en: And Leah said , God hath endued me with a good dowry  ; now will my husband dwell with me , because I have born him six sons : and she called his name Zebulun .
kha: Ka Leah ka ong ,  U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingai kaba kordor . Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa pdiang ïa nga , namar nga la kha ïa u hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Sebulun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Leah u la ong, U Blei u la pynlong ia nga da ka jingkhawai kaba bha ; mynta u tnga jong nga un shong bad nga, namar nga la kha ia u hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang: bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Sebulun .

en: The cup of blessing which we bless , is it not the communion of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , is it not the communion of the body of Christ ?
kha: Ka khuri kaba ngi pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai U Trai bad ïa kaba ngi ainguh ïa U Blei : Haba ngi dih na ka , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka snam U Khrist . Bad u kpu uba ngi kdiah : Haba ngi bam ïa u , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka met U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khuri jong ka jingkyrkhu kaba ngi kyrkhu , hato kam dei ka jingiasyllok jong ka snam U Khrist ? U kpu uba ngi bthei , hato kam dei ka jingiasyllok jong ka met U Khrist ?

en: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood  ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .
kha: Ym don shuh u briew uba hok uba dang don ha ka ri , ym don mano mano baïaineh bad U Blei . Uwei pa uwei u ap ïa ka kabu ban pynïap briew . Uwei pa uwei u behmrad ïa la u para shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba bha u la jah noh na ka khyndew : bad ym don uba beit hapdeng ki briew: baroh ki thiah ha ka snam ; ki leit khwai ia uwei pa uwei u hynmen jong u da ka net .

en: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make , ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof : it shall be unto thee holy for the  Lord .
kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna kum kane na ka bynta ïa lade . Ñiew ïa ka ba ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba la pynkyntang sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia ka jingiwbih kaba me dei ban leh , phin ym leh ia lade kat kum ka jinglong jong ka: kan long ha me kaba khuid na ka bynta U Trai .

en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , saying , He hath spoken blasphemy  ; what further need have we of witnesses ? behold , now ye have heard his blasphemy .
kha: Ha kane , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la ong ,  Ka jingkrenbeiñ blei ! Ngim donkam shuh bun ki sakhi ! Phi la dang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ blei jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah lyngdoh u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, u da ong, U la kren bein shuh shuh ia ngi ki sakhi ? ha khmih , mynta phi la iohsngew ia ka jingkren bein jong u .

en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
kha: Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u nongaplangbrot u sumar ia uwei pa uwei u langbrot jong u, ki rangbah ki pyrshang ban ithuh ia uwei pa uwei u dkhot jong ka balang marwei marwei .  Proberb 27 :23 .

en: Watch ye therefore , and pray always , that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass , and to stand before the Son of man .
kha: Da husiar bad duwai borabor ba phin don ka jingkhlaiñ ban leit ha ka jingshngain lyngba kito kiei kiei ki ban sa jia bad ban ïeng ha khmat jong U Khun U Briew .
translated_en_to_kha: To peit ia phi namarkata , bad duwai beit , ba phin long kiba bit ban lait na kine kiei kiei baroh ki ban sa jia , bad ban ieng ha khmat U Khun u briew .

en: And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
kha: Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  , uba jubab ,  Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki na kawei ka liang , najan ki dieng Balsam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai, u la ong, Wat leit shaneng shuh hynrei to leit wad ia ka kompas hadien jong ki, bad to wan hiar sha ki pyrshah ia ki dieng kiba don ha ka sniehdoh .

en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
kha: U Ahab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Balei ba ngim shym la leh ei ei ban ïohknieh pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Syria ? Ka dei ka jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, Phi tip ba u Ramoth ha Gilead u dei u jong ngi bad ngi dang sah bad ngim shim ia ka na ka kti u syiem Syria ?

en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment , and didst increase thy perfumes , and didst send thy messengers far off , and didst debase thyself even unto hell .
kha: Phi sleh ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki kynja jingsleh , bad leit ban mane ïa u blei Molekh . Ban lap ïa ki blei ban mane phi la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha jngai bah , wat shaduh ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la leit sha u syiem da ka umphniang, bad me la pynbun ia ki jingiwbih jong me, bad me la phah ia ki nonglam khubor jong me sha jngai, bad me la pynjah burom ia lade haduh dujok .

en: And when he hath taken away the multitude , his heart shall be lifted up  ; and he shall cast down many ten thousands : but he shall not be strengthened by it .
kha: Un sngewsarong ïa la ka jingjop bad ïa ki shipai kiba bun kiba u la lah pynïap , hynrei un ym neh sah ban jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la weng noh ia u paidbah, ka dohnud jong u kan kiew ; bad un pynhap bun shi hajar: hynrei un ym shah pynskhem da ka .

en: O  Lord  , why hast thou made us to err from thy ways , and hardened our heart from thy fear ? Return for thy servants  sake , the tribes of thine inheritance .
kha: Balei me shah ba ngin sakma na ki lynti jong me ? Balei ba me pynlong mutlop ïa ngi ba ngin phai lyndet na me ? To wan phai noh , na ka bynta kito kiba shakri ïa me , na ka bynta u paidlang uba la ju long u jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , balei me la pynlong ia ngi ban bakla na ki lynti jong me , bad me la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong ngi na ka jingtieng jong me ? To wan phai na ka bynta ki shakri jong me , ki jaitbynriew jong me .

en: They say unto him , Caesar s . Then saith he unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar s  ; and unto God the things that are God s .
kha: Ki jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kumta , te , to siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong ha u, u Kaisar s . Nangta u ong ha ki, To ai namarkata ia kiei kiei kiba long u Kaisar s ; bad ha U Blei ia kiei kiei kiba long U Blei s .

en: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths , when I brought them out of the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: khnang ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin ïoh tip ba U  Trai  u la pynshong ïa ki Israel ha ki ïingtrep mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki pateng jong phi kin tip ba nga la pynlong ia ki khun Israel ban shong ha ki ïingsah , haba nga la pynmih noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .
kha: Hadien kata u Elijah u ong ïa u paidbah ,  Wan kham hajan sha nga ,  bad baroh ki la wan ïalum sawdong ïa u . U shna pynbha ïa ka duwan U  Trai  kaba la pra .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha ki briew baroh, To wan hajan jong nga . Bad ki briew baroh ki la wan hajan jong u . Bad u la pynbha ia ka jingknia U Trai kaba la jot .

en: And the sons of Joseph , which were born him in Egypt , were two souls : all the souls of the house of Jacob , which came into Egypt , were threescore and ten .
kha: Ki khun shynrang u Joseph ïa kiba la kha ha Ijipt ki long ar ngut ; kumta ki briew baroh kiba na ka ïing u Jakob kiba la wan sha Ijipt ki long hynñiewphew ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Joseph kiba la kha ia u ha Ijipt ki long arngut: baroh ki mynsiem jong ka iing u Jakob kiba la wan sha Ijipt ki long hynriewphew snem .

en: From thence it passed toward Azmon , and went out unto the river of Egypt  ; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea : this shall be your south coast .
kha: ter ter sha Asmon , bad ka bud ïa ka wahduid ha ka pud jong ka Ijipt sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian , ha kaba kut u . Kata ka long ka pud kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la iaid sha ka wah Azmon, bad ka la leit sha ka wah Ijipt ; bad ki jingleit na kata ka rud duriaw ki la don ha duriaw: kane kan long ka rud duriaw ba shathie jong phi .

en: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt : and ye came unto the sea  ; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea .
kha: Hynrei nga la ïalam noh ïa phi ; nga la wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki la beh kthong nadien jong ki da ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la wanrah ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt: bad phi la poi sha duriaw ; bad ki nong Ijipt ki la beh hadien ki kpa tymmen jong phi da ki kali bad ki kulai sha duriaw Basaw .

en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood , and led him throughout all the land of Canaan , and multiplied his seed , and gave him Isaac .
kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi , na ka ri kaba sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis bad nga ïalam ïa u lyngba ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei . Nga la ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Nga la ai ha u ïa u Isaak ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia u kpa jong phi u Abraham na kawei pat ka liang jong ka jingshlei um, bad nga la ialam ia u ha kylleng ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei, bad nga la pynbun ia u symbai jong u, bad nga la ai ia u Isaak .

en: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la ïaleit sha ki lynti bah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh kiba ki lah ban ïashem , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kita ki shakri ki la leit sha ki surok bah , bad ki la ialum lang katba ki lap , baroh ar ki bym sniew bad kiba bha: bad ka jingkhawai ka la long kaba la pyndap da ki nongwan .

en: Thou shalt sow , but thou shalt not reap  ; thou shalt tread the olives , but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil  ; and sweet wine , but shalt not drink wine .
kha: Phin bet ïa u kew , hynrei phin ym ïoh ban ot . Phin khem ïa ka umphniang na ki soh Olib , hynrei phin ym lah da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka . Phin ïoh shna ïa ka waiñ , hynrei phin ym ïoh dih da lei lei ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban bet ia ka umphniang ; me dei ban kheit ia ki olive , hynrei wat pynsleh ia me da ka umphniang ; bad ka wain kaba thiang , hynrei wat dih wain .

en: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was , and saw him , she fell down at his feet , saying unto him , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .
kha: Ka Mari ka la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba U Jisu u la don , bad mar ïa-ïohi ïa u , ka la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u .  Ko Trai ,  ka la ong ,  lada men jin da la don hangne , u para jong nga un ym jin da la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta haba ka Maria ka la wan ha ka jaka ba U Jisu u don, bad ka la iohi ia u, ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u, ka da ong ha u, ko Trai, lada me la don hangne, u hynmen jong nga um shym la iap .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of our fathers , which hath put such a thing as this in the king s heart , to beautify the house of the  Lord  which is in Jerusalem :
kha: U Esra u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ! U la pynlong ïa u patsha da ka mon sngewbha ban burom ha kane ka rukom ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi uba la buh ia kaei kaei ha ka dohnud jong u syiem ban pynitynnad ia ka iing U Trai kaba don ha Jerusalem:

en: I have declared the former things from the beginning  ; and they went forth out of my mouth , and I shewed them  ; I did them suddenly , and they came to pass .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  La slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa kaei ka ban sa jia ; nangta kynsan nga pynlong ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynbna ia kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa naduh kaba sdang ; bad ki la mih na ka shyntur jong nga , bad nga la pyni ia ki ; nga la leh ia ki kynsan kynsan , bad ki la iaid .

en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,
kha: Nangta ki paid Israel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel bad ki Lebi bad kiwei pat ki khun ki la bat ia ka jingaiti ia kane ka iing U Blei da ka jingkmen .

en: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah jong ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim bynta ha kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka jingieit jong ki, bad ka jingshun jong ki, bad ka jingsngewsih jong ki, mynta kam don shuh ka bynta junom ha kano kano ka kam kaba la leh hapoh ka sngi .

en: CJI Lodha also denied that the SC collegium had recommended the elevation of Karnataka High Court judge KL Manjunath as Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana HC .
kha: U CJI Lodha u la kyntait ruh ba ka SC collegium ka la ai jingmut ban kyntiew ia u nongbishar jong ka Karnataka High Court u KL Manjunath kum u Chief Justice jong ka Punjab bad Haryana HC .
translated_en_to_kha: U CJI Lodha ruh u la kyntait ba ka SC ka la ai jingmut ban pynkiew ia u nongbishar jong ka Karnataka High Court u KL Manjunath kum u Chief Justice ka Punjab bad ka Haryana HC .

en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom : but within few days he shall be destroyed , neither in anger , nor in battle .
kha: Yn bud ïa u da uwei pat u syiem , u ban phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew da ki khajna na ka bynta ban pynroi ïa ka spah jong ka hima jong u . Tang khyndiat por ïa uta u syiem yn pynïap , hynrei ym ha kaba paw bad ym ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un ieng ha ka jaka jong u u nongrah khajna ha ka burom jong ka hima: hynrei tang khyndiat sngi un shah pynjot , ym ha ka jingbitar ne ha ka thma .

en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .
kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ kan long khat-ar mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap kan long hynriewphew phut bad ka jingjrong jong kawei ka jingtap kan long saw phut: bad uwei pa uwei na ki jingtap un don kawei ka jingthew .

en: Having a good conscience  ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .
kha: hynrei , to leh ïa kata ha ka jingjai jai bad da kaba burom . To sumar khuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong phi , khnang ba haba phi shah krenbeiñ , kita kiba kren sniew ïa ka jinglong jingim babha jong phi kum ki nongbud jong U Khrist kin shah lehrain na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka jingsngew kaba bha ; kata, katba ki kren bein ia phi, kum ki nongleh bymman, ki lah ban sngewlehrain ba ki kynnoh bakla ia ka jingiakren babha jong phi ha U Khrist .

en: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together , and encamped in Gilead . And the children of Israel assembled themselves together , and encamped in Mizpah .
kha: Nangta ka kynhun shipai jong ki Ammon ka la pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad sher dara ha Gilead . Ki paid Israel ki la ïalumlang bad sher dara ha Mispah kaba ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun ki shynrang ki la ialum lang bad ki la shong shnong ha Gilead . Ki khun Israel ki la ialum lang bad ki la shong shnong ha Mizpah .

en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea , to compass the land of Edom : and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh na u Lum Hor na ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khmut duriaw Akaba , ban ïaid sawdong ïa ka ri Edom . Hynrei ha lynti kim lah shah shuh bad ki la kren pyrshah ïa U Blei bad ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iaid na u lum Hor da ka lynti jong ka duriaw Basaw: bad ka mynsiem jong ki briew ka la duh mynsiem shibun namar ka lynti .

en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman : these are the families of Simeon .
kha: U Simeon u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul u khun jong ka kynthei nong Kanaan ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Simeon ; u Jemuel, bad u Jamin, bad u Ohad, bad u Machin, bad u Sohar bad u Shal u khun jong ka kynthei Kana: kine ki long ki long ki longiing jong u Simeon .

en: What mean ye , that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel , saying , The fathers have eaten sour grapes , and the children s teeth are set on edge ?
kha: bad u ong ,  Kaei kane ka proberb kaba ki briew ki ïai kren ha ka ri Israel ?   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki bam ïa ki sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki la ïoh ka jingmad bajew .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba phi mut , ba phi pyndonkam ia kane ka proberb shaphang ka ri Israel , da kaba ong , Ki kpa ki la bam ia ki sohjew kiba thiang bad ki bniat jong ki khun ki la buh ha ka tduh ?

en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee , and gird them with sackcloth , and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing .
kha: Ki khi noh ïa la ki khlieh na ka bynta jong pha bad ki kup ïa lade ha ki jaiñ khain . Ki dohnud jong ki , ki kthang sngewsih katba ki dang ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynlong ia lade da kaba jem na ka bynta jong me, bad kin teh ia ki da ka jain lyngkhuid, bad kin iam na ka bynta jong me da ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih kaba jur .

en: And they went in to the king into the court , but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe , and told all the words in the ears of the king .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki buh ïa ka kot kli ha ka kamra u Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki leit sha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , bad ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit shapoh u syiem shapoh ka iingbishar , hynrei ki la buh ia ka roll ha ka kamra jong u Elishama u nongthoh bad ki la iathuh ia ki ktien baroh ha ki shkor jong u syiem .

en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves ? against whom make ye a wide mouth , and draw out the tongue ? are ye not children of transgression , a seed of falsehood ,
kha: Ïano phi leh biria ? Ïano phi ki nongshukor phi rkhiebeiñ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah iano phi ialehkai ia lade ? pyrshah ia kiba phi pynlong ia ka shyntur kaba heh bad phi sei ia ka shyntur ? hato phim dei ki khun jong ka jingpynkhein , u symbai jong ka jinglamler .

en: Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrang bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga long u syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moab u la shah pynjot , bad u la leit noh na ki shnong jong ka , bad ki samla ba la jied jong u ki la leit hiar sha ka jingpyniap , ong u Syiem uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And Jesus , which is called Justus , who are of the circumcision . These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God , which have been a comfort unto me .
kha: U Joshua , ïa uba la khot ruh u Justos , u phah ruh ïa ki jingai khublei . Kine lai ngut ki long tang ma ki , ki parabangeit Jiw kiba trei bad nga na ka bynta Ka Hima U Blei , bad ki la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Jisu uba la khot u Justos uba long na ka jingotsher . Kine ki long tang ki para nongtrei jong nga sha ka hima U Blei kiba la long ka jingpyntngen ia nga .

en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died  ; and was gathered unto his people .
kha: U Ishmael u ïap haba u la dap shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki snem jong ka jingim u Ishmael, shispah laiphew hynriew snem: bad u la aiti noh ia u ksuid bad u la iap ; bad la lum lang ia u sha ki briew jong u .

en: Thou therefore gird up thy loins , and arise , and speak unto them all that I command thee : be not dismayed at their faces , lest I confound thee before them .
kha: Pynkhreh , ko Jeremaïah ; khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me ban ong . Wat leit sheptieng ïa ki mynta , ïoh ba ngan pynlong ïa me uba kham sheptieng haba me don bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me namarkata to pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong me, bad to ieng bad kren ha ki baroh kiba nga hukum ia me: wat sngewsih ha ki khmat jong ki , ioh nga pynjah burom ia me ha khmat jong ki .

en: They are exalted for a little while , but are gone and brought low  ; they are taken out of the way as all other , and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn .
kha: Na ka bynta shipor , u briew uba sniew u roi u par , hynrei u tyrkhong pat kum u ñiut , kum ki kop kew ïa kiba la ot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkiew ia ki khyndiat por , hynrei la pynhiar bad la pynhiar ia ki na ka lynti kumba long kiwei pat , bad la ot noh ia ki kum ki tduh jong ki shkor kew .

en: And he came thither unto a cave , and lodged there  ; and , behold , the word of the  Lord  came to him , and he said unto him , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
kha: Hangta u la rung shapoh krem bad sahmiet hangta . Kynsan kynsan U  Trai  u kren ha u ,  Elijah me leh aïu hangne ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan shata sha kawei ka krem, bad u la sah hangta; bad, ha khmih, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u, bad u la ong ha u, Me leh aiu hangne, ko Elijah ?

en: And it came to pass , as soon as Gideon was dead , that the children of Israel turned again , and went a whoring after Baalim , and made Baal–berith their god .
kha: Hadien ka jingïap jong u Gideon , ki paid Israel kim shym ïaineh shuh bad U Blei bad ki la mane ïa ki Baal . Ki la pynlong ïa u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang ban long u blei jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, tang shu iap u Gideon, ba ki khun Israel ki la phai biang, bad ki la leit shongkurim hadien u Baal, bad ki la leh ia u blei jong ki.

en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .
kha: Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U  Trai  ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng ,  A  Trai  Bakhrawbor ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong me markhmat !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba u long u angel U Trai , u Gideon u la ong: Ah Trai Blei ! namar namar nga la iohi ia u angel U Trai uba iakynduh markhmat .

en: I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .
kha: Ngam shym kren shaphang jong phi baroh ; nga tip ïa kito kiba nga la jied . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha , kaba ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabam lang ïa ka jingbam jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam kren ia phi baroh: Nga tip ia uba nga la jied: hynrei ba ka jingthoh kan long kaba la pyndep: hynrei uta uba bam ia u kpu bad nga u la pynkiew ia ka kjat jong u pyrshah ia nga .

en: And when it was told Saul , he sent other messengers , and they prophesied likewise . And Saul sent messengers again the third time , and they prophesied also .
kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , u phah kham bun shuh shuh ki nongrah-khubor , bad kita ruh ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa . U phah ki nongrah-khubor ha ka sien kaba lai , bad kajuh ka la jia ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la iathuh ia u Saul , u la phah ia kiwei pat ki nonglam khubor bad ki la iathuhlypa kumjuh . U Saul u la phah pat ia ki nonglam khubor ha ka sien kaba lai ruh .

en: Saying with a loud voice , Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power , and riches , and wisdom , and strength , and honour , and glory , and blessing .
kha: bad ki la rwai ha ka sur bajam :  U Khunlangbrot uba la shah pynïap u long uba dei hok ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bor , ka spah , ka jingstad , bad ka jingkhlaiñ , ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom , bad ka jingïaroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong da ka sur kaba jam , Ka long kaba sniew ia u Khunlangbrot uba la shah pyniap ban ioh ia ka bor bad ka spah bad ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlain bad ka burom bad ka burom bad ka jingkyrkhu .

en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .
kha: Kaei kaba u Syiem Kynrad u pan ka long kaba eh haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban leh ïa kata lait tang ki blei , bad kim shong kim sah hapdeng ki bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka long kaba duna bha kaba u syiem u dawa, bad ym don uwei pat uba lah ban pyni ia ka ha khmat u syiem , lait noh tang ki blei kiba ka shong jong ki kam don doh .

en: Come near , ye nations , to hear  ; and hearken , ye people : let the earth hear , and all that is therein  ; the world , and all things that come forth of it .
kha: Ale , phi ki briew jong ki hima baroh ! To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor . Ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un wan hangne bad shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan hajan, phi ki jaitbynriew, ban iohsngew ia ka ; bad sngap, phi ki briew: to ai ba ka khyndew kan iohsngew, bad baroh kaba don ha ka ; ka pyrthei bad kiei kiei baroh kiba mih na ka .

en: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine , lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
kha: Te men ym ïoh ong , ‘ Dei ma nga uba la pynriewspah ïa u Abram .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan ym shim na ka thread wat haduh ka jingpynkhih juti, bad ba ngan ym shim ia kaei kaei kaba long ka jong me, ioh ba me dei ban ong , nga la pynlong ia u Abram uba riewspah:

en: And when we had sailed slowly many days , and scarce were come over against Cnidus , the wind not suffering us , we sailed under Crete , over against Salmone  ;
kha: Ngi la ïaid suki bun sngi , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw , khatduh ngi la poi harud jong ka shnong Knidos . Ka lyer kam ailad shuh ïa ngi ban ïaid sha khmat ha kata ka liang , kumta ngi la ïaid arsut na ka liang kaba kah lyer jong ka Krit , da kaba ïaid najan ka Salmone .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la iaid suki suki bun sngi, bad tang khyndiat eh ki la wan shajan u Knidus, ka Iyer kaba ym shah shitom ia ngi, ngi la iaid hapoh Crete, shaphang u Salmone ; .

en: For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .
kha: Phi dei ban sngewskhem ba yn ym don uno uno uba awria , uba long jakhlia , lane uba kwah lalot (naba ka jingkwah lalot ka long hi ka rukom mane bleithaw) u ban ïoh bynta ha ka Hima jong U Khrist bad jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane phi tip , ba ym don u nongkhaïi met ne u briew uba khlem khuid ne uba thrang , uba long u nongleh bymman , uba don ka pateng ha ka hima U Khrist bad jong U Blei .

en: Hear , O Israel : Thou art to pass over Jordan this day , to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself , cities great and fenced up to heaven ,
kha: Shahshkor ko Israel ! Mynta ka sngi phin jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad knieh ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi . Ki shnong jong ki , ki long kiba heh , bad ki kynroh jong ki , ki kot haduh suiñbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ko Israel: Me dei ban iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan ha kane ka sngi , ban leit rung sha ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad kham khlain bor ban ia me hi , ki nongbah kiba khraw bad kiba la ker sawdong haduh bneng .

en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise , as in a strange country , dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob , the heirs with him of the same promise :
kha: Da ka jingngeit u la im kum u nongwei ha ka ri ha kaba U Blei u la kular ïa u . U la shong ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumta ruh u Isaak bad u Jakob , kiba la ïohpdiang ïa kajuh ka jingkular na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u la sah ha ka ri jong ka jingkular, kumba ha ka ri kaba phylla, u shong ha ki jaka sah bad u Isaak bad u Jakob, ki nongioh pateng bad u ia kajuh ka jingkular:

en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .
kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , kiba la kup da ki jaiñ linen ba-thaba kiba khuid lem bad ki panpoh ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shadem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynriew ngut ki angel ki la mih na ka tempi, ki don ki hynriew tylli ki khlam, ki la phong da ka jain lieh kaba khuid bad kaba lieh, bad ki la phong da ki shyntur ksiar .

en: And the Lord said unto him ,  Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter  ; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness .
kha: Kumta U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Mynta te , phi ki Pharisi phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , hynrei hapoh , phi dap da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Mynta phi Pharisi phi pynkhuid ia ka bynta ba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang ; hynrei ka bynta ba shapoh jong phi ka dap da ka jingsma bad ka jingsniew .

en: They shall run to and fro in the city  ; they shall run upon the wall , they shall climb up upon the houses  ; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief .
kha: Ki rung stet sha ka nongbah ; ki mareh nalor ki kynroh ; ki kiew sha ki ïing bad ki rung lyngba ki jingkhangïit kum ki nongtuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin mareh shapoh sor ; kin mareh halor ka kynroh , kin kiew sha jrong ki iing ; kin rung shapoh ki jingkhang kum u nongtuh .

en: And it came to pass , when Hushai the Archite , David s friend , was come unto Absalom , that Hushai said unto Absalom , God save the king , God save the king .
kha: Haba u Hushai , u paralok bajan jong u Dabid , u la ïakynduh ïa u Absalom , u la pyrta ,  To u syiem un im slem ! To u syiem un im slem !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Hushai u Arkit , u paralok u Dabid u la wan sha u Absalom , ba u Hushai u la ong ha u Absalom , U Blei u pynim ia u syiem .

en: So David and his men came to the city , and , behold , it was burned with fire  ; and their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , were taken captives .
kha: Ynda u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki poi , ki shem ba la thang ïa ka shnong , bad ba la rong noh ïa ki tnga jong ki , ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la wan sha ka shnong bad , ha khmih la thang ia ka da ka ding ; bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .

en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Philip ,  To khreh bad leit shaphang shathie sha kata ka lynti kaba leit na Jerusalem sha Gasa .  ( Kane ka long ka lynti ka bym ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )
translated_en_to_kha: U angel jong U Trai u la kren ha u Philip, u da ong: To khie bad leit shaphang shathie sha ka lynti kaba hiar na Jerusalem sha Gaza kaba long ka ri khlaw .

en: And the publican , standing afar off , would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven , but smote upon his breast , saying , God be merciful to me a sinner .
kha: Hynrei u nonglum khajna u la ïeng ha pajih bad um shym khmied la ka durkhmat sha bneng , hynrei u ïai tied ïa la ka shadem bad u la ong , ‘ A Blei , to isynei ïa nga , u nongpop !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u paidbah, uba ieng jngai, un ym kiew haduh katta katta sha bneng, hynrei un sngap jar ia ka shyntur jong u, da kaba ong: U Blei un long uba isynei ia nga u nongpop .

en: That they all may be one  ; as thou , Father , art in me , and I in thee , that they also may be one in us : that the world may believe that thou hast sent me .
kha: Nga duwai ba ki baroh kin ïalong kawei . Ko Pa ! To ai ba kin ïalong ha ngi , kumba me long ha nga bad ma nga ha me . To ai ba kin ïalong kawei , khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba baroh kin long kawei shuh kumba me long ha nga bad nga ha me: ba ka pyrthei kan ngeit ba me la phah ia nga .

en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .
kha: A Trai , to sngew ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , bad to trei ! Khnang ba uwei uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongbah bad kine ki briew ki long ki jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , to sngap ia ka shnong jong me bad ki briew jong me ki khot da ka kyrteng jong me .

en: But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
kha: Pynban ki la long kiba bha shikatdei ïa ngi ; kim ju pynthut ïa ngi , bad ha ki por baroh ba ngi don bad ki ha ki lyngkha , ym shym don kano kano ruh kaba dei ka jong ngi kaba la shah tuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shynrang ki la long kiba bha shibun ia ngi , bad ngim shym la shah pynmong , lymne ngim shym la duh ei ei , katba ngi dang iakynduh bad ki , haba ngi dang don ha ki lyngkha:

en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .
kha: Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha Babilonia bad un sah hangta haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kaei ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nong Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ialam ia u Sedekaiah sha Babilon, bad un don hangta haduh ba ngan da leit jngoh ia u, ong U Trai: wat la phi ialeh bad ki Khaldian , phin ym jop .

en: And I said unto her , Thou shalt abide for me many days  ; thou shalt not play the harlot , and thou shalt not be for another man : so will I also be for thee .
kha: Nga ong ïa ka ba ka dei ban ap slem ïa nga khlem da leh nuti lane klim ; bad ha kane ka por ngan ïai ap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha ka, Me dei ban kohnguh ia nga bun sngi; me dei ban leh ia ka kam runar, bad me dei ban long na ka bynta uwei pat u briew: kumta ngan long ruh na ka bynta jong me .

en: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .
kha: La ka long ha ka por balyngkot lane ha ka por bajlan ,  u Paul u la jubab ,  ka jingduwai jong nga ha U Blei ka long ba ma me bad baroh kiwei pat kiba sngap ïa nga ha kane ka sngi ki lah ban long kum ma nga — lait noh , da shisha , ïa kine ki kynjri !
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u la ong , Nga kwah ha U Blei , ba ym tang ma me , hynrei baroh kiba iohsngew ia nga mynta ka sngi , ki la jan long kum ma nga , lait noh tang kine ki jingteh .

en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee  ; and what I see , that I will tell thee .
kha: Ngan leit bad ngan ïeng hajan i pa ha kata ka jaka ba phi rieh , bad ngan ïakren bad i shaphang jong phi . Lada nga shem ei ei , ngan sa ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit shabar bad ngan ieng hajan u kpa jong nga ha lyngkha ha kaba me don, bad ngan iakynduh bad u kpa jong nga; bad kaei kaba nga iohi, ba ngan iathuh ia me .

en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .
kha: bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar ton u kew bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib man ka snem ban bsa ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ai arphew hajar tylli ki jingbam ha ka iing jong u, bad arphew tylli ki jingthew umphniang ba khuid: kumta u la ai ia u Solomon ha u Hiram man la u snem .

en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :
kha: Bad mynta nga kmen shaphang ki jingshahshitom jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , naba da ki jingshahshitom jong nga ha ka doh , nga ïarap ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba dang sah na ki jingshahshitom jong U Khrist na ka bynta ka balang , kaba long ka met jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba mynta u kmen ha ki jingjynjar jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , bad uba pyndap ia kata kaba don shadien jong ki jingjynjar U Khrist ha ka doh jong nga na ka bynta ka met jong u:

en: Behold , as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work  ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .
kha: Kumta kiba duk , kum ki kada khlaw , ki wad jingbam ha ka ri khlaw ba-tyrkhong ; ym don jaka hangno hangno ban shem jingbam na ka bynta ki khun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, kum ki kada khlaw ha ri khlaw, ki leit sha ka kam jong ki ; ki por ba ki mih na ka bynta ka jingbam: ka ri khlaw ka ai jingbam ia ki bad ia ki khun jong ki .

en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand , and put it upon Joseph s hand , and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen , and put a gold chain about his neck  ;
kha: U syiem u law noh na ka shynriah ti jong u ïa ka sati kaba don ka muhor syiem bad u pyndeng ïa ka ha ka shynriah ti jong u Joseph . U pynkup ruh ïa u da ka jaiñ linen bani , bad u pyndeng ïa u kynjri ksiar ha ka ryndang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la weng noh ia ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti jong u, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka kti u Joseph, bad u la pynbeit ia u da ki jain kiba jem, bad u la buh ia ka kynjri ksiar sawdong ka ryndang jong u;

en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter , that we may know that ye are gods : yea , do good , or do evil , that we may be dismayed , and behold it together .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ka lawei ka don — Te ngin tip ba phi long ki blei ! Leh katto katne kaba bha ne wallam katto katne ka jingpynjot ; pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingsheptieng bad jingkhynñiuh !
translated_en_to_kha: Pyni ia kiei kiei ki ban sa wan hadien, ba ngin tip ba phi long ki blei: Hooid, leh bha ne leh sniew, ba ngin sngewsih, bad ha khmih ia ka ryngkat .

en: For unclean spirits , crying with loud voice , came out of many that were possessed with them : and many taken with palsies , and that were lame , were healed .
kha: Ki mynsiem bymman ki la mihnoh na kiba bun ki briew da kaba lynñiar jam , bad ïa kiba bun kiba pang ïapshiliang bad kiba dkoh la pynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki mynsiem bymkhuid, kiba iam da ka sur kaba jam, ki la mih na kiba bun kiba la shah bat ha ki: bad kiba bun kiba la shah shim da ki jingpang sniehdoh, bad kiba la tyrkhong, ki la koit .

en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .
kha: Hadien kane U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki rangbah bad u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha ki shnong baroh bad ki jaka ha kaba ma u , u la mut ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei U Trai u la thung sa hynriewphew ngut ruh, bad u la phah ia ki ar ar arngut ha khmat jong u sha man la ka shnong bad ka jaka, ha kaba ma u hi un wan .

en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him :
kha: U nongpop u lah ban leh shispah tylli ki kam runar bad u dang im . O ! ho-oid , nga tip ïa kaei ba ki ong :  Lada phi kohnguh ïa U Blei , kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u nongpop u leh sniew shispah sien, bad ki sngi jong u kin nang slem, hynrei thikna nga tip ba kan long kaba bha ia ki kiba sheptieng ia U Blei, kiba sheptieng ha khmat jong u:

en: Thunderstorm accompanied with gusty winds is very likely to occur at isolated places in Jammu and Kashmir , Himachal Pradesh , Punjab and gangetic West Bengal .
kha: Ka eriong kaba don ryngkat bad ka lyer kaba jur bha ka lah ban jia ha ki jaka ba kyrpang ha Jammu bad Kashmir , Himachal Pradesh , Punjab bad gangetic West Bengal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhynñiuh jumai ryngkat bad ki Iyer kiba jur bha ka lah ban jia ha ki jaka ba la pyniakhlad ha Jammu bad Kashmir , Himachal Pradesh , Punjab bad ka West Bengal .

en: Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
kha: Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da phong jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , bad baroh — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kine ki briew ki la shah teh ha ki jainkup jong ki, ki hoen jong ki bad ki hat jong ki bad kiwei kiwei ki jain jong ki, bad la bret ia ki hapdeng ka ding kaba thang .

en: The morning is come unto thee , O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .
kha: Kaba kut ka la wan ha phi ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . Ka por ka la jan ha kaba yn ym don shuh ka jingïaleh kmen ha ki jaka mane ha ki lumbah , tang ka jingkulmar suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka step ka wan ha me, ko me uba shong ha ka ri: ka por ka la poi , ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar ka la jan , bad ym ka jingsawa biang jong ki lum .

en: Thou , O king , sawest , and behold a great image . This great image , whose brightness was excellent , stood before thee  ; and the form thereof was terrible .
kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , ha ka jingïohipaw jong phi , phi la ïohi ba la ïeng ha khmat jong phi ka durbriew bakhraw , kaba phyrnai bad thaba , bad kaba ishyrkhei ban khmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko syiem, me la iohi, bad ha khmih ka dur kaba khraw . Kane ka dur kaba khraw, kaba ka jingshai jong ka ka long kaba bha tam, ka la ieng ha khmat jong me; bad ka dur jong ka ka la long kaba shyrkhei .

en: The princes of Zoan are become fools , the princes of Memphis are deceived  ; they have also seduced Egypt , even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Soan bad jong ka Memphis ki dei ki bieit . La khmih lynti ïa ki ban ïalam ïa ka ri , hynrei ki la ïalam bakla ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka Soan ki kylla bieit , ki syiem jong ki Memphis ki shah thok ki la pynshoi ruh ia ka ri Ijipt , wat ia ki ruh kiba sah ha ki jaitbynriew jong ka .

en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .
kha: U Joab u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshun kin tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u jied ki shipai Israel bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khmat ïa ki shaphang ki Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Joab u la iohi ba ka thma ka la long pyrshah ia u shwa bad shadien , u la jied na ka jingjied baroh jong ki Israel , bad u la buh ia ki ha ka jingialeh pyrshah ia ki Syria .

en: I will open rivers in high places , and fountains in the midst of the valleys : I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ban tuid hapdeng ki lum bymseisoh bad ka um ha ki wahduid kan tuid ha ki jaka them . Nga pynkylla ïa ki jaka shyiap sha ki pukri um bad ki dewryngkhiang sha ki umpohliew batuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan plie ia ki wah ha ki jaka ba jrong , bad ki pung um hapdeng ki them: Ngan pynlong ia ka ri khlaw ka pung um , bad ki tyllong um kiba rkhiang .

en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .
kha: Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u para shnong lane ong ïa la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym hikai ia uwei pa uwei u paramarjan jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u para jong u, da kaba ong: To tip ia U Trai: namar baroh kin ithuh ia nga, naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .

en: And Aaron said unto them , Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me .
kha: U Aaron u ong ha ki ,  Law noh ïa ki sohshkor ksiar ba ki tnga jong phi , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi ki deng , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la ong ha ki, Pynduh noh ia ki shkor ksiar kiba don ha ki shkor jong phi, na ki khun shynrang jong phi bad ki khun kynthei jong phi bad wanrah ia ki ha nga .

en: Having many things to write unto you , I would not write with paper and ink : but I trust to come unto you , and speak face to face , that our joy may be full .
kha: Nga don shibun eh ban ïathuh ha phi , hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata ha ka kot bad ka sia ; pynban , nga kyrmen ban da wan jngoh ïa phi bad ïakren markhmat bad phi , ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don shibun kiei kiei ban thoh sha phi , ngan ym thoh da ka kot bad ka ink: hynrei nga shaniah ban wan sha phi , bad ban kren markhmat , ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap .

en: And he had thirty sons , and thirty daughters , whom he sent abroad , and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons . And he judged Israel seven years .
kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei . U pynshongkurim ïa la ki khun kynthei shabar na ka kur ka jait , bad u wanrah pat laiphew ngut ki samla kynthei nabar ka kur ka jait la jong ba kin shongkurim bad ki khun shynrang jong u . U Ibsan u ïalam ïa ki Israel hynñiew snem ,
translated_en_to_kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei kiba u la phah shabar ri, bad u la shim ia ki laiphew ngut ki khun kynthei na shabar ri na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad u la bishar ia ki Israel hynriew snem .

en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,
kha: U Blei um shym la kyntait ïa la ki jong ki briew , ïa kiba u la jied naduh kaba sdang . Phi tip ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ha ka jingïathuh shaphang u Elijah ba u ïasaid bad U Blei pyrshah ïa ki Israel :
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei um shym la bret noh ia ki briew jong u kiba u la tip lypa . Hato phim shym la leh ia kaei kaba ka jingthoh ka ong shaphang u Elias ? kumno u pynlong ia ka jingiarap ha U Blei pyrshah ia ki Israel da kaba ong:

en: And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .
kha: Ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kut kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki — ki kynton ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin rkhie bein ia ki syiem bad ki rangbah kin long kiba sngewsih ia ki: kin rkhie bein ia kawei pa kawei ka jaka kaba khlain; namar kin lum ia ka dewbilat bad kin shim ia ka .

en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .
kha: Kito kiba na kawei ka nongbah kin ong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u . To wan bad ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongshong shnong jong kawei ka shnong kin leit sha kawei pat ka shnong, ki da ong: To ngin leit kloi ban duwai ha khmat U Trai bad ban wad ia U Trai jong ki paid: Nga ruh ngan leit noh .

en: Therefore , behold , I will this once cause them to know , I will cause them to know mine hand and my might  ; and they shall know that my name is The  Lord .
kha: Kumta te ,  ong U  Trai  ,  Tang shisien keiñ ngan pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban tip ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga ; kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , ha khmih , kane ngan sa pynlong ia ki ban tip , ngan pynlong ia ki ban tip ia ka kti jong nga bad ka bor jong nga ; bad kin sa tip ba ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U Trai .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool : where is the house that ye build unto me ? and where is the place of my rest ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Kaba kumno keiñ ka ïing men tei ïa nga , bad kaba kumno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga bad ka khyndew ka long ka jaka shong kjat jong nga: hangno ka iing kaba phi tei ha nga ? bad hangno ka jaka shongthait jong nga ?

en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .
kha: Ki shim por sawphew sngi ban pyndep ïa ka , namar ka bam por katta ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pynlong ka jingïambriew ïa u hynñiewphew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sawphew sngi la pyndep na ka bynta jong u ; namar kumta la pyndep ia ki sngi jong kito kiba la shah pynkhuid: bad ki nong Ijipt ki la iam na ka bynta jong u hynriewphew sngi bad shi sngi .

en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,
kha: Nangta nga la iehnoh ïa ka Topheth , ha kaba U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u . Nga la leit bad ïeng hapoh ka phyllaw jong ka Templ bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la wan na Tophet , ha kaba U Trai u la phah ia u ban iathuhlypa bad u la ieng ha ka phyllaw jong ka iing U Trai; bad u la ong ha ki briew baroh .

en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he said on this wise , I will give you the sure mercies of David .
kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang kaba pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ym ban pyut noh ha ka jingtep :   ‘ Ngan ai ha me ïa kita ki jingkyrkhu bakyntang bad kiba thikna kiba nga la kular ha u Dabid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba u la pynmih ia u na kiba iap, mynta ym shuh ban leit phai sha ka jingbamsap , u la ong ha kane ka jingstad , ngan ai ia phi ia ki jingsngewrit ba thikna jong u Dabid .

en: And David said to Achish , Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do . And Achish said to David , Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever .
kha: Da shisha  u Dabid u jubab ,  Nga long u shakri jong phi bad phin sa ïohi da lade kaei ba nga lah ban leh .  U Akhish u ong ,  Ka biang ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi u nongïada jong nga shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Achish , Hooid men sa tip ia kaei kaba u shakri jong me u lah ban leh . U Achish u la ong ha u Dabid , Namarkata ngan pynlong ia me u nongsumar ia ka khlieh jong nga junom .

en: And not as it was by one that sinned , so is the gift : for the judgment was by one to condemnation , but the free gift is of many offences unto justification .
kha: Bad ka don ka jingïapher hapdeng ka jingai sngewbha U Blei bad ka pop jong uwei u briew . Hadien jong kata kawei ka pop , la wan ka jingbishar ïa  Kiba pop ;  hynrei hadien ki pop kiba bun bah , ka wan ka jingai sngewbha kaba ngim don hok , ka jong  Uba khlem pop !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym kumba ka la long da uwei uba la leh pop: namar ka jingbishar ka long da uwei ban pynrem , hynrei ka jingai kaba laitluid ka long na kiba bun ki jingleh bymman haduh ka jingpynshisha .

en: And the king said unto them , What seemeth you best I will do . And the king stood by the gate side , and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands .
kha: Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  u syiem u jubab . Nangta u ïeng harud jong ka khyrdop katba ki rangbah jong u ki dang ïaid sha khmat ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki, Kaei kaba phi sngewbha ngan leh . U syiem u la ieng hajan ka khyrdop , bad ki briew baroh ki la mih da ki spah bad da ki hajar .

en: And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .
kha: Em ,  ka la jubab .  Ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi dang shu dep leh !  Hynrei u Amnon um sngap ïa ka ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u: Ym don daw: kane ka jingsniew ha kaba phah noh ia nga ka kham khraw ban ia kawei pat kaba me la leh ha nga . Hynrei um shym la sngap ia ka .

en: Behold , ye despisers , and wonder , and perish : for I work a work in your days , a work which ye shall in no wise believe , though a man declare it unto you .
kha: ‘ Ha khmih , phi kiba beiñ briew ! To sngewlyngngoh bad to ïap ! Naba kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka long kaei kaei kaba phin ym ngeit , wat haba uno uno u batai ïa ka ha phi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih phi sngewsih, bad phi sngew lyngngoh: namar nga trei ia ka kam ha ki sngi jong phi, ka kam kaba phin ym ngeit da ka jingstad, wat la u briew u pynbna ia ka ha phi .

en: For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :
kha: Nga la iehnoh ïa me ha Krit , khnang ba men buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei kiba dang donkam ban leh bad ban thung ïa ki nongsharai balang ha man la ki shnong . To kynmaw ïa ki jingbthah jong nga :
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka daw kane nga la iehnoh ia me ha Crete, ba me dei ban buh ia kiei kiei kiba duna, bad ban buh ia ki rangbah ha man la ka shnong kumba nga la thung ia me:

en: And I will send an angel before thee  ; and I will drive out the Canaanite , the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite :
kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel jong nga ban ïalam ïa phi , bad ngan beh noh ïa ki Kanaan , ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ia u angel ha khmat jong me; bad ngan beh noh ia u Kanaani, u Amorit bad u Hitit bad u Perizite, u Hebite bad u Jesuse:

en: And Moses said unto him , Enviest thou for my sake ? would God that all the  Lord s  people were prophets , and that the  Lord  would put his spirit upon them !
kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Hato me pyrkhat lem shaphang kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad nga ? A ban da U  Trai  u ai ïa la ka bor mynsiem ha ki briew jong u baroh bad u pynlong ïa ki ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa !
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u, Me sngewbha na ka bynta jong nga ? hato U Blei ba ki briew jong U Trai baroh ki long ki nongiathuhlypa , bad ba U Trai un buh ia ka mynsiem jong u halor jong ki !

en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .
kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ki jingphohsniew ba ki ïathuh kin pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban klet ïa nga , kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la klet ïa nga bad phai sha u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pyrkhat ban pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ban klet ia ka kyrteng jong nga da ki jingphohsniew jong ki kiba ki iathuh ia uwei pa uwei ha u paramarjan jong u , kumba ki kpa jong ki ki la klet ia ka kyrteng jong nga na ka bynta u Baal .

en: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister , nor of thy father s sister : for he uncovereth his near kin : they shall bear their iniquity .
kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka kmienah kmiesan , ne bad la ka ñiakha , baroh ar ngut ki dei ban shahshitom namar kata ka kam sang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka para jong me ne ka para jong u kpa jong me: namar u pynpaw ia ka jingbymhok jong u: kin kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him , then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him , that God may be all in all .
kha: Hynrei haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh hapoh ka jingsynshar U Khrist , te ma u hi , U Khun , un pyndem ïa lade hapoh U Blei uba la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u ; bad U Blei un synshar lut halor baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda kiei kiei baroh kin sa shah pyndem ha u , te U Khun ruh un long hapoh jong uta uba buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u, ba U Blei un long baroh ha baroh .

en: At that time Berodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah : for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick .
kha: Kumba ha kata kajuh ka por u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u ïohsngew ba u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang , kumta u phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Beroochbaladan u khun u Baladan u syiem Babilon u la phah shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha sha u Hesekaiah: namar u la iohsngew ba u Hesekaiah u la pang .

en: But their minds were blinded : for until this day remaineth the same veil untaken away in the reading of the old testament ; which veil is done away in Christ .
kha: Ki jingmut jong ki , da shisha , ki long kiba la set khop ; bad haduh kane ka sngi ki jingmut jong ki , ki dang long kiba la tap da kata kajuh ka jingkah haba ki pule ïa ki kitab jong ka jutang barim . Ïa kata ka jingkah , la weng noh tang haba u briew u la pynïasoh ïa lade ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki ka la matlah: namar haduh kane ka sngi ka sah kajuh ka jingtap kaba khlem weng noh ha ka jingpule ia ka jutang barim; kaba la weng noh ha U Khrist .

en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .
kha: Ryngkat bad uta u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , ainguh kumba shi kilo u kew ba la tylliat ni bha ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad uwei u langbrot shi bynta ka shini ka la khleh lang bad ka bynta kaba saw jong ka umphniang ba la khleh ; bad ka bynta kaba saw jong ka wain na ka bynta ka jingainguh dih .

en: And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .
kha: Lada pha kylli balei kane baroh ka la jia ha pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki la kad noh bad pha la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha ka long kaba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me ong ha ka dohnud jong me , Balei kine kiei kiei ki wan ha nga ? Namar ka jingkhraw jong ka jingbymhok jong me la lap ia ki bniat jong me, bad ki tyrpeng jong me ki la paw .

en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shyntur jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jong u mradkhlaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa balamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kum ki khnai kiba mih na ka shyntur jong u bsein bad na ka shyntur jong u mrad bad na ka shyntur jong u nongiathuhlypa lamler .

en: Ye have said , It is vain to serve God : and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance , and that we have walked mournfully before the  Lord  of hosts ?
kha: Phi la ong , ‘ Kam myntoi ban shakri ïa U Blei . Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban leh ïa kaei kaba u ong lane kaba pyrshang ban pyn-i ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ba ngi sngewsih na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la ong , Ka long kaba lehnohei ban shakri ia U Blei : bad kaei ka jingmyntoi ba ngi la bat ia ka hukum jong u , bad ba ngi la iaid sngewsih ha khmat U Trai jong ki paid ?

en: And not holding the Head , from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered , and knit together , increaseth with the increase of God .
kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist la bsa ïa ka met baroh kawei bad la pyndait lang da ki mat bad doh-satar jong ka , bad ka san kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ka ba kan san .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban bat ia ka Khlieh, na kaba ka met baroh kawei da ki shyieng bad ki band ka la shakri, bad ka la nang kiew ryngkat bad ka jingroi jong U Blei .

en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law , and did obeisance , and kissed him  ; and they asked each other of their welfare  ; and they came into the tent .
kha: kumta u Moses u mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , u dem ha khmat jong u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïakylli para ma ki kumno ki ïalong , bad nangta ki la leit sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la mih ban iakynduh ia u kpa tymmen jong u, bad u la kohnguh ia u ; bad ki la kylli iwei ia iwei pat ia ka bha ka miat jong ki ; bad ki la wan shapoh ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses bad u Aaron ki dem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ong ,  A Blei , me , me long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh . Haba uwei na ngi u leh pop , hato men shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la dem khrup bad ki la ong: Ko Blei U Blei jong ki mynsiem jong ka doh baroh , hato uwei u briew un leh pop bad me long uba bitar bad ka jingiaseng baroh ?

en: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .
kha: Naba ki sngi ki wan ha kaba ki briew kin ong , ‘ Katno kiba donbok long ki kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung , ki bym ju bsa ïa ki !’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ha kaba kin ong: La kyrkhu ia ki khunlung bad ki kpoh ki bym ju kha khun bad ki pop ki bym ju ai dud .

en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .
kha: Ha ka sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kerkut jong ki nongshun jong phi la kurup bad ba ïa ki briew jong ki la pynïap , ki wahduid kin tuid na baroh ki lumbah bad ki lumrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don ha u lum uba jrong bad ha u lum uba jrong baroh , ki wah bad ki wah um ha ka sngi jong ka jingpyniap kaba khraw , haba ki tower ki hap .

en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine  ; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt  ; and the famine shall consume the land  ;
kha: Hadien kata , yn don ka  nemsniew ha ki hynñiew snem , bad yn klet noh ïa kita ki snem kiba pahuh , namar ka  nemsniew kan sa pynjot ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan mih hadien jong ki hynriew snem ka jingkyrduh ; bad ia ka jingbun baroh yn klet noh ha ka ri Ijipt ; bad ka jingkyrduh kan bam ia ka ri ; .

en: And Moses answered and said , But , behold , they will not believe me , nor hearken unto my voice : for they will say , The  Lord  hath not appeared unto thee .
kha: Te U Moses u jubab ïa U  Trai  ,  Hynrei tharai ki Israel kin ym ngeit ïa nga , bad kin ym shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Ngan leh kumno lada ki ong ba mem shym la paw ha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la jubab bad u la ong: Hynrei, ha khmih, kin ym ngeit ia nga, lymne kin ym sngap ia ka sur jong nga: namar kin ong: U Trai um shym la paw ha me .

en: And cried with a loud voice , and said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of the most high God ? I adjure thee by God , that thou torment me not .
kha: Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me ban ym pynshitom ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam bad u la ong, Nga don jingiadei bad me, ko Jisu, ko Khun U Blei uba ha khlieh duh ? Nga pynskhem ia me da U Blei ba me pynshitom ia nga .

en: And I will bring them , and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness .
kha: bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki na mihngi bad na sepngi ban shong ban sah ha Jerusalem . Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki , da kaba synshar ha ka jingïaineh bad ha ka jinglehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia ki, bad kin shong hapdeng ka Jerusalem: bad kin long ki briew jong nga, bad ngan long U Blei jong ki, ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .

en: And he charged them , and said unto them , I am to be gathered unto my people : bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite ,
kha: Nangta u Jakob u hukum ïa la ki khun shynrang , u da ong ,  Mynta ba ngan sa leit noh sha ki briew jong nga ha kaba ïap noh , tep ïa nga ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga ha ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha u Ephron , u nong Hit ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la kynnoh ia ki bad u la ong ha ki: nga dei ban ialum lang bad ki briew jong nga: tep ia nga bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga ha ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha jong u Ephron u Hitit .

en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye , and tell that fox , Behold , I cast out devils , and I do cures to day and to morrow , and the third day I shall be perfected .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa uta u myrsiang : ‘ Nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid bad nga pynkhiah mynta bad la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba lai ngan pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To leit bad to iathuh ia uta u blang, Ha khmih nga beh ia ki ksuid bad nga leh ia ki dawai ha ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba lai ngan sa long uba janai .

en: They are not humbled even unto this day , neither have they feared , nor walked in my law , nor in my statutes , that I set before you and before your fathers .
kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi phim shym la pynrit ïa lade . Phim shym la pyndonburom ïa nga lane im kat kum ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kim shym la shah pynrit mynsiem haduh kane ka sngi , lymne kim shym la tieng , lymne kim shym la iaid ha ka hukum jong nga , lymne ha ki ain jong nga , ba nga buh ha khmat jong phi bad ha khmat ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: And it came to pass , that after three days they found him in the temple , sitting in the midst of the doctors , both hearing them , and asking them questions .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai , ki la shem ïa u hapoh ka Templ , u da shong bad ki nonghikai jong ki Jiw , da kaba shahshkor ïa ki bad kylli jingkylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba hadien lai sngi ki la shem ia u ha ka tempi, u la shong hapdeng ki doktor, baroh arngut ki la iohsngew ia ki bad ki la kylli ia ki jingkylli .

en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
kha: Ki la bitar haduh katta katta ïa nga bad hukum ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïing u Jonathan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong u la pynlong ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ki rangbah ki la bitar ia u Jeremaiah bad ki la pynbeit ia u bad ki la buh ia u ha ka iing jong u Jonathan u nongthoh: namar ki la pynlong ia kata ka phatok .

en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him , and gave it to David , and his garments , even to his sword , and to his bow , and to his girdle .
kha: U law ïa ka jaiñkup ba u phong bad u ai ïa ka ha u Dabid , ryngkat bad ka jingkieng atiar jong u bad ruh ïa ka waitlam , ka ryntieh , bad u panpoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la weng noh ia lade na ka jainkup kaba don halor jong u, bad u la ai ia ka ha u Dabid bad ki jainkup jong u, wat ha ka waitlam jong u bad ha ka tyrpeng jong u .

en: In righteousness shalt thou be established : thou shalt be far from oppression  ; for thou shalt not fear : and from terror  ; for it shall not come near thee .
kha: Ka jingbishar hok bad ka hok tynrai kin pynkhlaiñ ïa pha . Phan lait na ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hok to long uba skhem: me dei ban long uba jngai na ka jingshah lehbein ; namar me dei ban tieng: bad na ka jingtieng ; namar kan ym wan hajan jong me .

en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun jong u Ahab , bad kumba long kiba na ka ïing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Israel . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iaid ha ka lynti jong ki syiem Israel: namar ka khun jong u Ahab ka long ka tnga jong u: bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .
kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga ithuh me long uei : Me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , To ngin ia kren marwei ia me, ko Jisu na Nazareth ? me wan ban pynjot ia ngi ? Nga tip ia me uba me long; U Bakhuid jong U Blei .

en: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh , This is the finger of God : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , and he hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
kha: Te kita ki nongleh myntor ki ong ha u Pharaoh ,  U Blei u la leh ïa kane .  Hynrei u Pharaoh u dang mutlop bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongleh jadu ki la ong ha u Pharaoh: Kane ka long ka kti U Blei: bad ka dohnud u Pharaoh ka la tyrkhong , bad um shym la sngap ia ki ; kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .
kha: Ki pynkylla kyrteng ïa ka Laish sha ka Dan , kum ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen u Dan , u khun jong u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka shnong Dan, hadien ka kyrteng u kpa jong ki, uba la kha ha ki Israel: katba ka kyrteng jong ka shnong ka long ka Laish ha kaba nyngkong .

en: Paul , a servant of God , and an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the faith of God s elect , and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness ;
kha: Na u Paul , u shakri jong U Blei bad u apostol jong U Jisu Khrist . Ïa nga la jied bad la phah ban ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei bad ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingshisha ba la hikai kat kum ka jingngeit jong ngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul u shakri U Blei bad u apostol U Jisu Khrist kat kum ka jingngeit U Blei u la jied, bad ka jingpdiang ia ka jingshisha kaba long hadien ka jinglong blei ; .

en: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel , and to Beth–maachah , and all the Berites : and they were gathered together , and went also after him .
kha: U Sheba u la leit lyngba ïa ka jaka jong ki jait Israel baroh bad u la wan poi ha ka nongbah Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki dkhot jong ka kur Bikri ki la ïalumlang bad bud ïa u sha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid lyngba ki jait Israel baroh haduh u Abel, bad haduh Bethmaah bad ki Berite baroh: bad ki la ialum lang bad ki la iaid ruh hadien jong u .

en: And she lay at his feet until the morning : and she rose up before one could know another . And he said , Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor .
kha: Kumta ka thiah hangta ha ki kjat jong u , hynrei ka la khie ha shuwa ban kynjat shai ïoh don ba ïohi ïa ka , namar ba u Boas um kwah ïano ïano ban tip ba ka la don hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la thiah ha ki kjat jong u haduh mynstep : bad ka la ieng shuwa ba uwei un ithuh ia uwei pat . Bad u la ong , Wat nym tip ba kawei ka kynthei ka la wan shapoh madan .

en: If thou wilt return , O Israel , saith the  Lord  , return unto me : and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight , then shalt thou not remove .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko paid Israel , lada phi kwah ban wan phai , to wan phai noh sha nga . Lada phi shaniah ha nga bad weng noh ïa ki bleithaw kiba nga ijli ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me wan phai, ko Israel, ong U Trai, to wan phai sha nga: bad lada me weng noh ia ki jingleh bymman jong me na ka khmat jong nga , te wat weng noh ia ki .

en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .
kha: Namar ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad mem shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki don . Na kata ka daw U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa me mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me khlem kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai , lane ba me pyndep ia ka jingbitar kaba jur jong u halor u Amalek , namarkata U Trai u la leh ia kane ka kam ha me ha kane ka sngi .

en: Your eyes have seen what the  Lord  did because of Baal–peor : for all the men that followed Baal–peor , the  Lord  thy God hath destroyed them from among you .
kha: Phi la ïohi da lade aïu U  Trai  u la leh ha u lum Peor . U la pynjot ïa uwei pa uwei uba mane ïa u Baal hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong u ki la iohi ia kaei kaba U Trai u la leh namar u Baalopeor: namar ki briew baroh kiba la bud ia u Baalopeor , U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynjot ia ki napdeng jong phi .

en: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about , like those windows : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
kha: La don ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong ha ki kamra jong kane ka khyrdop , katjuh kum ha kiwei pat ki khyrdop . Baroh shi lynter kata ka khyrdop ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki jingkhang ha ka bad ha ki arphew cubit sawdong: ka jingjrong ka long sanphew cubit bad ka jingjrong sanphew cubit .

en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :
kha: Haba u nongshet kpu rangbah u la ïohi ba kata ka jingbatai ïa ka jingphohsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga ruh nga la phohsniew ; nga la kit lai tylli ki shang kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u nongshet kpu uba ha khlieh duh u la iohi ba ka jingbatai ka long kaba bha, u la ong ha u Joseph , nga ruh nga la don ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga bad , ha khmih , nga la don lai tylli ki basket lieh ha ka khlieh jong nga:

en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .
kha: Hynrei don ki bym shym shahshkor ïa u Moses , bad ki la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba bud kata kaba sah ka la boi ksaiñ bad ka sma iwjit , bad u Moses u la bitar ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ki khlem sngap ia u Moses ; hynrei don napdeng jong ki kiba la sah na ka haduh ka por mynstep, bad ka la pynkha ia ki khniang, bad ka la sngap jar: bad u Moses u la bitar ia ki .

en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged  ; and they feared the king : for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him , to do judgment .
kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingrai jong u Solomon , ki la dap da ka jingñiewburom bakhraw ïa u , namar ki tip hangta ba U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingstad ban pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia ha ka hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la iohsngew ia ka jingbishar kaba u syiem u la bishar ; bad ki la tieng ia u syiem: namar ki la iohi ba ka jingstad U Blei ka don ha u, ban leh ia ka jingbishar .

en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do , do it with thy might  ; for there is no work , nor device , nor knowledge , nor wisdom , in the grave , whither thou goest .
kha: Trei shitom ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , namar yn ym don kano kano ka jingtrei , ka jingpyrkhat , ka jingtip , ka jingstad ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap — bad kata ka dei sha kaba phi leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaei kaba ka kti jong me ka shem ban leh, to leh ia kata da ka jingstad jong me; namar ym don kam, ne ka jingthmu, ne ka jingtip, ne ka jingtip, ne ka jingtip, ha ka jingtep, ha kaba me leit .

en: All ye inhabitants of the world , and dwellers on the earth , see ye , when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains  ; and when he bloweth a trumpet , hear ye .
