kha: To shahshkor , phi baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei ! To ap ïa ka lama ai dak kaba yn kyntiew halor ki kliar jong ki lumbah ! To shahshkor ïa ka jingput ïa ka ronsing !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh phi ki nongshong shnong jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongshong shnong ha ka khyndew , phi iohi , haba u rah ia ka dak ha ki lum ; bad haba u beh ia ka turoi , phi iohsngew .

en: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all , that ye say , We will be as the heathen , as the families of the countries , to serve wood and stone .
kha: Phi la pynbeit ïa la ki jingmut ba phi ïakwah ban long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , kum ki briew kiba shong basah ha kiwei pat ki ri bad kiba mane ïa ki dieng bad ki mawsiang . Hynrei kata kan ym long da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata kaba wan ha ka jingmut jong phi kan ym long satia, ba phi ong , Ngin long kum ki nongwei kum ki longiing jong ki ri, ban shakri ia ki dieng bad u maw .

en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,
kha: Haba la poi ktien ha ki Assyria ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syiem Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohsngew ba u la ong shaphang u Tirhakah u syiem ka Ethiopia , U la wan shabar ban ialeh thma bad me . Bad haba u la iohsngew ia kata u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Hesekaiah da kaba ong:

en: That they may see , and know , and consider , and understand together , that the hand of the  Lord  hath done this , and the Holy One of Israel hath created it .
kha: Ki briew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin tip ba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh ïa ka . Kin wan ban tip ba U Blei bakhuid ki Israel u la pynlong ïa ka ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin iohi bad tip bad pyrkhat bad sngewthuh lang ba ka kti U Trai ka la leh ia kane, bad U Bakhuid jong ki Israel u la thaw ia ka .

en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ : for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth ; to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .
kha: Nga don ka jingngeit baskhem ha ka Gospel ; ka long ka bor U Blei ban pynim ïa baroh kiba ngeit , nyngkong ïa ki Jiw bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam sngewlehrain ia ka gospel U Khrist: namar ka long ka bor U Blei ha ka jingpynim ia uwei pa uwei uba ngeit; ha u Jiw nyngkong eh bad ruh ha u Grik .

en: Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei kaba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba neh ha la ki dohnud . Wat sheptieng haba ki briew ki pynsalia bad krenbeiñ ïa phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga, phi kiba tip ia ka hok, ki briew ha ka dohnud jong nga kim tieng ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ki briew, lymne to tieng ia ki jingshah lehbein jong ki .

en: And Jephthah said unto them , I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon  ; and when I called you , ye delivered me not out of their hands .
kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi don ka jingïakajia kaba jur bad ki Ammon . Nga la khot ïa phi , hynrei phim shym la wan pyllait ïa nga na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la ong ha ki , Nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la ialeh pyrshah shibun bad ki khun Ammon ; bad haba nga la khot ia phi , phim shym la pyllait ia nga na ki kti jong ki .

en: Thou shalt seek them , and shalt not find them , even them that contended with thee : they that war against thee shall be as nothing , and as a thing of nought .
kha: bad kin jah noh na ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban wad ia ki, bad wat shem ia ki, wat ia kita kiba ialeh pyrshah ia me: kita kiba ialeh pyrshah ia me kin long kum ki bym don ei ei bad kum kaei kaei kaba khlem ei ei .

en: And it came to pass , as we went to prayer , a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us , which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying :
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ngi dang ïaleit sha ka jaka duwai , kawei ka shakri samla kaba la don u mynsiem bymman uba la pynlah ïa ka ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka ban sa wan , ka la ïakynduh ïa ngi . Ka la kamai bun ka pisa na ka bynta ki trai jong ka da kaba batai kupar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ngi dang leit sha ka jingduwai, kawei ka dam kaba don ka mynsiem jong ka jingleh jadu ka la iakynduh ia ngi, kaba la wanrah ia ki kynrad jong ka shibun ka jingmyntoi da kaba pynsngewbha:

en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .
kha: U pynap shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Judah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbah kiba u Asa u la jop ha ka ri ki Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki shipai ha ki shnong ba la ker sawdong jong ka Judah baroh kawei bad u la buh ia ki shipai ha ka ri Judah bad ha ki shnong Ephraim kiba u kpa jong u u la shim .

en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .
kha: Mynta ngam mut ïa ki bymngeit kiba awria ne kiba lalot ne kiba long ki nongtuh ne kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw . Ban lait na kine phi dei ban mihnoh shisyndon na ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym baroh ki nongleh kam sniew jong kane ka pyrthei, ne bad ki nongleh kam sniew, ne bad ki nongleh bymman ; namar nangta phi dei ban mih noh na ka pyrthei .

en: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem  ; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue , Aceldama , that is to say , The field of blood .
kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , bad ki la khot kyrteng ha ka ktien jong ki ïa kata ka lyngkha  Ka Akeldama ,  kaba mut  Ka lyngkha ka snam .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la tip ia ka ha ki nongshong shnong baroh ha Jerusalem ; khlem da pyrkhat ia kata ka lyngkha la khot ha ka shyntur kaba dei jong ki, Aceldama, kata ka long ka lyngkha snam .

en: If any man teach otherwise , and consent not to wholesome words , even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ , and to the doctrine which is according to godliness ;
kha: Uno uno uba hikai ïa ka jinghikai shongtynrai kaba pher bad um mynjur ïa ki ktien bashisha jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ka jingngeit jong ngi u long uba dap da ka jingsarong bad u bymtip ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u hikai lym kumta , bad um mynjur ia ki ktien kiba koit ba khiah , wat ia ki ktien U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist bad ia ka jinghikai kaba long kat kum ka jinglong blei ; .

en: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression , and it cast down the truth to the ground  ; and it practised , and prospered .
kha: Ki briew ki la leh pop hangta ha ka jaka ban ai ki jingkñia kiba dei man la ka sngi , bad ïa ka niam bashisha la bret sha khyndew . Ka reng ka la jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ka la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ia u ia u nongwan pyrshah ia ka jingknia kaba man ka sngi namar ka jingpynkhein , bad ka la pynhap ia ka jingshisha sha ka khyndew ; bad ka la leh , bad ka la roi .

en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , stand in the holy place ,  ( whoso readeth , let him understand : )
kha: Phin ïohi ïa ‘ Ka Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ ïa kaba u Daniel u nongïathuh lypa u la kren . Kan ïeng ha ka jaka bakhuid .  ( Ka jingkynthoh ïa u nongpule : Da pynthikna ban shemphang aïu kane ka kit jingmut ! )
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phin iohi ia ka jingpynjot ia ka jingpynjot, kaba la kren da u Daniel u nongiathuhlypa, to ieng ha ka jaka bakhuid, (u uno uba pule , to ai ba un sngewthuh: )

en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;
kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bnai Kisleb ) , U  Trai  u la ai ka khubor ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong u syiem Darius, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Sekharaiah ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba hynniew, wat ha Kisleu ; .

en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon s house  ; and he was laid down . And she took flour , and kneaded it , and made cakes in his sight , and did bake the cakes .
kha: Ka la leit shata bad ka lap ba u don ha jingthiah . Ka shim shilynglun u kpu im , ka la pynkhreh ïa u , bad ka shna katto katne tylli ki kpu hangta ha kaba u lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Nangta ka la shet ïa ki kpu
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit sha ka iing jong u hynmen jong ka u Amnon bad u la shah pynthiah . Bad ka la shim ia ka shini bad ka la dem ia ka bad ka la shet ia ki cake ha khmat jong u .

en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king s entry without , turned he from the house of the  Lord  for the king of Assyria .
kha: Bad khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa u patsha ki Assyria , u Ahas u weng ruh na ka Templ ïa ka rynsan na ka bynta ka khet syiem bad u set noh ïa ka jaka rung bakyrpang jong u syiem sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtap na ka bynta ka Sabha kaba ki la tei ha ka iing , bad u syiem u la leit shabar na ka iing U Trai na ka bynta u syiem Assyria .

en: Did not your fathers thus , and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .
kha: Kane ka dei ka daw balei ba U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba u wanrah ka jingjot halor kane ka nongbah . Bad pynban , phi pan kwah ba U Blei un phah shuh shuh ka jingbitar halor ka Israel da kaba pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim shym la wanrah ia kane ka jingsniew baroh ha ngi bad ha kane ka shnong ? hynrei phi wanrah shuh shuh ia ka jingbitar ha ki Israel da kaba pynjah burom ia ka Sabha .

en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .
kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la mih shabar bad pynïap ïa u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka jingsynshar kaba pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem u la hukum ia u Beniah u khun u Jehoiada; uba la mih noh bad u la hap halor jong u, ba u la iap . Bad ka hima ka la long kaba skhem ha ka kti u Solomon .

en: I beheld , and , lo , the fruitful place was a wilderness , and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the  Lord  , and by his fierce anger .
kha: Ka ri kaba seisoh ka kylla long ka ri shyiap , ki nongbah jong ka ki la don ha ka jingjot namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi, bad, ha khmih, ka jaka kaba seisoh ka la long ka ri khlaw, bad ki shnong jong ka baroh ki la shah pynpra ha khmat U Trai , bad da ka jingbitar kaba jur jong u .

en: But did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , like unto the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki hima kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , u Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai, kum ki jingleh bymman jong ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la bret noh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: So king Solomon sent , and they brought him down from the altar . And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon : and Solomon said unto him , Go to thine house .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khot ïa u Adonijah bad phah patan ïa u na ka duwan . U Adonijah u la leit sha u syiem bad u la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Me lah ban leit noh sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Solomon u la phah ia u, bad ki la wanrah ia u na ka almari . U la wan bad u la dem khrup ha u syiem Solomon: bad u Solomon u la ong ha u: Leit sha la iing .

en: Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,
kha: Nga la kylli ,  Sa katno kan long kumne , ko  Trai  ?  U la jubab ,  Tad haduh ba ki nongbah kin jot kin pra bad long thylli — tad haduh ba ki ïing kin long ïingjah — tad haduh ba ka ri hi kan long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , ko Trai, haduh katno ? Bad u la jubab , Haduh ba ki nongbah kin jah rngai noh khlem nongshong shnong bad ki iing khlem briew bad ka ri kan long kaba la jot lut .

en: And the haft also went in after the blade  ; and the fat closed upon the blade , so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly  ; and the dirt came out .
kha: Ka waitlam baroh kawei lem bad ka sping ka la rung shapoh bad ka khleiñ ka la tap ïa ka . U Ehud um shym la sei ïa ka na ka kpoh jong u syiem , bad ka la pei bla shadien , hapdeng ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u slap ruh u la rung hadien ka blade ; bad ka shini ka la khang ia ka blade , haduh ba um lah ban sei ia ka dagger na ka kpoh jong u ; bad ka jakhlia ka la mih .

en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .
kha: Kane ka la jia namar ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  da ki pop jong u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki pop jong u kiba u la leh sniew ha khmat U Trai, ha kaba iaid ha ka lynti jong u Jeroboan bad ha ka pop jong u kaba u la leh, ban pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near , and smote Micaiah upon the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem U  Trai  u la mih na nga bad kren ha phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u khun u Chenaah u la wan hajan bad u la shoh ia u Maiah ha ka rmiang shyntur bad u la ong: Kumno u Mynsiem U Trai u la leit noh na nga ban kren ha me ?

en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ïa ki ar ngut shi para kiba long ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang tong dohkha ha ka duriaw da ka jar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu, haba u iaid lyngba ka duriaw Galilaia, u la iohi ia arngut ki hynmen, u Simon uba la khot u Petros bad u Andrei u hynmen jong u, u la bret ia ka jar shapoh duriaw: namar ki long ki nongtong dohkha .

en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .
kha: Ki nongshong kulai kin tur lyngba ki lynti bah jong pha , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakhraw jong pha kin hap ha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki tyrpeng jong ki kulai jong u un iaid shapoh ki lynti jong me baroh: un pyniap ia ki briew jong me da ka waitlam , bad ki kynhun shipai kiba khlain jong me kin hiar shapoh khyndew .

en: If then God so clothe the grass , which is to day in the field , and to morrow is cast into the oven  ; how much more will he clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad uba jah noh la shai , ïa uba la thang noh ha ka lawar ding . Hato Un ym jin da la thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? A katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada U Blei u phong ia u phlang uba don ha lyngkha bad lashai la bret ia u ha ka oven ; katno un phong ia phi , ko jong ka jingngeit kaba rit ?

en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem , from before the tabernacle of the congregation , and reigned over Israel .
kha: Kumta u Solomon u mihnoh na ka jaka mane ha Gibeon , ha kaba don ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Hangta u synshar ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la wan na ka jingleit jong u sha ka jaka kaba jrong kaba don ha Gibeon sha Jerusalem , na khmat ka ïingjahthait jong ka jingïalang , bad u la synshar halor ki Israel .

en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity , because they have no knowledge : and their honourable men are famished , and their multitude dried up with thirst .
kha: kumta ïa phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ki nongïalam jong phi kin shahthngan haduh ban ïap , bad ki riewpaidbah kin ïap thynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki briew jong nga ki la leit sha ka jingshah set phatok , namar kim don jingtip: bad ki briew kiba donburom jong ki ki la shah thngan , bad ka jingbun jong ki ka la tyrkhong da ka jingthngan .

en: Surely , shall one say , in the  Lord  have I righteousness and strength : even to him shall men come  ; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed .
kha: Kin ong ba dei tang lyngba jong nga yn shem ïa ka jingjop bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; hynrei baroh kiba shun ïa nga kin shah pynjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, yn ong, ha U Trai nga don ka hok bad ka jingkhlain: wat ha u ruh ki briew kin wan ; bad baroh kiba sngewsih ia u kin sngewlehrain .

en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .
kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong ka Gerar ki la ïakajia bad ki nongap langbrot jong u Isaak , bad ki ong ,  Kane ka um ka dei ka jong ngi .  Kumta u Isaak u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri  Ka Jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong u Gerar ki la ialeh bad u Isaak ki nongap langbrot jong u Isaak ki da ong: Ka um ka long ka jong ngi: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka pung Esek ; namar ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u .

en: And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,
kha: U  Trai  u ïaid na khmat jong u , bad u pynbna ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei uba dap da ka jinglehsbun bad jinglehisynei , uba suki ban bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la iaid lyngba ha khmat jong u, bad u la pynbna , U Trai , U Trai Blei uba isynei bad uba sngewrit, uba sngewsih bad uba bun ha ka jingbha bad ka jingshisha .

en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write  ; These things saith the Amen , the faithful and true witness , the beginning of the creation of God  ;
kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Laodikaïa :  Kane ka long ka khubor na U Amen , uba ïaineh bad u sakhi bashisha , uba long u jingsdang jong baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u angel jong ka balang ki nong Laodice ki thoh ia ka ktien Amen, ka sakhi kaba ngeit bad kaba shisha, ka jingsdang jong ka jingthaw U Blei ; .

en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?
kha: Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka jingkhawai niam bym don thied ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki da ong ha u , Hangno me kwah ba ngin pynkhreh ia me ban bam ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglait ?

en: You may go to a local Kingdom Hall or speak to any of Jehovah’s Witnesses and request a publication in your language that will help you to understand the Bible .
kha: Phi lah ban leit sha ka Ïing Hima kaba don hajan jong phi ne ong ïa ino ino i Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ai ïa phi ki kot kiba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi lah ban leit sha ka Hima kaba don ha ka thain ne ban iakren bad uno uno na ki Nongsakhi jong ka Jehobah bad pan ia ka kot ha ka ktien jong phi kaba iarap ia phi ban sngewthuh ia ka Baibl .

en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts , the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them :
kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki la dep bynta ïa ka ri , ki la ai ha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun shi bynta jong ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la pynkut noh ia ka ri na ka bynta ka pateng da ki pud jong ki , ki khun Israel ki la ai pateng ia u Joshua u khun u Nun hapdeng jong ki:

en: Thou hast heard , see all this  ; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time , even hidden things , and thou didst not know them .
kha: Baroh kiba nga la ïathuh lypa , mynta ki la urlong ; phi hap ban pdiang ba ki jingïathuh lypa jong nga ki long kiba dei . Mynta ngan ong ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai ki ban wan , ki jingjia kiba ngam shym la pynpaw mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohsngew , peit ia kine baroh ; bad phin ym pynbna ia ka ? Nga la pyni ia me ia kiei kiei kiba thymmai naduh kane ka por, wat ia kiei kiei kiba buhrieh, bad me khlem ithuh ia ki .

en: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them , and they stood upon their feet  ; and great fear fell upon them which saw them .
kha: Hadien lai sngi shiteng , ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ba ai jingim ka la wan na U Blei bad ka la rung ha ki , bad ki la ïeng joit ; bad baroh kiba la ïohi ïa ki , ki la sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien lai sngi shiteng U Mynsiem jong ka jingim na U Blei u la rung ha ki , bad ki la ieng ha ki kjat jong ki ; bad ka jingtieng kaba khraw ka la hap ha ki kiba la iohi ia ki .

en: And the sign or the wonder come to pass , whereof he spake unto thee , saying , Let us go after other gods , which thou hast not known , and let us serve them  ;
kha: khnang ban ïalam ïa phi ban mane bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba phim pat ju mane mynshuwa . Wat la kata kaba u kular ka urlong shisha , wat shahshkor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka dak ne ka jingphylla ka wan jia, na kaba u la kren ha me, u da ong: To ngin iaid hadien kiwei pat ki blei kiba me khlem tip bad to ngin shakri ia ki ; .

en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerusha ka khun jong u Sadok .
translated_en_to_kha: Sanphew snem ka rta jong u ha ka por ba u sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Jerusha , ka khun jong u Sadok .

en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt , even unto this day , and in Israel , and among other men  ; and hast made thee a name , as at this day  ;
kha: Naduh mynbarim , me la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla ha Ijipt , bad me ïai leh ïa ki haduh kane ka sngi , ha Israel bad hapdeng kiwei ki hima baroh , ba kumta ïa me mynta la tip kylleng sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la buh ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla ha ka ri Ijipt, haduh kine ki sngi, bad ha Israel, bad hapdeng kiwei pat ki briew ; bad me la pynlong kyrteng ia me, kumba ha kane ka sngi ; .

en: And he commanded the steward of his house , saying , Fill the men s sacks with food , as much as they can carry , and put every man s money in his sack s mouth .
kha: U Joseph u hukum ïa u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Pyndap ïa ki byrni jong kine ki briew da ka jingbam , katba ki lah ban kit , bad thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei na ki ha khlieh ka byrni jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia u nongap iing jong u, u da ong: Pyndap ia ki shynrang da ka jingbam katba ki lah ban kit bad buh ia ka pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka shyntur jong u .

en: But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .
kha: Hynrei phi , phi dei ki briew kiba u la pyllait im na Ijipt , ka pajwa kaba klang da ka ding . U la wan ïalam ïa phi ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumne kumba phi long mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la shim ia phi, bad u la wanrah ia phi na ka ding nar, wat na Ijipt, ban long ha u ki briew kiba long ka pateng, kumba phi long mynta ka sngi .

en: Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .
kha: Bad mynta , ko  Trai  , to pyndep na ka bynta ka por baroh ïa ka kular jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kaei kaba me thmu ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta ko Trai , to ai ba kata kaba me la kren shaphang u shakri jong me bad shaphang ka iing jong u kan long kaba skhem junom , bad to leh kumba me la ong .

en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling , and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .
kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud eh jong ka sut    kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli ha rmiang jong ka jaiñ ka sut kaba ar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna sanphew tylli ki loop ha ka tduh kaba kut tam jong ka jingtap ha ka jingpyniasoh , bad sanphew tylli ki loop u la shna ia u ha ka tduh jong ka jingtap kaba ar .

en: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel , and all his great men , and his kinsfolks , and his priests , until he left him none remaining .
kha: Nangta u Jehu u pynïap lut sa ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u Ahab kiba shong basah ha Jesreel , bad ïa baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , ki paralok kiba jan eh bad u , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u ; ym don shuh uwei na ki ïa uba dang sah pynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jehu u la pyniap ia baroh kiba sah ha ka iing u Ahab ha Jesel, bad ki rangbah jong u baroh, bad ki jaitbynriew jong u, bad ki lyngdoh jong u, haduh ba un da iehnoh ia u .

en: Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .
kha: Uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew u klim ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la shah pyllait tnga u klim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba weng noh ia ka tnga jong u bad u shongkurim ia kawei pat: bad uno uno uba shongkurim ia ka uba la shah kyntait na u tnga jong ka u leh ia ka kam runar .

en: And I John saw these things , and heard them . And when I had heard and seen , I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things .
kha: Ma nga , u Ïoannis , nga la ïohsngew bad la ïohi ïa kine kiei kiei baroh . Bad haba nga la dep ïohsngew bad ïohi ïa ki , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u angel uba la pyn-i ha nga ïa kine kiei kiei , bad nga la jan mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga Ioannis nga la iohi ia kine kiei kiei bad nga la iohsngew ia ki . Bad haba nga la iohsngew bad iohi , nga la dem khrup ban mane ha khmat ki kjat jong u angel uba la pyni ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .
kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lum , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi , tad haduh ba U Khun U Briew u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang wan hiar na u lum , u la kyntu ia ki ba kim dei ban iathuh iano iano ruh ia kiei kiei kiba ki la iohi , haduh ba u Khun u briew un da mihpat na kiba iap .

en: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth , because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah , for that which he did in Jerusalem .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei ban sngewtriem ha ki namar kaei kaba u Manasseh u khun jong u Hesekaïah u la leh ha Jerusalem mynba u long u syiem ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki ban shah weng noh ha ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew namar u Manaseh u khun u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah namar kata kaba u la leh ha Jerusalem .

en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites , What shall I do for you ? and wherewith shall I make the atonement , that ye may bless the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
kha: Kumta u Dabid u khot hajir ïa ki paid Gibeon bad u ong ha ki ,  Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ? Nga kwah ban pynbeit noh ïa ka jingbakla ïa kaba la leh ïa phi , khnang ba phin kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Dabid u la ong ha ki nong Gibeon , Ngan leh aiu na ka bynta jong phi ? bad da kaba ngan leh ia ka jingpynkhuid , ba phin kyrkhu ia ka pateng U Trai ?

en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar , their appearances and themselves : they went every one straight forward .
kha: Ki durkhmat jong ki , ki syriem thik kum ki durkhmat ba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Uwei pa uwei u kherub u ïaid beit sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiasyriem jong ki khmat jong ki ka long kumjuh ki khmat kiba nga iohi da ka wah Chebar , ki dur jong ki bad ki hi: ki la iaid beit beit shakhmat .

en: For I the  Lord  love judgment , I hate robbery for burnt offering  ; and I will direct their work in truth , and I will make an everlasting covenant with them .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga ieit ïa ka jingbishar hok bad nga isih ïa ka jingbanbeiñ bad ka jingleh runar . Da shisha ngan sa ai bainong ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan pynlong ka jutang kaba neh junom bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga U Trai nga ieit ia ka jingbishar , nga shun ia ka jingshah lute na ka bynta ka jingainguh thang ; bad ngan pynbeit ia ka kam jong ki ha ka jingshisha , bad ngan leh ia ka jutang bymjukut bad ki .

en: And it came to pass a long time after that the  Lord  had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about , that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age .
kha: Kham slem hadien kane , U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingïada na ki nongshun sawdong jong ki . Ha kata ka por u Joshua u la tymmen bha ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia slem hadien ba U Trai u la ai jingjahthait ia ki Israel na ki nongshun jong ki baroh sawdong , ba u Joshua u la tymmen bad u la tyrkhong ha ka rta .

en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .
kha: Kin sa tip ruh ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba ngan ïoh shongduh hapdeng jong ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki, uba la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt, ba ngan shong hapdeng jong ki: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;
kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da la ki jong ki hukum bad ki kyndon , khnang ban ïoh pynlong ïa ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba pynduh noh ha ka doh jong u ia ka jinglong bymman, wat ia ka ain jong ki hukum kaba don ha ki jingpynbeit ; na ka bynta ban pynlong ha lade arngut uwei u briew uba thymmai, kumta ban pynlong ia ka jingsuk ; .

en: And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki rangbah shipai ,  Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Long uba kut jingmut triang uba skhem namar kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki, Wat tieng, lymne wat sngewsih, to long kiba khlain bad kiba shlur: namar kumta U Trai un leh ia ki nongshun jong phi baroh kiba phi ialeh pyrshah .

en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .
kha: U la ai ïa nga shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jong ki baroh u la jied ïa u Solomon ban synshar halor ka Israel , ka hima ka jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh, (namar U Trai u la ai ha nga bun ki khun shynrang), u la jied ia u Solomon khun jong nga ban shong ha ka khet jong ka hima U Trai halor ki Israel .

en: Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la trei , hynrei katno ka long kaba duh jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei .  Pynban nga lah ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban kyrshan na ka bynta jong nga ; un ai bainong ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , nga la trei shitom khlem jingmyntoi, nga la pynlut ia ka bor jong nga khlem jingmyntoi: hynrei shisha ka jingbishar jong nga ka long bad U Trai bad ka kam jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .

en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew, haba ki la tip ia kata, ki la bud ia u: bad u la pdiang ia ki, bad u la kren ha ki shaphang ka hima U Blei, bad u la pynkoit ia kita kiba donkam ban pynkoit .

en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains , and they robbed all that came along that way by them : and it was told Abimelech .
kha: Ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh briew ban apthap ïa u Abimelekh ha ki kliar lum , bad ki la lute ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti nangta . La ïathuh ïa kane ha u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Shechem ki la buh ia u ha jrong jong ki lum , bad ki la lute lut ia kiba la wan kumta da ki: bad la iathuh ia ka ha u Abimelech .

en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium , we launched , meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia  ; one Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica , being with us .
kha: Ngi la kiew da ka lieng na Adramyttion kaba la khreh ban leit sha ki kadlieng jong ka probins    jong ka Asia , bad ngi la leit . U Aristarkhos , u nong Makedonia uba na Thessaloni , u la don lem bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da kaba rung ha ka lieng jong ka ri Asia, ngi la sdang, kaba mut ban leit kai da ki rud duriaw jong ka Asia ; uwei u Aristarkhos , u Makedonia jong ka Thessaloni , u la don ryngkat bad ngi .

en: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,
kha: Ki rangbah kiba u Moses u la phah swar ïa ka ri , ki la wanrah ïa ka kaiphod balamler kaba la pynlong ïa u paidbah ban khñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba u Moses u la phah ban wad ia ka ri, kiba la wan phai, bad ki la pynlong ia ka jingiaseng baroh ban ia tyngkhuh pyrshah ia u , da kaba wanrah ia ka jingkren bein ia ka ri .

en: Then the king s countenance was changed , and his thoughts troubled him , so that the joints of his loins were loosed , and his knees smote one against another .
kha: U la kylla lieh blaid blaid bad u la sheptieng katta katta ba ki khohsiew jong u ki la sdang ban khynñiuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka khmat jong u syiem ka la kylla, bad ki jingpyrkhat jong u ki la pynkhuslai ia u, haduh ba ki shyieng jong u ki la jah noh , bad ki kjat jong u ki la ia tyngkhuh iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Let your women keep silence in the churches : for it is not permitted unto them to speak ; but they are commanded to be under obedience , as also saith the law .
kha: Kumba ka long ha ki balang jong u paidlang U Blei , ki kynthei ki dei ban sngap jar ha ki jingïaseng . Ym shah ïa ki ban kren ; kumba ka Hukum ki Jiw ka ong , kim dei ban leh trai khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki kynthei jong phi kin sngap jar ha ki balang: namar ym shah ia ki ban kren ; hynrei la hukum ia ki ban long hapoh ka jingsngap jar , kumba ruh ka ong ka hukum .

en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned : therefore , behold , I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king .
kha: Nga tip , kynrad , ba nga la leh pop , bad dei kane keiñ balei ba nga long uba nyngkong na ki jait bashaphang shatei ban wan bad ïakynduh ïa U Syiem Kynrad ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u shakri jong me um tip ba nga la leh pop: namarkata , ha khmih , nga wan nyngkong eh ha kane ka sngi jong u Joseph baroh ban leit hiar sha u kynrad jong nga u syiem .

en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow  ; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself : neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself .
kha: Ki nongsiatkhnam kin ym lah ïeng ha la ki jaka ïeng , ki nongmareh kiba stet kin ym lah lait , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ym lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ym ieng ia kata ka bow ; bad uta uba stet ka kjat un ym pyllait im ia lade: lymne uta uba shong kulai un ym pyllait im ia lade .

en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians , so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians .
kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin ñiewburom ïa ki Israel bad ba kin ai kat ïa kaba ki pan . Dei da kumne ba ki Israel ki rah noh ïa ka spah ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ai ia ki briew ha khmat ki nong Ijipt , haduh ba ki la ai ram ia ki ia kiei kiei kiba ki donkam . Ki la pynsniew ia ki nong Ijipt .

en: But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .
kha: Mynta pat , ngi la lait na ka Hukum , namar ngi la ïap noh ïa kata kaba shisien ka la khum ïa ngi kum ki koidi . Ngim shakri shuh ha ka rukom barim jong ka hukum ba la thoh , hynrei ha ka rukom bathymmai jong U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta la pyllait noh ia ngi na ka hukum , ba ngi la iap ha kaba la bat ia ngi; ba ngi dei ban shakri ha ka jinglong thymmai jong ka mynsiem , bad ym ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka shithi .

en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .
kha: Uta u briew uba la don u mynsiem bymman u la tur puk sha ki da ka jinglehbor kaba haduh katta ba u la jop ïa ki baroh . Ki la phet noh na ka ïing jong u , kiba la mynsaw bad ha ki jaiñ kiba la shah tar .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew ha uba u mynsiem bymman u la jngi halor jong ki , bad u la jop ia ki , bad u la jop ia ki , haduh ba ki la phet noh na kata ka iing lyngkhuid bad mynsaw .

en: And they made their father drink wine that night also : and the younger arose , and lay with him  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
kha: Kumta ki la pyndih buaid ïa la u kpa ha kata ka miet ruh , bad kata ka khun kaba ar ka leit ïathiah shongkha bad u . Ha kane ka kynti ruh u la buaid shaba palat kat haduh ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia u kpa jong ki ban dih wain ha kata ka miet ruh: bad kaba kham rit ka la ieng bad u ; bad um shym la sngewthuh haba ka la thiah , ne haba ka la ieng .

en: And Elijah took the child , and brought him down out of the chamber into the house , and delivered him unto his mother : and Elijah said , See , thy son liveth .
kha: U Elijah u rah biang ïa u khynnah shapoh sha ka kmie jong u bad u ong ha ka ,  Peit , u khun jong pha u la im !
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la shim ia uta u khynnah, bad u la wanrah ia u na ka kamra shapoh iing, bad u la aiti ia u ha ka kmie jong u: bad u Elijah u la ong: Peit, ko khun jong me u im .

en: And they went up , and pitched in Kirjath–jearim , in Judah : wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day : behold , it is behind Kirjath–jearim .
kha: Ki leit kiew bad sher dara ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Kiriath Jearim kaba ha Judah . Dei namar kata balei ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Jaka Sher Dara ki Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit shaneng, bad ki la iaid ha Kirjathjaram, ha Judah: namar kata ki la khot ia kata ka jaka Mahanehdan haduh kane ka sngi: ha khmih, ka don shadien jong ka Kirjathjaram .

en: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon , saying , What hast thou to do with me , that thou art come against me to fight in my land ?
kha: Nangta u Jephthah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Ammon ban ong ,  Me don daw aïu bad ngi ? Balei ba me wan hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la phah khubor sha u syiem ki khun Ammon u da ong: Me don jingiadei bad nga , ba me wan pyrshah ia nga ban ialeh ha ka ri jong nga ?

en: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .
kha: Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka  nemsniew ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u syiem jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingkyrduh ha ka ri, nalor ka jingkyrduh kaba nyngkong eh kaba la don ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u syiem jong ki Philistia ha Gerar .

en: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .
kha: Balei ? Namar ba ka Syria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Damaskos , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Damaskos kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Resin . Katba ïa ka Israel , hapoh ki hynriewphew san snem yn sa pynkhynñiuh ïa ka ruh ban lait im kum ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka khlieh jong ka Syria ka long ka Damaskos bad ka khlieh jong u Damaskos ka long ka Rezin ; bad hapoh hynriewphew snem bad san snem u Ephrahem un shah pynpra , ba kam dei ka jaitbynriew .

en: What shall we say then ? That the Gentiles , which followed not after righteousness , have attained to righteousness , even the righteousness which is of faith .
kha: Te kumta ngi ong ba ki Jentil , ki bym shym la pyrshang ban ïasuk bad U Blei , la pynïasuk bad u lyngba ka jingngeit ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ong aiu te ? Ba ki Jutang ki bym bud ia ka hok ki la ioh ia ka hok , wat ia ka hok kaba long ka jingngeit .

en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .
kha: Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong u blei Molekh uba phi la bah , bad ka dur jong u Rephan , u blei khlur jong phi ; ki la long ki bleithaw kiba phi la thaw ïa ka ban mane . Bad kumta ngan phah ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha palat ka Babilon .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, phi la shim ia ka iing jong u Molok, bad u khlur jong u blei jong phi u Remphan, ki dur kiba phi la pynlong ban mane ia ki: bad ngan rah noh ia phi sha lyndet ka Babilon .

en: And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .
kha: Ki leh kumta , bad halor jong ka u la hiar arsut ha ka lynti nadien u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trai uwei u dieng Sning .  Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ?  u kylli .  Nga dei ,  uta u briew u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bud ia uta u briew jong U Blei bad u la shem ia u ba u shong hapoh u dieng oak: bad u la ong ha u: Me long u briew jong U Blei uba wan na Judah ? Bad u la ong , Nga long .

en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , when thou wast naked and bare , and wast polluted in thy blood .
kha: Ha ka jingim ba-ijli jong pha kum ka nuti pham ju kynmaw shisien ruh ïa la ka jinglong khynnah — mynba pha long kaba lyngkhuit , bad ïaksaid ha la ka jong ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki jingleh bymman jong me baroh bad ki jingleh be-ijot jong me me khlem kynmaw ia ki sngi jong ka jinglong samla jong me, haba me la lyngkhuid bad lyngkhuid bad la pynjakhlia ia me ha ka snam jong me .

en: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .
kha: Haba u Iso u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u lynñiar jam bad ïamkthang ruh , bad u ong ,  Ko Pa ! to ai ha nga ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la iohsngew ia ki ktien u kpa jong u, u la pyrta da ka jingud kaba khraw bad kaba palat, bad u la ong ha u kpa jong u: Kyrkhu ia nga ruh ko kpa jong nga .

en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers : for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness ? and what communion hath light with darkness ?
kha: Wat pyrshang ban ïatreilang ryngkat bad ki bymngeit , naba kam lah ban long . Kumno kaba dei bad kaba bakla kin ïadon bynta lang ? Kumno ka jingshai bad ka jingdum kin ïasah lang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim dei ban iakynduh khlem da pyrkhat bad ki bym ngeit: namar kaei ka jingiadei bad ka jingbymhok ? bad kaei ka jingiadei bad ka jingdum ?

en: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err , and to do worse than the heathen , whom the  Lord  had destroyed before the children of Israel .
kha: U Manasseh u ïalam ïa ki paid Judah ban leh ïa ki pop kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Manasseh u la pynlong ia u Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ban bakla bad ban leh kham sniew ban ia ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la pynjot ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .
kha: Haba u Abram u la dap khyndaiphew khyndai snem ka rta , U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Kohnguh ïa nga bad ïai leh ïa kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la dap hynniewphew snem ka rta, u Trai u la paw ha u Abram, bad u la ong ha u, Nga long U Blei uba donbor baroh; to iaid ha khmat jong nga, bad me long uba janai .

en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .
kha: Ïa ki jingdih la sam ha ki khuri ksiar , kiba ïapher dur kawei na kawei pat , bad u syiem u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai um ia ki ha ki khiew ksiar , (ki khiew ki long kiba pher iwei na iwei pat), bad ka wain syiem ha ka jingbun , kat kum ka jinglong jong u syiem .

en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ,  Nga ainguh ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la weng noh ia u maw na ka jaka ba la buh ia kiba iap . U Jisu u la rah ia ki khmat bad u la ong: Ko Kpa nga ainguh ia me ba me la iohsngew ia nga .

en: He shall build an house for my name  ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father  ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .
kha: Un tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong nga . Un long u khun jong nga bad ngan long u kpa jong u . Ka longïing syiem jong u kan synshar ïa ka Israel junom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Un tei ia ka iing na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad un long u khun jong nga, bad ngan long u kpa jong u ; bad ngan pynskhem ia ka khet jong ka hima jong u halor ki Israel junom .

en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .
kha: Man ka por ba ka langbrot ka shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , nga kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanrah ïa kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shym dei ka jingbakla jong nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi ngan hap buria ïa kaba lah shah tuh la ka long mynsngi lane mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kata kaba la shah pynpra ha ki mrad ngam shym la wanrah ha me; nga la kit ia ka jingduh noh jong ka kti jong nga, la ka long kaba la tuh ha ka por mynstep ne kaba la tuh ha ka por miet .

en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , to be set by the four corners of it  ; even two rings upon the one side of it , and two rings upon the other side of it .
kha: U thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bret saw tylli ki ryntieh ksiar na ka bynta jong ka; wat ar tylli ki ryntieh ha kawei ka liang jong ka .

en: And they sought to lay hold on him , but feared the people : for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them : and they left him , and went their way .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu , namar ki la tip ba u la ong ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki . Hynrei ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , kumta ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wad ban bat ia u, hynrei ki la tieng ia ki briew: namar ki la tip ba u la kren ia ka pharshi pyrshah ia ki: bad ki la iehnoh ia u, bad ki la leit noh .

en: But woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck , in those days ! for there shall be great distress in the land , and wrath upon this people .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don khunlung ! Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bashyrkhei kan wan halor kane ka ri , bad ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei kan hap ha kane ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kordit ia kito kiba pun khun bad ia kito kiba ai dud ha kita ki sngi ! namar kan don ka jingjynjar kaba khraw ha ka ri bad ka jingbitar halor kane ka jaitbynriew .

en: In the law it is written , With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people ; and yet for all that will they not hear me , saith the Lord .
kha: Ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid la thoh :  Da ki briew kiba kren ha ki ktien kiba pher ngan kren ha ki briew jong nga , ong U Trai . Ngan kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongwei , hynrei wat la katta ki briew jong nga kin ym shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hukum la thoh , Da ki briew kiba na kiwei pat ki thylliej bad kiwei pat ki rmiang shyntur ngan kren ha une u briew ; bad wat la katta ruh kin ym iohsngew ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time , every man to his tribe and to his family , and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por kiwei pat ki Israel ki mihnoh nangta , bad man u rangbah u leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka jait bad sha la ka longïing bad sha la ki jingdon jingem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit noh nangta ha kata ka por , uwei pa uwei sha la ka jaitbynriew bad sha la ka iing ka sem , bad ki la leit noh nangta uwei pa uwei sha la ka pateng .

en: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam . And Jeroboam arose , and fled into Egypt , unto Shishak king of Egypt , and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon .
kha: Bad kumta u Solomon u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u Jeroboam ; hynrei u phet ïap sha u Shishak u syiem ka Ijipt bad u la sah hangta haduh ka jingïap u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la wad namarkata ban pyniap ia u Jeroboan . U Jeroboan u la mih bad u la phet noh sha Ijipt , sha u Syiem Ijipt , bad u la don ha Ijipt haduh ka jingiap u Solomon .

en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath , from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering  ; seven sabbaths shall be complete :
kha: Kheiñ hynñiew taïew naduh kata ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton ha kaba phi wallam ïa ka song kew ban ainguh sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin khein ia phi naduh ka sngi kaba bud ia ka sngi saitjain, naduh ka sngi ba phi wanrah ia ka sniehdoh jong ka wave; hynriew sngi saitjain kin long kiba pura:

en: When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu shibun kiba la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la poi ka janmiet, ki la wanrah ha u bun kiba la shah ktah ha ki ksuid: bad u la beh noh ia ki mynsiem da ka ktien jong u, bad u la pynkoit ia kiba pang baroh:

en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad u la leit rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  To ïathuh ïa ngi aïu ka pharshi shaphang ki ñiut hapoh ka lyngkha ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phah noh ia u paidbah sha jngai bad u la leit shapoh iing: bad ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u da kaba ong: To pynpaw ha ngi ia ka pharshi jong ki lyngkha .

en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .
kha: kiba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba wan mih bad ki ong ha u ,  Pyni ïa ngi kumno ngin ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongleit jingleit ki la iohi ia u briew uba mih na ka shnong bad ki la ong ha u: To pyni ia ngi, ngi duwai ia me, ka jingkhang shapoh ka shnong bad ngin pyni ia me ia ka jingisynei .

en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God , and took a great stone , and set it up there under an oak , that was by the sanctuary of the  Lord .
kha: U Joshua u thoh ïa kita ki hukum ha ka kitab Ka Aiñ U Blei . Nangta u la shim uwei u maw uba heh , bad u pynïeng ïa u hapoh u dieng Sning ha ka jaka kyntang jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la thoh ia kine ki ktien ha ka Kitab ka hukum U Blei , bad u la shim ia u maw uba heh bad u la buh ia u hangta hapoh u dieng oak uba don hajan ka jaka kyntang jong U Trai .

en: They shall howl , saying , How is it broken down ! how hath Moab turned the back with shame ! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him .
kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynkhynñiuh ! To kyang jam ! Ïa ka Moab la pynjahburom . Ka don ha ki jingjot , bad baroh ki hima ba don sawdong ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa pyrta, ki ong, Kumno ka la shah pynpra ! kumno u Moab u la phai noh da ka jingsngewlehrain ! kumta u Moab un long u nonglehbein bad u nonglehbein ia ki baroh shaphang jong u .

en: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane ka jingduwai , u la mihnoh bad la ki synran bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid ba la khot ka Kidron . Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda U Jisu u la kren ia kine ki ktien , u la leit noh bad ki synran jong u halor ka wah Cedron , ha kaba ka don ka kper , ha kaba u la rung bad ki synran jong u .

en: And the first beast was like a lion , and the second beast like a calf , and the third beast had a face as a man , and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle .
kha: Uba nyngkong u don ka dur kum u sing ; uba ar u don ka dur kum u masi kyrtong ; uba lai u don ka durkhmat kum ka durkhmat u briew ; bad uba saw u don ka dur kum u pukni uba her .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u mrad uba nyngkong u long kum u sing , bad u mrad uba ar kum u khun masi , bad u mrad uba lai u don ka khmat kum u briew , bad u mrad uba saw u long kum u blang uba her .

en: Thy words were found , and I did eat them  ; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart : for I am called by thy name , O  Lord  God of hosts .
kha: Me la kren ïa nga , bad nga la shahshkor ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien . Nga long u jong me , A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , bad kumta ki ktien jong me ki la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da kaba kmen bad ka jingsngewkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: La shem ia ki ktien jong me , bad nga la bam ia ki ; bad ka ktien jong me ka la long ha nga ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud jong nga: namar la khot ia nga da ka kyrteng jong me, ko Trai Blei jong ki paid .

en: Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .
kha: To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu uba don u thiat uba rim jong ka pop bad ka jingbymman , hynrei da u kpu u bym don thiat , u kpu jong ka jingkhuid bad ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ngin iai bteng ia ka jingkhawai, ym da ka jingkhleh kaba rim, lymne da ka jingkhleh jong ka jingsniew bad ka jingsniew ; hynrei da u kpu bym don kyiad jong ka jinglong ba shisha bad ka jingshisha .

en: Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?
kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha u Gog ïa kaei kaba u ong ïa u :  Mynta katba ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki dang shong ha ka jingsngewskhem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko khun u briew , to iathuhlypa bad ong ha u Gog , Kumta u ong U Trai Blei Ha kata ka sngi ba ki briew jong nga ki Israel ki shong suk im saiñ , hato phin ym tip ia ka ?

en: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel : and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel–meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room .
kha: pynsleh ïa u Jehu u khun jong u Nimshi kum u syiem ka Israel , bad pynsleh ïa u Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat na Abel Meholah ban long nongïathuhlypa hadien jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u khun u Nimshi un long u syiem halor ki Israel: bad u Elisa u khun u Abel ષhooh u dei ban long u nongiathuhlypa ha ka kamra jong me .

en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Nga long u Jiw , ïa uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong, Nga long u briew uba long u Jiw na Tarsos, ka shnong ha Ceceia, u nongshong shnong jong ka shnong kaba rit: bad, nga kyrpad ia me, to shah ia nga ban kren ha ki briew .

en: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah , that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah , and took them .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw ba u Hesekaïah u la long u Syiem ka Judah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah bad u la knieh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Hesekaiah, ba u Sennakherb u syiem Assyria u la wan pyrshah ia ki shnong ba la iada baroh jong ka Judah bad u la shim ia ki .

en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .
kha: Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin tei ia ki jaboh barim, kin pynmih ia ki jingjot kiba mynshuwa bad kin pynbha ia ki nongbah kiba la jot , ki jingjot jong kiba bun ki pateng .

en: And even things without life giving sound , whether pipe or harp , except they give a distinction in the sounds , how shall it be known what is piped or harped ?
kha: Shu shim nuksa ïa ki jingput jingtem ki bym don jingim kum ka tangmuri ne ka duitara — kumno phin tip ïa ka sur lymda la tem ha ki sur kiba shai ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat kiei kiei khlem ka jingim kaba ai sur , la ka long ka pipe ne ka harp , lait noh tang ba ki ai jingpyniapher ha ki sur , kumno yn tip ia kaei kaba la pipe ne kaba la pynkhih ?

en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?
kha: Em , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba bha . Kaei kaba u dawa na ngi ka long kane : Ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok , ban pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh , bad ban im ha ka jingïasyllok basngewrit bad U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyni ia me ko briew, kaei kaba bha bad kaei kaba U Trai u dawa na me, hynrei ban leh hok bad ban ieit ia ka jingisynei bad ban iaid da ka jingsngewrit bad U Blei jong me ?

en: And when they were come to him , he said unto them , Ye know , from the first day that I came into Asia , after what manner I have been with you at all seasons ,
kha: Haba ki la poi , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ïatip kumno ba nga la pynlut ïa ka por haba nga la don bad phi , naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga la poi ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la wan sha u , u la ong ha ki: Phi tip, naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba nga wan sha Asia, hadien kaei ka rukom ba nga la don bad phi ha ki aiom baroh .

en: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .
kha: Ka jingïaleh hapdeng ki kynhun ïaleh kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul bad kito kiba ïashah ïa u Dabid ka la neh slem bha . Katba u Dabid u nang khlaiñ nang khlaiñ , ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong u ki la nang tlot nang tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la don ka thma kaba jrong hapdeng ka iing u Saul bad ka iing u Dabid: hynrei u Dabid u la nang kham khlain bad kham khlain , bad ka iing u Saul ka la nang tlot bad kham tlot .

en: If an ox gore a man or a woman , that they die : then the ox shall be surely stoned , and his flesh shall not be eaten  ; but the owner of the ox shall be quit .
kha: Lada u masi kyrtong u tynrah ïano ïano , shynrang ne kynthei , haduh ba un da ïap , dei ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad ïa ka doh jong u ym bit ban bam ; hynrei u trai jong uta u masi un ym shah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u masi u briew ne ka kynthei u iap: te u masi un shah pynkhih maw shisha, bad ka doh jong u kan ym shah bam ; hynrei u trai jong u masi un shah iehnoh .

en: How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;
kha: Da kumno te ngin lait , lada ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpynim kaba khraw katta katta ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nyngkong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ngin lait im lada ngi iehnoh ia ka jingpynim kaba khraw ; kaba ha kaba nyngkong la sdang ban kren da U Trai , bad la pynskhem ia ngi da kito kiba la iohsngew ia u ; .

en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the  Lord  in Jerusalem , but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .
kha: Ïa kito ki lyngdoh ym shym la shah ban shakri ha ka Templ , hynrei ki lah ban bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat ba la ju ai ïa ki para lyngdoh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki lyngdoh jong ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la wan shaneng sha ka jingknia U Trai ha Jerusalem , hynrei ki la bam ia u kpu bym pat thied hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki .

en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .
kha: Ki kyntien jong u Dabid ki la pynïoh ïa ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phah ktien sha u ban wan phai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem khrup ia ka dohnud jong ki briew baroh jong ka Judah, kumba ka dohnud jong uwei u briew; kumta ki la phah ia kane ka ktien sha u syiem: To wan phai noh ma me bad ki shakri jong me baroh .

en: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , of the Reubenites  ; and Ramoth in Gilead , of the Gadites  ; and Golan in Bashan , of the Manassites .
kha: Ïa kiba na ka jait Reuben , ka don ka shnong Beser ha kawei ka madan kaba halor lum ha ka ri shyiap ; ïa kiba na ka jait Gad , ka don ka Ramoth ha ri Gilead ; bad ïa kiba na ka jait Manasseh , ka don ka Golan ha ri Bashan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata, u Bezer ha ka ri khlaw, ha ka ri kaba jylliew, na ki Reuben bad u Ramoth ha Gilead, na ki Gadita ; bad u Golan ha Basan, na ki Manasse .

en: And he said unto them , Lodge here this night , and I will bring you word again , as the  Lord  shall speak unto me : and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam .
kha: U Balaam u ong ha ki ,  Sahmiet noh hangne , bad lashai ngan sa ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u kren ha nga .  Kumta kita ki nongïalam jong ki Moab ki la sahmiet bad u Balaam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , To leit sah hangne mynta ka miet , bad ngan wanrah biang ia phi kumba U Trai un kren ha nga: bad ki rangbah jong ka Moab ki shong bad u Balaam .

en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God : and if it first begin at us , what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God ?
kha: Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingbishar ba kan sdang , bad ki briew jong U Blei hi kin long kiba nyngkong ban shah bishar . Lada ka sdang na ngi , kumno kan kut ha kito ki bym shym ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka por ka la poi ba ka jingbishar ka dei ban sdang na ka iing U Blei: bad lada ka sdang nyngkong eh na ngi , kaei ka jingkut jong kita ki bym kohnguh ia ka gospel U Blei ?

en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and , behold , the babe wept . And she had compassion on him , and said , This is one of the Hebrews  children .
kha: Haba ka plied ïa ka , ka ïohi ïa u khunlung . Uta u khunlung u ïam , bad ka sngewsynei ïa u .  Une te u dei uwei na ki khun Hebru ,  ka la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la plie ia ka, ka la iohi ia uta u khynnah: bad, ha khmih, u babe u iam . Bad ka la sngewsynei ia u bad ka la ong: Une u long uwei na ki khun Hebru .

en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river  ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them .
kha: Ki syiem bakhlaiñbor ki la synshar hangto bad ki la synshar ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi baroh kawei , ki da lum khajna bad ki jingmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la don ki syiem kiba donbor ruh halor ka Jerusalem , kiba la synshar ia ki ri baroh kiba don shabar jong ka wah ; bad ka jingsiew khajna bad ka riti dustur .

en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me : and there are that raise up strife and contention .
kha: Balei ba me pynlong ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kaba kum kane ka jingjynjar ? Kumno me lah ban shu peit ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh bymdei ? Ka jingpynjot bad ka jinglehbor ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad ka don ka jingïaleh bad jingïakajia ha kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me pyni ia nga ia ka jingbymhok, bad pynlong ia nga ban iohi ia ka jingsngewsih ? namar ka jingsniew bad ka jingleh donbor ki don ha khmat jong nga: bad ki don kiba pynmih ia ka jingialeh bad ka jingialeh pyrshah .

en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there , that they feared not the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  sent lions among them , which slew some of them .
kha: Haba ki dang leit sdang ban shong hangta , kim shym la mane ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta u phah ïa ki sing , kiba pynïap katto katne na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ka la long ha kaba sdang jong ka jingshong jong ki hangta, ba kim tieng ia U Trai: namarkata U Trai u la phah ia ki sing hapdeng jong ki , kiba la pyniap ia ki katto katne na ki .

en: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohmap ïa kano kano ka pop bad ïa kano kano kaba sniew kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ong ha phi , Baroh ki jait pop bad ki jingkren bein kin shah map ha ki briew: hynrei ka jingkren bein ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid kan ym shah map ha ki briew .

en: And Samuel said unto him , The  Lord  hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day , and hath given it to a neighbour of thine , that is better than thou .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u la kad ïa ka hima Israel na me ha kane ka sngi , bad u la ai ïa ka ha uta u briew uba kham bha ban ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha u , U Trai u la pynkylla ia ka hima Israel na me ha kane ka sngi , bad u la ai ia ka ha u para marjan jong me uba kham bha ban ia me .

en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :
kha: Ngi la shem ïa une u briew ba u long ka jingpynwit kaba shyrkhei ; u sdang ïa ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki Jiw ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei bad u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhun kaba na Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi la shem ia une u briew u paralok uba sngewsih, bad u nongkhih jong ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki Jiw baroh ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bad u nongialam jong ka kynhun jong ki Nazarene:

en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ha nga ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki , Nga ruh ngan kylli ia phi ia kawei ka jingjia, kaba lada phi iathuh ia nga , nga ruh ngan iathuh ia phi da ka bor kaba nga leh ia kine kiei kiei .

en: And I heard a voice from heaven , as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of a great thunder : and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps :
kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , bad kum ka jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Ka sawa kum ka sur jingtem ba la tem da ki nongtem kiba tem ïa la ki duitara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur na bneng, kum ka sur jong ki um kiba bun: bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ki harper kiba iaid ryngkat bad ki harp jong ki:

en: And she took a pan , and poured them out before him  ; but he refused to eat . And Amnon said , Have out all men from me . And they went out every man from him .
kha: bad ka la shim ïa ki na u khiew shet na ka bynta jong u ban bam , hynrei um treh . U ong ,  Phah noh shabar ïa iwei pa iwei baroh  — bad baroh ki la mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la shim ia ka pan, bad ka la theh ia ki ha khmat jong u ; hynrei u la kyntait ban bam . Bad u Amnon u la ong: To mih noh na nga baroh . Ki la mih noh uwei pa uwei na u .

en: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Go ye into the city , and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water : follow him .
kha: Te U Jisu u la phah ar ngut na ki ryngkat bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit sha ka nongbah , bad uwei u briew uba kit ïa u khiew um , un ïakynduh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u phah noh arngut ki synran jong u, bad u ong ha ki, To leit shapoh shnong, bad hangta phin iakynduh ia phi u briew uba rah ia ka khiew um: bud ia u .

en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven , whiles they lie in wait : their baker sleepeth all the night  ; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire .
kha: Ho-oid , ki khluit kum ka tyndur da ki jingïasylla jong ki . Baroh shi miet , ka jingbitar jong ki ka nang ing , bad mynstep ka mih kynsan kum ki thylliej ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong ki kum ka oven, kaba ki thiah: u nongshet jong ki u thiah baroh shi miet ; mynstep ka thang kum ka ding kaba rhem .

en: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him : but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! it had been good for that man if he had not been born .
kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ba un shah leh kumta , hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ïa uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ! Kan jin da kham bha ïa uta u briew lada ym shym la kha ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: U Khun u briew u leit kumba la thoh shaphang jong u: hynrei kordit ia uta u briew da uba la shet kylla ia u Khun u briew ! ka la long kaba bha ia uta u briew lada ym shym la kha ia u .

en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .
kha: ( U  Trai  u la sdang artat ban pynïoh pat ïa ka burom jong ka Israel , kumba ka la long ha khmat ki nongshun kiba la lute ïa ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai u la pynphai noh ia ka jingbha jong u Jakob, kumba ka jingbha jong ki Israel: namar ki nongleh kam sniew ki la pynkhuid ia ki, bad ki la pynkhih ia ki tnat sohjew jong ki .

en: And all the men of Shechem gathered together , and all the house of Millo , and went , and made Abimelech king , by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem .
kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo ki ïalumlang bad leit sha u dieng Sning bakyntang ha Shekhem , ha kaba ki la thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh jong ka Shehem ki la ialum lang bad ka iing jong u Millo baroh kawei bad ki la leit bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u Abimelekh da ka madan jong u mawsiang kaba don ha Shehem .

en: And John answered him , saying , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name , and he followeth not us : and we forbad him , because he followeth not us .
kha: U Ïoannis u la ong ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh , namar um long satia ha ka kynhun jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la jubab ia u, u da ong, Ko Nonghikai, ngi la iohi ia uwei uba beh ia ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me, bad um bud ia ngi: bad ngi la kyntait ia u, namar ba um bud ia ngi .

en: If a man therefore purge himself from these , he shall be a vessel unto honour , sanctified , and meet for the master s use , and prepared unto every good work .
kha: Lada uno uno u pynkhuid ïa lade na kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew , yn pyndonkam ïa ki na ka bynta ki jingthmu kiba kyrpang , namar la pynkyntang ïa ki bad ki long kiba myntoi ïa u Kynrad jong ki , kin long kiba bit ïa ka ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam babha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u pynkhuid ia lade na kine, un long u tiar sha ka burom, u la pynkyntang bad u iakynduh ia ka jingpyndonkam jong u kynrad bad u la pynkhreh ia ka kam kaba bha baroh .

en: In those days , and at that time , will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David  ; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land .
kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jied kum u syiem ïa u nonghiarpateng uba hok na u Dabid . Uta u syiem un leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi bad ha kata ka por , ngan pynlong ia ka Branch jong ka hok ban san sha u Dabid ; bad un pyndep ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok ha ka ri .

en: But ye said , No  ; for we will flee upon horses  ; therefore shall ye flee : and , We will ride upon the swift  ; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift .
kha: Pynban , phi thmu ban lait im na ki nongshun jong phi da kaba shong ha ki kulai bastet . Phi pyrkhat ïa kaba dei — ka jinglait im ka long kaei kaba phi donkam ! Phi pyrkhat ba ki kulai jong phi ki long kiba stet bha , hynrei kito kiba beh nadien jong phi ki kham stet !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi la ong: Em; namar ngin phet noh halor ki kulai; bad: Ngin ia shong halor ka jingsma; namarkata kita kiba bud ia phi kin long kiba stet .

en: When the  Lord  thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee , whither thou goest to possess them , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their land  ;
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang leit ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka bad shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Trai U Blei jong me un ot noh ia ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong me, ha kaba me leit ban don ia ki, bad me jop ia ki, bad me shong ha ka ri jong ki;

en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority , which the Lord hath given us for edification , and not for your destruction , I should not be ashamed :
kha: Naba ngam sngewlehrain , wat lada nga la sngewsarong lehse palat shaphang ka bor kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi — ka bor ban tei ïa phi , ym ban pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga dei ban sngew sarong katto katne ka bor jong ngi, kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi na ka bynta ka jingpynroi , bad ym na ka bynta ka jingpynjot jong phi , ngam dei ban sngewlehrain:

en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
kha: Ko Trai , shano men leit ?  u Petros u la kylli ïa u .  Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta shano sha ba ngan sa leit ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  hynrei hadien men sa bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u la ong ha u, ko Trai, shano me leit ? U Jisu u la jubab ia u, La nga leit, me lah ban bud ia nga mynta ; hynrei me hadien .

en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .  And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !  U mynsiem bymkhuid u la bret ïa uta u briew sha madan ha khmat jong ki , bad u la mihnoh na u , khlem pynmynsaw ei ei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la kynthoh ia u, u da ong, To bat ia ka jingsuk jong me, bad to mih noh na u . Bad haba u ksuid u la bret ia u hapdeng , u la mih na u , bad um shym la pynmong ia u .

en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God  : and it shall become a spoil to the nations .
