kha: Ki nongtong dohkha kin pynrkhiang ïa la ki jar halor jong u , hangta ha kaba u ïeng ha ka duriaw . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki jaitbynriew kin pynjot ïa ka Tyros .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan long ka jaka na ka bynta ka jingpynphriang ia ki net hapdeng ka duriaw: namar nga la kren ia ka , ong U Trai Blei: bad kan long ka jingjot ia ki jaitbynriew .

en: And let thy name be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God over Israel : and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee .
kha: Ka nam jong me kan long kaba khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U  Trai  Nongsynshar u long U Blei halor ki Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long kaba khraw junom, da kaba ong: U Trai jong ki paid u long U Blei halor ki Israel: bad to ai ba ka iing u Dabid jong me kan long kaba skhem ha khmat jong me .

en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah , What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people , that ye have put me in prison ?
kha: Nangta nga la kylli ,  Kaei ka kam runar ba nga la leh pyrshah ïa phi lane ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi lane ïa kane ka jaitbynriew , kaba pynlong ïa phi ban thep ïa nga ha byndi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Jeremaiah u la ong ha u syiem Sedekaiah: Kaei kaba nga la pynsngewsih ia me ne ia ki shakri jong me ne pyrshah ia une u briew ba phi la set ia nga ha phatok ?

en: And it came to pass the same day , that Isaac s servants came , and told him concerning the well which they had digged , and said unto him , We have found water .
kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la wan ïathuh ha u shaphang ka pukri kaba ki la ïatih . Ki ong ,  Ngi la shem ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi, ki shakri u Isaak ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ha u shaphang kata ka thliew kaba ki la tih bad ki la ong ha u: Ngi la shem um .

en: I have sworn by myself , the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and shall not return , That unto me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall swear .
kha: Ka jingkular jong nga ka long kaba shisha , bad kan ym kylla . Nga kular shisha da baroh kaba nga long ; baroh kin wan ban dem ha khmat jong nga bad kular ba ki long hok ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la smai da lade, ka ktien ka la mih na ka shyntur jong nga ha ka hok , bad kan ym wan phai shuh , Ba ha nga kawei pa kawei ka kjat kan dem khrup , kawei pa kawei ka shyntur kan smai .

en: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess ? So whomsoever the  Lord  our God shall drive out from before us , them will we possess .
kha: Hato men dang leit ban shim biang ïa ka ? Me lah ban bat kat ïa kaba u Khemosh u blei jong me u la ai ha me . Hynrei ngi te ngin bat ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , u la ai ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me don ia kata kaba u blei jong me u ai ia me ban don ? Kumta uno uno uba U Trai U Blei jong ngi un beh noh na khmat jong ngi , ia ki ngin sa don .

en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon , shall the inhabitant of Zion say  ; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea , shall Jerusalem say .
kha: To ai ba ki briew ka Seïon kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jinglehbor halor jong ngi !  To ai ba ki briew ka Jerusalem kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la shahshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleh donbor kaba la leh ia nga bad ia ka doh jong nga ha Babilon , u nongshong shnong jong ka Seion un ong; bad ka snam jong nga ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Kaldea kan ong ka Jerusalem .

en: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .
kha: Mynta ba u Absalom u la ïap , u Adonijah , u khun jong u Dabid bad ka Haggith , u dei u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba bhabriew . U Dabid um pat ju sneng tyngeh ïa u shaphang kano kano , bad u la kwah eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa lade ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ka kynhun synran kaba don sanphew ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kpa jong u um shym la pynsngewsih ia u ha kano kano ka por da kaba ong , Balei me la leh kumta ? bad u ruh u la long u briew uba bha shibun bad ka kmie jong u ka la kha ia u hadien u Absalom .

en: For he was wiser than all men  ; than Ethan the Ezrahite , and Heman , and Chalcol , and Darda , the sons of Mahol : and his fame was in all nations round about .
kha: U long uba stad tam na ki rangbah baroh : kham stad ban ïa u Ethan u nong Esrah , bad ïa u Heman , u Kalkol , bad u Darda , ki khun jong u Mahol , bad ka nam jong u ka phriang kylleng ki ri kiba marjan baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la kham stad ban ia ki briew baroh; bad u Heman, bad u Chalcol, bad u Darda, ki khun shynrang jong u Mahol: bad ka nam jong u ka la long ha ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong .

en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .
kha: Ngi la leh bymman pyrshah ïa me bad ngim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba me la hukum . Ngim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba u Moses , u shakri jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la leh bakla shibun ia me bad ngim shym la bat ia ki hukum ne ki ain ne ki jingbishar kiba me la hukum ia u Moses jong me .

en: And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
kha: Bad wat leit pyrkhat ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka bynta u Abraham !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat pyrkhat ban ong hapoh jong phi, Ngi don u Abraham ha u kpa jong ngi: namar nga ong ha phi, ba U Blei U lah na kine ki maw ban pynkha khun ia u Abraham .

en: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .
kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Joshua ,  Jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïaleh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïeng ha kliar u lum da kaba bat ïa u diengduh ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Joshua, To jied ia ngi, bad to leit shabar, ialeh bad u Amalek: ban ieng lashai ngan ieng ha jrong jong u lum da u diengduh U Blei ha ka kti jong nga .

en: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes , and your officers , that I may speak these words in their ears , and call heaven and earth to record against them .
kha: Lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh na ki jait jong phi bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi , ba ngan ïathuh ha ki ïa kine kiei kiei ; ngan khot ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ba kin long ki sakhi jong nga pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To lum ha nga ia ki rangbah jong phi baroh bad ki rangbah jong phi, ba ngan kren ia kine ki ktien ha ki shkor jong ki , bad nga khot ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew ban thoh pyrshah ia ki .

en: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the passover unto the  Lord  thy God : for in the month of Abib the  Lord  thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night .
kha: Burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da kaba phi rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha u bnai Abib , naba dei ha kawei ka miet jong uta u bnai ba u la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia u bnai Abib , bad to sumar ia ka jingkhawai Niam sha U Trai U Blei jong me: namar ha u bnai Abib U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynmih ia me na Ijipt ha ka por miet .

en: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days , he went down unto Caesarea  ; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought .
kha: U Phestos u la sah sa phra ne shiphew sngi lem bad ki bad nangta u la leit sha Kaisaria . Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la shong ha ka kamra bishar bad u la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la sah hapdeng jong ki palat shi sngi , u la leit hiar sha Kaisaria; bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la shong ha ka jaka bishar u la hukum ia u Paul ban wanrah .

en: Cast away from you all your transgressions , whereby ye have transgressed  ; and make you a new heart and a new spirit : for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
kha: To iehnoh ïa kaba sniew baroh kaba phi leh bad pynïoh ïa lade ki jingmut bad ka dohnud kiba thymmai . Balei ma phi ki Israel phi kwah ban ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia ki jingpynkhein jong phi baroh , ha kaba phi la iaid lait ia ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ka mynsiem kaba thymmai: namar balei phin iap , ko iing Israel ?

en: And I looked , and , lo , a Lamb stood on the mount Sion , and with him an hundred forty and four thousand , having his Father s name written in their foreheads .
kha: Te nga la peit , bad la don U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng halor u lum Seïon ; lem bad u la don shi lakh sawphew saw hajar ngut ki briew kiba la don ïa ka kyrteng jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Kpa jong u ïa kaba la thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga peit, bad, ha khmih, u Khunlangbrot u la ieng ha u lum Sion, bad bad u shispah sawphew saw hajar, u la thoh ia ka kyrteng U Kpa jong u ha ki khlieh jong ki .

en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .
kha: Me long kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat kiba itynnat bad ba kah syrngiew , u dieng uba jrong katta katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u Assyria u long u diengsoh ha Lebanon uba don ki tnat kiba jrong , bad uba don ka shadem kaba jrong ; bad ka tduh jong u ka la long hapdeng ki tnat kiba jrong .

en: And Moses lifted up his hand , and with his rod he smote the rock twice : and the water came out abundantly , and the congregation drank , and their beasts also .
kha: Nangta u Moses u rah shajrong ïa u diengduh bad u la tied ar sien ïa uta u mawsiang ; te ka um kaba heh ka la mih , bad baroh ki briew lem bad ki jingri ki la ïadih .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la rah ia la ka kti bad da u diengduh jong u u la pynkhih ia u maw arsien: bad ka um ka la mih bun , bad ka jingiaseng ka la dih , bad ki mrad jong ki ruh .

en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the  Lord  straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?
kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingtim ? Hato U  Trai  u la duh noh ïa la ka jingïaishah ? Hato un da leh shisha ïa kine kiei kiei ? Hato um shym kren bha ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko me uba la jer kyrteng ia ka iing u Jakob , hato ka mynsiem U Trai ka la tyrkhong ? hato kine ki jingleh jong u ? hato ki ktien jong nga kim leh bha ia uta uba iaid beit ?

en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin s mess was five times so much as any of theirs . And they drank , and were merry with him .
kha: La sam jingbam ïa ki na ka miej u Joseph , bad ïa u Benjamin la sam san shah ban ïa uno uno na ki . Kumta keiñ ki la ïabam ïadih bad leh sngewbha bad u Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim bad phah ia ki mess ha khmat jong u: hynrei u Benjamin u la kham bun san shah ban ia uno uno na ki . Ki la dih bad ki la ia sngewbha bad u .

en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?
kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki paid Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait Israel baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki Israel ki kylli ,  Ïathuh ïa ngi , kumno kane ka kam runar ka la jia ?
translated_en_to_kha: (Mynta ki khun shynrang ki la iohsngew ba ki khun Israel ki la leit sha Mizpah . ) Nangta ki la ong ki khun Israel: Iathuh ia ngi kumno kane ka jingsniew ka la long ?

en: And the unicorns shall come down with them , and the bullocks with the bulls  ; and their land shall be soaked with blood , and their dust made fat with fatness .
kha: Ki briew kin kyllon kum ki masi kyrtong khlaw bad ki masi lyngraw , bad ka khyndew kan saw da ka snam bad yn tap da ka khleiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai kin wan hiar ryngkat bad ki, bad ki masi bad ki masi bad ka ri jong ki kin sa sngem da ka snam, bad ka dewbilat jong ki kan sa tyrkhong da ka shini .

en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .
kha: Uwei na kito kiba la ïadon lang bad U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka shkor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, uwei na ki uba don bad U Jisu u la pynkhih ia la ka kti bad u la tan ia ka waitlam jong u, bad u la shoh ia u shakri jong u rangbah lyngdoh .

en: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
kha: Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingdie ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ruh hapdeng jong ki kiba duna: namar katba ki long ki trai jaka ne ki iing kiba la die ia ki , bad ki la wanrah ia ki dor jong kiei kiei kiba la die , .

en: But the Philistines took him , and put out his eyes , and brought him down to Gaza , and bound him with fetters of brass  ; and he did grind in the prison house .
kha: Ki Philistia ki kem ïa u bad ki khlaw ïa ki khmat jong u . Ki ïalam ïa u sha Gasa , ki teh ïa u da ki kynjri rnong , bad ki pyntrei ïa u ha ka kor tylliat hapoh byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la shim ia u, bad ki la pynmih ia ki khmat jong u, bad ki la wanrah ia u sha Gaza, bad ki la teh ia u da ki jingteh nar ; bad u la ia tyngkhuh ha ka iing phatok .

en: And the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand , and with an outstretched arm , and with great terribleness , and with signs , and with wonders :
kha: Da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt . U leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad u la pynjia ïa kiei kiei kiba sngewtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la wanrah ia ngi na Ijipt da ka kti kaba khlain bad da ka kti kaba la pynkhih shabar bad da ka jingtieng kaba khraw bad da ki dak bad ki jingphylla:

en: Meddle not with them  ; for I will not give you of their land , no , not so much as a foot breadth  ; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession .
kha: Kin tieng ïa phi , hynrei phim dei ban ïaknieh jaka bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ha phi wat tang khyndiat ruh na kata ka ri jong ki . Nga la ai ïa ka Edom ha ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym iaid bad ki ; namar ngan ym ai ia phi ia ka ri jong ki, em, ym katba ka kjat ka kjat ; namar nga la ai ia u Seir u Seir ha u Iso na ka bynta ka jingdon jingem .

en: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah , and came to Samaria , and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
kha: U Menahem u khun jong u Gadi u leit na Tirsah sha Samaria , u pynïap ïa u Shallum , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Menahem u khun u Gadi u la kiew na Tirsah bad u la wan sha Samaria bad u la shoh ia u Shallum u khun u Jabesh ha Samaria bad u la pyniap ia u bad u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And their whole body , and their backs , and their hands , and their wings , and the wheels , were full of eyes round about , even the wheels that they four had .
kha: Ïa ki met , ki ingdong , ki kti , ki thapniang , bad ki shalyntem jong ki , la tap da ki khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka met jong ki baroh kawei, bad ki tyrpeng jong ki, bad ki kti jong ki, bad ki tyrpeng jong ki, ki la dap da ki khmat sawdong sawdong, wat ki tyrpeng kiba ki don saw ngut.

en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Ïano ba me pyrkhat ba me la ñiewbeiñ bad rkhiebeiñ ? Me la long uba khlem burom ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Iano me la kren bein bad kren bein ? bad pyrshah ia uba me la pynkiew ia ka sur jong me bad me la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong me sha jrong ? wat pyrshah ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel , and the stranger that sojourneth among them  ; seeing all the people were in ignorance .
kha: Te yn map ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki , namar iwei pa iwei ki la don bynta ha ka jingbakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad yn map ia ka jingiaseng baroh jong ki Israel , bad u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong ki ; haba u iohi ia ki briew baroh ki la long ha ka jingbymtip .

en: Then Tatnai , governor on this side the river , Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , according to that which Darius the king had sent , so they did speedily .
kha: Nangta u Tattenai , u lat , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki la leh thik kumba u patsha u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Lat ka jylla ha kane ka liang ka wah, u Shetharbozenai bad ki paralok jong ki, kat kum kata kaba u Darius u la phah, kumta ki la leh stet .

en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man , clothed with a garment down to the foot , and girt about the paps with a golden girdle .
kha: bad napdeng jong ki , la don uba i kum U Khun U Briew , uba kup ka jaiñkup kaba kot haduh ki kjat jong u , bad u don u panpoh ksiar sawdong ka shadem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapdeng ki hynriew tylli ki sharak uwei uba long kum u Khun u briew, uba la phong da ka jain shapoh ka kjat , bad u la tap sawdong ia ki pop da ka ryndang ksiar .

en: But and if thou marry , thou hast not sinned ; and if a virgin marry , she hath not sinned . Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh : but I spare you .
kha: Hynrei lada phin shongkurim ruh , phim shym la leh pop ; bad lada ka briew ka bym pat shongkurim ka shongkurim noh , kam shym la leh pop . Hynrei ngan jin da la kwah ban pyllait ïa phi na ki jingeh kiba man ka sngi ïa kiba kita kiba la shongkurim kin don .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me shongkurim, me khlem pop ; bad lada ka long kaba thymmai, kam shym la leh pop . Wat la katta ruh kan don ka jingeh ha ka doh: hynrei nga pyllait ia phi .

en: And he saith unto me , Write , Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb . And he saith unto me , These are the true sayings of God .
kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito ïa kiba la khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim jong U Khunlangbrot .  Bad u angel u la bynrap ,  Kine ki long ki ktien kiba shisha jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha nga , Thoh , La kyrkhu ia kito kiba la khot sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim jong u Khunlangbrot . Bad u ong ha nga , Kine ki long ki jingkren bashisha jong U Blei .

en: And it came to pass , when he was come near to enter into Egypt , that he said unto Sarai his wife , Behold now , I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon :
kha: Hamar ba un sa rung ha ri Ijipt , u ong ha ka Sarai ka tnga jong u ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba bhabriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la jan rung sha Ijipt, ba u la ong ha ka tnga jong u, Ha khmih mynta, nga tip ba me long ka kynthei kaba bha ban peit:

en: But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :
kha: Hynrei lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u apthap ïa u , bad u shoh bad pynmynsaw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , bad nangta u phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban ïoh jingïada ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u briew u shun ia u paramarjan jong u, bad u thiah ha u, bad u ieng pyrshah ia u, bad u shoh ia u haduh ba un da iap, bad u phet noh sha kawei na kine ki nongbah:

en: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Ïano me pyrkhat ba me ibeiñ bad krenbeiñ ? Me la leh bymsuidñiew ïa nga , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Iano me la kren bein bad kren bein ? bad pyrshah ia uba me la pynkiew ia ka sur jong me bad me la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong me sha jrong ? wat pyrshah ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .
kha: Nangta ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la jop ïa ki Amor ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan phai noh sha Enmishpat, kaba long u Kadesh, bad ki la leit sha ka ri Amalek baroh kawei bad ki Amorit kiba shong ha Haszontamar .

en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven  ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  kaei kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi kam dei u kpu na bneng ; dei U Kpa jong nga uba ai ha phi ïa u kpu bashisha na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, u Moses um shym la ai ia phi ia uta u kpu na bneng ; hynrei U Kpa jong nga u ai ia phi ia uta u kpu uba shisha na bneng .

en: And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U  Trai  la pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka snem kaba phra jong u syiem u Rehoboam Shishak u syiem Ijipt u la wan pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem namar ba ki la iaid pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum : We have such an high priest , who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens  ;
kha: Ka bynta kaba kongsan na kine kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kren ka long ba ngi don kum uta U Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong ka khet ba kynja blei kaba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta na kiei kiei kiba ngi la kren kane ka long ka jingpynkut: Ngi don kum uta u lyngdoh rangbah uba la buh ha ka liang kadiang jong ka khet jong ka Jingkhraw ha ki bneng ; .

en: But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem ; ka longïing kaba ïa-pait pyrshah ïa lade kan kyllon la ka jong ka jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ki, u la ong ha ki, Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la phiah pyrshah ia lade ka shah pynjot ; bad ka iing kaba la phiah pyrshah ia ka iing ka la hap .

en: And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge  ; yea , he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
kha: Hynrei namar ba u Stad saiñpyrkhat u long uba stad , u ïai hikai ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba u tip . U la pule bniah ïa ki proberb bad da kaba sngur mynsiem u da tynjuh ïa ka jingshisha jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nalor kata, namar ba u nongialap u long uba stad, u dang hikai ia ki briew ia ka jingtip ; yes, u la ai jingmut bha, bad u la wad shabar, bad u la buh ha ka rukom kaba bun ki proberb .

en: Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :
kha: Naduh mynnyngkong nga la tip lypa ïa kaei ka ban mih ; la slem bah nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynkylla ia ka jingkut naduh kaba sdang , bad naduh ki por hyndai kiei kiei ki bym pat dep , da kaba ong , Ka jingai jingmut jong nga kan ieng , bad ngan leh ia ka jingsngewbha jong nga baroh:

en: Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;
kha: Mynta , namar ba ngi don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiem , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kane ba kan jia , bad kumta ngi ai jingmut
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namar ba ngi don ka jingsumar na ka iing syiem , bad kam shym la iakynduh ia ngi ban iohi ia u syiem u bym don burom , namarkata ngi la phah bad pynskhem ia u syiem;

en: And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
kha: Ka trai duriaw ka paw tyngkreiñ bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , haba U  Trai  u kynteit ïa ki nongshun jong u , bad u kyrhuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki lynti jong ka duriaw ki la paw, la lap ia ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei, ha ka jingshah pynrem jong U Trai, ha ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa jong ki shyntur jong u .

en: But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki bneng bad ka pyrthei kiba long mynta la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban ïoh pynjot da ka ding . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka bynta ka sngi haba ïa ki briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki bneng bad ka khyndew kiba long mynta, da kajuh ka ktien la buh ha ka ding pyrshah ia ka sngi bishar bad ka jingpynjot ia ki briew ki bym riewblei .

en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out , being hastened and pressed on by the king s commandment . And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .
kha: Ha ka jinghukum u syiem , ki nongshong kulai ki kiew ha ki kulai syiem bad ki pynmareh ha ka jingstet bajur . Ïa ka hukum la pynbna paidbah ruh ha Susa , ka nongbah ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki post kiba shong halor ki mules bad ki kulai ki la mih noh, la pynkhih bad pynkhih da ka hukum jong u syiem . Bad la ai ia ka hukum ha Shushan ka iing syiem .

en: Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .
kha: Wat pat leit tat ynda nga wanrah ha me ka jingainguh bam .  U jubab ,  Ngan ap haduh ba men da wan phai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leit noh kumta, nga kyrpad ia me, haduh ba ngan da wan sha me, bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingai jong nga, bad ngan buh ia ka ha khmat jong me . Bad u la ong , Ngan sah haduh ba me wan phai biang .

en: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
kha: Bad ar ngut ki rangbah bamatlah kiba shong harud lynti ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u ïaid nangta , kumta ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, arngut ki briew kiba matlah kiba shong ha rud lynti, haba ki la iohsngew ba U Jisu u la iaid lyngba, ki la pyrta, ki da ong: To isynei ia ngi ko Trai, ko Khun u Dabid .

en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Lada kim ngeit ïa me lane kim lah pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane kan pynngeit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia lada kim ngeit ia me, lymne kin sngap ia ka sur jong ka dak kaba nyngkong , ba kin ngeit ia ka sur jong ka dak kaba hadien .

en: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .
kha: Kaba mih ka long ba u trai jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u leh ïa kaba kum kane kaba sianti ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long kiba kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam ban ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kynrad u la iaroh ia u nongap bym hok , namar u la leh da ka jingstad: namar ki khun jong kane ka pyrthei ki kham stad ha ka pateng jong ki ban ia ki khun jong ka jingshai .

en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself , and the fat of that which is torn with beasts , may be used in any other use : but ye shall in no wise eat of it .
kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jong uno uno u jait mrad uba shu ïap hi ne uba la shah pynïap ha u mradkhlaw ym dei ban bam , hynrei lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthmu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shini jong u mrad kaba iap hi, bad ka shini jong kata kaba la tyrkhong bad ki mrad, lah ban pyndonkam ha kano kano ka rukom: hynrei phin ym bam da ka jingstad na ka .

en: My righteousness is near  ; my salvation is gone forth , and mine arms shall judge the people  ; the isles shall wait upon me , and on mine arm shall they trust .
kha: Ngan wan kloi bad ngan pynim ïa ki ; ka por jong ka jingjop ka la hajan . Nga da lade hi ngan synshar halor ki jaitbynriew . Ki ri ba hajngai bah ki ap ïa nga ba ngan wan ; ki ap da ka jingkyrmen ïa nga ban pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka hok jong nga ka la jan; ka jingpynim jong nga ka la jah noh, bad ki kti jong nga kin bishar ia ki briew ; ki dulir kin ap ia nga, bad ha ka kti jong nga kin shaniah .

en: Or if there be any flesh , in the skin whereof there is a hot burning , and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot , somewhat reddish , or white  ;
kha: Haba u briew u khluit ding , bad lada ka sniehdoh ka kylla lieh ne lam byrsaw-lieh , u lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada don kano kano ka doh , ha ka sniehdoh jong ka ka don ka jingthang kaba shit , bad ka doh kaba stet kaba thang ka don ka jaka kaba lieh kaba shai bha , katto katne kaba saw , ne kaba lieh ; .

en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God , we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold , or silver , or stone , graven by art and man s device .
kha: Namar ba ngi long ki khun U Blei , ngim dei ban tharai ba ka jinglong jong u ka long kaei kaei kaba kum ka dur da ka ksiar lane rupa lane maw , ba la pynwandur da ka jingstad bad ka buit briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata kumba ngi long ki khun ki ksiew jong U Blei , ngim dei ban pyrkhat ba ka jinglong Blei ka long kum ka ksiar ne rupa ne maw , la ker da ka art bad u briew .

en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .
kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , u la ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kita , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ban sam ha u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ia ki san tylli ki kpu bad ki ar tylli ki dohkha, bad u la kyrkhu ia ki, bad u la bret bad u la ai ha ki synran ban buh ha khmat u paidbah .

en: And they said , It is false  ; tell us now . And he said , Thus and thus spake he to me , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel .
kha: Em , ngim tip !  ki la jubab .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei ba u ong !   U ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ka Israel .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ka long kaba bakla shuh shuh. Bad u la ong, Kumta bad kumta u la kren ia nga, da kaba ong: Kumta u ong U Trai, nga la pynsleh ia me syiem halor ki Israel .

en: Since all husbands and wives are imperfect , learning to forgive is a key to happiness in marriage . —Read Ephesians 4 :31 , 32  ; 5 :22-25 , 33  ; 1 Peter 3 :7 .
kha: Namarba ki long ki bym janai , ki dei ban nang ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei , kane ka long kaba donkam khnang ba kin ïoh jingkmen .—Pule Ephesos 4 :31 , 32 ; 5 :22-25 , 33 ; 1 Petros 3 :7 .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba baroh ki tnga bad ki tnga ki long ki bym janai, ka jingpule ban map ka long u shabi jong ka jingkmen ha ka jingshongkha . Pule Ephesos 4 :31, 32 ; 5 :22-25, 33 ; 1 Petros 3:7.

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u ong :  Phim don hok ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ki khun jong nga lane ban ïathuh ïa nga kaei ba nga dei ban leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Uba khuid jong ki Israel bad u Nongshna jong u: To kylli ia nga ia kiei kiei ki ban sa wan shaphang ki khun shynrang jong nga bad shaphang ka kam jong ki kti jong nga phi hukum ia nga .

en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingshah lehrain jong pha ; baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u shipai u ban halor uwei pat , bad baroh ar ngut ki kyllon ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la iohsngew ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong me, bad ka jingpyrta jong me ka la pyndap ia ka ri: namar u riewshlur u la ia tyngkhuh bad u riewshlur , bad ki la hap lang baroh arngut .

en: And they found written in the law which the  Lord  had commanded by Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :
kha: Ki shem ha ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  u la ai lyngba u Moses , ba ka la hukum ïa ki Israel ban shong ban sah ha ki jakarieh bashipor ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shem ba la thoh ha ka hukum kaba U Trai u la hukum da u Moses , ba ki khun Israel kin shong ha ki ïingjaiñ ha ka jingkhawai jong u bnai kaba hynriew:

en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .
kha: Ïa kine ki jingkular baroh la pynlong na ka bynta jong ngi , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba pyntngit ïa ka met bad mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba don namarkata ia kine ki jingkular , baieit eh , to ngin pynkhuid ia lade na ka jingjakhlia baroh jong ka doh bad ka mynsiem , da kaba pynjanai ia ka jingkhuid ha ka jingtieng ia U Blei .

en: Who are Israelites ; to whom pertaineth the adoption , and the glory , and the covenants , and the giving of the law , and the service of God , and the promises ;
kha: Ki long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la pynlong ki khun jong u ïa ki bad u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u ha ki ; u la pynlong ki jutang bad ki bad u la ai ïa ki ka Hukum ; ki don ka jingmane bashisha ; ki la ïoh ïa ki jingkular U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei ki Israel; ha kiba ka long ka jingpdiang, bad ka burom, bad ki jutang , bad ka jingai ia ka hukum bad ka jingshakri U Blei;

en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and gather his wheat into the garner  ; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire .
kha: U don la ka byrsha pynher stait ban shoh ïa u kew baroh . Un lumlang ïa u kew ha ka thiar jong u , hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongkyrshan jong u u don ha ka kti jong u , bad un pynkhuid bha ia ka mala jong u , bad un lum ia u kew jong u ha ka jaka lum ; hynrei un thang ia u sohjew da ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynkhih .

en: Wherefore the king said unto me , Why is thy countenance sad , seeing thou art not sick ? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart . Then I was very sore afraid ,
kha: kumta u ong ,  Balei ba me imat sngewsih ? Mem shym pang , ka lah ban long ba me don jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u syiem u la ong ha nga: Balei ka khmat jong me ka sngewsih haba me iohi ba me pang ? kane kam long ei ei hynrei tang ka jingsngewsih . Nangta nga la tieng shibun ,

en: And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba u ïathiah bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u don ka kynthei kaba kyrteng u Rizpah: bad u Ishiioshet u la ong ha u Abner: Balei me leit sha u kpa jong nga ?

en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka lad ban pynïap noh ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar uta u paidbah baroh u la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la iohsngew ia kata, bad ki la wad kumno kin pynjot ia u: namar ki la tieng ia u , namar ki briew baroh ki la lyngngoh ia ka jinghikai jong u .

en: Behold , ye fast for strife and debate , and to smite with the fist of wickedness : ye shall not fast as ye do this day , to make your voice to be heard on high .
kha: Ka jingshah jingit jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban lehbor , bad phi ïakajia bad ïashoh . Phi pyrkhat ba kane ka rukom jingshah jingit kan pynlong ïa nga ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, phi ia stet na ka bynta ka jingialeh bad ka jingiakren, bad ban sngap jar ia ka jingsniew: phin ym ia stet kumba phi leh mynta ka sngi, ban pynlong ia ka sur jong phi ban iohsngew ha jrong .

en: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God , wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat ?
kha: Ka jingim jong phi ka dei ban long kaba khuid bad ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei , katba phi dang ap khmih ïa ka Sngi jong U Blei bad phi leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynlong ïa ka ba kan wan kloi — ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ki bneng yn thang duh noh bad yn pynjot , bad ïa ki metbneng yn sa pynum ha ka jingkhluit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingwad bad kyrkieh ia ka jingwan jong ka sngi U Blei , ha kaba ki bneng kin sa jah noh bad ki element kin sa rkhiang da ka jingshit kaba jur ?

en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the tenth month , came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem , and they besieged it .
kha: Ha u bnai ba-shiphew jong ka snem bakhyndai ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynniew jong u syiem Judah, ha ka shi bnai, u Nebuchassar u syiem Babilon bad ki shipai jong u baroh ki la wan pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem .

en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the plague be turned into white  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .
kha: Lada kata ka prum ka la kylla lieh , uta u briew u long uba khuid , bad uta u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un iohi ia u: bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam ka kylla lieh ; te u lyngdoh un pynbna ba u long uba khuid uba don ka khlam: u long uba khuid .

en: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation , and the altar : I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons , to minister to me in the priest s office .
kha: Ngan pynlong khuid ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa kata ka duwan , bad ngan pynkyrpang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkyntang ia ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, bad ka almari: Ngan pynkyntang ruh ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, ban shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone , and timber for couplings , and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed .
kha: bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki misteri dieng bad ki nongtei ban thied maw bad dieng sawdong ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei pynbha ïa ki ïing kiba ki syiem ka Judah ki la ieh ba kin pyut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ha ki nongshna bad ki nongtei ki la ai ia ka, ban thied ia u maw ba la ot, bad ki dieng na ka bynta ki jingpyniasoh , bad ban pynkhih ia ki iing kiba ki syiem Judah ki la pynjot .

en: Now I beseech you , brethren , for the Lord Jesus Christ s sake , and for the love of the Spirit , that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me ;
kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi bad da ka jingieit kaba U Mynsiem u ai : To ïasoh bad nga ha ka jingduwai shitrhem sha U Blei na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit na ka bynta U Trai Jisu Khrist bad na ka bynta ka jingieit U Mynsiem ba phi ialeh lang bad nga ha ki jingduwai jong phi ha U Blei na ka bynta jong nga;

en: And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,
kha: Kiba sah jong ki Lebi , ka kur Merari , ka la ïohpdiang na ka jaka jong ka jait Sebulun saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Jokneam , ka Kartah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki longiing jong ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Merari, kiwei pat ki Lebi, na ka jaitbynriew Sebulun, u Jokneam bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka, bad u Karta bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ka .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God  to Tyre  ; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall , when the wounded cry , when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee ?
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u don ïa kane ban ong ïa ka nongbah Tyros :  Haba la jop ïa pha , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki rud duriaw kin sngewtriem ha ka jinglynñiar jong kito kiba shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u ong ha Tyros ; Hato ki dulir kin ym khih ha ka sur jong ka jinghap jong me , haba u nongmynsaw u iam , haba ka jingpyniap ka long hapdeng jong me ?

en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
kha: da kaba siewdor ïa uwei uwei san shekel ka rupa kat kum ka jingthew kaba buh ryntih ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba la khein ia ki longiing jong u Meri , kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la khein kat kum ka ktien U Trai da ka kti u Moses .

en: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .
kha: Tang u briew uba stad u tip aïu kiei kiei ki kit jingmut shisha . Ka jingstad ka pynlong ïa u ban phuh samrkhie bad ka pynjah ïa ka jingnoh sngewsih ka durkhmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba long kum u briew uba stad ? bad mano ba tip ia ka jingbatai ia kaei kaei ? ka jingstad jong u briew ka pynlong ia ka khmat jong u ban shai , bad ka jingshlur jong ka khmat jong u kan kylla .

en: Though thou , Israel , play the harlot , yet let not Judah offend  ; and come not ye unto Gilgal , neither go ye up to Beth–aven , nor swear , The  Lord  liveth .
kha: Wat lada phi ki briew ka Israel phim ïaineh ha nga , ai ba ki Judah kin ym ngop ha kijuh ki jingleh pop . Wat leit mane sha Gilgal lane sha Bethaben , lane pynlong ki jingïateh kular ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la me, ko Israel, me leh ia ka kam sniew, hynrei wat ai ba u Judah un sngewsih; bad wat wan sha Gilgal, lymne leit shaneng sha Betaven, lymne smai, U Trai u im .

en: And the  Lord  commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the  Lord  our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh bad ban tiengburom ïa u , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi ba un ri pynim ïa ngi kumba ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la hukum ia ngi ban leh ia kine ki ain baroh, ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi, na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi man ka por, ba un pynim ia ngi kumba ka long ha kane ka sngi .

en: Then said she , Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .
kha: Ka Naomi ka ong ha ka ,  Ruth , ïaishah mynta , tad haduh ba phin da ïohi kumno kane baroh kan sa long . U Boas un ym shongthait mynta ka sngi tad haduh ba un da pyndep ïa kane ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ong: To shong, ko khun jong nga, haduh ba phin da tip kumno ka kam kan hap: namar uta u briew un ym shongthait , haduh ba un da pyndep ia kata ka sngi .

en: And the Sabeans fell upon them , and took them away  ; yea , they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
kha: Kynsan ki nong Sabia ki wan tur bad tuh ïa ki baroh . Ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei na ki shakri jong phi lait sa tang ïa nga . Tang ma nga uba la lait phet ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongdie ki la hap halor jong ki, bad ki la shim noh ia ki ; yea , ki la pyniap ia ki shakri da ka tduh jong ka waitlam ; bad nga la lait im tang marwei ban iathuh ia me .

en: And they brought every man his present , vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and raiment , harness , and spices , horses , and mules , a rate year by year .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki u wanrah ki jingai sngewbha ïa u Solomon — ki tiar kiba da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki barandi , ki tiar thma , ki musla , ki kulai , bad ki khashor . Kane ka ïai bteng na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia uwei pa uwei u mar jong u, ki tiar rupa bad ki tiar ksiar bad ki jain rong saw bad ki jingbam ba bang .

en: For I will lay the land most desolate , and the pomp of her strength shall cease  ; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate , that none shall pass through .
kha: Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , bad ka bor kaba ki ju sngewsarong katta katta kan sa kut noh . Ki lumbah ka Israel kin long khlaw kynjah ba ym don uba nud ban leit jingleit lyngba jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan buh ia ka ri kaba la jot tam, bad ka jingkhih jong ka bor jong ka kan sangeh noh; bad ki lum Israel kin sa jah noh , ba ym don ba iaid lyngba .

en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days , saith the Lord , I will put my laws into their hearts , and in their minds will I write them  ;
kha: Kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki , ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga hapoh ki dohnud jong ki bad thoh ïa ki ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jutang kaba ngan leh bad ki hadien kita ki sngi , ong U Trai , ngan buh ia ki ain jong nga ha ki dohnud jong ki bad ha ka jingmut jong ki ngan thoh ia ki;

en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth  ; because his sons made themselves vile , and he restrained them not .
kha: Nga lah da ïathuh ha u ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka ïing jong u junom , namar ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kren sniew pyrshah ïa nga . U Eli u tip ba ki leh kumne hynrei bad um shym la khang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la ong ia u ba ngan bishar ia ka iing jong u junom na ka bynta ka jingbymhok kaba u tip ; namar ki khun jong u ki la leh bein ia lade , bad um shym la khang ia ki .

en: He answered and said , Lo , I see four men loose , walking in the midst of the fire , and they have no hurt  ; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God .
kha: Te balei ba nga ïohi saw ngut ki rangbah kiba ïaid ha ka ding ?  u la kylli .  Ïa ki ym shym la khum , bad kim shym pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingmynsaw — bad uba saw u i kum u angel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong: Lo , nga iohi saw ngut ki briew kiba lait im, kiba iaid hapdeng ka ding , bad kim don jingmynsaw ; bad ka dur jong uba saw ka long kum U Khun U Blei .

en: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad nga la bynrap ,  To shahshkor , ko Hananaïah ! U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngeit ïa ka lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la ong ha u nongiathuhlypa, To sngap mynta, Hananiah U Trai um shym la phah ia me ; hynrei me pynlong ia une u briew ban shaniah ha ka jinglamler .

en: Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .
kha: Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa kum kane ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa U  Trai  ha kaba leh ïa kane , u khun jong phi un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba da kane ka kam me la ai lad shibun ia ki nongshun U Trai ban kren bein ia me, uta u khun ruh uba la kha ha me un iap shisha .

en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully : over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler , and Shimei his brother was the next .
kha: bad ki buh ïa ki jingai baroh bad kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hangta ban shngain . Ki thung ïa u Lebi uba kyrteng u Konanaïah ban peit bad ki pynlong ïa u para jong u , u Shimei kum u nongïarap lem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia ki jingainguh bad ki shiphew bad ki jingbam ba la aiti da ka jingshaniah: halor kaba u Lebi u la long u nongsynshar , bad u Shimei u hynmen jong u u long uba hadien .

en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho , nor the inhabitants of Zidon , nor of Ahlab , nor of Achzib , nor of Helbah , nor of Aphik , nor of Rehob :
kha: Ki jait Asher kim shym la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Akko , Sidon , Ahlab , Akhsib , Helbah , Aphek , bad Rehob .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Asher um shym la beh ia ki nongshong shnong jong u Accho, ne ia ki nongshong shnong jong u Ahlab, ne jong u Achzib, ne jong u Helbah, ne jong u Aphik, ne jong u Rehob:

en: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts , and they had thirty cities , which are called Havoth–jair unto this day , which are in the land of Gilead .
kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang kiba shong halor ki laiphew tylli ki kada . Ki don laiphew tylli ki nongbah ha ka ri Gilead , ïa kiba la dang khot ki nongrit u Jair .
translated_en_to_kha: U don laiphew ngut ki khun shynrang kiba shong ha ki laiphew tylli ki jaka ri jingri, bad ki don laiphew tylli ki shnong kiba la khot u Habothjair haduh kine ki sngi, kiba don ha ka ri Gilead .

en: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .
kha: Kumba ka leilieh ka thaba na shiliang sha shiliang jong ka sahit bneng bad ka pynshai ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , kumta un long U Khun U Briew ha ka sngi jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka jingshai kaba shai na kawei ka bynta hapoh bneng, ka shai sha kawei pat ka bynta hapoh bneng; kumta ruh U Khun u briew un long ha ka sngi jong u .

en: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock , and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger , and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar .
kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw , bad tah ïa ka da ka shynriah ti jong me ha ki reng jong kata ka duwan . Nangta , theh ïa ka snam kaba sah ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka snam jong u masi bad men buh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka almari da ka kti jong me bad theh ia ka snam baroh hajan ka tduh jong ka almari .

en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her ,  O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt .  And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ka ,  Pha long ka briew kaba khraw ka jingngeit ! Ïa kaei kaba pha kwah yn leh na ka bynta jong pha .  Bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa ka khun jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka, Ko kynthei, ka long kaba khraw ha me: to long ha me kumba me mon . Bad ka khun jong ka ka la long kaba pura naduh kata hi ka kynta .

en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .
kha: Nga la jied ïa me ha shuwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa me , nga la jied ïa me ban long u nongïathuhlypa sha ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ba ngan thaw ia me ha ka kpoh nga la ithuh ia me; bad shuwa ba me wan mih na ka kpoh nga la pynkyntang ia me, bad nga la buh ia me u nongiathuhlypa ha ki jaitbynriew .

en: So when even was come , the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward , Call the labourers , and give them their hire , beginning from the last unto the first .
kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u trai u la bthah ïa la u sordar , ‘ To khot ïa ki nongtrei bad siew ïa ka bainong jong ki , sdang na kito kiba la shah khot bylla khatduh bad pynkut ha kito kiba la shah khot bylla nyngkong .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ynda la poi ka por mynstep, u trai jong ka kper sohjew u ong ha u nongap jong u, Khot ia ki nongtrei bad ai ia ki ia ka bainong jong ki, naduh kaba khatduh haduh kaba nyngkong .

en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .
kha: Khie leit sha ki dkhot jong ka kur Rekhab bad ïakren bad ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha kawei na ki kamra ha ka Templ bad tyrwa waiñ ïa ki khyndiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha ka iing jong ki Rehabit bad kren ia ki bad wanrah ia ki shapoh ka iing U Trai, sha kawei na ki kamra bad ai wain ia ki ban dih .

en: But he was wounded for our transgressions , he was bruised for our iniquities : the chastisement of our peace was upon him  ; and with his stripes we are healed .
kha: Hynrei namar ki pop jong ngi ïa u la pynmong , la sympat namar ka jingbymman kaba ngi la leh . La pynkhiah ïa ngi da ka jingpynshitom kaba u la shah , la pynkhiah ïa ngi da ki jingsympat kiba u la ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la mynsaw namar ki jingpynkhein jong ngi, u la shah pynmong namar ki jingbymhok jong ngi: ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingsuk jong ngi ka la long halor jong u ; bad da ki jingmong jong u ngi la koit .

en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd : he shall gather the lambs with his arm , and carry them in his bosom , and shall gently lead those that are with young .
kha: Un sumar ïa ka kynhun jong u kum u nongaplangbrot ; un lumlang ïa ki khunlangbrot bad un rah ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong u ; un ïalam jai jai ïa ki kmie jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Un ai bam ia ki langbrot jong u kum u nongap langbrot: un lum ia ki khun langbrot da ka kti jong u, bad un rah ia ki ha ka kpoh jong u, bad un ialam da kaba jem ia kito kiba don ki khun .

en: Saying unto them ,  Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .
kha: Khie leit sha ka nongrit kaba hangta ha khmat jong phi , bad shisyndon phin shem ïa ka kada kaba la teh lem bad u khun kada hajan jong ka . Loit noh ïa ki bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong ha ki , Leit shapoh shnong pyrshah ia phi, bad mardor phin sa shem ia u kada ba la teh bad u khun masi bad ka: pyllait noh ia ki, bad wanrah ia ki sha nga .

en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former , saith the  Lord  of hosts : and in this place will I give peace , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ka Templ kaba bathymmai kan kham iphuh ban ïa kaba rim , bad hangta ngan ai ha ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingsuk .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom jong kane ka iing kaba hadien kan kham khraw ban ia kaba nyngkong: bad ha kane ka jaka ngan ai jingsuk , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued after the children of Israel : and the children of Israel went out with an high hand .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad une u la beh kthong ïa ki Israel , kiba la mihnoh da ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt , bad u la beh ia ki khun Israel: bad ki khun Israel ki la mih noh da ka kti kaba jrong .

en: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah , If I declare it unto thee , wilt thou not surely put me to death ? and if I give thee counsel , wilt thou not hearken unto me ?
kha: Nga la jubab ,  Lada nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha , phin sa pynïap ïa nga , bad lada nga ai jingmut ïa phi , phin ym shahshkor satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la ong ha u Sedekaiah, lada nga pynbna ia ka ha me , hato phin ym pyniap ia nga ? bad lada nga ai jingmut ia me , hato phin ym sngap ia nga ?

en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob , and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains : and mine elect shall inherit it , and my servants shall dwell there .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki khun Israel kiba dei na ka jait Judah , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong nga kaba ha ki lumbah . Ki briew ba la jied jong nga , kiba shakri ïa nga , kin shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih ia u symbai na u Jakob bad na Judah u nongioh pateng ia ki lum jong nga: bad ki jong nga kin hiar pateng ia ka, bad ki shakri jong nga kin shong hangta .

en: And the angel answering said unto him , I am Gabriel , that stand in the presence of God  ; and am sent to speak unto thee , and to shew thee these glad tidings .
kha: Nga long u Gabriel ,  u angel u la jubab .  Nga ïeng ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban kren ha me bad ïathuh ha me ïa kane ka khubor babha .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la jubab ha u, nga long u Gabriel, uba ieng ha khmat U Blei; bad la phah ia nga ban kren ha me, bad ban pyni ia me ia kine ki khubor kiba kmen .

en: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet , and his armourbearer after him : and they fell before Jonathan  ; and his armourbearer slew after him .
kha: U Jonathan u kiew shajrong na ka khim da kaba par da ki kti bad khohsiew , bad u samla u la bud ïa u . U Jonathan u la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad u pynkyllon ïa ki , bad u samla u la pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la kiew halor ki kti jong u bad halor ki kjat jong u, bad u nongrah tiar jong u hadien jong u: bad ki la hap ha khmat u Jonathan; bad u nongrah tiar jong u u la iaid hadien jong u .

en: And saying , Alas , alas , that great city , that was clothed in fine linen , and purple , and scarlet , and decked with gold , and precious stones , and pearls !
kha: Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka la ju riam ïa lade da ki jaiñ linen , kiba sawbthuh , bad kiba saw hain hain , bad ka kup ïa lade da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Alas, kata ka nongbah kaba khraw, kaba la phong da ka jain kaba bha, bad kaba saw bad kaba saw bad kaba la pynitynnad da ki maw ksiar bad ki mawkordor bad ki mawkordor !

en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :
kha: Hynrei u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki riewrangbah bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba la ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la iehnoh ia ka jingmut jong ki rangbah kiba ki la ai ha u bad u la iamir jingmut bad ki samla kiba la san bad u bad kiba la ieng ha khmat jong u:

en: And Samuel said , When thou wast little in thine own sight , wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel , and the  Lord  anointed thee king over Israel ?
kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Wat la phi ñiew ïa lade ba phim long ei ei , phi dei u nongïalam jong ki jait Israel . U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong: Haba me dang rit ha la ka jong ka khmat , hato phim shym la pynlong ia me u khlieh jong ki jait Israel bad U Trai u la pynsleh ia me u syiem halor ki Israel ?

en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpyrta bajam ,   Eli , Eli , lema Sabakhthani ?  kaba mut  U Blei jong nga , U Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba hynniew kynta u Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u la ong, Eli, u lama sabachthani ? kata ka mut ban ong: Ko Blei jong nga, ko Blei jong nga, balei me la iehnoh ia nga ?

en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
kha: Katno me long uba khraw ; A  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ym don uwei pat uba kum ma me , ngi la ju tip ba dei tang ma me hi uba long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata me long uba khraw, ko Trai Blei: namar ym don kum ma me, lymne ym don Blei nalor jong me, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la iohsngew da ki shkor jong ngi .

en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by his holiness , that , lo , the days shall come upon you , that he will take you away with hooks , and your posterity with fishhooks .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u long uba khuid , u la kular ,  Ki sngi kin poi haba kin ring noh ïa phi da ki bnoh ; kawei pa kawei na phi kan long kum ka dohkha ba la bnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei u la smai da ka jingkhuid jong u, ba, ha khmih, ki sngi kin wan ha phi, ba un weng noh ia phi da ki hook bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi da ki dohkha .

en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .
kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , pynban , kim mon ban ngeit ba une u briew u la long uba matlah bad mynta u la lah ban imat pat , tad ynda ki la khot ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u bad kylli na ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Jiw kim ngeit shaphang jong u , ba u la matlah bad u la ioh ia ka jingpeit jong u haduh ba kin da khot ia ki kmie ki kpa jong uta uba la ioh ia ka jingpeit jong u .

en: But the angel said unto him , Fear not , Zacharias : for thy prayer is heard  ; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son , and thou shalt call his name John .
kha: Hynrei u angel u la ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Sekharaïah ! U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad ka Elisabeth ka tnga jong me kan kha u khun ïa me . Men kyrteng ïa u , u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u angel u la ong ha u, Wat tieng, ko Sakharaiah: namar ka jingduwai jong me ka la iohsngew; bad ka tnga jong me ka Elisabeth kan kha ia me khun shynrang, bad me dei ban khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u loannis .

en: And he called his name Noah , saying , This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands , because of the ground which the  Lord  hath cursed .
kha: bad u ong ,  Na ka khyndew ha kaba U  Trai  u la buh ka jingtim , une u khunlung un wallam ha ngi ka jingpyntngen na baroh ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi ;  kumta u la kyrteng ïa u , u Noah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Noah, u da ong: Kane kajuh kan pyntngen ia ngi shaphang ka jingtrei bad ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi, namar ka khyndew kaba U Trai u la tim .

en: They shall run like mighty men  ; they shall climb the wall like men of war  ; and they shall march every one on his ways , and they shall not break their ranks :
kha: Ki tur ïaleh kum ki khla-ka-wait ; ki kiew ïa ki kynroh kum ki shipai . Ki baroh ki ïatur beit sha khmat bad kim phai sha kadiang ne kamon
translated_en_to_kha: Kin mareh kum ki briew kiba khlain bor ; kin kiew ia ka kynroh kum ki briew kiba ialeh thma bad kin iaid uwei pa uwei ha la ki lynti , bad kin ym pynpra ia ki lain jong ki:

en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .
kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jain jingshakri ban leh ha ka jaka bakhuid , bad ki jain kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ki jain jong u , ban shakri ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?
kha: To shahshkor , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! U Blei u la jied ïa ki briew kiba duk ha kane ka pyrthei ban long kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ban kam kynti ïa ka hima kaba u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ko para baieit jong nga , Hato U Blei um shym la jied ia kiba duk jong kane ka pyrthei kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ki nongioh pateng ia ka hima kaba u la kular ha ki kiba ieit ia u ?

en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace , when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , then shall the prophet be known , that the  Lord  hath truly sent him .
kha: Hynrei ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba ïathuh lypa ïa ka jingsuk lah ban ithuh ïa u kum u nongïathuhlypa uba U  Trai  u la phah shisha haba ki jingïathuhlypa jong uta u nongïathuhlypa kin urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongiathuhlypa uba iathuhlypa ia ka jingsuk, haba ka ktien jong u nongiathuhlypa kan jia , nangta yn sa tip ia u nongiathuhlypa , ba U Trai u la phah shisha ia u .

en: And he said unto them ,  Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but unto them that are without , all these things are done in parables :
kha: Ha phi la ai ïa ka jingmaïan jong ka Hima U Blei ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Hynrei kiwei pat , kiba long shabar , ki ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh lyngba ki pharshi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki: Ha phi la ai ban tip ia ka jingmaham jong ka hima U Blei: hynrei ha kito kiba shabar , ia kine kiei kiei baroh la leh ha ki pharshi:

en: Again , he limiteth a certain day , saying in David , To day , after so long a time  ; as it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts .
kha: Ïa kane la pyn-i lyngba ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la buh ïa kawei pat ka sngi , ïa kaba la khot  Ha kane ka sngi .  Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Dabid ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ïa kaba la lah kdew :  Lada phin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , u buh pud ia kawei ka sngi, da kaba ong ha u Dabid , Ha ka sngi , hadien ka por kaba jrong; kumba la ong: Ha ka sngi lada phin iohsngew ia ka sur jong u , wat pynkhlain ia ki dohnud jong phi .

en: For , behold , the darkness shall cover the earth , and gross darkness the people : but the  Lord  shall arise upon thee , and his glory shall be seen upon thee .
kha: Ïa kiwei pat ki ri yn tap da ka jingdum , hynrei ha phi ka jingshai U  Trai  ka tyngshaiñ ; ka jingphyrnai ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan long bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ka jingdum kan tap ia ka khyndew, bad ka jingdum kaba jur ia ki briew: hynrei U Trai un mih halor jong me, bad ka burom jong u kan sa paw halor jong me .

en: So the Philistines were subdued , and they came no more into the coast of Israel : and the hand of the  Lord  was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel .
kha: Kumta ki Philistia ki la shahjop , bad U  Trai  u la khanglad ïa ki na kaba jop ïa ka ri Israel katba u Samuel u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki Philistia ki la shah pyndem shuh ha ki rud duriaw Israel: bad ka kti U Trai ka la long pyrshah ia ki Philistia baroh ki sngi u Samuel .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land , as I have punished the king of Assyria .
kha: Namar kane , ma nga U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad ïa ka ri jong u , kumba nga la pynshitom ïa u patsha ka Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan pynshitom ia u syiem Babilon bad ka ri jong u kumba nga la pynshitom ia u syiem Assyria .

en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the  Lord .
kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka lah ban kiew sha suiñbneng bad tei ka kut baskhem hangta , ngan dang ïai phah hi ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka dei ban kiew sha bneng bad wat la ka dei ban pynskhem ia ka jingjrong jong ka bor jong ka, hynrei na nga ki nongpynjot kin wan sha ka , ong U Trai .

en: And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .
kha: ha kaba la don u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang . Katto katne ki briew hangta kiba la kwah ban mudui ïa U Jisu ha ka jingleh bakla , kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hato ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Aiñ jong ngi ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la don uwei u briew uba la tyrkhong ka kti jong u . Ki la kylli ia u, ki da ong: Hato ka long kaba dei ban pynkoit ha ka sngi Sabha ? ba kin kynnoh ia u .

en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .
kha: Ka jingïasoh jong nga bad U Trai Jisu ka pynlong thikna ïa nga ba ym don ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ; hynrei lada u briew u ngeit ba katto katne ka jingbam ka long ka bymkhuid , te ka long bymkhuid ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip , bad nga la shah pynbor ha U Trai Jisu , ba ym don ei ei kaba jakhlia hi: hynrei ha uta uba khein ia kaei kaei kaba jakhlia, ha u ka long kaba jakhlia .

en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold : three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
kha: bad laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba lai kilo . U phah buh ïa ki baroh ha ka Kamra Heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lai spah tylli ki shipai ki la pynlong ia u da ka ksiar ba la shoh: lai spah Shekel ka ksiar ka la leit sha kawei ka shipai . Bad u syiem u la buh ia ki ha ka iing jong ka khlaw Lebanon .

en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you , and Mark , sister s son to Barnabas , ( touching whom ye received commandments : if he come unto you , receive him ; )
kha: U Aristarkhos , uba ha byndi lem bad nga , u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , bad kumta ruh u Markos , u bakha jong u Barnabas . ( Phi la da ïohpdiang lypa ïa ki jingbthah ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u Markos lada u wan sha phi . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Aristarkhos u para nongshah set jong nga u ai khublei ia phi, bad u Mark, u khun para para ha u Barnabas, (u ktah ia uba phi la ioh ia ki hukum: lada u wan sha phi, to pdiang ia u; )

en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Blessed art thou , Simon Bar–jona : for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee , but my Father which is in heaven .
kha: Kaba bha ïa me , ko Simon u khun jong u Jonah !  la jubab U Jisu .  Naba kane ka jingshisha kam shym la wan ha me na uno uno u briew , hynrei la ai ïa ka ha me beit beit da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, "Ko la kyrkhu ia me, ko Simon Barjona: namar ka doh bad ka snam kam shym la pynpaw ia ka ha me, hynrei U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng .

en: And Elijah took his mantle , and wrapped it together , and smote the waters , and they were divided hither and thither , so that they two went over on dry ground .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , u kli ïa ka , bad u tied ïa ka um da ka ; ka um ka la kad arliang , bad ma u lem bad u Elisha ki la jam sha shiliang ha ka dewryngkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la shim ia ka jainkup jong u, bad u la tap ia ka, bad u la pynkhih ia ki um, bad ki la iakhlad noh hangne hangta, haduh ba ki arngut ki la leit sha jrong ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang .

en: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city , and that the smoke of the city ascended , then they turned again , and slew the men of Ai .
kha: Haba u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki ïohi ba kita kiwei pat ki la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah bad ba ka la pluh , ki phai kylla bad ki sdang pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong ka Ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Joshua bad ki Israel baroh ki la iohi ba ka shnong ka la kiew bad ba ka tdem jong ka shnong ka la kiew , nangta ki la phai biang bad ki la pyniap ia ki briew jong ka Ai .

en: And he said , Hear now my words : If there be a prophet among you , I the  Lord  will make myself known unto him in a vision , and will speak unto him in a dream .
kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Mynta sngap aïu ngan ong ! Haba don ki nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , nga pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ka jingïohipaw bad nga kren ha ki ha ki jingphohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: To sngap mynta ia ki ktien jong nga: Lada don u nongiathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , nga U Trai ngan pynpaw ia lade ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad ngan kren ha u ha ka jingphohsniew .

en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee ? wherefore camest thou not unto me ? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour ?
kha: U Balak u ong ha u ,  Balei phim wan mynba nga la phah khot ïa phi ha kaba nyngkong ? Phi tharai ngam lah ban ai bainong kaba biang ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la ong ha u Balaam, Hato ngam shym la phah shisha sha me ban khot ia me ? namar kata phim wan sha nga ? hato ngam lah shisha ban kyntiew ia me ban burom ?

en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten , the cankerworm , and the caterpiller , and the palmerworm , my great army which I sent among you .
kha: Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa kaei kaba phi la duh noh ha ki snem mynba ki kynhun jong ki puit ki la bam ïa ki jingthung phi . Dei ma nga uba la phah ïa kane ka kynhun pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynphai biang ia phi ia ki snem ba u khnai u la bam, ia u khniang bad u khniang bad u khniang, u khniang uba khraw jong nga uba nga la phah hapdeng jong phi .

en: After this I will return , and will build again the tabernacle of David , which is fallen down  ; and I will build again the ruins thereof , and I will set it up :
kha: ‘ Hadien kane ngan wan phai pat , ong U Trai , bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka hima jong u Dabid . Ngan tei pat ïa kaba la jot jong ka bad ngan pynkhlaiñ pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ngan wan phai biang , bad ngan tei pat ia ka iing u Dabid kaba la hap ; bad ngan tei pat ia ki jingjot jong ka , bad ngan buh ia ka:

en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;
kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Kumta te phin lah ban jam sha shiliang wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin sumar ia ki hukum baroh kiba nga hukum ia phi ha kane ka sngi, ba phin long kiba khlain bad leit rung bad ioh ia ka ri, ha kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka;

en: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy , they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius , a centurion of Augustus  band .
kha: Ynda la ïakut ba ngi dei ban leit da ka lieng sha Italy , ki la aiti ïa u Paul bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki koidi ha u Julius , u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka pyrton shipai ka Hima Rom kaba la khot  Ka Pyrton shipai jong u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la kut jingmut ba ngin leit sha Italy , ki la pynpoi ia u Paul bad katto katne kiwei pat ki koidi sha uwei uba kyrteng u Julius , u rangbah jong u Augustus band .

en: And the Levites , of the children of the Kohathites , and of the children of the Korhites , stood up to praise the  Lord  God of Israel with a loud voice on high .
kha: Ki Lebi kiba dei na ka kur u Kohath bad u Korah ki ïeng bad da ka sur kaba jam ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Lebi ki khun ki Koshite bad ki khun ki Khrist ki la ieng ban iaroh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel da ka sur kaba jam .

en: And it came to pass at that time , that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham , saying , God is with thee in all that thou doest :
kha: Ha kata ka por , u Abimelekh u leit bad u Phikol , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad u ong ha u Abraham ,  U Blei u long ryngkat bad me ha kaei kaei baroh ba me leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por, u Abimelech bad u Phichol u rangbah shipai jong u u la kren ha u Abraham, u da ong: U Blei u don ryngkat bad me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me leh:

en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of mine hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand ?
kha: Mynno na kine ki blei jong ki ri baroh kiba la ju pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei ki blei baroh jong ki ri kiba la pyllait ia ka ri jong ki na ka kti jong nga , ba U Trai un pyllait ia ka Jerusalem na ka kti jong nga ?

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you : for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye .
kha: Uno uno uba shoh ïa phi u shoh ïa uta uba kordor eh ha nga .  Kumta U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba la lute ïa ki briew jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid ; Hadien ka burom u la phah ia nga sha ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynsniew ia phi: namar uta uba ktah ia phi u ktah ia ka apple jong ka khmat jong u .

en: But when the Comforter is come , whom I will send unto you from the Father , even the Spirit of truth , which proceedeth from the Father , he shall testify of me :
kha: U Nongïarap un wan — U Mynsiem , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei bad uba wan na U Kpa . Ngan phah ïa u na U Kpa , bad un kren shaphang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda u Nongialam u la wan, ia uba ngan phah sha phi na U Kpa, wat ia U Mynsiem ka jingshisha uba mih na U Kpa, un saphriang ia nga:
