en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her , Hannah , why weepest thou ? and why eatest thou not ? and why is thy heart grieved ? am not I better to thee than ten sons ?
kha: U Elkanah u tnga jong ka u kylli ïa ka ,  Hannah , balei ba phi da ïam ? Balei ba phim bam ei ei ? Balei ba phi shu sngewsih sah ? Hato ngam kham lah ma nga ha phi ban ïa shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Elkanah u tnga jong ka ha ka, Hannah, balei me iam ? bad balei ba me bam ? bad balei ba ka dohnud jong me ka sngewsih ? hato ngam kham bha ia me ban ia ki shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang ?

en: And I sought for a man among them , that should make up the hedge , and stand in the gap before me for the land , that I should not destroy it : but I found none .
kha: Nga wad ïa uno uno uba lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh , uba lah ban ïeng ha ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh ki twa bad ban ïada ïa ka ri haba ka jingbitar jong nga ka la jan ban pynjot ïa ka , hynrei ngam shem ïano ïano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la wad ia u briew napdeng jong ki, uba dei ban pynlong ia ka jingkhang, bad ban ieng ha ka thliew ha khmat jong nga na ka bynta ka ri: hynrei ngam lap ei ei .

en: And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :
kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ,  Nga u Jakob , u shakri bakohnguh jong phi , nga pyntip ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso ba nga la shong la sah bad u Laban , bad nga la pynslem ban wan phai haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki da kaba ong: Kumta phin kren ha u kynrad jong nga u Iso;

en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked , both riches , and honour : so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days .
kha: Ngan ai ruh ha me ïa kaei kaba mem shym la pan : baroh shi rta ka jingim jong me , men don ka spah bad ka burom , kham bun ban ïa kata ka jong uno uno uwei pat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ruh ia me ia kaba me khlem pan, ka spah bad ka burom: khnang ba ym don uwei ruh napdeng ki syiem uba kum ma me ha ki sngi jong me baroh .

en: ( Hebrews 11 :4–12 :1 ) Just as an individual may bear witness in court in behalf of an innocent person , we are determined to make known the truth about our God .
kha: ( Hebru 11 :4–12 :1 ) Kumba u briew u sakhi na ka bynta jong uwei pat u baluilui ha ka ïingbishar , ngi ruh ngi la rai skhem ban ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hbraloni 11 :412 ) Kumba u briew shimet u lah ban sakhi ha ka iingbishar na ka bynta u briew uba khlem pop , ngi kut jingmut ban pynpaw ia ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei jong ngi .

en: And the man that lieth with his father s wife hath uncovered his father s nakedness : both of them shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
kha: U briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga jong u kpa jong u , u pynjahburom ïa la u kpa ; ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shah pynïap baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u briew uba shong bad ka tnga jong u u la pynpaw ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong u: baroh arngut kin shah pyniap shisha; ka snam jong ki kan long halor jong ki .

en: Then said the Jews among themselves , Whither will he go , that we shall not find him ? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles , and teach the Gentiles ?
kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïakren para ma ki ,  Shano ba un sa leit ba ngi ngin ym shem ïa u ? Hato un leit sha ki shnong jong ki Grik ha kaba ki briew jong ngi ki sah , bad ban hikai ïa ki Grik ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki Jiw ki la ong hapdeng jong ki: Hato un leit noh ia u ? hato un leit sha kiba la saphriang hapdeng ki Jutang bad un hikai ia ki Jutang ?

en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !
kha: Phi ong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynstet bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong ba un leh , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Israel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong u , to ngin khmih kaei u don ha ka jingmut jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka ong , To ai ba un pynsted ia ka kam jong u, ba ngin iohi ia ka: bad to ai ba ka jingmut jong U Bakhuid jong ki Israel kan wan hajan bad kan wan , ba ngin ithuh ia ka !

en: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
kha: Ka la long janmiet haba u Joseph na Arimathaïa u la wan poi . U la long u riewdonburom jong ka Dorbar , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U Blei . Ka la long ka sngi Pynkhreh ( kata , ka sngi shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton ) , kumta u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur sha u Pilat bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph na Arimathaea, u nongai jingmut uba donburom ruh uba ap ia ka hima U Blei, u la wan, bad u la leit sha u Pilat da ka jingshlur, bad u la kwah ia ka met U Jisu .

en: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up into the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nonglamktien bad pule ïa ka . Nangta u leit sha ka Templ , u buh ïa ka shithi hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la ioh ia ka shithi na ka kti jong ki nonglam khubor: bad u Hesekaiah u la leit sha ka iing U Trai bad u la pynphriang ia ka ha khmat U Trai .

en: And Moses said , The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen  ; and thou hast said , I will give them flesh , that they may eat a whole month .
kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Hangne nga ïalam ïa ki hynriew lakh ngut ki briew , bad me , me ong ban men ai doh ïa ki ka ban biang haduh shi bnai ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Ki briew kiba nga long ki long hynriew spah hajar ngut ki nongleit jingleit; bad me la ong: Ngan ai doh ia ki, ba kin bam shibnai pura .

en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .
kha: Ki dkhoh kin thaw ïa ki skum jong ki , kin kha pylleng bad pynmih ki khun , bad sumar ïa ki hangta . Ki pukni kin ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta u blang uba heh un shna ia ka bniat jong ka, bad un thiah bad un ialum hapoh ka jingdum jong ka: hangta ki blang ruh kin ialum lang , uwei pa uwei bad u lok jong ka .

en: Then shall he return into his land with great riches  ; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant  ; and he shall do exploits , and return to his own land .
kha: U syiem ka Syria un leit phai sha ïing lem bad ki jinglute kiba u la ïoh kurup , u la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un leh kat kaba u sngewbha bad nangta un leit phai sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un leit phai noh sha la ka ri da ka spah kaba khraw ; bad ka dohnud jong u kan long pyrshah ia ka jutang bakhuid ; bad un leh ia ki kam runar bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .
kha: Ha kata ka por wat ïa ki baje ha ki tyllai teh jong ki kulai yn thoh da ki kyntien  Ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .  Ki khiew shet ha ka Templ kin long kiba kyntang kum ki jingdiang ha khmat ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi kan don ha ki jingsawa jong ki kulai , KA JINGPYNBNA IA KI JINGPYNBNA .

en: Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshemphang ! Hato U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to sngap ia nga, phi ki briew kiba sngewthuh: jngai na U Blei, ba un leh ia ka jingsniew ; bad na Uba donbor baroh, ba un leh ia ka jingbymhok .

en: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women : and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the  Lord  of hosts , which he shaketh over it .
kha: Ka por ka wan haba ki briew jong ka Ijipt kin long kiba khawpud kum ki kynthei . Kin khynñiuh ha ka jingsngewtriem haba ki ïohi ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka Ijipt kan long kum ki kynthei: bad kan tieng bad ka tieng namar ka jingkhih jong ka kti U Trai jong ki paid , kaba u pynkhih halor jong ka .

en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , putteth it in a secret place , neither under a bushel , but on a candlestick , that they which come in may see the light .
kha: Ym don uba thang ïa ka sharak bad nangta u buhrieh ïa ka lane buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki wan rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew uba la pynmeh ia ka sharak, uba buh ia ka ha ka jaka kaba rieh, ym hapoh ka khlaw, hynrei ha ka sharak , ba kito kiba wan rung kin iohi ia ka jingshai .

en: In a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trump : for the trumpet shall sound , and the dead shall be raised incorruptible , and we shall be changed .
kha: To shahshkor ïa kane ka jingshisha barieh : Ngi baroh ngin ym ïap , hynrei haba ka turoi bakhatduh kan sawa , ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur ha kaba shikhyllipmat . Naba haba ka turoi kan sawa , ïa kiba ïap yn pynmihpat , ba kin ym ïap shuh da lei lei , bad ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka khyllipmat, ha ka jingkylla jong ka khmat, ha ka turoi kaba khatduh: namar ka turoi kan sawa , bad ia kiba iap yn pynmih khlem pyut , bad ngin kylla .

en: And there were also sodomites in the land : and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
kha: Kaba kham sniew ïa baroh , ka long ba don ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba shakri kum ki nuti ha kita ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki paid Judah ki la leh ïa kine ki kam kiba ilehrain ba ju leh da kito ki briew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki dang leit kurup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ruh ki nongleh kam sniew ha ka ri: bad ki la leh kat kum ki jingleh bymman jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba U Trai u la bret noh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem , and every man with his staff in his hand for very age .
kha: Sa shisien pat ki tymmen shynrang bad kynthei , kiba la tymmen haduh katta ba ki pyndonkam ïa ki diengduh haba ki ïaid , kin shong ha ki jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid Ki tymmen bad ki tymmen kin sah ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba don u diengduh jong u ha ka kti jong u ha ka rta kaba la rim bha .

en: And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .
kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Shim ïa une u khunlung bad ri ïa u na ka bynta jong nga , bad ngan da siew ïa pha .  Kumta kata ka kynthei ka shim ïa uta u khunlung , bad ka ri ka sumar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun jong u Pharaoh ka la ong ia ka, To weng noh ia une u khun, bad to ai dud ia u na ka bynta jong nga, bad ngan ai ia ka bainong jong me . Bad kata ka kynthei ka la shim ia uta u khun bad ka la ai dud ia u .

en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )
kha: Hynrei kim shym la iehnoh ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Jeroboam u la ïalam ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai leh ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh kim shym la leit noh na ki pop jong ka iing u Jeroboan , uba la leh pop ia ki Israel: bad hangta la sah ia u khlaw ruh ha Samaria . )

en: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee , go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone : if he shall hear thee , thou hast gained thy brother .
kha: Lada u para jong me u leh pop pyrshah ïa me , khie leit sha u bad pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingbakla jong u . Hynrei leh ïa ka ha kaba jar jar , kumba tang hapdeng para ma phi . Lada u shahshkor ïa me , me la ïoh pat ïa la u para .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata lada u hynmen jong me un iaid beit pyrshah ia me, leit bad iathuh ia ka jingbakla jong u hapdeng jong me bad ma u marwei: lada un iohsngew ia me, me la ioh ia u hynmen jong me .

en: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers  ; that they do not rise , nor possess the land , nor fill the face of the world with cities .
kha: Ai ba ka jingpynïap kan sdang ! Ki khun shynrang jong une u syiem kin ïap namar ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ym don mano mano na ki u ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei lane tap ïa ka da ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhreh ia ka jingpyniap ia ki khun jong u na ka bynta ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa jong ki; ba kim kiew , lymne ki don ia ka ri , lymne ki pyndap ia ka khmat jong ka pyrthei da ki nongbah .

en: And I have set there a place for the ark , wherein is the covenant of the  Lord  , which he made with our fathers , when he brought them out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Nga la pynkhreh ruh ka jaka ha ka Templ ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap jong ka jutang ha kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la buh hangta ia ka jaka na ka bynta ka synduk , ha kaba ka don ka jutang U Trai kaba u la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi haba u la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And when the people saw what Paul had done , they lifted up their voices , saying in the speech of Lycaonia , The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba u Paul u la leh , ki la sdang ban pyrta jam ha ka ktien Lykaonia jong ki ,  Ki blei ki la wan long kum ki briew bad ki la wan hiar sha ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew ki la iohi ia kaei kaba u Paul u la leh, ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, ki da ong ha ka jingkren jong ka Lycaia , Ki blei ki wan hiar sha ngi ha ka jinglong briew .

en: Moreover , in other parts of the country too , all the youth of North East including Manipur are being provided with better facilities such as good hostels today .
kha: Shuh shuh ha kiwei pat ki bynta jong ka ri ruh baroh ki samla jong ka North East kynthup ka Manipur ki ïoh ïa ki jingdonkam kiba kham bha kum ki hostel kiba bha mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, ha kiwei pat ki bynta jong ka ri ruh, baroh ki samla ka North East kynthup ia ka Manipur ki shah pynbiang da ki jingdonkam kiba kham bha kum ki hostel kiba bha mynta .

en: And the  Lord  spake suddenly unto Moses , and unto Aaron , and unto Miriam , Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation . And they three came out .
kha: Kynsan kynsan U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Miriam ,  Nga kwah ïa phi baroh lai ngut ban wan sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren kynsan ia u Moses bad u Aaron bad ha ka Miriam , To mih noh phi lai ngut sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng . Bad ki lai ngut ki la mih .

en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites : and they went out to the south of Judah , even to Beer–sheba .
kha: Nangta ki leit shaphang shathie sha Tyros ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta sha baroh ki nongbah jong ki Hib bad ki Kanaan , bad khatduh eh sha Beersheba , ha ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi sha ka jaka ba skhem jong ka Tyros bad sha ki shnong Hivite baroh: bad ki la leit shaphang shathie jong ka Judah, wat sha Beersheba .

en: And the word of God increased  ; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly  ; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith .
kha: Bad kumta ka ktien U Blei ka la ïai saphriang . Ka jingdon jong ki synran ha Jerusalem ka la nang kiew bad nang kiew , bad bun bah ki lyngdoh ki la pdiang ïa ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ktien U Blei ka la nang kiew; bad ka jingbun ki synran ka la nang kiew ha Jerusalem shibun bad ka kynhun kaba khraw jong ki lyngdoh ka la kohnguh ia ka jingngeit .

en: Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar–bozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :
kha: Nangta u Darius u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Tattenai , u lat jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai , bad ki para rangbah synshar ha Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata, Tatnai, u Lat sha lyndet ka wah, u Shetharbozenai, bad ki paralok jong phi ki Apharsheet kiba don sha lyndet ka wah, to long kiba jngai na kata:

en: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob , and also my covenant with Isaac , and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember  ; and I will remember the land .
kha: ngan sa kynmaw ïa la ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad u Jakob bad u Isaak bad u Abraham , bad ngan sa pynthymmai ïa la ka kular ban ai ïa kata ka ri ha ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan kynmaw ia ka jutang jong nga bad u Jakob, bad ruh ia ka jutang jong nga bad u Isaak, bad kumjuh ruh ia ka jutang jong nga bad u Abraham ngan kynmaw ia ka ri; bad ngan kynmaw ia ka ri .

en: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,
kha: bad ai ïa kata ka rupa ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba la shah khein na ki Lebi kiba u Moses bad u Aaron bad u rangbah Israel ki la khein , kat kum ki longiing jong ki bad hadien ka iing ki kpa jong ki .

en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses u ong ,  Sngap mynta , phi ki nongïaleh pyrshah ! Hato ngi hap pynmih um na une u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lum lang ia ka jingiaseng ha khmat u maw , bad u la ong ha ki: To sngap mynta , phi ki leh pyrshah ; hato ngi dei ban tan um na une u maw ?

en: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour , and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee :
kha: Ïa ka khyndew dei ban buh dor kat kum ka jingdon jong ki snem ha kiba kata ka khyndew ka lah ban pynmih soh shuwa ban poi ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingbun ki snem hadien ka jubilee me thied na u paramarjan jong me bad kat kum ka jingbun ki snem jong ki soh u die ha me:

en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .
kha: Hynrei , ko  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me tynjuh hok ïa ki briew ; me tip kaei kaba don hapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingmut jong ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ko Trai jong ki paid, uba pyrshang ia kiba hok, bad uba iohi ia ki bniat bad ka dohnud jong me, to ngan iohi ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong me halor jong ki: namar ha me nga la plie ia ka daw jong nga .

en: But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
kha: Hynrei phim im kumba ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong phi ka ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , phi im kumba U Mynsiem u ong ïa phi ban leh — lada , shisha , U Mynsiem U Blei u don hapoh jong phi . Uno uno u bym don ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khrist , um long u jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phim don ha ka doh hynrei ha U Mynsiem lada U Mynsiem U Blei U shong ha phi . Mynta lada uno uno u don ia U Mynsiem U Khrist , um long uwei ruh na ki jong u .

en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .
kha: Ka turoi bakhraw kan sawa , bad un phah ïa ki angel jong u sha ki sawlyer jong ka pyrthei , ban kin lumlang ïa ki briew kiba la jied jong u na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un phah ia ki angel jong u da ka sur kaba khraw jong ka turoi , bad kin lum lang ia ki ba la jied jong u na ki saw tylli ki Iyer , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka bneng haduh kawei pat .

en: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger , since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt , even unto this day .
kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ha ki briew jong nga , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad pynkhih bitar ïa nga naduh ka por ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la mihnoh na Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong nga bad ki la pynbitar ia nga naduh ka sngi ba ki kpa tymmen jong ki ki la mih na Ijipt haduh kine ki sngi .

en: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity  ; but the word of the oath , which was since the law , maketh the Son , who is consecrated for evermore .
kha: Ka Hukum u Moses ka thung ïa ki briew ki bymjanai ban long ki rangbah lyngdoh ; hynrei ka kular U Blei ba la pynlong da ka jingsmai , kaba wan hadien ka hukum , ka thung ïa U Khun , ïa uba la pynjanai junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hukum ka pynlong ia ki briew kiba khlem jingduna ; hynrei ka ktien jong ka jingsmai kaba la long naduh ka hukum , ka pynlong ia u Khun , uba la pynkyntang junom .

en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east : and his voice was like a noise of many waters : and the earth shined with his glory .
kha: bad hangta nga la ïohi ba wan na shaphang mihngi ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon U Blei ki Israel . Ka sur jong U Blei ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , bad ka pyrthei ka phyrnai da ka jingshai ba-thaba .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka burom U Blei jong ki Israel ka la wan na ka lynti mihngi : bad ka sur jong u ka la long kum ka jingsawa jong ki um kiba bun: bad ka khyndew ka la shai da ka burom jong u .

en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Baroh na phi phin phet noh bad phin iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ka kynhun langbrot yn pynsakma .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Baroh phin sngewsih namar jong nga mynta ka miet: namar la thoh: namar la thoh: Ngan shoh ia u nongaplangbrot bad ki langbrot kin sa jah noh .

en: And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .
kha: Ki la ïakynduh bad u Annas u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u Kaïaphas , u Ïoannis , u Aleksandar , bad kiwei pat kiba dei na ka longïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Anna u rangbah lyngdoh bad u Kiapha bad u Ioannis bad u Alexander bad katba ki long kiba iadei bad u rangbah lyngdoh ki la ialum lang ha Jerusalem .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge , and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart , to destroy it for the old hatred  ;
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynhiarkput jubor ïa ki nongshun ba la slem bha bad ki la pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Namar ki Philistia ki la leh da ka jingsiew kylliang, bad ki la shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang da ka dohnud kaba sniew, ban pynjot ia ka na ka bynta ka jingshun barim ; .

en: Therefore pray not thou for this people , neither lift up a cry or prayer for them : for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble .
kha: Ko Jeremaïah , wat duwai ha nga lane ïasaid bad nga na ka bynta kine ki briew . Haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad ki pyrta sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat duwai na ka bynta une u briew , wat pynmih ia ka jingpyrta ne jingduwai na ka bynta jong ki: namar ngan ym iohsngew ia ki ha ka por ba ki iam ha nga na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong ki .

en: But he is a Jew , which is one inwardly ; and circumcision is that of the heart , in the spirit , and not in the letter ; whose praise is not of men , but of God .
kha: Pynban , u Jiw bashisha u dei u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shapoh , kata , uba ïa ka dohnud jong u la otsher , bad kane ka dei ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei , ym jong ka Hukum ba la thoh . Kum uta u briew u ïoh ïa la ka jingïaroh na U Blei , ym na u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u long u Jiw, uba long uwei uba don ha ka dohnud, ha ka mynsiem, bad ym ha ka shithi; uba ka jingiaroh jong u kam dei ka jong ki briew hynrei ka jong U Blei .

en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest : and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David , and said unto him , Why art thou alone , and no man with thee ?
kha: U Dabid u leit sha u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh ha Nob . U Ahimelekh u mih da kaba sheptieng ban leit tan ïa u , bad u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan hangne tang marwei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la wan sha u Nob ha u Ahimelek u lyngdoh : bad u Ahimelek u la tieng ha ka jingiakynduh jong u Dabid bad u la ong ha u: Balei ma me marwei bad ym don briew bad me ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch out thy rod , and smite the dust of the land , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da u diengduh , ba u pui pui ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei un kylla mait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To ong ha u Aaron , Pynkhih ia ka dewbilat jong ka ri , ba kan kylla long ki khniang ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .
kha: kawei ka leit shaphang Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka leit shaphang ka khappud na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bad ïa ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pat ka kynhun ka la phai sha Bethihoron : bad kawei pat ka kynhun ka la phai sha ka lynti jong u pud u sam kaba peit sha ka them u Seboim sha ka ri khlaw .

en: One basket had very good figs , even like the figs that are first ripe : and the other basket had very naughty figs , which could not be eaten , they were so bad .
kha: Ka shang kaba nyngkong ka don ki soh Dumbur kiba bha , kito kiba ih kham kloi ; kawei pat ka don ki soh Dumbur kiba pyut , ki bym long bam shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka basket ka don ki soh kiba bha shibun, wat kum ki soh kiba la san nyngkong: bad kawei pat ka basket ka don ki soh kiba sniew bha, kiba ym lah ban bam , ki la sniew haduh katta katta .

en: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly , he said unto him ,  Thou art not far from the kingdom of God .  And no man after that durst ask him any question .
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi katno u la long uba stad ha ka jingjubab jong u , bad kumta U la ong ïa u ,  Mem long jngai na ka Hima U Blei .  Hadien kane , ym don shuh mano mano ba nud ban kylli kino kino ki jingkylli ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la iohi ba u la jubab da kaba sngap jar, u la ong ha u, Me ym jngai na ka hima U Blei . Bad ym don mano mano ruh hadien kata kiba kwah ia u ban kylli ei ei .

en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed , as Gozan , and Haran , and Rezeph , and the children of Eden which were in Telassar ?
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki Gosan , Haran bad Reseph , bad ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka Betheden kiba shong ha Telassar , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki blei jong ki uba pyllait im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew ki la pynpoi ia ki kiba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot , kum u Gozan bad u Haran bad u Rezeph bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Eden kiba la don ha Telasar ?

en: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .
kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei khlem ka jingngeit , naba uta uba wan sha U Blei u dei ban don ka jingngeit ba U Blei u don , bad ba u ainong ïa kita kiba wad ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khlem ka jingngeit kam lah ban pynsngewbha ia u: namar uta uba wan sha U Blei u dei ban ngeit ba u long , bad ba u long u nongsiew kylliang ia kita kiba wad ia u da ka jingminot .

en: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves  ; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the  Lord  spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire :
kha: Mynba U  Trai  u kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha u Lum Sinai , phim shym la ïohi ïa kano kano ka dur .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bha ia lade ; namar phim shym la iohi ia ka jingiasyriem ha ka sngi ba U Trai u la kren ha phi ha Horeb na pdeng ka ding:

en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .
kha: Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar kaba hynñiew , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sien kaba hynriew, haba ki lyngdoh ki la pyrta da ki turoi , u Joshua u la ong ha ki briew: To sngap jar namar U Trai u la ai ia ka shnong ha phi .

en: Lord  , bow down thine ear , and hear : open ,  Lord  , thine eyes , and see : and hear the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent him to reproach the living God .
kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , khmih ïa kaei kaba jia ha ngi . Shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u ong ban ibeiñ ïa me , U Blei uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai, to dem khrup ia ka shkor jong me, bad to iohsngew: ko Trai, ki khmat jong me, bad to iohi: bad to iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u Senakherib, kiba la phah ia u ban kren bein ia U Blei uba im .

en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you , seeing your master s sons are with you , and there are with you chariots and horses , a fenced city also , and armour  ;
kha: Ha ka shithi la thoh :  Phi dei ki nongpeit ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem jong phi bad phi don ruh bad phi ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , ki tiar ïapom bad ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta tang shu wan kane ka shithi ha phi, haba phi iohi ia ki khun kynrad jong phi ki don ryngkat bad phi, bad ki don ryngkat bad phi ki kali bad ki kulai, ka shnong kaba la ker sawdong ruh, bad ki tiar ialeh;

en: Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ar ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga Daniel nga peit, bad, ha khmih, ki la ieng sa arngut, uta uba don sha shiliang jong ka wah bad uwei pat ha kata ka liang jong ka wah .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , unto all that are carried away captives , whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon  ;
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ha kito ki briew baroh kiba u la shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia :
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel, ha baroh kiba la shah rah noh na Jerusalem sha Babilon;

en: Ye have plowed wickedness , ye have reaped iniquity  ; ye have eaten the fruit of lies : because thou didst trust in thy way , in the multitude of thy mighty men .
kha: Hynrei pynban phi la bet ïa kaba sniew bad ïoh ot ïa ka jingot jong ka . Phi la bam ïa ki soh ba la pynmih da ka jingshukor jong phi .  Namar ba phi shaniah ha ki kali thma jong phi bad ha ka jingbun paid ki shipai jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la rep ia ka jingsniew, phi la kheit ia ka jingbymhok ; phi la bam ia u soh jong ki jinglamler: namar ba me la shaniah ha ka lynti jong me, ha ka jingbun ki riewshlur jong me .

en: For then the king of Babylon s army besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the king of Judah s house .
kha: Ha kata ka por ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , bad ïa nga la set ha ka phyllaw ba la kerkut jong ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ka por u syiem Babilon u la leit sha Jerusalem: bad u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la shah set ha ka phyllaw jong ka phatok kaba don ha ka iing jong u syiem Judah .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me , a destroying wind  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga wallam ïa ka lyer ka jingjot pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Ha khmih , ngan kiew pyrshah ia ka Babilon , bad pyrshah ia kita kiba shong hapdeng jong ki kiba kiew pyrshah ia nga , ka Iyer kaba pynjot ; .

en: And the third angel followed them , saying with a loud voice , If any man worship the beast and his image , and receive his mark in his forehead , or in his hand ,
kha: U angel uba lai u la bud ïa ki ar ngut ki angel kiba sha khmat , da kaba kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno u mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad pdiang ïa ka shab ha ka shyllangmat jong u lane ha ka kti jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba lai u la bud ia ki, u da ong da ka sur kaba jam: Lada uno uno u briew u mane ia uta u mrad bad ka dur jong u bad u pdiang ia ka dak jong u ha ka khlieh jong u ne ha ka kti jong u .

en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out , and thou shalt break the sherds thereof , and pluck off thine own breasts : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Phan dih bad phan pynrngad tyrkhong ïa ka , bad da ki lyngkhot ba la pait jong ka phan tar ïa ka shadem jong pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei wat ban dih ia ka bad to dih ia ka, bad me dei ban pynpra ia ki bniat jong ka, bad to ot noh ia la ki jong ki bniat: namar nga la kren ia ka, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And the dove came in to him in the evening  ; and , lo , in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off : so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth .
kha: Ha ka por janmiet , kata ka paro ka wan phai pat sha u , ka da wanrah ha la ka shyntur ïa u sla dieng Olib ba dang shu kheit . Kumta u Noah u tip ba ka um ka la rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: U paro u la wan rung shapoh jong u ha ka por mynstep bad, ha ka shyntur jong ka la mih u sla olive: kumta u Noah u la tip ba ki um ki la jah noh na ka khyndew .

en: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to devils , and not to God : and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils .
kha: Em! Kaei kaba nga ong ka long ba ïa kaei kaba la kñia ha ki duwan jong ki bymngeit ka long kaba la kñia sha ki ksuid , ym sha U Blei . Bad ngam kwah ïa phi ban long kiba ïatrei lem bad ki ksuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong , ba kiei kiei kiba ki Jutang ki knia ha ki ksuid , bad ym ha U Blei : bad ngam kwah ba phin iasyllok bad ki ksuid .

en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even fourscore years old : and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim  ; for he was a very great man .
kha: U Barsillai u long uba la tymmen bha , u la phraphew snem ka rta . U long uba riewspah bha , bad u la pynbiang jingbam ïa u syiem mynba u dang sah ha Mahanaim .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Barzillai u la long u briew uba la san bha, wat uba dang saw snem: bad u la pynbiang ia u syiem ia ka jingbam katba u dang thiah ha Mahanaim ; namar u long u briew uba khraw shibun .

en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast , they give suck to their young ones : the daughter of my people is become cruel , like the ostriches in the wilderness .
kha: Wat ka kmie suri kan sumar ïa la ki khun , hynrei ki briew jong nga ki long kum ki ostrit , kiba lehbeiñ ïa ki khun rit jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ki mrad duriaw ruh ki sei ia ka sniehdoh jong ki: ka khun jong ki briew jong nga ka kylla long kaba sniew, kum ki blang ha ka ri khlaw .

en: These two things are come unto thee  ; who shall be sorry for thee ? desolation , and destruction , and the famine , and the sword : by whom shall I comfort thee ?
kha: Ka jingjot kaba ar shah ka la hap halor jong pha : ïa ka jaka jong pha la pynjot ha ka thma , bad ki briew jong pha ki la ïapthngan . Ym don uno uno uba pyn-i jingsngewlem ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ar tylli kiei kiei ki wan ha me; mano ba ngan pyntngen ia me ? ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynjot bad ka jingkyrduh: da mano ngan pyntngen ia me ?

en: But as it is written , Eye hath not seen , nor ear heard , neither have entered into the heart of man , the things which God hath prepared for them that love him .
kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohi ne ïohsngew , ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la pyrkhat ba lah ban jia , ka long kata hi kaei kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhreh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumba la thoh , U Eye um shym la iohi , lymne ka shkor kam shym la iohsngew , lymne ka la rung ha ka dohnud u briew , kiei kiei kiba U Blei u la pynkhreh na ka bynta kito kiba ieit ia u .

en: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
kha: Hadien ba ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jingïateh kular ha Beersheba , u Abimelekh bad u Phikol ki leit phai pat sha Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la leh ia ka jutang ha Beersheba: nangta u Abimelech u la kiew , bad u Phichol u rangbah shipai jong u , bad ki la leit phai biang sha ka ri jong ki Philistia .

en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them : for the Levites and the singers , that did the work , were fled every one to his field .
kha: Nga la tip ruh ba ki nongtem nongput ka Templ bad kiwei ki Lebi ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad poi biang sha ki jaka rep , namar ki briew kim shym la ai kaba biang ïa ki ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la sngewthuh ba ki bynta jong ki Lebi kim shym la ai ha ki: namar ki Lebi bad ki nongrwai kiba la leh ia ka kam ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka lyngkha .

en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Lo , I am come unto thee : have I now any power at all to say any thing ? the word that God putteth in my mouth , that shall I speak .
kha: U Balaam u jubab ,  Nga la wan em ! Hynrei mynta nga donbor aïu ? Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaba U Blei u ong ha nga ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u Balak, Lo, nga wan sha me: hato mynta nga don bor ei ei ruh em ban ong ei ei ? ka ktien kaba U Blei u buh ha ka shyntur jong nga, ba ngan kren .

en: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus  ; and the Syrians became David s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
kha: Nangta u pynïeng ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u bad ki siew khajna sha u . U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa u Dabid ha kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la buh ia ki shipai ha Syria cus ; bad ki Syria ki la kylla long ki shakri jong u Dabid bad ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha . Kumta U Trai u la pynneh pynsah ia u Dabid shano shano ruh ba u leit .

en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha Babilonia ba kin long ki koidi slem bah hangta bad ba kin tei ïa ki ïing , kin shongduh , kin thaw ki kper , bad bam ïa kaei kaba ki thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar namarkata u la phah sha ngi ha Babilon, u da ong: Kane ka jinglong mraw ka long kaba jrong: to tei ia ki iing bad to shong ha ki ; bad thung ia ki kper bad bam ia ki soh jong ki .

en: But then we saw the need to produce a new translation that would better help people to learn the “accurate knowledge of truth ,” which is God’s will for everyone .
kha: Hynrei ngi ïohi ba la donkam ban pynmih ïa ka jingpynkyllaktien bathymmai ban ïarap ïa ki briew ban ïoh “jingtip ia ka jingshisha .” Kane ka dei ka mon jong U Blei na ka bynta iwei pa iwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nangta ngi la iohi ia ka jingdonkam ban pynmih ia ka jingpynkylla kaba thymmai kaba kham bha ban iarap ia ki briew ban nang ia ka jingtip kaba thikna jong ka jingshisha,  kaba long ka mon jong U Blei na ka bynta baroh .

en: To morrow go ye down against them : behold , they come up by the cliff of Ziz  ; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook , before the wilderness of Jeruel .
kha: Tur pyrshah ïa ki la shai ka sngi haba kin wan kiew na ka them ha Sis . Phin ïakynduh ïa ki ha kaba kut jong ka them kaba poi sha ka ri khlaw hajan Jeruel .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit hiar sha ki: ha khmih , ki wan shaneng da ka kliar jong u Ziz ; bad phin shem ia ki ha kaba kut jong ka wah , ha khmat ka ri khlaw Jeruel .

en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour , and trust ye not in any brother : for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbour will walk with slanders .
kha: Uwei uwei baroh u dei ban da sumar bha pyrshah ïa u paralok jong u , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban shaniah ïa u hynmen u para shynrang jong u ; namar uwei pa uwei uba shi para u long uba dap da ka jingshukor kum u Jakob , bad uwei uwei u krenbeiñ ïa ki paralok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia uwei pa uwei na ki para marjan jong u, bad wat shaniah ha uno uno u hynmen: namar uwei pa uwei u hynmen un iaid beit iaid ryntih , bad uwei pa uwei u para marjan un iaid ryngkat bad ki jaboh .

en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .
kha: Nga ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , bad nangta nga wan ban ïarap ïa phi . Ym don u blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sakhi jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynbna , bad nga la pynim , haba ym don blei nongwei hapdeng jong phi: namarkata phi long ki sakhi jong nga , ong U Trai , ba nga long U Blei .

en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together , as the manner of some is  ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more , as ye see the day approaching .
kha: Wat ai ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka jingmlien ban ïaseng lang , kumba don kiba leh . Pynban , to ngin pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat , khamtam haba phi ïohi ba ka Sngi U Trai ka la nang jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ym iehnoh ia ka jingpyniasoh lang ia lade, kumba ka rukom jong ki katto katne ka long tang shu kyntu iwei ia iwei pat: bad katta katta shuh shuh , katba phi nang iohi ia ka sngi kaba la jan .

en: Now therefore make a new cart , and take two milch kine , on which there hath come no yoke , and tie the kine to the cart , and bring their calves home from them :
kha: Kumta pynkhreh kawei ka kali thymmai bad ar tylli ki masi kynthei ha kiba ym pat ju pyndait lyngkor ; teh ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun masi sha sem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to shna ia ka kali thymmai, bad shim ar tylli ki masi kiba la wan ha ka lyngkha, bad teh ia ki masi ha ka kali, bad wanrah ia ki khun masi jong ki na ki:

en: And the  Lord  drave out from before us all the people , even the Amorites which dwelt in the land : therefore will we also serve the  Lord   ; for he is our God .
kha: Katba ngi nang ïaid sha khmat sha kane ka ri , U  Trai  u la beh ïa ki Amor baroh kiba shong basah hangne . Kumta ma ngi ruh , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai  , u long U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la mih noh na khmat jong ngi baroh, wat ki Amorit kiba shong ha ka ri: namarkata ngin shakri ruh ia U Trai ; namar u long U Blei jong ngi .

en: Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .
kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , phi la tip lypa ïa kane . To sumar ïa lade , namarkata , ba phin ym shah ïalam bakla da ki jingpynbakla ki briew ki bym bat aiñ bad phi hap noh na ka jaka ba la shongshngain kaba phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ruh, ko baieit, haba phi tip ia kine kiei kiei mynshuwa, to husiar na kiar na phi ruh, ba phi shah ialam noh da ka jingbakla jong ki bymman, to hap noh na ka jinglong ba skhem jong phi hi .

en: And I will yet be more vile than thus , and will be base in mine own sight : and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of , of them shall I be had in honour .
kha: bad ngan pynjahburom shuh shuh ïa lade . Pha lah pyrkhat ba ngam long ei ei , hynrei kito ki kynthei kin ñiewburom shikatdei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan sa kham sniew ban ia kata, bad ngan sa long uba kham sniew ha la ka jong ka khmat: bad na ki shakri kiba me la kren shaphang jong ki , na ki ngan sa don ha ka burom .

en: He shall see of the travail of his soul , and shall be satisfied : by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many  ; for he shall bear their iniquities .
kha: Hadien ka jingim ba la shahshitom , un ïoh pat ïa ka jingkmen ; un tip ba um shym la shahshitom lehnoh-ei . U shakri ba la aiti lut jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha , un shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong kiba bun bad na ka bynta jong u ngan map ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Un iohi ia ka jingtrei shitom jong ka mynsiem jong u, bad un sngewhun: da ka jingtip jong u u shakri hok jong nga un pynshisha ia kiba bun; namar un kit ia ki jingbymhok jong ki .

en: O  Lord  , thou art my God  ; I will exalt thee , I will praise thy name  ; for thou hast done wonderful things  ; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth .
kha: A  Trai  , me long U Blei jong nga ; ngan pyndonburom ïa me bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Me la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla ; me la long uba ïaineh ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong me kiba me la thmu naduh mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, ko Blei jong nga; ngan pynkhraw ia me, ngan iaroh ia ka kyrteng jong me namar me la leh ia kiei kiei kiba phylla; ki jingai jingmut jong me barim ki long kiba iaineh bad kiba shisha .

en: I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .
kha: Te , kaei pat ? Nga ong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie bad ai ha phi ïa u kpu , namar ba phi dei u paralok jong u , pynban un khie joit bad ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi donkam namar ba phim lehrain ban ïai pan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ha phi , Wat la un ym kiew bad un ym ai ia u , namar ba u long u paralok jong u , hynrei namar ka jingkwah jong u un kiew bad un ai ia u katba u donkam .

en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb , The dog is turned to his own vomit again  ; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire .
kha: Kaei kaba la jia ha ki , ka pynpaw ba ki Proberb ki long kiba shisha :  U ksew u leit phai pat sha la ka prie  bad  u sniang ïa uba la pynsum pynsait u leit kyrsum pat ha ka ktieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia ha ki kat kum ka proberb kaba shisha , U kulai u kylla biang sha la ka jong ka jingsma; bad u sniang uba la sait ha ka ha ka dewbilat .

en: Be of good courage , and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people , and for the cities of our God : and let the  Lord  do that which is good in his sight .
kha: To long khlaiñ bad long shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongbah jong U Blei jong ngi . Bad to ai ba yn pyndep ïa ka mon U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba shlur bha , bad to ngin leh ia lade da ka jingsngewrit na ka bynta ki briew jong ngi , bad na ka bynta ki nongbah U Blei jong ngi : bad to ai ba U Trai un leh ia kaba bha ha ka jingpeit jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit sha u Pharaoh . Nga la pynmutlop ïa u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , khnang ba nga lah ban leh ïa kine ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: To leit sha u Pharaoh: namar nga la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u bad ka dohnud jong ki shakri jong u, ba ngan pyni ia kine ki dak jong nga ha khmat jong u:

en: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
kha: Lada u kynrad jong u , u pynïoh ïa u ka tnga , bad ka ïoh khun shynrang ne kynthei na u , kata ka briew bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki jong u kynrad jong ka , bad uta u briew un mihnoh tang marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u kynrad jong u u la ai tnga ia u, bad ka la kha ia u khun shynrang ne kynthei; ka tnga bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki kynrad jong ka, bad un leit noh hi dalade .

en: And God saw their works , that they turned from their evil way  ; and God repented of the evil , that he had said that he would do unto them  ; and he did it not .
kha: U Blei u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ; u la ïohi ba ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki . Kumta u la kylla jingmut bad um shym la pynshitom ïa ki kumba u la ong ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la iohi ia ki kam jong ki, ba ki la kylla na ka lynti kaba sniew jong ki ; bad U Blei u la kylla bamut na ka jingsniew, ba u la ong ba un leh ia ki ; bad um shym la leh ia kata .

en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .
kha: U Blei u ong ,  To sngap jar bad to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kren . To ngin ïawanlang ban rai mano ba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap jar ha khmat jong nga , ko dulir ; bad ai ba ki briew kin pynthymmai ia ka bor jong ki: to ai ba kin wan hajan ; nangta to ai ba kin kren: to ngin iawan lang hajan ka jingbishar .

en: Come , my people , enter thou into thy chambers , and shut thy doors about thee : hide thyself as it were for a little moment , until the indignation be overpast .
kha: To rung shapoh ki ïing jong phi , ko ki briew jong nga , bad to khang ïa ka jingkhang shadien jong phi . To buhrieh ïa lade katto katne por haduh ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan kut .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan, ko briew jong nga, to rung ha ki kamra jong me, bad khang ia ki jingkhang jong me sawdong jong me: to buhrieh ia lade kumba ka la long tang khyndiat por, haduh ba ka jingbitar kan da palat .

en: Examine yourselves , whether ye be in the faith ; prove your own selves . Know ye not your own selves , how that Jesus Christ is in you , except ye be reprobates ?
kha: To tynjuh ïa lade bad bishar hi da lade , ban shem la phi im ne em ha ka jingngeit . Hato da shisha phi tip ba U Khrist Jisu u don ha phi ? — lymda phi la long kiba la shahjop noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit bniah ia lade , la phi don ha ka jingngeit ; pynshisha ia la ka jong ka jingngeit . Hato phim tip ia la ka jong ka jinglong , kumno ba U Jisu Khrist U don ha phi , lait noh tang ba phi shah pynrem ?

en: And he said , Take them alive . And they took them alive , and slew them at the pit of the shearing house , even two and forty men  ; neither left he any of them .
kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew ,  Kem im ïa ki .  Ki la kem ïa ki , bad u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . Baroh ki ïadon sawphew ar ngut , bad ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei ruh na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: To shim ia ki da kaba im . Ki la shim ia ki da kaba im, bad ki la pyniap ia ki ha ka thliew jong ka iing ot khun, wat arphew ngut ki briew; um shym la iehnoh ia uwei ruh na ki .

en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains  ; the earth with her bars was about me for ever : yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption , O  Lord  my God .
kha: Nga la ngam shaduh ki trai jong ki lumbah , sha ka ri kaba ki khyrdop ki khang junom . Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong nga , me la wanrah im pat ïa nga na ki jingjylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la leit shapoh ki lum ; ka khyndew bad ki bar jong ka ka la long shaphang jong nga junom: hynrei me la pynmih ia ka jingim jong nga na ka jingbamsap , ko Trai jong nga .

en: And the children of Israel said unto the  Lord  , We have sinned : do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee  ; deliver us only , we pray thee , this day .
kha: Hynrei ki paid Israel ki ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ngi la leh pop . Leh ïa ngi katba me mon ; hynrei sngewbha , pyllait im ïa ngi ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ong ha U Trai: to leh ia ngi ia kaba bha ha me; to pyllait noh tang ia ngi, ngi duwai ia me, ha kane ka sngi .

en: And I took the little book out of the angel s hand , and ate it up  ; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey : and as soon as I had eaten it , my belly was bitter .
kha: Nga la shim ïa kata ka kot kli barit na ka kti jong u bad nga la bam ïa ka ; bad ha ka shyntur ka thiang kum ka ngap . Hynrei hadien ba nga la nguid ïa ka , ka la kylla jew ha ka  nierbah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia ka kot barit na ka kti jong u angel, bad nga la bam ia ka ha ka shyntur jong nga kaba thiang kum ka umsoh: bad tang shu bam ia ka , ka kpoh jong nga ka la tyrkhong .

en: Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .
kha: Nangta ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang kiba shong ha ki khet jong ki ha khmat U Blei ki la dem ngon ïa lade bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba ong :  Ko Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uta uba long bad uba la ju long ! Ngi ainguh ïa me ba me la shimti ïa ka bor bakhraw jong me bad me la sdang ban synshar !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ngi ainguh ia me , ko Trai Blei Baroh, kaba long, bad kaba la leit noh, bad ka long kaba dei ban wan ; namar ba me la shim ha me ia ka bor kaba khraw jong me, bad me la synshar .

en: Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .
kha: Haba u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh noh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lko pum ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba lah ban ieng ha khmat ka jingbitar jong u ? bad mano ba lah ban bat ia ka jingbitar jong u ? ka jingbitar jong u ka la tuid kum ka ding , bad ki maw ki shah pynhap noh da u .

en: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord  , no man shall abide there , neither shall a son of man dwell in it .
kha: Kajuh hi kan jia ïa ka Edom kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , mynba ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong ba-marjan la pynjot . Yn ym don ban sah biang hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ha ka jinghiar jong ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah bad ki nongbah ba marjan jong ka , ong U Trai , ym don briew uba sah hangta , lymne u khun u briew un shong ha ka .

en: ( Matthew 24 :14 ) What a joy it would be if you were able to help someone else to become a servant of Jehovah and gain eternal life !—1 Thessalonians 2 :19 , 20 .
kha: ( Mathaios 24 :14 ) Katno phin kmen lada phi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei ban long ki shakri jong U Jehobah bad ban ioh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—1 Thessaloni 2 :19 , 20 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Mathaios 24 :14 ) Kaei ka jingkmen lada phi lah ban iarap ia uwei pat ban long u shakri jong U Jehobah bad ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut !1 Thessaloni 2 :19 , 20 .

en: And the name of the star is called Wormwood : and the third part of the waters became wormwood  ; and many men died of the waters , because they were made bitter .
kha: ( Ka kyrteng uta u khlur ka long  Ka Jingkthang .  ) Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka um ka la kylla kthang , bad bun ki briew ki la ïap na kaba dih ïa kane ka um , namar ka la kylla kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong u khlur la khot Wormwood: bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ki um ka la kylla long kaba sniew ; bad bun ki briew ki la iap na ki um , namar ki la shah pynsngewsih .

en: Howbeit the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places . He built the higher gate of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynpra , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta . U dei u Jotham uba la tei ïa ka Khyrdop Bashaneng jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki jaka ba jrong kim shym la jah noh: ki briew ki la knia bad thang ia ka jingiwbih kaba dang don ha ki jaka ba jrong . U la tei ia ka khyrdop kaba kham halor jong ka iing U Trai .

en: These things I have spoken unto you , that in me ye might have peace . In the world ye shall have tribulation : but be of good cheer  ; I have overcome the world .
kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingsuk da kaba phi long lem bad nga . Ka pyrthei kan pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom . Hynrei to long shlur ! Nga , nga la jop ïa ka pyrthei !
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei kiba nga la kren ha phi, ba ha nga phin ioh ia ka jingsuk . Ha ka pyrthei phin sa shah pynshitom: hynrei to long kiba sngewbha; nga la jop ia ka pyrthei .

en: And it came to pass after forty years , that Absalom said unto the king , I pray thee , let me go and pay my vow , which I have vowed unto the  Lord  , in Hebron .
kha: Hadien saw snem , u Absalom u ong ha u syiem Dabid ,  Kynrad , shah ngan leit sha Hebron ban pyndep ïa la ka kular ba nga la ai ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien sawphew snem, u Absalom u la ong ha u syiem, nga kyrpad ia me, to ngan leit siew ia ka jingkular jong nga, kaba nga la kular ha U Trai, ha Hebron .

en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .
kha: U Jakob u shim ïa ki tnat kiba dang im na ka dieng lieng , u diengsoh almond , bad u dieng Sning , bad u khoh snep ha katto katne jaka haduh ba ki tnat dieng kin da paw ka met lieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la shim ia u da ki dieng kiba jyrngam bad kiba jyrngam bad kiba jyrngam bad kiba jyrngam ha ki, bad u la pynlong ia u dieng lieh uba la don ha ki dieng .

en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a merciful God  ; ) he will not forsake thee , neither destroy thee , nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them .
kha: U long U Blei uba isynei . Un ym iehnoh lane pynjot ïa phi , bad un ym klet ïa ka jutang kaba u hi u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u long U Blei uba isynei ; ) un ym iehnoh ia me, lymne un ym pynjot ia me, lymne un ym klet ia ka jutang jong ki kpa tymmen jong me kaba u la sngap jar ia ki .

en: And when he went out the second day , behold , two men of the Hebrews strove together : and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?
kha: Haba u leit sa ha kawei pat ka sngi , u ïohi ar ngut ki Hebru kiba ïashoh . U ong ha uta uba leh bymdei ,  Balei me da shoh ïa la u para Hebru ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la mih ha ka sngi kaba ar, ha khmih, arngut ki Hebru ki la ia tyngkhuh lang: bad u la ong ia u uba la leh bakla: Balei me la pyniap ia u paralok jong me ?

en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron : ( now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba : ) and they slew Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai .
kha: Ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Hebron , ïa kaba la ju khot ka Kiriath Arba . Hangta ki la jop ïa ki kur jong u Sheshai , u Ahiman bad u Talmai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la leit pyrshah ia ki nong Canaan kiba shong ha Hebron : (mynta ka kyrteng u Hebron shuwa ka long u Kirjatharba : ) bad ki la pyniap ia u Shisai, bad u Ahiman, bad u Talmai .

en: And they , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear , ( for they are a rebellious house , ) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them .
kha: La kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah kin shahshkor ïa me ne kim shahshkor , kin tip ba don u nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki , la kin iohsngew ne kin iehnoh , (namar ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah), hynrei kin tip ba la don u nongiathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .

en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .
kha: Nga la long tang ma nga hi uba la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , hynrei ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ïamareh bad leit rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang ma nga u Daniel u la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew: namar ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad nga kim shym la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew hynrei ka jingsawa kaba khraw ka la hap ha ki, haduh ba ki la phet noh ban buhrieh ia lade .

en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers  ;
kha: Naba phi tip ïa kaei kaba la siew ban pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka rukom im bymmyntoi kaba la ïohpateng na ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kam shym long kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban pynjot , kum ka rupa ne ka ksiar ;
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba phi tip ba phim shym la shah pyllait im da kiei kiei kiba pyut, kum ka rupa bad ka ksiar , na ka jingiakren kaba lehnohei jong phi kaba la ioh da ka dustur na ki kpa tymmen jong phi;

en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet , then ye shall say , Absalom reigneth in Hebron .
kha: Hynrei u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Israel baroh ban ong ,  Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki turoi , pyrta jam , ‘ U Absalom u la long syiem ha Hebron !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Absalom u la phah ia ki nongleit jingleit baroh ki jait Israel, u da ong: Tang shu iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi , te phin ong: U Absalom u la synshar ha Hebron .

en: And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife , and went in unto her , and lay with her : and she bare a son , and he called his name Solomon : and the  Lord  loved him .
kha: Te u Dabid u la pyntngen ïa ka Bathsheba ka tnga jong u . U la ïathiah shongkha bad ka ; bad ka la kha khun shynrang , ïa uba u Dabid u la ai kyrteng u Solomon . U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u khynnah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pyntngen ia ka tnga jong u, bad u la leit sha ka, bad u la thiah bad ka: bad ka la kha khun shynrang: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Solomon: bad U Trai u la ieit ia u .

en: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse , which sword proceeded out of his mouth : and all the fowls were filled with their flesh .
kha: Ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki la pynïap da ka waitlam kaba mihnoh na ka shyntur jong uta uba la shong halor u kulai ; bad ki sim baroh ki la bam baroh kat kaba ki lah na ka doh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kiba sah la pyniap da ka waitlam jong uta uba shong halor u kulai , kaba la mih na ka shyntur jong u: bad ki sim baroh ki la dap da ka doh jong ki .

en: So they feared the  Lord  , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places , which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places .
kha: Kine ki briew ki mane ruh ïa U  Trai  bad ki jied napdeng jong ki baroh ki jait briew bapher ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ki jaka mane blei thala bad ban ai jingkñia ïa ki hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la tieng ia U Trai , bad ki la leh ia lade na ki lyngdoh kiba rit tam jong ki jaka ba jrong , kiba la knia na ka bynta jong ki ha ki iing jong ki jaka ba jrong .

en: But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .
kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal ,  Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la phah katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uwei na ki samla u la iathuh ha u Abigail, ka tnga jong u Nabal, u da ong: Ha khmih u Dabid u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor na ka ri khlaw ban ai khublei ia u kynrad jong ngi; bad u la iaid lynti ia ki .

en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him : they are gone down , they lie uncircumcised , slain by the sword .
kha: Ki riewshlur bakhraw tam bad kito kiba ïaleh na ka liang ka Ijipt , ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nong Ijipt sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki ïa-pyrta : Ki bymriewblei kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ki la wan hiar shane bad hangne ki thiah !
translated_en_to_kha: Uba khlain hapdeng kiba khlain bor un kren ia u na pdeng ka dujok bad kito kiba iarap ia u: ki la leit noh , ki la thiah khlem da ot da ka waitlam .

en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
kha: Kynsan kynsan la don ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; u angel U Trai u la wan hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u maw , bad u la shong halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw: namar u angel U Trai u la hiar na bneng , bad u la wan bad u la pynkhih biang ia u maw na ka jingkhang , bad u la shong halor jong u .

en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .
kha: bad sa uwei u masi bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok . Dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban leh ïa kane namar U  Trai  un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u masi bad u langbrot na ka bynta ki jingknia jingsuk, ban knia ha khmat U Trai ; bad ka jingknia doh ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang: namar ha ka sngi U Trai un paw ha phi .

en: And Elisha said unto them , This is not the way , neither is this the city : follow me , and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek . But he led them to Samaria .
kha: Nangta u Elisha u sha ki bad u ong ,  Phi la bakla lynti ; kane kam dei kata ka shnong kaba phi wad . Bud ïa nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha uta u briew ïa uba phi wad .  Bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong ha ki, Kane kam dei ka lynti, bad kane ka shnong: to bud ia nga, bad ngan wanrah ia phi sha uta u briew uba phi wad . Hynrei u la ialam ia ki sha Samaria .

en: Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :
kha: Te mynta , lada phin kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ka jutang jong nga , phin long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka long ka jong nga , bad phi pat phin long ki briew kiba nga la jied ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata lada phin kohnguh shisha ia ka sur jong nga, bad phin sumar ia ka jutang jong nga, te phin long ka spah kaba kyrpang ha nga halor ki briew baroh: namar ka khyndew baroh ka long ka jong nga:

en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha , which by interpretation is called Dorcas : this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did .
kha: Ha Joppa la don ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Tabitha , kaba long ka riewngeit . ( Ka kyrteng jong ka ha ka Ktien Grik ka long ka Dorkas , kaba mut  ka skei .  ) Ka la pynlut ïa ka por jong ka baroh ha kaba leh babha bad ha kaba ïarap ïa kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la don ha Joppa uwei u synran uba kyrteng u Tabitha, uba la khot ka Dorkas: kane ka kynthei ka la dap da ki kam kiba bha bad ki jingai sngewbha kiba ka la leh .

en: And it came to pass , when I , even I Daniel , had seen the vision , and sought for the meaning , then , behold , there stood before me as the appearance of a man .
kha: Nga la pyrshang ban sngewthuh aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba kynsan uwei u la wan ïeng ha khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba nga, wat ma nga ruh nga la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew, bad nga la wad ia ka jingmut, te, ha khmih, nga la ieng ha khmat jong nga kum u briew .

en: Thou wilt surely wear away , both thou , and this people that is with thee : for this thing is too heavy for thee  ; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone .
kha: Phin shu ïa-pynthait ïa lade bad ruh ïa kine ki briew . Kane ka khia than eh ba phin leh tang marwei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi thikna ba phin sa jah noh, ma me bad une u briew uba don bad me: namar kane ka long kaba khia palat ia me; me lah ban pyndep ia ka hi .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , katba kaba shapoh ka dap da kaei kaba phi ïoh da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpyrkhat tang ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi pynkhuid ia ka bynta ba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang , hynrei hapoh jong ki ki dap da ka jingkhih bad palat .

en: Consider the ravens : for they neither sow nor reap  ; which neither have storehouse nor barn  ; and God feedeth them : how much more are ye better than the fowls ?
kha: Khmih ïa ki tyngab : Kim shym bet symbai lane lum ïa ka jingot ; kim don ki jaka kynshew lane ki thiar ; U Blei u bsa ïa ki ! Phi long kiba kor kham bun shah ban ïa ki sim !
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat ia ki raven: namar kim ju bet ne ot ; ki bym don jaka buh ne phyllaw bad U Blei U ai bam ia ki: katno phi kham bha ban ia ki sim ?

en: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life : for there is no matter hid from the king , and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me .
kha: Hynrei lada ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u Absalom , u syiem un ïohsngew shaphang kata — namar u ïohsngew shaphang kaei kaei baroh — bad phin ym ïada satia ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta nga la dei ban leh ia ka jinglamler pyrshah ia la ka jong ka jingim: namar ym don ei ei kaba buhrieh na u syiem , bad me hi me la buh ia lade pyrshah ia nga .

en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .
kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ka shithi kaba lyngkot da ka jingïarap u Silas , ïa uba nga ñiew kum u para Khristan baïaineh . Nga kwah ban pynshlur ïa phi bad ban ai ïa ka jingphla jong nga ba kane ka dei ka jingaiei bashisha jong U Blei . To ïeng skhem ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u Silvanus, u hynmen uba iaineh ha phi, kumba nga tharai, nga la thoh lyngkot, nga la kyntu bad nga la sakhi ba kane ka long ka jingaiei bashisha jong U Blei ha kaba phi ieng .

en: And the  Lord  shall smite Egypt : he shall smite and heal it : and they shall return even to the  Lord  , and he shall be entreated of them , and shall heal them .
kha: U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa ki Ijipt , hynrei pynban un pynkhiah ïa ki . Kin phai sha u , bad un ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad pynkoit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un shoh ia ka Ijipt: un pynkhih bad pynkoit ia ka: bad kin leit phai noh wat sha U Trai ruh: bad un sa shah pynkyntang na ki .

en: Simon Peter went up , and drew the net to land full of great fishes , an hundred and fifty and three : and for all there were so many , yet was not the net broken .
kha: U Simon Petros u la leit kiew ha ka lieng bad u la tan sha ryngkew ïa ka jar kaba la dap da ki dohkha kiba heh , baroh ki don shispah sanphew lai tylli ; wat la ki la bun katta , pynban kata ka jar kam shym la kad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u la kiew shaneng bad u la tan ia ka net ban hiar da ki dohkha kiba heh , shispah sanphew lai : bad na ka bynta baroh ki la don bun , hynrei ym shym la pynpra ia ka net .

en: And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .
kha: U la khmih shaiñ ïa u angel ha ka jingsheptieng bad u la ong ,  Ka dei kaei , ko Kynrad ?  U angel u la jubab ,  U Blei u la sngewbha ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me , bad u kloi ban jubab ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit ia u, u la tieng, bad u la ong, Ko Trai ? Bad u la ong ha u , Ki jingduwai bad ki alms jong me ki wan shaneng na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw ha khmat U Blei .

en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , Did not ye hate me , and expel me out of my father s house ? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress ?
kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u jubab ,  Phi la isih ïap ïa nga kat haduh ba phi da beh ïa nga na ïing i pa . Balei phi wan sha nga mynta haba phi la shem jynjar ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la ong ha ki rangbah Gilead , Hato phim shun ia nga bad phim shym la beh noh ia nga na ka iing u kpa jong nga ? bad balei phi wan sha nga mynta haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar ?

en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kito ki Lebi , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba na ki paid Israel , kiba la iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Lebi kiba la leit noh na nga, haba ki Israel ki la iaid bakla na nga hadien ki bleithaw jong ki; kin kit wat ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .
kha: Kumta u Jephthah u leit bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , bad u paidbah u thung ïa u kum u nongsynshar bad u nongïalam jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndon na ka liang jong u ha Mispah ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jephthah u la leit bad ki rangbah jong ka Gilead, bad ki briew ki la pynlong ia u khlieh bad u rangbah halor jong ki: bad u Jephthah u la kren ia ki ktien jong u baroh ha khmat U Trai ha Mizpah .

en: And every man , with whom was found blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen , and goats  hair , and red skins of rams , and badgers  skins , brought them .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba don ka jaiñ linen kaba ni ; ne u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh ne uba rong saw ; ne ka jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang ; ne ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw ; ne ka snieh kaba jlih , u wanrah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u briew, uba la lap ia u sohjew uba rong saw bad uba saw bad uba saw, bad uba jem, bad u blang uba saw bad ki snieh langbrot kiba saw, bad ki snieh blang kiba saw, ki la wanrah ia ki .

en: And the children of Reuben , and the children of Gad , and half the tribe of Manasseh , passed over armed before the children of Israel , as Moses spake unto them :
kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad na ka shiteng ka jait Manasseh , ki la khreh ïa ka thma , ki la jam ha shuwa jong kiba sah jong uta u paidbah , kumba u Moses u la bthah ïa ki ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki ksiew Reuben bad ki khun Gad bad shiteng na ka jaitbynriew Manasseh ki la iaid lyngba ha khmat ki khun Israel kumba u Moses u la kren ha ki:

en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .
kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la pyrkhat ban iaid ha ka hukum U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel da ka dohnud baroh: namar um shym la leit noh na ki pop jong u Jeroboan , kiba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .
kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la khyllad ; ka dei ka snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba san hi na ka jingot jong me wat kheit ia ki sohjew jong me: namar ka long ka snem jong ka jingjahthait ha ka ri .

en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
kha: Kumta , kumba u Joshua u la hukum , ka kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki turoi ; hadien jong kine bud sa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , kiba la bud pat da ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai ki la leit sha khmat ki lyngdoh kiba la pyrta da ki turoi , bad ki lyngdoh ki la wan hadien ka synduk , ki lyngdoh ki iaid shakhmat bad ki turoi .

en: And Sarai Abram s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian , after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan , and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife .
kha: Kumta ka la ai ïa ka Hagar ha u ba kan long ka tnga kliar jong u . ( Kane ka la jia hadien ba u Abram u la shong la sah shiphew snem ha ka ri Kanaan . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnga jong ka Sarai Abram ka la shim ia ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt jong ka, hadien ba u Abram u la shong shi snem ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la ai ia ka ha u tnga jong ka u Abram ban long ka tnga jong u .

en: The place of the scripture which he read was this , He was led as a sheep to the slaughter  ; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer , so opened he not his mouth :
kha: Ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba u dang pule ka la long kane :  Kum ka langbrot ïa kaba la ïalam ban shah pynïap , kum u khunlangbrot uba sngap jar haba khap ïa u shñiuh jong u , um shym kren wat shikyntien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka jong ka jingthoh kaba u pule ka long kane , La ialam ia U kum u langbrot sha ka jingpyniap ; bad kum u langbrot uba dum ha khmat u nongpynkhuid jong u , kumta um shym la plie ia ka shyntur jong u:
