en: For he hath put all things under his feet . But when he saith all things are put under him , it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u .  Ka long kaba shai , da shisha , ba ki ktien  kiei kiei baroh  kim kynthup ïa U Blei hi , uba buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u . Hynrei haba u ong ba kiei kiei baroh ki la buh hapoh jong u , ka paw ba u long uba lait noh uba la buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u .

en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .
kha: U shakri u ngeit ïa ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl bad ïa ka hukum ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha , bad u long uba stad ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiei ki jong u Khrist ha pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U mraw u long uba iaineh ha ki jingshisha jong ka Baibl bad ha ka jingbthah jong ka ban ialap ia ka khubor babha , bad ka long kaba rieh shaphang kumno ka sngewkhia da ka jingstad ia ki jingmyntoi jong U Khrist ha ka pyrthei .

en: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way  ; yet saidst thou not , There is no hope : thou hast found the life of thine hand  ; therefore thou wast not grieved .
kha: Phi pynthait ïa lade ban leit wad ïa kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei phim shym la sangeh . Phi pyrkhat ba ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi kin ai bor ïa phi , bad kumta phim ju khie tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la sngewsih ha ka jingkhraw jong ka lynti jong me ; hynrei me la ong: Ym don jingkyrmen: me la shem ia ka jingim jong ka kti jong me ; namarkata me la sngewsih .

en: This was the word of the  Lord  which he spake unto Jehu , saying , Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass .
kha: Kumta ïa ka jingkular la pyndep ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha u syiem Jehu :  Ki khun ki ksiew jong me , haduh ka pateng kaba saw , kin long ki syiem ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka la long ka ktien U Trai kaba u la kren ha u Jehu , u da ong , Ki khun jong me kin shong ha ka khet Israel haduh ka pateng kaba saw . Bad kumta ka la jia .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and all that he did , and his sin that he sinned , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Manasseh u la leh , kynthup ïa ki pop ba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Manasseh bad ka pop jong u ba u la leh pop , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure , wherewith the  Lord  was wroth against you to destroy you . But the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also .
kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  , naba u la bitar lep kat haduh ba u la kloi wat ban pynjot ïa phi ; hynrei sa shisien U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la tieng ia ka jingbitar bad ka jingbym sngewbha kaba jur, ha kaba U Trai u la bitar ia phi ban pynjot ia phi . Hynrei U Trai u la sngap ia nga ha kata ka por ruh .

en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and shall return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .
kha: U  Trai  un pynjia ïa u nongsynshar ban ïohsngew ïa ka hamsaïa ka ban pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri , bad U  Trai  un pynjia ba yn pynïap ïa u hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan phah ia ka jingbthei halor jong u , bad un iohsngew ia ka khubor , bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka ri ; bad ngan pynlong ia u ban hap da ka waitlam ha la ka jong ka ri .

en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :
kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khlaw noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, to pynmih noh ia ka: ka kham bha ia me ban rung sha ka hima U Blei da kawei ka khmat, ban ia kaba don ar tylli ki khmat ban shah bret ha dujok:

en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .
kha: U Joab u ong ha u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga ; bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit bad ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Lada ki Syria ki long kiba khlain palat ia nga, te me iarap ia nga: hynrei lada ki khun Ammon ki long kiba khlain palat ia me , te ngan wan iarap ia me .

en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate , and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste  ; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword .
kha: Ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew u Isaak ki mane Blei yn sa pynjot noh . Ïa ki jaka kyntang jong ki Israel yn sa iehnoh ha ki jingjot . Ngan wallam ïa ka longïing syiem jong u syiem Jeroboam sha ka jingkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaka ba jrong jong u Isaak kin sa jah rngai noh bad ki jaka kyntang jong ki Israel kin sa jah rngai noh; bad ngan kiew pyrshah ia ka iing u Jeroboan da ka waitlam .

en: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs , that he should bring certain of the children of Israel , and of the king s seed , and of the princes  ;
kha: U syiem u la hukum ïa u Ashpenas , u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh jong u , ban jied napdeng ki nong Israel kiba la shah ringmraw ïa ki katto katne ngut ki samla shynrang na ka longïing syiem bad na ki longïing ki riewkhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la kren ha u Ashpenaz u kynrad jong u, ba un wanrah katto katne na ki khun Israel bad na u symbai syiem, bad na ki rangbah;

en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki leh palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , bad ki la pynlong ia u ban sngewsih ia ki pop jong ki kiba ki la leh , halor kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kpa jong ki ki la leh .

en: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khuid ha ki liang baroh bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingim , bad ka met — kaba lait na kano kano ka jingbakla ha ka jingwan jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei jong ka jingsuk hi u pynkyntang ia phi baroh kawei bad nga duwai ia U Blei ba ka mynsiem bad ka mynsiem bad ka met jong phi baroh kawei kan long kaba khlem jingbakla haduh ka jingwan U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: But we will not boast of things without our measure , but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us , a measure to reach even unto you .
kha: Pynban na ka bynta jong ngi , ki jingkob sarong jong ngi kin ym ïaid palat pud ; kan don hapoh u pud jong ka jingtrei kaba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi , bad kane ka kynthup ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngin ym sngew sarong ia kiei kiei khlem ka jingthew jong ngi , hynrei kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jingsynshar kaba U Blei u la sam ha ngi , ka jingthew ban poi wat sha phi ruh .

en: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
kha: bad haba ki la wan ha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ïa uta u briew uba ju don shibun ki ksuid hapoh jong u . U la shong hangta , u la phong jaiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bad baroh ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan sha U Jisu, bad ki iohi ia uta uba la shah ktah ha u ksuid, bad u don ka jingpang sniehdoh, u shong bad u la phong da ka jain bad ha ka jingmut kaba dei jong u: bad ki la tieng .

en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;
kha: To khmih ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kum ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban ïoh im , kumba u Paul u para ba-ieit jong ngi u la thoh ha phi , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkhein ba ka jingshah shitom jong U Trai jong ngi ka long ka jingpynim ; kumba u hynmen baieit jong ngi u Paul ruh kat kum ka jingstad ba la ai ha u u la thoh ha phi ; .

en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .
kha: Nangta shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta shim biang ia ki, bad bret ia ki hapdeng ka ding, bad thang ia ki ha ka ding ; namar na ka ding kan mih sha ka iing Israel baroh kawei .

en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ring sha me sha ka wah Kishon Sisera, u rangbah shipai jong u Jabin, bad ki kali jong u bad ka kynhun jong u; bad ngan aiti ia u ha ka kti jong me .

en: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son , whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh s house : and Genubath was in Pharaoh s household among the sons of Pharaoh .
kha: Ka kha ha u ïa u khun , u Genubath , ïa uba la pynsan pynrangbah da ka syiem ha ïingsyiem , ha kaba u shong u sah lem bad ki khun shynrang u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka para jong u Tahpenes ka la kha ia u Genubath u khun jong u, uba u Tahpenes u la kha ha iing u Pharaoh: bad u Genubath u la don ha iing u Pharaoh hapdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Pharaoh .

en: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel , Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah , Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoram u khun jong u Jehoshaphat , u la long u syiem ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra jong u Joram u khun u Ahab u syiem Israel , u Jehoshaphat u la sdang ban synshar ha Judah .

en: And it shall come to pass , for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter : for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land .
kha: kin ai shibun ka dud kaba un dih kat kaba u donkam baroh . Ho-oid , khyndiat ngut kiba lait im kiba la iehnoh ha ka ri kin don ka dud bad ka ngap ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, namar ka jingbun ka dud kaba kin ai un bam ia ka butter: namar ka butter bad ka umsoh uwei pa uwei un bam ia kaba sah ha ka ri .

en: And it came to pass , that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki ïalum ar shah , saw kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew . Ki nongïalam baroh jong ka kynhun ki wan ïathuh shaphang kata ha u Moses ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew ki la lum ar shah ia u kpu, ar tylli ki omer na ka bynta uwei u briew : bad ki nongsynshar jong ka jingiaseng baroh ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ha u Moses .

en: And it was so , as she rode on the ass , that she came down by the covert of the hill , and , behold , David and his men came down against her  ; and she met them .
kha: Katba ka dang shong halor ka kada hajan kaba khun ha ka sharing lum , kynsan ka la ïashem ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wan sha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, katba ka dang shong ha ka tdong jong u lum, ba ka la wan hiar da ka jingtap jong u lum, bad, ha khmih u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la wan hiar shapoh jong ka ; bad ka la iakynduh ia ki .

en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .
kha: Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingstad . Uno uno uba shemphang u lah ban batai ïa ka jingmut jong u dak jingkheiñ jong u mradkhlaw , namar u dak jingkheiñ u ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u briew . U dak jingkheiñ jong kata ka kyrteng u long hynriewspah hynriewphew hynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangne ka don ka jingstad . To ai ba uta uba don ka jingsngewthuh un khein ia ka jingdon jong u mrad: namar ka long ka jingdon jong u briew ; bad ka jingdon jong u ka long hynriew spah hynriewphew hynriew .

en: And as David and his men went by the way , Shimei went along on the hill s side over against him , and cursed as he went , and threw stones at him , and cast dust .
kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki bteng la ka jingïaid lynti . U Shimei u bud ïa ki , u da ïaid na ka sharing lum ; u da tim bad kawang maw bad khyndew ha ki katba u dang ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki dang iaid lynti, u Shimei u la iaid sha shiliang lum pyrshah ia u, bad u la tim katba u dang iaid, bad u la ther maw ia u bad u la bret ia ka dewbilat .

en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .
kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la don ha ka jingjynjar haba la bthah ba ki dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la ju shna mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ophisar jong ki Israel ki la iohi ba ki la don ha ka jingjia kaba sniew, hadien ba la ong ia ka , Phim dei ban pynduh ia ki nar jong phi kiba man ka sngi .

en: They did work wilily , and went and made as if they had been ambassadors , and took old sacks upon their asses , and wine bottles , old , and rent , and bound up  ;
kha: bad ki la ïa-rai ban shukor ïa u . Ki la leit bad rah katto katne ka jingbam bad ki pynkit ha ki kada jong ki da ki byrni jot bad ki pla snieh waiñ kiba la syrdep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la trei shitom , bad ki la leit bad ki la leh kum ki nonglam khubor , bad ki la shim ia ki lyngkhot lyngkhai kiba rim ha ki tdong jong ki , bad ki bilor wain kiba la rim bad kiba la shah rong noh .

en: The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?
kha: u la ong ,  Ha khmih katno khraw ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong nga ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , ka burom jong nga bad ka jinglong syiem jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la kren bad u la ong: Hato kane ka Babilon kaba khraw kam dei kaba nga la tei na ka bynta ka iing jong ka hima da ka bor jong nga bad na ka bynta ka burom jong ka jingkhraw jong nga ?

en: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last , as it were appointed to death : for we are made a spectacle unto the world , and to angels , and to men .
kha: Naba ka paw ha nga ba U Blei u la ai ïa ka jaka bakhatduh tam ha ngi ki Apostol , kum ki briew kiba la rai pynrem ban shah ïap ha khmat u paidbah kum ka jingthadrong ha khmat ka pyrthei baroh kaba dei jong ki angel bad jong u bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la buh ia ngi ki apostol khatduh: namar ngi la shah pynlong ka jinglehkai ha ka pyrthei bad ha ki angel bad ha ki briew .

en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :
kha: Te u Isaïah u la phah ka khubor ban ïathuh ha u syiem Hesekaïah kaba jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Isaiah u khun u Amoz u la phah sha u Hesekaiah, u da ong: Kumta u ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel: Katba me la duwai ha nga pyrshah ia u Sennakherb syiem Assyria:

en: 1 , 2 . Jehovah gave the Israelites what kind of start , but what happened to them ? JEHOVAH gave the Israelites an upright start in the days of the prophet Moses .
kha: 1, 2. U Jehobah u la ai ha ki Israel ka jait jingsdang aiu hynrei kaei kaba la jia ia ki ? U Jehobah u la ai ia ki Israel ia ka jingsdang kaba hok ha ki sngi jong u nongiathuhlypa Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: 1, 2 . U Jehobah u la ai ia ki Israel ia ka jingsdang kaba kumno , hynrei kaei kaba la jia ia ki ? U JEHOVAH u la ai ia ki Israel ia ka jingsdang kaba beit ha ki sngi jong u Moses .

en: And they shall be mine , saith the  Lord  of hosts , in that day when I make up my jewels  ; and I will spare them , as a man spareth his own son that serveth him .
kha: Kin long ki briew jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .  Ha ka sngi ba ngan trei ïa ka kam , kin long ki jong nga hi . Ngan leh-isynei ïa ki kumba u kpa u leh-isynei ïa u khun uba shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin long ki jong nga, ong U Trai jong ki paid, ha kata ka sngi haba nga pynlong ia ki mawkordor jong nga ; bad ngan pyllait im ia ki, kumba u briew u pyllait im ia la u jong u khun uba shakri ia u .

en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters , but they only shall be delivered themselves .
kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Hynrei tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kine ki lai ngut ki briew ki don ha ka , kumba nga im , ong U Blei Trai , kin ym pynpoi ia ki khun shynrang ne kynthei , hynrei tang ma ki hi kin shah pynpoi .

en: But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .
kha: hynrei leit rah ïa ki tang ha kawei ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  un jied na ka ri jong kawei na ki jait jong phi , bad hangta phin leh ïa kita baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied ha kawei na ki jaitbynriew jong me , hangta me ai ia ki jingknia thang jong me , bad hangta me leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga hukum ia me .

en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me , saying , Come , let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono . But they thought to do me mischief .
kha: Kumta u Sanballat bad u Geshem ki phah khubor sha nga , da kaba ai jingmut ba ngan ïakynduh bad ki ha kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Madan Ono . Kane ka la long ka buit sianti jong ki ban pyrshang ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka Sanballat bad u Geshem ki la phah sha nga, ki da ong, To wan, to ngin ia iakynduh lang ha kawei na ki shnong ha ka madan Ono . Hynrei ki la pyrkhat ban leh ia nga kaba sniew .

en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond : it is graven upon the table of their heart , and upon the horns of your altars  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong ka Judah , ïa ka pop jong phi la thoh da u khulom nar ; la pruid jylliew halor ki dohnud jong phi da u diamond banep bad la ohdur halor ki dong jong ki duwan jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pop jong u Judah ka long kaba la thoh da ka pen nar, bad da ka tduh jong u mawkordor: la ker ia ka ha ka miej jong ka dohnud jong ki, bad ha ki bniat jong ki almari jong phi;

en: Tell it not in Gath , publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon  ; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice , lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph .
kha: Wat pynbna ïa ka ha Gath lane ha ki surok ka Ashkelon . Wat pynlong ïa ki kynthei Philistia ban kmen , wat ai ba ki khun kynthei jong ki bymngeit blei kin risa .
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia ka ha Gath , wat pynmih ia ka ha ki lynti jong u Ashkelon lymta ki khun kynthei jong ki Philistia kin sngewbha , lymta ki khun kynthei jong ka jingjop bym pat shah ot .

en: For I know the forwardness of your mind , for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia , that Achaia was ready a year ago ; and your zeal hath provoked very many .
kha: Nga tip ba phi mon sngewbha ban ïarap , bad nga la kob sarong ïa phi ha ki briew ha Makedonia .  Ki parabangeit ha Akhaïa  nga la ong ,  ki la kloi ban ïarap naduh ka snem kaba la dep .  Ka jinglong ba la kloi jong phi ka la pynkhih ïa kiba bun na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia ka jinglong ba shakhmat jong phi, namar kaba nga sngew sarong ia phi ha ki jong ka Makedonia, ba u Akhaia u la pynkhreh snem shuwa; bad ka jingkmen jong phi ka la pynkhih shibun .

en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .
kha: U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Joseph , bad mar kumta la wan sei ïa u na ka ïingbyndi . Ynda u la dep khi tmain bad bujli jaiñ , u leit ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u la phah bad u la khot ia u Joseph , bad ki la wanrah ia u da kaba kyrkieh na ka thliew: bad u la ot ia lade, bad u la pynkylla ia ka jainkup jong u, bad u la wan rung sha u Pharaoh .

en: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,
kha: La pyndap ïa ki da baroh ki jait jingbymman , ka jingsniew , ka jingkwah lalot bad ka jingthala ; ki dap da ka jingbishni , ka jingpynïap briew , ka jingïaleh , ka jingshukor , ka jingshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong ba la pyndap da ka jingbymhok baroh, ka jingleh be-ijot, ka jingsniew, ka jingkwah brai, ka jingsngewsih ; kaba dap da ka jingsngewsih, ka jingpyniap briew, ka jingiatai, ka jingleh thok, ka jingleh be-ijot ; ki nongkren bein;

en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .
kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga . U dei U Blei jong nga , bad ngan ïaroh ïa u , U Blei jong u kpa jong nga , bad ngan rwai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long ka bor bad ka jingrwai jong nga, bad u la kylla long ka jingpynim jong nga: u long U Blei jong nga, bad ngan pynkhreh ia u ia ka jaka shong jaka sah; u kpa jong nga, bad ngan pynkhraw ia u .

en: Then said the king to the servants , Bind him hand and foot , and take him away , and cast him into outer darkness  ; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ïa ki shakri jong u , ‘ To khum ïa u bad kti bad kjat , bad bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum . Hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha ki shakri , To teh ia u da ka kti bad ka kjat bad to weng noh ia u, bad bret noh ia u sha ka jingdum kaba shabar;

en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .
kha: Ïa uno uno uba kren ka kyntien pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa uno uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba kren ia ka ktien pyrshah ia u Khun u briew , yn map ia u: hynrei ia uta uba kren bein ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid yn ym map ia u .

en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the rising be white in the skin , and it have turned the hair white , and there be quick raw flesh in the rising  ;
kha: u ban khmih bniah ïa u . Lada ka don ka prum kaba lieh ha ka sniehdoh jong u kaba la pynlieh ïa u shñiuh bad kaba dap da ka ksuit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un iohi ia u: bad, ha khmih, lada ka jingmih ka long lieh ha ka sniehdoh, bad ka la pynkylla ia u shniuh lieh, bad ka don ka doh kaba la tyrkhong kloi ha ka jingmih;

en: And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .
kha: Un phah noh ïa ki angel sha sawdong ka pyrthei ban ïalumlang ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , na kawei ka dong jong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta un phah ia ki angel jong u, bad un lum lang ia ki nongjied jong u na ki saw tylli ki Iyer, naduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew haduh kaba kut jong ka bneng .

en: And I looked , and behold a white cloud , and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man , having on his head a golden crown , and in his hand a sharp sickle .
kha: Nangta nga la khmih , bad la don u lyoh uba lieh , bad uba shong halor u lyoh u la long uta uba i kum u briew , uba don ka pansngiat ksiar halor ka khlieh jong u bad ka rashi kaba nep ha ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga peit, bad ha kata ka lyoh lieh, bad halor kata ka lyoh u la shong kum u Khun u briew, u don ha ka khlieh jong u ka khlieh ksiar bad ha ka kti jong u ka waitlam kaba jem .

en: And the king commanded Hilkiah , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Abdon the son of Micah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
kha: bad u ai ïa kane ka hukum harum ha u Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , u Abdon u khun jong u Mikaïah , u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum ia u Hilkiah bad u Ahikam u khun u Mica, bad u Abdon u khun u Mica, bad u Shaphan u nongthoh bad u Asaya u shakri u syiem u la ong:

en: And he said , Thou hast asked a hard thing : nevertheless , if thou see me when I am taken from thee , it shall be so unto thee  ; but if not , it shall not be so .
kha: Kata ka dei ka jingkyrpad kaba jwat ban ai ,  u Elijah u phai ktien .  Hynrei men ïohpdiang ïa ka lada me ïohi ïa nga haba dang shim noh ïa nga na me ; lada mem ïohi ïa nga , men ym ïohpdiang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Me la kylli ia kaei kaei kaba eh: wat la katta ruh lada me iohi ia nga haba nga la shah shim na me, kan long kumta ha me; hynrei lada ym long kumta .

en: But I will send a fire upon Moab , and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth : and Moab shall die with tumult , with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet :
kha: Ngan phah ka ding ha ka ri Moab bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Kerioth . Ki briew ka Moab kin ïap hapdeng ka jingkhynwin jong ka thma katba ki shipai ki dang khynwin bad ki turoi ki dang sawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan phah ding ia u Moab bad kan bam ia ki iing jong u Kerioth: bad u Moab un iap da ka jingsawa kaba jem bad da ka jingsawa jong ka turoi:

en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .
kha: Wallam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pynlong ia u masi ban wanrah ha khmat ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin buh ia ki kti jong ki ha ka khlieh jong u masi .

en: But if any widow have children or nephews , let them learn first to shew piety at home , and to requite their parents : for that is good and acceptable before God .
kha: Hynrei lada ka riewkynthei ka don ki khun ne ki khun ksiew , ki dei ban nang shuwa nyngkong ban khmih ïa ki kam ba kynja mynsiem ka longïing la jong hi bad ha kane ka rukom ki siew kylliang ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa ki kmierad parad , namar kata ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u riewkynthei u don ki khun ne ki khun ksiew , to ai ba kin nang nyngkong eh ban pyni ia ka jinglong riewblei ha iing , bad ban pdiang ia ki kmie ki kpa jong ki: namar kata ka long kaba bha bad kaba lah ban pdiang ha khmat U Blei .

en: That they feared greatly , because Gibeon was a great city , as one of the royal cities , and because it was greater than Ai , and all the men thereof were mighty .
kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki sngewkyndit shikatdei eh da ka jingsheptieng ha kane , namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaba heh kum kano kano ka nongbah kaba don la u syiem ; ka kham heh ban ïa ka Ai , bad ki rangbah jong ka ki long ki riewïaleh kiba tbit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki la tieng shibun eh, namar ka Gibeon ka long ka nongbah kaba khraw, kum kawei na ki nongbah syiem, bad namar ba ka kham heh ban ia u Ai, bad ki briew jong ka baroh ki long kiba khlain bor .

en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying , What seest thou ? And I said , I see a seething pot  ; and the face thereof is toward the north .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga ,  Sa kaei pat me ïohi ?  u la kylli . Nga jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa u khiew uba thnam ha ka phang bashatei , bad u la jan hap sha kane ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga ha ka sien kaba ar, ka ong: Me iohi aiu ? Bad nga la ong , nga iohi ia ka umphniang kaba jyrngam ; bad ka khmat jong ka ka long shaphang shathie .

en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the  Lord  , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony , that he die not :
kha: Hangta ha khmat U  Trai  un thang ïa kata ka jingiwbih , halor ka ding bad ka tdem jong kata ka jingiwbih kan kah ïa ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang khnang ba un ym ïohi ïa ka bad u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un buh ia ka jingiwbih halor ka ding ha khmat U Trai, ba u lyoh jong ka jingiwbih un tap ia ka jaka shong jingisynei kaba don halor ka sakhi, ba un ym iap:

en: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen , neither shall the beast of the land devour them  ; but they shall dwell safely , and none shall make them afraid .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew ba-thala kin ym lute shuh ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin ym pynïap bad bam duh ïa ki . Kin im ha ka jingshngain , bad yn ym don ba pynsheptieng ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym long shuh ki mrad khlaw jong ki jaitbynriew, lymne ki mrad khlaw jong ka ri kin ym bam ia ki ; hynrei kin shong suk im saiñ bad ym don mano mano ruh ki ban pyntieng ia ki .

en: For the cloud of the  Lord  was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .
kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong ki baroh shi lynter , ki lah ban ïohi mynsngi ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha uta u lyoh halor ka Ïingjaiñ , bad mynmiet pat ha ka ding kaba meh halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u lyoh U Trai u la don halor ka iingjain ha ka por mynstep , bad ka ding ka la don ha ka ha ka por miet , ha khmat ki Israel baroh , ha ki jingleit jong ki baroh .

en: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the  Lord  sent me from Kadesh–barnea to espy out the land  ; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart .
kha: Nga la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba u Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga na Kadesh Barnea ban syntiat ïa kane ka ri . Nga la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la dap sawphew snem ka rta haba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la phah ia nga na Kadeshbarnea ban leit shabar ka ri ; bad nga la wanrah biang ia u kumba ka la don ha ka dohnud jong nga .

en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .
kha: Nga long kum u mraw uba ïeng ha khmat u kynrad jong u . Kumno nga lah ban ïakren bad phi ? Ngam donbor lane jingpynhiar mynsiem kaba dang sah ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumno u shakri jong une u kynrad jong nga u lah ban kren bad une u kynrad jong nga ? namar ha nga, beit ym shym la sah bor ha nga, lymne ym don mynsiem shuh ha nga .

en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto Jerusalem  ; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan  ; thy father was an Amorite , and thy mother an Hittite .
kha: Ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha ka :  La kha ïa pha ha ka ri Kanaan . U kpa jong pha u dei u nong Amor bad ka kmie jong pha ka dei ka nong Hit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei ha Jerusalem; Ka jingkha bad ka jingkha jong me ka long na ka ri Kanaan; u kpa jong me u la long u Amorit , bad ka kmie jong me ka long ka Hit .

en: Many shall be purified , and made white , and tried  ; but the wicked shall do wickedly : and none of the wicked shall understand  ; but the wise shall understand .
kha: Ïa kiba bun ki briew yn pynkhuid . Kito kiba bymman kin ym sngewthuh hynrei kin ïailong bymman ; tang kito kiba stad kin shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun kin shah pynkhuid, bad shah pynlong lieh, bad shah pyrshang hynrei ki bymman kin leh sniew: bad ym don uwei ruh na ki bymman u ban sngewthuh; hynrei kiba stad kin sngewthuh .

en: And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .
kha: Haba u Araunah u la khmih sharum bad u ïohi ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ba ki ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jong u Dabid
translated_en_to_kha: U Aragah u peit bad u la iohi ia u syiem bad ki shakri jong u ba ki wan sha u : bad u Aragah u la mih noh bad u la dem khrup ha khmat u syiem ha khmat jong u ha khyndew .

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in all the way of David his father , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left .
kha: U Josaïah u la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ; u bud ïa ka nuksa jong u syiem Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong u , da kaba bud pyrkhing ïa baroh ki aiñ U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai bad u la iaid ha ka lynti jong u kpa jong u u Dabid bad um shym la phai sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: The patient often needs much emotional support in meeting the stress of the illness , in comprehending its nature , and in carrying on courageously in spite of it .
kha: U nongpang bunsien u donkam ia ka jingkyrshan kaba jur ha ka jingsngew ha kaba iakynduh ia ka jingeh jong ka jingpang , ha kaba sngewthuh ia ka jinglong jong ka , bad ha kaba iaid shakhmat da ka jingshlur wat hapdeng jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpang bunsien u donkam shibun ka jingkyrshan ha ka jingsngew ha kaba iakynduh ia ka jingeh jong ka jingpang , ha kaba sngewthuh ia ka jinglong jong ka , bad ha kaba iaid shakhmat da ka jingshlur wat hapdeng jong ka .

en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .
kha: Me la pyrsad ïa ka duriaw bad ka um ka kynton shajrong eh ; ka ïeng beit thik kum ka kynroh ; ka bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jingbthei jong ki shyntur jong me ki la ialum lang , ki wah ki la ieng beit kum ka kynhun , bad ki jingjylliew ki la ia tyngkhuh ha ka dohnud jong ka duriaw .

en: The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .
kha: A  Trai  , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïasaid bad me na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad jingeh bajur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Hooid kan long kaba bha bad ka jingsah jong me; shisha ngan pynlong ia u nongshun ban sngewbha ia me ha ka por kaba sniew bad ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar .

en: I am sought of them that asked not for me  ; I am found of them that sought me not : I said , Behold me , behold me , unto a nation that was not called by my name .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la kloi ban jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga , hynrei kim shym la duwai . Nga la ap ïa ki ban shem ïa nga , hynrei kim shym la pyrshang . Ka jaitbynriew kam shym la khot kyrpad ïa nga , wat lada nga long la kloi ban jubab , ‘ Hangne nga don ; ngan ïarap ïa phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la wad na ki ki bym pan ia nga ; nga lap na ki ki bym wad ia nga: Nga la ong: Ha nga, ha nga, ha ka jaitbynriew kaba ym shym la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
kha: Kine ki dei ki khun shynrang ba ka Leah ka la kha na u Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka Leah ki long laiphew lai ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Leah, kiba ka la kha ha u Jakob ha Paddanaram, bad ka khun jong u ka Dinanham: baroh ki mynsiem jong u bad ki khun kynthei jong u ki long laiphew lai ngut .

en: Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin roi kum ki symboh shyiap , bad ngan jin da la pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot ïa ki da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: U symbai jong me ruh u la long kum ka dewbilat, bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me kum ka mawlyngnai jong u; ka kyrteng jong u kam shym la shah ot ne shah pynjot na khmat jong nga .

en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side , where prayer was wont to be made  ; and we sat down , and spake unto the women which resorted thither .
kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ngi la mih shabar na ka nongbah sha ka rudwah , ha kaba ngi la pyrkhat ba yn don ka jaka ha kaba ki Jiw ki ïalumlang ban duwai . Ngi la ïashong bad ïakren bad ki kynthei kiba la ïalumlang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi Sabha ngi la mih na ka shnong harud wah, ha kaba ym shym la leh ia ka jingduwai ; bad ngi la shong, bad ngi la kren ia ki kynthei kiba la leit sha kata ka jaka .

en: Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .
kha: Mano te , ki ban pynrem ïa ki ? Ym U Khrist Jisu , uba la ïap , lane , ïa uba la pynmihpat bad uba don ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , uba ïasaid bad u na ka bynta jong ngi!
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba pynrem ? Ka long U Khrist uba la iap, hooid khamtam eh, uba la mihpat biang, uba don wat ha ka liang kadiang jong U Blei , uba ruh u pynlong ia ngi .

en: For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .
kha: Naba ka jingieit ïa ka spah ka long ka thymmei jong ki jait jingsniew baroh . Don kiba da kwah eh ban ïoh ïa ka haduh ba ki la ïaid sakma na ka jingngeit bad ki pait dohnud na ki jingsngewsih babun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingieit ia ka pisa ka long ka tynrai jong ki jingsniew baroh: kiba katba don kiba kwah hadien , ki la bakla na ka jingngeit , bad ki la pynkhih ia lade da ki jingsngewsih kiba bun .

en: And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .
kha: Haba u Paul u la wan , ki Jiw kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki la ïeng sawdong ïa u bad ki la sdang ban buh shibun ki jingmudui kiba khia pyrshah ïa u , ïa kiba kim lah ban pynshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan , ki Jiw kiba wan hiar na Jerusalem ki la ieng sawdong bad ki la buh bun ki jingujor kiba sngewsih pyrshah ia u Paul , kiba kim lah ban pynshisha .

en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan  ; and bring the number of them to me , that I may know it .
kha: U Dabid u la ai ki hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit lyngba ka Israel , na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip haduh katno ngut ki ïadon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Joab bad ha ki nongsynshar jong ki briew, To leit, to khein ia ki Israel naduh Beersheba haduh Dan ; bad wanrah ia ka jingkhein jong ki ha nga, ba ngan tip ia kata .

en: The princes of Judah , and the princes of Jerusalem , the eunuchs , and the priests , and all the people of the land , which passed between the parts of the calf  ;
kha: Ki rangbah synshar ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki lyngdoh , bad baroh ki nongïalam , ki la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad nga da kaba ïaid hapdeng ar tylli ki shiteng jong u masi kyrtong ïa uba ki la ot ha ki ar bynta . Hynrei ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad kim shym la bat ïa ki kyndon jong ka . Kumta ngan leh ïa kine ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa u masi kyrtong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah Judah bad ki rangbah Jerusalem, ki nongshong shnong bad ki lyngdoh bad ki briew baroh kiba iaid hapdeng ki bynta jong u khun masi ; .

en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people , and blessed them , and came down from offering of the sin offering , and the burnt offering , and peace offerings .
kha: Haba u Aaron u la pyndep lut ïa kita ki jingkñia , u rah ïa la ki kti sha uta u paidbah bad u kyrkhu ïa ki ; bad nangta u wan hiar noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la rah ia la ka kti sha ki briew bad u la kyrkhu ia ki, bad u la wan hiar na kaba ai ia ka jingknia pop bad ka jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk .

en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men , that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , and said , How do ye advise that I may answer this people ?
kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongaibuit jong u Solomon u kpa jong u ,  Ka jubab aïu phi ai jingmut ban ai ïa kine ki briew ?  U kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Rehoboam u la iamir jingmut bad ki rangbah kiba la ieng ha khmat u Solomon u kpa jong u katba u dang im bad u la ong: Kumno phi ai jingmut ba ngan jubab ia une u briew ?

en: Thou hast multiplied the nation , and not increased the joy : they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest , and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil .
kha: Me la ai ha ki ka jingkmen kaba khraw , ko  Trai  ; me la pynlong ïa ki ban kmen . Ki shadkmen ha kaei kaba me la leh kumba ki briew ki shadkmen haba ki ot kew lane haba ki ïabynta ïa ka spah ba la ïoh kurup .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynbun ia ka jaitbynriew , bad ngam shym la pynbun ia ka jingkmen: ki sngewbha ha khmat jong me kat kum ka jingkmen ha ka jingot , bad kumba ki briew ki sngewbha haba ki phiah ia ka jingjot .

en: And whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the tree roots  ; thy kingdom shall be sure unto thee , after that thou shalt have known that the heavens do rule .
kha: U angel u la ai hukum ban iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . Kane ka mut ba phin sa long syiem pat haba phi pdiang ba U Blei u synshar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki la hukum ban iehnoh ia u tynrai jong u dieng; ka hima jong me kan long kaba thikna ha me, hadien ba me la tip ba ki bneng ki synshar .

en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing  ; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season  ; there shall be showers of blessing .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ngan shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha sawdong u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hangta ngan kyrkhu ïa ki da kaba pynhap ïa u  lap praw haba ki donkam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ki bad ki jaka sawdong jong nga ka jingkyrkhu ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka um ban wan hiar ha ka aiom jong u ; kin don ki um slap jong ka jingkyrkhu .

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the ways of David his father , and declined neither to the right hand , nor to the left .
kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ; u bud ïa ka nuksa u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , da kaba bud thik ïa ki hukum U Blei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai bad u la iaid ha ki lynti jong u Dabid u kpa jong u, bad um shym la kyntait sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang .

en: And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :
kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , bad un wallam ki jingpynjot halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingtim ba la jer ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pyniakhlad ia u na ki jait Israel baroh, kat kum ki jingtim jong ka jutang baroh kiba la thoh ha kane ka Kitab ka hukum:

en: And when his disciples James and John saw this , they said , Lord , wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven , and consume them , even as Elias did ?
kha: Haba U Jakob bad u Ïoannis kiba long ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane , ki la ong ,  Ko Trai , hato me kwah ïa ngi ban kyrpad ïa ka ding ban hiar na bneng ban pynjot ïa ki kumba u Elijah u la leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki synran jong u u Jakob bad u Ioannis ki la iohi ia kane, ki la ong: Ko Trai , me kwah ba ngin hukum ia ka ding ban wan hiar na bneng bad ban bam ia ki kumba u Elias u la leh ?

en: Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :
kha: Nga pynjot ïa ka Babilon bad nga pynsngap jar ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipai ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad tur ïaleh da ki jingpyrta bajam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba U Trai u la pynsniew ia ka Babilon , bad u la pynjot noh na ka ia ka sur kaba khraw haba ki um jong ka ki khih kum ki um kiba khraw , ka jingsawa jong ka sur jong ki ka mih:

en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .
kha: Slem sa katno ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa nga ? Nga la ïohsngew shibun ïa kine ki jingkhñium !
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh katno ngan shah ia kane ka jingiaseng kaba sniew kaba pyrta ia nga ? Nga la iohsngew ia ki jingkyrhuh jong ki khun Israel kiba ki pyrta pyrshah ia nga .

en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed  ; as Gozan , and Haran , and Rezeph , and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar ?
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ka Gosan , Haran , bad Reseph , bad pynïap ïa ki briew ka Betheden kiba sah ha Telassar , bad ym don na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban pyllait im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew ki la pynpoi ia ki kiba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot kum u Gozan bad u Haran bad u Rezeph bad ki khun u Eden kiba la don ha Thelasar ?

en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the waters of Sihor ? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria , to drink the waters of the river ?
kha: Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Ijipt ban dih um na ka Nile ? Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba leit sha Assyria ban dih um na ka Ïuphratis ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha ka lynti jong ka ri Ijipt ban dih ia ki um jong u Sihor ? lane kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha ka lynti jong ka Assyria ban dih ia ki um jong ka wah ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Shim katto katne kham u dpei na ka lawar ding ; u Moses un kynting ïa u shajrong ha khmat u Pharaoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses bad ha u Aaron, To shim ia ki kti jong ka ding, bad to ai ba u Moses un theh ia ka sha bneng ha khmat u Pharaoh .

en: And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , What shall we do to the ark of the  Lord  ? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place .
kha: ki briew ki khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongleh myntor bad ki kylli ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ? Lada ngi phah biang ïa ka sha ka jaka jong ka da-ei ngin phah ryngkat bad ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la khot ia ki lyngdoh bad ki nongleh jadu ki da ong: Ngi leh aiu ia ka synduk U Trai ? iathuh ia ngi da kaba ngin phah ia ka sha ka jaka jong u .

en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :
kha: Hynrei sngewbha kynmaw lem ïa nga haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , bad sngewbha ruh ban ïathuh lem shaphang jong nga ha u syiem bad ïarap lem ïa nga ban ïohlait noh na kane ka ïingbyndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei pyrkhat ia nga haba kan long kaba bha bad me, bad nga pynpaw ia ka jingsngewbha, nga kyrpad ia me, ha nga, bad to kdew ia nga ha u Pharaoh, bad to pynmih noh ia nga na kane ka iing:

en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .
kha: U don bad u ka byrsha pynher stait , ban shoh ïa u kew baroh bad ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka thiar jong u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongkyrshan jong u u don ha ka kti jong u , bad un pynkhuid bha ia ka mala jong u , bad un lum ia u kew ha ka jaka lum jong u ; hynrei ia u sohjew un thang da ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynkhih .

en: Bel boweth down , Nebo stoopeth , their idols were upon the beasts , and upon the cattle : your carriages were heavy loaden  ; they are a burden to the weary beast .
kha: Kane ka dei kaba kut jong ki blei ka Babilon ! Ïa u Bel bad ïa u Nebo shisien la mane ïa ki , hynrei mynta la pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada , ka jingbankhia ïa ki met ki mrad ba la thait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bel u dem khrup , u Nebo u dem khrup, ki bleithaw jong ki ki la don halor ki mrad bad halor ki masi: ki kali jong phi ki la long kiba heh ; ki long ka jingkit kaba khia ia u mrad uba la tyrkhong .

en: So he departed from Elisha , and came to his master  ; who said to him , What said Elisha to thee ? And he answered , He told me that thou shouldest surely recover .
kha: U Hasael u leit phai sha u Benhadad , uba kylli ïa u ,  U Elisha u ong kumno ?  U Hasael u jubab ,  U ong ha nga ba phin sa koit sa khiah bha pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit noh na u Elisha , bad u la wan sha u kynrad jong u; uba la ong ia u: Kaei kaba u la ong ia me ? Bad u la jubab , U la ong ia nga ba me dei ban koit shisha .

en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan phai sha nga bad ngan wan phai sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ki , Kumta to phai sha nga , ong U Trai jong ki paid , bad ngan phai sha phi , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: Lord  , when thou wentest out of Seir , when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom , the earth trembled , and the heavens dropped , the clouds also dropped water .
kha: Ko  Trai  , mynba me mihnoh na ki lum jong ka Seir , Haba me la mihnoh na ka thain Edom , Ka khyndew ka khynñiuh bad u slap u hap na sahit bneng . Ho-oid , la theh ïa ka um na ki lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Trai , haba me la mih na Seir , haba me la mih na ka lyngkha Edom , ka khyndew ka la khih bad ki bneng ki la tuid , ki lyoh ruh ki la tuid um .

en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him , Behold , thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken  ; for she is a man s wife .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet , U Blei u mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad u ong ha u ,  Men sa ïap , namar me la shim ïa kane ka briew ; ka la dep shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wan sha u Abimelech ha ka jingphohsniew miet bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih me long tang u briew uba la iap, namar kata ka kynthei kaba me la shim; namar ka long ka tnga shynrang .

en: And I punished them oft in every synagogue , and compelled them to blaspheme  ; and being exceedingly mad against them , I persecuted them even unto strange cities .
kha: Bunsien nga la phah pynshitom ïa ki ha ki synagog baroh bad pyrshang ban pynlong ïa ki ban len ïa la ka jingngeit . Nga la bitar haduh katta katta ïa ki ba nga da leit sha ki nongbah nongwei ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynshitom ia ki bunsien ha man la ka synagog , bad nga la pynbor ia ki ban kren bein ia ki; bad nga la sngewsih palat ia ki .

en: And the  Lord  their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people : for they shall be as the stones of a crown , lifted up as an ensign upon his land .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa ki briew jong u , kumba u nongaplangbrot u pyllait im ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u na ka jingma . Kin tyngshaiñ ha ka ri jong u kum ki mawlynnai ha ka pansngiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong ki un pynim ia ki ha kata ka sngi kum ka kynhun jong ki briew jong u: namar kin long kum ki maw jong ka khlieh , la pynkiew kum ka dak ha ka ri jong u .

en: And unto his son will I give one tribe , that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem , the city which I have chosen me to put my name there .
kha: hynrei ngan shah ba u khun jong u Solomon un ïoh ïa kawei ka jait , khnang ba borabor ngan don uwei uba mih pateng na u Dabid u shakri jong nga ban synshar ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u khun jong u ngan ai kawei ka jaitbynriew, ba u Dabid jong nga un don ka jingshai ha khmat jong nga ha Jerusalem , ka shnong kaba nga la jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong nga hangta .

en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
kha: Badno ba U Blei un ïasyllok khnang ban tip bad sngewthuh bad ban hikai kumno ba ïa kiei kiei dei ban leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Da mano u la shim jingmut , bad mano ba la hikai ia u , bad u la hikai ia u ha ka lynti jong ka jingbishar , bad u la hikai ia u ia ka jingtip , bad u la pyni ha u ia ka lynti jong ka jingsngewthuh ?

en: Hath oppressed the poor and needy , hath spoiled by violence , hath not restored the pledge , and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols , hath committed abomination ,
kha: U shukor ïa kiba duk , u lute , u bat noh ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U leit sha ki jaka mane blei thala , da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynshitom bein ia kiba duk bad kiba duk, u la pynsniew da ka jingleh donbor , um shym la pynphai biang ia ka jingkular , bad u la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong u sha ki bleithaw , u la leh ia ka jingleh bein , .

en: I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga long uta uba pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im junom , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ruh nga long uba pyntngen ia phi: me long ma me, ba me dei ban tieng ia u briew uba iap, bad ia u khun u briew uba la shah pynlong kum u phlang ; .

en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod , and thy throat from thirst : but thou saidst , There is no hope : no  ; for I have loved strangers , and after them will I go .
kha: Ko Israel wat pynlwait ïa ki kjat jong me , lane shah ïa u pdot jong me ban tyrkhong na kaba beh ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Hynrei me ong , ‘ Em ! Ngam lah ban phai dien . Nga la ieit ïa ki blei nongwei bad ngan leit hadien jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia ka kjat jong me na ka jingbym sngewtynnad: hynrei me la ong: Ym don jingkyrmen: em; namar nga la ieit ia ki nongwei bad hadien jong ki ngan leit noh .

en: And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .
kha: Kumno nga lah ban leh ïa kata ?  U Samuel u kylli .  Lada u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynïap ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Shim ïa u khun masi bad ong ba me don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong: Kumno ngan leit ? lada u Saul u iohsngew ia kata, un pyniap ia nga . Bad U Trai u la ong: Shim ia ka masi bad me bad me bad nga .

en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed : then he wrote the dream , and told the sum of the matters .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong kaba u Belshassar u long u syiem ka Babilonia , nga la phohsniew bad nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet . Nga la thoh ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad kane ka dei ka jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohi ha kata ka miet :
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong u Syiem Babilon u Daniel u la phohsniew bad ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong u ha ka jingthiah jong u: nangta u la thoh ia ka jingphohsniew , bad u la iathuh ia ka jingkhein lang jong kiei kiei .

en: Deliver me , I pray thee , from the hand of my brother , from the hand of Esau : for I fear him , lest he will come and smite me , and the mother with the children .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ba men pyllait ïa nga na ka kti u Iso u hynmen jong nga . Nga sheptieng — sheptieng ba u wan ban ïaleh bad pynïap lut ïa ngi baroh , wat ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyllait ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, na ka kti u hynmen jong nga, na ka kti u Iso: namar nga tieng ia u, ioh un wan bad un shoh ia nga, bad ia ka kmie bad ki khun .

en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in  ; he shall surely pay ox for ox  ; and the dead shall be his own .
kha: Hynrei lada la tip ba uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah teng , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u , u dei ban buria da kaba ai ïa uta uwei pat da u masi kyrtong uba im , bad un ïoh ma u ïa uta uba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada la tip ba u masi u la ju pynkhih ha ka por ba la leit noh, bad u trai jong u um shym la buh ia u ha ka por ba u la buh ia u masi u dei ban siew ia u masi na ka bynta u masi bad kiba iap kin long ki jong u hi .

en: And the  Lord  magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel , and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ban tiengburom ïa u Solomon , bad u la pynlong ïa u uba kham donburom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u syiem uba la synshar ïa ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhraw ia u Solomon haduh katta katta ha khmat ki Israel baroh , bad u la ai ha u ia ka jinglong syiem kaba khlem don ha khmat jong u ha Israel .

en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :
kha: Kan don ka jingpyrta da ka hukum , ka sur jong u angel rangbah , ka jingriew ka turoi jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade un sa wan hiar na bneng . Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khrist kin ïamih pat shuwa ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai hi un hiar na bneng da ka jingsawa, da ka sur jong u arngel bad da ka turoi U Blei: bad kiba iap ha U Khrist kin kiew nyngkong:

en: And the princes said unto them , Let them live  ; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation  ; as the princes had promised them .
kha: To ai kin im , hynrei kin dei ban long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um na ka bynta jong ngi .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki nongïalam ki la ai jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah ki la ong ha ki, Ai ba kin im ; hynrei ai ba kin long ki nonglum dieng bad ki nongtuh um ha ka jingiaseng baroh ; kumba ki rangbah ki la kular ia ki .

en: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah , and toward all the land of the plain , and beheld , and , lo , the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace .
kha: U khmih shaphang Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ïa kata ka them baroh kawei bad u la ïohi ïa ka tdem kaba mih na khyndew , kum ka tdem na ka lawar ding kaba heh bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la peit sha ka ri Sodom bad ka Gomorrah bad sha ka ri baroh kawei, bad u la iohi, bad, ha khmih, ka tdem jong ka ri ka la kiew kum ka tdem jong ka ding .

en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .
kha: To khie leit sha uwei u briew ha ka nongbah ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  bad ïathuh ha u : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong , ka por jong nga ka la poi ; ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ïing jong me !’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Leit sha ka shnong ha u briew uba kum uta, bad to ong ha u: U Nonghikai u ong: Ka por jong nga ka la jan; ngan buh ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ha iing jong me bad ki synran jong nga .

en: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts , thou , and many people with thee , all of them riding upon horses , a great company , and a mighty army :
kha: men sa mih na la ka jong ka ri kaba shaphang shatei eh , me da ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad khlaiñbor na shibun ki jaitbynriew , baroh na ki halor ki kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me wan na ka jaka jong me na ki bynta ba shathie, me bad bun ki briew bad me, baroh ki shong kulai, ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khlain:

en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and to the residue of the people , saying ,
kha: U la ong ïa u Haggai ban kren ha u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah , ha u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ha ki paidbah , bad ban ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kren mynta ha u Serubabel u khun u Shealtiel u Lat ka Judah bad ha u Joshua u khun u Jehozadak u rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki briew kiba sah ha ki briew da kaba ong:

en: And the man of God said unto the king , If thou wilt give me half thine house , I will not go in with thee , neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place :
kha: U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  Wat lada phi ai ïa nga shiteng na ka spah jong phi , ngan ym leit bad phi lane bam lane dih ei ei bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew jong U Blei u la ong ha u syiem: Lada me ai shiteng ia ka iing jong me, ngan ym leit rung bad me, lymne ngan ym bam kpu ne dih um ha kane ka jaka:

en: And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .
kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh — ym don uwei ruh uba lait !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang don ha lynti, ba ka khubor ka la wan sha u Dabid, ka la ong: U Absolon u la pyniap ia ki khun syiem baroh .

en: And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shadem bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moses u la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka shyntur, bad u la pynkhih ia ka na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai: namar na u langbrot jong ka jingpynkyntang ka long ka bynta jong u Moses; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto the woman , and said unto her , Behold now , thou art barren , and bearest not : but thou shalt conceive , and bear a son .
kha: U angel U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ka bad u ong ,  Pham shym la lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei shen phan sa punkhun bad phan ïoh ïa u khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la paw ha kata ka kynthei bad u la ong ha ka: Ha khmih mynta, me la kha khun bad me khlem kha khun: hynrei me la pun khun bad me la kha khun shynrang .

en: And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .
kha: bad u shong ha ka jaka ba u ju shong hajan kynroh . U Abner u shong hajan jong u , bad u Jonathan ha pyrshah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la shong ha ka jaka shong jong u, kumba ha kiwei pat ki por, wat ha ka jaka shong hajan ka kynroh: bad u Jonathan u la ieng, bad u Abner u la shong hajan u Saul, bad ka jaka jong u Dabid ka la thylli .

en: But he refused , and said unto his master s wife , Behold , my master wotteth not what is with me in the house , and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand  ;
kha: U la kyrngah bad u ong ha ka ,  Ha khmih , u kynrad jong nga um donkam ban pynkhuslai shuh shaphang ïa lade bad kano kano ka kam hapoh ïing , namar nga don hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kyntait bad u la ong ha ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u, Ha khmih, u kynrad jong nga um shym la leit noh ia kaei kaba don bad nga ha iing, bad u la leh ia kaba u don ha ka kti jong nga;

en: And he took the blind man by the hand , and led him out of the town  ; and when he had spit on his eyes , and put his hands upon him , he asked him if he saw ought .
kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew uba matlah na ka kti bad ïalam ïa u shabar ka nongrit . Hadien ba u la bynthiew ha ki khmat jong uta u briew , U Jisu u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u bad kylli ïa u ,  Me lah ban ïohi ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia uta u briew uba matlah da ka kti bad u la ialam ia u na ka shnong ; bad haba u la sngap jar ia ki khmat jong u, bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u halor jong u, u la kylli ia u lada u iohi ia kaei kaei .

en: Hearken now unto my voice , I will give thee counsel , and God shall be with thee : Be thou for the people to God-ward , that thou mayest bring the causes unto God :
kha: Mynta shah ngan ai buit lem ïa phi , bad U Blei un don lem bad phi . Ka long kaba dei ba phin mihkhmat ïa kine ki briew ha khmat U Blei , bad ban leit rah ïa ki jingïakajia jong ki sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap mynta ia ka sur jong nga, ngan ai jingmut ia me, bad U Blei un don ryngkat bad me: To long ma me na ka bynta ki briew ha U Blei-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-sha-

en: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy , and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ;
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka Israel kiba shu thaw hi ïa la ki jong ki jingïathuhlypa . Ïathuh ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien ka jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , to iathuhlypa ia ki nongiathuhlypa Israel kiba iathuhlypa bad to ong ha ki kiba iathuhlypa na la ki jong ki dohnud: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai;

en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .
kha: Kata ka jingbam kan long kum ka jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha kita ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki ban sa wan ha ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki briew kin ym ïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka jingbam kan long kaba la buh ha ka ri pyrshah ia ki hynriew snem ka jingkyrduh, kaba ha ka ri Ijipt; ba ka ri kan ym jah noh lyngba ka jingkyrduh .

en: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven , saying , Alleluia  ; Salvation , and glory , and honour , and power , unto the Lord our God :
kha: Hadien kane , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ki paidbah babun ha bneng , da kaba ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Ka Jingpynim , ka burom , bad ka bor ki long ki jong U Blei jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien kine kiei kiei nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba khraw jong ki briew kiba bun ha bneng, ki da ong: Aleluia ; Ka Jingpynim, bad ka burom bad ka burom bad ka bor, ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi:

en: And when Jesus came to the place , he looked up , and saw him , and said unto him ,  Zacchaeus , make haste , and come down  ; for to day I must abide at thy house .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ha u Sakhaïos ,  Hiar kloi , ko Sakhaïos , namar nga dei ban sah ha ka ïing jong me ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la poi ha kata ka jaka, u la peit sha jrong bad u la ong ha u, "Ko Sakhaios, to wan kyrkieh bad wan hiar shuh shuh namar haduh mynta nga dei ban sah ha iing jong me .

en: And he saith unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Hereafter ye shall see heaven open , and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man .
kha: Bad u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin sa ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ki angel jong U Blei ba ki ïakiew bad ïahiar ha U Khun U Briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, hadien kata phin sa iohi ia ka bneng kaba plie, bad ki angel U Blei kiba kiew bad hiar halor u Khun u briew .

en: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads , and shall have linen breeches upon their loins  ; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat .
kha: Khnang ba kin ym mih syep , kin phong ki jingspong jaiñ linen bad ki patlun jaiñ linen , khlem ki panpoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin don ki shyieng jain ha ki khlieh jong ki, bad kin don ki shyieng jain ha ki tyrpeng jong ki ; kim dei ban teh ia lade da kano kano ka jingbam kaba pynlong ia ka jingsma .

en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites , and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah , and upon the south of Caleb  ; and we burned Ziklag with fire .
kha: Ngi la leit lute ïa ka ri ki Khereth ha ka bynta kaba shathie jong ka Judah bad ïa ka ri jong ka jait u Kaleb , bad ngi la thang ruh ïa ka Siklag .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi la hiar thma shaphang shathie jong ki Kheriet , bad ha ka rud duriaw kaba dei jong u Judah , bad shaphang shathie jong u Caleb ; bad ngi la thang ia ka Ziklag da ka ding .

en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great : and when he was strong , the great horn was broken  ; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven .
kha: U  langsohmoh u la nang sngewmeng , hynrei ha ka jingdap rynïeng ka bor jong u , ka reng jong u ka la kheiñ . Ha ka jaka jong ka la wan mih saw tylli ki reng , kawei kawei ka phai sha ki liang baïapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u blang u la nang khraw shibun: bad haba u la khlain bha , ka horn kaba khraw ka la tyrkhong ; bad namar ka la wan shaneng saw tylli kiba pawnam sha ki saw tylli ki Iyer bneng .

en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid, baroh arliang jong ka sawdong , bad ki liang jong ka sawdong: ruh u la shna ia ka da ka khlieh ksiar sawdong .

en: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery , which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God , who created all things by Jesus Christ :
kha: U Blei uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , u la buhrieh ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki pateng baroh kiba mynshuwa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban pynlong ia ki briew baroh ban iohi ia kaei ka jingiasyllok jong ka jingmaham kaba la buhrieh ha U Blei uba la thaw ia kiei kiei baroh da U Jisu Khrist:

en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .
kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ba ka paw halor ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingiaseng baroh ka la pynlong ia ki da ki maw . Bad ka burom U Trai ka la paw ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ha khmat ki khun Israel baroh .

en: Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him , of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .
kha: U Philip u la shem ïa u Nathanael bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ngi la shem ïa uta ïa uba u Moses u la thoh ha ka kitab jong ka Hukum bad ïa uba ki nongïathuhlypa ruh ki la thoh shaphang jong u . U long U Jisu , u khun jong u Joseph , uba na Nasareth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Philip u lap ia u Nathanael bad u ong ha u, Ngi la shem ia uta, na uba u Moses ha ka hukum bad ki nongiathuhlypa ki la thoh, U Jisu na Nazareth u khun u Joseph .

en: Having eyes full of adultery , and that cannot cease from sin  ; beguiling unstable souls : an heart they have exercised with covetous practices  ; cursed children :
kha: Kim kwah ban peit ïa kaei kaei hynrei ïa ki kynthei ba leh ïa ki kam ba-ijli ; ka jingkwah brai jong ki ïa ka pop kam ju hun . Ki ïalam ïa ki briew kiba tlot sha ka jingriam . Ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba la shah hikai ban long kiba lalot . Ki don hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ki khmat kiba dap da ka jingleh be-ijot , bad kata kam lah ban sangeh na ka pop ; ka jingkyrpad ia ki mynsiem bym skhem: ka dohnud kaba ki la leh da ki jingleh kiba thrang ; ki khun kiba la shah tim:

en: And Jacob was wroth , and chode with Laban : and Jacob answered and said to Laban , What is my trespass ? what is my sin , that thou hast so hotly pursued after me ?
kha: Nangta u Jakob u la bitar lep ,  Ka kam sniew aïu ba nga la leh ?  u kylli da ka jingbitar .  Ka aiñ aïu ba nga la pynkheiñ kaba shong hok ha phi ban thwet ïa nga haduh katne ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la bitar bad u la ia tyngkhuh bad u Laban : bad u Jakob u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Laban: Kaei ka jingleh bymman jong nga ? kaei ka pop jong nga kaba me la bud jur ia nga ?

en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul , and bind them for a sign upon your hand , that they may be as frontlets between your eyes .
kha: To kynmaw ïa kine ki hukum bad ñiewkor ïa ki . Teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi kum ka jingpynkynmaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin buh ia kine ki ktien jong nga ha ka dohnud jong phi bad ha ka mynsiem jong phi, bad phin teh ia ki kum ka dak ha ka kti jong phi, ba kin long kum ki khmat hapdeng ki khmat jong phi .

en: But lift thou up thy rod , and stretch out thine hand over the sea , and divide it : and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea .
kha: Rah ïa la u diengduh bad bat ïa u halor ka duriaw . Ka um kan sa kad arliang , bad ki Israel kin lah ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw halor ka khyndew kaba rkhiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me rah ia u diengduh jong me, bad pynkhih ia ka kti jong me halor ka duriaw, bad phiah ia ka: bad ki khun Israel kin iaid ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang lyngba ka duriaw .

en: And if any man will hurt them , fire proceedeth out of their mouth , and devoureth their enemies : and if any man will hurt them , he must in this manner be killed .
kha: Lada uno uno u pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki , ka ding kan mih na ki shyntur jong ki bad kan bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ha kane ka rukom , uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa ki un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew un pynmong ia ki, ka ding ka mih na ka shyntur jong ki: bad lada uno uno u briew un pynmong ia ki , u dei ban shah pyniap ha kane ka rukom .

en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .
kha: Te mynta , A  Trai  , kat kum ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka bynta ka pop jong kine ki briew kumba me la map ïa ki naduh ba ki la mih na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Paradon , nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka jingbymhok jong une u briew kat kum ka jingkhraw jong ka jingisynei jong me, bad kumba me la map ia une u briew, naduh Ijipt haduh mynta .

en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :
kha: U Korah u khun jong u Ishar na ka jait Lebi jong u Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong u Moses . La wan ïasoh lem bad u da lai ngut ki dkhot na ka jait Reuben — u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab , bad u On u khun jong u Peleth — bad da ki arspah sanphew ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah Israel , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat ba la jied da ka kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng ha khmat u Moses, bad katto katne na ki khun Israel, arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah jong ka jingiaseng , kiba pawnam ha ka jingiaseng , ki briew kiba pawnam:

en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :
kha: U Joab u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongshun kan tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki shipai Israel , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Joab u la iohi ba ka khmat jong ka thma ka long pyrshah ia u shwa bad shadien , u la jied na ki briew ba la jied baroh jong ki Israel , bad u la buh ia ki ha ka jingialeh pyrshah ia ki Syria:

en: As when the melting fire burneth , the fire causeth the waters to boil , to make thy name known to thine adversaries , that the nations may tremble at thy presence !
kha: Kin khynñiuh kum ka um ba dang shet halor ka ding kaba khluit . Ale bad pynpaw ïa ka bor jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , bad pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban khynñiuh ha khmat jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka ding kaba rkhiang ka thang , ka ding ka pynlong ia ki um ban rkhiang , ban pynpaw ia ka kyrteng jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , ba ki jaitbynriew kin khih ha khmat jong me !

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .
kha: Kumta te , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan leh : Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki briew jong nga ban bam bad ka bih ban dih .
