translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel ; Ha khmih , ngan ai bam ia ki, wat ia une u briew, da ka um kaba jyrngam bad ngan ai ia ki ia ka um kaba jyrngam ban dih .

en: In that day shall the branch of the  Lord  be beautiful and glorious , and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel .
kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba U  Trai  un pynlong ïa uwei pa uwei u jingthung bad u dieng ha ka ri ban long uba heh bad ba-itynnat . Baroh ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin dap da ka jingkmen bad jingsarong ha ki mar rep ba ka ri ka pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka tnat U Trai kan long kaba itynnad bad kaba donburom , bad u soh jong ka khyndew un long uba bha bad uba wan na ka bynta kito kiba lait na Israel .

en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .
kha: Naba ujuh uba la ong ,  Wat klim ,  u la ong ruh ,  Wat pynïap .  Wat lada phim shym klim , phi la long nongpynkheiñ hukum lada phi pynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uta uba ong , Wat leh be-ijot ruh u la ong, Wat pyniap briew . Mynta lada phim leh be-ijot , hynrei lada me pyniap , me kylla long u nongpynkhein ia ka hukum .

en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation , and came out , and blessed the people : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the people .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad haba ki mih shabar , ki la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ na ka jingdon U  Trai  ka paw ha u paidbah baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad ki la mih bad ki la kyrkhu ia ki briew: bad ka burom U Trai ka la paw ha ki briew baroh .

en: And God said unto him , I am God Almighty : be fruitful and multiply  ; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee , and kings shall come out of thy loins  ;
kha: Bad U Blei u ong ha u ,  Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . To nang ïoh bun ki khun ki kti . Ki jaitbynriew kin hiarpateng na me , bad men long u kpa tymmen jong ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la ong ha u, Nga long U Blei Uba donbor baroh: to long kiba seisoh bad kiba bun jait ki jaitbynriew kin long na me, bad ki syiem kin mih na ki tyrpeng jong me;

en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :
kha: Haduh ngi baroh ngin wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jong ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin long ki briew kiba rangbah bha , kiba kot shaduh ka rynïeng ka jinglong rangbah pura U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba baroh ngin da wan ha ka jinglong kawei jong ka jingngeit bad ka jingtip ia U Khun U Blei, haduh u briew uba janai, haduh ka jingthew jong ka jinglong ba pura jong U Khrist:

en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nongrah-khubor bad pule ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la ioh ia ka shithi na ka kti jong ki nonglam khubor: bad u Hesekaiah u la leit sha ka iing U Trai bad u la pynphriang ia ka ha khmat U Trai .

en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the  Lord  of hosts  ; one shall be called , The city of destruction .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ïa ka ktien Hebru yn kren ha ki san tylli ki nongbah jong ka Ijipt . Ki briew hangta kin shim jingsmai ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ïa kawei na ki nongbah yn khot ,  Ka Nongbah jong ka Sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi san tylli ki shnong ha ka ri Ijipt kin kren ia ka ktien u Kanaan , bad kin smai ha U Trai jong ki paid beg ia kawei yn khot , Ka shnong jong ka jingpynjot .

en: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;
kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi ha kano kano ka rukom . Naba ka Sngi kan ym wan tad ynda ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia bad ba uta Uba Sniew u mihpaw ïa uba la buh lypa na ka bynta ka dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ia phi da kano kano ka lad: namar kata ka sngi kan ym wan shuh , lymda ka wan ka jinghap noh nyngkong , bad uta u briew jong ka pop un shah pynpaw , u khun jong ka jingpynjot ; .

en: Then said Pilate unto them , Take ye him , and judge him according to your law . The Jews therefore said unto him , It is not lawful for us to put any man to death :
kha: U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Te phi hi da lade to shim ïa u bad bishar ïa u kat kum ka hukum jong phi hi .  Ki la jubab ,  Ngim donbor ban rai pynïap ïano ïano .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Pilat ha ki, To shim ia u bad bishar ia u kat kum ka hukum jong phi . Ki Jiw ki la ong ha u: Kam long kaba dei ia ngi ban pyniap ia uno uno u briew:

en: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise ; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty ;
kha: U Blei u la jied khnang ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba ibieit khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba stad , bad u la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba tlot khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba donbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei u la jied ia kiei kiei kiba bieit jong ka pyrthei ban pynjah burom ia kiba stad ; bad U Blei u la jied ia kiei kiei kiba tlot jong ka pyrthei ban pynjah burom ia kiei kiei kiba donbor ; .

en: And Solomon said , If he will shew himself a worthy man , there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth : but if wickedness shall be found in him , he shall die .
kha: U Solomon u jubab ,  Lada u ai jingkyrshan , yn ym ktah wat ïa uwei na ki shñiuh ha ka khlieh jong u ; hynrei lada um long kumta , un ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la ong , Lada un pyni ia lade u briew uba bit dor , un ym hap u shniuh jong u ha ka khyndew: hynrei lada la lap ia ka jingsniew ha u , un iap noh .

en: So every man of Israel went up from after David , and followed Sheba the son of Bichri : but the men of Judah clave unto their king , from Jordan even to Jerusalem .
kha: Kumta ki Israel ki la iehnoh ïa u Dabid bad ki la leit bad u Sheba ; hynrei ki rangbah Judah ki la ïaineh bad ki bud ïa u Dabid na Jordan sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei u briew na Israel u la leit kiew na u Dabid bad u la bud ia u Sheba u khun u Bichri: hynrei ki briew jong ka Judah ki la leit sha u syiem jong ki, naduh Jordan haduh Jerusalem .

en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn , and reapeth the ears with his arm  ; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim .
kha: Ka Israel kan long kum ka lyngkha ha kaba ïa u riewhadem la ot bad la kheit , kan kynjah kum ka lyngkha ha ka Them Rephaim haba la pynsah lyngkhuit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long kum ha ka por ba u nongot u lum ia u kew bad u kheit ia ki shkor da ka kti jong u ; bad kan long kum uta uba lum ia ki shkor ha ka them Rephaim .

en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus : and the Syrians became servants to David , and brought gifts . And the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
kha: Nangta u la pynïeng ki dara sah shipai ha ki ri jong ki , bad ki la kylla long ki raïot jong u bad ki siew khajna sha u . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban jop kylleng kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la buh ia ki shipai ha Syria jong ka Damasacus : bad ki Syria ki la long ki shakri ia u Dabid bad ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha . Bad U Trai u la pynneh pynsah ia u Dabid shano shano ruh ba u leit .

en: Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka ding U Trai ka la hap , bad ka la bam ia ka jingknia thang bad ki dieng bad ki maw bad ka dewbilat bad ka la lympat ia ka um kaba don ha ka thliew .

en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever  ;
kha: Hangta bad ki la don u Heman bad u Jeduthun bad kiwei ïa kiba la jied kyrpang ban rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad ki u Heman bad u Jeduthun bad kiwei pat kiba la jied, kiba la pynpaw da ka kyrteng, ban ainguh ia U Trai, namar ka jingisynei jong u ka neh junom;

en: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing , he sought to slay Moses . But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh , and dwelt in the land of Midian : and he sat down by a well .
kha: Haba u Pharaoh u ïohsngew ïa kata , u pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u Moses ; hynrei u Moses u la phet ïap , bad u leit shong noh ha ri Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Pharaoh u la iohsngew ia kane ka jingjia, u la wad ban pyniap ia u Moses . Hynrei u Moses u la phet noh na ka khmat u Pharaoh bad u la shong ha ka ri Madian : bad u la shong hajan ka thliew .

en: And they burnt the house of God , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem , and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire , and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof .
kha: U thang ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ki ïingsyiem baroh bad ka spah jong ka , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thang ia ka iing U Blei bad ki la pynpra ia ka kynroh jong ka Jerusalem bad ki la thang ia ki iing jong ka baroh da ka ding .

en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :
kha: Baroh ki ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong pha , ki da sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynlong ia ka sur jong ki ban iohsngew pyrshah ia me, bad kin iam sngewsih, bad kin bret ia ka dewbilat halor ki khlieh jong ki, kin sa pynkhih ia lade ha ka dewbilat:

en: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness : none of them shall remain , nor of their multitude , nor of any of theirs : neither shall there be wailing for them .
kha: Ka jingleh jubor ka nang pynroi ïa ka jingbymman . Yn ym don kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong ki , ki ban neh , la ka long ka spah , ka burom , ne ka nam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingleh donbor ka la kiew sha ka jingsniew: ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban sah, ne na ka jingbun jong ki, ne na ki jong ki: lymne na ki: lymne na ka bynta jong ki .

en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So thou shalt put the evil away from among you .
kha: Ki sakhi ki dei ban lynthem maw nyngkong , bad nangta kiwei pat ki briew kin pynbud ïa ki , da kumta phin pynkhuid noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong ki sakhi kin long nyngkong eh ha u ban pyniap ia u, bad hadien kata ki kti jong ki briew baroh . Kumta me dei ban weng noh ia kaba sniew na pdeng jong phi .

en: And Saul s uncle said unto him and to his servant , Whither went ye ? And he said , To seek the asses : and when we saw that they were no where , we came to Samuel .
kha: U kñi jong u Saul u ïohi ïa u bad ïa uta u shakri , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïajah shano ?   Ngi ïaleit wad ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ynda ngim lap ïa ki , ngi leit sha u Samuel .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong u u la ong ha u bad ha u shakri jong u, Phi la leit sha u ? Bad u la ong: Ban wad ia ki kada: bad haba ngi la iohi ba kim don shano ruh , ngi la leit sha u Samuel .

en: And when they were come to Jerusalem , they were received of the church , and of the apostles and elders , and they declared all things that God had done with them .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki da ka balang , da ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ha kiba ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , la pdiang ia ki na ka balang bad na ki apostol bad ki rangbah bad ki la pynbna ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki .

en: And they asked him , saying , Master , we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly , neither acceptest thou the person of any , but teachest the way of God truly :
kha: Kine ki nongsyntiat ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko nonghikai , ngi tip ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba dei . Ngi tip ba mem khmih ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon jong U Blei na ka bynta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kylli ia u, ki da ong, Ko Nonghikai, ngi tip ba me ong bad hikai hok, wat pdiang ia ka briew jong uno uno, hynrei me hikai shisha ia ka lynti U Blei:

en: And she named the child I–chabod , saying , The glory is departed from Israel : because the ark of God was taken , and because of her father in law and her husband .
kha: Ka pynkyrteng ïa uta u khunlung u Ikhabod , ka da batai ,  Ka burom U Blei ka la phet na Israel !  — kaba thew ïa ka jingshah knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad ka jingïap u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jer kyrteng ia uta u khynnah Ichabod, da kaba ong, Ka burom ka la jah noh na Israel: namar ba la shim ia ka synduk U Blei bad namar u kpa tymmen jong ka bad u tnga jong ka .

en: And David my servant shall be king over them  ; and they all shall have one shepherd : they shall also walk in my judgments , and observe my statutes , and do them .
kha: U syiem uba kum u Dabid , u shakri jong nga un long u syiem jong ki . Kin ïalong kawei hapoh uwei u nongsynshar bad kin kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid u shakri jong nga un long u syiem halor jong ki ; bad baroh kin don uwei u nongaplangbrot: kin iaid ruh ha ki jingbishar jong nga bad kin sumar ia ki ain jong nga bad kin leh ia ki .

en: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand  ; because the  Lord  was with him , and that which he did , the  Lord  made it to prosper .
kha: U nongap byndi um donkam ban khmih ei ei shuh ïa kaba u Joseph u la shim jingkitkhlieh , namar U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap phatok um shym la peit ia kaei kaei kaba don hapoh ka kti jong u ; namar U Trai u la don ryngkat bad u , bad ia kaba u la leh , U Trai u la pynlong ia ka ban roi .

en: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .
kha: Kane ka jingong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang wad dong shuh shuh ban pynïap ïa u ; ym tang ba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum Sabbaton , hynrei ba u la ong ba U Blei hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïaryngkat bad U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki Jiw ki la nang kham kwah ban pyniap ia u , namar um shym la pynpra tang ia ka Sabha , hynrei u la ong ruh ba U Blei U long U Kpa jong u , da kaba pynlong ia lade uba iaryngkat bad U Blei .

en: And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen  ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .
kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u la ong .  Nga tip ba phi ïawad ïa U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba la sahnarphna . Um don hangne — u la mihpat ! Ha khmih , hangne ka jaka ha kaba ki la buh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha ki: Wat nym sngewsih: Phi wad ia U Jisu na Nazareth uba la sahnarphna: u la mih noh; um don hangne : ha khmih ka jaka ba ki la buh ia u .

en: When Jesus heard of it , he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart : and when the people had heard thereof , they followed him on foot out of the cities .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang jong u Ïoannis , u la mih nangta da ka lieng bad u la leit sha ka jaka bakynjah marwei hi . Ki briew ki la tip shaphang kata , kumta ki la iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki la ïabud ïa u na ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata, u la leit noh nangta da ka lieng sha ka jaka ri khlaw kaba jngai: bad haba ki briew ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la bud ia u da ka kjat na ki nongbah .

en: Professor Biran reports : In these two fragments are the name of the Aramean god Hadad , as well as a reference to a battle between the Israelites and the Arameans .
kha: U Professor Biran u iathuh : Ha kine ki ar tylli ki lyngkhot lyngkhai don ka kyrteng jong u blei Aram u Hadad , bad kumjuh ruh ka jingkdew shaphang ka jingialeh hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Aram .
translated_en_to_kha: U Professor Biran u iathuh: Ha kine ki ar tylli ki bynta ki long ka kyrteng jong u blei Aramean Hadad , bad kumjuh ruh ka jingkdew shaphang ka thma hapdeng ki Israel bad ki nong Aramean .

en: I have heard a rumour from the  Lord  , and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen , saying , Gather ye together , and come against her , and rise up to the battle .
kha: Nga ong ,  Ko Edom , nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U  Trai . U la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ïalumlang ïa ki shipai bad ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia ka khubor na U Trai, bad la phah ia u nonglamler sha ki nongwei , u da ong: To ia lum lang bad to wan pyrshah ia ka bad to kiew sha ka thma .

en: Behold my servant , whom I have chosen  ; my beloved , in whom my soul is well pleased : I will put my spirit upon him , and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles .
kha: Une hangne u long u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jied , uta uba nga ieit , bad ha uba nga sngewbha eh . Ngan phah ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor u , bad un pynbna ïa ka jingbishar jong nga ha ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih u shakri jong nga, uba nga la jied; ha uba ka mynsiem jong nga ka sngewbha shibun: Ngan buh ia ka mynsiem jong nga halor jong u, bad un pyni ia ka jingbishar ha ki Jutang .

en: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones , even four rows of stones : the first row shall be a sardius , a topaz , and a carbuncle : this shall be the first row .
kha: Pyndait ha ka , saw kyrdon ki mawkordor , u Rubi , u Topas , bad u Garnet ha ka kyrdon kaba nyngkong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ha ka ia ki maw, wat saw tylli ki lain maw: ka lain kaba nyngkong kan long ka sardius , ka topz bad ka carbuncle: kane kan long ka lain kaba nyngkong .

en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood : two cubits shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
kha: Thaw ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men shna ia ka miej kaba jrong: ar cubit ka jingjrong jong ka bad shi cubit ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: Who went in the way before you , to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , in fire by night , to shew you by what way ye should go , and in a cloud by day .
kha: wat la u leit ha shuwa jong phi borabor ban wad ka jaka ba phin sher dara . Ban kdew lynti ïa phi , u ïaid ha shuwa jong phi ha u rishot ding mynmiet bad ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba leit shapoh lynti ha khmat jong phi , ban wad ia phi ha ka jaka ban pynkhih ia ki ïingjaiñ jong phi ha ka por miet , ban pyni ïa phi ha kano ka rukom ba phi dei ban leit , bad ha ka lyer ha ka por mynstep .

en: For they being ignorant of God s righteousness , and going about to establish their own righteousness , have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God .
kha: Kim shym la tip ïa kata ka lynti kaba U Blei u pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng ki briew bad ma u hi , bad pynban , ki la pyrshang ban thaw hi da la ka jong ka lynti ; bad kumta kim shym la pyndem ïa lade ha ka lynti U Blei ban pynlong ka jingïadei bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ki bym tip ia ka hok U Blei bad ki leit ban pynskhem ia la ka jong ka hok , kim shym la aiti ia lade ha ka hok U Blei .

en: And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangta da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u :  U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pynim ïa lade lada u dei U Messaïah ïa uba U Blei u la jied !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ieng da kaba peit bniah . Bad ki nongsynshar ruh bad ki ki la rkhie bein ia u, ki da ong: U la pynim ia kiwei; to un pynim ia lade lada u long U Khrist, uba la jied da U Blei .

en: ( Psalm 26 :12 , footnote  ; 111 :1 ) These gatherings create an opportunity to meet and associate with Witnesses from other congregations or even from other lands .
kha: ( Salm 26 :12 ; 111 :1 ) Kine ki jingïalang ki plie lad ban ïakynduh bad ban ïa kren-ïa khana bad ki Nongsakhi kiba na kiwei ki balang ne na kiwei pat ki jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: ( Salm 26 :12 , ka jingthoh kjat ; 111:1 ) Kine ki jingialang ki pynmih ia ka lad ban iakynduh bad iakynduh bad ki Nongsakhi na kiwei pat ki jingiaseng ne wat na kiwei pat ki ri .

en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .
kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel ki ong ha u Gideon ,  To long u nongsynshar jong ngi — ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me . Me la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew Israel ki la ong ha u Gideon, Me halor jong ngi, ma me bad u khun jong me ruh: namar me la pyllait im ia ngi na ka kti jong u Midian .

en: Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .
kha: La u Abraham u la ïap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih bun kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , kat u shyiap bymlah ñiew shuh harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to mih hangta wat na uwei, bad u kum uba la iap, kum ki khlur bneng ha ka jingbun briew, bad kum ka dewbilat kaba don harud duriaw kaba ym lah ban khein .

en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .
kha: Katba ngi dang shong ha kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba na kane ka khyndew , ngi ud sat da ka jingsngew ba shah banbeiñ ; kam dei ba ngi kwah ban lait noh na ka met kaba na ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah ban ïoh noh ban phong da kata kaba kynja bneng , khnang ba ïa kata kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla dur noh da kaba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi kiba don ha kane ka jaka sah ngi ud: ym namar kata ba ngin sa shah rong noh, hynrei ngin sa shah rong noh, ba ka jingiap kan shah rong noh ha ka jingim .

en: And he said unto her , Give me , I pray thee , a little water to drink  ; for I am thirsty . And she opened a bottle of milk , and gave him drink , and covered him .
kha: U ong ïa ka ,  Sngewbha ai umdih ïa nga ; nga sliang .  Ka plied ïa ka pla snieh dud bad ka ai dih ïa u , bad ka la pynrieh biang ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka, Ai ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, khyndiat ka um ban dih ; namar nga sliang . Bad ka la plie ia ka bilor dud bad ka la ai ia u ia ka um bad ka la tap ia u .

en: Likewise , the way we appear at meetings shows our esteem for “the Judge of all the earth ,” Jehovah God , and for the place where we worship him . —Genesis 18 :25 .
kha: Kumjuh ruh , ka rukom riam jong ngi ha ki jingïalang ka pyni ba ngi burom ïa “U Nongbishar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ,” U Blei Jehobah , bad ïa ka jaka kaba ngi mane ïa u . —Jenesis 18 :25 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka rukom ba ngi paw ha ki jingialang ka pyni ia ka jingsngew jong ngi na ka bynta u Nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei,  U Blei Jehobah , bad na ka bynta ka jaka ba ngi mane ia u .  Genesis 18 :25 .

en: The righteous perisheth , and no man layeth it to heart : and merciful men are taken away , none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .
kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki ïap , bad ym don uba sngewthuh lane wat ban suidñiew . Hynrei haba ki ïap , yn ym don jingjynjar shuh ki ban ktah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U hok u jah noh , bad ym don mano mano ruh ba buh ia ka ha ka dohnud: bad ki briew kiba sngewrit ki shah weng noh , ym don ba pyrkhat ba ia kiba hok la weng noh na ka jingsniew kaban sa wan .

en: ( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .
kha: U  Trai  u phah ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na ki Syria , bad kumta ki Israel ki im ha ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: (U Trai u la ai ia ki Israel ia u nongpynim, kumta ki la mih noh na ka kti jong ki Syria: bad ki khun Israel ki la shong ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki kumba la ju long mynshuwa .

en: But we all , with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord , are changed into the same image from glory to glory , even as by the Spirit of the Lord .
kha: Te , baroh na ngi , ngi phalang ïa ka burom jong U Trai da ki durkhmat ba khlem tap , bad kata kajuh ka burom , kaba wan na U Trai , uba long U Mynsiem , ka pynkylla dur ïa ngi sha ka jingïasyriem ïa u ha kata ka kyrdan kaba kham khraw jong ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi baroh, da kaba plie ia ka khmat kaba peit kum ha ka glass ia ka burom U Trai, ngi kylla sha kajuh ka dur na ka burom sha ka burom, wat da U Mynsiem U Trai .

en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie , saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink  ; he shall even be the prophet of this people .
kha: Kine ki briew ki kwah ïa u jait nongïathuhlypa uba ïaid kylleng uba dap da ka lamler bad jingshukor bad u ong , ‘ Nga ïathuhlypa ba ka waiñ bad ka kyiad kin tuid na ka bynta jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew uba iaid ha ka mynsiem bad ka jinglamler u thok , u ong , Ngan iathuhlypa ha me ia ka wain bad ka jingdih kaba khlain ; un long wat u nongiathuhlypa jong une u briew .

en: Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .
kha: Kaba kham palat ïa kata ka long ba ïa ngi la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shaphang U Blei , namar ba ngi la ong ba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei lada ka long kaba shisha ba ïa kiba ïap ym shym la pynmihpat , te um shym la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bad ngi lap ia ki sakhi lamler jong U Blei ; namar ngi la sakhi ia U Blei ba u la pynmihpat ia U Khrist: ia uba um shym la pynmihpat , lada ka long kumta ba kiba iap kim kiewpat .

en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?
kha: Phi kiba sniew eh , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Kaba katno tam keiñ , ba U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ai kiei kiei kiba bha ha kito kiba pan na u !
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi long kiba sniew, phi tip kumno ban ai ia ki jingai sngewbha ha ki khun jong phi, katno u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng un ai ia kiei kiei kiba bha ha kito kiba pan ia u ?

en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa , hadien kata u Hananiah u nongiathuhlypa u la pynpra ia ka lyngkhot na ka ryndang jong u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah .

en: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod : and the angel stood , saying , Rise , and measure the temple of God , and the altar , and them that worship therein .
kha: La ai ha nga ïa u dieng uba syriem ïa u diengthew , bad la ong ïa nga ,  Khie leit bad thew ïa ka Templ U Blei bad ïa ka duwan , bad ñiew ïa kito kiba mane ha ka templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ai ha nga ia ka lyngkhot lyngkhai kum u dieng: bad u angel u la ieng, u da ong: To kiew bad thew ia ka tempi U Blei bad ka almari bad ia kita kiba mane ha ka .

en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body , whether we be Jews or Gentiles , whether we be bond or free ; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , baroh na ngi , la ngi long ki Jiw ne ki Jentil , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , la pynbaptis ha kawei ka met da ujuh U Mynsiem , bad la ai ha ngi ïa ujuh U Mynsiem ban ïoh dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da uwei u Mynsiem baroh ngi la shah pynbaptis ha kawei ka met , la ngi long ki Jiw ne ki Jutang , la ngi long ki bond ne ki Jutang baroh bad baroh ngi la shah pynlong ban dih ha uwei u Mynsiem .

en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
kha: bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . A  Trai  , me ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga bad me ïada ïa nga na ki riewthombor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka wanrah ia nga na ki nongshun jong nga: me ruh me la pynkiew ia nga sha jrong halor jong ki kiba la ieng pyrshah ia nga: me la pyllait im ia nga na u briew uba shyrkhei .

en: Jesus answered ,  He it is , to whom I shall give a sop , when I have dipped it .  And when he had dipped the sop , he gave it to Judas Iscariot , the son of Simon .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ngan wieh katto katne u kpu ha ka sos bad ngan ai ha u , uta ha uba nga ai ; u dei uta u briew .  Kumta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , u la wieh ha ka , bad u la ai ha u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab , U long uba ngan ai ia ka sop, haba nga la pynngam ia ka . Bad haba u la pynngam ia ka sop , u la ai ia ka ha u Judas Isarot u khun u Simon .

en: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab , and did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did the house of Ahab : for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab .
kha: Namar ba u Ahasaïah u don ka jingïadei bad u syiem Ahab da ka jingïashongkha , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumba ka longïing jong u Ahab ka la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid ha ka lynti jong ka iing u Ahab bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai kumba la leh ia ka iing u Ahab: namar u long u khun shynrang jong u Ahab .

en: And about the time of her death the women that stood by her said unto her , Fear not  ; for thou hast born a son . But she answered not , neither did she regard it .
kha: Hamar ba kan sa ïap , ki kynthei kiba sumar ïa ka ki ong ,  Long shlur ! pha ïoh khun shynrang !  Hynrei kam shym pynleit jingmut bad kam shym jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por ba ka iap ki kynthei kiba ieng hajan jong ka ki la ong ia ka: Wat tieng namar me la kha khun shynrang . Hynrei kam shym la jubab , bad kam shym la pyrkhat ia kata .

en: If thy whole body therefore be full of light , having no part dark , the whole shall be full of light , as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light .
kha: Lada ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingshai , khlem kano kano ka bynta jong ka ha kaba dum , kan long kaba phyrnai ha baroh , kum haba ka sharak ka tyngshaiñ ha phi da ka jingphyrnai jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka met jong me baroh kawei ka long kaba dap da ka jingshai, khlem ka bynta kaba dum, ka baroh kawei kan long kaba dap da ka jingshai, kumba ka jingshai kaba shai jong ka sharak ka ai jingshai ia me .

en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him , saying , Fight ye not with small or great , save only with the king of Israel .
kha: U syiem ka Syria u la hukum ïa ki nongïalam ki kali ïapom ban ym tur ïaleh ïano ïano ruh hynrei tang ïa u syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u syiem Syria u la hukum ia ki rangbah shipai kiba don ryngkat bad u, u da ong: Wat ialeh da kaba rit ne kaba heh , lait noh tang bad u syiem Israel .

en: Make ye mention to the nations  ; behold , publish against Jerusalem , that watchers come from a far country , and give out their voice against the cities of Judah .
kha: Ki la wan ban maham ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ban ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ba ki nongshun ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bah . Kine ki nongshun kin pyrta pyrshah ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia ki jaitbynriew kiba peit ia ka Jerusalem , ba ki nongpeitkai ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai , bad ki pynmih ia ka sur jong ki pyrshah ia ki nongbah Judah .

en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :
kha: Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Jordan , kine ki jait ki dei ban ïeng ha u lum Gerisim katba nang pynbna ïa ki jingkyrkhu : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka jait Joseph , bad ka jait Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kin ieng halor u lum Gerizim ban kyrkhu ia ki briew, haba phi wan halor ka Jordan Simeon, bad u Lebi, bad u Judah, bad u Issakhar, bad u Joseph, bad u Benjamin:

en: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .
kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad hukum ïa ki ban ym kren shuh da lei lei ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu ; bad nangta ki la pyllait noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u ki la ia mynjur lang: bad haba ki la khot ia ki apostol bad ki la shoh ia ki , ki la hukum ba kim dei ban kren ha ka kyrteng U Jisu bad ki la pyllait noh ia ki .

en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;
kha: Te u angel u la leit noh , bad u Kornelios u la khot ar ngut na ki shakri ïing jong u bad uwei u shipai uba riewblei uba long uwei na kiba shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u angel uba la kren bad u Kornellius u la leit noh, u la khot arngut ki shakri iing jong u bad uwei u shipai uba la shah sumar ha u man ka por;

en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city , and no city shall escape : the valley also shall perish , and the plain shall be destroyed , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ka ban lait na ka jingpynjot ; ki ri them bad ki ri thor kin shah pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongpynjot un wan ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong: ka them ruh kan jah noh , bad ka madan kan shah pynjot kumba U Trai u la kren .

en: But ye are they that forsake the  Lord  , that forget my holy mountain , that prepare a table for that troop , and that furnish the drink offering unto that number .
kha: Hynrei kan long pher ïa phi kiba la kyntait ïa nga , kiba lyndet ïa ka Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga , bad mane ïa u Gad bad u Meni , ki blei ka nusip bad ka kupar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi long kita kiba iehnoh ia U Trai, kiba klet ia u lum bakhuid jong nga, kiba pynkhreh ia ka miej na ka bynta kata ka kynhun shipai , bad kiba pynbiang ia ka jingknia dih sha kata ka jingkhein .

en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
kha: Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba nga la pynkhih ia ki khmat jong nga, nga la pyrkhat bad nga la iohi ia ki mrad khlaw kiba saw kjat bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki mrad khlaw kiba iaid kai bad ki sim jong ka Iyer .

en: Then she said , I desire one small petition of thee  ; I pray thee , say me not nay . And the king said unto her , Ask on , my mother : for I will not say thee nay .
kha: Ka ong ,  Nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad barit ban pan na me ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata , mei ?  u kylli .  Ngan ym kyrngah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ong , Nga kwah ia kawei ka jingkyrpad kaba rit jong me ; nga duwai ia me, to ong ia nga ym Nay . Bad u syiem u la ong ha ka, To kylli, ko kmie jong nga: namar ngan ym ong ia me Nay .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Behold , I will punish them : the young men shall die by the sword  ; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine :
kha: Kumta U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa ki ! Ki samla shynrang jong ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ki khun jong ki kin ïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid: Ha khmih ngan pynshitom ia ki: ki samla kin iap da ka waitlam ; ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki khun kynthei jong ki kin iap da ka jingkyrduh:

en: For example , when reading the book of Isaiah , review what is said elsewhere about kings Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , who are mentioned at Isaiah 1 : 1 .
kha: Kum ka nuksa haba pule ia ka kitab Isaiah bishar bniah ia kaei kaba la ong ha kiwei pat ki jaka shaphang ki syiem Usaiah , u Jotham , u Ahas bad u Hesekaiah kiba la kdew ha u Isaiah 1 : 1 .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka nuksa, haba pule ia ka kot Isaiah, kaei kaba la ong shaphang ki syiem Uzziah, u Jotham, u Ahasa bad u Hesekaiah, kiba la kdew ha Isaiah 1 : 1 .

en: Take Aaron and his sons with him , and the garments , and the anointing oil , and a bullock for the sin offering , and two rams , and a basket of unleavened bread  ;
kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad wanrah ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , ka umphniang pynsleh , u masi lyngraw ban long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ar tylli ki blang shynrang , bad ka shang ba buh ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad u, bad ki jain, bad ka umphniang pynsleh, bad u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, bad ar tylli ki langbrot bad ka lyngkhot kpu bym don thied;

en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .
kha: Nalor kane ruh , u syiem u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki bynta kiba dei jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka por jong ki baroh sha ki jingdawa jong ka Hukum jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la hukum ia ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem ban ai ia ka bynta jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ba kin ioh mynsiem ha ka hukum U Trai .

en: And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .
kha: Kumta u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ha ka jingpeit u Joseph , bad um shym pynkhuslai ei ei shuh ïa lade lait tang ka bam ba u ju bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iehnoh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha ka kti u Joseph bad um tip ia kaei kaba u don, lait noh tang u kpu uba u la bam . U Joseph u long u briew uba bha, bad uba la sngewbha shibun .

en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest :
kha: U dei ruh ban wallam sha u lyngdoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  , ïa u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor kan long kat kum ba la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong u ha U Trai, u langbrot khlem jingduna na ka kynhun langbrot, da ka jingkhein jong me, na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba palat, ha u lyngdoh:

en: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingïapher kaba shai kdar hapdeng ki khun U Blei bad ki khun u Soitan : Uno uno u bym leh ïa kaei kaba dei lane u bym ieit ïa la u hynmen u para um long u khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ki khun U Blei ki paw , bad ki khun u ksuid: uno uno u bym leh ia ka hok um dei na U Blei , lymne uta u bym ieit ia la u hynmen .

en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;
kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab , bad lada phim ñiewburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba phylla bad kaba khraw jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada men ym peit ban leh ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot , ba me lah ban tieng ia kane ka kyrteng kaba donburom bad kaba tieng , U Trai U BLEI;

en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
kha: Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw bad uba rit , u pyrshang ban shna pisa da ka jingbymhok ; wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na kiba rit tam na ki wat haduh kiba khraw tam na ki baroh u la shah ai ha ka jingkwah brai; bad na u nongiathuhlypa wat haduh u lyngdoh baroh u la iap thok .

en: The  Lord  hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof : and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof , as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki ban ai ka jingai jingmut kaba pynkulmar . Kaba mih nangta ka long ba ka Ijipt ka leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bakla bad ka ïaid sheng sheng kum u briew uba buaid uba syntuid ha la ka jong ka prie .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkhih ia ka mynsiem kaba bakla hapdeng jong ka: bad ki la pynlong ia ka Ijipt ban bakla ha ka kam baroh jong ka, kumba u briew uba la buaid u la lyngngoh ha ka jingsma jong u .

en: And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,
kha: U Stephan u la jubab ,  Ko ki hynmen ki para bad ko ki kpa , shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha shuwa ba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Abraham un leit noh ban shong ha Haran , U Blei ka burom u la mihpaw ha u ha Mesopotamia bad u la ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ki briew, ki para bad ki kpa tymmen, ki sngap jar U Blei ka burom u la paw ha u kpa jong ngi u Abraham, haba u la don ha Mesopotamia, shuwa ba un shong ha Charran .

en: And when they were come to the place , which is called Calvary , there they crucified him , and the malefactors , one on the right hand , and the other on the left .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Maloi Khlieh ,  ki la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu hangta , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki nongleh kam runar , uwei sha kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kaba la khot Kalvary , hangta ki la sahnarphna ia u bad ki nongleh bymman, uwei ha ka liang kadiang bad uwei pat ha ka liang kadiang .

en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind , and with all thy strength : this is the first commandment .
kha: Men ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh , da ka mynsiem jong me baroh , da ka jingmut jong me baroh , bad da ka bor jong me baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh: kane ka long ka hukum kaba nyngkong .

en: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .
kha: Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh nyngkong kiba kynsai tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Israel ki ai ïa nga man la ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka umphniang kaba bha tam bad ka wain kaba bha tam bad u kew baroh kaba ki ai ha U Trai .

en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets , which spake in thy name to our kings , our princes , and our fathers , and to all the people of the land .
kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong me , kiba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong me sha ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad ka jaitbynriew jong ngi baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngim shym la sngap ia ki shakri jong me ki nongiathuhlypa jong me kiba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong me ha ki syiem jong ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad ha ki briew jong ka ri baroh .

en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kor khlur-kba , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai banep . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bad pynlwet ïa ki ; ki lumrit kin lwet kum u pui pui .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia me ka tiar kaba thymmai kaba jem: men sa pynkhih ia ki lum , bad men sa pynlong ia ki lum kum ki lum .

en: And he said , What shall I give thee ? And Jacob said , Thou shalt not give me any thing : if thou wilt do this thing for me , I will again feed and keep thy flock :
kha: Ngan siew aïu ïa me ?  u Laban u kylli . U Jakob u jubab ,  Ngam donkam bainong ei ei . Ngan ïai bteng ban sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri jong phi lada phi mynjur ïa kane ka jingai jingmut :
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Ngan ai aiu ia me ? Bad u Jakob u la ong: Wat ai ei ei ia nga: lada me leh ia kane na ka bynta jong nga , ngan ai bam biang bad sumar ia ki kynhun jong me:

en: And he put the mitre upon his head  ; also upon the mitre , even upon his forefront , did he put the golden plate , the holy crown  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U buh ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ha khmat jong ka u pyndait ïa ka jingdeng ksiar , kaba long ka dak jong ka jingpynkyntang , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ka miej ha ka khlieh jong u ; ruh ha ka miej, wat ha khmat jong u, u la buh ia ka pliang ksiar, ka khlieh ksiar ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .
kha: Kajuh kaei kaei kan jia ïa ka Babilon kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , haba nga la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong kiba marjan . Yn ym don ba shong shuh hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Blei u la pynjot ia ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah bad ki nongbah ba marjan jong ka, ong u Trai ; kumta ym don briew uba sah hangta, lymne u khun briew un shong hangta .

en: Take heed therefore how ye hear : for whosoever hath , to him shall be given  ; and whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have .
kha: Da phikir , te , kumno phi pynshahshkor ; namar ha uno uno uba don yn ai kham bun shuh , hynrei ha uno uno u bym don , un shah shim noh na u wat ïa kata kaba rit tam kaba u pyrkhat ba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bha namarkata kumno phi iohsngew: namar uno uno uba don, ha u yn ai bad uno uno u bym don, na u yn shim wat ia kata kaba u i kumba u don.

en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
kha: U Amasaïah u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasaiah u la don arphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew hynniew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Jehoshin jong ka Jerusalem .

en: But there the glorious  Lord  will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams  ; wherein shall go no galley with oars , neither shall gallant ship pass thereby .
kha: U  Trai  un pyn-i ha ngi ïa ka burom jong u . Ngin shong ngin sah harud ki wah bad ki wahduid kiba ïar , hynrei ki liengbah jong ki nongshun kin ym ïaid ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hangta U Trai ba donburom un long ha ngi ka jaka jong ki wah bad ki wah kiba jylliew ha kaba ym leit sha ki wahduid, lymne ka lieng kaba jylliew kan iaid lyngba kata .

en: And Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .
kha: U Pharaoh u phah kylli ïa kaei kaba la jia bad la ïathuh ba na ki jingri jong ki Israel ym don satia kaba ïap . Hynrei u dang mutlop hi bad um shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la phah bad , ha khmih ym don uwei ruh na ki masi Israel uba la iap . Bad ka dohnud u Pharaoh ka la tyrkhong bad um shym la pyllait ia ki briew .

en: And sent Timothy , our brother , and minister of God , and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ , to establish you , and to comfort you concerning your faith :
kha: Bad ngi la phah ïa u Timothi , u parabangeit jong ngi uba ïatrei lem bad ngi na ka bynta U Blei ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist . Ngi la phah ïa u ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi bad ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah ia u Timothi, u para jong ngi, bad u nongshakri jong U Blei, bad u paralok jong ngi ha ka gospel U Khrist, ban pynskhem ia phi, bad ban pyntngen ia phi shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi:

en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day  ; and he took the city , and slew the people that was therein , and beat down the city , and sowed it with salt .
kha: Ka jingïaleh ka la neh baroh shi sngi . U Abimelekh u kurup ïa ka nongbah , u pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka , u pynkhyllem ïa ka , bad u tap ïa ka madan da ka mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka shnong baroh kata ka sngi; bad u la pyniap ia ki briew kiba don hangta, bad u la pynhap ia ka shnong bad u la bet ia ka da ka umsoh .

en: When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .
kha: Hynrei ngan riam da ka jar bad kem ïa ki kum ki sim katba ki dang ïaid . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman ba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda kin leit noh , ngan pynphriang ia ka net jong nga halor jong ki ; Ngan pynhap ia ki kum ki sim bneng ; Ngan pynshitom ia ki kumba ka jingiaseng jong ki ka la iohsngew .

en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .
kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw bashabar . La don laiphew tylli ki kamra ba la tei ha syndah ka kynroh bashabar bad ha khmat jong ki , la don ka jaka ba la siang maw kaba poi sawdong ka phyllaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wanrah ia nga sha ka iingbishar kaba shabar, bad, ha khmih, ki don ki kamra, bad ka lynti iaid kjat kaba la shna na ka bynta ka iingbishar sawdong: laiphew tylli ki kamra ki la don ha ka lynti iaid kjat .

en: But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la bitar ïa nga namar jong phi bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang katta ! Wat kren ei ei shuh shaphang kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai u la bitar ia nga na ka bynta jong phi, bad un ym iohsngew ia nga: bad U Trai u la ong ha nga: To ai ba phin ym kren shuh ia nga shaphang kane ka kam .

en: So likewise ye , when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you , say , We are unprofitable servants : we have done that which was our duty to do .
kha: Ka long kumjuh bad phi ; haba phi la pyndep ïa baroh kaba la bthah ïa phi ban leh , to ong , ‘ Ngi long ki tang ki shakri , ngi la pyndep tang ïa ka kamram jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kumjuh ruh phi, haba phi la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la hukum ia phi, to ong: Ngi long ki shakri ki bym don jingmyntoi: ngi la leh ia kata kaba la long ka kamram jong ngi ban leh .

en: And Moses wrote this law , and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and unto all the elders of Israel .
kha: Kumta u Moses u thoh ïa ka Hukum U Blei bad u ai ïa ka ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la thoh ia kane ka hukum bad u la aiti ia ka ha ki lyngdoh ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi kiba kit ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai bad ha ki rangbah Israel baroh .

en: That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .
kha: Ynda u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dei ban ai sha U  Trai  ïa u khun nyngkong baroh . Man uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad u long u jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me dei ban pyniakhlad ia U Trai baroh kiba plie ia ka matrix, bad uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong uba wan na u mrad uba me don; ki shynrang kin long ki Trai s .

en: Now also when I am old and grayheaded , O God , forsake me not  ; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation , and thy power to every one that is to come .
kha: Mynta ba nga la tymmen ruh bad ba u shñiuh jong nga u la lieh , wat iehnoh ïa nga , A Blei ! to long bad nga katba nga pynbna ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñbor jong me ha ki pateng baroh ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ruh haba nga la tymmen bad nga la tyrkhong, ko Blei, wat iehnoh ia nga haduh ba ngan da pyni ia ka bor jong me ha kane ka pateng bad ka bor jong me ha uwei pa uwei uba dei ban wan .

en: And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi buh ki jingkit halor ki met jong ki briew , kiba eh ïa ka ban kit , hynrei phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shympriah kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kita ki jingkit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Hooid ia phi ruh, ko nongiasaid ain! namar phi la leit sha ki briew kiba don ki jingkit kiba sngewsih ban shah kha, bad phi hi phim ktah ia ki jingkit da kawei na ki kti jong phi .

en: And they told the king , saying , Behold Nathan the prophet . And when he was come in before the king , he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground .
kha: La ïathuh ha u syiem ba U Nathan u nongïathuhlypa u don hangta , bad u Nathan u rung shapoh bad u dem ngon ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iathuh ha u syiem da kaba ong: Ha khmih u Nathan u nongiathuhlypa . Bad haba u la wan rung ha khmat u syiem , u la dem khrup ha khmat u syiem da ka khmat sha khyndew .

en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians , because thou wast unsatiable  ; yea , thou hast played the harlot with them , and yet couldest not be satisfied .
kha: Namar ym shym la pynhun ïa pha da kiwei , pha la leit bud nadien ki nong Assyria . Pha la long ka nuti jong ki , hynrei ki ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la ialehkai ia ka met bad ki nong Assyria ruh, namar ba me la long uba khlem pynhun ; yea , me la ialehkai bad ki, bad wat la katta ruh ngam lah ban sngewhun .

en: Then said Paul unto him , God shall smite thee , thou whited wall : for sittest thou to judge me after the law , and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law ?
kha: U Paul u la ong ha u ,  U Blei da kaba thikna un shoh ïa me — me ka kynroh ba la pushara lieh ! Me shong hangto ban bishar ïa nga kat kum ka Hukum , pynban me pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum da kaba hukum ïa ki ban thab ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ong ha u, U Blei un shoh ia me, me uba la tyrkhong: namar me shong ha ka hukum , bad me hukum ia nga ban shah pynshitom pyrshah ia ka hukum ?

en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;
kha: Katba nga dang trei bad ki Jiw , nga im kum u Jiw khnang ban jop ïa ki ; bad wat la ma nga hi ngam long hapoh ka Hukum u Moses , nga im kumba nga la long mynba nga dang trei bad kito kiba hapoh ka hukum , khnang ba ngan jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki Jiw nga la kylla long kum u Jiw, ba ngan ioh ia ki Jiw ; ha kito kiba hapoh ka hukum , ba ngan ioh ia kita kiba hapoh ka hukum ; .

en: And I Daniel fainted , and was sick certain days  ; afterward I rose up , and did the king s business  ; and I was astonished at the vision , but none understood it .
kha: Nga la noh mynsiem bad shitom bun bun sngi . Hadien kata nga la khie bad leit pat sha ka kam kaba u syiem u la ai ha nga , hynrei nga la shaïong da ka jingïohipaw bad ngam lah ban shemphang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga Daniel nga la lyngngoh katto katne sngi; hadien kata nga la ieng, bad u syiem u la leh ia ka kam; bad nga la lyngngoh ia ka jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don ba sngewthuh ia ka .

en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears , and bucklers , and shields , that had been king David s , which were in the house of God .
kha: U Jehoïada u ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u syiem Dabid bad kiba la buh ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Jehoiada u lyngdoh u la aiti ha ki rangbah jong ki spah ngut ki khnam bad ki khnam kiba la long u syiem Dabid s .

en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .
kha: Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , u syiem u la mane ïa U  Trai  da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha ka duwan rnong ; u la phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad thang tylli halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la leit sha ka jaka thang niang ha khmat U Trai kaba don ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad u la tyrwa shi hajar tylli ki jingknia thang halor jong ka .

en: He stretched out his hand over the sea , he shook the kingdoms : the  Lord  hath given a commandment against the merchant city , to destroy the strong holds thereof .
kha: U  Trai  u la kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw bad u la jop ïa ki hima . U la hukum ban pynjot ïa ki jaka pdeng jong ki jingkhaïi pateng ka Phoenisia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ka duriaw , u la pynkhih ia ki hima: U Trai u la ai hukum pyrshah ia ka nongbah kaba khlain , ban pynjot ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong ka .

en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap in mercy  ; break up your fallow ground : for it is time to seek the  Lord  , till he come and rain righteousness upon you .
kha: Nga la ong , ‘ Lur ïa ka khyndew thymmai na ka bynta ïa lade , bet ïa ka jinglehhok , bad ot ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba ka jingmane ïa nga kan pynmih . Ka la dei ka por ïa phi ban phai sha nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad ngan sa wan bad theh ki jingkyrkhu halor jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: To bet ia lade ha ka hok, to kheit ha ka jingsngewrit ; pynpra ia ka khyndew kaba la tyrkhong jong phi: namar ka la dei ka por ban wad ia U Trai, haduh ba un da wan bad u slap ia ka hok halor jong phi .

en: And these went into Micah s house , and fetched the carved image , the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image . Then said the priest unto them , What do ye ?
kha: Haba ki rangbah ki leit rung shapoh ïing u Mikah bad shim ïa ki tiar bakyntang , u lyngdoh u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi ïaleh aïu ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki la leit shapoh iing u Mica, bad ki la shim ia ka dur ba la ker, ka effod bad ka teraphim bad ka dur ba la khleh lang . Nangta u la ong u lyngdoh ha ki, Phi leh aiu ?

en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .
kha: Ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad kito kiba phi isih kin synshar halor jong phi ; phin sngewsheptieng haduh katta katta ba phin phet ïap haba ym don ba beh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia phi, bad phin shah pyniap ha khmat ki nongshun jong phi: kita kiba shun ia phi kin synshar halor jong phi ; bad phin phet noh haba ym don ba bud ia phi .

en: And under their hand was an army , three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred , that made war with mighty power , to help the king against the enemy .
kha: Hapoh jong ki don lai lakh hynñiew hajar sanspah ngut ki shipai kiba lah ban ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta u syiem pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapoh ka kti jong ki la don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai spah hajar hynriew hajar san spah snem kaba la ialeh thma da ka bor kaba khraw, ban iarap ia u syiem pyrshah ia u nongshun .

en: Incline thine ear , O  Lord  , and hear  ; open thine eyes , O  Lord  , and see : and hear all the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent to reproach the living God .
kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , to sngap ïa ngi bad to peit ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u la ong ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me , U Blei ba-im .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ia ka shkor jong me ko Trai, bad to iohsngew ia ki khmat jong me, ko Trai, bad to iohi: bad to iohsngew ia ki ktien baroh jong u Senakherib, uba la phah ban kren bein ia U Blei uba im .

en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee , I will bring thee unto another place  ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence .
kha: U Balak u ong ,  Ale bad nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse U Blei un shah ïa phi ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la ong ha u Balaam, To wan, nga kyrpad ia me, ngan wanrah ia me sha kawei pat ka jaka;

en: Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .
kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew bad kim long shuh ban pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la leit sha Euphrates , bad nga la tih ia ka girdle na ka jaka ba nga la buhrieh ia ka: bad, ha khmih, ka girdle ka la long kaba myntoi khlem jingmyntoi ei ei .

en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .
kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U  Trai  un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka langbrot lane kawei ka masi jong phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait khnang ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban knia ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ha U Trai U Blei jong me, na ka kynhun bad ka kynhun masi ha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u hangta .

en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem , to bring in to the  Lord  the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness .
kha: Ki la phah ktien sha kylleng ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah ïa baroh ban wallam sha U  Trai  ïa ka khajna ba u Moses , u shakri U Blei , u la lum nyngkong ha ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia ka jingpynbna lyngba ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ban wanrah sha U Trai ia ka jinglum lang kaba u Moses u shakri U Blei u la buh ha ki Israel ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .
kha: sa shi bynta na ka lai bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , bad kiba sah shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi kin ïeng ap phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyndet jong kiwei ki nongap phira .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bynta kaba lai kan long ha ka khyrdop Sur ; bad ka bynta kaba lai ha ka khyrdop hadien ka jingpahara: kumta phin sumar ia ka jingpahara jong ka iing, ba kan ym shah pynpra .

en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all  ; first being by interpretation King of righteousness , and after that also King of Salem , which is , King of peace  ;
kha: bad u Abraham u la ai ïa u kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na baroh kaba u la lum , ( ka jingmut kaba nyngkong jong ka kyrteng u Melkhisedek ka long  U syiem jong ka hok ;  bad namar ba u la long u syiem jong ka Salem , ka kyrteng jong u ruh ka mut  U syiem jong ka Jingsuk .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba u Abraham ruh u la ai shi bynta na ka jingsuk baroh;

en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,
kha: Ynda u syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la kwah ban tei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Solomon u la pyndep ia ka iing U Trai bad ka iing syiem bad ka jingkwah jong u Solomon baroh kaba u la sngewbha ban leh .

en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .
kha: Ki khnam jong me ki sam lyngba ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shipai jong u haba u la wan kum ka  erïong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka jingsarong kum kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iaid lyngba bad ki dieng jong u: ki la mih kum ka lyer kaba rkhie bein ban pynphriang ia nga: ka jingkmen jong ki ka long ban bam ia kiba duk da kaba rieh .

en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .
kha: Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Da la ki khmat jong ngi hi ngi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim shym la bud ia ki khanatang kiba la thmu da ka jingstad, haba ngi la pyntip ha phi ia ka bor bad ka jingwan jong U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , hynrei ngi la long ki nongsakhi khmat jong ka jingkhraw jong u .

en: And they went out , they and all their hosts with them , much people , even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude , with horses and chariots very many .
kha: Kita ki la ïawan lem bad ki shipai jong ki baroh — ka kynhun shipai kaba bun briew kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki don ruh shibun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh, ma ki bad ki shipai jong ki baroh, ki briew kiba bun, wat kum ka dewbilat kaba don ha rud duriaw ha ka jingbun paid, da ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar kiba bun .

en: The impotent man answered him , Sir , I have no man , when the water is troubled , to put me into the pool : but while I am coming , another steppeth down before me .
kha: Uta u briew uba pang u la jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , ngam don mano mano hangne ban leit buh ïa nga ha ka pungsum haba la pynkhih ïa ka um ; katba nga dang pyrshang ban hiar ha ka , uwei pat u poi nyngkong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u briew uba khlem bor u la jubab ia u, Ko sahep, ngam don briew, haba ka um ka la tyrkhong, ban buh ia nga ha ka pung: hynrei katba nga dang wan, uwei pat u hiar shapoh ha khmat jong nga .

en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Uno uno uba ieit ïa nga un kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga . U Kpa jong nga un ieit ïa u , bad U Kpa jong nga bad ma nga ngin wan ha u bad sah hapoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, Lada u briew u ieit ia nga, un sumar ia ki ktien jong nga: bad U Kpa jong nga un ieit ia u, bad ngin wan sha u bad ngin ia shong bad u .

en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
kha: Ka kynthei ba la shongkurim , kum ka nuksa , ka shah teh da ka hukum ha la u tnga katba u dang im ; hynrei haba u la ïap , te ka la laitluid na ka hukum kaba teh ïa ka bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kynthei kaba don u tnga ka shah teh ha ka ain ha u tnga jong ka katba u dang im ; hynrei lada u tnga u la iap , ka la lait na ka ain u tnga jong ka .

en: The cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office .
kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki Lyngdoh ki dei ban phong haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh , bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jain jingshakri , ban leh ia ka kam bakhuid , ki jain kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ki jain jong ki khun shynrang jong u ban shakri ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the  Lord  : whosoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it , an offering of the  Lord   ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
kha: Wallam ka jingainguh sha U  Trai . Kat uba kwah ban leh ïa kata un wanrah ïa kata ka jingainguh da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;
translated_en_to_kha: Shim na phi ia ka jingainguh ha U Trai: uno uno uba don ka dohnud kaba mon sngewbha , to un wanrah ia ka, ka jingainguh jong U Trai; ka ksiar bad ka rupa bad ka nar .

en: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah , that lieth before Shechem  ; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En–tappuah .
kha: Ka jaka jong ki Manasseh ka ïar naduh Asher haduh Mikhmethath , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Shekhem . Nangta u pud u hiar arsut shaphang shathie ban kynthup ïa ki briew jong ka Entappuah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rud duriaw jong u Manasseh ka long naduh u Asher haduh u Michmtah, kaba shong ha khmat u Shehem ; bad u pud u sam u la iaid sha ka liang kadiang sha ki nongshong shnong jong ka Entappuh .

en: And Jahath was the chief , and Zizah the second : but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons  ; therefore they were in one reckoning , according to their father s house .
kha: U Shimei u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jahath , u Sina , u Jeush , bad u Beraïah , kat kum ka rta jong ki . U Jeush bad u Beraïah kim shym don bun ngut ki khun ki ksiew ; kumta la ñiew ïa ki kum kawei ka kur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jahath u long u rangbah, bad u Siiah uba ar: hynrei u Jeush bad u Beriah kim don bun ki khun shynrang ; namarkata ki la don ha kawei ka jingkhein, kat kum ka iing u kpa jong ki .

en: And , ye masters , do the same things unto them , forbearing threatening : knowing that your Master also is in heaven ; neither is there respect of persons with him .
kha: Phi ki kynrad , to leh ha kajuh ka rukom ïa ki mraw jong phi bad keiñ noh ki jingbyrngem . To kynmaw ba ma phi bad ki mraw jong phi , phi long ki jong ujuh U Kynrad uba ha bneng , uba bishar ïa baroh da kajuh ka jingthew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, phi ki kynrad, to leh ia kijuh kiei kiei ha ki, da kaba pyrkhat: da kaba tip ba u Kynrad jong phi ruh u don ha bneng ; bad ym don ka jingburom ia ki briew bad u .

en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .
kha: Mynta , nga ong skhem ha phi , ba shano shano ba yn ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ban kynmaw ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Hangno hangno ba ia kane ka gospel yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ia kane ruh ba ka la leh yn kren na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw ia ka .

en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother , and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath , and utterly destroyed it . And the name of the city was called Hormah .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leit ryngkat bad ki paid Simeon , bad ki la jop ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sephath . Ki la buh ka jingtim halor ka nongbah , ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad ki la ai kyrteng ïa ka , ka Hormah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la leit bad u hynmen jong u u Simeon bad ki la pyniap ia ki nong Kanaan kiba la shong ha ka Sephath bad ki la pynjot lut ia ka . Bad ka kyrteng jong ka shnong la khot ka Hormah .

en: Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :
kha: U ong ha ki ,  To long kiba kut jingmut bad kiba sngewskhem , bad wat sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria lane ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba u ïalam . Ngi don kham bun ka bor ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba khlain bad kiba shlur , wat tieng ne sngewsih ia u syiem Assyria , ne na ka bynta u paidbah baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u: namar ki don kham bun bad ngi ban ia u:

en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .
kha: Haba uta u briew u ïohi ba um lah jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u ka la lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohi ba um shym la jop ia u , u la ktah ia ka tyrpeng jong u ; bad ka tyrpeng jong u Jakob ka la mih na ka tyrpeng jong u Jakob .

en: He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .
kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei dei ban otsher , bad kane kan long ka dak kaba paw shabar ban pyn-i ba ka jutang jong nga bad me ka long kaba ïaineh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la kha ha iing jong me bad uta uba la thied da ka pisa jong me, u dei ban shah ot: bad ka jutang jong nga kan long ha ka doh jong phi na ka bynta ka jutang bymjukut .

en: Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .
kha: Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka nongbah bad shna ka lynti na ka bynta u paidlang u ban wan phai ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynkhuid ïa ki maw kiba don ha ka ! To sieh ïa ka lama , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit lyngba , iaid lyngba ki khyrdop ; pynkhreh ia ka lynti jong ki briew;

en: The elders which are among you I exhort , who am also an elder , and a witness of the sufferings of Christ , and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed :
kha: Ma nga , uba ïa lade nga long u nongsharai balang , nga kyntu ïa ki nongsharai balang ka balang hapdeng jong phi . Nga long u sakhi ïa ki jingshahshitom U Khrist , bad ngan ïoh bynta ha ka burom kaba yn sa pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah kiba don hapdeng jong phi nga kyntu ia phi , kiba long ruh u rangbah bad u sakhi ia ki jingjynjar U Khrist , bad ruh u nongiashim bynta ha ka burom kaba yn sa pynpaw:

en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .
kha: Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kumba pynum ïa ka rupa ha ka lawar ding , bad nangta kin tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la pynkhyllem ia ka rupa hapdeng ka ding , kumta phin sa shah pynkhyllem hapdeng jong ka ; bad phin sa tip ba nga U Trai nga la theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong phi .

en: And David spake unto the  Lord  the words of this song in the day that the  Lord  had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies , and out of the hand of Saul :
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u Dabid na u Saul bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun , u Dabid u la rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kren ha U Trai ia ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai ha ka sngi ba U Trai u la pyllait im ia u na ka kti jong ki nongshun jong u baroh:

en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .
kha: Bun ki briew ki la wan sha Jerusalem , da kaba wanrah ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  bad ki jingai ïa u Hesekaïah , ba nangta sha khmat baroh ki jaitbynriew ki pyndonburom ïa u Hesekaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha sha U Trai ha Jerusalem, bad ki ai ha u Hesekaiah syiem Judah: kumta u la shah pynkhraw ha khmat ki jaitbynriew baroh naduh kata ka por .

en: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured , even thy merchants , from thy youth : they shall wander every one to his quarter  ; none shall save thee .
kha: Kata ka long baroh kaba kin leh ïa pha — kito ki nongbatai kupar kiba pha la twad jingmut baroh shi jingim jong pha . Baroh na ki kin ieh ïa pha bad kin leit ha la ki lynti , bad yn ym don uba sah u ban pyllait im ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kin long ha me bad me, wat ki nongkhaii jong me, naduh ka jinglong samla jong me: kin iaid kai iwei ia iwei pat; ym don mano mano ruh ban pynim ia me .

en: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made , to consecrate and to sanctify them : but a stranger shall not eat thereof , because they are holy .
kha: Kin bam tang ïa kata ïa kaba la pyndonkam ha ka jinglehniam ka jingmap ha ka por ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki . Tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingbam , namar ka long kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin bam ia kita kiei kiei kiba la pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid, ban pynkyntang bad ban pynkyntang ia ki: hynrei u nongwei un ym bam ia ki , namar ki long kiba khuid .

en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all that oppressed you , and drave them out from before you , and gave you their land  ;
kha: Nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki Ijipt bad na ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi hangne ha kane ka ri . Nga la beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat , bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pyllait noh ia phi na ka kti jong ki nong Ijipt bad na ka kti jong baroh kiba la pynshitom bein ia phi, bad nga la beh noh ia ki na khmat jong phi, bad nga la ai ia phi ia ka ri jong ki;

en: The  Lord  shall bring a nation against thee from far , from the end of the earth , as swift as the eagle flieth  ; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand  ;
kha: U  Trai  un phah ïa ka jaitbynriew na kaba kut ka pyrthei pyrshah ïa phi , ka jaitbynriew kaba ka ktien ka thylliej jong ka phin ym sngewthuh . Kin wan hiar kynsan ha phi kumba suh u pukni .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un wanrah ia ka jaitbynriew pyrshah ia me na jngai, na kaba kut jong ka khyndew, kumba u blang u her ; ka jaitbynriew kaba ka shyntur jong u wat sngewthuh ; .
