en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought . And every shipmaster , and all the company in ships , and sailors , and as many as trade by sea , stood afar off ,
kha: Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kane ka spah !  Baroh ki kapten jong ki liengbah bad ki nongshong lieng , ki maji bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la ïoh kamai na ka duriaw , ki la ïeng na sha jngai bah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka shi kynta ka spah kaba khraw ka la wan sha ka jaka kaba khraw . Bad uwei pa uwei u nongshna lieng bad ka kynhun baroh ha ki lieng bad ki nongleit jingleit bad katba ki long kiba khaii da ka duriaw ki la ieng sha jngai .

en: If a man say , I love God , and hateth his brother , he is a liar : for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen , how can he love God whom he hath not seen ?
kha: Lada uno uno u ong ba u ieit ïa U Blei , hynrei u isih ïa la u parabriew , u long uba lamler . Naba um lah ban ieit ïa U Blei , ïa uba um shym ïohi , lada um ieit ïa la u parabriew ïa uba u ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u ong , Nga ieit ia U Blei bad u shun ia la u hynmen: namar uta u bym ieit ia la u hynmen uba u la iohi , kumno u lah ban ieit ia U Blei uba um shym la iohi ?

en: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , and advanced him , and set his seat above all the princes that were with him .
kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Serksis u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Haman sha ka kyrdan myntri rangbah . U Haman u dei u khun jong u Hammedatha , uba hiarpateng na u Agag .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei u syiem Ahasaer u la pynroi ia u Haman u khun u Agagite , bad u la pynkiew ia u , bad u la buh ia ka jaka shong jong u halor ki syiem baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
kha: U syiem u la phah sa uwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah , kiba la leit kiew bad ong ha u Elijah ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shisyndon !
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien ruh u la phah sha u sa uwei pat u rangbah shiphew ngut bad ki sanphew ngut jong u . Bad u la jubab bad u la ong ha u , ko briew jong U Blei, kumta u syiem u la ong: To wan hiar kloi .

en: And so I saw the wicked buried , who had come and gone from the place of the holy , and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done : this is also vanity .
kha: Ho-oid nga la ïohi ïa ki riewbymman ba la tep bad hapoh ki jingtep jong ki , hynrei ha ka lynti leit phai na lum jingtep ki briew ki ïaroh ïa ki ha kata ka nongbah ha kaba ki la leh ïa ki kam sniew jong ki . Ka long ka bym don jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta nga la iohi ia kiba sniew kiba la leit noh na ka jaka jong kiba khuid , bad la klet noh ia ki ha ka shnong ha kaba ki la leh kumta: kane ruh ka long kaba khlem akor .

en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?
kha: A Trai , uno uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ? Hano ba U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingong jong u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa kan long kaba la pyndep , kaba u la kren , ko Trai uba la ngeit ia ka khubor jong ngi ? bad ha mano la pynpaw ia ka kti U Trai ?

en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation , that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble , by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God .
kha: U ïarap ïa ngi ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei kiba don ki jingjynjar babun jait , da kaba pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka lad jingïarap kaba ngi hi ngi la ïohpdiang na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba pyntngen ia ngi ha ka jingjynjar jong ngi baroh , ba ngin lah ban pyntngen ia ki kiba don ha kano kano ka jingeh , da ka jingpyntngen da kaba ngi hi ngi shah pyntngen na U Blei .

en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days  ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee , neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .
kha: Ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ; ym dei ban don u thiat ne u kpu ba la khleh thiat hangno hangno ha ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Yn bam ia u kpu bym don thied hynriew sngi bad ym dei ban iohi ia u kpu ba la khleh lang bad me , lymne ym dei ban iohi ia u kpu ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad me ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad ki ktah ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad ki ktah ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad ki ktah ha ki jaka ba la khleh lang bad ki ktah

en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family , because he hath no son ? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father .
kha: Tang namar ba im don khun shynrang , balei keiñ ba ka kyrteng jong i kan jah na Israel ? Ai bynta kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi hapdeng ki kur ki jait jong i pa .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ba ka kyrteng jong u kpa jong ngi kan jah noh na ka iing jong u ? Ai ha ngi namarkata ia ka jingdon hapdeng ki hynmen jong u kpa jong ngi .

en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Lada me kwah ban long uba janai , to khie leit bad die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta to wan bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u, Lada me kwah ban long uba janai, to leit die ia kata kaba me don, bad to ai ha kiba duk, bad me don ka spah ha bneng: bad to wan bud ia nga .

en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a jealous God among you ) lest the anger of the  Lord  thy God be kindled against thee , and destroy thee from off the face of the earth .
kha: Lada phi mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ka jingbitar U  Trai  kan wan bad thang ïa phi kum ka ding bad kan pynjot thiaw ïa phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba don ryngkat bad phi , um lah shah ba phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u long U Blei uba sngewsih hapdeng jong phi ) ioh ba ka jingbitar jong U Trai U Blei jong me kan kylla pyrshah ia me, bad pynjot ia me na ka khmat ka khyndew .

en: While the word was in the king s mouth , there fell a voice from heaven , saying , O king Nebuchadnezzar , to thee it is spoken  ; The kingdom is departed from thee .
kha: Ha shuwa ba ki kyntien kin mih shabar na ka shyntur jong u , ka sur ka la kren na bneng ,  Ko syiem Nebukhadnessar , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ! Ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong me la shim noh mynta na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ka ktien ka dang don ha ka shyntur jong u syiem, ka la hap ka sur na bneng, ka ong: Ko syiem Neuchadnezzar, ha me la kren; Ka hima ka la jah noh na me .

en: And Adam knew his wife again  ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .
kha: U Adam bad ka tnga jong u ki ka ïoh sa uwei pat u khun . Ka la ong ,  U Blei u la ai khun shynrang ïa nga ha ka jaka u Abel , ïa uba u Kain u la pynïap .  Kumta ka la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
translated_en_to_kha: U Adam u la ithuh biang ia ka tnga jong u bad ka la kha khun shynrang, bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Seth: Na ka bynta U Blei, ka la ong ba u la thung ia nga uwei pat u symbai ha ka jaka jong u Abel, uba u Kain u la pyniap .

en: Now when the sun was setting , all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him  ; and he laid his hands on every one of them , and healed them .
kha: Hadien ba la sep ka sngi , baroh kiba don ki paralok kiba pang na ki jait jingpang kiba pher bapher , ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu ; u la buh ïa la ki kti halor uwei pa uwei bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka sngi ka la sep , baroh kiba pang bad ki jingpang jyrhoh ki la wanrah ia ki ha u ; bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha uwei pa uwei na ki , bad u la pynkoit ia ki .

en: Which when they had taken up , they used helps , undergirding the ship  ; and , fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands , strake sail , and so were driven .
kha: Ki la kyntiew ïa ka , bad ki la teh katto katne ki tyllai sawdong ïa ka lieng . Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki lah ban tyngkhuh sha ka jaka kaba don shyiap jngai na ka rud duriaw jong ka Libya , kumta ki la pynhiar ïa ki jaiñ pynshah lyer bad ki la shah ïa ka lieng ban shah kit da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba haba ki la shim ia ka lieng, ki la pyndonkam ia ki jingiarap, ki la pynkhih ia ka lieng ; bad , ki tieng ba kin hap ha ki rud duriaw kiba stet , ki la iaid stet bad kumta ki la shah beh noh .

en: And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .
kha: Ki nang ruh ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka por ha kaba kyntiap na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat ; hynrei kaba kham sniew , ki nang ban ïa-lorni bad pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka jinglong ba rit ki nang ban long kiba khlem akor, ki iaid kai na iing sha iing bad ym tang ki bym don shuh, hynrei ki nonglehkai ruh bad ki briew kiba bunkam, ki kren ia kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban leh .

en: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ïakren shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Jisu u la tip ia kata , u ong ha ki , Balei phi pyrkhat ba phim don kpu ? phim sngewthuh haduh mynta ? hato ka dohnud jong phi ka dang khlain ?

en: And shed innocent blood , even the blood of their sons and of their daughters , whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan : and the land was polluted with blood .
kha: Ki la pynïap ïa kito ki khun balui lui , bad ïa ka ri la pynjyrsieh da kita ki jingpynïap briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynmih ia ka snam kaba khlem pop, wat ia ka snam jong ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki, kiba ki la knia ha ki bleithaw jong ka ri Kana: bad ka ri ka la jakhlia da ka snam .

en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . And Alexander beckoned with the hand , and would have made his defence unto the people .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pynskhem ba u Aleksandar u kitkhlieh , namar ba ki Jiw ki la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha khmat . Te u Aleksandar u la ai dak da la ka kti ba ki paidbah kin sngap jar , bad u la pyrshang ban kren ïasaid da .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tan ia u Alexander na u paidbah, ki Jiw ki la buh ia u sha khmat . U Alexander u la sngap jar bad ka kti bad u la leh ia ka jingiada jong u ha ki briew .

en: And this shall be a sign unto you , saith the  Lord  , that I will punish you in this place , that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil :
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka jingpynshisha ba ngan pynshitom ïa phi ha kane ka jaka bad ba ka jingkular jong nga ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha phi kan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka dak ha phi , ong U Trai , ba ngan pynshitom ia phi ha kane ka jaka , ba phin tip ba ki ktien jong nga kin ieng shisha pyrshah ia phi na ka bynta ka jingsniew:

en: Again I say unto you , That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask , it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven .
kha: Bad nga ong shuh shuh ha phi : Ha man ba ar ngut na phi , phi ïamynjur shaphang kaei kaei kaba phi ïa-pan , yn ai ïa kata ha phi da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien nga ong ha phi , Ba lada arngut na phi kin ia mynjur lang ha ka pyrthei kumba ki pan ei ei , kan long na ka bynta jong ki na ka bynta jong nga uba don ha bneng .

en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave , that thou wouldest keep me secret , until thy wrath be past , that thou wouldest appoint me a set time , and remember me !
kha: A ba men da buhrieh ïa nga ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; to ai ba yn buhrieh ïa nga tad haduh ban da jah ka jingbitar jong me , bad sa buh ïa ka por ba men kynmaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: O ba me buhrieh ia nga ha ka jingtep, ba me buhrieh ia nga, haduh ba ka jingbitar jong me kan iaid noh, ba me buh ia nga ka por ba la buh bad kynmaw ia nga !

en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
kha: U Jotham u long syiem haba u la don arphew san snem ka rta , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerushah , ka khun jong u Sadok .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jotham u la don arphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kyrteng jong ka kmie jong u ruh ka long ka Jerusha , ka khun jong u Sadok .

en: And she called unto her husband , and said , Send me , I pray thee , one of the young men , and one of the asses , that I may run to the man of God , and come again .
kha: Nangta ka khot ïa la u tnga , bad ka ong ha u ,  Phah ïa u shakri hangne lem bad ka kada . Nga donkam ban leit sha u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa . Ngan wan phai kloi katba nga lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la khot ia u tnga jong ka bad ka la ong: To phah ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, uwei na ki samla bad uwei na ki kada, ba ngan mareh sha u briew U Blei bad wan phai biang .

en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies  lands  ; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them .
kha: Katto katne na phi kiba dang lait im ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi kin nang ringswai namar ka pop jong phi bad ka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba sah na phi kin sa sngewsih ha ka jingbymhok jong ki ha ki ri nongshun jong phi bad ruh ha ki jingbymhok jong ki kpa jong ki kin sa sngewsih ia ki .

en: And the king of the south shall be strong , and one of his princes  ; and he shall be strong above him , and have dominion  ; his dominion shall be a great dominion .
kha: U syiem ka Ijipt un long uba khlaiñ . Hynrei , uwei na ki nongïalam shipai jong u un kham khraw bad un synshar ïa ka hima kaba kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un long uba khlain bad uwei na ki syiem jong u un long uba khlain halor jong u, bad un don ka jingsynshar ; ka jingsynshar jong u kan long ka jingsynshar kaba khraw .

en: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof , by the two corners of it , upon the two sides thereof , to be places for the staves to bear it withal .
kha: U thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad u pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba ïa-pyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar na ka bynta jong ka hapoh ka khlieh jong ka, da ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka, ha ki arliang jong ka, ban long ki jaka na ka bynta ki dieng ban kit ia ka da ka rong .

en: Whosoever transgresseth , and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ , hath not God . He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ , he hath both the Father and the Son .
kha: Uno uno u bymïaineh ha ka jinghikai U Khrist , hynrei uba ïaid palat ïa ka , um don ïa U Blei . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha ka jinghikai , u don ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba iaid lait ia ka jinghikai U Khrist , um don U Blei . Uta uba iaineh ha ka jinghikai U Khrist , u don ia U Kpa bad U Khun .

en: Between 1981 and 2000 , she was consultant clinical haematologist at Belfast City Hospital and was deputy director of the Northern Ireland Blood Transfusion Service .
kha: Hapdeng u snem 1981 bad 2000 , ka la long ka nongsumar snam ha Belfast City Hospital bad ka la long ruh ka deputy director jong ka tnad ai snam ha Northern Ireland .
translated_en_to_kha: Hapdeng u snem 1981 bad 2000 , ka la long ka doktor ha Belfast City City bad ka la long ka nongpyniaid ba kyrpang jong ka ri Ireland .

en: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .
kha: Ïa ka jingjied jong u la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingaiei jong u , ym ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Namar lada ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba ki briew ki leh , te ka jingaiei jong u kan ym long ka jingaiei bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada da ka jingaiei, te kam long shuh ki kam: lym kumta ka jingaiei kam long shuh ka jingaiei . Hynrei lada ka long ka jingaiei: lym kumta ka kam kam kam long shuh ka kam .

en: The Son of man indeed goeth , as it is written of him : but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed ! good were it for that man if he had never been born .
kha: U Khun U Briew un ïap kumba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ong ba un ïap ; hynrei katno kan long kaba sngewshyrkhei na ka bynta uta u briew uba shetkylla ïa U Khun U Briew ! Kan jin da la kham bha na ka bynta uta u briew lada ym shym la kha ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: U Khun u briew u leit shisha kumba la thoh shaphang jong u: hynrei kordit ia uta u briew da uba la shet kylla ia u Khun u briew ! ka la long kaba bha ia uta u briew lada um pat ju kha ia u .

en: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .
kha: lada ka long ban pynshlur ïa kiwei , ngi dei ban leh kumta . Uno uno uba ïasam bad kiwei u dei ban leh ïa kata da ka jingkylluid mynsiem ; uno uno uba don ka iktiar u dei ban trei shitom ; uno uno uba pyn-i ka jingsbun ïa kiwei u dei ban leh da kaba kmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane uta uba pynshlur, da ka jingkyntu: uta uba ai, to ai ba un leh ia kata da ka jinglong kaba suk ; uta uba synshar, da ka jingminot ; uta uba pyni ia ka jingisynei, da ka jingkmen .

en: But ye say , If a man shall say to his father or mother , It is Corban , that is to say , a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ; he shall be free .
kha: Hynrei phi hikai ba lada u briew u don ei ei , kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ha kaba ïarap ïa u kpa lane ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka Korban’ ( kaba mut , ka long sha U Blei ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phi ong , Lada u briew un ong ha la u kpa ne ka kmie , Ka long u Korban , kata ka mut ka jingai sngewbha , da kaba phi lah ban ioh jingmyntoi na nga; un long uba laitluid .

en: Then David enquired of the  Lord  yet again . And the  Lord  answered him and said , Arise , go down to Keilah  ; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u kylli sa shisien na U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Keilah , namar ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai sa shisien pat . Bad U Trai u la jubab ia u bad u la ong: To khie leit hiar sha Keilah ; namar ngan aiti ia ki Philistia ha ka kti jong me .

en: And after that came his brother out , and his hand took hold on Esau s heel  ; and his name was called Jacob : and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them .
kha: Ïa uba ar la kha da kaba u batskhem triang ïa ka khongdong jat jong u Iso ; kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Jakob . U Isaak u la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u hynmen jong u u la mih noh, bad ka kti jong u ka la bat ia u Iso bad la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Jakob: bad u Isaak u la dap hynriew snem ka rta haba ka la kha ia ki .

en: And lay siege against it , and build a fort against it , and cast a mount against it  ; set the camp also against it , and set battering rams against it round about .
kha: Nangta , ban pyn-i nuksa ïa ka jingshah kerkut , buh ki kharai , ki kynton khyndew , ki jaka sher dara bad ki tiar pynpait kynroh baroh sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to buh ia ka ha ka jaka kaba jrong pyrshah ia ka, bad to buh ia ka jingkieng pyrshah ia ka; to buh ia ka jaka sah ruh pyrshah ia ka, bad buh ia ki langbrot kiba ia tyngkhuh pyrshah ia ka sawdong .

en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .
kha: Kan jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba kin ym jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka hok ban ïa kaba tip ïa ka bad nangta pat ban phai dien noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la kham bha ia ki ban ym tip ia ka lynti jong ka hok, ban ia kaba ki la tip ia ka, ban phai noh na ka hukum bakhuid kaba la aiti ha ki .

en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins : they afflict the just , they take a bribe , and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .
kha: Nga tip haduh katno ki pop jong phi ki long kiba sngewshyrkhei bad katno kiba bun ki kam runar phi la leh . Phi pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew kiba bha , phi bamsap , phi khang noh ïa kiba duk ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok ha ki ïingbishar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia ki jingpynkhein kiba bun bad ki pop kiba khraw jong phi: ki pynshitom ia kiba hok , ki shim ia ka pisa , bad ki pynphai noh ia kiba duk ha ka khyrdop na ka liang kadiang jong ki .

en: And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .
kha: U Laban u ong ha u ,  Shah ba ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba wad na U Blei ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la ong ha u, nga kyrpad ia me, lada nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha ki khmat jong me, to sah: namar nga la nang da ka jingshemphang ba U Trai u la kyrkhu ia nga na ka bynta jong me .

en: Ask ye of the  Lord  rain in the time of the latter rain  ; so the  Lord  shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .
kha: To pan na U  Trai  ïa u slap ha ka pyrem jong ka snem . U dei U  Trai  uba phah ïa ki lyoh slap bad ïa u  lap praw , da kaba pynjyrngam ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli ia u slap jong U Trai ha ka por jong u slap ba hadien; kumta U Trai un pynlong ia ki lyoh kiba shai, bad un ai slap ia ki, ha uwei pa uwei u phlang ha lyngkha .

en: Every valley shall be filled , and every mountain and hill shall be brought low  ; and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough ways shall be made smooth  ;
kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei ka them dei ban pyndap , ïa uwei ba uwei u lumrit bad u lumbah dei ban pynmadan . Ïa ki lynti kiba kyllaiñ dei ban pynbeit , bad ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba khohruh khohram dei ban pynjlih .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka them kan long kaba jylliew, bad uwei pa uwei u lum bad u lum un shah pynhiar mynsiem bad ia kaba jylliew yn pynlong beit, bad ia ki lynti kiba jylliew yn pynlong beit ; .

en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs : but the time cometh , when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs , but I shall shew you plainly of the Father .
kha: Nga la pyndonkam da ki rukom kren bapher ban ïathuh ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei . Hynrei ka por kan poi haba ngan ym pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher , hynrei ngan kren ha phi da kaba shai kdar shaphang U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la kren ha phi da ki proberb: hynrei ka por ka wan , ha kaba ngan ym kren shuh ha phi da ki proberb , hynrei ngan pyni shai ia phi shaphang U Kpa .

en: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives , and in their death they were not divided : they were swifter than eagles , they were stronger than lions .
kha: U Saul bad u Jonathan , ki long kiba phylla bad ba sngewieit ; Ryngkat ryngkat ha ka jingim , bad ryngkat ryngkat ha ka jingïap ; ki kham stet ban ïa ki pukni , ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki sing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul bad u Jonathan ki long kiba ieit bad kiba sngewtynnad ha ka jingim jong ki , bad ha ka jingiap jong ki kim shym la shah phiah: ki kham stet ban ia ki blang , ki kham khlain ban ia ki sing .

en: And they brought every man his present , vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and garments , and armour , and spices , horses , and mules , a rate year by year .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew uba wan u wallam ïa u ka jingai sngewbha — ki tiar kiba da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ki barandi , ki tiar ïapom , ki jingiwbih , ki kulai , bad ki khashor . Kane ka ïailong kumta man ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia uwei pa uwei u jingai sngewbha jong u, ki tiar rupa, bad ki jain ksiar, bad ki jainkup bad ki jainkup bad ki jingbam ba bang, ki kulai bad ki kulai, ka dor man la u snem .

en: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret  ; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon .
kha: U la ong ïa ki ban duwai ha U Blei ka bneng na ka bynta ka jingisynei bad ban kyrpad ïa u ban batai ïa ka jingmaïan ha ki khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap lem bad kiwei pat ki nongai jingmut ha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin kwah ia ki jingsngewsih jong U Blei jong ka bneng shaphang kane ka jingmaham ; ba u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u kim dei ban jah noh bad kiwei pat ki riewstad jong ka Babilon .

en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and lament over thee , saying , What city is like Tyre , like the destroyed in the midst of the sea ?
kha: Ki phawar ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha : ‘ Badno yn ïanujor ïa ka Tyros , ka Tyros kaba la jah jar mynta shapoh duriaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingsawa jong ki kin shim ia ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta jong me, bad kin iam halor me, ki da ong: Kaei ka shnong kaba kum ka Tyros , kum kaba la shah pynjot hapdeng ka duriaw ?

en: Therefore , behold , I , even I , will utterly forget you , and I will forsake you , and the city that I gave you and your fathers , and cast you out of my presence :
kha: te ïathuh ïa ki ba da shisha ngan shim trait ïa ki , bad ngan bret noh ïa ki sha jngai na nga , ïa ki bad ïa ka nongbah kaba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , ha khmih , nga ruh ngan klet noh ia phi , bad ngan iehnoh ia phi bad ia ka shnong kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi:

en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious , even to the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O ye house of Israel , let it suffice you of all your abominations ,
kha: Ïathuh ïa kito ki paid Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan ym lah shah shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong ha ka iing Israel kaba leh pyrshah , wat ha ka iing Israel , Kumta u Trai Blei u ong; ko iing Israel , to ai ba kan biang ia phi na ki jingleh bymman jong phi baroh .

en: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas , Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord , and see how they do .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Paul u la ong ïa u Barnabas ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit phai pat bad leit jngoh ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi ha man la ka shnong ha kaba ngi la ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai , bad to ngin wad kumno ki ïalong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne sngi hadien ba u Paul u la ong ha u Barnabas , To ngin leit phai biang bad leit jngoh ia ki para jong ngi ha man la ki shnong ha kaba ngi la ialap ia ka ktien U Trai bad ngin peit kumno ki leh .

en: Therefore it shall come to pass , when the Egyptians shall see thee , that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me , but they will save thee alive .
kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt kin ïohi ïa pha , kin tharai ba pha dei ka tnga jong nga , bad kumta kin pynïap ïa nga bad shah ïa pha , ban im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan sa jia haba ki nong Ijipt kin iohi ia me, ba kin ong: Kane ka dei ka tnga jong u: bad kin pyniap ia nga , hynrei kin pynim ia me .

en: Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .
kha: Nalor kata , hato ki wah Abana bad Pharpar kiba ha Damaskos kim kham bha ban ïa kano kano ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban sum ha ki bad ban ïohkhiah !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka Abana bad ka Pharpar, ki wah Damasa, ki kham bha ban ia ki um Israel baroh ? nga lah ban ym sait ha ki , bad ban long uba khuid ? Kumta u la phai bad u la leit noh da ka jingbitar .

en: But thus shall ye deal with them  ; ye shall destroy their altars , and break down their images , and cut down their groves , and burn their graven images with fire .
kha: Kumta , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynpait pharia ïa ki rishot mawkyntang jong ki , mait ïa ki dak ka blei Asherah jong ki , bad thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumta phin leh ia ki ; phin pynjot ia ki nongleh kam sniew jong ki, bad phin pynpra ia ki dur jong ki, bad phin ot ia ki khlaw jong ki, bad thang ia ki dur ba la ker jong ki da ka ding .

en: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God  , The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come , and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .
kha: Ong ïa ka nongbah ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Namar ba pha la pynïap ïa kiba bun ki briew la jong bad pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , ka por jong pha ka la poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ong ma me , Kumta u Trai Blei u ong , Ka shnong ka pynmih snam hapdeng jong ka , ba ka por jong ka kan wan , bad ka pynlong ia ki bleithaw pyrshah ia lade ban pynjakhlia ia lade .

en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon , as much as thou shalt need : and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa  ; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem .
kha: Ha ki lum Lebanon ngin khet ïa ki dieng Kedar baroh katba phi donkam , ngin teh ïa ki ha ki bur , bad pynkie ïa ki ha ka duriaw shaduh Joppa . Na kata ka jaka phi lah ban kit ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngin ot ia u dieng na Lebanon katba phi donkam: bad ngin wanrah ia u ha me ha ki wah ha Joppa ; bad me men rah ia u sha Jerusalem .

en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .
kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Kine ki dei ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga hangne ha Ijipt .  U Jakob u ong ,  Wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha la u kpa, Ki long ki khun shynrang jong nga, kiba U Blei u la ai ha nga ha kane ka jaka . Bad u la ong: To wanrah ia ki, nga kyrpad ia me, ha nga bad ngan kyrkhu ia ki .

en: And Joshua said unto the people , Ye cannot serve the  Lord  : for he is an holy God  ; he is a jealous God  ; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins .
kha: U Joshua u ong ha u paidbah ,  Hynrei phin ym lah ban shakri ïa U  Trai . U long U Blei uba khuid bad un ym map ïa ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki briew , Phim lah ban shakri ia U Trai: namar u long U Blei bakhuid ; u long U Blei uba sngewsih ; un ym map ia ki jingpynkhein jong phi ne ia ki pop jong phi .

en: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .
kha: Un hap ban iehnoh ïa baroh kaba u la dep trei ; un ym ïohlad ban lehkmen halor ka spah jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba u la trei shitom na ka bynta jong u un pynphai biang ia ka: kat kum ka jingdon jong u kan long ka jingsiew kylliang , bad un ym sngewbha ha ka .

en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .
kha: bad u la jied ïa ki rangbah kiba tbit napdeng ki Israel baroh . U la thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ki spah , ki sanphew , bad ki phew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la jied ia ki briew kiba tbit na ki Israel baroh, bad u la pynlong ia ki ban long ki khlieh halor ki briew, ki nongsynshar da ki hajar ngut, ki nongsynshar da ki spah ngut, ki nongsynshar da ki sanphew ngut bad ki nongsynshar da ki phew ngut .

en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon . And they blew the trumpet  ; and all the people said , God save king Solomon .
kha: U Sadok u shim ïa ka jingbuh umphniang Olib kaba u la wanrah na ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad u la pynsleh ïa u Solomon . Ki la put ïa ka turoi , bad ki paidbah baroh ki pyrta ,  Im slem Syiem Solomon !
translated_en_to_kha: U Nada u lyngdoh u la shim ia ka umphniang na ka iingmane bad u la pynsleh ia u Solomon . Ki la pynbthei ia ka turoi ; bad ki briew baroh ki la ong: U Blei u la pynim ia u syiem Solomon .

en: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jingaiei lyngba U Khrist Jisu ha shuwa ban sdang ka pyrthei , hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingwan U Nongpynim jong ngi , U Khrist Jisu . U la pynkut noh ïa ka bor jong ka jingïap bad lyngba ka Gospel la pynpaw ïa ka jingim bymïap shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingmih jong U Nongpynim jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , uba la pynduh noh ia ka jingiap , bad u la wanrah ia ka jingim bad ka jingbym lah iap sha ka jingshai lyngba ka gospel:

en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites , and unto the judge that shall be in those days , and enquire  ; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment :
kha: bad mudui ha u lyngdoh Lebi bad u nongbishar uba treikam ha kata ka por , bad ieh kin rai ma ki ïa kata ka mokotduma .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban wan sha ki lyngdoh ki Lebi bad sha u nongbishar uba don ha kita ki sngi, bad to kylli; bad kin pyni ia me ia ka sentens jong ka jingbishar:

en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .
kha: To sumar ba phin ym ibeiñ ïano ïano na kine kiba rit . Ki angel jong ki ha bneng , nga ong ha phi , ki ïai don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ba phin ym khein ia uwei ruh na kine ki khynnah rit ; namar nga ong ha phi , Ba ha bneng ki angel jong ki ki ju iohi ia ka khmat U Kpa jong nga uba don ha bneng .

en: And he gave unto Moses , when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai , two tables of testimony , tables of stone , written with the finger of God .
kha: Haba U Blei u la dep kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai , u ai ha u ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba U Blei da lade hi u la thoh ïa ki hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ha u Moses, haba u la pynkut noh ia ka jingiadei bad u ha u lum Sinai, ar tylli ki miej jong ka jingsakhi , ki miej maw , ba la thoh da ka kti U Blei .

en: The best of them is as a brier : the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge : the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh  ; now shall be their perplexity .
kha: Wat kiba bha tam bad bahok tam na ki , ki long ki bymdondor kum ki ñiut . Ka sngi ka la poi haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa ki briew , kumba u la maham ïa ki lyngba ki nongap phira , ki nongïathuhlypa . Mynta ki don ha ka jingkulmar jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba bha tam na ki ka long kum ka brier: kaba kham beit ka kham jem ban ia ka jingkhang kaba jrong: ka sngi jong ki nongap jong me bad ka jingleit jngoh jong me ka wan; mynta kan long ka jinglong lyngkar jong ki .

en: And the children of Israel journeyed , and came unto their cities on the third day . Now their cities were Gibeon , and Chephirah , and Beeroth , and Kirjath–jearim .
kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh , bad hadien lai sngi ki la poi ha ki nongbah ha kaba kine ki briew ki shong : Ka Gibeon , ka Shephirah , ka Beeroth bad ka Kiriath Jearim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit sha ki shnong jong ki ha ka sngi kaba lai . Mynta ki shnong jong ki ki long u Gibeon bad u Kphirah bad u Beeroth bad u Kirjatjear .

en: And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :
kha: Ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bathymmai bad ka jingmut bathymmai . Ngan shim noh ïa ka dohnud maw ba-mutlop bad ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bakohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai ia ki kawei ka dohnud , bad ngan buh ia ka mynsiem kaba thymmai hapoh jong phi ; bad ngan shim ia ka doh maw na ka doh jong ki , bad ngan ai ia ki ia ka doh doh:

en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
kha: Nangta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongbishar ba bishar hok ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingsngew jong ki briew . Nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ko Trai jong ki paid, kiba bishar hok, kiba pynshitom ia ki bniat bad ka dohnud, to ngan iohi ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong me halor jong ki: namar ha me nga la pynpaw ia ka daw jong nga .

en: And Nathan said to David , Thou art the man . Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I anointed thee king over Israel , and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul  ;
kha: Phi long uta u briew ,  u Nathan u ong ha u Dabid .  Bad kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u ong : ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem Israel bad pyllait im ïa me na u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathan u la ong ha u Dabid , Me long u briew . Kumta u Trai Blei jong ki Israel u ong: Nga la pynsleh ia me syiem halor ki Israel bad nga la pyllait noh ia me na ka kti u Saul;

en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .
kha: U la hukum ïa ki shakri ban pynspong ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua . Ki la leh kumta , bad nangta ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U  Trai  u dang ïeng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong , Ai ba kin buh ia ka mitre kaba bha halor ka khlieh jong u . Kumta ki la buh ia ka mitre kaba bha halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la phong ia u da ki jain . Bad u angel U Trai u la ieng hajan .

en: And when he was gone , a lion met him by the way , and slew him : and his carcase was cast in the way , and the ass stood by it , the lion also stood by the carcase .
kha: Ha lynti , u la ïakynduh ïa u sing uba la pynïap ïa u . Ka metïap jong u ka don ha ka lynti bah , bad ka kada bad u sing ki ïeng ha syndah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la leit noh, u sing ruh u la iakynduh ia u hajan ka met jong u: bad ka met jong u ka la shah bret ha lynti , bad u tdong jong u u la ieng hajan jong ka , u sing ruh u la ieng hajan ka met jong u .

en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;
kha: Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum kane ïa kaba la rakhe da uno uno na ki syiem Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynba ki nongbishar ki synshar ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ym shym la don kum kata ka jingkhawai na ki sngi jong ki nongbishar kiba la bishar ia ki Israel, lane ha ki sngi jong ki syiem Israel baroh .

en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria , and reigned forty and one years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynshar u Amasaïah u khun jong u Joash kum u syiem ka Judah , u Jeroboam u khun jong u Jehoash u long syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Amasaiah u khun u Joash u khun u Joash u la sdang ban synshar ha Samaria bad u la synshar sawphew snem .

en: The chariots shall rage in the streets , they shall justle one against another in the broad ways : they shall seem like torches , they shall run like the lightnings .
kha: Ki kali ïapom ki tyngkhuh kulmar ha ki lynti bah , da kaba mareh shane shatai lyngba ki jaka paidbah ka nongbah . Ki thaba kum ki dongmusa bad ki stet kum ka leilieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kali kin iaid ha ki lynti iaid kjat, kin ia tyngkhuh iwei ia iwei pat ha ki lynti kiba jylliew: kin long kum ki torch , kin iaid kum ki jingshai .

en: And Jesus went out , and his disciples , into the towns of Caesarea Philippi : and by the way he asked his disciples , saying unto them ,  Whom do men say that I am ?
kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la leit noh sha ki nongrit kiba hajan ka Kaisaria Philippi . Katba u dang ïaid ha lynti u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , ki briew ki ong ba nga dei uei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la mih noh bad ki synran jong u, sha ki shnong jong u Philippi: bad ha ka lynti u la kylli ia ki synran jong u, u da ong ha ki: Nga long mano ?

en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh nga la weng noh ia ka kti jong nga, bad nga la leh na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ba kan ym shah pynjakhlia ha khmat ki nongwei, ha kiba nga la wanrah ia ki .

en: Concerning Damascus . Hamath is confounded , and Arpad : for they have heard evil tidings : they are fainthearted  ; there is sorrow on the sea  ; it cannot be quiet .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka Damaskos :  Ki briew ha ki nongbah jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ki khuslai bad ki sngew jynjar namar ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khubor basniew . Ka jinglyng-a ka tyllun halor jong ki kum ka duriaw , bad kim ïoh jahthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang u Damasios . U Hamath u la sngewthuh bakla, bad u Arpad: namar ki la iohsngew ia ki khubor kiba sniew: ki la sngewsih ; ka don ka jingsngewsih ha ka duriaw ; kam lah ban sngap jar .

en: And Samuel took a sucking lamb , and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the  Lord  : and Samuel cried unto the  Lord  for Israel  ; and the  Lord  heard him .
kha: U Samuel u pynïap uwei u khunlangbrot bad u thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Nangta u duwai ha U  Trai  ban ïarap ïa ki Israel , bad U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la shim ia u khun langbrot uba dang dih, bad u la tyrwa ia ka kum ka jingknia thang baroh kawei ha U Trai: bad u Samuel u la pyrta ha U Trai na ka bynta ki Israel; bad U Trai u la iohsngew ia u .

en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself , God , I thank thee , that I am not as other men are , extortioners , unjust , adulterers , or even as this publican .
kha: U Pharisi u la ïeng kyrpang la ka jong hi bad u la duwai , ‘ Nga ainguh ïa me , a Blei , ba ngam long uba lalot , u bymhok , lane uba klim , kum uno uno uwei pat . Nga ainguh ba ngam long kum utai u nonglum khajna hangtai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharisi u la ieng bad u la duwai kumta bad lade, ko Blei, nga ainguh ia me, ba ngam long kum kiwei pat ki briew, ki nongleh kam sniew, ki bym hok, ki nongleh kam sniew, ne wat kum kane ka publican .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , and his might that he shewed , and how he warred , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , baroh ki kam shlur jong u bad ki thma jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoshaphat bad ka bor jong u kaba u la pyni bad kumno u la ialeh thma , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: Your mother shall be sore confounded  ; she that bare you shall be ashamed : behold , the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .
kha: hynrei ïa ka nongbah bakhraw kaba dei ka jong phi yn pynpoh bad pynjahburom . Ka Babilonia kan long ka hima kaba poh tam na baroh ; kan long kaba ryngkhiang bad ka ri shyiap bym don um satia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kmie jong phi kan sngewsih shibun: kata ka khunlung kan sngewlehrain: ha khmih , ka jingkhanglad jong ki jaitbynriew kan long ka ri khlaw , ka ri kaba rkhiang bad ka ri khlaw .

en: And of Levi he said , Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one , whom thou didst prove at Massah , and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah  ;
kha: Shaphang ka jait Lebi u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpaw ïa la ka mon da u Urim bad u Thummim   Lyngba ki Lebi , ki shakri kiba ïaineh jong me . Me la tynjuh ïa ki ha Massah , Bad me la phrang ïa ki ha ki um ka Meribah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Lebi u la ong: To ai ba ka Thummim bad ka Urim jong me kin long bad u bakhuid jong me, uba me la pynshisha ha Massah bad uba me la ialeh ha ki um jong ka Meribah;

en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .
kha: Nangta u Eli u ju kyrkhu ïa u Elkanah bad ka tnga jong u , bad u ong ha u Elkanah ,  To U  Trai  un ai shuh ki khun ïa phi na kane ka briew ha ka jaka uta uba phi la aiti sha u .  Hadien kata ki sa leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eli u la kyrkhu ia u Elkanah bad ka tnga jong u bad u la ong, U Trai u ai symbai ia kane ka kynthei na ka bynta ka ram kaba la ai ram ha U Trai . Ki la leit sha la iing .

en: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver , which I had given thee , and madest to thyself images of men , and didst commit whoredom with them ,
kha: Pha la shim ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad rupa jong pha kiba nga lah ai ha pha , ban thaw ki durblei shynrang , bad leh awria bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la shim ruh ia ki jingdeng ksiar jong nga bad ka rupa jong nga, kiba nga la ai ha me, bad me la leh ia ki dur jong ki briew bad me la leh ia ka kam khaii bad ki .

en: O house of Israel , cannot I do with you as this potter ? saith the  Lord . Behold , as the clay is in the potter s hand , so are ye in mine hand , O house of Israel .
kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh ïa phi ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaba u nongthaw khiew u la leh ïa ka dewbyrtha ? Phi don ha ki kti jong nga kum ka dewbyrtha ha ki kti u nongthaw khiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko iing Israel , hato ngam lah ban leh ia phi kum kane ka khiew ? ong U Trai . Ha khmih kumba ka dewbilat ka don ha ka kti jong u nongtied khiew , kumta phi don ha ka kti jong nga ko iing Israel .

en: And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?
kha: Katba U Jisu u la sdang biang ha ka jingïaid lynti jong u , uwei u briew u la wan mareh , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai Babha , kaei kaba nga dei ban leh ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la leit shabar shapoh lynti, uwei u la wan mareh, bad u la dem ha u, bad u la kylli ia u, Ko Nonghikai babha, ngan leh aiu ba ngan ioh pateng ia ka jingim bymjukut ?

en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )
kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit ka long kane :  Phim dei ban kylli ïa lade , Uei u ban leit sha bneng ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist sha tbian ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka hok kaba long na ka jingngeit ka kren ha kane ka jingstad , Wat ong ha ka dohnud jong me , Mano ba kiew sha bneng ? (ka mut ban pynhiar ia U Khrist na jrong: )

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Behold , I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah , that whosoever heareth of it , both his ears shall tingle .
kha: Kumta nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ngan wallam ka jingjot ha Jerusalem bad Judah ba uwei pa uwei uba ïohsngew shaphang kata un lyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , Ha khmih nga wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha Jerusalem bad Judah , ba uno uno uba iohsngew ia ka , baroh ar tylli ki shkor jong u kin khih .

en: And he said unto them , Take me up , and cast me forth into the sea  ; so shall the sea be calm unto you : for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you .
kha: U Jonah u la jubab ,  Bret noh ïa nga sha ka duriaw , bad kan sa long jai jai . Nga tip ka dei ka jingleh bymdei jong nga ba phi la ngat ha kane ka  erïong kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To shim ia nga sha jrong bad to bret noh ia nga sha duriaw; kumta ka duriaw kan sngap jar ia phi: namar nga tip ba na ka bynta jong nga kane ka eriong kaba khraw ka don halor jong phi .

en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ong . U la lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam bad u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la mih noh bad u la iathuh ha ki briew ia ki ktien U Trai bad u la lum lang ia ki hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah jong ki briew bad u la buh ia ki sawdong ka iingjain .

en: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the  Lord  seven days in the year . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations : ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month .
kha: Rakhe ïa ka hynñiew sngi . Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban bud ïa kane ka hukum pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin buh ia ka kum ka jingkhawai ha U Trai hynriew sngi ha ka snem . Kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi: phin rakhe ia ka ha ka taiew kaba hynriew .

en: And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .
kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ïa kiba bun ki kmie ban duh khun , kumta mynta ka kmie jong me kan long khlem khun .  Bad u pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka duwan ha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong , Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ia ki kynthei ki bym don khun, kumta ka kmie jong me kan long kaba khlem khun hapdeng ki kynthei . U Samuel u la bam ia u Agag ha khmat U Trai ha Gilgal .

en: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .
kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa phi ki Moab ! Phi kiba mane ïa u Khemosh , phi la jot ! U blei jong phi u pynphetwir ïa ki shynrang , Bad ïa ki kynthei u pynlong ki mraw jong u syiem Amor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia me, ko Moab ! me la leh khlem akor, ko ki briew jong u Khossh: u la ai ia ki khun shynrang jong u kiba la lait im, bad ki khun kynthei jong u, ha ka jingshah set ha u syiem jong ki Amorites .

en: And this I speak for your own profit ; not that I may cast a snare upon you , but for that which is comely , and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction .
kha: Nga ong ïa kane namar nga kwah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam shym pyrshang ban buh ha phi ïa ki jingpyrkhing . Pynban , nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba biang , bad ban aiti lut ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai khlem kano kano ka jingteh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane nga kren na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi hi; ym ba ngan bret ia ka jingma ia phi, hynrei na ka bynta kata kaba wan, bad ba phin leit sha U Trai khlem jingthut .

en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven , and proclaim and publish the free offerings : for this liketh you , O ye children of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ïaid shaphrang bad rah ïa u kpu jong phi kum ka jingainguh sha U Blei , bad to sngewsarong shaphang ki jingainguh ba tam ba phi wallam ! Kane ka long ka rukom ïa kaei kaei kaba phi ieit ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ka jingknia ainguh da ka jingkhuid , bad pynbna bad pynmih ia ki jingknia khlem jingsiew: namar kane ka sngewtynnad ia phi ko khun Israel , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Art thou better than populous No , that was situate among the rivers , that had the waters round about it , whose rampart was the sea , and her wall was from the sea ?
kha: Ko Ninebeh , hato pha kham bha ban ïa ka Thebes , ka nongbah jong ka Ijipt ? Ma ka ruh ka la don ka wah ban ïada ïa ka kum ka kynroh — Ka wah Nile ka la long kum ka jingker jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me kham bha ban ia ka pop No, kaba la don hapdeng ki wah, kaba don ki um sawdong jong ka, kaba ka jingkhang jong ka ka long ka duriaw , bad ka kynroh jong ka ka long na duriaw ?

en: And said , I beseech thee , O  Lord  God of heaven , the great and terrible God , that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments :
kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ,  A  Trai  U Blei jong ka bneng ! Me long uba khraw , ngi ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa me . Me batskhem ïa la ka jutang bad kito kiba ieit ïa me bad kiba leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Nga kyrpad ia me , ko Trai Blei jong ka bneng, U Blei uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei, uba bat ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei na ka bynta kito kiba ieit ia u bad kiba sumar ia ki hukum jong u:

en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :
kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop tang shisien bad na ka bynta ki por baroh , u briew uba bha na ka bynta ki nongpop , ba un ïoh ïalam ïa phi sha U Blei . La pynïap ïa u ha ka doh , hynrei la pynim pat ïa u ha ka mynsiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist ruh u la shah shitom shisien na ka bynta ki pop, kiba hok na ka bynta ki bym hok, ba un wanrah ia ngi sha U Blei, la pyniap ia ngi ha ka doh , hynrei la pynkloi ia ngi da U Mynsiem:

en: After that he brought me toward the south , and behold a gate toward the south : and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures .
kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka liang kaba shathie , bad hangta ngi la ïohi sa ïa kawei pat ka khyrdop . U la thew ïa ki kynroh bashapoh bad ïa ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ka la long katjuh kum kito kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la wanrah ia nga shaphang shathie, bad ha khmih ka khyrdop shaphang shathie : bad u la thew ia ki post jong ka bad ki arches jong ka kat kum kine ki jingthew .

en: Take , I pray thee , my blessing that is brought to thee  ; because God hath dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . And he urged him , and he took it .
kha: Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingai sngewbha kaba nga la wallam ïa phi ; U Blei u la lehsbun ïa nga , bad u la ai ïa nga baroh kaba nga donkam .  U Jakob u la ïai kyrpad ïa u haduh ba un da pdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim, nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kaba la wanrah ha me ; namar ba U Blei u la leh sngewbha ia nga, bad namar ba nga la biang . Bad u la kyntu ia u , bad u la shim ia ka .

en: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .
kha: Ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka iktiar halor ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima ban rat bad ban pynkhyllem , ban pynjot bad ban bret sharud , ban tei bad ban thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit , nga don ha kane ka sngi ban buh ia me halor ki jaitbynriew bad halor ki hima , ban tynrai noh , bad ban tan noh , bad ban pynjot , bad ban pynhap noh , ban tei bad ban thung .

en: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come , by a greater and more perfect tabernacle , not made with hands , that is to say , not of this building  ;
kha: Hynrei U Khrist u la lah wan lypa kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong kiei kiei kiba bha kiba la don lypa hangne . Ka Ïingjaiñ ha kaba u shakri ka long kaba kham khraw bad kaba kham janai ; kam dei ka ïingjaiñ kaba la shna da u briew , kata ka long , kam dei ka bynta jong kane ka pyrthei ïa kaba la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Khrist u wan u lyngdoh rangbah jong kiei kiei kiba bha ki ban sa wan, da ka iing kaba kham heh bad kaba kham janai, kaba ym shym la shna da ki kti, kata ka mut, ym na kane ka jingtei;

en: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
kha: Ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la poi ha Rom , u rangbah u la aiti ia ki koidi ha u rangbah shipai: hynrei u Paul u la shah shitom ban shong hi bad u shipai uba la sumar ia u .

en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .
kha: Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka wah Khebar , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga sah hangta hynñiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la wan sha ki jong ka jingshah set ha Telabib, kiba shong hajan ka wah Chebar , bad nga la shong ha ka jaka ba ki shong , bad nga la sah hangta nga la lyngngoh hapdeng jong ki hynriew sngi .

en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you : whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not , and their damnation slumbereth not .
kha: Ha ka jinglalot jong ki , kine ki nonghikai balamler kin kamai da kaba ïathuh ïa phi ïa ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu thaw . La kham slem mynta U Nongbishar jong ki u la long uba la kloi , bad u Nongpynjot jong ki u la long u bym ju ïohthiah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lyngba ka jingkwah brai kin pynlong ia phi da ki ktien ba la shna da ki briew: kiba ka jingbishar jong ki mynta ka por kaba jrong kam sahkut, bad ka jingpynrem jong ki kam sahkut .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  See ye not all these things ? verily I say unto you , There shall not be left here one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
kha: Ho-oid ,  u la ong ,  phi lah ban khmih ïa kine baroh . Nga ong ha phi ïa kane : Yn ym don uwei u maw hangne u ban dang neh ha la ka jaka ; uwei pa uwei na ki un shah pynhap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Hato phim iohi ia kine kiei kiei baroh ? shisha nga ong ha phi , Ym shym la iehnoh hangne uwei u maw halor uwei pat , u bym shah pynhap .

en: These be the heads of their fathers  houses : The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel  ; Hanoch , and Pallu , Hezron , and Carmi : these be the families of Reuben .
kha: U Reuben , u khun nyngkong jong u Jakob , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : U Hanokh , u Pallu , u Hesron , bad u Karmi ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki khlieh jong ki iing ki sem jong ki: Ki khun shynrang jong u Reuben u khun nyngkong jong ki Israel;

en: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?
kha: A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Uei uba la pynthame ïa phi ? Ha khmat ki khmat jong phi hi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Jisu Khrist halor ka diengphna!
translated_en_to_kha: Ko nong Galatia uba bieit , uba la pynshoi ia phi , ba phim dei ban kohnguh ia ka jingshisha , ha khmat jong u Jisu Khrist u la paw shai ba u la sahnarphna hapdeng jong phi ?

en: For the indignation of the  Lord  is upon all nations , and his fury upon all their armies : he hath utterly destroyed them , he hath delivered them to the slaughter .
kha: U  Trai  u bitar ïa baroh ki hima bad baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki . U la pynrem ïa ki sha ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingbitar U Trai ka long halor ki jaitbynriew baroh, bad ka jingbitar jong u halor ki shipai jong ki baroh: u la pynjot lut ia ki , u la aiti lut ia ki sha ka jingpyniap .

en: Tamil Nadu continues to remain the second state with the highest number of suicides in the country , according to the recently released National Crime Records Bureau .
kha: Ka Tamil Nadu ka dang iai bteng ban long ka Jylla kaba ar kaba don bun tam ki briew kiba pyniap ialade ha ka Ri , ong ka National Crime Records Bureau kaba la pynmih dang shen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Tamil Nadu ka dang bteng ban long ka jylla kaba ar kaba don ka jingpyniap ialade kaba heh tam ha ka ri , katkum ka jingpynbna jong ka National Crime Records Bureau kaba dang shen .

en: As for my people , children are their oppressors , and women rule over them . O my people , they which lead thee cause thee to err , and destroy the way of thy paths .
kha: Ki nongai pisa kylliang ki banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki nongai ram jong ki , ki thok ïa ki . Ko paidlang jong nga , ki nongïalam jong phi ki ïalam bakla ïa phi , khnang ba phin ym tip kano ka lynti ban phai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ki briew jong nga, ki khun ki long ki nongpynshitom bein jong ki, bad ki kynthei ki synshar halor jong ki . Ko ki briew jong nga, ki ialam ia me ban bakla, bad pynjot ia ka lynti jong ki lynti jong me .

en: Southward it was Ephraim s , and northward it was Manasseh s , and the sea is his border  ; and they met together in Asher on the north , and in Issachar on the east .
kha: Ka ri Ephraim ka don shaphang shathie , bad ka ri Manasseh ka don shaphang shatei , bad ka Duriaw Mediterranian pat ka long u pud jong ki ha ka phang sepngi . Ka ri Asher ka don shaphang shatei lam sepngi , bad ka ri Issakhar shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang shathie ka la long ka Ephraim s, bad shaphang shathie ka la long ka Manasseh s, bad ka duriaw ka long ka pud jong u ; bad ki la iakynduh lang ha Asher shaphang shathie, bad ha Issakhar shaphang mihngi .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Balak took Balaam , and brought him up into the high places of Baal , that thence he might see the utmost part of the people .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balak u la ïalam ïa u Balaam sha Bamoth Baal , na kaba u Balaam u lah ban ïohi shi bynta jong ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, u Balak u la shim ia u Balaam bad u la wanrah ia u sha ki jaka ba jrong jong u Baal, ba nangta u lah ban iohi ia ka bynta kaba khraw tam jong ki briew .

en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .
kha: Ha ka por ba u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki la long ki syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Mikah , uba na ka shnong Moresheth . U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha u Mikah ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shaphang ka Samaria bad ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Migah u Moshiah ha ki sngi u Jotham, u Ahasa bad u Hesekaiah ki syiem Judah kiba u la iohi shaphang ka Samaria bad ka Jerusalem .

en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee , and our sins testify against us : for our transgressions are with us  ; and as for our iniquities , we know them  ;
kha: A  Trai  , ki kam runar jong ngi pyrshah ïa me ki long kiba bun . Ki pop jong ngi hi ki pynrem ïa ngi . Ngi tip bha ïa kine kiei kiei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki jingpynkhein jong ngi ki nang bun ha khmat jong me , bad ki pop jong ngi ki sakhi pyrshah ia ngi: namar ki jingpynkhein jong ngi ki long bad ngi; bad shaphang ki jingbymhok jong ngi , ngi tip ia ki;

en: The king answered and said to Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen , and the interpretation thereof ?
kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Daniel ( ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar ) ,  Hato me lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba nga phohsniew bad aïu ka kit jingmut ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Daniel uba la tip kyrteng u Beltsasar , Hato me lah ban pyntip ha nga ia ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi bad ka jingbatai jong ka ?

en: Jesus said ,  Take ye away the stone .  Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .
kha: Pyntyllun noh ïa u mawkhang !  U Jisu u la hukum . Ka Martha , ka hynmen uta uba la ïap , ka la jubab ,  Kan sa don ka jingsma iwtung , ko Trai . La lah tep ïa u la saw sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong, Pynduh noh ia u maw . Ka Martha, ka para jong uta uba la iap, ka ong ha u, ko Trai, ha kane ka por u la lyngngoh: namar u la iap saw sngi .

en: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives , and pray unto the  Lord  for it : for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace .
kha: Trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki nongbah sha kaba nga la pynlong ïa phi ban leit kum ki koidi . Duwai sha nga na ka bynta jong ki , namar lada ki manbha , phi ruh phin manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wad ia ka jingsuk jong ka shnong ha kaba nga la pynlong ia phi ban shah rah noh sha ki mraw, bad duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong ka: namar ha ka jingsuk jong ka phin ioh ia ka jingsuk .

en: And they rose up early on the morrow , and offered burnt offerings , and brought peace offerings  ; and the people sat down to eat and to drink , and rose up to play .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la wallam katto katne ki mrad ba yn thang kum ki jingkñia bad ïa kiwei pat ban ïabam kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ki briew ki la ïashong ban ïakhawai , kaba la kylla long ka jingïaleh shongshit ha ka ïadih ïabam bad ïaleh awria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng dang step, bad ki la wanrah ia ki jingknia thang, bad ki la wanrah ia ki jingainguh jingsuk ; bad ki briew ki la shong ban bam bad ban dih, bad ki la ieng ban ialehkai .

en: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .
kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun un ym shah bishar ; hynrei ïa uno uno u bymngeit la lah bishar lypa ïa u , namar ba um shym la ngeit ha U Khun ba tang marwei jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ngeit ia u um shah pynrem: hynrei uta u bym ngeit u la shah pynrem lypa , namar um shym la ngeit ha ka kyrteng U Khun U Blei uba la kha marwei .

en: And he walked in all the sins of his father , which he had done before him : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as the heart of David his father .
kha: U la leh ïa kijuh ki pop kum u kpa jong u bad um shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kumba ïaineh u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iaid ha ki pop baroh jong u kpa jong u, kiba u la leh ha khmat jong u: bad ka dohnud jong u kam shym la long kaba janai bad U Trai U Blei jong u, kum ka dohnud u Dabid u kpa jong u .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , That ye shall weep and lament , but the world shall rejoice : and ye shall be sorrowful , but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin ïam bad phin ïamkthang , hynrei , ka pyrthei kan shadkmen ; phin ïasngewsih , hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Ba phin iam bad sngewsih, hynrei ka pyrthei kan sngewbha: bad phin sngewsih , hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong phi kan kylla long ka jingkmen .

en: Then said Samuel , Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites . And Agag came unto him delicately . And Agag said , Surely the bitterness of death is past .
kha: Wallam ïa u syiem Agag hangne ha nga ,  u Samuel u hukum . U Agag u la wan sha u da kaba khynñiuh da ka jingtieng , u da pyrkhat ha lade ,  Katno ka long kaba kthang ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la ong: To wanrah ia nga ia u Agag u syiem jong ki Amalek . Bad u Agag u la wan sha u da kaba jem . Bad u Agag u la ong , Hooid ka jingsngewsih jong ka jingiap ka la iaid noh .

en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him  ; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue :
kha: Wat la katta ruh , kiba bun na ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ngeit ha U Jisu ; hynrei namar ki Pharisi kim shym la kren shaphang jong ka ha kaba paw , ba kin ym shah beh noh na ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh napdeng ki nongsynshar ruh bun ki la ngeit ia u ; hynrei namar ki Pharisi kim shym la phla ia u , ioh ba kin shah beh noh na ka synagog:

en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .
kha: U Blei um dei uba bishar bymhok . Un ym klet ïa ka kam kaba phi la leh lane ïa ka jingieit kaba phi la pynpaw na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïarap kaba phi la ai bad dang ïai ïarap ïa ki parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar U Blei um long uba khlem hok ban klet ia ka kam bad ka jingtrei shitom jong phi, kaba phi la pyni sha ka kyrteng jong u, ha kaba phi la shakri ia ki riewkhuid bad phi la shakri .

en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests , and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the  Lord  ,
kha: Nangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki lyngdoh bad jong ki briew baroh kiba la ïeng ha ka Templ , nga la ong ha u Hananaïah :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u nongiathuhlypa Jeremaiah u la ong ha u nongiathuhlypa Haniah ha khmat ki lyngdoh bad ha khmat ki briew baroh kiba ieng ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , as Moses entered into the tabernacle , the cloudy pillar descended , and stood at the door of the tabernacle , and the  Lord  talked with Moses .
kha: Ynda u Moses u la rung shapoh jong ka , u rishot lyoh u wan hiar bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses na uta u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u Moses u dang rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ, u mawlyngnai uba dum u la hiar bad u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ bad U Trai u la ïakren bad u Moses .

en: The rich shall not give more , and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel , when they give an offering unto the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .
kha: Haba ki siew ïa kane ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , uba riewspah un ym ai tam , bad uba duk un ym ai duna .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki riewspah kin ym ai shuh ia ka ram kaba duna ia ka Shekel haba ki ai ka jingainguh ha U Trai , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki mynsiem jong phi .

en: And he said unto them , What counsel give ye that we may answer this people , who have spoken to me , saying , Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter ?
kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  U kylli .  Kaei ngan ong ïa ki briew kiba kyrpad ïa nga ban pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kaei ka jingai jingmut kaba phi ai ba ngin jubab ia une u briew uba la kren ia nga da kaba ong: To pynlong ia ka jingkit kaba u kpa jong me u la buh ha ngi kham jem ?

en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard those words , that he rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his flesh , and fasted , and lay in sackcloth , and went softly .
kha: Haba u Elijah u la dep kren , u Ahab u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ , u la law ïa ki bad u phong da ki jaiñ khain . Um treh bam , u thiah ha ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit phai da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Ahab u la iohsngew ia kita ki ktien, ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la buh ia ka jain lyngkhuid ha ka doh jong u, bad u la shah bam dohkha, bad u la thiah ha ka jain lyngkhuid bad u la iaid jem .

en: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
kha: Bud ïa u sha ka ïing ba un rung bad ong ïa u trai jong ka ïing : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong ,  Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin ïabam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?  ’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangno hangno ba u leit rung, phi ong ha u briew uba bha jong ka iing , U Nonghikai u ong , Hangno ka kamra bam , ha kaba ngan bam ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jingkhawai bad ki synran jong nga ?

en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :
kha: U bat synshar ïa ki por bad ki aïom ; u pynlong bad u weng ïa ki syiem ; long ma u , uba ai ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pynkylla ia ki por bad ki aiom: u weng noh ia ki syiem bad u pynshong ia ki syiem: u ai ia ka jingstad ha kiba stad bad ka jingtip ha kito kiba tip ia ka jingstad:

en: And he heard the words of Laban s sons , saying , Jacob hath taken away all that was our father s  ; and of that which was our father s hath he gotten all this glory .
kha: U Jakob u ïohsngew ba ki khun shynrang jong u Laban ki ïa-ong ,  U Jakob u la shim lut baroh kat kaba dei ka jong i pa jong ngi . U la ïoh lut ïa ka spah baroh na kaei kaba i pa jong ngi i don .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ki khun shynrang jong u Laban, u da ong: U Jakob u la shim noh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba long u kpa jong ngi s ; bad na kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong ngi u la ioh ia kane ka burom baroh .

en: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword  ; and they that were his arm , that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen .
kha: Kin ïahiar lang bad u sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad kito kiba la khyllem lypa . Bad ïa baroh kiba im hapoh ka jingkah syrngiew jong u , yn pynsakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ruh ki la leit hiar sha dujok bad u ha kito kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam ; bad kita kiba long ka kti jong u , kiba shong hapoh ka jingdum jong u hapdeng ki nongwei .

en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work , and ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days :
kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kaba ai burom ïa U  Trai  hynñiew sngi lynter , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai kaba hynriew phin ym leh ei ei bad phin leh ia ka jingkhawai ha U Trai hynriew sngi:

en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , bad ka jingkhynwin ki shalyntem , kiba sawa jam kum u jumai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ruh ia ka jingsawa jong ki bniat jong ki jingthaw ba im kiba ktah iwei ia iwei pat, bad ka jingsawa jong ki tyrpeng halor jong ki , bad ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa kaba khraw .

en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters  ; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more , nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them .
kha: Ngan pynïap ïa ki jingri jong me ha man la ki jaka dih um . Yn ym don shuh ki briew ne jingri ban pynjngut pat ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynjot ruh ia ki mrad jong ka baroh najan ki um kiba heh ; lymne ka kjat u briew kan ym pynshitom shuh ia ki , lymne ki tyrpeng jong ki mrad kin ym pynshitom shuh ia ki .

en: And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .
kha: Katto katne por hadien , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban leit pat sha ka Ïuphratis bad shim ïa ki patlun lyngkot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien bun sngi, ba U Trai u la ong ha nga, To khie, leit sha Euphrates bad shim ia ka girdle naduh hangta, kaba nga la hukum ia me ban buhrieh hangta .

en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .
kha: Mynta ki la ïap noh bad kin ym im shuh ; ki sna-ïap jong ki kin ym mih , namar me la pynshitom bad pynjot ïa ki . Ym don uwei ruh u ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iap, kin ym im ; ki la iap, kin ym khie: namarkata me la leit jngoh bad pynjot ia ki, bad me la pynlong ia ka jingkynmaw jong ki baroh ban jah noh .

en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .
kha: Nga sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynshitom , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlot , dei hangta ba nga khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga sngewbha ha ki jingduna, ha ki jingshah lehbein, ha ki jingdonkam, ha ki jingshah pynshitom bein, ha ki jingjynjar na ka bynta U Khrist: namar haba nga tlot , te nga long uba khlain .

en: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant , that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne  ; and with the Levites the priests , my ministers .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom nga la pynlong ka jutang bad u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba un don borabor u nonghiarpateng u ban long syiem , bad nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki lyngdoh na ka jait Lebi ba borabor kin shakri ïa nga ; bad ïa kita ki jutang yn ym lah ban pynkheiñ lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ruh ka jutang jong nga kan shah pynpra bad u Dabid u shakri jong nga, ba un ym don khun shynrang ban synshar halor ka khet jong u ; bad bad ki Lebi ki lyngdoh jong nga .

en: And he charged him to tell no man :  but go , and shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing , according as Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un peit bniah ïa me ; nangta un pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la koit . To ai ïa ka jingkñia kumba U Moses u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kynnoh ia u ban iathuh iano iano ruh: hynrei to leit, bad to pyni ia lade ha u lyngdoh, bad to tyrwa ia ka jingpynkhuid jong me kumba u Moses u la hukum, na ka bynta ka jingsakhi ha ki .

en: But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .
