translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam jong ka ri mihngi u long ka duriaw mluh, haduh kaba kut jong ka Jordan . Bad u pud jong ki ha ka liang mihngi u la long na ka duriaw ha kaba kut eh jong ka Jordan:

en: For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .
kha: Naba nga ong ha phi ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , ‘ U la ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong kiba leh kam runar ,’ ka dei ban urlong shisha shaphang jong nga , namar kaei kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ka wan jia shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , ba ia kane kaba la thoh ha nga , Bad la khein ia u hapdeng ki nongleh bymman: namar kiei kiei kiba iadei bad nga ki don ka jingkut .

en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth ; fornication , uncleanness , inordinate affection , evil concupiscence , and covetousness , which is idolatry :
kha: Phi dei ban pynïap troiñ , te , ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei kiba trei hapoh jong phi , kum ka jingawria , ka jingkhlem-akor , ka jingkwah brai , ki jingkwah basniew , bad ka jinglalot (naba ka jinglalot ka long kawei pat ka dur jong ka jingmane bleithaw) .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit namarkata ia ki dkhot jong phi kiba don ha ka khyndew;

en: Then the moon shall be confounded , and the sun ashamed , when the  Lord  of hosts shall reign in mount Zion , and in Jerusalem , and before his ancients gloriously .
kha: U bnai un kylla dum , bad ka sngi kan ym tyngshaiñ shuh , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long u syiem . Un synshar ha Jerusalem halor u Lum Seïon , bad ki nongïalam jong ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u bnai un sngewlehrain, bad ka sngi kan sngewlehrain, haba U Trai jong ki paid un synshar ha u lum Seion, bad ha Jerusalem, bad ha khmat ki rangbah jong u da ka burom .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long will this people provoke me ? and how long will it be ere they believe me , for all the signs which I have shewed among them ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno kine ki briew kin kyntait ïa nga ? Sa katno ruh kin kyntait ban shaniah ha nga , wat la nga la leh bun ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Haduh katno kane ka briew kan pynkhih ia nga ? bad haduh katno por kin ngeit ia nga , namar ki dak baroh kiba nga la pyni hapdeng jong ki ?

en: But I say unto you , Love your enemies , bless them that curse you , do good to them that hate you , and pray for them which despitefully use you , and persecute you  ;
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad duwai na ka bynta kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , To ieit ia ki nongshun jong phi , to kyrkhu ia kiba tim ia phi , to leh bha ia kiba shun ia phi , bad duwai na ka bynta jong ki kiba pynshitom bein ia phi;

en: And he said unto them ,  Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Nga thikna ba phin sot ïa kane ka proberb ha nga , ‘ Ko nongpynkhiah , to pynkhiah ïa lade .’ Phin ong ruh ïa nga ban leh hangne ha la ka shnong ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba phi la ïohsngew ïa kiba la leh ha Kapernam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki , Phi lah shisha ban ong ha nga ia kane ka proberb: ko doktor, ko pynkoit ia lade: kaei kaei kaba ngi la iohsngew ba la leh ha Kapnaum , to leh ruh hangne ha ka ri jong me .

en: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel , saying , Take heed , and hearken , O Israel  ; this day thou art become the people of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Nangta u Moses , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh Lebi , ki ong ha ki Israel baroh ,  Ko phi ki Israel , sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa nga . Mynta ka sngi phi la long ki briew jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad ki lyngdoh ki Lebi ki la kren ha ki Israel baroh, ki da ong: To sumar bad sngap, ko Israel; ha kane ka sngi me la kylla long ki briew jong U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: Then the angel of the  Lord  commanded Gad to say to David , that David should go up , and set up an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
kha: U angel U  Trai  u ong ïa u Gad ban hukum ïa u Dabid ban leit bad tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  ha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel U Trai u la hukum ia u Gad ban ong ha u Dabid , ba u Dabid un leit shaneng ia ka jingbam ha U Trai ha ka jaka bam jong u Ornan u Jebus .

en: Nevertheless , if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it  ; if he do not turn from his way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .
kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew ba-bymman bad um sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap , kum u nongpop , hynrei ïa ka jingim jong me yn pynsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh lada me maham ia u bymman jong ka lynti jong u ban phai noh na ka ; lada um phai noh na ka lynti jong u, un iap ha ka jingbymhok jong u ; hynrei me la pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong me .

en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Haba phi duwai , to ong ïa kane :   ‘ Ko Kpa : Ai ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ; ai ban wan ka Hima jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Haba phi duwai, to ong, Ko Kpa jong ngi uba don ha bneng, to long ka kyrteng jong me . Ka hima jong me ka wan . Ka mon, kumba ha bneng, kumta ha ka khyndew .

en: Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane noh mynsiem , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , nga long ryngkat lem bad me kat shaba me leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ngam shym la hukum ia me ? To long kiba khlain bad kiba don ka jingshlur kaba bha wat tieng: namar U Trai U Blei jong me u don ryngkat bad me shano shano ruh ba me leit .

en: Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad u bym don shuh lashai , uba la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada U Blei u phong ia u phlang uba don ha ka sngi bad u la bret noh ia u ha ka umphniang , hato un ym phong kham bun ia phi ko phi kiba rit ka jingngeit ?

en: Who answered , Give me a blessing  ; for thou hast given me a south land  ; give me also springs of water . And he gave her the upper springs , and the nether springs .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga kwah katto katne ki pukri um . Ka jaka ba phi ai ïa nga ka don ha ka ri ryngkhiang .  Kumta u Kaleb u ai ha ka ïa ki umpohliew kiba haneng bad kiba harum .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la jubab: Ai ia nga ka jingkyrkhu ; namar me la ai ia nga ia ka ri kaba shaphang shathie; to ai ia nga ruh ia ki tyllong um kiba shalor . Bad u la ai ia ka ia ki tyllong um kiba shalor bad ki tyllong um kiba shapoh .

en: And he said unto me , It is done . I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end . I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely .
kha: Bad u la ong ,  La pyndep ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut . Ha uno uno uba sliang ngan ai ïa ka hok ban dih na ka umpohliew jong ka um ka jingim khlem da siewdor ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, La dep . Nga long u Alpha bad u Omega, ka jingsdang bad ka jingkut . Ngan ai ha uta uba thngan ia ka pung um jong ka jingim khlem jingsiew .

en: The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ki duriaw-bah ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka shnong jong phi , ka Tyros , la pynjot ; ki ïing bad ka kadlieng jong ka ki don ha ka jingjot . Kumba ki liengbah jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ka Tyros . Hooid, phi ki lieng jong ka Tarshish ; namar la pynjot ia ka, haduh ba ym don iing, ym don jingrung: na ka ri Kittim la pynpaw ha ki .

en: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life : as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee : I will not fail thee , nor forsake thee .
kha: Joshua , yn ym don mano mano uba lah ban jop ïa me katba me dang im . Ngan don ryngkat lem bad me kumba nga la don bad u Moses . Ngan ïailong lem bad me borabor ; ngan ym iehnoh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban ieng ha khmat jong me baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong me: kumba nga la don bad u Moses: ngan ym pynduh ia me , lymne ngan ym iehnoh ia me .

en: And then shall he depart from thee , both he and his children with him , and shall return unto his own family , and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return .
kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , ma u bad ki khun ki kti jong u kin ïamihnoh na phi bad kin leit phai sha la ka jong ka longïing bad sha ka jaka ki kpa tymmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta un leit noh na me, ma u bad ki khun jong u bad u, bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka iing bad sha ka jingdon jong ki kpa jong u un leit phai noh .

en: And the prophet Gad said unto David , Abide not in the hold  ; depart , and get thee into the land of Judah . Then David departed , and came into the forest of Hareth .
kha: Nangta , u Gad u nongïathuhlypa u la wan ha u Dabid bad u ong ,  Wat sah hangne ; leit noh shisyndon sha ka ri Judah .  Kumta u Dabid u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka khlaw Hereth .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongiathuhlypa Gad u la ong ha u Dabid, Wat sah ha ka jaka ba la buh, bad to poi sha ka ri Judah . Nangta u Dabid u la leit noh bad u la wan sha ka khlaw Hath .

en: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna , which thy fathers knew not , that he might humble thee , and that he might prove thee , to do thee good at thy latter end  ;
kha: Ha kata ka ri shyiap u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju ïoh mynno mynno . U la pyndem bad tynjuh ïa phi , khnang ba ha kaba kut un pynmanbha ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la ai bam ia me ha ka ri khlaw da ka manna, kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me kim tip, ba un pynrit ia me, bad ba un pynshisha ia me, ban leh bha ia me ha kaba kut jong me;

en: Some state that cephalosporins can be divided into five or even six generations , although the usefulness of this organization system is of limited clinical relevance .
kha: Don kiba ong ba ia ki cephalosporins lah ban phiah ha ki san ne wat hynriew pateng , wat la ka jingmyntoi jong kane ka rukom pynbeit ka long kaba rit eh ha ka jingsumar .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ki jylla kiba lah ban phiah ha ki san ne wat hynriew pateng , wat la ka jingmyntoi jong kane ka rukom seng ka long kaba duna ka jingiadei ha ka liang ka klinik .

en: And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
kha: U Trai u la phai sawdong bad u la khmih shlip ha u Petros , bad u Petros u la kynmaw ba U Trai u la lah ong ha u ,  Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ha kane ka miet , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la phai sha u Petros . U Petros u la kynmaw ia ka ktien U Trai, kumno u la ong ha u, Ha khmat u khnai, men kyntait ia nga shi sien .

en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .
kha: Haba u Hushai u la wan poi , u Absalom u ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahithophel kaba u la ai ïa ngi ; Hato ngin bud ïa ka ? Lada em , to ïathuh ma phi ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Hussan u la wan sha u Absalom , u la kren ha u, u la ong: U Ahitoh u la kren kumne: hato ngin leh katkum ka jingong jong u ? lada ym kren ia me .

en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let us fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for his mercies are great : and let me not fall into the hand of man .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba ngan shah pynshitom ha ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un dei uta u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Gad, nga don ha ka jingeh kaba khraw: to ngin hap mynta ha ka kti U Trai ; namar ki jingisynei jong u ki long kiba khraw: bad wat ai ba ngan hap ha ka kti u briew .

en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .
kha: Ki apostol ki la sah slem hangta , ki da kren shlur shaphang U Trai , uba la pynshisha ba ka khubor jong ki shaphang ka jingaiei ka long kaba shisha da kaba ai ha ki ka bor ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka por kaba jrong namarkata ki kren shlur ha U Trai , kaba la ai sakhi ia ka ktien ka jingaiei jong u , bad la ai ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla ban leh da ki kti jong ki .

en: Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ;  To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba kwah ban ïoh jingim , phi kiba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u mawsiang na uba phi la wan , ka par maw na kaba la tih ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia nga, phi kiba bud ia ka hok, phi kiba wad ia U Trai: peit sha u maw na kaba la ot ia phi, bad sha ka thliew jong ka thliew ha kaba la tih ia phi .

en: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword , utterly destroying them : there was not any left to breathe : and he burnt Hazor with fire .
kha: Ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta , ym don shuh uwei ruh uba dang lait im , bad la thang ruh ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la pynkhih ia ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta da ka tduh jong ka waitlam: ym don shuh shuh ban ring mynsiem: bad u la thang ia u Hazor da ka ding .

en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .
kha: Katba u Samuel u dang im , um shym ïohi shuh ïa u syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U  Trai  u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u syiem ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel um wan shuh ban iohi ia u Saul haduh ka sngi ba u la iap: wat la katta ruh u Samuel u la iam na ka bynta u Saul: bad U Trai u la kylla bamut ba u la pynlong ia u Saul syiem halor ki Israel .

en: This is that Moses , which said unto the children of Israel , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear .
kha: U Moses u long uta uba la kren ha ki paid Israel , ‘ U Blei un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uba napdeng ki briew jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ba u Moses uba la ong ha ki khun Israel , U Nongiathuhlypa U Trai U Blei jong phi un pynmih ia phi na ki hynmen jong phi, kumba ha nga; ia u phin iohsngew .

en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .
kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hynrei ym palat ïa kata ; lada palat ïa kata , kan pynpoh dor ïa u ha khmat ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Sawphew tylli ki jait u lah ban ai ia u, bad ym palat: ioh lada u palat ia kine, bad u shoh ia u halor kine da ki jait kiba bun, te u hynmen jong me un long uba sniew ha me .

en: And he said unto him , Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .
kha: U te u ong ha u ,  Wanrah kawei ka masi , kawei ka blang , uwei u langbrot , kawei pa kawei na ki ka dei ban long kaba lai snem ka rta , bad kawei ka paro , bad kawei ka lyngdkhur .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Shim ia nga ia ka masi kaba dang lai snem ka rta, bad ka blang kaba dang lai snem ka rta, bad u langbrot uba dang lai snem ka rta bad u khun masi uba dang rit .

en: And it came to pass , while the ark abode in Kirjath–jearim , that the time was long  ; for it was twenty years : and all the house of Israel lamented after the  Lord .
kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka don slem bha ha Kiriath Jearim , kumba arphew snem . Ha kata ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la kyang ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba ka synduk ka dang sah ha Kirjathjaram, ba ka por ka la slem ; namar ka la long arphew snem: bad ka iing Israel baroh kawei ka la iam hadien U Trai .

en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .
kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïingjaiñ , hangta hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la tap da ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh bad ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ba ka la ngat ïa kata ka jingpang ,
translated_en_to_kha: U lyoh u la mih noh na ka ïingjaiñ; bad, ha khmih, ka Miriam ka la kylla rong saw, ka la lieh kum u slap: bad u Aaron u la peit ia ka Miriam bad, ha khmih, ka la long kaba sniew .

en: And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .
kha: Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan tap ïa ka sahit bneng bad pyndum ïa ki khlur . Ka sngi kan buhrieh sha lyndet ki lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda nga la buh ia me shabar , ngan tap ia ka bneng , bad ngan pyut ia ki khlur jong ka; ngan tap ia ka sngi da u lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai ia ka jingshai jong ka .

en: Brethren , if a man be overtaken in a fault , ye which are spiritual , restore such an one in the spirit of meekness ; considering thyself , lest thou also be tempted .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada lap ïa uno uno ha kano kano ka jingpalat , kito na phi kiba kynja mynsiem ki dei ban pynbha pat ïa u ; hynrei phi dei ban leh ïa ka ha ka rukom ka jingjemnud . Bad da husiar bha ïa lade , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ym shah pynshoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko para bangeit, lada u briew u shah pynngop ha ka jingbakla, phi kiba long mynsiem, to pynphai biang ia uta ha ka mynsiem jong ka jinglong jemnud ; da kaba pyrkhat ia lade; ioh ba ma me ruh phin shah pynshoi .

en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .
kha: Kine ki long ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel , ban lap la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki da u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la dei ban pynshisha ia ki Israel da ki , ban tip la kin kohnguh ne em ia ki hukum U Trai , kiba u la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong ki da ka kti u Moses .

en: For my people have committed two evils  ; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , and hewed them out cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water .
kha: namar ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar tylli ki pop : Ki la phai noh na nga , ka umpohliew ki um basngur ; bad ki la tih ki jaka pynlang um , ki jaka pynlang um kiba la pdang ki bym lah ban pynlang ïa ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar tylli ki jingsniew ; ki la iehnoh ia nga ia ka pung um ba im, bad ki la mih noh na ki thliew um, ki thliew um ba la tyrkhong, ki bym lah ban bat um .

en: And when he was come into the house , the blind men came to him : and Jesus saith unto them ,  Believe ye that I am able to do this ?  They said unto him , Yea , Lord .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka ïing , ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la ïawan sha u , bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phi ngeit ba nga lah ban pynkhiah ïa phi ?   Ho-oid , Kynrad !  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan rung shapoh iing, ki briew kiba matlah ki la wan sha u: bad U Jisu u ong ha ki: To ngeit ba nga lah ban leh ia kane ? Ki la ong ha u: Hooid ko Trai .

en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years  ; and the  Lord  said unto him , Thou art old and stricken in years , and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed .
kha: U Joshua mynta u la tymmen bha . U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Me la tymmen bha , hynrei dang bun ka jaka kaba dei ban ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Joshua u la tymmen bad u la tyrkhong ha ki snem ; bad U Trai u la ong ha u , Me la tymmen bad me la tyrkhong ha ki snem , bad ka dang sah shibun ka ri ban long trai .

en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife  ; and he loved her : and Isaac was comforted after his mother s death .
kha: Nangta u Isaak u ïalam ïa ka Rebekka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba ka Sarah ka kmie jong u ka la ju shong , bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong u . U Isaak u ieit ïa ka Rebekka , bad da kumta u la ïoh jingtngen hadien ba u la duh ïa la ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la wanrah ia ka ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka kmie jong u, bad u la shim ïa ka Rebekka, bad ka la long ka tnga jong u ; bad u la ieit ïa ka : bad u Isaak u la shah pyntngen hadien ka jingiap jong ka kmie jong u .

en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years  ; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine .
kha: Ki hynñiew tylli ki masi raikhoh kiba wan mih hadien bad ki hynñiew tylli ki kop kew kiba raikhoh , bad kiba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , ki long hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki hynriew tylli ki sniang kiba rit bad kiba sniew kiba la wan hadien jong ki ki long hynriew snem ; bad ki hynriew tylli ki shkor kiba thylli kiba la bthei da ka Iyer mihngi kin long hynriew snem ka jingkyrduh bam .

en: And there shall be signs in the sun , and in the moon , and in the stars  ; and upon the earth distress of nations , with perplexity  ; the sea and the waves roaring  ;
kha: Kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla ki ban jia ha ka sngi , ha u bnai , bad ha ki khlur . Ha ka pyrthei , ki ri baroh kin don ha ka jingnoh mynsiem , ki tieng ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw bad ïa ka jingkhih phaloh ki jingat phyllung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin don ki dak ha ka sngi bad ha u bnai bad ha ki khlur bad ha ka khyndew ki jaitbynriew, da ka jingkhihwin; ka duriaw bad ki um ki tuid;

en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynhap slap ha ka khyndew jong phi ha ka aïom kaba biang , ha ka por synrai bad ha ka por pyrem , khnang ba phin ïohlum ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta jong phi hi , bad ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan ai ia phi ia u slap jong ka ri jong phi ha ka por ba u dei, u slap uba nyngkong bad u slap uba hadien, ba me lah ban lum ha u kew jong me bad ka wain jong me bad ka umphniang jong me .

en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u dem lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , pynwan biang ïa ka jingim ha une u khynnah !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia lade ha uta u khynnah lai sien bad u la pyrta ha U Trai bad u la ong: Ko Trai Blei jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba kane ka mynsiem khynnah kan wan biang shapoh jong u .

en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel , to the captains of thousands and of hundreds , and to the judges , and to every governor in all Israel , the chief of the fathers .
kha: U syiem Solomon u la ai hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba khmih ïa ki kynhun ba shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad ïa ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut ki rangbah , ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka sorkar , ïa baroh ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem , bad ki briew basah baroh , da kaba hukum ïa ki ban leit bad u sha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la kren ha ki Israel baroh , ha ki rangbah shihajar bad ha ki spah snem bad ha ki nongbishar bad ha uwei pa uwei u Lat ha Israel baroh .

en: ( But this spake he of the Spirit , which they that believe on him should receive : for the Holy Ghost was not yet given  ; because that Jesus was not yet glorified . )
kha: U Jisu u la kren ïa kane shaphang U Mynsiem , uba kito kiba la ngeit ha u kin ïohpdiang . Ha kata ka por ïa U Mynsiem ym pat shym la ai , namar ïa U Jisu ym pat shym la kyntiew sha ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hynrei kane ka kren ia U Mynsiem , ia kaba kita kiba ngeit ha u ki dei ban pdiang: namar ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid ym pat ai ; namar ba U Jisu um pat shah pyndonburom . )

en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .
kha: Nangta u Hushai u ïathuh ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u la ai ha u Absalom bad ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Hushai u la ong ha u Sadok bad ha u Abiathar ki lyngdoh , Kumta bad kumta u Ahitoh u la ai jingmut ia u Absalom bad ki rangbah Israel; bad kumta bad kumta nga la ai jingmut .

en: And Elijah took twelve stones , according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob , unto whom the word of the  Lord  came , saying , Israel shall be thy name :
kha: U shim khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei uwei na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait ba la shim kyrteng na ki khun u Jakob , u briew ïa uba U  Trai  u la ai ka kyrteng u Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la shim shiphew tylli ki maw kat kum ka jingdon jong ki jaitbynriew u Jakob ha kiba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan, da kaba ong: Ka kyrteng jong me:

en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .
kha: Ki don u syiem uba synshar halor jong ki , uba long u angel uba khmih ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka long u Abaddon ; bad ha ka ktien Grik ka long u Apollyon ( kaba mut u  Nongpynjot  ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don u syiem halor jong ki, uba long u angel jong ka thliew kaba khlem tduh, uba ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Hebru ka long u Abaddon , hynrei ha ka ktien Grik ka don ka kyrteng jong u Apollon .

en: And he said ,  Take heed that ye be not deceived : for many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and the time draweth near : go ye not therefore after them .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Sumar ; wat shah shukor . Kiba bun ki rangbah , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad , ‘ Ka por ka la poi !’ Hynrei wat bud ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: To sumar ba phin ym shah thok: namar bun kin wan ha ka kyrteng jong nga, ki da ong: Nga long U Khrist ; bad ka por ka la jan: phim leit noh namarkata hadien jong ki .

en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
kha: Phin ïoh shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba phin pynjlan ia ki sngi jong phi ha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha ki bad ha u symbai jong ki, ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the revilings of the children of Ammon , whereby they have reproached my people , and magnified themselves against their border .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Nga la ïohsngew ba ki briew jong ka Moab bad Ammon ki krenbeiñ bad ki pynsalia ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki kren khraw ba kin kurup ïa ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia ka jingshah lehbein jong u Moab bad ki jingkren bein jong ki khun Ammon , ha kaba ki la kren bein ia ki briew jong nga bad ki la pynkhraw ia lade pyrshah ia u pud u sam jong ki .

en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel , so that they lifted up their heads no more . And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon .
kha: Kumta ki Midian ki la shahjop ha ki Israel bad kim shym long shuh ka jingma ïa ki . Ka ri ka la don ha ka jingsuk haduh sawphew snem , haduh ba u Gideon u ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka Midian ka la shah pyndem ha khmat ki khun Israel , haduh ba kim shym la rah shuh ia la ka khlieh . Bad ka ri ka la long ha ka jingsuk sawphew snem ha ki sngi u Gideon .

en: And Simon Peter followed Jesus , and so did another disciple : that disciple was known unto the high priest , and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest .
kha: U Simon Petros bad uwei pat u synran ki la bud ïa U Jisu . Uta uwei u synran u la long uba la ïa-ithuh bha bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh , kumta u la leit rung lem bad U Jisu sha ka phyllaw ïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , katba u Petros pat u la ïeng shabar hajan ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u la bud ia U Jisu, bad kumjuh ruh uwei pat u synran: uta u synran u la ithuh ha u rangbah lyngdoh , bad u la rung bad U Jisu shapoh ka iing jong u rangbah lyngdoh .

en: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz Zadok s son , and Jonathan Abiathar s son  ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear .
kha: Ki don bad ki ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan , bad phi lah ban phah ïa ki sha nga lem bad ki jingtip baroh kiba phi la ïohlum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki don hangta bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong ki, u Ahimaas u khun shynrang bad u khun shynrang jong u Jonathan; bad da ki phin phah sha nga ia kiei kiei baroh kiba phi lah ban iohsngew .

en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias , which saith , By hearing ye shall hear , and shall not understand  ; and seeing ye shall see , and shall not perceive :
kha: Kumta ka jingïathuhlypa jong u Isaïah ka la treikam ha ki :   ‘ Kine ki briew kin shahshkor bad ïai shahshkor , hynrei kim shemphang ; kin khmih bad ïai khmih , hynrei kim ïohi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki la pyndep ia ka jingiathuhlypa jong u Isaiah, kaba ong: Da kaba iohsngew phin iohsngew, bad phin ym sngewthuh; bad phin ym sngewthuh:

en: And take double money in your hand  ; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks , carry it again in your hand  ; peradventure it was an oversight :
kha: Rah pisa ar shah bad phi , namar phin hap rah biang ïa kito ki pisa ïa kiba la buh pat ha khlieh ki byrni jong phi . Ka lah ban long tang ka jingbakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shim ar shah ia ka pisa ha ka kti jong phi ; bad ka pisa kaba la wanrah biang ha ka shyntur jong ki tdong jong phi , rah biang ia ka ha ka kti jong phi ; da kaba sngewthuh ba ka la long ka jingpeit bniah:

en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .
kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel ,  Ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit sha u Joshua ha ka shnong Gilgal bad ki la ong ha u bad ha ki briew Israel: mynta to leit noh bad ngi .

en: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no , not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .
kha: Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïawanlang shisien wan ba ym don jaka shuh kaba lait , ym don jaka shuh wat habar ha khmat ka jingkhang . U Jisu u dang ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi bun ki la ialum lang, khlem da don jaka ban pdiang ia ki, em, ym kumba ka long shaphang ka jingkhang: bad u la ialap ia ka ktien ha ki .

en: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .
kha: Kumta u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh ban shim bad u lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban tan noh ïa nga na ka pung shuwa ba ngan ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la hukum ia u nong Ithiopia, u da ong: To shim na kata ka por laiphew ngut ki briew bad me, bad shim noh ia u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa na ka thliew, shuwa ba un iap .

en: Then when he was come into Galilee , the Galilaeans received him , having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast : for they also went unto the feast .
kha: Haba u la poi ha Galilaïa , ki briew hangta ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa u , namar ba ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem bad ki la ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta haba u la wan sha Galilaia, ki nong Galilaia ki la pdiang ia u, haba ki la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha Jerusalem ha ka jingkhawai: namar ki ruh ki la leit sha ka jingkhawai .

en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .
kha: Haduh mynta u Balaam u la tip ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa u ba un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel , kumta um shym leit wad shuh ïa ki dak ki shin kumba u la leh mynshuwa . U la phai la ki khmat shaphang ka ri shyiap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Balaam u la iohi ba u la kyrkhu ia U Trai ban kyrkhu ia ki Israel , um shym la leit kumba ju long ha kiwei pat ki por , ban wad ia ki jingleh jadu , hynrei u la pynkhih ia la ka khmat sha ka ri khlaw .

en: The government has appointed RN Ravi as the new official interlocutor and government of India representative for Naga peace talks , an official notification said today .
kha: Ka sorkar ka la thung ia u RN Ravi kum u nongiakren ba thymmai bad u nongmihkhmat jong ka sorkar India na ka bynta ki jingiakren iasuk jong ka Naga , la ong ka jingpynbna mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sorkar ka la thung ia u RN Ravi kum u nongkren thymmai bad ka sorkar India na ka bynta ka jingiakren iasuk Naga , la ong ka jingpynbna kaba thikna mynta ka sngi .

en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .
kha: U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar bad u ong ,  Khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiew ïa ki khlur ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew kat kita .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u shabar ri, bad u la ong, Peit mynta sha bneng, bad iathuh ia ki khlur lada me lah ban khein ia ki: bad u la ong ha u: Kumta un long u symbai jong me .

en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .
kha: Naba ïa u tnga u bymngeit la pynlong uba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ka tnga ka bymngeit la pynlong kaba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha la u tnga uba ngeit . Lada kane kam long kumta , ki khun jong ki kin long kum ki khun jong ki bymngeit ; hynrei kumba ka long , la pynlong ïa ki kiba la pdiang da U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u tnga bym ngeit u long uba la pynkyntang da ka tnga , bad ka tnga bym ngeit ka long kaba la pynkyntang da u tnga: lym kumta ki khun jong phi ki long ki bymkhuid ; hynrei mynta ki long kiba khuid .

en: In an interview to The Indian Express , Yashwant Sinha said , I left a request for a meeting with PM on Kashmir , but unfortunately there has been no response from him .
kha: Ha ka jingiakren bad ka The Indian Express u Yashwant Sinha u la ong , nga la ieh ia ka jingkyrpad ban ia kynduh ia u PM halor ka Kashmir , hynrei sngewsih ba kam shym la don kano kano ka jubab na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingiakren bad ka The Indian Express , u Yashwant Sinha u la ong , nga la iehnoh ia ka jingkyrpad ban iakynduh bad u PM ha Kashmir , hynrei sngewsih ba ym shym la don ka jubab na u .

en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .
kha: Hadien ba u Paul u la ïoh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw , ngi la khreh ban leit sha Makedonia , namar ngi la rai ba U Blei u la khot ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki briew hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ba u la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew , mar kumta hi ngi la pyrshang ban leit sha Makedonia , da kaba thikna ba U Trai u la khot ia ngi ban ialap ia ka gospel ha ki .

en: For finding fault with them , he saith , Behold , the days come , saith the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah :
kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem jingduna bad ki briew jong u haba u ong ,  Ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai , haba ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ban shem ia ki, u ong, Ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, haba ngan leh ia ka jutang kaba thymmai bad ka iing Israel bad bad ka iing Judah:

en: Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .
kha: Lada u Demetrios bad ki nongtrei jong u ki don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïano ïano , ngi don ki bor synshar bad ki sngi kiba thikna ïa ka ïingbishar ; ïa ki jingmudui lah ban leh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada u Demetrius bad ki nongtrei kti kiba don bad u, ki don ka kam pyrshah ia uno uno u briew, ka ain ka plie, bad ki don ki nongmihkhmat: to ai ba kin ialeh pyrshah iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
kha: bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym leit na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka pateng kan ym mih na kawei ka jaitbynriew sha kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ; hynrei uwei pa uwei na ki jaitbynriew Israel un bat ia lade ha la ka jong ka pateng .

en: And when it was day , certain of the Jews banded together , and bound themselves under a curse , saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud katto katne ngut ki Jiw ki la ïakynduh lang bad ki la pynlong ka jingsylla . Ki la shim smai ba kin ym bam lane dih ei ei tad ynda ki la lah pynïap ïa u Paul .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep , katto katne na ki Jiw ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ki la teh ia lade hapoh ka jingtim , ki da ong ba kin ym bam ne dih haduh ba kin da pyniap ia u Paul .

en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la jied ïa u maw uba kordor ïa uba nga buh kum u mawdong ha Seïon ; bad uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym noh mynsiem da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh ka don ha ka jingthoh , Ha khmih , nga thiah ha Sion u maw ba kongsan , ba la jied: bad uta uba ngeit ha u un ym shah pynjah burom .

en: And these are they which are sown on good ground  ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .
kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha . Ki ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka , bad ki seisoh : katto katne laiphew , katto katne hynriewphew , bad katto katne shispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long kiba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha ; kum kiba iohsngew ia ka ktien , bad ki pdiang ia ka , bad ki pynmih soh , katto katne laiphew , katto katne hynriewphew bad katto katne shispah .

en: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh : and the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat u Pharaoh , hynrei U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u , bad um shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh ia kine ki jingphylla baroh ha khmat u Pharaoh: bad U Trai u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud u Pharaoh , haduh ba un ym pyllait ia ki khun Israel ban mih noh na ka ri jong u .

en: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse , the army and the power  ; they shall lie down together , they shall not rise : they are extinct , they are quenched as tow .
kha: U la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhlaiñ sha ka jingpynjot , ka kynhun shipai , ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai . Ki kyllon ha madan , kim lah khie shuh , ki lip kum ka thylliej ding ka sharak !
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba wanrah ia ka kali bad u kulai, ka kynhun shipai bad ka bor ; kin thiah lang: kin ym kiew: ki la jah noh kum ka tow .

en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .
kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynlong ïa jingïateh lok bakyntang bad ki , ki la pynsleh ïa u , bad u la long u syiem ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta baroh ki rangbah Israel ki la wan sha u syiem ha Hebron bad u syiem Dabid u la leit noh bad ki ha Hebron ha khmat U Trai : bad ki la pynsleh ia u syiem Dabid halor ki Israel .

en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom , that they are double to that which is ! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth .
kha: Un ïathuh ïa me ba don ki jingmaïan ka jingstad ; ki don kiei kiei kiba palat ïa ka jingshemphang u bynriew . U Blei u pynshitom kham duna ïa me ban ïa kaba me dei hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba un pyni ia me ia ki jingmaham jong ka jingstad, ba ki long ar shah ia kata kaba long ! Tip namarkata ba U Blei u shim na me kham duna ban ia kaba ka jingbymhok jong me ka dei hok .

en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .
kha: Ki sngi ka jingjynjar jong pha kin kut noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha , kham palat ban ïa ka sngi bad u bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi jong me kan ym hiar shuh shuh bad u bnai jong me un ym kynriah noh ia lade: namar U Trai un long ka jingshai bymjukut jong me, bad ki sngi jong ka jingsngewsih jong me kin kut noh .

en: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .
kha: U Nathanael u la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno me ithuh ïa nga ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ha shuwa ba u Philip un khot ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nathanael u ong ha u, Naei me ithuh ia nga ? U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha u, shuwa ba u Philip un khot ia me, haba me don hapoh u dieng sohjew, nga la iohi ia me .

en: And they began to accuse him , saying , We found this fellow perverting the nation , and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar , saying that he himself is Christ a King .
kha: Ngi la kem ïa une u briew uba ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong ngi , da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym siew khajna sha u Patsha bad u kam ba ma u hi u long U Messaïah , u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sdang ban kynnoh ia u, ki da ong, Ngi la shem ia une u paralok uba pynkylla ia ka jaitbynriew, bad u la khang ban ai khajna ia u Kaisar, da kaba ong ba ma u hi u long U Khrist U Syiem .

en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness , through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue :
kha: Ka bor jong U Blei ka la ai ha ngi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi donkam ban im ïa ka jingim riewblei bashisha da ka jingtip jong ngi ïa uta uba la khot ïa ngi ban ïadon bynta ha ka burom bad ka jingbha jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka bor blei jong u ka la ai ha ngi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba iadei bad ka jingim bad ka jinglong riewblei, lyngba ka jingtip jong uta uba la khot ia ngi sha ka burom bad ka jinglong babha:

en: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the  Lord  hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .
kha: Lane kum ki kper harud ka wah , Kum ki Alos ba U  Trai  u la thung , Lane kum ki dieng Kedar harud ki um .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ki them ki nang kiew, kum ki kper ha rud wah, kum ki dieng sohjew kiba U Trai u la thung, bad kum ki dieng sohjew kiba don harud um .

en: And Abimelech said , What is this thou hast done unto us ? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife , and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us .
kha: Kaei keiñ kane kaba me la leh ha ngi ?  u Abimelekh u ong .  Uwei na ki briew jong nga un jin da la kum ïathiah bad ka tnga jong me , bad men jin da la kit pop namar ki jingleh jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la ong, Kaei kaba me la leh ia ngi ? uwei na ki briew u lah ban don tang khyndiat eh bad ka tnga jong me, bad me la dei ban wanrah ia ka jinglong pop halor jong ngi .

en: The  Lord  thy God in the midst of thee is mighty  ; he will save , he will rejoice over thee with joy  ; he will rest in his love , he will joy over thee with singing .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong pha u long bad pha ; ka bor jong u ka ai ha pha ka jingjop . U  Trai  un shem jingsngewbha ha pha , bad ha ka jingieit jong u un ai ha pha ka jingim bathymmai . Un rwai bad un kmen halor jong pha ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong me hapdeng jong me u long uba donbor ; un pynim ia me, un sngewbha ia me da ka jingkmen ; un shongthait ha ka jingieit jong u, un sngewbha ia me da ka jingrwai .

en: The people answered him , We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever : and how sayest thou ,  The Son of man must be lifted up ?  who is this Son of man ?
kha: U paidbah u la jubab ,  Ka hukum jong ngi ka ïathuh ba U Messaïah un im junom . Kumno , te , me lah ban ong ba ka dei ïa U Khun U Briew ban kyntiew ? Uei une U Khun U Briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la jubab ia u , Ngi la iohsngew na ka hukum ba U Khrist U iaineh junom: bad kumno me ong , U Khun u briew u dei ban shah pynkiew ? mano une u Khun u briew ?

en: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men that were in the houses near to Micah s house were gathered together , and overtook the children of Dan .
kha: Haba ki la poi kham ha pajih na ka ïing , u Mikah u khot ïa ki paramarjan ban leit ïaleh thma ïa ki . Ki lap ïa ki rangbah na Dan
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba ki dang iaid bha na ka iing u Micah , ki briew kiba don hajan ka iing u Micah ki la ialum lang bad ki la iaid lait ia ki khun u Dan .

en: And say , Hear the word of the  Lord  , O king of Judah , that sittest upon the throne of David , thou , and thy servants , and thy people that enter in by these gates :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa nga ban leit sha ka ïing u syiem Judah , u khun jong u ksiew jong u Dabid , bad kren hangta ïa u syiem , ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai ko syiem Judah, uba shong ha ka khet u Dabid, ma me bad ki shakri jong me bad ki briew jong me kiba rung shapoh da kine ki khyrdop:

en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan , and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah , ( whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying ,
kha: Nga la ai ïa ka shithi ha u Elasah u khun jong u Shaphan bad ha u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Hilkaïah , ïa uba u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u phah sha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia . Ka ong :
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka kti u Elasah u khun u Shaphan bad u Gemariah u khun u Hilkiah (u uba u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah u la phah sha Babilon sha u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon) da kaba ong:

en: Who only hath immortality , dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto ; whom no man hath seen , nor can see : to whom be honour and power everlasting . Amen .
kha: Dei tang ma u marwei u bymïap shuh ; u shong ha ka jingshai ha kaba ym don uba lah ban leit sha jan jong u . Ym don uno uno uba la ju ïohi ïa u ; ym don uno uno uba lah ban ïohi ïa u . Ha u , to long ka burom bad ka borbah bymjukut ! Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba don tang ka jingbymjukut, kaba shong ha ka jingshai kaba ym don briew uba lah ban leit shajan jong u, bad u bym don briew uba lah ban iohi: ha uba ka burom bad ka bor ka long kaba bymjukut . Amen .

en: So the  Lord  sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed : and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha Israel , kaba neh naduh kata ka step haduh ka por kaba u la jied . Na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh ki la ïap haduh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la phah ia ka jingpang ha ki Israel naduh mynstep haduh ka por ba la buh: bad ki briew ki la iap naduh Dan haduh Beersheba hynriew hajar ngut ki briew .

en: The princes digged the well , the nobles of the people digged it , by the direction of the lawgiver , with their staves . And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah :
kha: Ka pukri ba la tih da ki khun syiem Bad da ki nongïalam u paidbah , La tih da u diengsynshar syiem Bad da ki diengduh jong ki .  Na kata ka ri khlaw ki la mihnoh sha Mattanah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ki la tih ia ka thliew, ki riew rangbah ki la tih ia ka, da ka jingbthah jong u nongthaw ain jong ki . Bad na ka ri khlaw ki la leit sha Mathan:

en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear , and deliver my people out of your hand , and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan sloit ïa ki jaiñ teh khlieh jong phi bad ngan shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban lait shisyndon na ka bor jong phi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkwah jong phi ruh ngan sa pynpra noh ia ki briew jong nga na ka kti jong phi , bad kin ym don shuh ha ka kti jong phi ban shah beh ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Then the king answered and said unto the woman , Hide not from me , I pray thee , the thing that I shall ask thee . And the woman said , Let my lord the king now speak .
kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Ngan kylli ei ei na pha , bad pha dei ban ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .   Kylli ïa kano kano na nga , ko Syiem Kynrad ,  ka la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la jubab bad u la ong ha kata ka kynthei, Wat nym buhrieh na nga, nga kyrpad ia me ia kata kaba ngan kylli ia me . Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong: To ai ba u kynrad jong nga un kren mynta .

en: And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynshahshkor ïa u Paul haduh ba un da dep kren ; hynrei pynban ki la sdang ban kyang jam eh ,  Pynduh ïa u ! Pynïap ïa u ! Um long uba bit ban im !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia u ia ka ktien kane, bad nangta ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, bad ki la ong: Shaphang u para bangeit na ka khyndew: namar kam long kaba dei ba un im .

en: The waters made him great , the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants , and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field .
kha: Ka don ka um kaba pynsan ïa u , bad ki wah napoh khyndew ki bsa ïa u , ki ai um ïa ka jaka ha kaba u san , bad ki phah ïa ki wahduid sha ki dieng baroh jong ka khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki la pynlong ia u uba khraw, ki wah kiba jylliew jong ka ki iaid sawdong ki jingthung jong u , bad ki la phah ia ki wah rit jong ka sha ki dieng baroh .

en: And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :
kha: Mynsngi , U  Trai  u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynmiet pat u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaid mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leit ha khmat jong ki ha ka por mynstep ha u lum, ban ialam ia ki ha ka lynti ; bad ha ka por miet ha ka lynti ding , ban ai jingshai ia ki ; ban leit miet bad sngi:

en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , they likewise fled before Abishai his brother , and entered into the city . Then Joab came to Jerusalem .
kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki phet ïap , ki phet ïap na u Abishai bad ki kynran sha ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u leit phai noh sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki ksiew ki la iohi ba ki Syria ki la phet noh, ki la phet noh kumjuh ha khmat u Abisai u hynmen jong u, bad ki la rung shapoh ka shnong . Nangta u Joab u la wan sha Jerusalem .

en: And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .
kha: Ngan ym leit phai bad phi ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phi la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad u la kyntait ïa phi kum u syiem ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha u Saul , Ngan ym wan phai bad me: namar me la kyntait ia ka ktien U Trai , bad U Trai u la kyntait ia me na kaba long syiem halor ki Israel .

en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , Thy god , O Dan , liveth  ; and , The manner of Beer–sheba liveth  ; even they shall fall , and never rise up again .
kha: Kito kiba smai ha ki bleithaw jong ka Samaria , kiba ong , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Dan ,’ lane , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Beersheba ,’ — kito ki briew kin kyllon , bad kin ym khie pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba sngap jar da ka pop jong ka Samaria, bad ki ong, ko blei jong me, ko Dan, ki im; bad ka rukom im jong u Beersheba wat ki ruh kin hap noh; bad kin ym kiew shuh .

en: And David cried to the people , and to Abner the son of Ner , saying , Answerest thou not , Abner ? Then Abner answered and said , Who art thou that criest to the king ?
kha: u pyrta ïa ki shipai u Saul bad ïa u Abner ,  Ko Abner ! Hato phi ïohsngew ïa nga ?   Uei uta uba pyrta bad uba pynkyndit thiah ïa u syiem ?  u Abner u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pyrta ia ki briew bad ia u Abner u khun u Ner, u da ong: Hato me jubab ia me, Abner ? Nangta u Abner u la jubab bad u la ong: Me long mano ba pyrta ia u syiem ?

en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister : and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the  Lord  , and when he cometh out , that he die not .
kha: U Aaron u dei ban phong ïa kane ka barandi haba u shakri kum u lyngdoh . Haba u wan ha khmat jong nga ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , lane haba u mih nangta , yn ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki shakuriaw , bad un ym shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha u Aaron ban shakri: bad ka sur jong u kan sa iohsngew haba u leit sha ka jaka bakhuid ha khmat U Trai bad haba u mih noh , ba un ym iap .

en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance , both for him that is born among the children of Israel , and for the stranger that sojourneth among them .
kha: Kajuh ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ka long ïa baroh kiba leh pop khlem da mut khnang , la ki dei ki traishnong Israel ne ki nongwei bashong basah bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban don kawei ka hukum na ka bynta uta uba leh pop lyngba ka jingbymtip, na ka bynta uta uba la kha hapdeng ki khun Israel bad na ka bynta u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong ki .

en: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you : ye shall not sow , neither reap that which groweth of itself in it , nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed .
kha: Phim dei ban bet ha ki lyngkha jong phi lane ot ïa u kew uba shu mih hi lane kheit ïa ki soh na ki brisoh jong phi kiba phim shym la khyllad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jubile kan long ha phi: phin ym bet ia kata kaba sanphew snem: lymne phin ym kheit ia kata kaba san hi ha ka , lymne ban lum ia ki sohjew ha ka jong u sohjew jong me .

en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron : and he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , With these shalt thou push the Syrians , until thou have consumed them .
kha: Uwei na ki , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Khenaanah , u shna ïa ki reng nar bad u ong ha u Ahab ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Da kine phin ïaleh ïa ki nong Syria bad phin jop thiaw ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u khun u Chenaah u la pynlong ia u da ki nar: bad u la ong: Kumta ong U Trai: Da kine me pynkhih ia ki Syria haduh ba men da bam ia ki .

en: For Moses had said , Consecrate yourselves to day to the  Lord  , even every man upon his son , and upon his brother  ; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day .
kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki Lebi ,  Mynta ka sngi phi la pynkyntang ïa lade kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa U  Trai  da kaba pynïap ïa la ki khun shynrang bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang , kumta U  Trai  u la ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Moses u la ong , To ai ia lade ha U Trai , wat uwei pa uwei ha u khun jong u, bad ha u hynmen jong u; ba un ai ia phi ia ka jingkyrkhu ha kane ka sngi .

en: Then said he unto all Israel , Be ye on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . And the people said unto Saul , Do what seemeth good unto thee .
kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha ki ,  Phi baroh ïeng hangtai , u Jonathan bad nga ngin ïeng hangne .   Leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki Israel baroh: To long ha kawei ka liang, bad nga bad u khun jong nga ngin don ha kawei pat ka liang . Ki briew ki la ong ha u Saul , To leh ia kaba bha ia me .

en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha shiliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki hukum bad ki jingbishar kiba U Trai u la hukum da ka kti u Moses ha ki khun Israel ha ki madan Moab da u Jordan hajan Jerikho .

en: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba khluit , kaba tyrkhong , kim shym la shahshitom na ka jingsliang . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mih na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong ki ; u pynpait ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka mih nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim shym la sliang haba u la ialam ia ki lyngba ki ri khlaw: u la pynlong ia ki um ban tuid na u maw na ka bynta jong ki: u la pynlong ia u maw ruh, bad ki um ki la tuid shabar .

en: And when they saw him , they were amazed : and his mother said unto him , Son , why hast thou thus dealt with us ? behold , thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing .
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la kyndit haba ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong ,  Ko khun jong nga , balei me la leh ïa kane ha ngi ? U kpa jong me bad ma nga ngi la khuslai shikatdei eh ha kaba pyrshang ban wad ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohi ia u, ki la lyngngoh: bad ka kmie jong u ka la ong ha u: Ko khun, balei me la leh kumta ia ngi ? ha khmih , u kpa jong me bad nga ngi la wad ia me da kaba sngewsih .

en: And those members of the body , which we think to be less honourable , upon these we bestow more abundant honour ; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness .
kha: bad kito ki dkhot met kiba ngi pyrkhat ba kim da myntoi eh , ki long kita kiba ngi dei ban kham sumar ; katba ïa ki dkhot jong ka met ki bym da itynnat eh la kham pynitynnat , ïa kiba ïa ki dkhot met kiba itynnat kim da donkam ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita ki dkhot jong ka met kiba ngi pyrkhat ba ki kham duna ka burom, halor kine ngi ai kham bun ka burom ; bad ki bynta jong ngi ki kham bun ka jingitynnad .

en: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , my servant  ; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him .
kha: Nga long uta uba la buh ïa kine ki jaitbynriew baroh hapoh ka bor jong u shakri jong nga , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , bad nga la pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga la ai ia kine ki ri baroh ha ka kti u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon , u shakri jong nga; bad ki mrad ki mreng jong nga ruh nga la ai ia u ruh ban shakri ia u .

en: And thou shalt swear , The  Lord  liveth , in truth , in judgment , and in righteousness  ; and the nations shall bless themselves in him , and in him shall they glory .
kha: kan long kaba dei ïa phi ban smai da ka kyrteng jong nga . Nangta baroh ki jaitbynriew kin kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrkhu ïa ki , bad kin ïaroh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban smai , U Trai u im, ha ka jingshisha, ha ka jingbishar, bad ha ka hok ; bad ki jaitbynriew kin kyrkhu ia lade ha u, bad ha u kin pyndonburom ia lade .

en: And , behold , the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying , This shall not be thine heir  ; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir .
kha: Nangta u ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren biang ha u ,  Une u Eliesar uba long u mraw un ym ïohpateng ïa ka spah ka phew jong me ; u khun jong me hi un long u nongïoh pateng jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u, ka ong, Kane kan ym long ka nongioh pateng jong me ; hynrei uta uba mih na ka kpoh jong me hi un long u nongioh pateng jong me .

en: And he gathered men unto him , and became captain over a band , when David slew them of Zobah : and they went to Damascus , and dwelt therein , and reigned in Damascus .
kha: ( Kane ka jia hadien ba u Dabid u la jop ïa u Hadadeser bad u la pynïap ïa ki paralok jong u na Syria . ) U Reson bad ki rangbah jong u ki leit bad sah ha Damaskos , ha kaba ki rangbah jong u ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum ia ki briew ha u, bad u la long u kapten jong ka kynhun, haba u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki na ka shnong Soba: bad ki la leit sha Damaskos bad ki la shong hangta bad ki la synshar ha Damaskos .

en: But Absalom fled . And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Absalom u la phet krad . Ha kata ka por u shipai ha ka por ap phira u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah babun kiba wan hiar na u lum , ha ka lynti na Horonaim . U la leit sha u syiem bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Absalom u la phet noh . Bad uta u samla uba la bat ia ka watch u la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong u, bad u la peit bad, ha khmih, ki la wan bun ki briew ha ka lynti jong u lum hadien jong u .

en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered  ; he shall not leave any of it until the morning .
kha: Ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad dei ban bam noh ha kata hi ka sngi ba la kñia ïa u ; ym dei ban pynsah wat tang khyndiat ruh haduh ka step kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka doh jong ka jingknia jingsuk jong u na ka bynta ka jingainguh jong u kan long ha kajuh ka sngi ba la tyrwa; um dei ban iehnoh ia ka haduh ka por mynstep .

en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias , saying , The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
kha: U Ïoannis u la long uta u briew ïa uba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la kren shaphang jong u haba u la ong ,  U don uwei uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , To pynkhreh ka lynti ïa U Trai ; to pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta jong u ban ïaid !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long ma u uba la kren da u nongiathuhlypa Isaiah, u da ong: Ka sur jong uwei uba iam ha ka ri khlaw , Pynkhreh ia ka lynti U Trai , pynlong ia ki lynti jong u kiba beit .

en: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest , that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the  Lord  , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :
kha: Khie leit sha u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad pynïoh ïa ka jingai jingkheiñ ïa ka pisa ba ki lyngdoh kiba treikam ha ka khyrdop jong ka Templ ba ki la ïohlum na ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit sha u Hilkiah u rangbah lyngdoh , ba un lum ia ka rupa kaba la wanrah sha ka iing U Trai , kaba ki nongap ka jingkhang ki la lum lang na ki briew:

en: And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .
kha: Kumta u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha la u kpa .  U dang kham pajih ha ka lynti na ïing haba u kpa jong u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohnud jong u ka la dap da ka jingisynei , bad u la mareh , u la piam ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u , bad u la doh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la wan sha la u kpa . Hynrei haba u dang iaid lynti shibun, u kpa jong u u la iohi ia u bad u la sngewsynei bad u la mareh bad u la hap ha ka ryndang jong u bad u la kdup ia u .

en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Moab . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynjot tang ha kawei ka miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka tap ïa ka ri Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong u Moab . Namar ha ka miet u Ar u Moab u la shah pynjot , bad la wanrah ia ka jingsngap jar jar jar jar namar ha ka miet u Kir u Moab u la shah pynjot , bad la wanrah ia ka jingsngap jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar

en: Run now , I pray thee , to meet her , and say unto her , Is it well with thee ? is it well with thy husband ? is it well with the child ? And she answered , It is well .
kha: Pynkloi ban leit sha ka bad kylli la kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang bad ka , u tnga jong ka , bad u khun jong ka .  Ka ïathuh ha u Gehasi ba kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniaid mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, ban iakynduh ia ka, bad ban ong ia ka, Hato ka long kaba bha bad me ? hato ka long kaba bha bad u khun ? Bad ka la jubab , Ka long kaba bha .

en: For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .
kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U  Trai  ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Lada jia kumta , U  Trai  un bitar lep ïa phi bad un pynjot ïa phi shisyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kin pynphai noh ia u khun jong me na kaba bud ia nga: kumta ka jingbitar U Trai kan sa bthei pyrshah ia phi , bad kan pynjot kynsan ia me .

en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her , and disallowed her not : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
kha: ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kata kaba ka la kular lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U tnga jong ka u la iohsngew ia kata, bad u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u ha ka, bad um shah ia ka: nangta ki jingkular jong ka baroh kin ieng, bad kawei pa kawei ka jingiadei kaba ka teh ia ka mynsiem jong ka kan ieng .

en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast , of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people .
kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka khleiñ jong u mrad ïa uba wanlam kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uno uno uba bam ia ka shini jong u mrad, na kaba ki briew ki ai ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai , wat ia ka mynsiem kaba bam ia ka yn ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Then thou shalt take an awl , and thrust it through his ear unto the door , and he shall be thy servant for ever . And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise .
kha: ïalam ïa u sha ka jingkhang ïing jong phi bad sam shkor ïa u hangta , te un sa long u mraw jong phi shi rta . Leh kumjuh ïa ka mraw jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta men shim ia ka awl, bad to pynkhih ia ka lyngba ka shkor jong u haduh ka jingkhang, bad un long u shakri jong me junom . Bad ruh ia u shakri jong me men leh kumjuh .

en: Save when there shall be no poor among you  ; for the  Lord  shall greatly bless thee in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri kaba u ai ha phi . Yn ym don uwei ruh uba duk na ki para jait jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar haba ym don uba duk hapdeng jong phi ; namar U Trai un kyrkhu shibun ia me ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me na ka bynta ka pateng ban don ia ka:

en: And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the  Lord  your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you : and my people shall never be ashamed .
kha: Mynta phin don kyrhai ban bam , bad phin sngewhun . Phin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla na ka bynta jong phi ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin bam ha ka jingbun bad phin sngewhun bad iaroh ia ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la leh phylla ia phi: bad ki briew jong nga kin ym sngewlehrain satia .

en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .
kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka sut kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh , ba la suh lang ha ka sut kaba ar . Kita ki kyrwoh ki ïaphai marpyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Sanphew tylli ki loop ba u la shna ha kawei ka jingtap, bad sanphew tylli ki loop u la shna ha ka tduh jong ka jingtap kaba don ha ka jingpyniasoh kaba ar: ki loop ki bat ia kawei ka jingtap sha kawei pat .

en: What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? wherefore , when I looked that it should bring forth grapes , brought it forth wild grapes ?
kha: Don kano kano kaba ngam shym la leh ïa ka ? Te balei ka pynmih ki sohwaiñ kiba jew bad ym kiba bha kumba nga la khmih lynti ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba lah ban leh kham bun ia ka kper sohjew jong nga, ba ngam shym la leh ha ka ? namar kata haba nga peit ba ka dei ban pynmih ia ki sohjew , nga la pynmih ia ki sohjew khlaw ?

en: What is it then ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also : I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .
kha: Kaei ken kane ? Ngan duwai da ka mynsiem jong nga , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga ; ngan rwai da la ka mynsiem , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kata ? Ngan duwai da ka mynsiem ruh: Ngan rwai da ka mynsiem ruh .

en: And if the plague come again , and break out in the house , after that he hath taken away the stones , and after he hath scraped the house , and after it is plastered  ;
kha: Lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang ha kata ka ïing hadien ba la weng noh ïa kita ki maw bad hadien ba la khrud bad la ñiad astor thymmai ruh ïa ka , u lyngdoh un leit khmih bha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka khlam ka wan biang ha iing, bad ka mih noh ha iing, hadien kata u la weng noh ia ki maw, bad hadien ba u la dep ban pynkhih ia ka iing, bad hadien kata la buh ia ka;

en: By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kohnguh haba U Blei u la khot ïa u ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ha u . U la mihnoh na la ka ri khlem tip shano ba un leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Abraham haba la khot ia u ban leit sha ka jaka kaba u dei ban ioh hadien ka pateng, u la kohnguh ; bad u la leit noh khlem da tip shano u leit .

en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .
kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khot ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long ruh ki lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la phah ban khot ia u Ahimeleh u lyngdoh u Ahitub bad ki iing jong u baroh: bad ki la wan baroh sha u syiem .

en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .
kha: bad ki ïohi ba ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kumta u buh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat haduh ba un da leit ïakren pat bad U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la iohi ia ka khmat u Moses, ba ka sniehdoh jong u Moses ka la shai: bad u Moses u la buh biang ia ka jingtap ha ka khmat jong u, haduh ba u la rung ban iakren bad u .

en: The God of my rock  ; in him will I trust : he is my shield , and the horn of my salvation , my high tower , and my refuge , my saviour  ; thou savest me from violence .
kha: U Blei jong nga u long ka jingïada jong nga ; bad nga shngain bad u , U ïada ïa nga kum ka stieh ; u da ïa nga bad ri pynim ïa nga . U long u nongpynim jong nga . U ïada ïa nga bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingumsnam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong u maw jong nga ; ha u ngan shaniah: u long ka jingda jong nga, bad ka horn jong ka jingpynim jong nga, bad ka jaka rieh jong nga kaba jrong, ko nongpynim jong nga ; me pynim ia nga na ka jingleh donbor .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .
kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa ka jaiñkup thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlup ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u la shim ia ka jain kaba jylliew bad u la pynngam ia ka ha ka um bad u la pynphriang ia ka ha ka khmat jong u, haduh ba u la iap: bad u Hazael u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Behold , what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us , that we should be called the sons of God : therefore the world knoweth us not , because it knew him not .
kha: Ha khmih haduh katno U Kpa u la ieit ïa ngi ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba ïa ngi la khot ki khun U Blei — bad kumta , ha ka jingshisha , ngi long . Dei kane ba balei ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa ngi : Kam pat la ithuh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, kaei ka rukom jingieit kaba U Kpa u la ai ha ngi, ba ngin shah khot ki khun U Blei: namarkata ka pyrthei kam ithuh ia ngi , namar kam ithuh ia u .

en: Now is the end come upon thee , and I will send mine anger upon thee , and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .
kha: Ko Israel , kaba kut ka la wan . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ; naba ngan bishar ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli jong pha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka jingkut ka wan ha me , bad ngan phah ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong me , bad ngan bishar ia me kat kum ki lynti jong me , bad ngan siew kylliang ia me baroh ki jingleh bymman jong me .

en: Behold , there came fire down from heaven , and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties : therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight .
kha: Ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong ki la pynïap da ka ding na bneng ; hynrei sngewbha isynei ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka la wan ka ding na bneng, bad ka la thang ia ki arngut ki rangbah kiba mynshuwa da ki sanphew snem jong ki: namarkata to ai ba ka jingim jong nga mynta kan long kaba kordor ha khmat jong me .

en: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and pitched beside Eben–ezer : and the Philistines pitched in Aphek .
kha: Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel , kumta ki Israel ki mih ban ïaleh ïa ki . Ki Israel ki sher dara ha Ebeneser bad ki Philistia pat ha Aphek .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien u Samuel ka la wan sha ki Israel baroh . Mynta ki Israel ki la leit sha ka thma, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh hajan u Ebener: bad ki Philistia ki la ia tyngkhuh ha Aphek .

en: And so was also James , and John , the sons of Zebedee , which were partners with Simon . And Jesus said unto Simon ,  Fear not  ; from henceforth thou shalt catch men .
kha: Kajuh ka la long ïa ki paralok jong u Simon , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . U Jisu u la ong ha u Simon ,  Wat sheptieng ; naduh mynta men long u nongtong briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumjuh ruh u Jakob bad u Ioannis, ki khun u Sebedei, kiba la iatreilang bad u Simon . U Jisu u la ong ha u Simon, Wat tieng naduh mynta to kem ia ki briew .

en: And all the house of Joseph , and his brethren , and his father s house : only their little ones , and their flocks , and their herds , they left in the land of Goshen .
