kha: Ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , ki hynmen ki para jong u , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem baroh jong u kpa jong u , ki ïaleit ryngkat bad u . Kiba sah ha Goshen ki long tang ki khun rit , bad ki langbrot , ki blang , bad kiwei kiwei de ki jingri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka iing u Joseph baroh bad ki hynmen jong u bad ka iing u kpa jong u: tang ki khun rit jong ki bad ki langbrot jong ki bad ki kynhun jong ki ki la leit noh ha ka ri Goshen .

en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
kha: Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi . Hato ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyllait ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?
translated_en_to_kha: To husiar na ka bynta ba u Hesekaiah un pynsngewthuh ia phi da kaba ong , U Trai un pyllait im ia ngi . Hato don uwei na ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew uba la pyllait ia ka ri jong u na ka kti jong u syiem Assyria ?

en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt : and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps .
kha: Un shim noh ïa ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa ba la buhrieh jong ka Ijipt bad ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingdon jingem jong ka kiba la ñiewkordor eh . Un hiarthma ïa ka Libya bad ka Sudan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un don ka bor halor ki spah ksiar bad rupa bad halor kiei kiei baroh kiba kordor jong ka ri Ijipt: bad ki Libyan bad ki nong Ithiopia kin don ha ki step jong u .

en: But charge Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him : for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .
kha: Hukum ïa u Joshua , bad pynshlur ïa u , naba un ïalam ïa u paidbah shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba me ïohi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to pynshlur ia u Joshua bad pynskhem ia u: namar un leit sha khmat une u briew bad un pynlong ia ki ban hiar pateng ia ka ri kaba me iohi .

en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him :
kha: Kane ka jingthmu , ïa kaba U Blei un sa pyndep ha ka ïa kaba biang , ka long ban lumlang ïa ka jingpynlong baroh , ha bneng bad ha khyndew , lem bad U Khrist kum u khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha ka jingpynbeit ia ka jingdap jong ki por u lah ban lum lang ha U Khrist baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha bneng bad kiba don ha ka khyndew ; wat ha u:

en: Blessed is the man that doeth this , and the son of man that layeth hold on it  ; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and keepeth his hand from doing any evil .
kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba ïai sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad ki bym pyndonkam bakla ïa ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito ki bym leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia u briew uba leh ia kane, bad u khun u briew uba bat ia ka ; uba bat ia ka Sabha ban pynjakhlia ia ka , bad u bat ia ka kti jong u ban leh ia kaba sniew .

en: Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki sa kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki Bneng ka long kumne . Ka briew ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew tad haduh ba u  purew ba la khleh u sieb .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pat ka pharshi ka la kren ia ki; Ka hima bneng ka long kum ka jingkhleh , kaba ka kynthei ka la shim bad ka la buhrieh ha ki lai tylli ki jingthew jingbam , haduh ba ka la long kaba la khleh lang baroh kawei .

en: Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?
kha: To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Phi bam ïa ka doh kaba dang bit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynïap briew . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Phi bam ia ka snam , bad phi rah ia ki khmat jong phi sha ki bleithaw jong phi , bad phi pynmih snam: bad phin sa ioh ia ka ri ?

en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
kha: U la leit sha u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada un lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ïa ka Lynti jong U Trai , un lah ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kwah na u ia ki shithi sha ki synagog ha ki synagog, ba lada u lap ia uno uno na kine ki rukom, la ki long shynrang ne kynthei, u lah ban wanrah ia ki sha Jerusalem .

en: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife , and hath not taken her ? let him go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her .
kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep ïatehktien ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uei u briew uba la shongkurim ia ka tnga bad um shym la shim ia ka ? to ai ba un leit phai noh sha la iing , ioh ba un iap ha ka thma bad uwei pat u briew un shim ia ka .

en: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him .
kha: Lada me la leh ïa kaba dei , men jin da la phuh samrkhie ; hynrei namar ba me la leh ïa kaba sniew , ka pop ka apthap ha ka jingkhang jong me . Ka kwah ban synshar ïa me , hynrei me dei ban jop ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me leh bha, hato ym pdiang ia me ? bad lada phim leh bha, ka pop ka shong ha ka jingkhang . Bad ha me kan long ka jingkwah jong u, bad me dei ban synshar halor jong u .

en: It came to pass after this also , that the children of Moab , and the children of Ammon , and with them other beside the Ammonites , came against Jehoshaphat to battle .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki kynhun shipai jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon , ryngkat bad kiba ïateh lok bad ki , ki Meun , ki hiarthma ïa ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la jia hadien kane ruh, ba ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Amoab bad ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Amoan bad kiwei pat ki briew kiba don hajan ki nong Ammon ki la wan pyrshah ia u Jehoshaphat ban ialeh thma .

en: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .
kha: U nongshun u ong , ‘ Ngan beh kthong bad kem ïa ki , ngan ïabynta ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga mon ; ngan sei ïa la ka waitlam , bad ngan shim ïa baroh kaba ki don .’
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshun u la ong , Ngan bud ia ki, ngan sa iaid lait noh, ngan phiah ia ka jingkwah brai jong nga kan sa pynhun ia ki ; ngan ring ia ka waitlam jong nga, ka kti jong nga kan pynjot ia ki .

en: And their houses shall be turned unto others , with their fields and wives together : for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ki ïing jong ki yn ai noh ha kiwei , bad kumta kan long ïa ki lyngkha jong ki bad ki tnga jong ki . Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ki briew jong kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki iing jong ki kin kylla sha kiwei pat, ryngkat bad ki lyngkha bad ki tnga jong ki: namar ngan pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri , ong U Trai .

en: This day the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments : thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
kha: Mynta ka sngi , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ; kumta kohnguh ïa ki da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka sngi U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me ban leh ia kine ki ain bad ki jingbishar: me dei ban sumar bad leh ia ki da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh .

en: She is empty , and void , and waste : and the heart melteth , and the knees smite together , and much pain is in all loins , and the faces of them all gather blackness .
kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh la pynjot , la iehnoh , kaba kynjah ! Ki dohnud ki um da ka jingsheptieng ; ki khohsiew ki khynñiuh , ka jingkhlaiñ ka la jah noh ; ki durkhmat ki la kylla lieh blaid blaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba thylli, bad kaba thylli: bad ka dohnud ka rkhiang, bad ki kjat ki ia tyngkhuh lang, bad ka jingpang kaba bun ka don ha ki tyrpeng baroh, bad ki khmat jong ki baroh ki lum ia ka jingdum .

en: Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .
kha: Kumta ki la ïalum ïa baroh kaba la tam bad ki la pyndap haduh khat-ar tukri da ki lyngkhot kiba la sah tam na ki san tylli ki kpu barli kiba ki briew ki la bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la lum lang ia ki , bad ki la pyndap ia ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot lyngkhai jong ki san tylli ki kpu barli kiba la sah shaneng shaneng ha ki .

en: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened ; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling , and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints ,
kha: Nga duwai ba yn plie ïa ki jingmut jong phi khnang ba phin ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong u , ba phin tip kaei kata ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba u la khot ïa phi , katno ki jingkynrei spah ki long kita ki jingkyrkhu baphylla kiba U Blei u la kular ïa la ki briew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong ka jingsngewthuh jong phi ki la shah pynshai shuh shuh ba phin tip kaei ka jingkyrmen jong ka jingkhot jong u , bad kaei ka spah jong ka burom jong ka pateng jong u ha ki riewkhuid , .

en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love , and they defiled her with their whoredom , and she was polluted with them , and her mind was alienated from them .
kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki wan ïathiah shongkha bad ka . Ki pyndonkam ïa ka bad ki pyntngit ïa ka katta katta haduh ba khatduh kan da sngewngiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Babilon ki la wan sha ka ha ka jingthiah jong ka jingieit , bad ki la pynjakhlia ia ka da ka jingkhaii met jong ki , bad ka la shah pynjakhlia bad ki , bad ka jingmut jong ka ka la jah noh na ki .

en: Behold , Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee , saying , Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth : for the right of redemption is thine to buy it .
kha: ba u Hanamel , u khun jong u kñi jong nga , u Shallum , un wan sha nga bad ka jingkyrpad ban thied ïa ka lyngkha jong u ha Anathoth ha ka thain Benjamin , namar nga long u ba-ha-ïing bajan tam bad ba nga don ka hok ban thied ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u Hanameel u khun jong u Shallum u un wan sha me, u da ong: Thied ia ka lyngkha jong nga kaba don ha Anathoth: namar ka hok jong ka jingpynim ka long ka jong me ban thied ia ka .

en: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast : and they worshipped the beast , saying , Who is like unto the beast ? who is able to make war with him ?
kha: Uwei pa uwei u la mane ïa u Ïakjakor namar ba u la ai ïa la ka bor synshar ha uta u mradkhlaw . Ki la mane ruh ïa uta u mradkhlaw , bad ki la ong ,  Uei uba kum u mradkhlaw ? Uei uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mane ia u bsein uba la ai bor ia u mrad: bad ki la mane ia uta u mrad ki da ong: Mano ba long kum uta u mrad ? uba lah ban ialeh thma bad u ?

en: Son of man , these men have set up their idols in their heart , and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face : should I be enquired of at all by them ?
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kine ki briew ki la ai ïa ki dohnud jong ki ha ki bleithaw bad ki la shah ba ki bleithaw kin ïalam ïa ki sha ka pop . Hato ki pyrkhat ba ngan ai ha ki ka jubab ?
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , kine ki briew ki la buh ia ki bleithaw jong ki ha ka dohnud jong ki , bad ki la buh ia ka jingbymhok jong ki ha khmat jong ki: hato nga dei ban shah kylli satia da ki ?

en: But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort ? for all things come of thee , and of thine own have we given thee .
kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngim lah shisha ban ai ei ei ïa me , namar kaei kaei baroh ka dei ka jingai sngewbha jong me , bad ngi la ai biang sha me ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga long mano bad kaei ka briew jong nga, ba ngin lah ban aiti da ka mon sngewbha hadien kane ka jait ? namar kiei kiei baroh ki wan na me bad na me hi ngi la ai ia me .

en: I know that , whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it , nor any thing taken from it : and God doeth it , that men should fear before him .
kha: Nga tip ba kaei kaei kaba U Blei u leh kan neh junom . Phim lah ban bynrap ei ei ha ka lane shim noh ïa kano kano na ka . Bad kawei kaba U Blei u leh ka long ban pynlong ïa ngi ban ïeng ha ka jingburom ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia kata, kaei kaei kaba U Blei u leh, kan long junom: ym lah ban buh ei ei ha ka, lane ia kaei kaei kaba la shim na ka: bad U Blei u leh ia kata, ba ki briew kin tieng ha khmat jong u .

en: And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
kha: Katba ka dang suh kha , uwei na ki u pynmih shabar ïa la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata ka kti , ka teh ïa ka da u  saisaw , bad ka ong ,  Une u dei uba mih nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ka la sngewsih, ba uta u la pynmih ia la ka kti: bad ka nongsumar ka la shim bad teh ha ka kti jong u ia u thread uba saw, da kaba ong: Kane ka la mih nyngkong .

en: And they took every man his censer , and put fire in them , and laid incense thereon , and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron .
kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding , u buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad u ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ lem bad u Moses bad u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka umphniang jong u bad ki la buh ding ha ki, bad ki la buh ia ka jingiwbih halor kata, bad ki la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad u Moses bad u Aaron .

en: And if thy brother , an Hebrew man , or an Hebrew woman , be sold unto thee , and serve thee six years  ; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee .
kha: Lada u para Israel , shynrang lane kynthei , ki die mraw ïa lade ha phi , phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki hadien ba ki la shakri ïa phi hynriew snem . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u hynmen jong me, u briew Hebru ne ka kynthei Hebru, u shah die ha me, bad u shakri ia me hynriew snem ; te ha ka snem kaba hynriew me dei ban pyllait noh ia u na me .

en: And Moses went up unto God , and the  Lord  called unto him out of the mountain , saying , Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel  ;
kha: bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha u lum ban ïashem bad U Blei . U  Trai  u la khot ïa u na u lum bad u la bthah ïa u ban ong ha ki Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob :
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la leit sha U Blei bad U Trai u la khot ia u na u lum, u da ong: Kumta to ong ha ka iing u Jakob bad to iathuh ia ki khun Israel;

en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki un long kum ka jingkah na ka lyer bad ka jaka ban rieh na ki  erïong . Kin long kum ki wahduid kiba tuid ha ka ri shyiap , kum ka jingkah syrngiew u mawsiang bah ha ka ri shrah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew un long kum ka jaka rieh na ka Iyer, bad ka jingtap na ka eriong;

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , take thy journey before the people , that they may go in and possess the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them .
kha: Nangta u ong ïa nga ban leit bad ïalam ïa phi , khnang ba phi lah ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga, To khie, to shim ia ka jingleit jong me ha khmat ki briew, ba kin leit rung bad ioh ia ka ri kaba nga sngap jar ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban ai ha ki .

en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abednego , hato ka long kaba shisha ba phi kyntait ban mane ïa u blei jong nga bad ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Neuchadnezzar u la kren bad u la ong ha ki, Hato ka long kaba shisha, ko Shadrak, ko Meshah bad u Abednego , phim shakri ia ki blei jong nga , ne mane ia ka dur ksiar kaba nga la buh ?

en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen ? to loose the bands of wickedness , to undo the heavy burdens , and to let the oppressed go free , and that ye break every yoke ?
kha: Ka rukom shah jingit kaba nga kwah ka dei kane : Pynduh noh ïa ki kynjri ka jingbanbeiñ bad ka lyngkor ka jingbymhok , bad ai ba kiba la shah banbeiñ kin ïoh laitluid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam dei ka jingstet kaba nga la jied ? ban pyllait ia ki kynhun bymman , ban pynkylla ia ki jingkit kiba khia , bad ban pyllait ia kiba shah pynshitom bein ban leit laitluid , bad ba phi pynpra ia kawei pa kawei ka jingkit ?

en: Therefore will I also deal in fury : mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice , yet will I not hear them .
kha: Kin sa sngew ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga baroh ; ngan ym tyngkai ïa ki ne pyn-i ka jinglehisynei ei ei ïa ki . Kin kyang ha nga da ki jingduwai jam katba ki lah , hynrei ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan leh ruh da ka jingbitar: ka khmat jong nga kan ym lait: bad wat la ki iam ha ki shkor jong nga da ka sur kaba jam , hynrei ngan ym iohsngew ia ki .

en: But the king spared Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the  Lord s  oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .
kha: Hynrei namar ka kular kaba kyntang kaba ma u bad u Jonathan ki la pynlong uwei ïa uwei pat , u Dabid u la pyllait ïa u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem u la pyllait im ia u Mephibosheth u khun u Jonathan u khun u Saul namar ka jingsmai U Trai kaba la don hapdeng jong ki, hapdeng u Dabid bad u Jonathan u khun u Saul .

en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .
kha: Haba u Abram u la ïohsngew ba la kem koidi ïa u pyrsa jong u , u khot lang ïa ki nongïapom kiba don hapoh ka dara jong u , baroh ki long laispah khatphra ngut , bad u la thwet ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem haduh Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram u la iohsngew ba u hynmen jong u u la shah kem , u la pynkhreh ia ki shakri ba la hikai jong u, kiba la kha ha la ka jong ka iing, lai spah shiphew snem bad u la bud ia ki haduh Dan .

en: Take great stones in thine hand , and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln , which is at the entry of Pharaoh s house in Tahpanhes , in the sight of the men of Judah  ;
kha: Hangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To pynïoh ïa ki mawbah bad tep ïa ki ha ka sorki jong ka jingsiang ha khmat ka khyrdop sha ka ïing sorkar kaba don ha ka nongbah , bad to ai ba katto katne ngut ki Israel kin ïohi ïa me ba me leh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim ia ki maw kiba heh ha ka kti jong me bad buhrieh ia ki ha ka dewbilat ha ka dewbilat kaba don ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing u Pharaoh ha Tahpanhes ha khmat ki briew jong ka Judah;

en: Why art thou cast down , O my soul ? and why art thou disquieted within me ? hope in God : for I shall yet praise him , who is the health of my countenance , and my God .
kha: Balei ba nga sngewsih haduh katta katta ? Balei ba nga sngew jynjar sat ? Ngan buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Blei , bad sa shisien pat ngan ïaroh ïa u , U nongpynim jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me bret noh ia u, ko mynsiem jong nga ? bad balei me sngewsih hapoh jong nga ? jingkyrmen ha U Blei: namar ngan dang iaroh ia u uba long ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong ka khmat jong nga bad U Blei jong nga .

en: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away , and the abomination that maketh desolate set up , there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days .
kha: Naduh ka por ba ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ki sangeh , kata , naduh ka por jong ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli , shihajar arspah khyndaiphew tylli ki sngi kin ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh ka por ba la weng noh ia ka jingknia kaba man ka sngi, bad ka jinglehrain kaba pynlong ia ka jingjot kan long shihajar arspah hynniewphew sngi .

en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;
kha: Ha kaba nyngkong u la ong ,  Mem shym la mon lane mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh lane ïa ki mrad ban thang ha ka duwan bad ïa ki jingkñia ïa ka ban kit noh ïa ki pop .  U la ong ïa kane wat haba ïa baroh ki jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Halor haba u la ong , Ka jingknia bad ka jingainguh bad ka jingknia na ka bynta ka pop ngam shym la leh kumta, lymne ngam shym la sngewbha ha kata ka por ; kiba la tyrwa da ka ain ; .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the sea , that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians , upon their chariots , and upon their horsemen .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw khnang ba ki um kin ïadait biang bad tyllep ïa ki nong Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki , bad ïa ki nongñiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me halor ka duriaw, ba ki um kin wan biang ha ki nong Ijipt, ha ki kali jong ki bad ha ki kulai jong ki .

en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough , and an uppermost branch , which they left because of the children of Israel : and there shall be desolation .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ïa ki nongbah kiba la ïada bha yn iehnoh bad yn ieh ha ka jingjot jingpra kum ki nongbah kiba ki Hib bad ki Amor ki la iehnoh mynba ki phet ïap na ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki shnong kiba skhem jong u kin long kum ka tnat kaba la iehnoh , bad ka tnat kaba kham halor , kaba ki la iehnoh namar ki khun Israel: bad kan long ka jingpynjot .

en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .
kha: U mihnoh na Bethlehem ban leit wad jaka shong shawei . Katba u dang don ha ka jingleit kumta , u wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u la mih noh na ka shnong na Bethlehemudah ban leit sah ha ka jaka ba u lah ban shem jaka : bad u la wan ban kiew Ephraim sha ka iing u Micah , katba u dang iaid .

en: The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
kha: Ki briew jong pha kiba la kha ha ka por ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — ngi donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun kiba me don, hadien ba me la duh noh ia uwei pat, kin ong biang ha ki shkor jong me: Ka jaka ka long kaba jynjar palat na ka bynta jong nga: ai jaka ia nga ba ngan shong .

en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .
kha: bad haba ki la ithuh ïa u kum u nongkhrong uba la ju shong ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , baroh ki la kyndit bad lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tip ba dei ma u uba shong ha ka khyrdop ba itynnad jong ka tempi: bad ki la dap da ka jinglyngngoh bad ka jinglyngngoh ia kata kaba la jia ia u .

en: For this shall the earth mourn , and the heavens above be black : because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent , neither will I turn back from it .
kha: Ka pyrthei kan ïam sngewsih ; ka sahit bneng kan sdang dum . U  Trai  u la kren bad un ym kylla ïa ka jingmut jong u . U la pynlong ïa ka jingrai jong u bad un ym kylla dien .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ka khyndew kan iam, bad ki bneng haneng kin long kiba lieh: namar nga la kren ia ka, nga la thmu ia ka, bad ngan ym kylla bamut, lymne ngan phaidien noh na ka .

en: Then David arose , and all the people that were with him , and they passed over Jordan : by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan .
kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sdang ban jam ïa ka Jordan , bad kat ban da kynjat shai mynstep , baroh ki la poi lut sha shiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ieng bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, bad ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan: ha ka jingshai mynstep ym don uwei ruh na ki uba khlem leit sha ka Jordan .

en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .
kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san snem ka rta bad nga dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta kumba nga la long mynba u Moses u la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ bha ban leit ïaleh thma ne na ka bynta kano kano .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh mynta nga long uba khlain kumjuh ha ka sngi ba u Moses u la phah ia nga: kumba ka bor jong nga ka la long ha kata ka por, wat kumjuh ruh ka bor jong nga mynta, na ka bynta ka thma, baroh ar ban leit shabar bad ban wan rung .

en: And Moses made a serpent of brass , and put it upon a pole , and it came to pass , that if a serpent had bitten any man , when he beheld the serpent of brass , he lived .
kha: Kumta u Moses u shna ïa u  seiñ rnong bad u wah ïa u ha u dieng . Kat uba shah puh bseiñ u peit sha uta u  seiñ rnong bad u koit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shna ia u bsein nar bad u la buh ia u ha u dieng bad ka la jia ba lada u bsein u la bam ia uno uno u briew haba u la iohi ia u bsein nar , u la im .

en: ( For the life was manifested , and we have seen it , and bear witness , and shew unto you that eternal life , which was with the Father , and was manifested unto us  ; )
kha: Haba ïa une u jingim la pynpaw , ngi la ïohi ïa u ; kumta ngi kren shaphang jong u bad ngi ïathuh ïa phi shaphang ka jingim bymjukut kaba la don bad U Kpa bad ba la pynithuh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta ka jingim ka la paw , bad ngi la iohi ia ka, bad ngi la sakhi, bad ngi la pyni ha phi ia kata ka jingim bymjukut kaba la don bad U Kpa, bad la pynpaw ha ngi; )

en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phi ïawad ïa nga namar ba phi la bam ïa u kpu bad phi la ïoh baroh kaba phi kwah , ym namar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kambah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia ki bad u la ong: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Phi wad ia nga ym namar ba phi la iohi ia ki kambah hynrei namar ba phi la bam ia ki kpu bad phi la dap .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :
kha: Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u syiem u la pule .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha kane ka jaka bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka, wat ia ki ktien jong ka kot baroh kiba u syiem Judah u la pule:

en: When I have bent Judah for me , filled the bow with Ephraim , and raised up thy sons , O Zion , against thy sons , O Greece , and made thee as the sword of a mighty man .
kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka Judah kum ka ryntieh jong u shipai bad ïa ka Israel kum ki khnam . Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki rangbah jong ka Seïon kum ka waitlam , ban ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong ka Gris .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la pynkhih ia u Judah na ka bynta jong nga, nga la pyndap ia ka bow bad u Ephraim, bad nga la pynmih ia ki khun jong me, ko Seion, pyrshah ia ki khun jong me, ko Grik, bad nga la pynlong ia me kum ka waitlam jong u briew uba khlain bor .

en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord , when he will return from the wedding  ; that when he cometh and knocketh , they may open unto him immediately .
kha: kum ki shakri kiba ap khmih ïa u kynrad jong ki ban wan phai pat na ka jingkhawai shongkurim . Haba u wan bad u tied jingkhang , mar kumta hi , kin plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi hi kum ki briew kiba ap ia u kynrad jong ki, haba un wan phai na ka jingkhawai shongkurim ba ynda u wan bad u tied , kin plie ia u mardor .

en: And they shall say , This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden  ; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced , and are inhabited .
kha: Baroh kin ong kumno kane ka ri , kaba shisien ka la long ka jaka khlaw , ka la kylla long kum ka Kper Eden , bad kumno ba ki nongbah kiba la shah pynjot , shah lute bad shah iehnoh ha ki jingjot , ki long mynta ki jaka shong briew bad ki jaka ba la ker kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ong , Kane ka ri kaba la jot ka la kylla long kum ka kper Eden bad ki nongbah kiba la jot bad kiba la jot ki kylla long kiba la ker sawdong bad ki la shong .

en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine , neither let her drink wine or strong drink , nor eat any unclean thing : all that I commanded her let her observe .
kha: Kam dei ban bam ïa kano kano kaba mih na u dieng sohwaiñ ; kam dei ban dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid . Ka dei ban leh ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la ong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kam lah ban bam ia kaei kaei kaba wan na u sohjew, lymne wat ai ba kan dih wain ne ka jingdih kaba khlain, lymne ban bam ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid: baroh kaba nga la hukum ia ka to ai ba kan peit ia ka .

en: Even the very dust of your city , which cleaveth on us , we do wipe off against you : notwithstanding be ye sure of this , that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
kha: ‘ Wat ïa u pui pui na ka shnong jong phi uba dambit ha ki kjat jong ngi , ngi ñiad noh pyrshah ïa phi . Hynrei kynmaw ba ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia ka dewmet jong ka shnong jong phi kaba la tyrkhong ha ngi, ngi sait ia phi: wat la phi sngewskhem ia kane, ba ka hima U Blei ka wan hajan jong phi .

en: And Moses spake before the  Lord  , saying , Behold , the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me  ; how then shall Pharaoh hear me , who am of uncircumcised lips ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Wat ki Israel ruh kim shym sngap ïa nga , u Pharaoh lei shano un sngap ? Nga dei u briew uba duna ka ktien ka thylliej .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha khmat U Trai, u da ong: Ha khmih ki khun Israel kim shym la sngap ia nga ; kumno te u Pharaoh un iohsngew ia nga uba long na ki rmiang shyntur ki bym pat tyrkhong ?

en: And when the men of Ashdod saw that it was so , they said , The ark of the God of Israel shall not abide with us : for his hand is sore upon us , and upon Dagon our god .
kha: Haba ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba jia , ki ong ,  U Blei ki Israel u pynshitom ïa ngi bad ïa u Dagon u blei jong ngi . Ngin ym shah shuh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ban don sah hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Ashdod ki la iohi ba ka long kumta, ki la ong: Ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel kan ym kohnguh ia ngi: namar ka kti jong u ka long kaba pang halor jong ngi bad halor u blei jong ngi .

en: I say then , Have they stumbled that they should fall ? God forbid : but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles , for to provoke them to jealousy .
kha: Nga kylli te : Haba ki Jiw ki jynthut , hato ki hap sha ka jingjot jong ki ? Em , ym kumta ! Namar ki la leh pop , ka jingpynim ka la wan sha ki Jentil , ban pynlong ïa ki Jiw ban bishni ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong te , Hato ki la ia tyngkhuh ba kin hap ? U Blei u la khang: hynrei kham bha lyngba ka jinghap jong ki ka la wan sha ki Jutang , namar ban pynkhih ia ki ban sngewsih .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , Concerning the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , even these are my feasts .
kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki Jingkhawai Niam , haba ki paid Israel ki ïalumlang ban mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki , Shaphang ki jingkhawai jong U Trai kiba phin pynbna ba ki long ki jingkhawai bakhuid jong nga .

en: So being affectionately desirous of you , we were willing to have imparted unto you , not the gospel of God only , but also our own souls , because ye were dear unto us .
kha: Namar ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi , ngi la long kiba la kloi ban ïabynta bad phi ym tang ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei hynrei wat ïa ka jingim jong ngi ruh . Phi la long kiba ieit thep mynsiem eh jong ngi!
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ngi kwah eh ia phi, ngi la mon sngewbha ban ai ha phi, ym tang ia ka gospel U Blei hynrei wat ia la ka jong ka mynsiem ruh namar ba phi la ieit eh ia ngi .

en: And the messenger said unto David , Surely the men prevailed against us , and came out unto us into the field , and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate .
kha: U ong ,  Ki nongshun jong ngi ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi , bad ki la wan mih shabar na kata ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ngi ha madan , hynrei ngi beh krad biang ïa ki sha ka khyrdop shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor u la ong ha u Dabid, Hooid ki briew ki la jop ia ngi, bad ki la mih sha ngi sha lyngkha , bad ngi la don halor jong ki haduh ka jingrung jong ka khyrdop .

en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women , and all that could hear with understanding , upon the first day of the seventh month .
kha: Kumta u Esra u wanrah ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang — ki rangbah , ki kynthei bad ki khynnah kiba la san kiba la lah ban sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esra u lyngdoh u la wanrah ia ka hukum ha khmat ka jingiaseng shynrang bad kynthei bad baroh kiba lah ban iohsngew da ka jingsngewthuh, ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai kaba hynriew .

en: And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .
kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka snam na ki dabor bad u synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi , mynba u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ka snam bad u la theh ia ka ha ki briew bad u la ong: Ha khmih ka snam jong ka jutang kaba U Trai u la leh bad phi shaphang kine ki ktien baroh .

en: And Abner said again to Asahel , Turn thee aside from following me : wherefore should I smite thee to the ground ? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother ?
kha: Sa shisien u Abner u ong ha u ,  Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! Balei men pynbor ïa nga ba ngan pynïap ïa me ? Kumno shuh ngan dang nud ban peit ïa ka khmat u Joab u hynmen jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u la ong biang ia u Asahel, To phai noh na kaba bud ia nga: namar kata nga dei ban pynkhih ia me sha khyndew ? kumno te nga dei ban bat ia ka khmat jong nga sha u Joab hynmen jong me ?

en: And in mercy shall the throne be established : and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David , judging , and seeking judgment , and hasting righteousness .
kha: Nangta uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid un long syiem , bad un synshar ïa ki briew da ka jingïaineh bad ka jingieit . Un long uba kloi ban leh ïa kaba dei , bad un khmih ba yn leh ïa ka jingbishar hok . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingisynei yn pynskhem ia ka khet: bad un shong halor jong ka ha ka jingshisha ha ka iingjain u Dabid , da kaba bishar bad wad ia ka jingbishar bad ka jingkwah ia ka hok .

en: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
kha: U Jisu u dang kren haba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la wan poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren, u Judas, uwei na ki shiphew ngut, u la wan bad u da u paidbah uba bun bad ki wait bad ki diengduh na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ki briew .

en: For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .
kha: Haba ki bet ïa ka lyer , kin ïoh ot ïa ka  erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat ih un ym lah ban pynmih kpu . Hynrei wat lada u pynmih ruh , ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la bet ia ka Iyer, bad kin kheit ia ka lyer kaba rkhie bein: kam don jingbam: u bud un ym ai jingbam: lada ka long kumta , ki nongwei kin bam ia ka .

en: As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ki nongbah kiba mynta ki don ha ka jingjot kin sa dap da ki paidbah kumba ka Jerusalem shisien ka ju dap da ki langbrot ba la wanrah kum ki jingkñia ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ka kynhun bakhuid ka long ka kynhun jong ka Jerusalem ha ki jingkhawai niam jong ka: bad kin tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonglam lynti kiba matlah ! Phi hikai , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka ksiar hapoh ka Templ , u long uba la shah teh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ia phi, phi ki nongpyniaid kiba matlah, kiba ong , Uno uno u ban smai da ka tempi , kam long ei ei ; hynrei uno uno uba smai da ka ksiar jong ka tempi , u long u nongkit ram !

en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :
kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ba sha Sepngi ,  Da shisha phi ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phi ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la kren ha ka iing u Joseph, wat ha Ephraim bad ha Manasseh, u da ong: Me long u briew uba khraw bad me don ka bor kaba khraw: me ym don tang kawei ka bynta:

en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .
kha: Haei ken kata ka jingkyrkhu ka ba phi la ong ? Nga hi nga lah ban ong ba phin da la khlaw noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lada phi lah , bad ban ai noh ïa ki ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ka jingkyrkhu kaba phi la kren ? namar nga kit ia phi, ba lada ka la long kaba lah, phi la ju ot noh ia la ki jong ki khmat bad phi la ai ia ki ha nga .

en: And they set the priests in their divisions , and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God , which is at Jerusalem  ; as it is written in the book of Moses .
kha: Ki la buh ryntih ruh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ka jingshakri ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem , kat kum ki jingbthah bad don ha ka kitab u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki buh ia ki lyngdoh ha ki bynta jong ki, bad ki Lebi ha ki jaka jong ki, na ka bynta ka jingshakri U Blei kaba don ha Jerusalem ; kumba la thoh ha ka kot u Moses .

en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .
kha: U briew uba la ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u dei ban phong da ki jaiñjot , un ieh khlem sad ïa la u shñiuh , un tap ïa la ka khmat naduh ki rmiang shyntur sharum , bad un pyrta ,  U bymkhuid , u bymkhuid !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongpang sniehdoh ha uba ka khlam ka don, ki jain jong u kin tyrkhong bad ka khlieh jong u kan tyrkhong bad un buh ia ka jingtap ha ka shyntur ba shalor jong u, bad un pyrta, U bymkhuid, u bymkhuid .

en: The Lord then answered him , and said ,  Thou hypocrite , doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall , and lead him away to watering ?
kha: U Trai u la jubab ïa u ,  Me uba arsap ! Uno uno na phi un law ïa la u masi dab lane ïa la ka kada na ka sem bad ïalam shabar ban ai um ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai nangta u la jubab ia u , bad u la ong , Me uba arsap , hato uwei pa uwei na phi ha ka sngi saitjain um u pyllait ia u masi ne ka tdong jong u na ka stall , bad u ialam noh ia u sha ka um ?

en: For he received from God the Father honour and glory , when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
kha: Ngi la don hangta mynba la ai ïa ka burom bad ïa ka jingpyndonburom ha u da U Blei uba U Kpa , haba ka sur ka la wan sha u na ka Burom Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , kaba ong ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit jong nga hi , ha uba nga sngewbha eh !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la ioh na U Blei ia ka burom bad ka burom jong u Kpa, haba ka la wan kum kata ka sur ha u na ka burom kaba khraw , Une u long U Khun baieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha shibun .

en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .
kha: Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit bneng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbam bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh um shym la iehnoh ia lade khlem sakhi, ha kaba u la leh bha, bad u la ai slap ia ngi na bneng, bad ki aiom ba seisoh , da kaba pyndap ia ki dohnud jong ngi da ka jingbam bad ka jingkmen .

en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .
kha: Phi shahshitom lem bad ki koidi , bad haba ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la shah kurup , phi la shah ïa la ka jingduh da kaba kmen , namar phi la tip ba phi la ïoh kam kynti shibun kiei kiei kiba kham bha , kiba neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la sngewsynei ia nga ha ki jingteh jong nga, bad phi la shim da ka jingkmen ia ka jingpynjot ia ki mar jong phi, da kaba tip ha lade ba phi don ha bneng ia ka jinglong kaba kham bha bad kaba neh .

en: And Cornelius said , Four days ago I was fasting until this hour  ; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house , and , behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing ,
kha: U Kornelios u la ong ,  Ka la long kumba ha kane ka por lai sngi mynshuwa ba nga dang duwai ha ka ïing jong nga ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi . Kynsan u briew uba riam ha ki jaiñ kiba phyrnai u la ïeng ha khmat jong nga , bad u la ong :
translated_en_to_kha: U Kornellius u la ong , Saw sngi mynshuwa nga la shah jingit haduh kane ka kynta ; bad ha ka por hynniew baje nga la duwai ha iing jong nga bad , ha khmih , uwei u briew u la ieng ha khmat jong nga da ki jain kiba shai .

en: And then the coast turneth to Ramah , and to the strong city Tyre  ; and the coast turneth to Hosah  ; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib :
kha: Nangta u pud u khun sha Ramah , u da poi ha Tyros , ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta u khun sha Hosah bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ka kynthup ïa ka Mahalab , ka Akhsib ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta ka rud duriaw ka phai sha Ramah , bad sha ka shnong kaba skhem Tir ; bad ka rud duriaw ka phai sha Hosah ; bad ki jingleit jong ka ki long ha duriaw naduh rud duriaw haduh Achzib:

en: And in the latter time of their kingdom , when the transgressors are come to the full , a king of fierce countenance , and understanding dark sentences , shall stand up .
kha: Haba ka jingkut jong kito ki hima ka la jan bad ki la long bymman katta katta ba ki la dei ban shah pynshitom , yn don u syiem uba mutlop , uba runar eh , bad uba dap da ka jingshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por kaba khatduh jong ka hima jong ki, haba ki nongleh kam sniew ki wan sha ka jingdap , u syiem uba shyrkhei bad uba sngewthuh ia ki sentens kiba dum , un ieng .

en: And it came to pass after this , that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob : then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph , which was of the sons of the giant .
kha: Hadien kane , la don ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , ha kaba u Sibbekai uba na Hushah u la pynïap ïa u ramhah uba kyrteng u Saph .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka la jia ba ka la don biang ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob: nangta u Sibeka u la pyniap ia u Saph uba long na ki khun shynrang .

en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .
kha: Ko phi ki briew bym lah shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïalang lok bad ka pyrthei ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno uno uba kwah ban pynlong lok bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa lade u nongshun jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki nongleh be-ijot bad ki nongleh be-ijot , phim tip ba ka jingiadei paralok jong ka pyrthei ka long kaba sniew bad U Blei ? uno uno uba long u paralok jong ka pyrthei u long u nongshun jong U Blei .

en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa tymmen u shim ïa kata ka metïap bad u kyntiew ïa ka halor ka kada , bad u leit kit pat ïa ka sha Bethel ban ïam sngewsih bad ban tep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongiathuhlypa u la shim ia ka met jong u briew jong U Blei, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka kada, bad u la wanrah biang ia ka: bad u nongiathuhlypa barim u la wan sha ka nongbah ban iam bad ban tep ia u .

en: Because that , when they knew God , they glorified him not as God , neither were thankful ; but became vain in their imaginations , and their foolish heart was darkened .
kha: Ki tip ïa U Blei , hynrei kim ai ïa u ka burom kaba dei ka jong u , lymne kim shym sngewnguh ïa u . Pynban , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki la long ki bym don jingmut ei ei , bad ïa ki jingmut ba-thylli jong ki la pyndap da ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata, haba ki la ithuh ia U Blei, kim shym la burom ia u kum U Blei, lymne kim shym la sngewnguh hynrei ki la kylla long kiba lehnohei ha ki jingmutdur jong ki, bad ka dohnud bieit jong ki ka la dum .

en: Be strong , and quit yourselves like men , O ye Philistines , that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews , as they have been to you : quit yourselves like men , and fight .
kha: Long shlur , ko ki Philistia ! Ïaleh kum ki rangbah , lym kumta ngin kylla long ki mraw ha kine ki Hebru , kumba ma ki , ki la long ki mraw jong ngi . Kumta to ïaleh kum ki rangbah !
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba khlain bad iehnoh ia lade kum ki briew, ko Philistia, ba phin ym long ki shakri ia ki Hebru kumba ki la long ha phi: iehnoh ia lade kum ki briew bad ialeh .

en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .
kha: Uno uno uba dei ban shah kem un shah kem da shisha ; uno uno uba dei ban shah pynïap da ka waitlam un shah pynïap shisha da ka waitlam . Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingïaishah bad ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ialam sha ka jingshah set phatok un leit sha ka jingshah set phatok: uta uba pyniap da ka waitlam u dei ban shah pyniap da ka waitlam . Hangne ka don ka jingshaniah bad ka jingngeit jong ki riewkhuid .

en: And they said , Thy servants are twelve brethren , the sons of one man in the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , the youngest is this day with our father , and one is not .
kha: Ki ong ,  Kynrad , baroh ngi ïadon khat-ar ngut shi para , ki khun jong ujuh u briew ha ka ri Kanaan . Uwei u para u la ïap , bad uba khatduh u don mynta bad i pa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ki shakri jong me ki long shiphew ngut ki hynmen, ki khun shynrang ha ka ri Kanaan ; bad ha khmih uba rit tam u don ha kane ka sngi bad u kpa jong ngi bad uwei um long .

en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;
kha: To hukum ïa kita kiba riewspah ha kiei kiei jong kane ka jingim ba kin ym sngewsarong , hynrei ban buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki , ym ha kata kaei kaei ka bym thikna kum ka spah , hynrei ha U Blei , uba ai kyrhai ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia kito kiba riewspah ha kane ka pyrthei , ba kim long kiba heh mynsiem , lymne kiba shaniah ha ki spah bym thikna , hynrei ha U Blei uba im , uba ai ia ngi da kaba riewspah ia kiei kiei baroh ban sngewbha ; .

en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?
kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi dei ban leh ïa kijuh ki pop kiba ki kpa jong phi ki la leh bad ba phi ïabud nadien ki bleithaw jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ka iing Israel , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Phi la shah pynjakhlia katkum ka rukom jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ? bad phi leh ia ka kam kaba sniew hadien ki jingleh bymman jong ki ?

en: Moreover I said unto the king , If it please the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river , that they may convey me over till I come into Judah  ;
kha: Nangta nga kyrpad ïa u ban lehsbun ïa nga da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha ki lat ka Probins    Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi , da kaba bthah ïa ki ban shah ïa nga ban ïaid lyngba sha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata nga la ong ha u syiem , Lada ka mon ia u syiem , to ai ba ngan ai shithi sha ki Lat sha shiliang wah , ba kin pynpoi ia nga haduh ba ngan da poi ha Judah ; .

en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans , and dwelt in Charran : and from thence , when his father was dead , he removed him into this land , wherein ye now dwell .
kha: Bad kumta u la iehnoh ïa la ka ri bad u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Haran . Hadien ba u kpa jong u Abraham u la ïap , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban kynriah sha kane ka jaka ha kaba phi mynta phi shong phi sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la mih na ka ri jong ki Khaldes , bad u la shong ha Charran : bad nangta haba u kpa jong u u la iap , u la weng noh ia u sha kane ka ri , ha kaba phi shong mynta .

en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .
kha: Ki la phai dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai hikai ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh jinghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki la phai sha nga da ka tyrpeng, bad ym ia ka khmat: wat la nga la hikai ia ki, da kaba khie dang step bad hikai ia ki, hynrei kim shym la sngap ban ioh jinghikai .

en: O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .
kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , naba ngim lah leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jong kane ka kynhun shipai babun paid kaba tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Ngim tip kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi phai sha me na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Blei jong ngi, hato men ym bishar ia ki ? namar ngim don bor pyrshah ia kane ka kynhun kaba khraw kaba wan pyrshah ia ngi ; bad ngim tip aiu ban leh: hynrei ki khmat jong ngi ki don ha me .

en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki nongsynshar jong ki bymngeit blei ki donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ka iktiar ba-pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la khot ia ki ha u bad u la ong: Phi tip ba ki rangbah jong ki Jutang ki synshar halor jong ki, bad kita kiba don ka bor kaba khraw halor jong ki .

en: So now it was not you that sent me hither , but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .
kha: Kumta ym dei shisha ma phi kiba la phah ïa nga shane , hynrei U Blei hi . U la pynlong ïa nga u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh . Nga dei u nongkhmih ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei ; nga long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta mynta ym dei ma phi uba la phah ia nga hangne, hynrei U Blei: bad u la pynlong ia nga u kpa ia u Pharaoh, bad u kynrad jong ka iing jong u baroh kawei, bad u nongsynshar ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
kha: ngan kynmaw ïa la ka kular ha phi bad ha ki mrad baroh ba ka jingshlei um da lei lei ruh kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan kynmaw ia ka jutang jong nga kaba don hapdeng jong nga bad phi bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba im jong ka doh baroh; bad ki um kin ym kylla long shuh ka jingshlei um ban pynjot ia ka doh baroh .

en: Likewise , ye wives , be in subjection to your own husbands  ; that , if any obey not the word , they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives  ;
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ki kynthei , to da pynkohnguh ïa lade ha la ki tnga , khnang ba lada don uno uno napdeng jong ki , ki bymngeit ïa ka ktien U Blei , ka jinglong jingim jong phi kan jop ïa ki ban ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh phi ki tnga , to long kiba kohnguh ia la ki jong ki tnga ; ba lada uno uno um kohnguh ia ka ktien , ki ruh ki lah ban jop khlem ka ktien da ka jingiakren jong ki tnga ; .

en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it , when ye have heaved from it the best of it : neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel , lest ye die .
kha: Haba phi la wanrah ïa kaba bha tam sha U  Trai  , phim long kiba shah rem haba phi bam ïa ka . Hynrei da sumar ban ym pyntngit ïa ki jingai kiba khuid jong ki Israel da kaba bam ïa kino kino ki jingai shuwa kaba ai ïa kaba bha tam . Lada phi leh kumta , yn pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym kit pop ei ei namar jong ka, haba phi la bam na ka kaba bha tam: lymne phin ym pynjakhlia ia kiei kiei kiba khuid jong ki khun Israel , ioh phin iap .

en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious : but unto them which be disobedient , the stone which the builders disallowed , the same is made the head of the corner ,
kha: Une u maw u long uba kordor eh ïa phi kiba ngeit ; hynrei ha kito ki bymngeit :  U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha phi namarkata uba ngeit u long uba kordor: hynrei ha kito ki bym kohnguh , ia u maw uba ki nongtei ki la shah , ia ujuh la pynlong ia ka khlieh jong ka kut .

en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .
kha: U Samson u ong ha ki ,  Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut kine ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim .  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi ,  ki ong .  To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phim lah ban pynbna ia nga, te phin ai ia nga laiphew tylli ki jain bad laiphew tylli ki jain . Ki la ong ha u: To buh ia ka jingkylli jong me, ba ngin iohsngew ia ka .

en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .
kha: La kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Kpa jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang na u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba u la lah kular . Kaei kaba phi ïohi bad ïohsngew mynta ka long ka jingai sngewbha kaba u la theh noh ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata da ka kti kadiang jong U Blei ka la kiew bad haba u la pdiang na U Kpa ia ka jingkular jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la pynmih ia kane kaba phi iohi mynta bad iohsngew .

en: Then said he unto them ,  But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .
kha: Hynrei mynta ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  uno uno uba don ka pla pisa lane ka pla u dei ban rah ïa ka ; bad uno uno u bym don ka waitlam u dei ban die noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u bad thied kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki, Hynrei mynta, uta uba don ka pla tyngka, un shim ia ka, bad kumjuh ruh ia ka jingthoh jong u: bad uta u bym don waitlam, un die ia ka jain jong u, bad un thied ia kawei .

en: And some cried one thing , some another , among the multitude : and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult , he commanded him to be carried into the castle .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pyrta ïa kawei kaei kaei , kiwei ïa kawei pat . Ka la don ka jingkulmar kaba haduh katta ba u rangbah ai hukum um lah ban tip thikna ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka kut shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don kiba pyrta kawei, kawei pat, hapdeng u paidbah: bad haba um lah ban tip ia ka jingthikna na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin , u la hukum ia u ban shah rah shapoh ka iing syiem .

en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls , and their kings shall minister unto thee : for in my wrath I smote thee , but in my favour have I had mercy on thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ki nongwei kin tei pat ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki syiem jong ki kin shakri ïa pha . Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei mynta ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bad jingisynei jong nga ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ki nongwei kin tei ia ki kynroh jong me, bad ki syiem jong ki kin shakri ia me: namar ha ka jingbitar jong nga nga la sngewsih ia me, hynrei ha ka jingsngewbha jong nga nga la isynei ia me .

en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .
kha: Mynta , nga pynthikna ïa phi ba hangno hangno haba yn ïalap ïa kane ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ïa ka ban kynmaw ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Hangno hangno ba ia kane ka gospel yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei , yn sa iathuh ia kane ruh , ba kane ka kynthei ka la leh , na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw ia ka .

en: And the sons of Judah  ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .
kha: U Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Shelah , u Peres , bad u Serah . ( Kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Judah : u Er bad u Onan ki la ïap noh ha Kanaan ) ; ki khun shynrang jong u Peres ki long u Hesron bad u Hamul .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Judah Er, bad u Onan, bad u Shelah, bad u Pharez: hynrei u Er bad u Onan ki la iap ha ka ri Kanaan . Bad ki khun shynrang jong u Pharez ki long u Hesron bad u Hamul .

en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam , and took cities from him , Beth–el with the towns thereof , and Jeshanah with the towns thereof , and Ephrain with the towns thereof .
kha: U Abijah u beh kthong ïa ka kynhun shipai u Jeroboam bad u ïohknieh katto katne na ki nongbah jong u : ka Bethel , ka Jeshanah , bad ka Ephron , bad ki nongrit kiba hajan jong kine ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abijah u la bud ia u Jeroboan, bad u la shim ia ki shnong na u, u Bethel bad ki shnong jong ka, bad u Jeshaniah bad ki shnong jong ka, bad u Ephrain bad ki shnong jong ka .

en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .
kha: U Saul bad u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren hapdeng jong ki . Hadien kata , u Jonathan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid bad u sngewieit ïa u kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u la dep ban kren ha u Saul , ba ka mynsiem u Jonathan ka la khih bad ka mynsiem u Dabid , bad u Jonathan u la ieit ia u kum ka mynsiem jong u hi .

en: The fierce anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have done it , and until he have performed the intents of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it .
kha: Ka jingbitar jong U  Trai  ka long ka  erïong , ka lyer kaba jur eh ka ban beh kyrthep nalor ki khlieh jong ki bymman . Kan ym kut tad ynda u la pyndep ïa baroh kaba u thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew kin shemphang kdar ïa kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai kan ym wan phai shuh, haduh ba un da leh ia kata, bad haduh ba un da leh ia ka jingthmu jong ka dohnud jong u: ha ki sngi kiba hadien phin pyrkhat ia ka .

en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
kha: U Petros u la kren bad ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin thaw noh lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei ïa me , kawei ïa u Moses , bad kawei ïa u Elijah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la jubab bad u la ong ha U Jisu, Ko Nonghikai, ka long kaba bha ia ngi ban don hangne : bad to ngin ia leh lai tylli ki Tabernak uwei na ka bynta jong me, bad uwei na ka bynta u Moses bad uwei na ka bynta u Elias .

en: Then Daniel requested of the king , and he set Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , over the affairs of the province of Babylon : but Daniel sat in the gate of the king .
kha: Ha ka jingkyrpad jong u Daniel , u syiem u la buh ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ban khmih ïa ka jingpynïaid kam jong ka probins jong ka Babilon ; hynrei u Daniel u la don ha ka ïingbishar jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la kyrpad ia u syiem, bad u la buh ia u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego, halor ki kam jong ka ri Babilon: hynrei u Daniel u la shong ha ka khyrdop jong u syiem .

en: And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people  ; there remained not one .
kha: bad U  Trai  ruh u leh kumba u Moses u la kyrpad . Ki skain ki phet noh na u Pharaoh , na ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad na ki briew jong u ; wat tang uwei ruh um sah shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leh kat kum ka ktien u Moses bad u la weng noh ia ki khnai na u Pharaoh, na ki shakri jong u, bad na ki briew jong u; ym don shuh shuh .

en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , saying ,
kha: U Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u la phah ïa u Pashhur , u khun jong u Malkhaïah , bad ïa u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Maaseïah , sha nga lem bad kane ka jingkyrpad :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha u Jeremaiah na U Trai, haba u syiem Sedekaiah u la phah sha u Pasur u khun u Malhijah bad u Sephaniah u khun u Maesaiah u lyngdoh u la ong:

en: And he saw that there was no man , and wondered that there was no intercessor : therefore his arm brought salvation unto him  ; and his righteousness , it sustained him .
kha: U lyngngoh ban ïohi ba ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa kiba shah banbeiñ . Kumta un pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka bor ban pyllait im ïa ki bad wanrah ïa ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ba ym don briew, bad u la lyngngoh ba ym don u nongkyrshan: namarkata ka kti jong u ka la wanrah ia ka jingpynim ha u ; bad ka hok jong u, ka la pynskhem ia u .

en: Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .
kha: Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri ,  Ha khmih , ka lyngkha u Joab ka don markhap bad ka jong nga , bad ka don u barli uba mih ha ka . Khie leit bad wiang ding ïa ka .  Kumta ki la leit bad wiang ding ïa ka lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, Peit, ka lyngkha Joab ka don hajan jong nga, bad u don u barli hangta; u leit thang ia ka . Bad ki shakri jong u Absalom ki thang ia ka lyngkha .

en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?
kha: Namar U Blei um shym la ong ha uno uno na ki angel jong u ,  Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .  Lymne U Blei um shym la ong shaphang uno uno u angel ,  Ngan long U Kpa u jong u bad un long u khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jongno na ki angel u la ong ha kano kano ka por , Me long u Khun jong nga ? Bad sa shisien ruh , ngan long ha u u Kpa bad un long ha nga u Khun ?

en: If the wicked restore the pledge , give again that he had robbed , walk in the statutes of life , without committing iniquity  ; he shall surely live , he shall not die .
kha: kum ka nuksa , lada u pynphai noh ïa ka bynda ba u shim ïa ka ram lane u pynphai noh ïa kaei ba u la tuh — lada u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u bud ïa ki aiñ kiba ai jingim , un ym ïap hynrei un im .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u bymman u pynphai biang ia ka jingkular , to ai biang ia kata kaba u la lute , to iaid ha ki ain jong ka jingim , khlem da leh ia ka jingbymhok ; un im shisha , un ym iap .

en: I applied mine heart to know , and to search , and to seek out wisdom , and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly , even of foolishness and madness :
kha: Hynrei nga la pynleit ïa lade ha ka jingtip bad ha ka jingpule bniah ; nga la kut jingmut ban shem ïa ka jingstad bad ïa ki jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong nga , bad ban tip haduh katno ka jingtasngeng ka long kaba sniew bad kaba bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlut ia ka dohnud jong nga ban tip , bad ban wad , bad ban wad ia ka jingstad bad ka daw jong kiei kiei , bad ban tip ia ka jingsniew jong ka jinglong bieit bad ka jinglong bieit:

en: He that hath not given forth upon usury , neither hath taken any increase , that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity , hath executed true judgment between man and man ,
kha: Um ju ai pisa kylliang na ka bynta ban ïohnong . U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad u ai ka jingrai kaba beit ha kano kano ka jingïakajia .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u bym shym la ai ia ka jingmyntoi , bad u bym shym la shim ia ka jingkiew , uba la weng noh ia la ka kti na ka jingbymhok , u la pyndep ia ka jingbishar kaba shisha hapdeng u briew bad u briew .

en: Therefore will he give them up , until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth : then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel .
kha: Kumta , U  Trai  un sa aiti noh ïa la ki briew sha ki nongshun jong ki haduh ba ka briew ka ban sa kha kan ïoh ïa u khun jong ka . Nangta kito ki paid Israel kiba dang don ha ka jingshah ringmraw kin wan ïasoh lang bad ki briew la jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata un aiti noh ia ki, haduh ka por ba kata ka la kha: nangta ki hynmen jong u kin wan phai biang sha ki khun Israel .

en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister s name was Maachah  ; ) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .
kha: U Makhir u pynïoh kawei ka tnga ïa u Huppim bad kawei pat ïa u Shuppim . Ka para jong u ka kyrteng ka Maakah . U khun uba ar jong u Makhir u dei u Selophehad , bad u don tang ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Machir u la shim ia ka para jong u Huppim bad u Shuppim, ka kyrteng jong ka ka long Maachach ; ) bad ka kyrteng jong kaba ar ka long ka Selophehad: bad u Selophehad u don ki khun kynthei .

en: And we said , We cannot go down : if our youngest brother be with us , then will we go down : for we may not see the man s face , except our youngest brother be with us .
kha: Ngi ïa-ong , ‘ Ngim lah ban leit , namar yn ym shah ïa ngi ban leit ha khmat uta u rangbah lymda u para khatduh jong ngi u leit lang bad ngi . Ngin leit tang lada u para khatduh jong ngi un leit ryngkat bad ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la ong: Ngim lah ban hiar: lada u hynmen barit jong ngi u don ryngkat bad ngi: te ngin hiar: namar ngim lah ban iohi ia u briew uba rit tam jong ngi .

en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice , and sent to Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , the son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us see one another in the face .
kha: U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah bad ki nongai jingmut jong u ki la ïasylla pyrshah ïa ka Israel . Kumta u la phah khubor sha u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Jehoahas bad u ksiew jong u Jehu , da kaba kob ïa u ban ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Amasaiah u syiem Judah u la shim jingmut bad u la phah sha u Joash u khun u Jehuoh u syiem Israel da kaba ong: To wan, to ngin ia peit iwei ia iwei pat ha khmat .

en: The kings of the earth , and all the inhabitants of the world , would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem .
kha: Ym don mano mano hangno hangno , ym don wat ki nongsynshar jong ki hima nongwei , kiba la ngeit ba uno uno u nonghiarthma un lah ban rung lyngba ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem jong ka khyndew bad ki nongshong shnong baroh jong ka pyrthei , kin ym ngeit ba u nongshun bad u nongshun ki la dei ban rung sha ki khyrdop Jerusalem .

en: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest , and ye shall afflict your souls : in the ninth day of the month at even , from even unto even , shall ye celebrate your sabbath .
kha: Naduh ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba khyndai haduh ka por sep sngi ha ka sngi kaba shiphew , rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi shongthait kaba kyrpang . Hapoh kata ka por , phim bit ban bam ei ei ruh em .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan long ha phi ka sngi shongthait jong phi: ha ka sngi kaba hynniew jong u bnai ha ka por janmiet , naduh ka por janmiet , phin rakhe ia ka sngi shongthait jong phi .

en: And the winepress was trodden without the city , and blood came out of the winepress , even unto the horse bridles , by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs .
kha: Ïa ki sohwaiñ la khñiot ha ka jaka khñiot waiñ shabar ka nongbah , bad ka snam ka la mihnoh na ka jaka khñiot waiñ ha ka jingshlei kumba laispah kilomitar ka jingjrong bad la jan ar mitar ka jingjylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpynkhluit wain ka la iaid shabar jong ka nongbah, bad ka snam ka la mih na ka jingpynkhluit wain, wat haduh ki bniat kulai, da ka jaka kaba jrong shihajar hynriew spah tylli ki bniat .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki bri sohwaiñ babha , kawei kawei ka don shihajar tylli ki dieng sohwaiñ bad kawei kawei ka shongdor shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , kin shlei da ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba kawei pa kawei ka jaka kan long, ha kaba ki don shi hajar tylli ki sohjew hajar tylli ki sboh rupa, kan long wat na ka bynta ki soh bad ki tnat .

en: That he may incline our hearts unto him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .
kha: to un pynlong ïa ngi kiba kohnguh ïa u ba ngin lah ban im borabor kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , bad ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un pynkhih ia ki dohnud jong ngi ha u, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u baroh , bad ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u bad ki ain jong u bad ki jingbishar jong u kiba u la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .

en: And Saul said unto Samuel , I have sinned : for I have transgressed the commandment of the  Lord  , and thy words : because I feared the people , and obeyed their voice .
kha: Ho-oid , nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ngam shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ïa ki jingsneng pyn-i jong phi . Nga la sheptieng ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad nga la leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u Samuel: namar nga la pynkhein ia ka hukum U Trai bad ki ktien jong me: namar nga la tieng ia ki briew bad nga la kohnguh ia ka sur jong ki .

en: No man taketh it from me , but I lay it down of myself . I have power to lay it down , and I have power to take it again . This commandment have I received of my Father .
kha: Ym don u ban shim noh ïa ka jingim jong nga na nga . Nga aiti ïa ka da la ka mon sngewbha hi . Nga don ka hok ban aiti noh ïa ka , bad nga don ka hok ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u la hukum ïa nga ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ba shim ia ka na nga , hynrei nga la buh ia ka na nga hi . Nga don ka bor ban buh ia ka shapoh bad nga don ka bor ban shim biang ia ka . Kane ka hukum nga la ioh na U Kpa jong nga .

en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
kha: Ki briew kin aiti noh ïa la ki hynmen ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khun ki ïeng pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin aiti ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u hynmen un die noh ia u hynmen haduh ka jingiap , bad u kpa u khun beg bad ki khun kin ieng pyrshah ia ki kmie ki kpa jong ki , bad kin pynlong ia ki ban shah pyniap .

en: And it shall be , when ye have taken the city , that ye shall set the city on fire : according to the commandment of the  Lord  shall ye do . See , I have commanded you .
kha: Ynda phi la kurup ïa ka nongbah , thang ïa ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kine ki long ki hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, ynda phi la shim ia ka shnong, ba phin thang ia ka shnong: kat kum ka hukum U Trai phin leh . Peit , nga la hukum ia phi .

en: See now that I , even I , am he , and there is no god with me : I kill , and I make alive  ; I wound , and I heal : neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand .
kha: ‘ Nga , bad tang ma nga hi , nga long U Blei ; ym don uwei pat u blei uba shisha . Nga pynïap bad nga ai jingim , nga pynmong bad nga pynkoit , bad ym don uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa kaei ba nga leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit mynta ba nga, wat ma nga ruh, bad ym don blei bad nga: nga pyniap, bad nga pynim ia nga; bad nga pynkoit: ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pyllait na ka kti jong nga .

en: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
kha: Naba ïa ki nongsynshar ym dei ban sheptieng da kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei da kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u briew uba don ha ka bor ? Te to leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki nongsynshar kim long ka jingtieng ia ki kam kiba bha, hynrei ia kiba sniew . Hato me ym tieng ia ka bor ? leh ia kaba bha bad me dei ban ioh ia ka jingiaroh ia kajuh:

en: And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .
kha: Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongïalam ,  Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa ngi da ka jingjngai uwei na uwei pat ha ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha ki riew rangbah bad ha ki nongsynshar bad ha kiwei pat ki briew , Ka kam ka long kaba khraw bad kaba heh , bad ngi la pyniakhlad ha ka kynroh , kawei na kawei pat .

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Though Moses and Samuel stood before me , yet my mind could not be toward this people : cast them out of my sight , and let them go forth .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Wat lada u Moses bad u Samuel kin ïeng hangne ban ïasaid bad nga , ngan ym pyn-i jingisynei ei ei ïa kine ki briew . Pynlong ïa ki ban leit noh ; pynlong ïa ki ban phet noh na khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga , Wat la u Moses bad u Samuel ki ieng ha khmat jong nga , hynrei ka jingmut jong nga kam lah ban long shaphang une u briew: bret noh ia ki na ka khmat jong nga , bad pyllait noh ia ki .

en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .
kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , bad ki la ong ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka ri shyiap ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u Moses bad u Aaron ki la rung shapoh bad ki la ong ha u Pharaoh , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u ong: To ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit noh, ba kin leh ia ka jingkhawai ha nga ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And Samuel said unto the people , Fear not : ye have done all this wickedness : yet turn not aside from following the  Lord  , but serve the  Lord  with all your heart  ;
kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Wat sheptieng ; la phi la leh ïa ka kam bymman , wat phai noh na U  Trai  , hynrei shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
