translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha ki briew: Wat tieng: phi la leh ia kane ka jingsniew baroh: hynrei wat phai noh na kaba bud ia U Trai , hynrei to shakri ia U Trai da ka dohnud baroh;

en: And thus shall ye eat it  ; with your loins girded , your shoes on your feet , and your staff in your hand  ; and ye shall eat it in haste : it is the  Lord s  passover .
kha: Phi dei ban ïabam kyrkieh ïa ka , namar phi dei ban riam na ka bynta ban leit jingleit , lem bad ki juti ha ki kjat jong phi bad u diengduh ha ka kti jong phi . Ka dei ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa nga , U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta phin bam ia ka ; da ki tyrpeng jong phi, bad u diengduh jong phi ha ka kti jong phi ; bad phin bam ia ka da kaba kyrkieh: ka long ka jingkhawai Niam U Trai .

en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts : and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear :
kha: Hynrei to tiengburom ïa U Khrist ha ki dohnud jong phi , bad pyndonburom ïa u kum U Trai . To long kiba la kloi ha ki por baroh ban ai ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kylli ïa phi ban batai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba don ha phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei pynkyntang ia U Trai Blei ha ki dohnud jong phi: bad to long kiba kloi beit ban ai jubab ia uwei pa uwei u briew uba kylli ia phi ia ka daw jong ka jingkyrmen kaba don ha phi da ka jingjemnud bad ka jingtieng:

en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God s sake ,
kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing lane ïa ka tnga lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa ki kmie ki kpa lane ïa ki khun na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Hooid nga ong ha phi, Ym don briew uba la iehnoh ia ka iing ne ki kmie ki kpa ne ki hynmen ne ki khun na ka bynta ka hima U Blei .

en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar tang lai bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem . U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoichin u la don 8 snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar lai bnai shi sngi ha Jerusalem : bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .
kha: Un pyrshah ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la khot blei , lane ïa kano kano ban mane , bad un buh ïa lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung bad shong hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad kam ba u long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba pyrshah bad pynkhraw ia lade halor kiei kiei baroh kiba la khot U Blei, ne kiba la mane; kumta u long uba la mane; kumta u long uba la mane;

en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks , two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams ,
kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u langbrot ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ki kan long kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang, lai tylli ki masi na ki shiphew tylli ki masi , ar tylli ki masi na ki ar tylli ki langbrot .

en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb  ; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot . Kine ki jingainguh thang ki dei ki jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne ka shini kaba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang na ka bynta ka jingknia doh sha uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia ba la thang da ka jingsma kaba thiang, ka jingknia kaba la shna da ka ding sha U Trai .

en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .
kha: Baroh ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel , bad na ka bynta kane , nga sngewkmen shibun shaphang jong phi . Nga kwah ïa phi ban long kiba stad shaphang kaei kaba bha , hynrei ban long lui lui ha kaei kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingsngap jong phi ka wan shabar sha ki briew baroh . Nga sngewbha namarkata na ka bynta jong phi: hynrei nga kwah ba phin long kiba stad ha kata kaba bha bad kaba suk shaphang ka jingsniew .

en: The blind receive their sight , and the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , and the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have the gospel preached to them .
kha: kiba matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , ïa kito kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh la pynkhuid , kiba kyllut ki ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap la pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba matlah ki ioh ia ka jingpeit jong ki, bad kiba lyngkhuid ki iaid , bad kiba sngap jar ki iohsngew , ia kiba iap la pynmihpat , bad kiba duk ki la ialap ia ka gospel ha ki .

en: And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .
kha: U syiem u kylli ,  Kumno ngi la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u Mordekai na ka bynta kane ?  Ki shakri jong u ki jubab ,  Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , Kaei ka burom bad ka burom kaba la leh ia u Mordecai na ka bynta kane ? Nangta u la ong ki shakri syiem kiba la shakri ia u: Ym don ei ei na ka bynta jong u .

en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit , and saith ,  Why doth this generation seek after a sign ? verily I say unto you , There shall no sign be given unto this generation .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ud jylliew bad u la ong ,  Balei ba ki briew mynta ki kwah ban ïohi kambah ? Em , nga ong ïa phi ! Yn ym ai kum kata ka jingpynshisha ha kine ki briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ud jylliew ha ka mynsiem jong u, bad u ong, Balei kane ka pateng ka wad ia ka dak ? shisha nga ong ha phi , Ym don dak ei ei ha kane ka pateng .

en: But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .
kha: Khatsaw sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun kynthei , kan long ka bymkhuid kum ha ka por ba ka poi bnai . Nangta kan shim por pat sa hynriewphew hynriew sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka kha khun kynthei, te kan long kaba khlem khuid ar taiew, kumba long ha ka jingpyniakhlad jong ka: bad kan iai bteng ha ka snam jong ka kaba pynkhuid ia ka laiphew hynriew sngi .

en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka tip , ba lada u briew uba bha jong ka iing u la tip ia ka por ba u nongtuh un wan , un jin da la peit , bad um shym la shah ia ka iing jong u ban shah pynpra .

en: And all the people said unto Samuel , Pray for thy servants unto the  Lord  thy God , that we die not : for we have added unto all our sins this evil , to ask us a king .
kha: bad ki ong ha u Samuel ,  A kynrad , to duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi , ba ngin ym ïap . Mynta ngi sngewthuh ba nalor ki pop jong ngi baroh , ngi la leh pop da kaba pan ban ïoh syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ong ha u Samuel , To duwai na ka bynta ki shakri jong me ha U Trai U Blei jong me, ba ngin ym iap: namar ngi la pyndap ia ki pop jong ngi baroh ia kane ka jingsniew, ban pan ia ngi ia u syiem .

en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child , his name was called JESUS , which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb .
kha: Hadien shi taïew , haba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ban otsher ïa u khunlung , la ai kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu , ka kyrteng kaba u angel u la lah ai na ka bynta jong U ha shuwa ba yn pun ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la pyndep 8 sngi na ka bynta ka jingot ia u khynnah , la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u JISU , kaba la jer kyrteng kumta da u angel shuwa ba un kha ha ka kpoh .

en: Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .
kha: Khie leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Amalek , bad pynjot lut khoit kat kaba ki don . Wat pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynïap lut ïa ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi bad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kada baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta leit bad pynjot lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki don, bad wat pyllait ia ki hynrei wat pyniap ia ki baroh arngut ki shynrang bad kynthei, ki khunlung bad ki khun masi bad ki langbrot .

en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
kha: Namar kane , ha ka shi sngi yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khlam — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewsih bad ka  nemsniew . Bad yn thang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Trai uba U Blei , uba bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki khniang jong ka kin wan ha kawei ka sngi, ka jingiap, bad ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingkyrduh bad kan shah thang lut da ka ding: namar u Trai Blei uba bishar ia ka .

en: And with them , by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men : for they had many wives and sons .
kha: Ki ïoh shibun ki tnga bad ki khun , haduh ba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki lah ban pynmih laiphew hynriew hajar ngut ki rangbah na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad ki, da ki pateng jong ki, hadien ka iing jong ki kpa jong ki, ki long ki kynhun shipai na ka bynta ka thma, hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shynrang: namar ki don bun ki tnga bad ki khun shynrang .

en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .
kha: U la sdang ban kren shlur ha ka synagog . Haba ka Priskila bad u Akwila ki la ïohsngew ïa u , ki la ïalam ïa u sha la ïing bad ki la batai ha u kham bniah ïa ka Lynti jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sdang ban kren shlur ha ka synagog : kiba haba u Akhila bad ka Priscilla ki la iohsngew ia u, ki la ialam ia u sha ki, bad ki la batai kham janai ha u ia ka lynti U Blei .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel sin : but he walked therein .
kha: U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai; um shym la leit noh na ki pop baroh jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong pop ia ki Israel: hynrei u la iaid hangta .

en: For , lo , I will command , and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations , like as corn is sifted in a sieve , yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth .
kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad ngan kyrsih ïa ki paid Israel kum ïa u kew . Ngan kyrsih ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ban weng ïa kita baroh ki bymdondor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngan hukum, bad ngan sa khleh ia ka iing Israel hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh, kumba la khleh ia u kew ha ka dewbilat , hynrei wat tang u kew uba rit eh un ym hap ha ka khyndew .

en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the  Lord  , silver , and gold , and vessels .
kha: U buh ha ka templ ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh ïa kiba u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , lem bad ïa ki mar ksiar bad mar rupa ïa kiba u hi u la pynkyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la wanrah ia kiei kiei kiba u kpa jong u u la aiti bad ia kiei kiei kiba u la aiti hi sha ka iing U Trai , ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki tiar .

en: And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .
kha: Nangta ki la ap hangta , bad u Nabal ha kaba khatduh u la jubab ,  U Dabid ? Uei uta ? Ngam pat ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap da ki mraw kiba phet na la ki kynrad !
translated_en_to_kha: U Nabal u la jubab ia ki shakri jong u Dabid bad u la ong, U Dabid u long u Dabid ? bad u khun u Jesse ? ki don bun ki shakri mynta ki sngi kiba pynduh noh ia uwei pa uwei na u kynrad jong u .

en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas , thou filledst many people  ; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise .
kha: Haba ki mar khaïi jong pha ki leit shabar ri , pha pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki hima baroh . la pynriewspah ïa ki syiem da ka spah jong ki mar jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki mar jong me ki la mih na ki duriaw , me la pyndap ia ki syiem jong ka khyndew da ka jingbun ki spah jong me bad ki mar ki mata jong me .

en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .
kha: Kumta nga la rung shapoh bad nga khmih . Ïa ka kynroh la tap da ki jingdro ïa ki dur bseiñ , bad ïa kiwei pat ki mrad bymkhuid , bad ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba ki Israel ki ïamane .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la rung bad nga la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba iaid kai bad ki mrad kiba sngewsih bad ki bleithaw baroh jong ka iing Israel .

en: I denounce unto you this day , that ye shall surely perish , and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land , whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it .
kha: yn pynjot thiaw ïa phi — nga maham ïa phi hangne mynta . Phin ym im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti ha shiliang ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyntait ia phi ha kane ka sngi, ba phin sa jah noh shisha, bad ba phin ym pynjlan ia ki sngi jong phi ha ka ri, ha kaba me iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan ban leit bat ia ka .

en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the  Lord  , and until it was finished . So the house of the  Lord  was perfected .
kha: Ha kum kane ka por la pyndep ïa ki kam ki jam u Solomon baroh . Naduh kaba seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ U  Trai  haduh ka jingpyndep ïa ka , baroh ka kam ka la long kaba jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta baroh ki kam jong u Solomon ki la long kiba la pynkhreh haduh ka sngi jong ka iing U Trai bad haduh ba la dep . Kumta ka iing U Trai ka la long kaba janai .

en: I beseech you , brethren , (ye know the house of Stephanas , that it is the firstfruits of Achaia , and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints ,)
kha: Phi tip shaphang u Stephanas bad ka longïing jong u ; ki long ki Khristan kiba nyngkong eh ha Akhaïa bad ki la aiti ïa lade ïa ka ban shakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia phi ko para bangeit, (phi tip ia ka iing u Stephanas, ba ka long ka soh nyngkong jong ka Akhaia, bad ba ki la ngop ia lade ha ka jingshakri jong ki riewkhuid,).

en: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger , and did eat no meat the second day of the month : for he was grieved for David , because his father had done him shame .
kha: U Jonathan u ïeng noh na kata ka miej ha ka jingbitar bad um shym bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi — ka sngi kaba ar jong ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai . U da khuslai sat shaphang u Dabid , namar u Saul u la pynjahburom ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jonathan u la mih na ka miej ha ka jingbitar kaba jur, bad um shym la bam doh ha ka sngi kaba ar jong u bnai: namar u la sngewsih ia u Dabid namar ba u kpa jong u u la lehrain ia u .

en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .
kha: U Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ïa ki byrni jong ki hynmen shynrang jong u da u kew , bad ban thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka byrni jong u , bad ban ai jingbam de ba kin ïoh bam ha lynti . Ïa kane la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ia ki lyngkhot jong ki da u kew , bad ban pynphai biang ia ka pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka lyngkhot jong u , bad ban ai ia ki ia ka jingbam na ka bynta ka lynti: bad kumta u la leh ia ki .

en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens , and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them .
kha: U buh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ban trei ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki tiar ki tar , bad phraphew hajar ngut ban trei ha kaba tih maw . La don lai hajar hynriewspah ngut kiwei pat kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ban pynïaid ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la iathuh ia ki lai hajar ngut ki briew ban kit ia ki jingkit, bad saw hajar ban leit sha u lum, bad lai hajar hynriew spah ban peit ia ki .

en: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold .  And when he had said these things , he cried ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
kha: Bad katto katne ki symbai ki la hap ha ka khyndew babha ; ki jingthung ki la san bad ki la pynmih symboh , da ki spah symboh uwei uwei .  Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u la hap ha ka khyndew kaba bha, bad u la mih bad u la sei soh shispah shah . Bad haba u la ong ia kine kiei kiei , u la pyrta , Uta uba don ki shkor ban iohsngew , to ai ba un iohsngew .

en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light  ; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops .
kha: Kumta te , ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la ong ha kaba dum yn ïohsngew ha kaba shai ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la pasiaw ha kaba jar jar ha ka kamra ba la khang , yn pyrta na ki tnum ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kaei kaei kaba phi la kren ha ka jingdum yn sa iohsngew ha ka jingshai ; bad ia kaba phi la kren ha ka shkor ha ki kamra ri jingri yn sa pynbna ha ki jingkhang iing .

en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .
kha: U Ahas u shim ïa ki rupa bad ksiar na ka Templ bad na ka ïing jingkynshew ha ïingsyiem bad u phah kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahas u la shim ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba la lap ha ka iing U Trai bad ha ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing syiem bad u la phah ia ka kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Assyria .

en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem  ; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day .
kha: Hynrei ki briew na ka jait Benjamin kim shym la beh noh ïa ki Jebus kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , bad ki Jebus ki dang shong hangta bad ki paid Benjamin naduh kata ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Benjamin kim shym la beh ia ki nong Jebus kiba shong ha Jerusalem hynrei ki nong Jebus ki shong bad ki khun shynrang ha Jerusalem haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists  ; whereby we know that it is the last time .
kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , kaba kut ka la jan ! La ïathuh ha phi ba u Nongshun jong U Khrist un sa wan ; bad mynta ki nongshun babun jong U Khrist ki la lah paw , bad kumta ngi tip ba kaba kut ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khynnah rit , ka dei ka sien kaba khatduh: bad kumba phi la iohsngew ba u nongialeh pyrshah un wan, wat mynta ruh ki don bun ki nongialeh pyrshah ; ha kaba ngi tip ba ka dei ka sien kaba khatduh .

en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall bring you into the land of Israel , into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers .
kha: Haba nga wallam pat ïa phi sha Israel , ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai haba ngan wanrah ia phi sha ka ri Israel , sha ka ri kaba nga la rah ia ka kti jong nga ban ai ia ka ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
kha: Uno uno u briew lane ka briew kiba leh byrtong kin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U shynrang ruh ne ka kynthei kaba don ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha, ne kaba long u nongleh jadu, un shah pyniap: kin sa pyniap ia ki da ki maw: ka snam jong ki kan long halor jong ki .

en: Beware of the scribes , which desire to walk in long robes , and love greetings in the markets , and the highest seats in the synagogues , and the chief rooms at feasts  ;
kha: To sumar bha pyrshah ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban ïaid kylleng ha ki jaiñkup bajynsur bad kiba ieit ban ïoh jingkhublei da kaba burom ha ki jaka ïew ; kiba jied ïa ki jaka ba la pynkyrpang ha ki synagog bad ïa ki jaka bakynsai tam ha ki jingkhawai ;
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ia ki nongthoh kiba kwah ban iaid ha ki jain kiba jrong , bad ki jingkhublei ha ki iew ki hat bad ki jaka shong kiba ha khlieh duh ha ki synagog bad ki kamra ba ha khlieh duh ha ki jingkhawai ; .

en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .
kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki ong ,  Kan bha ba phin ym bunktien lymda phi kwah ïa kine ki briew ban bitar bad ban kynrup ïa phi . Nangta ma phi bad ka longïing jong phi baroh phin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la ong ha u, Wat iohsngew ia ka sur jong me hapdeng jong ngi, ioh ki briew kiba bitar kin mareh halor jong me, bad me duh noh ia ka jingim jong me, bad ka jingim jong ka iing jong me .

en: And I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came four chariots out from between two mountains  ; and the mountains were mountains of brass .
kha: Nga la ïoh sa kawei pat ka jingïohipaw . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw tylli ki kali ïapom kiba wan mih napdeng ki ar tylli ki lumbah rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la phai, bad nga la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, la mih saw tylli ki kali na ki ar tylli ki lum ; bad ki lum ki long ki lum nar .

en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .
kha: Ym don u ban mynjur ïa kata ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh dei ban ïasam kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingkit jingbah un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uta uba leit sha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba sngap ia phi ha kane ka kam ? hynrei kumba ka bynta jong u ka leit sha ka thma , kumta ka bynta jong u kan long kaba sah ha ki tiar: kin iakhlad noh kumjuh .

en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .
kha: Haba phi ai kano kano ka jingkular ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynslem ha kaba pyndep ïa ka , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular jong phi , bad ka long ka pop ban ym pyndep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me kular ia ka jingkular ha U Trai U Blei jong me, wat nym sngap jar ban siew ia ka: namar U Trai U Blei jong me un dawa shisha ia ka na me; bad kan long ka pop ha me .

en: But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;
kha: Hynrei lada uta u shakri u ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong u , u shim por slem ban wan phai bad lada u sdang ban shoh ïa kiwei pat ki shakri , shynrang bad kynthei , bad bam bad dih bad buaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uta u shakri u ong ha ka dohnud jong u, u kynrad jong nga u pynslem ia ka jingwan jong u ; bad un sdang ban shoh ia ki shakri bad ki shakri, bad ban bam bad dih, bad ban dih ; .

en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon  ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .
kha: U Hiram , u syiem Tyros u la ju long u paralok jong u Dabid , bad haba u la ïohsngew ba u Solomon u la long syiem hadien jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , u la phah ki nongkit  tiensyiem sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u syiem Tyros u la phah ia ki shakri jong u sha u Solomon namar u la iohsngew ba ki la pynsleh ia u ha ka kamra u kpa jong u: namar u Hiram u la ju long u nongieit ia u Dabid .

en: And David sent messengers , and took her  ; and she came in unto him , and he lay with her  ; for she was purified from her uncleanness : and she returned unto her house .
kha: U Dabid u la phah ki nonglamktien sha ka ; ki la wallam ïa ka sha u bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka . ( Ka dang shu lah pyndep ïa la ka jinglehniam pynkhuid kaba man u bnai . ) Nangta ka la leit phai sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor, bad u la shim ia ka ; bad ka la wan rung shapoh jong u, bad u la thiah bad ka ; namar ka la pynkhuid ia ka na ka jingbymkhuid jong ka: bad ka la leit phai noh sha la iing .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Whence comest thou ? Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Kaei kaba me la lah leh ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Naei me wan ? Nangta u Soitan u la jubab ia U Trai, bad u la ong: Na kaba leit sha khyndew bad shapoh jong ka .

en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
kha: Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bam, ki la dih, ki la shongkurim ia ki tnga, ki la shah ai ha ka jingshongkha, haduh ka sngi ba u Noah u la rung ha ka lieng, bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynjot ia ki baroh .

en: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Abi , the daughter of Zachariah .
kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abijah , ka khun jong u Sekharaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Arphew san snem ka rta u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar arphew hynniew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kyrteng kmie jong u ruh ka long ka Abi , ka khun jong u Sakharaiah .

en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .
kha: U Jeroboam u long u samla uba dap shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long uba trei shitom , u buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor ha ka thain jong ki jait Manasseh bad Ephraim .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew u Jeroboam u long u briew uba khlain bor: bad u Solomon u la iohi ia uta u samla ba u long uba khlem trei shitom , u la pynlong ia u ban synshar ia ka jingkitkhlieh baroh jong ka iing u Joseph .

en: So the shipmaster came to him , and said unto him , What meanest thou , O sleeper ? arise , call upon thy God , if so be that God will think upon us , that we perish not .
kha: U kapten u la shem ïa u hangta bad u ong ïa u ,  Me leh aïu da kaba ïohthiah ? To khie bad to duwai ha u blei jong me na ka bynta ka jingïarap . Lehse un sngewlem ïa ngi bad pyllait im ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u nongpyniaid lieng u la wan sha u bad u la ong ha u, Me mut aiu ko nongthiah? to khie, to khot ia U Blei jong me lada U Blei un pyrkhat ia ngi, ba ngin ym jah noh .

en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him  ; for his heart was lifted up : therefore there was wrath upon him , and upon Judah and Jerusalem .
kha: Hynrei u Hesekaïah u sngewsarong palat ban pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewnguh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh namar jong u , bad ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki mad jingjynjar na kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Hesekaiah um shym la leh shuh katkum ka jingmyntoi ba la leh ia u ; namar ka dohnud jong u ka la kiew: namarkata ka la don ka jingbitar halor jong u bad halor ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

en: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh  ; for the Egyptians sold every man his field , because the famine prevailed over them : so the land became Pharaoh s .
kha: Kumta keiñ u Joseph u thied lut ïa ka khyndew ha Ijipt na ka bynta u syiem . La pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei u nong Ijipt ban die ïa la ki lyngkha namar ba ka  nemsniew ka la jur palat ; bad baroh ka khyndew ka kylla long ka jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la thied ia ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei na ka bynta u Pharaoh; namar ki nong Ijipt ki la die ia uwei pa uwei u briew ia ka lyngkha jong u: kumta ka ri ka la kylla long u Pharaoh s .

en: They have set up kings , but not by me : they have made princes , and I knew it not : of their silver and their gold have they made them idols , that they may be cut off .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la jied ïa ki syiem . Hynrei ki la leh ïa kata ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki thung ïa ki nongïalam , hynrei khlem ka jingpynskhem jong nga . Ki shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki bad ki thaw ïa ki bleithaw — na ka bynta ka jingjot jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ki syiem , hynrei ym da nga: ki la thaw ia ki syiem , bad ngam tip: na ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki ki la pynlong ia ki ki bleithaw , ba kin shah ot noh .

en: And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .
kha: Ka la long kaba khriat , kumta ki shakri bad ki nongap phira ki la thang ding da u rnga bad ki la ïeng sawdong jong ka , ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Te u Petros u la leit shata bad u la ïa-ïeng bad ki , ban pynsyaid ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri bad ki ophisar ki la ieng hangta, kiba la shna ia ka ding dewiong namar ka la khriat: bad ki la pynshit ia lade: bad u Petros u la ieng bad ki, bad u la pynshit ia lade .

en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his fathers had done : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
kha: Ma u , kum kiba ha shuwa jong u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai kumba ki kpa tymmen jong u ki la leh: um shym la phet noh na ki pop jong u Jeroboam u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta phi pyn-i ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Namar kane , ka jingpynshitom ïa phi kan long kaba kham sniew !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi bam ia ki iing kiba la shah ktah, bad na ka bynta ka jingleh thok phi leh ia ka jingduwai kaba jrong: namarkata phin sa ioh ia ka jingtim kaba kham khraw .

en: And the parched ground shall become a pool , and the thirsty land springs of water : in the habitation of dragons , where each lay , shall be grass with reeds and rushes .
kha: u shyiap uba khluit un kylla long ka pung , bad ïa ka ri ryngkhiang yn pyndap da ki umpohliew . Ha ka jaka ba ju shong ki myrsiang , u phlang bad u khah ha ki jaka jyrsieh kin mih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khyndew kaba la tyrkhong kan kylla long ka pung, bad ki tyllong um kiba sliang: ha ka jaka shong jong ki blang , ha kaba uwei pa uwei u thiah , un long u phlang bad u khnai bad u khnai .

en: And the company shall stone them with stones , and dispatch them with their swords  ; they shall slay their sons and their daughters , and burn up their houses with fire .
kha: To ai ba u paidbhur un lynthem maw ïa ki bad tur ïaleh ïa ki da ki waitlam , ban pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki , bad ban thang ïa ki ïing jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynhun kan pynkhih ia ki da ki maw , bad kin pyniap ia ki da ki waitlam jong ki; kin pyniap ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki , bad kin thang ia ki iing jong ki da ka ding .

en: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink , and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her : and they shall be weary . Thus far are the words of Jeremiah .
kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Babilonia — kan ngam bad kan ym lah khie shuh , namar ka jingpynjot ba U  Trai  un wallam ha ka .’   Ki ktien jong u Jeremaïah ki kut hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong , Kumta ka Babilon kan ngam jyllop bad kan ym kiew na ka jingsniew kaba ngan wanrah halor jong ka: bad kin sa thait . Haduh mynta ki ktien u Jeremaiah .

en: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them , he said to the ruler of his house , Bring these men home , and slay , and make ready  ; for these men shall dine with me at noon .
kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin lem bad ki , u ong ha u shakri uba peit ïa ka ïing jong u ,  Khie ïalam ïa kine ki briew sha ïing jong nga . Kin sa ïabam ryngkat bad nga ha ka por shiteng sngi ; kumta pynïap uwei na ki jingri bad shet ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la iohi ia u Benjamin bad ki, u la ong ha u nongsynshar jong ka iing jong u, To wanrah ia kine ki briew sha iing, bad to pyniap ia ki briew bad pynkhreh ia kine ki briew kin bam bad nga ha ka por shiteng sngi .

en: Behold the fowls of the air : for they sow not , neither do they reap , nor gather into barns  ; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them . Are ye not much better than they ?
kha: Khmih ïa ki sim : kim bet symbai , kim ïalum ïa ka jingot bad buh ïa ka ha ki thiar ; pynban U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u sumar sukher ïa ki ! Hato phim kam kor shibun ban ïa ki sim ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sim jong ka Iyer: namar kim bet , lymne kim kheit , lymne kim lum ha ki thliew ; hynrei U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng u ai bam ia ki . Hato phim kham bha shibun ban ia ki ?

en: For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God  ; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the  Lord  did they bestow upon Baalim .
kha: ( Ki nongbud jong ka Athalaïah , kata ka kynthei bymman , ki la pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ki la pyndonkam ïa kiba bun ki tiar ki tar bakyntang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Athaliah , kata ka kynthei kaba sniew , ka la pynpra ia ka iing U Blei bad kumjuh ruh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la aiti lut jong ka iing U Trai ki la ai ha u Baalim .

en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women  ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them .
kha: Kita ki nongpynkha khun ki jubab ,  Ki kynthei Hebru kim long kum ki kynthei Ijipt ; ki kha suk ïa ki khun , bad katba ngin da poi ma ngi , ki la lah kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongkha khun ki la ong ha u Pharaoh , Namar ki kynthei Hebru kim long kum ki kynthei Ijipt; namar ki long kiba im, bad ki long kiba la kha khun ha ki .

en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :
kha: Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew tylli ki tnat kin mih na ki liang jong ka ; lai tylli ki tnat jong ka sharak na kawei ka liang , bad lai tylli ki tnat jong ka sharak na kawei pat ka liang:

en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .
kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewphylla bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ki jait ktien aïu kine ? Da ka iktiar bad ka bor une u briew u ai ki hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki ïamihnoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki la lyngngoh bad ki la ia kren hapdeng jong ki, ki da ong: Kaei ka ktien kane ! namar da ka bor bad ka bor u hukum ia ki mynsiem bymkhuid bad ki mih noh .

en: And he sent Eliakim , who was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth , unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .
kha: U la phah ïa u Eliakim , u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , ïa u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki lyngdoh ba rangbah sha u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Amos . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khain .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u Eliakim uba la long halor ka iing bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad ki rangbah jong ki lyngdoh kiba la tap da ka jainkup, ha u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u khun u Amoz .

en: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren , see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently :
kha: Mynta ba da ka jingkohnguh jong phi ha ka jingshisha phi la pynkhuid ïa lade bad ïa ka ban don ka jingieit parabangeit ba khlem arsap , to phin da ieit shitrhem paralok da la ka dohnud baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi la pynkhuid ia ki mynsiem jong phi ha kaba kohnguh ia ka jingshisha lyngba U Mynsiem sha ka jingieit bym don pop jong ki para bangeit , peit ba phi ia ieit iwei ia iwei pat da ka dohnud kaba khuid:

en: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt . And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh , and went throughout all the land of Egypt .
kha: U Joseph u la dap laiphew snem ka rta mynba u sdang ban treikam na ka bynta u syiem Ijipt . U la iehnoh ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u leit kylleng ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la don laiphew snem ka rta haba u ieng ha khmat u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt . U Joseph u la mih noh na khmat u Pharaoh bad u la leit kylleng ka ri Ijipt .

en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .
kha: Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , ba uno uno u bym wan shaneng na ki longiing baroh sha Jerusalem ban mane ia u Syiem , U Trai jong ki paid , wat ha ki ruh un ym don slap .

en: And I will turn thee back , and leave but the sixth part of thee , and will cause thee to come up from the north parts , and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel :
kha: Ngan pynphai ïa u sha ka lynti bathymmai bad ngan ïalam ïa u shabar na shaphang shatei eh , haduh ba un da poi sha ki lumbah ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphai biang ia me, bad ngan iehnoh tang ia ka bynta kaba hynriew jong me, bad ngan pynlong ia me ban wan shaneng na ki bynta ba shathie, bad ngan wanrah ia me ha ki lum Israel:

en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jinglaitluid kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata namar ki para bangeit ki bym tip ba la wanrah shapoh, kiba la wan rung shimet ban sngap jar ia ka jinglaitluid jong ngi kaba ngi don ha U Khrist Jisu, ba kin wanrah ia ngi ha ka jinglong mraw:

en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering , and laid it upon Isaac his son  ; and he took the fire in his hand , and a knife  ; and they went both of them together .
kha: U Abraham u pynkit ha u Isaak ïa ki dieng na ka bynta ka jingkñia , bad ma u pat u rah ïa ka tari bad ïa ki rnga barhem ban sliew ding . Katba baroh ar ngut ki dang ïa-ïaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la shim ia u dieng jong ka jingainguh thang bad u la buh ia ka ha u Isaak u khun jong u ; bad u la shim ia ka ding ha ka kti jong u, bad ka wait ; bad ki la iaid lang baroh arngut .

en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .
kha: Kumta u ïeng ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta ,  Kat uba don ha ka liang jong U  Trai  , wan shane !  Kumta baroh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la ieng ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong bad u la ong: Mano ba don ha ka liang U Trai ? to ai ba un wan sha nga . Bad ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi baroh ki la ialum lang ha u .

en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .
kha: Na ka khet la mih ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrthat . Ha khmat jong ka khet , la don hynñiew tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka khet ki la mih ki jingshai bad ki jingsawa: bad ki don hynriew tylli ki sharak ding kiba thang ha khmat ka khet , kiba long ki hynriew Mynsiem U Blei .

en: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered , neither the sand of the sea measured : so will I multiply the seed of David my servant , and the Levites that minister unto me .
kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong u shakri jong nga u Dabid bad ïa ka jingdon ki lyngdoh na ka jait Lebi , ba kumta yn ym lah ban ñiew ïa ki kumba long ki khlur ha sahit bneng lane u shyiap harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ym lah ban khein ia ka kynhun jong ki bneng, lymne ia ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw: kumta ngan pynbun ia u symbai u Dabid u shakri jong nga, bad ki Lebi kiba shakri ia nga .

en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils , after whom they have gone a whoring . This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations .
kha: Ki Israel kim dei shuh ban lyndet ïa U  Trai  da kaba pynïap ïa ki mrad jong ki ha lum ha wah la kum ba kñia ainguh ïa ki sha ki ksuid . Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sumar ïa kane ka aiñ pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym ai shuh ia ki jingknia jong ki ha ki ksuid , hadien jong ki ki la leit sha ka kam khaii met . Kane kan long ka ain junom ha ki ha ki pateng jong ki baroh kawei .

en: And said , Naked came I out of my mother s womb , and naked shall I return thither : the  Lord  gave , and the  Lord  hath taken away  ; blessed be the name of the  Lord .
kha: U ong ,  La kha ïa nga lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei bad ngan ïap lyngkhuit khlem don ei ei . U  Trai  u la ai , bad mynta u la shim noh . To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Naked nga la mih na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga, bad lyngkhuid ngan leit phai noh sha kata: U Trai u la ai, bad U Trai u la weng noh ia ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .
kha: U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong phi ba kin shahjop haba ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh ki dong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynlong ia ki nongshun jong me kiba kiew pyrshah ia me ban shah pynmong ha khmat jong me: kin mih pyrshah ia me ha kawei ka rukom bad kin phet noh ha khmat jong me hynriew lynti .

en: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bullocks , all of them fatlings of Bashan .
kha: Ki dei ban bam ïa ki met jong ki shipai bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei , ïa ki baroh yn pynïap kumba pynïap ïa ki langbrot shynrang ne ki khunlangbrot ne ki blang ne ki masi dab kiba sngaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin bam ia ka doh jong ki rangbah bad dih ia ka snam jong ki syiem jong ka khyndew, jong ki langbrot bad ki blang bad ki blang .

en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .
kha: Ki dei ban da thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki kjat , ba kin ym ïap . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dei ban bud junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kin sait ia ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki, ba kin ym iap: bad kan long ka ain junom ia ki, wat ia u bad ia u symbai jong u ha ki pateng jong ki baroh .

en: From Jordan eastward , all the land of Gilead , the Gadites , and the Reubenites , and the Manassites , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , even Gilead and Bashan .
kha: shaduh shaphang shathie sha ka shnong Aroer kaba harud ka wah Arnon — kane ka kynthup ïa ki thain jong ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha kaba ki jait Gad , Reuben , bad ki Manasseh kiba shaphang mihngi ki shong ki sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Jordan shaphang mihngi, ka ri Gilead baroh kawei, ki Gadit bad ki Reuben bad ki Manassei, na Aroer kaba don harud ka wah Arnon, wat ka Gilead bad ka Basan .

en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .
kha: Ka  nemsniew ka la kham jur , bad ka la saphriang ïa ka ri baroh kawei , u Joseph u la plie ïa kita ki ïing kynshew jingbam baroh , bad u la die kew ha ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkyrduh ka la long halor ka khyndew baroh kawei: U Joseph u la plie ia ki iing buh jingbam baroh, bad u la die ha ki nong Ijipt; bad ka jingkyrduh ka la nang jur ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .
kha: Da pyrkhat shuwa ba phin kren , bad wat pynlong kino kino ki jingkular kyrkieh ha U Blei . U don ha bneng bad ma phi ha khyndew , kumta wat ong ei ei palat ban ïa kaba phi dei ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym sngewsih ia ka shyntur jong me, bad wat ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan kyrkieh ban kren ei ei ha khmat U Blei: namar U Blei u don ha bneng, bad me ha ka khyndew: namarkata to ai ba ki ktien jong me kin long kiba duna .

en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne , and worship him that liveth for ever and ever , and cast their crowns before the throne , saying ,
kha: Haba ki leh kumta , kita ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup ha khmat uta uba shong halor ka khet , bad mane ïa u , uba im junom la junom . Ki bret ïa ki pansngiat jong ki ha khmat jong ka khet bad ki ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sawphew ngut ki rangbah ki hap ha khmat jong u uba shong ha ka khet bad ki mane ia uta uba im junom bad ki bret ia ki khlieh jong ki ha khmat ka khet da kaba ong:

en: And Hadadezer sent , and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river : and they came to Helam  ; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadadezer went before them .
kha: U Syiem Hadadeser u la phah khot ïa ki Syria kiba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , bad ki la wan sha Helam ha ka jingïalam u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Hadadeser u syiem Sobah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hadadezer u la phah ia ki Syria kiba don sha shiliang wah: bad ki la poi ha Helam ; bad u Shobac u rangbah shipai u Hadadezer u la leit sha khmat jong ki .

en: Wherefore remember , that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh , who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands ;
kha: Phi ïa kiba la kha kum ki Jentil — ïa kiba la khot  ki bymotsher  da ki Jiw , kiba ïa lade pat ki khot  kiba la otsher  (kaba thew ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki leh ha ki met jong ki) — to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba phi la long mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to kynmaw , ba phi long ha ka por ba la leit noh ha ka doh , ia kiba la khot ki bym pat shah jied da kata kaba la khot ka Jingktah ha ka doh .

en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward , saying , Come , and let us join ourselves to the  Lord  in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten .
kha: Kin kylli ïa ka lynti sha Seïon bad nangta kin leit ha kata ka phang . Kin pynlong ka jutang baïaineh bad nga bad da lei lei kin ym pynkheiñ ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin kylli ia ka lynti sha Seion da ki khmat jong ki sha khmat , ki da ong , To wan , bad to ngin iasoh bad U Trai ha ka jutang bymjukut kaba ym klet .

en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .
kha: Kaei ka jynjar jong pha ?  Ka jubab ,  Ha kato ka sngi , kane ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ia ka, Kaei kaba phi sngewsih ? Bad ka la jubab ia nga, Kane ka kynthei ka la ong ha nga, Ai ia u khun jong me, ba ngin bam ia u mynta ka sngi, bad ngin bam ia u khun jong nga lashai .

en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee , seven times seven years  ; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years .
kha: Kheiñ hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem , kata baroh kan long sawphew khyndai snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban khein hynriew tylli ki sngi sait jain ha me, hynriew sien hynriew snem; bad ka jaka jong ki hynriew tylli ki sngi sait jain ha me kan long ha me sawphew hynniew snem .

en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .
kha: Hynrei me , me ïohi ; me khmih ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom , bad me ïailong uba la kloi ban ïarap . U briew u bym don nongïarap u aiti ïa lade ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la iohi ia ka ; namar me la iohi ia ka jingsniew bad ka jingsniew, ban siew kylliang ia ka da ka kti jong me: u baduk u pynlut ia lade ha me ; me long u nongiarap jong ki bym don kpa .

en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the coasts thereof round about , according to their families .
kha: Ka Jordan ka dei u pud uba shaphang mihngi . Kine ki dei ki pud jong ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Jordan ka long ka pud jong ka shaphang mihngi . Kane ka la long ka pateng jong ki khun shynrang jong ka ri Benjamin, da ki pud jong ka sawdong sawdong .

en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Repent , and turn yourselves from your idols  ; and turn away your faces from all your abominations .
kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : To phai noh bad ieh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ka iing Israel , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong: To kylla bamut noh ia lade na ki bleithaw jong phi; bad pynphai noh ia ki khmat jong phi na ki jingleh bymman jong phi baroh .

en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal , and , lo , there was a great earthquake  ; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair , and the moon became as blood  ;
kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynriew . Ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong ïong kum ka jaiñ ïong kaba khain , bad u bnai u la kylla rong saw kum ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba hynriew, bad, ha khmih, ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw ; bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong saw kum ka sniehdoh, bad u bnai u la kylla long kum ka snam ; .

en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :
kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ha Akhaïa :
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul, u apostol U Jisu Khrist da ka mon U Blei, bad u Timothi u para jong ngi, ha ka balang U Blei kaba don ha Korinth, ryngkat bad ki riewkhuid baroh kiba don ha Akhaia baroh:

en: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .
kha: Da shisha un pynïap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew ,  ki la jubab ,  bad un aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai , ki ban ai ha u ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit ha ka por kaba biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong ha u , Un pynjot bein ia kita ki briew kiba sniew, bad un pyllait noh ia ka kper sohjew jong u sha kiwei pat ki nongrep , ki ban pynphai biang ia u ia ki soh ha ki aiom jong ki .

en: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord , nor of me his prisoner : but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God ;
kha: Kumta wat sngewlehrain , ban sakhi na ka bynta U Trai jong ngi , lymne ban sngewlehrain ïa nga , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist . Pynban , to shim ïa la ka bynta ha kaba shahshitom na ka bynta ka Khubor Babha , kumba U Blei u ai ïa me ka bor ban leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewlehrain ia ka jingphla U Trai jong ngi: hynrei to long u nongiashim bynta ha ki jingjynjar jong ka gospel kat kum ka bor U Blei;

en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee , which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois , and thy mother Eunice ; and I am persuaded that in thee also .
kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ka jingngeit basngur kaba me don , ka jingngeit kaba kum ka jong ka kmierad jong me ka Lois bad kaba ka kmie jong me ka Ïuniki ruh ka don . Nga sngewthikna ba me ruh me don ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga khot ban kynmaw ia ka jingngeit bym pat ju long ha me, kaba shong nyngkong eh ha ka kmie tymmen jong me Lois, bad ka kmie jong me ka Eunice ; bad nga sngewskhem ia kata ha me ruh .

en: And , behold , there came a man named Jairus , and he was a ruler of the synagogue : and he fell down at Jesus  feet , and besought him that he would come into his house :
kha: Te u briew uba kyrteng u Jairos u la wan poi ; u la long u rangbah synshar ha ka synagog kaba ha kata ka shnong . U la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha ïing jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u la wan uwei u briew uba kyrteng u Jairus, bad u la long u nongsynshar jong ka synagog: bad u la dem ha ki kjat U Jisu, bad u la kyrpad ia u ba un wan shapoh iing jong u:

en: Then shall they cry unto the  Lord  , but he will not hear them : he will even hide his face from them at that time , as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings .
kha: Ka por kan poi haba phin kyang sha U  Trai  , hynrei un ym jubab ïa phi . Un ym sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , naba phi la leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin iam ha U Trai , hynrei un ym iohsngew ia ki: un buhrieh wat ia la ka khmat na ki ha kata ka por , kumba ki la leh ia lade ha ki kam jong ki .

en: Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .
kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , ryngkat bad baroh ki angel jong u kiba ïeng harud jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien u la ong , Namarkata to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai ; nga la iohi ia U Trai ba u shong halor ka khet jong u, bad baroh ki kynhun bneng ki ieng ha ka liang kadiang jong u bad ha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u la ong ha u Soitan ,  To U  Trai  un pynrem ïa me , ko Soitan ! To U  Trai  , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusalem , un pynrem ïa me . Une u briew u long kum u dieng ïa uba la sei noh na ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , U Trai u la kynthoh ia me , ko Soitan; wat U Trai uba la jied ia ka Jerusalem u la kynthoh ia me: hato kane kam dei ka brand kaba la shim na ka ding ?

en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .
kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas ,  Buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ha u Thomas, To ktah ia ka kti jong me, bad ha khmih ki kti jong nga ki ktah ia ka kti jong me, bad pynrung ia ka ha ka liang jong nga: bad wat long kiba khlem jingngeit, hynrei kiba ngeit .

en: And the scripture , foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith , preached before the gospel unto Abraham , saying , In thee shall all nations be blessed .
kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la ong lypa ba U Blei un pynksan ïa ki Jentil ha lade hi da ka jingngeit . Bad kumta ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka pynbna ïa ka khubor babha ha u Abraham :  Lyngba jong me , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingthoh , haba ka la iohi lypa ba U Blei un pynksan ia ki nongwei da ka jingngeit , ka la ialap ha khmat ka gospel ha u Abraham , ka ong , Ha me ki jaitbynriew baroh kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto all the congregation .
kha: Nangta u Korah u lumlang ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei , bad ki la ïeng da kaba phai pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Kynsan kynsan ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon U  Trai  ka paw ha ka kynhun baroh kawei ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Korah u la lum lang ia ka jingiaseng baroh pyrshah ia ki ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad ka burom U Trai ka la paw ha ka jingiaseng baroh .

en: Director General AFMS informed the Minister that the number of such hospitals is being enhanced depending upon the situation and availability of equipment from suppliers .
kha: U Director General AFMS u la pyntip sha u Myntri Rangbah ba ïa ka jingdon jong kum kine ki Hospital la nang pynbun katkum ka jinglong jingman bad ka jingdon jong ki tiar na ki supplier .
translated_en_to_kha: U Director General AFMS u la pyntip sha u Myntri ba la nang pynbha ia ka jingdon jong kum kine ki hospital katkum ka jinglong jingman bad ka jingdon jong ki tiar na ki nongsam .

en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la wan sha u ban shah pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki ,  Phi ki bseiñ — uei uba la ïathuh ha phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u la iohi ia kiba bun na ki Pharisi bad ki Sadusi ba ki wan sha ka jingpynbaptis jong u , u la ong ha ki , Ko pateng ki khnai kiba la maham ia phi ban phet noh na ka jingbitar kaban sa wan ?

en: And Ahab said to Elijah , Hast thou found me , O mine enemy ? And he answered , I have found thee : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Haba u Ahab u ïohi ïa u Elijah , u ong  Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , nga la lap ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  Me la aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la ong ha u Elijah, Hato me la shem ia nga, ko nongshun jong nga ? Bad u la jubab: Nga la shem ia me: namar me la die ia lade ban leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .
kha: Uno uno u bym don U Mynsiem , um lah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai kiba wan na U Mynsiem U Blei . Kum uta u briew da shisha um sngewthuh ïa ki ; ki long ka jingbieit ha u , namar ïa ka dor jong ki lah ban bishar tang na ka nongrim kaba kynja mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u briew uba kynja met um pdiang ia kiei kiei jong U Mynsiem U Blei: namar ki long ka jingbieit ha u: bad um lah ban ithuh ia ki: namar ba la ithuh ia ki ha ka mynsiem .

en: But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people , which had nothing , in the land of Judah , and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time .
kha: U la iehnoh ha Judah katto katne na ki briew kiba duk tam , ki bym don jaka puta , bad u la ai ïa ki , ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Nebuzaradan u rangbah jong ki nongap u la iehnoh ia kiba duk jong ki briew, ki bym don ei ei, ha ka ri Judah bad u la ai ia ki ki kper sohjew bad ki lyngkha ha kajuh ka por .

en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed , and will make him afraid : and all the people that are with him shall flee  ; and I will smite the king only :
kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa u katba u dang thait bad noh mynsiem . Un sa sheptieng ; bad ki rangbah jong u baroh kin phet krad . Ngan pynïap tang ïa u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wan ha u katba u dang thait bad u dang tlot ka kti, bad ngan pyntieng ia u: bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u kin phet noh; bad ngan shoh ia u syiem tang:

en: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit , and the Spirit against the flesh : and these are contrary the one to the other : so that ye cannot do the things that ye would .
kha: Ïa kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew jong ngi ka kwah ka long marpyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah , bad kaei kaba U Mynsiem u kwah ka long marpyrshah ïa kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynja briew jong ngi ka kwah . Kine ar ki ïalong nongshun , bad kane ka mut ba phim lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka doh ka kwah ia U Mynsiem bad U Mynsiem pyrshah ia ka doh: bad kine ki long kiba pyrshah ia uwei pat: kumta phim lah ban leh ia kiei kiei kiba phi kwah .

en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck , behold , it was dead : but when I had considered it in the morning , behold , it was not my son , which I did bear .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , haba nga la khie thiah bad sa ban ai buiñ ïa la u khun , nga ïohi ba u la ïap . Nga la khmih bniah hajan bad nga shem pynban ba um dei u khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la khie dang step ban ai ia u khun jong nga, ha khmih, ka la iap: hynrei haba nga la pyrkhat ia ka mynstep, ha khmih, kam dei u khun jong nga, uba nga la kha .

en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me , it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he were cast into the sea .
kha: Lada uno uno un pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban duh noh ka jingngeit jong u ha nga , kan kham bha ban teh ïa uta u briew da u mawtylliat baheh sawdong ïa ka ryndang jong u bad ban bret ïa u sha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba pynsngewsih ia uwei na kine kiba rit kiba ngeit ha nga , ka kham bha ia u ba la pyndait ia u maw mawsiang sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad la bret ia u sha duriaw .

en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .
kha: U Paul u la kwah ban ïalam bad u ïa u Timothi , kumta u la otsher ïa u . U la leh kumta namar baroh ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha kita ki jaka ki tip ba u kpa jong u Timothi u long u Grik .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul un hap ban leit sha khmat bad u ; bad u la shim bad ot ia u namar ki Jiw kiba don ha kita ki jaka: namar ki tip lut ba u kpa jong u u long u Grik .

en: And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki paid Israel baroh ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia , bad ki la leit sha Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ban jam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ieng dang step bad ki la leit noh na Shittim bad ki la poi ha Jordan , ma u bad ki khun Israel baroh .

en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead , that they might be judged according to men in the flesh , but live according to God in the spirit .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ruh ha kiba ïap , ha kito ïa kiba la bishar katba kum ka jingim ha ka doh kumba ïa uwei pa uwei la bishar ; la ïalap ha ki khnang ba ha jingim ba kynja mynsiem kin ïoh im kumba U Blei u im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na ka bynta kane ka daw la ialap ruh ha kito kiba la iap, ba kin shah bishar kat kum ki briew ha ka doh , hynrei kin im kat kum U Blei ha U Mynsiem .

en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
kha: Kiei kita ?  u la kylli .  Kiei kiei kiba la jia ha U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Une u briew u la long u nongïathuhlypa bad la ñiew da U Blei bad da ki briew baroh ba u long uba donbor ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u kren bad leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Kiei kiei kiei ? Ki la ong ha u, Shaphang U Jisu na Nazareth, uba long u nongiathuhlypa uba khraw ha ka kam bad ka ktien ha khmat U Blei bad ki briew baroh:

en: Why criest thou for thine affliction ? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity : because thy sins were increased , I have done these things unto thee .
kha: Wat ujor shuh shaphang ki jingmynsaw jong phi ; ym don kano kano ka jingpynkoit ïa phi . Nga la pynshitom ïa phi kumne namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka long kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me pyrta ia ka jingjynjar jong me ? ka jingsngewsih jong me ka long kaba ym lah ban pynkoit na ka bynta ka jingbun jong ka jingbymhok jong me: namar ba ki pop jong me ki la nang kiew , nga la leh ia kine kiei kiei ha me .

en: So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .
kha: Nangta ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shonshab ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , bad ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la thoh ia ki shithi ha ka kyrteng jong u Ahab, bad ka la khang ia ki da ka muhor jong u, bad ka la phah ia ki shithi sha ki rangbah bad sha ki rangbah kiba don ha ka shnong jong u, kiba shong bad u Naboth .

en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite , Wherefore goest thou also with us ? return to thy place , and abide with the king : for thou art a stranger , and also an exile .
kha: bad u syiem u ong ha u Ittai , u nongïalam jong ki ,  Balei phi ïaleit bad ngi ? Khie leit phai noh bad sah bad u syiem thymmai . Phi dei u nongwei , u nongphetwir na la ka jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha u Ittai u nong Gadit, Balei me ruh me leit bad ngi? leit phai noh sha ka jaka jong me, bad to kohnguh bad u syiem: namar me long u nongwei, bad ruh u nongshah beh shnong .

en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :
kha: Nangta pat u lyngdoh un pynlong sa ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u jingri namar ka jingainguh thang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un ai ia ka jingainguh pop , bad un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta uba dei ban pynkhuid na ka jingbymkhuid jong u ; bad hadien kata un pyniap ia ka jingainguh thang:

en: And he brought him to Jesus . And when Jesus beheld him , he said ,  Thou art Simon the son of Jona : thou shalt be called Cephas ,  which is by interpretation , A stone .
kha: Te u la ïalam ïa u Simon sha U Jisu . U Jisu u la peit ïa u bad u la ong ,  Ka kyrteng jong me ka long u Simon u khun jong u Jona , hynrei yn khot ïa me u Kephas .  ( Kane ka long kumjuh kum ka kyntien  Petros  kaba mut  u mawsiang . )
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u ha U Jisu . Bad haba U Jisu u la iohi ia u, u la ong, Me long u Simon u khun u Jonah: ia me yn khot u Cephas, kaba long da ka jingbatai , U maw .

en: For , as the  Lord  liveth , which saveth Israel , though it be in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . But there was not a man among all the people that answered him .
kha: Nga kular ha U  Trai  uba im , uba ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop , ba uta uba la leh un shah pynïap , wat la u dei u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba ong ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, kumba U Trai u im, uba pynim ia ki Israel, wat la ka long ha u Jonathan u khun jong nga, un sa iap shisha . Hynrei ym don briew napdeng ki briew baroh kiba la jubab ia u .

en: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh , and spread abroad his hands unto the  Lord  : and the thunders and hail ceased , and the rain was not poured upon the earth .
kha: U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , u leit shabar ka nongbah , bad u la rah ïa la ki kti ha ka jingduwai ha U  Trai . U pyrthat , u phria , bad u slap ki la sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la mih na ka shnong na u Pharaoh bad u la pynphriang ia ki kti jong u sha U Trai : bad ki jingsawa bad u slap kim shym la tuid ha ka khyndew .

en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .
kha: Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka manna sawphew snem lynter , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la bam ia ka Mannna sawphew snem , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri kaba la shong ; ki la bam ia ka Mannna , haduh ba kin da poi sha ki pud jong ka ri Kanaan .

en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people , and after the division of the families of the Levites .
kha: bad to pynbiang ïa lade khnang ba katto katne na phi phin long kiba la kloi ban ïarap ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing jong ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ieng ha ka jaka bakhuid kat kum ki jait jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki briew , bad hadien ka jingphiah ia ki jait Lebi .

en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .
kha: Nga la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingbitar nga la shim noh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga don ka kam ban leh ha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la plie ia ki tiar ialeh jong u, bad u la wanrah ia ki tiar ialeh jong u: namar kane ka long ka kam U Trai Blei jong ki paid ha ka ri jong ki Khaldi .

en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .
kha: Mynta , la don ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh awria hapdeng jong phi kaba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba wat ki bymngeit kin sngewrem ïa kata . La ïathuh ïa nga ba uwei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka meinah!
translated_en_to_kha: La ju iathuh ba ka don ka jingleh be-ijot hapdeng jong phi , bad kum kata ka jingleh be-ijot kumba ym shym la jer kyrteng hapdeng ki Jutang , ba uwei u dei ban don ka tnga jong u kpa jong u .

en: Casting down imaginations , and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God , and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ ;
kha: Ngi pynïap nia ïa ki jingïatainia ba-thala ; ngi pynduh ïa ka jingpynwit basngewmeng baroh ba la pynïeng pyrshah ïa kata ka jingtip U Blei ; ngi shim ïa ka jingpyrkhat baroh bad pynkohnguh ïa ka ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynhiar ia ki jingmutdur , bad kawei pa kawei kaba jrong kaba pynpaw pyrthei ia lade pyrshah ia ka jingtip U Blei , bad kaba wanrah ia ka jinglong mraw ia kawei pa kawei ka jingpyrkhat sha ka jingsngap jong U Khrist ; .

en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;
kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi : Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum , bad ïaineh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi sumar ia kine ki hukum baroh kiba nga hukum ia phi, ban leh ia ki, ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u baroh, bad ban iaineh ha u ; .

en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish , disobedient , deceived , serving divers lusts and pleasures , living in malice and envy , hateful , and hating one another .
kha: Naba ngi ruh ngi la long shisien kiba bieit , ki bymkohnguh bad kiba leh bakla . Ngi la long ki mraw ha ki jingkwah brai bad ki jingsngewbha babun jait . Ngi la pynlut ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingsniew bad jingpihuiñ ; kiwei ki la isih ïa ngi bad ngi la isih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi ruh teng teng ngi la long kiba bieit, ki bym kohnguh, kiba la shah thok, kiba shakri ia ki jingkwah brai bad ki jingsngewbha, kiba im ha ka jingsniew bad jingsngewsih, kiba shun bad kiba shun iwei ia iwei pat .

en: With whom the  Lord  had made a covenant , and charged them , saying , Ye shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them :
kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad ki bad u la hukum ïa ki :  Wat mane ïa kiwei ki blei ; wat dem khrup ha ki lane shakri ïa ki lane ai ki jingkñia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kiba U Trai u la leh ia ka jutang bad u la kynnoh ia ki da kaba ong: Phim dei ban tieng ia kiwei pat ki blei, lymne ban dem khrup ha ki, lymne ban shakri ia ki, lymne ban knia ia ki:

en: And he changed his behaviour before them , and feigned himself mad in their hands , and scrabbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down upon his beard .
kha: Kumta ha man ba u Dabid u don hajan jong ki , u leh mynleh kum u bieit bad leh kum u lamwir haba ki pyrshang ban khang ïa u ; u da pruid ha ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad u ailad ïa ka umbiah ban jaw ha u  ñiuhtmoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkylla ia ka jinglong jong u ha khmat jong ki, bad u la leh kum uba bieit ha ki kti jong ki, bad u la rkhie bein ia ki jingkhang jong ka khyrdop , bad u la ai ba ka ryndang jong u kan hap ha ka ryndang jong u .

en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
kha: Pynban , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka jingbhabriew bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai jai bad bajar jar , kaba long kaba khraw tam ha khmat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba kan long u briew uba buhrieh jong ka dohnud, ha kata kaba ym lah ban pyut, wat ka jingpynitynnad ia ka mynsiem kaba jem bad kaba jemnud kaba don ha khmat U Blei kaba kordor shibun .

en: And some of them of understanding shall fall , to try them , and to purge , and to make them white , even to the time of the end : because it is yet for a time appointed .
kha: Katto katne na kito ki nongïalam bastad kin shah pynïap , hynrei kaba mih na kane ka long ba yn pynkhuid ïa ki briew . Kane kan ïailong tad haduh ba kaba kut kan wan , ka por kaba U Blei u la buh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katto katne na ki kiba sngewthuh kin hap, ban pyrshang ia ki, bad ban pynkhuid ia ki, bad ban pynlong lieh ia ki, wat haduh ka por kaba kut: namar ka dang long na ka bynta ka por ba la buh .

en: And Abigail hasted , and arose , and rode upon an ass , with five damsels of hers that went after her  ; and she went after the messengers of David , and became his wife .
kha: Ka la ïeng kloi kloi bad ka shong halor ka kada jong ka . La synran ïa ka da ki shakri kynthei jong ka san ngut ; ka la leit ryngkat bad ki shakri jong u Dabid bad ka la long ka tnga jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abigail u la kyrkieh bad u la ieng halor ka kada jong ka, bad san tylli ki dam jong ka kiba la leit bud ia ka ; bad ka la leit bud ia ki nonglam khubor jong u Dabid bad ka la long ka tnga jong u .

en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa kaei kaba u Hamor bad u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad baroh ki shynrang ki la shah otsher .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u Hamor bad ha u Shehem u khun jong u u la sngap ia baroh kiba mih na ka khyrdop jong ka shnong jong u ; bad uwei pa uwei u shynrang u la shah ot , baroh kiba mih na ka khyrdop jong ka shnong jong u .

en: Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .
kha: U Elisha u khie joit , u ïaid shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangta u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade halor u khynnah . U khynnah u la synriah hynñiew sien bad u peit la ki khmat .
