translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wan phai biang shapoh iing bad u la rkhie bein bad u la leit shaneng, bad u la pynkhih ia lade halor jong u: bad uta u khynnah u la sngap jar hynriew sien , bad uta u khynnah u la plie ia ki khmat jong u .

en: And the  Lord  sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan , that reigned in Hazor  ; the captain of whose host was Sisera , which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u shah ba kin shahjop ha u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan uba la synshar ha ka nongbah Hasor . U rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , u dei u Sisera , uba shong ha Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la die ia ki ha ka kti u Jabin u syiem Kanaan , uba la synshar ha Hasor ; u rangbah shipai jong u u la long u Sisera uba shong ha Hashet jong ki Jutang .

en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Seïon ,  La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! Ngi dei ban iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïing jong ngi la pynkhyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sur jong ka jingsawa ka la iohsngew na Seion , Kumno ngi la shah pynsniew ! ngi sngew lyngngoh shibun , namar ngi la iehnoh ia ka ri , namar ki jaka sah jong ngi ki la beh noh ia ngi .

en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .
kha: U Judah u ong ha la u kpa ,  Phah ïa u para bad nga , bad ngin ïamihnoh kumne kumne . Te yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban ïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong ha ki Israel u kpa jong u, To phah ia u khynnah bad nga, bad ngin ia khie bad leit ; ba ngin im, bad ngin ym iap, ma ngi bad me bad ki khun rit jong ngi ruh .

en: And he came up , and told his father and his mother , and said , I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines : now therefore get her for me to wife .
kha: U leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u ong ha la u kpa bad ha la ka kmie ,  Ka don kawei ka kynthei Philistia hangthie ha Timnah kaba la pynïapmat ïa nga . Pynïoh ïa ka na ka bynta jong nga ; nga kwah ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan shaneng bad u la iathuh ha la u kpa bad ka kmie jong u bad u la ong: Nga la iohi ia ka kynthei ha Timna na ki khun kynthei jong ki Philistia: mynta to shim ia ka na ka bynta jong nga .

en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
kha: u la ong ha u Hasael , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Khie leit rah ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongïathuhlypa , bad kyrpad ïa u ban kylli na U  Trai  la ngan koit biang ne em .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Hazael, To shim ia ka jingai sngewbha ha ka kti jong me, bad leit iakynduh ia u briew jong U Blei, bad kylli ia U Trai da u, da kaba ong: Hato ngan koit na kane ka jingpang ?

en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness , Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers , neither observe their judgments , nor defile yourselves with their idols :
kha: Pynban , nga la maham ïa ki samla hapdeng jong ki : Wat sumar ïa ki aiñ kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki thaw ; wat bud ïa ki rukom jong ki lane pyntngit ïa lade da ki bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong ha ki khun jong ki ha ka ri khlaw , Wat iaid ha ki ain jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , lymne wat sumar ia ki jingbishar jong ki , lymne pynjakhlia ia lade da ki bleithaw jong ki:

en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt  ; they committed whoredoms in their youth : there were their breasts pressed , and there they bruised the teats of their virginity .
kha: Mynba ki dang samla , ki shong ki sah ha Ijipt , ki la duh noh ka jinglong sotti bad ki kylla long ki nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leh ia ki kam sniew ha Ijipt ; ki la leh ia ki kam sniew ha ka por ba ki dang samla: ki la pynkhih ia ki bniat jong ki , bad hangta ki la pynkhih ia ki bniat jong ka jinglong kynthei jong ki .

en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?
kha: Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba bha . Me long uba dap da kiba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ko khun u ksuid baroh , me u nongshun jong ka hok baroh , hato men ym sangeh ban pynkylla ia ki lynti kiba dei jong U Trai ?

en: At that time Merodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah : for he had heard that he had been sick , and was recovered .
kha: Hamar kaba kum kane ka por , u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u la ïohsngew ba u syiem Hesekaïah u pang , kumta u la phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Meroachbaladan u khun u Baladan u syiem Babilon u la phah shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha sha u Hesekaiah: namar u la iohsngew ba u la pang bad u la koit .

en: Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .
kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u shakri ryngkat bad me lem bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki para jong me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u ong ha nga: Peit wat leh ia kata: namar nga long u para nongshakri jong me, bad na ki hynmen jong me ki nongiathuhlypa, bad na kita kiba sumar ia ki ktien jong kane ka kot: mane ia U Blei .

en: A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingmut kaba thymmai . Ngan khlaw noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ba-eh rang jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka dohnud kaba kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud kaba thymmai ruh ngan ai ha phi , bad ka mynsiem kaba thymmai ngan buh hapoh jong phi: bad ngan weng noh ia ka dohnud maw na ka doh jong phi , bad ngan ai ia phi ia ka dohnud doh .

en: For , lo , I raise up the Chaldeans , that bitter and hasty nation , which shall march through the breadth of the land , to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs .
kha: Ngan wanrah ïa ki nong Babilonia ban don ha ka bor , kito kiba triem , ki briew bym lah ban shong khop . Ki leit kylleng ka pyrthei ban jop ïa kiwei ki ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, nga pynmih ia ki Chalded, kata ka jaitbynriew kaba sngewsih bad kaba kyrkieh, kaba iaid lyngba ka jingjyllei jong ka ri, ban don ia ki jaka shong jaka sah ki bym dei ki jong ki .

en: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle , and bade that he should be examined by scourging  ; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him .
kha: U rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom u la hukum ïa la ki rangbah ban ïalam ïa u Paul shapoh ka kut shipai , bad u la ong ïa ki ban sympat ïa u khnang ban lap balei ba ki Jiw ki kyang kumne pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U rangbah u la hukum ia u ban shah wanrah shapoh ka iing syiem, bad u la bthah ba dei ban bishar bniah ia u da kaba sngap jar jar ba un tip balei ki iam kumta pyrshah ia u .

en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .
kha: khnang ba phi lah ban long ki khun jong U Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng . Namar u pynlong ïa ka sngi kaba u la thaw ban tyngshaiñ ha ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumjuh , bad u ai slap ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha bad ha kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin long ki khun U Kpa jong phi uba don ha bneng: namar u pynlong ia ka sngi jong u ban mih na kaba sniew bad ha kaba bha , bad u phah slap ia kiba hok bad ha ki bym hok .

en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven , all whose works are truth , and his ways judgment : and those that walk in pride he is able to abase .
kha: Bad mynta , ma nga , u Nebukhadnessar , nga ïaroh , nga pyndon burom , bad nga ai burom ïa U Syiem jong ka Bneng . Kaei kaei baroh kaba u leh ka long kaba dei bad kaba hok , bad u lah ban pynhiar ïa uno uno uba leh sarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga u Nebuchadnezzar nga iaroh bad burom ia u Syiem bneng, baroh kiba ki kam jong u ki long ka jingshisha, bad ki lynti jong u ki long ka jingbishar: bad kito kiba iaid ha ka jingsarong u lah ban pynjah burom .

en: Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .
kha: A Blei , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga . To pynbha pat ïa ka Templ jong me , ïa kaba la pynjot ; to pynbha ïa ka khnang ba uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata ko Blei jong ngi, to sngap ia ka jingduwai jong u shakri jong me bad ki jingkyrpad jong u, bad pynlong ia ka khmat jong me ban shai halor ka jaka kyntang jong me kaba la jot , na ka bynta U Trai .

en: And they encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , till thou come unto Gaza , and left no sustenance for Israel , neither sheep , nor ox , nor ass .
kha: Ki sher dara ha ka ri bad ki pynjot ïa ki jingthung baroh shaduh ka jaka bashaphang shathie sawdong ïa ka Gasa . Ki shim ïa baroh ki langbrot , ki jingri , bad ki kada , bad kim shym pynsah ei ei shuh ïa ki Israel ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia shong pyrshah ia ki, bad ki la pynjot ia ka jingroi jong ka khyndew haduh ba me la poi ha Gaza, bad ngam shym la iehnoh ia ka jingbam na ka bynta ki Israel, lymne ki langbrot ne ki masi ne ki kada .

en: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands , which are the figures of the true  ; but into heaven itself , now to appear in the presence of God for us :
kha: Namar U Khrist um shym la leit rung shapoh ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam ba la shna da u briew , kaba long tang ka jingpyrthuh bud ïa kata kaba shisha . U la rung shapoh ka bneng hi , ha kaba mynta u mihkhmat na ka bynta jong ngi ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist um shym la rung ha ki jaka bakhuid ba la shna da ki kti , kiba long ki dur jong ka ; hynrei sha bneng hi , mynta ban paw ha khmat U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi:

en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .
kha: Pynban , ki Israel kim shym beh noh ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur bad Maakah ; ki dang shong ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki khun Israel kim shym la beh ia ki Geshur , ne ki Maakhasi: hynrei ki Geshur bad ki Maakhasi ki shong hapdeng ki Israel haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And in the seventh month , on the first day of the month , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work : it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynñiew phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam . Ha kata ka sngi put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka taiew kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, phin ym leh ia ka kam kaba khuid: ka dei ka sngi ban pynbthei ia ki turoi ha phi .

en: For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :
kha: Kaei kaba ka Hukum kam lah ban leh , namar ka jinglong ba kynja doh ka long kaba tlot , U Blei u la leh . U la pynrem ïa ka pop ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh da kaba u la phah ïa U Khun jong u hi , uba la wan kum ka jinglong u briew uba pop , ban jop ïa ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kaei kaba ka hukum kam lah ban leh, ha kaba ka la tlot lyngba ka doh, U Blei u phah ia la u jong u Khun ha ka dur jong ka doh pop, bad na ka bynta ka pop, u la pynrem ia ka pop ha ka doh:

en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he brought Jesus forth , and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement , but in the Hebrew , Gabbatha .
kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien , u la ïalam shabar ïa U Jisu bad u la shong halor ka khet u nongbishar ha ka jaka ba la khot  Kaba la Siang Maw .  ( Ha ka ktien Hebru ka kyrteng ka long  Gabbatha .  )
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Pilat u la iohsngew ia kata ka jingong, u la wanrah ia U Jisu shabar, bad u la shong ha ka jaka bishar ha ka jaka kaba la khot ka Pavement, hynrei ha Hebru , u Gabbatha .

en: Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
kha: hynrei namar ba u don ka jingduna ha ka met , um bit ban wan hajan ka jingkah pyrda kaba kyntang ne ban leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dei ban pynbit tngit ïa kine ki jaka kyntang jong nga ; namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga pynkyntang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ma u un ym leit shapoh ka jingtap, lymne un ym wan hajan ka jingkhang, namar u don ka jingduna ; ba un ym pynjah burom ia ki jaka kyntang jong nga: namar nga U Trai nga pynkyntang ia ki .

en: Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u Balaam ; u pynkylla pynban ïa kata ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu , namar ba u ieit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh U Trai U Blei jong me un ym sngap ia u Balaam hynrei U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynkylla ia ka jingtim ha ka jingkyrkhu ia me , namar U Trai U Blei jong me u la ieit ia me .

en: All these the sons of Jediael , by the heads of their fathers , mighty men of valour , were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers , fit to go out for war and battle .
kha: Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup khathynñiew hajar arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh ki khun shynrang jong u Jediael, da ki khlieh jong ki kpa jong ki, ki shiphew hajar arspah ngut ki shipai kiba la biang ban leit shabar ban leit sha ka thma bad ka thma .

en: But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :
kha: Katno kiba sniew bad bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka por !  U Jisu u la pynbna .  Phi pan na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki: Ka pateng kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ka wad ia ka dak bad ym don dak ei ei ha ka , hynrei ka dak jong u nongiathuhlypa Jonah:

en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given unto it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas .  And he left them , and departed .
kha: Katno kiba sniew bad ki bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka juk ! Phi kyrpad na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah .  Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka pateng kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ka wad ia ka dak ; bad ym shym la ai dak ei ei ha ka , hynrei ka dak jong u nongiathuhlypa Jona . U la iehnoh ia ki bad u la leit noh .

en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay , and that there is black hair grown up therein  ; the scall is healed , he is clean : and the priest shall pronounce him clean .
kha: Hynrei lada ha ka jingkhmih jong u lyngdoh ka prum kam shym pur , bad u shñiuh uba ïong u la sdang mih hangta , kata ka prum ka la jem , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka sniehdoh ka don ha ka jingpeit jong u ha ka jaka sah, bad ba don ki shniuh kiba lieh kiba la san ha ka ; ka sniehdoh ka la koit: bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid .

en: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .
kha: U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u la kyllaiñ da ki jaiñsop ïa kiba ïap , bad da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khmat jong u .  To law noh na u ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad ai ba un ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba la iap u la mih shabar, u la teh ia ka kti bad ka kjat bad ki jain tep: bad ka khmat jong u ka la teh sawdong da ka napkin . U Jisu u ong ha ki, Pynduh noh ia u, bad pyllait noh ia u .

en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand  ; and they came unto Balaam , and spake unto him the words of Balak .
kha: Kumta ki nongïalam jong ki Moab bad ki Midian ki rah bad ki ïa ka jingsiew na ka bynta ka jingtim , ki la leit sha u Balaam bad ki ai ha u ïa ka khubor na u Balak .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Moab bad ki rangbah jong ka Midian ki la leit noh bad ki khusnam jong ka jingleh jadu ha ka kti jong ki ; bad ki la poi ha u Balaam bad ki la kren ia u ia ki ktien u Balak .

en: And one of the scribes came , and having heard them reasoning together , and perceiving that he had answered them well , asked him , Which is the first commandment of all ?
kha: Uwei u nonghikai ka Hukum uba don hangta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren . U la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u la ai ïa ki Saddusi ka jubab kaba dei , kumta u la wan ha u ryngkat bad ka jingkylli :  Kano ka hukum kaba long kaba kongsan tam na baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki nongthoh u la wan bad u la iohsngew ia ki ba ki ia kren lang bad u la sngewthuh ba u la jubab bha ia ki, u la kylli ia u: Kaei ka hukum kaba nyngkong eh na baroh ?

en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .
kha: Nga la ong ,  To sngap ïa U  Trai  , phi ki kynthei , bad to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u . To hikai ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïambriew , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi kumno ban rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to iohsngew ia ka ktien U Trai , ko kynthei , bad to ai ba ka shkor jong phi kan pdiang ia ka ktien jong ka shyntur jong u , bad to hikai ia ki khun kynthei jong phi kiba iam , bad uwei pa uwei u para marjan jong ka .

en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ; )
kha: Ka jingleh jong ki ka pyn-i ba ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ki jingïatiplem jong ki ruh ki pyn-i ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki teng teng ki pynrem ïa ki bad teng teng ki kyrshan ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba pyni ia ka kam jong ka hukum kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ki, ka jingsngew jong ki ruh ka long ka sakhi, bad ki jingpyrkhat jong ki ki long kiba mut katba ki dang kynnoh ne lym kumta ki dang pynrem iwei ia iwei pat; )

en: Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .
kha: Nga long U  Trai  uba la thaw ïa phi ; naduh ka por ba la kha ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi . Wat sheptieng ; phi long u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai uba la thaw ia me, bad uba la thaw ia me na ka kpoh, uba iarap ia me wat tieng, ko Jakob, ko shakri jong nga; bad me, ko Jeshurun, ia uba nga la jied .

en: Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :
kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki . Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki kulai , bad ym don jingkut ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri jong ki ruh ka dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ym don ka jingkut jong ki spah jong ki ; ka ri jong ki ruh ka dap da ki kulai , ym don ka jingkut jong ki kali jong ki:

en: For though he was crucified through weakness , yet he liveth by the power of God . For we also are weak in him , but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you .
kha: Wat la ka la long ha ka jingtlot ba u la shah pynïap halor ka diengphna , dei da ka bor U Blei ba u im . Ha u ngi ruh ngi long kiba tlot ; hynrei ha ki jingïadei jong ngi bad phi ngin ïa-ïoh bynta lem ïa ka bor U Blei ha ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la u la shah pyniap lyngba ka jingtlot hynrei u im da ka bor U Blei . Namar ngi ruh ngi tlot ha u , hynrei ngin im bad u da ka bor U Blei shaphang jong phi .

en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la don bad ki ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei , ha ka ri shyiap . La thaw ïa ka kat kumba U Blei u la ong ha u Moses ban thaw ïa ka , kat kum ka dur ïa kaba la pyn-i ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki don ka jaka sakhi ha ka ri khlaw kumba u la buh, da kaba kren ha u Moses , ba un pynlong ia ka kat kum ka rukom kaba u la iohi .

en: Meghalaya : . An All Party Meeting was convened by Meghalaya Assembly Speaker , Metbah Lyngdoh . Govt and Opposition reaffirmed their resolve to fight COVID19 effectively .
kha: Meghalaya : . La khot ia ka All Party Meeting da u lamphang dorbar ka jylla Meghalaya u bah Metbah Lyngdoh . Ka sorkar bad ka liang pyrshah ki la pynskhem biang ia ka jingkut jingmut jong ki ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka COVID19 da kaba suk .
translated_en_to_kha: Meghalaya: . La khot ia ka jingialang jong ka seng baroh kawei da u Lamphang ka Meghalaya Assembly , u Metbah Lyngdoh . Ka Govt bad ka Liang Pyrshah ka la pynskhem biang ia ka jingkut jingmut jong ki ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka COVID19 da kaba suk .

en: And it came to pass , as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wouldest thou ?
kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada ba ka shong , bad u Kaleb u kylli aïu ba ka kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ka dang wan sha u, ba ka la pynkhih ia u ban pan na u kpa jong ka: bad ka la pynkhih ia ka tdong jong ka; bad u Caleb u la ong ha ka: Phi kwah aiu ?

en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;
kha: Ngi thoh sha phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingim , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi la ïohi ïa u da la ki khmat ; ho-oid , ngi la ïohi ïa u , bad ki kti jong ngi ki la ïohktah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba la long naduh kaba sdang, kaba ngi la iohsngew, kaba ngi la iohi da ki khmat jong ngi, kaba ngi la peit bad ki kti jong ngi ki la bat, na ka Ktien ka jingim ; .

en: I the  Lord  have called thee in righteousness , and will hold thine hand , and will keep thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , for a light of the Gentiles  ;
kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga la khot bad ai bor ïa phi , ban khmih ba ka jingbishar hok la pyndep ha pyrthei . Lyngba jong phi ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bad ki briew baroh ; lyngba jong phi ngan wanrah ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga U Trai nga la khot ia me ha ka hok, bad ngan bat ia me, bad ngan sumar ia me, bad ngan ai ia me na ka bynta ka jutang jong ki briew, na ka bynta ka jingshai jong ki Jutang ; .

en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .
kha: U Amos u ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; Ka sur jong u ka tied kum u pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong , bad u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , U Trai un rkhie bein na Seion , bad un pynmih ia ka sur jong u na Jerusalem bad ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ki nongap langbrot kin iam , bad ka tduh jong u Karmel kan tyrkhong .

en: And I looked , and there was none to help  ; and I wondered that there was none to uphold : therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me  ; and my fury , it upheld me .
kha: Nga la lyngngoh haba nga khmih bad peit ba ym don uwei ruh u ban ïarap ïa nga . Hynrei ka jingbitar jong nga ka pynkhlaiñ ïa nga , bad nga ïoh ïa ka jingjop ïa lade hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga peit, bad ym don mano mano ruh ban iarap ia nga; bad nga la lyngngoh ba ym don mano mano ruh ban pynskhem: namarkata ka kti jong nga hi ka la wanrah ia ka jingpynim ha nga; bad ka jingbitar jong nga, ka la pynskhem ia nga .

en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
kha: Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei kiei baroh ; nga ñiew ïa ka baroh tang kum ka synrum , khnang ba ngan ïoh ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynïasoh pura bad u . Ngam long shuh uba don ka hok ka jong nga hi , ka bynta kaba nga ïoh da kaba kohnguh ïa ka hukum . Nga mynta , nga ïoh ïa ka hok kaba la ai da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist , ka hok kaba wan na U Blei bad kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la shem ha u, ym da ka hok jong nga hi, kaba long na ka hukum , hynrei kata kaba long lyngba ka jingngeit U Khrist , ka hok kaba long na U Blei da ka jingngeit:

en: And this word , Yet once more , signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that are made , that those things which cannot be shaken may remain .
kha: Ki ktien  sa shisien pat  ki pyn-i shai ba ïa kiei kiei kiba la thaw yn pynkhynñiuh bad yn weng noh , khnang ba ïa kiei kiei ki bym lah ban pynkhynñiuh yn pynneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka ktien , Hynrei sa shisien pat , ka pynpaw ia ka jingpynkylla ia kita kiei kiei kiba la pynkhih , kum kiei kiei kiba la pynlong , ba kita kiei kiei kiba ym lah ban pynkhih kin sah .

en: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it shall devour the palaces thereof , with shouting in the day of battle , with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind :
kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh ka nongbah Rabbah , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka . Te kan don ki jingkhynwin ha ka sngi ïaleh thma , bad ka jingïaleh kaba jur kum ka  erlangthari .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynmeh ia ka ding ha ka kynroh jong ka Rabbah, bad kan bam ia ki iing jong ka, da kaba pyrta ha ka sngi thma, da ka eriong ha ka sngi jong ka lyer kaba jur:

en: The just  Lord  is in the midst thereof  ; he will not do iniquity : every morning doth he bring his judgment to light , he faileth not  ; but the unjust knoweth no shame .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u dang don ha ka nongbah ; u leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad da lei lei ruh em ïa kaei ka bymdei . Man ka step khlem bakla , u wallam ka jinglehhok ha ki briew jong u . Bad pynban hangta ki briew bymhok ki ïai leh bymdei bad kim sngewlehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai uba hok u don hapdeng jong ka ; un ym leh ia ka jingbymhok: man ka step u wanrah ia ka jingbishar jong u sha ka jingshai , um ju lehrain ; hynrei ki bym hok kim tip ia ka jingsngewlehrain .

en: Now upon the first day of the week , very early in the morning , they came unto the sepulchre , bringing the spices which they had prepared , and certain others with them .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step Sngi U Trai ki kynthei ki la leit sha ka jingtep ki da rah ïa ki musla kiba ki la pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taiew, mynstep bha, ki la wan sha ka jingtep, ki wanrah ia ki jingbam ba la pynkhreh bad katto katne kiwei pat bad ki .

en: And he said , It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery , neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome : but the noise of them that sing do I hear .
kha: U Moses u ong ,  Kata kam shym sawa kum ka jingrisa jop thma , lane kum ka jinglynñiar kiba shahjop ; hynrei ka dei ka jingsawa jong ka jingïarwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kam dei ka sur jong ki kiba pyrta na ka bynta ka jinglong trai, bad kam dei ruh ka sur jong kito kiba iam namar ba ki la shah jop: hynrei ka jingsawa jong kita kiba rwai nga iohsngew .

en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,
kha: Te ki rangbah kur , ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki nongai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u syiem da la ka mon sngewbha ki ai
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u rangbah jong ki kpa bad ki rangbah jong ki Israel bad ki rangbah jong ki hajar bad ki spah snem ryngkat bad ki nongsynshar jong u syiem ki la tyrwa da ka mon sngewbha .

en: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner : and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah , that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon .
kha: Hynrei u Joab bad u Abishai ki la mih ban buddien ïa u Abner , bad ha ka por sep sngi ki la wan poi ha u lum Ammah , uba don ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Giah ha ka lynti sha ka ri khlaw jong ka Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab ruh bad u Abisai ki la bud ia u Abner : bad ka sngi ka la hiar haba ki la poi ha u lum Ammah , kaba sah ha khmat u Giah ha ka lynti jong ka ri khlaw Gibeon .

en: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith s son unto the place of the Nethinims , and of the merchants , over against the gate Miphkad , and to the going up of the corner .
kha: U Malkhijah , u bania , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka ïing ba la pyndonkam da ki nongtrei shynrang ka Templ bad ki nongkhaïi , kaba don hajan ka Khyrdop Miphkad , kaba don hajan ka kamra halor ka dong jong ka kynroh kaba shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u khun ksiar ha ka jaka jong ki Nethinim bad ki nongkhaii, ha khmat ka khyrdop Miphkad bad ha ka jaka ba kiew sha ka kut .

en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .
kha: Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phi ïohi ïa uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la biang ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban phet krad . Yn ym don shuh ka kynhun shipai jong phi ka ban dang sah , lait noh sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jong u lum !
translated_en_to_kha: Shi hajar ngut ki briew kin phet noh na ka jingshah lehbein jong uwei u briew ha ka jingshah lehbein jong ki san ngut: haduh ba phin da iehnoh kum u blang ha jrong jong u lum bad kum ka dak ha u lum .

en: And at the side without , as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate , were two tables  ; and on the other side , which was at the porch of the gate , were two tables .
kha: Shabar kata ka kamra la don ruh saw tylli ki miej kiba long kumjuh , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khyrdop bashatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka liang ba shabar, katba uwei u nang kiew sha ka jingkhang shaphang shathie, ki don ar tylli ki miej ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang kaba don ha ka phyllaw jong ka khyrdop .

en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed , and was delivered of a child when she was past age , because she judged him faithful who had promised .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ïoh long u kpa , wat haba u la tymmen bha bad ka Sarah hi kam lah ban ïoh khun . U la shaniah ba U Blei un bat ïa la ka kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ka jingngeit ruh ka Sara hi ka la ioh bor ban kha symbai , bad la pynpoi ia u khun haba ka la dap ia ka rta , namar ka la bishar ia u uba iaineh uba la kular .

en: And the watchman told , saying , He came even unto them , and cometh not again : and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi  ; for he driveth furiously .
kha: Sa shisien pat u nongap phira u leit ïathuh ba u nonglamktien u la poi sha ka kynhun hynrei u khlem wan phai . Bad u ong shuh shuh ,  U nongïalam jong ka kynhun u ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u kum uba lamwir , i kumba u dei u Jehu !
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap u la iathuh, u la wan sha ki, bad um wan shuh: bad ka jingleit ka long kum ka jingleit jong u Jehu u khun u Nimshi ; namar u iaid kai da ka jingbitar .

en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem  ; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together , gold , and silver , and apparel , in great abundance .
kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Judah ki ïaleh ban ïada ïa ka Jerusalem . Kin shim kum ka jinglute ïa ka spah jong ki hima baroh — ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ki jaiñphong babun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Judah ruh un ialeh ha Jerusalem ; bad ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong yn lum lang, ka ksiar bad ka rupa bad ka jainkup kaba bun .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .
kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïaleh ïa pha , bad kin wan kum ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me, ko Tyros, bad ngan pynlong ia kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban wan pyrshah ia me, kumba ka duriaw ka pynlong ia ki um jong u ban wan shaneng .

en: And as he was yet a coming , the devil threw him down , and tare him . And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit , and healed the child , and delivered him again to his father .
kha: Katba uta u khynnah u dang wan , u mynsiem bymman u la shoh pynkyllon ïa u sha madan bad u la bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring . U Jisu u la ai hukum ïa u mynsiem bymman , U la pynkhiah ïa uta u khynnah , bad U la ai pat ïa u ha u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang wan, u ksuid u la pynhap ia u, bad u la pynlong ia u . U Jisu u la pynrem ia u mynsiem bymkhuid bad u la pynkoit ia uta u khynnah bad u la aiti biang ia u ha la u kpa .

en: Which is come unto you , as it is in all the world ; and bringeth forth fruit , as it doth also in you , since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth :
kha: Ka gospel ka ïai wallam ki jingkyrkhu bad ka par kylleng ka pyrthei , kumba ka la long hapdeng jong phi naduh kata ka sngi kaba phi la ïohsngew nyngkong shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei bad phi la tip ïa ka kumba ka long shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba wan ha phi kumba ka long ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad ka pynmih soh kumba ka long ruh ha phi naduh ka sngi ba phi la iohsngew ia ka bad phi la ithuh ia ka jingaiei U Blei ha ka jingshisha:

en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us , and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
kha: Bad wat shah ba un pynkohnguh ïa phi ban shaniah ha U  Trai . Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa phi , bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Assyria na kaba kurup ïa ka nongbah jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Hesekaiah ruh un ym ai ba phin shaniah ha U Trai da kaba ong , U Trai un pyllait im shisha ia ngi , bad kane ka shnong kan ym shah aiti ha ka kti jong u syiem Assyria .

en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .
kha: U Tiglath Pileser , haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat bad la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynïap ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha Kir .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la sngap ia u: namar u syiem Assyria u la leit sha ka nongbah Damasios bad u la shim ia ka bad u la rah ia ki briew jong ka sha Kir bad u la pyniap ia u Resin .

en: And it be told thee , and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently , and , behold , it be true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought in Israel :
kha: phi dei ban tohkit bniah ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha me, bad me la iohsngew ia kata, bad me la kylli da ka jingsngewrit, bad, ha khmih, ka long kaba shisha, bad kaba thikna, ba kum kata ka jingleh bein ka long ha Israel:

en: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .
kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi , bad u mradkhlaw , kin isih ïa ka nuti ; kin sa knieh noh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ka don bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit ïa ka ; kin bam ïa ka doh jong ka bad kin pynjot ïa ka da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shiphew tylli ki bniat kiba me la iohi ha uta u mrad , kine kin shun ia ka nongkhaii met bad kin pynlong ia ka ban tyrkhong bad lyngkhuid , bad kin bam ia ka doh jong ka bad kin thang ia ka da ka ding .

en: And it came to pass , that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering , behold , Samuel came  ; and Saul went out to meet him , that he might salute him .
kha: U la ainguh ïa ka jingainguh thang , bad hamar ba u dep , u Samuel u la wan poi . U Saul u mih ban ïakynduh ïa u bad pdiang sngewbha ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba tang shu dep ban ainguh ia ka jingainguh thang , ha khmih u Samuel u la wan ; bad u Saul u la mih ban iakynduh ia u , ba un ai khublei ia u .

en: And we sailed thence , and came the next day over against Chios  ; and the next day we arrived at Samos , and tarried at Trogyllium  ; and the next day we came to Miletus .
kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng nangta bad ngi la poi ha Khios ha ka sngi kaba bud . Hadien shi sngi ngi la wan poi ha Samos , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Miletos .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la leit noh nangta , bad ngi la poi ha ka sngi kaba bud pyrshah ia u Chios ; bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha u Samos , bad ngi la sah ha Trogyllium ; bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Mileto .

en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , the king of Heshbon  ; and Israel said unto him , Let us pass , we pray thee , through thy land into my place .
kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phah nonglamktien sha u Sihon , u syiem Amor ha Heshbon , ban pan jingbit ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u sha ka ri la jong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u syiem Heshbon bad ki Israel ki la ong ha u: To ngin iaid lyngba ia ka ri jong me sha ka jaka jong nga .

en: I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .
kha: Da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynlong ia ka khyndew, u briew bad u mrad kiba don ha ka khyndew, da ka bor bah jong nga bad da ka kti ba la pynkhih jong nga, bad nga la ai ia ka ha uba ka la long kumba ka iakynduh ia nga .

en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .
kha: Thaw ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynpur itynnat ha ki ïa ka dur ki kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me dei ban shna ia ka ïingjaiñ da ki shiphew tylli ki jingtap kiba la tyrkhong bha, bad kiba rong saw bad kiba rong saw: da ki cherub kiba la tyrkhong me dei ban shna ïa ki .

en: Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .
kha: To shahshkor , ko rangbah , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei , bad ïa kata ka krem kaba don hangta . Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba phin ïoh tep ïa la ka tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Em, ko kynrad jong nga, to sngap ia nga: ka lyngkha nga ai ia me, bad ka krem kaba don hangta, nga ai ia me ; ha khmat ki khun shynrang jong nga nga ai ia me: tep ia me: tep ia me .

en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .
kha: Kan ym long kumta! U Blei un long uba shisha , wat la uwei pa uwei u briew u long uba shukor . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phi ba phi long kiba shisha haba phi kren ; phi dei ban jop ïa ka jingïaleh haba la bishar ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la khang: Hooid, to ai ba U Blei un long uba shisha, hynrei u briew u long uba thok; kumba la thoh: Ba me long uba hok ha ki ktien jong me , bad me lah ban jop haba me shah bishar .

en: And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .
kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongbah ba-itynnat jong ki ïa kiba la ker kynroh ; phin pom ïa baroh ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki umpohliew jong ki ; bad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha baseisoh jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki maw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa pynkhih ia kawei pa kawei ka shnong kaba la ker sawdong bad kawei pa kawei ka shnong kaba la jied, bad phin hap ia u dieng uba bha baroh, bad phin sa pynsangeh ia ki tyllong um baroh, bad phin sa pynjot ia kawei pa kawei ka jaka kaba bha da ki maw .

en: And I will lay it waste : it shall not be pruned , nor digged  ; but there shall come up briers and thorns : I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it .
kha: Ngan shah ïa ka ba kan dap da ki ñiut suda . Ngan ym khap ïa ki thning lane kara ïa ka khyndew , hynrei ngan shah ïa ki dieng shynraiñ bad ki shiah ba kin tap ïa ka . Ngan khang wat ïa ki lyoh ban pynhap slap ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ka ha ka jaka kaba la tyrkhong: kan ym shah rong noh, lymne kan ym shah rong noh: hynrei kin wan ki bniat bad ki bniat: Ngan hukum ruh ia ki lyoh ba kin ym slap ia u slap halor jong ka .

en: When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him ? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :
kha: Lada U Blei u rai ban nym leh ei ei ruh , ym don uno uno uba lah ban wad daw ïa u . Lada u buhrieh ïa ka khmat jong u , ki briew kin long kiba khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u ai ia ka jingsngap jar , mano ba lah ban pynshitom ? bad haba u buhrieh ia ka khmat jong u , mano ba lah ban iohi ia u ? la ka long pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew ne pyrshah ia u briew tang:

en: Whose possessors slay them , and hold themselves not guilty : and they that sell them say , Blessed be the  Lord   ; for I am rich : and their own shepherds pity them not .
kha: Ki trai jong ki , ki pynïap ïa ki bad ki lait na ka jingshah pynshitom . Ki die ïa ka doh bad ki ong , ‘ To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Ngi la riewspah !’ Wat ki nongaplangbrot jong ki hi kim don jingisynei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki trai jong ki ki pyniap ia ki, bad ki bat ia lade ba kim don pop: bad kita kiba die ia ki ki ong: La kyrkhu ia U Trai ; namar nga long uba riewspah: bad ki nongri langbrot jong ki hi kim sngewsih ia ki .

en: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .
kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha tduh jong u dieng . Nangta u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shyntur U Jisu bad u la ong ,  To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Elijah un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la mareh bad u la pyndap ia ka sniehdoh kaba dap da u sohjew, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka lyngkhot lyngkhai bad u la ai ia u ban dih, da kaba ong: To ngin ia peit la u Elias un wan hiar ia u .

en: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .
kha: Un long u briew uba khraw ha khmat U Trai . Um dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un long uba khraw ha khmat U Trai, bad un ym dih wain ne ka jingdih kaba khlain bad un sa dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid, wat na ka kpoh jong u .

en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father , he strengthened himself , and slew all his brethren with the sword , and divers also of the princes of Israel .
kha: Haba u Jehoram u la skhem ha ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima , u la pynïap ïa ki para shynrang jong u baroh , bad ruh ïa ki katto katne ngut ki nong Israel kiba dei ki rangbah synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Jehoram u la kiew sha ka hima u kpa jong u, u la pynskhem ia lade bad u la pyniap ia ki hynmen jong u baroh da ka waitlam bad ki nongleit jingleit ruh jong ki syiem Israel .

en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .
kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïashong lang ban ïabam ha kajuh ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lamler uwei ïa uwei pat . Kin ym ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka bynta kata kam pat poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ar kine ki dohnud ki long kiba sniew, bad kin kren thok ha kawei ka miej ; hynrei kan ym roi: namar hynrei ka jingkut kan long ha ka por ba la buh .

en: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle  ; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold , and their faces were as the faces of men .
kha: Kita ki puit ki long kum ki kulai kiba la khreh na ka bynta ka thma ; halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la phong ïa kaei kaba syriem kum ki pansngiat ksiar ; bad ki durkhmat jong ki , ki long kum ki durkhmat briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dur jong ki khnai ki long kum ki kulai ba la pynkhreh sha ka thma ; bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ki long kum ki khlieh ksiar bad ki khmat jong ki ki long kum ki khmat briew .

en: And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?
kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab ,  Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha ki khun Israel: Hato ngam shym la pyllait im ia phi na ki nong Ijipt bad na ki Amorit , na ki khun Ammon bad na ki Philistia ?

en: And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .
kha: To wat pynïasyriem ïa lade bad ki rukom jong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla dur ïa kaba shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkylla ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi baroh . Te phin lah ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei — kaei kaba bha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat iadei bad kane ka pyrthei: hynrei to kylla da ka jingpynthymmai ia ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi, khnang ba phin pynshisha ia kaei kata kaba bha bad kaba pdiang bad kaba janai jong U Blei .

en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin ai ia ka jingknia thang kaba la thang da ka ding, ka jingknia kaba thiang ha U Trai: uwei u masi, uwei u langbrot, hynriew ngut ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong khlem jingduna:

en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house  ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .
kha: Ka la long kumta ha baroh ki arphew snem kiba nga la don bad phi . Khatsaw snem nga la shakri ban ïoh ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi ar ngut — bad hynriew snem na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi . Wat la katta ruh , phi la pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong nga haduh shiphew sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta nga la long arphew snem ha iing jong me ; nga la shakri ia me shiphew snem na ka bynta ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong me: bad me la pynkylla ia ka bainong jong nga shi sien .

en: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha Babilonia . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka jah noh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ka mynsiem ka la shim ia nga, bad ka la wanrah ia nga ha ka jingphohsniew da U Mynsiem U Blei ha Kaldea, ha ki jong ka jingshah set . Kumta ka jingphohsniew kaba nga la iohi ka la kiew na nga .

en: And they stood before Moses , and before Eleazar the priest , and before the princes and all the congregation , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , saying ,
kha: Ki la leit ban ïeng ha khmat u Moses , u Eleasar u lyngdoh , ki nongïalam , bad u paid Israel baroh ha ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  , bad ki ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng ha khmat u Moses bad ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah bad ka jingiaseng baroh kawei hajan ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood , and on which it was borne up , of the one with his right hand , and of the other with his left .
kha: U Samson u bat ïa kita ki rishot pdeng ar tylli kiba kyrshan ïa kata ka ïing . Da kaba buh ïa kawei ka kti ha uwei u rishot bad kawei pat ha uwei u rishot , u khynñiat pyrshah ïa ki
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la bat ia ki ar tylli ki maw pdeng ha kaba ka iing ka ieng, bad ha kaba la rah ia ka, na kawei kaba don ka kti kadiang jong u, bad na kawei pat kaba don ka kti kadiang jong u .

en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses , that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left  ;
kha: Kumta sumar ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Aiñ u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba shlur shibun ban sumar bad ban leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka Kitab u Moses , ba phin ym phai noh na kata sha ka liang kadiang ne sha ka liang kadiang;

en: They on the rock are they , which , when they hear , receive the word with joy  ; and these have no root , which for a while believe , and in time of temptation fall away .
kha: Ki symbai kiba hap halor ka jaka maw ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor bad kiba pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen . Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki ; ki ngeit tang shipor hynrei haba ka por jingtynjuh ka wan poi , ki hap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ha u maw, kiba haba ki iohsngew, ki pdiang ia ka ktien da ka jingkmen ; bad kine kim don tynrai, kiba shipor ki ngeit bad ha ka por jong ka jingpynshoi ki hap noh .

en: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley , which is neither eared nor sown , and shall strike off the heifer s neck there in the valley :
kha: Kin leit ïalam ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba harud kawei ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad um , ha kaba ym pat ju don ba lur ne thung jingthung , bad hangta kin pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin pynhiar ia ka masi sha ka them kaba jylliew kaba ym shym la bet ne bet , bad kin pynkhih ia ka ryndang masi hangta ha ka them:

en: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man , he walketh through dry places , seeking rest  ; and finding none , he saith , I will return unto my house whence I came out .
kha: Haba u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh na u briew , u leit kylleng ka ri ba-tyrkhong da kaba wad ka jaka ban shongthait . Lada um lah ban shem ïa ka , un ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha ka ïing jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u mynsiem bymkhuid u la jah noh na u briew , u iaid lyngba ki jaka ba rkhiang , u wad ia ka jaka shongthait ; bad um lap ei ei , u ong , ngan leit phai noh sha la iing na kaba nga la mih .

en: Now Eli was very old , and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel  ; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: U Eli mynta u la tymmen bha . U la ju ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki la leh ïa ki Israel , bad ba ki la ju ïathiah ruh bad ki kynthei kiba trei ha ka khyrdop ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eli u la tymmen bha , bad u la iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki khun shynrang jong u ki la leh ha ki Israel baroh .

en: Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .
kha: U ban pynkylla ïa ki met batlot jong ngi bad pynlong ïa ki kum ka met ba-dap da ka burom jong u hi , da kata ka bor da kaba u lah ban wallam ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba pynkylla ia ka met kaba sniew jong ngi, ba kan long kum ka met ba donburom jong u, kat kum ka jingtrei kaba u lah wat ban pyndem ia kiei kiei baroh ha lade .

en: Every man s work shall be made manifest : for the day shall declare it , because it shall be revealed by fire ; and the fire shall try every man s work of what sort it is .
kha: Bad ïa ka dor ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei u briew yn sa ïohi haba ka Sngi U Khrist kan pynpaw ïa ka . Naba ha kata ka Sngi , ka ding kan pynpaw ïa ka jingtrei jong uwei pa uwei ; ka ding kan tynjuh ïa ka bad kan pyn-i ïa ka dor bashisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia ka kam jong uwei pa uwei yn pynpaw: namar ka sngi kan pynbna ia ka, namar yn sa pynpaw da ka ding ; bad ka ding kan pyrshang ia uwei pa uwei u briew kaei ka jait .

en: And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me  ; for the earth is filled with violence through them  ; and , behold , I will destroy them with the earth .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,  Nga la kut jingmut ban pynduh noh ïa ki briew baroh . Ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki namar ka pyrthei ka la jyllei da ki kam leh jubor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Noah , Ka jingkut jong ka doh baroh ka wan ha khmat jong nga ; namar ka khyndew ka dap da ka jingleh donbor lyngba jong ki ; bad , ha khmih , ngan pynjot ia ki da ka khyndew .

en: Therefore because the king s commandment was urgent , and the furnace exceeding hot , the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego .
kha: Mynta namar ba u syiem u la ai ki hukum bapyrkhing na ka bynta ban pynlong ïa ka lawar ding kaba khluit haduh katta katta , ki thylliej ding ki la thang ïa ki nongap phira kiba ïalam ïa ki rangbah sha ka lawar ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata namar ba ka hukum jong u syiem ka long kaba kyrkieh, bad ka ding ka la shit palat, ka ding ka la pyniap ia kita ki briew kiba la shim ia u Shadrak, u Meshah bad u Abednego .

en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel , where he sojourned , and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose  ;
kha: Uno uno u Lebi uba don ka jingkwah , u lah ban wan na kano kano ka shnong ha Israel sha kata ka jaka mane Blei
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u Lebi u wan na kano kano ka khyrdop jong me na ki Israel baroh, ha kaba u la sahkut, bad u wan ryngkat bad ka jingkwah jong u baroh sha ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied;

en: And it came to pass , when Zimri saw that the city was taken , that he went into the palace of the king s house , and burnt the king s house over him with fire , and died ,
kha: Haba u Simri u ïohi ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon , u leit sha ka kut kaba shapoh jong ka ïingsyiem , u thang ïa ka ïingsyiem da ka ding bad u la ïap ha ki thylliej ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zimri u la iohi ba la shim ia ka shnong, u la leit shapoh ka iing syiem bad u la thang ia ka iing syiem halor jong u da ka ding bad u la iap .

en: Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .
kha: Phi long kiba riewspah katta katta ha baroh kiba phi don : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ban ïarap bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta ngi kwah ïa phi ban long kiba sbun ruh ha kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, kumba phi nang bun ha kiei kiei baroh, ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingstad, bad ha ka jingminot baroh, bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ia ngi, to iohi ba phi nang bun ha kane ka jingaiei ruh .

en: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
kha: Ko ki mrad , wat sheptieng . Ki jaka phlang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki dieng ki sei ïa la ki soh , bad don kyrhai ki soh Dumbur bad sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng, phi ki mrad khlaw: namar ki jaka ri jingri jong ka ri khlaw ki mih , namar u dieng u sei soh ia u soh jong u , u dieng sohjew bad u sohjew ki ai ia ka bor jong ki .

en: And some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to buffet him , and to say unto him , Prophesy : and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la sdang ban bynthiew ïa U Jisu bad ki la tap-matlah ïa u bad ki la shoh ïa u .  Ïathuh uei uba la shoh ïa me !  ki la ong . Bad ki nongap phira ki la shim ïa u bad ki la thab ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la sdang ban sngap jar ia u, bad ban tap ia ka khmat jong u, bad ban pynkhih ia u, bad ban ong ha u, To iathuhlypa: bad ki shakri ki la shoh ia u da ki kti jong ki .

en: So shall ye know that I am the  Lord  your God dwelling in Zion , my holy mountain : then shall Jerusalem be holy , and there shall no strangers pass through her any more .
kha: Te ko Israel , phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong pha . Nga shong ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga . Ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah bakyntang ; ki nongwei kin ym lah ban jop shuh ïa ka lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba shong ha Seion, u lum bakhuid jong nga: nangta ka Jerusalem kan long kaba khuid, bad ym don ki nongwei kiba iaid lyngba jong ka shuh .

en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked , yet will he not learn righteousness : in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly , and will not behold the majesty of the  Lord .
kha: Wat la me lehsbun ïa ki riewbymman , pynban kim ju hikai ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Wat hangne ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba hok ki dang leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki kyntait ban ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba un sngewbha ia kiba sniew, hynrei un ym nang ia ka hok: ha ka ri kaba hok un leh khlem hok , bad un ym iohi ia ka jingkhraw jong U Trai .

en: If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .
kha: Lehse ki briew kin shahshkor bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti basniew . Lada ki leh kumta , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynjot kaba nga la thmu ban wallam halor jong ki na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kumta kin sngap , bad kin phai noh na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u , ba ngan kylla bamut noh na ka jingsniew kaba nga thmu ban leh ia ki namar ka jingsniew jong ki jingleh jong ki .

en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them , with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria , and with all on whom she doted : with all their idols she defiled herself .
kha: Ka long ka nuti ïa baroh ki shipai Assyria , bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka , ka pynlong ïa ka ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la leh ia ki kam sniew jong ka bad ki, bad kita baroh kiba la jied jong ka Assyria, bad bad baroh kiba ka la sngewtynnad: da ki bleithaw jong ki baroh ka la pynjakhlia ia lade .

en: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee , I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath , and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men , and skilful to destroy .
kha: Phin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga phai jar jar ha phi kum ka ding baklang . Bad ngan aiti ïa phi ha ki briew bashyrkhei , kiba tbit ha ka ban pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong me , ngan beh pyrshah ia me ha ka ding jong ka jingbitar jong nga , bad ngan aiti ia me ha ka kti jong ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba tbit ban pynjot .

en: And he put garrisons in Edom  ; throughout all Edom put he garrisons , and all they of Edom became David s servants . And the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
kha: U la pynïeng ki dara sah shipai ha kylleng ka Edom , bad ki briew hangta ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban jop kylleng kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki shipai ha Edom ; ha ka ri Edom baroh kawei u la buh ia ki shipai, bad baroh ki briew jong ka ri Edom ki la long ki shakri jong u Dabid . Bad U Trai u la pynneh pynsah ia u Dabid shano shano ruh ba u leit .

en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
kha: Ka kyrteng uta u Israel uba la shah pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka long u Simri u khun jong u Salu , u khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka kyrteng jong u Israel uba la shah pyniap, wat ia kata ka kynthei Midini, ka long u Zimri u khun u Salu, u syiem jong ka iing kaba ha khlieh duh hapdeng ki Leehoion .

en: And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi sha ka lyer sepngi kaba jur , kaba la rong noh ïa ki puit bad bret ïa ki sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei ruh u puit ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynkylla ia ka Iyer kaba khlain bha shaphang shathie , kaba la weng noh ia ki khnai , bad u la bret ia ki shapoh ka duriaw Basaw ; ym don kawei ruh ka jaka sah ha ki rud duriaw baroh jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi  ; and called them after his own name , Bashan–havoth–jair , unto this day .
kha: U Jair , uba na ka jait Manasseh , u la kam kynti ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei , kata ka mut ïa ka Bashan , haduh u pud jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah . U khot ïa kine ki shnong da ka kyrteng la jong , bad haduh mynta la dang tip ïa ki kum ki shnong u Jair . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Jair u khun u Manasseh u la shim ia ka ri Argob baroh kawei haduh ki rud jong ka Geshuri bad Maachathi ; bad u la khot ia ki kat kum ka kyrteng jong u hi, u Basanhavothjair haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;
kha: Uwei na ki , u lah ban pynshoi ïa phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kita ki briew kiba shong marjan bad phi , lane kiba shong sha jngai na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata , na ki blei jong ki briew kiba don sawdong jong phi, hajan jong phi, ne jngai na phi, naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka khyndew haduh kawei pat ka tduh jong ka khyndew;

en: That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :
kha: sha kiba u briew u lah ban phet rieh bad lait im lada jia ba u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei u nongshun jong u . U lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na kine ki shnong bad un ym shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba u nongpyniap briew un phet noh sha kata ka jaka, kaba dei ban pyniap ia u para marjan jong u khlem da tip, bad um shym la shun ia u ha ki por ba la leit noh; bad kata ka phet noh sha kawei na kine ki nongbah ka lah ban im:

en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham , to thee , and to thy seed with thee  ; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger , which God gave unto Abraham .
kha: To un kyrkhu ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me kumba u la kyrkhu ïa u Abraham , bad ai ba men shim kynti ïa kane ka ri ha kaba me la shong la sah bad ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ia me ia ka jingkyrkhu jong u Abraham, ha me bad ha u symbai jong me bad me ba me lah ban ioh pateng ia ka ri ha kaba me long u nongwei, kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham .

en: And go quickly , and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead  ; and , behold , he goeth before you into Galilee  ; there shall ye see him : lo , I have told you .
kha: Khie leit bran bran mynta , bad ïathuh ha ki synran jong u , ‘ La pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , bad mynta u dang leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u !’ To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to leit noh kloi bad iathuh ha ki synran jong u ba u la mihpat na kiba iap; bad, ha khmih, u leit shuwa jong phi sha Galilaia; hangta phin sa iohi ia u: ha khmih, nga la iathuh ha phi .

en: And this is the will of him that sent me , that every one which seeth the Son , and believeth on him , may have everlasting life : and I will raise him up at the last day .
kha: Naba kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u kwah , ka long ba baroh kiba ïohi ïa U Khun bad ngeit ha u , ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad ngan pynmihpat ïa ki ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka mon jong uta uba la phah ia nga, ba uno uno uba iohi ia U Khun bad uba ngeit ha u, un ioh ia ka jingim bymjukut: bad ngan pynmihpat ia u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .
kha: Kaei kaba ngin leh ïa kine ki briew ?  ki la kylli .  Uwei uwei baroh ha Jerusalem u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kaba pher la leh da ma ki , bad ngim lah ban len ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ngi leh aiu ia kine ki briew ? namar kata shisha ka kambah kaba pawnam ka la long kaba paw ha ki baroh kiba shong ha Jerusalem ; bad ngim lah ban kyntait ia ka .

en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .
kha: ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim ban ong ,  Ki Philistia ki la pynphai ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai . Ale wan shim noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Kirjathjaram, ki da ong: Ki Philistia ki la wanrah biang ia ka synduk U Trai ; phi wan hiar shapoh jong phi .

en: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium , who persuaded the people , and , having stoned Paul , drew him out of the city , supposing he had been dead .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Jiw ki la wan na Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia bad na Ikoniom ; ki la ïoh ïa u paidbah sha ka liang jong ki , ki la lynthem maw ïa u Paul bad ki la paring ïa u shabar shnong , da kaba pyrkhat ba u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don kiwei pat ki Jiw na Antioch bad Iconia kiba la pynsngewthuh ia ki briew bad haba ki la pynkhih ia u Paul, ki la tan ia u na ka shnong da kaba shim ba u la iap .

en: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;
kha: U Blei um shym la klet ïa u Noah , bad ïa ki mrad baroh kiba ïadon lem bad u ha ka lieng ; u la pynlong ïa ka lyer ban beh , bad ka um ka la sdang hiar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la kynmaw ia u Noah bad ia ki jingthaw ba im baroh bad ki masi baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ha ka lieng: bad U Blei u la pynlong ia ka Iyer ban iaid halor ka khyndew bad ki um ki la jah noh;

en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked , therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north :
kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam jong nga pyrshah ïa baroh na shatei haduh shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba iohi nangta ba ngan ot noh na me ia kiba hok bad kiba sniew , namarkata ka waitlam jong nga kan mih noh na ka sniehdoh jong u pyrshah ia ka doh baroh na shaphang shathie:

en: Hear now , O Joshua the high priest , thou , and thy fellows that sit before thee : for they are men wondered at : for , behold , I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH .
kha: Kumta to pynshahshkor , ko Joshua , me uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh , to pynshahshkor , phi ki para lyngdoh jong u , ma phi kiba long ka dak jong ka lawei babha : Ngan pynpaw ïa la u shakri , ïa uba la khot U Tnat !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap mynta, ko Joshua u rangbah lyngdoh, me bad ki paralok jong me kiba shong ha khmat jong me: namar ki long ki briew kiba lyngngoh: namar, ha khmih, ngan wanrah ia u shakri jong nga u BRANCH .

en: Behold , he cometh with clouds  ; and every eye shall see him , and they also which pierced him : and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him . Even so , Amen .
kha: Ha khmih , u wan ha ki lyoh ! Baroh kin ïohi ïa u , kynthup ïa kito kiba la sum ïa u . Ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei kin ïamkthang namar jong u . Kumta kan long !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , u wan ryngkat bad ki lyoh ; bad kawei pa kawei ka khmat kan iohi ia u: bad ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew kin iaid namar jong u . Wat la katta ruh, Amen .

en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .
kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew saw ton ka rupa ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u ban nang pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pul u syiem Assyria u la wan pyrshah ia ka ri: bad u Menahem u la ai ia u Pul shi hajar talent rupa, ba ka kti jong u kan long bad u ban pynskhem ia ka hima ha ka kti jong u .

en: And when thou art come in , thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons , and shalt pour out into all those vessels , and thou shalt set aside that which is full .
kha: Nangta ma phi bad ki khun shynrang jong phi leit shapoh ïing , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad sdang phylliew ïa ka umphniang ha ki khra . Buh sharud ïa uwei pa uwei kat uba nang dap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda me la wan rung, to khang ia ka jingkhang halor jong me bad halor ki khun shynrang jong me, bad to theh shabar ha kita ki khiew baroh, bad to buh noh ia kata kaba dap .

en: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .
kha: Ka kamra rung ka la long marpyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong halor ki kynroh jong ka lynti ïaid . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki post jong ka ki long sha ka iingbishar kaba shabar bad ki dieng sohjew ki don ha ki post jong ka, ha kane ka liang bad ha kata ka liang: bad ka jingleit sha ka ka don 8 tylli ki step .

en: In the same day the  Lord  made a covenant with Abram , saying , Unto thy seed have I given this land , from the river of Egypt unto the great river , the river Euphrates :
kha: Hangta hangta hi , U  Trai  u pynlong ka jutang bad u Abram . U ong ,  Nga kular ban ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa kane ka ri , naduh ka khappud Ijipt haduh ka Wah Ïuphratis ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi U Trai u la leh ia ka jutang bad u Abram, u da ong: Ha u symbai jong me nga la ai ia kane ka ri, naduh ka wah Ijipt haduh ka wah bah , ka wah Euphrates:

en: When I blow with a trumpet , I and all that are with me , then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp , and say , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
kha: Ynda ma nga bad ka kynhun jong nga ngi put ïa la ki turoi , phi ruh put ïa la ki turoi baroh sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad pyrta jam , ‘ Ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !’
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga beh da ka turoi , ma nga bad kiba don ryngkat bad nga , te phi beh ia ki turoi ruh ha man la ki liang jong ka shnong baroh kawei bad phi ong , Ka waitlam U Trai bad u Gideon .

en: Then Judas , which had betrayed him , when he saw that he was condemned , repented himself , and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders ,
kha: Haba u Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ba ïa U Jisu la dep pynrem , u la kylla-kaba-mut bad u la leit rah biang ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Judas uba la shet kylla ia u haba u la iohi ba u la shah pynrem, u la kylla bamut bad u la wanrah biang ia ki laiphew tylli ki rupa sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah .

en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud men shim ïa u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ai ïa u kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . To pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u ha kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar men aiti ia u khun masi khlem jingduna na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; bad kin pynkhuid ia ka nongrim kumba ki la pynkhuid ia ka da u masi .

en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .
kha: Lymda kumta ka la dei ïa u ban shah bunsien naduh myn dang long ka pyrthei . Pynban , mynta haba ka por baroh ka la jan poi sha kaba kut , u la paw tang shisien hi , ban pyndam noh ïa ka pop da kaba kñia ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kata ka por u la shah shitom bunsien naduh ka jingsdang jong ka pyrthei: hynrei mynta shisien ha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei u la paw ba u la weng noh ia ka pop da ka jingknia ia lade .

en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;
kha: Long ba la tim ïa u briew uba tei ïa la ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynheh pynïar ïa ka da ka jingleh bymhok ; uba pynlong ïa la ki para shnong ban trei khlem kam , bad u bym siew bainong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To u briew uba tei ia ka iing jong u da ka jingbymhok, bad ki kamra jong u da kaba bakla;

en: He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .
kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shah ïa ka jingshitom bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ban peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u bym long ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: La niewbein bad kyntait ia u da ki briew; bad ngi la ithuh ia u da ka jingsngewsih: bad ngi la buhrieh kumba ki long ki khmat jong ngi na u; bad ngim shym la burom ia u .

en: And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .
kha: Kumba nga la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka sngi , ai ba U  Trai  un leh kumjuh ïa nga bad pyllait ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jong nga baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, kumba ka jingim jong me ka la long kaba la buh da kane ka sngi ha ki khmat jong nga, kumta to ai ba ka jingim jong nga kan long kaba la buh da ka jingim jong nga ha khmat U Trai, bad to ai ba un pyllait ia nga na ka jingjynjar baroh .

en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them  ; none shall slumber nor sleep  ; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed , nor the latchet of their shoes be broken :
kha: Ym don mano mano na ki , kiba la sdang thait , bad ym don mano mano na ki , kiba jynthut . Kim ju samthiah lane thiah . Ym don u  saipan ba la lait , ym don u ksai juti uba la dkut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh kiba sngewsih ne kiba lyngngoh hapdeng jong ki ; ym don mano mano ruh ki bym thiah ne thiah ; lymne ka tyrpeng jong ki kan ym shah pyllait , lymne ka tyrpeng jong ki juti jong ki kan ym shah pynpra:

en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness , they looked unto the multitude , and , behold , they were dead bodies fallen to the earth , and none escaped .
kha: Haba ka kynhun shipai Judah ka la poi ha ka jaka ba don u mot ha ka ri shyiap , ki peit sha ki nongshun bad ïohi ba ki la thiah ïap ha madan . Ym don uwei uba lait phet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la wan sha ka jaka pahara ha ri khlaw , ki la peit sha u paidbah bad , ha khmih , ki la hap ha ka khyndew , bad ym don ba lait im .

en: The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa phi ; u la weng noh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh . U  Trai  , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad phi ; ym don daw mynta ban sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la weng noh ia ki jingbishar jong me, u la bret noh ia u nongshun jong me: u syiem Israel , wat U Trai ruh u don hapdeng jong me: men ym iohi shuh ia ka jingsniew .

en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite , and Jadon the Meronothite , the men of Gibeon , and of Mizpah , unto the throne of the governor on this side the river .
kha: U Melataïah na Gibeon , u Jadon na Meronoth , bad ki rangbah ka Gibeon bad Mispah , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka jaka sah jong u lat ka Ïuphratis kaba shaphang sepngi .
