translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u Melatiah u nong Gibeon bad u Jadon u nong Meronot , ki briew jong ka Gibeon bad ka Mizpah , haduh ka khet jong u Lat ha kane ka liang ka wah .

en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight , as stuff for removing : and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight , as they that go forth into captivity .
kha: Katba ka dang shai , to teh ïa ka song jong me na ka bynta ka jingshah ringmraw , khnang ba kin lah ban ïohi ïa me , bad nangta shah ïa ki ban khmih ïa me ba me mihnoh ha ka premmiet kumba me leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to wanrah ia ki tiar jong me ha ka sngi ha khmat jong ki: bad me leit noh ha ka por janmiet ha khmat jong ki , kumba ki leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst , saying , The  Lord  our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
kha: U Hesekaïah u ïathuh ïa phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pyllait ïa phi na ka bor jong ngi , hynrei u Hesekaïah u shukor ïa phi bad un shah ba phin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingsliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u Hesekaiah um pynbor ia phi ban aiti noh ia lade da ka jingkyrduh bad da ka jingthngan , da kaba ong , U Trai U Blei jong ngi un pyllait ia ngi na ka kti u syiem Assyria ?

en: Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .
kha: Don uwei pat u ban ong ,  Ka jingbam ka dei na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ka jingbam .  Ho-oid , hynrei U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam awria , hynrei ïa ka ban shakri ïa U Trai ; bad U Trai u bsa ïa ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki doh na ka bynta ka kpoh, bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ki doh: hynrei U Blei un pynjot ia ka bad ia ki . Mynta ka met kam dei na ka bynta ka jingleh be-ijot , hynrei na ka bynta U Trai; bad U Trai na ka bynta ka met .

en: For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .
kha: U Blei uba la ong ,  Na ka jingdum ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ!  u long ujuh U Blei uba la pynlong ïa ka jingshai jong u ban tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ngi , ban wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka burom U Blei kaba tyngshaiñ ha U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Blei uba la hukum ia ka jingshai ban shai na ka jingdum , u la shai ha ki dohnud jong ngi , ban ai ia ka jingshai jong ka jingtip ia ka burom U Blei ha khmat U Jisu Khrist .

en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
kha: Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei bad ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla kaba dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jong ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ain kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses, hapdeng u shynrang bad ka tnga jong u, hapdeng u kpa bad ka khun jong u, haba ka dang don ha ka jinglong samla jong ka ha iing u kpa jong ka .

en: Therefore will I return , and take away my corn in the time thereof , and my wine in the season thereof , and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness .
kha: Kumta ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , bad ngan shim noh ruh ïa u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan wan phai noh ia u kew jong nga ha ka por jong ka, bad ka wain jong nga ha ka aiom jong ka, bad ngan sa koit noh ia ka snieh langbrot jong nga bad ka snieh jong nga kaba la ai ban tap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka .

en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways , and your doings that were not good , and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .
kha: Phin sa kynmaw ïa ki jingleh bymman jong phi bad ïa ki jingbakla ba phi la leh , bad phin sa isih ïa lade namar ki pop jong phi bad ki jingleh palat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin kynmaw ia la ki jong ki lynti kiba sniew bad ki jingleh bym shym la long kiba bha , bad phin ia lade ha la ka jong ka khmat na ka bynta ki jingbymhok jong phi bad na ka bynta ki jingleh bymman jong phi .

en: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .
kha: U Joseph u ong ,  O , em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta ! Tang uta keiñ ha uba la shem ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga . Kiwei pat na phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: U Blei un ym lah ban leh kumta: hynrei uta u briew ha uba la lap ia ka khuri, un long u shakri jong nga ; bad phi pat phi khie noh ha ka jingsuk ha u kpa jong phi .

en: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries , and against great kingdoms , of war , and of evil , and of pestilence .
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren slem bah mynshuwa , ha shuwa ka por jong nga bad jong phi , ki la ïathuhlypa shaphang kata ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ïa ka jingpang ki ban wan ha ki jaitbynriew babun bad ha ki hima bakhrawbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la don ha khmat jong nga bad ha khmat jong me ki la iathuhlypa baroh ar ki ri bad pyrshah ia ki hima kiba khraw , jong ka thma bad jong ka jingsniew bad jong ka jingpang .

en: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom , and with Birsha king of Gomorrah , Shinab king of Admah , and Shemeber king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela , which is Zoar .
kha: ki la leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki san ngut kiwei pat ki syiem : u Bera jong ka Sodom , u Birsha jong ka Gomorrah , u Shinab jong ka Admah , u Shemeber jong ka Seboiim , bad u syiem jong ka Bela ( lane Soar ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kine ki la ialeh thma bad u syiem Bera u syiem u Gomorrah bad u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syiem u syi

en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed ? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard ? and how shall they hear without a preacher ?
kha: Hynrei kumno kin lah ban khot kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta ka jingïarap lada kim shym la ngeit ? Bad kumno kin lah ban ngeit lada kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Bad kumno ki lah ban ïohsngew lada ïa ka khubor ym shym la pynbna ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno te kin khot ia uta ha uba kim shym la ngeit ? bad kumno kin ngeit ia uta uba kim shym la iohsngew ? bad kumno kin iohsngew khlem u nongialap ?

en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .
kha: Wat la u syiem Jehoshaphat u shong u sah ha Jerusalem , u leit borabor sha ki briew , na Beersheba shaphang shathie shaduh kaba kut jong ka ri lum Ephraim shaphang shatei , khnang ban khot pat ïa ki briew sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la shong ha Jerusalem : bad u la leit phai biang lyngba ki briew na Beersheba ban kiew Ephraham , bad u la wanrah biang ia ki sha U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .
kha: Te kumta , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga , to long phi kiba ïeng skhem bad kiba ïaineh . To long kiba ïai trei minot ïa ka kam U Trai , namar phi tip ba kano kano kaba phi leh ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai kam ju long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ko para baieit jong nga, to long kiba skhem, ki bym lah ban khih, kiba ju bun ha ka kam U Trai, kumba phi tip ba ka jingtrei shitom jong phi kam long lehnohei ha U Trai .

en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .
kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom jong u la sait ha ka pung Samaria ; ha kaba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam jong u , bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , kumba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la sait ia ka kali ha ka pung Samaria bad ki kulai ki la dih ia ka snam jong u ; bad ki la sait ia ki jainkup jong u ; kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u la kren .

en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth part  ; except the land of the priests only , which became not Pharaoh s .
kha: Kumta u Joseph u shna ïa ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka khyndew ha ri Ijipt ba kaba shi bynta na ka san bynta na ka jinglum ha ka aïom ot kan long ka jong u syiem . Kane ka aiñ ka dang neh haduh kane ka sngi . Tang ka khyndew jong ki lyngdoh te kam shym kylla long ka jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la pynlong ia ka ain halor ka ri Ijipt haduh kine ki sngi, ba u Pharaoh u dei ban don ia ka bynta kaba phra ; lait noh tang ka ri jong ki lyngdoh tang , kaba ym long u Pharaoh s .

en: And the number of them that lapped , putting their hand to their mouth , were three hundred men : but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water .
kha: La don laispah ngut ki rangbah kiba tong um da ki kti jong ki bad jliah ïa ka ; baroh kita kiwei pat ki dem khohsiew ban dih um .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingdon jong kita kiba la lyngngoh, da kaba buh ia la ka kti ha ka shyntur jong ki: hynrei kiwei pat ki briew ki la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong ki ban dih um .

en: Then Peter , turning about , seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following  ; which also leaned on his breast at supper , and said , Lord , which is he that betrayeth thee ?
kha: U Petros u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi hadien jong u ïa uta uwei pat u synran , ïa uba U Jisu u ieit — uta uba la shong shaniah ha U Jisu ha ka jingïabam miet bad uba la kylli ,  Ko Trai , uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la phai sha shiliang, u la iohi ia uta u synran uba U Jisu u ieit ban bud ; uba ruh u la shong ha ka shyntur jong u ha ka por bam ja miet, bad u la ong: Ko Trai , mano ba shet kylla ia me ?

en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it  ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .
kha: Hangta lano lano phin ym thngan , bad phin ym kyrduh ei ei . Ha ki mawsiang jong ka don u nar , bad ha ki lum jong ka lah ban tih tama .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ri ha kaba me bam ia u kpu khlem ka jingduna, wat duna ei ei ha ka ; ka ri kaba ki maw jong ka ki long ki nar , bad na ki lum jong ka me lah ban tih ia ka nar .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast clapped thine hands , and stamped with the feet , and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel  ;
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : phi la thab ïa ki kti bad kynthih da ka jingkmen . Phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka ri ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; Namar me la ia tyngkhuh bad ki kjat jong me, bad me la ia kmen ha ka dohnud jong me baroh wat hapdeng ka ri Israel;

en: Then I arose , and went forth into the plain : and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  stood there , as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar : and I fell on my face .
kha: Kumta nga la leit sha ka them , bad hangta nga ïohi ïa ka burom U  Trai  , kumba nga la ïohi ïa ka harud ka wah Khebar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ieng , bad nga la leit sha ka madan : bad, ha khmih, ka burom U Trai ka la ieng hangta, kum ka burom kaba nga la iohi da ka wah Chebar: bad nga la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong nga .

en: And he shall bring them unto the priest , who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first , and wring off his head from his neck , but shall not divide it asunder :
kha: Un wanrah ïa ki ha u lyngdoh , u ban kñia shuwa ïa ka sim na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Un khyrwait ïa ka ryndang jong ka khlem da pyndkut ïa ka khlieh na ka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un wanrah ia ki sha u lyngdoh uba ai ia kata kaba long na ka bynta ka jingknia pop nyngkong eh bad un ot noh ia ka khlieh jong u na ka ryndang jong u , hynrei un ym phiah ia ka:

en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread : and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians , Go unto Joseph  ; what he saith to you , do .
kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban kyrduh bam , ki la leit ud sha u syiem ba un ai bam ïa ki . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki ban leit sha u Joseph , bad ban leh kat kaba u ong ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka la shah thngan, ki briew ki la pyrta ha u Pharaoh na ka bynta u kpu: bad u Pharaoh u la ong ha ki nong Ijipt baroh: Leit sha u Joseph; kaei kaba u ong ha phi: To leh .

en: Son of man , take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre , and say unto him , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Thou sealest up the sum , full of wisdom , and perfect in beauty .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to sngewsih ïa ka kupar kaba ap ïa u syiem ka Tyros . Ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong : Shisien me la long u nuksa jong ka jingjanai . Katno uba stad bad uba bhabriew me la long !
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, to shim ia ka jingsngewsih halor u syiem Tyros, bad to ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Me pynkhuid ia ka jingkhein kaba dap da ka jingstad bad kaba janai ha ka jingitynnad .

en: Their webs shall not become garments , neither shall they cover themselves with their works : their works are works of iniquity , and the act of violence is in their hands .
kha: Hynrei ki jingïasylla jong phi kim wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phi — ki long bymlarkam kum ka jaiñphong ba la thain da ka snur thapbawa !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki web jong ki kin ym kylla jain , bad kin ym tap ia lade da ki kam jong ki: ki kam jong ki ki long ki kam bymman , bad ka kam leh donbor ka don ha ki kti jong ki .

en: For these nations , which thou shalt possess , hearkened unto observers of times , and unto diviners : but as for thee , the  Lord  thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .
kha: Kumta U Moses u ong ,  Ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , ki briew ki shahshkor ïa kito kiba shat kiba kheiñ bad kiba wad ïa ki dak ki shin , hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u khang ïa phi ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine ki jaitbynriew, kiba me don, ki la sngap ia ki nongpeitkai ia ki por, bad ia ki nongleh jadu: hynrei ia me , U Trai U Blei jong me um shym la shah ia me ban leh kumta .

en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .
kha: Ngi ngeit mynta , ym namar kaei kaba pha la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma ngi hi da lade ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi tip ba une da shisha u long u Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha kata ka kynthei: Mynta ngi ngeit ym namar ka jingong jong me: namar ngi la iohsngew ia u hi: bad ngi tip ba une u long shisha U Khrist U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .

en: I beseech you therefore , brethren , by the mercies of God , that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice , holy , acceptable unto God , which is your reasonable service .
kha: Kumta te , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong U Blei ïa ngi , nga kyrpad ïa phi : To aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia ba-im sha U Blei , ba la pynkyntang ha ka jingshakri ïa u bad ka jingpynsngewbha ïa u . Kane ka long ka jingmane bashisha kaba phi dei ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia phi namarkata, ko para bangeit, da ki jingsngewrit U Blei, ba phi ai ia ki met jong phi ka jingknia kaba im, kaba khuid, kaba pdiang sngewbha ia U Blei, kaba long ka jingshakri kaba don jingmut jong phi .

en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .
kha: Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jong ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun ; ki khun kin phai ïaleh pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u hynmen un aiti noh ia u hynmen haduh ka jingiap, bad u kpa u khun: bad ki khun kin ieng pyrshah ia ki kmie ki kpa jong ki , bad kin pynlong ia ki ban shah pyniap .

en: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half , and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves .
kha: Ki briew na baroh ki hima , ki kynja bynriew , ki jait ktien , bad ki jaitbynriew kin shu khmih ïa kita ki metïap jong ki haduh lai sngi shiteng bad kin ym shah ban tep ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew bad ki jaitbynriew bad ki thylliej bad ki jaitbynriew kin iohi ia ki met iap jong ki lai sngi shiteng , bad kin ym shah ia ki met iap jong ki ban shah tep .

en: So these nations feared the  Lord  , and served their graven images , both their children , and their children s children : as did their fathers , so do they unto this day .
kha: Kumta kito ki briew ki la mane ïa U  Trai  , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ; bad haduh kane ka sngi kiba hiarpateng na ki , ki ïai leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kine ki jaitbynriew ki la sheptieng ia U Trai, bad ki la shakri ia ki dur ba la shna da ki khun jong ki bad ki khun jong ki: kumba ki kpa jong ki ki la leh haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .
kha: Khie leit sha ka shnong hangta kaba ha khmat jong phi ; haba phi rung shapoh , phin shem ïa u khun kada uba la teh ha uba ym pat ju don bashong halor jong u . To loit bad wallam ïa u shane .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , To leit shapoh shnong pyrshah ia phi ; ha kaba ha ka por ba phi rung phin shem ia u khun masi ba la teh, ha kaba ym pat ju shong: pyllait ia u, bad wanrah ia u hangne .

en: Six days may work be done  ; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest , holy to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day , he shall surely be put to death .
kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka long ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi lah ban trei hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynriew ka long ka sngi shongthait kaba kyntang ha U Trai: uno uno uba leh ia kano kano ka kam ha ka sngi shongthait , un shah pyniap shisha .

en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished , as a mighty man that cannot save ? yet thou , O  Lord  , art in the midst of us , and we are called by thy name  ; leave us not .
kha: Balei me long kum u briew uba la shah shim kynsan , kum u shipai u bymdonbor ban ïarap ? Da shisha , A  Trai  , me long bad ngi ! ngi long ki briew jong me ; wat iehnoh ïa ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me dei ban long kum u briew uba la lyngngoh, kum u briew uba khlain bor uba ym lah ban pynim ? hynrei me, ko Trai, me don hapdeng jong ngi , bad la khot ia ngi da ka kyrteng jong me; wat iehnoh ia ngi .

en: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners , they said unto his disciples , How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners ?
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum , kiba long ki Pharisi , ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïabam bad kine ki briew ba la shah kyntait lem bad ki nonglum khajna , kumta ki la kylli ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei ba u ïabam lang bad kum kine ki briew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi ki la iohi ia u ba u bam bad ki nongpop bad ki nongpop , ki la ong ha ki synran jong u , Kumno u bam bad u dih bad ki nongpop bad ki nongpop ?

en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .
kha: Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine ki miej ba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ban thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew kylliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka phyllaw jong ka khyrdop ki don ar tylli ki miej na kane ka liang bad ar tylli ki miej na kata ka liang, ban pyniap ia ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingainguh pop bad ka jingainguh pop .

en: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom , and to see the business that is done upon the earth : ( for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes : )
kha: Man ba nga pyrshang ban long stad bad ban tip kaei kaba jia ha ka pyrthei , nga la sngewthuh ba phi lah ban peitmat , miet la bad sngi
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong nga ban tip ia ka jingstad, bad ban iohi ia ka kam kaba la leh ha ka khyndew: (na ka don ruh ba ym don ka sngi ne ka miet kaba thiah bad ki khmat jong u: )

en: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt : for in her youth they lay with her , and they bruised the breasts of her virginity , and poured their whoredom upon her .
kha: Ka ïai bteng na kaei kaba ka la sdang kum ka nuti ha Ijipt , hangta ha kaba la duh noh ïa la ka jinglong sotti . Naduh ka por ba ka long ka samla ba dang khynraw , ki rangbah ki la ïathiah bad ka bad leh ïa ka la kum ka nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kam shym la iehnoh ia ki jingkhaii met jong ka kiba la wanrah na Ijipt: namar ha ka jinglong samla jong ka ki la thiah bad ka, bad ki la pynmong ia ki bniat jong ka jinglong kynthei jong ka, bad ki la theh ia ka jingkhaii met jong ki ha ka .

en: And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown  ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka lynti ïaid ; ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , u Soitan u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ha rud lynti, ha kaba la bet ia ka ktien ; hynrei ynda ki la iohsngew , u Soitan u wan mardor , bad u shim noh ia ka ktien kaba la bet ha ki dohnud jong ki .

en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .
kha: Katba ki kynthih halor ki lumbah , ki riew kum ki kali ïapom ; ki sawa kum u phlangïap ha ka ding . Ki ïeng laiñ kum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kum ka jingsawa jong ki kali ha ki tduh lum kin kiew, kum ka jingsawa jong ka ding kaba bam ia u dieng , kum ki briew kiba khlain kiba la buh ha ka thma .

en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets  ; This man is not worthy to die : for he hath spoken to us in the name of the  Lord  our God .
kha: Nangta ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki ong ha ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa ,  Une u briew u la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; um dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ki rangbah bad ki briew baroh ha ki lyngdoh bad ha ki nongiathuhlypa: Une u briew um dei ban iap: namar u la kren ia ngi ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ngi .

en: Before the decree bring forth , before the day pass as the chaff , before the fierce anger of the  Lord  come upon you , before the day of the  Lord s  anger come upon you .
kha: ha shuwa ba yn beh noh ïa pha kum ïa u stait ba la beh noh da ka lyer , ha shuwa ba ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai  ka wan halor jong pha , ha shuwa ka sngi ha kaba u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuwa ba ka hukum kan mih , shuwa ba ka sngi kan iaid kum ka sniehdoh , shuwa ba ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai kan wan ha phi , shuwa ba ka sngi U Trai kan wan ha phi .

en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .
kha: Hynrei mem dei ban shah ïa u ban lait khlem ka jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba men leh , bad me dei ban khmih ba u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta wat bat ia u khlem pop: namar me long u briew uba stad bad me tip ia kaei kaba me dei ban leh ia u ; hynrei ka khlieh jong u me pynhiar shapoh ka jingtep da ka snam .

en: ( For they will come out after us ) till we have drawn them from the city  ; for they will say , They flee before us , as at the first : therefore we will flee before them .
kha: Kin wan beh ïa ngi haduh ba ngin da ïalam ïa ki kham sha jngai na ka nongbah . Kin pyrkhat ba ngi la phet ïap na ki , kumba ngi leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: (Namar kin mih hadien jong ngi ) haduh ba ngin da tan ia ki na ka nongbah ; namar kin ong , Ki phet noh ha khmat jong ngi kumba ha kaba nyngkong: namarkata ngin phet noh ha khmat jong ki .

en: Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .
kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan long u  sai-thew na ka bynta ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok kan long u  sai-sawar jong ka .  U phria un sar noh ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shaniah , bad ki jingshlei kin pynjot ïa ki jingsngewshngain jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbishar ruh ngan buh ha u lain, bad ka hok ha ka plummet: bad u hail un rong noh ia ka jaka rieh jong ki jinglamler , bad ki um kin tuid palat ia ka jaka rieh .

en: And he took the calf which they had made , and burnt it in the fire , and ground it to powder , and strawed it upon the water , and made the children of Israel drink of it .
kha: U shim ïa uta u khun masi uba ki la thaw , u pynum ïa u ha ka ding , bad u tylliat pynlwet jin ïa u , bad u la khleh ïa kata ha ka um . Nangta u la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban dih ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u khun masi uba ki la shna, bad u la thang ia u ha ka ding, bad u la pynlong ia ka ban tyrkhong, bad u la theh ia ka ha ka um , bad u la pynlong ia ki khun Israel ban dih ia ka .

en: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God any bullock , or sheep , wherein is blemish , or any evilfavouredness : for that is an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Wat kñia ainguh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa u masi lane ka langbrot kiba don kano kano ka jingduna ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kaba kum kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat knia ia U Trai jong me ia uno uno u masi ne u langbrot ha kaba u don ka jingduna ne kano kano ka jingsniew: namar kata ka long kaba sngewsih ia U Trai jong me .

en: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan ha nga , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long na ka bynta kum kine .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba U Jisu u la iohi ia ka, u la sngewsih shibun, bad u la ong ha ki, To ai ia ki khynnah rit ban wan sha nga, bad wat khang ia ki: namar na kiba kum kita ka long ka hima U Blei .

en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .
kha: Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh namar ba U  Trai  u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u ban pynlong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap , ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri kan khih bad ka jingsngewsih: namar ka jingthmu jong U Trai kan long pyrshah ia ka ri Babilon , ban pynlong ia ka ri Babilon ka jingjot khlem u nongshong shnong .

en: For , behold , the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts , doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff , the whole stay of bread , and the whole stay of water ,
kha: Mynta u Trai , U  Trai  Badonbor baroh un sa shim noh na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kaei kaei baroh bad ïa uwei pa uwei ba ki briew ki shaniah . Un shim noh ïa ka jingbam bad ka um jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, U Trai, U Trai jong ki paid, u shim noh na Jerusalem bad na Judah ia ka jingsah bad u diengduh baroh kawei ka jingsah jong u kpu bad ka um baroh kawei .

en: Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face  ; for he was afraid to look upon God .
kha: Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob de .  Kumta u Moses u tap ïa la ka khmat , namar um nud ban peit sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la ong , Nga long U Blei jong u kpa jong me, U Blei jong u Abraham, U Blei jong u Isaak bad U Blei jong u Jakob . U Moses u la buhrieh ia la ka khmat; namar u la tieng ban peit ia U Blei .

en: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people  ; as Mordecai had charged her : for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai , like as when she was brought up with him .
kha: Ka Esther kam pat shym la ïathuh ba ka dei ka Jiw . U Mordekai u la ong ïa ka ban ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad ka kohnguh ïa u ha kane , kumba ka la ju kohnguh ïa u mynba ka dang long ka khynnah rit hapoh ka jingsumar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Esther kam pat pyni ia ki paralok jong ka ne ki briew jong ka; namar ka Esther ka la leh ia ka hukum jong u Mordecai kumba la pynsan ia ka bad u .

en: And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka , ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ka la wan sha u, ba ka la pynkhih ia u ban pan na u kpa jong ka: bad ka la pynshai na ka tdong jong ka; bad u Caleb u la ong ha ka: Phi kwah aiu ?

en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half was the length of it , and a cubit and a half the breadth of it , and a cubit and a half the height of it :
kha: U Besalel u shna ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Bezaleel u la shna ia ka synduk dieng shittim: ar cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka , bad shi cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka:

en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon , saying , Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign , and David our lord knoweth it not ?
kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit sha ka Bathsheba , ka kmie jong u Solomon , bad u ong ha ka ,  Phim pat ïohsngew ba u Adonijah , u khun jong ka Haggith u la thung syiem ïa lade ? Bad u Syiem Dabid um tip ei ei shaphang kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Nathan u la kren ha u Bathsheba ka kmie u Solomon, u da ong: Hato phim shym la iohsngew ba u Adonijah u khun u Haggith u synshar, bad u Dabid u kynrad jong ngi um tip ia kata ?

en: But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah da wan bad ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka rukom kin lehbeiñ ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , Uta u Elias u la wan lypa, bad kim ithuh ia u, hynrei ki la leh ia u ia kaei kaei kaba ki la buh . Kumjuh ruh u Khun u briew un shah shitom na ki .

en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .
kha: Khie leit biang , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u don ban ong . Nangta wan phai pat bad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la kren ha phi . Ngin shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: To leit shajan bad to iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong ngi un ong: bad to kren ha ngi baroh ba U Trai U Blei jong ngi un kren ha me; bad ngin sngap ia kata, bad ngin leh ia kata .

en: Moses my servant is dead  ; now therefore arise , go over this Jordan , thou , and all this people , unto the land which I do give to them , even to the children of Israel .
kha: U ong ,  U shakri jong nga , u Moses u la ïap . Khreh mynta , ma me bad ki paid Israel baroh , bad jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u shakri jong nga u la iap; mynta to mih noh, to leit sha kane ka Jordan, me bad kine ki briew baroh, sha ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki, wat ha ki khun Israel .

en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .
kha: Phi dei ban pynkylla ïa ka rukom kaba phi im bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam halor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta pynkylla ia ki lynti bad ki jingleh jong phi, bad kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong phi bad U Trai un kylla bamut noh ia u na ka jingsniew kaba u la pynpaw pyrshah ia phi .

en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these  ; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these .
kha: Kito kiei kiei , ïa kiba la shim nuksa na kita kiba la sdang ha bneng , la dei ban pynkhuid ha kata ka rukom . Hynrei kita kiba kynja bneng hi ki donkam ïa ki jingkñia kiba kham bha shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la long namarkata ba ki rukom jong kiei kiei ha ki bneng kin long kiba la pynkhuid da kine ki ; hynrei kiei kiei kiba ha bneng hi da ki jingknia kiba kham bha ban ia kine .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that this place shall no more be called Topheth , nor The valley of the son of Hinnom , but The valley of slaughter .
kha: Kumta te , ka por kan wan haba ïa kane ka jaka yn ym khot shuh ka Topheth lane ka Them Hinnom . Pynban yn tip ïa ka kum ka Them ka Jingpynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ia kane ka jaka yn ym khot shuh u Tophet, ne ka them u khun u Hinnom , hynrei ka them ka jingpyniap .

en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .
kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u la ïasoh lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit u Ahithophel .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la iathuh ha u Dabid, u da ong, U Ahitophel u long napdeng ki nongthmu bad u Absalom . Bad u Dabid u la ong, ko Trai, nga kyrpad ia me, to pynkylla ia ka jingmut jong u Ahitophel sha ka jingbieit .

en: Thou shalt not wrest judgment  ; thou shalt not respect persons , neither take a gift : for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise , and pervert the words of the righteous .
kha: Kim dei ban leh bymhok lane leh shiliang khmat ha ki jingbishar jong ki ; kim dei ruh ban bamsap , namar ka jingbamsap ka pynmatlah wat ïa kito kiba stad bad kiba hok , bad ki pynlong ïa ki ban rai bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym burom ia ki briew, lymne wat shim ia ka jingai: namar ka jingai ka pynmatlah ia ki khmat kiba stad bad ka pynkylla ia ki ktien kiba hok .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
kha: Ka por kan wan  , ong U  Trai  ,  haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ha khmih ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba kin ym ong shuh: U Trai u im, uba la pynmih ia ki khun Israel na ka ri Ijipt;

en: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat , an Ephrathite of Zeredah , Solomon s servant , whose mother s name was Zeruah , a widow woman , even he lifted up his hand against the king .
kha: Uwei pat u briew uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Solomon u dei uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u , u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba na Seredah kaba ha Ephraim . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka riewkynthei kaba kyrteng ka Seruah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeroboan u khun u Nebat, u nongtrei jong u Seruiah, u shakri u Solomon, uba ka kyrteng jong ka ka long ka Seruiah, ka kynthei kaba la duh noh ia ka kti jong u pyrshah ia u syiem .

en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work  ; but they were men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .
kha: Ïa ki Israel ym shym la pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor , hynrei ki shakri kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongai hukum ïa kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ki khun Israel u Solomon um shym la leh ia ki shakri jong u ; hynrei ki long ki shipai bad ki rangbah shipai jong u bad ki rangbah shipai jong u .

en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard , neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard  ; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Wat leit phai shuh sha ka brisoh ban khar ïa ki sohwaiñ ba la iehnoh lane tam ïa kito ki sohwaiñ kiba la hap ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwei . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban lum ia ka kper sohjew jong me, bad me dei ban lum ia u sohjew jong me baroh u ; me dei ban iehnoh ia ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad kiba nabar: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Uta u lyngdoh un synreit ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong ka duwan ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad un thang ïa ka khleiñ ban pynmih ïa ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un theh ia ka snam halor ka jingkhang jong ka iingmane jong ka jingiaseng bad un thang ia ka shini kum ka jingiwbih kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: They organize assemblies and conventions , coordinate the construction of new Kingdom Halls , and see that literature is shipped to the congregations to supply their needs .
kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa ki jingïaseng asembli bad convention , ki pynïaid ïa ki jingtei ïa ki Ïing Hima bathymmai , bad ki peit ba ki kot ki sla kin poi sha ki balang ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki pynlong ia ki jingiaseng bad ki jingiaseng , ki pyniadei ia ka jingtei ia ki Hall ba thymmai , bad ki iohi ba la phah ia ki kot sha ki jingiaseng ban pyndap ia ki jingdonkam jong ki .

en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father s sister to wife  ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .
kha: U Amram u shongkurim ïa ka Jokhebed , ka para jong u kpa jong u , bad ka la kha ïa u Aaron bad u Moses . U Amram u la im haduh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amram u la shim ia u Jocheb u kpa jong u ha ka tnga jong u; bad ki snem jong ka jingim u Amram ki long shispah laiphew hynriew snem .

en: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )
kha: Hynrei ka ryntieh jong u ka neh khlem khih , Bad ïa ki ksang ti jong u la pynkhlaiñ Da ka bor jong U Blei Uba Khlaiñbor jong u Jakob , Da u Nongap langbrot , U nongïada jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka bow jong u ka la sah ha ka bor , bad ki kti jong u ki la long kiba khlain da ki kti U Blei uba khlain bor jong u Jakob ; (na kata ka long u nongaplangbrot , u maw Israel: )

en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses , and said , Give us water that we may drink . And Moses said unto them , Why chide ye with me ? wherefore do ye tempt the  Lord  ?
kha: Ki la khñium ha u Moses , bad ki la ong ,  Ai um ïa ngi ban dih .  U Moses u ong ha ki ,  Balei keiñ phi ïakhñium ïa nga ? Balei phi tynjuh ïa U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ki briew ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Moses bad ki la ong, Ai um ia ngi ba ngin dih . U Moses u la ong ha ki , Balei phi ia tyngkhuh bad nga ? namar kata phi pynshoi ia U Trai ?

en: Charity never faileth : but whether there be prophecies , they shall fail ; whether there be tongues , they shall cease ; whether there be knowledge , it shall vanish away .
kha: Ka jingieit ka neh bymjukut . Ki don ki khubor da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem , hynrei ki long tang shipor ; ki don ki jingai ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , hynrei kin dam noh ; ka don ka jingtip , hynrei kan sa jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong kaba sniew kam ju duna: hynrei la ki don ki jingiathuhlypa , kin sa jah noh; la ki don ki thylliej , kin sangeh noh; la ka don ka jingtip , kan jah noh .

en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us , lighter , and we will serve thee .
kha: U Solomon u kpa jong phi u la banbeiñ ïa ngi bad u buh ki jingkit kiba khia ha ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynsuk jingim ïa ngi , ngin long ki shakri bashaniah jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong me u la pynlong ia ka jinglong ba sngewsih jong ngi: mynta to pynlong ia ka jingshakri kaba sngewsih jong u kpa jong me, bad ka jinglong ba khia jong u kaba u la buh ha ngi, kaba kham jem, bad ngin shakri ia me .

en: But if they had stood in my counsel , and had caused my people to hear my words , then they should have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .
kha: Lada ki la tip ïa ki jingmut barieh jong nga , te kin jin da la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga sha ki briew jong nga , bad kin jin da la pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa ki jingim basniew ba ki im bad na ki kam bymman ba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ki la ieng ha ka jingai jingmut jong nga bad ki la pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ban iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga , te ki la dei ban pynphai noh ia ki na ka lynti kaba sniew jong ki bad na ka jingsniew jong ki jingleh jong ki .

en: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side  ; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath–shiloh , and passed by it on the east to Janohah  ;
kha: bad nangta sha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ka Mikhmethath ka don ha ka bynta bashatei jong ki . Shaphang mihngi jong kata , u pud u khun sha Taanath Shiloh bad u ïaid lyngba jong ka ha ka phang mihngi shaduh Janoah .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la mih sha duriaw shaphang mihngi; bad u pud u sam u la leit shaphang mihngi haduh Taanathshiloh .

en: And he pressed upon them greatly  ; and they turned in unto him , and entered into his house  ; and he made them a feast , and did bake unleavened bread , and they did eat .
kha: U ïai kyrpad jur ïa ki , bad khatduh ki la leit ryngkat bad u sha ka ïing jong u . U Lot u la hukum ïa la ki shakri ban shet kpu bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka bam kaba bang na ka bynta kine kiba shah khot sngewbha . Haba la dep khreh , ki la ïabam ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih shibun ia ki; bad ki la phai sha u, bad u la rung ha ka iing jong u ; bad u la pynlong ia ki ka jingkhawai , bad u la shet ia u kpu khlem thied , bad ki la bam .

en: Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life  ; but made like unto the Son of God  ; abideth a priest continually .
kha: Ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang u kpa lane ka kmie lane jong kino kino ki kpa tymmen jong u Melkhisedek ; ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang ka jingkha lane ka jingïap jong u . U syriem ïa U Khun U Blei , u ïaisah u lyngdoh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem u kpa, khlem ka kmie, khlem ka jinghiar, khlem ka jingsdang jong ki sngi, ne ka jingkut jong ka jingim hynrei la pynlong kum u Khun U Blei;

en: Then said the king , The one saith , This is my son that liveth , and thy son is the dead : and the other saith , Nay  ; but thy son is the dead , and my son is the living .
kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ,  Kawei pa kawei na phi ka kam ba u khun uba dang im u dei u jong ka bad ba u khun ba la ïap u dei jong kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong: Une u long u khun jong nga uba im, bad u khun jong me u long uba iap: bad uwei pat u ong: Em; hynrei u khun jong me u long uba iap, bad u khun jong nga u long uba im .

en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .
kha: Hynrei haba u angel uba hynñiew u put ïa la ka turoi , te U Blei un pyndep ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u , kumba u la pynbna ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ki sngi jong ka sur jong u angel uba hynriew, haba un sdang ban sawa, ka jingmaham jong U Blei ka dei ban long kaba la pyndep , kumba u la pynbna ha ki shakri jong u ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong u .

en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers , and to the hand of the workmen .
kha: Ngi la shim ïa ka pisa kaba la buh ha ka Templ bad ngi la aiti ha ki nongtrei bad ki nongkhmih ba-halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la lum lang ia ka pisa kaba la lap ha iing U Trai bad ki la aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong ki nongpeit bad ha ka kti jong ki nongtrei .

en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
kha: U Ephraim u don sa ar ngut ki khun shynrang nalor u Shuthelah : u Eser bad u Elead , kiba la shah pynïap haba ki la pyrshang ban tuh ïa ki jingri kiba dei jong ki traishnong jong ka Gath .
translated_en_to_kha: U Zabad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u, bad u Eser bad u Elead, kiba la kha ha kata ka ri ki la pyniap ia ki briew kiba la kha ha kata ka ri, namar ki la wan hiar ban shim noh ia ki masi jong ki .

en: When therefore he was risen from the dead , his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them  ; and they believed the scripture , and the word which Jesus had said .
kha: Kumta haba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ki synran jong u ki la kynmaw ba u la lah ong ïa kane , bad ki la ngeit ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la mihpat na kiba iap, ki synran jong u ki kynmaw ba u la ong ia kane ha ki ; bad ki la ngeit ia ka jingthoh bad ka ktien kaba U Jisu u la kren .

en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound , and with musical instruments of God . And the sons of Jeduthun were porters .
kha: Ïa u Heman bad u Jeduthun ruh la buh ban peit ïa ki turoi bad ki shakuriaw bad kiwei ki jingtem ba pyndonkam ha ka por ba rwai ïa ki jingrwai ïaroh . Ïa ki dkhot jong ka kur u Jeduthun , la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad ki Heman bad u Jeduthun da ki turoi bad ki cymbal na ka bynta kito kiba dei ban pynmih sur , bad da ki tiar rwai jong U Blei . Bad ki khun shynrang jong u Jeduthun ki long ki nongrah .

en: They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers  bosom .
kha: Khmih sha nga !  ka pyrta sha uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti najan .  Ym don mano mano ba don ka jingpang kum ka jong nga , ka Jingpang kaba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong nga ha ka por ka jingbitar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ong ha ki kmie jong ki , Hangno u kew bad ka wain ? haba ki la sngewsih kum kiba mynsaw ha ki surok jong ka nongbah , haba ka mynsiem jong ki ka la tuid shapoh ka kpoh jong ki kmie jong ki .

en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter , and James , and John , and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves : and he was transfigured before them .
kha: Hynriew sngi hadien , U Jisu u la shim bad u ïa u Petros , u Jakob , bad u Ïoannis , bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lum uba jrong , ha kaba ki la ïalong tang ma ki hi . Haba ki dang ïakhmih , ka jingkylla dur ka la wan ha U Jisu ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la shim bad u Petros bad u Jakob bad u Ioannis bad u la ialam ia ki sha u lum uba jrong marwei: bad u la kylla dur ha khmat jong ki .

en: The  Lord  shall establish thee an holy people unto himself , as he hath sworn unto thee , if thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , and walk in his ways .
kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad leh kat ïa kaba u hukum , un pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynskhem ia me u briew uba khuid ha lade kumba u la smai ha me, lada me sumar ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong me bad me iaid ha ki lynti jong u .

en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land : they shall not be buried , neither shall men lament for them , nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :
kha: Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk kin ïap ha kane ka ri , hynrei ym don mano mano ban tep ïa ki lane ban ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki . Ym don mano mano u ban ot ïa lade lane u ban khi ïa la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh arngut kiba khraw bad kiba rit kin iap ha kane ka ri: kin ym shah tep , lymne ki briew kin ym iam na ka bynta jong ki , lymne kin ym ot ia lade , lymne kin ym leh bein ia lade na ka bynta jong ki:

en: And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïai phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki bad ïa ka templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa jong ki u la phah sha ki da ki nonglam khubor jong u, da kaba kiew sha jrong, bad phah ; namar ba u la sngewsynei ia ki briew jong u, bad ha ka jaka shong jong u:

en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .
kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u bad uta u paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la aiti arphew hajar tylli ki masi bad shispah arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot: kumta u syiem bad ki briew baroh ki la aiti ia ka iing U Blei .

en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .
kha: Haba ki poi hangta , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlem pynsah wat uwei ruh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u Elijah ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la poi ha Samaria , u la pyniap lut ia kiba sah ha u Ahab ha Samaria haduh ba u la pynjot ia u kat kum ka jingong U Trai kaba u la kren ha u Elijah .

en: And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha Antiokh , ki la lumlang ïa ki briew jong ka balang bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki , bad kumno u la plie ka lynti na ka bynta ki Jentil ban ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan bad ki la lum lang ia ka balang , ki la pynkhreh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki , bad kumno u la plie ia ka jingkhang jong ka jingngeit ha ki Jutang .

en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .
kha: Yn sa rah ïa ki sha Babilonia bad kin sah hangta tad haduh ba ngan da phai ka jingmut jong nga sha ki . Nangta ngan wallam pat ïa ki bad buh biang ïa ki ha kane ka jaka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin shah rah sha Babilon , bad kin don hangta haduh ka sngi ba ngan leit jngoh ia ki , ong U Trai ; nangta ngan wanrah ia ki sha jrong bad ngan pynphai biang ia ki sha kane ka jaka .

en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .
kha: Hynrei naduh ka por jong u Adam haduh ka por jong u Moses , ka jingïap ka synshar halor u bynriew baroh , wat halor kito ki bym shym la leh pop ha ka rukom kumba u Adam u la leh mynba um shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei . U Adam u la long ka dur jong uta u ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka jingiap ka la synshar naduh u Adam haduh u Moses, wat halor jong ki ki bym shym la leh pop hadien ka jinglong jong u Adam, uba long ka dur jong uta u ban sa wan .

en: Behold , the people shall rise up as a great lion , and lift up himself as a young lion : he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey , and drink the blood of the slain .
kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel ka long kum u sing uba khrawbor ; U bym shongthait tad haduh ba u la lah patar bad bam lut khoit , Haduh ba un da dep dih ïa ka snam jong kito kiba u la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki briew kin kiew kum u sing uba khraw, bad kin rah ia lade kum u sing uba dang rit: un ym thiah haduh ba un da bam ia u mrad bad un da dih ia ka snam jong uba la shah pyniap .

en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;
kha: Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha kata ka sngi ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ruh ia ka jingkhawai jong ki ïingjaiñ kumba la thoh , bad ki la tyrwa ïa ki jingknia thang ba man ka sngi katkum ka rukom , kumba ka kamram jong ka man la ka sngi ka long kaba donkam;

en: Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea , as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .
kha: Wat la ym don kew ba dang sah , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ , ki diengsoh Dumbur , ki diengsoh Pomkranet , bad ki diengsoh Olib kim pat shym pynmih soh , pynban naduh mynta ngan kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u symbai u dang don ha ka phyllaw ? Hooid, haduh mynta u sohjew bad u dieng sohjew bad u dieng olive um shym la pynmih: naduh kane ka sngi ngan kyrkhu ia phi .

en: Is the law then against the promises of God ? God forbid : for if there had been a law given which could have given life , verily righteousness should have been by the law .
kha: Hato kane ka mut ba ka Hukum ka long pyrshah ïa ki jingkular U Blei ? Em , ym dei kumta! Naba lada u khunbynriew u la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hukum kaba lah ban wanrah jingim , te uwei pa uwei u lah ban long uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba kohnguh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka hukum ka long pyrshah ia ki jingkular U Blei ? U Blei u la khang: namar lada la don ka hukum kaba la ai kaba lah ban ai jingim , shisha ka hok ka la dei ban long da ka ain .

en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad kohnguh syiem tam ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka ? Balei phi kwah ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long uwei na kita kiba suk bad kiba iaineh ha Israel: me wad ban pynjot ia ka shnong bad ka kmie ha Israel: balei me sngap ia ka pateng U Trai ?

en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus  sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
kha: Bun bah ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la don ha Bethania , kumta ki la leit shata , ym tang namar jong U Jisu hynrei ban ïohi ruh ïa u Lasaros , ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun ki briew na ki Jiw ki tip namarkata ba u don hangta : bad kim wan tang na ka bynta U Jisu , hynrei ba kin iohi ia u Lasaros ruh uba u la pynmihpat na kiba iap .

en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .
kha: Nga salia aïu ïa ka jingiwbih kaba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lane ki musla na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingainguh jong ki lane ban sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kano ka jingthmu ka wan sha nga na Sheba, bad ka jingbam ba thiang na ka ri kaba jngai ? ki jingainguh thang jong phi kim long kiba lah ban pdiang , lymne ki jingknia jong phi ki long kiba thiang ha nga .

en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will prepare thee unto blood , and blood shall pursue thee : sith thou hast not hated blood , even blood shall pursue thee .
kha: Kumta te — da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — ka jingïap ka long ka kupar jong pha , bad men ym lah lait na ka . Me long uba la rem na ka jingpynïap briew , bad ka jingpynïap briew kan buddien ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei, ngan pynkhreh ia me ha ka snam, bad ka snam kan beh ia me: sith me khlem shun ia ka snam, wat ka snam ruh kan beh ia me .

en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way , and divide the coasts of thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to inherit , into three parts , that every slayer may flee thither .
kha: phiah ïa kata ka ri ha ki lai bynta . Kawei ka bynta kan don kawei ka shnong ha kaba yn don ruh ka lynti ka syngkien . Te u briew uba pynïap ïano ïano u lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pynkhreh ia me, bad phiah ia ki pud jong ka ri jong me, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me ban hiar pateng, ha ki lai bynta, ba uwei pa uwei u nongpyniap briew un phet noh sha kata ka jaka .

en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .
kha: Kumno keiñ ngan long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta katta ?  u Hasael u kylli .  Ngam long ei ei ruh em !  U Elisha u phai ktien ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba men sa long u syiem ka Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hazael u la ong, Hynrei kaei ka jinglong jong me, ba u dei ban leh ia kane ka kam kaba khraw ? U Elisha u la jubab , U Trai u la pyni ia nga ba me long syiem halor ka Syria .

en: And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .
kha: Suki pa suki un beh krad ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ym lah ban pynduh lut ïa ki shisyndon , namar , lada phi leh kumta , ki mradkhlaw kin jyllei palat bad kin long ka jingma pynban ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong me un beh noh ia kita ki jaitbynriew ha khmat jong me tang khyndiat: me ym lah ban bam ia ki shisien: ioh ba ki mrad ki nang kiew ha me .

en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .
kha: Hadien kata , un sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , bad nangta u lah ban rung sha ka jaka shong dara ; hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un sait ia ka doh jong u ha ka um bad hadien kata un wan shapoh ka jaka shong jaka sah bad u lyngdoh un long u bymkhuid haduh ka por janmiet .

en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .
kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba la shong la sah ha Samaria ki ïai bteng ban thaw ïa la ki bleithaw , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jaka mane kiba ki Israel ki la tei . Kawei pa kawei ka kynhun ka la thaw ïa ki bleithaw ha ki nongbah ha kiba ki shong ki sah :
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ka la thaw ia la ki jong ki blei, bad ka la buh ia ki ha ki iing jong ki jaka ba jrong kiba ki nong Samaria ki la shna, kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ki nongbah jong ki ha kaba ki shong ki sah .

en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ki angel ki bym shym la ri ïa ka burom hapoh ki pud ka bor synshar jong ki , hynrei ki la iehnoh ïa ki jaka shong jong ki hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum tliw tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki angel ki bym shym la bat ia ka jaka ba nyngkong jong ki, hynrei ki la iehnoh ia la ka jong ka jaka shong jaka sah , u la buh ha ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh ka jingdum haduh ka jingbishar jong ka sngi kaba khraw .

en: And he sent Eliakim , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .
kha: U phah khot ïa u Eliakim , u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki lyngdoh kiba ha shuwa jong u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khain .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia u Eliakim uba la long halor ka iing, bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad ki rangbah jong ki lyngdoh kiba la tap da ka jainkup, ha u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u khun u Amoz .

en: And , lo , thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice , and can play well on an instrument : for they hear thy words , but they do them not .
kha: Ha ki mem long ei ei lait tang u nongpynbyrngia da kaba rwai ki jingrwai jingieit ne tem ka duitara . Ki shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong me baroh hynrei kim kohnguh ïa kawei ruh na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, me long ha ki kum ka jingrwai kaba sngewtynnad shibun jong uta uba don ka sur kaba sngewtynnad, bad uba lah ban ialehkai bha ha ka tiar: namar ki iohsngew ia ki ktien jong me, hynrei kim leh ia ki .

en: Woe is me ! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .
kha: Ka long ka jingduh jingkyrmen ! Nga long kum u briew uba thngan uba shem ba ym don soh ba dang sah ha ki dieng bad ym don sohwaiñ ha ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ïa baroh ki sohwaiñ bad baroh ki soh Dumbur ba-bang la kheit lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ma nga ! namar nga long kumba ki la lum ia ki soh lyiur, kumba ki jingpynkhuid ia ki soh: ym don kynhun ban bam: ka mynsiem jong nga ka kwah ia u soh ba la san nyngkong .

en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father , and his heavy yoke that he put upon us , and we will serve thee .
kha: U kpa jong phi u la buh ki jingkit kiba khia ïa ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynlong ïa ka jingim jong ngi kaba kham suk te ngin long ki khun ki raïot kiba shakri hok ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong me u la pynlong ia ka jinglong ba sngewsih jong ngi: mynta to pynjem katto katne ia ka jinglong mraw jong u kpa jong me, bad ka jinglong ba khia jong u kaba u la buh ha ngi, bad ngin shakri ia me .

en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;
kha: Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew ngut ki nongai jingmut , ngi phah ïa phi ban wad jingtip ïa ki jinglong jingman ha Jerusalem bad Judah khnang ban ïohi kumno ïa ka Hukum U Blei jong me , ïa kaba la bynshet ha me , la kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba me la phah na u syiem bad na ki hynriew ngut ki nongai jingmut jong u, ban kylli shaphang ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kat kum ka hukum U Blei jong me kaba don ha ka kti jong me;

en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .
kha: Te ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ha kata ka ri katba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta katba ka suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki sngi jong phi kin nang bun, bad ki sngi jong ki khun jong phi, ha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ia ki, kumba ki sngi jong ka bneng ha ka khyndew .

en: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .
kha: da ka bor jong ki kambah bad ki jingphylla , bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei . Bad kumta , ha ka jingleit baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Jerusalem sha Illyrikom , nga la pynbna pura ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Lyngba ki dak bad ki jingphylla kiba khlain bor, da ka bor U Mynsiem U Blei; kumta na Jerusalem bad sawdong sawdong haduh Illyricum , nga la ialap pura ia ka gospel U Khrist .

en: Behold , we count them happy which endure . Ye have heard of the patience of Job , and have seen the end of the Lord  ; that the Lord is very pitiful , and of tender mercy .
kha: Ngi khot ïa ki kiba suk namar ki la long kiba ïaishah . Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaishah u Job , bad phi tip kumno U Trai u la pyndap ïa u ha kaba kut . Naba U Trai u long uba dap da ka jinglehisynei bad jinglehsbun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngi khein ia kiba iaishah . Phi la iohsngew ia ka jingshaniah jong u Job , bad phi la iohi ia ka jingkut jong U Trai ; ba U Trai u long uba sngewsih shibun , bad uba sngewrit shibun .

en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew kiba nga ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki don hok aïu ban don hapoh ka Templ jong nga ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ban ïada na ka jingpynjot da kaba pynlong ki jingkular bad da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pynkmen ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba ka baieit jong nga ka la leh ha iing jong nga, haba ka la leh ia ka kam sniew bad kiba bun, bad ka doh bakhuid ka la iaid noh na me ? haba me leh ia kaba sniew, te me sngewbha .

en: And when Joseph s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him .
kha: Hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong ki , ki hynmen u Joseph ki ïa-ong ,  Tip kan jia aïu keiñ lada u Joseph u dang buhnud bad thmu ban pynhiarkput ïa ngi namar ka kam sniew ba ngi la leh ïa u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki hynmen jong u Joseph ki la iohi ba u kpa jong ki u la iap , ki la ong , u Joseph un leh bein ia ngi , bad un siew kylliang ia ngi ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba ngi la leh ia u .

en: Listen , O isles , unto me  ; and hearken , ye people , from far  ; The  Lord  hath called me from the womb  ; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name .
kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki hima ba don sha jngai , phi ki briew bashong sha jngai bah ! Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U  Trai  u la jied ïa nga bad thung ïa nga ban long u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Sngap , ko isles, ha nga; bad sngap, phi ki briew, na jngai U Trai u la khot ia nga na ka kpoh ; na ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong nga u la kdew ia ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned two years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Meshullemeth , the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah .
kha: U Amon u la dap arphew ar snem ka rta haba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Meshullemeth , ka khun u Harus , na ka shnong Jotbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amon u la don arphew ar snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Meshullemet ka khun jong u Haruz jong ka jotbah .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban sdang ban burom ïa me kum u riewkhraw , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me kumba nga la long bad u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua , Ha kane ka sngi ngan sdang ban pynkhraw ia me ha khmat ki Israel baroh , ba kin tip ia kata kumba nga la don bad u Moses .

en: After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .
kha: Mynba nga dang ap khmih , sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syriem kum u  labasa , hynrei ha ka met jong u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sim , bad u don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum uba don ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane nga la iohi, bad uwei pat, kum u blang, uba don ha ka tyrpeng jong u saw tylli ki bniat jong u blang; u mrad ruh u don saw tylli ki khlieh ; bad la ai ia u ia u ha ka .

en: An agricultural fair in such a University thus becomes a gathering of farmers , entrepreneurs , farm scientists and extension workers from all the southern states of India .
kha: Ka agricultural fair ha kum kane ka University kumta ka kylla long ka jingialang jong ki nongrep , ki nongseng kam seng jam , ki riewstad rep bad ki nongtrei pynroi na baroh ki jylla ba shathie jong ka ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka fair ha ka rep ka riang ha kum kane ka University kumta ka kylla long ka jingialang jong ki nongrep , ki nongseng kam seng jam , ki stad rep bad ki nongtrei pynjlan por na baroh ki jylla ba shathie jong ka ri India .

en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .
kha: Wat pyntam ei ei nalor kaba nga hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei ei na ka . Kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban pyndap ia ka ktien kaba nga hukum ia phi , lymne phin ym duna ei ei na ka , ba phin sumar ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi kiba nga hukum ia phi .

en: And Reuben answered them , saying , Spake I not unto you , saying , Do not sin against the child  ; and ye would not hear ? therefore , behold , also his blood is required .
kha: U Reuben u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym ktah kti ïa u para , hynrei phim shym shahshkor . Kumta ngi hap shahshitom kylla mynta namar kata ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la jubab ia ki da kaba ong: Hato ngam shym la leh ia phi da kaba ong: Wat leh pop ia u khynnah ; bad phin ym iohsngew ? namarkata, ha khmih ruh ka snam jong u ka long kaba donkam .

en: And it shall be , when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom , that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites :
kha: Ynda u long syiem , u dei ban don kopi ïa ka kitab jong ki aiñ U Blei bad ki jinghikai kaba la shna na ka kot aiñ kaba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki bat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba u shong ha ka khet jong ka hima jong u, ba un thoh ia u ia ka kopi jong kane ka hukum ha ka kot na kata kaba don ha khmat ki lyngdoh ki Lebi:

en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .
kha: Hangta halor u Lum Sinai ha ka ri shyiap , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses ha u lum Sinai, ha ka sngi ba u la hukum ia ki khun Israel ban aiti ia ki jingainguh jong ki ha U Trai, ha ka ri khlaw Sinai .

en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes , and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres : because the riches that he hath gotten are perished .
kha: Te ka dohnud jong nga ka ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew ka Kir Heres , kumba mano re ba tem ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew ha ka tangmuri , namar baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong ki kim don shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka dohnud jong nga kan sawa kum ki pipe, bad ka dohnud jong nga kan sawa kum ki pipe na ka bynta ki briew jong ka Kirheres: namar ki spah kiba u la ioh ki la jah noh .

en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba yn pynshitom ïa nga da ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un long uta u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Gad, nga don ha ka jingeh kaba khraw: to ngan hap mynta ha ka kti U Trai ; namar ki jingisynei jong u ki long kiba khraw shibun: hynrei wat ai ba ngan hap ha ka kti u briew .

en: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u shu sngap . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kren ha u ,  Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga buh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa ngi lada me dei u Messaïah , U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u . Bad u rangbah lyngdoh u la jubab bad u la ong ha u , Nga pynskhem ia me da U Blei uba im, ba me iathuh ia ngi la me long U Khrist U Khun U Blei .

en: And Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel s left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel s right hand , and brought them near unto him .
kha: U Joseph u buh ïa u Ephraim ha ka liang kadiang jong u Jakob bad ïa u Manasseh ha ka liang kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la shim ia ki baroh arngut, u Ephraham ha ka liang kadiang jong u sha ka liang kadiang jong u Israel bad u Manasseh ha ka liang kadiang jong u sha ka liang kadiang jong u Israel bad u la wanrah ia ki hajan jong u .

en: I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .
kha: Ha kane ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet , nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum u briew . U la wan sha nga , ba la ker sawdong da u lyoh , bad u la leit sha uta uba la im junom bad la ai sngewbha ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ha ki jingphohsniew miet , bad , ha khmih , uwei kum u Khun u briew u la wan ryngkat bad ki lyoh bneng , bad u la wan sha u hyndai jong ki sngi , bad ki la wanrah ia u hajan jong u .

en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .
kha: Ngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar ,  u Elijah u la jubab .  Dei ma phi — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad phi mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab , Ngam shym la pynkhuslai ia ki Israel ; hynrei ma me bad ka iing u kpa jong me, namar ba phi la iehnoh ia ki hukum U Trai bad me la bud ia u Baalim .

en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .
kha: Ngan phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba kum ma me napdeng ki para jait jong ki hi ; ngan sa ïathuh ha u aïu un ong , bad un kren ha ki briew kat ïa kaba nga hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih ia ki u Nongiathuhlypa na ki hynmen jong ki, kum ma me, bad ngan buh ia ki ktien jong nga ha ka shyntur jong u ; bad un kren ha ki baroh kiba ngan hukum ia u .

en: And he took the fat , and the rump , and all the fat that was upon the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and their fat , and the right shoulder :
kha: U shim ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ka dongnai , ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki doh jem , ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai ba sop khleiñ , bad ïa ka kjat-dien kamon .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka shini, bad ka tyrpeng kaba don hapoh, bad ka sniehdoh kaba don halor ka sniehdoh, bad ki ar tylli ki snier bad ka shini jong ki, bad ka tyrpeng kaba sha kadiang:

en: If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u shynrang ruh u thiah bad u khun bynriew kumba u thiah bad ka kynthei: baroh arngut kin sa shah pyniap shisha; ka snam jong ki kan long halor jong ki .

en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ? yet , because thou didst rely on the  Lord  , he delivered them into thine hand .
kha: Hato ki Sudan bad ki Libya kim don ki kynhun shipai baheh paid ryngkat bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai ? Hynrei namar ba me la shaniah ha U  Trai  , u la ai ka jingjop ïa me halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki nong Ithiopia bad ki Libyan kim shym la long ki shipai kiba khraw, kiba don shibun ki kali bad ki kulai ? hynrei namar ba me la shaniah ha U Trai , u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong me .

en: The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .
kha: bad kan ym kut haduh ba un da leh ïa baroh kaba U thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew jong U kin sa sngewthuh shai ïa kane .
