translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai kan ym wan phai shuh, haduh ba un da pyndep, bad haduh ba un da leh ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud jong u: ha ki sngi kiba hadien phin pyrkhat pura ia ka .

en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .
kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkoit bad ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai un pynlong ia ki khniang jong me kiba phylla, bad ki khniang jong u symbai jong me, wat ki khniang kiba khraw, bad ki jingpang kiba jrong bad kiba pang kiba jrong .

en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart , and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah : and Uzza and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drave the new cart .
kha: Ki la shim ïa ka na ka ïing jong u Abinadab kaba don halor lum , bad ki buh ïa ka ha ka kali thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab , ki lam lynti ïa ka kali ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka synduk U Blei halor ka kali thymmai, bad ki la wanrah ia ka na ka iing u Abinadab kaba don ha Gibeah: bad u Ussa bad u Ahno , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab ki iaid ia ka kali thymmai .

en: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim , when they heard that the Philistines fled , even they also followed hard after them in the battle .
kha: Kiwei pat , kiba dang rieh ha ki lum Ephraim , ki la ïohsngew ba ki Philistia ki la phet krad ; kumta ki ruh ki la wan ïasoh bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki briew Israel baroh kiba la buhrieh ia lade ha u lum Ephraim , haba ki la iohsngew ba ki Philistia ki la phet noh , wat ki ruh ki la bud jur ia ki ha ka thma .

en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .
kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep kum ka ding , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki tynrai jong ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka ding ka la bthei ha ka jingbitar jong nga, bad kan thang ia ka dujok kaba rit tam, bad kan bam ia ka khyndew da ka jingroi jong ka, bad kan thang ia ki nongrim jong ki lum .

en: And Heshbon shall cry , and Elealeh : their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz : therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out  ; his life shall be grievous unto him .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang jam , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew kat shaduh Jahas . Wat ki shipai ki khynñiuh ; ka jingshlur jong ki ka duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Hesbon un iam, bad u Elealeh: ka sur jong ki kan sa iohsngew wat haduh Jahazi: namarkata ki shipai kiba don tiar jong ka Moab kin pyrta; ka jingim jong u kan long kaba sngewsih ia u .

en: But Abraham said , Son , remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things , and likewise Lazarus evil things : but now he is comforted , and thou art tormented .
kha: Hynrei , u Abraham u la ong , ‘ To kynmaw , ko khun jong nga , ba ha ka por ka jingim jong me la ai ha me ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba bha , katba u Lasaros u la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba sniew . Hynrei mynta u lehkmen ïa lade hangne , katba me don ha ka jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong, Ko khun, kynmaw ba me ha ka jingim jong me me me la ioh ia kiei kiei kiba bha jong me, bad kumjuh ruh ia kiei kiei kiba sniew: hynrei mynta u la shah pyntngen, bad me la shah pynshitom bein .

en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
kha: To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U  Trai  ; rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! ïaroh ïa u , phi kiba ïaid lynti ha duriaw ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingthaw baroh ka duriaw ! Rwai , phi ki ri bajngai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai ia U Trai ia ka jingrwai thymmai, bad ka jingiaroh jong u na kaba kut jong ka khyndew, phi kiba leit shapoh duriaw, bad baroh kaba don ha ka; ki dulir bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka .

en: If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
kha: Uno uno uba wan sha nga um lah ban long u synran jong nga lymda u ieit ïa nga kham palat ban ïa kaba u ieit ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong u , ïa ka tnga bad ki khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang bad kynthei jong u , bad ïa lade kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u wan sha nga, bad um shun ia la u kpa bad ka kmie bad ka tnga bad ki khun bad ki hynmen bad ki para kynthei, hooid, bad ka jingim jong u hi ruh, um lah ban long u synran jong nga ruh .

en: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke , the Benjamites looked behind them , and , behold , the flame of the city ascended up to heaven .
kha: Nangta ka dak ka paw ; u lyoh tdem u sdang ban kiew shajrong na kata ka shnong . Ki Benjamin ki khmih shadien jong ki bad ki kyndit ban ïohi ba kata ka nongbah baroh kawei ka la pluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ka ding ka la sdang ban mih na ka shnong da u mawsiang , ki Benjamin ki peit shadien jong ki bad , ha khmih ka ding jong ka shnong ka la kiew sha bneng .

en: And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .
kha: La don bun ki briew kiba la wan bad leit , haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh wat ban bam jingbam . Kumta u la ong ïa ki ,  To ngin ïaleit noh tang ma ngi sha ka jaka ba ngin ïalong tang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban pynjahthait shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To wan noh sha ka jaka ri khlaw, bad to shongthait shipor: namar ki la wan bad ki la leit noh shipor .

en: And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .
kha: Kumta u Gideon u ong ,  To , kam lei lei ! Haba U  Trai  u aiti ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ha nga , ngan shoh ïa phi da ki shiah bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shyiap !
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong , Namarkata haba U Trai u la aiti ia u Sebah bad u Zalmunna ha ka kti jong nga , te ngan pynpra ia ka doh jong phi da ki thliew jong ka ri khlaw bad da ki bniat .

en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O  Lord  , and it shall be blessed for ever .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai lehkmen ha ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  , me la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan neh bad ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ba phin kyrkhu ia ka iing jong u shakri jong me, ba kan long ha khmat jong me junom: namar me la kyrkhu, ko Trai, bad kan long kaba la kyrkhu junom .

en: Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
kha: Ki hima kiba khlaiñbor ki don ha ka jingkhynwin ha ka jingsawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw , kum ka jingphaloh jong ki jingat phyllung kiba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia u paidbah uba bun ki briew kiba pynmih ia ka jingsawa kum ka jingsawa jong ki duriaw bad ia ka jingsawa jong ki jaitbynriew , kiba pynmih ia ka jingsawa kum ka jingsawa jong ki um kiba khlain bor !

en: Therefore David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go and smite these Philistines ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go , and smite the Philistines , and save Keilah .
kha: Kumta u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ?   Ho-oid  U  Trai  u jubab .  Tur ïaleh ïa ki bad pyllait im ïa ka Keilah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai, u da ong, Hato ngan leit pyniap ia kine ki Philistia ? Bad U Trai u la ong ha u Dabid, To leit pyniap ia ki Philistia bad pynim ia u Keilah .

en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .
kha: Ko ba-ieit jong nga , phi long kaba bhabriew kum ka Jerusalem , kaba i-ieit kum ka nongbah Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem kum kine ki nongbah bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ryndang jong me ka long kum ka tower jong ka sniehdoh; ki khmat jong me kum ki pung dohkha ha Heshbon: ka shyntur jong me ka long kum ka tower jong u Lebanon kaba peit sha ka Damaskos .

en: And he said , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak yet but this once : Peradventure ten shall be found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for ten s sake .
kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Sngewbha wat bitar , A Trai , bad ngan kren biang sa tang shisien . Kumno lada don tang shiphew ngut hangta ?  U jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka lada don shiphew ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Oh wat nym bitar ia U Trai, bad ngan kren hynrei ia kane tang shisien: Ka jinglong kaba shiphew kan sa shem hangta . Bad u la ong , Ngan ym pynjot ia ka na ka bynta shiphew .

en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .
kha: Nangta ki la lah ban pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ki phang ka Gerar , namar ba ki briew hangta ki la khynñiuh ïa U  Trai . Ka kynhun shipai ka la lute ïa baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynjot ia ki shnong baroh sawdong u Gerar ; namar ka jingtieng U Trai ka la wan ha ki: bad ki la pynsniew ia ki shnong baroh; namar ka la don ka jingjot kaba palat ha ki .

en: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches  ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
kha: Hadien katto katne por u san bad u long uba heh tam na ki jingthung baroh . U pynmih ki tnat kiba heh haduh ba ki sim ki wan bad thaw skum ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba la bet ia u, u san bad u kham heh ban ia ki jingthung baroh, bad u mih ki tnat kiba heh ; khnang ba ki sim jong ka Iyer kin sah hapoh ka jingdum jong ka .

en: Egypt shall be a desolation , and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness , for the violence against the children of Judah , because they have shed innocent blood in their land .
kha: Ka Ijipt kan kylla long ka ri shyiap , bad ka Edom kan long ha ka jingjot lehnoh-ei , namar ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri Judah bad pynïap ïa ki briew balui lui jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ijipt kan long ka ri khlaw kaba la jot , bad ka Edom kan long ka ri khlaw kaba la jot , namar ka jingleh donbor pyrshah ia ki khun Judah , namar ki la pynmih snam khlem pop ha ka ri jong ki .

en: But bade them farewell , saying , I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem : but I will return again unto you , if God will . And he sailed from Ephesus .
kha: Pynban , u la ong ïa ki ha shuwa ba un mihnoh ,  Lada ka long ka mon U Blei , ngan wan pat sha phi .  Bad kumta u la leit da ka lieng na Ephesos .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong ia ki da kaba ong, nga dei ban bat ia kane ka jingkhawai kaba wan ha Jerusalem: hynrei ngan wan phai biang sha phi lada U Blei un mon . Bad u la leit noh na Ephesos .

en: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant , and unto the supplication of thy people Israel , to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee .
kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to peit ieit borabor sha ki briew jong me ki Israel bad u syiem jong ki , bad to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki ha man ba ki kyrpad jingïarap na me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki khmat jong me kin plie ia ka jingkyrpad jong u shakri jong me bad ia ka jingkyrpad jong ki briew jong me ki Israel, ban sngap ia ki ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ki khot ia me .

en: When they went , they went upon their four sides  ; they turned not as they went , but to the place whither the head looked they followed it  ; they turned not as they went .
kha: Haba ki kherub ki khih , ki lah ban leit sha kano kano ka liang khlem da hap phai . Baroh lang ki leit sha ka dong kaba ki ïakwah leit , khlem da hap phai sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ki la leit noh , ki la iaid ha ki saw liang jong ki ; kim shym la phai kumba ki leit , hynrei sha kata ka jaka ha kaba ka khlieh ka peit ki la bud ia ka ; kim shym la phai kumba ki leit .

en: And the statutes , and the ordinances , and the law , and the commandment , which he wrote for you , ye shall observe to do for evermore  ; and ye shall not fear other gods .
kha: Phi dei borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta jong phi . Phim dei ban kohnguh ïa kiwei ki blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki ain bad ki hukum bad ka hukum kaba u la thoh na ka bynta jong phi , phin sumar shuh shuh; bad phin ym tieng ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .
kha: Hynrei haba ki la thew ïa ka , kito kiba lum kham bun kim shym ïoh tam , bad kito kiba lum kham khyndiat kim shym ïoh duna ; man la u briew u lum tang katba u lah ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la lum ia ka da u sohjew, uta uba lum bun um don ei ei shuh, bad uta uba lum khyndiat um don shuh shuh; ki la lum ia uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingbam jong u .

en: For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
kha: Naba katba nga dang ïaid lyngba ka nongbah jong phi bad khmih ïa ki jaka ha kiba phi mane , nga la lap ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thoh , ‘ Ha U Blei uba ngim tip .’ Te ïa uta ïa uba phi mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba nga dang iaid lyngba , bad nga dang iohi ia ki jingaiti jong phi , nga la shem ia kawei ka jingbam bad kane ka jingthoh , SHA U BLEI U BLEI . Ia uba phim tip , u pynbna ia nga ha phi .

en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .
kha: To buh ha ka jingthoh , namar kam pat dei ka por ba kan urlong . Hynrei ka por ka wan kloi , bad kaei kaba nga pyn-i ha me kan urlong . Ka i kumba ka wan suki jai , hynrei to ap ïa ka ; kan sa jia long shisha , bad yn ym pyntud ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingphohsniew ka dang long na ka bynta ka por ba la buh, hynrei ha kaba kut kan kren, bad kan ym thok: wat la ka sahkut, ap ia ka ; namar kan sa wan shisha, kan ym sahkut .

en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the sin offering of atonement , and the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering of it , and their drink offerings .
kha: Ai ruh uwei u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop nalor u  langsohmoh ba la ai ha ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ïa u paidbah , bad ïa ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingkñia ainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop ; nalor ka jingknia pop kaba iai bteng , bad ka jingknia thang kaba iai bteng , bad ka jingknia doh jong ka , bad ki jingknia dih jong ki .

en: And the night following the Lord stood by him , and said ,  Be of good cheer , Paul : for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem , so must thou bear witness also at Rome .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U Trai u la ïeng hajan u Paul bad u la ong ,  Wat sheptieng ! Me la ai ka jingsakhi na ka bynta jong nga hangne ha Jerusalem , bad me dei ban leh kumjuh ruh ha Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka miet kaba bud ia U Trai ka la ieng hajan jong u, bad ka la ong, To long kiba sngewbha, ko Paul: namar kumba me la sakhi ia nga ha Jerusalem , kumta me dei ruh ban sakhi ha Rome .

en: The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .
kha: U  Trai  u wallam sha ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ïa ki nongïalam . U pynlong ïa kane ka jingkynnoh :  Phi la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong phi ki dap da kiei kiei kiba phi la shim na kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un rung ha ka jingbishar bad ki rangbah jong u: namar phi la bam ia ka kper sohjew; ka jingjot jong kiba duk ka don ha ki iing jong phi .

en: Behold , the  Lord  thy God hath set the land before thee : go up and possess it , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath said unto thee  ; fear not , neither be discouraged .
kha: nga ong , ‘ Mynta phi la poi ha ri lum Amor , kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u ai ha ngi . Peit ïa ka hangtai . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka kumba u la hukum . Wat leh tud , bad wat sheptieng .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih U Trai U Blei jong me u la buh ia ka ri ha khmat jong me: leit bad bat ia ka kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ong ha me; wat tieng, lymne wat duh mynsiem .

en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .
kha: Nga don ka jingpyrkhat ba ka donkam ban phah sha phi ïa u para jong ngi u Epaphroditos , uba la trei bad ïaleh ha syndah jong nga bad uba la shakri kum u nonglamktien jong phi ha kaba ïarap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la tharai ba ka long kaba donkam ban phah sha phi ia u Epaphroditus, u hynmen jong nga, bad u paralok jong nga ha ka kam, bad u paralok jong phi, hynrei u nonglam khubor jong phi, bad uta uba la shakri ia ki jingkwah jong nga.

en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day : and if it be spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit bniah biang ïa u , bad lada ka la pur , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit ia u ha ka sngi kaba hynriew: bad lada ka la saphriang bha ha ka sniehdoh , te u lyngdoh un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh .

en: Then take the box of oil , and pour it on his head , and say , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel . Then open the door , and flee , and tarry not .
kha: theh ïa kane ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ong , ‘ U  Trai  u pynbna ba u pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ki Israel .’ Hadien kata mihnoh nangta kloi katba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta shim ia ka synduk umphniang, bad theh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u, bad ong, Kumta ong U Trai, nga la pynsleh ia me syiem halor ki Israel . Nangta plie ia ka jingkhang bad phet noh .

en: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the  Lord  thy God hath given unto thee , and unto thine house , thou , and the Levite , and the stranger that is among you .
kha: To long kiba sngewnguh namar kiei kiei kiba bha ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi bad ha ka ïing ka sem jong phi ; shah ruh ïa ki Lebi bad ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi ban ïalehkmen lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban sngewbha ha ka jingbha baroh kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai ha me bad ha ka iing jong me, me bad u Lebi bad u nongwei uba don hapdeng jong phi .

en: And he said unto her ,  What wilt thou ?  She saith unto him , Grant that these my two sons may sit , the one on thy right hand , and the other on the left , in thy kingdom .
kha: Kaei kaba pha kwah ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab ,  To kular ïa nga ba kine ki khun shynrang jong nga kin shong ha ka liang kamon bad ka liang kadiang jong me haba men long u Syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka, Kaei kaba phi kwah ? Ka ong ha u, To ai ba kine ki arngut ki khun jong nga kin shong, uwei ha ka liang kadiang jong me bad uwei pat ha ka liang kadiang jong me .

en: Thy tacklings are loosed  ; they could not well strengthen their mast , they could not spread the sail : then is the prey of a great spoil divided  ; the lame take the prey .
kha: Baroh ki tyllai teh ha kito ki liengbah kim don jingmyntoi ; ki jaiñ pdiang lyer kim lah ban pyiar ! Ngin knieh noh ïa baroh ka spah jong ki kynhun shipai nongshun , bad kan bun haduh katta katta ba wat ki briew kiba dkoh ruh kin ïa-ïoh bynta . U  Trai  hi da lade un long u syiem jong ngi ; un synshar halor jong ngi bad un ïada ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingbam ba la tyrkhong jong u kim lah ban pynkhlain bha ia ka lieng jong ki: nangta ka long ka jingbam jong ka jingsniew kaba khraw kaba la phiah; ka lyngkhot lyngkhai ka shim ia ka jingbam .

en: And he spake unto the congregation , saying , Depart , I pray you , from the tents of these wicked men , and touch nothing of theirs , lest ye be consumed in all their sins .
kha: U ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kynriah na ki ïingjaiñ jong kine ki riewbymman bad wat ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ka jong ki , ïoh phi shah pynjot lang bad ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha ka jingiaseng, u da ong: To leit noh, nga kyrpad ia phi, na ki ïingjaiñ jong kine ki briew kiba sniew, bad wat ktah ei ei na ki jong ki, ioh ba phin shah pynjot ha ki pop jong ki baroh .

en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .
kha: Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ha kawei ka shnong , to phet sha kawei pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba phin ym pat lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam jong phi ha baroh ki shnong jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Khun U Briew un wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki pynshitom bein ia phi ha kane ka shnong , to phet noh sha kawei pat: namar shisha nga ong ha phi , Phin ym leit sha ki shnong Israel haduh ba u Khun u briew un wan .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they cannot fast .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka jingshongkurim ban leit khlem jingbam ? Ym kumta ! Katba u nongleitkurim u don ryngkat bad ki , kin ym shahthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Hato ki khun jong ka nongleitkurim ki lah ban shah jingit katba u nongleit kurim u dang don bad ki ? katba ki dang don u nongleit kurim bad ki , kim lah ban shah jingit .

en: Then the priest shall look : and , behold , if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white  ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin  ; he is clean .
kha: Lada kita ki dak ki long kiba lieh blad , ki dei tang ki dak thohbria ha ka sniehdoh jong ; uta u briew u long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un peit: bad, ha khmih, lada ki bniat kiba shai ha ka sniehdoh jong ki ki long kiba lieh basa ka long ka jaka kaba la tyrkhong kaba san ha ka sniehdoh basa u long uba khuid .

en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .
kha: Nangta u sei ïa ki jaiñ bad ki jingdeng rupa bad ksiar , bad u ai ïa ki ha ka Rebekka . U ai ruh ïa ki jingai kiba kordor ïa u hynmen bad ïa ka kmie jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la wanrah ia ki mawkordor rupa bad ki mawkordor ksiar bad ki jain ksiar bad u la ai ia ki ha ka Rebekeh: u la ai ruh ia u hynmen jong ka bad ia ka kmie jong ka ia kiei kiei kiba kordor .

en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers , as the heat in a dry place  ; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud : the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low .
kha: kum ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri baryngkhiang . Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me la pynsngap jar ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ; Me la pynsngap jar ïa ki jingpyrta jong ki riewrunar , kum u lyoh uba pynpyngngad ha ka sngi bashit .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pynhiar ia ka jingsawa jong ki nongwei, kum ka jingshit ha ka jaka kaba rkhiang shuh shuh: ka tnat jong kiba shyrkhei kan shah pynhiar dor .

en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord  ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka Lynti jong U Trai , bad da ka jingshitrhem bakhraw u la pynbna bad hikai khlem bakla ïa ki jingshisha shaphang U Jisu . Pynban u la tip tang ïa ka jingpynbaptis jong u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u briew u la shah hikai ha ka lynti U Trai ; bad u la sngewsih ha ka mynsiem , u la kren bad u la hikai da ka jingsngewrit ia kiei kiei jong U Trai , da kaba tip tang ia ka jingpynbaptis jong u loannis .

en: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day , saith the Lord  God  : there shall be many dead bodies in every place  ; they shall cast them forth with silence .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki jingrwai ha ka ïingsyiem kin kylla long ki jinglynñiar ka jingïambriew . Ki metïap kin don kylleng sawdong . Kin sa shah bret noh ha ka jingjar jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingrwai jong ka tempi kin long ki jingsawa ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai Blei: kin don bun ki met iap ha man la ki jaka; kin bret noh ia ki da kaba sngap jar .

en: And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .
kha: U dei U  Trai  u ban ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ban ïa-ïoh bynta lang . Kin ïa-im ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad kan long ka jong ki junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bret ia ka lot na ka bynta jong ki, bad ka kti jong u ka la phiah ia ka ha ki da ka lain: kin don ia ka junom: na ka pateng sha ka pateng kin shong ha ka .

en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , I beseech thee , save thou us out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  God , even thou only .
kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , to pyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khnang ba baroh ki hima ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi , U  Trai  , me long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ko Trai jong ngi, nga kyrpad ia me, to pynim ia ngi na ka kti jong u, ba ki hima baroh ki lah ban tip ba me long U Trai Blei, wat tang ma me hi .

en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .
kha: Phi tip shaphang U Jisu uba na Nasareth bad kumno U Blei u la theh halor jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ïa ka bor . U la leit kylleng , u da leh ki kam babha bad u da pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la long hapoh ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la don lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno U Blei u la pynsleh ia U Jisu na Nazareth da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka bor: uba la leit leh ia kaba bha, bad pynkoit ia baroh kiba la shah pynshitom bein ha u ksuid ; namar U Blei u la don ryngkat bad u .

en: Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong bad phi ha ka kyrteng u patsha . Ngan ai ïa phi ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada phi lah ban shem katta ngut ki rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to ai ia ki jingkular, nga kyrpad ia me, ha u syiem jong nga u syiem Assyria, bad ngan ai ia me ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada me lah na ka liang jong me ban buh ia ki nongshong kulai halor jong ki .

en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the  Lord  , and it shall be the priest s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings .
kha: U dei ban wallam shi bynta na uwei pa uwei u jait kpu kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  ; kata ka dei ka bynta jong u lyngdoh uba shim ïa ka snam jong u mrad bad uba theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka u dei ban aiti ia kawei na ki jingknia baroh kawei ha U Trai , bad dei u lyngdoh uba theh ia ka snam jong ki jingknia jingsuk .

en: For I say unto you , Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist : but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  U Ïoannis u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima U Blei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ha phi , Napdeng kito kiba la kha na ki kynthei ym don u nongiathuhlypa uba kham khraw ban ia u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis: hynrei uta uba kham duna ha ka hima U Blei u kham khraw ban ia u .

en: And thou shalt bring in the table , and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it  ; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick , and light the lamps thereof .
kha: Wanrah ïa ka miej bad buh ryntih ïa ki tiar jong ka ha ka . Wanrah ruh ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad buh hangta ïa ki sharak jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men wanrah ia ka miej, bad buh ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban buh ha ka ; bad men wanrah ia ka sharak bad pynmeh ia ki sharak jong ka .

en: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not , but saith unto him ,  Go home to thy friends , and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee , and hath had compassion on thee .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shah ïa u . Pynban , u la ong ïa u ,  Khie leit phai pat sha ïing sha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me bad ïathuh ïa ki haduh katno U Trai u la leh na ka bynta jong me bad kumno u la lehsbun ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu um shym la shah shitom ia u, hynrei u ong ha u, To leit phai noh sha la iing ha ki paralok jong me, bad to iathuh ia ki katno kiei kiei kiba khraw U Trai u la leh na ka bynta jong me, bad u la sngewsynei ia me .

en: Who shall not fear thee , O Lord , and glorify thy name ? for thou only art holy : for all nations shall come and worship before thee  ; for thy judgments are made manifest .
kha: Uei u ban ym ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa me , A Trai ? Uei u ban kyntait ban pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me ? Tang ma me hi uba khuid . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin wan bad mane ïa me , namar ïa ki jingleh bahok jong me la ïohi da baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba nym tieng ia me, ko Trai, bad ban pyndonburom ia ka kyrteng jong me ? namar me tang me long uba khuid: namar ki jaitbynriew baroh kin wan bad mane ha khmat jong me; namar ki jingbishar jong me ki paw .

en: All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .
kha: baroh ki riewshlur ki leit bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet sha Beth Shan . Ki shim noh ïa ki met jong u Saul bad jong ki khun shynrang jong u na kata ka kynroh , ki wallam pat ïa ki sha Jabesh , bad ki thang ïa ki hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki rangbah ki la ieng baroh shi miet, bad ki la shim ia ka met u Saul bad ki met jong ki khun shynrang jong u na ka kynroh jong ka Bethshan bad ki la poi sha Jabesh bad ki la thang ia ki hangta .

en: If he be able to fight with me , and to kill me , then will we be your servants : but if I prevail against him , and kill him , then shall ye be our servants , and serve us .
kha: Lada u jop bad u pynïap ïa nga , ngin long noh ki mraw jong phi ; hynrei lada ma nga , nga jop bad nga pynïap ïa u , phin long ki mraw jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u lah ban ialeh bad nga bad ban pyniap ia nga, te ngin long ki shakri jong phi: hynrei lada nga jop ia u bad pyniap ia u, te phin long ki shakri jong ngi bad shakri ia ngi .

en: But she was plucked up in fury , she was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up her fruit : her strong rods were broken and withered  ; the fire consumed them .
kha: Hynrei ki kti ba bitar ki la rat ïa u naduh tynrai bad bret ïa u sha madan . Ka lyer mihngi ka la pyntyrkhong ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat jong u ki la kheiñ ; ki la tyrkhong bad la thang noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la shah rong noh ha ka jingbitar, ka la shah pynhap ha ka khyndew, bad ka Iyer mihngi ka la tyrkhong ia u soh jong ka: ki dieng kiba khlain jong ka ki la tyrkhong bad ki la tyrkhong; ka ding ka la bam ia ki .

en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .
kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki mrad ki dei ban phong ki jaiñ khain . Uwei pa uwei u dei ban duwai jur ha U Blei bad u dei ban iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman bad ki kam sniew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba u briew bad u mrad kin shah tap da ka jainkup bad kin pyrta da ka jingsngewrit ha U Blei: Hooid, to ai ba kin phai noh iwei na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u bad na ka jingleh donbor kaba don ha ki kti jong ki .

en: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .
kha: Nga sngewthuh kumno ka long haba kyrduh , bad kumno ka long ban don pahuh kyrhai . Nga la nang ïa kane ka buit barieh , ba hangno hangno ha kano kano ka por , nga sngewhun haba lada nga sngewdap kyrhai ne sngew kyrduh lane haba nga don palat than eh ne don khyndiat eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip kumno ban shah pynjah burom, bad nga tip kumno ban dap: ha man la ki jaka bad ha kiei kiei baroh nga shah hikai baroh arngut ban dap bad ban thngan, baroh arngut ban dap bad ban shah shitom .

en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer , and put him in a prison house  ; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time .
kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa u Asa ban bitar haduh katta katta ïa u nongïathuhlypa bad phah teh kynjri ïa u . Ka la long ha kane kajuh ka por ba u Asa u sdang ban lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa katto katne ngut ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asa u la bitar ia u nongpeitkai, bad u la buh ia u ha ka iing set phatok; namar u la bitar ia u namar kane ka jingjia . Bad u Asa u la pynshitom bein ia ki katto katne ki briew ha kajuh ka por .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob , and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel , and will be jealous for my holy name  ;
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hynrei mynta ngan sngewsynei ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ki briew ka Israel , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ki . Ngan ïada ïa la ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei ; Mynta ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong u Jakob , bad ngan isynei ia ka iing Israel baroh kawei , bad ngan sngewsih ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga ; .

en: And it came to pass afterward , that he went throughout every city and village , preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God : and the twelve were with him ,
kha: Katto katne por hadien , U Jisu u la leit jingleit lyngba ki shnong bad ki nongrit , u da ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei . Ki khat-ar ngut ki synran ki la ïaleit bad u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien kata , ba u la leit kylleng kawei ka shnong bad ka shnong , u da ialap bad pyni ia ka khubor babha jong ka hima U Blei: bad ki shiphew ngut ki la don ryngkat bad u .

en: O that there were such an heart in them , that they would fear me , and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them , and with their children for ever !
kha: A , ba kin da la ïoh ïa kane ka dohnud ! Ba kin da la sheptieng burom ïa nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga borabor , ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin jin da la manbha junom .
translated_en_to_kha: O ba ki don ka dohnud kaba kum kata ha ki , ba kin sheptieng ia nga bad kin sumar ia ki hukum jong nga baroh shi katta , ba kan long kaba bha bad ki bad bad ki khun jong ki junom !

en: After that they have borne their shame , and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me , when they dwelt safely in their land , and none made them afraid .
kha: Haba sa shisien pat kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ka ri jong ki hi , ha kaba ym don shuh ba byrngem ïa ki , kin sa klet noh kumno ba ki shah pynjahburom naba ki la shetkylla ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata ki la kit ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki, bad ki jingleh bymman jong ki baroh kiba ki la iaid lait ia nga , haba ki shong suk ha ka ri jong ki , bad ym don ba pyntieng ia ki .

en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
kha: Te u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen ,  Nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un ri un da ïa phi , bad un ïalam noh ïa phi na kane ka ri sha kata ka ri kaba u la kular skhem ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, nga iap: bad U Blei un leit jngoh shisha ia phi, bad un wanrah ia phi na kane ka ri sha ka ri kaba u la smai ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob .

en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .
kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew sien ïa kata ka snam ha ka met uta u briew ïa uba yn dang pynkhuid na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad hadien kata un sa pynbna ba u long uba khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka sim kaba dang im ba kan her kat shaba ka mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un theh ia uta uba dei ban shah pynkhuid na ka jingpang sniehdoh hynriew sien , bad un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid , bad un pyllait ia u sim uba im sha ka lyngkha kaba plie .

en: But Zadok the priest , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and Nathan the prophet , and Shimei , and Rei , and the mighty men which belonged to David , were not with Adonijah .
kha: Hynrei u Sadok u lyngdoh , u Benaïah u khun jong u Jehoïada , u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , u Shimei , u Rei , bad ki nongïada jong u Dabid , kim don ha ka liang jong u Adonijah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Nada u lyngdoh bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada bad u Natha u nongiathuhlypa bad u Shimei bad u Rei bad ki riewshlur kiba dei ki jong u Dabid kim shym la don bad u Adonijah .

en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :
kha: Katba u Jakob u dang shong dang sah ha kata ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u bitar shla . U Jakob u don khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki Israel ki la shong ha kata ka ri, ba u Reuben u la leit thiah bad u Bilhah u kpa jong u: bad ki Israel ki la iohsngew ia kata . Mynta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki long shiphew:

en: And the men said unto Lot , Hast thou here any besides ? son in law , and thy sons , and thy daughters , and whatsoever thou hast in the city , bring them out of this place :
kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah ki ong ha u Lot ,  Lada me dang don shuh kino kino hangne — ki khun shynrang , ki khun kynthei , ki pyrsa kurim shynrang , ne kino kino ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem kiba shong basah ha kane ka nongbah — ïalam noh ïa ki na kane ka jaka , namar ngin sa pynjot ïa kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang ki la ong ha u Lot, Hato me don hangne nalor kata ? khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong me bad kaei kaei kaba me don ha ka shnong, to wanrah noh ia ki na kane ka jaka:

en: He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .
kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingai jingmut jong ki , u la ïasoh bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth ha Gilead , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid ruh hadien ka jingai jingmut jong ki, bad u la leit bad u Jehoram u khun u Ahab u syiem Israel ban ialeh pyrshah ia u Hazael u syiem Syria ha Ramothgilead : bad ki Syria ki la iaid beit ia u Jehoram .

en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage , and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time : and ye shall eat your bread to the full , and dwell in your land safely .
kha: Ki jingmih kin long kiba bun katta katta ba phin dang ot hi ïa u kew wat haba ka la dei ka por kheit sohwaiñ , bad phin dang kheit hi ïa kita ki soh wat haba ka la dei ka por bet kew . Phin ïoh bam kat kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh im suk im saiñ ha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingot jong phi kan poi sha ka por bet: bad phin bam ia u kpu jong phi haduh katta katta bad phin shong ha ka ri jong phi da kaba suk .

en: And the passengers that pass through the land , when any seeth a man s bone , then shall he set up a sign by it , till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog .
kha: Katba ki dang ïaid shaneng bad sharum jong ka ri , man ba ki lap ïa ka shyieng briew , kin buh dak hajan kata , ba kumta ki nongtih jingtep kin wan bad tep ïa ka ha ka Them ka Kynhun Shipai u Gog .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongleit jingleit kiba iaid lyngba ka ri, haba uno uno u iohi ia u shyieng briew, nangta un buh ia ka dak da ka, haduh ba ki nongtep kin da tep ia ka ha ka them Hamongog .

en: And he made the candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work made he the candlestick  ; his shaft , and his branch , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , were of the same :
kha: U shna ïa u diengpynïeng sharak uba da ka ksiar nylla . U shna ïa ka trai bad ïa ka ktang    jong u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u , kiba kynthup ïa ki shata bad ki sla jong ki , ki ïasoh lang kawei bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka sharak ksiar kaba khuid: jong ka kam ba la pynkhih u la shna ia ka sharak jong u, bad ka tnat jong u, ki khiew jong u, ki knot jong u, bad ki syntiew jong u, ki long kumjuh:

en: And when they shall have finished their testimony , the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them , and shall overcome them , and kill them .
kha: Haba ki dep ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong ki , uta u mradkhlaw uba wan kiew na ka liewlong ba khlem trai un ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ki la dep ia ka jingsakhi jong ki, u mrad uba kiew na ka thliew bym don shapoh un ialeh thma pyrshah ia ki , bad un jop ia ki bad un pyniap ia ki .

en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .
kha: Nga duwai ,  A Blei , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynshitom ïa ki . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Blei jong nga, to pyrkhat ia u Tobiah bad u Sanballat kat kum kine ki kam jong ki, bad ha ka jingiathuhlypa Noadaiah bad kiwei pat ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la buh ia nga ha ka jingtieng .

en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .
kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ong , ‘ To dih , bad ngan ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ Kumta nga la dih , bad ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynlong kyrkieh ia ka khiew jong ka na ka tyrpeng jong ka, bad ka la ong, To dih bad ngan ai um ia ki kulai jong me ruh: kumta nga la dih, bad ka la pynlong ia ki kulai ruh ban dih .

en: But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had , Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .
kha: hynrei mynba u dang im , u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang ba u la ïoh na kiwei pat ki tnga jong u . Nangta u phah noh ïa kine ki khun shynrang sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi , jngai na u khun jong u , u Isaak .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ki khun shynrang jong ki kynthei kiba la don, u Abraham u la ai jingai sngewbha, bad u la phah noh ia ki na u Isaak u khun jong u, katba u dang im, shaphang mihngi, shaphang mihngi .

en: Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
kha: Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kali ïapom u thrang ïa ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin khie dang step sha ki kper sohjew ; to ngin peit lada u sohjew u phuh, la u sohjew uba jem u paw ne em, bad ki sohjew ki mih noh: hangta ngan ai ia me ia ki jingieit jong nga .

en: And he lift up his eyes and looked , and , lo , three men stood by him : and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself toward the ground ,
kha: Tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , u mareh ban leit ïashem ïa ki . Da kaba u nguh ngon haduh khyndew , u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia ki khmat bad u la peit, bad, ha khmih, lai ngut ki briew ki la ieng hajan jong u: bad haba u la iohi ia ki, u la mareh ban iakynduh ia ki na ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ bad u la dem khrup sha khyndew .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ha khmih ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba yn ym ong shuh: U Trai u im, uba la pynmih ia ki khun Israel na ka ri Ijipt;

en: In transgressing and lying against the  Lord  , and departing away from our God , speaking oppression and revolt , conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood .
kha: Ngi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , kyntait ïa me , bad ngim treh ban bud ïa me . Ngi la banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad phai lyndet na me . Ki jingmut jong ngi ki long kiba bakla ; ki ktien jong ngi ki long kiba lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba iaid lait bad thiah pyrshah ia U Trai , bad ban leit noh na U Blei jong ngi , da kaba kren ia ka jingshah lehbein bad ka jingleh pyrshah , da kaba kha bad pynmih na ka dohnud jong ka jinglamler .

en: How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
kha: Namar ba kane ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno tam lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jong u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban shakri ïa U Blei uba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka snam U Khrist kaba lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut ka la tyrwa ia lade khlem da pynsniew ia U Blei , kan pynkhuid ia ka jingsngew jong phi na ki kam ba la iap ban shakri ia U Blei uba im ?

en: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them , they gathered all that were able to put on armour , and upward , and stood in the border .
kha: Haba ki Moab ki ïohsngew ba ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , ki la khot ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba lah ban kieng atiar , naduh kiba tymmen haduh kiba dang khynnah , bad la buh ïa ki ha ki khappud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nongshong shnong baroh ki la iohsngew ba ki syiem ki la wan ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki , ki la lum ia baroh kiba lah ban phong da ki tiar ialeh bad shaneng , bad ki la ieng ha u pud u sam .

en: And we have sent with them our brother , whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things , but now much more diligent , upon the great confidence which I have in you .
kha: Kumta ngi phah ïa u parabangeit jong ngi lem bad ki ; ngi la tynjuh ïa u bunsien bad ngi la shem ïa u ba u long borabor uba thrang ban ïarap . Bad mynta ba u la don haduh katta ïa ka jingshaniah ïa phi , u nang kham thrang shuh shuh ban ïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la phah bad ki ia u hynmen jong ngi, uba ngi la pynshisha bunsien ha kiba bun kiei kiei, hynrei mynta kham sngewrit shibun, halor ka jingshaniah kaba khraw kaba nga don ha phi .

en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved off the one half of their beards , and cut off their garments in the middle , even to their buttocks , and sent them away .
kha: U Hanun u la kem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid , u la khi shiliang ïa u  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , u khap ïa ki jaiñ jong ki na mar skhep , bad u la phah noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Hanun u la shim ia ki shakri jong u Dabid, bad u la ot noh ia kawei ka bniat jong ki, bad u la ot noh ia ki jain jong ki hapdeng, wat haduh ki tyrpeng jong ki, bad u la phah noh ia ki .

en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .
kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Adaïah , na ka shnong na Boskath .
translated_en_to_kha: U Josiah u la don 8 snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar laiphew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Adaiah jong u Bozkath .

en: Then said the  Lord  , Thou hast had pity on the gourd , for the which thou hast not laboured , neither madest it grow  ; which came up in a night , and perished in a night :
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Une u jingthung u la san ha ka shi miet bad jah noh ha kaba bud ; mem shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u , bad mem shym la pynlong ïa u ban san — pynban me la sngewsih na ka bynta jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai , Me la sngewsynei ia u sohjew , namar ia uta uba phim shym la trei shitom , lymne u la sngewsih ia u; uba la wan kiew ha ka shi miet , bad u la jah noh ha ka shi miet:

en: Subhas Chandra was of the view that a political campaign on a wide scale should have been launched in 1929 synchronising with the other developments in the Indian situation .
kha: U Subhas Chandra u don ka jingmut ba la dei ban sdang ia ka jingialap sain hima sima ha ka kyrdan kaba heh ha ka snem 1929 kaba iadei bad kiwei pat ki jingjia ha ka jinglong jingman jong ka ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: U Suhas Chandra u la don ka jingmut ba la dei ban pynlong ia ka jingialap ha ka sain pyrthei ha ka rukom kaba heh ha ka snem 1929 kaba iadei bad kiwei pat ki jingkylla ha ka jinglong jingman jong ka ri India .

en: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon , come down from thy glory , and sit in thirst  ; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee , and he shall destroy thy strong holds .
kha: Phi kiba shong ha Dibon , to hiar noh na ka jaka badonburom jong phi bad shong ha khyndew ha u pui pui ; u nongpynjot ka Moab u don hangne bad u la ieh ïa ki kut jong ka ha ki jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Me khun kaba sah ha Dibon, to wan hiar na ka burom jong me, bad shong ha ka jingthngan ; namar u nongpynjot ia ka Moab un wan ha me, bad un pynjot ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong me .

en: I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shyrkhei ba kin leh donbor halor jong phi ; kine kin pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , kin pynjot ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phi , bad kin sah sa tang khyndiat eh na phi , ba kumta ki lynti bah jong phi kin kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phah ruh ia ki mrad khlaw hapdeng jong phi , ki ban lute ia phi na ki khun jong phi , bad kin pynjot ia ki masi jong phi , bad kin pynlong ia phi tang khyndiat eh ha ka por ; bad ki lynti kiba jrong jong phi kin sa jah rngai noh .

en: And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .
kha: Em kynrad , ngam shym buaid  ka la jubab .  Ngam shym dih ! Nga jynjar sat bad nga dang duwai bad khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hannah u la jubab bad u la ong: Em ko kynrad jong nga: ngam shym la dih wain ne dih kyiad kaba khlain hynrei nga la theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha khmat U Trai .

en: For there shall arise false Christs , and false prophets , and shall shew great signs and wonders  ; insomuch that , if it were possible , they shall deceive the very elect .
kha: Naba ki Messaïah lamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa lamler kin ïamih , kin leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw bad ki kamphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew kiba la jied jong U Blei , lada ka long kaba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kin mih ki Khrist kiba bakla bad ki nongiathuhlypa kiba bakla, bad kin pyni ia ki dak bad ki jingphylla kiba khraw; ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki bym don shuh ki

en: And they shall comfort you , when ye see their ways and their doings : and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: te phin tip ba ka la don ka daw kaba bha ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pyntngen ia phi, haba phi iohi ia ki lynti bad ki jingleh jong ki: bad phin sa tip ba ngam shym la leh khlem daw ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh ha ka , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .
kha: U Dabid u dei u khun jong u Jesse , uba dei u nong Ephrath na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . U Jesse u don phra ngut ki khun shynrang , bad ha ka por ba u Saul u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u long u khun jong uta u Ephrateh u Bethlehemda, uba la jer kyrteng u Jesse ; bad u don 8 ngut ki khun shynrang: bad uta u briew u la leit sha ki briew kiba la tymmen ha ki sngi u Saul .

en: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword , but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee : because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ka jingma , bad yn ym pynïap ïa me . Men lait im namar me la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pyllait im shisha ia me, bad me phin ym hap da ka waitlam, hynrei ka jingim jong me kan long ka jingbam ha me: namar me la buh ia ka jingshaniah jong me ha nga , ong U Trai .

en: And he said , About this season , according to the time of life , thou shalt embrace a son . And she said , Nay , my lord , thou man of God , do not lie unto thine handmaid .
kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha ka ,  Kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem kaba bud phin rah ïa u khun ha ki ksang ti jong phi .   O !  ka ong da kaba kyndit .  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat lamler ïa nga . Phi dei u briew jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Shaphang kane ka aiom, kat kum ka por jong ka jingim, men pdiang ia u khun shynrang . Bad ka la ong: Em, ko kynrad jong nga, ko briew jong U Blei, wat ju thok ia ka kti jong me .

en: But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said ,  Daughter , be of good comfort  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And the woman was made whole from that hour .
kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la ong ,  To long shlur , ko ka khun jong nga ! Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkoit ïa pha .  Ha kata ka khyllipmat ka kynthei ka la koit .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai noh sha u, bad haba u la iohi ia ka, u la ong, Ko khun, to long ka jingpyntngen kaba bha; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynlong ia me kaba pura . Bad kata ka kynthei ka la long kaba pura naduh kata ka kynta .

en: And there followed another angel , saying , Babylon is fallen , is fallen , that great city , because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication .
kha: U angel uba ar u la bud ïa uba nyngkong , u da ong ,  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Ka la pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ kaba khor jong ka jingkwah brai khlem akor !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u angel u la bud ia kata ka nongbah kaba khraw namar ka la pynlong ia ki jaitbynriew baroh ban dih ia ka wain jong ka jingleh be-ijot jong ka .

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also  ; and greater works than these shall he do  ; because I go unto my Father .
kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh — ho-oid , un leh wat ïa ki kiei kiei kiba kham khraw , namar ngan leit sha U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Uta uba ngeit ha nga, ia ki kam kiba nga leh un leh ruh; bad ki kam kiba kham khraw ban ia kine un leh; namar nga leit sha U Kpa jong nga .

en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions , and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house .
kha: Haba u Joseph u leit ha khmat u syiem ka Ijipt , U Blei u la ai ha u ka akor kaba pynsngewbha bad ka jingstad ; bad u syiem u la pynlong lyngskor ïa u Joseph halor ka ri bad ka longïing syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyllait im ia u na ki jingjynjar jong u baroh, bad u la ai ia u ia ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingstad ha khmat u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt ; bad u la pynlong ia u u Lat jong ka ri Ijipt bad ka iing jong u baroh kawei .

en: These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .
kha: Kine ki briew kiba khñium bad borabor ki kynnoh ïa kiwei ; ki ïaid kat kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki ; ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad ïaroh arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaba ki kwah hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki nongkren bein, ki nongujor, ki iaid katkum la ka jong ka jingsngewtynnat ; bad ka shyntur jong ki ka kren ia ki kyntien kiba sngur kiba khraw , ki don ki briew kiba sngewtynnad namar ka jingmyntoi .

en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .
kha: A  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba me la leh , bad nga la dap da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha ki por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw kiba me la ju leh . To leh-isynei , wat haba me bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai , nga la iohsngew ia ka jingkren jong me , bad nga la tieng: Ko Trai , to pynim biang ia ka kam jong me hapdeng ki snem , hapdeng ki snem to pynpaw;

en: Therefore hath the  Lord  watched upon the evil , and brought it upon us : for the  Lord  our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth : for we obeyed not his voice .
kha: Ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , me la pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ngi , bad me la leh kumta , namar borabor me ju ïai leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad ngim shym la pynshahshkor ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la peit ia kaba sniew, bad u la wanrah ia ka ha ngi: namar U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long uba hok ha ki kam jong u baroh kiba u leh: namar ngim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong u .

en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .
kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka sngi kan long ha phi kum ka jingkhawai niam ha U Trai ha ki pateng jong phi baroh kawei .

en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the  Lord s  sacrifice , that I will punish the princes , and the king s children , and all such as are clothed with strange apparel .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka jingpynïap ,  ong U  Trai  ,  ngan pynshitom ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki khun shynrang jong u syiem , bad baroh kiba leh ïa ki rukom nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ka sngi jong ka jingknia U Trai, ba ngan pynshitom ia ki rangbah bad ki khun syiem bad ia kiba la phong da ki jain kiba phylla .

en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .
kha: U dei ban pynphai shi bynta na ka dor ha kaba la thied ïa u kat kum ka jingdon jong ki snem kiba dang sah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada dang sah tang khyndiat snem haduh ka snem jubilee , te un khein bad u bad kat kum ki snem jong u un ai biang ia u ia ka dor jong ka jingpynim jong u .

en: How he went into the house of God , and did take and eat the shewbread , and gave also to them that were with him  ; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone ?
kha: U la leit shapoh ka ïing U Blei , u la shim ïa u kpu ba la ai sha U Blei , u la bam ïa u , bad u la ai ruh ha ki rangbah jong u . Shisha ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa uno uno lait noh tang u lyngdoh ban bam ïa uta u kpu .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno u la leit shapoh iing U Blei bad u la shim bad bam ia u kpu ba la pyni bad u la ai ruh ha kito kiba don ryngkat bad u ; kaba ym long kaba dei ban bam hynrei tang na ka bynta ki lyngdoh ?

en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets , and said unto him , Gird up thy loins , and take this box of oil in thine hand , and go to Ramoth–gilead :
kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la khot ïa uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa samla , bad u ong ha u ,  Khreh bad leit sha Ramoth ha Gilead . Rah ïa une u khiew umphniang Olib bad me ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u nongiathuhlypa u la khot ia uwei na ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa bad u la ong ha u, To rah ia ki tyrpeng jong me bad shim ia kane ka synduk umphniang ha ka kti jong me bad leit sha Ramothgilead:

en: And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .
kha: Kumta , haba ka la sdang dum , ki leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda ki poi ha ka , ym don mano mano hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng ha ka por ba dum, ban leit sha ka jaka sah jong ki Syria: bad haba ki la poi sha ka jaka sah jong ki Syria: bad haba ki la poi sha ka jaka sah jong ki Syria: ha khmih ym don briew hangta .

en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him , and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king s treasuries for the Jews , to destroy them .
kha: U Mordekai u ong ïa u ïa kaei baroh kaba la jia ïa u bad haduh katno ka pisa ba u Haman u la kular ban buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew u syiem lada ïa baroh ki Jiw la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mordecai u la iathuh ha u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia ha u, bad ia ka pisa kaba u Haman u la kular ban siew ha u syiem ia ki spah jong ki Jiw, ban pynjot ia ki .

en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , saying , Hear ye the words of this covenant , and do them .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad sha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem . Pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga hangta bad ïathuh ïa ki briew ban shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang bad ban kohnguh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Pynpaw ia kine ki ktien baroh ha ki shnong Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem , da kaba ong: To sngap ia ki ktien jong kane ka jutang bad to leh ia ki .

en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus  name , and sealed it with the king s ring , and sent letters by posts on horseback , and riders on mules , camels , and young dromedaries :
kha: U Mordekai u la thoh ïa ki shithi ha ka kyrteng u syiem Serksis , bad u shon ïa ki da ka muhor syiem . La leit rah da ki nongshong kulai kiba shong ha ki kulai bastet na ki sem kulai syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thoh ha ka kyrteng jong u syiem Ahasaerus, bad u la khang ia ka da ka ryntieh syiem, bad u la phah ia ki shithi da ki post ha ka tyrpeng kulai, bad ki nongshong kulai ha ki mules, ki kulai bad ki khun rit:

en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin , to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .
kha: Kum u Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop jong u bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki briew ban leh pop bad mane bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la iaid ha ka lynti jong u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat bad ha ka pop jong u kaba u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop , ban pynkhih ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ban bitar da ki jinglong ba sniew jong ki .

en: Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .
kha: Pynbna ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , bad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynkhreh ban ïada ïa lade ; ïa kiei kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !
translated_en_to_kha: Pynpaw ia phi ha Ijipt , bad pynmih ha Migdol , bad pynmih ha Memphis bad ha Tahpanhes: to ong ia phi: To ieng stet, bad pynkhreh ia me; namar ka waitlam kan bam sawdong ia me .

en: And Elijah said unto her , Fear not  ; go and do as thou hast said : but make me thereof a little cake first , and bring it unto me , and after make for thee and for thy son .
kha: Wat khuslai  u Elijah u la ong ha ka .  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei nyngkong shet ïa u kpu uba rit na kaei kaba pha don bad wanrah ïa u sha nga , bad nangta sa shet ïa kaba sah na ka bynta jong pha bad ïa u khun jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha ka, Wat tieng ban leit bad leh kumba me la ong: hynrei to pynlong ia nga shwa ia ka cake khyndiat, bad wanrah ia ka ha nga, bad hadien ba la dep ban leh ia me bad ia u khun jong me .

en: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite : for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite .
kha: U Sisera u phet ïap sha ka dara jong ka Jael , ka tnga jong u Heber u jait Ken , namar u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor u don ha ka jingïasuk bad ka longïing jong u Heber .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno u Sisera u la phet noh da ki kjat jong u Jael ka tnga jong u Heber u Heber u Heber: namar ka la don ka jingsuk hapdeng u Jabin u syiem u Hasor bad ka iing u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u Heber u

en: And the ass said unto Balaam , Am not I thine ass , upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day ? was I ever wont to do so unto thee ? And he said , Nay .
kha: Ka kada ka phai ktien ,  Hato ngam dei kajuh ka kada ha kaba phi la ju shong baroh shi rta haduh mynta ? Hato nga la ju leh kumne ïa phi ?   Em ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kada u la ong ha u Balaam , Hato ngam dei u kada jong me, ha kaba me la shong naduh ba nga la long u jong me haduh kane ka sngi ? hato nga la ju leh kumta ia me ? Bad u la ong , Em .

en: Now we know that what things soever the law saith , it saith to them who are under the law : that every mouth may be stopped , and all the world may become guilty before God .
kha: Mynta ngi tip ba kiei kiei baroh ha ka Hukum ki dei ïa kito kiba im hapoh ka Hukum , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa baroh ki jingaidaw jong ki briew bad wallam ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi tip ba kiei kiei baroh kiba don hapoh ka hukum: ba kawei pa kawei ka shyntur ka lah ban sahkut , bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka lah ban long kaba don pop ha khmat U Blei .

en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .
kha: U kynrad jong u Joseph u la bitar lep
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u kynrad jong u u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka tnga jong u, kaba ka la kren ha u, da kaba ong: Hadien kane ka rukom u shakri jong me u la leh ia nga; ba ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei .

en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .
kha: Baroh ki kynthei kiba nang ban thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , bad ïa u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kynthei baroh kiba stad ki la khih da ki kti jong ki, bad ki la wanrah ia kata kaba ki la khih, baroh ar ka rong saw bad ka rong saw bad ka rong saw bad ka rong saw .

en: Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :
kha: Na u Simon Petros , u shakri bad u Apostol jong U Jisu Khrist — Sha kito ha kiba da ka hok jong U Blei jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim la ai ïa ka jingngeit kaba kordor kum ka jong ngi :
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros , u shakri bad u apostol jong U Jisu Khrist , ha kito kiba la ioh kum ka jingngeit kaba kordor bad ngi lyngba ka hok U Blei bad U Nongpynim jong ngi U Jisu Khrist:

en: And it came to pass , that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux : to whom Paul entered in , and prayed , and laid his hands on him , and healed him .
kha: Ka jingdonkam u briew ïa ka jingpynim
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba u kpa jong u Publius u la thiah ha ka jingshit bad ka snam: ha kaba u Paul u la rung shapoh bad u la duwai bad u la buh ia ki kti jong u ha u bad u la pynkoit ia u .

en: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .
kha: Ka kamra rung ka phai pyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong halor ki païa baroh arliang . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki arches jong ka ki long sha ka phyllaw kaba shabar bad ki dieng sohjew ki don ha ki post jong ka, ha kane ka liang bad ha kata ka liang: bad ka jingleit shaneng jong ka ka don 8 tylli ki step .

en: Then fell she down straightway at his feet , and yielded up the ghost : and the young men came in , and found her dead , and , carrying her forth , buried her by her husband .
kha: Shisyndon ka la kyllon ha ki kjat jong u bad ka la ïap . Ki samla shynrang ki la wan shapoh bad ki la ïohi ba ka la ïap , kumta ki la bah noh ïa ka shabar bad la tep ïa ka ha syndah u tnga jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la hap beit ha ki kjat jong u, bad ka la aiti noh ia u ksuid: bad ki samla ki la wan rung , bad ki la lap ia ka ba ka la iap , bad da kaba rah ia ka sha khmat , ki la tep ia ka da u tnga jong ka .

en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynti , bad ïa u sing uba ïeng hajan jong ka . Ki leit haduh Bethel bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki la ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki briew ki la iaid lyngba, bad ki la iohi ia ka met iap kaba la bret ha lynti, bad u sing uba ieng hajan ka met iap: bad ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ha ka shnong ha kaba u nongiathuhlypa barim u shong .

en: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove  ; and Asa destroyed her idol , and burnt it by the brook Kidron .
kha: U weng noh ïa ka Maakah , ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan syiemsad , namar ba ka la thaw ïa ka bleithaw ba-ijli jong ka Asherah ka blei jingkharoi . U Asa u pynkyllon ïa ka bleithaw bad u thang ïa ka ha ka them jong ka wah Kidron .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh u Maachah ka kmie jong u, wat ia ka ruh u la weng noh na ka jinglong mahadei, namar ka la shna bleithaw ha ka khlaw ; bad ka Asa ka la pynjot ia ka bleithaw jong ka, bad ka la thang ia ka da ka wah Kidron .

en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :
kha: Bad ka jubab kan long , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u la pynlong bad ki mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew kin ong , Namar ki la iehnoh ia ka jutang U Trai Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kaba u la leh bad ki haba u la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt:

en: Against Moab thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Woe unto Nebo ! for it is spoiled : Kiriathaim is confounded and taken : Misgab is confounded and dismayed .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong shaphang ka Moab :  Isynei ïa ki briew jong ka Nebo — ïa ka shnong jong ki la pynjot ! La kurup ïa ka Kiriathaim , ïa ka kut baskhem la pynpra , bad ïa ki briew jong ka la pynlehrain ; ka burom jong ka Moab ka la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia u Moab kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid Israel ! namar ka la shah pynsniew: U Kiriathaim u la sngewlehrain bad u la shah shim: U Misgab u la sngewlehrain bad u la sngewsih .

en: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests , and captains of the temple , and the elders , which were come to him ,  Be ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and staves ?
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ha ki tymmen ki san kiba la wan hangta ban kem ïa u ,  Hato phi la dei ban ïawan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ka tempi bad ki rangbah kiba la wan sha u: Hato phi mih noh kum u nongtuh ?

en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .
kha: U Shaphan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem ha u Hilkaïah bad u Hilkaïah u ïathuh ïa u ba u la shem ïa ka Kitab ka hukum ha ka Templ . U Hilkaïah u la ai ha u ïa ka Kitab , bad u Shaphan u pule ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hilkiah u rangbah lyngdoh u la ong ha u Shaphan u nongthoh , nga la shem ia ka Kitab Hukum ha iing U Trai . U Hilkiah u la ai ia ka kot ha u Shaphan bad u la pule ia ka .

en: And the Spirit and the bride say , Come . And let him that heareth say , Come . And let him that is athirst come . And whosoever will , let him take the water of life freely .
kha: U Mynsiem bad ka Nongleitkurim ki ong ,  To wan !  Uwei uwei baroh uba ïohsngew ïa kane u dei ruh ban ong ,  To wan !  To wan , uno uno uba sliang , to pdiang ïa ka um ka jingim kum ka jingai sngewbha , uno uno uba kwah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Mynsiem bad ka nongleitkurim ki ong, To wan . Bad to ai ba uta uba iohsngew un ong, To wan . Bad to ai ba uta uba sliang un wan . Bad uno uno uba mon , to ai ba un shim ia ka um jong ka jingim laitluid .

en: But he turned , and said unto Peter ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : thou art an offence unto me : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but those that be of men .
kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la ong ha u Petros ,  Khie noh na nga , ko Soitan ! Me long u maw jynthut ha ka lynti jong nga , namar kine ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei , hynrei na u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la phai bad u la ong ha u Petros, To leit shadien jong nga, ko Soitan: me long ka jingleh bein ia nga: namar me sngewbha ia kiei kiei kiba long na U Blei , hynrei ia kita kiba long na ki briew .

en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt : but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight , saying , Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad .
kha: Nga don ka bor ban pynmynsaw ïa me ; hynrei hynne mynmiet U Blei jong u kpa jong me u la maham ïa nga ba ngan ym byrngem ei ei ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ha ka bor jong ka kti jong nga ban pynmong ia phi: hynrei U Blei jong u kpa jong phi u la kren ha nga mynta ka miet , u da ong: To sumar ba me kren ia u Jakob la ka long kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

en: Thereafter , Satan and his demons will be bound as the Thousand Year Reign of Christ commences with great blessings in store for mankind . Revelation 20 : 1 , 2 . 21 : 3 , 4 .
kha: Hadien kata , yn teh ia u Soitan bad ki ksuid jong u katba ka Jingsynshar Hajar Snem U Khrist kan sdang da ki jingkyrkhu kiba khraw kiba la buh na ka bynta u khun bynriew . Jingpynpaw 20 : 1 , 2 . 21:3,4.
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata , u Soitan bad ki ksuid jong u kin sa shah teh katba ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist ka sdang da ki jingkyrkhu kiba khraw kiba la buh na ka bynta u khun bynriew . Jingpynpaw 20 : 1, 2 . 21 : 3 , 4 .

en: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts , that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering  ; but for a vow it shall not be accepted .
kha: Phi lah ban kñia ainguh ïa u jingri uba raid lane u bym shong beit ka met ka phad kum ka jingainguh sngewbha , hynrei yn ym pdiang ïa u haba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular .
translated_en_to_kha: La u masi ne u langbrot uba don kaei kaei kaba palat ne kaba duna ha ki bynta jong u, kata me lah ban aiti ia ka jingainguh kaba laitluid ; hynrei na ka bynta ka jingkular ym lah ban pdiang ia ka .

en: But these , as natural brute beasts , made to be taken and destroyed , speak evil of the things that they understand not  ; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption  ;
kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki leh la ka leh , kum ki mradkhlaw ïa kiba la kha ïa ka ban shah kem bad shah pynïap ; ki tur ïaleh da ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kine, kum ki mrad ba la shna da ka mariang, ki kren ia kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kin jah noh shisyndon ha la ka jong ka jingbamsap ; .
