en: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynmih ha kaba paw lyngba ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymjukut , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba baroh ki lah ban ngeit bad kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta la pynpaw ia ka , bad da ki jingthoh jong ki nongiathuhlypa , kat kum ka hukum U Blei bymjukut , la pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka bynta ka jingkohnguh jong ka jingngeit:

en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .
kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam pat ju shong ha ka templ ; nga la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ngam pat shong ha kano kano ka iing naduh ka por ba nga la wanrah ia ki khun Israel na Ijipt , wat haduh kine ki sngi , hynrei nga la iaid ha ka ïingjaiñ bad ha ka ïingjaiñ .

en: But they mocked the messengers of God , and despised his words , and misused his prophets , until the wrath of the  Lord  arose against his people , till there was no remedy .
kha: Hynrei ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kim suidñiew ïa ki ktien jong u bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ha kaba kut ka jingbitar U  Trai  pyrshah ïa la ki briew ka long kaba jur katta katta kat ban ym don lad shuh ban lait na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la rkhie bein ia ki nonglam khubor jong U Blei bad ki la leh bein ia ki ktien jong u bad ki la leh bakla ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong u haduh ba ka jingbitar U Trai ka la mih pyrshah ia ki briew jong u , haduh ba ym don dawai .

en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .
kha: Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un heh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ Pa’ , ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Damaskos bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn kit noh da u patsha ka Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shuwa ba u khynnah un ioh jingtip ban iam, u kpa jong nga bad ka kmie jong nga, ka spah jong u Damaskos bad ka jinglute jong ka Samaria yn sa shim noh ha khmat u syiem Assyria .

en: Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot ,  Ngan ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito kiba dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynjot kito kiba dei ban shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah kin pynjot iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong: ba kata kan iap; bad kata ka dei ban shah ot noh; bad to ai ba ka sah kan bam ia ka doh jong uwei pat .

en: As for his father , because he cruelly oppressed , spoiled his brother by violence , and did that which is not good among his people , lo , even he shall die in his iniquity .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , u kpa jong u , u la shukor bad lute bad u ïai leh ïa kaba sniew ha uwei pa uwei baroh . Bad kumta u la ïap namar ki pop kiba ma u hi u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia u kpa jong u, namar ba u la shah pynshitom bein jur, u la pynsniew ia la u hynmen da ka jingleh donbor, bad u la leh ia kata kaba ym bha hapdeng ki briew jong u, ha khmih ruh un iap ha ka jingbymhok jong u .

en: Then were the men exceedingly afraid , and said unto him , Why hast thou done this ? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the  Lord  , because he had told them .
kha: U Jonah u la ong shuh shuh ïa ki ba u la phet na U  Trai . Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei , bad ki la ong ïa u ,  Kata ka long kaei kaei kaba sngewma ban leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew ki la tieng palat bad ki la ong ha u, Balei me la leh ia kane ? Namar ki briew ki tip ba u la phet noh na khmat U Trai namar u la iathuh ia ki .

en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered mortar , seeing vanity , and divining lies unto them , saying , Thus saith the Lord  God  , when the  Lord  hath not spoken .
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la buhrieh ïa la ki pop kum kito kiba tap ïa ka kynroh da ka pushara lieh . Ki ïohi ïa ki jingïohipaw ba bakla bad ki pynmih la ki jong jingïathuhlypa ba bakla . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar , hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngam shym la kren ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka ki la pynkhih ia ki da ka jinglong ba khlem akor, ki la iohi ia ka jinglong ba sniew bad ki la thiah ha ki, ki da ong: Kumta ong U Trai Blei , haba U Trai um shym la kren .

en: And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken  ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?
kha: Ym kumta da shisha ! Pynban , phi ong ha u , ‘ To pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da    jong me bad shakri ïa nga katba nga dang bam bad dih ; hadien kata me lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym kham bha ban ong ia u, To pynkhreh ia lade bad to ai ia nga haduh ba ngan da bam bad nga la dih ; bad hadien kata phin sa bam bad dih ?

en: Joshua therefore sent them forth : and they went to lie in ambush , and abode between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of Ai : but Joshua lodged that night among the people .
kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah noh ïa ki , bad ki la leit sha la ka jakarieh bad ap hangta , ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Ai , hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel . U Joshua pat u sahmiet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua namarkata u la phah ia ki: bad ki la leit thiah ha Bethesel bad Ai, ha ka liang sepngi jong ka Ai: hynrei u Joshua u la sah ha kata ka miet hapdeng ki briew .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jong nga ban bat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai Blei Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla Kylla

en: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon , and thou wast not aware : thou art found , and also caught , because thou hast striven against the  Lord .
kha: Ko Babilonia , pha ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , bad pha la shah riam ha ka jingriam kaba nga la buh ïa pha , wat la pham shym la tip ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la buh ia ka jingma na ka bynta jong me, bad me ruh me la shim ia me, ko Babilon, bad me khlem tip: me la lap, bad me la shah kem ruh, namar me la ialeh pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel , so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kumba ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la shim na ka khlaw bad la thang , kumta ngan shim ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Kumba u dieng sohjew hapdeng ki dieng khlaw , kiba nga la ai ha ka ding ban thang umphniang , kumta ngan ai ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem .

en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty , and continueth therein , he being not a forgetful hearer , but a doer of the work , this man shall be blessed in his deed .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba peit bniah ïa ka hukum bajanai kaba pyllaitluid ïa ki briew , uba ïai pynleit jingmut ïa ka bad ym tang ban sngap ïa ka bad nangta ban klet noh , hynrei u pyntreikam ïa ka — uta u briew un ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba peit ia ka ain kaba janai jong ka jinglaitluid, bad uba iai bteng ha kata, u long u nongsngap uba klet , hynrei u nongleh ia ka kam , une u briew un long uba la kyrkhu ha ka kam jong u .

en: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
kha: U Petros u la ong ha ki ,  Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong u bad ba yn pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba yn map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba long ka jingai jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ha ki, To kylla bamut bad to shah pynbaptis ia phi iwei ia iwei ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta ka jingmap ia ki pop bad phin pdiang ia ka jingai jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,
kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrit Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jong ka kmie jong u ki shong ki sah , bad u ong ha ki
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u khun u Jerubbaal u la leit sha Shehem ha ki hynmen jong u bad u la iakynduh bad ki bad bad ka iing jong u kpa jong u baroh kawei .

en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast , full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns .
kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri shyiap . Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka briew kaba shong halor u mradkhlaw rong saw uba la don ki kyrteng kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba la thoh baroh shi rynïeng jong u ; u mradkhlaw u la don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la rah noh ia nga ha ka mynsiem sha ka ri khlaw: bad nga la iohi ia kawei ka kynthei kaba shong halor u mrad uba rong saw , uba dap da ki kyrteng jong ka jingkren bein Blei , kaba don hynriew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki bniat .

en: And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :
kha: U Angel jong U Blei uba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Blei uba la leit sha khmat ka kynhun Israel u la leit noh bad u la leit shadien jong ki bad u lum u la leit noh na khmat jong ki, bad u la ieng shadien jong ki:

en: After two days was the feast of the passover , and of unleavened bread : and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft , and put him to death .
kha: Ka la long mynta ar sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait bad U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wad ka lad ban kem jar jar ïa U Jisu bad ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ar sngi ka la long ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglaitluid bad u kpu bym don thied: bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la wad kumno ban shim ia u da ka kti , bad ki la pyniap ia u .

en: But know this , that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come , he would have watched , and would not have suffered his house to be broken up .
kha: Lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por ba u nongtuh un wan , phi lah ban thikna ba un jin da la peitmat bad un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to tip ia kane , ba lada u briew uba bha jong ka iing u la tip ha kano ka jingpeit u nongtuh un wan , un jin da la peit , bad un ym shah ia ka iing jong u ban shah pynpra .

en: Now therefore , I pray thee , give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria , and I will deliver thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïapan dor bad phi ha ka kyrteng jong u patsha . Ngan ai ha phi ar hajar ki kulai lada phi lah ban pynïoh katta ngut ki briew ban shong ha ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ia ka jingkular ha u syiem jong nga u syiem Assyria, bad ngan aiti ia me ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada me lah na ka liang jong me ban buh ia ki nongshong kulai halor jong ki .

en: And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .
kha: U la ong ,  Ki rangbah Jiw ki la ïakut ban kyrpad ïa me lashai ka sngi ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka Dorbar , da kaba leh mynleh ba ka Dorbar ka kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba kham thikna shaphang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Ki Jiw ki la mynjur ban kwah ia me ba me wanrah ia u Paul sha ka dorbar , kumba kin kylli kham janai ia u .

en: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
kha: Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki diengthew kiba beit , khnang ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban don ka jingkhia kaba janai bad kaba hok, ka jingthew kaba janai bad kaba hok: ba ki sngi jong me kin nang jrong ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me .

en: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants , every drove by themselves  ; and said unto his servants , Pass over before me , and put a space betwixt drove and drove .
kha: U la pynbynta ïa ki ha la ka jong ka jong ka kynhun , bad u buh uwei u shakri jong u ba un khmih ïa kawei kawei ka kynhun . U la ong ha ki ,  Khie nang ïaid sha khmat jong nga , bad pynjngai khyndiat hapdeng kawei ka kynhun bad kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong ki shakri jong u, uwei pa uwei u la niah kali da lade; bad u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, To iaid sha khmat jong nga, bad u la buh ia ka jaka kaba heh bad u la niah kali .

en: And thine elder sister is Samaria , she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand : and thy younger sister , that dwelleth at thy right hand , is Sodom and her daughters .
kha: Ka hynmen jong pha , ka dei ka Samaria ha ka phang bashatei , ryngkat bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ka para jong pha lem bad ki nongrit jong ka , ka dei ka Sodom ha ka phang bashathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka para kaba kham heh jong me ka long ka Samaria, ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka kiba shong ha ka liang kadiang jong me: bad ka para kaba kham rit jong me kaba shong ha ka liang kadiang jong me, ka long ka Sodom bad ki khun kynthei jong ka .

en: And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïalap shaphang jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin hikai ia ki khun jong phi, haba phi shong ha iing jong me, bad haba me iaid hajan ka lynti, haba me thiah shapoh bad haba me khie .

en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .
kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ban mane ïa u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pyndonkam ia ka bor jong u mrad ba nyngkong ha khmat jong u , bad u pynlong ia ka khyndew bad ia kito kiba shong ha ka ban mane ia u mrad ba nyngkong , uba la pynkoit ia ka jingmynsaw kaba pyniap .

en: And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .
kha: Ynda uta u khunlung u la san , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Moses ,  Namar ,  ka ong ,  nga la sei ïa u na ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: U khynnah u la san bad ka la wanrah ia u ha ka khun jong u Pharaoh bad u la long u khun jong ka . Bad ka la khot ia u u Moses: bad ka la ong: Namar nga la sei ia u na ka um .

en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains  ; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out  ; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto .
kha: Nangta kito kiba ha Judia ki dei ban phet noh sha ki lum ; kito kiba don ha ka nongbah ki dei ban mihnoh , bad kito kiba don shabar ha ki rudnong kim dei ban leit shapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ai ba kito kiba don ha Judaea kin phet sha ki lum ; bad to ai ba kito kiba don hapdeng jong ka kin leit noh; bad wat ai ba kito kiba don ha ki ri kin rung shata .

en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?
kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim shi klong ka umphniang Olib bad u theh ïa ka ha ka khlieh u Saul , u doh ïa u , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me kum u nongsynshar ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Men synshar ïa ki briew jong u bad men ïada ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki . Bad kane kan long ka jingpynshisha ïa me ba U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me ban long u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la shim ia ka umphniang bad u la theh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u bad u la kdup ia u bad u la ong: Hato kam dei namar ba U Trai u la pynsleh ia me ban long u kapten halor ka pateng jong u ?

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; I am the  Lord  thy God which teacheth thee to profit , which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go .
kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , U  Trai  uba pynim ïa phi , u ong :  Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uta uba kwah ban hikai ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi bad uba kdew ïa phi ïa ka lynti ba phi dei ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai, U Nongsiewspah jong me, U Blei bakhuid jong me; nga long U Trai U Blei jong me uba hikai ia me ban ioh jingmyntoi, uba ialam ia me da ka lynti kaba me dei ban iaid .

en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son  ; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount : and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount .
kha: bad u Moses u la law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad u pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . Hangta ha kliar lum u Aaron u la ïap , bad u Moses bad u Eleasar ki wan hiar noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la weng noh ia ki jain jong u Aaron, bad u la buh ia ki ha u Eleasar u khun jong u; bad u Moses bad u Eleasar ki la wan hiar na u lum .

en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps , and will rend the caul of their heart , and there will I devour them like a lion : the wild beast shall tear them .
kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum ka dngiem kaba la duh ïa la ki khun , bad ngan tar arliang ïa phi . Kum u sing ngan bam ïa phi hangta hi , bad ngan tar ïa phi lyngkhot lyngkhai kum u mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iakynduh ia ki kum u bear uba la duh noh ia ki bniat jong ka, bad ngan pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong ki, bad hangta ngan bam ia ki kum u sing: u mrad khlaw un pynpra ia ki .

en: And all the people went their way to eat , and to drink , and to send portions , and to make great mirth , because they had understood the words that were declared unto them .
kha: Kumta u paidbah u leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih da kaba kmen bad ïasam ïa kaei kaba ki don bad kiwei pat , namar ki la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la pule ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la leit bam bad dih bad phah ia ki bynta bad ban pynlong ia ka jingkmen kaba khraw , namar ki la sngewthuh ia ki ktien kiba la pynbna ha ki .

en: Come now therefore , and let us slay him , and cast him into some pit , and we will say , Some evil beast hath devoured him : and we shall see what will become of his dreams .
kha: Ale mynta to ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad bret ïa ka met jong u ha kawei na ki pukri ba-tyrkhong . Ngi lah ban ong ba u mradkhlaw u la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ngin sa ïakhmih kan jia aïu ïa ki jingphohsniew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan mynta , bad to ngin pyniap ia u, bad ngin bret ia u ha kawei ka thliew, bad ngin ong , Uwei u mrad uba sniew u la bam ia u: bad ngin sa iohi kaei ka ban jia na ki jingphohsniew jong u .

en: Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
kha: Ka Assyria kan ym lah da lei lei ban pyllait im ïa ngi , bad ki kulai thma kim lah ban ïada ïa ngi . Ngin ym ong shuh ha ki bleithaw jong ngi ba ki long U Blei jong ngi . A  Trai  , me pyn-i jingisynei ha kito ki bym don uno uno sha uba ki lah ban phai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asshur un ym pynim ia ngi ; ngin ym shong kulai: lymne ngin ym ong shuh ia ka kam jong ki kti jong ngi: Phi long ki blei jong ngi: namar ha me ki bym don kpa ki shem ia ka jingisynei .

en: And to his father he sent after this manner  ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .
kha: Ïa la u kpa ruh u phah lam shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa ki mar Ijipt kiba bha tam , bad shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa u kew , u kpu bad kiwei pat ki jait jingbam ba u kpa jong u un ïoh bam ha lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u kpa jong u u la phah hadien kane ka rukom; shiphew tylli ki kada ki la bam da u kew bad u kpu bad ka doh na ka bynta u kpa jong u ha ka lynti .

en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .
kha: Hynrei uba ïeng hajan hangta uba kyrteng u Elihu um lah kun shuh ïa la ka jingbitar , namar u Job u pynksan ïa lade bad u kynnoh ïa U Blei . ( U Elihu u dei u khun jong u Barakel , uba hiarpateng na u Bus , bad u dei na ka kur jong u Ram . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la pynmeh ia ka jingbitar jong u Elihu u khun jong u Barachel u Buzite: pyrshah ia u Job ka la pynkhih ia ka jingbitar jong u, namar u la pynshisha ia lade ban ia U Blei .

en: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots , saying , Fight neither with small nor great , save only with the king of Israel .
kha: U syiem Syria u la lah hukum ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki rangbah kali ïapom jong u ban ym tur ïaleh ïano ïano lait tang ïa u syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem Syria u la hukum ia ki laiphew arngut ki rangbah jong u kiba la synshar halor ki kali jong u, da kaba ong: Wat ialeh da kaba rit ne kaba khraw, lait noh tang bad u syiem Israel .

en: Hear ye , O mountains , the  Lord s  controversy , and ye strong foundations of the earth : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with his people , and he will plead with Israel .
kha: Phi ki lumbah , phi ki nongrim bymjukut jong ka khyndew , to shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui jong U  Trai  ! U  Trai  u don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa la ki briew . Un wanrah ïa ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia phi, ko lum, bad phi ki nongrim kiba skhem jong ka khyndew: namar U Trai u don ka jingiakren bad ki briew jong u , bad un kyrpad ia ki Israel .

en: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah . And the people were encamped against Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Simri u la synshar hynñiew sngi ha Tirsah ïa ka Israel . Ki shipai Israel ki kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Philistia ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynriew jong u syiem Judah u Zimri u la synshar hynriew sngi ha Tirsah . Bad ki briew ki la shong shnong pyrshah ia u Gibbethon uba dei jong ki Philistia .

en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .
kha: U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynjar bad u shah ïa phi ban kmen ha ka jingshngain ; ka miej jong phi ka shlei da ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh un sa weng noh ia me na ka jingeh sha ka jaka kaba jylliew, ha kaba ym don ka jingeh ; bad kata kaba dei ban buh ha ka miej jong me kan long kaba dap da ka jingkhluit .

en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .
kha: bad ha ka ri shyiap . Phi la ïohi kumno u la bah ïa phi khlem jingmynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti haduh kane ka jaka , kumba u kpa u bah ïa la u khun .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka ri khlaw, ha kaba me la iohi kumno ba U Trai U Blei jong me u la kit ia me, kumba u briew u kit ia la u khun, ha ka lynti baroh kaba phi la leit, haduh ba phin da poi ha kane ka jaka .

en: Because , even because they have seduced my people , saying , Peace  ; and there was no peace  ; and one built up a wall , and , lo , others daubed it with untempered mortar :
kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da kaba ong ba baroh ka bit ka biang . Baroh kam long shisha kaba bit babiang ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynïeng ka kynroh ki maw bym skhem , bad nangta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wan bad ki tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar , wat namar ba ki la pynshoi ia ki briew jong nga, da kaba ong , Ka jingsuk ; bad ym shym la don ka jingsuk bad uwei u la tei ia ka kynroh, bad, lo, kiwei pat ki la pynkhih ia ka da ka jingthang kaba khlem da pynkhih:

en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity , because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the  Lord  : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka un ngat ha ka jingpynrem ba u kheiñ dew thala ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata uwei pa uwei uba bam ia ka un kit ia ka jingbymhok jong u: bad kata ka mynsiem kan shah ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one s bands were loosed .
kha: Kynsan la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , kaba la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki nongrim jong ka byndi . Shisyndon ki jingkhang baroh ki la plie , bad ki kynjri ki la hap na ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kynsan kynsan ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw , haduh ba ki nongrim jong ka phatok ki la khih: bad mardor la plie ia ki jingkhang baroh , bad la pyllait noh ia ki band jong uwei pa uwei .

en: Then he said unto me , Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel : behold , they say , Our bones are dried , and our hope is lost : we are cut off for our parts .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , ki briew ka Israel ki long kum kine ki shyieng . Ki ong ba ki la tyrkhong , khlem kano kano ka jingkyrmen bad ym don shuh ka lawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, ko khun u briew, kine ki shyieng ki long ka iing Israel baroh kawei: ha khmih ki ong: ki shyieng jong ngi ki la tyrkhong bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ka la jah noh: ngi la shah ot noh na ka bynta ki bynta jong ngi .

en: When the  Lord  thy God hath cut off the nations , whose land the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their cities , and in their houses  ;
kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew bad u ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki , bad hadien ba phi la ïohknieh ïa ki shnong bad ki ïing jong ki bad ba phi la shong la sah hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ot noh ia ki jaitbynriew, kiba ka ri jong ki U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ia me, bad me jop ia ki, bad me shong ha ki shnong jong ki, bad ha ki iing jong ki;

en: And Pharaoh called Joseph s name Zaphenath–paneah  ; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On . And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt .
kha: U la ai kyrteng nong Ijipt ïa u Joseph da ka kyrteng Saphenath Paneah , bad u la ai ha u ka tnga , ka Asenath , ka khun jong u Potiphera , u lyngdoh ha ka nongbah Heliopolis .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la khot ia u Joseph u Zaphenathamsiah ; bad u la ai ia u ha ka tnga jong u Asenath ka khun jong u Lyngdoh jong u Potiphera ka ri On . U Joseph u la leit shabar ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael , by their names , according to their generations : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth  ; and Kedar , and Adbeel , and Mibsam ,
kha: ka la ïoh ïa kine ki khun shynrang , ïa kiba la thoh ter ter kat kum ka sngi kha jong ki : u Nebaïoth , u Kedar , u Adbeel , u Mibsan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang jong u Ishmael, kat kum ki jait jong ki: u khun nyngkong jong u Ishmael, u Nebaioth ; bad u Kedar bad u Adbeel bad u Mibsam .

en: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the  Lord  , with the two lambs : they shall be holy to the  Lord  for the priest .
kha: U lyngdoh un ai ïa uta u kpu bad ïa kita ki khunlangbrot ar tylli kum ki jingainguh kiba kyrpang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ki lyngdoh . Kine ki jingainguh ki long kiba kyrpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un pynkhih ia ki da u kpu jong ki soh ba nyngkong na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai: kin long kiba khuid ha U Trai na ka bynta u lyngdoh .

en: But it came to pass in the morning , when the wine was gone out of Nabal , and his wife had told him these things , that his heart died within him , and he became as a stone .
kha: Nangta , ynda u la pyngngad , ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ïohpang kyndit bad u la long kum uba ïap baroh shi rynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia ha ka por mynstep, haba ka wain ka la mih noh na u Nabal, bad ka tnga jong u ka la iathuh ia kiei kiei ha u, ba ka dohnud jong u ka la iap hapoh jong u, bad u la kylla long kum u maw .

en: Shall evil be recompensed for good ? for they have digged a pit for my soul . Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them , and to turn away thy wrath from them .
kha: Hato ka jingsniew ka dei ka bainong na ka bynta kaba bha ? Pynban ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan hap ha ka . To kynmaw kumno ba nga la wan sha me bad kren na ka bynta jong ki , khnang ba men ym leh ei ei ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka jingsniew kan long kaba la siew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingbha ? namar ki la tih ia ka thliew na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong nga . Kynmaw ba nga la ieng ha khmat jong me ban kren bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ban pynphai noh ia ka jingbitar jong me na ki .

en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children  ; and said , Who are those with thee ? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .
kha: Haba u Iso u phai sawdong , bad u ïohi ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khynnah , u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba bad phi ?  U Jakob u jubab ,  Kine , kynrad , ki dei ki khun kiba U Blei u la sngewbha eh ban ai ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la iohi ia ki kynthei bad ki khun ; bad u la ong: Kiei kita kiba don bad me ? Bad u la ong , Ki khun kiba U Blei u la ai sngewbha ia u shakri jong me .

en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down  ; why cumbereth it the ground ?
kha: Kumta u la ong ha u nongsumar kper jong u , ‘ Ha khmih , la lai snem nga la wan shane da kaba wad soh Dumbur ha une u diengsoh Dumbur , bad ngam shym shem ei ei . Khet noh ïa u ! Balei un shu pynsep-ei ïa ka khyndew ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u nongthiah jong u sohjew jong u, Ha khmih, kine ki lai snem nga wan wad soh ha une u dieng sohjew, bad ngam lap ei ei: ot ia u ; balei u lum ia ka khyndew ?

en: Jesus answered him ,  I spake openly to the world  ; I ever taught in the synagogue , and in the temple , whither the Jews always resort  ; and in secret have I said nothing .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga la ju kren ha kaba paw ha baroh ; ki jinghikai jong nga baroh ki la long ha ki synagog bad ha ka Templ , ha kaba ki briew baroh ki ïawanlang . Ngam ju ong ïa kano kano ha kaba rieh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab ia u, nga kren shai ha ka pyrthei ; nga la ju hikai ha ka synagog bad ha ka tempi , ha kaba ki Jiw ki ju leit sha ka ; bad ha kaba rieh ngam shym la kren ei ei .

en: Wherefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , Because ye speak this word , behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire , and this people wood , and it shall devour them .
kha: Ki la ong ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim long ei ei hynrei ki pla dap lyer bad ba kim don ka khubor na U  Trai . U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , namar ba kine ki briew ki la kren ïa kum kine kiei kiei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ktien jong nga kum ka ding ha ka shyntur jong me . Ki briew kin long kum ka dieng , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata kumne u ong U Trai Blei jong ki paid: Namar ba phi kren ia kane ka ktien , ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia ki ktien jong nga ha ka shyntur jong me .

en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey , who left his house , and gave authority to his servants , and to every man his work , and commanded the porter to watch .
kha: Kan long kumba u briew uba mih na ïing ban leit jingleit , bad u iehnoh ha ki shakri ban khmih ïa ka kam , hadien ba u ai ha uwei pa uwei ïa ka kam jong u ban leh , bad hadien ba u ong ïa u nongap khyrdop ban peit bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Khun u briew u long kum u briew uba leit jingleit sha jngai, uba la mih na la iing bad u la ai bor ia ki shakri jong u bad ha uwei pa uwei u briew jong u .

en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,
kha: Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar shla ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka shnong ka la long ha nga kum ka jingpynkhih ia ka jingbitar jong nga bad jong ka jingbitar jong nga naduh ka sngi ba ki la tei ia ka haduh kane ka sngi;

en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .
kha: La ïathuh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shipai jong ki ka la mih ban leit kem ïa u . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la ker kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki Philistia ki la iohsngew ba ki la pynsleh ia u Dabid halor ki Israel , ki Philistia baroh ki la wan shaneng ban wad ia u Dabid ; bad u Dabid u la iohsngew ia kata, bad u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la buh.

en: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .
kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba ka Hukum hi ka long kaba pop ? Ym kumta keiñ ! Hynrei ka la long ka Hukum kaba pynlong ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka pop . Lada ka Hukum kam shym la ong ,  Wat kwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong uwei pat ,  ngan ym jin da la tip ïa kum kata ka jingkwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi ong aiu te ? Hato ka hukum ka long ka pop ? U Blei u la khang . Em, ngam shym la tip ia ka pop, hynrei da ka hukum: namar ngam shym la tip ia ka jingkwah brai, lait noh tang ka hukum ka la ong , Wat kwah .

en: But unto the place which the  Lord  your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there , even unto his habitation shall ye seek , and thither thou shalt come :
kha: Na ka ri ki jait jong phi baroh , U  Trai  un jied tang kawei ka jaka sha kaba phi dei ban wan mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi un jied na ki jaitbynriew jong phi baroh ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u hangta, wat ha ka jaka shong jong u ruh phin wad, bad me ruh phin wan:

en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki hynmen ha Ijipt , ha ka bynta kaba bha tam hajan ka nongbah Rameses , kumba u syiem u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la buh ia la u kpa bad ki hynmen jong u, bad u la ai ia ki ha ka ri Ijipt, ha ka ri kaba bha tam, ha ka ri Rameses kumba u Pharaoh u la hukum .

en: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
kha: Hynrei haba kim shym lap ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki parabangeit ha khmat ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah bad ki la pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki la thaw jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Jason u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kim lap ia ki, ki la tan ia u Jason bad katto katne ki para sha ki nongsynshar jong ka shnong, ki da iam: Kine kiba la pynkylla ia ka pyrthei ki wan hi;

en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .
kha: Halor u lum uba sha mihngi na Jerusalem u tei ka jaka mane ïa u Khemosh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Moab , bad ka jaka mane ïa u Molekh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Solomon u la tei ia ka jaka kaba jrong na ka bynta u Khemosh, ka jinglehrain jong u Moab, ha u lum uba don ha khmat ka Jerusalem, bad na ka bynta u Molek, ka jinglehrain jong ki khun Ammon .

en: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .
kha: Shi taïew hadien ki synran ki la ïadon lang biang hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la don lem bad ki . Ïa ki jingkhang la khang skhem , hynrei U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien 8 sngi ki synran jong u ki la don hapoh, bad u Thomas bad ki: nangta u Jisu u la wan, ki jingkhang ki la khang, bad u la ieng hapdeng bad u la ong, Ka jingsuk ha phi .

en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall , and on the higher places , I even set the people after their families with their swords , their spears , and their bows .
kha: Kumta nga pynkieng atiar ïa ki briew da ki waitlam , ki sum , bad ki ryntieh , bad nga pynap ïa ki da ki kur hadien ki kynroh , ha ki jaka bym pat dep tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga buh ha ki jaka kiba kham poh shadien jong ka kynroh , bad ha ki jaka kiba kham jrong , nga buh wat ia ki briew hadien ki longiing jong ki da ki waitlam jong ki , ki khnam jong ki bad ki bow jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , From whence comest thou ? And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei me wan ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Naei me wan ? U Soitan u la jubab ia U Trai, bad u la ong: Na kaba leit sha khyndew bad shapoh jong ka .

en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
kha: U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki briew baroh ki ïakhñium katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung kynhun kynhun ha khmat jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la sngewkhuslai namar ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la iohsngew ia ki briew baroh kawei ka iing ka sem jong u: bad ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei shibun; u Moses ruh u la sngewsih .

en: For ye know how that afterward , when he would have inherited the blessing , he was rejected : for he found no place of repentance , though he sought it carefully with tears .
kha: Hadien kata , phi tip , u la kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu u kpa jong u , hynrei u la shah kyntait ; namar um ïohlad shuh ban pynkylla ïa kaei kaba u la leh , la u la wad ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi tip kumno kata hadien, haba u la ioh pateng ia ka jingkyrkhu: namar um shym la shem ia ka jaka jong ka jingkylla kaba mut, wat la u la wad ia ka da ki ummat .

en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
kha: Kum ka jingainguh bam , wanrah u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw ; ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lai tylli ki jingai sngewbha na ka bynta ka jingknia doh, la khleh lang bad ka umphniang, na ka bynta uwei u masi ; bad ar tylli ki jingai sngewbha na ka bynta ka jingknia doh , la khleh lang bad ka umphniang;

en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman  ; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid  ;
kha: ban pynïap ïa ki shynrang bad ïa ki kynthei , ban pynïap ïa kiba la tymmen bad ïa kiba dang samla , ban pynïap ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad ki khynnah kynthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Da me ruh ngan pynpra ia u shynrang bad kynthei ; bad bad me ngan pynpra ia u samla bad u samla ; bad me ngan pynpra ia u samla bad ka kynthei ; .

en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?
kha: U Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Lada phi ïalam biang ïa nga sha ïing ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa nga , nga dei ban long u nongsynshar jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la ong ha ki rangbah jong ka Gilead , Lada phi wanrah biang ia nga sha iing ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon bad U Trai un aiti ia ki ha khmat jong nga , hato ngan long u khlieh jong phi ?

en: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah , and against Benjamin , and against the house of Ephraim  ; so that Israel was sore distressed .
kha: Ki Ammon ki da jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban ïaleh ïa ki jait Judah , Benjamin , bad Ephraim . Ki Israel ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki khun Ammon ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan ban ialeh pyrshah ia u Judah bad pyrshah ia u Benjamin bad pyrshah ia ka iing u Ephraim ; haduh ba ki Israel ki la shah shitom jur .

en: But Peter stood at the door without . Then went out that other disciple , which was known unto the high priest , and spake unto her that kept the door , and brought in Peter .
kha: Nangta uta uwei pat u synran u la mih biang shabar , u la ïakren bad ka khynnah ha ka khyrdop , bad u la ïalam ïa u Petros shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ieng ha ka jingkhang shabar . Nangta u la mih noh uta uwei pat u synran uba la tip ha u rangbah lyngdoh bad u la kren ha ka kaba u la ap ia ka jingkhang bad u la wanrah ia u Petros .

en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression , and take away mine iniquity ? for now shall I sleep in the dust  ; and thou shalt seek me in the morning , but I shall not be .
kha: Mem lah ban map da lei lei ïa ki pop jong nga ? Hato mem lah ban map ïa ka jingbymdei ba nga leh ? Shen , ngan sa don ha la ka jingtep bad ngan ym don shuh haba men khmih ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei phim map ia ka jingleh bymman jong nga, bad weng noh ia ka jingbymhok jong nga? namar mynta ngan thiah ha ka dewbilat ; bad me phin wad ia nga mynstep , hynrei ngan ym long kumta .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth : this year thou shalt die , because thou hast taught rebellion against the  Lord .
kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  hi u ong ba un weng noh ïa me . Ha shuwa ban kut kane ka snem men ïap namar me la ong ïa ki briew ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai u ong: Ha khmih , ngan bret noh ia me na ka khmat ka khyndew: mynta u snem men iap noh namar me la hikai ia ka jingleh pyrshah ia U Trai .

en: And take heed to yourselves , lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting , and drunkenness , and cares of this life , and so that day come upon you unawares .
kha: Sumar bha ! Wat pynlut por shaba palat ha ka jingkhawai bad ka jingïadih bad ha ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ïoh ba kata Ka Sngi kan kem kynsan ïa phi kum ka jingriam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to sumar ia lade , ioh ha kano kano ka por ba ki dohnud jong phi kin shah pynkhih palat bad ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , bad kumta kata ka sngi kan wan ha phi khlem da tip .

en: Woe to the rebellious children , saith the  Lord  , that take counsel , but not of me  ; and that cover with a covering , but not of my spirit , that they may add sin to sin :
kha: U  Trai  u la kren :  Kito kiba synshar ïa ka Judah kin jot noh namar ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki bud ïa ki jingthmu kiba ngam shym la shna , bad ki soi ïa ki jingïateh kular pyrshah ïa ka mon jong nga , da kaba kynton kawei ka pop halor kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew ia ki khun kiba leh pyrshah, ong U Trai, kiba shim jingmut, hynrei ym na nga; bad kiba tap da ka jingtap, hynrei ym na ka mynsiem jong nga, ba kin pyndap ia ka pop ha ka pop:

en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .
kha: Hynrei baroh ki la sdang , uwei hadien uwei pat , ban ai daw . Uba nyngkong u la ong ha u shakri , ‘ Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha bad nga dei ban leit bad khmih ïa ka ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh da ka jingmynjur ki la sdang ban pynmih daw . Kaba nyngkong ka la ong ia u, nga la thied ia ka jaka , bad nga dei ban leit peit ia ka: Nga duwai ba nga la pynrem ia nga .

en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .
kha: Don kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u dang buhrieh na ka jingtip u briew ; hynrei u la pynpaw ïa ka Aiñ jong u , bad ma ngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi , ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa ka junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiei kiei kiba rieh ki long ki jong U Trai jong ngi: hynrei kita kiei kiei kiba la pynpaw ki long ki jong ngi bad ki khun jong ngi junom , ba ngin leh ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum .

en: And say ye , Save us , O God of our salvation , and gather us together , and deliver us from the heathen , that we may give thanks to thy holy name , and glory in thy praise .
kha: To ong ha u ,  Pynim ïa ngi , A Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ; lumlang ïa ngi baroh ; pyllait ïa ngi na ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba ngin sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi ong , To pynim ia ngi ko Blei jong ka jingpynim jong ngi, bad to lum lang ia ngi, bad pyllait im ia ngi na ki nongwei , ba ngin ainguh ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me bad ka burom jong me ha ka jingiaroh jong me .

en: Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day , a sabbath of rest to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death .
kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ban long kaba kyntang , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga U  Trai . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi yn trei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynriew kan long ha phi ka sngi bakhuid , ka sngi shongthait ha U Trai: uno uno uba trei ha kata ka sngi un shah pyniap .

en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lehniam dei ban leh shisien shisnem ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka ain kaba neh junom ha phi, ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki khun Israel na ka bynta ki pop jong ki baroh shisien shisnem . Bad u la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
kha: Kam pher ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa u Soitan ,  baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym pynmong ïa u Job hi .  Te u Soitan u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Ha khmih, baroh kaba u don ha ka bor jong me; tang ha lade wat pynjrong ia ka kti jong me . Kumta u Soitan u la leit noh na khmat U Trai .

en: Wherefore now let the fear of the  Lord  be upon you  ; take heed and do it : for there is no iniquity with the  Lord  our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .
kha: Burom ïa U  Trai  bad trei bha , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um lah shah ïa ka jingleh bymdei lane ka jingleh shiliang khmat lane ka jingshim pisa thok .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to ai ba ka jingtieng ia U Trai kan long halor jong phi; namar ym don ka jingbymhok bad U Trai jong ngi, lymne ka jingburom ia ki briew, lymne ka jingshim ia ki jingai sngewbha .

en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever , as I promised to David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel .
kha: ngan pynneh junom ïa ka khet syiem jong me ha Israel , kumba nga la kular ha u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba ong , ‘ Men ym kyrduh u briew u ban shong ha ka khet Israel .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan pynskhem ia ka khet jong ka hima jong me ha Israel junom , kumba nga la kular ha u kpa jong me u Dabid , da kaba ong: Wat pynduh ia me ia u briew ha ka khet jong ki Israel .

en: And David sat between the two gates : and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall , and lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold a man running alone .
kha: U Dabid u dang shong ha ka jaka hapdeng ka khyrdop kaba shabar bad ka khyrdop kaba shapoh jong ka nongbah . U nongap phira u kiew shajrong kynroh bad u ïeng halor ka tnum jong ka khyrdop ; u peit sha khmat bad u ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shong hapdeng ki ar tylli ki khyrdop: bad u nongap u la kiew sha jrong halor ka khyrdop sha ka jingkhang , bad u la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la peit bad u la iohi ia u briew uba mareh marwei .

en: When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .
kha: Haba ka Israel ka ïohi haduh katno ka pang jur bad haba ka Judah ka ïohi ïa la ki jingmong , nangta ki Israel ki leit sha Assyria ban pan jingïarap na u syiem uba khrawbor , hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ïa ki lane pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Ephraim u la iohi ia ka jingpang jong u, bad u Judah u la iohi ia ka jingmynsaw jong u, nangta u la leit sha u Assyrian , bad u la phah sha u syiem u Jab: hynrei um lah ban pynkoit ia phi , lymne ban pynkoit ia phi na ka jingmynsaw jong phi .

en: Sing , O heavens  ; and be joyful , O earth  ; and break forth into singing , O mountains : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , and will have mercy upon his afflicted .
kha: To rwai , ko ki bneng ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen , ko ka pyrthei ! To ai ba ki lumbah kin win ha ka jingrwai ! U  Trai  un pyntngen ïa la ki briew ; un don jingisynei ha ki briew jong u kiba jynjar .
translated_en_to_kha: To rwai , ko bneng ; bad to sngewbha, ko khyndew ; bad to mih noh sha ka jingrwai , ko lum: namar U Trai u la pyntngen ia ki briew jong u, bad un isynei ia u ba la shah shitom jong u .

en: When thou art in tribulation , and all these things are come upon thee , even in the latter days , if thou turn to the  Lord  thy God , and shalt be obedient unto his voice  ;
kha: Ynda phi don ha ka jynjar , bad kita kiei kiei baroh ki wan jia ha phi , te ha kaba khatduh phin phai sha U  Trai  bad kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me don ha ka jingjynjar bad kine kiei kiei baroh ki wan ha me, wat ha ki sngi kiba hadien, lada me phai sha U Trai U Blei jong me bad to kohnguh ia ka sur jong u;

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and he shall take it :
kha: Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka nongbah ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ; kin kurup ïa ka bad thang ïa ka da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih , ngan aiti ia kane ka shnong ha ka kti jong ki Khaldan bad ha ka kti jong u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon bad un shim ia ka:

en: And what shall I more say ? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon , and of Barak , and of Samson , and of Jephthae  ; of David also , and Samuel , and of the prophets :
kha: Hato ngan dang ïai bteng ? Ngam don por shibun ban ïathuh shaphang u Gideon , u Barak , u Samson , u Jepthah , u Dabid , u Samuel bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaba nga kham ong ? namar ka por kan ym lah ban iathuh ia u Gideon bad u Barak bad u Samson bad u Jephthah; u Dabid ruh bad u Samuel bad ki nongiathuhlypa:

en: For so the  Lord  said unto me , I will take my rest , and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs , and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan jngoh sha tbian na bneng kumba ka umjer ka wandur jar jar ha ki miet basyiad ha ka aïom ot , kumba ka sngi ka phyrnai itynnat ha ka jingshit ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ngan shim ia ka jingjahthait jong nga, bad ngan pyrkhat ha ka jaka shong jong nga kum ka jingshit kaba shai halor ki jingthung jingtep bad kum u lyoh jong ka dewbilat ha ka jingshit jong ka jingot .

en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God .
kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem : bad u la leh ia kata kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong u .

en: And they said every one to his fellow , Come , and let us cast lots , that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us . So they cast lots , and the lot fell upon Jonah .
kha: Ki maji ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  To ngin ïakynting sbai bad wad mano ba long ka daw kaba la pynlong ïa ngi ban ngat ha kane ka jingma .  Ki la leh kumta , bad ka la hap ha ka kyrteng u Jonah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong uwei pa uwei ha u paralok jong u, To wan, bad to ngin ia thep vote, ba ngin tip na ka bynta jongno kane ka jingsniew ka don halor jong ngi . Kumta ki la thep vote bad ka lot ka la hap ha u Jonah .

en: And say unto it , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O mount Seir , I am against thee , and I will stretch out mine hand against thee , and I will make thee most desolate .
kha: Ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kaei ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong :  Nga long u nongshun jong me , ko ki lumbah ka Edom ! Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jaka kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ka , Kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih, ko u lum Seir, nga long pyrshah ia me, bad ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia me, bad ngan pynlong ia me kaba kham sniew .

en: And said unto him , Hearest thou what these say ? And Jesus saith unto them ,  Yea  ; have ye never read , Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise ?
kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Me ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki ong ?   Ho-oid nga ïohsngew ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Phim pat la ju pule ïa kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ? ‘ Me la hikai ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ban ai ki jingïaroh bajanai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u , Hato me sngap ia kaei kaba kine ki ong ? Bad U Jisu u ong ha ki , Hooid phim pat ju pule , Na ka shyntur jong ki babes bad ki jingbam ba la pyndep ?

en: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her , Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them .
kha: Bad ki la kyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ka Rebekka da kine ki kyntien :  To phi , ka para , phin long ka kmie u paidbah byllien ! To ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin da jop thiaw ïa ki nongbah jong ki nongshun jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kyrkhu ia ka Rebekka bad ki la ong ha ka, Me long ka para jong ngi, to long ka kmie jong ki hajar hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar ngut ki hajar hajar ngut ki hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar hajar

en: For thus saith the Lord  God  , the Holy One of Israel  ; In returning and rest shall ye be saved  ; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength : and ye would not .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel , u ong ha ki briew ,  Phai noh bad to shaniah jar jar ha nga . Te phin long khlaiñ bad skhem .  Hynrei phi kyntait ban leh ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei , Uba khuid jong ki Israel ; Ha kaba wan phai bad shongthait phin sa shah pynim ; ha ka jingsngap jar bad ha ka jingshaniah phin long ka bor jong phi: bad phin ym long kumta .

en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places , as did the heathen whom the  Lord  carried away before them  ; and wrought wicked things to provoke the  Lord  to anger :
kha: bad ki thang jingiwbih ha baroh ki duwan ki blei thala , da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki briew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri . Ki pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  da ki jingleh kynriang jong ki baroh
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki jaka ba jrong baroh , kumba ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la rah noh ha khmat jong ki ; bad ki la leh ia kiei kiei kiba sniew ban pynkhih ia U Trai ban bitar:

en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , throughout thy tribes : and they shall judge the people with just judgment .
kha: Thung ïa ki nongbishar bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ha man la ka shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi . Kine kin bishar hok ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongbishar bad ki ophisar jong me baroh, kiba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, ha ki jaitbynriew jong me baroh: bad kin bishar ia ki briew da ka jingbishar kaba hok .

en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .
kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmih ka um na ka Umpohliew Gihon bad ban pun ïa ka um ba kan tuid lyngba ka nur-um sha ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u juh u Hesekaiah ruh u la pynsangeh ia ka wah kaba shalor jong u Gihon , bad u la wanrah beit shapoh ka liang sepngi jong ka shnong u Dabid . Bad u Hesekaiah u la roi ha ki kam jong u baroh .

en: And I took my concubine , and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel : for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .
kha: Nga shim ïa ka met jong ka , nga ot lyngkhot ïa ka , bad nga phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei ka jait Israel . Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba bymman bad ba-ijli hapdeng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la shim ia ka kynthei jong nga, bad nga la ot ia ka ha ki bynta baroh kawei: namar ki la leh ia ka kam sniew bad ka jingleh be-ijot ha Israel .

en: Samuel also said unto Saul , The  Lord  sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people , over Israel : now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the  Lord .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Dei ïa nga ba U  Trai  u la phah ban pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Mynta , sngap ïa kaba U  Trai  u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel ruh u la ong ha u Saul , U Trai u la phah ia nga ban pynsleh ia me ban long syiem halor ki briew jong u: mynta to sngap ia ka sur jong ki ktien U Trai .

en: ( After that Jeconiah the king , and the queen , and the eunuchs , the princes of Judah and Jerusalem , and the carpenters , and the smiths , were departed from Jerusalem  ; )
kha: Nga la thoh ïa ka hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakhin , ka kmie jong u , ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , ki nong-ohdur , bad ki nongtrei batbit ki la shah ringmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: (Hadien kata u syiem bad ka mahadei bad ki nongsynshar ki la leit noh na Jerusalem ;).

en: Moreover , if he be gotten into a city , then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there be not one small stone found there .
kha: Lada u kynran dien sha ka nongbah , ki briew jong ngi baroh kin wallam ïa ki tyllai bad kin shu tan ïa ka nongbah shapoh ka them . Yn ym don uwei ruh u maw ïa uba yn iehnoh ha kliar lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata, lada u la rung ha kawei ka shnong, te baroh ki Israel kin wanrah ia ki lynti sha kata ka shnong, bad ngin sa tan ia ka shapoh wah, haduh ba ym don uwei ruh u maw rit ba la lap hangta .

en: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground , thou shalt not be established , nor thy kingdom . Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me , for he shall surely die .
kha: Hato mem sngewthuh ba katba u Dabid u dang im , lano lano men ym ïoh long u syiem jong kane ka ri ? Mynta hi to khie leit bad wallam ïa u shane — u dei ban ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba u khun u Jesse u dang im ha ka khyndew, men ym shong skhem, ne ka hima jong me . Namar kata mynta phah bad leit sha nga, namar un sa iap shisha .

en: And after a time he returned to take her , and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion : and , behold , there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion .
kha: Katto katne sngi hadien , u Samson u leit phai pat ban shongkurim ïa ka . Ha ka jingleit jong u , u leit sharud lynti ban khmih ïa ka metïap jong uta u sing , bad u sngewlyngngoh ban lap shi kiaw u ngap bad khyndiat ka ngap hapoh kata ka metïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien katto katne por u la wan phai biang ban shim ia ka, bad u la phai shawei ban iohi ia ka met jong u sing: bad , ha khmih , ka la don ka sniehdoh jong ki khnai bad ka umsoh ha ka met jong u sing .

en: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms  ; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations : for I will diminish them , that they shall no more rule over the nations .
kha: ka hima batlot tam na baroh , bad kin ym ïoh synshar pat halor kiwei ki hima . Ngan pynlong ïa ki , ki bymlarkam haduh ba kin ym lah ban pynlong ïa kano kano ka hima ban pyndem ha ka mon jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan long kaba rit tam na ki hima ; bad kan ym pynkiew shuh ia lade halor ki jaitbynriew: namar ngan pynduna ia ki, ba kin ym synshar shuh ia ki jaitbynriew .

en: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .
kha: Katba ki briew ki dang shahshkor ïa kane , U Jisu u la bteng bad u la ïathuh ïa ka pharshi ha ki . U la jan poi artat ha Jerusalem , bad ki la tharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jan paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei, u la bynrap bad kren ia ka jingiathuhkhana , namar ba u la jan sha Jerusalem , bad namar ba ki la pyrkhat ba ka hima U Blei ka dei ban paw mardor .

en: And now , brethren , I commend you to God , and to the word of his grace , which is able to build you up , and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified .
kha: Bad mynta nga aiti ïa phi ha ka jingsumar jong U Blei bad ha ka khubor jong ka jingaiei jong u , kaba lah ban tei ïa phi , bad ai ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba U Blei u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ko para bangeit, nga ai khublei ia phi ha U Blei bad ha ka ktien ka jingaiei jong u kaba lah ban tei ia phi bad ban ai ia phi ia ka pateng hapdeng jong ki baroh kiba la pynkyntang .

en: Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?
kha: Hangno mynta ka don ka nongbah kata kaba long kum ka krem jong ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing samla , ha kaba u sing bad ka sing kin leit bad ki khun jong ki kin don ha ka jingshngain ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno ka jaka shong jong ki sing bad ka jaka bam jong ki sing rit , ha kaba u sing , wat u sing uba la tymmen ruh u la iaid , bad u sing u la iaid lyngngoh , bad ym don ba pyntieng ia ki ?

en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .
kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , nga dang lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka reng barit ba ka kren sarong eh bad kob . Katba nga dang ap khmih , la pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw uba saw , bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ki thylliej ding bad ka pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi nangta namar ka sur jong ki kyntien kiba khraw kiba u horn u la kren: Nga la iohi wat haduh ba u mrad u la shah pyniap, bad ka met jong u ka la shah pynjot , bad la ai ha ka ding kaba thang .

en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .
kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la leit sha u Elisha , bad ki ong ,  Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba itynnat , hynrei ka um ka sniew bad ka wanrah ki jinghap khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki la ong ha u Elisha, Ha khmih, nga kyrpad ia me, ka jinglong jong kane ka shnong ka long kaba sngewtynnad kumba u kynrad jong nga u iohi: hynrei ka um ka long kaba sniew bad ka khyndew ka long kaba rkhiang .

en: And , having made peace through the blood of his cross , by him to reconcile all things unto himself ; by him , I say , whether they be things in earth , or things in heaven .
kha: Da U Khun , te , U Blei u la kut jingmut ban wallam pat ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei sha lade hi . U Blei u la pynïasuk da ka jingïap U Khun jong u kum ka jingkñia halor ka diengphna bad kumta u la wallam pat sha lade hi ïa kiei kiei baroh , kiba ha ka pyrthei bad kiba ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iasuk lyngba ka snam jong u diengphna jong u, da u ban pynbeit ia kiei kiei baroh ha lade; da u, nga ong, la ki long kiei kiei ha ka khyndew ne kiei kiei ha bneng .

en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eloi , Eloi , lama sabachthani ?  which is , being interpreted ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,   Eloi , Eloi , lema sabakhthani ?   kaba mut ,  A Blei jong nga , A Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por kaba hynniew U Jisu u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u la ong, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani ? kaba long, kaba la pynkylla ktien: Ko Blei jong nga, ko Blei jong nga, balei me la iehnoh ia nga ?

en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .
kha: Kumta ki langbrot jong nga ki ïaid sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pyrshang ban wad ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki langbrot jong nga ki iaid lyngba ki lum baroh, bad halor u lum baroh: Hooid, ka kynhun jong nga ka la bthei ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew baroh kawei, bad ym don ba wad ne wad ia ki .

en: For though I made you sorry with a letter , I do not repent , though I did repent : for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry , though it were but for a season .
kha: Naba wat lada kata ka shithi jong nga ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi , nga te ngam sngewsih ba nga la thoh ïa ka . Ngan jin da la sngewsih haba nga la ïohi ba ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga la sngewsih ia phi da ka shithi, ngam kylla bamut, wat la nga la kylla bamut: namar nga sngewthuh ba kata kajuh ka shithi ka la pynsngewsih ia phi, wat la ka la long tang shi aiom .

en: And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .
kha: Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki pla snieh waiñ , ki dang thymmai , hynrei ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki juti jong ngi ki la jot namar ka jingïaid lynti kaba jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki bilor wain kiba ngi la pyndap ki long kiba thymmai bad, ha khmih, ki la tyrkhong: bad kine ki jain bad ki juti jong ngi ki la kylla tymmen namar ka jingleit kaba jngai bha .

en: And the  Lord  said , I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt , and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters  ; for I know their sorrows  ;
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ïohi haduh katno la pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt ; nga la ïohsngew ruh ba ki ud ban ïohlait noh na ki nongpyntrei mraw jong ki . Nga tip ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ki baroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Nga la iohi shisha ia ka jingjynjar jong ki briew jong nga kiba don ha Ijipt , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki namar ki nongtrei jong ki ; namar nga tip ia ki jingsngewsih jong ki ; .

en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba thang ïa ka sharak bad tap ïa ka da ka shang lane buh ïa ka ha khrum jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki dang wan rung .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew, haba u la pynmeh ia ka sharak, uba tap ia ka da ka umphniang, ne uba buh ia ka hapoh ka jingthiah ; hynrei u buh ia ka ha ka sharak , ba kito kiba rung ki lah ban iohi ia ka jingshai .

en: The light of the body is the eye : therefore when thine eye is single , thy whole body also is full of light  ; but when thine eye is evil , thy body also is full of darkness .
kha: Ki khmat jong phi ki long kum ka sharak ïa ka met jong phi . Haba ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingshai ; hynrei haba ki khmat jong phi kim bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei kan long ha ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshai jong ka met ka long ka khmat: namarkata haba ka khmat jong me ka long marwei, ka met jong me baroh kawei ruh ka dap da ka jingshai ; hynrei haba ka khmat jong me ka long kaba sniew , ka met jong me ruh ka dap da ka jingdum .

en: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person , to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom : but he shall come in peaceably , and obtain the kingdom by flatteries .
kha: U angel u la bteng ban batai :  U syiem uba bud jong ka Syria un long u briew uba sniew u bym don ka hok ban long syiem , hynrei un wan khlem khmih lynti bad un knieh ïa ka bor da ka buit shukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jaka jong u un ieng u briew uba sniew, ha uba kin ym ai ia ka burom jong ka hima: hynrei un wan rung suk , bad un ioh ia ka hima da ki jingsngewbha .

en: And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .
kha: khnang ba phin ïoh kam kynti biang ïa kata ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shong shisien . Un pynmanbha bad un pynroi ïa phi kham bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong me un wanrah ia me sha ka ri kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki don, bad men long trai ia ka ; bad un leh ia me kaba bha, bad un pynbun ia me halor ki kpa tymmen jong me .

en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .
kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki bad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba ngi lah ban ap phira ïa ka nongbah mynmiet bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha kajuh ka por nga la ong ha ki briew , To ai ba uwei pa uwei bad u shakri jong u un sah hapoh Jerusalem , ba ha ka miet kin long ki nongap ia ngi bad ki trei shitom ha ka sngi .

en: And I will make thee like the top of a rock : thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon  ; thou shalt be built no more : for I the  Lord  have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan ieh sa tang u mawsiang ha uba ki nongtong dohkha ki lah ban pynrkhiang ïa la ki jar . Ïa ka nongbah yn ym tei pat ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia me kum ka tduh jong u maw: me long ka jaka ban pynphriang ia ki net ha me beg yn ym tei shuh: namar nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
kha: Ki nongshun jong me kim tip satia ba men pynshitom ïa ki . A  Trai  , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kin jynjar da ka jingpynshitom kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me ieit ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, haba la pynkiew ia ka kti jong me, kin ym iohi: hynrei kin sa iohi, bad kin sngewlehrain namar ka jingsngewsih jong ki ia ki briew ; yea, ka ding jong ki nongshun jong me kan bam ia ki .

en: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan , the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron , and said unto them , Come near , carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp .
kha: U Moses u khot ïa u Mishael bad ïa u Elsaphan , ki khun jong u Ussiel , u kñi jong u Aaron , bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ale shane bad ïarah noh ïa kine ki met jong ki parakha jong phi na ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang bad buh ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia u Mishael bad u Elzaphan, ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron, bad u la ong ha ki, To wan hajan, to rah ia ki hynmen jong phi na khmat ka jaka kyntang na ka jaka ri jingri .

en: Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .
kha: Nga kwah ba phin tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u lah ban ong  Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu!  bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla  U Jisu u long U Trai ,  lymda la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ai ia phi ban sngewthuh , ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba kren da U Mynsiem U Blei uba la shah kyntait: bad ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban ong ba U Jisu U long U Trai , hynrei da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

en: Then the people rejoiced , for that they offered willingly , because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the  Lord  : and David the king also rejoiced with great joy .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la ai da ka mon sngewbha sha U  Trai  , bad ki kmen ba ki la ai shibun . U Syiem Dabid ruh u la sngewkmen shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew ki la sngewbha , namar kata ki la tyrwa mon sngewbha , namar da ka dohnud kaba janai ki la tyrwa mon sngewbha ha U Trai : bad u syiem u Dabid ruh u la sngewbha da ka jingkmen kaba khraw .

en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
kha: bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa hapoh jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna sawphew tylli ki socket rupa hapoh ki arphew tylli ki board jong u na ka bynta ki ar tylli ki board jong u, bad ar tylli ki soket hapoh kawei pat ka board jong u na ka bynta ki ar tylli ki board jong u .

en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .
kha: haduh ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jong u , kumba u la maham lyngba ki shakri jong u ki nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . Te ki paid Israel ki la shah pynryngkang par sha Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba U Trai un weng noh ia ki Israel na ka khmat jong u, kumba u la ong da ki shakri jong u baroh ki nongiathuhlypa . Kumta la rah noh ia ki Israel na la ka jong ka ri sha Assyria haduh kine ki sngi .

en: Even the Spirit of truth  ; whom the world cannot receive , because it seeth him not , neither knoweth him : but ye know him  ; for he dwelleth with you , and shall be in you .
