kha: Uta u long U Mynsiem uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei . Ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang ïa u , namar ba kam ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u . Hynrei phi ithuh ïa u , namar ba u ïaisah bad phi bad u don hapoh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat U Mynsiem jong ka jingshisha uba ka pyrthei kam lah ban pdiang, namar kam iohi ia u, lymne kam ithuh ia u: hynrei phi ithuh ia u; namar u shong bad phi bad un don ha phi .

en: ( I stood between the  Lord  and you at that time , to shew you the word of the  Lord  : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount  ; ) saying ,
kha: Nga la ïeng hapdeng jong phi bad U  Trai  ha kata ka por ban ïathuh ha phi aïu u ong , namar ba phi sheptieng ïa kata ka ding bad phim shym leit kiew sha uta u lum .  U  Trai  u la ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: (Nga la ieng hapdeng U Trai bad phi ha kata ka por, ban pyni ia phi ia ka ktien U Trai: namar phi la tieng namar ka ding , bad phim shym la leit sha u lum ; ) da kaba ong:

en: Similarly , for thousands of years , hope in the salvation of Jehovah has sustained men and women of faith in times of trouble , and this hope has never led to disappointment .
kha: Kumjuh ruh da ki hajar snem ka jingkyrmen ha ka jingpynim U Jehobah ka la pynneh ia ki shynrang bad kynthei kiba ngeit ha ki por ba shitom , bad kane ka jingkyrmen kam ju ialam sha ka jingduh jingkyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh da ki hajar snem , ka jingkyrmen ha ka jingpynim U Jehobah ka la pynneh ia ki shynrang bad kynthei kiba ngeit ha ki por ba jynjar , bad kane ka jingkyrmen kam ju wanrah ia ka jingduh jingkyrmen .

en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .
kha: Um long kum kiwei pat ki rangbah lyngdoh ; um da donkam ban da ai jingkñia man ka sngi na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad nangta na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew . U ai kawei ka jingkñia , tang shisien hi , haba u la kñia noh ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba donkam man ka sngi, kum kita ki rangbah lyngdoh, ban aiti nyngkong eh na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi, bad nangta na ka bynta ki briew s: namar kane u la leh shisien, haba u la aiti ia lade .

en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .
kha: U Blei u thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad phim lah ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kaba u leh ban ïa kaba phi sngewthuh kumno ka jingim bathymmai ka sdang ha ka kpoh jong ka kynthei kaba armet .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba me tip ia kaei ka lynti jong u mynsiem, ne kumno ki shyieng ki san ha ka kpoh jong ka kaba don khun: wat la katta ruh me tip ia ki kam U Blei uba pynlong ia baroh .

en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .
kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ha la u kpa ,  Wat bitar ïa nga , ko kynrad , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi , nga dang poi bnai .  U Laban u la wad , hynrei um shym la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u kpa jong ka, Wat pynsngewsih ia u kynrad jong nga ba ngam lah ban kiew ha khmat jong me ; namar ka dustur jong ki kynthei ka don ha nga . Bad u la wad , hynrei um shym la lap ia ki dur .

en: He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .
kha: U la thaw nynkong ia ki shijur ki briew U Adam bad ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki haka kper Eden , bad u la hukum ia ki , ba kin ioh khun ioh kti , bad ban pyniar ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei kum ka kper Eden .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thaw ia u briew uba nyngkong eh u Adam bad ka Im , u la buh ia ki ha ka paradais jong ka pyrthei kaba la khot ka Eden , bad u la bthah ia ki ban ioh khun bad pynjlan ia ka pyrthei jong ki ha ka pyrthei jong ki ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah : and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the  Lord  , which he had spoken unto him , upon a roll of a book .
kha: Kumta nga la khot ïa u Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah bad nga la ong ïa u ban thoh katba nga dang ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la lah ong ha nga . Bad u Barukh u la thoh ïa ka baroh ha ka kot kli .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la khot ia u Barukh u khun u Jeremaiah: bad u Barukh u la thoh na ka shyntur jong u Jeremaiah ia ki ktien U Trai baroh kiba u la kren ha u, ha ka kot lyngkdop .

en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles , whom God drave out before the face of our fathers , unto the days of David  ;
kha: Hadien , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka ïingjaiñ na ki kpa jong ki , ki la bah ïa ka lem bad ki haba ki la leit bad u Joshua bad shimti ïa ka ri na ki jaitbynriew kiba U Blei u la beh katba ki nang tur sha khmat . Bad ka la don hangta haduh ka por jong u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la wanrah bad U Jisu ha ka jingdon jong ki Jutang, kiba U Blei u la ring noh ha khmat ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, haduh ki sngi u Dabid;

en: Since Gilead’s founding in 1943 , more than 8 ,000 graduates of this school have been sent out as missionaries to give a witness “to the ends of the earth” with great success .
kha: Naduh ba la sdang ïa ka Gilead ha u snem 1943 , palat 8 ,000 ngut ki la wan sha kane ka skul bad la phah ïa ki kum ki mishoneri ban sakhi “shaduh kaba kut ka pyrthei .”
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ba la seng ia ki Gilead ha ka snem 1943 , palat 8 000 ngut ki nongpule jong kane ka skul la phah shabar kum ki mishoneri ban ai sakhi  haduh ki kut jong ka pyrthei  da ka jingjop kaba khraw .

en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us , and we gave them reverence : shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits , and live ?
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki kpa jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei , ki sneng sympat ïa ngi bad ngi burom ïa ki . Katno tam , te , ngi dei ban pyndem ha U Kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi bad ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh ngi la don ki kpa jong ka doh jong ngi kiba la pynbeit ia ngi , bad ngi la ai ia ki ka jingburom: hato ngin kham sngewbha ban long hapoh U Kpa ki mynsiem bad im ?

en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :
kha: Hato phi la klet noh ïa ki ktien pynshlur ïa kiba U Blei u la kren ha phi kum ïa la ki khun ?  Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut haba U Trai u sneng pynbeit ïa phi , bad wat sngew noh mynsiem haba u sneng ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la klet ia ka jingkyntu kaba kren ha phi kum ki khun jong nga, wat ju leh bein ia ka jingpynshitom bein ia U Trai, lane wat ju leh bein haba me la shah pynrem ia u:

en: Rejoice and be glad , O daughter of Edom , that dwellest in the land of Uz  ; the cup also shall pass through unto thee : thou shalt be drunken , and shalt make thyself naked .
kha: To ïai rkhie , ko ki briew ka Edom bad ka Us ; to kmen katba phi dang lah . Ka jingpynjot ïa phi ruh ka wan ; ma phi ruh phin ïaid sheng sheng lyngkhuit ha ka jinglehrain .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha bad to sngewbha ko khun jong u Edom, kaba shong ha ka ri Uz ; ka khuri ruh kan iaid lyngba ia me: me la dih kyiad bad me la pynlong ia lade uba lyngkhuid .

en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt , and with an high arm brought he them out of it .
kha: U Blei jong ki paid Israel u la jied ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw ïa une u paid ha ka por ba ki la im kum ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt . U Blei u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bakhraw jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong une u briew jong ki Israel u la jied ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad u la pynkhraw ia ki briew haba ki shong kum ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt , bad da ka kti kaba jrong u la pynmih ia ki na ka .

en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years , even the selfsame day it came to pass , that all the hosts of the  Lord  went out from the land of Egypt .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba kut jong kita ki sawspah laiphew snem , baroh ki paid U  Trai  ki mihnoh na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki saw spah laiphew snem, wat ha kajuh ka sngi ka la jia, ba ki shipai U Trai baroh ki la mih na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And there was nothing lacking to them , neither small nor great , neither sons nor daughters , neither spoil , nor any thing that they had taken to them : David recovered all .
kha: Ym don ei ei kaba jah . U Dabid u ïoh pat ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei baroh jong ki briew jong u , bad ïa ki mar lute baroh ba ki Amalek ki la kit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don ei ei kaba duna ha ki, ym don khun shynrang ne kynthei, ym don khun shynrang ne kynthei, lymne ka jingbam ba la shim ha ki: U Dabid u la koit lut .

en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house : and I looked , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house of the  Lord  : and I fell upon my face .
kha: Te uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashaphang shatei haduh ha khmat ka Templ . Katba nga dang khmih , nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ U  Trai  la pyndap da ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wanrah ia nga ha ka lynti jong ka khyrdop shaphang shathie: bad nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ia ka iing U Trai: bad nga la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong nga .

en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .
kha: Ki nong Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Gibeah ki la ieng pyrshah ia nga, bad ki la pynkhih ia ka iing sawdong jong nga ha ka por miet, bad ki la pyrkhat ban pyniap ia nga: bad ka tnga jong nga ki la pynbor ia nga, ba ka la iap .

en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
kha: U Ammon lane u Moab — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew — ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ammon ne u Moab un ym rung ha ka jingiaseng U Trai ; wat haduh ka pateng kaba shiphew jong ki kin ym rung ha ka jingiaseng U Trai junom:

en: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .
kha: Shim bad me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shynrang bad ka kynthei na kawei pa kawei ka jait mrad bad jait sim baroh , na ka bynta ba yn ri pynim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ki sim kat kum ka jait jong ki, bad ki masi katkum ka jait jong ki, na kawei pa kawei ka jait jong ka khyndew katkum ka jait jong u, ar tylli na ki jait kin wan sha me, ban pynim ia ki .

en: And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .
kha: U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynrei kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lem bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki . Kine ki briew kiba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , bad kumta ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh krad ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la don bad u Judah ; bad u la beh noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong u lum hynrei um lah ban beh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka them namar ki don ki kali nar .

en: And I am this day weak , though anointed king  ; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me : the  Lord  shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness .
kha: Wat la nga long u syiem uba la jied da U Blei , nga sngewtlot mynta ka sngi . Kine ki khun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki long ka jingma ïa nga . To U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa kine ki nongkamsniew kumba ki dei ban ïoh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga long uba tlot ha kane ka sngi, wat la u syiem ba la pynsleh u la long uba eh palat ia nga: U Trai un siew kylliang ia u nongleh bymman kat kum ka jingsniew jong u .

en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .
kha: Nangta u mih bad wallam ïa ki hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dep baroh , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong ba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u leit sha u hynriew tylli kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ia u hi bad ki rung shapoh bad ki shong hangta : bad ka jinglong kaba khatduh jong uta u briew ka kham sniew ban ia kaba nyngkong .

en: And of Benjamin he said , The beloved of the  Lord  shall dwell in safety by him  ; and the  Lord  shall cover him all the day long , and he shall dwell between his shoulders .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Benjamin u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jait ba U  Trai  u ieit bad ïada ; U ïada ïa ki baroh shi sngi , Bad u shong hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na u Benjamin u la ong , U baieit jong U Trai un shong shngain ha u bad U Trai un tap ia u baroh shisngi, bad un shong hapdeng ki tyrpeng jong u;

en: Brethren , I count not myself to have apprehended : but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind , and reaching forth unto those things which are before ,
kha: Da shisha , ko parabangeit jong nga , nga shisha ngam pyrkhat ba nga la jop lypa ïa ka ; ïa kane kawei nga leh , la kumno kumno , da kaba klet noh ïa kaei kaei kaba shadien jong nga bad nga ïaleh shitom ban poi sha kaei kaba sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki para bangeit , ngam khein ia lade ba nga la sngewthuh: hynrei kane kawei kaba nga leh , nga klet ia kiei kiei kiba shadien , bad nga poi sha kiei kiei kiba don ha khmat .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities , and the wastes shall be builded .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ynda haba ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki pop jong phi baroh , ngan sa shah ba phin shong biang ha ki nongbah jong phi bad shah ba phin tei pat ïa ki jaka ba la jot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei ; Ha ka sngi ba ngan pynkhuid ia phi na ki jingbymhok jong phi baroh ngan pynlong ruh ia phi ban shong ha ki nongbah , bad ia ki jaboh yn tei .

en: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country : they may be redeemed , and they shall go out in the jubilee .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki ïing ha ki nongrit ki bym shym la ker kynroh yn leh kumba leh ïa ki lyngkha ; u trai uba nyngkong u don ka hok ban thied pat ïa ki , bad yn pynphai pat ïa ki ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia ki iing shnong ki bym don kynroh sawdong jong ki yn khein kum ki lyngkha jong ka ri: ki lah ban siewspah , bad kin leit shabar ha ka jubilee .

en: And if thy brother be waxen poor , and fallen in decay with thee  ; then thou shalt relieve him : yea , though he be a stranger , or a sojourner  ; that he may live with thee .
kha: Lada uno uno u para Israel uba shong marjan bad phi u kylla duk bad um lah shuh ban kyrshan hi ïa lade , phi dei ban ïarap ïa u kumba phi leh ïa u nongtrei , khnang ba u lah ban ïailong u paramarjan jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u hynmen jong me u la shah pynduh bad me; te me dei ban pyllait im ia u: hooid, wat la u long u nongwei, ne u nongwan jngohkai; ba un im bad me .

en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;
kha: Na uwei u briew u la thaw ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei bad u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lypa ïa ki por kiba biang bad ïa ki pud jong ki jaka ha kaba kin shong kin sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba don ha ka khyndew baroh kawei, bad u la buh ia ki por shuwa ban buh ia ki bad ki pud jong ka jaka shong jong ki;

en: But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and hath followed me fully , him will I bring into the land whereinto he went  ; and his seed shall possess it .
kha: Hynrei u Kaleb u shakri jong nga u don ka jinglong bapher bad u la ïaineh ha nga , ngan wallam ïa u sha kata ka ri kaba u la swar , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u shakri jong nga u Caleb , namar ba u don kawei pat ka mynsiem bad u , bad u la bud pura ia nga , ngan wanrah ia u sha ka ri kaba u la leit; bad u symbai jong u un don ia ka .

en: For through the anger of the  Lord  it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah , until he had cast them out from his presence , that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .
kha: U  Trai  u la bitar haduh katta katta ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ha kaba u la beh noh ïa ki na khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lyngba ka jingbitar U Trai ka la jia ha Jerusalem bad Judah haduh ba u la beh noh ia ki na khmat jong u , ba u Sedekaiah u la leh pyrshah ia u syiem Babilon .

en: Now I rejoice , not that ye were made sorry , but that ye sorrowed to repentance : for ye were made sorry after a godly manner , that ye might receive damage by us in nothing .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga kmen — ym namar ba nga la pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei namar ba ka jingsngewsih jong phi ka la pynlong ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut . Ïa kata ka jingsngewsih la pyndonkam da U Blei , bad kumta ngim shym la pynmong ei ei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta nga sngewkmen, ym ba phi la sngewsih, hynrei ba phi la sngewsih: namar phi la sngewsih katkum ka rukom kaba riewblei, ba phin ioh ia ka jingshah pynjot ha ngi khlem da don ei ei .

en: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly  ; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her . And Amnon said unto her , Arise , be gone .
kha: Nangta u Amnon u la shlei da ka jingisih bakhraw ïa ka ; u la isih ïa ka mynta kham palat ban ïa kaba u la ieit ïa ka mynshuwa . U ong ha ka ,  Khie leit noh !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Amnon u la shun palat ia ka; kumta ka jingshun kaba u shun ia ka ka la kham khraw ban ia ka jingieit kaba u la ieit ia ka . Bad u Amnon u la ong ia ka: To khie noh ia ka .

en: And he said , Ye have taken away my gods which I made , and the priest , and ye are gone away : and what have I more ? and what is this that ye say unto me , What aileth thee ?
kha: U Mikah u jubab ,  Phi mut aïu , ‘ kaei kaba la jia ?’ Phi la shim ïa u lyngdoh bad ki bleithaw ba nga la thaw , bad phi shu phet ! Kaei kaba sah bad nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Phi la shim noh ia ki blei jong nga kiba nga la thaw, bad ia u lyngdoh: bad kaei kaba nga don shuh shuh ? bad kaei kata kaba phi ong ha nga , Kaei kaba phi la leh ?

en: He answered and said unto them ,  Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites , as it is written , This people honoureth me with their lips , but their heart is far from me .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  A katno kaba dei ba u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shaphang jong phi ! Phi long kiba arsap , thik kumba u la thoh :   ‘ Kine ki briew , ong U Blei , ki burom ïa nga da ki ktien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , ka long jngai shisha na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, Hooid u Isaiah u la iathuhlypa ia phi ki nongleh arsap kumba la thoh: Une u briew u burom ia nga da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki ka long kaba jngai na nga .

en: But we are all as an unclean thing , and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags  ; and we all do fade as a leaf  ; and our iniquities , like the wind , have taken us away .
kha: Baroh na ngi , ngi long kiba pop ; wat ki kam babha tam jong ngi ki long ki bymkhuid shi lynter . Namar ki pop jong ngi , ngi long kum ki sla ba la tlor bad ba la rong noh da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi long baroh kum kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid, bad ki hok jong ngi baroh ki long kum ki rag kiba jakhlia ; bad ngi baroh ngi jah noh kum u sla ; bad ki jingbymhok jong ngi, kum ka Iyer, ki la shim noh ia ngi .

en: And Lot went up out of Zoar , and dwelt in the mountain , and his two daughters with him  ; for he feared to dwell in Zoar : and he dwelt in a cave , he and his two daughters .
kha: Namar ba u Lot u sheptieng ban sah ha Soar , ma u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki la kynriah sha ki lum , bad ki ïashong ïasah ha kawei ka krem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lot u la mih na u Soar bad u la shong ha u lum bad ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong u bad u; namar u la tieng ban shong ha u Soar: bad u la shong ha ka krem , ma u bad ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong u .

en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God , and in the law , and in the commandments , to seek his God , he did it with all his heart , and prospered .
kha: U la long uba jop , namar baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta ka Templ lane ha kaba sumar ïa ka Hukum , u la leh ha ka mynsiem kaba ïaineh tylli bad aiti lut ha U Blei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka kam baroh kaba u la sdang ha ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Blei bad ha ka hukum bad ha ki hukum ban wad ia U Blei jong u, u la leh ia kata da ka dohnud jong u baroh bad u la roi .

en: And the  Lord  shall be seen over them , and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning : and the Lord  God  shall blow the trumpet , and shall go with whirlwinds of the south .
kha: U  Trai  un mihpaw halor ki briew jong u ; un siat ïa ki khnam jong u kum ka leilieh . U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynsawa ïa ka turoi ; un ïaid ha ki  erïong na shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un sa iohi halor jong ki, bad u khnam jong u un leit sha khmat: bad U Trai Blei un beh ia ka turoi , bad un leit bad ki Iyer kiba jylliew jong ka ri Sepngi .

en: And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len biang ïa kata . Katto katne por hadien , kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la mudui biang ïa u Petros ,  Mem lah ban len ba me long uwei na ki , namar ma me ruh , me long na Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyntait biang ia ka . Bad hadien khyndiat por, kita kiba ieng hajan ki la ong biang ha u Petros, Hooid me long uwei na ki: namar me long u Galilaia, bad ka jingkren jong me ka mynjur ia kata .

en: And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaba la pynïap ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synran U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u kpu khlem thied , haba ki la pyniap ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka long ka jingkhawai Niam ka long kaba nyngkong eh .

en: Behold also the ships , which though they be so great , and are driven of fierce winds , yet are they turned about with a very small helm , whithersoever the governor listeth .
kha: Lane to pyrkhat ïa ka lieng kaba heh : La ka heh katno katno bad la pynïaid ïa ka da ki lyer bakhlaiñ , la ñiah ïa ka da u boitha uba rit eh , bad ka ïaid kat shaba u nongking lieng u mon ba kan leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ruh ki lieng kiba la pynkhih da ki Iyer kiba jur bha, hynrei ki kylla da ka helm kaba rit bha, katba u Lat u sngap .

en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .
kha: Kumta te , kumba da kawei ka pop la pynrem ïa u bynriew baroh , ha kajuh ka rukom kawei ka kam bahok ka pyllait bad ka ai jingim ïa u bynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumba da ka jingleh jong uwei u briew u la wan ha ki briew baroh ban pynrem; wat la katta ruh da ka hok jong uwei ka jingai kaba laitluid ka la wan ha ki briew baroh ban pynshisha ia ka jingim .

en: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together , and said unto them , These are the words which the  Lord  hath commanded , that ye should do them .
kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei , bad u la ong ha ki ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la lum lang ia ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei bad u la ong ha ki , Kine ki long ki ktien kiba U Trai u la hukum , ba phi dei ban leh ia ki .

en: And the chief of all the people , even of all the tribes of Israel , presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God , four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword .
kha: Ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel baroh ki ïadon ryngkat ha kata ka jingïalang jong ki briew U Blei , bad ki ïadon saw lakh ngut ki shipai hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u rangbah jong ki briew baroh, wat na ki jait Israel baroh, u la wan ha ka jingiaseng jong ki briew U Blei, saw spah hajar ngut ki nonglehkai kjat kiba la tan ia ka waitlam .

en: And I will give them an heart to know me , that I am the  Lord  : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God : for they shall return unto me with their whole heart .
kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingangnud ban tip ba nga long U  Trai . Te ki kin long ki briew jong nga , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki , namar kin phai pat sha nga da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ia ki ia ka dohnud ban ithuh ia nga, ba nga long U Trai: bad kin long ki briew jong nga, bad ngan long U Blei jong ki: namar kin wan phai sha nga da ka dohnud baroh .

en: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon , by the way . But David abode in the wilderness , and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness .
kha: bad u sher dara harud lynti ha u Lum Hakhilah . U Dabid u dang don ha kata ka ri khlaw , bad haba u tip ba u Saul u la wan wad ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la iaid ha u lum Hachilah uba don ha khmat u Jeshimon . Hynrei u Dabid u la shong ha ka ri khlaw bad u la iohi ba u Saul u la wan hadien jong u sha ka ri khlaw .

en: And he said unto them , The  Lord  is witness against you , and his anointed is witness this day , that ye have not found ought in my hand . And they answered , He is witness .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  bad u Syiem uba u la jied ki long ki sakhi mynta ka sngi ba phi la shem ba nga long uba lui lui .   Ho-oid , U  Trai  u long u sakhi jong ngi ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , U Trai u long u sakhi pyrshah ia phi, bad u nongsleh jong u u long u sakhi ha kane ka sngi , ba phim shym la shem ei ei ha ka kti jong nga . Ki la jubab , U long u sakhi .

en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs , being seen of them forty days , and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God :
kha: Ha ki sawphew sngi hadien ka jingïap jong u , u la mihpaw bunsien ha ki ha ki rukom kiba la pynshisha khlem jingartatien ba u im . Ki la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïakren bad ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba ruh u la pyni ia lade hadien ka jingsngewsih jong u da ki jingpynshisha kiba ym lah ban bakla, la iohi ia ki sawphew sngi , bad u kren ia kiei kiei kiba iadei bad ka hima U Blei:

en: And all nations shall serve him , and his son , and his son s son , until the very time of his land come : and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him .
kha: Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin shakri ïa u , bad kin shakri ïa u khun bad u khun ksiew jong u tad haduh ba ka por kan wan ïa ka hima jong u hi ban kyllon . Te ka jaitbynriew jong u kan shakri ïa ki jaitbynriew badonbor bad ïa ki syiem bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin shakri ia u, bad u khun jong u, bad u khun jong u, haduh ka por jong ka ri jong u: bad nangta bun ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem kiba khraw kin shakri ia lade na u .

en: And the priest answered David , and said , There is no common bread under mine hand , but there is hallowed bread  ; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women .
kha: U lyngdoh u ong ,  Ngam don shuh u kpu paidbah , don sa tang u kpu ba la pynkyntang ; phi lah ban bam ïa u tang lada ki rangbah jong phi kim shym la ïathiah shongkha dang shen .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh u la jubab ia u Dabid , bad u la ong , Ym don kpu ba ju don hapoh ka kti jong nga , hynrei ka don u kpu ba la pynkyntang ; lada ki samla ki la iada ia lade la kumno kumno na ki kynthei .

en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .
kha: Haba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka la kylli la dang don shuh ne em .  Uto u dei uba khatduh ,  uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ban tuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki khiew ki la dap, ba ka la ong ha u khun jong ka, To wanrah ia nga sa kawei ka khiew . Bad u la ong ha ka , Ym don ka khiew shuh . Bad ka umphniang ka la sah .

en: For if by one man s offence death reigned by one ; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one , Jesus Christ .)
kha: Ka long ka jingshisha ba lyngba ka pop jong uwei u briew , ka jingïap ka la sdang ban synshar , namar jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei katno kaba kham khraw ka long ka jingmih jong kaei kaba la leh da uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist ! Baroh kiba ïohpdiang ïa jingaiei bakyrhai U Blei bad ba la pynïasuk bad u kin synshar ha ka jingim lyngba U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada da uwei u briew u la synshar da uwei u ; kham bun kiba ioh ia ka jingaiei bad ka jingai jong ka hok kin synshar ha ka jingim da uwei u Jisu Khrist.)

en: In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .
kha: Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbah uba burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Phi shukor ïa ki nongwei bad shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha me ki la pynshai da u kpa bad ka kmie: hapdeng jong me ki la leh da ka jingshah lehbein bad u nongwei: ha me ki la pynsngewsih ia u khlem kpa bad ka riewkynthei .

en: Ho , every one that thirsteth , come ye to the waters , and he that hath no money  ; come ye , buy , and eat  ; yea , come , buy wine and milk without money and without price .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To wan , phi kiba sliang — hangne ka don ka um ! To wan , phi ki bym don pisa — thied ïa u kew bad bam ! To wan ! Thied ïa ka waiñ bad ka dud — phin ym hap siew ei ei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ho , uwei pa uwei uba sliang , u wan sha ki um , bad uta u bym don pisa ; u wan sha phi, u thied, bad u bam ; yea, u wan, u thied ia ka wain bad ka dud khlem pisa bad khlem dor .

en: And great multitudes came unto him , having with them those that were lame , blind , dumb , maimed , and many others , and cast them down at Jesus  feet  ; and he healed them :
kha: Ki paidbah babun ki la wan sha u , ki da wallam bad ki ïa kiba dkoh , kiba matlah , kiba khrew , ki bymnang kren , bad kiwei pat ki briew kiba pang , ïa kiba ki la buh ha ki kjat jong U Jisu ; bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah kiba bun ki la wan sha u, ki don bad ki kiba lyngngoh, kiba matlah, kiba lyngngoh bad kiba bun kiwei pat, bad ki la pynhap ia ki ha ki kjat U Jisu; bad u la pynkoit ia ki:

en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :
kha: U la khot lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ong ïa phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk , ka la pynnoh kham bun ha ka synduk jingainguh ban ïa baroh kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ki synran jong u bad u la ong ha ki, Hooid nga ong ha phi, Ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk ka la bret kham bun ban ia kita baroh kiba la bret sha ka jaka buh jingbam:

en: Who art thou , O great mountain ? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain : and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings , crying , Grace , grace unto it .
kha: Ki jingjynthut kiba khraw kat ki lumbah kin jah noh ha khmat jong me . Men tei pat ïa ka Templ , bad katba me dang buh ïa u maw bakhatduh ha la ka jaka , ki briew kin pyrta ‘ Kaba itynnat , kaba itynnat !’
translated_en_to_kha: Me long mano, ko lum uba khraw ? ha khmat u Serubabel men long u nongrep: bad un wanrah ia u maw khlieh jong ka da ki jingpyrta, da kaba pyrta, Ka jingaiei, ka jingaiei ha ka .

en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away .
kha: Haba u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilon u la rah ïa u Jehoïakhin u syiem ka Judah ha ka jingringmraw na Jerusalem , ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki koidi , u Mordekai u long uwei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la shah rah noh na Jerusalem bad ka jinglong mraw kaba la shah rah noh bad u syiem Judah , ia uba u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon u la rah noh .

en: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?
kha: Tharai uwei na phi u don shispah tylli ki langbrot bad u duh noh kawei na ki — kaei kaba un leh ? U ieh ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki langbrot ha ka jaka bam phlang bad u leit ban wad ïa kata kaba la sakma haduh ba un da shem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uei u briew na phi uba don shispah tylli ki langbrot lada u duh noh ia kawei na ki , um iehnoh ia ki hynniewphew hynniew ha ka ri khlaw bad u leit bud ia kata kaba la jah noh haduh ba un da lap ia ka ?

en: And one of you say unto them , Depart in peace , be ye warmed and filled  ; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body  ; what doth it profit ?
kha: Kan myntoi aïu da kaba ong ha ki ,  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi ! To phong syaid bad to bam bha !  — lada phim ai ha ki ïa ki jingdonkam jong ka jingim ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na phi u ong ha ki, To leit noh ha ka jingsuk, to sngem bad pyndap wat la phim ai ia ki ia kiei kiei kiba donkam ia ka met ; kaei ka jingmyntoi ?

en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .
kha: Haba u Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la wan sha u syiem Dabid , bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Joab bad ki shipai baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la wan , ki la iathuh ha u Joab da kaba ong: U Abner u khun u Ner u la wan sha u syiem bad u la phah noh ia u bad u la leit noh da kaba suk .

en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah , saying , So let the gods do to me , and more also , if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time .
kha: Ka la phah khubor sha u Elijah :  Ai ba ki blei kin pynïap ïa nga lashai kum ha kane ka por lada ngam leh ïa kajuh kaba me la leh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jesbel u la phah ia u nonglam khubor sha u Elijah, u da ong, Kumta to ai ba ki blei kin leh ia nga, bad kham bun ruh lada ngam pynlong ia ka jingim jong me kum ka jingim jong uwei na ki da kaba sngewsih lashai shaphang kane ka por .

en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .
kha: U long kum ka bniap ha ka ri shyiap , kaba mih ha ka ri khlaw baryngkhiang , halor ka khyndew mluh ha kaba ym don kaei kaei kaba mih . Ym don kano kano kaba bha kaba la ju jia ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un long kum ka sniehdoh ha ka ri khlaw, bad un ym iohi haba ka bha ka wan hynrei un shong ha ki jaka ba la tyrkhong ha ka ri khlaw, ha ka ri kaba thiang bad ym shong .

en: But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Simon u shong u sah hangta , uba shipor u la pynlyngngoh ïa ki nong Samaria da ka jingleh myntor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don uwei u briew uba la khot u Simon, uba la pyndonkam lypa ha kajuh ka shnong bad u la pynlong ia ki briew jong ka Samaria, da kaba pynpaw ba ma u hi u long uba khraw:

en: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza  ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboiim , even unto Lasha .
kha: haduh ba ki pud ka Kanaan ki la ïar naduh Sidon , beit beit shathie shaphang Gerar hajan Gasa , bad shaphang mihngi shaduh Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , bad Seboiim hajan Lasha .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam jong ki nong Kana u la long na Sidon, katba u dang wan sha Gerar, haduh Gaza ; katba u dang leit sha Sodom, bad u Gomorrah, bad u Admah, bad u Seboiim, wat haduh Lasha .

en: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign  ; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Athaliah , the daughter of Omri king of Israel .
kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew ar snem , bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Athalaïah , ka khun jong u Syiem Ahab bad ka khun ksiew jong u Omri u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Arphew snem ka rta u Ahasaiah haba u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Athaliah , ka khun jong u Omri syiem Israel .

en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways , nor done after their abominations : but , as if that were a very little thing , thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways .
kha: Hato pha la ïoh jinghun ban bud ïa ki dien jat jong ki bad pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki ? Em , tang hapoh khyndiat por pha la leh kham sniew palat ban ïa kaba ki long ha kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me khlem iaid katkum ki lynti jong ki, ne leh katkum ki jingleh bymman jong ki: hynrei kumba kata ka long tang khyndiat eh, me la pynsniew kham palat ia ki ha ki lynti jong me baroh .

en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship , when they had let down the boat into the sea , under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship ,
kha: Nangta ki maji ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka lieng ; ki la pynhiar ïa ka lieng rit sha ka duriaw bad ki la leh mynleh kumba ki mut ban buh sa katto katne ki angkor ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki nongleit lieng ki dang thmu ban phet noh na ka lieng , haba ki la pynhap ia ka lieng shapoh duriaw , hapoh ka rong kumba kin sa bret noh ia ki nar na ka jingpeit bniah , .

en: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .
kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel kim long jingmyntoi ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kum ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nar , bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, ka iing Israel ka long ha nga kaba la tyrkhong: baroh ki long ki nar, bad ki tin, bad ki nar, bad ki nar, hapdeng ka ding; ki long wat ki dewbilat rupa ruh .

en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .
kha: Hadien ba ki la jop ïa ka ri , ka kynhun Israel baroh kawei ka la ïalumlang ha Shiloh bad pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei ka la ialum lang ha Shiloh bad ka la buh ia ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng hangta . Bad ka ri ka la shah pynduh ha khmat jong ki .

en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you , that ye also may have fellowship with us : and truly our fellowship is with the Father , and with his Son Jesus Christ .
kha: Ïa kaei kaba ngi la ïohi bad la ïohsngew ngi pynbna ha phi ruh , khnang ba phin ïasnoh bad ngi ha ka jingïasyllok kaba ngi don bad U Kpa lem bad U Jisu Khrist U Khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata kaba ngi la iohi bad iohsngew ngi pynbna ha phi, ba phi ruh phin iakynduh bad ngi: bad shisha ka jingiasyllok jong ngi ka long bad U Kpa bad U Khun jong u U Jisu Khrist .

en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .
kha: Shim ïa ki jaka shong jong phi ha ka Templ shi kur shi kur , kat kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi da u syiem Dabid bad u syiem Solomon u khun jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynkhreh ia lade da ki iing ki sem jong phi, kat kum ka jingthoh jong u syiem Israel bad kat kum ka jingthoh jong u Solomon u khun jong u .

en: How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;
kha: Kumno me lah ban ong ba mem shym la pyntngit ïa lade , ba mem pat ju mane ïa u Baal ? Ha khmih kumno me la leh pop ha ka them ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kum ka ut khlaw ha ka por jingkwah shongkha jong ka , kaba mareh laitluid kylleng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno me ong , ngam shym la shah pynjakhlia , ngam shym la leit bud ia u Baalim ? peit ia ka lynti jong me ha ka them , tip ia kaei kaba me la leh: me long ka jinglehkai kaba stet kaba iaid lyngba ia ki lynti jong ka;

en: Although many skilled tradesmen from the region volunteer their labor at every building site , members of the local congregation make up the bulk of the volunteer labor force .
kha: Wat lada don shibun ki nongtrei mon sngewbha kiba tbit kiba wan na kiwei ki jaka , hynrei kiba bun pat ki dei ki para bangeit kiba trei mon sngewbha na kato hi ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la bun ki nongkhaii kiba tbit na ka thain ki trei mon sngewbha ha man la ka jaka tei ïing , ki dkhot jong ka balang trai shnong ki pynlong ia ka bynta kaba khraw jong ka bor trei mon sngewbha .

en: And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .
kha: Haba ki la ïohpdiang ïa ka shithi jong u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab , ki buh ïa ki khlieh jong ki ha ki shang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ka shithi ka la poi ha ki, ba ki la shim ia ki khun syiem bad ki la pyniap ia ki hynriewphew ngut ki briew bad ki la buh ia ki khlieh jong ki ha ki basket bad ki la phah ia u sha Jesel .

en: When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shaba palat ban leit phai ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad ynda ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki la san biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iathuh ha u Dabid, u la phah ban iakynduh ia ki, namar ki briew ki la sngewlehrain shibun: bad u syiem u la ong: To leit sha Jeriko haduh ba ki ryndang jong phi kin san, bad nangta sa wan phai noh .

en: And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
kha: Ha ka miet shuwa ba u Herod un wallam ïa u sha u paidbah , u Petros u dang ïohthiah hapdeng ar ngut ki nongap phira . La teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri , bad la don ki nongap phira kiba ap ha ka khyrdop jong ka byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Herod un sa wanrah ia u shabar, ha kajuh ka miet u Petros u dang thiah hapdeng arngut ki shipai, la teh da ki ar tylli ki kynjri: bad ki nongap ha khmat ka jingkhang ki la buh ia ka phatok .

en: And I will make her that halted a remnant , and her that was cast far off a strong nation : and the  Lord  shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth , even for ever .
kha: Ki la long kiba dkoh bad jngai na ïing , hynrei ngan pynlong ka jingsdang kaba thymmai bad kito kiba sah , bad kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan synshar halor jong ki ha u lum Seïon naduh kata ka por bad junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ka kaba la sahkut, bad ia ka kaba la shah bret noh na ka jaitbynriew kaba khlain: bad U Trai un synshar halor jong ki ha u lum Seion naduh mynta, wat junom .

en: And it came to pass , when he was come , that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim , and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount , and he before them .
kha: Haba u poi hangta ha ka ri lum ki Ephraim , u la put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki paid Israel sha ka thma ; nangta u la ïalam ïa ki arsut na ki lumrit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan, u la pyrta ha u lum Ephram bad ki khun Israel ki la hiar ryngkat bad u na u lum bad u ha khmat jong ki .

en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,
kha: Ka por ka wan ha kaba ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathuh ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh sha ki na ka ri shyiap . Kan ym long ka lyer kaba jai jai kaba shu beh pynher noh ïa u stait —
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por yn ong ia une u briew bad ha Jerusalem , Ka Iyer kaba rkhiang jong ki jaka ba jrong ha ka ri khlaw sha ka khun jong ki briew jong nga , ban ym pynkhuid , ne ban pynkhuid .

en: And I will set my face against that man , and will make him a sign and a proverb , and I will cut him off from the midst of my people  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pyrshah ïa u . Ngan pynlong ïa u ka nuksa . Ngan weng ïa u na ka kynhun ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ma phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia uta u briew bad ngan pynlong ia u ka dak bad ka proberb , bad ngan ot noh ia u na pdeng ki briew jong nga ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them  ;
kha: Ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad kawei pat ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ki la ïohpdiang lypa ïa ka ri kaba u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ha ki ; ka don ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kiba ki Reben bad ki Gad ki la ioh ia ka pateng jong ki, kaba u Moses u la ai ha ki, shaphang shathie jong ka Jordan shaphang mihngi, kumba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la ai ha ki;

en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean , and those things , before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :
kha: U lyngdoh un ïalam ïa uta u briew lem bad ïa kita ki jingainguh jong u ha khmat ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh uba pynkhuid ia u un pyni ia uta u briew uba dei ban pynkhuid bad kita kiei kiei ha khmat U Trai ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng:

en: And when inquisition was made of the matter , it was found out  ; therefore they were both hanged on a tree : and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king .
kha: Ka la don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem ba ka jingïathuh ka long kaba dei , kumta ïa baroh ar ngut ki briew la sdien phasi . U syiem u la hukum ba ïa kane ka jingjia dei ban thoh ha ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la wad bniah ia kata ka kam, la lap ia ka ; namarkata baroh arngut ki la sahkut ha u dieng: bad la thoh ia ka ha ka kot ki khanatang ha khmat u syiem .

en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .
kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu hangta hi , namar ki la tip ba u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïasheptieng ïa ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ha kajuh ka kynta ki la wad ban buh kti ia u bad ki la tieng ia ki briew: namar ki la sngewthuh ba u la kren ia kane ka pharshi pyrshah ia ki .

en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?
kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri ïa u Solomon u kpa jong u kum ki nongaibuit .  Kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki briew ?  u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Rehoboam u la iamir jingmut bad ki rangbah kiba la ieng ha khmat u Solomon u kpa jong u katba u dang im , u da ong , Kaei ka jingai jingmut kaba phi ai ia nga ban jubab ia une u briew ?

en: For thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , The barrel of meal shall not waste , neither shall the cruse of oil fail , until the day that the  Lord  sendeth rain upon the earth .
kha: Naba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong : ‘ Kata ka pliang kan ym thylli  purew lane uta u klong un nym long khlem umphniang shuwa kata ka sngi ba nga , U  Trai  ngan phah slap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , Ka barel jong ka jingbam kan ym jah rngai , lymne ka umphniang kan ym jah rngai noh haduh ka sngi ba U Trai un phah slap ia ka khyndew .

en: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations , I will recompense their way upon their own heads , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba ieit ban mane ïa ki bleithaw ba-isaitmet bad ba-ijli . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kito kiba ka dohnud jong ki ka iaid katkum ka dohnud jong ki jingleh bymman bad ki jingleh bymman jong ki , ngan pynphai biang ia ka lynti jong ki ha la ki jong ki khlieh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And the harp , and the viol , the tabret , and pipe , and wine , are in their feasts : but they regard not the work of the  Lord  , neither consider the operation of his hands .
kha: Ha ki jingkhawai jong phi , phi don ki duitara , ki shakuriaw bad ki tangmuri — bad ka waiñ . Hynrei phim sngewthuh aïu U  Trai  u leh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka harp bad ka viol, ka tabet bad ka pipe bad ka wain, ki don ha ki jingkhawai jong ki: hynrei kim khein ia ka kam U Trai, lymne kim pyrkhat ia ka jingtreikam jong ki kti jong u .

en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :
kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai u la kwah ban pyllait im ïa u Paul , kumta u la khang ïa ki na kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la hukum ïa kito kiba lah ban jngi ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ban jngi sha ryngkew ;
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai uba mon ban pynim ia u Paul u la bat ia ki na ka jingthmu jong ki bad u la hukum ba kita kiba lah ban jngi ki dei ban bret nyngkong ia lade sha duriaw , bad ban poi sha duriaw:

en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .
kha: U pynlong ïa ki paid Benjamin bad uwei pa uwei uba don ha Jerusalem ban kular ban sumar ïa ka jutang . Bad kumta ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka jutang kiba ki la pynlong bad U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia baroh kiba don ha Jerusalem bad u Benjamin ban ieng ha ka . Bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la leh kat kum ka jutang U Blei , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And when it was day , they knew not the land : but they discovered a certain creek with a shore , into the which they were minded , if it were possible , to thrust in the ship .
kha: Haba ka sngi ka la mih , ki maji kim shym ithuh ïa ka rud duriaw , hynrei ki la ïohi ïa ka kdong um lem bad ka rud duriaw shyiap bad ki la rai ba , lada long kaba lah , kin pynsangeh ïa ka lieng hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka la dei ka sngi , kim tip ia ka ri: hynrei ki la lap ia kawei ka wah kaba don ka rud duriaw, ha kaba ki la pyrkhat, lada ka long kaba lah, ban rung ha ka lieng .

en: And he sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , and withal of a beautiful countenance , and goodly to look to . And the  Lord  said , Arise , anoint him : for this is he .
kha: Kumta u Jesse u phah khot ïa u . U long uba bhabriew , u samla bakoit bakhiah bad ki khmat kiba phyrnai . U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Dei une — pynsleh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la phah , bad u la wanrah ia u shapoh . Mynta u la long uba sniew, bad u la don ka khmat kaba itynnad, bad u la bha ban peit . Bad U Trai u la ong: To khie noh ia u: namar kane ka long ma u .

en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .
kha: kin jah noh kum ki jaiñ ba la bam khñiang ! Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba ngan wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan neh ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u khnai un bam ia ki kum ka jain , bad u khniang un bam ia ki kum ka snieh: hynrei ka hok jong nga kan long junom bad ka jingpynim jong nga na ka pateng sha ka pateng .

en: And when he went forth to land , there met him out of the city a certain man , which had devils long time , and ware no clothes , neither abode in any house , but in the tombs .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hiar harud duriaw , la wan ïashem ïa u da u briew na ka shnong uba shongksuid . La slem bah une u briew u la leit khlem phong jaiñ bad um mon ban shong ha ïing , hynrei u la pynlut ïa la ka por ha ki krem jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ri, u la iakynduh ia u na ka shnong uwei u briew uba la don ki ksuid kiba la slem bha, bad u khlem jain ei ei, lymne u sah ha kano kano ka iing, hynrei ha ki jingtep .

en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .
kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka iktiar ha ka khyndew ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad leit sha ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba phin tip ba u Khun u briew u don ka bor ha ka khyndew ban map ia ki pop, (ta u ong ha kiba pang) To khie noh ia ka jingthiah jong me bad leit sha la iing .

en: And how shall they preach , except they be sent ? as it is written , How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace , and bring glad tidings of good things !
kha: Bad kumno ïa ka khubor lah ban pynbna lada ïa ki nongrah-khubor ym shym la phah ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Katno ka long kaba phylla ka jingwan jong ki nongrah-khubor kiba wallam ïa ka khubor babha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumno kin ialap , lymda la phah ia ki ? kumba la thoh , Katno ki kjat jong kito kiba ialap ia ka gospel jong ka jingsuk bad ki wanrah ia ki khubor babha !

en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily , saying , Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem  ; and , behold , they fortify the city against thee .
kha: U phah ki nonglamktien sha u Abimelekh ha Arumah ban ong ,  U Gaal u khun jong u Ebed bad ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u ki la wan sha Shekhem , bad kin ym shah ïa phi ban wan rung shapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha u Abimelech da kaba kyrpang, u la ong, Ha khmih u khun u Ebed bad ki hynmen jong u kin wan sha Shehem ; bad, ha khmih, ki pynskhem ia ka shnong pyrshah ia me .

en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the  Lord  cometh , for it is nigh at hand  ;
kha: To put ïa ka turoi , to pynsawa ba don jingma ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong U Blei . To khynñiuh , ko ki paid Judah ! Ka sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih ia ka turoi ha Seion , bad pynsawa ia ka alarm ha u lum bakhuid jong nga: to ai ba ki nongshong shnong baroh kin khih: namar ka sngi U Trai kan wan , namar ka la jan;

en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people  ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
kha: Naba ha kane ka kynti ngan pynshitom ym tang ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki briew jong me , hynrei ïa me hi ruh , khnang ba men ïoh tip ba ym don uba kum ma nga ha ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha kane ka por ngan phah ia ki jingpang jong nga baroh ha ka dohnud jong me bad ha ki shakri jong me bad ha ki briew jong me;

en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .
kha: Ngan lum ïa kiba sah na ki briew jong nga na ki ri kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri . Kin ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan lum ia ki kynhun jong nga kiba sah na ki ri baroh kiba nga la beh noh ia ki, bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki sha ki jaka ri dohkha jong ki; bad kin long kiba seisoh bad kiba bun .

en: If a man have two wives , one beloved , and another hated , and they have born him children , both the beloved and the hated  ; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated :
kha: Lada u briew u don ar ngut ki tnga bad baroh ar ki ïoh khun shynrang na u , hynrei u khun uba nyngkong um dei na ka tnga kaba u kham ieit ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u don arngut ki tnga, uwei u la ieit , bad uwei pat u la shun ia u , bad ki la kha ia u khun , baroh arngut kiba ieit bad kiba la shun ; bad lada u khun nyngkong u long u jong ka uba la shun:

en: And the sons of Becher  ; Zemira , and Joash , and Eliezer , and Elioenai , and Omri , and Jerimoth , and Abiah , and Anathoth , and Alameth . All these are the sons of Becher .
kha: U Bekher u don khyndai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Semirah , u Joash , u Elieser , u Elioenai , u Omri , u Jeremoth , u Abijah , u Anathoth , bad u Alemeth .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Becher ; Zemra, bad u Joash, bad u Elieser, bad u Elioenai, bad u Omri, bad u Jerimoth, bad u Abiah, bad u Anath, bad u Alamet . Kine baroh ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Becher .

en: And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us ? intendest thou to kill me , as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .
kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Mano ba thung ïa phi kum u syiem bad nongbishar jong ngi ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap ïa nga kumba phi la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt ?  Kumta u Moses u la sheptieng , bad u pyrkhat ,  Pleng , ki briew ki la tip ïa kaei ba nga la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Mano ba la pynlong ia me u syiem bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ? me thmu ban pyniap ia nga kumba me la pyniap ia u nong Ijipt ? U Moses u la tieng bad u la ong: Hooid ia kane ka jingjia la tip .

en: For ye remember , brethren , our labour and travail : for labouring night and day , because we would not be chargeable unto any of you , we preached unto you the gospel of God .
kha: Da shisha phi kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong ngi , kumno ba ngi la minot bad trei shitom ! Ngi la trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ba ngin ym bankhia ïa phi haba ngi la ïalap ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi kynmaw ko para bangeit, ia ka jingtrei shitom bad ka jingtrei shitom jong ngi: namar ba ngi la trei shitom miet bad sngi , namar ba ngin ym shah kynnoh ha uno uno na phi , ngi la ialap ha phi ia ka gospel U Blei .

en: The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .
kha: Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom ïa nga ; ki myrsiang bad ki ostrit kin ïaroh ïa nga haba ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ba kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai um ïa ki briew ba la jied jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U mrad khlaw un burom ia nga, ki bsein bad ki blang: namar nga ai um ha ka ri khlaw bad ki wah ha ka ri khlaw , ban ai um ia ki briew jong nga , kiba la jied jong nga .

en: And if thy hand offend thee , cut it off : it is better for thee to enter into life maimed , than having two hands to go into hell , into the fire that never shall be quenched :
kha: Kumta lada ka kti jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa la ka jingngeit , ot noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti , ban ïa kaba don ki kti baroh ar tylli bad ban leit sha dujok , sha ka ding bym ju lip .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka kti jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, ot noh ia ka: ka kham bha ia me ban rung sha ka jingim kaba la tyrkhong, ban ia kaba don ar tylli ki kti ban leit sha dujok, sha ka ding kaba ym ju shah pynlip:

en: And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .
kha: Kumta ki la leit sha u Ïoannis bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , phi kynmaw ïa u briew uba la don lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ïa uba phi la kren shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , u la pynbaptis mynta , bad baroh ki la leit sha u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan sha u Ioannis bad ki la ong ha u, Rabbi, uta uba don bad me sha shiliang ka Jordan, ha uba me la shah pynbaptis, ha khmih, bad ki briew baroh ki wan sha u .

en: No man can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .
kha: Ym don uba lah ban long u mraw jong ar ngut ki kynrad ; un isih ïa uwei bad ieit ïa uwei pat ; un long uba kohnguh ïa uwei bad ñiewbeiñ ïa uwei pat . Phim lah ban shakri ïa baroh ar , ïa U Blei bad ïa ka pisa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don u briew uba lah ban shakri arngut ki kynrad: namar un shun ia uta uba don ha ka met bad un ieit ia uwei pat lane lym kumta un bat ia uta uba don ha ka met bad un leh bein ia uwei pat . Phi lah ban shakri ia U Blei bad u mammon .

en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u ong , Bad uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip kaba wan na U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , uba la iohsngew ia ki ktien U Blei , bad uba la tip ia ka jingtip jong Uba ha khlieh duh tam , uba la iohi ia ka jingphohsniew jong Uba donbor baroh , uba la hap ha ka jingkylla , hynrei uba la plie ia ki khmat jong u:

en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language , whose words thou canst not understand . Surely , had I sent thee to them , they would have hearkened unto thee .
kha: Lada nga la phah ïa me sha ki jaitbynriew bakhraw kiba kren ïa ki ktien kiba eh kiba mem sngewthuh , kin shahshkor ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym ha kiba bun ki briew kiba kren phylla bad kiba eh, kiba me lah ban sngewthuh . Hooid, lada nga la phah ia me sha ki , kin jin da la sngap ia me .

en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose , and followed him .
kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , uba kyrteng u Matthaïos , uba shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U la ong ha u ,  To bud ïa nga .  U Matthaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba U Jisu u dang iaid noh nangta, u la iohi ia u briew uba kyrteng u Mathaios, uba shong ha ka jaka pdiang sngewbha: bad u la ong ha u, To bud ia nga . U la ieng bad u la bud ia u .

en: But afterward they turned , and caused the servants and the handmaids , whom they had let go free , to return , and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids .
kha: Ki la pyllaitluid shisha ïa ki , hynrei hadien ki la kylla jingmut , ki la shim pat ïa ki , bad ki la pynbor ïa ki ban long mraw biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ki la phai noh , bad ki la pynlong ia ki shakri bad ki nongtrei kti kiba ki la pyllait im, ban wan phai noh , bad ki la wanrah ia ki ha ka jingshah pyndem na ka bynta ki shakri bad na ka bynta ki nongtrei kti .

en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew lai mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka rukom kaba me dei ban pynlong: Ka jingjrong jong ka lieng kan long sanphew cubit bad ka jingjrong jong ka laiphew cubit .

en: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth , when ye shall see Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , and all the prophets , in the kingdom of God , and you yourselves thrust out .
kha: A katno phin ïam bad kyr-iat ïa la ki bniat haba phi ïohi ïa u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ha ka Hima U Blei , katba ïa phi la bret noh shabar !
translated_en_to_kha: Kan don ka jingiam bad ka jingkyrhuh ki bniat haba phin iohi ia u Abraham bad u Isaak bad u Jakob bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ha ka hima U Blei bad phi hi phin sa mih noh .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred , and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten , to the house of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ka nongbah ha Israel ka phah noh shihajar ngut ki shipai , hynrei tang shispah ngut ki wan phai ; kawei pat ka nongbah ka phah shispah ngut , hynrei tang shiphew ngut ki wan phai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei u la ong: Ka shnong kaba la leit noh da ka shi hajar kan iehnoh shispah snem bad kata kaba la leit noh da ka shispah kan iehnoh shiphew snem sha ka iing Israel .

en: He hath blinded their eyes , and hardened their heart  ; that they should not see with their eyes , nor understand with their heart , and be converted , and I should heal them .
kha: U Blei u la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la khang khyrdep ïa ki jingmut jong ki , ba ki khmat jong ki kin ym ïohi , bad ba ki jingmut jong ki kin ym shemphang , bad kin ym phai sha nga , ong U Blei , ïa nga ba ngan pynkhiah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynmatlah ia ki khmat jong ki, bad u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong ki; ba kin ym iohi da ki khmat jong ki, lymne ban sngewthuh da ka dohnud jong ki, bad ngan pynkoit ia ki .

en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .
kha: U Simri , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba peit ïa shiteng ki kali ïapom jong u syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha kawei ka sngi ha Tirsah , u Elah u buaid ha ka ïing jong u Arsa , uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri jong u u Zimri, u rangbah shipai jong u, u la thmu pyrshah ia u, kumba u la don ha Tirsah, u la dih ia lade ha ka iing u nongap jong u ha Tirsah .

en: And she said unto him , Give me a blessing : for thou hast given me a south land  ; give me also springs of water . And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Nga kwah katto katne ki pukri um . Ka jaka ba phi la ai ïa nga ka don ha ka ri ryngkhiang .  Kumta u Kaleb u ai ha ka ïa ki umpohliew kiba haneng bad kiba harum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u, Ai jingkyrkhu ia nga: namar me la ai ia nga ia ka ri kaba shaphang shathie. Bad u Caleb u la ai ia ka ia ki tyllong um kiba shalor bad ki tyllong um kiba shapoh .

en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .
kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynban ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iohi ia ka jinglong ba sniew bad ka jingleh thok, da kaba ong, U Trai u ong: bad U Trai um shym la phah ia ki: bad ki la pynlong ia kiwei pat ban kyrmen ba kin pynskhem ia ka ktien .

en: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .
kha: ha ka rta kaba laiphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka khun jong u Shilhi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la don laiphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Azubah ka khun jong u Shilhi .

en: If thy father at all miss me , then say , David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city : for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family .
kha: Lada i pa jong phi i shem ba ngam don lang ha ka miej bam , ïathuh ïa i ba nga la pan jingbit na phi ban leit sha la ïing ha Bethlehem , namar ba ka dei ka por jong ka jingkñia ainguh ba shisien shisnem hangta ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u kpa jong me u sngewsih ia nga satia, te u ong, u Dabid u la pan shuti na nga ba un phet sha Bethlehem ka shnong jong u: namar ka don ka jingknia kaba man la u snem hangta na ka bynta ka iing baroh .

en: And while he yet spake , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came : and Adonijah said unto him , Come in  ; for thou art a valiant man , and bringest good tidings .
kha: Ha shuwa ba un pynkut ïa ka jingkren , u Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar u lyngdoh , u la wan poi .  Ale rung ,  u Adonijah u ong .  Me long u briew uba bha — me dei ban wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang kren, ha khmih, u Jonathan u khun u Abhiatar u la wan: bad u Adonijah u la ong ha u: To wan rung; namar me long u briew uba shlur bad me wanrah ia ka khubor babha .

en: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image , or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above , or that is in the earth beneath , or that is in the waters beneath the earth :
kha: ‘ Wat thaw durblei ïa lade , lane ïa kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shajrong , lane ha ka khyndew sha tbian , lane ha ka um hapoh ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynlong ia me ia ka dur ba la ker , ne ia ka dur jong kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shaneng , ne kaba don ha ka khyndew hapoh khyndew:

en: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words , saying , Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and serve him and his people , and live .
kha: Nga la ong ïa kajuh ha u syiem Sedekaïah jong ka Judah .  Pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Shakri ïa u bad ïa ki briew jong u , bad phin im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kren ruh ha u Sedekaiah syiem Judah kat kum kine ki ktien baroh, da kaba ong: To wanrah ia ki ryndang jong phi hapoh ka jingkit jong u syiem Babilon bad to shakri ia u bad ki briew jong u bad to im .

en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .
kha: Nga la leh mynleh kum u bieit — hynrei phi la pynlong ïa nga ban leh kumta . Dei ma phi kiba la dei ban pynpaw ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi ïa nga . Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na kita ki  apostol  kiba kham kyrpang jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la kylla bieit ha kaba pyndonburom ia nga: namar nga la dei ban shah iaroh na phi: namar ha kaei kaei nga long hadien jong ki apostol kiba khraw tam, wat la ngam long ei ei .

en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan , in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood : and they are there unto this day .
kha: U Joshua u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw hapdeng jong ka Jordan , ha kaba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïeng . ( Kito ki maw ki dang don hangta . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la buh shiphew tylli ki maw hapdeng ka Jordan, ha ka jaka ba ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk ka jutang ki ieng: bad ki don hangta haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah , saying , Pray now unto the  Lord  our God for us .
kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la phah ïa u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah ban ong ïa nga ban duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u syiem u la phah ia u khun u Sheemaiah bad u Sephaniah u khun u Maesaiah u lyngdoh ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa , u da ong: To duwai mynta ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong ngi .

en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .
kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka ruh bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongap , ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong u yn ym ïohsngew pat halor ki lum jong ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia u ha ki kynjri bad ki la wanrah ia u sha u syiem Babilon: ki la wanrah ia u ha ki jaka ba la set , ba ka sur jong u kan ym iohsngew shuh ha ki lum Israel .

en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ  ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
kha: U Blei uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long u Nongaplangbrot uba khraw jong ki langbrot da kata ka jingïap ha kaba la kñia ïa u , da kaba la pynskhem ïa ka jutang bymjukut . To ai ba U Blei ka jingsuk un pyndap ïa phi da kaei kaei kaba bha baroh kaba phi donkam khnang ban leh ïa ka mon jong u , bad ai ba ma u , da U Jisu Khrist , un leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Bad ha U Khrist to long ka burom junom la junom , Amen .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia phi kiba janai ha ka kam babha baroh ban leh ia ka mon jong u, da kaba trei ha phi ia kata kaba sngewbha ha khmat jong u, lyngba U Jisu Khrist; ha uba to long ka burom junom . Amen .

en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .
kha: La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa halor ki kliar lum : ki dei ki paid Israel kiba ïam bad ïasaid , namar ba ki la im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop bad ba ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La iohsngew ia ka sur ha ki jaka ba jrong , ka iam bad ka jingkyrpad jong ki khun Israel: namar ki la pynkylla ia la ka lynti , bad ki la klet noh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: For the son dishonoureth the father , the daughter riseth up against her mother , the daughter in law against her mother in law  ; a man s enemies are the men of his own house .
kha: Ha kine ki por , ki khun shynrang ki ñiew ïa la ki kpa kum kiba bieit , ki khun kynthei ki pyrshah ïa la ki kmie , bad ki kynthei samla ki ïakajia bad la ki kiaw ; ki nongshun jong u briew ki dei ki dkhot na ka longïing jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u khun u khlem burom ia u kpa, ka khun kynthei ka ieng pyrshah ia ka kmie jong ka, ka khun kynthei pyrshah ia ka kmie tymmen jong ka; ki nongshun shynrang ki long ki shynrang jong ka iing jong u hi .

en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us , and we will hang them up unto the  Lord  in Gibeah of Saul , whom the  Lord  did choose . And the king said , I will give them .
kha: Kumta aiti ha ngi hynñiew ngut na ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u , bad ngin phasi ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha Gibeah , ka shnong trai jong u Saul , u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai .   Ngan aiti ïa ki ,  u syiem u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u kin shah aiti ha ngi, bad ngin sa pynsangeh ia ki ha U Trai ha Gibeah u Saul uba U Trai u la jied . Bad u syiem u la ong , Ngan ai ia ki .

en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh  ;
kha: Lada kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la pur ha ka met jong u naduh khlieh haduh kjat ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka jingpang sniehdoh ka mih shabar ha ka sniehdoh , bad ka sniehdoh ka tap lut ia ka sniehdoh jong uta uba don ka khlam naduh ka khlieh jong u haduh ka kjat jong u , ha kaba u lyngdoh u peit;

en: And he commanded them , saying , This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king s house  ;
kha: U la pyn-i ha ki ïa u Joash u khun jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum harum :  Haba phi wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi phin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia ki da kaba ong: Kane ka long kaba phi dei ban leh; Ka bynta kaba lai na phi kaba rung ha ka sngi Sabha kan long wat ki nongap ia ka iing syiem;

en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .
