kha: Kaba mih na kaei ba ki apostol ki la leh , ka long ba ïa ki briew kiba pang la rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba la kumno kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto katne ngut na ki katba u dang ïaid najan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynrung ba ki la wanrah ia kiba pang sha ki surok, bad ki la buh ia ki ha ki jingthiah bad ki shuki , ba la kumno kumno ka jingdum jong u Petros kaba iaid lyngba ka lah ban tap ia ki katto katne na ki .

en: And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well s mouth in his place .
kha: Ha man ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh ki la ïapoi lang hangta , ki nongap langbrot ki ju pyntyllun sharud ïa uta u maw bad ki ai um ïa ki . Nangta ki buh pat ïa uta u maw ha kajuh ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta ki langbrot baroh ki la ialum lang: bad ki la pynkhih ia u maw na ka shyntur jong ka thliew bad ki la ai um ia ki langbrot bad ki la buh biang ia u maw ha ka shyntur jong ka thliew ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And if some of the branches be broken off , and thou , being a wild olive tree , wert grafted in among them , and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree ;
kha: Ïa ki katto katne na ki tnat jong u dieng Olib ba la thung , la pynkheiñ noh , bad ba ïa u tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw la pynïasoh bad u . Ma phi ki Jentil phi long kum ki dieng Olib khlaw , bad mynta phi ïadon bynta ha ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem bakhlaiñ jong ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada don katto katne ki tnat kiba la tyrkhong, bad me, da kaba long u dieng olive khlaw, u la tyrkhong hapdeng jong ki, bad bad ki u iashim bynta ha ka tynrai bad ka shini jong u dieng olive ; .

en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem , and turned his name to Jehoiakim . And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother , and carried him to Egypt .
kha: U Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim u para jong u Joahas kum u syiem ka Judah bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la ïalam sha Ijipt da u Neko .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ijipt u la pynlong ia u Eliakim u hynmen jong u halor ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem bad u la pynphai ia ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoiakim . U Neco u la shim ia u hynmen jong u bad u la rah ia u sha Ijipt .

en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven , and will give unto thy seed all these countries  ; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ;
kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri baroh . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan kyrkhu ïa ki kumba nga la kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia u symbai jong me ban nang bun kum ki khlur bneng, bad ngan ai ha u symbai jong me ia kine ki ri baroh beg bad ha u symbai jong me baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu;

en: And he said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord : Peradventure there shall be twenty found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for twenty s sake .
kha: U Abraham u ong ,  To map ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Tharai don tang arphew ngut hangta ?  U jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka nongbah lada nga shem arphew ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ha khmih mynta, nga la shim ia nga ban kren ha U Trai: Hooid kin don arphew ngut kiba la lap hangta . Bad u la ong , Ngan ym pynjot ia ka na ka bynta arphew ngut .

en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  unto his place , into the oracle of the house , to the most holy place , even under the wings of the cherubims .
kha: Nangta ki lyngdoh ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sha ka Templ bad ki buh ïa ka ha Ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hapoh ki kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki la wanrah ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai ha ka jaka jong u, ha ka jaka ba kyntang tam jong ka iing .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the Lord  God  , that I will send a famine in the land , not a famine of bread , nor a thirst for water , but of hearing the words of the  Lord  :
kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Ki briew kin thngan , hynrei ym ïa u kpu ; kin sliang , hynrei ym ïa ka um . Kin thngan bad kin sliang ïa ka khubor na U  Trai . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan , ong U Trai Blei , ba ngan phah ia ka jingkyrduh ha ka ri , ym ia ka jingkyrduh um ne ka jingthngan um , hynrei ban iohsngew ia ki ktien U Trai:

en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .
kha: Ki briew hangta ki long kiba kham ïar jingmut ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahshkor ïa ka khubor da ka jingangnud bakhraw , bad man ka sngi ki ju pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban khmih lada kaei kaba u Paul u ong ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki kham donburom ban ia kito kiba don ha Thessaloni, ha kaba ki la pdiang ia ka ktien da ka jinglong ba la pynkhreh baroh, bad ki la wad ia ki jingthoh man ka sngi, la kita kiei kiei ki long kumta ne em .

en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .
kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha kiba ngeit , katba ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ka long ka jingpynshisha ïa kiba ngeit , ym ïa ki bymngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki thylliej ki long na ka bynta ka dak, ym ia kito kiba ngeit, hynrei ia kito ki bym ngeit: hynrei ka jingiathuhlypa kam long na ka bynta kito ki bym ngeit, hynrei na ka bynta kito kiba ngeit .

en: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .
kha: Ka long kaba dei eh ba U Blei , uba thaw bad pynneh ïa kiei kiei baroh , un pynlong ïa U Jisu uba janai lyngba ka jingshah shitom , khnang ban pynwan ïa kiba bun ki khun ban ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingpynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la long ma u, na ka bynta jong u baroh, bad da uba baroh, ha kaba wanrah ia ki khun shynrang kiba bun sha ka burom, ban pynlong ia u khliehduh jong ka jingpynim jong ki uba janai lyngba ki jingjynjar .

en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .
kha: Namar ba u syiem Ahas u la leh pop , U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la shah ïa u syiem ka Syria ban jop ïa u bad ban ring koidi bun bah na ki Judia sha Damaskos . U  Trai  u la shah ruh ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Remalaïah , ban jop ïa u Ahas bad pynïap shi lakh arphew hajar ki shipai Judia kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki u la shah ïa kane ban jia , namar ki briew ka Judah ki la kyntait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Pekah u khun u Remaliah u la iap ha Judah shispah arphew hajar ha kawei ka sngi , kiba long baroh ki briew kiba shlur ; namar ki la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .
kha: bad u la kyrpad rit ïa u ,  Ka khun rit jong nga ka pang jur . To sngewbha ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ka , khnang ba kan khiah bad ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kyrpad shibun eh ia u, u da ong, Ka khun barit jong nga ka thiah ha ka por ba ka iap: Nga kyrpad ia me, to wan bad buh ia ki kti jong me ha ka, ba kan koit; bad kan im .

en: Now therefore write ye this song for you , and teach it the children of Israel : put it in their mouths , that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel .
kha: Mynta , thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai . Hikai ïa ka ha ki Israel , khnang ba ka kan ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to thoh ia kane ka jingrwai na ka bynta jong phi , bad hikai ia ka ha ki khun Israel: buh ia ka ha ka shyntur jong ki , ba kane ka jingrwai kan long ka sakhi na ka bynta jong nga pyrshah ia ki khun Israel .

en: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .
kha: Kumta ki la ot noh ïa ki angkor bad ki la shah ïa ki ba kin ngam ha ka duriaw , bad ha kajuh ka por ki la pynkylluid ïa ki tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki boitha . Nangta ki la kyntiew ïa ka jaiñ pynshah lyer ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng khnang ba ka lyer ka lah ban beh ïa ka lieng sha khmat , bad ngi la ïaid beit sha ka ryngkew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la shim ia ki nar, ki la aiti ia lade sha duriaw, bad ki la pyllait ia ki band kiba jrong bad ki la pynkhih ia ka lyer kaba heh sha rud duriaw .

en: And the watchman saw another man running : and the watchman called unto the porter , and said , Behold another man running alone . And the king said , He also bringeth tidings .
kha: Nangta uta u nongap phira u ïohi sa uwei pat u briew uba mareh marwei , bad u pyrta sha tbian sha u nongap khyrdop ,  Ha peit ! Don sa uwei u briew uba mareh !  U syiem u jubab ,  Uta ruh u wanrah khubor babha .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap u la iohi ia uwei pat u briew uba mareh: bad u nongap u la pyrta ia u nongrah mar, bad u la ong: Ha khmih uwei pat u briew uba mareh marwei . Bad u syiem u la ong , U ruh u wanrah khubor .

en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .
kha: Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad mynta u tnga jong nga un ieit ïa nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Reuben .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Leah ka la pun khun bad ka la kha khun shynrang bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Reuben: namar ka la ong: Hooid U Trai u la peit ia ka jingjynjar jong nga; mynta u tnga jong nga un ieit ia nga .

en: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the  Lord  , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets , and hid them by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water . )
kha: bad haba ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  , u Obadaïah u la shim bad pynrieh ïa ki shispah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ha ki krem , da kaba phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun kiba sanphew ngut ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad u la pynbiang jingbam bad um ïa ki . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la long kumta, haba u Jesbel u la ot noh ia ki nongiathuhlypa U Trai, ba u Obadiah u la shim shispah ngut ki nongiathuhlypa, bad u la buhrieh ia ki da sanphew ngut ha ka krem , bad u la ai bam ia ki da u kpu bad ka um .

en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
kha: bad ynda phi la poi sha shiliang ka Jordan , pynïeng ïa kita ki maw ha u lum Ebal , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi , bad ñiad astor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan long ynda phi la leit sha Jordan, ba phin buh ia kine ki maw kiba nga hukum ia phi mynta ka sngi, ha u lum Ebal, bad me dei ban buh ia ki da ka plaster .

en: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom , and wrote it in a book , and laid it up before the  Lord . And Samuel sent all the people away , every man to his house .
kha: U Samuel u pynshai ha uta u paidbah ïa ki hok bad ki kamram u syiem , bad u thoh ïa ki ha ka kitab bad u buh ïa ka ha ka jaka kyntang . Nangta u phah ïa ki ba kin leit noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Samuel u la iathuh ha ki briew ia ka rukom synshar jong ka hima, bad u la thoh ia ka ha ka kot bad u la buh ia ka ha khmat U Trai . U Samuel u la phah noh ia ki briew baroh, uwei pa uwei sha la iing .

en: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus , whom thou hast anointed , both Herod , and Pontius Pilate , with the Gentiles , and the people of Israel , were gathered together ,
kha: Naba shisha u Herod bad u Pontios Pilat ki la ïakynduh lang ha kane ka nongbah lem bad ki Jentil bad ki paid Israel pyrshah ïa U Jisu , u shakri bakhuid jong me , ïa uba me la pynlong U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingshisha pyrshah ia u khun bakhuid jong me U Jisu, uba me la pynsleh , baroh arngut u Herod bad u Pontius Pilat bad ki Jutang bad ki briew Israel ki la ialum lang .

en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ ; that every one may receive the things done in his body , according to that he hath done , whether it be good or bad .
kha: Naba baroh na ngi ngin paw ha khmat U Khrist , ba yn bishar ïa ngi da u . Ngin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba ngi dei hok , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la leh , la bha ne la sniew , ha kane ka jingim ha ka met jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar baroh ngi dei ban paw ha khmat ka jaka bishar jong U Khrist ; ba uwei pa uwei un pdiang ia kiei kiei kiba la leh ha ka met jong u, kat kum kata kaba u la leh, la ka long kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

en: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Caesar .
kha: Ki la pyrta biang ,  To pynïap noh ïa u ! Pynïap noh ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !  U Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Phi kwah ïa nga ba ngan sahnarphna ïa u syiem jong phi ?  Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jubab ,  U syiem uba ngi don u dei tang u Patsha !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la pyrta , Shaphang jong u, sha jngai bad u, to sahnarphna ia u . U Pilat u ong ha ki , Hato ngan sahnarphna ia u Syiem jong phi ? Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jubab , Ngim don syiem hynrei tang u Kaisar .

en: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u long uba hok , namar ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang jong nga . Ki samla shynrang bad kynthei jong nga ki la shah ringmraw noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong ki ka la pyrta ha U Trai , ko kynroh jong ka khun jong u Seion , to ai ba ki ummat kin tuid kum ka wah sngi bad ka miet: to ai ia lade ba phin ym shongthait shuh; wat ai ba ka apple jong ka khmat jong me kan sangeh noh .

en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .
kha: Ka Joppa kam shym da jngai na Lydda , bad haba ki parabangeit ha Joppa ki la ïohsngew ba u Petros u la don ha Lydda , ki la phah ar ngut ki rangbah sha u lem bad ka khubor ,  To pynkloi bad wan sha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Lydda u la jan sha Joppa, bad ki synran ki la iohsngew ba u Petros u don hangta, ki la phah sha u arngut ki briew, ki kwah ia u ba un ym slem ban wan sha ki .

en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the  Lord  , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil :
kha: un shim ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih ba la pyndap da u rnga ding barhem na ka duwan bad ar kham ka jingiwbih , bad un wanrah ïa ki sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ka umphniang kaba dap da ki dewiong ba la thang na ka jingbam ba thiang ba la khleh lang bad ki kti jong u kiba dap da ka jingiwbih ba thiang ba la khleh lang bad u wanrah ia ka hapoh ka jingtap:

en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :
kha: bad ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal khnang ban thang ïa ki khun jong ki ha ka ding kum ki jingkñia . Ngam ju hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi ruh ha ka jingpyrkhat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la tei ruh ia ki jaka ba jrong jong u Baal , ban thang ia ki khun shynrang jong ki da ka ding na ka bynta ki jingknia thang ha u Baal , kaba ngam shym la hukum ne kren ia ka , bad kam shym la wan ha ka jingmut jong nga:

en: And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
kha: Hynrei uta u shakri u kylli ,  Kumno lada jia ba kata ka samla kam mon ban iehnoh ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha kane ka ri ? Hato ngan phah noh ïa u khun jong phi sha kata ka ri na kaba phi wan ?
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la ong ha u, "Hato kata ka kynthei kan ym mon ban bud ia nga sha kane ka ri: hato nga donkam ban wanrah biang ia u khun jong me sha kata ka ri na kaba me wan ?

en: And Joshua rent his clothes , and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the  Lord  until the eventide , he and the elders of Israel , and put dust upon their heads .
kha: U Joshua bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewdiaw , bad ki dem khrup ha khyndew ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad dem hangta haduh janmiet lem bad u pui pui halor ki khlieh jong ki ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la hap ha khyndew ha khmat jong u ha khmat ka synduk U Trai haduh ka por ba la jia , ma u bad ki rangbah Israel bad ki la buh ia ka dewbilat ha ki khlieh jong ki .

en: And he also had made savoury meat , and brought it unto his father , and said unto his father , Let my father arise , and eat of his son s venison , that thy soul may bless me .
kha: U ruh u la shet ïa ka jingbam kaba bang bad u leit rah ïa ka sha la u kpa . U ong ,  Ko pa , sngewbha , to khie shong bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh ba nga la wanrah ïa phi , ba phi lah ban ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U ruh u la shet ia ka doh kaba thiang bad u la wanrah ia ka ha u kpa jong u, bad u la ong ha u kpa jong u, To ai ba u kpa jong nga un khie bad bam ia ka snam jong u khun jong u, ba ka mynsiem jong me kan kyrkhu ia nga .

en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .
kha: Ki nongkhaïi ki ong ha ka ,  Baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba pha la angnud ban ïoh ki la jah noh , bad baroh ka spah jong pha bad ka rong phong jong pha ki la leit noh , phan ym shem shuh ïa ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki soh kiba ka mynsiem jong me ka la kwah ki la jah noh na me , bad kiei kiei baroh kiba la long kiba itynnad bad kiba bha ki la jah noh na me , bad men ym shem shuh ia ki satia .

en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
kha: U la buh ka por kaba dei ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ai ha ngi ka jingkwah ban tip ïa ka lawei , hynrei um ju ai ha ngi ka jinghun ban sngewthuh lut ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ia kiei kiei baroh kiba itynnad ha ka por jong u: kumjuh ruh u la buh ia ka pyrthei ha ka dohnud jong ki , haduh ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban shem ia ka kam kaba U Blei U leh naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut .

en: And one of his servants said , None , my lord , O king : but Elisha , the prophet that is in Israel , telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber .
kha: Uwei na ki u jubab ,  Ko syiem kynrad , ym don uwei ruh . U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u ïathuh ha u syiem ka Israel ïa kaei kaba phi ong wat ha kaba rieh hapoh ka kamra jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki shakri jong u u la ong, Ym don uwei ruh, ko kynrad jong nga: hynrei u Elisa, u nongiathuhlypa uba don ha Israel, u la ong ia u syiem Israel ia ki ktien kiba me kren ha ka kamra thiah jong me .

en: Then shall they also answer him , saying , Lord , when saw we thee an hungred , or athirst , or a stranger , or naked , or sick , or in prison , and did not minister unto thee ?
kha: Nangta kin jubab ïa u , ‘ Mynno , ko Trai , ba ngi la ju ïohi ba me thngan lane sliang lane ba me long u nongwei lane ba me la lyngkhuit lane ba me pang lane hapoh ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngim shym la ïarap ïa me ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin jubab ruh ia u da kaba ong, ko Trai, haba ngi la iohi ia me ba me la thngan ne nga la sliang ne u nongwei ne u nongwei ne u nongwei ne u nongpang ne u nongpang ne u nongpang ha phatok ?

en: Son of man , thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house , which have eyes to see , and see not  ; they have ears to hear , and hear not : for they are a rebellious house .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  me im hapdeng ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah . Ki don ki khmat , hynrei kim ïohi ei ei ; ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew ei ei , namar ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, me shong hapdeng ka iing kaba leh pyrshah, kaba don ki khmat ban iohi, bad kim iohi; kim don ki shkor ban iohsngew, bad kim iohsngew: namar ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet , saying , The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .
kha: Kumba la thoh ha ka kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :  Don uwei uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : ‘ To pynkhreh ka lynti bah na ka bynta U Trai ; to pynlong ka lynti ba-beit na ka bynta jong u ba un ïaid !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab jong ki ktien u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa , u ong , Ka sur jong uwei uba iam ha ka ri khlaw , Pynkhreh ia ka lynti U Trai , pynlong ia ki lynti jong u kiba beit .

en: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth , and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem  ; and they are wasted and desolate , as at this day .
kha: Te nga pynmih noh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga bad ka jingbitar shla ha ki shnong jong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem , bad nga thang ïa ki da ka ding . La iehnoh ïa ki ha ki jingjot bad ki la long ka jingïohi ba-itriem , kumba ki long mynta ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ka jingbitar jong nga bad ka jingbitar jong nga ka la tuid sha khmat ha ki nongbah Judah bad ha ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem; bad ki la jah rngai bad ki la jah rngai noh kumba ha kane ka sngi .

en: Therefore I was left alone , and saw this great vision , and there remained no strength in me : for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption , and I retained no strength .
kha: La iehnoh ïa nga marwei hangta , da kaba khmih ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phylla . Ngam donbor shuh , bad ka durkhmat jong nga ka la kylla dur haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban ithuh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la sah marwei , bad nga la iohi ia kane ka jingphohsniew kaba khraw , bad ym shym la sah bor ha nga: namar ka jinglong babha jong nga ka la kylla ha nga sha ka jingbamsap , bad ngam shym la bat ia ka bor .

en: And he shall look on the plague , and , behold , if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes , greenish or reddish , which in sight are lower than the wall  ;
kha: Lada don ki dak lam jyrngam lane lam saw kiba paw kumba ki la ngam ha ka kynroh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un peit ia ka khlam, bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam ka don ha ki kynroh jong ka iing da ki rong saw, kiba jyrngam ne kiba jyrngam, kiba ha khmat ki kham duna ban ia ka kynroh ; .

en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be of those that eat at thy table : for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother .
kha: Hynrei pyn-i ka jinglehsbun ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Barsillai uba na Gilead bad ri sumar ïa ki , namar ki la lehsbun ïa nga mynba nga la phet krad na u Absalom , u hynmen jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to pyni ia ka jingsngewbha ia ki khun shynrang jong u Barzillai u Gilead bad to ai ba kin long na kito kiba bam ha ka miej jong me: namar kumta ki la wan sha nga haba nga la phet noh namar u Absalom u hynmen jong me .

en: And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .
kha: U la jubab ,  Katba phi dang leit shapoh ka nongbah , u briew uba kit shi khra ka um un ïashem ïa phi . Bud ïa u shapoh ka ïing ba u rung , bad ong ha u trai jong ka ïing :
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Ha khmih haba phi rung shapoh shnong, un iakynduh ia phi, u la rah ia ka umphniang um ; bud ia u shapoh ka iing ha kaba u rung .

en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face , and I will shew the nations thy nakedness , and the kingdoms thy shame .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa pha , ko Ninebeh ! ngan sloit lyngkhuit ïa pha bad ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ïohi ïa pha , ban ïohi ïa pha ha ka jinglehrain jong pha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me, ong U Trai jong ki paid ; bad ngan sa lap ia ki bniat jong me ha ka khmat jong me, bad ngan pyni ia ki jaitbynriew ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong me, bad ki hima jong me .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .
kha: U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Haba ki hynñiewphew snem jong ka Babilonia ki la kut , ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga na ka bynta jong phi bad bat ïa ka kular jong nga ban wallam pat ïa phi sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Ba hadien hynriewphew snem ngan leit jngoh ia phi, bad ngan leh ia ka ktien babha jong nga ha phi, ha kaba pynlong ia phi ban leit phai biang sha kane ka jaka .

en: But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Israel bad me . U  Trai  um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u briew jong U Blei u la wan ha u, u da ong, ko syiem, wat ai ba ki shipai Israel kin leit bad me; namar U Trai um don bad ki Israel baroh .

en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain : and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months .
kha: U Elijah u la long u briew kum ma ngi . U la duwai shitrhem ba kan ym hap slap , bad ym shym la hap slap halor ka khyndew haduh lai snem shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elias u long u briew uba shah ktah ha ki jingsngewtynnat kumba ngi long , bad u la duwai jur ba un ym slap: bad um slap ha ka khyndew da ka por lai snem hynriew bnai .

en: And Elisha said unto her , What shall I do for thee ? tell me , what hast thou in the house ? And she said , Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house , save a pot of oil .
kha: Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga , phi don aïu ha ïing ?   Ym don ei ei shuh , lait sa tang u khra umphniang Olib uba rit ,  ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong ia ka, Nga leh aiu na ka bynta jong me ? iathuh ia nga, kaei kaba phi don ha iing ? Bad ka la ong: Ka kti jong me kam don ei ei ha iing , lait noh tang ka umphniang .

en: But by an equality , that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want , that their abundance also may be a supply for your want : that there may be equality :
kha: Ngam pyrshang ban pynsting ïa kiwei da kaba buh ïa ka jingkit kaba khia halor jong phi ; hynrei namar ba phi don kyrhai ha kane ka por , kaba long kaba biang ba phi dei ban ïarap ïa kito kiba kyrduh . Te , haba phi kyrduh bad ma ki pat ki don kyrhai , kin ïarap ïa phi . Ha kane ka rukom yn ïoh ñiew mar ryngkat ïa phi bad ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da ka jingiaryngkat , ba mynta ha kane ka por ka jingbun jong phi ka lah ban long ka jingpynbiang ia ka jingkwah jong ki , ba ka jingbun jong ki ruh ka lah ban long ka jingpynbiang ia ka jingkwah jong phi: ba kan don ka jingiaryngkat:

en: Then ye shall come up after him , that he may come and sit upon my throne  ; for he shall be king in my stead : and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah .
kha: Bud biang ïa u shane haba u wan ban shong ha ka khet jong nga . Un long syiem hadien jong nga , namar u dei ma u , uta uba nga la jied ban long u nongsynshar jong ka Israel bad ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta phin wan shaneng hadien jong u, ba un wan shong ha ka khet jong nga: bad nga la thung ia u ban long u nongsynshar halor ki Israel bad halor ka Judah .

en: And the man came into the house : and he ungirded his camels , and gave straw and provender for the camels , and water to wash his feet , and the men s feet that were with him .
kha: Kumta uta u briew u leit rung sha kata ka ïing , bad u Laban u pynhiar ïa ki jingkit na kita ki ut bad u la ai phlangïap bad jingbam ïa ki . Nangta u la wanrah um ïa u shakri jong u Abraham bad ïa ki nongbud jong u ba kin sait ïa la ki kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: Utei u briew u la wan shapoh iing : bad u la pynkhih ia ki kulai jong u, bad u la ai sboh bad u sohjew na ka bynta ki kulai, bad ka um ban sait ia ki kjat jong u bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they turn and encamp before Pi–hahiroth , between Migdol and the sea , over against Baal–zephon : before it shall ye encamp by the sea .
kha: Ong ïa ki Israel ban phai dien bad ban sher dara ha khmat ka Pi Hahiroth , hapdeng ka Migdol bad ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Baal Sephon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel ba kin phai bad shong ha khmat u Pihahiroth, hapdeng u Migdol bad ka duriaw, ha khmat u Baalzephon: shuwa ba phin shong ha rud duriaw .

en: When a ruler hath sinned , and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  his God concerning things which should not be done , and is guilty  ;
kha: Lada u dei u nongsynshar uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u nongsynshar u la leh pop , bad u la leh katto katne lyngba ka jingbymtip pyrshah ia kano kano ka hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong u shaphang kiei kiei kiba ym dei ban leh , bad u long uba don pop;

en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .
kha: U Paul u la kut jingmut ban ïaid lait ïa ka Ephesos , ba kumta yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka probins jong ka Asia . U la kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pentekost , lada ka long kaba lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Paul u la kut jingmut ban leit noh da u Ephesos , namar un ym pynlut por ha Asia: namar u la kyrkieh, lada lah ia u, ban don ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pentecost .

en: For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?
kha: Nga tip haduh katno phi long kiba mutlop bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah . Phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba nga dang im , bad ynda nga la ïap lei lei , phin nang kham ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia ka jingleh pyrshah jong me, bad ka ryndang kaba jem jong me: ha khmih , katba nga dang im bad phi ha kane ka sngi , phi la leh pyrshah ia U Trai ; bad katno hadien ka jingiap jong nga ?

en: And the men of Judah came , and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah . And they told David , saying , That the men of Jabesh–gilead were they that buried Saul .
kha: Nangta ki rangbah ka Judah ki la wan sha Hebron bad ki la pynsleh ïa u Dabid kum u syiem ka Judah . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead ki la tep ïa u Saul ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la wan, bad hangta ki la pynsleh ia u syiem u Dabid halor ka iing u Judah . Ki la iathuh ha u Dabid da kaba ong: Ba ki briew jong u Jabesh Gilead ki long kiba tep ia u Saul .

en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .
kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban neh sha ka jingim bymjukut . Kane ka long ka jingbam kaba U Khun U Briew un ai ha phi , namar ba U Blei uba U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka doh kaba pyut hynrei na ka bynta kata ka doh kaba neh haduh ka jingim bymjukut kaba U Khun u briew un ai ha phi: namar ha u U Blei U Kpa u la khang .

en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tarshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
kha: U don shi kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha duriaw ryngkat bad ka kynhun lieng u Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki kynhun lieng jong u ki ju wan phai , ki da wan kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem u la don ha duriaw ka duriaw jong ka Tarshish bad ka duriaw jong u Hiram: shisien ha ki lai snem ka la wan ka duriaw jong u Tarshish , kaba wanrah ia ka ksiar bad ka rupa , ka sniehdoh bad ki sohjew .

en: In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other , to the end that man should find nothing after him .
kha: Haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , to kmen , bad haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , shu kynmaw : U Blei u phah ïa ka jingkmen bad ka jingjynjar ; phin ym tip da lei lei kaei ka ban jia hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi jong ka jingroi jingpar to sngewbha, hynrei ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar to pyrkhat: U Blei ruh u la buh ia uta uwei pyrshah ia uwei pat, haduh ba u briew un ym shem ei ei hadien jong u .

en: I know thy works : behold , I have set before thee an open door , and no man can shut it : for thou hast a little strength , and hast kept my word , and hast not denied my name .
kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha leh ; nga tip ba pha don khyndiat ka bor ; pha la bud ïa ka jinghikai jong nga bad pha la ïaineh ha nga . Nga la plie ïa ka jingkhang ha khmat jong pha , kaba ym don ba lah ban khang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia ki kam jong me: ha khmih nga la buh ha khmat jong me ia ka jingkhang kaba plie, bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban khang ia ka: namar me don ka bor khyndiat bad me la bat ia ka ktien jong nga bad me khlem kyntait ia ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .
kha: Men im da ka waitlam , Hynrei men long u mraw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , Men lait na ka jingsynshar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad da ka waitlam jong me men im, bad men shakri ia u hynmen jong me; bad kan sa jia ynda me la don ka jingsynshar, ba me pynpra ia ka jingkit jong u na ka ryndang jong me .

en: Then went he also to Ramah , and came to a great well that is in Sechu : and he asked and said , Where are Samuel and David ? And one said , Behold , they be at Naioth in Ramah .
kha: Nangta da lade hi u leit sha Ramah . Ynda u la poi ha ka pukri kaba heh ha Seku , u kylli ha-ei u Samuel bad u Dabid ki don bad la ïathuh ha u ba ki don ha Naïoth .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit ruh sha Rama , bad u la poi ha ka thliew kaba khraw kaba don ha Sechu: bad u la kylli bad u la ong: Hangno u Samuel bad u Dabid ? Bad uwei u la ong: Ha khmih ki don ha Naiot ha Rama .

en: And devils also came out of many , crying out , and saying , Thou art Christ the Son of God . And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak : for they knew that he was Christ .
kha: Ki ksuid ruh ki la mihnoh na kiba bun ki briew , ki da lynñiar ,  Me long U Khun jong U Blei !  U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ksuid bad um shah ïa ki ban kren , namar ba ki la ithuh ba u la long U Messaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ksuid ruh ki la mih na kiba bun, ki da pyrta bad ki da ong: Me long U Khrist U Khun U Blei . Bad u la pynshitom ia ki ba kim kren: namar ki tip ba u long U Khrist .

en: Is not this the carpenter , the son of Mary , the brother of James , and Joses , and of Judas , and Simon ? and are not his sisters here with us ? And they were offended at him .
kha: Hato um dei uto u misteri , u khun jong ka Mari , bad u hynmen jong u Jakob , u Josis , u Judas bad u Simon ? Hato ki para kynthei jong u kim shong kim sah hangne ?  Bad kumta ki la kyntait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam dei ka nongshna dieng, u khun jong ka Maria, u hynmen u Jakob bad u Joses bad u Judas bad u Simon ? bad hato ki para jong u hangne bad ngi ? Ki la sngewsih ia u .

en: All things are delivered to me of my Father : and no man knoweth who the Son is , but the Father  ; and who the Father is , but the Son , and he to whom the Son will reveal him .
kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don batip U Khun u long uei lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don batip U Kpa u long uei lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei la aiti ha nga na U Kpa jong nga: bad ym don ba tip mano ba long U Khun, hynrei U Kpa ; bad Uba U Kpa u long , hynrei U Khun , bad uta ha uba U Khun un pynpaw ia U .

en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh  ; he shall see it , and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon , and to his children , because he hath wholly followed the  Lord .
kha: lait tang u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh . U te u ïaineh ha nga , kumta ngan ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la leit syntiat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia u khun u Jephunneh ; un iohi ia ka, bad ha u ngan ai ia ka ri kaba u la iaid , bad ha ki khun jong u , namar u la bud pura ia U Trai .

en: And he said unto them , What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people , which have spoken to me , saying , Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us ?
kha: Kaei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ?  u kylli .  Kaei ba ngan ong ha ki briew kiba ong ïa nga ba ngan pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Kaei ka jingai jingmut kaba phi ai ba ngin jubab ia une u briew uba la kren ia nga da kaba ong: To ai katto katne ka jingkit kaba u kpa jong me u la buh ha ngi ?

en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .
kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher kum ka dak jong ka jutang . Kumta u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi taïew naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u Jakob u khun jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen kiba pawnam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ia u ia ka jutang jong ka jingotsher: bad kumta u Abraham u la kha ia u Isaak, bad u la ot ia u ha ka sngi kaba phra; bad u Isaak u la kha ia u Jakob; bad u Jakob u la kha ia ki shiphew ngut ki kpa tymmen .

en: God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei um lah shah ïa kino kino ki nongïaleh pyrshah ; u pynshitom ïa kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingbitar jong u , u siew kylliang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u sngewsih , bad U Trai u pynrem ia u; bad u bitar; bad U Trai un pynrem ia ki nongshun jong u .

en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
kha: Ko Moab , pha shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ha la ka spah , hynrei mynta wat ïa pha ruh yn jop noh ; ïa u blei Khemosh jong pha yn ringmraw , lem bad ki khun syiem bad ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar namar ba me la shaniah ha ki kam jong me bad ha ki spah jong me: bad u Chemosh un leit sha ka jingshah set bad ki lyngdoh jong u bad ki syiem jong u ryngkat .

en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .
kha: U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai kin sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jong ki .  U  Trai  u la kren — U  Trai  ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un iaid sha ka jaka ba skhem jong u namar ka jingtieng, bad ki rangbah jong u kin tieng ia ka dak , ong U Trai , uba ka ding jong u ka don ha Seion bad ka ding jong u ha Jerusalem .

en: This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee , and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me , for harm .
kha: Kine baroh ar — ka kynton bad une u maw pynsah jingkynmaw ki long ki jingpynkynmaw . Ngan ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , bad me ruh men ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton bad ïa une u maw pynsah kynmaw ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka kynhun kan long ka sakhi , bad une u maw un long u sakhi , ba ngan ym iaid lait ia kane ka kynhun ha me , bad ba me ym iaid lait ia kane ka kynhun bad une u maw ha nga , namar ka jingma .

en: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .
kha: U kurup ruh bun bah ka rnong na Tibhath bad Kun , ki nongbah ba synshar u Hadadeser . ( U Solomon hadien u pyndonkam ïa kane ka rnong ha kaba thaw ïa ka pung-um , ki rishot , bad ki khiew rong na ka bynta ka Templ . )
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh na ka Timath, bad na ki shnong Hadarezer, u la wanrah ia u Dabid shibun ki nar, ha kaba u Solomon u la shna ia ka duriaw kaba heh bad ki maw bad ki tiar nar .

en: And as I was considering , behold , an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth , and touched not the ground : and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes .
kha: Katba nga dang lyngngoh aïu kane ka mut , u  langsohmoh u la wan mareh na shaphang sepngi , u da mareh stet eh ba ki kjat jong u kim shym kynduh khyndew . U la don tang kawei ka reng hapdeng ki khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba nga dang pyrkhat, ha khmih, u blang u la wan na shaphang sepngi ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew baroh kawei: bad u blang u don ka bniat kaba pawnam hapdeng ki khmat jong u .

en: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel , even all that fight against her and her munition , and that distress her , shall be as a dream of a night vision .
kha: te baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki hima kiba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah jong ka duwan U Blei , baroh ki tiar ïaleh jong ki bad ki tiar ki tar — baroh kiei kiei — kin jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum kaei kaei ba la shu mutdur mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbun jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ialeh pyrshah ia ka Ariel , wat ia kiba ialeh pyrshah ia ka bad ki tiar siat jong ka , bad kiba pynshitom ia ka , kan long kum ka jingphohsniew miet .

en: He made many to fall , yea , one fell upon another : and they said , Arise , and let us go again to our own people , and to the land of our nativity , from the oppressing sword .
kha: Ki shipai jong phi ki jynthut bad ki kyllon ; uwei u ong ïa uwei pat , ‘ Pynkloi ! Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïing sha ki briew jong ngi bad ban ïohlait im na ka waitlam u nongshun !’
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ia kiba bun ban hap, hooid, uwei u la hap ha uwei pat: bad ki la ong: To khie noh bad to ngin leit phai biang sha la ka jong ka ri bad sha ka ri jong ka jingkha jong ngi, na ka waitlam kaba pynshitom bein .

en: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you , saying , Shew a miracle for you : then thou shalt say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and cast it before Pharaoh , and it shall become a serpent .
kha: Lada u Pharaoh u dawa ba phin pynshisha ïa lade da kaba leh kambah , ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad bret ïa u ha khmat u Pharaoh , bad un sa kylla bseiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Pharaoh un kren ha phi, da kaba ong, To pyni ia ka kambah na ka bynta jong phi: te men ong ha u Aaron: To shim ia u diengduh jong me bad bret ia u ha khmat u Pharaoh bad un kylla long u bsein .

en: But there was a strong tower within the city , and thither fled all the men and women , and all they of the city , and shut it to them , and gat them up to the top of the tower .
kha: La don uwei u mot baskhem hangta , bad uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ka kynthei ha ka nongbah , kynthup ïa ki nongïalam , ki mareh sha u . Ki khang ïa lade shapoh bad ki kiew shalor ka tnum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka don ka tower kaba khlain hapoh ka shnong , bad ki la phet noh ia ki shynrang bad kynthei baroh , bad ki la khang ia ka ha ki , bad ki la khang ia ki haduh ka tduh jong ka tower .

en: And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .
kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga ,  Kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah . Bad U Trai uba U Blei , uba ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha ki nongïathuhlypa , u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Kine ki ktien ki long kiba iaineh bad kiba shisha: bad U Trai U Blei jong ki nongiathuhlypa bakhuid u la phah ia u angel jong u ban pyni ha ki shakri jong u ia kiei kiei kiba dei ban long shen .

en: And saith unto him , Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine  ; and when men have well drunk , then that which is worse : but thou hast kept the good wine until now .
kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa u nongleitkurim , bad u la ong ha u ,  U briew baroh u ai shuwa ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tam , bad hadien ba kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki la dih pahuh , u pynbud sa da ka waiñ kaba kham duna ka jingmad . Hynrei ma me , me tyngkai ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tam haduh mynta !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u , Uwei pa uwei ha kaba sdang u buh ia ka wain kaba bha ; bad haba ki briew ki la dih bha, te kaba kham sniew: hynrei me la buh ia ka wain kaba bha haduh mynta .

en: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews  enemy unto Esther the queen . And Mordecai came before the king  ; for Esther had told what he was unto her .
kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi u syiem Serksis u la ai ha ka Esther , ka mahadei ïa baroh ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman , u nongshun jong ki Jiw . Ka Esther ka ong ïa u syiem ba u Mordekai u don ka jingïadei bad ka , bad naduh kata ka por ïa u Mordekai la shah ban rung sha ka jaka ba don u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi u syiem Ahasaerus u la ai ia ka iing jong u Haman u nongshun jong ki Jiw ha ka mahadei . Bad u Mordecai u la wan ha khmat u syiem ; namar u Esther u la iathuh ia kaei kaba u la iathuh ha ka .

en: And he said unto him , Why art thou , being the king s son , lean from day to day ? wilt thou not tell me ? And Amnon said unto him , I love Tamar , my brother Absalom s sister .
kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Amnon ,  Phi dei u khun jong u syiem ; pynban na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat nga ïohi ba phi i sngewsih . Jia aïu ?   Nga ibha ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u Absalom , uba ïalong shi para bad nga na ijuh i pa ,  u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Balei phi long u khun syiem, phim iathuh ia nga man ka sngi ? Bad u Amnon u la ong ha u, Nga ieit ia ka Tamar, ka para jong nga u Absalom .

en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .
kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la pynkyrpang ïa ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat kum u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam u pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh noh ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u la ai wai ia ki Israel na ka iing u Dabid bad ki la pynlong ia u Jeroboiah u khun u Nebat syiem: bad u Jeroboiah u la pynlong ia ki ban leh pop shibun .

en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .
kha: Kumta keiñ la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la pyndep ia ka kam baroh jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad ki khun Israel ki la leh katba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And it came to pass after many days , that the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah in the third year , saying , Go , shew thyself unto Ahab  ; and I will send rain upon the earth .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingrang ryngkhiang , U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah ,  Khie leit pyn-i ïa lade ha u syiem Ahab , bad ngan sa phah slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien bun sngi, ba ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Elijah ha ka snem kaba lai, ka da ong: To leit, to pyni ia lade ha u Ahab ; bad ngan phah slap ia ka khyndew .

en: And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .
kha: Haba u Dabid u la dep kren , u Saul u ong ,  Hato dei ma phi shisha , ko Dabid u khun jong nga ?  Bad u la sdang ban ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Dabid u la pynkut noh ia kine ki ktien ha u Saul , ba u Saul u la ong: Hato kane ka dei ka sur jong me, ko khun jong nga u Dabid ? U Saul u la pynkiew ia la ka sur bad u la iam .

en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .
kha: Bad ki paidbah ki la wan na ki shnong kiba sawdong ka Jerusalem , ki da wallam ïa kito kiba pang lane kiba don mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong ki ; bad la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan ruh na ki shnong sawdong sha Jerusalem , ki wanrah ia ki nongpang bad kito kiba la shah pynmong ha ki mynsiem bymkhuid: bad ki la koit iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And I will lay sinews upon you , and will bring up flesh upon you , and cover you with skin , and put breath in you , and ye shall live  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ki thied bad ki dohksah , bad ngan tap ïa phi da ka sniehdoh . Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim . Te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ki shyieng ha phi, bad ngan wanrah ia ka doh halor jong phi, bad ngan tap ia phi da ka sniehdoh, bad ngan ring mynsiem ha phi, bad phin im ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you : for morning by morning shall it pass over , by day and by night : and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report .
kha: Kan shoh bad kan ïai shoh ïa phi , na kawei ka step sha kawei pat . Phin hap ban shah ïa ka bad sngi bad miet . Kawei pa kawei ka khubor thymmai na U Blei kan wanrah ïa ka jingshyrkhei bathymmai !
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ka por ba ka mih kan shim ia phi: namar mynstep kan iaid noh, ha ka sngi bad mynmiet: bad kan long ka jingsngewsih tang ban sngewthuh ia ka khubor .

en: The  Lord  called thy name , A green olive tree , fair , and of goodly fruit : with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it , and the branches of it are broken .
kha: Shisien nga la khot ïa ki , u dieng Olib babun sla , uba dap da ki soh ba-itynnat ; hynrei mynta , da ka jingkyrhuh kum u pyrthat ngan thang ïa ki sla jong u ha ka ding bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong me , U dieng olive uba jyrngam bad uba bha: da ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa kaba khraw u la pynmeh ding halor jong ka , bad ki tnat jong ka ki la tyrkhong .

en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .
kha: U Dabid u la bthah ruh ïa ki ban ong ha u Amasa ,  Phi dei u ba-ha-ïing jong nga . Naduh mynta nga buh ïa phi ban ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi ong ha Ama , Hato phim dei na ka shyieng jong nga bad na ka doh jong nga ? U Blei un leh kumta ia nga, bad kham bun ruh lada phim long u kapten jong ka kynhun shipai ha khmat jong nga man ka por ha ka kamra jong u Joab .

en: Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
kha: Phi ki briew ka Shaphir , leit shah ringmraw , ha ka jinglyngkhuit bad jinglehrain . Kito kiba shong ha Saanan kim nud ban mih shabar na ka nongbah jong ki . Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki briew jong ka Bethesel ki ïambriew , phin tip ba ym don jakarieh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia phi, me uba shong ha ka Saphir, uba don ka jingsngewlehrain jong me: u nongshong shnong jong u Zaanan um shym la mih ha ka jingsngewsih jong u Bethezel ; un pdiang na phi ia ka jinglong jong u.

en: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .
kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka long ka bym don jingmut , hynrei ha ka nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh . Katto katne ki briew kiba bha ki lah ban ïap katba kiwei pat ki dang im wat haba ki long kiba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei nga la iohi ha ki sngi jong ka jinglong ba sniew jong nga: don u briew uba hok uba jah noh ha ka hok jong u , bad don u briew uba sniew uba pynjlan ia ka jingim jong u ha ka jingsniew jong u .

en: Insomuch that the multitude wondered , when they saw the dumb to speak , the maimed to be whole , the lame to walk , and the blind to see : and they glorified the God of Israel .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la lyngngoh haba ki la ïohi ba ki bymnang kren ki kren , kiba khrew ki koit , kiba dkoh ki ïaid , bad kiba matlah ki ïohi , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u paidbah u la lyngngoh, haba ki la iohi ia u briew uba dum ban kren, uba la tyrkhong ban long uba pura, uba lyngkhuid ban iaid bad uba matlah ban iohi: bad ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars , and commanded Judah and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall worship before one altar , and burn incense upon it ?
kha: Dei ma u uba pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bad ki duwan bad nangta u ong ïa ki paid Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ban mane bad thang jingiwbih tang ha kawei ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u juh u Hesekaiah um shym la weng noh ia ki jaka ba jrong bad ki jingkhang jong u bad u la hukum ia u Judah bad ka Jerusalem da kaba ong: Phin mane ha khmat kawei ka jingkhang bad thang ia ka jingiwbih halor jong ka ?

en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .
kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien ngan tei ia me, bad me yn tei, ko nongleh kam sniew jong ki Israel: me sa pynitynnad biang da ki jainkup jong me, bad me leit shabar ha ki jingshad jong ki kiba pynkmen .

en: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields  ; for they are white already to harvest .
kha: Phi don ka jingong , ‘ Sa saw bnai bad nangta pat ka aïom ot .’ Hynrei nga ong ïa phi , to da khmih ïa ki lyngkha ; ki jingthung mynta ki la ih bad ki la dei ban ot !
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ong ba phi dang don saw bnai bad nangta ka wan ka jingot ? ha khmih , nga ong ha phi , Pynieng ia ki khmat jong phi bad peit ia ki lyngkha ; namar ki la nang lieh ban ot .

en: Because the palaces shall be forsaken  ; the multitude of the city shall be left  ; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever , a joy of wild asses , a pasture of flocks  ;
kha: Wat ïa ka ïingsyiem yn iehnoh bad ka nongbah kan long kynjah jar . Ki ïing bad ki jaka ba la tei kut kiba ïada ïa ki kin don hapdeng ka jingjot junom . Ki kada khlaw kin ïashang hangta , bad ki langbrot kin shem ki jaka phlang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba ki iing kin shah iehnoh ; ka jingbun briew jong ka nongbah kan sah ha ki kut bad ki tower kin long ki thliew junom , ka jingkmen jong ki kada khlaw , ka jaka ri masi ; .

en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , and out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh , ten cities .
kha: Kiwei pat kiba sah jong ka kur Kohath ki ïoh shiphew tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Ephraim , Dan , Manasseh ba sha Sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki khun u Kohath ki don shiphew tylli ki jaitbynriew Ephraim bad na ka jaitbynriew Dan bad na ka jaitbynriew Manasseh .

en: And his brethren said to him , Shalt thou indeed reign over us ? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us ? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba men sa long u syiem bad synshar ïa ngi ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki ong . Kumta ki la nang kham isih shuh shuh ïa u namar ki jingphohsniew jong u bad namar kaei kaba ba u la kren shaphang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki la ong ia u, Hato me dei shisha ban synshar halor jong ngi ? lane me dei shisha ban synshar halor jong ngi ? Bad ki la shun ia u kham bun na ka bynta ki jingphohsniew jong u bad na ka bynta ki ktien jong u .

en: That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .
kha: Nga ong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long uta u ban synshar na ka bynta jong nga ; men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban leh ; men hukum ïa ka Jerusalem ban tei biang bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban seng pat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka ong u Cyrus , U long u nongaplangbrot jong nga baroh: wat haba ong ha Jerusalem: Me la tei; bad ha ka tempi , Ka nongrim jong Me kan long .

en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?
kha: Kumno uno uno u lah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa ngi ha kane ka jingim jong ngi kaba lyngkot bad ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kumno ngi lah ban tip aïu kan jia ha ka pyrthei hadien ba ngi la ïap ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba tip ia kaei kaba bha na ka bynta u briew ha kane ka jingim , baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim ba la pynlut kum ka jingdum ? namar mano ba lah ban iathuh ia u briew kaei ka ban long hadien jong u hapoh ka sngi ?

en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest , Art not thou a seer ? return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz thy son , and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .
kha: Bad u la bteng da kaba ong shuh shuh ha u Sadok ,  Peit shane , khie ïalam noh ïa u Ahimaas , u khun jong me bad ïa u Jonathan u khun jong u Abiathar sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ruh ha u Sadok u lyngdoh, Hato me dei u nongpeitkai? leit phai noh sha ka shnong ha ka jingsuk, bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong phi bad phi, Ahimaas u khun jong me, bad u Jonathan u khun jong u Abiatar .

en: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u la don arphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaiah jong ka Libna .

en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .
kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Hato phi ithuh da shisha ïa nga bad tip nangno nga wan ? Ngam shym la wan da ka bor jong nga hi . Uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban , u long uba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la pyrta ia U Jisu ha ka tempi kumba u la hikai, u da ong, Phi baroh arngut phi tip ia nga, bad phi tip naei nga don: bad ngam wan na lade: hynrei uta uba la phah ia nga u long uba shisha, uba phim ithuh .

en: And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ki lyngkha bad ka ïaid nadien jong ki nongot , ka da tam ïa u kew uba ki ieh . Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba ka don ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Boas .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la leit noh bad ka la wan bad ka la ia tyngkhuh ha lyngkha hadien ki nongot: bad ka hap jong ka ka la long ban shai ha kawei ka bynta jong ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u Boaz uba long na ka jait jong u Elimelek .

en: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .
kha: Ïa ki tduh jingbah lah ban ïohi da uno uno uba ïeng pyrshah ha khmat ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hynrei ym nawei pat . ( Kita ki dieng jingbah ki dang don hangta haduh mynta . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sei ia ki dieng , ba la iohi ia ki tduh jong ki dieng ha ka jaka bakhuid ha khmat ka oracle , bad ym shym la iohi ia ki shabar: bad hangta ki don haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And he said , Hear thou therefore the word of the  Lord  : I saw the  Lord  sitting on his throne , and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .
kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei ba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong ha ka khet jong u ha bneng , lem bad ki angel jong u kiba ïeng hajan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai: Nga la iohi ia U Trai ba u shong ha ka khet jong u, bad ki shipai bneng baroh ki ieng hajan jong u ha ka liang kadiang bad sha ka liang kadiang jong u .

en: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour , and cities which ye built not , and ye dwell in them  ; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat .
kha: Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka khyndew ha kaba phim shym la trei bad ïa ki nongbah kiba phim shym la tei . Mynta phi shong phi sah hangta bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym thung , bad ki soh Olib na ki dieng kiba phim shym thung .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ia phi ia ka ri kaba phim shym la trei shitom, bad ki shnong kiba phim shym la tei, bad phi shong ha ki ; na ki kper sohjew bad ki kper olive kiba phim shym la thung .

en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country , Go into the harlot s house , and bring out thence the woman , and all that she hath , as ye sware unto her .
kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongsyntiat ,  Khie leit sha ka ïing jong ka nuti bad wan ïalam ïa ka bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka , kumba phi la kular ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la ong ha ki arngut ki briew kiba la leit shabar ri, To leit sha ka iing kaba sniew, bad to wanrah noh nangta ia kata ka kynthei bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don, kumba phi la sngap jar ia ka .

en: Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong : Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ïa kaei kaba nga la ong yn pyndep . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ki , Kumta ong U Trai Blei ; Ym don kawei ruh na ki ktien jong nga kaba la pynjlan shuh , hynrei ka ktien kaba nga la kren kan long , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar , who had made him swear by God : but he stiffened his neck , and hardened his heart from turning unto the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: U Sedekaïah u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba pynbor ïa u bad smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba un ïaineh ha u . Da kaba leh mutlop u kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban phai pat sha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ruh u la leh pyrshah ia u syiem Nebuchadnezzar uba la pynlong ia u ban smai da U Blei: hynrei u la pynkhih ia ka ryndang jong u bad u la pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u ban phai sha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki long na ka bynta jong phi , bad phi ïoh bynta ha ka jutang kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumba u la ong ha u Abraham , ‘ Lyngba ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa bad ka jutang kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi da kaba ong ha u Abraham , Bad ha u symbai jong me baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

en: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol ? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure ? wherefore are they cast out , he and his seed , and are cast into a land which they know not ?
kha: Nga la ong ,  Hato u syiem Jehoïakhin u la kylla long kum u khra uba la pait uba la bret noh bad u bym don ba kwah shuh mano mano ? Hato ka long kata balei ba ma u bad ïa ki khun jong u la ringmraw sha ka ri kaba kim tip ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato une u briew u dei u bleithaw ba la shah pynpra ? hato u dei u khiew ha kaba ym don jingsngewbha ? namar kata la bret noh ia ki , ma u bad u symbai jong u , bad la bret noh ia ki sha ka ri kaba kim tip ?

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , What seest thou , Jeremiah ? And I said , Figs  ; the good figs , very good  ; and the evil , very evil , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , me ïohi aïu ?  Nga jubab ,  Ki soh Dumbur . Kiwei kiba bha ki da bha shisha , bad kiwei kiba sniew ki da sniew shisha , haduh ba ym long bam shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga, Kaei kaba me iohi, ko Jeremaiah ? Bad nga la ong, Ki soh ki soh kiba bha, kiba bha shibun bad kiba sniew shibun, kiba ym lah ban bam, ki long kiba sniew haduh katta katta .

en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs , and with wonders , and with a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with great terror  ;
kha: Da ki kambah bad ki jingphylla kiba la pynsngewshyrkhei ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , me la pyndonkam ïa ka bor bad ka borbah jong me ban wallam ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la wanrah ia ki briew jong me Israel na ka ri Ijipt da ki dak bad ki jingphylla bad da ka kti kaba khlain bad da ka kti kaba la pynjrong bad da ka jingtieng kaba khraw;

en: Be merciful , O  Lord  , unto thy people Israel , whom thou hast redeemed , and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel s charge . And the blood shall be forgiven them .
kha: A Trai , map ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait na Ijipt . Map ïa ngi bad wat pynkit pop ha ngi namar ka jingpynïap ïa uta uba lui lui .’
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba isynei, ko Trai, ia ki briew jong me ki Israel, kiba me la siewspah, bad wat ai snam khlem pop ia ki briew jong me ki Israel . Bad ka snam kan long kaba map ia ki .

en: And as John fulfilled his course , he said , Whom think ye that I am ? I am not he . But , behold , there cometh one after me , whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose .
kha: Bad haba u Ïoannis u la jan pyndep ïa la ka jingtrei , u la ong ha u paidbah , ‘ Phi tharai ba nga dei uei ? Ngam long uta uba phi ïa-ap khmih . Hynrei to shahshkor ! U da wan hadien jong nga , bad ngam long uba bit ban loit ïa ki juti jong u na ki kjat jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u Ioannis u dang pyndep ia ka lynti jong u, u la ong, Mano ba phi pyrkhat ba nga long ? Ngam dei ma nga . Hynrei, ha khmih, u wan hadien jong nga, uba ki juti jong u ngam long uba bit ban pyllait .

en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi hi ba ki pynïap ïa ki khun jong nga kum ki jingkñia sha ki bleithaw , ki la wan sha ka Templ jong nga bad pyntngit ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ki la pyniap ia ki khun jong ki ha ki bleithaw jong ki, nangta ki la wan ha kajuh ka sngi ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga ban pynjah burom ia ka ; bad, ha khmih, kumta ki la leh hapdeng ka iing jong nga .

en: O  Lord  , thou knowest : remember me , and visit me , and revenge me of my persecutors  ; take me not away in thy longsuffering : know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  , me sngewthuh . To kynmaw ïa nga bad ïarap ïa nga . Shah ngan ïoh pynhiarkput halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga . Wat ym da ïaishah katta katta ïa ki kat ba kin jop ha kaba pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba ka dei na ka bynta jong me ba la ibeiñ ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, me tip: kynmaw ia nga, bad leit jngoh ia nga, bad to pynrem ia nga na ki nongpynshitom bein jong nga; wat shim noh ia nga ha ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong me: to tip ba na ka bynta jong me nga la shah pynshitom bein .

en: " Speaking on the occasion , the President said that the success of any nation state depends on how effectively it harnesses all the available resources at its disposal . " " "
kha: " Haba kren ha kane ka sngi , u President u la ong ba ka jingjop jong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka shong haduh katno ka pyndonkam hok ia ki jingdon jingem baroh kiba don ha ka jingdon jong ka . " " "
translated_en_to_kha: " Haba kren ha kane ka sngi , u President u la ong ba ka jingjop jong kano kano ka ri ka shong haduh katno ka pyndonkam bha ia ki jingdon jingem baroh kiba don ha ka jingpynduh jong ka . "

en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
kha: Nangta u Isaïah u phah ïa ka khubor kaba ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah kum ka jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Isaiah u khun u Amoz u la phah sha u Hesekaiah, u da ong: Kumta u ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel: Kata kaba me la duwai ha nga pyrshah ia u Sennakherb syiem Assyria nga la iohsngew .

en: When I therefore was thus minded , did I use lightness ? or the things that I purpose , do I purpose according to the flesh , that with me there should be yea yea , and nay nay ?
kha: Ha kane ka jingthmu , hato nga i kum u bymneh jingmut ? Haba nga pynlong ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , hato nga leh ïa ki da ki jingthmu ba khwan myntoi , kum uba la kloi ban ong  Ho-oid , ho-oid  bad  Em , em  ha kajuh ka por ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la pyrkhat kumta, hato nga la pyndonkam ia ka jingshai ? lane kiei kiei kiba nga thmu, hato nga thmu kat kum ka doh, ba bad nga dei ban don ka yea yea, bad ka nay Nay ?

en: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead , in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites , and of Og king of Bashan  ; and he was the only officer which was in the land .
kha: U Geber u khun jong u Uri : ka thain Gilead , kaba la synshar da u Sihon u syiem Amor bad u Og u syiem Bashan . Nalor kine khat-ar ngut , la don uwei u lat halor ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Geber u khun jong u Uri u la don ha ka ri Gilead , ha ka ri jong u syiem u Sihon u syiem u Amorit bad u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan; bad u long tang ma u uba don ha ka ri .

en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
kha: Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim tip ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , u briew uba la ïalam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta , thaw noh ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la ong ha nga, To leh ia ngi ki blei, ki ban leit ha khmat jong ngi: namar ia une u Moses, u briew uba la pynmih ia ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ngim ju leh ia kaei kaba jia ia u .

en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience , I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation , which shall come upon all the world , to try them that dwell upon the earth .
kha: Namar ba pha la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga ban shahshitom , nga ruh ngan ri sumar ïa pha ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar ka ban wan ha ka pyrthei ban tynjuh ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me la bat ia ka ktien jong ka jingshaniah jong nga , nga ruh ngan sumar ia me na ka kynta jong ka jingpynshoi kaban sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban tynjuh ia kita kiba shong ha ka khyndew .

en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .
kha: Ha khmat ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw , kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khet da saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kiba don ki khmat sha khmat bad shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha khmat ka khet la don ka duriaw kaba jylliew kum ka kristal: bad hapdeng ka khet , bad sawdong ka khet , ki don saw tylli ki mrad kiba dap da ki khmat ha khmat bad shadien .

en: O the hope of Israel , the saviour thereof in time of trouble , why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land , and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night ?
kha: Tang ma me , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; me long uta uba la pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingpynjot . Balei me long kum u nongwei ha ka ri jong ngi , kum u nongleit jingleit uba sah tang shi miet ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko ka jingkyrmen jong ki Israel , u nongpynim jong ka ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar , balei phi dei ban long kum u nongwei ha ka ri bad kum u briew uba leit jingleit uba phai noh ban sah shi miet ?

en: That by two immutable things , in which it was impossible for God to lie , we might have a strong consolation , who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us :
kha: Te , don kine ar tylli kiei kiei ki bym lah ban kylla bad ïa kiba U Blei um lah ban lamler . Kumta ïa ngi kiba la shem ka jingshngain ha u la nang pynshlur shuh shuh ban batskhem ïa kata ka jingkyrmen ïa kaba la buh ha khmat jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba da ar tylli kiei kiei ki bym lah ban kylla, ha kaba ym lah ban long ba U Blei un thiah , ngi lah ban don ka jingpyntngen kaba khlain , kiba la phet noh na ka bynta ka jaka rieh tngen ban bat ia ka jingkyrmen kaba la buh ha khmat jong ngi:

en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee : for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger , and hast cast me behind thy back :
kha: Me la leh ïa ki pop kiba khraw palat liam ban ïa kito kiba la synshar ha shuwa jong me . Me la kyntait ïa nga bad me la pynbitar lep ïa nga da kaba me thaw ïa ki bleithaw bad ki dur ba la shu saiñ ban mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la leh ia kaba sniew halor kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha khmat jong me: namar me la leit noh bad me la thaw ia me kiwei pat ki blei, bad ki dur ba la khleh lang, ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar, bad me la bret ia nga shadien jong me:

en: Bless ,  Lord  , his substance , and accept the work of his hands : smite through the loins of them that rise against him , and of them that hate him , that they rise not again .
kha: Ko  Trai  , to ïarap ïa ka jait jong ki ba kan nang khlaiñ ; To pdiang sngewbha kat ïa kaba ki pyndep , To pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ba kin ym khie khlieh shuh lano lano .
translated_en_to_kha: Kyrkhu, Trai, ia ka jinglong jong u, bad pdiang ia ka kam jong ki kti jong u: to sngap jar ia ki tyrpeng jong kito kiba kiew pyrshah ia u, bad na kita kiba shun ia u, ba kin ym kiew shuh .

en: I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof : now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples  ;
kha: Ai ba u syiem un don hynriewphew ngut ki mahadei , phraphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ki kynthei ba dang samla khlem ka jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , Ngan leit sha u dieng sohjew , ngan bat ia ki tnat jong u: mynta ruh ki bniat jong me kin long kum ki kynhun sohjew , bad ka jingsma jong ka shyntur jong me kum ki apple ; .

en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , ( for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt  ; )
kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban phet ïap na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat, uba dang don ha Ijipt, u la iohsngew ia kata, (namar u la phet noh na ka jingdon jong u syiem Solomon, bad u Jeroboan u la shong ha Ijipt ; )

en: I have overthrown some of you , as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah , and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Nga la pynjot katto katne na phi kumba nga la pynjot ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah . Kito na phi kiba la lait im ki long kum ka dieng barhem ba la sei na ka ding . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga ,  ong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynhap ia ki katto katne na phi, kumba U Blei u la pynhap ia ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah, bad phi la long kum ka ding kaba la tyrkhong na ka jingthang: hynrei phim shym la wan phai sha nga , ong U Trai .
