en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it , and put them in the four corners thereof  ; and two rings shall be in the one side of it , and two rings in the other side of it .
kha: Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men bret saw tylli ki ryntieh ksiar na ka bynta jong ka, bad men buh ia ki ha ki saw tylli ki tduh jong ka ; bad ar tylli ki ryntieh kin don ha kawei ka liang jong ka , bad ar tylli ki ryntieh ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka .

en: And I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land : and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness , and sleep in the woods .
kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki kaba pynskhem ïa ka jingshongshngain jong ki . Ngan beh noh ïa ki mrad kynsha baroh na ka ri , khnang ba ki langbrot jong nga kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ki jaka phlang bad thiah ha ki khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong bad ki ia ka jutang jong ka jingsuk, bad ngan pynlong ia ki mrad kiba sniew ban sangeh noh na ka ri: bad kin shong suk ha ka ri khlaw bad kin thiah ha khlaw .

en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka lynti bah pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kano kano ka nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata me tei ia ka jaka ba pawnam jong me ha ka khlieh jong ki lynti baroh, bad me pynlong ia ka jaka ba jrong jong me ha man la ki lynti ; bad ngam shym la long kum ka jaka ri khunswet, ha kata me la sngewsih;

en: For thus hath the  Lord  of hosts said , Hew ye down trees , and cast a mount against Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited  ; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la hukum ïa kine ki syiem ban khet ïa ki dieng bad ban shna ki kynton khnang ban kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem . U la ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa kane ka nongbah namar ka la dap da ka jingbanbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid u la ong, Pynkhih ia ki dieng, bad bret ia u lum pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem: kane ka long ka nongbah ban leit jngoh ; ka long ka jingshah lehbein pura hapdeng jong ka .

en: And the angel took the censer , and filled it with fire of the altar , and cast it into the earth : and there were voices , and thunderings , and lightnings , and an earthquake .
kha: Nangta uta u angel u la shim ïa kata ka pliang thang jingiwbih , u la pyndap ïa ka da ki rnga ding barhem na ka duwan , bad u la bret ïa ka halor ka khyndew . La don ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ki jingthaba leilieh , bad u jumai .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la shim ia ka umphniang bad u la pyndap ia ka da ka ding jong ka almari bad u la bret ia ka ha ka khyndew: bad ki la don ki sur bad ki jingsawa bad ki jingshai bad ka jingkhynñiuh jumai .

en: Then Asa the king took all Judah  ; and they carried away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha was building  ; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah .
kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u lum ïa ki rangbah na baroh sawdong ka Judah bad hukum ïa ki ban rah noh ïa ki maw bad ki dieng sawdong kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ha Ramah , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban tei kut ïa ki nongbah ka Geba bad Mispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asa u la shim ia u Judah baroh bad ki la rah noh ia ki maw jong ka Rama bad ki dieng jong ka, ha kaba u Basa u dang tei ; bad u la tei da kata ka Geba bad ka Mizpah .

en: And the  Lord  thy God will circumcise thine heart , and the heart of thy seed , to love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , that thou mayest live .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi kiba kohnguh hukum , khnang ba phin ieit ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad ba phin ïaishong ha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong me un ot ia ka dohnud jong me bad ia ka dohnud jong u symbai jong me, ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh, ba me lah ban im .

en: I went out full , and the  Lord  hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the  Lord  hath testified against me , and the Almighty hath afflicted me ?
kha: Mynba nga mihnoh nangne , nga don kyrhai , hynrei U  Trai  u la wallam thylli ïa nga . Balei yn khot ïa nga ka Naomi haba U  Trai  Uba Khrawbor u la pynrem bad phah jingjynjar ha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la mih noh pura, bad U Trai u la wanrah biang ia nga sha iing thylli: balei te phi khot ia nga u Naomi , haba phi iohi ba U Trai u la sakhi pyrshah ia nga , bad U Blei Baroh u la pynshitom ia nga ?

en: Former prime minister Manmohan Singh said it was time for all opposition parties to shed their differences and move forward unitedly  " to save " " sovereignty and democracy . "
kha: Myntri Rangbahduh barim u Manmohan Singh u la ong ba ka la dei ka por ia baroh ki seng pyrshah ban weng noh ia ki jingiapher jingmut jong ki bad ban iaid shakhmat da kawei  " ban pynim ia ka jingsynshar bad ka synshar paidbah . "
translated_en_to_kha: U myntri rangbahduh barim u Manmohan Singh u la ong ba ka la dei ka por na ka bynta baroh ki liang pyrshah ban pynkhih ia ki jingiapher jong ki bad ban iaid shakhmat da ka jingiatylli " ban pynim " " ia ka jingsynshar bad ka synshar paidbah ."

en: Brethren , I write no new commandment unto you , but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning . The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane ka hukum kaba nga thoh sha phi kam long kaba thymmai ; ka long ka hukum kaba rim , kata kaba phi la ïoh naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ka hukum barim ka long ka khubor kaba phi la lah ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko para bangeit, ngam thoh ia ka hukum kaba thymmai ha phi, hynrei ka hukum kaba rim kaba phi la don naduh kaba sdang . Ka hukum kaba rim ka long ka ktien kaba phi la iohsngew naduh kaba sdang .

en: Seek ye out of the book of the  Lord  , and read : no one of these shall fail , none shall want her mate : for my mouth it hath commanded , and his spirit it hath gathered them .
kha: To wad ha ka kitab jong U  Trai  ïa ki jingthaw ba-im bad pule ïa kaei ba ka ong . Yn ym don tang kawei ruh na kine ki jingthaw ka ban jah noh , bad yn ym don tang kawei ruh ka ban ym don lok . U  Trai  u la hukum ba kan long kumta ; ma u hi da lade un wallam lang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To wad na ka Kitab U Trai, bad to pule: ym don uwei ruh na kine u ban duh: namar ka shyntur jong nga ka la hukum, bad ka mynsiem jong u ka la lum ia ki .

en: As he did to the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , when he destroyed the Horims from before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead even unto this day :
kha: U  Trai  u la leh kumjuh na ka bynta ki Edom , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , kiba shong ha ri lum Edom . U pynjot ïa ki Hor , kumta ki Edom ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shongsah hangta haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u la leh ia ki khun u Iso kiba shong ha Seir , haba u la pynjot ia ki Horim na khmat jong ki ; bad ki la jop ia ki, bad ki la shong ha ka jaka jong ki haduh kine ki sngi:

en: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .
kha: Mynta ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khyndai , ka sngi ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jia naduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrkhat mynta naduh kane ka sngi shaneng, naduh ka sngi kaba saw bad arphew jong u bnai kaba hynniew, wat naduh ka sngi ba la buh ia ka nongrim jong ka tempi U Trai, pyrkhat ia ka .

en: And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah s wife died  ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , ka tnga jong u Judah ka la ïap . Hadien ba u la pyndep ïa ka por ka jingïam sngewsih , ma u lem bad u paralok jong u , u Hirah uba na Adullam ki la ïaleit sha Timnah , ha kaba la khap shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por ka khun jong u Shua Judah ka la iap; bad u Judah u la shah pyntngen, bad u la leit sha ki nongshong shnong jong u ha Timna, ma u bad u paralok jong u u Hirah u Adullamite .

en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .
kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la wan na Judia sha Galilaïa , u la leit sha u bad kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha Kapernam bad ban pynkhiah ïa u khun jong u , uba don ha tmier ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la iohsngew ba U Jisu u la mih na Judaea sha Galilaia, u la leit sha u bad u la kyrpad ia u ba un wan hiar bad pynkoit ia la u khun: namar u la jan iap .

en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself : he that believeth not God hath made him a liar  ; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son .
kha: Kumta uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei u don ïa kane ka jingphla ha ka dohnud jong u hi ; hynrei uno uno u bymngeit ha U Blei , la pynlong ïa u , uba lamler , namar um shym la ngeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang U Khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba ngeit ia U Khun U Blei u don ka sakhi ha lade: uta u bym ngeit ia U Blei u la pynlong ia u u nonglamler ; namar ba um ngeit ia ka jingthoh ba U Blei u la ai shaphang u Khun jong u .

en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno uba ai dih wat shi khuri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbud jong nga namar ba u dei u nongbud jong nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba ai um ia uwei na kine kiba rit tang ha ka kyrteng jong u synran , shisha nga ong ha phi , un ym duh ia ka bainong jong u .

en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them  ; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ïa ka jingsop kaba shapoh bad kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ka pyrda jong ka jingkhang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh laiphew snem shaneng haduh sanphew snem to khein ia ki baroh kiba rung ban leh ia ka jingshakri, ban leh ia ka kam ha ka iingjain jong ka balang .

en: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .
kha: Katba baroh ki dang ïa-peit , uta u briew u la ïeng joit , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad mar kumta hi u la leit noh . Baroh ki la ïa-sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi kum kane kaei kaei !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng mardor, u la shim ia ka jingthiah, bad u la leit sha khmat jong ki baroh;

en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me , because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .
kha: Sa shisien la ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa kham jan sha nga , namar nga la kha lai ngut ki khun shynrang ïa u  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pun khun biang, bad ka la kha khun shynrang ; bad ka la ong: Mynta ka por un iasoh bad nga, namar nga la kha ia u lai ngut ki khun shynrang: namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Lebi .

en: The  Lord  will be terrible unto them : for he will famish all the gods of the earth  ; and men shall worship him , every one from his place , even all the isles of the heathen .
kha: U  Trai  un pynshyrkhei ïa ki . Un pynhiar ïa ki blei jong ka pyrthei sha ka bym long ei ei , bad kumta kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kan mane ïa u , kawei kawei ha la ka jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un long uba shyrkhei ia ki: namar un pyniap ia ki blei baroh jong ka khyndew bad ki briew kin mane ia u, uwei pa uwei na ka jaka jong u, wat ia ki dujok baroh jong ki nongwei .

en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword , and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds : and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Ïa ki shipai bakynsai tam jong u yn pynïap ha ka thma bad ïa kiba lait im yn pynsakma ha ki phang baroh . Te phan tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongleh kam sniew jong u baroh kin hap da ka waitlam, bad kito kiba sah kin sa jah noh sha ki Iyer baroh: bad phin sa tip ba nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof : for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure , saith the  Lord .
kha: Halor ki tnum ïing baroh ha Moab bad ha baroh ki jaka paidbah ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingïam sngewsih , namar nga la pynpait ïa ka Moab kum u khra uba ym don shuh mano mano ban kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan don ka jingsngewsih ha ki iing jong ka Moab baroh kawei: namar nga la pynpra ia ka Moab kum ka lieng ha kaba ym don jingsngewbha, ong U Trai .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethims , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .
kha: Bad kumta nga pynbna ba ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad ban pynjah syndon ïa ki . Ngan pynjot ïa kiba sah baroh kiba dang im ha ki jaka madan ka Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih , ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor ki Philistia , bad ngan ot noh ia ki Kheriotim , bad ngan pynjot ia kaba sah jong ka rud duriaw .

en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .
kha: Un shim ïa me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ka ri kaba kham khraw . Men ïap hangta hajan ki kali ïapom kiba me , me la sngewsarong . Me long ka jingjahburom ïa ka longïing jong u kynrad jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Un sa kylla shisha bad un sa bret ia me kum ka bol sha ka ri kaba heh: hangta men iap , bad hangta ki kali jong ka burom jong me kin long ka jinglehrain jong ka iing jong u kynrad jong me .

en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . And his mother s name was Nehushta , the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .
kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Nehushta , ka khun jong u Elnathan uba na Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoichin u la don shiphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar bad u la synshar ha Jerusalem lai bnai . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Nehushet , ka khun jong u Elnathan na Jerusalem .

en: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .
kha: Ka lyer ka beh kat sha kaba ka mon ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba ka pynmih , hynrei mem tip nangno ba ka wan lane shaei ba ka leit . Ka long kumta ïa uwei pa uwei ïa uba la kha na U Mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Iyer ka beh shano shano ruh, bad me iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka, hynrei ngam lah ban tip naei ka wan, bad shano ka leit: kumjuh ruh uwei pa uwei uba la kha na U Mynsiem .

en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .
kha: Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa ka nongbah kaba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kiew sha jrong jong ka khyndew, bad ki la ker sawdong ia ka shnong jong ki riewkhuid sawdong: bad ka ding ka la wan hiar na U Blei na bneng , bad ka la bam ia ki .

en: I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .
kha: Ha khmat jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist Jisu bad jong ki angel to kohnguh ïa kine ki jinghikai khlem jingujor lane khlem shah shiliang ïano ïano ha kano kano kaba me leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kynnoh ia me ha khmat U Blei bad U Trai Jisu Khrist bad ki angel ba la jied, ba me peit ia kine kiei kiei khlem da sngewtynnad iwei ia iwei pat, khlem da leh ei ei da kaba sngew shiliang .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani , who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoshaphat u la leh , naduh kaba sdang jong ka jingsynshar jong u haduh kaba kut , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani  , kaba long shi bynta jong  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoshaphat, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha khmih la thoh ha ka Kitab u Jehu u khun Hanani uba la kdew ha ka Kitab ki syiem Israel .

en: But thou , O  Lord  , knowest me : thou hast seen me , and tried mine heart toward thee : pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .
kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me ithuh ïa nga ; me ïohi kaei ba nga leh , bad kumno nga la ieit ïa me . To paring sharud ïa kine ki rangbah basniew kum ïa ki langbrot ki ban shah ot doh ; to sumar ïa ki tad haduh ba ka dei ka por ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, ko Trai, me tip ia nga: me la iohi ia nga, bad me la pyrshang ia ka dohnud jong nga sha me: to tan noh ia ki kum ki langbrot na ka bynta ka jingpyniap , bad pynkhreh ia ki na ka bynta ka sngi pyniap .

en: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , thus shall ye say to him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , As touching the words which thou hast heard  ;
kha: Na ka bynta u syiem hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha u syiem Judah uba la phah ia phi ban kylli ia U Trai , kumta phin ong ha u , Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , Kumba ka ktah ia ki ktien kiba me la iohsngew;

en: And he said , Peace be to you , fear not : your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them .
kha: Uta u shakri u ong ,  Wat khuslai . Wat sheptieng ruh . Dei U Blei jong phi , U Blei jong u kpa jong phi , uba la thep ïa ki pisa ha ki byrni jong phi na ka bynta jong phi . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka dor ba phi la siew .  Nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Simeon sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ka jingsuk ha phi, wat tieng: U Blei jong phi, bad U Blei jong u kpa jong phi, u la ai ia phi ia ka spah ha ki tyrpeng jong phi: Nga la don ka pisa jong phi . Bad u la wanrah ia u Simeon sha ki .

en: So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
kha: Ngam shym la kylliang sopti wat ha ka por miet , lymne mano mano na ki paralok jong nga , lymne ki shakri jong nga , lymne ki nongap phira jong nga . Bad ma ngi baroh ngi bat ïa ki tiar ïaleh ha ka kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ym ma nga, ne ki hynmen jong nga, ne ki shakri jong nga, ne ki briew kiba la bud ia nga, ym don uwei ruh na ngi uba la weng noh ia ki jain jong ngi, da kaba pynim ia kata baroh kawei .

en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days , and keep the charge of the  Lord  , that ye die not : for so I am commanded .
kha: Phi dei ban sah ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ miet la bad sngi haduh hynñiew sngi , ban leh ïa kata kaba U  Trai  u la hukum . Lada phim leh kumta , phin ïap . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phin sah ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingmane miet bad ka jingiaseng hynriew sngi bad ka jingkitkhlieh jong U Trai, ba phin ym iap: namar kumta nga la hukum .

en: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .
kha: Haba ki la dep duwai , ka jaka ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ka la khynñiuh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei da ka jingshlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la duwai , kata ka jaka ka la khih ha kaba ki la ialum lang bad baroh ki la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad ki la kren ia ka ktien U Blei da ka jingshlur .

en: And a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches going out of it .
kha: Don kawei ka shata syntiew harum ki lai jur ki tnat kiba mih na u diengpynïeng sharak .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka knop hapoh ar tylli ki tnat jong kajuh , bad ka knop hapoh ar tylli ki tnat jong kajuh , bad ka knop hapoh ar tylli ki tnat jong kajuh , kat kum ki hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na ka .

en: And he turned back , and looked on them , and cursed them in the name of the  Lord . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood , and tare forty and two children of them .
kha: U Elisha u phai dien , u la khmih da ka jingbitar ïa ki , bad u la tim ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai . Nangta ar tylli ki dngiem kynthei ki la wan mih na khlaw bad ki la patar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki sawphew ar ngut ki khynnah shynrang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai shadien bad u la peit ia ki bad u la tim ia ki ha ka kyrteng U Trai . Bad la mih arngut ki khun ki kti na u dieng bad ki khun ki kti ki long sawphew arngut ki khun jong ki .

en: And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .
kha: Ngan ai ha me , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kane ka ri ha kaba mynta me long u nongwei . Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei kan long ka jingïohkynti junom jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me ; bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ha u symbai jong me hadien jong me, ka ri ha kaba me long u nongwei, ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei, na ka bynta ka jinglong bymjukut ; bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .

en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore , or the price of a dog , into the house of the  Lord  thy God for any vow : for even both these are abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Nalor kata , ym dei ban wanrah ïa ka kamai nuti , la ka dei ka jong u shynrang ne ka kynthei , sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kum ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai , namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ki nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat wanrah ia ka bainong jong u nongkhaii met ne ka dor jong u kulai ha iing U Trai U Blei jong me na ka bynta kano kano ka jingkular: namar wat kine baroh ar ki long kiba sngewsih ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth  ; and I have set thee so : thou wast upon the holy mountain of God  ; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire .
kha: Nga buh ïa u angel ba-itriem hangta ban ap phira ïa me . Me la shong ha u lumbah bakhuid jong nga bad me la ïaid hapdeng ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long u cherub ba la pynsleh uba tap ; bad nga la buh ia me kumta: me la don ha u lum bakhuid jong U Blei; me la iaid shaneng bad shapoh hapdeng ki maw ding .

en: And his power shall be mighty , but not by his own power : and he shall destroy wonderfully , and shall prosper , and practise , and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people .
kha: Un long uba khlaiñ — hynrei ym da ka bor jong u hi . Un pynlong ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei bad un jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh . Un wallam ka jingjot halor ki rangbah kiba donbor bad halor ki briew jong U Blei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bor jong u kan long kaba khlain bor, hynrei ym da ka bor jong u hi: bad un pynjot phylla, bad un roi bad un leh , bad un pynjot ia kiba khlain bad ki briew kiba khuid .

en: The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .
kha: Haba U Khun U Briew u la wan , u la bam bad u la dih , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Ha khmih ïa une u briew ! U long uba lalot bad u nongdih , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait !’ Pynban , ïa ka jingstad Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da kiba mih na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Khun u briew u la wan bam bad dih, bad ki ong , Ha khmih u briew uba bam dohkha bad u nongrah wain , u paralok jong ki nongleh kam sniew bad ki nongpop . Hynrei ka jingstad ka long kaba hok ia ki khun jong ka .

en: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains , and the chains had been plucked asunder by him , and the fetters broken in pieces : neither could any man tame him .
kha: bunsien ïa ki kjat bad ki kti jong u la teh da ki kynjri , hynrei man ka por u bthat ïa ki kynjri bad pynpait ïa ki nar ha ki kjat jong u . U khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ym don uba lah ban pyndem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u la shah teh bunsien bad ki kynjri bad ki kynjri, bad ki kynjri ki la shah rong noh ha u, bad ki kynjri ki la tyrkhong ha ki bynta: ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pynkhih ia u.

en: And he said unto them , Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day , which ye shall command your children to observe to do , all the words of this law .
kha: u ong ,  Sumar bha ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ïathuh ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi , ba ki ruh kin ïai kohnguh ïa baroh ki jinghikai jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , To buh ia ki dohnud jong phi ha ki ktien baroh kiba nga pynshisha hapdeng jong phi ha kane ka sngi , kiba phin hukum ia ki khun jong phi ban sumar , ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum .

en: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .
kha: Ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa u Lum Hermon , ka Salekah , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh ki pud jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , bad shiteng jong ka Gilead haduh ka ri jong u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon .
translated_en_to_kha: U la synshar ha u lum Hermon, bad ha u Slakh, bad ha u Basan baroh, haduh u pud u sam jong ki Geshur bad ki Maachath, bad shiteng Gilead, u pud u sam jong u syiem Heshbon .

en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .
kha: Suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men tap ia ka da ka ksiar kaba khuid, ka tduh jong ka bad ki liang jong ka sawdong sawdong .

en: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt , and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king  ; who slew him with the sword , and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people .
kha: Ki la wallam pat ïa u sha u syiem Jehoïakim , uba la phah pynïap ïa u bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ka jaka tep paidbah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ialam noh ia u Urijah na Ijipt bad ki la wanrah ia u ha u syiem uba la pyniap ia u da ka waitlam bad ki la bret ia ka met iap jong u ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba rit paid .

en: And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .
kha: U Elijah u hukum bad ong ,  Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; wat ai ba uno uno na ki un lait phet !  Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki baroh , bad u Elijah u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka wah Kishon bad pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha ki, To shim ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong u Baal to ym ai ba uwei ruh na ki un lait im . Ki la shim ia ki: bad u Elijah u la wanrah ia ki shapoh wah Kishon , bad u la pyniap ia ki hangta .

en: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
kha: Kumta u Adonisedek u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Hoham u syiem ka Hebron , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syiem ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Eglon :
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u Syiem u la phah sha u syiem u Hoham u syiem u Heron bad sha u syiem u Piram u syiem u Jarmut bad sha u syiem u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u Jabiah u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u Jabiah u u syiem u Jabiah u la phah sha u syiem u

en: They shall not hunger nor thirst  ; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them : for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them , even by the springs of water shall he guide them .
kha: Kin ym shahthngan lane sliang shuh . Ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad ka ri shyiap kin ym pynjynjar ïa ki , namar yn ïalam ïa ki da uta uba ieit ïa ki . Un ïalam ïa ki sha ki umpohliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym iap ne sliang; lymne ka jingshit ne ka sngi kan ym pynkhih ia ki: namar uta uba isynei ia ki un ialam ia ki, wat da ki tyllong um ruh un ialam ia ki .

en: And Joshua called for all Israel , and for their elders , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers , and said unto them , I am old and stricken in age :
kha: kumta u khot ïa ki Israel baroh , ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u paidbah , bad u ong ,  Nga la tymmen bha mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la khot ia ki Israel baroh, bad ia ki rangbah jong ki, bad ia ki khlieh jong ki, bad ia ki nongbishar jong ki, bad ia ki rangbah jong ki, bad u la ong ha ki: Nga la tymmen bad nga la tyrkhong ha ka rta:

en: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you , ye said unto me , Nay  ; but a king shall reign over us : when the  Lord  your God was your king .
kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohi ba u Nahash u syiem Ammon u wan tur pyrshah ïa phi , phi la kyntait ïa U  Trai  kum u syiem jong phi bad phi ong ha nga , ‘ Ngi kwah syiem ban synshar ïa ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi la iohi ba u Nahas u syiem jong ki khun Ammon u la wan pyrshah ia phi, phi la ong ha nga: Em; hynrei u syiem un synshar halor jong ngi: haba U Trai U Blei jong phi u long u syiem jong phi .

en: And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,
kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kiba la ïashim bynta ha ka jingawria bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka kin lynñiar bad ïam na ka bynta ka nongbah haba ki ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba bam duh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ka khyndew kiba la leh ia ka kam sniew bad kiba la im sngewbha bad ka , kin iam ia ka bad kin iam na ka bynta jong ka haba kin iohi ia ka tdem jong ka jingthang jong ka .

en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and see : all they gather themselves together , they come to thee : thy sons shall come from far , and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side .
kha: Khmih sawdong jong pha bad peit kaei kaba jia : Ki briew jong pha kin ïalumlang ban wan phai sha ïing ; ki khun shynrang jong pha kin wan na sha jngai bah , bad ïa ki khun kynthei jong pha yn shu rah kum ïa ki khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong me sawdong, bad peit: baroh ki ia lum lang ia lade, ki wan sha me: ki khun shynrang jong me kin wan na jngai , bad ki khun kynthei jong me kin shah sumar ha ka liang jong me .

en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .
kha: Ki long baroh kiba la ïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïap ha ka thma bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa u lum jingtep jong ka . Pynban shisien ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingtep jong ka ki long kiba la buh ha ki liang jong ka thliew , bad ka kynhun jong ka ka long sawdong sawdong ka jingtep jong ka: baroh ki la shah pyniap , ki la hap da ka waitlam , kaba la pynmih ia ka jingtieng ha ka ri jong kiba im .

en: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph , another piece . After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber .
kha: U Hananaïah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Hanun , u khun bahynriew jong u Salaph , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka jingtrei kaba ar jong ki . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Hananiah u khun jong u Sheemaiah, bad u Hanun u khun ba hynriew jong u Saph, kawei pat ka bynta . Hadien jong u u la pynbha ia u Meshullam u khun u Beriah ha ka kamra jong u .

en: Hear this word , ye kine of Bashan , that are in the mountain of Samaria , which oppress the poor , which crush the needy , which say to their masters , Bring , and let us drink .
kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki kynthei ka Samaria , kiba nang sngaid kum ki masi ba la bsa bha jong ka Bashan , kiba lehbeiñ ïa kiba tlot , kiba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk , bad kiba dawa ba ki tnga jong phi kin pynbiang ïa phi da ka kyiad !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane ka ktien, phi ki jong u Bashan, kiba don ha u lum Samaria, kiba pynshitom ia kiba duk, kiba pynkhih ia kiba duk, kiba ong ha ki kynrad jong ki, To wanrah ia ngi bad to ngin ia dih .

en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?
kha: Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poi ha Bethlehem . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba hangta ki la pyrta ,  Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki arngut ki la leit haduh ba kin da poi ha Bethlehem . Bad ka la jia ba ki la poi ha Bethlehem , ba ka shnong baroh kawei ka la khih sawdong jong ki , bad ki la ong: Hato kane ka dei ka Naomi ?

en: If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
kha: Haba u briew u kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane u smai ban kyndiah na kaei re kaei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndep lut ïa baroh kaba u la ong ban pyndep .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u kular ha U Trai ne u smai ban teh ia ka mynsiem jong u da ka bond ; un ym pynkhein ia ka ktien jong u , un leh kat kum kaei kaei kaba mih na ka shyntur jong u .

en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :
kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ban pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ïa ka jingim kaba u la khot ïa phi ban im . Ai ba un pyndap da ka bor jong u ïa ka jingkwah jong phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingbha bad ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ka jingngeit jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ruh ngi duwai na ka bynta jong phi man ka por, ba U Blei jong ngi un khein ia phi ba phi long uba bit ia kane ka jingkhot, bad un pyndep ia ka jingsngewbha jong u baroh, bad ka kam jong ka jingngeit da ka bor:

en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say , A measure of wheat for a penny , and three measures of barley for a penny  ; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum ka sur kaba wan napdeng ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im kaba la ong ,  Shi kilo u kew na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi , bad lai kilo u barli na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi . Hynrei wat pynjot noh ïa ki dieng Olib bad ïa ki bri sohwaiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur hapdeng ki saw tylli ki mrad ba ong: Ka jingthew ia u kew na ka bynta ka pisa , bad lai tylli ki jingthew jong u barli na ka bynta ka pisa ; bad peit wat pynmong ia ka umphniang bad ka wain .

en: Behold , the money , which we found in our sacks  mouths , we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan : how then should we steal out of thy lord s house silver or gold ?
kha: Phi tip ba ngi la wanrah biang sha phi na Kanaan ïa kito ki pisa ba ngi lap ha khlieh ki byrni jong ngi . Balei keiñ ngin leit tuh kat ïa ka rupa ne ksiar na ka ïing u kynrad jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka pisa kaba ngi lap ha ki shyntur jong ngi, ngi la wanrah biang sha me na ka ri Kana: kumno te ngin tuh na ka rupa ne ksiar jong u kynrad jong me ?

en: And while he yet talked with them , behold , the messenger came down unto him : and he said , Behold , this evil is of the  Lord   ; what should I wait for the  Lord  any longer ?
kha: Katba un da dep kren ïa kane , haba u syiem u wan poi bad u la ong ,  U long U  Trai  uba la wallam ïa kane ka jingjynjar ha ngi ! Balei ba ngan ap slem ïa u ban leh ei ei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang ia kren bad ki, ha khmih u nonglam khubor u la wan hiar sha u : bad u la ong: Ha khmih kane ka jingsniew ka long na U Trai ; kaei kaba nga dei ban ap shuh ia U Trai ?

en: Thus shalt thou say unto him , The  Lord  saith thus  ; Behold , that which I have built will I break down , and that which I have planted I will pluck up , even this whole land .
kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la pyntwa noh ïa kaei kaba nga la tei bad rat noh ïa kaei kaba nga la thung . Ngan leh ïa kane ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta to ong ha u, U Trai u ong kumta ; Ha khmih, ia kaba nga la tei ngan pynpra noh, bad ia kaba nga la thung ngan sa kheit noh, wat ia kane ka ri baroh kawei .

en: And it came to pass at the seven years  end , that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines : and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land .
kha: Ynda la kut kita ki hynñiew snem , ka la wan phai sha Israel bad ka la leit sha u syiem ban kyrpad ïa u ban pynphai biang sha ka ïa ka ïing bad ka khyndew jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki hynriew snem , kata ka kynthei ka la leit phai noh na ka ri Philistia: bad ka la leit sha u syiem na ka bynta ka iing jong ka bad na ka bynta ka ri jong ka .

en: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow , nor her that is put away : but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel , or a widow that had a priest before .
kha: Uno uno u lyngdoh um lah ban shongkurim ïa ka briew ba la iehnoh tnga ; un shongkurim tang ïa ka theisotti Israel lane ïa ka riewkynthei jong uwei pat u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym shim na ka bynta ki tnga jong ki ia ka kynthei kaba la shah kyntait: hynrei kin shim ia ki kynthei na u symbai jong ka iing Israel , ne ka kynthei kaba la shah kyntait mynshuwa .

en: And when he had apprehended him , he put him in prison , and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him  ; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people .
kha: Hadien ba la kem ïa u , ïa u Petros la thep ha phatok , ha kaba la aiti ïa u ban ap phira da ki saw tylli ki kynhun kiba kawei kawei ka don saw ngut ki shipai . U Herod u la thmu ban bishar ha khmat u paidbah hadien ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda u la sngewthuh ia u, u la buh ia u ha phatok, bad u la aiti ia u ha ki saw tylli ki shipai ban buh ia u ; da kaba thmu hadien ka Easter ban wanrah ia u sha ki briew .

en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho , unto the water of Jericho on the east , to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth–el ,
kha: Ïa u pud bashaphang shathie jong ka ri la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ; u sdang na ka Jordan hajan ka Jerikho , ha ka bynta kaba sha mihngi jong ki umpohliew ka Jerikho , bad u suh sha ka ri shyiap . U suh na ka Jerikho artet sha ka ri lum haduh ka Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bynta jong ki khun u Joseph ka la hap na Jordan da u Jerikho, haduh ka um Jerikho shaphang mihngi, haduh ka ri khlaw kaba kiew na Jerikho baroh kawei ka lum Bethesel .

en: O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , that dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth : thou hast made heaven and earth .
kha: A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba shong ha ka khet shajrong ki kherub , me marwei me long U Blei , uba synshar ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei . Me thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai jong ki paid, ko Blei jong ki Israel, uba shong hapdeng ki cherubim, me long U Blei, wat tang ma me hi, na ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew: me la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Behold , thou art with child , and shalt bear a son , and shalt call his name Ishmael  ; because the  Lord  hath heard thy affliction .
kha: Phan sa ïoh khun shynrang , bad phan khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , namar U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud sngew jynjar jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha ka: Ha khmih me la kha khun bad men kha khun shynrang bad men khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Ismael ; namar U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka jingjynjar jong me .

en: Hear , O earth : behold , I will bring evil upon this people , even the fruit of their thoughts , because they have not hearkened unto my words , nor to my law , but rejected it .
kha: To shahshkor , ko pyrthei ! Kum ka jingpynshitom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nga wallam ka jingjot halor kine ki briew , namar ki la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki ktien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap, ko khyndew: ha khmih ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor kane ka jaitbynriew, wat ia u soh jong ki jingpyrkhat jong ki, namar kim shym la sngap ia ki ktien jong nga, ne ia ka hukum jong nga, hynrei ki la kyntait ia ka .

en: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven , and came to the land of Judah , to Gedaliah , unto Mizpah , and gathered wine and summer fruits very much .
kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh na ki jaka ba la pynsakma ïa ki bad ki la wan phai pat sha Judah . Ki la wan sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah , bad hangta ki la ïalum shibun bah ka waiñ bad ki soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ki Jiw baroh ki la leit phai noh na ki jaka baroh ha kaba ki la shah beh noh, bad ki la poi sha ka ri Judah, sha Gedaliah, Mizpah, bad ki la lum ia ki soh wain bad ki soh slap shibun .

en: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him , Number now , and see who is gone from us . And when they had numbered , behold , Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there .
kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  Ñiew ïa ki shipai bad wad uei uba jah .  Ki leh kumta , bad ki shem ba u Jonathan bad u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u kim don .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Saul ha ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, "Ko nombar mynta, bad peit mano ba la jah noh na ngi . Bad haba ki la khein , ha khmih u Jonathan bad u nongrah tiar ialeh jong u kim shym la don hangta .

en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying , the fire came down from heaven , and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices  ; and the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .
kha: Haba u syiem Solomon u la dep ban duwai , ka ding ka wan hiar na bneng bad ka thang duh ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh , bad ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka pyndap ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Solomon u la pyndep ia ka jingduwai, ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng , bad ka la bam ia ka jingainguh thang bad ki jingknia ; bad ka burom U Trai ka la pyndap ia ka iing .

en: When ye go , ye shall come unto a people secure , and to a large land : for God hath given it into your hands  ; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth .
kha: Ynda phi poi hangta , phin shem ba ki briew kim suba sniew ei ei . Ka long ka ri kaba heh , ka don lut kiei kiei kiba u briew u lah ban kwah , bad U Blei u la ai ïa ka ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba phi leit, phin wan sha ka ri kaba shngain, bad sha ka ri kaba heh: namar U Blei u la ai ha ki kti jong phi; ka jaka ha kaba ym don jingduna ei ei kaba don ha ka khyndew .

en: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south : also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision  ; but they shall fall .
kha: Te shibun ki briew kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ijipt . Bad katto katne ki rangbah thombor na ka jaitbynriew jong me , ko Daniel , kin ïeng ïaleh pyrshah namar ka jingïohipaw kaba ki la lah ïohi , hynrei kin sa shahjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita ki por bun kin ieng pyrshah ia u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi: kumjuh ruh ki nonglute jong me kin pynkhraw ia lade ban pynskhem ia ka jingphohsniew ; hynrei kin hap .

en: Israel is a scattered sheep  ; the lions have driven him away : first the king of Assyria hath devoured him  ; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long kum ki langbrot , ba la shah beh bad pynsakma da ki sing . Nyngkong , la tur ïaleh da u patsha ka Assyria , bad nangta u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u ktha ïa ki shyieng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki long ki langbrot kiba la bthei ; ki sing ki la beh noh ia u: nyngkong u syiem Assyria u la bam ia u ; bad khatduh une u syiem Babilon u la pynpra ia ki shyieng jong u .

en: And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .
kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Asahel bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por kynjat shai ki la wan poi biang ha Hebron .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u Ashael bad ki la tep ia u ha ka jingtep jong u kpa jong u kaba don ha Bethlehem . U Joab bad ki briew jong u ki la leit baroh shi miet bad ki la poi sha Hebron ha ka por mynstep sngi .

en: And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;
kha: Na ka bynta u syiem ïa lade hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang u syiem Judah uba la phah ia phi ban kylli ia U Trai , kumta phin ong ha u , Kumta ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel shaphang ki ktien kiba me la iohsngew;

en: And if thy foot offend thee , cut it off : it is better for thee to enter halt into life , than having two feet to be cast into hell , into the fire that never shall be quenched :
kha: Bad lada ka kjat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit , ot noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kjat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki kjat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka kjat jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, ot noh ia ka: ka kham bha ia me ban rung sha ka jingim, ban ia kaba don ar tylli ki kjat ban shah bret ha dujok, sha ka ding kaba ym ju shah pynlip:

en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .
kha: ryngkat bad kiwei ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba u Ashurbanipal bakhraw bad badonbor , u la pynkynriah ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki bad pynsah ïa ki ha ka nongbah Samaria bad shawei shaei ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba u Asnapar uba khraw bad uba donburom u la wanrah ha ki shnong Samaria bad kiwei pat kiba don ha kane ka liang ka wah bad ha kum kata ka por .

en: The nakedness of thy sister , the daughter of thy father , or daughter of thy mother , whether she be born at home , or born abroad , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka hynmen ne ka para , ne ka para kaba na ujuh u kpa , kam pher la ka heh ka san ryngkat bad me ha kajuh ka ïing ne shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka para jong me, ka khun jong u kpa jong me, ne ka khun jong ka kmie jong me, la ka long ha iing ne shabar ri, wat ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ki ruh wat nym lap .

en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .
kha: U Nahash u jubab ,  Ngan ïateh jutang bad phi halor kawei ka kyndon : Ngan khlaw ïa ka khmat kamon jong phi baroh , bad da kumta ngan pynjahburom halor ki Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nahas u la jubab ia ki, Ha kane ka jinglong ngan leh ia ka jutang bad phi, ba ngan pynmih ia ki khmat kadiang jong phi baroh, bad ngan buh ia ka ha ka jingshah lehbein ha ki Israel baroh .

en: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .
kha: Ka spah baroh ka wan na me ; me synshar halor kiei kiei baroh da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka bor jong me , bad me lah ban pynlong ïano ïano uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ar ka spah bad ka burom ka wan na me, bad me synshar halor baroh; bad ha ka kti jong me ka don ka bor bad ka bor; bad ha ka kti jong me ka long ban pynlong ia ka bor kaba khraw, bad ban ai bor ia baroh .

en: They which builded on the wall , and they that bare burdens , with those that laded , every one with one of his hands wrought in the work , and with the other hand held a weapon .
kha: Wat kito kiba kit ïa ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka jingtei , ki trei da kawei ka kti bad bat ha kawei pat ïa ka tiar ïaleh thma ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba tei ha ka kynroh , bad ki kiba kit jingkit , bad kito kiba la iaid , uwei pa uwei u la leh ia ka kam , bad da kawei pat ka kti u la bat ia ka tiar .

en: Epaphras , who is one of you , a servant of Christ , saluteth you , always labouring fervently for you in prayers , that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God .
kha: Ki jingai khublei na u Epaphras , uwei pat u dkhot jong ka kynhun jong phi bad u shakri jong U Khrist Jisu . U ïai duwai shitrhem borabor na ka bynta jong phi , da kaba kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pynlong ïa phi kiba ïeng skhem , kum kiba la san rangbah bha bad kiba skhem pura , ha ka jingkohnguh pura ïa ka mon U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Epaphras uba long uwei na phi, u shakri U Khrist, u ai khublei ia phi, u ju trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi ha ki jingduwai, ba phin ieng skhem bad ba pura ha ka mon U Blei baroh .

en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
kha: Naba ngi la wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad da ka jingsngewthuh pura ïa ka jingshisha jong ka . Phi tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka la long na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka gospel jong ngi kam shym la wan sha phi tang ha ka ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad ha ka jingpynthikna kaba bun ; kumba phi tip ia kaei ka jait briew kaba ngi la long hapdeng jong phi na ka bynta jong phi .

en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .
kha: U kpa jong ki u ong ha ki ,  Phi kwah ba ngan duh lut ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon ruh um don , bad mynta pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Benjamin . Dei ma nga keiñ uba shah jynjar !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u kpa jong ki u la ong ha ki: Nga la duh noh ia ki khun jong nga: U Joseph um long kumta bad u Simeon um long kumta: bad phin shim noh ia u Benjamin: kine kiei kiei baroh ki long pyrshah ia nga .

en: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother , the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite , and said unto them , As the  Lord  liveth , who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity ,
kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa ki ,  Nga la shim jingsmai ha U  Trai  uba im , uba la pyllait ïa nga na ki jingma baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la jubab ia u Rekhab bad u Baah u hynmen jong u, ki khun shynrang jong u Rimon u Berohot bad u la ong ha ki: Kumba U Trai u im , uba la siewspah ia ka mynsiem jong nga na ka jingjynjar baroh .

en: And there came a man of God unto Eli , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father , when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh s house ?
kha: U nongïathuhlypa u wan sha u Eli bad ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Haba u Kpa tymmen jong me u Aaron bad ka longïing jong u ki dang long ki mraw jong u Pharaoh ka Ijipt . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha u Aaron .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew jong U Blei u la wan sha u Eli bad u la ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai: Hato nga la paw shai ha ka iing u kpa jong me haba ki la don ha Ijipt ha iing u Pharaoh ?

en: After the same manner also he took the cup , when he had supped , saying ,  This cup is the new testament in my blood : this do ye , as oft as ye drink it , in remembrance of me .
kha: Kumjuh ruh , hadien kaba bam ïa ka jingbam miet u la shim ïa ka khuri bad u la ong ,  Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang kaba thymmai jong U Blei , la pynskhem da ka snam jong nga . Man ba phi dih ïa ka , to leh kumta ban kynmaw ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kajuh ka rukom ruh u la shim ia ka khuri, haba u la bam, u da ong, Kane ka khuri ka long ka jutang bathymmai ha ka snam jong nga: kane phi leh ia ka, kumba phi dih ia ka, ha ka jingkynmaw ia nga .

en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .
kha: Pynban , un pyndonburom ïa u blei uba ïada ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawlynnai , bad kiwei kiwei ki jingai babha sha u blei uba ki kpa tymmen jong u kim shym la ju mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka jaka jong u un burom ia U Blei jong ki bor: bad u blei uba ki kpa jong u kim tip un burom da ka ksiar bad ka rupa bad da ki maw kiba kordor bad kiba sngewtynnad .

en: Thus the  Lord  saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria , and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem na ka bor u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , bad ruh na kiwei ki nongshun jong ki . U ai ba ki briew kin im ha ka jingsuk bad baroh ki ri kiba marjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai u la pynim ia u Hesekaiah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem na ka kti u Sennakherib u syiem Assyria bad na ka kti jong kiwei pat baroh .

en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff , what hast thou found of all thy household stuff ? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren , that they may judge betwixt us both .
kha: Mynta ba phi la khyllie lut ïa ki jingdon jingem jong nga baroh , ki tiar ïing aïu phi shem kiba dei ki jong phi ? To phriang ïa ki hangne ba ki briew jong phi bad ki jong nga kin ïohi , bad ai kin rai ba mano na ngi uba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba me la wad ia ki tiar jong nga baroh, kaei kaba me lap na ki tiar iing jong me baroh? buh ia ka hangne ha khmat ki hynmen jong nga bad ki hynmen jong me, ba kin bishar ia ngi baroh arngut .

en: For the king s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram : every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
kha: U don ka kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid sha duriaw ryngkat bad ki liengbah jong u syiem Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki lieng jong u ki wan phai , ki da kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki lieng syiem ki la leit sha Tarshish bad ki shakri jong u Hiram: shisien ki lieng jong u Tarshish ki wanrah ia ka ksiar bad ka rupa, ka sniehdoh bad ki sohjew .

en: He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa u lum ban ïam ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewsih ïa ki nongbah jong ka Nebo bad Medeba ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u  ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha Bajith, bad sha Dibon, ki jaka ba jrong, ban iam: U Moab un iam halor u Nebo, bad halor ka Medeba: ha ki khlieh jong ki baroh kin long kiba sniew, bad uwei pa uwei u ryndang un ot noh .

en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
kha: bad ai ïa kane ka hukum ha u Hilkaïah u lyngdoh , ha u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ha u Akhbor u khun jong u Mikaïah , ha u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ha u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum ia u Hilkiah u lyngdoh bad u Ahikam u khun u Mihaiah bad u Ahbor u khun u Mihaiah bad u Ahban u nongthoh bad u Ahaya u shakri u syiem u la ong:

en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Because the  Lord  hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also : and she called his name Simeon .
kha: Ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ruh ha nga ïa une u khun , namar u la ïohsngew ba ngam shym long kaba la ieit  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Simeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pun khun biang, bad ka la kha khun shuh shuh bad ka la ong: Namar ba U Trai u la iohsngew ba nga la shun ia nga, u la ai ia nga ia une u khun ruh: bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Simeon .

en: That thou mayest say to the prisoners , Go forth  ; to them that are in darkness , Shew yourselves . They shall feed in the ways , and their pastures shall be in all high places .
kha: Ngan ong ha kiba shah set byndi , ‘ Leit ha kaba laitluid !’ bad ïa kito kiba don ha ka jingdum , ‘ Wan sha ka jingshai !’ Kin long kum ki langbrot kiba bam phlang halor ki lumrit ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban ong ha ki koidi, To leit sha ki kiba don ha ka jingdum, To pyni ia lade . Kin bam ha ki lynti bad ki jaka ri jingri jong ki kin long ha ki jaka ba jrong baroh .

en: And he gave a sign the same day , saying , This is the sign which the  Lord  hath spoken  ; Behold , the altar shall be rent , and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out .
kha: Bad u nongïathuhlypa u ïai kren ban ong ,  Kane ka duwan kan pra phum bad ïa u dpei yn pynsaphred . Te phin tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ai ka dak ha kajuh ka sngi, u da ong: Kane ka long ka dak kaba U Trai u la kren; Ha khmih ka jingbam kan sa tyrkhong bad ka dewbilat kaba don halor jong ka kan sa tuid noh .

en: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings , saith the  Lord  : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof , and it shall devour all things round about it .
kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan thang ïa ka ïingsyiem jong pha da ka ding , bad kan bam duh ïa baroh kat kaba don sawdong jong ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ia phi kat kum u soh jong ki jingleh jong phi: bad ngan thang ding ha ka khlaw jong ka , bad kan bam lut ia kiei kiei baroh sawdong jong ka .

en: I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
kha: To kynmaw , A  Trai  , ba nga la shakri ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïaineh skhem , bad nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh .  Bad u sdang ban ïamkthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kyrpad ia me, ko Trai, kynmaw mynta kumno nga la iaid ha khmat jong me ha ka jingshisha bad da ka dohnud kaba janai, bad nga la leh ia kaba bha ha khmat jong me . Bad u Hesekaiah u la iam .

en: As for me , I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee : neither have I desired the woeful day  ; thou knowest : that which came out of my lips was right before thee .
kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , ngam ju kyrpad ïa me ban wallam ka jingpynjot halor jong ki ; ngam shym la kwah ïa ka por jingjynjar na ka bynta jong ki . A  Trai  , me tip ïa kane ; me tip ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga pat ngam shym la kyrkieh ban long u pastor ban bud ia me: bad ngam shym la kwah ia ka sngi kaba sngewsih ; me tip: kata kaba la mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka la long beit ha khmat jong me .

en: And his mother s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words : and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech  ; for they said , He is our brother .
kha: Ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka kmie jong u ki ïakren ïa kane ha ki rangbah ka Shekhem na ka bynta jong u , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki la kut jingmut ban bud ïa u Abimelekh namar u dei uba ha ïing jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki la kren ia u ha ki shkor jong ki briew baroh: bad ki dohnud jong ki ki la sngap jar ban bud ia u Abimelech ; namar ki la ong: U long u hynmen jong ngi .

en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men  ; that I might leave my people , and go from them ! for they be all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .
kha: Nga thrang ban don ka jaka ban sah ha ka ri shyiap ha kaba nga lah ban lait na ki briew jong nga . Ma ki baroh ki long ki bymïaineh , ki paidbhur ki nongshetkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Oh ba nga la don ha ka ri khlaw ka jaka sah jong ki briew kiba iaid lynti ba ngan iehnoh ia ki briew jong nga, bad leit noh na ki ! namar ki long baroh ki nongleh kam sniew, ka jingiaseng jong ki briew kiba thok .

en: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded thee , and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments  ;
kha: Lada me shakri hok ïa nga kumba leh u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum ïa me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me ruh lada me iaid ha khmat jong nga kumba u kpa jong me u la iaid bad leh katba nga la hukum ia me, bad to sumar ia ki ain jong nga bad ki jingbishar jong nga;

en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and cast into his garden  ; and it grew , and waxed a great tree  ; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it .
kha: Ka long kumne . Uwei u briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa uta ha ka lyngkha jong u . U jingthung u san bad u kylla long u dieng , bad ki sim ki thaw ïa la ki skum ha ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kum u symbai ba la khleh lang, uba u briew u la shim, bad u la bret ha ka kper jong u ; bad u la san , bad u la san u dieng uba heh ; bad ki sim ka Iyer kiba la sah ha ki tnat jong u .

en: And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou ? and whither goest thou ? and whose are these before thee ?
kha: U la hukum ruh ïa u shakri uba ha khmat eh ,  Ynda u Iso u hynmen jong nga u ïakynduh ïa me , bad u kylli , ‘ Uei u kynrad jong me ? Shano men leit ? Uei u trai jong kine ki jingri kiba ha khmat jong me ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la hukum ia kaba ha khmat eh, u da ong, Haba u Iso u hynmen jong nga u iakynduh ia me bad u kylli ia me da kaba ong, Me long mano ? bad me leit shano ? bad kine ki long ha khmat jong me ?

en: For I have set my face against this city for evil , and not for good , saith the  Lord  : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire .
kha: Nga la kut jingmut skhem ba ngan ym pynsah ïa kane ka nongbah , hynrei ban pynjot ïa ka . Yn ai ïa ka ha u syiem ka Babilonia , bad un thang lut khoit ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia kane ka shnong na ka bynta ka jingsniew, bad ym na ka bynta ka jingbha: yn aiti ia ka ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon , bad un thang ia ka da ka ding .

en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceable , gentle , and easy to be entreated , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .
kha: Hynrei ka jingstad kaba wan najrong nyngkong eh ka long kaba sngur ; ka long kaba pynïashong suk , kaba jemnud bad kaba pynlong paralok ; ka dap da ka jinglehisynei bad ka pynmih ïa ka jingseisoh ha ki kam babha ; ka lait na ka jingshah shiliang bad ka jingarsap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka jingstad kaba don haneng ka long kaba khuid nyngkong, nangta kaba suk, kaba jemnud bad kaba suk ban shah pynkhih, kaba dap da ka jingisynei bad ki soh kiba bha, khlem ka jinglong shiliang khmat bad khlem ka jingleh arsap .

en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him : and the chief captain also was afraid , after he knew that he was a Roman , and because he had bound him .
kha: Mar kumta ki rangbah kiba la leit ban tohkit ïa u Paul ki la kynriah noh na u , bad uta u rangbah ai hukum u la sheptieng haba u la sngewthuh ba u Paul u la long u traishnong ka Hima Rom bad ba u la lah phah khum kynjri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta mardor ki la leit noh na u uba la dei ban bishar bniah ia u: bad u rangbah ruh u la tieng , hadien ba u la tip ba u long u Roman , bad namar ba u la teh ia u .

en: And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .
kha: Da kine ki ktien , nga pynlong ka jutang bad phi : Nga kular ba lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im da ka jingshlei um , da lei lei ruh ka jingshlei um kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga bad phi ; bad ka doh baroh kan ym shah ot noh shuh da ki um jong ka jingshlei um ; bad kan ym don shuh ka jingshlei um ban pynjot ia ka khyndew .

en: And as for thy nativity , in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut , neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee  ; thou wast not salted at all , nor swaddled at all .
kha: Haba la kha ïa pha , ym don mano mano ban ot ïa u sohpet jong pha lane pynsum ïa pha lane kyllan mluh ïa pha lane sop ïa pha da ka jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba long ka jingkha jong me, ha ka sngi ba la kha ia me, ym shym la ot ia ka um jong me, lymne ngam shym la sait um ha ka um ban pynsngem ia me ; ngam shym la sngur satia, lymne ngam shym la sngur satia .

en: And it came to pass after these things , that the son of the woman , the mistress of the house , fell sick  ; and his sickness was so sore , that there was no breath left in him .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , u khun jong kata ka riewkynthei u la kem pang ; ka jingpang ka nang jur nang jur bad khatduh u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kine kiei kiei, u khun jong kata ka kynthei, u nongshong shnong jong ka iing, u la pang ; bad ka jingpang jong u ka la pang haduh katta katta ba ym don mynsiem shuh ha u .

en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !
kha: Ka hima Israel ka la kut ! Ka burom jong ka , ka la jah kum ki pansngiat syntiew ha ki khlieh jong ki nongïalam buaid . Ïa ki khlieh basarong jong ki la pyniwbih bha , hynrei hangta ki ïathiah , ki buaid bhor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew ia ka khlieh jong ka jingsarong , ia ki nongdih kyiad jong ka Ephraim , kiba ka jingitynnad ba donburom jong ki ka long u syntiew uba la jah rngai noh , kiba don ha ka khlieh jong ki them kiba heh jong ki kiba la jop da ka wain !

en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in the blue , and in the purple , and in the scarlet , and in the fine linen , with cunning work .
kha: Ki shoh stang kum ki jingsiang ïa ka ksiar bad ki ot ïa ka ksiar kum ki ksai ïa ka ban suh ha kata ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , bad ha u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkhih ia ka ksiar ha ki pliang kiba rit, bad ki la ot ia ka ha ki wire, ban trei ia ka ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw, bad ha ka rong saw kaba jem .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land  ; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee , and thy palaces shall be spoiled .
kha: Bad kumta , u nongshun un kerkut ïa ka ri , un pyntwa ïa ki jingker jong ki , bad un lute ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; U nongshun un don wat sawdong ka ri ; bad un pynhiar ia ka bor jong me na me , bad ki iing jong me kin shah pynjot .

en: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there . And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there .
kha: U Abraham u ong ,  A Trai , wat bitar ba ngan kren biang . Kumno lada don tang laiphew ngut ?  U ong ,  Ngan ym leh ei ei ïa ka lada nga shem laiphew ngut hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u, Oh wat ai ba U Trai un bitar, bad ngan kren: Hooid yn shem ia ki laiphew ngut hangta . Bad u la ong , Ngan ym leh ia kata lada nga shem laiphew hangta .

en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the  Lord  , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines : for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel .
kha: U kpa bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ba kane baroh ka dei na U  Trai  , naba U  Trai  u wad ka lad ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u kpa jong u bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ba ka long na U Trai , ba u wad ia ka lad pyrshah ia ki Philistia: namar ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki la synshar halor ki Israel .

en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not , and he doth not sin , he shall surely live , because he is warned  ; also thou hast delivered thy soul .
kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew uba bha ba un ym leh pop , bad u shahshkor ïa me bad um leh pop , un im da shisha , bad ïa ka jingim jong me ruh yn pyllait .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh lada me maham ia u briew uba hok, ba u hok um leh pop, bad um leh pop, un im shisha, namar ba la maham ia u; me ruh me la pyllait ia ka mynsiem jong me .

en: To me belongeth vengeance , and recompence  ; their foot shall slide in due time : for the day of their calamity is at hand , and the things that shall come upon them make haste .
kha: U  Trai  un pynhiarkput bad pynshitom ïa ki ; ka por kan poi haba kin kyllon ; ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki ka la jan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha nga ka long ka jingsiew kylliang, bad ka jingsiew kylliang jong ki kan sdang ban khih ha ka por kaba biang: namar ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar jong ki ka la jan , bad kiei kiei ki ban wan ha ki ki pynkloi .

en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite , the porter toward the east , was over the freewill offerings of God , to distribute the oblations of the  Lord  , and the most holy things .
kha: U Kore u khun jong u Imnah , u Lebi uba long u rangbah ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Mihngi jong ka Templ , u long u khlieh ha ka jingpdiang ïa ki jingai ba ai sha U  Trai  bad ha kaba sam ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Kren u khun jong u Imnah u Lebi, u nongrah shaphang mihngi, u la long halor ki jingainguh ba laitluid jong U Blei , ban sam ia ki jingainguh jong U Trai bad kiei kiei kiba khuid tam .

en: Their Redeemer is strong  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name : he shall thoroughly plead their cause , that he may give rest to the land , and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon .
kha: Hynrei uwei u ban pyllait ïa ki u long uba khlaiñ — ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ma u hi da lade un bahkhlieh na ka bynta jong ki bad un wallam ïa ka jingsuk ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ka jingjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nongsiewspah jong ki u long uba khlain; U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u: un kyrpad pura ia ka daw jong ki, ba un ai jingjahthait ia ka ri, bad un pynjah burom ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Babilon .

en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Zebudah , the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah .
kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sebidah , ka khun u Pedaïah na ka shnong Rumah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Sebudah , ka khun jong u Pediah jong ka ri Bilat .

en: And while the day was coming on , Paul besought them all to take meat , saying , This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting , having taken nothing .
kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , u Paul u la kyrpad ïa ki baroh ban bam khyndiat ka jingbam :  Phi la ïa-ap la khatsaw sngi mynta , bad ha kane ka por baroh phim shym la bam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ka sngi ka dang iaid , u Paul u la kyrpad ia ki baroh ban bam doh , u da ong , Kane ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba shiphew ba phi la sah bad bteng ban bam ei ei .

en: And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .
kha: Ka kynthei ha ka jingkhang ka la shoh samthiah ngai katba ka dang tai kew bad ka ïohthiah , kumta u Rekhab bad u Baanah ki ïohrung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan shapoh ka iing, kumba ki la shim ia u kew ; bad ki la pynkhih ia u hapoh ka rib kaba phra: bad u Rehab bad u Baanah u hynmen jong u ki la lait im .

en: If others be partakers of this power over you , are not we rather ? Nevertheless we have not used this power ; but suffer all things , lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ .
kha: Lada kiwei pat ki don hok ban khmih lynti ïa kane na phi , hato ngi ngim don ïa ka hok kaba kham khraw ? Hynrei ngim shym la pyndonkam ïa kane ka hok . Pynban , ngi la ïaishah ïa kiei kiei baroh khnang ban ym buh jingpynwit ha ka lynti jong ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kiwei pat ki long ki nongiashim bynta ia kane ka bor halor jong phi , hato ngim kham bha ? Wat la katta ruh ngim shym la pyndonkam ia kane ka bor ; hynrei ngi la shah shitom lut ia kiei kiei baroh , ioh ba ngin khanglad ia ka gospel U Khrist .

en: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed , and keep all my statutes , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
kha: Lada u briew uba sniew u sangeh ban leh pop bad u sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga , lada u leh ïa kaba dei bad kaba bha , un ym ïap ; un im da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u bymman un phai noh na ki pop jong u baroh kiba u la leh, bad un sumar ia ki ain jong nga baroh, bad un leh ia kaba dei bad kaba dei, un ym iap shisha .

en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .
kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka lyngkha kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip    ïa u sohkew uba phi kheit da la ki kti , hynrei phim dei ban ot ïa u da ka rashi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me wan shapoh u kew ba ieng jong u paramarjan jong me, te me lah ban ktah ia ki shkor da ka kti jong me ; hynrei wat pynkhih ia u kew ba ieng ha u paramarjan jong me .

en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image , or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above , or that is in the earth beneath , or that is in the water under the earth :
kha: Wat thaw durblei na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shajrong , ne ha ka khyndew sha tbian , ne ha ka um hapoh ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynlong ia me ia kano kano ka dur ba la ker , ne kano kano ka dur jong kaei kaei kaba don ha bneng shaneng , ne kaba don ha ka khyndew hapoh khyndew:

en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .
kha: Kumta ki la ai ha u Jakob ïa kita ki blei nongwei baroh kiba ki don , bad ruh ïa ki sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob u buhrieh ïa ki ha trai u dieng Sning hajan Shekhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ha u Jakob ia ki blei bar ri baroh kiba don ha ka kti jong ki, bad ki shkor jong ki baroh kiba don ha ki shkor jong ki; bad u Jakob u la buhrieh ia ki hapoh u oak uba don ha Shechem .

en: He made him ride on the high places of the earth , that he might eat the increase of the fields  ; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock , and oil out of the flinty rock  ;
kha: U ai ba kin synshar ïa ki ri lum , bad ki bam ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha . Hapdeng ki mawsiang ki lap ïa ka ngap ; ki diengsoh Olib jong ki , ki san ki plung ha ki jaka maw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynlong ia u ban shong ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khyndew , ba un bam ia ka jingroi jong ki lyngkha ; bad u la pynlong ia u ban dih ia ka umsoh na u mawsiang, bad ka umphniang na u mawsiang ba jyrngam ; .

en: Seek ye the  Lord  , all ye meek of the earth , which have wrought his judgment  ; seek righteousness , seek meekness : it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the  Lord s  anger .
kha: To phai noh sha U  Trai  , phi baroh ki briew kiba sngewrit , kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . To leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad to pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U  Trai . Lehse phin lait na ka jingpynshitom ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u .
