translated_en_to_kha: To wad ia U Trai, baroh phi kiba jemnud jong ka khyndew, kiba la leh ia ka jingbishar jong u ki wad ia ka hok, ki wad ia ka jingjemnud: ka lah ban long ba phin buhrieh ha ka sngi U Trai ka jingbitar .

en: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them  ; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
kha: Phi bam syndon ïa ki briew jong nga . Phi puid noh ïa ka sniehdoh jong ki , pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki , bad shaiñ ïa ki kum ïa ka doh ha u khiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba bam ruh ia ka doh jong ki briew jong nga, bad ki pynkhih ia ka sniehdoh jong ki na ki ; bad ki pynpra ia ki shyieng jong ki, bad ki ot ia ki ha ki bynta, kumba long ka umphniang bad kum ka doh hapoh ka umphniang .

en: For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
kha: Ha shuwa ba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ba la phah da u Jakob kin poi hangta , u Petros u la ïabam lang bad ki parabangeit Jentil . Hynrei hadien ba kine ki rangbah ki la poi , u la kynriah noh bad um shym ïabam lang shuh bad ki Jentil , namar u la sheptieng ïa kito kiba ha ka liang kiba otsher ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shuwa ba uta u la wan na u Jakob, u la iabam bad ki Jutang: hynrei ynda ki la wan , u la kynriah noh bad u la pyniakhlad ia lade , da kaba tieng ia ki kiba long na ka jingkren bein .

en: Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :
kha: Pha ong , ‘ Nga long kaba riewspah bad kaba dap babiang ; nga don baroh kaba nga donkam .’ Hynrei pham tip haduh katno pha long kaba lanot bad kaba isynei ban khmih ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , bad kaba matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me ong , nga riewspah bad nga la nang kiew da ki mar, bad ngam donkam ei ei bad ngam tip ba me la sngewsih, bad me la sngewsih, bad me la duk, bad me la matlah, bad me la lyngkhuid:

en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?
kha: Ko paid Israel , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Hato nga la long kum ka ri shyiap ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kat kaba phi sngewbha , ba phin ym wan phai shuh sha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ko pateng , phi iohi ia ka ktien U Trai . Hato nga la long ka ri khlaw ha Israel ? ka ri jong ka jingdum ? namar kata to ong ia ki briew jong nga , Ngi long ki kynrad; ngin ym wan shuh sha me ?

en: Lauding PM Modi for his outstanding leadership and selfless service , Kotler said his efforts have resulted in extraordinary economic , social and technological advances in India .
kha: Haba iaroh ia u PM Modi na ka bynta ka jinglong nongialam ba tbit jong u bad ka jingshakri ba khlem len lade , u Kotler u la ong ba ka jingpyrshang jong u ka la wanrah ia ka jingkiew kaba phylla ha ka ioh ka kot , ka imlang sahlang bad ka teknoloji ha ka ri India .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ai ia u PM Modi na ka bynta ka jinglong nongialam ba phylla bad ka jingshakri kaba khlem jingsngewrit jong u , u Kotler u la ong ba ka jingpyrshang jong u ka la wanrah ia ka jingkiew kaba phylla ha ka ioh ka kot , ka imlang sahlang bad ka teknoloji ha India .

en: And when the cherubims went , the wheels went by them : and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth , the same wheels also turned not from beside them .
kha: Haba ki kherub ki kiew sha suiñ bad ki khih , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki . Haba ki pyiar ïa ki thapniang ban her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki cherub ki la leit noh, ki tyrpeng ki la iaid ryngkat bad ki: bad haba ki cherub ki la kiew ia ki bniat jong ki ban kiew na ka khyndew , kita ki tyrpeng ruh kim shym la kylla najan jong ki .

en: And there came two angels to Sodom at even  ; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom : and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them  ; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground  ;
kha: Haba kita ki ar ngut ki angel ki la poi ha Sodom ha ka por janmiet , u Lot u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka nongbah . Haba u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u ïeng joit ban leit ïashem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki arngut ki angel ki la wan sha Sodom ha ka por mynstep bad u Lot u la shong ha ka khyrdop u Sodom: bad u Lot u la iohi ia ki ba ki la ieng ban iakynduh ia ki ; bad u la dem khrup ia lade da ka khmat jong u sha ka khyndew ; .

en: Howbeit the  Lord  would not destroy the house of David , because of the covenant that he had made with David , and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .
kha: hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynduh ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid , namar u la lah pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid bad ba u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai un ym pynjot ia ka iing u Dabid namar ka jutang kaba u la leh bad u Dabid bad kumba u la kular ban ai jingshai ia u bad ia ki khun jong u junom .

en: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .
kha: U Petros u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shabar ka kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ong ,  Ko Tabitha , khie joit !  Ka la plied ïa la ki khmat , bad haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros , ka la khie shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros u la buh ia ki baroh sha khmat, bad u la dem khrup, bad u la duwai; bad ka la plie ia ki khmat jong ka: bad haba ka la iohi ia u Petros , ka la shong .

en: And Joab said unto him , Thou shalt not bear tidings this day , but thou shalt bear tidings another day : but this day thou shalt bear no tidings , because the king s son is dead .
kha: Em ,  u Joab u jubab ,  mynta ka sngi men ym rah kano kano ka khubor babha . Ha kawei pat ka sngi me lah ban leh kumta , hynrei ym mynta , naba u khun jong u syiem u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ong ha u, Wat ju iathuh khubor ha kane ka sngi: hynrei ha kane ka sngi wat iathuh khubor ei ei: namar u khun syiem u la iap .

en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee .
kha: Phi kiba shong ha Lakhish , teh ïa ki kali ïapom ha ki kulai . Phi pynbud ïa ki pop jong ki Israel bad kumta ka pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko nongshong shnong jong ka Lachish, to teh ia ka kali sha u mrad ba stet: ka long ka jingsdang jong ka pop ia ka khun jong u Seion: namar ki jingpynkhein jong ki Israel la shem ha me .

en: And when the mourning was past , David sent and fetched her to his house , and she became his wife , and bare him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the  Lord .
kha: Haba ka por ïambriew ka la kut , u Dabid u phah wan ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem ; ka la long noh ka tnga jong u , bad ka kha u khun shynrang na u . Hynrei U  Trai  um sngewbha ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka jingsngewsih ka la iaid noh, u Dabid u la phah bad u la leit sha iing jong u, bad ka la long ka tnga jong u, bad ka la kha khun ia u . Hynrei kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ka la pynsngewsih ia U Trai .

en: He that committeth sin is of the devil  ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .
kha: Uno uno uba ïai leh ïa ka pop , u long jong u Soitan , namar u Soitan u la leh pop naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . U Khun U Blei u la paw na ka bynta kane hi ka daw , ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba la leh da u Soitan .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pyndep ia ka pop u long na u ksuid ; namar u ksuid u leh pop naduh kaba sdang . Na ka bynta kane la pynpaw ia u Khun U Blei , ba un pynjot ia ki kam u ksuid .

en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them  ; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath : their own way have I recompensed upon their heads , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Te ngan theh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha ki , bad kum ka ding ngan pynjot ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la theh ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki ; nga la bam ia ki da ka ding jong ka jingbitar jong nga: ha la ka jong ka lynti nga la siew kylliang ia ki khlieh jong ki , ong U Trai Blei .

en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .
kha: Ngan bat ïa la ka kular bad me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ki ban dang wan ba kan long ka jutang kaba ïaineh junom . Ngan long U Blei jong me bad U Blei jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga hapdeng jong nga bad me bad u symbai jong me hadien jong me ha ki pateng jong ki na ka bynta ka jutang bymjukut ha me bad ha u symbai jong me hadien jong me .

en: And from Jerusalem , and from Idumaea , and from beyond Jordan  ; and they about Tyre and Sidon , a great multitude , when they had heard what great things he did , came unto him .
kha: na Jerusalem , na ka ri Idumia , na ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jordan , bad na ka jaka sawdong ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon . Baroh kine ki briew ki la wan sha U Jisu namar ki la lah ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei kiba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na Jerusalem bad na Idumaea bad na sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ki shaphang ka Tyros bad ka Sidon, haba ki la iohsngew ia kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh, ki la wan sha u .

en: And though they go into captivity before their enemies , thence will I command the sword , and it shall slay them : and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil , and not for good .
kha: Lada ki shah ringmraw ha ki nongshun jong ki , ngan hukum ïa ki ba kin pynïap . Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ki , ym ban ïarap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la ki leit sha ka jingshah set ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki, te ngan hukum ia ka waitlam, bad kan pyniap ia ki: bad ngan buh ia ki khmat jong nga ha ki na ka bynta ka jingsniew, bad ym na ka bynta ka jingbha .

en: But the God of all grace , who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after that ye have suffered a while , make you perfect , stablish , strengthen , settle you .
kha: Hynrei hadien ba phi la shahshitom tang khyndiat por , U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh , uba la khot ïa phi ban ïoh bynta na ka burom bymjukut jong u ha U Khrist , ma u hi keiñ un pynjanai ïa phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingsngewskhem , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka nongrim kaba skhem shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh, uba la khot ia ngi sha ka burom bymjukut jong u da U Khrist Jisu, hadien ba phi la shah shitom shipor, u pynlong ia phi kiba janai, kiba skhem, kiba skhem, kiba pynskhem ia phi .

en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you , but give you occasion to glory on our behalf , that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance , and not in heart .
kha: Ngim pyrshang biang ban ïaroh ïa lade ha khmat jong phi ; pynban , ngi pyrshang ban ai ha phi ïa ka daw kaba biang ba phin sngewsarong shaphang jong ngi , khnang ba phin lah ban ai jubab sha kito kiba sngewsarong shaphang kata kaba paw shabar jong u briew bad ym ha ka jinglong jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim iaroh biang ia lade ha phi, hynrei ngi ai lad ia phi ban pyndonburom ia ngi, ba phin ioh katto katne ban jubab ia ki kiba pyndonburom ha ka dur , bad ym ha ka dohnud .

en: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places , wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods , upon the high mountains , and upon the hills , and under every green tree :
kha: Ha kata ka ri ba phi ïohkynti , pynjot ïa ki jaka baroh ha kiba ki briew ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki ha ki lum kiba jrong , ha ki lumrit , bad hapoh ki dieng kiba jyrngam .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin pynjot lut ia ki jaka baroh, ha kaba ki jaitbynriew kiba phi don ki shakri ia ki blei jong ki, halor ki lum kiba jrong bad halor ki lum kiba jyrngam:

en: They were stoned , they were sawn asunder , were tempted , were slain with the sword : they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins  ; being destitute , afflicted , tormented  ;
kha: La lynthem maw ïa ki , la ot arliang ïa ki , la pynïap ïa ki da ka waitlam . Ki la ïaid kylleng , ki da phong da ki jaiñ snieh langbrot lane snieh blang — ha ka jingduk , ha ka jingshah pynshitom , bad ha ka jingshah lehbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynkhih ia ki da u maw, la pynshoi ia ki, la pyniap ia ki da ka waitlam: ki la iaid kai ha ki snieh langbrot bad ki blang blang ; ki la shah pynshitom bein, ki la shah pynshitom bein ; .

en: Then said the  Lord  unto Isaiah , Go forth now to meet Ahaz , thou , and Shear–jashub thy son , at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Isaïah ,  To shim ïa u Shear Jashub u khun jong me , bad khie leit ban ïakynduh ïa u Syiem Ahas . Men shem ïa u ha ka lynti ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , ha kaba kut ka nala kaba wallam um na ka pung kaba haneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha Isaiah, To leit mynta ban iakynduh ia u Ahasa, me bad u khun jong me, ha kaba kut jong ka pung kaba shalor ha ka lynti bah jong ka lyngkha kaba kham pura;

en: Awake , awake , put on strength , O arm of the  Lord   ; awake , as in the ancient days , in the generations of old . Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab , and wounded the dragon ?
kha: A  Trai  to khie bad ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyndonkam ïa la ka bor bad pynim ïa ngi ; pyndonkam ïa ka kum ha ka por mynbarim . Dei ma me uba la ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Rahab u mrad duriaw bakynsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Awake, khie, to buh ia ka bor, ko kti U Trai to khie, kumba ha ki sngi hyndai, ha ki pateng hyndai . Hato kam dei ma me uba la ot ia u Rahab bad uba la pynmynsaw ia u bsein ?

en: And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .
kha: Hynrei ka ong ha la u kpa ,  To leh kane kawei ïa nga . Ai por ïa nga ar bnai ba ngan ïoh leit sha ki lum bad la ki paralok , ban ïa-ïam sngewsih ba nga dei ban ïap kum kaba dang sotti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u kpa jong ka: Ai ba kane kan long na ka bynta jong nga: to ai ba ngan leit sha jngai ar bnai, ba ngan leit shaneng shaneng sha jrong ki lum bad nga sngewsih ia ka jinglong kynthei jong nga, ma nga bad ki paralok jong nga .

en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?
kha: Uei u shipai uba ju dei ban siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam shipai ? Uei u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki soh na la ka bri sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u bym pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki langbrot ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba leit thma ha la ka jong ka por ? uba thung ia u sohjew bad u bam ia u soh jong u ? lane uba ai bam ia ka kynhun bad u bam ia ka dud jong ka kynhun ?

en: The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ . U pynlong ïa nga uba skhem ki kjat kum ka skei bad u sumar ïa nga halor ki lumbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei U long ka bor jong nga, bad un pynlong ia ki kjat jong nga kum ki kjat ba jrong jong nga . Ha u nongrwai ba kongsan ha ki tiar ba la tyrkhong jong nga .

en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .
kha: U briew u bym lah ïoh rupa ne ksiar u jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei dieng batbit ban shna ïa ka dur ka ban ym kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba la shah pynbor haduh katta katta ba um don ka jingkyrpad u jied ia u dieng u bym pyut ; u wad ha u ia u nongtrei uba stad ban pynkhreh ia ka dur ba la ker , kaba ym lah ban khih .

en: Behold , the name of the  Lord  cometh from far , burning with his anger , and the burden thereof is heavy : his lips are full of indignation , and his tongue as a devouring fire :
kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka burom U  Trai  yn ïohi naduh na sha jngai . Ka ding bad ka tdem ki pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u . U kren , bad ki ktien jong u ki meh kum ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka kyrteng U Trai ka wan na jngai, ka thang ia ka jingbitar jong u, bad ka jingkit jong ka ka long kaba khia: ki rmiang shyntur jong u ki dap da ka jingbitar , bad ka shyntur jong u kum ka ding kaba bam:

en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and enquired of him : and he described unto him the princes of Succoth , and the elders thereof , even threescore and seventeen men .
kha: u la ïohkem ïa uwei u samla uba na Sukkoth bad u kylli ïa u . U samla u la thoh na ka bynta u Gideon ïa ki kyrteng jong ki hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh jong ka Sukkoth .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kem ia uwei u samla na ki shynrang jong ka Sucoth bad u la kylli ia u: bad u la batai ha u ia ki rangbah jong ka Sucoth bad ki rangbah jong ka, wat la ki long hynriewphew ngut ki briew .

en: With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .
kha: U don ka bor briew , hynrei ngi don U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi .  Ki briew ki ïoh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki ktien jong u syiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Da u don ka kti jong ka doh ; hynrei bad ngi U Trai U Blei jong ngi ban iarap ia ngi , bad ban ialeh ia ki thma jong ngi . Bad ki briew ki la shongthait ia lade ha ki ktien u Hesekaiah syiem Judah .

en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .
kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , namar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mane blei thala , ki ban sa ïuhroit ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid haduh sawphew ar bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka iingbishar kaba don shabar ka temple ka mih noh, bad ym ju thew ia ka; namar la ai ia ka ha ki Jutang: bad ka nongbah bakhuid kin iaid hapoh ka kjat sawphew ar bnai .

en: And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .
kha: Haba me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pat sha ka krung kamon jong me bad shahshitom sawphew sngi namar ki kam bymman ka ïing Judah — kawei ka sngi namar kawei kawei ka snem jong ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda me la pyndep ia ki, to thiah biang ha ka liang kadiang jong me, bad me kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka iing Judah sawphew sngi: nga la thung ia me man la ka sngi na ka bynta shisnem .

en: And wherefore hath the  Lord  brought us unto this land , to fall by the sword , that our wives and our children should be a prey ? were it not better for us to return into Egypt ?
kha: Balei keiñ U  Trai  u ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri ? Ngin shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki tnga jong ngi lem bad ki khun ki kti kin shah kem . Hato kam long kaba kham bha ba ngin ïaleit phai pat sha Ijipt ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei ba U Trai u la wanrah ia ngi sha kane ka ri, ban hap da ka waitlam, ba ki tnga jong ngi bad ki khun jong ngi kin long ki mrad ? hato kam kham bha ia ngi ban leit phai noh sha Ijipt ?

en: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem , the children of Judah could not drive them out : but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day .
kha: Hynrei ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh noh ïa ki Jebus kiba shong ha Jerusalem . Ki Jebus ki dang shong dang sah hangta lem bad ki paid Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ki khun shynrang jong ka Judah ki khlem lah ban beh ia ki: hynrei ki khun shynrang ki shong bad ki khun shynrang ha Jerusalem haduh kine ki sngi .

en: While we look not at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen : for the things which are seen are temporal ; but the things which are not seen are eternal .
kha: Naba ngi pynleit jingmut , ym ha kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi , hynrei ha kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi . Kata kaba lah ban ïohi ka neh tang shipor , hynrei kata ka bym lah ban ïohi ka neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ngim peit ia kiei kiei kiba la iohi , hynrei ia kiei kiei kiba ym lah ban iohi: namar kiei kiei kiba la iohi ki long kiba shipor; hynrei kiei kiei kiba ym lah ban iohi ki long kiba bymjukut .

en: And the  Lord  hearkened to the voice of Israel , and delivered up the Canaanites  ; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities : and he called the name of the place Hormah .
kha: U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa ki bad u ïarap ïa ki ban jop ïa ki nong Kanaan . Kumta ki Israel ki la pynjot thiaw ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong jong ki , bad ki la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Hormah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la sngap ia ka sur jong ki Israel , bad u la aiti noh ia ki nong Kana bad ki la pynjot lut ia ki bad ki shnong jong ki: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Hormah .

en: And when David came to Ziklag , he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the  Lord   ;
kha: Ynda u Dabid u la wan phai sha Siklag , u phah ai bynta na kata ka mar lute sha ki paralok jong u , ki nongïalam ka Judah , bad ka khubor ,  Kane ka jingai sngewbha ïa phi na ka jinglute ba ngi la shim na ki nongshun U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la poi ha Ziklag , u la phah ia ka jinglute sha ki rangbah Judah , wat sha ki paralok jong u , u da ong: Ha khmih ka jingai na ka bynta jong phi na ka jinglute jong ki nongshun U Trai;

en: And he shall be for a sanctuary  ; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel , for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
kha: Namar ka jinglongkhuid baphylla jong nga , nga long kum u maw uba ki briew ki jynthut ; nga long kum ka jingriam ka ban kem ïa ki briew jong ka Judah bad Israel bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un long na ka bynta ka jaka kyntang ; hynrei na ka bynta u maw uba ia tyngkhuh bad u maw uba pynsngewsih ia baroh ar tylli ki iing Israel , na ka bynta u gin bad na ka bynta ka jingma ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone , where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever .
kha: Nangta ïa u Ksuid , uba la shukor ïa ki , la bret sha ka pung ka ding bad u kyndok , ha kaba la lah bret ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler , bad kin shah pynkordit mynsngi bad mynmiet junom la junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ksuid uba la shukor ia ki u la shah bret ha ka pung ding bad u mawlyngnai , ha kaba u mrad bad u nongiathuhlypa lamler ki don , bad kin shah pynshitom sngi bad miet junom .

en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Moses u dang ap ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , bad u wan poi ha Sinai , u lum uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Moses u la buh ia ka kynhun jong u Jethro u kpa jong u: bad u la ialam ia ka kynhun sha ka liang ba shadien jong ka ri khlaw , bad u la poi sha u lum U Blei , wat sha Horeb .

en: And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
kha: Hadien ba ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ki la leit noh , U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shaphang jong u ha u paidbah :  Haba phi la leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , aïu phi la khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Hato ïa ka sla phlang kaba khun ha ka lyer ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki nonglam khubor jong u Ioannis ki la leit noh , u la sdang ban kren ha ki briew shaphang u Ioannis , Kaei kaba phi la leit sha ka ri khlaw ban iohi ? Ka reed ka la khih da ka Iyer ?

en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , the prophets say unto them , Ye shall not see the sword , neither shall ye have famine  ; but I will give you assured peace in this place .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga tip ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa ki briew ba yn ym don ka thma kane ka jingïapthngan , namar me la kular , ki ong , ba kan don tang ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong, Ah Trai Blei ! ha khmih ki nongiathuhlypa kin ong ha ki , Phin ym iohi ia ka waitlam , lymne phin ym ioh ia ka jingkyrduh ; hynrei ngan ai ia phi ia ka jingsuk kaba skhem ha kane ka jaka .

en: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .
kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la tyllep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh jong u Pharaoh kaba la buddien ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym don kawei ruh na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki um ki la wan phai biang, bad ki la tap ia ki kali kit kulai bad ki shipai u Pharaoh baroh kiba la wan sha duriaw hadien jong ki; ym don shuh shuh uwei ruh na ki .

en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands ? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand ?
kha: Hato phim tip kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong nga bad nga ngi la leh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki hima ? Hato ki blei jong kano kano ka hima ki pyllait ïa la ki briew na u patsha ka Assyria ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim tip ia kaei kaba nga bad ki kpa tymmen jong nga ngi la leh ia ki briew baroh ? hato ki blei jong kita ki ri ki lah ban pynpoi ia ki ri jong ki na ka kti jong nga ?

en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month , in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land .
kha: Nangta , ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kaba dei ka Sngi ka Jingpynïasuk , phah ïa u briew ban pynsawa ïa ka turoi ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to pynlong ia ka turoi jong ka jubilee ban sawa ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi ba la pynkhuid phin sa sawa ha ka ri jong phi baroh kawei .

en: And he said unto Abram , Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs , and shall serve them  ; and they shall afflict them four hundred years  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin long ki nongwei ha ka ri nongwei ; kin long ki mraw hangta , bad kin shah pynshitom beiñ haduh sawspah snem .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Abram , To tip da kaba thikna ba u symbai jong me un long u nongwei ha ka ri kaba ym dei ka jong ki, bad un shakri ia ki ; bad kin pynshitom ia ki saw spah snem ; .

en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
kha: Uta u kpu u dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei ban bam ïa u ha ka jaka kaba kyntang , naba uta u long ka bynta kaba kyntang eh na ki jingainguh bam ba la kñia sha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u; bad kin bam ia ka ha ka jaka bakhuid: namar ka long kaba khuid tam ha u na ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding da ka ain kaba neh .

en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure , having this seal , The Lord knoweth them that are his . And , Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity .
kha: Hynrei ïa ka nongrim baskhem kaba U Blei u la buh ym lah ban pynkhih ; bad halor jong ka la thoh ïa kine ki ktien :  U Trai u ithuh ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u  bad  Baroh kiba ong ba ki dei ki jong U Trai ki dei ban phai noh na kaba leh bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ka nongrim jong U Blei ka ieng skhem, da kaba don ia kane ka muhor , U Trai u tip ia kita kiba long ki jong u . Bad , To ai ba uwei pa uwei uba kyrteng ia ka kyrteng U Khrist un leit noh na ka jingbymhok .

en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
kha: lem bad u Elisaphan u khun jong u Ussiel kum u rangbah kur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingshakri jong ki longiing jong u Gerson ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad ka jingkitkhlieh jong ki kan long hapoh ka kti u Ishaar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh .

en: For he saith , I have heard thee in a time accepted , and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee : behold , now is the accepted time ; behold , now is the day of salvation .
kha: Ha sngap aïu U Blei u ong :  Haba ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pyn-i ïa ka jingshem sngewbha ha phi , nga la ïohsngew ïa phi ; haba ka sngi ka la poi ïa nga ban pynim ïa phi , nga la ïarap ïa phi .  To shahshkor ! Kane ka dei ka kynta ban pdiang ïa ka jingshem sngewbha U Blei ; Mynta , ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingpynim !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u ong , Nga la iohsngew ia me ha ka por ba la pdiang , bad ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynim nga la iarap ia me: ha khmih , mynta ka por ba la pdiang; ha khmih , mynta ka sngi jong ka jingpynim .

en: Son of man , I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; and , lo , it shall not be bound up to be healed , to put a roller to bind it , to make it strong to hold the sword .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ym don ba la sop spaiñ ïa ka lane pynsdien ïa ka khnang ba kan ïohkhiah bad ban khlaiñ kat ban lah ban bat biang ïa ka waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, nga la pynpait ia ka kti jong u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt; bad, ha khmih, kan ym shah teh ban koit, ban buh ia ka rol ban teh ia ka, ban pynlong ia ka ban khlain ban bat ia ka waitlam .

en: Doubtless thou art our father , though Abraham be ignorant of us , and Israel acknowledge us not : thou , O  Lord  , art our father , our redeemer  ; thy name is from everlasting .
kha: Me long u kpa jong ngi . U Abraham bad u Jakob , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , kim pdiang ïa ngi , hynrei ma me , ko  Trai  , me long u kpa jong ngi , uta uba pyllait im ïa ngi borabor .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem artatien me long u kpa jong ngi, wat la u Abraham um tip ia ngi, bad ki Israel kim pdiang ia ngi: me, ko Trai, me long u kpa jong ngi, ko nongsiewspah jong ngi; ka kyrteng jong me ka long naduh bymjukut .

en: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit , how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks , seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest ?
kha: Haba phi ainguh ha U Blei tang ha ka mynsiem , da kumno u riewpaidbah uba shim bynta ha ka jingïaseng u lah ban ong  Amen  ha kata ka jingduwai ainguh jong phi ? Kim don lynti ban sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba phi kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta haba me kyrkhu da ka mynsiem , kumno uta uba shong ha ka kamra jong ki bym nang un ong Amen da kaba ai khublei ia me , haba um sngewthuh ia kaei kaba me ong ?

en: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee .
kha: ‘ Ha khmih’ u la bteng , ‘ Baroh ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin . Nga pynlong ïa kane ban jia namar nga la ïohi ïa baroh kaba u Laban u la leh ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: To rah mynta ia ki khmat jong me, bad peit, baroh ki langbrot kiba jngi halor ki masi ki la tyrkhong, ki la tyrkhong bad ki la tyrkhong: namar nga la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u Laban u leh ia me .

en: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the  Lord s  offering : and every man , with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service , brought it .
kha: Baroh kiba lah ban ai da ka rupa ne da ka rnong ki wallam kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  , bad baroh kiba don ïa ka dieng akasia ïa kaba lah ban pyndonkam , ki wallam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la ai ia ka jingainguh rupa bad ka nar u la wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong U Trai: bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba la lap ia u dieng shittim na ka bynta kano kano ka kam jong ka jingshakri u la wanrah ia ka .

en: Yea , thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem  ;
kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ka Israel , nga ong shaphang ki jingkynshew kiba la iehnoh hapoh ka Templ bad hapoh ka ïingsyiem ha Jerusalem :
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel , shaphang ki tiar kiba sah ha ka iing U Trai bad ha ka iing u syiem Judah bad ka Jerusalem;

en: And Jacob said unto his father , I am Esau thy firstborn  ; I have done according as thou badest me : arise , I pray thee , sit and eat of my venison , that thy soul may bless me .
kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga dei u Iso u khun rangbah jong phi ; nga la leh kumba phi la bthah ïa nga . Sngewbha khie shong , bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , ba phin ïoh ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong ha u kpa jong u, Nga long u Iso u khun nyngkong jong me uba nga la leh katba me ruh: to khie, nga kyrpad ia me, to shong bad bam ia ka bih jong nga, ba ka mynsiem jong me kan kyrkhu ia nga .

en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .
kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa ngi bad ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syiem , bad pynshong nongrim ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ai ba ki khmat jong ngi kin peit ha khmat jong me, bad ka khmat jong ki khun kiba bam ia ka bynta jong ka doh syiem: bad kumba me iohi, to leh bad ki shakri jong me .

en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .
kha: U tip ïa kaei kaba u leh ! U phah ka jingjot . U phah ïa ki jingbyrngem ban pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sniew bad kito kiba ïada ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma u ruh u long uba stad, bad un wanrah ia ka jingsniew, bad un ym khot biang ia ki ktien jong u: hynrei un mih pyrshah ia ka iing jong ki nongleh bymman bad pyrshah ia ka jingiarap jong ki kiba leh ia ka jingbymhok .

en: Whithersoever they went out , the hand of the  Lord  was against them for evil , as the  Lord  had said , and as the  Lord  had sworn unto them : and they were greatly distressed .
kha: Man ka por ba ki leit sha ka thma , U  Trai  u long pyrshah ïa ki , kumba u la lah ong ba un leh kumta . Ki la don ha ka jingkhuslai bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: La ki mih noh, ka kti U Trai ka la long pyrshah ia ki na ka bynta ka jingsniew kumba U Trai u la ong , bad kumba U Trai u la smai ha ki: bad ki la sngewsih shibun .

en: Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: U angel u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha u Serubbabel ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Men jop , ym da ka bor shipai lymne da ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong me , hynrei da U Mynsiem jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab bad u la kren ha nga, u da ong, Kane ka long ka ktien U Trai ha u Serubabel, u da ong: Ym da ka bor ne da ka bor hynrei da ka mynsiem jong nga , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: Again he said unto her , Stand in the door of the tent , and it shall be , when any man doth come and enquire of thee , and say , Is there any man here ? that thou shalt say , No .
kha: Nangta u ong ïa ka ,  Ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ka dara , bad lada uno uno u wan bad kylli ïa phi la hangne don briew ne em , sa ong em .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien u la ong ia ka, To ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ, bad kan long, haba uno uno u briew u wan kylli na me, bad u ong, Hato don mano mano hangne ? ba me ong: Em .

en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
kha: Ha kawei ka sien , ki nongbud jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki Pharisi ki dang ïashahjingit . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wan ha U Jisu bad kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ki synran jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki shahjingit , katba ki jong me kim shahjingit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran u Ioannis bad ki Pharisi ki ju shah jingit: bad ki wan bad ki ong ha u: Balei ki synran u loannis bad ki Pharisi ki shah jingit, hynrei ki synran jong me kim shah jingit ?

en: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the  Lord  , and out of the house of the king , and of the princes , and gave it unto the king of Assyria : but he helped him not .
kha: Kumta u Ahas u shim ïa ka ksiar na ka Templ , na ka ïingsyiem bad na ki ïing jong ki nongïalam jong ki briew , bad u ai ïa ka ha u patsha , hynrei wat kane kam shym la ïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Ahas u la shim noh ia ka bynta na ka iing U Trai bad na ka iing u syiem bad ki rangbah bad u la ai ia ka ha u syiem Assyria: hynrei um shym la iarap ia u .

en: For I have sworn by myself , saith the  Lord  , that Bozrah shall become a desolation , a reproach , a waste , and a curse  ; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes .
kha: Nga da lade hi nga la smai ba kane ka nongbah Bosrah kan long ka jingïohi ba-itriem bad ka ri shyiap ; ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ka bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim . Baroh ki nongrit ba-marjan kin don ha ka jingjot junom . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la smai da lade, ong U Trai, ba u Bosrah un kylla long u nongpynjot, u nongpynjah burom, u nongpynjot bad u nongpynjot ; bad ki nongbah jong ka baroh kin long ki jaboh jabaiñ kiba neh slem .

en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even unto this day , rising early and protesting , saying , Obey my voice .
kha: Haba nga wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , nga la maham kyntang ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga la ïai maham ïa ki briew tad haduh kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la pyrshah jur ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka sngi ba nga la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt, haduh kane ka sngi, nga la mih dang step bad nga la pyrshah, nga ong , Ko sur jong nga .

en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen , and they shall possess their houses : I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease  ; and their holy places shall be defiled .
kha: Ngan wanrah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sniew tam hangne bad ailad ïa ki ban shimti ïa ki ïing jong phi . Ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam jong phi kin duh noh ïa la ka jingsngewskhem ynda nga shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka ha kaba phi mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngan wanrah ia kiba sniew tam na ki nongwei , bad kin don ia ki iing jong ki: ngan pynlong ruh ia ka pop jong kiba khlain ban sangeh noh; bad ki jaka kyntang jong ki kin sa shah pynjakhlia .

en: They shall lick the dust like a serpent , they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth : they shall be afraid of the  Lord  our God , and shall fear because of thee .
kha: Kin par ha ka khyndew kum ki bseiñ ; kin mih shabar na ki kut jong ki , da ka jingkyiuh bad jingsheptieng . Kin phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ha ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sa lympat ia ka dewmet kum u bsein, kin mih na ki thliew jong ki kum ki khniang jong ka khyndew: kin tieng ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi , bad kin tieng namar jong me .

en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .
kha: Phan ym leit khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem sopkjat lane sngewsih ne ïam . Phan pynsep-ei namar ki pop jong pha , bad phan ïa-ud iwei ha iwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki tyre jong phi kin long halor ki khlieh jong phi, bad ki juti jong phi ha ki kjat jong phi: phin ym iam ne iam ; hynrei phin ia sngap jar na ka bynta ki jingbymhok jong phi, bad phin ia sngap jar iwei ia iwei pat .

en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews  speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall , to affright them , and to trouble them  ; that they might take the city .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar ki pyrta ïa kane ha ka ktien Hebru khnang ban pynsheptieng bad pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba don ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah , te kan long kaba kham suk ban knieh ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ha ka jingkren jong ki Jiw ha ki briew jong ka Jerusalem kiba don ha ka kynroh , ban pynkhih ia ki, bad ban pynshitom ia ki ; ba kin shim ia ka nongbah .

en: But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .
kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki ïakren pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap . Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato u khunlung u la ïap ?   Ho-oid , u la ïap ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Dabid u la iohi ba ki shakri jong u ki la sngap jar, u Dabid u la sngewthuh ba uta u khynnah u la iap: namarkata u Dabid u la ong ha ki shakri jong u: Hato uta u khynnah u la iap ? Ki la ong , U la iap .

en: Go , and say to Hezekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will add unto thy days fifteen years .
kha: Te U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Isaïah ban leit pat sha u Hesekaïah ban ong ha u ,  Nga , U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kpa tymmen jong me u Dabid , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me bad ïohi ïa ki ummat jong me ; ngan shah pat ïa me ban im sa khatsan snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad ong ha Hesekaiah , Kumta u Trai u Blei u Dabid u kpa jong me, nga la iohsngew ia ka jingduwai jong me: ha khmih , ngan pyndap ia ki sngi jong me shiphew snem .

en: If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;
kha: Hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba pyneh ïa nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kin phla ia ka jingbymhok jong ki bad ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa jong ki, da ka jingleh be-ijot jong ki kaba ki la leh pyrshah ia nga, bad kata ruh ki la iaid pyrshah ia nga;

en: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool : but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof , neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago .
kha: Khnang ban pynlang ïa ka um , phi la shna ka jaka pynlang um hapoh jong ka nongbah ban bat ïa ka um kaba tuid na ka pung kaba rim . Hynrei phim shym la pynshahshkor ïa U Blei , uba la thmu ïa kane baroh la slem bah bad uba la pynurlong ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la shna ruh ia ka thliew hapdeng ki ar tylli ki kynroh na ka bynta ka um jong ka pung kaba rim: hynrei phim shym la peit sha u nongshna jong ka , lymne phim shym la burom ia uta uba la thaw ia ka mynshuwa .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .
kha: Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Khie leit bad kine ki briew , hynrei kren tang ïa kaba nga ong ha me ban kren .  Kumta u Balaam u la leit ryngkat bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha u Balaam: To leit bad ki briew: hynrei tang ka ktien kaba ngan kren ha me, ba me kren . Kumta u Balaam u la leit bad ki rangbah jong u Balak .

en: And they told him all the words of Joseph , which he had said unto them : and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him , the spirit of Jacob their father revived :
kha: Hynrei haba ki ïathuh ha u ïa kata baroh kaba u Joseph u la ong ïa ki , bad haba u ïohi ïa ki kali ba u Joseph u la phah ban kit ïa u sha Ijipt , u kyndit bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iathuh ha u ia ki ktien baroh jong u Joseph kiba u la ong ha ki: bad haba u la iohi ia ki kali kiba u Joseph u la phah ban kit ia u:

en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :
kha: U Paul sa ba un sdang kren , haba u Gallio u la ong ha kita ki Jiw ,  Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kam sniew ba la leh , kan long kaba shongnia ïa nga ban ïaishah bad ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Paul mynta u la jan plie ia ka shyntur jong u , u Gallio u la ong ha ki Jiw , Lada ka long ka kam kaba bakla ne kaba sniew , ko Jiw , ka daw ba ngan shah ia phi:

en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .
kha: U buh ïa kita ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki kynhun langbrot ha ki shyngoid dih um jong ki . U buh ïa ki hangta , namar ki langbrot ki ju ïa-pakor haba ki wan dih um .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ki dieng kiba u la lum ha khmat ki kynhun ha ki thliew um haba ki kynhun ki wan dih um , ba kin pun khun ynda ki wan dih .

en: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .
kha: haduh lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shiphew hajar kilo u kew , ar hajar litar ka waiñ , ar hajar litar ka umphniang Olib , bad katba donkam ka mluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh shispah tylli ki talent rupa, bad haduh shispah tylli ki jingthew kba, bad haduh shispah tylli ki umsoh bad ka umsoh khlem da ai katno .

en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .
kha: Hynrei , lehse don sawphew san ngut ha ka jaka sanphew ngut kiba hok . Hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei namar ba duna san ngut ?  U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym pynjot noh ïa ka lada nga shem sawphew san ngut kiba hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingshisha kan duna san ngut na ki sanphew ngut ki hok: men pynjot ia ka shnong baroh kawei namar ka jingbym don san ngut ? Bad u la ong , Lada nga shem hangta sawphew san ngut , ngan ym pynjot ia ka .

en: In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Dei ban khleh ïa u bad ka umphniang bad shet ha u khiew ba la tap bad nangta dei ban pynlwet ïa u bad ai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka pan yn shna da ka umphniang ; bad ynda la shet ia ka: bad ki bynta ba la shet jong ka jingknia doh men aiti ia ka da ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
kha: Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei kylleng ki ïathuh lorni shaphang ka kupar jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki la lap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka: ki la shim ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ka: bad ka la pawnam hapdeng ki kynthei ; namar ki la pyndep ia ka jingbishar halor jong ka .

en: Then said the king to Ziba , Behold , thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth . And Ziba said , I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight , my lord , O king .
kha: U syiem u ong ha u Siba ,  Baroh kaba dei ka jong u Mephibosheth ka long ka jong me .   Nga long u shakri jong phi ,  u Siba u jubab .  Ai ba ngan ïai pynsngewbha ïa U Syiem Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha u Siba , Ha khmih, me long baroh kiba iadei bad u Mephibosheth . Bad u Siba u la ong , Nga kyrpad ia me da ka jingsngewrit ba ngan shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem .

en: And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .
kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri baseisoh , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la wanrah ia phi ha ka ri kaba bun, ban bam ia u soh bad ka jingbha jong ka ; hynrei haba phi la rung , phi la pynjakhlia ia ka ri jong nga , bad phi la pynlong ia ka pateng jong nga kaba sngewsih .

en: And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .
kha: Haba ki kylli lada don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha Mispah , ki shem ba ym don uwei ruh na Jabesh ha Gilead kiba la don hangta ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Kaei kaba don na ki jait Israel kaba khlem wan sha ka Mizpah sha U Trai ? Bad, ha khmih, ym shym la wan sha ka jaka shong jaka sah na Jabeshgilead sha ka jingiaseng .

en: And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimaeus , the son of Timaeus , sat by the highway side begging .
kha: Ki la wan sha Jerikho , bad katba U Jisu u sdang ban mihnoh ryngkat bad ki synran jong u bad u paidbah babun , u nongkhrong uba matlah uba kyrteng u Bartimaïos , u khun jong u Timaïos , u dang shong harud lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Jerikos: bad katba u dang mih na Jerikos bad ki synran jong u bad ki briew kiba bun, u Bartimeo uba matlah, u khun u Timayos, u la shong hajan ka liang kaba heh .

en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .
kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad ngan kyrdem halor jong ki lumbah jong nga . Ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na ki jingkit kiba ki don ban bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan pynpra ia u Assyria ha ka ri jong nga, bad halor ki lum jong nga ngan iaid kjat ia u: nangta ka jingkit jong u kan leit noh na ki, bad ka jingkit jong u kan leit noh na ki tyrpeng jong ki .

en: And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .
kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh u Saul , ki loit noh ïa ki atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor babha sha ki blei jong ki bad ha ki briew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ot noh ia ka khlieh jong u, bad ki la weng noh ia ki tiar ialeh jong u, bad ki la phah sha ka ri Philistia sawdong , ban pynmih ia ka ha ka iing jong ki bleithaw jong ki bad hapdeng ki briew .

en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
kha: bad u ong ,  Mynta nga la dap shispah arphew snem bad ngam lah shuh ban long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ba ngan ym ïoh ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga la dap shispah arphew snem mynta ka sngi ngam lah shuh ban mih bad wan rung: ruh U Trai u la ong ha nga: Wat leit sha shiliang kane ka Jordan .

en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .
kha: Kam pher kaei ka jingkylli ba u syiem u la kylli , lane kano ka jingeh kaba u pynpaw , kine ki saw ngut ki la kham tip shiphew shah ban ïa uno uno u nongbatai kupar lane u nongleh myntor ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki kam baroh jong ka jingstad bad jingsngewthuh , ba u syiem u la kylli ia ki , u la shem ia ki shi shah kham bha ban ia ki nongleh jadu bad ki nongleh jadu baroh kiba don ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .

en: For brass I will bring gold , and for iron I will bring silver , and for wood brass , and for stones iron : I will also make thy officers peace , and thine exactors righteousness .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa pha ïa ka ksiar ha ka jaka ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka tama ha ka jaka u nar bad ka dieng , bad u nar ha ka jaka u maw . Ki nongsynshar jong pha kin ym banbeiñ shuh ïa pha ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ban synshar da ka hok bad ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka nar ngan wanrah ia ka ksiar, bad na ka bynta ka nar ngan wanrah ia ka rupa, bad na ka bynta ki maw nar: Ngan pynlong ruh ia ki ophisar jong me ban iasuk, bad ia ki nongkyrshan jong me ban iasuk .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :
kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewsarong ïa ki jingïohipaw jong u lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane kup ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jong u nongïathuhlypa khnang ban shukor ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ki nongiathuhlypa kin sngewlehrain ia kawei pa kawei ka jingphohsniew jong u, haba u la iathuhlypa ; bad kin ym phong da ka jain kaba jem ban thok:

en: And there were seven steps to go up to it , and the arches thereof were before them : and it had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , upon the posts thereof .
kha: La don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka , bad ka kamra rung jong ka , ka la don ha kaba kut marpyrshah ïa ka phyllaw . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong ha ki halor ki kynroh bashapoh kiba phai khmat sha ka lynti ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don hynriew tylli ki step ban kiew sha ka , bad ki arch jong ka ki don ha khmat jong ki: bad ka don ki dieng sohjew, uwei na kane ka liang bad uwei pat na kata ka liang, halor ki post jong ka .

en: For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .
kha: Ha ki hynriew sngi , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la shongthait . Namar kata , nga U  Trai  , nga la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , bad nga la pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ki hynriew sngi U Trai u la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew, ka duriaw bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki: namar kata U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ka sngi Sabha bad u la pynkyntang ia ka .

en: Because of the wrath of the  Lord  it shall not be inhabited , but it shall be wholly desolate : every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .
kha: Namar ka jingbitar jong nga , yn ym don u ban shong ban sah ha Babilon ; kan sah ha ka jingjot , bad baroh kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad lyngngoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbitar U Trai kan ym shong satia: uwei pa uwei uba leit sha Babilon un sngew lyngngoh bad un sngap jar ia ki jingpang jong ka baroh .

en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds , and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph . And Saul sought him every day , but God delivered him not into his hand .
kha: U Dabid u sah ha ka jakarieh ha ri lum kaba ha ka ri khlaw hajan ka Siph . U Saul u ïai pyrshang ban shem ïa u , hynrei U Blei um shym la aiti ïa u Dabid ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shong ha ka ri khlaw ha ki jaka ba skhem, bad u la sah ha u lum ha ka ri khlaw jong u Siph . U Saul u la wad ia u man ka sngi , hynrei U Blei um shym la aiti ia u ha ka kti jong u .

en: Sell that ye have , and give alms  ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
kha: Die noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk . Pynbiang ïa lade ki pla kynshew ki ban ym jot noh , bad kynshew ïa ka spah jong phi ha bneng , ha kaba kan ym duna , namar ba ym don u nongtuh uba lah ban ïoh ïa ka , bad ym don khñiang ba lah ban pynjot ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To die ba phi don, bad ai ia lade ki pla ki bym ju mih, ka spah ha ki bneng ki bym ju jah rngai, ha kaba ym don u nongtuh uba wan shajan, lymne u khnai uba pyut .

en: Also he said , Bring the veil that thou hast upon thee , and hold it . And when she held it , he measured six measures of barley , and laid it on her : and she went into the city .
kha: U Boas u ong ïa ka ,  Law ïa kato ka jaiñkup bad siang ïa ka hangne .  Ka leh kumta , bad u theh hangta jan dap arphew kilo u barli bad u ïarap ïa ka ban kyntiew halor ka tyrpeng jong ka . Nangta ka leit phai bad kata sha shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la ong , To wanrah ia ka jingtap kaba me don halor jong me, bad bat ia ka . Bad haba ka la bat ia ka, u la thew hynriew tylli ki barli, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka : bad ka la leit shapoh shnong .

en: Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
kha: te un tang shu tip ba u la leh pop kumta , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada ka pop jong u kaba u la leh pop ka wan sha ka jingtip jong u: nangta un wanrah ia ka jingainguh jong u, u khun blang, ka kynthei kaba khlem jingduna, na ka bynta ka pop jong u kaba u la leh pop .

en: And it came to pass in the seventh year , in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month , that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the  Lord  , and sat before me .
kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba san jong ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi . Katto katne ngut na ki nongïalam jong ka kynhun ki Israel , ki la ïawan ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ka mon jong U  Trai  , bad ki la shong ha khmat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi kaba phra, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, ba katto katne na ki rangbah Israel ki la wan ban kylli ia U Trai bad ki la shong ha khmat jong nga .

en: Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .
kha: Men kynting ïa ki ha ka lyer ; ka lyer kaba jur kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka  erïong . Te men sa kmen namar nga long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pynkhih ia ki, bad ka Iyer kan rah noh ia ki, bad ka lyer kan pynphriang ia ki: bad me dei ban sngewbha ha U Trai bad to pyndonburom ia U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

en: And when the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them before thee  ; thou shalt smite them , and utterly destroy them  ; thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor shew mercy unto them :
kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u aiti ïa kine ki briew ha phi bad phi jop ïa ki , phi dei ban pynïap lut ïa ki baroh . Wat ïateh jutang bad ki bad wat leh-isynei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba U Trai U Blei jong me un aiti ia ki ha khmat jong me ; me dei ban pynjot lut ia ki ; me dei ban leh ia ka jutang bad ki;

en: Chandigarh : A special court here has directed the CBI to investigate if former UT Pollution Control Committee assistant environment engineer Sandeep Madan cheated with the court .
kha: Chandigarh : Ka Kashari kaba kyrpang hangne ​​ka la bthah ïa ka CBI ban tohkit lada u nongïarap barim ka Environment Engineer jong ka UT Pollution Control Committee u Sandeep Madan u leh thok bad ka Kashari .
translated_en_to_kha: Chandigarh: Ka iingbishar kaba kyrpang hangne ka la bthah ia ka CBI ban tohkit lada u nongiarap barim jong ka UT Pyniaid ia ka mariang u Sandeep Madan u la thok bad ka iingbishar .

en: And I wrote this same unto you , lest , when I came , I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice ; having confidence in you all , that my joy is the joy of you all .
kha: Dei na kata ka daw nga la thoh ïa kata ka shithi sha phi — ngam shym kwah ban wan sha phi bad ba yn pynsngewsih da kita hi ki briew kiba la dei ban pynkmen ïa nga . Naba nga sngewdei ba haba nga kmen , te ma phi baroh phi ïakmen lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la thoh ia kane ha phi baroh , ioh ba ngan sngewsih na ki kiba nga dei ban sngewbha ; da kaba shaniah ha phi baroh , ba ka jingkmen jong nga ka long ka jingkmen jong phi baroh .

en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
kha: Ka bynta ba ki pule ka kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u Mordekai u la lap ïa ka jingsylla ban pynïap ïa u syiem — ka jingsylla da u Bigthana bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki kamra u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la lap ba la thoh ia ka, ba u Mordecai u la iathuh shaphang u Bigthana bad u Teresh, arngut ki kamra jong u syiem, ki nongap ia ka jingkhang, kiba la wad ban buh kti ia u syiem Ahasaerus .

en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la ngeit ïa ki tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki da lade hi . Hynrei ngam shym la ïohsngew wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad ka spah jong phi ki long kiba khraw shibun eh ban ïa kaei kaba la ïathuh ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ngam ngeit ia ki ktien , haduh ba ngan da wan, bad ki khmat jong nga kim shym la iakynduh ia ka: bad, ha khmih, ka jingstad bad ka jingroi jong me ka palat ia ka nam kaba nga la iohsngew .

en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words , of him shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he shall come in his own glory , and in his Father s , and of the holy angels .
kha: Lada u briew u lehrain ïa nga bad ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , te U Khun U Briew un lehrain ïa u haba u wan ha ka burom jong u bad ha ka burom jong U Kpa bad jong ki angel bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar uno uno uba sngewlehrain ia nga bad ia ki ktien jong nga, na u U Khun u briew un sngewlehrain, haba un wan ha la ka jong ka burom bad ha U Kpa jong u bad na ki angel bakhuid jong u .

en: And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ki suh ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang . Ki suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki jain kiba rong saw bad kiba rong saw, ki la shna ia ki jain kiba rong saw, ban leh ia ka jingshakri ha ka jaka bakhuid, bad ki la shna ia ki jain kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron ; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard , and hath not yet eaten of it ? let him also go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man eat of it .
kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep rep bri sohwaiñ , hynrei u bym pat ïohlad ban kheit ïa ki soh jong ka ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un ïoh bam ïa ki soh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uei u briew uba la thung ia ka kper sohjew bad um pat bam ia ka ? to ai ba un leit phai noh sha la iing , ioh ba un iap ha ka thma bad uwei pat u briew un bam ia ka .

en: And he said unto them ,  Cast the net on the right side of the ship , and ye shall find .  They cast therefore , and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes .
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Bret ïa ka jar shaphang kamon jong ka lieng , bad phin sa ngat katto katne .  Kumta ki la bret ïa ka jar bad kim lah tan shuh ïa ka , namar ba ki la ngat bun eh ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To bret ia ka net ha ka liang kadiang jong ka lieng bad phin sa shem . Ki la bret namarkata bad mynta kim lah ban tan ia ka na ka bynta ka jingbun ki dohkha .

en: When he was gone out , his servants came  ; and when they saw that , behold , the doors of the parlour were locked , they said , Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber .
kha: Ki shakri ki la ïawan bad ïohi ba ki jingkhang ki dang khang , Hynrei ki shu pyrkhat ba u syiem u don hapoh bad ba u dang leit rud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda u la leit noh shabar , ki shakri jong u ki la wan; bad haba ki la iohi ia kata, ha khmih ki jingkhang jong ka paralok ki la khang , ki la ong: Hooid u tap ia ki kjat jong u ha ka kamra lyiur jong u .

en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .
kha: Hangta ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la kyrkhu ïa phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi phin ïabam bad ïalehkmen ha kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi la trei shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta phin bam ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad phin sngewbha ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi buh ia ka kti jong phi ha phi bad ha ki iing jong phi, ha kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ia phi .

en: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people , saying , The  Lord  sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard .
kha: Nangta nga la ong ,  U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga kren pyrshah ïa kane ka Templ bad pyrshah ïa kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeremaiah u la kren ha ki rangbah baroh bad ha ki briew baroh , u da ong: U Trai u la phah ia nga ban iathuhlypa pyrshah ia kane ka iing bad pyrshah ia kane ka nong baroh ki ktien kiba phi la iohsngew .

en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .
kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Em , ko  Trai  , wat phah ïa nga . Ngam ju long u nongkren ba-pnah , bad ngam shym long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa nga . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba suki bad uba thlun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Trai, ko Trai jong nga, ngam long uba stad, lymne haduh mynta, lymne namar ba me la kren ha u shakri jong me: hynrei nga long uba slem ban kren bad uba slem .

en: And there were voices , and thunders , and lightnings  ; and there was a great earthquake , such as was not since men were upon the earth , so mighty an earthquake , and so great .
kha: La don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad jingtied pyrthat , bad u jumai uba shyrkhei . Ym pat ju don kum uta u jumai naduh ba la thaw ïa u khunbynriew ; une u la long u jumai uba jur tam na baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ki sur, bad ki jingsawa, bad ki jingshai bad ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw, kumba ym shym la long naduh ba ki briew ki la don ha ka khyndew, kumta ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khlain bor bad kaba khraw .

en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah . And Saul said , God hath delivered him into mine hand  ; for he is shut in , by entering into a town that hath gates and bars .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la leit sha Keilah , bad u ong ,  U Blei u la buh ïa u ha ka bor jong nga . U Dabid u la pynngat ïa lade da kaba leit sha ka nongrit ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la wan sha Keilah . U Saul u la ong, U Blei u la aiti ia u ha ka kti jong nga ; namar u la shah khang, da kaba rung ha ka shnong kaba don ki khyrdop bad ki bar .

en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .
kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka nongbah bad ïa ki kynthei Jentil kiba don ha ki kyrdan kiba halor ha ka imlang ka sahlang kiba la mane ïa U Blei . Ki la sdang ban pynshitom beiñ pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas bad ki la beh ïa ki shabar na ka thain jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhih ia ki kynthei kiba riewblei bad kiba donburom bad ki rangbah jong ka shnong , bad ki la pynmih ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein pyrshah ia u Paul bad u Barnabas bad ki la beh noh ia ki na ki jaka jong ki .

en: And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .
kha: bad mynta une u syiem un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen bad phuh  ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jong nga ki don bad phi . Nga la long u nongïalam jong phi naduh ba nga dang samla haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, u syiem u iaid ha khmat jong phi: bad nga la tymmen bad nga la tyrkhong bad nga la tyrkhong bad nga la iaid ha khmat jong phi: bad nga la iaid ha khmat jong phi naduh ka por ba nga dang rit haduh kane ka sngi .

en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling : likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
kha: Ki shna ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ha rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na kita ki jingkah baroh ar tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ki loops kiba rong saw ha ka tduh jong kawei ka jingtap: kumjuh ruh u la shna ha ka liang kaba kut tam jong kawei pat ka jingtap, ha ka jingpynkylla ia kaba ar .

en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him , How is it that thou , being a Jew , askest drink of me , which am a woman of Samaria ? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans .
kha: Kata ka briew ka la jubab ,  Me long u Jiw , bad nga long ka nong Samaria — te kumno me lah ban pan um na nga ban dih ?  ( Ki Jiw kim pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki khuri bad ki pliang kiba ki nong Samaria ki pyndonkam . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka kynthei ka ong ia u, Kumno kata ka long ba me, uba long u Jiw, me pan ia ka jingdih na nga, kaba long ka kynthei jong ka Samaria ? namar ki Jiw kim don jingiadei bad ki nong Samaria .

en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving , and came to him , and said , Lord , dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone ? bid her therefore that she help me .
kha: Ka Martha ka la khuslai halor ki kam baroh kiba ka la dei ban leh , kumta ka la wan bad ka la ong ,  Ko Trai , hato mem pyrkhat lem ba ka para jong nga ka la ieh ïa nga ban leh ïa ka kam baroh da lade hi ? To ong ïa ka ban wan bad ïarap ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Martha ka la sngew lyngngoh shibun, bad ka la wan sha u, bad ka la ong, ko Trai, hato me sngewthuh ba ka para jong nga ka la iehnoh ia nga ban shakri marwei ? to ai ia ka namarkata ba kan iarap ia nga .

en: But the  Lord  is the true God , he is the living God , and an everlasting king : at his wrath the earth shall tremble , and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation .
kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei bashisha , me long U Blei uba im bad u syiem bymjukut . Haba me bitar , ka pyrthei ka khynñiuh ; ki jaitbynriew kim lah shah ïa ka jingbitar jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai U long U Blei uba shisha, u long U Blei uba im, bad u syiem bymjukut: ha ka jingbitar jong u ka khyndew kan khih , bad ki jaitbynriew kin ym lah ban kohnguh ia ka jingbitar jong u .

en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass , which the  Lord  shall lay upon him , it shall be with tabrets and harps : and in battles of shaking will he fight with it .
kha: Kumba U  Trai  u shoh bad u ïai shoh ïa ki , ki briew jong u pat kin ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki ksing bad ki duitara . U Blei hi da lade un ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha man la ka jaka ba u dieng uba la pynshong nongrim un iaid, uba U Trai un thiah halor jong u, un long da ki taber bad ki harp: bad ha ki thma ba pynkhih un ialeh bad ka .

en: Then I consulted with myself , and I rebuked the nobles , and the rulers , and said unto them , Ye exact usury , every one of his brother . And I set a great assembly against them .
kha: Nga la pynrem ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ,  Phi la banbeiñ ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi !  Nga la khot ïa ka jingïalang paidbah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh bad nga ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iamir jingmut bad lade, bad nga la pynrem ia ki riew rangbah bad ki nongsynshar bad nga la ong ha ki, Phi thikna ia ka jingmyntoi, uwei pa uwei na u hynmen jong u . Bad nga la buh ia ka jingialang kaba khraw pyrshah ia ki .

en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews  ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .
kha: Kumta U Jisu um ïaid shuh ha Judia ha kaba paw , hynrei u la mihnoh bad leit sha ka jaka hajan ka ri shyiap , sha ka shnong ïa kaba la khot ka Ephraim , ha kaba u la sah bad ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu namarkata um ju iaid shuh hapdeng ki Jiw ; hynrei u la leit shata sha ka ri kaba jan bad ka ri khlaw, sha kawei ka shnong kaba la khot Ephraim , bad hangta u la bteng bad ki synran jong u .

en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?
kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Seïon ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong ,  Ka jingbishar U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un lait im na ka ding kaba kum kata ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongpop ha Seion ki tieng ia ka jingtieng kaba la pynlyngngoh ia ki nongleh arsap . Mano napdeng jong ngi ban shong bad ka ding kaba bam ? mano napdeng jong ngi ban shong bad ki jingthang bymjukut ?

en: Your Bible teacher will be pleased to explore the answers with you so that you and your family can “keep yourselves in God’s love , . . . with everlasting life in view .” —Jude 21 .
kha: I nonghikai Baibl jong phi in kmen ban wad lang ïa ki jubab bad phi khnang ba maphi lem bad ka ïing ka sem jong phi phin lah ban ‘ ri noh ia lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih hir hir ia . . . ka jingim bymjukut .’ —Judah 21 .
translated_en_to_kha: U nonghikai Baibl jong phi un sngewbha ban wad bniah ia ki jubab bad phi khnang ba phi bad ka iing jong phi phin lah ban p ia lade ha ka jingieit jong U Blei, . . . da ka jingim bymjukut ha ka jingpeit .

en: Yet Michael the archangel , when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses , durst not bring against him a railing accusation , but said , The Lord rebuke thee .
kha: Wat u Mikhael , u angel rangbah um shym la leh ïa kane . Ha ka jingïakajia jong u bad u Soitan , mynba ki la ïania shaphang uei u ban ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym nud ban pynrem ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong ,  U Trai un da sneng ïa me !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Michael u arnghel, haba u ialeh pyrshah ia u ksuid u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka met u Moses, um shym la wanrah pyrshah ia u ia ka jingkynnoh kaba lyngkot, hynrei u la ong , U Trai u la kyntait ia me .

en: Also in the day of the firstfruits , when ye bring a new meat offering unto the  Lord  , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work :
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , haba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh da u kew thymmai sha U  Trai  , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ka sngi jong ki soh ba nyngkong, haba phi wanrah ia ka jingainguh bam kaba thymmai ha U Trai, hadien ba ki taiew jong phi ki la mih noh, phin sa don ka jingpynlong kaba khuid; phin ym leh ei ei:

en: God is not a man , that he should lie  ; neither the son of man , that he should repent : hath he said , and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken , and shall he not make it good ?
kha: U Blei um long kum ki briew , kiba kren lamler ; Um long kum u briew uba kylla la ka jingmut . Kat kaba u kular , u pyndep ; U kren , bad la pyndep ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei um dei u briew, ba un thok; u khun u briew, ba un kylla bamut: hato u la ong , bad un ym leh ia kata ? lane u la kren , bad un ym pynbha ia ka ?

en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not , lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ , who is the image of God , should shine unto them .
kha: Kim shym la ngeit , namar ba ïa ki jingmut jong ki la kah dum da u blei basniew jong kane ka pyrthei . U khang ïa ki ba kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ha ki , ka jingshai kaba mihnoh na kata ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka burom jong U Khrist , uba long ka dur jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba u blei jong kane ka pyrthei u la pynmatlah ia ka jingmut jong ki ki bym ngeit , ioh ba ka jingshai jong ka gospel ba donburom jong U Khrist , uba long ka dur U Blei kan shai ha ki .

en: The  Lord  reigneth , he is clothed with majesty  ; the  Lord  is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself : the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .
kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem . U kup da ka main longsyiem bad ka bor . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ban pynkhih ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u synshar , u la phong da ka jingkhraw ; U Trai u la phong da ka bor , ha kaba u la pynkhih ia lade: ka pyrthei ruh ka la sahkut , ba ym lah ban pynkhih ia ka .
