en: If there be among you any man , that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night , then shall he go abroad out of the camp , he shall not come within the camp :
kha: Lada don u briew u bymkhuid da kaba liat ksuit mynmiet , u dei ban leit sah shabar kata ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don hapdeng jong phi uno uno u briew u bym khuid namar ka jingbymkhuid kaba pynkylla ia u ha ka por miet , te un leit shabar na ka shnong , un ym wan shapoh ka shnong:

en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .
kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u bad u la ai ha ki ka iktiar ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman bad ban pynkhiah ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingpang bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la khot ia ki shiphew ngut ki synran jong u, u la ai bor ia ki ia ki mynsiem bymkhuid, ban beh noh ia ki, bad ban pynkoit ia ki jingpang baroh bad ki jingpang baroh .

en: And they said unto him , From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the  Lord  thy God : for we have heard the fame of him , and all that he did in Egypt ,
kha: Nangta ki ïathuh ha u ïa kane ka khana :  Bah , ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , namar ngi la ïohsngew shaphang U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la leh ha Ijipt
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u: Na ka ri kaba jngai bha ki shakri jong me ki wan namar ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong me: namar ngi la iohsngew ia ka nam jong u bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha Ijipt .

en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar  ; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar : it is a sin offering .
kha: bad un synreit khyndiat ïa ka snam jong ka ha ka krung jong ka duwan . Ïa ka snam kaba dang sah yn pjiar ha trai ka duwan . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ban map ïa ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un theh ia ka snam jong ka jingknia pop ha ka liang jong ka almari bad ia ka snam kaba sah yn sa pynkhih ha trai jong ka almari: ka long ka jingknia pop .

en: It shall not be quenched night nor day  ; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever : from generation to generation it shall lie waste  ; none shall pass through it for ever and ever .
kha: Kan ing mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad ka tdem kan kiew na ka junom . Ka khyndew kan sah lehnoh-ei na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad yn ym don shuh u ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan ym shah pynlip miet ne sngi shuh shuh: ka tdem jong ka kan kiew junom: na ka pateng sha ka pateng kan long kaba sniew shuh shuh.

en: Forbear to cry , make no mourning for the dead , bind the tire of thine head upon thee , and put on thy shoes upon thy feet , and cover not thy lips , and eat not the bread of men .
kha: Wat ai ba yn pynsngew ïa ki jingïam jong pha . Wat leit kumto khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem jingsopkjat kum ka dak jong ka jingïam pangnud . Wat tap ïa la ka khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
translated_en_to_kha: To shah ban iam, wat sngewsih ia kiba iap, to teh ia ka tyrpeng jong ka khlieh jong me halor jong me, bad to buh ia ki juti jong me ha ki kjat jong me, bad wat tap ia ki rmiang shyntur jong me, bad wat bam ia u kpu jong ki briew .

en: And it shall come to pass , that he that is left in Zion , and he that remaineth in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem :
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem , uba U Blei u la jied ban ïohlait im , yn khot uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uta uba sah ha Seion bad uta uba sah ha Jerusalem yn khot bakhuid, wat ia uwei pa uwei uba la thoh hapdeng kiba im ha Jerusalem:

en: Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .
kha: Ka duwan rnong kaba la thaw da u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , ka don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U syiem Solomon bad ki briew baroh ki la mane ïa U  Trai  hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka jingbam ba la shna da u khun jong u Uri, u khun jong u Hur, u la buh ha khmat ka ïingjaiñ U Trai: bad u Solomon bad ka jingïalang ki la wad ïa ka .

en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie noh ! Khie joit ïa lade bad ïeng ! Pha la dih ïa ka khuri ka jingpynshitom kaba U  Trai  ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phan dih ; pha dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha ban ïaid sheng sheng .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, to khie, to ieng, ko Jerusalem, kaba la dih ha ka kti U Trai ia ka khuri jong ka jingbitar jong u ; me la dih ia ki khniang jong ka khuri jong ka jingkhihwin , bad me la pynkhih ia ki .

en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water , that bringeth forth his fruit in his season  ; his leaf also shall not wither  ; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper .
kha: Ki long kum ki dieng kiba mih harud ka wahduid , kiba seisoh ha ka por kaba dei , bad kiba ki sla jong ki kim tyrkhong . Ki jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un long kum u dieng ba la thung da ki wah um, uba pynmih ia u soh jong u ha ka aiom jong u ; u sla jong u ruh un ym tyrkhong ; bad kaei kaei kaba u leh kan roi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first : and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables , which thou brakest .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba mynshuwa , bad ngan sa thoh ha ki ïa ki ktien kiba la don ha ki mawlyngkniap kiba nyngkong , ïa kiba me la pynpait .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To leh ia me ar tylli ki maw kum ha kaba nyngkong: bad ngan thoh ha kine ki maw ia ki kyntien kiba la don ha ki maw ba nyngkong , kiba me bret noh .

en: Neither hath oppressed any , hath not withholden the pledge , neither hath spoiled by violence , but hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment ,
kha: lane banbeiñ ïano ïano lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynshitom bein ia uno uno, um shym la bat ia ka jingkular, bad um shym la shah pynsniew da ka jingleh donbor , hynrei u la ai ia u kpu jong u ha kiba thngan , bad u la tap ia kiba lyngkhuid da ka jain .

en: But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .
kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kyntait ban shahshkor , kumta u syiem Jehoash u tur shaphrang lem bad ki rangbah jong u bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Amasaiah un ym iohsngew . Namarkata u syiem Israel u la leit shaneng bad ma u bad u syiem Judah ki la ia peit iwei ia iwei pat ha ka khmat ha Betshesh kaba dei ka jong u Judah .

en: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab , the ruler of part of Beth–haccerem  ; he built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Rekhab , u nongsynshar ïa ka Beth Hakkherem distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Synrum . U pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khyrdop ka la pynbha ia u Malchiah u khun u Rehab, u nongsynshar jong ka bynta jong ka Bethhamar; u la tei ia ka, bad u la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka, ki jingkhang jong ka bad ki bar jong ka .

en: Their roaring shall be like a lion , they shall roar like young lions : yea , they shall roar , and lay hold of the prey , and shall carry it away safe , and none shall deliver it .
kha: Ki shipai ki kyrhuh kum ki sing kiba la pynïap ïa ka mrad bad kiba la rong ïa ka sha ka jaka ha kaba ym don ba lah ban knieh ïa ka na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsawa jong ki kan long kum u sing, kin sa rkhie kum ki sing rit: Hooid, kin sa rkhie bein bad kin bat ia ka mrad , bad kin rah noh ia ka da kaba suk , bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynpoi ia ka .

en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof , that the brass of it may be hot , and may burn , and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it , that the scum of it may be consumed .
kha: Mynta buh ïa u khiew rnong ba suda halor ki rnga bad ai ba un sawlep . Te u khiew un long ba la pynkhuid ha ka jinglehniam sa shisien hadien ba ka sarang ka la ing lut ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta sa buh thylli ia ka ha ki dewiong jong ka, ba ka nar jong ka kan long kaba shit, bad kan thang , bad ba ka jingjakhlia jong ka kan long kaba la khleh lang ha ka , ba ka sniehdoh jong ka kan long kaba la bam .

en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
kha: ( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Edom , da kaba jia ryngkhat u don hangta ha kata ka sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta uwei u briew na ki shakri u Saul u la don hangta ha khmat U Trai ; bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Doeg , u nongshong shnong uba kham heh na ki nongap langbrot kiba dei jong u Saul .

en: That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .
kha: khnang ba ,   ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin ym ïohi ; Kin sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngewthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phai sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki iohi ba ki lah ban iohi, bad kim sngewthuh ; bad ki lah ban iohsngew, bad kim sngewthuh lym kumta ha kano kano ka por ki dei ban kylla bamut, bad ki pop jong ki dei ban map ia ki.

en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid , and great pain shall come upon them , as in the day of Egypt : for , lo , it cometh .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan bad ïa ka Ijipt la pynjot , ngan phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha ki liengbah ban pynkhih ïa ki briew ki bym poi pyrkhat jong ka Sudan , bad kin sngewtriem . Kata ka sngi ka la jan wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki nonglam khubor kin leit noh na nga ha ki lieng ban pyntieng ia ki nong Ithiopia ki bym don jingkhuslai, bad ka jingpang kaba khraw kan wan ha ki, kumba ha ka sngi Ijipt: namar, ha khmih, ka wan .

en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , the shittah tree , and the myrtle , and the oil tree  ; I will set in the desert the fir tree , and the pine , and the box tree together :
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki dieng Kedar ban mih ha ka jaka shyiap bad ki dieng Akasia bad ki dieng Martl bad ki dieng Olib . Bad ki khlaw kin mih ha ki jaka shrah ki khlaw dieng Kseh bad dieng Kseh-Juniper bad dieng Kseh-Sypress .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan thung ha ka ri khlaw ia u dieng sohjew, u dieng shittah, bad u dieng umphniang ; ngan buh ha ka ri khlaw ia u dieng ding, bad u dieng pine bad u dieng synduk ryngkat:

en: This is he that came by water and blood , even Jesus Christ  ; not by water only , but by water and blood . And it is the Spirit that beareth witness , because the Spirit is truth .
kha: U Jisu Khrist u long uta uba la wan da ka um jong ka jingpynbaptis jong u bad ka snam jong ka jingïap jong u . U la wan ym tang da ka um , hynrei , da ka um bad ka snam ruh . Bad U Mynsiem da lade hi u phla ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar U Mynsiem u long ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u long uba wan da ka um bad ka snam, wat U Jisu Khrist ruh ym da ka um tang, hynrei da ka um bad ka snam . Bad U Mynsiem uba sakhi , namar U Mynsiem u long ka jingshisha .

en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka sngi ka la poi haba ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka hima u Dabid kaba long kum ka ïing kaba la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngan tei pat ïa ka bad ngan pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju long mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan pynmih ia ka iingjain u Dabid kaba la hap , bad ngan khang ia ki jingpynkhein jong ka ; bad ngan pynmih ia ki jingjot jong u , bad ngan tei ia ka kumba ha ki sngi barim:

en: And it came to pass , that on one of those days , as he taught the people in the temple , and preached the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders ,
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u don ha ka Templ , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ; ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum , lem bad ki tymmen ki san , ki la wan bad ong ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha kawei na kita ki sngi, katba u dang hikai ia ki briew ha ka tempi bad u dang ialap ia ka gospel , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la wan ha u ryngkat bad ki rangbah .

en: The word of the  Lord  came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest , the son of Buzi , in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar  ; and the hand of the  Lord  was there upon him .
kha: Hangta ha Babilonia harud ka wah Khebar , nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga bad nga la sngew ïa ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai ka la wan shai ha u Esekiel u lyngdoh u khun u Buzi ha ka ri jong ki Khaldi hajan ka wah Chebar ; bad ka kti U Trai ka la don hangta halor jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .
kha: U  Trai  u kren biang ha u Moses ,  Bsuh ïa la ka kti shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U Moses u la kohnguh ; bad ynda u sei pat ïa la ka kti , ka la ïoh jingpang kaba la tap da ki jingthohlieh , kum ka ïor .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong shuh shuh ha u, To buh ia ka kti jong me ha ka kpoh jong me . Bad u la buh ia la ka kti ha ka kpoh jong u: bad haba u la sei ia ka: bad haba u la sei ia ka: ha khmih ka kti jong u ka la tyrkhong kum u slap .

en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin ai ka jingainguh thang ia U Trai na ka bynta uwei u masi uba thiang, uwei u langbrot bad hynriew ngut ki langbrot kiba nyngkong; kin long ha phi khlem jingduna:

en: Yea , they are greedy dogs which can never have enough , and they are shepherds that cannot understand : they all look to their own way , every one for his gain , from his quarter .
kha: Ki long kum ki ksew kiba jlawnguid , ki bym ju ïoh bam kdang . Kine nongïalam ruh kim don ka jingshemphang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u leh katba u sngewbit , bad wad ïa la ka jong ka jingmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki long ki kulai kiba thrang ki bym lah ban ioh biang , bad ki long ki nongap langbrot ki bym lah ban sngewthuh: baroh ki peit ia la ka jong ka lynti, uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong u, na ka jaka sah jong u.

en: For it is a day of trouble , and of treading down , and of perplexity by the Lord  God  of hosts in the valley of vision , breaking down the walls , and of crying to the mountains .
kha: Kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingkhih jingmut , ka jingshahjop , bad ka jingkulmar jingmut ha ka Them ka Jingïohipaw , bad U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa ka ha ngi . Ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah jong ngi la tied pynkhyllem , bad ki jingkyang ban ïoh jingïarap ki la sawa hapdeng ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar, bad ka jingkhihwin da U Trai Blei jong ki paid ha ka them jong ka jingphohsniew , ka jingpynpra ia ki kynroh bad ka jingleit sha ki lum .

en: And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob  ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular skhem ban ai ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob ; bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka nongkynti jong phi hi . Nga long U  Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia phi sha ka ri kaba nga la smai ban ai ia ka ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob; bad ngan ai ia ka ha phi kum ka pateng: Nga long U Trai .

en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will , and none shall stand before him : and he shall stand in the glorious land , which by his hand shall be consumed .
kha: U nonghiarthma Syria un leh ïa ki kat kaba u sngewbha , khlem kano kano ka jingïapyrshah . Un ïeng ha ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un ïoh ïa ka baroh ha ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba wan pyrshah ia u un leh kat kum ka mon jong u hi: bad un ieng ha ka ri kaba donburom kaba da ka kti jong u yn pynjot .

en: For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive ? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory , as if thou hadst not received it ?
kha: Uei uba pynlong ïa phi ban sngew kham halor ïa kiwei pat ? Hato ym dei U Blei uba la ai ha phi baroh kaba phi don ? Kumta , te , kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong , kumba kaei kaba phi don , kam dei ka jingai sngewbha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba pynlong ia me ban iapher na uwei pat ? bad kaei kaba me khlem pdiang ? mynta lada me la pdiang ia ka , balei me la pdiang ia ka , kumba me khlem pdiang ia ka ?

en: There is no end of all the people , even of all that have been before them : they also that come after shall not rejoice in him . Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit .
kha: Ka lah ban ym don pud ïa ka jingdon ki briew kiba u syiem u synshar ; haba um don shuh , ym don mano mano uba sngewnguh ïa kaei kaba u la leh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi . Ka long kum ka jingbeh ïa ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don jingkut na ki briew baroh, wat na baroh kiba la don ha khmat jong ki: ki ruh kiba wan hadien kin ym sngewbha ha u . Hooid kane ruh ka long ka jinglong ba sniew bad ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem .

en: Six days thou shalt do thy work , and on the seventh day thou shalt rest : that thine ox and thine ass may rest , and the son of thy handmaid , and the stranger , may be refreshed .
kha: Trei hynriew sngi shi taïew , hynrei wat trei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , khnang ba ki mraw jong phi bad ki nongwei kiba trei bad phi , bad wat ki jingri jong phi hi , kin ïoh shongthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi me dei ban leh ia ka kam jong me, bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew me dei ban shongthait: ba u masi bad ka tdong jong me kin shongthait, bad u khun jong u nongtrei jong me bad u nongwei u lah ban shongthait .

en: Therefore thou art inexcusable , O man , whosoever thou art that judgest : for wherein thou judgest another , thou condemnest thyself ; for thou that judgest doest the same things .
kha: Hato , ko paralok jong nga , phi bishar ïa kiwei pat ? Phim lah lait satia , lada phi long uei uei ruh . Namar haba phi bishar ïa kiwei bad nangta phi leh ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ki leh , phi pynrem ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me long uba ym lah ban map, ko briew, mano mano ruh ba me bishar: namar ha kaba me bishar ia uwei pat, me pynrem ia lade; namar me uba bishar me leh ia kijuh kiei kiei .

en: And king David said to Ornan , Nay  ; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the  Lord  , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .
kha: Hynrei u Syiem u jubab ,  Em , ngan siew ha me ïa ka dor ba-pura . Ngan ym ai kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me , da kaei kaba shu ïoh ei .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Dabid u la ong ha u Ornan, Em; hynrei ngan thied shisha ia ka ha ka dor kaba pura: namar ngan ym shim ia kata kaba long ka jong me na ka bynta U Trai, lymne ngan ym ai ia ki jingknia thang khlem da siew ei ei .

en: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing : but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha U Blei ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha U Blei, Nga la leh pop shibun, namar nga la leh ia kane: hynrei mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, to weng noh ia ka jingbymhok jong u shakri jong me; namar nga la leh bieit shibun .

en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings . So the  Lord  was entreated for the land , and the plague was stayed from Israel .
kha: Nangta u la thaw ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka jingïapthem ha Israel ka la sangeh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la tei hangta ia ka jingknia bad ki jingknia iasuk . Kumta u Trai u la shah pynkhih na ka bynta ka ri , bad ka khlam ka la sah na Israel .

en: This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :
kha: U long ma u , uba la ïadon lem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ha ka ri shyiap ; u la don lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi lem bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , bad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ban ai pateng ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u long ma u , uba la don ha ka balang ha ka ri khlaw bad u angel uba la kren ha u ha u lum Sinai bad bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi: uba la pdiang ia ki jingkren lyngkot kiba im ban ai ha ngi:

en: And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .
kha: Haba ki jingri kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u Jakob u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha khmat jong ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin dup seng khun hapdeng kita ki tnat dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , katba ki masi kiba kham khlain ki la pun khun , ba u Jakob u la buh ia ki dieng ha khmat ki masi ha ki thliew , ba kin pun khun hapdeng ki dieng .

en: And they beckoned unto their partners , which were in the other ship , that they should come and help them . And they came , and filled both the ships , so that they began to sink .
kha: Kumta ki la ai dak ïa ki paralok jong ki kiba ha kawei pat ka lieng ban wan bad ïarap ïa ki . Ki la wan bad pyndap smam ïa ki lieng baroh ar tylli da ki dohkha , ba ki lieng ki la jan ngam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren bad ki paralok jong ki kiba don ha kawei pat ka lieng, ba kin wan iarap ia ki . Ki la wan bad ki la pyndap ia baroh ar tylli ki lieng haduh ba ki la sdang ban ngam jyllop .

en: And if so be that the king s wrath arise , and he say unto thee , Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight ? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall ?
kha: u lah ban bitar bad kylli ïa phi , ‘ Balei ba phi da leit tur shaduh sha jan eh jong ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ki ? Phim sngewthuh ba kin siat da ki khnam na ki kynroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka long kumta ba ka jingbitar jong u syiem ka mih , bad u ong ha me , Balei phi la leit shajan ka shnong haba phi la ialeh ? phim tip ba kin siat na ka kynroh ?

en: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .
kha: Ka leit rah ïa u kew sha shnong bad ka pyn-i ha la ka kiaw kurim haduh katno ka la lum . Ka la ai ruh ha ka ïa kata ka jingbam kaba sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la shim ia ka sha jrong , bad ka la leit shapoh shnong : bad ka kmie tymmen jong ka ka la iohi ia kaei kaba ka la lum: bad ka la wanrah ia ka , bad ka la ai ha ka ba ka la buh lypa hadien ba ka la biang .

en: If he rise again , and walk abroad upon his staff , then shall he that smote him be quit : only he shall pay for the loss of his time , and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed .
kha: lada uta uba shah shoh u hap thiah pang , hynrei hadien u lah ban khie pat bad ban ïaid shabar da kaba kyrshan ha u diengduh , uta uba shoh ïa u , u dei ban buria ïa ka por kaba u la duh bad ban sumar na ka bynta jong u haduh ba un da jem bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u kiew biang bad u iaid shabar ri halor u diengduh jong u, te uta uba la shoh ia u un shah iehnoh: tang ma u un siew ia ka jingduh noh ia ka por jong u , bad un pynlong ia u ban koit pura .

en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you  ; for thee , and for thy servant , and for thy maid , and for thy hired servant , and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee ,
kha: Wat la ka khyndew ha kata ka snem ka sah shrah , kan pynmih jingbam hi ïa phi , ïa ki mraw jong phi , ïa ki nongbylla jong phi , ïa ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Sabha jong ka ri kan long ka jingbam na ka bynta jong phi, bad na ka bynta u shakri jong me, bad na ka bynta ka shakri ba la siew jong me, bad na ka bynta u nongwei jong me uba sah bad me .

en: And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again  ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .
kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , u la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judia , bad u la jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan . Ki paidbah ki la ïalum biang ha u , bad u la hikai ïa ki , kumba u ju leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la mih nangta, bad u wan sha ki jaka jong ka Judaea ha ka liang kaba kham jngai jong ka Jordan: bad ki briew ki leit phai biang sha u ; bad kumba u la ju long, u la hikai biang ia ki .

en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread  ; and they that were hungry ceased : so that the barren hath born seven  ; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble .
kha: Kito kiba la im pahuh pahai shisien mynta ki leit bylla ban ïoh bam , hynrei kito kiba thngan kim thngan shuh . Ka briew kaba lyngki ka ïoh khun hynñiew ngut , hynrei ka kmie kaba bun ki khun ka sah marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiba la dap ki la shim ia lade na ka bynta u kpu ; bad kito kiba la thngan ki la sangeh noh: kumta ka barren ka la kha hynriew ; bad kata kaba don bun ki khun ka la nang tlot .

en: And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .
kha: Ka Hannah ka la duwai :  U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da ka jingkmen ; katno nga sngewtynnat namar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga rkhie ïa ki nongshun jong nga ; katno nga shadkmen namar ba U Blei u la ïarap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hannah u la duwai bad u la ong: Ka dohnud jong nga ka sngewbha ha U Trai: ka shyntur jong nga ka la nang heh halor ki nongshun jong nga; namar nga sngewbha ha ka jingpynim jong me .

en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki kin sa die ïa ki sha jngai sha ki Sabean . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan die ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong phi ha ka kti jong ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong phi ha ka kti jong ki khun shynrang bad kynthei: namar U Trai u la kren ia kata .

en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them , every one that entereth into the service , to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Uba rangbah duh na ki Lebi u dei u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh . U dei uba khmih ïa kito kiba pyndep ïa ki kamram ha ka Jaka Kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh laiphew snem shaneng haduh sanphew snem to khein ia ki , uwei pa uwei uba rung ha ka jingshakri , ban leh ia ka kam jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .
kha: Ym don u shakri uba lah ban long u mraw jong ki ar ngut ki kynrad ; un isih ïa uwei bad un ieit ïa uwei pat ; un kohnguh ïa uwei bad un ñiewbeiñ ïa uwei pat . Phim lah ban shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ka spah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don u shakri uba lah ban shakri arngut ki kynrad: namar un shun ia uta uba don, bad un ieit ia uwei pat lane lym kumta un bat ia uta uba don, bad un leh bein ia uwei pat . Phi lah ban shakri ia U Blei bad u mammon .

en: He and his people with him , the terrible of the nations , shall be brought to destroy the land : and they shall draw their swords against Egypt , and fill the land with the slain .
kha: Ma u bad ka kynhun shipai bymsalia jong u kin wan ban pynjulor ïa ka ri . Kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt da ki waitlam , bad ka ri kan dap da ki metïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U bad ki briew jong u bad u, kiba shyrkhei jong ki jaitbynriew, kin shah pynjot ia ka ri: bad kin ring ia ki waitlam jong ki pyrshah ia ka ri Ijipt bad kin pyndap ia ka ri da kiba la shah pyniap .

en: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .
kha: Nangta u Jakob u mihnoh na Beersheba . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynshong ïa u , ïa ki khun rit jong ki , bad ïa ki tnga jong ki , ha kita ki kali kiba u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah ban kit ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la kiew na Beersheba: bad ki khun Israel ki la kit ia u kpa jong ki bad ki khun rit jong ki bad ki tnga jong ki ha ki kali kiba u Pharaoh u la phah ban kit ia u .

en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar ; bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaiah jong ka Libna .

en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him , then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand  ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .
kha: Lada uta uba wad kput u bud ïa u shata , ki briew jong ka nongbah kim dei ban aiti ïa u ha uta . Ki dei ban ïada ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa u briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat bad ym na ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u nongpyniap snam u bud ia u , te kin ym aiti ia u nongpyniap briew sha ka kti jong u ; namar u la shoh ia u para marjan jong u khlem da tip , bad um shym la shun ia u shuwa .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold , I went out to withstand thee , because thy way is perverse before me :
kha: U angel u la kylli ,  Balei me da sympat kumne ïa la ka kada ha kine lai sien ? Nga la wan ban khang lynti ïa me namar mem shym la dei ban leit sha kane ka jingleit .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la ong ha u: Balei me la pynkhih ia ka tdong jong me ha kine ki lai sien ? ha khmih , nga la leit shabar ban ialeh pyrshah ia me , namar ka lynti jong me ka long kaba bakla ha khmat jong nga:

en: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you , because ye go to law one with another . Why do ye not rather take wrong ? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded ?
kha: Ka jingshisha ba phi ïadon ki jingïakajia hapoh ka aiñ hapdeng jong phi hi , ka pyn-i phi la rem nadong shadong . Hato kam kham bha ïa phi ban shah bymdei ? Hato kam kham bha ba phin shah lute noh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka don ka jingbakla kaba khraw hapdeng jong phi, namar phi leit sha ka ain iwei ia iwei pat . Balei phim kham sngewbha ban shim bakla ? balei phim kham shah ia lade ban shah pynduh ?

en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man , whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty .
kha: Lada uno uno u kum ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid kaba mih na u briew , la ka long kaba kumno kumno , u long uba la rem hi mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada u ktah ia ka jingbymkhuid jong u briew, kaei kaei ka jingbymkhuid kan long ba u briew un shah pynjakhlia bad u la buhrieh na u ; haba u tip ia ka, te un sa shah pynrem .

en: Woe unto them ! for they have fled from me : destruction unto them ! because they have transgressed against me : though I have redeemed them , yet they have spoken lies against me .
kha: A ki long kiba la tim ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ïeng pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa ki yn pynduh noh . Nga la kwah ban pyllait im ïa ki , hynrei ka jingmane jong ki ïa nga ka long kaba thala .
translated_en_to_kha: To ia ki ! namar ki la phet noh na nga: ka jingpynjot ia ki ! namar ki la iaid lait ia nga: wat la nga la siewspah ia ki , hynrei ki la kren thok pyrshah ia nga .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Kim shym burom ïa ki shyieng u syiem Edom da kaba thang haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein ia ka Moab , bad na ka bynta saw tylli , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar u la thang ia ki shyieng jong u syiem ka Edom sha ka dewbilat:

en: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you , I am not ashamed ; but as we spake all things to you in truth , even so our boasting , which I made before Titus , is found a truth .
kha: Nga la kob sarong shaphang jong phi ha u , bad phim shym pynduh jingkyrmen ïa nga . Ngi la kren borabor ïa ka jingshisha ha phi , bad ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingkob sarong kaba ngi la ong ha u Titos la ka long kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga la sngew sarong ei ei ha u na phi , ngam sngewlehrain hynrei kumba ngi kren ia kiei kiei baroh ha phi ha ka jingshisha , wat la katta ruh ka jingsngew sarong jong ngi kaba nga la leh ha khmat u Titus , la shem ia ka jingshisha .

en: And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;
kha: Haba ka la dep ai um , uta u briew u shim ïa ka sati ksiar kaba remdor bad u pyndait ha ka khmut jong ka , bad u pyndeng ruh ar tylli ki khadu ksiar kiba heh ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, kumba ki kulai ki la dih, ba uta u briew u la shim ia ka shkor ksiar kaba shiteng Shekel , bad ar tylli ki bracelet na ka bynta ki kti jong ka kiba shiphew Shekel ksiar ; .

en: And he entered into one of the ships , which was Simon s , and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land . And he sat down , and taught the people out of the ship .
kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor kawei na ki lieng — kaba long ka jong u Simon — bad u la kyrpad ïa u ban ñiat tang khyndiat na ka rud duriaw . U Jisu u la shong ha ka lieng bad u la hikai ïa u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rung ha kawei na ki lieng kaba long u Simon s bad u la duwai ia u ba un beh noh khyndiat na ka ri . U la shong bad u la hikai ia ki briew na ka lieng .

en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision , that the law of Moses should not be broken  ; are ye angry at me , because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day ?
kha: Lada ïa u khynnah la otsher ha ka sngi Sabbaton ba yn ym pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum u Moses , balei phi bitar ïa nga namar ba nga pynkhiah ïa u briew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew ha ka sngi Sabha u ioh ia ka jingotsher , ba ka hukum u Moses kan ym shah pynpra ; phi bitar ia nga , namar nga la pynlong ia u briew baroh kawei ha ka sngi Sabha ?

en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .
kha: Hato mem ngeit , ko Philip , ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga ? Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  kim shym la wan na nga hi . U Kpa , uba ïaisah bad nga , u trei la ka jong ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ngeit ba nga don ha U Kpa bad U Kpa ha nga ? ki ktien kiba nga kren ha phi ngam kren na lade: hynrei U Kpa uba shong ha nga , u leh ia ki kam .

en: And I stayed in the mount , according to the first time , forty days and forty nights  ; and the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also , and the  Lord  would not destroy thee .
kha: Nga la sah ha uta u lum sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , kumba nga la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong . U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga sa shisien bad um mon ban pynjot ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la sah ha u lum, kat kum ka sien kaba nyngkong, sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet bad U Trai u la sngap ia nga ha kata ka por ruh , bad U Trai un ym pynjot ia me .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon them , which they shall not be able to escape  ; and though they shall cry unto me , I will not hearken unto them .
kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga maham ïa ki ba ngan wanrah ka jingpynjot halor jong ki , bad kin ym lah ban lait . Bad haba ki kyang sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor jong ki , kaba kin ym lah ban lait ; bad wat la kin pyrta ha nga , ngan ym sngap ia ki .

en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,
kha: Wat shah ïa lade ban shah pynrem da uno uno uba kam ba u long uba kham hakhlieh namar ki jingïohipaw kiba kyrpang bad uba ïai ban ha ka jingsngewrit bymdei bad ha kaba mane ïa ki angel . Naba khlem kano kano ka daw , ïa kiba kum kine ki briew la pynmeng shikatdei da ka rukom pyrkhat briew bad ki la sangeh ban batskhem ha U Khrist , uba long u khlieh jong ka met .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un pynshoi ia phi da ka jinglong ba sngewrit bad ka jingmane ia ki angel , da kaba rung sha kita kiei kiei kiba um pat iohi , khlem da pyrkhat ei ei da ka jingmut ba kynja doh jong u .

en: But when he seeth his children , the work of mine hands , in the midst of him , they shall sanctify my name , and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall fear the God of Israel .
kha: Haba phin ïohi ïa ki khun kiba ngan ai ha phi , te phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel . Phin sa burom ïa nga bad phin ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda u la iohi ia ki khun jong u, ka jingtrei jong nga, hapdeng jong u, kin pynkyntang ia ka kyrteng jong nga, bad kin pynkyntang ia U Bakhuid jong u Jakob, bad kin sheptieng ia U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong ki :  Ma ngi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ki hynmen ki para jong phi , ngi phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thoh ia ki shithi da ki ha kane ka rukom ; Ki apostol bad ki rangbah bad ki para ki phah khublei ia ki para kiba long na ki Jutang ha Antiok bad Syria bad Kilia:

en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .
kha: U syiem u ong ha u ,  Nga la phohsniew ïa ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai ïa ka . La ïathuh ha nga ba me lah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ong ha u Joseph, nga la phohsniew ia ka jingphohsniew, bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban batai ia ka: bad nga la iohsngew ba me ong shaphang jong me, ba me lah ban sngewthuh ia ka jingphohsniew ban batai ia ka .

en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the  Lord  , saying ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u syiem Josaïah u phah ïa u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u khun jong u Asalaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshullam , sha ka Templ bad ka hukum :
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong u syiem Josiah, u syiem u la phah ia u Shaphan u khun u Ataliah u khun u Meshullam u nongthoh sha ka iing U Trai da kaba ong:

en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?
kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Joshua , ki paid Israel ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Mano na ki jait jong ngi kaba dei ban leit nyngkong ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien ka jingiap u Joshua ka la jia ba ki khun Israel ki la kylli ia U Trai da kaba ong: Mano ba leit sha jrong na ka bynta jong ngi pyrshah ia ki nong Kanaan nyngkong eh ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki ?

en: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate , and an helmet of salvation upon his head  ; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing , and was clad with zeal as a cloak .
kha: Un kup ïa ka hok kum ka jingïada shadem , bad ïa ka bor bapynim kum ka jingda khlieh . U kup ïa lade da ka jingangnud kaba khraw ban buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei bad ban pynshitom bad pynhiarkput ïa ki jingsniew kiba ki briew ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la phong ia ka hok kum ka jainkup, bad ka helmet jong ka jingpynim ha ka khlieh jong u ; bad u la phong ia ki jainkup jong ka jingsiew kylliang na ka bynta ki jainkup , bad u la phong da ka jingkmen kum ka jainkup .

en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .
kha: Hynñiew sngi phim dei ban mih na ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , tat ynda la pyndep lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym mih na ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ha ki hynriew sngi, haduh ba ki sngi jong ka jingpynkyntang jong phi kin kut noh: hynriew sngi un pynkyntang ia phi .

en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .
kha: U Dabid u la ai ruh ïa ki dur pynkhreh kiba ïadei bad ki jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , bad pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , ban trei ïa ki kam jong ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh na ka bynta ki jinghikai jong ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad na ka bynta ki kam baroh jong ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .
kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlong bad to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim tang da kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka dujok ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, to sei ia ka, bad bret noh ia ka na me: ka kham bha ia me ban rung sha ka jingim da kawei ka khmat, ban ia kaba don ar tylli ki khmat ban shah bret ha ka ding dujok .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .
kha: Bad baroh kiei kiei kiba u Abijah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Abijam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ? Bad ka la don ka thma hapdeng u Abijam bad u Jeroboan .

en: I tell you , this man went down to his house justified rather than the other : for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased  ; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  u nonglum khajna , bad ym u Pharisi , uba don ha ka liang kaba dei bad U Blei haba u leit noh sha ïing . Naba ïa uno uno uba pynkhraw ïa lade yn pynrit , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit yn pynkhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ong ia phi, une u briew u la leit hiar sha la iing da kaba hok ban ia uwei pat: namar uwei pa uwei uba pynkhraw ia lade un shah pynjah burom ; bad uta uba pynrit mynsiem ia lade un shah pynkhraw .

en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba dang sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka umphniang kaba sah ha ka kti jong u lyngdoh un theh ha ka khlieh jong uta uba dei ban pynkhuid: bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u ha khmat U Trai .

en: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk , and his heart was merry , he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn : and she came softly , and uncovered his feet , and laid her down .
kha: Haba u Boas u la dep bam dep dih , u la don ha ka jingsngewtynnat bha . U leit sha ka kynton barli bad u thiah hangta . Ka Ruth ka leit jar jar , ka khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad ka thiah ha ki kjat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Boaz u la bam bad u la dih kyiad, bad ka dohnud jong u ka la sngewbha, u la leit thiah ha kaba kut jong u kew: bad ka la wan jem jai, bad ka la tap ia ki kjat jong u, bad ka la thiah ia ka .

en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall put off the linen garments , which he put on when he went into the holy place , and shall leave them there :
kha: Nangta u Aaron un leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , un law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh kiba u la kup shuwa ba un leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un buh ïa ki hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un wan shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang, bad un weng noh ïa ki jain lin kiba u phong haba u leit sha ka jaka bakhuid bad un iehnoh ïa ki hangta :

en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel : and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains , and caves , and strong holds .
kha: Ki Midian ki long kiba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ki Israel , bad ki paid Israel ki rieh ïa lade na ki ha ki krem bad ha kiwei pat ki jaka bashngain ha ki lumrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kti jong u Midian ka la jop ia ki Israel: bad namar ki nong Midian ki khun Israel ki la pynlong ia ki ki thliew kiba don ha ki lum bad ki krem bad ki jingbat kiba khlain .

en: The little chambers thereof , the posts thereof , and the arches thereof , and the windows to it round about : the length was fifty cubits , and the breadth five and twenty cubits .
kha: Kum ma ki , ka ruh ka la don ki kamra ap phira , ki kynroh bashapoh ba la pynitynnat , ka kamra rung , bad ki jingkhangïit baroh sawdong . Ka lynter jong ka baroh ka la long arphew san mitar , bad ka pyngkiang jong ka khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kamra rit jong ka, ki tnum jong ka, bad ki ar tylli ki tnum jong ka: ka jingjrong ka long sanphew cubit bad ka jingjrong sanphew cubit .

en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingjot ha me . Ngan sar noh phar ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jong me , la u samla bad tymmen kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha me , bad ngan weng noh na u Ahab ia uta uba sngap jar pyrshah ia ka kynroh bad ia uta uba la shah khang bad uba sah ha Israel .

en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth , neither whatsoever worketh abomination , or maketh a lie : but they which are written in the Lamb s book of life .
kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano ka bymkhuid ka ban ïohrung sha ka nongbah , lymne uno uno uba leh ïa kino kino kiba sngewlehrain lane uba ïathuh lamler . Tang kito ïa kiba ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im jong U Khunlangbrot kin ïohrung sha kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym rung ha ka kano kano ka jingjia kaba jakhlia, lymne kaei kaei kaba pynsniew ne kaba pynlong ia ka jinglamler: hynrei kita kiba la thoh ha ka kot jingim jong u Khunlangbrot .

en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?
kha: Nangta u Dabid u phet na Naïoth kaba ha Ramah bad u leit sha u Jonathan .  Kaei kaba nga la leh ?  u kylli .  Ka kam sniew aïu nga la leh ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ïa i pa jong phi ba i da thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phet noh na Naiot ha Ramah bad u la wan bad u la ong ha khmat u Jonathan, Nga la leh aiu ? bad kaei ka pop jong nga ha khmat u kpa jong me ba u wad ia ka jingim jong nga ?

en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished  ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .
kha: Hadien kata , u Judas u nong Galilaïa u la mih ha ka por jong ka jingkheiñbriew ; u la khring ïa u paidbah ban bud ïa u , hynrei ïa u ruh la pynïap , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsakma .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien une u briew u la mih u Judas na Galilaia ha ki sngi jong ka jingsiew khajna, bad u la pynkynriah noh ia ki briew kiba bun hadien jong u: u ruh u la jah noh; bad baroh, wat kiba kohnguh ia u, ki la jah noh .

en: And thou shalt beat some of it very small , and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation , where I will meet with thee : it shall be unto you most holy .
kha: Tylliat khyndiat ïa ka haduh ba kan da lwet ni bha , rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ber ïa ka ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Kheiñ ïa kane ka jingiwbih kum kaba da kyntang janai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shoh katto katne na ka kaba rit bha, bad buh ia ka ha khmat ka jingphla ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, ha kaba ngan iakynduh bad me: kan long ha phi kaba khuid tam .

en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .
kha: Nga la kylli , ‘ Aïu ngan leh , A Trai ?’ bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit bad leit sha Damaskos , bad hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la thmu na ka bynta jong me ban leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong, Nga dei ban leh aiu ko Trai ? Bad U Trai u la ong ha nga, To khie bad leit sha ka Damaskos ; bad hangta yn sa iathuh ia me ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la buh ia me ban leh .

en: And they said unto him , We have dreamed a dream , and there is no interpreter of it . And Joseph said unto them , Do not interpretations belong to God ? tell me them , I pray you .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew la ka jong ka jong ka jingphohsniew , bad ym don mano mano hangne u ban batai ïa ka jingmut ki .  Te u Joseph u ong ,  Dei U Blei uba ai ka jinglah ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew . To ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingphohsniew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Ngi la phohsniew ia ka jingphohsniew, bad ym don u nongpynkylla ia ka . U Joseph u la ong ha ki , Hato ki jingbatai ki dei ki jong U Blei ? iathuh ia nga , nga kyrpad ia phi .

en: Why will ye die , thou and thy people , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence , as the  Lord  hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon ?
kha: Balei ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi phin ïap ha ka thma lane ha ka jingïapthngan lane ha ka jingpang ? Kata ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka bym pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei phin iap, ma me bad ki briew jong me, da ka waitlam, da ka jingkyrduh bad da ka jingpang khlam, kumba U Trai u la kren pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew kaba ym shakri ia u syiem Babilon ?

en: So the priest gave him hallowed bread : for there was no bread there but the shewbread , that was taken from before the  Lord  , to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away .
kha: Kumta uta u lyngdoh u ai ha u Dabid ïa uta u kpu bakyntang , namar u kpu uba u don , u dei uba la ainguh ha U Blei , ïa uba la weng noh na ka miej bakyntang , bad ba la bujli da u kpu uba dang lah shet .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u lyngdoh u la ai ia u kpu ba la pynkyntang: namar ym don kpu hangta hynrei ia u kpu ba la shim na khmat U Trai , ban buh ia u kpu ba shit ha ka sngi ba la shim noh ia u .

en: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi , Let me now go to the field , and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace . And she said unto her , Go , my daughter .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Ruth ka ong ha ka Naomi ,  Shah ba ngan leit sha ki lyngkha ban tam ïa u kew ba ki nongot ki ieh . Nga thikna ban shem u briew u ban shah ïa nga ban trei bad u .  Ka Naomi ka ong ,  Khie leit , ko khun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ruth ka Moab u la ong ha u Naomi, To ngan leit sha lyngkha, bad ngan lum ia ki shkor kew hadien jong u ha uba ngan shem ia ka jingaiei . Bad ka la ong ia ka, To leit noh, ko khun jong nga .

en: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .
kha: Ka por kan poi , bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ïa phi baroh yn sa pynsakma , uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka ïing , bad ngan shah iehnoh tang marwei . Hynrei ngam long shisha marwei , namar U Kpa u long lem bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ka por ka wan, em, mynta ka la wan, ba phin sa shah pynpra noh, uwei pa uwei ha la ka jong ka jong ka jaka bad phin iehnoh ia nga marwei: bad wat la katta ruh ngam long marwei, namar U Kpa u don ryngkat bad nga .

en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it  ; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein , to make dumb idols ?
kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam jong ka bleithaw ? Ka long tang kaei kaei kaba la thaw da u briew , bad kam kren ei ei hynrei ka shukor . Kaei kaba bha ba ka leh ïa u nongthaw ba un shaniah ha ka — U Blei u bym lah wat ban kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingmyntoi ia ka dur ba la ker da u nongshna jong ka; ka dur ba la khleh lang bad u nonghikai ia ki jinglamler , ba u nongshna ia ka kam jong u u shaniah ha ka , ban shna ia ki bleithaw kiba dum ?

en: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,
kha: Ïa ka histori jong u syiem Dabid naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha ki kot buh jingkynmaw jong ki lai ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Samuel , u Nathan , bad u Gad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki kam jong u syiem u Dabid, nyngkong bad khatduh, ha khmih, la thoh ha ka Kitab u Samuel u nongiohi, bad ha ka Kitab u Natha u nongiathuhlypa, bad ha ka Kitab u Gad u nongiohi , .

en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :
kha: Ha kata ka por phi bud ïa ka rukom im basniew jong ka pyrthei ; phi la kohnguh ïa u nongsynshar jong ki bor mynsiem ha ka haw haw , u mynsiem uba synshar mynta ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba ha ka por ba la leit noh phi la iaid kat kum ka jinglong jong kane ka pyrthei , kat kum u syiem jong ka bor jong ka Iyer , ka mynsiem kaba mynta ka trei ha ki khun ka jingbym kohnguh:

en: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands , and brought it down unto us , and brought us word again , and said , It is a good land which the  Lord  our God doth give us .
kha: Ki la wanrah khyndiat ki soh ba ki shem hangta , bad ki la ïathuh ruh ba kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi ka long kaba seisoh bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia u soh jong ka ri ha ki kti jong ki, bad ki la wanrah ia u sha ngi, bad ki la wanrah biang ia ngi, bad ki la ong: Ka long ka ri kaba bha kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi .

en: Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Hynrei la kumno kumno pyn-i ka jingñiewkor ïa nga ha khmat ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong nga bad ki Israel baroh . Ïaleit phai ryngkat bad nga , ba ngan lah ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong: hynrei to burom ia nga mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, ha khmat ki rangbah jong nga bad ha khmat ki Israel, bad to phai biang bad nga, ba ngan mane ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise : and another shall rise after them  ; and he shall be diverse from the first , and he shall subdue three kings .
kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki ban synshar ïa kata ka hima . Nangta sa uwei pat u syiem un mihpaw ; un long uba pher bak lbak ïa kiba mynshuwa bad un pynkhyllem ïa ki lai ngut ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki bniat na kane ka hima kin mih: bad uwei pat un kiew hadien jong ki ; bad un long uba pher na uba nyngkong , bad un pyndem ia lai ngut ki syiem .

en: And the angel said unto me , Wherefore didst thou marvel ? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman , and of the beast that carrieth her , which hath the seven heads and ten horns .
kha: Balei ba me la sngewkyndit ?  u angel u la kylli ïa nga .  Ngan ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingmut barieh jong kata ka briew , bad jong u mradkhlaw uba kit ïa ka , uta u mradkhlaw uba don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la ong ha nga: Balei me lyngngoh ? Ngan iathuh ia me ia ka jingmaham jong kata ka kynthei bad jong u mrad uba kit ia ka , uba don ki hynriew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki bniat .

en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was in Egypt , whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king , heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt .
kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban lait im na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeroboan u khun u Nebat uba don ha Ijipt , ha kaba u la phet noh na ka khmat u Solomon u syiem u la iohsngew ia kata .

en: And to masons , and hewers of stone , and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the  Lord  , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .
kha: ki nongtrei maw , bad ki nongshniah maw , ki thied ïa ki dieng sawdong bad ïa ki maw kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingshna pynbha , bad siew ïa ki jingpynlut ba dei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki maw bad ki maw maw maw bad ban thied ia ki dieng bad ki maw ba la khleh ban pynbha ia ki jingtwa jong ka iing U Trai , bad na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba la buh na ka bynta ka iing ban pynbha ia ka .

en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei , hynrei kam pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un paw , ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: La ieit, mynta ngi long ki khun U Blei, bad kam pat paw kaei kaba ngin long: hynrei ngi tip ia kata , ynda un paw , ngin long kum ma u ; namar ngin sa iohi ia u kumba u long .

en: Then Pharaoh said unto him , But what hast thou lacked with me , that , behold , thou seekest to go to thine own country ? And he answered , Nothing : howbeit let me go in any wise .
kha: Balei ?  u syiem u kylli .  Hato ngam shym lah ban ai ei ei ïa me ? Hato dei kata balei ba me da kwah ban leit phai sha ïing ?   Shu shah ïa nga ban leit ,  u Hadad u jubab ïa u syiem . Bad u leit phai sha la ka ri . Kum u syiem Edom , u Hadad u long uba bymman , u nongshun uba pynkthang ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u la ong ha u, Hynrei kaei kaba phi la duna bad nga, kata, ha khmih, me wad ban leit sha la ka jong ka ri ? Bad u la jubab: Ym don ei ei: wat la nga leit sha ka ri .

en: There shall the fire devour thee  ; the sword shall cut thee off , it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm : make thyself many as the cankerworm , make thyself many as the locusts .
kha: Kam pher kaei pha leh , ïa pha hi yn thang pynïap lane yn pynïap ha ka thma . Yn weng noh ïa pha kum ki jingthung ba la bam noh da ki puit . Pha la roi kum ki puit !
translated_en_to_kha: Hangta ka ding kan bam ia me; ka waitlam kan ot noh ia me kum u khniang: pynlong ia lade kum u khniang .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will send unto him wanderers , that shall cause him to wander , and shall empty his vessels , and break their bottles .
kha: Te mynta , ka por ka poi haba ngan phah ïa ki briew ban theh noh ïa ka Moab kum ka waiñ . Kin pynthylli ïa ki khra buh waiñ bad pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ngan phah sha u ia ki nongleit jingleit, ki ban pynlong ia u ban iaid kai bad ngan pynthylli ia ki khiew jong u bad ngan pynpra ia ki bilor jong ki .

en: So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .
kha: U Jonah u la mih bad leit shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah bad u la shong hangta . U la shna ka jakarieh tngen ïa lade bad shong ha ka syrngiew jong ka , da kaba ap ban khmih kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ninebeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Jonah u la mih na ka shnong bad u la shong ha ka liang mihngi jong ka shnong bad hangta u la shna ia u ia ka ïingsah bad u la shong hapoh jong ka ha ka jingdum haduh ba un da iohi kaei kaban sa jia ia ka shnong .

en: To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei , ki briew kin rieh ha ki thliew bad ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong u bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban leit shapoh ki thliew maw, bad shapoh ki tduh jong ki maw kiba la tyrkhong, namar ka jingtieng ia U Trai bad na ka bynta ka burom jong ka jingkhraw jong u, haba u mih ban pynkhih shibun ia ka khyndew .

en: And of thy garments thou didst take , and deckedst thy high places with divers colours , and playedst the harlot thereupon : the like things shall not come , neither shall it be so .
kha: Pha la pyndonkam katto katne tylli ki jaiñ jong pha ban pynitynnat ïa ki jaka mane jong pha , bad kum ka nuti , pha la ai ïa lade ha uei uei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki jain jong me me la shim, bad me la pynitynnad ia ki jaka ba jrong jong me da ki rong saw, bad me la ialehkai ia ka kam sniew halor kata: kiei kiei kiba kum kita kin ym wan, lymne kin ym long kumta .

en: And thou shalt take the garments , and put upon Aaron the coat , and the robe of the ephod , and the ephod , and the breastplate , and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod :
kha: Nangta pynriam ïa u Aaron da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh — ka sopti-poh , ka barandi kaba hapoh ka ephod , ka ephod , ka jingdeng shadem bad u panpoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ki jain, bad men buh ha u Aaron ia ka jainkup, bad ka jainkup jong u ephod bad ka sniehdoh bad ka sniehdoh bad to teh ia u da ka sniehdoh kaba sngewtynnad:

en: And the fish that was in the river died  ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river  ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .
kha: Ki dohkha ha ka wah ki la ïap , bad ka la sma iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kim nud shuh ban dih um na ka . Ka snam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dohkha kiba don ha ka wah ki la iap; bad ka wah ka la tyrkhong , bad ki nong Ijipt kim lah ban dih ia ka um jong ka wah ; bad ka la don ka snam ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki synran bad u la ong ,  Phi dang ïohthiah bad pynjahthait ? Ha khmih ! Ka por ka poi ïa U Khun U Briew ba yn aiti noh ha ka bor ki briew kiba pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u wan sha ki synran jong u, bad u ong ha ki, To thiah mynta, bad to shim ia ka jingjahthait jong phi: ha khmih ka por ka la jan , bad u Khun u briew u la shah pyndem ha ki kti jong ki nongpop .

en: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity , according to the number of the days , three hundred and ninety days : so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .
kha: Nangta thiah pyrshing ha ka krung kadiang , bad ngan pynkit ha me ïa ki kam bymman ka jaitbynriew Israel . Kumba laispah khyndaiphew sngi men sah hangta bad shahshitom namar ki kam bymman jong ki . Nga la pynshitom ïa me shi sngi na ka bynta kawei kawei ka snem haduh ba ka jingpynshitom jong ki kan kut noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la buh ha me ia ki snem jong ka jingbymhok jong ki, kat kum ka jingbun ki sngi, lai spah hynniewphew sngi: kumta me kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka iing Israel .

en: Because the spoiler is come upon her , even upon Babylon , and her mighty men are taken , every one of their bows is broken : for the  Lord  God of recompences shall surely requite .
kha: Ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Babilon ; ïa ki shipai jong ka la kem , bad ïa ki ryntieh jong ki la kdiah . Nga long U Blei uba pynshitom ïa kaba sniew , bad ngan leh ïa ka Babilon kumba ka dei hok ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba u nongpynjot u wan ha ka, wat ha Babilon, bad ki briew kiba khlain bor jong ka ki shah shim noh: namar U Trai U Blei jong ki jingsiew kylliang un sa siew kylliang shisha .

en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .
kha: katba u Dabid bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïashad da ka bor baroh ban ainguh ïa U Blei . Ki rwai bad ki tem ïa ki jingtem — ki duitara , ki ksing , ki shakuriaw , bad ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid bad ki Israel baroh ki la ialehkai ha khmat U Blei da ka bor jong ki baroh, bad da ki jingrwai, bad da ki jingrwai bad ki jingrwai bad ki jingrwai bad ki jingrwai bad ki jingrwai bad ki jingrwai .

en: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingphla na ka bynta jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïoannis u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kam kiba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki kren na ka bynta jong nga bad ki pyn-i ba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingphla kaba kham khraw ban ia ka jong u loannis: na ka bynta ki kam kiba U Kpa u la ai ha nga ban pyndep, kita ki kam kiba nga leh, ki sakhi ia nga, ba U Kpa u la phah ia nga .

en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood , in the hill of Hachilah , which is on the south of Jeshimon ?
kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew na Siph ki la leit sha u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ong ,  U Dabid u rieh ha ka ri jong ngi ha Horesh halor u Lum Hakhilah , ha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri khlaw Judia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan shaneng ha u Saul sha Gibeah, ki da ong: Hato u Dabid um buhrieh ia lade bad ngi ha ki jaka ba skhem ha ki dieng, ha u lum Hachilah uba don shaphang shathie jong u Jeshimon ?

en: And they shall be joined unto thee , and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , for all the service of the tabernacle : and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you .
kha: Ki dei ban ïarap ïa me bad pyndep ïa la ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei uno uno u bym bit bym biang um lah ban ïarap ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin iasoh bad me, bad kin sumar ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong ka iingjain: bad u nongwei un ym wan hajan jong phi .

en: During this period , Charanjit Singh Sharma and some others had filed a writ before the Punjab and Haryana High Court , on which the court gave its verdict recently ,  " he said . "
kha: Ha kane ka por , u Charanjit Singh Sharma bad katto katne kiwei pat ki la mudui ia ka writ hakhmat ka Kashari Punjab bad Haryana High Court , ha kaba ka kashari ka la ai ia ka rai jong ka dang shen , u la ong . "
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka por , u Charanjit Singh Sharma bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki la ujor ha khmat ka Punjab bad ka Haryana High Court , ha kaba ka iingbishar ka la ai ia ka rai jong ka dang shen ," u la ong ."

en: Then shalt thou say , O  Lord  , thou hast spoken against this place , to cut it off , that none shall remain in it , neither man nor beast , but that it shall be desolate for ever .
kha: Nangta sa duwai , ‘ A  Trai  , me la ong ba men pynjot ïa kane ka jaka , haduh ba yn ym don jingthaw ba im ha ka , u briew lane u mrad , bad ba kan long kum ka ri shyiap junom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ong , ko Trai, me la kren pyrshah ia kane ka jaka, ban ot noh ia ka, ba ym don uwei ruh u briew ne u mrad, hynrei ba kan long kaba la jot junom .

en: Son of man , when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land , they defiled it by their own way and by their doings : their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  haba ki Israel ki dang shong ha la ka ri , ki la pyntngit ïa ka da ki rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , nga ñiew ïa ka rukom im jong ki kum ka bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam kum ka kynthei ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , haba ka iing Israel ka shong ha la ka jong ka ri , ki la pynjakhlia ia ka da la ka jong ka rukom bad da ki jingleh jong ki: ka lynti jong ki ka la long ha khmat jong nga kum ka jingbymkhuid jong ka kynthei kaba la weng noh .

en: And Eleazar Aaron s son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife  ; and she bare him Phinehas : these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families .
kha: U Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Putiel , bad ka la kha ïa u Phinehas . Kine ki la long ki khlieh jong ki kur bad ki jait kiba mih na u Lebi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Eleasar Aaron u la shim ia u uwei na ki khun kynthei jong u Putiel bad ka la kha ia u Phinehas: kine ki long ki khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Lebi kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli ba nga ai ha me , pyndap ïa ka kpoh jong me da ka .  Te nga bam ïa ka , bad ka thiang kum ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, to pynlong ia ka kpoh jong me ban bam, bad pyndap ia ki bniat jong me da kane ka roll kaba nga ai ha me . Nangta nga la bam ia ka ; bad ka la don ha ka shyntur jong nga kum ka umsoh .

en: And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .
kha: U paralok jong u , u phai ktien ,  Ka dei ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ngi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U paralok jong u u la jubab bad u la ong, Kane kam long ei ei shuh hynrei tang ka waitlam u Gideon u khun u Joash: namar ha ka kti jong u U Blei u la aiti ia ka Madian bad ka kynhun shipai baroh .

en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took of the blood of it , and put it upon the tip of Aaron s right ear , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot .
kha: U Moses u shim khyndiat ka snam bad u tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong u Aaron , ha ka  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ka  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ia ka ; bad u Moses u la shim ia ka snam jong ka, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka tduh jong ka shkor kadiang jong u Aaron bad ha ka kti kadiang jong u bad ha ka kjat kadiang jong u .

en: For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .
kha: Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jaitbynriew kaba kyrpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me long u briew uba khuid ha U Trai U Blei jong me: U Trai U Blei jong me u la jied ia me ban long u briew uba kyrpang ha lade, halor ki briew baroh kiba don ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew .

en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the  Lord  and of the king s house , and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,
kha: Kumta u Asa u shim rupa bad ksiar na ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem bad phah sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asa u la sei ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing U Trai bad ka iing syiem, bad u la phah sha u Benhadad u syiem Syria uba shong ha Damaskos, da kaba ong:

en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day : and there escaped not a man of them , save four hundred young men , which rode upon camels , and fled .
kha: Ka tang shu kynjat shai ha kawei pat ka sngi u Dabid u tur pyrshah bad u ïaleh ïa ki haduh janmiet . Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait im lait noh tang sawspah ngut ki samla shynrang kiba kiew ha ki ut bad kiba phet ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pynkhih ia ki naduh ka por mynstep haduh ka por mynstep: bad ym don uwei ruh na ki, lait noh tang saw spah ngut ki samla kiba shong halor ki kulai bad ki la phet noh .

en: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nangta la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka long ka bym lah long ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la byrngem shuh shuh ia ki, ki la pyllait noh ia ki, khlem da lap ei ei kumno kin pynshitom ia ki, namar ki briew: namar ki briew baroh ki la pyndonburom ia U Blei na ka bynta kata kaba la leh .

en: And Lamech said unto his wives , Adah and Zillah , Hear my voice  ; ye wives of Lamech , hearken unto my speech : for I have slain a man to my wounding , and a young man to my hurt .
kha: Te u Lamekh u ong ha ki tnga jong u ,  Ko Adah bad Sillah , to sngap ïa nga : Nga la pynïap ïa uwei u samla namar u la shoh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lamech u la ong ha ki tnga jong u, U Adah bad u Sillah, To sngap ia ka sur jong nga; phi ki tnga jong u Lamech, to sngap ia ka jingkren jong nga: namar nga la pyniap ia u briew ha ka jingmynsaw jong nga, bad u samla ha ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness , and despise government . Presumptuous are they , selfwilled , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities .
kha: Kine ki nonghikai balamler ki long kiba shlur bad kiba kyr-eit , bad kim pyn-i jingñiewburom ïa ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ; pynban ki krenbeiñ ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei khamtam eh ia kito kiba iaid hadien ka doh ha ka jingkwah brai jong ka jingbymkhuid, bad ki pynjah burom ia ka sorkar . Ki long kiba sngewrit , ki long kiba sngewrit , kim tieng ban kren sniew ia ki burom .

en: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams  horns : and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times , and the priests shall blow with the trumpets .
kha: Hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh , uwei uwei uba rah ïa ka turoi , kin ïaid ha shuwa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me , men ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah katba ki lyngdoh ki dang put ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew ngut ki lyngdoh kin rah ha khmat ka synduk hynriew tylli ki turoi langbrot: bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew phin iaid sawdong ia ka nongbah hynriew sien , bad ki lyngdoh kin iaid sawdong ia ka nongbah .

en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .
kha: Wat bam kano kano ka jingbam kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ; wat bam kano kano ka snam ; wat bam kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait ; bad sumar ïa lade na ka jingawria . Phin manbha lada phi sumar ban ym leh ïa kine kiei kiei . Da ka jingkhublei babha tam jong ngi .
