translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin kiar na ki doh ba la tyrwa ha ki bleithaw, bad na ka snam, bad na kiei kiei kiba la tyrkhong: na kiba lada phi sumar ia lade, phin leh bha . Ka long kaba bha .

en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .
kha: U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la bynta jaka ïa ki jaitbynriew ; u la buh hangno ki briew kin shong . U la ai uwei u blei ïa kawei kawei ka jaitbynriew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u High tam u la phiah ia ki jaitbynriew jong ki , haba u la pyniakhlad ia ki khun shynrang u Adam , u la buh ia ki pud ki sam jong ki briew katkum ka jingbun ki khun Israel .

en: And when king Arad the Canaanite , which dwelt in the south , heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies  ; then he fought against Israel , and took some of them prisoners .
kha: Haba u syiem ka Arad , u nong Kanaan uba shong shaphang shathie ka ri Kanaan , u la ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki wan ïaid lynti na shaphang Atharim , u la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad u la ïohkem katto katne ngut na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u syiem Arad u nong Kanaan uba shong shaphang shathie u la iohsngew ba ki Israel ki wan da ka lynti jong ki nongpeitkai ; nangta u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel bad u la shim katto katne na ki ki koidi .

en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .
kha: Ha kata ka miet , la pynkyndit ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa baroh ki nong Ijipt . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khlem ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la ieng ha ka miet , ma u bad ki shakri jong u baroh bad ki nong Ijipt baroh bad ka la don ka jingud kaba khraw ha Ijipt ; namar ym don iing ha kaba ym don ba iap .

en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .
kha: Haba phi ïakhun ïa ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka thma ; U  Trai  un ym don lem bad phi , namar phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Amalek bad ki nong Kana ki don hangta ha khmat jong phi: namar ba phi la phai noh na U Trai , namarkata U Trai un ym don ryngkat bad phi .

en: Thou hast avouched the  Lord  this day to be thy God , and to walk in his ways , and to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and to hearken unto his voice :
kha: Mynta ka sngi phi la pynbna ba U  Trai  u long U Blei jong phi ; phi la kular ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u , bad ban leh ruh kat ïa kaba u hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la sngewsih ia U Trai ha kane ka sngi ban long U Blei jong me, bad ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u, bad ban sumar ia ki ain jong u bad ki hukum jong u bad ki jingbishar jong u, bad ban sngap ia ka sur jong u:

en: Blessed are ye , when men shall hate you , and when they shall separate you from their company , and shall reproach you , and cast out your name as evil , for the Son of man s sake .
kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki isih ïa phi ; kiba kyntait ïa phi , ki krenbeiñ ïa phi , bad ki ong ba phi long uba sniew , baroh namar U Khun U Briew !
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia phi haba ki briew kin shun ia phi, bad haba kin pyniakhlad ia phi na ka kynhun jong ki, bad kin kren bein ia phi, bad kin bret noh ia ka kyrteng jong phi kum kaba sniew, na ka bynta u Khun u briew .

en: And prayed unto him : and he was entreated of him , and heard his supplication , and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom . Then Manasseh knew that the  Lord  he was God .
kha: U Blei u pdiang ïa ka jingduwai u Manasseh bad jubab ïa ka da kaba pynlah ïa u ban leit phai sha Jerusalem bad synshar pat . Kane ka pynskhem ïa u Manasseh ba U  Trai  u long U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la duwai ha u : bad u la sngew ia ka jingkyrpad jong u, bad u la wanrah biang ia u sha Jerusalem sha ka hima jong u . Nangta u Manasseh u la tip ba U Trai u long U Blei .

en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle , and were gathered together at Soco , which belongeth to Judah , and pitched between Soco and Azekah , in Ephes–dammim .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh thma ha Sokoh , ka shnong kaba ha Judah ; ki sher dara ha kawei ka jaka kaba ki khot Ephes Dammim , kaba hapdeng ka Sokoh bad ka Asekah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki Philistia ki la ialum lang ia ki shipai jong ki ban ialeh thma, bad ki la ialum lang ha Soco, kaba dei ka jong u Judah, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh hapdeng u Soco bad u Azekah, ha Ephesos damm .

en: For my people is foolish , they have not known me  ; they are sottish children , and they have none understanding : they are wise to do evil , but to do good they have no knowledge .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki long kiba mutlop ; kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki long kiba bieit kum ki khynnah ; kim don kano kano ka jingshemphang . Ki long kiba tbit ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew , hynrei ki bym lah ban leh ïa kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki long kiba bieit, kim shym la ithuh ia nga ; ki long ki khun kiba sngewsih, bad kim don jingmut ei ei: ki long kiba stad ban leh ia kaba sniew , hynrei ban leh ia kaba bha kim don jingtip ei ei .

en: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven : and the  Lord  sent thunder and hail , and the fire ran along upon the ground  ; and the  Lord  rained hail upon the land of Egypt .
kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh shajrong , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad ïa u phria , bad ka leilieh ruh ka la tied ïa ka khyndew . U  Trai  u phah ïa u phria uba jur , lem bad ka leilieh kaba thaba .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynjrong ia u diengduh jong u sha bneng: bad U Trai u la phah ia u lyoh bad u slap, bad ka ding ka la iaid ryngkat bad ka khyndew ; bad U Trai u la slap ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: And that their children , which have not known any thing , may hear , and learn to fear the  Lord  your God , as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki bym pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka Aiñ U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kin ïohsngew ïa ka . Te kin sa nang ban kohnguh ïa u katba ki dang im ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti ha shiliang ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba ki khun jong ki ki bym tip ei ei, kin iohsngew bad kin nang ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, katba phi dang im ha ka ri ha kaba phi leit sha ka Jordan ban ioh ia ka .

en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself , and opened her mouth without measure : and their glory , and their multitude , and their pomp , and he that rejoiceth , shall descend into it .
kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka thngan ïa ki , ka ang pynheh ïa la ka shyntur . Ka klun shapoh ïa ki riewdonburom jong ka Jerusalem bad ki paid ba kaw kaw jong ki riewpaidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka dujok ka la pynheh ia lade, bad ka la plie ia ka shyntur jong ka khlem da thew: bad ka burom jong ki, bad ka jingbun briew jong ki, bad ka jingkmen jong ki, bad uta uba sngewbha, un hiar shapoh jong ka .

en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies . Furthermore I tell thee that the  Lord  will build thee an house .
kha: Nga la jied ka jaka na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad nga la pynshong pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin shongduh shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki la rung ha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh pyrshah ha ki briew kiba runar , hynrei kane kan ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me bad ban ai ha me ki nonghiarpateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh ka por ba nga la hukum ia ki nongbishar jong nga ban long halor ki briew jong nga Israel . Nalor kata ngan pyndem ia ki nongshun jong me baroh . Shuh shuh nga ong ia me ba U Trai un tei ia me ia ka iing .

en: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .
kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga lah ban kren ha me da ka jingshlur , namar ba me tip ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , naba kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kaba rieh ha kyndong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem u tip ia kine kiei kiei, ha khmat jong u ruh nga kren laitluid: namar nga sngewskhem ba ym don kawei ruh na kine kiei kiei kaba la buhrieh na u ; namar ia kane ka kam ym shym la leh ha ka kut .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Me ong kumta . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baroh : Naduh kane ka por phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da wan ha ki lyoh bneng !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u: Hynrei nga ong ha phi: Hynrei hadien kata phin sa iohi ia U Khun u briew uba shong ha ka liang kadiang jong ka bor bad uba wan ha ki lyoh bneng .

en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him , but slew his son . And when he died , he said , The  Lord  look upon it , and require it .
kha: U syiem u la klet ïa ka jingshakri bahok ba u Jehoïada , u kpa jong u Sekharaïah u la ai ïa u , bad u la phah pynïap ïa u Sekharaïah . Shuwa ba u Sekharaïah un ïap , u pyrta ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh bad un pynshitom ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joash u syiem um kynmaw ia ka jingbha kaba u kpa jong u u la leh ia u, hynrei u la pyniap ia u khun jong u . Bad haba u la iap , u la ong , U Trai u peit ia ka , bad u dawa ia ka .

en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .
kha: ba ka jaitbynriew kaba la wan na Ijipt ka la saphriang ha ka ri baroh kawei . U kwah ïa nga ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïaleh pyrshah bad beh noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, don ka jaitbynriew kaba mih na Ijipt, kaba tap ia ka khmat jong ka khyndew: to wan mynta, to tim ia nga; nga lah ban jop ia ki, bad beh noh ia ki .

en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name , that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee : for thou hast hid thy face from us , and hast consumed us , because of our iniquities .
kha: Ym don uwei ruh uba phai sha me ha ka jingduwai ; ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha me ban ïoh jingïarap . Me la buhrieh ïa lade na ngi bad iehnoh ïa ngi namar ki pop jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba khot ia ka kyrteng jong me, kiba sngap jar ia me: namar me la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong me na ngi , bad me la bam ia ngi namar ki jingbymhok jong ngi .

en: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field , both man and beast  ; and the hail smote every herb of the field , and brake every tree of the field .
kha: Kylleng ka ri Ijipt , u phria u shoh lut plain kat ïa kiba don habar , kynthup ïa ki briew bad ïa ki mrad baroh . U la pynjulor naphang ïa ki jingthung baroh ha lyngkha , bad u la pynkheiñ lut ruh ïa ki dieng baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U bsein u la bthei ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei kaba don ha lyngkha , u briew bad u mrad baroh kawei .

en: And when they had stripped him , they took his head , and his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to carry tidings unto their idols , and to the people .
kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Saul , ki law noh ïa ki jingkieng atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban leit ïathuh ïa ka khubor babha sha ki bleithaw jong ki bad sha ki briew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la weng noh ia u, ki la shim ia ka khlieh jong u bad ki tiar ialeh jong u bad ki la phah sha ka ri Philistia sawdong , ban rah khubor sha ki bleithaw jong ki bad sha ki briew .

en: And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumno lada uwei na phi u don kawei ka langbrot bad ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Hato phin ym bat ïa ka bad kyntiew ïa ka shabar ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki: Uei u briew uba don kawei ka langbrot bad lada ka hap ha ka thliew ha ka sngi Sabha , hato un ym thiah ia ka bad un ym rah ia ka ?

en: Then said David , Ye shall not do so , my brethren , with that which the  Lord  hath given us , who hath preserved us , and delivered the company that came against us into our hand .
kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab ,  Ko ki hynmen ki para jong nga , phim dei ban leh kumta ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ! U la ri la da ïa ngi , bad u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor kito ki nonglute .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong , Phim dei ban leh kumta ko para jong nga, bad kata kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi, kaba la pynneh pynsah ia ngi bad kaba la aiti ia ka kynhun kaba la wan pyrshah ia ngi ha ka kti jong ngi .

en: And the  Lord  smote Benjamin before Israel : and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men : all these drew the sword .
kha: U  Trai  u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa ki shipai Benjamin . Ki Israel ki pynïap arphew san hajar shispah ngut ki shipai Benjamin ha kata ka sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynjot ia u Benjamin ha khmat ki Israel: bad ki khun Israel ki la pynjot ia ki Benjamin ha kata ka sngi arphew san hajar shispah ngut ki briew: kine baroh ki la tan ia ka waitlam .

en: In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants  ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him :
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongpynïaidkam . Ki kynhun shipai ka Persia bad ka Media ki la ïadon lang , kumjuh ruh ki lat bad ki riewpawkhmat jong ki jylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la leh ia ka jingkhawai ha ki syiem jong u baroh bad ki shakri jong u; ka bor jong ka Persia bad ki Media , ki riew rangbah bad ki syiem jong ki jylla , ki don ha khmat jong u:

en: And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
kha: U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U  Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u tei ïa ka duwan ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la thoh ia ki ktien U Trai baroh , bad u la ieng dang step , bad u la tei ia kawei ka jingknia hapoh u lum bad shiphew tylli ki lum katkum ki shiphew tylli ki jait Israel .

en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ , let us go on unto perfection  ; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works , and of faith toward God ,
kha: Te , to ngin ïaid shaphrang , sha ka jinghikai ïa kiba ïadei bad kiba la san bad ieh shadien jong ngi ïa ki jinghikai banyngkong ka khubor jong ka jingngeit . Ngim dei ban neh sah ha ka nongrim jong ka jingphai noh na ki kam bymseisoh bad ka jingngeit ha U Blei ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi iehnoh ia ki nongrim jong ka jinghikai U Khrist , to ngin iaid shakhmat sha ka jinglong janai;

en: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow , and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish : but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow .
kha: Hynrei wat haba ki khie lung bad ki phuh syntiew ha ka step ba pha thung ïa ki , yn ym don kano kano ka jingot . Yn don tang ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang ka bym lah pynkoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi to pynlong ia u symbai jong me ban san, bad ha ka por mynstep to pynlong ia u symbai jong me ban roi: hynrei u soh un long u lum ha ka sngi jong ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih kaba jur .

en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash , Bring out thy son , that he may die : because he hath cast down the altar of Baal , and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it .
kha: Nangta ki ong ha u Joash ,  Wallam shabar ïa u khun jong me hangne , ba ngin pynïap ïa u ! U la pynkhyllem ïa ka duwan ïa u Baal bad pynngat ïa ka dak jong ka Asherah kaba ha syndah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka shnong ki la ong ha u Joash, To wanrah ia u khun jong me, ba un iap: namar u la pynhap ia ka jingbam jong u Baal bad namar ba u la ot ia u khlaw uba don hajan jong ka .

en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness , and hidden riches of secret places , that thou mayest know that I , the  Lord  , which call thee by thy name , am the God of Israel .
kha: Ngan ai ïa me ki jingkynshew na ki jaka ba-dum , bakynjah ; te men tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ba U Blei ki Israel u la khot ïa me da ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ha me ia ki spah jong ka jingdum bad ki jaka rieh ba la buhrieh, ba me tip ba nga, U Trai, uba khot ia me da ka kyrteng jong me, nga long U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses  father in law before God .
kha: Nangta u Jethro u la wanrah ïa ka jingainguh ban thang tylli bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki jingainguh ban ai jingkñia sha U Blei ; bad u Aaron lem bad nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh ki la ïaleit bad u ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba kyntang kum ka dak ka jingmane ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jethro u kpa jong u Moses u la shim ia ka jingainguh thang bad ki jingknia na ka bynta U Blei: bad u Aaron u la wan bad ki rangbah Israel baroh ban bam ia u kpu bad u kpa jong u Moses ha khmat U Blei .

en: And Jesus said ,  Who touched me ?  When all denied , Peter and they that were with him said , Master , the multitude throng thee and press thee , and sayest thou ,  Who touched me ?
kha: U Jisu u la kylli ,  Mano ba ktah ïa nga ?  Uwei pa uwei u len ïa ka , bad u Petros u ong ,  Ko kynrad , ki briew ki don sawdong jong me bad ki ïalum ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong: Mano ba ktah ia nga ? Haba baroh ki la kyntait , u Petros bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la ong: Ko Nonghikai, u paidbah u la pynkhih ia me bad u la pynkhih ia me bad me ong: Me uba ktah ia nga ?

en: And the multitudes that went before , and that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna to the Son of David : Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord  ; Hosanna in the highest .
kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïaid ha khmat jong U Jisu bad kito kiba la bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U khun u Dabid ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki paidbah kiba la leit sha khmat bad kiba la bud ki la pyrta, ki la pyrta, ki la ong, Hosanna ia u Khun u Dabid: La kyrkhu ia uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai ; Hosanna ha kaba ha khlieh duh .

en: And the residue thereof he maketh a god , even his graven image : he falleth down unto it , and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it , and saith , Deliver me  ; for thou art my god .
kha: Ka dieng kaba sah u shna ïa ka bleithaw , bad nangta u dem bad mane ïa ka . U duwai ha ka bad u ong ,  Phi long U Blei jong nga — to pynim ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsah jong ka u pynlong ia u blei, wat ia ka dur ba la ker jong u: u hap ha ka , bad u mane ia ka , bad u duwai ha ka , bad u ong: To ai ia nga; namar me long u blei jong nga .

en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye nations , and declare it in the isles afar off , and say , He that scattered Israel will gather him , and keep him , as a shepherd doth his flock .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki jaitbynriew , to shahshkor ïa nga , bad to pynbna ïa ki ktien jong nga shaduh ki rud duriaw kiba jngai . Nga la pynsakma ïa ki briew jong nga , hynrei ngan lumlang ïa ki bad ïada ïa ki kumba u nongaplangbrot u ïada ïa la ka kynhun langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai , ko ki jaitbynriew , bad to pynbna ia ka ha ki dulir kiba jngai , bad to ong , Uta uba la pynpra ia ki Israel un lum ia u , bad un sumar ia u kum u nongaplangbrot jong u .

en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water , but hired Balaam against them , that he should curse them : howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing .
kha: Kane ka long namar ki Amon bad ki Moab kim shym la ai jingbam bad um ïa ki Israel ha ka lynti ba ki mih na Ijipt . Pynban , ki la siew pisa sha u Balaam ban tim ïa ki Israel , hynrei U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla long ïa ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la iakynduh ia ki khun Israel da u kpu bad da ka um , hynrei ki la thung ia u Balaam pyrshah ia ki: wat la U Blei jong ngi u la pynkylla ia ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu .

en: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots , even nine hundred chariots of iron , and all the people that were with him , from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon .
kha: u la khot ïa ki khyndaispah tylli ki kali ïapom kiba da ka nar bad ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad u la phah ïa ki na Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil sha ka wah Kishon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sisera u la lum lang ia ki kali jong u baroh, wat hynniew spah tylli ki kali nar bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, naduh u Hashet jong ki Jutang haduh ka wah Kishon .

en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death : that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father , even so we also should walk in newness of life .
kha: Da ka jingpynbaptis , ïa ngi la btep bad u , bad ngi ïadon bynta bad ka jingïap jong u , khnang ba , kumba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap da ka bor jong ka burom U Kpa , kumta ruh ma ngi , ngi lah ban im ka jingim bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la tep ia ngi bad u da ka jingpynbaptis ha ka jingiap: ba kumba U Khrist u la mihpat na kiba iap da ka burom U Kpa , wat la katta ruh ngi ruh ngi dei ban iaid ha ka jinglong thymmai jong ka jingim .

en: And Isaiah said , This sign shalt thou have of the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do the thing that he hath spoken : shall the shadow go forward ten degrees , or go back ten degrees ?
kha: U Isaïah u jubab ,  U  Trai  un sa ai ïa ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la ka kular . Mynta , hato men jied ïa ka syrngiew ha ki mawkyrdon ban jam shiphew jam sha khmat ne ban leit shiphew jam shadien ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah u la ong: Kane ka dak phin don na U Trai, ba U Trai un leh ia kaei kaba u la kren: hato ka jingdum kan leit sha khmat shi kyrdan ne leit phai biang shi kyrdan ?

en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .
kha: Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin long kum ka umjer ba pynpyngngad ba la phah da U  Trai  na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shaniah ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsah jong u Jakob kan long hapdeng ki briew kiba bun kum ka dewbilat na U Trai, kum ki dewbilat ha u phlang , ki bym sah ha u briew , ne ki khun shynrang .

en: The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khyndew kumba long ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na ki jingainguh bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki Lebi bad ka jait Lebi baroh kin ym don bynta ne pateng bad ki Israel: kin bam ia ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding bad ka pateng jong u .

en: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt , and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros , into the land of their habitation  ; and they shall be there a base kingdom .
kha: bad ngan shah ïa ki ban im ha ka bynta bashathie ka Ijipt , ka shnong trai jong ki . Hangta kin long ka hima kaba tlot bor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ka ri Ijipt bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban leit phai biang sha ka ri Pathro, sha ka ri jong ki; bad kin don hangta ka hima ba sdang .

en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .
kha: Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem bad ka shadem jong u mrad ban ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti jong u hi kin wanrah ia ki jingknia jong U Trai ba la shna da ka ding, ka shini bad ka shyntur , un wanrah ia ka shyntur ba ka shyntur kan khih na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba jylliew ha khmat U Trai .

en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .
kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga la pynshitom wat kham jur ban ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Sodom , kiba la ïashem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsan ha ki kti jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynshitom ia ka jingbymhok jong ka khun jong nga ka kham khraw ban ia ka jingpynshitom ia ka pop jong ka Sodom , kaba la shah pynhap noh kumba ha ka khyllipmat , bad ym don kti ba sah ha ka .

en: And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .
kha: Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , ha kaba U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u sumar ïa la ki briew , phan long pat sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima kaba la ju long ka jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko tower jong ka kynhun, ka jingbat kaba skhem jong ka khun jong ka Seion, ha me kan wan, wat ka jingsynshar kaba nyngkong eh; ka hima kan wan sha ka khun jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
kha: Ka jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u, ko kynrad jong nga, me sngewsih ia U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka kti jong me, da kaba ong: Hooid u Solomon u khun jong me un synshar hadien jong nga, bad un shong ha ka khet jong nga .

en: Then the priest shall consider : and , behold , if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .
kha: u lyngdoh un khmih bniah biang ïa uta u briew . Lada u shem ba kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la sop shisha ïa ka met jong u baroh shi rynïeng , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long uba khuid . Lada ka sniehdoh jong u baroh ka la kylla lieh un long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un pyrkhat: bad, ha khmih, lada ka jingpang sniehdoh ka la tap lut ia ka doh jong u, un pynbna ba u long uba khuid uba don ka khlam: baroh ka la kylla lieh: u long uba khuid .

en: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki hukum , ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ban hikai ia phi , ba phin leh ia ki ha ka ri kaba phi leit ban ioh ia ka:

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .
kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ïa ka Tyros yn klet noh hynñiewphew snem , kat ka rta u syiem . Haba kita ki snem ki la kut noh , ka Tyros kan long kum ka nuti ha ka jingrwai :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba u Tyros un shah klet hynriewphew snem, kat kum ki sngi jong uwei u syiem: hadien ba la kut hynriewphew snem u Tyros un rwai kum u nongkhaïi .

en: O  Lord  God of Abraham , Isaac , and of Israel , our fathers , keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people , and prepare their heart unto thee :
kha: Ko  Trai  , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ki la buh ïa kum kane ka jingmane kaba khlaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ki briew jong me bad ki ïai pynlong ïa ki ban ïaineh ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad ki Israel jong ngi, to buh ia kane junom ha ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong ki briew jong me, bad pynkhreh ia ka dohnud jong ki ha me:

en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates , that their heart may faint , and their ruins be multiplied : ah ! it is made bright , it is wrapped up for the slaughter .
kha: Ka pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban duh ka jingshlur bad ban kyllon . Nga byrngem ïa ka nongbah jong ki da ka waitlam kaba thaba kum ka leilieh bad ka pynkhreh ban pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la buh ia ka tduh jong ka waitlam pyrshah ia ki khyrdop jong ki baroh, ba ka dohnud jong ki kan sngewsih, bad ki jingjot jong ki kin nang bun: ah ! la pynlong ia ka kaba shai , la pynkhih ia ka na ka bynta ka jingpyniap .

en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .
kha: Yn don hi man la ka por ki Israel kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kiba duk kin ym sangeh na ka ri: namarkata nga hukum ia me, da kaba ong: Me plie ia la ka kti sha u hynmen jong me, ha u baduk jong me, ha ka ri jong me .

en: And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?
kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa pha kin kynran dien . Kin ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba don kano kano ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mano ba kwah ban pyntngen ïa ka ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba baroh kiba peit ia me kin phet noh na me, bad kin ong: Ka Nineveh ka la jah rngai noh: mano ba sngewsih ia ka ? nangta ngan wad ia ki nongpyntngen na ka bynta jong me ?

en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords , he drove them all out of the temple , and the sheep , and the oxen  ; and poured out the changers  money , and overthrew the tables  ;
kha: Te u la thaw ïa u jingsympat da ki tyllai jingteh bad u la beh noh shabar ka Templ ïa ki mrad baroh , ki langbrot bad ki masi ruh ; u la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ pisa bad u la pynsaphred ïa ki pisa sbai ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la shna ia ki nar rit , u la beh noh ia ki baroh na ka tempi , bad ki langbrot bad ki masi beg bad u la theh ia ka pisa jong ki nongkylla beg bad u la pynkhih ia ki miej beg .

en: But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .
kha: Hynrei lada phi lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingmut jong ka , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi pyni ia ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai jong ka, phin pdiang na nga ia ki jingai sngewbha bad ki jingsiew bad ka burom kaba khraw: namarkata to pyni ia nga ia ka jingphohsniew bad ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: And bring your youngest brother unto me : then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men : so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .
kha: Wan ïalam ruh ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Da kumta ngan tip ba phim dei ki nongsyntiat , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ; ngan ai pat ha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad phi lah ban sah hangne bad khaïi ruh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wanrah ia u hynmen uba rit tam jong phi ha nga: te ngan tip ba phim dei ki nongleit jingleit , hynrei ba phi long ki briew kiba shisha: kumta ngan pyllait noh ia phi ia u hynmen jong phi , bad phin ia khaii ha ka ri .

en: Then all the children of Israel went out , and the congregation was gathered together as one man , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , with the land of Gilead , unto the  Lord  in Mizpah .
kha: Baroh ki paid Israel naduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei haduh Beersheba kaba shaphang shathie , kumjuh ruh naduh ri Gilead kaba shaphang mihngi , ki la ïawanlang . Ki ïalumlang kum kawei ka kynhun ha khmat U  Trai  ha Mispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Israel baroh ki la mih noh, bad ka jingiaseng ka la ialum lang kum uwei u briew, naduh Dan haduh Beersheba, bad ka ri Gilead, sha U Trai ha Mizpah .

en: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .
kha: Wat ai por ïa ki shipai ban siat ïa ki khnam ne kieng ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong ki . Wat pyllait ïa ki samla shynrang ! Pynjot ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei !
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia uta uba dem u ai ba u nongsiat un dem ia ka bow jong u, bad pyrshah ia uta uba pynkiew ia lade ha ka jingleh be-ijot jong u: bad phim pyllait ia ki samla jong ka; phi pynjot lut ia ka kynhun jong ka .

en: They cried unto them , Depart ye  ; it is unclean  ; depart , depart , touch not : when they fled away and wandered , they said among the heathen , They shall no more sojourn there .
kha: Khie leit noh !  ki briew ki pyrta .  Phi la long kiba tngit ! Wat ktah ïa nga !  Kumta ki la sakma na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , khlem don mano mano ba pdiang sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta ia ki, Pynduh noh ia ka; ka long kaba khlem khuid, leit noh: haba ki la phet noh bad ki la iaid kai , ki la ong hapdeng ki nongwei , Kin ym sah shuh hangta .

en: I make a decree , that all they of the people of Israel , and of his priests and Levites , in my realm , which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem , go with thee .
kha: Nga hukum ba ha baroh kawei ka hima jong nga , baroh ki Israel , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ïa kat kita kiba kwah , la ai jingbit ban leit bad me sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pynlong ia ka hukum , ba baroh ki briew jong u Israel bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi jong u, ha ka hima jong nga, kiba don ka jingmut jong ki hi ban leit sha Jerusalem , kin leit ryngkat bad me .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , U  Trai  un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt ban wan kum ki skain na ki shnat kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Nile , bad ïa ki Assyria ban wan kum ki ngap na ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba U Trai un pyrta na ka bynta u khnai uba don ha ka bynta kaba kut jong ki wah Ijipt bad na ka bynta u khnai uba don ha ka ri Assyria .

en: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles , and shalt suck the breast of kings : and thou shalt know that I the  Lord  am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer , the mighty One of Jacob .
kha: Ki jaitbynriew bad ki syiem kin sumar ïa pha , kumba ka kmie ka sumar ïa la ki khun jong ka . Phan sa tip ba nga U  Trai  , nga la pyllait ïa pha , ba U Blei Bakhrawbor ki Israel u pyllaitluid ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me ruh men dih ia ka dud jong ki Jutang, bad me dei ban dih ia ka shyntur jong ki syiem: bad me tip ba nga U Trai nga long U Nongpynim jong me bad U Nongsiewspah jong me, Uba khlain bor jong u Jakob .

en: Then the prophets , Haggai the prophet , and Zechariah the son of Iddo , prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel , even unto them .
kha: Ha kata ka por , ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Iddo , ki sdang ban kren ha ka kyrteng U Blei ki Israel ha ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Judah bad Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongiathuhlypa , u Haggai u nongiathuhlypa bad u Sikharaiah u khun Iddo ki la iathuhlypa ha ki Jiw kiba don ha Judah bad Jerusalem ha ka kyrteng U Blei jong ki Israel wat ha ki ruh .

en: Now ye Philippians know also , that in the beginning of the gospel , when I departed from Macedonia , no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving , but ye only .
kha: Phi ki nong Philippi phi tip bha shibun ba haba nga la mihnoh na Makedonia ha ki sngi kiba sdang ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha , phi dei tang ma phi ka balang ban ïarap ïa nga ; phi dei tang ma phi kiba la shim bynta ha ki jingïoh bad jingduh jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta phi Philippi ruh phi tip, ba ha kaba sdang jong ka gospel, haba nga la leit noh na Makedonia, ym don ka balang kaba la iakren bad nga kum kaba ai bad pdiang, hynrei tang ma phi .

en: And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .
kha: Hynrei , ïeng joit bad leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , ha kaba yn ïathuh ïa me ïa kaei kaba me dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khih bad u la lyngngoh u la ong, ko Trai, kaei kaba me kwah ban leh ? U Trai u la ong ha u: To khie bad leit shapoh shnong bad yn sa iathuh ia me ia kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus : even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar , unto Beth–horon the upper  ;
kha: Kane ka long ka ri jong ki longïing ka jait Ephraim : u pud jong ki u sdang na Ataroth Addar ha ka phang mihngi haduh Beth Horon kaba Shaneng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam jong ki khun Ephraim kat kum ki longiing jong ki: wat u pud jong ka pateng jong ki ha ka liang mihngi u long u Atarothaddar, haduh Bethoron u top ; .

en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .
kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut — phi kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei nga la thoh ha phi kiba ngeit ha ka kyrteng U Khun U Blei ; ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut bad ba phin ngeit ha ka kyrteng U Khun U Blei .

en: And it came to pass , that in the morning watch the  Lord  looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud , and troubled the host of the Egyptians ,
kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , U  Trai  u la khmih ïa ka kynhun shipai Ijipt na u rishot ding bad u rishot lyoh bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka por mynstep u Trai u la peit sha ka kynhun jong ki nong Ijipt lyngba u lum ding bad u lyoh bad u la pynkhuslai ia ka kynhun jong ki nong Ijipt .

en: And it came to pass , that , as he was praying in a certain place , when he ceased , one of his disciples said unto him , Lord , teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi U Jisu u dang duwai ha kawei ka jaka . Haba u la dep , uwei na ki synran jong u , u la ong ha u ,  Ko Trai , to hikai ïa ngi ban duwai , kumba u Ïoannis u la hikai ïa ki synran jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba katba u dang duwai ha kawei ka jaka, haba u la sangeh, uwei na ki synran jong u u la ong ha u, Ko Trai, to hikai ia ngi ban duwai kumba u loannis ruh u la hikai ia ki synran jong u .

en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram , out of the mountains of the east , saying , Come , curse me Jacob , and come , defy Israel .
kha: U Balaam u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  U Balak u syiem Moab u la wan ïalam ïa nga Na Syria , na ki lum mihngi . ‘ Ale kren lem na ka bynta jong nga ,’ u ong . ‘ Buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka pharshi jong u, bad u la ong, U Balak u syiem u la wanrah ia nga na Aram, na ki lum jong ka ri mihngi, u da ong: To wan, to wan, to wan, to wan pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .
kha: Ynda me ïap , bad la tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ka hima jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la pyndep ia ki sngi jong me bad me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me, ngan pynmih ia u symbai jong me hadien jong me, uba mih na ka kpoh jong me, bad ngan pynskhem ia ka hima jong u .

en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel , spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people , saying , Why have ye not built me an house of cedars ?
kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong nga bad ki paid Israel , ngam ju kylli ïano ïano na ki nongïalam kiba nga la thung balei kim shym la thaw ïa nga ka templ ba la shna da ki dieng Kedar .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hangno hangno ba nga la iaid bad ki Israel baroh , nga la kren ia ka ktien ha uno uno na ki nongbishar Israel , ia kiba nga la hukum ban ai bam ia ki briew jong nga da kaba ong , Balei phim shym la tei ia nga ia ka iing jong ki diengsoh ?

en: And the king said , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Ahimaaz answered , When Joab sent the king s servant , and me thy servant , I saw a great tumult , but I knew not what it was .
kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  U syiem u kylli . U Ahimaas u jubab ,  Kynrad , haba u Joab u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u phah ïa nga , nga ïohi ïa ka jingkhihwin kaba jur , hynrei ngam tip ka dei kaei .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Absalom u la ong: Hato u samla u la shngain ? Bad u Ahimaas u la jubab: Haba u Joab u la phah ia u shakri syiem bad nga u shakri jong me, nga la iohi ia ka jingsawa kaba khraw hynrei ngam tip kaei kata .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Write this for a memorial in a book , and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua : for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh ha ka jingthoh shaphang kane ka jingjop ban pynsah jingkynmaw . Ïathuh ruh ha u Joshua ba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To thoh ia kane na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw ha ka kot , bad to pynkhreh ia ka ha ki shkor u Joshua: namar ngan sa weng noh shisha ia ka jingkynmaw ia u Amalek na shapoh bneng .

en: And they said , We saw certainly that the  Lord  was with thee : and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us , even betwixt us and thee , and let us make a covenant with thee  ;
kha: Ki jubab ,  Mynta ngi tip ba U  Trai  u don bad phi , bad ngi pyrkhat ba ka dei ban don ka jingïateh kular badonburom hapdeng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Ngi la iohi shisha ba U Trai u la don ryngkat bad me: bad ngi la ong: To ai mynta ka jingsmai ia ngi, wat ia ngi bad ia me, bad to ngin ia leh ia ka jutang bad me;

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , In the seventh month , in the first day of the month , shall ye have a sabbath , a memorial of blowing of trumpets , an holy convocation .
kha: Ong ha ki Israel ,  Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynñiew , rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi shongthait kaba kyrpang , bad haba ka turoi ka sawa , wan ïalumlang ban mane Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel, da kaba ong: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai, phin don ka Sabha, ka jingkynmaw ia ka jingsawa ia ki turoi , ka jingpynbna bakhuid .

en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood : and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls : for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul .
kha: Ka jingim ki kynja ba-im baroh ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la hukum ba dei ban theh ïa baroh ka snam ha ka duwan ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Ka snam , kaba long ka jingim , ka weng noh ïa ki pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingim jong ka doh ka don ha ka snam: bad nga la ai ia ka ha phi ha ka almari ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong phi: namar ka long ka snam kaba pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka mynsiem .

en: And when they began to sing and to praise , the  Lord  set ambushments against the children of Ammon , Moab , and mount Seir , which were come against Judah  ; and they were smitten .
kha: Haba ki la sdang ban rwai , U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai ba wan tur ïaleh , ban ngat hapdeng ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la sdang ban rwai bad ban iaroh , U Trai u la buh ia ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Ammon , u Moab bad u lum Seir , kiba la wan pyrshah ia u Judah ; bad ki la shah pynjot .

en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall , and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar , and will say unto you , The wall is no more , neither they that daubed it  ;
kha: Ka kynroh bad kito kiba tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh kin sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Nangta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba ka kynroh kam don shuh bad kumta ruh long kito kiba ñiad pushara lieh ïa ka —
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor ka kynroh bad halor jong ki kiba la pynkhih ia ka da ka dewbilat kaba khlem da pynkhih , bad ngan ong ha phi , Ka kynroh kam don shuh , lymne kita kiba la pynkhih ia ka;

en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity , they allure through the lusts of the flesh , through much wantonness , those that were clean escaped from them who live in error .
kha: Ki kren ïa ki jingkren sarong bad ba-mutlop , bad ki riam pah da ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh ïa ki briew kiba dang shu sdang ban phet ïap napdeng ki briew kiba im ha ka jingleh bymdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ki kren ia ki ktien kiba sngewsih kiba khraw jong ka jinglong ba sniew, ki pynkhih lyngba ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh, lyngba ka jingkwah brai kaba bun, kito kiba la khuid ki la lait na ki kiba im ha ka jingbakla .

en: And the third angel sounded , and there fell a great star from heaven , burning as it were a lamp , and it fell upon the third part of the rivers , and upon the fountains of waters  ;
kha: Nangta u angel uba lai u la put ïa la ka turoi . U khlur uba heh , uba meh kum ka dongmusa , u la hap na sahit bneng bad u la hap halor ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki wah bad halor ki pukri um .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba lai u la sawa , bad u la hap u khlur uba khraw na bneng , uba thang kumba ka long ka sharak , bad u la hap ha ka bynta kaba lai jong ki wah bad ha ki pung um;

en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel : and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Ahab u khun u Omri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar arphew ar snem ha Samaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew san snem u syiem Judah u la sdang ban synshar ia ki Israel: bad u Ahab u khun u Omri u la synshar ia ki Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri Israel ha ka ri

en: A cubit shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof  ; foursquare shall it be : and two cubits shall be the height thereof : the horns thereof shall be of the same .
kha: Ka dei ban long kaba sawdong , sawphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong , bad sawphew san sentimitar ka pyngkiang bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka kynjang . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki dei ban ïadait lang kawei bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka cuit kan long ka jingjrong jong ka, bad ka cuit ka long: bad ar cuit kan long ka jingjrong jong ka: ki bniat jong ka kin long kumjuh .

en: As for thee , O king , thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed , what should come to pass hereafter : and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass .
kha: Mynba u Syiem Kynrad u dang ïohthiah , phi la phohsniew shaphang ka lawei ; bad U Blei uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan , u la pyn-i ha phi kaei ka ban sa jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia me, ko syiem, ki jingpyrkhat jong me ki la wan ha ka jingmut jong me ha ka jingthiah jong me, kaei kaba dei ban jia hadien: bad uta uba pynpaw ia ki jingmaham u pynpaw ia me ia kaei kaban sa jia .

en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word  ; and the care of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , choke the word , and he becometh unfruitful .
kha: Ki symbai kiba hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai shaphang kane ka jingim bad ka jingieit ïa ka spah ki kjap ïa ka khubor , bad kim pynmih soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta ruh uba la ioh symbai hapdeng ki thliew u long uta uba iohsngew ia ka ktien ; bad ka jingsumar jong kane ka pyrthei , bad ka jingleh thok jong ki spah , u pynkhih ia ka ktien , bad u kylla long u bym don soh .

en: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day , to do that which is right in the eyes of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , bad phi leh ruh ïa kata kaba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me sngap ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong me, ban sumar ia ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi .

en: And when he had opened the third seal , I heard the third beast say , Come and see . And I beheld , and lo a black horse  ; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand .
kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba lai ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba lai uba ong ,  To wan !  Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai uba ïong . U nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka tarajur ha la ka kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la plie ia ka muhor kaba lai, nga la iohsngew ia u mrad uba lai ba u ong, To wan bad peit . Bad nga la iohi, bad u kulai uba lieh; bad uta uba shong halor jong u u don ar tylli ki jinglong ha ka kti jong u .

en: And I charged your judges at that time , saying , Hear the causes between your brethren , and judge righteously between every man and his brother , and the stranger that is with him .
kha: Ha ka por ba thung , nga la hikai ïa ki , ‘ Sngap bha ïa ki kam ïakajia kiba mih hapdeng ki briew jong phi . Bishar hok ïa kawei pa kawei ka kam , la ka long tang hapdeng ki briew jong phi , ne ka ïadei ruh bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la pynngat ia ki nongbishar jong phi ha kata ka por, da kaba ong: To sngap ia ki daw hapdeng ki hynmen jong phi, bad bishar hok hapdeng uwei pa uwei bad u hynmen jong u, bad u nongwei uba don bad u .

en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us ?
kha: Hato kam pat biang tang ba phi la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt kaba seisoh ban pynïap ïa ngi hangne ha ri khlaw ? Phi kwah sa ban da long kynrad halor jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka long kaba rit ba me la wanrah ia ngi na ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ban pyniap ia ngi ha ka ri khlaw , lait noh tang ma me hi uba long u syiem halor jong ngi ?

en: And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the street which is called Straight , and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul , of Tarsus : for , behold , he prayeth ,
kha: U Trai u la ong ha u ,  Khreh bad leit sha ‘ Ka Lynti Ba-beit ,’ bad ha ka ïing jong u Judas kylli ïa u briew na Tarsos uba kyrteng u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, To khie, bad leit sha ka lynti kaba la khot ka Lynti, bad to kylli ha ka iing u Judas na ka bynta uwei uba la khot u Saul, na u Tarsos: namar, ha khmih, u duwai .

en: And the battle increased that day : howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even : and about the time of the sun going down he died .
kha: Katba ka thma ka dang jur , u syiem Ahab u kyrshan tyngeh ïa lade ha ka kali ïapom jong u pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ha ka por sep sngi u ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka thma ka la nang kiew ha kata ka sngi: katba u syiem Israel u la sah ha ka kali jong u pyrshah ia ki Syria haduh ka por ba ka sngi ka la hiar u la iap .

en: And Joseph made ready his chariot , and went up to meet Israel his father , to Goshen , and presented himself unto him  ; and he fell on his neck , and wept on his neck a good while .
kha: Haba ki la poi hangta , u Joseph u kiew ha la ka kali kulai bad u leit sha Goshen ban ïashem ïa u kpa jong u . Haba ki la ïashem , u Joseph u la piam khak ïa la u kpa , u da ïam slem ha ka ryndang u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la pynkhreh ia ka kali jong u, bad u la leit sha u Israel u kpa jong u, ha Goshen, bad u la pyni ia lade ha u ; bad u la dem ha ka ryndang jong u, bad u la iam ha ka ryndang jong u shipor .

en: And the watchman said , Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok . And the king said , He is a good man , and cometh with good tidings .
kha: Uta u nongap phira u ong ,  Nga ïohi ba u briew uba ha khmat u mareh kum u Ahimaas .   U dei u briew uba bha ,  u syiem u ong ,  bad u wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongap u la ong , Nga pyrkhat ia ka jingmareh kaba kham shakhmat ka long kum ka jingmareh jong u Ahimaas u khun u Sadok . Bad u syiem u la ong , U long u briew uba bha bad u wan ryngkat bad ki khubor kiba bha .

en: But I tell you of a truth , many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias , when the heaven was shut up three years and six months , when great famine was throughout all the land  ;
kha: Shahshkor ïa nga : Ka long kaba shisha ba ki don shibun ki riewkynthei ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elijah , haba ym shym la don slap haduh lai snem shiteng bad ba ka  nemsniew bajur ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ong ia phi ia ka jingshisha, bun ki riewkynthei ki la don ha Israel ha ki sngi u Elias, haba ka bneng ka la khang lai snem hynriew bnai, haba ka jingkyrduh kaba khraw ka la long ha kylleng ka ri;

en: And the children of Benjamin said , They are smitten down before us , as at the first . But the children of Israel said , Let us flee , and draw them from the city unto the highways .
kha: Ki Benjamin ki ïa-ong ,  Ngi la jop ïa ki kum mynshuwa .  Hynrei ki Israel ki la ïasylla lypa ban randien bad ban ring pah ïa ki shabar ka nongbah shaduh ki lynti bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la ong , Ki la shah pynpra ha khmat jong ngi kumba ha kaba nyngkong . Hynrei ki khun Israel ki la ong , To ngin phet noh bad ngin tan ia ki na ka nongbah sha ki surok bah .

en: Know therefore that the  Lord  thy God , he is God , the faithful God , which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations  ;
kha: To kynmaw ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u long ma u hi U Blei , U Blei uba ïaineh . Un bat ïa la ka jutang bad pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit kaba ïaineh ha ki hajar pateng bynriew kiba ieit ïa u bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: To tip namarkata ba U Trai U Blei jong me, u long U Blei, U Blei uba iaineh, uba bat ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei bad ki kiba ieit ia u bad u bat ia ki hukum jong u haduh shihajar pateng;

en: While he yet spake , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them : and behold a voice out of the cloud , which said , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased  ; hear ye him .
kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh uba tyngshaiñ u la wan halor jong ki , bad ka sur na u lyoh ka la ong ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh — to shahshkor ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren, ha khmih, u lyoh uba shai u la tap ia ki: bad ha khmih ka sur na ka lyoh kaba la ong: Une u long U Khun baieit jong nga, ha uba nga sngewbha; ha uba nga sngewbha;

en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .
kha: Ko phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano lano ruh . U  Trai  u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ban ïoh jingïarap , un jubab ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki briew kin shong ha Seion ha Jerusalem: men ym iam shuh: un sngewbha shibun ia me ha ka sur jong ka jingud jong me ; ynda un iohsngew ia ka, un jubab ia me .

en: My people ask counsel at their stocks , and their staff declareth unto them : for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err , and they have gone a whoring from under their God .
kha: Ki pan ïa ki jingpynpaw na u lyngkhot dieng ! u diengduh u batai ïa ki kaei ba ki kwah ban tip ! Ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Kum ka briew kaba la kylla nuti , ki la aiti ïa lade ha kiwei pat ki blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong nga ki kylli jingmut ha ki stock jong ki, bad ki nongtrei jong ki ki pynbna ha ki: namar ka mynsiem jong ki nongkhaïi ka la pynlong ïa ki ban bakla , bad ki la leit noh na shapoh U Blei jong ki .

en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :
kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga tip ba me long u briew uba eh ; me ot ïa ki jingot na kaba mem shym la bet , bad me lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba mem shym la bet symbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta uta uba la ioh ia uta uwei u talent u la wan bad u la ong: Ko Trai, nga tip ia me ba me long u briew uba eh, uba ot ha ka jaka ba me la bet bad lum ha ka jaka ba me la bet:

en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;
kha: U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki bad u la ong ha ka Mari , ka kmie jong u ,  Ïa une u khunlung la jied da U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynim ïa kiba bun ha Israel . Un long ka dak na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun ki briew kin kren pyrshah bad kumta un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simeon u la kyrkhu ia ki bad u la ong ha ka Maria ka kmie jong u, Ha khmih, une u khynnah u la buh na ka bynta ka jinghap bad ka jingmih biang na kiba bun ha Israel ; bad na ka bynta ka dak kaba yn kren pyrshah ia u ; .

en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .
kha: To pynïeng ki jingkdew lynti bad pruid dak ha ka surok ; to wad biang ïa ka lynti kaba phi la iehnoh . To wan phai biang , ko phi ki paid Israel , to wan sha la ka ri , sha ki shnong kiba phi la iehnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia me sha jrong ki dak ki shin, pynlong ia me ban kiew sha ka lynti bah: pynbeit ia ka dohnud jong me sha ka lynti bah: phai biang sha kine ki nongbah jong me .

en: Six days shall work be done : but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest , an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no work therein : it is the sabbath of the  Lord  in all your dwellings .
kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei ïa la ka kam , hynrei kynmaw ba ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka Sabbaton , ka dei ka sngi shongthait . Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei . Ka Sabbaton ka long ka jong U  Trai  , ha ki ïing jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi yn trei: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynriew ka long ka sngi shongthait kaba khuid; phin ym leh ei ei ha kata: ka long ka sngi shongthait jong U Trai ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh .

en: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal , and I have not made supplication unto the  Lord  : I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .
kha: kumta nga la pyrkhat , ‘ Ki Philistia kin wan tur ïaleh ïa nga hangne ha Gilgal , bad ngam shym la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U  Trai .’ Kumta nga sngew ba nga dei ban ai ka jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la ong , Ki Philistia kin wan hiar mynta ha nga sha Gilgal , bad ngam shym la kyrpad ia U Trai: Nga la pynbor ia lade namarkata , bad nga la tyrwa ia ka jingknia thang .

en: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .
kha: Ka la leh ïa kane bun sngi , haduh ba u Paul u la sngew salia eh ba u la phai sawdong bad u la ong ha uta u mynsiem bymman ,  Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist nga hukum ïa me ban mihnoh na ka !  Uta u mynsiem bymman u la mihnoh na ka ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka la leh bun sngi . Hynrei u Paul, haba u la sngewsih, u la phai bad u la ong ha u mynsiem, Nga hukum ia me ha ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist ban mih na ka . Bad u la mih ha kajuh ka kynta .

en: Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .
kha: Ko hynmen ko para jong nga ,  u la ong ,  ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha ha kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u Dabid , u la pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la long u nongïalam ïa kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang bad ki para , kane ka jingthoh ka la dei ban long kaba la pyndep, kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid da ka shyntur u Dabid u la kren ha khmat u Judas , kaba la ialam ia ki kiba la shim ia U Jisu .

en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him : and he rose up by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots .
kha: Kumta u Jehoram lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la mih bad ki kali ïapom bad ki hiarthma ïa ka Edom . Hangta ka kynhun shipai jong ki Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki , hynrei ha ka por mynmiet ki la ïohlad ban mih shabar bad lait phet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jehoram u la leit noh bad ki rangbah jong u, bad ki kali jong u baroh: bad u la ieng miet , bad u la shoh ia ki nong Edome kiba la ker sawdong ia u , bad ki rangbah jong ki kali .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height , and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs , and his heart is lifted up in his height  ;
kha: Mynta te , ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar ngan ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa uta u dieng uba la san haduh ba u la kot ïa ki lyoh . Katba u nang san kham jrong u la nang sngewsarong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Namar me la pynkiew ia lade ha ka jingjrong, bad u la pynkiew ia la ka tduh hapdeng ki tnat kiba jylliew, bad ka dohnud jong u ka la kiew ha ka jingjrong jong u ; .

en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .
kha: Ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade da ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long kiba khuid . Hynrei lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Un pynkhuid ia lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew un long uba khuid: hynrei lada um pynkhuid ia lade ha ka sngi kaba lai , te ha ka sngi kaba hynriew un ym long uba khuid .

en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them  ; and they declare their sin as Sodom , they hide it not . Woe unto their soul ! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves .
kha: Ïa ki jingnoh shiliang jong ki yn bat pyrshah ïa ki . Ki leh pop khlem rieh kumba ki briew ka Sodom ki la leh . Ki long kiba la tim , bad ki la wallam ïa ka halor jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpyni ia ka khmat jong ki ka sakhi pyrshah ia ki ; bad ki pynbna ia ka pop jong ki kum ka Sodom , kim buhrieh ia ka . Ka long kaba sniew ia ka mynsiem jong ki ! namar ki la siew kylliang ia lade .

en: Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .
kha: To long u nongaplangbrot ïa la ki briew , A  Trai  , ki briew kiba me la jied . Wat la ki shong saphred ha ka ri khlaw , ka don ka jaka baseisoh sawdong jong ki . To ai ba kin leit bad bam na ki jaka phlang bajyrngam jong ka Bashan bad ka Gilead , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa la slem bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyndait ia ki briew jong me da u diengduh jong me, ka kynhun jong ka pateng jong me, kaba shong marwei ha khlaw, hapdeng ka Karmel: to ai ba kin bam ha Basan bad Gilead kumba ha ki sngi barim .

en: He heweth him down cedars , and taketh the cypress and the oak , which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest : he planteth an ash , and the rain doth nourish it .
kha: U lah ban pom ïa ki dieng Kedar ban pyndonkam , lane u jied da u dieng Sning lane u dieng Kseh-Sypress na ka khlaw . Lane u lah ban thung u dieng ba ïai jyrngam bad u ap ïa u slap ban pynmih ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U pynkhih ia u shapoh ki diengsoh , bad u shim ia u sohjew bad u oak , uba u pynskhem ia lade hapdeng ki dieng khlaw: u thung ia ka dewbilat bad u slap u pyndap ia ka .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go on before the people , and take with thee of the elders of Israel  ; and thy rod , wherewith thou smotest the river , take in thine hand , and go .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ïalam bad me katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad leit sha shuwa jong u paidbah . Rah ruh ïa u diengduh da uba me la shoh ïa ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To iaid shakhmat ha khmat ki briew, bad to shim bad me ia ki rangbah Israel; bad u diengduh jong me, da kaba me sngap jar ia ka wah, to shim ha ka kti jong me bad leit noh .

en: And the king answered , Chimham shall go over with me , and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee : and whatsoever thou shalt require of me , that will I do for thee .
kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Ngan ïalam ïa u bad nga , ngan leh na ka bynta jong u kat kaba phi kwah . Bad ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ïa kano kano kaba phi ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab: U Chimham un leit shajan bad nga, bad ngan leh ia kata kaba bha ha me: bad kaei kaei kaba me dawa na nga, kata ngan leh na ka bynta jong me .

en: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven , clothed with a cloud : and a rainbow was upon his head , and his face was as it were the sun , and his feet as pillars of fire :
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi sa uwei pat u angel bakhrawbor ba u wan hiar na bneng . La sop ïa u ha u lyoh bad la don u simpyllieng sawdong ka khlieh jong u ; ka durkhmat jong u ka long kum ka sngi , bad ki kjat jong u kum ki rishot ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia uwei pat u angel uba khlain bor ba u wan hiar na bneng: bad u slap u la don halor ka khlieh jong u: bad ka khmat jong u ka la long kum ka sngi: bad ki kjat jong u kum ki lum ding:

en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold , and their hooks shall be of gold : and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them .
kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , thaw san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar . Ki bnoh jong ki ruh ki dei ban long da ka ksiar . Thaw san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong ha ka bynta kine ki rishot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki san tylli ki lum kiba jrong, bad to tap ia ki da ka ksiar, bad ki hook jong ki kin long ki ksiar: bad me dei ban bret san tylli ki socket nar na ka bynta jong ki .

en: These are the words of the covenant , which the  Lord  commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .
kha: Kine ki long ki ktien jong kata ka jutang ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban pynlong bad ki Israel ha ka ri ki Moab ; kane baroh ka la long ka jingbynrap shuh shuh halor kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki ha u Lum Sinai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ktien jong ka jutang kaba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses ban leh bad ki khun Israel ha ka ri Moab , nalor ka jutang kaba u la leh bad ki ha Horeb .

en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .
kha: U briew uba ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long kum ka sim kaba pynmih khun na ki pylleng kiba ka khlem kha . Ha ka rta ba la ih bha un duh noh ïa ka spah jong u , bad ha kaba kut um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u bsein u shong ha ki snier , bad u pynkha ia ki; kumta uta uba ioh ia ka spah, bad ym da ka hok, un iehnoh ia ki hapdeng ki sngi jong u, bad ha kaba kut jong u un long uba bieit .

en: Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .
kha: La phi don ne phim don ïa ka Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phi , ngi pynshlur ïa phi ban pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka sngi . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .
translated_en_to_kha: La phi don ia ka Jingpynkylla ia ka Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phi ne em, ngi pynshlur ia phi ban rung ha ka rukom kaba bha jong ka jingpule ia ka Ktien Jehobah man ka sngi .  Joshua 1:8 ; Salm 1:2 , 3 .

en: Simon Peter saith unto them , I go a fishing . They say unto him , We also go with thee . They went forth , and entered into a ship immediately  ; and that night they caught nothing .
kha: U Simon Petros u la ong ha kita kiwei pat ,  Ngan leit tong dohkha noh .   Ngin wan lang bad me ,  ki la ong ha u . Kumta ki la ïamihnoh ha ka lieng , hynrei baroh shi miet kim shym la ngat ei ei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Simon Petros u ong ha ki, nga leit ri dohkha . Ki ong ia u , Ngi ruh ngi leit ryngkat bad me . Ki la leit noh bad ki la rung ha ka lieng mardor; bad ha kata ka miet kim shym la kem ei ei .

en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth , and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Haba kata kan jia , ngan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel kiba khlaiñ bad ngan shah ïa me , ko Esekiel , ban kren ha kaba baroh kin ïohsngew ïa me , khnang ba kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan pynlong ia ka horn jong ka iing Israel ban mih sha khmat , bad ngan ai ia me ia ka jingplie ia ka shyntur hapdeng jong ki ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering , and , behold , it was burnt : and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar , the sons of Aaron which were left alive , saying ,
kha: U Moses u la kylli bniah shaphang uta u  langsohmoh ba la ai kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad u la tip ba la lah thang noh ïa u . Kane ka la pynlong ïa u ban bitar ïa u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , bad u kylli ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wad da ka jingsngewrit ia u blang jong ka jingknia pop: bad u la bitar ia u Eleasar bad u Isar , ki khun shynrang u Aaron kiba la sah im , ki da ong:

en: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew kiba donburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kata , u ong ha ki , Kiba koit ba khiah kim donkam ia u doktor , hynrei kiba pang: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ia kiba hok , hynrei ki nongpop ban kylla bamut .

en: And to them it was given that they should not kill them , but that they should be tormented five months : and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion , when he striketh a man .
kha: Ym shym la shah ïa ki puit ban pynïap ïa kine ki briew , hynrei tang ban shu pynsaja ïa ki san bnai . Ka jingkynjut na kata ka jingpynsaja ka long kum na ka sni jong ka  ñianglartham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki la ai ba kim dei ban pyniap ia ki, hynrei ba kin shah pynshitom san bnai: bad ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki ka long kum ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong u khniang , haba u shoh ia u briew .

en: And he said ,  Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God : but to others in parables  ; that seeing they might not see , and hearing they might not understand .
kha: bad u la jubab ,  Ïa ka jingtip ïa kiba rieh jong ka Hima U Blei la ai ha phi , hynrei ha kiwei pat ka wan ha ki pharshi , khnang ba ki lah ban peit hynrei kim ïohi , bad shahshkor hynrei kim shemphang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ha phi la ai ban tip ia ki jingmaham jong ka hima U Blei: hynrei ha kiwei pat ha ki pharshi ; ba ki iohi ba kim lah ban iohi , bad ki iohsngew ba kim lah ban sngewthuh .

en: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .
kha: Ki pyrshang ban shem lano ka por kan long bad kumno kan wan . Kane ka la long ka por sha kaba U Mynsiem U Khrist uba don ha ki u kdew , ha kaba ïathuhlypa ïa ki jingshah shitom kiba U Khrist un hap ban shah bad ïa ka burom ka ban sa bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingwad ia kaei , ne kaei ka rukom jong ka por U Khrist uba la don ha ki ka la paw , haba ka la sakhi lypa ia ki jingjynjar U Khrist , bad ka burom kaba dei ban bud .

en: But this I confess unto thee , that after the way which they call heresy , so worship I the God of my fathers , believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets :
kha: Nga phla ïa kane ha me : Nga mane ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi da kaba bud ïa kata ka Lynti ïa kaba ki ong ba ka long kaba bakla . Hynrei nga ruh nga ngeit ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses bad ha ki kitab jong ki nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kane nga phla ha me, ba hadien ka lynti kaba ki khot ka jingngeit bakla, kumta nga mane ia U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga, da kaba ngeit ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka hukum bad ha ki nongiathuhlypa:

en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .
kha: Ym don jingbuh pud ïa ka jingdih waiñ ; u syiem u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih katba ki sngewkwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingdih ka long kat kum ka ain ; ym don ba pynbor: namar kumta u syiem u la thung ia ki ophisar jong ka iing jong u baroh, ba kin leh kat kum ka jingsngewbha jong uwei pa uwei .

en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said thus unto him , I have found a man of the captives of Judah , that will make known unto the king the interpretation .
kha: Kumta hi u Ariokh u la ïalam ïa u Daniel sha u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad u la ïathuh ha u syiem ,  Nga la shem uwei na ki Jiw kiba la shah ringmraw , uba lah ban ïathuh ha u Syiem Kynrad ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Arich u la wanrah ia u Daniel ha khmat u syiem da kaba kyrkieh bad u la ong kumta ha u , nga la shem ia u briew na ki nongshah set jong u Judah , uba pyntip ha u syiem ia ka jingbatai .

en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem : but he did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , like David his father :
kha: U Ahas u long syiem haba u la dap arphew snem ka rta , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Um shym la bud ïa ka nuksa babha jong u kpa tymmen jong u , u syiem Dabid ; pynban u la leh ïa kaei ka bym pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  bad u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahas u la don arphew snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar , bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem : hynrei um shym la leh ia kata kaba dei ha khmat U Trai, kum u kpa jong u:

en: And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .
kha: Haba u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynmaw ïa ka jutang baïaineh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka bow kan long ha u lyoh ; bad ngan peit ia ka , ba ngan kynmaw ia ka jutang bymjukut hapdeng U Blei bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba im jong ka doh baroh kaba don ha ka khyndew .

en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ong ha phi , ‘ Ngan sa leit noh , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phi .’ Lada phi la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U Kpa ; naba u long kham khraw ban ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la iohsngew kumno nga la ong ha phi, nga leit noh bad nga wan phai biang sha phi . Lada phi ieit ia nga , phin sngewbha , namar nga la ong: namar U Kpa jong nga u kham khraw ban ia nga .

en: That at that time ye were without Christ , being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel , and strangers from the covenants of promise , having no hope , and without God in the world :
kha: Ha kata ka por phi la long khlem U Khrist . Phi la long ki nongwei bad phim shym la dei ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei . Phim shym la don bynta ha ki jutang , kiba la pynshong nongrim ha ki jingkular jong U Blei sha ki briew jong u , bad phi la im ha kane ka pyrthei khlem jingkyrmen bad khlem U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha kata ka por phi la long khlem U Khrist, da kaba long ki nongwei na ka ri Israel, bad ki nongwei na ki jutang jong ka jingkular, khlem jingkyrmen, bad khlem U Blei ha ka pyrthei:
