en: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth , and hath given him power to eat thereof , and to take his portion , and to rejoice in his labour  ; this is the gift of God .
kha: Lada U Blei u ai ha ngi ka spah bad ka jingdon jingem bad to ngin lehkmen ha ki , ngi dei ban sngewnguh bad lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai na U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pa uwei ruh ha uba U Blei u la ai ia ka spah bad ka spah, bad u la ai bor ia u ban bam ia ka, bad ban shim ia ka bhah jong u, bad ban kmen ha ka jingtrei shitom jong u; kane ka long ka jingai jong U Blei .

en: When the sin , which they have sinned against it , is known , then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin , and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: kumta haba la bna ïa kata ka pop , u paidlang un wanlam ïa u masi lyngraw kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop . Kin wanrah sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la tip ia ka pop kaba ki la leh pyrshah ia ka , te ka jingiaseng kan aiti ia u masi rit na ka bynta ka pop , bad kan wanrah ia u ha khmat ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters  ; they only shall be delivered , but the land shall be desolate .
kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Kin lah ban pynim tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim , bad ka ri kan kylla long ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la kine ki lai ngut ki briew ki la don ha ka, kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei, kin ym ai khun shynrang ne kynthei ; tang ma ki kin shah pynpoi , hynrei ka ri kan sa shah pynjot .

en: And one of the elders saith unto me , Weep not : behold , the Lion of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , hath prevailed to open the book , and to loose the seven seals thereof .
kha: Te uwei na ki nongsharai balang u la ong ha nga ,  Wat ïam . Ha khmih ! U Sing na ka jait Judah , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , u la ïoh ïa ka jingjop , bad u lah ban pynpait ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait bad ban plied ïa ka kot kli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha nga, Wat iam: ha khmih u Sing jong ka jait Judah , u Root u Dabid u la jop ban plie ia ka kot bad ban pyllait ia ki hynriew tylli ki muhor jong ka .

en: Behold , he shall come up and fly as the eagle , and spread his wings over Bozrah : and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs .
kha: U nongshun un tur ïaleh ïa ka Bosrah kum u pukni uba suh wia sha tbian lem bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar . Ha kata ka sngi ki shipai Edom kin sheptieng kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , un wan shaneng bad un her kum u blang , bad un pynphriang ia ki bniat jong u halor u Bosrah: bad ha kata ka sngi ka dohnud jong ki riewshlur jong ka Edom kan long kum ka dohnud jong ka kynthei ha ki jingpang jong ka .

en: He that hath my commandments , and keepeth them , he it is that loveth me : and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father , and I will love him , and will manifest myself to him .
kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ïa ki hukum jong nga bad ngeit ïa ki u long uta uba ieit ïa nga . U Kpa jong nga un ieit ïa uno uno uba ieit ïa nga ; nga ruh ngan ieit ïa u bad ngan pynpaw ïa lade ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba don ia ki hukum jong nga bad uba sumar ia ki, uta u long uba ieit ia nga: bad uta uba ieit ia nga un shah ieit ha U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan ieit ia u bad ngan pynpaw ia lade ha u .

en: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor , and turn aside the way of the meek : and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid , to profane my holy name :
kha: Ki kyrdem ïa kiba tlot bad ki bymdonbor bad ki khynñiat sharud lynti ïa kiba duk . U briew bad u kpa jong u ki ïathiah shongkha ïa kajuh ka kynthei mraw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka pan ia ka dewmet jong ka khyndew ha ka khlieh jong kiba duk, bad ka pynphai noh ia ka lynti jong kiba jemnud: bad u briew bad u kpa jong u kin leit sha kajuh ka nongtrei , ban pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga:

en: And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .
kha: U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap lut khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Nob, ka shnong jong ki lyngdoh, u la sdang ia ka waitlam, ki shynrang bad ki kynthei, ki khun bad ki khun masi bad ki blang bad ki blang bad ki langbrot bad ki blang .

en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king , and without a prince , and without a sacrifice , and without an image , and without an ephod , and without teraphim :
kha: Ha kane kajuh ka rukom ki briew ka Israel kin hap ban ap slem khlem ki syiem ne ki nongïalam , khlem jingkñia lane rishot mawkyntang , khlem bleithaw lane dur ban pyndonkam ha kaba khan blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun Israel kin im bun sngi khlem u syiem, bad khlem u syiem, bad khlem ka jingknia, bad khlem ka dur , bad khlem ka effod bad khlem ka teraphim:

en: For it is written , Rejoice , thou barren that bearest not ; break forth and cry , thou that travailest not : for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband .
kha: Naba la thoh ,  Suk , pha ka kynthei kaba lyngki ! To risa bad kyang da ka jingkmen , pha ka bym ju la ïohmad ïa ki jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha ! Naba kata ka kynthei kaba la shah iehnoh kan ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka kynthei kaba u tnga um ju iehnoh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar la thoh: To sngewbha, me uba khlem shah shuh shuh bad uba iam: namar ka jingkren bein ka don bun ki khun kiba kham bun ban ia kata kaba don tnga .

en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers .
kha: Da kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , ba phin ïoh im , phin roi , bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki hukum kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi phin sumar , ba phin im bad nang bun bad leit rung bad bat ia ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: But if ye will not obey the voice of the  Lord  , but rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall the hand of the  Lord  be against you , as it was against your fathers .
kha: Hynrei lada phim shahshkor ïa U  Trai  bad phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , un long pyrshah ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phin ym kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai , hynrei phin leh pyrshah ia ka hukum U Trai , te ka kti U Trai kan long pyrshah ia phi kumba ka la long pyrshah ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Kane ka lah ban i kum ka bym lah long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mynta , hynrei kam long ka bym lah ban long ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai jong ki paid ; Lada ka long kaba phylla ha ki khmat jong kine ki briew kiba sah ha kine ki sngi ? ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And Moses called all Israel , and said unto them , Hear , O Israel , the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day , that ye may learn them , and keep , and do them .
kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh bad u ong ha ki ,  Ko phi ki Israel , shahshkor ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Pule ïa ki bad pynthikna ba phi kohnguh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia ki Israel baroh bad u la ong ha ki, To sngap ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba nga kren ha ki shkor jong phi mynta ka sngi, ba phin nang ia ki bad to sumar ia ki .

en: And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon  ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .
kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba shong basah ha Jerusalem uba kyrteng u Simeon . U la long u briew uba bha , uba sheptieng ïa U Blei bad uba ïai ap na ka bynta ki Israel ban ïoh jingpynim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la don uwei u briew ha Jerusalem, uba la jer kyrteng u Simeon ; bad uta u juh u briew u long uba hok bad uba riewblei, uba ap ia ka jingpyntngen ia ki Israel: bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la don halor jong u .

en: ( As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir , and the Moabites which dwell in Ar , did unto me  ; ) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the  Lord  our God giveth us .
kha: haduh ba ngin da jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi , kumba ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , kiba shong ha Edom , bad ki Moab kiba shong ha Ar , ki la shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: (Kumba ki khun u Iso kiba shong ha Seir bad ki nong Moab kiba shong ha Ar ki la leh ia nga ; ) haduh ba ngan da iaid lait ia ka Jordan sha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u ai ha ngi .

en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness  ; and all that were numbered of you , according to your whole number , from twenty years old and upward , which have murmured against me ,
kha: Phin ïap bad ïa ki metïap jong phi yn pynphriang ha kylleng kane ka ri khlaw . Namar ba phi la khñium pyrshah ïa nga , yn ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la palat arphew snem ka rta u ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki met iap jong phi kin hap ha kane ka ri khlaw bad baroh kiba la khein ia phi katkum ka jingkhein jong phi baroh kawei, naduh arphew snem shaneng, kiba la ia tyngkhuh bad nga .

en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation , and for the altar of the  Lord  , even unto this day , in the place which he should choose .
kha: Hynrei ha kajuh ka por u la pynlong mraw ïa ki ban thoh dieng bad kit um ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa ka duwan U  Trai . Haduh kane ka sngi ki la ïai bteng ïa kane ka kam ha ka jaka kaba u Trai u la jied ban mane ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynlong ia ki ha kata ka sngi ki lum dieng bad ki um na ka bynta ka jingiaseng bad na ka bynta ka jingknia U Trai, haduh kane ka sngi, ha ka jaka kaba u dei ban jied .

en: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
kha: La leit on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad kaba ki dang leit lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria , ki la ïathuh kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai sha U Blei ; kane ka khubor ka la wallam ka jingkmen bakhraw ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la wanrah ia ki da ka balang, ki la iaid lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria, ki da pynbna ia ka jingkylla kaba mut jong ki Jutang: bad ki la pynmih ia ka jingkmen kaba khraw ia ki parabangeit baroh .

en: Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .
kha: Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me ,  u Joab u ong . U rah lai tylli ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong u Absalom katba u dang im , haba u dang sdien ha u dieng Sning .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joab u la ong: Ngam lah ban sah kumta bad me . Bad u la shim lai tylli ki nar ha ka kti jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ki lyngba ka dohnud u Absalom , katba u dang im hapdeng u oak .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; No stranger , uncircumcised in heart , nor uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any stranger that is among the children of Israel .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga pynbna ba yn ym don uno uno u nongwei bym shym la otsher , uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa nga , un rung ha ka Templ jong nga , wat u nongwei uba shong basah hapdeng ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai Blei bar ri, u bym pat shah ot ha ka dohnud, ne u bym pat shah ot ha ka doh, un rung ha ka jaka kyntang jong nga, na uno uno u nongwei uba don hapdeng ki khun Israel .

en: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals : they shall be of fine flour  ; they shall be baken with leaven  ; they are the firstfruits unto the  Lord .
kha: Kawei pa kawei ka longïing ka dei ban wallam ar tylli ki kpu ban pynlong ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai . Kita ki kpu ki dei ban long kiba ar kilo uwei uwei , kiba la pynkhreh na u  purew , bad kiba la shet bad u thiat , bad yn ai ïa ki kum ki soh nyngkong sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin pynmih na ki jaka shong jaka sah jong phi ar tylli ki kpu ba la shet: kin long ki shini kiba bha ; kin long kiba la shet da ka jingsma ; ki long ki soh ba nyngkong eh ha U Trai .

en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That there be some of them that stand here , which shall not taste of death , till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power .
kha: Bad u la ong shuh shuh ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ki don katto katne ngut hangne ki ban ym ïap haduh ba kin da ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei ba ka wan ha ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ba don katto katne na kita kiba ieng hangne ki bym sngewtynnad ia ka jingiap , haduh ba kin da iohi ia ka hima U Blei ba ka wan da ka bor .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take unto thee sweet spices , stacte , and onycha , and galbanum  ; these sweet spices with pure frankincense : of each shall there be a like weight :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim mar katjuh na kine ki jingiwbih suhsieng — ka stakte , ka onikha , ka galbanum , bad ka jingiwbih basngur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To shim ha me ia ki jingbam ba thiang, ki staque bad ki onycha, bad ki sohjew baroh arngut: na kawei pa kawei kan don ka jingkhia kaba kum kata:

en: Then Saul said to David , Blessed be thou , my son David : thou shalt both do great things , and also shalt still prevail . So David went on his way , and Saul returned to his place .
kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko khun jong nga ! Phin nang jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh !  Kumta u Dabid u leit ha la ka lynti , bad u Saul u leit phai sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la ong ha u Dabid, To long uba la kyrkhu, ko khun jong nga: me ruh men leh ia kiei kiei kiba khraw, bad me ruh men dang jop . Kumta u Dabid u la leit noh sha la ka jong ka jaka .

en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lane ka longïing kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la tip ia ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha ki: Kawei pa kawei ka hima kaba la phiah pyrshah ia lade ka shah pynjot ; bad kawei pa kawei ka shnong ne ka iing kaba la phiah pyrshah ia lade kan ym ieng:

en: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock , and out of thy floor , and out of thy winepress : of that wherewith the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him .
kha: Ai kylluid mynsiem ïa ki na ki jingkyrkhu kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi — na ki langbrot , na u kew , bad na ka waiñ jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban pyndap ia u da kaba laitluid na ka kynhun jong me, bad na ka mala jong me, bad na ka jaka dih wain jong me: na kata kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la kyrkhu ia me .

en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen , either in the warp , or woof , or any thing of skins , to pronounce it clean , or to pronounce it unclean .
kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka jingbthuh ha ka jaiñkup , la ka dei kaba da u  saiwul ne da ka linen , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh , dei ha kane ka rukom yn bishar la ka long kaba khuid ne ka bymkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka ain jong ka khlam sniehdoh ha ka jain kaba jyrngam ne kaba jyrngam , la ka long ha ka sniehdoh ne ka sniehdoh , ban pynpaw ia ka kaba khuid , ne ban pynpaw ia ka kaba khlem khuid .

en: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards , and the caul that is above the liver , and the two kidneys , and the fat that is upon them , and burn them upon the altar .
kha: Nangta pat , weng noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki snier , ïa u dohnud , bad ïa ki khyllai baroh ar lem bad ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki , bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan kum ka jingainguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me shim ia ka shini baroh kaba tap ia ka sniehdoh bad ka sniehdoh kaba don halor ka sniehdoh bad ki ar tylli ki snier bad ka shini kaba don halor jong ki bad thang ia ki ha ka almari .

en: But Jeremiah said , They shall not deliver thee . Obey , I beseech thee , the voice of the  Lord  , which I speak unto thee : so it shall be well unto thee , and thy soul shall live .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Yn ym aiti noh ïa phi sha ki . Nga kyrpad ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ka khubor U  Trai  ; te baroh kan bha ïa phi , bad ïa ka jingim jong phi yn pynsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jeremaiah u la ong , Kin ym pyllait ia me . Obey, nga kyrpad ia me, ka sur U Trai, kaba nga kren ha me: kumta kan long kaba bha ia me bad ka mynsiem jong me kan im .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondmen , saying ,
kha: Te U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ban ong ha ki paidbah :  Nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba nga la pyllait ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt bad pyllaitluid ïa ki na ka jinglongmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel; nga la leh ia ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha ka sngi ba nga la wanrah ia ki na ka ri Ijipt , na ka iing ki mraw , da kaba ong:

en: And the apostles , when they were returned , told him all that they had done . And he took them , and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida .
kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai pat bad ki la ïathuh ha U Jisu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh . U la ïalam ïa ki bad u , bad ki la ïaleit tang ma ki hi sha ka shnong ba la khot , ka Bethsaida .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki apostol, haba ki la wan phai, ki la iathuh ha u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh . U la shim ia ki bad u la leit noh marwei sha ka jaka ri khlaw kaba dei ka shnong kaba la khot ka Bethsaida .

en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .
kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang shi bynta ka jaka kumba la batai harum : Ka ri ka kynjoh shathie sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jong ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka pud jong ka Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane nangta ka la long ka bynta jong ki khun Judah da ki longiing jong ki ; haduh u pud u sam jong ka Edom ka ri khlaw Zin shaphang shathie ka la long kaba kut tam jong ka rud duriaw ba shathie .

en: And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold , of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou , She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him , Because I said , Lest I die for her .
kha: Kumta u Abimelekh u phah khot ïa u Isaak , bad u ong ,  Pleng , ka dei ka tnga jong me ! Balei pat me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me ?  U jubab ,  Namar nga pyrkhat ïoh ba nga shah pynïap lada nga ong ba ka dei ka tnga jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech u la khot ia u Isaak bad u la ong: Ha khmih, ka long ka tnga jong me: bad kumno me ong: Ka dei ka para jong nga ? U Isaak u la ong ha u: Namar nga la ong: To ngan iap na ka bynta jong ka .

en: Therefore I write these things being absent , lest being present I should use sharpness , according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification , and not to destruction .
kha: Kata ka long balei ba nga thoh ïa kane katba nga dang don jngai na phi ; ka long kumta ba haba nga poi ngan ym hap ban leh tyngeh ha kaba pyndonkam ïa ka iktiar ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha nga — ka bor ïa ka ban tei ïa phi , ym ïa ka ban pynpra .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga thoh ia kine kiei kiei ki bym don , ioh ba ngan pyndonkam ia ka jinglong kaba jem , kat kum ka bor kaba U Trai u la ai ha nga ban tei , bad ym ban pynjot .

en: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan , saying , The  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in , with the suburbs thereof for our cattle .
kha: Hangta ha Shiloh ha ka ri Kanaan ki ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la hukum da u Moses ba dei ban ai ïa ngi ki nongbah ba ngin shong ngin sah , lem bad ki pyntha phlang sawdong jong ki na ka bynta ki jingri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ha ki ha Shiloh ha ka ri Kanaan, ki da ong: U Trai u la hukum da ka kti u Moses ban ai ia ngi ki shnong ban shong ha ki jaka ba marjan jong ka na ka bynta ki masi jong ngi .

en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him , Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .
kha: Don uwei u shakri uba kyrteng u Siba ha ka longïing jong u Saul , bad la bthah ïa u ban leit sha u Dabid .  Me dei u Siba ?  u syiem u la kylli .  Nga hangne , ko Kynrad ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don na ka iing u Saul u shakri uba kyrteng u Siba . Bad haba ki la khot ia u ha u Dabid , u syiem u la ong ha u: Me Siba ? Bad u la ong: U shakri jong me u long ma u .

en: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things , in blue clothes , and broidered work , and in chests of rich apparel , bound with cords , and made of cedar , among thy merchandise .
kha: Ki la die ïa ki jaiñ baremdor , ki jaiñ rong jngum , bad ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki jingsiang ba shai rong , bad ki ksai bad tyllai ba la shna bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki nongkhaii jong me ha kiei kiei baroh, ha ki jain rong saw, bad ha ki shyntur jong ki jain kiba riewspah, kiba la teh da ki nar , bad kiba la shna da u sohjew, hapdeng ki mar jong me .

en: And it came to pass in Iconium , that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spake , that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed .
kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha Ikoniom : U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la kren ha kata ka rukom ba kiba bun ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki la kylla long ki riewngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha Iconia, ba ki la leit lang sha ka synagog jong ki Jiw bad kumta ki la kren , ba u paidbah uba bun na ki Jiw bad ruh na ki Grik u la ngeit .

en: I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .
kha: Nga long U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me ha Bethel , ha kaba me la pynkyntang ïa u maw kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw da kaba me la theh ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u bad ha kaba me la smai ha nga . Mynta to khreh ban leit phai pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Blei jong ka Bethel, ha kaba me la pynsleh ia u maw, bad ha kaba me la kular ia nga: mynta to mih noh na kane ka ri bad to leit phai noh sha ka ri jong u .

en: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols , we know that an idol is nothing in the world , and that there is none other God but one .
kha: Kumta te , shaphang kaba bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia sha ki bleithaw : Ngi tip ba ka bleithaw ka ïeng na ka bynta kano kano ka bym don ei ei shisha ; ngi tip ba don tang uwei U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka jingbam ia kita kiei kiei kiba la tyrwa ha ki bleithaw , ngi tip ba u bleithaw um don ei ei ha ka pyrthei , bad ba ym don uwei pat u Blei hynrei tang uwei .

en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also , he said unto them ,  Whosoever will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u khot ïa u paidbah bad ïa la ki synran sha u .  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  u dei ban klet noh ïa lade , bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la khot ia ki briew ha u bad ki synran jong u ruh, u la ong ha ki, Uno uno uba wan hadien jong nga, to un kyntait ia lade bad un rah ia la ka diengphna bad un bud ia nga .

en: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them ,  Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of  ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :
kha: Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab . U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Da shisha phin sa dih na ka khuri kaba nga dei ban dih bad ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba dei ban pynbaptis ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Ngi lah . U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Phi lah shisha ban dih na ka khuri kaba nga dih na ka ; bad da ka jingpynbaptis ia nga da ka um phin sa shah pynbaptis:

en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby .
kha: Haba la sneng sympat ïa ngi , ngi ju pyrkhat ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa ngi , bad ym kaba pynkmen ïa ngi . Pynban hadien , kito kiba shah pynbeit da kita ki rukom sneng sympat ki ïoh ot ïa ka bainong kaba ai jingsuk jong ka jingim bahok .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ym don ka jingpynkhuid ia ka mynta kaba i kumba ka long kaba kmen, hynrei kaba sngewsih: wat la katta ruh hadien kata ka ai ia u soh uba suk jong ka hok ha kito kiba la pyntreikam da kata .

en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .
kha: U la ailad ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jong u na bneng khnang ba u lah ban hikai ïa phi ; bad hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phin ïohi ïa ka ding kaba kyntang jong u , bad u la kren ha phi na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na bneng u la pynlong ia me ban iohsngew ia ka sur jong u, ba un hikai ia me: bad ha ka khyndew u la pyni ia me ia ka ding kaba khraw jong u ; bad me la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u na pdeng ka ding .

en: When the princes of Judah heard these things , then they came up from the king s house unto the house of the  Lord  , and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the  Lord s  house .
kha: Haba ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba lah jia , ki la wan kloi na ka ïingsyiem sha ka Templ bad ki la shong ha ka Khyrdop Bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki rangbah Judah ki la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei , ki la wan kiew na ka iing syiem sha ka iing U Trai , bad ki la shong ha ka jingkhang thymmai jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki kti jong ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor kata ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pdiang ia ki na ki kti jong ki, bad men thang ia ki ha ka jingknia thang, namar ka jingsma kaba thiang ha khmat U Trai: ka long ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: And they took ashes of the furnace , and stood before Pharaoh  ; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven  ; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast .
kha: Kumta ki la rah khyndiat u dpei bad ki la ïeng ha khmat u Pharaoh ; U Moses u la kynting ïa uta u dpei sha ka lyer , bad u dpei u la pynmih ïa ki tohjaw kiba kylla prum ha u briew bad ha u mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka dewbilat jong ka ding, bad ki la ieng ha khmat u Pharaoh ; bad u Moses u la pynkhih ia ka sha bneng ; bad ka la kylla long ka dewbilat kaba rkhiang da ki bniat ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !
kha: Ym don myntor , ym don jingleh byrtong , Kaba lah ban pyndonkam pyrshah ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Mynta ki briew kin ïakren shaphang ki Israel , ‘ Khmih aïu U Blei u la leh !’
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ym don ka jingleh jadu pyrshah ia u Jakob , bad ym don ka jingleh jadu pyrshah ia ki Israel: kat kum kane ka por yn ong ia u Jakob bad jong ki Israel , Kaei kaba U Blei u la leh !

en: Then I testified against them , and said unto them , Why lodge ye about the wall ? if ye do so again , I will lay hands on you . From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath .
kha: Nga maham ïa ki ,  Kam myntoi ban ap hangto habar ki kynroh ka nongbah na ka bynta ka step ka ban wan . Lada phi pyrshang biang ïa kane , ngan pyndonkam da ka bor pyrshah ïa phi .  Naduh kata , kim ju wan shuh ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la sakhi pyrshah ia ki bad nga la ong ha ki, Balei phi sahkut ha ka kynroh ? lada phi leh kumta pat ngan buh kti ia phi . Naduh kata ka por kim wan shuh ha ka sngi Saitjain .

en: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth , Gog and Magog , to gather them together to battle : the number of whom is as the sand of the sea .
kha: bad un mih shabar ban shukor ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba la pynsakma kylleng ka pyrthei , kata ka Gog bad ka Magog . U Soitan un wallam lang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïaleh thma , kiba bun kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan leit shabar ban shukor ia ki jaitbynriew kiba don ha ki saw bynta jong ka khyndew , u Gog bad u Magog , ban lum lang ia ki ban ialeh thma: ka jingbun jong ki ka long kum ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw .

en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side the river : and he had peace on all sides round about him .
kha: U Solomon u la synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kaba sha sepngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , naduh Tiphsah kaba ha Ïuphratis haduh shaphang sepngi ka nongbah Gasa . Baroh ki syiem kiba sha sepngi jong ka Ïuphratis ki la hap hapoh jong u , bad u la don ha ka jingïasuk bad ki ri ba-marjan baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la don ka jingsynshar halor ka thain baroh kawei ha kane ka liang ka wah, naduh Tiphsah haduh Gaza, halor ki syiem baroh ha kane ka liang ka wah: bad u la don ka jingsuk ha baroh sawdong jong u .

en: For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .
kha: Lada me tang shu mih bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid Kidron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shah kynnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan long ha ka sngi ba me mih noh bad iaid lyngba ia ka wah Kidron, men sa tip thikna ba men sa iap: ka snam jong me kan long ha la ka jong ka khlieh .

en: Without charge , a friendly neighbor qualified to teach the Bible can come to your home or another convenient location and spend a little time each week discussing the Bible with you .
kha: Ïwei na ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah in wan sha ïing jong phi lane ha kano kano ka jaka kaba phi kwah , bad man la ka taiew kin wan ban phylliew jingmut bad phi na ka Baibl .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem da shim khia , u para marjan uba sngewbha uba tbit ban hikai ia ka Baibl u lah ban wan sha iing jong phi ne kawei pat ka jaka kaba suk bad pynlut por khyndiat man la ka taiew ban iakren ia ka Baibl bad phi .

en: Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ,  Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .   Phi dei ki nongshetkylla !  u Saul u kyang .  Pyntyllun uwei u maw heh shane sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la iathuh ha u Saul, ki da ong: Ha khmih ki briew ki leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai, ha kaba ki bam da ka snam . Bad u la ong: Phi la iaid lait: phi la pynkhih ia u maw uba khraw ha nga ha kane ka sngi .

en: And Joshua spake unto the priests , saying , Take up the ark of the covenant , and pass over before the people . And they took up the ark of the covenant , and went before the people .
kha: Nangta u ong ïa ki lyngdoh ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad leit bad ka ha shuwa ki paidbah . Ki la leh kumba u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la kren ha ki lyngdoh u da ong: To shim ia ka synduk ka jutang bad iaid sha khmat ki briew . Ki la shim ia ka synduk ka jutang bad ki la leit sha khmat ki briew .

en: And the Philistines fought , and Israel was smitten , and they fled every man into his tent : and there was a very great slaughter  ; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen .
kha: Ki Philistia ki la ïaleh tyngeh bad ki la jop ïa ki Israel , kiba phet ïap sha la ki ïing . Ka la don ka jingshah pynïap kaba khraw : Laiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Israel ki shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la ialeh , bad ki Israel ki la shah pynjot , bad ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha ka ïingjahthait jong u: bad ka la don ka jingpyniap kaba khraw bha; namar ka la hap na ki Israel laiphew hajar ngut ki nonglehkai kjat .

en: Cry yet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad  ; and the  Lord  shall yet comfort Zion , and shall yet choose Jerusalem .
kha: U angel u la bthah ruh ïa nga ban pynbna :  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ki nongbah jong u kin manbha biang bad ba sa shisien pat un ïarap ïa ka Jerusalem bad kam ïa ka nongbah kum ka jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: To iam hynrei da kaba ong , Kumta u Trai jong ki paid ; Ki nongbah jong nga lyngba ka jingroi jingpar kin sa saphriang shabar ri ; bad U Trai un sa pyntngen ia ka Seion , bad un sa jied ia ka Jerusalem .

en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush : and he looked , and , behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .
kha: Hangta u angel jong U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u ha ka dur ka thylliej ding napdeng kawei ka  lawlynnong . U Moses u ïohi ba kata ka  lawlynnong ka la kem ding , hynrei kam shym ing satia .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel U Trai u la paw ha u ha ka ding kaba mih na pdeng ka khlaw: bad u la peit, bad, ha khmih, u khlaw u la thang da ka ding, bad u khlaw um shym la shah thang .

en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers : now thy shepherds which were with us , we hurt them not , neither was there ought missing unto them , all the while they were in Carmel .
kha: U la ïohsngew ba phi dang ot shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad u kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ki nongap langbrot jong phi ki don bad ngi bad ngim shym pynmynsaw ïa ki . Ym shym la tuh ïa kano kano kaba dei ka jong ki ha ki por baroh haba ki don ha Karmel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta nga la iohsngew ba me don ki nongri khun: mynta ki nongap langbrot jong me kiba don ryngkat bad ngi, ngim shym la pynmong ia ki, lymne ym shym la don ei ei ha ki, katba ki dang don ha Karmel .

en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations , or of the bread , remain unto the morning , then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire : it shall not be eaten , because it is holy .
kha: Lada don kaba tam na ka doh ne na u kpu kiba ym shym la lah bam lut haduh mynstep , dei ban thang noh ïa ki . Ym dei ban bam ïa ka , naba ka long kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka doh jong ki jingpynkyntang ne jong u kpu ka sah haduh mynstep , te men thang ia kaba sah da ka ding: ym dei ban bam ia ka namar ka long kaba khuid .

en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment : thou shalt not respect the person of the poor , nor honour the person of the mighty : but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour .
kha: Lehhok bad bishar hok haba phi shim rai ha ka mokotduma ; wat shah shiliang ïa uba duk lane ban sheptieng ïa uba riewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban leh ia ka jingbymhok ha ka jingbishar: wat burom ia ka briew jong kiba duk, lymne to burom ia ka briew jong kiba khlain: hynrei ha ka hok men bishar ia u paramarjan jong me .

en: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually  ; they shall not be shut day nor night  ; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles , and that their kings may be brought .
kha: Bad sngi bad miet ki khyrdop jong pha kin plie , kumta ba ki syiem jong ki jaitbynriew kin wanrah sha pha ïa ka spah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki khyrdop jong me kin plie beit; kin ym khang sngi ne miet; ba ki briew kin wanrah ha me ia ki bor jong ki Jutang bad ba ki syiem jong ki kin wanrah .

en: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u Balaam bad u ong ,  Lada kine ki briew ki la wan khot ïa me ban leit bad ki , to khreh ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa kata kaba nga ong ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la wan sha u Balaam ha ka por miet bad u la ong ha u, "Lada ki briew ki wan ban khot ia me, to khie bad leit bad ki ; hynrei ka ktien kaba ngan ong ha me, kata to leh .

en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :
kha: Lada phi kham pyn-i burom ïa u briew uba riam bha bad phi ong ïa u ,  To shong ha kane ka jaka shong kaba bha tam ,  hynrei phi ong ïa u briew uba duk ,  To ïeng hangtai , lane to shong hangne ha madan hajan ki kjat jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi don burom ia uta uba phong ia ka jain gay, bad phi ong ha u, To shong hangne ha ka jaka kaba bha ; bad to ong ha kiba duk: To ieng hangta, ne shong hangne hapoh ka jaka shong kjat jong nga:

en: And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .
kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat bad ïa ka jingsawa ka turoi , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa uta u lum uba mih tdem , ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïeng noh sha jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la iohi ia ki jingsawa, bad ki jingshai, bad ka jingsawa jong ka turoi, bad u lum ba u dih duma: bad haba ki briew ki la iohi ia ka, ki la leit noh bad ki la ieng jngai .

en: And there went out after him Joab s men , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and all the mighty men : and they went out of Jerusalem , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
kha: Kumta ki rangbah jong u Joab , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad kiwei pat ki shipai ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad u Abishai ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ka met jong u, bad ki nong Keros bad ki Pelot bad ki riewshlur baroh: bad ki la mih noh na Jerusalem ban beh ia u Sheba u khun jong u Bichri .

en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .
kha: Ka um ïa kaba ngan ai ha u kan long ha u ka umpohliew ka ban pynïoh ïa u da ka um kaba ai jingim bad ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba dih ia ka um kaba ngan ai ha u un ym sliang satia hynrei ka um kaba ngan ai ha u kan long ha u ka pung um kaba tuid sha ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ,  Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phi ïa u masi dab . Duwai ha u blei jong phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha ki nongiathuhlypa jong u Baal, To jied ia phi uwei u masi na ka bynta lade, bad to phong ia ka ha ka por ba nyngkong eh namar phi bun ; bad khot ia ka kyrteng jong ki blei jong phi, hynrei wat buh ding hapoh .

en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :24 ) Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :24 ) Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang . —Proberb 27 :23 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Corinth 2 :24 ) Kumba u nongaplangbrot u sumar bha ia uwei pa uwei na ki langbrot jong u, ki rangbah ki pyrshang ban ithuh ia uwei pa uwei u dkhot jong ka balang marwei marwei .  Proverb 27 :23 .

en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin :
kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh basniew jong u Ahab u kpa jong u , ka Jesebel ka kmie jong u , bad jong u syiem Jeroboam , kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai bad u la iaid ha ka lynti u kpa jong u bad ha ka lynti ka kmie jong u bad ha ka lynti u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat uba la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop:

en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : because they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki mynba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Nineve kin kiew ha ka jingbishar bad kane ka pateng: namar ki la kylla bamut ha ka jingialap jong u Jonah; bad, ha khmih, uba kham khraw ban ia u Jonah u don hangne .

en: And he shall break down the house , the stones of it , and the timber thereof , and all the mortar of the house  ; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place .
kha: Dei ban lied noh ïa ka , bad ïa ki maw , ki dieng , bad ka sorki jong ka baroh dei ban kit shabar shnong bad bret ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynpra ia ka iing, ki maw jong ka bad ki dieng jong ka bad ki maw baroh jong ka iing; bad un rah ia ki na ka shnong sha ka jaka kaba khlem khuid .

en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , hynñiew ngut ki kynthei kin bat ïa uwei u briew bad ong ,  Ngi lah ban bsa bad pynkup jaiñ ïa lade , hynrei sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ong ba phi long u tnga jong ngi , ba kumta ngim donkam ban shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong ka jinglong bym pat shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi hynriew ngut ki kynthei kin bat ia uwei u briew, ki da ong: Ngin bam ia la ka jong ka kpu bad ngin phong ia la ka jong ka jain: tangba to ai ba ngin shah khot da ka kyrteng jong me, ban weng noh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ngi .

en: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master , that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets , and the blood of all the servants of the  Lord  , at the hand of Jezebel .
kha: Me dei ban pynïap ïa u syiem uba long u kynrad jong me , uto keiñ u khun jong u Ahab khnang ba ngan ïoh pynshitom ïa ka Jesebel namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga bad ïa kiwei pat ki shakri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shoh ia ka iing u Ahab jong me, ba ngan pynim ia ka snam jong ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa bad ka snam jong ki shakri U Trai baroh, ha ka kti u Jesbel .

en: In the morning sow thy seed , and in the evening withhold not thine hand : for thou knowest not whether shall prosper , either this or that , or whether they both shall be alike good .
kha: Thung ïa ki jingthung jong phi mynstep bad janmiet ruh . Da lei lei phin ym tip la baroh kin san bha lane la kawei ka rukom thung kan kham bha ban ïa kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep to bet ia u symbai jong me, bad ha ka por janmiet wat nym bat ia ka kti jong me: namar ngam tip la kin roi ne em, la kane ne kata, ne la baroh arngut kin long kiba bha kumjuh .

en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .
kha: Ngan wanrah ruh khyndiat ka jingbam ; kan ai bor ïa phi katba phi nang bteng ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong phi . Phi la pyndonburom ïa nga haba phi wan rung ha ïing jong nga , kumta shah ngan shakri ïa phi .  Ki jubab ,  Khublei shibun ; ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan shim ia u kpu uba jem, bad phin pyntngen ia ki dohnud jong phi hadien ba phin iaid shakhmat: namar namarkata phi wan sha u shakri jong phi . Ki la ong , To leh kumba me la ong .

en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah  ; even Issachar , and also Barak : he was sent on foot into the valley . For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart .
kha: Ki nongïalam ka jait Issakhar ki wan bad ka Deborah ; Ho-oid , ki Issakhar ki wan bad u Barak ruh , Bad ki la bud ïa u sha ka them . Hynrei ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah Issakhar ki la don bad ka Deborah ; wat u Issakhar ruh: la phah ia u da ka kjat shapoh them . Na ka bynta ki jingphiah jong u Reuben ki don ki jingpyrkhat kiba khraw jong ka dohnud .

en: I saw by night , and behold a man riding upon a red horse , and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom  ; and behind him were there red horses , speckled , and white .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa uwei u angel jong U  Trai  uba shong halor u kulai basaw . U la sangeh hapdeng katto katne tylli ki dieng Martl ha ka them , bad hadien jong u la don sa kiwei pat ki kulai — kiba saw , kiba thohbroin , bad kiba lieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ha ka por miet , bad ha khmih uwei u briew uba shong halor u kulai uba saw , bad u la ieng hapdeng ki dieng kiba saw kiba don ha trai ; bad hadien jong u ki don ki kulai kiba saw kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba lieh .

en: And Ehud came unto him  ; and he was sitting in a summer parlour , which he had for himself alone . And Ehud said , I have a message from God unto thee . And he arose out of his seat .
kha: Nangta , katba u syiem u dang shong hangta marwei ha la ka kamra shong pyngngad halor tnum ïing , u Ehud u la leit sha u , bad u ong ,  Nga don ka khubor na U Blei sha phi .  U syiem u la ïeng joit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ehud u la wan sha u ; bad u la shong ha ka jaka shong jaka sah kaba u don tang ma u hi . Bad u Ehud u la ong , Nga don ka khubor na U Blei ha me . Bad u la mih na ka jaka shong jong u .

en: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another , What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon ? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
kha: Hangta ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki jait Israel ki kylli para ma ki ,  Mano ban ïalam ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon ? Uno uno uba leh un long u nongïalam jong uwei pa uwei ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew bad ki rangbah Gilead ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat: Uei uta u briew uba sdang ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun Ammon ? un long u khlieh halor ki nongshong shnong jong ka Gilead baroh .

en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof :
kha: Hynriew tylli ki tnat ki mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na ki liang jong ka ; lai tylli ki tnat jong ka sharak na kawei ka liang jong ka , bad lai tylli ki tnat jong ka sharak na kawei pat ka liang jong ka:

en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .
kha: Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi ki ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka dei kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan pynphai biang ia me ia ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong me, bad ngan pynkoit ia me na ki jingmynsaw jong me, ong U Trai ; namar ki la khot ia me u Nongkhrong , da kaba ong , Une u dei u Seion , ia uba ym don mano mano ruh ba wad ia u .

en: And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .
kha: U la jubab ,  Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba nga don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la ïohi ïa u Saul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U samla uba la iathuh ha u u la ong, Kumba nga la jia ryngkhat ha u lum Gilboa, ha khmih u Saul u la shong ha ka khnam jong u ; bad, ha khmih, ki kali bad ki kulai ki la bud jur ia u .

en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
kha: Hynrei kaei ba nga ïohi ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ki phai dien ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki shipai jong ki , ki shah beh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh stet kat lah kat ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga la iohi ia ki ba ki la sngewsih bad ki la phaidien noh ? bad ki riewshlur jong ki ki la shah shoh noh, bad ki la phet noh noh: namar ka jingtieng ka la iaid sawdong , ong U Trai .

en: And I will give peace in the land , and ye shall lie down , and none shall make you afraid : and I will rid evil beasts out of the land , neither shall the sword go through your land .
kha: Ngan ai ïa ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong phi , bad phin thiah phin dem khlem tieng ïano ïano . Ngan ym shah ban don ki mradkhlaw kiba runar ha kata ka ri , bad ka thma kan ym don shuh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai jingsuk ha ka ri, bad phin thiah noh, bad ym don ba pyntieng ia phi: bad ngan beh noh ia ki mrad kiba sniew na ka ri , lymne ka waitlam kan iaid lyngba ka ri jong phi .

en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa kaei kaba ka la wallam ïa u bad u ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ïing bad wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ioh na ka kti jong ka ia kaba ka la wanrah ia u, bad u la ong ha ka, To leit sha ka iing jong me; peit, nga la sngap ia ka sur jong me, bad nga la pdiang ia ka khmat jong me .

en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee , and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt : so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them , nor remember Egypt any more .
kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ïa ki jingijli kiba pha la leh naduh ba pha dang don ha Ijipt . Phan ym khmih shuh ïa ki bleithaw ne pyrkhat shuh shaphang ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynlong ia ka jinglehrain jong me ban sangeh noh na me, bad ka jingleh be-ijot jong me kaba la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt: khnang ba men ym rah shuh ia ki khmat jong me sha ki , lymne wat kynmaw shuh ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: And had a wall great and high , and had twelve gates , and at the gates twelve angels , and names written thereon , which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel :
kha: Ka la don ka kynroh kaba khraw , kaba jrong bad khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop lem bad ki khat-ar ngut ki angel kiba khmih ïa ki khyrdop . Ha ki khyrdop la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar jait ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ka kynroh kaba heh bad kaba jrong, bad ka don shiphew tylli ki khyrdop, bad ha ki khyrdop la thoh ia ki kyrteng ha ki shiphew tylli ki jait Israel:

en: And the burden of the  Lord  shall ye mention no more : for every man s word shall be his burden  ; for ye have perverted the words of the living God , of the  Lord  of hosts our God .
kha: Kumta kim dei shuh ban pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’ namar lada uno uno u leh kumta , ngan pynlong ïa ka khubor jong nga ka jingkit kaba khia shisha ïa u . Ki briew ki la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki ktien U Blei jong ki , U Blei uba im , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkit jong U Trai phin ym kdew shuh: namar uwei pa uwei u ktien un long ka jingkit jong u ; namar phi la pynkylla ia ki ktien U Blei uba im, jong U Trai jong ki paid jong ngi .

en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .
kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad ka bam duh ïa ka jingkñia ainguh thang bad ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ baroh ha ka duwan . Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadem ngon haduh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka ding na khmat U Trai, bad ka la bam ia ka jingknia thang bad ka shini: kaba haba ki briew baroh ki la iohi ki la pyrta bad ki la hap ha ki khmat jong ki .

en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?
kha: Haduh katno kan jin da la kham bha lada ki briew jong ngi ha kane ka sngi ki la bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki la shim haba ki jop ïa ki nongshun . Shu pyrkhat haduh katno ngut shuh shuh ki Philistia kin jin da la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka long kaba kham bun lada lehse ki briew ki la bam laitluid ha ka sngi jong ki nongshun jong ki kiba ki la shem ? namar ym shym la don mynta ka jingpyniap kaba kham khraw hapdeng ki Philistia ?

en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go , and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense : but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble .
kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kin leit sha ki blei ha kiba ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad kin kyang jam sha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Hynrei kito ki blei kin ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba kane ka jingpynjot ka wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shnong Judah bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem kin leit sha ki blei kiba ki ai jingiwbih: hynrei kin ym pynim satia ia ki ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong ki .

en: I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .
kha: Naba wat ba phi la tip ïa kane baroh , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phi ba kumno U Trai u la pyllait im shisien ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei hadien , u la pynjot ïa kito ki bym shym la ngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia phi ha ka jingkynmaw, wat la phi la tip ia kane, kumno ba U Trai, haba u la pynim ia ki briew na ka ri Ijipt, hadien kata u la pynjot ia ki ki bym ngeit .

en: That ye receive her in the Lord , as becometh saints , and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you : for she hath been a succourer of many , and of myself also .
kha: To pdiang ïa ka ha ka kyrteng U Trai , kumba ki briew jong U Blei ki dei ban leh , bad to ai ha ka ïa kano kano ka jingïarap kaba ka lah ban donkam na phi ; namar ma ka hi , da lade ka long ka paralok babha ïa kiba bun ki briew bad ïa nga ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phi pdiang ia ka ha U Trai, kumba ka long ki riewkhuid, bad ba phi iarap ia ka ha kano kano ka kam kaba ka donkam ia phi: namar ka la long ka nongshong shnong jong kiba bun, bad jong nga ruh .

en: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .
kha: Baroh ki jait sim ki thaw skum ha ki tnat jong u ; ki mradkhlaw ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jong u ; ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sim bneng baroh ki la shna ia ki bniat jong u ha ki tnat jong u, bad hapoh ki tnat jong u ki mrad baroh ki la pynmih ia ki khun jong ki, bad hapoh ka jingdum jong u ki la shong ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw baroh .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Make thee a fiery serpent , and set it upon a pole : and it shall come to pass , that every one that is bitten , when he looketh upon it , shall live .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ïa u Moses ban shna u bseiñ rnong bad wah ïa u ha u dieng , kumta ba uno uno uba shah puh bseiñ u lah ban peit sha u bad un koit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To pynlong ia me u bsein uba thang ding, bad to buh ia u halor u dieng: bad kan sa jia ba uwei pa uwei uba shah ktah, haba u peit ia u, un im .

en: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot , the mistress of witchcrafts , that selleth nations through her whoredoms , and families through her witchcrafts .
kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh , ka nuti la nang pynshitom . Kaba khring bad kaba dap da ki jingpynshohbieit kiba ma , ka la pynshohbieit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ka la ringmraw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbun ki nongkhaïi met jong ka kynthei kaba la sngewtynnad bha, ka jingbym don ki nongleh jadu, kata ka long kaba don ki jaitbynriew lyngba ki nongkhaïi jong ka, bad ki longïing lyngba ki nongleh jadu jong ka .

en: And , behold , there came an old man from his work out of the field at even , which was also of mount Ephraim  ; and he sojourned in Gibeah : but the men of the place were Benjamites .
kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , uwei u tymmen uba dang wan phai na lyngkha bad ïaid nangta ynda la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lum Ephraim , hynrei ha kata ka por u shong u sah ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei kiba shong hangta ki dei na ka jait Benjamin . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, la wan uwei u rangbah na ka kam jong u ha ka por janmiet, kaba long ruh jong u lum Ephraim ; bad u la sah ha Gibeah: hynrei ki briew jong kata ka jaka ki long ki Benjamin .

en: Then saith Jesus unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ha kane hi ka miet phi baroh phin ïaphet noh bad iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ki langbrot jong ka kynhun yn pynsakma .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jisu u ong ha ki , Baroh phin sngewsih namar jong nga mynta ka miet: namar la thoh: namar la thoh: Ngan shoh ia u nongaplangbrot bad ki langbrot jong ka kynhun kin sa jah noh shabar ri .

en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .
kha: Em , ngam shym leh bymdei ei ei ïa me . Ma me uba leh bymdei ïa nga da kaba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa nga . U  Trai  u long u Nongbishar . Un rai mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata ngam shym la leh pop pyrshah ia me , hynrei me leh bakla ia nga ban ialeh pyrshah ia nga: U Trai Nongbishar un bishar ha kane ka sngi hapdeng ki khun Israel bad ki khun Ammon .

en: Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
kha: Kaei ba ki la ïohi ha ka ïing syiem ?   Ki la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym don kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki ha ki ïing jingkynshew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong: Ki la iohi aiu ha ka iing jong me ? U Hesekaiah u la jubab: Baroh kaba don ha iing jong nga kim shym la iohi: ym don ei ei hapdeng ki spah jong nga ba ngam shym la pyni ia ki .

en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .
kha: U Blei u ong ha u Jakob ,  Khie leit sha Bethel bad shongsah hangta . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa nga , U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me mynba me dang phet ïap na u Iso u hynmen jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Jakob, To khie, to leit sha Bethesel, bad to shong hangta : bad to thaw hangta ia ka jingknia ha U Blei, kaba la paw ha me haba me la leit noh na ka khmat u Iso u hynmen jong me .

en: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men  ; all these drew the sword .
kha: Bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki Benjamin ki wan mih na Gibeah , bad ha kane ka sien ki pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai batbit ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benjamin u la leit sha khmat jong ki na Gibeah ha ka sngi kaba ar, bad u la pynjot biang ia ki khynnah Israel .

en: But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .
kha: Ko Israel , U Blei uba la thaw ïa phi u ong ,  Wat sheptieng — ngan pyllait im ïa phi , nga la khot ïa phi da ka kyrteng — phi long u jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta kumta u Trai uba la thaw ia me, ko Jakob, bad uta uba la thaw ia me, ko Israel, Wat tieng: namar nga la siewspah ia me, nga la khot ia me da ka kyrteng jong me; me long jong nga .

en: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .
kha: Ka jingkhihwin ka la par ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei . Ki paidbhur ki la kem ïa u Gaïos bad ïa u Aristarkhos , ki ar ngut ki nong Makedonia kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad u Paul , bad ki la paring mareh bad ki sha ka rynsan leh tamasa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong baroh kawei ka la dap da ka jingkulmar: bad haba ki la kem ia u Gayo bad u Aristarkhos , ki briew jong ka Makedonia , ki paralok jong u Paul ha ka jingleit jingwan , ki la mareh da kawei ka jingmut sha ka jaka peitkai .

en: And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?
kha: Ka Templ ka long mynta kaba ïoh burom shibun , hynrei kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un lyngngoh bad un kylli , ‘ Balei ba U  Trai  u la leh kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka Templ ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka iing kaba jrong kan long ka jinglyngngoh ia uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba jong ka ; haduh ba un ong: Balei U Trai u la leh kumta ia kane ka ri bad ia kane ka iing ?

en: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok , which approach unto me , to minister unto me , saith the Lord  God  , a young bullock for a sin offering .
kha: Kito ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jait Lebi kiba hiarpateng na u Sadok ki long tang ma ki , ki ban wan ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ban shakri ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga hukum ïa kane . Men ai ïa ki u masi lyngraw ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh ia ki Lebi kiba long na u symbai u Sadok, kiba wan shajan jong nga, ban shakri ha nga , ong U Trai Blei , u khun masi uba dang rit na ka bynta ka jingknia pop .

en: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :
kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew , namar kam shym la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dei ban ïap , naba kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kum ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh bad pynïap ïa uwei pat u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka dam me dei ban leh ei ei; ym don pop ei ei ha ka dam: namar kumba u briew u ieng pyrshah ia u paramarjan jong u bad u pyniap ia u, wat la katta ruh:

en: Then the king commanded to call the magicians , and the astrologers , and the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans , for to shew the king his dreams . So they came and stood before the king .
kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongkheiñ ksuid bad ki nongleh byrtong ban ïawan bad batai ïa ka jingphohsniew ha u . Haba ki la ïawan bad ïeng ha khmat u syiem ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la hukum ban khot ia ki nongleh jadu, bad ki nongleh jadu, bad ki nongleh jadu, bad ki nongleh jadu, namar ban pyni ia ki jingphohsniew jong u . Kumta ki la wan bad ki la ieng ha khmat u syiem .

en: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations  ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
kha: Haba u sangeh , ka pyrthei ka khih ; u tang shu peit , ki jaitbynriew ki kyiuh . Ki lumbah ba bymjukut ki khih ; ki lumrit baneh junom ki ngam shapoh , ki lumrit ha kiba u ju ïaid ha ki por mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng , bad u la thew ia ka khyndew: u la iohi , bad u la pynkhih ia ki jaitbynriew bad ki lum bymjukut ki la bthei , ki lum bymjukut ki la dem khrup: ki lynti jong u ki long kiba bymjukut .

en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters , whom thou hast borne unto me , and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured . Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter ,
kha: Nangta pha la shim ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei kiba pha la kha ïa nga bad pha la ainguh ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ha ki bleithaw . Hato kam shym long kaba sniew eh ban ym ïaineh ha nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me la shim ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me kiba me la kha ha nga bad kine me la knia ha ki ban shah bam . Hato kane ka long kaba rit na ki jingkhaii met jong me .

en: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong phi . Phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi haba nga pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shim ia phi sha nga na ka bynta u briew, bad ngan long ha phi u Blei: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba pynmih ia phi na shapoh ki jingkit jong ki nong Ijipt .

en: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly , and steal away from me  ; and didst not tell me , that I might have sent thee away with mirth , and with songs , with tabret , and with harp ?
kha: Balei me shukor ïa nga bad mih jar jar khlem da ïathuh ïa nga ? Lada me la ïathuh ïa nga , ngan jin da la phah ïa me da ka jingkmen bad da ki jingkyn-ud sur ha ki kanjari bad ki duitara .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata me la phet noh da kaba rieh bad me khlem iathuh ia nga, ba nga la phah noh ia me da ka jingsngewbha bad da ki jingrwai, da ka tabet bad da ka harp ?

en: He saith to him again the second time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .
kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga ?   Ho-oid , ko Trai ,  u la jubab ,  me tip ba nga ieit ïa me .  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U ong biang ia u ha ka sien kaba ar, ko Simon, ko khun u Jonah, me ieit ia nga ? U ong ha u, Hooid, ko Trai me tip ba nga ieit ia me . U ong ia u: To ai bam ia ki langbrot jong nga .

en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round , and cut off our name from the earth : and what wilt thou do unto thy great name ?
kha: Ki Kanaan bad baroh kiba hapoh ka ri kin sa ïohsngew ïa kane . Kin sa kerkut ïa ngi , bad kin sa pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ïa ngi ! Bad nangta aïu men leh ban ïada ïa la ka burom ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki nongshong shnong bad ki nongshong shnong baroh kin iohsngew ia ka , bad kin ker sawdong ia ngi sawdong bad kin ot noh ia ka kyrteng jong ngi na ka khyndew : bad kaei kaba me leh ia ka kyrteng kaba khraw jong me ?

en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood , and my sword shall devour flesh  ; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives , from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy .
kha: Ki khnam jong nga kin jreiñ da ka snam jong ki , bad ka waitlam jong nga kan pynïap lut ïa kiba pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa uno uno uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ngan ym map ; wat ki koidi bad kito kiba mynsaw ruh kin ïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki khnam jong nga kiba la dih da ka snam, bad ka waitlam jong nga kan bam ia ka doh bad kata da ka snam jong kiba la shah pyniap bad jong ki nongshah set , naduh ba sdang ban pynshitom bein ia u nongshun .

en: And the men of Ephraim said unto him , Why hast thou served us thus , that thou calledst us not , when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites ? And they did chide with him sharply .
kha: Nangta ki paid Ephraim ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Balei phim shym khot ïa ngi haba phi la leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian ? Balei phi leh kumne ïa ngi ?  Ki la khñium tyngeh shaphang kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Ephraim ki la ong ha u, Balei me la shakri ia ngi kumta, ba me khlem khot ia ngi haba me leit ialeh bad ki nong Midian ? Ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u da kaba jem .

en: Then he sent out a second on horseback , which came to them , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu answered , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me .
kha: Nangta la phah sa uwei u nonglamktien uba kylli ha u Jehu ïa kajuh ka jingkylli . U Jehu u la jubab biang ,  Kata kam dei ka kam jong me ! Bud nadien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la phah ia kawei ka sekhon ha ka jaka kaba shadien kaba la wan sha ki, bad u la ong, Kumta u ong u syiem, Hato ka long ka jingsuk ? U Jehu u la jubab , Kaei kaba phi don bad ka jingsuk ? phai noh shadien jong nga .

en: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing : and my lord is wise , according to the wisdom of an angel of God , to know all things that are in the earth .
kha: Hynrei u la leh ïa ka khnang ban pynbeit ïa kane ka kam . U Syiem Kynrad u long uba stad kum u angel jong U Blei bad u tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban wad ia kane ka rukom kren u shakri jong me u Joab u la leh ia kane: bad u kynrad jong nga u long uba stad kat kum ka jingstad jong u angel U Blei , ban tip ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka khyndew .

en: And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .
kha: Haba U Jisu la hiar na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babun , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la pyndap da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Kumta u la sdang ban hikai bun kiei kiei ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu haba u la mih u la iohi ia ki briew kiba bun bad u la sngewsih ia ki namar ki long kum ki langbrot ki bym don nongaplangbrot: bad u la sdang ban hikai ia ki shibun kiei kiei .

en: Ask ye now , and see whether a man doth travail with child ? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins , as a woman in travail , and all faces are turned into paleness ?
kha: Mynta to sangeh bad pyrkhat ! Hato u briew u lah ban kha khun ? Te balei keiñ ba nga ïohi ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ba u buh ïa la ka kti ha la ka kpoh kum ka kynthei ha ka jingsuh kha ? Balei uwei pa uwei baroh u blad rong ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli mynta , bad peit la u briew u trei bad u khun ? namar kata nga iohi ia uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ki kti jong u ha ki tyrpeng jong u , kum ka kynthei ha ka jingkha khun , bad baroh ki khmat ki kylla rong saw ?

en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward  ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .
kha: Ki long kiba tbit baroh ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew . Ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongbishar ki bamsap . U briew uba lah u ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba u kwah , bad kumta ki ïasylla lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kin leh ia kaba sniew da baroh ar ki kti da kaba sngewrit, u syiem u pan ia ka bainong ; bad u briew uba khraw , u pynpaw ia ka jingkwah kaba sniew jong u: kumta ki pynkhih ia ka .

en: And shall put my spirit in you , and ye shall live , and I shall place you in your own land : then shall ye know that I the  Lord  have spoken it , and performed it , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pyrsad da ka mynsiem jong nga ha ki , bad kin im biang , bad ngan sa shah ïa ki ban im ha ka ri jong ki hi . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha phi, bad phin im, bad ngan buh ia phi ha la ka jong ka ri: nangta phin sa tip ba nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata, bad nga la leh ia kata, ong U Trai .

en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the  Lord  : men shall call you the Ministers of our God : ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves .
kha: bad ïa phi yn khot ki lyngdoh U  Trai  , ki shakri jong U Blei jong ngi . Phin sa lehkmen ïa ka spah ki jaitbynriew , bad phin sa sngewsarong ba ka dei ki jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei yn jer kyrteng ia phi ki Lyngdoh U Trai: ki briew kin khot ia phi ki Myntri jong U Blei jong ngi: phin bam ia ka spah jong ki Jutang , bad ha ka burom jong ki phin sngew sarong ia lade .

en: And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .
kha: Nga la hukum ban don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem shisha ba naduh ki por mynhyndai ka Jerusalem ka la ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bor syiem bad ba ka dap da ki nongïaleh pyrshah bad ki nongthaw jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hukum , bad la wad bniah ia kane ka shnong hyndai ka la leh pyrshah ia ki syiem , bad kata ka jingleh pyrshah bad ka jingleh pyrshah ka la long ha ka .

en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee ? let them arise , if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble : for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods , O Judah .
kha: Hangno ki blei kiba phi la thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ? Haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , ai ba ma ki kin pynim ïa phi — lada ki lah ! Ko Judah pha la don shibun ki blei kumba pha don ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shano ki blei jong me kiba me la pynlong ia me ? to ai ba kin mih lada ki lah ban pynim ia me ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong me: namar kat kum ka jingbun ki nongbah jong me ki long ki blei jong me, ko Judah .

en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
kha: U Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor halor jong ngi bad ki lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam noh ïa ngi sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Baruk u khun u Neriah u shong ha ka kti jong ki Khaldian , ba kin pyniap ia ngi bad rah noh ia ngi sha Babilon .

en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay , they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men : but they shall not cleave one to another , even as iron is not mixed with clay .
kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ïa ka nar la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha . Kane ka mut ba ki nongsynshar jong kata ka hima kin pyrshang ban pynïatylli ïa ki longïing jong ki da ka jingïashongkha khleh , hynrei kin ym lah , kumba ka nar kam lah ban ïakhleh bad ka dewbyrtha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba me dang iohi ia ka nar kaba la khleh lang bad ka dewbilat kaba jyrngam, kin ia khleh lang bad u symbai briew: hynrei kin ym ia tyngkhuh iwei ia iwei pat, kumba ka nar kam ia khleh lang bad ka dewbilat .

en: And all the men of might , even seven thousand , and craftsmen and smiths a thousand , all that were strong and apt for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynryngkang par ïa baroh ki rangbah badonkam sha Babilonia , baroh lang hynñiew hajar ngut , bad shihajar ngut ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , baroh na ki , ki long ki rangbah bakhlaiñ kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew baroh jong ka ri, ki lah ban long wat hynriew hajar, bad ki nongtrei bad ki nongshna tiar hajar, baroh kiba khlain bad kiba tbit ban ialeh thma, wat ia ki ruh u syiem Babilon u la wanrah ia ki sha Babilon .

en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem , and into the temple : and when he had looked round about upon all things , and now the eventide was come , he went out unto Bethany with the twelve .
kha: U Jisu u la rung sha Jerusalem , u la leit sha ka Templ , bad u la khmih sawdong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Hynrei namar ba ka la dier eh ha kata ka sngi , u la mih bad leit sha Bethania ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la rung sha Jerusalem bad shapoh ka tempi: bad haba u la peit kylleng kylleng ia kiei kiei baroh, bad mynta ka la jia , u la leit sha Bethania ryngkat bad ki shiphew ngut .

en: And Achish said , Whither have ye made a road to day ? And David said , Against the south of Judah , and against the south of the Jerahmeelites , and against the south of the Kenites .
kha: Nangta u wan phai pat sha u Akhish , uba ju kylli ïa u ,  Phi la leit lute shano ha kane ka kynti ?  bad u Dabid ruh u ju ïathuh ïa u ba u la leit sha ka ri Judah kaba shathie , lane sha ka ri ki Jerahmeel , lane sha ka ri bashong ki Ken .
translated_en_to_kha: U Akhis u la ong: Phi la leh ia ka lynti sha ka sngi ? U Dabid u la ong: Shaphang shathie jong ka Judah bad shaphang shathie jong ki Jareamele bad shaphang shathie jong ki Kenit .

en: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them , and make merry , and shall send gifts one to another  ; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth .
