kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin ïakmen namar ka jingïap jong kine ki ar ngut . Kin ïalehkmen bad kin ïa-ai jingai sngewbha markylliang , namar ba kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wallam shibun ki jingshitom halor u bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita kiba shong ha ka khyndew kin sngewbha ia ki, bad kin ia sngewbha iwei ia iwei pat; namar kine ki arngut ki nongiathuhlypa ki la pynshitom ia kito kiba shong ha ka khyndew .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch , and a King shall reign and prosper , and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan wan haba ngan jied kum u syiem ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid uba hok . Uta syiem u ban synshar da ka jingstad , bad u ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha kylleng ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba ngan pynmih ha u Dabid ia u Branch uba hok, bad u Syiem un synshar bad un roi, bad un pyntreikam ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok ha ka khyndew .

en: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue  ; for I am tormented in this flame .
kha: Kumta u la pyrta , ‘ Ko Kpa Abraham ! To sngewsynei ïa nga , bad phah ïa u Lasaros ban wieh ïa ka shynriah ti jong u ha ka um khyndiat bad pyntngen ïa u thylliej jong nga , namar nga don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw ha kane ka ding !’
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyrta bad u la ong, Ko Kpa Abraham, to isynei ia nga, bad phah ia u Lasaros, ba un pynngam ia ka tduh jong ka kti jong u ha ka um, bad un pynkhriat ia ka shyntur jong nga; namar nga la shah pynshitom ha kane ka ding .

en: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven : for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?
kha: Phi dei ban peit bha ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei jong ka Bneng u donkam na ka bynta ka Templ jong u , bad ban pynthikna un ym bitar ïa nga lane ïa kito ki ban synshar hadien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba la hukum da U Blei jong ka bneng , to ai ba kan long kaba trei shitom na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong ka bneng: namar balei ba kan don ka jingbitar pyrshah ia ka hima u syiem bad ki khun jong u ?

en: For the king of the north shall return , and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former , and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches .
kha: U syiem ka Syria un leit phai pat bad lum ka kynhun shipai kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa . Haba ka por babiang ka poi , un wan phai bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad kaba la kieng atiar bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un wan phai, bad un buh ia ka kynhun kaba kham bun ban ia kaba nyngkong , bad kan sa wan shisha hadien katto katne snem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad kaba don shibun ki spah .

en: That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee , and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the  Lord .
kha: Ngi kwah ba phin kular ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kumba ngi ruh ngim shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi . Ngi la lehsbun ïa phi bad ngi la shah ba phin leit da kaba suk . Mynta ka paw shai ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me'n ym pynmynsaw ia ngi, kumba ngim shym la ktah ia me, bad kumba ngim shym la leh ei ei ia me hynrei tang ka jingbha, bad ngi la phah noh ia me ha ka jingsuk: me long mynta uba la kyrkhu ia U Trai .

en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .
kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki la pynïap bun ki nongshun ha ka thma bad ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki naduh ka wah Arnon na shaphang shatei haduh ka Jabbok , kata , haduh ki Ammon , namar ka khappud ki Ammon ka long kaba khlaiñ bha ka jingïada .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la shoh ia u da ka tduh jong ka waitlam, bad ki la bat ia ka ri jong u naduh u Arnon haduh u Jabok, wat haduh ki khun Ammon: namar u pud u sam jong ki khun Ammon u la khlain .

en: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
kha: Bad ma phi ruh , kiba la kylla long ki briew jong U Blei mynba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor kaba shisha , ka khubor babha kaba wallam ïa phi ka jingpynim . Phi la ngeit ha U Khrist , bad U Blei u la buh ïa ka jingshonshab ka jinglong trai ha phi da kaba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba phi ruh phi la shaniah, hadien ba phi la iohsngew ia ka ktien jong ka jingshisha, ka gospel jong ka jingpynim jong phi: ha uba ruh hadien ba phi la ngeit, la khang ia phi da uta u Mynsiem bakhuid jong ka jingkular .

en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .
kha: Haba ki shaniah ha phi , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynkdor ïa la ki met .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la bat ia me da ka kti jong me, me la bthei, bad me la pynkhih ia ka tyrpeng jong ki baroh: bad haba ki la shaniah ha me, me la sngap jar bad me la sngap jar ia ki tyrpeng jong ki baroh ban ieng .

en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the  Lord  build the ruined places , and plant that that was desolate : I the  Lord  have spoken it , and I will do it .
kha: Te ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan kiba la lait im kin ïoh tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot , bad nga la thung ïa kata kaba la long shrah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan sa leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki nongwei kiba la shah iehnoh sawdong jong phi kin tip ba nga U Trai nga tei ia ki jaka ba la jot , bad nga thung ia kata kaba la jot: Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata , bad ngan leh ia kata .

en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works  ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him ?
kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh te ba kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba ngi lah ban leh . Ym don kano kano ka lynti ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka ban jia ynda ngi ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga sngewthuh ba ym don kaei kaei kaba kham bha, ban ia kaba u briew u dei ban sngewbha ha la ki jong ki kam ; namar kata ka long ka bynta jong u: namar mano ban wanrah ia u ban iohi ia kaei kaban sa jia hadien jong u ?

en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .
kha: Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Kin ïeng joit ha ki thapniang kum ki pukni ; kin mareh bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïaid bad kin ym sngewthait .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kito kiba ap ia U Trai kin pynthymmai ia ka bor jong ki ; kin kiew da ki bniat ; kin mareh , bad kin ym sngewsih ; bad kin iaid , bad kin ym lyngngoh .

en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;
kha: Bad haba U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ïa phi bad ba u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba U Trai un leh ia u kynrad jong nga kat kum ka jingbha baroh kaba u la kren shaphang jong me, bad un sa thung ia me u nongsynshar halor ki Israel;

en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat , Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah : all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .
kha: U Jehoram , u khun jong u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u don hynriew ngut ki para shynrang : u Asaraïah , u Jehiel , u Sekharaïah , u Asaraïahu , u Mikhael , bad u Shephataïah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la don ki hynmen jong u Jehoshaphat, u Asariah, bad u Jehiah, bad u Asariah, bad u Asariah, bad u Michael bad u Shephiah: kine baroh ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoshaphat syiem Israel .

en: And he answering said , Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy strength , and with all thy mind  ; and thy neighbour as thyself .
kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,   ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , bad da la ka mynsiem baroh , da la ka jingkhlaiñ baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh’ ; bad ‘ Ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa lade .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab da kaba ong: Me dei ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh, bad da ka bor jong me baroh; bad ia u paramarjan jong me kum ma me hi .

en: When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;
kha: U Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Jethro u lyngdoh jong ka Midian , u kpa jong u Moses u la iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad na ka bynta ki Israel jong u bad ba U Trai u la pynmih ia ki Israel na Ijipt;

en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess . And Abijam his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Rehoboam u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Abijah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rehoboam u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u, bad la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Naamah ka Ammon . Bad u Abiram u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :
kha: Nangta u Apollos u la kut jingmut ban leit sha Akhaïa , kumta ki parabangeit ha Ephesos ki la ïarap ïa u da kaba thoh sha ki parabangeit kiba ha Akhaïa , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u . Haba u la poi , u la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa kito kiba da ka jingaiei jong U Blei ki la kylla long ki parabangeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la thmu ban iaid sha Akhaia, ki para bangeit ki la thoh, da kaba kyntu ia ki synran ban pdiang ia u: uba haba u la wan, u la iarap shibun ia ki kiba la ngeit lyngba ka jingaiei:

en: These words spake his parents , because they feared the Jews : for the Jews had agreed already , that if any man did confess that he was Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .
kha: Ki kmie ki kpa jong u ki la ong ïa kane namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , kiba la lah mynjur lypa ba uno uno uba ong ba u ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah un shah beh noh na ka synagog .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki ktien ki kren ia ki kmie ki kpa jong u , namar ki tieng ia ki Jiw: namar ki Jiw ki la ia mynjur lypa , ba lada uno uno u phla ba u long U Khrist , dei ban beh noh ia u na ka synagog .

en: Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,
kha: ngan ai ba yn tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah kiba ïada ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Baal Meon , bad ka Kiriathaim .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata , ha khmih , ngan plie ia ka liang jong u Moab na ki shnong jong u kiba don ha ki pud jong u, ka burom jong ka ri, ka Bethjeshimoth , ka Baalmeon bad ka Kiriathaim .

en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .
kha: Thaw ïa ka synduk da ka dieng akasia , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shna ia ka synduk dieng shittim: ar cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka bad shi cubit shiteng ka jingjrong jong ka .

en: And the people served the  Lord  all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua , who had seen all the great works of the  Lord  , that he did for Israel .
kha: Katba u Joshua u dang im , ki paid Israel ki shakri ïa U  Trai  , bad wat hadien ka jingïap jong u ki ïai leh kumta katba dang im ki nongïalam kiba la ïohi da lade ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U  Trai  u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la shakri ia U Trai ha ki sngi jong u Joshua bad ha ki sngi jong ki rangbah kiba la im u Joshua , kiba la iohi ia ki kam kiba khraw baroh jong U Trai , kiba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .
kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha uwei pa uwei uba wan najan , bad pha la kham long kum ka nuti man la ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la tei ia ka jaka ba jrong jong me ha man la ka khlieh lynti, bad me la pynlong ia ka jingitynnad jong me ban shah pynjah burom, bad me la plie ia ki kjat jong me ha uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba, bad me la pynbun ia ki kam khaii met jong me .

en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .
kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta jong me .  Uta u briew u la leit lyngba ïa ka shnong , u da ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit phai sha la ka jong ka iing, bad to pyni katno kiei kiei kiba khraw U Blei u la leh ha me . Bad u la leit noh ha ka shnong baroh kawei katno kiei kiei kiba khraw U Jisu u la leh ha u .

en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .
kha: Te u Manoah u duwai ha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , nga kyrpad ba men shah ïa u briew jong U Blei ïa uba me la phah ban wan biang sha ngi bad ban ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh ïa uta u khunlung ynda la kha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Manoah u la kyrpad ia U Trai bad u la ong, ko Trai jong nga, to ai ba uta u briew jong U Blei uba me la phah un wan phai biang sha ngi, bad to hikai ia ngi ia kaei kaba ngin leh ia uta u khun uba la kha .

en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God . And he said unto them , Behold , the king s son shall reign , as the  Lord  hath said of the sons of David .
kha: Baroh ki la ïalumlang ha ka Templ bad hangta ki la pynlong ka jutang bad u Joash , u khun jong u syiem . U Jehoïada u ong ha ki ,  Une hangne u dei u khun jong u syiem ba la khlad noh ! Mynta u dei ban long syiem , kumba U  Trai  u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la leh ia ka jutang bad u syiem ha iing U Blei . Bad u la ong ha ki: Ha khmih u khun syiem un synshar kumba U Trai u la ong na ki khun shynrang u Dabid .

en: And I will set my face against them  ; they shall go out from one fire , and another fire shall devour them  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I set my face against them .
kha: bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lah lait na kawei ka ding , hynrei mynta ka ding kan thang khoit ïa ki . Haba nga pynshitom ïa ki , phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia ki ; kin mih na kawei ka ding, bad kawei pat ka ding kan bam ia ki ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai haba nga buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia ki .

en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki la leh pop ; ki la phai dien noh na nga , ki la ai jingkñia sha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la shna ïa ki bleithaw bad mane ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynpaw ia ki jingbishar jong nga pyrshah ia ki kiba la iehnoh ia nga baroh , bad ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane ia ki kam jong ki hi .

en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him : and he dipped his finger in the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar , and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar :
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka , bad u tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad u theh ïa kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ki la wanrah ia ka snam ha u: bad u la pynkhih ia ka kti jong u ha ka snam , bad u la buh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka almari , bad u la theh ia ka snam ha trai jong ka almari:

en: And set two men , sons of Belial , before him , to bear witness against him , saying , Thou didst blaspheme God and the king . And then carry him out , and stone him , that he may die .
kha: Pynshong ar ngut ki riewrunar ban mudui pyrshah ïa u , ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem jong u . Nangta sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh arngut ki briew, ki khun shynrang, ha khmat jong u, ban sakhi pyrshah ia u, da kaba ong: Me la kren bein ia U Blei bad ia u syiem . Bad nangta to rah ia u shabar bad u maw ia u, ba un iap .

en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools , the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish : how say ye unto Pharaoh , I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings ?
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka nongbah Soan ki dei ki bieit ! Ki briew kiba stad tam jong ka Ijipt ki ai ka jingai jingmut ba khlem pyrkhat bha ! Kumno ki nud ban ïathuh ïa u syiem ba ki dei ki nongmih bujli ïa ki riewstad hyndai bad ïa ki syiem ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ki syiem jong ka Soan ki long kiba bieit, ka jingai jingmut jong ki nongai jingmut kiba stad jong u Pharaoh ka la kylla long kaba sniew: kumno phi ong ha u Pharaoh , nga long u khun uba stad , u khun jong ki syiem hyndai ?

en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom ; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord .
kha: Ka khubor jong U Khrist ha ka jingdap pura jong ka baroh , ka dei ban im hapoh ki dohnud jong phi . To hikai bad kyntu iwei ïa iwei pat da ka jingstad baroh . To rwai ki salm , ki jingrwai , bad ki jingrwai bakyntang ; to rwai sha U Blei da ka jingainguh ha ki dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka ktien U Khrist kan shong ha phi da ka jingstad baroh; ka jinghikai bad ka jingsneng iwei ia iwei pat ha ki Salm bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem, ka rwai da ka jingaiei ha ki dohnud jong phi ha U Trai .

en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .
kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba ki paid Israel ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da miet ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba pynjot . Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleh jubor ki nang jyllei hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , bad ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephraim u bam ia ka Iyer , bad u bud ia ka Iyer mihngi: u nang bun ki jinglamler bad ka jingpynjot ; bad ki leh ia ka jutang bad ki nong Assyria , bad ka umphniang ka iaid sha Ijipt .

en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .
kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran u la poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah ba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi, katba u dang kren, u Judas, uwei na ki shiphew ngut, bad bad u u paidbah uba bun bad ki waitlam bad ki diengduh, na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh bad ki rangbah .

en: And now thy two sons , Ephraim and Manasseh , which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt , are mine  ; as Reuben and Simeon , they shall be mine .
kha: U Jakob u bteng ,  Joseph , ki khun shynrang jong me ar ngut kiba me la ïoh ha Ijipt shuwa ba ngan wan hangne ki dei ki jong nga ; u Ephraim bad u Manasseh ki long ki khun jong nga kumba long u Reuben bad u Simeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong me, u Ephraim bad u Manasseh, kiba la kha ha me ha ka ri Ijipt shuwa ba ngan wan sha me ha Ijipt, ki long ki jong nga; kum u Reuben bad u Simion, kin long ki jong nga .

en: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines : and the Philistines said , Behold , the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves .
kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ki Philistia ban ïohi ïa ki , bad ki Philistia ki ong ,  Ha khmih ! katto katne ki Hebru ki wan mih na ki thliew ha kiba ki rieh !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh arngut ki la lap ia lade ha ka kynhun jong ki Philistia: bad ki Philistia ki la ong: Ha khmih ki Hebru ki mih na ki thliew ha kaba ki la buhrieh ia lade .

en: But the  Lord  , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm , him shall ye fear , and him shall ye worship , and to him shall ye do sacrifice .
kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U  Trai  , uba la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; phi dei ban dem khrup ha nga bad ban ai ki jingkñia ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Trai uba la wanrah ia phi na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor kaba khraw bad ka kti kaba la pynjrong , ia u phin tieng , bad ia u phin mane bad ia u phin leh ia ka jingknia .

en: And the battle increased that day : and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians , and died at even : and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot .
kha: Katba ka thma ka dang jur bha , u syiem Ahab u la shu kyrshan ha ka kali ïapom jong u , u da phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ka snam na ka jingmong jong u ka tuid bad ka tap shaduh trai jong ka kali ïapom , bad haba la janmiet u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka thma ka la nang kiew ha kata ka sngi: bad u syiem u la sah ha ka kali jong u pyrshah ia ki Syria , bad u la iap ha ka por janmiet: bad ka snam ka la tuid na ka jingmynsaw shapoh ka kali .

en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ , and for your liberal distribution unto them , and unto all men ;
kha: Bad namar ka jingpynshisha ïa kaba kane ka jingshakri jong phi ka wallam , bun ki ban ai burom ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel U Khrist , ïa kaba phi ïaphla , bad ïa ka jinglehsbun jong phi ha kaba ïasam bynta lem bad ki bad uwei pa uwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba sngewsih da ka jingpyrshang jong kane ka jingshakri ki pyndonburom ia U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpyndem jong phi ia ka gospel U Khrist , bad na ka bynta ka jingsam kaba laitluid jong phi ha ki , bad ha ki briew baroh;

en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el : and the horns of the altar shall be cut off , and fall to the ground .
kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta ki pop jong ki , ngan pynjot ïa ki duwan ka Bethel . Ïa ki dong jong kawei pa kawei ka duwan yn pom noh bad kin hap ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha ka sngi ba ngan leit jngoh ia ki jingpynkhein jong ki Israel halor jong u ngan leit jngoh ruh ia ki jingkhang jong ka Bethel: bad ki bniat jong ka jingkhang kin sa shah ot noh bad kin hap ha ka khyndew .

en: And it was so , when they came into the midst of the city , that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them , and cast them into the midst of the pit , he , and the men that were with him .
kha: Ki tang shu mar ïapoi hapoh ka nongbah , u Ishmael bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap ïa ki bad ki la bret ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ka pukri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba ki la poi hapdeng ka shnong, ba u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah u la pyniap ia ki bad u la bret ia ki hapdeng ka thliew, ma u bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: The same came to Jesus by night , and said unto him , Rabbi , we know that thou art a teacher come from God : for no man can do these miracles that thou doest , except God be with him .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet , une u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong ha u ,  Ko Rabbi , ngi tip ba me long u nonghikai ïa uba la phah da U Blei . Ym don uno uno uba lah ban leh ïa ki kambah kiba me leh lymda U Blei u don ryngkat bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U juh u la wan ha U Jisu ha ka por miet bad u la ong ha u, Rabbi, ngi tip ba me long u nonghikai uba wan na U Blei: namar ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban leh ia kine ki kambah kiba me leh, lymda U Blei U don ryngkat bad u .

en: These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .
kha: Kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , lem bad ki nongbud jong u ïa kiba u la khot , u la jied , bad kiba ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa ki , namar ba u dei U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem jong ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kin ialeh thma bad u Khunlangbrot bad u Khunlangbrot un jop ia ki: namar u long U Trai jong ki kynrad bad u Syiem ki syiem: bad ia kita kiba don bad u la khot bad la jied bad kiba iaineh .

en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .
kha: Nangta u Hiram u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon :  Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong me , bad nga kloi ban leh ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hiram u la phah sha u Solomon, u da ong, nga la pyrkhat ia kiei kiei kiba me phah sha nga: bad ngan leh ia ka jingkwah jong me baroh shaphang u dieng cedar bad shaphang u dieng ding .

en: It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .
kha: Hynrei u khun syiem uba synshar , u lah ban rung hangta ban bam ïa ka jingbam bakhuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka kamra ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long na ka bynta u syiem ; u syiem, un shong ha ka ban bam ia u kpu ha khmat U Trai un rung da ka lynti jong kata ka khyrdop, bad un leit noh da ka lynti jong kata kajuh .

en: And he opened the bottomless pit  ; and there arose a smoke out of the pit , as the smoke of a great furnace  ; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit .
kha: U khlur u la plie ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai , bad ka tdem ka la mih puk na ka , kum ka tdem na ka lawar ding kaba heh ; ïa ka jingshai ka sngi bad ka suiñbneng la pyndum ngaiñ da ka tdem na kata ka liewlong ba khlem trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la plie ia ka thliew kaba khlem tduh bad ka la mih ka tdem na ka thliew, kum ka tdem jong ka ding kaba heh ; bad ka sngi bad ka Iyer ka la dum namar ka tdem jong ka thliew .

en: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna , What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor ? And they answered , As thou art , so were they  ; each one resembled the children of a king .
kha: Nangta u Gideon u kylli ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ,  Kumno shaphang ki briew kiba phi la pynïap ha Tabor ?  Ki jubab ,  Ki syriem ïa phi — uwei pa uwei na ki u syriem ïa u khun jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u Sebah bad u Zalmunna, "Ki briew kiba phi la pyniap ha Tabor ? Ki la jubab: Kumba me long, kumta ki la long kum ki khun syiem .

en: Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u shah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Ki la kem ïa u Manasseh , ki pyndait jingbnoh ha u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , bad ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata U Trai u la wanrah ha ki ia ki rangbah jong u syiem Assyria , kiba la shim ia u Manasseh hapdeng ki thliew bad ki la teh ia u da ki kynjri bad ki la rah ia u sha Babilon .

en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .
kha: Ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Judah naduh kata ka por . Ha kane kajuh ka por , ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , namar u Jehoram u la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki nong Edome ki la kylla na hapoh ka kti u Judah haduh kane ka sngi . Ha kajuh ka por ruh u Libnah u la kylla na hapoh ka kti jong u ; namar u la iehnoh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u .

en: Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Samuel , naba ka ong ,  Nga la pan ïa u na U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka la jia, haba ka por ka la poi hadien ba ka Hannah ka la pun khun, ba ka la kha khun shynrang bad ka la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Samuel, da kaba ong: Namar nga la kylli ia u na U Trai .

en: But I have made Esau bare , I have uncovered his secret places , and he shall not be able to hide himself : his seed is spoiled , and his brethren , and his neighbours , and he is not .
kha: Hynrei nga la sloit lut ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso bad pynpaw ïa ki jakarieh jong ki , te ba kin ym lah buhrieh shuh . Ïa baroh ki briew ka Edom la pynjot . Khlem pynsah shuh ïa uwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la pynlong ia u Iso uba lyngkhuid, nga la pynpaw ia ki jaka rieh jong u, bad un ym lah ban buhrieh ia lade: u symbai jong u u la jot , bad ki hynmen jong u bad ki para marjan jong u , bad um long kumta .

en: And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe  ; and they are all zealous of the law :
kha: Hadien ba la ïohsngew ïa u , ki baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . Nangta ki la ong ,  Ko Paul , phi lah ban ïohi katno hajar ngut ki Jiw ki la kylla long ki parabangeit , bad katno ma ki baroh ki bat pyrkhing ïa ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohsngew ia kata, ki la pyndonburom ia U Trai, bad ki la ong ha u, Me iohi, ko para, katno hajar ngut ki Jiw ki don kiba ngeit ; bad baroh ki sngewtynnad ia ka hukum:

en: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea  ; and of the Thessalonians , Aristarchus and Secundus  ; and Gaius of Derbe , and Timothy  ; and of Asia , Tychicus and Trophimus .
kha: U Sopater , u khun jong u Pyrrhos , uba na Beria , u la leit lem bad u ; kumta ruh u Aristarkhos bad u Sekundos , na Thessaloni ; u Gaïos na Derbe ; u Tukhikos bad u Trophimos , na ka probins    jong ka Asia ; bad u Timothi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta u la iadon ryngkat bad u ha Asia Sopater u Berea ; bad ki nong Thessaloni, u Aristarkhos bad u Secundus bad u Gaios u Derbe, bad u Timothi ; bad u Asia, u Tychicus bad u Trophimus .

en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard , and shall be removed like a cottage  ; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it  ; and it shall fall , and not rise again .
kha: Ka pyrthei hi kan khih kum u nongbuaid bad khih shane bad shatai kum ka ïingtrep ha ka  erïong . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynkhia da ki pop jong ka ; kan khyllem bad kan ym lah khie khlieh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyndew kan kylla long kum u nongdih kyiad, bad yn weng noh ia ka kum ka ïing rit ; bad ka jingpynkheiñ jong ka kan long kaba khia halor jong ka ; bad kan hap biang .

en: And he shall have it , and his seed after him , even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood  ; because he was zealous for his God , and made an atonement for the children of Israel .
kha: Ma u bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin bat ïa ka kam lyngdoh junom , namar ba um shym la shah ïa kiba ïakob bor bad nga bad ba u la wallam ka jingïohmap na ka bynta ka pop jong ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un don ia ka, bad u symbai jong u hadien jong u, wat ia ka jutang jong ka jinglong lyngdoh bymjukut ; namar u la sngewsih ia U Blei jong u , bad u la leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki khun Israel .

en: And I , and all the people that are with me , will approach unto the city : and it shall come to pass , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them ,
kha: Ki rangbah jong nga bad ma nga ngin leit tur sha ka nongbah . Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki wan mih pyrshah ïa ngi , ngin phai dien bad ngin phet , kumba ngi la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad nga ngin leit sha ka shnong: bad kan sa jia ynda ki la mih pyrshah ia ngi kumba ha kaba nyngkong eh ba ngin phet noh ha khmat jong ki .

en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord  God   ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord  God  ?
kha: Pynban , mynta me la leh kham bun , A  Trai  Nongsynshar ; me la pynlong ki jingkular shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan . Bad me shah ïa u briew ban ïohi ïa kane , A  Trai  Nongsynshar !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka la long kaba rit ha ka jingpeit jong me, ko Trai Blei; hynrei me la kren ruh shaphang ka iing jong u shakri jong me ha ka por kaba khraw ban wan . Bad kane ka long ka rukom briew ko Trai Blei ?

en: Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la byrngem ïa kane ka ri da ka jingjot , bad mynta u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la ong ba un leh . Baroh kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Trai u la wanrah ia ka, bad u la leh kumba u la ong: namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai bad phim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong u , namarkata kane ka jingjia ka la wan ha phi .

en: But Barak pursued after the chariots , and after the host , unto Harosheth of the Gentiles : and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword  ; and there was not a man left .
kha: U Barak u beh kthong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ka kynhun shipai sha Harosheth-jong-ki-Jentil , bad la pynïap plain ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u Sisera . Ym don uwei ruh u briew uba lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Barak u la bud ia ki kali bad hadien ka kynhun shipai, haduh u Hashet jong ki Jutang: bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ka la hap ha ka tduh jong ka waitlam ; bad ym don briew uba sah shuh .

en: It shall not be baken with leaven . I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire  ; it is most holy , as is the sin offering , and as the trespass offering .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kin bam ïa kaba sah baroh . Yn pynlong ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat bad ban bam ha ka jaka bakhuid , ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki na kata ka jingainguh bam . Ka long kaba khuid , kumba long ki jingainguh namar ka pop bad ki jingainguh namar ki jingleh palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym dei ban shet da ka jingkhleh . Nga la ai ia ka ha ki na ka bynta jong ki na ki jingainguh jong nga ba la shna da ka ding; ka long kaba khuid tam, kumba long ka jingainguh pop .

en: Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .
kha: Hato don ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u long u nongïatrei lang bad nga ban ïarap ïa phi ; bad shaphang kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang bad ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u kylli ia u Titus , u long u paralok bad u paralok jong nga ha kaba iadei bad phi: lane ki para jong ngi ki shah kylli jingkylli , ki long ki nonglam khubor jong ki balang bad ka burom U Khrist .

en: Then said Paul , John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance , saying unto the people , that they should believe on him which should come after him , that is , on Christ Jesus .
kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ka long na ka bynta kito kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong ki ; bad u la ïathuh ha ki paid Israel ban ngeit ha uta u ban sa wan hadien jong u — kata , ha U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la ong u Ioannis da kaba pynbaptis shisha ia ka jingkylla kaba mut, da kaba ong ha ki briew, ba kin ngeit ha uta uba dei ban wan hadien jong u, kata ha U Khrist Jisu .

en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .
kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba bad ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga la iaid lyngba jong me, bad nga la iohi ia me ba me la pynjakhlia ha ka snam jong me hi, nga la ong ha me haba me la don ha ka snam jong me, To im;

en: Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .
kha: Hynrei uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha u ,  Ngi baroh ngi la tlot na ka jingthngan , hynrei i pa jong phi i la byrngem ïa ngi bad ong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia uwei na ki briew , bad u la ong , U kpa jong me u la pynngat jur ia ki briew da ka jingsmai , u la ong , La tim ia uta u briew uba bam ei ei ha kane ka sngi . Bad ki briew ki la lyngngoh .

en: When Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .
kha: Hynrei u Sanballat , na ka shnong Beth Horon , bad u Tobiah , u rangbah synshar jong ka probins Ammon , ki la ïohsngew ba don mano mano ba la wan ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki Israel , bad ki la bitar haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Sanballat u Horon bad u Tobiah u shakri, u Ammon u la iohsngew ia kata, ka la pynsngewsih ia ki haduh katta katta ba la wan u briew ban wad ia ka jingbha jong ki khun Israel .

en: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jong me shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U ruh u leh kumta , bad haba u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Pyndait biang ia ka kti jong me ha ka shyntur jong me . Bad u la buh biang ia ka kti jong u ; bad u la ot biang ia ka na ka shyntur jong u, bad , ha khmih , ka la kylla biang kum kawei pat ka doh jong u .

en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria . And Jehu wrote letters , and sent to Samaria , unto the rulers of Jezreel , to the elders , and to them that brought up Ahab s children , saying ,
kha: Ki don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Samaria . U Jehu u thoh ka shithi bad u la phah ïa ki kopi jong ka sha ki nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , sha ki riewpawkhmat , bad sha ki nongsumar ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u don hynriewphew ngut ki khun shynrang ha Samaria . U Jehu u la thoh shithi bad u la phah sha Samaria, sha ki nongsynshar jong ka Jesel, sha ki rangbah bad ha ki kiba la pynsan ia ki khun u Ahab, da kaba ong:

en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , like as did the house of Ahab : for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife : and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the  Lord .
kha: U bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Ahab bad kiwei pat ki syiem Israel , namar u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Ahab , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iaid ha ka lynti jong ki syiem Israel kumba la leh ia ka iing u Ahab: namar u la don ka khun jong u Ahab ha ka tnga: bad u la leh ia kata kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the  Lord  had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .
kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . U Aaron u bret ïa la u diengduh ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad u kylla bseiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit sha u Pharaoh bad ki la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum: bad u Aaron u la pynhap ia u diengduh jong u ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki shakri jong u .

en: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .
kha: Um shym bud ïa ki nuksa babha jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u bad u bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki syiem Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Arphew snem ka rta u Ahasa haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar shiphew snem ha Jerusalem , bad um shym la leh ia kata kaba dei ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong u, kum u kpa jong u u Dabid .

en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only , but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham , which he had being yet uncircumcised .
kha: U long ruh u kpa jong kito ïa kiba la otsher , kata , jong kito kiba , nalor ba la otsher ïa ki , ki la im ruh ïa kajuh ka jingim jong ka jingngeit kaba u Abraham u kpa jong ngi u la im shuwa ba yn otsher ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kpa jong ka jingotsher ia kito ki bym dei tang na ka jingotsher hynrei kiba iaid ruh ha ki dienjat jong kata ka jingngeit jong u kpa jong ngi u Abraham , kaba u dang long uba khlem ot .

en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , As thou didst deal with David my father , and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein , even so deal with me .
kha: U Solomon u phah khubor sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros :  To ïakhaïi bad nga kumba phi la leh bad u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong nga , mynba phi la die ïa u ki dieng Kedar tylli na ka bynta ban tei ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la phah sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros, u da ong: Kumba me la leh bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga, bad me la phah ia u da ki soh sohjew ban tei ia u ia ka iing ban shong hangta, wat ia nga ruh .

en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .
kha: Mynta kumne kumne phan sa sngew ïa ka bor jingbitar jong nga baroh . Ngan bishar ïa pha kat kum kiei kiei kiba pha la leh , bad pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ba-ijli jong pha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngan sa theh noh tang khyndiat por ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong me: bad ngan bishar ia me kat kum ki lynti jong me baroh .

en: In that day , he which shall be upon the housetop , and his stuff in the house , let him not come down to take it away : and he that is in the field , let him likewise not return back .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi u briew uba don halor ka tnum jong ka ïing jong u , um dei ban leit hiar shapoh ka ïing ban shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u ; ha kajuh ka rukom u briew uba don shabar ha ka lyngkha um dei ban leit phai pat sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi , uta uba don halor ka iing bad ki tiar jong u ha iing , un ym wan hiar ban shim noh ia ka: bad uta uba don ha lyngkha , un ym wan phai shuh .

en: With twelve hundred chariots , and threescore thousand horsemen : and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt  ; the Libyans , the Sukkiims , and the Ethiopians .
kha: U Shishak u syiem ka Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba shihajar arspah tylli ki kali ïapom , hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad shibun ki shipai ban ïa kaba lah ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew , kaba kynthup ïa ki nong Libya , ki Sukki , bad ki kynhun Sudan .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki shiphew spah tylli ki kali kit kulai bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki kulai: bad ki briew ki long ki bym don jingkhein kiba wan ryngkat bad u na Ijipt; ki Libyan, ki Sukkim bad ki nong Ethiopia .

en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .
kha: Mar ïapoi ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong , ka kynhun leit ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap u long u khun nyngkong jong ka briew kaba long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka shnong u la ïadon lem bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u la wan hajan ka khyrdop jong ka shnong, ha khmih u la don uwei u briew uba la iap, u khun marwei jong ka kmie jong u: bad bun ki briew jong ka shnong ki la don ryngkat bad ka .

en: Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;
kha: Khie leit phai noh sha ïing , naba nga la tymmen ban shongkurim biang . Wat lada nga pyrkhat ba dang don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban shongkurim ha kane ka miet bad ïoh khun shynrang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynphai biang ia ki khun kynthei jong nga, leit noh ia ka lynti jong phi namar nga la tymmen palat ban don u tnga . Lada nga dei ban ong, nga don ka jingkyrmen, lada nga dei ban don u tnga ruh ban leit miet, bad nga dei ruh ban kha khun shynrang;

en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn ai noh kum ki mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi pat phi shu peit . Man ka sngi phin pynshitom sat ïa la ki khmat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me kin shah ai ha kawei pat ka jaitbynriew, bad ki khmat jong me kin peit bad ki jah noh da kaba kwah ia ki baroh shisngi: bad kan ym don ka bor ha ka kti jong me .

en: My meat also which I gave thee , fine flour , and oil , and honey , wherewith I fed thee , thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour : and thus it was , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Nga la ai ha pha ka jingbam — u  purew babha tam , ka umphniang Olib bad ka ngap — hynrei pha la ainguh kum ka jingkñia ban ïoh ka jingsngewbha jong ki bleithaw .  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka doh jong nga ruh kaba nga la ai ha me, ka shini kaba bha bad ka umphniang bad ka umsoh ha kaba nga la ai bam ia me, me la buh wat ia ka ha khmat jong ki na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang: bad kumta ka la long, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , that thou shalt set thee up great stones , and plaster them with plaster :
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad rung sha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , pynïeng katto katne tylli ki maw kiba heh , ñiad astor ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha ka sngi ba phin iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan sha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, ba me buh ia me ia ki maw kiba heh bad to buh ia ki da ka plaster:

en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , that ye should not be their bondmen  ; and I have broken the bands of your yoke , and made you go upright .
kha: Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba phin ym long shuh ki mraw . Nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka bor kaba pynpoh ïa phi , bad nga la pynlah ïa phi ban ïaid ha ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la pynmih ia phi na ka ri Ijipt , ba phin ym long ki mraw jong ki ; bad nga la pynpra ia ki teh jong ka lyngkhot jong phi bad nga la pynlong ia phi ban iaid beit .

en: Then Abraham fell upon his face , and laughed , and said in his heart , Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old ? and shall Sarah , that is ninety years old , bear ?
kha: U Abraham u dem ngon ha khyndew , hynrei u la sdang ban rkhie haba u pyrkhat ,  Hato u briew u lah mo ban ïoh khun haba u la don shispah snem ka rta ? Hato ka Sarah ka lah mo ban ïoh khun haba ka la don khyndaiphew snem ka rta ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abraham u la dem khrup bad u la rkhie bad u la ong ha la ka dohnud: Hato yn kha khun ia uta uba la dap shispah snem ? bad ka Sarah kaba la dap hynniewphew snem ka rta kan kha khun ?

en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo , to the top of Pisgah , that is over against Jericho . And the  Lord  shewed him all the land of Gilead , unto Dan ,
kha: U Moses u leit kiew na ri them Moab sha u Lum Nebo haduh kliar jong u Lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi na Jerikho , bad nangta U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei : ka ri Gilead shaduh Dan kaba shaphang shatei ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kiew na ki madan Moab haduh u lum Nebo, haduh u lum Pisgah, uba don ha Jericho . U Trai u la pyni ia u ia ka ri Gilead baroh kawei, haduh u Dan .

en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .
kha: Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba ha Atad , kaba sha mihngi na ka Jordan , ki ïapynlong hangta ïa ka jingïambriew kaba jur bad kaba kthang mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndep ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka rep jong u Atad kaba don sha lyndet ka Jordan , bad hangta ki la iam da ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw bad kaba jur bha: bad u la iam na ka bynta u kpa jong u hynriew sngi .

en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .
kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong bad ïa ki jingri jong ki baroh ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban pynkhih shisha ia ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka shnong da ka tduh jong ka waitlam , da kaba pynjot lut ia ka bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka .

en: We are bound to thank God always for you , brethren , as it is meet , because that your faith groweth exceedingly , and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth ;
kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi . Ka long kaba dei ïa ngi ban leh kumta , namar ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka la san shikatdei eh bad ba ka jingieit kaba iwei pa iwei na phi , phi don na ka bynta kiwei pat ka la nang kham khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi dei ban ainguh ia U Blei man ka por na ka bynta jong phi, ko para bangeit, kumba ka long ban iakynduh, namar ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nangroi palat, bad ka jingaiei jong phi baroh iwei ia iwei ia iwei pat;

en: And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .
kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki ïawanlang bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nangta ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la iap bad ki Israel baroh ki la ialum lang, bad ki la iam ia u bad ki la tep ia u ha ka iing jong u ha Ramah . U Dabid u la ieng bad u la leit hiar sha ka ri khlaw Paran .

en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .
kha: Haba ki tnga jong ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem jong ka Persia bad Media kin ïohsngew shaphang ka jingleh jong ka mahadei kin ong ïa la ki tnga jong ki shaphang kata shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut . Ki kynthei ha kylleng sawdong kin ym burom shuh ïa la ki tnga , bad ki shynrang kin dap da ka jingbitar ïa la ki tnga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki kynthei jong ka Persia bad ka Media kin ong ha kane ka sngi ha ki syiem baroh kiba la iohsngew ia ka kam jong ka mahadei . Kumta kan mih ka jingleh bein bad ka jingbitar palat .

en: Behold , therefore I am against thee , and against thy rivers , and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate , from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia .
kha: nga long u nongshun jong me bad u nongshun jong ka wah Nile jong me . Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt baroh kawei kaba suda khlem jingmyntoi , naduh ka nongbah Migdol ha ka phang bashatei haduh ka nongbah Aswan ha ka phang bashathie , baroh shi lynter haduh u pud ki Sudan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia me bad pyrshah ia ki wah jong me , bad ngan pynlong ia ka ri Ijipt kaba la jot bad kaba la jot lut , naduh u pud u sam jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .
kha: Ka ksiar bad ka rupa jong phi ka la bam sarang , bad kane ka sarang kan long ka sakhi pyrshah ïa phi bad kan sa bam duh ïa ka doh jong phi kum ka ding . Phi la kynshew spah ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ksiar bad ka rupa jong phi ka la tyrkhong ; bad ka jingsma jong ki kan long ka sakhi pyrshah ia phi , bad kan bam ia ka doh jong phi kumba ka long ka ding . U la lum lang ia ka spah ha ki sngi ba khatduh .

en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera , and said unto him , Turn in , my lord , turn in to me  ; fear not . And when he had turned in unto her into the tent , she covered him with a mantle .
kha: Ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u Sisera bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale shapoh , kynrad ; wan sha ka dara jong nga . Wat sheptieng .  Kumta u leit shapoh , bad ka pynrieh ïa u hadien ka pyrda .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jael u la mih ban iakynduh ia u Sisera, bad u la ong ha u, To phai noh sha nga; wat tieng . Bad haba u la phai sha ka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ .

en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously , whether he be born in the land , or a stranger , the same reproacheth the  Lord   ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
kha: Hynrei mano mano ba leh pop khnang , la ki dei ki traishnong ne ki nongwei , ki long kiba la rem ba kim ñiewkor ïa U  Trai  , bad ki dei ban shah pynïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka mynsiem kaba leh da kaba sngewthuh bakla, la u long ha ka ri ne u nongwei, uta u juh u kren bein ia U Trai ; bad kata ka mynsiem kan shah ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth  ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you  ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .
kha: Hynrei nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ka kham bha ïa phi ba nga leit noh , namar lada ngam leit noh , U Nongïarap un ym wan sha phi . Hynrei lada nga leit noh , te ngan phah ïa u sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh nga ong ia phi ia ka jingshisha ; Ka long kaba donkam ia phi ba ngan leit noh: namar lada ngam leit noh , u Nongialam un ym wan sha phi ; hynrei lada nga leit noh , ngan phah ia u sha phi .

en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .
kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban sah ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad ka tnga kliar jong u ki sdang ïa ka jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki kada ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi ka la jan sep haba ki wan poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumta u shakri u ong ha la u kynrad ,  Balei ngim sangeh ban sahmiet ha kane ka nongbah ki Jebus ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la don hajan u Jebus , ka sngi ka la jah noh bad u shakri u la ong ha u kynrad jong u: To wan, nga kyrpad ia me, bad to ngin phai sha kane ka shnong jong ki Jesus bad ngin sah ha ka .

en: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you : but are there not with you , even with you , sins against the  Lord  your God ?
kha: Bad mynta phi thmu sa ban pynlong ïa ki shynrang bad kynthei jong ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki mraw jong phi . Hato phim tip ba phi ruh phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta phi thmu ban bat hapoh ki khun Judah bad Jerusalem na ka bynta ki mraw bad ki mraw ha phi: hynrei hato ym don bad phi, wat bad phi, ki pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong phi ?

en: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .
kha: Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kaba ong ,  Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap !  U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba khie  erïong ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan sha u, bad ki la pynkynjah ia u, ki da ong, Ko kynrad, ngi la jah noh . Nangta u la ieng bad u la pynrem ia ka Iyer bad ka jingtuid jong ka um: bad ki la sangeh noh, bad ka la don ka jingsuk .

en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .
kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki briew jong nga ; nga la shim ïa ki kumba kim dei shuh ki jong nga : Nga buh ïa ki ha ka bor jong pha , bad pham pyn-i jinglehisynei ïa ki ; wat ïa kiba la tymmen pha leh da kaba tyngeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la bitar ia ki briew jong nga, nga la pynjakhlia ia ka pateng jong nga, bad nga la ai ia ki ha ka kti jong me: me khlem da isynei ia ki; ha ki hyndai me la buh shibun eh ia ka jingkit jong me .

en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .
kha: te ïa ka kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jong nga kham slem ban ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ha ki ruh ngan ai ha iing jong nga bad hapoh ki kynroh jong nga ka jaka bad ka kyrteng kaba kham bha ban ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei: Ngan ai ia ki ka kyrteng kaba bymjukut , kaba ym shah ot noh .

en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dabid da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka synduk metïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Joab bad ha ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u, To ai ia ki jain jong phi, bad to buh ia phi da ka jainkup bad to iam ha khmat u Abner . Bad u syiem Dabid hi u la bud ia ka umsoh .

en: And going on from thence , he saw other two brethren , James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , in a ship with Zebedee their father , mending their nets  ; and he called them .
kha: U la nang ïaid u la ïohi ïa ar ngut kiwei pat shi para , ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi . Ki la don ha ka lieng lem bad u Sebedi u kpa jong ki , ba ki dang ïapynkhreh ïa ki jar jong ki . U Jisu u la khot ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nang iaid shakhmat nangta , u la iohi ia kiwei pat ki arngut ki hynmen , u Jakob u khun u Sebedee bad u Ioannis u hynmen jong u, ha ka lieng bad u kpa jong ki u Zebedee, u la pynbeit ia ki jar jong ki; bad u la khot ia ki .

en: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?
kha: U Jisu u la phai , u la ïohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïawad aïu ?  Ki la jubab ïa u ,  Hangno me sah , ko Rabbi ?  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Nonghikai . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phai bad u la iohi ia ki ba ki bud, bad u la ong ha ki, Phi wad aiu ? Ki la ong ha u, Rabbi, (ka kaba mut, ba la pynkylla ktien, Ko Nonghikai, ) ha kaba me sah ?

en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .
kha: Kynmaw ba dei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba ai spah ïa phi , ba un ïoh pynskhem haduh kane ka sngi ïa kata ka jutang ba u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban kynmaw ia U Trai U Blei jong me: namar dei ma me uba ai bor ia me ban ioh ia ka spah, ba un pynskhem ia ka jutang jong u kaba u sngap jar ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, kumba ka long ha kane ka sngi .

en: Therefore said he unto them ,  The harvest truly is great , but the labourers are few : pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he would send forth labourers into his harvest .
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ka don ka jingot bakhraw , hynrei tang khyndiat ngut ki nongtrei ban ïalum ïa ka . To kyrpad ïa u trai jong ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban lumlang ha ka jingot jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la ong ha ki , Ka jingot shisha ka long kaba khraw , hynrei ki nongtrei ki long tang khyndiat: to duwai namarkata ia U Trai jong ka jingot , ba un phah ia ki nongtrei sha ka jingot jong u .

en: And they left all the commandments of the  Lord  their God , and made them molten images , even two calves , and made a grove , and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served Baal .
kha: Ki pynkheiñ ïa baroh ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong ki bad ki thaw ar tylli ki khun masi da ka nar ban mane ; ki thaw ruh ïa ka durblei jong ka blei Asherah , ki mane ïa ki khlur , bad ki shakri ïa u blei Baal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iehnoh ia ki hukum baroh jong U Trai U Blei jong ki, bad ki la thaw ia ki dur ba la khleh lang, wat ar tylli ki khun masi, bad ki la thaw ia ka khlaw bad ki la mane ia ka kynhun ki bneng baroh kawei, bad ki la shakri ia u Baal .

en: O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .
kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Balak u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban leh ïa phi bad kumno u Balaam u khun jong u Beor u la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la jia ha lynti na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia sha Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei bad phin shem ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko ki briew jong nga, to kynmaw mynta ia kaei kaba u Balak u la iamir jingmut bad kaei kaba u Balaam u khun u Beor u la jubab ia u naduh Shittim haduh Gilgal ; ba phin ithuh ia ka hok U Trai .

en: Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them ,  Let us go over unto the other side of the lake .  And they launched forth .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng lem bad ki synran jong u bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw .  Kumta ki la ïaleit .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha kawei ka sngi, ba u la leit shapoh lieng bad ki synran jong u: bad u la ong ha ki: To ngin leit sha shiliang ka pung . Ki la iaid shabar .

en: And when it was told David , he gathered all Israel together , and passed over Jordan , and came to Helam . And the Syrians set themselves in array against David , and fought with him .
kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai Israel baroh , u jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan , bad u ïaid sha Helam ha kaba ki Syria ki ïeng ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa u . Ka jingïaleh ka la sdang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la iathuh ha u Dabid, u la lum lang ia ki Israel baroh, bad u la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan, bad u la poi ha Helam . Ki Syria ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Dabid bad ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u .

en: Then came in the magicians , the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers : and I told the dream before them  ; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof .
kha: Te la wallam shapoh ïa baroh ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga , hynrei kim lah ban batai ïa ka ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan ha ki nongleh jadu, ki nongleh jadu, ki nongleh jadu bad ki nongleh jadu: bad nga la iathuh ia ka jingphohsniew ha khmat jong ki ; hynrei kim shym la pynpaw ha nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;
kha: Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ai ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga jong ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngi la kohnguh ia ka sur jong u Jehonadab u khun u kpa jong ngi ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la kynnoh ia ngi, ban ym dih wain baroh shi sngi jong ngi, ngi, ki tnga jong ngi, ne ki khun kynthei jong ngi;

en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the  Lord  their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .
kha: Hynrei ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa ki briew ka Judah . Ma nga U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ngan pyllait im ïa ki ; hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata da ka thma — da ki waitlam lane ki ryntieh , bad ki khnam lane ki kulai bad ki shipai shong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan isynei ia ka iing Judah bad ngan pynim ia ki da U Trai U Blei jong ki, bad ngan ym pynim ia ki da ka bow ne da ka waitlam ne da ka waitlam ne da ka thma, da ki kulai ne da ki kulai .

en: And it came to pass , when our enemies heard that it was known unto us , and God had brought their counsel to nought , that we returned all of us to the wall , every one unto his work .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki ïohsngew ba ngi la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïasylla , bad ki sngewthuh ba U Blei u la jop ïa ki jingthmu jong ki . Nangta ma ngi baroh ngi leit biang ban tei pat ïa ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki nongshun jong ngi ki la iohsngew ba la tip ia ngi, bad U Blei u la wanrah ia ka jingthmu jong ki ha ka por ba ngi la leit phai noh baroh sha ka kynroh, uwei pa uwei sha ka kam jong u .

en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth , ere it was chewed , the wrath of the  Lord  was kindled against the people , and the  Lord  smote the people with a very great plague .
kha: Katba kata ka doh ka dang bun ba kin bam , U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa kita ki briew bad u pynngat ka jingïapthem kaba jur hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ka doh ka dang don hapdeng ki bniat jong ki, ka la shah ktah, ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki briew , bad U Trai u la pynkhih ia ki briew da ka khlam kaba khraw shibun .

en: And there shall ye remember your ways , and all your doings , wherein ye have been defiled  ; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed .
kha: Te phin kynmaw ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba jahburom kiba phi la leh bad kumno phi la pyntngit ïa lade . Phin sa isih ïa lade namar kiei kiei kiba sniew baroh kiba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta phin kynmaw ia ki lynti jong phi baroh, bad ia ki jingleh jong phi baroh, ha kaba phi la shah pynjakhlia bad phin sa ia tyngkhuh bad ki jingsniew jong phi baroh kiba phi la leh.

en: And Gideon made an ephod thereof , and put it in his city , even in Ophrah : and all Israel went thither a whoring after it : which thing became a snare unto Gideon , and to his house .
kha: U Gideon u shna ka bleithaw na ka ksiar bad u buh ïa ka ha la shnong , ha Ophrah . Baroh ki Israel ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei bad ki la leit shata ban mane ïa ka bleithaw . Ka la long ka jingriam ïa u Gideon bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la shna ia ka ha ka shnong jong u, wat ha Ophrah: bad ki Israel baroh ki la leit sha ka jaka kaba shongkurim hadien jong ka: kaba la kylla long ka jingma ia u Gideon bad ia ka iing jong u .

en: For thy waste and thy desolate places , and the land of thy destruction , shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants , and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away .
kha: Ïa ka ri jong pha la pynjot bad la iehnoh kynjah — hynrei mynta kan rit eh na ka bynta kito ki ban wan ban shong hangta . Bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa pha ha ka jingjot yn pynkynriah jngai na pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki jaka ba la jot bad ki jaka ba la jot jong me, bad ka ri jong ka jingpynjot jong me, wat mynta ruh kan long kaba rit palat namar ki nongshong shnong jong me, bad kita kiba la bam ia me kin long kiba jngai .

en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?
kha: Hato la dei ki wah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar , A  Trai  ! Hato la dei ka duriaw kaba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar shla ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka  erïong u la long ka kali ïapom jong me , mynba me la wallam jingjop ha la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Trai u la sngewsih ia ki wah ? hato ka jingbitar jong me ka la long pyrshah ia ki wah ? hato ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ia ka duriaw , ba me la shong halor ki kulai jong me bad ki kali jong me jong ka jingpynim ?

en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , both young men and old together : for I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them , and make them rejoice from their sorrow .
kha: Nangta ki samla kynthei kin shad bad kin kmen , bad ki shynrang , kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin shadkmen . Ngan pyntngen ïa ki bad pynkylla ïa ka jingïambriew sha ka jingkmen , ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingsngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u nongleh kam sniew un ia kmen lang: namar ngan pynkylla ia ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingkmen , bad ngan pyntngen ia ki , bad ngan pynsngewbha ia ki na ka jingsngewsih jong ki .

en: But the prophet , which shall presume to speak a word in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or that shall speak in the name of other gods , even that prophet shall die .
kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u nongïathuhlypa u nud ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa ka khubor kaba ngam shym la hukum ïa u , u dei ban ïap namar kata ; bad uno uno u nongïathuhlypa uba kren ha ka kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki blei u ruh u dei ban ïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u nongiathuhlypa uba sngew sarong ban kren ia ka ktien ha ka kyrteng jong nga kaba ngam shym la hukum ia u ban kren , lane uta u nongiathuhlypa un iap noh .

en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people , the priests , and the Levites , unto Ezra the scribe , even to understand the words of the law .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki rangbah kur , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ki leit sha u Esra ban pule bniah ïa ka jinghikai jong ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar la lum lang ia u rangbah jong ki kpa tymmen baroh , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ha u Esra u nongthoh , wat ban sngewthuh ia ki ktien jong ka hukum .

en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .
kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba ki don mynta .  Nga la ong ,  Ho-oid , ko  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngan pyndep ia ka jingsmai kaba nga la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi, ban ai ia ki ia ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kumba ka long mynta ka sngi . Nangta nga la jubab bad nga la ong , To long kumta ko Trai .

en: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day , Behold , such is our expectation , whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria : and how shall we escape ?
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki briew kiba shong shi lynter ka rud duriaw jong ka Philistia kin ong , ‘ Khmih ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki briew kiba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na u patsha jong ka Assyria ! Kumno ngin ïohlait im ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u nongshong shnong jong kane ka ïew un ong ha kata ka sngi , Ha khmih, kum kata ka jingkhmih lynti jong ngi, ha kaba ngi phet noh ban ioh jingïarap na u syiem Assyria: bad kumno ngin lait ?

en: For I have not sent them , saith the  Lord  , yet they prophesy a lie in my name  ; that I might drive you out , and that ye might perish , ye , and the prophets that prophesy unto you .
kha: U  Trai  hi u la ong ba um shym phah ïa ki bad ba ki lamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong u . Bad kumta un beh noh ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn pynïap , ïa phi bad ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa phi ïa kine ki jinglamler .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam shym la phah ia ki , ong U Trai , hynrei ki iathuhlypa ia ka jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga; ba ngan beh noh ia phi, bad ba phin jah noh, phi, bad ki nongiathuhlypa kiba iathuhlypa ha phi .

en: And he said , I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life  ; and , lo , Sarah thy wife shall have a son . And Sarah heard it in the tent door , which was behind him .
kha: Uwei na ki u ong ,  Ngan sa wan biang sha me hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong me kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .  Ka Sarah kaba ïeng hadien jong u ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , ka pynshahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , Ngan sa wan phai shisha sha me katkum ka por jong ka jingim; bad ka Sarah ka tnga jong me kan ioh khun shynrang . Bad ka Sarah ka la iohsngew ia ka ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ kaba don shadien jong u .

en: And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;
kha: Hangta ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , kumba la ju khot ïa ka , la don u briew uba la dkoh baroh shi jingim . Man ka sngi la ju bah ïa u sha ka khyrdop ban khrong pisa na ki briew kiba leit shapoh ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la rah ia uwei u briew uba lyngngoh na ka kpoh jong u, ia uba ki la thiah man ka sngi ha ka khyrdop jong ka tempi kaba la khot ka Bynta , ban kylli ia ki alm jong ki kiba rung shapoh ka tempi ; .

en: But even after that we had suffered before , and were shamefully entreated , as ye know , at Philippi , we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention .
kha: Phi tip kumno ba ngi la shah lehbeiñ bad shah krenbeiñ ha Philippi shuwa ba ngin wan sha phi ha Thessaloni . Bad wat la ka la don ka jingpyrshah kaba jur , U Blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba wan na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat hadien kata ngi la shah shitom mynshuwa, bad ngi la shah pynjah burom, kumba phi tip, ha Philipi, ngi la shlur ha U Blei jong ngi ban kren ha phi ia ka gospel U Blei da ka jingiakren kaba khraw .

en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
kha: U la leit kham jngai sa katto katne , u la dem khrup ïa lade bad ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim noh ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me mon .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iaid kham sha jngai khyndiat bad u la dem khrup bad u la duwai, u da ong, ko Kpa jong nga lada lah, to ai ba kane ka khuri kan iaid noh na nga: wat la katta ruh ym kumba nga mon hynrei kumba me mon .

en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you .
kha: Phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  bad ba katba phi dang bat ïa ki aiñ jong ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan , phi la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai: namar phim shym la iaid ha ki ain jong nga , lymne phim shym la pyndep ia ki jingbishar jong nga , hynrei phi la leh kat kum ka akor jong ki nongwei kiba don sawdong jong phi .

en: The king answered unto Daniel , and said , Of a truth it is , that your God is a God of gods , and a Lord of kings , and a revealer of secrets , seeing thou couldest reveal this secret .
kha: U syiem u la ong ,  U Blei jong me u long uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh , U Trai halor ki syiem , bad uta uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . Nga tip ïa kane namar me la lah ban batai ïa kane ka jingmaïan .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab ia u Daniel , bad u la ong , Na ka jingshisha ka long , ba U Blei jong phi u long U Blei jong ki blei , bad U Trai jong ki syiem bad u nongpynpaw ia ki jingmaham , haba me lah ban pynpaw ia kane ka jingmaham .

en: And I looked , and , behold , ye had sinned against the  Lord  your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the  Lord  had commanded you .
