kha: Nga la ïohi ba phi la lyndet ïa ka hukum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi , bad ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba phi thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ka durblei ba la saiñ ha ka dur u khun masi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, phi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad phi la pynlong ia phi u khun masi ba la khleh lang: phi la phai noh kloi na ka lynti kaba U Trai u la hukum ia phi .

en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes , even to Ben–hail , and to Obadiah , and to Zechariah , and to Nethaneel , and to Michaiah , to teach in the cities of Judah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u phah ïa kine ki rangbah synshar ban hikai ha ki nongbah ka Judah : u Benhail , u Obadaïah , u Sekharaïah , u Nethanel bad u Mikaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u u la phah sha ki rangbah jong u, wat sha u Benhail, bad sha u Obadaiah, bad ha u Sekharaiah, bad ha u Nethanel bad ha u Mikhaiah, ban hikai ha ki shnong Judah .

en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
kha: U Moses u la kohnguh bad u la shim
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh laiphew snem shaneng haduh sanphew snem , uwei pa uwei uba wan ban leh ia ka jingshakri bad ka jingshakri ia ka jingkit ha ka iingjain jong ka balang .

en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him , saying , And what shall we do ? And he said unto them , Do violence to no man , neither accuse any falsely  ; and be content with your wages .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki shipai ruh ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno ma ngi pat ? Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?  U la ong ha ki ,  Wat shim pisa nano nano da ka bor lane mudui lamler ïano ïano . To sngewhun ha la ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shipai ruh kumjuh ki la dawa ia u, ki da ong, Bad ngin leh aiu ? Bad u la ong ha ki, Wat leh donbor ia uno uno u briew, wat kynnoh ia uno uno u briew bad to sngewhun ia ka bainong jong phi.

en: I have not spoken in secret , in a dark place of the earth : I said not unto the seed of Jacob , Seek ye me in vain : I the  Lord  speak righteousness , I declare things that are right .
kha: Ngam shym la kren ha kaba rieh lane buhrieh ïa ka jingthmu jong nga . Ngam shym la dawa na u paid Israel ban khmih ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la iehnoh suda . Nga long U  Trai  , bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ; nga pynlong ban tip ïa kaei kaba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam shym la kren rieh, ha ka jaka kaba dum jong ka khyndew: Ngam shym la ong ha u symbai u Jakob: To wad ia nga khlem da pyrkhat: Nga U Trai nga kren ia ka hok , nga pynbna ia kiei kiei kiba dei .

en: For we would not , brethren , have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia , that we were pressed out of measure , above strength , insomuch that we despaired even of life :
kha: Ngi kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit , ïa kata ka jingjynjar kaba ngi la ïohmad ha ka probins    jong ka Asia . Ki jingkit ba la buh halor jong ngi ki la long kiba khraw bad kiba khia kat haduh ba ngi la duh jingkyrmen ban dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngin ym tip, ko para bangeit, ia ka jingjynjar jong ngi kaba la wan ha ngi ha Asia, ba ngi la shah pynkhih palat, palat ia ka bor, khlem da pyrkhat ba ngi la duh jingkyrmen wat ia ka jingim:

en: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you , that I have set before you life and death , blessing and cursing : therefore choose life , that both thou and thy seed may live :
kha: Nga ai ha phi mynta ban jied napdeng ka jingim bad ka jingïap , napdeng ka jingkyrkhu U Blei bad ka jingtim U Blei , bad nga khot ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ban sakhi ïano phi jied . Jied ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga khot ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew ban thoh ia kane ka sngi pyrshah ia phi, ba nga la buh ha khmat jong phi ia ka jingim bad ka jingiap, ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim: namarkata to jied ia ka jingim , ba ma me bad u symbai jong me kin im:

en: So Naomi returned , and Ruth the Moabitess , her daughter in law , with her , which returned out of the country of Moab : and they came to Beth–lehem in the beginning of barley harvest .
kha: Kumne keiñ , kumno ba ka Naomi ka wan phai pat na Moab lem bad ka Ruth , ka pyrsa kurim nong Moab . Ka dei hamar ba sdang ka por ot barli ba ki wan poi ha Bethlehem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka Naomi ka la wan phai, bad ka Ruth ka Moabitess, ka khun jong ka, bad ka, kaba la wan phai na ka ri Moab: bad ki la poi ha Bethlehem ha kaba sdang ka jingot barli .

en: Furthermore then we beseech you , brethren , and exhort you by the Lord Jesus , that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God , so ye would abound more and more .
kha: Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong ngi , phi la ïohnang na ngi kumno phi dei ban im khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei . Kane ka long da shisha , kumno phi la ju im . Bad mynta ngi kyrpad bad kyntu ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh kham bha shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh to sngewbha ia phi ko para bangeit bad to kyntu ia phi da U Trai Jisu, ba kumba phi la ioh na ngi kumno phi dei ban iaid bad ban pynsngewbha ia U Blei, kumta phin nang bun shuh shuh .

en: Come ye near unto me , hear ye this  ; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning  ; from the time that it was , there am I : and now the Lord  God  , and his Spirit , hath sent me .
kha: Mynta to wan sha jan jong nga bad sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong . Naduh mynnyngkong nga la kren da kaba shai , bad borabor nga la pynlong ba ki ktien jong nga kin wan urlong shisha .  ( Mynta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ai ha nga ïa ka bor jong u bad u la phah ïa nga . )
translated_en_to_kha: To wan hajan jong nga, to iohsngew ia kane; ngam shym la kren rieh naduh kaba sdang, hangta nga don: bad mynta U Trai Blei bad U Mynsiem jong u, u la phah ia nga .

en: And the  Lord  your God , he shall expel them from before you , and drive them from out of your sight  ; and ye shall possess their land , as the  Lord  your God hath promised unto you .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa ki ban kynriah na phi , bad un beh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ïoh ïa ka ri jong ki , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai U Blei jong phi un beh noh ia ki na khmat jong phi, bad un beh noh ia ki na ka khmat jong phi ; bad phin ioh ia ka ri jong ki kumba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kular ha phi .

en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews , exorcists , took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus , saying , We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Jiw kiba la leit kylleng sawdong ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman ki la pyrshang ruh ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh ïa kane . Ki la ong ha ki mynsiem bymman ,  Nga hukum ïa me ha ka kyrteng U Jisu , ïa uba u Paul u ïalap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta katto katne na ki Jiw kiba iaid kai, ki la shim ia ki ban khot ia ki kiba don ki mynsiem bymman ia ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu , da kaba ong , Ngi pynbeit ia phi da U Jisu uba u Paul u ialap .

en: Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
kha: Ka dei ka Ijipt , kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah ba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei bad ngan tyllep ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Ijipt ka kiew kum ka jingshlei um, bad ki um jong u ki khih kum ki wah ; bad u ong , Ngan kiew , bad ngan tap ia ka khyndew ; ngan pynjot ia ka shnong bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka .

en: And he put the wood in order , and cut the bullock in pieces , and laid him on the wood , and said , Fill four barrels with water , and pour it on the burnt sacrifice , and on the wood .
kha: Nangta u buh ïa ki diengthang halor ka duwan , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u masi dab bad buh halor ki diengthang . U ong ,  Pyndap saw tylli ki khiew da ka um bad theh ïa ka um halor ka jingkñia bad ki dieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia u dieng ha ka rukom kaba biang , bad u la ot ia u masi ha ki bynta , bad u la buh ia u ha u dieng , bad u la ong , Pyndap ia ka da ka um , bad theh ia ka ha ka jingknia thang bad ha u dieng .

en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them , that I will not turn away from them , to do them good  ; but I will put my fear in their hearts , that they shall not depart from me .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Ngan ym sangeh lano lano ruh ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki ban tiengburom ïa nga da ka dohnud jong ki baroh , khnang ba kin ym phai dien shuh na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan leh ia ka jutang bymjukut bad ki, ba ngan ym phai noh na ki, ban leh ia ki beg hynrei ngan buh ia ka jingtieng jong nga ha ki dohnud jong ki, ba kin ym leit noh na nga .

en: And they shall be coupled together beneath , and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring : thus shall it be for them both  ; they shall be for the two corners .
kha: Ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha ki dong dei ban pynïasoh lang naduh trai , baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . Dei ban thaw ïa kine ki jingker kiba ha dong baroh ar tylli ha kajuh ka rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin iasoh lang hapoh , bad kin iasoh lang halor ka khlieh jong ka ha kawei ka ryntieh: kumta kan long na ka bynta jong ki baroh arngut; kin long na ka bynta ki ar tylli ki tduh .

en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .
kha: Ki briew jong phi kin wan phai na kylleng — na Assyria kaba ha mihngi , na Ijipt ha ka phang shathie , na ki thain ka Ïuphratis , na ki duriaw ba sha jngai bad ki lumbah ba don sha jngai bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ruh un wan sha me na Assyria, bad na ki shnong ba la khang, bad na ka kut haduh ka wah, bad naduh ka duriaw haduh ka duriaw .

en: The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .
kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U  Trai  : U la rai pynshitom ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Damaskos . Ym tang ki jait Israel hynrei ka nongbah Syria ruh ka long ka jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ka ktien U Trai ha ka ri Hadrak bad ka Damekh kan long kaba sah: haba ki khmat u briew, kum ki jait Israel baroh, kin long sha U Trai .

en: And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee  ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another  ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .
kha: Kin pynjot thiaw ïa pha bad ïa ki briew kiba hapoh ki kynroh jong pha ; yn ym pynsah wat uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don , namar ba pham shym ithuh ïa ka por mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa pha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to thiah ia me wat bad ka khyndew, bad ki khun jong me hapoh jong me; bad kin ym iehnoh ha me uwei u maw halor uwei pat; namar ba me tip ia ka por jong ka jingleit jngoh jong me .

en: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .
kha: Nga la shem ïa kaei kaei kaba kham kthang ban ïa ka jingïap — ka kynthei kaba long kum ka jingriam . Ka jingieit ba ka ai ïa phi kan kem ïa phi kum ka jar , bad ki kti jong ka sawdong jong phi kin bat ïa phi kum u kynjri . U briew uba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei u lah ban lait , hynrei kan kem ïa u nongpop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga shem kham sngewsih ban ia ka jingiap ia ka kynthei, kaba ka dohnud jong ka ka long kaba jynjar bad kaba jem, bad ki kti jong ka kum ki band: uba U Blei u sngewbha un lait na ka ; hynrei u nongpop un shah shim noh da ka .

en: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me , and take it to thee . For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them .
kha: Hynrei lada phi shem ïa ki blei jong phi ha uno uno hangne , uta un shah pynïap . Hangne , lem bad ki briew jong ngi kum ki sakhi , peit ïa kano kano ka tiar kaba dei ka jong phi bad shim ïa kaba dei ka jong phi .  U Jakob um shym tip ba ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong u Laban .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba me shem ia ki blei jong me, wat ai ba un im: ha khmat ki hynmen jong ngi to sngewthuh ia kaei kaba don bad nga, bad to shim ia ka ha me . Namar u Jakob um tip ba u Rakhel u la tuh ia ki .

en: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea  ; and the  Lord  caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night , and made the sea dry land , and the waters were divided .
kha: U Moses u kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw , bad U  Trai  u kyndat ïa kata ka duriaw da ka lyer mihngi kaba jur . Kata ka lyer ka beh jur baroh shi miet bad ka pynlong dewryngkhiang ïa ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ka duriaw ; bad U Trai u la pynlong ia ka duriaw ban leit phai biang da ka Iyer mihngi kaba khlain baroh shi miet , bad u la pynlong ia ka duriaw kaba rkhiang baroh shi miet .

en: And no sin offering , whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten : it shall be burnt in the fire .
kha: Hynrei lada wanrah wat tang khyndiat na ka snam shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba lehniam ban ïohmap ïa ki pop , ïa u mrad ym dei ban bam ; dei ban thang lut khoit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym dei ban bam ia ka jingknia pop, na kata ka snam ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng ban pyniasuk bad ka jaka bakhuid: yn thang ia ka ha ka ding .

en: And they said , Go to , let us build us a city and a tower , whose top may reach unto heaven  ; and let us make us a name , lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth .
kha: Ki ïa-ong ,  Mynta to ngin ïatei kawei ka nongbah kaba don u mot uba kot haduh sahit bneng , ba kumta , ngin lah ban thaw nam ïa lade bad ym ban ïasakma ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: To leit sha , to ngin tei ia ngi ka shnong bad ka tower kaba ka tduh jong ka ka lah ban poi sha bneng ; bad to ngin pynlong kyrteng ia ngi , ioh ba ngin sa shah pynpra shabar ri ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: But I beseech you , that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence , wherewith I think to be bold against some , which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh .
kha: Da ka jingjemnud bad jingbha U Khrist , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban nym pynbor ïa nga ban long uba eh haba nga wan ; naba nga thikna ba nga lah ban leh da kaba eh ïa kito kiba ong ba ngi leh ïa kiei kiei na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga kyrpad ia phi , ba ngan ym long uba shlur haba nga don bad kata ka jingshaniah , ha kaba nga pyrkhat ban long uba shlur pyrshah ia ki katto katne , kiba pyrkhat ia ngi kumba ngi iaid katkum ka doh .

en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ , happy are ye  ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you : on their part he is evil spoken of , but on your part he is glorified .
kha: Suk ma phi haba phi shah krenbeiñ namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong U Khrist ; kane ka mut ba U Mynsiem ka burom , U Mynsiem jong U Blei , u don ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi shah pynjah burom na ka bynta ka kyrteng U Khrist , phi sngewbha; namar ka mynsiem ka burom bad U Blei ka shong ha phi: na ka liang jong ki la kren bein ia u , hynrei na ka liang jong phi la pyndonburom ia u .

en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .
kha: Nga la thoh sha phi da ka dohnud kaba sngewkhia bad sngewkhuslai ryngkat bad ki ummat kiba bun ; ka jingthmu jong nga kam shym long ban pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei ban pynsngewthuh ïa phi haduh katno nga ieit ïa phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na ka jingjynjar bad jingsngewsih kaba khraw nga la thoh sha phi da ki ummat kiba bun ym ba phin sngewsih , hynrei ba phin tip ia ka jingieit kaba nga kham bun ha phi .

en: They shall call the people unto the mountain  ; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness : for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas , and of treasures hid in the sand .
kha: Ki khot sngewbha ïa ki nongwei sha u lum jong ki , Bad hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh kiba biang . Ki ïohlum spah na duriaw , Bad na u shyiap harud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin khot ia ki briew sha u lum ; hangta kin ai ia ki jingknia jong ka hok: namar kin dih ia ka jingbun ki duriaw bad ki spah ba la buhrieh ha ka dewbilat .

en: As for the beauty of his ornament , he set it in majesty : but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein : therefore have I set it far from them .
kha: Shisien ki la ju sngewsarong ïa la ki mawlynnai ba-itynnat , hynrei ki la pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna ïa ki bleithaw kiba ijli . Dei na kata ka daw balei ba U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka spah jong ki ban kynriah noh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka jingitynnad jong ka jingpynitynnad jong u, u la buh ia ka ha ka jingkhraw: hynrei ki la shna ia ki dur jong ki bad jong kiei kiei kiba sngewsih jong ki hangta: namarkata nga la buh ia ka jngai na ki .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .
kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Pashhur u la pyllait ïa nga na ki kynjri , nga la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  um shym kyrteng ïa me u Pashhur . Ka kyrteng kaba u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u Pashur u la pynmih ia u Jeremaiah na ki dieng . Nangta u Jeremaiah u la ong ha u, U Trai um shym la khot ia ka kyrteng jong me Pashur, hynrei u Magormissabib .

en: And when the morning arose , then the angels hastened Lot , saying , Arise , take thy wife , and thy two daughters , which are here  ; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city .
kha: Dang step phyrngab , kita ki angel ki la pynkyrkieh ïa u Lot .  Pynkloi !  ki ong .  Ïalam ïa la ka tnga bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong me bad phet noh , ba men ym duh la ka jingim haba yn pynjot ïa kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la mih ka step, ki angel ki la kyrkieh ia u Lot, ki da ong: To khie, to shim ia ka tnga jong me bad ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong me kiba don hangne; ioh ba me shah pynjot ha ka jingbymhok jong ka nongbah .

en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
kha: Hangne ngi ïohi katno U Blei u long uba sbun bad katno u long uba eh . U long uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lada phi ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jong u . Hynrei lada phim leh kumta , ma phi ruh phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih namarkata ka jingbha bad ka jingkhlain jong U Blei: ha kito kiba la hap, ka jingkhlain hynrei ha me, ka jingbha, lada me iai bteng ha ka jingbha jong u: lym kumta me ruh yn ot noh ia me.

en: And when they had called to the king , there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder .
kha: Nangta ki phah wallam ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , bad ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ki leit ban ïakynduh ïa ki : u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah , uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem ; u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; bad u Joah u khun jong u Asaph , uba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la khot ia u syiem, u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah uba la long halor ka iing bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad u Joah u khun u Asaph u nongthoh .

en: There is no healing of thy bruise  ; thy wound is grievous : all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee : for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually ?
kha: Ym don jingpynkoit ei ei ïa ki jingmynsaw jong me , bad ïa ki jingmong jong me ym lah ban pynkoit . Baroh kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynjot ïa me ki thap ïa la ki kti ha ka jingkmen . Hato uno uno un lait phet na ka jinglong runar bymkut jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ka jingpynkhiah ia ka jingmynsaw jong me: baroh kiba iohsngew ia ka jingsma jong me kin ia tyngkhuh ia me: namar halor jong u ka jingsniew jong me kam shym la iaid beit ?

en: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought  ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .
kha: Wat wad daw ïa u syiem , wat ha kaba jar jar , bad wad daw ïa kiba riewspah , wat ha ka jingkyrpang ka kamra thiah jong phi . Ka sim ka lah ban rah ïa ka khubor bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba phi kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tim ia u syiem, ym ha ka jingpyrkhat jong me; bad wat tim ia kiba riewspah ha ka kamra thiah jong me: namar u sim jong ka Iyer un kit ia ka sur , bad uta uba don ki bniat un iathuh ia kata ka kam .

en: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity , and the water of affliction , yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more , but thine eyes shall see thy teachers :
kha: U Trai un pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid lyngba ki por ba-eh , hynrei ma u hi un don hangta ban hikai ïa phi , bad phin ym donkam ban wad shuh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la U Trai u ai ia phi ia u kpu jong ka jingjynjar, bad ka um jong ka jingjynjar, hynrei ki nonghikai jong me kin ym shah weng noh shuh ha ka kut, hynrei ki khmat jong me kin iohi ia ki nonghikai jong me:

en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhishua . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba kham rit ka Mikhal .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan bad u Ishui bad u Malchishua: bad ki kyrteng jong ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong u ki long kine; ka kyrteng jong u Merab ba nyngkong bad ka kyrteng jong u Michal uba kham rit:

en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?
kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbah jong pha ka long ka kut mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta phi ong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba lah ban pynhiar ïa nga sha tbian ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsarong jong ka dohnud jong me ka la shukor ia me, me uba shong ha ki thliew maw, uba ka jaka shong jong u ka long kaba jrong; uba ong ha ka dohnud jong u: Mano ba pynhiar ia nga shapoh khyndew ?

en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Nineve kin kiew ha ka jingbishar bad kane ka pateng: namar ki la kylla bamut ha ka jingialap jong u Jonah ; bad, ha khmih, uba kham khraw ban ia u Jonah u don hangne .

en: And he took all the gold and silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and hostages , and returned to Samaria .
kha: U shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kiba u lah ban ïoh , ki tiar ka templ baroh bad ki jingkynshew baroh jong ka ïingsyiem , bad u rah biang ïa ki sha Samaria . U rah ruh ïa ki koidi bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka ksiar bad ka rupa baroh bad ki tiar kiba la lap ha ka iing U Trai bad ha ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing syiem bad ki nongshah rahbor bad u la leit phai noh sha Samaria .

en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïeng joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka  nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wan jia mynba u Klaudius u la long u Patsha . )
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki u la ieng da u Mynsiem ba dei ban don ka jingduna kaba khraw ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei: kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Claudius Kaisar .

en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird , and with the running water , and with the living bird , and with the cedar wood , and with the hyssop , and with the scarlet :
kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing da ka snam jong kata ka sim , ka um sngur , ka sim kaba dang im , u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , u tnat Hissop , bad u  saiwul saw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pynkhuid ia ka iing da ka snam jong u sim, bad da ka um kaba tuid, bad da u sim uba im, bad da u dieng cedar bad da u dieng cedar bad da u dieng cedar:

en: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judaea , a certain priest named Zacharias , of the course of Abia : and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron , and her name was Elisabeth .
kha: Ha ka por mynba U Herod u long u syiem ka Judia , la don u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Sekharaïah , uba dei na ka pateng lyngdoh jong u Abijah . Ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u , ka long ka Elisabeth ; ma ka ruh ka la long na ka longïing lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi u Herod u syiem Judaea, uwei u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Sakhiaas: bad ka tnga jong u ka long na ki khun kynthei u Aaron bad ka kyrteng jong ka ka long ka Elisabeth .

en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .
kha: Hadien ka jingpule na ka Hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah synshar jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki :  Ko hynmen ko para , ngi kwah ïa phi ban kren ha u paidbah lada phi don ka khubor ai mynsiem na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien ka jingpule ia ka hukum bad ki nongiathuhlypa ki nongsynshar jong ka synagog ki la phah sha ki , ki ong , Phi ki briew bad ki para , lada phi don kano kano ka ktien ban kyntu ia ki briew , to kren .

en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .
kha: Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa nga , bad nga la long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba la dei ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shim ar tylli ki dieng : Ïa uwei nga la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad ïa uwei pat  U Jingtylli .  Bad nga la sumar ïa ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai bam ia ka kynhun jong ka jingpyniap, wat ia phi ruh, ko baduk jong ka kynhun . Bad nga la shim ha nga ar tylli ki dieng ia uta uba nga khot u Beauty , bad uwei pat nga la khot u Band ; bad nga la ai bam ia ka kynhun .

en: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth , and called thee from the chief men thereof , and said unto thee , Thou art my servant  ; I have chosen thee , and not cast thee away .
kha: Nga la wallam ïa me na kiba kut ka pyrthei ; nga la khot ïa me naduh ki pud bajngai bah jong ka bad nga la ong ha me ‘ me long u shakri jong nga ,’ ngam shym la kyntait ïa me , hynrei nga la jied ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Me uba nga la shim na ki kut jong ka khyndew bad nga la khot ia me na ki rangbah jong ka, bad nga la ong ha me: Me long u shakri jong nga; nga la jied ia me, bad ngam shym la bret noh ia me .

en: And he said unto them ,  Ye are they which justify yourselves before men  ; but God knoweth your hearts : for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God .
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phi long kita kiba pynlong ïa lade ban ibiang ha ka jingkhmih jong kiwei ki briew , hynrei U Blei u tip ïa ka dohnud jong phi . Naba kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la ñiewkordor shikatdei eh da u briew , ki long ki bymdondor ei ei ruh em ha ka jingkhmih U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki , Phi long kiba pynshisha ia lade ha khmat ki briew ; hynrei U Blei U tip ia ki dohnud jong phi: namar kata kaba la burom bha hapdeng ki briew ka long kaba sngewsih ha khmat U Blei .

en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .
kha: Sawdong ïa ka khet , la don arphew saw tylli kiwei pat ki khet , ha kaba la shong arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    kiba la riam da kaba lieh bad phong ki pansngiat ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sawdong ka khet ki don sawphew tylli ki jaka shong: bad halor ki jaka shong nga la iohi sawphew ngut ki rangbah kiba shong, kiba la phong da ki jain lieh ; bad ki don ha ka khlieh jong ki ki khlieh ksiar .

en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him .
kha: Ki mih na Babilonia ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai banyngkong , bad da ka jingïarap U Blei , ki poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai uba san .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai ba nyngkong u la sdang ban kiew na Babilon , bad ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai kaba phra u la poi ha Jerusalem kat kum ka kti babha jong U Blei jong u halor jong u .

en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem : for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king , and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :
kha: Katba kane ka dang long kumne , ngam shym la don ha Jerusalem , namar ha ka snem kaba laiphew ar ba u Artakserksis u long u syiem ka Babilon , nga la dei ban leit phai ban ai jingtip sha u . Hadien katto katne por , nga la ïoh jingbit
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kane ka por baroh ngam shym la don ha Jerusalem: namar ha ka snem kaba arphew snem jong u Artaxerxes u syiem Babilon nga la wan sha u syiem, bad hadien katto katne sngi nga la ioh ia ka jingbit na u syiem:

en: Blind , or broken , or maimed , or having a wen , or scurvy , or scabbed , ye shall not offer these unto the  Lord  , nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the  Lord .
kha: Wat kñia sha U  Trai  da uno uno u jingri uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la mong ka met , uba don prum , uba don  ñiangdait , lane uba sarew prum . Wat kñia kum ïa uta u jingri ha ka duwan kum ka jingainguh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhluit ne pynmong ia ki, ne kiba don ka Wen ne kaba la tyrkhong ne kaba la tyrkhong, phim dei ban aiti ia kine ha U Trai , lymne ban ai da ka jingknia da ka ding jong ki ha ka almari ha U Trai .

en: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever : and they have no rest day nor night , who worship the beast and his image , and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name .
kha: Ka tdem jong ka ding kaba pynsaja ïa ki ka kiew shajrong junom la junom . Ym don jingtngen mynsngi ne mynmiet ïa kito kiba mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u , ïa uno uno uba don ïa ka shab jong ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tdem jong ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki ka kiew junom: bad kim don jingjahthait sngi ne miet , kiba mane ia u mrad bad ka dur jong u , bad uno uno uba pdiang ia ka dak jong ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .
kha: Te , lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang , ka mut ba ka la wan pur biang , bad u trai u dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka paw ha ka jain, la ka long ha ka sniehdoh ne ha ka sniehdoh, ne ha kano kano ka jinglong sniehdoh ; ka long ka khlam kaba saphriang: me dei ban thang ia kata ha kaba ka khlam ka don da ka ding .

en: And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la beh noh ïa baroh kito kiba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ sbai bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba die paro ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka tempi U Blei bad u la bret noh ia kita baroh kiba die bad thied ha ka tempi bad u la pynkhih ia ki miej jong ki nongkylla pisa bad ki jaka shong jong kita kiba die ia ki paro .

en: And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .
kha: Hadien kata U Jisu u leit bam ha ka ïing u Lebi . Don bun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait na ka imlang ka sahlang kiba ïabud ïa U Jisu , bad bun na ki , ki la ïadon bynta bad u lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba, katba U Jisu u dang shong ha ka jingbam ha iing jong u, bun ki nongleh kam sniew bad ki nongpop ruh ki la shong lang bad U Jisu bad ki synran jong u: namar ki la don bun bad ki la bud ia u .

en: But I have all , and abound : I am full , having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you , an odour of a sweet smell , a sacrifice acceptable , wellpleasing to God .
kha: Hangne , te , ka long ka jingïohpdiang jong nga ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi la ai ha nga — bad ka la long palat ban ïa kaba nga donkam! Nga don ïa baroh kaba nga donkam mynta ha kaba u Epaphroditos u la wanrah sha nga ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh jong phi . Ki long kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih sha U Blei , ka jingkñia kaba pdiang hun bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga don lut, bad nga dap: Nga la pdiang na u Epaphroditus ia kiei kiei kiba la phah na phi, ka jingsma jong ka jingsma kaba thiang, ka jingknia kaba pdiang sngewbha ia U Blei .

en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold , whose height was threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof six cubits : he set it up in the plain of Dura , in the province of Babylon .
kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah thaw ka durbriew ksiar , arphew hynñiew mitar ka kynjang bad jan lai mitar ka pyngkiang , bad u la phah pynïeng ïa ka ha ka pyntha Dura ha ka probins    jong ka Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Neuchadnezzar u syiem u la shna ia ka dur ksiar, kaba ka jingjrong jong ka ka long hynriewphew cubit: u la buh ia ka ha ka madan Dura, ha ka ri Babilon .

en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker , and buildeth temples  ; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities : but I will send a fire upon his cities , and it shall devour the palaces thereof .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la tei ïa ki ïingsyiem , hynrei ki la klet ïa la U Nongthaw . Ki paid Judah ki la tei ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh . Hynrei ngan phah da ka ding ka ban thang duh ïa ki ïingsyiem bad ki nongbah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki Israel ki la klet noh ia u Nongshna jong u, bad ki tei ia ki iing mane blei bad u Judah u la pynbun ia ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong: hynrei ngan phah ding ia ki nongbah jong u, bad kan bam ia ki iing jong ka .

en: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria , and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt , and the Egyptian into Assyria , and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , kan don ka surok bah hapdeng ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria . Ki briew jong kito ki ar tylli ki ri kin ïaleit ïawan hapdeng jong ki , bad ki ar tylli ki ri kin ïamane lang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi kan don ka lynti kaba heh na Ijipt sha Assyria , bad ka Assyria kan wan sha Ijipt bad ka Ijipt sha Assyria , bad ki nong Ijipt kin shakri bad ki nong Assyria .

en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee , the fir tree , the pine tree , and the box together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary  ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .
kha: Ïa ki dieng jong u dieng Kseh , u dieng Kseh-Juniper , bad u dieng Kseh-Sypress , ki dieng kiba kynsai tam jong ka khlaw Lebanon yn wallam ban tei biang ïa pha , ko Jerusalem , ban pynitynnat ïa ka Templ jong nga , ban pyndonburom ïa ka nongbah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka burom jong u Lebanon kan wan ha me, u dieng sohjew, u dieng pine bad ka synduk ryngkat, ban pynitynnad ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka jaka jong ki kjat jong nga kaba donburom .

en: If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .
kha: Ha man ba i ong , ‘ Ki blang kiba thohbria kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ Kita kiba thohshuid kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ kata ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohshuid suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u ong kumta , Ka jingsiew jong me kan long kumta baroh ki masi ki la tyrkhong: bad lada u ong kumta: Ka ring ka long ka bainong jong me; te ka ring ia ki masi baroh ki la tyrkhong .

en: For she had said unto the servant , What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us ? And the servant had said , It is my master : therefore she took a veil , and covered herself .
kha: bad ka kylli ïa u shakri jong u Abraham ,  Uei utai u briew uba ïaid ha pyntha sha pyrshah jong ngi ?   U dei u kynrad jong nga ,  la jubab uta u shakri . Kumta ka shim ïa la ka jaiñsop ryndang bad ka la tap ïa la ka khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la ong ha uta u shakri, Uei une u briew uba iaid ha lyngkha ban iakynduh ia ngi ? Bad uta u shakri u la ong: Ka long ka kynrad jong nga: namarkata ka la shim ia ka jingtap bad ka la tap ia lade .

en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .
kha: Ngan khmih halor jong ki bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym tar lyngkhot ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki bad ngan ym rat ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan buh ia ki khmat jong nga ha ki na ka bynta ka jingbha, bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki sha kane ka ri: bad ngan tei ia ki, bad ngan ym tan ia ki ; bad ngan thung ia ki, bad ngan ym kheit ia ki .

en: And when they had told David , saying , Uriah went not down unto his house , David said unto Uriah , Camest thou not from thy journey ? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house ?
kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohsngew ba u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing , u la kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang shu wan phai hadien ka jingleit kaba jlan ; balei phi khlem leit sha ïing ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iathuh ha u Dabid, ki da ong, U Uriam um shym la leit sha la iing , u Dabid u la ong ha u Uriam , Hato me leit noh na ka jingleit jong me ? balei te me leit hiar sha la iing ?

en: And they shall keep thy charge , and the charge of all the tabernacle : only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar , that neither they , nor ye also , die .
kha: Ki dei ban pynbiang ïa ki kamram jong ki sha me bad ïa la ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei kim bit ban pyndei ïa ki tiar kiba khuid ha ka Jaka Kyntang , lane ïa ka duwan . Lada ki leh kumta , ïa ki bad ïa me yn pynïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin sumar ia ka jingsiew jong me, bad ka jingsiew jong ka iingmane baroh: tang ba kin ym wan hajan ki tiar jong ka jaka kyntang bad ka jaka bam, ba ma ki ruh kin ym iap .

en: Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .
kha: Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon u la pynlong u lat jong kata ka jaka . Kumta ki la leit noh sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin lait na ki nong Babilonia . Ha lynti , ki la sangeh ha Shimham , kaba hajan Bethlehem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki Khaldes: namar ki la tieng ia ki, namar u Ishmael u khun u Nethaniah u la pyniap ia u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam ia uba u syiem Babilon u la pynlong Lat ha ka ri .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain , vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold . And the  Lord  set a mark upon Cain , lest any finding him should kill him .
kha: Te U  Trai  u jubab ,  Em . Lada uno uno ruh u pynïap ïa me , yn sa pynïap hynñiew ki mynsiem ha ka jingpynhiarkput .  Kumta U  Trai  u buh ka dak ha u Kain ban maham ïano ïano ba ïashem ïa u ban ym pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u , Namarkata uno uno uba pyniap ia u Kain, yn shim ia ka jingsiew kylliang ha u hynriew shah . Bad U Trai u la buh ia ka dak halor u Kain , na ka bynta ba uno uno uba lap ia u un pyniap ia u .

en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one spake saying after this manner , and another saying after that manner .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli , ‘ Mano ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’ Katto katne ki angel ki ong ïa kawei , bad kiwei pat ki ong ïa kawei pat ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Mano ba pynsngewsih ia u Ahab u syiem Israel, ba un leit sha Ramothgilead ? Bad uwei u la kren da kaba ong kumne bad uwei pat da kaba ong kumta .

en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;
kha: Kane ka long ka dur kaba kdew sha ka por kaba mynta . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei kim lah satia ban pynjanai ïa ka dohnud jong uta uba mane ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la long ka dur na ka bynta ka por kaba la don ha kata ka por, ha kaba la tyrwa ia ki jingai sngewbha bad ki jingknia , kata kam lah ban pynlong ia u uba la leh ia ka jingshakri kaba janai , kumba ka iadei bad ka jingsngewsih ; .

en: Then arose Peter , and ran unto the sepulchre  ; and stooping down , he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves , and departed , wondering in himself at that which was come to pass .
kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ïeng joit bad u la mareh sha ka jingtep ; u la dem shapoh bad u la ïohi ïa ki jingsop linen hynrei ym kano kano kawei pat . Nangta u la leit phai pat sha ïing da ka jinglyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ieng, bad u la mareh sha ka jingtep ; bad u la dem khrup, u la iohi ia ki jain lin ba la buh da ki hi, bad u la leit noh, da kaba lyngngoh ha lade ia kata kaba la jia .

en: Now when the congregation was broken up , many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas : who , speaking to them , persuaded them to continue in the grace of God .
kha: Hadien ba ki paidbah ki la mihnoh na ka jingïalang , ïa u Paul bad u Barnabas la bud da kiba bun ki Jiw bad da kiba bun ki Jentil kiba la kylla sha ka niam ki Jiw . Ki apostol ki la kren ha ki bad ki la pynshlur ïa ki ban ïai im ha ka jingaiei jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ka balang ka la bthei , bun na ki Jiw bad ki nongwan niam ki la bud ia u Paul bad u Barnabas: kiba haba kren ia ki ki la pynsngewthuh ia ki ban iai bteng ha ka jingaiei U Blei .

en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi leit lyngba ki duriaw bad phi ïaid sha kylleng ki ri baroh ban pynkylla ïano ïano ; bad haba phi lah , phi pynlong ïa u ar shah uba dei ban leit sha dujok kumba phi hi , phi long !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi iaid lait ia ka duriaw bad ka khyndew ban pynlong ia uwei u nongkyrshan , bad ynda la pynlong ia u , phi pynlong ia u ar shah ia u khun dujok ban ia lade .

en: The sun shall be no more thy light by day  ; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee : but the  Lord  shall be unto thee an everlasting light , and thy God thy glory .
kha: Ka sngi kan ym long shuh ka jingshai jong pha mynsngi , lymne u bnai un long ka jingshai jong pha mynmiet , ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha ; ka jingshai jong ka burom jong nga kan tyngshaiñ ha pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sngi kan ym long shuh ka jingshai jong me ha ka sngi ; bad na ka bynta ka jingshai u bnai un ym pynshai ia me: hynrei U Trai un long ha me ka jingshai bymjukut, bad U Blei jong me ka burom jong me .

en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , Jehu departed not from after them , to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth–el , and that were in Dan .
kha: Hynrei u pyrthuh bud ïa ka pop jong u syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ha kaba mane ïa ki khun masi ksiar kiba u la pynïeng ha Bethel bad ha Dan .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la na ki pop jong u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat , u Jehu um shym la leit noh hadien jong ki, ban leit noh ia ki khun masi ksiar kiba don ha Betel bad kiba don ha Dan .

en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria : they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ka Israel kan long kaba khlem jingïada , bad ka Damaskos kan duh noh ïa ka jinglaitluid jong ka . Kito ki nong Syria kiba lait im kin don ha ka jinglehrain kum ki briew jong ka Israel . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kut ruh kan sangeh noh na Ephraim , bad ka hima na Damaskos bad ka jingsah jong ka Syria: kin long kum ka burom jong ki khun Israel , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And ye murmured in your tents , and said , Because the  Lord  hated us , he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to destroy us .
kha: Phi la ïakren khñium para ma phi : ‘ U  Trai  u isih ïa ngi . U la wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt tang ban aiti ïa ngi ha kine ki Amor , ba kin ïoh pynïap ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la ia sngap jar ha ki ïingjaiñ jong phi bad phi la ong: Namar ba U Trai u la shun ïa ngi, u la pynmih noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt, ban aiti ïa ngi sha ka kti jong ki Amorites, ban pynjot ïa ngi .

en: For I tell you , that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ba bun ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki syiem ki la kwah ban ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi , bad ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew , hynrei kim shym la ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong ia phi ba bun ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki syiem ki la kwah ban iohi ia kiei kiei kiba phi iohi, bad kim shym la iohi ia ki ; bad ban iohsngew ia kiei kiei kiba phi iohsngew , bad kim shym la iohsngew ia ki .

en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant ? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight , that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me ?
kha: bad u la ong ha U  Trai  ,  Balei keiñ ba me la pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ? Balei ba mem sngewbha ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kine ki paidbah baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Trai , Balei me la pynshitom ia u shakri jong me ? bad balei ngam shym la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me baroh ba me buh ia ka jingkit jong kine ki briew ha nga ?

en: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whose heart the  Lord  had put wisdom , even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it :
kha: U Moses u la khot ïa u Besalel , ïa u Oholiab , bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba tbit ha kiba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka jingnang bad kiba kloi mon sngewbha ban ïarap , bad u ong ïa ki ban sdang trei noh ïa kata ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia u Beatael bad u Ahliab bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba stad, ha ka dohnud jong u U Trai u la buh jingstad, wat uwei pa uwei uba ka dohnud jong u ka la pynkhih ia u ban wan sha ka kam ban leh ia kata:

en: So David and his men went to Keilah , and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their cattle , and smote them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .
kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ; ki la pynïap bun ngut na ki bad ki la shim ïa ki jingri jong ki . Bad ka la long kumta ba u Dabid u la pyllait im ïa kata ka shnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki Philistia bad ki la rah noh ia ki masi jong ki bad ki la pyniap ia ki da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw . Kumta u Dabid u la pynim ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah .

en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la leh ïa ka Samaria , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynjrong ia ka Jerusalem ia u lain jong ka Samaria, bad ia ka plum jong ka iing u Ahab: bad ngan sait ia ka Jerusalem kumba u briew u sait ia ka pliang, da kaba sait ia ka, bad pynphai ia ka shapoh .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria , and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael , all their days .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u bitar ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria bad u khun jong u , u Benhadad ban jop ïa ki Israel na ka por sha ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki Israel bad u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti u Hazael u syiem Syria bad ha ka kti u Benhadad u khun u Hazael baroh ki sngi jong ki .

en: Son of man , they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak , saying , Abraham was one , and he inherited the land : but we are many  ; the land is given us for inheritance .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong  Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot jong ka ri Israel ki ong : ‘ U Abraham u long tang uwei u briew , bad u la ïoh ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ngi ïadon bun ngut , kumta mynta ka ri ka dei ka jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , kita kiba shong ha kita ki jaboh jong ka ri Israel ki kren , ki ong , U Abraham u la long uwei , bad u la hiar pateng ia ka ri: hynrei ngi long kiba bun; ia ka ri la ai ha ngi kum ka pateng .

en: I have raised him up in righteousness , and I will direct all his ways : he shall build my city , and he shall let go my captives , not for price nor reward , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Nga da lade hi nga la pynkhih ïa u Syros ban leh ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong nga bad buh beit ïa kiei kiei . Ngan pynbeit ïa ka lynti baroh ba u leit . Un tei biang ïa ka nongbah jong nga , ka Jerusalem , bad un pyllait ïa ki briew ba shah set byndi jong nga . Ym don ba la shim wai ïa u ne ba la pynbam klop ïa u ban leh ïa kane .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynmih ia u ha ka hok , bad ngan pynbeit ia ki lynti jong u baroh: un tei ia ka shnong jong nga , bad un pyllait noh ia ki mraw jong nga , ym na ka bynta ka dor ne ka bainong , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
kha: Ïa u Lum Sinai baroh uwei la tap da ka tdem , namar U  Trai  u la wan hiar ha u ha ka ding . Ka tdem ka kiew kum kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew baroh ki la kyiuh shibun eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lum Sinai u la long baroh kawei ha ka tdem, namar U Trai u la hiar halor jong ka ha ka ding: bad ka tdem jong ka ka la kiew kum ka tdem jong ka ding , bad ka lum baroh kawei ka la khih shibun .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , against this family do I devise an evil , from which ye shall not remove your necks  ; neither shall ye go haughtily : for this time is evil .
kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga dang thmu ban wallam ïa ka jingjot ha phi , bad phin ym lah ban lait na ka . Phin sa shem ïa lade ha ka jingeh , bad nangta phin ym ïaid sngewsarong shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih, pyrshah ia kane ka longiing nga thmu ia ka jingsniew, na kaba phin ym weng noh ia ki ryndang jong phi ; bad phin ym leit sha ka jaka kaba jrong: namar kane ka por ka long kaba sniew .

en: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , baroh ki nongwei kiba tur ïaleh ïa pha kin shah beh noh kum ïa u pui pui , bad ki kynhun shipai bashyrkhei jong ki kin her kum u phlangïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka jingbun jong ki nongwei jong me kan long kum ka dewmet kaba rit, bad ka jingbun jong kiba shyrkhei kan long kum ka dewbilat kaba jah noh: Hooid, kan long ha ka khyndiat kynsan kynsan .

en: And that which fell among thorns are they , which , when they have heard , go forth , and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life , and bring no fruit to perfection .
kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ; hynrei ki jingkhuslai bad ka spah bad ki jingsngewbha jong kane ka jingim ki ïatyllep bad kjap ïa ki , bad ki soh jong ki kim ju ih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata kaba la hap hapdeng ki thliew ki long ma ki, kiba haba ki la iohsngew, ki leit noh bad ki shah rong noh ha ki jingkhuslai bad ki spah bad ki jingsngewbha jong kane ka jingim , bad kim wanrah soh ei ei sha ka jinglong janai .

en: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing  ; and he called his servants , and said unto them , Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel ?
kha: U syiem Syria u khuslai jingmut shibun shaphang kane ; u la khot ïa la ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Uno napdeng jong phi uba long ha ka liang jong u syiem ka Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka dohnud u syiem Syria ka la sngewsih namar kane ka kam ; bad u la khot ia ki shakri jong u bad u la ong ha ki: Hato phin ym pyni ia nga mano na ngi na ka bynta u syiem Israel ?

en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .
kha: Mynba me la sdang ban ïasaid bad U Blei , u la jubab ïa me . U ieit ïa me , bad kumta nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka jubab ha me . Mynta to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ki jingkyrpad jong me ka hukum ka la mih , bad nga wan ban pyni ia me ; namar me la ieit shibun: namarkata sngewthuh ia ka kam , bad pyrkhat ia ka jingphohsniew .

en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee , until thou have destroyed them .
kha: Un aiti ha phi ïa ki syiem jong ki . Phin pynïap ïa ki , bad yn klet noh ïa ki . Yn ym don mano mano ban khang ïa phi ; phin pynjot ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti ia ki syiem jong ki ha ka kti jong me, bad me pynjot ia ka kyrteng jong ki na shapoh bneng: ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban ieng ha khmat jong me, haduh ba me la pynjot ia ki .

en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Sephanaïah ha ka por ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Ammon u long u syiem ka Judah . ( U Sephanaïah u la hiarpateng na u syiem Hesekaïah lyngba u Amaraïah , u Gedalaïah , bad u Kushi . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Sephaniah u khun u Gedaliah u khun u Amariah u khun u Hesiah ha ki sngi u Josiah u khun u Amon u syiem Judah .

en: And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;
kha: Lada ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin phai pat sha U  Trai  , bad kohnguh da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki hukum jong u kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to wan phai sha U Trai U Blei jong me, bad to kohnguh ia ka sur jong u katba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi, ma me bad ki khun jong me, da ka dohnud jong me baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh;

en: That thou mayest remember , and be confounded , and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame , when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan map ïa ki jingbakla baroh kiba pha la leh , hynrei phan kynmaw ïa ki bad sngewlehrain palat ban ang ïa la ka shyntur .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban kynmaw , bad ban sngewlehrain , bad wat ju plie ia ka shyntur jong me namar ka jingsngewlehrain jong me, haba nga sngewsih ia me na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba me la leh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia , but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad ; so that we need not to speak any thing .
kha: Naba ym dei tang ba ka khubor shaphang U Trai ka la mih na phi sha kylleng ka Makedonia bad Akhaïa , hynrei ka khubor shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Blei ka la par kylleng . Ym don shuh kano kano te ba ngi donkam ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar na phi la pynmih ia ka ktien U Trai ym tang ha Makedonia bad Akhia , hynrei ha man la ki jaka ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Blei ka la saphriang shabar ri; kumta ngim donkam ban kren ei ei .

en: Now therefore , let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the  Lord  : for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea , as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains .
kha: Wai ai ba ngan shah pynïap ha ka ri nongwei , jngai na U  Trai . Balei u syiem Israel un wan ban pynïap ïa u thyllah kum ïa nga ? Balei un beh ïa nga kumba beh ïa ka sim khlaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata, wat ai ba ka snam jong nga kan hap ha ka khyndew ha khmat U Trai: namar u syiem Israel u mih ban wad ia u khnai, kumba u briew u leit khwai ia u khnai ha ki lum .

en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death  ; and was not found , because God had translated him : for before his translation he had this testimony , that he pleased God .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba ïada ïa u Enokh na ka jingïap . Pynban , la rah ïa u sha U Blei , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban shem ïa u , namar U Blei u la rah ïa u shajrong . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ba shuwa ban rah ïa u Enokh shajrong , u la pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit la pynkylla ia u Enokh ba um dei ban iohi ia ka jingiap ; bad ym shym la lap ia u, namar U Blei u la pynkylla ia u: namar shuwa ka jingpynkylla jong u u la don ia kane ka jingphla, ba u la pynsngewbha ia U Blei .

en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .
kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah bad u la ïai kren haduh shiteng synñia , namar ba un sa mihnoh ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taiew, haba ki synran ki la iawan lang ban bam kpu , u Paul u la ialap ha ki , u la pynkhreh ban leit noh ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong; bad u la bteng ia ka jingkren jong u haduh shiteng miet .

en: And arms shall stand on his part , and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength , and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate .
kha: Katto katne na ki shipai jong u kin pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Kin pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi bad kin pynïeng ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kti kin ieng na ka liang jong u , bad kin pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang jong ka bor , bad kin weng noh ia ka jingknia kaba man ka sngi , bad kin buh ia ka jinglehrain kaba pynlong ia ka jingjot .

en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .
kha: hynrei ïa ka jingtim , lada phi leh lyndet ïa kine ki hukum bad phai noh ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ïa kiba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtim lada phin ym kohnguh ia ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi , hynrei phin phai noh na ka lynti kaba nga hukum ia phi mynta ka sngi , ban leit bud ia kiwei pat ki blei kiba phim pat tip .

en: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field , and his boughs were multiplied , and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters , when he shot forth .
kha: Namar ba la ai um pahuh , u san kham shajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki dieng ki tnat jong u ki rben bad ki jrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jingjrong jong u ka la kiew halor ki dieng baroh jong ka lyngkha , bad ki tnat jong u ki la nang bun , bad ki tnat jong u ki la nang jrong namar ka jingbun ki um , haba u la mih sha jrong .

en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks , and into the caves of the earth , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
kha: Ki briew kin rieh ha ki krem ha mawsiang lum lane tih thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong U  Trai  bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u , haba u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin leit shapoh ki thliew maw bad shapoh ki krem jong ka khyndew , namar ka jingtieng ia U Trai bad na ka bynta ka burom jong ka jingkhraw jong u , haba u la mih ban pynkhih shibun ia ka khyndew .

en: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead  ; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .
kha: Ym don mano mano ban bam lane dih badno badno ban pyntngen ïa u mynba iba ieit bathoiñ i ïap . Ym don mano mano ban pyn-i jingsngewlem , wat ïa uta uba la duh noh ïa la u kpa lane ïa ka kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew ruh kin ym iam na ka bynta jong ki ha ka jingsngewsih, ban pyntngen ia ki na ka bynta kiba iap; bad ki briew kin ym ai ia ki ia ka khuri pyntngen ban dih na ka bynta u kpa jong ki ne na ka bynta ka kmie jong ki .

en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .
kha: Khlemlait lada u briew , daym pynbor ban leh kumta , u la kut jingmut skhem ban ym shongkurim , bad lada ïa la ka mon u lah ban synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut jong u ïa kaei kaba un leh — te u leh ïa kaba dei ban ym shongkurim kata ka theisotti .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh uta uba ieng skhem ha ka dohnud jong u, u bym don jingdonkam, hynrei u don ka bor halor la ka jong ka mon , bad u la kut jingmut ha ka dohnud jong u ba un sumar ia ka khunlung jong u , u leh bha .

en: And all the king s servants , that were in the king s gate , bowed , and reverenced Haman : for the king had so commanded concerning him . But Mordecai bowed not , nor did him reverence .
kha: U syiem u la hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ha ka jingtreikam ban pynpaw ïa ka jingburom ïa u Haman da kaba dem khohsiew bad nguh ïa u . Baroh ki la leh kumta , lait noh tang u Mordekai , uba la kyntait ban leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shakri syiem baroh kiba don ha ka khyrdop syiem ki la dem khrup bad ki la pynphai biang ia u Haman: namar u syiem u la hukum ia u kumta . Hynrei u Mordecai um shym la dem khrup, lymne u la leh burom ia u .

en: And it came to pass , that after we were gotten from them , and had launched , we came with a straight course unto Coos , and the day following unto Rhodes , and from thence unto Patara :
kha: Ngi la khublei ïakhlad ïa ki bad ngi la leit noh . Hadien ba ngi la leit da ka lieng sha shiliang , ngi la wan poi ha Kos ; ha ka ngi kaba bud , ngi la poi ha Rhodes , bad nangta ngi la leit sha Patara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba hadien ba ngi la ioh na ki, bad ngi la leit noh, ngi la wan ryngkat bad ka lynti kaba beit sha Coos, bad ka sngi kaba bud sha Rhodes, bad nangta sha Patara:

en: Then I will set my face against that man , and against his family , and will cut him off , and all that go a whoring after him , to commit whoredom with Molech , from among their people .
kha: nga hi ngan phai pyrshah ïa uta u briew bad ïa ka ïing jong u baroh bad ïa kito baroh kiba ïadon kti bad u ha kaba leh lyndet ïa nga bad ha kaba mane ïa u Molekh . Ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa ki ba ki dei ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan buh ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia uta u briew bad pyrshah ia ka iing jong u, bad ngan ot noh ia u, bad ia baroh kiba leit shongkurim hadien jong u, ban leh ia ka kam runar bad u Molek, na ki briew jong ki .

en: And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .
kha: U Joab u la leit , bad ka kylli ,  Phi dei u Joab ?   Ho-oid , nga dei ,  u jubab .  Kynrad , sngap ïa nga ,  ka ong .  Nga sngap keiñ ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan hajan jong ka, kata ka kynthei ka la ong, Hato me Joab ? Bad u la jubab , Nga long ma nga . Nangta ka la ong ha u: To sngap ia ki ktien jong u nongtrei jong me . Bad u la jubab , Nga iohsngew .

en: And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )
kha: Hynrei u ong shuh shuh ,  Shah ngan pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa uwei na phi un ai noh ha nga ïa ki sohshkor ba phi la shim .  ( Ki Midian kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la ong ha ki, Nga kwah ia ka jingkyrpad jong phi, ba phin ai ia nga uwei pa uwei ia ki shkor jong u mrad jong u . (Namar ki don ki shkor ksiar , namar ki long ki Issakhel).

en: And it shall be , if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten , that the judge shall cause him to lie down , and to be beaten before his face , according to his fault , by a certain number .
kha: Lada la rai ban sympat ïa uta uba la leh palat , u nongbishar un pyndem pyllup ïa u ha madan bad un phah sympat ïa u . Ka jingsympat kan long kat kum ka kam palat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long lada u briew uba sniew u dei hok ban shah shoh , ba u nongbishar un pynlong ia u ban thiah bad ban shah shoh ha khmat jong u kat kum ka jingbakla jong u .

en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee  ; and thou hast well done that thou art come . Now therefore are we all here present before God , to hear all things that are commanded thee of God .
kha: Bad kumta shisyndon nga la phah khot ïa me , me ruh me la long uba sbun eh ban wan . Mynta ngi baroh ngi don hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , da kaba ap ban ïohsngew ïa kano kano kaba U Trai u la bthah ïa me ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Mar kumta hi nga la phah sha me; bad me la leh bha ba me wan . Mynta ngi baroh ngi don hangne ha khmat U Blei , ban iohsngew ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la hukum ia me na U Blei .

en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?
kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kleopas , u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long tang ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha kine ki khyndiat sngi ba la leit ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta na ki uba kyrteng u Cleopas u la jubab ia u: Hato me long tang u nongwei ha Jerusalem bad phim tip ia kiei kiei kiba jia hangta ha kine ki sngi ?

en: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children , in that he hath raised up Jesus again  ; as it is also written in the second psalm , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee .
kha: Bad ngi don hangne ban wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha sha phi : Ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ba un leh , u la pyndep mynta na ka bynta jong ngi , kiba long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , da kaba pynmihpat ïa U Jisu . Kumba la thoh ha ka Salm kaba ar :   ‘ Me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la pyndep ia kajuh ha ngi ki khun jong ki, ha kaba u la pynmih biang ia U Jisu kumba la thoh ruh ha ka Salm kaba ar: Me long U Khun jong nga, ha kane ka sngi nga la kha ia me .

en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
kha: Wat mih shabar ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh phi ïap , namar la pynkyntang ïa phi da ka umphniang pynsleh jong U  Trai .  Kumta ki la leh kumba u Moses u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym mih na ka jingkhang jong ka iingmane jong ka jingiaseng: namar ka umphniang ba pynsleh jong U Trai ka don halor jong phi . Bad ki la leh kat kum ka ktien u Moses .

en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta men sa ïohi aïu ngan leh ïa u Pharaoh . Ngan pynbor ïa u ban shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit . Ha ka jingshisha , ngan pynbor ïa u ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Mynta men sa iohi ia kaei kaba ngan leh ia u Pharaoh: namar da ka kti kaba khlain un pyllait noh ia ki bad da ka kti kaba khlain un beh noh ia ki na ka ri jong u .

en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .
kha: Ki jingbishar jong u ki long kiba shisha bad kiba hok ! U la pynrem ïa ka nuti kaba pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jong ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki jingbishar jong u kiba shisha bad kiba hok: namar u la bishar ia ka nongkhaii kaba khraw , kaba la pynsniew ia ka khyndew da ka jingleh be-ijot jong ka , bad u la pynshitom ia ka snam jong ki shakri jong u ha ka kti jong ka .

en: And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Hangne u long uta u briew uba U  Trai  u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jong ngi .  Baroh u paidbah u risa ,  To un im slem u syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha ki briew baroh: Phi iohi ia uta uba U Trai u la jied, ba ym don kum ma u hapdeng ki briew baroh ? Ki briew baroh ki la pyrta bad ki la ong: U Blei u pynim ia u syiem .

en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .
kha: U  Trai  u don ïa uta uba khlaiñ bad badonbor uba la kloi ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban wan kum u phria bajur , kum u  lapbah , kum ka jingshlei um bakhlaiñbor , bad kan tap lup ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Trai u don ka eriong kaba khlain bad kaba khlain , kaba kum ka eriong kaba pynjot , kum ka jingshlei um kaba khlain kaba tuid shapoh ka khyndew da ka kti .

en: Then Esther the queen answered and said , If I have found favour in thy sight , O king , and if it please the king , let my life be given me at my petition , and my people at my request :
kha: Ka Esther , ka mahadei ka jubab ,  Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , ban ai ïa ka jingkyrpad barit jong nga , ka jingkwah jong nga ka long ba ngan lah ban im bad ba ki briew jong nga ruh kin im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka mahadei ka la jubab bad ka la ong: Lada nga la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me ko syiem bad lada ka sngewbha ia u syiem , to ai ba ka jingim jong nga kan long ha ka jingkyrpad jong nga, bad ki briew jong nga ha ka jingkyrpad jong nga:

en: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kut jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jia ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki met jong ki yn patan noh da ki ksew ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bam ïa kaei kaba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh halor jong ki saw jait, ong U Trai: ka waitlam ban pyniap , bad ki kulai ban pynpra , bad ki sim bneng bad ki mrad khlaw jong ka khyndew , ban bam bad pynjot .

en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the corn which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh s house .
kha: Katba ki nang thied kew , u Joseph u lumlang ïa ka pisa bad u leit ai ïa ki sha ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la lum lut ia ka pisa kaba la lap ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka ri Kanaan: bad u Joseph u la wanrah ia ka pisa sha ka iing u Pharaoh .

en: The sword is without , and the pestilence and the famine within : he that is in the field shall die with the sword  ; and he that is in the city , famine and pestilence shall devour him .
kha: Ka don ka jingïashoh ha ki lynti ïaid , bad ka jingpang bad ka jingthngan hapoh ki ïing . Uno uno uba don ha rudnong u ïap ha ka jingïaleh , uno uno uba don ha nongbah u ïap da ka jingpang ne jingthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam ka don shabar , bad ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingkyrduh: uta uba don ha lyngkha un iap da ka waitlam ; bad uta uba don ha sor , ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingkyrduh kan bam ia u .

en: And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la ai ha ki Lebi ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew baroh ba ki Israel ki wanrah sha nga . Kane ka long ka jingsiew ïa ka jingshakri jong ki ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, nga la ai ia ki khun Lebi baroh ha Israel kum ka pateng, na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ki kaba ki shakri, wat ka jingshakri jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: He was taken from prison and from judgment : and who shall declare his generation ? for he was cut off out of the land of the living : for the transgression of my people was he stricken .
kha: La kem ïa u bad la bishar bad ïalam noh ban shah pynïap , bad ym don ba salia ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa u . La pynïap ïa u na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: La shim noh ia u na phatok bad na ka jingbishar: bad mano ban pynbna ia ka pateng jong u ? namar la ot noh ia u na ka ri jong kiba im: namar ka jingleh bein jong ki briew jong nga u la shah pynmong .

en: And she fastened it with the pin , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awaked out of his sleep , and went away with the pin of the beam , and with the web .
kha: Ka Delilah nangta ka kynoi thiah ïa u , ka shim ïa kita ki kynthrong shñiuh jong u , bad ka thain hynñiew tylli ïa ki . Ka pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ bad ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Hynrei u khie joit bad u law pynsynjor ïa la u shñiuh na kata ka jingthain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pynkhih ia ka da u pin, bad ka la ong ha u, Ki Philistia ki don halor jong me, u Samson . U la kyndit na ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la leit noh bad u pin jong u beam bad bad bad ka web .

en: And he shall pass through Judah  ; he shall overflow and go over , he shall reach even to the neck  ; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land , O Immanuel .
kha: Kin sar lyngba ka Judah ha ka jingshlei um , da kaba kiew haduh tyrpeng bad tap lin ïa kaei kaei baroh .  U Blei u long lem bad ngi ! Ki thapniang jong u ba la pyiar shabar ki ïada ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un iaid lyngba ka Judah ; un tuid bad un leit sha jrong, un poi haduh ka ryndang ; bad ka jingpynjlan ia ki bniat jong u kan pyndap ia ka jingjyllei jong ka ri jong me, ko Immanel .

en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;
kha: Um ju shukor lane lute ïano ïano . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u buh bynda ; u bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la pynshitom bein ia uno uno, hynrei u la pynphai biang ia ka jingkular jong u, um shym la pynsniew ia u da ka jingleh donbor, u la ai ia u kpu jong u ha kiba thngan, bad u la tap ia kiba lyngkhuid da ka jain;

en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it  ; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it : and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion , and the stones of emptiness .
kha: Ki dkhoh bad ki tyngab kin shimti ïa ka ri . U  Trai  un ym pynseisoh shuh ïa ka , kumba ka la long ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u kor bad u bniat kin don ia ka; u bsein ruh un shong ha ka: bad un pynjrong ia u lain jong ka jingkulmar bad ki maw jong ka jingkyrduh .

en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .
kha: Ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u ka long kaba sniew hi kum ka jingleh byrtong , bad ka jingmeng ka long hi ka pop kum ka jingmane bleithaw . Namar ba me la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u la kyntait ïa me kum u syiem .
