translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingleh pyrshah ka long kum ka pop jong ka jingleh jadu, bad ka jingleh sting ka long kum ka jingbymhok bad ka jingleh be-ijot . Namar ba me la kyntait ia ka ktien U Trai , u la kyntait ruh ia me na kaba long syiem .

en: And rend your heart , and not your garments , and turn unto the  Lord  your God : for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repenteth him of the evil .
kha: Ai ba ka dohnud ba la pait jong phi kan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong phi ; kaba kad ïa ki jaiñphong jong phi kam biang .  To wan phai pat sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . U long uba sbun bad uba dap da ka jingisynei ; u long uba ïaishah slem bad uba bat ïa la ka kular ; u long borabor uba kloi ban map bad ym ban pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to pynkhih ia ka dohnud jong phi, bad ym ia ki jain jong phi, bad to phai sha U Trai U Blei jong phi: namar u long uba sngewrit bad uba isynei, uba slem ban bitar bad uba sngewrit shibun, bad u kylla bamut noh ia u na kaba sniew .

en: Then stood up upon the stairs , of the Levites , Jeshua , and Bani , Kadmiel , Shebaniah , Bunni , Sherebiah , Bani , and Chenani , and cried with a loud voice unto the  Lord  their God .
kha: Ka don ka jaka bakynjang , na ka bynta ki Lebi bad halor jong ka , u ïeng u Jeshua , u Bani , u Kadmiel , u Shebanaïah , u Bunni , u Sherebaïah , u Bani , bad u Khenani . Ki la duwai jam ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ieng halor ki step, na ki Lebi, u Jeshua, bad u Bani, u Kadmiel, u Shebaniah, u Bunni, u Sherebiah, u Bani, bad u Chenani, bad ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ha U Trai jong ki .

en: How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed ? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand , and take you away from the earth ?
kha: Katno kaba kham sniew kan long ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui uba dang ïohthiah ha la ka jong ka ïing ! Mynta ngan pynhiarkput ïa phi namar ka jingpynïap ïa u bad ngan pyndam ïa phi na sla khyndew !
translated_en_to_kha: Katno tam haba ki briew kiba sniew ki la pyniap ia u briew uba hok ha la ka jong ka iing halor ka jingthiah jong u ? hato ngan ym dawa mynta ia ka snam jong u na ka kti jong phi bad ngan shim noh ia phi na ka khyndew ?

en: Then called Esther for Hatach , one of the king s chamberlains , whom he had appointed to attend upon her , and gave him a commandment to Mordecai , to know what it was , and why it was .
kha: Nangta ka khot ïa u Hathakh , uwei na ki ïunukh ba la thung da u syiem , bad ong ïa u ban leit sha u Mordekai bad ban shem ïa kaei kaba la jia bad ban kylli balei ka long kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot ia u Esther na ka bynta u Hatach , uwei na ki kamra jong u syiem uba u la thung ban leit sha ka , bad u la ai hukum ia u ha u Mordecai , ban tip kaei kata bad balei ka long .

en: And Jesus went about all Galilee , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people .
kha: U Jisu u la leit kylleng ka Galilaïa , u da hikai ha ki Synagog , u da ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima ki Bneng , bad u da pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba la don baroh ki jait jingpang bad jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit kylleng ka Galilaia baroh kawei, u la hikai ha ki synagog jong ki bad u la ialap ia ka gospel jong ka hima bad u la pynkoit ia ki jingpang baroh bad ki jingpang baroh hapdeng ki briew .

en: I have seen , I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt , and I have heard their groaning , and am come down to deliver them . And now come , I will send thee into Egypt .
kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshah shitom bashyrkhei jong ki briew jong nga ha Ijipt . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingud jong ki , bad nga la wan hiar ban pyllaitluid ïa ki . Ale mynta ; ngan phah ïa me sha Ijipt .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi , nga la iohi ia ka jingjynjar jong ki briew jong nga kiba don ha Ijipt , bad nga la iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki , bad nga wan hiar ban pyllait im ia ki . Bad mynta to wan, ngan phah ia me sha Ijipt .

en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .
kha: Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynduh , bad ïa ka jingïakut jong phi bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap yn pyndam noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shahjop noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jutang jong phi bad ka jingiap kan ym shah pynduh noh , bad ka jingiateh jong phi bad ka dujok kan ym ieng shuh haba ka jingsma kaba tuid palat kan iaid lyngba , te phin sa shah pynkhih noh da ka .

en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;
kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad u la tip aïu U Blei u la kular ïa u : U Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka jinglong nongiathuhlypa bad ka jingtip ba U Blei u la smai ha u , kata na ki soh jong u , kat kum ka doh , un pynmih ia U Khrist ban shong ha ka khet jong u ; .

en: Namely , five lords of the Philistines , and all the Canaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon , from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath .
kha: Kito kiba dang sah ha kata ka ri ki long ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki Kanaan baroh , ki Sidon , bad ki Hib kiba shong ha ki Lum Lebanon naduh u Lum Baal Hermon haduh ka Khim Hamath .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata, san ngut ki kynrad jong ki Philistia, bad ki nong Kanaan baroh, bad ki nong Sidoni, bad ki nong Hiv kiba shong ha u lum Lebanon, naduh u lum Baal hermon haduh ka jingrung jong ka Hamath .

en: And the  Lord  will take away from thee all sickness , and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which thou knowest , upon thee  ; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee .
kha: U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi na ka jait jingpang baroh , bad un ym pynngat ha phi wat tang kawei ruh na ki jingpang kiba sngewtriem ba phi la mad ha ka ri Ijipt , hynrei un pynngat ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un weng noh na me ia ka jingpang baroh, bad un ym buh ia ki jingpang kiba sniew jong ka ri Ijipt, kiba me tip, ha me; hynrei un buh ia ki ha kita baroh kiba shun ia me .

en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .
kha: Naba ngim ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei pyrshah ïa ki bor bymman ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng , ki nongsynshar , ki bor synshar , bad ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka juk ba-dum .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim ialeh pyrshah ia ka doh bad ka snam , hynrei pyrshah ia ki hima , pyrshah ia ki bor , pyrshah ia ki nongsynshar jong ka jingdum jong kane ka pyrthei , pyrshah ia ka jingsniew ba kynja mynsiem ha ki jaka ba jrong .

en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .
kha: Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ki ; kin ïakren kai ïa ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim kylleng kat shaba nga pynsakma ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pyllait noh ia ki sha ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew na ka bynta ka jingshah pynmong jong ki, ban long ka jingkren bein bad ka jingkren bein, ka jingkren bein bad ka jingtim, ha ki jaka baroh ha kaba ngan beh noh ia ki .

en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .
kha: Bad haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa kane ka hukum :  Wat leit noh na Jerusalem , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba nga la ïathuh , ka jingai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la ialum lang bad ki, u la hukum ia ki ba kim dei ban mih na Jerusalem, hynrei ap ia ka jingkular U Kpa, kaba u la iohsngew ia nga .

en: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .
kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hangta , kumba ki la leh ha Lakhish .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shim ia ka ha kata ka sngi , bad ki la pynkhih ia ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam , bad ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta u la pynjot lut ha kata ka sngi , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha u Lachish .

en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .
kha: U Jisu u la leit jngoh kylleng ki nongbah bad ki nongrit . U la hikai ha ki synagog , u la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang babun jait bad ki jingshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la leit kylleng ki shnong bad ki shnong baroh, u la hikai ha ki synagog jong ki bad u la ialap ia ka gospel jong ka hima bad u la pynkoit ia ki jingpang baroh bad ki jingpang baroh hapdeng ki briew .

en: And with every living creature that is with you , of the fowl , of the cattle , and of every beast of the earth with you  ; from all that go out of the ark , to every beast of the earth .
kha: bad baroh ki jingthaw ba-im — ki sim , bad ki mrad baroh — kat kiba la wan mih lang bad phi na kata ka lieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bad ki jingthaw ba im baroh kiba don bad phi, na ki khnai bad na ki mrad baroh jong ka khyndew bad phi;

en: And the king said unto me , ( the queen also sitting by him , ) For how long shall thy journey be ? and when wilt thou return ? So it pleased the king to send me  ; and I set him a time .
kha: U patsha , ryngkat bad ka mahadei kaba shong ha syndah jong u , u la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga . U la kylli ïa nga katno slem ngan jah bad ba ngan wan phai pat , bad nga ïathuh ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha nga, (ka mahadei ruh ka shong hajan jong u, ) Katno ka jingleit jong me kan long ? bad mynno phin wan phai ? Kumta ka la sngewbha ia u syiem ban phah ia nga; bad nga la buh por ia u .

en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles , and their offspring among the people : all that see them shall acknowledge them , that they are the seed which the  Lord  hath blessed .
kha: Kin long kiba pawnam hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , uwei pa uwei uba ïohi ïa ki un tip ba ki long ki briew ïa kiba nga la kyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia u symbai jong ki yn sa tip hapdeng ki Jutang , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki hapdeng ki briew: baroh kiba iohi ia ki kin pdiang ia ki , ba ki long u symbai uba U Trai u la kyrkhu .

en: Lo , thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed , on Egypt  ; whereon if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him .
kha: Phi khmih lynti ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan long kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh ban ïaid — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata kan long kaei kaba u syiem Ijipt u long haba uno uno u shaniah ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, me shaniah ha u dieng jong une u khniang uba la tyrkhong, ha Ijipt; ha ka por ba u briew u la tyrkhong, un leit sha ka kti jong u, bad un pynkhih ia ka: kumjuh ruh u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt ha baroh kiba shaniah ha u .

en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the  Lord  , I have sinned  ; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me : now therefore , if it displease thee , I will get me back again .
kha: U Balaam u phai ktien ,  Nga la leh pop . Ngam shym tip ba me ïeng hapdeng lynti ban khang ïa nga ; hynrei mynta , lada kam dei ïa nga ban leit , ngan leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u angel U Trai, nga la leh pop ; namar ngam tip ba me ieng ha ka lynti pyrshah ia nga: namarkata mynta lada kam sngewbha ia me , ngan sa ioh biang ia nga .

en: They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
kha: Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang shit ; kin ïap na ki jingpang kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mradkhlaw ban kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don bih ban puh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin shah thang da ka jingkyrduh, bad kin shah pynjot da ka jingshit kaba jur: Ngan phah ruh ia ki bniat jong ki mrad ha ki , da ka bih jong ki bsein jong ka dewbilat .

en: Neither have our kings , our princes , our priests , nor our fathers , kept thy law , nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies , wherewith thou didst testify against them .
kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh Kim shym la sumar ïa ka Hukum jong me . Kim shym la sngap ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki syiem jong ngi, ki rangbah jong ngi, ki lyngdoh jong ngi, ne ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la kohnguh ia ki hukum jong me bad ki jingphla jong me, ha kaba me la sakhi pyrshah ia ki .

en: Great in counsel , and mighty in work : for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men : to give every one according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings :
kha: Me thaw ïa ki jingthmu bastad bad me leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khrawbor ; me ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki briew ki leh , bad me ainong ïa ki kat kum ki jingleh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba khraw ha ka jingai jingmut bad kaba khlain ha ka kam: namar ki khmat jong me ki plie ia ki lynti jong ki khun shynrang baroh: ban ai ia uwei pa uwei kat kum ki lynti jong u bad kat kum u soh jong ki jingleh jong u:

en: Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .
kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat uwei u khynnah u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïing jong uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka pukri hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh uwei u samla u la iohi ia ki, bad u la iathuh ha u Absalom: hynrei ki la leit noh kloi sha ka iing jong u briew ha Bahurim kaba don ka thliew ha ka iing jong u ; ha kaba ki la leit hiar .

en: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates : and king Josiah went against him  ; and he slew him at Megiddo , when he had seen him .
kha: Katba u Josaïah u long syiem , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai sha ka wah Ïuphratis ban ïarap ïa u patsha ka Assyria . U syiem Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Ijipt ha Megiddo bad u la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki sngi jong u u Pharaoh u la leit sha u syiem Assyria sha ka wah Euphrates : bad u syiem Josiah u la leit pyrshah ia u ; bad u la pyniap ia u ha Megiddo , haba u la iohi ia u .

en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb : in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the  Lord  for a drink offering .
kha: Kum ka jingainguh da ka waiñ lem bad u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , theh shi litar ka waiñ ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh dih jong ka kan long ka bynta kaba saw na ka bynta uwei u khun langbrot: ha ka jaka bakhuid to pynlong ia ka wain kaba khlain ban theh ha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingainguh dih .

en: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .
kha: Hato phim tip ba u syiem Baalis jong ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael ban pynïap ïa phi ?  Hynrei u Gedalaïah um shym ngeit ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, "Phi tip shisha ba u syiem jong ki Ammon u la phah ia u Ismael u khun u Nethaniah ban pyniap ia me ? Hynrei u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam um shym la ngeit ia ki .

en: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .
kha: U Jisu u la ïalam sharud ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ha sngap ! Ngi ïaleit sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh shaphang U Khun U Briew kan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ha u ia ki shiphew ngut bad u la ong ha ki: Ha khmih ngi leit sha Jerusalem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh da ki nongiathuhlypa shaphang U Khun u briew kin sa pyndep .

en: For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;
kha: Ka long kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shisha , ba ïa ki hukum la thaw , ym na ka bynta ki briew ki babha , hynrei ïa ki nongpynkheiñ hukum bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba khlem Blei bad kiba pop , na ka bynta kito ki bymriewblei ne ki bym long kiba kynja mynsiem , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa bad ki kmie , na ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na ka bynta kiba leh kam ba-ijli , na ka bynta kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta kito kiba shukor bad kiba ai jingphla lamler lane kito kiba leh ïa kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka jinghikai kaba shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki nongkhaii met , na ka bynta jong ki kiba pynjakhlia ia lade bad u khun bynriew , na ka bynta ki nongleh thok , na ka bynta ki briew kiba la shah pynjot , bad lada don kaei kaei pat kaba pyrshah ia ka jinghikai kaba sawa ; .

en: And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?
kha: bad u la leit phai pat sha la ka shnong . U la hikai ha ka synagog , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh kat kane ka jingstad ?  ki la kylli .  Bad kumno shaphang ki kambah jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan ha la ka jong ka ri, u la hikai ia ki ha ka synagog jong ki, khlem da sngewthuh ba ki la lyngngoh, bad u la ong: Naei une u briew une ka jingstad bad kine ki kam kiba khraw ?

en: Now when Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon  ; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin  ;
kha: Kumno re kumno , u Ebedmelekh , u nong Sudan , u ïunukh uba trei ha ka ïingsyiem u la ïohsngew ba ki la thep ïa nga ha ka pung . Ha kata ka por u syiem u dang pynlong ka jingbishar ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Ebedmeech u nong Ithiopia, uwei na ki nongsynshar uba don ha iing syiem u la iohsngew ba ki la buh ia u Jeremaiah ha ka thliew ; u syiem nangta u la shong ha ka khyrdop u Benjamin ; .

en: Which sometime were disobedient , when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah , while the ark was a preparing , wherein few , that is , eight souls were saved by water .
kha: Kine ki la long ki mynsiem jong kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei mynba u la ap da ka jingshahslem ha ki sngi ba u Noah u dang shna ïa ka ïinglieng jong u . Ki briew kiba don tang khyndiat ha ka ïinglieng — phra ngut ha baroh — ki la lait im da ka um ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba la long katto katne por ka bym kohnguh , haba shisien ka jingshah shitom jong U Blei ka la ap ha ki sngi u Noah , katba ka lieng ka dang long ka jingpynkhreh , ha kaba tang khyndiat eh , kata ka long , 8 tylli ki mynsiem ki la shah pynim da ka um .

en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , neither hath the eye seen , O God , beside thee , what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him .
kha: Ym pat ju don ba ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba kum ma me , uba leh ïa kiba kum kita ki kam na ka bynta kito kiba ap kyrmen ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar naduh ba sdang ka pyrthei ki briew kim shym la iohsngew, lymne kim shym la sngewthuh da ka shkor, lymne ka khmat kam shym la iohi, ko Blei, nalor jong me, ia kaei kaba u la pynkhreh na ka bynta uta uba ap ia u .

en: And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .
kha: U Joshua u ong ha u ,  Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha hangne ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla . Ïathuh ha nga mynta ïa kaei kaba me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha u Achan, ko khun jong nga, to ai, nga kyrpad ia me, ia ka burom ha U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, bad to phla ha u ; bad to iathuh ia nga mynta kaei kaba me la leh ; wat buhrieh ia ka na nga .

en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .
kha: U Jonathan u pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia ha Geba , bad ki Philistia baroh ki ïohsngew shaphang kata . Nangta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka thma da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jonathan u la pynkhih ia ka kynhun jong ki Philistia kaba don ha Gba, bad ki Philistia ki la iohsngew ia kata . U Saul u la pynsawa ia ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri , u da ong , Ai ba ki Hebru kin iohsngew .

en: But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .
kha: Hynrei ngi da ïohi ïa U Jisu , ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban ïa ki angel , kumta ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U Blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pa uwei baroh . Mynta ngi ïohi ïa u , ba la pynphong pansngiat da ka burom bad da ka jingpyndonburom namar ka jingïap kaba u la shah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi iohi ia U Jisu uba la shah pynlong kham poh khyndiat ban ia ki angel na ka bynta ka jingjynjar jong ka jingiap, la pynkup burom da ka burom bad ka burom ; ba ma u da ka jingaiei U Blei u dei ban mad ia ka jingiap na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u briew .

en: Who shall offer it before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for her  ; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .
kha: U lyngdoh un kñia ïa ka jingainguh jong ka ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka ; bad kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid . Kane ka long kaba ka kynthei ka dei ban leh hadien ba kha khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba ai ia ka ha khmat U Trai , bad ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka ; bad kan sa shah pynkhuid na ka snam jong ka . Kane ka long ka ain na ka bynta jong ka kaba la kha shynrang ne kynthei .

en: For your shame ye shall have double  ; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion : therefore in their land they shall possess the double : everlasting joy shall be unto them .
kha: Ki jinglehrain bad jingjahburom jong phi kin kut noh . Phin sa shong ha la ka jong ka ri , bad ka spah jong phi kan roi ar shah ; ka jingkmen jong phi kan neh bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingsngewlehrain jong phi phin sa ioh ar shah bad na ka bynta ka jingkulmar kin sngewbha ha ka bynta jong ki: namarkata ha ka ri jong ki kin don ia ka jingkmen kaba ar shah: ka jingkmen bymjukut kan long ha ki .

en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .
kha: Lada u briew u klim bad ka tnga jong u para Israel , ma u bad kata ka kynthei kin shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u briew uba leh be-ijot bad ka tnga jong uwei pat, wat uta uba leh be-ijot bad ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u, u nongleh be-ijot bad u nongleh be-ijot un shah pyniap shisha .

en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim , of mount Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephrathite :
kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Elkanah , uba na ka jait Ephraim , uba shong ha ka shnong Ramah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim . U dei u khun jong u Jeroham bad u khun ksiew jong u Elihu , bad u dei na ka longïing jong u Tohu kaba hap hapoh ka jait Suph .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la don uwei u briew uba na u lum Ephraham bad ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Elkanah u khun u Elihu u khun u Tohu u khun u Euphraham:

en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .
kha: Bad nangta kan don ka hima kaba saw , kaba eh kum ka nar , kaba pynkhynñiuh bad pynpait ïa kaei kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka nar ka pynkhynñiuh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kan pynkhynñiuh bad pynlwet ïa baroh ki hima kiba mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka hima kaba saw kan long kaba skhem kum ka nar: ka long kaba khraw kum ka nar bad ka pynduna ia kiei kiei baroh: bad kum ka nar kaba pynpra ia kine baroh , kan sa bthei bad kan sa tyrkhong .

en: And there were six steps to the throne , with a footstool of gold , which were fastened to the throne , and stays on each side of the sitting place , and two lions standing by the stays :
kha: Don hynriew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khet bad ka don ka jingïuhkjat kaba la pyndait ha ka , ba la sop da ka ksiar . Ki don ki jingshan kti ha baroh arliang jong ka khet , bad ka dur u sing ka ïeng ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don hynriew tylli ki step sha ka khet , bad ka jaka shong ksiar , kaba la pyndait ha ka khet , bad ka sah ha kawei pa kawei ka liang jong ka jaka shong , bad ar tylli ki sing kiba ieng hajan ki jaka sah:

en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way , at the head of the two ways , to use divination : he made his arrows bright , he consulted with images , he looked in the liver .
kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïeng hajan ka dak jingkdew ha kaba ka lynti ka ïakhlad . Ban tip shano ban leit , u pynkhih ïa ki khnam ; u wad jingmut na ki bleithaw jong u ; u khmih thuh ïa u khyllai jong u mrad ba la kñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem Babilon u la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka lynti, ha ka khlieh jong ki arliang: u la pynlong ia ki khnam jong u kiba shai , u la iamir jingmut bad ki dur , u peit shapoh ka sniehdoh .

en: Then the king , when he heard these words , was sore displeased with himself , and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him : and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him .
kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh bad u la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban shem lad ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel . U la ïai pyrshang haduh ban da sep sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem haba u la iohsngew ia kine ki ktien, u la sngewsih shibun ia lade, bad u la buh ia la ka dohnud ha u Daniel ban pyllait im ia u: bad u la trei shitom haduh ka jinghiar jong ka sngi ban pyllait im ia u .

en: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth : and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth , even of all that went in at the gate of his city , saying ,
kha: U Ephron hi u la shong lem bad kita kiwei pat ki Hit ha ka jaka ba ju long dorbar ha ka khyrdop jong ka nongbah ; u la jubab ha ka jingïohsngew jong uwei pa uwei baroh hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Ephron u la shong hapdeng ki khun Heth: bad u Ephron u Hittite u la jubab ia u Abraham ha ka jingbishar jong ki khun Heth, wat na baroh kiba la leit rung ha ka khyrdop jong ka shnong jong u, da kaba ong:

en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him , at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king s dale .
kha: Haba u Abram u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa u Khedorlaomer bad ïa kita kiwei pat ki syiem , u syiem jong ka Sodom u leit ban ïashem ïa u ha ka them Shabeh ( ïa kaba la khot ruh ka Them u Syiem ) .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la leit shabar ban iakynduh ia u hadien ba u la wan phai na ka jingpyniap ia u Khloreer bad ki syiem kiba don ryngkat bad u, ha ka them Shaveh kaba long u syiem u la leit phai noh .

en: And he answered and told them ,  Elias verily cometh first , and restoreth all things  ; and how it is written of the Son of man , that he must suffer many things , and be set at nought .
kha: Ka jingjubab jong u ka long ,  U Elijah u wan shisha nyngkong khnang ban pynkhreh ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban balei ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ba U Khun U Briew un hap shahshitom shibun bad shah kyntait ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, U Elias u wan shisha, bad u pynphai biang ia kiei kiei baroh bad kumno la thoh shaphang u Khun u briew, ba u dei ban shah shitom shibun kiei kiei, bad un shah set ha ka por bym don shuh .

en: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families : and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph .
kha: Ka jaka kaba dei jong ki longïing jong ka jait Benjamin ka long kaba nyngkong eh ïa kaba la ai . Ka jaka jong ki ka don hapdeng ki jait Judah bad Joseph .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka bhah jong ki khun shynrang ka la wan shaneng katkum ka longiing jong ki: bad ka rud duriaw jong ki ka la mih hapdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u Joseph .

en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king s household , and to do what he thought good . And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king , as he was come over Jordan  ;
kha: Ki la jam sha shiliang jong ka wah ban synran ïa ka kynhun ba kynja syiem bad ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u syiem u kwah . Katba u syiem u khreh ban jam sha shiliang , u Shimei u rynsied ïa lade ha khmat jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ka lieng kaba la kit ia ka iing syiem bad ban leh ia kaba u la pyrkhat bha . U Shimei u khun u Gera u la hap ha khmat u syiem , katba u dang wan sha Jordan;

en: And Pharaoh–neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father , and turned his name to Jehoiakim , and took Jehoahaz away : and he came to Egypt , and died there .
kha: U syiem Neko u pynlong ïa u Eliakim , u khun jong u Josaïah , kum u syiem Judah ha ka jaka u Josaïah u kpa jong u , bad u pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoïakim . Ïa u Joahas la rah sha Ijipt da u syiem Neko , bad u la ïap hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaohneco u la pynlong ia u Eliakim u khun u Josiah ha ka kamra jong u Josiah u kpa jong u, bad u la pynphai ia ka kyrteng jong u sha u Jehoiakim bad u la shim noh ia u Jehoias: bad u la poi sha Ijipt bad u la iap hangta .

en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .
kha: Haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u , u Abraham u tei ïa ka duwan bad u pynbeit ïa kita ki dieng halor jong ka . U la khum ïa la u khun bad pynthiah ïa u halor ka duwan , hajrong kita ki dieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka kaba U Blei u la iathuh ha u; bad u Abraham u la tei ia ka jingknia hangta, bad u la buh ia u dieng ha ka rukom kaba biang, bad u la teh ia u Isaak u khun jong u, bad u la buh ia u ha ka jingknia halor u dieng .

en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him : for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you  ; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you .
kha: U Moses u la rah bad u ïa ka met u Joseph , kumba u Joseph u la pynsmai ïa ki Israel . U Joseph u la lah ong ,  Haba U Blei u wan pyllait ïa phi , phi dei ban kit noh ïa ka met jong nga na kane ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ki shyieng jong u Joseph bad u: namar u la smai jur ia ki khun Israel , u da ong: U Blei un leit jngoh shisha ia phi ; bad phin rah noh ia ki shyieng jong nga kumta bad phi .

en: Will the  Lord  be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?
kha: Hato U  Trai  un sngewbha lada nga wallam sha u da ki hajar ki langbrot lane da ka umphniang Olib kaba tuid khlem kut ? Hato ngan ai ha u da u khun nyngkong jong nga ban siew na ka bynta ki pop jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Trai un sngewbha da ki hajar tylli ki langbrot ne da ki shi hajar tylli ki wah umphniang ? hato ngan ai ia u khun nyngkong jong nga na ka bynta ka jingleh bymman jong nga ?

en: And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .
kha: U Jakob u phai ktien ,  Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki tlot , bad nga dei ruh ban pyrkhat shaphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiah jubor ïa ki wat tang shi sngi ruh , baroh ki jingri kin ïap lut .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, u kynrad jong nga u tip ba ki khynnah ki long kiba jemnud, bad ki kynhun bad ki kynhun ki don ryngkat bad nga: bad lada ki briew kin pynkhih palat ia ki ha kawei ka sngi , ka kynhun baroh kan iap .

en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .
kha: Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa ban shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros . U shong basa ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u nongpdem snieh , uba shong basah harud duriaw .’
translated_en_to_kha: Phah namarkata sha Joppa, bad khot ia u Simon, uba la tip kyrteng kum u Petros; u la sah ha iing uwei u Simon u nonglehkai ha rud duriaw: uba haba u wan un kren ha me .

en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;
kha: Hadien ar sngi , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka ri Judah kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la thang ïa ka shnong
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai, u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la wan sha Chiklag ha ka sngi kaba lai, ba ki Amalek ki la hiar thma shaphang shathie, bad u Ziklag bad u la thang ia ka da ka ding ; .

en: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock ! the sword shall be upon his arm , and upon his right eye : his arm shall be clean dried up , and his right eye shall be utterly darkened .
kha: Uta u nongaplangbrot u bymmyntoi ei ei u long uba la tim ! U la iehnoh ïa la ka kynhun langbrot . Ka thma kan pynjot khoit ïa ka bor jong u . Ka kti jong u kan ïapstai bad ka khmat kamon jong u kan long kaba matlah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sniew ia u nongap langbrot bleithaw uba iehnoh ia ka kynhun ! ka waitlam kan long ha ka kti jong u, bad ha ka khmat kadiang jong u: ka kti jong u kan sa tyrkhong pura, bad ka khmat kadiang jong u kan sa dum pura .

en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
kha: Ko Nonghikai , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem don khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki lah ban don ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew kum ki khun jong uta u briew uba la ïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: U nonghikai , u Moses u la thoh ha ngi , Lada u hynmen shynrang u iap , bad u iehnoh ia ka tnga jong u shadien jong u , bad u iehnoh ia ki khun , ba u hynmen jong u un shim ia ka tnga jong u bad un pynmih symbai sha u hynmen jong u .

en: These are the statutes and judgments , which ye shall observe to do in the land , which the  Lord  God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it , all the days that ye live upon the earth .
kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ba phi dei ban kohnguh katba phi dang shong ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba phin peit ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me u ai ha me ban don ia ka ha ki sngi baroh kiba phi im ha ka khyndew .

en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .
kha: Ka hima u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baroh ki ri naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pud Ijipt . Ki la siew khajna ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la synshar ia ki hima baroh naduh ka wah haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh u pud u sam jong ka ri Ijipt: ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha bad u Solomon u la shakri ia u ha ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u baroh .

en: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .
kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam ,  Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka jaka sher dara tad ynda ngi wan phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki don hangne bad phi ; bad kumta uno uno uba don kano kano ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u lah ban leit sha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki rangbah: To iaid hangne na ka bynta jong ngi, haduh ba ngin da wan phai biang sha phi: bad, ha khmih, u Aaron bad u Hur ki don ryngkat bad phi: lada uno uno u don ka kam ban leh, to un wan sha ki .

en: And he was there with the  Lord  forty days and forty nights  ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .
kha: U Moses u la sah hangta bad U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , khlem bam khlem dih . U thoh ruh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa ki ktien jong kata ka jutang — ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la don hangta bad U Trai sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet um ju bam kpu ne dih um . Bad u la thoh halor ki miej ia ki ktien jong ka jutang , ki shiphew tylli ki hukum .

en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .
kha: Don kiba klim , bad kiwei ki pynbieit ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ne ïa la ki bakha kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u la leh ia ka kam kaba sniew bad ka tnga jong u bad uwei pat u la pynsniew bein ia ka khun jong u ha ka ain ; bad uwei pat ha me u la pynrit ia ka para jong u, ka khun jong u kpa jong u.

en: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol s temple , shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols ;
kha: Tharai u briew uba ka jingïatiplem ka tlot ha kane ka bynta u ïohi ïa phi uba don kata kaba khot  ka jingtip  , ba phi shong bam ha ka templ jong ka bleithaw ; hato kane kam pynshlur ïa uta ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba la kñia sha ki bleithaw ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada uno uno u briew u iohi ia me uba don ka jingtip ba u shong ha ka temple bleithaw , ka jingsngew jong uta uba tlot kan ym shah pynshlur ban bam ia kita kiei kiei kiba la tyrwa sha ki bleithaw ; .

en: This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
kha: U Moses u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki paid Israel . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u Moses uba ki la kyntait da kaba ong , Mano ba la pynlong ia me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar ? kumjuh ruh U Blei u la phah ban long u nongsynshar bad u nongpyllait im da ka kti jong u angel uba la paw ha u ha khlaw .

en: And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot  ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .
kha: Nalor kata baroh , ka don ka kharai kaba jylliew hapdeng jong ngi , khnang ba kito kiba kwah ban jam sha shiliang nangne sha me kim lah ban leh kumta , lymne uno uno un lah ban jam sha shiliang sha ngi na ka jaka kaba me don .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nalor kine baroh, hapdeng jong ngi bad phi ka don ka jingkhang kaba khraw: kumta kita ki ban iaid noh nangta sha phi kim lah ban ; bad kim lah ruh ban iaid sha ngi, kata kan wan nangta .

en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets , when the sound of the grinding is low , and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird , and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low  ;
kha: Ki shkor jong phi kin ym ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha ki lynti . Da kaba shitom phin lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingtylliat haba ka tylliat , bad ïa ka sur jingtem haba ka sawa , hynrei wat ka jingpah jong ka sim kan kyrsiew ïa phi na ka jingïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki jingkhang kin khang ha ki lynti, haba ka sur jong ka jingsawa ka long kaba duna, bad un kiew ha ka sur jong u sim , bad ki khun kynthei baroh kin shah pynhiar ro;

en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , saying , I will open my mouth in parables  ; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world .
kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :  Ngan pyndonkam da ki pharshi haba nga kren ha ki , ngan ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei ki bymtip naduh ba la pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba kan long kaba la kren da u nongiathuhlypa, da kaba ong , Ngan plie ia ka shyntur jong nga ha ki pharshi ; Ngan kren ia kiei kiei kiba la buhrieh naduh ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei .

en: And he answered , My lord , O king , my servant deceived me : for thy servant said , I will saddle me an ass , that I may ride thereon , and go to the king  ; because thy servant is lame .
kha: U jubab ,  Kumba phi tip , ko Syiem Kynrad , nga dei uba dkoh . Nga la ong ïa la u shakri ban teh jin ïa ka kada jong nga ba kumta nga lah ban shong lem bad phi , hynrei u la shet shukor ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la jubab: ko kynrad jong nga, ko syiem, u shakri jong nga u la shukor ia nga: namar u shakri jong me u la ong: namar u shakri jong me un sa sngap jar ia nga, ba ngan shong ha kata ka jaka, bad ngan leit sha u syiem ; namar u shakri jong me u long uba lyngngoh .

en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .
kha: Haba ka ktien ka la poi ha u syiem ka Judah ba ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha kaba ki la khynñiuh kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha ka iing u Dabid, da kaba ong, Ka Syria ka iadei bad u Ephram . Bad ka dohnud jong u ka la khih bad ka dohnud jong ki briew jong u, kumba ki dieng ki khih da ka Iyer .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha Ramah , ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam kthang . Ka Rakhel ka ïam namar ki khun jong ka ; ki la ïap noh , bad kam treh ba yn pyntngen ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Ka sur ba la iohsngew ha Ramah, ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih kaba sngewsih na ka bynta ki khun jong ka ka la kyntait ban shah pyntngen na ka bynta ki khun jong ka, namar kim shym la long kumta .

en: It shall come to pass , when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die : and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave .
kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad ,  u Judah u bteng ,  lada ngan leit phai sha i pa khlem u para , in tang shu ïohi ba u para um don bad nga , in sa ïap . I ieit thep mynsiem ïa u , bad namar ba i la tymmen eh , ka jingleh jong ngi kan pynïap sngewsih ïa i .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan sa jia haba u iohi ba u khynnah um don bad ngi, ba un iap: bad ki shakri jong me kin pynhiar ia ki shniuh kiba rong saw jong u shakri jong me u kpa jong ngi da ka jingsngewsih sha ka jingtep .

en: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the  Lord  , how I hid an hundred men of the  Lord s  prophets by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water ?
kha: Phim shym ïohsngew ba katba ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  , nga la buhrieh shispah ngut na ki ha ki krem , ha ki ar kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad pynbiang jingbam bad um ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ym shym la iathuh ia u kynrad jong nga ia kaei kaba nga la leh haba u Jesbel u la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa U Trai , kumno nga la buhrieh ia ki shispah ngut ki nongiathuhlypa U Trai da sanphew ngut ha ka krem , bad nga la ai bam ia ki da u kpu bad ka um ?

en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
kha: Kine ki kur u Merari kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , lem bad u Suriel u khun jong u Abihail kum u rangbah kur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingshakri jong ki longiing jong ki khun shynrang jong ka Merari, kat kum ka jingshakri jong ki baroh, ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng, hapoh ka kti jong u Ishaar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh .

en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita ki syiem kiba don ha ka liang jong u ki la wan ryngkat bad la ki shipai bad jop ïa ki Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa ki Susim ha Ham , ïa ki Emim ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba shiphew u la wan u Chedorlaomer bad ki syiem kiba don ryngkat bad u, bad ki la pynbeit ia ki Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim bad ki Zuzim ha Ham bad ki Emim ha Shaveh Kiriatham .

en: For ye shall go out with joy , and be led forth with peace : the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing , and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands .
kha: Phin mihnoh na Babilon da ka jingkmen ; yn ïalam ïa phi shabar ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk . Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin sawa da ka jingrwai , bad ki dieng kin pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phin leit shabar da ka jingkmen, bad phin ialam noh da ka jingsuk: ki lum bad ki lum kin bthei ha khmat jong phi ban rwai , bad ki dieng baroh kin ia tyngkhuh kti .

en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead ,
kha: To ngin ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïa U Kpa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi . Namar ka jingisynei bakhraw jong u , u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingim bathymmai da kaba pynmihpat ïa U Jisu Khrist na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi U Jisu Khrist uba kat kum ka jingisynei kaba khraw jong u u la kha pat ia ngi sha ka jingkyrmen kaba im da ka jingmihpat U Jisu Khrist na kiba iap .

en: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice , the villages that Kedar doth inhabit : let the inhabitants of the rock sing , let them shout from the top of the mountains .
kha: Ai ba ka ri shyiap bad ki shnong jong ka kin ïaroh ïa U Blei ; ai ba ki briew jong ka Kedar kin ïaroh ïa U ! Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ka nongbah Sela kin risa da ka jingkmen na ki kliar jong ki lumbah !
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ka ri khlaw bad ki shnong jong ka kin pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, ki shnong kiba u Kedar u shong: ai ba ki nongshong shnong jong u maw kin rwai , ai ba kin pyrta na jrong jong ki lum .

en: And thou shalt set the table without the veil , and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south : and thou shalt put the table on the north side .
kha: Habar jong ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam buh ïa kata ka miej ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ka miej khlem ka jingtap , bad ka sharak ha ka liang ka miej shaphang shathie: bad men buh ia ka miej shaphang shathie .

en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .
kha: U Joseph u la thied ïa ka jaiñ linen , u la pynhiar ïa ka met shapoh , u la sop ïa ka da ka jaiñ , bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep ïa kaba la lah tih ha u mawsiang . Nangta u pyntyllun ïa u maw uba heh ha ka jaka rung jong ka jingtep .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thied ia u jain uba bha, bad u la pynkhih ia u da ka jain , bad u la buh ia u ha ka jingtep kaba la ot na u maw , bad u la pynkhih ia u maw haduh ka jingkhang jong ka jingtep .

en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army . And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field .
kha: Te u la hukum ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban leit na Lakhish sha Jerusalem lem bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw ban dawa ba u syiem Hesekaïah u dei ban pyndem . U rangbah synshar u ïeng ha ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , harud ka nur kaba wanrah um na ka pung kaba haneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Assyria u la phah ia u Rabsakeh na Lachish sha Jerusalem sha u syiem Hesekaiah ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw . Bad u la ieng hajan ka pung kaba shalor ha ka lynti bah jong ka lyngkha kaba kham pura .

en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man , and their heart shall rejoice as through wine : yea , their children shall see it , and be glad  ; their heart shall rejoice in the  Lord .
kha: Ki paid Israel kin long kiba khlaiñ kum ki shipai , kiba kmen kum ki rangbah kiba la dih waiñ . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin kynmaw ïa kane ka jingjop bad kin kmen namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jong ka Ephraim kin long kum u briew uba khlain bor, bad ka dohnud jong ki kan sngewbha kum ka wain: hooid , ki khun jong ki kin iohi ia ka, bad kin sngewbha; ka dohnud jong ki kan sngewbha ha U Trai .

en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .
kha: Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tylli ki mynsiem ki leit noh sha ki syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa ki na ka bynta ka thma ha ka Sngi kaba khraw jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba trei ia ki kambah kiba leit sha ki syiem jong ka pyrthei bad jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban lum ia ki sha ka thma jong kata ka sngi kaba khraw jong U Blei Uba donbor .

en: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made , in praise , and in name , and in honour  ; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God , as he hath spoken .
kha: Un kyntiew ïa phi ha khlieh eh ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ba u la thaw , bad phi pat phin ïaroh bad ai burom ïa ka kyrteng jong u . Phi phin long ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban pynlong ia me uba ha khlieh duh halor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba u la thaw, ha ka jingiaroh bad ha ka kyrteng, bad ha ka burom ; bad ba me long u briew uba khuid ha U Trai U Blei jong me, kumba u la kren .

en: My tabernacle is spoiled , and all my cords are broken : my children are gone forth of me , and they are not : there is none to stretch forth my tent any more , and to set up my curtains .
kha: La pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ïa ki tyllai ba pynskhem ïa ki la pyndkut . Ki khun jong ngi ki la leit noh baroh ; ym don shuh mano mano ba dang sah ban pynïeng pat ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ym don shuh mano mano ban wah ïa ki pyrda jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tent jong nga ka la jot , bad ki lynti jong nga baroh ki la tyrkhong: ki khun jong nga kim don shuh: ym don shuh ban pynjlan ia ka ïingjahtang jong nga shuh shuh .

en: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge : for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol ; and their conscience being weak is defiled .
kha: Hynrei ym baroh uba tip ïa kane ka jingshisha . Don ki briew kiba la ju myllen bad ki bleithaw ba haduh kane ka sngi haba ki bam kum ïa kata ka jingbam ki dang pyrkhat hi ïa ka kum ka jingbam kaba dei jong ka bleithaw ; ka jingïatiplem jong ki ka long kaba tlot , bad ki sngew ba la pynjakhlia ïa ki da kata ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym don ha uwei pa uwei u briew kata ka jingtip: namar don kiba don ka jingsngew jong u bleithaw haduh kane ka kynta ki bam ia ka kum kaei kaei kaba la tyrwa ha u bleithaw ; bad ka jingsngew jong ki ka long kaba tlot ka la pynsniew .

en: Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ki briew ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pra ! Ka bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïaleh pyrshah jong ngi !’
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew, namar kata ka Tyros ka la ong pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem, Ah, ka la shah pynpra ia kata ka khyrdop jong ki briew: ka la phai sha nga: Ngan sa shah pyndap biang, mynta ka la shah pynjot:

en: And he said , I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills , as sheep that have not a shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master : let them return every man to his house in peace .
kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Israel ba ki sakma ha ki lum kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai kin leit phai noh sha ïing da kaba suk .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , nga la iohi ia ki Israel baroh kiba la saphriang ha ki lum , kum ki langbrot ki bym don nongap langbrot: bad U Trai u la ong: Kine kim don kynrad: to ai ba kin leit phai noh uwei pa uwei sha la iing ha ka jingsuk .

en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak , If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the word of the  Lord  my God , to do less or more .
kha: Hynrei u Balaam u jubab ,  Wat lada u Balak u ai lut ka ksiar ka rupa kaba don ha ïingsyiem jong u , da lei lei ngam lah khlem da kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong nga wat ïa iba rit tam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki shakri u Balak, Lada u Balak un ai ia nga ia ka iing jong u kaba dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ngam lah ban iaid palat ia ka ktien U Trai U Blei jong nga, ban leh kham duna ne kham bun .

en: Certain men , the children of Belial , are gone out from among you , and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city , saying , Let us go and serve other gods , which ye have not known  ;
kha: ba don ki riewbymman napdeng jong phi kiba la ïalam bakla ïa la ki para shnong para thaw ban mane ïa ki blei kiba phim ju mane mynno mynno .
translated_en_to_kha: Katto katne ki briew, ki khun jong ka Belial ki la mih noh na pdeng jong phi bad ki la weng noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ki da kaba ong , To ngin leit shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei kiba phim pat tip ; .

en: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him , Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me , seeing I am a stranger ?
kha: Ka Ruth ka nguh ngon haduh khyndew , bad ka ong ha u Boas ,  Balei phi da pyrkhat ïa nga haduh katta katta ? Balei phi da lehsbun haduh katta katta ïa ka nongwei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong ka bad ka la dem khrup ha khyndew bad ka la ong ha u: Balei nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha ki khmat jong me ba me dei ban ithuh ia nga haba nga long u nongwei ?

en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver , and of gold , and of precious things , with fenced cities in Judah : but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram  ; because he was the firstborn .
kha: U kpa jong ki u la ai ha ki shibun ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad kiwei kiwei ki markordor , bad u la buh ïa uwei pa uwei na ki ban peit ïa kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah ; hynrei namar u Jehoram u dei uba nyngkong eh , u Jehoshaphat u la pynlong ïa u , u nongmih bujli jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong ki u la ai ia ki ki jingai sngewbha kiba khraw jong ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki mar kiba kordor, bad ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong ha Judah: hynrei ka hima ka la ai ia u ha u Jehoram ; namar ba u long u khun nyngkong .

en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .
kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim ruh ïa ki met ba kynja doh jong phi da ka jingdon U Mynsiem jong u hapoh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada U Mynsiem jong uta uba la pynmihpat ia U Jisu na kiba iap u shong ha phi , uta uba la pynmihpat ia U Khrist na kiba iap un pynim ia ki met iap jong phi da U Mynsiem jong u uba shong ha phi .

en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .
kha: Na ka daw jong u paidbah , kim shym la lah ban wallam ïa uta u briew sha u . Kumta ki la weng ïa ka jingsop na ka tnum ïing hamar ka jaka ba U Jisu u don . Haba ki la dep weng ïa ka jingsop ïing , ki la pynhiar ïa uta u briew shapoh , u da thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kim lah ban wan hajan jong u na ka bynta ka press , ki la lap ia ka tnum ha kaba u don: bad haba ki la pynpra ia ka , ki la pynhap ia ka jingthiah ha kaba u nongpang u la thiah .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shield , nor cast a bank against it .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang u patsha ka Assyria : ‘ Un nym ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah lane ïoh siat ïa uwei ruh u khnam pyrshah ïa ka . Yn ym don shipai rah stieh ki ban lah ban wan sha jan ka nongbah , bad yn ym tei kynton kerkut sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai shaphang u syiem Assyria , Un ym wan sha kane ka shnong , lymne un ym siat ia u khnam hangta , lymne un ym wan ha khmat jong ka da ka jingda , lymne un ym bret ia ka bank pyrshah ia ka .

en: And he said , I will go out , and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the  Lord  said , Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail : go out , and do even so .
kha: U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler .’ U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Khie leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin jop .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ngan leit shabar, bad ngan long u mynsiem uba thok ha ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong u baroh . Bad U Trai u la ong: Me ruh men jop: leit noh bad leh kumta ruh .

en: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten : for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites , because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah .
kha: te ki Benjamin ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop . Ki Israel kiba ha khmat eh ki la kynran dien na ki Benjamin namar ba ki shaniah ha kita ki rangbah ba la buh ban apthap baroh sawdong ïa ka Gibeah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang ki la iohi ba ki la shah pyniap: namar ki briew Israel ki la ai jaka ia ki Benjamin , namar ki la shaniah ha ki nongshong shnong kiba ki la buh hajan ka Gibeah .

en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka synshar ïa ka ri . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew hadien kawei pat bad kim shym pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki pynkhih ia ki shyntur jong ki kum ki jinglamler jong ki: hynrei kim long kiba shlur ia ka jingshisha halor ka khyndew ; namar ki iaid na kaba sniew sha kaba sniew , bad kim ithuh ia nga , ong U Trai .

en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds : but when it is grown , it is the greatest among herbs , and becometh a tree , so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof .
kha: U long u symbai uba rit tam na ki symbai baroh , hynrei haba u la san , u long u jingthung uba heh tam na baroh ki jingthung . U kylla long u dieng , ba kumta ki sim ki wan bad thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba shisha ka long kaba rit tam na ki symbai baroh: hynrei haba la san ka long kaba khraw tam napdeng ki jingthung , bad ka kylla long u dieng , kumta ki sim Iyer ki wan sah ha ki tnat jong ka .

en: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .
kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ïa u syiem ka Ijipt ,  Nga la pynlong syiem ïa me khnang ban pyndonkam ïa me ban pyn-i ïa ka bor jong nga bad ban pynphriang ïa ka nam jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingthoh ka ong ha u Pharaoh , Wat na ka bynta kane kajuh ka jingthmu nga la pynmih ia me, ba ngan pyni ia ka bor jong nga ha me, bad ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan shah pynbna ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: For , behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and , lo , my sheaf arose , and also stood upright  ; and , behold , your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .
kha: Baroh ngi ïadon lang ha lyngkha ba ngi ïateh song ïa u kew , ha kaba ka song jong nga ka khie joit bad ka ïeng beit . Ki song jong phi pat ki tawiar sawdong ïa ka song jong nga , bad ki ïanguh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ngi la teh ia ki bniat ha lyngkha, bad, ha khmih, ka bniat jong nga ka la mih, bad ruh ka la ieng beit ; bad, ha khmih, ki bniat jong phi ki la ieng sawdong, bad ki la kohnguh ia ka bniat jong nga .

en: And she said unto him , How canst thou say , I love thee , when thine heart is not with me ? thou hast mocked me these three times , and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .
kha: Kumta ka ong ha u ,  Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi ieit ïa nga haba phim mut kumta ? Phi pynlong ka bieit ïa nga la lai sien , bad phim pat shym la ïathuh satia ha nga kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi uba khlaiñbor bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha u, Kumno me ong ia me haba ka dohnud jong me kam don bad nga ? me la rkhie bein ia nga kine ki lai sien bad me khlem iathuh ia nga ha kaba ka bor bah jong me ka sah .

en: And fell at his feet , and said , Upon me , my lord , upon me let this iniquity be : and let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak in thine audience , and hear the words of thine handmaid .
kha: ha ki kjat jong u Dabid , bad ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , to sngap ïa nga ! Ai ngan kit pop ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la dem ha ki kjat jong u, bad u la ong, Ha nga, ko kynrad jong nga, to ai ba kane ka jingbymhok kan long: bad to ai ba ka kti jong me kan long: bad to ai ba ka kti jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, to kren ha ki nongsngap jong me, bad to iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka kti jong me .

en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb : and what was I able to do in comparison of you ? Then their anger was abated toward him , when he had said that .
kha: Nalor kata , da ka bor ka jong U Blei phi la pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb . Nga la leh aïu ban ïanujor bad kata ?  Haba u la kren ïa kane , kim shym la bitar shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la aiti ha ki kti jong phi ia ki syiem jong ka Midian , u Oreb bad u Seeb : bad nga la lah ban leh aiu haba ianujor bad phi ? Nangta ka jingbitar jong ki ka la nang hiar sha u haba u la ong kumta .

en: And it shall be , if thou do at all forget the  Lord  thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them , and worship them , I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .
kha: Lada phi klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phi phai sha kiwei pat ki blei ban mane bad ban shakri ïa ki , nga maham jur ïa phi ha kane ka sngi ba phin ïap da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, lada me klet noh ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad me iaid hadien kiwei pat ki blei, bad me shakri ia ki, bad nga mane ia ki, nga sakhi pyrshah ia phi ha kane ka sngi ba phin sa jah noh shisha .

en: Neither from a stranger s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these  ; because their corruption is in them , and blemishes be in them : they shall not be accepted for you .
kha: Wat ju kñia ïa uba kum uta u jingri ba phi ïoh na ki nongwei na ka bynta ka jingainguh bam . Kum ïa kita ki jingri la ñiew ba ki long kiba don ka jingduna , bad ym lah ban pdiang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka kti jong u nongwei phin ym ai ia u kpu jong U Blei jong phi na kine ki ; namar ka jingbamsap jong ki ka don ha ki, bad ki jingduna ha ki: kin ym shah pdiang na ka bynta jong phi .

en: How much she hath glorified herself , and lived deliciously , so much torment and sorrow give her : for she saith in her heart , I sit a queen , and am no widow , and shall see no sorrow .
kha: To ai ha ka , katta ka jingshitom bad ka jingsngewsih kat ka burom bad ka jingpahuh kaba ka la ai ïa lade . Naba ka ïai-ong ïa lade : ‘ Hangne nga shong , ka syiem ! Ngam long ka riewkynthei , ngan ym tip ïa ka jingsngewsih !’
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka la pyndonburom ia lade, bad ka la im sngewbha, ka jingshah pynshitom bad jingsngewsih kaba bun ka ai ia ka: namar ka ong ha ka dohnud jong ka: nga shong ka mahadei bad ngam shym la iap lok, bad ngan ym iohi ia ka jingsngewsih .

en: And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bam duh ïa baroh kaei kaei kaba jyrngam ha ka ri , bad nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to map ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba ki la pyndep ia ka jingbam ia u phlang jong ka ri, te nga la ong, ko Trai Blei, map ia me: da mano u Jakob un mih ? namar u long uba rit .

en: Thine own friend , and thy father s friend , forsake not  ; neither go into thy brother s house in the day of thy calamity : for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off .
kha: Wat nym klet ïa la ki paralok lane ïa ki paralok u kpa jong phi . Lada phi don ha ka jingjynjar , wat ong ïa u hynmen ne para jong phi ban ïarap ; u paramarjan uba hajan u lah ban ïarap ïa phi kham bha ban ïa u hynmen ne para uba sha jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: U paralok jong me hi, bad u paralok jong u kpa jong me, wat leit sha iing u hynmen jong me ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar jong me: namar kham bha u para marjan uba don hajan ban ia u hynmen uba jngai .

en: Because they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  their God , but transgressed his covenant , and all that Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded , and would not hear them , nor do them .
kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh namar ki Israel kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , hynrei ki pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad ki bad kim kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ ba la ai da u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai . Kim shahshkor bad kim kohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai jong ki, hynrei ki la pynkhein ia ka jutang jong u, bad baroh kaba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la hukum , bad un ym iohsngew ia ki , lymne ia ki .

en: And Israel served the  Lord  all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua , and which had known all the works of the  Lord  , that he had done for Israel .
kha: Katba u Joshua u dang im , ki paid Israel ki la shakri ïa U  Trai  , bad hadien ka jingïap jong u , ki dang bteng ban leh kumta katba dang im kito ki nongïalam kiba la ïohi da lade hi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel ki la shakri ia U Trai baroh ki sngi jong u Joshua bad ki rangbah baroh kiba la im u Joshua bad kiba la tip ia ki kam U Trai baroh kiba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ki paid Israel bad Judah ki shah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la ong U Trai jong ki paid ; Ki khun Israel bad ki khun Judah ki la shah pynshitom bein lang: bad baroh kiba la shim ia ki ki la bat ia ki da kaba stet; ki la kyntait ban pyllait noh ia ki .

en: And he said , Lay not thine hand upon the lad , neither do thou any thing unto him : for now I know that thou fearest God , seeing thou hast not withheld thy son , thine only son from me .
kha: Wat pynmynsaw ïa u khynnah lane leh ei ei ïa u ,  u ong .  Mynta , nga tip ba me sheptieng bad kohnguh ïa U Blei , namar mem shym la tyngkai ïa la u khun marwei na u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Wat buh ia ka kti jong me halor uta u khynnah, bad me wat leh ei ei ia u: namar mynta nga tip ba me sheptieng ia U Blei, namar me khlem bat ia u khun jong me, tang u khun jong me na nga .

en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers : and there arose another generation after them , which knew not the  Lord  , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel .
kha: Kata ka pateng bynriew baroh ka la ïap , bad ka pateng bynriew kaba bud ka la klet ïa U  Trai  bad ïa kaei kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh baroh kata ka pateng ka la ialum lang bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki: bad ka la mih kawei pat ka pateng hadien jong ki , kaba khlem ithuh ia U Trai , lymne ia ki kam kiba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens , and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service : and of the Levites there were scribes , and officers , and porters .
kha: Kiwei pat ki Lebi ki peit halor ka jingpynkit jingkit bad halor ki nongtrei ha ki kam bapher bapher , bad kiwei ki buh jingkheiñ lane ki shakri kum ki nongap phira .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ki la long halor ki nongkit jingkit, bad ki long ki nongpeit ia baroh kiba trei ia ka kam ha kano kano ka rukom jingshakri: bad na ki Lebi ki don ki nongthoh bad ki ophisar bad ki nongrah .

en: Then they brought out the king s son , and put upon him the crown , and gave him the testimony , and made him king . And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him , and said , God save the king .
kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam shabar ïa u Joash , u buh ïa ka pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ kiba ïadei bad ka jingsynshar . U Jehoïada u lyngdoh bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynsleh ïa u Joash , bad uwei pa uwei u pyrta :  To un im slem u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la pynmih ia u khun syiem, bad ki la buh ha u ia ka khlieh, bad ki la ai ia u ia ka jingsakhi, bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u . U Jehoiada bad ki khun jong u ki la pynsleh ia u bad ki la ong: U Blei un pynim ia u syiem .

en: And when they heard that , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord , and said , Lord , thou art God , which hast made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all that in them is :
kha: Haba ki riewngeit ki la ïohsngew ïa kata , baroh ki la ïasoh lang ha ka jingduwai sha U Blei :  Ko Kynrad bad ko Nongthaw ïa ka bneng , ka pyrthei , bad ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kaba don ha ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki sha U Blei da kawei ka jingmut bad ki la ong: Ko Trai, me long U Blei uba la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew bad ka duriaw bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki:

en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .
kha: Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang ban pyn-i ïa kaei ba ka long ka jingpalat , bad la thmu ba kan neh haduh ka jingwan uta u nonghiarpateng jong u Abraham , ha uba la pynlong ïa ka jingkular . Ïa ka Hukum la aiti da ki angel , lem bad u briew uba ïeng kum u ksiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei te ka shakri ia ka hukum ? La pyndap ia ka namar ki jingpynkhein , haduh ba u symbai un wan ha uba la leh ia ka jingkular ; bad la pynbeit ia ka da ki angel ha ka kti jong u nongpyniasuk .

en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her , which shall make her land desolate , and none shall dwell therein : they shall remove , they shall depart , both man and beast .
kha: Ka jaitbynriew na shatei ka la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia bad yn pynlong ri shyiap ïa ka . Ki briew bad ki mrad kin phet krad noh , bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka liang mihngi ka wan ka jaitbynriew pyrshah ia ka, kaba pynlong ia ka ri jong ka ban jah rngai noh, bad ym don ba shong hangta: kin leit noh, ki briew bad ki mrad .

en: Therefore , behold , the days come , that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon : and her whole land shall be confounded , and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her .
kha: Bad ka por ka poi haba ngan leh ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilonia . Ïa ka ri baroh kawei yn buh ha ka jinglehrain , bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh yn pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ba ngan leh ia ka jingbishar halor ki dur ba la ker jong ka Babilon: bad ka ri jong ka baroh kawei kan sa shah pynjah burom , bad baroh ka ri jong ka kan hap hapdeng jong ka .

en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi men ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban kren ïa kaba me la duh noh , bad men ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka rukom men long ka dak ïa ki briew , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka shyntur jong me kan plie ia uta uba la lait im, bad me dei ban kren , bad wat long shuh uba dum: bad me long ka dak ha ki ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: The  Lord  shall bring upon thee , and upon thy people , and upon thy father s house , days that have not come , from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah  ; even the king of Assyria .
kha: U  Trai  un wallam halor jong phi , halor ki briew jong phi , bad halor ka longïing syiem baroh kawei , ïa ki sngi jingjynjar kiba kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kaba lah wan naduh ba ka hima Israel ka la khlad na ka Judah — un wallam ïa u syiem ka Assyria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un wanrah ia me bad ia ki briew jong me bad ha ka iing u kpa jong me, ki sngi ki bym pat wan, naduh ka sngi ba u Ephraham u la leit noh na Judah; wat ia u syiem Assyria .

en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first , that he went through the corn fields  ; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn , and did eat , rubbing them in their hands .
kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la sdang ban kheit ïa ki kop kew , ki kyrjaw ïa ki ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki bam ïa ki symboh kew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka Sabha kaba ar hadien kaba nyngkong, ba u la iaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ; bad ki synran jong u ki la ot ia ki shkor kew bad ki la bam ia ki da kaba khleh ia ki ha ki kti jong ki .

en: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations  ; Gershon , and Kohath , and Merari : and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years .
kha: U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari ; kine ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki jait kiba ai kyrteng da ki . U Lebi u la im haduh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi kat kum ki pateng jong ki beg u Gerson bad u Kohat bad u Merari: bad ki snem ka jingim u Lebi ki long shispah laiphew hynriew snem .

en: And when she was baptized , and her household , she besought us , saying , If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house , and abide there . And she constrained us .
kha: Hadien ba ma ka bad ki dkhot jong ka ïing jong ka ki la shah pynbaptis , ka la khot sngewbha ïa ngi ,  To wan bad sah hapoh ka ïing jong nga lada phi la pdiang ba nga long ka parabangeit bashisha ha U Trai .  Bad ka la pynkohnguh ïa ngi ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la pynbaptis ia ka bad ka iing jong ka, ka la kyrpad ia ngi, ka da ong: Lada phi la bishar ia nga ban long uba iaineh ha U Trai, to wan shapoh iing jong nga bad to sah hangta . Bad ka la khang ia ngi .

en: Hath given forth upon usury , and hath taken increase : shall he then live ? he shall not live : he hath done all these abominations  ; he shall surely die  ; his blood shall be upon him .
kha: bad u ai kylliang pisa na ka bynta ban ïohnong . Hato un im ? Em , un ym im . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli , bad kumta un ïap . Un long uba la shah kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u la ai ha ka jingmyntoi , bad u la nang kiew: hato un im ? un ym im: un ym im: u la leh ia kine ki jingleh bymman baroh; u la iap shisha; ka snam jong u kan long halor jong u .
