en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother , Come up with me into my lot , that we may fight against the Canaanites  ; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot . So Simeon went with him .
kha: Ki paid Judah ki ong ha ki paid Simeon ,  Ale leit bad ngi sha ka ri ba la ai ha ngi , bad ngin ïakhun lang ïa ki Kanaan . Nangta ngin ïaleit bad phi sha ka ri kaba la ai ha phi .  Kumta ki jait Simeon
translated_en_to_kha: U Judah u la ong ha u hynmen jong u u Simeon, To wan ryngkat bad nga ha ka bynta jong nga, ba ngin ialeh pyrshah ia ki nong Kanaan ; bad kumjuh ruh ngan leit bad me ha ka bynta jong me . Kumta u Simeon u la leit bad u .

en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .
kha: Haba phi pang  ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki ong ïa phi , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai ïa kiba nga la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh, ba phin peit bniah, bad leh katba kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ki lyngdoh ki Lebi kin hikai ia phi: kumba nga la hukum ia ki , kumta phin peit bniah ban leh .

en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said unto them , Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord .
kha: U Joshua u la khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ong ha ki ,  Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad hynñiew ngut na phi kin leit ha shuwa jong phi , da kaba kieng ïa ki turoi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u khun u Nun u la khot ia ki lyngdoh bad u la ong ha ki: To shim ia ka synduk ka jutang bad ai ba hynriew ngut ki lyngdoh kin rah hynriew tylli ki turoi langbrot ha khmat ka synduk U Trai .

en: And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .
kha: U Laban u leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u leit sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Leah , bad sha ka ïingjaiñ jong kita ki ar ngut ki mraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa ki blei jong u . Nangta u leit rung sa ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka Rakhel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la leit sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob, bad sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u Lea, bad sha ki ar tylli ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongtrei; hynrei um shym la lap ia ki . Nangta u la mih na ka ïingjaiñ jong u Lea, bad u la rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Rakhel .

en: But the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots , and forty thousand footmen , and killed Shophach the captain of the host .
kha: Ka jingïaleh ka sdang , bad ki Israel ki pynher krad ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria sha la ka jaka . U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki pynïap hynñiew hajar ngut ki nongñiah kali ïapom jong ki Syria bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . Ki pynïap ruh ïa u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum ki Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki Syria ki la phet noh ha khmat ki Israel; bad u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki Syria hynriew hajar ngut ki briew kiba ialeh ha ki kali kit mar, bad sawphew hajar ngut ki nongialehkai kjat, bad u la pyniap ia u Shopah u rangbah shipai .

en: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land : for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt .
kha: U syiem Ijipt bad ka kynhun shipai jong u kim ju mih shuh shabar ka Ijipt , namar u syiem Babilonia mynta u synshar ïa baroh ka ri kaba dei jong ka Ijipt , naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaduh ka pud bashatei jong ka Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem Ijipt um shym la wan shuh na ka ri jong u: namar u syiem Babilon u la shim na ka wah Ijipt haduh ka wah Euphrates baroh kaba iadei bad u syiem Ijipt .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki kum ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong ki paid ; Ha khmih, ngan phah ia ki ia ka waitlam, ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingpang khlam, bad ngan pynlong ia ki kum ki soh ba sniew, kiba ym lah ban bam, ki long kiba sniew haduh katta katta .

en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .
kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ bad ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh ban kot ïa ki lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ki dieng kiba khlain na ka bynta ki dieng jong ki kiba thylli, bad ka jinglong jong ka ka la kiew hapdeng ki tnat kiba jylliew , bad ka la paw ha ka jingjrong jong ka da ki tnat jong ka kiba bun .

en: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David  ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .
kha: Ka kynthei nong Kanaan kaba shong ba sah ha kata ka thain ka la wan sha u .  Ko khun u Dabid !  ka la pyrta jam .  To isynei ïa nga , ko Kynrad ! Ka khun jong nga ka don u ksuid bad ka don ha ka jinglong bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, kawei ka kynthei Kana ka la mih na kijuh ki rud duriaw, bad ka la pyrta ia u, ka la ong: To isynei ia nga ko Trai, ko Khun u Dabid; ka khun jong nga ka la sngewsih shibun eh bad u ksuid .

en: And whiles I was speaking , and praying , and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel , and presenting my supplication before the  Lord  my God for the holy mountain of my God  ;
kha: Nga la bteng ban duwai , da kaba phla ïa ki pop jong nga bad ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel , bad da kaba ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ban pynbha pat ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga dang kren , bad nga dang duwai , bad nga phla ia ka pop jong nga bad ka pop jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel , bad nga ai ia ka jingkyrpad jong nga ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong nga na ka bynta u lum bakhuid jong U Blei jong nga;

en: O my soul , come not thou into their secret  ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .
kha: Da lei lei ngan ym ïadon bad ki ha ki jingïaphylliew jingmut barieh jong ki . Da lei lei ngan ym ïasyllok lang bad ki ha ki jingïakynduh jong ki , naba haba ki khie bitar ki pynïap ïa ki briew , bad ki pyndkoh ïa ki masi shynrang kum ka jinglehkai sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko mynsiem jong nga, wat wan sha ka jingiaseng jong ki kaba rieh, ko burom jong nga, wat long ba me long uba iatylli: namar ha ka jingbitar jong ki ki la pyniap ia u briew bad ha ka mon jong ki ki la tih ia ka kynroh .

en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram s wife was Sarai  ; and the name of Nahor s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .
kha: U Abram u la shongkurim ïa ka Sarai , bad u Nahor u la shongkurim ïa ka Milkah , ka khun jong u Haran , uba long ruh u kpa jong ka Iskah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abram bad u Nahor ki la shim ia ki: ka kyrteng jong u Abram ka long ka Sarai ; bad ka kyrteng jong u Nahor ka long ka Melkah ka khun u Haran u kpa u Melkah bad u kpa u Isak .

en: So he came near where I stood : and when he came , I was afraid , and fell upon my face : but he said unto me , Understand , O son of man : for at the time of the end shall be the vision .
kha: U Gabriel u la wan bad u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad nga la sheptieng katta katta ba nga kyllon ha khyndew . U la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to shemphang ïa ka jingmut . Ka jingïohipaw ka ïadei bad ka jingkut jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la wan hajan ka jaka ba nga ieng: bad haba u la wan, nga la tieng, bad nga la dem khrup ha ka khmat jong nga: hynrei u la ong ha nga: Sngewthuh ko khun u briew: namar ha ka por kaba kut kan long ka jingphohsniew .

en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .
kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki nongrit sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Baalath Beer ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Simeon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shnong baroh kiba la don sawdong ia kine ki shnong ha Balathbeer , Ramath jong ka ri Sepngi . Kane ka long ka pateng jong ka jaitbynriew u Simeon kat kum ki longiing jong ki .

en: And Jacob said , O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac , the  Lord  which saidst unto me , Return unto thy country , and to thy kindred , and I will deal well with thee :
kha: Nangta u Jakob u la duwai ,  A U Blei jong u parad jong nga u Abraham , bad U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Isaak , to shahshkor ïa nga ! Me la bthah ïa nga , A  Trai  , ban leit phai pat sha la ka ri bad sha la ki kur ki jait , bad men pynbiang ba kiei kiei baroh kin ïaid beit bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong: Ko Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Abraham bad U Blei jong u kpa jong nga u Isaak, U Trai uba la ong ha nga: To leit phai noh sha ka ri jong me bad sha ka ri jong me bad ha ka ri jong me bad ngan leh bha ia me:

en: And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .
kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lai , u la ong ïa ki ,  Hato phi dang ïohthiah bad dang shongthait ? Ka la biang ! Ka kynta ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U Khun U Briew yn ai noh mynta ha ka bor jong ki briew kiba pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u wan ha ka sien kaba lai , bad u ong ha ki, To thiah mynta bad to shim ia ka jingjahthait jong phi: ka la biang, ka kynta ka la poi ; ha khmih , u Khun u briew u la shah pyndem ha ki kti jong ki nongpop .

en: And when they entered unto the heathen , whither they went , they profaned my holy name , when they said to them , These are the people of the  Lord  , and are gone forth out of his land .
kha: Kat shaba ki leit , ki pynlehrain ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ba ki briew ki ïoh kynnoh , ‘ Kine ki long ki briew jong U  Trai  , pynban ki hap ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la rung sha ki nongwei, ha kaba ki la leit noh, ki la pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga, haba ki la ong ha ki: Kine ki long ki briew jong U Trai bad ki la leit noh na ka ri jong u .

en: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it , shall be of the same , according to the work thereof  ; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha da kijuh ki tiar dei ban pyndait ha ka ephod khnang ba kan ïalong kawei ka lyngkhot bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkren lyngkot jong ka ephod kaba don halor jong ka, kan long kumjuh, kat kum ka jingtrei jong ka.

en: Saying , Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name ? and , behold , ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine , and intend to bring this man s blood upon us .
kha: Ngi la ai ha phi ïa ki hukum bapyrkhing ban ym hikai ha ka kyrteng jong une u briew ,  u la ong ;  hynrei peit kaei kaba phi la leh ! Phi la pynphriang ïa ka jinghikai jong phi kylleng ka Jerusalem , bad phi kwah ban pynlong ïa ngi kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Hato ngim shym la hukum ia phi ba phin ym hikai ha kane ka kyrteng ? bad , ha khmih , phi la pyndap ia ka Jerusalem da ka jinghikai jong phi , bad phi thmu ban wanrah ia kane ka snam ha ngi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?
kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , Hato me la pyrkhat ia u shakri jong nga u Job, ba ym don uwei ruh uba kum ma u ha ka khyndew, u briew uba janai bad uba hok, uba sheptieng ia U Blei bad uba sngewsih ia ka jingsniew ?

en: Behold , I am against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , and rock of the plain , saith the  Lord   ; which say , Who shall come down against us ? or who shall enter into our habitations ?
kha: Pha ko Jerusalem , pha kaba shong shajrong eh na ki ri them , kum u mawsiang uba ïeng shajrong na ka madan . Hynrei ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha . Pha ong ba ym don ba lah ban tur ïaleh ïa pha ne ban pynpra ïa ki jingker jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me ko nongshong shnong jong ka them bad u maw jong ka madan , ong U Trai ; uba ong , Mano ba wan hiar pyrshah ia ngi ? lane mano ba rung ha ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ngi ?

en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong , whom ye see and know : yea , the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .
kha: Ka long ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u kaba la ai jingkhlaiñ ïa une u briew uba dkoh . Ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi bad tip , la leh da ka jingngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u ; ka long ka jingngeit ha U Jisu kaba la pynkhiah ïa u , kumba phi baroh phi ïohi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kyrteng jong u lyngba ka jingngeit ha ka kyrteng jong u ka la pynlong ia une u briew uba khlain: hooid, ka jingngeit kaba don da u ka la ai ia u ia kane ka jingkhlain kaba janai ha khmat jong phi baroh .

en: And the  Lord  called Samuel again the third time . And he arose and went to Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou didst call me . And Eli perceived that the  Lord  had called the child .
kha: U  Trai  u khot biang ïa u Samuel ha ka sien kaba lai ; u la khie , u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong ,  Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne .  Hangta u Eli u sngewthuh ba dei U  Trai  uba la khot ïa uta u khynnah ;
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la khot biang ia u Samuel ha ka sien kaba lai . U la ieng bad u la leit sha u Eli, bad u la ong: Hangne nga don; namar me la khot ia nga . Bad u Eli u la sngewthuh ba U Trai u la khot ia uta u khynnah .

en: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again , and said , Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth .
kha: Nangta kata ka sur ïa kaba nga la ïohsngew kaba kren na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga , ka da ong ,  To leit bad shim ïa ka kot kli kaba la plied kaba don ha ka kti jong u angel uba ïeng halor kata ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur kaba nga la iohsngew na bneng ka la kren biang ha nga, bad ka la ong: To leit shim ia ka kot barit kaba plie ha ka kti jong u angel uba ieng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew .

en: And Ahab said , By whom ? And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces . Then he said , Who shall order the battle ? And he answered , Thou .
kha: Mano ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh ?  u Ahab u kylli . U nongïathuhlypa u la jubab ,  U  Trai  u ong ba ki shipai samla hapoh ka hukum jong ki lat jong ki distrik kin leh ïa kata .   Mano ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun kaba kongsan ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ma me ,  u nongïathuhlypa u la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u la ong: Da mano ? Bad u la ong, Kumta u ong U Trai, Wat da ki samla jong ki nongsynshar jong ki ri . Nangta u la ong , Mano ba dei ban hukum ia ka thma ? Bad u la jubab , Me .

en: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared , that thou hast lied , and hast not remembered me , nor laid it to thy heart ? have not I held my peace even of old , and thou fearest me not ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kiei kine ki blei kiba pynsheptieng ïa phi , kumta ba phi ïathuh ïa nga ïa kaba lamler bad klet syndon ïa nga ? Hato phim shym la ai burom shuh ïa nga namar ba nga la shu sngap la slem bah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na kiba me la tieng ne tieng, ba me la thok bad ngam kynmaw ia nga, ne nga la buh ia ka ha ka dohnud jong me ? hato ngam shym la bat ia ka jingsuk jong nga wat naduh mynshuwa , bad me khlem tieng ia nga ?

en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods , and one call thee , and thou eat of his sacrifice  ;
kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri , namar haba ki mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki , bad kñia ha ki , kin sa khot sngewbha ïa phi ban ïasoh bad ki , bad phin shah pynshoi ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki ai ïa ki blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To leh ia ka jutang bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, bad ki leit shongkurim hadien ki blei jong ki, bad ki knia ia ki blei jong ki, bad uwei u khot ia me, bad me bam ia ka jingknia jong u;

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoash kiba u la leh bad ka bor jong u bad kumno u la ialeh bad u Amaiah syiem Judah , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Haba nga ïohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , nga la tip skhem ba un sa ïathuh ha u Saul . Kumta nga kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abiatar , Nga la tip ia kata ha kata ka sngi, haba u Doeg u la don hangta, ba un sa iathuh shisha ha u Saul: Nga la pynlong ia ka jingiap jong ki briew baroh jong ka iing u kpa jong me .

en: Behold , the  Lord  hath proclaimed unto the end of the world , Say ye to the daughter of Zion , Behold , thy salvation cometh  ; behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .
kha: Ba U  Trai  u la pynbna shaduh ka pyrthei baroh :  To ong ha ki paid ka Jerusalem ba U Trai un wan ban ïada ïa phi un wallam bad u ïa ki briew kiba u la pyllait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , U Trai u la pynbna haduh kaba kut jong ka pyrthei , To ong ia ka khun jong u Seion , Ha khmih ka jingpynim jong me ka wan; ha khmih ka bainong jong u ka don bad u bad ka kam jong u ha khmat jong u .

en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .
kha: Uwei uwei u kherub u don saw tylli ki durkhmat . Ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka dei ka jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jong u sing , bad kaba saw ka jong u pukni .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u don saw tylli ki khmat: ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka long ka khmat jong u cherub , bad ka khmat kaba ar ka long ka khmat jong u briew , bad kaba lai ka khmat jong u sing , bad kaba saw ka khmat jong u blang .

en: But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hairs therein , and if it be not lower than the skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
kha: Hynrei ynda u lyngdoh u la peit bniah ïa kata ka dak bad u shem ba u shñiuh uba hangta um pat kylla lieh , bad ba kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u lyngdoh u peit ia ka, bad, ha khmih, ym don shniuh lieh ha ka, bad lada kam kham duna ban ia ka sniehdoh, hynrei ka long kaba dum katto katne ; te u lyngdoh un khang ia u hynriew sngi:

en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .
kha: U  Trai  u wan na ka jaka shong jong u na bneng ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei namar ki pop jong ki . Ki jingpynïap briew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kan ym lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, U Trai u mih na ka jaka jong u ban pynshitom ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew namar ka jingbymhok jong ki: ka khyndew ruh kan pynpaw ia ka snam jong ka , bad kan ym tap shuh ia ka jingpyniap jong ka .

en: Shall not the land tremble for this , and every one mourn that dwelleth therein ? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood  ; and it shall be cast out and drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
kha: Bad kumta ka khyndew kan khynñiuh , bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un long ha ka jinglanot . Ka ri baroh kawei kan khynñiuh ; kan kiew bad kan hiar kum ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka ri kan ym khih na ka bynta kane, bad uwei pa uwei un iam ha ka ? bad kan kiew baroh kawei kum ka jingshlei um ; bad kan sa shah bret noh bad shah rong noh kum ka jingshlei um jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
kha: Wat kñia ïa la ki khun da kaba thang ïa ki ha ka duwan jong phi ; wat shah ïa la ki briew ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ym dei ban shem hapdeng jong phi ia uno uno u khun jong u ne ka khun jong u ban iaid lyngba ka ding , ne uba pyndonkam ia ka jingleh jadu ne u nongleh jadu .

en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the  Lord  , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid , and gave it to the king of Assyria .
kha: u khlong ïa ka ksiar na ki jingkhang ka templ bad ïa ka ksiar kaba u hi u la tap ïa ki shawkad jingkhang , bad u phah lut ïa ka sha u Sennakherib .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Hesekaiah u la ot noh ia ka ksiar na ki jingkhang jong ka tempi U Trai bad na ki maw kiba u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah u la buh palat ia ka ksiar bad u la ai ia ka ha u syiem Assyria .

en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me ? because he humbleth himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days : but in his son s days will I bring the evil upon his house .
kha: Me la ïohi ne em kumno u Ahab u la pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga ? Namar ba u la leh kumne , ngan ym pynjot ïa u katba u dang im ; kan long ha ka pateng u khun jong u , ba ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ka longïing jong u Ahab .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi iohi ia lade ha khmat jong nga ? namar u pynrit ia lade ha khmat jong nga: hynrei ha ki sngi jong u ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha ka iing jong u .

en: And stay ye not , but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them  ; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the  Lord  your God hath delivered them into your hand .
kha: hynrei ma phi pat wat sah hangta . Ïai beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi , bad tur ïaleh ïa ki na shadien ; wat ailad ba kin ïohrung sha la ki jong ki nongbah ! U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat sah ha ki nongshun jong phi, hynrei to beh ia ki nongshun jong phi, bad to pynkhih ia kiba hadien tam jong ki; to ai ba kin rung sha ki shnong jong ki: namar U Trai U Blei jong phi u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong phi .

en: Jesus Christ himself said : “Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out .”—John 5 :28 , 29  ; Acts 24 :15 .
kha: U Jisu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “Wat sngew kyndit ia kane , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jing tep kin ioh sngew ia ka jingpyrta jong u bad kin ia mih noh .” —Ioanis 5 :28 , 29 ; Ki Kam 24 :15 .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu Khrist hi u la ong: Wat sngewphylla ia kane, namar ka kynta kan sa wan ha kaba baroh kiba don ha ki jingtep jingkynmaw kin iohsngew ia ka sur jong u bad kin mih noh .

en: And Moses took them from off their hands , and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering : they were consecrations for a sweet savour : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka jingbam na ki bad u thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , halor ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh jingpynkyntang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh bam , bad ka jingiw na ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la shim ia ki na ki kti jong ki, bad u la thang ia ki ha ka jingknia thang: ki la long ki jingpynkyntang na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang: ka long ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .
kha: Lymne ym don uno uno u ban theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ kaba thymmai la theh noh ha ki lwa snieh bym pat ju pyndonkam , bad baroh ar kin neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shynrang ruh kim buh ia ka wain thymmai ha ki bilor barim: lym kumta ki bilor ki mih noh , bad ka wain ka tuid noh , bad ki bilor ki jah noh: hynrei ki buh ia ka wain thymmai ha ki bilor thymmai , bad baroh ar ki long kiba la pynneh pynsah .

en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days : but , lo , Michael , one of the chief princes , came to help me  ; and I remained there with the kings of Persia .
kha: U angel jong u khun syiem jong ka hima Persia u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga haduh arphew wei sngi . Nangta u Mikhael , uwei na ki angel rangbah , u la wan ban ïarap ïa nga , namar nga la shah iehnoh marwei hangta ha Persia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem jong ka hima Persia u la ialeh pyrshah ia nga shiphew sngi: hynrei, ha khmih, u Michael, uwei na ki syiem rangbah, u la wan iarap ia nga ; bad nga la sah hangta bad ki syiem Persia .

en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering , so shall he do with this : and the priest shall make an atonement for them , and it shall be forgiven them .
kha: Un leh kumjuh ïa une u masi lyngraw kumba u ju leh ïa u masi lyngraw jong ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u paidlang , bad yn map ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un leh ia u masi kumba u la leh ia u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop: bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki , bad yn map ia ki .

en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One  ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :
kha: Hato ym don u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pynshitom beiñ ? Ki la pynïap ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kiba slem bah mynshuwa ki la pynbna ïa ka jingwan jong u shakri bahok jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano na ki nongiathuhlypa ki bym shym la shah pynshitom bein ? bad ki la pyniap ia ki kiba la pyni ha khmat ka jingwan jong U Blei uba phi la long mynta ki nongshet kylla bad ki nongpyniap briew:

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shields , nor cast a bank against it .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang u patsha Assyria : ‘ Un ym ïohrung ha kane ka nongbah lane siat ïa uwei u khnam pyrshah ïa ka . Yn ym don ki shipai lem bad ki stieh ki ban wan hajan ka nongbah , bad yn ym don ka kynton ba la tei ha sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai shaphang u syiem Assyria , Un ym wan sha kane ka shnong , lymne un ym siat ia u khnam hangta , lymne un ym wan ha khmat jong ka da ki shipai , lymne un ym bret ia ka bank pyrshah ia ka .

en: And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :
kha: Dang tang khyndiat sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki para Israel , bad phi la pynlong ïa ka jutang ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ha ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta phi la kylla long uba hok ha khmat jong nga, ha kaba pynbna ia ka jinglaitluid uwei pa uwei ha u paramarjan jong u ; bad phi la leh ia ka jutang ha khmat jong nga ha ka iing kaba la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga:

en: The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”
kha: U apostol Paul u la ong ha kawei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha phi yn pyniasngew tngen lem ia nga bad phi , da la ka jingngeit jingngeit . . . ka jong phi ruh bad ka jong nga de .”
translated_en_to_kha: U apostol Paul u la iathuh ha kawei na ki jingiaseng ha ka sngi jong u: Nga kwah eh ban iohi ia phi, . . . ba ngin ioh ia ka jingkylla jong ka jingpynshlur iwei ia iwei pat.

en: And ye , in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing , lest ye make yourselves accursed , when ye take of the accursed thing , and make the camp of Israel a curse , and trouble it .
kha: Hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa kano kano kaba dei ïa ka ban pynjot ; lada phi leh kumta , phin wanrah ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpynjot ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi, ha kano kano ka rukom kaba stad, ioh ia lade na kaei kaei kaba la shah tim, haba phi shim ia kaei kaei kaba la shah tim, bad phi pynlong ia ka kynhun Israel ka jingtim, bad phi pynshitom ia ka .

en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath , he and his men , every man with his household , even David with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the Carmelitess , Nabal s wife .
kha: U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki sah ha Gath ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . U Dabid u don ar ngut ki tnga lem bad u , ka Ahinoam na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shong bad u Achish ha Gath, ma u bad ki briew jong u, uwei pa uwei bad ka iing jong u, wat u Dabid bad ki arngut ki tnga jong u, u Ahinoam ka Jesril, bad u Abigail ka Karmelis, ka tnga jong u Nabal .

en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves , and to all the flock , over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers , to feed the church of God , which he hath purchased with his own blood .
kha: To sumar bha ïa lade bad ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ïa kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la buh ha ka jingsumar jong phi . To sharai ïa ka balang U Blei , ïa kaba u la pynlong ka jong u hi lyngba ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u khun jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade bad ia ka kynhun langbrot baroh kaba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la pynlong ia phi ki nongpeitkai , ban ai bam ia ka balang U Blei kaba u la thied da ka snam jong u hi .

en: Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .
kha: Haba u rangbah shipai bad ki shipai kiba bad u , kiba la ïa-ap ïa U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa u jumai bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ong ,  Da shisha u la long U Khun U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u rangbah bad kito kiba don ryngkat bad u, ki la iohi ia u Jisu, ki la iohi ia ka jingkhynñiuh jumai bad kita kiei kiei kiba la jia, ki la tieng shibun, ki la ong: Hooid une u long U Khun U Blei .

en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .
kha: Ynda ngi la kam kynti ïa kata ka ri , nga ai ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ïa ka jaka kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer hajan ka wah Arnon bad shiteng na ka ri lum Gilead lem bad ki shnong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka ri kaba ngi la don ha kata ka por, na Aroer, kaba don harud ka wah Arnon, bad shiteng u lum Gilead bad ki shnong jong ka, nga la ai ha ki Reuben bad ha ki Gadit .

en: But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .
kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U  Trai  , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kata baroh ïa kaba la hukum ïa u ban kren ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u la leit shapoh U Trai ban kren bad u, u la weng noh ia ka jingtap haduh ba un da mih noh . U la mih noh bad u la kren ha ki khun Israel ia kaba u la hukum .

en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh . Nga pynthikna ïa pha ba phan ym ïohi ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi haba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ka iing jong phi ka la sah ha phi: bad shisha nga ong ha phi , Phin ym iohi ia nga haduh ka por ba phin ong: La kyrkhu ia uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng U Trai .

en: So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .
kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka bynta kaba khatduh jong ka jingim u Job kham palat ban ïa kaba u la kyrkhu ha kaba mynnyngkong . U Job u long trai ïa ki khatsaw hajar tylli ki langbrot , hynriew hajar tylli ki ut , ar hajar tylli ki masi , bad shihajar tylli ki kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta U Trai u la kyrkhu ia ka bynta kaba khatduh jong u Job kham palat ia ka jingsdang jong u: namar u don shiphew hajar tylli ki langbrot bad hynriew hajar tylli ki kulai bad shi hajar tylli ki masi .

en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .
kha: Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi bad wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih noh ia phi na ki briew , bad ngan lum ia phi na ki ri ha kaba phi la saphriang , da ka kti kaba khlain bad da ka kti kaba la pynjrong shabar .

en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .
kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba ka balang ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa bad Samaria ka la ïoh shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la nang san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki balang ki la shongthait ha kylleng ka ri Judaea bad ka Galilaia bad ka Samaria baroh kawei, bad ki la nang kiew bad ki la iaid ha ka jingtieng ia U Trai, bad ha ka jingpyntngen U Mynsiem Bakhuid, ki la nang bun .

en: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .
kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , ba haba ka por ka poi ïa ki ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei , phin sa kynmaw ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .  Ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba mynnyngkong , naba nga la don lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia kine kiei kiei nga la iathuh ha phi , ba ynda la poi ka por , phin kynmaw ba nga la iathuh ia phi shaphang jong ki . Bad ia kine kiei kiei ngam shym la ong ha phi ha kaba sdang , namar nga la don ryngkat bad phi .

en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet , until his disease was exceeding great : yet in his disease he sought not to the  Lord  , but to the physicians .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai ba u Asa u long syiem , u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat kaba jur ; wat la katta ruh um shym la phai sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , hynrei sha ki nongpynkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynniew jong ka jingsynshar jong u u la pang ha ki kjat jong u, haduh ba ka jingpang jong u ka la nang jur palat: hynrei ha ka jingpang jong u um shym la wad ia U Trai , hynrei ia ki doktor .

en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .
kha: Te , kumba u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kata ka sngi ban mane ïa U  Trai  , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta baroh ka jingshakri jong U Trai ka la long ha kajuh ka sngi , ban pynlong ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait bad ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha ka almari U Trai kat kum ka hukum jong u syiem Josiah .

en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .
kha: U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Iso ba u wan lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah . Kumta u pynïabynta ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga kliar ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la rah ia ki khmat jong u, bad u la peit, bad, ha khmih, u Iso u la wan bad u saw spah ngut ki briew . Bad u la phiah ia ki khun ha ka Leah bad ha ka Rakhel bad ha ki arngut ki nongtrei .

en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David  ; they were sore displeased ,
kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la bitar haba ki la ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh bad ba ki khynnah ki ïa-pyrta ha ka Templ ,  To ïaroh ïa U Khun u Dabid !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh ki la iohi ia kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh, bad ki khynnah ki iam ha ka tempi bad ki ong: Hosanna ia u Khun u Dabid; ki la sngewsih shibun .

en: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise , as some men count slackness  ; but is longsuffering to us-ward , not willing that any should perish , but that all should come to repentance .
kha: U Trai um pyntud ban leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular , kumba don kiba pyrkhat . Pynban , u long uba ïaishah slem bad phi , namar um kwah ïano ïano ban jot noh , hynrei u kwah ba baroh kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai um long uba sniew ha kaba iadei bad ka jingkular jong u, kumba don ki briew kiba khein ia ka jinglong lyngkar ha ngi, ym da kaba mon ba uno uno un jah noh, hynrei ba baroh kin wan sha ka jingkylla kaba mut.

en: His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant  ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u u la ong ha u, To leh bha, ko shakri uba bha bad uba iaineh halor kiei kiei kiba rit, ngan pynlong ia me ban synshar halor kiei kiei kiba bun: to rung ha ka jingkmen jong u kynrad jong me .

en: And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .
kha: Hangne halor u Lum Seïon , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynkhreh ka jingkhawai bah na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei — ka jingkhawai bah da ki jingbam bakyrhai eh bad ka waiñ bakynsai tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha une u lum U Trai jong ki paid un pynlong ia ki briew baroh ka jingkhawai kaba heh , ka jingkhawai wain ha ki lum ba la pyndap da ka sniehdoh .

en: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me  ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .
kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor kaba me la ai ha nga , bad ki la pdiang ïa ka ; ki tip ba ka long kaba shisha ba nga la wan na me , bad ki ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la ai ha ki ia ki ktien kiba me la ai ha nga ; bad ki la pdiang ia ki, bad ki la tip shisha ba nga la mih na me , bad ki la ngeit ba me la phah ia nga .

en: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .
kha: Nga la pyn-i ha phi ha kiei kiei baroh ba da kaba trei shitom ha kane ka rukom ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , da kaba kynmaw ïa ki ktien kiba U Trai Jisu da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ka don ka jingkmen kaba kham khraw ha kaba ai ban ïa kaba pdiang .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pyni ia kiei kiei baroh , kumno kata ka long kaba kham duna ban kyrshan ia kiba tlot , bad ban kynmaw ia ki ktien U Trai Jisu , kumno u la ong , Ka kham suk ban ai ban ia kaba pdiang .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .
kha: Kumta nga la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingisynei ïa ka nongbah . Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka Templ jong nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn tei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai u la pynphai biang ia nga sha Jerusalem da ki jingsngewrit: ka iing jong nga kan long ha ka , ong U Trai jong ki paid , bad u lain un sa pynjrong sha Jerusalem .

en: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon  ; and it shall be , when thou wilt ease thyself abroad , thou shalt dig therewith , and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee :
kha: Rah uwei u dieng kum shi bynta jong ki tiar jong phi , khnang ba ha ka por ba phi leit shabar , phi lah ban tih thliew bad ban tep pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban don ka jingleit sha ka tiar jong me ; bad kan long, haba me sngewbha ia lade shabar ri, men tih da kata, bad men phai biang bad tap ia kata kaba wan na me:

en: Then came the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , into the desert of Zin in the first month : and the people abode in Kadesh  ; and Miriam died there , and was buried there .
kha: Ha u bnai uba nyngkong , u paid Israel baroh u wan poi ha ka ri khlaw Sin bad u shong dara ha Kadesh . Hangta ka Miriam ka la ïap bad la tep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Israel, wat ka kynhun baroh kawei, ki la wan sha ka ri khlaw Zin ha ka taiew kaba nyngkong: bad ki briew ki la shong ha Kadesh ; bad ka Miriam ka la iap hangta , bad la tep ia u hangta .

en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people : for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel , because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah .
kha: U Aaron un ym ïohrung ha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki Israel ; un sa ïap noh , namar baroh ar ngut phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum jong nga ha Meribah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un ialum lang ha ki briew jong u: namar un ym rung sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki khun Israel , namar ba phi la leh pyrshah ia ka ktien jong nga ha ka um Meribah .

en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh . For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth , much more shall not we escape , if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven :
kha: Te , to sumar bad wat kyntait ban shahshkor ïa uta uba kren . Kita kiba kyntait ïa uta uba ïathuh ïa ka khubor ba kynja bneng ha pyrthei kim shym lait im . Sa katno tam ma ngi , ngin ïohlait im , te , lada ngi phai noh na uta uba kren na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ba phim kyntait ia uta uba kren . Namar lada kim shym la lait im ia uta uba la kyntait ia uta uba kren ha ka khyndew, kham bun ngin ym lait im, lada ngi phai noh na uta uba kren na bneng:

en: And I stood upon the sand of the sea , and saw a beast rise up out of the sea , having seven heads and ten horns , and upon his horns ten crowns , and upon his heads the name of blasphemy .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei u mradkhlaw uba wan mih na duriaw . U la don shiphew tylli ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ; halor kawei pa kawei jong ki reng jong ka , la don ka pansngiat , bad halor kawei pa kawei jong ki khlieh jong ka la don ka kyrteng kaba krenbeiñ Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ieng halor ka dewbilat jong ka duriaw , bad nga la iohi ia u mrad uba la mih na ka duriaw , uba don hynriew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki bniat jong u , bad halor ki bniat jong u shiphew tylli ki khlieh jong u .

en: Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .
kha: Uei u ban ym pyndonburom ïa me , u syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ? Me dei hok ban ïoh ka pyndonburom . Ym don mano mano uba kum ma me hapdeng ki riewstad baroh jong ki jaitbynriew lane napdeng uno uno u syiem jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba nym tieng ia me ko Syiem ki jaitbynriew ? namar ha me kam long: ka long kaba don hapdeng ki riewstad baroh jong ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki hima jong ki baroh .

en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :
kha: Ko  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , nga long u shakri jong me . Shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad kiba nga la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to burom ia ka jingduwai jong u shakri jong me bad ia ka jingkyrpad jong u, ko Trai jong nga, ban sngap ia ka jingud bad ia ka jingduwai kaba u shakri jong me u duwai ha khmat jong me ha ka sngi:

en: And the children of Israel smote them not , because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel . And all the congregation murmured against the princes .
kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim lah ban pynïap ïa ki , namar ba ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . U paidbah baroh u la ujor ha ki nongïalam shaphang kane ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel kim shym la sngap jar ia ki, namar ki rangbah jong ka jingiaseng ki la smai ha ki da U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel . Bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la ia tyngkhuh bad ki rangbah .

en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .
kha: Hynrei naduh ba ngi sangeh ban ai jingkñia ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng bad ngi sangeh ban theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ngim shym don ei ei shuh , bad ki briew jong ngi ki ïap ha ka thma bad na ka jingïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba ngi la leit noh ban thang ia ka mahadei bneng bad ban theh ia ki jingknia dih sha ka , ngi la kwah ia kiei kiei baroh , bad ngi la shah bam ha ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh bam .

en: And stood at his feet behind him weeping , and began to wash his feet with tears , and did wipe them with the hairs of her head , and kissed his feet , and anointed them with the ointment .
kha: bad ka la ïeng hadien jong U Jisu , hajan ki kjat jong u , ka da ïam bad ka da pynjhieh ïa ki kjat jong u da ki ummat jong ka . Nangta ka la ñiad pynrkhiang ïa ki kjat jong u da u shñiuh jong ka , ka la doh ïa ki , bad ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh ba-iwbih halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng ha ki kjat jong u hadien jong u da kaba iam, bad u la sdang ban sait ia ki kjat jong u da ki ummat , bad u la sait ia ki da ki shniuh khlieh jong ka , bad u la kdup ia ki kjat jong u , bad u la pynsleh ia ki da ka umphniang .

en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .
kha: Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong ngi kiba la ïap kin im biang ! Ki met jong ki kin wan phai biang sha ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba ïohthiah ha ki jingtep jong ki kin kyndit thiah bad kin rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khyndew , kumta ruh U  Trai  un pynkhie im pat ïa kito kiba la ïap la slem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba iap jong me kin im, ryngkat bad ka met iap jong nga kin mih . To khie bad rwai, phi kiba shong ha ka dewbilat: namar ka dewbilat jong me ka long kum ka dewbilat jong ki jingthung , bad ka khyndew kan bret noh ia kiba iap .

en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
kha: Haba u wan , un sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba wan na U  Trai  bad da ka burom jong U  Trai  U Blei hi . Ki briew jong u kin shong ha ka jingshngain namar ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthei kin ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , bad un wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un ieng bad bam ha ka bor U Trai, ha ka jingkhraw jong ka kyrteng U Trai jong u ; bad kin iaineh: namar mynta un long uba khraw haduh ki kut jong ka khyndew .

en: To fulfil the word of the  Lord  by the mouth of Jeremiah , until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths : for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath , to fulfil threescore and ten years .
kha: Bad kumta ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh mynshuwa lyngba u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa la pyndep :  Ka ri kan sa sah kynjah haduh hynñiewphew snem , ban pynïabiang ïa ka jingshongthait Sabbaton , ïa kaba ym pat shym la rakhe .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyndep ia ka ktien U Trai da ka shyntur jong u Jeremaiah , haduh ba ka ri ka la sngewbha ia ki sngi shongthait jong ka: namar katba ka dang sahkut ka la bat ia ka sngi shongthait, ban pyndep ia ka sanphew snem bad shi snem .

en: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me , it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea .
kha: Uno uno u ban pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban duh noh ka jingngeit ha nga , ka kham bha ïa uba kum uta u briew ban pynteh da u mawtylliat uba heh ha ka ryndang jong u bad ban pynngam jyllop hapoh ka duriaw bajylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uno uno uba pynsngewsih ia uwei na kine kiba rit kiba ngeit ha nga, ka la kham bha ia u ba u maw mawsiang u la sahkut ha ka ryndang jong u bad ba u la ngam jyllop ha ka jingjylliew jong ka duriaw .

en: And they burnt the city with fire , and all that was therein : only the silver , and the gold , and the vessels of brass and of iron , they put into the treasury of the house of the  Lord .
kha: Nangta ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah bad ki thang khoit ïa ka , lem bad baroh kiba don ha ka , lait noh kita kiei kiei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nar , ïa kaba ki la shim bad buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thang ia ka shnong da ka ding, bad ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don hangta: tang ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki tiar nar bad nar, ki la buh ha ka jaka buh jingbam jong ka iing U Trai .

en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord  : where I will meet you , to speak there unto thee .
kha: Ha ki por baroh ki ban wan , dei ban ai ïa kane ka jingainguh thang ha khmat jong nga ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kata ka long ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïakren bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kan long ka jingainguh thang kaba iai bteng ha ki pateng jong phi ha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain ha khmat U Trai: ha kaba ngan iakynduh ia phi , ban kren hangta ha me .

en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .
kha: Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga ban ong ha phi shaphang kane ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , ngan ym leh kumta!
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ? hato phim don iing ban bam bad ban dih ? lane phi pynjah burom ia ka balang U Blei , bad phi pynjah burom ia ki ki bym don ? Ngan ong aiu ia phi ha kane ? Ngam iaroh ia phi .

en: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the  Lord . And they took Dagon , and set him in his place again .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki briew ka Ashdod , ki la ïohi ïa u mot jong u Dagon ba u la kyllon da pyllup ha madan ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai . Kumta ki khyllie bad buh biang ïa u ha kajuh ka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki na Ashdod ki la ieng dang step, ha khmih u Dagon u la hap ha khmat jong u ha khyndew ha khmat ka synduk U Trai . Ki la shim ia u Dagon bad ki la buh biang ia u ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .
kha: U la ong ruh ïa ngi ban ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym buh ki bri sohwaiñ lane thied ïa ki . U la hukum ïa ngi ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ , khnang ba ngin don ha kane ka ri ha kaba ngi im kum ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym tei iing, lymne ban bet symbai, lymne ban thung kper sohjew, lymne ban don: hynrei baroh ki sngi jong phi phin shong ha ki ïingjaiñ; ba phin im bun sngi ha ka ri kaba phi long ki nongwei .

en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude , and as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of mighty thunderings , saying , Alleluia : for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba sawa kum u paid uba bun , kum ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , kum ki jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Naba U Trai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh jong ngi , u long U Syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew kumba ka long ka sur jong u paidbah uba bun, bad kum ka sur jong ki um kiba bun, bad kum ka sur jong ki jingsawa kiba khlain bor, ki ong: Aleluia: namar U Trai U Blei uba donbor baroh u synshar .

en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .
kha: Pha la dei ban ym ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad ban kem ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingshipa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me ruh me la ieng ha ka lynti iaid kjat, ban ot noh ia kiba lait na u ; bad me la pyndep ia kiba sah ha ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar .

en: He was oppressed , and he was afflicted , yet he opened not his mouth : he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter , and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb , so he openeth not his mouth .
kha: U la shah lehbeiñ sat , hynrei u la shah da kaba sngewrit ; um shym la kren shikyntien ruh . Kum i khunlangbrot ban sa shah pynïap , kum ka langbrot ka ban sa shah khih ïa la u shñiuh , um shym kren shikyntien ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynshitom bein ia u , bad u la shah pynshitom , hynrei um shym la plie ia ka shyntur jong u: la wanrah ia u kum u langbrot sha ka jingpyniap , bad kum u langbrot ha khmat ki nongpynkhuid jong ka u la lyngngoh , kumta um plie ia ka shyntur jong u .

en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence , which they of that place which the  Lord  shall choose shall shew thee  ; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee :
kha: Kin ai ïa la ka jingrai jong ki , bad phi dei ban leh kumba ki ong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban leh kat kum ka sentens , kaba ki jong kata ka jaka kaba U Trai un jied kin pyni ia me ; bad me dei ban peit ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ki pyntip ia me:

en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart , both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , so that the wrath of the  Lord  came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah .
kha: Khatduh pat u Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki pynrit ïa lade , bad kumta U  Trai  um shym pynshitom ïa ki briew haduh hadien ka jingïap u Hesekaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u Hesekaiah u la pynrit mynsiem ia lade namar ka jingsarong jong ka dohnud jong u, ma u bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem, haduh ba ka jingbitar U Trai kam shym la wan ha ki ha ki sngi u Hesekaiah .

en: When Mordecai perceived all that was done , Mordecai rent his clothes , and put on sackcloth with ashes , and went out into the midst of the city , and cried with a loud and a bitter cry  ;
kha: Haba u Mordekai u tip ïa kata baroh ba la leh , u tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bajur . Nangta u phong da ki jaiñ khain bad sleh ïa ka khlieh da u dpei , bad ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , u da ïam lynñiar kthang , haduh ba un da poi ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Mordecai u la sngewthuh lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la leh, u Mordecai u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u, bad u la phong da ka jainkup bad ka dewbilat bad u la leit shabar hapdeng ka nongbah bad u la iam da ka jingsawa kaba jam bad kaba sngewsih;

en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God , and from his power  ; and no man was able to enter into the temple , till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled .
kha: Ïa ka templ la pyndap da ka tdem na ka burom bad ka bor jong U Blei , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit shapoh ka templ tad haduh ba ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ba la wanrah da ki hynñiew ngut ki angel , ki la poi sha kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tempi ka la dap da ka tdem na ka burom U Blei , bad na ka bor jong u ; bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban rung shapoh ka tempi haduh ba la pyndep ia ki hynriew tylli ki khlam jong ki hynriew ngut ki angel .

en: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom  ; for Moses had laid his hands upon him : and the children of Israel hearkened unto him , and did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U Joshua u khun jong u Nun u long uba la pyndap da ka jingstad , naba u Moses u la thung ïa u ban long u nongshimti pateng . Ki Israel ki kohnguh ïa u Joshua bad ki sumar ïa ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki lyngba u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u khun u Nun u la dap da ka mynsiem jong ka jingstad ; namar u Moses u la buh ia ki kti jong u halor jong u: bad ki khun Israel ki la sngap ia u bad ki la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents , saying , Lord , thou deliveredst unto me five talents : behold , I have gained beside them five talents more .
kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ai ïa kiwei ki san hajar . ‘ Ko kynrad , me la ai ha nga san hajar tylli ki sbai ,’ u la ong . ‘ Ha khmih ! Kine hangne sa san hajar tylli kiba nga la ïohnong .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta uta uba la ioh san tylli ki talent u la wan bad u la wanrah sa san tylli ki talent, u da ong: Ko Trai, me la aiti ha nga san tylli ki talent: ha khmih nga la ioh hajan jong ki san tylli ki talent .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate , and an howling from the second , and a great crashing from the hills .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha ka Khyrdop Dohkha ha Jerusalem . Phin ïohsngew ka jingud ha ka bynta bathymmai jong ka nongbah bad ka jingsawa bajam jong ka jingkhyllem ha ki lumrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ko Trai, ba kan don ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa na ka khyrdop dohkha, bad ka jingsawa kaba ar na ki lum .

en: But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :
kha: Hynrei ngi pat ngi dang ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi bad ngim shym pat iehnoh ïa u . Ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , bad ki Lebi ki ïarap lem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia ngi , U Trai u long U Blei jong ngi , bad ngim shym la iehnoh ia u bad ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ia U Trai , ki long ki khun shynrang u Aaron bad ki Lebi ki ap ia ka kam jong ki:

en: And should not I spare Nineveh , that great city , wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand  ; and also much cattle ?
kha: Katno tam , te , ba ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ka Ninebeh , kata ka nongbah bakhraw . La kumno kumno , ka don palat ïa ka shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki khunlung balui lui ha ka , kumjuh ruh shibun ki mrad !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato ngam dei ban pyllait im ia ka Nineveh, kata ka nongbah kaba khraw, ha kaba ki don palat hynriew hajar ngut ki briew ki bym lah ban ithuh hapdeng ka kti kadiang bad ka kti kadiang jong ki; bad ruh bun ki masi ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .
kha: bad u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To shim ia ki khlieh jong ki briew baroh bad to pynsangeh ia ki ha khmat U Trai pyrshah ia ka sngi , ba ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai kan kylla noh na Israel .

en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard , very costly , and anointed the feet of Jesus , and wiped his feet with her hair : and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment .
kha: Te ka Mari ka la shim shiteng litar ka jingiwbih kaba remdor bha ïa kaba la shna na u nard bakynsai , ka la theh ïa ka ha ki kjat U Jisu , bad ka la ñiad ïa ki kjat jong u da u shñiuh khlieh jong ka . Ka jingsma basngewtynnat na ka jingiwbih ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la shim ia ka Maria ka umphniang kaba rem dor bha, bad u la pynsleh ia ki kjat U Jisu, bad u la sait ia ki kjat jong u da ki shniuh jong ka: bad ka iing ka la dap da ka jingsma jong ka umphniang .

en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?
kha: u Isaak u ong ,  Ko pa !  U jubab ,  Oi , khun ?  U Isaak u kylli ,  Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynrei hangno pat u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la kren ha u kpa jong u, bad u la ong, ko kpa jong nga: bad u la ong, Hangne nga don, ko khun jong nga . Bad u la ong: Ha khmih ka ding bad u dieng: hynrei shano u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia thang ?

en: For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .
kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Perasim bad ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kaba u thmu ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin long kum kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam jong u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai un kiew kum ha u lum Perazim, un bitar kum ha ka them Gibeon, ba un leh ia ka kam jong u, ka kam phylla jong u; bad un pyndep ia ka kam phylla jong u.

en: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him , he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords , to break through even unto the king of Edom : but they could not .
kha: Haba u syiem ka Moab u sngewthuh ba u la rem thma , u la shim bad u hynñiewspah ngut ki rangbah kieng waitlam bad u pyrshang ban ïaid lyngba ki syrtap nongshun bad ban lait phet sha u syiem Syria , hynrei um shym lah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u Moab u la iohi ba ka thma ka la jur palat ia u, u la shim bad u hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la sei da ki waitlam, ban iaid lyngba wat haduh u syiem u Edom: hynrei kim lah .

en: And I will spread my net upon him , and he shall be taken in my snare , and I will bring him to Babylon , and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me .
kha: Ngan phriang ïa ka jar u nongriam sim bad pynngat ïa u ha ka . Ngan rah ïa u sha Babilonia bad pynshitom ïa u hangta , namar um shym la ïaineh ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynphriang ia ka net jong nga halor jong u, bad un shah shim ha ka jingma jong nga, bad ngan wanrah ia u sha Babilon , bad ngan kyrpad ia u hangta namar ka jingleh be-ijot jong u kaba u la leh pyrshah ia nga .

en: Then the king made Daniel a great man , and gave him many great gifts , and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon , and chief of the governors over all the wise men of Babylon .
kha: Te u la ai ha u Daniel ka kyrdan kaba halor , u la ai sngewbha ïa u da ki jingai kiba kynsai tam , u la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa ka probins    jong ka Babilon , bad u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh jong baroh ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la pynlong ia u Daniel u briew uba khraw, bad u la ai ia u shibun ki jingai sngewbha kiba khraw, bad u la pynlong ia u ban synshar ia ka ri Babilon baroh kawei bad u rangbah jong ki nongsynshar halor ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Babilon .

en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .
kha: Kiba bun kito kiba ju leh myntor ki la wallam lang ïa ki kitab jong ki baroh bad thang ïa kita ha khmat u paidbah . Ki la kheiñlang ïa ka dor jong ki kitab , bad ka jingkheiñ ka long kumba sanphew hajar tylli ki sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bun na ki ruh kiba pyndonkam ia ki jingdro kiba sngewtynnad ki la wanrah lang ia ki kot jong ki, bad ki la thang ia ki ha khmat ki briew baroh: bad ki la khein ia ka dor jong ki, bad ki la shem ia ka sanphew hajar tylli ki rupa .

en: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the  Lord   ; for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one  ;
kha: Kine ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar ba ki Philistia ki phah pat kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingpalat sha U  Trai  ki long na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka shnong : Ka Ashdod , ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , ka Gath , bad ka Ekron .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki jingmih ksiar kiba ki Philistia ki la wan phai na ka bynta ka jingaiti kaba sniew ha U Trai ; na ka bynta u Ashdod uwei, na ka bynta u Gaza uwei, na ka bynta u Ashkelon uwei, na ka bynta u Ekron uwei;

en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .
kha: hynrei lada phi kular ei ei da la ka mon sngewbha , kynmaw ban pyndep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ia kaba la jah noh na ki rmiang shyntur jong me me dei ban sumar bad leh wat ia ka jingainguh kaba mon sngewbha, kumba me la kular ha U Trai U Blei jong me, kaba me la kular da ka shyntur jong me .

en: Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
kha: Kumta u Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Lada me mon , ngan shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ hangne , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia u Petros bad u la ong ha U Jisu, ko Trai, ka long kaba bha ia ngi ban don hangne : lada me mon, to ngin pynlong hangne lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ; kawei na ka bynta jong me, bad kawei na ka bynta u Moses bad kawei na ka bynta u Elias .

en: Are they not on the other side Jordan , by the way where the sun goeth down , in the land of the Canaanites , which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal , beside the plains of Moreh ?
kha: ( Kine ki lum ar tylli ki don sha sepngi ka wah Jordan ha ka ri ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka Them Jordan . Ki don shaphang sepngi , ym da jngai na ki dieng kyntang ha Moreh hajan ka shnong Gilgal . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kim don sha shiliang ka Jordan, ha ka lynti ba ka sngi ka hiar, ha ka ri jong ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha ka jaka ba la buh ha Gilgal , hajan ki madan Mrek ?

en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him , because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah  ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah .
kha: Bun ki briew ha Judah ki la ïalong ha ka liang jong u na ka bynta u kthaw jong u , u Shekanaïah , uba long u Jiw , u khun jong u Arah . Nalor kata , u Jehohanan , u khun jong u , u la shongkurim ïa ka khun u Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki don bun ha Judah kiba la smai ha u, namar u long u khun shynrang jong u Shechaniah u khun u Arah ; bad u khun jong u u Jehanan u la shim ia ka khun jong u Meshullam u khun u Beriah .

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka mynsiem kaba leh pop khlem da tip, haba u leh pop khlem da tip ha khmat U Trai, ban leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u ; bad yn map ia u .

en: And Saul said unto Michal , Why hast thou deceived me so , and sent away mine enemy , that he is escaped ? And Michal answered Saul , He said unto me , Let me go  ; why should I kill thee ?
kha: U Saul u kylli ïa ka Mikhal ,  Balei pha shet shukor ïa nga kumne bad shah ïa u nongshun jong nga ban lait phet ?  Ka jubab ,  U byrngem ban pynïap ïa nga lymda nga ïarap ïa u ban lait phet .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u Michal, Balei me la thok ia nga kumta, bad me la phah noh ia u nongshun jong nga, ba u la lait im ? U Michal u la jubab ia u Saul .

en: Butter of kine , and milk of sheep , with fat of lambs , and rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the fat of kidneys of wheat  ; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape .
kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong ki , ki ai kyrhai ka dud , ki la don ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki masi ruh kiba da kynsai , u kew uba kynsai tam bad ka waiñ kaba bang tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shini jong ki masi bad ka dud langbrot, bad ki langbrot jong u Bashan bad ki blang, bad ka shini jong u kew ; bad me la dih ia ka snam kaba khuid jong u sohjew .

en: I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .
kha: Nga smai ba ngan leh ïa kane ha phi u paidlang bymman uba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa uwei na phi un ïap . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nga U Trai nga la ong , ngan leh shisha ia kane ka jingiaseng kaba sniew baroh: ha kane ka ri khlaw kin shah pynjot bad hangta kin iap .

en: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth : it shall not return unto me void , but it shall accomplish that which I please , and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it .
kha: Kumta ruh kan long ka ktien kaba nga kren — kan ym pep ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba nga thmu na ka bynta jong ka ; kan pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga phah ïa ka ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka ktien jong nga kan long kaba mih na ka shyntur jong nga: kan ym wan phai sha nga khlem da pyndep ia kaba nga sngewbha, bad kan roi ha kata ka jaka ba nga phah ia ka .

en: Curse ye Meroz , said the angel of the  Lord  , curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof  ; because they came not to the help of the  Lord  , to the help of the  Lord  against the mighty .
kha: Buh ka jingtim halor ka Meros ,  ong u angel jong U  Trai  ,  Ka jingtim , ka jingtim halor kito kiba sah hangta . Kim shym la wan ïarap ïa U  Trai  , Kim shym wan kum ki shipai ban ïaleh pyrshah na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To tim ia phi Meroz , la ong u angel jong U Trai , to tim ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ; namar kim shym la wan sha ka jingiarap jong U Trai , sha ka jingiarap jong U Trai pyrshah ia kiba khlain bor .

en: Saying , Master , Moses wrote unto us , If any man s brother die , having a wife , and he die without children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
kha: Ko Nonghikai , u Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong ngi : ‘ Lada u briew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa la ka tnga hynrei khlem don khun , u para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa kata ka riewkynthei khnang ba ki lah ban ïoh ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew ba ki long ki khun jong uta u briew uba la ïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong , Ko Nonghikai, u Moses u la thoh ha ngi, Lada uno uno u hynmen u iap, u don ka tnga bad u iap khlem khun, ba u hynmen jong u un shim ia ka tnga jong u bad un pynmih symbai sha u hynmen jong u .

en: And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .
kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw nga la shem kynsan ïa lade ha ka nongbah Susa ba la ker kynroh ha ka probins    jong ka Elam . Nga la ïeng harud ka wah Ulai ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew bad ka la jia, haba nga la iohi, ba nga la don ha Shushan ha ka iing syiem, kaba don ha ka ri Elam ; bad nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew, bad nga la don hajan ka wah Ulai .

en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .
kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki sla , kumta u la leit ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wan sha uta u dieng , u la shem tang ki sla , namar kam pat dei ka por ban mih soh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohi ia u dieng sohjew uba jngai, u la wan, lada lehse u lah ban shem ei ei ha kata ka por: bad haba u la poi ha ka , um lap ei ei hynrei tang ki sla ; na ka bynta ka por jong ki sohjew kim pat don .

en: And when he came , lo , Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching : for his heart trembled for the ark of God . And when the man came into the city , and told it , all the city cried out .
kha: U Eli , uba dang pyrkhat khuslai shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang , u dang shong harud lynti , u da peit lyngngoh . Uta u rangbah u pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng ka shnong bad uwei pa uwei u lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan, ha khmih, u Eli u la shong ha ka jaka shong kaba don harud lynti: namar ka dohnud jong u ka la khih na ka bynta ka synduk U Blei . Bad haba uta u briew u la wan shapoh shnong bad u la iathuh ia kata, ka shnong baroh kawei ka la pyrta .

en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven , and poured out drink offerings unto her , did we make her cakes to worship her , and pour out drink offerings unto her , without our men ?
kha: Bad ki kynthei ki ong shuh shuh ,  Haba ngi shet ïa ki kpu ha ka dur kum ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , ngi ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka , bad theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ki tnga jong ngi ki mynjur ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la thang ia ka mahadei bneng bad ngi la theh ia ki jingknia dih ha ka , hato ngi la shna ia ki cake jong ka ban mane ia ka , bad ngi la theh ia ki jingknia dih sha ka , khlem ki briew jong ngi ?

en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the host was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , Let me depart , that I may go to mine own country .
kha: Haba ka khubor ka poi ha u Hadad ha Ijipt ba u Dabid u la ïap bad ba u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u ruh u la ïap , u Hadad u ong ha u syiem ,  Shah ba ngan leit phai sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hadad u la iohsngew ha Ijipt ba u Dabid u la thiah bad ki kpa tymmen jong u bad ba u Joab u la iap , u Hadad u la ong ha u Pharaoh , To ngan leit noh sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof .
kha: Ka Jordan ka dei ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ka jait Reuben . Kine ki long ki nongbah bad ki nongrit kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam jong ki khun u Reuben u long u Jordan bad u pud jong ka . Kane ka la long ka pateng jong ki khun u Reuben hadien ki longiing jong ki, ki shnong bad ki shnong jong ki .

en: And the people shall be oppressed , every one by another , and every one by his neighbour : the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient , and the base against the honourable .
kha: Uwei pa uwei un shim kabu ïa uwei pat . Ki samla kin ym burom ïa ki rangbah , bad ki riewpoh kin ym burom ïa kiba halor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew kin shah pynshitom bein iwei ia iwei pat, bad iwei pa iwei da u paramarjan jong u: u khynnah un leh sngew sarong ia lade pyrshah ia kiba rim , bad ka nongrim pyrshah ia kiba donburom .

en: And Pharaoh s servants said unto him , How long shall this man be a snare unto us ? let the men go , that they may serve the  Lord  their God : knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed ?
