kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Pharaoh ki la ong ha u ,  Sa katno te une u briew un pynjynjar ïa ngi ? Pyllait noh ïa ki Israel , khnang ba kin ïoh mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki . Hato phim pat sngewthuh ba ka Ijipt ka la jot ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Pharaoh ki la ong ha u, Haduh katno une u briew un long u nongshah teh ha ngi ? to ai ba ki briew kin leit noh ba kin shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong ki: phim tip haduh mynta ba ka Ijipt ka la shah pynjot ?

en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .
kha: U Dabid u leit noh na kata ka jaka sha Mispah ha Moab bad u ong ha u syiem Moab ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i pa bad i mei jong nga ban wan bad sah bad phi haduh ba ngan da tip aïu U Blei un leh na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit shata sha Mizpeh jong ka ri Moab: bad u la ong ha u syiem ka ri Moab: bad u la ong ha u syiem ka ri Moab: To ai ba u kpa jong nga bad ka kmie jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, to wan shabar bad to don ryngkat bad phi, haduh ba ngan da tip ia kaei kaba U Blei un leh na ka bynta jong nga .

en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .
kha: Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki dap , ka slap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki lyoh ki dap da u slap , ki thylli ia lade ha ka khyndew : bad lada u dieng u hap shaphang shathie ne shaphang shathie , ha ka jaka ba u dieng u hap , hangta un don .

en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them : but they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
kha: Ki Israel kin nym shaniah shuh ha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Ka kupar ki nong Ijipt kan pynkynmaw ïa ki Israel kumno ka la long kaba bakla ban shaniah ha ki . Te ki Israel kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym long shuh ka jingshaniah jong ka iing Israel kaba wanrah ia ka jingbymhok jong ki ha ka jingkynmaw , haba kin peit ia ki: hynrei kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai Blei .

en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .
kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit ia kata kaba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi: ha khmih nga beh noh ha khmat jong me ia u Amorit bad u Kanaan bad u Hitit bad u Perizite bad u Hebus bad u Jebus .

en: Declare ye in Judah , and publish in Jerusalem  ; and say , Blow ye the trumpet in the land : cry , gather together , and say , Assemble yourselves , and let us go into the defenced cities .
kha: To put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri ! To pyrta jam bad shai kdar ! Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ban phet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbna ia phi ha Judah , bad pynbna ha Jerusalem ; bad ong: To pynkhih ia ka turoi ha ka ri: to iam , to ia lum lang bad to ong , To ia lum lang ia lade bad to ngin leit sha ki nongbah ba la iada .

en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :
kha: Hapoh ar snem ngan wallam pat sha kane ka jaka ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hapoh ar snem pura ngan wanrah biang sha kane ka jaka ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Trai baroh, ba u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon u la shim noh na kane ka jaka bad u la rah ia ki sha Babilon:

en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
kha: U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kiba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim noh ia ki spah jong ka iing U Trai, bad ki spah jong ka iing syiem u la shim noh wat ia ki baroh: bad u la shim noh ia ki jingda ksiar baroh kiba u Solomon u la shna .

en: And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .
kha: Ha ka balang , U Blei u la buh ïa baroh ha la ka bynta : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba lai ïa ki nonghikai ; nangta ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kambah , bud sa kito ha kiba la ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah lane ban ïarap ïa kiwei lane ban pyn-i lem lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei u la buh katto katne ha ka balang, ki apostol ba nyngkong, ki nongiathuhlypa, kiba lai, hadien kata ki kambah, nangta ki jingai sngewbha jong ki jingpynkhiah, ki jingiarap, ki sorkar, ki jaitbynriew bapher bapher .

en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea : and if one look unto the land , behold darkness and sorrow , and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , kin kyrhuh halor ka Israel da kaba jam kum ka duriaw . Ha khmih ïa kane ka ri ! Ka jingdum bad ka jinglyng-a ! Ïa ka jingshai la nguid da ka jingdum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka sngi kin iaid pyrshah ia ki kum ka jingsawa duriaw: bad lada peit sha ka ri , ha khmih ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih , bad ka jingshai ka la dum ha ki bneng jong ka .

en: He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .
kha: Un hiarthma wat ïa ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un pynïap da ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Edom , Moab , bad kaei kaba la iehnoh jong ka Ammon kin lait .
translated_en_to_kha: Un rung ruh ha ka ri kaba donburom, bad bun ki ri kin shah pynhap: hynrei kine kin lait na ka kti jong u, wat u Edom bad u Moab bad u rangbah jong ki khun Ammon .

en: They have sown wheat , but shall reap thorns : they have put themselves to pain , but shall not profit : and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the  Lord .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la bet ïa u kew , hynrei ki la lum ïa ki ñiut ; ki la trei shitom , hynrei kim shym ïoh ei ei na ka bynta kata . Namar ka jingbitar shla jong nga ki jingthung jong ki kim shym long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la bet ia u kew , hynrei kin kheit ia ki soh: ki la buh ia lade ha ka jingjynjar , hynrei kin ym ioh jingmyntoi: bad kin sngewlehrain ia ki jingmih jong phi namar ka jingbitar kaba jur jong U Trai .

en: For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
kha: Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai noh ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynban hadien lai sngi , un sa mihpat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la hikai ia ki synran jong u bad u la ong ha ki: U Khun u briew u la shah aiti ha ki kti ki briew bad kin pyniap ia u ; bad hadien ba u la shah pyniap , un sa mih ha ka sngi kaba lai .

en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth , which is by En–rogel , and called all his brethren the king s sons , and all the men of Judah the king s servants :
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Adonijah u ai ka jingkñia da ki langbrot , ki masi dab , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid ha u Mawsiang Bseiñ , hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel . U la khot sngewbha ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong U Syiem Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem kiba dei na Judah ban wan sha kane ka jingkhawai ai jingkñia ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Adonijah u la pyniap ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki masi kiba heh da u maw jong u Sohelet, uba don ha u Enrogel bad u la khot ia ki hynmen jong u baroh ki khun syiem bad ki briew jong u Judah baroh:

en: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people : for the people shouted with a loud shout , and the noise was heard afar off .
kha: Ym don ba lah ban pynïapher hapdeng ki jingpyrta jong ka jingkmen bad ka jingïam , namar ka jingsawa kaba ki la pynlong ka long kaba haduh katta katta , ba lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha jngai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew kim lah ban ithuh ia ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyrhuh jong ki briew: namar ki briew ki la pyrta da ka jingsawa kaba jam , bad la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa na jngai .

en: For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .
kha: Hadien ba nga la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jong phi , yn ym don mano mano u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong phi haba phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan beh noh ia ki jaitbynriew ha khmat jong me, bad ngan pynheh ia ki pud jong me: lymne uno uno u briew un kwah ia ka ri jong me, haba me leit sha jrong ban paw ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka snem .

en: And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
kha: Te U  Trai  U Blei u la pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san kham jrong ïa u Jonah khnang ban ai ïa u katto katne ka jingkah syrngiew , khnang ba un kham tngen . U Jonah u la sngewkmen shibun ïa u jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei u la pynkhreh ia u sohjew, bad u la pynlong ia ka ban wan shaneng halor u Jonah, ba kan long ka jingdum halor ka khlieh jong u, ban pyllait ia u na ka jingsngewsih jong u . Kumta u Jonah u la sngewbha palat ia ka sohjew .

en: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants , even Esther s feast  ; and he made a release to the provinces , and gave gifts , according to the state of the king .
kha: Nangta u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai kaba khraw kum ka jinglehburom ïa ka Esther bad khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar bad nongpynïaidkam . U la pynbna shuti ha ka hima baroh kawei bad ai ki jingai sngewbha kiba shongdor kum ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la leh ia ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ia ki syiem bad ki shakri jong u baroh, wat ia ka jingkhawai Esther baroh kawei bad u la pyllait ia ki jylla , bad u la ai jingai sngewbha katkum ka jinglong jong u syiem .

en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices great abundance , and precious stones : neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon .
kha: Ka ai sngewbha ïa u syiem Solomon ki jingai kiba ka la wanrah : palat saw hajar kilo ka ksiar bad shikatdei eh ki musla bad ki mawkordor . Ym pat ju don musla kiba bha kum kita kiba ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ai ha u syiem Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ai ia u syiem shispah arphew talent ka ksiar bad ki jingbam ba bang: ym don ruh kum kata ka jingbam ba la ai da ka mahadei ka Sheba .

en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
kha: ban ong ha u ,  U blei ha uba phi shaniah u la ong ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jong nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin kren ha u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah da kaba ong: Wat ai ba U Blei jong me uba me shaniah un shukor ia me da kaba ong: Ka Jerusalem kan ym shah aiti ha ka kti jong u syiem Assyria .

en: For all the sins of Baasha , and the sins of Elah his son , by which they sinned , and by which they made Israel to sin , in provoking the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .
kha: Namar ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki bad namar ba ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop , u Baasha bad u khun jong u , u Elah , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki pop baroh jong u Baasha bad ki pop jong u khun jong u, da kaba ki la leh pop bad da kaba ki la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop, da kaba pynkhih ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ban bitar ia ki jinglong ba sniew jong ki .

en: And it came to pass , that when David was come to the top of the mount , where he worshipped God , behold , Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent , and earth upon his head :
kha: Haba u Dabid u la poi ha ka kliar jong u lum , ha kaba don ka jaka mane Blei , u Hushai , u nong Arkhit uba dei u paralok bajan jong u , u la ïakynduh ïa u da kaba phong ki jaiñ kiba la kad bad ka khyndew ha ka khlieh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Dabid u la poi ha jrong jong u lum, ha kaba u la mane ia U Blei, ha khmih u Husi u Arkit u la wan iakynduh ia u da ka jainkup jong u, bad ka khyndew halor ka khlieh jong u:

en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace .
kha: ha Makhpelah kaba sha mihngi na Mamre ha ka ri Kanaan . U Abraham u la thied ïa kane ka krem lem bad ka lyngkha u Ephron ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha Machpelah kaba don ha khmat u Mamre, ha ka ri Kanaan, kaba u Abraham u la thied bad ka lyngkha Ephron u Hitit na ka bynta ka jaka tep .

en: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place , and all speak with tongues , and there come in those that are unlearned , or unbelievers , will they not say that ye are mad ?
kha: Namarkata lada , ka balang baroh kawei ka ïaseng lang bad baroh ki sdang ban kren da ki thylliej bapher — bad lada ki riewpaidbah lane ki bymngeit ki rung hapoh , hato kin nym ong ba phi la ïalamwir ?
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka balang baroh kawei ka iawan lang ha kawei ka jaka, bad baroh ki kren da ki thylliej bad ki wan rung ha kito ki bym nang la stad ne ki bym ngeit , hato kin ym ong ba phi la bieit ?

en: And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .
kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u dang batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka bor halor lade , bad ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la sheptieng bad u la ong ,  Mynta me lah ban leit noh shuwa . Ngan sa phah khot pat haba nga ïohlad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang pyrkhat ia ka hok, ka jinglong bad ka jingbishar ban wan , u Felix u la khih bad u la jubab: To leit noh ia kane ka por ; haba nga don ka aiom kaba suk , ngan khot ia me .

en: Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul : be not cut off in her iniquity  ; for this is the time of the  Lord s  vengeance  ; he will render unto her a recompence .
kha: To phet noh na Babilonia ! Phet ban lait im ! Wat ai ba yn shah pynïap na ka bynta ka pop jong ka Babilonia . Nga mynta nga siew kylliang bad pynshitom ïa ka kumba ka dei hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh na pdeng ka Babilon, bad to ai ia ka mynsiem jong u: wat shah ot noh ha ka jingbymhok jong ka ; namar kane ka dei ka por jong ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Trai; un ai ia ka ka jingsiew kylliang ia ka .

en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .
kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngdoh , ka jingkulmar ha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka nang kham jur ; kumta u Saul u ong ha u ,  Ym don por ban kylli ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u Saul u dang kren ha u lyngdoh, ba ka jingsawa kaba don ha ka kynhun ki Philistia ka la nang kiew: bad u Saul u la ong ha u lyngdoh: Pynduh noh ia la ka kti .

en: Behold , I have set the land before you : go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , to give unto them and to their seed after them .
kha: Kane baroh ka long kata ka ri kaba nga U  Trai  nga la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki . Khie leit kam kynti ïa ka .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la buh ia ka ri ha khmat jong phi: leit rung bad bat ia ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi, u Abraham, u Isaak bad u Jakob, ban ai ha ki bad ha ki symbai jong ki hadien jong ki .

en: And when thou comest thither , look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi , and go in , and make him arise up from among his brethren , and carry him to an inner chamber  ;
kha: bad ynda me la poi hangta , wad ïa u Jehu u khun jong u Jehoshaphat bad u ksiew jong u Nimshi . Ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra kaba kyrpang jngai na ki paralok jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba me wan shabar, peit shabar hangta u Jehoshaphat u khun u Nimshi, bad leit shapoh bad pynlong ia u ban kiew na ki hynmen jong u, bad rah ia u sha ka kamra kaba shapoh ; .

en: And the people believed : and when they heard that the  Lord  had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la ngeit , bad haba ki ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la wan sha ki bad ba u la ïohi kumno ki la shah lehbeiñ tyngeh , ki la nguh la dem bad ki la ïamane ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ngeit: bad haba ki la iohsngew ba U Trai u la leit jngoh ia ki khun Israel , bad ba u la peit ia ka jingjynjar jong ki , nangta ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .

en: Then shall we know , if we follow on to know the  Lord  : his going forth is prepared as the morning  ; and he shall come unto us as the rain , as the latter and former rain unto the earth .
kha: To ngin ïai pyrshang ban tip ïa U  Trai . Da shisha un sa wan sha ngi kum ka step phyrngab , shisha kum u slap pyrem uba ai um ïa ka khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngin sa tip, lada ngi bud ia U Trai: ka jingleit jong u ka long kaba la pynkhreh kum ka por mynstep bad un wan ha ngi kum u slap, kum u slap uba hadien bad uba mynshuwa sha ka khyndew .

en: And it came to pass , when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
kha: Haba u Isaak u la don hangta katto katne por , u syiem Abimelekh u peit na ka jingkhangïit bad u ïohi ïa u Isaak bad ka Rebekka ba ki ïaleh ieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la don hangta slem, ba u syiem Philistia u la peit shabar ia ka jingkhang, bad u la iohi, bad ha khmih u Isaak u dang ialehkai bad ka Rebekeh ka tnga jong u .

en: And in the morning , It will be foul weather to day : for the sky is red and lowring . O ye hypocrites , ye can discern the face of the sky  ; but can ye not discern the signs of the times ?
kha: Bad dang step phyrngab phi ong , ‘ Kan sa slap , namar ba ka suiñbneng ka saw bad ka dum .’ Phi lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglong ka suiñbneng da kaba khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , hynrei phim lah ban batai ïa ki dak kiba ïadei bad kine ki por !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka por mynstep , Kan long kaba sniew ha ka sngi: namar ka bneng ka long kaba saw bad kaba jrong . Ko phi ki nongleh arsap , phi lah ban ithuh ia ka khmat jong ka bneng ; hynrei phim lah ban ithuh ia ki dak jong ki por ?

en: Who hath saved us , and called us with an holy calling , not according to our works , but according to his own purpose and grace , which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began ,
kha: U la pynim ïa ngi bad u la khot ïa ngi ban long ki briew jong u hi , ym namar ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingthmu jong u hi bad ka jingaiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la pynim ia ngi bad uba la khot ia ngi da ka jingkhot bakhuid ym kat kum ki kam jong ngi hynrei kat kum ka jingthmu bad ka jingaiei jong u hi kaba la ai ha ngi ha U Khrist Jisu shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .

en: Therefore , O Aholibah , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will raise up thy lovers against thee , from whom thy mind is alienated , and I will bring them against thee on every side  ;
kha: Mynta te , ko Oholibah , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha pha . Pha la thait ïa kito ki nongleh-ieit , hynrei ngan pynlong ïa ki ban bitar ïa pha bad ngan wallam ïa ki ban ker sawdong ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko Ahlibah , kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , ngan pynmih ia ki nongieit jong me pyrshah ia me , na kiba ka jingmut jong me ka la jah noh , bad ngan wanrah ia ki pyrshah ia me na man la ki liang;

en: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart , when he goeth in unto the holy place , for a memorial before the  Lord  continually .
kha: Haba u Aaron u rung sha ka Jaka Kyntang , un phong ïa kane ka jingdeng shadem ha kaba la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar jait Israel , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai kynmaw ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un kit ia ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel ha ka shyntur jong ka jingbishar ha ka dohnud jong u haba u leit sha ka jaka bakhuid , kum ka jingkynmaw ha khmat U Trai man ka por .

en: And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?
kha: Kumta ki ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kane , bad u jubab ,  Ka long ka burom kaba khraw ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem , kaba khraw than ïa uba kum ma nga uba duk bad u bymdondor ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Saul ki kren ia kita ki ktien ha ki shkor u Dabid . Bad u Dabid u la ong , Ka long kaba jem ha phi ban long u khun syiem ha ka ain , haba nga iohi ba nga long u briew uba duk bad uba rit paid ?

en: Then it shall be , when he maketh his sons to inherit that which he hath , that he may not make the son of the beloved firstborn before the son of the hated , which is indeed the firstborn :
kha: ha ka sngi ba uta u briew u rai ban sam ïa ka spah ka phew jong u ha la ki khun , um dei ban leh shiliang ïa u khun jong kata ka tnga ba u kham ieit da kaba ai noh ha u ïa ka bynta u khun nyngkong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan long , haba u pynlong ia ki khun shynrang jong u ban hiar pateng ia kaei kaba u don , ba un ym pynlong ia u khun nyngkong ba ieit ha khmat u khun nyngkong uba la shun:

en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
kha: Uno uno ne uei uei uba ktah ïa ka doh jong uta u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Lada kano kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uta u jingkñia , dei ban sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaei kaba dei ban ktah ia ka doh jong ka kan long kaba khuid: bad haba la theh ia ka snam jong ka ha kano kano ka jain , me dei ban sait ia kata ha ka jaka bakhuid .

en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem , and cry unto her , that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned : for she hath received of the  Lord s  hand double for all her sins .
kha: To pynshlur ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem . To ïathuh ha ki ba ki la jynjar slem bha bad ïa ki pop jong ki la map mynta . Nga la pynshitom ïa ki la biang bha na ka bynta ki pop jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren suk ia ka Jerusalem, bad to iam ia ka, ba ka thma jong ka ka la pyndep, ba ka jingbymhok jong ka ka la shah map: namar ka la ioh na ka kti U Trai ar shah na ka bynta ki pop jong ka baroh .

en: Surely after that I was turned , I repented  ; and after that I was instructed , I smote upon my thigh : I was ashamed , yea , even confounded , because I did bear the reproach of my youth .
kha: Ngi la phai dien noh na me , hynrei shen ngi la kwah ban wan phai pat . Hadien ba me la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi la pyndem ïa la ki khlieh ha ka jingsngewsih . Ngi la sngewlehrain bad jahburom , namar ngi la leh pop mynba ngi dang samla .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid hadien kata nga la kylla bamut ; bad hadien kata nga la shah hikai: Nga la sngewlehrain, hooid, wat nga la sngewlehrain ruh, namar nga la shah ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ka jinglong samla jong nga .

en: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah , and smote him , and slew him , and reigned in his stead , in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah kum u syiem ka Judah , u Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Pekah , u pynïap ïa u , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hoshea u khun jong u Elah u la leh ia ka jingthmu pyrshah ia u Pekah u khun jong u Remaliah bad u la shoh ia u bad u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u, ha ka snem kaba arphew jong u Jotham u khun jong u Usiah .

en: And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them ,  Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !
kha: Ki synran ki la sngewkyndit halor kine ki ktien , hynrei U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun jong nga , katno ka long kaba eh ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki synran ki la lyngngoh ia ki ktien jong u . Hynrei U Jisu u jubab biang bad u ong ha ki , Ko khun , katno ka long kaba eh ia kito kiba shaniah ha ka spah ban rung sha ka hima U Blei !

en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering , for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting .
kha: hynrei U Blei u la leh-isynei ïa nga khnang ba U Khrist Jisu un ïoh pynpaw ïa ka jingïaishah slem jong u ha kaba ïadei bad nga , uba sniew tam na kiba pop , kum ka nuksa ïa kito baroh ki ban sa ngeit ïa u hadien bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ka bynta kane ka daw nga la ioh ia ka jingisynei, ba ha nga nyngkong eh U Jisu Khrist un pyni ia ka jingshah shitom baroh, namar ka nuksa ha ki kiba hadien ki dei ban ngeit ha u haduh ka jingim bymjukut .

en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil , and Israel to the robbers ? did not the  Lord  , he against whom we have sinned ? for they would not walk in his ways , neither were they obedient unto his law .
kha: Mano ba la ai ïa ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? Ka long na U  Trai  hi , pyrshah ïa u ba ngi la leh pop ! Ngim shym im kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , lane kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai kiba u ai ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la ai ia u Jakob na ka bynta ka jinglute bad ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? ym U Trai , ma u uba ngi la leh pop ? namar kin ym iaid ha ki lynti jong u , lymne kim shym la kohnguh ia ka ain jong u .

en: And he called the name of the place Massah , and Meribah , because of the chiding of the children of Israel , and because they tempted the  Lord  , saying , Is the  Lord  among us , or not ?
kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Massah bad ka Meribah , namar ba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium bad tynjuh ïa U  Trai  haba ki ïakylli ,  Hato U  Trai  u don ne em bad ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Massah bad ka Meribah namar ka jingshah pynshitom jong ki khun Israel bad namar ba ki la pynshoi ia U Trai da kaba ong: Hato U Trai u don hapdeng jong ngi ne em ?

en: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .
kha: bad u tang shu rah ïa la ka kti , ki rangbah kiba la rieh ki ïeng joit , ki mareh sha ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka . Mar mar ruh ki thang ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U ambush u la mih noh kloi na ka jaka jong ki, bad ki la mareh tang shu pynkhih ia la ka kti: bad ki la rung shapoh ka shnong bad ki la shim ia ka bad ki la kyrkieh bad thang ia ka shnong .

en: Also before they burnt the fat , the priest s servant came , and said to the man that sacrificed , Give flesh to roast for the priest  ; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee , but raw .
kha: Nalor kata , wat shuwa ban shim ïa ka khleiñ bad thang ïa ka ruh , u shakri u lyngdoh u ju wan bad ong ha uta u briew uba ai jingkñia ,  Ai ïa nga khyndiat ka doh na ka bynta u lyngdoh ban syang ; um treh shim ïa ka doh kaba la shet , hynrei tang ïa ka doh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh shuwa ba kin thang ia ka shini, u shakri lyngdoh u la wan, bad u la ong ha uta u briew uba la knia, Ai doh ban bam ia u lyngdoh ; namar un ym don doh ba la khleh lang na phi, hynrei un ym don doh .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness , behold , they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh bad ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Jingïohipaw jong u Nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos  bad ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Hesekaiah bad ka jingbha jong u, ha khmih la thoh ha ka jingphohsniew jong u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u khun u Amoz bad ha ka kot ki syiem Judah bad ki Israel .

en: And king Herod heard of him  ; ( for his name was spread abroad : ) and he said , That John the Baptist was risen from the dead , and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
kha: Mynta u syiem Herod u la ïohsngew shaphang kane baroh , namar ka nam U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki ïa-ong ,  U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la im pat ! Dei na kata ka daw balei u don ïa kane ka bor ban leh ki kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Herod u la iohsngew ia u (na ka kyrteng jong u ka la saphriang shabar ri: ) bad u la ong: Ba u loannis u la mihpat na kiba iap, bad namarkata ki kam kiba donbor ki paw ha u .

en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains , and to the beasts of the earth : and the fowls shall summer upon them , and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them .
kha: Ïa ki metïap jong ki shipai jong ki yn iehnoh ha ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw . Ha ka lyiur ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ha ka tlang ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin sah lang ha ki sim lum bad ha ki mrad khyndew: bad ki sim kin sahkut ha ki , bad ki mrad khyndew baroh kin sahkut ha ki .

en: Yea , I will cause men to walk upon you , even my people Israel  ; and they shall possess thee , and thou shalt be their inheritance , and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .
kha: Ngan sa wallam pat ïa phi , ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban shong biang ha ka ri . Kan long noh ka ri jong phi bad ki khun jong phi kin ym kyrduh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ngan pynlong ia ki briew ban iaid halor jong phi, wat ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad kin don ia me, bad me long ka pateng jong ki, bad me ym pynduh shuh ia ki na ki briew .

en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God , in whom thou trustest , deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria .
kha: Haba u Patsha u ïohsngew ïa kane , u phah ka shithi sha u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah ban ong ïa u ,  U Blei ïa uba me shaniah u la ong ha me ba un ym hap ha ki kti jong nga , hynrei wat ai ba kata kan shukor ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta phin kren ha u Hesekaiah u syiem Judah da kaba ong: Wat ai ba U Blei jong me, ha uba me shaniah, un ym shukor ia me da kaba ong: Ka Jerusalem kan ym shah aiti ha ka kti jong u syiem Assyria .

en: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises : that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature , having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom , u la ai ha ngi ïa ki jingai kiba khraw eh bad ba kordor ïa kiba u la kular , khnang ba lyngba kine ki jingai phi lah ban phet ïap noh na ka jingkwah brai bapynjot kaba don ha ka pyrthei , bad ba ngi lah ban wan ïashim bynta ha ka jinglong ba kynja Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba la ai ha ngi ia ki jingkular kiba khraw bad kiba kordor: ba da kine phi lah ban long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka jinglong ba kynja Blei , haba phi la lait na ka jingbamsap kaba don ha ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingkwah brai .

en: Fear ye not , neither be afraid : have not I told thee from that time , and have declared it ? ye are even my witnesses . Is there a God beside me ? yea , there is no God  ; I know not any .
kha: Wat sheptieng , ko ki briew jong nga ! Phi tip ba naduh ki por mynbarim haduh mynta nga la ïathuhlypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia , bad phi long ki sakhi jong nga . Hato don uno uno uwei pat U Blei ? Hato don kiwei pat ki blei badonbor ba ngam shym ïohsngew ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia phi, lymne wat tieng: hato ngam shym la iathuh ia me naduh kata ka por ? phi long wat ki sakhi jong nga ruh . Hato don U Blei nalor jong nga ? Hooid , ym don Blei; ngam tip ei ei .

en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khubor Babha ban pynbna ha ki briew ka pyrthei , ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynja bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia uwei pat u angel uba her hapdeng ka bneng, uba don ka gospel bymjukut ban ialap ha ki kiba shong ha ka khyndew bad ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew bad ka jaitbynriew bad ka shyntur bad ki briew .

en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt , and gather them out of Assyria  ; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon  ; and place shall not be found for them .
kha: Na Ijipt bad na Assyria ngan wallam ïa ki sha ïing bad ngan pynshongduh ïa ki ha ka ri jong ki hi . Ngan pynshongduh ïa ki ha Gilead bad ha Lebanon kumjuh ; ka ri baroh kawei kan dap da ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah biang ia ki ruh na ka ri Ijipt, bad ngan lum ia ki na Assyria ; bad ngan wanrah ia ki sha ka ri Gilead bad Lebanon ; bad ka jaka kan ym lap ia ki .

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the  Lord  for his sin which he hath done : and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him .
kha: bad da uta , u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ban weng noh ïa ka pop jong uta u briew , bad U Blei un map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u da u langbrot jong ka jingaiti kaba la leh ha khmat U Trai na ka bynta ka pop jong u kaba u la leh: bad ka pop kaba u la leh kan long kaba la map ia u .

en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man , or by all thy people Israel , which shall know every man the plague of his own heart , and spread forth his hands toward this house :
kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . Lada uno uno na ki briew jong me ki Israel , da kaba sngewkynduh ha la ka mynsiem , ki kner la ki kti ha ka jingduwai sha kane ka Templ , to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad kaba la leh da uno uno u briew, ne da ki briew jong me baroh Israel, ki ban tip ia ka khlam jong u hi, bad kin pynjrong ia ki kti jong u sha kane ka iing:

en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi , la ïarap ïa nga da U Blei , bad kumta nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka jingsakhi jong nga ha baroh , ha uba rit bad ha uba khraw kumjuh . Kaei kaba nga ong ka long kajuh hi kaba ki nongïathuhlypa bad u Moses ki la ong ba kan sa jia :
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ioh ia ka jingiarap jong U Blei , nga iai bteng haduh kine ki sngi , nga sakhi ia kiba rit bad kiba khraw , nga ong ym da kumwei pat hynrei tang ia kito kiba ki nongiathuhlypa bad u Moses ki la ong ba kin wan:

en: And I will set my face against that man , and will cut him off from among his people  ; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech , to defile my sanctuary , and to profane my holy name .
kha: Nga hi ngan phai pyrshah ïa uta u briew bad ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga , namar u la ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u Molekh , bad kumta u pynbyrsieh ïa ka jaka kyntang jong nga bad u pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ia ka khmat jong nga pyrshah ia uta u briew, bad ngan ot noh ia u na ki briew jong u; namar u la ai ia u symbai jong u ha u Molek, ban pynjakhlia ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga, bad ban pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga .

en: And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .
kha: Haba ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongrit ,  Sngewbha ai ïa ki rangbah jong nga katto katne ki kpu . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang beh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki briew jong ka Sucoth, To ai, nga kyrpad ia phi, ia ki kpu sha ki briew kiba bud ia nga ; namar ki la lyngngoh, bad nga bud ia u Sebah bad u Zalmuna, ki syiem Magin .

en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt , which dwell at Migdol , and at Tahpanhes , and at Memphis , and in the country of Pathros , saying ,
kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ki Israel baroh kiba shong ha Ijipt , ha ki nongbah Migdol , Tahpanhes , bad Memphis , bad ki bynta bashathie jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba la wan ha Jeremaiah shaphang ki Jiw baroh kiba shong ha ka ri Ijipt, kiba shong ha Migdol bad ha Tahpanhes bad ha Memphis bad ha ka ri Pathros, da kaba ong:

en: Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Babilon , to hiar noh na ka khet jong pha , bad shong ha u pui pui halor ka khyndew . Shisien pha la long kum kaba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei pham long shuh kaba jem bad ba long jai jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !
translated_en_to_kha: To wan hiar, bad shong ha ka dewmet, ko khun kynthei jong ka Babilon, to shong ha ka khyndew: ym don ka khet, ko khun jong ki Khaldi: namar ia me ym shuh yn khot ia me uba jem bad uba jem .

en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday , should I this day make thee go up and down with us ? seeing I go whither I may , return thou , and take back thy brethren : mercy and truth be with thee .
kha: Phi la sah hangne tang khyndiat por , kumta balei ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sakma kylleng bad nga ? Ngam tip shano ngan leit . Khie leit phai noh bad ïalam bad phi ïa la ki jong ki briew — bad to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba me wan hynrei hynnin ka sngi nga dei ban pynlong ia me ban leit shaneng bad shapoh bad ngi ? haba nga leit shano shano ruh nga lah ban leit phai noh ia me bad shim biang ia ki hynmen jong me: ka jingisynei bad ka jingshisha ka long bad me .

en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan kynmaw na ka bynta jong ki ia ka jutang jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki, ia kiba nga la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt ha khmat ki nongwei: Nga long U Trai .

en: And saith unto them ,  Go your way into the village over against you : and as soon as ye be entered into it , ye shall find a colt tied , whereon never man sat  ; loose him , and bring him .
kha: Leit sha ka nongrit hangta ha shuwa jong phi . Phi tang shu poi hangta , phin shem ïa u khun kada ba la teh ïa u , u bym pat ju don uba shong halor jong u . Law ïa u bad wallam ïa u hangne .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki, To leit shapoh shnong shapoh shnong: bad tang shu rung ha ka , phin sa shem ia u khun masi ba la teh , ha kaba ym ju shong mano mano ruh;

en: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest , and unto Joshua the son of Nun , and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel  ;
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ki longïing na ka jait Lebi ki leit sha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , sha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad sha ki khlieh jong ki longïing na ki jait Israel baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la wan hajan ki khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Lebi ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad ha u Joshua u khun u Nun bad ha ki khlieh jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Israel;

en: Whithersoever the spirit was to go , they went , thither was their spirit to go  ; and the wheels were lifted up over against them : for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .
kha: Kita ki jingthaw ki leit kat shaba ki mon bad ki shalyntem ruh ki leit ryngkat bad ki ; namar kita ki jingthaw ki pynïaid ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La ka mynsiem jong ki ka la leit noh sha ki tyrpeng: namar ka mynsiem jong u jingthaw ba im ka la don ha ki tyrpeng .

en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .
kha: Hynrei la pyrshah ïa u da katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba la khot ïa ki ) , kaba kynthup ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Aleksandria . Ma ki bad kiwei pat ki Jiw na ki thain ka Kilikia bad Asia ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la mih katto katne na ka synagog kaba la khot ka synagog jong ki Librites bad ki Cyrene bad ki Alexander bad na ki jong ka Kylia bad ka Asia .

en: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book , If any man shall add unto these things , God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book :
kha: Ma nga , u Ïoannis , nga maham da ka jingsngew kyntang ïa uno uno baroh uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien ka jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka kitab : Lada uno uno u bynrap ei ei ha ki , U Blei un bynrap ha ka jingpynshitom ïa ki da ki khlam ïa kiba la batai ha kane ka kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga pynshisha ha uwei pa uwei uba iohsngew ia ki ktien jong ka jingiathuhlypa jong kane ka kot , Lada uno uno u briew un pyndap ia kine kiei kiei , U Blei un pyndap ha u ia ki khlam kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot:

en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;
kha: Kumta nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap ba ngan ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga ruh nga la rah ia la ka kti sha ki ha ka ri khlaw, ba ngan ym wanrah ia ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki, kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kaba long ka burom jong ki ri baroh;

en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .
kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ki shipai shong kulai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , uwei uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha khlaw , kiwei kin ïakiew shajrong hapdeng ki mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong yn iehnoh thylli , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka shnong baroh kawei kan phet noh na ka bynta ka jingsawa jong ki kulai bad ki khnai ; kin leit sha ki lum , bad kin kiew sha jrong ki maw: kawei pa kawei ka shnong kan shah iehnoh , bad ym don briew uba shong hangta .

en: My net also will I spread upon him , and he shall be taken in my snare : and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans  ; yet shall he not see it , though he shall die there .
kha: Hynrei ngan phriang ïa ka jar jong nga bad riam ïa u ha ka . Nangta ngan shim ïa u sha ka nongbah Babilon , ha kaba un ïap khlem da ïohi ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka net jong nga ruh ngan saphriang halor jong u, bad un sa shah shim ha ka jingma jong nga: bad ngan wanrah ia u sha Babilon sha ka ri jong ki Khaldians ; hynrei un ym iohi ia ka, wat la un iap hangta .

en: That then the  Lord  thy God will turn thy captivity , and have compassion upon thee , and will return and gather thee from all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath scattered thee .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leh-isynei ïa phi . Un wan ïalam pat ïa phi napdeng kita ki jaitbynriew sha kiba u la pynsakma ïa phi , bad un pynbha pat ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Trai U Blei jong me un pynphai noh ia ka jinglong mraw jong me, bad un sngewsynei ia me, bad un wan phai bad un lum ia me na ki jaitbynriew baroh, ha kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynpra ia me .

en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To rwai da ka jingkmen na ka bynta ki Israel , kiba khraw tam na ki jaitbynriew . To rwai ïa ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh jong phi , ‘ U  Trai  u la pynim ïa la ki briew ; u la pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai u rwai da ka jingkmen na ka bynta u Jakob, bad u pyrta hapdeng u rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew: to pynbna ia phi, to iaroh ia phi, bad to ong, ko Trai, to pynim ia ki briew jong me, ko Israel kiba sah .

en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .
kha: ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . Kin pynjot ïa kiei kiei kiba itynnat baroh kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit bad jingstad jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , namarkata ngan wanrah ia ki nongwei halor jong me: bad kin ring ia ki waitlam jong ki pyrshah ia ka jingitynnad jong me , bad kin pynjakhlia ia ka jingshai jong me .

en: When he saw Jesus , he cried out , and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God most high ? I beseech thee , torment me not .
kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , u la kyang jam , u la pyndem ïa lade ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me , wat pynshitom ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la iohi ia U Jisu , u la pyrta bad u la dem ha khmat jong u bad da ka sur kaba jam u la ong: Nga don jingiadei bad me Jisu, ko Khun U Blei uba ha khlieh duh ? Nga kyrpad ia me, wat pynshitom ia nga .

en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake  ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold , it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it .
kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi ong ha ka lyngkhot dieng ,  Khie noh !  ne ïa u maw ,  Ïeng joit !  Hato ka bleithaw ka lah ban pynpaw ei ei ïa phi ? Lah ban suit ïa ka da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , hynrei ym don jingim ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To u ba ong ha u dieng, To khie bein ia u maw uba dum, To khie, kan hikai ! Ha khmih, la buh ia ka da ka ksiar bad ka rupa, bad ym don mynsiem satia hapdeng jong ka .

en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .
kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Pharaoh u la phah khot mar mar ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Khie mihnoh na ka ri jong nga , ma phi bad ki Israel ! Khie leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  kumba phi la pan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia u Moses bad u Aaron ha ka por miet, bad u la ong, To khie noh ia phi na ki briew jong nga, phi bad ki khun Israel; bad leit shakri ia U Trai kumba phi la ong .

en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .
kha: Hynrei ïa ki Israel u Solomon um shym la pynlong mraw ; ki la shakri ïa u kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki rangbah ai hukum , ki kapten kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong kulai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ki khun Israel u Solomon um shym la leh mraw: hynrei ki long ki briew kiba ialeh thma bad ki shakri jong u bad ki rangbah jong u bad ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongsynshar jong u bad ki kulai jong u .

en: Then went he down , and dipped himself seven times in Jordan , according to the saying of the man of God : and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child , and he was clean .
kha: Kumta u Naaman u leit hiar sha ka Jordan , u pynngam ïa lade hynñiew sien ha ka , kumba u Elisha u la bthah , bad u la ïohkhiah phar . Ka doh jong u ka la wandur bad khiah krat , kum ka jong u khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit hiar, bad u la pynngam ia lade hynriew sien ha Jordan, kat kum ka jingong jong u briew U Blei: bad ka doh jong u ka la wan biang kum ka doh jong u khynnah rit , bad u la khuid .

en: After these things were ended , Paul purposed in the spirit , when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia , to go to Jerusalem , saying , After I have been there , I must also see Rome .
kha: Hadien ba kine kiei kiei ki la jia , u Paul u la kut jingmut ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia bad ka Akhaïa bad ban nang leit sha Jerusalem .  Hadien ba nga leit shata ,  u la ong ,  nga dei ban ïohi ruh ïa ka Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ba kine kiei kiei ki la kut noh , u Paul u la thmu ha ka mynsiem , haba u la iaid lyngba ka Makedonia bad ka Akhaia , ban leit sha Jerusalem , da kaba ong: Hadien ba nga la leit shata ruh nga dei ban iohi ia ka Rome .

en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
kha: hynrei uno uno ïa uba la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka mynsiem kaba bam ia ka doh jong ki jingknia jingsuk kaba iadei bad U Trai, kaba don ia ka jingbymkhuid jong u halor jong u, wat ia kata ka mynsiem ruh yn ot noh na ki briew jong u .

en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed .
kha: Katba ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa ka . Ngan ai ïa ka jingkyrpad jong pha wat la phan pan shiteng na ka hima jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha ka jingkhawai wain jong me ? bad yn ai ia me: bad kaei ka jingkyrpad jong me ? wat ha ka shiteng jong ka hima yn sa leh .

en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
kha: Khie leit sha kliar u Lum Pisgah , bad peit baroh sawdong , shatei , shathie , sha mihngi , bad sha sepngi . Peit bha ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , namar lano lano ruh men ym ïoh leit sha shiliang ka Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: To kiew sha jrong jong ka Pisgah, bad to rah ia ki khmat jong me shaphang sepngi, bad shaphang shathie, bad shaphang shathie, bad ha khmih ia ka da ki khmat jong me: namar me dei ban leit sha jrong ia kane ka Jordan .

en: And the ransomed of the  Lord  shall return , and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads : they shall obtain joy and gladness , and sorrow and sighing shall flee away .
kha: Kin poi sha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen , kin rwai bad kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , kiba la lait junom na ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpangnud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsiew bai lutksan jong U Trai kan wan phai noh sha Seion da ki jingrwai bad ka jingkmen bymjukut ha ki khlieh jong ki: kin ioh ia ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen , bad ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih kan phet noh .

en: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .
kha: uta u briew u dei ban siew ïa u kpa jong kata ka briew sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan long ka tnga jong u , namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha bad u . Katba u dang im um lah shuh ban pyllait ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u briew uba thiah bad ka un ai ha u kpa jong ka dam sanphew Shekel ka rupa bad kan long ka tnga jong u ; namar ba u la pynrit mynsiem ia ka , um lah ban weng noh ia ka ha ki sngi jong u baroh .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .
kha: Kane , mynta , ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan buh ha Seïon ka nongrim kaba skhem bad bakhlaiñ . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaba skhem ka long ruh kaba ïaishah .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Ha khmih nga thiah ha ka nongrim u maw, u maw ba la pyrshang, u maw ba kordor, u maw ba skhem: uta uba ngeit un ym kyrkieh .

en: In thy filthiness is lewdness : because I have purged thee , and thou wast not purged , thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more , till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , ki jingleh awria jong pha ki la pyntngit ïa pha . Wat la nga la pyrshang ban pynkhuid ïa pha , pha ïaisah ha ka jingtngit . Phan ym long khuid pat haduh ba phan da mad lut ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingjakhlia jong me ka long ka jinglehrain: namar nga la pynkhuid ia me, bad me khlem pynkhuid shuh ia me, wat shah pynkhuid shuh na ka jingjakhlia jong me, haduh ba ngan da pynlong ia ka jingbitar jong nga ban shong ha me .

en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .
kha: U Hanani , uwei na kiba shi para bad nga , u wan poi na Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun jong kiwei pat ki rangbah , bad nga kylli ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ki para Jiw jong ngi kiba la leit phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u Hanani, uwei na ki hynmen jong nga, u la wan, ma u bad katto katne ngut ki briew jong ka Judah bad nga la kylli ia ki shaphang ki Jiw kiba la lait im, kiba la sah na ka jingshah set phatok bad shaphang ka Jerusalem .

en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning , and thine health shall spring forth speedily : and thy righteousness shall go before thee  ; the glory of the  Lord  shall be thy rearward .
kha: Te ka jinglehieit jong nga kan tyngshaiñ ha phi kum ka sngi mynstep , bad ki jingmong jong phi kin sa koit kloi . Ngan don ryngkat bad phi borabor ban pyllait ïa phi ; ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan ïada ïa phi ha ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka jingshai jong me kan mih noh kum ka step, bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah jong me kan mih noh kloi: bad ka hok jong me kan leit sha khmat jong me; ka burom U Trai kan long hadien jong me .

en: Only rebel not ye against the  Lord  , neither fear ye the people of the land  ; for they are bread for us : their defence is departed from them , and the  Lord  is with us : fear them not .
kha: Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad wat sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Ngin jop da kaba suk ïa ki . U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi bad u la jop ïa ki blei kiba ïada ïa ki ; kumta te wat sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ba phin ym leh pyrshah ia U Trai, lymne phi tieng ia ki briew jong ka ri ; namar ki long u kpu na ka bynta jong ngi: ka jingiada jong ki ka la jah noh na ki , bad U Trai u don ryngkat bad ngi: wat tieng ia ki .

en: And not only they , but ourselves also , which have the firstfruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for the adoption , to wit , the redemption of our body .
kha: Hynrei ym dei tang ki jingthaw kiba ud ; ma ngi ruh kiba don ïa U Mynsiem kum ki jingai banyngkong jong U Blei , ngi ïa-ud hapoh lade hi , katba ngi dang ap ïa U Blei ba un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u bad ban pyllaitluid phar ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym tang ma ki, hynrei ia lade ruh, kiba don ia ki soh ba nyngkong jong U Mynsiem, wat ngi hi ruh ngi ud hapoh jong ngi, ngi ap ia ka jingpdiang sngewbha, ban wad ia ka jingpynim ia ka met jong ngi .

en: Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;
kha: Ha ka jingim jong u ha kane ka pyrthei , U Jisu u la duwai bad khot kyrpad da kaba pyrta jam bad ïam ha khmat U Blei , uba lah ban pyllait ïa u na ka jingïap . Namar ba u long uba sngewrit bad aiti lut , U Blei u la shahshkor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba ha ki sngi jong ka doh jong u , haba u la tyrwa ia ki jingduwai bad ki jingkyrpad da kaba iam bad ki ummat kiba jur ha u uba la lah ban pynim ia u na ka jingiap , bad la iohsngew ia u ha kaba u la tieng;

en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin  ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?
kha: Wat ai ba ki kyntien jong phi kin ïalam ïa phi sha ka pop , ba kumta phi hap ban ïathuh ïa u lyngdoh jong U Blei ba phim shym mut shisha . Balei ban pynlong ïa U Blei ban bitar ïa phi ? Balei yn shah ïa u ban pynjot thiaw ïa kaei kaba phi la trei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pynsngewbha ia ka shyntur jong me ban pynlong ia ka doh jong me ban leh pop ; lymne ong ha khmat u angel ba ka la long ka jingbakla: namar kata u Blei un bitar ia ka sur jong me bad un pynjot ia ka kam jong ki kti jong me ?

en: So shall he sprinkle many nations  ; the kings shall shut their mouths at him : for that which had not been told them shall they see  ; and that which they had not heard shall they consider .
kha: Hynrei mynta bun ki hima kin sngewphylla ïa u , bad ki syiem kin ym lait kren namar ka jingsngew lyngngoh . Kin ïohi bad kin sngewthuh katto katne kaba kim pat ju tip mynno mynno .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta un pynkhih ia kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ; ki syiem kin khang ia ka shyntur jong ki ha u: namar ia kata kaba ym shym la iathuh ha ki kin iohi ; bad ia kaba kim shym la iohsngew kin pyrkhat .

en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and , behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :
kha: bad ngi la lynñiar sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap . U la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ngi bad u la phah ïa u angel , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na Ijipt . Mynta ngi don ha Kadesh , ka shnong kaba ha khappud ka hima jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la pyrta ha U Trai , u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ngi bad u la phah ia u angel bad u la pynmih ia ngi na Ijipt : bad, ha khmih, ngi don ha Kadesh, ka shnong kaba don ha ka pud jong me:

en: And Ahiah , the son of Ahitub , I–chabod s brother , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eli , the  Lord s  priest in Shiloh , wearing an ephod . And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone .
kha: ( U lyngdoh uba rah ïa ka ephod u dei u Ahijah , u khun jong u Ahitub uba shi para bad u Ikhabod , uba dei u khun jong u Phinehas bad u khun ksiew jong u Eli , u lyngdoh jong U  Trai  ha Shiloh . ) Ki rangbah kim shym tip ba u Jonathan u la lah mih .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahiah u khun u Ahitub, u hynmen jong u Phinehas, u khun u Eli, u lyngdoh jong U Trai ha Shiloh, u phong ia ka Ephod . Bad ki briew kim tip ba u Jonathan u la jah noh .

en: And he saw them toiling in rowing  ; for the wind was contrary unto them : and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them , walking upon the sea , and would have passed by them .
kha: U la ïohi ba ki synran jong u ki dang ïaleh shitom ha ki boitha , namar ki dang king pyrshah ïa ka lyer , kumta katto katne por hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep u la wan sha ki , da kaba ïaid halor ka um . U la don jingmut ban ïaid najan jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la iohi ia ki ba ki iaid lyngba ia ki briew: bad shaphang ka jingpahara kaba saw jong ka miet u wan sha ki, u iaid halor ka duriaw, bad un sa iaid lyngba jong ki .

en: Come up , ye horses  ; and rage , ye chariots  ; and let the mighty men come forth  ; the Ethiopians and the Libyans , that handle the shield  ; and the Ludim , that handle and bend the bow .
kha: Hukum ïa ki kulai ban leit bad ïa ki kali ïapom ban tyllun ! To phah noh ïa ki shipai : ki rangbah na Sudan bad Lydia , kiba rah ïa ki stieh bad ki nongsiatkhnam batbit na Lydia .’
translated_en_to_kha: To wan shaneng, phi ki kulai ; bad ka jingbitar, phi ki kali bad ai ba ki riewshlur kin wan shabar; ki nong Ithiopia bad ki Libyan kiba bat ia ka stieh ; bad ka Ludim kiba bat bad pynkhih ia ka bow .

en: And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .
kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Ngin ïaleit lut baroh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki tymmen jong ngi . Ngin ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi , lem bad ki langbrot bad ki blang , bad ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynlong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong , Ngin ia leit bad ki khun shynrang jong ngi bad ki khun shynrang jong ngi bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi bad ki kynthei jong ngi bad ki kynhun jong ngi ngin ia leit; namar ngi dei ban leh ia ka jingkhawai sha U Trai .

en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger , I will not return to destroy Ephraim : for I am God , and not man  ; the Holy One in the midst of thee : and I will not enter into the city .
kha: Ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga ; ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki Israel . Namar nga dei U Blei bad ym u briew . Ma nga , uta Uba Khuid ngan long bad phi . Ngan ym wan sha phi ha ka jingbitar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ym pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga, ngan ym wan phai shuh ban pynjot ia u Ephraim: namar nga long U Blei , bad ym u briew uba khuid hapdeng jong me: bad ngan ym rung shapoh ka nongbah .

en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u syiem ka Israel u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad sdang ban tei kut ïa ka Ramah khnang ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lynti shapoh bad shabar ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka hynriewphew snem jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem Israel u la wan pyrshah ia u Judah bad u la tei ia u Ramah, da ka jingthmu ba un ym pyllait ne wan rung sha u syiem Judah .

en: And when they came to the camp of Israel , the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites , so that they fled before them : but they went forward smiting the Moabites , even in their country .
kha: Hynrei haba ki la poi ha ka jaka shong dara , ki Israel ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki bad ki la beh krad ïa ki . Ki Israel ki la ïai beh kthong , da kaba pynïap ïa ki Moab
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka sah jong ki Israel, ki Israel ki la ieng bad ki la shoh ia ki nong Moab , haduh ba ki la phet noh ha khmat jong ki: hynrei ki la leit sha khmat ki nong Moab , wat ha ka ri jong ki ruh .

en: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council , and bound Jesus , and carried him away , and delivered him to Pilate .
kha: Dang step eh ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh kyrkieh bad ki rangbah nongïalam , ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum , bad ïa ka Dorbar baroh kawei , bad ki la shna ïa ki jingthmu jong ki . Ki la teh kynjri ïa U Jisu , ki la ïalam noh ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u sha u Pilat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ia kren bad ki rangbah bad ki nongthoh bad ka dorbar baroh kawei, bad ki la teh ia U Jisu bad ki la rah noh ia u sha u Pilat .

en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .
kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingshisha , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jentil , ki Jentil ki dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pynsngewbha shisha ia ki bad ki nongkit ram jong ki ki long . Namar lada ki Jutang ki la shah pynlong ki nongshim bynta ha kiei kiei kiba kynja mynsiem jong ki , ka kamram jong ki ruh ka long ban shakri ia ki ha kiei kiei kiba kynja doh .

en: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u long uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid nga ong ha phi , Napdeng kita kiba la kha na ki kynthei ym shym la mih uba kham khraw ban ia u Ioannis u Nongpynbaptis: wat la uta uba kham duna ha ka hima bneng u kham khraw ban ia u .

en: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea , and there abode .
kha: U Herod u la ai hukum ban wad ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem ïa u . Kumta u la phah tohkit ïa ki nongap phira bad u la hukum ban pynïap ïa ki . Hadien kane , u Herod u la iehnoh ïa ka Judia bad u la pynlut katto katne por ha Kaisaria .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Herod u la wad ia u bad um lap ia u, u la bishar bniah ia ki nongsumar bad u la hukum ba kin shah pyniap . Bad u la leit hiar na Judaia sha Kaisaria bad hangta u la sah .

en: And God s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the  Lord  stood in the way for an adversary against him . Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him .
kha: U Blei u la bitar ba u Balaam u la leit , bad katba u Balaam u dang leit da kaba shong halor ka kada jong u , la synran ïa u da ar ngut ki shakri jong u ; u angel U  Trai  u la ïeng ha ka surok ban khang lynti ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingbitar U Blei ka la bthei namar ba u la leit: bad u angel U Trai u la ieng ha lynti na ka bynta u nongshun pyrshah ia u . Mynta u la shong ha ka tdong jong u , bad ki arngut ki shakri jong u ki la don ryngkat bad u .

en: Now , brethren , if I come unto you speaking with tongues , what shall I profit you , except I shall speak to you either by revelation , or by knowledge , or by prophesying , or by doctrine ?
kha: Kumta haba nga wan ha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ka myntoi aïu ïa phi lada nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher ? Tang khyndiat ruh em , lymda nga wanrah katto katne ka jingpynpaw na U Blei ne katto katne ka jingtip ne katto katne ka khubor kaba pyrsad mynsiem , ne katto katne ka jinghikai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ko para bangeit lada nga wan sha phi da kaba kren da ki thylliej , ngan ioh jingmyntoi aiu ia phi , lymda ngan kren ia phi da ka jingpynpaw ne da ka jingtip ne da kaba iathuhlypa ne da ka jinghikai ?

en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering , according to the manner : and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: Nangta un kñia ïa kaba ar kum ka jingainguh thang , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un aiti ia kaba ar na ka bynta ka jingknia thang katkum ka rukom: bad u lyngdoh un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u na ka bynta ka pop jong u kaba u la leh pop , bad yn map ia u .

en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :
kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa phi ,  Kane ka dei ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ,  te wat nym bam phi ïa kata ka jingbam , na ka bynta uta uba la ïathuh ïa phi bad na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem —
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u briew u ong ha phi , Ia kane la tyrwa ha ki bleithaw , wat bam na ka bynta jong u ba la pyni ia ka , bad na ka bynta ka jingsngew: namar ka khyndew ka long U Trai s , bad ka jingdap jong ka:

en: And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .
kha: Ki briew bahok kin pynrem ïa ki halor ka daw jong ka jingawria bad jingpynïap briew , namar ki ïai klim bad ki kti jong ki , ki bit da ka snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shynrang kiba hok kin bishar ia ki katkum ka rukom leh be-ijot bad katkum ka rukom leh be-ijot jong ki kynthei kiba pynmih snam ; namar ki long ki nongleh be-ijot bad ka snam ka don ha ki kti jong ki .

en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him , and about his house , and about all that he hath on every side ? thou hast blessed the work of his hands , and his substance is increased in the land .
kha: Me la ïada ïa u borabor bad ïa ka longïing jong u bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u don . Me la kyrkhu ïa baroh kiba u leh , bad me la ai ha u shibun ki masi ban pyndap ha baroh ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la leh ia ka jingkhang shaphang jong u bad shaphang ka iing jong u bad shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba u don ha man la ki liang ? me la kyrkhu ia ka kam jong ki kti jong u bad ka jingdon jong u ka la nang kiew ha ka ri .

en: Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space  ;
kha: Hynrei uwei na ki , u Pharisi uba kyrteng u Gamaliel , uba long u nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa uba la burom shikatdei da ki briew baroh , u la ïeng ha ka Dorbar . U la hukum ban ïalam ïa ki apostol shipor shabar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ieng hangta uwei ha ka dorbar, u Pharisi uba kyrteng u Gamaliel , u doktor jong ka hukum , u la don ha ka nam hapdeng ki briew baroh , bad u la hukum ban buh ia ki apostol shabar khyndiat ka jaka;

en: And when they opposed themselves , and blasphemed , he shook his raiment , and said unto them , Your blood be upon your own heads  ; I am clean : from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .
kha: Haba ki la ïa-pyrshah ïa u bad ki la ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong u , u la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngew pyrshah da kaba kynther ïa u pui pui na ki jaiñ jong u bad ong ha ki ,  Lada phi long kiba la jah noh , phi hi da lade phi dei ban shim ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta jong ka ! Ngam don jingkitkhlieh . Naduh mynta ngan leit sha ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pyrshah ia lade bad ki la kren bein ia lade, u la pynkhih ia ka jainkup jong u, bad u la ong ha ki, Ka snam jong phi kan long halor ki khlieh jong phi hi; nga long uba khuid: naduh mynta ngan leit sha ki Jutang .

en: Though Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter  ; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness .
kha: wat lada u Noah , u Daniel , bad u Job ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Ka jingbha jong ki kan pyllait im tang ïa ka jingim jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u Noah, u Daniel bad u Job, ki la don ha ka, kumba nga im, ong U Trai Blei, kin ym aiti ia u khun shynrang ne kynthei ; kin ym aiti ia la ka jong ka mynsiem da ka hok jong ki .

en: But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .
kha: U  langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asasel yn wallam im ha khmat U  Trai  bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnang ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u blang, ha uba ka lot ka la hap ban long u blang , yn pyni im ha khmat U Trai , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid bad u , bad ban pyllait noh ia u na ka bynta u blang sha ka ri khlaw .

en: And the king said , Who is in the court ? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king s house , to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him .
kha: Don mano mano na ki rangbah synshar jong nga ha ïingsyiem ?  u syiem u kylli . Mynta u Haman u dang shu rung ha phyllaw ; u la wan ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien phasi ïa u Mordekai ha ka diengphasi kaba la dep pynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong , Mano ba don ha ka iing ? Mynta u Haman u la wan sha ka iing syiem kaba shabar, ban kren ha u syiem ban pynsangeh ia u Mordecai ha ka lyngkhot kaba u la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong u .

en: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain , by which he obtained witness that he was righteous , God testifying of his gifts : and by it he being dead yet speaketh .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abel ban ainguh ha U Blei ïa ka jingkñia kaba kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Kain . Lyngba ka jingngeit jong u , u la ïohpdiang ka jingsngewbha U Blei kum u briew uba hok , namar U Blei hi u la pdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong u . Da kata ka jingngeit , u Abel u dang ïai kren wat haba u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Abel u la tyrwa ha U Blei ia ka jingknia kaba kham bha ban ia u Kain, da kaba u la ioh ia ka sakhi ba u long uba hok: bad da kata u la iap hynrei u kren .

en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath : for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire  ; and he was found of them : and the  Lord  gave them rest round about .
kha: Baroh ki paid ka Judah ki la kmen namar ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jutang da ka dohnud baroh . Ki shem sngewbha ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , bad u pdiang ïa ki bad u ai ha ki ka jingsuk na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Judah baroh u la sngewbha ha ka jingsmai: namar ki la smai da ka dohnud baroh: bad ki la wad ia u da ka jingkwah baroh kawei jong ki; bad la lap ia u na ki: bad U Trai u la ai ia ki ia ka jingjahthait sawdong .

en: And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
kha: Nga kwah ïa me ban pynlong ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia me ban smai da U Trai, U Blei jong ka bneng bad U Blei jong ka khyndew, ba men ym shim ia ka tnga ha u khun jong nga na ki khun kynthei jong ki nong Kana:

en: But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice , and said unto them , Ye men of Judaea , and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem , be this known unto you , and hearken to my words :
kha: Nangta u Petros u la ïeng joit lem bad kiwei pat ki khatwei ngut ki apostol bad ha ka sur bajam u la sdang ban kren ha u paidbah :  Ko para Jiw bad phi baroh kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa nga bad shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi aïu kane ka kit jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Petros, haba u la ieng bad ki shiphew ngut, u la pynkiew ia la ka sur bad u la ong ha ki, Phi ki briew jong ka Judaea bad phi baroh kiba shong ha Jerusalem, to tip ia kane ha phi bad to sngap ia ki ktien jong nga:

en: When he hath made plain the face thereof , doth he not cast abroad the fitches , and scatter the cummin , and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place ?
kha: Shisien ba u la pynkhreh ïa ka khyndew , u bet ïa ki symbai jong ki jingthung kum ïa u dil bad u kumin . U bet ha ki laiñ ïa u kew bad u barli , bad sawdong ha ki rud jong ka , u bet da kiwei pat ki symbai .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la pynpaw shai ia ka khmat jong ka , hato um bret shabar ia ki jingbam ba la shet, bad u pynphriang ia u cummin , bad u bret ha u kew ba kongsan bad u kew ba la buh bad u rie ha ka jaka jong ki ?

en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Bad ki briew jong kane ka jaitbynriew basniew kiba dang im , kiba shong ha ki jaka kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , kin jied ban ïap ban ïa kaba ki ïai im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiap kan long kaba la jied ban ia ka jingim da ki jingsah jong ki baroh kiba sah na kane ka longiing kaba sniew, kiba sah ha ki jaka baroh ha kaba nga la beh ia ki , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king s meat , and of the wine which he drank : so nourishing them three years , that at the end thereof they might stand before the king .
kha: U syiem u la ai ruh ki hukum ba man la ka sngi la dei ban ai ïa ki da kajuh ka jingbam bad ka waiñ kum ïa ki dkhot jong ka ïingbishar syiem . Hadien lai snem jong kane ka jingai jinghikai ki dei ban wan mih ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la buh ia ki da ka jingbam ba man ka sngi jong u syiem bad na ka wain kaba u la dih: kumta u la pyndap ia ki lai snem , ba ha kaba kut jong ka kin ieng ha khmat u syiem .

en: Then Samuel took the horn of oil , and anointed him in the midst of his brethren : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon David from that day forward . So Samuel rose up , and went to Ramah .
kha: U Samuel u shim ïa ka umphniang Olib bad u pynsleh ïa u Dabid ha khmat ki hynmen jong u . Hangta hi U Mynsiem U  Trai  u wan borbah ha u Dabid bad u long ryngkat bad u naduh kata ka sngi . Nangta u Samuel u leit phai noh sha Ramah .
