kha: Nangta wat ki rangbah kiba shlur tam , ki bym ju tieng kum ki sing , kin sheptieng namar uwei pa uwei ha Israel u tip ba u kpa jong phi u dei u shipai bakhraw bad ba ki rangbah jong u ki dei ki nongïaleh kiba satar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta ruh uba shlur, uba ka dohnud jong u ka long kum ka dohnud u sing, un sa rkhiang pura: namar ki Israel baroh ki tip ba u kpa jong me u long u briew uba khlain bor bad kita kiba don ryngkat bad u ki long ki briew kiba shlur .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it , they are the flesh , and this city is the caldron : but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it .
kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi . Kane ka nongbah ka dei da shisha u khiew shet , hynrei kaei ka doh ? Ki metïap jong kito kiba phi la pynïap ! Phin ym don shuh hangne — Ngan bret ïa phi shabar kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai U Trai

en: And there was trembling in the host , in the field , and among all the people : the garrison , and the spoilers , they also trembled , and the earth quaked : so it was a very great trembling .
kha: Baroh ki Philistia ha ki nongkyndong ki la sheptieng ; ki nonglute bad ki shipai ha ka jaka sher dara ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ka khyndew ka khynñiuh , bad ka la don ka jingkulmar jingmut kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la khih ha ka kynhun shipai, ha lyngkha, bad hapdeng ki briew baroh: ka garrison bad ki nongpynjot ruh ki la khih, bad ka khyndew ka la khih: kumta ka la khih shibun eh .

en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers : Of Judah , the captains of thousands  ; Adnah the chief , and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand .
kha: U Adnah u long u nongïalam shipai na ki kur ka Judah , bad u don lai lakh ngut ki shipai hapoh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki long ki rangbah jong ki kat kum ka iing jong ki kpa jong ki: Na Judah, ki rangbah jong ki hajar; bad bad u ki rangbah shipai ki long lai spah hajar .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Phi la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan leit kiew biang sha U  Trai  ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingmap ïa ka pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u Moses u la ong ha ki briew, Phi la leh pop shibun: bad mynta ngan leit sha U Trai ; da kaba nga leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ka pop jong phi .

en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles : else the new wine doth burst the bottles , and the wine is spilled , and the bottles will be marred : but new wine must be put into new bottles .
kha: Lymne ym don uno uno uba theh ïa ka waiñ thymmai ha ki lwa snieh barim , namar ka waiñ kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , bad baroh ar , ka waiñ bad ki snieh kin sniew noh . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ thymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don mano mano ruh ba buh ia ka wain thymmai ha ki bilor kiba rim: lym kumta ka wain thymmai ka bthei ia ki bilor , bad ka wain ka tuid , bad ki bilor kin sa tyrkhong: hynrei ka wain thymmai dei ban buh ha ki bilor thymmai .

en: And Jesus took the loaves  ; and when he had given thanks , he distributed to the disciples , and the disciples to them that were set down  ; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would .
kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la sam ïa ki ha ki briew kiba la ïashong hangta . U la leh kumjuh ruh ïa ki dohkha , bad baroh ki la ïabam kat kaba ki kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la shim ia ki kpu ; bad haba u la ainguh , u la sam ha ki synran bad ki synran ha ki kiba la buh ; bad kumjuh ruh ia ki dohkha katba ki mon .

en: But who is able to build him an house , seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him ? who am I then , that I should build him an house , save only to burn sacrifice before him ?
kha: Pynban ym don uno uno uba lah shisha ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U Blei , namar wat ka jingïar jong ka bneng kam lah ban ngiam ïa u . Kumno te nga lah ban tei ka Templ ka ban long kaba kumno kumno kaba kham heh ban ïa ka jaka ban thang jingiwbih ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mano ba lah ban tei ia u iing , haba iohi ia ka bneng bad ka bneng ki bneng kam lah ban bat ia u ? nga long mano te ba nga dei ban tei ia u iing , lait noh tang ban thang ia ka jingknia ha khmat jong u ?

en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John , and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men , they marvelled  ; and they took knowledge of them , that they had been with Jesus .
kha: Ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la sngewlyngngoh ban ïohi kumno u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la long kiba shlur bad ban tip ba ki long ki riewpaidbah ki bymnang bymstad . Ki la sngewthuh te ba ki la long ki nongsynran jong U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba ki la iohi ia ka jingshlur jong u Petros bad u Ioannis bad ki la sngewthuh ba ki long ki briew ki bym nang nang la stad bad ki bym nang la stad, ki la lyngngoh ; bad ki la ithuh ia ki , ba ki la don bad U Jisu .

en: There is none greater in this house than I  ; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee , because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?
kha: Ha kane ka ïing , nga don kajuh ka iktiar kumba u don , bad um shym la tyngkai ei ei shuh na nga lait noh tang ïa phi . Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leh kat ïa kata ka kam runar , bad ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don mano mano ruh ha kane ka iing ban ia nga; bad um shym la buhrieh ei ei na nga hynrei na me: namar me long ka tnga jong u: kumno te ngan leh ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw bad nga leh pop pyrshah ia U Blei ?

en: There is Meshech , Tubal , and all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword , though they caused their terror in the land of the living .
kha: Ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal ki don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ki ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Pynban shisien ki la pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka Meshech , ka Tubal bad ka jingbun briew jong ka baroh: ki jingtep jong ka ki don sawdong jong u: baroh ki long ki bym pat shah ot , ki la shah pyniap da ka waitlam , wat la ki la pynmih ia ka jingtieng jong ki ha ka ri jong kiba im .

en: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .
kha: Nangta u Joseph u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang .  Nga la phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïanguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew, bad u la iathuh ha ki hynmen jong u, bad u la ong: Ha khmih nga la phohsniew kham bun; bad ha khmih ka sngi bad u bnai bad ki shiphew tylli ki khlur ki la kohnguh ia nga .

en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .
kha: Me dei ban shim katto katne na ka snam jong u bad ban buh ïa ka ha ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong kiba halor ha ka duwan , bad ha ki dong jong ka bynta ba hapdeng jong ka duwan , bad ha baroh sawdong jong ki tduh . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkhuid ïa ka duwan bad pynkyntang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men shim ia ka snam jong ka, bad men buh ia ka ha ki saw tylli ki tduh jong ka jaka shong jaka sah bad ha u pud sawdong: kumta men pynkhuid bad pynkhuid ia ka .

en: None eye pitied thee , to do any of these unto thee , to have compassion upon thee  ; but thou wast cast out in the open field , to the lothing of thy person , in the day that thou wast born .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba khmih isynei ïa pha ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta jong pha . Mynba la kha ïa pha , ym don mano mano ba la ieit ïa pha . La bret ïa pha ha madan bym don jingkah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don kawei ruh ka khmat kaba sngewsih ia me, ban leh ia kata ha me, ban sngewsynei ia me hynrei me la bret noh ha ka lyngkha kaba plie, ha ka jingthang ia ka khmat jong me, ha ka sngi ba la kha ia me.

en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin  ; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver :
kha: U la ai jingbthah ruh katno ka ksiar nylla kan leit ha kaba pyndonkam ban shna ïa ki proh , ki pliang , bad ki khiew , bad katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha kaba shna ïa ki pliang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ka ksiar kaba khuid na ka bynta ki bniat dohkha, bad ki khiew ksiar: bad na ka bynta ki pung ksiar u la ai ksiar da ka jingkhia na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka pla; bad kumjuh ruh ka rupa da ka jingkhia na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka pla rupa:

en: And the king said unto Cushi , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Cushi answered , The enemies of my lord the king , and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt , be as that young man is .
kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  u syiem u kylli . U mraw u jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , nga sngew ba kaei kaba la jia ha u kan jin da la jia ha baroh ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ha baroh kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Cushi , Hato u samla u la shngain ? Bad u Cushi u la jubab , Ki nongshun jong u kynrad jong nga u syiem bad baroh kiba kiew pyrshah ia me ban leh ia me kaba sniew, to long kumba uta u samla u long .

en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the  Lord  telleth thee that he will make thee an house .
kha: Nga la jied ka jaka ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad nga la pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin im khlem da shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki rung sha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh ha ki riewrunar , hynrei kane kan ym jia shuh . Nga kular ban sumar ïa me na ki nongshun jong me baroh bad ban ai ha me ki khun ki ksiew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba naduh ka por ba nga la hukum ia ki nongbishar jong nga ki Israel, bad ki la pynlong ia me ban shongthait na ki nongshun jong me baroh . Kumjuh ruh U Trai u ong ia me ba un pynlong ia me ka iing .

en: That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .
kha: U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingïakut ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Hebru , ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , khnang ba uno uno ruh un ym don u para jait Israel kum u mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba uwei pa uwei u dei ban ailad ia u nongshakri jong u, bad uwei pa uwei u nongshakri jong u, uba long u Hebru ne u Hebru, un leit laitluid; ba ym don mano mano ruh ba dei ban shakri ia lade na ki, ban leit noh, na u hynmen jong u.

en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots .
kha: U Dabid u ïohknieh shihajar tylli ki kali ïapom jong u , hynñiew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai , bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U buh ki kulai kat ban biang na ka bynta shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad u pyndkoh noh ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim na u shi hajar tylli ki kali kit kulai, bad hynriew hajar ngut ki nongshong kulai: U Dabid ruh u la bat ia ki kulai kit kulai baroh .

en: Wherefore then do ye harden your hearts , as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts ? when he had wrought wonderfully among them , did they not let the people go , and they departed ?
kha: Balei phin pyneh ïa la ki dohnud kumba leh u Pharaoh bad ki nong Ijipt ? Wat klet kumno U Blei u la pynlong ki bieit ïa ki haduh ba kin da shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei te phi pynkhlain ia ki dohnud jong phi kumba ki nong Ijipt bad u Pharaoh ki la pynkhlain ia ki dohnud jong ki ? haba u la leh phylla hapdeng jong ki , kim shym la pyllait ia ki briew bad ki la leit noh ?

en: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin , if she pass the flower of her age , and need so require , let him do what he will , he sinneth not : let them marry .
kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki ar ngut kiba la ïatehktien kiba la rai ba kin ym ïashongkurim : Lada uta u briew u sngew ba um shym leh kaba dei ïa ka theisotti bad lada ki jingkwah brai jong u ki jur haduh katta katta bad u sngew ba u dei ban shongkurim , te ki dei ban ïashongkurim noh , kumba u kwah . Kam don pop ei ei ha kane .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u briew u pyrkhat ba u leh khlem akor ia ka khunlung jong u, lada ka iaid lait ia u syntiew jong ka rta jong ka, bad ka donkam kumta, to un leh katba u mon: to ai ba kin ia poi kha .

en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?
kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da kat ka ïing kan kylla long kaba sah kynjah , bad kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un kyndit thret bad un pang met ; bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U  Trai  u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kane ka iing kaba jrong , uwei pa uwei uba iaid lyngba jong ka un sngew lyngngoh bad un sngap jar bad kin ong: Balei U Trai u la leh kumta ia kane ka ri bad ia kane ka iing ?

en: And they went out into the fields , and gathered their vineyards , and trode the grapes , and made merry , and went into the house of their god , and did eat and drink , and cursed Abimelech .
kha: Baroh ki ïaleit sha la ki bri sohwaiñ bad kheit ïa ki sohwaiñ , ki shna waiñ na ki , bad ki pynlong ka jingïaleh kmen . Ki leit sha ka templ jong u blei jong ki , ha kaba ki la ïabam bad ïadih bad ki krenbeiñ ïa u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit sha ki lyngkha bad ki la lum ia ki kper sohjew jong ki bad ki la iaid kjat bad ki la ia sngewbha bad ki la leit shapoh iing u blei jong ki bad ki la bam bad dih bad ki la tim ia u Abimelech .

en: And say to the land of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I am against thee , and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath , and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked .
kha: Ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong phi . Ngan sei ïa ka waitlam jong nga bad ngan pynïap ïa phi baroh , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ka ri Israel , Kumta u Trai ; Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me, bad ngan sei noh ia ka waitlam jong nga na ka sniehdoh jong u, bad ngan ot noh na me ia kiba hok bad kiba sniew .

en: But woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men : for ye neither go in yourselves , neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi khang ïa ka jingkhang sha ka Hima ki bneng na khmat ki briew , hynrei ma phi da lade hi phim leit rung shapoh , lymne ba phi shah shapoh ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kordit ia phi, ko nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ko nongleh arsap ! namar phi khang ia ka hima bneng pyrshah ia ki briew: namar phim leit shapoh jong phi hi , lymne phim shah ia kita kiba rung shapoh .

en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .
kha: u da ïaid na shatei jong ka sharing lum jong ka Beth Hoglah , bad u kut ha ka jaka ba ka wah Jordan ka wan tuid ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka Duriaw Baïap . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam u la iaid sha ka liang ka Bethhoglah shaphang shathie : bad ki jingleit jingwan jong u pud ki long ha ka liang mihngi jong ka duriaw mluh ha ka tduh ba shathie jong ka Jordan: kane ka la long ka rud duriaw ba shathie .

en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not , nor unto any place of the river Jabbok , nor unto the cities in the mountains , nor unto whatsoever the  Lord  our God forbad us .
kha: Hynrei ngim shym leit sha jan ka ri ki Ammon lane sha ki jaka harud ka Wah Jabbok lane sha ki shnong ha ri lum lane sha kano kano ka jaka sha kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la adong ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ha ka ri jong ki khun Ammon wat leit sha kano kano ka jaka jong ka wah Jabok, ne sha ki nongbah ha ki lum, ne sha kano kano ka jaka ba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la leit noh ia ngi .

en: And when thou hast stayed three days , then thou shalt go down quickly , and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel .
kha: La shi sngi , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan kham paw shuh shuh ; te leit hiar sha kato ka jaka ha kaba phi rieh mynshuwa ; bad rieh ha lyndet ka kynton maw hangto .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda me la sah lai sngi, te me dei ban leit hiar kloi, bad to wan sha ka jaka ba me la buhrieh ia lade haba ka kam ka la don ha kti, bad to sah hajan u maw Esel .

en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father : and no man knoweth the Son , but the Father  ; neither knoweth any man the Father , save the Son , and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .
kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Khun lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Kpa lait tang U Khun bad kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpaw ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiei kiei la aiti ha nga na U Kpa jong nga: bad ym don ba tip ia U Khun , hynrei U Kpa um ithuh ia u briew u Kpa , lait noh tang ia U Khun , bad uta ha uba U Khun un pynpaw ia U .

en: Rejoice , O ye nations , with his people : for he will avenge the blood of his servants , and will render vengeance to his adversaries , and will be merciful unto his land , and to his people .
kha: Phi ki jaitbynriew , ïaroh ïa ki briew U  Trai  ; naba u pynshitom ïa kito baroh kiba pynïap ïa ki . U pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong u , bad u map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha, ko ki jaitbynriew, bad ki briew jong u: namar un pynshitom ia ka snam jong ki shakri jong u, bad un pynshitom bein ia ki nongshun jong u, bad un long uba isynei ia ka ri jong u bad ia ki briew jong u .

en: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel , Go , lie down : and it shall be , if he call thee , that thou shalt say , Speak ,  Lord   ; for thy servant heareth . So Samuel went and lay down in his place .
kha: kumta u ong ha u ,  Khie leit thiah biang , bad lada u khot biang ïa phi sa shisien , sa ong , ‘ To kren , ko  Trai  , u shakri jong me u sngap .’   Kumta u Samuel u leit biang sha la ka jaka thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Eli u la ong ha u Samuel, To leit thiah: bad kan long, lada u khot ia me, ba me ong, To kren, ko Trai; namar u shakri jong me u iohsngew . Kumta u Samuel u la leit thiah ha ka jaka jong u .

en: But the same servant went out , and found one of his fellowservants , which owed him an hundred pence : and he laid hands on him , and took him by the throat , saying , Pay me that thou owest .
kha: Nangta uta u briew u la mihnoh bad u la ïakynduh ïa uwei na ki para shakri jong u uba la shahram ïa u katto katne tyngka . U la bat trait bad u la ksih ïa u . ‘ Siew noh ïa ka ram jong nga !’ u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta u juh u shakri u la mih noh, bad u la shem ia uwei na ki para shakri jong u uba la donkam ia u da ki shispah pen: bad u la buh kti ha u, bad u la shim ia u da ka shyntur, u da ong: To siew ia nga ba me dei ban siew .

en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways , and be ashamed , when thou shalt receive thy sisters , thine elder and thy younger : and I will give them unto thee for daughters , but not by thy covenant .
kha: Phan kynmaw kumno pha la leh , bad sngewlehrain ïa ka haba pha ïoh pat ïa ka hynmen bad ka para jong pha . Ngan shah ïa ki ban long kum ki khun kynthei jong pha , wat la kane kam dei ka bynta jong ka jutang jong nga bad pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to kynmaw ia ki lynti jong me, bad to sngewlehrain, haba me pdiang ia ki para kynthei jong me, kiba kham heh bad kiba kham rit jong me: bad ngan ai ia ki ha me na ka bynta ki khun kynthei jong me, hynrei ym da ka jutang jong me .

en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .
kha: Ka met jong u dieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat kin ym long shuh da lei lei kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . Kane ka dei ka jingrwai jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju rwai bad ïai rwai ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ding ka la jah noh na u dieng jong ka, uba la bam ia u soh jong ka, haduh ba kam don u dieng uba khlain ban long u diengduh ban synshar . Kane ka long ka jingsngewsih , bad kan long na ka bynta ka jingsngewsih .

en: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .
kha: Ngi khmih sha phi kum u nongïalam uba khraw ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep kaba bha tam kaba ngi don . Uno uno na ngi un da sngewkmen ban ai jaka tep ha phi , ba phin ïoh ban tep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ngi, ko kynrad jong nga: me long u syiem uba khlain bor hapdeng jong ngi: ha ka jingjied ia ki jingtep jong ngi to tep ia ka met iap jong me; ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban kyntait na me ia ka jingtep jong u, hynrei ba me lah ban tep ia kiba iap jong me .

en: And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .
kha: ki da pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh , bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad wat ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pynkhih ia ka ri, bad um shym la iehnoh ia u briew ne ka kynthei, bad u la shim noh ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ki kada bad ki kulai bad ki kulai bad ki jain bad u la wan phai noh sha Akhis .

en: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :
kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam ,  Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan knieh noh ïa ka hima na u Solomon , bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u Jeroboam: To shim ia me shiphew tylli: namar kumta u ong U Trai, U Blei jong ki Israel: Ha khmih ngan pynkylla ia ka hima na ka kti u Solomon bad ngan ai shiphew jait ha me:

en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki parabangeit ïa kiba la pynsakma da ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ kaba la jia myn haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , ka la pur shaduh sha Phoenisia , Sypros , bad Antiokh , da kaba ïathuh ïa ka khubor tang ha ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kito kiba la shah pynpra shabar ri ha ka jingshah pynshitom bein kaba la mih shaphang u Stephan ki la leit haduh Phoenisia bad u Cyprus bad u Antioch, ki da ialap ia ka ktien ym sha ki Jiw tang ha ki Jiw .

en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel . And it came to pass , when the man of God saw her afar off , that he said to Gehazi his servant , Behold , yonder is that Shunammite :
kha: Kumta ka la leit , bad ka leit sha u Lum Karmel , ha kaba u Elisha u don . U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , ba ka wan katba ka dang don kham ha pajih , bad u ong ha u Gehasi , u shakri jong u ,  Ha khmih — katai ka briew na Shunem ka wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la leit bad ka la wan sha u briew jong U Blei ban kiew ia ka Karmel . Bad ka la jia haba uta u briew jong U Blei u la iohi ia ka na jngai, ba u la ong ha u Gehasi u shakri jong u, Ha khmih, hangta u Shunam:

en: For some of them thought , because Judas had the bag , that Jesus had said unto him , Buy those things that we have need of against the feast  ; or , that he should give something to the poor .
kha: Namar ba u Judas u long uba bat ïa ka pla pisa , don na ki synran ki la pyrkhat ba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ban leit bad thied ïa kaei kaba ki donkam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam , lane ban ai ei ei ïa kiba duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta katto katne na ki ki la pyrkhat, namar ba u Judas u don ka pla, ba U Jisu u la ong ha u, To thied ia kita kiei kiei kiba ngi donkam pyrshah ia ka jingkhawai ; ne , ba un ai ei ei ia kiba duk .

en: And , behold , thou shalt be dumb , and not able to speak , until the day that these things shall be performed , because thou believest not my words , which shall be fulfilled in their season .
kha: Hynrei mem shym ngeit ïa ka khubor jong nga , ka ban urlong shisha ha ka por kaba dei . Namar ba mem shym la ngeit , men ym lah ban kren , men ïailong uba jar jar tad ynda ka sngi ha kaba ka jingkular jong nga ha me ka urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, men long uba dum, bad wat lah ban kren, haduh ka sngi ba kine kiei kiei kin long, namar me ngeit ia ki ktien jong nga, kiba yn pyndep ha ka aiom jong ki .

en: For Moses truly said unto the fathers , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you .
kha: Naba U Moses u la ong , ‘ U Trai uba U Blei jong phi un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uwei na ki briew jong phi hi . Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u ong ïa phi ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Moses u la ong shisha ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi: U Nongiathuhlypa U Trai U Blei jong phi un pynmih ha phi na ki hynmen jong phi, kumba ha nga; ia u phin iohsngew ha kiei kiei baroh kiba un ong ha phi .

en: Thus said the  Lord  unto me  ; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , whereby the kings of Judah come in , and by the which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem  ;
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , khie leit bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ka Khyrdop Paidbah , kaba lyngba jong ka ki syiem jong ka Judah ki rung shapoh bad mih shabar ka nongbah ; nangta leit sha baroh kiwei pat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai u la ong ha nga; To leit ieng ha ka khyrdop jong ki khun ki ksiew, ha kaba ki syiem Judah ki wan rung, bad da kaba ki mih noh, bad ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem baroh;

en: All ye , assemble yourselves , and hear  ; which among them hath declared these things ? The  Lord  hath loved him : he will do his pleasure on Babylon , and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans .
kha: To ïalumlang bad to shahshkor , ma phi baroh ! Ym don na ki blei kiba lah ban ïathuh lypa ba u briew uba nga la jied un tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon ; un leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ïa u ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh phi , to ia lum lang ia lade , bad to iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei ? U Trai u la ieit ia u: un leh ia ka jingsngewbha jong u ha Babilon , bad ka kti jong u kan long ha ki Khaldes .

en: And the king said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah ? so let him curse , because the  Lord  hath said unto him , Curse David . Who shall then say , Wherefore hast thou done so ?
kha: Kane kam dei ka kam jong me ,  u syiem u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u .  Lada u tim ïa nga namar ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa u , mano ba don hok ban kylli balei u leh ïa ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong: Nga don jingiadei bad phi, ko khun jong u Seruiah? kumta to ai ba un tim ia u, namar U Trai u la ong ha u, U Dabid uba la tim ia u. Mano ba ong te: Balei me la leh kumta ?

en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
kha: Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jong pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki lah ban long jingïarap katto katne ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: To ieng mynta bad ki jingleh jadu jong me, bad bad ka jingbun ki jingleh jadu jong me, ha kaba me la trei shitom na ka jinglong samla jong me; lada kumta me lah ban ioh jingmyntoi, lada kumta me lah ban jop .

en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .
kha: U  Trai  u shoh ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba shyrkhei kaba la sah bad u shi lynter ka jingim jong u . U sah hi marwei ha la ka jong ka ïing , la pyllait ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la shoh ia u syiem, haduh ba u la long u nongpang niangthohlieh haduh ka sngi jong ka jingiap jong u, bad u la shong ha kawei ka iing . Bad u Jotham u khun syiem u la long halor ka iing , u la bishar ia ki briew jong ka ri .

en: The conversation , which takes place in Hindi , goes something like this : At first , Vijayvargiya can be heard enquiring about some new leaders who could engage the Matua community in Bengal .
kha: Ka jingiakren kaba long ha ka ktien Hindi ka iaid kumne : Ha kaba nyngkong lah ban iohsngew ia u Vijayvargiya ba u kylli shaphang ki katto katne ki nongialam thymmai kiba lah ban pyniadei bad ka jaitbynriew Matua ha Bengal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiakren kaba jia ha ka ktien Hindi , ka iaid kumne: Ha kaba nyngkong , lah ban iohsngew ia u Vijayvargiya ba u kylli shaphang ki katto katne ki nongialam thymmai kiba lah ban pyntreikam ia ka imlang sahlang Matua ha Bengal .

en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran katba ki dang ïabam . U la kren tyngeh ïa ki , namar kim shym la don jingngeit bad namar ka jingmutlop palat ïa ka ban ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la paw ha ki shiphew ngut ki dang shong ha ka doh, bad u la pynkhih ia ki da ka jingbymngeit bad ka jingkhlain jong ka dohnud jong ki, namar kim ngeit ia kita kiba la iohi ia u hadien ba u la mihpat .

en: Mischief shall come upon mischief , and rumour shall be upon rumour  ; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet  ; but the law shall perish from the priest , and counsel from the ancients .
kha: Ka jingjynjar kan bud kawei hadien kawei pat , ka khubor basniew kan ïai tuid . Phin kyrpad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki ïohi lypa . Ki lyngdoh kin ym don ei ei shuh ban hikai ïa ki briew , bad ki tymmen ki san kin ym don jingsneng jingkraw shuh ban ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbym don jingmut kan wan ha ka jingsniew, bad ka jingsngewsih kan long ha ka jingsma; nangta kin wad ia ka jingphohsniew jong u nongiathuhlypa ; hynrei ka hukum kan jah noh na u lyngdoh bad ka jingai jingmut na ki rangbah .

en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;
kha: U la ong ,  Shim ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah bad u Jedaïah kiba la shah ringmraw , bad leit shisyndon sha ka ïing jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baroh ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Shim na ki na ka jingshah set phatok, wat na u Heldai, na u Tobiiah bad na u Jedaiah, kiba wan na Babilon, bad me wan ha kajuh ka sngi, bad leit sha ka iing u Josiah u khun u Sephaniah;

en: For I am a man under authority , having soldiers under me : and I say to this man , Go , and he goeth  ; and to another , Come , and he cometh  ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
kha: Ma nga ruh , nga long u briew hapoh ka iktiar jong ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kham halor , bad nga don ruh ki shipai hapoh jong nga . Nga hukum ïa une uwei , ‘ Khie leit !’ bad u leit ; bad nga hukum ïa utai uwei , ‘ Ale !’ bad u wan ; bad nga hukum ïa u mraw jong nga , ‘ Leh ïa kane !’ bad u leh ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga long u briew uba hapoh ka bor, uba don ki shipai hapoh jong nga: bad nga ong ia une u briew, To leit; bad u leit sha uwei pat: To wan; bad u wan sha u shakri jong nga: To leh ia kane, bad u leh ia kata .

en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not , when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem  ;
kha: ( Mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , bad ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , u la iehnoh ïa ki rishot , ka dabor tama , ki kali tan , bad katto katne tylli kiwei pat ki jingkynshew ka Templ . )
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba u Neuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon um shym la shim , haba u la rah noh ia u khun u Jehoshim u syiem Judah na Jerusalem sha Babilon bad ki rangbah Judah bad Jerusalem baroh;

en: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin : and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel , and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin .
kha: U Abner u la kren ruh ha ki briew jong ka jait Benjamin , bad nangta u leit sha Hebron ban ïathuh ha u Dabid aïu ki paid Benjamin bad Israel ki la mynjur ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner ruh u la kren ha ki shkor u Benjamin : bad u Abner ruh u la leit kren ha ki shkor u Dabid ha Hebron baroh kaba la long kaba bha ia ki Israel bad kata ka la long kaba bha ia ka iing u Benjamin baroh kawei .

en: Girded with girdles upon their loins , exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads , all of them princes to look to , after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea , the land of their nativity :
kha: Ka nang ngam nang ngam ha ka jinglong bajakhlia jong ka . Ka ïapmat ïa ki durbriew jong ki rangbah shipai ka Babilonia ba la ohdur ha ka kynroh bad ba la airong da ka rong saw baphyrnai , lem bad ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki bad ki jaiñspong ba-itynnat ha ki khlieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La pyndonkam da ki jain ha ki tyrpeng jong ki, da kaba pynkylla ia ki jain rong saw ha ki khlieh jong ki, baroh ki syiem ban peit sha ka rukom jong ki nong Babilon jong ka Kaldesia, ka ri jong ka jingkha jong ki:

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .
kha: U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , U  Trai  uba pynim ïa phi u ong ,  Ban pynim ïa phi , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Babilon ; ngan pynpait ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah , bad ki jingrisa jong ki briew jong ka kin kylla jingïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , u nongsiewspah jong phi , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel ; Na ka bynta jong phi nga la phah sha Babilon , bad nga la pynhap ia ki rangbah jong ki baroh , bad ki Khaldes kiba ka jingud jong ki ka don ha ki lieng .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .
kha: To sngap noh na ka jingïam jong phi bad to ñiad noh ïa ki ummat jong phi . Baroh kiba phi la leh na ka bynta ki khun jong phi kin ym long lehnoh-ei ; kin wan phai pat na ka ri u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai ; Pynsangeh ia ka sur jong me na ka jingud, bad ki khmat jong me na ki ummat: namar ka kam jong me kan long kaba la siew kylliang , ong u Trai ; bad kin wan phai biang na ka ri jong u nongshun .

en: And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .
kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , shim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pyndonkam ïa ka ban khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh bad u  ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, ko khun u briew, shim ia me da ka wait kaba jem, shim ia me da ka ryndang kaba jem, bad pynlong ia ka ban iaid halor ka khlieh jong me bad halor ka ryndang jong me: nangta shim ia me da ki jingthew ban khia, bad phiah ia ki shniuh .

en: Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;
kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki thang jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lynti ba ki dei ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti ba khlem buh dak .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki briew jong nga ki la klet ia nga , ki la thang ia ka jingiwbih sha ka jinglong ba sniew , bad ki la pynlong ia ki ban ia tyngkhuh ha ki lynti jong ki na ki lynti hyndai , ban iaid ha ki lynti ki lynti ki bym ju kiew ; .

en: And when they came down to him , Elisha prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , Smite this people , I pray thee , with blindness . And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha .
kha: Haba ki Syria ki wan tur ïaleh , u Elisha u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynmatlah ïa kine ki briew .  U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u bad shoh pynmatlah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la wan hiar sha u , u Elisha u la duwai ha U Trai bad u la ong: To sngap ia une u briew, nga kyrpad ia me da ka jingmatlah . Bad u la shoh ia ki da ka jingmatlah katkum ka ktien jong u Elisha .

en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba u ong ban ai ha u Isaïah :  Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingshah shitom ; ngi la shah pynshitom bad don ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi long kum ka briew kaba la khreh ban kha khun , hynrei ka tlot palat ban kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u , Kumta u Hesekaiah u ong: Kane ka sngi ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah lehbein: namar ki khun ki wan sha ka jingkha khun , bad ym don bor ban kha khun .

en: They return , but not to the most High : they are like a deceitful bow : their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue : this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt .
kha: Ki ïai phai lyndet na nga sha u blei u bymdonbor ei ei ruh em . Ki long ki bym lah ban shaniah kum ka ryntieh kaba kynriang . Namar ki nongïalam jong ki , ki kren meng , kin ïap ha ka jingïap bashyrkhei , bad ki nong Ijipt kin sa ïa-rkhie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan phai , hynrei ym sha ka jaka kaba heh tam: ki long kum ka bow kaba thok: ki syiem jong ki kin hap da ka waitlam na ka bynta ka jingbitar jong ka shyntur jong ki: kane kan long ka jingleh bein jong ki ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: But woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs , and pass over judgment and the love of God : these ought ye to have done , and not to leave the other undone .
kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ai sha U Blei ïa kawei na ki shiphew jong ki jhur pynbang jingbam , kum u pudina bad u rue    bad baroh kiwei pat ki jait jhur , hynrei phi leh klet ïa ka jinglehhok bad ka jingieit ïa U Blei . Ïa kine phi la dei ban leh , khlem da leh klet ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei sngewsih ia phi, ko Pharisi ! namar phi ia ka jingmut bad ka jingsma bad ki jingthung bapher bapher bad ki jingthung bapher bapher: kine ki la dei ban leh , bad ban ym iehnoh ia kiwei pat ki bym don shuh .

en: For we which have believed do enter into rest , as he said , As I have sworn in my wrath , if they shall enter into my rest : although the works were finished from the foundation of the world .
kha: Ngi kiba ngeit , te , ngi ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular . Ka la long kumba u la ong ,  Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingkular kyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ka jingjahthait !’   U la kren ïa kane wat haba la pyndep ïa ka kam jong u naduh ka por ba u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi kiba la ngeit ngi rung ha ka jingjahthait kumba u la ong , Kumba nga la smai ha ka jingbitar jong nga: wat la ki kam ki la dep naduh ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei .

en: Concerning Kedar , and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite , thus saith the  Lord   ; Arise ye , go up to Kedar , and spoil the men of the east .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang ka jait Kedar bad ïa ki distrik hapoh ka jingpynïaid u Hasor , ïa kiba la jop thma da u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia :  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Kedar bad pynjot ïa kata ka jait jong ki briew na mihngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang u Kdar bad shaphang ki hima Hasor, kiba u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon un sa khih, kumta u ong u Trai ; To kiew ia phi, to kiew sha Kdar bad pynjot ia ki briew jong ka ri mihngi .

en: But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .
kha: Uta U Nongïarap , U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw ïa baroh kaba nga la ïathuh ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Nongialam uba long U Mynsiem Bakhuid, uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ia phi ia kiei kiei baroh bad un wanrah ia kiei kiei baroh ha ka jingkynmaw jong phi , katba nga la ong ha phi .

en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .
kha: Lehse haba ki paid Judah kin ïohsngew shaphang baroh ka jingpynjot kaba nga thmu ban wallam halor jong ki , kin phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong ki . Te ngan map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka iing Judah kan iohsngew ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba nga thmu ban leh ia ki ; ba kin pynphai noh ia uwei pa uwei na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u ; ba ngan map ia ka jingbymhok jong ki bad ka pop jong ki .

en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together , he rebuked the foul spirit , saying unto him ,  Thou dumb and deaf spirit , I charge thee , come out of him , and enter no more into him .
kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u paidbah u la nang kyntur ïa ki , kumta u la hukum ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid .  Mynsiem bakyllut bad bymnang kren ,  u la ong ,  Nga hukum ïa me ban mihnoh na u khynnah bad wat ju rung shuh hapoh jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohi ba ki briew ki la ia mareh lang, u la pynrem ia u mynsiem bymman, u da ong ha u: Me mynsiem bad ba sngap jar, nga kynnoh ia me, to mih noh na u bad wat rung shuh ha u .

en: As it is written in the law of Moses , all this evil is come upon us : yet made we not our prayer before the  Lord  our God , that we might turn from our iniquities , and understand thy truth .
kha: da kaba ai ha ngi ïa baroh ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka Aiñ jong u Moses . Hynrei wat mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , ngim shym la pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa me da kaba phai noh na ki pop jong ngi lane da kaba bud ïa ka jingshisha jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba la thoh ha ka hukum u Moses , kane ka jingsniew baroh ka wan ha ngi: hynrei ngim shym la leh ia ka jingduwai jong ngi ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong ngi, ba ngin phai noh na ki jingbymhok jong ngi bad sngewthuh ia ka jingshisha jong me .

en: And they turned aside thither , to go in and to lodge in Gibeah : and when he went in , he sat him down in a street of the city : for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging .
kha: Ki phai noh na ka lynti bah ban leit sahmiet hangta . Ki rung shapoh ka nongbah bad ki shong ha madan shnong , hynrei ym don ba khot basa ïa ki ha kata ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai noh shapoh hangta, ban leit rung bad ban sah ha Gibeah : bad haba u la leit rung , u la shong ia u ha kawei ka lynti jong ka shnong: namar ym don briew uba la ialam ia ki shapoh iing jong u ban sah .

en: Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .
kha: Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la tei da u syiem Ahas , U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien .  Bad ka syrngiew ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan wanrah biang ia ka jingdum jong ki kyrdan , kaba la hiar ha ka sngi u Ahas , shi degree shadien . Kumta ka sngi ka la wan phai shi degree , da kaba ka la hiar .

en: ( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .
kha: kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babun .  Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khmat U Blei , ha uba u Abraham u la ngeit — U Blei uba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .
translated_en_to_kha: (Kumba la thoh , nga la pynlong ia me u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , ) ha khmat jong uta uba u ngeit , wat U Blei ruh uba pynkloi ia kiba iap bad uba khot ia kita kiei kiei kiba ym long kumta .

en: And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitlam ba phi lah ban ai ïa nga ? Ki hukum jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa nga ban mih kyrkieh kumne haduh ba ngam don por ban leit shim ïa la ka waitlam lane ïa kano kano ka atiar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Ahimelek, Bad hato ym don hangne hapoh ka kti jong me? namar ngam shym la wanrah ia ka waitlam jong nga ne ki tiar jong nga bad nga, namar ka kam syiem ka donkam kyrkieh .

en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; A great eagle with great wings , longwinged , full of feathers , which had divers colours , came unto Lebanon , and took the highest branch of the cedar :
kha: ban pyntip ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : La don u pukni radbah uba don ki sner ba-itynnat bad ki thapniang kiba khraw , kiba pyiar heh . U la her sha ki lumbah Lebanon bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong: U bsein uba khraw uba don ki bniat kiba heh, uba jrong, uba dap da ki bniat kiba jrong, uba don ki rong ba jrong, u la wan sha Lebanon , bad u la shim ia ka tnat kaba jrong tam jong u sohjew:

en: And I entreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .
kha: Bad ïa phi ruh , ko paralok baïaineh jong nga , nga kwah ïa phi ban ïarap ïa kine ki kynthei ; naba ki la trei shitom lem bad nga ban pynsaphriang ïa ka gospel , ryngkat bad u Klemen , bad baroh kiwei pat ki para nongïatrei lem jong nga , kiba ki kyrteng jong ki , ki don ha ka kitab jong kiba im jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga sngewsih ia me ruh, ko khun shisha, iarap ia kita ki kynthei kiba la trei shitom bad nga ha ka gospel, bad u Klement ruh, bad bad kiwei pat ki para nongtrei jong nga, kiba ki kyrteng jong nga ki don ha ka kot jingim .

en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;
kha: Lada dei uwei na ki riewpaidbah uba leh pop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba u pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno na ki briew kiba rit paid u leh katto katne pyrshah ia kano kano ka hukum U Trai kaba iadei bad kiei kiei kiba ym dei ban leh, bad u long uba don pop;

en: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel : eighteen years , all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites , which is in Gilead .
kha: Haduh khatphra snem ki la banbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh kiba shong ha ka ri ki Amor ha ka phang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kata ka snem ki la pynsngewsih bad pynshitom bein ia ki khun Israel: shiphew snem , ki khun Israel baroh kiba don sha shiliang ka Jordan ha ka ri ki Amorit kiba don ha Gilead .

en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him , he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
kha: Uno uno uba artatien ïa ka iktiar jong me lane u bymkohnguh ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong me un shah pynïap . To long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba leh pyrshah ia ka hukum jong me, bad un ym kohnguh ia ki ktien jong me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me hukum ia u, un shah pyniap: tang ban long uba skhem bad uba shlur bha .

en: And they sat down , and did eat and drink both of them together : for the damsel s father had said unto the man , Be content , I pray thee , and tarry all night , and let thine heart be merry .
kha: Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki shong bad ki ïabam ïadih lang . Nangta u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha sahmiet noh hangne bad pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shong bad ki la ia bam bad dih lang: namar u kpa jong u dam u la ong ha uta u briew: To sngewhun, nga kyrpad ia me, bad to sah baroh shi miet, bad to ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan sngewbha .

en: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day , David sware , saying , So do God to me , and more also , if I taste bread , or ought else , till the sun be down .
kha: Baroh shi sngi ki briew ki wan kyntu ïa u Dabid ban bam ei ei , hynrei u Dabid u la pynlong ka kular kaba shongkhia ,  Ieh U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada nga bam ei ei shuwa ba ka sngi kan sep !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew baroh ki la wan ban pynlong ia u Dabid ban bam doh katba dang sngi , u Dabid u la sngap jar, u la ong, Kumta to leh ia nga, bad kham bun ruh, lada nga sngewtynnad ia u kpu, ne kaei kaei pat, haduh ba ka sngi kan da hiar .

en: Now David had said , Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness , so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him : and he hath requited me evil for good .
kha: U Dabid u la ju pyrkhat ,  Balei ba nga ïada ïa ka jingdon jingem jong utai u briew hangne ha ka ri khlaw ? Ym shym don kano kano kaba dei ka jong u ïa kaba la tuh , bad da kumne u siew kylliang ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingïarap kaba nga la ai ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Dabid u la ong: Hooid nga la buh lut ia kiei kiei baroh kiba une u paralok u don ha ka ri khlaw, haduh ba ym shym la duh ei ei na kiei kiei baroh kiba iadei bad u: bad u la pynshitom bein ia nga na ka bynta ka jingbha .

en: His lord said unto him , Well done , thou good and faithful servant : thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .
kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shaniah ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban khmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wan rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong u u la ong ha u, To leh bha, me u shakri uba bha bad uba iaineh: me la long uba iaineh halor kiei kiei kiba rit: ngan pynlong ia me ban synshar halor kiei kiei kiba bun: me rung ha ka jingkmen jong u kynrad jong me .

en: For thou , O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee .
kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , U Blei ki Israel ! nga sngew shlur ban duwai kane ka jingduwai ha me , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane baroh ha nga , u shakri jong me , bad ba me la ong ha nga ba men pynlong syiem ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta me, ko Trai jong ki paid, ko Blei jong ki Israel, me la pynpaw ha u shakri jong me, da kaba ong: nga tei ia me ka iing: namarkata u shakri jong me u la shem ha ka dohnud jong u ban duwai ia kane ka jingduwai ha me .

en: For Zion s sake will I not hold my peace , and for Jerusalem s sake I will not rest , until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness , and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth .
kha: Ngan kren jam ban pynshlur ïa ka Jerusalem ; ngan ym sngap jar haduh ba yn pynim ïa ka , bad ka jingjop jong ka kan tyngshaiñ kum ka jingshai ha ka por mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka Seion ngan ym bat ia ka jingsuk jong nga, bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem ngan ym shongthait, haduh ba ka hok jong ka kan leit noh kum ka jingshai, bad ka jingpynim jong ka kum ka sharak kaba thang .

en: And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .
kha: Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ki tiar ki tar baroh jong ka sha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka synduk U Trai bad ka iingmane bad ki tiar kyntang baroh kiba don ha ka iingmane , wat kita ruh ki la wanrah ia ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .

en: And the men of Kirjath–jearim came , and fetched up the ark of the  Lord  , and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill , and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the  Lord .
kha: Kumta ki nong Kiriath Jearim ki wan shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ki leit rah ïa ka sha ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Abinadab , uba shong ha uwei u lum . Ki la pynkyntang ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u ban sumar ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Kirjathjaram ki la wan, bad ki la rah ia ka synduk U Trai, bad ki la wanrah ia ka ha ka iing u Abinadab ha lum .

en: We have also a more sure word of prophecy  ; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed , as unto a light that shineth in a dark place , until the day dawn , and the day star arise in your hearts :
kha: Kumta ngi la nang sngewskhem shuh shuh ha ka khubor ba la pynbna da ki nongïathuhlypa . Kan bha ba phi shahshkor ïa ka , namar ka long kum ka sharak kaba shai ha ka jaka ba-dum haduh ba kata ka Sngi ka wan bad ka jingshai jong u  lurstep ka tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi don ruh ka ktien kaba kham skhem jong ka jingiathuhlypa ; ha kaba phi leh bha ba phi sumar bha, kum ka jingshai kaba shai ha ka jaka kaba dum, haduh ba ka sngi kan da shai bad u khlur sngi un mih ha ki dohnud jong phi:

en: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families , the family of Matri was taken , and Saul the son of Kish was taken : and when they sought him , he could not be found .
kha: Nangta u Samuel u pynwan sha khmat ïa ki ïing na ka jait Benjamin , bad ka ïing u Matri ka la shah jied . Nangta ki rangbah na ka ïing kur u Matri ki wan sha khmat , bad u Saul u khun jong u Kish u la shah jied . Ki wad ïa u hynrei haba kim shem ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u la pynlong ia ka jaitbynriew Benjamin ban wan hajan ki longiing jong ki, la shim ia ka iing ka sem jong u Matri bad la shim ia u Saul u khun u Kish: bad haba ki la wad ia u , ym lah ban shem ia u .

en: The first angel sounded , and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood , and they were cast upon the earth : and the third part of trees was burnt up , and all green grass was burnt up .
kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la put ïa la ka turoi . U phria bad ka ding , ba la khleh lang bad ka snam , ki la hap halor ka khyndew . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka khyndew la thang duh noh , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki dieng , bad ïa baroh ki phlang bajyrngam .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la sawa , bad ka la bud ia u hail bad ka ding kaba la khleh lang bad ka snam: bad ka bynta kaba lai jong ki dieng ka la shah thang , bad la thang ia ki phlang baroh .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron ;  Ïathuh ha ki Israel bad ha u Pharaoh ba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses bad ha u Aaron bad u la ai ia ki ia ka jingbthah ha ki khun Israel bad ha u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt ban wanrah ia ki khun Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods , with their princes , and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold  ; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north .
kha: Un rah pat sha Ijipt ïa ki dur jong ki blei jong ki bad ïa ki tiar ksiar bad rupa kiba la pynkyntang sha kito ki blei . Hadien bun bun snem ka jingsuk
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un rah ruh ia ki mraw jong ki sha Ijipt, bad ki syiem jong ki, bad ki tiar ksiar bad ksiar jong ki.

en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs  ; three cities .
kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang lai tylli ki nongbah : ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Hammoth Dor , bad ka Kartan , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka jaitbynriew Naphtali, u Kadesh ha Galilaia bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, ban long ka shnong rieh tngen na ka bynta u nongpyniap briew bad u Hammothdor bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka, bad u Kartan bad ki jaka ba marjan jong ka;

en: And when the king s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire , ( for it is great , ) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour , both to great and small .
kha: Haba ïa ka jingpynbna jong phi la pynphriang sha kylleng sawdong jong kane ka hima baïar , kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kan ai ha ki tnga jong ki ïa ka burom ba dei , la u riewspah ne duk .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u syiem u la pynmih ia ka hukum jong u baroh kawei, (namar ka long kaba khraw), ki tnga baroh kin ai burom ia ki tnga jong ki, kiba heh bad kiba rit .

en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house , lest thou be a cursed thing like it : but thou shalt utterly detest it , and thou shalt utterly abhor it  ; for it is a cursed thing .
kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka bleithaw sha la ïing ïoh ba kajuh ka jingtim kan ngat sa ha phi ruh . Phi dei ban isih bad ibeiñ ïa kine ki bleithaw , namar ki long kiba la tim da U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat wanrah ia ka jinglehrain ha ka iing jong me, ioh ba phin long kaei kaei kaba la tim kum kata: hynrei men sngewsih shibun ia ka; namar ka long kaba la tim .

en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree  ; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads .
kha: La ïathuh ïa ki ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa u phlang lane ïa ki dieng lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingthung ; ki lah ban pynmynsaw tang ïa ki briew ki bym don ka shab jong U Blei ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la hukum ia ki ba kim dei ban pynmong ia u phlang jong ka khyndew , lymne ia u jingthung ba jyrngam , lymne ia u dieng ; hynrei tang kita ki briew ki bym don ka muhor U Blei ha ka khlieh jong ki .

en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar .
kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia ka snam jong ka da ka kti jong u bad un theh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka jingknia thang , bad un theh ia ka snam jong ka baroh ha trai jong ka .

en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee , and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
kha: Nga la long ryngkat bad me shano shano ba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me katba me ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kum ki nongïalam bakhraw tam ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la don bad me ha kano kano ka jaka ba me la iaid, bad nga la ot noh ia ki nongshun jong me baroh na khmat jong me , bad nga la pynlong ia me kum ka kyrteng jong ki briew kiba khraw kiba don ha ka khyndew .

en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :
kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai , uwei pa uwei u rangbah un jied ïa u khunlangbrot lane ïa u khunblang na ka bynta la ka jong ka ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei, da kaba ong: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai kin shim ia ki uwei pa uwei u langbrot kat kum ka iing ki kpa jong ki:

en: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks , that , behold , every man s bundle of money was in his sack : and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money , they were afraid .
kha: Katba ki dang pynthylli ïa la ki byrni , uwei pa uwei u lap ïa la ka pla pisa ha ka byrni jong u ; bad haba ki la ïohi ïa ka pisa , ma ki bad u kpa jong ki u Jakob ki la ïasheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang thylli ia ki lyngkhot lyngkhai jong ki, ba, ha khmih, uwei pa uwei u la don ha ka lyngkhot lyngkhai jong u: bad haba ma ki bad u kpa jong ki ki la iohi ia ki lyngkhot lyngkhai jong ka pisa , ki la tieng .

en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .
kha: La shah ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad jingim ha kata ka dur jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , khnang ba ka durblei ka lah ban kren bad pynïap ïa kito baroh ki ban ym mane ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u don ka bor ban ai jingim ia ka dur jong u mrad , ba ka dur jong u mrad kan kren baroh arngut bad kan pynlong ia kata katba ym lah ban mane ia ka dur jong u mrad .

en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity  ; and their delectable things shall not profit  ; and they are their own witnesses  ; they see not , nor know  ; that they may be ashamed .
kha: Baroh kito kiba shna bleithaw kim long ei ei , bad u blei ba ki ñiewkor shibun um long uba larkam . Kito kiba mane ïa kine ki blei ki long kiba matlah bad kiba bieit bad kin shah pynjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba shna dur baroh ki long kiba sniew bad kiei kiei kiba sngewtynnad jong ki kin ym ioh ia ka jingmyntoi ; bad ki long ki sakhi jong ki hi; kim iohi, lymne ki tip; ba ki lah ban sngewlehrain .

en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U  Trai  ; ki im ka jingim bymman bad pyndonkam bakla ïa la ka bor . Namar ka jingtim U  Trai  , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka ri ka dap da ki nongleh kam sniew ; namar namar ba ka sngap jar ia ka ri ka sngewsih ; ki jaka ba sngewtynnad jong ka ri khlaw ki tyrkhong , bad ka lynti jong ki ka long kaba sniew , bad ka bor jong ki kam long kaba dei .

en: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth–el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel , saying , Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel : the land is not able to bear all his words .
kha: Amasaïah , u lyngdoh ka Bethel , u la phah ka khubor sha u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel :  U Amos u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi hapdeng ki briew . Ki jingkren jong u kin pynjot ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Amasaiah u lyngdoh jong ka Bethel u la phah sha u syiem Israel , u da ong: U Amos u la thmu pyrshah ia me hapdeng ka iing Israel: ka ri kam lah ban shah ia ki ktien jong u baroh .

en: I said , Surely thou wilt fear me , thou wilt receive instruction  ; so their dwelling should not be cut off , howsoever I punished them : but they rose early , and corrupted all their doings .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba kumta ki briew jong nga kin da la ñiewkor ïa nga bad pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong nga , ba kin ym da la klet ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la hikai ïa ki . Hynrei shen shen ki la leh bymman kumba ki ju leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong , Hooid men tieng ia nga, phin ioh jinghikai ; kumta ka jingshong jong ki kan ym shah ot noh , katba nga la pynshitom ia ki: hynrei ki la ieng kloi , bad ki la pynsniew ia ki jingleh jong ki baroh .

en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim , it displeased him : and he held up his father s hand , to remove it from Ephraim s head unto Manasseh s head .
kha: U Joseph um sngewtynnat haba u ïohi ïa u kpa jong u ba u buh ïa la ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim ; kumta u bat ïa ka kti u kpa jong u ban pynkynriah ïa ka na ka khlieh u Ephraim sha ka khlieh u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la iohi ba u kpa jong u u la buh ia ka kti kadiang jong u Ephram: bad u la bat ia ka kti u kpa jong u, ban weng noh ia ka na ka khlieh jong u Ephram haduh ka khlieh jong u Manasseh .

en: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .
kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi un rah ïa la u khiew buh ding , un buh hangta ïa ka jingiwbih , bad nangta un wanrah ïa ka sha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to shim ia uwei pa uwei u nongleh kam sniew jong u, bad to buh ia ka jingiwbih ha ki, bad to wanrah ia ka jingiwbih jong u ha khmat U Trai, arspah sanphew ngut ki nongleh kam sniew jong u.

en: Then the king commanded , and they brought Daniel , and cast him into the den of lions . Now the king spake and said unto Daniel , Thy God whom thou servest continually , he will deliver thee .
kha: Kumta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa u Daniel bad ban bret ïa u shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . U la ong ha u Daniel ,  Ai ba U Blei jong me , ïa uba me shakri hok katta katta , un pyllait im ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la hukum , bad ki la wanrah ia u Daniel bad ki la bret ia u ha ka thliew jong ki sing . Mynta u syiem u la kren bad u la ong ha u Daniel , U Blei jong me uba me shakri beit , un pyllait im ia me .

en: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven , and broughtest them into the land , concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers , that they should go in to possess it .
kha: Me ai ïa ki , ki khun kiba bun kat ki khlur ha sahit bneng , bad me la shah ïa ki ban jop bad ban shong ban sah ha ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun jong ki ruh ki la nang bun kum ki khlur bneng , bad me wanrah ia ki sha ka ri , shaphang me kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ba kin leit rung ban ioh ia ka .

en: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate , and the habitation forsaken , and left like a wilderness : there shall the calf feed , and there shall he lie down , and consume the branches thereof .
kha: Ka nongbah ba la kerkut ka don ha ka jingjot . La iehnoh kynjah ïa ka kum ka ri khlaw kynjah bym don ei ei . Ka la long ka jaka bam phlang jong ki masi , ha kaba ki lah ban shongthait bad bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka shnong kaba la iada kan long kaba la shah iehnoh bein bad ka jaka shong jaka sah kan iehnoh kum ka ri khlaw: hangta u khun masi un bam , bad hangta un thiah , bad un bam ia ki tnat jong ka .

en: And it shall be , that the city which is next unto the slain man , even the elders of that city shall take an heifer , which hath not been wrought with , and which hath not drawn in the yoke  ;
kha: Nangta ki nongïalam jong ka shnong kaba jan tam na kata ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin jied kawei ka masi lud ka bym pat ju ring lyngkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , ba ka shnong kaba don hajan u briew uba la shah pyniap, wat ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin shim ia ka masi kaba ym shym la shna bad kaba ym shym la ring ha ka yoke ; .

en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
kha: Nangta ki la thain pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nangta ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u .  Im slem u Syiem ki Jiw !  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong ki khniang, ki la buh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u, bad ka lyngkhot ha ka kti kadiang jong u: bad ki la dem khrup ha khmat jong u, bad ki la rkhie bein ia u, ki da ong: Hail, ko Syiem ki Jiw !

en: So the king hearkened not unto the people : for the cause was of God , that the  Lord  might perform his word , which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  U Blei ban pynjia ïa kaei ba u la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Kane ka long balei ba u syiem um shym la shahshkor ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem um shym la sngap ia ki briew: namar ka daw ka long jong U Blei, ba U Trai un pyndep ia ka ktien jong u, kaba u la kren da ka kti u Ahiah u Shilon ha u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat .

en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain : pangs have taken hold upon me , as the pangs of a woman that travaileth : I was bowed down at the hearing of it  ; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .
kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew ha ka jingïohipaw ka la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem bad sngewpang , ka jingpang kum ka jong ka kynthei ha ka por suh kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki tyrpeng jong nga ki dap da ka jingpang: ki pang ki la bat ia nga , kum ki jingpang jong ka kynthei kaba kha khun: Nga la dem khrup ha ka jingsngap ia ka ; nga la sngewsih haba nga iohi ia ka .

en: Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga long ba la tim namar kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga sah hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka long kaba pop . Bad pynban , da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa U Syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong: Ko long ma nga ! namar nga long u briew uba khlem khuid, bad nga shong hapdeng ki briew kiba khlem khuid: namar ki khmat jong nga ki la iohi ia u Syiem , U Trai jong ki paid .

en: This is the law of the burnt offering , of the meat offering , and of the sin offering , and of the trespass offering , and of the consecrations , and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ;
kha: Kine keiñ ki long kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , ki jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat , ki jingkñia pynkyntang , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong ka jingknia thang , jong ka jingknia doh bad ka jingknia pop bad ka jingknia ba la pynkylla dur bad ki jingpynkyntang bad ka jingknia ia ki jingainguh ba la shet;

en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .
kha: Haba kumta , phi dei ne phim dei u syiem ?  Ka Jesebel ka jubab ,  To khie joit na jingthiah , lehkmen bad to bam . Ngan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka bri sohwaiñ u Naboth !
translated_en_to_kha: U Jesbel ka tnga jong u ka la ong ha u: Me mynta me synshar ia ka hima Israel ? to khie bad to bam ia u kpu bad to ai ba ka dohnud jong me kan sngewbha: Ngan ai ia me ia ka kper sohjew jong u Nabot u Jeselete .

en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .
kha: Ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut ba u Ahithophel u la ai ha kito ki sngi , la pdiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Dabid bad u Absalom baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahitohel kaba u la ai jingmut ha kita ki sngi, ka long kumba u briew u la kylli ha ka jaka jong U Blei: kumjuh ruh ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahitohel baroh ar bad u Dabid bad u Absolon .

en: And now , behold , I have brought the firstfruits of the land , which thou , O  Lord  , hast given me . And thou shalt set it before the  Lord  thy God , and worship before the  Lord  thy God :
kha: Kumta nga wallam mynta sha U  Trai  ïa u soh nyngkong na ka jingot ba u la ai ha nga .’  Nangta buh ïa ka shang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad mane hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, nga la wanrah ia ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka ri, kaba me, ko Trai, me la ai ha nga . Bad men buh ia ka ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me bad to mane ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me:

en: Samaria shall become desolate  ; for she hath rebelled against her God : they shall fall by the sword : their infants shall be dashed in pieces , and their women with child shall be ripped up .
kha: Ïa ka Samaria yn pynshitom namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki briew jong ka kin ïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki khunlung yn bret sha madan , ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun yn patar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Samaria kan kylla long kaba la jot namar ka la leh pyrshah ia U Blei jong ka: kin hap da ka waitlam: ki khunlung jong ki kin shah pynpra noh ha ki bynta ba la tyrkhong , bad ki kynthei jong ki kiba don khun kin shah rong noh .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them : I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Men ym ïoh ka jingdon jingem kum ka jingïohpateng bad ym don kano kano ka bynta na ka ri Israel ban ai ha me . Tang ïa nga U  Trai  , me donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Aaron, Me dei ban don ka pateng ha ka ri jong ki: Nga long ka bynta bad ka pateng jong me hapdeng ki khun Israel .

en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done evil in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Namar kane keiñ U  Trai  u la pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Eglon u syiem ka Moab ban ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai: bad U Trai u la pynskhem ia u Eglon u syiem u Moab pyrshah ia ki Israel , namar ki la leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .
kha: Mynba nga dang duwai , u Gabriel , uba nga la lah ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u la wan her sha tbian sha ka jaka ha kaba nga don . Ka la long ha ka por ban ai ïa ka jingkñia janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, haba nga dang kren ha ka jingduwai, wat uta u briew Gabriel, uba nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew ha kaba sdang, uba la shah pynlong ban her stet, u la ktah ia nga ha ka por jong ka jingpynkylla janmiet .

en: So he took him , and brought him to the chief captain , and said , Paul the prisoner called me unto him , and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee , who hath something to say unto thee .
kha: U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shim ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha u rangbah ai hukum , bad u la ong ,  U Paul , u koidi , u la khot ïa nga bad kyrpad ïa nga ban wallam ïa une u samla sha me , namar ba u don ei ei ban ong ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la shim ia u bad u la wanrah ia u ha u rangbah shipai bad u la ong: U Paul u la khot ia nga ha u bad u la duwai ia nga ban wanrah ia une u samla ha me uba don ei ei ban ong ha me .

en: Since those days were , when one came to an heap of twenty measures , there were but ten : when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press , there were but twenty .
kha: phi leit sha ka thup kew da kaba khmih lynti ban shem arspah kilo , hynrei yn don hangta tang shispah . Phin leit ban tong shispah litar ka waiñ na ka jingbuh hynrei phi shem tang sawphew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba kita ki sngi ki long , haba uwei u la poi sha ka kynhun kaba arphew tylli ki jingthew , ki don tang shiphew tylli: haba uwei u la wan sha ka jaka buh jingbam na ka press , ki don tang arphew tylli ki lieng na ka press .

en: The posts went out , being hastened by the king s commandment , and the decree was given in Shushan the palace . And the king and Haman sat down to drink  ; but the city Shushan was perplexed .
