kha: Ha ka hukum u syiem ïa ka hukum la pyntip paidbah ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima , bad ki nongrah-khubor ki rah ïa ka khubor sha ki jylla . U syiem bad u Haman ki shong bad ïadih sngewbha katba ka nongbah Susa ka la don hapdeng ka jingkulmar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki post ki la mih noh, la pynkloi da ka hukum jong u syiem, bad la ai ia ka hukum ha Shushan ka iing syiem . Bad u syiem bad u Haman ki la shong ban dih ; hynrei ka shnong Shushan ka la kylla lyngngoh .

en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–kadesh , in the wilderness of Zin  ; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel .
kha: namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh palat ïa nga ha khmat ki Israel . Mynba phi ïadon ha ki um Meribah , hajan ka shnong Kadesh , ha ka ri khlaw Sin , phi la pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba phi la iaid pyrshah ia nga hapdeng ki khun Israel ha ki um jong ka Meribahkadesh, ha ka ri khlaw Zin ; namar ba phim shym la pynkyntang ia nga hapdeng ki khun Israel .

en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .
kha: Haba u Syiem Dabid u la wan poi ha Bahurim , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Saul , u Shimei , u khun jong u Gera , u la wan ïakynduh ïa u , u da tim ïa u katba u dang wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Dabid u la wan sha Bahurim, ha khmih, nangta u la mih uwei u briew na ka iing u Saul, uba kyrteng u Shimei u khun u Gera: u la mih shabar bad u la tim ia u katba u dang wan .

en: And they laughed him to scorn . But when he had put them all out , he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel , and them that were with him , and entereth in where the damsel was lying .
kha: Ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u , kumta u la phah noh ïa ki baroh shabar , u la shim ïa u kpa bad ïa ka kmie jong ka , bad ki lai ngut ki synran jong u , bad rung shapoh ka kamra ha kaba ka khynnah ka thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rkhie bein ia u ban rkhie bein . Hynrei ynda u la pynmih ia ki baroh shabar , u shim ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong u dam bad kito kiba don ryngkat bad u , bad u rung shapoh ha ka jaka ba u dam u la thiah .

en: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation , and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength , therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants , and shalt set it with strange slips :
kha: Ko Israel , pha la klet noh ïa U Blei uba la pyllait ïa pha bad uba la ïada ïa pha kum u mawsiang bah . Pynban , pha la thung ki kper bakyntang khnang ban mane ïa u blei nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la klet ia U Blei jong ka jingpynim jong me, bad ngam shym la pyrkhat ia u maw jong ka bor jong me, namarkata men thung ia ki jingthung kiba sngewtynnad bad men buh ia ka da ki slips kiba phylla:

en: When Jesus heard these things , he marvelled at him , and turned him about , and said unto the people that followed him ,  I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
kha: U Jisu u la kyndit haba u la ïohsngew ïa kane ; u la phai sawdong bad u la ong ha u paidbah uba bud ïa u ,  nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ka jingngeit kaba kum kane , ym don wat ha Israel ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei, u la lyngngoh ia u, bad u la phai noh sha u, bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba bud ia u, nga ong ha phi, ngam shym la shem ia ka jingngeit kaba khraw kum kata, em, ym ha Israel .

en: And thou shalt grope at noonday , as the blind gropeth in darkness , and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways : and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore , and no man shall save thee .
kha: Phin shu tare ruma mynsngi kum u matlah , bad phin ym lap lynti . Kat kaba phi leh kan pulom . Phin shah lehbeiñ bad shah lute man ka por , bad yn ym don ba ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban rkhie bein ha ka por shiteng sngi, kumba u matlah u rkhie bein ha ka jingdum, bad me ym roi ha ki lynti jong me: bad me dei ban shah pynshitom bein bad shah pynjot shuh shuh, bad ym don mano mano ruh ban pynim ia me .

en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .
kha: Uta u shakri uba peit halor ki jingdon jingem jong u Abraham , u shim shiphew tylli ki ut jong u kynrad jong u bad u leit sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .
translated_en_to_kha: U shakri u la shim shiphew tylli ki kulai jong u kynrad jong u, bad u la leit noh namar ki mar ki mata jong u kynrad jong u ki don ha ka kti jong u: bad u la ieng bad u la leit sha Mesopotamia, sha ka shnong Nahor .

en: And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one  ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him .
kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dang don i pa iba la tymmen , bad sa uwei u para uba la kha ha ka jinglong tymmen jong i . U hynmen jong u khynnah , u la ïap , bad na ki khun ka kmie jong u , dei sa tang ma u uba dang im ; i pa ruh i da ieit thep mynsiem ïa u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi la ong ha u kynrad jong nga, Ngi don u kpa, u tymmen bad u khun jong ka jinglong tymmen jong u, u barit ; bad u hynmen jong u u la iap , bad tang ma u hi uba sah na ka kmie jong u , bad u kpa jong u u ieit ia u .

en: And it shall be with him , and he shall read therein all the days of his life : that he may learn to fear the  Lord  his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them :
kha: Un buh bad u ïa kata ka kitab bad un pule na ka synñia sngi , ba un tip ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba la thoh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long bad u , bad un pule ha ka jingim jong u baroh: ba un nang ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong u, ban sumar ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum bad kine ki ain:

en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .
kha: Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kylla dien ha ki maw ba la ohdur hajan Gilgal , u la leit biang sha u Eglon , bad u ong ,  Syiem Kynrad , nga don ka khubor barieh na ka bynta jong phi .  Kumta u syiem u hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Ieh ïa ngi tang baroh ar ngut !  Bad baroh ki la ïamih shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ma u hi u la phai biang na ki maw kiba don hajan u Gilgal, bad u la ong, Nga don ka jingkren lyngkot ha me, ko syiem: uba la ong: To sngap jar . Bad baroh kiba ieng hajan jong u ki la mih noh na u .

en: He burneth part thereof in the fire  ; with part thereof he eateth flesh  ; he roasteth roast , and is satisfied : yea , he warmeth himself , and saith , Aha , I am warm , I have seen the fire :
kha: Da katto katne ki dieng u pynmeh ding ; u syang doh , u bam ïa ka , bad u kdang . U pynsyaid ïa lade bad u ong ,  Katno kaba sngewtynnat bad sngewsyiad ! Katno ka rhem ka ding !
translated_en_to_kha: U thang ia ka ha ka ding ; bad ka bynta jong ka u bam ia ka doh ; u rkhiang ia ka dohkha, bad u sngewhun: Hooid, u pynshit ia lade, bad u ong, Ah, nga la pynshit, nga la iohi ia ka ding:

en: And the people went out , and spoiled the tents of the Syrians . So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the word of the  Lord .
kha: Ki nong Samaria ki mih shabar bad ki leit lute ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Syria . Bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren , lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli la die ha ka dor shi sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la mih noh bad ki la pynsniew ia ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nong Syria . Kumta la die ia ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta ka Shekel , bad ar tylli ki barli na ka bynta ka Shekel kat kum ka ktien U Trai .

en: But he refused , and said , I will not eat . But his servants , together with the woman , compelled him  ; and he hearkened unto their voice . So he arose from the earth , and sat upon the bed .
kha: U Saul um treh , bad u ong ba un ym bam ei ei . Hynrei ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kyrpad ïa u ban bam . Khatduh eh u kohnguh , u ïeng nangta na madan , bad u shong halor jingthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la kyntait bad u la ong, Ngan ym bam . Hynrei ki shakri jong u ryngkat bad kata ka kynthei ki la pynbor ia u ; bad u la sngap ia ka sur jong ki . Kumta u la ieng na ka khyndew bad u la shong ha ka jingthiah .

en: They are upright as the palm tree , but speak not : they must needs be borne , because they cannot go . Be not afraid of them  ; for they cannot do evil , neither also is it in them to do good .
kha: Kiba kum kine ki bleithaw ki long kum ki jingpyntieng ïa ki sim ha ki lyngkha sohkhia ; kim lah ban kren ; la dei ban rah ïa ki namar kim lah ban ïaid . Wat sheptieng ïa ki : kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi , bad kim lah ban lehbha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba beit kum u dieng sohjew, hynrei kim ju kren: ki dei ban shah kha, namar kim lah ban leit . Wat tieng ia ki ; namar kim lah ban leh ia kaba sniew, bad kam don ruh ha ki ban leh ia kaba bha .

en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not , they lifted up their voice , and wept  ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .
kha: Katba ki dang don kham sha jngai ki la ïohi ïa u Job , hynrei kim shym ithuh ba dei ma u . Haba ki la ithuh , ki la sdang ban ïam bad lynñiar kthang , ki kad ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka jingsngewsih bad ki kynting pui pui sha suiñ bad ha la ki khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la pynkiew ia ki khmat jong ki sha jngai, bad kim ithuh ia u, ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki, bad ki iam ; bad ki la pynkhih ia uwei pa uwei u jainkup jong u, bad ki la pynkhih ia ka dewmet jong ki sha bneng .

en: And the  Lord  discomfited Sisera , and all his chariots , and all his host , with the edge of the sword before Barak  ; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot , and fled away on his feet .
kha: Haba u Barak u tur ïaleh lem bad la ka kynhun shipai , U  Trai  u buh ïa u Sisera ha ka jingshaïong jingmut lem bad ki kulai ïapom bad ki rangbah jong u baroh . U Sisera u hiar na la ka kali ïapom bad u phet ïap da ka kjat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynsngewsih ia u Sisera bad ki kali jong u baroh, bad ka kynhun jong u baroh, da ka tduh jong ka waitlam ha khmat u Barak; kumta u Sisera u la pynjem ia ka kali jong u, bad u la phet noh da ki kjat jong u .

en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things , thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ , nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine , whereunto thou hast attained .
kha: Lada me ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki parabangeit , men long u shakri babha jong U Khrist Jisu , kumba me bsa ïa lade ha ka mynsiem da ki ktien jong ka jingngeit bad jong ki jinghikai bashisha ïa kiba me la bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me buh ia ki para bangeit ha ka jingkynmaw ia kine kiei kiei, men long u nongshakri babha jong U Jisu Khrist, uba la pyndap da ki ktien jong ka jingngeit bad ka jinghikai babha, ha kaba me la ioh .

en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
kha: hadien u la ong ïa u ,  Sngap , wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang kane . Hynrei leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai ba un khmih ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha baroh ba me la ïohkhiah , sa ai ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u: Peit wat ong ei ei ia uno uno u briew: hynrei to leit noh ia lade ha u lyngdoh bad to tyrwa na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid ia kita kiei kiei kiba u Moses u la hukum, na ka bynta ka jingsakhi ha ki .

en: For what glory is it , if , when ye be buffeted for your faults , ye shall take it patiently ? but if , when ye do well , and suffer for it , ye take it patiently , this is acceptable with God .
kha: Naba ka nong aïu ka don lada phi ïaishah ïa ki jingshah sympat ba phi dei hok haba phi la leh ïa kaba bakla ? Hynrei lada phi ïaishah ïa ka jingshahshitom wat haba phi la leh ïa kaba dei , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kaei ka burom, lada, haba phi shah pynshitom na ka bynta ki jingbakla jong phi, phin shim ia ka da ka jingsbun? hynrei lada, haba phi leh bha bad shah shitom na ka bynta jong ka, phi shim ia ka da ka jingsbun, kane ka long kaba pdiang sngewbha bad U Blei .

en: Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head  ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .
kha: A  Trai  , to shahshkor na bneng bad bishar ïa ki shakri jong me . Pynshitom ïa uta u nongleh palat kumba ka dei hok ïa u ban ïoh , bad pynksan ïa uta uba lui lui .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngap ha bneng , bad to leh bad bishar ia ki shakri jong me, da kaba pynrem ia kiba sniew, ban wanrah ia ka lynti jong u ha ka khlieh jong u ; bad ban pynshisha ia uba hok, ban ai ia u kat kum ka hok jong u .

en: And now go to  ; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard : I will take away the hedge thereof , and it shall be eaten up  ; and break down the wall thereof , and it shall be trodden down :
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba ngan leh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga : Ngan weng noh ïa ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , ngan pynpra ïa ka kynroh kaba da ïa ka , ngan shah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban bam ïa ka bad ïuhroit ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta to leit sha u sohjew jong nga: Ngan weng noh ia ka jingkhang jong ka, bad yn bam ia ka; bad yn pynpra ia ka kynroh jong ka:

en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .
kha: Un ïohpdiang shispah shah shuh shuh ki ïing , ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkha — bad ki jingshah pynshitom beiñ ruh kumjuh ; bad ha ka pateng ka ban sa wan un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un pdiang shispah shah mynta ha kane ka por, ki iing bad ki hynmen bad ki para kynthei bad ki kmie bad ki khun bad ki khyndew bad ki khyndew bad ki khyndew bad ki jingjynjar ; bad ha ka pyrthei ban wan ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .
kha: Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la sangeh ; ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng ka la sahkut bad kam lah ban khih , katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki jingat phyllung bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki hap ha ka jaka ba ar tylli ki duriaw ki iakynduh , ki la pyniaid ia ka lieng kaba la tyrkhong bad ka bynta ba shakhmat ka la sahkut stet , bad ka la sah khlem khih , hynrei ka bynta kaba khanglad ka la tyrkhong da ka jingleh donbor jong ki um .

en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
kha: Bad haba la pyntip ha nga ba ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha phi . Nga la ong ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u ha khmat jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba la iathuh ia nga kumno ki Jiw ki la ap ia uta u briew, nga la phah beit sha me, bad nga la ai hukum ia ki nongmudui jong u ruh ban iathuh ha khmat jong me ia kaei kaba ki don pyrshah ia u . Ka jingbam .

en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people , and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies .
kha: Ïa kane dei ban pynbna kum ka hukum bad pyntip sha baroh ha kawei pa kawei ka probins , khnang ba ki Jiw kin long la kloi ban pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun haba ka sngi kan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: La pynmih ia ka kopi jong ka jingthoh na ka bynta ka hukum ban ai ha man la ka jylla ha ki briew baroh , bad ba ki Jiw kin long kiba la pynkhreh pyrshah ia kata ka sngi ban pynshitom bein ia ki nongshun jong ki .

en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Have I been so long time with you , and yet hast thou not known me , Philip ? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father  ; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father ?
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Naba la slem nga la don bad phi baroh ; pynban mem ithuh ïa nga , ko Philip ? Uno uno uba la ïohi ïa nga u la ïohi ïa U Kpa . Balei , te , me ong , ‘ To pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ?’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha u: Hato nga la don slem bad phi, bad me pat ithuh ia nga, ko Philip ? uta uba la iohi ia nga u la iohi ia U Kpa ; bad kumno me ong te me , To pyni ia ngi ia U Kpa ?

en: And the priests  custom with the people was , that , when any man offered sacrifice , the priest s servant came , while the flesh was in seething , with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand  ;
kha: lane ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih shaphang kaei ba ki lyngdoh ki lah ban dawa na ki briew . Pynban haba uno uno u briew u kñia ïa ka jingainguh , u shakri u lyngdoh u ju wan bad u proh lai pnat ha la ka kti ha ka por ba dang shet ïa ka doh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki ju leh ia kata, ba haba uno uno u briew u la ainguh, u shakri lyngdoh u la wan, katba ka doh ka dang sahkut, bad ka dohkha kaba don lai tylli ki bniat ha ka kti jong u;

en: Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .
kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba bunsien nga la thmu ban wan jngoh ïa phi , hynrei don kaei kaei kaba la ju khang ïa nga borabor na kaba leh kumta . Nga kwah ban jop ïa ki mynsiem napdeng jong phi ruh , kumba nga la ju leh hapdeng kiwei ki Jentil .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngam shym la don ia phi khlem jingtip, ko para bangeit, ba bunsien nga la thmu ban wan sha phi, (hynrei la shah haduh mynta,) ba ngan ioh soh katto katne hapdeng jong phi ruh, kumba long hapdeng kiwei pat ki Jutang .

en: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai , which is beside Beth–aven , on the east side of Beth–el , and spake unto them , saying , Go up and view the country . And the men went up and viewed Ai .
kha: U Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah na Jerikho sha Ai , ka nongbah sha ka phang mihngi na Bethel , hajan ka Bethaben , lem bad ki hukum ïa ki bad swar ïa ka jaka . Haba ki la dep leh kumta ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la phah ia ki briew na Jerikoh sha Ai, kaba don hajan ka Bethaven, ha ka liang mihngi jong ka Bethel, bad u la kren ha ki, u da ong: To leit shaneng bad peit ia ka ri . Ki briew ki la leit shaneng bad ki la peit ia u Ai .

en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .
kha: Ki da ap ïa ka jingkhih jong ka um , namar u angel U Trai hateng hateng u ju hiar sha kata ka pungsum ban pynkhih ïa ka um . Ïa u nongpang uba nyngkong uba hiar ha ka pungsum hadien ba la pynkhih ïa ka um la pynkhiah na kano kano ka jingpang kaba u don .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta uwei u angel u la hiar ha kawei ka aiom shapoh ka pung: uno uno uba nangta nyngkong hadien ka jingkhluit jong ka um u la rung shapoh u la shah pynlong baroh kawei ka jingpang kaba u don.

en: But thou , when thou prayest , enter into thy closet , and when thou hast shut thy door , pray to thy Father which is in secret  ; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly .
kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , to leit sha ka kamra jong phi , khang ïa ka jingkhang , bad duwai sha U Kpa jong phi , ïa uba ym lah ban ïohi . Bad U Kpa jong phi , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha kaba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me haba me duwai, to rung shapoh ka kamra jong me, bad haba me khang ia ka jingkhang jong me, to duwai ha U Kpa jong me uba don ha kaba rieh ; bad U Kpa jong me uba iohi ha kaba rieh un siew kylliang ia me ha kaba rieh .

en: Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?
kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa u :  Mynta te , ïathuh ïa ngi ! Mano uba long ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Me leh aïu hangne ? Me wan na kano ka ri ? Kaei ka jinglong traishnong jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u, Iathuh ia ngi, ngi duwai ia me, namar ka daw jongno kane ka jingsniew ka long halor jong ngi ; Kaei ka kam jong me ? bad naei me wan ? kaei ka ri jong me ? bad na kiei ki briew ?

en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent , and thrust both of them through , the man of Israel , and the woman through her belly . So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel .
kha: U la shim ïa u sum , u la bud ïa uta u shynrang bad kata ka kynthei shapoh ïingjaiñ , bad u dung ïap da u sum ïa ki baroh ar ngut . Da kumne la pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem kaba la pynjot ïa ki Israel ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit bud ia u briew Israel shapoh ka ïingjaiñ, bad u la pynkhih ia ki baroh arngut, u briew Israel bad ka kynthei lyngba ka kpoh jong ka . Kumta ka khlam ka la sah na ki khun Israel .

en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .
kha: Ka khyndew baroh ha kaba phin ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar naduh ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shatei , bad naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shaphang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jaka ha kaba ki khyndew jong phi kin iaid kan long ka jong phi: na ka ri khlaw bad ka Lebanon, na ka wah, ka wah Euphrates, wat haduh ka duriaw kaba kut tam jong phi kan long .

en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .
kha: Buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka jingkah kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh lang ha ka jingkah kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Sanphew tylli ki loop men shna ha kawei ka jingtap , bad sanphew tylli ki loop men shna ha ka tduh jong ka jingtap kaba don ha ka jingpyniasoh kaba ar ; ba ki loop kin bat iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .
kha: Nga lah ban don ka jingai ban ïalap da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingtip baroh bad shemphang ha ki jingmaïan baroh ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donkam ban pynkynriah ïa ki lumbah — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ngam long ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la nga don ka jingai jong ka jingiathuhlypa, bad nga sngewthuh ia ki jingmaham baroh, bad ka jingtip baroh bad wat la nga don ka jingngeit baroh, haduh ba ngan lah ban weng ia ki lum, bad ngam don ka jingai sngewbha, ngam long ei ei.

en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
kha: Kata ka ri ba phin sa ïohkynti kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , haba phi bet ïa u symbai , phi hap ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha ;
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kata ka ri kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka, kam long kum ka ri Ijipt, na kaba me la mih, na kaba me la bet ia u symbai jong me bad me la ai um ia u da ka kper jong me:

en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki kynriah noh na uta u paidbah bad ki la ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dem khrup ha khyndew , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka la paw ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leit na khmat ka jingiaseng sha ka jingkhang jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng bad ki la dem khrup ha ki khmat jong ki: bad ka burom U Trai ka la paw ha ki .

en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .
kha: Ngam long uba bit dor ban ïohpdiang ïa baroh ka jinglehisynei bad ka jingieit baïaineh ba me la pynpaw ha nga , u shakri jong me . Nga la jam ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , bad mynta pat nga la wan phai bad kine ar ki kynhun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngam long uba bitdor ia ki jingisynei baroh, bad na ka jingshisha baroh, kaba me la pyni ha u shakri jong me ; namar da u diengduh jong nga nga la iaid lait ia kane ka Jordan ; bad mynta nga la kylla long ar tylli ki kynhun .

en: And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .
kha: U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka Ijon , Dan , Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki nongbah ka Naphtali ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .
translated_en_to_kha: U Benhadad u la sngap ia u syiem Asa, bad u la phah ia ki rangbah shipai jong u sha ki shnong Israel ; bad ki la shoh ia u Ijon, bad u Dan, bad u Abelmaim, bad ki shnong dukan jong u Naphtali baroh .

en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .
kha: bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha kaba shna ïa ka duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïapom na ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka jingiwbih ka la pynkhuid ia ka ksiar bad ka ksiar na ka bynta ka dur jong ka kali jong ki cherubim , kiba la pynphriang ia ki bniat jong ki , bad ki la tap ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai .

en: Fear thou not  ; for I am with thee : be not dismayed  ; for I am thy God : I will strengthen thee  ; yea , I will help thee  ; yea , I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness .
kha: Wat sheptieng — nga long ryngkat bad me ! Nga long U Blei jong me — wat ai ba kano kano kan pynsheptieng ïa me ! Ngan pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ bad ngan ïarap ïa me ; ngan ïada ïa me bad ngan pynim ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia me; namar nga don ryngkat bad me: wat sngewsih; namar nga long U Blei jong me: Ngan pynskhem ia me ; yea , ngan iarap ia me ; yea , ngan kyrshan ia me da ka kti kadiang jong nga .

en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :
kha: ka kynthup ïa ka Them Jordan naduh Duriaw Galilaïa arsut shaduh Beth Jeshimoth ( shaphang mihngi jong ka Duriaw Baïap ) bad sha trai jong u Lum Pisgah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh ka madan haduh ka duriaw Chinneroth shaphang mihngi, bad haduh ka duriaw jong ka madan, wat ka duriaw mluh shaphang mihngi, ka lynti sha Bethjeshimoth ; bad na shathie, hapoh ka Ashdothishah:

en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh U Mynsiem u wan ban ïarap ïa ngi , ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem hi da lade u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi ha ki jingud kiba ki ktien kim lah ban pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh U Mynsiem ruh u iarap ia ki jingduna jong ngi: namar ngim tip ia kaei kaba ngi dei ban duwai kumba ngi dei ban duwai: hynrei U Mynsiem hi u pynlong ia ngi da ki jingud ki bym lah ban pynpaw .

en: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago , ( whether in the body , I cannot tell ; or whether out of the body , I cannot tell : God knoweth ; ) such an one caught up to the third heaven .
kha: Nga ithuh ïa u briew uba ngeit ïa uba khatsaw snem mynshuwa la rong noh sha ka bneng kaba jrong tam ( ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne u la ïoh ïa ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga tip ia u briew ha U Khrist palat shiphew snem mynshuwa , (la ha ka met , ngam lah ban tip ; ne na ka met , ngam lah ban tip: U Blei u tip ; ) kum uta u la shah kem haduh ka bneng kaba lai .

en: And all the vessels of the house of God , great and small , and the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king , and of his princes  ; all these he brought to Babylon .
kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u lute ïa ka Templ , ïa ka ïing jingkynshew ka Templ , bad ka spah jong u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad u kit baroh sha Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki tiar baroh jong ka iing U Blei kiba heh bad kiba rit bad ki spah jong ka iing U Trai bad ki spah jong u syiem bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la wanrah sha Babilon .

en: But when ye go over Jordan , and dwell in the land which the  Lord  your God giveth you to inherit , and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about , so that ye dwell in safety  ;
kha: Ynda phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan , U  Trai  un shah ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri bad un ïada ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phi leit sha shiliang ka Jordan bad phi shong ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai pateng ia phi, bad haba u ai jingjahthait ia phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh sawdong, haduh ba phin shong ha ka jingshngain ; .

en: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .
kha: U syiem Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ bad weng noh ïa ki khiew kiba don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa rnong na ki bynta ba shadien jong ki khat-ar tylli ki masi dab rnong , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Ahasa u la ot noh ia ki pud jong ki nongrim, bad u la weng noh ia ka um na ki ; bad u la weng noh ia ka duriaw na ki masi kiba la tyrkhong kiba don hapoh jong ka, bad u la buh ia ka ha ka lynti iaid kjat jong ki maw .

en: But before all these , they shall lay their hands on you , and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues , and into prisons , being brought before kings and rulers for my name s sake .
kha: Pynban , ha shuwa ba kine kiei kiei baroh kin jia , ïa phi yn kem bad pynshitom beiñ ; yn aiti ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog bad ban shah thep ha ka byndi ; yn wallam ïa phi ha khmat ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei shuwa kine baroh, kin buh ia ki kti jong ki ha phi, bad kin pynshitom bein ia phi, da kaba aiti ia phi sha ki synagog bad sha ki phatok, da kaba wanrah ia phi ha khmat ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Abram , after that Lot was separated from him , Lift up now thine eyes , and look from the place where thou art northward , and southward , and eastward , and westward :
kha: Hadien ba u Lot u la mihnoh , U  Trai  u ong ha u Abram ,  Nangto naba me ïeng , peit bha baroh sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Abram hadien ba u Lot u la iakhlad noh na u, To rah mynta ia ki khmat jong me, bad peit na ka jaka ba me don shaphang shathie, bad shaphang shathie, bad shaphang shathie:

en: And she made him sleep upon her knees  ; and she called for a man , and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head  ; and she began to afflict him , and his strength went from him .
kha: Ka Delilah ka kynoi thiah ïa u Samson ha pneh jong ka bad nangta ka khot ïa uwei u briew , uba khi noh ïa kita ki hynñiew tylli ki kynthrong shñiuh jong u Samson . Kumta ka sdang ban pynsaja ïa u , naba u la duh noh ïa ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynthiah ia u ha ki kjat jong ka ; bad ka la khot ia u briew , bad ka la pynlong ia u ban ot noh ia ki hynriew tylli ki khlieh jong u ; bad ka la sdang ban pynshitom ia u , bad ka bor jong u ka la leit noh na u .

en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan pynkhih ka thma poh-ïing ha Ijipt bad ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u para bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun kin ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ki nong Ijipt pyrshah ia ki nong Ijipt: bad kin ialeh iwei ia iwei ia la u hynmen, bad iwei ia iwei ia u para marjan jong u;

en: But at the last Daniel came in before me , whose name was Belteshazzar , according to the name of my god , and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods : and before him I told the dream , saying ,
kha: Te u Daniel u la wan shapoh . ( La khot ruh ïa u , u Belteshassar , ha ka kyrteng u blei jong nga . ) U mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong u , kumta nga la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba nga la phohsniew . Nga la ong ha u :
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha kaba khatduh u Daniel u la wan rung ha khmat jong nga, uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Beltesar , kat kum ka kyrteng jong u blei jong nga: bad ha khmat jong u nga la iathuh ia ka jingphohsniew , da kaba ong:

en: Now therefore , I pray thee , if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee , that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
kha: Lada ka long kumta , nga kyrpad ïa me ba men ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jong me , khnang ba nga lah ban ïai shakri bad pynsngewbha ïa me . To da kynmaw ruh ba me la jied ïa kane ka jaitbynriew ba kan long u paidlang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, lada nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, to pyni ia nga mynta ia ka lynti jong me, ba ngan ithuh ia me, ba ngan shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me: bad to pyrkhat ba kane ka jaitbynriew ka long ka briew jong me .

en: And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
kha: U loit noh ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shad bad risa ha khmat u Samuel , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha kata ka sngi baroh shi sngi bad ha kata ka miet baroh shi miet . ( Ha kane ka rukom la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la kylla long u nongïathuhlypa ?  )
translated_en_to_kha: U la weng noh ia ki jain jong u ruh, bad u la iathuhlypa ha khmat u Samuel ha kajuh ka rukom, bad u la thiah lyngkhuid baroh shisngi bad baroh shi miet . Balei ki ong , Hato u Saul ruh u long napdeng ki nongiathuhlypa ?

en: And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   Shi shang ki soh ,  nga la jubab . Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kaba kut ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, Amos, kaei kaba me iohi ? Bad nga la ong, Ka lyngkhot soh jong ka por lyiur . Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga , Ka jingkut ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel; ngan ym iaid shuh ia ki .

en: At that time the  Lord  separated the tribe of Levi , to bear the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , to stand before the  Lord  to minister unto him , and to bless in his name , unto this day .
kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  u thung ïa ki rangbah kiba na ka jait Lebi ban sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ban shakri ïa u kum ki lyngdoh , bad ban ai ïa ki jingkyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong u . Kine ki dang dei ki kamram jong ki haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por U Trai u la pyniakhlad ia ka jaitbynriew Lebi, ban kit ia ka synduk ka jutang U Trai, ban ieng ha khmat U Trai ban shakri ia u bad ban kyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong u, haduh kine ki sngi .

en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal : for there I hated them : for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house , I will love them no more : all their princes are revolters .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Baroh ki kam sniew jong ki , ki la sdang ha Gilgal . Ka la long hangta ba nga sdang ban isih ïa ki . Bad namar ka jingsniew ba ki la leh , ngan beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong nga . Ngan ym ieit shuh ïa ki ; baroh ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsniew jong ki baroh ka don ha Gilgal: namar hangta nga la shun ia ki: namar ka jingsniew jong ki jingleh jong ki ngan beh noh ia ki na ka iing jong nga: ki syiem jong ki baroh kin long ki nongleh pyrshah .

en: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment , and with his skirt do touch bread , or pottage , or wine , or oil , or any meat , shall it be holy ? And the priests answered and said , No .
kha: Tharai uno uno u shim ïa ka lyngkhot doh ba la pynkyntang na ka jingkñia bad u rah ha ka jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñkup jong u . Te lada u kum pyndei ïa la ka jaiñkup ha uno uno u kpu , ka jingbam ba la shet , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ne ka dei kano kano ka jait jingbam , hato kan pynlong ba la pynkyntang ruh ïa kata ka jingbam ?  Haba la kylli ïa kata ka jingkylli , ki lyngdoh ki jubab ,  Em .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u kit ia ka doh bakhuid ha ka tduh jong ka jain jong u, bad da ka sniehdoh jong u u ktah ia u kpu ne u sohjew ne ka wain ne ka umphniang ne ka doh , hato kan long kaba khuid ? Ki lyngdoh ki la jubab bad ki la ong: Em .

en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .
kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U la buh bun tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ïa kiba sah u la pyndkoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la shim na u shi hajar tylli ki kali kit kulai bad hynriew spah ngut ki nongshong kulai: bad u Dabid u la buh kyrpang ia ki kulai kit kulai baroh .

en: Else if ye do in any wise go back , and cleave unto the remnant of these nations , even these that remain among you , and shall make marriages with them , and go in unto them , and they to you :
kha: Lada phi long ki bymïaineh bad ïasnohkti bad kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah hapdeng jong phi bad phi ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lym kumta lada phi leh ha kano kano ka por kaba stad, bad phi ia sngap jar bad kine ki jaitbynriew kiba sah hapdeng jong phi, bad phin ia shongkurim bad ki, bad kin leit sha ki, bad ki sha phi:

en: And , behold , the  Lord  stood above it , and said , I am the  Lord  God of Abraham thy father , and the God of Isaac : the land whereon thou liest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed  ;
kha: Bad hangta la don U  Trai  uba ïeng hajan jong u .  Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak ,  u ong .  Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa kane ka jaka ha kaba me thiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, U Trai u la ieng halor jong ka, bad u la ong, Nga long U Trai U Blei jong u Abraham u kpa jong me, bad U Blei jong u Isaak: ka ri ha kaba me sah, ha me ngan ai ia ka, bad ha u symbai jong me;

en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand  ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .
kha: U Iso u la isih ïa u Jakob , namar ba u kpa jong u , u la ai ha u Jakob ïa ka jingkyrkhu . U la pyrkhat ,  Ka por ban ïambriew na ka bynta i pa jong nga ka la jan ; te kumta ngan sa pynïap ïa u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: U Iso u la shun ia u Jakob namar ka jingkyrkhu kaba u kpa jong u u la kyrkhu ia u: bad u Iso u la ong ha ka dohnud jong u: Ki sngi jong ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta u kpa jong nga ki don hajan; te ngan pyniap ia u hynmen jong nga u Jakob .

en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require  ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man  ; at the hand of every man s brother will I require the life of man .
kha: Lada uno uno u shim ïa ka jingim briew , yn pynshitom ïa u . Ngan pynshitom da ka jingïap ïa uno uno u mrad uba shim ïa ka jingim briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shisha ka snam jong phi jong ka jingim jong phi ngan dawa ia ka ; na ka kti jong u mrad baroh ngan dawa ia ka, bad ha ka kti jong u briew ; na ka kti jong u briew baroh ngan dawa ia ka jingim jong u briew .

en: And the king said , Is there not yet any of the house of Saul , that I may shew the kindness of God unto him ? And Ziba said unto the king , Jonathan hath yet a son , which is lame on his feet .
kha: U syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Don mano mano ba dang sah na ka longïing u Saul ïa uba nga lah ban pyn-i ka jingïaineh bad ka jingbhasbun ïa u , kumba nga la kular ha U Blei ba ngan leh ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Don sa tang uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jonathan . U dei uba dkoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong: Hato ym pat don uwei ruh na ka iing u Saul ba ngan pyni ia ka jingbha U Blei ha u ? U Siba u la ong ha u syiem: U Jonathan u dang don u khun shynrang uba la tyrkhong ha ki kjat jong u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall  ; and the pride of her power shall come down : from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword , saith the Lord  God .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Naduh Migdol ha ka phang shatei haduh Aswan ha ka phang shathie , baroh ki nongkyrshan ïa ka Ijipt kin shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka kynhun shipai basarong jong ka Ijipt yn pynjot . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai ; Ki ruh kiba pynskhem ia ka Ijipt kin hap bad ka jingsarong jong ka bor jong ka kan hiar: na ka tower jong ka Syne kin hap ha ka da ka waitlam , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .
kha: Sngewbha da pyrkhat shaphang kane bad sa rai ïa kaei ban leh . Kane ka lah ban long kaba shyrkhei ïa u kynrad jong ngi bad ïa ka longïing jong u baroh . U long uba sniew jinglong ba un ym sngap ïano ïano ruh !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to tip bad pyrkhat ia kaei kaba phin leh ; namar ka jingsniew ka long kaba la kut jingmut pyrshah ia u kynrad jong ngi baroh: namar u long u khun uba sniew , ba u briew um lah ban kren ia u .

en: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah  ; and the goings out thereof were at the sea . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families .
kha: U pud u suh sha sepngi na Tappuah sha ka wahduid Kanah bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Kane ka long ka jaka ba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Ephraim kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la mih na Tappuah shaphang shathie haduh ka wah Kanah ; bad ki jingleit na ka ki la don ha duriaw . Kane ka long ka pateng jong ka jaitbynriew jong ki khun Ephraim da ki longiing jong ki .

en: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me ; ngam don shuh ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga , ba kin ïoh long kawei kumba ma me bad nga ngi ïalong kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta ngam don shuh ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kine ki don ha ka pyrthei bad nga wan sha me . Ko Kpa bakhuid, to sumar lyngba ka kyrteng jong me hi ia kito kiba me la ai ha nga, ba kin long kawei kumba ngi long .

en: And Pharaoh–neco put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath , that he might not reign in Jerusalem  ; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver , and a talent of gold .
kha: Ka jingsynshar jong u ka la kut haba u Neko u syiem Ijipt u kem koidi ïa u ha Riblah , ha ri ki Hamath , bad pynlong ïa ka Judah ban siew lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa bad laiphew saw kilo ka ksiar kum ka bai nguh syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaohneco u la buh ia u ha Riblah ha ka ri Hamath, ba un ym synshar ha Jerusalem ; bad u la buh ia ka ri ha ka khajna kaba shispah talent ka rupa bad ka talent ksiar .

en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly , and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died , for the blood of Asahel his brother .
kha: Haba u Abner u la wan poi ha Hebron , u Joab u ïalam ïa u kham sharud ha ka khyrdop , kumba u kwah ban ïakren jar jar bad u , bad hangta u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh . Bad kumta la pynïap ïa u Abner namar ba u la pynïap ïa u Asahel , u para u Joab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abner u la wan phai sha Hebron , u Joab u la shim ia u shawei ha ka khyrdop ban kren ia u da kaba sngap jar, bad u la shoh ia u hangta hapoh ka rib kaba phra, ba u la iap, namar ka snam u Asahel u hynmen jong u .

en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .
kha: U shakri u pynmih ïa ka shabar bad u khang ïa ka jingkhang . Ka Tamar ka kup ïa ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti , ka jait jaiñ ba ju phong da ki khun syiem kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim ha kito ki sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka don ka jain jong ki rong saw ha ka: namar da ki jain kiba kum kita ki la phong da ki khun kynthei kiba la riam . Nangta u shakri jong u u la wanrah ia ka shabar , bad u la bolt ia ka jingkhang hadien jong ka .

en: And it shall be , if it make thee answer of peace , and open unto thee , then it shall be , that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee , and they shall serve thee .
kha: Lada ki plie ïa ki khyrdop shnong bad ki kloi ban ïasuk , baroh ki dei ban long ki mraw jong phi bad kin trei ruh kum ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, lada ka pynlong ia me ban jubab ia ka jingsuk, bad kan plie ia me, te kan long, ba ki briew baroh kiba la shem ha ka kin long ki nongtrei ha me, bad kin shakri ia me .

en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his  ; and it came to pass , when he went in unto his brother s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .
kha: Hynrei u Onan u la tip ba ki khun kin ym long ki jong u , kumta haba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u hynmen jong u , u pynhap noh ïa la u symbai sharud , khnang ban yn ym pynïoh khun ïa u hynmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Onan u tip ba u symbai um dei ban long u ; bad ka la jia, haba u la leit sha ka tnga jong u hynmen jong u, ba u la theh ia u ha ka khyndew , ioh ba un ai symbai ia u hynmen jong u .

en: The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .
kha: Ki briew kiba don hapoh ïing bad ka Mari , ban pyntngen ïa ka , ki la ïabud ïa ka haba ki la ïohi ba ka la ïeng joit bad mih kyrkieh . Ki la pyrkhat ba ka leit sha ka jingtep ban ïam hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Jiw ki la don ryngkat bad ka ha iing, bad ki la pyntngen ia ka haba ki la iohi ia ka Mari, ba ka la ieng kyrkieh bad ka la leit noh da kaba kyrkieh bad ka la leit noh da kaba kyrkieh ia ka.

en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kum u khiew ba sarang u bym ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kawei ka dkhot doh la sei shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u la ong ia ka shnong kaba snam, ha ka umphniang kaba ka sniehdoh jong u ka don hangta , bad ka sniehdoh jong u kam shym la mih na ka ! pynmih ia ka shi bynta; wat ai ba kan hap ha ka .

en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .
kha: Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap lane ai ha ngi ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad mynta phi pyrshang ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim wan !
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me khlem wanrah ia ngi sha ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka umsoh ne me la ai pateng ia ngi ia ki lyngkha bad ki kper sohjew: hato me weng noh ia ki khmat jong kine ki briew ? ngin ym wan shaneng .

en: And it came to pass in the morning , that he went out , and stood , and said to all the people , Ye be righteous : behold , I conspired against my master , and slew him : but who slew all these ?
kha: Ynda mynstep , u leit sha kata ka khyrdop shnong , bad u ong ha ki briew kiba don hangta ,  Nga dei ma nga uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram bad uba la pynïap ïa u ; phim dei kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynta kata . Hynrei mano ba la pynïap ïa kine baroh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por mynstep ba u la mih noh bad u la ieng bad u la ong ha ki briew baroh: Phi long kiba hok: ha khmih nga la thmu pyrshah ia u kynrad jong nga bad nga la pyniap ia u hynrei mano ba pyniap ia kine baroh ?

en: And every little chamber was one reed long , and one reed broad  ; and between the little chambers were five cubits  ; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed .
kha: Sha lyndet jong ka , ka don ka jaka ïaid ha kaba don lai tylli ki kamra ap phira ha baroh arliang . Kawei pa kawei ka kamra ap phira ka long kaba sawdong , lai mitar ha ki liang baroh bad ki kynroh hapdeng kita ki kamra ki rben ar mitar shiteng . Sha lyndet jong ki kamra ap phira ka don ka jaka ïaid kaba jrong lai mitar kaba poi sha ka kamra ban rung kaba phai marpyrshah ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pa kawei ka kamra barit ka long kawei ka rong saw bad hapdeng ki kamra barit ki don san cubit ; bad ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop da ka phyllaw jong ka khyrdop hapoh ka don kawei ka rong saw .

en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .
kha: Ar sngi hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun shynrang . Ngi ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar ngut ha kata ka ïing — ym don mano mano ba don ryngkat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba lai hadien ba nga la kha ia kane ka kynthei ruh: bad ngi la ia don lang; bad ym don nongwei bad ngi ha iing , lait noh tang ma ngi arngut ha iing .

en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .
kha: U syiem Dabid mynta u shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u . Ha kawei ka sngi u phah khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa bad ong ha u ,  Hangne nga shong ha ka ïing ba la thaw da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, katba u Dabid u dang shong ha iing jong u, ba u Dabid u la ong ha u Natha u nongiathuhlypa, Lo, nga shong ha ka iing jong ki diengsoh , hynrei ka synduk ka jutang U Trai ka sah hapoh ki jingtap .

en: And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .
kha: Ha kata ka por shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U  Trai  bad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah hapdeng jong phi , bad phin tip ba u la lah phah ïa nga sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad bun ki jaitbynriew kin iasoh bad U Trai ha kata ka sngi , bad kin long ki briew jong nga : bad ngan shong hapdeng jong me , bad me tip ba U Trai jong ki paid u la phah ia nga sha me .

en: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .
kha: Kane kan jia ha ki namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba nga ju ïai phah sha ki lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga . Ki la kyntait ban shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la sngap ia ki ktien jong nga , ong U Trai , ia kaba nga la phah sha ki da ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa jong nga, da kaba khie dang step bad phah ia ki ; hynrei phin ym iohsngew , ong U Trai .

en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .
kha: Kynsan kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ha ka kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem , ha kaba ka jingshai na ki sharak ka shai phyrnai eh . Bad u syiem u la ïohi ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka kynta la mih ki kti jong u briew, bad u la thoh pyrshah ia ka sharak ha ka jaka jong ka iing syiem: bad u syiem u la iohi ia ka bynta jong ka kti kaba la thoh .

en: I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .
kha: Nga la jied ïa u briew uba shong basah shaphang mihngi ; ngan wallam ïa u ban tur ïaleh na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh halor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka ktieh , kum u nongthaw khiew uba ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynmih ia uwei na shaphang shathie, bad un wan: naduh ba mih ka sngi un khot ia ka kyrteng jong nga: bad un wan ha ki syiem kumba u iaid ha ka dewbilat .

en: Who is among you that feareth the  Lord  , that obeyeth the voice of his servant , that walketh in darkness , and hath no light ? let him trust in the name of the  Lord  , and stay upon his God .
kha: Phi baroh kiba burom ïa U  Trai bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien u shakri jong u , ka lynti kaba phi ïaid ka lah ban long kaba dum da shisha , hynrei shaniah ha U  Trai  , aiti ha U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano napdeng jong phi uba sheptieng ia U Trai, uba kohnguh ia ka sur jong u shakri jong u, uba iaid ha ka jingdum bad u don ka jingshai ? to ai ba un shaniah ha ka kyrteng U Trai bad un sah ha U Blei jong u .

en: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people , saying , This man is worthy to die  ; for he hath prophesied against this city , as ye have heard with your ears .
kha: Nangta ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong ha ki nongïalam bad ha ki briew ,  Une u briew u dei hok ban shah pynrem ban ïap namar ba u kren pyrshah ïa ka nongbah jong ngi . Phi la ïohsngew ïa u da la ki jong ki shkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kren ia ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiathuhlypa ha ki rangbah bad ha ki briew baroh , da kaba ong: Une u briew u dei hok ban iap ; namar u la iathuhlypa pyrshah ia kane ka shnong kumba phi la iohsngew da ki shkor jong phi .

en: And it came to pass at the end of two months , that she returned unto her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed : and she knew no man . And it was a custom in Israel ,
kha: Hadien ar bnai ka wan phai sha la u kpa . U leh kumba u la kular ha U  Trai  , bad ka la ïap haba ka dang sotti . Kane ka la long ka thymmei ïa ka ban bud kum ka rukom ha Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha kaba kut jong ki ar bnai, ba ka la leit phai noh sha la u kpa, uba la leh ia ka kat kum ka jingkular jong u kaba u la kular: bad kam ithuh iano iano ruh . Bad ka la long ka dustur ha Israel .

en: And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .
kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïeng hajan jong u , katba ka kynhun ki shipai ïada syiem ki dang ïaid na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïaid ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u baroh ki la iaid shakhmat hajan jong u; bad ki Kheriet baroh, bad ki Kheriet baroh, hynriew spah ngut ki briew kiba la wan hadien jong u na Gath, ki la iaid shakhmat ha khmat u syiem .

en: And when the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , the  Lord  raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel , who delivered them , even Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother .
kha: Te ki Israel ki la kyang ha U  Trai  , bad u la phah ïa uwei u briew ban pyllait ïa ki . Une u dei u Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas uba dei u para jong u Kaleb .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki khun Israel ki la pyrta ha U Trai , U Trai u la pynmih ia u nongpyllait im ha ki khun Israel , uba la pynpoi ia ki , wat u Othniel u khun jong u Kenas , u hynmen uba kham rit .

en: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .
kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la pyrta jam ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !  U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Shim noh ma phi ïa u , te , bad sahnarphna ïa u . Ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah ki la iohi ia u, ki la pyrta, ki la ong: Pynsah ia u, to sahnarphna ia u . U Pilat u ong ha ki: To shim ia u bad to sahnarphna ia u: namar ngam shem pop ei ei ha u .

en: Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her , and the daughters of the famous nations , unto the nether parts of the earth , with them that go down into the pit .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  to ïamkthang namar baroh u paidbah babun ka Ijipt . Phah ïa ki ban hiar lem bad ki jaitbynriew badonbor sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun u briew, u iam na ka bynta ka jingbun briew jong ka ri Ijipt, bad u bret noh ia ki, wat ia ka bad ki khun kynthei kiba pawnam, haduh ki bynta ba shapoh jong ka khyndew, bad ki kiba leit shapoh ka thliew .

en: For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .
kha: Ki la pynlong ïa u ban phai dien noh na U Blei , bad kat haduh ba un da tymmen ki la ïalam noh ïa u ban mane ïa ki blei nongwei . Um shym la ngeit hok shuh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la jia, haba u Solomon u la tymmen, ba ki tnga jong u ki la pynphai noh ia ka dohnud jong u hadien kiwei pat ki blei: bad ka dohnud jong u kam shym la long kaba janai bad U Trai U Blei jong u, kumba ka dohnud u Dabid u kpa jong u .

en: And he carried away all his cattle , and all his goods which he had gotten , the cattle of his getting , which he had gotten in Paddan–aram , for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan .
kha: Kumta u Jakob u khreh ban leit phai pat sha la u kpa ha ka ri Kanaan . U pynshong ïa ki khun bad ki tnga jong u halor ki ut , bad u ïalam ïa la ki kynhun jingri jong u baroh ha shuwa jong u , lem bad baroh kiba u la ïohlum ha Mesopotamia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah noh ia ki masi jong u baroh bad ki mar ki mata jong u baroh kiba u la ioh, ki masi jong u kiba u la ioh ha Paddanaram, namar ban leit sha u Isaak u kpa jong u ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: And in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplied , there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration .
kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ka jingdon ki synran ka nang ïai kiew , la don ka jingïania hapdeng ki Jiw kiba kren Grik bad ki Jiw kiba kren ktien tynrai . Ki Jiw kiba kren Grik ki la kam ba ïa ki riewkynthei la leh klet ha ka jingsam pisa kaba man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kita ki sngi, haba ka jingbun ki synran ka la nang bun, ka la mih ka jingkyrhuh jong ki Grik pyrshah ia ki Hebru , namar ba la iehnoh bein ia ki tnga jong ki ha ka jingshakri ba man ka sngi .

en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :
kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um ban pyn-i ba phi la kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei uta uba wan hadien jong nga un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding . U long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga ; bad ngam long uba bit wat tang ban rah ïa ki juti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga pynbaptis shisha ia phi da ka um sha ka jingkylla kaba mut: hynrei uta uba wan hadien jong nga u kham khlain ban ia nga: u la pynbaptis ia phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid:

en: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image , neither rear you up a standing image , neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land , to bow down unto it : for I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat thaw ki bleithaw lane pynïeng durblei , ki païa maw , lane ohdur ha ki maw ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim dei ban thaw ia phi ia ki bleithaw ne ki dur ba la ker , lymne ban pynkhih ia phi ia ka dur maw ha ka ri jong phi: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there  ; to the end thou mayest know that I am the  Lord  in the midst of the earth .
kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait ïa ka ri Goshen , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong , ba kumta yn ym don skain hangta . Ngan leh ïa kane ba men tip ba nga U  Trai  nga trei ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ot ha kata ka sngi ia ka ri Goshen, ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong, ba ym don ki khnai kiba don hangta; haduh kaba kut me lah ban tip ba nga long U Trai hapdeng ka khyndew .

en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service  ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
kha: U ai jingbthah ruh katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kan leit ha kaba shna ïa kita ki khiew ki pliang ,
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai ksiar da ka jingkhia na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh, na ka bynta ki tiar baroh ki jait jingshakri rupa ruh na ka bynta ki tiar rupa baroh da ka jingkhia, na ka bynta ki tiar baroh:

en: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me : for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth  ; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee , nor rebuke thee .
kha: Ha ka por u Noah nga la kular ba ngan ym pynshlei shuh ïa ka pyrthei . Mynta nga kular ba ngan ym bitar shuh ïa pha ; ngan ym mai ne pynshitom ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kane ka long kum ki um u Noah ha nga: namar kumba nga la smai ba ki um u Noah kin ym leit shuh halor ka khyndew ; kumta nga la smai ba ngan ym bitar ia me, lymne ngan ym pynrem ia me .

en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .
kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lada kila kohnguh ia U Blei , kin jin da la kha ia ki khun ki bajanai , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan jin da la long ka paradais , ha kaba ki briew kin ioh im haka jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .
translated_en_to_kha: (Jenesis 1:31) Lada ki la kohnguh ia U Blei, kin jin da la pynmih ia ki khun kiba janai, bad ka khyndew kan jin da la kylla long ka paradais ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei, ha kaba ki briew kin im junom ha ka jingsuk bad jingkmen .

en: The  Lord  render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness : for the  Lord  delivered thee into my hand to day , but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed .
kha: U  Trai  un ainong ïa kito baroh kiba hok bad ïaineh . Ha kane ka sngi u la aiti ïa phi ha ka bor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi , uta ïa uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u ai ha uwei pa uwei ia ka hok bad ka jinglong bashisha jong u: namar U Trai u la aiti ia me ha ka kti jong nga ha ka sngi , hynrei ngan ym pynjrong ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia U Trai ba la pynsleh .

en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingshai kan don hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne por . To nang ïaid katba ka jingshai ka dang don , ba ka jingdum kan ym wan lap ïa phi ; naba uta uba ïaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano ba u leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Hynrei tang khyndiat por ka jingshai bad phi . Iaid katba phi dang don ka jingshai , ioh ba ka jingdum kan wan ha phi: namar uta uba iaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano u leit .

en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head , and restore thee unto thy place : and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh s cup into his hand , after the former manner when thou wast his butler .
kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi , un map ïa phi , bad un buh biang ïa phi ha kajuh ka kyrdan . Phin sa ai ha u ïa ka khuri jong u kumba phi ju leh mynshuwa mynba phi long u nongrah khuri rangbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hapoh lai sngi u Pharaoh un rah ia ka khlieh jong me, bad un pynphai biang ia me sha ka jaka jong me: bad me dei ban aiti ia ka khuri jong u Pharaoh ha ka kti jong u, kat kum ka rukom kaba mynshuwa haba me long u nongshong shnong jong u .

en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
kha: Pynphong ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u . Nangta pynkupbor ïa ki bad pynkyntang da kaba pynsleh ïa ki da ka umphniang Olib , khnang ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ki ha u Aaron u hynmen jong me, bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad u; bad men pynkyntang ia ki, bad pynkyntang ia ki, ba kin shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them , to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands :
kha: Ka la long ha kato ka por ba nga la kular ban shim noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la jied na ka bynta jong ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri kaba kynsai tam na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga la rah ia ka kti jong nga sha ki, ban wanrah ia ki na ka ri Ijipt sha ka ri kaba nga la sngewtynnad na ka bynta jong ki, kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap, kaba long ka burom jong ki ri baroh:

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?
kha: Dei ma me uta uba nga kren la slem bah , haba nga pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngi ki ban wan ngan sa wallam ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei; Me long ma me uba nga la kren ha ki por mynshuwa da ki shakri jong nga ki nongiathuhlypa Israel kiba la iathuhlypa ha kita ki sngi bun snem ba ngan wanrah ia me pyrshah ia ki ?

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited  ; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee  ;
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba shah iehnoh kum ki nongbah ba la pynjot ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shong hangta . Ngan tap ïa pha da ka um jong ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; Haba ngan pynlong ia me ka nongbah kaba la jot, kum ki nongbah ki bym shong basa haba ngan wanrah ia ka jingjylliew halor jong me, bad ki um kiba heh kin tap ia me;

en: That we henceforth be no more children , tossed to and fro , and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the sleight of men , and cunning craftiness , whereby they lie in wait to deceive ;
kha: Te ngin ym long shuh kum ki khynnah , ba la pynshad kynting da ki jingat phyllung bad ka jingbeh ka  erïong man ba ka kylla da ka jinghikai jong ki riewshukor , kiba ïalam ïa kiwei pat sha ka jingbakla da ki buit sianti ba ki pynmih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ngi nangne shakhmat ngin ym long shuh ki khun, kiba la shah pynkhih bad shah rah bad kawei pa kawei ka Iyer jong ka jinghikai, da ka jinglong ba jem jong ki briew, bad ka jingstad ba sniew, ha kaba ki thiah ha ka jingap ban thok ; .

en: And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night  ;
kha: Te u rangbah ai hukum u la khot ar ngut na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad u la ong ,  Pynkhreh arspah ngut ki shipai ban leit sha Kaisaria , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arspah ngut ki nongbat sum , bad pynkhreh ban mih ha ka por khyndai baje mynta ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khot ia u ar spah ngut ki shipai, u da ong, Pynkhreh arspah ngut ki shipai ban leit sha Kaisaria, bad ki shiphew ngut ki shipai, bad ki shiphew ngut ki shipai, ha ka por kaba lai jong ka miet;

en: The breaker is come up before them : they have broken up , and have passed through the gate , and are gone out by it : and their king shall pass before them , and the  Lord  on the head of them .
kha: U Blei un plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong ki bad un ïalam noh ïa ki na ka jingshah ringmraw . Kin mih bran na ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad kin long kiba laitluid . U syiem jong ki , U  Trai  da lade hi , un ïalam ïa ki shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongpynkhluit u la wan shaneng ha khmat jong ki: ki la iaid lyngba ka khyrdop bad ki la leit noh da ka: bad u syiem jong ki un iaid ha khmat jong ki .

en: And he said unto his men , The  Lord  forbid that I should do this thing unto my master , the  Lord s  anointed , to stretch forth mine hand against him , seeing he is the anointed of the  Lord .
kha: bad u ong ha la ki rangbah ,  To U  Trai  un bat ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa u kynrad jong nga , ïa uba U  Trai  u la jied kum u syiem ! Ngam dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u , naba u dei u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki briew jong u, U Trai u la khang ba ngan leh ia kane ka kam ha u kynrad jong nga, U Trai u la pynsleh ia u, ban pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia u, namar u long uba la pynsleh ia U Trai .

en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
kha: Ka dei ban don ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , khnang ba kan ym kad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don ka thliew ha trai jong ka, hapdeng jong ka: kan don ka jingteh kaba la shna sawdong sawdong ka thliew jong ka, kumba ka long ka thliew jong u khniang, ba kan ym tyrkhong .

en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .
kha: Ki briew kiba sah hangta kin rwai ïaroh ; kin pyrta jam da ka jingkmen . Da ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kin roi ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka burom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki ngan iaid shakhmat bad ka sur jong ki kiba pynkmen: bad ngan pynbun ia ki, bad kin ym duna shuh shuh; ngan pyndonburom ruh ia ki, bad kin ym long kiba rit .

en: And call ye on the name of your gods , and I will call on the name of the  Lord  : and the God that answereth by fire , let him be God . And all the people answered and said , It is well spoken .
kha: Nangta ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin duwai ha u blei jong ki , bad ma nga ngan duwai ha U  Trai  , bad uta uba jubab da kaba phah ïa ka ding — uta u dei U Blei .  U paidbah u la pyrta bad ai ïa ka jingmynjur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to khot ia ka kyrteng jong ki blei jong phi, bad ngan khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai : bad U Blei uba jubab da ka ding , to ai ba un long U Blei . Bad ki briew baroh ki la jubab bad ki la ong , La kren bha .

en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :
kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin ai ia ka jingknia kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai ; ar tylli ki masi rit bad uwei u langbrot bad hynriew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong: kin long ha phi khlem jingduna:

en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
kha: Nangta kan shim por pat sa laiphew lai sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam . Kam dei ban ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba khuid lane rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad ynda la kut ka por pynkhuid ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan iai bteng ha ka snam jong ka da kaba pynkhuid ia ka lai sngi bad laiphew sngi .

en: And they said , Arise , that we may go up against them : for we have seen the land , and , behold , it is very good : and are ye still ? be not slothful to go , and to enter to possess the land .
kha: Ale ïeng ,  ki pynphai ktien ,  Ïa ngin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Laish . Ngi la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka , bad ka long kaba seisoh bha . Wat shong hangne khlem leh ei ei ; pynkloi ! Leit rung shapoh bad dakhol ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: To khie, ba ngin leit sha ki: namar ngi la iohi ia ka ri, bad, ha khmih, ka long kaba bha shibun: bad phi dang sngap jar ban leit sha ka ri .

en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .
kha: Leh kumba u Joab u ong ,  u Solomon u jubab .  Pynïap ïa u bad tep ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bynta kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah kiba lui lui .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u, To leh kumba u la ong, bad to hap halor jong u, bad to tep ia u ; ba me lah ban weng noh ia ka snam bym don pop, kaba u Joab u la pynmih, na nga bad na ka iing u kpa jong nga .

en: Then tidings came to Joab : for Joab had turned after Adonijah , though he turned not after Absalom . And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .
kha: U Joab u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia . ( U la kyrshan ïa u Adonijah , hynrei ym ïa u Absalom . ) Kumta u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad u bat ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khubor ki la wan sha u Joab: namar u Joab u la phai noh hadien u Adonijah, wat la um shym la phai noh hadien u Absalom . U Joab u la phet noh sha ka iing U Trai bad u la bat ia ki bniat jong ka almari .

en: Now therefore fear the  Lord  , and serve him in sincerity and in truth : and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood , and in Egypt  ; and serve ye the  Lord .
kha: Mynta te ,  u Joshua u bteng ,  pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , bad shakri ïa u da kaba sngur bad kaba shisha . Iehnoh syndon ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la ju mane ha Mesopotamia bad ha Ijipt , bad shakri tang ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sheptieng ia U Trai , bad to shakri ia u ha ka jinglong ba shisha bad ha ka jingshisha: bad bret noh ia ki blei kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shakri ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka jingshlei um, bad ha Ijipt; bad to shakri ia U Trai .

en: Behold , they shall be as stubble  ; the fire shall burn them  ; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame : there shall not be a coal to warm at , nor fire to sit before it .
kha: Kin long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ! Kin ym lah wat ban pyllait im ïa lade — ki thylliej ding kin khluit eh na ka bynta jong ki , yn ym don ka ding kaba rhem ban pynsyaid ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , kin long kum ki diengsuin ki dei ban thang ia ki ; kim dei ban pyllait im ia lade na ka bor jong ka ding: ym don dewiong ban pynshit , lymne ding ban shong ha khmat jong ka .

en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem , according to thine estimation , for the money of five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , which is twenty gerahs .
kha: Ïa ki khunlung dei ban thied pat ynda ki la dap shi bnai ha ka jingbuhdor bym kylla kaba long san tylli ki sbai rupa , kat kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba dei ban siew kylliang na ka shibnai, kat kum ka jingkhein jong me, na ka bynta ka pisa san Shekel jong ka jaka kyntang kaba arphew gram .

en: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the  Lord  , and of his statutes to Israel .
kha: U Artakserksis u ai ïa kane ka jingthoh ha u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad , uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel :
