translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kane ka long ka kopi jong ka shithi kaba u syiem Artaxerxes u la ai ha u Esra u lyngdoh , u nongthoh , wat u nongthoh ia ki ktien jong ki hukum U Trai bad ki ain jong u ha Israel .

en: The shield of his mighty men is made red , the valiant men are in scarlet : the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation , and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken .
kha: Ki shipai jong u nongshun ki rah ïa ki stieh rong saw bad ki phong ki sopti rong saw . Ki pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ! Ki kali ïapom jong ki , ki thaba kum ka ding ! Ki kulai jong ki jam stet !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingda jong ki briew kiba khlain bor jong u ka long kaba saw, ki briew kiba shlur ki long kiba saw: ki kali kin long kiba la tyrkhong ha ka sngi jong ka jingpynkhreh jong u , bad ki dieng ding kin sa khih shibun .

en: And it shall be in that day , that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem  ; half of them toward the former sea , and half of them toward the hinder sea : in summer and in winter shall it be .
kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , ka um basngur kan tuid na Jerusalem , shiteng na ka sha ka Duriaw Baïap bad kawei pat ka shiteng sha ka duriaw Mediterranian . Kan tuid baroh shisnem , ha ka aïom ba-rkhiang bad ha ka aïom bajhieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ha kata ka sngi, ba ki um kiba im kin mih na Jerusalem; shiteng na ki sha ka duriaw kaba rim: ha ka por lyiur bad ha ka por lyiur kan long .

en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the  Lord  in the hand of the sons of David  ; and ye be a great multitude , and there are with you golden calves , which Jeroboam made you for gods .
kha: Mynta phi thmu ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka iktiar syiem kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid . Phi don ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bad phi don ki khun masi ksiar kiba u Jeroboam u la shna ba kin long ki blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta phi pyrkhat ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka hima U Trai ha ka kti jong ki khun shynrang u Dabid bad phi long ka kynhun kaba khraw , bad ki don bad phi ki khun masi ksiar kiba u Jeroboam u la pynlong ia phi kum ki blei .

en: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord : and one said unto him , Is all well ? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee ? And he said unto them , Ye know the man , and his communication .
kha: U Jehu u leit phai sha la ki para rangbah shipai , ki kylli ïa u ,  Ka bit ka biang baroh ? Kaei kaba uto u khleh bieit u kwah na phi ?  U Jehu u jubab ,  Phi tip ïa kaei kaba u kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jehu u la wan sha ki shakri jong u kynrad jong u: bad uwei u la ong ha u, Hato baroh ki long kiba bha ? namar kata une u paralok uba bieit u la wan sha me ? Bad u la ong ha ki: Phi tip ia uta u briew bad ka jingiakren jong u .

en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin  ; but he slipped away out of Saul s presence , and he smote the javelin into the wall : and David fled , and escaped that night .
kha: U Saul u thmu ban sum ïa u Dabid ha ka kynroh , hynrei u Dabid u kynriah , bad uta u sum u sahkut ha ka kynroh . U Dabid u phet ïap bad u lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la wad ban shoh ia u Dabid haduh ka kynroh da ka waitlam ; hynrei u la phet noh na ka khmat u Saul: bad u Dabid u la phet noh ha kata ka miet .

en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .
kha: Bad u Joshua u ong ,  Balei me la pynngat ha ngi ïa ka jynjar kaba kum kane ? U  Trai  mynta un pynngat ïa ka jynjar ha me !  Te ki briew baroh ki lynthem maw ïa u Akhan haduh ba un da ïap ; ki lynthem maw bad ki thang ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong: Balei me la pynkhuslai ia ngi ? U Trai un pynkhuslai ia me ha kane ka sngi . Bad ki Israel baroh ki la thang ia u da ki maw bad ki la thang ia ki da ka ding hadien ba ki la ther maw ia ki da ki maw .

en: Behold , all his fellows shall be ashamed : and the workmen , they are of men : let them all be gathered together , let them stand up  ; yet they shall fear , and they shall be ashamed together .
kha: Baroh uba mane ïa ka un shah ñiewbeiñ . Ki briew kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki long tang ki briew bad ym don shuh . Shah ïa ki ban wan bad ban ïeng ha ka jingbishar — kin khynñiuh bad kin shah pynjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , baroh ki paralok jong u kin sngewlehrain: bad ki nongtrei jong u: to ai ba kin ialum lang baroh, to ai ba kin ieng ; hynrei kin tieng , bad kin sngewlehrain lang .

en: Be thou ashamed , O Zidon : for the sea hath spoken , even the strength of the sea , saying , I travail not , nor bring forth children , neither do I nourish up young men , nor bring up virgins .
kha: Ko nongbah Sidon , pha long kaba la jahburom ! Ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw-rit bad duriaw-bah ki la kyntait ïa pha bad ki ong ,  Ngam ju don kino kino ki khun . Ngam ju pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun shynrang ne ki khun kynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewlehrain ia me, ko Sidon: namar ka duriaw ka la kren, wat ia ka bor duriaw, ka ong, Ngam ju kha khun, lymne nga ju pynkha khun ia ki samla, lymne nga pynkha khun ia ki khun kynthei .

en: And under the firmament were their wings straight , the one toward the other : every one had two , which covered on this side , and every one had two , which covered on that side , their bodies .
kha: Hangta hapoh kata ka tnum kita ki jingthaw ki ïeng , uwei uwei u pyiar ar tylli ki thapniang sha kiwei pat kiba hajan bad u bad tap pat ïa lade da ki ar tylli ki thapniang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapoh ka bneng ki don ar tylli ki bniat jong ki kiba beit beit, kawei sha kawei pat: uwei pa uwei u don ar tylli ki met jong ki .

en: For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong :  Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ki nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, U Trai jong ki paid, ba ngan pynpra ia ka lyngkhot jong u na ka ryndang jong me, bad ngan pynpra ia ki jingteh jong me, bad ki nongwei kin ym shakri shuh ia lade na u:

en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
kha: Uwei hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u paid Israel . Uwei pa uwei un shon ha ka ksang ti jong u ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad un khot ïa lade uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei un ong , Nga long U Trai s ; bad uwei pat un khot ia lade da ka kyrteng u Jakob bad uwei pat un ai kyrteng da ka kti jong u ha U Trai , bad un ai kyrteng ia lade da ka kyrteng jong ki Israel .

en: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .
kha: Ha kata ka por u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa u ,  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  Bad u la pait ka dohnud bad u la lynñiar kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sien kaba ar ka kynhun jong ki khnai . U Petros u la pyrkhat ia ka ktien kaba U Jisu u la ong ha u, Ha shuwa ba u khnai un leit sha u khnai arsien, me un kyntait ia nga . Bad haba u la pyrkhat ia kata, u la iam .

en: And this man shall be the peace , when the Assyrian shall come into our land : and when he shall tread in our palaces , then shall we raise against him seven shepherds , and eight principal men .
kha: Haba ki Assyria ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi bad tur lyngba ki jingïada jong ngi , ngin phah ïa ki nongïalam bakhlaiñ tam ban ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad une u briew un long ka jingsuk, haba u Assyria un wan sha ka ri jong ngi: bad ynda un iaid ha ki iing jong ngi , te ngin pynmih pyrshah ia u hynriew ngut ki nongap langbrot bad 8 ngut ki rangbah .

en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .
kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw ïa kito kiba pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa ki kum ka bainong .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta un leh ha ka jaka kaba khlain tam bad u blei nongwei, uba un pdiang bad pynroi da ka burom: bad un pynlong ia ki ban synshar ia kiba bun , bad un phiah ia ka ri na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi .

en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .
kha: Kumta to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ngan lum wat ia phi na ki briew , bad ngan lum lang ia phi na ki ri kiba phi la shah pynpra , bad ngan ai ia phi ia ka ri Israel .

en: And Amnon said unto Tamar , Bring the meat into the chamber , that I may eat of thine hand . And Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother .
kha: Nangta u ong ha ka ,  Wallam ïa kito ki kpu hangne ha ka jingthiah jong nga bad pyntian ïa nga da ma phi hi .  Ka la shim ïa ki kpu bad ka la leit sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Amnon u la ong ha ka kamra, To wanrah ia ka doh ha ka kamra, ba ngan bam na ka kti jong me. Bad ka Tamar ka la shim ia ki cake kiba ka la shna, bad ka la wanrah ia ki ha ka kamra sha u hynmen jong ka .

en: And the first went , and poured out his vial upon the earth  ; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast , and upon them which worshipped his image .
kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la leit bad u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka pyrthei . Ki prum kiba shyrkhei bad kiba tyrha ki la mih ha kito kiba la don ïa ka shab jong u mradkhlaw bad ha kito kiba la mane ïa ka dur jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba nyngkong ka la leit noh bad ka la theh ia ka khiew jong u ha ka khyndew; bad ka la hap ka jingpang kaba jur bad kaba sngewsih ha ki briew kiba don ka dak jong u mrad bad ha kito kiba mane ia ka dur jong u .

en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .
kha: Ngam khot shuh ïa phi ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u leh . Pynban , nga khot ïa phi ki paralok , namar nga la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ïohsngew na U Kpa jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngam khot ia phi ki shakri ; namar u shakri um tip ia kaei kaba u kynrad jong u u leh: hynrei nga la khot ia phi ki paralok ; namar kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la iohsngew na U Kpa jong nga nga la pynpaw ha phi .

en: The  Lord  shall bring thee , and thy king which thou shalt set over thee , unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known  ; and there shalt thou serve other gods , wood and stone .
kha: U  Trai  un leit rah ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi sha ka ri nongwei , ha kaba ma phi lane ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim pat ju poi ; hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei kiba da u dieng bad da u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un wanrah ia me, bad ia u syiem jong me uba la buh halor jong me, ha ka jaitbynriew kaba me ne ki kpa tymmen jong me kim tip; bad hangta men shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei, ki dieng bad u maw .

en: And when I looked , behold the four wheels by the cherubims , one wheel by one cherub , and another wheel by another cherub : and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone .
kha: Nga la ïohi ruh ba la don saw tylli ki shalyntem , baroh kiba ïasyriem , hajan uwei pa uwei kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba nga peit, ha khmih ki saw tylli ki tyrpeng da ki cherub, kawei ka tyrpeng da uwei pat u cherub: bad ka dur jong ki tyrpeng ka long kum ka rong jong u maw ba la shna da u maw .

en: These things understood not his disciples at the first : but when Jesus was glorified , then remembered they that these things were written of him , and that they had done these things unto him .
kha: Ki synran jong u kim shym la sngewthuh ïa kane ha kata ka por ; hynrei ynda haba la pyndonburom ïa U Jisu , ki la kynmaw ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la ong ïa kane shaphang jong u bad ki la leh ïa kane na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei kim sngewthuh ia ki synran jong u ha kaba nyngkong: hynrei haba la pyndonburom ia U Jisu , nangta ki kynmaw ba la thoh ia kine kiei kiei shaphang jong u , bad ba ki la leh ia kine kiei kiei ha u .

en: And the other woman said , Nay  ; but the living is my son , and the dead is thy son . And this said , No  ; but the dead is thy son , and the living is my son . Thus they spake before the king .
kha: Hynrei kata kawei pat ka kynthei ka ong ,  Em ! u khunlung uba dang im u dei u jong nga , bad uba la ïap u dei u jong pha !  Kata ka kynthei kaba nyngkong ka jubab ,  Em ! u khunlung uba la ïap u dei u jong pha , bad uba dang im dei u jong nga .  Bad kumta ki ïakajia ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei pat ka kynthei ka la ong: Em; hynrei uba im u long u khun jong nga, bad uba iap u long u khun jong me . Bad kane ka la ong: Em; hynrei uba iap u long u khun jong me . Kumta ki la kren ha khmat u syiem .

en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the  Lord  had given them .
kha: Ki la leit haduh ka Them Eshkol bad ki la ïohi ïa ka ri , hynrei ynda ki la wan phai ki la pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew na kaba leit rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ki la leit sha ka them Escol bad ki la iohi ia ka ri , ki la pynduh mynsiem ia ka dohnud ki Israel ba kim dei ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki .

en: Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
kha: Ki kham shaniah ïa me Ban ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki hynmen ki para , ne ki khun ki kti . Ki kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me Bad ki ïaineh ha ka jutang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba la ong ha u kpa bad ha ka kmie jong u, ngam shym la iohi ia u ; bad um shym la ithuh ia ki hynmen jong u, lymne u la ithuh ia la ki jong ki khun: namar ki la sumar ia ka ktien jong me bad ki la bat ia ka jutang jong me .

en: Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .
kha: Mynta hukum ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal bad sawspah ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka blei Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to phah bad lum lang ha nga baroh ki Israel ha u lum Karmel, bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong u Baal saw spah sanphew snem bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ki khlaw saw spah snem .

en: And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
kha: Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ?   Ki la ïohi lut ïa kiei kiei . Ym don kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Ki la iohi aiu ha ka iing jong me ? U Hesekaiah u la jubab: Baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha iing jong nga ki la iohi: ym don ei ei hapdeng ki spah jong nga ba ngam shym la pyni ia ki .

en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .
kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u kpa jong u , u la leh ; hynrei , ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym la leh pop da kaba thang jingiwbih ha ka Templ . Ki briew pynban , ki dang ïai leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u kpa jong u u la leh: wat la u la rung ha ka tempi U Trai . Bad ki briew ki dang bamsap .

en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave  ; I will redeem them from death : O death , I will be thy plagues  ; O grave , I will be thy destruction : repentance shall be hid from mine eyes .
kha: Ngan ym pyllait ïa kine ki briew na ka ri kiba ïap lane pyllait im ïa ki na bor ka jingïap . Wanlam ïa ki khlam jong pha , ko jingïap ! Wanlam ïa ka jingpynjot jong pha , ko ka pyrthei kiba ïap ! Ngan ym don jingisynei shuh ïa kine ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan siewspah ia ki na ka bor jong ka jingtep ; Ngan siewspah ia ki na ka jingiap: Ko jingiap, ngan long ki khniang jong me; Ko jingtep jong me: ka jingkylla kaba mut kan long kaba buhrieh na ki khmat jong nga .

en: And the tongue is a fire , a world of iniquity : so is the tongue among our members , that it defileth the whole body , and setteth on fire the course of nature  ; and it is set on fire of hell .
kha: Bad u thylliej u long kum ka ding . U long ka pyrthei jong ka jingsniew , uba shim ïa ka jaka ha ki met jong ngi bad uba pynphriang ïa kaba sniew ha ka met baroh kawei . U wiang ding ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong ka jingim da ka ding kaba wan sha u na ka dujok hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shyntur ka long ka ding, ka pyrthei jong ka jingbymhok: kumjuh ruh ka shyntur hapdeng ki dkhot jong ngi , ba ka pynjakhlia ia ka met baroh kawei , bad ka thang ia ka lynti jong ka mariang ; bad ka shah thang ha ka ding dujok .

en: Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .
kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khun u briew ; kane ka waitlam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ki nongïalam ki Israel baroh . Ïa ki yn pynïap lang bad kiba sah baroh na ki briew jong nga . Tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !
translated_en_to_kha: To iam bad to iam, ko khun u briew: namar kan long halor ki rangbah Israel baroh: ki jingtieng namar ka waitlam kin long halor ki briew jong nga: to sngap jar namarkata halor ka tyrpeng jong me .

en: And he saith unto him , Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee , thou wicked servant . Thou knewest that I was an austere man , taking up that I laid not down , and reaping that I did not sow :
kha: U la ong ha u , ‘ Me u shakri bym long ! Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ktien jong me ban pynrem ïa me ! Me tip ba nga long u briew uba eh , uba shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong nga bad uba ot ïa kaei kaba ngam shym bet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u ong ha u , Na ka shyntur jong me hi ngan bishar ia me, ko shakri bymman . Me tip ba nga la long u briew uba sniew, uba shim ia kata kaba ngam shym la thiah, bad uba ot ia kata kaba ngam shym la bet:

en: And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .
kha: U  Trai  un pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong Ijipt , bad nangta kin tip bad kin mane ïa u , bad kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Kin pynlong ki jingkular kyntang ha u bad kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia U Trai yn sa tip ha Ijipt, bad ki nong Ijipt kin ithuh ia U Trai ha kata ka sngi, bad kin leh ia ka jingknia bad ka jingknia ; yea , kin kular ia ka jingkular ha U Trai , bad kin pyndep ia kata .

en: And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .
kha: Ki rangbah ki leit shaduh Jordan , bad baroh shi lynter lynti ki ïohi ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki tiar ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bret katba ki dang phet ïap . Nangta ki wan phai bad ki leit ïathuh ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit bud ia ki sha Jordan : bad, ha khmih, baroh kawei ka lynti ka la dap da ki jain bad ki khiew, kiba ki Syria ki la bret noh da kaba kyrkieh . Ki nonglam khubor ki la wan phai biang bad ki la iathuh ha u syiem .

en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang :  Nga isih ïa ka jingsarong ki briew ka Israel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh kiba don ha ka , ha u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei u la smai hi dalade, ong U Trai U Blei jong ki paid, nga shun ia ka jingbha jong u Jakob bad nga shun ia ki iing jong u: namarkata ngan aiti noh ia ka nongbah bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don hangta .

en: I opened to my beloved  ; but my beloved had withdrawn himself , and was gone : my soul failed when he spake : I sought him , but I could not find him  ; I called him , but he gave me no answer .
kha: Ngan sah halor u lum ka mirr , u lum ka jingiwbih , tad ynda ka lyer step ka beh bad ba ka jingdum ka jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la plie ia u nongieit jong nga ; hynrei u nongieit jong nga u la kyntait ia lade: ka mynsiem jong nga ka la jah noh haba u la kren: Nga la wad ia u , hynrei ngam lah ban shem ia u ; nga la khot ia u , hynrei um shym la jubab ei ei ia nga .

en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :
kha: Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong ka jingshah pynshitom bakhatduh namar ki pop jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la don ka jingshun kaba neh slem, bad me la pynmih ia ka snam jong ki khun Israel da ka bor jong ka waitlam ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong ki, ha ka por ba ka jingbymhok jong ki ka la kut noh:

en: The copy of the letter that Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and his companions the Apharsachites , which were on this side the river , sent unto Darius the king :
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuh ba ki la phah sha u patsha :
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kopi jong ka shithi ba u Tatnai, u Lat ha kane ka liang ka wah, bad u Shetharbozenai, bad ki paralok jong u ki Apharshah kiba don ha kane ka liang ka wah, ki la phah sha u Darius u syiem:

en: Son of man , speak to the children of thy people , and say unto them , When I bring the sword upon a land , if the people of the land take a man of their coasts , and set him for their watchman :
kha: Ko khun u briew  , u la ong , ïathuh ha ki briew jong me ïa kaei kaba jia haba nga wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka ri . Ki briew ha kata ka ri ki jied ïa uwei napdeng jong ki ban long u nongap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun u briew, to kren ia ki khun jong me bad to ong ha ki: Haba nga wanrah ia ka waitlam ha ka ri , lada ki briew jong ka ri ki shim ia u briew na ki pud jong ki , bad ki buh ia u na ka bynta u nongap jong ki:

en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand : but I will break Pharaoh s arms , and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .
kha: Nangta ngan pynlong ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Babilonia kaba khlaiñ bad ngan buh ïa ka waitlam jong nga ha ki kti jong u . Hynrei ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka Ijipt , bad un ud bad ïap ha khmat u nongshun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynskhem ia ki kti jong u syiem Babilon bad ngan buh ia ka waitlam jong nga ha ka kti jong u: hynrei ngan pynpait ia ki kti jong u Pharaoh , bad un iam ha khmat jong u da ka jingud jong u briew uba la mynsaw haduh katta katta .

en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .
kha: Pha long kaba khlem bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan sha khmat ban pyllait im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba wad jingtip shaphang ki khlur , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki bneng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat kaei ka ban jia ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la sngewsih ha ka jingbun ki jingmut jong me . To ai ba mynta ki nongleh jadu, ki khlur , ki nongleh jadu man ka sngi kin ieng bad pynim ia me na kine kiei kiei ki ban sa wan ha me .

en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
kha: A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jong me da kaba wallam noh ïa ki briew jong me na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Trai jong ngi, me la wanrah ia ki briew jong me na ka ri Ijipt da ka kti kaba khlain bor bad me la ioh nam ia me, kumba ha kane ka sngi ngi la leh pop, ngi la leh sniew .

en: Awake , awake  ; put on thy strength , O Zion  ; put on thy beautiful garments , O Jerusalem , the holy city : for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , to long khlaiñ bad long khraw biang ! Ko nongbah Bakhuid jong U Blei , to kup ïa lade da ka burom ! Kiba mane blei thala kin ym ïohrung shuh da lei lei lyngba ki khyrdop jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: To khie noh, to khie noh ia ka bor jong me, ko Seion; to buh ia ki jain kiba itynnad jong me, ko Jerusalem, ka nongbah bakhuid: namar nangne shakhmat kan ym wan shuh ha me ki bym pat tyrkhong bad ki bymkhuid .

en: For mine Angel shall go before thee , and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .
kha: U angel jong nga un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri jong ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus ; bad ngan pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong nga u Angel un leit sha khmat jong me, bad ngan wanrah ia me sha ki Amorites, bad ki Hitit bad ki Perizzite bad ki Kanait , ki Hivite bad ki Jerubite: bad ngan ot noh ia ki .

en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga bitar ïa kito ki nongwei kiba synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki paid Judah ki long ki jong nga , bad ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan sumar ïa ki . Kin long ki kulai thma badonbor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la bthei pyrshah ia ki nongap langbrot: namar U Trai jong ki paid u la leit jngoh ia ka kynhun jong u ka Judah , bad u la pynlong ia ki kum u kulai babha jong u ha ka thma .

en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
kha: Nga la don ryngkat bad me kat shaba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa ki nongshun jong me baroh katba me nang ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kat ki nongïalam kiba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la don ryngkat bad me ha kano kano ka jaka ba me leit, bad nga la ot noh ia ki nongshun jong me baroh na ka khmat jong me, bad nga la pynlong ia me ka kyrteng kaba khraw, kum ka kyrteng jong ki briew kiba khraw kiba don ha ka khyndew .

en: If thieves came to thee , if robbers by night , ( how art thou cut off ! ) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee , would they not leave some grapes ?
kha: Haba ki nongtuh ki wan mynmiet , ki rah tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah . Haba ki briew ki lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , borabor ki pynsah khyrdong khyndiat . Hynrei ki nongshun jong pha ki la pyndam noh khoit ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki nongtuh ki wan sha me, lada ki runar ki wan miet , (kumno me la ot noh ! ) hato kin ym shym la tuh haduh ba kin da biang ? lada ki nongrep ki wan sha me , hato kin ym iehnoh katto katne ki sohjew ?

en: Send me also cedar trees , fir trees , and algum trees , out of Lebanon : for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon  ; and , behold , my servants shall be with thy servants ,
kha: Nga tip haduh katno ka jingtbit jong ki nongot dieng jong phi , kumta to phah ïa nga ki dieng Kedar , ki dieng Kseh-Sypress , bad ki dieng Kseh-Juniper tylli na Lebanon .
translated_en_to_kha: Phah ia nga ruh ia ki dieng cedar, ki dieng sohjew bad ki dieng sohjew, na Lebanon: namar nga tip ba ki shakri jong me ki lah ban ot dieng ha Lebanon ; bad, ha khmih, ki shakri jong nga kin don bad ki shakri jong me .

en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand , women , sons , and daughters , and took also away much spoil from them , and brought the spoil to Samaria .
kha: Wat la ki Judia ki dei ki para ri jong ki , ki shipai Israel ki ring koidi ïa ki ar lakh ngut ki kynthei bad khynnah bad ki rah ïa ki sha Samaria , lem bad ka jinglute kaba bun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la rah noh ia ki hynmen jong ki arspah hajar ngut ki kynthei bad ki khun kynthei bad ki khun kynthei kiba la shah rong noh na ki bad ki la wanrah ia ka jinglute kaba bun na ki sha Samaria .

en: And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .
kha: Hato don mano mano ba la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ? Mano ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong haduh kaba kut ka por ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mano, kumba nga khot, bad un pynbna ia ka, bad un buh ia ka na ka bynta jong nga, namar nga la thung ia ki briew hyndai ? bad kiei kiei kiba wan bad ki ban sa wan , to kin pyni ha ki .

en: And when Herod saw Jesus , he was exceeding glad : for he was desirous to see him of a long season , because he had heard many things of him  ; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him .
kha: U Herod u la sngewbha shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , namar u la lah ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad u la da kwah eh ban ïohi ïa u la slem bah . U la kyrmen ban ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u leh katto katne ki kambah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Herod u la iohi ia U Jisu , u la sngewbha palat: namar u la kwah ban iohi ia u kaba jrong por, namar u la iohsngew ia kiei kiei kiba bun shaphang jong u ; bad u la kyrmen ban iohi ia kano kano ka kambah kaba la leh da u .

en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam kiba khatduh u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  To wan , bad ngan pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jong U Khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki hynriew ngut ki angel uba don ki hynriew tylli ki khiew kiba dap da ki hynriew tylli ki khlam ba khatduh, bad u la kren bad nga, u da ong: To wan hangne, ngan pyni ia me ia ka nongleitkurim, ka tnga jong u Khunlangbrot .

en: Assemble yourselves and come  ; draw near together , ye that are escaped of the nations : they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image , and pray unto a god that cannot save .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ale lang , ko ki briew jong ki hima , baroh kiba lait im na ka jingkyllon ka hima-patsha ; ai ïa lade na ka bynta ka jingbishar ! Ki briew kiba ïaid bad la ki bleithaw kiba da ki dieng bad duwai sha ki blei ki bym lah ban pynim ïa ki — kito ki briew ki bymtip ei ei satia !
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniasoh ia lade bad to wan hajan , phi kiba la lait na ki jaitbynriew: kim don jingtip kiba buh ia u dieng jong ka dur ba la ker jong ki , bad ki duwai ha u blei u bym lah ban pynim .

en: Then Saul said to Jonathan , Tell me what thou hast done . And Jonathan told him , and said , I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand , and , lo , I must die .
kha: Nangta u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Me la leh aïu ?  U Jonathan u jubab ,  Nga la bam khyndiat ka ngap da u dieng uba nga rah . Nga don hangne — nga la kloi ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la ong ha u Jonathan , Iathuh ia nga kaei kaba me la leh . U Jonathan u la iathuh ha u, bad u la ong, Nga la dih tang khyndiat ka umsoh bad ka tduh jong u diengduh uba don ha ka kti jong nga, bad, ha khmih, nga dei ban iap .

en: When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .
kha: Haba u Jakob bad ka ïing jong u ki leit sha Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïarap sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad pynshong pynsah ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Jakob u la wan sha Ijipt bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la pyrta ha U Trai , te U Trai u la phah ia u Moses bad u Aaron kiba la wanrah ia ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt bad ki la pynlong ia ki ban shong ha kane ka jaka .

en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and of blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .
kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba u ïathuh ha ki ban ai ha u Isaïah ;  Mynta ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar ; ngi la shah pynshitom bad ngi long ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi long kum ka kynthei kaba la suh kha , hynrei kaba tlot katta katta ba kam lah ban kha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u , Kumta u Hesekaiah u ong: Kane ka sngi ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah lehbein: namar ki khun ki wan sha ka jingkha khun bad ym don bor ban kha khun .

en: She put her hand to the nail , and her right hand to the workmen s hammer  ; and with the hammer she smote Sisera , she smote off his head , when she had pierced and stricken through his temples .
kha: Ka la shim ïa u snar pynskhem dara ha kawei ka kti , Bad ïa u tyrnem jong u nongtrei ha kawei pat ka kti ; Ka tied ïa u Sisera bad ka pynpait ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u ; Ka pynpei phlait lyngba ka khlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la buh ia ka kti jong ka ha u nail, bad ka kti kadiang jong ka ha ki nongtrei ka la pynkhih ia u Sisera, ka la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u, haba ka la bthei bad ka la bthei lyngba ki temple jong u .

en: And the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians , and forty thousand horsemen , and smote Shobach the captain of their host , who died there .
kha: bad ki Israel ki la pynher krad ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria . U Dabid lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap hynñiewspah ngut ki nongñiah kali ïapom bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong u nongshun , uba la ïap ha ka madan thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Syria ki la phet noh ha khmat ki Israel; bad u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki briew kiba don hynriew spah tylli ki kali jong ki Syria, bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai kulai, bad u la pyniap ia u Shhoach u rangbah shipai jong ki, uba la iap hangta .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Lashai dang step , leit ïakynduh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To khie dang step bad to ieng ha khmat u Pharaoh bad to ong ha u: Kumta u Trai U Blei jong ki Hebru u ong: To ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit shakri ia nga .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will lay stumblingblocks before this people , and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them  ; the neighbour and his friend shall perish .
kha: Bad kumta ngan pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban jynthut bad kyllon . Ki kpa bad ki khun kin ïap , bad kumta kin long ki paralok bad ki paramarjan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan buh ia ki jingthung ha khmat une u briew , bad ki kpa bad ki khun shynrang ryngkat kin hap halor jong ki ; u para marjan bad u paralok jong u kin jah noh .

en: For when they came into the house , he lay on his bed in his bedchamber , and they smote him , and slew him , and beheaded him , and took his head , and gat them away through the plain all night .
kha: Mar ïarung shapoh , ki leit sha ka kamra thiah u Ishbosheth , ha kaba u dang ïohthiah lyngngai , bad ki la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki la ot ïa ka khlieh jong u , ki rah ïa ka bad ki , bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet lyngba ka Them Jordan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba ki la rung shapoh iing, u la thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u ha ka kamra thiah jong u, bad ki la shoh ia u, bad ki la pyniap ia u, bad ki la ot ia u khlieh jong u, bad ki la leit noh ia ki lyngba ka madan baroh shi miet .

en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat , Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead ? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , I am as thou art , my people as thy people , my horses as thy horses .
kha: Bad u Ahab u kylli ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Phin leit lang bad nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Nga la kloi , haba phi la kloi ,  u Jehoshaphat u jubab  bad kumta ruh ki briew bad ki shipai bad ki shipai shong kulai jong nga ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, Hato me leit bad nga ban ialeh thma ia u Ramot Gilead ? Bad u Jehoshaphat u la ong ha u syiem Israel , Nga long kum ma me, ko briew jong nga kum ki briew jong me, ko kulai jong nga kum ki kulai jong me .

en: And Zacchaeus stood , and said unto the Lord  ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor  ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
kha: U Sakhaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha U Trai ,  To shahshkor , kynrad ! ngan ai shiteng na ki jingdon jingem jong nga ha kiba duk , bad lada nga la shukor ïano ïano , ngan siew pat ïa u sa saw shah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sakhaios u la ieng bad u la ong ha U Trai ; Ha khmih, ko Trai, ka shiteng na ki mar jong nga nga ai ha kiba duk ; bad lada nga la shim ei ei na uno uno u briew da kaba kynnoh lamler , nga pynphai biang ia u saw shah .

en: O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .
kha: Uba ieit jong nga u long kum ki syntiew khlaw kiba phuh ha ki bri sohwaiñ ha Engedi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko paro jong nga, kata ha ki thliew maw, ha ki jaka ba rieh jong ki step, to ngan iohi ia ka khmat jong me, to ngan iohsngew ia ka sur jong me; namar ka sur jong me ka long kaba thiang, bad ka khmat jong me ka wan .

en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .
kha: Ka jingai jingmut jong nga ka long ba phin lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , ki ban bun kat u shyiap ka rud duriaw , bad ba ma phi da lade hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ai jingmut ba baroh ki Israel kin ialum lang ha me, naduh Dan haduh Beersheba, kum ka dewbilat kaba don harud duriaw na ka bynta ka jingbun briew ; bad ba me leit sha ka thma ha la ka jong ka khmat .

en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone , which Moses put there at Horeb , when the  Lord  made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Ym don ei ei ruh hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang lait tang ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha u Lum Sinai , mynba U  Trai  u pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel katba ki dang wan mihnoh na ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don ei ei ha ka synduk lait noh tang ki ar tylli ki miej maw kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha Horeb , haba U Trai u la leh ia ka jutang bad ki khun Israel haba ki la mih na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out  ; and they could not .
kha: Haba u mynsiem u tur ïaleh ïa u , u bret ïa u sha madan , bad u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur , u kyr-iat ki bniat , bad u eh tnen baroh shi rynïeng . Nga la ong ïa ki synran jong me ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid , hynrei kim shym la lah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangno hangno ba u shim ia u, u pynkhih ia u: bad u sngap jar bad u sngap jar bad ki bniat jong u: bad nga la kren ha ki synran jong me ba kin bret noh ia u ; bad kim lah .

en: And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
kha: U Hiram u la kmen shaba palat haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na u Solomon , bad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha kane ka sngi ba u la ai ha u Dabid ïa u khun uba stad kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa kata ka jaitbynriew bakhraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u Hiram u la iohsngew ia ki ktien u Solomon , ba u la sngewkmen shibun bad u la ong: To long ba la kyrkhu ia U Trai ha kane ka sngi , uba la ai ha u Dabid ia u khun uba stad halor kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
kha: Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka jaka , ka dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam shym la sah ha ka jong me ? bad hadien ba la die ia ka , hato kam shym la long ha ka bor jong me hi ? balei me la pyrkhat ia kane ha ka dohnud jong me ? me la thok ia ki briew hynrei ha U Blei .

en: And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa u Sihon bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki shimti ïa baroh ka ri jong ki Amor kiba shong ha kata ka thain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la aiti ia u Sihon bad ki briew jong u baroh ha ka kti jong ki Israel: kumta ki Israel ki la don ia ka ri baroh kawei jong ki Amorites , ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri .

en: And they answered the angel of the  Lord  that stood among the myrtle trees , and said , We have walked to and fro through the earth , and , behold , all the earth sitteth still , and is at rest .
kha: Ki la wan ïathuh ha u angel :  Ngi la leit sha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngi la shem ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka don hapdeng ka jingbymlah ban leh ei ei bad ha ka jingshah pyndem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la jubab ia u angel U Trai uba la ieng hapdeng ki dieng kiba jyrngam bad ki la ong: Ngi la iaid sha khyndew bad ngi la iaid lyngba ka khyndew bad, ha khmih, ka khyndew baroh kawei ka dang shong bad ka dang shongthait .

en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .
kha: Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop ba uta u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un long jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u namar ba u la leh pop ha kawei na kine: bad ka jingsah kan long ka jingknia doh .

en: Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor , saith the  Lord   ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you , and hath conceived a purpose against you .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Hasor , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga maham ïa phi ban phet noh bad ban leit rieh . U Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , bad kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong ,
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia phi, to sah jylliew, ko phi ki nongshong shnong jong ka Hazor, ong U Trai ; namar u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon u la shim jingmut pyrshah ia phi, bad u la pyrkhat ia ka jingthmu pyrshah ia phi .

en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .
kha: ( U syiem ka ri Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser bad u la ïohknieh ïa ka , u la pynïap ïa ki traishnong hangta bad u la thang ïa ka . Nangta u la ai ïa ka ha ka khun jong u kum ka jingïoh bynta jong ka ha ka por ba ka shongkurim ïa u Solomon , bad u Solomon u tei thymmai ïa ka . )
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt u la leit shaneng, bad u la thang ia ka da ka ding, bad u la pyniap ia ki nong Kanaan kiba shong ha ka shnong, bad u la ai ia ka kum ka jingai sngewbha ia ka khun jong u, ka tnga jong u Solomon .

en: And when he came , behold , the captains of the host were sitting  ; and he said , I have an errand to thee , O captain . And Jehu said , Unto which of all us ? And he said , To thee , O captain .
kha: ha kaba u la shem ba ki rangbah shipai ki dang ïashong pyrkhat kam . U ong ,  Kynrad , nga don ka khubor ïa phi .  U Jehu u kylli ,  Phi kren ïano na ngi ?   Ïa phi keiñ , ko rangbah ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan, ha khmih, ki rangbah shipai ki la shong ; bad u la ong, Nga don ka jingeh ia me, ko rangbah . Bad u Jehu u la ong , Ha ngi baroh ? Bad u la ong: Ha me ko rangbah .

en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
kha: U Isaïah nangta u la ïathuh ha u syiem ,  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ka por kan poi ba baroh kaba ha ka ïingsyiem jong me , baroh kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la lum haduh kane ka sngi , yn sa kit noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don shuh ka ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ba baroh kaba don ha ka iing jong me bad kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la buh haduh kane ka sngi, yn rah sha Babilon: ym don ei ei kaba sah shuh, ong U Trai .

en: Because thou hast spoiled many nations , all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee  ; because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
kha: Phi la thombor ïa ki briew jong ki hima kiba bun , hynrei mynta kito kiba la lait im kin thombor ïa phi namar ki kam pynïap briew ba phi la leh bad namar ki jingleh jubor jong phi pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongbah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ba me la pynsniew ia kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , ki briew baroh kin pynsniew ia me namar ka snam jong ki briew bad namar ka jingleh donbor jong ka ri, jong ka shnong bad na kito baroh kiba shong hangta .

en: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant , and as a root out of a dry ground : he hath no form nor comeliness  ; and when we shall see him , there is no beauty that we should desire him .
kha: Ka dei ka mon jong U  Trai  ba u shakri jong u un san kum u jingthung uba ksam ïa ki thied ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong . Um don main ne jingitynnat ban pynlong ïa ngi ban peit ïa u . Ym don kano kano kaba ngin ibha ïa u , ym don kano kano ka ban khring ïa ngi sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar un san ha khmat jong u kum u jingthung uba jem, bad kum u tynrai na ka khyndew kaba rkhiang: um don dur ne ka jinglong rit paid bad haba ngin iohi ia u , ym don ka jingitynnad kaba ngi dei ban kwah ia u .

en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , namar U  Trai  u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wan phai, uwei pa uwei u briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem, bad u Jehoshaphat ha khmat jong ki, ban leit phai biang sha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen ; namar U Trai u la pynlong ia ki ban sngewbha ia ki nongshun jong ki .

en: He that overcometh , the same shall be clothed in white raiment  ; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life , but I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .
kha: Ïa kito kiba ïoh ka jingjop yn pynkup ïa ki kumne ha ki jaiñkup balieh , bad ngan ym weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong kiba im . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga bad ki angel jong u , ngan pynbna paidbah ba ki long ki jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba jop , uta hi un shah rong lieh; bad ngan ym pynduh ia ka kyrteng jong u na ka Kitab ka jingim , hynrei ngan phla ia ka kyrteng jong u ha khmat U Kpa jong nga bad ha khmat ki angel jong u .

en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,
kha: Haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pud u suh sha Bethdagon , u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel ha ka lynti shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bteng shaphang shatei sha ka Kabul ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka phai sha ka liang mihngi sha Bethdagan, bad ka poi sha ka them Iphtahel sha ka liang mihngi jong ka Bethrek, bad ka leit sha Cabul sha ka liang kadiang .

en: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart : and the damsel s father said , Comfort thine heart , I pray thee . And they tarried until afternoon , and they did eat both of them .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba san u khreh ban mihnoh , hynrei u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ,  Da bam shuwa , bad ap haduh ban da noh ka sngi .  Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki ïabam ïadih lang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la khie dang step ha ka sngi kaba phra ban leit noh: bad u kpa jong u dam u la ong: To sngewbha ia ka dohnud jong me, nga duwai ia me . Ki la sah haduh ka por mynstep bad ki la bam ia ki baroh arngut .

en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .
kha: Phi dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ ; uno uno uba ktah ïa kata ka um u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka ain kaba neh ha ki, ba uta uba theh ia ka um pyniakhlad un sait ia ki jain jong u ; bad uta uba ktah ia ka um pyniakhlad un long u bymkhuid haduh ka por janmiet .

en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
kha: ka thma kan sa wan ha ki briew jong phi , bad ïa ki kut jong phi baroh yn pynjot . Kan long kum ka sngi ha kaba u syiem Shalman u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah Betharbel ha ka thma , ha kaba ïa ki kmie bad ki khun jong ki la pynlwet haduh ban da ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan mih ka jingsawa hapdeng ki briew jong me, bad ki kut jong me baroh kin sa shah pynjot, kumba u Shalman u la pynjot ia ka Betharbel ha ka sngi thma: ka kmie ka la shah pynpra ha ki khun jong ka .

en: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la pyndonkam ïa kano kano na kine ki jingmyntoi , lymne ngam shym la thoh ïa kane mynta khnang ban dawa ïa kiba kum kine ki hok na ka bynta ïa lade . Kan kham bha ïa nga ba ngan ïap shuwa ! Ym don mano mano ban pynkylla ïa ka jingkob badei hok jong nga sha ki kyntien ba thylli !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngam shym la pyndonkam ei ei na kine kiei kiei: bad ngam shym la thoh ia kine kiei kiei, ba dei ban leh kumta ha nga: namar ka la kham bha ia nga ban iap, ban ia ba uno uno u briew un pynlong ia nga uba sngew sarong .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury  ; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger , and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .
kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan phah ïa ka lyer bajur , u slap bajur , bad u phria ban pynjot ïa ka kynroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; ngan pynkhih ia ka da ka Iyer kaba jur ha ka jingbitar jong nga; bad kan don ka jingsait kaba tuid palat ha ka jingbitar jong nga, bad ki maw kiba heh ha ka jingbitar jong nga ban bam ia ka .

en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink , thou , nor thy sons with thee , when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations :
kha: Ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me phim dei ban rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga hadien ba phi la dih waiñ lane dih kyiad ; lada phi leh kumta phin ïap . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba dei ban bud da ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat dih wain ne dih kyiad kaba jur, ma me, ne ki khun shynrang jong me bad me, haba phi leit sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: ioh ba phin iap: kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi:

en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field  ; the which when a man hath found , he hideth , and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath , and buyeth that field .
kha: Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew ryngkhat u shem ïa ka jingkynshew ba la buhrieh hapoh ka lyngkha . U tap pat ïa ka , bad u kmen haduh katta katta ba u leit bad die ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la don , bad nangta u leit pat bad thied ïa kata ka lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Sa shisien , ka hima bneng ka long kum ka spah kaba la buhrieh ha ka lyngkha ; kaba haba u briew u la shem , u buhrieh bad na ka bynta ka jingkmen jong ka u leit bad u leit noh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u don bad u thied ia kata ka lyngkha .

en: Defraud ye not one the other , except it be with consent for a time , that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer ; and come together again , that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency .
kha: Wat ju kyrngah iwei ïa iwei pat , lait noh tang haba phi la ïamynjur shuwa ban leh kumta shipor khnang ba phi lah ban pynlut ïa ka por jong phi ha ka jingduwai ; hynrei nangta ban phai biang sha ka jingïadei para ma phi . Ha kane ka rukom yn ïada ïa phi na ki jingpynshoi jong u Soitan namar ka jingbymlah jong phi ban synshar ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat nym ialeh pyrshah iwei ia iwei pat, lait noh tang da ka jingmynjur na ka bynta ka por, ba phin ai ia lade ha ka jingleh niam bad ka jingduwai ; bad to iawan biang lang, ba u Soitan un ym pynshoi ia phi na ka bynta ka jingbym lah ban bat ia phi.

en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :
kha: Phin ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym ïoh jaka ban kam kum la ka jong ; hangta U  Trai  un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen , bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew men ym shem jingsuk, lymne ka kjat jong me kan ym shongthait: hynrei U Trai un ai ia me hangta ka dohnud kaba khih bad kaba duna ki khmat bad ka jingsngewsih:

en: Son of man , speak unto the elders of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye come to enquire of me ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kren ha kine ki nongïalam bad ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Phi la ïawan ban kylli ïa ka mon jong nga , hato ym dei kumta ? Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Khun u briew , kren ha ki rangbah Israel bad ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Phi wan ban kylli ia nga ? Kumba nga im , ong U Trai Blei , ngan ym shah kylli ha phi .

en: And it shall come to pass , that the man s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you .
kha: Te u diengduh jong uta u briew ïa uba nga la jied un khie lung . Da kumta ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingïaikren khñium jong kine ki Israel pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uta u briew uba nga jied un phuh: bad ngan pynlong ban sangeh noh na nga ia ki jingkyrhuh jong ki khun Israel , ha kaba ki ia kren pyrshah ia phi .

en: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver : and he shall purify the sons of Levi , and purge them as gold and silver , that they may offer unto the  Lord  an offering in righteousness .
kha: Un wan ban bishar kum uwei uba phrang bad pynkhuid ïa ka rupa . Kumba u nongtrei nar u phrang ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , kumta u nonglamktien jong U  Trai  un pynkhuid ïa ki lyngdoh , khnang ba kin wallam sha U  Trai  da ki jingainguh kiba dei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shong kum u nongpynkhuid bad pynkhuid ia ka rupa: bad un pynkhuid ia ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi , bad un pynkhuid ia ki kum ka ksiar bad ka rupa , ba kin ai ha U Trai ia ka jingainguh ha ka hok .

en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,
kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u langbrot kum ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok na ka bynta ki paidbah . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyniap ruh ia u masi bad u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingknia jingsuk: bad ki khun shynrang ki la wanrah ha u ia ka snam kaba u la theh ha ka jaka bam sawdong .

en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Yn ym don na ki hima ba-marjan kiba la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long pat kum ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban pynmong ïa ki Israel . Bad kin tip ba ma nga , nga long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan ym don shuh ka jingsma kaba jem ha ka iing Israel , lane kano kano ka jingsma kaba sngewsih na baroh kiba don sawdong jong ki , kiba la lehbein ia ki ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai Blei .

en: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement : and thou shalt cleanse the altar , when thou hast made an atonement for it , and thou shalt anoint it , to sanctify it .
kha: Man la ka sngi me dei ban kñia uwei u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia , khnang ba yn map ïa ka pop . Kane kan pynkhuid ruh ïa kata ka duwan . Nangta kyllan ïa ka da ka umphniang Olib ban pynkyntang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men ai man la ka sngi ia u masi na ka bynta ka jingknia pop: bad men pynkhuid ia ka nongrim , haba me la pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ka , bad me pynkhuid ia ka , ban pynkyntang ia ka .

en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .
kha: nangta u kynrad un wan phai pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip . U kynrad un ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki bymkohnguh .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong uta u shakri un wan ha ka sngi ba um peit ia u , bad ha ka shi kynta ba um tip , bad un ot ia u ha ka por ba u la shah rong noh bad un buh ia u ia ka bynta jong u bad ki bym ngeit .

en: O daughter of my people , gird thee with sackcloth , and wallow thyself in ashes : make thee mourning , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation : for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To kup jaiñ khain bad to tyllun ha u dpei . To ïam sngewsih lem bad ki ummat kthang kumba phin ïam ïa u khun marwei , namar uta uba wan ban pynjot ïa phi un tur ïaleh kynsan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun jong ki briew jong nga, to sngap jar ia me da ka jainkup, bad to sngap jar ia lade ha ka dewbilat: to sngewsih ia me, kumba tang uwei u khun shynrang: namar u nongpynjot un wan kynsan ha ngi .

en: And he struck it into the pan , or kettle , or caldron , or pot  ; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself . So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither .
kha: u ju dung ïa uta u proh hapoh u khiew shet , bad kat kaba ngat ha uta u proh ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh . Ki ju leh kumta ïa ki Israel baroh kiba wan sha Shiloh ban ai jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynkhih ia ka ha ka pan, ne ka rong ne ka rong saw, ne ka khiew baroh kaba u lyngdoh u la wanrah na ka bynta lade . Kumta ki la leh ha Shiloh ia ki Israel baroh kiba wan shata .

en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel  ; and he said , Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and have not hearkened unto my voice  ;
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u ong ,  Kane ka jaitbynriew ka la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban sumar . Namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la shit ia ki Israel ; bad u la ong: Namar ba une u briew u la pynkhein ia ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la hukum ia ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad kim shym la sngap ia ka sur jong nga ; .

en: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river  ; and her maidens walked along by the river s side  ; and when she saw the ark among the flags , she sent her maid to fetch it .
kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka la wan hiar sha ka wah ban sum , katba ki shakri kynthei jong ka pat ki nang ïa-ïaid kai harud wah . Kynsan ka la ïohi ïa kata ka shang hapdeng ki khah , bad ka phah ïa ka mraw ban leit shim ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khun jong u Pharaoh ka la wan hiar ha ka wah ; bad ki nongtrei jong ka ki la iaid ryngkat bad ka wah ; bad haba ka la iohi ia ka synduk hapdeng ki lama , ka la phah ia ka nongtrei jong ka ban leit shim ia ka .

en: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword , and shall be led away captive into all nations : and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles , until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled .
kha: Katto katne ngut kin shah pynïap da ka waitlam , bad kiwei pat kin shah rah kum ki koidi sha ki ri baroh ; bad ki bymngeit blei kin ïuh ïa ka Jerusalem tad ynda ka por jong ki ka la kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin hap da ka tduh jong ka waitlam, bad kin shah rah noh sha ki jaitbynriew baroh: bad ka Jerusalem kan sa shah pynkhih noh na ki Jutang , haduh ba ki por jong ki Jutang kin da pyndep .

en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynduh lut ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli — ym shym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ot noh ia ki jaitbynriew: ki tower jong ki ki la jah rngai noh; ba ym don ki surok jong ki: ba ki shnong jong ki ki la shah pynjot , haduh ba ym don briew , ba ym don nongshong shnong .

en: And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa ki jingpynjot kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei uwei baroh un tare shane shatai kum u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum ka um , bad ki metïap jong ki kin pyut ha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah ia ka jingjynjar ha ki briew, ba kin iaid kum ki briew kiba matlah, namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai: bad ka snam jong ki kan sa tuid kum ka dewbilat bad ka doh jong ki kum ka sboh .

en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria , and carried Israel away into Assyria , and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .
kha: kaba long ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea , u patsha ka Assyria u kurup ïa ka Samaria , u rah ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi , bad pynsah katto katne ngut na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne pat hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah jong ka Media .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynniew jong u Hoshea u syiem Assyria u la rah noh ia ki Israel sha Assyria bad u la buh ia ki ha Halah bad ha Habor hajan ka wah Gozan bad ha ki shnong ki Media .

en: And I will make the rivers dry , and sell the land into the hand of the wicked : and I will make the land waste , and all that is therein , by the hand of strangers : I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Ngan pynrngad ïa ka wah Nile bad ngan buh ïa ka Ijipt hapoh ka bor jong ki briew kiba sniew . Ki nongwei kin pynjulor ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki wah ban tyrkhong bad ngan die ia ka ri ha ka kti jong kiba sniew: bad ngan pynlong ia ka ri kaba la jot , bad baroh kaba don ha ka: da ka kti jong ki nongwei: Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: Ye are the salt of the earth : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be salted ? it is thenceforth good for nothing , but to be cast out , and to be trodden under foot of men .
kha: Phi , phi long kum ka mluh ïa u paid bynriew baroh . Hynrei lada ka mluh ka la blad noh , ym don kano kano ka lad ban pynbha pat ïa ka . Ka la kylla long ka bymdondor , kumta la bret noh ïa ka sharud bad ki briew ki ïuh halor jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ka umsoh jong ka khyndew: hynrei lada ka umsoh ka la duh noh ia ka jingsma jong ka ? ka long kaba bha shuh shuh, hynrei ban shah bret noh bad ban shah pynkhih hapoh ki kjat jong ki briew .

en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth , from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias , whom ye slew between the temple and the altar .
kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki rangbah balui lui kan hap halor jong phi , naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel balui lui haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sakharaïah u khun jong u Berakhaïah , ïa uba phi la pynïap hapdeng ka Templ bad ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba halor jong phi ka snam kaba hok baroh kawei kan wan ha ka khyndew, na ka snam jong u Abel uba hok haduh ka snam jong u Sakhia u khun u Baraiah uba phi la pyniap hapdeng ka tempi bad ka almari .

en: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest , and did eat the shewbread , which is not lawful to eat but for the priests , and gave also to them which were with him ?
kha: kumta u la rung shapoh ka Ïing U Blei bad bam ïa u kpu ba ainguh ha U Blei . Kane ka la long mynba u Abiathar u long u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Kat kum ka Hukum jong ngi tang ki lyngdoh ki lah ban bam ïa une u kpu — hynrei u Dabid u la bam ïa u bad u la ai ïa u wat ha ki rangbah kiba bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno u la leit shapoh iing U Blei ha ki sngi jong u Abhiatar u rangbah lyngdoh bad u la bam ia u kpu ba la pyni , u bym dei ban bam hynrei na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad u la ai ruh ia kita kiba don ryngkat bad u ?

en: And Ishbi–benob , which was of the sons of the giant , the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight , he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David .
kha: U ramhah uba kyrteng u Ishbibenob , uba rah ïa u sum rnong uba khia kumba lai kilo shiteng bad uba kieng ka waitlam bathymmai , u la pyrkhat ba u lah ban pynïap ïa u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishbibenob uba long na ki khun shynrang uba heh, uba ka jingkhia jong u ka la heh lai spah Shekel ka nar ha ka jingkhia, u la shah teh da ka waitlam kaba thymmai, u la pyrkhat ba u la pyniap ia u Dabid .

en: Not boasting of things without our measure , that is , of other men s labours ; but having hope , when your faith is increased , that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly ,
kha: Kumta ngim leh sarong shaphang ka kam kaba kiwei ki la leh palat shabar u pud ïa uba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi . Pynban , ngi kyrmen ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nang san bad ba ngi lah ban leh ïa ka kam kaba kham khraw hapdeng jong phi , borabor hapoh ki pud ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ym sngew sarong ia kiei kiei khlem ka jingthew jong ngi, kata, jong kiwei pat ki briew hynrei ka jingkyrmen, haba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nang kiew, ba ngin nang heh da phi kat kum ka jingsynshar jong ngi shibun .

en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :
kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongïalam — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki nongïalam , nga ong , kim don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na kine kiba la long kumba ki long katto katne, (kaei kaei ruh, kam pher ia nga: U Blei um pdiang ia u briew uba don briew) namar kita kiba la long kumba ki don katto katne ha ka jingialang kim shym la pyndap ei ei ia nga:

en: And , behold , they brought to him a man sick of the palsy , lying on a bed : and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy  ;  Son , be of good cheer  ; thy sins be forgiven thee .
kha: ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki la wallam sha u ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , uba thiah ha ka jingthiah . Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki don , u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To long shlur , ko khun jong nga ! Ïa ki pop jong me la map .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki la wanrah ha u ia u briew uba pang ba pang, uba thiah ha ka jingthiah: bad U Jisu haba u la iohi ia ka jingngeit jong ki u la ong ha kiba pang ba pang;

en: And when they shall say unto you , Seek unto them that have familiar spirits , and unto wizards that peep , and that mutter : should not a people seek unto their God ? for the living to the dead ?
kha: Hynrei ki briew kin ong ïa me ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongkren byrtong kiba kren jam bad kiba kren mian mian . Kin ong ,  Nalor baroh , ki briew ki dei ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki mynsiem bad kylli na kiba ïap na ka bynta kiba im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kin ong ha phi , To wad ia ki kiba don ki mynsiem kiba la tip bha bad ha ki nongleh jadu kiba peit bniah bad kiba sngap jar: hato ki briew kim dei ban wad ia U Blei jong ki ? na ka bynta kiba im haduh kiba iap ?

en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,
kha: Katba u Petros u dang sngewlyngngoh shaphang ka jingmut jong kane ka jingïohipaw , ki rangbah kiba u Kornelios u la phah ki la tip hangno ka ïing jong u Simon ka don , bad mynta ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta katba u Petros u dang artatien ha lade kaei ka jingphohsniew kaba u la iohi, ha khmih ki briew kiba la phah na u Kornelio ki la wad bniah ia ka iing u Simon bad ki la ieng ha khmat ka khyrdop .

en: And they caught every one his fellow by the head , and thrust his sword in his fellow s side  ; so they fell down together : wherefore that place was called Helkath–hazzurim , which is in Gibeon .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u briew u kynrup na ka khlieh ïa uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad u pynngam ïa la ka waitlam ha ka krung jong u nongïaleh pyrshah , ba kumta baroh arphew saw ngut ki la kyllon ïap lang . Bad kumta , ïa kata ka jaka ha Gibeon la khot  Ka Lyngkha jong ki Waitlam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kem ia uwei pa uwei u paralok jong u da ka khlieh, bad ki la pynkhih ia ka waitlam jong u ha ka liang jong u baroh kawei: kumta kata ka jaka la khot ka Helkathhazurim kaba don ha Gibeon .

en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb  ; and if thou wilt not redeem it , then thou shalt break his neck : and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem .
kha: Ïa u khun kada ba la kha nyngkong baroh phin bujli da u khunlangbrot . Lada phim kwah ban bujli ïa uta u khun kada , phi dei ban pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Phi dei ruh ban pyllait ïa u khun nyngkong jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong jong u kada men siew kylliang da u khun langbrot ; bad lada phim lah ban siew kylliang ia ka , te men pynpra ia ka ryndang jong u: bad u khun nyngkong jong u briew baroh napdeng ki khun jong me men siew kylliang .

en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me , as a wise masterbuilder , I have laid the foundation , and another buildeth thereon . But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon .
kha: Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingai kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , nga la trei ïa ka kam u rangbah nongtei uba tbit bad nga la seng ïa ka nongrim , bad uwei pat u tei halor jong ka . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u dei ban sumar kumno u tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la ai ha nga, kum u nongtei uba stad, nga la buh ia ka nongrim, bad uwei pat u tei halor kata . Hynrei to ai ba uwei pa uwei un sumar kumno u tei halor kata .

en: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
kha: Mynta u Samuel u la ïap , bad baroh ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u hi , ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah beh lut ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong baroh na Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Samuel u la iap, bad ki Israel baroh ki la iam ia u, bad ki la tep ia u ha Ramah, wat ha la ka jong ka shnong . Bad u Saul u la weng noh ia kito kiba don ki mynsiem kiba la tip bha, bad ki nongleh jadu, na ka ri .

en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master , and the servant as his lord . If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub , how much more shall they call them of his household ?
kha: Kumta uba shah hikai u dei ban sngewhun ban long kum u nonghikai jong u , bad u mraw kum u kynrad jong u . Lada ïa u khlieh jong ka longïing la khot u Beelsebul , ïa ki dkhot jong ka longïing yn khot da ki kyrteng kiba kham sniew !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka biang ia u synran ba un long kum u kynrad jong u, bad u shakri kum u kynrad jong u . Lada ki la khot ia u trai iing u Belzebul , katno tam kin khot ia ki na ka iing jong u ?

en: Neither say they in their heart , Let us now fear the  Lord  our God , that giveth rain , both the former and the latter , in his season : he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest .
kha: Phim ju pyrkhat da lei lei ban pyndonburom ïa nga , wat la nga phah ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem bad ai ha phi ïa ka aïom ot man la ka snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kim ong ruh ha ka dohnud jong ki , To ngin sheptieng mynta ia U Trai jong ngi , uba ai slap ia u slap uba nyngkong bad uba hadien: u buh ha ngi ia ki taiew ba la buh jong ka jingot .

en: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u ong , ‘ Baroh kiba shakri ïa nga ki dei ban burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong nga ha la ki briew .’   Hynrei u Aaron u shu sngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses u la ong ha u Aaron , Kane ka long ba U Trai u la kren, u da ong, Ngan sa shah pynkyntang ha kito kiba wan hajan jong nga, bad ha khmat ki briew baroh ngan sa shah pyndonburom . Bad u Aaron u la bat ia ka jingsuk jong u .

en: And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
kha: Lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men ia u da ki maw, ba un iap; namar u la wad ban beh noh ia me na U Trai U Blei jong me uba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And he said unto him , Fear not : for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee  ; and thou shalt be king over Israel , and I shall be next unto thee  ; and that also Saul my father knoweth .
kha: da kaba ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng . I pa jong nga in ym lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi . I tip bha ba phi dei uta u ban sa long u syiem jong ki Israel bad ba ma nga , nga dei uba ar ha ka kyrdan .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, Wat tieng: namar ka kti u kpa jong nga u Saul kan ym shem ia me bad me phin long syiem halor ki Israel, bad ngan long hadien jong me; bad uta ruh u kpa jong nga u tip .

en: While he spake these things unto them , behold , there came a certain ruler , and worshipped him , saying , My daughter is even now dead : but come and lay thy hand upon her , and she shall live .
