kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , u rangbah synshar ki Jiw u la wan sha U , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ka khun jong nga ka dang shu ïap ; hynrei wan ban buh ïa ki kti jong me halor jong ka , bad kan im pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren ia kine kiei kiei ha ki, ha khmih, u la wan uwei u nongsynshar, bad u la mane ia u, u da ong: Ka khun jong nga ka la iap mynta: hynrei to wan bad buh ia ka kti jong me halor jong ka, bad kan im .

en: For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;
kha: Na kane ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pyndap ïa phi da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U Mynsiem jong u , u ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane ngi ruh naduh ka sngi ba ngi la iohsngew ia ka , ngim sangeh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi bad ban kwah ba phin ioh ia ka jingtip ia ka mon jong u ha ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh ba kynja mynsiem baroh;

en: Wash thyself therefore , and anoint thee , and put thy raiment upon thee , and get thee down to the floor : but make not thyself known unto the man , until he shall have done eating and drinking .
kha: Te sum sleh ïa lade , sleh ki jingiwbih , bad phong ki jaiñ kiba bha tam . Nangta leit sha ka jaka ba u dung kew ; hynrei wat ai ba un tip ba phi don hangta tad haduh ba un da dep bam dep dih .
translated_en_to_kha: To sait ia lade namarkata, bad to pynsleh ia me, bad to buh ia ka jainkup jong me ha me, bad to pynhiar ia me shapoh khyndew: hynrei wat pynpaw ia lade ha uta u briew, haduh ba un da dep bam bad dih .

en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy , lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely , and lest they should say , Our hand is high , and the  Lord  hath not done all this .
kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban kren kob ba ki dei ma ki kiba la pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga , haba dei ma nga hi uba la khñiot ïa ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ym dei ba nga la tieng ia ka jingbitar jong u nongshun , ioh ba ki nongshun jong ki kin leh phylla , bad ioh ba kin ong , Ka kti jong ngi ka long kaba jrong , bad U Trai um shym la leh ia kine baroh .

en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full , and came and shred them into the pot of pottage : for they knew them not .
kha: Uwei na ki u leit sha lyngkha ban ïoh katto katne ki jhur . U lap uwei u jyrmi khlaw bad u kheit bun tylli ki klong katba u lah ban kit . U la wanrah ïa ki bad ot dkhot ïa ki hapoh ka syrwa , khlem da tip ki dei kiba kumno .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la leit sha lyngkha ban lum ia ki jingthung sohjew, bad u la lap ia u sohjew khlaw, bad u la lum ia ki khlaw khlaw jong u da kaba dap, bad u la wan bad u la pynkhih ia ki ha ka umphniang jong u sohjew: namar kim ithuh ia ki .

en: But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .
kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit . Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga tang shu pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ngan wan ïalam ïa u sha ïing U  Trai  , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka Hannah kam shym la kiew shuh namar ka la ong ha u tnga jong ka, Ngan ym kiew haduh ba u khun un da shah pynkha khun, bad nangta ngan wanrah ia u, ba un paw ha khmat U Trai, bad hangta un sah junom .

en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house : and all that came into Solomon s heart to make in the house of the  Lord  , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .
kha: Hadien ba u Syiem Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , u da pyndep janai ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u la buh jingmut ban leh ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Solomon u la pyndep ia ka iing U Trai, bad ka iing syiem: bad baroh kaba la wan ha ka dohnud u Solomon ban leh ha ka iing U Trai, bad ha la ka jong ka iing, u la treikam bha .

en: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names : for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar  ; and to Hananiah , of Shadrach  ; and to Mishael , of Meshach  ; and to Azariah , of Abed–nego .
kha: U rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh u la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki : u Belteshassar , u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba u rangbah jong ki nongsynshar u la ai kyrteng: namar u la ai ha u Daniel ia ka kyrteng u Belteshazzar bad ha u Hananiah, na u Shadrak ; bad ha u Mishael, na u Meshah ; bad ha u Azariah, na u Abednego .

en: And it came to pass , as he spake these things , a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice , and said unto him , Blessed is the womb that bare thee , and the paps which thou hast sucked .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa kane , ka kynthei ka la kren na u paidbah bad ka la ong ha u ,  A katno kaba kmen long ka briew kaba la kha bad kaba la bsa la pjiah ïa me !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u dang kren ia kine kiei kiei, kawei ka kynthei na ka kynhun ka la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ka, bad ka la ong ha u: La kyrkhu ia ka kpoh kaba la kha ia me bad ki pop kiba me la dih .

en: And the Lord said ,  If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye might say unto this sycamine tree , Be thou plucked up by the root , and be thou planted in the sea  ; and it should obey you .
kha: U Trai u la jubab ,  Lada phi don ka jingngeit kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ha une u diengsoh lyngdkhur , ‘ To jynrat noh ïa lade na ki thied bad thung ïa lade hapoh duriaw !’ bad un kohnguh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Lada phi don ka jingngeit kum u symbai ba la khleh lang, phi lah ban ong ha une u dieng uba la tyrkhong da u tynrai, bad to long ba me la thung ha duriaw ; bad ka dei ban kohnguh ia phi .

en: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight , they have remained in their holds : their might hath failed  ; they became as women : they have burned her dwellingplaces  ; her bars are broken .
kha: Ki shipai Babilonia ki la sangeh ban ïaleh bad ki sah ha ki kut jong ki . Ki la duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki bad ki la long kum ki kynthei . Ïa ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah la pynpra , bad ki ïing ki don ha ka jingpluh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang kiba khlain bor jong ka Babilon ki la kha ban ialeh , ki la sah ha ki jingbat jong ki: ka bor jong ki ka la jah noh; ki la kylla long ki kynthei: ki la thang ia ki jaka sah jong ka; ki bar jong ka ki la tyrkhong .

en: And , behold , I , even I , do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven  ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .
kha: Ngan sa pynshlei ïa ka pyrthei da ka um ban pynduh noh khoit ïa ki kynja ba-im baroh . Baroh kat kiba don ha ka pyrthei kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, nga, wat ma nga ruh, nga wanrah ia ka jingshlei um ha ka khyndew, ban pynjot ia ka doh baroh, ha kaba ka don ka jingsawa jong ka jingim, na shapoh bneng ; bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka khyndew kin iap .

en: For they that dwell at Jerusalem , and their rulers , because they knew him not , nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day , they have fulfilled them in condemning him .
kha: Naba ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad ki nongsynshar jong ki kim tip ba u long U Nongpynim , lymne ba ki la shemphang ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ïa kiba la pule man ka sngi Sabbaton . Pynban ki la pynlong ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa ban urlong shisha da kaba pynrem ïa U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kita kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad ki nongsynshar jong ki, namar kim ithuh ia u, lymne ia ki sur jong ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la pule man la ka sngi Sabha , ki la pyndep ia ki ha kaba pynrem ia u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Damascus , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki ; ki la shohbeiñ ïa ki briew ka Gilead da ka kam runar ba khleh bieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein ia ka Damaskos , bad na ka bynta saw tylli , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ki la pynkhih ia ka Gilead da ki tiar kiba rkhiang:

en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia : Grace be unto you , and peace , from him which is , and which was , and which is to come  ; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne  ;
kha: Na u Ïoannis sha ki hynñiew tylli ki balang ha ka probins    jong ka Asia : Ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ïa phi na U Blei , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan , bad na ki hynñiew ki mynsiem kiba ha khmat ka khet jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ioannis ha ki hynriew tylli ki balang kiba don ha Asia: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na uta uba long, bad uba la long, bad uba dei ban wan; bad na ki hynriew Mynsiem ki bym don shuwa ka khet jong u;

en: And the sword shall come upon Egypt , and great pain shall be in Ethiopia , when the slain shall fall in Egypt , and they shall take away her multitude , and her foundations shall be broken down .
kha: Kan don ka thma ha Ijipt bad ka jingjynjar bah ha Sudan . Kiba bun ha Ijipt kin shah pynïap ; ka ri kan shah pynjot bad kan shah ieh ha ki jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka waitlam kan wan ha Ijipt bad ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw kan long ha Ethiopia , haba u nongshah pyniap un hap ha Ijipt , bad kin shim noh ia ka jingbun briew jong ka bad ki nongrim jong ka kin sa tyrkhong .

en: And to the genealogy of all their little ones , their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , through all the congregation : for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness :
kha: La kyntiew kyrteng ïa ki baroh ryngkat lang bad ki tnga jong ki , ki khun , bad kiba hap ha ka jingsumar jong ki , namar ka donkam ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ki kam bakyntang ha kano kano ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jaitbynriew barit jong ki baroh, ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun shynrang jong ki, lyngba ka jingiaseng baroh: namar ha ka kam ba la buh jong ki ki la pynkyntang ia lade ha ka jingkhuid:

en: But the rest fled to Aphek , into the city  ; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left . And Ben–hadad fled , and came into the city , into an inner chamber .
kha: Kiba lait im ki ïaphet ïap sha ka nongbah Aphek , ha kaba ki kynroh ka nongbah ki khyllem halor ki arphew hynñiew hajar ngut . U Benhadad ruh u lait phet shapoh ka nongbah bad u rieh ha ka kamra ba shadien jong ka ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kiba sah ki la phet noh sha Aphek, shapoh ka nongbah bad hangta ka kynroh ka la hap ha ki arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki briew kiba la sah . U Benhadad u la phet noh bad u la wan shapoh ka nongbah, shapoh ka kamra kaba shapoh .

en: But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .
kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai baroh , ki kali ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara harud ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Pi Hahiroth bad ka Baal Sephon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki nong Ijipt ki la bud ia ki, ki kulai bad ki kali jong u Pharaoh, bad ki shipai jong u, bad ki shipai jong u, bad ki la iaid lait ia ki da ka duriaw, nalor u Piharoth, ha khmat u Baalzephon .

en: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah , of the goldsmiths . Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries , and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall .
kha: U Ussiel , u khun jong u Harhaïah , u bania , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Hananaïah , u nongshna jingiwbih , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka Kynroh Baïar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata u la pynbha ia u Uzzel u khun jong u Hachiah . Hadien jong u ruh u la pynbha ia u Hananiah u khun jong uwei na ki nongleh kam sniew , bad ki la pynskhem ia ka Jerusalem haduh ka kynroh kaba heh .

en: And it came to pass , as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the cloud .
kha: Katba u Aaron u dang kren ha ka kynhun baroh kawei , ki phai shaphang ka ri shyiap , bad kynsan ka jingshai baphyrnai jong U  Trai  ka la paw ha u lyoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba u Aaron u dang kren ha ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei, ba ki peit sha ka ri khlaw bad , ha khmih ka burom U Trai ka la paw ha u lyoh .

en: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness , those that remember thee in thy ways : behold , thou art wroth  ; for we have sinned : in those is continuance , and we shall be saved .
kha: Me pdiang sngewbha ïa kito kiba shem jingkmen ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , ïa kito kiba kynmaw kumno me kwah ïa ki ban im . Me la bitar ïa ngi , hynrei ngi dang ïai leh pop ; wat la me la bitar shla ngi dang ïai leh ïa kaba sniew naduh mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Me iakynduh ia uta uba kmen bad uba leh hok, kita kiba kynmaw ia me ha ki lynti jong me: ha khmih me bitar; namar ngi la leh pop: ha kita ki long kiba iai bteng, bad ngin sa shah pynim .

en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes  ; and there shall be no more death , neither sorrow , nor crying , neither shall there be any more pain : for the former things are passed away .
kha: Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat baroh na ki khmat jong ki . Yn ym don shuh ka jingïap , ym don shuh ka jingsngewsih lane ka jingïam lane ka jingpang . Kiei kiei kiba rim ki la jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Blei un sait noh ia ki ummat baroh na ki khmat jong ki ; bad kan ym don shuh ka jingiap, lymne ka jingsngewsih ne ka jingud: namar kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa kin ym don shuh: namar kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa kin ym don shuh .

en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .
kha: Ong ïa u ban die ha nga katba ka shongdor haba phi dang ïadon ryngkat , ba ngan ïohkynti ïa ka kum ka jaka tep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un ai ia nga ia ka krem Machpelah kaba u don ha kaba kut jong ka lyngkha jong u ; katba u lah ban siew ia ka na ka bynta ka jaka tep hapdeng jong phi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , As the new wine is found in the cluster , and one saith , Destroy it not  ; for a blessing is in it : so will I do for my servants  sakes , that I may not destroy them all .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ym ju don ba pynjot ïa ki sohwaiñ kiba bha ; pynban , ki shna waiñ na ki . Lymne ngan ym pynjot ruh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh — ngan ïada ïa kito kiba shakri ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , Kumba la lap ia ka wain thymmai ha ka kynhun , bad uwei u ong , Wat pynduh ia ka; namar ka jingkyrkhu ka don ha ka: kumta ngan leh na ka bynta ki shakri jong nga, ba ngan ym pynjot ia ki baroh .

en: As touching our brother Apollos , I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren : but his will was not at all to come at this time ; but he will come when he shall have convenient time .
kha: Mynta , shaphang u Apollos u parabangeit , nga la ju pynshlur ïa u ban wan jngoh ïa phi ryngkat bad kiwei ki parabangeit , hynrei um da mon eh ban wan ha kane ka por . Pynban , ynda u ïoh ïa ka lad , un sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u hynmen jong ngi u Apollos u la kwah shibun eh ia u ban wan sha phi ryngkat bad ki para bangeit: hynrei ka mon jong u kam shym la wan satia ha kane ka por ; hynrei un sa wan ynda u la ioh ia ka por kaba suk .

en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;
kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur jong kiba bun ki angel sawdong ka khet bad ki mrad bad ki rangbah: bad ka jingdon jong ki ka long shi hajar shi hajar .

en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
kha: ba ka por ka poi haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka ïingsyiem , kiei kiei kiba ki kpa tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kane ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ki sngi ki wan, ba baroh kaba don ha ka iing jong me bad kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la buh haduh kane ka sngi, yn rah sha Babilon: ym don ei ei kaba sah shuh, ong U Trai .

en: And if thy right hand offend thee , cut it off , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .
kha: Lada ka kti kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , to ot noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh ïa kawei na ki kti jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka leit sha dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka kti kadiang jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, ot noh ia ka bad bret noh ia ka na me: namar ka long kaba myntoi ia me ba uwei na ki dkhot jong me un jah noh, bad ym ba ka met jong me baroh kawei kan shah bret noh sha dujok .

en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
kha: Bad haba phi shahjingit , wat leh  mat sngewsih kumba ki riewarsap ki leh . Kim kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jong ki khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ba ki shahjingit . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata haba phi shah jingit, wat long kum ki nongleh arsap: namar ki pynkylla dur ia ki khmat jong ki, ba kin paw ha ki briew ban shah jingit . Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ki don ka bainong jong ki .

en: And it came to pass , as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob , and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , that Esau his brother came in from his hunting .
kha: U Isaak u la pyndep ban ai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , bad shen hadien ba u Jakob u la leit , u Iso u hynmen jong u , u la wan phai na kaba behmrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia tang shu dep ban kyrkhu ia u Jakob bad u Jakob u dang duna na ka jingdon jong u kpa jong u u Isaak .

en: And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .
kha: Namar ba nga la leh kumta , u Moses u la kular ïa nga ba ki khun ki kti jong nga bad ma nga , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thikna kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba nga la ïuhkjat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la sngap jar ha kata ka sngi, u da ong: Hooid ka ri ha kaba ki kjat jong me ki la iaid kan long ka pateng jong me bad ki khun jong me junom , namar me la bud pura ia U Trai U Blei jong nga .

en: And Jesus answering said ,  A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and fell among thieves , which stripped him of his raiment , and wounded him , and departed , leaving him half dead .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Shisien la don u briew uba la leit hiar na Jerusalem sha Jerikho mynba ki nonglute ki la tur ïaleh ïa u , ki la sloit lyngkhuit ïa u , bad ki la shoh ïa u , ki da iehnoh lyngktop ïa u kum uba ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab u la ong: Uwei u briew u la hiar na Jerusalem sha Jerikos bad u la hap hapdeng ki nongtuh kiba la weng noh ia u na ka jainkup jong u bad u la pynmynsaw ia u bad u la leit noh da kaba iehnoh ia u shiteng .

en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone , and cast it into the sea , saying , Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down , and shall be found no more at all .
kha: Nangta u angel bakhlaiñbor u la shim ïa u maw uba heh la kat u mawtylliat baheh bad u la kawang ïa u sha ka duriaw , da kaba ong ,  Kane ka long kumno ïa ka nongbah Babilon bakhraw yn pynkhyllem ha ka borbah bad yn ym ïohi shuh ïa ka da lei lei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei u angel uba khlain bor u la shim ia u maw kum u mawsiang uba khraw bad u la bret ia u sha duriaw , u da ong: Kumta da ka jingleh donbor yn bret noh ia kata ka nongbah kaba khraw .

en: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high , and covered with their wings over the mercy seat , with their faces one to another  ; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims .
kha: Kita ki Kherub ki ïaphai markhmat halor kata ka jingtap , bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki cherub ki la pynphriang ia ki bniat jong ki sha jrong , bad ki la tap da ki bniat jong ki halor ka jaka shong jingisynei , bad ki khmat jong ki iwei ia iwei pat; wat haduh ka jaka shong jingisynei ki la long ki khmat jong ki cherub .

en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets : my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword  ; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger  ; thou hast killed , and not pitied .
kha: To shahshkor ïa ki jingud jong nga ; ym don mano mano ban pyntngen ïa nga . Ki nongshun jong nga ki kmen ba me la wallam ka jingjot halor jong nga . To wallam ïa ka sngi kaba me la kular ; to pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban shahshitom kum ma nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla bad ki rangbah ki thiah ha madan ha ki lynti: ki khunlung jong nga bad ki samla jong nga ki hap da ka waitlam ; me la pyniap ia ki ha ka sngi ka jingbitar jong me ; me la pyniap , bad ngam shym la sngewsih .

en: And I , behold , I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they shall follow them : and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .
kha: Ngan pynmutlop haduh katta katta ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin beh nadien jong ki , bad ngan ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ka jingjop jong nga ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , ïa ki kali ïapom jong u , bad ïa ki nongñiah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ha khmih, ngan pynkhlain ia ki dohnud jong ki nong Ijipt, bad kin bud ia ki: bad ngan ioh ia ka burom ia u Pharaoh bad ha ka kynhun jong u baroh, ha ki kali jong u bad ha ki kulai jong u .

en: And they mourned , and wept , and fasted until even , for Saul , and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the  Lord  , and for the house of Israel  ; because they were fallen by the sword .
kha: Ki la sngewsih kthang , ki ïambriew , bad ki la shahjingit haduh janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan bad na ka bynta ki Israel , ki briew jong U  Trai  , namar bun bah ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la iam bad ki la iam haduh ban da janmiet, na ka bynta u Saul bad na ka bynta u Jonathan u khun jong u bad na ka bynta ki briew jong U Trai, bad na ka bynta ka iing Israel; namar ki la hap da ka waitlam .

en: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the  Lord  hath promised : for we have sinned .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïamih ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri lum , ki da ong ,  Mynta te ngi la kloi ban leit sha kata ka jaka ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha ngi . Ngi phla ba ngi la leh pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng dang step, bad ki la leit sha jrong jong u lum, ki da ong: Lo, ngi don hangne, bad ngin leit kiew sha ka jaka kaba U Trai u la kular: namar ngi la leh pop .

en: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it , and of ancient times that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps .
kha: Hato mem shym la ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kine baroh la slem bah ? Bad mynta nga la pyndep ïa ki . Nga la ai ha me ïa ka bor bad pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la kerkut sha ki kynton maw ba la twa .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me khlem iohsngew mynshuwa kumno nga la leh ia kata, bad na ki por hyndai ba nga la thaw ia ka ? mynta nga la wanrah ia ka ban jia , ba me dei ban buh ia ki nongbah ba la khang lypa ha ki thliew kiba la jot .

en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel  ; because the  Lord  did there confound the language of all the earth : and from thence did the  Lord  scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth .
kha: Ïa ka nongbah la khot kyrteng ka Babel , namar dei hangta ba U  Trai  u la pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki briew baroh ; bad nangta la pynsaphred ïa ki sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la khot ia ka Babel ; namar U Trai u la pynkulmar ia ka ktien jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei: bad nangta U Trai u la pynphriang ia ki shabar ri ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

en: And it came to pass , when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .
kha: Man ka por ba u Moses u leit shata , ki paidbah ki ïeng ha ki jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki ïa-peit ïa u Moses haduh ba un da rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la mih sha ka ïingjaiñ, ki briew baroh ki la ieng bad u la ieng uwei pa uwei ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjaiñ jong u, bad u la peit ïa u Moses haduh ba u la leit sha ka ïingjaiñ .

en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .
kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U  Trai  u ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ka miet kaba la ju peit bniah shibun eh ha U Trai namar ba u la wanrah ia ki na ka ri Ijipt: kane ka dei kata ka miet jong U Trai ban shah peit bniah na ki khun Israel baroh ha ki pateng jong ki .

en: For the saying which he cried by the word of the  Lord  against the altar in Beth–el , and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria , shall surely come to pass .
kha: Ki ktien ba u kren da ka hukum U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ka duwan ha Bethel bad pyrshah ïa ki jaka mane baroh ha ki shnong kiba ha Samaria , da shisha kin sa urlong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kata ka jingong kaba u la pyrta da ka ktien U Trai pyrshah ia ka jingknia ha Bethel bad pyrshah ia ki iing baroh kiba don ha ki nongbah jong ka Samaria .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor , it is time to thresh her : yet a little while , and the time of her harvest shall come .
kha: Shen u nongshun un ot ïa ki bad un ïuhroit ïa ki kum u kew ha ka jaka tylliat kew . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid, U Blei jong ki Israel; Ka khun jong ka Babilon ka long kum ka jingthung ia ka: hynrei khyndiat por , bad ka por jong ka jingot jong ka kan sa wan .

en: And his servitor said , What , should I set this before an hundred men ? He said again , Give the people , that they may eat : for thus saith the  Lord  , They shall eat , and shall leave thereof .
kha: hynrei u jubab ,  Hato phi pyrkhat kane kan biang na ka bynta ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ?  U Elisha u jubab ,  Ai ha ki ban bam , namar U  Trai  u ong ba kin bam bad yn don kaba sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u shakri jong u u la ong, Kaei, nga dei ban buh ia kane ha khmat shispah ngut ki briew ? U la ong biang: Ai ia ki briew, ba kin bam: namar kumta u ong U Trai: Kin bam bad kin iehnoh ia ka .

en: ( For those priests were made without an oath  ; but this with an oath by him that said unto him , The Lord sware and will not repent , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec : )
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la long u lyngdoh da ka jingsmai haba U Blei u la ong ha u ,  U Trai u la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang bad un ym kylla shuh : ‘ Me , me long u lyngdoh junom .’
translated_en_to_kha: (Na ka bynta kita ki lyngdoh la leh khlem da smai ; hynrei ia kane da ka jingsmai da uta uba la ong ha u: U Trai un smai bad un ym kylla bamut: Me long u lyngdoh junom hadien ka hukum jong u Melchisedec: )

en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest , and found mandrakes in the field , and brought them unto his mother Leah . Then Rachel said to Leah , Give me , I pray thee , of thy son s mandrakes .
kha: Ha ka aïom ot kew , u Reuben u la leit sha lyngkha bad u lap ïa ki mandriek    , kiba u la wanrah sha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Ka Rakhel ka ong ïa ka Leah ,  Ai lem katto katne ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la leit ha ki sngi ot kew, bad u la lap ia ki khniang ha lyngkha, bad u la wanrah ia ki ha ka kmie jong u ka Leah . Nangta u Rakhel u la ong ha ka Leah: Ai ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, na ki khun jong me .

en: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee : and they have not discovered thine iniquity , to turn away thy captivity  ; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment .
kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki pop jong nga baroh bad u la teh lang ïa ki baroh ; u la sdien ïa ki ha u ryndang jong nga , bad nga la sdang tlot hapoh ka jingbankhia . U Trai u la ai ïa nga ha ki nongshun jong nga , bad ngam lah leh ei ei pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongiathuhlypa jong me ki la iohi ia kiei kiei kiba lehnohei bad kiba bieit na ka bynta jong me: bad kim shym la lap ia ka jingbymhok jong me, ban pynphai noh ia ka jingshah set phatok jong me; hynrei ki la iohi na ka bynta jong me ia ki jingkit kiba bakla bad ki daw jong ka jingshah beh .

en: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .
kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ban kiar noh na ki bangeit baroh kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba ngi ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ngi hukum ia phi ko para bangeit ha ka kyrteng U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist , ba phin weng noh ia lade na uwei pa uwei u para uba iaid khlem akor , bad ym kat kum ka dustur kaba u la ioh na ngi .

en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
kha: Man ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , ki long ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Utei u briew u la mih na ka shnong jong u man la u snem ban mane bad ban knia ha U Trai jong ki paid ha Shiloh . Bad ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Eli, u Huphni bad u Phinehas, ki lyngdoh jong U Trai ki la don hangta .

en: And the names of them were Aholah the elder , and Aholibah her sister : and they were mine , and they bare sons and daughters . Thus were their names  ; Samaria is Aholah , and Jerusalem Aholibah .
kha: Kaba kham shuwa ka kyrteng ka Oholah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Samaria ) , bad kaba hadien ka kyrteng ka Oholibah ( ka mih pli ïa ka Jerusalem ) . Nga shongkurim ïa ki baroh ar ngut , bad ki kha ïa ki khun ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kyrteng jong ki ki long u Ahlah uba kham rangbah, bad ka Ahlibah ka para jong ka: bad ki long ki jong nga, bad ki kha khun shynrang bad kynthei . Kumta ki kyrteng jong ki ki long ki ; Samaria, bad ka Jerusalem Ahlibah .

en: And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .
kha: Ki la ïai duwai lynñiar bad kumba lamwir haduh palat shiteng sngi ; hynrei ym shym don jingjubab , ne ïohsngew ïa kano kano ka sur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba la dep ka por shiteng sngi, bad ki la iathuhlypa haduh ka por jong ka jingknia janmiet, ba ym don sur, ne don ba jubab, ne don ba iadei .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the  Lord  shall bring his oblation unto the  Lord  of the sacrifice of his peace offerings .
kha: Uno uno uba wallam ïa ka jingainguh ïasyllok u dei ban wanrah ruh shi bynta na ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai  , da kaba wanrah hi ïa ka da la ki kti kum ka jingainguh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong , Uta uba ai ia ka jingknia jong u ha U Trai un wanrah ia ka jingknia jong u ha U Trai .

en: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river , the river Euphrates , all the land of the Hittites , and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun , shall be your coast .
kha: Ki pud jong phi kin kot naduh ka ri shyiap ha ka phang shathie haduh ki Lumbah Lebanon ha ka phang shatei ; naduh ka wah Ïuphratis bakhraw ha ka phang mihngi , lyngba ka ri ki Hit , haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian ha ka phang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka ri khlaw bad kane ka Lebanon haduh ka wah bah , ka wah Euphrates , ka ri Hittite baroh kawei bad haduh ka duriaw bah sha ka jingleit jong ka sngi .

en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye children of Israel : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land , because there is no truth , nor mercy , nor knowledge of God in the land .
kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . To sngap , ko Israel , ïa kaei kaba u ong :  Ym don jingïaineh ne ka jingieit ha ka ri , Bad ki briew kim pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai, ko khun Israel: namar U Trai u don ka jingiakren bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri , namar ym don ka jingshisha ne ka jingisynei ne ka jingtip ia U Blei ha ka ri .

en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .
kha: Me la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri kiba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Heshbon , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , bad ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata me la ai ia ki ki hima bad ki jaitbynriew, bad me la phiah ia ki ha ki thliew: kumta ki la don ia ka ri u Sihon bad ka ri u syiem u Heshbon bad ka ri u syiem u Og u syiem u Basan .

en: And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .
kha: U kren shaphang ki dieng bad ki jingthung , naduh ki dieng Kedar Lebanon haduh u Hissop uba mih halor kynroh ; u la kren shaphang ki mrad , ki sim , ki bseiñ , bad ki dohkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ia ki dieng , naduh u dieng cedar uba don ha Lebanon haduh ka hyssop kaba mih na ka kynroh: u kren ruh ia ki mrad bad ki sim bad ki dohkha .

en: Then these men assembled unto the king , and said unto the king , Know , O king , that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed .
kha: Nangta ki rangbah ki la wan biang sha u syiem bad ki la ong ha u ,  U Syiem Kynrad u tip ba kat kum ki aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia ym don kano kano ka hukum kaba u syiem u la ai ïa kaba lah ban pynkylla .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kine ki briew ki la ialum lang ha u syiem bad ki la ong ha u syiem: To tip ko syiem, ba ka ain jong ki Media bad ki Persia ka long , Ba ym lah ban pynkylla ia ka hukum ne ka ain kaba u syiem u pynskhem .

en: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .
kha: I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon lang bad ki nongbud jong u Korah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ; i la ïap namar ka pop la jong .
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong ngi u la iap ha ka ri khlaw , bad um shym la don ha ka kynhun jong ki kiba la ialum lang pyrshah ia U Trai ha ka kynhun jong u Korah hynrei u la iap ha la ka jong ka pop , bad um don khun shynrang .

en: And when David had called him , he did eat and drink before him  ; and he made him drunk : and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord , but went not down to his house .
kha: U Dabid u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam miet bad u , bad u la pyndih buaid ïa u . Hynrei ha kata ka miet ruh , u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban , u la thiah ha la ka jaka thiah ha ka kamra ki nongap phira ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la khot ia u, u la bam bad u la dih ha khmat jong u ; bad u la pynlong ia u ban dih kyiad: bad ha ka por mynstep u la leit shabar ban thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ki shakri jong u kynrad jong u , hynrei um shym la leit hiar sha la iing .

en: The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .
kha: Da lei lei U  Trai  un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la pynlong syiem ! To ngin ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khiew um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la khang ba ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia U Trai ba la pynsleh: hynrei, nga kyrpad ia me, to shim mynta ia ka khnam kaba don ha ka bol jong u, bad ia ka um kaba jylliew jong u, bad to pyllait noh ia ngi .

en: And cinnamon , and odours , and ointments , and frankincense , and wine , and oil , and fine flour , and wheat , and beasts , and sheep , and horses , and chariots , and slaves , and souls of men .
kha: bad ïa ka siasia , ki musla , ïa ka jingiwbih , ka mirr , bad ka jingiwbih remdor ; ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ïa u  purew bad u kew , ïa ki jingri bad ki langbrot , ïa ki kulai bad ki kali kulai , ïa ki mraw bad wat ïa ki mynsiem briew ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka cinnamon, bad ki jingsma, bad ki umphniang, bad ka wain, bad ka umphniang, bad ka shini kaba bha, bad u kew bad ki mrad bad ki langbrot bad ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar bad ki mraw bad ki mynsiem jong ki briew .

en: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt  ; and Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh , captain of the guard , an Egyptian , bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites , which had brought him down thither .
kha: Mynta ki nong Ishmael ki la ïalam ïa u Joseph sha ka ri Ijipt bad ki die ïa u ha u Potiphar , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , uba long u kapten jong kiba ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la shah pynhiar sha Ijipt bad u Potiphar, u rangbah jong u Pharaoh, u rangbah shipai Ijipt u la thied ia u na ki kti jong ki Ishakele kiba la pynhiar ia u shapoh .

en: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them , weeping all along as he went : and it came to pass , as he met them , he said unto them , Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam .
kha: Te u Ishmael u la leit noh na Mispah ban ïakynduh ïa ki , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Haba u la wan ha ki , u la ong ,  Sngewbha wan shapoh ban khmih ïa u Gedalaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ishmael u khun u Nethaniah u la leit shabar na Mizpah ban iakynduh ia ki: bad ka la jia ba u la iakynduh ia ki, u la ong ha ki: To wan sha u Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam .

en: And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew  ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .
kha: Te uwei uba la ïohlait u wan ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u Abram , u Hebru , uba la shong la sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre u kynja Amor . U Mamre bad ki para shynrang jong u , u Eshkol bad u Aber , ki dei ki paralok u Abram .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u la wan uba la lait im, bad u la iathuh ha u Abram u Hebru ; namar u la shong ha ka madan u Mamre u Amore , u hynmen u Escol bad u hynmen u Aner: bad kine ki la iasoh bad u Abram .

en: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .
kha: To ngin ïakhmih shaiñ sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka don naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynban , namar ka jingkmen kaba la ap ïa u , um shym pyrkhat ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap halor ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka liang ka mon jong ka khet U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba peit sha U Jisu u nongthoh bad u nongpyndep ia ka jingngeit jong ngi ; uba na ka bynta ka jingkmen kaba la buh ha khmat jong u u la shah ia ka diengphna , da kaba pynjah burom ia ka jingsngewlehrain , bad la buh ia u ha ka liang kadiang jong ka khet U Blei .

en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .
kha: U hukum ïa la ki rangbah synshar ban ïakren jar jar bad u Dabid bad ban ïathuh ha u ,  U syiem u shem sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi ; mynta ka dei ka por kaba biang ba phin shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la hukum ia ki shakri jong u, u da ong, To iakynduh bad u Dabid da kaba rieh bad u la ong: Ha khmih u syiem u la sngewbha ia me, bad ki shakri jong u baroh ki ieit ia me: mynta to long u khun syiem ha ka ain .

en: He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .
kha: U lyngdoh u dei ban thang noh ïa ka , namar ka dei ka jingpang bthuh kaba pur , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Un thang ia kata ka jain, la ka long kaba jem ne kaba jem, ha ka sniehdoh ne ha ka sniehdoh, ha kaba ka khlam ka long: namar ka long ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba jem; yn thang ia ka ha ka ding .

en: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him , and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul , and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him  ; and they went over Jordan before the king .
kha: U la don bad u shihajar ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin . Bad u Siba ruh , u shakri jong ka longïing jong u Saul , u la wan lem bad ki khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad arphew ngut ki shakri , bad ki la wan poi ha Jordan ha shuwa jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don shi hajar ngut ki briew jong u Benjamin bad u, bad u Siba u shakri jong ka iing u Saul bad ki shiphew ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki arphew ngut ki shakri jong u bad ki la leit sha Jordan ha khmat u syiem .

en: Look down from thy holy habitation , from heaven , and bless thy people Israel , and the land which thou hast given us , as thou swarest unto our fathers , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
kha: To khmih nangto na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me ha bneng bad kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Peit shapoh na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me, na bneng, bad to kyrkhu ia ki briew jong me ki Israel bad ka ri kaba me la ai ha ngi, kumba me sngewtynnad ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi, ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers .
kha: Ka Israel kan ïasoh bad ka Judah , bad ryngkat lang kin ïawan na ka jingshah ringmraw ha ka ri kaba shatei bad kin wan phai sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi kum ka jingdon jingem kaba neh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi ka iing u Judah kan iaid ryngkat bad ka iing Israel , bad kin iawan lang na ka ri jong ka ri sha ka ri kaba nga la ai pateng ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: And Zelah , Eleph , and Jebusi , which is Jerusalem , Gibeah , and Kirjath  ; fourteen cities with their villages . This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families .
kha: ka Sela , ka Haeleph , ka Jebus ( lane ka Jerusalem ) , ka Gibeah , bad ka Kiriath Jearim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki . Kane ka long ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Zelah, ka Eleph, bad ka Jebusi, kaba long ka Jerusalem, ka Gibeah bad ka Kirjath ; bad ki shnong jong ki . Kane ka long ka pateng jong ki khun shynrang jong ki .

en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow , or a voluntary offering , it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice : and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten :
kha: Lada u briew u wanlam ïa ka jingainguh ïasyllok ban pyndep ïa la ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong u hi , ym da donkam ban bam lut ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba la kñia ; hynrei ïa kaba sah lah ban bam ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka jingknia jong u ka long ka jingkular ne ka jingainguh mon sngewbha, yn bam ia ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba u ai ia ka jingknia jong u: bad ha ka sngi kaba sah ruh yn bam:

en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u briew uba ot ki dei ban trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kyrmen ban ïoh bynta na u jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane u ong ia ka baroh kawei na ka bynta jong ngi ? Na ka bynta jong ngi, khlem artatien, ia kane la thoh: ba uta uba bet u dei ban bet ha ka jingkyrmen ; bad ba uta uba sngewsih ha ka jingkyrmen u dei ban long u nongiashim bynta ha ka jingkyrmen jong u .

en: And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .
kha: U Elijah u leit sha u paidbah bad ong ,  Sa katno slem ba phin pynbeit ïa ki jingmut jong phi ? Lada U  Trai  u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baal u dei U Blei , mane ïa u !  Hynrei u paidbah u la shu sngap jar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la wan sha ki briew baroh, bad u la ong, Katno por phi sah hapdeng ar tylli ki jingmut ? lada U Trai u long U Blei, to bud ia u: hynrei lada u Baal, te to bud ia u . Ki briew kim jubab ia u da ka ktien .

en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
kha: Katno kaba kynjah long ka Jerusalem , kaba shisien ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka long kum ka riewkynthei ; kaba donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno U Trai u la tap ia ka khun jong u Seion da u lyoh ha ka jingbitar jong u , bad u la pynhap na bneng sha ka khyndew ia ka jingitynnad jong ki Israel , bad um kynmaw ia ka jaka shong kjat jong u ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar jong u !

en: Rejoice not thou , whole Philistia , because the rod of him that smote thee is broken : for out of the serpent s root shall come forth a cockatrice , and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Philistia , u dieng uba la tied ïa phi u la kheiñ , hynrei phim don kano kano ka daw ban shadkmen . Haba uwei u bseiñ u ïap , uwei pat uba kham sniew u wan ha ka jaka jong u . Ka pylleng bseiñ ka pynmih ïa u Ïakjakor uba her .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngewbha ia me, ko Philistia baroh kawei, namar u diengduh jong uta uba la tyrkhong ia me: namar na u bsein u la mih u khnai bad u soh jong u un long u bsein uba her ding .

en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek  ; after thee , Benjamin , among thy people  ; out of Machir came down governors , and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer .
kha: Ki la wan na Ephraim sha ka them , Hadien ka jait Benjamin bad ki briew jong ka . Ki nongai hukum ki la wan hiar na Makhir , Ki rangbah pynïaidkam na Sebulun .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Ephraim la don ka tynrai jong ki pyrshah ia u Amalek ; hadien jong me, u Benjamin, napdeng ki briew jong me; na Machir ki la wan hiar ki Lat, bad na u Zebulun kita kiba pyniaid ia ka pen jong u nongthoh .

en: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated for the firstborn , by giving him a double portion of all that he hath : for he is the beginning of his strength  ; the right of the firstborn is his .
kha: U dei ban ai ar bynta na ka spah ka phew jong u ha la u khun nyngkong , wat la um dei u khun na ka tnga ba u kham ieit . U dei ban ai ha la u khun nyngkong ïa ka hok kaba u dei ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un pdiang ia u khun nyngkong jong u khun nyngkong: namar u long ka jingsdang jong ka bor jong u; ka hok jong u khun nyngkong ka long ka jong u .

en: Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba dang kham samla phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa kiba la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh phi dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingsngewrit , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U Blei u ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh phi kiba kham rit, to pyndem ia lade ha kiba kham rangbah . Hooid, baroh na phi to long kiba kohnguh iwei ia iwei pat: namar U Blei u pyrshah ia kiba sngew sarong bad u ai ia ka jingaiei ia kiba pynrit mynsiem .

en: And it came to pass , when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat , that they said , Surely it is the king of Israel . And they turned aside to fight against him : and Jehoshaphat cried out .
kha: Kumta haba ki ïohi ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat , baroh ki tharai ba u dei u syiem Israel , bad ki phai ban tur ïaleh ïa u ; hynrei haba u lynñiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ki rangbah shipai ki la iohi ia u Jehoshaphat, ba ki la ong: Hooid u long u syiem Israel . Ki la phai noh ban ialeh pyrshah ia u: bad u Jehoshaphat u la pyrta .

en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw his brother Benjamin , his mother s son , and said , Is this your younger brother , of whom ye spake unto me ? And he said , God be gracious unto thee , my son .
kha: Haba u Joseph u ïohi ïa u Benjamin u para jong u , u ong ,  Une seh u para khatduh jong phi , uta uba phi la ïathuh ha nga ? U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi , khun .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la iohi ia u hynmen jong u u Benjamin, u khun jong u, bad u la ong: Hato une u hynmen barit jong phi uba phi kren ha nga ? Bad u la ong: U Blei un sngewbha ia me ko khun jong nga .

en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep . Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , as I commanded thee , in the time of the month Abib : for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt .
kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Kumba nga la hukum ïa phi , bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat hynñiew sngi lynter ha u bnai Abib , namar dei ha uta u bnai ba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhawai jong u kpu khlem thied . Hynriew sngi men bam ia u kpu khlem thied kumba nga la hukum ia me, ha ka por jong u bnai Abib: namar ha u bnai Abib me mih na Ijipt .

en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?
kha: Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri baroh , kiba lah ban pyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Blei jong phi un pynim ïa phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba don hangta napdeng ki blei jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la pynjot lut ia ki briew jong u na ka kti jong nga , ba U Blei jong phi un lah ban pyllait ia phi na ka kti jong nga ?

en: And there was no deliverer , because it was far from Zidon , and they had no business with any man  ; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth–rehob . And they built a city , and dwelt therein .
kha: Hadien , ki rangbah na Dan ki shim ïa u lyngdoh bad ïa kiei kiei kiba u Mikah u la thaw , ki leit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Laish , kata ka shnong jong kiba shongsuk , ki briew kiba jar jar , kaba don ha kajuh ka them kum ka Bethrehob . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongshong shnong bad ki thang ïa ka shnong . Ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki , naba ka Laish ka don jngai na Sidon , bad ki ruh kim don jingïadei bad kiwei pat ki briew . Ki rangbah na Dan ki tei pat ïa ka shnong bad ki shongduh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym don u nongpyllait im, namar ba ka don jngai na u Sidon, bad kim don kam bad uno uno u briew ; bad ka la don ha ka them kaba don ha Betrehob . Ki la tei ia ka shnong bad ki la shong hangta .

en: Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .
kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh san ngut ki don hangta , bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynthei halor tnum ïing , kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka iing ka la dap da ki shynrang bad kynthei ; bad ki kynrad Philistia baroh ki la don hangta ; bad ki don ha ka tnum kumba lai hajar ngut ki shynrang bad kynthei kiba la iohi katba u Samson u dang ialehkai .

en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .
kha: Nangta un thang ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh halor ka duwan , kumba ju thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u nongsynshar , bad yn map ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un thang ia ka shini jong u baroh ha ka liang ka bam: bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong u kumba ka long kaba iadei bad ka pop jong u .

en: And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart  ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me : therefore suffered I thee not to touch her .
kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u ha kata ka jingphohsniew ,  Ho-oid , nga tip ba me la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur ; kumta nga la khang ïa me ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngam shym la shah ïa me ban ktah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , Hooid , nga tip ba me la leh ia kane ha ka jinglong ba janai jong ka dohnud jong me ; namar nga ruh nga la khang ia me na kaba leh pop pyrshah ia nga: namarkata nga la shah ia me ban ym ktah ia ka .

en: And the rulers knew not whither I went , or what I did  ; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews , nor to the priests , nor to the nobles , nor to the rulers , nor to the rest that did the work .
kha: Ym don na kino kino ki rangbah synshar kiba na kata ka jaka kiba la tip shano ba nga la leit bad kaei kaba nga la leh . Haduh kata ka por , ngam pat shym la ong ei ei ïano ïano ruh na ka para Jiw jong nga — ki lyngdoh , ki nongïalam , ki rangbah synshar , lane mano mano ruh u ban ïashim bynta ha ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongsynshar kim tip shano nga leit, ne kaei kaba nga la leh; bad nga la iathuh ha ki Jiw, ne ha ki lyngdoh , ne ha ki riew rangbah ne ha ki nongsynshar , ne ha kiwei pat kiba leh ia kata ka kam .

en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger , and the strength of battle : and it hath set him on fire round about , yet he knew not  ; and it burned him , yet he laid it not to heart .
kha: Kumta u pynlong ïa ngi ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong u bad shah jynjar ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka thma . Kum ka ding ka jingbitar jong u ka meh kylleng ka Israel , hynrei ngim ju tip aïu ka jia ; ngim shym ïoh jinghikai satia ei ei na ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u la theh ia ka jingbitar jong u, bad ka jingkhlain jong ka thma: bad ka la thang ia u sawdong sawdong , hynrei um tip ia u ; bad ka la thang ia u , hynrei um shym la buh ia ka ha ka dohnud .

en: The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
kha: U  Trai  un shah ba ki nongshun kin jop ïa phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phin sa her ïap na kiba bun ki dong , bad ki briew ka pyrthei kin sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka jia ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un pynlong ia me ban shah pynshitom ha khmat ki nongshun jong me: men leit shabar pyrshah ia ki , bad phet noh hynriew lynti ha khmat jong ki: bad yn weng noh ia me sha ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew .

en: And she said , I pray you , let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now , that she tarried a little in the house .
kha: Ka kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ba kan bud nadien jong ki nongot bad tam ïa u kew . Ka la trei naduh dang step phyrngab bad dang myntan ka shongthait shipor hapoh ka jingkahtngen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Nga kyrpad ia phi, to ngan ia lum bad lum hadien ki nongot hapdeng ki thliew: kumta ka la wan , bad ka la bteng wat naduh mynstep haduh mynta , ba ka la sah khyndiat ha iing .

en: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away : they shall take to themselves their curtains , and all their vessels , and their camels  ; and they shall cry unto them , Fear is on every side .
kha: Knieh ïa ki ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki jingri jong ki , ïa ki pyrda jong ka ïingjaiñ bad baroh kiei kiei kiba don ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . Shim ïa ki ut jong ki bad ong ïa ki briew , ‘ Ka jingma ka don baroh sawdong jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki kynhun jong ki kin shim noh: kin shim noh ïa ki jingtap jong ki, bad ki tiar jong ki baroh, bad ki kulai jong ki baroh ki dei ban pyrta ha ki;

en: Now Heber the Kenite , which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses , had severed himself from the Kenites , and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u Heber u jait Ken u pynïeng la ka dara marjan ïa ka Kedesh hajan u dieng Sning ha Saanannim . U la kynriah noh na kiwei pat ki jait Ken , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hobab , u kynum jong u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U Heber u Kensi uba long na ki khun u Hobab u kpa jong u Moses u la ot noh ia lade na ki Kensi bad u la buh ia ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka madan Zahuliim kaba don ha Kadesh .

en: And he brought me thither , and , behold , there was a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass , with a line of flax in his hand , and a measuring reed  ; and he stood in the gate .
kha: U la rah ïa nga kham sha jan , bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba phyrnai kum ka rnong . U bat ha ka kti ïa u pita uba da ka jaiñ linen bad ïa u diengthew bad u ïeng hajan ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia nga hangta, bad, ha khmih, u don uwei u briew uba ka dur jong u ka long kum ka dur jong u nar, bad u lain flax ha ka kti jong u, bad u la ieng ha ka khyrdop ; bad u la ieng ha ka khyrdop .

en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :
kha: La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khet jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew shapoh ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa ka suiñbneng kum ka pyrda , kum ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba yn shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Dei ma u uba shong halor ka pyrthei, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka ki long kum ki khlaw ; kiba pynjrong ia ki bneng kum ka jingtap , bad ki pynphriang ia ki kum ka ïingjaiñ ban shong:

en: My bowels , my bowels ! I am pained at my very heart  ; my heart maketh a noise in me  ; I cannot hold my peace , because thou hast heard , O my soul , the sound of the trumpet , the alarm of war .
kha: Ka jingpang ! Ngam lah shah ïa ka jingpang ! Ka dohnud jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyndeh jur ! Ngam lah ban sngap jar ; nga ïohsngew ïa ki turoi bad ki jingpyrta jong ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki bniat jong nga, ki bniat jong nga ! Nga sngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga hi; ka dohnud jong nga ka pynmih ia ka jingsawa ha nga; ngam lah ban bat ia ka jingsuk jong nga, namar me la iohsngew, ko mynsiem jong nga, ia ka sur jong ka turoi, ka jingsawa jong ka thma .

en: Then Ahimelech answered the king , and said , And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David , which is the king s son in law , and goeth at thy bidding , and is honourable in thine house ?
kha: U Ahimelekh u jubab ,  U Dabid u dei u rangbah pynïaidkam uba hok tam uba phi don ! U dei u pyrsa kurim jong phi , u kapten jong ki shipai kiba ïada ïa phi , bad ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da uwei pa uwei ha ka ïingsyiem jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ahimeel u la jubab ia u syiem bad u la ong: Bad mano ba iaineh hapdeng ki shakri jong me baroh kum u Dabid , uba long u khun syiem ha ka ain jong me bad uba don burom ha ka iing jong me ?

en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that heareth my word , and believeth on him that sent me , hath everlasting life , and shall not come into condemnation  ; but is passed from death unto life .
kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong nga bad uba ngeit ha uta uba la phah ïa nga u don ka jingim bymjukut . Yn ym bishar ïa u , hynrei u la lait shiliang na ka jingïap sha ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, Uta uba iohsngew ia ka ktien jong nga bad uba ngeit ha uta uba la phah ia nga, un ym wan sha ka jingpynrem ; hynrei u la iaid noh na ka jingiap sha ka jingim .

en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
kha: Ki briew ka Judah bad ki briew ka Israel kin ïasoh lang kawei sa shisien . Kin sa jied tang uwei u nongïalam na ka bynta jong ki , bad sa shisien pat kin sa manbha bad roi kyrhai ha la ka ri . Ho-oid , ka sngi jong ka Jesreel kan long ka sngi kaba khraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Judah bad ki khun Israel kin ialum lang bad kin buh ia lade kawei ka khlieh bad kin mih noh na ka ri: namar ka sngi Jesel kan long kaba khraw .

en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki shabi jong ka Hima ki bneng , kaei kaba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha bneng , bad kaei kaba me shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ïa ka ha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ai ha me ia ki shabi jong ka hima bneng: bad kaei kaei kaba me teh ha ka khyndew kan sa shah teh ha bneng: bad kaei kaei kaba me pyllait ha ka khyndew kan sa shah pyllait ha bneng .

en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty , and their houses a desolation : they shall also build houses , but not inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , but not drink the wine thereof .
kha: Ïa ka spah jong ki yn lute bad ïa ki ïing jong ki yn pynjot . Kin ym shong ha ki ïing kiba ki tei lane dih ïa ka waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba ki thung .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki mar ki mata jong ki kin kylla long ki jingjot: kin tei ruh ia ki iing , hynrei kin ym shong ha ki ; bad kin thung ia ki kper sohjew , hynrei kin ym dih ia ka wain jong ka .

en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word , and understandeth it  ; which also beareth fruit , and bringeth forth , some an hundredfold , some sixty , some thirty .
kha: Bad ki symbai kiba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor bad shemphang ïa ka : ki pynmih soh , katto katne shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba la ioh symbai ha ka khyndew kaba bha u long uta uba iohsngew ia ka ktien, bad uba sngewthuh ia ka; kaba ruh ka sei soh, bad kaba pynmih, katto katne shispah, katto katne hynriewphew .

en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you , every man child in your generations , he that is born in the house , or bought with money of any stranger , which is not of thy seed .
kha: Naduh mynta me dei ban otsher ïa u khunlung baroh haba u la dap phra sngi , kynthup ruh ïa ki mraw kiba la kha ha ki longïing longsem jong me bad ïa ki mraw kiba me la thied na ki nongwei . Kane kan pyn-i ba ka don ka jutang hapdeng jong nga bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba dang 8 sngi ka rta un shah ot hapdeng jong phi, uwei pa uwei u khun ha ki pateng jong phi, uta uba la kha ha iing ne uba la thied da ka pisa jong uno uno u nongwei u bym dei na u symbai jong me .

en: And Joseph was the governor over the land , and he it was that sold to all the people of the land : and Joseph s brethren came , and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth .
kha: U Joseph kum u lat jong ka ri Ijipt u die kew ha ki briew kiba wan na kylleng ka pyrthei . Kumta ki hynmen shynrang jong u Joseph ki la ïawan bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u , ki da pyndem la ki khmat sha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la long u Lat jong ka ri, bad u la long uba la die ha ki briew baroh: bad ki hynmen jong u Joseph ki la wan , bad ki la dem khrup ha khmat jong u da ki khmat jong ki sha ka khyndew .

en: And it came to pass , as he drew back his hand , that , behold , his brother came out : and she said , How hast thou broken forth ? this breach be upon thee : therefore his name was called Pharez .
kha: Hynrei uta u pynran noh pat ïa la ka kti , bad kumta la kha shuwa ïa u para jong u . Kata ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ,  Da kumne mo me wan mih !  Kumta la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Peres .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, katba u dang pynkhih ia la ka kti, ba, ha khmih, u hynmen jong u u la mih: bad ka la ong: Kumno me la bthei ? kane ka jingpynkhein ka long halor jong me: namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong u u Pharez .

en: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
kha: Nangta nga ong ha u Joshua , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong me u la leh ïa kito ki ar ngut ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh kumjuh ïa kita baroh ïa kiba men dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hukum ia u Joshua ha kata ka por, da kaba ong, Ki khmat jong me ki la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine ki arngut ki syiem: kumta U Trai un leh ia ki hima baroh kiba me iaid lait .

en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .
kha: Mynba nga la don lem bad ki , nga la ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga . Nga la ïada ïa ki , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la jah noh , lait tang u briew uba la dei ban jah — khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang don bad ki ha ka pyrthei , nga la buh ia ki ha ka kyrteng jong me: kita kiba me la ai ha nga nga nga la buh , bad ym don uwei ruh na ki uba la jah noh , hynrei u khun jong ka jingjot; ba ka jingthoh kan long kaba la pyndep .

en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble , and the strong men shall bow themselves , and the grinders cease because they are few , and those that look out of the windows be darkened ,
kha: Nangta ki kti jong phi , kiba la ïada ïa phi , kin khynñiuh , bad ki kjat jong phi , kiba khlaiñ mynta , kin sdang tlot . Ki bniat jong phi kin long tang khyndiat eh ban ktha ïa ka jingbam jong phi , bad ki khmat jong phi ki byr-ïe shaba palat ban ïohi shai kdar .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi ba ki nongap iing kin khih , bad ki briew kiba khlain kin dem khrup , bad ki maw ki sangeh noh namar ba ki long tang khyndiat , bad kito kiba peit shabar ki jingkhang kin dum .

en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about , and the Gammadims were in thy towers : they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about  ; they have made thy beauty perfect .
kha: Ki shipai na Arbad ki ap phira ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki rangbah na Gamad ki ap phira ïa ki mot jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh jong ki ha ki kynroh jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba pynitynnat ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Arvad bad ka kynhun shipai jong me ki la don ha ki kynroh jong me sawdong: ki la pyndait ia ki jingda jong ki ha ki kynroh jong me sawdong; ki la pynlong ia ka jingitynnad jong me kaba janai .

en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell , the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand , and hath made thee ruler over them all . Thou art this head of gold .
kha: U la pynlong ïa phi u nongsynshar ïa baroh ka pyrthei bashongbriew bad u nongsynshar ïa baroh ki mrad bad ki sim . Phi long ka khlieh kaba da ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha kaba ki khun shynrang ki shong ki sah, ki mrad bad ki sim bneng u la aiti ha ka kti jong me, bad u la pynlong ia me ban synshar halor jong ki baroh . Me long kane ka khlieh ksiar .

en: And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of speaking , that , behold , the king s sons came , and lifted up their voice and wept : and the king also and all his servants wept very sore .
kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kane , ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki wan rung ; ki la sdang ban ïam , bad u Dabid lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki la ïa-ïam kthang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, tang shu dep kren, ba, ha khmih, ki khun syiem ki la wan, bad ki la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ki bad ki la iam: bad u syiem ruh bad ki shakri jong u baroh ki iam shibun .

en: Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .
kha: Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng :  U  Trai  u la pynim ïa ki shakri jong u , ki Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: To leit noh na Babilon, to phet noh na ki Khaldi, da ka sur jingrwai phi pynbna ia kane, to iathuh ia kane, to pynpaw ia ka haduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew; to ong ia phi, U Trai u la siewspah ia u shakri jong u u Jakob .

en: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat , ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym shad ! Ngi la rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym ïam !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha iew, bad kiba ia pyrta iwei ia iwei pat, bad ki ong , Ngi la pipe ia phi , bad phim shym la shad ; ngi la iam ia phi , bad phim shym la iam .

en: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki, Ka jingainguh jong nga bad u kpu jong nga na ka bynta ki jingknia jong nga ba la shet da ka ding, namar ka jingsma kaba thiang ha nga, phin peit ia nga ha ka por ba la buh ha nga .

en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .
kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko Israel , la slem bah me la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga bad mane ïa nga . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki blei ka jingkharoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka por barim nga la pynpra ia ka lyngkhot jong me, bad nga la bthei ia ki band jong me ; bad me la ong , Ngan ym iaid lait noh haba ha u lum baroh uba jrong bad hapoh u dieng uba jyrngam me iaid kai .

en: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :
kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la shah pynbaptis , u la wan kiew noh na ka um . Nangta ïa ka bneng la plie ha u , bad u la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem jong U Blei uba wan hiar kum ka paro bad ka da wan shong halor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu, haba u la shah pynbaptis, u la kiew beit na ka um: bad, ha khmih, ki bneng ki la plie ha u, bad u la iohi ia U Mynsiem U Blei ba u hiar kum ka paro, bad u la shai halor jong u:

en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .
kha: Ki Lebi ki syang ïa ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka ding , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih , bad ki syrwa ïa ki jingainguh bakyntang ha ki khiew , ki khiew heh , ki khiew rit , bad kloi lan ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la thang ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka long katkum ka hukum: hynrei kiwei pat ki jingknia bakhuid ki la sdang ban sdang ha ki thliew bad ha ki thliew bad ha ki pan bad ki la phiah stet ia ki hapdeng ki briew baroh .

en: Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .
kha: Hynrei ma phi , ki briew jong U Blei , phin long kiba kmen bad phin rwai kumba phi leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin long kiba kmen kum kito kiba ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U  Trai  , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Phin don ka jingrwai, kumba ha ka por miet haba la buh ia ka jinglong ba khuid bad ka jingkmen jong ka dohnud, kumba u leit bad u pipe ban wan sha u lum U Trai, sha U Blei uba donbor jong ki Israel .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .
kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! Uba la pynpaw katno u sngewbha eh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel . Namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa ki Israel junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban synshar bha bad bishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong me, uba la sngewbha ha me, ban buh ia me ha ka khet Israel: namar U Trai u la ieit ia ki Israel junom: namar u la leh ia me syiem, ban leh ia ka jingbishar bad ka hok .

en: And Joab said unto the man that told him , And , behold , thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground ? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver , and a girdle .
kha: U Joab u jubab ,  Lada me la ïohi ïa u , balei men shym pynïap ïa u ha shen ? Nga da lade hi ngan jin da la ai ha me shiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad uwei u panpoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ong ha uta u briew uba la iathuh ia u, Bad, ha khmih, me la iohi ia u, bad balei phim shym la shoh ia u hangta haduh ka khyndew ? bad nga la ai ia me shiphew sekel rupa bad ka ryndang .

en: And it came to pass , when he was in a certain city , behold a man full of leprosy : who seeing Jesus fell on his face , and besought him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
kha: Shisien U Jisu u la don ha kawei ka shnong ha kaba la don u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh . Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu u la pyndem khrup ïa lade ha madan bad u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Ko kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong ïa nga uba khuid !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la don ha kawei ka shnong, ha khmih uwei u briew uba dap da ka jingpang sniehdoh: uba la iohi ia U Jisu u la dem khrup ia u, bad u la kyrpad ia u, u da ong: Ko Trai, lada me mon, me lah ban pynkhuid ia nga .

en: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki synran jong u :  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un sa shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sdang ban hikai ia ki , ba u Khun u briew u dei ban shah shitom shibun kiei kiei bad shah kyntait na ki rangbah bad na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh bad shah pyniap , bad hadien lai sngi u la mih biang .

en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , Great and marvellous are thy works , Lord God Almighty  ; just and true are thy ways , thou King of saints .
kha: bad ki da rwai ïa ka jingrwai u Moses , u shakri jong U Blei , bad ïa ka jingrwai U Khunlangbrot :  U Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh , katno kiba khraw bad kiba phylla long ki kam jong me ! U Syiem jong ki jaitbynriew , katno kiba dei bad kiba shisha ki long lynti jong me !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki rwai ia ka jingrwai jong u Moses u shakri U Blei, bad ka jingrwai jong u Khunlangbrot, ki ong: Ki kam jong me kiba khraw bad kiba phylla, ko Trai Blei Baroh ki long kiba hok bad kiba shisha, ko Syiem jong ki riewkhuid .

en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the  Lord  on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .
