kha: U Dabid bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïashad kmen bad ïarwai shitrhem da ka bor baroh ban burom ïa U  Trai . Ki da tem ïa ki duitara , ki jingtem ksai , ki ksing , ki kanjari , bad ki shakuriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid bad ka iing Israel baroh kawei ki la ialehkai ha khmat U Trai ha ki tiar kiba la shna da ki dieng kiba la shna da ki dieng , wat ha ki harp bad ha ki jingbam ba la shna da ki dieng bad ha ki dieng bad ha ki dieng .

en: Which had the golden censer , and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold , wherein was the golden pot that had manna , and Aaron s rod that budded , and the tables of the covenant  ;
kha: Ha ka la buh ïa ka duwan ksiar na ka bynta ban thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ïa kaba la sop ksiar bad la don u khiew ksiar lem bad ka manna ha u , u diengduh jong u Aaron uba la mih sla , bad ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba don ka umphniang ksiar, bad ka synduk ka jutang ka la tap sawdong da ka ksiar, ha kaba ka don ka umphniang ksiar kaba don ka manna, bad u Aaron u la sdang ban khih, bad ki miej jong ka jutang;

en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .
kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jied ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me , ki Lebi , napdeng ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ha khmih, nga la shim ia ki hynmen jong phi na ki khun Israel: ha phi la ai ia ki kum ka jingai sngewbha na ka bynta U Trai , ban leh ia ka jingshakri jong ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng .

en: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus , and great among the Jews , and accepted of the multitude of his brethren , seeking the wealth of his people , and speaking peace to all his seed .
kha: U Mordekai , u Jiw , u la long uba ar ha ka kyrdan tang ïa u syiem Serksis hi . Ïa u la burom bad sngewtynnat da ki para Jiw baroh . U la trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jingmiat ki briew jong u bad ka jingbit jingbiang jong baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Mordecai u Jiw u la long hadien u syiem Ahasaerus, bad u la pdiang ia ka jingbun ki hynmen jong u, u wad ia ka spah jong ki briew jong u, bad u kren ia ka jingsuk bad u symbai jong u baroh .

en: And it came to pass in those days , when there was no king in Israel , that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim , who took to him a concubine out of Beth–lehem–judah .
kha: Ha kita ki sngi , ha shuwa ba ki Israel kin don syiem , la don uwei u Lebi uba shong sha jngai bah ha ka ri lum Ephraim . U shim ïa kawei ka kynthei na Bethlehem ha Judah ban long ka tnga kliar jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kito ki sngi, haba ym don syiem ha Israel, ba don uwei u Lebi uba leit sha ka liang jong u lum Ephraim, uba la shim ia u da ka kynthei na Bethlehemda .

en: Notwithstanding the  Lord  turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath , wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah , because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal .
kha: Hynrei ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  la pynkhih pyrshah ïa ka Judah da kaei kaba u syiem Manasseh u la leh , bad wat mynta ruh kam shym la duh noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la U Trai um shym la phai na ka jingbitar kaba khraw jong u, ha kaba ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei pyrshah ia u Judah, namar ki jingpynkhih baroh kiba u Manasseh u la pynkhih ia u da ka jingbitar .

en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes ,  Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me ? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple , and ye laid no hold on me .
kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kren ha u paidbah ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ? Man la ka sngi nga la shong bad hikai hapoh ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata kajuh ka kynta u Jisu u la ong ha ki paidbah: Hato phi mih kum u nongtuh da ki wait bad ki dieng na ka bynta ban kem ia nga ? Nga la shong man ka sngi bad phi da kaba hikai ha ka tempi , bad phim shym la bat ia nga .

en: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel : he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy , and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire , which devoureth round about .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki long ki mraw ki bym lah leh ei ei , kiba la shah pynmih da ka bor na la ka ïing . Ki la shong la sah ha kiwei pat ki ri , khlem kano kano ka jaka ban khot ka jong ki hi — La kerkut da ki nongshun , khlem kano kano ka lad ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ot noh ha ka jingbitar kaba jur jong u Israel: u la tan biang ia ka kti kadiang jong u na khmat u nongshun , bad u la thang ia u Jakob kum ka ding kaba rhem sawdong .

en: Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?
kha: Khie leit bad khmih ïa ka nongbah Kalneh . Nangta ïai leit sha ka nongbah bakhraw ka Hamath bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judah bad Israel ? Hato ka ri jong ki ka kham heh ban ïa ka jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Pass ia phi sha Kalneh , bad phi iohi ia u Hamath uba khraw: nangta to hiar sha Gath jong ki Philistia: hato ki kham bha ban ia kine ki hima ? lane u pud jong ki uba kham heh ban ia u pud jong phi ?

en: And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .
kha: U la buh ïa ki rangbah kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh ka bynta ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh ia ki briew baroh, uwei pa uwei u don ia ka tiar jong u ha ka kti jong u, naduh ka liang kadiang jong ka tempi haduh ka liang kadiang jong ka tempi, ryngkat bad ka jaka bam bad ka tempi sawdong .

en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .
kha: Shisyndon ïa ki khuri ksiar bad rupa la wallam shapoh , bad ma ki baroh ki la ïadih waiñ na ki
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la wanrah ia ki khiew ksiar kiba la shim na ka iing U Blei kaba don ha Jerusalem ; bad u syiem bad ki rangbah jong u, ki tnga jong u bad ki tnga jong u, ki la dih ha ki .

en: And all the country wept with a loud voice , and all the people passed over : the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron , and all the people passed over , toward the way of the wilderness .
kha: Ki briew ki la kyang jam katba ki nongbud jong u Dabid ki la mihnoh . U syiem u la jam ïa ka wahduid Kidron , ki rangbah jong u ki la bud nadien , bad ryngkat ki la ïaleit lang sha ka phang ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri baroh kawei ka iam da ka sur kaba jam: u syiem ruh u la iaid lyngba ia ka wah Kidron , bad ki briew baroh ki la iaid lyngba , sha ka lynti jong ka ri khlaw .

en: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank , which is upon the hollow of the thigh , unto this day : because he touched the hollow of Jacob s thigh in the sinew that shrank .
kha: Wat haduh mynta mynne , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Israel kim ju bam ïa ka dohksah kaba halor ka shyieng skhep , namar dei ha kata ka dohksah ba u Jakob u la shah kura .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki khun Israel kim ju bam ia ka sniehdoh kaba la tyrkhong, kaba don ha ka tyrpeng jong u Jakob haduh kane ka sngi: namar u la ktah ia ka tyrpeng jong u Jakob ha ka tyrpeng kaba la tyrkhong .

en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .
kha: La ong ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa u briew  u nongsynshar halor kiei kiei baroh ;  kane ka paw shai ba ka kynthup ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban , ngim pat ïohi ba u briew un synshar halor kiei kiei baroh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh ki kjat jong u . Namar ha kata u la buh ia kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u . Hynrei mynta ngim pat iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba la buh hapoh jong u .

en: But he that is an hireling , and not the shepherd , whose own the sheep are not , seeth the wolf coming , and leaveth the sheep , and fleeth : and the wolf catcheth them , and scattereth the sheep .
kha: Haba u nongbylla sngi , u bym dei u nongaplangbrot bad u bym dei trai ïa ki langbrot , u ïohi ïa u suri ba u wan , u iehnoh ïa ki langbrot bad u phet noh ; kumta u suri u kynrup ïa ki langbrot bad pynsaphred ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta u nongtrei kam, bad u nongaplangbrot, u bym don ki langbrot jong u, u iohi ia u blang uba wan, bad u iehnoh ia ki langbrot: bad u blang u kem ia ki, bad u pynphriang ia ki langbrot .

en: And Moses called unto all Israel , and said unto them , Ye have seen all that the  Lord  did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh , and unto all his servants , and unto all his land  ;
kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi la ïohi da lade hi aïu U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la khot ia ki Israel baroh bad u la ong ha ki, Phi la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la leh ha khmat jong phi ha ka ri Ijipt ha u Pharaoh bad ha ki shakri jong u baroh .

en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life , save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .
kha: U  Trai  u leh ïa kane namar ba u Dabid u la leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad um ju lyndet ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong u , lait noh tang ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad u Uriah u nong Hit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u Dabid u la leh ia kaba dei ha khmat U Trai , bad um shym la phai noh na kaei kaei kaba u la hukum ia u baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u , lait noh tang ha ka kam jong u Urih u Hit .

en: Now when Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan , the son of Saul , was come unto David , he fell on his face , and did reverence . And David said , Mephibosheth . And he answered , Behold thy servant !
kha: Haba u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul , u wan poi , u la dem ngon ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom . U Dabid u ong ,  Mephibosheth !  bad u jubab ,  Nga hangne , ko Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba u Mephibosheth u khun u Jonathan u khun u Saul u la wan sha u Dabid, u la dem khrup bad u la leh ia ka jingburom . U Dabid u la ong, Mephibosheth . Bad u la jubab: Ha khmih u shakri jong me !

en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .
kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Katba ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam pher .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel u la ong ha u Jehoshaphat, Ngan pynkylla dur ia lade, bad ngan rung sha ka thma ; hynrei me phong ia ki jainkup jong me . U syiem Israel u la pynkylla dur ia lade bad u la leit sha ka thma .

en: Whose leaves were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all  ; under which the beasts of the field dwelt , and upon whose branches the fowls of the heaven had their habitation :
kha: Ki sla jong u ki la long kiba itynnat , bad u la don kyrhai ki soh ha u ban bsa ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Ki mradkhlaw ki la pynjahthait hapoh jong u , bad ki sim ki la thaw ïa ki skum jong ki ha ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sla jong u ki long kiba itynnad bad ki soh jong ka ki long kiba bun, bad ha ka la don ka doh na ka bynta baroh kiba ki mrad lyngkha ki shong, bad ha ki tnat jong ki ki sim bneng ki don ka jaka shong jaka sah jong ki:

en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .
kha: Bad mynta kaba ap ïa nga ka long ka bainong jong ka jingjop ïa kaba la buh beit da U Blei uba U Trai , u nongbishar bahok , u ban ai ha nga ha kata ka Sngi — ym tang ïa nga , hynrei ïa kito baroh kiba ap ïa u da ka jingieit ba un wanpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta la buh ia nga ia ka khlieh jong ka hok, kaba U Trai, u nongbishar uba hok, un ai ha nga ha kata ka sngi: bad ym tang ha nga , hynrei ha kita baroh ruh kiba ieit ia ka jingmih jong u .

en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works , which were done in you , had been done in Tyre and Sidon , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .
kha: Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha , ko Khorasin ! Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah kiba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad Sidon , la kham slem ki briew hangta kin jin da la phong da ka jaiñ khain bad synreit da u dpei halor lade , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi, ko Khristan ! to phi, ko Bethsaida ! namar lada la leh ia ki kam kiba khraw ha phi, la leh ha Tyros bad ha Sidon, kin jin da la kylla bamut mynshuwa ha ka jain bad ka dewbilat .

en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .
kha: Ho-oid  u jubab .  Nga la wan ban ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Pynkhuid ïa lade , bad wan bad nga .  U ong ruh ïa u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkhuid ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Da kaba suk: Nga wan ban knia ia lade ha U Trai: pynkhuid ia lade bad wan ryngkat bad nga sha ka jingknia . Bad u la pynkyntang ia u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .
kha: U syiem Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalumlang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki kñia ainguh da bun bah ki langbrot bad ki masi — bun katta katta bym lah ñiew shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon bad ka kynhun Israel baroh kaba la ialum lang bad u, ki la don ryngkat bad u ha khmat ka synduk , ki da knia langbrot bad ki masi , kiba ym lah ban iathuh ne khein ia ka jingbun briew .

en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen : and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen , which he placed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .
kha: U la thaw ka kynhun ïaleh kaba don shihajar sawspah tylli ki kali ïapom bad khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki shipai shnong kulai . Katto katne na ki u la buh ha Jerusalem , bad ïa kiba sah u la buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la lum ia ki kali kit kulai bad ki kulai: bad u don shi hajar san spah tylli ki kali kit kulai bad shiphew hajar tylli ki kulai kiba u la buh ha ki shnong kit kulai bad bad u syiem ha Jerusalem .

en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet s reward  ; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man s reward .
kha: Uno uno uba pdiang ïa u nonglamktien jong U Blei namar ba u long u nonglamktien jong U Blei , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jong u . Bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa u briew uba bha namar ba u long uba bha , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba pdiang ia u nongiathuhlypa ha ka kyrteng jong u nongiathuhlypa un pdiang ia ka bainong nongiathuhlypa bad uta uba pdiang ia u briew uba hok ha ka kyrteng jong u briew uba hok un pdiang ia ka bainong uba hok .

en: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side , and the space was one cubit on that side : and the little chambers were six cubits on this side , and six cubits on that side .
kha: Ha khmat jong kawei pa kawei ka kamra ap phira la don kawei ka kynroh kaba tbian , sanphew sentimitar ka kynjang bad sanphew sentimitar ka jingrben . ( Kine ki kamra ki la long lai mitar sawdong . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jaka ruh ha khmat ki kamra rit ka long kawei ka cuit ha kane ka liang: bad ki kamra rit ki long hynriew cuit ha kane ka liang .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki wah , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pung-um , bad pynmih ïa ki jakoid ba kin pyndap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses, To ong ha u Aaron, To pynkhih ia ka kti jong me halor ki wah, halor ki wah bad halor ki pung bad pynlong ia ki khnai ban wan shaneng ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?
kha: U la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki shahjingit bad ïambriew ha u bnai basan bad bahynñiew ha kine ki hynñiewphew snem , kam shym dei ha ka jingñiewburom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki briew baroh jong ka ri bad ha ki lyngdoh da kaba ong: Haba phi la shah jingit bad sngewsih ha ka taiew kaba phra bad kaba hynriew , wat ia kita ki hynriewphew snem , hato phi la shah jingit ha nga , wat ha nga ruh ?

en: My God hath sent his angel , and hath shut the lions  mouths , that they have not hurt me : forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me  ; and also before thee , O king , have I done no hurt .
kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing khnang ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga . U la leh ïa kane namar u tip ba nga la long uba lui lui bad namar ba ngam shym la leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong nga u la phah ia u angel jong u, bad u la khang ia ki shyntur jong ki sing, ba kim shym la pynmong ia nga: namar ha khmat jong u la lap ia ka jingbym don pop ha nga ; bad ruh ha khmat jong me ko syiem, ngam shym la leh ei ei .

en: And answered them after the advice of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , but I will add thereto : my father chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
kha: kumba ki samla ki la ai jingmut . U ong ,  I pa jong nga i la buh ki jingkit kiba khia , nga ngan pynlong ïa ki , kiba kham khia shuh shuh . I la sympat ïa phi da u shabuk , nga ngan sympat ïa phi ïa u shabuk kulai !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la jubab ia ki hadien ka jingai jingmut jong ki samla, u da ong, U kpa jong nga u la pynlong ia ka jingkit jong phi kaba khia, hynrei ngan pyndap ia phi: u kpa jong nga u la pynshitom ia phi da ki khnam , hynrei ngan pynshitom ia phi da ki khnai .

en: So will I stretch out my hand upon them , and make the land desolate , yea , more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath , in all their habitations : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ho-oid ngan kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pynjot ïa ka ri jong ki . Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka shrah naduh ka ri shyiap bashathie shaduh ka nongbah Riblah kaba na shatei , khlem da map ïa kano kano ruh ka jaka bashong ki Israel . Te baroh kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong ki, bad ngan pynlong ia ka ri kaba kham jot ban ia ka ri khlaw sha ka ri khlaw baroh: bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: For nation shall rise against nation , and kingdom against kingdom : and there shall be earthquakes in divers places , and there shall be famines and troubles : these are the beginnings of sorrows .
kha: Ki ri kin ïaleh para ma ki ; ki hima kin tur ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat . Ki jumai kin khynñiuh ha kylleng , bad kin don ki  nemsniew . Kine kiei kiei ki long kum ki jingpang suh kha banyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew kan kiew pyrshah ia ka jaitbynriew, bad ka hima pyrshah ia ka hima: bad kin don ki jingkhynñiuh jumai ha ki jaka ba jylliew , bad kin don ki jingkyrduh bad ki jingeh: kine ki long ki jingsdang jong ki jingsngewsih .

en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :
kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u kylla duk bad u die mraw noh ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u nongwei ne u nongwei u riewspah da me, bad u hynmen jong me uba sah ha u u duk, bad u die ia lade ha u nongwei ne u nongwei da me, ne ha ka stock jong ka iing jong u nongwei:

en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah synshar ki Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh ba kin da lah thoh sha u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka khmat U Blei jong ki ka la long halor ki rangbah jong ki Jiw, ba kim lah ban pynlong ia ki ban sangeh noh, haduh ba ka kam ka la poi ha Darius: bad nangta ki la wan phai da ka shithi shaphang kane ka kam .

en: Ye men of Israel , hear these words  ; Jesus of Nazareth , a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs , which God did by him in the midst of you , as ye yourselves also know :
kha: A to shahshkor ïa kine ki kyntien , ko para nong Israel ! U Jisu uba na Nasareth u la long u briew uba ïa ka bor ba kynja blei jong u la pynshisha da kaba shai ha phi da ki kambah bad kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong u . Phi hi phi tip ïa kane , naba ka la jia hangne hapdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi ki briew jong ka Israel , to iohsngew ia kine ki ktien ; U Jisu na Nazareth , u briew uba la mynjur da U Blei hapdeng jong phi da ki kambah bad ki jingphylla bad ki dak kiba U Blei u la leh da u hapdeng jong phi , kumba phi ruh phi tip:

en: And he said ,  Lord  God of Israel , there is no God like thee , in heaven above , or on earth beneath , who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :
kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , ym don U Blei uba kum ma me ha bneng shajrong ne ha khyndew shapoh ! Me bat ïa ka jutang bad me pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha la ki jong ki briew kiba kohnguh ïa me naduh ka mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , ym don Blei kum ma me, ha bneng shaneng ne ha khyndew hapoh khyndew, uba bat ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei bad ki shakri jong me kiba iaid ha khmat jong me da ka dohnud jong ki baroh:

en: Behold , I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain , to be an inheritance for your tribes , from Jordan , with all the nations that I have cut off , even unto the great sea westward .
kha: Nga la ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki jait jong phi ïa ka ri jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah , lem bad ka jong kito ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la dep jop , naduh ka wah Jordan ha ka phang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian ha ka phang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la phiah ha phi da ka lot ia kine ki jaitbynriew kiba sah, ban long ka pateng na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew jong phi, na Jordan, bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba nga la ot noh, wat haduh ka duriaw bah shaphang shathie .

en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,
kha: Nangta u khun shaphang shatei sha Enshemesh bad nangta pat sha Geliloth , marpyrshah ïa ka khim Adummim . Nangta u hiar arsut sha u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translated_en_to_kha: La ring ia u na shaphang shathie bad u la leit sha Enshesh bad u la leit sha Gliloth kaba don shaphang ka jingleit sha jrong jong u Adummim bad u la hiar sha u maw u Bhon u khun u Reuben .

en: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him : for the  Lord  thy God hardened his spirit , and made his heart obstinate , that he might deliver him into thy hand , as appeareth this day .
kha: Hynrei u syiem Sihon um shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka ri jong u . Naba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyneh ïa ka mynsiem jong u bad u la pynlong mutlop ïa u , khnang ba ngin ïoh jop bad shim ïa ri jong u ïa kaba ngi dang bat haduh mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem Hesbon un ym shah ia ngi ban iaid lyngba jong u: namar U Trai U Blei jong me u la pynkhlain ia ka mynsiem jong u, bad u la pynlong ia ka dohnud jong u ban sngur, ba un aiti ia u ha ka kti jong me, kumba ka paw ha kane ka sngi .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah , which reigned instead of Josiah his father , which went forth out of this place  ; He shall not return thither any more :
kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang u Joahas , u khun jong u Josaïah , uba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u kum u syiem ka Judah ,  U la leit noh nangne , un ym wan phai shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai u ktah ia u Sallum u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah, uba la synshar ha ka jaka jong u Josiah u kpa jong u, uba la leit noh na kane ka jaka ; Un ym wan phai shuh:

en: Then the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Jephthah , and he passed over Gilead , and Manasseh , and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead , and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon .
kha: Te U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u wan ha u Jephthah . U ïaid lyngba ïa ka Gilead bad ka Manasseh bad u wan phai sha Mispah ha Gilead , bad nangta u leit sha Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Mynsiem U Trai u la wan ha u Jephiah bad u la iaid lait ia ka Gilead bad u Manasseh bad u la iaid lait ia ka Mizpah jong ka Gilead bad na Mizpah jong ka Gilead u la iaid lait sha ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Ammon .

en: They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
kha: ki rangbah bashlur tam ki leit bad shim ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad jong ki khun jong u , bad ki wanrah ïa ki sha Jabesh . Ki tep ïa ki hangta hapoh u dieng Sning , bad ki shahjingit hynñiew sngi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng, baroh ki briew kiba shlur, bad ki la shim noh ia ka met u Saul bad ki met jong ki khun shynrang jong u, bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha Jabesh bad ki la tep ia ki shyieng jong ki hapoh u oak ha Jabesh bad ki la shah jingstet hynriew sngi .

en: In that day the  Lord  with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent , even leviathan that crooked serpent  ; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam badonbor bad bashyrkhei jong u ban pynshitom ïa u Lebiathan , uta u Ïakjakor uba khih bad uba khyrwait , bad ban pynïap ïa uta u mrad kynsha uba im ha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai da ka waitlam kaba jur bad kaba khlain bad kaba khlain jong u un pynshitom ia u bsein uba la tyrkhong; bad un pyniap ia u bsein uba don ha duriaw .

en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about , so that in the day of the  Lord s  anger none escaped nor remained : those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed .
kha: To pynrem ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki baroh ; to pynshitom ïa ki kumba me la pynshitom ïa nga na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Nga ud ha ka jingjynjar , bad nga pang ha ka dohnud jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la khot kumba ha ka sngi kaba sngewsih ia ki jingtieng jong nga sawdong, haduh ba ha ka sngi jong ka jingbitar U Trai ym don ba lait ne sah: kito kiba nga la sngap jar bad pynsan ia ki nongshun jong nga ki la bam .

en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .
kha: u la phah shata katto katne ngut ki rangbah lem bad kane ka khubor :  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi namar ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jingieit ïa la u syiem da kaba tep ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la phah ia ki briew jong u Jabeshgilead bad u la ong ha ki, To long kiba la kyrkhu na U Trai, ba phi la pyni ia kane ka jingbha ha u kynrad jong phi, wat ha u Sool ruh, bad phi la tep ia u .

en: Thank you for taking the time to examine this brochure in order to familiarize yourself with Jehovah’s Witnesses as a people , to learn about our activities , and to see our organization in action .
kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la ai por ban peit bniah ïa kane ka kot lyngkdop khnang ban tip shaphang ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , ïa ki kam jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingtreikam ka seng jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Khublei shibun ba phi la shim por ban bishar bniah ia kane ka kot lyngkdop khnang ban ithuh ia lade bad ki Nongsakhi jong ka Jehobah ].

en: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .
kha: U Nadab bad u Abihu , ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron , ki shim ïa la ki khiew thang jingiwbih , ki buh rnga ding ha ki , ki thang ïa ka jingiwbih hangta , bad ki kñia ainguh ïa ka ha U  Trai . Hynrei kane ka ding ka long ka bymkhuid , namar U  Trai  um shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nadab bad u Abihu, ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron, ki la shim ia ka ding jong u, bad ki la thang ia ka ding ha ka ding bad ki la buh ia ka jingiwbih ha ka ding .

en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom , and burnt his children in the fire , after the abominations of the heathen whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
kha: u thang jingiwbih ha ka Them Hinnom , bad u kñia wat ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang kum ki jingainguh thang ïa ki bleithaw , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ba-ijli jong ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki nang tur shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ka them u khun u Hinnom , bad u la thang ia ki khun jong u ha ka ding , hadien ki jingleh bymman jong ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la bret noh ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines , and brake down the wall of Gath , and the wall of Jabneh , and the wall of Ashdod , and built cities about Ashdod , and among the Philistines .
kha: U Ussaïah u leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia . U pyntwa ïa ki kynroh jong ki nongbah jong ka Gath , ka Jamnia , bad ka Ashdod ; bad u tei ïa ki shnong ba la ker kynroh hajan ka Ashdod bad ha ki jaka basah jong ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha khmat bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Philistia, bad u la pynpra ia ka kynroh jong ka Gath, bad ka kynroh jong u Jabneh bad ka kynroh jong u Ashdod bad u la tei ia ki nongbah sawdong ka Ashdod bad hapdeng ki Philistia .

en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , and used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
kha: Ki kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kum ki jingainguh thang sha ki blei thala ; ki wad jingmut na ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongpeit kti , bad ki aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei kaba bakla ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kumta ki pynkhih bitar ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki ban iaid lyngba ka ding , bad ki la pyndonkam ia ka jingleh jadu bad ki jingleh jadu , bad ki la die ia lade ban leh ia kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai , ban pynkhih ia u ban bitar .

en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon , saying , The  Lord  make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab , whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire  ;
kha: Haba ki briew kiba la shah rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia ki kwah ban wallam ka jingtim hano hano , kin ong , ‘ To U  Trai  un ñiew ïa phi kum u Sedekaïah bad u Ahab , kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u la syang im !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki yn shim ia ka jingtim da ka jingshah set jong u Judah baroh kaba don ha Babilon , da kaba ong: U Trai u pynlong ia me kum u Sedekaiah bad kum u Ahab , ia uba u syiem Babilon u la thang ha ka ding;

en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
kha: Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan hiar na bneng . Lada uno uno u bam ïa une u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka doh jong nga , ïa kaba nga ai khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ïoh im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan hiar na bneng: lada uno uno u bam ia une u kpu , un im junom: bad u kpu uba ngan ai u long ka doh jong nga , uba ngan ai na ka bynta ka jingim jong ka pyrthei .

en: And the people that were encamped heard say , Zimri hath conspired , and hath also slain the king : wherefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the host , king over Israel that day in the camp .
kha: bad haba ki ïohsngew ba u Simri u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u , hangta hi ki baroh ki pynbna ba u nongai hukum jong ki , u Omri , u long u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew kiba la shah set ki la iohsngew ba ki la thmu ban leh kumta: bad u la pyniap ruh ia u syiem: namar kata ki Israel baroh ki la pynlong ia u Omri, u rangbah shipai, u syiem halor ki Israel ha kata ka sngi ha ka jaka shong jaka sah .

en: And if the family of Egypt go not up , and come not , that have no rain  ; there shall be the plague , wherewith the  Lord  will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
kha: Lada ki nong Ijipt ki kyntait ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep , te yn sa shoh ïa ki da kajuh ka jingpang kaba U  Trai  un phah ha ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba kyntait ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka longiing Ijipt kam kiew shaneng, bad kam wan, kata ka bym don slap kan don ka khlam, ha kaba U Trai un shoh ia ki nongwei ki bym wan shaneng ban bat ia ka jingkhawai jong ki ïingjaiñ .

en: They shall be holy unto their God , and not profane the name of their God : for the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and the bread of their God , they do offer : therefore they shall be holy .
kha: U dei ban long uba khuid bad um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; u kñia ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga , bad kumta u dei ban long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin long kiba khuid ha U Blei jong ki , bad kin ym pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng U Blei jong ki: namar ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding , bad u kpu U Blei jong ki: namarkata kin long kiba khuid .

en: But thou shalt utterly destroy them  ; namely , the Hittites , and the Amorites , the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee :
kha: Pynduh khoit ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh : ïa ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me dei ban pynjot lut ia ki ; kata ki Hit bad ki Amorites, ki Kanaan bad ki Perizite , ki Hivite bad ki Hebus ; kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me:

en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban siew ar shah na ka bynta ki pop bad ka jingbymman jong ki , namar ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri jong nga da ki bleithaw ki bym don jingim kum ki metïap , bad ki la pyndap ïa ka da ki blei thala jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nyngkong ngan siew kylliang ia ka jingbymhok jong ki bad ka pop jong ki ; namar ki la pynjakhlia ia ka ri jong nga , ki la pyndap ia ka pateng jong nga da ki met iap jong ki kiba sngewsih bad kiba sngewsih .

en: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon , and the king s mother , and the king s wives , and his officers , and the mighty of the land , those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la ringmraw ïa u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon , lem bad ka kmie jong u Jehoïakhin , ki tnga jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U la rah noh ia u Jehoichin sha Babilon bad ka kmie jong u syiem bad ki tnga jong u bad ki rangbah jong u bad ki riewshlur jong ka ri .

en: And he said unto them ,  Where is your faith ?  And they being afraid wondered , saying one to another , What manner of man is this ! for he commandeth even the winds and water , and they obey him .
kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Hangno ka jingngeit jong phi ?  Hynrei ki la sngewlyngngoh bad sheptieng , bad ki la ong uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Une u briew uba kumno ? U ai hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phyllung , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, Hangno ka jingngeit jong phi ? Bad ki la tieng, ki la ia lyngngoh iwei ia iwei pat, "U long u briew uba kumno ! namar u hukum wat ia ki Iyer bad ka um ruh bad ki kohnguh ia u .

en: The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ?  And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?
kha: Nangno ka hok jong u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan : hato ka long na U Blei ne na u briew ?  Ki la sdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Aïu ngin ïa-ong ? Lada ngi jubab ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , phim ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynbaptis u loannis naei ka long ? na bneng ne na ki briew ? Bad ki la ia pyrkhat bad ki briew ki da ong: Lada ngin ong: Na bneng; un ong ha ngi: Balei phim ngeit ia u ?

en: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people  ; and therein was found written , that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever  ;
kha: Katba dang pule jam ïa ka Hukum u Moses ha u paidbah , ki poi ha ka bynta kaba ong ba ym dei ban shah ïa u nong Amon ne u nong Moab ban ïasnohlang bad ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ha ki nongsngap jong ki briew ; bad la lap hangta ba la thoh , ba u Ammon bad u Moab kim dei ban wan sha ka jingiaseng U Blei junom ; .

en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .
kha: Uno uno uba sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew , bad uno uno uba jaboh u dei ban ïai jaboh ; uno uno uba bha u dei ban ïai lehbha , bad uno uno uba khuid u dei ban ïailong khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba khlem hok , to ai ba un long uba khlem hok: bad uta uba jakhlia, to ai ba un long uba jakhlia: bad uta uba hok, to ai ba un long uba hok: bad uta uba khuid, to ai ba un long uba khuid .

en: And when he was come into his house , he took a knife , and laid hold on his concubine , and divided her , together with her bones , into twelve pieces , and sent her into all the coasts of Israel .
kha: Ynda u la poi , u rung shapoh ïing bad u shim kawei ka tari . U shim ïa ka met ka tnga kliar jong u , u ot ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot , bad u phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei na ki khat-ar jait ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan rung ha iing jong u, u la shim ia ka wait bad u la bat ia ka tnga jong u, bad u la phiah ia ka ryngkat bad ki shyieng jong ka, ha ki shiphew tylli ki bynta jong ka, bad u la phah ia ka sha ki pud jong ki Israel baroh .

en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .
kha: Kum ki dieng , ki briew jong nga kin im slem . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen pura ha kiei kiei kiba ki la trei shitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin ym tei, bad uwei pat u briew un ym thung, bad uwei pat un ym bam: namar kumba ki sngi jong u dieng ki long ki sngi jong ki briew jong nga, bad ki jong nga ki long kiba la jied kin sngewbha shibun ia ka kam jong ki kti jong ki .

en: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine , and knew not whence it was : ( but the servants which drew the water knew  ; ) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom ,
kha: Ki la leit rah ïa ka um , kaba mynta ka la kylla waiñ , bad u la mad ïa ka . Um shym tip nangno la wanrah ïa kane ka waiñ ( hynrei , da shisha , ki shakri kiba la tong ïa ka um ki la tip ïa kata ) ;
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u nongsynshar jong ka jingkhawai u la mad ia ka um kaba la shna wain , bad um tip naei ka don: (hynrei ki shakri kiba la tan ia ka um ki tip; ) u Lat ka jingkhawai u la khot ia u nongleit kurim , .

en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , then fled they also before Abishai , and entered into the city . So Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .
kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki la her ïap , ki ruh ki la phet krad na u Abishai bad ki leit rung noh shapoh ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u wan phai noh na ka jingïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad u leit noh sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Ammon ki la iohi ba ki Syria ki la phet noh, nangta ki ruh ki la phet noh ha khmat u Abisai bad ki la rung shapoh ka shnong . Kumta u Joab u la wan phai na ki khun Ammon bad u la wan sha Jerusalem .

en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .
kha: Haba ka khubor ka la poi ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Joab u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u Joab ban kylli ïa u balei ba u la phet sha ka duwan . U Joab u jubab ba u la phet krad sha U  Trai  namar ba u la sheptieng ïa u Solomon . Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ban pynïap ïa u Joab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u syiem Solomon ba u Joab u la phet noh sha ka iing jong U Trai bad, ha khmih, u don hajan ka almari . Nangta u Solomon u la phah ia u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada, u da ong: Leit, to hap halor jong u .

en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver , and built on the hill , and called the name of the city which he built , after the name of Shemer , owner of the hill , Samaria .
kha: bad nangta u thied ïa u lum ka Samaria da hynriew hajar ki sbai rupa na u briew uba kyrteng u Shemer . U Omri u la tei ka kut ïa u lum , u tei ka shnong hangta , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Samaria , da kaba pynbud ïa ka kyrteng u Shemer , u trai ba-mynshuwa jong uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U la thied ia u lum Samaria jong u Shemer ar talent ka rupa, bad u la tei ha u lum, bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka shnong kaba u la tei, hadien ka kyrteng jong u Shemer, trai u lum, u Sameria .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Cast it unto the potter : a goodly price that I was prised at of them . And I took the thirty pieces of silver , and cast them to the potter in the house of the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .  Kumta nga la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa — ka jingkheiñ kaba khraw kaba ki la pyrkhat ba nga la shongdor — bad buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga, To bret ia ka ha ka umphniang: ka dor kaba bha kaba nga la shah set ha ki . Bad nga la shim ia ki laiphew tylli ki rupa bad nga la bret ia ki ha ka umphniang ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .
kha: U Moses u wan ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa ki hukum baroh bad ïa ki aiñ baroh jong U  Trai  , bad ki briew baroh ki ïajubab lang ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u ong , ngin leh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la wan bad u la iathuh ha ki briew ia ki ktien U Trai baroh: bad ki briew baroh ki la jubab da kawei ka sur bad ki la ong: Baroh ki ktien kiba U Trai u la ong ngin leh .

en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :
kha: Hynrei lada ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jong me phi phai dien noh na nga , bad phim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi phai noh na kaba bud ia nga, ma phi ne ki khun jong phi, bad phin ym sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad ki ain jong nga kiba nga la buh ha khmat jong phi, hynrei to leit shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei bad to mane ia ki:

en: Moreover all the chief of the priests , and the people , transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen  ; and polluted the house of the  Lord  which he had hallowed in Jerusalem .
kha: Nalor kane , ki nongïalam ka Judah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew ki bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ki ha kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ , ïa kaba U  Trai  da lade hi u la pynlong kaba kyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata baroh ki rangbah jong ki lyngdoh bad ki briew ki la iaid lait noh shibun hadien ki jingleh bymman baroh .

en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me , neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions  ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ban da ïa ki Israel na kaba klet noh ïa nga bad pynjakhlia ïa lade da ki pop jong ki . Ki dei ban long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka iing Israel kan ym iaid shuh na nga, lymne ban shah pynjakhlia shuh da ki jingpynkhein jong ki baroh; hynrei ba kin long ki briew jong nga, bad nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s house , thou shalt not covet thy neighbour s wife , nor his manservant , nor his maidservant , nor his ox , nor his ass , nor any thing that is thy neighbour s .
kha: Wat kwah rhah ïa ka ïing u paramarjan jong phi ; wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong u , lane ïa ki mraw jong u , lane ïa ki masi jong u , lane ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei ruh kaba dei ka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat kwah ia ka iing jong u paramarjan jong phi, wat kwah ia ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong phi, ne ia u nongshong shnong jong u, ne ia u nongshong shnong jong u, ne ia u masi jong u, ne ia kaei kaei kaba long u paramarjan jong phi.

en: And if thy right eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .
kha: Kumta lada ka khmat kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , khlaw noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh noh shi bynta na ka met jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei yn shah bret sha ka dujok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka khmat kadiang jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, to ot noh ia ka, bad bret noh ia ka na me: namar ka long kaba myntoi ia me ba uwei na ki dkhot jong me un jah noh, bad ym ba ka met jong me baroh kawei kan shah bret noh sha dujok .

en: Behold , here is my daughter a maiden , and his concubine  ; them I will bring out now , and humble ye them , and do with them what seemeth good unto you : but unto this man do not so vile a thing .
kha: Khmih ! Hangne ka don ka tnga kliar jong u bad ka khun jong nga , kaba dang sotti . Ngan wan ïalam ïa ki mynta shabar , bad phi lah ban shim ïa ki . Leh ïa ki katba phi sngewkwah . Hynrei wat leh ïa ka kam bymman ha une u briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, hangne ka khun jong nga ka long kaba rit, bad ka tnga jong u ngan pynmih mynta, bad phin pynrit mynsiem ia ki, bad leh bad ki ia kaba phi sngewbha: hynrei ia une u briew wat leh ia kaba sniew kumta .

en: Then she arose with her daughters in law , that she might return from the country of Moab : for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the  Lord  had visited his people in giving them bread .
kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa la ki briew da kaba ai ha ki ka jingot kaba bha ; kumta ka la khreh ban mihnoh na Moab lem bad la ki pyrsa kurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ieng bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ha ka ri Moab: namar ka la iohsngew ha ka ri Moab kumno U Trai u la leit jngoh ia ki briew jong u ha kaba ai kpu ia ki .

en: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation , and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: bad hangta ha khmat jong kata ka pyrda u buh ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang . U kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka jingainguh bam halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh ia ka jingknia thang ding ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjahthait jong ka jingïalang , bad u la tyrwa halor jong ka ïingknia thang bad ka jingknia doh; kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .

en: When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee  ; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them :
kha: Haba me khang ïa u slap ban hap namar ba ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta haba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai khmat sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka bneng ka la khang , bad ym don slap , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ia me lada ki duwai sha kane ka jaka , bad ki phla ia ka kyrteng jong me bad ki phai noh na ka pop jong ki;

en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward  ; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times .
kha: Un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad un synreit ïa ka da la ka shynriah ti ha khmat kata ka jingtap , bad nangta un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un shim ia ka snam jong u masi bad un theh ia ka da ka kti jong u ha ka jaka ba la shet shaphang mihngi ; bad ha khmat ka jaka ba la shet u dei ban theh ia ka snam da ka kti jong u hynriew sien .

en: Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha khmih haduh katno ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ki long kiba sarong ! Ki ïaid da kaba pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki sien jam kiba rit itynnat bad ki jingdeng ha ki matsohlah ki sawa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Trai u ong , Namar ki khun kynthei jong ka Seion ki long kiba sngewrit , bad ki iaid ryndang bad ki khmat kiba jrong , ki iaid bad ki khmat kiba jrong katba ki nang iaid , bad ki iaid ryngkat bad ki kjat jong ki:

en: And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .
kha: Lyngba ka duriaw me pynlong ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta ki briew jong me bad me ïalam ïa ki lyngba ka khyndew ba-rkhiang . Ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki , me pynïap jyllop ha ka um bajylliew , kum u maw uba ngam ha ka duriaw ba-atphyllung .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me la phiah ia ka duriaw ha khmat jong ki, haduh ba ki la iaid lyngba ka duriaw ha ka ri kaba rkhiang ; bad ki nongpynshitom bein jong ki me la bret shapoh ki jingjylliew , kum u maw shapoh ki um kiba khlain .

en: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah , and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place , and the name of the Chemarims with the priests  ;
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah baroh . Ngan pynjot ïa ka dien bakhatduh ka jingmane ïa u Baal hangta , bad ym don mano mano ban kynmaw wat ïa ki lyngdoh blei nongwei kiba shakri ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhih ruh ia ka kti jong nga halor ka Judah, bad halor ki nongshong shnong baroh jong ka Jerusalem; bad ngan ot noh ia ka jingsah jong u Baal na kane ka jaka .

en: And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :
kha: Ynda ki la dep tep , u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki khun ,  Ynda nga ïap , tep ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep bad buh ïa ka met jong nga syndah bad ka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ba u la tep ia u, ba u la kren ha ki khun shynrang jong u, u da ong: Ynda nga la iap, te tep ia nga ha ka jingtep ha kaba la tep ia u briew U Blei; ki shyieng jong nga ki la sah hajan ki shyieng jong u:

en: Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .
kha: Ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei kam shym la pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka kupar . Ka jingkyllon jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khyrdop jong ka ki la ngam shapoh khyndew; u la pynjot bad pynpra ia ki bar jong ka: u syiem jong ka bad ki syiem jong ka ki long hapdeng ki Jutang: ka hukum kam long shuh; ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka ruh kim lap ia ka jingphohsniew na U Trai .

en: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka , kim tip ka dei kaei , bad kumta ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei mo kane ?  Te u Moses u ong ha ki ,  Une u dei u kpu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la iohi ia ka, ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, Ka long ka Mannana: namar kim shym la sngewsih ia kaei kata . U Moses u la ong ha ki: Une u long u kpu uba U Trai u la ai ha phi ban bam .

en: Behold , I will watch over them for evil , and not for good : and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine , until there be an end of them .
kha: Ngan khmih ïa kane ba phin ym manbha , hynrei phin shah pynjot . Baroh na phi phin ïap , ha ka thma ne na ka jingpang , haduh ba yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan peit ia ki na ka bynta kaba sniew , bad ym na ka bynta kaba bha: bad ki briew jong ka Judah baroh kiba don ha ka ri Ijipt kin shah pynjot da ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh bam haduh ba kin da kut noh .

en: Which also said , Ye men of Galilee , why stand ye gazing up into heaven ? this same Jesus , which is taken up from you into heaven , shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven .
kha: Ko nong Galilaïa , balei phi ïa-ïeng hangne da kaba khmied sha ka sahit bneng ? Une U Jisu , ïa uba la shim noh sha bneng na phi , un wan pat ha kajuh ka rukom ba phi la ïohi ba u kiew sha bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba ruh ka la ong: Phi ki briew jong ka Galilaia, balei phi ieng sha bneng ? une u juh u Jisu uba la shah rah noh na phi sha bneng , un wan ha ka rukom kumba phi la iohi ia u ba u leit sha bneng .

en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the  Lord  in the sabbaths , in the new moons , and on the set feasts , by number , according to the order commanded unto them , continually before the  Lord  :
kha: bad ha man ba thang ïa ki jingainguh ba la ai sha U  Trai  ha ka Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei kiwei ki Jingkhawai Niam . La thaw ïa ki jingpynbeit ryntih da kaba kdew ïa ka jingdon ki Lebi kiba la pynkhamti ban leh ïa kane ka kam man ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban aiti ia ki jingknia thang baroh ha U Trai ha ki sngi Saitjain, ha ki bnai thymmai, bad ha ki jingkhawai ba la buh, kat kum ka hukum ba la hukum ha ki, beit ha khmat U Trai:

en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba ka por ka poi , ki paid Israel bad Judah kin wan ïa-ïam , kin wad ïa nga , U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi bad ha kata ka por , ong U Trai , ki khun Israel kin wan , ma ki bad ki khun Judah ryngkat: kin leit bad kin wad ia U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .
kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Buh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka bynta ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano hano ha uwei pat . Ngan pule na ka bynta u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba la thoh bad ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Daniel u la jubab bad u la ong ha khmat u syiem: To ai ba ki jingai sngewbha jong me kin long ha me hi, bad to ai ia ka bainong jong me ha uwei pat u ; hynrei ngan pule ia ka jingthoh ha u syiem bad ngan pyntip ha u ia ka jingbatai .

en: And thou shalt say , I will go up to the land of unwalled villages  ; I will go to them that are at rest , that dwell safely , all of them dwelling without walls , and having neither bars nor gates ,
kha: Men sa rai ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri ka bym don jingïarap ha kaba ki briew ki ïashongsuk shongshngain ha ki shnong kiba khlem ker kynroh bad ki bym don jingker .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong , Ngan leit sha ka ri jong ki shnong bym don kynroh shuh shuh , kiba shong shngain , baroh ki shong khlem ki kynroh , bad ki bym don bar ne ki khyrdop .

en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .
kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akwila , ïa uba la kha ha Pontos , uba dang shu wan shen na Italy lem bad ka Priskila ka tnga jong u , naba u Patsha Klaudius u la lah hukum ïa ki Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shem ia uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Aquila, uba la kha ha Ponto, dang shen u wan na Italy, bad ka tnga jong u ka Priscilla ; (namar ba u Claudius u la hukum ia ki Jiw baroh ban leit noh na Rome : ) bad u la wan sha ki .

en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban pynshisha ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ban shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingïaroh bad ka burom bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka jingtynjuh ia ka jingngeit jong phi, ka long kaba kham kordor shibun ban ia ka ksiar kaba jah noh, wat la ka long kaba la pyrshang da ka ding, lah ban shem ha ka jingiaroh bad ka burom bad ka burom ha ka jingmih U Jisu Khrist:

en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua , saying , Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit , seeing I am a great people , forasmuch as the  Lord  hath blessed me hitherto ?
kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ki ong ha u Joshua ,  Balei phi ai ïa ngi tang shi bynta jong ka ri ba ngin kam kynti kum la ka jong ? Ngi ïadon bun ngut namar U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun u Joseph ki la kren ha u Joshua, ki da ong: Balei me la ai tang kawei ka bynta bad kawei ka bynta ban hiar pateng, haba nga long u briew uba khraw, kumba U Trai u la kyrkhu ia nga haduh mynta ?

en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .
kha: Ki don ka bor ban set ïa ka sahit bneng ba yn ym hap slap ha ka por ba ki pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Ki don ka bor ruh halor ki pukri um , ban pynkylla snam ïa ki ; ki don ka bor ruh ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da kano kano ka jait khlam katba shong ka mon jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki don ka bor ban khang ia ka bneng , ba kan ym slap ha ki sngi jong ka jingiathuhlypa jong ki: bad ki don ka bor halor ki um ban pynkylla ia ki sha ka snam , bad ban pynkhih ia ka khyndew da ki khniang baroh , katba ki mon .

en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
kha: U Aaron u la kohnguh , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad mareh sha pdeng ki briew ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïohi ba ka khlam ka la lah sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u rnga ding bad u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron u la shim kumba u Moses u la hukum, bad u la mareh hapdeng ka jingiaseng ; bad, ha khmih, ka khlam ka la sdang hapdeng ki briew: bad u la buh ia ka jingiwbih bad u la leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta ki briew .

en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak , saying , Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; and a calf and a lamb , both of the first year , without blemish , for a burnt offering  ;
kha: Nangta ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa uwei u  langsohmoh ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , uwei u khun masi uba shisnem , bad uwei u khunlangbrot uba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki khun Israel me dei ban kren da kaba ong: To shim ia u khun masi na ka bynta ka jingainguh pop ; bad u khun masi bad u langbrot baroh arngut ha ka snem kaba nyngkong .

en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .
kha: Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri jong u ban pynphong ïa u Daniel ha ka jaiñkup syiem kaba sawbthuh bad ban pyndeng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Belshasar u la hukum ia u Daniel da ka rong saw bad u la buh ia ka kynjri ksiar sawdong ka ryndang jong u bad u la pynlong ia ka jingpynbna shaphang jong u , ba u dei ban long u nongsynshar ba lai ha ka hima .

en: And the  Lord  shall guide thee continually , and satisfy thy soul in drought , and make fat thy bones : and thou shalt be like a watered garden , and like a spring of water , whose waters fail not .
kha: Bad ngan ïalam ïa phi borabor , bad pynkdang ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha . Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Phin long kum ka kper kaba pahuh um , kum ka umpohliew ka bym ju rngad .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un ialam ia me man ka por, bad un pynhun ia ka mynsiem jong me ha ka jingkhriat: bad me long kum ka kper kaba la ai um, bad kum ka tyllong um kaba ki um jong me kim ju jah .

en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  Nga ong ha me , to khie joit , shim ïa la ka jingthiah , bad khie leit noh sha ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ba phin tip ba u Khun u briew u don ka bor halor ka khyndew ban map ia ki pop, (u la ong ha kiba pang) Nga ong ha me, To khie noh ia ka jingthiah jong me bad leit shapoh iing jong me .

en: Let that therefore abide in you , which ye have heard from the beginning . If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you , ye also shall continue in the Son , and in the Father .
kha: To sngewskhem , te , ban sumar ha ki dohnud jong phi ïa ka khubor ba phi la ïohsngew naduh mynnyngkong . Lada phi sumar ïa kata ka khubor , te phin ïaisah borabor ha U Khun bad ha U Kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba kata kan sah ha phi, kaba phi la iohsngew naduh kaba sdang . Lada kata kaba phi la iohsngew naduh kaba sdang kan sah ha phi , phi ruh phin iai bteng ha U Khun bad ha U Kpa .

en: Honour thy father and thy mother , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee  ; that thy days may be prolonged , and that it may go well with thee , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
kha: ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , kumba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga hukum ïa phi , khnang ba phin manbha bad im slem ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To burom ia u kpa bad ka kmie jong me kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me ba ki sngi jong me kin nang slem, bad ba kin iaid bha bad me, ha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ia me .

en: After the discourse , there is a one-hour “Watchtower” Study , in which members of the congregation are welcome to participate in a discussion of an article from the study edition of The Watchtower .
kha: Hadien ka jingkren ka don ka Jingpule na “Ka Kut Ap Phira” kaba shikynta ha kaba ki dkhot ka balang ki lah ban ai jubab na ka Kut Ap Phira ( ha ka Phareng ) .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ka jingiakren , ka don ka jingpule kaba shi kynta Watchtower , ha kaba ki dkhot jong ka balang ki pdiang sngewbha ban iashim bynta ha ka jingiakren ia ka jingthoh na ka jingpule jong ka The Watchtower .

en: And it shall be said in that day , Lo , this is our God  ; we have waited for him , and he will save us : this is the  Lord   ; we have waited for him , we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation .
kha: Haba kane kan jia , baroh kin ong ,  U long U Blei jong ngi ! Ngi la buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ngi ha u , bad u la pyllait im ïa ngi . U long U  Trai  ! Ngi la buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u , bad mynta ngi kmen namar ba u la pynim ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad yn ong ha kata ka sngi , Lo, une u Blei jong ngi; bad un pynim ia ngi: kane ka long U Trai; ngi la ap ia u; ngin ia sngewbha bad sngewbha ha ka jingpynim jong u .

en: That she called unto the men of her house , and spake unto them , saying , See , he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us  ; he came in unto me to lie with me , and I cried with a loud voice :
kha: ka la khot ïa ki shakri ïing jong ka bad ka ong ha ki ,  Peit kaei kane ! Une u Hebru uba u tnga jong nga u la wan ïalam ha ïing u la pynjahburom ïa ngi . U la wan rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad u la pyrshang ban batbor ïa nga , hynrei nga la lynñiar kat lah kat ïai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ka la khot ia ki briew jong ka iing jong ka, bad ka la kren ha ki, ka la ong, Peit, u la wanrah ia u Hebru ha ngi ban rkhie bein ia ngi; u la wan rung ha nga ban thiah bad nga, bad nga la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam:

en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .
kha: Ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la sngewsarong namar ki la don kyrhai ban bam bad im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa kiba rangli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih kane ka la long ka jingbymhok jong ka para jong me ka Sodom, ka jingsarong, ka jingdap jong u kpu bad ka jingbun ka jingbym shimkhia ka la don ha ka bad ha ki khun kynthei jong ka , bad kam shym la pynskhem ia ka kti jong kiba duk bad kiba duk .

en: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh , fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind ; and were by nature the children of wrath , even as others .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha , baroh na ngi , ngi la long kum ma ki bad ngi la im kat kum ki jingkwah ka doh jong ngi , da kaba leh ïa kano kano kaba ïahap kat kum ki jingkwah jong ki met bad ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi hi . Ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ngi , kumba long uwei pa uwei , la buh lypa ban shah pynshitom ha ka jingbitar U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng jong ngi baroh ngi la don ka jingiakren jong ngi ha ki por ba la leit noh ha ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh jong ngi, da kaba pyndep ia ki jingkwah jong ka doh bad ka jingmut; bad ngi la long da ka jinglong jong ki khun jong ka jingbitar, wat kum kiwei pat .

en: And the men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city , did as Jezebel had sent unto them , and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them .
kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kaba ka Jesebel ka la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka shnong jong u, wat ki rangbah bad ki riew rangbah kiba shong ha ka shnong jong u, ki la leh kumba u Jesbel u la phah sha ki, bad kumba la thoh ha ki shithi kiba ka la phah sha ki .

en: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen , being understood by the things that are made , even his eternal power and Godhead ; so that they are without excuse :
kha: Naduh ba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ki jinglong bym lah ban ïohi jong u , ka bor bymjukut bad ka jinglong ba kynja Blei jong u , la ïohi shai kdar ; la ïohi ïa ki ha kiei kiei kiba U Blei u la thaw . Kumta kito ki briew kin ym lait satia !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ym lah ban iohi jong u naduh ka jingthaw ia ka pyrthei la iohi shai , la sngewthuh da kiei kiei kiba la pynlong , wat ia ka bor bymjukut bad ka jinglong Blei jong u; kumta ki long khlem daw:

en: Wherefore it shall come to pass , if ye hearken to these judgments , and keep , and do them , that the  Lord  thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers :
kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa kine ki hukum bad kohnguh hok ïa ki , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïai bat ïa la ka jutang bad phi bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa ka jingieit jong u kaba ïaineh , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kan sa jia lada phi sngap ia kine ki jingbishar bad phi sumar bad leh ia ki, ba U Trai U Blei jong me un sumar ha me ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei kaba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me:

en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .
kha: Katno kiba suk bad kiba la ïoh jingkyrkhu shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat banyngkong ïa kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu bad bakhuid ia uta uba don bynta ha ka jingmihpat kaba nyngkong: ha kum kata ka jingiap kaba ar kam don bor , hynrei kin long ki lyngdoh jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .

en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money , neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices : but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins , thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities .
kha: Phim shym la thied jingiwbih ïa nga lane pynhun ïa nga da ka khleiñ ki jingri jong phi . Pynban phi la bankhia ïa nga da ki pop jong phi ; phi la pynbtai ïa nga da ki jingbakla ba phi la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la thied ia nga da ka pisa kaba thiang, bad me la pyndap ia nga da ka shini jong ki jingknia jong me: hynrei me la pynlong ia nga ban shakri da ki pop jong me, me la pynsngewsih ia nga da ki jingbymhok jong me .

en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ jong phi kin dap da ki sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynrem ia u nongbam na ka bynta jong phi , bad un ym pynjot ia ki soh jong ka khyndew jong phi; bad u sohjew jong phi un ym bret ia u soh jong ka ha khmat ka por ha lyngkha , ong U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
kha: Ka rah ïa ka ïing bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ka la wan ka Iyer kaba khraw na ka ri khlaw, bad ka la pynkhih ia ki saw tylli ki thliew jong ka iing, bad ka la hap halor ki samla, bad ki la iap ; bad tang ma nga uba la lait im tang ban iathuh ia me .

en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge , and said , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them : and I will be with thee .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u kren ha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad u ong ha u ,  Long uba sngewskhem bha bad uba kut jingmut , namar me men ïalam ïa ki Israel sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , bad ngan don ryngkat bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ai ia u Joshua u khun u Nun, bad u la ong: To long uba khlain bad uba shlur bha: namar me wanrah ia ki khun Israel sha ka ri kaba nga sngap jar ha ki: bad ngan long bad me .

en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
kha: Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , la pule ha ki , bad ha ki lai kynta kiba bud , ki phla ïa la ki pop bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ieng ha ka jaka jong ki , bad ki la pule ha ka Kitab U Trai jong ki shi bynta na ka saw bynta jong ka sngi ; bad kawei pat ka bynta kaba saw ki la phla , bad ki la mane ia U Trai jong ki .

en: For the vineyard of the  Lord  of hosts is the house of Israel , and the men of Judah his pleasant plant : and he looked for judgment , but behold oppression  ; for righteousness , but behold a cry .
kha: Ka Israel ka dei ka bri sohwaiñ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ; ki briew ka Judah ki dei ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba u la thung . U la khmih lynti ba kin leh ïa kaei kaba bha , hynrei pynban ki la pynïap briew . U la khmih lynti ba kin leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei kiba shah lanot jong ki , ki kyang ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kper sohjew jong U Trai jong ki paid ka long ka iing Israel, bad ki briew jong u Judah ki long u jingthung ba sngewtynnad jong u: bad u la wad ia ka jingbishar, hynrei ha khmih ka jingshah pynshitom bein;

en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .
kha: Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba don hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha kawei kawei ka kti bad hynriew tylli ki shympriah kjat ha kawei kawei ka kjat . U long uba hiarpateng na ki ramhah mynhyndai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad sa shisien pat ka la don ka thma ha Gath, ha kaba u briew uba heh ka met, uba ki kti bad ki tyrpeng jong u ki long sawphew snem, hynriew tylli ki kti bad hynriew tylli ki kjat: bad u ruh u long u khun jong u rangbah .

en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .
kha: bad ba phi lah ban ïathuh ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kumno nga la pynpaw bieit ïa ki nong Ijipt haba nga leh ïa kine ki kambah . Phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba me lah ban iathuh ha ki shkor jong u khun jong me bad u khun jong me, ia kiei kiei kiba nga la leh ha Ijipt bad ki dak jong nga kiba nga la leh hapdeng jong ki; ba phin tip kumno ba nga long U Trai .

en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens , and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work .
kha: U la pynbeit hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki ban kit ïa ki tiar ki tar bad phraphew hajar ngut ban shtah maw ha ki jaka lum , bad u la thung lai hajar hynriewspah ngut ki nongpynïaidkam ki ban pynthikna ba yn pyndep ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la buh lai hajar ngut ki briew ban kit ia ki jingkit, bad saw hajar ngut ki nongrah ha u lum, bad lai hajar hynriew spah ngut ki nongpeitkai ban buh ia ki briew ha ka kam .

en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .
kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit noh , namar ba ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh kawei jong ka ri Gadaren u la kyrpad ia u ban leit noh na ki ; namar la shim ia ki da ka jingtieng kaba khraw: bad u la leit shapoh lieng , bad u la wan phai biang .

en: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : for thou exceedest the fame that I heard .
kha: ngam shym la ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki ïathuh ïa nga tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi da lade hi . Ngam shym pat ïohsngew wat tang shiteng na ka jingstad jong phi . Phi kham stad shuh shuh ban ïa kaba ki briew ki ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngam shym la ngeit ia ki ktien jong ki, haduh ba ngan da wan, bad ki khmat jong nga kim shym la iohi ia kata: bad, ha khmih, kawei ka bynta jong ka jingkhraw jong ka jingstad jong me ym shym la iathuh ia nga: namar me palat ia ka nam kaba nga la iohsngew .
