en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pushara lieh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: To phi ki nongthoh bad ki Pharisi, ki nongleh arsap ! namar phi long kum ki jingtep ba la rong saw, kiba paw shisha ba ki long kiba itynnad shabar , hynrei ki long hapoh ki shyieng jong ki briew kiba la iap bad ki jingbymkhuid baroh .

en: And he brought also the brasen altar , which was before the  Lord  , from the forefront of the house , from between the altar and the house of the  Lord  , and put it on the north side of the altar .
kha: Ka duwan rnong ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  ka don hapdeng ka duwan bathymmai bad ka Templ , te u Ahas u pynkynriah noh ïa ka sha ka bynta bashaneng jong ka duwan bathymmai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ruh ia ka jingkhang kaba la tyrkhong ha khmat U Trai, na khmat ka iing, naduh ka liang mihngi jong ka iing U Trai .

en: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place , and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar : and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places , even out of the meadows of Gibeah .
kha: Kumta haba ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ka kynran dien bad ban ïakynduh lang biang ha Baaltamar , ki rangbah kiba khangkdong ïa ka Gibeah ki mih kynsan na la ki jakarieh ba don ha ki jaka maw jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki Israel ki la mih na ka jaka jong ki, bad ki la buh ia lade ha Baaltamar: bad ki nongshong shnong jong ki Israel ki la mih na ki jaka jong ki, wat na ki khlaw Gibeah .

en: And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .
kha: bad ong ha ki paidbah ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa ki lyngdoh ba ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , loit noh ïa ka jaka shong dara bad bud ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la hukum ia ki briew da kaba ong: Haba phi iohi ia ka synduk jong U Trai U Blei jong phi bad ki lyngdoh ki Lebi ki kit ia ka , te phin leit noh na ka jaka jong phi bad phin leit bud ia ka .

en: Then said his servants unto him , What thing is this that thou hast done ? thou didst fast and weep for the child , while it was alive  ; but when the child was dead , thou didst rise and eat bread .
kha: Ngim shemphang satia ïa kane ,  ki rangbah synshar ki ong ha u .  Katba i khunlung i dang im , phi la ïam na ka bynta jong i bad phim treh ban bam ; hynrei mar ïa-ïap ma i , phi la khie joit bad phi la bam !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shakri jong u ki la ong ia u, Kaei kata kaba me la leh ? me la shah jingit bad iam na ka bynta uta u khynnah katba u dang im ; hynrei haba u khynnah u la iap , me la ieng bad bam kpu .

en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword , not of a mighty man  ; and the sword , not of a mean man , shall devour him : but he shall flee from the sword , and his young men shall be discomfited .
kha: Ïa ka Assyria yn pynjot ha ka thma , hynrei ym da ka bor briew . Ki nong Assyria kin phet ïap na ka thma , bad ïa ki samla shynrang jong ki yn pynlong mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Assyria un hap da ka waitlam, ym na u briew uba khlain bad ka waitlam, ym na u briew uba rit paid: hynrei un phet noh na ka waitlam, bad ki samla jong u kin sa shah pynjah burom .

en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .
kha: Ki syiem Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh sngewbha bad ban ai ïa ka jingainguh kaba khraw ïa u Dagon u blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai ,  U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop ïa u Samson u nongshun jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la lum lang ia ki ban aiti ia ka jingknia kaba khraw ha u Dagon jong ki, bad ban kmen: namar ki la ong: U blei jong ngi u la aiti ia u nongshun jong ngi ha ka kti jong ngi .

en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .
kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , ba uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u klim lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ong ha phi , Uno uno uba weng noh ia ka tnga jong u, lait noh tang na ka bynta ka jingleh be-ijot bad un shongkurim ia kawei pat: bad uno uno uba shongkurim ia ka kaba la weng noh u leh be-ijot .

en: Behold , O  Lord  , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?
kha: Ha khmih , A  Trai  , ha ka jingkordit jong nga , ha ka jingjynjar sat ka mynsiem jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka pait ha ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Ka don ka jingpynïap ha ki lynti bah ; wat hapoh ïing ka don ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ko Trai bad to pyrkhat ia uba me la leh ia kane . Hato ki kynthei kin bam ia u soh jong ki bad ki khun jong ka span ? hato u lyngdoh bad u nongiathuhlypa kin shah pyniap ha ka jaka kyntang jong U Trai ?

en: What hast thou here ? and whom hast thou here , that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here , as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high , and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock ?
kha: Me mut me dei uei ? Me don hok aïu ban shna ka jingtep ïa lade ha ka sharing mawsiang ?
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba me don hangne ? bad mano ba me don hangne, ba me la pynmih ia me shabar ka jingtep hangne, kumba u pynmih ia u shabar ka jingtep kaba jrong , bad kata ka tep ia ka jaka shong jaka sah na ka bynta lade ha u maw ?

en: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication :
kha: Kata ka briew ka la riam ha ki jaiñ ba sawbthuh bad basaw hain hain , bad ba la tap da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila . Ha ka kti jong ka , ka la bat ïa ka khuri ksiar kaba dap da kiei kiei kiba isaitmet bad ijakhlia , kiba mih na ka jingawria jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynthei ka la long kaba la rong saw bad kaba saw, bad la pynitynnad da ki maw ksiar bad ki mawkordor bad ki mawkordor, ka don ka khuri ksiar ha ka kti jong ka kaba dap da ki jingpynjakhlia bad ka jingjakhlia jong ka:

en: And it came to pass , when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .
kha: Hynrei haba U Blei u la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong kata ka them ha kaba u Lot u shong shnong , u la buh jingkynmaw ïa u Abraham , bad u la ailad ïa u Lot ban lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba U Blei u la pynjot ia ki shnong jong ka madan , ba U Blei u la kynmaw ia u Abraham bad u la phah ia u Lot na pdeng ka jingtwa , haba u la pynpra ia ki shnong ha kaba u Lot u la shong .

en: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel , and maketh merchandise of him , or selleth him  ; then that thief shall die  ; and thou shalt put evil away from among you .
kha: Uno uno uba rong jubor ïa la u para Israel bad u pynlong mraw lane die mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada lap ia u briew uba tuh ia uno uno na ki para Israel jong u, bad u pynlong ia u, ne u pynlong ia u; te uta u nongtuh un iap; bad me dei ban weng noh ia kaba sniew na pdeng jong phi .

en: Until thy brother s anger turn away from thee , and he forget that which thou hast done to him : then I will send , and fetch thee from thence : why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?
kha: Te ngan sa phah shaw pat ïa me . Balei ngan shu duh ei ïa ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haduh ba ka jingbitar jong u hynmen jong me kan phet noh na me, bad un klet ia kata kaba me la leh ia u: te ngan phah ia me nangta: balei ba nga ruh ngan shah pynduh noh ia phi baroh arngut ha kawei ka sngi ?

en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Joash bad ki kam baroh kiba u la leh bad ka jingkhlain jong u ha kaba u la ialeh pyrshah ia u Amaiah syiem Judah , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: So he departed thence , and found Elisha the son of Shaphat , who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him , and he with the twelfth : and Elijah passed by him , and cast his mantle upon him .
kha: U Elijah u la mihnoh bad shem ïa u Elisha ba u dang pynlur ïa shi jur ki masi dab ; la don khatwei jur ki masi dab kiba don ha ki lyngkor ha khmat jong u , bad u dang pynlur ïa kiba khatduh . U Elijah u la law noh ïa la ka barandi bad u la pynkup ha u Elisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la leit noh nangta, bad u la shem ia u Elisa u khun u Shaphat, uba dang rep da ki shiphew tylli ki oxen ha khmat jong u, bad ma u bad ka shiphew tylli ki masi: bad u Elijah u la iaid lyngba jong u, bad u la bret ia ka jainkup jong u halor jong u .

en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki lyer ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka kylleng , haduh ba yn ym don ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ka Elam ngan wanrah ia ki saw tylli ki Iyer na ki saw bynta jong ka bneng , bad ngan pynphriang ia ki sha kita ki Iyer baroh; bad kan ym don ka jaitbynriew kaba ki nongshah beh jong ka Elam kin ym wan .

en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
kha: Ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad nga ai ïa kata ka ri kaba naduh Gilead haduh ka wah Arnon . U pud uba shaphang shathie u long napdeng jong kata ka wah , bad u pud uba shaphang shatei pat u long ka wah Jabbok ; kaba shi bynta na kata ka pynlong ruh ïa u pud ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki Reuben bad ha ki Gad nga la ai naduh Gilead haduh ka wah Arnon shiteng ka them, bad u pud u sam haduh ka wah Jabok, kaba long u pud u sam jong ki khun u Ammon;

en: Thou shalt betroth a wife , and another man shall lie with her : thou shalt build an house , and thou shalt not dwell therein : thou shalt plant a vineyard , and shalt not gather the grapes thereof .
kha: Phin ïatehktien bad ka samla — hynrei uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka . Phin tei ïa ka ïing — hynrei phin ym ïoh shong ha ka . Phin thung ka bri sohwaiñ — hynrei phin ym ïoh bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban thiah bad ka tnga bad uwei pat u shynrang bad ka: me dei ban tei ia ka iing bad me dei ban shong hangta: me dei ban thung ia u sohjew bad wat lum ia ki sohjew jong ka .

en: And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishai ,  U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Shim ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ban leit shong shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abisai, Mynta u Sheba u khun u Bikri un leh kham sniew ia ngi ban ia kaba u la leh: to shim ia ki shakri kynrad jong me, bad to bud ia u, ioh ia ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong jong u, bad un lait na ngi .

en: A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .
kha: Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Elam , to tur ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingphohsniew kaba sngewsih ka long kaba la pynbna ha nga; u nongdie uba thok u la shah pynjot bein, bad u nongpynjot u la shah pynjot . Leit shaneng, ko Elam: ka jingkren bein, ko Media; baroh ka jingsngewsih jong ka nga la pynlong ban sangeh noh .

en: Even as I sware unto thee by the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead  ; even so will I certainly do this day .
kha: ba ha kane ka sngi ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha pha ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ba u Solomon , u khun jong pha un long syiem hadien jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba nga sngap jar ha me da U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, da kaba ong: Hooid u khun jong me un synshar hadien jong nga, bad un shong ha ka khet jong nga ha ka jaka jong nga; kumta ruh ngan leh ha kane ka sngi .

en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart : but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king s gate , that he stood not up , nor moved for him , he was full of indignation against Mordecai .
kha: Haba u Haman u la mihnoh na ka jingkhawai u la kmen bad dap da ka jingsngewbha . Hynrei u ïohi pat ïa u Mordekai ha ka khyrdop bad um shym la ïeng lane pyn-i kano kano ka dak jong ka jingburom haba u ïaid nangta , u Haman u la bitar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Haman u la leit noh ha kata ka sngi da ka jingkmen bad da ka dohnud kaba kmen: hynrei haba u Haman u la iohi ia u Mordecai ha ka khyrdop syiem , ba um shym la ieng , lymne u la khih na ka bynta jong u , u la dap da ka jingbitar pyrshah ia u Mordecai .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kular ïa ka jingsuk ïa kito kiba da siewdor ïa ki , hynrei ki byrngem da ka thma ïa kito ki bym siew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai shaphang ki nongiathuhlypa jong nga kiba bakla, kiba bam da ki bniat jong ki, bad kiba iam, Ka jingsuk ; bad uta u bym buh ha ka shyntur jong ki , ki pynkhreh wat ia ka thma pyrshah ia u .

en: Therefore now go , lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee : behold , mine Angel shall go before thee : nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them .
kha: Mynta khie leit , ïalam ïa u paidbah sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la ïathuh ïa me . Kynmaw ba u angel jong nga un ïalam ïa phi , hynrei ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynshitom ïa kine ki briew namar ka pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to leit ia ki briew sha ka jaka kaba nga la kren ha me: ha khmih u Angel jong nga un leit ha khmat jong me: wat la katta ruh ha ka sngi ba nga leit jngoh ngan leit jngoh ia ka pop jong ki halor jong ki .

en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption , and this mortal shall have put on immortality , then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written , Death is swallowed up in victory .
kha: Kumta haba kane ka jia , bad ïa kaba dei ban ïap la pynkylla sha ka bym dei ban ïap , te ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ïa ka jingïap la pynjot thiaw ; ka jingjop ka la long kaba pura!
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba kane ka jingbam kan sa long kaba sniew, bad une u briew uba iap un sa phong ia ka jingbym lah iap, nangta yn sa pynlong ia ka jingong kaba la thoh , Ka jingiap ka la shah rong noh ha ka jingjop .

en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .
kha: Ki wan lem bad la ki jingri bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki lem bad ki ut jong ki , ki bun haduh katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la wan shaneng bad ki masi bad ki ïingjaiñ jong ki, bad ki la wan kum ki khniang na ka bynta ka jingbun paid ; namar baroh arngut ki long ki bym don jingkhein: bad ki la rung shapoh ka ri ban pynjot ïa ka .

en: But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .
kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei nga long kumba nga long , bad ka jingaiei kaba u la ai ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kawei ka liang , nga la kham trei shitom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat na ki apostol , wat la kam shym la long da ka jingleh jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba trei ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei nga long kumta: bad ka jingaiei jong u kaba la pynpaw ha nga kam shym la long lehnohei; hynrei nga la trei kham bun ban ia ki baroh: hynrei ym ma nga, hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba la long bad nga .

en: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel : and when they joined battle , Israel was smitten before the Philistines : and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men .
kha: Ki Philistia ki tur ïaleh pyrshah bad hadien ka jingïaleh kaba jur ki jop ïa ki Israel bad ki pynïap ha ka madan thma kumba saw hajar ngut ki rangïapom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la buh ia lade ha ka thma pyrshah ia ki Israel : bad haba ki la iasoh bad ki Israel ki la shah shoh ha khmat ki Philistia: bad ki la pyniap ia ki shipai ha lyngkha kumba saw hajar ngut ki briew .

en: Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am  ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .
kha: Ko Pa ! Me la ai ïa ki ha nga , bad nga kwah ïa ki ba kin don bad nga ha kaba nga don , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga , ka burom ïa kaba me la ai ha nga ; naba me la ieit ïa nga ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Kpa, nga kwah ba ma nga ruh, ia kiba me la ai ha nga, kin long bad nga ha kaba nga don: ba me la ieit ia nga shuwa ka nongrim jong ka pyrthei .

en: For I also am a man set under authority , having under me soldiers , and I say unto one , Go , and he goeth  ; and to another , Come , and he cometh  ; and to my servant , Do this , and he doeth it .
kha: Nga ruh , nga long u briew uba la buh hapoh ka bor jong ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kham halor , bad nga don ki shipai hapoh jong nga . Nga hukum ïa une uwei , ‘ khie leit !’ bad u leit ; nga hukum ïa uta uwei , ‘ Ale !’ bad u wan ; bad nga hukum ïa u mraw jong nga , ‘ Leh ïa kane !’ bad u leh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ruh nga long u briew uba la buh hapoh ka bor, uba don hapoh jong nga ki shipai, bad nga ong ha uwei, To leit; bad u leit sha uwei pat: To wan; bad u wan sha u shakri jong nga: To leh ia kane, bad u leh ia kata .

en: And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .
kha: Naduh nangta hi , man ka por ba uta u mynsiem bymman ba phah U Blei u wan ha u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem ïa ka . Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad u Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u mynsiem bymman na U Blei u la don ha u Saul, ba u Dabid u la shim ia ka harp bad u la ialehkai da ka kti jong u: kumta u Saul u la sngewsih bad u la koit, bad u mynsiem bymman u la leit noh na u .

en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synran jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros .  Khie noh na nga , me u Soitan ,  u la ong .  Ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba u la phai bad u la peit ia ki synran jong u, u la kynthoh ia u Petros, u da ong: To leit noh shadien jong nga, ko Soitan: namar me sngewbha ia kiei kiei kiba long jong U Blei hynrei ia kiei kiei kiba long jong ki briew .

en: Behold , the eyes of the Lord  God  are upon the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth  ; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga khmih ïa kane ka hima Israel kaba pop , bad ngan pynjot ïa ka na sla khyndew . Hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki khmat U Trai U Blei ki don ha ka hima pop , bad ngan pynjot ia ka na ka khmat jong ka khyndew ; da kaba pynim ba ngan ym pynjot lut ia ka iing u Jakob , ong U Trai .

en: Now it came to pass , when they spake daily unto him , and he hearkened not unto them , that they told Haman , to see whether Mordecai s matters would stand : for he had told them that he was a Jew .
kha: man ka sngi ki kyntu ïa u ban pyndem , hynrei um sngap ïa ki .  Nga dei u Jiw ,  u batai ,  bad ngam lah ban dem ha u Haman .  Kumta ki ïathuh ïa kane ha u Haman , bad ki pyrkhat la un lah ban shah ïa kane ka jingleh u Mordekai .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, haba ki la kren man ka sngi ha u, bad um shym la sngap ia ki, ba ki la iathuh ha u Haman, ban peit la u Mordecai u ieng ne em: namar u la iathuh ha ki ba u long u Jiw .

en: And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
kha: Haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , phin sa shadkmen ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban long khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Te phin sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga pyn-i ïa la ka jingbitar pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba phi iohi ia kane , ka dohnud jong phi kan sngewbha bad ki shyieng jong phi kin phuh kum u jingthung: bad ka kti U Trai kan sa paw ha ki shakri jong u , bad ka jingbitar jong u ha ki nongshun jong u .

en: That ye come not among these nations , these that remain among you  ; neither make mention of the name of their gods , nor cause to swear by them , neither serve them , nor bow yourselves unto them :
kha: Wat klet ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka , bad nangta phin ym ïakhleh bad kine ki briew kiba dang sah hapdeng jong phi lane ïakren ïa ki kyrteng jong ki blei jong ki lane pyndonkam ïa kito ki kyrteng ha kaba shim smai lane mane ïa kito ki blei lane nguh dem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin ym wan hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew, kine kiba sah hapdeng jong phi ; lymne ban kdew ia ka kyrteng jong ki blei jong ki, lymne ban pynlong ia ki ban smai da ki, lymne ban shakri ia ki, lymne ban dem ha ki:

en: So he died according to the word of the  Lord  which Elijah had spoken . And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah  ; because he had no son .
kha: U Ahasaïah u la ïap , kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong lyngba u Elijah . U Ahasaïah um shym don khun shynrang , kumta u Joram , u para jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoram u khun jong u Jehoshaphat , u syiem ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u la iap kat kum ka ktien U Trai kaba u Elijah u la kren . Bad u Jehoram u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Jehoram u khun u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah; namar ba um don khun shynrang .

en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves , and they came to the battle : and , behold , every man s sword was against his fellow , and there was a very great discomfiture .
kha: Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki ïaid sha ka thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia , kiba ïaleh iwei ïa iwei pat ha ka jingkulmar bajur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la ialum lang bad ki la wan sha ka thma: bad, ha khmih uwei pa uwei u la ialeh pyrshah ia la u paralok , bad ka la don ka jingbymsuk kaba khraw shibun .

en: God brought him forth out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .
kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh namar jong ki la kum u masi prut . Ki bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ki pynlwet ïa ki shyieng jong ki , ki pynkheiñ ïa ki khnam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la wanrah ia u na Ijipt u don kumba ka long ka bor jong u khun masi: un bam ia ki jaitbynriew jong u, bad un pynpra ia ki shyieng jong ki, bad un pynpra ia ki da ki khnam jong u .

en: Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .
kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u shah ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia ban jop ïa ki . Bad u synshar halor jong ki haduh phra snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka jingbitar U Trai ka la shit pyrshah ia ki Israel , bad u la die ia ki ha ka kti u Syiem Chushanrishathaim u syiem ka ri Mesopotamia : bad ki khun Israel ki la shakri ia u Chushanrishathaim 8 snem .

en: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him : but the Jews cried out , saying , If thou let this man go , thou art not Caesar s friend : whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar .
kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la pyrshang ban thaw lad ban pyllait ïa U Jisu . Hynrei u paidbah u la pyrta biang ,  Lada me pyllait ïa u , kata ka mut ba mem dei u paralok jong u Patsha ! Uno uno uba kam ba u dei u syiem u long u nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u Patsha !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh kata ka por u Pilat u la wad ban pyllait ia u: hynrei ki Jiw ki la pyrta, ki da ong: Lada me pyllait ia une u briew, me long u paralok jong u Kaisar: uno uno uba pynlong ia lade u syiem u kren pyrshah ia u Kaisar .

en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?
kha: Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , bad U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi kat shaba nga leit . Mynta ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka la long tang khyndiat kaba me la don shuwa ba ngan wan, bad mynta ka la nang kiew sha ka kynhun paidbah bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ia me naduh ka jingwan jong nga: bad mynta mynno ngan pynbiang ia la ka jong ka iing ruh ?

en: Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .
kha: bad ha shuwa ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la leh ? Mynta pha long kum ma ka — ka jingbiria ïa ki nong Edom , ki Philistia bad kiwei pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha shuwa ba la lap ia ka jingsniew jong me, kumba ha ka por jong ka jingshah lehbein jong me jong ki khun kynthei jong ka Syria bad baroh kiba don sawdong jong ka, ki khun kynthei jong ki Philistia kiba sngewsih ia me sawdong .

en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
kha: Nga kwah ban ïakynduh ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , hadien ba nga la sngewhun ban sah shipor ha ka jingwan khmih ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lano lano ruh nga shim ia ka jingleit jong nga sha Spain , ngan wan sha phi: namar nga shaniah ban iohi ia phi ha ka jingleit jong nga , bad ban shah ialam ha ka lynti jong nga sha khmat jong phi , lada nyngkong nga la dap katto katne bad ka kynhun jong phi .

en: And the temple of God was opened in heaven , and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament : and there were lightnings , and voices , and thunderings , and an earthquake , and great hail .
kha: Ïa ka Templ U Blei ha bneng la plie , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang la ïohi hangta . Nangta la don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ka jingkhynñiuh jumai bad ka jinghap phria kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka tempi U Blei ka la plie ha bneng , bad la iohi ha ka tempi jong u ia ka synduk jong ka jutang jong u: bad ki la don ki jingshai bad ki sur bad ki jingsawa bad ki jingsawa bad ka jingkhynñiuh jumai bad ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw .

en: But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .
kha: Ki briew U  Trai  ki la riewspah , hynrei kiba ïaleh pyrshah ; ki la sngaid bad ki la dap bha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Jeshurun u la nang heh, bad u la nang heh: me la nang heh, me la nang heh, me la tap da ka jingbun paid nangta u la iehnoh ia U Blei uba la thaw ia u, bad u la khein sting ia u Rock jong ka jingpynim jong u.

en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised  ; for to build the house of the  Lord  , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .
kha: U Syiem Solomon u la pyndonkam da ka jingpyntrei jubor ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , ban pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U la pyndonkam ruh ïa ka , na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ki nongbah Hasor , Megiddo bad Geser .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka dei ka daw jong ka jingleit kaba u syiem Solomon u la kiew na ka bynta ban tei ia ka iing U Trai, bad ka iing jong u hi, bad u Millo, bad ka kynroh Jerusalem, bad u Hasor, bad u Megiddo, bad u Gzer .

en: Be it known now unto the king , that , if this city be builded , and the walls set up again , then will they not pay toll , tribute , and custom , and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings .
kha: Ko syiem , lada ïa kane ka nongbah yn tei pat bad ïa ki kynroh jong ka yn pyndep , ki briew kin sa sangeh ban siew khajna , bad ki jingmih ka ïingsyiem kin sa duna .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip mynta ha u syiem, ba lada la tei ia kane ka shnong bad ki kynroh kin ym siew khajna bad ka rukom synshar paidbah bad kumta me dei ban siew ia ka khajna jong ki syiem .

en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , neither hath defiled his neighbour s wife , neither hath come near to a menstruous woman ,
kha: Um ju mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana . Um ju khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew lane ïathiah shongkha bad ka kynthei ha ka por poi bnai jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la bam ia ki lum, lymne um shym la pynkhih ia ki khmat jong u sha ki bleithaw jong ka iing Israel , lymne um shym la pynjakhlia ia ka tnga jong u para marjan jong u , lymne um shym la wan hajan ka kynthei kaba kha khun .

en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :
kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki don ka long tang ban shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin shim ia ka jain rong saw, bad kin tap ia ka sharak jong ka jingshai, bad ki sharak jong u, bad ki thylliej jong u bad ki sliang jong u baroh bad ki umphniang jong ka:

en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :
kha: Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka jingtei pynbha ïa ka Templ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka ha ka kti jong ki nongtrei kiba don ka jingpeit ia ka iing U Trai , bad ki la ai ia ka ha ki nongtrei kiba trei ha ka iing U Trai , ban pynbha bad pynbha ia ka iing:

en: And all the people , even the people of war that were with him , went up , and drew nigh , and came before the city , and pitched on the north side of Ai : now there was a valley between them and Ai .
kha: Ma u bad ki shipai ki ïaleit sha ka khyrdop bah jong ka nongbah bad ki sher dara ha ka phang bashatei , ha kaba don ka them hapdeng jong ki bad ka Ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh, wat ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, ki la kiew bad ki la iaid shajan bad ki la wan ha khmat ka shnong bad ki la iaid shaphang shathie jong ka Ai: mynta ka la don ka them hapdeng jong ki bad u Ai .

en: In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
kha: Katba u Mordekai u dang long u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u Bigthana bad u Teresh , kiba long ar ngut na ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ka khyrdop sha ki kamra u syiem , ki la shun ïa u syiem Serksis bad sylla ban pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi, katba u Mordecai u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong u syiem, arngut ki kamra jong u syiem, u Bigthan bad u Teresh, na kito kiba bat ia ka jingkhang, ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ki la wad ban buh kti ia u syiem Ahasuerus .

en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .
kha: Pha sngewshngain ïa lade ha la ki kam sniew ; pha pyrkhat ba ym don mano mano ba ïohi ïa pha . Ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong pha ki ïalam bakla ïa pha , bad pha ong ha lade , ‘ Nga long U Blei — ym don uno uno pat kum ma nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la shaniah ha ka jingsniew jong me: me la ong, Ym don ba iohi ia nga . Ka jingstad bad ka jingtip jong me, ka la pynkylla ia me ; bad me la ong ha ka dohnud jong me, nga long, bad ym don shuh hajan jong nga .

en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them  ; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone  ; till thy people pass over , O  Lord  , till the people pass over , which thou hast purchased .
kha: Ka jingshyrkhei bad ka jingkhuslai ki wan hap halor jong ki . Ki ïohi ïa ka bor jong me , ko  Trai  , ki ïeng khlem lait kren da ka jingtieng , tad haduh ba ki briew jong me ki la ïaid lait sha shiliang — ki briew kiba me la pyllaitluid na ka jinglongmraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingtieng bad ka jingtieng kan hap halor jong ki ; da ka jingkhraw jong ka kti jong me kin long kum u maw ; haduh ba ki briew jong me kin iaid lait noh, ko Trai, haduh ba ki briew kin iaid lait noh, kiba me la thied .

en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren , upon whose head the anointing oil was poured , and that is consecrated to put on the garments , shall not uncover his head , nor rend his clothes  ;
kha: U Rangbah lyngdoh ha uba ïa ka umphniang pynsleh la theh ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ïa uba la pynkyntang ban phong ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , um dei ban ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba long u rangbah lyngdoh napdeng ki hynmen jong u, ha ka khlieh jong u la theh ia ka umphniang pynsleh bad uba la pynkyntang ban phong ia ki jain , un ym tap ia ka khlieh jong u, lymne un ym pynkhuid ia ki jain jong u;

en: And when Felix heard these things , having more perfect knowledge of that way , he deferred them , and said , When Lysias the chief captain shall come down , I will know the uttermost of your matter .
kha: Nangta u Pheliks , uba la ïoh jingtip bha shaphang ka Lynti , u la pynsangeh shuwa ïa ka jingbishar .  Haba u Lusias , u rangbah ai hukum u poi ,  u la ong ha ki ,  ngan sa rai ïa ka kam jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Felix u la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei, haba u la kham tip ia ki ha kata ka rukom, u la pynslem ia ki, bad u la ong: Ynda u Lysias u rangbah shipai un wan hiar , ngan sa tip ia ka kam jong phi kaba kham jylliew .

en: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles : that , whereas they speak against you as evildoers , they may by your good works , which they shall behold , glorify God in the day of visitation .
kha: Ka rukom im jong phi hapdeng ki bymngeit ka dei ban long kaba bha kumta ba haba ki mudui ïa phi kum ki nongleh bymman , kin hap ban ithuh shai ïa ki kam babha jong phi bad kumta kin ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka Sngi ka jingwan jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon ia ka jingiakren jong phi kaba hok hapdeng ki Jutang: ba, katba ki kren pyrshah ia phi kum ki nongleh bymman, ki lah da ki kam babha jong phi, kiba kin iohi, ban pyndonburom ia U Blei ha ka sngi leit jngoh .

en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the  Lord  will come to meet me : and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee . And he went to an high place .
kha: Nangta u Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga pat ngan leit peit la U  Trai  un ïakynduh ne em ïa nga . Ngan sa ïathuh ha phi kat ïa kaba u pynpaw ha nga .  Kumta u la leit marwei sha kliar jong uwei u lum ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Balaam u la ong ha u Balak, To ieng hajan ka jingainguh thang jong me, bad ngan leit: khamtam eh u Trai un wan iakynduh ia nga: bad kaei kaei kaba u pyni ia nga ngan iathuh ia me . Bad u la leit sha ka jaka kaba jrong .

en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :
kha: U la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad khet noh ïa ki tnat jong u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Beh noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki sim na ki tnat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyrta jam , bad u la ong kumta , Pynduh ia u dieng , bad ot ia ki tnat jong u , pynkhih ia ki sla jong u bad pynphriang ia ki soh jong u: ai ba ki mrad kin phet noh na shapoh jong u , bad ki sim na ki tnat jong u:

en: And it shall be , when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down  ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
kha: Da pynthikna bha ha-ei u thiah , bad hadien ba u la ïohthiah , leit bad khyllied ïa ki jaiñ tap bad thiah ha ki kjat jong u . Un sa ïathuh ïa phi kaei ba phi dei ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba u la thiah, ba phin buh dak ia ka jaka ba un thiah, bad phin leit rung, bad phin plie ia ki kjat jong u, bad phin thiah ia me; bad un iathuh ia me kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Touch me not  ; for I am not yet ascended to my Father : but go to my brethren , and say unto them , I ascend unto my Father , and your Father  ; and to my God , and your God .
kha: Wat ktah ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  namar ngam pat shym la leit kiew sha U Kpa . Hynrei khie leit sha ki para jong nga bad ïathuh ïa ki ba ngan leit phai sha u , uba long U Kpa jong nga bad U Kpa jong ki , U Blei jong nga bad U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ka, Wat ktah ia nga ; namar ngam pat kiew sha U Kpa jong nga: hynrei leit sha ki hynmen jong nga, bad ong ha ki, nga kiew sha U Kpa jong nga, bad U Kpa jong phi ; bad ha U Blei jong nga .

en: And the Israelite woman s son blasphemed the name of the  Lord  , and cursed . And they brought him unto Moses : ( and his mother s name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan : )
kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kpa jong u , u dei u nong Ijipt bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dei ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri uba na ka jait Dan . Une u briew u ïakajia bad uwei u Israel hapoh ka jaka shong dara . Katba ki dang ïakajia kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  : kumta ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: U khun Israel u la kren bein ia ka kyrteng U Trai bad u la tim . Ki la wanrah ia u ha u Moses : (bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Shelomith , ka khun jong u Dabri , na ka jait Dan : )

en: The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .
kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Hosia u khun jong u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki long ki syiem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien U Trai kaba la wan ha u Hosia, u khun u Beeri, ha ki sngi u Uzziah, u Jotham, u Ahasa, bad u Hesekaiah, ki syiem Judah bad ha ki sngi u Jeroboiah u khun u Joash u syiem Israel .

en: And put fire therein , and put incense in them before the  Lord  to morrow : and it shall be that the man whom the  Lord  doth choose , he shall be holy : ye take too much upon you , ye sons of Levi .
kha: Lashai mynstep , ma phi bad ki nongbud jong phi phin shim ïa ki khiew buh ding , phin buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad leit rah ïa ki sha ka duwan . Ngin sa peit hangta ïa uno na ngi U  Trai  u la jied . Dei ma phi hi ki Lebi kiba la leh shaba palat !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to buh ding ha ka , bad to buh jingiwbih ha ki ha khmat U Trai ban sdang: bad kan long ba uta u briew uba U Trai u jied: u long uba khuid palat ia phi, phi ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi .

en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians . Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt , in the sight of Pharaoh s servants , and in the sight of the people .
kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa ki Israel . Shisha , ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew baroh ki ñiew ba u Moses u dei u briew uba khraw katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ia ki briew ha khmat ki nong Ijipt . Nalor kata u briew u Moses u la long uba khraw shibun ha ka ri Ijipt , ha khmat ki shakri jong u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki briew .

en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us ( not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God , ) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ :
kha: kaba long ka dak kaba kdew sha ka jingpynbaptis , kaba pyllait im ïa phi mynta . Kam dei ka jingsait noh ïa ka jakhlia na ka met , hynrei ka jingkular ba la pynlong sha U Blei na ka jingïatiplem babha . Ka pynim ïa phi da ka jingmihpat jong U Jisu Khrist ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dur kaba kum kata ha kaba wat ka jingpynbaptis ruh mynta ka pynim ia ngi (ym ka jingpynkylla ia ka jingjakhlia jong ka doh , hynrei ka jubab jong ka jingsngewbha sha U Blei , ) da ka jingmihpat U Jisu Khrist:

en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands , and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them : the Great , the Mighty God , the  Lord  of hosts , is his name ,
kha: Me la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh sha ki hajar , hynrei me pynshitom ruh ïa ki briew na ka bynta ki pop ki kmie ki kpa jong ki . Me long U Blei bakhraw bad badonbor ; me long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me pyni ia ka jingieit ia ki hajar ngut ki kpa sha ka kpoh jong ki khun jong ki hadien jong ki: U Blei Bakhraw, U Trai jong ki paid, u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh kiwei ki nongbah ka Judah . Wat mynta ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , bad ym don ba sah ha ki namar ki briew jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa nga ban bitar . Ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki ne ma phi ne ki kpa tymmen jong phi kim ju mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingsniew jong ki kaba ki la leh ban pynmih ia nga ban bitar , ha kaba ki la leit thang jingiwbih bad ban shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei kiba kim tip , lymne ma ki, ne ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Come up to me into the mount , and be there : and I will give thee tables of stone , and a law , and commandments which I have written  ; that thou mayest teach them .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wan kiew sha nga ha une u lum , bad katba me dang don hangne , ngan ai ha me ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba don ïa ki hukum baroh kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta ban hikai ïa ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, To wan shaneng ha nga sha u lum, bad to don hangta : bad ngan ai ia me ia ki maw bad ka hukum bad ki hukum kiba nga la thoh; ba me lah ban hikai ia ki .

en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .
kha: Haba ym don pisa shuh ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan , baroh ki nong Ijipt ki ïawan sha u Joseph , bad ki ong ,  Ai jingbam ba ngin bam ! Wat ai ba ngin shu ïapthngan ! Ngim don pisa shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ka pisa ka la duna ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka ri Kanaan, ki nong Ijipt baroh ki la wan sha u Joseph bad ki la ong: Ai ia ngi ia u kpu: namar balei ngi dei ban iap ha khmat jong me ? namar ka pisa ka la jah noh .

en: Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .
kha: A  Trai  , naduh kaba nyngkong eh me long U Blei . Me long U Blei jong nga , uba khuid bad uba bymjukut . A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga bad u nongïada , me la jied ïa ki nong Babilonia bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba khlaiñ khnang ba kin lah ban pynshitom ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me long na bymjukut, ko Trai jong nga, ko Blei Bakhuid jong nga? ngin ym iap . Ko Trai, me la buh ia ki na ka bynta ka jingbishar ; bad ko Blei uba donbor, me la pynskhem ia ki na ka bynta ka jingpynbeit .

en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come , saying , What is this ? that thou shalt say unto him , By strength of hand the  Lord  brought us out from Egypt , from the house of bondage :
kha: Hadien habud , ynda u khun jong phi u kylli ïa phi ka mut aïu kane ka jingrakhe , phin jubab ïa u , ‘ Da kaba pyndonkam ïa la ka borbah , U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba ngi la long ki mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long haba u khun jong me un kylli ia me ha ka por ban wan, da kaba ong, Kaei kane ? ba me ong ha u: Da ka bor jong ka kti U Trai u la pynmih ia ngi na Ijipt, na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw:

en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba kin pynïap ïa ki khun jong pha , bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpang , ka jingleh thombor , bad ka thma ban pynïap ïa pha . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan phah ia phi ia ka jingkyrduh bad ki mrad kiba sniew, bad kin pynduh noh ia me bad ka jingpang bad ka snam kan iaid lyngba jong me ; bad ngan wanrah ia ka waitlam halor jong me . Nga U Trai nga la kren ia kata .

en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .
kha: U Gaal u ïohi ïa ki , bad u ong ha u Sebul ,  Ha khmih ! La don ki briew kiba wan hiar na kliar ki lum !  Kito kim dei ki briew ,  jubab u Sebul .  Ki shu long tang ki syrngiew halor ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gaal u la iohi ia ki briew, u la ong ha u Zebul, Ha khmih ki briew ki wan hiar na jrong ki lum . Bad u Zebul u la ong ha u , Me iohi ia ka jingdum jong ki lum kumba ki long ki briew .

en: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed  ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .
kha: U Blei u ong ,  Em . Ka Sarah , ka tnga jong me kan sa kha khun shynrang ïa me , bad men khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak . Ngan bat ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ka dei ka jutang baïaineh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong: Ka Sarah jong me kan kha ia me u khun shisha bad me dei ban khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Isaak: bad ngan pynskhem ia ka jutang jong nga bad u na ka bynta ka jutang bymjukut bad bad u symbai jong u hadien jong u .

en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .
kha: Ki la kyntait ban ai jingbam bad ai um ïa phi mynba phi don ha lynti na Ijipt , bad ki la khot wai ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la iakynduh ia phi da u kpu bad ka um ha lynti , haba phi la mih na Ijipt bad namar ba ki la thung ia u Balaam u khun u Beor u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Balaam u Bala

en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u hukum ïa uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ban shim ïa ka ding napdeng ki shalyntem kiba don hapoh ki kherub , uta u briew u rung shapoh bad u ïeng hajan kawei na ki shalyntem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u la hukum ia uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lin, u da ong: To shim ding na pdeng ki tyrpeng, na pdeng ki cherubim ; nangta u la rung shapoh bad u la ieng hajan ki tyrpeng .

en: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west , and to the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Jebusite in the mountains , and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah .
kha: U la phah ktien ruh sha ki Kanaan kiba don ha baroh arliang jong ka Jordan , sha ki Amor , sha ki Hit , sha ki Peris , bad sha ki Jebus kiba ha ka ri lum , kumjuh ruh sha ki Hib kiba shong ha trai u Lum Hermon ha ka ri Mispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki nong Kana ha ka liang mihngi bad shaphang sepngi, bad ha ka ri Amor, bad ha ka ri Hittite, bad ha ki ri Hittite bad ha ki lum , bad ha ki ri Hivite hapoh ka ri Mesa .

en: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him , Give us seven days  respite , that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel : and then , if there be no man to save us , we will come out to thee .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Jabesh ki ong ,  Ai por ïa ngi hynñiew sngi ban phah nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Israel . Te lada ym don u ban wan ïarap ïa ngi , ngin aiti ïa lade ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong u Jabesh ki la ong ha u, Ai por ia ngi hynriew sngi, ba ngin phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha ki ri Israel baroh: bad nangta lada ym don briew ban pynim ia ngi , ngin sa mih sha me .

en: And he took all the gold and the silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom , and the treasures of the king s house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .
kha: U la rah pat sha Samaria kum ka mar lute ïa baroh ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba ha ka Templ , ki tiar ki tar ka Templ ïa kiba la ap phira da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Obed Edom , bad ïa ki jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem . U la ïalam ruh ïa ki koidi lem bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka ksiar bad ka rupa baroh bad ki tiar kiba la lap ha ka iing U Blei bad u Obededom bad ki spah jong ka iing syiem ruh bad u la leit phai noh sha Samaria .

en: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets  ; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ki jingpang ha pha bad ban shah ba ka snam kan tuid ha ki lynti bah jong pha . Phan shah tur ïaleh na baroh ki liang , bad ïa ki briew jong pha yn pynïap . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan phah ia ka jingpang jong ka, bad ka snam ha ki lynti jong ka ; bad ia kiba mynsaw yn bishar hapdeng jong ka da ka waitlam ha ka man la ka liang ; bad kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .
kha: Kumta u Petros u la ong ha ka ,  Balei ba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , phi kut jingmut ban tynjuh ïa U Mynsiem jong U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la tep ïa u tnga jong pha ki la don mynta ha ka jingkhang , bad kin bah noh ïa pha ruh shabar !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ha ka, Kumno phi la ia mynjur lang ban pynshoi ia U Mynsiem U Trai ? ha khmih ki kjat jong kita kiba la tep ia u tnga jong me ki don ha ka jingkhang bad kin rah ia me shabar .

en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?
kha: Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jong u , u khiew uba long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba u leh ? Hato u khiew un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khiew ba um don jingtbit ?
translated_en_to_kha: To u ba ialeh bad u Nongthaw jong u ! Ai ba ka khyndew kan ialeh bad ki thliew khyndew . Hato ka dewbilat kan ong ia uta uba pynlong ia ka, Kaei kaba me leh ? lane ka kam jong me , Um don kti ?

en: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven , every stone about the weight of a talent : and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail  ; for the plague thereof was exceeding great .
kha: Ki phria kiba heh , uwei uwei uba khia kat sanphew kilo , ki la hap na sahit bneng ha ki briew , kiba la tim ïa U Blei namar ka khlam jong u phria , namar ka la long ka khlam kaba shyrkhei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la hap ha ki briew ka jingsawa kaba khraw na bneng, uwei pa uwei u maw shaphang ka jingkhia jong ka talent: bad ki briew ki la kren bein ia U Blei namar ka khlam jong u hail ; namar ka khlam jong ka ka ka la long kaba palat .

en: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness  ; but the battle overtook them  ; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them .
kha: Ki phet noh na ki Israel sha khmat ka jaka kynjah , hynrei kim lah shuh ban lait im . Ki la sahkut hapdeng ki shipai ba ha khmat bad ki nongïapom kiba wan mih na kata ka nongbah , bad ki la shah pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la phai noh ha khmat ki briew Israel sha ka lynti jong ka ri khlaw hynrei ka thma ka la jop ia ki ; bad ia kiba la mih na ki nongbah ki la pynjot hapdeng jong ki .

en: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall , the terrible of the nations , all of them : and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt , and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed .
kha: Ngan shah ïa ki shipai jong ki jaitbynriew kiba runar ban sei ïa ki waitlam jong ki ban pynïap ïa baroh ki briew jong me . Baroh ki briew jong me bad kiei kiei de kiba me sarong yn sa pynjot thiaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki waitlam jong ki riewshlur ngan pynlong ia ka kynhun jong me ban hap , kaba shyrkhei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh: bad kin pynjot ia ka jingkhih jong ka ri Ijipt , bad ka kynhun jong ka baroh kan sa shah pynjot .

en: At his day thou shalt give him his hire , neither shall the sun go down upon it  ; for he is poor , and setteth his heart upon it : lest he cry against thee unto the  Lord  , and it be sin unto thee .
kha: Man la ka sngi shuwa ban sep sngi , siew dep ïa ka bainong jong u ha kata ka sngi , namar u dei uba duk bad u ap dngong ban ïoh ïa ka . Lada phim ai ïa ka , un kyang ha U  Trai  pyrshah ïa phi , bad kata kan long ka pop ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi jong u to ai ia u ia ka bainong jong u, lymne ka sngi kan hiar halor jong ka namar u long uba duk, bad u pynshong ia ka dohnud jong u halor jong ka: ioh ba un iam pyrshah ia me ha U Trai, bad ka long ka pop ha me .

en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .
kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki ïamynjur , bad haba katto katne ki nongkhaïi na Midian ki ïaid lynti nangta , ki hynmen ki la sei noh ïa u Joseph na kata ka pukri bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ishmael arphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad ki ruh ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la iaid lyngba ki nongkhaii Midian bad ki la sei bad ki la rah ia u Joseph na ka thliew, bad ki la die ia u Joseph ha ki Ishakele arphew tylli ki rupa: bad ki la wanrah ia u Joseph sha Ijipt .

en: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion , and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment , and by the spirit of burning .
kha: Da la ka bor U  Trai  un bishar bad pynkhuid ïa ka jaitbynriew bad sait noh ïa ka jingpalat jong ka Jerusalem , bad ïa ka snam kaba la pynmih noh hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Trai un sa sait ia ka jingjakhlia jong ki khun kynthei jong ka Seion , bad un sa pynkhuid ia ka snam Jerusalem na pdeng jong ka da ka mynsiem bishar bad da ka mynsiem thang .

en: They say still unto them that despise me , The  Lord  hath said , Ye shall have peace  ; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart , No evil shall come upon you .
kha: Ha ki briew kiba kyntait ban sngap ïa kaei kaba nga la ong , ki ïai-ong ba baroh ka long bha bad ki . Bad ki ïathuh ïa uwei uwei baroh uba mutlop ba ka jingjot kan ym ktah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dang ong ha ki kiba sngewsih ia nga , U Trai u la ong , Phin ioh ia ka jingsuk bad ki ong ha uwei pa uwei uba iaid katkum ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong u hi: Ym don ka jingsniew kaba wan ha phi .

en: Thou art filled with shame for glory : drink thou also , and let thy foreskin be uncovered : the cup of the  Lord s  right hand shall be turned unto thee , and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory .
kha: Markylliang yn tap ïa phi da ka jinglehrain ha ka jaka ka burom . Phi ruh phin ïadih bad ïaid sheng sheng . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi ban dih na la ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , bad ka burom jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingjahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la dap da ka jingsngewlehrain na ka bynta ka burom: me ruh to dih: bad to ai ba ka khmat jong me kan paw: ka khuri jong U Trai kan phai sha me , bad ka jingkyrhuh kaba pynjah burom kan long ha ka burom jong me .

en: And Elisha said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , surely , were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , I would not look toward thee , nor see thee .
kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , uba nga shakri , nga smai ba ngam don ei ei bad phi lada ngam burom ïa u paralok jong phi , u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la ong: Kumba U Trai jong ki paid u im, ha khmat jong nga, shisha, lada ngam shym la pyrkhat ia ka jingdon jong u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah , ngan ym peit sha me , lymne ngan ym iohi ia me .

en: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh sha u bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba mane blei thala , ki leh donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka bor nadong shadong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la khot ia ki ha u , bad u la ong ha ki , Phi tip ba kita kiba la shah khein ban synshar halor ki Jutang ki leh ia ka jingsynshar halor jong ki ; bad ki rangbah jong ki ki leh ia ka bor halor jong ki .

en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;
kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng , uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban jia ha ka lawei . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lah ïoh mynba phi dang ïohthiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng uba pynpaw ia ki jingmaham, bad u pyntip ha u syiem Nebuchadnezzar ia kaei kaban sa jia ha ki sngi kiba hadien . Ka jingphohsniew jong me bad ki jingphohsniew jong ka khlieh jong me halor ka jingthiah jong me, ki long kine;

en: But thus do unto them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :
kha: Na ka jait u Gershon ki mih ki longïing jong u Libni bad u Shimei ; kine ki long ki jait Gershon .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumta to leh ia ki, ba kin im, bad ba kin ym iap, haba ki leit sha kiei kiei kiba khuid tam: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin leit rung , bad kin thung ia ki iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia ka jingshakri jong u bad ha ka jingkit jong u:

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah :
kha: Nga ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew baroh da ka jingtim ba la thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaba la pule ha khmat u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha kane ka jaka bad ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka , wat ia ki jingtim baroh kiba la thoh ha ka Kitab kaba ki la pule ha khmat u syiem Judah:

en: Wherefore , though I wrote unto you , I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered wrong , but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you .
kha: Kumta , wat la nga la thoh ïa kato ka shithi , ka la long ym namar jong uta uba la leh bymdei lane na ka bynta uta uba la shah leh bymdei . Pynban , nga la thoh ïa ka khnang ban pynshai ha phi , ha khmat jong U Blei , katno ka long da shisha kaba jylliew ka jingaiti jong phi sha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, wat la nga la thoh sha phi, ngam shym la leh ia kata na ka bynta jong u uba la leh bakla, lane na ka bynta jong u uba la shah shitom bakla, hynrei ba ka jingsumar jong ngi ia phi ha khmat U Blei kan paw ha phi .

en: And mine eye shall not spare thee , neither will I have pity : but I will recompense thy ways upon thee , and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha , ne pyn-i jingisynei ei ei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha na ka bynta ki kam ba-ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khmat jong nga kan ym pyllait ia me, lymne ngan ym sngewsynei: hynrei ngan pynphai ia ki lynti jong me ha me: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: O Lord  God  , thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness , and thy mighty hand : for what God is there in heaven or in earth , that can do according to thy works , and according to thy might ?
kha: ‘ Ko Trai Nongsynshar , me la pyn-i ha la u shakri dang tang ïa kaba sdang jong ki kam kiba khraw bad kiba phylla jong me . Ym don blei ha bneng ne ha khyndew uba lah ban leh ïa ki kam kiba khraw kiba me , me la leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai Blei, me la sdang ban pyni ia ka jingkhraw jong me bad ka kti ba donbor jong me: namar kaei kaba U Blei u don ha bneng ne ha khyndew , kaba lah ban leh kat kum ki kam jong me bad kat kum ka bor jong me ?

en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him  ; but he refused to be comforted  ; and he said , For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning . Thus his father wept for him .
kha: Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u baroh ki la ïawan ban pyntngen ïa u , hynrei u kyntait ban shah pyntngen bad u ong ,  Ngan leit noh sha ka ri kiba ïap bad ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u khun jong nga .  Kumta u ïai ïam sngewsih na ka bynta u Joseph u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki khun shynrang jong u baroh bad ki khun kynthei jong u baroh ki la ieng ban pyntngen ia u ; hynrei u la kyntait ban shah pyntngen ; bad u la ong: Namar ngan leit hiar shapoh ka jingtep sha u khun jong nga da kaba iam . Kumta u kpa jong u u iam na ka bynta jong u .

en: And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :
kha: Hynrei , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bha pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la nang duna , u dei ban tar noh ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh na kata ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u lyngdoh u peit, bad, ha khmih, ka khlam ka dum katto katne hadien ba la sait ia ka ; te un pynkhih ia ka na ka jain, ne na ka sniehdoh, ne na ka sniehdoh:

en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the  Lord  , and to the king s palace , and harps and psalteries for singers : and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah .
kha: U Solomon u pyndonkam ïa uta u dieng ha kaba shna ïa ki mawkyrdon ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u , bad ha kaba shna ïa ki duitara bad jingtem ksai na ka bynta ki nongput nongtem . Ym pat ju don kum kata ha kaba lah ban ïohi mynshuwa ha ka ri Judah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem u la shna ia ki dieng kiba la shna da ki dieng ha ka iing U Trai, bad ha ka iing syiem, bad ki harp bad ki jingrwai na ka bynta ki nongrwai: bad ym shym la iohi ia kiba kum kita mynshuwa ha ka ri Judah .

en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings , and eat it  ; but the  Lord  accepteth them not  ; now will he remember their iniquity , and visit their sins : they shall return to Egypt .
kha: Ki ai ïa ki jingkñia sha nga bad ki bam ïa ka doh kñia . Hynrei ma nga U Trai , ngam sngewbha ïa ki , bad mynta ngan kynmaw ïa ki pop jong ki bad pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata ; ngan phah biang ïa ki sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki knia ia ki jingknia jong nga, bad ki bam ia ka ; hynrei U Trai um pdiang ia ki; mynta un kynmaw ia ka jingbymhok jong ki, bad un leit jngoh ia ki pop jong ki: kin leit phai noh sha Ijipt .

en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew uba la lait im na Jerusalem , u la wan sha nga bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingshah set jong ngi, ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai, ba uta uba la lait na Jerusalem u la wan sha nga, u da ong: Ka shnong ka la shah pynjot .

en: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech , and Seraiah the son of Azriel , and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel , to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet : but the  Lord  hid them .
kha: Nangta u la hukum ïa u khun syiem Jerahmeel , ryngkat bad u Seraïah u khun jong u Asriel bad u Shelemaïah u khun jong u Abdeel , ban kem ïa nga bad ïa u sekretari jong nga u Barukh . Hynrei U  Trai  u la buhrieh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u syiem u la hukum ia u Jerahmeel u khun u Hamelek bad u Seraiah u khun u Azriel bad u Sheemaiah u khun u Abdeel ban shim ia u Baruk u nongthoh bad u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa: hynrei U Trai u la buhrieh ia ki .

en: And Sarai said unto Abram , My wrong be upon thee : I have given my maid into thy bosom  ; and when she saw that she had conceived , I was despised in her eyes : the  Lord  judge between me and thee .
kha: Te ka Sarai ka ong ha u Abram ,  Dei namar jong me ba ka Hagar ka ibeiñ ïa nga ! Nga hi nga la ai ïa ka ha me , bad naduh ba ka tip ba ka la punkhun , ka ibeiñ ïa nga . Ai ba U  Trai  un bishar mano ba dei napdeng jong ngi , ma me lane ma nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U Sarai u la ong ha u Abram, Ka jingbakla jong nga ka long halor jong me: nga la ai ia ka shakri jong nga ha ka kpoh jong me; bad haba ka la iohi ba ka la pun khun, nga la shah niewbein ha ki khmat jong ka: U Trai u bishar hapdeng jong nga bad me .

en: And when he had given him licence , Paul stood on the stairs , and beckoned with the hand unto the people . And when there was made a great silence , he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue , saying ,
kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la shah ïa u , kumta u Paul u la ïeng halor ki mawkyrdon bad u la ai dak da ki kti jong u ha u paidbah ban sngap jar . Haba ki la sngap jar , u Paul u la kren ïa ki ha ka ktien Hebru :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la ai laisen ia u, u Paul u la ieng ha ki step bad u la pynkhih da ka kti sha ki briew . Bad haba la sngap jar shibun u la kren ha ki da ka shyntur Hebru da kaba ong:

en: For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .
kha: Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit ki lah ban twa , hynrei ka jingieit jong nga ïa pha kan ym kut noh ; ngan pynneh junom ïa la ka kular jong ka jingsuk .  Kumta te ong U  Trai  uba ieit ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki lum kin jah noh , bad ki lum kin jah noh tang shuh shuh hynrei ka jingbha jong nga kan ym jah noh na me , lymne ka jutang jong ka jingsuk jong nga kan ym jah noh , ong U Trai uba isynei ia me .

en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .
kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan bad ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat :  Ka kynhun shipai babun paid na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason Tamar .  ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka Engedi . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wan don kiba la iathuh ha u Jehoshaphat, ki da ong, Ka wan ka kynhun kaba khraw pyrshah ia me na sha shiliang duriaw ha kane ka liang ka Syria; bad, ha khmih, ki don ha Haszontamar, kaba long ka Endigedi .

en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :
kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jong u ba kata ka prum ka long kumjuh bad kam shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh un peit ia u ha ka sngi kaba hynriew: bad, ha khmih, lada ka khlam ha khmat jong u ka long ha ka jaka sah, bad ka khlam kam saphriang ha ka sniehdoh ; te u lyngdoh un khang ia u hynriew sngi shuh shuh:

en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai bor ïa nga , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la U Trai u la ieng bad nga, bad u la pynskhem ia nga; ba da nga la ithuh pura ia ka jingialap, bad ba ki Jutang baroh kin iohsngew: bad nga la shah pyllait na ka shyntur jong u sing .

en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people  ; then let him bring for his sin , which he hath sinned , a young bullock without blemish unto the  Lord  for a sin offering .
kha: Lada dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh uba leh pop bad da kumta u wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ha ki paidbah , un ai ïa u masi lyngraw u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad un kñia sha U  Trai  namar ka pop jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u lyngdoh uba la shah pynsleh u leh pop katkum ka pop jong ki briew te un wanrah ia ka pop jong u kaba u la leh pop, u khun masi khlem jingduna ha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingknia pop .

en: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her : the daughters of the nations shall lament her : they shall lament for her , even for Egypt , and for all her multitude , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Kane ka jingmaham bakyntang kan long ka jingrwai ïapbriew . Ki kynthei na ki jaitbynriew kin ïarwai sngewsih na ka bynta ka Ijipt bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh . Ma nga , u  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingsngewsih ha kaba kin iam ia ka: ki khun kynthei jong ki jaitbynriew kin iam ia ka: kin iam na ka bynta jong ka, wat na ka bynta ka ri Ijipt bad na ka bynta ka jingbun briew jong ka baroh kawei, ong U Trai Blei .

en: Moreover ye see and hear , that not alone at Ephesus , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people , saying that they be no gods , which are made with hands :
kha: Mynta , phi lah ban ïohi bad ïohsngew da lade aïu une u Paul u leh . U ong ba ki blei kiba la shna da ki kti jong ki briew kim long da shisha ki blei , bad u la jop ha kaba pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki briew , hangne ha Ephesos bad hajan baroh kawei jong ka probins jong ka Asia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata phi iohi bad iohsngew ia kata ym tang ha Ephesos hynrei la jan ha kylleng ka Asia, une u Paul u la pynsngewthuh bad pynphai noh ia kiba bun ki briew, da kaba ong ba kim long ki blei kiba la shna da ki kti:

en: At the same time spake the  Lord  by Isaiah the son of Amoz , saying , Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins , and put off thy shoe from thy foot . And he did so , walking naked and barefoot .
kha: Lai snem mynshuwa , U  Trai  u la ong ïa u Isaïah u khun jong u Amos ban loit noh ïa ki juti jong u bad ïa ka jaiñ khain kaba u phong . U la kohnguh bad u la ïaid lyngkhuit bad da ka kjat suda .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por u la kren ia U Trai da u Isaiah u khun u Amoz, u da ong: Leit bad pyllait noh ia ka jainkup na ki tyrpeng jong me, bad weng noh ia ka juti jong me na ka kjat jong me . Bad u la leh kumta, da kaba iaid lyngkhuid bad khlem jain .

en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .
kha: Ngan pynthikna ba ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin tip ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom . Te ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngan pynpaw ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga hapdeng ki briew jong nga; bad ki nongwei kin tip ba nga long U Trai , Uba khuid ha Israel .

en: And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house , and , behold , his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances : and she was his only child  ; beside her he had neither son nor daughter .
kha: Haba u Jephthah u wan phai sha la ïing ha Mispah , ka khun jong u ka wan ban ïakynduh ïa u , ka da shad bad tem ïa ka ksing . Ka dei ka khun marwei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jephthah u la wan sha ka iing jong u, bad, ha khmih, ka khun jong u ka la mih ban iakynduh ia u da ki dieng bad da ki jingshad: bad ka la long tang kawei ka khun jong u; hajan jong ka um don khun shynrang ne kynthei .

en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate : and the Syrians of Zobah , and of Rehob , and Ish–tob , and Maacah , were by themselves in the field .
kha: Ki Ammon ki la wan mih bad ki ïeng pynkhreh ïaleh ha ka jaka rung sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ki , katba kiwei pat , ki Syria bad ki rangbah na Tob bad Maakah , ki la ïeng pynkhreh ïaleh ha rudnong bym don jingkah ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la mih noh, bad ki la buh ia ka thma ha ka jaka rung jong ka khyrdop: bad ki Syria jong ka Sobah bad ka Rehob bad ka Ishtob bad ka Maah ki la don hi ha lyngkha .

en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .
kha: Haba ka briew kan sa kha khun , ka sngewsih namar ba ka kynta jong ka jingshahshitom jong ka , ka la poi ; hynrei haba la kha ïa i khunlung , ka klet noh ïa la ka jingshah shitom , namar ka kmen ba la kha ïa i khunlung sha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kynthei haba ka dang kha khun ka don ka jingsngewsih namar ka por jong ka ka la poi: hynrei tang shu kha ia ka khun , kam kynmaw shuh ia ka jingsngewsih , namar ka jingkmen ba la kha ia u briew ha ka pyrthei .

en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .
kha: Pynban , hadien lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la phet noh sha u Akhish , u syiem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba kut jong ki lai snem, ba arngut ki shakri jong u Shimei ki la phet noh sha u Achish u khun u Maachah u syiem Gath . Ki la iathuh ha u Shimei ki da ong: Ha khmih ki shakri jong me ki don ha Gath .

en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , saying , This is the law of the sin offering : In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the  Lord  : it is most holy .
