kha: To wallam ka jingjahburom halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga , hynrei pyllait im ïa nga , A  Trai . Pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei wat pynshyrkhei ïa nga . To wallam ka jingjot ha ki bad pynkdiah lyngkhot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin sngewlehrain kiba pynshitom bein ia nga, hynrei wat ai ba ngan sngewlehrain: to ai ba kin sngewsih , hynrei wat ai ba ngan sngewsih: to wanrah ia ki ia ka sngi kaba sniew , bad pynjot ia ki da ka jingpynjot kaba arsien .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned unto Zion , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth  ; and the mountain of the  Lord  of hosts the holy mountain .
kha: Ngan wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga , bad ban shong ban sah hangta . Ïa ka yn tip kum ka nongbah baïaineh , bad ïa u lum jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh yn khot u lum bakyntang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai ; nga la wan phai sha Seion, bad ngan shong hapdeng ka Jerusalem: bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah jong ka jingshisha ; bad u lum jong U Trai jong ki paid u lum bakhuid .

en: Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .
kha: Uei une uba wan na ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Uei une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha ka bor bad jingkhlaiñ ?   U dei U Trai , uba donbor ban pyllait im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba wan na Edom, bad ki jain ba la rong na Bosrah ? kane kaba donburom ha ka jainkup jong u , kaba iaid ha ka jingkhraw jong ka bor jong u ? Nga uba kren ha ka hok , uba donbor ban pynim .

en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation , they shall wash with water , that they die not  ; or when they come near to the altar to minister , to burn offering made by fire unto the  Lord  :
kha: ha shuwa ba kin leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , lane shuwa ba kin leit hajan ka duwan ban ai ïa ka jingainguh bam khnang ba kin ym ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki leit shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïalang , kin sait da ka um , ba kin ym ïap ; ne haba ki wan hajan ka ïingkhuid ban shakri , ban thang da ka ding sha U Trai:

en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place , where the ashes are poured out , and burn him on the wood with fire : where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt .
kha: un rah ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid ha kaba yn theh ïa u dpei , bad hangta un thang ha ka kynton diengïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia u masi baroh kawei un rah sha ka jaka kaba khuid, ha kaba la theh ia ka dewbilat bad un thang ia u ha u dieng da ka ding: ha kaba la theh ia ka dewbilat un shah thang .

en: And the garment , either warp , or woof , or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash , if the plague be departed from them , then it shall be washed the second time , and shall be clean .
kha: Lada u sait ïa kata bad ka jingbthuh ka jah noh , u dei ban sait biang ïa ka sa shisien , bad kan sa long kaba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jain, la ka long kaba sniew ne kaba sniew, kaba me dei ban sait, lada ka khlam ka jah noh na ki, te dei ban sait ia ka ha ka sien kaba ar bad kan long kaba khuid .

en: And when she could not longer hide him , she took for him an ark of bulrushes , and daubed it with slime and with pitch , and put the child therein  ; and she laid it in the flags by the river s brink .
kha: Hynrei haba kam lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa u , ka shim kawei ka shang ba la shna na u khah bad ka lape ïa ka da ka bsiang ban ym pei um . Ka pynthiah ïa uta u khunlung hapoh kata ka shang bad ka buh ïa ka hapdeng ki khah harud jong ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kam lah shuh ban buhrieh ia u, ka la shim na ka bynta jong u ia ka synduk jong ki bniat, bad ka la pynkhih ia ka da ka sniehdoh bad da ka madan, bad ka la buh ia u khynnah ha kata ka ; bad ka la buh ia ka ha ki lama da ka wah .

en: And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
kha: Na ki jingkñia ainguh kiba da u masi ne ka langbrot , ki lyngdoh ki dei ban ïoh ïa ka tyrpeng , baroh ar ki ngab , bad ka  nierbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane kan long ka jinglong lyngdoh na ki briew, na kito kiba ai ia ka jingknia, la ka long ka masi ne ka langbrot ; bad kin ai ha u lyngdoh ia ka tyrpeng bad ki ar tylli ki rmiang shyntur bad u maw .

en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .
kha: Ki ktien ha kane ka kitab ki long kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel mynba ki don ha ka ri khlaw sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan . Ki ïadon ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong Paran ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long ki ktien kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel baroh ha kane ka liang ka ri Jordan, ha ka madan pyrshah ia ka duriaw Basaw, hapdeng ka Paran, bad ka Tophel, bad u Laban, bad u Haseroth, bad u Dzahab .

en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you , of them shall ye buy , and of their families that are with you , which they begat in your land : and they shall be your possession .
kha: Phi lah ruh ban thied ïa ki khun jong ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi . Kum kita ïa kiba la kha ha ka ri jong phi ki lah ban long ka jingïohkynti jong phi ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata na ki khun jong ki nongwei kiba sah hapdeng jong phi, na ki phin thied, bad na ki longiing jong ki kiba don bad phi, kiba ki kha ha ka ri jong phi: bad kin long ki jong phi .

en: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes , there met him two possessed with devils , coming out of the tombs , exceeding fierce , so that no man might pass by that way .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan sha ka thain Gadara ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw , la ïashem ïa u da ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la wan mih ïa ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Kine ki rangbah ki la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki bad ki la long kiba itriem shikatdei ba ym don mano mano ba nud ban leit na kata ka lynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la poi sha kawei pat ka liang ha ka ri jong ki Genes , u la iakynduh ia u arngut ki ksuid kiba mih na ki jingtep , kiba palat ia ka jingkhlain , khnang ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban iaid kumta .

en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold , I cannot go beyond the commandment of the  Lord  , to do either good or bad of mine own mind  ; but what the  Lord  saith , that will I speak ?
kha: ba wat lada phi ai lut ha nga ïa ka ksiar ka rupa kaba don ha ka ïingsyiem jong phi , ngan ym ïaid palat ïa ka hukum U  Trai  da kaba leh ïa kaei kaei da la ka mon . Ngan kren tang ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha nga ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u Balak un ai ia nga ia ka iing jong u kaba dap da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ngam lah ban iaid shabar ka hukum U Trai , ban leh ia kaba bha ne kaba sniew jong nga hi; hynrei ia kaba U Trai u ong , kata ngan kren ?

en: And Elisha saw it , and he cried , My father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof . And he saw him no more : and he took hold of his own clothes , and rent them in two pieces .
kha: U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la pyrta jam ha u Elijah ,  Ko pa jong nga , ko pa jong nga ! Ko nongïada bakhrawbor jong ki Israel ! Phi la leit noh !  Bad um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u Elijah . Ha ka jingsngewsih , u Elisha u la kad arliang ïa la ka jaiñkup .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la iohi ia ka, bad u la pyrta, ko kpa jong nga, ka kali Israel bad ki kulai jong ka . Bad um shym la iohi shuh ia u: bad u la bat ia la ki jong ki jain, bad u la pynpra ia ki ar tylli .

en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired , namely , by them beyond the river , by the king of Assyria , the head , and the hair of the feet : and it shall also consume the beard .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , U  Trai  un wai uwei u nongkhap shñiuh na sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis — u patsha jong ka Assyria ! — bad un khi ïa ki tmain jong phi bad ïa ki shñiuh halor ki khlieh bad ki met jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi U Trai un ot da ka razor kaba la thung, kata, da ki sha shiliang wah, da u syiem Assyria, ka khlieh bad ki shniuh kjat: bad kan bam ruh ia ka ryndang .

en: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet , and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his device that he had devised against the Jews .
kha: Nangta ka Esther ka kren biang ha u syiem da kaba dem ha ki kjat jong u bad ïam . Ka kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingsylla basniew kaba u Haman , uba hiarpateng na u Agag , pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esther u la kren biang ha khmat u syiem bad u la dem da ki ummat ban weng noh ia ka jingsniew jong u Haman u Agagite bad ka buit jong u kaba u la thmu pyrshah ia ki Jiw .

en: And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kynrad jong nga bad u la pynlong ïa u , u briew uba riewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiar , ki mraw shynrang bad kynthei , ki ut bad ki kada .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la kyrkhu shibun ia u kynrad jong nga bad u la kylla long uba khraw: bad u la ai ia u ia ki langbrot bad ki masi bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar bad ki nongtrei bad ki nongtrei bad ki kulai bad ki kada .

en: And if the latter husband hate her , and write her a bill of divorcement , and giveth it in her hand , and sendeth her out of his house  ; or if the latter husband die , which took her to be his wife  ;
kha: bad uta ruh u rai ba um mon shuh ïa ka , kumta u thoh ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga , u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ïing jong u , lane , haba u tnga jong ka uba ar u ïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u tnga uba hadien u shun ia ka, bad u thoh ia ka ha ka kti jong ka, bad u phah ia ka na iing jong u ; lane lada u tnga uba hadien u iap, kaba la shim ia ka ban long ka tnga jong u ; .

en: But when divers were hardened , and believed not , but spake evil of that way before the multitude , he departed from them , and separated the disciples , disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus .
kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na ki , ki long kiba mynthi bad kim ngeit , bad ha khmat ka kynhun baroh kawei ki la kren ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang ka Lynti jong U Trai . Kumta u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la ïalam bad u ïa kiba ngeit bad man la ka sngi u la pynlong ki jingïaphylliew jingmut ha ka kamra hikai u Tyrannus .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba ki nongleit jingleit ki la nang jur, bad kim shym la ngeit, hynrei ki la kren bein kumta ha khmat u paidbah, u la leit noh na ki, bad u la pyniakhlad ia ki synran, da kaba ialeh man ka sngi ha ka skul jong uwei u Tyrososos .

en: But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :
kha: haba mynta u Timothi u la wanna ph sha ngi , bad u la wanrah sha ngi ïa ka khubor kaba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit jong phi . Bad U la ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pyrkhat bha ïa ngi borabor ba phi kwah hir hir ban ïohi ïa ngi kumba ma ngi ruh , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta haba u Timothi u la wan na phi sha ngi, bad u la wanrah ia ngi ia ka khubor babha jong ka jingngeit bad ka jingai sngewbha jong phi, bad ba phi don ka jingkynmaw babha ia ngi man ka por, da kaba kwah shibun ban iohi ia ngi, kumba ngi ruh ngi iohi ia phi:

en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O my people , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , and bring you into the land of Israel .
kha: Kumta ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad ong ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan plied ïa ki jingtep jong ki . Ngan sei noh ïa ki shabar , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to iathuhlypa bad to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih ko ki briew jong nga , ngan plie ia ki jingtep jong phi , bad ngan pynlong ia phi ban mih na ki jingtep jong phi , bad ngan wanrah ia phi sha ka ri Israel .

en: It may be they will present their supplication before the  Lord  , and will return every one from his evil way : for great is the anger and the fury that the  Lord  hath pronounced against this people .
kha: Lehse kin duwai ha U  Trai  bad phai pat na ki lynti bymman jong ki , namar U  Trai  u la byrngem ïa kane ka jaitbynriew da ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lehse kin pyni ia ka jingkyrpad jong ki ha khmat U Trai , bad kin pynphai noh ia uwei pa uwei na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u: namar ka long kaba khraw ia ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar kaba U Trai u la pynpaw pyrshah ia une u briew .

en: Then Judah came near unto him , and said , Oh my lord , let thy servant , I pray thee , speak a word in my lord s ears , and let not thine anger burn against thy servant : for thou art even as Pharaoh .
kha: Nangta u Judah u leit kham hajan u Joseph , bad u ong ,  Ko kynrad , shah ïa nga ban kren laitluid bad phi . Wat bitar ïa nga , phi long kum u syiem hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Judah u la wan hajan jong u bad u la ong, ko kynrad jong nga, to ai ba u shakri jong me, nga kyrpad ia me, un kren ia ka ktien ha ki shkor jong u kynrad jong nga, bad wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong me kan thang ia u shakri jong me: namar me long wat kum u Pharaoh .

en: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : he hath a blemish  ; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God .
kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew uba hiarpateng na u Aaron , u lyngdoh , uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don u briew uba don ka jingduna jong u symbai Aaron u lyngdoh un wan hajan ban aiti ia ki jingknia jong U Trai ba la shna da ka ding: u don ka jingduna ; un ym wan hajan ban aiti ia u kpu U Blei jong u .

en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night  ; yea , with my spirit within me will I seek thee early : for when thy judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness .
kha: Mynmiet nga thrang ïa me da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ; haba me bishar ïa ka pyrthei bad ki briew jong ka , baroh kin tip kaei ka long ka jingbishar hok .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka mynsiem jong nga nga la kwah ia me ha ka por miet ; hooid, da ka mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong nga ngan wad ia me kloi: namar haba ki jingbishar jong me ki don ha ka khyndew , ki nongshong shnong jong ka pyrthei kin nang ia ka hok .

en: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
kha: Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , u la ong ha ki ,  Ko para Israel , balei phi ïakyndit ha kane , bad balei ba phi peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei da ka bor jong ngi hi lane da ka jingriewblei jong ngi hi ba ngi la pynlong ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u Petros u la iohi ia ka, u la jubab ha ki briew, Phi ki briew Israel, balei phi sngew lyngngoh ia kane? lane balei phi peit skhem ia ngi, kumba da ka bor ne ka jingkhuid jong ngi hi ngi la pynlong ia une u briew ban iaid ?

en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .
kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah shukor ban ai ki jubab kiba bakla , ka dei namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la shukor ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u nongiathuhlypa u la shah thok haba u la kren ia kaei kaei, nga U Trai nga la shukor ia uta u nongiathuhlypa , bad ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor jong u , bad ngan pynjot ia u na pdeng ki briew jong nga Israel .

en: Mine age is departed , and is removed from me as a shepherd s tent : I have cut off like a weaver my life : he will cut me off with pining sickness : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
kha: Ïa ka jingim jong nga la ot noh bad ka la kut , kum ka ïingjaiñ ba la pynkhyllem , kum ka jaiñ ba la khapnoh na ka kor thain jaiñ . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rta jong nga ka la jah noh na nga kum ka ïingjaiñ nongap langbrot: Nga la ot noh kum u nongthaïi ïing jong nga: un ot noh ïa nga da ka jingpang kaba jem: naduh ka sngi haduh ka miet phin pynkut noh ïa nga .

en: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people  ; for the cause was from the  Lord  , that he might perform his saying , which the  Lord  spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  ban pynjia ïa kaei kaba U la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Dei namar kane balei ba u syiem um shym shahshkor ïa ki paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata u syiem um shym la sngap ia ki briew ; namar ka daw ka long na U Trai, ba un leh ia ka ktien jong u, kaba U Trai u la kren da u Ahiah u Shilon ha u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat .

en: Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bha ka pynlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym kumta! Ka dei ka pop kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kaei kaba bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa nga , khnang ba ïa kata ka jinglong bashisha jong ka pop yn pynpaw . Bad kumta , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham shyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kata ka long kaba bha kaba la pynlong ia nga ? U Blei u la khang . Hynrei ka pop, ba kan paw ka pop, kaba trei ha nga da kaba bha; ba ka pop da ka hukum ka lah ban long kaba palat ia ka pop .

en: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work made he them .
kha: Ki briew kiba tbit tam napdeng kita kiba trei ki shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki shna ïa ka na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka linen bani , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ha kiba la suh pynpur itynnat da ki dur jong ki Kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba stad hapdeng jong ki uba la leh ia ka kam jong ka iingjain u la shna shiphew tylli ki jain kiba la tyrkhong bha, bad kiba rong saw bad kiba rong saw: da ki cherub kiba la tyrkhong u la shna ia ki .

en: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion  ; they , they are thy lot : even to them hast thou poured a drink offering , thou hast offered a meat offering . Should I receive comfort in these ?
kha: Phi shim ïa ki maw kiba jlih nangta bad mane ïa ki kum ki blei . Phi theh ïa ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh ïa ki bad wallam sha ki ïa ki jingainguh kew . Phi tharai ba ngan sngewbha da kine kiei kiei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Napdeng ki maw kiba jem jong ka wah ka long ka bynta jong me; ki long ka bhah jong me: wat ha ki ruh me la theh ia ka jingainguh dih , me la tyrwa ia ka jingainguh bam . Hato nga dei ban pdiang ia ka jingpyntngen ha kine ?

en: For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .
kha: Lada phi leh shisha kumba nga la hukum , te ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin ïailong syiem . Bad ma ki , lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin ïai bteng ban ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop jong kane ka ïingsyiem ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada phi leh ia kane ka kam shisha, te kin rung da ki khyrdop jong kane ka iing ki syiem kiba shong ha ka khet u Dabid, ki shong ha ki kali bad ha ki kulai, ma u bad ki shakri jong u bad ki briew jong u .

en: And I have put my words in thy mouth , and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and say unto Zion , Thou art my people .
kha: Nga la pynpyiar ïa ki bneng bad pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei ; nga ong ïa ka Jerusalem , ‘ Phi long ki briew jong nga ! Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad nga ïada ïa phi da ka ksang ti jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la buh ia ki ktien jong nga ha ka shyntur jong me, bad nga la tap ia me ha ka jingdum jong ka kti jong nga, ba ngan thung ia ki bneng bad nga buh ia ki nongrim jong ka khyndew bad nga ong ha u Seion , Me long ki briew jong nga .

en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban hikai ia ki da kaba sngap jar ha ki khun jong me, bad to kren ia ki haba me shong ha iing jong me, bad haba me iaid hajan ka lynti, bad haba me thiah shapoh bad haba me khie .

en: But let none come into the house of the  Lord  , save the priests , and they that minister of the Levites  ; they shall go in , for they are holy : but all the people shall keep the watch of the  Lord .
kha: Ym don mano mano u ban rung sha ki ïing ka Templ lait noh tang ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi kiba wan ban pyndep kam . Ki lah ban rung , namar ki long kiba la pynkyntang , hynrei kiba sah jong ki paidbah ki dei ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong U  Trai  bad ban shong shabar .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat ai ba uno uno un wan shapoh ka iing U Trai, lait noh tang ki lyngdoh bad kita kiba shakri ia ki Lebi; kin leit rung: namar ki long kiba khuid: hynrei ki briew baroh kin sumar ia ka jingpahara U Trai .

en: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses  ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for thy handmaid , and for the young man which is with thy servants : there is no want of any thing .
kha: wat la ngi don la u phlang bad ki jingbam ïa ki kada jong ngi , kumjuh ruh u kpu bad ka waiñ na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa kane ka tnga kliar jong nga bad ïa une u shakri jong nga . Ngi don lut kat kaba ngi donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka don baroh ar ka sboh bad ka jingmih na ka bynta ki kada jong ngi bad ka don u kpu bad ka wain ruh na ka bynta jong nga, bad na ka bynta ka kti jong me, bad na ka bynta u samla uba don bad ki shakri jong me: ym don jingduna ei ei ruh em .

en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even : as the meat offering of the morning , and as the drink offering thereof , thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
kha: Ynda janmiet pat , ainguh ïa u langbrot uba ar ha kajuh ka rukom kumba la leh ïa ka jingainguh kaba mynstep , ryngkat bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ . Kane ruh ka dei ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u langbrot men knia ha ka por janmiet: kum ka jingainguh bam mynstep bad kum ka jingainguh dih jong ka , men knia ia ka da ka ding , ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai .

en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .
kha: Lada nga la kwah ban sngewsarong , ngan ym jin da la long uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei ngan ym kob sarong , namar ngam kwah mano mano ban don ka jingpyrkhat ba kham halor ïa nga ban ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi ba nga leh lane u la ïohsngew ïa kaba nga ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la nga kwah ban pyndonburom, ngan ym long uba bieit ; namar ngan ong ia ka jingshisha: hynrei mynta nga pyrkhat ia nga palat ia kaba u iohi ia nga ba nga long, ne ba u iohsngew ia nga .

en: Which thing I also did in Jerusalem : and many of the saints did I shut up in prison , having received authority from the chief priests  ; and when they were put to death , I gave my voice against them .
kha: Kata ka long kaei kaba nga la leh ha Jerusalem . Nga la ïohpdiang ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ban thep phatok ïa kiba bun ki briew jong U Blei ; bad haba la rai pynïap ïa ki , nga ruh nga la mynjur pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaei kaba nga ruh nga la leh ha Jerusalem: bad bun na ki riewkhuid nga la shah set phatok, haba nga la ioh ia ka bor na ki rangbah lyngdoh bad haba ki la shah pyniap;

en: And it came to pass , that when Isaac was old , and his eyes were dim , so that he could not see , he called Esau his eldest son , and said unto him , My son : and he said unto him , Behold , here am I .
kha: U Isaak mynta u la tymmen bad u la kylla matlah . U la phah khot ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Iso u bad u ong ïa u ,  Ko khun !   Oi ,  u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Isaak u la tymmen bad ki khmat jong u kim lah ban iohi, u la khot ia u Iso u khun rangbah jong u, bad u la ong ha u: Ko khun jong nga: bad u la ong ha u: Ha khmih nga don hangne .

en: And the  Lord  discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .
kha: U  Trai  u la pynkulmar jingmut ïa ki Amor ha ka jingïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel . Ki Israel ki pynïap ïa ki ha Gibeon bad ki la beh ïa ki arsut ïa ka khim lum ha Beth Horon , da kaba ïai ïaleh shaduh shaphang shathie ha Asekah bad Makkedah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la pynsngewsih ia ki ha khmat ki Israel, bad u la pyniap ia ki da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw ha Gibeon, bad u la beh ia ki ha ka lynti kaba leit sha Bethoron, bad u la pynkhih ia ki haduh Azekah, bad haduh Azekah .

en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
kha: Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkyntang ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u . Ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men teh ia ki da ki shyieng Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u: bad ka kam lyngdoh kan long ka jong ki na ka bynta ka ain kaba neh: bad men pynkyntang ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati bad ïa baroh ki nongbah ïa kiba u la tei , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Ahab bad kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh bad ka iing kaba sniew kaba u la shna bad ki nongbah baroh kiba u la tei , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Israel ?

en: And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi ruh , phin hap shah ïa kiei kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Aaron , Me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad ka iing u kpa jong me bad me kin kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka jaka kyntang: bad me bad ki khun shynrang jong me bad me kin kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka jinglong lyngdoh jong me .

en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren , that that disciple should not die : yet Jesus said not unto him , He shall not die  ; but ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ?
kha: Kumta ka khubor ka la pur hapdeng ki nongbud jong U Jisu ba une u synran un ym ïap . Hynrei U Jisu um shym ong ba un ym ïap ; u la ong ,  Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda nga wan , ka pher aïu ïa me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit noh shabar ri hapdeng ki para bangeit, ba uta u synran um dei ban iap: hynrei U Jisu um shym la ong ha u: Um dei ban iap; hynrei lada nga mon ba un sah haduh ba ngan da wan, kaei kata ha me ?

en: Behold , thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not , and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the  Lord  thy God , and for the Holy One of Israel  ; for he hath glorified thee .
kha: Mynta phin phah khot ïa ki hima ri nongwei ; mynshuwa kim shym la tip ïa phi , hynrei mynta kin wan mareh ban ïasoh bad phi ! Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , ngan pynjia ïa kane baroh ; ngan ai ha phi ïa ka burom bad jingpyndonburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih me, men khot ia ka jaitbynriew kaba me tip, bad ki jaitbynriew ki bym ithuh ia me kin mareh sha me namar U Trai U Blei jong me, bad na ka bynta U Bakhuid jong ki Israel; namar u la pyndonburom ia me .

en: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep thy commandments , thy testimonies , and thy statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for the which I have made provision .
kha: Ai ha u Solomon u khun jong nga ka jingkwah naduh ka dohnud ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me la hukum bad ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa kaba nga la pynlong kine ki jingpynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ha u Solomon u khun jong nga ka dohnud kaba janai, ban sumar ia ki hukum jong me, bad ki jingphla jong me, bad ban leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh, bad ban tei ia ka iing syiem, na ka bynta kaba nga la pynkhreh .

en: And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
kha: U Blei u jubab ,  Ngan long lem bad me , bad haba me ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lum . Kata kan long ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Hooid ngan long bad me bad kane kan long ka dak ha me: Haba me la wanrah ia ki briew na Ijipt , phin shakri ia U Blei halor une u lum .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In this thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : behold , I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river , and they shall be turned to blood .
kha: Mynta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , U  Trai  u ong ba phin sa tip u long uei da kaei kaba un sa leh . Ha khmih , ngan tied ïa ka sla um da une u diengduh , bad ka um kan kylla snam .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai , Ha kane phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai: ha khmih , ngan sa shoh da u diengduh uba don ha ka kti jong nga halor ki um kiba don ha ka wah , bad kin kylla snam .

en: David also arose afterward , and went out of the cave , and cried after Saul , saying , My lord the king . And when Saul looked behind him , David stooped with his face to the earth , and bowed himself .
kha: Nangta u Dabid ruh u mih shabar hadien jong u bad u khot ïa u ,  Syiem kynrad !  U Saul u phai dien , bad u Dabid u dem ngon sha khyndew ha ka jingburom
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid ruh u la mih hadien kata, bad u la pyrta hadien u Saul, u da ong: Ko kynrad jong nga u syiem . Bad haba u la peit shadien jong u , u Dabid u la dem khrup bad u la dem khrup ia lade .

en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines . For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace  ; not with meats , which have not profited them that have been occupied therein .
kha: Wat shah ba ki jinghikai bakhyllah baroh kin ïalam bakla ïa phi na ka lynti kaba dei . Ka long kaba bha ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba kyrsoi na shapoh da ka jingaiei U Blei , bad ym da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba ïadei bad ki jingbam ; kito kiba kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum kim shym la ïoh jingïarap ei ei na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shah rah bad ki jinghikai kiba phylla bad kiba phylla . Namar ka long kaba bha ba ka dohnud kan long kaba skhem da ka jingaiei ; ym da ki doh , ki bym shym la pynmyntoi ia ki kiba la shong ha ka .

en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah  ; for there they blessed the  Lord  : therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah , unto this day .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ki ïalumlang ha ka Them Berakah bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot ïa ka them ,  Ka Berakah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki la ialum lang ha ka them Berasah ; namar hangta ki la kyrkhu ia U Trai : namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka , Ka them Berasah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And as the ark of the  Lord  came into the city of David , Michal Saul s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the  Lord   ; and she despised him in her heart .
kha: Katba dang wallam ïa ka Synduk shapoh ka nongbah , ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , ka la peit na ka jingkhangïit bad ka la ïohi ïa u Syiem Dabid ba u shad bad kynthih kylleng sawdong ha ka jingshad bakyntang , bad ka la i ngiah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ka synduk U Trai ka dang wan shapoh ka shnong u Dabid , ka khun jong u Michal u la peit lyngba ka jingkhang , bad ka la iohi ia u syiem Dabid ba u la mareh bad u la shad ha khmat U Trai ; bad ka la leh bein ia u ha ka dohnud jong ka .

en: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt , and rested in all the coasts of Egypt : very grievous were they  ; before them there were no such locusts as they , neither after them shall be such .
kha: Kita ki puit ki wan kynhun kynhun bad ki dem ha ka ri baroh kawei . Kat kata ka jingbun ki puit ym pat ju ïohi mynno mynno lane yn ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khnai ki la leit sha jrong ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei: ki la sngewsih shibun eh ha khmat jong ki ym shym la don kum kita ki khnai kum ma ki, lymne hadien jong ki kin ym long kumta .

en: And there was there with us a young man , an Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard  ; and we told him , and he interpreted to us our dreams  ; to each man according to his dream he did interpret .
kha: Uwei u samla Hebru u la don hangta lem bad ngi , uba dei u mraw jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira . Ngi la ïathuh ha u ïa la ki jingphohsniew , bad u la batai ïa ki ha ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la don hangta bad ngi u samla, u Hebru, u shakri ia u kapten jong u nongap ; bad ngi la iathuh ia u, bad u la batai ia ngi ia ki jingphohsniew jong ngi ; ha uwei pa uwei u briew kat kum ka jingphohsniew jong u .

en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the  Lord   ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .
kha: U la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U la duwai , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u da kaba phah ïa ka ding na bneng ban thang ïa ki jingainguh halor ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la tei hangta ia ka jingknia bad ki jingknia iasuk , bad u la khot ia U Trai ; bad u la jubab ia u na bneng da ka ding halor ka jingknia thang .

en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth : and it came to pass , after they went forth , that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul  ; so that his name was much set by .
kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ju wan ban ïaleh thma , hynrei ha man ki jingïaleh , u Dabid u kham jop ïa ki ban ïa uno uno u rangbah shipai jong u Saul . Kumta u Dabid u la pawnam shibun .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah jong ki Philistia ki la leit noh: bad ka la jia hadien ba ki la leit noh , ba u Dabid u la leh kham stad ban ia ki shakri jong u Saul baroh .

en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .
kha: Ma nga hi nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! Nga shem sngewbha bad kito kiba sngewrit bad kiba kylla-kaba-mut , kiba sheptieng ïa nga bad kiba kohnguh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kita kiei kiei baroh ki la long, bad kita kiei kiei baroh ki la long, ong U Trai: hynrei ha une u briew ngan peit, wat ha uta uba duk bad uba sngewsih, bad nga khih ia ka ktien jong nga .

en: Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .
kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa kane bad yn pyndap da ka jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah jong ki kin wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta men sa iohi, bad ka dohnud jong me kan sa tieng, bad ka la nang heh ; namar ka jingbun jong ka duriaw kan kylla sha me , ki bor jong ki Jutang kin wan sha me .

en: So Uzziah slept with his fathers , and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings  ; for they said , He is a leper : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jaka tep syiem hynrei namar ka jingpang jong u ym shym la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem . U Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Uzziah u la thiah bad ki kpa jong u, bad ki la tep ia u bad ki kpa jong u ha ka lyngkha jong ki syiem ; namar ki la ong: U long u nongpang niang: bad u Jotham u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And the city lieth foursquare , and the length is as large as the breadth : and he measured the city with the reed , twelve thousand furlongs . The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal .
kha: Ka nongbah ka la long kaba sawdong janai , ka ïar kat ka lynter jong ka . U angel u la thew ïa ka nongbah da u diengthew jong u : Ka la don ar hajar sawspah kilomitar ka lynter bad ka la ïar bad kynjang kat ka lynter jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong ka la sah saw tylli ki jaka, bad ka jingjrong jong ka ka long kumba ka long: bad u la thew ia ka shnong da ka rong saw hajar tylli ki jaka ba jrong . Ka jingjrong bad ka jingjrong jong ka ka iaryngkat .

en: And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .
kha: U Blei u ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jong U Blei u kren ha ka Hagar ,  Ko Hagar , pha khuslai ïa-ei ? Wat sheptieng . U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u khynnah ; bad u angel U Blei u la pyrta ia ka Hagar na bneng, bad u la ong ha ka, Kaei kaba phi la leh ia me, Hagar ? wat tieng ia ka ktien namar U Blei u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong u khynnah ha kaba u don .

en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come , and not the very image of the things , can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect .
kha: Ka Hukum ki Jiw kam dei ka nuksa ba-pura bad baïaineh jong kiei kiei kiba shisha ; ka long tang ka nuksa batlot jong kita kiei kiei kiba bha ki ban sa wan . Ïa kijuh ki jait jingkñia la ju ainguh lynter , na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem . Kumno kata ka Hukum , te , da kaba leh ïa kine ki jingkñia kan lah ban pynjanai ïa ki briew kiba wan sha U Blei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka hukum kaba don ka jingdum jong kiei kiei kiba bha ki ban sa wan, bad ym ka dur hi jong kiei kiei , kam lah ban long satia bad kita ki jingknia kiba ki la tyrwa man la u snem .

en: The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop ; ki la bat ïa ka ha ka bor jong ki . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka ban shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop kiba bun jong ka baroh . Ïa ki khun jong ka la kem bad la shah rah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la long kum u nongshun: u la sngap jar ia ki iing jong ka baroh: u la pynjot ia ki jingbat ba skhem jong u, bad u la nang kiew ha ka khun jong u Judah da kaba iam bad sngewsih .

en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron  ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath–jearim :
kha: Na kata u suh sha ki umpohliew ka Nephtoah bad mih sha ki nongbah hajan u Lum Ephron . Hangta u phai sha Baalah ( lane Kiriath Jearim )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u pud u sam u la mih na jrong jong u lum haduh ka pung um jong u Nephtoah , bad u la leit sha ki shnong jong u lum Ephron ; bad u pud u sam u la mih sha Balah , kaba long u Kirjathjear:

en: And honey , and butter , and sheep , and cheese of kine , for David , and for the people that were with him , to eat : for they said , The people is hungry , and weary , and thirsty , in the wilderness .
kha: Ki la wanrah ki pliang , ki khra , bad ki jaiñkup thiah , bad ki jingbam ruh ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u : u kew , u barli , u  purew , u kew sdieh , u rymbai , u motor , ka ngap , ka ktung dud    , ka malai , bad katto katne ki langbrot . Ki tip ba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan , ki la sliang , bad ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka umsoh bad ka butter bad ki langbrot bad ki sohjew, na ka bynta u Dabid bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, ban bam: namar ki la ong: Ki briew ki thngan bad ki sliang, ha ka ri khlaw .

en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
kha: Phi long borabor ha ka dohnud jong nga ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngew kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . Namar phi baroh phi la ïoh bynta lem bad nga ha kane ka lad kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , mynta haba nga don ha byndi bad ruh haba nga la long laitluid ban ïada ïa ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka long kaba dei ia nga ban pyrkhat ia kane na phi baroh, namar nga don ia phi ha ka dohnud jong nga kumba ha ki jingteh jong nga baroh arngut, bad ha ka jingiada bad jingpynskhem ia ka gospel , phi baroh phi long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka jingaiei jong nga .

en: And speak unto him , saying , Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH  ; and he shall grow up out of his place , and he shall build the temple of the  Lord  :
kha: Ïathuh ïa u ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ U briew ïa uba la khot U Tnat un manbha ha kaba u don bad un tei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kren ha u da kaba ong , Kumta u kren ia U Trai jong ki paid: Ha khmih uta u briew uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long Ka BRANCH ; bad un kiew na ka jaka jong u bad un tei ia ka tempi U Trai:

en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me  ; and , behold , he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth  ; and , lo , it was the latter growth after the king s mowings .
kha: Nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka nga la ïohi ïa u ba u pynmih shi kynhun ki puit tang hadien ba la ot noh ïa u skum uba long ka bynta u syiem bad u phlang u la sdang ban mih biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u la pyni ha nga ; bad, ha khmih, u la thaw ia ki khniang ha kaba sdang jong ka jingmih kaba hadien; bad, ha khmih, ka la long ka jingroi kaba hadien hadien ka jingmih jong u syiem .

en: Then shalt thou prosper , if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the  Lord  charged Moses with concerning Israel : be strong , and of good courage  ; dread not , nor be dismayed .
kha: Lada me kohnguh ïa baroh ki aiñ kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses na ka bynta ki Israel , me lah ban jop . Kut jingmut bad long skhem , bad wat shah ïa kano kano ban pyntieng ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to roi , lada me pyrkhat ban pyndep ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba U Trai u la pynngat ha u Moses shaphang ki Israel: to long kiba skhem bad kiba shlur bha; wat tieng, lymne wat nym sngewsih .

en: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet , saying , And they took the thirty pieces of silver , the price of him that was valued , whom they of the children of Israel did value  ;
kha: Te kaei kaba u Jeremaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong , ka la urlong shisha :  Ki la shim ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa , ka dor kaba ki paid Israel ki la mynjur ban siew na ka bynta jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la pyndep ia kata kaba la kren da u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa, da kaba ong: Bad ki la shim ia ki laiphew tylli ki rupa , ka dor jong uta uba la khein kor , ia uba ki na ki khun Israel ki la khein kor;

en: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .
kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh hangne ; bad ai ba kin pdiang ïa ki naduh ka dohnud . Ki lynti U  Trai  ki long kiba beit , bad ki briew kiba hok ki im da kaba bud ïa ki , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut bad ki kyllon namar ba kim suidñiew ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba stad bad un sngewthuh ia kine kiei kiei ? kiba stad bad un ithuh ia ki ? namar ki lynti U Trai ki long kiba dei bad kiba hok kin iaid ha ki: hynrei ki nongleh kam sniew kin hap ha ka .

en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .
kha: Ka khun jong ka Herodias ka la wan shapoh bad ka la shad , bad ka la pynsngewbha ïa u Herod bad ïa kiba u la khot sngewbha . Kumta u syiem u la ong ha kata ka khynnah ,  Kaei kaba pha kwah ban ïoh ? Ngan ai ïa pha ïa kano kano kaba pha kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ka khun jong u Herodias ka la wan rung bad ka la shad bad ka la pynsngewbha ia u Herod bad ia kiba shong bad u, u syiem u la ong ha u damel: Kylli na nga katba phi mon bad ngan ai ia kata ia me .

en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ynda nga la pynlong kynjah ïa ka Ijipt bad pynjot noh ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka , kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda nga la pynlong ia ka ri Ijipt ban jah rngai noh, bad ka ri kan sa jah noh na kata kaba la dap , haba ngan sa shoh ia kita baroh kiba shong hangta , te kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Therefore shall the land mourn , and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish , with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven  ; yea , the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away .
kha: Bad kumta ka ri kan sa tyrkhong , kiei kiei baroh kiba im ha ka kin ïap . Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim , bad wat ki dohkha ruh , kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka ri kan iam bad uwei pa uwei uba shong ha ka un sa jah noh bad ki mrad khlaw bad ki sim bneng; yea , ki dohkha duriaw ruh kin sa jah noh .

en: And said unto me , Behold , I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , and I will make of thee a multitude of people  ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .
kha: U la ong ha nga , ‘ Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba kumta ki nongmih pateng jong me kin sa long ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Ngan ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ba kan long ka ri kynti jong ki junom .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia me uba seisoh bad uba bun briew bad ngan pynlong ia me u briew uba bun briew; bad ngan ai ia kane ka ri ha u symbai jong me hadien jong me na ka bynta ka jinglong trai bymjukut .

en: And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .
kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam ïa u Joash shabar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ ba pynïaid ïa ka jinglong syiem . Nangta ïa u Joash la pynsleh syiem bad la pynbna kum u syiem . Ki paidbah ki thab ïa la ki kti bad ki ïarisa ,  Im slem ko syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia u khun syiem, bad u la buh ia ka khlieh halor jong u, bad u la ai ia u ia ka jingsakhi ; bad ki la pynlong syiem ia u ; bad ki la pynsleh ia u ; bad ki la ia tyngkhuh ia ki kti jong ki, bad ki la ong, U Blei un pynim ia u syiem .

en: The days of visitation are come , the days of recompence are come  ; Israel shall know it : the prophet is a fool , the spiritual man is mad , for the multitude of thine iniquity , and the great hatred .
kha: Ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ka la poi , ka por ha kaba ki briew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei hok . Haba kata ka jia , ki Israel kin tip ïa ka !  Une u nongïathuhlypa ,  phi ong ,  u dei uba bieit . Une u briew uba ïoh mynsiem u dei uba lamwir .  Phi ki briew phi isih jur ïa nga namar ba la jyllei eh ki pop jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sngi jong ka jingleit jngoh ki wan, ki sngi jong ka jingsiew kylliang ki wan: u nongiathuhlypa u long uba bieit, u briew uba kynja mynsiem u la mad , namar ka jingbun jong ka jingbymhok jong me, bad ka jingshun kaba khraw .

en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi hi un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki ; bad u Joshua un long u nongïalam jong phi , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai U Blei jong me, un leit sha khmat jong me, bad un pynjot ia kine ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong me, bad me kin long trai ia ki: bad u Joshua , un leit sha khmat jong me kumba U Trai u la ong .

en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .
kha: Kito kiba sha jngai bah kin ïohpang bad ïap noh ; kito kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito kiba lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lut .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba jngai un iap na ka jingpang ; bad uta uba jan un hap da ka waitlam ; bad uta uba sah bad uba la shah pyniap un iap da ka jingkyrduh: kumta ngan pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga halor jong ki .

en: They are waxen fat , they shine : yea , they overpass the deeds of the wicked : they judge not the cause , the cause of the fatherless , yet they prosper  ; and the right of the needy do they not judge .
kha: balei ba ki sngaid bad ba la ïoh jingbsa bha . Ym don pud satia ïa ki kam sniew jong ki . Kim ju ai ïa ki hok jong ki khunswet lane pyn-i ka jingbishar hok ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki long kiba heh , ki shai: hooid, kim bishar ia ka daw , ka daw jong ki bym don kpa , hynrei ki roi; bad ka hok jong kiba duk kim ju bishar .

en: And it shall come to pass , when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee , which shall be of thy sons  ; and I will establish his kingdom .
kha: Ynda me ïap bad tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ynda la kut noh ki sngi jong me ba me leit sha ki kpa tymmen jong me, ba ngan pynmih ia u symbai jong me hadien jong me, uba long na ki khun shynrang jong me; bad ngan pynskhem ia ka hima jong u .

en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught , and loveth to tread out the corn  ; but I passed over upon her fair neck : I will make Ephraim to ride  ; Judah shall plow , and Jacob shall break his clods .
kha: Ka Israel ka la long shisien kum ka masi lud kaba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kaba la kloi bad mon ban shoh kew . Hynrei nga la rai ban buh ïa ka lyngkor ha ka ryndang ba-itynnat jong ka bad ban pyndait lyngkor ïa ka na ka bynta ka kam kaba kham eh . Ngan pynlong ïa u Judah ba un lur , bad u Israel un pynlwet khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Ephraim u long kum u nonglehkai masi uba la shah hikai, bad u ieit ban iaid shabar ia u kew ; hynrei nga la iaid lait noh ha ka ryndang kaba itynnad jong ka: Ngan pynlong ia u Ephraim ban shong ; Judah un sa tyrkhong, bad u Jakob un pynpra ia ki tyrpeng jong u.

en: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee , and the spoil of beasts , which made them afraid , because of men s blood , and for the violence of the land , of the city , and of all that dwell therein .
kha: Phi la pynduh ïa ki khlaw ka Lebanon ; mynta yn pyndkut ïa phi . Phi la pynïap ïa ki mrad ha ka ; mynta ki mrad kin pyntriem ïa phi . Kane kan jia namar ki kam pynïap ba phi la leh bad namar ki kam leh jubor pyrshah ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei bad ki nongbah jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingleh donbor jong ka Lebanon kan tap ia me, bad ka jingjot jong ki mrad, kaba la pyntieng ia ki, namar ka snam jong ki briew, bad na ka bynta ka jingleh donbor jong ka ri, jong ka shnong bad jong baroh kiba shong hangta .

en: But this is a people robbed and spoiled  ; they are all of them snared in holes , and they are hid in prison houses : they are for a prey , and none delivereth  ; for a spoil , and none saith , Restore .
kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ki briew jong u la shah lute ; ki la shah set ha ki krem byndi bad shah buhrieh ha ki ïingbyndi . Ki la shah lute bad shah pynjot . Khlem uno uno uba wan ban pyllait im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kane ka dei ka briew kaba la shah lute bad kaba la shah pynjot baroh ki la shah rong noh ha ki thliew , bad ki la buhrieh ha ki iing phatok: ki long na ka bynta ka jingbam , bad ym don ba pynpoi ia ka ; na ka bynta ka jingjot , bad ym don ba ong: Pynkylla .

en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel , and said unto him , Go , strengthen thyself , and mark , and see what thou doest : for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee .
kha: Nangta uta u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u ong ,  Khie leit noh bad pynkhlaiñ ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , bad da pynbha ïa ka rukom ïaleh namar u syiem Syria un wan tur ïaleh biang ha ka por pyrem ka ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: U nongiathuhlypa u la wan sha u syiem Israel bad u la ong ha u, To leit pynskhem ia lade bad to buh dak bad peit kaei kaba me leh: namar ha ka jingwan phai jong u snem u syiem Syria un wan pyrshah ia me .

en: Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .
kha: U  Trai  , u la pynskhem triang ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jong nga ; u la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la ai ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong nga . Nga smai da U  Trai  uba im ba u Adonijah un ïap ha kane hi ka sngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, kumba U Trai u dang im, uba la pynskhem ia nga, bad uba la buh ia nga ha ka khet u Dabid u kpa jong nga, bad uba la thaw ia nga ka iing kumba u la kular , u Adonijah un shah pyniap ha kane ka sngi .

en: And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .
kha: Shaphang ka jait Judah u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to shahshkor haba ki kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap ; Tehsong ïa ki kawei bad la ki para jait . Ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki , ko  Trai  , Bad ïarap ïa ki pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingkyrkhu jong u Judah: bad u la ong: To sngap, ko Trai, ia ka sur jong u Judah, bad to wanrah ia u sha ki briew jong u: to ai ba ki kti jong u kin biang ia u ; bad me long u nongiarap ia u na ki nongshun jong u .

en: And he said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my daughter : for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning , inasmuch as thou followedst not young men , whether poor or rich .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ,  u ong .  Phi pyn-i ka kamram kaba khraw kaba ïadei bad ka longïing ha kaei kaba phi leh mynta ban ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa la ka kiaw kurim . Phin jin da la leit wad ïa u rangsamla , la u dei uba riewspah ne uba duk , hynrei phim shym leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: La kyrkhu ia me na U Trai, ko khun jong nga: namar me la pyni kham bun ka jingsngewbha ha kaba kut ban ia kaba sdang, kumba me la bud ia ki samla, la ki long kiba duk ne kiba riewspah .

en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
kha: U Blei u pyndonkam ïa kane ka jingleit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u dang don hangta , ma u bad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Jehu , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U  Trai  u la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingpynjot ia u Ahasaiah ka long na U Blei da kaba wan sha Joram: namar haba u la wan u la leit noh bad u Jehoram pyrshah ia u Jehoram u khun u Nimshi , ia uba U Trai u la pynsleh ban ot noh ia ka iing u Ahab .

en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron  ; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver , which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth , four hundred shekels of silver , current money with the merchant .
kha: U Abraham u la mynjur bad u la thew ïa kata ka dor kaba u Ephron u la ong ha ka jingïohsngew lang kita ki briew — sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa kat kum ka jingthew ba la pyndonkam da ki nongkhaïi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la sngap ia u Ephron ; bad u Abraham u la thew ia ka rupa kaba u la jer kyrteng ha ki khmat jong ki khun shynrang Heth, saw spah Shekel ka rupa kaba mynta bad u nongkhaii .

en: And they said unto him , We are come down to bind thee , that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines . And Samson said unto them , Swear unto me , that ye will not fall upon me yourselves .
kha: Ki ong ,  Ngi la wan hangne ban khum ïa me , khnang ba ngin ïoh aiti ïa me ha ki .  U Samson u ong ,  Kular ha nga da ka ktien ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga da phi hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha u, Ngi wan hiar ban teh ia me, ba ngin aiti ia me ha ka kti jong ki Philistia . U Samson u la ong ha ki: To sngap jar ia nga, ba phin ym hap ha nga hi .

en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices , I was about to write : and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered , and write them not .
kha: Hamar ba ki la kren , nga la sdang ban thoh . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bneng ,  To buhrieh ïa kaei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ong ; wat thoh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki hynriew tylli ki jingsawa ki la pynmih ia ki sur jong ki: bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur na bneng kaba ong ha nga: To buh ia kita kiei kiei kiba ki hynriew tylli ki jingsawa ki la pynmih , bad wat thoh ia ki .

en: And I , whither shall I cause my shame to go ? and as for thee , thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel . Now therefore , I pray thee , speak unto the king  ; for he will not withhold me from thee .
kha: Kumno shuh ngan da ïa la ka burom hapdeng ki briew ? Bad phi — phin long uba jahburom nadong shadong ha Israel . Sngewbha , kren ha u syiem , bad nga thikna ba un ai ïa nga ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga ruh ngan pynlong ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong nga ban leit ? bad me ruh, me long kum uwei na ki bieit ha Israel . Mynta , nga kyrpad ia me, to kren ha u syiem ; namar un ym khang ia nga na me .

en: And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .
kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Ki briew jong nga ki la shim ïa ki na ki Amalek . Ki la buh ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïa kiba sah ngi la pynduh lut khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , Ki la wanrah ia ki na ki nong Amalek: namar ki briew ki la pyllait im ia ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba bha tam, ban knia ha U Trai U Blei jong me; bad ia kaba sah ngi la pynjot lut .

en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
kha: Haba ki Israel kiba shong basah ha ka Them Jesreel ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ka la phet ïap , bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew Israel baroh kiba don ha ka them ki la iohi ba ki la phet noh bad ba u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la iap , nangta ki la iehnoh ia ki shnong jong ki: bad ki Philistia ki la wan shong ha ki .

en: And he said , The  Lord  came from Sinai , and rose up from Seir unto them  ; he shined forth from mount Paran , and he came with ten thousands of saints : from his right hand went a fiery law for them .
kha: U  Trai  u wan na u Lum Sinai ; u mih kum ka sngi ha Edom , bad u tyngshaiñ ha la ki briew na u Lum Paran . Shiphew hajar ki angel ki don ryngkat bad u , bad ka ding kaba meh ha ka kti kamon jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong , U Trai u la wan na Sinai, bad u la kiew na Seir sha ki; u la shai na u lum Paran, bad u la wan ryngkat bad shi hajar ngut ki riewkhuid: na ka kti kadiang jong u u la leit sha ki .

en: And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .
kha: U Blei , mynkata , um shym la ai ha u Abraham ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shi mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynrei U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u bad ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ha ka por ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular , u Abraham um pat don khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la ai pateng ia u ha ka, em, ym haduh katta katta ban buh ia ka kjat jong u: hynrei u la kular ba un ai ia ka ha u na ka bynta ka jingdon jingem, bad ha u symbai jong u hadien jong u, haba u dang don khun .

en: Behold , I stand by the well of water  ; and it shall come to pass , that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water , and I say to her , Give me , I pray thee , a little water of thy pitcher to drink  ;
kha: Mynta nga don hangne harud kane ka pukri . Haba ka samla ka wan ban tong um , ngan ong ha ka ba kan ai um ba ngan dih ïa nga na u khiew um jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga ieng hajan ka pung um ; bad kan sa jia, ba haba ka theisotti ka wan shabar ban dih um, bad nga ong ia ka: Ai ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, khyndiat ka um jong me ban dih ; .

en: And ye shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand : and he that cometh within the ranges , let him be slain : and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in .
kha: Phi dei ban ap phira ïa u syiem Joash ryngkat bad ki waitlam ba la sei lypa bad don ryngkat bad u kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba wan sha jan jong phi u dei ban shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ker sawdong ia u syiem sawdong, uwei pa uwei bad ki tiar ialeh jong u ha ka kti jong u: bad uta uba wan hapoh ki lum, to ai ba un shah pyniap: bad to long bad u syiem katba u nang mih bad katba u nang wan rung .

en: And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
kha: Kata ka kali ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong u briew uba kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Beth Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki pom lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , ki pynïap ïa kita ki masi kynthei bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kali ka la wan sha ka lyngkha u Joshua, u Bethsemite, bad ka la ieng hangta, ha kaba don u maw uba heh: bad ki la pynkhih ia u dieng jong ka kali, bad ki la tyrwa ia ki masi ia ka jingknia thang ha U Trai .

en: Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
kha: To ïalumlang ïa ki paidbah ; to pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïalang bakyntang ; to wallam ki briew ba la tymmen ; to ïalumlang ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ruh . Wat kito kiba dang shu dep shongkurim ki dei ban mihnoh na la ka kamra bad ban wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhuid ia ki briew, pynkhuid ia ka balang, pynlong ia ki rangbah, lum ia ki khun bad kito kiba dih ia ki bniat: to ai ba u nongleit kurim un leit noh na ka kamra jong u, bad ka nongleit kurim na ka kamra jong ka .

en: For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :
kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynrngad ïa ka um jong ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi haduh ba phin da la jam sha shiliang , kumba u la pynrngad ïa ka Duriaw Basaw na ka bynta jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong phi u la tyrkhong ia ki um Jordan na khmat jong phi, haduh ba phin da iaid lait noh, kumba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la iaid sha ka duriaw Basaw kaba u la tyrkhong na khmat jong ngi, haduh ba ngi la iaid noh:

en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .
kha: Kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Hima hynrei ki bymshemphang ïa ka , ki long kum ki symbai kiba la hap ha shi lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat . Uta u Basniew u wan bad u knieh noh ïa kaei kaba la bet hapoh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba uno uno u iohsngew ia ka ktien jong ka hima bad um sngewthuh ia ka , te u wan u bymman bad u kem noh ia kata kaba la bet ha ka dohnud jong u . Une u long uba la ioh symbai da ka lynti .

en: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .
kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kine ki nongbah baroh bad ïa ki syiem jong ki , da kaba pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei , kumba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shnong baroh jong kita ki syiem bad ki syiem jong ki baroh ki la shim ia ki da ka waitlam bad u la pynjot lut ia ki kumba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la hukum .

en: Hast thou not heard long ago , how I have done it  ; and of ancient times , that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps .
kha: Hato mem pat ju ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kane baroh slem mynshuwa ? Bad mynta nga pynurlong ïa ka . Nga ai ha me ka bor ban pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh sha ki kynton theh ñiut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la iohsngew mynshuwa , kumno nga la leh ia ka ; bad ki por hyndai , ba nga la thaw ia ka ? mynta nga la wanrah ia ka ban iaid , ba me dei ban long ban buh ia ki nongbah kiba la shah pynjot ha ki thliew kiba la jot .

en: From Aroer , which is by the brink of the river of Arnon , and from the city that is by the river , even unto Gilead , there was not one city too strong for us : the  Lord  our God delivered all unto us :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la shah ba ngin ïohknieh ïa ki shnong baroh naduh Aroer kaba harud ka Them Arnon , bad ïa ka nongbah hapdeng kata ka them , haduh Gilead . Ym don kawei ruh ka shnong ïa kaba ngim shym jop .
translated_en_to_kha: Na Aroer kaba don ha rud wah Arnon bad na ka shnong kaba don harud wah, wat haduh Gilead ruh ym don kawei ruh ka shnong kaba khlain palat ia ngi: U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la aiti lut ha ngi:

en: And when he had taken the book , the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps , and golden vials full of odours , which are the prayers of saints .
kha: Katba u dang leh kumta , kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    ki la dem khrup ha khmat U Khunlangbrot . Uwei pa uwei u la don ka duitara bad ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingiwbih , kiba long ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la shim ia ka kot , ki saw tylli ki mrad bad arphew ngut ki rangbah ki la hap ha khmat u Khunlangbrot , ki don uwei pa uwei na ki u harp bad ki vial ksiar kiba dap da ki jingsma , kiba long ki jingduwai jong ki riewkhuid .

en: Send one of you , and let him fetch your brother , and ye shall be kept in prison , that your words may be proved , whether there be any truth in you : or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies .
kha: Uwei na phi un leit bad un wan ïalam ïa u . Ïa kiba sah na phi pat yn buh hapoh ka jingap phira tad haduh ba yn da lah ban pynshisha ïa kaei kaba phi ong . Lym kumta , katba u syiem u im , phi dei ki nongsyntiat .
translated_en_to_kha: Phah ia uwei na phi , bad un leit sha u hynmen jong phi , bad phin shah set phatok , ba ki ktien jong phi kin long kiba la pynshisha , la ka don ne em ka jingshisha ha phi: lane lym kumta da ka jingim u Pharaoh shisha phi long ki nongleit jingleit .

en: The multitude of camels shall cover thee , the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah  ; all they from Sheba shall come : they shall bring gold and incense  ; and they shall shew forth the praises of the  Lord .
kha: Ki kynhun bah ki ut kin wan , na Midian bad na Ephah . Kin wan na Sheba , kin wanrah ïa ka ksiar bad ka jingiwbih . Ki briew kin ïathuh ïa ka khubor kaba bha ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingbun ki kulai kan tap ia me, ki khnai jong ka Madian bad ka Ephah baroh ki wan na Sheba: kin wanrah ia ka ksiar bad ka jingiwbih ; bad kin pyni ia ki jingiaroh ia U Trai .

en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .
kha: Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki rangbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur shi jur . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor ,  Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon ha ka jingpait jingpra ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, hangne ka wan ka kali jong ki briew, bad arngut ki nongshong kulai . Bad u la jubab bad u la ong: Ka Babilon ka la hap; bad ki dur ba la ker jong ki blei jong ka baroh ki la bthei ha ka khyndew .

en: And ye shall overthrow their altars , and break their pillars , and burn their groves with fire  ; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods , and destroy the names of them out of that place .
kha: Pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki bad pynpait pharia ïa ki maw blei jong ki . Thang ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah bad mait ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , khnang ba kin ym mane shuh ha kito ki jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin pynhap ia ki nongrim jong ki, bad phin pynpra ia ki lum jong ki, bad phin thang ia ki dieng jong ki da ka ding ; bad phin pynkhyllem ia ki dur ba la ker jong ki blei jong ki, bad pynjot ia ki kyrteng jong ki na kata ka jaka .

en: Baana the son of Ahilud  ; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth–shean , which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel , from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah , even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam :
kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Ahilud : ki nongbah Taanakh , Megiddo , bad baroh ka thain hajan ka Beth Shan , hajan ka nongrit Sarethan , kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Jesreel , haduh ka nongbah Abel Meholah bad ka nongbah Jokmeam
translated_en_to_kha: U Bana u khun u Ahilud ; ha u u la ioh ia ka Taach bad ka Megiddo, bad baroh ka Bethshean, kaba don ha ka Zarehan hapoh Jesel, naduh Betheshan haduh Abelshean haduh ka jaka kaba don sha lyndet jong u Jokmeam:

en: I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .
kha: Hadien ba nga la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad nga lumlang ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba nga long uba khuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pdiang ia phi da ka jingsngewbha kaba thiang jong phi, haba nga wanrah ia phi na ki briew , bad ngan lum ia phi na ki ri ha kaba phi la shah pynpra ; bad ngan long uba la pynkyntang ha phi ha khmat ki nongwei .

en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .
kha: Phi dei ban pynlut ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kane ka pisa bad ban thied ki masi kyrtong , ki langbrot shynrang , ki khunblang , u kew bad ka waiñ bad ban ainguh ïa ki ha ka duwan jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban thied kloi da une u masi , u langbrot bad ki langbrot bad ki jingknia bam bad ki jingknia dih jong ki , bad to ai ia ki ha ka jingknia jong ka iing U Blei jong phi kaba don ha Jerusalem .

en: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity , whereby they have sinned against me  ; and I will pardon all their iniquities , whereby they have sinned , and whereby they have transgressed against me .
kha: Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki na ki pop kiba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynkhuid ia ki na ka jingbymhok jong ki baroh , ha kaba ki la leh pop pyrshah ia nga ; bad ngan map ia ki jingbymhok jong ki baroh , ha kaba ki la leh pop pyrshah ia nga .

en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun  ; and he cried with a loud voice , saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven , Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God  ;
kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha ka sngi . U la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ïa ki sim baroh kiba her ha shiteng suiñ :  Ale bad ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingkhawai kaba khraw jong U Blei !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi ia u angel uba ieng ha ka sngi ; bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam, u da ong ha ki sim baroh kiba her hapdeng ka bneng , To wan bad to lum lang ia lade ha ka jingkhawai miet jong U Blei uba khraw ; .

en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .
kha: Kane ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U  Trai  u la ong shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab ka wan jia shisha . U  Trai  u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip mynta ba kan hap ha ka khyndew ym don ei ei na ka ktien U Trai kaba U Trai u la kren shaphang ka iing u Ahab: namar U Trai u la leh ia kata kaba u la kren da u shakri jong u u Elijah .

en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .
kha: Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ jong u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bynta , kawei ka bynta ïa uwei uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain khlem kano kano ka jingsuh ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki shipai, haba ki la sahnarphna ia U Jisu, ki la shim ia ki jain jong u, bad ki la shna saw bynta, ha uwei pa uwei u shipai u la leh ia kawei ka bynta beg bad ruh ia ka jainkup jong u: mynta ka jainkup ka la long khlem seam, kaba la phong na jrong baroh kawei .

en: And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong kita ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmat jong ka ephod , hamar ka jaka suh pyndait , bad haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shna ar tylli kiwei pat ki ryntieh ksiar, bad ki la buh ia ki ha ki arliang jong ka ephod hapoh jong ka, sha ka bynta ba shakhmat jong ka, pyrshah ia kawei pat ka jingpyniasoh jong ka, halor ka ryntieh ksiar kaba sngewtynnad jong ka ephod .

en: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges  ; he shall also bring him to the door , or unto the door post  ; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl  ; and he shall serve him for ever .
kha: te u kynrad jong u un ïalam ïa u sha ka jaka mane Blei . Hangta un pynïeng ïa u ha ka jingkhang ne ha ka shawkad bad un sam shkor ïa u . Te un sa long u mraw jong u shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u kynrad jong u un wanrah ia u sha ki nongbishar ; u ruh un wanrah ia u sha ka jingkhang, ne sha ka jingkhang ; bad u kynrad jong u un rah ia ka shkor jong u lyngba da ka rong; bad un shakri ia u junom .

en: I will get me unto the great men , and will speak unto them  ; for they have known the way of the  Lord  , and the judgment of their God : but these have altogether broken the yoke , and burst the bonds .
