kha: Ngan leit sha ki briew kiba ha ka bor ; bad ïakren bad ki . Da shisha ki tip kaei ba U Blei u dawa , kaei ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa ki ban leh .  Hynrei ki baroh ki la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong U  Trai bad ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan poi sha ki briew kiba khraw, bad ngan kren ha ki ; namar ki la tip ia ka lynti U Trai bad ka jingbishar U Blei jong ki: hynrei kine ki la pynpra lut ia ka jingteh bad ki la pynpra ia ki jingteh .

en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .
kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Shong noh bad nga . Long u nongaibuit bad u lyngdoh jong nga , bad ngan ai ïa phi shiphew ki sbai rupa shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mica u la ong ha u, To sah bad nga, bad to long ha nga u kpa bad u lyngdoh, bad ngan ai ia me shiphew Shekel ka rupa ha ka snem , bad ka jainkup bad ki jingbam jong me . Kumta u Lebi u la rung .

en: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee , the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee : they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar , and I will glorify the house of my glory .
kha: Ïa baroh ki kynhun langbrot jong ka Kedar bad Nebaïoth yn wallam sha pha kum ka jingkñia bad ainguh ha ka duwan ban pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . U  Trai  un pyndonburom ïa ka templ jong u ban ïa kaba ka ju long .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki kynhun jong u Kdar kin ialum lang ha me, ki langbrot jong u Nebaioth kin shakri ha me: kin wan shaneng da ka jingpdiang sngewbha ha ka almari jong nga, bad ngan pyndonburom ia ka iing jong ka burom jong nga .

en: Now then do it : for the  Lord  hath spoken of David , saying , By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines , and out of the hand of all their enemies .
kha: Mynta , kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi . Kynmaw ba U  Trai  u la ong , ‘ Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Dabid u shakri jong nga ban pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel na ki Philistia bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun jong ki baroh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to leh ia kata: namar U Trai u la kren shaphang u Dabid, u da ong: Da ka kti u Dabid jong nga ngan pyllait im ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel na ka kti jong ki Philistia bad na ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki baroh .

en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah : he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi .
kha: U Jehoshaphat u la long syiem ka Judah mynba u dap laiphew san snem ka rta bad u synshar ha Jerusalem arphew san snem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Asubah , ka khun jong u Shilhi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoshaphat u la synshar ia ka Judah: u la don laiphew san snem ka rta haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar arphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Bad ka kyrteng ka kmie jong u ka long ka Azubah ka khun jong u Shilhi .

en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
kha: La ïathuh ha baroh ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia bad ba ki Philistia ki la isih ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasoh bad u Saul ha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la iohsngew ba u Saul u la pyniap ia ka kynhun shipai jong ki Philistia bad ba ki Israel ruh ki la don ha ka jingsngewsih bad ki Philistia . Bad la khot ia ki briew hadien u Saul sha Gilgal .

en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one that is learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I cannot  ; for it is sealed :
kha: Ïa ka jingmut jong kawei pa kawei ka jingïohipaw u nongïathuhlypa yn buhrieh noh na phi ; kan long kum ka kot kli ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor . Lada phi leit rah ïa ka sha uno uno uba tip ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un ong ba um lah ban pule namar ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingphohsniew jong baroh ka kylla long ha phi kum ki ktien jong ka kot kaba la khang, kaba ki briew ki ai sha uwei uba la nang la stad, ki da ong: Pule ia kane, nga duwai ia me: bad u ong: Ngam lah ban shah khang:

en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , Now when this letter is come unto thee , behold , I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee , that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy .
kha: Ka shithi kaba u rah ka ong :  Kane ka shithi kan pynithuh ïa u Naaman , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong nga . Nga kwah ïa phi ban pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la wanrah ia ka shithi sha u syiem Israel, u da ong: Mynta haba kane ka shithi ka la wan ha me, ha khmih nga la phah ia u Naaman u shakri jong nga ha me, ba me lah ban pynkoit ia u na ka jingpang sniehdoh jong u .

en: And on the morrow when he departed , he took out two pence , and gave them to the host , and said unto him , Take care of him  ; and whatsoever thou spendest more , when I come again , I will repay thee .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u la sei ar tylli ki sbai rupa bad u la ai ïa ki ha u trai ïing . ‘ To sumar ïa u ,’ u la ong ïa u trai ïing , ‘ bad ynda nga wan phai na kane ka lynti , ngan siew ïa me ïa kano kano kaba me pynlut halor jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka sngi kaba bud haba u la leit noh, u la sei ar pen bad u la ai ia ki ha u nongpdiang sngewbha, bad u la ong ha u: To sumar ia u ; bad kaei kaei kaba phi pynlut kham bun, ynda nga wan phai pat, ngan siew kylliang ia me .

en: And David said unto him , To whom belongest thou ? and whence art thou ? And he said , I am a young man of Egypt , servant to an Amalekite  ; and my master left me , because three days agone I fell sick .
kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Uei u kynrad jong me , bad na-ei me wan ?   Nga dei u nong Ijipt , u mraw jong u nong Amalek ,  u la jubab .  U kynrad jong nga u la iehnoh ïa nga lai sngi mynshuwa namar ba nga kem pang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u, Me long mano ? bad nangno me long ? Bad u la ong, Nga long u samla Ijipt, u shakri ia u Amalekite ; bad u kynrad jong nga u la iehnoh ia nga, namar lai sngi nga la pang .

en: And when this people , or the prophet , or a priest , shall ask thee , saying , What is the burden of the  Lord  ? thou shalt then say unto them , What burden ? I will even forsake you , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , haba uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh u kylli ïa me , ‘ Kaei ka khubor jong U  Trai  ?’ Men ïathuh ha u , ‘ Me long ka jingkit ïa U  Trai  , bad un sa kynther noh ïa me .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba une u briew ne u nongiathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh un kylli ia me da kaba ong, Kaei ka jingkit jong U Trai ? me nangta to ong ha ki , Kaei ka jingkit ? Ngan iehnoh wat ia phi , ong U Trai .

en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them , When ye have heaved the best thereof from it , then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .
kha: Haba phi la ai ïa kaba bha tam , phi lah ban bat ïa kaba dang sah , kumba u nongrep u bat ïa kaba dang sah hadien ba u la wanrah ïa la ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ki , Ynda phi la lum ia kaba bha tam na ka , te yn khein ia ka ha ki Lebi kum ka jingkiew jong ka lynti iaid kjat bad kum ka jingkiew jong ka lynti iaid kjat .

en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :
kha: Un shim sa ïa kawei pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u  saiwul uba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka sim kaba im, un shim ia ka bad u dieng sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad u sohjew bad un pynngam ia ki bad ia u sim ba im ha ka snam jong u sim uba la shah pyniap halor ka um kaba tuid:

en: When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
kha: U nonglamktien uba la wan sha nga ha Siklag bad ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u la pyrkhat ba u la wallam ka khubor babha . Nga la kem ïa u , bad phah pynïap ïa u . Kata ka dei ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta kata ka khubor babha jong u !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba uwei u la iathuh ia nga, u la ong, Ha khmih, u Saul u la iap, u la pyrkhat ba u la wanrah ia ka khubor babha, nga la bat ia u bad nga la pyniap ia u ha Ziklag , uba la pyrkhat ba ngan jin da la ai ia u ia ka bainong na ka bynta ki khubor jong u:

en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba peit ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Mar kumta , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet rieh sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u la phah ia u Adoram uba la long halor ka khajna ; bad ki Israel baroh ki la ther maw ia u da ki maw, ba u la iap . Namarkata u syiem Rehoboam u la kyrkieh ban kiew ia u sha ka kali jong u, ban phet noh sha Jerusalem .

en: And I arose in the night , I and some few men with me  ; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem : neither was there any beast with me , save the beast that I rode upon .
kha: bad haduh lai sngi ngam shym ïathuh ïano ïano ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pyrsad mynsiem ha nga ban leh na ka bynta ka Jerusalem . Nangta ha shiteng jong ka miet nga ïeng joit bad mih shabar , da kaba ïalam bad nga katto katne ngut ki paralok jong nga . U jingri uba ngi la shim u dei u kada uba nga la shong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ieng ha ka por miet , ma nga bad katto katne ngut ki briew kiba don bad nga; ngam shym la iathuh ha uno uno u briew ia kaei kaba U Blei jong nga u la buh ha ka dohnud jong nga ban leh ha Jerusalem: ym don mrad bad nga, lait noh tang ia u mrad uba nga shong halor jong nga .

en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .
kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyngdoh ! To pynleit jingmut , phi ki paid Israel ! To shahshkor , phi kiba na ka longïing u syiem ! La khmih lynti ïa phi ban bishar da ka hok — Kumta ka jingbishar kan wan hap ha phi ! Phi la long ka jingriam ha Mispah , ka jar ba la pynap ha u lum Tabor ,
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kane, ko lyngdoh bad to sngap, ko iing Israel; bad to ai shkor ia phi, ko iing syiem; namar ka jingbishar ka long ha phi, namar phi la long ka jingma ha ka Mizpah, bad ka net ka la saphriang ha Tabor .

en: And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .
kha: Nangta ong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha phi ba phin shah ïa ki briew jong u ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Hynrei haduh mynta phim shym shahshkor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban ong ha u: U Trai U Blei jong ki Hebru u la phah ia nga sha me, da kaba ong: To ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit noh, ba kin shakri ia nga ha ka ri khlaw: bad, ha khmih, haduh mynta me ym shym la iohsngew .

en: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .
kha: U Moses u la leit hiar na uta u lum , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum ha baroh arliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la phai noh, bad u la hiar na u lum, bad ki ar tylli ki miej jong ka jingsakhi ki la don ha ka kti jong u: la thoh ia ki miej ha baroh arliang jong ki; ha kawei ka liang bad ha kawei pat la thoh ia ki .

en: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us , Hereby shall I know that ye are true men  ; leave one of your brethren here with me , and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :
kha: Uta u briew u jubab , ‘ Da kumne ngan tip ba phim dei ki riewshukor , uwei na phi un sah bad nga ; ieh kiwei pat kin leit kit kew sha la ki ba-ha-ïing kiba shahthngan , bad kin leit noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew uba long trai jong ka ri u la ong ha ngi, Da kane ngan tip ba phi long ki briew kiba shisha; to iehnoh ia uwei na ki hynmen jong phi hangne bad nga, bad shim jingbam na ka bynta ka jingkyrduh jong ki iing jong phi, bad to leit noh:

en: Now the hand of the  Lord  was upon me in the evening , afore he that was escaped came  ; and had opened my mouth , until he came to me in the morning  ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no more dumb .
kha: Ha ka janmiet shuwa ba un wan , nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai kaba jur . Haba uta u briew u la poi ha ka step kaba bud , U Trai u ai ha nga pat ïa ka bor ban kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka kti U Trai ka la don halor jong nga ha ka por janmiet , shuwa uta uba la lait im u la wan ; bad u la plie ia ka shyntur jong nga , haduh ba u la wan sha nga ha ka por mynstep ; bad ka shyntur jong nga ka la plie noh , bad ngam shym la lyngngoh shuh .

en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Hitherto thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound . And he said unto her , If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web .
kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ïa u Samson ,  Haduh mynta phi dang pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ïa kaba shisha . Ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .  U jubab ,  Lada phi thain ïa kine ki kynthrong shñiuh jong nga hynñiew tylli bad phi pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Delilah u la ong ha u Samson, Haduh mynta me la rkhie bein ia nga, bad me la iathuh ia nga: to iathuh ia nga da kaba me lah ban shah teh . Bad u la ong ha ka , Lada me shna ia ki hynriew tylli ki khlieh jong nga da ka web .

en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the  Lord  , and for the king s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .
kha: U Solomon u la pyndonkam ïa kine ki dieng ha kaba shna jingker ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ha kaba shna duitara bad jingtem ksai ïa ki nongput nongtem . Ki long ki dieng Kseh-Juniper kiba kynsai tam ïa kiba la wanrah sha Israel , ym don shuh kum kita ban dang lah ban ïohi biang . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem u la shna ia ki dieng almug na ka bynta ka iing U Trai, bad na ka bynta ka iing syiem ruh: ym shym la iohi ia ki dieng almug kiba kum kita haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , in integrity of heart , and in uprightness , to do according to all that I have commanded thee , and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments :
kha: Lada me pat men shakri ïa nga ha ka jingkhuid dohnud bad ka jingïaid beit , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , bad lada me kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada me iaid ha khmat jong nga kumba u kpa jong me u la iaid, ha ka jinglong ba janai bad ha ka jinglong hok, ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia me, bad phin sumar ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar jong nga:

en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which she had brought unto the king . So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .
kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka Sheba kat ïa kaba ka pan . Kane ka long nalor kaei kaba u la ai markylliang ha ka na ka bynta ki jingai sngewbha kiba ka la wanrah ïa u . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki la leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la ai ha ka mahadei jong ka Sheba ia ka jingkwah jong ka baroh, kaei kaei kaba ka la pan, nalor kata kaba ka la wanrah ha u syiem . Kumta ka la phai noh bad ka la leit noh sha la ka jong ka ri, ma ka bad ki shakri jong ka .

en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .
kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa na Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u bad ki ong ,  Ka bor u Elijah ka don ha u Elisha !  Ki la leit ban ïashem ïa u , ki la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa kiba la leit sha Jerikoh ki la iohi ia u, ki la ong: Ka mynsiem jong u Elijah ka shong ha u Elisha . Ki la wan iakynduh ia u bad ki la dem khrup ha khyndew ha khmat jong u .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki die sha ka jinglongmraw ïa ki briew kiba hok ki bym lah siew pat ïa ki ram jong ki , ki briew kiba duk ki bym lah siew pat wat ïa ka dor shi jur ki juti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein Israel , bad na ka bynta saw , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ki la die ia kiba hok na ka bynta ka rupa , bad kiba duk na ka bynta kawei ka juti ; .

en: Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .
kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ban ïa uno uno uba la don ha shuwa lane u ban sa ïoh pat hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga la leh katkum ki ktien jong me: ha khmih nga la ai ia me ka dohnud kaba stad bad kaba sngewthuh ; kumta ym don mano mano ruh kiba kum ma me ha khmat jong me, lymne hadien jong me kin mih kum ma me .

en: That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;
kha: bad u la phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel :  Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba U Trai u la phah ia u nongiathuhlypa ha ki khun Israel , uba la ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei jong ki Israel , nga la wanrah ia phi na Ijipt bad nga la wanrah ia phi na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw;

en: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen , and ten chariots , and ten thousand footmen  ; for the king of Syria had destroyed them , and had made them like the dust by threshing .
kha: U Jehoahas um don ki shipai kieng atiar kiba dang sah , lait sa tang ki sanphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai , shiphew tylli ki kali ïapom , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat , namar u syiem ka Syria u la pynjot ïa kiwei , da kaba ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa u pui pui .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad um shym la iehnoh ia ki briew ha u Jehoah hynrei sanphew ngut ki kulai bad shiphew ngut ki kali iaid kjat bad shi hajar ngut ki nongialehkai kjat namar u syiem Syria u la pynjot ia ki, bad u la pynlong ia ki kum ka dewbilat da kaba pynkhyllem .

en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;
kha: Ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la don shibun ki jingri . Haba ki la ïohi ba ka ri Jaser bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki khun u Reuben bad ki khun Gad ki don shibun ki masi: bad haba ki la iohi ia ka ri Jazer bad ka ri Gilead , kata , ha khmih kata ka jaka ka long ka jaka na ka bynta ki masi ; .

en: Therefore , son of man , speak unto the house of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me , in that they have committed a trespass against me .
kha: Mynta te , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki . Kane ka dei kawei pat ka rukom kaba ki kpa jong ki , ki la ibeiñ ïa nga da ka jingbymïaineh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko khun u briew, to kren ha ka iing Israel bad to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei u la kren bein ia nga, ha kaba ki la leh ia ka jingleh be-ijot pyrshah ia nga .

en: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .
kha: U Hiram jong ka Tyros u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksiar ruh , katba u donkam . Ynda la dep tei ïa ki , u Syiem Solomon u ai ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka thain Galilaïa .
translated_en_to_kha: (Mynta u Hiram u syiem Tyros u la pynbiang ia u Solomon da ki dieng sohjew bad ki dieng sohjew bad da ka ksiar kat kum ka jingkwah jong u baroh) ba u syiem u la ai arphew tylli ki shnong ha ka ri Galilaia .

en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u kylli ,  Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ?  U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ki la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la wan sha u syiem Hesekaiah bad u la ong ha u, "Kine ki briew ki la ong aiu?" bad naei ki la wan sha me ? U Hesekaiah u la ong: Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai, wat na Babilon .

en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day , wherewith they have forsaken me , and served other gods , so do they also unto thee .
kha: Naduh ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt , ki la phai noh na nga bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; bad mynta ki leh ïa me kumba ki la ju leh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ki kam baroh kiba ki la leh naduh ka sngi ba nga la wanrah ia ki na Ijipt haduh kine ki sngi , ha kaba ki la iehnoh ia nga bad ki la shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei , kumta ruh ki shakri ia me .

en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .
kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u Dabid , u kpa jong nga u la dei ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong u , um shym la lah ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me tip kumno ba u kpa jong nga u Dabid um lah ban tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong u na ka bynta ki thma kiba la don sawdong jong u ha man la ki liang , haduh ba U Trai un da buh ia ki hapoh ki tyrpeng jong u .

en: And they crucified him , and parted his garments , casting lots : that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet , They parted my garments among them , and upon my vesture did they cast lots .
kha: Ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad nangta ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki da kaba ïakhalai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sahnarphna ia u, bad ki la pyniakhlad ia ki jain jong u, ki da thep vote: ba kan long kaba la kren da u nongiathuhlypa: Ki la pyniakhlad ia ki jain jong nga hapdeng jong ki, bad halor ka jain jong nga ki la thep vote .

en: I will consume man and beast  ; I will consume the fowls of the heaven , and the fishes of the sea , and the stumblingblocks with the wicked  ; and I will cut off man from off the land , saith the  Lord .
kha: ïa baroh ki briew bad ki mrad , ki sim bad ki dohkha . Ngan wallam ka jingkyllon jong u bymman . Ngan pynjot ïa u bynriew baroh , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uno uno uba lait im . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bam ia u briew bad u mrad ; Ngan bam ia ki sim bneng bad ki dohkha duriaw bad ki dohkha kiba ia tyngkhuh bad ka ; bad ngan ot noh ia u briew uba sniew na ka ri , ong U Trai .

en: Yea , the  Lord  will answer and say unto his people , Behold , I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith : and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :
kha: U la jubab ïa ki :  Mynta ngan ai ïa phi u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , bad phin long kiba la sngewhun . Kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym ñiewbeiñ shuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , U Trai un jubab bad ong ha ki briew jong u , Ha khmih , ngan phah ia phi ia u kew bad ka wain bad ka umphniang , bad phin sa sngewhun da kata: bad ngan ym pynlong shuh ia phi ka jingshah lehbein hapdeng ki jaitbynriew:

en: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself , and that he may be unto thee a God , as he hath said unto thee , and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
kha: khnang ba U  Trai  un pynskhem ïa phi mynta kum ki briew jong u bad ba un long U Blei jong phi , kumba u la kular ïa phi bad ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba un pynskhem ia me ha ka sngi na ka bynta u briew ha lade, bad ba un long ha me U Blei kumba u la ong ha me, bad kumba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob .

en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  fell upon me , and said unto me , Speak  ; Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thus have ye said , O house of Israel : for I know the things that come into your mind , every one of them .
kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha ki briew ïa kane ka khubor :  Ko ki paid Israel , nga tip ïa kaei kaba phi ong bad ïa kaei kaba phi thmu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Trai u la hap halor jong nga, bad u la ong ha nga, Kren kumta u Trai; Kumta phi la ong, ko iing Israel: namar nga tip ia kiei kiei kiba wan ha ka jingmut jong phi, uwei pa uwei na ki .

en: Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
kha: Te u lyngskor u la ai dak ïa u Paul ban kren , u Paul u la ong ,  Nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem , bad kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul, hadien ba u Lat u la kren ia u, u la jubab, Kumba nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar ha kane ka jaitbynriew, nga leh kham sngewbha ia ka jubab na ka bynta lade:

en: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people , even for salvation with thine anointed  ; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked , by discovering the foundation unto the neck . Selah .
kha: Me mihnoh ban pyllait ïa la ki briew , ban pyllait ïa u syiem ba la jied jong me . Me pynkyllon ïa u nongïalam jong ki bymman bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongbud jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Me la leit sha khmat na ka bynta ka jingpynim ia ki briew jong me, wat na ka bynta ka jingpynim jong me; me la pynmynsaw ia ka khlieh na ka iing jong ki bymman, da kaba lap ia ka nongrim haduh ka ryndang . Ka jingbam .

en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth , even apparently , and not in dark speeches  ; and the similitude of the  Lord  shall he behold : wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses ?
kha: Kumta nga ïakren bad u markhmat , da kaba shai , bad ym ha ki jingkyntip ; u la ïohi wat ïa ka dur jong nga . Kumno keiñ phi nud ban kren pyrshah ïa u Moses u shakri jong nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Da u ngan kren da ka shyntur sha ka shyntur, wat kumba ka paw, bad ym ha ki jingkren kiba dum bad ka jingiasyriem jong U Trai un iohi: namar kata phim shym la tieng ban kren pyrshah ia u shakri jong nga u Moses ?

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong , and that which was broken  ; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .
kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u baroh ar tylli — kaba dang bha bad kaba la kheiñ lypa — bad ka waitlam kan hap na ka kti jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u la ong: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt , bad ngan pynpra ia ki kti jong u , kiba khlain bad ia kaba la tyrkhong ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka waitlam ban hap na ka kti jong u .

en: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock , there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns : but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen , and for the treading of lesser cattle .
kha: Baroh ki lumrit ha kaba shisien la thung ïa ki mar rep kin jyllei shikatdei da ki shiah ba yn ym don mano mano ba leit hangta . Kan long ka jaka ha kaba ki masi bad ki langbrot ki bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ki lum baroh kiba la tih da ki bniat, kan ym wan sha kata ka jingtieng ia ki bniat bad ki bniat: hynrei kan long na ka bynta ban phah ia ki masi , bad na ka bynta ban iaid ia ki masi kiba kham rit .

en: And it came to pass , when David was come to Mahanaim , that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo–debar , and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim ,
kha: Haba u Dabid u la wan poi ha Mahanaim , u Shobi , u khun jong u Nahash , na ka shnong Rabbah kaba ha Ammon , u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , na Lodebar , bad u Barsillai , na Rogelim kaba ha Gilead , ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la poi ha Mahanaim, u Shhobi u khun u Nahas na ki khun Ammon bad u Machir u khun u Ammiel na Lodebar bad u Barzillai u Gilead u Rogelim .

en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .
kha: Haba ki syiem kiba hap hapoh u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Dabid bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u . Ki Syria kim ju mon shuh ban ïarap ïa ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki shakri jong u Hadareer ki la iohi ba ki la shah pynsniew shuh shuh ha khmat ki Israel , ki la iasuk bad u Dabid bad ki la long ki shakri jong u: bad ki Syria kin ym iarap shuh ia ki khun Ammon .

en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .
kha: Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki long kiba runar bad ki bym don jingisynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki shong ha ki kulai jong ki . Ki la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kin thiah ha ka bow bad ki khnam ki long kiba sniew, bad kim don jingsngewrit; ka sur jong ki ka khih kum ka duriaw ; bad ki shong halor ki kulai, ki la buh ha ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ia me, ko khun jong ka Seion .

en: The fifth , sardonyx  ; the sixth , sardius  ; the seventh , chrysolite  ; the eighth , beryl  ; the ninth , a topaz  ; the tenth , a chrysoprasus  ; the eleventh , a jacinth  ; the twelfth , an amethyst .
kha: uba san u maw Oniks , uba hynriew u maw Karnelian , uba hynñiew u mawleiñ bastem , uba phra u maw Beryl , uba khyndai u maw Topas , uba shiphew u maw Khalkedon , uba khatwei u maw Turkwois , uba khat-ar u maw Amethyst .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba phra , ka Sardonyx kaba hynriew, ka sngi kaba hynriew, ka sngi kaba hynriew, ka sngi kaba phylla .

en: Israel is an empty vine , he bringeth forth fruit unto himself : according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars  ; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba dap da ki sohwaiñ . Katba ki nang manbha , katta ki nang tei kham bun ki duwan . Katba ka ri jong ki ka nang pahuh , katta ruh ki nang pynitynnat ïa ki rishot maw bakyntang ba ki mane .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka Israel ka long ka sohjew kaba thylli , u wanrah ia ki soh ha lade: kat kum ka jingbun ki soh jong u u la pynbun ia ki almari ; kat kum ka jingbha jong ka ri jong u ki la shna bha ia ki dur .

en: Blessed are those servants , whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching : verily I say unto you , that he shall gird himself , and make them to sit down to meat , and will come forth and serve them .
kha: A katno kiba kmen long kito ki shakri kiba u kynrad jong ki u shem ba ki dang peitmat bad kiba la kloi haba u wan ! Nga ong ha phi , ba un law ïa la ka jaiñkup , un ong ïa ki ban shong , bad un shakri ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia kita ki shakri, kiba u kynrad ynda u wan un shem ba u peit: shisha nga ong ha phi, ba un teh ia lade, bad un pynlong ia ki ban shong ha ka jingbam, bad un wan shabar bad un shakri ia ki .

en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .
kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haduh mynta . Dei namar kata ba ïa kata jaka la dang ïai khot ka Them Jingjynjar . Da kumta U  Trai  um shym da bitar shla shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynkiew halor jong u ia u maw uba heh haduh kane ka sngi . Kumta U Trai u la kylla na ka jingbitar jong u . Namarkata la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka , Ka them Achor haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me ? let my people go , that they may serve me .
kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , bad ki ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ Sa katno te men kyntait ban pyndem ha nga ? Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la wan rung sha u Pharaoh bad ki la ong ha u, Kumta u ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Hebru: Haduh katno phin kyntait ban pynrit ia lade ha khmat jong nga ? to ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit noh , ba kin shakri ia nga .

en: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above  ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof  ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it .
kha: Thaw ruh ka tnum ïa kata ka lieng bad pyllait jaka kumba sawphew saw sentimitar hapdeng ka tnum bad ki krung . Shna ïa ka lai mala bad buh ïa ka jingkhang ha krung jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkhang to pynlong ia ka lieng, bad ha ka cuit to pyndep ia ka halor ka ; bad ka jingkhang jong ka lieng to buh ha ka liang jong ka ; da kaba kham poh, kaba ar bad kaba lai .

en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .
kha: Balei ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt sha ka jaka kaba sniew kum kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei ruh um mih ? Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba u kew ruh um long , u soh Dumbur ruh um long , u sohwaiñ ruh um long , bad u soh Pomkranet ruh um long . Wat ka umdih ruh kam don !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad balei phi la pynlong ia ngi ban mih na Ijipt, ban wanrah ia ngi sha kane ka jaka kaba sniew ? kam dei ka jaka symbai ne ki soh ne ki sohjew ne ki sohjew; bad ym don um ban dih .

en: All that found them have devoured them : and their adversaries said , We offend not , because they have sinned against the  Lord  , the habitation of justice , even the  Lord  , the hope of their fathers .
kha: Ki la shah tur ïaleh da baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa ki . Ki nongshun jong ki , ki ong , ‘ Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta kaei kaba ngi la leh , kam long kaba bakla . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , bad ma ki hi kiba la dei ban ïailong kiba ïaineh ha u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh kiba la shem ia ki ki la bam ia ki: bad ki nongshun jong ki kim shym la sngewsih , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai , ka jaka shong jong ka hok , wat ia U Trai ruh , ka jingkyrmen jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Assyria bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san hajar ngut ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi kaba bud hangta ki thiah , baroh ki la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel U Trai u la leit noh, bad u la leit sha ka jaka sah jong ki nong Assyria shispah san hajar: bad haba ki la khie dang step , ha khmih baroh ki la iap .

en: Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .
kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Wat shah ba ki jingri jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki bym dei na kajuh ka jait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar jait u symbai . Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ kaba la suh da ki ar jait ki ksai .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi dei ban sumar ia ki ain jong nga . Wat ai ba ki masi jong me kin long kiba pher bapher: wat bet ia ka lyngkha jong me da u symbai ba la khleh lang: lymne ka jain kaba la khleh lang bad ka snieh langbrot kan wan ha me .

en: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .
kha: Buh kyrpang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ki shynrang baroh ba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi ; wat pyntreikam ïa kita ki masi , bad wat ot shñiuh ïa kita ki langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki shynrang kiba dang kha kiba wan na ka kynhun jong me bad na ka kynhun jong me men pynkyntang ia U Trai U Blei jong me: men ym leh ei ei bad ka jingkha khun nyngkong jong me , lymne ban ot ia ka jingkha khun nyngkong jong me .

en: Then thine handmaid said , The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable : for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad : therefore the  Lord  thy God will be with thee .
kha: Nga la ong ha lade ba ki kular jong phi , ko Kynrad , kin pynshngain ïa nga , namar ba u syiem u long kum u angel jong U Blei bad u lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew . To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka kti jong me ka la ong: Ka ktien jong u kynrad jong nga mynta kan long kaba suk: namar kum u angel U Blei , kumjuh ruh u kynrad jong nga ban ithuh ia kaba bha bad kaba sniew: namarkata U Trai U Blei jong me un don ryngkat bad me .

en: And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .
kha: Ha baroh ki jylla , hangno hangno ba la pynbna paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , la don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shahjingit , ki ïam bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki phong jaiñ khain bad thiah ha u dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha man la ka jylla, ha kano kano ka jaka ba u syiem bad ka hukum jong u ka la wan, ka la don ka jingsngewsih kaba khraw hapdeng ki Jiw, bad ka jingleh niam, bad ka iam, bad ka iam; bad bun ki la thiah ha ka jain bad ka dewbilat .

en: For verily I say unto you , That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .
kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba bun ki nongïathuhlypa bad bun ki briew ki jong U Blei ki la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hynrei kim lah ïohi , bad ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew , hynrei kim shym la lah ïohsngew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shisha nga ong ha phi , Ba bun ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki briew kiba hok ki la kwah ban iohi ia kita kiei kiei kiba phi iohi , bad kim shym la iohi ia ki ; bad ban iohsngew ia kita kiei kiei kiba phi iohsngew , bad kim shym la iohsngew ia ki .

en: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword , that with it he should smite the nations : and he shall rule them with a rod of iron : and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God .
kha: Na ka shyntur jong u la mih ka waitlam kaba nep , da kata un jop ïa ki jaitbynriew . Un synshar halor jong ki da u diengduh nar , bad ïuhroit ïa ka waiñ hapoh ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei U Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ka shyntur jong u ka mih ka wait kaba jem, ba da ka un shoh ia ki jaitbynriew: bad un synshar ia ki da u dieng nar: bad u iaid ia ka lynti iaid kjat jong ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar jong U Blei uba donbor baroh .

en: And I went unto the angel , and said unto him , Give me the little book . And he said unto me , Take it , and eat it up  ; and it shall make thy belly bitter , but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey .
kha: Nga la leit sha uta u angel bad nga la kyrpad ïa u ban ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli kaba rit . U la ong ïa nga ,  To shim ïa ka bad to bam ïa ka ; kan sa kylla jew ha ka  nierbah jong me , hynrei ha ka shyntur jong me kan long kaba thiang kum ka ngap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la leit sha u angel bad nga la ong ha u, Ai ia nga ia kata ka kot barit . Bad u la ong ha nga, Shim ia ka, bad bam ia ka; bad kan pynsngem ia ka kpoh jong me, hynrei kan long ha ka shyntur jong me kaba thiang kum ka umsoh .

en: And it shall come to pass , that as ye were a curse among the heathen , O house of Judah , and house of Israel  ; so will I save you , and ye shall be a blessing : fear not , but let your hands be strong .
kha: Ko ki paid Judah bad Israel ! Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ki nongwei ki ïatim iwei ïa iwei pat da kaba ong , ‘ Ai ba kijuh ki jingpynjot kiba la hap ha Judah bad Israel kin hap halor jong phi !’ Hynrei ngan pynim ïa phi , bad nangta kito ki nongwei kin ong iwei ïa iwei pat , ‘ Ai ba phin ïohpdiang ïa kijuh ki jingkyrkhu kiba la wan ha ka Judah bad Israel !’ Kumta to long shlur bad wat sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba kumba phi la long ka jingtim hapdeng ki nongwei, ko iing Judah bad ka iing Israel; kumta ngan pynim ia phi, bad phin long ka jingkyrkhu: wat tieng: hynrei to ai ba ki kti jong phi kin long kiba skhem .

en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar :
kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia ka snam jong ka jingknia pop da ka kti jong u, bad un theh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka jingknia thang , bad un theh ia ka snam jong ka baroh ha trai jong ka jingknia:

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it , to offer burnt offerings thereon , and to sprinkle blood thereon .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Haba la tei ïa ka duwan , me dei ban pynkyntang ïa ka da kaba thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka bad da kaba synreit halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad ba la kñia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , kumta u Trai Blei ; Kine ki long ki jingpynbeit jong ka almari ha ka sngi ba kin pynlong ia ka, ban ainguh ia ki jingknia thang halor kata bad ban theh snam halor kata .

en: And it came to pass , when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness , ( for the mountain did burn with fire , ) that ye came near unto me , even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders  ;
kha: Katba uta u lum baroh uwei u dang mehding bad phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan napdeng ka jingdum , ki nongïalam bad ki tymmen ki san na ki jait jong phi ki ïawan sha nga
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba phi la iohsngew ia ka sur na pdeng ka jingdum, (namar u lum u la thang da ka ding), ba phi la wan hajan jong nga, wat ki khlieh jong ki jaitbynriew jong phi baroh, bad ki rangbah jong phi;

en: Also I have made a decree , that whosoever shall alter this word , let timber be pulled down from his house , and being set up , let him be hanged thereon  ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .
kha: Nga hukum ruh ba lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , dei ban sei ïa u bim dieng na ka ïing jong u , ban pynnep ha kawei ka liang , bad ban sam lyngba ïa ka met jong u . Bad ïa ka ïing jong u ban pynlong kum ka kynton ñiut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh nga la buh ia ka hukum , ba uno uno u briew un pynkylla ia kane ka ktien , to ai ba un shah pynhiar na ka iing jong u , bad la buh ia u , to ai ba un shah pynsangeh ha kata ka por ; bad to ai ba ka iing jong u kan long ka dewbilat na ka bynta kane .

en: And said unto them ,  Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me : for he that is least among you all , the same shall be great .
kha: Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa une u khynnah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , u pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u pdiang sngewbha ruh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga . Naba uta uba rit tam napdeng jong phi baroh u long uba khraw tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha ki: Uno uno uba pdiang ia une u khynnah ha ka kyrteng jong nga u pdiang ia nga: bad uno uno uba pdiang ia nga u pdiang ia uta uba la phah ia nga: namar uta uba rit tam napdeng jong phi baroh .

en: And they shall pass through it , hardly bestead and hungry : and it shall come to pass , that when they shall be hungry , they shall fret themselves , and curse their king and their God , and look upward .
kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma lyngba ka ri , kiba la noh mynsiem bad thngan . Ha ka jingthngan bad jingbitar jong ki , kin tim ïa u syiem jong ki bad ïa U Blei jong ki . Ki lah ban khmih sha ka sahit bneng
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin iaid lyngba ia ka, tang khyndiat eh bad ki thngan: bad kan sa jia ba ynda ki la thngan, kin sa sngewsih ia lade, bad kin sa tim ia u syiem jong ki bad ia U Blei jong ki, bad kin peit sha jrong .

en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
kha: lada ka dei kaba lam jyrngam lane kaba lam saw , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dei ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka khlam ka long kaba jyrngam ne kaba saw ha ka jain ne ha ka sniehdoh, la ka long ha ka sniehdoh ne ha ka sniehdoh; ka long ka khlam jong ka sniehdoh, bad yn pyni ha u lyngdoh:

en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death . And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Set thine house in order  ; for thou shalt die , and not live .
kha: Hamar kane ka por u syiem Hesekaïah u kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos u leit peit ïa u bad ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa phi ba phin buh ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh , namar ba phin ym ïohkhiah . Pynkhreh ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi u Hesekaiah u la pang haduh ka jingiap . Bad u nongiathuhlypa Isaiah u khun u Amoz u la wan sha u bad u la ong ha u , Kumta u ong U Trai: To buh ia ka iing jong me khnang ba me iap, bad ym ban im .

en: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .
kha: Kumta ki la khmih ïa ka kabu . Ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leh mynleh kum kiba shida , bad ki la phah ïa ki ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli , khnang ba kin lah ban aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar bad sha ka bor jong u lyngskor ka Hima Rom .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la peit ia u, bad ki la phah ia ki nongleit jingleit, kiba dei ban leh kum ki briew kiba rit paid, ba kin bat ia ki ktien jong u, ba kin aiti ia u sha ka bor bad ka bor jong u Lat .

en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
kha: Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki  erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh kum ka  erïong tlang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar me la long ka bor ia kiba duk, ka bor ia kiba duk ha ka jingjynjar jong u, ka jaka rieh na ka eriong , ka jingdum na ka jingshit , haba ka jingbthei jong kiba shyrkhei ka long kum ka eriong pyrshah ia ka kynroh .

en: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .
kha: Wah ïa kata ka pyrda na ki jingpyndait kiba don hapoh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba don ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap buh ïa ka sha lyndet ka pyrda . Kata ka pyrda kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men pyndait ia ka jingtap hapoh ki taches , ba men wanrah shapoh ka jingtap: bad ka jingtap kan phiah ha phi hapdeng ka jaka bakhuid bad kaba khuid tam .

en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand , and for a memorial between thine eyes , that the  Lord s  law may be in thy mouth : for with a strong hand hath the  Lord  brought thee out of Egypt .
kha: Kane ka jingrakhe kan long ka jingpynkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la teh ha ka kti jong phi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong phi ; kan pynkynmaw ïa phi ban ïai kren bad ïai puson ïa ka Aiñ U  Trai  , namar U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt da ka borbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long ka dak ha me ha ka kti jong me, bad ka jingkynmaw hapdeng ki khmat jong me, ba ka hukum U Trai kan long ha ka shyntur jong me: namar da ka kti kaba khlain U Trai u la pynmih ia me na Ijipt .

en: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded , which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel , with the women , and the little ones , and the strangers that were conversant among them .
kha: U Joshua u pule ïa kawei pa kawei na ki hukum u Moses ha kata ka jingïalang , ha kaba la kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah , lem bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym shym la don ka ktien jong baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum, kaba u Joshua um shym la pule ha khmat ka jingiaseng Israel baroh kawei, bad ki kynthei bad ki khynnah rit bad ki nongwei kiba la tip hapdeng jong ki .

en: But , behold , I will raise up against you a nation , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts  ; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh da lade u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai nongwei ban knieh ïa ka ri jong phi . Kan banbeiñ ïa phi naduh ka Khim Hamath bashaphang shatei haduh ka wahduid Arabah bashaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei, ha khmih, ngan pynmih pyrshah ia phi ia ka jaitbynriew, ko iing Israel, ong U Trai U Blei jong ki paid ; bad kin pynshitom ia phi naduh ba rung ha ka wah Hamath haduh ka wah jong ka ri khlaw .

en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob , because they be replenished from the east , and are soothsayers like the Philistines , and they please themselves in the children of strangers .
kha: A Blei me la iehnoh ïa ki briew jong me , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ! Ka ri ka dap da ki jingleh myntor na ka ri Mihngi bad na ka Philistia . Ki briew ki bud ïa ki dustur nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me la iehnoh ia ki briew jong me na ka iing u Jakob , namar ba ki la shah pyndap na shaphang mihngi , bad ki long ki nonglehkai kum ki Philistia , bad ki sngewbha ia lade ha ki khun ki ksiew .

en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard , and his feet were as the feet of a bear , and his mouth as the mouth of a lion : and the dragon gave him his power , and his seat , and great authority .
kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u ïasyriem ïa u  labasa , bad ki kjat kum ki kjat dngiem bad ka shyntur u kum ka shyntur sing . U Ïakjakor u la ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong u hi , ïa ka khet jong u , bad ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u mrad uba nga iohi u long kum u blang, bad ki kjat jong u ki long kum ki kjat jong u bear bad ka shyntur jong u kum ka shyntur jong u sing: bad u bsein u la ai ia u ia ka bor jong u bad ka jaka shong jong u bad ka bor kaba khraw .

en: Behold , the hand of the  Lord  is upon thy cattle which is in the field , upon the horses , upon the asses , upon the camels , upon the oxen , and upon the sheep : there shall be a very grievous murrain .
kha: ngan pynshitom ïa me da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang kaba shyrkhei ha ki jingri jong me baroh — ha ki kulai , ki kada , ki ut , ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka kti U Trai ka don ha ki masi jong me kiba don ha lyngkha, ha ki kulai, ha ki kada, ha ki kulai, ha ki kulai, ha ki masi bad ha ki langbrot: kan don ka jingsawa kaba jur bha .

en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumta ngan kyrkhu ïa u bad ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un long u kpa jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , bad ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shaphang u Ismael , nga la iohsngew ia me: Ha khmih nga la kyrkhu ia u, bad ngan pynkha khun ia u, bad ngan pynbun ia u haduh katta katta; shiphew ngut ki rangbah un kha khun ia u, bad ngan pynlong ia u ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

en: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials , and talked with me , saying unto me , Come hither  ; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters :
kha: Nangta uwei na kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang , u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  Ale , ngan pyn-i ha me ba kumno yn pynshitom ïa ka nuti bapawnam , kata ka nongbah bakhraw ïa kaba la tei hajan ki wah babun .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei na ki hynriew ngut ki angel uba don ki hynriew tylli ki khiew bad u la kren bad nga, u da ong ha nga: To wan hangne ngan pyni ha me ia ka jingbishar jong ka nongkhaii kaba khraw kaba shong halor ki um kiba bun:

en: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the  Lord  they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem  ; and he fled to Lachish : but they sent to Lachish after him , and slew him there .
kha: Naduh kata ka por mynba u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem . Ha kaba khatduh u la phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , hynrei ki nongshun jong u ki la buddien ïa u shata bad ki la pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta hadien ka por ba u Amasaiah u la phai noh na kaba bud ia U Trai ki la leh ia ka jingthmu pyrshah ia u ha Jerusalem ; bad u la phet noh sha Lachish : hynrei ki la phah sha Lachish hadien jong u bad ki la pyniap ia u hangta .

en: And Elijah said unto him , Tarry , I pray thee , here  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jordan . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And they two went on .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha ka wah Jordan .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingshaniah skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha u, Tarry, nga kyrpad ia me, hangne; namar U Trai u la phah ia nga sha Jordan . Bad u la ong: Kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ngan ym iehnoh ia me . Bad ki arngut ki la iaid shakhmat .

en: And it came to pass , that , when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab , and found the princes of Judah , and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah , that ministered to Ahaziah , he slew them .
kha: Katba u Jehu u dang pyntreikam ïa ka rai jong U Blei halor ka longïing syiem , u la ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun kaba don ki nongïalam jong ka Judia bad ki pyrsa jong u Ahasaïah kiba la synran ïa u Ahasaïah ha ka jingleit jngoh jong u . U Jehu u la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Jehu u dang pyndep ia ka iing u Ahab bad u la lap ia ki rangbah Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u Ahasaiah kiba shakri ia u Ahasaiah .

en: And now , behold , the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir , whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade , when they came out of the land of Egypt , but they turned from them , and destroyed them not  ;
kha: Mynta ki briew jong ka Ammon , ka Moab bad ka Edom ki la tur ïaleh ïa ngi . Mynba ki kpa tymmen ki mihnoh na Ijipt , mem shym la shah ïa ki ban rung ha kito ki ri , kumta ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la hap ban ïaid sawdong jong ki bad mem shym la pynjot ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ha khmih, ki khun ki ksiew jong ka Ammon bad ka Mount Seir, kiba me ym shah ia ki Israel ban hiar thma, haba ki la mih na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei ki la phai noh na ki bad kim shym la pynjot ia ki;

en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga maham ïa phi ban ym shah ïa lade ban shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba im hapdeng jong phi lane da kino kino kiwei pat kiba kam ba ki lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei . Wat ym pynleit jingmut satia ïa ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki Israel; Wat ai ba ki nongiathuhlypa jong phi bad ki nongleh jadu jong phi kin long hapdeng jong phi .

en: If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,
kha: Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shnong jong phi ïa u shynrang lane ka kynthei kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don hapdeng jong phi hapoh kano kano ka khyrdop jong me kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me , ko shynrang ne kynthei , uba la leh ia ka jingsniew ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me , ha kaba pynkhein ia ka jutang jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha Jesreel . Ngan pynkut noh ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jong u Jehu .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Khot ia ka kyrteng jong u Jesel tang khyndiat por, bad ngan pynlong ia ka snam Jesel halor ka iing u Jehu , bad ngan pynlong ban sangeh noh ia ka hima Israel .

en: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand ? will Saul come down , as thy servant hath heard ? O  Lord  God of Israel , I beseech thee , tell thy servant . And the  Lord  said , He will come down .
kha: Hato ki nongshong shnong jong ka Keilah kin aiti ïa nga ha u Saul ? Hato u Saul un wan shisha , kumba nga la ïohsngew ? Ko  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga kyrpad ïa me ban jubab ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  U Saul un wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ki briew jong ka Keilah kin aiti ia nga sha ka kti jong u ? u Saul un wan hiar kumba u shakri jong me u la iohsngew ? Ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , nga kyrpad ia me, to iathuh ia u shakri jong me . Bad U Trai u la ong , Un wan hiar .

en: And it came to pass , that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the  Lord  their God , for which the  Lord  their God had sent him to them , even all these words ,
kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa ki paidbah baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Jeremaiah u la pynkut noh ia ki briew baroh ki ktien U Trai jong ki, namar ba U Trai U Blei jong ki u la phah ia u ha ki, wat ia kine ki ktien baroh .

en: After the doings of the land of Egypt , wherein ye dwelt , shall ye not do : and after the doings of the land of Canaan , whither I bring you , shall ye not do : neither shall ye walk in their ordinances .
kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im ki briew ha ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi ruh shisien phi la shong , ne ïa ki jong ki briew ha ri Kanaan , sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien ki kam jong ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong, phin ym leh: bad hadien ki kam jong ka ri Kana: bad hadien ki kam jong ka ri Kana: bad phin ym iaid ha ki kyndon jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , If her father had but spit in her face , should she not be ashamed seven days ? let her be shut out from the camp seven days , and after that let her be received in again .
kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Lada u kpa jong ka u bynthiew halor ka khmat jong ka , ka dei ban shah ïa ka jingjahburom hynñiew sngi . Kumta ieh kan shah khang shabar ka jaka sher dara shi taïew , bad hadien kata lah ban pynrung pat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, Lada u kpa jong ka u la sngap jar ia ka khmat jong ka, hato kam dei ban sngewlehrain hynriew sngi ? to ai ba kan shah khang noh na ka shnong hynriew sngi bad hadien kata to ai ba kan shah pdiang biang ia ka .

en: Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .
kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong kata ka jingbitar shla bad ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai ha ka khmut jong me bad u bnoh ha ka shyntur jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka jingbitar jong me pyrshah ia nga, bad ka jingsawa jong me, ka la wan sha ki shkor jong nga, namarkata ngan buh ia ka hook jong nga ha ka shyntur jong me, bad ngan pynphai biang ia me da ka lynti kaba me wan.

en: And the  Lord  shall utter his voice before his army : for his camp is very great : for he is strong that executeth his word : for the day of the  Lord  is great and very terrible  ; and who can abide it ?
kha: U  Trai  u kyrhuh ïa ki hukum sha ka kynhun shipai jong u . Ki shipai kiba kohnguh ïa u ki long shibun bad kiba khlaiñbor . Haduh katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ka sngi jong U  Trai  ! Uei u ban lait im na ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynmih ia ka sur jong u ha khmat ka kynhun shipai jong u: namar ka kynhun jong u ka long kaba khlain bha: namar u long uba khlain uba pyntreikam ia ka ktien jong u: namar ka sngi U Trai ka long kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei shibun bad mano ba lah ban shah ia ka ?

en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar un pynkut noh ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong baroh bad un weng noh ïa ka jingjahburom kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U  Trai  hi da lade u la kren !
translated_en_to_kha: Un sa bam ia ka jingiap ha ka jingjop ; bad U Trai Blei un sait ia ki ummat na ki khmat baroh ; bad ka jingshah lehbein jong ki briew jong u un weng noh na ka khyndew baroh kawei: namar U Trai u la kren ia kata .

en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .
kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei jong u kpa jong me u Abraham . Wat sheptieng , nga don ryngkat bad me . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew namar ka jingkular jong nga ïa u shakri jong nga u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la paw ha u ha kajuh ka miet bad u la ong: Nga long U Blei jong u Abraham u kpa jong me: wat tieng, namar nga don ryngkat bad me, bad ngan kyrkhu ia me, bad ngan pynbun ia u symbai jong me na ka bynta u Abraham jong nga .

en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .
kha: Ym don mano mano ba wan sha ka Templ mynta ban mane ha ki sngi bakhuid . Ki kynthei samla kiba rwai hangta ki shahshitom , bad ki lyngdoh ki lah tang ban shu ud . Ki khyrdop ka nongbah ki ïeng thylli , bad ka Seïon ka don ha ka jingkordit .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pynkhih ia ka bow jong u kum u nongshun: u la ieng da ka kti kadiang jong u kum u nongshun , bad u la pyniap ia kiei kiei baroh kiba sngewtynnad ia ka khmat ha ka jaka sah jong ka khun jong u Seion: u la theh ia ka jingbitar jong u kum ka ding .

en: And he began again to teach by the sea side : and there was gathered unto him a great multitude , so that he entered into a ship , and sat in the sea  ; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land .
kha: U Jisu u la sdang biang ban hikai harud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah uba la ïalum sawdong jong u , u la bun haduh katta katta ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka . Ka lieng ka don ha ka um , bad u paidbah u la ïeng ha ryngkew harud ka um .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sdang biang ban hikai ha rud duriaw: bad la lum lang ia u ha u u paidbah uba bun , haduh ba u la rung ha ka lieng , bad u la shong ha duriaw ; bad u paidbah baroh u la don ha rud duriaw ha ka ri .

en: Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .
kha: Ngi kwah ba u syiem un tip ba ki Jiw kiba la wan hangne na kiwei ki ri , ki la shong la sah ha Jerusalem bad ki dang tei pat ïa kato ka nongbah kaba sniew bad kaba ïaleh pyrshah . Ki la sdang ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh bad shen kin sa pyndep ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ha u syiem ba ki Jiw kiba wan shaneng na me sha ngi ki wan sha Jerusalem , ki tei ia ka nongbah kaba leh pyrshah bad kaba sniew , bad ki la buh ia ki kynroh jong ka , bad ki la iasoh bad ki nongrim .

en: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not , and wells digged , which thou diggedst not , vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not  ; when thou shalt have eaten and be full  ;
kha: Ki ïing kin dap da ki mar kiba bha kiba phim shym la leit buh hangta , bad kin don ki pukri kiba phim shym la tih , bad ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Olib kiba phim shym la thung . Ynda U  Trai  u ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri bad phi ïoh kat ïa kaba phi kwah ban bam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki iing kiba dap da kiei kiei baroh kiba bha, kiba me la pyndap, bad ki thliew um kiba me la tih, kiba me la tih, ki kper sohjew bad ki dieng olive kiba me la thung;

en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah , and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah  ; they laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , and the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
kha: U Joïada , u khun jong u Paseah , bad u Meshullam , u khun jong u Besodeïah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Jeshanah . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ka khyrdop barim ka la pynbha ia u Jehoiada u khun u Besodiaiah; ki la buh ia ki beam jong ka, bad ki la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka, bad ki jingkhang jong ka .

en: Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past , that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .
kha: ki ïa-pihuin , ïabuaid , ki don jingkhawai jingdih kyiad , bad leh ïa kiwei kiei kiei kiba kum kine . Nga maham ïa phi mynta kumba nga la maham mynshuwa ; ba kita kiba ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei kin ym ïohkynti ïa ka hima U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingsngewsih, ki jingpyniap briew, ki jingdih buaid, bad kiwei kiwei: na kiba nga ong ia phi mynshuwa , kumba nga la ong ruh ha phi ha ki por ba la leit noh , ba kito kiba leh ia kum kine kiei kiei kin ym hiar pateng ia ka hima U Blei .

en: And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .
kha: Shuwa ban kut ka jingduwai , ka Rebekka ka la wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khun jong u Bethuel , uba long u khun jong ka Milkah bad u Nahor , uba shi para bad u Abraham .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia shuwa ba un kren, ba, ha khmih, ka Rebekka ka la mih, kaba la kha ia u Bethuel u khun u Milkah, ka tnga jong u Nahor u hynmen u Abraham, bad ka khiew jong ka ha ka tyrpeng jong ka .

en: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan , and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water , ( for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest , )
kha: Ka dei ka aïom ot , bad ka wah ka don ha ka jingshlei um . Haba u paidbah u la mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ban jam ïa ka Jordan , ki lyngdoh ki la leit ha shuwa jong ki , ki da bah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Hamar ba ki lyngdoh ki ïuh ha ka wah ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba ki dang kit ia ka synduk ki la poi sha Jordan , bad ki kjat jong ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk ki la ngam ha ka tduh um , (na ka Jordan ka tuid lut ha ki rud jong u baroh kawei ka por .)

en: I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .
kha: Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin kren ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Naba u briew uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kham kor ban ïa uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher — lymda don uno uno uba batai ïa kaei kaba u kren , khnang ba kan long ka jingïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga kwah ba phi baroh phin kren da ki thylliej, hynrei kham bha ba phin iathuhlypa: namar uba kham khraw ban ia uta uba kren da ki thylliej, lait noh tang ba u batai, ba ka balang kan ioh ia ka jingpynroi .

en: And it came to pass , that in the morning , behold , it was Leah : and he said to Laban , What is this thou hast done unto me ? did not I serve with thee for Rachel ? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me ?
kha: Dei tad ynda ka la shai mynstep ba u Jakob u shem ba ka dei pynban da ka Leah . U leit sha u Laban , bad u ong ,  Balei phi leh ïa kane ha nga ? Nga la trei ban ïoh ïa ka Rakhel ? Balei phi la shukor ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka por mynstep, ha khmih, ka la long ka Leah: bad u la ong ha u Laban: Kaei kane kaba me la leh ia nga ? ngam shym la shakri bad me na ka bynta ka Rakhel ? namar kata me la sngewbha ia nga ?

en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .
kha: Nangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahit bneng , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh bneng ha ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta kan paw ka dak jong u Khun u briew ha bneng : bad nangta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka khyndew kin iam , bad kin iohi ia u Khun u briew uba wan ha ki lyoh bneng da ka bor bad ka burom kaba khraw .

en: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .
kha: Ha ka por sep sngi , u poi sha ka jaka bakhuid bad u la sher dara hangta . U dem ban thiah , u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh halor u maw .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shai ha kawei ka jaka, bad u la sah hangta baroh shi miet, namar ba ka sngi ka la sep ; bad u la shim ia ki maw jong kata ka jaka , bad u la buh ia ki na ka bynta ki tyrpeng jong u , bad u la thiah ha kata ka jaka ban thiah .

en: And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say to your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard , with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .
kha: u phah pat ïa kane ka jubab :  U  Trai  u ong ïa phi ban nym shah ba ki Assyria kin pynsheptieng ïa phi da ki jingkam jong ki ba un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah u la ong ha ki , Kumta phin ong ha u kynrad jong phi , Kumta u ong U Trai , Wat tieng ia ki ktien kiba me la iohsngew , da kiba ki shakri jong u syiem Assyria ki la kren bein ia nga .

en: And the bramble said unto the trees , If in truth ye anoint me king over you , then come and put your trust in my shadow : and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon .
kha: U dieng shiah u jubab , ‘ Lada phi kwah shisha ban pynlong ïa nga u syiem jong phi , te ale wan bad riehtngen hapoh ka syrngiew jong nga . Lada phim kwah , ka ding kan klang na ki tnat shiah jong nga bad bam duh ïa ki dieng Kedar ka Lebanon .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u bramble u la ong ha ki dieng , Lada ha ka jingshisha phi pynsleh ia nga syiem halor jong phi, te to wan bad buh ia ka jingshaniah jong phi ha ka jingdum jong nga: bad lada ym dei, to ai ba ka ding kan mih na ka bramble, bad to bam ia ki soh Lebanon .

en: Wherefore , O king , let my counsel be acceptable unto thee , and break off thy sins by righteousness , and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor  ; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity .
kha: Kumta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , to bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Sangeh ban leh pop , to leh ïa kaba dei , bad to sngewsynei ïa kiba duk . Te phin ïailong uba manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko syiem, to ai ba ka jingai jingmut jong nga kan long kaba pdiang sngewbha ia me, bad to weng noh ia ki pop jong me da ka hok, bad ki jingbymhok jong me da kaba pyni ia ka jingsngewrit ia kiba duk; lada ka lah ban long ka jingpynjlan ia ka jingsuk jong me .

en: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt , every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself , because of the counsel of the  Lord  of hosts , which he hath determined against it .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Ijipt kin sngewtriem ïa ka Judah ha man ka por ba la pynkynmaw ïa ka kupar kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la khreh na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ri Judah kan long ka jingtieng ia ka ri Ijipt , uwei pa uwei uba kdew ia ka un tieng ha lade , namar ka jingmut jong U Trai jong ki paid kaba u la kut jingmut pyrshah ia ka .

en: Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .
kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel ba la pynsakma halor ki lum kum ïa ki langbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong , nga la iohi ia ki Israel baroh kiba la saphriang ha ki lum , kum ki langbrot ki bym don nongap: bad U Trai u la ong: Kine kim don kynrad ; to ai ba kin leit phai noh namarkata uwei pa uwei sha la iing da kaba suk .

en: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early  ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled  ; but that they might eat the passover .
kha: Dang step phyrngab la ïalam ïa U Jisu na ka ïing u Kaïaphas sha ka ïing jong u lyngskor . Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw kim shym la rung shapoh ka ïing , naba ki kwah ban sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam , khnang ba ki lah ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ialam ia U Jisu na u Kaiaphas sha ka jaka bishar: bad ki hi kim shym la leit sha ka jaka bishar, ioh ba kin shah pynjakhlia ; hynrei ba kin bam ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka Jinglaitluid .

en: So the king of Israel went , and the king of Judah , and the king of Edom : and they fetched a compass of seven days  journey : and there was no water for the host , and for the cattle that followed them .
kha: Kumta u syiem Joram bad ki syiem ka Judah bad Edom ki la ïamih . Hadien ka jingïaid kaba hynñiew sngi , ki la kyrduh um , bad ym don ei ei shuh na ka bynta ki rangbah lane na ka bynta ka kynhun ki mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem Israel u la leit noh bad u syiem Judah bad u syiem Judah: bad ki la leit ia ka jingleit kaba hynriew sngi: bad ym don um na ka bynta u shipai bad na ka bynta ki masi kiba bud ia ki .

en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?
kha: Balei phim shym ïabam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntang ? Ka long kaba khuid bha , bad U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka bynta ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u paidlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phim shym la bam ia ka jingainguh pop ha ka jaka bakhuid tam , bad U Blei u la ai ia ka ha phi ban kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ka balang , ban pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki ha khmat U Trai ?
