en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .
kha: Ki la ai jingtip ha u syiem ïa ka jingdon baroh jong ki rangbah kiba bit ban long shipai : phra lakh ha Israel bad san lakh ha Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la aiti ia ka jingkhein jong ki briew ha u syiem: bad ki don ha Israel hynriew spah hajar ngut ki briew kiba shlur kiba la tan ia ka waitlam ; bad ki briew jong ka Judah ki long san spah hajar ngut ki briew .

en: Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod : waste and utterly destroy after them , saith the  Lord  , and do according to all that I have commanded thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Merathaim bad jong ka Pekod . Pynïap bad pynjot ïa ki . Leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba nga hukum ïa phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit sha ka ri Methaim, wat pyrshah ia ka, bad pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Pekod: pynjot bad pynjot lut hadien jong ki, ong U Trai, bad leh katba nga la hukum ia me .

en: And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .
kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha phi ban ym shah ba ki Assyria kin pynkhaw-eit ïa phi da ki jingkob jong ki ba um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaiah u la ong ha ki , Kumta phin ong ha u kynrad jong phi , Kumta u ong U Trai , Wat tieng ia ki ktien kiba me la iohsngew , ha kaba ki shakri jong u syiem Assyria ki la kren bein ia nga .

en: Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him ,  Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .
kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha u ,  Dang don sa kawei pat kaei kaei kaba me donkam ban leh . Die noh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta wan bad bud ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba U Jisu u la iohsngew ia kine kiei kiei, u la ong ha u: Hynrei me duna kawei: die lut ia kaba me don, bad sam ha kiba duk, bad me don ka spah ha bneng: bad to wan, to bud ia nga .

en: And the bay went forth , and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth : and he said , Get you hence , walk to and fro through the earth . So they walked to and fro through the earth .
kha: Katba ki kulai thohbroin ki dang wan mih , ki la long kiba da kwah eh ban leit bad ban jurip ïa ka pyrthei . U angel u la ong ,  Khie leit bad jurip ïa ka pyrthei !  — bad ki la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka duriaw ka la leit sha khmat, bad ka la wad ban leit noh ba kin iaid sha khyndew: bad u la ong: To iaid namarkata sha khyndew . Kumta ki la iaid sha khyndew .

en: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .
kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha uno uno uba mut ban pynlong ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um sngewbha ïa ka , te u dei ban die pat ïa ka ha u kpa jong ka ; u kynrad jong ka um lah ban die ïa ka ha ki nongwei , namar u la leh bymdei ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada kam sngewbha ia u kynrad jong ka, uba la pynlong ia ka ha lade, te un ailad ia ka ban siewspah: ban die ia ka ha ka jaitbynriew nongwei un ym don bor ei ei, namar ba u la leh thok ia ka .

en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .
kha: Nyngkong ha Damaskos bad ha Jerusalem bad nangta ha ka Judia baroh bad hapdeng ki Jentil , nga la ïalap ba ki dei ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pop jong ki bad ban phai sha U Blei bad leh ïa kiei kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la pyni nyngkong eh ha ki ha ka ri Damarkos bad ha Jerusalem bad ha ki ri Judaea baroh kawei bad nangta ha ki Jutang baroh kawei, ba kin kylla bamut bad phai sha U Blei bad leh ia ki kam kiba iadei bad ka jingkylla kaba mut .

en: And they brought in the ark of the  Lord  , and set it in his place , in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it : and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
kha: Ki la wallam ïa ka Synduk bad buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la pynïeng na ka bynta jong ka . Nangta u ainguh ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wanrah ia ka synduk U Trai, bad ki la buh ia ka ha ka jaka jong u, hapdeng ka iingjain kaba u Dabid u la buh na ka bynta jong ka: bad u Dabid u la tyrwa ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk ha khmat U Trai .

en: And from Jesus Christ , who is the faithful witness , and the first begotten of the dead , and the prince of the kings of the earth . Unto him that loved us , and washed us from our sins in his own blood ,
kha: bad na U Jisu Khrist , u sakhi baïaineh , uba nyngkong ïa uba la pynmih na ka jingïap bad uba long ruh u nongsynshar jong ki syiem jong ka pyrthei . U ieit ïa ngi , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki pop
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na U Jisu Khrist uba long u nongsakhi uba iaineh, bad uba la kha nyngkong eh na kiba iap bad u syiem jong ki syiem jong ka khyndew . Ha uta uba la ieit ia ngi bad uba la sait ia ngi na ki pop jong ngi ha ka snam jong u hi .

en: O  Lord  , the hope of Israel , all that forsake thee shall be ashamed , and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth , because they have forsaken the  Lord  , the fountain of living waters .
kha: A  Trai  , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; baroh kiba la lyndet ïa me yn buh ha ka jinglehrain . Kin jah noh kum ki kyrteng ba la thoh ha ka khyndew , namar ki la lyndet ïa me , U  Trai  , uba long ka umpohliew ki um basngur .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Trai, ka jingkyrmen jong ki Israel, baroh kiba iehnoh ia me kin sngewlehrain , bad kita kiba leit noh na nga kin sa shah thoh ha ka khyndew , namar ki la iehnoh ia U Trai , ka pung um ba im .

en: And the messengers came again , and said , Thus speaketh Ben–hadad , saying , Although I have sent unto thee , saying , Thou shalt deliver me thy silver , and thy gold , and thy wives , and thy children  ;
kha: Hadien ki nonglamktien ki wan biang sha u Ahab bad kawei pat ka jingdawa na u Benhadad ;  Nga la phah ktien sha me ba men aiti noh ha nga ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong me , bad ïa ki kynthei bad ki khun jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nonglam khubor ki la wan biang bad ki la ong, Kumta u kren u Benhadad, u da ong, Wat la nga la phah sha me, da kaba ong: Me dei ban aiti ia nga ia ka rupa jong me bad ka ksiar jong me bad ki tnga jong me;

en: And they are informed of thee , that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses , saying that they ought not to circumcise their children , neither to walk after the customs .
kha: La ïathuh ha ki , ba me la hikai ïa ki Jiw baroh kiba shong basah ha ki ri jong ki Jentil ban iehnoh ïa ka Hukum u Moses , da kaba ong ïa ki ban ym otsher ïa ki khun jong ki lane bud ïa ki dustur jong ki Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la pyntip ia me ba me hikai ia ki Jiw baroh kiba don hapdeng ki Jutang ban iehnoh ia u Moses , da kaba ong ba kim dei ban ot ia ki khun jong ki , lymne ban iaid katkum ki riti dustur .

en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .
kha: u don la ki khun shynrang ; bad kine ynda ki la san ki beh noh ïa u Jephthah na ïing . Ki ong ha u ,  Men ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jong ngi , naba me dei u khun na kawei pat ka briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka tnga jong u Gilead ka la kha ia u; bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la san la san, bad ki la beh noh ia u Jephthah, bad ki la ong ha u, Wat hiar pateng ha ka iing u kpa jong ngi; namar me long u khun jong ka kynthei nongwei .

en: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
kha: Hadien ngan sa theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha uwei pa uwei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki tymmen shynrang kin don ki jingphohsniew , bad ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia hadien kata, ba ngan theh ia ka mynsiem jong nga ha ka doh baroh bad ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong phi kin iathuhlypa, ki rangbah jong phi kin phohsniew; ki samla jong phi kin iohi ia ki jingphohsniew:

en: And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
kha: Ki Israel kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynta ki wan hiar ban ïasoh lem ha ka thma . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki shem ïa lade ba ki la shah kerkut ha ki Israel , bad ba ki la shah pynïap lut . Ym don uwei ruh uba lait im , bad ym don uwei ruh uba lait na kata lait tang u syiem jong ka Ai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u la mih na ka shnong pyrshah ia ki ; kumta ki la don hapdeng ki Israel, don ha kane ka liang bad don ha kata ka liang: bad ki la shoh ia ki, haduh ba kim shah ia uwei ruh na ki ban sah ne ban lait im .

en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .
kha: Bun snem hadien kane , u syiem Ijipt u ïap noh , hynrei ki Israel ki dang ïai ud namar kata ka jinglongmraw jong ki bad ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por ba u syiem Ijipt u la iap: bad ki khun Israel ki la ud namar ka jinglong mraw , bad ki la iam , bad ka jingud jong ki ka la wan shaneng sha U Blei namar ka jinglong mraw .

en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :
kha: Hynrei , ngan ym knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na u Solomon , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka bor katba u dang im . Kane ngan leh na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jied bad uba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan ym shim ia ka hima baroh kawei na ka kti jong u: hynrei ngan pynlong ia u u syiem baroh ki sngi jong u na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga, uba nga la jied, namar u la sumar ia ki hukum jong nga bad ki ain jong nga:

en: There shall be no more thence an infant of days , nor an old man that hath not filled his days : for the child shall die an hundred years old  ; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed .
kha: Ki khunlung kin ym ïap shuh haba ki dang khunlung , bad baroh ki briew kin im haduh ba ki la pura bha ka rta . Kito kiba im kumba shispah snem yn ñiew ïa ki ba ki dang samla . Ban ïap shuwa ïa kata pat kan dei ka dak ba nga la pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don shuh u khunlung uba dang kha khun shispah snem: namar u khynnah un iap shispah snem; hynrei u nongpop uba la dap shispah snem yn sa tim .

en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .
kha: Phi lah ban pynngat ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng bad pyndonkam ïa ki ha kaba tei ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong haduh ba kan da kyllon .
translated_en_to_kha: Tang ki dieng kiba me tip ba kim long ki dieng na ka bynta ka doh , men pynjot bad ot ia ki ; bad men tei ia ki kynroh pyrshah ia ka nongbah kaba ialeh thma bad me haduh ba kan da shah pynduh noh .

en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness : they shall be driven on , and fall therein : for I will bring evil upon them , even the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki lynti ïaid ba ki bud kin long kiba btuit bad kiba dum ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ba kin jynthut bad kin kyllon . Ngan wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki ; ka por ka jingpynshitom ïa ki ka la nang wan , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka lynti jong ki kan long ha ki kum ki lynti kiba sniew ha ka jingdum: kin sa shah beh noh bad kin hap ha ka: namar ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew halor jong ki, wat ia ka snem jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki, ong U Trai .

en: Look down from heaven , and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory : where is thy zeal and thy strength , the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me ? are they restrained ?
kha: A  Trai  , to khmih ïa ngi na bneng , ha kaba me shong ha ka jingkhuid bad ka burom jong me . Hangno kata ka jingsngewkhia bakhraw jong me ïa ngi ? Hangno kata ka bor jong me ? Hangno kata ka jingieit bad ka jingsngewlem jong me ? Wat leh bymsuidñiew ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit shapoh na bneng , bad ha khmih na ka jaka shong jong ka jingkhuid jong me bad jong ka burom jong me: hangno ka jingkmen bad ka bor jong me , ka jingsawa jong ki bniat jong me bad jong ki jingsngewrit jong me sha nga ? hato ki la shah teh ?

en: And the servants of Achish said unto him , Is not this David the king of the land ? did they not sing one to another of him in dances , saying , Saul hath slain his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem ki ong ha u Akhish ,  Hato une um dei u Dabid , u syiem jong ka ri jong u ? Une u dei u briew uba shaphang jong u ki kynthei ki phawar , katba ki dang shad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u Achish ki la ong ha u, Hato une u Dabid u dei u syiem jong ka ri? kim shym la rwai iwei ia iwei pat ha ki jingshad, ki da ong: U Saul u la pyniap ia ki hajar jong u bad u Dabid u la pyniap ia ki shi hajar ?

en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .
kha: U Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , uba na ka jait Issakhar , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab bad u la pynïap ïa u katba u Nadab bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Baasha u khun u Ahijah, na ka iing u Issakhar, u la thmu ia u ; bad u Baasha u la shoh ia u ha Gibbethon, kaba dei ka jong ki Philistia ; na ka bynta u Nadab bad ki Israel baroh ki la leit sha Gibbethon .

en: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .
kha: Baroh ki paid Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeroboam ïa uba yn ïoh tep donburom , namar u long tang ma u hi ïa uba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki Israel baroh kin iam na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ia u: namar tang ma u hi na u Jeroboan un wan sha ka jingtep , namar ha u la shem ia kaei kaei kaba bha ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ha ka iing u Jeroboan .

en: And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
kha: Ki jubab ,  Ïa ka jingïakajia bad u Saul lem bad ka longïing jong u ym lah ban pynbeit da ka rupa lane ka ksiar , lymne ba ngi kwah ban pynïap ïa uno uno u Israel .   Te , kaei phi pyrkhat ba ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u Dabid u kylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Gibeon ki la ong ha u, Ngin ym don rupa ne ksiar jong u Saul, ne na ka iing jong u ; bad na ka bynta jong ngi wat pyniap ia uno uno u briew ha Israel . Bad u la ong , Kaei kaba phi ong , kata ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi .

en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .
kha: bad kumta U  Trai  u ong ba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki lah ban ïashongkurim bad uno uno uba ki mon , hynrei tang hapoh ka jait jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai u hukum shaphang ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad, da kaba ong , Ai ba kin shongkurim ia uba ki pyrkhat bha; tang ia ka iing ka sem jong u kpa jong ki kin shongkurim .

en: Know that thus saith the  Lord  of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David , and of all the people that dwelleth in this city , and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity  ;
kha: Pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong shaphang u syiem uba synshar ïa ka hima kaba u Dabid u la synshar bad shaphang ki briew jong kane ka nongbah , kata , ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi ki bym shym la shah rah noh kum ki koidi lem bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Tip ba kumta u Trai jong u syiem uba shong ha ka khet u Dabid bad na ki briew baroh kiba shong ha kane ka shnong bad na ki hynmen jong phi ki bym shym la leit shabar bad phi sha ka jingshah set phatok ; .

en: This is the word which the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin , the daughter of Zion , hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong  Ka nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sennakherib , bad ka ñiewbeiñ ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka ktien kaba U Trai u la kren shaphang jong u ; Ka khun kynthei jong ka Seion ka la lehbein ia me bad ka la rkhie bein ia me; ka khun kynthei jong ka Jerusalem ka la pynkhih ia la ka khlieh ha me .

en: See , for that the  Lord  hath given you the sabbath , therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days  ; abide ye every man in his place , let no man go out of his place on the seventh day .
kha: Kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  nga la ai ha phi ïa ka sngi shongthait , bad dei namar kata ba ha ka sngi kaba hynriew nga ai jingbam ïa phi kat ban biang na ka bynta ar sngi . Baroh phin ïashong ha ka jaka ba phi don ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad phim dei ban mih na la ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit, namar ba U Trai u la ai ia phi ia ka Sabha, namarkata u ai ia phi ha ka sngi kaba hynriew ia u kpu jong ki ar sngi; to sah ha ka jaka jong u , wat ai ba uno uno un mih na ka jaka jong u ha ka sngi kaba hynriew .

en: And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .
kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ïa u Doeg ,  Ma me , pynïap ïa ki !  — bad u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki baroh . Ha kata ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san ngut ki lyngdoh kiba bit ban phong ïa ka ephod .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong ha u Doeg, To phai noh ia me, bad to hap ha ki lyngdoh . Bad u Doeg u la phai noh, bad u la hap halor ki lyngdoh, bad u la pyniap ha kata ka sngi saw ngut bad san ngut ki briew kiba phong ia ka jain lyngkhuid .

en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .
kha: Ka Seïon ka la siew na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U  Trai  un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingbymhok jong me ka la pyndep , ko khun jong u Seion ; un ym rah shuh ia me sha ka jingshah set: un leit jngoh ia ka jingbymhok jong me, ko khun jong u Edom ; un sa lap ia ki pop jong me .

en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .
kha: Don ki Pharisi kiba la ong ,  Uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane um lah ban long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton .  Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u lah ban leh kum kita ki kambah kat kine ?  Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata la ong katto katne na ki Pharisi: Une u briew um dei na U Blei namar ba um ju bat ia ka sngi Sabha . Kiwei pat ki la ong: Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u lah ban leh ia ki kambah kiba kum kita ? Bad ka la don ka jingphiah hapdeng jong ki .

en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ki suri bad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kin bam phlang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: U blang bad u langbrot kin ia bam lang, bad u sing un bam ia u sboh kum u masi: bad ka dewbilat kan long ka doh jong u bsein . Kin ym pynmong ne pynjot ha u lum bakhuid jong nga baroh , ong U Trai .

en: My people hath been lost sheep : their shepherds have caused them to go astray , they have turned them away on the mountains : they have gone from mountain to hill , they have forgotten their restingplace .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki long kum ki langbrot kiba ki nongap langbrot ki la shah ba kin jah noh ha ki lumbah . Ki la sakma kum ka langbrot na uwei u lum sha uwei pat , bad ki la klet hangno ka ïing jong ki ka don .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la jah noh: ki nongap langbrot jong ki ki la pynlong ia ki ban iaid bakla , ki la pynphai noh ia ki sha ki lum: ki la leit noh na u lum sha lum , ki la klet noh ia ka jaka shongthait jong ki .

en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah , and they cast up a bank against the city , and it stood in the trench : and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall , to throw it down .
kha: Ki rangbah jong u Joab ki la ïohsngew ba u Sheba u don hangta , bad kumta ki la leit ban kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Ki tei ka kynton stong marpyrshah ïa ka kynroh kaba phai shabar bad ki la sdang ruh ban tih sha trai ka kynroh ban pynkhyllem ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan bad ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u ha u Abel jong ka Bethmaah, bad ki la bret ia ka bank pyrshah ia ka shnong, bad ka la ieng ha ka thliew: bad ki briew baroh kiba don bad u Joab ki la pynkhih ia ka kynroh, ban pynhap ia ka .

en: Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .
kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ko Daniel , to wat sheptieng . U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba me la kut jingmut ban pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Wat tieng, Daniel: namar naduh ka sngi ba nyngkong ba me la buh ia ka dohnud jong me ban sngewthuh bad ban pynkhuid ia lade ha khmat U Blei jong me, la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong me bad nga wan na ka bynta ki ktien jong me .

en: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin : but yield yourselves unto God , as those that are alive from the dead , and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God .
kha: Lymne ba phi dei ban pyndem ïa kano kano ka bynta jong phi sha ka pop ha ka jingpyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingthmu bymman . Pynban , phi dei ban ai ïa lade sha U Blei , kum kito ïa kiba la wallam pat na ka jingïap sha ka jingim , bad ban pyndem ha u ïa la ka jingim baroh kawei , ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingthmu bahok .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phim ai ia ki dkhot jong phi kum ki tiar jong ka jingbymhok ha ka pop: hynrei to aiti ia lade ha U Blei , kum kito kiba im na kiba iap , bad ki dkhot jong phi kum ki tiar jong ka hok ha U Blei .

en: Then the glory of the  Lord  went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house  ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the  Lord s  glory .
kha: Te ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon U  Trai  ka la kiew noh na ki kherub sha ka jaka rung jong ka Templ . Te u lyoh u la tap ïa ka Templ , bad kata ka phyllaw ka phyrnai da ka jingshai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka burom U Trai ka la kiew na ka cherub , bad ka la ieng halor ka jingkhang jong ka iing ; bad ka iing ka la dap da u lyoh , bad ka phyllaw ka la dap da ka jingshai jong ka burom U Trai .

en: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy , who is my beloved son , and faithful in the Lord , who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ , as I teach every where in every church .
kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu nga phah ha phi ïa u Timothi , uba long u khun ba-ieit bad baïaineh jong nga ha ka jingim kum uba ngeit . Un pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ki nongrim kiba nga bud ha ka jingim kaba thymmai ha U Khrist Jisu bad kaba nga hikai ha ki balang baroh kiba don kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kane nga la phah ha phi ia u Timothi uba long u khun baieit jong nga bad uba ngeit ha U Trai , uba pynkynmaw ia phi ia ki lynti jong nga kiba don ha U Khrist , kumba nga hikai ha man la ki jaka ha man la ka balang .

en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom — dei tang ha kane ka sngi ba ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka hynñiew sien .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ba ki la ieng dang step ha ka por mynstep jong ka sngi , bad ki la ker sawdong ia ka nongbah da kajuh ka rukom: tang ha kata ka sngi ki la ker sawdong ia ka nongbah hynriew sien .

en: Let my lord , I pray thee , pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .
kha: Sngewbha , khie nang ïaid sha khmat , ngan nang bud suki suki , ban ïaid katba nga lah lem bad kine ki jingri bad ki khynnah haduh ba ngin sa ïashem pat bad phi ha Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba u kynrad jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, un iaid shakhmat ha khmat u shakri jong u: bad ngan ialam jem jai, katba ki masi kiba leit ha khmat jong nga bad ki khun kin lah ban shah, haduh ba ngan da poi ha u kynrad jong nga ha Seir .

en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli ki ryntieh ksiar men shna ia ka hapoh ka khlieh jong ka, da ki ar tylli ki tduh jong ka, ha ki arliang jong ka men shna ia ka ; bad kin long na ka bynta ki dieng ban kit ia ka .

en: And Reuben said unto them , Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him  ; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .
kha: Shu bret ïa u ha kane ka pukri hangne ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei wat pynmynsaw ïa u .  U ong kumta namar ba u mut ban pyllait im ïa u na ki , bad ban phah pat ïa u sha la u kpa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Reuben u la ong ha ki, Wat ai snam ia u, hynrei wat bret ia u ha kane ka thliew kaba don ha ka ri khlaw, bad wat buh kti ia u ; ba un weng noh ia u na ki kti jong ki, ban aiti biang ia u sha u kpa jong u .

en: And this I say , that the covenant , that was confirmed before of God in Christ , the law , which was four hundred and thirty years after , cannot disannul , that it should make the promise of none effect .
kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Abraham bad u la kular ban bat ïa ka . Ka hukum , ïa kaba la ai hadien sawspah laiphew snem , kam lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad pyndam noh ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane nga ong , ba kata ka jutang kaba la pynskhem ha khmat U Blei ha U Khrist , ka hukum kaba la long saw spah laiphew snem hadien , kam lah ban pynduh noh ia ka jingkular kaba ym don jingktah ei ei .

en: The  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saith  ; Behold , I will punish the multitude of No , and Pharaoh , and Egypt , with their gods , and their kings  ; even Pharaoh , and all them that trust in him :
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ,  Ngan pynshitom ïa u Amon , u blei jong ki Thebes , ryngkat lang bad ka Ijipt bad ki blei bad ki syiem jong ka . Ngan shim noh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa baroh kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai jong ki paidbah , U Blei jong ki Israel , u ong: Ha khmih, ngan pynshitom ia u paidbah jong u No, bad u Pharaoh bad ka ri Ijipt, bad ki blei jong ki, bad ki syiem jong ki; bad ki syiem jong ki;

en: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death . And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Set thine house in order : for thou shalt die , and not live .
kha: Kum ha kane ka por u Syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Amos u la leit ban jngoh ïa u bad u la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u ïathuh ïa phi ba phi dei ban buh beit ïa kiei kiei baroh namar phin ym koit shuh . Pynkhreh ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi u Hesekaiah u la pang haduh ka jingiap . Bad u Isaiah u khun u Amoz u la wan sha u bad u la ong ha u: Kumta u ong U Trai: To buh ia ka iing jong me ha ka rukom: namar me iap, bad ym im .

en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .
kha: Nga la kwah ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot jong u ; hynrei ki long kum u dieng sohwaiñ khlem ki sohwaiñ , kum u diengsoh Dumbur khlem ki soh Dumbur ; wat ki sla ki la jlop . Namar kata , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim noh ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bam shisha ia ki , ong U Trai: ym don ki sohjew ha u sohjew ne ki sohjew ha u dieng sohjew bad u sla un jah noh; bad kiei kiei kiba nga la ai ha ki kin jah noh na ki .

en: And the seventh angel sounded  ; and there were great voices in heaven , saying , The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord , and of his Christ  ; and he shall reign for ever and ever .
kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la put ïa la ka turoi , bad la don ki sur kiba jam ha bneng , kiba ong ,  Ka bor ban synshar halor ka pyrthei ka long mynta ka jong U Trai jong ngi bad jong U Messaïah jong u , bad un synshar junom la junom !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u angel uba hynriew u la sawa ; bad ki la don ki sur kiba khraw ha bneng , ki hima jong kane ka pyrthei ki kylla long ki hima jong U Trai jong ngi bad jong U Khrist jong u ; bad un synshar junom .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands , lest Israel vaunt themselves against me , saying , Mine own hand hath saved me .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Ki rangbah kiba me don , ki la bun eh ïa nga ban ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Midian . Ki lah ban pyrkhat ba ki la jop da lade hi , bad kumta kim ai burom ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gideon , Ki briew kiba don bad me ki long kiba bun palat ia nga ban aiti ia ki nong Midan ha ki kti jong ki , ioh ba ki Israel kin iaid pyrshah ia nga da kaba ong: Ka kti jong nga hi ka la pynim ia nga .

en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and , behold , the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .
kha: Ha ka aïom pakor nga la phohsniew , bad nga la ïohi ba ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria bad kiba thohbroin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por ba ki masi ki la pun khun, ba nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la iohi ha ka jingphohsniew, bad, ha khmih, ki langbrot kiba la jngi halor ki masi ki la tyrkhong, ki la tyrkhong bad ki la tyrkhong .

en: And David said unto Achish , But what have I done ? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day , that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king ?
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla aïu eh keiñ , kynrad ? Lada , kumba phi ong , ba phim shym la shem jingbakla ha nga naduh ka sngi ba nga sdang ban shakri ïa phi , balei ba ngam dei ban leit bad phi , u kynrad bad u syiem jong nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Akhis: Hynrei nga la leh aiu ? bad kaei kaba me la shem ha u shakri jong me katba nga dang don bad me haduh kane ka sngi , ba ngam lah ban leit ialeh pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong u kynrad jong nga u syiem ?

en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad , whom I have not made sad  ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :
kha: Da ki jinglamler jong phi , phi pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew babha , kiba ngam kwah ba kin sngewmong . Phi khang ïa ki briew basniew ban iehnoh ïa kaba sniew bad pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da ki jinglamler phi la pynsngewsih ia ka dohnud jong kiba hok, ia kiba ngam shym la pynsngewsih bad pynskhem ia ki kti jong kiba sniew, ba un ym phai noh na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u;

en: Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .
kha: Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . To shahshkor ïa ki jingmudui jong ki ! Ki jingkyang jong kito kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki la poi sha ki shkor jong U Blei , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ka jingsiew jong ki nongtrei kiba la kheit ia ki lyngkha jong phi, kaba la buh da ka jingleh thok: bad ki jingpyrta jong ki kiba la kheit ki rung ha ki shkor U Trai jong ka ri Sepngi .

en: Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .
kha: Ale hangne bad ïathuhlypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , khnang ba ngin tip ïa ka haba ka urlong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kiba la dep bad ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba kin wanrah ia ki shabar , bad kin pyni ia ngi ia kaei kaban sa jia: to ai ba kin pyni ia kiei kiei kiba mynshuwa, kaei kaba ki long, ba ngin pyrkhat ia ki, bad ngin tip ia kaba hadien jong ki ; ne pynbna ia kiei kiei kiba hadien .

en: Neither let the son of the stranger , that hath joined himself to the  Lord  , speak , saying , The  Lord  hath utterly separated me from his people : neither let the eunuch say , Behold , I am a dry tree .
kha: U nongwei uba pynïasoh bad u paidlang jong U  Trai  um dei ban ong ,  U  Trai  un ym shah ïa nga ban mane bad ki briew jong u .  U briew ba la shah dab um dei ban pyrkhat namar ba um lah ban don khun , um lah ban don bynta lang bad ki paidlang U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u khun jong u nongwei uba la iasoh bad U Trai, un kren, u ong, U Trai u la pyniakhlad noh shisyndon ia nga na ki briew jong u: bad u eunuch un ong: Ha khmih nga long u dieng uba la tyrkhong .

en: And thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , They are laid desolate , they are given us to consume .
kha: Te men sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong me ba ïa ki lumbah ka Israel ba ki la sah kynjah bad ba ki long ki jong me ba men bam duh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me tip ba nga long U Trai bad ba nga la iohsngew ia ki jingkren bein jong me baroh kiba me la kren pyrshah ia ki lum Israel , da kaba ong , La pynjot ia ki , la ai ia ngi ban bam .

en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .
kha: bad u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la bret ïa ka mluh ha ka um , bad u ong ,  Kane ka dei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka um , bad kan ym pynjia shuh kano kano ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khun .’
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit sha ka tyllong um, bad u la theh ia ka umsoh hangta, bad u la ong: Kumta ong U Trai, nga la pynkoit ia kine ki um ; kan ym don shuh ka jingiap ne ka ri kaba khlem sboh .

en: And I said unto the king , If it please the king , and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight , that thou wouldest send me unto Judah , unto the city of my fathers  sepulchres , that I may build it .
kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ka Bneng , bad nangta nga ong ha u patsha ,  Lada ma me , ko syiem , me don ka jingsngewbha ïa nga bad ai sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , shah ïa nga ba ngan leit sha ka ri Judah , sha ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga , khnang ba nga lah ban tei pat ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ong ha u syiem , Lada ka long kaba sngewbha ia u syiem bad lada u shakri jong me u la shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me, ba me phah ia nga sha Judah, sha ka shnong jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga, ba ngan tei ia ka .

en: When they fast , I will not hear their cry  ; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation , I will not accept them : but I will consume them by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence .
kha: Wat lada ki shahjingit , ngan ym shahshkor ïa ki jingkyang jong ki ban ïoh jingïarap ; bad wat lada ki ai ïa nga ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bam , ngan ym sngewbha ïa ki . Pynban ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki iaid niam , ngan ym iohsngew ia ka jingud jong ki ; bad haba ki ai ia ka jingainguh thang bad ka jingknia , ngan ym pdiang ia ki: hynrei ngan bam ia ki da ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh .

en: Let people serve thee , and nations bow down to thee : be lord over thy brethren , and let thy mother s sons bow down to thee : cursed be every one that curseth thee , and blessed be he that blesseth thee .
kha: To ai ba ki jaitbynriew kin long ki shakri jong me , bad ki briew kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . To men synshar halor ki kur ki jait jong me baroh , bad to ai ba ki khun ki ksiew ka kmie jong me kin dem khrup ha khmat jong me . Ai ba kito kiba tim ïa me kin long kiba la tim bad ai ba kito kiba me kyrkhu kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba ki briew kin shakri ia me, bad ki jaitbynriew kin dem khrup ha me: to long u kynrad halor ki hynmen jong me, bad to ai ba ki khun shynrang jong me kin dem khrup ha me: to long uba la tim ia me, bad la kyrkhu ia uta uba kyrkhu ia me .

en: Now therefore send quickly , and tell David , saying , Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness , but speedily pass over  ; lest the king be swallowed up , and all the people that are with him .
kha: U Hushai u bynrap ,  Pynkloi , mynta ! phah khubor sha u Dabid ban ym sahmiet ha ki jaka jam wah ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ban jam mar mar ïa ka Jordan , ba kumta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh kin ym shah kem bad shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to phah kloi ia u Dabid da kaba ong: Wat leit noh mynta ka miet ha ki madan ri khlaw , hynrei to iaid stet ia u syiem na ka daw ba u syiem un shah rong noh bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u .

en: And they tarried till they were ashamed : and , behold , he opened not the doors of the parlour  ; therefore they took a key , and opened them : and , behold , their lord was fallen down dead on the earth .
kha: Ki la ap haduh ba ki dang lah ban ap , hynrei haba um shym la plie ïa ka jingkhang , ki la shim ïa u shabi bad plie ïa ka . Bad hangta u don u kynrad jong ki , u da thiah ïap ha madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la sah haduh ba kin da sngewlehrain: bad, ha khmih, um shym la plie ia ki jingkhang jong ka parlor ; namarkata ki la shim ia u shabi, bad ki la plie ia ki: bad, ha khmih, u kynrad jong ki u la hap iap ha ka khyndew .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .
kha: Lada ha kawei ka sngi ïa ka suiñbneng la lah ban thew bad ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei la ïitbniah , tang kata hi ka ban pynlong ba un kyntait ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh kaba ki la leh . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Lada lah ban thew ia ka bneng shaneng, bad ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki la wad shapoh , ngan bret noh ruh ia u symbai Israel baroh na ka bynta kiei kiei baroh kiba ki la leh , ong U Trai .

en: And Moses besought the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people , which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power , and with a mighty hand ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u la ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ba men bitar haduh katne ïa la ki jong ki briew , kiba me la pyllait na ka ri Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw bad da ka bor ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kyrpad ia U Trai U Blei jong u, bad u la ong, Ko Trai, balei ba ka jingbitar jong me ka nang jur pyrshah ia ki briew jong me, kiba me la wanrah na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor kaba khraw bad da ka kti kaba khlain ?

en: And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .
kha: Ki jubab , ‘ Ngi dei ki shakri jong U Blei ka bneng bad ka khyndew , bad ngi tei pat ïa ka Templ kaba lah dep tei bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat bun snem mynshuwa da u syiem bakhrawbor ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumta ki la pynphai biang ia ngi da kaba ong , Ngi long ki shakri U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , bad ngi tei ia ka iing kaba la tei bun snem mynshuwa , kaba u syiem Israel uba khraw u la tei bad u la buh .

en: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him : and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded . So they left off speaking with him  ; for the matter was not perceived .
kha: Te baroh ki rangbah synshar ki la wan ban kylli ïa nga , bad nga la ong ïa ki thik kumba u syiem u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha ki . Ym don ei ei pat kaba ki lah ban leh , namar ym don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh ki la wan sha u Jeremaiah bad ki la kylli ia u: bad u la iathuh ha ki kat kum kine ki ktien baroh kiba u syiem u la hukum . Kumta ki la iehnoh ia ka jingiakren bad u ; namar ia kata ym shym la sngewthuh .

en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire , and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women : and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot , and thou also shalt give no hire any more .
kha: Kin thang duh ïa ki ïing jong pha bad shah ïa ki paid kynthei ban ïohi ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong pha . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ban sangeh ban long ka nuti bad pynlong ïa pha ban sangeh ban ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki nongleh-ieit jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin thang ia ki iing jong me da ka ding, bad kin pyndep ia ki jingbishar halor jong me ha khmat kiba bun ki kynthei: bad ngan pynlong ia me ban sangeh noh ban ialehkai ia ka kam sniew, bad me ruh men ym ai jingsiew shuh .

en: And a certain woman named Lydia , a seller of purple , of the city of Thyatira , which worshipped God , heard us : whose heart the Lord opened , that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul .
kha: Kawei na kito kiba la ïohsngew ïa ngi ka dei ka Lydia kaba na Thiatira , ka dei ka nongdie ïa ka jaiñ sawbthuh . Ka long ka briew kaba mane ïa U Blei , bad U Trai u la plie ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ka ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kaba u Paul u ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Lydia, ka nongdie ia ka rong saw, na ka shnong Thiatira, kaba mane ia U Blei, ka la iohsngew ia ngi: ka dohnud jong u U Trai ka la plie, ba ka la leit sha kiei kiei kiba la kren shaphang u Paul .

en: And David girded his sword upon his armour , and he assayed to go  ; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul , I cannot go with these  ; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him .
kha: U Dabid u bsuh ïa ka waitlam u Saul ha kata ka jingkieng atiar bad u pyrshang ban ïaid , hynrei um lah , namar ba um ju mlien ban phong ïa kita .  Ngam lah ban leit ïaleh ryngkat bad kine ,  u ong ïa u Saul .  Ngam ju mlien ïa ki .  Kumta u loit noh ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la pynkhih ia ka waitlam jong u ha ka jainkup jong u, bad u la sngewthuh ba um shym la pynshisha ia kata . U Dabid u la ong ha u Saul, Ngam lah ban leit bad kine ki ; namar ngam shym la pynshisha ia ki . U Dabid u la weng noh ia ki na u .

en: Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .
kha: Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha khyndew bad ngan wanrah ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan iehnoh ia me ha ka ri , ngan bret noh ia me ha ka lyngkha kaba plie , bad ngan pynlong ia ki sim bneng baroh ban sah ha me , bad ngan pyndap ia ki mrad jong ka khyndew baroh kawei da me .

en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , namar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki briew ha kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki shong ki sah nga la lah pynbna ha ki Israel ba nga ngan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la leh na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ba kan ym shah pynjakhlia ha khmat ki nongwei, ha kiba ki la don, ha kiba nga la pynpaw ia lade ha ki khmat jong ki, ha kaba wanrah ia ki na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God upon the top of this rock , in the ordered place , and take the second bullock , and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down .
kha: Tei ka duwan kaba la shna bha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong me ha kliar kane ka kynton . Nangta shim ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar bad thang tylli ïa u kum ka jingainguh , da kaba pyndonkam diengthang da ki dak jong ka Asherah ïa kaba me la pynkhyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tei ia ka jingknia ha U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka tduh jong une u maw, ha ka jaka ba la buh ryntih, bad shim ia u masi uba ar, bad to ai ia ka jingknia thang da u dieng jong u khlaw uba me ot shapoh .

en: And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .
kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumta , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ho-oid , mynta ngi shah jynjar namar kaei kaba ngi la leh ïa la u jong u para . Ngi la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad ngim shym la shahshkor . Dei namar kata ba ngi shah jynjar kumne mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia kren iwei ia iwei pat, Ngi long shisha kiba don pop ha u hynmen jong ngi, ha kaba ngi la iohi ia ka jingsngewsih jong ka mynsiem jong u, haba u la sngewsih ia ngi, bad ngin ym iohsngew ia ngi; namarkata kane ka jingjynjar ka wan ha ngi .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Gaza , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they carried away captive the whole captivity , to deliver them up to Edom :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Gasa ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh bad die noh ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ki briew ka Edom .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein jong ka Gaza , bad na ka bynta saw tylli , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ki la rah noh ia ka jingshah set baroh kawei, ban aiti noh ia ki haduh:

en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel : and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury  ; and they shall know my vengeance , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin pynhiarkput ïa ka Edom namar jong nga , bad kin pynlong ïa ka Edom ban mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga . Ki Edom kin tip ka mut aïu ban shah ha ka jingpynhiarkput jong nga .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan buh ia ka jingpynshitom bein jong nga ha u Edom da ka kti jong ki briew jong nga: bad kin leh ha Edom kat kum ka jingbitar jong nga bad kat kum ka jingbitar jong nga; bad kin tip ia ka jingpynshitom bein jong nga, ong U Trai U Blei .

en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .
kha: U la hukum ïa u paidbah ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synran ki la leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la hukum ia ki briew ban shong ha madan : bad u la shim ia kita ki hynriew tylli ki kpu bad u la ainguh bad u la bret bad u la ai ha ki synran jong u ban buh ha khmat jong ki ; bad ki la buh ia ki ha khmat ki briew .

en: And Elijah answered and said unto them , If I be a man of God , let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And the fire of God came down from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangbah jong me !  Hangta hi ka ding jong U Blei ka la wan hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki, Lada nga long u briew jong U Blei, to ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad kan bam ia me bad ia me sanphew snem . Bad ka ding U Blei ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la bam ia u bad ia u sanphew snem .

en: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .
kha: hato phi lah hi ban ap haduh ba kin da san ? Hato kane kan khanglad ïa phi na kaba shongkurim ïano ïano ? Em , ko khun kynthei jong nga , phi tip ba kata kam lah ban long . U  Trai  u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , bad nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phin sah na ka bynta jong ki haduh ba kin da san ? hato phin sah na ka bynta jong ki na ka jingdon tnga ? hooid, ki khun kynthei jong nga; namar ka pynsngewsih shibun ia nga na ka bynta jong phi ba ka kti U Trai ka la mih noh pyrshah ia nga .

en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans , but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men , whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury , and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city .
kha: Katto katne kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nong Babilonia , ki ban pyndap ïa ki ïing da ki metïap jong kito kiba ngan sa pynïap namar ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Nga la phai noh na kane ka nongbah namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki briew jong ka ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki wan ban ialeh bad ki Khlieh , hynrei ka long ban pyndap ia ki da ki met iap jong ki briew kiba nga la pyniap ha ka jingbitar jong nga bad ha ka jingbitar jong nga , bad na ka bynta jong ki baroh kiba nga la buhrieh ia ka khmat jong nga na kane ka nongbah .

en: But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .
kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Abimelekh bad kan bam duh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang duh ïa u Abimelekh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ym dei, to ai ba ka ding kan mih na Shechem, bad kan bam ia ki briew jong u Shechem, bad ka iing jong u Millo ; bad ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki briew jong u Shechem, bad na ka iing jong u Millo, bad kan bam ia u Abimelech .

en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .
kha: U briew baroh un khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka kyrteng jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka sngi ngan sdang ban buh ia ka jingtieng ia me bad ka jingtieng ia me ha ki jaitbynriew kiba don hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei , ki ban iohsngew ia ka khubor jong me , bad kin sa khih namar jong me .

en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .
kha: Da ki jingkyrkhu jong me , ki syiem ki la synshar ïa ki briew jong me haba ki shong ki sah ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh ba me la ai ïa ki ; hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ka pop ban shakri ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kim shym la shakri ia me ha ka hima jong ki, bad ha ka jingbha kaba khraw jong me ba me ai ia ki, bad ha ka ri kaba heh bad kaba heh kaba me ai ha khmat jong ki, lymne kim shym la phai noh na ki kam bymman jong ki .

en: And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .
kha: Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , buh ïa ka ha kata ka kali , bad thep ha kawei ka synduk kaba ha syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka jingainguh namar ki pop jong phi . Pyllait ïa ka kali ha ka lynti jong ka bad ieh kan leit hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shim ia ka synduk U Trai, bad buh ia ka ha ka kali ; bad buh ia ki mawkordor ksiar, kiba phi pynphai biang ia u na ka bynta ka jingainguh kaba sniew, ha ka synduk kaba don ha ka liang jong ka ; bad phah noh ia ka, ba kan leit noh .

en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right : thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father s brethren  ; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them .
kha: Kaei kaba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki kyrpad ka long kaba dei ; ai bynta lem na ka jingdon jingem jong ki kur ki jait u kpa jong ki . Ai ba ka jingïohkynti jong u kan hiarpateng ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad ki kren beit: me dei ban ai ia ki ia ka pateng hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki ; bad me dei ban pynlong ia ka pateng jong u kpa jong ki ban iaid sha ki .

en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads  ; and let my name be named on them , and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac  ; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth .
kha: To u angel uba la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsniew baroh , un kyrkhu ïa ki ! To ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ka jong ki kpa jong nga , u Abraham bad u Isaak , Kan ïai im lyngba kine ki khun ! To kin don bun ki khun ki kti bad ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun !
translated_en_to_kha: U Angel uba la siewspah ia nga na ka jingsniew baroh, ki khynnah ; bad ai ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan long ha ki , bad ka kyrteng jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga u Abraham bad u Isaak ; bad ai ba kin san ha ka jingbun briew hapdeng ka khyndew .

en: Then I lifted up mine eyes , and saw , and , behold , there stood before the river a ram which had two horns : and the two horns were high  ; but one was higher than the other , and the higher came up last .
kha: bad hangta harud jong ka wah nga la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la don ar tylli ki reng bajrong , kawei na ki kaba kham jrong bad kham thymmai bad ïa kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la iohi, bad, ha khmih, u la ieng ha khmat ka wah uwei u langbrot uba don ar tylli ki bniat: bad ki ar tylli ki bniat ki long kiba jrong ; hynrei uwei u kham jrong ban ia uwei pat, bad uba kham jrong u la wan shaneng khatduh .

en: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years  ; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria  ; and I will defend this city for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
kha: Ngan ai ba men im tam sa khatsan snem . Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ïa kane ka nongbah Jerusalem na u patsha ka Assyria . Ngan ïada ïa kane ka nongbah , na ka bynta ka burom ka jong nga bad namar ka kular kaba nga la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pyndap ia ki sngi jong me shiphew snem; bad ngan pyllait noh ia me bad ia kane ka shnong na ka kti u syiem Assyria bad ngan iada ia kane ka shnong na ka bynta jong nga hi, bad na ka bynta u shakri jong nga u Dabid .

en: Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kpa u la kwah ?   Uta uba kham san ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha shuwa jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato na ki arngut ki la leh ia ka mon jong u kpa jong u ? Ki ong ha u , Kaba nyngkong . U Jisu u ong ha ki , Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ba ki nongkhaii bad ki nongkhaii ki leit sha ka hima U Blei ha khmat jong phi .

en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he brake , even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die .
kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  une u syiem un ïap ha Babilonia namar u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Babilonia , uba la buh ïa u halor ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba nga dang im, ong U Trai Blei, shisha ha ka jaka ba u syiem u la pynlong syiem ia u, uba u la leh bein ia u, bad uba u la leh bein ia ka jutang jong u, wat bad u hapdeng ka Babilon un iap .

en: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel  ; and it was a cloud and darkness to them , but it gave light by night to these : so that the one came not near the other all the night .
kha: U lyoh u wanrah jingdum ïa ki nong Ijipt , hynrei u ai jingshai ïa ki Israel , bad kumta baroh shi miet ki paidïapom kim shym ïawan jan para ma ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan hapdeng ka kynhun jong ki nong Ijipt bad ka kynhun jong ki Israel ; bad ka la long ka lyoh bad ka jingdum ha ki , hynrei ka la ai jingshai miet ia kine: kumta uta u bym wan hajan uwei pat baroh shi miet .

en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .
kha: bad ngan ai ïa me ha ki briew ïa kiba me sheptieng , ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa me . Ngan ai ïa me ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ha ki shipai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan aiti ia me ha ka kti jong kita kiba wad ia ka jingim jong me, bad ha ka kti jong kita kiba me tieng, wat ha ka kti jong u Neuchrashar syiem Babilon bad ha ka kti jong ki Khaldian .

en: And the children of Israel were numbered , and were all present , and went against them : and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids  ; but the Syrians filled the country .
kha: La khot ïa ki Israel bad la pynkieng atiar ïa ki ; ki la ïaleit bad sher dara ha ki ar kynhun ban ïaleh ïa ki Syria . La ïohi ïa ki Israel ba ki long kum ar tylli ki kynhun blang barit haba ïanujor bad ki nong Syria , kiba la pyndap ïa ki rudnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la shah khein bad ki la don baroh: bad ki khun Israel ki la iaid ha khmat jong ki kum ar tylli ki kynhun khynnah rit ; hynrei ki Syria ki la pyndap ia ka ri .

en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not . Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned : for they laid the pleasant land desolate .
kha: Kum ka  erïong nga la sar noh ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri nongwei . Ïa kane ka ri babha la iehnoh kynjah ïa ka , khlem don mano mano bashong ba sah hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la pynphriang ia ki da ka lyer kaba rkhie bein hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba kim tip . Kumta ka ri ka la jah noh hadien jong ki , ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba iaid lyngba ne wan phai: namar ki la buh ia ka ri kaba sngewbha .

en: And it came to pass , when the king heard the words of the woman , that he rent his clothes  ; and he passed by upon the wall , and the people looked , and , behold , he had sackcloth within upon his flesh .
kha: Haba ïohsngew ïa kane , u syiem u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingkhuslai , bad ki briew kiba sah hajan ka kynroh ki lah ban ïohi ba u phong da ka jaiñ khain hapoh ki jaiñ jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba u syiem u la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong kata ka kynthei, ba u la pynkhih ia ki jain jong u bad u la iaid lyngba ia ka jingkhang, bad ki briew ki la peit, bad ha khmih u la don ka jainkup kaba don hapoh ka doh jong u .

en: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub , whereupon he was , to the threshold of the house . And he called to the man clothed with linen , which had the writer s inkhorn by his side  ;
kha: Te ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon jong U Blei ki Israel ka la kiew na kita ki kherub , ha kiba ka la shong , bad ki ïaid sha ka jaka rung jong ka Templ . U  Trai  u la khot ïa uta u briew uba kup da ki jaiñ linen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka burom U Blei jong ki Israel ka la kiew na u cherub, ha kaba u la don, ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing . Bad u la khot ia uta u briew uba la phong da ka jain lin, uba don ka inkhorn jong u;

en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh , the children of Israel lifted up their eyes , and , behold , the Egyptians marched after them  ; and they were sore afraid : and the children of Israel cried out unto the  Lord .
kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa u Pharaoh bad u paidïapom jong u ba ki tur sha ki , ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh , bad ki kyang jam sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Pharaoh u la jan, ki khun Israel ki la rah ia ki khmat jong ki, bad, ha khmih ki nong Ijipt ki la iaid hadien jong ki ; bad ki la tieng jur: bad ki khun Israel ki la pyrta sha U Trai .

en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  their God , which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen : but I have gathered them unto their own land , and have left none of them any more there .
kha: Te ki briew jong nga kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki . Kin sa tip ïa kane , namar nga la phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw bad mynta nga lumlang ïa ki bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , khlem da iehnoh wat uwei na ki shadien .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki, uba la pynlong ia ki ban shah rahbor hapdeng ki nongwei: hynrei nga la lum ia ki sha la ka jong ka ri , bad ngam shym la iehnoh ia uwei ruh na ki hangta .

en: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  brought an east wind upon the land all that day , and all that night  ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .
kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh , bad U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka lyer na shaphang mihngi ban beh ha kata ka ri baroh shi sngi bad baroh shi miet . Ynda mynstep kata ka lyer mihngi ka wan kit ïa ki puit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynjrong ia u diengduh jong u halor ka ri Ijipt , bad U Trai u la wanrah ia ka Iyer mihngi ha kata ka ri baroh shisngi , bad baroh kata ka miet ; bad ynda la dei ka por mynstep , ka Iyer mihngi ka la wanrah ia ki khnai .

en: And said unto the king , Let the king live for ever : why should not my countenance be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers  sepulchres , lieth waste , and the gates thereof are consumed with fire ?
kha: Nga la kyndit bad nga jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , to im junom ! Kumno ngan lah khlem imat sngewsih haba ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga ka don hapdeng ki jingjot bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ha ka ding ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u syiem: To ai ba u syiem un im junom: balei ba ka khmat jong nga kan ym sngewsih haba ka shnong, ka jaka jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga ka la jah rngai noh bad ki khyrdop jong ka ki la shah thang da ka ding ?

en: And there went up some of the children of Israel , and of the priests , and the Levites , and the singers , and the porters , and the Nethinims , unto Jerusalem , in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king .
kha: U Esra u long u riewstad uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel u la ai ha u Moses . Namar ba u Esra u don ïa ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u patsha u ai kat ïa kaba u pan . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u Esra u la mih na Babilonia ban leit sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad shi kynhun ki Israel kiba kynthup ïa ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem ka Templ , ki nongap phira ka Templ bad ki nongtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don katto katne na ki khun Israel bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi bad ki nongrwai bad ki nongap khyrdop bad ki Nethinim sha Jerusalem ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong u Artaxerxes u syiem .

en: Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .
kha: Hynrei haba nga ong ,  Ngan klet noh ïa U  Trai bad ngan ym kren shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u ,  te ka khubor jong me ka long kum ka ding kaba klang jylliew hapoh jong nga . Nga la pyrshang kat kaba nga lah ban kun ïa ka , hynrei ngam lah ban bat ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong , Ngan ym kdew shuh ia u, lymne ngan kren shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u . Hynrei ka ktien jong u ka la long ha ka dohnud jong nga kum ka ding kaba thang ha ki shyieng jong nga , bad nga la thait da kaba sngap jar , bad ngam lah ban sah .

en: Teams of construction servants and volunteers move from one congregation to the next within a country , even in remote areas , assisting the local congregations with the construction of their Kingdom Halls .
kha: Ki kynhun jong ki nongtei mon sngewbha ki leit na kawei ka balang sha kawei pat ha kajuh ka ri , wat sha ki jaka ba kyndong , ban ïarap tei ïa ki Ïing Hima jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kynhun jong ki shakri shna ïing bad ki nongtrei mon sngewbha ki leit na kawei ka balang sha kawei pat hapoh ka ri , wat ha ki jaka ba jngai , ki iarap ia ki jingiaseng ha ka thain bad ka jingtei ia ki Hima jong ki .

en: They that sanctify themselves , and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst , eating swine s flesh , and the abomination , and the mouse , shall be consumed together , saith the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaba kut ka la jan ïa kito kiba pynkhuid ïa lade na ka jingmane ba-thala , kiba ïaid paidbah ha ka kynhun sha ki kper bakyntang , bad kito kiba bam ïa ka doh sniang , bad ïa ka doh khnai bad kiwei pat ki jingbam ba-ijli .
translated_en_to_kha: Kito kiba pynkhuid ia lade, bad kiba pynkhuid ia lade ha ki kper hadien uwei u dieng hapdeng , ki bam ia ka doh sniang , bad ka jingpynjakhlia bad u khniang , kin shah bam lang , ong U Trai .

en: And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?
kha: U Saul um sngewtynnat ïa kane , bad u bitar lep . U ong ,  Ïa u Dabid ki ai nam da ki phew hajar , hynrei ïa nga pat tang da ki hajar . Kin sa pynlong syiem ïa u hadien nangne !
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la bitar shibun, bad kata ka jingong ka la pynsngewsih ia u ; bad u la ong, Ki la ai ha u Dabid shi hajar, bad ha nga ki la ai tang da ki hajar: bad kaei kaba u lah ban don shuh shuh hynrei tang ka hima ?

en: Behold , I will bring a fear upon thee , saith the Lord  God  of hosts , from all those that be about thee  ; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth  ; and none shall gather up him that wandereth .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingma ha phi na ki liang baroh . Baroh phin phet krad . Uwei pa uwei un phet ïap namar la ka jingim , bad yn ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam lang sa shisien ïa ki shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan wanrah ia ka jingtieng halor jong me , u Trai Blei jong ki paid , na kito baroh kiba don sawdong jong me bad phin sa shah beh noh ia u briew baroh uwei u briew uba iaid beit .

en: And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .
kha: U Esra u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei uba khraw !  Baroh u paidbah u rah la ki kti shajrong bad ong ,  Amen ! Amen !  Ki dem khohsiew ha ka jingshakri , ki phai ki khmat jong ki sha khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Esra u la kyrkhu ia U Trai, U Blei uba khraw . Bad ki briew baroh ki la jubab, Amen, Amen, da kaba rah ia ki kti jong ki: bad ki la dem khrup ia la ki khlieh bad ki la mane ia U Trai da ki khmat jong ki shapoh khyndew .

en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ïoh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki kjat lum shaphang sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Israel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bad Samaria ; ki briew jong ka Benjamin kin shim ïa ka Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jong ka ri Sepngi kin don ia ka lum jong u Iso bad ki jong ka ri Philistia: bad kin don ia ki lyngkha Ephraim bad ki lyngkha Samaria: bad u Benjamin un don ia ka Gilead .

en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .
kha: U phah ïa ka lyer ha shuwa jong u kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lut ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki hima sha ka jingjot bad u pynkut ïa ki jingthmu basniew jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingsawa jong u, kum ka wah kaba tuid palat, kan poi sha pdeng ka ryndang, ban pynkhih ia ki jaitbynriew da ka jinglong ba sniew: bad kan don ka jingkhih ha ki bniat jong ki briew , kaba pynlong ia ki ban bakla .

en: And when they come from the market , except they wash , they eat not . And many other things there be , which they have received to hold , as the washing of cups , and pots , brasen vessels , and of tables .
kha: lymne kim ju bam ïa kaei kaei kaba wanrah na ïew lymda ki sait shuwa ïa ka . Bad ki bud ïa kiba bun kiwei ki aiñ kiba ki la ïohpdiang , kum kaba sait ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa ki khuri , ki khiew , ki pliang rnong , bad ki jingthiah . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki wan na iew , lait noh tang ba ki sait , kim ju bam . Bad bun kiwei pat kiei kiei ki don, kiba ki la ioh ban bat, kum ka jingsait ia ki khuri bad ki khiew, ki khiew kiba la tyrkhong bad ki miej .

en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another  ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be .
kha: Kita ki kherub kin ïaphai markhmat , na shiliang sha shiliang ka jingtap bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa kata ka jingtap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki cherub kin pynjrong ia ki bniat jong ki shaneng, ki tap ia ka jaka shong jingisynei da ki bniat jong ki, bad ki khmat jong ki kin peit iwei ia iwei pat; sha ka jaka shong jingisynei ki khmat jong ki cherub kin long .

en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :
kha: Ka ktien jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap kiba wan hap na suiñbneng ban ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pynlong ïa ki jingthung ban san bad pynmih ïa u symbai ban ïoh bet bad ka jingbam ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar katba u slap u wan hiar, bad u slap na bneng, bad um ju wan phai sha kata ka jaka, bad u pynlong ia ka ban pynmih bad pynmih ia ka, ba kan ai symbai ia u nongthung bad u kpu ia u nongbam:

en: And there went out another horse that was red : and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth , and that they should kill one another : and there was given unto him a great sword .
kha: Sa uwei pat u kulai u la wan mih , uba saw ka rong . Ha u nongshong kulai la ai ïa ka bor ban wanrah ïa ka thma ha ka pyrthei , ba ki briew kin ïa-pynïap para ma ki hi . La ai ha u ïa ka waitlam kaba heh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la mih uwei pat u kulai uba saw: bad la ai bor ia u uba shong ha kata ka jaka ban shim ia ka jingsuk na ka khyndew , bad ba kin pyniap iwei ia iwei pat: bad la ai ha u ia ka waitlam kaba khraw .

en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito ki por kiba ka la klet ïa nga mynba ka thang ki jingiwbih ïa u Baal bad ka la pynphuh pynphieng ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan leit jngoh ia ka ha ki sngi jong u Balim, ha kaba ka la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ki, bad ka la pynitynnad ia lade da ki shkor bad ki jingdeng jong ka, bad ka la leit bud ia ki nongieit jong ka, bad ka la klet noh ia nga, ong U Trai .

en: And I will punish Bel in Babylon , and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up : and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him : yea , the wall of Babylon shall fall .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u Bel , u blei ki nong Babilonia , bad ngan pynlong ïa u ban aiti noh ïa ki tiar jong u kiba shu tuh ; ki jaitbynriew kin ym mane shuh ïa u .  Ki kynroh ka Babilon ki la khyllem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynshitom ia u Bel ha Babilon, bad ngan pynmih na ka shyntur jong u ia kaba u la dih: bad ki jaitbynriew kin ym tuid shuh sha u: hooid, ka kynroh jong ka Babilon kan hap .

en: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll : and he took it out of Elishama the scribe s chamber . And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king , and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king .
kha: Te u syiem u la phah ïa u Jehudi ban leit shim ïa ka kot kli . U la leit shim na ka kamra u Elishama bad u la pule ïa ka ha u syiem bad ha baroh ki rangbah synshar kiba ïeng sawdong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem u la phah ia u Jehudi ban shim ia ka roll: bad u la shim ia ka na u Elishama u nongthoh . Bad u Jehii u la pule ia ka ha ki shkor jong u syiem bad ha ki shkor jong ki syiem baroh kiba ieng hajan u syiem .

en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , ) then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .
kha: Nangta ki pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Israel , da kaba buh ïa ki ha ka khim khait . Katto katne na ki Israel ki rieh ha ki krem bad ha ki thliew , lane hapdeng ki mawsiang lane ha ki thliew bad ki pukri um ;
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew Israel ki la iohi ba ki don ha ka jingeh , (na ka bynta ki briew ki la shah pynshitom), nangta ki briew ki la buhrieh ia lade ha ki krem bad ha ki lum bad ha ki maw bad ha ki jaka ba jrong bad ha ki thliew .

en: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren , in the service of the house of the  Lord .
kha: La ai ha ki ka jingkitkhlieh ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ka Templ , bad ban ïarap ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , ha ka jingmane ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba kin sumar ia ka kam jong ka iingmane bad ka kam jong ka jaka bakhuid bad ka kam jong ki khun shynrang jong ki Aaron ha ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Trai .

en: The king said moreover to Shimei , Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to , that thou didst to David my father : therefore the  Lord  shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head  ;
kha: Me tip biang biang ïa ka jingleh bakla baroh kaba me la leh ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa me namar kata .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ong shuh shuh ha u Shimei , Me tip ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba ka dohnud jong me ka tip , ba me la leh ia u Dabid u kpa jong nga: namarkata U Trai un pynphai noh ia ka jingsniew jong me ha la ka jong ka khlieh;

en: So Ebed–melech took the men with him , and went into the house of the king under the treasury , and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags , and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .
kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit bad ki rangbah sha ka kamra buh jingbam ha ka ïingsyiem bad la ïoh katto katne ki jaiñphong ba la rim kiba u la pynhiar sha nga da ki tyllai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Ebedmedmech u la shim ia ki briew bad u, bad u la leit shapoh ka iing u syiem hapoh ka jaka buh jingbam, bad u la shim ia ki jain kiba la rim bad ki jain kiba la tyrkhong kiba la tyrkhong kiba la tyrkhong bad u la pynhap ia ki da ki nar kiba la tyrkhong ha Jeremaiah .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of Jehoiakim king of Judah  ; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .
