kha: Te mynta , ma nga U  Trai  , nga ong ha me , ko syiem Jehoïakim , ba yn ym don u ban hiarpateng na me u ban synshar shuh halor ka hima u Dabid . Ïa ka metïap jong me yn bret shabar ha ka jingshit kyr-ang ka sngi ha ka por mynsngi bad ha u thah mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong u Jehoiakim u syiem Judah ; Un ym don shuh ban shong ha ka khet u Dabid: bad ka met iap jong u kan sa bret noh ha ka sngi sha ka jingshit bad ha ka miet sha ka jingkhriat .

en: And the great city was divided into three parts , and the cities of the nations fell : and great Babylon came in remembrance before God , to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath .
kha: Ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw la kad ha ki lai bynta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki ri baroh la pynjot . U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Babilon bakhraw bad u la pynlong ïa ka ban dih ïa ka waiñ na ka khuri jong u — ka waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka nongbah kaba khraw ka la phiah ha ki lai bynta, bad ki nongbah jong ki jaitbynriew ki la hap: bad ka Babilon kaba khraw ka la wan ha ka jingkynmaw ha khmat U Blei , ban ai ha ka ia ka khuri jong ka wain jong ka jingbitar jong u .

en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .
kha: Ynda U  Trai  u wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , phin pynbna ïa ka jingkyrkhu nalor u lum Gerisim bad ïa kata ka jingtim nalor u lum Ebal .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia, haba U Trai U Blei jong me u la wanrah ia me sha ka ri kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka, ba me buh ia ka jingkyrkhu halor u lum Gerizim bad ka jingtim halor u lum Ebal .

en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .
kha: Phin shim ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki blei jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta ,  Wat don shuh ha khmat jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Phin pynjakhlia ruh ia ka jingtap jong ki dur rupa jong me, bad ka jingpynitynnad ia ki dur ksiar jong me: me dei ban bret noh ia ki kum ka jain kaba jyrngam; me dei ban ong ha ka: To leit noh nangta .

en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years , which were in the land of Egypt , and laid up the food in the cities : the food of the field , which was round about every city , laid he up in the same .
kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah , u la kynshew ïa ka jingbam na ki lyngkha kiba don sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la lum ia ki jingbam baroh hynriew snem kiba don ha ka ri Ijipt bad u la buh ia ki jingbam ha ki nongbah: ka jingbam jong ka lyngkha kaba la ker sawdong ia kawei pa kawei ka shnong .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Lo , I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee , and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the  Lord .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan wan ha me ha u lyoh uba rben , khnang ba u paidbah un ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ïakren bad me , bad un sa ngeit ïa me naduh mynta .  U Moses u la ïathuh ha U  Trai  ïa ka jubab jong uta u paidbah ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Hooid nga wan sha me ha u lyoh uba jylliew, ba ki briew kin iohsngew haba nga kren bad me bad ngeit ia me junom . U Moses u la iathuh ia ki ktien jong ki briew ha U Trai .

en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
kha: Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syiem ,  Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura halor ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .
translated_en_to_kha: U briew jong U Blei u la bitar ia u, bad u la ong, Me la dei ban pynkhih san ne hynriew sien ; nangta me la pynkhih ia ka Syria haduh ba me la bam ia ka: katba mynta me la pynkhih ia ka Syria hynrei lai sien .

en: Saul also sent messengers unto David s house , to watch him , and to slay him in the morning : and Michal David s wife told him , saying , If thou save not thy life to night , to morrow thou shalt be slain .
kha: Ha kata hi ka miet u Saul u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban khmih siar ïa ka ïing u Dabid bad ban pynïap ïa u ha ka step kaba bud . Ka Mikhal , ka tnga u Dabid , ka maham ïa u ,  Lada phim phet mynta ka miet , lashai ka sngi phin long uba la ïap noh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul ruh u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor sha iing u Dabid, ban peit ia u bad ban pyniap ia u ha ka por mynstep: bad ka tnga jong u Dabid ka la iathuh ha u, ka da ong: Lada phim pynim ia ka jingim jong me haduh ka miet, lashai ka sngi phin sa shah pyniap .

en: And Elkanah her husband said unto her , Do what seemeth thee good  ; tarry until thou have weaned him  ; only the  Lord  establish his word . So the woman abode , and gave her son suck until she weaned him .
kha: U Elkanah u la ong ha ka ,  Leh katba phi sngewbit ; sah ha ïing haduh ba phin da pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u . Bad to U  Trai  un pynurlong ïa ka jingkular jong phi .  Kumta ka Hannah ka shong ha ïing bad ka sumar ïa la u khun bad ïai bsa ïai pjiah ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elkanah u tnga jong ka u la ong ha ka, To leh ia kaba phi sngewbha shuh shuh haduh ba phin da ai snam ia u shuh shuh . Kumta kata ka kynthei ka la sah bad ka la ai ia u khun jong ka haduh ba ka la ai snam ia u .

en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
kha: Katto katne ki Philistia ki wallam sha u Jehoshaphat shibun bah ka rupa bad kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , bad katto katne ki Arab ki wallam hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki langbrot bad hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki blang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh katto katne na ki Philistia ki la wanrah ia ki jingai sngewbha; bad ki nong Arab ki la wanrah ia u ia ki langbrot, hynriew hajar hynriew spah tylli ki langbrot bad hynriew hajar hynriew spah tylli ki blang .

en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling  ; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain , in the coupling of the second .
kha: Thaw ïa ki kyrwoh da ka jaiñ kaba jngum ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba harud duh na kita ki jingkah baroh ar tylli .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban shna ia ki loops kiba rong saw ha ka tduh jong kawei ka jingtap ha ka tduh kaba rit tam jong kawei pat ka jingtap .

en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
kha: Hynrei u syiem u pynlong ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ; ki la mihnoh na khmat jong u bad ki la leit ban ñiew ïa ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka ktien jong u syiem ka la jop pyrshah ia u Joab bad pyrshah ia ki rangbah shipai . U Joab bad ki rangbah shipai ki la mih noh na khmat u syiem ban khein ia ki briew Israel .

en: And it grew , and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and the roots thereof were under him : so it became a vine , and brought forth branches , and shot forth sprigs .
kha: U jingthung u la speh bad u la long u dieng sohwaiñ uba lyngkot bad uba pyiar kylleng . Ki tnat ki san shajrong sha u pukni , bad ki thied ki suh jylliew . La tap ïa u dieng sohwaiñ da ki tnat bad ki sla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la san, bad ka la kylla long ka sohjew kaba la saphriang sha u, bad ki tynrai jong ka ki la don hapoh jong u: kumta ka la kylla long u sohjew, bad ka la pynmih ia ki tnat kiba la pynmih shabar .

en: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers , and to their posts within the gate round about , and likewise to the arches : and windows were round about inward : and upon each post were palm trees .
kha: La don ki jingpong thliew kiba rit ha ki kynroh kiba shabar jong ki kamra baroh , bad ruh ha ki kynroh kiba hapoh hapdeng ki kamra . La ohdur ïa ki dieng Tlai halor ki païa kiba hapoh kiba phai pyrshah ïa ka lynti ïaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki don ki jingkhang kiba rit sha ki kamra rit, bad ha ki post jong ki hapoh ka khyrdop sawdong: bad ki jingkhang ki la iaid sawdong shapoh: bad halor kawei pa kawei ka post ki don ki dieng sohjew .

en: Then said Saul , I have sinned : return , my son David : for I will no more do thee harm , because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day : behold , I have played the fool , and have erred exceedingly .
kha: U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la leh bakla ; wan phai pat ko Dabid , u khun jong nga . Namar ba phi la kheiñ kor ïa ka jingim jong nga ha kane ka miet , lano lano ngan ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa phi . Nga la leh bieit shisha , bad nga la bakla palat .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Saul: To wan phai, ko khun jong nga Dabid: namar ngan ym leh ei ei shuh ia me: namar ka mynsiem jong nga ka la long kaba kordor ha ki khmat jong me ha kane ka sngi: ha khmih nga la leh bieit bad nga la bakla palat .

en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them  ; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them : and I will place them , and multiply them , and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore .
kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki ka ban pynneh ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki junom . Ngan tei skhem ïa ki bad ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka Templ jong nga ha ka ri jong ki , ha kaba kan neh junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ngan leh ia ka jutang jingsuk bad ki ; kan long ka jutang bymjukut bad ki: bad ngan buh ia ki , bad ngan pynbun ia ki , bad ngan buh ia ka jaka kyntang jong nga hapdeng jong ki junom .

en: And Araunah said , Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant ? And David said , To buy the threshingfloor of thee , to build an altar unto the  Lord  , that the plague may be stayed from the people .
kha: bad u kylli ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi wan shane ?  U Dabid u jubab ,  Ban thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong phi bad ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aragah u la ong: Balei u kynrad jong nga u wan sha u shakri jong u ? Bad u Dabid u la ong: Ban thied ia ka jaka bam jong me, ban tei ia ka jaka bam ha U Trai, ba ka khlam kan sah na ki briew .

en: A wild ass used to the wilderness , that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure  ; in her occasion who can turn her away ? all they that seek her will not weary themselves  ; in her month they shall find her .
kha: ka da mareh stet sha ka ri shyiap . Haba ka don ha ka jingkwah shongkha , mano ba lah ban bat synshar ïa ka ? Ym don uno uno u shynrang uba kwah ïa ka uba dei ban pynjynjar ïa lade ; ka ïai don borabor ha ka aïom shongkha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kada khlaw kaba ju bam ia ka ri khlaw , kaba pynkhih ia ka Iyer ha ka jingsngewbha jong ka ha ka por jong ka kaba lah ban pynphai noh ia ka ? baroh kiba wad ia ka kin ym thait ia lade; ha u bnai jong ka kin shem ia ka .

en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming : it stirreth up the dead for thee , even all the chief ones of the earth  ; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .
kha: Ka pyrthei jong kiba ïap ka pynkhreh ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Ki sna-ïap jong kito kiba donbor ha ka pyrthei ki ïakhih ksar . Ki sna-ïap jong ki syiem ki ïeng na ki khet jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dujok na shapoh ka la khih na ka bynta jong me ban iakynduh ia me ha ka jingwan jong me: ka pynkhih ia kiba iap na ka bynta jong me: wat ia ki rangbah baroh jong ka khyndew; ka la pynmih na ki khet jong ki baroh ki syiem jong ki jaitbynriew .

en: The Lord  God  hath given me the tongue of the learned , that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary : he wakeneth morning by morning , he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la hikai ïa nga kaei ban ong , khnang ba ngan lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kiba tlot bor . Man la ka step u pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba un hikai ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai Blei u la ai ha nga ia ka shyntur jong kiba la nang la stad, ba nga dei ban nang kumno ban kren ia ka ktien ha ka por ha uta uba la thait: u khie mynstep da ka step , u pynkynjah ia ka shkor jong nga ban iohsngew kum uba la nang la stad .

en: Thou shalt eat , but not be satisfied  ; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt take hold , but shalt not deliver  ; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword .
kha: Phin bam , hynrei phin ym sngewhun — ha ka jingshisha phin dang ïai thngan hi . Phin rah bak ïa kiei kiei , hynrei phin ym lah ban ri ïa ki ; ïa kino kino kiba phi lah ban ri , ngan pynjot ïa ki ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban bam, hynrei wat sngewhun ia ka met jong me bad ka jingthep jong me kan long hapdeng jong me ; bad me dei ban bat, hynrei wat pynpoi ; bad ia kaba me pynpoi ngan aiti noh sha ka waitlam .

en: But ye shall receive power , after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you : and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem , and in all Judaea , and in Samaria , and unto the uttermost part of the earth .
kha: Hynrei haba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u wan ha phi , yn pyndap ïa phi da ka bor , bad phin long ki sakhi jong nga ha Jerusalem , ha baroh ka Judia bad Samaria , bad shaduh kiba kut jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei phin sa ioh ia ka bor, hadien ba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan halor jong phi: bad phin sa long ki sakhi ia nga ha Jerusalem bad ha Judaea baroh kawei bad ha Samaria bad haduh kaba kut jong ka khyndew .

en: Take thou also unto thee principal spices , of pure myrrh five hundred shekels , and of sweet cinnamon half so much , even two hundred and fifty shekels , and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels ,
kha: Shim ïa ki jingiwbih musla kiba kynsai tam — hynriew kilo ka mirr ba la pynum , lai kilo ka siasia kaba sma iwbih , lai kilo ka um pai kaba iwbih ,
translated_en_to_kha: To shim ruh ia ki jingbam ba kongsan jong me, da ki san spah tylli ki Shekel kiba khuid, bad ka cinnamon kaba thiang shiteng haduh katne, wat arspah sanphew Shekel bad ka calamus kaba thiang arspah sanphew Shekel .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan phah ïa ki saw tylli ki jingpynshitom basniew tam jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka thma , ka  nemsniew , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Katno ka long haba nga phah ia ki saw tylli ki jingbishar ba shyrkhei jong nga ha Jerusalem, ka waitlam bad ka jingkyrduh bad u mrad ba la tyrkhong bad ka jingpang khlam, ban ot noh na ka ia u briew bad u mrad ?

en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :
kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane kham heh uba la wan na Ijipt un ym ïohrung sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ym don uwei ruh na ki briew kiba la mih na Ijipt, naduh arphew snem shaneng, u ban iohi ia ka ri kaba nga la smai ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob; namar kim shym la bud pura ia nga:

en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,
kha: U Shephataïah u khun jong u Mattan , u Gedalaïah u khun jong u Pashhur , u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah , bad u Pashhur u khun jong u Malkhaïah ki la ïohsngew ba nga la ong ïa ki paidbah ba
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Shephiah u khun u Mathan bad u Gdalaiah u khun u Sheemaiah bad u khun u Sheemaiah bad u Pashur u khun u Malhiiah ki la iohsngew ia ki ktien kiba u Jeremaiah u la kren ha ki briew baroh .

en: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it , and shame shall cover her which said unto me , Where is the  Lord  thy God ? mine eyes shall behold her : now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets .
kha: Te ki nongshun jong ngi kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin shah pynjahburom — kijuh ki nongshun kiba la pynthut ïa ngi da kaba kylli ,  Hangno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ?  Ngin ïohi ba ki la shahjop , shah ïuh kum ka ktieh ha ki lynti bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka nongshun jong nga kan iohi ia ka, bad ka jingsngewlehrain kan tap ia ka kaba la ong ha nga, Hangno U Trai U Blei jong me ? ki khmat jong nga kin iohi ia ka: mynta kan sa shah pynkhih kum ka dewbilat jong ki surok .

en: And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth : I being in the way , the  Lord  led me to the house of my master s brethren .
kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la batskhem ïa la ka kular ha u kynrad jong nga . U  Trai  hi u la ïalam beit ïa nga sha ki kur ki jait u kynrad jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: La kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga Abraham, uba khlem iehnoh ia u kynrad jong nga ia ka jingisynei bad ka jingshisha jong u: Nga la don ha lynti , U Trai u la ialam ia nga sha ka iing jong ki hynmen jong nga .

en: But if thou say to me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is it not he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and said to Judah and to Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar ?
kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ong shuh shuh ,  Lane hato phin ïathuh ha nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ki long ki jaka mane blei bad ki duwan jong U  Trai  ba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha kawei ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada me ong ha nga , Ngi shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi: hato ym dei ma u uba ki jaka ba jrong bad ki jaka mane jong u u Hesekaiah u la weng noh ia ki jaka mane bad u la ong ha Judah bad ha Jerusalem , Phi dei ban mane ha khmat kane ka jaka mane ?

en: For the  Lord  thy God blesseth thee , as he promised thee : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , but thou shalt not borrow  ; and thou shalt reign over many nations , but they shall not reign over thee .
kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi kumba u la kular . Phin sa ai kylliang ha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , hynrei phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano ; phin long kynrad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , hynrei yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ka ban long kynrad halor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u kyrkhu ia me kumba u la kular ia me: bad me dei ban ai ram ia ki jaitbynriew kiba bun , hynrei me dei ban shim ram; bad me dei ban synshar halor ki jaitbynriew kiba bun , hynrei kin ym synshar halor jong me .

en: And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .
kha: Nangta nga ai ruh ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka ri kaba sha mihngi na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pat , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la hukum ia phi ha kata ka por, da kaba ong, U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ia phi ia kane ka ri ban ioh ia ka: phin iaid lait noh ha khmat ki hynmen jong phi ki khun Israel baroh kiba iakynduh ia ka thma .

en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Did ye never read in the scriptures , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner : this is the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Hato phim pat ju pule ïa kaei ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ?   ‘ Ïa u maw ba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh . Ïa kane la leh da U Trai ; katno ka long kaba itynnat !’
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ha ki , Hato phim ju pule ha ki jingthoh , U maw uba ki nongtei u la kyntait , u long kumjuh u khlieh jong ka kut: kane ka long kaba phylla ha ki khmat jong ngi ?

en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , yea , and made his son to pass through the fire , according to the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel .
kha: U kñia wat ïa u khun la jong kum ka jingainguh thang ïa ki bleithaw , da kaba pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh kiba ijli jong ki briew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh na ka ri katba ki khun Israel ki dang tur shaphrang .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la iaid ha ka lynti jong ki syiem Israel , hooid , bad u la pynlong ia u khun jong u ban iaid lyngba ka ding , kat kum ki jinglehrain jong ki nongwei kiba U Trai u la beh noh na khmat ki khun Israel .

en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :
kha: Kumta ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga ong ha u , ‘ nga la shim ïa me na kaba sumar ïa ki langbrot ha ki jaka phlang bad pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta te to ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid, nga la shim ia me na ka kynhun langbrot, wat na kaba bud ia ki langbrot, ba me dei ban long u nongsynshar halor ki briew jong nga ki Israel:

en: Then she said , Let me find favour in thy sight , my lord  ; for that thou hast comforted me , and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid , though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens .
kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Kynrad , phi la lehsbun shibun ïa nga . Phi la pynlong ïa nga ban kham sngewbiang da kaba kren jem jai jai ïa nga , wat la ngam ïaryngkat kyrdan bad kawei na ki shakri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la ong , To ngan shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong me, ko kynrad jong nga, namar ba me la pyntngen ia nga, bad namar kata me la kren paralok bad ka kti jong me, wat la ngam long kum uwei na ki kti jong me .

en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .
kha: Bun snem hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria ban leit khmih ïa u Ahab . Ban lehburom ïa u Jehoshaphat bad kito kiba bad u , u Ahab u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot bad ki masi ban pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien katto katne snem u la leit hiar sha u Ahab sha Samaria . U Ahab u la pyniap ia ki langbrot bad ki masi na ka bynta jong u ha ka jingbun paid bad na ka bynta ki briew kiba u don ryngkat bad u, bad u la pynbor ia u ban leit sha u sha Ramothgilead .

en: And it came to pass , as soon as he came nigh unto the camp , that he saw the calf , and the dancing : and Moses  anger waxed hot , and he cast the tables out of his hands , and brake them beneath the mount .
kha: Haba u Moses u la poi hajan kata ka jaka sher dara na kaba u ïohi ïa uta u khun masi bad ïa ka jingïashad jong kita ki paidbah , u Moses u bitar lep . Hangta ha trai u lum , u lynthaw ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap kiba u rah haduh ba ki da pait .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, tang shu wan hajan ka shnong, ba u la iohi ia u khun masi bad ka jingshad: bad u Moses u la bitar , bad u la bret ia ki miej na ki kti jong u , bad u la bret ia ki hapoh ka lum .

en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab , But howsoever , let me , I pray thee , also run after Cushi . And Joab said , Wherefore wilt thou run , my son , seeing that thou hast no tidings ready ?
kha: U Ahimaas u ïai ban ,  Ngam salia ïa kaei kaba jia ; sngewbha shah ïa nga ruh ban rah ïa ka khubor .   Balei phi da kwah ban leh ïa kata , ko khun jong nga ?  u Joab u kylli .  Phin ym ïoh bainong ei ei na ka bynta kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ahimaas u khun u Sadok u la ong biang ha u Joab , Hynrei kumno kumno ruh, to ngan mareh ruh hadien u Cushi . Bad u Joab u la ong: Balei me mareh ko khun jong nga haba me iohi ba ngam don khubor ba la pynkhreh ?

en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .
kha: Me la jied ïa ki napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ban long u paidlang jong me , kumba me la ïathuh ha ki lyngba u Moses u shakri jong me mynba me wan ïalam noh na Ijipt ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta jong ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew, ban long ka pateng jong me, kumba me la kren da ka kti u Moses u shakri jong me, haba me la wanrah ia ki kpa tymmen jong ngi na Ijipt , ko Trai Blei .

en: That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
kha: Da shisha men ym pynïap ïa kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . Mem lah ban leh kumta . Lada me leh kumta , kiba hok kin shah pynshitom ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . U nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh u dei ban lehhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Kata ka long kaba jngai na me ban leh kumne, ban pyniap ia kiba hok bad kiba sniew: bad ba kiba hok kin long kum kiba sniew , kiba jngai na me: Hato u Nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh kan ym leh hok ?

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy redeemer , and he that formed thee from the womb , I am the  Lord  that maketh all things  ; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone  ; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself  ;
kha: Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongpynim jong phi ; nga long uta uba la thaw ïa phi . Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongthaw ïa baroh kiei kiei . Nga marwei hi nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; haba nga thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ym don u ban ïarap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai, u nongsiewspah jong me, bad uta uba la thaw ia me na ka kpoh, nga long U Trai uba pynlong ia kiei kiei baroh kiba pynjrong ia ki bneng marwei;

en: Who raised up the righteous man from the east , called him to his foot , gave the nations before him , and made him rule over kings ? he gave them as the dust to his sword , and as driven stubble to his bow .
kha: Uei uta uba wanrah ïa u nongjop na sha mihngi , bad pynlong ïa u ban leh risa kat shaba u leit ? Mano ba ai jingjop ïa u halor ki syiem bad ki jaitbynriew ? Ka waitlam jong u ka mait ïa ki la kumba ki long ka pui pui , ki khnam jong u ki pynsaphred ïa ki kum u phlangïap ha khmat ka lyer .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la pynmih ia u briew uba hok na mihngi, u la khot ia u ha ka kjat jong u, u la ai ia ki jaitbynriew ha khmat jong u bad u la pynlong ia u ban synshar ia ki syiem ? u la ai ia ki kum ka dewbilat ha ka waitlam jong u, bad kum ka jingsma kaba la pynkhih ha ka bow jong u .

en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .
kha: Nangta ngin khreh ban leit bad la kiwei pat ki Israel sha ka thma bad ngin ïalam ban tur ïaleh haduh ba ngin da pynïoh pynsah ïa ki ha ka ri ka ban long ka jong ki . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba hap hapoh ka jingsumar sukher jong ngi ki lah ban sah hangne ha ki shnong kiba la ker da ki kut baskhem , khlem jingma na ki briew jong kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi hi ngin iaid lyngba ha khmat ki khun Israel , haduh ba ngin da wanrah ia ki ha ka jaka jong ki: bad ki khun rit jong ngi kin shong ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong namar ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri .

en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same  ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil  ;
kha: Namar ba kita ki khun , kumba u khot ïa ki , ki long ki briew na ka doh bad ka snam , U Jisu u la long u briew kum ma ki hi bad ïoh bynta lang na ka jinglongbriew jong ki . U la leh ïa kane , khnang ba da ka jingïap jong u , u lah ban pynduh ïa u Bymman , uba don ka bor halor ka jingïap ,
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kata kumba ki khun ki long ki nongiashim bynta ha ka doh bad ka snam, ma u ruh kumjuh u la shim bynta ha kajuh ka ; ba lyngba ka jingiap u lah ban pynjot ia uta uba don ka bor iap , kata ka long u ksuid ; .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Enter not into the house of mourning , neither go to lament nor bemoan them : for I have taken away my peace from this people , saith the  Lord  , even lovingkindness and mercies .
kha: Mem dei ban rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba don ka jingïambriew . Wat ym ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jongno jongno . Ngan ym kyrkhu shuh ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jingsuk lane pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Wat rung ha ka iing kaba sngewsih , wat leit ud ne sngewsih ia ki: namar nga la weng noh ia ka jingsuk jong nga na une u briew , ong U Trai , wat ia ka jingieit bad ki jingsngewrit .

en: O vine of Sibmah , I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer : thy plants are gone over the sea , they reach even to the sea of Jazer : the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage .
kha: Ngan ïam na ka bynta ki briew ka Sibmah , wat kham palat ban ïa ki briew ka Jaser . Ko ka nongbah Sibmah , pha long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba ki tnat jong u ki poi shaduh sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap bad jngai shaduh Jaser . Hynrei mynta ïa ki soh lyiur jong pha bad ïa ki sohwaiñ jong pha la pynjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko sohjew jong ka Sibma , ngan iam na ka bynta jong me da ka jingud jong u Jazer: ki jingthung jong me ki la leit noh sha ka duriaw , ki poi wat sha ka duriaw Jazer: u nongpynjot u la hap ha ki soh jong me bad ha ka por lyiur jong me .

en: Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .
kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong pha ki long kum ka kynhun ki puit kiba dem ha ka kynroh ha ka sngi kaba khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym don mano mano batip shano ki la jah noh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la pynkup burom ia ki kum ki khnai, bad ki khnai jong me kum ki khnai kiba khraw, kiba shong ha ki kynroh ha ka sngi kaba khriat , hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih ki phet noh , bad ym tip ia ka jaka jong ki shano ki don .

en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .
kha: Kaba mih nangta kan long ba ki kmie ki kpa ha Jerusalem kin bam ïa la ki khun , bad ki khun pat kin bam ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha bad ngan pynsakma kylleng ïa kino kino kiba dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki kpa kin bam ia ki khun shynrang hapdeng jong me, bad ki khun shynrang kin bam ia ki kpa jong ki ; bad ngan pyndep ia ki jingbishar ha me , bad ia ka jingsah jong me baroh kawei ngan sa pynphriang sha ki Iyer baroh .

en: When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shong ha trai u dieng Tamarisk halor u lum , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki don sawdong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Saul u la iohsngew ba la lap ia u Dabid bad ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, (mynta u Saul u la shong ha Gibeah hapoh u dieng ha Ramah , u la don ka khnam jong u ha ka kti jong u , bad ki shakri jong u baroh ki la ieng sawdong jong u ;).

en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
kha: Kane baroh kan jia namar ba ki paid Israel ki la leh pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei . Ïano yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïaleh pyrshah ki Israel ? Ka Samaria hi , ka nongbah ! Mano ba shah kynnoh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkhein ia u Jakob ka long baroh kane , bad na ka bynta ki pop jong ka iing Israel . Kaei ka jingpynkhein ia u Jakob ? ym dei ka Samaria ? bad kiei ki jaka ba jrong jong u Judah ? kim dei ka Jerusalem ?

en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first  ; and Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up unto mount Sinai , as the  Lord  had commanded him , and took in his hand the two tables of stone .
kha: Kumta u Moses u shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba mynshuwa . Dang step phyrngab u leit kiew ïa u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum ar tylli ki maw kumba long ha ka por ba nyngkong bad u Moses u la ieng dang step bad u la leit sha u lum Sinai kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u bad u la shim ha la ka kti ia ki ar tylli ki maw .

en: And it came to pass , when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and , behold , every man s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .
kha: Haba ngi la poi ha ka jaka ban sahmiet , ngi plied ïa la ki byrni , bad uwei pa uwei na ngi u lap ïa la ki pisa ha la ka jong ka jong ka byrni — ki pisa ki biang thik . Ngi la wanrah biang ïa ki sha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba ngi la poi ha ka jaka sah, ba ngi la plie ia ki tyrpeng jong ngi, bad, ha khmih, ka pisa jong uwei pa uwei ka la don ha ka shyntur jong u, ka pisa jong ngi ha ka jingkhia kaba pura: bad ngi la wanrah biang ia ka ha ka kti jong ngi .

en: From thence they removed , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites : for Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .
kha: Nangta pat ki la mihnoh bad sher dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Wah Arnon , ha ka ri khlaw kaba ïar shaduh ki khappud ka ri Amor . ( Ka wah Arnon ka la long ka pud hapdeng ka ri Moab bad ki Amor . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la leit noh sha kawei pat ka liang jong u Arnon, kaba don ha ka ri khlaw kaba mih na ki pud jong ki Amorites: namar u Arnon u dei u pud u sam jong u Moab, hapdeng u Moab bad ki Amorites .

en: This is a faithful saying , and these things I will that thou affirm constantly , that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works . These things are good and profitable unto men .
kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha . Nga kwah ba men ïai ban kyrpang ïa kine kiei kiei , khnang ba kito kiba ngeit ha U Blei kin kitkhia ha kaba ai ïa ka por jong ki ban leh ïa ki kam babha , kiba long ki babha bad kiba myntoi ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba iaineh , bad kine kiei kiei nga kwah ba me pynskhem beit , ba kito kiba la ngeit ha U Blei kin sumar bha ban pynneh ia ki kam kiba bha . Kine kiei kiei ki long kiba bha bad kiba myntoi ia ki briew .

en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth : for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands , saith the  Lord .
kha: Naduh kaba sdang eh jong ka histori jong ki , ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsngewsih ïa nga bad ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaei kaba ki la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun Israel bad ki khun Judah ki la leh tang ia kaba sniew ha khmat jong nga naduh ka jinglong samla jong ki: namar ki khun Israel ki la pynkhih tang ia nga ban bitar da ka jingtrei jong ki kti jong ki , ong U Trai .

en: And it came to pass , when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister s son , that he ran to meet him , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .
kha: Ka leit bran bran ban ïathuh ha la u kpa ; bad haba u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang u pyrsa jong u , u Jakob , mar mar u leit ban ïashem ïa u ; u la kdup bad u doh ïa u , bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: U Laban u la iohsngew ia ka khubor jong u khun jong u u Jakob, ba u la mareh ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la kdup ia u bad u la kdup ia u bad u la wanrah ia u sha la iing . Bad u la iathuh ia u Laban ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made a pool , and a conduit , and brought water into the city , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u , bad ki jingïathuh ba kumno u la tei ïa ka jaka pynlang um bad u tih ïa ka nur ban wallam um sha ka nongbah , la buh jingthoh baroh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kiwei pat ki kam jong u Hesekaiah bad ka bor jong u baroh bad kumno u la thaw ia ka pung bad ka um bad u la wanrah um shapoh ka nongbah , hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot ki sla jong ki syiem Judah ?

en: The burden of Egypt . Behold , the  Lord  rideth upon a swift cloud , and shall come into Egypt : and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence , and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it .
kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Ijipt . U  Trai  u wan sha Ijipt , u da shong ha u lyoh uba ïaid stet . Ki bleithaw jong ki Ijipt ki khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , bad ki briew jong ka Ijipt ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingkit jong ka ri Ijipt . Ha khmih, U Trai u shong halor u lyoh uba stet, bad un wan sha Ijipt : bad ki bleithaw jong ka ri Ijipt kin khih ha khmat jong u , bad ka dohnud jong ka ri Ijipt kan rkhiang hapdeng jong ka .

en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers , ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God  ; and are become such as have need of milk , and not of strong meat .
kha: Ka la dei ka por kaba la biang bha ïa phi ban long ki nonghikai — pynban , phi dang donkam ïa uwei pat ban hikai ïa phi ïa ki jinghikai banyngkong jong ka khubor U Blei . Ha ka jaka ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba eh , phi dang ïai donkam ban dih da ka dud .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba na ka bynta ka por ba phi dei ban long ki nonghikai, phi donkam ia kata ban hikai biang ia phi kaba long ki nongrim ba nyngkong jong ki oracle jong U Blei ; bad ki kylla long kiba donkam ia ka dud , bad ym ia ka doh kaba skhem .

en: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ? And the man of God answered , The  Lord  is able to give thee much more than this .
kha: U Amasaïah u kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa ,  Hynrei kumno pat shaphang ka rupa baroh kaba nga la dep siew ïa ki ?  U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  U  Trai  u lah ban ai pat sha me kham bun ban ïa kata !
translated_en_to_kha: U Amasaiah u la ong ha uta u briew jong U Blei , Hynrei ngin leh aiu na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki talent kiba nga la ai ha ka kynhun shipai Israel ? Bad uta u briew jong U Blei u la jubab , U Trai u lah ban ai kham bun ban ia me ban ia kane .

en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days . And so it was , that in the seventh day the battle was joined : and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day .
kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi ki Syria bad ki Israel ki shong ha la ki jaka sher dara marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ki sdang ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki Israel ki pynïap da ki spah hajar ki Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia tyngkhuh bad kiwei pat ki hynriew sngi . Bad kumta ka la long, ba ha ka sngi kaba hynriew la iasoh lang: bad ki khun Israel ki la pyniap ia ki Syria shispah hajar ngut ki nonglehkai kjat ha ka shisngi .

en: Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?
kha: A  Trai  , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga bad me , men pynshisha ba me long ha kaba dei . Pynban nga dei ban kylli ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki manbha katta katta ? Balei ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba hok, ko Trai, haba nga kyrpad ia me: hynrei to ngan ia kren bad me ia ki jingbishar jong me: Balei ba ka lynti jong ki bymman ka roi ? namar kata baroh ki ia leh da kaba thok shibun ?

en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty . And he went up to him : and , behold , he sat on the top of an hill . And he spake unto him , Thou man of God , the king hath said , Come down .
kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah ban wanlam ïa u Elijah . U rangbah pynïaidkam u shem ïa u ba u shong halor u lum bad u ong ha u ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shane .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la phah ha u ia u rangbah shiphew ngut bad ki sanphew ngut jong u . Bad u la leit sha u: bad, ha khmih, u la shong ha jrong jong u lum . Bad u la kren ha u, Me u briew jong U Blei, u syiem u la ong: To wan hiar .

en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,
kha: Kynmaw mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la tip shaphang U  Trai  lyngba ki jingïashem jong phi bad u . Dei ma phi , ym ki khun ki kti jong phi kiba la ïohmad ïa kine ki jingïashem . Phi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , ïa ka bor jong u , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , bad ïa ki kambah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to tip ia phi ha kane ka sngi: namar ngam ju kren bad ki khun jong phi ki bym pat tip , bad ki bym pat iohi ia ka jingpynshitom jong U Trai U Blei jong phi , ka jingkhraw jong u , bad ka kti ba khlain jong u .

en: ( Acts 20 :28 ) These elders are spiritually mature men who take the lead in the congregation and shepherd , “not under compulsion , but willingly before God  ; not for love of dishonest gain , but eagerly .”
kha: ( Kam 20 :28 ) Kine ki rangbah balang ki long kiba la ih bha ha ka jinglong mynsiem ; ki ïalam ïa ka balang bad sharai “ym da kaba leh jubor , hynrei da la ka mon sngewbha hi ; ym da kaba khwan myntoi hynrei da ka jingsngew la kloi .”
translated_en_to_kha: (Ki Kam 20 :28 ) Kine ki rangbah ki long ki briew kiba la san ha ka mynsiem kiba ialam ha ka balang bad u nongaplangbrot ,  ym hapoh ka jingpynbor , hynrei da ka mon sngewbha ha khmat U Blei ; ym na ka bynta ka jingieit ia ka jingmyntoi kaba khlem akor , hynrei da ka jingkwah brai .

en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
kha: Baroh ki khuri dih jingdih jong u Solomon ki long kiba la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym long kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki tiar dih um baroh ki long ki ksiar , bad ki tiar jong ka khlaw Lebanon baroh ki long ki ksiar kiba khuid ; ym don kawei ruh ka rupa: ym shym la khein ei ei ha ki sngi u Solomon .

en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .
kha: Ha kata ka janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka la da dier eh , bad kane ka dei ka jaka bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki paidbah bad shah ïa ki ban leit sha ki shnong ban thied jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u, ki da ong: Kane ka dei ka jaka ri khlaw, bad ka por mynta ka la leit noh; phah noh ia u paidbah sha ki shnong ki thaw bad ki thied ia ki jingbam ba la shet .

en: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and they have caused him to ride upon the king s mule :
kha: U la phah khot ïa u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ïa ki nongïada syiem ban synran ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la phah bad u Sadok u lyngdoh bad u Natha u nongiathuhlypa, bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada, bad ki Kheriet bad ki Kheriet bad ki Kheriet bad ki Kheriet bad ki Kheriet bad ki la pynlong ia u ban shong ha u syiem:

en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive , and brought them unto the top of the rock , and cast them down from the top of the rock , that they all were broken in pieces .
kha: bad ki la ïohkem sa shiphew hajar ngut . Ki la ïalam ïa ki koidi sha ka kliar uwei u mawsiang ha ka nongbah Sela bad ki bret ïa ki , ba kumta la pynïap ïa ki ha ki mawsiang kiba don sha trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kiwei pat ki shi hajar ngut ki khun Judah ki la rah noh ia ki sha jrong jong u maw bad ki la pynhap ia ki na jrong jong u maw, ba baroh ki la shah pynpra .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Again in this place , which is desolate without man and without beast , and in all the cities thereof , shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ong ,  Ha kane ka ri kaba long kum ka ri shyiap bad ha kaba ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta , yn sa don biang ki jaka phlang ha kiba ki nongaplangbrot kin wallam ïa ki langbrot jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid U la ong biang ha kane ka jaka kaba la jot khlem briew bad khlem mrad , bad ha ki shnong jong ka baroh .

en: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .
kha: Hynrei lada phim pyndem , te ïa kane ka nongbah yn aiti noh sha ki nong Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phin ym lait im na ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada men ym leit sha ki syiem Babilon , te ia kane ka shnong yn aiti ha ka kti jong ki Khaldian , bad kin thang ia ka da ka ding , bad me ym lait na ka kti jong ki .

en: Saying ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes  ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :
kha: Sngap ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi dang leit kiew sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Kin rai pynrem ban pynïap ïa u bad nangta kin aiti ïa u sha ki Jentil ,
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong: Ha khmih , ngi leit sha Jerusalem ; bad ia u Khun u briew yn aiti ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ha ki nongthoh ; bad kin pynrem ia u haduh ka jingiap, bad kin aiti noh ia u ha ki Jutang:

en: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , and serve him , those will I let remain still in their own land , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall till it , and dwell therein .
kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad shakri ïa u , te ngan shah ïa ka ba kan shong ha la ka ri , ban rep ïa ka bad shong hangta . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki jaitbynriew kiba wanrah ia ka ryndang jong u syiem Babilon bad kiba shakri ia u, kita ngan ailad ban sah ha la ka jong ka ri , ong u Trai ; bad kin sah ha ka .

en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .
kha: Mar kumta , u khot kyrkieh ïa u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong u , bad u hukum ïa u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn ong ba ka kynthei ka la pynïap ïa nga .  Kumta u samla u dung lyngba ïa u , bad u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khot kyrkieh ia u samla jong u, bad u la ong ha u, Pynkhluit ia ka waitlam jong me, bad pyniap ia nga, ba ki shynrang kim ong na nga, Ka kynthei ka la pyniap ia u . Bad u samla jong u u la pynkhih ia u lyngba , bad u la iap .

en: So shall they fear the name of the  Lord  from the west , and his glory from the rising of the sun . When the enemy shall come in like a flood , the Spirit of the  Lord  shall lift up a standard against him .
kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi baroh kin sheptieng ïa u bad ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u . Un wan kum ka um ba kyrthep , kum ka lyer kaba jur .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kin sheptieng ia ka kyrteng U Trai na sepngi, bad ka burom jong u na ka jingmih ka sngi . Ynda u nongshun un wan rung kum ka jingshlei um , U Mynsiem U Trai un rah ia ka lama pyrshah ia u .

en: But , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country , and from all countries whither I had driven them  ; and they shall dwell in their own land .
kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri kaba shatei bad na kiwei pat ki ri baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Te kin sa ïoh shong ha la ka jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei , U Trai u im, uba la pynmih bad uba la ialam ia u symbai jong ka iing Israel na ka ri Sepngi , bad na ki ri baroh kiba nga la beh noh ia ki ; bad kin shong ha la ka jong ka ri .

en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and went out against Israel into the wilderness : and he came to Jahaz , and fought against Israel .
kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shah ïa ki Israel ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong u . U la lum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u bad u la leit sha Jahas ha ka ri khlaw bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Sihon un ym shah ia ki Israel ban iaid lyngba u pud jong u: hynrei u Sihon u la lum lang ia ki briew jong u baroh: bad u la leit sha ka ri Israel: bad u la poi ha Jahazi bad u la ialeh pyrshah ia ki Israel .

en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .
kha: Bad ïa pha pat ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade sha bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dujok ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh mynta !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me, Kapernam, kaba la pynkiew sha bneng, yn sa pynhiar sha dujok: namar lada la leh ia ki kam kiba khraw kiba la leh ha me, la leh ha ka ri Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh kine ki sngi .

en: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel , they made peace with Israel , and served them . So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more .
kha: Haba ki syiem kiba shah synshar ha u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki la pynlong ka jingïasuk bad ki bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong ki . Bad ki Syria ki la sheptieng ban ïarap biang ïa ki Ammon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki syiem baroh kiba long ki shakri jong u Hadadeser ki la iohi ba ki la shah pyniap ha khmat ki Israel , ki la iasuk bad ki Israel bad ki la shakri ia ki . Kumta ki Syria ki la tieng ban iarap shuh ia ki khun u Ammon .

en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins : also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .
kha: Kaei kaba ka ri ka pynmih ka leit sha ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi namar ba ngi la leh pop . Ki leh katba ki sngewbha ïa ngi bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi , bad ngi don ha ka jinglanot kaba khraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka ai shibun ia ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi namar ki pop jong ngi: ruh ki don ka jingsynshar halor ki met jong ngi bad halor ki masi jong ngi, ha ka jingsngewbha jong ki, bad ngi don ha ka jingjynjar kaba khraw .

en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar , that the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba saw jong ka snem kaba laiphew , ma nga , u Esekiel u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Busi , nga dang ïashong ïasah ryngkat bad ki Jiw ba la shah ringmraw harud ka wah Khebar ha Babilonia . Ka bneng ka la plie wang , bad nga la ïohi ïa U Blei ha ka jingïohipaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha ka snem kaba laiphew, ha ka sngi kaba saw, ha ka sngi kaba phra jong u bnai, katba nga dang don hapdeng ki mraw hajan ka wah Chebar , ba ki bneng ki la plie , bad nga la iohi ia ki jingphohsniew jong U Blei .

en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , Therefore we turn again to thee now , that thou mayest go with us , and fight against the children of Ammon , and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
kha: Ki ong ïa u Jephthah ,  Ngi phai sha me mynta namar ngi kwah ïa me ban leit lang bad ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon , bad ban long u nongïalam ïa ki Gilead baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah Gilead ki la ong ha u Jephthah: Namar kata ngi phai biang sha me mynta, ba me lah ban leit ryngkat bad ngi, bad ban ialeh pyrshah ia ki khun ki ksiew jong ka ri Ammon bad to long ka khlieh jong ngi halor ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri Gilead baroh .

en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .
kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem ,  Kane ka dei ka ktien U  Trai  : ‘ Namar ba me la shah ïa u briew ban lait phet ïa uba nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew da la ka jingim , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba la pyllait ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u , Kumta u ong U Trai , Namar ba me la pyllait noh na ka kti jong me ia u briew uba nga la buh ban pynjot lut , namarkata ka jingim jong me kan leit noh na ka bynta ka jingim jong u bad ki briew jong me na ka bynta ki briew jong u .

en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death , he shall ask , and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death . There is a sin unto death : I do not say that he shall pray for it .
kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa la u parabriew ba u leh ïa ka pop ka bym ïalam sha ka jingïap , phi dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ha u ïa ka jingim . Kane ka ïadei ïa kito kiba ki pop jong ki , kim ïalam sha ka jingïap . Hynrei ka don ka pop kaba ïalam sha ka jingïap , bad ngam ong ba phi dei ban duwai sha U Blei shaphang kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada uno uno u briew u iohi ia u hynmen jong u ba u leh pop kaba ym dei ban iap , un pan ia u bad un ai jingim ia u na ka bynta jong ki ki bym leh pop haduh ka jingiap . Ka don ka pop haduh ka jingiap: Ngam ong ba un duwai na ka bynta kata .

en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: U la shim ïa kita ki sohshkor , u thang pynum ïa ki , u theh ïa ka ksiar ha ka tiar saiñdur , bad u thaw ïa ka dur u khun masi . Ki paidbah ki ïa-ong ,  Ko Israel , une u long u blei jong ngi , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !
translated_en_to_kha: U la pdiang ia ki ha ka kti jong ki, bad u la pynlong ia ka da ka tiar kaba rben: bad ki la ong: Kine ki long ki blei jong me, ko Israel, kiba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .
kha: Haba ka jingmudui aiñ ka mih , ki lyngdoh kin ai jingrai ïa ka jingmudui kat kum ki aiñ jong nga . Kin pynïaid ïa ki jinglehniam kat kum ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih jong nga , bad kin rakhe khuid ïa ka Sabbaton .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka jingiakren kin ieng ha ka jingbishar ; bad kin bishar ia ka katkum ki jingbishar jong nga: bad kin sumar ia ki ain jong nga bad ki ain jong nga ha ki jingiaseng baroh jong nga; bad kin pynkyntang ia ki Sabha jong nga .

en: Yea , thou heardest not  ; yea , thou knewest not  ; yea , from that time that thine ear was not opened : for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously , and wast called a transgressor from the womb .
kha: Nga la tip ba ïa phi ym lah ban shaniah , la ju tip ïa phi kum u nongïaleh pyrshah . Na kata ka daw phim pat ju ïohsngew satia ïa kane , balei ba wat shikyntien ruh kam shym la wan ha ki shkor jong phi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid me, ngam shym la iohsngew ia me, ngam tip ia me, naduh kata ka por ba ka shkor jong me kam shym la plie: namar nga tip ba me leh da kaba thok shibun, bad la khot ia me u nongleh kam sniew na ka kpoh .

en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .
kha: U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asbuk , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Bethsur distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka jingtep u Dabid , ka pungsum bad jaka sah shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien jong u u Nehemaiah u khun u Azbuk, u nongsynshar jong ka bynta kaba shiteng na ka Bethzur, haduh ka jaka kaba don pyrshah ia ki jingtep jong u Dabid bad haduh ka pung kaba la shna, bad haduh ka iing jong kiba khlain .

en: And I prayed unto the  Lord  my God , and made my confession , and said , O Lord , the great and dreadful God , keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him , and to them that keep his commandments  ;
kha: Nga la duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga bad nga la phla ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga . Nga la ong ,  A Trai U Blei , me long uba khraw , bad ngi pyndonburom ïa me . Me long uba bat ïa la ka jutang bad me pyn-i ka jingieit baneh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa me bad leh ïa kaei kaba me hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la duwai ha U Trai U Blei jong nga, bad nga la leh ia ka jingphla jong nga, bad nga la ong, ko Trai, U Blei uba khraw bad uba shyrkhei, uba bat ia ka jutang bad ka jingisynei ia kita kiba ieit ia u, bad ia kita kiba sumar ia ki hukum jong u;

en: And Samuel said , Hath the  Lord  as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices , as in obeying the voice of the  Lord  ? Behold , to obey is better than sacrifice , and to hearken than the fat of rams .
kha: Te u Samuel u ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u kham sngewbha : ka jingkohnguh ne ki jingainguh bad ki jingkñia ? Ka kham bha ban kohnguh ïa u ban ïa kaba kñia ha u ïa ka langbrot kaba kynsai tam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong , Hato U Trai u sngewbha shibun eh ha ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia kumba u kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai ? Ha khmih , ban kohnguh ka kham bha ban ia ka jingknia , bad ban sngap ia ka shini jong ki langbrot .

en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .
kha: Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa kita ki shipai samla kiba long hapoh ki nongai hukum jong ki distrik , kiba don arspah laiphew ar ngut baroh . Nangta u la khot ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel , kaba don hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la khein ia ki samla jong ki nongsynshar jong ki ri, bad ki long arspah laiphew arngut: bad hadien jong ki u la khein ia ki briew baroh, wat ia ki khun Israel baroh, ki long hynriew hajar .

en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number , or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves : but they measuring themselves by themselves , and comparing themselves among themselves , are not wise .
kha: Ha ka jingshisha ngin ym nud ban pynïaryngkat ïa lade lane ïanujor ïa lade bad kito kiba pynkiew skong palat ïa lade . Katno kiba mutlop ki long! Ki buh ïa la ki jong ki kyndon ban thew ïa lade , bad ki bishar ïa lade da la ki jong ki jingthew!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngim nud ban pynlong ia lade da u nombar, ne ban ianujor ia lade bad ki katto katne kiba iaroh ia lade: hynrei ki thew ia lade da lade, bad ki ianujor ia lade hapdeng jong ki hi, kim long kiba stad .

en: And the  Lord  said , I will remove Judah also out of my sight , as I have removed Israel , and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen , and the house of which I said , My name shall be there .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa ka Judah kumjuh kumba nga la leh ïa ka Israel : Ngan pynjah ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong nga , bad ngan kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba nga la jied , bad ka Templ , ka jaka kaba nga la ong ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan weng noh ia u Judah ruh na ka khmat jong nga, kumba nga la weng noh ia ki Israel, bad ngan bret noh ia kane ka nongbah Jerusalem kaba nga la jied, bad ka iing jong ka kaba nga la ong: Ka kyrteng jong nga kan don hangta .

en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .
kha: Kata ka long balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa nga ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban ai jingshlur ïa nga . U nongshun u la jop ïa nga ; ki briew jong nga kim don ei ei shuh kaba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshun jong me baroh ki la plie ia ka shyntur jong ki pyrshah ia me: ki sngap jar bad ki sngap jar: ki ong: Ngi la sngap jar ia ka: shisha kane ka dei ka sngi kaba ngi la wad; ngi la shem ia ka .

en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
kha: Ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U Trai u ieit . Naba U Blei u la jied ïa phi kum kiba nyngkong ban pynim da ka bor U Mynsiem ban pynlong ïa phi ki riewkhuid jong u bad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingshisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngi dei ban ainguh ia U Blei na ka bynta jong phi, ko para baieit jong U Trai, namar U Blei u la jied ia phi naduh kaba sdang ban pynkhuid ia U Mynsiem bad ka jingngeit ia ka jingshisha:

en: So Joram went over to Zair , and all the chariots with him : and he rose by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him about , and the captains of the chariots : and the people fled into their tents .
kha: Kumta u Jehoram u leit sha Sair bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , ha kaba ka kynhun shipai Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki . Ha ka por mynmiet ma u bad ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki kali ïapom ki la ïohlad ban lait bad ki phet ïap , bad ki shipai jong u ki phet sakma sha ki ïing jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joram u la leit sha Zair, bad ki kali baroh ryngkat bad u: bad u la ieng miet , bad u la pynkhih ia ki nong Edome kiba la ker sawdong ia u: bad ki rangbah jong ki kali: bad ki briew ki la phet noh sha la ki ïingjaiñ .

en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write  ; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God , and the seven stars  ; I know thy works , that thou hast a name that thou livest , and art dead .
kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Sardis :  Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba don ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei bad ki hynñiew ki khlur . Nga tip ïa kaei kaba pha leh ; nga tip ba pha don ka nam babha ba pha long kaba im , wat la pha la ïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u angel jong ka balang ha Sardis u thoh ; Kine kiei kiei u ong ba u don ki hynriew Mynsiem U Blei, bad ki hynriew tylli ki khlur ; Nga tip ia ki kam jong me, ba me don ka kyrteng ba me im, bad me la iap .

en: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves : but for father , or for mother , or for son , or for daughter , for brother , or for sister that hath had no husband , they may defile themselves .
kha: U lyngdoh um dei ban long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam da kaba ktah ïa ka metïap , lait noh kaba dei ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u , lane ki khun jong u lane ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u lane ki kynthei kiba shi para bad u ki bym pat shongkurim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ym wan sha u briew uba la iap ban pynjakhlia ia lade: hynrei na ka bynta u kpa ne na ka bynta ka kmie ne na ka bynta u khun shynrang ne na ka bynta ka khun kynthei kaba khlem tnga, ki lah ban pynjakhlia ia lade .

en: And they set the altar upon his bases  ; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries : and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  , even burnt offerings morning and evening .
kha: Wat la kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai , ki sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri , pynban ki tei biang ïa ka duwan ha ka jaka ba ka ïeng mynshuwa . Nangta ki sdang biang ban thang halor jong ka ïa ki jingkñia man ka step bad man ka janmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la buh ia ka jingbam ha ki nongrim jong u; namar ka jingtieng ka la don ha ki namar ki briew jong kita ki ri: bad ki la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang ha U Trai, wat ki jingknia thang mynstep bad janmiet .

en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .
kha: Bad mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Sngewbha wat phah pat ïa nga sha ka byndi ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada phi leh kumta , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to sngap mynta, nga kyrpad ia me, ko kynrad jong nga: to ai ba ka jingkyrpad jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, kan long kaba la pdiang ha khmat jong me; ba me pynlong ia nga ban leit phai noh sha ka iing u Jonathan u nongthoh , ioh ba ngan iap hangta .

en: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .
kha: Dei ha ka jingngeit ba kine ki briew baroh ki la ïap . Kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba U Blei u la kular , hynrei na sha jngai ki ïohi ïa ki bad ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , bad ki la pynbna paidbah ba ki la long ki nongwei bad ki sohshnong ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine baroh ki la iap ha ka jingngeit, kim shym la ioh ia ki jingkular, hynrei ki la iohi ia ki na jngai, bad ki la sngewskhem ia ki, bad ki la pdiang ia ki, bad ki la phla ba ki long ki nongwei bad ki nongleit jingleit ha ka khyndew .

en: And the curious girdle of his ephod , that was upon it , was of the same , according to the work thereof  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha da kijuh ki tiar la pyndait lang ha ka ephod kumba U  Trai  U la hukum ïa u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkren lyngkot jong u, kaba la don halor jong ka, ka long kumjuh, kat kum ka jingtrei jong ka; ka ksiar, ka rong saw bad ka rong saw, bad ka rong saw kaba jem bha; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel , twelve , according to their names , like the engravings of a signet  ; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes .
kha: Ha uwei uwei na ki , thoh ïa ka kyrteng jong uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki maw kin long bad ki kyrteng jong ki khun Israel, shiphew tylli ki jaitbynriew jong ki.

en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit  ; it was foursquare  ; and two cubits was the height of it  ; the horns thereof were of the same .
kha: U shna ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih . Ka long kaba sawdong , ka don sawphew san sentimitar ka lynter bad sawphew san sentimitar ka jingïar bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki ïadait lang kawei bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shna ia ka jaka dih jingiwbih kaba heh: ka jingjrong jong ka ka long shi cuit , bad ka jingjrong jong ka ka long saw cuit ; bad ar cuit ka long ka jingjrong jong ka ; ki bniat jong ka ki long kumjuh .

en: They went out from us , but they were not of us  ; for if they had been of us , they would no doubt have continued with us : but they went out , that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us .
kha: Kine ki briew da shisha kim don ha ka jingïasyllok jong ngi , bad kata ka long balei ba ki la iehnoh ïa ngi ; lada ki la don ha ka jingïasyllok bad ngi , kin jin da la sah bad ngi . Hynrei ki mihnoh , ba kan paw shai ba ym don napdeng jong ki kiba dei shisha ki jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih noh na ngi , hynrei kim shym la long na ngi ; namar lada ki la long na ngi , khlem artatien kin jin da la bteng bad ngi: hynrei ki la leit noh , ba kin sa paw ba kim long baroh .

en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah , for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger , and made Israel to sin .
kha: Ka longïing jong me kan long kum ka longïing u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , bad kum ka longïing u syiem Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah , namar ba me la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan pynlong ia ka iing jong me kum ka iing u Jeroboan u khun u Nebat bad kum ka iing u Basah u khun u Ahiah, namar ka jingkhih kaba me la pynkhih ia nga ban bitar bad u la pynlong ia ki Israel ban leh pop .

en: Behold , I will make them of the synagogue of Satan , which say they are Jews , and are not , but do lie  ; behold , I will make them to come and worship before thy feet , and to know that I have loved thee .
kha: Shahshkor ! Na ka bynta kato ka kynhun kaba dei ka jong u Soitan , kito kiba lamler kiba kam ba ki dei ki Jiw hynrei kim dei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ban wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong pha . Baroh kin tip ba nga ieit ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia ki na ka synagog u Soitan , kiba ong ba ki long ki Jiw , bad kim long kumta , hynrei ki thok ; ha khmih , ngan pynlong ia ki ban wan bad mane ha khmat ki kjat jong me bad ban tip ba nga la ieit ia me .

en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders , and carry it forth in the twilight : thou shalt cover thy face , that thou see not the ground : for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel .
kha: Shah ïa ki ban khmih ba me tawah ïa la ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong me bad mih shabar sha kaba dum da kaba tap ïa ki khmat jong me , khnang ba men ym ïohi shano me leit . Kaei kaba me leh kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingpeit jong ki men kit ia ka ha ki tyrpeng jong me, bad men rah ia ka ha ka jingshai: men tap ia ka khmat jong me, ba men ym iohi ia ka khyndew: namar nga la buh ia me kum ka dak ha ka iing Israel .

en: And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nong Ijipt khnang ba un ïoh pyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Israel ki la ïakynduh ha lynti bad kumno U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la iathuh ha u kpa jong u ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la leh ha u Pharaoh bad ha ki nong Ijipt na ka bynta ki Israel bad ka jingtrei shitom baroh kaba la wan ha ki ha ka lynti .

en: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him  ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .
kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa phi bad ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to ïapynbeit noh ïa ka jingïakajia bad u katba dang don ka por ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Shisien ba phi la don hangta , un aiti ïa phi sha u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi sha u pulit , bad un set ïa phi ha ka ïingbyndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniadei bad u nongshun jong me kloi, ha kaba me don ha ka lynti bad u;

en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the  Lord  their God , and they built them high places in all their cities , from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city .
kha: Ki Israel ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki um sngewbha ïa kita . Ki tei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ha ki shnong baroh , naduh ka shnong barit eh haduh ki nongbah baheh tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leh rieh ia kita kiei kiei kiba ym long kiba dei pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong ki, bad ki la tei ia ki ha ki jaka ba jrong ha ki shnong jong ki baroh , naduh ka tower jong ki nongap haduh ka nongbah ba la ker sawdong .

en: And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .
kha: Kynsan u angel jong U Trai u la ïeng hangta , bad ka jingshai ka la thaba hapoh ka kamra byndi . U angel u la pynkhih ïa u Petros na ka tyrpeng , u la kyrsiew ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Pynkloi ! Khie joit !  mar kumta hi ki kynjri ki la hap na ki kti jong u Petros .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u angel U Trai u la wan ha u, bad ka jingshai ka la shai ha ka phatok: bad u la shoh ia u Petros ha ka liang , bad u la pynkiew ia u da kaba ong: To khie noh kloi . Bad ki kynjri jong u ki la hap noh na ki kti jong u .

en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
kha: Haba kin ïohi ïa u lyoh tdem uba kiew shajrong na kata ka nongbah , ki Israel kiba ha madan thma ki dei ban phai kylla . Hynrei kat haduh kane ka por , ki Benjamin ki la ïoh pynïap laiphew ngut ki Israel . Ki ong ha lade ,  Ho-oid , ngi la jop ïa ki kumba ngi la leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew Israel ki la shongthait ha ka thma , u Benjamin u la sdang ban shoh bad pyniap ia ki briew Israel kumba laiphew ngut: namar ki la ong: Hooid ki la shah pynjot ha khmat jong ngi kumba ha ka thma kaba nyngkong .

en: And the man , the master of the house , went out unto them , and said unto them , Nay , my brethren , nay , I pray you , do not so wickedly  ; seeing that this man is come into mine house , do not this folly .
kha: Hynrei u tymmen u mih shabar bad u ong ha ki ,  Em , ko paralok jong nga ! Sngewbha ! Wat leh kaba kum kata ka kam bymman , ka kam bakhlemrain ! Une u briew u long uba nga la khot sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Utei u briew, u trai iing, u la leit sha ki, bad u la ong ha ki, Em, ko para jong nga, em, nga kyrpad ia phi, wat ju leh bein ia kane ka briew ba une u briew u wan shapoh iing jong nga, wat leh ia kane ka jingleh bein .

en: For even thy brethren , and the house of thy father , even they have dealt treacherously with thee  ; yea , they have called a multitude after thee : believe them not , though they speak fair words unto thee .
kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me , ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong me hi , ki la shetkylla ïa me ; ki la ïasoh ha ki jingtur ïaleh pyrshah ïa me . Wat shaniah ïa ki , wat la ki kren ki ktien sngewieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat ki hynmen jong me bad ka iing u kpa jong me ruh ki la leh thok ia me ; yea , ki la khot ia u paidbah hadien jong me: wat la ki kren ia ki ktien kiba hok ha me .

en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .
kha: Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la sop da ka rupa na Spain bad da ka ksiar na Uphas baroh ki jingtrei jong ki nongtrei ; la pynphong jaiñ ïa ki ha ki jaiñ ïongjngum bad sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongthain jaiñ batbit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka rong saw ka la saphriang ha ki pliang , bad ka ksiar na Uphas , ka kam jong u nongtrei , bad na ki kti jong u nongseng: ka rong saw bad ka rong saw ka long ka jain jong ki: ki long baroh ki kam jong ki briew kiba sniew .

en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , and I will add to your yoke : my father also chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
kha: U ong ,  I pa i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita . I pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kren ia ki hadien ka jingai jingmut jong ki samla, da kaba ong, U kpa jong nga u la pynkhih ia ka jingkit jong phi: u kpa jong nga ruh u la pynshitom ia phi da ki khnam , hynrei ngan pynshitom ia phi da ki khnai .

en: And the children of Israel said unto him , We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it : I will only , without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .
kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ,  Ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah , bad lada ma ngi lane ki jingri jong ngi , ngi dih ïa ka um jong phi , ngin da siewdor ïa ka — baroh kaba ngi kwah ka long ban shu ïaid lyngba .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la ong ha u, Ngin iaid lyngba ka lynti kaba jrong: bad lada nga bad ki masi jong nga ngin dih ia ka um jong me: Ngan siew ia ka: tang shu leh ei ei shuh shuh: ngan iaid lyngba ki kjat jong nga .

en: And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .
