kha: Phi dei ban ong , ‘ U shakri jong phi u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’   U Jakob u la pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jong u da ki jingai sngewbha , bad haba nga ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong shuh shuh: Ha khmih u shakri jong me u Jakob u don shadien jong ngi . Namar u la ong , Ngan pynsngewbha ia u da ka jingai sngewbha kaba leit ha khmat jong nga , bad hadien kata ngan iohi ia ka khmat jong u;

en: And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .
kha: U syiem la u itynnat ïa ka palat ban ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , bad palat ban ïa kiwei pat , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha bad ka jingsngewieit . U buh ïa ka pansngiat syiem ha ka khlieh jong ka bad pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la ieit ia ka Esther halor ki kynthei baroh, bad ka la ioh ia ka jingaiei bad ka jingsngewbha ha khmat jong u kham palat ia ki nongleh kam sniew baroh.

en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the  Lord  upon his two shoulders for a memorial .
kha: Buh ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel . Ha kane ka rukom u Aaron un kit ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai kynmaw ïa ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men buh ia ki ar tylli ki maw ha ki tyrpeng jong u Ephod na ka bynta ki maw jingkynmaw ha ki khun Israel: bad u Aaron un kit ia ki kyrteng jong ki ha khmat U Trai ha ki ar tylli ki tyrpeng jong u na ka bynta ka jingkynmaw .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :
kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki dong jaiñkup jong phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngum ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phi dei ban leh ïa kane shi lynter .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia ki khun Israel , bad to hukum ia ki ba kin pynlong ia ki ban shet ha ki pud jong ki jain jong ki ha ki pateng jong ki baroh kawei .

en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .
kha: ( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dei u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khun jong u Nahash bad ka para jong ka Seruïah , ka kmie jong u Joab . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la pynlong ia u Amasa u rangbah shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab: uba u Amasa u long u khun shynrang uba kyrteng u Ithra u Israel uba la leit sha u Abigail ka khun jong u Nahas , ka para jong u Seruiah Joab .

en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle : and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn , and next unto him Abinadab , and the third Shammah .
kha: Lai ngut ki khun kiba nyngkong jong u ki la leit lang bad u Saul sha ka thma . Uba nyngkong eh u dei u Eliab , uba bud u dei u Abinadab , bad uba lai u dei u Shammah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang kiba kham rangbah jong u Jesse ki la leit sha ka thma: bad ki kyrteng jong ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u kiba la leit sha ka thma ki long u Eliab u khun nyngkong, bad hadien jong u u Abinadab bad u Shammah uba lai .

en: And he answering said to his father , Lo , these many years do I serve thee , neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment : and yet thou never gavest me a kid , that I might make merry with my friends :
kha: Hynrei u la jubab ïa la u kpa , ‘ Ha khmih , baroh kine ki snem nga la trei kum u mraw na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngam pat ju saitlah ïa ki hukum jong phi . Phi la ai aïu ïa nga ? Ym don wat tang kawei ka blang na ka bynta jong nga ban ïakhawai bad ki paralok jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la jubab ia la u kpa, Lo, kine ki snem nga shakri ia me, ym shym la pynkhein ia nga ha kano kano ka por: bad wat ju ai khun ia nga, ba ngan sngewbha bad ki paralok jong nga:

en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .
kha: Ko khun u briew , ngan phah ïa me sha ki paid Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lyndet ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pyrshah hi , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, nga phah ia me sha ki khun Israel, sha ka jaitbynriew kaba leh pyrshah ia nga: ma ki bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ki la iaid pyrshah ia nga, wat haduh kane ka sngi .

en: The vision of Obadiah . Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning Edom  ; We have heard a rumour from the  Lord  , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen , Arise ye , and let us rise up against her in battle .
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuhlypa jong u Obadaïah — kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong shaphang ka jaitbynriew Edom . U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ha ki jaitbynriew , bad ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong u :  To pynkhreh ! Ïa ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ka Edom !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingphohsniew jong u Obadia . Kumta u Trai Blei Edom Ngi la iohsngew ia ka khubor na U Trai , bad u nongwan u la phah hapdeng ki nongwei , To mih noh phi , bad to ngin ia kiew pyrshah ia ka ha ka thma .

en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :
kha: Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka long kaba lieh , bad kam shym paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh ha kata ka prum ruh um pat lieh , u lyngdoh un pynkyrpang ïa uta u briew hynñiew sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka jingshai kaba shai ka long kaba lieh ha ka sniehdoh jong u, bad ha ka jingpeit kam kham jylliew ban ia ka sniehdoh, bad u shniuh jong ka um dei ban kylla lieh ; te u lyngdoh un khang ia uta uba don ia ka khlam hynriew sngi:

en: And seekest thou great things for thyself ? seek them not : for , behold , I will bring evil upon all flesh , saith the  Lord  : but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest .
kha: Hato me khmih lynti ïa ka jingleh bakyrpang na ka bynta ïa lade ? Wat leh ïa kata . Nga wallam ïa ka jingjot ha u khunbynriew baroh , hynrei men pyllait ïa ka jingim kat shaba me leit . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me wad ia kiei kiei kiba khraw na ka bynta lade ? wat wad ia ki: namar, ha khmih, ngan wanrah ia ka jingsniew ha ka doh baroh, ong U Trai: hynrei ka jingim jong me ngan ai ha me na ka bynta ka jingbam ha ki jaka baroh .

en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?
kha: Katba u Adonijah bad baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong kata ka jingsawa baroh hapoh ka nongbah ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Adonijah bad ki nongwan baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u ki la iohsngew ia ka kumba ki la pyndep ia ka jingbam . Bad haba u Joab u la iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka turoi , u la ong: Balei kane ka jingsawa jong ka nongbah ka long ha ka jingsawa ?

en: And he said unto me ,  My grace is sufficient for thee : for my strength is made perfect in weakness .  Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities , that the power of Christ may rest upon me .
kha: Hynrei ka jubab jong u ka la long :  Ka jingaiei jong nga ka long baroh kaba me donkam , naba ka bor jong nga ka khraw tam dei haba me tlot .  Nga kmen eh , namarkata , ban sngewsarong ha ki jingtlot jong nga , khnang ban mad ïa ka jingïada ka bor jong U Khrist halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, Ka jingaiei jong nga ka biang ia me: namar ka bor jong nga ka long kaba janai ha ka jingtlot . Kaba kham sngewbha namarkata ngan kham sngewbha ban sngew sarong ha ki jingduna jong nga, ba ka bor U Khrist kan shong ha nga .

en: And it shall come to pass , if ye diligently hearken unto me , saith the  Lord  , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day , but hallow the sabbath day , to do no work therein  ;
kha: Ïathuh ïa kine ki briew ba ki dei ban kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum jong nga . Kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong kane ka nongbah ha ka Sabbaton . Ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton kum ka sngi bakyntang bad kim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia lada phi sngap jar ia nga, ong U Trai, ban wanrah ia ka jingkit lyngba ki khyrdop jong kane ka shnong ha ka sngi Sabha , hynrei ban pynkyntang ia ka sngi Sabha , ban ym leh ei ei ha kata ka sngi Sabha;

en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : every one that toucheth them shall be holy .
kha: Ha ki por ki ban wan baroh uno uno na ki shynrang kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki lah ban bam ïa ka pateng la pateng kum ka bynta na ki jingkñia ainguh bam sha U  Trai . Uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa ka jingainguh bam un mynsaw na ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki shynrang napdeng ki khun Aaron kin bam ia ka . Kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi shaphang ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding: uwei pa uwei uba ktah ia ki un long uba khuid .

en: Then they went out to see what was done  ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
kha: Ki briew ki la ïaleit ban peit ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , bad haba ki la poi ha U Jisu , ki la shem ïa u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh , ba u da shong ha ki kjat jong U Jisu , u la phong jaiñ bad ha ka jingtipbriew ; bad baroh ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la mih ban peit ia kaei kaba la leh ; bad ki la wan sha U Jisu, bad ki la shem ia uta u briew, na uba ki ksuid ki la leit noh, u la shong ha ki kjat U Jisu, u la phong da ka jainkup bad ha ka jingmut kaba dei jong u: bad ki la tieng .

en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
kha: Ki briew kiba la shahjop ki beiñ pyrshah ïa kiba jop ïa ki bad ki pyn-i jingisih ïa ki . Kin ong ,  Phi shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong phi , hynrei phi long ba la tim ! Katno slem phin ïailong kiba riewspah da kaba pynbor ïa ki nongshim ram jong phi ban siew noh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kine baroh kin ym shim ia ka jingiathuhkhana pyrshah ia u, bad ka jingkren bein pyrshah ia u, bad kin ong , Ko ia uta uba pynbun ia kata kaba ym dei jong u ! katno por ? bad ia uta uba pynkhih ia lade da ka dewbilat kaba jylliew !

en: But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .
kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan ,  U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka .  Hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba ngan sa dih ?   Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong , Phim tip ia kaei kaba phi kylli . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri kaba ngan dih , bad ban shah pynbaptis da ka jingpynbaptis kaba nga shah pynbaptis ? Ki ong ia u , Ngi lah .

en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .
kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka ri Sheba ïa baroh kaba ka pan , nalor kiwei pat ki jingai sngewbha kat kum ka dustur ïa kiba u la lah ai ha ka na ka jingjynsur mynsiem . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Solomon u la ai ha ka mahadei jong ka Sheba ia ka jingkwah jong ka baroh, kaei kaei kaba ka la pan, nalor kata kaba u Solomon u la ai ia ka na ka spah syiem jong u . Kumta ka la phai bad ka la leit sha la ka jong ka ri, ma ka bad ki shakri jong ka .

en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .
kha: Hynrei ban pyllait ïa nga na kaba dap da ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba bun kiba phylla ba nga la ïohi , la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaba jur ha ka met , kaba long kum u nonglamktien jong u Soitan ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ban pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsngew sarong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ioh ba ngan shah pynkiew palat ia ka jingbun ki jingpynpaw , la ai ha nga ia ka jingsma ha ka doh , u nonglam khubor jong u Soitan ban pynkhih ia nga , ioh ba ngan shah pynkiew palat ia ka jingthew .

en: Now , behold , thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed , even upon Egypt , on which if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him .
kha: Phi khmih lynti ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan long kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata ka dei kaei kaba u syiem ka Ijipt u long haba mano mano ki shaniah tylli ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ha khmih, me shaniah ha u dieng jong une u khniang uba la tyrkhong, wat ha Ijipt, ha kaba lada u briew u shaniah, un leit sha ka kti jong u, bad un pynkhih ia ka: kumjuh ruh u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt ha kito baroh kiba shaniah ha u .

en: And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .
kha: Na kane ka jingkerkut , ka jingkyrduh bam ha ka nongbah ka la long kaba jur katta katta kat haduh ba kawei ka khlieh kada ka shongdor phraphew ki sbai rupa , bad arspah gram ka eit paro    ka shongdor san sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don ka jingkyrduh kaba khraw ha Samaria : bad, ha khmih, ki la ia tyngkhuh bad ka khlieh jong ka kada kaba saw tylli ki rupa, bad ka bynta kaba saw jong ka cab jong ka rong saw na ka bynta san tylli ki rupa .

en: Them did Moses the servant of the  Lord  and the children of Israel smite : and Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites , and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasseh .
kha: Kine ki ar ngut ki syiem ki la shahjop ha u Moses bad ki paid Israel . U Moses , u shakri U  Trai  , u la ai ïa ka ri jong ki ha ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad , bad ha shiteng na ka jait Manasseh , ba kan long ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pynlong ia u Moses u shakri U Trai bad ki khun Israel: bad u Moses u shakri U Trai u la ai ia ka kum ka jaka ha ki Reuben bad ki Gad bad ka jaitbynriew Manasseh .

en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?
kha: La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga ,  u la khot ïa la ki hynmen shynrang .  Kane hangne ha ka byrni jong nga !  Mar kumta ki rit mynsiem ria , bad da kaba sheptieng ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba U Blei u la leh ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki hynmen jong u, "Ka pisa jong nga ka la wan phai shuh shuh bad, ha khmih, ka don wat ha ka tdong jong nga: bad ka dohnud jong ki ka la duh noh ia ki, bad ki la tieng, ki da ong iwei ia iwei pat, Kaei kane kaba U Blei u la leh ia ngi ?

en: How shall I give thee up , Ephraim ? how shall I deliver thee , Israel ? how shall I make thee as Admah ? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim ? mine heart is turned within me , my repentings are kindled together .
kha: Kumno nga lah ban ieh ïa phi , ko Israel ? Kumno nga lah ban iehnoh ïa phi ? Hato ngan pynjot junom ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Admah , lane ngan leh ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Seboiim ? Ka dohnud jong nga kan ym shah ïa nga ban leh ïa kata ! Ka jingieit jong nga ïa phi ka long khlaiñ haduh katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ngan aiti noh ia me, Ephraim ? kumno ngan pyllait im ia me, Israel ? kumno ngan pynlong ia me kum u Admah ? kumno ngan buh ia me kum u Seboiim ? ka dohnud jong nga ka kylla hapoh jong nga , ki jingkylla jong nga ki kylla long kiba la pynkhih lang .

en: Whereupon the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold , and said unto them , It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem : behold thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Hadien ba u la pyrkhat bha , u shna ar tylli ki khun masi kiba da ka ksiar bad u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Phi la hap ïaleit mane jngai palat shaduh Jerusalem . Ko ki paid Israel , khmih kine ki blei kiba la wanlam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba u syiem u la iamir jingmut bad u la thaw ar tylli ki khun masi ksiar bad u la ong ha ki: Ka long kaba palat ia phi ban leit sha Jerusalem: ha khmih ki blei jong me, ko Israel, kiba la wanrah ia me na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .
kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud u leit wad ïa u Saul . U ïohsngew ba u Saul u la leit sha ka nongrit Karmel , ha kaba u la tei mot ïa lade , bad nangta u la leit sha Gilgal .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ieng dang step ban iakynduh ia u Saul, la iathuh ha u Samuel, u la ong, U Saul u la wan sha Karmel, bad, ha khmih, u la buh ia u ha ka jaka, bad u la leit noh, bad u la leit hiar sha Gilgal .

en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .
kha: U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki Israel , bad ki la ïawan sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la lum ia ki jait Israel baroh ha Shehem , bad u la khot ia ki rangbah Israel bad ia ki khlieh jong ki bad ia ki nongbishar jong ki; bad ki la pyni ia lade ha khmat U Blei .

en: If thou sayest , Behold , we knew it not  ; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
kha: Phi lah ban ong ba kam dei ka kam jong phi , hynrei U Blei u tip bad u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi . U ïai ap khmih ïa phi ; u tip . Un ainong ïa phi kat kum kaei kaba phi leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me ong , Ha khmih , ngim tip ia ka ; hato uta uba pyrkhat ia ka dohnud um tip ia ka ? bad uta uba sumar ia ka mynsiem jong me ? bad un ym siew ia u briew kat kum ki kam jong u ?

en: For we must needs die , and are as water spilt on the ground , which cannot be gathered up again  ; neither doth God respect any person : yet doth he devise means , that his banished be not expelled from him .
kha: Ngi baroh ngin ïap ; ngi long kum ka um kaba hoit ha khyndew , ïa kaba ym lah shuh ban tong biang . Wat U Blei um ju wallam ïa kiba la ïap ban im pat , hynrei u syiem u lah la kumno kumno ban shem lynti ban wallam pat ïa u briew na ka jingphet wir .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi dei ban iap, bad ki long kum ka um kaba tuid ha ka khyndew, kaba ym lah ban lum biang ; bad U Blei um burom ia uno uno u briew: hynrei u pyrkhat ia ka jingmut jong u ba u la shah beh noh na u .

en: When thou art come unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt possess it , and shalt dwell therein , and shalt say , I will set a king over me , like as all the nations that are about me  ;
kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta , phin sa ïa-pyrkhat ban don noh u syiem kumba ïalong lem ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me wan sha ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me, bad men long trai ia ka, bad men shong ha ka, bad men ong, ngan buh syiem halor jong nga, kumba long ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba don sawdong jong nga;

en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .
kha: Un leit ha shuwa jong U Trai , uba khlaiñ bad uba khrawbor kum u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa . Un pynïasuk pat ïa ki kpa bad ki khun ; un pynphai pat ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh sha ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiba hok ; un pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U Trai na ka bynta jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un leit ha khmat jong u ha ka mynsiem bad ka bor jong u Elias , ban pynphai ia ki dohnud jong ki kpa sha ki khun , bad ki bym kohnguh ia ka jingstad jong ki briew kiba hok ban pynkhreh ia ki briew kiba la pynkhreh na ka bynta U Trai .

en: Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
kha: Ka long kumta bad phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namar phi long ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mynta phi long ki jong u , uta ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ko para bangeit jong nga ruh phi la iap ha ka hukum da ka met U Khrist; ba phin ia poi kha bad uwei pat, wat ia uta uba la pynmihpat na kiba iap, ba ngin wanrah soh ha U Blei .

en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .
kha: Kane ka mut , ba u dei ban long uba syriem kum ki para jong u ha kiei kiei baroh , ba un ïoh long u rangbah lyngdoh uba lah ban shaniah bad uba sngewsynei ha ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , kumta ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ha kiei kiei baroh ka la long ba un long kum ki hynmen jong u, ba un long u lyngdoh rangbah uba isynei bad uba iaineh ha kiei kiei kiba iadei bad U Blei , ban pynbeit ia ki pop jong ki briew .

en: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you , and there remained but wounded men among them , yet should they rise up every man in his tent , and burn this city with fire .
kha: Wat la men jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Babilonia baroh kawei , ba tang ki rangbah ba la mynsaw kin sah , kiba thiah ha la ki ïingjaiñ , kito ki rangbah kin dang ïeng bad thang ïa kane ka nongbah ha ban da ing khoit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar wat la phi la pynkhih ia ka kynhun shipai jong ki Khaldi kaba ialeh pyrshah ia phi, bad ki la sah tang ki briew kiba la mynsaw hapdeng jong ki, hynrei ki dei ban kiew uwei pa uwei ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u, bad thang ïa kane ka nongbah da ka ding .

en: Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .
kha: Ki nongïalam ki la jubab ,  Ngin leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai noh ïa ka jaka bad ngin pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram .  Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad pynlong ïa ki nongïalam ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban bat ïa ka kular kaba ki la lah khlei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong: Ngin sa pynphai biang ia ki, bad ngin ym donkam ei ei na ki ; kumta ngin leh kumba me ong . Nangta nga la khot ia ki lyngdoh bad nga la shim ia ka jingsmai jong ki , ba kin leh katkum kane ka jingkular .

en: And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
kha: Shim ïa u khun jong me ,  U Blei u ong ,  u Isaak , u khun ba tang marwei jong me , ïa uba me ieit thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . Hangta halor u lum ïa uba ngan sa pyn-i ha me , kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: To shim mynta ia u khun jong me, u Isaak uba me ieit, bad to leit sha ka ri Moriah ; bad to ai ia u hangta na ka bynta ka jingknia thang halor uwei na ki lum kiba ngan iathuh ia me .

en: And Saul said unto Samuel , Yea , I have obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , and have gone the way which the  Lord  sent me , and have brought Agag the king of Amalek , and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites .
kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa U  Trai   u Saul u jubab .  Nga la leit kumba u la phah ïa nga , nga la wan ïalam ïa u Agag , u syiem , bad nga la pynïap ïa ki Amalek baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong ha u Samuel , Hooid nga la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai bad nga la leit noh sha ka lynti kaba U Trai u la phah ia nga bad nga la wanrah ia u Agag u syiem ka Amalek bad nga la pynjot lut ia ki Amalek .

en: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement : it shall be an holy convocation unto you  ; and ye shall afflict your souls , and offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ka long ka sngi ka jingpyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba man ka snem ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Wat bam ei ei ruh em ha kata ka sngi ; ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai kaba hynriew kan long ka sngi pynkhuid: kan long ka jingpynkhuid bakhuid ia phi ; bad phin pynshitom ia ki mynsiem jong phi , bad phin aiti ia ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding sha U Trai .

en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night , and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and beast  ; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment : I am the  Lord .
kha: Ha kata ka miet ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt , da kaba pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh , la u dei u briew ne u mrad , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki blei ka ri Ijipt baroh . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngan iaid lyngba ka ri Ijipt mynta ka miet , bad ngan shoh ia u khun nyngkong baroh ha ka ri Ijipt , u briew bad u mrad baroh beg bad pyrshah ia ki blei Ijipt baroh ngan pyndep ia ka jingbishar: Nga long U Trai .

en: Make the heart of this people fat , and make their ears heavy , and shut their eyes  ; lest they see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and understand with their heart , and convert , and be healed .
kha: Nangta u ong ïa nga ,  Pynbthi ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong kine ki briew , pynkyllut ïa ki shkor jong ki , bad pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki , ba kumta kin ym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew lane sngewthuh . Lada ki leh kumta , ki lah ban phai sha nga bad ïoh jingkhiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynlong ia ka dohnud jong une u briew kaba heh, bad pynlong ia ki shkor jong ki kiba khia, bad khang ia ki khmat jong ki na ka bynta ba kin iohi da ki khmat jong ki, bad kin iohsngew da ki shkor jong ki, bad kin sngewthuh da ka dohnud jong ki, bad kin kylla bamut, bad kin koit .

en: And I went up by revelation , and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately to them which were of reputation , lest by any means I should run , or had run , in vain .
kha: Nga la leit namar U Blei u la pynpaw ha nga ba nga dei ban leit . Ha ka jingïakynduh bajar jar bad ki nongïalam , nga la batai ïa ka khubor ka Gospel ïa kaba nga ïalap ha ki Jentil . Ngam shym la kwah ba ka jingtrei jong nga kaba mynshuwa bad kaba mynta kin shu sep-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la leit shaneng da ka jingpynpaw , bad nga la pynpaw ha ki ia kata ka gospel kaba nga ialap hapdeng ki Jutang , hynrei tang ha ki kiba la pawnam , ioh da kano kano ka lad nga la mareh ne nga la mareh khlem da pynpaw ei ei .

en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
kha: Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shakri ban tong um ; ki leit sha ki thliew pynlang um , hynrei kim shem um ; ki wan phai pat bad ki khra thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem bad shaïong jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki rangbah jong ki ki la phah ia ki khun rit jong ki sha ki um: ki la poi sha ki thliew , bad kim lap um shuh shuh ki la wan phai da ki umphniang jong ki kiba thylli shuh shuh ki la sngewlehrain bad sngewlehrain , bad ki la tap ia ki khlieh jong ki .

en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me , O children of Israel ? saith the  Lord . Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt ? and the Philistines from Caphtor , and the Syrians from Kir ?
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , nga da pyrkhat ïa ki briew ka Sudan kumba nga leh ïa phi . Nga la wallam ïa ki nong Philistia na Krit bad ïa ki nong Syria na Kir , kumba nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim long kum ki khun jong ki nong Ithiopia ha nga ? ong U Trai . Hato ngam shym la wanrah ia ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt ? bad ki Philistia na Kaphtor bad ki Syria na Kir ?

en: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are : and when I see the blood , I will pass over you , and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt .
kha: Ka snam ha ki shawkad kan long ka dak ban pyn-i ïa ki ïing ha kiba phi shong . Haba nga ïohi ïa kata ka snam , ngan ïaid lait na phi , bad ngan ym ktah ïa phi haba nga pynshitom ïa ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka snam kan long ha phi kum ka dak ha ki iing ha kaba phi don: bad ynda nga iohi ia ka snam , ngan iaid lait noh ia phi , bad ka khlam kan ym don ha phi ban pynjot ia phi , haba nga shoh ia ka ri Ijipt .

en: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard , and hold fast , and repent . If therefore thou shalt not watch , I will come on thee as a thief , and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee .
kha: Kynmaw te , ïa kaei kaba la hikai ïa pha bad ïa kaei kaba pha la ïohsngew ; kohnguh ïa kata bad phai noh na ki pop jong pha . Lada pham kyndit bynriew noh , ngan wan ha pha kum u nongtuh , bad phan ym lah wat ban tip ïa ka por lano ngan wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Kynmaw namarkata kumno me la pdiang bad iohsngew, bad bat skhem bad kylla bamut . Namarkata lada phim peit , ngan wan ha me kum u nongtuh , bad me ym tip ha ka por ba ngan wan ha me .

en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up :
kha: Phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki turoi , ba la bud da ka jingput ïa ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , bad ki duitara ; bad nangta sa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem kin ïasoh lang . Tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , phi dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah pynïeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ha kano ka por ba phi iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka kornet, ka flute, ka harp, ka jingsawa, ka jingsawa, ka jingsawa, bad ki jait jingsawa baroh, phi hap bad mane ia ka dur ksiar kaba u Nebuchadnezzar u syiem u la buh:

en: Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .
kha: Ki briew ki kylli ,  Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U  Trai  um patiaw ? Balei ngi dei ban leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ?  U  Trai  u ong ïa ki ,  Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi shahjingit , phi ïabeh ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi bad banbeiñ ïa la ki nongtrei .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei ngi la shah jingit, ong ma phi, bad me khlem iohi ? namar kata ngi la pynshitom ia ka mynsiem jong ngi, bad me shim jingtip ei ei ? Ha khmih, ha ka sngi jong ka jingleh niam jong phi phi shem ia ka jingsngewbha, bad to pynbeit ia ki jingtrei shitom jong phi baroh .

en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites , in all their burdens , and in all their service : and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens .
kha: Kine ki kur u Kohath kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba la buh ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin long baroh ki khun shynrang jong ki, ha ki jingkit jong ki baroh: bad phin buh ha ki ban peit ia ki jingkit jong ki baroh .

en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this , that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God : no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them .
kha: Nga la pyrkhat slem bad pyrkhat shitom ïa kane baroh bad nga la ïohi ba U Blei u synshar ïa ki jingleh jong ki briew kiba stad bad bahok , wat ïa ka jingieit bad ka jingisih jong ki . Ym don mano mano batip ei ei shaphang kaei kaba don ha khmat jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kine baroh nga la pyrkhat ha ka dohnud jong nga wat ban pynbna ia kine baroh, ba ki hok bad ki riewstad bad ki kam jong ki ki don ha ka kti U Blei: ym don mano mano ruh kiba tip ia ka jingieit ne jingshun da kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha khmat jong ki .

en: And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .
kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat bad uwei u masi uba dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u  purew , bad shi pla snieh ka waiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , wat la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ka la pynkha ia u, ka la rah ia u bad ka, bad lai tylli ki masi, bad kawei ka epha ka shini bad ka bilor wain, bad ka la wanrah ia u sha ka iing U Trai ha Shiloh: bad u khynnah u dang rit .

en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , through the way of the plain from Elath , and from Ezion–geber , we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .
kha: Kumta ngi la nang ïaid , bad ngi kiar ïa ka lynti kaba leit na ki shnong Elath bad Esiongeber sha ka Duriaw Baïap , bad ngi phai shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi sha ka ri Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la iaid lyngba na ki hynmen jong ngi ki khun shynrang jong ngi kiba shong ha Seir, lyngba ka lynti jong ka madan na Elat bad na Ezionbir , ngi la phai bad iaid lyngba ka lynti jong ka ri khlaw jong ka ri Israel .

en: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .
kha: bad ïa lade ka leit shong kumba shispah mitar na kata ka jaka . Ka ong ha lade ,  Ngam lah shah ban ïohi ïa la u khun ba u ïap .  Katba ka dang shong hangta , ka la sdang ban ïam .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la leit noh bad ka la shong ia ka ha u kum ka jingsawa kaba bha: namar ka la ong , Wat ai ba ngan iohi ia ka jingiap jong u khynnah . Bad ka la shong ha u , bad ka la pynkiew ia ka sur jong ka bad ka la iam .

en: When men strive together one with another , and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him , and putteth forth her hand , and taketh him by the secrets :
kha: Lada ar ngut ki briew ki ïashoh , bad ka tnga jong uwei na ki ka pyrshang ban ïarap ïa la u tnga da kaba bat tyngeh na ka rain jong uta uwei pat ,
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki shynrang ki ialeh lang iwei ia iwei pat, bad ka tnga jong uta ka wan hajan ban pyllait ia u tnga jong ka na ka kti jong uta uba pynkhih ia u, bad ka pynkhih ia ka kti jong ka, bad ka shim ia u da ki jingmaham:

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :
kha: ban ïathuh ha ki Israel ba uno uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki aiñ harum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel da kaba ong: Lada ka mynsiem kan leh pop da ka jingbymtip ia uno uno na ki hukum U Trai shaphang kiei kiei kiba ym dei ban leh , bad kan leh pyrshah ia uno uno na ki:

en: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee , from me : if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right  ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .
kha: Kumta te to ngin ïakhlad noh . Jied ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri kaba me mon . Me leit shawei , bad nga ngan leit shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato ka ri baroh kawei ha khmat jong me ? pyniakhlad ia lade, nga kyrpad ia me: lada me shim ia ka kti kadiang, te ngan leit sha ka liang kadiang ; lane lada me leit sha ka liang kadiang, te ngan leit sha ka liang kadiang .

en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses , at the rushing of his chariots , and at the rumbling of his wheels , the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands  ;
kha: Kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki jingjam jong ki kulai , ki jingriew jong ki kali ïapom , ki jingtyllun jong ki shaka . Ki kpa kin phai pat na ka bynta la ki khun ; ki kti jong ki kin noh kyrwep .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ki tyrpeng jong ki kulai kiba khlain jong u, ha ka jingkhih jong ki kali jong u, bad ha ka jingkhih jong ki tyrpeng jong u , ki kpa kin ym peit shadien sha ki khun jong ki namar ka jingtlot jong ki kti;

en: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith , and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil , saying , It is ready for the sodering : and he fastened it with nails , that it should not be moved .
kha: U misteri u ong ïa u bania , ‘ Me la lehbha !’ U briew uba shoh pynjlih ïa ka bleithaw u pynshlur ïa uwei uba sah preg ban pyndait lang ïa ka . Ki ong ‘ ka jingpyndait ka long kaba bha’ — bad ki pynskhem ïa ka bleithaw ha ka jaka da ki preg .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u nongshna nar u la pynshlur ia u nongshna ksiar, bad uta u la pynkhih ia u uba la pynkhih ia u anvil, da kaba ong: Ka long kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingleh be-ijot: bad u la pynskhem ia ka da ki nail, ba kan ym khih .

en: And when these days were expired , the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace , both unto great and small , seven days , in the court of the garden of the king s palace  ;
kha: Hadien kata , u syiem u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah jong ka hima , ka Susa , ïa kiba duk bad kiba riewspah kumjuh . Ka neh shi taïew bad la pynlong ha ki kper jong ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda la kut noh kine ki sngi, u syiem u la leh ia ka jingkhawai ha ki briew baroh kiba la don ha Shushan ka iing syiem, haduh katta katta bad kiba rit, hynriew sngi, ha ka phyllaw jong ka kper syiem;

en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai  :  Ngan rwai ha U  Trai namar ka jingjop kaba khraw jong u ; sha duriaw u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki khun Israel ki rwai ia kane ka jingrwai ha U Trai, bad u la kren, u da ong: Ngan rwai ha U Trai: u kulai bad u nongshong kulai jong u u la bret sha duriaw .

en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us , written not with ink , but with the Spirit of the living God ; not in tables of stone , but in fleshy tables of the heart .
kha: Ka long kaba shai ba U Khrist da lade hi u la thoh ïa kane ka shithi bad u la phah ïa ka da ngi . Naba la thoh , ym da ka sia hynrei da U Mynsiem jong U Blei uba im , bad ym ha ki mawlyngkniap hynrei ha ki dohnud briew keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Shaphang jong phi la pynbna shai ba phi long ka epistle jong U Khrist ba la shakri da ngi, ym da ka ink , hynrei da U Mynsiem U Blei uba im; ym da ki miej maw , hynrei ha ki miej dohnud .

en: And the  Lord  said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth  ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air  ; for it repenteth me that I have made them .
kha: La pyndap ïa u da ka jingbabe , kat haduh ba u la ong ,  Ngan pynduh khoit ïa kine ki briew kiba nga la thaw , bad ruh ïa ki mrad bad ki sim , naba nga la sngewsih ba nga la thaw ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan pynjot ia u briew uba nga la thaw na ka khyndew baroh arngut u briew bad u mrad bad u mrad bad ki sim ba her bad ki sim ba her; namar ka kylla bamut ia nga ba nga la pynlong ia ki .

en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early , and gone forth , behold , an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots . And his servant said unto him , Alas , my master ! how shall we do ?
kha: Kum lashai dang step phyrngab , u shakri jong u Elisha u khie , u mih shabar ïing , bad u ïohi ba ki shipai Syria lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki ba ki la kerkut ïa kata ka shnong . U leit phai sha u Elisha bad u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , ngi la ïap ! Ngin leh kumno ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u shakri jong u briew U Blei u la khie dang step, bad u la leit noh, ha khmih, ka kynhun shipai ka la ker sawdong ia ka shnong baroh arngut ki kulai bad ki kali kit mar . Bad u shakri jong u u la ong ha u, Alas, ko kynrad jong nga ! kumno ngin leh ?

en: Also day by day , from the first day unto the last day , he read in the book of the law of God . And they kept the feast seven days  ; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly , according unto the manner .
kha: Naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh , ki pule ïa ki bynta jong ka Hukum U Blei man ka sngi . Ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la long na ka bynta hynñiew sngi , bad ha ka sngi kaba phra , ka la don ka jingpynkut ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam kumba la ong ha ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh man la ka sngi, naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong haduh ka sngi kaba khatduh, u pule ha ka Kitab ka hukum U Blei . Ki la pynlong ia ka jingkhawai hynriew sngi; bad ha ka sngi kaba phra ka la long ka jingiaseng kaba skhem katkum ka rukom .

en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the  Lord .
kha: Pateng la pateng , kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ki teh ïa phi bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi . Ma phi bad ma ki phi ïalong kumjuh ha khmat U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kawei ka hukum kan long na ka bynta jong phi na ka jingiaseng bad kumjuh ruh na ka bynta u nongwei uba sah bad phi: kumba phi long , kumta u nongwei un long ha khmat U Trai .

en: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the  Lord  bowls of silver , snuffers , basins , trumpets , any vessels of gold , or vessels of silver , of the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord  :
kha: Pynban ym shym la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa , ban siew ha kaba shna ïa ki khuri rupa , ki khiew , ki turoi , ne ki tiar pynmeh ïa ki sharak , ne kiwei de ki tiar ba la shna na ka rupa ne na ka ksiar .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ym shym la shna ia ki khiew rupa, ki sniang, ki thliew ksiar ne ki khiew rupa na ka pisa ba la wanrah sha ka iing U Trai:

en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute  ; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba khmih ïa ki nongtrei ba la shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki la lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Ha kane u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet sha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u la phah ia u Hadoram uba la don halor ka khajna ; bad ki khun Israel ki la ther maw ia u da ki maw, ba u la iap . Hynrei u syiem Rehoboam u la kyrkieh ban kiew ia u sha ka kali jong u, ban phet noh sha Jerusalem .

en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .
kha: U Hanun bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew mitar , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka khyrdop them ka la pynbha ia u Hanun, bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Zanoah ki la tei ia ka, bad ki la buh ia ki jingkhang jong ka, ki jingkhang jong ka bad ki bar jong ka, bad shi hajar cubit ha ka jingkhang haduh ka khyrdop .

en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
kha: Khot ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit kiba nga la ai ha ki ka sap bad ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Aaron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren ha baroh kiba stad mynsiem, kiba nga la pyndap da ka mynsiem jingstad, ba kin pynlong ia ki jain Aaron ban pynkyntang ia u, ba un shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh .

en: And he said , Well  ; I will make a league with thee : but one thing I require of thee , that is , Thou shalt not see my face , except thou first bring Michal Saul s daughter , when thou comest to see my face .
kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan ïateh kular bad phi tang ha kawei ka kyndon : phi dei ban wallam ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u Saul sha nga haba phi wan ïakynduh ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Hooid ngan leh ia ka jingiateh bad me: hynrei kawei kaba nga dawa na me, kata , Wat iohi ia ka khmat jong nga , lait noh tang ma me nyngkong eh ia ka khun jong u Michal Saul haba me wan peit ia ka khmat jong nga .

en: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .
kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wanrah biang sha kane ka jaka u khun jong u syiem Judah, ryngkat bad ki mraw jong u Judah baroh kiba la leit sha Babilon: namar ngan pynpra ia ka jingkit jong u syiem Babilon .

en: When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .
kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba nga kwah ban pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad pynlong ïa ki ban manbha sa shisien pat , baroh kaba nga lah ban ïohi ka long ka jingbymman jong ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki leh . Ki shukor uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki rung jubor ha ki ïing bad ki tuh ; ki lute ïa ki briew ha ki lynti bah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la pynkoit ia ki Israel, nangta la lap ia ka jingbymhok jong u Ephraim bad ka jingsniew jong ka Samaria: namar ki leh thok ; bad u nongtuh u wan rung shapoh , bad ka kynhun ki nongtuh ka la jah noh shabar .

en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;
kha: Haba u syiem Jehoïakim bad ki shipai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Uriah u la lah ong , u syiem u la pyrshang ban phah pynïap ïa u . Hynrei u Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewtriem bad u la lait phet sha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoiakim u syiem, bad ki rangbah jong u baroh, bad ki rangbah baroh, ki la iohsngew ia ki ktien jong u: hynrei haba u Ulia u la iohsngew ia kata, u la tieng bad u la phet noh sha Ijipt;

en: Who hath heard such a thing ? who hath seen such things ? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day ? or shall a nation be born at once ? for as soon as Zion travailed , she brought forth her children .
kha: Hato don mano mano ba ju ïohi ne ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kata ? Uei uba la ïohi ïa kaba kum kata ? Lah mo ban kha ïa ka hima tang ha ka shi sngi ? Ka Seïon kam donkam ban shahshitom slem , shuwa ba yn kha ïa ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la iohsngew ia kum kata ka jingjia ? mano ba la iohi ia kum kine kiei kiei ? Hato ka khyndew kan sa mih ha kawei ka sngi ? lane ka jaitbynriew kan sa kha shisien ? namar tang shu kha ia ki khun jong ka .

en: And Joshua had commanded the people , saying , Ye shall not shout , nor make any noise with your voice , neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth , until the day I bid you shout  ; then shall ye shout .
kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym risa , lane kren shikyntien ruh tad haduh ba un da ai hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la hukum ia ki briew da kaba ong: Phim dei ban pyrta ne pynmih jingsawa da ka sur jong phi, lymne kano kano ka ktien kan mih na ka shyntur jong phi, haduh ka sngi ba nga pyrta ia phi; nangta phin pyrta .

en: And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen  ;
kha: Haba u la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ha ka jaka ha kaba ka lynti kaba hiar sha u lum ki Olib , ki paid synran jong u kiba bun bah ki la sdang ban ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa u ha ki sur bajam na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba khraw baroh kiba ki la lah ïohi :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la wan hajan, wat mynta ha ka jinghiar jong u lum Olives, u paidbah baroh u la sdang ban kmen bad iaroh ia U Blei da ka sur kaba jam na ka bynta ki kam kiba khraw baroh kiba ki la iohi ; .

en: Let both grow together until the harvest : and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers , Gather ye together first the tares , and bind them in bundles to burn them : but gather the wheat into my barn .
kha: Ai ba u kew bad ki ñiut kin ïasan lang tad haduh ka aïom ot . Nangta ngan ong ha ki nongot ban rat nyngkong ïa ki ñiut , ban tehsong ïa ki bad ban thang ïa ki , bad nangta ban lumlang shapoh ïa u kew bad buh ïa u ha ka thiar jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ai ba baroh arngut kin san lang haduh ka por ot: bad ha ka por ot ngan ong ha ki nongot , Pyniasoh nyngkong ia ki sohjew , bad teh ia ki ha ki thliew ban thang ia ki: hynrei to lum ia u kew ha ka phyllaw jong nga .

en: And when they told it to Jotham , he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim , and lifted up his voice , and cried , and said unto them , Hearken unto me , ye men of Shechem , that God may hearken unto you .
kha: Haba u Jotham u tip ïa kane , u leit bad u ïeng ha kliar u Lum Gerisim , bad u pyrta jam sha ki ,  Shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah ka Shekhem , bad U Blei u lah ban sngap ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la iathuh ha u Jotham, u la leit bad u la ieng ha jrong jong u lum Gerizim, bad u la pynkiew ia ka sur jong u bad u la pyrta bad u la ong ha ki: To sngap ia nga, phi ki briew jong ka Shehem, ba U Blei un sngap ia phi .

en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee , and shall turn again to thee , and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :
kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki shahjop ha ki nongshun jong ki namar ba ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta ki phai pat sha me bad wan sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewrit ha me na ka bynta ban ïoh jingmap , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki la shah pynjot ha khmat u nongshun, namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ia me, bad kin phai biang sha me, bad kin phla ia ka kyrteng jong me, bad kin duwai, bad kin kyrpad ia me ha kane ka iing:

en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .
kha: Hapdeng ki briew ha Jabesh ki lap sawspah ngut ki theisotti , kumta ki wan ïalam ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara ha Shiloh , kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shem hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong u Jabeshgilead saw spah ngut ki khun samla kiba khlem ithuh briew da kaba thiah bad uno uno u shynrang: bad ki la wanrah ia ki sha ka shnong Shiloh kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .

en: But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .
kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied — ym hawei pat ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . Leh ïa kata ha ka por sep sngi , kaba ïadei bad ka por ba phi mih na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka jaka kaba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied ban buh ia ka kyrteng jong u, hangta me dei ban knia ia ka jingkhawai Niam ka por mynstep ka sngi .

en: Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .
kha: La khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongtem , ki nongap phira , ki nongtrei lane kino kino kiba don ka jingïadei bad kane ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ngi pynshisha ia phi , ba haba ktah ia uno uno na ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ki nongrwai , ki nongrah jingrwai , ki Nethinim ne ki nongtrei jong kane ka iing U Blei , kan ym long kaba dei ban buh ia ka khajna ne ka riti dustur ha ki .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lynti ïaid kiba mynbarim bad hangno ka don ka surok babha tam . To ïaid ha ka , bad phin im ha ka jingsuk .  Hynrei ki ong ,  Em , ngin ym leh !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , To ieng ha ki lynti , bad peit , bad pan ia ki lynti barim , shano ka lynti kaba bha , bad iaid ha ka , bad phin shem ia ka jingjahthait na ka bynta ka mynsiem jong phi . Hynrei ki la ong , Ngin ym iaid ha ka .

en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .
kha: U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balui lui , haduh ba ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la leh ïa kane nalor ba u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah sha ka jingmane bleithaw da kaba pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u Manasseh u la pynmih shibun eh ia ka snam kaba khlem pop, haduh ba u la pyndap ia ka Jerusalem naduh kawei pat ka tduh hajan ka pop jong u ha kaba u la pynlong ia u Judah ban leh pop, ha kaba u la leh ia kata kaba sniew ha khmat U Trai .

en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper  ; the second , sapphire  ; the third , a chalcedony  ; the fourth , an emerald  ;
kha: Ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka kynroh ka nongbah la pynkup itynnat da ki jait maw bakordor baroh . U maw nongrim uba nyngkong u la long u maw Jasper , uba ar u maw Sapphir , uba lai u maw Agate , uba saw u maw Emerald ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki nongrim jong ka kynroh jong ka nongbah ki la long kiba la shna da ki maw kiba kordor baroh . Ka nongrim kaba nyngkong ka long Jasper ; kaba ar , ka saphiret ; kaba lai .

en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Israel phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , namar ngam shym leh ïa phi kat kum ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba phi dei hok ban ïoh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai, haba nga la leh bad phi na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ym kat kum ki lynti bymman jong phi, lane kat kum ki jingleh bamsap jong phi, ko iing Israel jong phi, ong U Trai Blei .

en: I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :
kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha kito na phi kiba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei pat ; nga la ong ïa kane mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngoh kaba ar ïa phi , hynrei ngan ong biang mynta ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka por ba nga wan yn ym don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la ong ia phi mynshuwa , bad nga iathuh lypa ia phi , kumba nga la don hangta , ka sien kaba ar bad ka jingbym don mynta nga thoh sha ki kiba la leh pop mynta , bad sha kiwei pat baroh , ia kata , lada nga wan biang , ngan ym pyllait:

en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines , where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim , a Beth–lehemite , slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver s beam .
kha: La don sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , bad u Elhanan , u khun jong u Jair uba na Bethlehem u la pynïap ïa u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba rben kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la don biang ka thma ha Gob bad ki Philistia, ha kaba u Elhanan u khun u Jaareoregim, u Bethlehemite u la pyniap ia u hynmen u Goliath u Gilead , u diengduh jong u u long kum u nongthain jain .

en: And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .
kha: Nangta halor u Lum Seïon bad halor baroh kiba la ïalumlang hangta , U  Trai  un phah ïa u lyoh ha ka por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka thylliej ding baphyrnai ha ka por mynmiet . Ka burom U Blei kan tap bad da ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un thaw halor kawei pa kawei ka jaka shong jong u lum Seion, bad halor ki jingiaseng jong ka, u lyoh bad ka tdem ha ka sngi , bad ka jingshai jong ka ding kaba rhem ha ka por miet: namar halor ka burom baroh kan long ka jingiada .

en: That in blessing I will bless thee , and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven , and as the sand which is upon the sea shore  ; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies  ;
kha: nga kular ba ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khlur ka sahit bneng , lane kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba da kaba kyrkhu ngan kyrkhu ia me, bad da kaba pynbun ia u symbai jong me kum ki khlur bneng, bad kum ka dewbilat kaba don ha rud duriaw ; bad u symbai jong me un don ia ka khyrdop jong ki nongshun jong u ; .

en: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up : glory of this , and tarry at home : for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me la jop ïa ki Edom , bad me dap da ka jingsarong . To sngewhun bad la ka nam bad shong khop ha ïing . Balei me pynkynroi jingkulmar ka ban wanrah tang ïa ka jingpynjot ha me bad ha ki briew jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me la pynkhih shisha ia u Edom, bad ka dohnud jong me ka la pynkiew ia me: ka burom jong kane, bad to sah ha iing: namar balei me dei ban ia tyngkhuh bad ka jingsngewsih jong me, ba me dei ban hap, wat ma me bad u Judah bad me?

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A plumbline . Then said the Lord , Behold , I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel : I will not again pass by them any more :
kha: U la kylli ïa nga ,  Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   U Sawar ,  nga la jubab . Nangta u ong ,  Nga pyndonkam ïa u ban pyn-i ba ki briew jong nga ki long kum ka kynroh ka bym biang sawar . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ong ha nga, Amos, me iohi ia me ? Bad nga la ong, Ka jingpynkylla dur . Nangta u la ong U Trai: Ha khmih ngan buh ia ka um ha pdeng ki briew jong nga Israel: Ngan ym iaid shuh ia ki:

en: Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :
kha: Dei namar jong phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la bitar ïa nga bad u la kren da kaba shai ba ngan ym ïoh jam ïa ka wah Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh kaba u ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh U Trai u la bitar ia nga na ka bynta jong phi, bad u la sngap jar ba ngam dei ban leit sha ka ri kaba bha, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me kum ka pateng:

en: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .
kha: Kumta khie leit bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u leit hiar sha ka wah Nile . Rah bad me ïa u diengduh ïa uba la pynkylla bseiñ , bad ap ïa u harud wah .
translated_en_to_kha: To leit sha u Pharaoh ha ka por mynstep; u leit sha ka wah ; bad me dei ban ieng hajan ka wah kaba u wan; bad u diengduh uba la kylla long u bsein me dei ban shim ha ka kti jong me .

en: Sojourn in this land , and I will be with thee , and will bless thee  ; for unto thee , and unto thy seed , I will give all these countries , and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father  ;
kha: To shong to sah hangne , bad ngan long lem bad me , bad ngan kyrkhu ïa me . Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka ri baroh ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me . Ngan bat ïa la ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u Abraham u kpa jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap jar ha kane ka ri , bad ngan long bad me bad ngan kyrkhu ia me namar ia me bad ia u symbai jong me , ngan ai ia kine ki ri baroh , bad ngan pyndep ia ka jingsmai kaba nga smai ha u Abraham u kpa jong me;

en: And I asked her , and said , Whose daughter art thou ? And she said , The daughter of Bethuel , Nahor s son , whom Milcah bare unto him : and I put the earring upon her face , and the bracelets upon her hands .
kha: Nga la kylli ïa ka , ‘ Uei u kpa jong phi ?’ Bad ka la jubab , ‘ U kpa jong nga u dei u Bethuel , u khun jong u Nahor bad ka Milkah .’ Nangta nga pyndait ïa ka sati ha ka khmut jong ka , bad nga pyndeng ruh ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la kylli ia ka, bad nga la ong, Ka khun jongno me long ? Bad ka la ong, Ka khun jong u Bethuel, u khun u Nahor, uba u Milkh u la kha ha u: bad nga la buh ia ka shkor ha ka khmat jong ka bad ki brace ha ki kti jong ka .

en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :
kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , baroh ki dei ban long ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ai ia ka jingknia thang kaba la thang da ka ding, ka jingknia kaba thiang ha U Trai ; shiphew tylli ki masi rit , ar tylli ki langbrot bad shiphew tylli ki langbrot jong ka snem kaba nyngkong; kin long ki bym don jingduna:

en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns : and Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son .
kha: U Abraham u khmih sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la sahkut ki reng ha ka bniap . U leit ban shim ïa u , bad kñia ïa u kum ka jingainguh thang ha ka jaka u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abraham u la rah ia ki khmat jong u bad u la peit bad u la iohi hadien jong u ia u langbrot uba la shah kem ha ka thliew jong u: bad u Abraham u la leit shim ia uta u langbrot bad u la tyrwa ia u ban thang ia u ha ka jaka jong u khun jong u .

en: Ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , and my servant whom I have chosen : that ye may know and believe me , and understand that I am he : before me there was no God formed , neither shall there be after me .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , phi long ki sakhi jong nga ; nga la jied ïa phi ban long u shakri jong nga , khnang ba phin tip ïa nga bad ngeit ha nga bad sngewthuh ba nga long tang ma nga U Blei . Nalor jong nga ym don uwei pat u blei ; u bym pat ju long bad u ban nym long .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi long ki sakhi jong nga, ong U Trai, bad u shakri jong nga uba nga la jied: ba phin ithuh bad ngeit ia nga, bad sngewthuh ba nga long ma nga: ha khmat jong nga ym shym la thaw ia U Blei, lymne un ym don hadien jong nga .

en: Our cattle also shall go with us  ; there shall not an hoof be left behind  ; for thereof must we take to serve the  Lord  our God  ; and we know not with what we must serve the  Lord  , until we come thither .
kha: Em , ngin ïalam ïa ki mrad jong ngi lem bad ngi ; yn ym don kawei ruh ïa ka ban iehnoh shadien . Ngin sa jied hi ïa ki mrad da kiba ngin mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Bad katba ngim pat poi hangta , ngin ym tip ki jingri kiba kumno ngin kñia ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki masi jong ngi ruh kin iaid ryngkat bad ngi ; ym dei ban iehnoh ia ka kjat; namar kata ngi dei ban shim ban shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong ngi ; bad ngim tip da kaei kaba ngi dei ban shakri ia U Trai, haduh ba ngin da wan sha kata .

en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba hynriew , jong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïing jong nga . Kynsan kynsan ka bor jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar ka la wan halor jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba hynriew, ha ka sngi kaba phra jong u bnai, katba nga dang shong ha iing jong nga, bad ki rangbah Judah ki la shong ha khmat jong nga, ba ka kti U Trai U Blei ka la hap hangta halor jong nga .

en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .
kha: Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah wallam ïa nga sha u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sedekaiah u syiem u la phah ia u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa ha u ha ka jingkhang kaba lai kaba don ha ka iing U Trai: bad u syiem u la ong ha u Jeremaiah: bad u syiem u la ong ha u Jeremaiah: Ngan kylli ia me ia kaei kaei kaba nga buhrieh na nga .

en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams : for the  Lord  your God proveth you , to know whether ye love the  Lord  your God with all your heart and with all your soul .
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pyndonkam ïa u ban tynjuh ïa phi , ban khmih la phi ieit ne em ïa U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat sngap ia ki ktien jong uta u nongiathuhlypa ne uta u nongphohsniew: namar U Trai U Blei jong phi u pynshisha ia phi , ban tip la phi ieit ne em ia U Trai U Blei jong phi da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .

en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :
kha: Haba u Aaron u kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka longïing jong u ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Aaron un wanrah ia u masi jong ka jingknia pop, kaba long na ka bynta jong u hi, bad un pynlong ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ka iing jong u, bad un pyniap ia u masi jong ka jingknia pop kaba long na ka bynta jong u hi:

en: Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :
kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba katto katne ngut kiba la leit na ka kynhun jong ngi kiba la pynjynjar bad pynkhuslai ïa phi da kaei kaba ki la ong ; pynban , kim shym la ïohpdiang kano kano ka jingbthah na ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba ngi la iohsngew, kata ka long kaba la mih na ngi kaba la pynkhuslai ia phi da ki ktien, kaba pynkylla ia ki mynsiem jong phi, da kaba ong: Phi dei ban shah ot bad sumar ia ka hukum: ha kiba ngim shym la ai kum kata ka hukum:

en: And when he was come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching , and said , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority ?
kha: U Jisu u la wan pat sha ka Templ ; bad katba u dang hikai , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan sha u bad ki la kylli ,  Me don hok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan shapoh ka tempi, ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ki briew ki la wan sha u katba u dang hikai bad ki la ong: Da ka bor aiu me ia kine kiei kiei ? bad mano ba la ai ia me ia kane ka bor ?

en: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth , to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus , called to be saints , with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord , both theirs and ours :
kha: Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , ha kito baroh kiba la khot ban long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei , kiba dei ki jong u ha U Khrist Jisu , lem bad ki briew baroh kylleng kiba mane ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long U Trai jong ki ruh :
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka balang U Blei kaba don ha Korinth , ha kito kiba la pynkyntang ha U Khrist Jisu , la khot ia ki ban long ki riewkhuid , bad baroh kiba ha man la ki jaka ki khot ia ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist jong ngi:

en: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying , Behold , the tabernacle of God is with men , and he will dwell with them , and they shall be his people , and God himself shall be with them , and be their God .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka khet :  Mynta ka ïing jong U Blei ka long bad u bynriew ! Un shong bad ki , bad kin long ki briew jong u . U Blei da lade hi un long bad ki , bad un long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur kaba khraw na bneng kaba ong: Ha khmih, ka iing jong U Blei ka don bad ki briew , bad un shong bad ki , bad kin long ki briew jong u , bad U Blei hi un long bad ki bad U Blei jong ki .

en: Then shalt thou call , and the  Lord  shall answer  ; thou shalt cry , and he shall say , Here I am . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke , the putting forth of the finger , and speaking vanity  ;
kha: Haba phi duwai , ngan jubab ïa phi . Haba phin khot ïa nga ngan jubab .  Lada phi pynkut noh ïa ka jingbanbeiñ , na man la ka jingleh ibeiñ , bad na man la ka ktien sniew ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to khot ia u, bad U Trai un iam, bad un ong, Hangne nga don . Lada me weng noh na pdeng jong me ia ka lyngkhot, ka jingpynkhih ia ka kti, bad kren bein;

en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines , and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth : for the  Lord  will spoil the Philistines , the remnant of the country of Caphtor .
kha: Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa ka Philistia , ban pyndam noh na ka Tyros bad ka Sidon ïa ka jingïarap baroh kaba dang sah . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Philistia , baroh kiba wan na ki rud duriaw ka Krit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sngi kaba wan ban pynjot ia ki Philistia baroh, bad ban ot noh na Tyros bad u Sidon uwei pa uwei u nongiarap uba sah: namar U Trai un pynjot ia ki Philistia , ia kiba sah jong ka ri Kaphtor .

en: Rise ye up , take your journey , and pass over the river Arnon : behold , I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land : begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .
kha: Hadien ba ngi la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab , U  Trai  u ong ha ngi , ‘ Khreh mynta ban jam ïa ka wah Arnon . Nga la aiti ïa u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon jong ki Amor bad ïa ka hima jong u ha phi . Tur ïaleh ïa u bad kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: To kiew shaneng, to iaid shaphrang ia ka wah Arnon: ha khmih , nga la aiti ha ka kti jong me ia u Amorit , u syiem Hesbon bad ka ri jong u: sdang ban don ia ka, bad ialeh bad u ha ka thma .

en: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall : and they shall fight against thee , but they shall not prevail against thee : for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kynroh da ka rnong tylli ha ka jingïadei bad ki . Kin ïakhun pyrshah ïa me , hynrei kin ym jop ïa me . Ngan long bad me ban ïada ïa me bad sumar pynim ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia me ha une u briew u kynroh ba la khang: bad kin ialeh pyrshah ia me , hynrei kin ym jop ia me: namar nga don ryngkat bad me ban pynim ia me bad ban pyllait im ia me , ong U Trai .

en: And Ittai answered the king , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as my lord the king liveth , surely in what place my lord the king shall be , whether in death or life , even there also will thy servant be .
kha: Hynrei u Ittai u jubab ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , nga smai ha phi ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba ngan ïai leit bad phi kat shaba phi leit , wat la ka dei ban ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Itai u la jubab ia u syiem bad u la ong: Kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba u kynrad jong nga u im, shisha ha kano ka jaka u kynrad jong nga un long, la ka long ha ka jingiap ne ha ka jingim, wat hangta ruh u shakri jong me un long .

en: And he left the oxen , and ran after Elijah , and said , Let me , I pray thee , kiss my father and my mother , and then I will follow thee . And he said unto him , Go back again : for what have I done to thee ?
kha: U Elisha u la iehnoh ïa ki masi dab jong u , u la mareh nadien u Elijah , bad u ong ,  Shah ïa nga ba ngan leit doh bad khublei shuwa ïa i pa bad i mei , bad hadien kata ngan sa leit bad phi .  U Elijah u la jubab ,  Phi lah ban leit . Ngam khang ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U la iehnoh ia ki masi bad u la mareh hadien u Elijah bad u la ong, To ngan, nga kyrpad ia me, nga ai ba ngan kdup ia u kpa jong nga bad ka kmie jong nga, bad nangta ngan bud ia me . Bad u la ong ha u: To leit phai biang: namar nga la leh aiu ia me ?

en: Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?
kha: Ïa u Daniel la wallam shisyndon shapoh sha ka jaka ba don u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u ,  Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jiw uba shah ringmraw ïa uba u kpa jong nga u syiem u la wallam hangne na Judah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta la wanrah ia u Daniel ha khmat u syiem . Bad u syiem u la kren bad u la ong ha u Daniel , Hato me long u Daniel uba long na ki khun jong ka jingshah set jong u Judah , ia uba u syiem jong nga u la wanrah na Judah ?

en: And it came to pass , as they still went on , and talked , that , behold , there appeared a chariot of fire , and horses of fire , and parted them both asunder  ; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven .
kha: Ki ïai ïakren katba ki dang ïaid ; nangta kynsan kynsan ka kali ïapom da ka ding ba la ring da ki kulai ding ka la wan hapdeng jong ki , bad ïa u Elijah la shim noh sha bneng da ka  erlangthari .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang iaid shakhmat, bad ki dang ia kren, ba, ha khmih, ka la paw ka kali ding bad ki kulai ding, bad ka la pyniakhlad ia ki baroh arngut kum ki briew bad u Elijah u la kiew da ka lyer kaba rkhie bein sha bneng .

en: When the king of Babylon s army fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities of Judah that were left , against Lachish , and against Azekah : for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah .
kha: Ka kynhun shipai ka dang tur ïaleh ruh ïa ka Lakhish bad ka Asekah , kiba long tang ma ki kiwei pat ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh kiba dang sah jong ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u syiem Babilon u la ialeh pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem bad pyrshah ia ki nongbah Judah baroh kiba la sah, pyrshah ia ka Lachish bad pyrshah ia ka Azakah: namar kine ki nongbah ba la iada ki sah ha ki nongbah Judah .

en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate , which shall come with an army , and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and shall deal against them , and shall prevail :
kha: Shen hadien kata , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka un long syiem . Un tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem Syria , un rung shapoh ki kut jong ki , bad jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei na ka tnat jong ki tynrai jong ka un ieng ha ka jaka jong u, kaba wan ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai , bad un rung sha ka kut jong u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi , bad un leh pyrshah ia ki:
