en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?
kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbam jong phi bad kiba thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba duk ki bym don ïing . Ai jaiñphong ïa kito ki bym don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kam dei ban ai ia u kpu jong me ha kiba thngan bad ba me wanrah ia kiba duk kiba la bret shabar sha ka iing jong me ? haba me iohi ia kiba lyngkhuid ba me tap ia u ; bad ba me buhrieh ia lade na ka doh jong me hi ?

en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .
kha: To long kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un wan . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaishah haba u ap ïa la ka khyndew ban pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah ban ap ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem .
translated_en_to_kha: To long kiba iaishah namarkata, ko para bangeit, haduh ka jingwan U Trai . Ha khmih u nongrep u ap ia u soh ba kordor jong ka khyndew , bad u don ka jingshaniah kaba slem na ka bynta jong u , haduh ba un da ioh ia u slap uba kloi bad uba hadien .

en: This they shall give , every one that passeth among them that are numbered , half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary : ( a shekel is twenty gerahs : ) an half shekel shall be the offering of the  Lord .
kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shah kynthup ha ka jingkheiñbriew u dei ban siew ïa ka dor ba la buh , kat kum ka jingthew ha ka jaka kyntang , uwei pa uwei un siew ïa kane kum ka jingainguh sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane kin ai , uwei pa uwei uba iaid hapdeng jong ki uba la khein , shiteng Shekel hadien ka Shekel jong ka jaka kyntang: (u Shekel u long arphew gram: ) shiteng Shekel un long ka jingainguh U Trai .

en: Now therefore , what have I here , saith the  Lord  , that my people is taken away for nought ? they that rule over them make them to howl , saith the  Lord   ; and my name continually every day is blasphemed .
kha: Bad mynta ha Babilonia kajuh hi ka la jia ; phi long kiba shahtehmraw , bad ym shym siewdor ei ei na ka bynta jong phi . Kito kiba synshar halor jong phi ki kop bad ki meng bad ki ïai pynpaw jingbeiñ ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta namarkata , nga don aiu hangne , ong U Trai , ba ki briew jong nga ki shah shim noh na ka bynta ka jingbym don ei ei ? kita kiba synshar halor jong ki ki pynlong ia ki ban pyrta , ong u Trai ; bad ka kyrteng jong nga man ka sngi ka shah kren bein bein .

en: And it come to pass , when he heareth the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , I shall have peace , though I walk in the imagination of mine heart , to add drunkenness to thirst :
kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don hangne mynta ka sngi uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jutang , pynban uba pynngeit ïa lade ba kaei kaei kan ym jia ïa u wat la u ïaid mon da ka dohnud kaba mutlop . Ka jingmih na kata kan long ba phi baroh phin jot thiaw , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jia haba u iohsngew ia ki ktien jong kane ka jingtim, ba u kyrkhu ia lade ha ka dohnud jong u, u ong: Ngan ioh ia ka jingsuk wat la nga iaid ha ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong nga, ban pyndap ia ka jingdih buaid ha ka jingthngan:

en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :
kha: Lada don u para Israel uba kyrduh ha kano kano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat khim mynsiem bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don hapdeng jong phi u briew uba duk na ki para jong me hapoh ka ri jong me kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u ai ha me , wat pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong me , lymne wat khang ia ka kti jong me na u hynmen baduk jong me:

en: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod , and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon , and I will turn mine hand against Ekron : and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ngan weng noh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki nongbah ka Ashdod bad ka Ashkelon . Ngan pynshitom ïa ka nongbah Ekron , bad ïa baroh ki Philistia kiba dang sah kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ot noh ia u nongshong shnong na Ashdod bad ia uta uba bat ia u diengduh na Ashkelon bad ngan pynphai ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia u Ekron: bad ki Philistia kiba sah kin jah noh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: There shall be no more praise of Moab : in Heshbon they have devised evil against it  ; come , and let us cut it off from being a nation . Also thou shalt be cut down , O Madmen  ; the sword shall pursue thee .
kha: Ki nongshun ki la knieh ïa ka Heshbon bad ki ïasylla ban pynjot ïa ka hima ki Moab . Ïa ka shnong Madmen yn pynsngap jar ; ki shipai kin tur pyrshah ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don shuh ka jingiaroh ia ka Moab: ha Heshbon ki la thmu ia ka; bad to ngin ot noh ia ka na ka jinglong jaitbynriew . Kumjuh ruh ia me ruh to shah ot noh, ko Madmen; ka waitlam kan bud ia me .

en: And I will clothe him with thy robe , and strengthen him with thy girdle , and I will commit thy government into his hand : and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Judah .
kha: Ngan buh ïa ka jaiñkup bad u panpoh nongpynïaidkam jong me halor jong u bad ngan ai ha u ka iktiar baroh kaba me la don . U , un long kum u kpa ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan phong ia u da ka jainkup jong me, bad ngan pynskhem ia u da ka ryndang jong me, bad ngan aiti ia ka jingsynshar jong me ha ka kti jong u: bad un long u kpa ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem bad ia ka iing u Judah .

en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs , and two clusters of raisins : and when he had eaten , his spirit came again to him : for he had eaten no bread , nor drunk any water , three days and three nights .
kha: ki ai ruh khyndiat ki soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ar rynjup ki soh kismis . Ynda u la dep bam , u la ïohbor biang ; naba um shym la bam la dih ei ei la lai sngi pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ai ia u ia ka cake jong ki sohjew bad ar tylli ki kynhun ki sohjew: bad ynda u la bam , ka mynsiem jong u ka la wan biang ha u: namar um shym la bam ia u kpu , lymne um ei ei ruh em , lai sngi lai miet .

en: To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;
kha: Man ka step bad man ka janmiet kin thang tylli ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan kat kum ba la thoh ha ka Hukum kumba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ban ai ia ki jingknia thang sha U Trai ha ka jingknia thang man ka por mynstep bad janmiet , bad ban leh kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba la thoh ha ka hukum U Trai , kiba u la hukum ia ki Israel;

en: But take heed to yourselves : for they shall deliver you up to councils  ; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten : and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them .
kha: Ma phi ïa lade hi phi dei ban long kiba sumar bha . Phin shah kem bad shah ïalam sha ka ïingbishar . Ïa phi yn sa shoh ha ki synagog ; phin sa ïeng ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem na ka bynta jong nga ban ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khubor Babha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to sumar ia lade: namar kin aiti ia phi sha ki dorbar bad ha ki synagog phin shah shoh: bad phin shah pynngat ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem na ka bynta jong nga, na ka bynta ka jingsakhi pyrshah ia ki .

en: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir , and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim , which is Chesalon , on the north side , and went down to Beth–shemesh , and passed on to Timnah :
kha: ha kaba u tawiar shaphang sepngi jong ka Baalah sha ka ri lum jong ka Edom , ter ter sha ka phang bashatei jong u Lum Jearim ( lane Khesalon ) , arsut sha Beth Shemesh , bad ter ter lyngba ka Timnah .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la iaid lait na Bala shaphang shathie haduh u lum Seir, bad u la iaid lyngba sha ka liang jong u lum Jearim, uba long u Ksalon, shaphang shathie, bad u la hiar sha Betheshemesh, bad u la iaid sha Timna:

en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
kha: U Moses u phai ktien ,  Ngan da sngewbha eh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Buh da ka por lano nga dei ban kyrpad na ka bynta jong phi , na ka bynta ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad na bynta ki briew jong phi . Te phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Pharaoh: To burom ia nga: mynno ngan kyrpad ia me bad ia ki shakri jong me bad ia ki briew jong me ban pynjot ia ki khnai na me bad ki iing jong me, ba kin sah ha ka wah tang ?

en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day , that it may be an holy convocation unto you : ye shall do no servile work therein : it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi , hynrei ïalumlang ban mane Blei . Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh ïa kane ka hukum pateng la pateng shano shano ba ki don .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin pynbna ha kajuh ka sngi, ba kan long ka jingpynbna bakhuid ia phi: phin ym leh ia ka kam kaba rit ha ka: kan long ka ain junom ha ki jaka shong jong phi baroh ha ki pateng jong phi .

en: Then I beheld , and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire : from the appearance of his loins even downward , fire  ; and from his loins even upward , as the appearance of brightness , as the colour of amber .
kha: Nga la khmied bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw ïa ka dur kaba i kum ka durbriew bameh ding . Na ka syngkai sharum , ka met jong u ka long kum ka ding , bad na ka syngkai shaneng , u shat phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la kyrshut phyrnai bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iohi, bad nga la iasyriem kum ka dur jong ka ding: na ka dur jong ki tyrpeng jong u wat shapoh, ka ding ; bad na ki tyrpeng jong u wat shaneng, kum ka dur jong ka jingshai , kum ka rong jong u amber .

en: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .
kha: Ha kawei ka miet hangta ha ka ïingbyndi , uta u nongrah khuri bad u nongshet kpu rangbah ki la phohsniew mar la ka jong ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phohsniew ia ka jingphohsniew jong u baroh arngut, uwei pa uwei u la phohsniew ha kawei ka miet , uwei pa uwei u briew kat kum ka jingbatai jong u , u nongshet bad u nongshet kpu jong u syiem Ijipt kiba la shah teh ha phatok .

en: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests ? therefore it shall be , that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king s house , thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests .
kha: U Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh kin don hangta ; ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïohsngew ha ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hato me don hangta bad me u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki lyngdoh ? namarkata kan long, ba kaei kaei kaba phi iohsngew na ka iing syiem, to iathuh ia ka ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki lyngdoh .

en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt , saying , Let us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians , than that we should die in the wilderness .
kha: Hato ngim shym la ong lypa ha phi shuwa ba ngin mih ba kane kan sa jia ? Ngi la ong ïa phi ban ym pynsalia ïa ngi bad ban shah ïa ngi ban ïailong ki mraw jong ki nong Ijipt . Kan jin da la kham bha ban long ki mraw hangta ban ïa kaba ïap hangne ha ri shyiap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato kane kam dei ka ktien kaba ngi la iathuh ha me ha Ijipt, da kaba ong , To ngin ia marwei, ba ngin shakri ia ki nong Ijipt ? Namar ka la kham bha ia ngi ban shakri ia ki nong Ijipt , ban ia kaba ngi iap ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering , in the holy place : for as the sin offering is the priest s , so is the trespass offering : it is most holy :
kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka kaba kyntang ha kaba la ju pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa ki jingkñia ainguh thang . U dei ban leh ïa kane namar ba ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpalat , kumba long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh , bad ka long kaba khuid bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un pyniap ia u langbrot ha ka jaka ba un pyniap ia ka jingknia pop bad ka jingknia thang: namar kumba ka jingknia pop ka long ka lyngdoh: kumjuh ruh ka jingknia kaba bakla: ka long kaba khuid tam:

en: I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .
kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga ainguh ia me bad nga iaroh ia me, ko Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong nga, uba la ai ia nga ia ka jingstad bad ka bor bad me la pyntip ha nga mynta ia kaei kaba ngi kwah na me: namar me la pyntip mynta ha ngi ia ka kam syiem .

en: And lo Zadok also , and all the Levites were with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God : and they set down the ark of God  ; and Abiathar went up , until all the people had done passing out of the city .
kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh u la don hangta , bad ryngkat bad u la don ki Lebi kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba kyntang . Ki la pynhiar ïa ka bad kim shym la rah shuh tad haduh ba ki briew baroh kin da mihnoh na ka nongbah . U Abiathar , u lyngdoh u la don lang hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Sadok ruh bad ki Lebi baroh ki la don ryngkat bad u, ki la pynhiar ia ka synduk ka jutang U Blei: bad ki la pynhap ia ka synduk U Blei ; bad u Abiatar u la kiew , haduh ba ki briew baroh ki la iaid lait noh na ka shnong .

en: And Sarai said unto Abram , Behold now , the  Lord  hath restrained me from bearing : I pray thee , go in unto my maid  ; it may be that I may obtain children by her . And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai .
kha: Balei mem leit thiah bad ka mraw jong nga ? Lehse ka , ka lah ban ïoh khun ïa nga .  U Abram u la mynjur ïa kaei ba ka Sarai ka ong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sarai u la ong ha u Abram, Ha khmih mynta, U Trai u la khang ia nga ban kha khun: Nga kyrpad ia me, leit sha ka tnga jong nga; ka lah ban long ba ngan ioh khun da ka . Bad u Abram u la sngap ia ka sur jong ka Sarai .

en: Then she runneth , and cometh to Simon Peter , and to the other disciple , whom Jesus loved , and saith unto them , They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre , and we know not where they have laid him .
kha: Ka la leit mareh sha u Simon Petros bad sha uwei pat u synran , uba U Jisu u ieit , bad ka la ïathuh ha ki ,  Ki la ïarah noh ïa U Trai na ka jingtep , bad ngim tip hangno ki la ïabuh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la mareh sha u Simon Petros bad ha uwei pat u synran uba U Jisu u ieit bad u la ong ha ki: Ki la weng noh ia U Trai na ka jingtep bad ngim tip shano ki la buh ia u .

en: And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them , but made himself strange unto them , and spake roughly unto them  ; and he said unto them , Whence come ye ? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .
kha: Haba u Joseph u la ïohi ïa la ki hynmen , bad u la ithuh ïa ki , hynrei u leh kum bym ithuh ïa ki , bad u kren khor ïa ki ,  Phi kiba na-ei ?   Ngi ïawan na ka ri Kanaan , ban thied jingbam ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la iohi ia ki hynmen jong u bad u la ithuh ia ki, hynrei u la kren lyngngoh ia ki, bad u la kren lyngkot ia ki ; bad u la ong ha ki: Naei phi wan ? Ki la ong: Na ka ri Kanaan ban thied jingbam .

en: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods , O Judah  ; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing , even altars to burn incense unto Baal .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Judah ki la don shibun bah ki blei kumba ki la don ki nongbah , bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la pynïeng katta tylli ki duwan na ka bynta ki jingkñia sha uta u blei Baal ba-ijli kat ka jingdon ki lynti hapoh ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kat kum ka jingbun ki nongbah jong me ki long ki blei jong me, ko Judah; bad kat kum ka jingbun ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem phi la buh ia ki nongleh bymman ha kata ka jaka .

en: Now before the feast of the passover , when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father , having loved his own which were in the world , he loved them unto the end .
kha: Ka la dei shi sngi ha shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Jisu u la tip ba ka kynta ka la poi ban iehnoh ïa kane ka pyrthei bad ban leit sha U Kpa . U la ju ieit borabor ïa kito kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba long ki jong u hi , bad u la ieit ïa ki haduh kaba kut .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shuwa ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait im, haba U Jisu u la tip ba ka por jong u ka la poi ba un leit noh na kane ka pyrthei sha U Kpa, haba u la ieit ia la ka jong kaba don ha ka pyrthei , u la ieit ia ki haduh kaba kut .

en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them , and have brought them into the land of their enemies  ; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled , and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity :
kha: bad kiba la pynlong ruh ïa nga ban phai pyrshah ïa ki bad pynsakma ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki . Khatduh , ynda ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki la pyndem rit ïa lade bad ki la shah pynshitom namar ka pop bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ba nga ruh nga la iaid pyrshah ia ki, bad nga la wanrah ia ki ha ka ri jong ki nongshun jong ki ; lada nangta ki dohnud bym pat tyrkhong jong ki ki long kiba la tyrkhong , bad nangta ki pdiang ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingbymhok jong ki:

en: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  to accomplish his vow , or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep , it shall be perfect to be accepted  ; there shall be no blemish therein .
kha: Haba uno uno u kñia ïa ka jingainguh pynïasuk sha U  Trai  , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh kam dei ban don kano kano ka jingduna khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba ai ia ka jingknia jong ki jingainguh jingsuk ha U Trai ban pyndep ia ka jingkular jong u, ne ka jingainguh kaba mon sngewbha ha ki khnai ne ki langbrot , kan long kaba janai ban pdiang; kan ym don jingduna ha ka .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place , and concerning their mothers that bare them , and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land  ;
kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa me kaei ka ban jia ïa ki khynnah kiba la kha hangne bad ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai shaphang ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kiba la kha ha kane ka jaka , bad shaphang ki kmie jong ki kiba kha ia ki , bad shaphang ki kpa jong ki kiba kha ia ki ha kane ka ri;

en: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah , Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth–gilead ? And he answered him , I am as thou art , and my people as thy people  ; and we will be with thee in the war .
kha: U ong ,  Phin leit bad nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?  U Jehoshaphat u jubab ,  Nga long uba la kloi haba phi la kloi , bad kumjuh ruh ka kynhun shipai jong nga . Ngin ïasnohkti lang bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahab u syiem Israel u la ong ha u syiem Judah, Hato me leit ryngkat bad nga sha Ramotgilead ? Bad u la jubab ia u, Nga long kumba me long, bad ki briew jong nga kum ki briew jong me; bad ngin ia don ryngkat bad me ha ka thma .

en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .
kha: Haba u Joseph um sngewlah kun shuh ïa la ka jingsngew ha khmat ki shakri jong u , kumta u la hukum ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym shym don mano mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki hynmen shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joseph um lah ban kiar na lade ha khmat jong u baroh kiba ieng hajan jong u; bad u la pyrta, To mih noh na nga . Bad ym don briew uba ieng bad u, katba u Joseph u la pynpaw ia lade ha ki hynmen jong u .

en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ïa u Ahimelekh u nong Hit bad ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) ,  Mano napdeng jong phi ar ngut ban leit bad nga sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ?   Ma nga ,  u Abishai u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Ahimeel u Hiti bad ha u Abisai u khun jong u Seruiah u hynmen jong u Joab da kaba ong: Mano ba leit hiar ryngkat bad nga sha u Saul sha ka jaka shong jaka sah ? Bad u Abisai u la ong , Ngan leit hiar ryngkat bad me .

en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin , in the strife of the congregation , to sanctify me at the water before their eyes : that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin .
kha: namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh pyrshah ïa ka hukum jong nga ha ka ri khlaw Sin . Haba u paidbah baroh u ïakren khñium ïa nga ha Meribah , phi la kyntait ban pynpaw ïa ka burom kaba kyntang ka jong nga ha khmat jong ki .  ( Ka Meribah ka dei ka umpohliew ha Kadesh ha ka ri khlaw Sin . )
translated_en_to_kha: Namar phi la leh pyrshah ia ka hukum jong nga ha ka ri khlaw Zin, ha ka jingialeh jong ka jingiaseng, ban pynkyntang ia nga ha ka um ha khmat ki: kata ka long ka um Meribah ha Kadesh ha ka ri khlaw Zin .

en: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy , God shall take away his part out of the book of life , and out of the holy city , and from the things which are written in this book .
kha: Bad lada uno uno u shim noh ïa kano kano na ki kyntien jingïathuhlypa jong kane ka kitab , U Blei un shim noh na u ïa ka bhah jong u na u soh jong u dieng ka jingim bad jong ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ïa kiba la batai ha kane ka kitab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew un weng noh ia ki ktien jong kane ka jingiathuhlypa , U Blei un weng noh ia ka bynta jong u na ka Kitab ka jingim bad na ka nongbah bakhuid bad na kiei kiei kiba la thoh ha kane ka kot .

en: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .
kha: Nangta u pud u suh sha u lum shaphang shatei jong ka Ekron , u phai sha ka Shikkeron , lyngba u Lum Baalah , bad ter ter sha Jamnia . U kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian ,
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la mih sha ka liang jong u Ekron shaphang shathie: bad u pud u sam u la iaid sha u Shicron , bad u la iaid ryngkat bad u lum Balah , bad u la leit sha Jabneel ; bad ki jingleit na u pud ki long ha duriaw .

en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them , and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them  ; and they shall come again to me .
kha: Ai ha nga lai ngut ki rangbah na kawei kawei ka jait . Ngan phah ïa ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei bad jurip ïa kata ka jaka kaba kin mon ban ïohkynti . Hadien kata kin wan pat ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai na phi lai ngut ki briew na kawei ka jaitbynriew: bad ngan phah ia ki, bad kin iaid lyngba ia ka ri, bad kin batai ia ka kat kum ka pateng jong ki ; bad kin wan phai biang sha nga .

en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness , and ye believed him not : but the publicans and the harlots believed him : and ye , when ye had seen it , repented not afterward , that ye might believe him .
kha: Naba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan ha phi da kaba pyn-i ha phi ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba dei , bad phim shym la ngeit ïa u ; hynrei ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki la ngeit ïa u . Wat haba phi la ïohi ïa kane , phim shym la kylla ïa la ki jingmut hadien bad ngeit ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u loannis u la wan sha phi ha ka lynti jong ka hok, bad phim ngeit ia u: hynrei ki nongkhaii bad ki nongkhaii ki ngeit ia u: bad phi, haba phi la iohi ia ka, phim shym la kylla bamut hadien kata, ba phin ngeit ia u .

en: And they shall be as mighty men , which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle : and they shall fight , because the  Lord  is with them , and the riders on horses shall be confounded .
kha: Ki paid Judah kin jop kum ki shipai kiba kyrdem ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ktieh jong ki lynti bah . Kin ïaleh namar U  Trai  u don bad ki , bad kin jop wat ïa ka kynhun shipai shong kulai jong u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin long kum ki briew kiba khlain bor, kiba iaid shapoh ki nongshun jong ki ha ka dewbilat jong ki surok ha ka thma: bad kin ialeh , namar U Trai u don ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshong kulai kin shah pynjah burom .

en: For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .
kha: Haba ka jingjot ka wan bad ïa ki briew la pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin lumlang ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep hangta ha Memphis ! Ki jingdon jingem jong ki kum ka rupa bad ki jaka ha kaba ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la ïeng yn tap da ki ñiut bad ki bniap shiah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, ki la jah noh namar ka jingpynjot: Ka Ijipt kan lum ia ki: ki jaka ba sngewtynnad na ka bynta ka rupa jong ki: ki bniat kin don ia ki: ki bniat kin don ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .

en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?
kha: Ki rangbah ka Judah ki jubab ,  Ngi leh ïa kata namar ba u syiem u long uwei na ngi . Balei kane kan pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka bynta ka bam jong ngi lane um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah ki la jubab ia ki briew Israel: Namar u syiem u long uba hajan jong ngi: namarkata phi bitar ia kane ka kam ? hato ngi la bam ia ka dor jong u syiem baroh ? lane u la ai ia ngi ia ka jingai sngewbha ?

en: The gold for things of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers . And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the  Lord  ?
kha: bad na ka bynta ki tiar ki tar baroh kiba ki nong-ohdur ki dei ban shna . Mynta mano pat ba mon ban ai kylluid mynsiem sha U  Trai  ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ksiar na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba rupa bad na ka bynta ki kam baroh kiba la shna da ki kti jong ki nongshna tiar . Bad mano te uba kloi ban pynkyntang ia ka jingshakri jong u ha kane ka sngi ha U Trai ?

en: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout , they said , What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews ? And they understood that the ark of the  Lord  was come into the camp .
kha: Ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingrisa bad ki ong ,  Sngap ïa kata ka jingrisa baroh ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ! Ka mut aïu kata ?  Haba ki shem ba ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ka la poi ha ka jaka shong dara ki Hebru ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka jingsawa , ki la ong , Kaei ka jingsawa kaba khraw ha ka jaka sah jong ki Hebru ? Ki la sngewthuh ba ka synduk U Trai ka la wan shapoh ka jaka sah .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up upon the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail hath left .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti halor ka ri Ijipt ban wallam ïa ki puit . Kin wan bad bam ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba mih , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba lait na u phria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me halor ka ri Ijipt na ka bynta ki khnai , ba kin wan sha jrong ha ka ri Ijipt bad kin bam ia u jingthung baroh jong ka ri .

en: And David said to all the congregation , Now bless the  Lord  your God . And all the congregation blessed the  Lord  God of their fathers , and bowed down their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  , and the king .
kha: Nangta u Dabid u la hukum ïa u paidbah ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi !  Bad kiba la ïalumlang baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki la pyndem la ki khlieh bad ai burom ïa U  Trai  bad ruh ïa u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha ka jingiaseng baroh , Mynta to kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong phi . Bad ka jingiaseng baroh ka la kyrkhu ia U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki, bad ki la dem khrup ia ki khlieh jong ki, bad ki la mane ia U Trai bad ia u syiem .

en: Take ye wives , and beget sons and daughters  ; and take wives for your sons , and give your daughters to husbands , that they may bear sons and daughters  ; that ye may be increased there , and not diminished .
kha: To ïashongkurim bad to ïoh ki khun ki kti . Nangta shah ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban shongkurim , ba kumta ma ki ruh kin don ki khun ki kti . Phi dei ban roi ha ka jingbun briew bad ym ban duna .
translated_en_to_kha: To shim ia ki tnga bad ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong phi; bad to shim ia ki tnga jong phi bad ai ia ki khun kynthei jong phi ha ki tnga jong phi, ba kin kha khun shynrang bad kynthei; ba phin nang kiew hangta, bad ym duna .

en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .
kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jong u , u nongpynjot jong ki jaitbynriew u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Judah . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano bashong ba sah ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U sing u wan shaneng na ka thliew jong u, bad u nongpynjot ia ki Jutang u don ha ka lynti jong u ; u la leit noh na ka jaka jong u ban pynlong ia ka ri jong me kaba la jot; bad ki nongbah jong me kin sa jah rngai noh .

en: When I shall bring again their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat — ïa ka Sodom bad ki nongrit jong ka bad ka Samaria bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ho-oid ngan pynmanbha ïa pha ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda nga la wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong ki, ka jinglong mraw jong ka Sodom bad ki khun kynthei jong ka, bad ka jinglong mraw jong ka Samaria bad ki khun kynthei jong ka, te ngan wanrah biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong me hapdeng jong ki:

en: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
kha: Kito sha kiba u ju phai khmat bunsien na ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , u Meres , u Marsena bad u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba bat ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba bud ia u ka long ka Karshena, u Shethar, u Adma, u Tarshish, u Meres, u Marsena, bad u Memucan, ki hynriew ngut ki syiem ka Persia bad ka Media, kiba la iohi ia ka khmat u syiem, bad kiba la shong nyngkong eh ha ka hima ; )

en: And he said unto them ,  Go .  And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ; kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh kawei ka la mareh arsut ïa ka riat jong ka synrang shapoh ka duriaw bad ka la ïap jyllop .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To leit noh. Bad haba ki la mih shabar , ki la leit sha ka kynhun sniang: bad , ha khmih , ka kynhun sniang baroh kawei ka la mareh stet shapoh duriaw .

en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .
kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uta u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: U lyngdoh un shim ia ka snam jong ka jingknia pop da ka kti jong u bad un theh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka jingknia thang , bad un theh ia ka snam jong u ha trai jong ka jingknia thang .

en: And it was so , when they saw that there was much money in the chest , that the king s scribe and the high priest came up , and they put up in bags , and told the money that was found in the house of the  Lord .
kha: Man ba la don shibun ka pisa ha ka synduk , u sekretari ka ïingsyiem bad u Rangbah Lyngdoh ki wan , ki pynum ïa ka rupa , bad thew ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta haba ki la iohi ba ka don ka pisa kaba bun ha ka shyntur , ba u nongthoh syiem bad u rangbah lyngdoh ki la wan shaneng , bad ki la buh ha ki pla bad ki la iathuh ia ka pisa kaba la lap ha ka iing U Trai .

en: And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .
kha: Kham hadien , u Joab bad ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la wan phai na kaba leit lute , ki da wanrah shikatdei ka mar lute bad ki . Hynrei u Abner um don shuh bad u Dabid hangta ha Hebron , namar u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ki shakri u Dabid bad u Joab ki la wan na kaba bud ia ka kynhun shipai, bad ki la wanrah ia ka jinglute kaba khraw bad ki: hynrei u Abner um shym la don bad u Dabid ha Hebron ; namar u la phah noh ia u; bad u la leit noh da kaba suk .

en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence , and the valley of Achor for a door of hope : and she shall sing there , as in the days of her youth , and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Ngan ai pat ha ka ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka Them Jingshitom sha ka khyrdop ka jingkyrmen . Hangta kan sa phai ktien ïa nga kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , mynba ka wan mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan ai ia ki kper sohjew jong ka naduh kata ka por, bad ka them Achor na ka bynta ka jingkyrmen: bad kan rwai hangta kumba ha ki sngi samla jong ka, bad kumba ha ka sngi ba ka la mih na ka ri Ijipt .

en: And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .
kha: U khur ïa kata ka ngap ha la ka kti bad u da bam ïa ka katba u dang ïaid ha la ka lynti . Nangta u leit sha la u kpa bad sha la ka kmie bad u ai ïa ki mar khyndiat . Ki bam ïa ka , hynrei u Samson um shym ïathuh ha ki ba u la shim ïa kata ka ngap na ka metïap u sing .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka ha ki kti jong u, bad u la leit bam, bad u la wan sha la u kpa bad ka kmie, bad u la ai ia ki, bad ki la bam: hynrei um shym la iathuh ha ki ba u la shim ia ka umsoh na ka met jong u sing .

en: Likewise , ye husbands , dwell with them according to knowledge , giving honour unto the wife , as unto the weaker vessel , and as being heirs together of the grace of life  ; that your prayers be not hindered .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phi ki shynrang to da shong ryngkat bad la ki tnga da ka jingshemphang ba dei biang ba ki long kiba kham tlot ban ïa phi . To ñiewburom ïa ki , namar ki ruh kin ïohpdiang , lem bad phi , ka jingim kaba long ka jingai jong U Blei . To leh ïa kane ba kan ym don kano kano ka ban tuklar ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh phi ki tnga, to shong bad ki katkum ka jingtip, da kaba ai burom ia ka tnga, kumba ka long ka khiew kaba kham tlot, bad kum ki nongioh pateng lang ia ka jingaiei jong ka jingim; ba ki jingduwai jong phi kin ym shah khanglad .

en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .
kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kum ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbynta ïa ka ha ki lyngkhot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait . Kumta ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Joshua u la shim ia ka ri baroh kawei katkum ka jingkren jong U Trai ha u Moses bad u Joshua u la ai ia ka kum ka pateng ha ki Israel katkum ka jingphiah jong ki da ki jaitbynriew jong ki . Bad ka ri ka la shongthait na ka thma .

en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .
kha: Ki sngi ki la poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba u kew un san stet ban ïa kaba lah ban ot , bad ki sohwaiñ kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban shna . Ki lumbah kin jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ki sngi ki wan, ong U Trai, ba u nongrep un jop ia u nongot, bad u nongrep u bet ia u symbai ; bad ki lum kin pynhap ia ka wain kaba thiang, bad ki lum baroh kin sa rkhiang .

en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning , behold , the altar of Baal was cast down , and the grove was cut down that was by it , and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built .
kha: Haba ki briew ha ka nongrit ki khie dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki shem ba ka duwan ïa u Baal bad ka dak jong ka Asherah la pynkhyllem , bad ba la thang ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar halor ka duwan ïa kaba la tei hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki briew jong ka shnong ki la ieng dang step , ha khmih la pynhap ia ka jingkhang jong u Baal bad la ot ia u khlaw uba don hajan jong ka .

en: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying , Fear not to serve the Chaldeans : dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you .
kha: U Gedalaïah u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ai ïa phi ïa la ka ktien ba kam donkam ïa phi ban sheptieng ban pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , to shongduh ha kane ka ri , to shakri ïa u syiem ka Babilonia , bad baroh kan bha ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gedaliah u khun u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan u la sngap jar ia ki bad ia ki briew jong ki: Wat tieng ban shakri ia ki Khaldi: shong ha ka ri bad shakri ia u syiem Babilon bad kan long kaba bha bad phi .

en: And the  Lord  shall make thee plenteous in goods , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy ground , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
kha: U  Trai  un ai ha phi kyrhai ki khun ki kti , kyrhai ki masi , bad kyrhai ki soh ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynlong ia me uba bun ha ki mar ki mata, ha u soh jong ka met jong me, bad ha u soh jong ka khyndew jong me, ha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me ban ai ia me .

en: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour s wife , neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour s house , his field , or his manservant , or his maidservant , his ox , or his ass , or any thing that is thy neighbour s .
kha: ‘ Wat ikwah ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; wat ikwah ïa ka ïing jong u , ïa ka jaka jong u , ïa ki mraw jong u , ïa ki masi jong u , ïa ki kada jong u , lane ïa kaei kaei kaba dei ka jong u .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat kwah ia ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong me, lane wat kwah ia ka iing jong u paramarjan jong me, ne ia u nongtrei jong u, ne ia u nongtrei jong u, ne ia ka masi jong u, ne ia kaei kaei kaba long u paramarjan jong me.

en: And thou shalt hear what they say  ; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host . Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host .
kha: Men sa ïohsngew aïu ki ïakren , bad nangta men ïoh ka jingshlur ban tur ïaleh .  Kumta u Gideon bad u Purah u shakri jong u ki leit hiar sha ka tduh jong ka jaka sher dara jong ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban iohsngew ia kaei kaba ki ong ; bad hadien kata ki kti jong me kin nang khlain ban hiar sha ka kynhun shipai . Nangta u la leit hiar bad u shakri jong u shabar jong ki shipai kiba don ha ka kynhun shipai .

en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .
kha: uba la kha nyngkong da kaba phin ai pat da u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka jong u . Lada phim thied biang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Thied biang ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong jong phi .  Uno uno ruh , um dei ban wan ha khmat jong nga khlem ka jingainguh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ia u khun nyngkong jong u kada men siew kylliang da u langbrot: bad lada phim siew kylliang ia u , te men pynpra ia ka ryndang jong u . Baroh ki khun nyngkong jong me men siew kylliang . Bad ym don mano mano ruh ban paw ha khmat jong nga thylli .

en: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets , nor to your diviners , nor to your dreamers , nor to your enchanters , nor to your sorcerers , which speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon :
kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi lane ïa uno uno uba kam ba u lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa la lawei , la ka long da ki jingphohsniew lane da kaba khot ïa ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap lane da ka myntor . Ma ki baroh kim ong ïa phi ban pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat sngap ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong phi, ne ia ki nongleh jadu jong phi, ne ia ki nongleh jadu jong phi, ne ia ki nongleh jadu jong phi kiba kren ha phi, ki ong ha phi: Phin ym shakri ia u syiem Babilon:

en: And unto Sarah he said , Behold , I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver : behold , he is to thee a covering of the eyes , unto all that are with thee , and with all other : thus she was reproved .
kha: Ha ka Sarah pat u ong ,  Ngan ai ha u hynmen jong pha shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka jingpynshisha ha baroh kiba ïadon lem bad pha ba pha long kaba lui lui ; uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba pham shym la leh bakla .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha ka Sarah u la ong: Ha khmih nga la ai ia u hynmen jong me shi hajar tylli ki rupa: ha khmih, u long ha me ka jingtap ia ki khmat, ha baroh kiba don bad me, bad bad kiwei pat: kumta la pynrem ia ka .

en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew , Behold , I have given Esther the house of Haman , and him they have hanged upon the gallows , because he laid his hand upon the Jews .
kha: U syiem Serksis nangta u ong ha ka Esther ka mahadei bad u Mordekai , u Jiw ,  Peit , nga la sdien phasi ïa u Haman na ka bynta ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa ki Jiw , bad nga la ai ha ka Esther ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem Ahasaerus u la ong ha ka mahadei bad ha u Mordecai u Jiw , Ha khmih nga la ai ia ka iing u Haman bad ia u ki la shong ha ki diengsoh namar u la buh ia la ka kti halor ki Jiw .

en: And they shall deal with thee hatefully , and shall take away all thy labour , and shall leave thee naked and bare : and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered , both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .
kha: Bad namar ba ki isih ïa pha , kin shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la trei na ka bynta kita bad kin ieh lyngkhuit bad thad ïa pha kum ka nuti . Ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha ki la wanrah ïa kane ha pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin leh ia me da ka jingshun, bad kin weng noh ia ka jingtrei shitom jong me baroh: bad ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ki jingkhaii met jong me kan sa paw , baroh ar ka jingleh be-ijot jong me bad ki jingkhaii met jong me .

en: And as he talked with them , behold , there came up the champion , the Philistine of Gath , Goliath by name , out of the armies of the Philistines , and spake according to the same words : and David heard them .
kha: Katba u dang ïakren bad ki , u Goliath u mih sha khmat bad u kob ïa ki Israel kumba u la leh mynshuwa . Bad u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang ia kren bad ki, ha khmih, u la wan shaneng u nongjop, u Philistia u Gath, u Goliath da ka kyrteng, na ki shipai Philistia, bad u la kren kat kum kita ki kyntien: bad u Dabid u la iohsngew ia ki .

en: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living : and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword , even Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u syiem Ijipt ba un pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im , hynrei ma u bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kin shah pynïap bad kin thiah ha ka jingjahthait lem bad baroh kiba khlem otsher kiba ïap ha ka thma ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga la pynlong ia ka jingtieng jong nga ha ka ri jong kiba im: bad un sa shah set hapdeng ki bym pat shah ot bad ki kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam, wat u Pharaoh bad u paidbah jong u baroh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;
kha: ban kitkhlieh ha kaba peit ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei , ïa u  purew ba la ju pyndonkam ha ki jingainguh , ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ïa ki jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u  purew ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang Olib , ban thew ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ar na ka bynta u kpu ba la shet, bad na ka bynta ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta ka jingainguh doh, bad na ka bynta kata kaba la shet ha ka pan, bad na ka bynta kata kaba la shet, bad na ka bynta ka jingthew bad ka jingheh baroh;

en: And David said to Abner , Art not thou a valiant man ? and who is like to thee in Israel ? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king ? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Abner , hato mem dei u briew uba khraw tam ha Israel ? Haba kumta , balei mem ïada ïa u syiem , u kynrad jong me ? Myntan uwei u briew u la ïohrung ha ka ïing dara ban pynïap ïa u syiem kynrad jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Abner, Hato me long u briew uba shlur ? bad mano ba long kum ma me ha Israel ? namar kata me la sumar ia u kynrad jong me ? namar uwei na ki briew u la wan ban pynjot ia u kynrad jong me .

en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .
kha: Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh na ki jaka baseisoh jong ka Moab . Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot waiñ ; ym don shuh mano mano ba shna ïa ka waiñ bad ban pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen ka long na ka lyngkha kaba bun, bad na ka ri Moab bad nga la pynlong ia ka wain ban jah noh na ki thliew sohjew: ym don ba iaid ryngkat bad ka jingpyrta ; jong ki kan ym long kaba pyrta .

en: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the sons of the king , and Abiathar the priest , and Joab the captain of the host : but Solomon thy servant hath he not called .
kha: U la ai ka jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid , bad u la khot sngewbha ruh sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , hynrei ïa u Solomon u khun jong phi um shym la khot .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyniap ia ki masi bad ki langbrot kiba heh ha ka jingbun paid, bad u la khot ia ki khun shynrang baroh, bad u Abiatar u lyngdoh bad u Joab u rangbah shipai: hynrei u Solomon u shakri jong me um shym la khot ia u .

en: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .
kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kylliang bad wat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïoh ka bainong kaba khraw , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh . Naba u long uba bha ïa u bymsngewnguh bad ïa uba bymman .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ieit ia ki nongshun jong phi, bad to leh bha, bad ai ram, da kaba kyrmen ei ei shuh bad ka bainong jong phi kan long kaba khraw, bad phin long ki khun jong Uba ha khlieh duh: namar u long uba sbun ia ki bym don jingsngewnguh bad ia kiba sniew .

en: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon : and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men  ; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom , and slew two thousand men of them .
kha: Kiba sah ki phai bad phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon . San hajar ngut na kita ki shah pynïap ha lynti bah . Ki Israel ki ïai beh ïa kiba dang sah haduh Gidom , ki da pynïap ar hajar ngut na kita .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phai bad ki la phet noh sha ka ri khlaw sha u mawsiang jong ka rimmon : bad ki la lum lang ia ki ha ki surok bah san hajar ngut ki briew; bad ki la beh jur ia ki haduh Gidom .

en: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rab–shakeh .
kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ki leit bad ïathuh sha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar ka Assyria u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah uba la long halor ka iing, bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad u Joah u khun u Asaph u nongthoh kot, ha u Hesekaiah da ki jain jong ki, bad u la iathuh ha u ia ki ktien u Rabsakeh .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .
kha: U  Trai  u ïakren markhmat bad u Moses , kumba u briew u ïakren bad la u paralok . Nangta u Moses u leit phai sha ka jaka sher dara . Hynrei u samla , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u , u shongsah ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses khmat ha khmat, kumba u briew u kren ha u paralok jong u . Bad u la phai biang sha ka jaka shong jaka sah: hynrei u shakri jong u u Joshua u khun u Nun u samla u khlem mih na ka iingjain .

en: And it came to pass , when they had brought them forth abroad , that he said , Escape for thy life  ; look not behind thee , neither stay thou in all the plain  ; escape to the mountain , lest thou be consumed .
kha: Uwei na kita ki angel u ong ,  Phet ïap noh ! Wat kyrtiang dien bad wat sangeh ha ka them . Phet ïap sha ki lum , ba phin ym shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki la wanrah ia ki shabar ri, ba u la ong, To phet noh na ka bynta ka jingim jong me ; wat peit shadien jong me, lymne me sah ha ka madan baroh kawei; to phet noh sha u lum .

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me  ; This gate shall be shut , it shall not be opened , and no man shall enter in by it  ; because the  Lord  , the God of Israel , hath entered in by it , therefore it shall be shut .
kha: Ka khyrdop ka khang , bad U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kane ka khyrdop kan long ba la khang bad yn ym plie lano lano ruh . Yn ym don u briew ïa uba yn shah ban plie ïa ka , namar ma nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la rung lyngba jong ka . Kan sah ba la khang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga; Kane ka khyrdop kan ym plie, bad ym don mano mano ruh ban rung da ka ; namar ba U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u la rung da ka; namarkata kan khang .

en: And he took away the strange gods , and the idol out of the house of the  Lord  , and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the  Lord  , and in Jerusalem , and cast them out of the city .
kha: U pynkynriah na ka Templ ïa ki blei nongwei bad ïa ka durblei kaba u la buh hangta , bad ki duwan ki blei thala kiba la don halor u lum ha kaba ka Templ ka la ïeng bad ha kiwei ki jaka ha Jerusalem ; u kit lut ïa kine kiei kiei shabar ka nongbah bad u bret lut ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la weng noh ia ki blei nongwei bad ia ka bleithaw na ka iing U Trai bad ki nongleh niam baroh kiba u la tei ha u lum jong ka iing U Trai bad ha Jerusalem bad u la bret noh ia ki na ka nongbah .

en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .
kha: bad u syiem Jehoïakhin lem bad ka kmie jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar u Nebukhadnessar u la shim koidi ïa u Jehoïakhin
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehoichin u syiem Judah u la leit sha u syiem Babilon , ma u bad ka kmie jong u bad ki shakri jong u bad ki rangbah jong u: bad u syiem Babilon u la shim ia u ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
kha: U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Rehum , u lat , ha u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , bad ha ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha kiba sah jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , ki jingkhublei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la phah ia u syiem ia ka jubab sha u Rehum u nongthoh khubor bad ha u Shimshai u nongthoh khubor bad ha kiwei pat ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha kiwei pat sha shiliang wah , Ka jingsuk bad ha kum kata ka por .

en: But camest back , and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place , of the which the  Lord  did say to thee , Eat no bread , and drink no water  ; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers .
kha: Pynban , phi la wan phai bad phi bam phi dih ha ka jaka ha kaba u la khang ïa phi ban bam ban dih . Namar kane yn sa pynïap ïa phi , bad ïa ka met jong phi yn ym tep ha ka jingtep ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to wan phai biang, bad phi la bam ia u kpu bad dih ia ka um ha kata ka jaka, na kaba U Trai u la ong ha me: Wat bam ia u kpu bad wat dih um; ka met jong me kan ym wan sha ka jingtep jong ki kpa tymmen jong me .

en: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him ? be it far from me : let not the king impute any thing unto his servant , nor to all the house of my father : for thy servant knew nothing of all this , less or more .
kha: Ho-oid , nga la kylli na U Blei na ka bynta jong u , bad kam shym dei ka sien banyngkong . Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , wat ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un kynnoh ïa nga lane ïano ïano na ka longïing jong nga . Ngam tip ei ei shaphang kane !
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la sdang ban kylli ia U Blei na ka bynta jong u ? to long kiba jngai na nga: wat ai ba u syiem un ym shim ei ei ia u shakri jong u, ne ia ka iing jong u kpa jong nga baroh: namar u shakri jong me um tip ei ei na kine baroh, kham duna ne kham bun .

en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin , in any sin that he sinneth : at the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall the matter be established .
kha: Kam biang tang uwei u sakhi ban rai pynrem ïa u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka kam palat ; la kumno kumno , ar ngut ki sakhi ki dei ban pynsabut ba u briew u leh kam sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u sakhi un ym kiew pyrshah ia u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbymhok ne na ka bynta kano kano ka pop kaba u leh: ha ka shyntur jong ki arngut ki sakhi ne ha ka shyntur jong ki lai ngut ki sakhi .

en: And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .
kha: Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban pynjot thiaw kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai . Tang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka yn pyllait im , namar ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka shnong kan shah tim, wat ia ka, bad baroh kiba don ha ka, ha U Trai: tang ka Rahab ka nongkhaii met kan im , ma ka bad baroh kiba don bad ka ha iing , namar ka la buhrieh ia ki nonglam khubor kiba ngi la phah .

en: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper , as he sat at meat , there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious  ; and she brake the box , and poured it on his head .
kha: U Jisu u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing u Simon , u briew uba pang  ñiangthohlieh . Katba U Jisu u dang bam , kawei ka kynthei ka la wan shapoh ryngkat bad ka dabi alabastar ba la dap da ka jingsleh iwbih baremdor haduh katta katta na u nard bakynsai . Ka la pynpait ïa ka dabi bad ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka khlieh U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u don ha Bethania ha ka iing u Simon u nongpang niangthohlieh, katba u dang shong ha ka doh, ka la wan kawei ka kynthei kaba don ka synduk kaba don ka umphniang kaba la khleh lang bad ka la bret ia ka synduk kaba kordor bha; bad ka la theh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u .

en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath–jearim , who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :
kha: ( La don uwei pat u briew , u Uriah u khun jong u Shemaïah na Kiriath Jearim , uba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  pyrshah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ka jaitbynriew kumba u Jeremaïah u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad don ruh uwei u briew uba la iathuhlypa ha ka kyrteng U Trai , u Urijah u khun u Shemaiah jong ka Kirjathjaram , uba la iathuhlypa pyrshah ia kane ka shnong bad pyrshah ia kane ka ri kat kum ki ktien baroh jong u Jeremaiah:

en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
kha: Nabynta kaei nga ruh nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga dap da ka jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban sumar skhem haduh kata ka Sngi ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta kata kaba nga ruh nga shah shitom ia kine kiei kiei: wat la katta ruh ngam sngewlehrain: namar nga tip ia uba nga la ngeit , bad nga sngewskhem ba u lah ban bat ia kata kaba nga la aiti ha u ha kata ka sngi .

en: But I said , How shall I put thee among the children , and give thee a pleasant land , a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations ? and I said , Thou shalt call me , My father  ; and shalt not turn away from me .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel , nga la kwah ban pdiang ïa pha kum u khun jong nga bad ai ha pha ïa ka ri kaba pynkmen , ka ri kaba itynnat tam ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Nga la kwah ïa pha ban khot pa ïa nga bad ban ym phai shuh da lei lei na nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong , Kumno ngan buh ia me hapdeng ki khun bad ngan ai ia me ia ka ri kaba sngewbha, ka pateng kaba bha jong ki jaitbynriew ? bad nga la ong , Me dei ban khot ia nga , ko kpa jong nga; bad wat phai noh na nga .

en: And there came an angel of the  Lord  , and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah , that pertained unto Joash the Abi–ezrite : and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress , to hide it from the Midianites .
kha: Nangta u angel jong U  Trai  u la wan sha ka nongrit Ophrah bad u shong ha trai u dieng Sning jong u Joash , u briew na ka kur u Abieser . U Gideon u khun jong u , u dang shoh kew jar jar ha ka thliew khem um sohwaiñ , khnang ba ki Midian kin ym ïohi ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel jong U Trai u la wan shong hapoh u diengsoh uba don ha Ophrah: bad u khun jong u u Gideon u la kheit ia u kew da u sohjew , ban buhrieh ia u na ki nong Ijipt .

en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;
kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u kpa jong u ,  Nga dei ban leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba ki hynmen ki para jong nga bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem i pa kiba shong ha Kanaan ki la wan poi sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joseph u la ong ha ki hynmen jong u bad ha ka iing u kpa jong u, ngan leit shaneng, bad ngan pyni ia u Pharaoh, bad ngan ong ha u, ki hynmen jong nga bad ka iing u kpa jong nga kiba don ha ka ri Kanaan, ki wan sha nga;

en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Entreat the  Lord  , that he may take away the frogs from me , and from my people  ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the  Lord .
kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron , bad u ong ,  To kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki jakoid , bad ngan sa pyllait ïa ki briew jong phi ba kin ïoh kñia ainguh ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u la khot ia u Moses bad u Aaron bad u la ong: To sngewbha ia U Trai, ba un weng noh ia ki khnai na nga bad na ki briew jong nga; bad ngan pyllait noh ia ki briew, ba kin leh ia ka jingknia ha U Trai .

en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Koz . And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabeel . And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah .
kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshesabel u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sadok , u khun jong u Baana u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong ki u la pynbha ia u Merem u khun jong u Uri, u khun jong u Koz . Bad hadien jong ki u la pynbha ia u Meshullam u khun u Beriah u khun u Mesabel . Bad hadien jong ki u la pynbha ia u Sadok u khun u Baah .

en: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .
kha: Kumta u syiem Sedekaïah u la kular ïa nga ha kaba rieh ,  Nga smai da U Blei uba im , U Blei uba ai jingim ïa ngi , ba ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lane ai noh ïa phi sha ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Sedekaiah u syiem u la sngap jar ha u Jeremaiah, u da ong: Kumba U Trai u im, uba la pynlong ia ngi ia kane ka mynsiem , ngan ym pyniap ia me , lymne ngan ym aiti ia me ha ka kti jong kine ki briew kiba wad ia ka jingim jong me .

en: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest , and commanded them , saying , Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead with the edge of the sword , with the women and the children .
kha: Kumta ka jingïalang ka phah khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah bashlur tam lem bad ka hukum ,  Khie leit bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ha Jabesh , kaba kynthup ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingiaseng ka la phah ia ki shiphew hajar ngut ki briew kiba shlur tam, bad ka la hukum ia ki, da kaba ong: To leit bad pyniap ia ki nongshong shnong jong u Jabesh ؔlid da ka tduh jong ka waitlam, bad ki kynthei bad ki khun .

en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .
kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynlut ïa ka bainong jong phi bad ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei phi pynlut pisa na ka bynta kata kaba ym long u kpu ? bad ka jingtrei shitom jong phi na ka bynta kata kaba ym pynhun ? sngap jar ia nga , bad bam ia kata kaba bha , bad to ai ba ka mynsiem jong phi kan sngewbha ia lade ha ka jingbun snam .

en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :
kha: Khie leit sha ki Lum Abarim kiba ha ka ri Moab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki paid Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: To kiew sha une u lum Abarim, haduh u lum Nebo, uba don ha ka ri u Jerikhoi; bad ha khmih ka ri Kanaan kaba nga ai ha ki khun Israel:

en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude  ; and their camels were without number , as the sand by the sea side for multitude .
kha: Ki Midian , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki la saphriang ha ka them kum ka kynhun ki puit , bad ki la don bun bah ki ut kat ki symboh shyiap ka rud duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Midian bad ki khun shynrang baroh ki la thiah ha ka them kum ki khlaw na ka bynta ka jingbun paid bad ki kulai jong ki ki long ki bym don jingkhein shuh, kum ka dewbilat ha rud duriaw na ka bynta ka jingbun paid .

en: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king s name , and seal it with the king s ring : for the writing which is written in the king s name , and sealed with the king s ring , may no man reverse .
kha: Hynrei ka jingpynbna ba la dep pynmih ha ka kyrteng u syiem bad ba la shon da ka muhor syiem , ym lah ban pynkylla . Phi lah pat ban thoh sha ki Jiw ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah ; bad phi lah ban thoh ïa ka ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad shon ïa ka da ka muhor syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Thoh ruh ia ki Jiw kumba phi sngewtynnad, ha ka kyrteng syiem, bad to buh ia ka da ka ryntieh syiem: namar ka jingthoh kaba la thoh ha ka kyrteng syiem, bad la khang da ka ryntieh syiem, ym don mano mano ruh kiba kylla .

en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel s ,
kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  bad nga ong ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing ne ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei lane ka kmie lane u kpa lane ki khun lane ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka gospel , un ïohpdiang kham palat ha kane ka pateng ba mynta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la jubab bad u la ong ha phi, Hooid ngam don briew uba la iehnoh ia ka iing ne ki hynmen ne ki para ne ki kmie ne ki kmie ne ki khun ne ki jaka na ka bynta jong nga bad ka gospel s .

en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .
kha: Te u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli ,  Nangno kine ki briew ki wan bad kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ?  U Hesekaïah u la jubab ,  Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bha , na Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Isaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la wan sha u syiem Hesekaiah bad u la ong ha u, "Kine ki briew ki la ong aiu ? bad nangno ki la wan sha me ? U Hesekaiah u la ong: Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai sha nga, wat na Babilon .

en: So it came to pass in the day of battle , that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan : but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found .
kha: Bad kumta ha ka sngi ïaleh thma , ym don mano mano na ki shipai Israel uba don waitlam lane sum , lait noh u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ka la jia ha ka sngi thma, ba ym shym la lap ia ka waitlam ne ka khnam ha ka kti jong uno uno na ki briew kiba don bad u Saul bad u Jonathan: hynrei bad u Saul bad u Jonathan u la shem hangta .

en: That their hearts might be comforted , being knit together in love , and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding , to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God , and of the Father , and of Christ ;
kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba yn pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshlur bad ba yn lah ban khring lang ïa ki ha ka jingieit , bad kumta kin ïoh ïa ka jingdap ba-pura ïa ka jingsngewskhem kaba ka jingshemphang ka wallam . Ha kane ka rukom kin tip ïa ka jingmaïan ka jong U Blei , kaba long U Khrist hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki dohnud jong ki kin ioh jingpyntngen, da kaba sngewtynnad ia ka jingieit, bad ha ki spah baroh jong ka jingshaniah kaba pura jong ka jingsngewthuh, ha ka jingpdiang ia ka jingmaham jong U Blei bad jong U Kpa, bad jong U Khrist;

en: And he arose , and went into the house  ; and he poured the oil on his head , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I have anointed thee king over the people of the  Lord  , even over Israel .
kha: Nangta ar ngut na ki , ki leit rung shapoh ïing , bad u nongïathuhlypa samla u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlieh u Jehu , bad u ong ha u ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem jong ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la leit shapoh iing ; bad u la theh ia ka umphniang ha ka khlieh jong u, bad u la ong ha u: Kumta ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la pynsleh ia me syiem halor ki briew jong U Trai, wat halor ki Israel .

en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine , which shall be for their destruction , and which I will send to destroy you : and I will increase the famine upon you , and will break your staff of bread :
kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingwanrah bam ïa pha bad ngan pynshahthngan ïa pha . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingtynrah ka jingthngan kum ki khnam banep ba la siat ban pynjot ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda ngan phah ha ki ia ki khnam kiba sniew jong ki, kiba ngan phah ban pynjot ia phi: bad ngan pynbun ia ka jingkyrduh ha phi: bad ngan pynbun ia ka jingkyrduh ha phi: bad ngan pynpra ia u dieng jong phi:

en: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
kha: khnang ba ym dei shuh ma nga uba im , hynrei dei U Khrist uba im ha nga . Kane ka jingim kaba nga im mynta , nga im da ka jingngeit ha U Khun U Blei , uba la ieit ïa nga bad uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la sahnarphna bad U Khrist: wat la katta ruh nga im; hynrei U Khrist u im ha nga: bad ka jingim kaba nga im mynta ha ka doh nga im da ka jingngeit U Khun U Blei uba la ieit ia nga bad uba la aiti ia lade na ka bynta jong nga .

en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha Jahas ; lah ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha Soar , bad la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Eglath Shelishiyah . Wat ka wahduid Nimrim ka la rngad noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ka jingpyrta jong u Hesbon haduh u Elealeh, bad wat haduh u Jaaz, ki la pynmih ia ka sur jong ki, naduh u Soar haduh Horonaim, kum ka masi kaba dang lai snem: namar ki um ruh jong u Nimrim kin sa jah noh .

en: And see , and , behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances , then come ye out of the vineyards , and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .
kha: Haba ki theisamla na Shiloh ki wan shad ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi to wan mih na kita ki bri sohwaiñ . Uwei pa uwei na phi un shim da ka bor napdeng kita ki theisamla bad ïalam ban long ka tnga jong phi sha ka jaka ki Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad peit, bad, ha khmih, lada ki khun kynthei jong u Shiloh ki mih ban shad ha ki jingshad, te phi mih na ki kper sohjew, bad phi kem ia phi uwei pa uwei u tnga jong u na ki khun kynthei jong u Shiloh, bad leit sha ka ri u Benjamin .

en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and the Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Na u Paul , u Silas , bad u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai : Ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kan long ka jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul bad u Silvanus bad u Timothi ha ka balang jong ki nong Thessaloni kaba don ha U Blei U Kpa bad ha U Trai Jisu Khrist: Ka jingaiei kan long ha phi, bad ka jingsuk, na U Blei U Kpa jong ngi, bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

en: And another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud , Thrust in thy sickle , and reap : for the time is come for thee to reap  ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe .
kha: Nangta uwei pat u angel u la wan mihnoh na ka Templ bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam sha uta uba shong halor u lyoh ,  To pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi bad to ot ïa ka jingot , namar ka por ka la poi ; ka pyrthei ka la ih na ka bynta ka jingot !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u angel u la mih na ka tempi, u da pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ia uta uba shong ha u lyoh: To leit sha ka lyngkhot jong me bad to ot: namar ka por ka la dei na ka bynta jong me ban ot; namar u jingot jong ka khyndew u la san .

en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Haba kha ïa uno uno u khun masi , lane ïa u khunlangbrot , lane ïa u khunblang , ieh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , hynrei hadien kata lah ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba la wanrah ia u masi ne u blang ne u blang , te kan long hynriew sngi hapoh ka dam ; bad naduh ka sngi kaba phra bad nangta yn pdiang ia ka na ka bynta ka jingknia kaba la shna da ka ding sha U Trai .

en: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven , and hath founded his troop in the earth  ; he that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name .
kha: U  Trai  u tei ïa ka ïing jong u ha ki bneng , bad halor ka khyndew u buh ka jingtei jong ka sahit bneng . U khot ïa ki um ka duriaw bad u theh ïa ki ha sla pyrthei . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  !
translated_en_to_kha: Dei ma u uba tei ia ki jingiathuhkhana jong u ha bneng , bad u la seng ia ka kynhun jong u ha ka khyndew ; uta uba khot ia ki um duriaw , bad u theh ia ki shabar ha ka khmat ka khyndew : U Trai u long ka kyrteng jong u .

en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches , and the multitude of his children , and all the things wherein the king had promoted him , and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king .
kha: U la kren sarong ha khmat jong ki kumno ba u long uba riewspah , ba u don bun ki khun shynrang , kumno ba u syiem u la pynkiew ïa u sha ka kyrdan ba-halor , bad kumno ba u long uba kham donkam ban ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Haman u la iathuh ha ki ia ka burom jong ka spah jong u bad ka jingbun ki khun jong u bad kiei kiei baroh ha kaba u syiem u la pynroi ia u bad kumno u la pynkiew ia u halor ki rangbah bad ki shakri jong u syiem .

en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
kha: U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli yn die ha Samaria ha ka dor shi sbai rupa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia kumba u briew jong U Blei u la kren ha u syiem, u da ong: Ar tylli ki nar na ka bynta u Shekel bad kawei ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta u Shekel, kin long ha ka por mynta ha ka khyrdop jong ka Samaria:

en: Howbeit when he , the Spirit of truth , is come , he will guide you into all truth : for he shall not speak of himself  ; but whatsoever he shall hear , that shall he speak : and he will shew you things to come .
kha: Pynban , haba U Mynsiem un wan , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei , un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingshisha baroh . Un ym kren ha ka bor jong u hi , hynrei un kren ïa kaei kaba u ïohsngew , bad un ïathuh ha phi ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ynda ma u, U Mynsiem jong ka jingshisha, un ialam ia phi sha ka jingshisha baroh: namar un ym kren ia lade ; hynrei kaei kaei kaba un iohsngew: bad un pyni ia phi ia kiei kiei ki ban sa wan .

en: The first was like a lion , and had eagle s wings : I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked , and it was lifted up from the earth , and made stand upon the feet as a man , and a man s heart was given to it .
