kha: Uba nyngkong u syriem kum u sing , hynrei u don ki thapniang kum u pukni . Katba nga dang khmih la pynkdiah ïa ki thapniang . Ïa u mradkhlaw la rah shajrong bad la pynlong ïa u ban ïeng kum u briew . Bad nangta la ai ha u ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kum u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba nyngkong ka long kum u sing , bad ka don ki bniat jong u blang: nga la iohi haduh ba la pynkhih ia ki bniat jong ka, bad la pynkiew ia ka na ka khyndew , bad la pynlong ia ka ban ieng ha ki kjat kum u briew , bad la ai ia ka dohnud briew ha ka .

en: And the tale of the bricks , which they did make heretofore , ye shall lay upon them  ; ye shall not diminish ought thereof : for they be idle  ; therefore they cry , saying , Let us go and sacrifice to our God .
kha: Hynrei khmih ba kin shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba mynshuwa ; tang uwei ruh ym dei ban duna . Kim da bunkam eh , bad dei namar kata ba ki ïai kyrpad ïa nga ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ai ki jingkñia sha U Blei jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingiathuhkhana shaphang ki nar kiba ki la shna haduh mynta, phin thiah ha ki ; phin ym duna ei ei: namar ki long kiba khlem akor ; namarkata ki iam , ki ong , To ngin leit bad knia ia U Blei jong ngi .

en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
kha: U Syiem Asa u pynkynriah ïa ka Maakah ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan kum ka syiemsad , namar ka la thaw ka bleithaw kynsha jong ka Asherah ka blei jingseisoh . U Asa u pynpra ïa ka bleithaw , u pyndkut ïa ka , bad u thang ïa ki lyngkhot ha ka them Kidron .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ruh shaphang ka Maah ka kmie jong u Asa u syiem, u la weng noh ia ka na ka jinglong mahadei, namar ba ka la shna bleithaw ha ka khlaw: bad u Asa u la ot ia ka bleithaw jong ka, bad u la thang ia ka ha ka wah Kidron .

en: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man that is my fellow , saith the  Lord  of hosts : smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered : and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  To khie joit , ko waitlam , bad tur ïaleh ïa u nongaplangbrot uba trei na ka bynta jong nga ! Pynïap ïa u , bad ïa ki langbrot yn pynsakma . Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga
translated_en_to_kha: To khie, ko waitlam, pyrshah ia u nongaplangbrot jong nga, bad pyrshah ia u briew uba long u para jong nga: to pynkhih ia u nongaplangbrot: bad ki langbrot kin sa bthei: bad ngan pynphai ia la ka kti ha kiba rit .

en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .
kha: Shisha kumba u symbai u khie lung bad u san , U  Trai  Nongsynshar un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ïaroh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumba ka khyndew ka pynmih ia u soh jong ka, bad kumba ka kper ka pynmih ia kiei kiei kiba la bet ha ka ban mih; kumta U Trai Blei un pynmih ia ka hok bad ka jingiaroh ban mih ha khmat ki jaitbynriew baroh .

en: There is a league between me and thee , as there was between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent thee silver and gold  ; go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .
kha: To ngin ïalong paralok , kumba ki kpa jong ngi ki la ïalong . Kane ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ka jingai sngewbha ïa phi . Mynta pynkheiñ noh ïa ka jingïateh lok bad u Baasha u syiem Israel khnang ba un weng noh ïa ki shipai jong u na ka ri jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingiasoh hapdeng jong nga bad me, kumba ka la long hapdeng u kpa jong nga bad u kpa jong me: ha khmih nga la phah ia me ia ka rupa bad ka ksiar; to leit noh ia ka jingiasoh jong me bad u syiem Israel, ba un leit noh na nga .

en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;
kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la kylla riewspah bha , bad uwei pa uwei u burom ïa u . U don ki kamra kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , ki musla , ki stieh , bad kiwei ki tiar baremdor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la don ka spah bad ka burom kaba palat: bad u la thaw ia lade ia ki spah rupa, bad na ka bynta ka ksiar bad na ka bynta ki maw ba kordor bad na ka bynta ki jingbam ba bang bad na ka bynta ki jingdawa bad na ka bynta ki jingdeng kiba sngewtynnad baroh;

en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , that the mountain of the  Lord s  house shall be established in the top of the mountains , and shall be exalted above the hills  ; and all nations shall flow unto it .
kha: Ha ki sngi ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba da jrong eh halor ki lumrit baroh . Kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kin tuid sha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ki sngi ba khatduh, ba u lum jong ka iing U Trai un sa skhem ha jrong jong ki lum, bad un sa kiew halor ki lum ; bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tuid sha ka .

en: I will bear the indignation of the  Lord  , because I have sinned against him , until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me : he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .
kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , te mynta ngi dei ban ïaishah ïa ka jingbitar jong u shipor . Hynrei ha kaba kut un ïada ïa ngi bad un pynbeit ïa ka bymdei kaba la leh ha ngi . Un wallam ïa ngi shabar sha ka jingshai ; ngin im ban ïohi ba u pyllait im ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan shah ia ka jingbitar U Trai , namar nga la leh pop pyrshah ia u , haduh ba un da kyrpad ia ka daw jong nga bad un pyndep ia ka jingbishar na ka bynta jong nga: un wanrah ia nga sha ka jingshai , bad ngan sa iohi ia ka hok jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi ngan pynïap ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki Israel . Phi dei ban pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Joshua: Wat tieng na ka bynta jong ki: namar ban sngewsih ia kine ki por baroh ngan aiti noh ia ki ha khmat ki Israel: me dei ban thang ia ki kulai jong ki bad thang ia ki kali jong ki da ka ding .

en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served . And he sent to meet them : for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shikatdei ban leit phai sha ïing . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ktien sha ki ba kin sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad haduh ba ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki da san biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la leit thikna, bad u la iathuh ha u Dabid kumno la shakri ia ki briew . Bad u la phah ban iakynduh ia ki: namar ki briew ki la sngewlehrain shibun . Bad u syiem u la ong: To leit sha Jeriko haduh ba ki ryndang jong phi kin san, bad nangta sa wan phai noh .

en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .
kha: kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kata kawei pat kum ka jingainguh thang ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam . Kumne keiñ uta u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la u lah ban ioh, ia kawei na ka bynta ka jingknia pop, bad ia kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingknia thang: bad u lyngdoh un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta uba dei ban pynkhuid ha khmat U Trai .

en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah : there Aaron died , and there he was buried  ; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest s office in his stead .
kha: ( Ki Israel ki mihnoh na ki pukri ki nong Jaakan bad ki leit sha Moserah . Hangta u Aaron u la ïap , bad hangta ruh la tep ïa u , bad u Eleasar u khun jong u , u shim ïa ka jaka jong u kum u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la leit noh na Beroh ki khun u Jaakan haduh Mosrah: hangta u Aaron u la iap , bad hangta la tep ia u ; bad u Eleasar u khun jong u u la shakri ha ka kam lyngdoh jong u ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Behold , the third time I am ready to come to you ; and I will not be burdensome to you : for I seek not yours , but you : for the children ought not to lay up for the parents , but the parents for the children .
kha: Kane mynta ka long ka sien kaba lai ba nga la khreh ban wan jngoh ïa phi — bad ngan ym pynlong kino kino ki jingdawa na phi . Dei ïa phi ba nga kwah , ym ïa ka pisa jong phi . La kumno kumno , ki khun kim da dei ban pynbiang na ka bynta la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei ki kmie ki kpa keiñ ki dei ban pynbiang na ka bynta la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, ka sien kaba lai nga la pynkhreh ban wan sha phi ; bad ngan ym long uba khia ia phi: namar ngam wad ia ka jong phi: namar ki khun kim dei ban thiah na ka bynta ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei ki kmie ki kpa na ka bynta ki khun .

en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days  ; neither shall there any thing of the flesh , which thou sacrificedst the first day at even , remain all night until the morning .
kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym bit ïa uno uno ha kata ka ri ban don thiat ha ïing jong u ; bad ïa ka doh ba phi kñia ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba nyngkong dei ban bam lut ha kajuh hi ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ym dei ban don u kpu ba la khleh lang bad me ha baroh ki rud duriaw jong me hynriew sngi bad ym dei ban don ei ei na ka doh kaba me la knia ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong ha ka por mynstep .

en: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .
kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha lane pyn-i kano kano ka jingisynei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad dei ma nga uba pynshitom ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka khmat jong nga kan ym lait, lymne ngan ym sngewsynei: Ngan pynphai kylla ia me katkum ki lynti jong me bad ki jingleh bymman jong me kiba don hapdeng jong me ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai uba pynkhih .

en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up , saying , Wherefore dost thou prophesy , and say , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall take it  ;
kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la set byndi ïa nga hangta bad u la mudui ba nga la pynbna ba U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan pynlong ba u syiem ka Babilonia un kurup ïa kane ka nongbah , bad u syiem Sedekaïah un ym lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah u la khang ia u, u la ong, "Namar kata me iathuhlypa, bad me ong: Kumta ong U Trai: Ha khmih ngan aiti ia kane ka shnong ha ka kti u syiem Babilon bad un shim ia ka;

en: Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink  ; nor yet for your body , what ye shall put on . Is not the life more than meat , and the body than raiment ?
kha: Dei kane keiñ balei nga ong ïa phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam bad ka jingdih kaba phi donkam ban im , lane shaphang ki jaiñ na ka bynta ka met jong phi . Nalor baroh , hato ka jingim kam kham kor shibun ban ïa ki jingbam ? Hato ka met kam kham kor ban ïa ki jaiñ ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata nga ong ha phi , Wat pyrkhat ia ka jingim jong phi, kaei kaba phin bam ne kaei kaba phin dih ; ne kaei kaba phin phong . Hato ka jingim ka kham palat ia ka doh bad ka met ban ia ka jain ?

en: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes  letter was read before Rehum , and Shimshai the scribe , and their companions , they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews , and made them to cease by force and power .
kha: Tang shu pule ïa kane ka shithi na u Artakserksis ha u Rehum bad u Shimshai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki leit kyrkieh sha Jerusalem bad pynbor ïa ki Jiw ban sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba la pule ia ka shithi jong u syiem Artaxerxes ha khmat u Rehum, bad u Shimshai u nongthoh bad ki paralok jong ki, ki la leit sha Jerusalem sha ki Jiw bad ki la pynlong ia ki ban sangeh noh da ka bor bad ka bor .

en: And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .
kha: Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To ngin ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynti kaba biang eh ba ngin leit kiew bad kiba kumno ki jait shnong kiba don hangta .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la wan hajan jong nga iwei pa iwei na phi, bad phi la ong , Ngin phah ia ki briew ha khmat jong ngi, bad kin sa wad ia ngi na ka ri, bad kin wanrah biang ia ngi da kano ka rukom ba ngi dei ban leit shaneng bad sha kino ki nongbah kiba ngin wan .

en: And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .
kha: Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka ,  u Araunah u ong ,  bad to kñia ha U  Trai  ïa kano kano kaba phi mon . Kine hangne ki masi dab ban thang kum ka jingainguh halor ka duwan ; kine hangne ki dei ki lyngkor jong ki bad ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Aragah u la ong ha u Dabid, To ai ba u kynrad jong nga un shim bad un aiti ia kaei kaba bha ia u: ha khmih, hangne ki don ki masi na ka bynta ka jingknia thang , bad ki tiar ot bad kiwei kiwei ki tiar jong ki masi na ka bynta ki dieng .

en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .
kha: Ha ka por ba la leit , wat haba u Saul u dang long u syiem jong ngi , phi la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Israel ha ka thma bad U  Trai  u la kular ïa phi ba phin ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad ban long u nongsynshar jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ka por ba la leit noh, haba u Saul u la long syiem halor jong ngi, me long ma me uba la leit shabar bad uba la wanrah ha Israel: bad U Trai u la ong ha me: Me dei ban ai bam ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel, bad me long u rangbah shipai halor ki Israel .

en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .
kha: Shu pdiang ba pha la bakla bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong pha . To phla ba hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingieit ha ki blei nongwei bad ba pham shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Tangba to pdiang ia ka jingbymhok jong me, ba me la iaid lait ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad me la pynphriang ia ki lynti jong me sha ki nongwei hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng uba jyrngam , bad phim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong nga , ong U Trai .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom , and will cut off man and beast from it  ; and I will make it desolate from Teman  ; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword .
kha: Mynta nga pynbna ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka Edom bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew bad u mrad hangta . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba sah shrah , na ka nongbah Teman haduh ka nongbah Dedan , bad ki briew kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei; nga ruh ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor ka Edom, bad ngan ot noh ia u briew bad u mrad na ka ; bad ngan pynlong ia ka ban jah noh na u Teman ; bad ki jong u Dedan kin hap da ka waitlam .

en: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly , and said , Who ? where is he that hath taken venison , and brought it me , and I have eaten of all before thou camest , and have blessed him ? yea , and he shall be blessed .
kha: U Isaak u la sdang ban kyiuh bad khynñiuh baroh shi rynïeng , bad u la kylli ,  Te uei pat uto uba la pynïap mrad bad uba la wanrah ïa ka sha nga ? Nga la bam ïa ka shuwa ba men wan . Nga la ai ha u ïa ka jingkyrkhu bakhatduh , bad kumta ka long ka jong u shi junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la khih palat, bad u la ong, Mano ? hangno uta uba la shim ia ka bih bad u la wanrah ia ka ha nga bad nga la bam ia ka ha khmat jong me baroh ? Hooid , bad un long uba la kyrkhu .

en: Yea doubtless , and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord : for whom I have suffered the loss of all things , and do count them but dung , that I may win Christ ,
kha: Ia ki jingartatiend ; nga ñiew ïa kiei kiei baroh kum ka jingduh ba-pura na ka bynta kata kaba kham kor palat , ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid khlem artatien , bad nga khein ia kiei kiei baroh hynrei nga la duh noh ia ka jingbha jong ka jingtip ia U Khrist Jisu U Trai jong nga: na ka bynta jong u nga la shah shitom ia ka jingduh lut ia kiei kiei baroh , bad nga khein ia ki hynrei nga lah ban jop ia U Khrist .

en: And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
kha: Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka jingjop kaba khraw ; hato ngan shu ïap mynta na ka jingsliang um bad ban hap ha ki kti jong kine ki Philistia bymngeit ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la sngewsih shibun bad u la pyrta ia U Trai bad u la ong: Me la ai ia kane ka jingpyllait kaba khraw ha ka kti jong u shakri jong me: bad mynta ngan iap na ka bynta ka jingthngan bad ngan hap ha ka kti jong ki bym pat shah ot ?

en: So they poured out for the men to eat . And it came to pass , as they were eating of the pottage , that they cried out , and said , O thou man of God , there is death in the pot . And they could not eat thereof .
kha: La ai ïa kata ka syrwa ha ki rangbah ban bam , hynrei mar ïamad ïa ka ki pyrta jam ha u Elisha ,  Ka dei kaba long bih !  — bad kim shym bam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la theh ia ki briew ban bam . Bad ka la jia, katba ki dang bam ia ka pot , ba ki la pyrta bad ki la ong , Ko briew jong U Blei, ka don ka jingiap ha ka umphniang . Bad kim lah ban bam ia ka .

en: Then said he unto me , Prophesy unto the wind , prophesy , son of man , and say to the wind , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Come from the four winds , O breath , and breathe upon these slain , that they may live .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa ha ka lyer . To ïathuh ha ka lyer ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u hukum ïa ka ba kan wan na baroh sawdong , ban pyrsad mynsiem ha kine ki metïap , bad ban wallam pat ha ki ïa ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, To iathuhlypa ia ka Iyer, ko khun u briew, bad to ong ha ka Iyer, Kumta u ong U Trai Blei; To wan na ki saw tylli ki Iyer, ko mynsiem, bad pynhiar mynsiem ia kine kiba la shah pyniap, ba kin im .

en: Now the acts of Rehoboam , first and last , are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet , and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies ? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .
kha: Ïa ki kam jong u Rehoboam naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut bad ki jinglum jingthoh ïa ka longïing jong u la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong u Shemaïah u Nongïathuhlypa  bad ha  Ka Histori jong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa . U Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ki ïai ïaleh thma uwei ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki kam jong u Rehoboam, nyngkong bad khatduh, hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot u nongiathuhlypa u Shemaiah bad u Ido u nongiathuhlypa uba iadei bad ki jaitbynriew ? Bad ki la don ki thma hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam .

en: And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?
kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la thynrang palat bad ki la ïai khñium ha u Moses . Ki la ong ,  Balei keiñ ba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap da ka jingsliang ïa ngi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la sliang hangta na ka bynta ka um ; bad ki briew ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Moses bad ki la ong: Balei ba me la wanrah ia ngi na Ijipt ban pyniap ia ngi bad ia ki khun jong ngi bad ki masi jong ngi da ka jingthngan ?

en: How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman jong ki briew jong ngi , ki briew kiba ong , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ka ri kan iam bad ki jingthung jong kawei pa kawei ka lyngkha kin tyrkhong namar ka jingsniew jong kita kiba shong ha ka ? ki mrad ki shah bam , bad ki sim; namar ki la ong , Un ym iohi ia ka jingkut kaba khatduh jong ngi .

en: For all of my father s house were but dead men before my lord the king : yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table . What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king ?
kha: Baroh kiba na ka longïing jong i pa jong nga ki dei hok ban shah pynïap ha phi ko Syiem Kynrad , hynrei phi ai ha nga ka hok ban bam ha ka miej bam jong phi . Ngam don hok ban pan shuh shuh ïa ki jinglehbha na u Syiem Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta baroh ki iing jong u kpa jong nga ki long tang ki briew kiba la iap ha khmat u kynrad jong nga: hynrei me la buh ia u shakri jong me hapdeng jong ki kiba la bam ha ka miej jong me hi . Kaei ka hok ba nga dang iam shuh shuh ha u syiem ?

en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat , but it withereth the grass , and the flower thereof falleth , and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth : so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways .
kha: Ka sngi ka mih lem bad ka jingshit kyr-ang bad ka thang ïa u jingthung ; u syntiew jong u , u hap noh , bad ka jingitynnat jong u ka jah noh . Ha kajuh ka rukom ïa uba riewspah yn pynjot noh katba u dang don ha ka kam jong u ba u trei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka sngi kam ju mih kloi da ka jingshit kaba thang, hynrei ka pyut ia u phlang bad u syntiew jong ka u hap noh: kumta ruh u riewspah un jah noh ha ki lynti jong u .

en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .
kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U Blei un ym shah ba phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymdonkam , bad im ju buhrieh ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u, U Blei un ym iap: ha khmih u kpa jong nga un ym leh ei ei kaba khraw ne kaba rit hynrei un pyni ia nga: bad balei u kpa jong nga un buhrieh ia kane na nga ? kam long kumta .

en: And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .
kha: Lai sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ud pang na ka jingotsher jong ki , ar ngut na ki khun shynrang u Jakob , u Simeon bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shynrang jong ka Dinah , ki la shim ïa la ki waitlam bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang baroh , kynthup ïa u Hamor bad u Shekhem u khun jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai, haba ki la pang, ba arngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob, u Simeon bad u Lebi, ki para shynrang ki la shim ia ka waitlam jong u, bad ki la wan sha ka shnong da ka jingshlur, bad ki la pyniap ia ki shynrang baroh .

en: The God of Abraham , and of Isaac , and of Jacob , the God of our fathers , hath glorified his Son Jesus  ; whom ye delivered up , and denied him in the presence of Pilate , when he was determined to let him go .
kha: U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak , bad jong u Jakob , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la ai ïa ka burom ba kynja blei ha U Jisu u shakri jong u . Hynrei phi la aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar , bad phi la kyntait ïa u ha khmat u Pilat , wat hadien ba u Pilat u la rai ban pyllait noh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak bad u Jakob u Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi u la pyndonburom ia u Khun jong u Jisu uba phi la aiti noh, bad u la kyntait ia u ha khmat u Pilat haba u la kut jingmut ban pyllait noh ia u .

en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;
kha: Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kum ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin hap shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pynlong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom haba ki ïashong bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lynti bashukor !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pdiang ia ka bainong jong ka jingbymhok, kumba ki khein ia ka jingsngewbha ban pynkhih ha ka por mynstep . Ki jaka ki long bad ki jingduna , ki ialehkai ia lade da ki jingleh thok jong ki hi katba ki dang ia bam bad phi ;

en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .
kha: hynrei mem don kano kano ka jingtep , bad ïa ka metïap jong me la bret shabar ba kan pyut . La tap ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , la kynting ïa ka lem bad ki ha ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me la bret noh na ka jingtep jong me kum ka tnat kaba sngewsih, bad kum ka jainkup jong kito kiba la shah pyniap, la pynkhih da ka waitlam, kiba hiar sha ki maw jong ka thliew ; kum ka met iap kaba la iaid hapoh ki kjat .

en: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation , Solomon my son , whom alone God hath chosen , is yet young and tender , and the work is great : for the palace is not for man , but for the  Lord  God .
kha: U Syiem Dabid u pynbna ha baroh kiba ïalumlang ,  U Solomon u khun jong nga u dei ma u uba U Blei u la jied , hynrei u dang samla bad dang duna ka jingtbit . Ka kam ban leh ka long kaba khraw , namar kane kam dei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ki briew hynrei ka Templ na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Shuh shuh u Dabid u la ong ha ka jingiaseng baroh, U Solomon u khun jong nga, uba tang U Blei u la jied, u dang samla bad u dang rit paid: namar ka iing kam long na ka bynta u briew hynrei na ka bynta U Trai Blei .

en: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee  ; which have said to thy soul , Bow down , that we may go over : and thou hast laid thy body as the ground , and as the street , to them that went over .
kha: Ngan ai ïa ka ha kito kiba banbeiñ ïa phi , ïa kito kiba la pynlong ïa phi ban thiah ha ki surok bah bad ïuhroit halor jong phi kum ka jakhlia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan buh ia ka ha ka kti jong kita kiba pynshitom ia me; kiba la ong ha ka mynsiem jong me: To leit noh: bad me la buh ia ka met jong me kum ka khyndew bad kum ka lynti ia ki kiba la leit noh .

en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .
kha: Ha shuwa ba ngan kut ka jingduwai bajar jar jong nga , ka Rebekka ka la wan bad u khiew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka bad ka la leit hiar sha kata ka pukri ban tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba ngan dih .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shuwa ba ngan kren ha ka dohnud jong nga, ha khmih ka Rebeka ka la mih bad ka khiew jong ka ha ka tyrpeng jong ka ; bad ka la leit hiar sha ka thliew um: bad nga la ong ia ka: To ai ba ngan dih, nga kyrpad ia me .

en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .
kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim kin sngewsih katba u nongleitkurim u dang don lem bad ki ? Em kam long kumta ! Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta keiñ kin sa shahjingit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki, Hato ki khun jong ka nongleitkurim ki lah ban iam katba u nongleit kurim u dang don bad ki ? hynrei ki sngi kin sa wan , haba u nongleit kurim un shah shim noh na ki , bad nangta kin sa shah jingit .

en: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .
kha: Ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kliar lum Aben , ha kiba ki paid Israel ki mane ïa ki bleithaw , yn pynjot noh . Ki shiah bad ki ñiut kin san ha ki duwan jong ki ; ki briew kin sa pyrta ha ki lumbah ,  To buhrieh ïa ngi !  bad ha ki lumrit ,  To tap ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaka ba jrong ruh jong u Aven , ka pop jong ki Israel kin shah pynjot: u thorn bad ka thylliej kin wan shaneng ha ki almari jong ki ; bad kin ong ha ki lum , Pynsah ia ngi ; bad ha ki lum , Ka jinghap ha ngi .

en: Of whom I have no certain thing to write unto my lord . Wherefore I have brought him forth before you , and specially before thee , O king Agrippa , that , after examination had , I might have somewhat to write .
kha: Hynrei ngam don kano kano kaba dei thik shaphang jong u ban thoh sha u Patsha . Kumta nga la wallam ïa u hangne ha khmat jong phi — bad kyrpang ha khmat jong phi , ko syiem Agrippa ! — khnang ba , hadien ka jingtohkit ïa ka kam jong u , nga lah ban don ei ei ban thoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Na kiba ngam don ei ei ban thoh sha u kynrad jong nga . Namarkata nga la wanrah ia u ha khmat jong phi, bad khamtam eh ha khmat jong me, ko syiem Agrippa, ba hadien ba nga la dep ban bishar bniah, nga lah ban don katto katne ban thoh .

en: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him , and behaved himself wisely : and Saul set him over the men of war , and he was accepted in the sight of all the people , and also in the sight of Saul s servants .
kha: U Dabid u la pyndep hok ïa ki kam baroh ïa kiba u Saul u la phah ïa u , bad kumta u Saul u pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kane ka la pynsngewbha ïa baroh ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah jong u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit shabar ha kaba u Saul u la phah ia u: bad u Saul u la buh ia u halor ki shipai , bad la pdiang ia u ha khmat ki briew baroh , bad ruh ha khmat ki shakri jong u Saul .

en: And the woman said , Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God ? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty , in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished .
kha: Ka ong ha u ,  Balei ba phi la leh kum kane ka jingbakla ha ki briew jong U Blei ? Phim shym la shah ïa la u jong u khun ban wan phai noh na ka jingphet wir , bad kumta phi la pynrem ïa lade da kaei kaba phi dang shu dep ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kata ka kynthei ka la ong: Balei te me la pyrkhat ia kata ka jingjia pyrshah ia ki briew U Blei ? namar u syiem um kren ia kane ka jingkren kum uba bakla, ha kaba u syiem um ju leit phai biang sha la iing .

en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .
kha: Haba ki shakri kynthei jong ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u leh , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah sha u Mordekai katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka jaka ki jaiñ khain , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki nongtrei jong ka Esther bad ki kamra jong ka ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ia ka . Nangta ka mahadei ka la sngewsih palat ia u ; bad ka la phah ia u da ka jainkup ban phong ia u Mordecai , bad ban weng noh ia ka jainkup jong u na u : hynrei um shym la pdiang ia ka .

en: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her : and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness , which put bracelets upon their hands , and beautiful crowns upon their heads .
kha: Lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur jingsawa jong ki paidbah ba leh sngewbha , ka kynhun ki rangbah ba la wanrah na ka ri shyiap . Ki pyndeng ïa ki khadu ha ki kti ki kynthei bad ki pansngiat ba-itynnat ha ki khlieh jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka sur jong u paidbah ka la long kaba suk bad ka: bad bad ki briew kiba iadei bad ka ri khlaw la wanrah ia ki nongwan na ka ri khlaw , kiba la buh ia ki brace ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki khlieh kiba itynnad ha ki khlieh jong ki .

en: And the Lord  God  of hosts is he that toucheth the land , and it shall melt , and all that dwell therein shall mourn : and it shall rise up wholly like a flood  ; and shall be drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u ktah ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh baroh kiba shong ha ka ki ïambriew , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kiew ka hiar kum ka wah Nile .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai Blei jong ki paid u long uta uba ktah ia ka ri, bad kan sa rkhiang, bad baroh kiba shong ha ka kin iam: bad kan kiew baroh kawei kum ka jingshlei um ; bad kan sa shah rong noh kum ka jingshlei um jong ka ri Ijipt .

en: And if , when the priest seeth it , behold , it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white  ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .
kha: U lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u , bad lada kata ka dak ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka bad ba u shñiuh hangta ruh u la kylla lieh , un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid . Kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba sdang na uta u tohjaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u lyngdoh u iohi ia ka, ha khmih ka kham duna ban ia ka sniehdoh, bad u shniuh jong ka u la kylla lieh ; u lyngdoh un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid: ka long ka khlam jong ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba la tyrkhong na ka jingkhluit .

en: For it is a fact : This “world is passing away and so is its desire , but he that does the will of God remains forever ,” to enjoy eternally the blessings to be showered down by our loving Creator .—1 John 2 :17 .
kha: Namar ka long ka bashisha “Kane ka pyrthei ka ïaid jah noh bad kata ka jingkwah brai jong ka , hynrei uta uba leh ïa ka mon u Blei u ïaisah bymjukut ,” ban lehkmen junom ïa ki jingkyrkhu ban thehsei da u Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw . —Ïoannis 2 :17 .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka long ka jingshisha: Kane ka pyrthei  ka iaid noh bad kumjuh ruh ka jingkwah jong ka, hynrei uta uba leh ia ka mon U Blei u sah junom , ban sngewbha junom ia ki jingkyrkhu ban shah pynhap noh da u Nongthaw ba ieit jong ngi .

en: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen : and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen , whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots , and with the king at Jerusalem .
kha: U Solomon u lumlang ïa ki shihajar sawspah tylli ki kali ïapom bad khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na kita u buh ha Jerusalem , bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la lum lang ia ki kali bad ki kulai: bad u don shi hajar san spah tylli ki kali kit kulai bad shiphew hajar ngut ki kulai kiba u la ai ha ki nongbah na ka bynta ki kali kit kulai bad bad u syiem ha Jerusalem .

en: And David said unto Achish , If I have now found grace in thine eyes , let them give me a place in some town in the country , that I may dwell there : for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee ?
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Akhish ,  Lada phi long u paralok jong nga , ai jaka ïa nga ha kawei ka shnongrit ba ngan ïoh shong hangta . Bah , kam donkam ïa nga ba ngan sah ryngkat bad phi ha kane ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Akhis: Lada nga la shem mynta ha ki khmat jong me, to ai jaka ia nga ha kano kano ka shnong ha ka ri, ba ngan shong hangta: namar balei ba u shakri jong me un shong ha ka shnong syiem bad me ?

en: Take heed unto yourselves , lest ye forget the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he made with you , and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the  Lord  thy God hath forbidden thee .
kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynlong bad phi . Kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ban ym thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ïa kano kano ka durblei ,
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar ia lade , ioh ba phin klet ia ka jutang U Trai U Blei jong phi , kaba u la leh bad phi , bad pynlong ia phi ka dur ba la ker , ne ka dur jong kaei kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la khang ia phi .

en: And , behold , I am with thee , and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land  ; for I will not leave thee , until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of .
kha: To kynmaw , ba ngan long ryngkat bad me bad ïada ïa me kat shaba me leit , bad ngan wallam pat ïa me sha kane ka ri . Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me tad haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la kular ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih , nga don bad me, bad ngan buh ia me ha ki jaka baroh kiba me leit, bad ngan wanrah biang ia me sha kane ka ri ; namar ngan ym iehnoh ia me, haduh ba ngan da leh ia kata kaba nga la kren ia me .

en: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances , and have not kept them . Return unto me , and I will return unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts . But ye said , Wherein shall we return ?
kha: Ma phi , kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha shuwa jong phi , phi la phai noh na ki aiñ jong nga bad phim shym la sumar ïa ki . To phai pat sha nga , bad ngan phai sha phi . Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ban phai pat sha me ?’
translated_en_to_kha: Wat na ki sngi jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi phi la leit noh na ki jinglong jong nga, bad phim shym la bat ia ki . To wan phai sha nga bad ngan wan phai sha phi , ong U Trai jong ki paid . Hynrei phi la ong , Hangno ngin leit phai noh ?

en: And they said unto them , The  Lord  look upon you , and judge  ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us .
kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh , bad un pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi pynlong ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ban isih ïa ngi . Phi la ai daw ïa ki ban pynïap ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha ki: U Trai u peit ia phi, bad u bishar namar ba phi la pynlong ia ka jingsngewsih jong ngi ban shah pynjah burom ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki shakri jong u, ban buh ia ka waitlam ha ka kti jong ki ban pyniap ia ngi .

en: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them , saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki Israel . Ïathuh ïa ki ba ynda la kem ïongreiñ kin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam , bad ha ka por mynstep kin sa ïoh u kpu uba ki kwah . Te kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  nga long U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew ia ki jingkyrhuh jong ki khun Israel: kren ha ki da kaba ong: Ha ka por mynstep phin bam doh bad ha ka por mynstep phin sa dap da u kpu ; bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .

en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols ? for ye are the temple of the living God ; as God hath said , I will dwell in them , and walk in them ; and I will be their God , and they shall be my people .
kha: Kumno ka templ jong U Blei kan don jingïateh bad ki bleithaw ? Naba ngi long ka templ jong U Blei uba im ! Kumba U Blei da lade hi u la ong ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ka ïing jong nga bad ki briew jong nga bad ngan shong hapdeng jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei ka jingiateh jong U Blei bad ki bleithaw ? namar phi long ka tempi U Blei uba im ; kumba U Blei u la ong: Ngan shong ha ki, bad ngan iaid ha ki ; bad ngan long U Blei jong ki, bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation  ; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels .
kha: Lada u briew u lehrain ïa nga bad ïa ka jinghikai jong nga ha kane ka sngi jong ka jingbymriewblei bad ka jingbymman , te U Khun U Briew un lehrain ïa u haba un wan ha ka burom jong U Kpa jong u ryngkat bad ki angel bakhuid .
translated_en_to_kha: Uno uno uba sngewlehrain ia nga bad ia ki ktien jong nga ha kane ka pateng kaba sniew bad kaba pop jong u ruh un sngewlehrain ia u khun u briew haba u wan ha ka burom U Kpa jong u ryngkat bad ki angel bakhuid .

en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
kha: Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u , bad u la ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ka long kaba shisha ! U Trai u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyllait ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herod bad na kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khmih lynti ba kan jia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Petros u la wan sha la ka jong ka jaka , u la ong , Mynta nga tip ia ka jingshisha ba U Trai u la phah ia u angel jong u bad u la pyllait im ia nga na ka kti u Herod bad na ka jingkhmih lynti baroh jong ki Jiw .

en: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi kaba nyngkong , phin shim ïa ki soh kiba kynsai , ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba bun sla , bad sdang ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin shim ia phi ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong ia ki tnat dieng kiba bha, ki tnat dieng sohjew bad ki tnat dieng kiba jylliew, bad ki tnat jong ka wah ; bad phin ia kmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi hynriew sngi .

en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about , saying , Take heed to yourselves , that ye go not up into the mount , or touch the border of it : whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death :
kha: Buh dak sawdong uta u lum khnang ba ki briew kim dei ban jam palat , bad ong ïa ki ba kin ym leit kiew sha u lum , lane wat ban leit tur sha jan jong u . Lada uno uno u leit ïuhkjat ha u lum , yn pynïap ïa u ;
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban buh pud ia ki briew sawdong, da kaba ong: To sumar ia lade, ba phin ym leit sha u lum ne ktah ia u pud jong u: uno uno uba ktah ia u lum un shah pyniap shisha:

en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon , which have been done in you , they had a great while ago repented , sitting in sackcloth and ashes .
kha: A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha , ko Khorasin ! A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah ba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad ha Sidon , ki briew kiba hangta kin jin da la shong naduh mynshuwa , kin kup ka jaiñ khain bad synreit dpei halor lade , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: To phi, ko Khristan ! to phi, ko Bethsaida ! namar lada la leh ia ki kam kiba khraw ha Tyros bad ha Sidon kiba la leh ha phi, ki la kylla bamut shipor mynshuwa, ki la shong ha ka jain bad ka dewbilat .

en: Woe is me , my mother , that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth ! I have neither lent on usury , nor men have lent to me on usury  ; yet every one of them doth curse me .
kha: A nga long u briew u bym don jingkmen ! Balei ba i mei jong nga i wallam ïa nga sha ka pyrthei ? Nga la dei ban ïakajia bad ïania bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri . Ngam shym la ai kylliang ïa kano kano ka pisa lane shim kylliang ïa kano kano ; pynban uwei pa uwei u tim ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long ma nga, ko kmie jong nga, ba me la kha ia nga u briew uba ialeh bad u briew uba ialeh pyrshah ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! Ngam shym la ai ram ia nga ha ka kam kaba myntoi; hynrei uwei pa uwei na ki u la tim ia nga .

en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .
kha: Ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , ñiewburom ïa ki jingkñia kiba kyntang ba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , ba kumta phin ym pynkheiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, ba kin pyniakhlad ia lade na kiei kiei kiba kyntang jong ki khun Israel bad ba kin ym pynjah burom ia ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga ha kita kiei kiei kiba ki pynkyntang ha nga: Nga long U Trai .

en: And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .
kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u kpa jong ki , ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh . Da kane ka jingpynsleh , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh shi rta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynsleh ia ki kumba me la pynsleh ia u kpa jong ki, ba kin shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh: namar ka jingpynkhuid jong ki kan long shisha ka jinglong lyngdoh bymjukut ha ki pateng jong ki baroh .

en: Behold , I will put a fleece of wool in the floor  ; and if the dew be on the fleece only , and it be dry upon all the earth beside , then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand , as thou hast said .
kha: Te nga buh katto katne u shñiuh langbrot halor ka khyndew ha kaba ngi shoh kew . Lada ha ka por mynstep don umjer tang ha u shñiuh langbrot hynrei ym ha ka khyndew , te ngan tip ba men pyndonkam ïa nga ban pyllait ïa ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan buh ia ka snieh langbrot ha ka mala ; bad lada ka dewbilat ka don tang ha ka snieh langbrot , bad kan sa tyrkhong ha ka khyndew baroh kawei nalor kata , te ngan sa tip ba men pynim ia ki Israel da ka kti jong nga kumba me la ong .

en: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , standing where it ought not ,  ( let him that readeth understand , )  then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains :
kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa ka ‘ Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ kaba ïeng ha ka jaka kaba kam dei ban don .  ( Ka jingpynkynmaw ïa uba pule : da pynthikna ban sngewthuh ka mut aïu kane ! )  Te kito kiba don ha Judia ki dei ban phet sha ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba phin iohi ia ka jingpynjot ia ka jingjot, kaba la kren da u Daniel u nongiathuhlypa, uba ieng ha ka jaka kaba ym dei ban pule, (to ai ba uta uba pule un sngewthuh), te to ai ba kita kiba don ha Judaea kin phet noh sha ki lum:

en: A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .
kha: Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ka ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai ba shu wai — Katno ki long kiba tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka waitlam ka don ha ki kulai jong ki, bad ha ki kali jong ki, bad ha ki briew kiba la khleh lang baroh kiba don hapdeng jong ka ; bad kin kylla long kum ki kynthei: ka waitlam ka don ha ki spah jong ka ; bad kin shah lute .

en: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed , that thou shalt sow the ground withal  ; and bread of the increase of the earth , and it shall be fat and plenteous : in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures .
kha: Man ba phi bet ïa ki symbai jong phi , U  Trai  un phah slap ban pynlong ïa ki ban san bad ai ïa phi ka jingot kaba bun , bad ki jingri jong phi kin don shibun ki jaka bam phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un ai ia u slap jong u symbai jong me, ba me bet ia ka khyndew bad u kpu jong ka jingroi jong ka khyndew, bad kan long kaba heh bad kaba bun: ha kata ka sngi ki masi jong me kin bam ha ki jaka ri jingri kiba heh .

en: And he said , What is the thing that the  Lord  hath said unto thee ? I pray thee hide it not from me : God do so to thee , and more also , if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee .
kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh aïu ha phi ?  u Eli u kylli .  Wat buhrieh ei ei na nga . U Blei un pynshitom jur ïa phi lada phim ïathuh lut ha nga kat ïa kaba u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kaei kata kaba U Trai u la ong ha me ? Nga kyrpad ia me ban buhrieh ia ka na nga: U Blei un leh kumta ha me, bad kham palat ruh lada me buhrieh ei ei na nga na kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong ha me .

en: The priests said not , Where is the  Lord  ? and they that handle the law knew me not : the pastors also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after things that do not profit .
kha: Ki lyngdoh kim shym kylli , ‘ Hangno U  Trai  u don ?’ Ki lyngdoh jong nga hi kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki nongsynshar ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka kyrteng jong u Baal bad ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh kim shym la ong , Hangno U Trai ? bad kita kiba pyniaid ia ka hukum kim ithuh ia nga: ki lyngdoh ruh ki la iaid pyrshah ia nga , bad ki nongiathuhlypa ki la iathuhlypa da u Baal , bad ki la iaid hadien kiei kiei ki bym myntoi .

en: Ashkelon shall see it , and fear  ; Gaza also shall see it , and be very sorrowful , and Ekron  ; for her expectation shall be ashamed  ; and the king shall perish from Gaza , and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited .
kha: Ka nongbah Ashkelon kan ïohi ïa kane bad kan sheptieng . Ka nongbah Gasa kan ïohi ïa kane bad kan shah ka jingshitom bakhraw . Kumta ruh kan long ka Ekron , bad ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ka yn pynkhynñiuh . Ka Gasa kan duh noh ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa ka Ashkelon yn ieh kynjah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ashkelon un iohi ia ka, bad u Gaza ruh un iohi ia ka, bad un sngewsih shibun, bad u Ekron ; namar ka jingkhmih lynti jong ka un sngewlehrain ; bad u syiem un jah noh na Gaza, bad u Ashkelon un ym shong .

en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus  ; Thou hast chastised me , and I was chastised , as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke : turn thou me , and I shall be turned  ; for thou art the  Lord  my God .
kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa ki paid Israel ba ki ong ha ka jingsngewsih , ‘ A  Trai  , ngi la long kum u mrad uba khlem shah hikai , hynrei me la hikai ïa ngi ban kohnguh . To wallam pat ïa ngi ; ngi long kiba la kloi ban wan phai pat sha me , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohsngew shisha ia u Ephraim ba u la sngewsih kumta ; Me la pynshitom ia nga, bad nga la shah pynshitom kum u masi khlem da ju shah ktah ha ka lyngkhot: to pynphai ia nga, bad ngan kylla ; namar me long U Trai U Blei jong nga .

en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: te phin shem ka jingkmen kaba wan na kaba shakri ïa nga . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïoh burom ha kylleng ka pyrthei . Bad phin lehkmen ha ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha u kpa tymmen jong phi , u Jakob . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to sngewbha ia lade ha U Trai ; bad ngan pynlong ia me ban shong ha ki jaka ba jrong jong ka khyndew , bad ngan ai bam ia me da ka pateng jong u kpa jong me: namar ka shyntur U Trai ka la kren ia kata .

en: And their windows , and their arches , and their palm trees , were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east  ; and they went up unto it by seven steps  ; and the arches thereof were before them .
kha: Ka kamra rung , ki jingkhangïit , bad ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong , ki la long kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Hangne la don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khyrdop , bad ka kamra rung ka la long ha kaba kut marpyrshah ka phyllaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingkhang jong ki bad ki dieng jong ki, ki long hadien ka jingthew jong ka khyrdop kaba peit shaphang mihngi ; bad ki la kiew sha ka da ki hynriew tylli ki step ; bad ki dieng jong ka ki la don ha khmat jong ki .

en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms , whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms : and in that thou givest a reward , and no reward is given unto thee , therefore thou art contrary .
kha: Pha long ka jait nuti kaba kyrpang . Ym don mano mano ba pynbor ïa pha ban long kumta . Pham shym ïoh jingsiew , pha siew ïa ki ! Ho-oid , pha long kaba pher .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaba pyrshah ka long ha me na kiwei pat ki kynthei ha ki kam khaii met jong me, katba ym don ba bud ia me ban leh ia ki kam khaii: bad ha kata ba me ai ia ka bainong bad ym shym la ai bainong ia me, namarkata me long pyrshah .

en: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial , and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted , and could not withstand them .
kha: Hadien u lumlang ïa ka kynhun ki riewmadan , bad ki pynbor ïa ka mon jong ki ha u Rehoboam u khun jong u Solomon , uba dang khynnah eh bad ba dang lung ka jingtbit ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki briew kiba la lum lang ha u, ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kiba la pynskhem ia lade pyrshah ia u Rehoboam u khun u Solomon , haba u Rehoboam u dang samla bad u la jem mynsiem bad um lah ban shah ia ki .

en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I do not this for your sakes , O house of Israel , but for mine holy name s sake , which ye have profaned among the heathen , whither ye went .
kha: Mynta te , to ai ha ki Israel ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga don na ka bynta jong ki : Kaei kaba ngan leh kam long na ka bynta jong phi ki Israel , hynrei na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , ïa kaba phi la pynjahburom ha kawei pa kawei ka ri kat sha kaba phi leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to ong ha ka iing Israel , Kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Ngam leh ia kane na ka bynta jong phi, ko iing Israel, hynrei na ka bynta ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga, kaba phi la pynjah burom hapdeng ki nongwei, ha kaba phi la leit .

en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron : and the whole congregation said unto them , Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt ! or would God we had died in this wilderness !
kha: Ki la khñium pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad ki ong ,  Kan jin da la kham bha ban ïap ha Ijipt lane wat hangne ha ka ri khlaw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel baroh ki la ia ud pyrshah ia u Moses bad u Aaron : bad ka jingiaseng baroh kawei ka la ong ha ki: Hato U Blei un iap ha ka ri Ijipt ! lane u Blei un iap ha kane ka ri khlaw !

en: And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .
kha: Kumta u Gideon u la leit sha la ïing bad u shet uwei u khunblang bad u la pyndonkam shiphew kilo u  purew ban shet ïa u kpu khlem thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka syrwa hapoh u khiew , u la wallam ïa ki sha u angel jong U  Trai  ha trai u dieng Sning , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gideon u la rung shapoh, bad u la pynkhreh ia u khun masi, bad ki cake bym don thied: ka doh u la buh ha ka basket , bad u la buh ia ka umsoh ha ka umphniang , bad u la wanrah ia ka shabar ha u hapoh u oak , bad u la pyni ia ka .

en: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan  ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them  ;
kha: Ki tnga jong phi , ki khun jong phi , bad ki jingri jong phi kin sah hangne , hynrei ki shipai jong phi , kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma , kin jam shuwa ïa kiwei pat ki Israel khnang ban ïarap ïa ki
translated_en_to_kha: Ki tnga jong phi, ki khun rit jong phi bad ki masi jong phi kin sah ha ka ri kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi ha kane ka liang jong ka Jordan ; hynrei phin iaid ha khmat ki hynmen jong phi baroh kiba don ka bor met bad iarap ia ki ; .

en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;
kha: Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ban ïatrei lem bad u . Nga la ai ruh ïa ka jinglah kaba bakhraw ha kiwei pat ki misteri kiba tbit , khnang ba ki lah ban shna ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ba dei ban shna :
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, ha khmih, nga la ai bad u Ahliab, u khun Ahisamach, na ka jait Dan: bad ha ki dohnud jong baroh kiba stad nga la buh ia ka jingstad, ba kin leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ia me;

en: And when they went , I heard the noise of their wings , like the noise of great waters , as the voice of the Almighty , the voice of speech , as the noise of an host : when they stood , they let down their wings .
kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki thapniang haba ki her ; ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , kumba khynwin ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ; kum ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Haba ki sangeh na kaba her , ki khylliap ïa la ki thapniang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit , nga la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ki bniat jong ki, kum ka jingsawa jong ki um kiba khraw, kum ka sur jong u Blei uba donbor baroh: haba ki ieng ki pynhap ia ki bniat jong ki .

en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .
kha: Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki jingiwbih , ki mawlynnai , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah ban pyrkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wan sha Jerusalem da ka rel kaba khraw bha, bad ki kulai kiba la tyrkhong bad ki maw ksiar bad ki maw ba kordor bha: bad haba ka la poi ha u Solomon , ka la iakynduh bad u na kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka dohnud jong ka .

en: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah , and all that were therein , and the coasts thereof from Tirzah : because they opened not to him , therefore he smote it  ; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up .
kha: Katba u Menahem u dang don ha lynti na Tirsah , u pynjot thiaw ïa ka nongbah Tappuah , ki nongshong shnong jong ka , bad ki ri ba-marjan , namar ka nongbah kam shym pyndem wait ha u . U patar wat ïa ki kpoh jong ki kynthei ba-armet baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Menahem u la pynkhih ia ka Tiphsah bad baroh kiba don ha ka, bad ki pud jong ka na Tirsah: namar kim shym la plie ia u, namarkata u la pynkhih ia ka; bad ki kynthei baroh kiba don khun ki la tyrkhong .

en: And he will appoint him captains over thousands , and captains over fifties  ; and will set them to ear his ground , and to reap his harvest , and to make his instruments of war , and instruments of his chariots .
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki un thung kum ki rangbah synshar ki ban peit ïa ki shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad katto katne ngut ki ban peit ïa ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah : ki khun shynrang jong phi kin hap ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u , ban lum ïa ki jingmih jong u na ka khyndew , bad ban shna ïa ki tiar thma bad ki tiar kali ïapom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un thung ia u da ki shipai kiba palat ia ki hajar snem , bad un buh ia ki ban tih ia ka khyndew jong u , bad ban kheit ia u jingot jong u , bad ban pynlong ia ki tiar ialeh jong u bad ki tiar ialeh jong u .

en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,
kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ka pyrda ïa ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka ; ïa ki snar jong ka Ïingjaiñ ; ïa ki tiar baroh kiba pyndonkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingdeng jong ka iingbishar, ki lum jong u, bad ki socket jong u, bad ka jingdeng na ka bynta ka khyrdop jong ka iingbishar, ki nar jong u bad ki pin jong u, bad ki tiar baroh jong ka jingshakri jong ka Tabernakel, na ka bynta ka ïingjaiñ jong ka jingïasoh .

en: If they sin against thee , ( for there is no man that sinneth not , ) and thou be angry with them , and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near  ;
kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki leh pop pyrshah ïa me — bad ba ym don uwei ruh u briew uba khlem leh pop — bad ha la ka jingbitar me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban ring koidi ïa ki sha kawei pat ka ri , wat la kata ka ri ka long kaba jngai , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki leh pop pyrshah ia me , (namar ym don briew uba leh pop), bad me bitar ia ki, bad me aiti ia ki ha u nongshun , haduh ba kin rah noh ia ki sha ka ri jong u nongshun, sha jngai ne hajan;

en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat , Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the  Lord  ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the  Lord .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa , u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani , u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem bad ong ha u ,  Hato ka long kaba dei ban ïarap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew bad ban ïashah bad kito kiba isih ïa U  Trai  ? Kaei kaba phi la leh ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  halor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u khun u Hanani u la leit shabar ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la ong ha u syiem Jehoshaphat, Hato me dei ban iarap ia ki bym don Blei bad me ieit ia ki kiba shun ia U Trai ? namarkata ka jingbitar halor jong me na khmat U Trai .

en: As for the likeness of their faces , they four had the face of a man , and the face of a lion , on the right side : and they four had the face of an ox on the left side  ; they four also had the face of an eagle .
kha: Uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im u don saw tylli ki durkhmat baïapher : ka durbriew ha khmat , sha ka mon ka durkhmat sing , sha kadiang ka durkhmat masi dab , bad shadien ka durkhmat pukni .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia ka dur jong ki khmat jong ki, ki saw ngut ki don ka khmat u briew, bad ka khmat u sing, ha ka liang kadiang: bad ki saw ngut ki don ka khmat u masi ha ka liang kadiang; ki saw ngut ruh ki don ka khmat jong u blang .

en: For I would not , brethren , that ye should be ignorant of this mystery , lest ye should be wise in your own conceits ; that blindness in part is happened to Israel , until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in .
kha: Ka don ka jingshisha barieh , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , kaba nga kwah ïa phi ban tip , naba kan pynlong ïa phi ban ym pyrkhat katno uba stad phi long . Kata ka long ba ka jingmutlop jong ki paid Israel kam neh sah , hynrei kan neh tang haduh kata ka por ba baroh ki Jentil kin wan sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngam kwah, ko para bangeit, ba phin long kiba khlem jingtip ia kane ka jingmaham, ioh ba phin long kiba stad ha la ki jong ki jingmutdur ; ba ka jingmatlah ha kawei ka bynta ka la jia ha ki Israel , haduh ba ka jinglong ba pura jong ki Jutang kan wan rung .

en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .
kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la lwet , bad nga la khynñiuh . Namar jong U  Trai  , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u briew uba buaid u briew uba la dih bun eh ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka dohnud jong nga hapoh jong nga ka la tyrkhong namar ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ki shyieng jong nga ki khih ; Nga long kum u briew uba la buaid , bad kum u briew uba ka wain ka la jop , namar U Trai , bad namar ki ktien jong ka jingkhuid jong u .

en: Therefore the redeemed of the  Lord  shall return , and come with singing unto Zion  ; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head : they shall obtain gladness and joy  ; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away .
kha: Kito kiba me la pyllait im kin ïoh poi ha Jerusalem da ka jingkmen , da kaba rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang mynsiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u nongsiewspah jong U Trai un wan phai noh bad ka jingrwai sha Seion ; bad ka jingkmen bymjukut kan long halor ka khlieh jong ki: kin ioh ia ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen ; bad ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingsngewsih kan phet noh .

en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .
kha: Ym don dieng Kedar ha ka kper U Blei uba lah ban ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju don kum kita ki tnat , bad ym don u dieng ha madan uba don kum kita ki tnat , ym don u dieng ha ka kper jong U Blei uba itynnat katta katta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dieng ha ka kper U Blei kim lah ban buhrieh ia u: ki dieng ki bym long kum ki tnat jong u, bad ki dieng kim long kum ki tnat jong u ; lane uno uno u dieng ha ka kper U Blei u la long kum ma u ha ka jingitynnad jong u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh , and upon Egypt  ; afterwards he will let you go hence : when he shall let you go , he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan phah sa tang kawei ka jingpynshitom ha u Pharaoh bad ki briew jong u . Hadien kata , un sa shah ba phin ïamihnoh . Ha ka jingshisha , un sa beh lut ïa phi nangne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Hynrei ngan wanrah sa kawei ka khlam ha u Pharaoh , bad ha Ijipt hadien un pyllait noh ia phi kumta: ynda un pyllait noh ia phi , un sa beh noh shisha ia phi kumta baroh kawei .

en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .
kha: Ngam pat shym la tip hi ba u dei ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbaptis da ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïohi ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar bad u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei uta , uba pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngam ithuh ia u: hynrei uta uba la phah ia nga ban pynbaptis da ka um, uta u la ong ha nga, Ha uba me iohi ia U Mynsiem ba U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakhuid U Mynsiem Bakh U Mynsiem Bakh U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem U Mynsiem

en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel , thou , and all thy bands , and the people that is with thee : I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort , and to the beasts of the field to be devoured .
kha: U Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u kin kyllon ïap ha ki lumbah ka Israel , bad ngan ai ïa ki met jong ki ba kin long ka jingbam ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Me hap ha ki lum Israel, ma me, bad ki kynhun jong me baroh: Ngan ai ia me ia ki sim kiba sniew jong ki jait baroh .

en: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee for ever , when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Da shahshkor ïa kata baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa phi , ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha junom , namar ba phi leh ïa kata kaba dei bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Peit bad sngap ia kine ki ktien baroh kiba nga hukum ia me, ba kan iaid bha bad me bad ki khun jong me hadien jong me junom, haba me leh ia kaba bha bad kaba dei ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah , and the servants of David , went out , and met together by the pool of Gibeon : and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side of the pool .
kha: U Joab , u khun jong ka Seruïah , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka pung , ha kaba baroh ki la ïashong , kawei ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang jong ka pung bad kawei pat ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u khun u Seruiah bad ki shakri u Dabid ki la mih noh bad ki la iakynduh lang hajan ka pung Gibeon : bad ki la shong, uwei ha kawei ka liang jong ka pung bad uwei pat ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka pung .

en: And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .
kha: bad ki ïa-ong , ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynpaw ha ngi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka burom jong u haba ngi ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren napdeng ka ding ! Mynta ka sngi ngi la ïohi ba u briew u dang lah hi ban im , wat la U Blei u la kren ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phi la ong: Ha khmih U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la pyni ia ngi ia ka burom bad ka jingkhraw jong u: ngi la iohi ia kane ka sngi ba U Blei U kren bad u briew bad u im .

en: And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .
kha: Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  U khie joit bad u pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynsynjor bad pyllait war , kumba mynshuwa .  Um shym tip ba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong , Ki Philistia ki don halor jong me, Samson . Bad u la kyndit na ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la ong, Ngan leit noh kumba ju long mynshuwa, bad ngan pynkhih ia lade . Bad um shym la sngewsih ba U Trai u la leit noh na u .

en: Thou shalt bring them in , and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance , in the place , O  Lord  , which thou hast made for thee to dwell in , in the Sanctuary , O Lord , which thy hands have established .
kha: Me wan ïalam ïa ki shapoh bad me buh ïa ki ha u lumbah jong me , ha ka jaka kaba me , ko  Trai  , me la jied na ka bynta ka ïing jong me , ka Templ kaba me hi me la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban wanrah ia ki shapoh, bad thung ia ki ha u lum jong ka pateng jong me, ha kata ka jaka, ko Trai, kaba me la pynlong ia me ban shong ha ka jaka kyntang, ko Trai, kaba ki kti jong me ki la pynskhem .

en: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards  ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king s high way , until we be past thy borders .
kha: Shah ngin ïaid na ka ri jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri ngin ym leit sakma na ka lynti lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ; bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi ; ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da lait na ka ri jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngan iaid lyngba ka ri jong me: ngin ym phai sha ki lyngkha ne sha ki kper sohjew ngin ym dih ia ki um jong ka pung: hynrei ngin iaid ryngkat bad ki pud jong u syiem .

en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :
kha: Bad u la ong ruh ,  Ko khun u briew , ngan sa pynduna bam ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki briew hangto kin da sa shem jynjar bad sngewkhuslai namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ba ki bam bad ïa ka um ba ki dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, ha khmih, ngan pynpra ia u dieng kpu ha Jerusalem: bad kin bam ia u kpu da ka jingkhia, bad da ka jingsumar; bad kin dih ia ka um da ka jingthew, bad da ka jinglyngngoh:

en: For if I be an offender , or have committed any thing worthy of death , I refuse not to die : but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me , no man may deliver me unto them . I appeal unto Caesar .
kha: Lada nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum bad leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynrem da ka jingïap , ngam kyrpad ban lait na ka . Hynrei lada ym don ka jingshisha ha ki jingmudui ïa kiba ki wallam pyrshah ïa nga , ym don uno uno uba lah ban aiti ïa nga sha ki . Nga apil sha u Patsha .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada nga long u nongleh kam sniew, ne nga la leh ia kaei kaei kaba dei ban iap: hynrei lada ym don kawei ruh na kine kiei kiei kiba kine ki kynnoh ia nga , ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban aiti ia nga ha ki . Nga kyrpad ia u Kaisar .

en: For so it was , that the children of Israel had sinned against the  Lord  their God , which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt , from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and had feared other gods ,
kha: Ka Samaria ka kyllon noh namar ki Israel ki leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , uba la pyllait im ïa ki na u syiem ka Ijipt bad la ïalam noh bak ïa ki na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta ka la long , ba ki khun Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong ki , uba la pynmih ia ki na ka ri Ijipt , na hapoh ka kti u Pharaoh u syiem Ijipt bad ki la tieng ia kiwei pat ki blei .

en: For the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand : he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness : these forty years the  Lord  thy God hath been with thee  ; thou hast lacked nothing .
kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la leh . U la sumar sukher ïa phi haba phi ïaid sakma lyngba kane ka ri shyiap kaba ïar . U la don ryngkat bad phi ha kine ki sawphew snem , bad phi la ïoh ruh kat ïa kaba phi donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u la kyrkhu ia me ha ki kam baroh jong me: u tip ia ka jingleit jong me lyngba kane ka ri khlaw kaba khraw: kine ki sawphew snem U Trai U Blei jong me u la don ryngkat bad me; me la duna ei ei .

en: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .
kha: Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri lane ai ba yn lum ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangta un sheptieng ïa ka kynhun shipai ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynduh noh ia u nongbet na Babilon , bad uta uba bat ia ka waitlam ha ka por ot: namar ka jingtieng ia ka waitlam kaba pynshitom kin phai noh iwei ia iwei ia iwei pat sha ki briew jong u , bad kin phet noh iwei ia iwei ia iwei pat sha la ka jong ka ri .

en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley , even before the dragon well , and to the dung port , and viewed the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and the gates thereof were consumed with fire .
kha: Ka dang long mynmiet katba nga la mihnoh na ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them shaphang sepngi bad leit shaphang shathie da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Umpohliew u Ïakjakor sha ka Khyrdop Synrum . Katba nga dang leit , nga khmih ïa ki kynroh ba la pra jong ka nongbah bad ki khyrdop ïa kiba la pynjot da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la mih noh ha ka por miet na ka khyrdop jong ka them, wat ha khmat u bsein bad ha ka jaka buh dewbilat, bad nga la peit ia ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem kiba la tyrkhong bad ki khyrdop jong ka ki la shah thang da ka ding .

en: And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .
kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Elijah , uba na Tishbe kaba ha Gilead , u la ong ha u Syiem Ahab ,  Ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei uba im jong ki Israel , ïa uba nga shakri , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snem kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u slap tad haduh ba ngan ong kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u Tishbite uba long na ki nongshong shnong Gilead u la ong ha u Ahab , Kumba U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel u im ha khmat jong nga , kan ym don dew ne slap ha kine ki snem , hynrei kat kum ka ktien jong nga .

en: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah , and said , Who are ye ? And they answered , We are the brethren of Ahaziah  ; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen .
kha: u ïakynduh katto katne ngut ki kur ki jait jong u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Phi dei kiei ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi dei ki kur ki jait jong u Ahasaïah . Ngi ïaleit sha Jesreel ban lehburom ïa ki khun jong ka syiem Jesebel bad ïa kiba ha ka longïing syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la iakynduh bad ki hynmen jong u Ahasaiah u syiem Judah bad u la ong: Phi long mano ? Ki la jubab , Ngi long ki hynmen jong u Ahasaiah; bad ngi hiar ban ai khublei ia ki khun syiem bad ki khun jong ka mahadei .

en: And furthermore , that ye have sent for men to come from far , unto whom a messenger was sent  ; and , lo , they came : for whom thou didst wash thyself , paintedst thy eyes , and deckedst thyself with ornaments ,
