kha: Ki phah bad ïai phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit khot sngewbha ïa ki rangbah ban wan na sha jngai bah , bad ki rangbah ki la wan . Baroh ar ngut shi para ki sum bad tah ïa ki  ñiuhmat bad deng ïa ki jingdeng mawkordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kham palat, ba phi la phah ia ki briew ban wan na jngai, ha kiba la phah ia u nonglam khubor; bad, ha kaba phi la leit: namar ia kiba me la sait ia lade, da kaba rong ia ki khmat jong me, bad da kaba pynitynnad ia lade da ki jingpynitynnad .

en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne , having put on their robes , in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .
kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem , kiba riam da ki jaiñphong syiem jong ki , ki dang ïashong ha la ki khet ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba habar ka khyrdop Samaria bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki dang ïathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Israel bad u syiem Judah u la shong uwei pa uwei ha ka khet jong u, da kaba phong ia ki jainkup jong ki, ha ka jaka kaba thylli ha ka jingkhang jong ka Samaria ; bad ki nongiathuhlypa baroh ki la iathuhlypa ha khmat jong ki .

en: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God of Israel , even a God to Israel : and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee .
kha: Ka nam jong me kan khraw , bad ki briew kin ong junom , ‘ U  Trai  Bakhrawbor baroh u long U Blei ha Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiem jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: To ai ba kan long kaba skhem wat, ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long kaba khraw junom, da kaba ong: U Trai jong ki paid u long U Blei jong ki Israel: bad to ai ba ka iing u Dabid jong u shakri jong me kan long kaba skhem ha khmat jong me .

en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , smote him , and he died  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Joash ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ar ngut na kine , u Josakar u khun jong u Shimeath bad u Jehosabad u khun jong u Shomer , ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïing kaba u la tei halor ka jaka ba la pyndap khyndew kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem , ha ka lynti kaba hiar sha Silla . Ïa u Joash la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Amasaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Joasar u khun u Shimeath bad u Jehosbad u khun u Shomer ki la shoh ia u, bad u la iap ; bad ki la tep ia u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u ha ka shnong u Dabid : bad u Amasaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee  ; before it came to pass I shewed it thee : lest thou shouldest say , Mine idol hath done them , and my graven image , and my molten image , hath commanded them .
kha: Bad kumta nga la ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei jong phi lah slem bah , da kaba pynbna ïa ki jingjia ha shuwa ba kin wan jia , ban khang ïa phi na kaba kam ba ki bleithaw bad ki durblei jong phi , ki la pynjia ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynbna ia ka ha me naduh kaba sdang: shuwa ba kan jia nga la pyni ia ka ha me: ioh ba me ong: ioh ba me ong: U bleithaw jong nga u la leh ia ki, bad ka dur ba la shna da nga, bad ka dur ba la shna da nga, u la hukum ia ki .

en: And he took the people , and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field , and looked , and , behold , the people were come forth out of the city  ; and he rose up against them , and smote them .
kha: kumta u ïalam ïa la ki briew , u pynkhlad ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , bad ki rieh apthap ha ki lyngkha . Haba u ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki mih shabar na ka nongbah , u la mih na la ka jakarieh ban pynïap ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki briew, bad u la phiah ia ki ha ki lai tylli ki kynhun, bad u la buh ia ki ha lyngkha, bad u la peit, bad, ha khmih, ki briew ki la mih na ka shnong ; bad u la ieng pyrshah ia ki, bad u la pynkhih ia ki .

en: And they come to Jerusalem : and Jesus went into the temple , and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves  ;
kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerusalem , U Jisu u la rung shapoh ka Templ bad u la sdang ban beh noh shabar ïa baroh kito kiba dang ïathied bad ïadie . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ pisa bad ïa ki jaka shong jong kito kiba ïadie paro ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la poi ha Jerusalem : bad U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka tempi, bad u la sdang ban beh noh ia kita kiba die bad thied ha ka tempi, bad u la pynkhih ia ki miej jong ki nongkylla pisa bad ki jaka shong jong ki kiba die ia ki paro ; .

en: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Deal gently for my sake with the young man , even with Absalom . And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom .
kha: U la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u Abishai , bad u Ittai :  Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Absalom .  Bad ki kynhun shipai baroh ki ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ai ïa kane ka hukum ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la hukum ia u Joab bad u Abisai bad u Itai, u da ong, To leh jem na ka bynta jong nga bad u samla, wat bad u Absalom . Bad ki briew baroh ki la iohsngew haba u syiem u la ai ia ki rangbah baroh kiba iadei bad u Absalom .

en: We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .
kha: Ngi pynshlur ïa phi ba phin ïai bteng ban pule shaphang U Blei , ban ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing hasem bad ki paralok jong phi shaphang kiei kiba phi pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da pud ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi pynshlur ia phi ban iai bteng ban tip ia U Blei , ban iathuh ia kiba sah ha iing ha sem bad ki paralok jong phi shaphang kaei kaba phi nang , bad ban iakynduh man ka por bad ngi ha ki jingiaseng Khristan jong ngi . hanu 10 :23-25 .

en: And David and his men went up , and invaded the Geshurites , and the Gezrites , and the Amalekites : for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land , as thou goest to Shur , even unto the land of Egypt .
kha: Ha kata ka por u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki ju leit hiarthma ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur , ki Girsi , bad ki Amalek , kiba la ju shong ha kata ka thain naduh mynhyndai . U ju leit lute ïa ka ri jong ki haduh Shur , baroh shi lynter lynti haduh ka ri Ijipt ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki la leit kiew bad ki la hiar thma ia ki Geshur bad ki Geshur bad ki Amalek: namar kita ki jaitbynriew ki long kiba la rim bha ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, kumba me leit sha Shur, wat sha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Now therefore hearken , O Israel , unto the statutes and unto the judgments , which I teach you , for to do them , that ye may live , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  God of your fathers giveth you .
kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga hikai ïa phi , te phin ïoh im bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to sngap ia ki ain bad ki jingbishar kiba nga hikai ia phi, na ka bynta ban leh ia ki, ba phin im bad ban leit shapoh bad ban bat ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sneng tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron . U ong  Namar ba phim don ka jingngeit kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka bor bakhuid jong nga ha khmat ki paid Israel , phin ym ïoh ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la kren ha u Moses bad u Aaron , Namar ba phim ngeit ia nga , ban pynkyntang ia nga ha khmat ki khun Israel , namarkata phin ym wanrah ia kane ka kynhun sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .

en: Then said Zebul unto him , Where is now thy mouth , wherewith thou saidst , Who is Abimelech , that we should serve him ? is not this the people that thou hast despised ? go out , I pray now , and fight with them .
kha: Nangta u Sebul u ong ha u ,  Shano kato ka jingkren kob jong me ? Dei ma me uba ong balei ngin shakri ïa une u Abimelekh . Kine ki dei ki briew kiba me la krenbeiñ . Khie mih mynta bad ïaleh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Zebul u la ong ha u, Hangno mynta ka shyntur jong me, ha kaba me ong, Uei u Abimelech, ba ngin shakri ia u ? hato kane kam dei ka briew kaba me la lehbein ? leit noh, nga duwai mynta, bad ialeh bad ki .

en: And the  Lord  gave them rest round about , according to all that he sware unto their fathers : and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them  ; the  Lord  delivered all their enemies into their hand .
kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ka jingshongsuk ha kata ka ri baroh kawei , kumba u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ym don uwei ruh na ki nongshun jong ki baroh uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki , namar U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ai ia ki ia ka jingjahthait sawdong, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba u la sngap jar ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki: bad ym don uwei ruh na ki nongshun jong ki baroh ha khmat jong ki; U Trai u la aiti ia ki nongshun jong ki baroh ha ka kti jong ki .

en: Therefore night shall be unto you , that ye shall not have a vision  ; and it shall be dark unto you , that ye shall not divine  ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them .
kha: Ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki nongïathuhlypa , ka sngi jong phi ka la jan kut noh ; ka sngi ka la jan wai na ka bynta jong phi . Namar ba phi ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga , phin ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ban ïathuhlypa , bad phin ym lah ban ïathuh lypa ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka miet kan long ha phi, ba phin ym don ka jingphohsniew bad kan dum ha phi, ba phin ym iathuh lypa; bad ka sngi kan hiar halor ki nongiathuhlypa, bad ka sngi kan dum halor jong ki .

en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Kawei na ki kan sar kum ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki khun shynrang jong u kin sa khih, bad kin lum lang ia ki shipai kiba khraw: bad uwei un wan shisha, bad un iaid lyngba: nangta un wan phai noh, bad un sa khih, wat sha ka kut jong u.

en: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns , and in Aroer and her towns , and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon , three hundred years ? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time ?
kha: La laispah snem ki Israel ki la shong ha Heshbon bad ha Aroer , bad ha ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki , bad ha ki nongbah baroh kiba harud ka wah Arnon . Balei baroh shi katta mem shym la shim pat ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ki Israel ki shong ha Heshbon bad ki shnong jong ka bad ha Aroer bad ki shnong jong ka bad ha ki shnong baroh kiba don ryngkat bad ki rud duriaw jong ka Arnon , lai spah snem ? balei phim shym la koit ia ki hapoh kata ka por ?

en: And it came to pass , when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter , till they were consumed , that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities .
kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa ki , wat la katto katne ki ïohlad ban shem jaka lait im hapoh ki kynroh shnong bad ba ki khlem shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia , haba u Joshua bad ki khun Israel ki la pynkut noh ia ki da kaba pyniap shibun eh ia ki haduh ba kin da shah pynjot , ba kiwei pat ki la rung ha ki nongbah ba la ker sawdong .

en: But if the priest s daughter be a widow , or divorced , and have no child , and is returned unto her father s house , as in her youth , she shall eat of her father s meat : but there shall no stranger eat thereof .
kha: Hynrei ka khun u lyngdoh kaba la long riewkynthei lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , ka bym don khun , bad kaba la wan phai ban shong ban sah bad la u kpa kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , ka lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam ba u kpa jong ka u ïohpdiang kum u lyngdoh . Dei tang uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka khun lyngdoh ka long kaba la duh noh ne kaba la iakhlad bad kaba khlem khun bad kaba la pynphai biang sha ka iing u kpa jong ka kumba ha ka por ba ka dang samla, kan bam ia ka doh jong u kpa jong ka: hynrei ym don u nongwei uba bam ia ka .

en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .
kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew kan ang ban pdiang ïa u bad kan phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar hok . Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynlong ïa kane ban jia .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynhiar ia ka jingpynim, phi ki bneng, na jrong, bad ai ba ki bneng kin tuid shapoh ka hok: ai ba ka khyndew kan plie, bad ai ba kin wanrah ia ka jingpynim, bad ai ba ka hok kan mih lang; nga U Trai nga la thaw ia ka .

en: And he took their king s crown from off his head , the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones : and it was set on David s head . And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance .
kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ka pansngiat ksiar na ka khlieh u blei Molekh , u bleithaw ki Ammon kaba khia kumba laiphew san kilo bad kaba don u mawkordor ha ka . U Dabid u la shim ïa u mawkordor bad u buh ïa u ha la ka pansngiat . U rah ruh shibun ki mar lute na ka nongbah
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shim ia ka khlieh syiem jong ki na ka khlieh jong u, ka jingkhia jong ka ka long ka talent ksiar ryngkat bad ki maw ba kordor: bad la buh ia ka ha ka khlieh jong u Dabid . Bad u la wanrah ia ka jinglute jong ka shnong ha ka jingbun .

en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years , year after year  ; and David enquired of the  Lord . And the  Lord  answered , It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he slew the Gibeonites .
kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Dabid , la don ka  nemsniew kaba jur kaba la neh haduh lai snem lynter . Kumta u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  shaphang kata bad U  Trai  u ong ,  U Saul bad ka longïing jong u ki long kiba rem ha ka jingpynïap briew ; u la pynïap ïa ki paid Gibeon .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka la don ka jingkyrduh ha ki sngi u Dabid lai snem, snem hadien snem bad u Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai . Bad U Trai u la jubab , Ka long na ka bynta u Saul bad na ka bynta ka iing kaba snam jong u, namar u la pyniap ia ki nong Gibeon .

en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :
kha: Haba ki leit ïathuh ïa kane ha u Jehu , u la ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia , mynba u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Elijah : ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka Jesebel ha ka thain Jesreel .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la wan biang, bad ki la iathuh ia u . Bad u la ong, Kane ka long ka ktien U Trai, kaba u la kren da u shakri jong u u Elijah u Tishbite, da kaba ong: Ha ka bynta jong u Jesel ki kulai kin bam ia ka doh jong u Jesbel:

en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and meted out heaven with the span , and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?
kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban thew ïa ka duriaw-bah da ki lynghoh kti lane ban thew ïa ka sahit bneng da ki kti jong u ? Don uno uno uba lah ban bat ïa ka khyndew jong ka pyrthei ha ka khuri lane thew ïa ki lumbah bad lumrit ha ki tarajur ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la thew ia ki um ha ka jingjylliew jong ka kti jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ka bneng da ka span , bad u la sngewthuh ia ka dewbilat jong ka khyndew ha ka jingthew , bad u la thew ia ki lum ha ka jingthew ?

en: And they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We have sinned , because we have forsaken the  Lord  , and have served Baalim and Ashtoreth : but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve thee .
kha: Nangta ki kyang sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap , bad ki ong , ‘ Ngi la leh pop , namar ngi la phai noh na me , ko  Trai  , bad ngi la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong u Baal bad ki Astarte . To pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ngin mane ïa me !’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la pyrta ha U Trai bad ki la ong: Ngi la leh pop namar ngi la iehnoh ia U Trai bad ngi la shakri ia u Baalim bad u Ashtoret: hynrei mynta to pyllait noh ia ngi na ka kti ki nongshun jong ngi bad ngin shakri ia me .

en: And Samuel said to Saul , Thou hast done foolishly : thou hast not kept the commandment of the  Lord  thy God , which he commanded thee : for now would the  Lord  have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever .
kha: Kata ka la dei ka jingleh bieit ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi . Lada phi la kohnguh , un jin da la shah ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ban synshar ïa ki Israel junom .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samuel u la ong ha u Saul: me la leh bieit: me la sumar ia ka hukum U Trai U Blei jong me, kaba u la hukum ia me: namar mynta u Trai un sa pynskhem ia ka hima jong me ha Israel junom .

en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .
kha: Lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei jong me lane ki aiñ jong ka hima , ïa u dei ban pynshitom mardor : da ka jingïap lane da ka jingringmraw lane da kaba knieh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lane da ka jingset byndi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno u bym leh ia ka hukum U Blei jong me bad ka hukum jong u syiem, to ai ba ka jingbishar kan long kaba kloi halor jong u, la ka long haduh ka jingiap ne ban shah beh ne ban shah set phatok .

en: And said , O man greatly beloved , fear not : peace be unto thee , be strong , yea , be strong . And when he had spoken unto me , I was strengthened , and said , Let my lord speak  ; for thou hast strengthened me .
kha: U la ong ,  U Blei u ieit ïa me , kumta wat ai ba kano kano kan pynkhuslai ïa me lane pynsheptieng ïa me .  Haba u la ong ïa kane , nga la nang kham sngewkhlaiñ shuh shuh bad ong ,  Ko rangbah , to ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong . Phi la pynlong ïa nga ban kham sngewkhlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong, ko briew baieit shibun, wat tieng: ka jingsuk ha me, to long uba khlain, hooid, to long uba khlain . Bad haba u la kren ia nga , nga la nang khlain , bad nga la ong , To ai ba u kynrad jong nga un kren; namar me la pynskhem ia nga .

en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .
kha: U Moses u la dep ai ïa ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ha kiwei pat ki ar jait bad shiteng jong kawei jait . ( Ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Joseph la bynta ha ki ar jait : Manasseh bad Ephraim . ) Wat la katta , u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka bynta jong ka jaka ïa ki Lebi . Tangba , ki la ïoh ïa ki nongbah ban shong ban sah , lem bad ki pyntha na ka bynta ki jingri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u Joseph ki long ar jait, u Manasseh bad u Ephraim: namarkata kim shym la ai bynta ia ki Lebi ha ka ri , lait noh tang ki nongbah ban shong ha ki jaka ri jingri jong ki bad na ka bynta ki masi jong ki bad na ka bynta ki jingdon jingem jong ki .

en: And if the household be too little for the lamb , let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls  ; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb .
kha: Lada ka longïing jong u ka don tang khyndiat ngut ki dkhot bad kam lah bam lut ïa uta u jingri , uta u rangbah un ïasam lang ïa uta u jingri bad uba marjan ïing jong u kat kum ka jingdon briew , bad kat kumba uwei uwei u briew u lah ban bam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka iing ka long kaba duna palat na ka bynta u khun langbrot , to ai ba ma u bad u para marjan jong u kin shim ia ka katkum ka jingbun ki mynsiem ; uwei pa uwei katkum ka jingbam jong u un khein ia u khun langbrot .

en: Shout against her round about : she hath given her hand : her foundations are fallen , her walls are thrown down : for it is the vengeance of the  Lord  : take vengeance upon her  ; as she hath done , do unto her .
kha: Pynjam ïa ka jingkyang thma baroh sawdong ka nongbah ! Mynta ka Babilon ka la wan pyndem . Ki kynroh jong ka ki la pei lyngba bad la pyntwa . Nga siew kylliang ïa ki nong Babilonia . Te to siew kylliang ïa ki , bad leh ïa ki kumba ki la leh ïa kiwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynkhih pyrshah ia ka sawdong jong ka: ka la ai ia ka kti jong ka: ki nongrim jong ka ki la hap: namar ka long ka jingpynshitom bein jong U Trai: to shim ia ka met jong ka kumba ka la leh, leh ia ka .

en: Then it shall be , that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me , when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , shall surely be the  Lord s  , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering .
kha: ngan kñia ïa ka jingainguh da u briew ne ka briew ba mih nyngkong eh na ka ïing jong nga ban wan tan ïa nga , ynda nga wan phai na ka jingjop . Ngan ai ha me ïa uta ne kata ka briew kum ka jingainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan long , ba kaei kaei kaba mih na ki jingkhang jong ka iing jong nga ban iakynduh ia nga , haba nga wan phai noh da kaba suk na ki khun Ammon , kan long shisha ka jong U Trai s , bad ngan aiti ia ka kum ka jingknia thang .

en: Then David said to Ornan , Grant me the place of this threshingfloor , that I may build an altar therein unto the  Lord  : thou shalt grant it me for the full price : that the plague may be stayed from the people .
kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Die noh ha nga ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong me , ba kumta nga lah ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem . Ngan siewdor pura ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u Ornan , Ai ia nga ia ka jaka jong kane ka jaka rep, ba ngan tei ia ka jingknia hangta ha U Trai: me ai ia ka ha ka dor kaba pura: ba ka khlam kan sah na ki briew .

en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .
kha: Ym don kino kino ki bleithaw jong ki jaitbynriew kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka suiñbneng da lade hi kam lah ban pynhap slap . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , namar me long uta uba leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato don mano mano ruh napdeng ki bym don pop kiba lah ban pynmih slap ? lane ki bneng kim lah ban pynmih slap ? em ma me , ko Trai jong ngi ? namarkata ngin ap ia me: namar me la leh ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: And they received of Moses all the offering , which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary , to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning .
kha: Ki la ïohpdiang na u ïa kita ki jingai baroh ba ki Israel ki la wallam na ka bynta ban tei ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang . Hynrei ki Israel ki nang ïai wallam sha u Moses ïa ki jingainguh jong ki man ka step .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ioh na u Moses ia ka jingainguh baroh kaba ki khun Israel ki la wanrah na ka bynta ka kam jong ka jaka kyntang . Ki la wanrah shuh shuh ha u ia ki jingainguh khlem jingsiew man ka step .

en: And command thou the people , saying , Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau , which dwell in Seir  ; and they shall be afraid of you : take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore :
kha: U la ong ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kine ki jinghikai : ‘ Mynta phin ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri lum Edom , ka ri ki kur ki jait jong phi , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me hukum ia ki briew da kaba ong: Phi dei ban iaid lyngba ki rud duriaw jong phi ki khun Iso kiba shong ha Seir ; bad kin tieng ia phi: to sumar bha ia lade namarkata:

en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites , and of the priests , and of the chief of the fathers of Israel , for the judgment of the  Lord  , and for controversies , when they returned to Jerusalem .
kha: Ha Jerusalem , u Jehoshaphat u thung ïa ki Lebi , ki lyngdoh bad katto katne ki riewkhmat ka shnong kum ki nongbishar ha ki kam ba ïadei bad ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum U  Trai  lane ki jingïakajia ba dei ïa ka aiñ hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ha Jerusalem u Jehoshaphat u la buh ia ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh bad ki rangbah jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki Israel na ka bynta ka jingbishar U Trai bad na ka bynta ki jingiakren haba ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem .

en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .
kha: Dei ban don uwei u shylluit syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lai jur ki tnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan don ka knop hapoh ar tylli ki tnat jong kajuh, bad ka knop hapoh ar tylli ki tnat jong kajuh, kat kum ki hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na ka sharak .

en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !
kha: Katno ka long kaba phylla ban ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khubor babha , ka khubor jong ka jingsuk ! U pynbna ïa ka jingjop bad u ong ïa ka Seïon ,  U Blei jong phi u long u syiem !
translated_en_to_kha: Katno ki long kiba itynnad ha ki lum jong uta uba wanrah ia ka khubor babha, uba pynmih ia ka jingsuk ; kaba wanrah ia ka khubor babha, uba pynmih ia ka jingpynim ; kaba ong ha u Seion , U Blei jong me u synshar !

en: And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof , and the pillars thereof , and sockets thereof ,
kha: Na ka jait u Merari ki mih ki longïing jong u Mahli bad u Mushi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka jingkit jong ki, kat kum ka jingshakri jong ki baroh ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng; ki board jong ka iingjain bad ki bar jong ka bad ki maw jong ka bad ki socket jong ka .

en: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army , because of him that passeth by , and because of him that returneth : and no oppressor shall pass through them any more : for now have I seen with mine eyes .
kha: Ngan ap phira ïa ka ri jong nga bad ngan ym shah ïa ki kynhun shipai ban ïaid lyngba jong ka . Ngan ym shah shuh ïa ki nongbanbor ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga . Nga la ïohi haduh katno ki briew jong nga ki la shahshitom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan iaid kylleng ka iing jong nga namar ki shipai jong nga: bad namar uta uba wan phai: bad ym don u nongpynshitom bein shuh: namar mynta nga la iohi da ki khmat jong nga .

en: Nevertheless they were disobedient , and rebelled against thee , and cast thy law behind their backs , and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee , and they wrought great provocations .
kha: Hynrei ki briew jong me ki ïaleh pyrshah bad leh bymkohnguh ïa me ; ki phai dien noh na ka Hukum jong me . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba maham ïa ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh ki la long ki bym kohnguh ia me bad ki la leh pyrshah ia me, bad ki la bret ia ka hukum jong me shadien jong ki, bad ki la pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa jong me kiba la sakhi pyrshah ia ki ban pynphai ia ki sha me, bad ki la leh ia ki jingpynkhih kiba khraw .

en: And he said , If now I have found grace in thy sight , O Lord , let my Lord , I pray thee , go among us  ; for it is a stiffnecked people  ; and pardon our iniquity and our sin , and take us for thine inheritance .
kha: U la ong ,  Ko  Trai  , lada me sngewbha shisha ïa nga , nga kyrpad ïa me ban wan ryngkat bad ngi . Kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop , hynrei map ïa ka jingbymman bad ka pop jong ngi , bad pdiang ïa ngi kum ki briew ki jong me hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Lada mynta nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, ko Trai, to ai ba U Trai jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, to leit hapdeng jong ngi ; namar ka long ka briew kaba la tyrkhong ; bad map ia ka jingbymhok jong ngi bad ka pop jong ngi , bad to shim ia ngi na ka bynta ka pateng jong me .

en: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance , and begin not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
kha: To leh ïa kita kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la phai noh na ki pop jong phi . Bad wat sdang ban ong hapdeng jong phi hi ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham !
translated_en_to_kha: To wanrah namarkata ia ki soh kiba dei hok ban kylla bamut, bad wat sdang ban ong hapoh jong phi, Ngi don u Abraham ha u kpa jong ngi: namar nga ong ha phi: Ba U Blei U lah ban pynkha khun ia u Abraham .

en: For their mother hath played the harlot : she that conceived them hath done shamefully : for she said , I will go after my lovers , that give me my bread and my water , my wool and my flax , mine oil and my drink .
kha: Ma ka hi ka la ong ,  Ngan leit sha kiba ieit ki jong nga — ki pynbiang ïa nga ka jingbam bad ka um , u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen , ka umphniang Olib bad ka waiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kmie jong ki ka la ialehkai ia ka kam runar: ma ka kaba la kha ia ki ka la leh lehrain: namar ka la ong , Ngan leit bud ia ki nongieit jong nga , kiba ai ia nga ia u kpu jong nga bad ka um jong nga, ka snieh langbrot jong nga bad ka um jong nga .

en: And an highway shall be there , and a way , and it shall be called The way of holiness  ; the unclean shall not pass over it  ; but it shall be for those : the wayfaring men , though fools , shall not err therein .
kha: Kan long ka lynti bah hangta , ba la khot  Ka Lynti jong ka Jingkhuid .  Yn ym don nongpop u ban ïaid ha kata ka lynti ; ym don ki riewbieit ki ban ïalam bakla ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lynti bah kan don hangta, bad ka lynti, bad yn khot ia ka Ka lynti jong ka jingkhuid ; ka bymkhuid kan ym iaid lait ia ka ; hynrei kan long na ka bynta kita: ki briew kiba iaid lynti, wat la ki bieit, kin ym bakla ha ka .

en: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .
kha: Ka kynhun kiba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei kan wan phai bad jop ïa ka Phoenisia jngai bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sarephath . Kiba shah ringmraw na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis kin kurup ïa ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jinglong mraw jong kane ka kynhun ki Israel kan long ka jong ki nong Kanaan, wat haduh ka por ba la shah set phatok ha Jerusalem kaba don ha Sepharat, kan long ka jong ki nongbah jong ka ri Sepngi .

en: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel , whom I commanded to feed my people Israel , saying , Why build ye not me an house of cedar ?
kha: Ha ka jingleit jong nga baroh bad ki paid Israel ngam pat ju ong ha uno uno na ki nongïalam ba nga la thung , balei ba kim shym la tei ïa nga ka templ kaba thaw da ki dieng Kedar .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ki jaka baroh ha kaba nga la iaid bad ki khun Israel baroh nga la kren ia ka ktien bad uno uno na ki jait Israel , ia kiba nga la hukum ban ai bam ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel , da kaba ong , Balei phim tei ia nga ia ka iing cedar ?

en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .
kha: Kata ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat jong uwei pa uwei baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba kata ka kynthei ka la iohi ba kam shym la buhrieh , ka la wan khih bad ka la hap ha khmat jong u , ka la pynbna ha u ha khmat ki briew baroh balei ka la ktah ia u bad kumno ka la koit noh mardor .

en: And let it be , when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself : for then shall the  Lord  go out before thee , to smite the host of the Philistines .
kha: Haba me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïaid halor ki kliar dieng , te tur ïaleh ïa ki namar ngan ïaid ha shuwa jong me ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to long, haba me iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ka jingleit sha ki tduh jong ki dieng sohjew, ba nangta me pynkhih ia lade: namar nangta U Trai un mih noh ha khmat jong me, ban pynkhih ia ka kynhun jong ki Philistia .

en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host , which was with him , Go now through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , and number ye the people , that I may know the number of the people .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u :  Khie leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi ha kylleng ki jait Israel na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip ki don haduh katno .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u syiem u la ong ha u Joab u rangbah shipai uba don ryngkat bad u, To leit mynta lyngba ki jait Israel baroh, naduh Dan haduh Beersheba, bad to khein ia ki briew, ba ngan tip ia ka jingbun ki briew .

en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .
kha: Uwei u samla uba kyrteng u Ïutikhos u la shong ha ka jingkhangïit , bad katba u Paul u dang kren , u Ïutikhos u la shoh samthiah jur , kat haduh ba u la ïohthiah lyngngai bad u la hap na ka mala kaba lai sha madan . Haba ki la rah ïa u , u la ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shong ha ka jingkhang uwei u samla uba kyrteng u Eutycus, u la iohthiah lyngngai: bad katba u Paul u dang ialap slem , u la ngam jyllop bad u la hap na ka jaka kaba lai, bad la shim ia u .

en: Because he hath appointed a day , in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained  ; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men , in that he hath raised him from the dead .
kha: Naba u la buh ka sngi ha kaba un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jinglehhok , da uta u briew ïa uba u la jied . U la ai ka jingpynshisha ïa kane ha uwei pa uwei da kaba pynmihpat ïa uta u briew na ka jingïap !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u la buh ia ka sngi , ha kaba un bishar ia ka pyrthei ha ka hok da uta u briew uba u la buh ; na uba u la ai jingkular ia ki briew baroh , ha kaba u la pynmih ia u na kiba iap .

en: And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .
kha: Ho-oid , to  ki ong ,  ngin shu teh ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . Ngin ym pynïap ïa me .  Kumta ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na kata ka krem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la kren ia u, ki da ong, Em, hynrei ngin teh skhem ia me, bad ngin aiti ia me ha ka kti jong ki: hynrei thikna ba ngin ym pyniap ia me . Ki la teh ia u da ki ar tylli ki lynti thymmai, bad ki la pynmih ia u na u maw .

en: And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .
kha: Katba u Abimelekh bad ka kynhun jong u ki tur pynkloi sha khmat ban ïada ïa ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynhun ki tur ïaleh ïa ki briew hapoh lyngkha bad ki pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Abimelech bad ka kynhun kaba don ryngkat bad u, ki la mareh sha khmat bad ki la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ka shnong: bad ki ar tylli ki kynhun ki la mareh sha ki briew baroh kiba don ha ki lyngkha .

en: And the children of Israel , which were come again out of captivity , and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land , to seek the  Lord  God of Israel , did eat ,
kha: Ïa ki jingkñia la bam da baroh ki Israel kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw bad da baroh kito kiba la iehnoh ïa ki rukom mane blei thala jong kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri bad kiba la wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel kiba la mih biang na ka jingshah set phatok bad baroh kiba la pyniakhlad ia lade ha ki na ka jingjakhlia jong ki nongwei ban wad ia U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel ki la bam .

en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .
kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane ïa me bad halor ki briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki briew jong me ; ki la pynjot khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ha ka jingjot jingpra .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynngam ia ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym ithuh ia me, bad halor ki longiing ki bym khot ia ka kyrteng jong me: namar ki la bam ia u Jakob, bad ki la bam ia u, bad ki la bam ia u, bad ki la pynlong ia ka jaka shong jong u ban jah rngai noh .

en: So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .
kha: Kumta u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynshong ïa u Solomon halor u khashor jong u Syiem Dabid bad ki la synran ïa u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Nadaok u lyngdoh bad u Natha u nongiathuhlypa, bad u Benaiah u khun u Jehoiada, bad ki Kheriet bad ki Kheriet ki la hiar, bad u Solomon u la shong ha u syiem u Dabid u la wanrah ia u sha Gihon .

en: And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .
kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynta u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong phi , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u, Wat tieng: namar ngan pyni shisha ia me na ka bynta u Jonathan u kpa jong me, bad ngan pynphai biang ia me ia ka ri baroh kawei jong u kpa jong me; bad me dei ban bam ia u kpu ha ka miej jong nga man ka por .

en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
kha: Nangta to ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ong ha ki , Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ha khmih , ngan shim ia ki khun Israel na ki nongwei , ha kaba ki la leit noh , bad ngan lum ia ki na kawei pa kawei ka liang , bad ngan wanrah ia ki sha la ka jong ka ri:

en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .
kha: Hynrei nga la kular ha phi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi , bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei nga la ong ha phi , Phin ioh pateng ia ka ri jong ki bad ngan ai ha phi ban ioh ia ka, ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la pyniakhlad ia phi na kiwei pat ki briew .

en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said , Rise thou , and fall upon us : for as the man is , so is his strength . And Gideon arose , and slew Zebah and Zalmunna , and took away the ornaments that were on their camels  necks .
kha: Nangta u Sebah bad u Salmunna ki ong ha u Gideon ,  Shim , pynïap hi ma phi ïa ngi . Ka dei ïa u rangbah ban leh ïa ka kam rangbah .  Kumta u Gideon u la pynïap ïa ki bad u shim ïa ki jingdeng kiba ha ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Sebah bad u Zalmunna ki la ong, To kiew, bad to hap halor jong ngi: namar kumba u briew u long, kumjuh ruh ka bor jong u. U Gideon u la ieng bad u la pyniap ia u Sebah bad u Zalmunna, bad u la weng noh ia ki jingdeng kiba don ha ki ryndang jong ki kulai jong ki .

en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest go into it to see the plague , that all that is in the house be not made unclean : and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house :
kha: U lyngdoh un hukum ba dei ban pynmih lut napoh ïing ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh shuwa ba un leit khmih ïa kata ka jingbthuh ; lym kumta , yn pynbna ba baroh kaba don ha kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid . Nangta un sa leit rung shapoh ïing bad un khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ba kin thylli ia ka iing shuwa ba u lyngdoh un leit shapoh ban peit ia ka khlam, ba baroh kaba don ha ka iing kan ym long kaba jakhlia: bad hadien kata u lyngdoh un leit shapoh ban peit ia ka iing:

en: So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my lambs .
kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam , U Jisu u la ong ïa u Simon Petros ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me kham ieit ma me ïa nga ban ïa kaba kine kiwei ki ieit ?   Ho-oid , ko Trai ,  u la jubab ,  me tip ba nga ieit ïa me .  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki khunlangbrot jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta haba ki la ia bam ja miet, U Jisu u ong ha u Simon Petros, u Simon, u khun u Jona, me ieit ia nga kham palat ia kine ? U ong ha u, Hooid, ko Trai me tip ba nga ieit ia me . U ong ha u, To ai bam ia ki langbrot jong nga .

en: Now therefore , if ye have done truly and sincerely , in that ye have made Abimelech king , and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house , and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands  ;
kha: Mynta te ,  u Jotham u bteng ,  Hato phi lehhok bad da kaba khuid mynsiem shisha haba phi thung syiem ïa u Abimelekh ? Hato phi kynmaw burom ïa u Gideon bad lehbha ïa ka longïing jong u , kumba ki kam jong u ki dei ban ïoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, lada phi la leh shisha bad shisha, ha kaba phi la pynlong syiem ia u Abimelech, bad lada phi la leh bha ia u Jerubaal bad ka iing jong u, bad phi la leh ia u kat kum ka hok jong u;

en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?
kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kylli ,  Hato une um dei uto uba ha Jerusalem u la pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa uta U Jisu ? Bad hato um shym wan hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu ban kem ïa kito ki briew bad ban ïalam pat ïa ki sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei baroh kiba la iohsngew ia u ki la lyngngoh bad ki la ong: Hato une um dei ma u uba la pynjot ia kita kiba la khot ia kane ka kyrteng ha Jerusalem bad u la wan hangne na ka bynta kata ka jingthmu, ba un wanrah ia ki sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ?

en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them , and shall pray unto the  Lord  toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :
kha: Haba me hukum ïa ki briew jong me ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki bad ba ki duwai ha me , hangno hangno ha kaba ki don , ki da phai khmat sha kane ka nongbah ïa kaba me la jied bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki briew jong me ki leit sha ka thma jong ki, ha kano kano ka jaka ba me phah ia ki, bad to duwai ha U Trai sha ka shnong kaba me la jied, bad sha ka iing kaba nga la tei na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong me:

en: And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .
kha: U Jakob u buh pynkhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang bad u pynphai ïa ki khmat jong ki sha kito kiba thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka rukom u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Laban .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la pyniakhlad ia ki langbrot bad u la buh ia ki khmat jong ki kynhun langbrot sha ka liang kaba la tyrkhong bad baroh ki rong saw ha ka kynhun langbrot jong u Laban; bad u la buh ia la ki jong ki langbrot hi dalade , bad um shym la buh ia ki ha ki masi jong u Laban .

en: And when he saw a fig tree in the way , he came to it , and found nothing thereon , but leaves only , and said unto it ,  Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever .  And presently the fig tree withered away .
kha: U la ïohi ïa u dieng Dumbur harud ka lynti bad u la leit sha u , hynrei um shem ei ei ha u lait noh tang ki sla . Kumta u la ong ha u dieng ,  Men ym pynmih soh shuh !  Mar kumta hi u dieng Dumbur u la ïap tyrkhong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la iohi ia u dieng sohjew ha lynti , u la wan shajan jong u, bad um lap ei ei ha kata ka por , hynrei u la ong ha u , Wat ai ba u soh un mih ha me nang kiew sha khmat . Bad mynta u dieng sohjew u la tyrkhong noh .

en: At that time will I bring you again , even in the time that I gather you : for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth , when I turn back your captivity before your eyes , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan wallam sha ïing ïa ki briew jong pha kiba la shah pynsakma ; ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba pawnam ha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba manbha pat .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por ngan wanrah biang ia phi, wat ha ka por ba nga lum ia phi: namar ngan pynlong ia phi ka kyrteng bad ka jingiaroh hapdeng ki briew baroh jong ka khyndew , haba nga pynphai biang ia ka jinglong mraw jong phi ha khmat ki khmat jong phi , ong U Trai .

en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh , and on all his servants , and on all the people of his land : for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them . So didst thou get thee a name , as it is this day .
kha: Me pynjia ki kambah baphylla pyrshah ïa u Pharoah , pyrshah ïa ki rangbah synshar ki briew jong ka ri jong u , namar me tip kumno ki la banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong me . Me la jop ha kata ka por , ka nam kaba me dang don ha kane ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki dak bad ki jingphylla ha u Pharaoh, bad ha ki shakri jong u baroh: namar me tip ba ki la leh sngew sarong ia ki . Kumta me la ioh ia ka kyrteng, kumba ka long mynta ka sngi .

en: And the same hour was there a great earthquake , and the tenth part of the city fell , and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand : and the remnant were affrighted , and gave glory to the God of heaven .
kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat hi la jia ka jingkhih jumai kaba jur ; shi bynta na ka shiphew bynta jong ka nongbah la pynjot , bad hynñiew hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïap . Kita kiwei pat ki briew ki la sngewtriem bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw U Blei jong ka bneng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata kajuh ka kynta la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba khraw, bad ka shi bynta jong ka nongbah ka la hap, bad ha ka jingkhynñiuh jumai la pyniap ïa ki briew hynriew hajar: bad kiba sah ki la shah pynmong bad ki la ai burom ïa U Blei jong ka bneng .

en: And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,
kha: U Moses u kyrpad jur ïa U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhot dieng , ïa uba u la bret hapoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla long kaba bit ban dih . Dei hangta ba U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa ki aiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U la pyrta ha U Trai ; bad U Trai u la pyni ia u ia u dieng, uba haba u la theh ha ki um, ki um ki la sngur: hangta u la pynlong ia ki da ka ain bad ka hukum , bad hangta u la pynshisha ia ki .

en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir , utterly to slay and destroy them : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir , every one helped to destroy another .
kha: Ki Amon bad ki Moab ki tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Edom bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad hadien kata , ki ïaphai pyrshah para ma ki ha ka jingïaleh bashyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun jong u Ammon bad u Moab ki la ieng pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong u lum Seir, da kaba pyniap bad pynjot ia ki: bad haba ki la pynkut noh ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Seir , uwei pa uwei u la iarap ban pynjot ia uwei pat .

en: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king , and had neither dressed his feet , nor trimmed his beard , nor washed his clothes , from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace .
kha: Nangta u Mephibosheth , u ksiew jong u Saul , u wan hiar ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem . Um shym la sait ïa la ki kjat , lane khi ïa la u  ñiuhtmoh , lane sait ïa la ki jaiñ , naduh ka por ba u syiem u la iehnoh ïa ka Jerusalem haduh ba un da wan phai pat ha ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mephibosheth u khun u Saul u la wan hiar sha u syiem bad um shym la phong ia ki kjat jong u, lymne um shym la ot ia ka ryndang jong u, lymne um shym la sait ia ki jain jong u, naduh ka sngi ba u syiem u la leit noh haduh ka sngi ba u wan phai biang ha ka jingsuk .

en: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
kha: Hynrei haba ka por jong ngi bad ki ka la kut , ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la nang leit ha ka jingleit jong ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem bad ngi na ka nongbah sha ka rud duriaw , ha kaba ngi la ïadem khohsiew bad duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda ngi la pyndep ia kita ki sngi , ngi la leit noh bad ki la iaid lynti bad baroh ki la wanrah ia ngi ha ka lynti jong ngi, bad ki tnga bad ki khun, haduh ba ngin da mih na ka shnong : bad ngi la dem khrup ha rud duriaw bad ngi la duwai .

en: Blessed be the  Lord  , that hath given rest unto his people Israel , according to all that he promised : there hath not failed one word of all his good promise , which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant .
kha: U da ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la ai ka jingsuk ïa ki briew jong u , kumba u la kular ban leh . U la bat ïa baroh ki jingkular basbun kaba u la pynlong lyngba u Moses u shakri jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: La kyrkhu ia U Trai uba la ai jingjahthait ia ki briew jong u Israel, kat kum ka jingkular baroh: ym shym la pep ia kawei ruh ka ktien na ka jingkular babha jong u baroh, kaba u la kular da ka kti u Moses u shakri jong u .

en: For before these days there was no hire for man , nor any hire for beast  ; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction : for I set all men every one against his neighbour .
kha: Ha shuwa kata ka por ym don mano mano ba lah bor ban wai la ïa ki mrad lymne ki briew , ban ym don mano mano ba lait na ki nongshun jong u . Nga la pynphai ïa ki briew pyrshah iwei ïa iwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar shuwa kine ki sngi ym shym la don ka jingsiew na ka bynta u briew, ne ka jingsiew na ka bynta u mrad ; bad ym shym la don ka jingsuk ia uta uba la mih ne wan rung namar ka jingjynjar: namar nga la buh ia ki briew baroh iwei ia iwei ia iwei pat .

en: And the king of Syria said , Go to , go , and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel . And he departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , and six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of raiment .
kha: U syiem u ong ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Israel bad rah ïa kane ka shithi sha u .  Kumta u Naaman u leit , u da rah laiphew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot ksiar , bad shiphew riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem Syria u la ong, To leit, bad ngan phah shithi sha u syiem Israel . U la leit noh bad u la shim bad u shiphew talent ka rupa bad hynriew hajar tylli ki ksiar bad shiphew tylli ki jain rong .

en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee  ; and I will give thee riches , and wealth , and honour , such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee , neither shall there any after thee have the like .
kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa kata ka jingstad bad ka jingtip . Nalor kata , ngan ai ruh ha me bun ka spah , ka jingkynshew , bad ka nam ban ïa uno uno u syiem uba la ju ïoh mynshuwa lane un ïoh biang pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingstad bad ka jingtip la ai ha me ; bad ngan ai ia me ia ka spah bad ka spah bad ka burom kumba ym don uwei ruh na ki syiem uba la don ha khmat jong me, lymne hadien jong me un ym don uwei ruh uba kum uta .

en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .
kha: Ynda la dap shiteng sngi u Elijah u la sdang ban kren biria ïa ki :  Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Lehse u dang phohsniew lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang leit jingleit ! Lane lehse u dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban kyrsiew ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por shiteng sngi, ba u Elijah u la rkhie bein ia ki, bad u la ong, To pyrta jam: namar u long u blei ; u kren , ne u dang bud , ne u dang iaid lynti , ne u la thiah lyngngai , bad u dei ban shah pynkynjah .

en: But in the last days it shall come to pass , that the mountain of the house of the  Lord  shall be established in the top of the mountains , and it shall be exalted above the hills  ; and people shall flow unto it .
kha: Ha ki sngi ki ban wan u lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng un long uba jrong tam na baroh , uba tyllep ïa ki lumrit baroh . Ki jaitbynriew kiba bun kin wan tuid sha u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ki sngi ba khatduh kan sa jia ba u lum jong ka iing U Trai un sa skhem ha jrong jong ki lum , bad un sa kiew halor ki lum ; bad ki briew kin tuid sha ka .

en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .
kha: Men leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba me la leh ïa ka Jerikho bad u syiem jong ka , hynrei ha kane ka sien me lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban leh ia ka Ai bad u syiem jong ka kumba me la leh ia ka Jerikoh bad u syiem jong ka: tang ia ka jingjot jong ka bad ki masi jong ka: to buh ia ka jaka sah ha ka shnong hadien jong ka .

en: Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
kha: Man la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ïa ki bad un ieh ba kin meh haduh mynstep ha khmat U  Trai  shabar ka jingkah kaba ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban leh pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Khlem ka jingtap jong ka jingsakhi, ha ka jaka jong ka jingiaseng, u Aaron un hukum ia ka naduh ka por janmiet haduh ka por mynstep ha khmat U Trai man ka por: kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi .

en: At the same time came to them Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , and said thus unto them , Who hath commanded you to build this house , and to make up this wall ?
kha: Mar kumta hi , u Tattenai , u lat ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki para rangbah synshar , ki wan sha Jerusalem bad ki dawa bad ong :  Mano ba ai hukum ïa phi ban tei ïa kane ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Lat ka jylla ha kane ka liang ka wah bad u Shetharbozenai bad ki paralok jong ki bad u la ong kumta ha ki , Mano ba la hukum ia phi ban tei ia kane ka iing bad ban pynlong ia kane ka kynroh ?

en: Obey them that have the rule over you , and submit yourselves : for they watch for your souls , as they that must give account , that they may do it with joy , and not with grief : for that is unprofitable for you .
kha: To kohnguh ïa ki nongïalam jong phi da kaba bud ïa ki hukum jong ki . Ki sharai ïa ki mynsiem jong phi khlem da thait , namar ki dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa ka kam jong ki sha U Blei . Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki , kin trei ïa ka kam da kaba kmen ; lada phim kohnguh , kin trei ïa ka kam da kaba sngewsih , bad kata kan ym ïarap ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Obey ia kita kiba don ka jingsynshar halor jong phi, bad kiba pyndem ia lade: namar ki peit ia ki mynsiem jong phi, kumba ki dei ban ai jingkhein, ba kin leh ia kata da ka jingkmen, bad ym da ka jingsngewsih: namar kata ka long kaba khlem jingmyntoi ia phi .

en: Is Ephraim my dear son ? is he a pleasant child ? for since I spake against him , I do earnestly remember him still : therefore my bowels are troubled for him  ; I will surely have mercy upon him , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ko Israel , phi long u khun ba-ieit eh jong nga , u khun uba nga ieit tam . Man ba nga ong ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi da ka jingieit . Ka dohnud jong nga ka leit sha phi ; ngan isynei ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato u Ephraim u khun baieit jong nga ? hato u long u khynnah uba sngewbha ? namar namar ba nga dang kynmaw ia u: namarkata ki bniat jong nga ki la tyrkhong na ka bynta jong u ; nga thikna ba ngan isynei ia u, ong U Trai .

en: And he put upon him the coat , and girded him with the girdle , and clothed him with the robe , and put the ephod upon him , and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod , and bound it unto him therewith .
kha: U pynphong ïa ka sopti bad pynkup ïa ka barandi ha u Aaron , bad u pynteh ïa u panpoh ha ka syngkai jong u . U pynphong ïa ka ephod ha u , bad u pynskhem ïa ka da kaba teh ïa ki jingteh ba la thain itynnat ha ka syngkai jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U la buh halor jong u ia ka jainkup, bad u la pyndait ia u da ka jainkup, bad u la phong ia u da ka jainkup, bad u la pyndait ia u da ka jainkup kaba sngewtynnad jong u, bad u la teh ia ka ha u da kata ka jainkup .

en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :
kha: ngan jynrat noh ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïing ïa kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin sa shah rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ngan ot noh ia ki Israel na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ia kane ka iing kaba nga la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, ngan bret noh na ka khmat jong nga ; bad ki Israel kin long ka nuksa bad ka ktien hapdeng ki briew baroh:

en: And Gehazi passed on before them , and laid the staff upon the face of the child  ; but there was neither voice , nor hearing . Wherefore he went again to meet him , and told him , saying , The child is not awaked .
kha: U Gehasi u la nang leit sha khmat , bad u buh ïa u diengduh jong u Elisha halor u khynnah , hynrei ym don jingsawa ei ei lane kano kano ka dak ba don jingim . Kumta u la leit phai ban ïashem ïa u Elisha bad u ong ,  U khynnah um shym kyndit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Gehasi u la iaid shakhmat ha khmat jong ki, bad u la buh ia u dieng ha ka khmat jong u khynnah; hynrei ym shym la don sur ne jingsngap . Kumta u la leit phai biang ban iakynduh ia u, bad u la iathuh ha u, u khynnah um shym la kyndit .

en: So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?
kha: Kumta u Haman u wan shapoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Don uba nga kwah eh ban lehburom . Kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta une u briew ?  U Haman u la pyrkhat ha lade ,  Mynta ïano u syiem u kwah eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa nga keiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Haman u la wan rung . Bad u syiem u la ong ha u, Kaei kaba dei ban leh ia uta u briew uba u syiem u sngewbha ban burom ? Mynta u Haman u la pyrkhat ha ka dohnud jong u , Hano u syiem un sngewbha ban leh kham bun ban ia nga ?

en: And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .
kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad hangta phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei kiba da ka dieng bad da u maw , ki blei kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju mane mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai un pynphriang ia me hapdeng ki briew baroh, naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka khyndew haduh kawei pat ka khyndew bad hangta men shakri ia kiwei pat ki blei kiba me ne ki kpa tymmen jong me kim shym la ithuh, wat ia u dieng bad u maw .

en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me , he hath crushed me , he hath made me an empty vessel , he hath swallowed me up like a dragon , he hath filled his belly with my delicates , he hath cast me out .
kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u la pynkut ïa ka Jerusalem bad bam ïa ka . U pynthylli ïa ka nongbah kum ïa u khra ; kum u mrad kynsha u la nguid ïa ka . U la shim kat ïa kaba u kwah bad bret noh ïa kiba sah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Nebuchadrezzar u syiem Babilon u la bam ia nga, u la pynkhih ia nga, u la pynlong ia nga ka khiew kaba thylli, u la sngap jar ia nga kum u bsein, u la pyndap ia ka kpoh jong u da ki bniat jong nga, u la bret noh ia nga .

en: Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .
kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad leit bad ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar Assyria u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Eliakim u khun u Hilkiah uba la long halor ka iing bad u Shebna u nongthoh bad u Joah u khun u Asaph u nongthoh u la wan sha u Hesekaiah bad ki jain jong ki, bad u la iathuh ha u ia ki ktien u Rabsakeh .

en: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him , neither in this world , neither in the world to come .
kha: Uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew u lah ban ïoh jingmap ; hynrei uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap — mynta lane junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba kren ia ka ktien pyrshah ia u Khun u briew , yn map ia u: hynrei uno uno uba kren pyrshah ia U Mynsiem Bakhuid , yn ym map ia u, lymne ha kane ka pyrthei , lymne ha ka pyrthei ban sa wan .

en: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt , I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house , that my name might be therein  ; but I chose David to be over my people Israel .
kha: ‘ Naduh ka por ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , ngam shym la jied kano kano ka nongbah na baroh ka ri Israel ban tei hangta ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Hynrei nga la jied ïa me , u Dabid , ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga .’
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh ka sngi ba nga la wanrah ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel na Ijipt , ngam shym la jied ia ka shnong na ki jait Israel baroh ban tei ia ka iing , ba ka kyrteng jong nga kan long hangta ; hynrei nga la jied ia u Dabid ban long halor ki briew jong nga ki Israel .

en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive , and her father s household , and all that she had  ; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day  ; because she hid the messengers , which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .
kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la pyllait im ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka baroh , namar ba ka la pynrieh ïa ki ar ngut ki nongsyntiat kiba u la phah sha Jerikho . ( Ki khun ki ksiew jong ka ki shong ki sah ha Israel haduh kane ka sngi . )
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la pynim ia ka Rahab kaba im bad ka iing jong u kpa jong ka, bad baroh kaba ka don; bad ka la shong ha Israel haduh kane ka sngi; namar ka la buhrieh ia ki nonglam khubor kiba u Joshua u la phah ban leit jngoh ia ka Jerikho .

en: And Samson called unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , remember me , I pray thee , and strengthen me , I pray thee , only this once , O God , that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes .
kha: Te u Samson u duwai ,  A  Trai  Bakhraw , to kynmaw ïa nga , ai ha nga ïa ka bor sa tang shisien , khnang ba tang da kane ngan lah ban pynhiarkput ïa ki Philistia namar ba ki la khlaw ïa ki khmat jong nga baroh ar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Samson u la khot ia U Trai bad u la ong, ko Trai Blei, to kynmaw ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, bad pynskhem ia nga, nga kyrpad ia me, tang ia kane shisien, ko Blei, ba ngan sa shah pynrem shisien na ki Philistia na ka bynta ki ar tylli ki khmat jong nga .

en: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon , make the watch strong , set up the watchmen , prepare the ambushes : for the  Lord  hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon .
kha: Ai ïa ka dak ban tur ïaleh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Babilon . Pynkhlaiñ ïa ki nongap ! Buh ïa ki nongap phira ! Buh ïa ki rangbah ban apthap !  U  Trai  u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la ong ban un leh ïa ki briew jong ka Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynsah ia ka lama ha ki kynroh jong ka Babilon, pynlong ia ka jingpahara kaba khlain, pynlong ia ki nongap: namar U Trai u la thmu bad leh ia kata kaba u la kren pyrshah ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka Babilon .

en: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .
kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar dei ha kane ka sngi ba nga la ïalam noh ïa ki jait jong phi na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pateng phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin peit ia ka jingkhawai jong u kpu bym don thied ; namar ha kane ka sngi nga la wanrah ia ki shipai jong phi na ka ri Ijipt: namarkata phin peit ia kane ka sngi ha ki pateng jong phi da ka hukum junom .

en: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan , and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah , which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite , before Mamre .
kha: ki la bah ïa ka met jong u sha Kanaan bad ki tep ïa ka ha kata ka krem kaba don ha ka lyngkha ha Makhpelah , sha mihngi na Mamre , kaba u Abraham u la thied na u Ephron u jait Hit ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u ki la rah ia u sha ka ri Kanaan , bad ki la tep ia u ha ka krem jong ka lyngkha Machpelah , kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka lyngkha na ka bynta ka jaka tep jong u Ephron u Hitit , ha khmat u Mamre .

en: To whom shall I speak , and give warning , that they may hear ? behold , their ear is uncircumcised , and they cannot hearken : behold , the word of the  Lord  is unto them a reproach  ; they have no delight in it .
kha: Nga la jubab ,  Mano ban shahshkor ïa nga lada nga la kren ha ki bad maham ïa ki ? Ki long kiba mutlop bad ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong me ; ki rkhie ïa kaei kaba me ong ïa nga ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hano ngan kren bad ngan ai jingmaham ba kin iohsngew ? ha khmih ka shkor jong ki ka long kaba khlem ot bad kim lah ban sngap: ha khmih ka ktien U Trai ka long ha ki ka jingshah lehbein; kim don jingsngewbha ha ka .

en: Then the king arose , and sat in the gate . And they told unto all the people , saying , Behold , the king doth sit in the gate . And all the people came before the king : for Israel had fled every man to his tent .
kha: Nangta u syiem u ïeng joit , bad u leit shong hajan ka khyrdop shnong . Ki rangbah jong u ki ïohsngew ba u don hangta , bad baroh ki la ïalumlang sawdong jong u . Ha kajuh ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la phet krad sha la ki jong ki ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ieng bad u la shong ha ka khyrdop . Ki la iathuh ha ki briew baroh, ki da ong: Ha khmih u syiem u shong ha ka khyrdop . Bad ki briew baroh ki la wan ha khmat u syiem: namar ki Israel ki la phet noh uwei pa uwei sha la ka ïingjaiñ .

en: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon , with the freewill offering of the people , and of the priests , offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem :
kha: Men rah ruh baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba me la lum na baroh kawei ka probins    Babilon bad ki jingainguh kiba ki Israel bad ki lyngdoh jong ki , ki ai na ka bynta ka Templ jong U Blei jong ki ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh kaba me lah ban shem ha ka ri Babilon baroh kawei, ryngkat bad ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong ki briew bad ki lyngdoh , da kaba ai mon sngewbha na ka bynta ka iing U Blei jong ki kaba don ha Jerusalem:

en: And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .
kha: Ka la ïam shaphang kata ha baroh kita ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u ïathuh ha ka , ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip , naba ka ïai thlia ïa u katta katta . Nangta ka ïathuh pat ha kita ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la iam ha khmat jong u hynriew sngi, katba ka jingkhawai jong ki ka dang neh: bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ba u la iathuh ia ka: namar ba ka la thiah ha u: bad ka la iathuh ia ka jingkylli ha ki khun jong ka .

en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .
kha: Nangta u suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba sharum .
translated_en_to_kha: U pud u sam u la leit noh nangta sha ka liang ka Luz, kaba long ka Bethel, shaphang shathie ; bad u pud u sam u la hiar sha ka Atarothadar, hajan u lum uba don shaphang shathie jong ka Bethhoron .

en: And he said unto me , O Daniel , a man greatly beloved , understand the words that I speak unto thee , and stand upright : for unto thee am I now sent . And when he had spoken this word unto me , I stood trembling .
kha: U angel u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Daniel , U Blei u ieit ïa me . Ïeng joit bad to shahshkor biang biang ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Ïa nga la phah sha me .  Haba u la lah ong ïa kane , nga la ïeng , nga dang khynñiuh hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha nga, ko Daniel, ko briew uba ieit shibun, to sngewthuh ia ki ktien kiba nga kren ha me, bad to ieng beit: namar ha me la phah mynta . Bad haba u la kren ia kane ka ktien ha nga , nga la ieng da kaba khih .

en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David : wherefore he came down into a rock , and abode in the wilderness of Maon . And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .
kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki mih ban leit wad ïa u , hynrei u la ïohsngew shaphang kata bad u la leit sha u mawsiang lum ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon bad u la sah hangta . Haba u Saul u tip ïa kane , u leit beh nadien u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul ruh bad ki briew jong u ki la leit wad ia u . Ki la iathuh ha u Dabid: namar kata u la wan hiar sha u mawsiang bad u la shong ha ka ri khlaw Maon . Bad haba u Saul u la iohsngew ia kata , u la bud ia u Dabid ha ka ri khlaw Maon .

en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .
kha: U Mordekai u mih na ka ïingsyiem , ha ki jingphong syiem kiba jngum rong bad balieh , ka barandi linen ba sawbthuh bad ka pansngiat ksiar ba-itynnat . Nangta ki lynti bah ka Susa ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïaroh jong ka jingkmen .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mordecai u la mih na khmat u syiem ha ka jain syiem kaba rong saw bad kaba lieh, bad da ka khlieh ksiar kaba heh bad ka jain kaba jem bad kaba lieh: bad ka shnong Shushan ka la ia risa bad ka la ia sngewbha .

en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?
kha: U Jisu u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .’ Hato dei kane kaba phi ïakylli para ma phi hi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta U Jisu u la tip ba ki kwah ban kylli ia u, bad u la ong ha ki, Hato phi kylli hapdeng jong phi ia kata kaba nga la ong: Khyndiat por bad phin ym iohi ia nga: bad sa khyndiat por bad phin sa iohi ia nga ?

en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth  ; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy  ; and I will say to them which were not my people , Thou art my people  ; and they shall say , Thou art my God .
kha: Ngan pynlong skhem ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri bad ngan pynmanbha ïa ki . Ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-Ruhamah ,  bad ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-ammi  ngan sa ong ,  Phi long ki briew jong nga ,  bad kin jubab ,  Me long U Blei jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan bet ia ka ha nga ha ka khyndew ; bad ngan isynei ia ka kaba khlem ioh ia ka jingsngewrit ; bad ngan ong ha ki ki bym dei ki briew jong nga; bad kin ong: Me long ki briew jong nga ; bad kin ong: Me long U Blei jong nga .

en: And they returned to Joshua , and said unto him , Let not all the people go up  ; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai  ; and make not all the people to labour thither  ; for they are but few .
kha: ki wan ïathuh ha u Joshua ,  Ym da donkam ba baroh kin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Ai . Phah tang kumba ar ne lai hajar ngut ki rangbah . Wat phah ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ban leit ïaleh ; kam dei ka shnong kaba heh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leit phai sha u Joshua bad ki la ong ha u, Wat ai ba ki briew baroh kin leit shaneng shuh shuh hynrei ai ba kumba ar ne lai hajar ngut ki briew kin leit shaneng bad kin leit sha Ai ; bad wat pynlong ia ki briew baroh ban trei shuh shuh shuh shuh shuh shuh.

en: And when he was come to the king , the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And he said , Go ye up , and prosper , and they shall be delivered into your hand .
kha: Haba u ïeng ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u ,  Ko Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur !  u Mikaïah u ong .  Da shisha phin jop . U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la poi ha u syiem, u syiem u la ong ha u, "Mikaiah, hato ngin leit sha Ramotgilead ban ialeh thma, ne ngan leit noh ? Bad u la ong, To leit shaneng, bad to roi, bad kin shah aiti ha ka kti jong phi .

en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .
kha: Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa kato ka briew ha u tnga jong ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa duwai na ka bynta jong me , ba kumta men ym ïap . Hynrei lada mem pynphai pat ïa ka , nga maham ïa me ba men ïap , ma me bad ki briew jong me baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta to pynphai biang ia u briew uba u long u nongiathuhlypa, bad un duwai na ka bynta jong me, bad me phin im: bad lada me pynphai biang ia ka, to tip ba me shisha me iap, me bad baroh kiba long jong me .

en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of them that seek their life , and into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which are gone up from you .
kha: Ngan ai ruh ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u sha kito kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa ki . Ngan aiti ïa ki sha ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , kaba la sangeh ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem Judah bad ki rangbah jong u ngan aiti ha ka kti jong ki nongshun jong ki bad ha ka kti jong kito kiba wad ia ka jingim jong ki bad ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon uba la leit noh na phi .
