en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh  ; lo , he cometh forth to the water  ; and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lashai dang step phyrngab , khie leit ap ïa u Pharaoh katba u dang leit sha ka wah , bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , To khie dang step, bad to ieng ha khmat u Pharaoh; u wan shabar sha ka um ; bad u ong ha u: Kumta u ong ia u Trai: To ai ba ki briew jong nga kin leit sha khmat jong nga .

en: But Paul said unto them , They have beaten us openly uncondemned , being Romans , and have cast us into prison  ; and now do they thrust us out privily ? nay verily  ; but let them come themselves and fetch us out .
kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Ym shym la shem ïa ngi kiba la shah pynrem na kano kano ka kam runar , pynban ki la sympat ïa ngi ha khmat u paidbah — bad ngi dei ki traishnong ka Hima Rom ! Nangta ki la thep ïa ngi sha ka byndi , bad mynta ki kwah ban phah noh jar jar ïa ngi . Ka bym lah long ! Ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom ki dei ban wan hi da lade hangne bad pyllait ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha ki, Ki la shoh ia ngi khlem da shah pynrem, ki long ki nong Rom, bad ki la bret ia ngi ha phatok ; bad mynta ki pynkhih ia ngi da kaba shimet ?

en: And David came to Baal–perazim , and David smote them there , and said , The  Lord  hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me , as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim .
kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit sha Baal Perasim bad hangta u la jop ïa ki Philistia . U ong ,  U  Trai  u la sar naphang lin ïa ki nongshun jong nga kum ka jingshlei um .  Bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Baal Perasim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la wan sha Baalperazim, bad u Dabid u la shoh ia ki hangta, bad u la ong, U Trai u la bthei ha ki nongshun jong nga ha khmat jong nga, kum ka jingpynkhein ia ki um . Namarkata u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong kata ka jaka Baalperazim .

en: The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; ka sur jong u ka byrthen na Jerusalem ; ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng ki khynñiuh . Hynrei un ïada ïa la ki briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai ruh un pyrta na Seion, bad un pynmih ia ka sur jong u na Jerusalem bad ki bneng bad ka khyndew kin khih: hynrei U Trai un long ka jingkyrmen jong ki briew jong u bad ka jingkhlain jong ki khun Israel .

en: When thy sisters , Sodom and her daughters , shall return to their former estate , and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate , then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate .
kha: Kin sa manbha pat , bad ïa pha bad ki nongrit jong pha ruh yn sa pynneh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki para kynthei jong me, ka Sodom bad ki khun kynthei jong ka, kin leit phai noh sha ka jaka barim jong ki, bad ka Samaria bad ki khun kynthei jong ka kin leit phai noh sha ka jaka barim jong ki, te ma me bad ki khun kynthei jong me phin leit phai noh sha ka jaka barim jong phi .

en: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
kha: te ma phi baroh phi dei ban tip , bad baroh ki paid Israel ki dei ban tip , ba une u briew u ïeng hangne ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah kran da ka bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth — ïa uba phi la sahnarphna bad ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translated_en_to_kha: To tip ha phi baroh bad ha ki briew Israel baroh, ba da ka kyrteng U Jisu Khrist na Nazareth, ia uba phi la sahnarphna, ia uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na kiba iap, wat da u ruh une u briew u ieng hangne ha khmat jong phi baroh kawei .

en: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me  ; as also the king s words that he had spoken unto me . And they said , Let us rise up and build . So they strengthened their hands for this good work .
kha: Bad nga la ong ïa ki kumno U Blei u la long ryngkat bad nga bad ïarap ïa nga , bad kaei kaba u patsha u la ong ha nga . Ki la phai ktien ,  To ngin ïasdang tei pat !  Bad kumta ki la ïakhreh ban sdang ïa ka kam .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iathuh ha ki ia ka kti U Blei jong nga kaba la long kaba bha ha nga; bad ki ktien syiem kiba u la kren ha nga . Ki la ong , To ngin ia kiew bad tei . Kumta ki la pynskhem ia ki kti jong ki na ka bynta kane ka kam kaba bha .

en: When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew ba-bymman u dei ban ïap bad mem shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïap , kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga ong ha kiba sniew , ko briew uba sniew, men iap shisha; lada phim kren ban maham ia kiba sniew na ka lynti jong u, uta u briew uba sniew un iap ha ka jingbymhok jong u; hynrei ka snam jong u ngan dawa ha ka kti jong me .

en: And the  Lord  did so  ; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants  houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
kha: Bad U  Trai  u leh kumta ; ki skain da ki kynhun bah ki wan rung hapoh ïing jong u Pharaoh bad hapoh ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong u . Ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka julor ha kita ki skain .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la leh kumta bad ka la wan ka kynhun khnai kaba jur ha ka iing u Pharaoh bad ha ki iing jong u bad ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei: ka ri ka la shah pynjot namar ka kynhun khnai .

en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .
kha: Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por jong phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la ngat kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riam ha ki katto katne ki khep basniew ha kaba ngim shym khmih lynti satia ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u briew ruh um tip ia ka por jong u: kumba ki dohkha kiba la shah kem ha ka net kaba sniew, bad kumba ki sim kiba la shah kem ha ka snare ; kumjuh ruh ki khun shynrang ki la shah rong noh ha ka por kaba sniew, haba ka hap kynsan kynsan ha ki .

en: Beside their genealogy of males , from three years old and upward , even unto every one that entereth into the house of the  Lord  , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses  ;
kha: Ki ai bynta ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba laiphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw kiba don jingkitkhlieh man ka sngi ha ka Templ kat kum ki kyrdan jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor ka jinglong shynrang jong ki, naduh lai snem shaneng, wat ha uwei pa uwei uba rung ha iing U Trai, ka bynta jong u man ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ki ha ki jingsiew jong ki;

en: On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth–peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
kha: Dei hadien ba ki la wan mih na Ijipt bad mynba ki don ha kata ka them kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Bethpeor , ba u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum . Kane ka long ha ka hima u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba synshar ha ka shnong Heshbon . Mynba U Moses bad ki Israel ki la jop ïa u ynda ki la mih na Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kane ka liang Jordan, ha ka them kaba don ha ka ri jong u syiem Amor, uba shong ha Heshbon, ia uba u Moses bad ki khun Israel ki la leit noh na Ijipt:

en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found , and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground : and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one .
kha: Ngin shem ïa u Dabid hangno hangno ha kaba u don , bad ngin tur ïaleh ïa u ha shuwa ba un tip kaei kaba jia . Ma u lane uno uno na ki rangbah jong u kin ym lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ngin wan ha u ha kano kano ka jaka ha kaba un shem ia u, bad ngin sa pynshai ia u kum ka dewbilat ha ka khyndew: bad na u bad na ki briew baroh kiba don bad u ym shah iehnoh tang shiwei ruh .

en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for I will bring upon it , even upon Moab , the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .
kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban lait na ka jingshyrkhei un hap hapoh ki liewlep , bad uno uno uba kiew na ki liewlep un ngat ha ki jingriam , namar U  Trai  u la buh por na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ka Moab .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba phet noh na ka jingtieng un hap ha ka thliew ; bad uta uba mih na ka thliew un shah shim ha ka jingma: namar ngan wanrah ia ka, wat ha ka Moab, ka snem jong ka jingleit jngoh jong ki, ong U Trai .

en: And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .
kha: U Joshua u jubab ,  Lada phi ïabun paid haduh katta katta bad ba ka ri lum Ephraim ka rit than ïa phi , te khie leit sha ki khlaw bad prat na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka ri ki Peris bad ki Rephaim .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la jubab ia ki, Lada me long u briew uba khraw, te to kiew sha ka ri khlaw, bad ot ia lade hangta ha ka ri jong ki Perizi bad ki rangbah, lada u lum Ephraim u long uba rit palat na ka bynta jong me .

en: When she was brought forth , she sent to her father in law , saying , By the man , whose these are , am I with child : and she said , Discern , I pray thee , whose are these , the signet , and bracelets , and staff .
kha: Katba ka dang shah sei kumta , ka la phah ktien sha la u kthaw kurim :  Nga la punkhun na uta u briew uba long u trai kine ki tiar . Peit ïa ki bad khmih ki dei ki jongno — kane ka muhor bad u ksai jong ka bad une u diengduh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ynda la wanrah ia ka, ka la phah sha u kpa tymmen jong ka, da kaba ong, Da u briew, uba kine ki long, nga don khun: bad ka la ong: To sngewthuh, nga kyrpad ia me, uba kine ki long, ki dak bad ki brace bad ki dieng .

en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth–el and the towns thereof , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof  ; Shechem also and the towns thereof , unto Gaza and the towns thereof :
kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shim bad shongduh ka kynthup ïa ka Bethel bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka naduh shaphang mihngi ka Naaran bad haduh shaphang sepngi ka Geser bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka . Ka kynthup ruh ïa ki nongbah ka Shekhem bad ka Ayyah bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jaka bad ki jaka shong jaka sah jong ki ki long, ka Bethel bad ki shnong jong ka, bad shaphang mihngi ka Naaran, bad shaphang sepngi ka Gzer, bad ki shnong jong ka; Shechem ruh bad ki shnong jong ka, haduh Gaza bad ki shnong jong ka:

en: And behold another beast , a second , like to a bear , and it raised up itself on one side , and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it : and they said thus unto it , Arise , devour much flesh .
kha: U mradkhlaw uba ar u syriem kum ka dngiem kaba ïeng ha ki kjat-dien jong ka . Ka la bat lai tylli ki shyieng krung hapdeng ki bniat jong ka , bad ka sur ka la ong ha ka ,  Khie leit , bam shibun ka doh katba pha lah !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha khmih uwei pat u mrad, uba ar, uba kum u bear, bad u la pynkiew ia lade ha kawei ka liang, bad u don lai tylli ki ryndang ha ka shyntur jong u hapdeng ki bniat jong u: bad ki la ong kumta ha u: To khie, to bam ia ka doh kaba bun .

en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah , when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
kha: Ha snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Barukh u thoh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien ba u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la kren ha u Baruk u khun u Jeremaiah haba u la thoh ia kine ki ktien ha ka kot ha ka shyntur jong u Jeremaiah ha ka snem kaba saw jong u Jehosiah u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah .

en: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles , saying , Let neither man nor beast , herd nor flock , taste any thing : let them not feed , nor drink water :
kha: U la phah ka jingpynbna sha ki briew ka Ninebeh :  Kane ka dei ka hukum na u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u : Yn ym don uno uno u ban bam ei ei ; ïa baroh ki briew , ki masi bad ki langbrot la khang ban bam lane ban dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia ka ban shah pynbna bad shah pynbna lyngba u Nineveh da ka hukum jong u syiem bad ki rangbah jong u, da kaba ong: Wat ai ba u briew ne u mrad ne u mrad , un ym bam ei ei: wat ai ba kin ym bam ei ei: wat ai ba kin ym bam ei ei:

en: And Balak said unto him , Come , I pray thee , with me unto another place , from whence thou mayest see them : thou shalt see but the utmost part of them , and shalt not see them all : and curse me them from thence .
kha: Nangta u Balak u ong ha u Balaam ,  Ale bad nga sha kawei pat ka jaka na kaba phi lah ban ïohi tang katto katne ki Israel . Tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la ong ha u, To wan, nga kyrpad ia me, bad nga sha kawei pat ka jaka, na kaba me lah ban iohi ia ki: men sa iohi tang ia ka bynta kaba kut tam jong ki: bad wat iohi ia ki baroh: bad to tim ia nga naduh hangta .

en: And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
kha: Kumta u Aaron u shoh ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u pui pui baroh ha Ijipt u kylla mait , bad kumta la boi da u mait ha u briew bad ha u mrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la leh kumta; namar u Aaron u la pynkhih ia la ka kti da u diengduh jong u, bad u la pynkhih ia ka dewmet jong ka khyndew, bad ka la kylla long ki khniang ha u briew, bad ha ki mrad baroh ki la kylla long ki khniang ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .
kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ba ki la sdang ban ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei kane ? Hato ka dei ka jait jinghikai thymmai ? Une u briew u don ka bor ban ai hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki la lyngngoh, khlem da pyrkhat ia lade, ki la kylli hapdeng jong ki, ki da ong: Kaei kane ? kaei ka jinghikai kaba thymmai kane ? namar da ka bor u hukum wat ia ki mynsiem bymkhuid ruh bad ki kohnguh ia u .

en: But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .
kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la ïarap ïa u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ki apostol . U la batai ha ki kumno u Saul u la ïohi ïa U Trai ha ka lynti bad ba U Trai u la lah kren bad u Saul . U la ïathuh ruh kumno u Saul u la ïalap da ka jingshlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Barnabas u la shim ia u bad u la wanrah ia u ha ki apostol bad u la iathuh ha ki kumno u la iohi ia U Trai ha lynti bad ba u la kren ia u bad kumno u la ialap shlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .

en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .
kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  pruid dak ar tylli ki lynti na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lah ban wan lem bad la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . Buh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ko khun u briew, to buh ia me ar lynti, ba ka waitlam jong u syiem Babilon kan wan: baroh arngut kin mih na kawei ka ri: bad me jied ia ka jaka , jied ia ka ha ka khlieh jong ka lynti sha ka nongbah .

en: And the priest , whom he shall anoint , and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest s office in his father s stead , shall make the atonement , and shall put on the linen clothes , even the holy garments :
kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa uba la pynkupbor bad pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ha ka jaka u kpa jong u , u dei ban pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . U dei ban da phong ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u lyngdoh uba un pynsleh bad uba un pynkyntang ha ka kam lyngdoh ha ka jaka jong u kpa jong u, un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid bad un phong ia ki jain lin, wat ia ki jain kyntang:

en: Keep therefore and do them  ; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations , which shall hear all these statutes , and say , Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people .
kha: Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki , bad kata hi kan kren ha ki briew jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew haduh katno phi long kiba stad bad kiba shemphang . Haba ki ïohsngew shaphang kine ki aiñ , kin sa ïa-ong , ‘ Haduh katne pleng , kane ka jaitbynriew ka don ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang !’
translated_en_to_kha: To sumar bad leh ia ki namar kane ka long ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh jong phi ha khmat ki jaitbynriew , ki ban iohsngew ia kine ki ain baroh , bad kin ong , Hooid kane ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw ka long ka briew kaba stad bad kaba sngewthuh .

en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , Go yet , love a woman beloved of her friend , yet an adulteress , according to the love of the  Lord  toward the children of Israel , who look to other gods , and love flagons of wine .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Khie leit biang bad leh-ieit ïa ka briew kaba dang ïaleh nuti bad uba ieit jong ka . Me dei ban ieit ïa ka kumba nga ruh nga dang ieit ïa ki paid Israel , wat la ki phai sha kiwei pat ki blei bad ki ieit ban ainguh ha ki bleithaw da ki soh kismis .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong U Trai ha nga, To leit ieit ia ka kynthei kaba ieit ia ka paralok jong ka, hynrei ka jingleh be-ijot, kat kum ka jingieit U Trai ia ki khun Israel kiba peit sha kiwei pat ki blei bad ki ieit ia ki sohjew wain .

en: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise men , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men : and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ngan pynbuaid ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka — ki rangbah kiba stad , ki nongïalam , bad ki shipai . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit shuh . Ma nga u syiem , nga la kren . Nga long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan pynlong ia ki syiem jong ka, bad ki riewstad jong ka, bad ki nongsynshar jong ka: bad kin thiah ia ka jingthiah kaba neh slem, bad kin ym khie , ong u Syiem uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai jong ki paid .

en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only , but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
kha: Nangta u Memukan u ong ha u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar :  Ka Bashti , ka Mahadei ka la krenbeiñ ym tang ïa u syiem hynrei ïa ki rangbah synshar ruh — ha ka jingshisha , ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha ka hima !
translated_en_to_kha: U Memukan u la jubab ha khmat u syiem bad ki syiem, u Vashti ka mahadei kam shym la leh bakla tang ia u syiem , hynrei ia ki syiem baroh bad ia ki briew baroh kiba don ha ki jylla jong u syiem Ahasuerus .

en: And he said , I will make all my goodness pass before thee , and I will proclaim the name of the  Lord  before thee  ; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious , and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy .
kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Ngan pynïaid ha khmat jong me ïa ka jingitynnat jong nga baroh , bad hangta haba me don , ngan pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba kyntang jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  bad ngan lehsbun bad leh-isynei ïa kito kiba nga jied .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Ngan pynlong ia ka jingbha jong nga baroh ha khmat jong me , bad ngan pynbna ia ka kyrteng U Trai ha khmat jong me ; bad ngan sngewbha ia uba ngan sngewbha , bad ngan sngewsynei ia uba ngan sngewsih .

en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .
kha: U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u syiem bad un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U lyngdoh un ïeng hajan ka khet jong u , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Wat u ruh un tei ia ka tempi U Trai ; bad un kit ia ka burom, bad un shong bad synshar halor ka khet jong u ; bad un long u lyngdoh halor ka khet jong u: bad ka jingai jingmut jong ka jingsuk kan long hapdeng jong ki baroh arngut .

en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: bad u ai ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka hukum U Trai la khein ia ki da ka kti u Moses , uwei pa uwei kat kum ka jingshakri jong u , bad kat kum ka jingkit jong u: kumta la khein ia ki na u kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .
kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba ong ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai !   Ho-oid shisha !  U Mynsiem u jubab .  Kin ïoh shongthait na ki jingtrei shitom jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingshakri jong ki , ki leit lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohsngew ia ka sur na bneng kaba ong ha nga, Thoh , La kyrkhu ia kiba iap ha U Trai naduh mynta: Hooid , ong U Mynsiem , ba kin shongthait na ki jingtrei shitom jong ki ; bad ki kam jong ki ki bud ia ki .

en: And he made his son pass through the fire , and observed times , and used enchantments , and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards : he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
kha: U kñia ïa la u khun kum ka jingainguh thang . U khan bad u leh myntor , bad u ïasyllok bad ki nongpeit kti bad ki nongleh byrtong . U la leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkhih bitar ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynlong ia u khun jong u ban iaid lyngba ka ding, bad u la ju peit bniah ia ki por, bad u la leh ia ki jingleh jadu bad ki nongleh jadu ba la tip bha: u la leh ia ka jingsniew kaba khraw ha khmat U Trai, ban pynkhih ia u ban bitar .

en: And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .
kha: Bad uno uno uba la iehnoh ïa ki ïing ki sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa u kpa lane ïa ka kmie lane ïa ki khun ki kti lane ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga , un ïohpdiang shispah shah tam ïa kata , bad yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei uba la iehnoh ia ki iing ne ki hynmen ne ki para kynthei ne u kpa ne ka kmie ne ki khun ne ki jaka na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga, un ioh shispah shah bad un hiar pateng ia ka jingim bymjukut .

en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
kha: Lada don tang kawei ka shnong , ka lynti shata ka lah ban jngai than , bad uta uba wad kput u lah ban lap ïa u bad ha la ka jingbitar u lah ban pynïap ïa u briew u bym dei hok ban ïap , namar um shym don ka jingïashun bad la u paramarjan mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ba u nongpyniap ia ka snam un bud ia u nongpyniap briew, katba ka dohnud jong u ka shit, bad u la palat ia u, namar ka lynti ka long kaba jrong, bad u la pyniap ia u ; katba um shym la bit ban iap, namar ba um shym la shun ia u ha ka por ba la leit noh .

en: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee , whom the  Lord  thy God shall choose : one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee : thou mayest not set a stranger over thee , which is not thy brother .
kha: Da kynmaw ba u briew uba phi jied ban long u syiem u dei ban long uta ïa uba U  Trai  hi u la jied . U dei ban long na ka jait ka kynja jong phi hi ; wat jied syiem ïa u nongwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban long ha uno uno u rangbah uba stad halor jong me, uba U Trai U Blei jong me un jied: uwei na ki hynmen jong me men long syiem halor jong me: me dei ban buh ia u nongwei halor jong me, u bym dei u hynmen jong me .

en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite , David s counsellor , from his city , even from Giloh , while he offered sacrifices . And the conspiracy was strong  ; for the people increased continually with Absalom .
kha: Bad katba u dang ai jingkñia , u Absalom u phah khot ruh na ka shnong Gilo ïa u Ahithophel , uba long uwei na ki nongaibuit jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka jingthmu barieh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka nang jur , bad ki nongbud jong u Absalom ki nang bun .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u la phah ia u Ahitophel u Nonghikai u Dabid, na ka shnong jong u, wat na Giloh, katba u dang tyrwa ia ki jingknia . Bad ka jingthmu ka la long kaba khlain; namar ki briew ki la nang kiew beit bad u Absalom .

en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope , that in nothing I shall be ashamed , but that with all boldness , as always , so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body , whether it be by life , or by death .
kha: Katkum ka jingkwah bajur bad ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ba ngan ym shah rem ha ka kamram jong nga , hynrei , ha ki por baroh , bad kyrpang ïa mynta hi , ngan da long uba dap da ka jingshlur , khnang ba da ka longrynïeng jong nga baroh , ngan wanrah burom ïa U Khrist , la nga im ne nga ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum ka jingkhmih lynti bad jingkyrmen jong nga, ba ha kaei kaei ngan sngewlehrain, hynrei kata da ka jingshlur baroh, kumba ju long, kumta mynta ruh U Khrist un sa shah pynkhraw ha ka met jong nga, la ka long da ka jingim ne da ka jingiap .

en: And they said unto me , The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach : the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down , and the gates thereof are burned with fire .
kha: Ki ïathuh ïa nga ba kito kiba dang im bad kiba la poi biang ha la ka jong ka ri , ki don hapdeng ka jingeh bakhraw bad ba ki nongwei kiba shong basah marjan , ki peitbeiñ ïa ki . Ki ïathuh ruh ïa nga ba ki kynroh ka Jerusalem ki la pra bad ba ïa ki khyrdop ym shym la pynbha pat naduh ka por ba la thang ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong ha nga , Ka jingsah jong ka jingshah set hangta ha ka ri ka long ha ka jingjynjar kaba khraw bad ka jingshah lehbein: ka kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ruh ka la tyrkhong , bad ki khyrdop jong ka ki la shah thang da ka ding .

en: And Elijah said unto him , Elisha , tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jericho . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they came to Jericho .
kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Jerikho .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit sha Jerikho .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha u, Elisa, to sah hangne, nga kyrpad ia me, namar U Trai u la phah ia nga sha Jeriko . Bad u la ong: Kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ngan ym iehnoh ia me . Kumta ki la poi ha Jeriko .

en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits , and the breadth one cubit  ; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits , and the breadth one cubit .
kha: Ka bynta kaba sha trai eh jong ka duwan , na ka bynta ba-halor jong ka trai , ka long shi mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta kaba bud na ka tduh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong , bad ka long ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta hadien kata na ka tduh ruh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad naduh ka tduh jong ka khyndew haduh ka jaka ba shapoh kan long ar cubit bad ka jingjylliew kan long tang saw cubit bad ka jingjylliew kan long saw cubit .

en: And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim . Lada u leh kumta , un tar ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïadei ïa kaba rim .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ruh ia ka pharshi ha ki ; Ym don mano mano ruh kiba buh ia ka jain thymmai halor ka jain kaba rim; lada ym kumta, te baroh ar ka long kaba thymmai, bad kata ka jain kaba la shim na kaba thymmai kam iahap bad kaba rim .

en: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the  Lord  thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand , which thou shalt give unto the  Lord  thy God , according as the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee :
kha: bad nangta rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , da kaba phi wanrah ïa ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi kat kumba u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men sumar ia ka jingkhawai kaba shi taiew ha U Trai U Blei jong me da ka jingai sngewbha jong me da ka mon sngewbha jong me, kaba me ai ha U Trai U Blei jong me, kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u la kyrkhu ia me:

en: And Balak s anger was kindled against Balaam , and he smote his hands together : and Balak said unto Balaam , I called thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast altogether blessed them these three times .
kha: U Balak u kham tyngeh ïa la ki sla kti da ka jingbitar bad u ong ha u Balaam ,  Nga la khot ïa me ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei la lai sien me la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Balak u la pynkhih ia ki kti jong u Balak: bad u Balak u la ong ha u Balak: bad u Balak u la ong ha u Balak: Nga la khot ia me ban tim ia ki nongshun jong nga, bad, ha khmih, me la kyrkhu lut ia ki ha kine ki lai sien .

en: Enquire , I pray thee , of the  Lord  for us  ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us  ; if so be that the  Lord  will deal with us according to all his wondrous works , that he may go up from us .
kha: Sngewbha ban kren ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ngi , namar u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la wan kerkut ïa ka nongbah . Lehse U  Trai  un leh kawei na ki kambah jong u na ka bynta jong ngi , bad un pynbor ïa u Nebukhadnessar ba un kynran dien noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli ia me, nga kyrpad ia me, na ka bynta jong ngi; namar u syiem Babilon u leh thma ia ngi; lada ka long kumta ba U Trai un leh ia ngi kat kum ki kam ba phylla jong u baroh, ba un leit noh na ngi .

en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .
kha: Wat lyngngoh haba phi ïohi ba ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehhok bad ïa ki hok jong ki . Ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah synshar la ïada da uno uno uba kham halor bad ïa baroh ar la ïada da ki rangbah synshar kiba kham halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me iohi ia ka jingshah lehbein jong kiba duk bad kaba shyrkhei jong ka jingbishar bad ka hok ha kawei ka jylla, wat sngewphylla ia kata: namar uta uba kham halor ban ia uba kham halor; bad hangta u kham halor ban ia ki .

en: Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta ngan pynhap bam na bneng ïa phi baroh . Ki briew ki dei ban mih shabar man ka sngi ban lum kat ban biang na ka bynta kata ka sngi . Da kumta nga lah ban tynjuh ïa ki ban shem la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ha khmih, ngan slap ia u kpu na bneng na ka bynta jong phi ; bad ki briew kin leit shabar bad lum katto katne ka dor man la ka sngi , ba ngan pynshisha ia ki , la kin iaid ha ka ain jong nga ne em .

en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more , neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more , neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ka ri kan ym shahshkor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba krenbeiñ ïa ka , lane ïohi ki kynja bynriew kiba peitbeiñ ïa ka . Ka ri kan ym knieh shuh ïa la ki khun na ka jaitbynriew . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan ym pynlong shuh ia ki briew ban iohsngew ha me ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ki nongwei, lymne men ym shah shuh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong ki briew, lymne men ym pynlong shuh ia ki jaitbynriew jong me ban hap shuh , ong U Trai Blei .

en: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha , and the cities about them in like manner , giving themselves over to fornication , and going after strange flesh , are set forth for an example , suffering the vengeance of eternal fire .
kha: To kynmaw ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , bad ki shnong ba-marjan , ha kaba ki briew ki leh kumba la leh kito ki angel bad ki kyrsum ha ki jingleh nuti bad bajakhlia : Ki shah ïa ka jingpynshitom ha ka ding bymjukut kum ka jingmaham ïa baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka Sodom bad ka Gomorraha, bad ki nongbah kiba don shaphang jong ki ha kajuh ka rukom, ki aiti ia lade ha ka kam sniew, bad ki leit bud ia ka doh kaba phylla, ki long kiba la buh kum ka nuksa, ki shah ia ka jingshah pynshitom bein jong ka ding bymjukut .

en: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days , and say unto him , I profess this day unto the  Lord  thy God , that I am come unto the country which the  Lord  sware unto our fathers for to give us .
kha: Leit sha u lyngdoh uba dei peit kam ha kata ka por , bad ong ha u , ‘ Nga pynbna mynta ka sngi ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ba nga la wan rung ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ban ai ha ngi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me leit sha u lyngdoh uba don ha kita ki sngi bad to ong ha u , nga pynpaw mynta ka sngi ha U Trai U Blei jong me , ba nga wan sha ka ri kaba U Trai u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ban ai ia ngi .

en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .
kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynrei ba kan pynmih pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la shim khyndiat ka um , u la thet ïa la ki kti ha khmat u paidbah , bad u la ong ,  Ngam don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong une u briew ! Kane ka dei ka jingleh jong phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Pilat u la iohi ba um lah ban jop ei ei, hynrei kata ka kham long ka jingsawa, u la shim um bad u la sait ia ki kti jong u ha khmat u paidbah, u da ong , Nga long uba khlem pop na ka snam jong une u briew uba hok: peit ia ka .

en: Is not the  Lord  your God with you ? and hath he not given you rest on every side ? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand  ; and the land is subdued before the  Lord  , and before his people .
kha: U ong ,  U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la don ryngkat bad phi bad u la ai ha phi ïa ka jingsuk ha baroh ki liang . U shah ba ngan jop ïa ki briew baroh kiba ju shong ha kane ka ri , bad mynta ki don hapoh jong phi bad ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato U Trai U Blei jong phi bad phi ? bad um shym la ai jingjahthait ia phi ha man la ki liang ? namar u la ai ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri ha ka kti jong nga ; bad ka ri ka la shah pyndem ha khmat U Trai bad ha khmat ki briew jong u .

en: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
kha: Hynrei kine ar kim long kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Adam . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ki la ïap namar ka pop jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei ka long kham khraw , bad kumta ruh ka jingai sngewbha ïa kiba bun ki briew lyngba ka jingaiei jong uta uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym kum ka jingleh bymman, kumjuh ruh ka jingai kaba laitluid . Namar lada lyngba ka jingleh bymman jong uwei u la iap, kham bun ka jingaiei U Blei, bad ka jingaiei da ka jingaiei kaba long da uwei u briew, U Jisu Khrist, ka la nang kiew sha kiba bun .

en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
kha: Ho-oid shisha ,  u Petros u la jubab . Haba u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong ,  Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mano ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?
translated_en_to_kha: U ong, Hooid . Bad haba u la wan shapoh iing, U Jisu u la khanglad ia u, u da ong, Me pyrkhat aiu ko Simon ? na kiba ki syiem ka khyndew ki shim ia ka dustur ne khajna ? na ki khun jong ki hi ne na ki nongwei ?

en: Then answered Jesus and said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , The Son can do nothing of himself , but what he seeth the Father do : for what things soever he doeth , these also doeth the Son likewise .
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Khun um lah ban leh ei ei na lade ; u leh tang ïa kaei kaba u ïohi ba U Kpa jong u , u leh . Ïa kaei kaba U Kpa u leh , U Khun ruh u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la jubab ia U Jisu bad u la ong ha ki, Hooid, shisha, nga ong ha phi, U Khun um lah ban leh ei ei na lade: namar kiei kiei kiba u leh: namar kiei kiei kiba u leh, kine ruh ki leh kumjuh .

en: And he went up from thence unto Beth–el : and as he was going up by the way , there came forth little children out of the city , and mocked him , and said unto him , Go up , thou bald head  ; go up , thou bald head .
kha: U Elisha u mihnoh na Jerikho ban leit sha Bethel , bad ha lynti katto katne ngut ki khynnah shynrang ki wan mih na ka shnong bad ki leh biria ïa u ,  Khie phet noh nangne , ko syllen !  ki la pyrta .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kiew nangta sha Betel : bad katba u dang leit sha jrong na ka shnong, ki la mih ki khynnah rit na ka shnong, bad ki la rkhie bein ia u, bad ki la ong ha u, To kiew, me khlieh blang; to kiew sha jrong, me khlieh blang .

en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon , who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land , God left him , to try him , that he might know all that was in his heart .
kha: U Hesekaïah u ïoh jingjop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh , bad wat haba ki nonglamktien ka Babilon ki wan ban kylli shaphang ki jingjia bym ju kham jia kiba jia ha ka ri , U Blei u shah ba u Hesekaïah un leit ha la ka lynti tang ban tynjuh ïa ka jinglong jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka kam jong ki nongsynshar jong ka Babilon , kiba la phah sha u ban kylli ia ka jingphylla kaba la leh ha ka ri , U Blei u la iehnoh ia u , ban tynjuh ia u , ba un tip ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself , saying , This man , if he were a prophet , would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him : for she is a sinner .
kha: Haba u Pharisi u la ïohi ïa kane , u la ong ha lade ,  Lada une u briew u dei shisha u nongïathuhlypa , un da la tip kaba kumno kane ka briew ka long kaba ktah ïa u ; un da la tip ka jait jingim bapop kaba kumno ka la im !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta haba uta u Pharisi uba la bthah ia u u la iohi ia ka, u la kren hapoh jong u, u da ong: Une u briew lada u long u nongiathuhlypa, un jin da la tip mano bad kaei ka jait kynthei kaba ktah ia u: namar ka long ka nongpop .

en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side , in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them .
kha: Pha ïeng sharud ha kata ka sngi haba ki nongshun ki pynpra ïa ki khyrdop jong ki . Pha la long kaba sniew kum kito ki nongwei kiba rah noh ïa ka spah jong ka Jerusalem bad pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi ba me ieng sha shiliang, ha ka sngi ba ki nongwei ki la rah noh ia ki shipai jong u, bad ki nongwei ki la rung ha ki khyrdop jong u, bad ki la thep vote ha Jerusalem , wat ma me ruh kum uwei na ki .

en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the  Lord  , even against the word of the  Lord  , which he kept not , and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit , to enquire of it  ;
kha: U Saul u la ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u ha U  Trai . Um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ; u pyrshang ban wad jingshai da kaba kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap , ha ka jaka ba un kylli na U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Saul u la iap na ka bynta ka jingleh bymman jong u kaba u la leh pyrshah ia U Trai, wat pyrshah ia ka ktien U Trai kaba um shym la bat, bad ruh namar ba u la pan jingmut na uwei uba don ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha, ban kylli ia ka;

en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .
kha: bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , U  Trai  u la kren ha u bun bunsien , tad haduh ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai uba san jong kata ka snem , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la ringmraw noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la wan ruh ha ki sngi jong u Jehosiah u khun jong u Josiah u syiem Judah haduh kaba kut jong ka snem kaba shiphew jong u Sedekaiah u khun jong u Josiah u syiem Judah .

en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land , saying , But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee , hear me : I will give thee money for the field  ; take it of me , and I will bury my dead there .
kha: bad u ong ha u Ephron , ba uwei pa uwei u lah ban ïohsngew ,  Sngewbha , shah ngan kyrpad ïa phi , ban shahshkor . Ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei . To pdiang ïa ka jingsiew jong nga , bad ngan tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la kren ha Ephron ha ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri, u da ong: Hynrei lada me ai ia ka, nga kyrpad ia me: ngan ai pisa ia me na ka bynta ka lyngkha; ngan tep ia ka na nga, bad ngan tep ia kiba iap jong nga hangta .

en: And if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark  ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .
kha: Hynrei lada kata ka dak ka sah kumjuh , bad kam shym pur satia , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , kata kam dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid , namar ka dei tang ka sohkhliang na kata ka dak ing ding .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ka jaka kaba shai ka sah ha ka jaka jong u, bad kam saphriang katto katne ka dum ; ka long ka jingmih jong ka jingthang, bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ia u ba u long uba khuid: namar ka long ka jingsma jong ka jingthang .

en: Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify  ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ba ngan phah ha phi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki briew kiba stad bad ïa ki nonghikai ; phin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki , phin sahnarphna ïa kiwei pat , bad phin sympat ïa kiwei pat ha ki synagog bad beh ïa ki na kawei ka shnong sha kawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih, nga phah sha phi ia ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki riewstad bad ki nongthoh: bad katto katne na ki phin pyniap bad sahnarphna; bad katto katne na ki phin ia tyngkhuh ha ki synagog jong phi, bad phin pynshitom bein ia ki na kawei ka nongbah sha kawei pat:

en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .
kha: U  Trai  u ong shaphang kine ki briew ,  Ki ieit ban phet noh na nga , bad kin ym lah ban bat synshar ïa lade . Kumta ngam shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la leh bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ha une u briew , Kumta ki la sngewtynnad ban iaid kai , kim shym la kyntait ia ki kjat jong ki , namarkata U Trai um pdiang ia ki ; mynta un kynmaw ia ka jingbymhok jong ki , bad un leit jngoh ia ki pop jong ki .

en: Lo , I will bring a nation upon you from far , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  : it is a mighty nation , it is an ancient nation , a nation whose language thou knowest not , neither understandest what they say .
kha: Ko ki paid Israel , U  Trai  u wallam ka jaitbynriew na sha jngai ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlaiñ bad kaba la rim , ka jaitbynriew kaba ïa ka ktien jong ka phim tip .
translated_en_to_kha: Lo , ngan wanrah ia ka jaitbynriew halor jong phi na jngai , ko iing Israel , ong U Trai: ka long ka jaitbynriew kaba khlain bor , ka long ka jaitbynriew hyndai , ka jaitbynriew kaba me tip ia ka ktien jong u , lymne sngewthuh ia kaei kaba ki ong .

en: Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .
kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dkoh bad ngan wallam sha ïing ïa kiba shah ringmraw . Ngan pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jong ki sha ka jingdonburom , bad baroh ka pyrthei kan ïaroh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por ngan pynpaw ia kiei kiei baroh kiba pynshitom ia me: bad ngan pynim ia ka kaba sahkut, bad ngan lum ia ka kaba la beh noh; bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban iaroh bad ban pawnam ha man la ka ri ha kaba ki la shah pynjah burom .

en: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image , an abomination unto the  Lord  , the work of the hands of the craftsman , and putteth it in a secret place . And all the people shall answer and say , Amen .
kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba thaw durblei da u maw , da u dieng , lane da u nar bad uba mane ïa ka ha kaba rieh ; U  Trai  u isih ïa ka jingmane bleithaw .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translated_en_to_kha: La tim ia u briew uba shna ia kano kano ka dur kaba la shna ne kaba la shna da ka met, ka jingleh bein ia U Trai, ka kam jong ki kti jong u nongtrei kti, bad u buh ia ka ha ka jaka kaba rieh . Bad ki briew baroh kin jubab bad kin ong , Amen .

en: Even by the God of thy father , who shall help thee  ; and by the Almighty , who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lieth under , blessings of the breasts , and of the womb :
kha: Dei U Blei jong u kpa jong me uba ïarap ïa me , U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba kyrkhu ïa me da ki jingkyrkhu u slap najrong , Bad da ki um kiba jylliew napoh khyndew , Ki jingkyrkhu da shibun ki jingri bad ki khun ki kti ,
translated_en_to_kha: Wat da U Blei jong u kpa jong me, uba iarap ia me bad da U Blei Baroh, uba kyrkhu ia me da ki jingkyrkhu jong ka bneng shaneng, ki jingkyrkhu jong ka jingjylliew kaba don hapoh, ki jingkyrkhu jong ki bniat bad ka kpoh:

en: And to love him with all the heart , and with all the understanding , and with all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbour as himself , is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices .
kha: Bad u briew u dei ban ieit ïa U Blei da ka dohnud jong u baroh bad da ka jingmut jong u baroh bad da ka bor jong u baroh ; bad u dei ban ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba u ieit ïa lade . Ka long kaba kham donkam ban kohnguh ïa kine ki ar tylli ki hukum ban ïa kaba ai jingainguh da ki mrad bad kiwei ki jingkñia sha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ban ieit ia u da ka dohnud baroh, bad da ka jingsngewthuh baroh, bad da ka mynsiem baroh, bad da ka bor baroh, bad ban ieit ia u paramarjan jong u kumba u long ma u hi, ka long kaba kham palat ban ia ki jingknia bad ki jingknia ba la thang baroh .

en: Should ye not hear the words which the  Lord  hath cried by the former prophets , when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity , and the cities thereof round about her , when men inhabited the south and the plain ?
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa ha ka por mynba ka Jerusalem ka dang manbha bad dap da ki briew bad mynba dang don bun ki briew kiba shong basah ym tang ha ki shnong sawdong ïa ka nongbah hynrei kumjuh ruh ha ka phang bashathie bad ha ki kjat lum ha ka phang sepngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato phim dei ban iohsngew ia ki ktien kiba U Trai u la pyrta da ki nongiathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa , haba ka Jerusalem ka la shong bad ka la roi ka par bad ki nongbah jong ka sawdong jong ka , haba ki briew ki shong ha ka thain shatei lam mihngi bad ka madan ?

en: Then said I unto them , Ye see the distress that we are in , how Jerusalem lieth waste , and the gates thereof are burned with fire : come , and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem , that we be no more a reproach .
kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha ki ,  Peit kaei ka jingeh kaba ngi don namar ka Jerusalem ka long hapdeng ka jingjot bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ! To ngin ïatei pat ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah bad pynkut noh ïa ka jingjahburom jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la ong ha ki, Phi iohi ia ka jingjynjar kaba ngi don, kumno ka Jerusalem ka sahkut bad ki khyrdop jong ka ki shah thang da ka ding: to ngin tei ia ka kynroh jong ka Jerusalem, ba ngin ym long shuh ka jingshah lehbein .

en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us , as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .
kha: Ki nong Moab ki ong ha ki nongïalam jong ki Midian ,  Kane ka kynhun shen kan sa pynjot ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba don sawdong jong ngi , kum u masi uba bam phlang ha ka pyntha phlang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moab u la ong ha ki rangbah jong ka ri Madian, Mynta kane ka kynhun kan lympat ia kiei kiei baroh sawdong jong ngi, kumba u masi u lympat ia u phlang . Bad u Balak u khun u Zippor u la long u syiem jong ki nong Moab ha kata ka por .

en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: Ha kata ka sngi ngan shim ïa me , ko Serubbabel u shakri jong nga , bad ngan thung ïa me ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Me long uta uba nga la jied .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai jong ki paid: ko u Serubabel jong nga, u khun jong nga, u khun jong u Shealtiel .

en: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone : and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it .
kha: Halor ka tnum ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ; ba la shna da u mawkordor Sapphir ; bad don bashong halor kata ka khet ba i kum u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad halor ka khlaw kaba la don halor ki khlieh jong ki ka long ka dur jong ka khet , kum ka dur jong u maw ba la shna da ka sniehdoh: bad halor ka dur jong ka khet ka la long ka dur kum ka dur jong u briew uba don halor jong ka .

en: Give glory to the  Lord  your God , before he cause darkness , and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains , and , while ye look for light , he turn it into the shadow of death , and make it gross darkness .
kha: To pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong phi , ha shuwa ba un wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ba phi jynthut halor ki lumbah ; ha shuwa ba un pynkylla sha ka jingdum synñia ïa ka jingshai kaba phi la kyrmen .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai burom ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, shuwa ba un pynlong ia ka jingdum, bad shuwa ba ki kjat jong phi kin ia tyngkhuh bad ki lum kiba dum, bad katba phi dang wad ia ka jingshai , u pynkylla ia ka sha ka jingdum jong ka jingiap , bad u pynlong ia ka ka jingdum kaba khraw .

en: And all the cities of store that Solomon had , and cities for his chariots , and cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .
kha: ki nongbah ha kiba u kynshew jingbam , ki shnong buh kulai bad kali ïapom , bad kat ïa kaba u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lebanon , bad kylleng ka hima jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki shnong baroh kiba u Solomon u don, bad ki shnong na ka bynta ki kali jong u, bad ki shnong na ka bynta ki kulai jong u, bad ia kaba u Solomon u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem bad ha Lebanon bad ha ka ri baroh kawei jong ka jingsynshar jong u .

en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places : thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations  ; and thou shalt be called , The repairer of the breach , The restorer of paths to dwell in .
kha: Ki briew jong phi kin tei pat ïa kaei kaba la pra la slem bah , kin tei pat halor ki nongrim ba-mynshuwa . Yn tip ïa phi kum ki briew kiba tei pat ïa ki kynroh , kiba pynbha pat ïa ki ïing ba la pra .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kita ki ban long na me kin tei ia ki jaka ba la rim: me dei ban pynmih ia ki nongrim jong kiba bun ki pateng ; bad ia me yn khot , U nongpynbha ia ka jingpynkhein , U nongpynkylla ia ki lynti ban shong .

en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering , which I have commanded in my habitation  ; and honourest thy sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people ?
kha: Balei mynta pat , me da kwah rhah sa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ba nga dawa na la ki briew ? Balei Eli ba me kham ai burom ïa la ki khun shynrang ban ïa nga da kaba me shah ba kin pynsngaid ïa lade da ki bynta kiba bha tam na ki jingkñia ba ki briew ki ai ha nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata phi kiew ha ka jingknia jong nga bad ha ka jingainguh jong nga, kaba nga la hukum ha ka jaka shong jaka sah jong nga; bad to burom ia ki khun shynrang jong me halor jong nga, ban pynlong ia lade da ka jingknia kaba khraw tam jong ki Israel jong nga ?

en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
kha: Mar ïalong syiem , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka longïing u Baasha . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u la sdang ban synshar, tang shu shong ha ka khet jong u, ba u la pyniap ia ka iing u Baasha baroh kawei: um shym la iehnoh ia u iano iano ruh kiba sngap jar pyrshah ia ka kynroh, lymne na ki jaitbynriew jong u .

en: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down , and took him , and brought him up , and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father . And he judged Israel twenty years .
kha: Ki para bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u baroh ki wan shim bad rah noh ïa ka met jong u . Ki shim pat ïa u bad ki tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Manoah u kpa jong u , kaba hapdeng ka Sorah bad ka Eshtaol . U la long u nongïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki hynmen jong u bad ka iing jong u kpa jong u baroh ki la wan hiar, bad ki la rah ia u, bad ki la tep ia u hapdeng ka Zorah bad ka Eshool ha ka jaka tep jong u kpa jong u . Bad u la bishar ia ki Israel arphew snem .

en: Then David and his men , which were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah , and went whithersoever they could go . And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah  ; and he forbare to go forth .
kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u — kumba hynriewspah ngut baroh — ki mihnoh shisyndon na Keilah bad ki ïaid sa ïaid . Haba u Saul u tip ba u Dabid u la phet noh na Keilah , u la sangeh noh ïa la ka jingpynkhreh .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid bad ki briew jong u kiba la don kumba hynriew spah ngut ki la ieng bad ki la leit noh na Keilah bad ki la leit shano shano ruh . Bad la iathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la lait na Keilah ; bad u la leit noh sha khmat .

en: Let us make a little chamber , I pray thee , on the wall  ; and let us set for him there a bed , and a table , and a stool , and a candlestick : and it shall be , when he cometh to us , that he shall turn in thither .
kha: To ngin shna kawei ka kamra halor tnum ïing , ngin buh kawei ka jingthiah , kawei ka miej , kawei ka shuki , bad kawei ka sharak hapoh jong ka , bad u lah ban sah hangta man ba u wan jngoh ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: To ngin shna khyndiat ka kamra, nga kyrpad ia me, ha ka jingkhang ; bad to ngin buh ia u hangta ka jingthiah, bad ka miej, bad ka shuki: bad kan long, ynda u wan sha ngi, ba un phai shapoh hangta .

en: And when they were gone out of the city , and not yet far off , Joseph said unto his steward , Up , follow after the men  ; and when thou dost overtake them , say unto them , Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good ?
kha: Haba ki la ïaid ym pat da jngai na shnong , u Joseph u ong ha uta u shakri bahakhlieh ha ka ïing jong u ,  Khie , leit bud mar mar nadien kito ki briew . Ynda phi lap ïa ki , ong ha ki , ‘ Balei phi siew kylliang da kaba sniew ïa kaba bha ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki la leit noh na ka shnong bad ym pat jngai, u Joseph u la ong ha u nongap jong u, Up, bud ia ki briew ; bad haba me la palat ia ki, to ong ha ki: Balei phi la siew kylliang ia ka jingsniew na ka bynta ka jingbha ?

en: Rejoice greatly , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O daughter of Jerusalem : behold , thy King cometh unto thee : he is just , and having salvation  ; lowly , and riding upon an ass , and upon a colt the foal of an ass .
kha: To kmen to shadkmen ko ki briew ka Seïon ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen phi ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ! Ha khmih u syiem jong phi u wan sha phi ! U wan ha ka jingrisa bad ha ka jingjop , hynrei ha ka jingsngewrit bad u da shong halor ka kada — halor u khun kada .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngewbha shibun, ko khun jong u Seion; to pyrta, ko khun jong u Jerusalem: ha khmih, u Syiem jong me u wan sha me: u long uba hok, bad uba don ka jingpynim; bad uba shong ha ka kada, bad halor ka khun masi jong u kada .

en: Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :
kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit bad ki . Um shym da jngai na ka ïing mynba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la phah ïa ki paralok ban ong ha U ,  Kynrad , wat pynshitom ïa lade . Ngam dei hok ban pdiang ïa me ha ka ïing jong nga ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad ki . Bad haba u la don mynta ha iing, u rangbah u la phah paralok ia u, u da ong ha u: Ko Trai, wat pynkhuslai ia lade: namar ngam long uba bit ba me rung hapoh ka tnum jong nga:

en: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering , both of the new moons , and of all the set feasts of the  Lord  that were consecrated , and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the  Lord .
kha: bad nalor kata , ki ai ki jingainguh thang tylli bad kito ki jingainguh ban ai ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai bad ha baroh kiwei ki jingïaseng ba ju long ha kaba la mane ïa U  Trai  , kumjuh ruh ki jingainguh ba ai sha U  Trai  da ka mon sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kata la ai ia ka jingainguh thang kaba iai bteng, baroh ar ki bnai thymmai bad na ki jingkhawai ba la buh jong U Trai kiba la pynkyntang , bad na uwei pa uwei uba la aiti mon sngewbha ia ka jingainguh kaba laitluid ha U Trai .

en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus , whom we have not preached , or if ye receive another spirit , which ye have not received , or another gospel , which ye have not accepted , ye might well bear with him .
kha: Naba phi la ïaishah da kaba kmen ïa uno uno uba wan ha phi bad ïalap ïa uwei pat U Jisu , ym uta uba ngi la ïalap ; bad phi pdiang ïa u mynsiem bad ïa ka gospel kaba pher shibun na U Mynsiem bad ka gospel kaba phi la ïohpdiang na ngi!
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada uta u wan u ialap ia uwei pat u Jisu, ia uba ngim shym la ialap, lane lada phi pdiang ia uwei pat u mynsiem, ia uba phim shym la pdiang, ne ia kawei pat ka gospel kaba phim shym la pdiang, phi lah ban shah bha bad u .

en: And when we departed from Horeb , we went through all that great and terrible wilderness , which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites , as the  Lord  our God commanded us  ; and we came to Kadesh–barnea .
kha: Ngi la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi . Ngi mih na u Lum Sinai bad ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad ba-ima sha ka ri lum Amor . Ynda ngi poi ha Kadesh Barnea ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ngi la leit noh na Horeb , ngi la iaid lyngba kata ka ri khlaw kaba khraw bad kaba shyrkhei baroh kaba phi la iohi da u lum ki Amorites , kumba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ia ngi; bad ngi la poi ha Kadeshbarnea .

en: Also , thou son of man , shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength , the joy of their glory , the desire of their eyes , and that whereupon they set their minds , their sons and their daughters ,
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , ngan shim noh na ki ïa ka Templ bakhraw kaba la long ka jingsarong bad ka jingkmen jong ki , kaba ki sngewtynnat ban khmih bad ban leit jngoh . Bad ngan shim noh ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh, ko khun u briew, kan ym long ha ka sngi ba ngan shim na ki ia ka bor jong ki, ka jingkmen jong ka burom jong ki, ka jingkwah jong ki khmat jong ki bad kata ha kaba ki buh ia ka jingmut jong ki, ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki .

en: And yet for all that , when they be in the land of their enemies , I will not cast them away , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly , and to break my covenant with them : for I am the  Lord  their God .
kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , katba ki dang don ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki , ngan ym iehnoh syndon lane pynjot ïa ki . Da kumta ngan ym pyndkut noh ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ki , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la katta ruh na ka bynta kita baroh, haba ki don ha ka ri jong ki nongshun jong ki, ngan ym bret noh ia ki, lymne ngan ym kyntait ia ki, ban pynjot lut ia ki, bad ban pynpra ia ka jutang jong nga bad ki: namar nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .

en: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea , and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared  ; and the Egyptians fled against it  ; and the  Lord  overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea .
kha: Kumta u Moses u kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw , bad haba ka la kynjat shai ka duriaw ka dap biang kumba mynshuwa . Ki nong Ijipt ki la pyrshang ban lait im na ka um , hynrei U  Trai  u la bret ïa ki sha ka duriaw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la pynkhih ia la ka kti halor ka duriaw , bad ka duriaw ka la wan phai biang sha ka bor jong u haba la mih ka ; bad ki nong Ijipt ki la phet noh pyrshah ia ka ; bad U Trai u la pynkhih ia ki nong Ijipt hapdeng ka duriaw .

en: And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u dei ban leh , u la kylli ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba phi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu leh hi marwei ïa kane baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng hangne naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u kpa tymmen u Moses u la iohi ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u la leh ia ki briew ? balei ba me shong marwei bad ki briew baroh ki ieng hajan jong me naduh mynstep haduh janmiet ?

en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .
kha: Nangta ki pynïabynta hapdeng ki briew , kat kum ki kynhun longïing , ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang , khnang ba kin lah ban ai ïa ki kat kum ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la weng noh ia ki jingknia thang , ba kin ai katkum ka jingphiah jong ki longiing jong ki briew , ban ai sha U Trai kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab u Moses . Bad kumta ki la leh ia ki masi .

en: Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .
kha: Phi la kyrmen ïa ki jingot kiba bun , hynrei ki la kylla long tang khyndiat . Bad haba phi la wanrah ïa ka jingot sha ïing , nga pynher ïa ka sha jngai . Balei ba nga la leh ïa kata ? Namar ka Templ jong nga ka dang don ha ki jingjot katba uwei pa uwei na phi u bunkam ha ka jingtrei ïa la ka jong ka ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Phi la wad shibun, bad, ha khmih, ka la poi sha ka iing kaba rit bad haba phi la wanrah ia ka sha iing, nga la pynbthei ia ka . Balei ? ong U Trai jong ki paid . Namar ka iing jong nga kaba la jot , bad phi iaid uwei pa uwei sha la ka jong ka iing .

en: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee , or if thou know him not , then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house , and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it , and thou shalt restore it to him again .
kha: Hynrei lada u shong jngai , lane lada phim tip uei u trai jong ka , ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jong phi . Ynda u trai u wan wad ïa ka , ai ïa ka ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada u hynmen jong me um long uba jan bad me, lane lada phim ithuh ia u, te to wanrah ia ka ha la iing, bad kan long bad me haduh ba u hynmen jong me un wad ia ka, bad men pynphai biang ia ka ha u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven , that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt , upon man , and upon beast , and upon every herb of the field , throughout the land of Egypt .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong , bad u phria un hap ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei — ha ki briew , ha ki mrad , bad ha ki jingthung baroh kiba ha lyngkha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, Pynkhih ia ka kti jong me sha bneng, ba kan don ka jingkhriat ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei, halor u briew bad halor ki mrad bad halor uwei pa uwei u jingthung jong ka lyngkha, ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

en: Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :
kha: U Syiem Kynrad u la pynmih ka hukum ba tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , uwei pa uwei u dei ban dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,
translated_en_to_kha: Me, ko syiem, me la hukum, ba uwei pa uwei u briew uba iohsngew ia ka sur jong ka kornet, ka flute, ka harp, ka sackbut , ka jingsawa bad ka jingsma bad ki jait jingsawa baroh ki dei ban hap bad mane ia ka dur ksiar:

en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold , and of spices very great store , and precious stones : there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon .
kha: Ka la ai sngewbha ïa u syiem Solomon da ki jingai kiba ka la wanrah palat saw hajar kilo ka ksiar bad shikatdei eh ki jingiwbih bad ki mawlynnai . Kat kita ki jingiwbih ba ka ai ïa u ka long kaba bun tam ba um pat ju ïoh ha kano kano ka por .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ai ia u syiem shispah arphew talent ka ksiar bad ki jingbam ba bang bha bad ki maw ba kordor: ym shym la wan shuh ki jingbam ba bun kum kine kiba ka mahadei ka Sheba ka la ai ha u syiem Solomon .

en: Then the angel of the  Lord  answered and said , O  Lord  of hosts , how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah , against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years ?
kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me la bitar ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah haduh hynñiewphew snem mynta . Slem sa katno kan long ha shuwa ba men pyn-i ha ki ka jingisynei ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u angel U Trai u la jubab bad u la ong: Ko Trai jong ki paid, haduh katno phin ym isynei ia ka Jerusalem bad ia ki shnong Judah , ha kaba me la don ka jingbitar ia kine ki hynriewphew snem ?

en: And moreover the king s servants came to bless our lord king David , saying , God make the name of Solomon better than thy name , and make his throne greater than thy throne . And the king bowed himself upon the bed .
kha: Nalor kata , ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar ki la leit bad ai ka jingñiewburom jong ki ïa u Syiem Kynrad , u Syiem Dabid bad ki ong , ‘ To U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa u Solomon uba kham pawnam ban ïa phi , bad ai ba ka jingsynshar jong u Solomon kan long kaba man roi shibun ban ïa ka jong phi .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nalor kata ki shakri syiem ki la wan ban kyrkhu ia u syiem jong ngi u Dabid, da kaba ong: U Blei un pynlong ia ka kyrteng u Solomon kaba kham bha ban ia ka kyrteng jong me, bad un pynlong ia ka khet jong u kaba kham heh ban ia ka khet jong me . Bad u syiem u la dem khrup ia lade halor ka jingthiah .

en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .
kha: Baroh kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , ki don mar hynriew tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmat , shapoh bad shabar . Mynsngi bad mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba rwai :  Bakhuid , bakhuid , bakhuid , long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , Uba la long , uba long bad u ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki saw tylli ki mrad ki don hynriew tylli ki bniat sawdong jong u ; bad ki la dap da ki khmat hapoh: bad kim shongthait miet bad sngi, ki ong: U Blei Bakhuid, bakhuid, U Trai Bakhuid, U Trai Bakhuid, Uba la long, bad uba la wan .

en: And he hath confirmed his words , which he spake against us , and against our judges that judged us , by bringing upon us a great evil : for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem .
kha: Me la leh ïa kaei kaba me la ong ba men leh ha ngi bad ha ki nongsynshar jong ngi . Me la pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kham jur ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka nongbah ha ka pyrthei ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynskhem ia ki ktien jong u, kiba u la kren pyrshah ia ngi, bad pyrshah ia ki nongbishar jong ngi kiba la bishar ia ngi, da kaba wanrah ia ngi ia ka jingsniew kaba khraw: namar hapoh ka bneng baroh kawei kam shym la long kumba la leh ha Jerusalem .

en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
kha: Haba kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad hap . Bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u .  U  Trai  u la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ong U Trai jong ki paid , yn weng noh ia u nail uba la shah pynskhem ha ka jaka kaba skhem, bad yn ot noh ia u, bad yn hap; bad ka jingkit kaba la don halor jong ka yn ot noh: namar U Trai u la kren ia ka .

en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .
kha: U Paul u la nang sah kham bun sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Korinth , nangta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit da ka lieng lem bad ka Priskila bad u Akwila sha Syria . Ha shuwa ba un leit da ka lieng na Kenkhria u la phah khi ïa la ka khlieh namar ka jingsmai kaba u la pynlong .
translated_en_to_kha: U Paul hadien kane u la sah hangta sa shipor, bad nangta u la leit noh na ki para bangeit, bad u la leit noh nangta sha Syria, bad bad u u Priscilla bad u Aquila; u la ot ia la ka khlieh ha Cenchrea: namar u la don ka jingkular .

en: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God , and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God , and shut up the doors of the house of the  Lord  , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem .
kha: Nalor kata u shim ïa baroh ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ , bad u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki ; u khang noh ïa ka Templ , bad u tei ki duwan ha man la ki dong jong ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahas u la lum lang ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Blei bad u la ot ia ki tiar jong ka iing U Blei bad u la khang ia ki jingkhang jong ka iing U Trai bad u la shna ia u ha man la ki thliew jong ka Jerusalem .

en: And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
kha: Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet noh na surok bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . U Balaam u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .
translated_en_to_kha: U kada u la iohi ia u angel U Trai uba ieng ha lynti, bad ka waitlam jong u ka la tan noh na ka lynti, bad u kada u la leit sha lyngkha: bad u Balaam u la pynkhih ia ka sha ka lynti .

en: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod .
kha: Teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem bad ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngum , khnang ba ka jingdeng shadem kan shong halor u panpoh bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin teh ia ka sniehdoh da ki ryntieh jong ka ha ki ryntieh jong ka ephod da ka rong saw, ba kan long halor ka ryntieh kaba sngewtynnad jong ka ephod bad ba ka sniehdoh kan ym jah noh na ka ephod .

en: Said unto them , Ye have brought this man unto me , as one that perverteth the people : and , behold , I , having examined him before you , have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him :
kha: Phi la wallam ïa une u briew ha nga bad phi la ong ba u ïalam bakla ïa u paidbah . Mynta , nga la jurip bha ïa u hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong phi , bad ngam shym shem ïa u ba u shah rem ha kano kano ka kam runar kaba phi mudui ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: La ong ha ki , Phi la wanrah ia une u briew ha nga kum uba pynkylla ia ki briew: bad, ha khmih, nga la bishar bniah ia u ha khmat jong phi, ngam shym la lap ia ka jingbakla ha une u briew uba ktah ia kita kiei kiei kiba phi kynnoh ia u:

en: And now , Israel , what doth the  Lord  thy God require of thee , but to fear the  Lord  thy God , to walk in all his ways , and to love him , and to serve the  Lord  thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul ,
kha: Mynta , ko ki paid Israel , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u dawa na phi : Mane ïa U  Trai  bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum . Ieit ïa u , shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta, ko Israel, kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u dawa na me, hynrei ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong me, ban iaid ha ki lynti jong u baroh bad ban ieit ia u bad ban shakri ia U Trai U Blei jong me da ka dohnud jong me baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong me baroh .

en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them , which I command thee this day , to love the  Lord  thy God , and to walk ever in his ways  ; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee , beside these three :
kha: te phi dei ban jied sa lai tylli ki shnong . ( Un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri lada phi leh ïa baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi ha kane ka sngi bad lada phi ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad im kat kum ki jinghikai jong U . )
translated_en_to_kha: Lada me sumar ia kine ki hukum baroh ban leh ia ki, kiba nga hukum ia me ha kane ka sngi, ban ieit ia U Trai U Blei jong me, bad ban iaid beit ha ki lynti jong u ; te me pyndap lai tylli ki nongbah na ka bynta jong me, nalor kine lai tylli:

en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish , and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish , and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and one log of oil .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , un wallam ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang bad kawei ka langbrot kynthei kaba shisnem , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna , lai kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad kumba shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra un shim ar tylli ki langbrot khlem jingduna, bad uwei u langbrot khlem jingduna ha ka snem kaba nyngkong, bad lai tylli ki shini kiba bha na ka bynta ka jingknia doh, ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang .

en: And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .
