kha: Te , lada phim mon shuh ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namar ba phi la pynbor ban ïathiah shongkha bad ka , phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka kum ka mraw bad die ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, lada phim sngewbha ia ka, te to pyllait noh ia ka katba ka mon; hynrei wat die ia ka satia na ka bynta ka pisa .

en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa uba na Shiloh , u ïakynduh ïa u marwei ha lynti kaba ha rudnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por ba u Jeroboan u la mih na Jerusalem, ba u nongiathuhlypa Ahiah u Shilon u la lap ia u ha lynti ; bad u la phong ia lade da ka jain thymmai ; bad ki arngut ki la don marwei ha lyngkha :

en: Then said Ziba unto the king , According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant , so shall thy servant do . As for Mephibosheth , said the king , he shall eat at my table , as one of the king s sons .
kha: U Siba u jubab ,  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma phi Syiem Kynrad phi hukum .  Kumta u Mephibosheth u ïabam lang ha ka miej bam jong u syiem , kum uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Siba u la ong ha u syiem: Kat kum ka jinglong jong u syiem jong nga, kumta u shakri jong me un leh . Katba u Mephiboshet u la ong u syiem .

en: This is the ordinance of the law which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying , Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring thee a red heifer without spot , wherein is no blemish , and upon which never came yoke :
kha: ban ai ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki Israel .  Wallam ha u Moses bad u Aaron kawei ka masi lud rong saw ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad ïa kaba ym pat shym la pyntreikam ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong ka hukum kaba U Trai u la hukum, da kaba ong: Kren ha ki khun Israel , ba kin wanrah ia me ia ka masi kaba saw khlem da sniew , ha kaba ym don jingduna , bad ha kaba ym ju wan ka yoke:

en: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne , and before the four beasts , and the elders : and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand , which were redeemed from the earth .
kha: Ki shi lakh sawphew saw hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khet , ha khmat ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ha khmat ki nongsharai balang ; ki la ïarwai ïa ka jingrwai kaba thymmai , kaba tang ma ki hi ki lah ban nang . Na ki bynriew baroh , ki long tang ma ki , kiba la siewspah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rwai kumba ka long ka jingrwai thymmai ha khmat ka khet bad ha khmat ki saw tylli ki mrad: bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban nang ia kata ka jingrwai hynrei tang ki shispah sawphew saw hajar ngut kiba la shah pyllait im na ka khyndew .

en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us ,  A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Ka mut aïu kane ? U ïathuh ïa ngi ba sa tang shipor ngin ym ïohi shuh ïa u ; bad nangta sa shipor hadien ngin sa ïohi ïa u ; bad u ong ruh , ‘ Ka long namar ba ngan sa leit noh sha U Kpa .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong katto katne na ki synran jong u hapdeng jong u, Kaei kane ba u ong ha ngi: Khyndiat por bad phin ym iohi ia nga: bad sa shisien pat: bad phin sa iohi ia nga: bad , Namar nga leit sha U Kpa ?

en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
kha: Namar ba phi la sngewkmen , ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kin sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta . Kin bam ïa u soh bad kin dih ïa ka dud kiba dei ki jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , namarkata ngan aiti ia me ha ki briew jong ka mihngi na ka bynta ka jingdon jingem jong me, bad kin buh ia ki iing jong ki ha me, bad kin shna ia ki jaka sah jong ki ha me: kin bam ia u soh jong me bad kin dih ia ka dud jong me .

en: We lie down in our shame , and our confusion covereth us : for we have sinned against the  Lord  our God , we and our fathers , from our youth even unto this day , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God .
kha: Ngi dei ban shah ha ka jinglehrain bad ai ba ka jingjahburom kan tap ïa ngi . Ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ngi la ïai leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ; ngim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi thiah ha ka jingsngewlehrain jong ngi , bad ka jingkulmar jong ngi ka tap ia ngi: namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai jong ngi , ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi naduh ka por ba ngi dang samla haduh kane ka sngi , bad ngim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai jong ngi .

en: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite , the stranger , and the fatherless , and the widow , that are within thy gates .
kha: To ïalehkmen ïa ka lem bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kmen ha ka jingkhawai jong me, ma me bad u khun jong me, bad u nongshakri jong me, bad u nongshakri jong me, bad u Lebi, u nongwei bad u khlem kpa, bad ka riewkynthei jong me, kiba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me .

en: But the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying , Thou hast shed blood abundantly , and hast made great wars : thou shalt not build an house unto my name , because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ïa nga , ba nga la pynïap shibun eh ki briew bad ïaleh shibun ki thma . Bad kumta , namar ba nga la pynmih shibun ka snam , un ym shah ïa nga ban tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha nga, ka da ong: Me la pynmih snam shibun bad me la leh ia ki thma kiba khraw: me dei ban tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng jong nga , namar me la pynmih snam shibun ha ka khyndew ha khmat jong nga .

en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .
kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïaid sha shiliang ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ki ïeng ha ka dewryngkhiang hapdeng jong ka Jordan tad haduh ba uta u paidbah un da jam sha shiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba kit ia ka synduk jong ka jutang U Trai ki la ieng skhem ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang hapdeng ka Jordan , bad ki Israel baroh ki la iaid lyngba ia ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , haduh ba ki briew baroh ki la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan .

en: Mine eyes do fail with tears , my bowels are troubled , my liver is poured upon the earth , for the destruction of the daughter of my people  ; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city .
kha: Ki briew jong ka ki ud katba ki wad ei ei ban bam ; ki ïa-bujli ïa la ki jingkynshew na ka bynta ka jingbam ban pynsah im ïa lade .  To khmih sha nga , A  Trai  ,  ka nongbah ka kyang ;  to peit ïa nga ha ka jinglong rangli jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki jah rngai da ki ummat , ki bniat jong nga ki la tyrkhong , ka sniehdoh jong nga ka la tuid ha ka khyndew , namar ka jingpynjot ia ka khun jong ki briew jong nga ; namar ki khynnah bad ki khun ki tuid ha ki surok jong ka nongbah .

en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
kha: Kumta haba phi ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti bah . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki briew kin ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da ïoh ka jingsiew ba-pura .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata haba me leh ia ki alms jong me, wat pynsawa ia ka turoi ha khmat jong me, kumba ki nongleh arsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti iaid kjat, ba kin ioh ia ka burom jong ki briew . Hooid nga ong ha phi , Ki don ka bainong jong ki .

en: For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .
kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongbatai kupar , hynrei ki jubab kiba ki ïoh ki long ki jinglamler bad ki bym don jingmut . Katto katne ki pyrshang ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , hynrei tang ban shu ïalam bakla ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta ki briew ki sakma kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la jah . Ki don ha ka jingjynjar namar ba kim don u nongïalam .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki bleithaw ki la kren bein, bad ki nongleh jadu ki la iohi ia ka jinglamler, bad ki la iathuh ia ki jingphohsniew lamler ; ki pyntngen khlem da don ei ei: namarkata ki la iaid lynti kum ka kynhun , ki la shah pynshitom , namar ym don nongap langbrot .

en: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear : and there is a multitude of slain , and a great number of carcases  ; and there is none end of their corpses  ; they stumble upon their corpses :
kha: Ki nongshong kulai ki kynha , ki waitlam ki thaba , ki sum ki phalang ! ïa ki metïap la kynton shajrong , ki metïap bym don jingkheiñ — ki briew ki jynthut halor jong ki !
translated_en_to_kha: U nongshong kulai u pynkiew ia ka waitlam kaba shai bad ka waitlam kaba rben: bad ka don ka jingbun ki briew kiba la shah pyniap; bad ym don jingkut ei ei na ki met iap jong ki; ki ia tyngkhuh bad ki met iap jong ki:

en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them , nor serve them : for I the  Lord  thy God am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me  ;
kha: Wat dem lane mane ïa kano kano ka bleithaw , naba nga , nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad ngam lah shah ïano ïano ba pyrshah ïa nga . Nga wallam ka jingpynshitom ha kito kiba isih ïa nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng bynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat dem khrup ia lade ha ki , lymne wat shakri ia ki: namar nga U Trai U Blei jong me nga long U Blei uba sngewsih , nga leit jngoh ia ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa ha ki khun haduh ka pateng kaba lai bad kaba saw jong ki kiba shun ia nga;

en: Tell them therefore , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will make this proverb to cease , and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel  ; but say unto them , The days are at hand , and the effect of every vision .
kha: Mynta ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don ban ong shaphang kata . Ngan buh ka jingkut ïa kata ka proberb . Yn ym ïai kren shuh ïa ka da lei lei ha Israel . Pynban to ïathuh ïa ki : Ka por ka la wan , bad ki jingïathuhlypa ki la urlong shisha !
translated_en_to_kha: Iathuh ia ki namarkata , Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong ba ngan pynlong ia kane ka proberb ban sangeh noh , bad kin ym pyndonkam shuh ia ka kum ka proberb ha Israel ; hynrei kin ong ha ki , Ki sngi ki don hajan bad ka jingktah jong kawei pa kawei ka jingphohsniew .

en: And the  Lord  delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel , which took it on the second day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein , according to all that he had done to Libnah .
kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor ka Lakhish ha ka sngi kaba ar jong ka thma . Kumba ki la leh ha Libnah , kim shym iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la aiti ia ka Lachish ha ka kti jong ki Israel, kiba la shim ia ka ha ka sngi kaba ar, bad u la shoh ia ka da ka tduh jong ka waitlam bad ki mynsiem baroh kiba don hangta, kat kum ka jingleh jong u ia ka Libna .

en: And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .
kha: Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak bad wad ïa ka Jerusalem . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sngewhun ha lade bad kiba sngewskhem , kiba ong ha lade , ‘ U  Trai  um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane katai .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka por, ba ngan wad ia ka Jerusalem da ki sharak, bad ngan pynshitom ia ki briew kiba la shong ha ka kot jong ki: kiba ong ha ka dohnud jong ki: U Trai un ym leh bha , lymne un ym leh ia kaba sniew .

en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years , that the  Lord  will visit Tyre , and she shall turn to her hire , and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth .
kha: Haba ki hynñiewphew snem ki la kut , U  Trai  un sa shah ïa ka Tyros ban leit phai pat sha ka kam khaïi kaba mynshuwa , bad kan aiwai ïa lade sha baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia hadien ka jingkut jong ki hynriewphew snem, ba U Trai un leit jngoh ia ka Tyros , bad kan phai sha ka bainong jong ka , bad kan leh ia ka kam sniew bad ki hima pyrthei baroh ha ka khmat jong ka pyrthei .

en: When the  Lord  thy God shall enlarge thy border , as he hath promised thee , and thou shalt say , I will eat flesh , because thy soul longeth to eat flesh  ; thou mayest eat flesh , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .
kha: Ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la kular , lada phi kwah bam doh phi lah ban bam katba phi mon .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba U Trai U Blei jong me un pynheh ia u pud jong me, kumba u la kular ia me, bad me dei ban ong, Ngan bam doh, namar ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah ban bam doh ; me lah ban bam ia ka doh, katba ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah .

en: So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .
kha: Ki la leit shata namar dei hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ka don , ha kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pynïeng ha ka ri khlaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Solomon bad ka jingiaseng baroh ryngkat bad u ki la leit sha ka jaka kaba jrong kaba don ha Gibeon ; namar ka don ka iing jong ka jingiaseng U Blei kaba u Moses u shakri U Trai u la leh ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation  ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .
kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Phi hi phi tip bha ba la khang ïa u Jiw da ka niam jong u ban leit jngoh lane ïajan bad ki Jentil . Hynrei U Blei u la pyn-i ha nga ba ngam dei ban ñiew bymkhuid ne basang kat kum ka jinglehniam ïa uno uno u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki , Phi tip kumno ba ka long kaba khlem ain ia u briew uba long u Jiw ban iakynduh , ne ban wan sha kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ; hynrei U Blei u la pyni ia nga ba ngam dei ban khot ia uno uno u briew uba iadei ne uba khlem khuid .

en: And the feast of harvest , the firstfruits of thy labours , which thou hast sown in the field : and the feast of ingathering , which is in the end of the year , when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field .
kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba phi sdang ban ot .  Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ka por synrai , haba phi kheit ïa u soh na ki brisoh jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingkhawai jong ka jingot , ki soh ba nyngkong jong ka jingtrei shitom jong me , kiba me la bet ha lyngkha : bad ka jingkhawai jong ka jinglum lang kaba don ha kaba kut jong u snem , haba me la lum ha ka jingtrei shitom jong me na lyngkha .

en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate : and the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died , as the man of God had said , who spake when the king came down to him .
kha: Ka leit jingjia ryngkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la buh ha ka khyrdop nongbah hapoh ka jingpeit jong u rangbah pynïaidkam uba dei u nongïarap ba-hajan jong u . U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shah ïuh hangta ha ki paidbah bad u la ïap kumba u Elisha u la ïathuh lypa mynba u syiem u la leit ïakynduh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la thung ia u kynrad ha ka kti jong u ban don ka jingkitkhlieh jong ka khyrdop: bad ki briew ki la iaid halor jong u ha ka khyrdop , bad u la iap , kumba u briew U Blei u la ong , uba la kren haba u syiem u la wan hiar sha u .

en: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas : I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday : I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly , and terrors upon the city .
kha: La don kham bun ki riewkynthei ha ka ri jong phi ban ïa ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Nga la pynïap ïa ki rangsamla jong phi ha ka rta kaba dang khie bha bad pynlong ïa ki kmie jong ki ban shahshitom . Nga lynshop kynsan ïa ki da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingtriem .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki riewkynthei jong ki ki nang kiew ha nga halor ka dewbilat jong ki duriaw: Nga la wanrah ia ki pyrshah ia ka kmie jong ki samla ha ka por shiteng sngi: Nga la pynlong ia u ban hap ha ka kynsan kynsan, bad ki jingtieng ia ka nongbah .

en: And Ruth said , Entreat me not to leave thee , or to return from following after thee : for whither thou goest , I will go  ; and where thou lodgest , I will lodge : thy people shall be my people , and thy God my God :
kha: Hynrei ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Wat ong ïa nga ban iehnoh ïa phi ! Shah ba ngan leit bad phi . Kat shaba phi leit , ngan leit ; kat haba phi shong phi sah , hangta ngan shong ngan sah . Ki briew jong phi kin long ki briew jong nga , bad U Blei jong phi un long U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka Ruth ka la ong: Pynbeit ia nga ban ym iehnoh ia me, ne ban leit phai noh hadien jong me: namar ha kaba me leit, ngan leit; bad ha kaba me leit sah: ki briew jong me kin long ki briew jong nga, bad U Blei jong me U Blei jong nga:

en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .
kha: Pynban mynta me ïai leh shuh shuh ; me la pynlong ki kular na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan , bad me , ko  Trai  U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kum u briew uba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad pynban kane ka la long kaba rit ha ki khmat jong me, ko Blei; namar me ruh me la kren shaphang ka iing jong u shakri jong me ha ka por kaba bun ban wan, bad me la pyrkhat ia nga kat kum ka jaka jong u briew uba heh , ko Trai Blei .

en: O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .
kha: Ko Belteshassar , u rangbah jong ki nongbatai kupar , nga tip ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me , bad ba me shemphang ïa ki jingmaïan baroh . Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew jong nga . To ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Belteshazzar, ko kynrad jong ki nongleh jadu, namar nga tip ba ka mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid ka don ha me, bad ym don jingeh kaba rieh ia me, to iathuh ia nga ia ki jingphohsniew jong nga kiba nga la iohi, bad ka jingbatai jong ka .

en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come  ; and even now already is it in the world .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba len ïa kane shaphang U Jisu , um don U Mynsiem na U Blei . U mynsiem ba u don , u long na u Nongshun jong U Khrist ; phi la ïohsngew ba un wan , bad mynta u la da don hangne ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei u mynsiem u bym phla ba U Jisu Khrist u wan ha ka doh: bad kane ka long kata ka mynsiem jong u nongialeh pyrshah ia U Khrist, na kaba phi la iohsngew ba ka dei ban wan; bad wat mynta ruh ka la don ha ka pyrthei .

en: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .
kha: Ngan pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nong Ijipt bad ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ban ïarap ïa ki , bad kin leit ban kylli na ki nongleh byrtong bad kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap ban ïoh jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka mynsiem jong ka ri Ijipt kan jah noh hapdeng jong ka bad ngan pynjot ia ka jingmut jong ka: bad kin wad ia ki bleithaw bad ia ki nongleh jadu bad ia kito kiba la tip bha bad ia ki nongleh jadu .

en: Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , and take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said , and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king s gate : let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .
kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Haman ,  Pynkloi bad shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad ïa u kulai bad pyndonburom kumne ïa u Mordekai , u Jiw . Leh ïa u baroh kata kaba me la ai jingmut . Men shem ïa u ba u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ha u Haman, To shim kyrkieh ia ka jain bad u kulai kumba me la ong, bad leh kumta ruh ia u Mordecai u Jiw uba shong ha ka khyrdop syiem: wat ai ba ym don ei ei kaba duna na kiei kiei baroh kiba me la kren .

en: But since ye say , The burden of the  Lord   ; therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Because ye say this word , The burden of the  Lord  , and I have sent unto you , saying , Ye shall not say , The burden of the  Lord   ;
kha: Bad lada kim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei namar ba phi ong , Ka jingkit jong U Trai ; namarkata ka ong kumta ia U Trai ; Namar phi ong ia kane ka ktien , Ka jingkit jong U Trai , bad nga la phah sha phi da kaba ong , Phim dei ban ong , Ka jingkit jong U Trai ; .

en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the  Lord  , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the  Lord . So he finished the house .
kha: Lai sien shisnem , u Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh pynïasuk ha kata ka duwan ba u la tei ha U  Trai . U thang ruh ïa ka jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai . Bad kumta u pyndep kaba tei ïa ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lai sien ha ka shisnem u Solomon u la ainguh ia ki jingknia thang bad ki jingknia jingsuk ha ka almari kaba u la tei ha U Trai , bad u la thang ia ka jingiwbih ha ka almari kaba don ha khmat U Trai . Kumta u la pyndep ia ka iing .

en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .
kha: Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim kawei ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka hadien jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng . Ki ïaid dadien shapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da phai dien khnang ba kin ym ïohi ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Shem bad u Japhet ki la shim ia ka jain bad ki la buh ia ka ha baroh ar tylli ki tyrpeng jong ki, bad ki la leit phai shadien bad ki la tap ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong ki ; bad ki khmat jong ki ki la phaidien noh , bad kim shym la iohi ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong u kpa jong ki .

en: And the kings of the earth , and the great men , and the rich men , and the chief captains , and the mighty men , and every bondman , and every free man , hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains  ;
kha: Te ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah shipai , kiba riewspah bad kiba donbor , bad kiwei pat ki briew baroh , ki mraw ne kiba laitluid , ki la buhrieh ïa lade ha ki krem bad ha ki synrang maw ba-don ha ki lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki syiem ka khyndew bad ki riew rangbah bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki riew rangbah bad ki riew rangbah bad u nongshun bad u nongshun bad u briew uba laitluid baroh ki la buhrieh ia lade ha ki thliew bad ha ki mawsiang lum;

en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and his prayer unto his God , and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the  Lord  God of Israel , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel .
kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba u Manasseh u la leh , ka jingduwai ba u pynlong sha U Blei , bad ki khubor jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Manasseh bad ka jingduwai jong u ha U Blei jong u bad ki ktien jong ki nongiohi kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , ha khmih la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Israel .

en: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .
kha: U Dabid bad ki paidbah ki leit sha ka nongbah Baalah , kata ka dei ka Kiriath Jearim , ha ka ri Judah , ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  uba shong halor ki Kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la leit kiew, bad ki Israel baroh, sha Bala, kata, sha Kirjathjaram, kaba long ka jong u Judah, ban wanrah nangta ia ka synduk U Blei U Trai, kaba shong hapdeng ki cherubim, kiba la khot kyrteng ha ka .

en: When thou criest , let thy companies deliver thee  ; but the wind shall carry them all away  ; vanity shall take them : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land , and shall inherit my holy mountain  ;
kha: Haba phi kyang ban ïoh jingïarap , ai ba kito ki bleithaw jong phi kin pyllait ïa phi ! Tang shisien pyrsad ka lyer kan rong noh ïa ki ! Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha nga kin ïoh im ha ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha ka Templ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me pyrta, to ai ba ki kynhun jong me kin pynpoi ia me ; hynrei ka Iyer kan rah noh ia ki baroh: hynrei uta uba buh ia ka jingshaniah jong u ha nga un ioh ia ka ri, bad un hiar pateng ia u lum bakhuid jong nga ; .

en: And she said unto her , Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son s mandrakes also ? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son s mandrakes .
kha: Ka Leah ka jubab ,  Hato pham pat sngewhun ba pha la knieh noh ïa u tnga jong nga ? Mynta pat pha pyrshang ban shim sa ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong nga .  Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  Lada phan ai ïa nga ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong pha , pha lah ban thiah bad u Jakob mynta ka miet .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ong ha ka, Hato ka long kaba rit ba me la shim ia u tnga jong nga ? bad hato me shim noh ia u khun jong nga ruh ? Bad ka Rakhel ka la ong , Namar kata un thiah bad me miet na ka bynta u khun jong me .

en: Also he strengthened himself , and built up all the wall that was broken , and raised it up to the towers , and another wall without , and repaired Millo in the city of David , and made darts and shields in abundance .
kha: U syiem u pynkhlaiñ ïa ki jingïada ïa ka nongbah da kaba tei bha ïa ka kynroh , kaba tei ïa ki kut halor jong ka , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh na shabar . Nalor kata , u tei pat ïa ki jingïada ba la tei ha ka jaka kaba la pyndap khyndew ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem ha ka bynta kaba rim . U phah shna ruh bun bah ki sum bad ki stieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la pynskhem ia lade , bad u la tei ia ka kynroh baroh kaba la tyrkhong , bad u la pynkiew ia ka haduh ki tower , bad kawei pat ka kynroh shabar , bad u la pynbha ia u Millo ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u la shna ia ki nar bad ki jingda ha ka jingbun .

en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles , and shall take many : but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease  ; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him .
kha: Hadien kata un tur ïaleh ïa ki hima kiba harud duriaw bad u jop ïa kiba bun na ki . Hynrei u nongïalam nongwei un jop ïa u bad un pynkut ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u ; da shisha un pynphai pat ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u syiem ka Syria sha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane un phai ia la ka khmat sha ki dulir, bad un shim bun: hynrei u syiem na ka bynta jong u hi un pynlong ia ka jingshah lehbein kaba la tyrwa da u ban sangeh noh; khlem ka jingshah lehbein jong u hi un pynlong ia ka ban phai noh sha u .

en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .
kha: U kamar u shim shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ïa ka ha ka ding . Ka ksang ti bakhlaiñ jong u ka pynkhih ïa u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka sniehdoh kaba don ki thliew baroh ar ka trei ha ki dewiong , bad ka pynlong ia ka da ki hammer , bad ka trei ia ka da ka jingkhlain jong ki kti jong u: Hooid , u la thngan , bad ka bor jong u ka la jah noh: um dih um , bad u la tyrkhong .

en: As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .
kha: Da U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , nga smai ba u syiem u la phah wad ïa phi ha baroh sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba uno uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim don ha ka ri jong u , u Ahab un dawa na uta u nongsynshar ban smai ba phi long u bym lah ban shem .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba U Trai U Blei jong me u im, ym don ka jaitbynriew ne ka hima, ha kaba u kynrad jong nga um shym la phah ban wad ia me: bad haba ki la ong: Um don hangta; u la smai ia ka hima bad ka jaitbynriew ba kim shym la lap ia me .

en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
kha: Ka jingpyrta ka la kham jam , bad katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharisi ki la ïeng bad ki la pyrshah jur :  Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u angel u la kren shisha ha u !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la mih ka jingpyrta kaba khraw: bad ki nongthoh kiba long na ka bynta jong ki Pharisi ki la mih, bad ki la ia tyngkhuh, ki da ong: Ngim shem ei ei ha une u briew: hynrei lada u mynsiem ne u angel u la kren ia u: to ngin ym ialeh pyrshah ia U Blei .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Like these good figs , so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga pyrkhat ba ki briew kiba la ringmraw sha Babilonia ki long kum kine ki soh Dumbur kiba bha , ngan lehbha ïa ki da ka jingsbun .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel; Kum kine ki soh kiba bha , kumta ngan pdiang ia ki kiba la shah rah noh na Judah , kiba nga la phah noh na kane ka jaka sha ka ri jong ki Khaldian na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki .

en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice , saying , Babylon the great is fallen , is fallen , and is become the habitation of devils , and the hold of every foul spirit , and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird .
kha: U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam :  Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Mynta ka la long ka jaka shong ki ksuid bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ; baroh ki jait sim kiba jakhlia bad kiba isaitmet ki shong ha ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jem, u da ong, Ka Babylon kaba khraw ka la hap, bad ka la kylla long ka jaka shong jong ki ksuid bad ka jingbat ia uwei pa uwei u mynsiem bymkhuid bad uba shun .

en: To open their eyes , and to turn them from darkness to light , and from the power of Satan unto God , that they may receive forgiveness of sins , and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me .
kha: Me dei ban pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad pynphai ïa ki na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai , bad na ka bor jong u Soitan sha U Blei , khnang ba da ka jingngeit jong ki ha nga kin ïoh ka jingmap noh ïa ki pop jong ki bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka hapdeng ki briew kiba la jied jong U Blei .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ban plie ia ki khmat jong ki , bad ban pynphai ia ki na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai , bad na ka bor u Soitan sha U Blei , ba kin ioh ia ka jingmap ia ki pop bad ka pateng hapdeng jong ki kiba la pynkyntang da ka jingngeit kaba don ha nga .

en: And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?
kha: A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng halor ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long uba donbor bad uba khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Ko Trai U Blei jong ngi, em me U Blei ha bneng ? bad wat synshar ia ki hima baroh ? bad ha ka kti jong me ym don bor bad ka bor , haduh ba ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban shah ia me ?

en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .
kha: Kumta u pynphai pat ïa ki sha la ka kmie . Ka shim arspah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ka ai ïa ki ha u bania , uba la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka rupa . La buh ïa ka ha ïing u Mikah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la pynphai biang ia ka pisa sha ka kmie jong u ; bad ka kmie jong u ka la shim arspah Shekel rupa, bad u la ai ia ki ha u nongseng ia ka dur ba la ker bad ka dur ba la khleh lang: bad ki la don ha iing u Mihaah .

en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .
kha: Ym don mano mano ruh ba lah ban pyllait ïa lade na ka ban ïap lane pynslem ïa ka sngi ka jingïap jong u . Kata ka dei ka thma kaba ngim lah ban lait ; ngim lah ban pyllait ïa lade da ka jingshukor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym don briew uba don bor halor ka mynsiem ; bad um don bor ha ka sngi iap: bad ym don ka jingmih ha kata ka thma ; bad ka jingsniew kan ym aiti ia kito kiba la ai ha ka .

en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him , Their gods are gods of the hills  ; therefore they were stronger than we  ; but let us fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they .
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Benhadad ki ong ha u ,  Ki blei jong ki Israel ki dei ki blei lum , bad dei na kata ka daw ba ki Israel ki jop ïa ngi . Hynrei ngin sa jop khlem pep ïa ki lada ngi ïaleh ïa ki ha ki jaka madan .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u syiem Syria ki la ong ha u, Ki blei jong ki ki long ki blei jong ki lum namarkata ki kham khlain ban ia ngi ; hynrei to ngin ialeh pyrshah ia ki ha ka madan; bad shisha ngin kham khlain ban ia ki .

en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram , on every side : and Dathan and Abiram came out , and stood in the door of their tents , and their wives , and their sons , and their little children .
kha: Kumta ki la kynriah noh na ki ïingjaiñ jong u Korah , u Dathan , bad u Abiram . U Dathan bad u Abiram ki la mih shabar bad ïeng ha ka jingkhang jong ki dara jong ki lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun ki kti jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la mih na ka ïingjaiñ u Korah, u Datan bad u Abiram, na kawei ka liang: bad u Datan bad u Abiram ki la mih shabar bad ki la ieng ha ka jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki khun rit jong ki .

en: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed : and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring it into the king s treasuries .
kha: Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , pynmih da ka hukum ba dei ban pynïap noh ïa ki . Lada phi leh kumta , nga pynthikna ba ngan lah ban buh palat lai lakh sawphew hajar kilo ka rupa sha ka jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ka jingpynïaid kam ha ka hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka long kaba sngewbha ia u syiem , to ai ba kin shah pynjot: bad ngan siew shi hajar talent rupa ha ki kti jong kito kiba don ka jingkitkhlieh ia ka kam , ban wanrah ia ka ha ki jaka buh jingbam jong u syiem .

en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .
kha: bad ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shatei ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ha ka duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la hiarpateng na u Sadok ; dei tang ïa kine ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ban shakri ïa U .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kamra kaba ka jingkyrmen jong ka ka long shaphang shathie ka long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , ki nongsumar ia ka jingkitkhlieh jong ka almari: kine ki long ki khun shynrang jong u Sadok napdeng ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi kiba wan hajan U Trai ban shakri ia u .

en: Conaniah also , and Shemaiah and Nethaneel , his brethren , and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad , chief of the Levites , gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle , and five hundred oxen .
kha: Ki rangbah jong ki Lebi — u Konanaïah , u Shemaïah bad u para jong u , u Nethanel , u Hashabaïah , u Jeiel , bad u Josabad — ki ai sngewbha san hajar tylli ki langbrot bad ki khunblang bad sanspah tylli ki masi kyrtong na ka bynta ki Lebi ban ai kum ki jingkñia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Koniah ruh bad u Shemaiah bad u Nethaneel, ki hynmen jong u, bad u Hashabiah bad u Jeiel bad u Josbad u rangbah jong ki Lebi ki la ai ha ki Lebi na ka bynta ki jingknia ia ka jingkhawai niam san hajar tylli ki masi rit bad san spah tylli ki masi rit .

en: And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .
kha: Haba map , dei ban leh kumne . Uwei pa uwei uba ai ram ha la u para Israel u dei ban map ïa kata ka ram ; um dei ban dawa shuh ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  hi u la map ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kane ka long ka rukom pyllait: Uwei pa uwei u nongshim ram uba ai ram ia u para marjan jong u un pyllait ia ka ; um dei ban shim ia ka na u para marjan jong u ; namar la khot ia ka ka;

en: Behold , I will gather them out of all countries , whither I have driven them in mine anger , and in my fury , and in great wrath  ; and I will bring them again unto this place , and I will cause them to dwell safely :
kha: Ngan sa lumlang ïa ki briew na baroh ki ri na kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha kane ka jaka bad shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka jingshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan lum ia ki na ki ri baroh , ha kaba nga la beh noh ia ki ha ka jingbitar jong nga bad ha ka jingbitar kaba khraw; bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki sha kane ka jaka , bad ngan pynlong ia ki ban shong suk:

en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , The fire of God is fallen from heaven , and hath burned up the sheep , and the servants , and consumed them  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .
kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  U Pyrthat u la tied ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki nongaplangbrot bad pynïap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga uba la lait im ban wan ïathuh ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba u dang kren , la wan ruh uwei pat, bad u la ong: Ka ding U Blei ka la hap na bneng , bad ka la thang ia ki langbrot bad ki shakri bad ka la bam ia ki ; bad tang ma nga uba lait im tang ban iathuh ia me .

en: And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,
kha: Kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kaba don ki shnong kiba heh bad kiba pahuh pahai kiba phim shym la tei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long, haba U Trai U Blei jong me un wanrah ia me sha ka ri kaba u la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong me, ha u Abraham, ha u Isaak bad ha u Jakob, ban ai ia me ia ki nongbah kiba khraw bad kiba bha, kiba me la tei .

en: Come on , let us deal wisely with them  ; lest they multiply , and it come to pass , that , when there falleth out any war , they join also unto our enemies , and fight against us , and so get them up out of the land .
kha: Lada ka thma ka khie , ki lah ban leit ïasoh bad ki nongshun jong ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi , bad ban ïohphet noh na kane ka ri . To ngin kham ïaleh sian ban ym shah ïa ki ba kin nang ïaroi shuh shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: To wan , to ngin ialeh da ka jingstad bad ki ; ioh ba kin nang bun, bad ka jia, ba haba don kano kano ka thma, ki iasoh ruh bad ki nongshun jong ngi, bad ki ialeh pyrshah ia ngi, bad kumta ki mih noh na ka ri .

en: Then shall he bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it , even a memorial thereof , and burn it on the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
kha: Un wanrah ïa u ha u lyngdoh , u ban shim shi kham na u kum ka dak ba la ainguh sha U  Trai  , bad un thang ïa u ha ka duwan kum ka jingkñia ainguh bam . Ka long ka jingkñia ban pynkhuid ïa ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta un wanrah ia ka ha u lyngdoh bad u lyngdoh un shim ia ka kti jong u, wat ka jingkynmaw ia ka, bad un thang ia ka ha ka almari kat kum ki jingainguh ba la shna da ka ding sha U Trai: ka long ka jingainguh pop .

en: I John , who also am your brother , and companion in tribulation , and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ , was in the isle that is called Patmos , for the word of God , and for the testimony of Jesus Christ .
kha: Nga long u Ïoannis , u parabangeit jong phi , bad kum u nongbud jong U Jisu nga long uba ïadon bynta lem bad phi ban ïaishah ïa ka jingjynjar kaba wan ha kito kiba long na ka Hima jong u . Ïa nga la buh ha ka dewlynnong Patmos namar nga la pynbna ïa ka Ktien U Blei bad ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga Ioannis ruh uba long u hynmen jong phi, bad u paralok jong phi ha ka jingjynjar bad ha ka hima bad ka jingshaniah U Jisu Khrist, nga la don ha ka ri kaba la khot u Patos, na ka bynta ka ktien U Blei bad na ka bynta ka jingphla U Jisu Khrist .

en: But thus saith the  Lord  , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away , and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered : for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee , and I will save thy children .
kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Kane ka long kata kaei ka ban sa jia . Ïa ki koidi jong u shipai yn ïalam noh , bad ïa ka jinglute jong u nongsynshar leh jubor yn bat noh . Ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa uta uba ïaleh ïa pha , bad ngan pyllait ïa ki khun jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei kumta u ong U Trai , Wat ia ki mraw jong kiba khlain bor yn sa shim noh: namar ngan ialeh pyrshah ia uta uba ialeh pyrshah ia me bad me , bad ngan pynim ia ki khun jong me .

en: And there went out the king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrah , and the king of Admah , and the king of Zeboiim , and the king of Bela ( the same is Zoar  ; ) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim  ;
kha: Nangta ki syiem jong ka Sodom , ka Gomorrah , ka Admah , ka Seboiim , bad ka Bela ki la khreh ïa la ki shipai na ka bynta ka thma ha ka them Siddim bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u Gomorrah bad u syiem u Admah bad u syiem u Seboiim bad u syiem u Bela (u juh u long u Soar ; ) bad ki la iasoh bad ki ha ka wah Sidim ; .

en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this , that we have let Israel go from serving us ?
kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba uta u paidbah u la phet , ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kylla ka jingmut jong ki , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la leh aïu ? Ngi la shah ïa ki Israel ba kin phet noh , bad ngi la duh ïa ki kum ki mraw jong ngi !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la iathuh ha u syiem Ijipt ba ki briew ki la phet noh: bad ka dohnud u Pharaoh bad ki shakri jong u ki la kylla pyrshah ia ki briew , bad ki la ong: Balei ngi la leh ia kane , ba ngi la pyllait noh ia ki Israel ban shakri ia ngi ?

en: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .
kha: ka dei ban leh lut kumba ka la kular lymda u kpa jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u kpa jong ka u iohsngew ia ka jingkular jong ka, bad ka jingiadei jong ka kaba ka la teh ia ka mynsiem jong ka: nangta ki jingkular jong ka baroh kin ieng .

en: And they shall go forth , and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me : for their worm shall not die , neither shall their fire be quenched  ; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh .
kha: Katba ki dang leit phai noh kin ïohi ïa ki metïap jong kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki ksaiñ kiba bam ïa ki kin ym ïap shuh , bad ka ding kaba thang ïa ki kan ym lip noh . Ka jingïohi ïa ki kan long kaba isaitmet ïa u bynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin leit sha khmat bad kin peit ia ki met iap jong ki briew kiba la iaid lait ia nga: namar ka sniehdoh jong ki kan ym iap , lymne ka ding jong ki kan ym shah pynlip ; bad kin long ka jingpynbthei ia ka doh jong ki baroh .

en: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the  Lord  , every man and woman , whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work , which the  Lord  had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses .
kha: Ki paid Israel baroh , shynrang bad kynthei , kiba sngewkynduh ki wallam mon sngewbha ïa ka jingainguh jong ki sha U  Trai  na ka bynta kata ka kam kaba u la hukum ïa u Moses ban leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun Israel ki la wanrah ia ka jingainguh kaba mon sngewbha ha U Trai , uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ka kynthei , kiba ka dohnud jong ki ka la pynlong ia ki ban wanrah na ka bynta ki kam baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum ban leh da ka kti u Moses .

en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lyer khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa baroh ki kper bad bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng Dumbur bad ki dieng Olib jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la pynkhih ia phi da ka jingsma bad ka jingsma: haba ki kper jong phi bad ki kper sohjew jong phi bad ki dieng sohjew jong phi ki la nang kiew, u sohjew u la bam ia ki: hynrei phim shym la wan phai sha nga , ong U Trai .

en: And half Gilead , and Ashtaroth , and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .
kha: Ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead , lem ruh bad ka Ashtaroth bad Edrei , ki nongbah jong ka hima u Og ha Bashan . Ïa kane baroh la ai ha kaba shiteng jong ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad shiteng na ki khun shynrang jong u Machir u khun shynrang jong u Machir u khun shynrang jong u Machir da ki longiing jong ki .

en: I pray thee , forgive the trespass of thine handmaid : for the  Lord  will certainly make my lord a sure house  ; because my lord fighteth the battles of the  Lord  , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days .
kha: Sngewbha map ïa nga , ko kynrad , na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa phi u syiem , bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ruh , naba phi ïaleh ïa ki thma jong u ; bad phin ym leh kano kano kaba sniew katba phi dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga duwai ia me, map ia ka jingleh be-ijot jong me: namar U Trai un pynlong shisha ia u kynrad jong nga u iing uba skhem ; namar u kynrad jong nga u ialeh ia ki thma U Trai , bad ym shym la lap ia ka jingsniew ha me baroh ki sngi jong me .

en: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples , how that he must go unto Jerusalem , and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be killed , and be raised again the third day .
kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shai ha la ki synran ,  Nga dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad shahshitom shibun na ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Ïa nga yn pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Naduh kata ka por u Jisu u la sdang ban pyni ha ki synran jong u, kumno u dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad shah shitom shibun kiei kiei na ki rangbah bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongthoh .

en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki dur pynkhreh jong kita baroh kiba u don ha ka jingmut ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra sawdong jong ki bad ïa ki kamra buh ïa ki tiar jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka rukom jong kiei kiei baroh kiba u don da ka mynsiem U Trai, bad na ki kamra baroh sawdong, na ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong ka iing U Blei bad na ki jingbuh jingkynmaw jong kiei kiei kiba la aiti:

en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law , he took the blood of calves and of goats , with water , and scarlet wool , and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book , and all the people ,
kha: Nyngkong , u Moses u la pynbna ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh kat kum ba la buh ha ka hukum . Nangta u la shim ïa ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang , u la khleh ïa ka bad ka um , bad u la synreit ïa ka halor kata ka kitab ka hukum bad halor u paidbah baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u tnat Hissop bad katto katne u  saiwul uba saw .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar haba u Moses u la kren ia kawei pa kawei ka hukum ha ki briew baroh katkum ka hukum , u la shim ia ka snam jong ki khun masi bad ki blang , da ka um bad ka snieh langbrot kaba saw bad ka snieh langbrot bad u la theh ia ka kot bad ki briew baroh .

en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne , even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill  ; and all the firstborn of beasts .
kha: bad man la u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt un ïap , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u syiem u ban ïoh ïa ka khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong ka mraw kaba tylliat kew . Kiba kha nyngkong na ki jingri baroh ruh kin ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki khun nyngkong ha ka ri Ijipt kin iap, na u khun nyngkong jong u Pharaoh uba shong ha ka khet jong u, wat haduh u khun nyngkong jong u shakri ba nyngkong uba don shadien jong ka mill ; bad ki mrad ba nyngkong baroh .

en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
kha: Ïa baroh ki khuri jong u syiem Solomon la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ha ki sngi u Solomon ïa ka rupa ym pat ñiew kaba kordor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki tiar dih um baroh jong u syiem Solomon ki long ki tiar ksiar , bad ki tiar jong ka khlaw Lebanon ki long ki ksiar kiba khuid: ym don kawei ruh ka rupa; kam shym la long kaei kaei kaba la khein ha ki sngi u Solomon .

en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel , and he spied the company of Jehu as he came , and said , I see a company . And Joram said , Take an horseman , and send to meet them , and let him say , Is it peace ?
kha: Uwei u nongap phira uba ïeng halor ka jaka ap phira ha Jesreel u la ïohi ïa u Jehu bad ki rangbah jong u ba ki wan ,  Nga ïohi shi kynhun ki shipai ,  u la pyrta . U Joram u jubab ,  Phah uwei u nongshong kulai ban pynthikna la ki dei ki paralok ne ki nongshun .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng u nongap ha ka tower ha Jesel , bad u la sngap jar ia ka kynhun u Jehu katba u dang wan, bad u la ong, Nga iohi ia ka kynhun . Bad u Joram u la ong: Shim ia u kulai, bad phah ia u ban iakynduh ia ki, bad to ai ba un ong: Hato ka long ka jingsuk ?

en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth  ; not any of her vows , or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul , shall stand : and the  Lord  shall forgive her , because her father disallowed her .
kha: Hynrei lada u kpa jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata ka kular . U  Trai  un map ïa ka , namar ba u kpa jong ka , u khang ba kan bat ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada u kpa jong ka u khlem shah ia ka ha ka sngi ba u iohsngew ia ka; lane na ki jingkular jong ka, ne na ki jingteh jong ka, un ieng: bad U Trai un map ia ka, namar ba u kpa jong ka u la khlem shah ia ka .

en: The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .
kha: Un pynhap ïa u slap ha la ka aïom na ka ïing kynshew jong u ha bneng bad un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh ai kylliang ha kiba bun ki jaitbynriew , katba ma phi pat phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai un plie ia ka spah babha jong u, ka bneng ban ai slap ia ka ri jong me ha ka por jong u, bad ban kyrkhu ia ka kam jong me baroh: bad me phin ai ram ia ki jaitbynriew kiba bun, bad me ym shim ram .

en: Three bowls made like unto almonds , with a knop and a flower in one branch  ; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch , with a knop and a flower : so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick .
kha: Lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew    ba la oh-shrong itynnat ki dei ban don ha kawei kawei ka tnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Lai tylli ki khiew ba la shna kum ki almond, bad u knop bad u syntiew ha kawei ka tnat bad lai tylli ki khiew ba la shna kum ki almond ha kawei pat ka tnat, bad u knop bad u syntiew : kumta ha ki hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na ka sharak .

en: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?
kha: Ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh ka jingïathuhkhana kumno ba u la pynkiew ïa u Mordekai sha ka kyrdan treikam kaba halor , la buh jingkynmaw ha ki jingthoh ba dei ïa ki syiem ka Persia bad Media .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kam baroh jong ka bor jong u bad jong ka bor jong u, bad ka jingpynbna ia ka jingkhraw jong u Mordecai, ha kaba u syiem u la nang kiew shaphrang ia u, hato kim shym la thoh ha ka kot ki khanatang jong ki syiem Media bad ka Persia ?

en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .
kha: Uta u syiem u ban synshar ïa phi un leh kumne ,  u Samuel u pynshai .  Un pynlong shipai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi ; don na ki , ki ban trei ha ki kali ïapom jong u , don ki ban long ki shipai shong kulai , bad don ruh ki ban mareh na khmat ki kali ïapom jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong , Kane kan long ka rukom jong u syiem uba synshar halor jong phi: Un shim ia ki khun shynrang jong phi, bad un thung ia ki na ka bynta lade, na ka bynta ki kali jong u, bad ban long ki nongshong kulai jong u; bad don kiba iaid ha khmat ki kali jong u .

en: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire : thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them , nor take it unto thee , lest thou be snared therein : for it is an abomination to the  Lord  thy God .
kha: Thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki . Wat ikwah ïa ka rupa lane ïa ka ksiar kaba don ha ki , bad wat shim ïa ka sha lade ïoh phi ïap , namar U  Trai  u isih ïa ka jingmane bleithaw .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki dur ba la ker jong ki blei jong ki phin thang da ka ding: wat kwah ia ka rupa ne ka ksiar kaba don ha ki , lymne wat shim ia ka ha me: namar ka long kaba sngewsih ia U Trai U Blei jong me .

en: This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , Gather of it every man according to his eating , an omer for every man , according to the number of your persons  ; take ye every man for them which are in his tents .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ba uwei pa uwei na phi un lum katba u lah ban bam , ar kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew ha ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long kaei kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum , To shim ia ka kat kum ka jingbam jong u , ka um na ka bynta uwei pa uwei u briew kat kum ka jingbun ki briew jong phi; to shim ia phi uwei pa uwei na ka bynta jong ki kiba don ha ki ïingjaiñ jong u .

en: But Rabshakeh said , Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words ? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall , that they may eat their own dung , and drink their own piss with you ?
kha: U jubab ,  Phi tharai ba ma phi bad u syiem ki long tang kita kiba u patsha u la phah ïa nga ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Em , nga kren ruh ha ki briew kiba shong ha ka kynroh , kiba hap ban bam ïa la ka jakhlia bad dih ïa la ka um pynjhieh , kumba phi ruh phi hap ban leh kumta .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Rabsakeh u la ong: Hato u kynrad jong nga u la phah ia nga sha u kynrad jong me bad ha me ban kren ia kine ki ktien ? hato um shym la phah ia nga sha ki briew kiba shong halor ka kynroh ba kin bam ia la ka jong ka sboh bad dih ia la ka jong ka piss bad phi ?

en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations  ; that ye may know that I am the  Lord  that doth sanctify you .
kha: Rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabbaton , ka sngi shongthait jong nga namar ka long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi pateng la pateng , ba phin ïoh tip ba nga U  Trai  nga la pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga hi .
translated_en_to_kha: To kren ruh ia ki khun Israel, da kaba ong: Hooid ia ki sngi shongthait jong nga phin sumar: namar ka long ka dak hapdeng jong nga bad phi ha ki pateng jong phi baroh; ba phin tip ba nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ia phi .

en: Thou sayest , Lo , thou hast smitten the Edomites  ; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast : abide now at home  ; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me kob ba me la jop ïa ki Edom , hynrei nga ai jingmut ïa me ba men shong ha ïing . Balei me pynkhih jingkulmar ka ban shu wanrah tang ka jingjot ha me bad ki briew jong me ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me ong , Lo, me la pynkhih ia ki nong Edome bad ka dohnud jong me ka pynkiew ia me ban sngew sarong: sah mynta ha iing ; balei me dei ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka jingsngewsih jong me, ba me dei ban hap, wat ma me bad u Judah bad me ?

en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord .
kha: kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh ; baroh ki long arphew ar hajar arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kiba la khein na ki longiing jong u Gerson , na baroh kiba lah ban shakri ha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng , kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la khein kat kum ka hukum U Trai .

en: Now therefore , behold , the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river , strong and many , even the king of Assyria , and all his glory : and he shall come up over all his channels , and go over all his banks :
kha: ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan wallam ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria bad ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u baroh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . Kin tur shaphrang kum ki um bashlei jong ka wah Ïuphratis , kiba lyngkien ïa ki rud jong ka baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta, ha khmih, U Trai u wanrah halor jong ki ia ki um jong ka wah, kiba khlain bad kiba bun, wat ia u syiem Assyria bad ka burom jong u baroh: bad un wan shaneng halor ki lynti jong u baroh: bad un wan shaneng halor ki wah jong u baroh:

en: And Naaman said , Be content , take two talents . And he urged him , and bound two talents of silver in two bags , with two changes of garments , and laid them upon two of his servants  ; and they bare them before him .
kha: Sngewbha shim hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa ,  u Naaman u jubab . U la ïai ban ïa kata , u la teh ïa ka rupa ha ki ar tylli ki pla , u la ai ïa ki bad ïa ki ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ha ki ar ngut ki shakri jong u , bad u la phah ïa ki ha shuwa jong u Gehasi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Naaman u la ong, To sngewhun, to shim ar tylli ki talent . Bad u la kyntu ia u, bad u la teh ar tylli ki talent rupa ha ki ar tylli ki pla, bad ar tylli ki jain ki nep, bad u la buh ia ki ha ki arngut ki shakri jong u; bad ki la kit ia ki ha khmat jong u .

en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .
kha: Sumar khuid ïa ka jaka shong dara jong phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi hangta ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phi ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Wat leh ïa kano kano kaba khlem akor kaba lah ban pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban phai noh na phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta U Trai U Blei jong me u iaid hapdeng ka jaka shong jong me, ban pyllait im ia me, bad ban aiti noh ia ki nongshun jong me ha khmat jong me: ba un ym iohi ia kaei kaei kaba jakhlia ha me, bad un phai noh na me .

en: Behold , all ye that kindle a fire , that compass yourselves about with sparks : walk in the light of your fire , and in the sparks that ye have kindled . This shall ye have of mine hand  ; ye shall lie down in sorrow .
kha: Phi baroh kiba ïasylla ban pynjot ïa kiwei yn pynjot ïa phi ha ki jingsylla jong phi hi . U  Trai  da lade hi un pynjia ïa kane ; phin shahshitom ha ka jingkordit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, phi baroh kiba pynmeh ia ka ding, kiba ker sawdong ia lade da ki jingshai: iaid ha ka jingshai jong ka ding jong phi, bad ha ki jingshai kiba phi la pynmeh . Kane phin sa don ka kti jong nga; phin sa thiah ha ka jingsngewsih .

en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .
kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong ka Moab kan jah noh . Na ki briew kiba bun jong ka , tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin long kiba tlot .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta U Trai u la kren, u la ong, Hapoh lai snem, kum ki snem jong ka jingsiew bai bylla, bad ka burom jong u Moab kan shah pynrem, bad kata ka jingbun paid baroh kawei; bad kaba sah kan long kaba rit bad kaba tlot bha .

en: And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .
kha: Pynban U  Trai  u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U kloi ban sngewlem ïa phi namar u long borabor uba leh ïa kaba dei . Suk kito kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki ha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad namarkata U Trai un ap, ba un long uba sngewrit ia phi, bad namarkata un shah pynkhraw, ba un sngewsih ia phi: namar U Trai u long U Blei jong ka jingbishar: la kyrkhu ia kito baroh kiba ap ia u .

en: So the people took victuals in their hand , and their trumpets : and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent , and retained those three hundred men : and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley .
kha: Kumta u Gideon u phah noh ïa kita ki Israel baroh sha ïing , lait noh ki laispah ngut , kiba la sumar ïa baroh ki jingbam bad ki turoi . Ka jaka sher dara jong ki Midian ka don sharum jong ki ha ka them .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki briew ki la shim ia ki jingbam ha ka kti jong ki, bad ki turoi jong ki: bad u la phah ia ki Israel baroh sha ka ïingjaiñ jong u: bad ka kynhun jong ki nong Midian ka la don hapoh jong u ha ka them .

en: Then they that feared the  Lord  spake often one to another : and the  Lord  hearkened , and heard it , and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the  Lord  , and that thought upon his name .
kha: Te ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  ki la ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat , bad U  Trai  u shahshkor bad ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ki ong . Ha khmat jong u , hangta la thoh ha ka kitab ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa kito kiba sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad kiba ñiewkor ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kita kiba la tieng ia U Trai ki ju kren bunsien iwei ia iwei pat: bad U Trai u la sngap ia ka, bad la iohsngew ia ka, bad la thoh ia ka kot jingkynmaw ha khmat jong u na ka bynta kito kiba la tieng ia U Trai, bad kata ka la pyrkhat ia ka kyrteng jong u .

en: Have I conceived all this people ? have I begotten them , that thou shouldest say unto me , Carry them in thy bosom , as a nursing father beareth the sucking child , unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers ?
kha: Ngam shym thaw ïa ki lymne pynkha ïa ki ! Balei ba me ong ïa nga ba ngan long nongri khun bad rah ïa ki kum ïa ki khunlung shi lynter lynti shaduh ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hato nga la pun khun ia kine ki briew baroh ? hato nga la kha ia ki , ba me dei ban ong ha nga , To rah ia ki ha ka kpoh jong me , kumba u kpa uba ai dud u kha ia u khun uba ai dud ia u khun , haduh ka ri kaba me sngap jar ia ki kpa jong ki ?

en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .
kha: Shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pyndonkam ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban pynlong ia ka sniehdoh jong ka jingbishar da ka kam kaba jem; hadien ka jingtrei jong ka ephod me dei ban pynlong ia ka;

en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan , in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king , that wine was before him : and I took up the wine , and gave it unto the king . Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , saw bnai hadien , haba u patsha Artakserksis u dang shong bam , nga leit rah ïa ka waiñ sha u . Um pat ju ïohi ïa nga ba nga imat sngewsih mynshuwa ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha u bnai Nisan, ha ka snem kaba arphew jong u Artaxerxes u syiem: bad nga la shim ia ka wain bad nga la ai ia ka ha u syiem . Mynta ngam shym la sngewsih mynshuwa ha khmat jong u .

en: Wherefore the Lord said , Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth , and with their lips do honour me , but have removed their heart far from me , and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men :
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Kine ki briew ki ong ba ki mane ïa nga , hynrei ki ktien jong ki kim don jingmut ei ei , bad ki dohnud jong ki , ki long shawei pat . Ka niam jong ki kam long ei ei , hynrei ka long tang ki aiñ bad ki rukom briew , kiba ki shu spel lyndet .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata U Trai u la ong , Kumba une u briew u wan hajan jong nga da ka shyntur jong ki bad da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ki burom ia nga , hynrei ki la weng noh ia ka dohnud jong ki na nga , bad ka jingtieng jong ki ia nga la hikai da ka jingbthah jong ki briew:

en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and there shall be none  ; and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found : for I will pardon them whom I reserve .
kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym shem ïa ka pop ha Israel bad ïa ka jingbymman ha Judah , namar ngan map ïa kito ki briew kiba nga la pynsah ïa ka jingim jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi bad ha kata ka por , ong U Trai , yn wad ia ka jingbymhok jong ki Israel , bad kan ym don shuh shuh ka ; bad ki pop jong u Judah , bad kin ym lap ia ki: namar ngan map ia kita kiba nga buh kyrpang .

en: And he went up , and lay upon the child , and put his mouth upon his mouth , and his eyes upon his eyes , and his hands upon his hands : and he stretched himself upon the child  ; and the flesh of the child waxed warm .
kha: Nangta u dem halor jong u khynnah , u da buh ïa la ka shyntur , ki khmat , bad ki kti halor ka shyntur , ki khmat bad ki kti jong u khynnah . Katba u dang dem halor u khynnah , ka met jong u khynnah ka sdang ban syiad .
translated_en_to_kha: U la kiew shaneng, bad u la thiah halor u khynnah, bad u la buh ia ka shyntur jong u ha ka shyntur jong u, bad ki khmat jong u ha ki khmat jong u: bad u la pynkhih ia lade ha u khynnah ; bad ka doh jong u khynnah ka la rkhiang .

en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .
kha: Hynrei u Josaïah u kut jingmut ban ïaleh . U kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong lyngba u syiem Neko , kumta u riam pher ïa lade bad u leit sha ka thma ha ka them jong ka Megiddo .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la katta ruh u Josiah un ym phai noh na u , hynrei u la pynkylla dur ia lade, ba un ialeh bad u , bad um shym la sngap ia ki ktien u Neco na ka shyntur U Blei , bad u la wan ban ialeh ha ka them Megiddo .

en: Yet was she carried away , she went into captivity : her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets : and they cast lots for her honourable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .
kha: Pynban ïa ki briew jong ka Thebes la rah noh sha ka jinglongmraw . Ha kawei pa kawei ka kyndong jong ka lynti bah ïa ki khun jong ki la tied pynïap . Ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki la ïalam noh ha ki kynjri bad la pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongkurup .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la rah noh ia ka sha ka jingshah set: ki khun rit jong ka ruh ki la shah rong noh ha jrong jong ki surok baroh: bad ki la bret ia ki lot na ka bynta ki briew kiba donburom jong ka , bad ki rangbah jong ka baroh ki la shah teh ha ki kynjri .

en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :
kha: Phi la lehsbun shikatdei eh bad phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih mynta, u shakri jong me u la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, bad me la pynkhraw ia ka jingisynei jong me, kaba me la pyni ha nga ha kaba pynim ia ka jingim jong nga ; bad ngam lah ban lait sha u lum, ioh ba kaei kaei kaba sniew kan shim ia nga, bad nga iap:

en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished , and I will cause my fury to rest upon them , and I will be comforted : and they shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it in my zeal , when I have accomplished my fury in them .
kha: Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga haduh ba ngan da sngewhun . Haba kane baroh ka jia , phan sa sngewthuh ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren ïa pha namar nga la bitar shla ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta kan long ka jingbitar jong nga, bad ngan pynlong ia ka jingbitar jong nga ban shong ha ki: bad kin sa tip ba nga U Trai nga la kren ia ka ha ka jingkmen jong nga, haba nga la pyndep ia ka jingbitar jong nga ha ki .

en: And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?
kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak ,  Nga la sngewngiah bad sngewthait ïa ki tnga nongwei jong u Iso . Lada u Jakob ruh u shongkurim ïa kawei na kine ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïap noh ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Rebeka u la ong ha u Isaak: Nga la thait na ka jingim jong nga namar ki khun kynthei jong u Heth: lada u Jakob u shim ia ka tnga na ki khun kynthei jong u Heth kum kine kiba long na ki khun kynthei jong ka ri , kaei ka jingmyntoi jong nga ?

en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,
kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi , ngi don katne u paid sakhi babun byllien sawdong jong ngi . Kumta te , to ngin ïabret noh na lade ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba wan pynwit ha lynti , bad ïa kata ka pop kaba shait snoh skhem ha ngi , bad to ngin ïaphet da ka jingkut jingmut ïa ka jingïaphet thong kaba don ha khmat jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ngi ruh ngi la shah ker sawdong bad ka lyer kaba khraw jong ki sakhi , to ngin buh shawei ia kawei pa kawei ka jingkhia , bad ka pop kaba suk ban pynshitom ia ngi , bad to ngin ia mareh da ka jingshaniah ia ka jingiakop kaba la buh ha khmat jong ngi .

en: And he said , Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign : howbeit the kingdom is turned about , and is become my brother s : for it was his from the  Lord .
kha: U jubab ,  Phi tip ba nga la dei ban long syiem bad ba uwei pa uwei baroh ha Israel u khmih lynti ïa kata . Hynrei ka la jia long da kumwei pat , bad u para jong nga u la long syiem namar ka dei ka mon U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong: Me tip ba ka hima ka long ka jong nga, bad ba ki Israel baroh ki buh ia ki khmat jong ki ha nga, ba ngan synshar: hynrei ka hima ka kylla long ka hynmen jong nga: namar ka long ka jong u na U Trai .

en: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei don uwei pat uba wan uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit wat ban loit ïa ki juti jong u . Un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ioannis u la jubab da kaba ong ha ki baroh, nga pynbaptis shisha ia phi da ka um ; hynrei uwei uba kham khlain ban ia nga: ka jingkhang jong u kaba ngam dei ban pyllait: un pynbaptis ia phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding:

en: Slay utterly old and young , both maids , and little children , and women : but come not near any man upon whom is the mark  ; and begin at my sanctuary . Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house .
kha: Pynïap ïa ki tymmen , ki samla shynrang , ki samla kynthei , ki longkmie bad ki khynnah rit . Hynrei wat ktah kti ïa uno uno uba don ka dak ha ka shyllangmat jong u . Sdang nangne na ka Templ jong nga .  Kumta ki la sdang na ki nongïalam kiba ïeng hangta ha ka Templ .
translated_en_to_kha: Sla ia ki nongtrei kiba la tymmen bad kiba dang rit bha, bad ki khynnah rit bad ki kynthei: hynrei wat wan hajan uno uno u briew ha uba ka dak ; bad sdang na ka jaka kyntang jong nga . Nangta ki la sdang na ki shynrang hyndai kiba don ha khmat ka iing .

en: And Jehu sent through all Israel : and all the worshippers of Baal came , so that there was not a man left that came not . And they came into the house of Baal  ; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another .
kha: La pynlong ka jingpynbna bad u Jehu u phah ktien ha kylleng ka ri Israel . Baroh kiba mane ïa u Baal ki la wan ; ym don uwei ruh na ki uba pep . Baroh ki leit rung ha ka templ u Baal , da kaba pyndap ïa ka na kut ha kut .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jehu u la phah lyngba ki Israel baroh: bad ki nongmane Baal baroh ki la wan , haduh ba ym don briew uba sah uba wan . Ki la wan shapoh ka iing u Baal; bad ka iing u Baal ka la dap na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat .

en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them , nor serve them : for I the  Lord  thy God am a jealous God , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me ,
kha: Wat dem ne mane ïa kano kano ka bleithaw , naba nga U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ngam lah shah ba phin mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Nga pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat dem khrup ia lade ha ki , lymne wat shakri ia ki: namar nga U Trai U Blei jong me nga long U Blei uba sngewsih , nga leit jngoh ia ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa ha ki khun haduh ka pateng kaba lai bad kaba saw jong ki kiba shun ia nga .

en: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
kha: Thaw shuh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ka bynta kaba sha trai jong ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng hajan ka jaka ba la suh pyndait bad haneng jong u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .
