translated_en_to_kha: Bad ar tylli kiwei pat ki ryntieh ksiar me dei ban shna, bad to buh ia ki ha ki arliang jong ka ephod hapoh jong ka, sha ka bynta ba shakhmat jong ka, sha khmat kawei pat ka jingpyniasoh jong ka, halor ka jingkylli kaba sngewtynnad jong ka ephod .

en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .
kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Baroh kiba lait im kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kum ka kur ha ka jait Judah . Ka Ekron kan kylla long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan weng noh ia ka snam jong u na ka shyntur jong u, bad ki jingleh bein jong u na pdeng ki bniat jong u: hynrei uta uba sah, wat ma u ruh, un long na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi, bad un long kum u Lat ha Judah bad u Ekron kum u nong Jebus .

en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , my servants shall eat , but ye shall be hungry : behold , my servants shall drink , but ye shall be thirsty : behold , my servants shall rejoice , but ye shall be ashamed :
kha: Bad kumta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba kito kiba mane bad kohnguh ïa nga kin ïoh kyrhai ban bam ban dih , hynrei phi phin thngan bad phin sliang . Ma ki kin shadkmen hynrei ma phi phin jahburom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai Blei u ong: Ha khmih, ki shakri jong nga kin bam, hynrei phin sa thngan: ha khmih, ki shakri jong nga kin dih, hynrei phin sa sliang: ha khmih, ki shakri jong nga kin sngewbha:

en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations : it shall not go out in the jubilee .
kha: Hynrei lada um thied pat ïa ka hapoh kata ka snem , u duh noh ïa kata ka hok ban thied biang , bad kata ka ïing ka sah duh ha uta u nongthied bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u pateng la pateng ; yn ym pyllait ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada ym shym la siew kylliang hapoh ka por jong ka snem kaba pura, te ka iing kaba don ha ka shnong ba la ker sawdong kan long kaba skhem junom ha uta uba la thied ia ka ha ki pateng jong u baroh: kan ym mih ha ka jubilee .

en: If a soul sin , and commit a trespass against the  Lord  , and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep , or in fellowship , or in a thing taken away by violence , or hath deceived his neighbour  ;
kha: Dei ban ai ïa ka jingkñia lada uno uno u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba kyntait ban pynphai ïa kaei kaba u para Israel u la phah buh ha u lane da kaba tuh na u lane da kaba u shukor ïa u
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ka mynsiem ka pop , bad ka leh ia ka kam runar pyrshah ia U Trai , bad ka thiah ha u paramarjan jong u ha kata kaba la aiti ia u ban bat , ne ha ka jingiasyllok , ne ha kaei kaei kaba la shim noh da ka jingleh donbor , ne ka la shukor ia u paramarjan jong u;

en: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah ? hath thy soul lothed Zion ? why hast thou smitten us , and there is no healing for us ? we looked for peace , and there is no good  ; and for the time of healing , and behold trouble !
kha: A  Trai  , hato me la kyntait ïa ka Judah nadong shadong ? Hato me isih ïa ki briew jong ka Seïon ? Balei ba me la pynmong jur ïa ngi ba ngim lah ban koit ? Ngi la wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei ym don kano kano jingbha kaba la jia , ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei ka wan pynban ka jingshyrkhei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hato me la kyntait lut ia u Judah ? hato ka mynsiem jong me ka la jah noh ? balei me la pynkhih ia ngi bad ym don jingpynkhiah ia ngi ? ngi wad ia ka jingsuk, bad ym don shuh shuh ka jingsuk, bad ym don shuh shuh ka por kaba bha bad na ka bynta ka por jong ka jingpynkhiah , bad ha khmih ka jingjynjar !

en: For Tophet is ordained of old  ; yea , for the king it is prepared  ; he hath made it deep and large : the pile thereof is fire and much wood  ; the breath of the  Lord  , like a stream of brimstone , doth kindle it .
kha: Naduh mynshuwa eh ïa ka jaka la pynkhreh ha kaba ka ding bajur kan thang ïa u patsha ka Assyria . Ka long kaba jylliew bad kaba ïar , bad ba la kynton jrong da ki diengthang . U  Trai  un pyrsad da ka phylliah ding ban thang ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u Tophet u la shah pynbeit na u ; uba rim, namar u syiem u la pynkhreh ia ka; ka ding bad u dieng uba bun; ka jingsawa jong U Trai, kum ka wah kaba jylliew .

en: And the name of the man was Elimelech , and the name of his wife Naomi , and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion , Ephrathites of Beth–lehem–judah . And they came into the country of Moab , and continued there .
kha: Slem bah mynshuwa , ha ki sngi shuwa ba ki Israel kin ïoh syiem , la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri . Kumta u briew uba kyrteng u Elimelekh , uba na ka kur Ephrath bad uba shong ha Bethlehem kaba ha Judah , u leit bad ka Naomi ka tnga jong u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Mahlon bad u Khilion , ban sah shipor ha ka ri Moab . Katba ki dang sah hangta ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka kyrteng jong uta u briew ka long u Elimech bad ka kyrteng jong ka tnga jong u, bad ka kyrteng jong ki arngut ki khun shynrang jong u, u Mahlon bad u Khlon , u Ephrahi u Bethlehem ]. Ki la poi ha ka ri u Moab bad ki la bteng hangta .

en: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him , Hear now , ye Benjamites  ; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards , and make you all captains of thousands , and captains of hundreds  ;
kha: La ïathuh ha u ba la lap ïa u Dabid bad ki nongbud jong u , bad u ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ,  Shahshkor , ko rangbah Benjamin ! Hato phi pyrkhat ba u Dabid un ai ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ ha phi baroh , bad ban thung ïa phi ki rangbah nongïalam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Saul u la ong ha ki shakri jong u kiba ieng sawdong jong u, To sngap mynta, phi ki Benjamin kin ai ia phi iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia iwei ia ki lyngkha bad ki kper sohjew bad pynlong ia phi baroh ki rangbah shihajar bad ki rangbah jong ki spah;

en: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them  ; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day , and let them not cease : for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach , with a very grievous blow .
kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingsngewsih jong nga bad ban ong :  Ai ba ki khmat jong nga kin tuid da ki ummat mynsngi bad mynmiet , ai ba da lei lei ngan ym sangeh ban ïam , namar ki briew jong nga ki la mynsaw jur bad ki la mong tyngeh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata me dei ban ong ia kane ka ktien ha ki ; Ai ba ki khmat jong nga kin tuid da ki ummat miet bad sngi , bad wat ai ba kin ym sangeh: namar ka khun kynthei jong nga ka la tyrkhong da ka jingtwa kaba khraw , da ka jingshah shoh kaba jur bha .

en: I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?
kha: U la ïohi ba pha leh ïa kiei kiei kiba u isih . U la ïohi ba pha bud ïa ki blei thala halor ki lum bad ki lyngkha , kum u briew uba threw jakhlia ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong u lane kum u kulai ïa ka kulai . Ko ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , phi long kiba la tim ! Lano phin ïoh long kiba khuid ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia ki jingleh be-ijot jong me, bad ki para marjan jong me, ka jingleh be-ijot jong me, bad ki jingleh be-ijot jong me ha ki lum ha ki lyngkha . Ka long kaba sniew ia me ko Jerusalem ! hato ym lah ban pynkhuid ia me ? haba kan long shisien ?

en: Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .
kha: La thoh :  U Geshem u ong ïa nga ba ka don ka hamsaïa kaba ïaid kylleng hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kaba don marjan , ba ma phi bad ka jaitbynriew Jiw phi don jingthmu ban ïaleh pyrshah bad dei na kane ka daw balei ba phi la tei pat ïa ka kynroh . U ong ruh ba phi thmu ban pynlong ïa lade u syiem
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kaba la thoh ia ka hapdeng ki nongwei, bad u Gashmu u ong ia ka, ba me bad ki Jiw phi pyrkhat ban leh pyrshah: namar kata me tei ia ka kynroh, ba me long u syiem jong ki kat kum kine ki kyntien .

en: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .
kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jin da la shu sngap jar bad ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ; hynrei ngi la jan shah pynjot — shah pynduh pyndam !
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ngi la shah die, ma nga bad ki briew jong nga, ban shah pynjot, ban shah pyniap bad ban jah noh . Hynrei lada ngi la shah die na ka bynta ki mraw bad ki mraw , nga la bat ia ka shyntur jong nga , wat la u nongshun um lah ban ialeh pyrshah ia ka jingpynjot jong u syiem .

en: Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .
kha: U Abishai u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ha kane ka miet , U Blei u la aiti ïa u nongshun jong phi ha ka bor jong phi . Mynta shah ngan tynrah tang shisien tynrah da une u sum jong u hi haduh khyndew ; ngam donkam ban da tynrah ïa u ar sien !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abisai u la ong ha u Dabid , U Blei u la aiti ia u nongshun jong me ha ka kti jong me ha kane ka sngi: mynta to ngan shoh ia u, nga kyrpad ia me, da ka khnam wat haduh ka khyndew ha ka shisien , bad ngan ym shoh ia u ha ka sien kaba ar .

en: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust , and made thee prince over my people Israel  ; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam , and hast made my people Israel to sin , to provoke me to anger with their sins  ;
kha: Mem shym la long ei ei ruh em , hynrei nga la pynlong ïa me u nongïalam jong ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Bad mynta me la leh pop kum u Jeroboam bad me la ïalam ïa ki briew jong nga sha ka pop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmat ba nga la pynkhraw ia me na ka dewmet, bad nga la pynlong ia me u syiem halor ki briew jong nga; bad me la iaid ha ka lynti jong u Jeroboan, bad me la pynlong ia ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban leh pop, ban pynkhih ia nga ban bitar ia ki pop jong ki;

en: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write  ; These things saith he that is holy , he that is true , he that hath the key of David , he that openeth , and no man shutteth  ; and shutteth , and no man openeth  ;
kha: Thoh ha u angel jong ka balang ha Philadelphia :  Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba khuid bad uba shisha . U don u shabi jong u Dabid , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang , ym don uba lah ban khang ïa ka , bad haba u khang ïa ka , yn ym don uba lah ban plie ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ha u angel jong ka balang ha Philadelphia u thoh ia kine kiei kiei kiba khuid, uta uba shisha, uta uba don ia u shabi u Dabid, uta uba plie; bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba khang;

en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khatwei ( u bnai Shebat ) , U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka khubor ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba sawphew snem jong u bnai uba shiphew snem, kata ka long ka taiew Sebat, ha ka snem kaba ar jong u Darius, ka la wan ka ktien U Trai ha u Sekharaiah u khun u Beriah u khun u Ido u nongiathuhlypa, u da ong:

en: Pass through the host , and command the people , saying , Prepare you victuals  ; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan , to go in to possess the land , which the  Lord  your God giveth you to possess it .
kha: ban rung sha ka jaka shong dara bad ban ong ha u paidbah ,  Pynkhreh jingbam katto katne , namar ha ki lai sngi phin leit jam ïa ka wah Jordan ban ïohkynti ïa ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Iaid lyngba ka kynhun shipai , bad hukum ia ki briew da kaba ong: Pynkhreh ia phi namar hapoh lai sngi phin iaid lait ia kane ka Jordan , ban leit rung ban ioh ia ka ri kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban ioh ia ka .

en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams , and of silver ten thousand talents , and of brass eighteen thousand talents , and one hundred thousand talents of iron .
kha: ïa kine harum na ka bynta ka jingtrei ha ka Templ : Palat ban ïa ka shispah hynñiewphew ton ka ksiar , palat ïa ka laispah sawphew ton ka rupa , bad la jan hynriewspah arphew ton ka rnong , bad palat ban ïa ka lai hajar sawspah ton ka nar .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la ai na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Blei kaba san hajar bad shi hajar tylli ki dram ksiar bad shi hajar tylli ki nar rupa bad shiphew hajar tylli ki nar nar nar .

en: But it came to pass within a while after , in the time of wheat harvest , that Samson visited his wife with a kid  ; and he said , I will go in to my wife into the chamber . But her father would not suffer him to go in .
kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Samson u leit jngoh ïa la ka tnga ha ka por ot kew , u da rah ïa ka uwei u khunblang . U ong ïa u kpa jong ka ,  Ngan leit rung sha kamra ka tnga jong nga .  Hynrei um shym shah ba un rung shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka la jia tang hadien katto katne por, ha ka por ot kew, ba u Samson u la leit jngoh ia ka tnga jong u bad u la ong: Ngan leit shapoh ka tnga jong nga shapoh ka kamra . Hynrei u kpa jong ka un ym shah ia u ban leit rung .

en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
kha: Shahshkor ïa ki , ko Israel , bad kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin nang roi bad long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap namarkata ko Israel bad to peit ia ka; ba kan long kaba bha ia me, bad ba phin nangroi shibun, kumba U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me u la kular ia me, ha ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .

en: Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .
kha: To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew ! To shahshkor , phi ki bynta ba sha jngai jong ka pyrthei . Pynkhreh ban ïaleh , hynrei to sheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkhreh , hynrei to sheptieng !
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniadei ia lade , ko ki briew , bad phin sa shah pynpra ha ki bynta ; bad ai shkor , phi baroh na ki ri kiba jngai: to buh ia lade , bad phin sa shah pynpra ha ki bynta ; to buh ia lade ha ki bynta; bad phin sa shah pynpra ha ki bynta .

en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes , he looked up to heaven , and blessed , and brake the loaves , and gave them to his disciples to set before them  ; and the two fishes divided he among them all .
kha: Nangta u Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei . U la kdiah ïa ki kpu bad ai ïa ki ha ki synran jong u ban sam ha ki briew . U la ïasam ruh ïa ki ar tylli ki dohkha hapdeng jong ki baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ki san tylli ki kpu bad ki ar tylli ki dohkha, u la peit sha bneng, bad u la kyrkhu, bad u la bret ia ki kpu, bad u la ai ia ki ha ki synran jong u ban buh ha khmat jong ki ; bad ki ar tylli ki dohkha u la phiah ia ki hapdeng jong ki baroh .

en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws , and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales , and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers , and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .
kha: Ngan buh ïa u bnoh lyngba ka tyngam jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka dohkha ha ka wah jong me ban sahkut sbak ha me . Nangta ngan tan ïa me na ka wah Nile bad ïa ki dohkha baroh kiba snoh ha me .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan buh ia ki hook ha ki bniat jong me bad ngan pynlong ia ki dohkha jong me ban bat ia ki bniat jong me , bad ngan pynmih ia me na pdeng ki wah jong me , bad ki dohkha jong me baroh kin bat ia ki bniat jong me .

en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
kha: Kumta u Paul u la ïalam ïa kita ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid lem bad ki . Nangta u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngi kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , haba yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Paul u la shim ia ki briew , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la rung ha ka tempi , ban pynpaw ia ka jingpyndep ia ki sngi pynkhuid , haduh ba yn ai ia ka jingainguh na ka bynta uwei pa uwei na ki .

en: When those went , these went  ; and when those stood , these stood  ; and when those were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up over against them : for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels .
kha: Kumta man ka teng ba ki jingthaw ki ïaid ne sangeh ne kiew sha suiñ , ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba kita ki la leit noh, kine ki la leit bad haba kita ki la ieng; bad haba kita ki la shah pynkiew na ka khyndew , la pynkiew ia ki tyrpeng pyrshah ia ki: namar ka mynsiem jong u jingthaw ba im ka la don ha ki tyrpeng .

en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .
kha: Ka kur Gershon ka ïoh khatlai tylli ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Issakhar , Asher , Naphtali , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Gerson ki don shiphew tylli ki jait shynrang jong u Issakhar bad na ka jait Asher bad na ka jait Naphtali bad na ka jait shynrang jong u Manasseh ha Basan .

en: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city , and those that fell away , that fell to him , with the rest of the people that remained .
kha: Khatduh u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la ringmraw sha Babilonia ïa ki briew ba dang sah ha ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Nebuzaradan u rangbah shipai u la rah noh sha Babilon ia ki briew kiba sah ha ka shnong bad kito kiba la hap noh ha u bad kiwei pat ki briew kiba sah .

en: And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :
kha: Ïa ki nongai jingmut bad ki nongleh myntor la wallam shapoh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ban ïathuh ha nga aïu ka kit jingmut , hynrei kim shym lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta la wanrah ia ki riewstad, ki nongleh jadu ha khmat jong nga, ba kin pule ia kane ka jingthoh bad pyntip ha nga ia ka jingbatai jong ka: hynrei kim lah ban pyni ia ka jingbatai jong kata:

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , and I sent them not , yet they say , Sword and famine shall not be in this land  ; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei ba ngan leh ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ngam shym phah hynrei kiba kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad ong ba ka thma bad ka jingïapthngan kin ym lynshop ïa kane ka ri — ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u ong U Trai shaphang ki nongiathuhlypa kiba iathuhlypa ha ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ngam shym la phah ia ki , hynrei ki ong , Ka jingkyrduh bad ka jingkyrduh kan ym don ha kane ka ri ; Da ka waitlam bad ka jingkyrduh kan ym shah pynjot ia kita ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , a king of kings , from the north , with horses , and with chariots , and with horsemen , and companies , and much people .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan wallam ïa u syiem bakhraw tam na baroh — u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia — ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Tyros . Un wan na shaphang shatei ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai babun , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih, ngan wanrah ia u syiem Babilon, u syiem ki syiem, na shaphang shathie, da ki kulai bad ki kali kit kulai bad ki shipai bad ki shipai kiba bun .

en: And it came to pass , that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves , he cut it with the penknife , and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth , until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth .
kha: Mar shu dep pule da u Jehudi ïa ki lai ne saw bynta , u syiem u la ot ïa ki da ka tari barit bad bret ïa ki ha ka ding . U ïai leh ïa kane haduh ba la thang lut ïa ka kot kli baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba u Jehudi u la pule lai ne saw sla, u la ot ia ka da ka pen Knife bad u la bret ia ka ha ka ding kaba don ha ka ding , haduh ba ka roll baroh ka la bam ha ka ding kaba don ha ka ding .

en: Thou shalt not do so unto the  Lord  thy God : for every abomination to the  Lord  , which he hateth , have they done unto their gods  ; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods .
kha: Wat mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi kumba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar ba ha kaba mane ïa ki , ki leh ruh ïa ki kam isaitmet baroh kiba U  Trai  u isih . Ki kñia wat ïa la ki khun ki kti ruh ha ka ding halor ki duwan jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat leh kumta ia U Trai U Blei jong me: namar ka jingleh bein ia U Trai kaba u shun, ki la leh ia ki blei jong ki ; namar wat ia ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong ki ruh ki la thang ha ka ding ia ki blei jong ki .

en: And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
kha: Kumta ha kata ka sngi ki la kmen shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bam bad u la dih ha khmat U Trai ha kata ka sngi da ka jingkmen kaba khraw . Ki la pynlong ia u Solomon u khun u Dabid u syiem ha ka sien kaba ar bad ki la pynsleh ia u ha U Trai ban long u Lat rangbah bad u Sadok ban long u lyngdoh .

en: Then said Saul unto his servants , Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit , that I may go to her , and enquire of her . And his servants said to him , Behold , there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor .
kha: Kumta u Saul u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u ,  Khie wad ka kynthei kaba kren byrtong , bad ngan leit kylli na ka .   Don kawei ka nongkren byrtong ha Endor ,  ki jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong u Saul ha ki shakri jong u, To wad ia nga ia ka kynthei kaba don ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha, ba ngan leit sha ka bad nga kylli ia ka . Ki shakri jong u ki la ong ia u: Ha khmih ka don ka kynthei kaba don ka mynsiem kaba la tip bha ha Endor .

en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .
kha: Ïa uta uba la shah kdew bad ha uba la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la mana yn thang ha ka ding , lem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , naba u wanrah ïa ka jinglehrain bashyrkhei ïa ki Israel bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan long , ba uta uba la shah thang da ka ding , ma u bad baroh kaba u don: namar ba u la pynkhein ia ka jutang U Trai bad namar ba u la leh be-ijot ha Israel .

en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will extend peace to her like a river , and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream : then shall ye suck , ye shall be borne upon her sides , and be dandled upon her knees .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ha phi ïa ka jingdap kyrhai baneh ; ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew kan tuid sha phi kum ka wah , ka bym ju rngad . Phin long kum i khunlung iba la sumar da la ka kmie , ba la rah ha ki ksang ti jong ka , bad sumar da ka jingieit .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar kumta u ong U Trai , Ha khmih , ngan pynjlan ia ka kum ka wah , bad ka burom jong ki Jutang kum ka wah kaba tuid: nangta phin sa dih , phin sa shah rah ha ki liang jong ka , bad phin sa shah rong noh ha ki tyrpeng jong ka .

en: And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ki briew ki ïa-ong ba ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei de kaba nga don ban ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta u ong kumta U Trai, U Blei jong ki Israel, shaphang kane ka shnong, na kaba phi ong: Yn aiti ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon da ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh;

en: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved , and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll : and all their host shall fall down , as the leaf falleth off from the vine , and as a falling fig from the fig tree .
kha: Ka sngi , u bnai bad ki khlur kin lwet jin . Ka sahit bneng kan jah noh kum ka kitab ba la kli , bad ba ki khlur kin hap kum ki sla na u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng Dumbur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka kynhun jong ki bneng baroh kan sa jah noh, bad ki bneng kin sa kylla lang kum ka kot lyngkdop: bad ka kynhun jong ki baroh kan hap noh , kumba u sla u hap noh na u sohjew bad kum u sohjew uba hap na u dieng sohjew .

en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumta ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Syria kiba naphang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis bad buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingai hukum u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sobah .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki Syria ki la iohi ba ki la shah pynsniew ha khmat ki Israel , ki la phah ia ki nong Syria kiba don sha shiliang wah: bad u Shophak u rangbah shipai u Hadareer u la leit sha khmat jong ki .

en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
kha: Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki païa , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingjrong jong ka phyllaw ka long arphew cubit bad ka jingjrong shiphew cubit bad u la wanrah ia nga da ki step ha kaba ki la kiew sha ka : bad ki don ki maw da ki post , uwei na kane ka liang bad uwei pat na kata ka liang .

en: If ye will fear the  Lord  , and serve him , and obey his voice , and not rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the  Lord  your God :
kha: Lada phi tiengburom ïa U  Trai  , phi shakri ïa u , phi shahshkor ïa u , bad phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , bad lada ma phi bad u syiem uba synshar ïa phi , phi bud ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , baroh kan manbha bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phin sheptieng ia U Trai bad phin shakri ia u bad phin kohnguh ia ka sur jong u bad ym pyrshah ia ka hukum U Trai , te phi bad u syiem uba synshar halor jong phi phin iai bteng ban bud ia U Trai U Blei jong phi:

en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
kha: Ngi tip ba U Khun U Blei u la wan bad u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngin ithuh ïa U Blei uba shisha . Ngi im ha U Blei uba shisha — ha U Jisu Khrist U Khun jong u . Une u long U Blei uba shisha , bad kane ka long ka jingim bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngi tip ba U Khun U Blei U la wan, bad u la ai ia ngi ka jingsngewthuh, ba ngin ithuh ia uta uba shisha, bad ngi long ha uta uba shisha, wat ha U Khun jong u U Jisu Khrist . Kane ka long U Blei uba shisha bad ka jingim bymjukut .

en: And thou shalt speak and say before the  Lord  thy God , A Syrian ready to perish was my father , and he went down into Egypt , and sojourned there with a few , and became there a nation , great , mighty , and populous :
kha: nangta , hangta ha khmat ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  phin ong ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ U kpa tymmen jong nga u dei u nong Aram uba ïaidwir , uba la leit ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem sha Ijipt ban shong ban sah . Ki ïadon tang khyndiat eh mynba ki ïadon hangta , hynrei ki la man long ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid bad kaba khrawbor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad me dei ban kren bad ong ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong me, U Syria uba la pynkhreh ban jah noh u la long u kpa jong nga, bad u la leit hiar sha Ijipt, bad u la sah hangta bad katto katne ngut, bad u la kylla long hangta ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw, kaba khlain bad kaba don pop:

en: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .
kha: Ïa ka sanphew sentimitar kaba tam na ka lynter jong kata ka jingtap ha baroh arliang dei ban wah ha ki krung jong ka Ïingjaiñ ba kan tap ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kawei ka cuit ha kawei ka liang bad ka cuit ha kawei pat ka liang kaba sah ha ka jingjrong jong ki jingtap jong ka ïingjaiñ , kan sahkut ha ki liang jong ka ïingjaiñ ha kane ka liang bad ha kata ka liang .

en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron , and of the anointing of his sons , out of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , in the day when he presented them to minister unto the  Lord  in the priest s office  ;
kha: Kane ka long ka bynta jong ka jingbam ba la ainguh sha U  Trai  ïa kaba la ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun jong u ha kata ka sngi ba pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kane ka long ka bynta jong ka jingpynkhuid ia u Aaron bad na ka jingpynkhuid ia ki khun shynrang jong u, na ki jingainguh U Trai ba la shna da ka ding, ha ka sngi ba u la pyni ia ki ban shakri ia U Trai ha ka kam lyngdoh;

en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .
kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha shi lynter jong ka rud duriaw . U  Trai  u la ai ka rai bishar halor jong phi . Un pynjot ïa phi , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba sngewsih ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka duriaw, ka jaitbynriew jong ki nongshong shnong ! ka ktien U Trai ka long pyrshah ia phi; Ka ri jong ki Philistia , ngan pynjot wat ia me ruh .

en: And see , if it goeth up by the way of his own coast to Beth–shemesh , then he hath done us this great evil : but if not , then we shall know that it is not his hand that smote us  ; it was a chance that happened to us .
kha: Nangta peit kumno ka ïaid ; lada ka leit sha la ka ri Beth Shemesh , ka mut ba dei U Blei ki Israel uba la pynngat ha ngi ïa kane ka jingjynjar kaba sngewshyrkhei . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ngin sa tip ba ym dei ma u uba la phah ïa ka khlam ; ka dei kaba shu wan jia ryngkhat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad peit, lada ka leit sha jrong da ka lynti jong u hi sha Betheshemesh, te u la leh ia ngi ia kane ka jingsniew kaba khraw: hynrei lada ym dei, te ngin sa tip ba kam dei ka kti jong u kaba la pynkhih ia ngi; ka la long ka lad kaba la jia ia ngi .

en: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh–acrabbim , and passed along to Zin , and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh–barnea , and passed along to Hezron , and went up to Adar , and fetched a compass to Karkaa :
kha: ka hiar shaphang shathie na ka Khim Akrabbim bad ter ter sha Sin . Ka ïaid shaphang shathie jong ka Kadesh Barnea , lyngba ïa ka Hesron bad shatei sha Addar , ka da phai sha Karka ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ka la mih sha ka liang sepngi sha Mahalahrabbim, bad ka la iaid ryngkat bad ka Zin, bad ka la kiew sha ka liang sepngi sha Kadeshbarnea, bad ka la iaid ryngkat bad ka Hesron, bad ka la leit sha Adar, bad ka la leit sha Karkaa:

en: Then pleased it the apostles and elders , with the whole church , to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas  ; namely , Judas surnamed Barsabas , and Silas , chief men among the brethren :
kha: Nangta ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang lem bad ka balang hi baroh kawei , ki la ïakut ban jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah na ka kynhun bad phah ïa ki sha Antiokh lem bad u Paul bad u Barnabas . Ki la jied ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da ki riewngeit , u Judas , ïa uba la khot u Barsabbas , bad u Silas ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la sngewbha ia ki apostol bad ki rangbah, ryngkat bad ka balang baroh kawei, ban phah ia ki briew kiba la jied sha Antiok bad u Paul bad u Barnabnam kata ka long: U Judas u la ai kyrteng ia u Barsabas bad u Silas, ki rangbah shipai:

en: But Naaman was wroth , and went away , and said , Behold , I thought , He will surely come out to me , and stand , and call on the name of the  Lord  his God , and strike his hand over the place , and recover the leper .
kha: Hynrei u Naaman u la leit noh ha ka jingbitar , da kaba ong ,  Nga pyrkhat ba la kumno kumno un wan mih shabar sha nga , un duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong u , un khaweh ïa la ka kti halor ki jaka ba don jingpang , bad pynkhiah ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Naaman u la bitar, bad u la leit noh, bad u la ong, Ha khmih, un sa mih shisha sha nga, bad un ieng, bad un khot ia ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong u, bad un sa kner ia la ka kti halor kata ka jaka, bad un pynkoit ia u nongpang niangthohlieh .

en: Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .
kha: Nga ngan ïeng ha khmat jong me ha u mawsiang ha u Lum Sinai . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïoh dih .  U Moses u leh kumta ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih , ngan ieng ha khmat jong me hangta halor u maw ha Horeb ; bad me dei ban pynkhih ia u maw, bad kan mih ka um na ka , ba ki briew kin dih . U Moses u la leh kumta ha khmat ki rangbah Israel .

en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .
kha: Hadien ba la kut ki hynñiew bnai yn jied kyrpang ïa ki rangbah ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ban tep ïa kito ki metïap kiba dang sah ha madan , ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin ot noh ia ki briew kiba iai bteng, ban iaid lyngba ka ri ban tep bad ki nongleit nongwan ia kito kiba sah ha ka khmat jong ka khyndew: hadien ba la kut hynriew bnai kin wad .

en: So the king of the north shall come , and cast up a mount , and take the most fenced cities : and the arms of the south shall not withstand , neither his chosen people , neither shall there be any strength to withstand .
kha: Kumta u syiem ka Syria un kerkut ïa ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad kurup ïa ka . Ki shipai jong ka Ijipt kin ym ïaleh shuh ; wat kiba tbit tam na ki kin ym don ka jingkhlaiñ kaba biang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un wan, bad un leit sha jrong, bad un shim ia ki nongbah kiba la ker sawdong tam: bad ki kti jong ka ri Sepngi kin ym lah ban ieng , lymne ki briew ba la jied jong u, lymne kan ym don ka bor ban ieng .

en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude : and they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip , and Prochorus , and Nicanor , and Timon , and Parmenas , and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch :
kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngewbha ïa ka jingtyrwa jong ki apostol , kumta ki la jied ïa u Stephan , u briew uba dap da ka jingngeit bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad u Philip , u Prokhoros , u Nikanor , u Timon , u Parmenas , bad u Nikolas , u Jentil uba na Antiokh uba mynshuwa u la kylla sha ka niam Jiw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingong ka la pynsngewbha ia u paidbah baroh: bad ki la jied ia u Stephan, u briew uba dap da ka jingngeit bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid, bad u Philip, bad u Prokhoros, bad u Nicanor, bad u Timon, bad u Nicolos u nongpynkylla niam jong u Antioch:

en: And he said , My son shall not go down with you  ; for his brother is dead , and he is left alone : if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go , then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave .
kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  U khun jong nga um lah ban leit ryngkat bad phi ; u hynmen jong u , u la ïap , bad u sah sa tang marwei . Kaei kaei ka lah ban ngat ha u ha lynti . Nga dei u briew uba la tymmen , bad ka jingsngewsih kaba phin pynjia ha nga kan sa pynïap ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: U khun jong nga un ym leit hiar bad phi, namar u hynmen jong u u la iap: lada ka jingsniew ka la jia ia u ha ka lynti ha kaba phi leit , te phin pynhap ia ki shniuh kiba rong saw jong nga da ka jingsngewsih sha ka jingtep .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .
kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler . U  Trai  u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, Da kaba ? Bad u la ong, Ngan leit noh, bad ngan long u mynsiem uba thok ha ka shyntur jong ki nongiathuhlypa jong u baroh . Bad u la ong: Me dei ban pynsngewthuh ia u, bad me ruh: leit noh bad leh kumta .

en: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say , Because the  Lord  was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them , and because he hated them , he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness .
kha: Lymda kumta ki nong Ijipt kin ong ba mem lah ban ïalam ïa la ki briew sha ka ri kaba me la kular ha ki . Kin ong ba me la ïalam noh ïa la ki briew sha ka ri shyiap ban pynïap ïa ki , namar me la isih ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat la ka ri na kaba me wanrah ia ngi ka ong , Namar ba U Trai um shym la lah ban wanrah ia ki sha ka ri kaba u la kular ia ki , bad namar ba u la shun ia ki , u la wanrah ia ki shabar ban pyniap ia ki ha ka ri khlaw .

en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty , If I be a man of God , then let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And there came down fire from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangbah jong me !  Hangta hi ka ding ka la wan hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la jubab bad u la ong ha u rangbah shiphew ngut, te to ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad kan bam ia me bad ia me sanphew ngut . Bad ka la wan hiar ding na bneng bad ka la bam ia u bad ia u sanphew ngut .

en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor , that hath not received usury nor increase , hath executed my judgments , hath walked in my statutes  ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father , he shall surely live .
kha: U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad um ju ai pisa kylliang ban ïohnong . U sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Un ym ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong u kpa jong u , hynrei un im da shisha .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta u la weng noh ia la ka kti na kiba duk, u bym shym la ioh ia ka sut ne ka jingkiew, u la pyndep ia ki jingbishar jong nga, u la iaid ha ki ain jong nga ; un ym iap na ka bynta ka jingbymhok jong u kpa jong u, un im shisha .

en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years , whereof the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah the prophet , that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem .
kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u , nga la pule bniah ïa ki kitab bakyntang bad pyrkhat shaphang ki hynñiewphew snem kiba ka Jerusalem kan don ha ki jingpra , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ïathuh ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u nga Daniel nga sngewthuh da ki kot ia ka jingbun ki snem , na kine ka ktien U Trai ka la wan ha u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa , ba un pyndep hynriewphew snem ha ki jingjot jong ka Jerusalem .

en: To execute judgment upon all , and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed , and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him .
kha: ban wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha baroh , ban pynrem ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki kam bymriewblei ba ki la leh bad na ka bynta ki ktien ba sngewtriem kiba ki nongpop ba khlem blei ki la kren pyrshah ïa u !
translated_en_to_kha: Ban pyndep ia ka jingbishar halor baroh , bad ban pynngeit ia baroh kiba khlem blei hapdeng jong ki na ki kam bymman jong ki baroh kiba ki la leh khlem akor , bad na ki jingkren kiba eh jong ki baroh kiba ki pop khlem blei ki la kren pyrshah ia u .

en: The Babylonians , and all the Chaldeans , Pekod , and Shoa , and Koa , and all the Assyrians with them : all of them desirable young men , captains and rulers , great lords and renowned , all of them riding upon horses .
kha: Ngan wallam ïa ki nong Babilonia bad ki nong Khaldi baroh , ki rangbah na Pekod , Shoa , bad Koa , bad ïa ki nong Assyria baroh . Ngan lumlang ïa kito ki rangsamla ba-bhabriew bad ki rangbah shipai , baroh kito ki rangbah pynïaidkam bapaw bad ki rangbah shipai ba-halor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nong Babilon baroh , bad ki Khaldesia baroh, bad u Koa, bad ki nong Assyria baroh bad ki: baroh ki samla kiba kwah eh, ki rangbah bad ki nongsynshar kiba khraw bad kiba pawnam, baroh ki shong kulai .

en: Then said David to the Philistine , Thou comest to me with a sword , and with a spear , and with a shield : but I come to thee in the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , whom thou hast defied .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Me wan ïaleh ïa nga da ka waitlam , da u lyngka , bad da u sum , hynrei nga wan pyrshah ïa me ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor , U Blei jong ki kynhun ïapom ki Israel , ïa uba me la ñiewbeiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Dabid u la ong ha u Philistia , Me wan sha nga da ka waitlam bad da ka waitlam: hynrei nga wan sha me ha ka kyrteng U Trai jong ki paid , U Blei jong ki shipai Israel kiba me la leh pyrshah .

en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it , as the shaking of an olive tree , two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough , four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof , saith the  Lord  God of Israel .
kha: Tang khyndiat ki briew kin lait im , bad ka Israel kan long kum u dieng Olib na kaba la kheit lut ïa ki soh Olib lait noh ar ne lai tylli kiba ha kliar eh , lane khyndiat kiba la iehnoh ha ki tnat kiba shapoh . Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki soh kiba jyrngam kin sah ha ka , kum ka jingkhih jong u dieng olive , ar ne lai tylli ki soh ha jrong jong ka tnat kaba shalor tam , saw ne san tylli ki tnat kiba jyrngam tam jong ka , ong U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel .

en: Then Peter arose and went with them . When he was come , they brought him into the upper chamber : and all the widows stood by him weeping , and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made , while she was with them .
kha: Kumta u Petros u la khreh bad u la leit bad ki . Haba u la poi , la ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra kaba haneng , ha kaba ki riewkynthei baroh ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki da ïam bad pyn-i ïa ki sopti bad ki jaiñkup kiba ka Dorkas ka la suh mynba ka dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Petros u la ieng bad u la leit bad ki . Ynda u la wan, ki la wanrah ia u shapoh ka kamra kaba shalor: bad ki riewkynthei baroh ki la ieng hajan jong u ki iam , bad ki pyni ia ki jain bad ki jain kiba u Dorkas u la shna katba ka dang don ryngkat bad ki .

en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , and to keep the feast of tabernacles .
kha: Nangta baroh na kiba lait im na ki jaitbynriew kiba la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin leit shata man la ka snem ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem bad ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ba uwei pa uwei uba sah na ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba wan pyrshah ia ka Jerusalem un leit sha jrong na ka snem sha ka snem ban mane ia u Syiem , U Trai jong ki paid bad ban bat ia ka jingkhawai jong ki ïingjahthait .

en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the  Lord  brought again the waters of the sea upon them  ; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .
kha: Ki Israel ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang . Hynrei haba ki kali ïapom jong ki nong Ijipt lem bad ki kulai bad nongñiah ki leit shapoh ka duriaw , U  Trai  u pynïadait pat ïa ka um bad ka la tyllep ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u kulai u Pharaoh u la leit rung bad ki kali jong u bad ki kulai jong u shapoh duriaw , bad U Trai u la wanrah biang ia ki um duriaw halor jong ki ; hynrei ki khun Israel ki la leit sha ka ri kaba rkhiang hapdeng ka duriaw .

en: And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .
kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la rai shaphang ki nong Assyria :  Kin ym don kino kino kiba hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jong ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingtep ïa ki nong Assyria — kim don hok ban im !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad U Trai u la ai hukum shaphang me, ba ym dei shuh ia ka kyrteng jong me: na ka iing jong ki blei jong me ngan ot noh ia ka dur ba la ker bad ka dur ba la khleh lang: Ngan pynlong ia ka jingtep jong me; namar me long uba sniew .

en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Tyre , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom , and remembered not the brotherly covenant :
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Tyros ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki Edom , bad kim shym bat ïa ka jutang ka jingïalong paralok ba ki la ïateh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai ; Na ka bynta lai tylli ki jingpynkhein jong ka Tyros , bad na ka bynta saw tylli , ngan ym pynphai noh ia ka jingpynshitom jong ka ; namar ki la aiti noh ia ka jingshah set baroh kawei sha u Edom , bad kim kynmaw ia ka jutang para bangeit:

en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang , ki ai shispah tylli ki masi kyrtong , arspah ki langbrot , bad sawspah tylli ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh thang , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kum ki jingainguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la tyrwa ha ka jingpynkyntang ia kane ka iing U Blei shispah tylli ki masi , arspah tylli ki langbrot , saw spah tylli ki langbrot ; bad na ka bynta ka jingknia pop na ka bynta ki Israel baroh , shiphew tylli ki blang kiba la tyrwa na ka bynta ki Israel .

en: And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .
kha: Ka dur jong ka kaba kumno ?  u kylli .  Dei u tymmen uba wan mih ,  ka jubab .  U kup da ka barandi .  Kumta u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , bad u dem ngon haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ka , U long kumno ? Bad ka la ong, Uwei u rangbah u wan shaneng bad u la tap da ka jainkup . U Saul u la sngewthuh ba u dei u Samuel bad u la dem khrup da ka khmat sha khyndew .

en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , peit shaphang shatei .  Nga la peit , bad hangta hajan ka duwan harud ka jaka rung ka khyrdop nga la ïohi ïa ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingijli ba pynbitar ïa U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, to rah ia ki khmat jong me mynta shaphang shathie . Kumta nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga shaphang shathie, bad ha khmih shaphang shathie ha ka khyrdop jong ka almari ia kane ka dur jong ka jingsngewsih ha ka jingrung .

en: And Naaman said , Shall there not then , I pray thee , be given to thy servant two mules  burden of earth ? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods , but unto the  Lord .
kha: Kumta u Naaman u ong ,  Lada phim pdiang ïa ka jingai jong nga , te shah ïa nga ban rah sha ïing ar kit khashor ka khyndew , namar naduh mynta ngan ym ai jingkñia lane jingainguh thang ha uno uno u blei lait noh tang U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U Naaman u la ong, Hato ym dei ban ai ha u shakri jong me ar tylli ki khyndew ? namar u shakri jong me un ym ai shuh ia ka jingknia thang ne ka jingknia sha kiwei pat ki blei , hynrei ha U Trai .

en: Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .
kha: Wat nym sheptieng — phan ym shah pynlehrain biang ; phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet noh ïa ka jingbymlongkhuid kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka jinglong marwei ba shah ibeiñ kum ka riewkynthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat tieng ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong me: lymne wat sngewlehrain namar ba me ym shah pynjah burom: namar me klet ia ka jingsngewlehrain jong ka jinglong samla jong me, bad wat kynmaw shuh ia ka jingshah lehbein jong me .

en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .
kha: Bun ki briew ki wan sha ka liang u Asa na Ephraim , Manasseh , bad Simeon , bad ki shong ki sah ha ka hima jong u , namar ki la ïohi ba U  Trai  u long lem bad u . U Asa u phah khot ïa ki baroh bad ïa ki paid Judah bad Benjamin .
translated_en_to_kha: U la lum ia ki Judah bad u Benjamin baroh bad ki nongwei bad ki na Ephraim bad na Manasseh: namar ki la hap ha u na Israel ha ka jingbun briew haba ki la iohi ba U Trai U Blei jong u u don ryngkat bad u .

en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .
kha: U la tied ïa ka um da ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah , bad u ong ,  Hangno U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Elijah ?  Nangta u la tied biang ïa ka um , bad ka la kad arliang , bad u la ïaid sha shiliang .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia ka jainkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u, bad u la pynkhih ia ki um, bad u la ong: Hangno U Trai U Blei jong u Elijah ? bad haba u ruh u la pynkhih ia ki um , ki la iakhlad noh hangne hangta: bad u Elisha u la leit shajan .

en: And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .
kha: Ka Judah ka la ïohi ba nga la pyllait tnga ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa ka namar ba ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la kylla long ka nuti . Hynrei ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , kam shym sheptieng . Ma ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la iohi, haba na ka bynta ki daw baroh kiba u Israel u la leh be-ijot nga la weng noh ia ka, bad nga la ai ia ka ia ka bill jong ka jingkhlad noh ; hynrei ka para jong ka kaba thok ka Judah kam shym la tieng, hynrei ka la leit bad ka la ialehkai ia ka kam runar ruh .

en: So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel , and smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–beth–maachah , and all Chinneroth , with all the land of Naphtali .
kha: U syiem Benhadad u mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong u lem bad ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Israel . Ki la kurup ïa ka Ijon , ka Dan , ka Abel Beth Maakah , ka jaka hajan ka duriaw Galilaïa , bad ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Benhadad u la sngap ia u syiem Asa, bad u la phah ia ki rangbah shipai kiba u don pyrshah ia ki shnong Israel, bad u Ijon, bad u Dan, bad u Abel bed bed ĕbed ĕbed ĕbed ĕbed ĕbed ĕbed ].

en: That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .
kha: Katba phi dang im , ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi , khnang ba phi lah ban im slem ha kata ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba me lah ban sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong me, ban sumar ia ki ain jong u baroh bad ki hukum jong u, kiba nga hukum ia me, me bad u khun jong me, bad u khun jong me baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong me; bad ba ki sngi jong me kin nang slem .

en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .
kha: Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u bad ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem halor ki Israel bad ki Judah . Lada kane kam pat biang , ngan jin da la ai shuh sa ar shah ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la ai ia me ia ka iing jong u kynrad jong me, bad ki tnga jong me ha ka kpoh jong me, bad nga la ai ia me ia ka iing Israel bad ka Judah ; bad lada kata ka la long kaba duna palat, nga la ai shuh shuh ia me ia kiei kiei kiba kum kita .

en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .
kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Wat sheptieng ! Ïeng skhem , bad phin sa ïohi aïu U  Trai  un leh mynta ka sngi ban pyllait im ïa phi ; lano lano ruh phin ym ïohi shuh ïa kine ki nong Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki briew, Wat tieng, to ieng shuh, bad to iohi ia ka jingpynim U Trai, kaba un pyni ha phi ha ka sngi: namar ki nong Ijipt kiba phi la iohi ha ka sngi , phin ym iohi shuh ia ki .

en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely  ; he shall even restore it in the principal , and shall add the fifth part more thereto , and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth , in the day of his trespass offering .
kha: Haba u briew u leh pop ha kano kano na kine , u dei ban siew pat ïa kata baroh kaba u la ïoh da ki lad bymdei . Ha kata ka sngi ba la lap ba u la leh pop , u dei ban pynphai pura sha u trai , lem bad arphew bynta na ka shispah .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane baroh kaba u la smai lamler; un pynphai biang ia ka ha ka nongrim, bad un pyndap ia ka kaba phra tam ha kata, bad un ai ia ka ha uta uba ka dei ka jong u, ha ka sngi ba u la leit noh .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also destroy the idols , and I will cause their images to cease out of Memphis  ; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt : and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki blei bashukor ha Memphis . Yn ym don u ban synshar halor ka Ijipt , bad ngan pyntriem ïa ki briew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei ; Ngan pynjot ruh ia ki bleithaw, bad ngan pynlong ia ki dur jong ki ban sangeh noh na Memphis ; bad kan ym don shuh u syiem jong ka ri Ijipt: bad ngan buh ia ka jingtieng ha ka ri Ijipt .

en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken  ; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate : but thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah , and thy land Beulah : for the  Lord  delighteth in thee , and thy land shall be married .
kha: Yn ym khot shuh ïa pha ,  Kaba la shah iehnoh ,  ne ïa ka ri jong pha yn khot ,  Ka tnga ba la shah iehnoh .  Ka kyrteng bathymmai jong pha kan long  U Blei u sngewbha ïa ka .  Ïa ka ri jong pha yn khot ,  Ka jingshongkurim kaba suk ,  naba U  Trai  u sngewbha eh ïa pha , bad un long kum u tnga ïa ka ri jong pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat shah khot shuh ha ka ktien ba la buh lypa: bad ka ri jong me kan ym shah khot shuh: hynrei ia me yn khot u Hephzibah: hynrei ia me yn khot u Hephzibah: bad ka ri jong me ka long ka ri jong me: namar U Trai u sngewbha ha me, bad ka ri jong me kan long ka ri jong me .

en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
kha: Da kumta keiñ ka khyndew jong u Ephron kaba ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , ka kylla long ka jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba don hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka lyngkha Ephron kaba don ha Machpelah kaba don ha khmat u Mamre, ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta bad ki dieng baroh kiba don ha lyngkha kiba don ha ki pud baroh sawdong .

en: The  Lord  is longsuffering , and of great mercy , forgiving iniquity and transgression , and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .
kha: ‘ Nga , U  Trai  nga long uba suki ban bitar , bad nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ka jingïaineh bad map ïa ka pop bad ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah . Nalorkata , ngam pep ban pynshitom ïa ki khun bad ki ksiew haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u long uba slem, bad uba sngewsih shibun, uba map ia ka jingbymhok bad ka jingpynkhein , bad da kaba ym pynkhuid ia kiba don pop , kaba leit jngoh ia ka jingbymhok jong ki kpa ha ki khun haduh ka pateng kaba lai bad kaba saw .

en: The words of Amos , who was among the herdmen of Tekoa , which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel , two years before the earthquake .
kha: Kine ki long ki ktien u Amos , u nongaplangbrot na ka shnong Tekoa . Ar snem shuwa u jumai , mynba u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Israel , U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Amos ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shaphang ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ktien jong u Amos uba la don hapdeng ki nongri jingri jong ka Tekoa , kiba u la iohi shaphang ki Israel ha ki sngi jong u Usiah u syiem Judah bad ha ki sngi jong u Jeroboiah u khun u Joash u syiem Israel ar snem shuwa ka jingkhynñiuh jumai .

en: The beginning of the word of the  Lord  by Hosea . And the  Lord  said to Hosea , Go , take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms : for the land hath committed great whoredom , departing from the  Lord .
kha: Haba U  Trai  u la kren nyngkong eh ïa ki Israel lyngba u Hosia , U la ong ïa u Hosia ,  Khie leit bad shongkurim , ka tnga jong me kan long ka bymïaineh , bad ki khun jong me kin long kum ma ka hi . Ha kajuh ka rukom , ki briew jong nga ki la ieh ïa nga bad ki la long ki bymïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingsdang jong ka ktien U Trai da u Hosia . Bad U Trai u la ong ha u Hosia , Leit sha me ka tnga jong ki nongkhaii bad ki khun shynrang: namar ka ri ka la leh ia ka kam khaii kaba khraw, kaba mih na U Trai .

en: And Hezekiah prayed before the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  God of Israel , which dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth  ; thou hast made heaven and earth .
kha: bad u duwai ,  A  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Israel , uba don ha ka khet halor ki Kherub , me hi me long U Blei , uba synshar halor ki hima baroh jong ka pyrthei . me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa ka suiñbneng .
translated_en_to_kha: U Hesekaiah u la duwai ha khmat U Trai bad u la ong, ko Trai U Blei jong ki Israel, uba shong hapdeng ki cherubim, me long U Blei, wat ma me hi, na ki hima baroh jong ka khyndew; me la thaw ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew .

en: But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .
kha: Hynrei uta u briew u la leit bad u la sdang ban pynphriang ïa ka khubor kylleng . Ha ka jingshisha , u la ïathuh ha baroh haduh ba U Jisu um lah shuh ban rung shapoh shnong ha kaba paw paidbah . Hynrei , U la shong noh ha ki jaka kynjah , bad ki briew ki la ïawan sha u na kylleng .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la mih noh, bad u la sdang ban pynmih shibun ia ka, bad ban bthei shabar ri, khlem da pyrkhat ba U Jisu um lah shuh ban rung shapoh ka nongbah, hynrei u la don shabar ha ki jaka ri khlaw: bad ki la wan sha u na man la ki jaka .

en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company , if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator , or covetous , or an idolater , or a railer , or a drunkard , or an extortioner ; with such an one no not to eat .
kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba phin ym ïakhleh bad u briew uba khot ïa lade u parabangeit hynrei uba awria ne uba lalot ne uba mane bleithaw ne uba kren sniew ne uba buaid ne u nongtuh . To wat ïashong bam lem bad kum uta u briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta nga la thoh ha phi ban ym iakynduh , lada uno uno u briew uba la khot u para u long u nongkhaii met ne u nongleh kam sniew ne u nongleh kam sniew ne u nongleh kam sniew ne u nongleh kam sniew .

en: Then was the king exceeding glad for him , and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den . So Daniel was taken up out of the den , and no manner of hurt was found upon him , because he believed in his God .
kha: U syiem u la kmen shikatdei bad u la ai hukum ba yn tan noh ïa u Daniel na ka thliew . Kumta ki la tan ïa u shajrong bad ki la ïohi ba um shym la mynsaw ei ei , namar u la shaniah ha U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u syiem u la sngewbha palat ia u, bad u la hukum ba kin shim noh ia u Daniel na ka thliew . Kumta la shim noh ia u Daniel na ka thliew bad ym shym la lap ia u da ka jingsngewsih ei ei ha u , namar u la ngeit ha U Blei jong u .

en: Saying to a stock , Thou art my father  ; and to a stone , Thou hast brought me forth : for they have turned their back unto me , and not their face : but in the time of their trouble they will say , Arise , and save us .
kha: Ïa phi baroh yn pynjahburom — ma phi kiba ong ba u dieng u dei u kpa jong phi bad ba u mawsiang u dei ka kmie jong phi . Kane kan jia namar ba phi la phai noh na nga ha ka jaka ba phin phai sha nga . Hynrei haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , phi kyrpad ïa nga ban wan bad pynim ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba ong ha ka stock , Me long u kpa jong nga ; bad ha u maw: me la wanrah ia nga: namar ki la phai noh sha nga , bad ym ia ka khmat jong ki: hynrei ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar jong ki kin ong: To khie bad pynim ia ngi .

en: But yet in it shall be a tenth , and it shall return , and shall be eaten : as a teil tree , and as an oak , whose substance is in them , when they cast their leaves : so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof .
kha: Wat lada uwei u briew na ki shiphew ngut u sah ha ka ri , ïa u ruh yn pynjot , un long kum u dyngkhong jong u dieng Sning uba la khet .  ( U dyngkhong u ïeng na ka bynta ka jingsdang bathymmai ïa ki briew jong U Blei . )
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ha ka kan long ka shi bynta, bad kan sa wan phai: kum u dieng rit bad kum u oak uba don ha ki, haba ki bret ia ki sla jong ki: kumta u symbai bakhuid un long ka jinglong jong u .

en: And it was so , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet , as she came in at the door , that he said , Come in , thou wife of Jeroboam  ; why feignest thou thyself to be another ? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings .
kha: Hynrei haba u Ahijah u ïohsngew ba ka rung ha jingkhang , u ong ,  Rung shapoh , nga tip pha dei ka tnga u Jeroboam . Balei pha leh mynleh kumba pha dei da kawei pat ka briew ? Nga don ka khubor kaba sngewsih ïa pha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta haba u Ahiah u la iohsngew ia ka jingsawa jong ki kjat jong ka, katba ka dang rung ha ka jingkhang, ba u la ong: To wan rung, ko tnga jong u Jeroboan; balei me leh ia lade ba me long uwei pat? namar nga la phah sha me da ki khubor kiba khia .

en: For , lo , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and no razor shall come on his head : for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb : and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines .
kha: bad hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong pha , wat pyndei syrti ha ka khlieh jong u , namar na ka sngi ba la kha ïa u un long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir . Un sdang ïa ka kam ban pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar, ha khmih, men pun khun bad un ym wan u khun shynrang ha ka khlieh jong u: namar u khun un long u Nazarite ha U Blei na ka kpoh: bad un sdang ban pyllait ia ki Israel na ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael , Slay us not : for we have treasures in the field , of wheat , and of barley , and of oil , and of honey . So he forbare , and slew them not among their brethren .
kha: Hynrei la don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha ka kynhun kiba la ong ha u Ishmael ,  Sngewbha wat pynïap ïa ngi ! Ngi don u kew , u barli , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap ba la buhrieh ha ki lyngkha .  Kumta u la pyllait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei la lap ia shiphew ngut ki briew kiba la ong ha u Ishmael, Wat pyniap ia ngi: namar ngi don ki spah ha lyngkha, u kew bad u kew bad ka umphniang bad ka umsoh . Kumta u la pyniap ia ki hapdeng ki hynmen jong ki .

en: And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and , behold , a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .
kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , kynsan ki la ïohi shi kynhun ki nong Ishmael kiba wan ïaid lynti na Gilead sha Ijipt . Ïa ki ut jong ki la pynkit ïa ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shong ban bam ia u kpu: bad ki la pynkiew ia ki khmat bad ki la peit, bad, ha khmih, ka kynhun ki Ishaklele ki la wan na Gilead ryngkat bad ki kulai jong ki kiba kit ia ka jingbam bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ka umsoh bad ki khmat ki la leit sha Ijipt .

en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .
kha: Haba u Absalom u hynmen jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylli ,  Hato u Amnon u la ktah kti ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko hep , wat shah ba kata kan pynsngewsih shibun ïa phi . U dei u ba ïalong shi para bad phi na ijuh i pa , kumta te wat ïathuh hano hano shaphang kata .  Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ha ka ïing jong u Absalom , ka da sngewsih bad sngew marwei .
translated_en_to_kha: U Absalom u hynmen jong ka u la ong ia ka, Hato u hynmen jong me u la don bad me? hynrei to bat mynta ia ka jingsuk jong me, ko para jong nga: u long u hynmen jong me; wat ia kane ka jingjia . Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ha ka iing jong u hynmen jong ka .

en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :
kha: Lada ki rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , ngan wad ïa ki bad kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha trai duriaw , ngan hukum ïa ki mrad duriaw bakynsha ban dait ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad wat la ki buhrieh ia lade ha trai jong u Karmel , ngan wad bad shim noh ia ki nangta ; bad wat la ki buhrieh na ka jingpeit jong nga ha trai duriaw , nangta ngan hukum ia u bsein , bad un bam ia ki:

en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter , neither shalt thou take her son s daughter , or her daughter s daughter , to uncover her nakedness  ; for they are her near kinswomen : it is wickedness .
kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka khun ne ka ksiew jong kano kano ka briew kaba me la ïathiah shongkha ; ki long kiba dang ïadei jan bad me , bad kata ka long kaba shong sang .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka kynthei bad ka khun jong ka, lymne wat shim ia ka khun jong ka, ne ka khun jong ka, ban plie ia ka jinglong lyngkhuid jong ka ; namar ki long ki kynthei kiba hajan jong ka: ka long ka jingsniew .

en: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body , the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee , in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee :
kha: Ynda ki nongshun jong phi ki kerkut ïa ki shnong jong phi , phin sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban hap bam wat ïa la ki jong ki khun ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men bam ia u soh jong ka met jong me hi, ka doh jong ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong me, kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la ai ha me, ha ka jingshah shoh bad ha ka jingshah pynshitom bein, ha kaba ki nongshun jong me kin pynshitom ia me:

en: And the people spake against God , and against Moses , Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? for there is no bread , neither is there any water  ; and our soul loatheth this light bread .
kha: Ki la khñium ,  Balei phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt ban ïap ha kane ka ri shyiap ha kaba ym don bam lane ka um ? Ngim sngewlah shuh ban bam kum kane ka jingbam !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki kren pyrshah ia U Blei bad pyrshah ia u Moses , Balei phi la wanrah ia ngi na Ijipt ban iap ha ka ri khlaw ? namar ym don kpu , lymne ym don um; bad ka mynsiem jong ngi ka iaid lait ia une u kpu uba jem .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .
kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit hiar , bad wan ïalam pat bad me ïa u Aaron . Hynrei ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kim bit ban jam ïa u pud ban wan sha nga , ïoh nga pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u, To hiar noh ia me, bad me, bad u Aaron bad me: hynrei wat ai ba ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kin iaid lyngba ban wan sha U Trai, ioh ba un iaid sha ki .

en: Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
kha: Phim shym la jied ïa nga ; nga la jied ïa phi bad nga la thung ïa phi ban leit bad ban seisoh shibun , u jait soh uba ïaineh . Bad kumta U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Phim shym la jied ia nga, hynrei nga la jied ia phi, bad nga la buh ia phi, ba phin leit pynmih soh bad ba u soh jong phi un sah: ba kaei kaei kaba phin pan na U Kpa ha ka kyrteng jong nga, un ai ia phi .

en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving , then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil , and unleavened wafers anointed with oil , and cakes mingled with oil , of fine flour , fried .
kha: Lada u briew u wallam ïa kane ka jingainguh kum ka jingai sngewnguh sha U Blei , u dei ruh ban wanrah , ryngkat bad uta u mrad ïa uba yn kñia , ïa ka jingainguh ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat : ki kpu kiba rben ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib lane kiba stang ba la kyllan da ka umphniang Olib lane da u  purew ba la shet khleh bad ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u ai ia ka na ka bynta ka jingainguh, te un ai da ka jingknia jong ki kpu khlem thied ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang , bad ki doh khlem thied ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
kha: Hynñiew sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun shynrang , kan long ka bymkhuid , kumba ka long ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel, da kaba ong, Lada ka kynthei ka la pun khun bad kha khun shynrang: te kan long kaba khlem khuid hynriew sngi; kat kum ki sngi ba la pyniakhlad ia ka na ka bynta ka jingbym lah kha khun jong ka kan long kaba khlem khuid .

en: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the  Lord  , he arose from before the altar of the  Lord  , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
kha: Hadien ba u Solomon u la pynkut ïa kane ka jingduwai ha U  Trai  , u ïeng noh na khmat kata ka duwan , na ka jaka ba u la dem khohsiew da kaba rah ïa la ki kti .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba haba u Solomon u la pynkut noh ia kane ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad baroh ha U Trai , u la ieng na khmat ka almari U Trai , na kaba dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u da ki kti jong u kiba la pynjrong sha bneng .

en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,
kha: U Elijah u nongïathuhlypa u la phah shithi sha u Jehoram , kaba ong kumne harum :  U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Dabid , u kpa tymmen jong me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem shym bud ïa ki nuksa u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa jong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u kparad jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la wan ka jingthoh ha u na u Elijah u nongiathuhlypa, ka ong: Kumta u Trai U Blei u Dabid u kpa jong me , Namar ngam shym la iaid ha ki lynti jong u Jehoshaphat u kpa jong me, lane ha ki lynti jong u Asa u syiem Judah .

en: And that lord answered the man of God , and said , Now , behold , if the  Lord  should make windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
kha: ha kaba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la jubab ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  Bad u Elisha u la jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta u kynrad u la jubab ia uta u briew jong U Blei, bad u la ong, Mynta, ha khmih, lada U Trai un thaw ia ki jingkhang ha bneng, hato ka lah ban long kum kata ? Bad u la ong: Ha khmih, men iohi ia ka da ki khmat jong me, hynrei wat bam ia ka .

en: The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .
kha: Mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Hato me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Israel , kata ka kynthei bymïaineh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad halor uwei pa uwei u lum bajrong bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ka la leh kum ka nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ruh ha nga ha ki sngi u Josiah u syiem, Me la iohi ia kata kaba la pynkylla ia ki Israel ? ka la leit sha jrong ha u lum baroh uba jrong bad hapoh u dieng baroh uba jyrngam .

en: Command Aaron and his sons , saying , This is the law of the burnt offering : It is the burnt offering , because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning , and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it .
kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingainguh thang . Ïa ka jingainguh thang dei ban ieh halor ka duwan baroh shi miet , bad hangta ka ding ruh ka dei ban ïai meh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynbeit ia u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u, da kaba ong: Kane ka long ka jingknia thang: Ka long ka jingknia thang , namar ka jingthang halor ka jingbam baroh shi miet haduh mynstep , bad ka ding jong ka jingbam kan thang ha ka .
