en: And when he had removed him , he raised up unto them David to be their king  ; to whom also he gave testimony , and said , I have found David the son of Jesse , a man after mine own heart , which shall fulfil all my will .
kha: Hadien ba la weng noh ïa u , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong ki . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang jong u : ‘ Nga la shem ba u Dabid u khun jong u Jesse , u long u jait briew uba nga sngewbha , u briew u ban leh ïa baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u ban leh .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la weng noh ia u, u la pynmih ia u Dabid ban long u syiem jong ki; ha uba u la ai sakhi ruh, bad u la ong: Nga la shem ia u Dabid u khun u Jesse, u briew uba bud ia ka dohnud jong nga hi, uba pyndep ia ka mon jong nga baroh .

en: Because they ministered unto them before their idols , and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity  ; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them , saith the Lord  God  , and they shall bear their iniquity .
kha: Hynrei namar ba ki la leh ïa ka jingmane ïa ki bleithaw na ka bynta ki paid Israel bad ba ha kane ka rukom ki la ïalam ïa ki paidbah sha ka pop , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga smai kyntang ba dei ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki la shakri ia ki ha khmat ki bleithaw jong ki, bad ki la pynlong ia ka iing Israel ban hap ha ka jingbymhok ; namarkata nga la rah ia ka kti jong nga pyrshah ia ki , ong U Trai Blei , bad kin kit ia ka jingbymhok jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka ri Moab , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lane wat ïaleh thma bad ki . Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka shnong Ar , bad ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga, Wat nym ialeh pyrshah ia ki ha ka thma: namar ngan ym ai ia me ia ka ri jong ki na ka bynta ka jaka; namar nga la ai ia u Ar ha ki khun u Lot na ka bynta ka jaka .

en: Yet they seek me daily , and delight to know my ways , as a nation that did righteousness , and forsook not the ordinance of their God : they ask of me the ordinances of justice  ; they take delight in approaching to God .
kha: Ki mane ïa nga man la ka sngi , ki da kam ba ki thrang ban tip ïa ki lynti jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga . Ki ong ba ki kwah ïa nga ban ai ïa ki aiñ kiba beit bad ba ki shem sngewbha ha kaba mane ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki wad ia nga man ka sngi, bad ki sngewbha ban tip ia ki lynti jong nga, kum ka jaitbynriew kaba la leh hok, bad kim shym la iehnoh ia ka hukum jong U Blei jong ki: ki pan na nga ia ki hukum jong ka hok ; ki sngewbha ban leit sha U Blei .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u mynsiem bymman na U Blei kynsan kynsan u ïoh tylli ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing la kum uba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , bad u Saul u bat ïa la u sum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba bud, ba u mynsiem bymman na U Blei u la wan ha u Saul, bad u la iathuhlypa hapdeng ka iing: bad u Dabid u la ialehkai da ka kti jong u kumba ha kiwei pat ki por: bad ka la don ka javelin ha ka kti jong u Saul .

en: This evil people , which refuse to hear my words , which walk in the imagination of their heart , and walk after other gods , to serve them , and to worship them , shall even be as this girdle , which is good for nothing .
kha: Kine ki briew basniew ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga . Ki la long kiba mutlop bad bymman kumba ki la ju long , bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei ki blei . Kumta te , ki la long kum kine ki patlun lyngkot ki bym long shuh ban pyndonkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Une u briew uba sniew uba kyntait ban iohsngew ia ki ktien jong nga, uba iaid ha ka jingmutdur jong ka dohnud jong ki, bad uba iaid hadien kiwei pat ki blei, ban shakri ia ki bad ban mane ia ki, un long wat kum kane ka kynhun kaba bha na ka bynta kaei kaei ruh .

en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit mynsiem ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ophisar kin kren shuh shuh ha ki briew bad kin ong, Uei u briew uba tieng bad uba sngewsih ? to ai ba un leit phai noh sha la iing , ioh ba ka dohnud jong u kan sngewsih kumjuh ruh ia ka dohnud jong u .

en: And the king was much moved , and went up to the chamber over the gate , and wept : and as he went , thus he said , O my son Absalom , my son , my son Absalom ! would God I had died for thee , O Absalom , my son , my son !
kha: Te u syiem u la shah tyllep da ka sngewsih . U leit kiew sha ka kamra kaba halor kata ka khyrdop , bad u la ïam . Katba u dang leit , u la kyang ,  A , ko khun jong nga ! Ko khun jong nga , ko Absalom ! Ko Absalom , u khun jong nga ! Lada ngan da la ïap ha ka jaka jong phi , ko khun jong nga ! Ko Absalom , ko khun jong nga !
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la khih shibun, bad u la leit sha ka kamra kaba don halor ka khyrdop, bad katba u dang leit: bad katba u dang leit, kumta u la ong, ko khun jong nga u Absalom ! lada U Blei u la iap na ka bynta jong me, ko Absalom, ko khun jong nga !

en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khatwei , ha ka snem kaba sawphew hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban ong ha ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka snem kaba sawphew snem, ha ka shiphew bnai, ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnai, ba u Moses u la kren ha ki khun Israel, kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la ai ha ki;

en: Against Egypt , against the army of Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt , which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong shaphang ki kynhun shipai u Neko , u syiem ka Ijipt , ïa uba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la jop ha Karkhemish hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem ka Judah :
translated_en_to_kha: Pyrshah ia ka ri Ijipt , pyrshah ia ka kynhun shipai jong u Pharaoh u la don hajan ka wah Euphrates ha Karkemis , kaba u Neuchastrozzar u syiem Babilon u la leit ha ka snem kaba saw jong u Jehoiakim u khun u Josiah u syiem Judah .

en: And he carried away all Jerusalem , and all the princes , and all the mighty men of valour , even ten thousand captives , and all the craftsmen and smiths : none remained , save the poorest sort of the people of the land .
kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la ring koidi ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem , ïa ki khun syiem shynrang baroh , bad baroh ki rangbah bapawkhmat , baroh lang shiphew hajar ngut . U la pynryngkang par ruh ïa baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , da kaba iehnoh shadien ha Judah tang ïa ki briew kiba duk tam eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la rah noh ia ka Jerusalem baroh kawei, bad ki rangbah baroh, bad ki rangbah baroh, wat shi hajar ngut ki nongshah set phatok bad ki nongshna tiar baroh: ym don ba sah, lait noh tang ki briew kiba duk tam jong ka ri .

en: And Saul said , I will give him her , that she may be a snare to him , and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Wherefore Saul said to David , Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain .
kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ai ïa ka Mikhal ha u Dabid : ngan pyndonkam ïa ka ban riam ïa u , bad un sa shah pynïap ha ki Philistia .  Kumta ha ka sien kaba ar u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Men sa long u pyrsa kurim jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la ong , Ngan ai ia ka ha u, ba kan long ka jingma ia u, bad ba ka kti jong ki Philistia kan long pyrshah ia u . Kumta u Saul u la ong ha u Dabid , Me long mynta ka sngi u khun jong nga ha uwei na ki arngut .

en: And I will come down and talk with thee there : and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee , and will put it upon them  ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee , that thou bear it not thyself alone .
kha: Ngan wan hiar bad ïakren bad me hangta , bad ngan shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem ïa kaba nga la ai ha me bad ngan ai ïa ka ha ki . Te kin sa lah ban ïakit lem ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta kine ki paidbah , bad men ym donkam shuh ban kit tang marwei hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan wan hiar bad ngan ia kren bad me hangta : bad ngan shim ia ka mynsiem kaba don halor jong me, bad ngan buh ia ka ha ki ; bad kin kit ia ka jingkit jong ki briew bad me, ba me ym kit ia ka hi marwei .

en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings , and the flesh of captains , and the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses , and of them that sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and bond , both small and great .
kha: Ale bad bam ïa ka doh jong ki syiem , ki nongïalam shipai , bad jong ki shipai , ka doh jong ki kulai bad ki nongshong jong ki , ka doh jong ki briew baroh , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , kiba rit bad kiba khraw !
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin bam ia ka doh jong ki syiem bad ka doh jong ki rangbah shipai bad ka doh jong ki kulai bad ki kulai bad ki kulai kiba shong ha ki bad ka doh jong ki briew baroh, baroh arngut kiba laitluid bad kiba khraw .

en: And it shall come to pass , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , The  Lord  liveth  ; as they taught my people to swear by Baal  ; then shall they be built in the midst of my people .
kha: Lada kin pdiang da ka dohnud jong ki baroh ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong nga bad kin smai , ‘ Kumba U  Trai  u im’ — kumba shisien ki la hikai ïa ki briew jong nga ban smai da u Baal — nangta ki ruh kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga ban kin manbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia lada kin nang da ka jingsngewrit ia ki lynti jong ki briew jong nga, ban smai da ka kyrteng jong nga , U Trai u im; kumba ki la hikai ia ki briew jong nga ban smai da u Baal ; te kin sa tei hapdeng ki briew jong nga .

en: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord come , who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness , and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts : and then shall every man have praise of God .
kha: Kumta phim dei ban bishar ïano ïano shuwa ba ka por kaba dei kan poi . Ka jingbishar bakhatduh ka dei ban ap tad ynda U Trai un wan ; un wallam ha ka jingshai ïa ki jingbuhrieh ba-dum bad pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu barieh jong ki jingmut ki briew . Bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka jingïaroh kaba u dei hok ban ïoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata wat bishar ei ei shuwa ka por, haduh ba U Trai un wan, uba baroh arngut un pynpaw ia kiei kiei kiba buhrieh jong ka jingdum , bad un pynpaw ia ki jingthmu jong ki dohnud: bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ioh ia ka jingiaroh ia U Blei .

en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles , and set up my standard to the people : and they shall bring thy sons in their arms , and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew :  Ngan pyn-i dak sha ki jaitbynriew , bad kin wallam ïa ki khun jong pha sha ïing .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u ong , Ha khmih , ngan rah ia ka kti jong nga sha ki Jutang , bad ngan rah ia ka lama jong nga sha ki briew: bad kin wanrah ia ki khun shynrang jong me ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei jong me kin shah rah ha ki tyrpeng jong ki .

en: Then Elisha said , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the  Lord  , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria .
kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi phin lah ban thied ha Samaria lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli tang shi sbai rupa .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Elisha u la ong , To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai ; Kumta u ong U Trai , Haduh mynta ka por yn die ia ka shini kaba bha na ka bynta ka Shekel , bad ar tylli ki barli na ka bynta ka Shekel , ha ka khyrdop jong ka Samaria .

en: For the seed shall be prosperous  ; the vine shall give her fruit , and the ground shall give her increase , and the heavens shall give their dew  ; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .
kha: Kin thung ïa ki jingthung jong ki ha ka jingsuk . Ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki kin pynmih ki sohwaiñ , ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad u slap un don kyrhai . Ngan ai ïa kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh ha ki briew jong ka hima jong nga kiba dang lait im .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u symbai un long uba roi; u sohjew un ai ia u soh jong ka, bad ki bneng kin ai ia ka dewbilat jong ki; bad ngan pynlong ia kiba sah jong une u briew ban don ia kine kiei kiei baroh .

en: And it came to pass , when God caused me to wander from my father s house , that I said unto her , This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me  ; at every place whither we shall come , say of me , He is my brother .
kha: Kumta haba U Blei u la phah noh ïa nga na ka ïing u kpa jong nga sha ki ri nongwei , nga ong ha ka , ‘ Pha lah ban pyn-i haduh katno pha shaniah ïa nga da kaba ïathuh ïa iwei pa iwei ba nga long u hynmen jong pha .’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia haba U Blei u la pynlong ia nga ban iaid kai na iing u kpa jong nga, ba nga la ong ha ka: Kane ka long ka jingbhabriew jong me kaba me pyni ha nga ; ha man la ka jaka ba ngin wan, ong shaphang jong nga: U long u hynmen jong nga .

en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .
kha: U synran ïa uba U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros ,  U dei U Trai !  Haba u Petros u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata uta u synran uba U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros, U long U Trai . Mynta haba u Simon Petros u la iohsngew ba u long U Trai , u la bat ia ka jain ri dohkha jong u ha u (na u la lyngkhuid) bad u la bret ia lade ha duriaw .

en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .
kha: Ki mraw kiba long ki jong ki kynrad kiba ngeit kim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , naba ki long ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki dei ban shakri ïa ki kham bha shuh shuh , namar kito kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba ki ieit . Me dei ban hikai bad ïalap ïa kine kiei kiei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kito kiba don ki kynrad kiba ngeit , wat ai ba kin leh bein ia ki, namar ki long ki para ; hynrei ki kham shakri ia ki, namar ki long kiba iaineh bad kiba ieit , ki nongiashim bynta ha ka jingmyntoi . Kine kiei kiei ki hikai bad ki kyntu .

en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he judged Israel , and went out to war : and the  Lord  delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand  ; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim .
kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la wan ha u , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki Israel . U Othniel u leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor u syiem ka Mesopotamia .
translated_en_to_kha: U Mynsiem U Trai u la wan halor jong u, bad u la bishar ia ki Israel, bad u la leit sha ka thma: bad U Trai u la aiti ia u Chushanrishathaim syiem ka ri Mesopotamia ha ka kti jong u; bad ka kti jong u ka la jop ia u Chushanrishathaim .

en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , which killest the prophets , and stonest them that are sent unto thee  ; how often would I have gathered thy children together , as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings , and ye would not !
kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , pha lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah sha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ki briew jong pha , kumba ka syiar ka kdup ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei phan ym shah ïa nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Ko Jerusalem Jerusalem, Jerusalem, kaba pyniap ia ki nongiathuhlypa, bad kaba pyniap ia kita kiba la phah sha me ; katno sien nga la lum lang ia ki khun jong me, kumba ka syiar ka lum ia ki khun jong ka hapoh ki bniat jong ka , bad phim shym la lum ia ki !

en: And they said , The God of the Hebrews hath met with us : let us go , we pray thee , three days  journey into the desert , and sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God  ; lest he fall upon us with pestilence , or with the sword .
kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la jubab ,  U Blei jong ki Hebru u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  uba U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngim leh kumta , un sa pynïap ïa ngi da ka jingpang lane da ka thma .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: U Blei jong ki Hebru u la iakynduh bad ngi: to ngin leit noh, ngi duwai ia me, lai sngi ka jingleit sha ka ri khlaw, bad ka jingknia ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi; ioh ba un hap ha ngi da ka jingpang khlam, ne da ka waitlam .

en: But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baroh kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei , U Trai u im, uba la wanrah ia ki khun Israel na ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie, bad na ki ri baroh kiba u la beh noh ia ki: bad ngan wanrah biang ia ki sha ka ri jong ki kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

en: And David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up to the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go up : for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand .
kha: U Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Hato ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato men ai ha nga ïa ka jingjop ?   Ho-oid , khie tur ïaleh !  U  Trai  u la jubab .  Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop !
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la kylli ia U Trai, u da ong, Hato ngan leit sha ki Philistia ? me wan aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong nga ? Bad U Trai u la ong ha u Dabid: To leit shaneng: namar khlem artatien ngan aiti ia ki Philistia ha ka kti jong me .

en: In those days there was no king in Israel : and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in  ; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel .
kha: Ha kata ka por , ym don syiem ha Israel . Ha kita ki sngi ki Dan ki dang wad jaka la ka jong ban shong ban sah namar kim pat shym la ïoh la ka jaka hapdeng ki jait Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kita ki sngi ym don syiem ha Israel: bad ha kita ki sngi ka jaitbynriew Dan ka la wad ia ki ia ka pateng ban shong ha ka ; namar haduh kata ka sngi baroh ka pateng jong ki kam shym la hap ha ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew Israel .

en: And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba u Moses u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , u la ïohi ba u diengduh jong u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la shylluit , phuh syntiew , bad sei ki soh almond kiba ih !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Aaron bad ha khmih u Aaron na ka bynta ka ïing u Lebi u la tyrkhong bad u la pynmih ïa ki soh bad u la phuh ki syntiew bad u la ai ïa ki soh almond .

en: And Moses gave commandment , and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp , saying , Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary . So the people were restrained from bringing .
kha: Kumta u Moses u phah pynbna ha ka jaka sher dara baroh kawei ba ym donkam shuh ïano ïano ban wallam jingainguh na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang ; kumta kita ki paidbah kim shym wallam ei ei shuh .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ai hukum , bad ki la pynlong ia ka ban shah pynbna ha baroh kawei ka jaka shong jaka sah , ki da ong , Wat ai ba u shynrang ne ka kynthei kin leh ei ei shuh na ka bynta ka jingknia ia ka jaka kyntang . Kumta ki briew ki la shah khanglad ban wanrah .

en: But he shall not multiply horses to himself , nor cause the people to return to Egypt , to the end that he should multiply horses : forasmuch as the  Lord  hath said unto you , Ye shall henceforth return no more that way .
kha: U syiem um dei ban pynbun ki kulai na ka bynta ïa lade , bad um dei ban phah briew sha Ijipt ban thied kulai nangta , namar U  Trai  u la ong ba ki briew jong u kim dei ban leit phai shata lano lano .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei un ym pynbun ia ki kulai ha lade, lymne ban pynlong ia ki briew ban leit phai sha Ijipt, haduh ba un da pynbun ia ki kulai: namar kumba U Trai u la ong ha phi: Phin ym wan phai shuh kumta .

en: And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him , a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the  Lord  our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
kha: Hangta ha ka Templ , u Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ki hynñiew sngi . Hangta la don u paidbah bynriew babun naduh ki jaka kiba jngai kum ka Khim Hamath shaphang shatei bad ka u pud ka Ijipt shaphang shathie .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kata ka por u Solomon u la leh ia ka jingkhawai, bad ki Israel baroh, ka jingiaseng kaba khraw, naduh ka jingrung jong u Hamath haduh ka wah Ijipt, ha khmat U Trai jong ngi, hynriew sngi bad hynriew sngi, wat shiphew sngi .

en: These are they which were not defiled with women  ; for they are virgins . These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth . These were redeemed from among men , being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb .
kha: Ki long ki rangbah kiba la ri khuid ïa lade khlem ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei ; ki long ki rangsotti . Ki bud ïa U Khunlangbrot kat shaba u leit . La siewspah ïa ki napdeng u khunbynriew bad ki long kiba nyngkong ïa kiba la ainguh ha U Blei bad ha u Khunlangbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine ki long kita ki bym shym la pynsniew bad ki kynthei ; namar ki long ki nongleh kam sniew . Kine ki long kiba bud ia u Khunlangbrot katba u leit . Ia kine la siewspah na ki briew, ki long ki soh nyngkong eh ha U Blei bad ha U Khunlangbrot .

en: I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .
kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka borbah jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la duwai namarkata ha U Trai bad nga la ong, ko Trai Blei, wat pynjot ia ki briew jong me bad ia ka pateng jong me, kaba me la siewspah lyngba ka jingkhraw jong me, kaba me la wanrah na Ijipt da ka kti kaba khlain .

en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti ïa u , ïa ki briew jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh ha phi . Leh ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .’
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga: Wat tieng ia u: namar ngan aiti ia u bad ia ki briew jong u baroh, bad ia ka ri jong u, ha ka kti jong me; bad me men leh ia u kumba me la leh ia u ha u syiem jong ki Amorites uba shong ha Heshbon .

en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece , for each prince one , according to their fathers  houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .
kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel , bad uwei pa uwei na ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ai ha u mar uwei u diengduh , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait , baroh ki long khat-ar tylli , bad ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron la buh lem bad ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la kren ha ki khun Israel, bad uwei pa uwei na ki rangbah jong ki u la ai ia u uwei uwei u rangbah jong ki, kat kum ki iing ki sem jong ki, wat shiphew tylli ki dieng: bad u dieng u Aaron u la don hapdeng ki dieng jong ki .

en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :
kha: Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang uwei u syiem u ban synshar halor jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynlong ia ki kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri Israel bad uwei u syiem un long syiem ia ki baroh: bad kin ym long shuh ar jaitbynriew: bad kin ym long ar tylli ki jaitbynriew:

en: And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Em , kata kam da pher eh ; lada nga la ïoh ka jingsngewbha jong phi , to pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha jong nga . Ban ïohi ïa ka khmat jong phi ka long ïa nga hi kumba ïohi ïa ka khmat U Blei , mynta ba phi la leh jan ïa nga katne .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jakob u la ong, Em, nga kyrpad ia me, lada nga la shem ia ka jingaiei ha khmat jong me, te to pdiang ia ka jingai jong nga ha ka kti jong nga: namar namarkata nga la iohi ia ka khmat jong me kumba nga la iohi ia ka khmat U Blei, bad me la sngewbha ia nga .

en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the  Lord  will take away thy master from thy head to day ? And he answered , Yea , I know it  ; hold ye your peace .
kha: Ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don hangta ki la leit sha u Elisha bad ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato phi tip ba U  Trai  un sa shim noh na phi ïa u kynrad jong phi ha kane ka sngi ?   Ho-oid , nga tip ,  u Elisha u jubab ;  Hynrei to ngin ym ïakren shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa kiba don ha Jerikoh ki la wan sha u Elisha bad ki la ong ha u, "Phi tip ba U Trai un weng noh ia u kynrad jong me na ka khlieh jong me haduh ka sngi ? U la jubab: Hooid , nga tip ia kata; to sngap jar .

en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand  ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .
kha: Hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam Israel ki don hangta , kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Shaphan . Uwei pa uwei u bat ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih , bad ka tdem ka dang kiew na ka jingiwbih .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah jong ka iing Israel, bad hapdeng jong ki u Jaasiah u khun u Shaphan, bad uwei pa uwei u la kiew ha ka kti jong u; bad u lyoh ba jylliew jong u u la kiew .

en: And it came to pass in an eveningtide , that David arose from off his bed , and walked upon the roof of the king s house : and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself  ; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , haba la kham janmiet , u Dabid u la khie na kaba thiah shipor bad u la leit shalor ka tnum ïing jong ka ïingsyiem . Katba u dang ïaid sawdong hangta , u la ïohi ïa ka kynthei kaba dang sum . Ka long kaba bhabriew shikatdei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka por janmiet, ba u Dabid u la ieng na ka jingthiah jong u, bad u la iaid halor ka tnum jong ka iing syiem: bad na ka tnum u la iohi ia kawei ka kynthei kaba sait ia lade ; bad kata ka kynthei ka la itynnad bha ban peit .

en: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men : for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim , and smote them in the going down : wherefore the hearts of the people melted , and became as water .
kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki beh krad ïa ki naduh ka khyrdop shnong haduh ki katto katne ki par bad ki la pynïap kumba laiphew hynriew ngut ha ka lynti sharum ki lumrit . Te ki Israel ki la duh ka jingshlur bad ki la sheptieng .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew jong ka Ai ki la sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang ban sdang

en: And God said unto Abraham , Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad , and because of thy bondwoman  ; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee , hearken unto her voice  ; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called .
kha: Hynrei U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Wat khuslai na ka bynta uta u khynnah bad na ka bynta ka Hagar ka mraw jong me . Leh ïa kaei kaba ka Sarah ka ong ha me , namar na u Isaak men sa ïoh ki khun ki ksiew kiba nga la kular .
translated_en_to_kha: U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham: Wat nym sngewsih ha khmat jong me namar u khynnah shynrang bad namar ka jinglong mraw jong me baroh kaba ka Sarah ka la ong ha me baroh kawei .

en: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time , which went up with them into the camp from the country round about , even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan .
kha: Katto katne ki Hebru , kiba la don ha ka liang jong ki Philistia bad kiba la leit bad ki sha ka jaka sher dara , ki la kylla liang sa shisien bad ki la ïasoh bad u Saul bad u Jonathan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki Hebru kiba la don bad ki Philistia shuwa kata ka por , kiba la leit sha ka jaka shong jaka sah na ka ri sawdong , wat ki ruh ki la kylla long bad ki Israel kiba don bad u Saul bad u Jonathan .

en: I will pass through all thy flock to day , removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle , and all the brown cattle among the sheep , and the spotted and speckled among the goats : and of such shall be my hire .
kha: Shah ba ngan ïaid hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong phi mynta ka sngi bad ban shim ïa baroh ki khunlangbrot baïong bad ïa ki khunblang baroh kiba thohbria bad thohbroin . Kata kan long ka bainong kaba nga kwah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iaid lyngba ki langbrot jong me baroh ha ka sngi, nga weng noh na kata ka jaka ia ki masi kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong , bad ki masi kiba la tyrkhong bad kiba la tyrkhong hapdeng ki blang: bad na kita kin long ki bainong jong nga .

en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .
kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing syiem Khaldi . Ïa ka Templ la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei hadien ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynkhih ia U Blei jong ka bneng haduh ka jingbitar, u la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong u Neuchadnezzar u syiem Babilon , u Khlieh uba la pynjot ia kane ka iing bad u la rah noh ia ki briew sha Babilon .

en: But Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , had no sons , but daughters : and these are the names of his daughters , Mahlah , and Noah , Hoglah , Milcah , and Tirzah .
kha: U Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , um don khun shynrang ; hynrei tang ki khun kynthei . Ki kyrteng jong ki , ki long ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Selophehad u khun u Hepher u khun u Gilead u khun u Machir u khun u Manasseh: bad kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khun kynthei jong u, u Mahlah bad u Noah, u Hoglah, u Millah bad u Tirsah .

en: They bear him upon the shoulder , they carry him , and set him in his place , and he standeth  ; from his place shall he not remove : yea , one shall cry unto him , yet can he not answer , nor save him out of his trouble .
kha: Ki kyntiew ïa ka ha la ki tyrpeng bad rah ïa ka ; ki buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka , bad hangta ka ïeng , khlem lah ban khih na ka jaka ba ka don . Lada don uno uno ba duwai ha ka , kam lah ban jubab lane pyllait ïa u na ka jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki kit ia u ha ka tyrpeng jong u, ki kit ia u, bad u ieng ia u ha ka jaka jong u, bad u ieng ; na ka jaka jong u un ym weng noh: hooid, uwei un iam ia u, hynrei um lah ban jubab ia u, ne ban pynim ia u na ka jingjynjar jong u .

en: I sleep , but my heart waketh : it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh , saying , Open to me , my sister , my love , my dove , my undefiled : for my head is filled with dew , and my locks with the drops of the night .
kha: Ki bniat jong phi ki lieh kum ka langbrot ba dang shu dep ot shñiuh bad ba la shah pynsum . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long kiba ïaryntih bha .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga thiah, hynrei ka dohnud jong nga ka kyndit: ka long ka sur jong u baieit jong nga kaba tied, da kaba ong: Plie ia nga, ko para jong nga, ko jingieit jong nga, ko khun jong nga: namar ka khlieh jong nga ka dap da ka dewbilat bad ki jingkhang jong nga da ki tdem miet .

en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .
kha: Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen jong u sha u syiem . U ong ,  I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wan na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki , bad baroh ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Joseph u la wan bad u la iathuh ha u Pharaoh bad u la ong: U kpa jong nga bad ki hynmen jong nga bad ki langbrot jong ki bad ki kynhun jong ki bad ki jingdon jong ki baroh ki mih na ka ri Kana; bad, ha khmih, ki don ha ka ri Goshen .

en: If my people , which are called by my name , shall humble themselves , and pray , and seek my face , and turn from their wicked ways  ; then will I hear from heaven , and will forgive their sin , and will heal their land .
kha: lada ki duwai sha nga bad ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai noh na ki kam bymman ba ki leh , te ngan shahshkor ïa ki na bneng , ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ka ri jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada ki briew jong nga kiba la khot da ka kyrteng jong nga kin pynrit ia lade bad kin duwai bad kin wad ia ka khmat jong nga bad kin phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong ki ; te ngan iohsngew na bneng bad ngan map ia ka pop jong ki bad ngan pynkoit ia ka ri jong ki .

en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u la kren napdeng ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la thoh ha ki miej, kat kum ka jingthoh kaba nyngkong, ia ki shiphew tylli ki hukum kiba U Trai u la kren ha phi ha ka jaka ba la lum na pdeng ka ding ha ka sngi ba la lum lang: bad U Trai u la ai ia ki ha nga .

en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .
kha: Nga la khmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki reng jong u sha sepngi , shatei , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jong u . U la leh katba u sngewbha bad u la nang sngewmeng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi ia u langbrot uba pynkhih shaphang sepngi, bad shaphang shathie, bad shaphang shathie, khnang ba ym don ki mrad kiba lah ban ieng ha khmat jong u, bad ym don mano mano ruh kiba lah ban pynpoi na ka kti jong u ; hynrei u la leh kat kum ka mon jong u, bad u la long uba khraw .

en: There were giants in the earth in those days  ; and also after that , when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men , and they bare children to them , the same became mighty men which were of old , men of renown .
kha: Ha kito ki sngi , bad wat hadien kata ruh , la don ki ramhah ha ka pyrthei kiba long ki khun ki ksiew jong kita ki khun kynthei jong ki briew bad kita ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng . Ki la long ki riewshlur bakhraw bad ki briew kiba pawnam ha ki por mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki don ki rangbah ha ka khyndew ha kito ki sngi ; bad ruh hadien kata, haba ki khun shynrang ki la wan rung ha ki khun kynthei jong ki briew , bad ki la kha khun ha ki , kita ki long ki briew kiba khlain bor kiba la rim bha .

en: Behold , a son shall be born to thee , who shall be a man of rest  ; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about : for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days .
kha: La katta ruh , u la pynlong ka jingkular bad nga . U ong , ‘ Phin sa don u khun jong u ban synshar ha ka jingsuk , namar ba ngan ai ha u ka jingsuk na ki nongshun jong u baroh . Ka kyrteng jong u kan long u Solomon , namar ha ka jingsynshar jong u ngan ai ha ki Israel ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih, yn kha ia u khun shynrang ha me, uba long u briew uba shongthait bad ngan ai jingjahthait ia u na ki nongshun jong u baroh sawdong: namar ka kyrteng jong u kan long u Solomon , bad ngan ai jingsuk bad jingsuk ia ki Israel ha ki sngi jong u .

en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch , a knop and a flower  ; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch , a knop and a flower : so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick .
kha: Kawei pa kawei na kita ki hynriew tylli ki tnat ka don lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata bad ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Lai tylli ki khiew ba la shna hadien ka rukom jong ki almond ha kawei ka tnat, u knop bad u syntiew bad lai tylli ki khiew ba la shna kum ki almond ha kawei pat ka tnat, u knop bad u syntiew ; kumta ha baroh ki hynriew tylli ki tnat ki mih na ka sharak .

en: And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .
kha: Nangta u Lot u la leit sha ki rangbah kiba la ïatehktien bad ki khun kynthei jong u , bad u ong ,  To pynkloi bad mihnoh nangne ; naba U  Trai  un sa pynjot thiaw ïa kane ka jaka .  Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shu kren biria .
translated_en_to_kha: U Lot u la mih noh, bad u la kren ha ki khun shynrang jong u, kiba la shongkurim ia ki khun kynthei jong u, bad u la ong, To mih noh na kane ka jaka ; namar U Trai un pynjot ia kane ka shnong . Hynrei u la long kumba u la rkhie bein ia ki khun shynrang jong u .

en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .
kha: Ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kali ïapom kiba ki wai bad ka kynhun shipai u syiem Maakah ki wan sher dara hajan ka Medeba . Ki Ammon ruh ki wan na baroh ki nongbah jong ki bad ki long kiba la kloi ban ïaleh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la shim da ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kali kit mar, bad u syiem u Maah bad ki briew jong u kiba la wan bad ki la iaid ha khmat u Medeba . Ki khun Ammon ki la ialum lang na ki shnong jong ki bad ki la wan sha ka thma .

en: And Joab said unto the king , Now the  Lord  thy God add unto the people , how many soever they be , an hundredfold , and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it : but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing ?
kha: Hynrei u Joab u jubab ïa u syiem ,  Syiem Kynrad , to U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynroi ïa ki Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki don mynta , bad to phin dang im ban ïohi ïa u ba u leh ïa kata . Hynrei balei keiñ u Syiem Kynrad u kwah ban leh ïa kane ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Joab u la ong ha u syiem, Mynta U Trai jong me u la pyndap ia ki briew, katno ngut ki long, shispah shah bad ba ki khmat jong u kynrad jong nga ki lah ban iohi ia ka: hynrei balei u kynrad jong nga u sngewbha ia kane ka kam ?

en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it , and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it , for the glory thereof , because it is departed from it .
kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka nongbah jong ka Samaria kin sheptieng bad ïam sngewsih namar ka jingduh noh ïa u masi ksiar ha Bethel . Ma ki bad kita ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ïa u bleithaw kin ïam sngewsih namar jong u . Kin sa ïam pangnud haba yn law lyngkhuit ïa ka jingthaba rong ksiar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshong shnong jong ka Samaria kin tieng namar ki khun masi jong ka Bethaven: namar ki briew jong ka kin iam halor jong ka, bad ki lyngdoh jong ka kiba la sngewbha halor jong ka, namar ka la jah noh na ka .

en: By faith Noah , being warned of God of things not seen as yet , moved with fear , prepared an ark to the saving of his house  ; by the which he condemned the world , and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith .
kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Noah ban shahshkor ïa ki jingmaham U Blei shaphang kiei kiei ki ban sa jia ïa kiba um shym lah ban ïohi . U la kohnguh ïa U Blei bad u la thaw ïa ka ïinglieng ha kaba ma u bad ka longïing jong u ki la ïohlait im . Da kane , la pynrem ïa ka pyrthei , bad u Noah u la ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka hok kaba wan da ka jingngeit .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ka jingngeit u Noah, u la shah maham ia U Blei jong kiei kiei ki bym pat iohi haduh mynta, u la khih da ka jingtieng, u la pynkhreh ia ka lieng sha ka jingpynim ia ka iing jong u ; da kaba u la pynrem ia ka pyrthei , bad u la long u nongioh pateng ia ka hok kaba long da ka jingngeit .

en: On the eighth day he sent the people away : and they blessed the king , and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the  Lord  had done for David his servant , and for Israel his people .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u Solomon u phah noh sha ïing ïa u paidlang . Baroh ki la ïaroh ïa u bad ki leit suk sha ïing namar ki jingkyrkhu baroh ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong u bad ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u la phah noh ia ki briew: bad ki la kyrkhu ia u syiem , bad ki la leit sha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki da ka jingkmen bad ka jingkmen na ka bynta ka jingbha baroh kaba U Trai u la leh na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong u bad na ka bynta ki Israel jong u .

en: The leaves thereof were fair , and the fruit thereof much , and in it was meat for all : the beasts of the field had shadow under it , and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof , and all flesh was fed of it .
kha: Ki sla jong u ki long kiba itynnat , bad la pynshlei ïa u da ki soh — kiba kyrhai na ka bynta ka pyrthei baroh kawei ban bam . Ki mradkhlaw ki pynjahthait ha ka syrngiew jong u , ki sim ki shna ïa ki skum ha ki tnat jong u , bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba-im ki la bam ïa u soh jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki sla jong ka ki long kiba itynnad, bad u soh jong ka u long uba bun: ki mrad khlaw ki la shadem hapoh jong ka , bad ki sim bneng ki shong ha ki tnat jong ka , bad baroh ki la bam ia ka .

en: And David arose , and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah , to bring up from thence the ark of God , whose name is called by the name of the  Lord  of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims .
kha: bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Baal ha Judah khnang ban wallam nangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jong u ka long halor ki Kherub .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ieng bad u la leit bad ki briew baroh kiba don ryngkat bad u na Bala jong ka Judah, ban wanrah na kata ka jaka ia ka synduk U Blei , kaba la khot da ka kyrteng U Trai jong ki paid kiba shong hapdeng ki cherubim .

en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua  ; upon one stone shall be seven eyes : behold , I will engrave the graving thereof , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .
kha: Nga buh ha khmat jong u Joshua ïa uwei u maw uba don hynñiew tylli ki dong . Ngan shniah ka jingthoh halor jong u bad ha ka shi sngi ngan shim noh ïa ka pop jong kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ha khmih u maw uba nga la buh ha khmat u Joshua u la don hynriew tylli ki khmat: ha khmih , ngan sa thoh ia ka jingtep jong ka , ong U Trai jong ki paid , bad ngan weng noh ia ka jingbymhok jong kata ka ri ha kawei ka sngi .

en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword , from the famine , and from the pestilence  ; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan shah katto katne ngut na ki ban lait im na ka thma , ka  nemsniew , bad na ki jingpang , khnang ba hangta hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kin sngewthuh haduh katno kiba ijli ki long ki jingleh jong ki bad kin pdiang ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ngan iehnoh katto katne ngut ki briew na ka waitlam, na ka jingkyrduh bam, bad na ka jingpang ; ba kin pynbna ia ki jingleh bymman jong ki baroh hapdeng ki nongwei ha kaba ki wan ; bad kin tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .
kha: Uta u paidbah u ïawan sha u Moses bad u ong ,  Ngi la leh pop haba ngi la kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ïa phi ruh . Mynta to duwai ha U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki bseiñ .  Kumta u Moses u la duwai na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki briew ki la wan sha u Moses bad ki la ong: Ngi la leh pop, namar ngi la kren pyrshah ia U Trai, bad pyrshah ia me to duwai ha U Trai, ba un weng noh ia ki bsein na ngi . U Moses u la duwai na ka bynta ki briew .

en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .
kha: namar u long u shakri jong U Blei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew , te to sheptieng ïa u , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka long kaba dei . U long u shakri jong U Blei bad u pyntreikam ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar u long u nongshakri U Blei ha me na ka bynta ka jingbha . Hynrei lada me leh ia kaba sniew, to tieng; namar um ju shah ia ka waitlam khlem da donkam: namar u long u nongshakri U Blei, u nongpynshitom bein ban pyntreikam ia ka jingbitar ia uta uba leh sniew .

en: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed  ; and he reared up altars for Baal , and made a grove , as did Ahab king of Israel  ; and worshipped all the host of heaven , and served them .
kha: U tei pat ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ïa kiba u Hesekaïah u kpa jong u , u la pynjot ; u la tei ki duwan ban mane ïa u Baal bad thaw ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , kumba u Ahab u syiem Israel u la leh . U Manasseh u la mane ruh ïa ki khlur .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta u la tei pat ia ki jaka ba jrong kiba u Hesekaiah u kpa jong u u la pynjot ia u Baal bad u la pynmih ia ki jingbam na ka bynta u Baal bad u la shna ia u phlang kumba u Ahab u la leh ia u syiem Israel baroh u la mane ia ki .

en: And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .
kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingma kaba khraw , namar ki briew jong u kiba la sngewkthang haba ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa u ; hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la sngewsih shibun eh namar ki briew ki la kren bein ia u, namar ka mynsiem jong ki briew baroh ka la sngewsih , uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong u: hynrei u Dabid u la pynshlur ia lade ha U Trai U Blei jong u .

en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .
kha: Lada ka kti lane ka kjat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to ot noh bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti lane ka kjat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki kti bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka ding bymjukut .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata lada ka kti jong me ne ka kjat jong me ka pynsngewsih ia me, ot noh ia ki bad bret noh ia ki na me: ka kham bha ia me ban rung sha ka jingim kaba sahkut ne kaba sahkut, ban ia kaba don ar tylli ki kti ne ar tylli ki kjat ban shah bret ha ka ding bymjukut .

en: And he provided the first part for himself , because there , in a portion of the lawgiver , was he seated  ; and he came with the heads of the people , he executed the justice of the  Lord  , and his judgments with Israel .
kha: Ki shim ïa ka jaka kaba bha tam na ka bynta ïa lade , Ïa ka bynta u nongïalam , la ai ha ki . Ki la kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum U  Trai Haba ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ïalum shi jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pynbiang ia ka bynta kaba nyngkong na ka bynta lade, namar hangta, ha ka bynta jong u nongthaw ain, u la shong ; bad u la wan ryngkat bad ki khlieh jong ki briew , u la pyndep ia ka hok U Trai bad ki jingbishar jong u bad ki Israel .

en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way , but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places : whosoever would , he consecrated him , and he became one of the priests of the high places .
kha: U syiem Jeroboam jong ka Israel um shym phai noh na ki lynti bymman jong u , hynrei u ïai jied ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing riewpaidbah ban shakri ha ki duwan kiba u la tei . U pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ïa uno uno kat uba kwah ban long u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka kam u Jeroboam um shym la wan phai na ka lynti kaba sniew jong u, hynrei u la pynlong biang ia u na ki lyngdoh jong ki briew kiba rit tam: uno uno uba mon , u la pynkyntang ia u , bad u la long uwei na ki lyngdoh jong ki jaka ba jrong .

en: But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth  ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell  ; and the ruin of that house was great .
kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba la tei ïa la ka ïing khlem da pynshong nongrim ; haba ka jingshlei um ka lynshop ïa kata ka ïing , ka khyllem shisyndon — bad katno ka jingkhyllem kaba shyrkhei kata ka la long !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei uta uba iohsngew bad u bym leh kumta u long kum u briew uba khlem nongrim u la tei ia ka iing halor ka khyndew ; pyrshah ia kaba ka wah ka la khih jur, bad mardor ka la hap ; bad ka jingjot jong kata ka iing ka la long kaba khraw .

en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the  Lord  , and hast not kept the commandment which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee ,
kha: bad u la kren jam ha u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah ,  U  Trai  u ong ba phi la lyndet ïa ka ktien U  Trai  , bad phim shym la leh kumba u la hukum ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la pyrta ia u briew jong U Blei uba wan na Judah, u da ong: Kumta u ong U Trai , Kumba me la leh khlem kohnguh ia ka shyntur U Trai , bad me khlem sumar ia ka hukum kaba U Trai U Blei jong me u la hukum ia me .

en: Therefore , behold , I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people , even a marvellous work and a wonder : for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish , and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid .
kha: Kumta ngan sa pynkyndit ïa ki da kawei hadien kawei pat ka jingtied kaba kim poi pyrkhat . Kito kiba stad kin kylla long ki bieit , bad baroh ka jingsian jong ki kan long lehnoh-ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata, ha khmih , ngan iaid shakhmat ban leh ia ka kam kaba phylla hapdeng kine ki briew, wat ia ka kam kaba phylla bad kaba phylla: namar ka jingstad jong ki riewstad jong ki kan jah noh bad ka jingsngewthuh jong ki riewstad jong ki kan sa buhrieh .

en: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood  ; and I will rain upon him , and upon his bands , and upon the many people that are with him , an overflowing rain , and great hailstones , fire , and brimstone .
kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa u da ka jingpang bad ka jingïa-umsnam . Ïa u  lapbah  lapsan bad u phria , ryngkat bad ka ding bad u kyndok , ngan theh noh ha u bad ha ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad halor kiba bun ki jaitbynriew kiba ïashah liang bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ngan kyrpad ia u da ka jingpang bad da ka snam ; bad ngan slap ia u, bad ha ki band jong u, bad ha ki briew kiba bun kiba don ryngkat bad u, u slap uba tuid palat, bad u maw ba heh .

en: Now it came to pass upon a day , that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over to the Philistines  garrison , that is on the other side . But he told not his father .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jonathan u ong ha u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia .  Hynrei u Jonathan um shym ïathuh ha la u kpa , u Saul
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia ha kawei ka sngi, ba u Jonathan u khun u Saul u la ong ha uta u samla uba phong ia ki tiar ialeh jong u, To wan, bad to ngin leit sha ki Philistia kiba don sha shiliang . Hynrei um shym la iathuh ia la u kpa .

en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water  ; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar : it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour , and an offering made by fire unto the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
kha: U ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa langbrot , bad u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ki kjat-dien da ka um , bad u thang ïa ka khlieh , ïa ka khleiñ bad ïa ki lyngkhot doh baroh ha ka duwan , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kane ka jingainguh thang ka long ka jingainguh bam , bad ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la sait ia ki bynta ba shapoh bad ki kjat ha ka um bad u Moses u la thang ia u langbrot baroh kawei halor ka jingbam ba thiang: ka la long ka jingknia thang ia ka jingsma kaba thiang, bad ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai; kumba U Trai u la hukum ia u Moses .

en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la kem pang na ka jait jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u leit jngoh ïa u .  Ko pa jong nga , pa jong nga !  u pyrta da kaba ïam .  Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Israel !
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la pang na ka jingpang jong u ha kaba u la iap . U Joash u syiem Israel u la wan hiar sha u , bad u la iam halor ka khmat jong u bad u la ong: Ko kpa jong nga, ko kpa jong nga, ka kali Israel bad ki kulai jong ka .

en: Thus saith thy Lord the  Lord  , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people , Behold , I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling , even the dregs of the cup of my fury  ; thou shalt no more drink it again :
kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ïada ïa phi bad u ong ,  Nga shim noh ïa ka khuri kaba nga la ai ha phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga . Phin ym hap ban dih shuh ïa ka waiñ kaba pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sheng sheng .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ong U Trai jong me U Trai bad U Blei jong me uba kyrpad ia ka daw jong ki briew jong u: Ha khmih nga la shim na ka kti jong me ia ka khuri kaba khih, wat ia ki khniang jong ka khuri jong nga; men ym dih shuh ia ka:

en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold , I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants  ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him : and what shall I do now unto thee , my son ?
kha: U Isaak u jubab ,  Nga la pynlong ïa u , u kynrad halor jong me , bad nga la pynlong ïa ki kur ki jait jong u ban long ki mraw jong u . Nga la ai ha u ïa u kew bad ka waiñ . Mynta ngam don ei ei shuh ba nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong me , ko khun ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Isaak u la jubab bad u la ong ha u Iso, Ha khmih nga la pynlong ia u u kynrad jong me, bad ki hynmen jong u baroh nga la ai ha u na ka bynta ki shakri ; bad da u kew bad ka wain nga la pynneh pynsah ia u bad nga leh aiu mynta ia me, ko khun jong nga ?

en: Hear another parable : There was a certain householder , which planted a vineyard , and hedged it round about , and digged a winepress in it , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country :
kha: To shahshkor sa kawei pat ka pharshi ,  U Jisu u la ong .  La don shisien u trai jaka uba la thung ka bri sohwaiñ , u la buh ka jingker sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ka jaka khñiot waiñ , bad u la tei ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha ki nongshimwai bad u la leit jingleit .
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia kawei pat ka pharshi: U don uwei u trai iing, uba la thung ia ka kper sohjew, bad u la ker sawdong ia ka sawdong , bad u la tih ia ka jaka dih wain ha ka , bad u la tei ia ka tower , bad u la pyllait ia ka sha ki nongrep , bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai:

en: And David saved neither man nor woman alive , to bring tidings to Gath , saying , Lest they should tell on us , saying , So did David , and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines .
kha: U Dabid u ju pynïap lut , shynrang bad kynthei , khnang ba yn ym don uba leit rah khubor sha Gath bad ïathuh aïu ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la leh . Kane ka long kaba u Dabid u la ju leh katba u dang sah ha ri Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u Dabid um shym la pynim ia u shynrang ne kynthei uba im, ban wanrah khubor sha Gath, da kaba ong , Khmih lynti ba kin iathuh ia ngi da kaba ong , Kumjuh ruh u Dabid bad kumjuh ruh ka rukom jong u ha ka por ba u dang sah ha ka ri Philistia .

en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
kha: Baroh ki bat ïa ki dongmusa ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa ki turoi ha la ki kti kamon , bad ki pyrta ,  Ka waitlam ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lai tylli ki kynhun ki la pynsawa ia ki turoi, bad ki la pynkhih ia ki sharak ha ki kti kadiang jong ki, bad ki turoi ha ki kti kadiang jong ki ban pynkhih da ka kti kadiang: bad ki la pyrta: Ka waitlam U Trai bad u Gideon .

en: And ye shall eat neither bread , nor parched corn , nor green ears , until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
kha: Wat bam na uta u kew thymmai , la uba dang im , ne uba la sdieh pyrthiew , ne uba la pynlong kpu , tad haduh ba phi la wallam ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh pateng la pateng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin ym bam ia u kpu, ne u kew ba la tyrkhong, ne ki shkor kiba jyrngam, haduh kajuh ka sngi ba phi la wanrah ia ka jingainguh ha U Blei jong phi: kan long ka ain junom ha ki pateng jong phi baroh .

en: Behold , I am against thee , O destroying mountain , saith the  Lord  , which destroyest all the earth : and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and roll thee down from the rocks , and will make thee a burnt mountain .
kha: Ko Babilonia pha long kum u lumbah uba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long u nongshun jong pha . Ngan shim noh ïa pha , pynmadan ïa pha ha ka khyndew , bad ieh ïa pha ha u dpei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih nga long pyrshah ia me, ko lum ba pynjot, ong U Trai, uba pynjot ia ka khyndew baroh kawei: bad ngan pynkhih ia ka kti jong nga halor me, bad ngan pynkhih ia me na ki mawsiang, bad ngan pynlong ia me u lum ba la thang .

en: He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .
kha: U long kum u briew uba , ha kaba tei ïa la ka ïing , u la tih jylliew bad u la pynshong nongrim halor u mawsiang . Ka wah ka la shlei bad ka la lynshop ïa kata ka ïing hynrei kam lah ban pynkhih ïa ka , namar la shna bha ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U long kum u briew uba la tei ia ka iing, bad u la tih jylliew, bad u la buh ia ka nongrim ha u maw: bad haba ka jingshlei um ka la mih , ka wah ka la khih jur ha kata ka iing , bad kam lah ban pynkhih ia ka: namar la pynshong nongrim ia ka ha u maw .

en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
kha: un leit sha kata ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u  langsohmoh bad un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong kata ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un leit sha ka jaka bam kaba don ha khmat U Trai, bad un shim ia ka snam jong u masi bad na ka snam jong u blang bad un buh ia ka ha ki bniat jong ka jaka bam sawdong .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wat sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u , ïa ki briew jong u baroh , bad ïa ka ri jong u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses: Wat tieng ia u: namar nga la aiti ia u ha ka kti jong me, bad ki briew jong u baroh, bad ka ri jong u baroh kawei bad me dei ban leh ia u kumba me la leh ia u ha u syiem jong ki Amorites uba shong ha Heshbon .

en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )
kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba tip ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to iohsngew ha bneng ia ka jaka shong jong me, bad to map, bad to leh, bad to ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum ki lynti jong u, uba me tip ; (nam ma me, wat tang ma me, me tip ia ki dohnud jong ki khun ki briew baroh ; )

en: And now , saith the  Lord  that formed me from the womb to be his servant , to bring Jacob again to him , Though Israel be not gathered , yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the  Lord  , and my God shall be my strength .
kha: Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U  Trai  u la thung ïa nga ; u la pynlong ïa nga u shakri jong u ban wallam pat ïa ki briew jong u , ban wallam pat ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba la saphriang kylleng . U  Trai  u ai ha nga ka burom ; u long u tyllong jong ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mynta , ong U Trai uba la thaw ia nga na ka kpoh ban long u shakri jong u, ban wanrah biang ia u Jakob ha u , Wat la ki Israel kim shym la ialum lang hynrei ngan long uba donburom ha khmat U Trai bad U Blei jong nga un long ka bor jong nga .

en: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years , so that the days of his years be many , and his soul be not filled with good , and also that he have no burial  ; I say , that an untimely birth is better than he .
kha: Ngi lah ban don shispah ngut ki khun bad ban im slem , hynrei kam pher haduh katno ngi im , lada ngim ïoh ïa la ka bynta jong ka jingsngewkmen bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingontep kaba donburom , te nga ong ba kham bha u khunlung uba la kha ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u briew u kha shispah ngut ki khun, bad u im bun snem, khnang ba ki sngi jong u kin long kiba bun, bad ka mynsiem jong u kan ym dap da ka jingbha, bad ruh ba um don ka jingtep ; nga ong, ba ka jingkha khlem por ka kham bha ban ia u .

en: Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :
kha: To sngap ïa kane , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kaba pyrkhat ba pha shongshngain bad sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw kum U Blei — ba ym don mano mano pat kum ma pha . Pha pyrkhat ba da lei lei phan ym long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata to sngap mynta ia kane, me uba la shah ai ha ki jingsngewbha, uba shong khlem da pyrkhat, uba ong ha ka dohnud jong me, nga long, bad ym don uwei pat nalor jong nga; ngan ym shong kum ka riewkynthei, lymne ngan ym tip ia ka jingduh noh ia ki khun:

en: Well reported of for good works ; if she have brought up children , if she have lodged strangers , if she have washed the saints  feet , if she have relieved the afflicted , if she have diligently followed every good work .
kha: Nalor kata ka dei ban long kaba la shongkurim tang shisien bad donnam ha ki kam babha : Ka briew kaba la pynsan pynrangbah bha ïa la ki khun , kaba pdiang ïa ki nongwei ha ka ïing jong ka , kaba leh ïa ki kam rit na ka bynta ki parabangeit , kaba ïarap ïa ki briew kiba don ha ka jingjynjar , bad kaba aiti ïa lade ha kaba leh ïa kaba bha .
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh bha ia ki kam kiba bha lada ka la pynsan ia ki khun ki ksiew, lada ka la leit phai noh ia ki kjat riewkhuid, lada ka la pynjem ia kiba la shah pynshitom bein, lada ka la bud ryntih ia kawei pa kawei ka kam kaba bha.

en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel , even of all the mighty men of wealth , of each man fifty shekels of silver , to give to the king of Assyria . So the king of Assyria turned back , and stayed not there in the land .
kha: U Menahem u ïoh ïa ka pisa na kiba riewspah ka Israel da kaba pynbor ïa uwei pa uwei ban noh synñiang sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa . Te u Tiglath Pileser u leit phai pat sha la ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U Menahem u la shim ia ka pisa jong ki Israel, wat na ki riewshlur baroh, na uwei pa uwei u briew sanphew sekel rupa, ban ai sha u syiem Assyria . Kumta u syiem Assyria u la phai noh sha ka ri .

en: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture , but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures ? and to have drunk of the deep waters , but ye must foul the residue with your feet ?
kha: Don na phi ki bym hun ban ïoh bam ïa u phlang uba shngiam tam ; phi da kyrdem wat ïa kaei kaba phim bam ! Phi dih ïa ka um kaba sngur bad phi da pynjngut ïa kata kaba phim dih !
translated_en_to_kha: Ka long kaba rit ia phi ban bam ia ka jaka ri jingri kaba bha , hynrei phi dei ban pynkhih da ki kjat jong phi ia ki jingbam ba sah jong phi ? bad ban dih ia ki um kiba jylliew , hynrei phi dei ban pynkhuid ia ka jingsah da ki kjat jong phi ?

en: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?
kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam , ha kiba ki la buh ban khmih ïa ka kam . Ki la dawa ,  Balei ba phim shym shna katjuh ki maw-it kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ophisar jong ki khun Israel kiba ki nongtrei jong u Pharaoh ki la buh halor jong ki, ki la shah shoh bad ki la dawa , Balei phim shym la pyndep ia ka kam jong phi ha kaba shna nar hynnin ka sngi bad mynta ka sngi ?

en: And he took his staff in his hand , and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in a shepherd s bag which he had , even in a scrip  ; and his sling was in his hand : and he drew near to the Philistine .
kha: U shim ïa la u diengduh bad u tam san tylli ki maw kiba jlih na ka wahduid bad u thep ïa ki ha ka pla kieng jong u . Lem bad ka jingshat maw ha kti , u tur ban ïakynduh ïa u Goliath .
translated_en_to_kha: U la shim ia u diengduh jong u ha ka kti jong u, bad u la jied ia u san tylli ki maw kiba jem na ka wah, bad u la buh ia ki ha ka pla nongap langbrot kaba u don, wat ha ka jingthoh ; bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka la don ha ka kti jong u: bad u la leit shajan u Philistia .

en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead : for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest . So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .
kha: Katto katne ngut ki Arab ki la leit lute bad pynïap ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoram lait noh u Ahasaïah , uba khatduh . Te mynta ki briew ka Jerusalem ki thung ïa u Ahasaïah kum u syiem ba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshong shnong jong ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ia u Ahasaiah u khun ba rit tam jong u ha ka jaka jong u: namar ka kynhun ki briew kiba wan ryngkat bad ki nong Arab sha ka jaka sah ki la pyniap ia kiba heh tam baroh . Kumta u Ahasaiah u khun jong u Jehoram u la synshar .

en: And it came to pass , when I prophesied , that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then fell I down upon my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel ?
kha: Katba nga dang ïathuhlypa , u Pelataïah u la kyllon ïap . Nga la rynsied pyllup ïa lade ha khyndew bad pyrta jam ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Hato men pynïap ïa uwei uwei baroh ba dang sah ha Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba nga la iathuhlypa, ba u Pelatiah u khun u Benaiah u la iap . Nangta nga la hap ha ka khmat jong nga bad nga la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam bad nga la ong: Ah Trai Blei ! hato me pynlong ia ka jingkut kaba pura jong ki Israel kiba sah ?

en: And what he did unto the army of Egypt , unto their horses , and to their chariots  ; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you , and how the  Lord  hath destroyed them unto this day  ;
kha: Phi la ïohi kumno U  Trai  u la pynduh lut ïa kynhun ïapom ki nong Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali thma jong ki , da kaba pynngam jyllop ïa ki ha ka Duriaw Basaw mynba ki beh nadien jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kaei kaba u la leh ia ki shipai Ijipt, ia ki kulai jong ki bad ia ki kali jong ki; kumno u la pynlong ia ka um jong ka duriaw Basaw ban tuid ia ki katba ki dang beh ia phi, bad kumno U Trai u la pynjot ia ki haduh kine ki sngi;

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Smite with thine hand , and stamp with thy foot , and say , Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel ! for they shall fall by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence .
kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Khyrwait ïa la ki kti ! kyrdem ïa la ki kjat ! kyang da ka jingsngewsih namar ki jingsniew baroh , kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki Israel ki la leh . Kin ïap ha ka thma , da ka  nemsniew bad da ka jingpang .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai Blei u la ong da ka kti jong me, bad u la ong: Alas na ka bynta ki jingleh bymman baroh jong ka iing Israel ! namar kin hap da ka waitlam, da ka jingkyrduh bam bad da ka jingpang khlam .

en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .
kha: U syiem Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria bad kem ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi un sa khih da ka jingkhriat, bad un wan shabar bad un ialeh bad u, wat bad u syiem jong ka ri Sepngi: bad un buh ia u paidbah uba bun; hynrei ia u paidbah yn ai ha ka kti jong u .

en: Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , while he was zealous for my sake among them , that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy .
kha: Namar kaei kaba u Phinehas u la leh , ngam bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel . U kyntait ban shah ïa ka jingmane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang ïa nga , bad namar kata ngam shym la pynjot ïa ki wat haba nga la bitar .
translated_en_to_kha: U Phinehas u khun u Eleasar u khun u Aaron u lyngdoh u la pynphai noh ia ka jingbitar jong nga na ki khun Israel , katba u dang sngewsih na ka bynta jong nga hapdeng jong ki , ba ngam shym la bam ia ki khun Israel ha ka jingsngewsih jong nga .

en: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah : and she sent and called Jacob her younger son , and said unto him , Behold , thy brother Esau , as touching thee , doth comfort himself , purposing to kill thee .
kha: Hynrei haba ka Rebekka ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingthmu jong u Iso , ka la phah khot ïa u Jakob bad ka ong ,  To shahshkor , u Iso u hynmen jong me u thmu ban siew kylliang bad ban pynïap ïa me .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia kine ki ktien jong u Iso u khun rangbah jong ka la iathuh ha ka Rebeka: bad ka la phah bad khot ia u khun rit jong ka, bad ka la ong ha u: Ha khmih u hynmen jong me u Iso, haba u ktah ia me, u pyntngen ia lade, da kaba thmu ban pyniap ia me .

en: And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .
kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad kumta u la shah ïa ki Philistia bad ïa u syiem Moab bad ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai ka nongbah Hasor , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ban jop ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la klet noh ia U Trai U Blei jong ki, u la die noh ia ki ha ka kti jong u Sisera, u rangbah shipai jong ka Hazor bad ha ka kti jong ki Philistia bad ha ka kti jong u syiem u Moab bad ki la ialeh pyrshah ia ki .

en: And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .
kha: Mynba u Moses u wan hiar na u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ namar ba u la ïakren bad U  Trai  ; hynrei um tip satia ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Moses u la wan hiar na u lum Sinai ryngkat bad ki ar tylli ki miej jong ka jingsakhi ha ka kti jong u Moses, haba u la wan hiar na u lum, ba u Moses um shym la sngewsih ba ka sniehdoh jong ka khmat jong u ka la shai katba u dang iakren bad u .

en: According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
kha: Ha kato ka sngi mynba phi ïalumlang ha u Lum Sinai , phi la kyrpad ba phim kwah ban ïohsngew shuh ïa ka sur U  Trai  , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha kaba u don , namar ba phi sheptieng ïoh phi ïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Kat kum kata baroh kaba me kwah na U Trai U Blei jong me ha ka por jong ka jingiaseng , da kaba ong , Wat iohsngew shuh ia ka sur U Trai U Blei jong nga , lymne wat iohsngew ia kane ka ding kaba khraw shuh shuh ba ngan ym iap .

en: Thou shalt surely give him , and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him : because that for this thing the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thy works , and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto .
kha: Ai ha u da ka mon sngewbha bad khlem da khñium , te U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ki kam jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Me dei ban ai ia u, bad ka dohnud jong me kan ym sngewsih haba me ai ha u: namar ba na ka bynta kane ka jingleh U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha ki kam jong me baroh, bad ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me buh ia ka kti jong me ha ka .

en: And they arose out of Midian , and came to Paran : and they took men with them out of Paran , and they came to Egypt , unto Pharaoh king of Egypt  ; which gave him an house , and appointed him victuals , and gave him land .
kha: Ki mihnoh na Midian bad ki leit sha Paran , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ïasoh lang bad ki . Nangta ki leit sha Ijipt bad sha u syiem uba la ai ïa u Hadad katto katne ka jaka bad ka ïing bad u pynbiang bam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la mih na Madian, bad ki la poi ha Paran: bad ki la leit sha Ijipt, u Pharaoh syiem Ijipt ha ka ri Ijipt .
