en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kaba long ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Solomon u phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki briew jong u ki Israel , ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew jong u bnai kaba hynriew u la phah noh ia ki briew sha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki, da kaba kmen bad sngewbha ha ka dohnud na ka bynta ka jingbha kaba U Trai u la pyni ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon bad ha ki Israel jong u .

en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot uba ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U  Trai  , bad ka jingiwbih jong ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pat u langbrot men knia ha ka por janmiet bad men leh ia kata kat kum ka jingainguh bam mynstep bad kat kum ka jingainguh dih jong ka, na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang, ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai .

en: But when I speak with thee , I will open thy mouth , and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; He that heareth , let him hear  ; and he that forbeareth , let him forbear : for they are a rebellious house .
kha: Nangta haba nga kren biang ïa me bad ai biang ha me ïa ka bor ban kren , men ïathuh ïa ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Don na ki , ki ban sngap , hynrei don na ki , ki bym leh salia ïa me , naba ki long ka jaitbynriew jong ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba nga kren bad me , ngan plie ia ka shyntur jong me bad me phin ong ha ki: Kumta u Trai Blei; Uta uba iohsngew, to un iohsngew; bad uta uba sngap jar, to un iehnoh: namar ki long ka iing kaba leh pyrshah .

en: And they gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the  Lord  , and fasted on that day , and said there , We have sinned against the  Lord . And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .
kha: Kumta baroh ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tong ïa ka um bad ki theh ïa ka kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  bad ki shahjingit baroh shi sngi . Ki ong ,  Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .  Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ia lum lang ha Mizpa, bad ki la theh ia ka ha khmat U Trai, bad ki la shah jingit ha kata ka sngi bad ki la ong hangta , Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ia U Trai . U Samuel u la bishar ia ki khun Israel ha Mizpa .

en: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things , which David the king , and the chief fathers , the captains over thousands and hundreds , and the captains of the host , had dedicated .
kha: U Shelomith bad ki dkhot ka longïing jong u ki dei peit ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh ba la pynkyntang sha U Blei da u syiem Dabid , ki khlieh jong ki longïing , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , bad ki rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai .
translated_en_to_kha: Kaba u Shelomith bad ki hynmen jong u ki long halor ki spah jong kiei kiei kiba la aiti lut, kiba u syiem u Dabid bad ki kpa tymmen ki la aiti lut .

en: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;
kha: U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasyriem thik bad ka dur U Blei hi , uba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jong u . Hadien ba u la ïohpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki pop u khunbynriew , u la shong ha bneng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor Tam .
translated_en_to_kha: Uba long ka jingshai jong ka burom jong u, bad ka dur ba paw jong ka jinglong jong u, bad kaba pynskhem ia kiei kiei baroh da ka ktien jong ka bor jong u, haba u la pynkhuid hi dalade ia ki pop jong ngi, u la shong ha ka liang kadiang jong ka Jingbhabriew ha jrong;

en: And he removed from thence , and digged another well  ; and for that they strove not : and he called the name of it Rehoboth  ; and he said , For now the  Lord  hath made room for us , and we shall be fruitful in the land .
kha: U la kynriah noh nangta bad tih ïa kawei pat ka pukri . Ym shym don jingïakajia shuh ïa kata , kumta u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  Ka Jinglaitluid .  U ong ,  Mynta te U  Trai  u la ai jinglaitluid ïa ngi ban shong ban sah ha kane ka jaka , bad ngin sa nang roi ha kane ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh nangta, bad u la tih sa kawei pat ka thliew ; bad namar kata kim shym la iaid: bad u la khot ia ka kyrteng jong ka Rehoboth ; bad u la ong: Mynta U Trai u la ai jaka ia ngi, bad ngin long kiba seisoh ha ka ri .

en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat : because he hath nothing left him in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates .
kha: Wat u briew uba jem tam ka dohnud uba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , un poi ha ka kutlad ha ka por ba u shah kerkut , kat ban da bam ïa la ki khun namar ba um don kawei pat ka jait jingbam . Un ym ai ei ei wat ïa la u para ne ka tnga kaba u ieit ne ïa la ki khun kiba dang don bad u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta un ym ai ei ei ia u khun jong u uba un bam: namar um don ei ei kaba sah ha ka jingshah set bad ha ka jingjynjar , ha kaba ki nongshun jong me kin pynshitom ia me ha ki khyrdop jong me baroh .

en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded : they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long ki bymdonbor ; ki long kiba khaw-eit bad sah lyngngoh . Ki long kum u phlang ha ka madan ne ki ñiut kiba san halor tnum haba ka lyer khluit na mihngi ka shoh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki nongshong shnong jong ki ki long kiba rit ka bor , ki la sngewsih bad sngewsih: ki la long kum ki phlang lyngkha , bad kum u jingthung ba jyrngam , kum u phlang ha ki iing , bad kum u kew u la bthei shuwa ba un san .

en: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law , Blessed be he of the  Lord  , who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead . And Naomi said unto her , The man is near of kin unto us , one of our next kinsmen .
kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u Boas !  ka Naomi ka pyrta .  U  Trai  borabor u bat ïa la ki kular ha kiba im bad kiba ïap !  Bad ka ong shuh shuh ,  Uta u briew u dei u ba-ha-ïing uba jan eh jong ngi , uwei na kito kiba kitkhlieh ban ri sumar ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Naomi u la ong ha ka khun jong ka ha ka ain , To long uba la kyrkhu ia u na U Trai, uba khlem iehnoh ia ka jingbha jong u ha kiba im bad ha kiba iap . Bad u Naomi u la ong ha ka , Uta u briew u long uba hajan jong ngi, uwei na ki jaitbynriew kiba hadien jong ngi .

en: And there came a man from Baal–shalishah , and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits , twenty loaves of barley , and full ears of corn in the husk thereof . And he said , Give unto the people , that they may eat .
kha: Ha kawei ka por , u briew u la wan na Baal Shalishah , u da wanrah ïa u Elisha arphew tylli ki kpu ba la shet na u barli uba nyngkong ba la ot ha kata ka snem , bad katto katne ki sohkew ba dang shu ot . U Elisha u ong ïa u shakri jong u ban ai bam ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa da kane ,
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew na Baalshalishah u la wanrah ia u briew jong U Blei, arphew tylli ki kpu barli bad ki shkor kew ba pura ha ka sniehdoh jong ka . Bad u la ong: Ai ha ki briew ba kin bam .

en: And he answered , Thou shalt not smite them : wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow ? set bread and water before them , that they may eat and drink , and go to their master .
kha: U jubab ,  Em ! ym dei wat ïa ki shipai kiba me la ïohkem ha ka jingïaleh mem dei ban pynïap . Ai ïa ki katto katne ban bam bad dih , bad ieh kin leit phai sha la u syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la jubab , Wat shoh ia ki: hato me la shoh ia kito kiba me la shim da ka waitlam bad da ka bow jong me ? buh ia u kpu bad ka um ha khmat jong ki , ba kin bam bad dih bad leit sha u kynrad jong ki .

en: But even a whole month , until it come out at your nostrils , and it be loathsome unto you : because that ye have despised the  Lord  which is among you , and have wept before him , saying , Why came we forth out of Egypt ?
kha: hynrei baroh shi bnai , haduh ba kan da mihnoh shabar na ki shkor jong phi , haduh ba phin da sngewjli ïa ka . Kane kan jia namar ba phi la kyntait ïa U  Trai  uba don hangne hapdeng jong phi bad ba phi la ïakhñium ha u ba phim dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Ijipt .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei wat tang shibnai baroh kawei, haduh ba kan da mih ha ki shyntur jong phi, bad ka long kaba sngewsih ia phi: namar ba phi la leh bein ia U Trai uba don hapdeng jong phi, bad phi la iam ha khmat jong u, da kaba ong: Balei ngi la mih na Ijipt ?

en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan shim ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar bajrong bad kdiah ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai Blei ; Ngan shim ruh ia ka tnat kaba jrong tam jong u sohjew uba jrong , bad ngan buh ia ka ; ngan ot noh na jrong jong ki tnat kiba rit jong u , bad ngan thung ia ka ha u lum uba jrong bad uba pawnam:

en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans , The thing is gone from me : if ye will not make known unto me the dream , with the interpretation thereof , ye shall be cut in pieces , and your houses shall be made a dunghill .
kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la kut jingmut ba phi dei ban ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad nangta ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Lada phim lah , ngan phah tar ïa ka kti ka kjat jong phi kawei na kawei pat bad ngan pynlong ïa ki ïing jong phi ka kynton ki jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la jubab bad u la ong ha ki Khaldes: lada phim pyntip ia nga ia ka jingphohsniew, ryngkat bad ka jingbatai jong ka, phin sa shah ot noh bad ki iing jong phi kin long ki dewbilat .

en: And Saul sent messengers to take David : and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as appointed over them , the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul , and they also prophesied .
kha: Ki ïohi ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ba ki ïashad bad ki ïarisa , lem bad ïa u Samuel uba u ïalam na khmat . Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wan hiar tyllep ha ki rangbah jong u Saul , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor ban shim ia u Dabid : bad haba ki la iohi ia ka kynhun ki nongiathuhlypa ba ki iathuhlypa, bad u Samuel u la ieng kumba la buh halor jong ki, U Mynsiem U Blei u la don halor ki nonglam khubor jong u Saul, bad ki ruh ki la iathuhlypa .

en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .
kha: Uta uba khat ïa u dpei u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïaid ryntih ka long kaba dei ha ki por ki ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba lum ia ka dewbilat jong ka masi un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un long u bymkhuid haduh ka por janmiet: bad kan long ha ki khun Israel bad ha u nongwei uba sah hapdeng jong ki, na ka bynta ka ain junom .

en: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations , and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her : for they have refused my judgments and my statutes , they have not walked in them .
kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong nga , ka da pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kiwei pat ki ri , ka la long bymkohnguh kham palat ïa ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka . Ka Jerusalem ka la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga bad kam kohnguh satia ïa ki aiñ jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la pynkylla ia ki jingbishar jong nga sha ka jingsniew kaba kham palat ban ia ki jaitbynriew , bad ki ain jong nga kham palat ban ia ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka: namar ki la kyntait ia ki jingbishar jong nga bad ki ain jong nga , kim shym la iaid ha ki .

en: So Amnon lay down , and made himself sick : and when the king was come to see him , Amnon said unto the king , I pray thee , let Tamar my sister come , and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat at her hand .
kha: Kumta u Amnon u leit thiah bad u la leh mynleh kum uba pang . U Syiem Dabid u la leit jngoh ïa u , bad u Amnon u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i Tamar ban wan bad shet katto katne ki kpu hangne ha kaba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad nangta in ai bam ïa nga da ma i hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Amnon u la thiah , bad u la pang: bad haba u syiem u la wan ban iohi ia u , u Amnon u la ong ha u syiem , nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ka Tamar jong nga kan wan, bad to ai ba ngan bam ar tylli ki cake ha khmat jong nga, ba ngan bam ha ka kti jong ka .

en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back , that they should not go with him to battle , fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Beth–horon , and smote three thousand of them , and took much spoil .
kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ki shipai Israel kiba u Amasaïah um shym la shah ba kin leit sha ka thma bad u ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Judia hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Beth Horon , ki la pynïap lai hajar ngut ki rangbah , bad ki la kurup shibun ki mar lute .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shipai kiba u Amasaiah u la phah biang, ba kim dei ban leit thma bad u, ki la hap ha ki shnong Judah, naduh ka Samaria haduh Bethhoron, bad ki la shah shoh lai hajar ngut na ki, bad ki la shim ia ka jinglute kaba bun .

en: And cast him into the bottomless pit , and shut him up , and set a seal upon him , that he should deceive the nations no more , till the thousand years should be fulfilled : and after that he must be loosed a little season .
kha: U angel u la bret ïa u sha ka  liewlong khlem trai , u la khang tala ïa ka , bad u la pynskhem ïa ka , khnang ba un ym lah ban shukor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew tad haduh ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut . Hadien kata ïa u dei ban pyllait shipor .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la bret ia u ha ka thliew kaba khlem tduh, bad u la khang ia u, bad u la buh ia ka muhor halor jong u, ba un ym shukor shuh ia ki jaitbynriew, haduh ba ki hajar snem kin da pyndep: bad hadien kata u dei ban shah pyllait noh khyndiat por .

en: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites , which dwelt on the other side Jordan  ; and they fought with you : and I gave them into your hand , that ye might possess their land  ; and I destroyed them from before you .
kha: Nangta nga la wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Amor , kiba shong ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan . Ki la ïaleh ïa phi , hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki . Phi la knieh ïa ka jaka jong ki , bad nga la pynjot ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga la wanrah ia phi sha ka ri jong ki Amorites kaba shong sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ki la ialeh pyrshah ia phi: bad nga la aiti ia ki ha ka kti jong phi, ba phin ioh ia ka ri jong ki ; bad nga la pynjot ia ki na khmat jong phi .

en: And her lord rose up in the morning , and opened the doors of the house , and went out to go his way : and , behold , the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house , and her hands were upon the threshold .
kha: Haba u tnga jong ka u khie ha kata ka step , bad haba u plie ïa ka jingkhang ban mih shabar ban leit noh , u lap ïa la ka tnga kliar ba ka thiah ha khmat jingkhang , ryngkat bad ki kti kiba kner sha kata ka jingkhang .
translated_en_to_kha: U kynrad jong ka u la ieng mynstep bad u la plie ia ki jingkhang jong ka iing bad u la leit shabar: bad ha khmih kata ka kynthei ka la hap ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing bad ki kti jong ka ki la don ha ka jingkhang .

en: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth , and thou shalt spread abroad to the west , and to the east , and to the north , and to the south : and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed .
kha: Kin man bun kum ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew . Kin pynïar ïa la u pud u sam ha ki liang baroh ; bad da me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u symbai jong me un long kum ka dewmet jong ka khyndew, bad me phin saphriang shaphang shathie bad shaphang shathie bad shaphang shathie: bad ha me bad ha u symbai jong me baroh ki longiing jong ka khyndew kin long kiba la kyrkhu .

en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter s clay : for shall the work say of him that made it , He made me not ? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it , He had no understanding ?
kha: Ki pynkylla khongpong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Kano kaba kham donkam , u nongthaw khiew ne ka dewbyrtha ? Hato lah mo ba kaei kaei kaba u briew u la thaw kan ong ha u ,  Phim shym la thaw ïa nga ?  Lane hato ka lah ban ong ha u ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi leh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid ka jingkylla jong phi shapoh kan long kum ka dewbilat: namar ka kam kan ong ia uta uba la thaw ia ka , Um shym la thaw ia nga ? lane kaei kaei kaba la pynlong ia ka kan ong shaphang uta uba la frame ia ka , Um don jingmut ei ei ?

en: But thou , Beth–lehem Ephratah , though thou be little among the thousands of Judah , yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel  ; whose goings forth have been from of old , from everlasting .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Bethlehem Ephrathah , pha long kaba rit tam na ki shnong ha Judah , hynrei na pha ngan pynmih ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki Israel , uba ka tynrai longïing jong u ka long na ki por mynbarim .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, Bethlehem Ephraham, wat la me long tang khyndiat eh napdeng ki hajar ngut ki Judah, hynrei na me un wan sha nga uba dei ban long u nongsynshar ha Israel ; uba ki jingleit jong u ki la long naduh mynshuwa .

en: But if ye say unto me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is not that he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ?
kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki bteng ,  Lane phin ïathuh ïa nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ka dei ki jaka mane ïa U  Trai  bad ki duwan kiba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot , haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha ka duwan ha Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada phi ong ha nga , Ngi shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi: hato uta u, uba ki jaka ba jrong bad ki jaka mane jong u u Hesekaiah u la weng noh ia u bad u la ong ha Judah bad Jerusalem , Phi dei ban mane ha khmat kane ka jaka mane ha Jerusalem ?

en: Lift up your eyes on high , and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number : he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might , for that he is strong in power  ; not one faileth .
kha: A to khmied sha ka sahit bneng ! Mano ba thaw ïa ki khlur ba phi ïohi ? Uta uba ïalam ïa ki shabar kum ka kynhun shipai , u tip katno ki don bad u khot ïa uwei uwei da ka kyrteng ! Ka bor jong u ka khraw katta katta — Ym don uwei na ki u ban jah noh .
translated_en_to_kha: Pynieng ia ki khmat jong phi sha jrong, bad ha khmih uba la thaw ia kine kiei kiei, kiba pynmih ia ki nongwan jong ki da ka jingbun: u khot ia ki baroh da ki kyrteng da ka jingkhraw jong ka bor jong u, namar ba u long uba khlain ha ka bor ; ym don kawei ruh ka jingduna .

en: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth–el came forth to Elisha , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the  Lord  will take away thy master from thy head to day ? And he said , Yea , I know it  ; hold ye your peace .
kha: Ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa kiba don hangta ki la leit sha u Elisha bad ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato phi tip ba U  Trai  un sa shim noh na phi ïa u kynrad jong phi ha kane ka sngi ?   Ho-oid , nga tip ,  u Elisha u jubab .  Hynrei to ngin ym ïakren shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa kiba don ha Betel ki la wan sha u Elisha bad ki la ong ha u , Me tip ba U Trai un weng noh ia u kynrad jong me na ka khlieh jong me ha ka sngi ? Bad u la ong: Hooid , nga tip ia kata; to sngap jar .

en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
kha: U Jeshua , u Lebi , lem bad ki khun shynrang bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka kur Henadad . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jeshua bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki hynmen jong u, u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u, ki khun shynrang jong u Judah, ki la ieng lang ha khmat ki nongtrei ha ka iing U Blei: ki khun shynrang jong u Hennadad, bad ki khun shynrang jong ki bad ki hynmen jong ki ki ki long ki Lebi .

en: And another angel came and stood at the altar , having a golden censer  ; and there was given unto him much incense , that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne .
kha: Uwei pat u angel , uba bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih kaba da ka ksiar , u la wan bad u la ïeng ha ka duwan . La ai ha u shikatdei ka jingiwbih ryngkat bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei baroh bad ban ai ïa ka halor ka duwan ksiar kaba ïeng ha khmat kata ka khet .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei pat u angel u la wan bad u la ieng ha ka jaka bam ksiar bad la ai ha u ia ka jingiwbih ksiar kaba bun , ba un ai ia ka da ki jingduwai jong ki riewkhuid baroh ha ka jaka bam ksiar kaba don ha khmat ka khet ksiar .

en: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken , saying , The two families which the  Lord  hath chosen , he hath even cast them off ? thus they have despised my people , that they should be no more a nation before them .
kha: Phi la ïohi kumno ba ki briew ki ïa-ong ba nga la kyntait noh ïa ki Israel bad Judah , ki ar tylli ki longïing kiba nga la jied ? Bad kumta ki khmih da ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa ki briew jong nga bad kim kheiñ shuh ïa ki kum ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat pyrkhat ia kaei kaba une u briew u la kren, da kaba ong , Ki ar tylli ki longiing kiba U Trai u la jied , u la bret noh wat ia ki ? kumta ki la leh bein ia ki briew jong nga , ba kim dei shuh ka jaitbynriew ha khmat jong ki .

en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong biang ha u Moses ,  Mynta ba me leit phai sha Ijipt , da kynmaw ban leh ha khmat u Pharaoh ïa ki kambah baroh kiba nga la ai ha me ïa ka bor ban leh . Hynrei ngan pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Moses, Haba me leit phai sha Ijipt, to peit ba me leh ia kita ki jingphylla baroh ha khmat u Pharaoh, kiba nga la buh ha ka kti jong me: hynrei ngan pynkhlain ia ka dohnud jong u, ba un ym pyllait ia ki briew .

en: Then he said , What title is that that I see ? And the men of the city told him , It is the sepulchre of the man of God , which came from Judah , and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth–el .
kha: Ka jingtep jongno katai ?  u kylli . Ki briew ka Bethel ki jubab ,  Ka dei ka jingtep jong u nongïathuhlypa uba la wan na Judah bad uba la ïathuhlypa ïa kine kiei kiei kiba phi la leh ha kane ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong: Kaei kata kaba nga iohi ? Ki briew jong ka shnong ki la iathuh ha u , Ka long ka jingtep jong u briew U Blei uba la wan na Judah bad u la pynbna ia kine kiei kiei kiba me la leh pyrshah ia ka jingknia jong u Bethel .

en: And every one that was in distress , and every one that was in debt , and every one that was discontented , gathered themselves unto him  ; and he became a captain over them : and there were with him about four hundred men .
kha: Ki briew kiba la shah banbeiñ lane kiba dap ram lane kiba kthang mynsiem ki la leit sha u , baroh ki don kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uwei pa uwei uba don ha ka jingeh, bad uwei pa uwei uba don ha ka ram, bad uwei pa uwei uba khlem sngewhun, u la lum ia lade ha u ; bad u la long u kapten halor jong ki: bad ki don bad u kumba saw spah ngut ki briew .

en: And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .
kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba la jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u kpa jong pha bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong ki briew jong u ki Israel . Bad ngan ïai shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u Michal: Ka la long ha khmat U Trai, uba la jied ia nga ha khmat u kpa jong me bad ha khmat ka iing jong u baroh: namarkata ngan ialehkai ha khmat U Trai .

en: And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .
kha: U jop thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki naduh Aroer haduh ka thain Minnith , baroh ki long arphew tylli ki nongbah , bad haduh Abel Keramim . Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew kaba jur , bad ki Ammon ki shahjop ha ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la shoh ia ki na Aroer, haduh ba me la poi ha Minith, wat ha ki arphew tylli ki shnong bad ha ka madan ki kper sohjew, da ka jingpyniap kaba khraw shibun . Kumta ki khun ki ksiew ki la shah pyndem ha khmat ki khun Israel .

en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , and your tithes , and heave offerings of your hand , and your vows , and your freewill offerings , and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks :
kha: Shata phi dei ban leit rah ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi , bad ïa ki jingainguh jong phi , ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi kular ïa U  Trai  , ïa ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi , bad ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hangta phin wanrah ia ki jingknia thang jong phi, bad ki jingknia jong phi, bad ki jingknia ba heh jong phi, bad ki jingkular jong phi, bad ki jingknia ba mon sngewbha jong phi, bad ki khun nyngkong jong phi bad ki langbrot jong phi:

en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .
kha: Hangta u pud u khun sha sepngi shaduh Asnoth Tabor , bad nangta sha Hukkok , da kaba kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaphang sepngi , bad ïa ka Jordan shaphang mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka rud duriaw ka phai shaphang sepngi sha Aznothtabor, bad ka mih nangta sha Hkkok, bad ka poi sha ka Zebulun shaphang shathie, bad ka poi sha Asher shaphang shathie, bad sha Judah shaphang ka Jordan shaphang ka sngi .

en: And it was so , that all that saw it said , There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day : consider of it , take advice , and speak your minds .
kha: Kat uba ïohi ïa ka u ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kane kaei kaei ! Ym pat ju jia mynno mynno kaba kum kane naduh ba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt ! Ngi dei ban leh ei ei na ka bynta kane ! Kan jia aïu hadien ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta , ba baroh kiba la iohi ia ka ki la ong: Ym shym la don kum kata ka kam kaba la leh ne iohi naduh ka sngi ba ki khun Israel ki la mih na ka ri Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi: pyrkhat ia ka, to shim jingmut bad kren ia ka jingmut jong phi .

en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day , even toward the place of which thou hast said , My name shall be there : that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place .
kha: Khmih halor kane ka Templ mynsngi bad mynmiet , kane ka jaka ha kaba me la jied ban mane ïa me . Shahshkor ïa nga haba nga phai ka khmat sha kane ka templ ban duwai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki khmat jong me kin plie sha kane ka iing miet bad sngi, wat sha ka jaka kaba me la ong: ba me sngap ia ka jingduwai kaba u shakri jong me un leh sha kane ka jaka .

en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger , and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst , and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them .
kha: Haba ki thngan , me ai kpu ïa ki na bneng , bad ka um na u mawsiang haba ki sliang . Me ong ïa ki ban shimti bad pynïaid ïa ka ri kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to ai ia ki ia u kpu na bneng na ka bynta ka jingkyrduh jong ki, bad to pynmih ia ka um na u maw na ka bynta ka jingthngan jong ki, bad kular ia ki ba kin leit rung ban ioh ia ka ri kaba me la kular ban ai ia ki .

en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .
kha: Lada ki briew ki la lait im na ki bor ba pynpyut jong ka pyrthei da ka jingtip jong ki ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi , bad nangta ki ngat biang bad shahjop ha ki , kum kita ki briew ki don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ha kaba kut ban ïa kaba ki la long ha kaba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada hadien ba ki la lait na ki jingpynjakhlia jong ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingtip ia U Trai bad U Nongpynim U Jisu Khrist , ki la shah pynkylla biang ha ka , bad ki la jop , kaba hadien ka kham sniew bad ki ban ia kaba sdang .

en: And his servants came near , and spake unto him , and said , My father , if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing , wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then , when he saith to thee , Wash , and be clean ?
kha: Ki shakri jong u ki leit sha u , bad ki ong ,  Ko kynrad , lada u nongïathuhlypa u la phah ïa phi ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba jwat , phin jin da la leh ïa ka . Mynta balei phim shu sait ïa lade , kumba u ong bad ban ïohkhiah ?
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shakri jong u ki la wan hajan bad ki la kren ha u bad ki la ong, ko kpa jong nga, lada u nongiathuhlypa u la bthah ia me ban leh ia kaei kaei kaba khraw, hato me ym shym la leh ia kata? katno ka kham bha, haba u ong ha me, Wash bad to long uba khuid ?

en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long khlem bor ; ki la sheptieng bad lyngngoh . Ki la long kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiut kiba san ha tnum haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki nongshong shnong jong ki ki long kiba rit bor, ki la sngewsih bad sngewsih ki long kum ki phlang lyngkha , bad kum u jingthung ba jyrngam , kum u phlang ha ki iing rit , bad kum u kew u la bthei shuwa ba un san .

en: O ye children of Benjamin , gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem , and blow the trumpet in Tekoa , and set up a sign of fire in Beth–haccerem : for evil appeareth out of the north , and great destruction .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Benjamin , to phet ban lait im ! Phet noh na Jerusalem ! Pynsawa ïa ka turoi ha Tekoa bad to thaw ka ding-ai-dak ha Beth Hakkherem . Ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot ki la wan artat na shatei .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko khun shynrang jong u Benjamin, to lum ia lade ban phet noh na pdeng ka Jerusalem, bad to pynsawa ia ka turoi ha Tekoa, bad to buh ia ka dak jong ka ding ha Betheshem: namar ka jingsniew ka paw na shaphang shathie bad ka jingpynjot kaba khraw .

en: Restore , I pray you , to them , even this day , their lands , their vineyards , their oliveyards , and their houses , also the hundredth part of the money , and of the corn , the wine , and the oil , that ye exact of them .
kha: Map noh ïa ki ram kiba ki shah ïa phi — ka pisa , u kew , ka waiñ lane ka umphniang Olib . Pynphai noh shisyndon sha ki ïa ki pynthor , ki bri sohwaiñ , ki khlaw Olib bad ki ïing !
translated_en_to_kha: To pynphai biang ia ki, nga kyrpad ia phi, wat ha kane ka sngi, ia ki jaka jong ki, ki kper sohjew jong ki, bad ki iing jong ki, bad ka shispah bynta jong ka pisa, bad na u kew, ka wain bad ka umphniang, ba phi shim na ki .

en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims , and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen : who took it , and went out .
kha: Uwei na kita ki kherub u buh ïa la ka kti ha ka ding kaba don hangta hapdeng jong ki , u la shim khyndiat ki rnga ding , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ki kti u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen . Uta u briew u la shim ïa kita ki rnga ding bad u la mihnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u cherub u la pynjrong ia la ka kti naduh pdeng ki cherub haduh ka ding kaba don hapdeng ki cherubim bad u la shim ia ka ha ki kti jong uta uba la phong da ka jain lin: uba la shim ia ka bad u la mih noh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , which giveth the sun for a light by day , and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night , which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar  ; The  Lord  of hosts is his name :
kha: U  Trai  u pynbiang ïa ka sngi ban pynshai mynsngi , ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban pynshai mynmiet . U pynkhih ïa ka duriaw bad pynlong ïa ka ban kyrhuh ; ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai uba ai ia ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingshai ha ka sngi , bad ki jingpynbeit jong u bnai bad ki khlur na ka bynta ka jingshai ha ka por miet , kaba phiah ia ka duriaw haba ki um jong ka ki khih ; U Trai jong ki paid u long ka kyrteng jong u:

en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
kha: Ka shadem jong phi kan kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . Man ka step phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka janmiet pat phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka step .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por mynstep me dei ban ong , Hato U Blei u la long wat la jan ! bad ha ka por mynstep me dei ban ong , Hato U Blei u la long mynstep ! namar ka jingtieng ia ka dohnud jong me da kaba me tieng, bad na ka bynta ka jingpeit jong ki khmat jong me kiba me iohi .

en: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth–el  ; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth–el : the words which he had spoken unto the king , them they told also to their father .
kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u nongïathuhlypa uba la tymmen uba shong ha Bethel . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki la wan ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u la leh ha Bethel ha kata ka sngi bad ïa kaei kaba u la kren ha u syiem Jeroboam .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta la shong uwei u nongiathuhlypa barim ha Bethesel ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la wan bad ki la iathuh ha u ia ki kam baroh kiba u briew U Blei u la leh ha kata ka sngi ha Bethesel: ki ktien kiba u la kren ha u syiem, ia ki ruh ki la iathuh ha u kpa jong ki .

en: But he said unto me , Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink , neither eat any unclean thing : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death .
kha: Hynrei u da ong ha nga ba ngan sa punkhun bad ïoh khun shynrang . U ong ïa nga ban nym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid , namar uta u khunlung un long uba yn pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir katba u dang im .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la ong ha nga: Ha khmih, me la pun khun bad me la kha khun shynrang bad mynta wat dih wain ne dih kyiad ba khlain, wat bam ia kaei kaei kaba khlem khuid: namar uta u khun un long u Nazarite ha U Blei naduh ka kpoh haduh ka sngi ba u iap .

en: Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .
kha: Un aiti noh ïa me bad ïa ki Israel ha ki Philistia . Lashai ka sngi ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa ïadon ryngkat bad nga , bad U  Trai  un aiti noh ruh ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ha ki Philistia .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata U Trai un aiti ruh ia ki Israel bad me ha ka kti jong ki Philistia: bad lashai me bad ki khun jong me kin long bad nga: U Trai ruh un aiti ia ka kynhun Israel ha ka kti jong ki Philistia .

en: All thy lovers have forgotten thee  ; they seek thee not  ; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy , with the chastisement of a cruel one , for the multitude of thine iniquity  ; because thy sins were increased .
kha: Baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong phi ki la klet noh ïa phi ; kim salia shuh ïa phi . Nga la tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u nongshun ; ka jingshah pynshitom jong phi ka la long kaba eh namar ki pop jong phi ki long kiba bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka long kaba khraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Baroh ki nongieit jong me ki la klet ia me ; kim wad ia me ; namar nga la pynmynsaw ia me da ka jingmynsaw jong u nongshun , da ka jingpynshitom bein ia u nongshun jong me; namar ka jingbun jong ka jingbymhok jong me ; namar ba ki pop jong me ki la nang kiew .

en: And , lo , he hath given occasions of speech against her , saying , I found not thy daughter a maid  ; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter s virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .
kha: U la kynnoh pynban ïa ka da kaba ong ba kam long shuh kaba sotti haba u shongkurim ïa ka . Hynrei kine ki long ki dak jong ka jinglong sotti ka khun jong nga ; khmih ïa ki jingbitsnam ha ka jingsiangthiah shongkurim !’
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, u la ai por ia ka, da kaba ong, Ngam shym la shem ia ka khun jong me ka shakri ; bad hynrei kine ki long ki dak jong ka jinglong kynthei jong nga . Bad kin sa pynphriang ia ka jain ha khmat ki rangbah jong ka shnong .

en: And next him were Eden , and Miniamin , and Jeshua , and Shemaiah , Amariah , and Shecaniah , in the cities of the priests , in their set office , to give to their brethren by courses , as well to the great as to the small :
kha: Ha kiwei pat ki nongbah ha kiba ki lyngdoh ki shong , la kyrshan jingïarap ha kane da kiwei ki Lebi : u Eden , Miniamin , Jeshua , Shemaïah , Amaraïah , bad u Shekanaïah . Ki sam ryntih ïa ka jingbam sha ki para Lebi kat kum ki kamram jong ki , bad ym kat kum ki kur .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad hadien jong u ki long u Eden, bad u Miniamin, bad u Shemaiah, u Amariah bad u Shecaniah, ha ki shnong ki lyngdoh, ha ka kam ba la buh jong ki, ban ai ha ki hynmen jong ki da ki jinghikai, bad kumjuh ruh ha kiba khraw kum kiba rit:

en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals , when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .
kha: ban pynbna ïa kane ka khubor ha uwei pa uwei ha Jerusalem ,  Nga kynmaw kumno phi la long kiba ïaineh mynba phi dang khynnah , kumno phi la ieit ïa nga mynba ngi dang shongkurim nyngkong ; phi la bud ïa nga lyngba ka ri shyiap , lyngba ka ri ka bym pat shym la thung jingthung .
translated_en_to_kha: Leit bad iam ha ki shkor jong ka Jerusalem, da kaba ong: Kumta u Trai nga kynmaw ia me, ka jingbha jong ka jinglong samla jong me, ka jingieit jong ki tdong jong me, haba me la leit bud ia nga ha ka ri khlaw, ha ka ri kaba ym shym la bet .

en: He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .
kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa tymmen uba na Bethel u ong ha u ,  Nga ruh nga dei u nongïathuhlypa kum ma phi , bad ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u angel u la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa phi sha ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phi .  Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u lamler .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha u , Nga long u nongiathuhlypa ruh kumba me long; bad u angel u la kren ha nga da ka ktien U Trai , u la ong: To wanrah biang ia u bad me shapoh iing jong me , ba un bam ia u kpu bad u dih um . Hynrei u la thiah ha u .

en: And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .
kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ka ,  Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don hapoh jong pha ; Phan sa kha ar jait ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki . Kawei kan kham khlaiñ ban ïa kawei pat , Kaba ha shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha ka , Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don ha ka kpoh jong me , bad ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kin iakhlad noh na ki bniat jong me ; bad uwei u briew un kham khlain ban ia kiwei pat ki briew ; bad u rangbah un shakri ia uba kham rit .

en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah : and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day , and made them an ordinance in Israel : and , behold , they are written in the lamentations .
kha: U Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa u thaw ïa ka jingrwai pangnud ïa u syiem Josaïah . Ka long ka rukom ha Israel na ka bynta ki nongrwai , kynthei bad shynrang , ban rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai haba ki ïambriew namar jong u . La shem ïa kane ka jingrwai ha ki jingrwai pangnud ba la lumlang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jeremaiah u la iam na ka bynta u Josiah : bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba rwai ki kren ia u Josiah ha ki jingrwai jong ki haduh kine ki sngi: bad, ha khmih, la thoh ia ki ha ki jingrwai .

en: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
kha: U angel u la jubab ,  U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wan ha pha , bad ka bor jong U Blei kan shong halor jong pha . Na kane ka daw , ïa i khunlung bakhuid yn khot U Khun U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel u la jubab bad u la ong ha ka: U Mynsiem Bakhuid un wan halor jong me bad ka bor jong Uba ha khlieh duh kan tap ia me: namarkata ruh ia kata ka jinglong bakhuid kaba la kha na me yn khot U Khun U Blei .

en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .
kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha ngi baroh , ‘ Ki khun ki kti jong phi , kiba dang lung palat ban tip ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kin rung sha kata ka ri — ki khun ki kti kiba phi ong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki , ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata ki khun rit jong phi kiba phi ong ba kin long ki mrad ba la bam bad ki khun jong phi kiba ha kata ka sngi kim don jingtip hapdeng ka jingbha bad ka jingsniew , kin leit shapoh hangta , bad ha ki ngan ai ia ka , bad kin don ia ka .

en: And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .
kha: Lada phi leh kumta , U  Trai  un khie bitar ïa phi . Un khang khop ïa u slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin ym mih shuh . Te phin sa ïap shen hangta , wat la kata ka khyndew kaba u ai ha phi ka long kaba seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nangta ka jingbitar jong U Trai ka la bthei pyrshah ia phi, bad u la khang ia ka bneng, ba ym don slap, bad ba ka ri kan ym ai soh ia u soh jong ka ; bad ba phin ym jah noh kloi na ka ri kaba bha kaba U Trai u ai ia phi .

en: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him , from among the children of Israel , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office , even Aaron , Nadab and Abihu , Eleazar and Ithamar , Aaron s sons .
kha: Khot ïa u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , u Nadab , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar . Pynkyrpang ïa ki na ki Israel khnang ba kin shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad to shim ia u Aaron u hynmen jong me bad ki khun shynrang jong u, na ki khun Israel, ba un shakri ia nga ha ka kam lyngdoh, wat u Aaron, u Nadab bad u Abihu, u Eleasar bad u Isar , ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron .

en: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
kha: Naba don ki briew ki bymriewblei hapdeng jong ngi , kiba la syntuid noh khlem poi pyrkhat , ki briew kiba la pynkylla ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi , khnang ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia , bad kiba kyntait ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi . La slem bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingpynrem kaba ki la ïohpdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ki don katto katne ki briew ki rung khlem da tip, kiba la shah pynrem ha kane ka jingpynrem kaba khlem akor, ki briew ki bym don Blei, ki pynkylla ia ka jingaiei U Blei jong ngi sha ka jinglong ba sniew, bad ki kyntait ia U Trai U Blei uba marwei bad U Trai jong ngi U Jisu Khrist .

en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .
kha: Shi bynta jong ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ha ki katto katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpa jong u Gilead , u dei u khun nyngkong jong u Manasseh bad u khla-ka-wait uba pawnam ; kumta ïa ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ruh shibun na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Manasseh ; namar u long u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph; namar u long u khun nyngkong jong u Manasseh: namar u long u briew uba ialeh thma, namarkata u don u Gilead bad u Basan .

en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .
kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrod , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kin pynjot ia ka ri Assyria da ka waitlam bad ka ri Nimrod ha ki jingkhang jong ka: kumta un pyllait im ia ngi na ka Assyria haba u wan shapoh ka ri jong ngi bad haba u iaid hapoh ki pud jong ngi .

en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle , and went out , and stood in the entering in of the cave . And , behold , there came a voice unto him , and said , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
kha: Haba u Elijah u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u tap ïa la ka khmat da la ka barandi bad u leit ban ïeng ha khmat kata ka krem . Ka sur kaba kren ha u ,  Elijah , me leh aïu hangne ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la long kumta, haba u Elijah u la iohsngew ia kata, ba u la tap ia la ka khmat ha ka jainkup jong u, bad u la mih noh, bad u la ieng ha ka jingrung jong ka krem . Bad, ha khmih, ka la wan ka sur ha u, bad u la ong, Me leh aiu hangne, ko Elijah ?

en: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight , and shall go forth : they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby : he shall cover his face , that he see not the ground with his eyes .
kha: U khun syiem uba synshar ïa ki un tawah ïa la ka song ha ka tyrpeng jong u bad un phet lyngba ka thliew kaba ki la tih na ka bynta jong u ha ka kynroh . Un tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad um ïohi shano ba u leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u syiem uba don hapdeng jong ki un kit ia ka tyrpeng jong u ha ka jingshai , bad un leit shabar: kin tih lyngba ka kynroh ban pyndep da kata: un tap ia ka khmat jong u , ba un ym iohi ia ka khyndew da ki khmat jong u .

en: And whether we be afflicted , it is for your consolation and salvation , which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer : or whether we be comforted , it is for your consolation and salvation .
kha: Lada ngi shahshitom , ka long na ka bynta ka jingïarap bad ka jingpynim jong phi ; lada la ïarap ïa ngi , te la ïarap ïa phi ruh bad la ai ïa ka bor ban ïaineh lem da ka jingïaishah ha kita kijuh ki jingshahshitom ba ngi ruh ngi la ïaineh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad la ngi shah pynshitom ne em, ka long na ka bynta ka jingpyntngen bad jingpynim jong phi, kaba treikam ha kaba shah ia kijuh ki jingjynjar kiba ngi ruh ngi shah shitom: ne la ngi shah pyntngen ne em, ka long na ka bynta ka jingpyntngen bad jingpynim jong phi .

en: And it came to pass , when they were gone over , that Elijah said unto Elisha , Ask what I shall do for thee , before I be taken away from thee . And Elisha said , I pray thee , let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me .
kha: Hangta , u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  To ong ha nga kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ha shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga .   Ai ngan ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong ka bor jong phi ka ban pynlong ïa nga u nongmih bujli jong phi ,  u Elisha u jubab .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ki la leit noh, ba u Elijah u la ong ha u Elisha, To kylli kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta jong me, shuwa ba ngan shah weng noh na me . U Elisha u la ong, nga kyrpad ia me, to ai ba ka bynta kaba arsien jong me kan long halor jong nga .

en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men , and the  Lord  delivered a very great host into their hand , because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers . So they executed judgment against Joash .
kha: Ka kynhun shipai Syria ka long kaba rit , hynrei U  Trai  u la shah ïa ki ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Judia kaba kham heh namar ki paidbah ki la iehnoh ïa u , U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom la pynshitom ïa u syiem Joash .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ka kynhun shipai jong ki Syria ka la wan ryngkat bad ka kynhun kaba rit jong ki briew, bad U Trai u la aiti ia ka kynhun shipai kaba khraw bha ha ka kti jong ki, namar ki la iehnoh ia U Trai Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Kumta ki la pyndep ia ka jingbishar pyrshah ia u Joash .

en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury  ; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
kha: Phi lah ban kheiñ sut haba phi ai ram ïa u nongwei , ym haba phi ai ram ïa la u para Israel , ba kumta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu kat ïa kaba phi leh ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha u nongwei me lah ban ai ram ha ka kam khaii; hynrei ha u hynmen jong me wat ai ram ha ka kam khaii: ba U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me buh ia ka kti jong me ha ka ri ha kaba me leit ban ioh ia ka .

en: And it came to pass on the morrow , which was the second day of the month , that David s place was empty : and Saul said unto Jonathan his son , Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat , neither yesterday , nor to day ?
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka sngi hadien ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , ka jaka shong bam u Dabid ka dang thylli hi , bad u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Balei u Dabid um shym wan sha ka jingkhawai mynhynnin bad mynta ka sngi ruh ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ha ka sngi kaba ar jong u bnai, ba u Dabid u la thylli: bad u Saul u la ong ha u Jonathan u khun jong u: Balei u khun u Jesse u wan bam hynnin ka sngi ne ha ka sngi ?

en: Now the queen , by reason of the words of the king and his lords , came into the banquet house : and the queen spake and said , O king , live for ever : let not thy thoughts trouble thee , nor let thy countenance be changed :
kha: Ka kmie jong u syiem ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba la pynmih da u syiem bad ki rangbah donburom jong u bad ka la rung sha ka kamra jingkhawai . Ka la ong ,  To u syiem un im junom ! Sngewbha wat da khih khuslai than bad wat da lieh blaid blaid .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka mahadei, namar ki ktien jong u syiem bad ki kynrad jong u, ka la wan shapoh ka iing bam: bad ka mahadei ka la kren bad ka la ong: Ko syiem, to ai ba ki jingpyrkhat jong me kin ym pynkhuslai ia me:

en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .
kha: Nangta u la leit sha ka khyrdop kaba phai sha mihngi . U la kiew ïa ki mawkyrdon , bad ha kliar u la thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la long lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la poi ha ka khyrdop kaba peit shaphang mihngi, bad u la kiew ia ki step jong ka, bad u la thew ia ka jingkhang jong ka khyrdop kaba heh;

en: Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .
kha: Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynjot ! Ki kynthei ka Rabbah , ki leit ïam sngewsih ! Ki phong ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïam pangnud . Ki mareh lamwir . Ïa u Molekh u blei jong phi yn ïalam mraw , lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid, ko Heshbon, namar u Ai u la shah pynjot: to iam, phi ki khun kynthei jong u Rabbah, to sngap jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar jar

en: Then answered they and said before the king , That Daniel , which is of the children of the captivity of Judah , regardeth not thee , O king , nor the decree that thou hast signed , but maketh his petition three times a day .
kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u syiem ,  U Daniel , uwei na kiba shah ringmraw na Judah , um shym burom ïa u Syiem Kynrad lane kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba phi la pynmih . U la duwai tista lai sien shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha khmat u syiem , Uta u Daniel uba long na ki khun jong ka jingshah set jong u Judah, um ju pyrkhat ia me ko syiem ne ia ka hukum kaba me la soi , hynrei u leh ia ka jingkyrpad jong u lai sien ha ka shisngi .

en: And it came to pass , when Ben–hadad heard this message , as he was drinking , he and the kings in the pavilions , that he said unto his servants , Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city .
kha: U Benhadad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jubab u Ahab katba ma u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u , kiwei pat ki nongsynshar , ki dang ïadih ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kumta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka jaka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba u Benhadad u la iohsngew ia kane ka khubor, katba u dang dih, ma u bad ki syiem ha ki pavilion, ba u la ong ha ki shakri jong u, To buh ia lade ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ka jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki jaka ba la buh ha ki .

en: There is a league between me and thee , and between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold  ; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .
kha: To ngin ïalong paralok , kumba la long ki kpa jong ngi . Kane ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ki jingai sngewbha ïa phi . Mynta , pyndkut noh ïa ka jingïadei paralok jong phi bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel , khnang ba un hap weng noh ïa ki shipai jong u na ka hima jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ka jingiasoh hapdeng jong nga bad me, bad hapdeng u kpa jong nga bad u kpa jong me: ha khmih nga la phah ha me ia ka jingai sngewbha rupa bad ksiar ; wan bad pynpra ia ka jingiasoh jong me bad u syiem Israel jong me, ba un leit noh na nga .

en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .
kha: Naba ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka waiñ bakhor jong ka jingkwah brai awria jong ka . Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ki la kiew spah bha na ka jingkwah brai bym lah teh lakam jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ia ka wain jong ka jingleh be-ijot jong ka , bad ki syiem jong ka khyndew ki la leh be-ijot bad ka , bad ki nongkhaii jong ka khyndew ki la nang riewspah lyngba ka jingbun ki jingbam ba bang jong ka .

en: For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .
kha: Ki la noh mynsiem namar ka jingsuki jong ka jingïaid ka kam . Hynrei kin ïohi ba u Serubbabel u dang ïai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kin long kiba kmen .  U angel u la ong ha nga ,  Ki hynñiew tylli ki sharak ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki khmat jong U  Trai  kiba khmih halor ka pyrthei baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar mano ba la lehbein ia ka sngi kaba rit ? namar kin sngewbha bad kin iohi ia ka plum ha ka kti jong u Serubabel bad kita ki hynriew ; ki long ki khmat U Trai kiba iaid sha ka khyndew baroh kawei .

en: If I go forth into the field , then behold the slain with the sword ! and if I enter into the city , then behold them that are sick with famine ! yea , both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not .
kha: Haba nga leit sha ki lyngkha , nga ïohi ïa ki met jong ki rangbah kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ; haba nga leit sha ki shnong , nga ïohi ïa ki briew kiba ïapthngan . Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki trei la ki kam , hynrei kim tip ïa kaei ki leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada nga leit sha lyngkha , te ha khmih ia kiba la shah pyniap da ka waitlam ! bad lada nga rung ha ka shnong , te ha khmih ia kiba pang thngan ! Hooid , baroh arngut u nongiathuhlypa bad u lyngdoh ki leit sha ka ri kaba kim tip .

en: I shall see him , but not now : I shall behold him , but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
kha: Nga khmih sha ka lawei , Bad nga ïohi ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . U syiem , uba kum u khlur phyrnai , un mih ha kata ka jaitbynriew . Kum u  lur dih duma un wan mih na Israel . Un shoh ïa ki nongïalam ki Moab , Bad un pyndem ïa ki briew jong u Seth .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan iohi ia u, hynrei ym mynta: Ngan iohi ia u, hynrei ym hajan: kan wan u Khlur na u Jakob, bad u Sceptre un mih na Israel, bad un pynkhih ia ki kut jong ka Moab, bad un pynjot ia ki khun shynrang jong u Sheth baroh .

en: And it came to pass , that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes : for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God .
kha: Haba ki nongshun jong ngi kiba don ha ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong ngi ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewthuh ba ki la poi ha ka jinglehrain , namar baroh ki tip ba ïa ka jingtrei la pyndep da ka jingïarap U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba haba ki nongshun jong ngi baroh ki la iohsngew ia kata, bad ki nongwei baroh kiba don sawdong jong ngi ki la iohi ia kine kiei kiei: namar ki la sngewthuh ba kane ka kam ka la long na U Blei jong ngi .

en: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered  ; so will I seek out my sheep , and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom kumba u nongaplangbrot u sumar bha ïa la ki langbrot kiba la sakma bad u wallam lang ïa ki pat . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka sha kiba la pynsakma ïa ki ha kata sngi ka jingdum bad jingjot .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumba u nongaplangbrot u wad ia ka kynhun jong u ha ka sngi ba u don hapdeng ki langbrot jong u kiba la saphriang ; kumta ngan wad ia ki langbrot jong nga , bad ngan pyllait noh ia ki na ki jaka baroh ha kaba ki la saphriang ha ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba dum .

en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans  ; this people was not , till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness : they set up the towers thereof , they raised up the palaces thereof  ; and he brought it to ruin .
kha: ( Ki dei ki nong Babilonia , ym ki nong Assyria , kiba la pynlong ba ki mradkhlaw kin tur ïa ka Tyros . Dei ki nong Babilonia kiba la tei ïa ki mot-kerkut , kiba la pyntwa ïa ki jingtei-kut ka Tyros bad ki la iehnoh ïa ka nongbah ha ka jingjot . )
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ka ri jong ki Khlieh kam shym la long kumta, haduh ba u Assyria u la seng ia ka na ka bynta jong ki kiba shong ha ka ri khlaw: ki la buh ia ki tower jong ka, ki la pynkiew ia ki iing syiem jong ka; bad u la pynjot ia ka .

en: Ask thy young men , and they will shew thee . Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes : for we come in a good day : give , I pray thee , whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants , and to thy son David .
kha: Shu kylli ïa ki , bad kin ïathuh ïa phi . Ngi la wan ha ka sngi jingkhawai , bad u Dabid u kyrpad ïa phi ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ngi . Sngewbha ai ïa kaba phi lah ha ngi ki shakri jong phi bad ha u paralok ba-ieit jong phi , u Dabid .
translated_en_to_kha: Kylli ia ki samla jong me, bad kin pyni ia me . Namarkata to ai ba ki samla kin shem ia ka jingsngewbha ha ki khmat jong me: namar ngi wan ha ka sngi kaba bha: to ai, nga kyrpad ia me, kaei kaei kaba wan ha ka kti jong me ha ki shakri jong me bad ha u khun jong me u Dabid .

en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :
kha: Lada jia ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dieng ne ha khyndew lem bad ïa ka sim kmie kaba pdem ïa ki pylleng lane kaba kdup ïa la ki khun , phim dei ban kem ïa ka sim kmie .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada u sim u don ha khmat jong me ha kano kano ka dieng, ne ha khyndew, la ki long ki khun rit ne ki snier bad ka dam kaba shong halor ki khun rit ne halor ki snier, wat shim ia ka dam bad ki khun rit:

en: Now Naaman , captain of the host of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honourable , because by him the  Lord  had given deliverance unto Syria : he was also a mighty man in valour , but he was a leper .
kha: U Naaman , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Syria , u long u briew ïa uba la burom shikatdei eh bad ñiewkor shibun da u syiem Syria , namar lyngba u Naaman , U  Trai  u la ai ka jingjop ïa ki shipai Syria . U la long u shipai bakhraw , hynrei u don ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Naaman, u rangbah shipai jong u syiem Syria, u la long u briew uba khraw bad u kynrad jong u, bad uba donburom, namar da u U Trai u la ai jingpyllait im ia ka Syria: u la long ruh u briew uba khlain bor ha ka jingleh donbor, hynrei u la long u nongpang niangthohlieh .

en: Them also king David dedicated unto the  Lord  , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations  ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .
kha: U syiem Dabid u pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingmane , ryngkat bad ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop — ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia bad ki Amalek .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki ruh ki la aiti ha U Trai, da ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la wanrah na kine ki jaitbynriew baroh; bad na Moab bad na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ammon bad na ki Philistia bad na Amalek .

en: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king s meat , nor with the wine which he drank : therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself .
kha: U Daniel u la kut jingmut ban ym shah ïa lade ban long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam da kaba bam ïa ka jingbam bad dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka ïingbishar syiem , kumta u la kyrpad ïa u Ashkenas ban ïarap ïa u ,
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Daniel u la thmu ha ka dohnud jong u ba un ym pynjakhlia ia lade da ka bynta jong ka doh syiem ne da ka wain kaba u la dih: namarkata u la kyrpad ia u syiem jong ki nongshong shnong ba un ym pynjakhlia ia lade .

en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .
kha: Kumta ki sop da ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ïa ki syngkai jong ki bad ki tyllai sawdong ïa ki ryndang jong ki , ki leit sha u Ahab bad ong ,  U shakri jong phi u Benhadad u kyrpad ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .  U Ahab u jubab ,  U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U long kum uba shi para bad nga !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ki la pynkhih ia ki tyrpeng jong ki, bad ki la buh ia ki lynti ha ki khlieh jong ki, bad ki la wan sha u syiem Israel, bad ki la ong, U shakri jong me u Benhadad u ong, nga kyrpad ia me, to ngan im . Bad u la ong, Hato u dang im ? u long u hynmen jong nga .

en: And lest , when I come again , my God will humble me among you , and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already , and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed .
kha: Nga sheptieng haba ha kawei ka por ba nga wan , U Blei jong nga un pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat jong phi , bad ngan ïam na ka bynta kiba bun kiba la leh pop mynshuwa bad ki bym pat shym kylla-kaba-mut na ki kam awria ba ki la leh — ki jingkwah brai bad ki pop awria jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ioh ba ynda nga wan phai pat, U Blei jong nga un pynrit ia nga hapdeng jong phi, bad ba ngan iam bun kiba la leh pop mynta , bad kim shym la kylla bamut na ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingleh be-ijot bad ka jingleh be-ijot kaba ki la leh .

en: When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .
kha: Haba phi ïaid lyngba ïa ki um bajylliew , ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ki jingeh kin ym tyllep ïa phi . Haba phi ïaid lyngba ka ding , phin ym ing ; ki jingtynjuh ba-eh kiba wan kin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me iaid lyngba ki um, ngan don bad me bad lyngba ki wah, kin ym tuid palat ia me: haba me iaid lyngba ka ding , men ym shah thang ; bad ka ding kan ym thang ia me .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .
kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhlaiñ jong ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajrong jong ka yn thang noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kam long ei ei ; ki jingpyrshang jong ki , ki kut ha ka ding . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u Trai jong ki paid; Ki kynroh kiba heh jong ka Babilon kin shah thang lut bad ki khyrdop ba jrong jong ka kin shah thang da ka ding ; bad ki briew kin trei shitom lehnohei, bad ki briew kin sa thait ha ka ding .

en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
kha: Ka don ka jingma , te , ba kane ka kam jong ngi kan budnam . Ym tang kata , hynrei ka don ruh ka jingma ba ka templ jong ka blei Artemis kan ym don jingmut ei ei shuh bad ba ïa ka jingkhraw jong ka yn pynduh — ka blei ba la mane da uwei pa uwei ha Asia bad ha ka pyrthei baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta ym tang kane ka kam jong ngi ka don ha ka jingma ban shah set ha ka por shuh shuh hynrei ruh ba ka tempi jong ka blei kaba khraw ka dei ban shah pynjah burom , bad ka jingkhraw jong ka ka dei ban shah pynjot , ia kaba ka Asia baroh bad ka pyrthei ka mane .

en: Yea , and what have ye to do with me , O Tyre , and Zidon , and all the coasts of Philistia ? will ye render me a recompence ? and if ye recompense me , swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head  ;
kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrshang ban leh ïa nga , ko Tyros bad Sidon , bad baroh ki jaka jong ka Philistia ? Hato phi pyrshang ban siew pat ïa nga na ka bynta kaei kaei ? Lada phi leh kumta , ngan siew kylliang kloi kloi pat ïa phi !
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , bad phi don jingiadei bad nga, ko Tyros, bad u Sidon, bad ki pud jong ka Philistia baroh ? phin pynphai biang ia nga ? bad lada phi pynphai biang ia nga , kloi bad kloi ngan pynphai biang ia ka jingsiew kylliang jong phi ha la ka jong ka khlieh;

en: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and the ten men that were with him , and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword , and slew him , whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land .
kha: Katba ki dang ïabam jingbam lang , u Ishmael bad ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah lem bad u ki la sei ïa la ki waitlam bad ki la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Ishmael u khun u Nethaniah bad ki shiphew ngut ki briew kiba don ryngkat bad u, bad u la shoh ia u khun u Ahikam u khun u Shaphan da ka waitlam bad u la pyniap ia u, ia uba u syiem Babilon u la pynlong Lat ia ka ri .

en: Thou art thy mother s daughter , that lotheth her husband and her children  ; and thou art the sister of thy sisters , which lothed their husbands and their children : your mother was an Hittite , and your father an Amorite .
kha: Pha long shisha ka khun jong ka kmie jong pha . Ka la isih jur ïa u tnga jong ka bad ïa ki khun jong ka . Pha long kum ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha , kiba la isih ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun . Ma pha bad ki nongbah kiba shi para bad pha , phi la don ka kmie ka nong Hit bad u kpa u nong Amor .
translated_en_to_kha: Me long ka khun jong ka kmie jong me, kaba la duh noh ia u tnga jong ka bad ki khun jong ka; bad me long ka para jong ki para jong me: ka kmie jong me ka long ka Hitit bad u kpa jong me u long u Amorit .

en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign . And this Seraiah was a quiet prince .
kha: U nongsumar ïa u syiem Sedekaïah u dei u Seraïah , u khun jong u Neraïah bad u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Seraïah u dang leit sha Babilonia bad u , bad nga la ai ha u katto katne ki jingbthah .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka ktien kaba u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa u la hukum ia u Seraiah u khun u Maaseiah haba u la leit bad u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah sha Babilon ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar jong u . Bad kane ka Seraiah ka long ka syiem kaba sngap jar .

en: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled , and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel , which ye have heard , and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven ; whereof I Paul am made a minister ;
kha: Phi dei , da shisha , ban ïaineh ha ka nongrim kaba skhem bad kaba thikna , bad phim dei ban shah ïa lade ban shah pynkhynñiuh na ka jingkyrmen kaba phi la ïoh myn haba phi la ïohsngew ïa ka gospel . Ka dei na kane ka gospel ba ma nga u Paul , nga la kylla long u shakri — kane ka gospel kaba la ïalap ha uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Lada phi iai bteng ha ka jingngeit kaba la pynshong nongrim bad kaba la pynshong nongrim , bad wat shah pynkynriah noh na ka jingkyrmen jong ka gospel kaba phi la iohsngew bad kaba la ialap ha uwei pa uwei u jingthaw uba don hapoh bneng; na u Paul la pynlong ia nga u myntri;

en: Whither shall we go up ? our brethren have discouraged our heart , saying , The people is greater and taller than we  ; the cities are great and walled up to heaven  ; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there .
kha: Ngin ïaleit lei shata ? Ngi te ngi sheptieng . Kito ki rangbah kiba ngi la phah ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba ki briew hangta ki kham khlaiñ bad kham jrong ban ïa ngi , bad ba ki shong ha ki nongbah kiba ki kynroh jong ki , ki kynjoh ïa ka suiñbneng . Ki la ïohi ruh hangta ïa ki ramhah .’
translated_en_to_kha: Ngi leit shaneng ? ki hynmen jong ngi ki la duh mynsiem ia ka dohnud jong ngi, ki da ong: Ki briew ki kham heh bad kham jrong ban ia ngi; ki nongbah ki long kiba khraw bad kiba la iaid sha bneng ; bad kham palat ngi la iohi ia ki khun shynrang jong ki Anaim hangta .

en: For by him were all things created , that are in heaven , and that are in earth , visible and invisible , whether they be thrones , or dominions , or principalities , or powers : all things were created by him , and for him :
kha: Namar da u , U Blei u la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew , kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi bad kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi , kynthup ïa ki bor ba kynja mynsiem , ki kynrad , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor synshar . U Blei u la thaw ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei da u na ka bynta jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar da u la thaw ia kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha bneng bad kiba don ha ka khyndew, kiba lah ban iohi bad ki bym lah ban iohi, la ki long ki khet ne ki jingsynshar ne ki hima: ia kiei kiei baroh la thaw da u: bad na ka bynta jong u:

en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :3 , 4 ) We gladly share the Bible’s promises with those in despair , offering the assurance that soon God’s Kingdom will bring an end to all the tragedies that cause pain and suffering . —Revelation 21 :4 .
kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :3 , 4 ) Da ka jingkmen ngi ïasam ïa ki jingkular jong ka Baibl bad kito kiba sngewsih , ngi pynthikna ïa ki ba shen ka Hima jong U Blei kan sa pynduh lut ïa ki jingjia ba sngewsih baroh kiba wanrah jingpang bad jingjynjar . —Jingpynpaw 21 :4 .
translated_en_to_kha: (Corinth 2:30), 4 ) Ngi sngewbha ban iasam ia ki jingkular jong ka Baibl bad kito kiba la duh jingkyrmen, da kaba ai ia ka jingpynthikna ba shen U Blei s Hima un pynkut noh ia ki jingjia ba sngewsih baroh kiba pynmih ia ka jingpang bad jingjynjar . Pynpaw 21:4 .

en: And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :
kha: Hynrei ynda ki la wan sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; kim shym la leh ïa kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la wallam ïa kane ka jingpynjot baroh ha ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan rung , bad ki la don ia ka ; hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ia ka sur jong me, lymne kim shym la leh ei ei na kiei kiei baroh kiba me la hukum ia ki ban leh: namarkata me la pynlong ia kane ka jingsniew baroh ban wan ha ki:

en: The Lord hath cast off his altar , he hath abhorred his sanctuary , he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces  ; they have made a noise in the house of the  Lord  , as in the day of a solemn feast .
kha: Ka long ka jingjot bakynjah mynta , ka Jerusalem ka kynmaw ïa la ka burom ba-itynnat kaba mynbarim . Haba ka hap ha ki nongshun , ym don mano mano ba wan ïarap ïa ka ; ki nongjop ïa ka ki la rkhie ha ka jingkyllon jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la bret noh ia ka jingknia jong u, u la pynjah burom ia ka jaka kyntang jong u, u la aiti ha ka kti jong u nongshun ia ki kynroh jong ki iing jong ka ; ki la pynmih ia ka jingsawa ha ka iing U Trai, kumba ha ka sngi jong ka jingkhawai kaba jem .

en: My father made me swear , saying , Lo , I die : in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan , there shalt thou bury me . Now therefore let me go up , I pray thee , and bury my father , and I will come again .
kha: ‘ Shuwa ba i pa in ïap , i la pynsmai ïa nga ba ngan leit tep ïa i ha ka jingtep ba i la pynkhreh ha Kanaan . Kumta shah ba ngan leit tep ïa i pa , bad hadien kata ngan sa wan phai pat .’
translated_en_to_kha: U kpa jong nga u la pynlong ia nga ban sngap jar, u da ong, Lo, nga iap: ha ka jingtep jong nga kaba nga la tih na ka bynta jong nga ha ka ri Kanaan, hangta me leit tep ia nga . Mynta to ngan leit kiew sha jrong, nga kyrpad ia me, bad ngan wan phai biang ia u kpa jong nga .
