en: And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan ha ka jingpynpaw burom kaba khraw bad ha ka jinglehkmen bad ki la rung sha ka kamra bishar lem bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah pawkhmat jong ka nongbah . U Phestos u la ai ka hukum , bad ïa u Paul la wallam shapoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud, haba u Agrippa u la wan, bad u Bernice, da ka jingkyrhuh kaba khraw, bad u la rung ha ka jaka bishar, bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah jong ka shnong, ha ka hukum jong u Festo la wanrah ia u Paul .

en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .
kha: Ko ki rangbah Israel !  ki la pyrta .  To ïarap ! Dei une u briew uba leit kylleng kylleng da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa uwei pyrshah ïa ki paid Israel , ïa ka Hukum u Moses , bad ïa kane ka Templ . Bad mynta u la wan ïalam wat katto katne ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka bakhuid !
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba pyrta , Ki briew jong ki Israel ki iarap: Une u briew uba hikai ia ki briew baroh ha man la ki jaka pyrshah ia ki briew bad ka hukum bad kane ka jaka: bad shuh shuh u la wanrah ia ki Grik ruh sha ka tempi , bad u la pynjakhlia ia kane ka jaka bakhuid .

en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .
kha: U Jehoram u la don laiphew ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem . Ym don mano mano ba sngewsih haba u ïap . Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Laiphew ar snem ka rta jong u haba u la sdang ban synshar, bad u la synshar ha Jerusalem 8 snem, bad u la leit noh khlem da kwah . Wat la ki la tep ia u ha ka shnong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ki jingtep jong ki syiem .

en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
kha: U ong ha u paidbah baroh ,  Une u maw un long u sakhi ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh ba U  Trai  u la kren ha ngi . Kumta un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa phi na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Joshua u la ong ha ki briew baroh: Ha khmih une u maw un long u sakhi ia ngi namar u la iohsngew ia ki ktien U Trai baroh kiba u la kren ha ngi: kan long namarkata ka sakhi ia phi: ioh ban kyntait ia U Blei jong phi .

en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb , then he shall bring for his trespass , which he hath committed , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , unto the  Lord   ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .
kha: Lada u briew um kotbor ban wallam da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , un wanrah sha U  Trai  ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur kum ka jingpli ïa la ka pop , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada um lah ban wanrah ia u khun langbrot , te un wanrah na ka bynta ka jingleh bymman jong u, kaba u la leh , ar tylli ki turtle ne ar tylli ki khun sniang ha U Trai ; kawei na ka bynta ka jingknia pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingknia thang .

en: Then the same day at evening , being the first day of the week , when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews , came Jesus and stood in the midst , and saith unto them ,  Peace be unto you .
kha: Ka la long la kham janmiet jong ka Sngi U Trai , bad ki synran ki la ïalumlang hapoh ka kamra kaba la khang skhem , namar ba ki la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Nangta U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki .  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi ,  u la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ha kajuh ka sngi ha ka por janmiet, haba ki jingkhang ki la khang ha kaba ki synran ki la ialum lang namar ka jingtieng ia ki Jiw, u Jisu u la wan bad u la ieng hapdeng bad u la ong ha ki: Ka jingsuk ha phi .

en: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near  ; for them the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to minister unto him , and to bless in the name of the  Lord   ; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried :
kha: Ki lyngdoh Lebi ruh kin leit lang shata , namar dei ma ki , ki ban rai ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingïania bad ka jingïashoh . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la jied ïa ki ban shakri ïa u bad kyrkhu ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lyngdoh ki khun shynrang jong u Lebi kin wan hajan jong ki;

en: And Saul went on this side of the mountain , and David and his men on that side of the mountain : and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul  ; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them .
kha: U Saul bad ki rangbah jong u ki don ha kawei ka liang jong u lum , la pynïakhlad na u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , kiba don ha kawei pat ka liang . Ki la pynstet ban phet krad na u Saul bad ki rangbah jong u , kiba nang kham hajan ïa ki bad kiba la jan ïohkem ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Saul u la leit sha kane ka liang jong u lum, bad u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ha kata ka liang jong u lum: bad u Dabid u la kyrkieh ban phet noh namar ka jingtieng ia u Saul ; namar u Saul bad ki briew jong u ki la ker sawdong ia u Dabid bad ki briew jong u sawdong ban shim ia ki .

en: But none of these things move me , neither count I my life dear unto myself , so that I might finish my course with joy , and the ministry , which I have received of the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .
kha: Hynrei nga ñiew ïa la ka jingim ba ka long ka bymdondor ei ei ïa nga ; nga kwah tang ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga bad pyndep pura ïa ka kam kaba U Trai Jisu u la ai ha nga ban leh , kaba long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ym don kawei ruh na kine kiei kiei kaba pynkhih ia nga, lymne nga khein ia ka jingim jong nga kaba kordor ha nga hi, khnang ba ngan pyndep ia ka lynti jong nga da ka jingkmen bad ka jingshakri kaba nga la ioh na U Trai Jisu , ban sakhi ia ka gospel jong ka jingaiei U Blei .

en: And they said , If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel , send it not empty  ; but in any wise return him a trespass offering : then ye shall be healed , and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you .
kha: Ki la jubab ,  Lada phi pynphai ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel , phi dei da shisha ban phah bad ka ïa ka jingai sngewbha sha u ban siew noh na ka bynta ka pop jong phi . Ka Synduk ka Jutang kam dei ban leit noh khlem ka jingai sngewbha . Da kumne , yn pynkoit ïa phi bad phin sa sngewthuh balei ba u ïai pynshitom ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: Lada phi beh noh ia ka synduk U Blei jong ki Israel, wat phah thylli hynrei ha kano kano ka rukom kaba stad: nangta phin sa koit noh, bad phin sa tip ia phi balei ba ka kti jong u kam shym la weng noh na phi .

en: But the mountain shall be thine  ; for it is a wood , and thou shalt cut it down : and the outgoings of it shall be thine : for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites , though they have iron chariots , and though they be strong .
kha: Ka ri lum kan long ka jong phi . Wat la ka dei ka khlaw , phin prat pynkhuid bad shim kynti ïa ka na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat ka tduh . Shaphang ki Kanaan , phin beh noh ïa ki , wat la ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar bad ba ki long ki briew kiba khlaiñ .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u lum un long u dieng jong me, bad me dei ban ot ia u: bad ki jingmih jong ka kin long ki jong me: namar me dei ban beh noh ia ki nong Kanaan wat la ki don ki kali nar bad wat la ki long kiba khlain .

en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened , when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt : and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her : as for her , a cloud shall cover her , and her daughters shall go into captivity .
kha: Ka jingdum kan tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , bad ki briew jong ki nongbah jong ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha ka por ba la dum ruh ka sngi, haba ngan pynpra hangta ia ki bniat jong ka ri Ijipt: bad ka jingkhih jong ka bor jong ka kan sangeh noh ha ka: katba ia ka, u lyoh un tap ia ka, bad ki khun kynthei jong ka kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok .

en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .
kha: Ka jingpynshitom ïa ka jingshah pynïap jong ki kan hap ha u Joab bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u shi junom . Hynrei U  Trai  un ïai ai ka jingjop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid kiba shong ha ka khet jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka snam jong ki kan wan phai noh ha ka khlieh jong u Joab bad ha ka khlieh jong u symbai jong u junom: hynrei ha u Dabid bad ha u symbai jong u bad ha ka iing jong u bad ha ka khet jong u, kan don ka jingsuk junom na U Trai .

en: Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
kha: Lada U Blei jong ki kpa jong nga , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak um shym la don ryngkat bad nga , phin jin da la phah thylli ïa nga . Hynrei U Blei u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga bad ïa ka jingtrei ba nga la pyndep , bad hynne mynmiet u la ai ïa ka jingbishar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Lait noh tang U Blei jong u kpa jong nga, U Blei jong u Abraham, bad ka jingtieng u Isaak, u la don ryngkat bad nga, shisha me la phah noh ia nga mynta thylli . U Blei u la iohi ia ka jingjynjar jong nga bad ka jingtrei shitom jong nga, bad u la pynrem ia me mynta ka miet .

en: And the children of Benjamin did so , and took them wives , according to their number , of them that danced , whom they caught : and they went and returned unto their inheritance , and repaired the cities , and dwelt in them .
kha: Ki Benjamin ki leh kumta ; uwei pa uwei na ki u jied ïa ka tnga napdeng ki theisamla kiba shad ha Shiloh bad ïalam noh ïa ki . Nangta ki leit phai sha la ka jaka , ki tei thymmai ïa la ki shnong , bad ki shong hangta .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang ki la leh kumta, bad ki la shim ia ki tnga kat kum ka jingdon jong ki: bad ki la leit phai noh sha ka pateng jong ki, bad ki la shong ha ki .

en: And he turned unto her by the way , and said , Go to , I pray thee , let me come in unto thee  ; ( for he knew not that she was his daughter in law . ) And she said , What wilt thou give me , that thou mayest come in unto me ?
kha: U leit sha ka harud jong ka lynti bad u ong ,  To ong , katno phi buh dor ?  ( Um shym tip ba ka dei ka pyrsa kurim jong u . ) Ka ong  Phin ai aïu ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai sha ka ha lynti, bad u la ong, To leit sha, nga kyrpad ia me, to ngan wan rung shapoh jong me ; (namar um tip ba ka dei ka khun jong u ha ka ain . ) Bad ka la ong: Kaei kaba phin ai ha nga, ba phin wan rung sha nga ?

en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?
kha: Hynrei kumno me lah ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew kiba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khuid palat kat ban peit ïa kaba sniew , bad mem lah shah ban peit ïa ki briew ba leh bymdei . Te balei ba me shu sngap jar jar katba ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: Me long uba kham khuid ban ia kaba peit ia ka jingsniew, bad ngam lah ban peit ia ka jingbymhok: namar kata me peit ia kita kiba leh thok , bad me bat ia ka shyntur jong me haba u bymman u bam ia uta u briew uba kham hok ban ia u ?

en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman , that is a bondmaid , betrothed to an husband , and not at all redeemed , nor freedom given her  ; she shall be scourged  ; they shall not be put to death , because she was not free .
kha: Lada kano kano ka mraw ka long ka tnga kliar ba la ithuh jong u briew bad ym pat shym la siew dep ïa ka dor jong ka bad pyllaitluid , te lada uno uno u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka , yn pynshitom ïa ki , hynrei ym dei ban pynïap namar ka dei ka mraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uno uno uba shong ha ka met bad ka kynthei, kata ka long ka nongtrei kam, kaba la shah pyllait im ha u tnga, bad ym shym la siewspah satia, lymne ka jinglaitluid kaba la ai ia ka ; kan ym shah pyniap; namar ba kam shym la laitluid .

en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?
kha: U la khmih halor ki briew jong ka pyrthei kum bym long ei ei ; ki angel ha bneng bad ki briew ha ka pyrthei ki don hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyrshah ïa ka mon jong u lane kylli jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew ki long kiba la tip kum ki bym don ei ei: bad u leh kat kum ka mon jong u ha ka kynhun shipai bneng bad hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka khyndew: bad ym don ba lah ban sah ia ka kti jong u ne ong ia u: Me leh aiu ?

en: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
kha: Nangta ki la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong ki bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka kynhun u Herod .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi tip ba me ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew , khlem da khuslai shaphang kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat , namar ba mem pyrkhat ïa ka kyrdan jongno jongno .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la phah sha u ia ki synran jong ki bad ki nong Herodian, ki da ong, Ko Nonghikai, ngi tip ba me long uba shisha, bad me hikai ia ka lynti U Blei ha ka jingshisha: namar me khlem pyrkhat ia ka khmat ki briew .

en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .
kha: Te kiwei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lat ki la ïapyrshang ban shem kaei kaei kaba bakla bad ka rukom kaba u Daniel u pynïaid ïa ka hima , hynrei kim lah , namar ba u Daniel u long uba lah ban shaniah , bad um shym leh kano kano kaba bakla lane ka jingbymhok .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki president bad ki syiem ki la wad ban wad ia ka lad pyrshah ia u Daniel ha kaba iadei bad ka hima ; hynrei kim lah ban shem ia ka lad ne ka jingbakla ; namar ba u long uba iaineh , ym don kano kano ka jingbakla ne jingbakla ba la lap ha u .

en: Wherefore they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We beseech thee , O  Lord  , we beseech thee , let us not perish for this man s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou , O  Lord  , hast done as it pleased thee .
kha: Kumta ki la kyang sha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , ngi duwai , to wat pynshitom ïa ngi da ka jingïap ban shim ïa ka jingim jong une u briew ! Ma me , ko  Trai  , me kitkhlieh na ka bynta kane baroh ; ka long ka jingleh jong me .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki la pyrta ha U Trai bad ki la ong: Ngi kyrpad ia me ko Trai, ngi kyrpad ia me, wat nym duh noh ia ka jingim jong une u briew, bad wat buh ia ngi ia ka snam bym don pop: namar me, ko Trai, me la leh katba me mon .

en: It shall blossom abundantly , and rejoice even with joy and singing : the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it , the excellency of Carmel and Sharon , they shall see the glory of the  Lord  , and the excellency of our God .
kha: Ka ri shyiap kan rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen ; kan long kaba itynnat kat ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad kaba seisoh kat ki pyntha ka Karmel bad Sharon . Baroh kin ïohi ïa ka jingitynnat U  Trai  , kin ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ïa ka bor jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan phuh shibun, bad kan kmen wat da ka jingkmen bad jingrwai: ka burom jong u Lebanon yn ai ha ka, ka jingbha jong u Carmel bad u Sharon , kin iohi ia ka burom U Trai bad ka jingbha jong U Blei jong ngi .

en: And when he polled his head , ( for it was at every year s end that he polled it : because the hair was heavy on him , therefore he polled it : ) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king s weight .
kha: U  ñiuhkhlieh jong u , u long uba rben katta katta bad u hap ban khap ïa u shisien shisnem ; haba u la jrong than bad khia . U ju khia palat ïa ar kilo kat kum ka jingthew ryntih ba kynja syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la pynkhih ia ka khlieh jong u , (namar ha kaba kut jong u snem ba u la pynkhih ia ka: namar ba u shniuh u la khia ha u: namarkata u la pynkhih ia ka: ) u la khia ia u shniuh jong u ha ka arspah Shekel hadien ka jingkhia jong u syiem .

en: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the  Lord  , and say , Is not the  Lord  among us ? none evil can come upon us .
kha: Ïa ki nongsynshar ka nongbah la tap-lup da ki jingbamsap , ki lyngdoh ki pynbatai ïa ka hukum na ka bynta ka tulop , ki nongïathuhlypa ki ai ïa ki jingpynpaw jong ki na ka bynta ka pisa — bad baroh ki kam ba U  Trai  u don bad ki .  Yn ym don jingma ka ban hap halor jong ngi ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  u long lem bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khlieh jong ka ki bishar ia ka bainong jong ka, bad ki lyngdoh jong ka ki hikai ia ka bainong, bad ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka ki long kiba riewblei na ka bynta ka pisa: hynrei kin shaniah ha U Trai , bad kin ong: Hato U Trai u dei u Trai hapdeng jong ngi ? ym don ka jingsniew kaba lah ban wan ha ngi .

en: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it : and the men were grieved , and they were very wroth , because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob s daughter  ; which thing ought not to be done .
kha: Haba ki ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la kyndit bad bitar shla ba u Shekhem u la leh ïa kaba kum kane bad ba u la ibeiñ ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel da kaba batbor ïa ka khun jong u Jakob .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la mih na lyngkha haba ki la iohsngew ia kata: bad ki briew ki la sngewsih shibun , namar u la leh ia ka kam ha Israel ha kaba thiah bad ka khun jong u Jakob .

en: And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .
kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Josaïah u la ai sngewbha na ki kynhun jong ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tylli ki blang , ki langbrot , bad ki khunblang , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .
translated_en_to_kha: U Josiah u la ai ha ki briew, na ki langbrot bad ki khun shynrang, baroh na ka bynta ki jingknia jong ka jingkhawai Niam ka jinglait im, na ka bynta baroh kiba la don, haduh laiphew hajar, bad lai hajar tylli ki masi: kine ki long ki jong u syiem .

en: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin , a captain of the ward was there , whose name was Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah  ; and he took Jeremiah the prophet , saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans .
kha: Hynrei haba nga la poi ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin , u rangbah nongïalam uba dei khmih ïa ki shipai ba don ha ka kam hangta , u briew uba kyrteng u Irijah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u ksiew jong u Hananaïah , u la pynsangeh ïa nga bad u la ong ,  Phi la phet noh ban ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia !
translated_en_to_kha: U la don ha ka khyrdop u Benjamin, u rangbah jong ka ward u la don hangta, uba la ai kyrteng u Irijah u khun u Sheemaiah u khun u Hananiah; bad u la shim ia u Jeremaiah u nongiathuhlypa da kaba ong: Me la hap noh sha ki Khaldian .

en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?
kha: Katba ki dang don hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur kren jong u samla Lebi , kumta ki leit sha u bad ki kylli ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba wallam ïa me shane ?
translated_en_to_kha: Haba ki la don hajan ka iing u Micah , ki la ithuh ia ka sur jong u samla Lebi: bad ki la phai shapoh hangta , bad ki la ong ha u: Mano ba wanrah ia me hangne ? bad kaei kaba me leh ha kane ka jaka ? bad kaei kaba me don hangne ?

en: Wherefore his servants said unto him , Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin : and let her stand before the king , and let her cherish him , and let her lie in thy bosom , that my lord the king may get heat .
kha: Kumta ki rangbah synshar jong u ki ong ha u ,  Syiem Kynrad , shah ngin wad ka samla kynthei ban sah bad phi bad ban sumar ïa phi . Kan thiah ha syndah jong phi ba kan pynsyaid ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki shakri jong u ki la ong ha u: To ai ba kan ieng ha khmat u syiem jong nga: bad to ai ba kan ieng ha khmat u syiem , bad to ai ba kan sumar ia u , bad to ai ba kan thiah ha ka kpoh jong me , ba u kynrad jong nga un ioh ia ka jingshit .

en: And when the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed unto her a certain officer , saying , Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now .
kha: Haba jubab ïa ka jingkylli u syiem , ka pynthikna ïa ka jingïathuhkhana u Gehasi , bad kumta u syiem u la khot ïa u rangbah synshar bad ong ha u ba un pynphai pat ha ka ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong ka , kynthup ïa ka dor jong ki jingmih na ki lyngkha baroh ha kita ki hynñiew snem kiba ka don shawei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u syiem u la kylli ia kata ka kynthei , ka la iathuh ha u . Kumta u syiem u la thung ia ka ha uwei u ophisar , u da ong: To pynphai noh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba long ki jong ka bad ki soh lyngkha baroh naduh ka sngi ba ka la mih na ka ri, wat haduh mynta .

en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .
kha: Ki Israel ki la tlot na ka jingthngan ha kata ka sngi , namar u Saul , da ka jingsmai kyntang , u la ai hukum :  Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam kano kano ka jingbam mynta ka sngi ha shuwa ba ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga .  Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew Israel ki la sngewsih ha kata ka sngi: namar u Saul u la pynsngewsih ia ki briew, u da ong: La tim ia uta u briew uba bam ia kano kano ka jingbam haduh ban da janmiet, ba ngan shah pynshitom bein ha ki nongshun jong nga . Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki briew uba la mad ia kano kano ka jingbam .

en: Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .
kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba shisien shisnem ha U  Trai  ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi .  ( Ka Shiloh ka don shatei na Bethel , shathie na Lebonah , bad sha mihngi na ka lynti bah hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Shekhem . )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki la ong: Ha khmih ka don ka jingkhawai jong U Trai ha Shiloh man la u snem ha ka jaka kaba don shaphang shathie jong ka Bethel , shaphang mihngi jong ka surok bah kaba kiew na Bethel sha Shehem bad shaphang shathie jong ka Lebonah .

en: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
kha: Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew u dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba tang ma ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïabam bad ka jingïadih bad ka jinglehsngewbha ïa lade . U lah la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kane katba u trei ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrthei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la iaroh ia ka jingkmen, namar u briew um don ei ei kaba kham bha hapoh ka sngi, ban ia kaba bam bad ban dih bad ban sngewbha: namar kata kan iaineh bad u na ka jingtrei shitom jong u ha ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u, kaba U Blei u ai ia u hapoh ka sngi .

en: And , behold , I purpose to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God , as the  Lord  spake unto David my father , saying , Thy son , whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room , he shall build an house unto my name .
kha: U  Trai  u la kular ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , ‘ U khun jong me , uba ngan pynlong syiem hadien jong me , un tei ka Templ ïa nga .’ Bad mynta nga la kut jingmut ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, nga thmu ban tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong nga, kumba U Trai u la kren ha u kpa jong nga, da kaba ong: Ko khun jong me, ia uba ngan buh ha ka khet jong me ha ka kamra jong me, un tei ia ka iing ha ka kyrteng jong nga .

en: And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban ïasam ïa ka ri ha ki paid Israel da kaba kynting sbai . U la hukum ruh ïa phi ban ai ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong u para kur jong ngi u Selophehad ha ki khun kynthei jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la ong: U Trai u la hukum ia u kynrad jong nga ban ai ia ka ri da ka lot sha ki khun Israel: bad u kynrad jong nga u la hukum da u Trai ban ai ia ka pateng jong u hynmen jong ngi ha ki khun kynthei jong u .

en: Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , nga la ai ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ka jingdon jingem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Templ jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nalor kata , namar ba nga la buh ia ka jingieit jong nga ha ka iing U Blei jong nga , nga don la ka jong ka jingbha kaba biang , ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba nga la ai ha ka iing U Blei jong nga , halor kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la pynkhreh na ka bynta ka iing bakhuid .

en: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .
kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalam ïa u sha Antiokh , bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut ki la ïakynduh ïa ki briew ka balang bad ki la hikai ïa ka kynhun kaba heh . Ka la long ha Antiokh ba ïa ki parabangeit la khot nyngkong eh  Ki Khristan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba u la shem ia u, u la wanrah ia u ha Antiok . Bad ka la jia ba ki la ialum lang bad ka balang baroh kawei bad ki la hikai ia ki briew kiba bun . Bad la khot nyngkong eh ia ki synran ha Antiok .

en: And he said unto them , Follow after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand . And they went down after him , and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab , and suffered not a man to pass over .
kha: U ong ha ki ,  Bud ïa nga ! U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab , ki nongshun jong phi .  Kumta ki la bud arsut ïa u Ehud bad ki la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka ha kaba ki Moab ki dei ban jam ïa ka Jordan ; kim shym pyllait wat tang uwei u briew ruh ban jam .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ong ha ki, To bud ia nga: namar U Trai u la aiti ia ki nongshun jong phi ha ka kti jong phi . Ki la leit hiar hadien jong u bad ki la shim ia ki khlaw Jordan sha ka ri Moab .

en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty , not walking in craftiness , nor handling the word of God deceitfully ; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man s conscience in the sight of God .
kha: Hynrei la pynbna ki kam babuhrieh kiba pynlehrain ; ngim shym leh da ka jingshukor , lymne ngim pynbakla ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Ha ka jingshai kaba pura jong ka jingshisha , ngi im ha khmat U Blei bad ngi pyrshang ban aiti ïa lade sha ka jingïatiplem babha jong uwei pa uwei .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki la kyntait ia kiei kiei kiba buhrieh jong ka jingbymhok, ym da kaba iaid ha ka kam shna jingshna, lymne da kaba bat ia ka ktien U Blei da kaba thok ; hynrei da kaba pynpaw ia ka jingshisha da kaba iaroh ia lade ha uwei pa uwei u briew ha khmat U Blei .

en: Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .
kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingpynim kaba ngi ïoh lang , haba nga la shem ïa ka jingdonkam ban thoh shisyndon ban pynshlur ïa phi , ban ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai shisien ai ha ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ko baieit , haba nga la ai ka jingminot baroh ban thoh sha phi ia ka jingpynim kaba iadei bad phi , ka la long kaba donkam ia nga ban thoh sha phi , bad ban kyntu ia phi ba phi dei ban ialeh shitom na ka bynta ka jingngeit kaba la aiti shisien sha ki riewkhuid .

en: And as for me , when I came from Paddan , Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way , when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath : and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath  ; the same is Beth–lehem .
kha: Dei na ka bynta ka Rakhel ka kmie jong me ba nga leh ïa kane . Nga sngewsih eh ba ka la ïap noh ha ri Kanaan , hajan Ephrath , katba ngi dang ïawan phai na Mesopotamia . Nga la tep ïa ka hangta harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath .  ( Ïa ka Ephrath la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem . )
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ia nga, haba nga wan na Paddan, ka Rakhel ka la iap da nga ha ka ri Kana ha ka lynti, haba dang don tang khyndiat ka lynti ban poi sha Ephrath: bad nga la tep ia ka hangta ha ka lynti jong u Ephrath ; kajuh ka long ka Bethlehem .

en: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace ! O Judah , keep thy solemn feasts , perform thy vows : for the wicked shall no more pass through thee  ; he is utterly cut off .
kha: Ha khmih , u nonglamktien u wan halor ki lumbah lem bad ka khubor kaba bha ! U don ha la ka lynti ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop ! Ko ki paid Judah , to rakhe ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi bad to ai ha U Blei ïa kaei kaba phi la kular kyntang ha u . U bymman da lei lei ruh un ym hiarthma shuh ïa ka ri jong phi . La pynjot thiaw ïa ki baroh !
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih ha ki lum ki kjat jong uta uba wanrah ia ka khubor babha, uba pynmih ia ka jingsuk ! Ko Judah, to sumar ia ki jingkhawai ba sngewbha jong me: namar ki bymman kin ym iaid shuh lyngba jong me; u la shah ot noh shi syndon .

en: Delilah therefore took new ropes , and bound him therewith , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber . And he brake them from off his arms like a thread .
kha: Kumta ka Delilah ka shim ki tyllai kiba thymmai bad ka khum ïa u . Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  Ki rangbah ki ap ha kawei pat ka kamra . Hynrei u bthat ïa kita ki tyllai na ki ksang ti jong u kum ïa u  saihon .
translated_en_to_kha: U Delilah u la shim ia ki lynti thymmai, bad u la teh ia u da kata, bad u la ong ha u, Ki Philistia ki don halor jong me, Samson . Bad ki don ki nongleit jingleit kiba sah ha ka kamra . Bad u la bret ia ki na ki kti jong u kum u thread .

en: And the young men that were spies went in , and brought out Rahab , and her father , and her mother , and her brethren , and all that she had  ; and they brought out all her kindred , and left them without the camp of Israel .
kha: Kumta ki leit bad wan ïalam ïa ka Rahab , lem bad ïa u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka , ki hynmen ki para jong ka , bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka kiba dang sah . Ki shim ïa ki baroh , ki longïing longsem bad ki mraw , sha ka jaka bashngain hajan ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki samla kiba long ki nongleit jingleit ki la rung shapoh bad ki la wanrah ia ka Rahab bad u kpa jong ka bad ka kmie jong ka bad ki hynmen jong ka bad baroh kaba ka don; ki la wanrah ia ki baroh kiba ha iing jong ka.

en: And David said to him , Canst thou bring me down to this company ? And he said , Swear unto me by God , that thou wilt neither kill me , nor deliver me into the hands of my master , and I will bring thee down to this company .
kha: U Dabid u ong ïa u ,  Men ïalam ïa nga sha kito ki nonglute ?  U jubab ,  Ngan leit lada phi kular ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga lane aiti ïa nga ha u kynrad jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u, Phi lah ban wanrah ia nga sha kane ka kynhun ? Bad u la ong: To sngap jar ia nga da U Blei, ba phin ym pyniap ia nga, ne phin ym aiti ia nga ha ki kti jong u kynrad jong nga, bad ngan pynhiar ia me sha kane ka kynhun .

en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .
kha: Ha kata ka por U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingmut bad sheptieng haduh katta ba uwei uwei baroh un kem ïa u briew hajan jong u bad tur ïaleh ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha kata ka sngi, ba ka jingsawa kaba khraw na U Trai kan long hapdeng jong ki ; bad kin buh ia uwei pa uwei ha ka kti jong u paramarjan jong u , bad ka kti jong u kan kiew sha jrong pyrshah ia ka kti jong u paramarjan jong u .

en: Behold that which I have seen : it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life , which God giveth him : for it is his portion .
kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba nga la shem : Kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban bam bad ban dih bad ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei ha ka jingim balyngkot kaba U Blei u la ai ïa ngi ; kane ka dei ka kupar jong ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih kata kaba nga la iohi: ka long kaba bha bad kaba sngewtynnad ia u briew ban bam bad ban dih, bad ban ioh ia ka jingbha jong ka jingtrei shitom jong u baroh kaba u shim hapoh ka sngi baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong u: namar ka long ka bynta jong u .

en: Only take heed to thyself , and keep thy soul diligently , lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen , and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life : but teach them thy sons , and thy sons  sons  ;
kha: Da leh husiar ! Kynmaw ba katba phi dang im phim dei ban klet ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi da la ki khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Tangba to sumar ia lade, bad to sumar ia ka mynsiem jong me da kaba minot, ioh ba men klet ia kiei kiei kiba me la iohi, bad ioh ba kin leit noh na ka dohnud jong me baroh ki sngi jong ka jingim jong me: hynrei to hikai ia ki ia ki khun shynrang jong me;

en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .
kha: Ai ha kiwei , bad U Blei un ai ha phi . Da shisha , phin ïohpdiang ka jingthew kaba dap biang , ka jingai basbun , kaba la theh ha ki kti jong phi — baroh kata kaba phi lah ban bat . Ka jingthew kaba phi pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei ka long kata kaba U Blei un pyndonkam ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ai, bad yn ai ha phi ia ka jingthew kaba bha, kaba la pynkhih bad kaba la pynkhih lang, bad kaba iaid sha jrong, ki briew kin ai ha ka kpoh jong phi . Namar da kajuh ka jingthew kaba phi buh ha ka met jong phi yn thew biang ia ka ha phi .

en: I will break also the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven , and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden : and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop nongbah ka Damaskos , bad ngan weng ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Them Aben , bad ïa u nongsynshar ka Betheden . Ki briew ka Syria kin shah ring kum ki koidi sha ri Kir .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynpra ruh ia ka bar jong u Damasios, bad ngan ot noh ia u nongshong shnong na ka madan Aven: bad ki briew jong ka Syria kin leit sha ka jinglong mraw sha Kir , ong U Trai .

en: Who is the wise man , that may understand this ? and who is he to whom the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken , that he may declare it , for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness , that none passeth through ?
kha: Nga la kylli ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ka ri ka ha ka jingjot jingpra bad ka tyrkhong kum ka ri shyiap , ba ym don mano mano ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ka ? Uei uba stad eh ban shemphang ïa kane ? Hano me la batai ïa ka ba u lah ban ïathuh ha kiwei pat ?
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba stad , uba lah ban sngewthuh ia kane ? bad mano ba ka shyntur U Trai ka la kren , ba un pynbna ia ka , namar kaei kaba ka ri ka jah bad ka shah thang kum ka ri khlaw , ba ym don ba iaid lyngba ?

en: Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .
kha: Lada uno uno u smai khlem da pyrkhat , kam pher la ka long ïa kano kano , u long uba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
translated_en_to_kha: Lane lada ka mynsiem ka sngap jar, da kaba pynpaw da ki rmiang shyntur jong u ban leh ia kaba sniew, ne ban leh ia kaba bha, la ka long kumta ruh ba u briew un pynpaw da ka jingsmai, bad ka la buhrieh na u haba u tip ia kata; te un long uba don pop ha kawei na kine .

en: And , behold , God himself is with us for our captain , and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you . O children of Israel , fight ye not against the  Lord  God of your fathers  ; for ye shall not prosper .
kha: U Blei hi da lade u long u nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh jong u ki don hangne lem bad ki turoi , ba la khreh ban put ïa ki bad ban khot ïa ngi bad ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa phi . Ko paid Israel , wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ! Phin ym jop !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih , U Blei hi u don ryngkat bad ngi na ka bynta u rangbah jong ngi, bad ki lyngdoh jong u da kaba pyrta ia phi . Ko khun Israel , wat ialeh pyrshah ia U Trai U Blei jong phi; namar phin ym jop .

en: Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together , saith the  Lord  , which have burned incense upon the mountains , and blasphemed me upon the hills : therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom .
kha: na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ki la thang ki jingiwbih ha ki duwan thala kiba halor ki lum bad ki la kren sniew ïa nga . Kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei hok ïa ki namar ki kam ba ki la leh mynshuwa .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki jingbymhok jong phi bad ki jingbymhok jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi ryngkat , ong U Trai , kiba la thang ia nga halor ki lum , bad ki la kren bein ia nga halor ki lum: namarkata ngan thew ia ka kam barim jong ki ha ka kpoh jong ki .

en: And like unto him was there no king before him , that turned to the  Lord  with all his heart , and with all his soul , and with all his might , according to all the law of Moses  ; neither after him arose there any like him .
kha: Ym shym la don syiem uba kum ma u mynshuwa , uba shakri ïa U  Trai  da ka dohnud , ka jingmut , bad da ka bor jong u baroh , da kaba kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum u Moses ; lymne don u syiem uba kum ma u naduh kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kumba long ha u ym don syiem shuh ha khmat jong u, uba phai sha U Trai da ka dohnud jong u baroh, bad da ka mynsiem jong u baroh, kat kum ka hukum jong u Moses baroh.

en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki briew ki bymkhuid . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u dei ban pynkhuid ïa kito , kiba , hadien ba ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad sum ïa lade , ki kylla long kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngi kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad uta uba khuid un theh ia uta u bymkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew: bad ha ka sngi kaba hynriew un pynkhuid ia lade bad un sait ia ki jain jong u bad un sait ia lade ha ka um bad un long uba khuid ha ka por janmiet .

en: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed–edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps  ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals  ;
kha: Ïa u Asaph la thung nongïalam bad ïa u Sekharaïah kum u nongïarap . La thung ïa u Jeiel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehiel , u Mattithaïah , u Eliab , u Benaïah , u Obed Edom bad u Jeiel ban tem ki duitara . U Asaph un pynsawa ki shakuriaw ,
translated_en_to_kha: U Asaph u rangbah, bad hajan jong u u Seariah, u Jeiel, bad u Semiramoth, bad u Jehiel, bad u Mathaiiah, bad u Elia, bad u Benaiah, bad u Obededom: bad u Jeiel bad ki jingrwai bad ki harp ; hynrei u Asaph u la sawa da ki cymbal ; .

en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads  ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .
kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la lute ïa ka jingkynshew jong ka baroh . Ka la ïohi ïa ki , ba ki rung sha ka Templ hi , ha kaba U  Trai  u la lah khang ïa ki Jentil ban leit .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah jong ka khun jong ka Seion ki shong ha madan , bad ki sngap jar: ki la bret ia ka dewbilat ha ki khlieh jong ki ; ki la pynkhih ia lade da ka sniehdoh: ki khun masi jong ka Jerusalem ki la pynkhih ia la ka khlieh shapoh khyndew .

en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth , and upon every fowl of the air , upon all that moveth upon the earth , and upon all the fishes of the sea  ; into your hand are they delivered .
kha: Baroh ki mrad , ki sim , bad ki dohkha kin im ha ka jingsheptieng ïa phi . La buh ïa ki hapoh ka bor jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingtieng ia phi bad ka jingtieng jong phi kan long halor uwei pa uwei u mrad jong ka khyndew bad halor uwei pa uwei u sim jong ka Iyer , halor kiei kiei baroh kiba iaid halor ka khyndew bad halor ki dohkha baroh jong ka duriaw; ha ka kti jong phi la pynpoi ia ki .

en: And the officers shall speak unto the people , saying , What man is there that hath built a new house , and hath not dedicated it ? let him go and return to his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man dedicate it .
kha: Nangta ki rangbah synshar kin kren ha uta u paidïapom , bad kin ong , ‘ Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep shna ïing thymmai , hynrei u bym pat pynkyntang ïa ka ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat u pynkyntang ïa ka ïing jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki rangbah kin kren ha ki briew ki da ong: Uei u briew uba la tei ia ka iing thymmai bad um shym la aiti ia ka ? to ai ba un leit phai noh sha la iing , ioh ba un iap ha ka thma bad uwei pat u briew un aiti ia ka .

en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Because your fathers have forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , and have walked after other gods , and have served them , and have worshipped them , and have forsaken me , and have not kept my law  ;
kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  u la ong , ‘ Ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la phai dien noh na nga bad ki la mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad kim shym kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta to ong ha ki , Namar ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la iehnoh ia nga , ong U Trai , bad ki la iaid hadien kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la shakri ia ki , bad ki la mane ia ki , bad ki la iehnoh ia nga , bad kim shym la bat ia ka ain jong nga ; .

en: And Moses said unto God , Behold , when I come unto the children of Israel , and shall say unto them , The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you  ; and they shall say to me , What is his name ? what shall I say unto them ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Haba nga leit sha ki Israel bad ngan ong ha ki , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la phah ïa nga sha phi ,’ kin sa kylli ïa nga , ‘ Kaei ka kyrteng jong u ?’ Ngan ong kumno ïa ki ?
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha U Blei , Ha khmih haba nga wan sha ki khun Israel bad ngan ong ha ki: U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la phah ia nga sha phi ; bad kin ong ha nga: Kaei ka kyrteng jong u ? kaei kaba ngan ong ia ki ?

en: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .
kha: Bad namar ka jingaiei U Blei ïa nga , nga ong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi : To wat ñiewkor palat than ïa lade ban ïa kaba phi dei ban leh . Pynban , to long adkar ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi , bad to bishar ïa lade kat kum ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga ong, lyngba ka jingaiei ba la ai ha nga, ha uwei pa uwei uba don hapdeng jong phi, ban ym pyrkhat kham palat ia lade ban pyrkhat ; hynrei ban pyrkhat da kaba jem, kumba U Blei u la leh ha uwei pa uwei u briew ia ka jingthew jong ka jingngeit .

en: And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .
kha: U nonglamktien u jubab ,  Ki Israel ki la phet ïap na ki Philistia ; ka la long ka jingshahjop kaba shyrkhei ïa ngi ; bad nalor kata ki khun jong phi , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei la shah knieh noh !
translated_en_to_kha: U nonglam khubor u la jubab bad u la ong: Ki Israel ki la phet noh ha khmat ki Philistia , bad ka la don ruh ka jingpyniap kaba khraw hapdeng ki briew , bad ki arngut ki khun jong me ruh, u Hophni bad u Phinehas ki la iap , bad la shim noh ia ka synduk U Blei .

en: And the glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fat valley , shall be a fading flower , and as the hasty fruit before the summer  ; which when he that looketh upon it seeth , while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up .
kha: Ka burom jong kito ki nongïalam basarong ka nang jah noh kum ki soh Dumbur ba mih nyngkong jong ka aïom , ba la shim bad bam ïa ki tang shu ih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingitynnad kaba donburom kaba don ha ka khlieh jong ka them kaba heh , kan long u syntiew uba la tyrkhong bad kum u soh uba kyrkieh ha khmat ka por lyiur ; uba haba uta uba peit ia ka u iohi ia ka , katba ka dang don ha ka kti jong u u bam ia ka .

en: And when the people complained , it displeased the  Lord  : and the  Lord  heard it  ; and his anger was kindled  ; and the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them , and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp .
kha: Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban ujor ha U  Trai  shaphang ki jingjynjar jong ki . Haba U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la bitar lep bad u phah da ka ding ha kita ki paidbah . Kata ka ding ka klang hapdeng jong ki bad ka la pynjot ïa kawei ka dong jong ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad haba ki briew ki la ud , ka la pynsngewsih ia U Trai: bad U Trai u la iohsngew ia ka ; bad ka jingbitar jong u ka la bthei ; bad ka ding U Trai ka la thang hapdeng jong ki , bad ka la bam ia ki kiba don ha ki bynta ba kut jong ka shnong .

en: As for me , behold , I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans , which will come unto us : but ye , gather ye wine , and summer fruits , and oil , and put them in your vessels , and dwell in your cities that ye have taken .
kha: Ma nga hi ngan sah ha Mispah bad ngan long u nongmihkhmat jong phi haba ki nong Babilonia kin wan shane . Hynrei phi lah ban lum bad kynshew ïa ka waiñ , ki soh , bad ka umphniang Olib , bad ban shong ban sah ha la ki shnongrit ba phi don .
translated_en_to_kha: Katba ia nga, ha khmih, ngan shong ha Mizpa ban shakri ia ki Khaldi, ki ban wan sha ngi: hynrei phi lum ia ka wain bad ki soh slap bad ka umphniang bad buh ia ki ha ki khiew jong phi bad shong ha ki nongbah jong phi kiba phi la shim .

en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut ka khyndew . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u pynmih ia ka sur jong u , ka don ka jingbun ki um ha ki bneng bad u pynlong ia ki lyer ban kiew na ki tduh jong ka khyndew: u pynmih ia ki lyer da u slap , bad u pynmih ia ka Iyer na ki spah jong u .

en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .
kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi long kiba khlaiñ ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , bad phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la thoh ha phi ko kpa, namar phi la ithuh ia uta uba long naduh kaba sdang . Nga la thoh sha phi ko samla, namar ba phi long kiba skhem, bad ka ktien U Blei ka sah ha phi, bad phi la jop ia uba sniew .

en: And said unto the king , Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me , neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .
kha: bad u ong ,  Ko Syiem kynrad , to klet noh ïa ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh ha kato ka sngi kaba phi la iehnoh ïa ka Jerusalem . Wat buhnud ei ei pyrshah ïa nga lane pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong ha u syiem: Wat ai ba u kynrad jong nga un shim ia ka ha ka dohnud jong u .

en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden : and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen  ; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king .
kha: U syiem u ïeng ha ka jingbitar , u mih na ka kamra bad u leit shabar sha ki kper ka ïingsyiem . U Haman u ïohi ba u syiem u la kut jingmut ban pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta kane , kumta u sah hangta ban kyrpad ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei na ka bynta ka jingim jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U syiem u la mih na ka jingkhawai wain ha ka jingbitar jong u: bad u Haman u la ieng ban pan ia ka jingim jong u ha ka Esther ka mahadei; namar u la iohi ba ka don ka jingsniew kaba la kut jingmut pyrshah ia u da u syiem .

en: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying , A man of God came unto me , and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God , very terrible : but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name :
kha: Te kata ka briew ka leit ïathuh ha la u tnga ,  U briew jong U Blei u la wan ha nga , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka iphieng kum u angel U Blei . Ngam shym kylli ba u wan na-ei , bad u ruh um shym ïathuh ïa la ka kyrteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kata ka kynthei ka la wan bad ka la iathuh ha u tnga jong ka, ka da ong, U briew jong U Blei u la wan sha nga, bad ka khmat jong u ka long kum ka khmat jong u angel U Blei, uba shyrkhei shibun: hynrei ngam shym la kylli ia u naei u don:

en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem  ka don ki jingïathuhkhana shaphang ki khun shynrang jong u Joash , ki jingïathuhlypa kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbuh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta shaphang ki khun shynrang jong u, bad ka jingkhraw jong ki jingkit ba la buh ha u, bad ka jingpynbha ia ka iing U Blei, ha khmih la thoh ha ka jingiathuhkhana jong ki syiem . Bad u Amasaiah u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal : and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him , Thou knowest the thing that the  Lord  said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea .
kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katto katne ki briew na ka jait Judah ki la wan ha u Joshua ha Gilgal . Uwei na ki , u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , u ong ha u ,  Phi tip kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha Kadesh Barnea shaphang jong phi bad nga ha u Moses , u briew jong U Blei .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ki khun Judah ki la wan sha u Joshua ha Gilgal : bad u Caleb u khun u Jephunneh u Kenez u la ong ha u: Me tip ia kata kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ha u Moses u briew jong U Blei shaphang jong nga bad me ha Kadeshbarnea .

en: And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
kha: Lada uta u briew u jubab ,  Ai ngin leh ïa kaba dei bad ieh kin da thang shuwa ïa ka khleiñ ; nangta sa shim katba phi kwah ,  uta u shakri u lyngdoh u ju ong ,  Em ! Ai noh mynta kumne ! Lym kumta , ngan shim ïa ka da ka bor !
translated_en_to_kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ia u: Wat ai ba kin ym thang ia ka shini mynta, bad nangta un shim katba ka mynsiem jong me ka kwah; te un jubab ia u: Em; hynrei me dei ban ai ia ka mynta: bad lada ym dei, ngan shim da ka bor .

en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .
kha: Ngan pynïar ïa ki pud jong ka ri jong phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka duriaw Mediterranian bad naduh ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . Ngan ai ha phi ka bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri , bad phin beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan buh ia ki pud jong me naduh ka duriaw Basaw haduh ka duriaw Philistia bad naduh ka ri khlaw haduh ka wah: namar ngan aiti ia ki nongshong shnong jong ka ri ha ka kti jong me ; bad me dei ban beh noh ia ki ha khmat jong me .

en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .
kha: U Moses u pynkut da kaba ong ,  Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jong nga , bad kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh bad ban mihnoh . Hadien kata ngan sa leit .  Nangta u Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kine ki shakri jong me baroh kin wan hiar sha nga, bad kin dem khrup ha nga, ki da ong: To mih noh na me bad ki briew baroh kiba bud ia me: bad hadien kata ngan leit noh . Bad u la mih noh na u Pharaoh ha ka jingbitar kaba khraw .

en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .
kha: Haba la poi u bnai uba hynñiew , ki briew ka Israel ki la ïashong ïasah ha ki shnong . Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem , ha ka jaka basawdong hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew baroh ki la ialum lang kum uwei u briew ha ka lynti kaba don ha khmat ka khyrdop um bad ki la kren ha u Esra u nongthoh ban wanrah ia ka Kitab ka hukum u Moses kaba U Trai u la hukum ha ki Israel .

en: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah , in the sepulchre of Kish his father : and they performed all that the king commanded . And after that God was entreated for the land .
kha: Nangta ki la tep ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad u Jonathan ha ka jingtep jong u Kish , u kpa jong u Saul , ha Sela ha ka ri Benjamin , ki da pyndep ïa kata baroh kaba u syiem u la hukum . Bad hadien kata , U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki na ka bynta ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shyieng u Saul bad u Jonathan jong u ki la tep ia ki ha ka ri u Benjamin ha ka ri u Ksha u kpa jong u: bad ki la leh ia kiei kiei baroh kiba u syiem u la hukum . Bad hadien kata la pynlong ia U Blei na ka bynta kata ka ri .

en: And it came to pass , while they were slaying them , and I was left , that I fell upon my face , and cried , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem ?
kha: Katba ka jingpynïap ka dang ïaid , nga la don hangta marwei . Nga dem khrup ha khyndew bad nga pyrta ,  Ko  Trai  Nongsynshar , hato me la bitar palat ïa ka Jerusalem ba men pynïap lut ïa baroh kiba dang sah ha Israel ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia katba ki dang pyniap ia ki, bad nga la sah, ba nga la dem khrup bad nga la pyrta bad nga la ong: Ah Trai Blei ! hato me pynjot ia ki Israel baroh kiba sah ha ka jingtuid jong me ha Jerusalem ?

en: I beheld till the thrones were cast down , and the Ancient of days did sit , whose garment was white as snow , and the hair of his head like the pure wool : his throne was like the fiery flame , and his wheels as burning fire .
kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , la buh ïa ki khet ha la ki jaka . Uta uba la im junom u la shong halor kawei na ki khet . Ki jaiñ jong u ki la long kiba lieh kum ka ïor , bad u shñiuh jong u , u long kum u  saiwul nylla . Ïa ka khet jong u , la buh halor ki shalyntem ding , kaba la klang da ka ding ,
translated_en_to_kha: Nga la iohi haduh ba ki khet ki la shah pynhap, bad u hyndai jong ki sngi u la shong, uba ka jain jong u ka long kum u slap, bad u shniuh jong u kum u snieh langbrot uba khuid: ka khet jong u ka long kum ka ding kaba thang ding, bad ki tyrpeng jong u kum ka ding kaba thang .

en: Also he built towers in the desert , and digged many wells : for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains : husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel : for he loved husbandry .
kha: U tei ruh ki kut kiba skhem ha ki rudnong , bad u tih shibun ki pukri , naba u don ki kynhun jingri kiba bun ha kjat ki lum bashaphang sepngi bad ha ki pyntha . Namar ba u ieit ïa ka rep ka riang , u pynshlur ïa ki briew ban thung dieng sohwaiñ ha ki jaka lum bad ban rep ha ki jaka kiba seisoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh u la tei ia ki tower ha ka ri khlaw, bad u la tih bun ki thliew: namar u don shibun ki masi, ha ka ri kaba rit bad ha ki madan: ki nongrep ruh: bad ki nongri sohjew ha ki lum, bad ha Karmel: namar u ieit ia ka kam ri jingri .

en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra buh tiar jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u pynmih ia ka sur jong u , ka don ka jingbun ki um ha ki bneng , bad u pynlong ia ki lyer ban kiew na ki tduh jong ka khyndew ; u pynmih ia ki lyer da u slap , bad u pynmih ia ka Iyer na ki spah jong u .

en: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave . And the unclean spirits went out , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea , ( they were about two thousand  ; ) and were choked in the sea .
kha: U la shah ïa ki ban leit , bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la mih na uta u briew bad ki la rung hapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun sniang baroh kawei — kaba don baroh ar hajar tylli ki sniang — ka la noh kynsan sha ka riat jong ka duriaw bad ïap jyllop .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad mar kumta hi U Jisu u la ai shuti ia ki . Ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la mih noh, bad ki la rung ha ka sniang: bad ka kynhun ka la mareh stet shapoh duriaw , (ki la don kumba ar hajar ; ) bad ki la shah rong noh ha duriaw .

en: If there be in the land famine , if there be pestilence , blasting , mildew , locust , or if there be caterpiller  ; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities  ; whatsoever plague , whatsoever sickness there be  ;
kha: Haba don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri , lane ka jingïapthem , lane ba ïa ki jingthung la pynjot da ka lyer khluit lane ka kynhun ki puit , lane haba ki briew jong me ki shah tur ïaleh ha ki nongshun jong ki , lane haba don ka jingpang hapdeng jong ki ,
translated_en_to_kha: Lada don ha ka ri kaba thylli, lada don ka jingpang khlam, ka jingbthei, ka jingpang sniehdoh, ne lada don ka jingpang sniehdoh ; lada u nongshun jong ki u la ker sawdong ia ki ha ka ri jong ki nongbah jong ki ; kaei kaei ka jingpang kaba don;

en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .
kha: Hynrei u kyntait , bad kumta u ong ïa u ,  Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u sing un sa pynïap ïa phi tang mar shu ïakhlad bad nga .  Tang mar shu ïamih , u sing u wan bad pynïap ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha u: Namar ba me khlem kohnguh ia ka sur U Trai, ha khmih, tang shu leit noh na nga, u sing un pyniap ia me . Bad tang shu leit noh na u , u sing u la lap ia u bad u la pyniap ia u .

en: But the men would not hearken to him : so the man took his concubine , and brought her forth unto them  ; and they knew her , and abused her all the night until the morning : and when the day began to spring , they let her go .
kha: Hynrei kita ki briew kim shahshkor satia ïa u . Kumta u Lebi u shim ïa la ka tnga kliar bad u buh ïa ka shabar bad ki . Ki pynjahburom da kaba leh sang ïa ka baroh shi miet bad ki khlem sangeh haduh mynstep .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ki shynrang kim shym la sngap ia u: kumta uta u briew u la shim ia ka tnga jong u, bad u la wanrah ia ka shabar sha ki ; bad ki la ithuh ia ka, bad ki la leh bein ia ka baroh shi miet: bad ynda ka sngi ka la sdang ban mih ka sngi, ki la pyllait noh ia ka .

en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers : and , behold , this vine did bend her roots toward him , and shot forth her branches toward him , that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation .
kha: La don sa uwei u pukni radbah uba don ki thapniang kiba khraw bad ki sner kiba rben . Bad mynta u dieng sohwaiñ u pyiar ïa la ki thied sha u bad u la pynphai ïa la ki sla sha u , ha ka jingkyrmen ba un ai ïa u kham bun ka um ban ïa kaba ka don ha ka kper ha kaba u san .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka don ruh kawei pat ka blang kaba heh bad kaba bun ki bniat: bad, ha khmih, une u sohjew u la pynkhih ia ki tynrai jong ka sha u , bad u la pynkhih ia ki tnat jong ka sha u , ba un ai um ia ka da ki bniat jong ka jingthung jong ka .

en: And he came unto the men of Succoth , and said , Behold Zebah and Zalmunna , with whom ye did upbraid me , saying , Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand , that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary ?
kha: Nangta u Gideon u leit sha ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth bad u ong ,  Kynmaw haba phi la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga ? Phi ong ba phim lah ban ai jingbam ei ei ïa ki shipai jong nga kiba la thait ïan namar ba ngam pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna . Te , kine hangne !
translated_en_to_kha: U la wan sha ki briew jong ka Sucoth bad u la ong, Ha khmih u Sebah bad u Zalmunna, kiba phi la pynkhih ia nga, da kaba ong: Hato ki kti u Sebah bad u Zalmunna mynta ki don ha ka kti jong me, ba ngin ai kpu ia ki briew jong me kiba la thait ?

en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
kha: Nangta u la phai sha kata ka briew bad u la ong ha u Simon ,  Me ïohi ïa kane ka briew ? Nga la wan shapoh ka ïing jong me , bad mem shym la ai um ïa nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga , hynrei ka la sait ïa ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka bad ka la ñiad rkhiang ïa ki da u shñiuh jong ka .
translated_en_to_kha: U la phai sha kata ka kynthei bad u la ong ha u Simon, Me iohi ia kane ka kynthei ? Nga la rung ha iing jong me, me khlem ai um ia nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga: hynrei ka la sait ia ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat bad ka la sait ia ki da ki shniuh khlieh jong ka .

en: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .
kha: U Moses u kren ha u paidbah ,  Kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi long ki mraw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki briew: Kynmaw ia kane ka sngi, ha kaba phi la mih na Ijipt, na ka iing jong ka jinglong mraw ; namar da ka bor jong ka kti U Trai u la pynmih ia phi na kane ka jaka: ym dei ban bam ia u kpu ba la khleh lang .

en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;
kha: Yn aiti noh ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un kren ïa u hi da lade .
translated_en_to_kha: U Sedekaiah u syiem Judah un ym lait na ka kti jong ki Khaldian , hynrei un shah aiti shisha ha ka kti jong u syiem Babilon , bad un kren bad u da ka shyntur sha ka shyntur , bad ki khmat jong u kin iohi ia ki khmat jong u;

en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u , U  Trai  un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bad un thung ïa u ban long nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei mynta ka hima jong me kan ym bteng: U Trai u la wad ia u briew katkum ka dohnud jong u hi, bad U Trai u la hukum ia u ban long u kapten halor ki briew jong u, namar ba me khlem sumar ia kata kaba U Trai u la hukum ia me .

en: Yea , they made their hearts as an adamant stone , lest they should hear the law , and the words which the  Lord  of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets : therefore came a great wrath from the  Lord  of hosts .
kha: bad ki pynlong ïa ki dohnud jong ki , kiba eh kum u mawsiang . Namar ba kim shym la shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la phah lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im slem bah , nga la bitar shikatdei eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , ki la pynlong ia ki dohnud jong ki kum u maw uba sngewsih , ioh ba kin iohsngew ia ka hukum bad ki ktien kiba U Trai jong ki paid u la phah ha ka mynsiem jong u da ki nongiathuhlypa kiba mynshuwa: namarkata ka la wan ka jingbitar kaba khraw na U Trai jong ki paid .

en: To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .
kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba ma ngi ki nong Rom ngim ju mlien ban aiti ïa uno uno uba la shah kynnoh ha ka kam runar ha shuwa ba un ïakynduh ïa ki nongmudui jong u markhmat bad ba u la ïoh ka lad ban ïasaid da ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka jingkynnoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha uba nga la jubab , Kam dei ka rukom jong ki nong Rom ban pynpoi ia uno uno u briew ban iap , shuwa ba uta uba shah kynnoh un iakynduh khmat , bad u don ka laisen ban jubab na ka bynta lade shaphang ka kam runar kaba la buh pyrshah ia u .

en: But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee  ;
kha: Hynrei khie joit bad ïeng . Nga la paw ha me ban thung ïa me kum u shakri jong nga . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kiwei pat ïa kaba me la ïohi ïa nga ha kane ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaba ngan pyn-i ha me ha ka ban sa wan .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to khie bad ieng ha ki kjat jong me: namar nga la paw ha me na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu, ban pynlong ia me u nongshakri bad u sakhi ia kine kiei kiei baroh ar kiba me la iohi, bad ia kita kiei kiei ha kiba ngan paw ha me;

en: The  Lord  of hosts shall defend them  ; and they shall devour , and subdue with sling stones  ; and they shall drink , and make a noise as through wine  ; and they shall be filled like bowls , and as the corners of the altar .
kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un ïada ïa ki briew jong u , bad kin pynjot ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Kin pyrta ha ka thma kum ki rangbah ba la buaid bad kin pynmih ïa ka snam jong ki nongshun jong ki ; kan tuid kum ka snam jong ka jingkñia ba la theh halor ka duwan na ka jingdiang .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai jong ki paid un iada ia ki ; bad kin bam ia ki da ki maw kiba rkhiang ; bad kin dih , bad kin pynmih ia ka jingsawa kumba lyngba ka wain ; bad kin sa dap kum ki khiew bad kum ki thliew jong ka almari .

en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go through the midst of the city , through the midst of Jerusalem , and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof .
kha: Khie ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah Jerusalem bad buh dak ha ka shyllangmat jong uwei pa uwei uba shem jynjar bad khuslai namar ki kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli kiba la leh ha ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Trai u la ong ha u: To iaid lyngba ka nongbah, lyngba ka Jerusalem, bad buh dak ha ki khlieh jong ki briew kiba ud bad kiba iam na ka bynta ki jingleh bymman baroh kiba la leh hapdeng jong ka .

en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .
kha: U don ruh shibun ngut ki shakri bad u la long u briew bariewspah tam ha ka ri Mihngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingdon jong u ruh ka long hynriew hajar tylli ki langbrot bad lai hajar tylli ki kulai bad san spah tylli ki masi bad san spah tylli ki masi bad ka iing kaba heh bha; kumta une u briew u long uba khraw tam na ki briew baroh kiba na mihngi .

en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel , after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them  ; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred .
kha: U syiem Solomon u shim jingkheiñ ïa ki nongwei baroh kiba shong ha ka ri Israel , syriem kum ka jingkheiñbriew kaba la shim da u Dabid u kpa jong u . La don shi lakh sanphew lai hajar hynriewspah ngut ki nongwei kiba shong basah .
translated_en_to_kha: U Solomon u la khein ia ki nongwei baroh kiba don ha ka ri Israel, hadien ka jingkhein ia ki da u kpa jong u u la khein ia ki ; bad la lap ia ki shispah sanphew hajar bad lai hajar hynriew spah .

en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife  ; and he said , She is my sister : for he feared to say , She is my wife  ; lest , said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah  ; because she was fair to look upon .
kha: Haba ki briew hangta ki kylli shaphang ka tnga jong u , u jubab ba ka dei ka para jong u . Um shym ïathuh ba ka dei ka tnga jong u , namar u sheptieng ïoh ba ki briew hangta kin pynïap ïa u ban ïoh ïa ka Rebekka , kaba long kaba bhabriew eh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki shynrang jong kata ka jaka ki la kylli ia u na ka bynta ka tnga jong u ; bad u la ong, Ka dei ka para jong nga: namar u la tieng ban ong: Ka dei ka tnga jong nga ; na ka bynta kata ka jaka ki dei ban pyniap ia nga na ka bynta ka Rebekah ; namar ba ka la dei ban peit ia ka .

en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to slay the souls that should not die , and to save the souls alive that should not live , by your lying to my people that hear your lies ?
kha: Phi pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat ki briew jong nga khnang ban ïoh katto katne kham u barli bad khyndiat tylli ki lyngkhot kpu . Phi pynïap ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban ïap , bad phi pynsah im ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban im . Kumta phi ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ngeit ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad phin pynjakhlia ia nga hapdeng ki briew jong nga na ka bynta ki kti jong u barli bad na ka bynta ki kpu , ban pyniap ia ki mynsiem ki bym dei ban iap , bad ban pynim ia ki mynsiem kiba ym dei ban im , da kaba thok ia ki briew jong nga kiba iohsngew ia ki jinglamler jong phi ?

en: And David rose up early in the morning , and left the sheep with a keeper , and took , and went , as Jesse had commanded him  ; and he came to the trench , as the host was going forth to the fight , and shouted for the battle .
kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Dabid u khie dang step phyrngab , u ieh ïa ki langbrot ha uwei pat u nongsharai , u rah ïa kata ka jingbam , bad u leit kumba u Jesse u la bthah ïa u . U poi ha ka jaka sher dara hamar ba ki Israel ki dang leit sha ka madan thma , ki da ïarisa ha ka sur-thma .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la khie dang step, bad u la iehnoh ia ki langbrot bad u nongap langbrot, bad u la leit noh kumba u Jesse u la hukum ia u bad u la poi sha ka thliew, katba u shipai u dang leit sha ka thma.

en: And their camels shall be a booty , and the multitude of their cattle a spoil : and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners  ; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof , saith the  Lord .
kha: Shim ïa ki ut jong ki bad ïa baroh ki jingri jong ki ! Ngan pynsakma sha ki liang baroh ba kito ki briew kiba la khap lyngkot ïa la ki shñiuh , bad ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ki na ki liang baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki kulai jong ki kin long ka jingjot, bad ki masi jong ki kin sa bthei: bad ngan pynphriang sha ki Iyer baroh kiba don ha ki thliew baroh kiwei bad ngan wanrah ia ka jingjynjar jong ki na baroh ki liang jong ka , ong U Trai .

en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?
kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab ,  Hato ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ïohi ba ha kaba kut ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Ngi long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki rangbah jong me ban sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ngi ?
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Abner u la khot ia u Joab bad u la ong, Hato ka waitlam kan bam noh junom ? phim tip ba kan long ka jingsngewsih ha kaba kut ? katno por te , hato me la ong ia ki briew ban wan phai noh na kaba bud ia ki hynmen jong ki ?

en: But if he be not able to restore it to him , then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee : and in the jubilee it shall go out , and he shall return unto his possession .
kha: Hynrei lada um kotbor ban thied pat ïa ka , kan ïaisah hi ha ka kti uta u nongthied haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat . Ha kata ka snem yn sa pynphai pat ïa ka sha u trai uba nyngkong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada um lah ban pynphai biang ia ka ha u , te kata ka long ha ka kti jong uta uba la thied ia ka haduh ka snem jubilee: bad ha ka jubilee kan mih noh bad un leit phai noh sha la ka jong ka .

en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye be come into the land which I give unto you , and shall reap the harvest thereof , then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest :
kha: Ong ha ki Israel ,  Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi , bad haba phi ot ïa u kew , leit rah ïa ka song kaba nyngkong sha u lyngdoh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren ha ki khun Israel bad ong ha ki: Ynda phi la poi ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phi bad phin kheit ia u soh jong ka , te phin wanrah ia ka snieh kaba nyngkong eh jong u soh jong phi ha u lyngdoh:

en: And he began to speak unto them by parables .  A certain man planted a vineyard , and set an hedge about it , and digged a place for the winefat , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country .
kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la kren ha ki ha ki pharshi :  Shisien la don u briew uba don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la thaw ka jingker baroh sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew ban khñiot sohwaiñ , bad u la thaw ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ sha ki nongshimwai bad u la mih na ïing ban leit jingleit .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la sdang ban kren ia ki da ki pharshi . Uwei u briew u la thung ia ka kper sohjew , bad u la buh ia ka jingkhang sawdong jong ka , bad u la tih ia ka jaka na ka bynta ka jingbam sohjew , bad u la tei ia ka tower , bad u la pyllait ia ka sha ki nongrep , bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai .

en: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah , and Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the proud men , saying unto Jeremiah , Thou speakest falsely : the  Lord  our God hath not sent thee to say , Go not into Egypt to sojourn there :
