kha: Nangta u Asaraïah u khun jong u Hoshaïah bad u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah ba leh meng ki la ong ïa nga ,  Phi shukor . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um shym la phah ïa phi ban ong ha ngi ba ngin ym leit bad shong ha Ijipt .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Asaria u khun u Hosaiah bad u Johanan u khun u Krea, bad ki briew baroh kiba sngew sarong, ki da ong ha u Jeremaiah: Me kren bakla: U Trai U Blei jong ngi um shym la phah ia me ban ong: Wat leit sha Ijipt ban sah hangta:

en: Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .
kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglong bakongsan shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sngi bakhadduh ,” U Jisu u la ong : “Te ia kane ka gospel jong ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh , ia kaban long ka jingphla ha ki kynja bynriew baroh ; ynda kumta kein kan jia kata kaba kut .” —Mathaios 24 :14 .
translated_en_to_kha: Da kaba iathuh lypa ia ka bynta kaba kongsan jong ka dak ki sngi ba khatduh,  U Jisu u la ong: Kane ka khubor babha jong ka hima yn sa ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei na ka bynta ka jingsakhi ia ki jaitbynriew baroh; bad nangta ka jingkut kan sa wan .

en: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land  ; a rumour shall both come one year , and after that in another year shall come a rumour , and violence in the land , ruler against ruler .
kha: Wat nym duh noh ïa ka jingshlur ne sheptieng namar ki khubor lamler ba phi ïohsngew . Man ka snem ki khubor lamler bapher ki phriang — ki khubor lamler shaphang ka jinglehbor ha ka ri bad ba uwei u syiem u ïaleh ïa uwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ioh ba ka dohnud jong phi kan khih, bad phi tieng ia ka khubor kaba yn iohsngew ha ka ri; ka khubor kan wan ha kawei ka snem , bad ka jingleh donbor ha ka ri .

en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .
kha: U syiem Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki sum , bad ar lakh phraphew ngut ki rangbah na Benjamin , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki long kiba shlur , ki rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .
translated_en_to_kha: U Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba don ki thliew bad ki khnam, na Judah lai spah hajar bad na Benjamin, kiba don ki shipai bad ki khnam, ar spah saw hajar: kine baroh ki long ki briew kiba khlain bor .

en: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him , and smote the Philistine , and killed him . Then the men of David sware unto him , saying , Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle , that thou quench not the light of Israel .
kha: Hynrei u Abishai u khun jong ka Seruïah u wan ïarap ïa u Dabid , u tur ïaleh ïa u ramhah , bad u pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynkular ïa u Dabid ba un ym leit shuh da lei lei ruh bad ki sha ka thma .  Phi long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel , bad ngim kwah ban duh noh ïa phi ,  ki la ong .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u Abisai u khun u Seruiah u la iarap ia u, bad u la shoh ia u Philistia bad u la pyniap ia u . Nangta ki briew jong u Dabid ki la sngap jar ia u, ki da ong: Wat leit shuh bad ngi sha ka thma, ba me ym pynlip ia ka jingshai jong ki Israel .

en: And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
kha: Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak ,  Khie leit ! U  Trai  u ïalam ïa me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjop halor u Sisera .  Kumta u Barak u la leit arsut na u Lum Tabor lem bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Deborah u la ong ha u Barak, Up ; namar kane ka dei ka sngi ha kaba U Trai u la aiti ia u Sisera ha ka kti jong me: hato U Trai um shym la mih shuwa jong me ? Kumta u Barak u la hiar na u lum Tabor bad shi hajar ngut ki briew hadien jong u .

en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the  Lord  : it shall not be treasured nor laid up  ; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the  Lord  , to eat sufficiently , and for durable clothing .
kha: Ïa ka pisa kaba ka kamai da ka jingkhaïi pateng , yn pynkyntang sha U  Trai . Pynban kan ym buh tyngkai , hynrei kito kiba mane ïa U  Trai  , kin pyndonkam ïa ka pisa jong ka ban thied jingbam bad ki jaiñ ki nep kiba ki donkam .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ki mar ki mata jong ka bad ka bainong jong ka kin long kiba khuid ha U Trai: ym dei ban buh spah ne buh ia ka mar jong ka ha ka por ba ki shong ha khmat U Trai, ban bam bha bad na ka bynta ki jain kiba neh .

en: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour : and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine , the fourth part of an hin .
kha: Ryngkat bad uta , phin ai ruh ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam . Ka jingiwbih jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Phin ai lang ruh bad kata ka jingkñia shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh dih .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka jingainguh doh jong ka kan long ar tylli ki jingai sngewbha kiba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang, ka jingainguh kaba la shna da ka ding ha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingsma kaba thiang: bad ka jingainguh dih jong ka kan long ka wain , ka bynta kaba saw jong ka hin .

en: In like manner shalt thou do with his ass  ; and so shalt thou do with his raiment  ; and with all lost thing of thy brother s , which he hath lost , and thou hast found , shalt thou do likewise : thou mayest not hide thyself .
kha: Leh kumjuh haba phi lap ïa ka kada , ka jaiñkup , lane kaei kaei kaba jah kaba dei ka jong u para Israel jong phi ; wat shu ieh khlem da ïarap .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom to leh bad ka tdong jong u; bad kumta to leh ia ka jingbam jong u; bad bad ka jinglong ba la jah noh jong u hynmen jong me, kaba u la jah noh, bad me la shem, me leh kumjuh: me lah ban buhrieh ia lade .

en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel , and said unto them , Why are ye come out to set your battle in array ? am not I a Philistine , and ye servants to Saul ? choose you a man for you , and let him come down to me .
kha: U Goliath u ïeng bad u byrthen ïa ki Israel ,  Phi ïaleh aïu hangto , pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ? Nga , nga dei u Philistia , phi ki mraw u Saul ! Jied uwei na ki rangbah jong phi ban ïaleh bad nga .
translated_en_to_kha: U la ieng bad u la pyrta ha ki shipai Israel bad u la ong ha ki, Balei phi mih ban buh ia ka thma jong phi ha ka jaka ? hato ngam dei u Philistia bad phi ki shakri ia u Saul ? jied ia phi u briew na ka bynta jong phi bad to ai ba un wan hiar sha nga .

en: And I will bring them out from the people , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them to their own land , and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers , and in all the inhabited places of the country .
kha: Ngan wallam noh ïa ki na ki ri nongwei , ngan lumlang ïa ki , bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , ngan ïalam biang ïa ki sha ki lumbah bad ki wahduid ka Israel bad ngan bsa ïa ki ha ki jaka bam phlang kiba sngewtynnat .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynmih ia ki na ki briew bad ngan lum ia ki na ki ri bad ngan wanrah ia ki sha la ka jong ka ri bad ngan ai bam ia ki ha ki lum Israel da ki wah bad ha ki jaka ba shong ha ki ri baroh .

en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah , and tell him , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall burn it with fire :
kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga ban leit bad ban ong ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ai ïa kane ka nongbah ha u syiem ka Babilonia , bad un thang duh ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumta u ong U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel; To leit bad kren ha u Sedekaiah u syiem Judah, bad to iathuh ha u: Kumta u ong u Trai; Ha khmih , ngan aiti ia kane ka shnong ha ka kti u syiem Babilon .

en: And it shall come to pass , that like as I have watched over them , to pluck up , and to break down , and to throw down , and to destroy , and to afflict  ; so will I watch over them , to build , and to plant , saith the  Lord .
kha: Bad kumba nga la ïaleh shitom ban rat noh , ban pyntwa , ban jop , ban pynjot bad ban pynpra ïa ki , kumta ruh ngan ïaleh shitom ban thung ïa ki bad ban tei pat ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia , kumba nga la peit ia ki, ban kheit bad ban pynpra bad ban pynjot bad ban pynjot; kumta ngan peit ia ki, ban tei bad ban thung, ong U Trai .

en: And they came , both men and women , as many as were willing hearted , and brought bracelets , and earrings , and rings , and tablets , all jewels of gold : and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the  Lord .
kha: Baroh kiba kwah kumta , kynthei bad shynrang , ki ïawan rah ïa ki jingpyndait ba la oh-shrong , ki sohshkor , ki sati , ki kpieng , bad ki jingdeng ksiar kiba har rukom , bad ki pynkyntang ïa ki sha U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la wan, ki shynrang bad ki kynthei, katba ki mon sngewbha, bad ki la wanrah ia ki brace, bad ki shkor bad ki ryntieh ksiar baroh: bad uwei pa uwei u briew uba la tyrwa ia ka jingainguh ksiar ha U Trai .

en: For I know him , that he will command his children and his household after him , and they shall keep the way of the  Lord  , to do justice and judgment  ; that the  Lord  may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him .
kha: Nga la jied ïa u khnang ba un hukum ïa la ki khun shynrang bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kata kaba dei bad kaba hok . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan leh lut ïa kata kaba nga la kular ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga tip ia u, ba un hukum ia ki khun jong u bad ka iing jong u hadien jong u, bad kin sumar ia ka lynti U Trai, ban leh ia ka hok bad ka jingbishar ; ba U Trai un wanrah ha u Abraham ia kaba u la kren shaphang jong u .

en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place , and put on his garments , and come forth , and offer his burnt offering , and the burnt offering of the people , and make an atonement for himself , and for the people .
kha: U dei ban sum ha ka jaka kaba khuid bad phong da la ki jong ki jaiñ . Hadien kata , un mih shabar bad un kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang ban weng noh ïa ki pop jong u bad ïa ki pop jong u paidbah de .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un sait ia ka doh jong u da ka um ha ka jaka bakhuid , bad un phong ia ki jain jong u , bad un wan shabar , bad un aiti ia ka jingainguh thang jong u bad ka jingainguh thang jong ki briew , bad un leh ia ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta lade bad na ka bynta ki briew .

en: That ye shall say , Thy servants  trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now , both we , and also our fathers : that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen  ; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians .
kha: phin jubab ba phi dei ki nongri jingri baroh shi jingim kumba long ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumta keiñ un shah ïa phi ban shong ha Goshen ; namar ki nong Ijipt kim kwah kano kano ka jingïadei bad ki nongap langbrot .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba phin ong , Ki shakri jong me ki la long shaphang ki masi naduh mynta , ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi: ba phin shong ha ka ri Goshen ; namar uwei pa uwei u nongap langbrot u long uba sngewsih ia ki nong Ijipt .

en: And while he lingered , the men laid hold upon his hand , and upon the hand of his wife , and upon the hand of his two daughters  ; the  Lord  being merciful unto him : and they brought him forth , and set him without the city .
kha: U Lot u leh tud pynban . Hynrei U  Trai  u la leh-isynei ïa u ; kumta kita ki rangbah ki shim ïa u , ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar kata ka nongbah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad katba u dang sahkut, ki shynrang ki la bat ia ka kti jong u, bad ha ka kti jong ka tnga jong u, bad ha ka kti jong ki arngut ki khun kynthei jong u; bad ki la wanrah ia u shabar jong ka shnong .

en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall , that he died in Thebez ? why went ye nigh the wall ? then say thou , Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
kha: Phim kynmaw kumno u Abimelekh , u khun jong u Gideon u la shah pynïap ? Ka dei ha Thebes ba ka kynthei ka la pynhap shapoh ïa u mawtylliat na ka kynroh bad la pynïap ïa u . Balei , keiñ , phi leit tur sha jan eh jong ka kynroh ?’ Lada u syiem u kylli ïa kane na phi , ïathuh ïa u , ‘ U Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .’
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la shoh ia u khun u Jerubeseth ? hato ka kynthei kam shym la bret ia u mawsiang halor jong u na ka jingkhang ? balei phi la leit shajan ka jingkhang ? nangta to ong ia me, U shakri jong me u la iap ruh .

en: And I will multiply upon you man and beast  ; and they shall increase and bring fruit : and I will settle you after your old estates , and will do better unto you than at your beginnings : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
kha: Ngan pynroi ïa ki briew bad ïa ki jingri . Hangta phin nang kham roi ban ïa kaba long mynshuwa bad phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti . Ngan shah ïa phi ban shong hangta kumba phi la ju shong , bad ngan pynlong ïa phi ban kham man roi ban ïa kaba mynshuwa . Te phin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: Ngan pynbun ia phi u briew bad u mrad bad kin nangroi bad kin sa sei soh: bad ngan pynshong ia phi katkum ki jaka barim jong phi, bad ngan leh kham bha ia phi ban ia kaba sdang jong phi: bad phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .

en: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies , and seest horses , and chariots , and a people more than thou , be not afraid of them : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
kha: Haba phi leit ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong phi bad phi ïohi ba ki kali ïaleh thma , ki kulai , bad ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ban ïa ki jong phi , wat sheptieng ïa ki . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt , un don ryngkat bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba me leit sha ka thma pyrshah ia ki nongshun jong me, bad haba me iohi ia ki kulai bad ki kali kit nongshong shnong kiba kham palat ia me: namar U Trai U Blei jong me u don ryngkat bad me, uba la pynmih ia me na ka ri Ijipt .

en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .
kha: Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa phi kin shah klun , bad ïa baroh ki nongshun jong phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn banbeiñ , bad ïa baroh kiba lute ïa phi yn lute .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata baroh kiba bam ia me kin shah rong noh bad ki nongshun jong me baroh kin leit sha ka jingshah set phatok bad kita kiba pynsniew ia me kin long ka jingjot , bad baroh kiba bam ia me ngan ai ia ka jingbam .

en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day , that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it  ; ye shall not prolong your days upon it , but shall utterly be destroyed .
kha: Nga khot ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew ban sakhi pyrshah ïa phi ba , lada phim kohnguh ïa nga , phin sa jah noh shen na kata ka ri ; phin ym im slem ha kata ka ri sha shiliang ka Jordan ïa kaba phin sa ïohkynti . Yn sa pynjot thiaw ïa phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga khot ia ka bneng bad ka khyndew ban sakhi pyrshah ia phi ha kane ka sngi , ba phin sa jah noh shen na ka ri kaba phi leit sha ka Jordan ban ioh ia ka; phin ym pynjlan ia ki sngi jong phi ha ka, hynrei phin sa shah pynjot lut .

en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt  ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .
kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha kata ka sngi ha kaba nga la btin ïa ki bad la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Kim shym ïaineh ha kata ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki , bad kumta ngam shym shahshkor shuh ïa ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ym kat kum ka jutang kaba nga la leh bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha ka sngi ba nga la shim ia ki da ka kti ban ialam ia ki na ka ri Ijipt ; namar kim shym la bteng ha ka jutang jong nga , bad ngam shym la khein ia ki , ong U Trai .

en: And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .
kha: Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka  erïong ba ka wan na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh uba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawdong jong u , ka phyrnai . Ha ka jaka ba ka leilieh ka thaba , don kaei kaei kaba phyrnai kum ka rnong .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga peit, bad, ha khmih, ka lyer kaba jur ka la mih na shaphang shathie, bad ka ding ka la rung hi, bad ka jingshai ka la don sawdong jong ka, bad na pdeng jong ka kum ka rong jong u amber, na pdeng jong ka ding .

en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kaba nga ong yn pyndep . Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ha ka por ka jong phi hi , ko ki nongïeng ïaleh pyrshah , ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la maham ïa phi ba ngan leh . Nga la kren ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar nga long U Trai : Ngan kren, bad ka ktien kaba ngan kren kan ym long shuh: namar ha ki sngi jong phi, ko iing kaba leh pyrshah, ngan kren ia ka ktien bad ngan leh ia kata, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And he shall speak great words against the most High , and shall wear out the saints of the most High , and think to change times and laws : and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time .
kha: Un kren pyrshah ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh bad banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U Blei . Un pyrshang ban pynkylla ïa ki aiñ niam bad ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong ki , bad ki briew jong U Blei kin long hapoh ka bor jong u haduh lai snem shiteng .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad un kren ia ki ktien kiba khraw tam pyrshah ia kiba ha khlieh duh tam, bad un pynkhih ia ki riewkhuid jong kiba ha khlieh duh: bad kin shah ai ha ka kti jong u haduh ka por bad ka jingphiah ia ka por .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and his abominations which he did , and that which was found in him , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .
kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoïakim u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong u bad ki kam bymman kiba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel Bad Ka Judah . U Jehoïakhin u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Jehoiakim bad ki jingleh bymman jong u kiba u la leh bad kiba la lap ha u: ha khmih la thoh ha ka kot ki syiem Israel bad Judah: bad u khun jong u u la synshar ha ka jaka jong u .

en: And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you , it be done speedily ,
kha: Nga hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka ïing jingkynshew ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi ban pynbiang khlem pynslem ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ha ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u pan ,
translated_en_to_kha: Bad nga, wat nga ruh nga long u nongbuh pisa baroh kiba don sha shiliang wah, ba kaei kaei kaba u Esra u lyngdoh u Esra u nongthoh ka hukum U Blei jong ka bneng un dawa na phi, dei ban leh kloi .

en: I write unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I write unto you , young men , because ye have overcome the wicked one . I write unto you , little children , because ye have known the Father .
kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u uba la long naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nga thoh ha phi ko kpa, namar phi la ithuh ia uta uba long naduh kaba sdang . Nga thoh ha phi ko samla, namar phi la jop ia u bymman . Nga thoh sha phi ko khun rit, namar phi la ithuh ia U Kpa .

en: Let not my lord , I pray thee , regard this man of Belial , even Nabal : for as his name is , so is he  ; Nabal is his name , and folly is with him : but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord , whom thou didst send .
kha: Sngewbha , wat pynleit jingmut ei ei ïa u Nabal , uto u bym long ei ei ! U dei hi thik kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka mut — u bieit ! Kynrad , ngam shym don hangta haba ki shakri jong phi ki wan poi .
translated_en_to_kha: Wat ia u kynrad jong nga, nga kyrpad ia me, to khein ia une u briew uba sniew, wat ia u Nabal: namar kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka long, bad u Nabal u long bad u: hynrei nga u nongtrei jong me ngam shym la iohi ia ki samla jong u kynrad jong nga, kiba me la phah .

en: But if the ministration of death , written and engraven in stones , was glorious , so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance ; which glory was to be done away :
kha: Ïa ka Hukum la oh dur da ki dak halor ki mawlyngkniap , bad ka burom U Blei ka la wan hiar mynba la ai ïa ka . Wat la ka jingtyngshaiñ ha ka durkhmat u Moses ka la sdang ban lip noh , ka la long kaba khlaiñ haduh katta katta ba ki paid Israel kim shym lah ban peit shlip ïa la ki khmat ha u .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei lada ka jingpynlong ia ka jingiap, kaba la thoh bad kaba la thoh da ki maw, kam shym la long kaba donburom, haduh ba ki khun Israel kim lah ban iohi ia ka khmat u Moses na ka bynta ka burom jong u; kaba ka burom ka la dei ban jah noh:

en: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . And when the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .
kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah , kita ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit kiew bad la ki briew ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , bad ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kata bad ki la sheptieng ,
translated_en_to_kha: Ki Philistia ki la iohsngew ba ki khun Israel ki la ialum lang ha Mizpah , ki kynrad jong ki Philistia ki la leit sha Israel . Bad haba ki khun Israel ki la iohsngew ia kata , ki la tieng ia ki Philistia .

en: And they sung a new song , saying , Thou art worthy to take the book , and to open the seals thereof : for thou wast slain , and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred , and tongue , and people , and nation  ;
kha: Ki la rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai :  Me long uba dei hok ban shim ïa ka kot kli bad ban pynpait ïa ki jingpyndait jong ka . Naba la pynïap ïa me , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong me me la siew kuna na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei na kawei pa kawei ka jait , ka jait ktien , ka hima bad ka jaitbynriew .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la rwai ia ka jingrwai kaba thymmai, ki da ong: Me long uba bit ban shim ia ka kot bad ban plie ia ki muhor jong ka: namar me la pyniap ia ngi, bad me la siewspah ia ngi ha U Blei da ka snam jong me na ka jaitbynriew baroh, bad ka shyntur bad ki briew bad ka jaitbynriew;

en: And when these days are expired , it shall be , that upon the eighth day , and so forward , the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar , and your peace offerings  ; and I will accept you , saith the Lord  God .
kha: Haba la kut shi taïew , ki lyngdoh kin sdang ki jingainguh thang halor ka duwan bad ki jingainguh thang jingïasyllok ki paidbah . Te ngan sngewbha na bynta jong phi baroh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda kine ki sngi ki la kut noh, kan long, ba ha ka sngi kaba phra, bad kumta ter ter, ki lyngdoh kin leh ia ki jingknia thang jong phi halor ka almari, bad ki jingknia jingsuk jong phi; bad ngan pdiang ia phi, ong U Trai Blei .

en: And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .
kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki ïakem  iar khiar baroh shi sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi miet , bad baroh shi sngi ha kawei pat ka sngi ; ym don uwei ruh uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar kilo . Nangta ki thad ïa ki sawdong kata ka jaka shong dara .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki briew ki la ieng baroh shisngi, bad baroh shi miet, bad baroh shisngi: uta uba la lum tang shiphew ngut ki nongshong shnong: bad ki la pynphriang ia ki baroh shabar ri na ka bynta jong ki sawdong ka camp .

en: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt , for it was not leavened  ; because they were thrust out of Egypt , and could not tarry , neither had they prepared for themselves any victual .
kha: Ki shet ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat na uta u kpu im ba ki wanrah na Ijipt , naba ki la shah beh kynsan na ka ri Ijipt ba kim ïoh por ban da khreh jingbam lane ban pynkhreh ïa u kpu im .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki la shet ia ki cake bym don thied na Ijipt , namar ym shym la pynmih ia ka; namar ba la pynmih ia ki na Ijipt , bad kim lah ban sahkut , bad kim shym la pynkhreh ia lade ia ka jingbam .

en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished , and rose up in haste , and spake , and said unto his counsellors , Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire ? They answered and said unto the king , True , O king .
kha: Kynsan kynsan u Nebukhadnessar u la rynsied da kaba ïeng ha ka jinglyngngoh . U la kylli ïa ki rangbah synshar ,  Hato ym dei ba ngi la khum lai ngut ki rangbah bad bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang ?  Ki la jubab ,  Ho-oid , ngi la leh kumta , ko Syiem Kynrad .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Neuchadnezzar u la lyngngoh, bad u la ieng kyrkieh bad u la kren ha ki nongai jingmut jong u, Hato ngim shym la bret ia lai ngut ki briew kiba la shah teh hapdeng ka ding ? Ki la jubab bad ki la ong ha u syiem: Hooid ko syiem .

en: And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?
kha: Hynrei u Dabid u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u ,  Mano ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hato phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? Mynta , nga dei ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel bad ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynïap ïa uno uno ruh u Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong: Kaei kaba nga don bad phi, ko khun jong u Seruiah, ba phi dei ban long ki nongshun ia nga mynta ka sngi ? hato don mano mano ba shah pyniap ha kane ka sngi ha Israel ? namar ngam tip ba nga long mynta ka sngi syiem halor ki Israel ?

en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot , Turn thine hand , and carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .
kha: Pynban ka jia ryngkhat hangta ba uwei u shipai Syria u siat da u khnam uba leit dei ïa u syiem Ahab napdeng ki jingpyndait ka jingkieng atiar jong u .  Nga la mynsaw !  u lynñiar ha u nongñiah kali ïapom jong u .  Phai bad kynran noh na ka thma !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u la ring ia ka bow ha ka jaka ri jingri, bad u la shoh ia u syiem Israel hapdeng ki shyieng jong u sohjew: namar kata u la ong ha u nongniah kali jong u: To pynphai ia ka kti jong me, bad rah ia nga na ka jaka ri khunswet; namar nga la mynsaw .

en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread  ; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses : for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .
kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ym bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat — bam tang ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat . Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong phi dei ban bret noh ïa u thiat baroh na ïing jong phi , namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynriew sngi phin bam ia u kpu bym don thied shuh shuh na ki iing jong phi: namar uno uno uba bam ia u kpu ba la khleh lang naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong haduh ka sngi kaba hynriew , ia kata ka mynsiem yn ot noh na Israel .

en: After this manner ye shall offer daily , throughout the seven days , the meat of the sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ainguh ha U  Trai  ïa ka jingainguh bam hynñiew sngi lynter , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Ainguh ïa kane nalor ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ kaba man ka sngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hadien kane ka rukom phin ai man ka sngi, ha ki hynriew sngi, ia ka doh jong ka jingknia ba la shna da ka ding, ka jingsma kaba thiang ha U Trai: yn ai hajan ka jingainguh thang kaba iai bteng bad ka jingainguh dih jong u .

en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants , and did as the  Lord  had said unto him : and so it was , because he feared his father s household , and the men of the city , that he could not do it by day , that he did it by night .
kha: Kumta u Gideon u shim shiphew ngut na ki shakri jong u bad u leh kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa u . U la sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa ka longïing bad ïa ki briew ha ka nongrit ban leh ïa ka ha ka por mynsngi , kumta u leh ïa ka ha ka por mynmiet .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Gideon u la shim shiphew ngut ki shakri jong u bad u la leh kumba U Trai u la ong ha u: bad kumta ka la long, namar ba u la tieng ia ka iing u kpa jong u bad ki briew jong ka shnong, ba um lah ban leh ia kata ha ka por mynstep, ba u la leh ia kata ha ka por miet .

en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?
kha: Namar phi long kum ka tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw ïa uba la pynkheiñ bad nangta , pyrshah ïa ka jinglong tynrai , la pynïasoh bad u dieng Olib ba la thung . Ki Jiw ki long kum une u dieng uba la thung ; bad kan long kaba kham suk ïa U Blei ban pynïasoh biang ïa kine ki tnat ba la pynkheiñ sha ki dieng jong ki hi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namar lada me la ot noh na u dieng olive uba long khlaw da ka jinglong , bad u dieng olive uba la pyndap pyrshah ia ka mariang: katno tylli kine ki long ki tnat ba kynja met jong ki hi ?

en: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .
kha: Hadien kata , u la leit shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel bad u la pynïeng ïa ka dara hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang sepngi bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u la mane ïa U  Trai .
translated_en_to_kha: U la leit noh nangta sha u lum shaphang mihngi jong ka Bethel, bad u la buh ia ka ïingjain jong u, u la don ka Bethel shaphang sepngi, bad u Ai shaphang mihngi: bad hangta u la tei ïa ka ïingknia ha U Trai .

en: It shall not seem hard unto thee , when thou sendest him away free from thee  ; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee , in serving thee six years : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest .
kha: Wat sngew bynnud haba phi pyllaitluid ïa la u mraw , naba u la pynmyntoi ïa phi ar shah ban ïa u nongbylla sngi haduh hynriew snem . Leh kumta , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ki kam jong phi baroh .
translated_en_to_kha: Kan ym long kaba eh ia me, haba me phah noh ia u na me; namar u la long uba kordor arsien ia me, ha kaba shakri ia me hynriew snem: bad U Trai U Blei jong me un kyrkhu ia me ha kiei kiei baroh kiba me leh .

en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse , and arrayed Mordecai , and brought him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaimed before him , Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour .
kha: Kumta u Haman u shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad u kulai , bad u pynphong ïa ki jaiñphong ha u Mordekai . U Mordekai u kiew ha u kulai , bad u Haman u ïalam ïa u lyngba ka jaka paidbah jong ka nongbah , da kaba pyrta sha ki briew katba ki nang ïaid :  Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u briew uba u kwah ban pyndonburom !
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Haman u la shim ia ka jain bad u kulai, bad u la pynkhreh ia u da u kulai lyngba ka lynti jong ka shnong , bad u la pynbna ha khmat jong u , Kumta yn leh ia uta u briew uba u syiem u sngewbha ban burom .

en: And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?
kha: U Iso u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka sien kaba ar ba u la shet shukor ïa nga . Kam long kaba phylla ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khun nyngkong jong nga , bad mynta pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato phim shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkhu ïa nga ?
translated_en_to_kha: Bad u la ong: Hato um shym la jer kyrteng hok ia u Jakob ? namar u la pynkylla ia nga ha kine ki ar sien: u la shim noh ia ka hok kha jong nga; bad, ha khmih, mynta u la shim noh ia ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Bad u la ong: Hato phim shym la buh kyrpang ia nga ?

en: And when ye shall come into the land , and shall have planted all manner of trees for food , then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised : three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you : it shall not be eaten of .
kha: Ynda phi poi ha ri Kanaan bad thung ïa uno uno u jait diengsoh , ñiew ba u soh jong u , u long u bymkhuid haduh lai snem . Hapoh kane ka por phim dei ban bam ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ynda phi la wan sha ka ri bad phin sa thung ia ki dieng baroh ki bym pat tyrkhong: lai snem kan long kum ka bym pat tyrkhong ha phi: ym dei ban bam ia u .

en: How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .
kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Balei ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong nga ? Ki la iehnoh ïa nga , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei ki bymshisha . Nga la bsa ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin da kdang , hynrei ki la leh awria , bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki bad ki nuti .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumno ngan map ia me na ka bynta kane ? ki khun jong me ki la iehnoh ia nga, bad ki la smai da ki bym dei ki blei: haba nga la ai bam ia ki haduh katta katta, nangta ki la leh ia ka kam sniew, bad ki la ialum lang da ki shipai ha ki iing kiba sniew .

en: And it came to pass , when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron , that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation : and , behold , the cloud covered it , and the glory of the  Lord  appeared .
kha: Hadien ba ki la ïalumlang baroh ban pynpaw pyrshah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki la phai shaphang ka Ïingjaiñ bad ki la ïohi ba u lyoh u la tap ïa ka bad ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka la paw .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia, haba ka jingiaseng ka la ialum lang pyrshah ia u Moses bad pyrshah ia u Aaron, ba ki peit sha ka iingjain jong ka jingiaseng: bad, ha khmih, u lyoh u la tap ia ka, bad ka burom U Trai ka la paw .

en: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand , and the seven golden candlesticks . The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches : and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches .
kha: Kane ka dei ka jingmut barieh jong ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur kiba me ïohi ha ka kti kamon jong nga , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar : Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ki long ki angel jong ki hynñiew tylli ki balang , bad ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki balang .
translated_en_to_kha: Ka jingmaham jong ki hynriew tylli ki khlur kiba me la iohi ha ka kti kadiang jong nga, bad ki hynriew tylli ki sharak ksiar . Ki hynriew tylli ki khlur ki long ki angel jong ki hynriew tylli ki balang: bad ki hynriew tylli ki sharak kiba me la iohi ki long ki hynriew tylli ki balang .

en: And , behold , I will give to thy servants , the hewers that cut timber , twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat , and twenty thousand measures of barley , and twenty thousand baths of wine , and twenty thousand baths of oil .
kha: Kum ka jingpynbiang ïa ki nongtrei jong phi , ngan phah sha phi ar hajar ton u kew , ar hajar ton u barli , saw lakh litar ka waiñ bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad, ha khmih, ngan ai ha ki shakri jong me, ki nongot dieng, arphew hajar tylli ki jingthew ba la ot bad arphew hajar tylli ki jingthew barli bad arphew hajar tylli ki um dih wain bad arphew hajar tylli ki um dih umphniang .

en: Behold therefore , I will gather thee unto thy fathers , and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace  ; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place . And they brought the king word again .
kha: bad ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ngan wallam ha Jerusalem kan nym wan haduh hadien ka jingïap jong phi . Ngan shah ïa phi ban ïap ha kaba suk .  Ki rangbah ki leit phai pat sha u syiem Josaïah bad kane ka khubor .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha khmih namarkata , ngan lum ia me sha ki kpa tymmen jong me, bad me shah lum ha ka jingtep jong me ha ka jingsuk ; bad ki khmat jong me kin ym iohi ia ka jingsniew baroh kaba ngan wanrah ha kane ka jaka . Bad ki la wanrah biang ia ka ktien syiem .

en: Then Jael Heber s wife took a nail of the tent , and took an hammer in her hand , and went softly unto him , and smote the nail into his temples , and fastened it into the ground : for he was fast asleep and weary . So he died .
kha: U Sisera u la thait haduh katta katta ba u da ïohthiah jar . Nangta ka Jael ka shim ïa u tyrnem bad u snar pynskhem dara , ka la leit mian mian sha u , bad ka pynïap ïa u da kaba sah ïa u snar na ka moi moi jong u ha ban da pei phlait haduh khyndew .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta ka tnga jong u Heber ka la shim ia u nar ha ka kti jong ka, bad ka la leit jem sha u, bad ka la pynkhih ia u nar ha ki temple jong u, bad ka la pynkhih ia u shapoh khyndew: namar u la iohthiah lyngngai bad u la thait . Kumta u la iap .

en: Now these are the kings of the land , which the children of Israel smote , and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun , from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon , and all the plain on the east :
kha: Ki paid Israel ki la lah jop bad kam kynti ïa ka ri kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , naduh ka Them Arnon haduh ka Them Jordan bad shaduh u Lum Hermon ha ka phang bashatei . Ki la jop ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kine ki long ki syiem jong ka ri, kiba ki khun Israel ki la leit sha shiliang ka wah Jordan sha ka liang mihngi jong ka sngi, naduh ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Hermon, bad ka madan baroh shaphang mihngi:

en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .
kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jia , khnang ba ngin lah ban ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don uba la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong ïa kata .
translated_en_to_kha: Mano ba la pynbna naduh kaba sdang, ba ngin tip ? bad shuwa kata, ba ngin ong , U long uba hok ? Hooid , ym don mano mano ruh kiba pynpaw , hooid , ym don mano mano ruh kiba iohsngew ia ki ktien jong phi .

en: And Elijah said unto Elisha , Tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Beth–el . And Elisha said unto him , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they went down to Beth–el .
kha: bad ha lynti u Elijah u ong ïa u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Bethel .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingïaineh skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  uba im bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit sha Bethel .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elijah u la ong ha u Elisha, To leit sah hangne, nga kyrpad ia me namar U Trai u la phah ia nga sha Bethesel . U Elisha u la ong ha u, Kumba U Trai u im, bad kumba ka mynsiem jong me ka im, ngan ym iehnoh ia me . Kumta ki la leit hiar sha Bethesel .

en: But as for thee , stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it .
kha: Hynrei me pat , Moses , men sah hangne bad nga , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . Hikai ïa ki ha u paidbah ba kin sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki .’
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei me, to ieng hangne hajan jong nga, bad ngan kren ha me ia ki hukum baroh bad ki hukum bad ki jingbishar kiba me hikai ia ki, ba kin leh ia ki ha ka ri kaba nga ai ia ki ban ioh ia ka .

en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , why weepest thou ? whom seekest thou ?  She , supposing him to be the gardener , saith unto him , Sir , if thou have borne him hence , tell me where thou hast laid him , and I will take him away .
kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka ,  Ïano pha wad ?  Ka la nang pyrkhat ba u la dei u nongsumar kper , kumta ka la ong ha u ,  Lada me la rah noh ïa u , ko kynrad , to ïathuh ïa nga hangno me la buh ïa u , bad ngan ïoh leit bad shim ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Jisu u ong ia ka, Ko kynthei, balei me iam ? mano ba phi wad ? Ka da kaba shim ba u dei u nongrep, ka ong ha u, ko sahep, lada me la kha ia u kumta to iathuh ia nga shano me la buh ia u, bad ngan shim noh ia u .

en: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt , the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers , which hath said , My river is mine own , and I have made it for myself .
kha: To ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ïathuh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt : Nga long u nongshun jong me , ma me u kuratia bakynsha , uba dem ha ka wah . Me ong ba ka wah Nile ka long ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Kren , bad ong , Kumta u Trai Blei; Ha khmih , nga long pyrshah ia me, ko syiem Ijipt , u bsein uba khraw uba shong hapdeng ki wah jong u , uba la ong , Ka wah jong nga ka long ka jong nga hi , bad nga la thaw ia ka na ka bynta lade .

en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : therefore he said to his chariot man , Turn thine hand , that thou mayest carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .
kha: Kumno re kumno pat , u shipai Syria u siat ïa u khnam uba dei ïa u syiem Ahab hapdeng ka jaka bapyndait ïa ka jingkieng atiar jong u .  Nga la mynsaw !  u pyrta sha u nongñiah ka kali ïapom jong u .  Phai noh bad phet noh na ka thma !
translated_en_to_kha: Uwei u briew u la ring ia ka bow ha ka jaka ri jingri, bad u la shoh ia u syiem Israel hapdeng ki shyieng jong u sohjew: namarkata u la ong ha u briew jong u: To pynphai ia ka kti jong me, ba me lah ban rah ia nga na ka kynhun shipai; namar nga la mynsaw .

en: Now it came to pass , when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the  Lord  had commanded him to speak unto all the people , that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him , saying , Thou shalt surely die .
kha: bad hamar ba nga la pyndep ïa baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban kren , ki la kem ïa nga bad pyrta ,  Me dei ban shah pynïap namar kane !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ka la jia, haba u Jeremaiah u la pyndep ia kaba kren ia kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la hukum ia u ban kren ha ki briew baroh, ba ki lyngdoh bad ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki briew baroh ki la shim ia u da kaba ong: Me dei ban iap shisha .

en: And Boaz said unto her , At mealtime come thou hither , and eat of the bread , and dip thy morsel in the vinegar . And she sat beside the reapers : and he reached her parched corn , and she did eat , and was sufficed , and left .
kha: Ha ka por bam , u Boas u ong ïa ka Ruth ,  Wan bad shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad wieh ïa u ha kane ka sos   .  Kumta ka la shong lang bad ki nongtrei , bad u Boas u ai ïa ka katto katne u kew sdieh . Ka la bam haduh ban da sngewhun , bad ka dang don katto katne ka jingbam kaba sah tam .
translated_en_to_kha: U Boaz u la ong ha ka, Ha ka por bam, bad bam ia u kpu, bad pynngam ia ka jingbam jong me ha ka umsoh . Bad ka la shong hajan ki nongot: bad u la poi ha u kew ba la tyrkhong jong ka, bad ka la bam, bad ka la biang bad ka la leit noh .

en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria , and was sick : and he sent messengers , and said unto them , Go , enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease .
kha: U Ahasaïah , u syiem Israel u la hap na ka jaka jngoh kai halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Samaria , bad u la mynsaw jur . Kumta u phah katto katne ki nonglamktien ban kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei jong ka Ekron , ka nongbah Philistia , khnang ban tip la un ïohkhiah ne em .
translated_en_to_kha: U Ahasaiah u la hap lyngba ka jingpang ha ka kamra kaba shalor jong u kaba don ha Samaria: bad u la phah ia ki nonglam khubor bad u la ong ha ki: To leit kylli ia u Baalzebul u blei jong u Ekron la ngan koit ne em na kane ka jingpang .

en: Gather the people together , men , and women , and children , and thy stranger that is within thy gates , that they may hear , and that they may learn , and fear the  Lord  your God , and observe to do all the words of this law :
kha: Khot lang ïa ki shynrang , ïa ki kynthei , bad ïa ki khynnah baroh , bad ïa ki nongwei ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , khnang ba uwei pa uwei un ïohsngew ïa ka bad un nang ban burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong U .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniasoh lang ia ki briew, ki shynrang bad ki kynthei bad ki khun bad ki nongwei jong me kiba don hapoh ki khyrdop jong me, ba kin iohsngew bad ba kin nang, bad kin sheptieng ia U Trai U Blei jong phi, bad kin sumar ban leh ia ki ktien baroh jong kane ka hukum:

en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , the flesh and the blood , upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God : and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God , and thou shalt eat the flesh .
kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka duwan U  Trai . Kñia ruh ïa kita ki jingainguh na kiba phi bam ïa ka doh jong ki , bad theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad men aiti ia ki jingknia thang jong me, ia ka doh bad ka snam, halor ka jingknia U Trai jong me: bad ka snam jong ki jingknia jong me kan sa theh halor ka jingknia U Trai jong me, bad me dei ban bam ia ka doh .

en: And it came to pass , that in process of time , after the end of two years , his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness : so he died of sore diseases . And his people made no burning for him , like the burning of his fathers .
kha: Kumba ar snem ka la nang jur tad haduh ba u syiem u la ïap ha ka jingkordit . Ki raïot jong u kim shym thang ding shabar ha kaba ïambriew ïa u kumba la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong u .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia ba ha ka por kaba ar snem, ki bniat jong u ki la hap noh namar ka jingpang jong u: kumta u la iap na ki jingpang kiba jur . Bad ki briew jong u kim shym la thang ia u kum ka jingthang ia ki kpa jong u .

en: Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .
kha: U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u dieng ban thang ding bad shi bynta jong u ban pynlong bleithaw . Da shi bynta u pynmeh ding ban pynsyaid ïa lade bad shet kpu ; da kawei pat ka shi bynta u shna blei bad mane ïa ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta kan long na ka bynta u briew ban thang: namar un shim ia ka yes, bad un pynkhluit ia ka, bad u shet kpu ; yes, u shna blei; bad u mane ia ka; u pynlong ia ka ka dur ba la ker; bad u hap ha ka .

en: Sing , O barren , thou that didst not bear  ; break forth into singing , and cry aloud , thou that didst not travail with child : for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife , saith the  Lord .
kha: Ko Jerusalem , pha la long kum ka briew ka bym don khun , hynrei mynta pha lah ban rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen . Mynta phan sa ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka briew kaba u tnga jong ka um ju iehnoh ïa ka !
translated_en_to_kha: Sing, ko barren, me uba khlem shah shuh shuh ha ka jingrwai, bad me uba khlem kha khun: namar ki khun jong kiba la shah pynjot ki kham bun ban ia ki khun jong ka tnga kaba la shongkurim, ong U Trai .

en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .
kha: Balei ba me la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  ba kane ka Templ kan long kum ka Shiloh bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah yn pynjot bad yn ym don bashong ba sah hangta ?  Nangta ki briew ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga .
translated_en_to_kha: Balei me la iathuhlypa ha ka kyrteng U Trai, da kaba ong: Kane ka iing kan long kum ka Shiloh bad kane ka shnong kan long kaba la jot khlem u nongshong shnong ? Bad ki briew baroh ki la ialum lang pyrshah ia u Jeremaiah ha ka iing U Trai .

en: Now Absalom had commanded his servants , saying , Mark ye now when Amnon s heart is merry with wine , and when I say unto you , Smite Amnon  ; then kill him , fear not : have not I commanded you ? be courageous , and be valiant .
kha: bad u bthah ïa la ki shakri :  Khmih haba u Amnon u la buaid palat , bad nangta haba nga ai hukum , pynïap ïa u . Wat sheptieng . Ngan shim jingkitkhlieh hi da lade . To long shlur bad wat sngewlehrain !
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta u Absalom u la hukum ia ki shakri jong u, u da ong, Markos mynta haba ka dohnud jong u Amnon ka sngewbha bad ka wain, bad haba nga ong ha phi, Sngap ia u Amnon; te to pyniap ia u: ngam shym la hukum ia phi ? to long kiba shlur bad to long kiba shlur .

en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land , ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days : on the first day shall be a sabbath , and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath .
kha: Ynda phi la dep lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam hynñiew sngi naduh ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Ka sngi nyngkong ka dei ka sngi shongthait , bad kumjuh ruh ka sngi kaba phra .
translated_en_to_kha: Kumjuh ruh ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai kaba hynriew, haba phi la lum ia u soh jong ka ri, phin leh ia ka jingkhawai ha U Trai hynriew sngi: ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong kan long ka Sabha bad ha ka sngi kaba phra kan long ka Sabha .

en: And it came to pass , after they were departed , that they came up out of the well , and went and told king David , and said unto David , Arise , and pass quickly over the water : for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you .
kha: Haba ki la leit noh , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ki wan mih na kata ka pukri bad ki la leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid . Ki la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Ahithophel u la pynkhreh pyrshah ïa u bad ong ,  To pynkloi bad jam ïa ka wah .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad ka la jia hadien ba ki la leit noh, ba ki la mih na ka thliew bad ki la leit iathuh ha u syiem Dabid bad ki la ong ha u Dabid: To khie noh kloi ia ka um: namar kumta u Ahitophel u la thmu pyrshah ia phi .

en: And an angel of the  Lord  came up from Gilgal to Bochim , and said , I made you to go up out of Egypt , and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers  ; and I said , I will never break my covenant with you .
kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u leit na Gilgal sha Bokhim bad u ong ha ki Israel ,  Nga la shim ïa phi na Ijipt bad wallam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga la ong , ‘ Ngan ym pynkheiñ lano lano ïa ka jutang jong nga bad phi .
translated_en_to_kha: U angel jong U Trai u la wan kiew na Gilgal sha u Bochim bad u la ong , Nga la pynlong ia phi ban leit sha Ijipt bad nga la wanrah ia phi sha ka ri kaba nga la smai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi; bad nga la ong: Ngan ym pynkhein ia ka jutang jong nga bad phi .

en: And as soon as the lad was gone , David arose out of a place toward the south , and fell on his face to the ground , and bowed himself three times : and they kissed one another , and wept one with another , until David exceeded .
kha: Hadien ba uta u khynnah u la leit , u Dabid u ïeng nadien kata ka kynton maw , bad u dem khohsiew bad u nguh lai sien . Baroh ar ngut , ma u bad u Jonathan ki ïa-ïam katba ki dang ïadoh markylliang ; ka jingsngewsih u Dabid ka kham jur ban ïa ka jong u Jonathan .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad tang shu leit noh u khynnah, u Dabid u la mih na ka jaka shaphang shathie, bad u la dem khrup ha ka khyndew: bad ki la ia sngap jar iwei ia iwei pat, bad ki la iam iwei ia iwei pat, haduh ba u Dabid u la palat .

en: And Moses said , It is not meet so to do  ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the  Lord  our God : lo , shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us ?
kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ba ngin leh kumta , namar ki nong Ijipt kin thut haba ngin kñia ïa ki mrad kiba ngi ai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngi pyndonkam ïa kine ki mrad bad pynmong ïa ki nong Ijipt da kaba kñia ïa kine ki jingri ha ka jaka ba ki lah ban ïohi , kin sa lynthem maw ïa ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la ong: Kam long kaba iadei bad ka kam kaba sniew ia ki nong Ijipt ha U Trai jong ngi: ha khmih , hato ngin ym knia ia ka jingleh bein jong ki nong Ijipt ha khmat jong ki , bad hato kin ym maw ia ngi ?

en: And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .
kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka jaka ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .
translated_en_to_kha: La iathuh ha u Dabid baroh bad u la lum lang ia ki Israel baroh, bad u la iaid lyngba ia ka Jordan, bad u la wan ha ki, bad u la buh ia ka thma ha ka thma pyrshah ia ki . Kumta haba u Dabid u la buh ia ka thma ha ka thma pyrshah ia ki Syria , ki la ialeh pyrshah ia u .

en: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth out , and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you , he shall live , and his life shall be unto him for a prey .
kha: Uno uno uba sah ha ka nongbah un shah pynïap ha ka thma , ne da ka  nemsniew , ne da ka jingïapthngan . Hynrei uno uno uba mih shabar bad uba pyndem ha ki Babilonia , kiba dang tur ïaleh mynta ïa ka nongbah , un ym shah pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
translated_en_to_kha: Uta uba sah ha kane ka shnong un iap da ka waitlam bad da ka jingkyrduh: hynrei uta uba leit shabar bad uba hap ha ki Khaldes kiba la shah ktah ha phi, un im bad ka jingim jong u kan long ha u kum ka jingbam .

en: And of the ten horns that were in his head , and of the other which came up , and before whom three fell  ; even of that horn that had eyes , and a mouth that spake very great things , whose look was more stout than his fellows .
kha: Bad nga la kwah ban tip shaphang ki shiphew tylli ki reng halor ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka reng kaba la mih hadien bad kaba la pynhap ïa ki lai tylli ki reng . Ka la don ki khmat bad ka shyntur bad ka da kob sarong . Ka la kham ishyrkhei ban ïa kiwei pat .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad na ki shiphew tylli ki bniat kiba don ha ka khlieh jong u, bad na kiwei pat kiba la wan shaneng, bad ha khmat jong u lai tylli ki la hap; wat na kata ka bniat kaba don ki khmat, bad ka shyntur kaba kren ia kiei kiei kiba khraw shibun, kiba ka dur jong u ka kham jem ban ia ki paralok jong u .

en: The adversaries of the  Lord  shall be broken to pieces  ; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them : the  Lord  shall judge the ends of the earth  ; and he shall give strength unto his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed .
kha: Ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  yn pynjot ; kum u pyrthat na bneng un tied pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ; Un ai ka bor ha la u syiem , Un pynlong ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u ban ïoh ïa ka jingjop .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki nongshun jong U Trai kin shah pynpra noh na bneng: U Trai un bishar ia ki kut jong ka khyndew ; bad un ai bor ia u syiem jong u, bad un pynkiew ia ka horn jong u ba la pynsleh .

en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets , and the  Lord  set every man s sword against his fellow , even throughout all the host : and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath , and to the border of Abel–meholah , unto Tabbath .
kha: Katba ki rangbah jong u Gideon ki dang put ïa la ki turoi , U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun ban tur ïaleh para ma ki da la ki waitlam . Ki la mareh sha Sarethan haduh Beth Shittah , haduh ka nongrit jong ka Abel Meholah hajan ka Tabbath .
translated_en_to_kha: Ki lai spah ngut ki la pyrta ia ki turoi, bad U Trai u la buh ia ka waitlam jong u, wat ha baroh kawei ka kynhun shipai: bad u kynhun shipai u la phet noh sha Bethesheta ha Serratha bad sha u pud u sam jong u Abelmehlah, haduh Tabat .

en: But let him that glorieth glory in this , that he understandeth and knoweth me , that I am the  Lord  which exercise lovingkindness , judgment , and righteousness , in the earth : for in these things I delight , saith the  Lord .
kha: Lada uno uno u kwah ban kob sarong , u dei ban kob sarong ba u ithuh bad ba u shemphang ïa nga , namar ka jingieit jong nga ka long kaba neh , bad nga leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba dei . Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei to ai ba uta uba pyndonburom ia ka burom ha kane, ba u sngewthuh bad tip ia nga, ba nga long U Trai uba leh ia ka jingieit, ka jingbishar bad ka hok, ha ka khyndew: namar ha kine kiei kiei nga sngewbha, ong U Trai .

en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Paddan–aram , to take him a wife from thence  ; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan  ;
kha: U Iso u la ïoh jingtip ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob bad ba u la phah noh ïa u sha Mesopotamia ban shem ïa ka tnga . U la ïoh jingtip ruh ba haba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u , u hukum ba un ym shongkurim ïa ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba u Iso u la iohi ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ia u Jakob, bad u la phah noh ia u sha Paddanaram, ban shim ia ka tnga na kata ka por ; bad ba kumba u la kyrkhu ia u u la ai hukum ia u da kaba ong: Wat shim ia ka tnga jong ki khun kynthei u Kanaan ; .

en: That they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands , and with their idols have they committed adultery , and have also caused their sons , whom they bare unto me , to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .
kha: Ki la klim bad pynïap briew — kaba klim bad ki bleithaw bad ka jingpynïap ïa ki khun kiba la kha na ka bynta jong nga . Ki kñia ïa ki khun jong nga ha ki bleithaw jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: Ba ki la leh ia ka kam sniew, bad ka snam ka don ha ki kti jong ki, bad da ki bleithaw jong ki ki la leh ia ka kam sniew, bad ki la pynlong ruh ia ki khun shynrang jong ki kiba ki kha ha nga, ban iaid na ka bynta jong ki lyngba ka ding, ban bam ia ki .

en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .
kha: Hangta u Jephthah u lumlang ïa ki rangbah Gilead baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Ephraim , bad u jop ïa ki . ( Naba ki Ephraim ki ong ,  Phi ki Gilead kiba ha Ephraim bad Manasseh phi dei ki nongphetwir na Ephraim !  )
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u Jephthah u la lum lang ia ki briew jong ka Gilead baroh: bad ki briew jong ka Gilead ki la ia tyngkhuh bad u Ephraim , namar ki la ong , Ki Gilead ki long ki nongleh bymman jong u Ephraim bad ki nongleh kam sniew .

en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon , first and last , are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite , and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat ?
kha: Ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingïathuh shaphang u Solomon naduh ba sdang haduh ba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori u Nathan u Nongïathuhlypa  , ha  Ka Jingïathuhlypa u Ahijah uba na Shiloh  , bad ha  Ki Jingïohipaw u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa  , kiba ïathuh ruh shaphang ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta kiwei pat ki kam jong u Solomon, nyngkong bad khatduh, hato ym shym la thoh ha ka kot u Natha u nongiathuhlypa bad ha ka jingiathuhlypa jong u Ahijah u Shilonite bad ha ki jingphohsniew jong u Ido u nongiathuhlypa u Jeroboan u khun u Nobat ?

en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant which the  Lord  made with you , then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights , I neither did eat bread nor drink water :
kha: Nga kiew ïa uta u lum ban pdiang ïa ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi . Nga sah hangta sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei .
translated_en_to_kha: Haba nga la leit sha u lum ban pdiang ia ki miej maw, wat ia ki miej jong ka jutang kaba U Trai u la leh bad phi , te nga la sah ha u lum sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , ngam shym la bam ia u kpu ne dih um:

en: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt , that they might give him horses and much people . Shall he prosper ? shall he escape that doeth such things ? or shall he break the covenant , and be delivered ?
kha: Hynrei u syiem ka Judah u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah bad u la phah briew sha Ijipt ban ïoh ki kulai bad ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Hato un jop ? Hato u lah ban leh ei ei da kata ? Um lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok bad leit khlem shah pynshitom !
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei u la leh pyrshah ia u ha kaba phah ia ki nonglam khubor jong u sha Ijipt, ba kin ai ia u kulai bad bun ki briew . Hato un jop ? un lait na kaba leh ia kum kita kiei kiei ? lane un pynpra ia ka jutang bad un shah pyllait ?

en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;
kha: bad la shaniah ha ki ïa kine ki kam : ban ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron bad ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ , ban sumar ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra jong ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namar ka kam jong ki ka long ban ap ia ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron na ka bynta ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Trai, ha ki phyllaw bad ha ki kamra bad ha ka jingpynkhuid ia kiei kiei baroh kiba khuid bad ka kam jong ka jingshakri jong ka iing U Blei;

en: Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .
kha: U mareh sha u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u bad u pynïap ïa u . Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ba u rangkynsai jong ki u la shah pynïap , ki phet krad .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata u Dabid u la mareh bad u la ieng halor ka Philistia, bad u la sei ia ka waitlam jong u, bad u la pyniap ia u, bad u la ot noh ia ka khlieh jong u da kata . Bad haba ki Philistia ki la iohi ba u nongialehkai jong ki u la iap .

en: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers  ; as Barnabas , and Simeon that was called Niger , and Lucius of Cyrene , and Manaen , which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch , and Saul .
kha: Ha ka balang ha Antiokh la don katto katne ngut ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki nonghikai : U Barnabas , u Simeon ( ïa uba la khot u Niger ) , u Lukios ( na Kyrini ) bad u Manaen ( ïa uba la pynsan pynrangbah bad u Herod Antipas uba long u lyngskor ) bad u Saul .
translated_en_to_kha: Mynta ki don ha ka balang kaba la don ha Antiok katto katne ki nongiathuhlypa bad ki nonghikai; bad u Simeon uba la khot u Niger, bad u Lucius u Cyrene bad u Manaen, kiba la pynsan pynrangbah bad u Herod u Herod u Tetrarch bad u Saul .

en: These things ye shall do unto the  Lord  in your set feasts , beside your vows , and your freewill offerings , for your burnt offerings , and for your meat offerings , and for your drink offerings , and for your peace offerings .
kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingainguh waiñ , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok ba phi dei ban ai sha U  Trai  ha ki Jingkhawai Niam ba la buh . Kine ki long nalor kito ki jingainguh kiba phi ai ha kaba pyndep ïa ka jingkular lane kum ki jingainguh mon sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Kine kiei kiei kiba phi dei ban leh ha U Trai ha ki jingkhawai jong phi, nalor ki jingkular jong phi, bad ki jingainguh ba laitluid jong phi, na ka bynta ki jingknia thang jong phi, bad na ka bynta ki jingknia bam jong phi, bad na ka bynta ki jingknia jingsuk jong phi .

en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came out two women , and the wind was in their wings  ; for they had wings like the wings of a stork : and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven .
kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad ïohi ïa ki ar ngut ki kynthei kiba her sha nga lem bad ki thapniang bakhlaiñbor kum kito ki jong ka thring . Ki la shim ïa ka shang bad ki her noh lem bad ka .
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta nga la rah ia ki khmat jong nga, bad nga la peit, bad, ha khmih, ki la mih arngut ki kynthei, bad ka Iyer ka la don ha ki bniat jong ki: bad ki la rah ia ka ephah hapdeng ka khyndew bad ka bneng .

en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us , saying , Take victuals with you for the journey , and go to meet them , and say unto them , We are your servants : therefore now make ye a league with us .
kha: Ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka ri jong ngi ki ong ïa ngi ban khreh katto katne ka jingbam na ka bynta ka jingleit bad ban leit ïakynduh ïa phi . La ong ba ngi dei ban buh ïa lade ban shakri ïa phi bad ban kyrpad ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ki rangbah jong ngi bad ki nongshong shnong jong ngi baroh ki kren ha ngi, ki ong: To leit sha ka jingleit bad phi, bad leit iakynduh ia ki, bad to ong ha ki: Ngi long ki shakri jong phi: namarkata mynta phi ialeh bad ngi .

en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .
kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba la jia ,  u Dabid u la ong .  Ka kynhun shipai jong ngi ka la phet krad na ka madan thma ,  u la jubab ,  bad bun na ki rangïapom jong ngi ki la shah pynïap . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la shah pynïap .
translated_en_to_kha: U Dabid u la ong ha u, Kumno ka kam ka la iaid ? Nga kyrpad ia me, to iathuh ia nga . Bad u la jubab, Ba ki briew ki la phet noh na ka thma, bad bun na ki briew ruh ki la hap bad ki la iap; bad u Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la iap .

en: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law , and said unto him , Let me go , I pray thee , and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt , and see whether they be yet alive . And Jethro said to Moses , Go in peace .
kha: Nangta u Moses u leit phai sha u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , bad u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban leit phai sha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem ha Ijipt , ban leit khmih la ki dang im ne em .  U Jethro u mynjur bad u la kren khublei ïa u .
translated_en_to_kha: U Moses u la leit phai noh sha u Jethro u kpa jong u, bad u la ong ha u, To ngan leit phai noh sha ki hynmen jong nga kiba don ha Ijipt bad peit la ki dang im ne em . U Jethro u la ong ha u Moses, To leit suk .

en: Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye that tremble at his word  ; Your brethren that hated you , that cast you out for my name s sake , said , Let the  Lord  be glorified : but he shall appear to your joy , and they shall be ashamed .
kha: To sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u kren , phi kiba sheptieng bad kohnguh ïa u :  Namar phi long kiba ïaineh ha nga , katto katne na ki briew jong phi hi ki shun ïa phi bad kin ym don ïadon bynta ei ei bad phi . Ki rkhiebeiñ ïa phi bad ong , ‘ Ai ba U  Trai  un pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u bad pynim ïa phi , kumta ba ngin ïohi ïa phi ba phi shadkmen .’ Hynrei dei ma ki hi , ki ban jahburom !
translated_en_to_kha: To sngap ia ka ktien U Trai , phi kiba khih ha ka ktien jong u; ki hynmen jong phi kiba la shun ia phi, kiba bret noh ia phi na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong nga: Hato U Trai un paw ha ka jingkmen jong phi: bad kin sngewlehrain .

en: Yea , they shall not be planted  ; yea , they shall not be sown : yea , their stock shall not take root in the earth : and he shall also blow upon them , and they shall wither , and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble .
kha: Ki long tang kum ki jingthung ba dang lung , ba dang shu mih bad bym pat suhthied , haba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka lyer , ki tyrkhong noh bad kit noh kum u phlangïap .
translated_en_to_kha: Hooid , kin ym shah 

en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , saith God , I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh : and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams :
kha: ‘ Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan leh ha ki sngi bakhatduh , U Blei u ong : Ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor uwei pa uwei baroh . Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw , bad ki rangbah ba la tymmen jong phi kin ïoh ki jingphohsniew .
translated_en_to_kha: Bad kan sa jia ha ki sngi ba khatduh , ko Blei , ngan theh noh na U Mynsiem jong nga halor ka doh baroh: bad ki khun shynrang bad kynthei jong phi kin iathuhlypa , bad ki samla jong phi kin iohi ia ki jingphohsniew , bad ki rangbah jong phi kin phohsniew:

en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .
kha: Shisien , haba la don ka  nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha Gilgal . Katba u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jong u ban tiew ïa u khiew uba heh ha ding bad shet syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .
translated_en_to_kha: U Elisha u la wan phai biang sha Gilgal : bad ka la don ka jingduna ha ka ri ; bad ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa ki la shong ha khmat jong u : bad u la ong ha u shakri jong u: To buh ha ka umphniang kaba khraw bad u symbai na ka bynta ki khun ki nongiathuhlypa .

en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
kha: Bad kumta ïa ka kular la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit , khnang ba ïa ka jingngeit yn pynthikna kum ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa baroh kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham — ym tang ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka Hukum , hynrei ïa kito ruh kiba ngeit kumba u Abraham u la leh . Namar u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi baroh ;
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata ka long na ka jingngeit , ba ka lah ban long da ka jingaiei;

en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark , every man in the chambers of his imagery ? for they say , The  Lord  seeth us not  ; the  Lord  hath forsaken the earth .
kha: U Blei u la kylli ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , me ïohi aïu ki rangbah Israel ki ïaleh ha kaba rieh ? Baroh ki ïamane ha ka kamra kaba dap da ki dur bleithaw . Ka jingpynksan jong ki ka long : ‘ U  Trai  um ïohi ïa ngi ! U la iehnoh ïa ka ri .’
translated_en_to_kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga, Ko khun u briew, me la iohi ia kaei kaba ki rangbah jong ka iing Israel ki leh ha ka jingdum ? namar ki ong , U Trai um ju iohi ia ngi; U Trai u la iehnoh ia ka khyndew .

en: And with them he sent Levites , even Shemaiah , and Nethaniah , and Zebadiah , and Asahel , and Shemiramoth , and Jonathan , and Adonijah , and Tobijah , and Tob–adonijah , Levites  ; and with them Elishama and Jehoram , priests .
kha: La synran ïa ki da khyndai ngut ki Lebi bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh . Ki Lebi ki long u Shemaïah , u Nethanaïah , u Sebadaïah , u Asahel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehonathan , u Adonijah , u Tobijah bad u Tobadonijah ; bad ki lyngdoh ki long u Elishama bad u Jehoram .
translated_en_to_kha: Da ki u la phah ia ki Lebi, wat ia u Shemaiah, bad u Nethaniah, bad u Asahel, bad u Shemiramot, bad u Jonathan, bad u Adonijah, bad u Tobadonijah, bad bad ki Lebi; bad bad ki ki Elishama bad u Jehoram, ki lyngdoh .

en: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .
kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la kular ïa kane , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan ïaisah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata mynta to ai ba phin kyrkhu ia ka iing jong u shakri jong me, ba kan iai bteng junom ha khmat jong me: namar me, ko Trai Blei, me la kren ia kata: bad da ka jingkyrkhu jong me to ai ba ka iing jong u shakri jong me kan long kaba la kyrkhu junom .

en: But when thou art bidden , go and sit down in the lowest room  ; that when he that bade thee cometh , he may say unto thee , Friend , go up higher : then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee .
kha: Pynban , haba la khot sngewbha ïa phi , khie leit bad shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh , khnang ba u nongpdiang ïa phi un wan ha phi bad ong , ‘ Ale kiew shane , ko paralok jong nga , sha ka jaka ba kham kyrpang .’ Kane kan wanrah ka burom ïa phi ha khmat jong baroh kiwei pat kiba shah khot sngewbha .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei haba me la shah khot, leit shong ha ka kamra kaba rit tam ba haba uta uba la bthah ia me u wan, u lah ban ong ha me, Paralok, to leit shaneng: nangta to mane ha khmat jong ki kiba shong ha ka doh bad me .

en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .
kha: Ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ha ka padun ri shyiap sha mihngi jong ka Jerikho , ki jied ïa ka Beser kaba ha ka jaka ki jait Reuben , ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead ha ka jaka ki jait Gad ; bad ïa ka Golan ha Bashan ha ka jaka ki jait Manasseh .
translated_en_to_kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang ka Jordan da u Jerikos shaphang mihngi, ki la aiti ia u Bezer ha ka ri khlaw na ka jaitbynriew Reuben, bad u Ramoth ha Gilead na ka jaitbynriew Gad, bad u Golan ha Basan na ka jaitbynriew Manasseh .

en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .
kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngba ki surok bah jong phi ! To khmih sawdong ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ïa ki jaka ïew ! Hato phi lah ban shem uwei u briew uba leh ïa kaba dei bad uba pyrshang ban ïaineh ha U Blei ? Lada phi lah , U  Trai  un map ïa ka Jerusalem .
translated_en_to_kha: Pyniaid ia ki lynti jong ka Jerusalem, bad peit mynta, bad tip, bad wad ha ki jaka ba jylliew jong ka, lada phi lah ban shem ia u briew, lada don mano mano ba pyndep ia ka jingbishar, uba wad ia ka jingshisha ; bad ngan map ia ka .

en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts concerning the prophets  ; Behold , I will feed them with wormwood , and make them drink the water of gall : for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land .
kha: Kumta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga ong shaphang ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem :  Ngan ai ïa ki da ki jhur kthang ban bam , bad ka bih ba kin dih ; namar ba ki la pynsaphriang ïa ka jingbymriewblei kylleng ka ri .
translated_en_to_kha: Namarkata kumta u Trai jong ki paid ha kaba iadei bad ki nongiathuhlypa ; Ha khmih , ngan ai bam ia ki da ka um kaba jyrngam: namar na ki nongiathuhlypa jong ka Jerusalem ka la leit sha ka ri baroh kawei .

en: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still  ; that the poor of thy people may eat : and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat . In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard , and with thy oliveyard .
kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba hynñiew ai jingjahthait ïa ka , bad wat ot ïa kaei kaei kaba mih ha ka . Kiba duk ki lah ban bam ïa kaei kaba mih hangta , bad ba ki mradkhlaw ruh kin ïoh bam ïa kaba la iehnoh . Leh kumjuh ïa ki bri sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki brisoh Olib jong phi .
translated_en_to_kha: Hynrei ka snem kaba hynriew me dei ban ai ba kan shongthait bad thiah shuh shuh ba ki baduk jong me kin bam: bad kaei kaba ki iehnoh ia ki mrad ka lyngkha kin bam . Kumjuh ruh men leh ia ka kper sohjew jong me bad ka kper olive jong me .

en: And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .
